title: Dore urutonde rw’abagabo  biyita ibihangange ku isi bigereranya na Yesu [Amafoto]
content:
Ubuzima abantu babayeho usanga intumwa n’abahanuzi ba kera barabigizeho iyerekwa ndetse bakanabihanurira ab’igihe kizaza babinyujije mu byanditswe byera ngo babe maso batazatungurwa no kugaruka k’Umwami Yesu Kirisitu. Mu rwandiko Intumwa Pawulo yandikiye Timoteyo amuhugurira kwitanga amaramaje yavuye imuzi bimwe mu bimenyetso bizagaragaza ko iminsi y’imperuka yegereje amubwira ko mu minsi y’imperuka hazaza ibihe birushya, aho abantu bazaba bikunda, bakunda impiya, birarīra, bibona, batukana, batumvira ababyeyi babo, indashima, batari abera, … bakunda ibibanezeza aho gukunda Imana, bafite ishusho yo kwera ariko bahakana imbaraga zako ndetse anamusaba kugendera kure abameze batyo (2 Timoteyo 3:1-5). Nta gishya munsi y’ijuru kuko byinshi byaravuzwe ndetse biranaboneka. Mu 2014, umunyamakuru akaba n’inzobere mu gufotora, ukomoka muri Norvège, Jonas Bendiksen, yatangiye kwegeranya amafoto atandukanye, agaragaza abagabo bivugira ko ari ba Mesiya uvugwa muri Bibiliya kandi bakigereranya na Yesu. Bamwe muri bo bafite abayoboke uruhuri, abandi bakagira intumwa zibarirwa ku ntoki z’ikiganza kimwe. Bitandukanye n’ibivugwa mu nkuru, cyangwa ibyagiye byandikwa mu mpapuro, aba bahanuzi Bendiksen yagaragaje ko bo ubwabo bagiye babitangaza ku mbuga nkoranyambaga zirimo Facebook ndetse bakabigaragaza mu mashusho kuri YouTube. The Telegraph dukesha iyi nkuru igaragaza ko buri wese yizera ko ari we watoranijwe kugira ngo azacungure Isi. Dore urutonde rw’aba bagabo n’uburyo bagenda bigaragaza imbere y’abayoboke babo: 5. INRI Cristo




Inri Cristo yavukiye muri Leta ya Santa Catarina muri Brazil, ku ya 22 Werurwe 1948. Ni umwarimu uhora avuga ko ari Yesu, akaba yaramenyekanye cyane kubera kugaragara mu bitangazamakuru bitandukanye byo muri Brazil n’ahandi. Inri yagiye agaragara mu biganiro mpaka bivuga ku iyobokamana ari kumwe n’impuguke mu by’iyobokamana nka Padiri Oscar González Quevedo. INRI akunze kuba agaragiwe n’abantu ku mbuga ye kandi yicaye ku ntebe ikoze nk’igare. INRI ubundi ni impine y’amagambo Ponsiyo Pirato yanditse ku mutwe w’umusaraba Yesu yari abambyeho, bikaba bisobanura ngo ‘Yesu Kirisitu, Umwami w’Abayuda’ INRI Cristo yagaragaye muri Brazil mu 2014. Iki gihe, yari atwaye igare ku muharuro we muri Brazilia, ahazwi nka Yerusalemu nshya (The New Jerusalem) INRI Cristo kandi akunda kubwiriza abayoboke be, ahagaze hejuru y’inzu y’umuzamu. Abamukurikiye ari bo ntumwa ze, babaho mu buzima busa n’aho bwihariye kandi bwitarura abandi mu cyaro, bahinga imyaka yabo, kandi bakagendera kuri gahunda n’intego bya INRI. 4. Yesu wa Kitwe Kitwe ni umujyi wa kabiri muri Zambia haba mu bunini no kugira abaturage benshi. Tumfweko wiyise Yesu wa Kitwe yagendaga mu isoko abwiriza kandi atanga ubutumwa bw’amaza ye nk’umucunguzi, muri Zambia mu 2015. Abihuje n’uko Yesu wo muri Bibiliya yari umubaji, Tumfweko wiyise Yesu wa Kitwe abaho mu buzima bwo gutwara abantu. 3. Vissarion Sergey Anatolyevitch Torop yavutse tariki ya 14 Mutarama 1941, mu gace ka Krasnodar mu Burusiya. Abayoboke be bamwita Vissarion bisobanura “uwazanye ubuzima bushya.” Ni we washinze kandi akanayobora urusengero rwitwa “Church of the Last Testament”, rukaba rufite icyicaro muri Siberiya. Afite abayoboke bitwa “Vissarionites” bagera ku bihumbi bine mu gace uru rusengero ruherereyemo, na ho ku Isi yose afite abagera ku bihumbi 10. Vissarion, Kirisitu wa Siberiya, yahoze ari umupolisi wo mu muhanda mu myaka ya 1980. Yatangaje ko ari Yesu Kirisitu, mu gihe cy’isenyuka rya Repubulika Zunze Ubumwe z’Abasoviyeti. Kuva icyo gihe, yegeranije abantu babarirwa hagati y’ibihumbi bitanu n’icumi, ari na bo bahise baba intumwa ze muri Siberiya. Abayoboke be batuye mu bice by’icyaro kure y’inyubako zabo bari basanzwe babamo, kandi ubuzima babamo butandukanye n’ubwo babagamo mbere. Umunsi mukuru ubanzirizwa n’urugendo rumara amasaha 24, rwahujwe n’itariki y’amavuko ya Vissarion iba ku wa 14 Mutarama. Iyi tariki kandi ifatwa nka Noheri ku bayoboke be. 2. Moses Hlongwane Moses Hlongwane wo muri Afurika y’Epfo, na we yigereranye nka Yesu w’i Nazareti wishwe akabambwa nyuma y’iminsi itatu akazuka. Aha yari ari gutanga icyigisho mu bukwe bwe na Angel, umwe mu ntumwa ze. Hari mu 2016, muri Afurika y’Epfo. Moses yavuze ko Imana yamugize Mesiya mu nzozi yagize mu 1992. Icyo gihe yacuruzaga imitako. Uyu mugabo ufite intumwa zirenga 40 kuva muri uwo mwaka yahise atangira kubwiriza i Johannesburg no mu yindi mijyi yo mu karere. Uyu mugabo yavuze ko umunsi w’ubukwe bwe, wabaye intangiriro y’iherezo ry’iminsi. Yigeze kuvuga ko atazapfa kuko ari isezerano Imana yamuhaye. Ibi yabitangaje muri Kamena 2013. 1.David Shayler David Shayler yavukiye mu Bwongereza tariki ya 24 Ukuboza 1965. Inyigisho atanga abwiriza abantu akomeza kugaragaza ko ari we Mesiya ugarutse gucungura abantu. Uyu mugabo yari ari kureba ubwirakabiri mu 2015, ahagaze ku musozi yigeze gutangiraho ubutumwa mu 2008 ubwo yari mu Bwongereza. Salongo Richard

title: Pasiteri wari ukuriye Ivugabutumwa muri ADEPR yirukanwe mu itorero
content: Itorero rya Pantekote mu Rwanda ryirukanye Pasiteri Zigirinshuti Michel, uzwi cyane muri ADEPR, wari ukuriye ivugabutumwa, wamamaye kubera imvugo zidasanzwe akoresha abwiriza. Iki cyemezo ADEPR yagifashe nyuma y’uko Pasiteri Zigirinshuti amaze igihe kirenga ukwezi yarataye akazi ke, adasabye uruhushya nk’uko Umuvugizi wa ADEPR, Rev. Karuranga yabitangaje Yagize ati "Pasiteri Zigirinshuti twamwirukanye kubera ko yataye akazi. Amakuru mfite ni uko ngo yari yaragiye mu bihugu byo hanze. Ntiyigeze atumenyesha n’umuyobozi we wa hafi muri serivisi akoramo ntiyigeze amumenyesha kandi ntiyari mu kiruhuko." Rev. Karuranga yakomeje avuga ko kwirukana Zigirinshuti ADEPR nta tegeko yishe ngo kuko yarengeje iminsi umunani umukozi yihanangirizwa cyangwa agasabwa ibisobanuro. Karuranga ati "Nta tegeko twishe kuko yarengeje iminsi umunani itegeko rivuga ko umukozi yihanangirizwa. We yamaze ukwezi kurenga." Pasiteri Zigirinshuti Michel yaherukaga mu ivugabutumwa muri Afurika y’Epfo mu giterane cyateguwe n’Itorero Fullness of God International Ministries rifatanyije na Parani Pentecostal Church Ministry. Iki giterane cyari gifite insangamatsiko iboneka muri Yeremiya 31:4 handitse hati "Nzongera kukubaka wa mwari wa Isiraheli we.” Twagerageje kuvugisha Zigirinshuti ariko ntabwo twamufatishije kuri telefone ye igendanwa. content: Kuri uyu  wa gatandatu, inkuba yakubise urusengero rwa ADEPR mu Karere ka Rwamagana  mu Murenge wa Munyiginya  mu kagari ka Nkomangwa,   abantu batanu bagira ibibazo by’ihungabana . title: Leta na Islam bumvikanye ku mikoreshereze mishya y’indangururamajwi
content: Inzego za Leta na Islam mu Rwanda zumvikanye ku mikoreshereze mishya y’indangururamajwi zari zaciwe ku misigiti muri Kigali, bigateza impaka mu bumvise icyo cyemezo. Umuvugizi w’Umuryango w’Abayisilamu mu Rwanda, Sheikh Musa Sindayigaya, yatangaje  ko nyuma yo gusabwa gukuraho izo ndangururamajwi, Islam yahuye n’inzego nyinshi za leta hafatwa umurongo wumvikanyweho, hakanakosorwa ahashoboraga kuva ijwi ribangamira abandi. Yagize ati “Icya mbere, hari adhana iriya yo irakomeza nk’uko bisanzwe ariko ku ijwi ritoya ribwira abari mu mbago z’umusigiti, bawuturiye kuko niba hirya gatoya undi musigiti, bivuze ngo buri wose ubwira abari mu mbago zawo ntabwo ari ngombwa ko umusigiti ujya kubwira n’ab’ahandi. Ni umurongo uvuga ngo hari ukureba ijwi ku buryo ritarenga imbago z’abari ku musigiti kuko ari bo (abawusengeramo) baba bakeneye ko babwirwa ko igihe kigeze cy’aho ngaho …Nta musigiti uhari usimbura indi ku buryo ukeneye ijwi ryo hejuru ribwira abantu bose bo mu mujyi. Icyo ni kimwe cyasobanutse neza kandi koko ni ikosa byakoreshwaga nabi.” Yakomeje avuga ko na nyuma ya adhana, hemejwe ko n’Umuyobozi w’amasengesho mu musigiti (Imamu) atazongera kujya acomeka indangururamajwi, ngo yigishe abari imbere ngo n’abari hanze bibereye mu zindi gahunda babyumve. Sheikh Sindayigaya anavuga ko nka mu gitondo hari igihe abantu basenga hari ababa bakiryamye, akaba atari ngombwa gucomeka indangururamajwi. Yakomeje ashimira Leta ku biganiro yagiranye na Islam nyuma y’icyemezo cya Gitifu kitari cyumvikanye neza, hakavamo umurongo ukosora ibitagendaga neza n’idini rikaba rigiye gukomeza imirimo neza nta nkomyi. Ikumirwa ry’indangururamajwi ryaje rikurikira inkubiri y’ifungwa ry’insengero zitujuje ibisabwa hirya no hino mu gihugu. Byageze n’aho abapasiteri bakomeye batawe muri yombi bashinjwa gukora inama zitemewe zo gutambamira iyo gahunda. Abayisilamu umutima wasubiye mu nda kuko bumvaga guca indangururamajwi ku misigiti ari ukubabangamira imigenzo yabo . Chief editor of Muhabura.rw

title: Islam yagize icyo ivuga nyuma yokubuzwa gukoresha indagururamajwi ku misigiti
content:
Nyuma yuko Umurenge wa Nyarugenge  kuri uyu wa gatatu tariki ya 14 Werurwe usohoye itangazo rivuga ko hafashwe icyemezo cyo guhagarika indangururamajwi zo ku misigiti umujyanama wa Mufti w’ Rwanda yatangaje ko kiriya cyemezo cyababangamiye ariko bagiye gusaba Leta ngo ice inkoni izamba,ngo ni byananirana bazifashisha ubundi buryo mugutora Adhana nko gushyira adhana muri telefone, igihe cyagera cyo gusenga ikibutsa nyirayo . hashingiwe ku bugenzuzi bwakozwe ku nsengero n’imisigiti ku wa 19 Gashyantare 2018, bagasanga imisigiti ikoresha indangururamajwi hejuru yayo bigatera urusaku. Mu ibaruwa yandikiwe imisigiti, Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Nyarugenge, Havuguziga Charles, yagize ati “Mbandikiye ngira ngo mbasabe guhagarika gukoresha izo ndangururamajwi mugashaka ubundi buryo budateza urusaku iyo muhamagara abayoboke ku isaha y’isengesho.”

Nyuma y’iki cyemezo Umujyanama wa Mufti w’ Rwanda, Sheikh Mbarushimana Suleiman, yabwiye itangazamakuru  ko guhagarika gukoresha indangururamajwi mu guhamagarira abayoboke gusenga ari icyemezo cyababangamiye. Yagize ati “Twumva ko rero igikwiye atari uguhagarika iyo ‘adhana’ ahubwo ari ukuyikora neza, umuhamagaro ugakorwa ku buryo nta n’umwe ubangamirwa; ubundi ahari nk’amikoro ifite ijwi rirangira bigatuma hari abo ribuza gusinzira cyangwa kuruhuka, ibyo rwose tugasaba ko bikorwa mu ijwi ryiza rigera kuri ba bandi bakora isengesho kuri uwo musigiti.”

Yakomeje avuga ko ‘gutora adhana’ bishingiye ku kwemera kw’ibanze kwa Islam agira ati"kuko n’ubundi uba uhamagarira abantu kuza gusingiza ya Mana imwe, gusenga ya Mana imwe, iruta byose; kubakura muri wa murongo w’ibindi bikorwa bakibagirwa igihe cyo gushimira Imana. Ku buryo rero kuba hari uwavuga ati ‘uwo muhamagaro nuhagarare’ yaba ahagaritse kwemera Imana no kuyiha agaciro ikwiye mu gihe cyayo.” Mu gihe leta yahakanira Islam gukomeza gukoresha indangururamajwi, Sheikh Mbarushimana yavuze ko hari izindi nzira eshatu bahita bifashisha mu ‘gutora adhana’. Yagize ati “Twasaba ko ziriya ndangururamajwi, amajwi agarukira imbere mu rusengero, tukongera tugakoresha ubundi buryo bwa kabiri bwo kumenyereza abayisilamu ko igihe cyo gusenga niba kigeze baba bakizi bose bakahagera mbere y’igihe. Ku buryo na wa wundi wari utegereje ko ari bwumve ijwi rimuhamagara rirangurura ridahari, akabimenya akibwiriza akaza mbere.” Uretse ubwo, Sheikh Mbarushimana yavuze ko kuri ubu ikoranabuhanga rifasha, ku buryo adhana yashyirwa muri telefone, igihe cyagera ikibutsa nyirayo ko isaha yo gusenga ibura iminota 15, akitegura. Inzego za leta zimaze iminsi mu igenzura ry’insengero hirya no hino mu gihugu, aho zisanze hari ibyo zibura zigafungwa. I Kigali no mu Majyaruguru gusa, hafunzwe insengero zirenga 1400. Mu birebwa harimo no kuba zidateza urusaku aho zikorera. Yanditswe na Habarurema Djamali

title: Kicukiro: Urusengero rwa ADEPR rwafashwe n’inkongi y’umuriro
content:
Urusengero rwa ADEPR ruri aho bita SGM i Gikondo mu Karere ka Kicukiro mu Mujyi wa Kigali rwafashwe n’inkongi y’umuriro rurashya rurakongoka.Ibyo byabaye kuri uyu wa gatatu tariki 14 Werurwe ku gicanunsi.

Icyateye iyi nkongi y’uru rusengero ntabwo kiramenyekana, gusa abari bari hafi yarwo rugitangira gushya batangarije bavuze  ko ikibatsi cy’umuriro cyaturutse muri za matela zari zarakoreshejwe imbere ku bikuta by’uru rusengero nk’izirinda ko ijwi ryasohoka hanze,ariko ntabwo bamenye  neza icyaba cyatumye izo matera zifatwa n’uwo muriro cyangwa inkomoko yawo. Ubwo abantu bari  hafi bagerageje kuzimya iyi nkongi ndetse batabaza na Polisi ariko biranga biba iby’ubusa kuko umuriro wari mwinshi cyane. Ibyari muri uru rusengero byose byangiritse ku buryo nta na kimwe cyarokowe n’ubwo agaciro k’ibyarimo byose kataramenyekana. Umuyobozi w’akarere ka Kicukiro Dr Nyirahabimana Jeanne yatangarije Muhabura.rw ko ibyo byabaye ari mu nama atari yabimenya ariko agiye kubikurikirana. Yagize ati"Ibyo ntabwo ndabimenya kuko nahoze munama ariko ndaje mbaze ndajya kubabwira nimbimenya".

Iyi nkongi y’umuriro yibasiye uru rusengero rwa ADEPR, ije nyuma y’uko inkuba zari zimaze iminsi zibasira zimwe munsengero  ndatse bamwe mu ba kirisitu bakahasiga ubuzima. 
Ibintu byose byari mu rusengero umuriro wabifashe  birakongoka
 Yanditswe na Habarurema Djamali

title: Urusengero rw’Abadivantisite rwafunzwe abayoboke  Babura aho bakorera isabato[REBA AMAFOTO]
content:
Mu gitondo  cyo kuri  uyu wa Gatandatu taliki ya 10, Abadiventisiti  b’Umunsi  wa karindwi  bakorera  amateraniro  yabo mu rusengero rw’Abadivantisite ruherereye  i Nyamirambo  hafi yo kuri Club Rafiki  mu karere ka Nyarugenge babaye  nk’abakubiswe n’inkuba  nyuma yo kujya gukora  amasengesho yo ku munsi w’isabato  basanga  ingufuri yumanye n’umuryango  bakwiragira  imishwaro  bashakisha aho bateranira. 
 Uru rusengero rw’Abadiventisiti rwafunzwe ku wa Gatanu, tariki ya 9 Werurwe 2018,  nyuma y’ubugenzuzi bwakozwe n’Umurenge wa Nyamirambo nk’uko bigaragara ku itangazo ubuyobozi bw’uwo murenge  bwasohoye . Mu biri kwitabwaho mbere yo gufata gahunda yogufunga urusengero uru n’uru,ni uko ubugenzuzi buri kwita kuri ibi:imiterere y’insengero, niba aho zikorera hemewe hatagenewe inzu  zo guturwamo ngo  zibe za sakuriza abaturage, kuba zitazengurukijwe  shitingi cyangwa amabati ku nkuta,kuba zifite ubwiherero buhagije, zifite parking  y’imodoka ikwiye, kuba byibuze urusengero ruri ku buso bwa hegitari, kuba insengero zifite uburyo bwo gufata amazi ava ku bisenge,ikiyongereyeho kandi  idini cyangwa se itorero rihasengera cyangwa rihateranira rikaba rifite icyangombwa kiriha uburenganzira bwo gukora. Gusa nyuma y’uko uru rusengero  rufunzwe, Umunyamakuru yageze aho ruhereye mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu(Ku isabato) asanga hari abayoboke babuze aho bizihiriza umunsi w’isabato. Uyu munsi w’Isabato uhabwa agaciro gakomeye muri iri torero bitewe n’uko abayoboke baryo bawemera cyane ku buryo nta kintu na kimwe cyerekeranye n’umurimo bashobora kuwukoraho ahubwo uba ari umunsi w’ikiruhuko no gusenga gusa. Nta byo kurya indimi bamwe batangarije umunyamakuru ko bibatunguwe  kuba basanze  urusengero rwabo rwashyizweho ingufuri. Umwe muri bo yagize ati “Birababaje cyane kubona urusengero nk’uru rufungwa kubera ibibazo by’ubuziranenge hanyuma ngo tujye gusengera mu Rugunga. Abayoboke benshi baba bibaza ikiba cyabuze kugira ngo bigere aho urusengero rufungwa.” Undi witwa Shyirambere Viateur yagize ati “Nanjye byantunguye gusanga rufunze ariko nta gikuba cyacitse kuko nibamara kuzuza ibyo basabwe tuzongera tuhasengere.” Ifungwa ry’uru rusengero rukomeye rw’Abadiventisiti rije nyuma y’uko hafunzwe urundi rukomeye rwa ADEPR Nyarugenge  ndetse kandi mu Mujyi wa Kigali hamaze gufungwa izirenga 714 zirimo 156 muri 352 z’abadive  mu Karere ka Kicukiro, muri Gasabo hafunzwe 355 muri 699 naho muri Nyarugenge hafunzwe 203 muri 300. 
Iki gikorwa cyo gufunga insengero zitujuje ibisabwa cyageze no mu turere twose tugize igihugu. 
Shyirambere Viateur nawe yatunguwe ni bibabye uyu munsi
Aba bayoboke batangiye kubunza imitima bashaka aho bajya guteranira 

Aba bahise bayoborwa kwizihiriza isabato  mu Rugunga kuko niho hari hafi

 Yanditswe na Chief Editor

title: Insengero  zikomeye  nazo zagezweho n’inkubiri yo gufunga insegero zitujuje  ibisabwa
content:
Urusengero ruri mu zikomeye ruri muzabanje kubakwa rwa ADEPR Nyarugenge ruherereye mu Mujyi wa Kigali rwagati ahazwi nko mu Gakinjiro rwagezweho n’inkubiri yo gufunga insengero zitujuje ibisabwa.Ibi byabaye yuma yo gusanga rutujuje ibisabwa birwemerera gukorerwamo amateraniro.

Itangazo ryashyizweho umukono n’ubuyobozi bw’Umurenge wa Nyarugenge rimenyesha ko uru rusengero “rwafunzwe kuko aho rukorera hatujuje ibisabwa”Rikaba riri ku mpande zose z’urusengero ngo hatagira uwifasha ko ataribonye ngo yinjiremo ahasengere kandi bibujijwe. 
Iri niryo tangazo rihamanitse ribuza kwinjiramo gukoreramo amateraniro Uru rusengero ruri mu za mbere zubatswe mu Mujyi wa Kigali aho Itorero rya ADEPR ryashinze imizi ahagana mu 1978 ritangiriye i Gasave, Paruwase yaguye imiryango ikabyara iya Nyarugenge. Kuri uyu mudugudu niho habarizwa Korali Hoziana ifite amateka ahambaye muri ADEPR kuko yabonye izuba mu 1978 ndetse habarizwa n’abandi bakomeye bazwi muri ADEPR mu nzego zitandukanye. Iki gikorwa cyo gufunga insengero zitujuje ibicyenewe  cyahereye  mu Mujyi wa Kigali mu mpera za Gashyantare aho izigera kuri 714 zafunzwe kandi  cyakurikiranye n’itabwa muri yombi ry’abapasiteri bashatse kwivanga muri iyi gahunda y’ubu bugenzuzi abo ni Apôtre Rwandamura Charles wo mu itorero rya UCC, Revela Pasiteri Nyamurangwa Fred, Bishop Rugagi Innocent ,Pasiteri Kalisa Shyaka Emmanuel, Revela Ntambara Emmanuel, ndetse na Pasiteri Dura James. Iri genzura ryakomereje no mu bindi bice by’igihugu aho mu turere dutandukanye hari izagiye zifungwa nko muri Rwamagana,Nyamasheke n’ahandi. Yanditswe na Habarurema Djamali

title: Bishop Rugagi arasaba  inkunga y’amasengesho itangazamakuru
content:
Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Itorero Redeemed Gospel Church Rwanda Bishop Rugagi Innocent, aremeza ko  ari mu bihe bikomeye kandi bibi bitamworoheye, kuburyo ageze n’aho asaba abantu kumusengera.
 Muri iki gihe Bishop Rugagi ntiyorohewe n’abamukwena nyuma y’aho hagiye hatangazwa ko yahanuriye umukobwa  witwa Umunyana Shanitah ko azaba Nyampinga w’u Rwanda, bizakurangira atamubaye ariko k’ubw’amahirwe yegukana umwanya w’igisonga cy’uwabaye Nyampinga. Aganiro n’itangazamakuru  kuri uyu 28 Gashyantare 2018, Bishop Rugagi nibwo yafashe umwanya wo kwisobanura no gusubiza  ibibazo bitandukanye bimaze iminsi bimuvugwaho birimo  icyo gufungirwa urusengero  icy’ubuhanuzi bwe bucyemangwa ndetse n’ibindi bitandukanye bishobora kuba bimusiga isura itari nziza mu ruhando rw’abandi ba Bishop. Aha Rugagi yagize ati "Ndi mu bigeragezo  bikomeye nkeneye inkunga y’amasengesho kandi nanjye nkomeje gusenga nawe kandi unsengere ”.

 Kubyerekeranye n’ubuhanuzi bwe akora
   Aha yibanze k’ubuhanuzi yavuzweho ko yakoreye umukobwa washakaga kwegukana ikamba rya nyampinga,yarahiye yeruye ko mubyukuri atamuhanuriye ngo yegukane iryo kamba ahubwo yamusabiye umugisha. Rugagi yagize ati"Tariki 4 Gashyantare 2018, nibwo nahamagaye umukobwa witwa Shanitah. Shanitah ni umwana wanjye, aririmba muri Angels (Korali yo mu Itorero Abacunguwe). Papa we ni umujyanama mu rusengero, rero niwe wansabye ngo nsengere umukobwa we ari mu irushanwa rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda. Mu by’ukuri njyewe icyo nakoze ni ukumusabira umugisha ntabwo ari ukumuhanurira".

Yakomeje avuga ko akunda gushyigikira abanyarwanda baba bafite impano bacyeneye kuzigaragaza,arinabwo yatanze urugero rwa Alpha Rwirangira wigeze kwegukana igihembo cya Task Project ko icyo gihe yari muri Kenya kandi ko yamushyigikiye. Yagize ati “Mba numva ko nashyigikira umunyarwanda wese ufite impano runaka kandi agashaka kuyigaragaza. Nahamagaye Belinda na Shanitah ndanabasengera bombi ariko ntabwo nigeze mbahanurira. Urabona iyo Imana iba yampaye ubwo buhanuzi? mba narabahanuriye.”

 Kubyerekeranye n’ifungwa ry’urusengero rwe
  Aha yavuze ko bijya gutangira ari abazungu b’Abahinde bakorera hafi y’urusengero rwe, ahamya ko bagejeje ikibazo cyabo ku buyobozi bw’Umurenge wa Nyarugenge, ari nabwo ubuyobozi bwaje kumusaba ko yashyiramo ibyuma birinda urusaku (Sound proof).Ibi byuma Bishop Rugagi ngo yabishyizemo nyuma , Umuyobozi w’Umurenge araza aramufungira birangije ajya ku karere bamuha urupapuro rumuha uburenganzira bwo gufungura ariko nyuma umurenge uragaruka uramufungira. Arongera abazwa impamvu atagiye kurega abamufungiye urusengero ku rwego rubakuriye avuga ko yanze gukomanya imitwe ubuyobozi. Yagize ati “Ikintu ugomba kubanza kureba ni ukureka ikintu kitwa igonganisha ry’inzego ugatwara ibintu mu mahoro, niba komanda wa Polisi turi kumwe akaba ari kubwira Gitifu ati ko afite urwandiko rw’iminsi ine kugira ngo abe yimutse mwamuretse, Gitifu ati oya.”

Ubusabe yasabye abakunzi be ndetse n’abanyarwanda nuko bajya ku mavi bakamusengera kuko arageramiwe nubwo nawe asenga, ariko inkunga y’amasengesho nti yamugwa nabi. Chief editor

title: Ntamuhanga  Cassien nyuma yo gutoroka gereza  yigambye ko ari kwidegembya mu buhungiro
content:
Ntamuhanga Cassien wari mu idosiye imwe na Kizito Mihigo yatangaje ko nyuma yo gutoroka gereza ya Nyanza mu mezi ane ashize, yahawe ubuhungiro ubu ari kwidegembya mu gihugu atavuze amazina.
 Uyu mugabo yatorotse gereza mu ijoro rishyira ku wa 31 Ukwakira 2017, aho Urwego rw’Igihugu rw’Imfungwa n’Abagororwa, RCS, rwaje kwemeza ko hamwe n’abo bajyanye “bakoresheje imigozi bakurira urukuta rwa gereza.” Kuri uyu wa Gatatu uyu mugabo yumvikanye kuri Radio Ijwi rya Amerika, avuga ko mbere yo guhunga yari afite impungenge z’igihano yakatiwe kandi akumva no mu bujurire nta kizahinduka. Yagize ati “Ngira ngo ubu amezi agiye kuba ane nsohotse muri gereza...., ndakomeye ndimo ndidegembya.” Ntamuhanga wari umunyamakuru wa Radio Amazing Grace yaregwaga hamwe na Jean Paul Dukuzumuremyi, Agnes Niyibizi na Kizito Mihigo. Yaje guhanishwa igifungo cy’imyaka 25 ku cyaha cyo kugambira kugirira nabi Umukuru w’Igihugu, kuko ari cyo gihano kiruta ibindi urebeye ku byaha yahamijwe, birimo kurema umutwe w’abagizi ba nabi no gucura umugambi w’ibikorwa by’iterabwoba. Ntamuhanga yakomeje agira ati “Igihugu ndimo natse ubuhungiro nk’abandi bose, barabumpaye bampereza ibyangombwa n’abandi bantu b’impunzi baba bafite abo aribo bose.” Nyuma yo gutoroka Urwego Rushinzwe Imfungwa n’Abagororwa rwahise rutangaza ko ari gushakishwa. Mu bo batorokanye harimo Sibomana Kirenge wari warakatiwe imyaka 20 nyuma yo guhamya icyaha cy’ubuhotozi na Batambirije Théogène wari warahamijwe icyaha cyo gufata ku ngufu gusa nyuma akaza gutoroka gereza akatirwa imyaka 16. Amategeko ahana y’u Rwanda agena ko umuntu wese utoroka yarakatiwe ahanishwa igihano gikubye inshuro ebyiri igihano yari asigaje.

title: RGB n’inzego z’ibanze mu mugi wa Kigali bamaze gufunga insegero 714 zitujuje ibisabwa
content:
Mu bice bitandukanye by’umugi wa Kigali hamaze gufungwa insengero 714 kubera ko ubuyobozi bwasanze zitujuje  ibisabwa ngo zishobore gukora.Igikorwa cyo kuzifunga cyatangiye mu cyumweru gishize. 
 Ibyo bikorwa remezo byifashishwa mu gusenga byagiye bigaragara ko bitujuje ibyangombwa birimo nk’iby’isuku, kuba bidatanga umutekano ku bahasengera no kuba hasengerwa mu buryo butemewe. Icyo gikorwa cy’igenzura kiri gukorwa n’ubuyobozi bw’uturere bufatanyije n’Urwego rw’Igihugu rw’Imiyoborere (RGB), ari narwo rufite amatorero n’amadini mu nshingano. Umuyobozi Ushinzwe Imitwe ya Politiki n’Imiryango Itari iya Leta muri RGB, Justus Kangwagye, yabwiye itangamakuru ko izo nsengero zasabwe guhagarika ibikorwa byazo kugeza igihe zizuzuriza ibisabwa byose. Yagize ati “Amasengesho akwiye gukorwa mu buryo bufite gahunda kandi hagakurikizwa ibisabwa. Kubahiriza uburenganzira bwawe mu gusenga ntabwo bikwiye guhungabanya uburenganzira bw’abandi. Basabwe guhagarika ibikorwa byabo kugeza bujuje ibisabwa.”
 Kangwagye yavuze ko bishoboka ko hari n’izitazongera gufungura vuba kuko zikorera mu nyubako ishobora guteza ibyago abayirimo bityo abahakorera bagomba gushaka ubundi buryo. Ahandi ngo byagiye bigaragara ko badafite parikingi y’ibinyabiziga ugasanga babisiga mu muhanda cyangwa bigateza ikibazo ku migendekere y’ibindi. Abandi bafungiwe ni abasengeraga mu mahema. Yakomeje agira ati “Amateraniro abera mu mahema nayo yasabwe guhagarika ibikorwa. Ku bijyanye n’isuku byo ntabwo ushobora guteranira ahantu hatari amazi yo gukaraba intoki, hatari ubwiherero n’ibindi,”
 Izindi nsengero zidafite ibyangombwa by’umutekano nazo zasabwe kubishaka vuba cyangwa nazo zikazagerwaho n’izi ngaruka. Kangwagye avuga ko gushinga itorero bisaba icyemezo cy’igihe gito kimara amezi 12, umuntu agasabwa kuba yashatse icyemezo cya burundu mu mezi icyenda mbere y’uko icyangombwa yahawe mbere kirangira. Gusa ngo abantu benshi ntibaka ibyo byangombwa by’igihe kirekire, ahubwo bagendera mu kuvuga ko buri muntu yemerewe gusenga ntibashake ibyangombwa bikenewe. Akarere ka Gasabo niko kaza ku isonga  ahafunzwe insengero nyinshi kuko mu nsengero  699 hafunzwe 355,mu karere ka Nyarugenge mu nsengero 300 hafunzwe 203 naho mu karere ka Kicukiro mu nsengero 352 hafunzwe 156. Muhabura.rw

title: Hari  amadini n’amatorero agiye gufungwa bitarenze ku wa gatatu w’iki cyumweru
content:
Ubuyobozi bw’akarere ka Gasabo bwaburiye amadini n’amatorero ko buzafunga insengero zitubahirije ibisabwa bitarenze ku wa gatatu w’iki cyumweru.
 Bubasaba kugira ibyangombwa by’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Imiyoborere (RGB) icyemezo cy’akarere. Umuyobozi w’Itorero agomba kuba afite uburenganzira bumwemerera guhagararira iryo torero, imyubakire y’urusengero igomba kuba itateza ibibazo abaruteraniramo. Ntibyemewe kandi guteranira mu nyubako ikirimo kubakwa, urusengero rugomba kugira parikingi itarimo umukungu n’icyondo, rugomba kuba rwubatse byibura ku buso bungana na 1/2 cya hegitare. Ntibyemewe gusengera muri shitingi, hagomba uburyo bwo kwirinda ko urusaku rusohoka hanze, ntibyemewe gukorera mu nzu yagenewe guturwamo, icururizwamo cyangwa igize umudugudu utuwemo. Insengero zitegetswe kandi kugira ubwiherero byibura ibyumba bine n’ahantu hafatirwa amafunguro hasukuye. Mu gusoma amabwiriza, Umuyobozi w’akarere ka Gasabo, Stephen Rwamurangwa yagize ati "Ubwiherero butameze neza bwonyine burahagije kuba itorero ryahagarikwa". Ati "Insengero zitubahirije ibi mube muzifunze kugira ngo zibanze zitunganye ibitameze neza, nta gihe tubahaye kuko igenzura rirakorwa kuri uyu wa kabiri hanyuma ku wa gatatu amabwiriza azashyirwa mu bikorwa". Ubuyobozi bw’akarere ka Gasabo n’inzego zishinzwe umutekano bavuga ko hari abantu bashobora guteza umutekano muke bitwaje kujya gusenga. Rwamurangwa yavuze ko bazagera aho bakanereba ibyo abantu bigisha kuko ngo hari n’abigisha ibyo batazi b’abapagani. Ati:"Ariko murumva bitumvikanye neza kurushaho?" Pasteri Ntambara Innocent uhagarariye Itorero bita Success, ni umwe mu bahagarariye amadini n’amatorero uvuga ko iki cyemezo gitunguranye. Ati "Ku bijyanye n’insengero zaba zifite virusi yo guteza umutekano muke zo nta gihe zigomba guhabwa, ariko turasaba ko iryo tsinda rigenzura ryagenda gahoro kuko insengero zubahirije ibyo muvuze ni nke cyane." Ubuyobozi bw’akarere ka Gasabo buvuga ko nta gisibya ko hari insengero zitangira gufungwa bitarenze kuri uyu wa gatatu tariki 21 Gashyantare 2018.
Ku rundi ruhande Ikigo gishinzwe imiyoborere (RGB) nacyo cyahise gitangariza abanyamakuru ko kigiye kongera ibisabwa amadini n’amatorero mu rwego rwo gukaza umutekano w’abayasengeramo.


 Yanditswe na Niyomugabo Albert

title: Kigali:  Urundi Rusengero rwa Bishop Rugagi ruherereye mu Mujyi wa Kigali rwagati rwafunzwe
content:
Urusengero Redeemed Gospel Church rwa Bishop Rugagi Innocent ruherereye mu Mujyi wa Kigali rwagati rwafunzwe kubera ibibazo birimo n’urusaku. Ku mugoroba wo ku wa Mbere, tariki ya 12 Gashyantare 2018 nibwo uru rusengero rwashyizweho ingufuri. Amakuru avugako  uru rusengero rwafunzwe nyuma y’amakuru umwe mu baruturiye yatanze avuga ko rusakuza cyane mu gihe cy’amateraniro. Uru usengero rw’iryo torero riyoborwa mu Rwanda na Bishop Rugagi Innocent, rwafunzwe Rukurikira urwo ,  mu Murenge wa Ruhango hafi y’ibiro by’Akarere ka Ruhango. Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Ruhango, Mbabazi Francoix Xavier yari yavuze  ko iryo torero ryafungiwe urusengero kuberako  rwashoboraga gushyira mu kaga abarusengeragamo. 
Bishop Rugagi Innocent Ingingo ya 600 y’igitabo cy’amategeko ahana y’u Rwanda iteganyiriza ko abateza urusaku rukabije nijoro, igifungo kuva ku minsi umunani (8) kugera ku mezi abiri n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda kuva ku 50,000 kugera kuri miliyoni imwe cyangwa kimwe muri ibyo. 
Urusengero rwashoboraga gushyira abantu mu kaga Ingingo ya 108 y’itegeko ngenga nomero 04 /2005 ryo ku wa 8 Mata 2005 rigena uburyo bwo kurengera no kubungabunga ibidukikije mu Rwanda, igena igihano ku bateza urusaku cy’igifungo kigera ku mezi abiri n’ihazabu y’amafaranga ibihumbi ijana kuri buri nshuro habaye urusaku. title: Pasiteri  Kayumba aravugwaho gutera umwana w’impfubyi inda yarangiza agahunga
content: Pasitiri Kayumba Fiston wayoboraga itorero Revelation Church Nyamatete ryo mu Karere ka Gatsibo yaburiwe irengero nyuma yo gutera inda umwana w’impfubyi irera barumuna bayo babiri. Byemejwe n’Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Akagari ka Nyamatete Umurenge wa Rwimbogo, Athanase Rukundo, wavuze ko inkuru yamenyekanye nyuma y’amezi abiri umwana abyaye. Yagize ati “Twamenye ko atwite ariko abajyanama b’ubuzima ababwira ko inda yayitewe n’umushumba w’inka atazi. Amaze amezi abyaye nibwo yamennye ibanga ko ari Pasitoro we wayimuteye.” Rukundo avuga ko uyu mwana yari amaze umwaka umwe avuye kwa Kayumba Fiston. Ubu yarerwaga n’uwitwa Bazatoha Sam agakomeza gusengera muri urwo rusengero aho asanzwe ari umuririmbyi muri kolari y’abana. Pasiteri Ruzindana Godfrey umuvugizi w’itorero Revelation mu Rwanda, avuga ko bamenye ko Pasitoro Kayumba akekwaho gutera umwana inda bihutira kumuhagarika. Ati “Nk’umupasitoro ntabwo akwiye kongera guhagarara imbere y’abantu, duhitamo kuba dushyizeho undi kugira ngo ababishinzwe babikurikirane.” Pasiteri Ruzindana avuga ko igihe bazasanga ibyo akekwaho atari ukuri azasubizwa mu nshingano ze. Tariki 28 Mutarama 2018, nibwo Pasiteri Kayumba Fiston yakuwe ku nshingano zo kuyobora itorero. Yambuwe inshingano adahari, kuko yagiye abwiye abakirisitu ko agiye mu masengesho y’iminsi 20 mu Karere ka Nyagatare. Pasiteri Kayumba w’imyaka 52 y’amavuko arubatse afite umugore n’abana 10. Naho umwana yateye inda ubu nibwo yujuje imyaka 18, asanzwe ari impfubyi irera barumuna be babiri. Ubuyobozi bw’Akagari ka Nyamatete buvuga ko kubufatanye n’abaturage bazafasha izi mpfubyi ku bijyanye n’ibiribwa no kwigisha barumuna b’uwabyaye. Yanditswe na chief editor

title: Pasiteri  yateye inda abagore  n’Abakobwa barenga 20 bo mu rusengero rwe [REBA AMAFOTO]
content:
Umupasiteri wo muri Nigeria uzwi kumazina ya Timothy Ngwu ,ufite imyaka 53 aravugwaho gutera inda abagore n’abakobwa  barenga 20 basengeraga hamwe nawe ,bamwe mu ribo  bari bubatse abandi bakiri abakobwa   bato, Imbere yabashinzwe umutekano yisobanuye avuga ko ibikorwa bye yabitegetswe n’umwuka wera .
 Amaraizu  umuvugizi wa Police yo mumugi wa Enugu yagize ati "Pasiteri  avuga ko yubashye ubushake bw’Imana ,bwo gutera inda uwo umwuka wera yamuhitiyemo yaba yarashatse cyangwa atarashatse"  Iyo umubyeyi abyaye Umwana na Mama we baguma kurusengero ubuzima bwabo bwose busigaye, aya makuru yatanzwe n’uwahoze ari umugore we Veronica Ngwu warurambiwe imico y’umugabo we nyuma yo gutera inda umwana muto abereye nyirasenge. Umuvandimwe wa Pasiteri utashatse ko imyirondoro ye agaragara yavuze ko hari hashize igihe kinini umuryango we umuhana kumafuti ye gusa ngo nta numwe yashakaga kumva.   Umuvandimwe we akomeza avuga ko Ifatwa ry’umuvandimwe we ryatewe nuburakari bw’Imana. Yagize ati"Mumfashe mbambwire , Uburakari bw’Imana bwikubise ku muvandimwe wanjye ,twamugiriye inama kenshi ko ibyo arimo ari amafuti gusa we yarabyanze Adushinja ko twamugiriye ishyari kuko arigukora ibyo Imana imutegetse. Icyo nibaza Ni gute umugabo warezwe yakora ibintu nkibi ? Abagize ururusengero bose ni Ibigoryi ,ni gute umugore yata umugabo we agakorana amafuti y’ubusambanyi n’undi mugabo akabyita ubushake bw’Imana ? Singiye kwinjira muri iki kibazo gusa ndifuza ko ururusengero barufunga burundu." Akomeza avuga ko yirukanye umugorewe n’abana kugira ngo abone uko atera inda abagore babandi n’abakobwa bakiri bato . Pasiteri Ngwu ubusanzwe yarasanzwe afite abagore 5 n’abana 13 hakiyongeraho nabo yitako bavutse kubushake nu bubasha bw’Imana akomeza avuga ko nta mugore w’ubatse yasambanyije umugabo atemeranyijwe no kwemera kw’Imana. Calista Omeje na Assumpta Odo n’abagore babiri bataye abagabo babo babana na  Timothy Ngwu bavuga ko babikoze bagendeye kunyigisho za  Pasiteri Ngwu, Calista Omeje ufitanye abana 10 numugabo we yavuze ko Ngwu yamuteye inda nyuma umwana akaza gupfa. title: Byinshi utaruzi  kuri Bishopo  Muragizi umaze gukora ibitangaza mu Rwanda no mu mahanga [Reba Amafoto]
content:
Bishopu  MURAGIZI  JEAN DE  DIEUX  Umuvugizi  w’Itorero  Power  Delivarence Church International  yemeza  ko  amasengesho bakora agira  akamaro  ku bantu batandukanye aho bamwe bakira indwara ziba  zarababayeho  karande nk’indwara  ya kanseri [ Cancer ]ndetse n’izindi  ariko  kumwe  n’imbaraga z’IMANA,amasengesho  bakorera  abo  baba  barashegeshwe  nizo  ndwara  barakira  burundu.  Bishopu  Muragizi  avuga ko itorero  abereye umuvugizi ariryo Power Delivarance Church  International, basengera abantu bagakira indwara zikomeye  nka  kanseri [cancer] ndetse n’ibindi bibazo ubuzima bwa muntu buhura nabyo ,kubera umwanzi satani,ariko kubera imbaraga z’Imana ndetse n’amasengesho bakora umuntu arabohoka. Ibi byose ariko ngo babikora ari ugufasha igihugu cy’u Rwanda n’abagituye Ndetse n’Abanyamahanga. 
Bishopu  MURAGIZI  JEAN DE  DIEUX Nkuko byemezwa na bakorewe  amasengesho,  ngo  indwara bari bararwaye  zarakize kubera imbaraga z’Amasengesho  bakorewe. Urugero  nk’Umukobwa witwa Ester yakize kanseri [cancer]  yari  arwaye ati"Imana yankoreye ibitangaza!!Nari ndwaye ikintu mu’ibere numva mbabara cyane maze njya kwa muganga i Kanombe bambwira ko ari ikibyimba kizabyara cancer,hanyuma bampa gahunda (rendez-vous) yo gusubirayo bakampima bagahita babaga aho mbabara.Ubwo naratashye mbibwira Bishop wanjye aransengera maze arambwira ngo nizere Imana ntakiyinanira.Akomeza kunsengera arambwira ati kumeza nawe usenge wizeye ibitangaza by’Imana bizakora  maze hashize igihe gito,bwa buribwe numva bwaragiye nkira ntyo none ndumva ndi muzima kubera amasengesho yankoreye kuko sinongeye gusubira kwa muganga". Umugore  utuye  Kacyiru  yari  arwaye  kanseri [ Cancer]  agiye  muri  Amerika  kwipimisha  asanga yarakize, umupasiteri utuye Kayonza yari afite umwana amaze  imyaka irindwi  atagenda,atavuga ariko baramusengeye  umwana  arakira nkuko  byemezwa ubwabo. Aganira na Muhabura.rw, Bishopu MURAGIZI yemeranywa n’abakorewe amasengesho  bagakira yagize  ati”Hariho abantu bakize kanseri [cancer]. Akenshi abantu bazi ko kanseri idakira ariko hariho imbaraga  zibohora nkuko itorero ryacu ryitwa n’imbaraga z’amasengesho zibohora.Ngira ngo bamwe mwabibarije,dufite benshi batanga, ubuhamya hari umukobwa witwa Ester ari hano,yakize kanseri ,hari Umugore twasengeye Utuye Kacyiru yari afite kanseri  agiye muri Amerika baramubwira ko  yayikize,Imana yaduhaye imbaraga zo kumusengera arayikira.Hari umupasiteri utuye kayonza uzaganira newe,namusengeye afite umwana utagenda ufite imyaka irindwi,Imana itubwira ko mugicuku iri butubwire igitangaza cyayo umwana yarakize papa we muzabonana umwna ntiyavugaga,ntiyagendaga mbese yari umutwaro k’umuryango,bigeze mu gicuku atangira kuvuga,atangira gahamagara papa we, izo n’imbaraga z’imana. ziravuga,zirakiza ntabwo ari twebwe ariko iyo baje mu Rusengero turi gusenga barakira ”. 
 Ababyeyi baba baje ari benshi kubera ibitangaza Bishopu  MURAGIZI  JEAN DE  DIEUX  akora Asoza  anenga kandi yamagana  bamwe mu ba Bishopu ndetse n’Abapasitori banduza izina ry’Imana bijandika mu byaha nko gufata ku ngufu abo bashinzwe kubwiriza  bakanabatera inda ati”Biteye agahinda n’ubwoba kumva  umuntu witiriwe izina ry’Imana agera aho  gutera  umukobwa  inda cg  gutinyuka kwiyambura avuguruza ibyo asanzwe akora tubibona nk’igikorwa kigayitse.ndagira  ngo mbwire  abanyarwanda iteka ni ugushishoza.Hari abiyitirira  kirisitu  atari  aba kristu.ikindi nuko  tutagomba  guhagarara ku  kibi hari  ikiza.Turamagana aba Pasitori,aba Bishop bariganya mu buryo bumwe cg ubundi, yuko bashinzwe gushumba intama nti bashinzwe kuzonona.Biragayitse  birababaje  ariko urufatiro  rw’Imana ruracyahari”. 
Bishopu  MURAGIZI  JEAN DE  DIEUX   arimo gusengera abantu benshi Birashoboka  ko haba hari  indwara  yakubanye  karande  yaragutesheje umutwe cg warabaye imbata  y’ibyaha ,wakisunga  itorero  rya Power Revaration Church International ugakira cg se ukabohoka iyo  ngohi ya satani kubera amasengesho  bagukorera ugahita utandukana n’ibyo bibi  byakugize  imbata. Kandi  bakira  abantu  b’ingeri  zose ntawe barobanura ndetse  n’abashaka  kuhasengera cg kwifatanya  nabo  nuko badakumiriwe  kuza kuhasengera. Ushaka kwifatanya na Bishop mu bikorwa byo gusenga cg gusengerwa ukabohorwa wabasanga mu murenge wa Nyarugunga  akarere ka Kicukiro hafi ya King Devid Academy  muri sale ya Alpha  Community Academy. title: Bishop Tom Rwagasana wo muri ADEPR  yarekuwe
content:
Bishop Tom Rwagasana wahoze ari Umuvugizi wungirije ushinzwe ubuzima bw’itorero rya ADEPR Urukiko rukuru rwafashe umwanzuro wo kurekura by’agateganyo. akurikiranywe ho  ibyaha byo kunyereza umutungo .  Mu kwiregura, Tom Rwagasana yakunze kuvuga ko kuba yaragiye asinya ku masheki yari abifitiye ububasha, ahubwo agasaba ko abahabwaga ayo mafaranga babazwa icyo bayakoresheje kuko we yasinyaga ibyateguwe n’abandi babishinzwe. Umuvugizi w’Inkiko, Itamwa Emmanuel yavuze ko Bishop Rwagasana yarekuwe by’agateganyo kubera ikibazo cy’uburwayi. Ati “Nibyo, Urukiko Rukuru ejo rwafashe icyemezo cyo kumurekura by’agateganyo. Ubushinjacyaha bwari bwasabye ko akomeza gufungwa, bwari bwasabye ko icyemezo kimufunga by’agateganyo cyongerwa. Ariko bigeze mu Rukiko Rukuru barabiburana noneho n’ubushinjacyaha busaba ko yaba afunguwe by’agateganyo kuko ararwaye cyane.”
 “Urukiko Rukuru rwamwemereye ko afungurwa by’agateganyo ariko rugira ibyo rumutegeka agomba kubahirirza nko kujya yitaba ubushinjacyaha buri cyumweru, gutanga pasiporo ye n’ibindi. Bisobanuke ko atagizwe umwere ahubwo ari uko afunguwe by’agateganyo agakurikiranwa ari hanze.”

title: Kiliziya Gatolika irifuza ko ingengabihe y’amashuri ihinduka, umwaka ukajya utangira muri Nzeri
content:
Kiliziya Gatolika yasabye Leta y’u Rwanda guhindura ingengabihe y’amashuri ku buryo yakongera kujya atangira muri Nzeri, ikavuga ko byarushaho gufasha abanyeshuri mu myigire yabo. Hashize imyaka isaga 10 imiterere y’ingengabihe y’amashuri mu Rwanda isaba ko abanyeshuri batangira umwaka muri Mutarama ugasozwa mu Ugushyingo mu gihe mbere watangiraga muri Nzeri ugasozwa muri Kamena. Ubwo Kiliziya Gatolika yasozaga icyumweru cyahariwe uburezi kuri uyu wa 16 Kamena 2017 muri Paruwasi ya Zaza, Umushumba wa Diyoseze ya Gikongoro, Hakizimana Célestin yatanze ubutumwa mu izina ry’Umushumba w’iya Butare Ushinzwe uburezi Gatolika mu Rwanda, Phillipe Rukamba, avuga ko abanyeshuri babangamiwe no kuba biga mu mpeshyi. Yagize ati “Nagira ngo ngire icyo nisabira umushyitsi Mukuru (Uwari uhagarariye Minisitiri w’Uburezi), mu rwego rwo kunoza imikoranire myiza isanzwe iranga Leta na Kiliziya mu burezi, ndahera ku ngengabihe y’umwaka w’amashuri; hashize igihe twifuza ko umwaka w’amashuri wajya utangira mu kwezi kwa cyenda, ukarangira mu kwezi kwa Gatandatu.” Mu mpamvu batanga harimo kuba abanyeshuri biga mu gihe cy’izuba bikagira ingaruka ku myigire yabo. Ati “Impamvu ni nyinshi ariko cyane cyane ni igihe cy’izuba n’ibura ry’amazi tuzi twese ko biremerera abana bacu baba ku mashuri mu kwezi kwa munani, hakiyongeraho na gahunda zinyuranye ziba ziri muri ayo mezi mu rwego rwa Kiliziya no mu buzima mbonezamubano, bibangamira cyane abarezi baba bagomba kuzitabira.” Kugeza ubu amashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye mu Rwanda agera ku 3189, muri ayo yose, agera ku 1381 angana na 43,3% ni aya Kiliziya Gatolika. Mu banyeshuri hafi miliyoni eshatu biga mu mashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye, abagera kuri 1.175.369 barererwa mu ya Kiliziya Gatolika. Ibyo kandi biza byongera ku kuba Kiliziya Gatolika ifatwa n’uruhongore rw’intiti nyinshi ziri mu Rwanda ndetse byatumye Umuyobozi Mukuru wungirije w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Uburezi REB, Dr Michel Rwibasira, ashima uburezi n’Uburere Kiliziya ikomeje guha umwana w’Umunyarwanda avuga ko n’ibyo Kiliziya yasabye bazabyigana ubushishozi n’abo bireba bigakemuka. Yagize ati “ Kuba byagira ishingiro ni uko wabihuza n’izindi mpamvu zose, hari izuba noneho hari no kureba ibihugu biri mu karere ka Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Tubihinduye tugomba kwiga tukareba ingaruka byagira abanyeshuri bava hanze batugana, baramutse basanze bitandukanye.” Yongeyeho ati “ Iyo ukemura ikibazo giterwa n’impamvu imwe byakoroha, tumaze iminsi natwe tubiganiraho ariko turashaka ngo tubanze duhuze n’impamvu nyinshi zirimo n’iyo y’abanyeshuri kugira ngo dufate umwanzuro. Bifite ishingiro ariko kugira ngo tubifataho umwanzuro bikenera ko dufata n’izindi mpamvu zirimo izo nababwiye kugira ngo nyuma tuzafate ukwiriye abanyeshuri, ukwiriye u Rwanda ariko ukwiriye n’abarezi.” Icyumweru cyahariwe uburezi Gatolika cyasorejwe mu Karere ka Ngoma, mu Ntara y’Uburasirazuba, muri Paruwasi ya Zaza, Diyoseze ya Kibungo. Cyari gifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti “ Nk’abakirisitu mu Ntangiriro ya Kiliziya, Ishuri ryacu turigire igicumbi cy’Ubumwe n’Ubufatanye.” Kugeza ubu muri iyo diyoseze, habarirwa ibigo by’amashuri 102, birimo amashuri abanza 36, amashuri yisumbuye y’uburezi bw’ibanze bw’imyaka icyenda na 12 agera kuri 56, ikagira n’amashuri 10 acumbikira abanyeshuri. Kwizihiza icyo cyumweru byari bibaye ku nshuro ya cyenda kuko byatangiye mu 2008.

title: Abayobozi b’amadini biyemeje gufatanya n’Ubuyobozi guhangana n’amakimbirane ndetse n’ibihuha
content:
Abayobozi b’amadini n’amatorero akorera mu Ntara y’Iburasirazuba biyemeje kongera imbaraga bafatanyije n’ubuyobozi bw’Inzego z’ibanze n’izindi nzego mu guhangana n’ibyaha bigaragara hirya no hino muri iyi Ntara cyane cyane amakimbirane mu miryango, ibiyobyabwenge ndetse na bamwe mu biyita abahanuzi bakwirakwiza ibihuha mu baturage.. Ibi byagarutsweho mu nama nyunguranabitekerezo yahuje Ubuyobozi bw’Intara y’Iburasirazuba, Abayobozi b’amadini n’amatorero akorera muri iyi ntara, Inzego z’umutekano n’Abayobozi b’Uturere kuri uyu wa mbere tariki ya 29 Gicurasi 2017 hagamijwe kungurana ibitekerezo ku mikoranire y’amadini n’inzego z’ibanze, n’uruhare rwamadini mu guteza imbere abaturage. Guverineri Kazaire Judith uyobora iyi Ntara yabwiye abitabiriye ko Amadini afite uruhare rufatika mu iterambere ry’abaturage, abasaba kongera imbaraga mu kwegera abaturage bagafatanya na Leta mu gukangurira abaturage guhangana n’amakimbiran mu miryango, ibiyobyabwenge usanga cyan cyane byinjira biturutse  kubona muri iyi minsi hagaragara ibyaha byiinshi bishingiye ku makimbirane mu miryango, abitwaza amadini bakayobya abaturage, bitwaje ubuhanuzi bw’ibinyoma,  iyi nama ko yatumijwe

 Inzego zifite aho zihurira n’umutekano nazo zari zitabiriye iyi nama 
Umuyobozi wa Polisi mu Ntara y’Iburasirazuba ACP Rutaganira Dismas yagaragaje ko muri rusange Umutekano mu Ntara y’’Iburazuba ariko ko ibyaha birimo amakimbirane mu ngo, ibiyobyabwenge, gukubita no gukomeretsa bikomeza kuza ku isonga mu bihungabanya umutekano. umuyobozi wa Peace Plan(Ihuriro ry’amatorero n’amadini rigamije amahoro) ku rwego rw’igihugu Musenyeri Birindabagabo Alexis avuga ko amadini afite uruhare rufatika mu kurwanya ibyaha uko abayarwanda benshi bafite amadini babarizwamo kuburyo umuyobozi w’idini agiye yigisha abayoboke kurwanya ibyaha byatanga umusaruro ufatika. Ku kibazo cy’ibihuha yagize ati  "Abahanuzi b’ibinyoma bakurwaho n’abahanuzi b’ukuri kandi aba ni bacye, ubuhanuzi bw’ibinyoma nitwe ba mbere dukwiye kuburwanya tugatangaza ubuhanuzi bw’ukuri kuko birahari, icyo twe dukwiye gukora ni ukugira ubufatanye tukamenya abantu bahanura ibyo binyoma natwe tukabanyomoza, byanarimba tukitabaza inzego za leta kugirango zidufashe ariko natwe twashyizeho akacu" Musenyeri NZAKAMWITA wa Sylverian wa Diyosezi ya BYUMBAMH avuga ko muri Kiliziya Gaturika hashyizweho Iyobokamana rishingiye ku ngo, hashyirwaho za komisiyo kuri buri byiciro mu rwego rwo kureba ibibazo byugarije ingo no kubishakira ibisubizo. Abayobozi b’amadini bashimiwe uruhare bagira mu bikorwa bitandukanye haba mu buvuzi, amashuri n’ibindi bikorwa by’amajyambere dore ko ngo iyo byigishijwe n’abanyamadini abanyarwanda babumva cyane kuko bo bafite umwihariko wo kubaka roho n’imibiri by’ababagana.

title: Abari abayobozi ba ADEPR begujwe, hatorwa abo kubasimbura
content:
Abagize inteko rusange ya ADEPR kuri uyu wa Kabiri bahuriye mu nteko rusange idasanzwe batoye Rev. Karuranga Ephraim nk’Umuvugizi w’iri torero.. Iyi nama yakorewe mu muhezo aho itangazamakuru ryaba irivuga n’iryandika ritemerewe kuhakandagiza ikirenge. Mu masaha ya saa tanu nibwo bamwe mu bagize inteko rusange batangiye kugera aho iri kubera mu gihe hari abakiri mu nzira. Abamaze kugera mu cyumba cy’inama bigabanyijemo ibice bibiri bari kuganira ku ngingo zitandukanye. Amakuru ava imbere mu cyumba ni uko amatora y’ubuyobozi bushya arimbanyije, ndetse humvikanyemo amashyi bisa n’aho hari icyo abarimo imbere bishimiye. Ni inama yateranye nyuma y’itabwa muri yombi ry’abayobozi ba Biro Nyobozi ya ADEPR bane barimo Bishop Sibomana Jean, Umuvugizi w’Itorero; Umwungirije Bishop Tom Rwagasana ; Ushinzwe Imari, Mutuyemariya Christine na Rev. Sebagabo Leonard wari Umujyanama waryo. Nyuma y’amakuru yakurikiye gufatwa kw’aba bose, kuwa Mbere tariki ya 29 Gicurasi 2017 hakozwe inama yahuje abayobozi b’indembo eshanu zigize ADEPR yayobowe na Rev.Rurangirwa, uri mu bahabwa amahirwe yo gusimbura Bishop Sibomana. Rev.Rurangirwa Emmanuel niwe Muyobozi Mukuru ukuriye abashumba b’indembo zose. Itegeko rigena uwasimbura umuvugizi wa ADEPR rivuga ko Umushumba w’ururembo uhagarariye abandi ari we uba ugomba gusimbura umuvugizi w’Itorero mu gihe komite yose yaba yavuyeho. Umuyobozi utorerwa gusimbura Bishop Sibomana azayobora inzibacyuho y’amezi atatu mu gihe byaba byemejwe n’Inteko Rusange, nayo ihagarariwe n’Inama Nkuru y’Abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda (CPR).
Mu bandi batowe harimo Umuvugizi wungirije ariwe Rev Karangwa John (yari umuyobozi mu rurembo rwa ADEPR Uganda) , Umunyamabanga Mukuru aba Pasiteri Ruzibiza Viateur wakoraga mu ishami ry’ivugabutumwa ashinzwe urubyiruko. Ushinzwe Imari n’Ubutegetsi watowe ni Umuhoza Aulerie wari usanzwe ari Umukirisitu w’i Remera, Umujyanama aba Pasiteri Nsengiyumva Patrick wari Umuyobozi w’urubyiruko rwa ADEPR ku rwego rw’igihugu.

title: Amadini n’amatorero yakuwe mu ihuriro rya Sosiyete Sivile nyarwanda
content: Hashize igihe amadini n’amatorero abarirwa mu miryango igize Sosiyete Sivile mu Rwanda ariko ubu yamaze gukurwamo ngo agende yikorere ihuriro ryayo. Mu nama yahuje imiryango igize Sosiyete Sivile Nyarwanda kuri uyu wa Kabiri, yiga ku mategeko no kwishyiraraho ubuyobozi ni bwo hatangajwe ko amadini n’amatorero agomba gukora ukwayo. Umuyobozi wa Sosiyete Sivile mu Rwanda, Munyamariza Edward, yatangaje ko itegeko rishya ry’Urwego rw’Igihugu rw’imiyoborere (RGB) rigenga Sosiyete Sivile, amadini n’amatorero atabarirwamo. Munyamariza yasobanuye ko gushyira ku ruhande amadini n’amatorero bishingiye ahanini ku kuba hari ibintu aba yemera bitandukanye n’ibyo Sosiyete sivile ishaka gukorera ubuvugizi, kubw’ibyo bikaba ari ngombwa ko na yo ajya ukwayo agashinga ihuriro ryayo. title: Kugira Ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside ni nko kugendana Cancer mu mubiri isaha iyo igeze irakwica- B Shop Birindabagabo ...
content:
Umuyobozi mukuru w’Itorero ry’Abanglican mu Rwanda Diyoseze ya Gahini, B Shop Birindabagabo Alex avuga ko kuri we kumva ko hari umunyarwanda waba ugifite ingengabitekerezo yaba ameze nk’umuntu ugendana indwara ya Cancer mu mubiri we nk’uko amaherezo iyo ndwara iba azamwica kandi vuba niko n’ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside iba izageraho igafungisha cyangwa igashyira mu byago uyifite cyangwa undi wese uyihemebera
 Ni ubutumwa bukubiye mu kiganiro kirambuye uyu mukozi w’Imana yagiranye n’ikinyamakuru Ukwezi.com. Aho yavuze ko kugeza ubu niba Leta y’u Rwanda ivuga ko imibare igaragaza  igipimo cy’Ubumwe n’ubwiyunge igeze kuri 92% hari imbaraga nyinshi baba barashyizemo nk’abavugabutumwa ariko ku rundi ruhande akavuga ko burya nk’abakozi b’Imana iyo babwiriza ubutumwa hari bamwe bemera abandi bakanangira ari naho hava iyi mibare igera ku 8% isigaye ngo abanyarwanda bagere ku bumwe n’ubwiyunge busesuye. Abajijwe ku kuba hakiri bamwe mu bakirisitu usanga bakigaragaraho ingengabitekerezo mu matorero n’amadini amwe n’amwe B Shop Alex uyobora EAR (Eglise Anglican au Rwanda) Diyoseze ya Gahini  yagize ati “Buriya iyo tuvuze ibohokamitima n’isanamitima ni ibintu bijyana n’umwuka twebwe mu butumwa bwiza tubwiriza abakristu harimo urukundo no kubana neza na bagenzi babo kandi batarobanuye rero urumva iyo habayeho guhinduka kuri bamwe ubwo ni babandi baba bafashijwe naho bamwe rero banangiye imitima urumva nyine baba banze kwihana ari nabwo iyo umuntu yanze kwihana  habaho guhana bivuze ngo na Leta yagakwiye kujya ishyira mu bikorwa ya mategeko ahana kuri babandi banze kwihana” B Shop Alex yakomeje avuga ati “Ikindi ni uko  ahanini ingengabitekerezo iterwa n’ibintu bibiri, icyambere kandi kireba twese abanyarwanda ni ubujiji ari naho dukwiye gukora akazi kanini ndetse gahoraho ko kwigisha. Ikindi kintu gitera ingengabitekerezo ni ubugome aho ho niho uruhare rwacu rwihariye rugomba kugaragarira ari nayo mpamvu tuvuga ubutumwa kugirango bano bantu bafite ubugome babe bakiwihana ariko mu gihe banangiye bahanwa n’amategeko gusa sinakwibagirwa n’ababyeyi nakwita ko bagaburira abana babo uburozi babigisha amagambo mabi cyane abo ndumva ko ari nka bamwe bagendana Cancer mu mubiri wabo kuko isaha ku isaha iba izabica ari nako n’Ingengabitekerezo iba izageza muri gereza cyangwa igashyira imiryango yabo  mu byago bikomeye” B Shop Alex akomeza asaba abakristu kwitandukanya n’icyitwa ikibi cyose by’umwihariko Ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside kuko bazi neza amahano yabaye mu Rwanda ahanini yatewe n’izo mvugo zihembera urwango mu bantu ari nazo zatumye habaho Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi bo mu Rwanda muri Mata 1994. title: Perezida Kagame arasura na Papa François i Vatican
content: Kuri uyu wa mbere tariki 20 Werurwe 2017, Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame aragirira uruzinduko i Vatican mu Butaliyani, aho azahura na Papa François umushumba wa Kiliziya Gatolika ku Isi. Radio Vatican dukesha iyi nkuru ntiva imuzingo ibyo aba bayobozi bombi bashobora kuganiraho, gusa hari ingingo za Politike abantu bakeka ko bazaganiraho. Perezida Paul Kagame nubwo ari umukristu wa Kiliziya Gatolika (niho yabatirijwe) ibiganiro bye na Papa bishobora kuzagaruka ku mubano n’imikoranire ya Kiliziya Gatolika ndetse n’u Rwanda, dore ko Kiliziya ifite ishoramari n’imitungo myinshi mu Rwanda Gusa, hari n’abatekereza ko bashobora no kuzaganira ku ruhare rwa bamwe mu bayoboke ba Kiliziya bagize uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, kuo Leta y’u Rwanda ikunze gushyira igitutu kuri Kiliziya ngo ibasabire imbabazi. title: Papa Francis yashyizeho intumwa nshya imuhagararira mu Rwanda
content: Ku isaaha ya saa Sita y’i Roma, ikaba saa 13h00 zo mu Rwanda, kuri uyu wa Gatanadatu Papa Francis yashyizeho intumwa nshya yo kumuhararira mu Rwanda ari we Musenyeri Andrzej Józwowicz Mu ibaruwa yashyizwe hanze n’Inama y’Abepisikopi Gatolika mu Rwanda igashyirwaho umukono na Perezida wayo, Musenyeri Philippe Rukanga akaba n’Umwepiscope wa Diyoseze ya Butare, yamenyeshesheje abayoboke ba Kiliziya Gatulika mu Rwanda n’Abanyrwanda muri rusange iyi nkuru y’iyimikwa ry’Intumwa nshya ya Papa Francis. Msgr Andrzej Józwowic wagizwe intumwa nshya yo guhagararira Papa Francis mu Rwanda yavutse kuwa 14 Mutarama, 1 965  mu gihugu cya Pologne ahitwa Bocki. Nyirubutungane Andrzej Józwowic yimitswe nk’Umusaseridoti kuwa 24 Gicurasi 1 990. Afite impamyabumenyi y’ikirenga ya Doctorat mu mategeko y’ubuyobozi bwa Kiliziya Gatulika (Droit Canonique) no mu mategeko mbonezamubano (Droit Civil). Kuva kuwa 01 Nyakanga 1 997 iyi ntumwa nsha ya Papa mu Rwanda yagiye igirwa uhagarariye ibiro bya Kiliziya Gatulika mu bihugu nka Mozambique, Thailande, Hongrie, Syrie, Iran no mu Burusiya. title: Min Kaboneka yitabiriye ibirori byo kwizihiza imyaka 20 Chorale Ambassadors of Christ rimaze
content:
Minisitiri w’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu, Francis Kaboneka yavuze ko ubuyobozi bw’u Rwanda bwashyizweho n’Imana kandi bukaba ari yo bukorera, bityo ko budashobora gutererana Abanyarwanda muri byose bahura na byo. Yabitangaje kuri uyu wa 24 Ukuboza 2016, mu birori byo kwizihiza isabukuru y’imyaka 20 Chorale Ambassadors of Christ imaze ibwiriza ubutumwa mu buryo bw’indirimbo. Yabishingiye ku buhamya bwatanzwe buvuga uburyo mu ijoro ryo kuwa 9 Gicurasi 2011, Dar es Salaam-Kigali, yakoze impanuka abaririmbyi bayo bane bagakomereka abandi batatu bakitaba Imana. Nyuma yaho Perezida Paul Kagame yohereje indege ngo ijye gutabara abari basigaye, ndetse vuba aha iyi Chorale iherutse kumuha igikombe ku bw’ubwo butabazi. Kaboneka yagize ati “ Satani yashatse kurimbura iyi Chorale ariko ukuboko kw’Imana kubana nayo ndetse nk’uko umuyobozi mukuru yabivuze ubuyobozi bw’igihugu bwarahabaye ariko ni inshingano kubikorera Abanyarwanda. Ubuyobozi bukorera Imana bwashyizweho n’Imana, nta kuntu rero bwatererana Abanyarwanda.” Yashimye uruhare rw’iyi Chorale mu kubwiriza ubutumwa bwiza avuga ko bwagiriye u Rwanda akamaro, nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu mwaka wa 1994. Minisitiri Kaboneka yasabye abari bateraniye aho kugirirana urukundo hagati yabo,bakigana urwo umukuru w’Igihugu yagaragarije iyi Chorale ubwo yari yakoze impanuka. Ati “Imana yakunze Abanyarwanda ibaha abayobozi beza, ni urukundo twakabaye natwe twigisha. Perezida wa Repubulika ajya gufata icyemezo cyo kohereza indege n’imodoka mwakoze impanuka, nta mwana we wari urimo, nta mwene wabo wari urimo, yabikoze kubera ko akunda Abanyarwanda.” Umurava wa Chorale Ambassadors of Christ wagarutsweho n’Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Itorero ry’Abadivantisiti mu Rwanda Dr Hesron Byiringiro wavuze ko iyi yakoze umurimo ukomeye. Ati “Chorale Ambassadors of Christ yarabwirije, yamenyekanishje itorero ry’abadivantisiti b’umunsi wa karindwi mu Rwanda, mu bihugu byose bidukikije irazwi, Zambia yambwiye ko yayishimye ndetse abantu bo muri Angola bansabye ko yazajya kubaririmbira.” Ibirori by’isabukuru y’imyaka 20 Chorale Ambassadors of Christ imaze itangiye gukora umurimo w’Imana mu ndirimbo, byitabiriwe n’abantu basaga 2000, banezezwa n’indirimbo n’ubutumwa bwahatangiwe.

title: Ese Koko tariki 25 UKuboza Wari Umunsi W’ibigirwamana cyangwa ni ho Yezu yavutse, yavutse ate?
content: Yezu ni umwe mu biremwa bitangaje, cyane kuko ari umwana w’Imana, ariko wigize Umuntu maze akabana natwe, maze akemera kuvuka nk’abantu kugira ngo yisanishe natwe, ndetse aza gupfira abantu twese kubera ibyaha byacu. Ivuka rye rero rikaba ritavugwaho rumwe cyane cyane amadini atandukanye, kuva na kera kugeza n’ ubu. Abakristo benshi bizihiza ivuka ry’uyu mucunguzi ku itarik ya 25 ukuboza buri mwaka.  Ese iyi tariki niyo koko yavutseho? Ese Bibiliya ibivuga ho Iki? Bibiliya ivuga ko hari abantu batatu bashobora kuba bazi neza igihe nyakuri Yezu yaba yaravukiye, mbese yaba yarageze kuri iyi Si dutuyemo.  Abo bagabo bazwi ku izina rya “Magi” aribo bitwa  abanyabwenge batatu bagiye kuramya Yezu bayobowe n’inyenyeri. Izi nyenyeri zamurikiye aba bagabo batatu ngo nizo zirekana igihe nyacyo Yezu yaba yaravukiye kuko ngo zagaragaye agahana mu kinyeshna cya 6 na 5 ku ngoma ya Herodi. Ariko na Bibiliya ntacyo itangaza kigaragara ku gihe nyakuri ku ivuka rya Yezu, ndetse ngo inavuge igihe  itariki n’umwaka bizihiriza ivuka ry’umukiza. Ariko iby’uyu munsi   washyizweho wo kuri 25 ukuboza ngo bifitanye isano n’Abaromani ba bapagani  bizihizaga uyu munsi baramya ikigirwamana cyabo “ Saturnalia” icyo kigirwamana kikaba cyari cy’umusaruro. Mbere y’ikigihe Abakristu  ntibigeraga bizihiza uyu munsi w’ivuka rya Yezu, uyu munsi rero ukaba waramenyekanye cyane cyane mu kinyeshna cya 19. Itariki ya 25 ukuboza byaje nyuma y’imyaka 320 yezu avutse. Ubwo rero mu nyuma y’imyaka 320 nibwo papa Juliua I  yashyizeho iyo tariki ngo ige iba umunsi wo kwizihiza ibirori by’ivuka rya yezu. Naho mu mwaka wa 325 Constantine the Great, umwami w’Abami w’abaromani nibwo yemeje iyo tariki kumugaragaro,maze Musenyeri w’I Roma Liberius ahita ategeka abakristo kwizihiza uwo munsi tariki 25 ukuboza. Iyi tariki rero ikaba yarashyizweho kumpamvu z’abapagani bagiraga umunsi mukuru w’ibigirwamana kuri iyi tariki ya 25 ukuboza, maze abakristu nabo bahita baboneraho kuwegurira umucunguzi ngo berekane ko umucunguzi nyakuri ari Yezu umwana w’Imana iruta izindi zose ku isi. Ariko ngo umwaka nyakuri Yezu yaziyeho ku isi ni umwaka wa 6 m kwezi kwa kane (4)  kuko nta mwaka 0 zero wabayeho. Arko abakristu bo batangiye kwizihiza uwo munsi cyane cyane mukinyeshana cya 19. title: Papa Francis yikomye ibinyamakuru bitangaza ibihuha abigereranya no kugabura amazirantoki
content: Papa Francis yavuze ko ibinyamakuru byibanda ku gutangaza byacitse no gutangaza amakuru y’impuha ntaho bitaniye no kugaburira abantu amazirantoki. Ibi Papa Francis yabivugiye mu kiganiro yagiranye n’itangazamakuru kuri uyu wa 07 Ukwakira 2016. Papa Francis yavuze ko gutangaza ibihuha ari kimwe mu bintu byangiza umuryango itangazamakuru rishobora gukora kurusha uko rikora ibintu byigisha abaturage. Yavuze ko ubusanzwe itangazamakuru rifite imbaraga zo guhindura ubuzima bw’abantu binyuze mu kwigisha, mu bintu byubaka batangaza, mu gutuma abantu batekereza cyane n’ibindi. Papa avuga ko hari ubwo rigira abarikoresha bagamije gutangaza ibihuha ngo bahindanye isura y’abandi cyane cyane muri politiki. Yagaye kandi abatangaza byacitse ndetse bakibanda ku gutangaza ibintu bibi gusa kuko bigira ingaruka mbi nkuko Reuters dukesha iyi nkuru ibitangaza. Yagize ati: "Ndatekereza ko itangazamakuru rikwiye gutangaza ukuri, kandi mu mucyo bakirinda gukora icyaha cyo kugaburira abantu amazirantoki ari byo bigereranywa no guhora batangaza byacitse, ni ibintu bibabaje kuko bishobora kwangiza" Yagaragaje uburyo bamwe mu banyepolitiki bakoresha itangazamamkuru kugirango bavugwe neza maze bo bakavuga abandi ibitari byo bagamije kubasebya, agaragaza ko ibyo nta muntu ubifitiye uburenganzira kandi ko ari n’icyaha. Yasabye abanyamakuru kwirinda gutangaza ukuri kw’igice no kwibanda ku nkuru zivuga ibintu bibi gusa kuko ari bo muyoboro wo kubakwa kwa sosiyete. Yanditswe na Ubwanditsi/MUHABURA.rw

title: Abanyamadini barasabwa gukomeza kwamagana abayoboke barya/batanga ruswa
content:
Mu muri gahunda y’icyumweru cyahariwe gukumira no kurwanya ruswa, kuri uyu wa kane Urwego rw’Umuvunyi rwaganiriye n’abanyamadini banyuranye, rubibutsa ko bafite inshingano zo kwigisha abakristu babo kwirinda ruswa. Ariko ngo n’ufite amakuru ku muyoboke we wijanditse muri ruswa nta mpamvu yo kumuhishira.
Bernadette KANZAYIRE, Umuvunyi mukuru wungirije avuga ko bateguye kuganira n’abanyamadini byari bigamije gufasha abanyamadini kubona umwanya wo gusuzuma uruhare rwabo mu gukumira no kurwanya ruswa n’ibyaha bifitanye isano nabyo. Yavuze ko bashaka ko abanyamadini bareba ngo ese urwo ruhare rurahagije, hanyuma bafate ingamba kugira ngo urwo ruhare rukomere, bafashe abayoboke b’amadini yabo kurushaho kumva ko bafite inshingano zo gukumira no kurwanya ruswa, atari ukuyanga no kuyivuga mu magambo gusa, ahubwo bagakora ibikorwa bifatika. Kandi bagahora bakangurira abayoboke ko ruswa n’ibyaha bifitanye isano nabyo ari icyaha nk’uko bigaraga mu bitabo bitagatifu bagenderaho
Ati “Bagiye gukora iki cyatuma noneho nka bamwe mu batuye uru Rwanda bagaragara ko hari umusanzu ufatika bagize, ese hari ibimenyetso bajya batanga ko ruswa yatanzwe na bamwe mu banyamadini?” Ku birebana n’amakuru ku byaha abayoboke baba bakoze, abanyamadini bakayamenya ariko ntibayahe Leta, Umuvunyi KANZAYIRE avuga ko hagomba kurebwa niba hari amategeko abategeko ababuza kuba batanga ikimenyetso runaka. Ati “Nk’abenegihugu nabo bafite inshingano yo gutanga ibimenyetso, nibakomeza bakayihishira (ruswa) kandi babimenye, ejo izatera ibibazo kandi nabo izabagiraho ikibazo nabo. Niba tuvuga ngo hari kubakwa amashuri 10, hakubakwa abiri kubera ruswa yatanzwe, ni ukuvuga ngo abana b’igihugu bazaba batabonye amashuri meza bari bakwiye kubera ruswa yatanzwe, icyo gihe rero niba bayimenye, uko babimenye ni akazi kabo,… nibo bariburebe ingamba nyazo z’uko bazabikora kandi batishe n’umurongo w’idini.” Umuvunyi akavuga ko abanyamadini bashobora kwifashisha itegeko rirengera umuntu watanze amakuru, bakajya batanga amakuru ku rwego rw’umuvunyi cyangwa izindi nzego zikorana narwo atagaragaye. Padiri Etienne Mucyeragabiro, Umupadiri wa Diyoseze ya Nyundo, ushinzwe Komisiyo y’ubutabera n’amahoro muri iyo Diyoseze yabwiye Umuseke ko ruswa ari icyaha nk’ibindi amadini yigisha abayoboke bayo kureka. Ati “Dufite uruhare rukomeye cyane mu kwigisha abayoboke b’ayo madini, abanyarwanda muri rusange kugira ngo bacike kuri ruswa nk’icyaha, ariko noneho bihe n’uburyo igihugu gutera imbere kuko umutungo kiba gifite ukoreshwa neza, buri wese agahabwa icyo afitiye uburenganzira ahabwa n’amategeko.”
Ku birebana n’amakuru ku byaha abayoboke baba bakoze babaha mu gihe bihana, Padiri Mucyeragabiro avuga ko iyo Umupadiri yakiriye amabanga yo mu ntebe ya Penetensiya cyangwa umuntu aje kumugisha inama, ngo icyo uwo muntu aba ashaka ari ugukiranuka, no ugutunganira Imana. Ati “Icyo gihe rero mu biganiro ni ukumvikanisha ko umuntu ushaka gukira neza ku buryo bwuzuye, yiyunga n’Imana aca ukubiri n’icyaha yakoze, ariko ku rundi ruhande akaba agomba kwiyunga n’igihugu, n’abo yahemukiye. Niba umuntu yarariye ruswa, umufasha kumva ububi bwa ruswa, akumva ko ari icyaha gikomeye. Niba asabye imbabazi mu ntebe ya Penetensiya umuntu akaba yamubwira ko Imana yo ihora ibabarira, ariko na none Imana yifuza ko abantu bubahiriza amategeko, ni ukuvuga ngo niba yaribye, yaratwaye iby’abandi, icyo umuntu yamusaba ni uko abisubizwa, umuntu akagira uburenganzira kubyo yari yaravukijwe, ubundi noneho agashobora kubura amaso akabona uko yiyunga n’Imana neza.” Musenyeri Innocent Byakatonda, umusenyeri wa Orthodox mu karere we avuga ko mu gihe umuyoboke yireze akemera icyaha akwiye kubanza kuganirizwa akagirwa inama. Gusa, ngo hari n’aho biba ngobwa ko bamugira inama yo kujya kwirega mu nzego z’umutekano nk’iyo yakoze icyaha gikomeye cyangwa yarananiwe kwihana.

title: Ubu buhanuzi noneho ntibubaho! Ngo umuntu ukorana n’ibigo gikora nka Bank wese ntazajya mu ijuru?
content: Umugabo wo muri Nigeria, Akande Thomas yakwirakwije ubuhamya bushimangira ko umuntu winjiye muri gahunda yo gukorana n’ibigo bitsura amajyambere ntacyo azageraho. Yabishimangiraga nk’umuntu wafunguye konti mu kigega cyitwa MMM yarangiza akunguka ariko yajya gutanga icyacumi ku Mana, ikacyanga. Thomas abinyujije kuri rubuga rwa facebook, yavuze ko akurikije uburyo umuntu wabigiyemo ari umukirisitu Imaana yamwibwiriye ko amazina amazina y’abazabijyamo azasibwa mu gitabo cy’ubugingo. Dore uko inkuru ye yari imeze:  “bwa mbere njya muri MMM, nasenze Imana nyibaza niba yabihaye umugisha. Impakanira itabiciye ku ruhande, ngo umukirisutu wese ubigiemo izina rye risibwa mu gitabo cy’ubugingo. Nahise ngwa mu kantu ndetse ubwoba burantaha kuko nari ndi no gusenga njyenyine. Nkimara gusenga nahise nibaza nti ese ubundi irijwi rimbujije ni iry’Imana koko? Nkishidikanjya irindi jwi riramanukira rigira riti: “ntabwo ari iry’Imana ahubwo ni iry’umudayimoni ushaka kukuzirikira ku ngoyi y’ubukene” nkibyumva nahise ndeka iby’irya mbere numvira irya kabiri. nahise mfata umwanzuro wo gushora ibihumbi 250 muri MMM. Nyuma y’ukwezi byari ibyishimo ubwo nagarukaga aho nashoye. Imana yemeje wa mudayimoni maze impa umusaruro urenze. Nyuma yahoo nakurikijeho gutanga icyacumi. Nkitekereza ku byo kubikuza amafaranga Imana yarambwiye iti: “ntacyo mfite cyo gukoresha ayo mafaranga” nahise nturika ndarira nicuza impamvu nasuzuguye Imana. Nahise nsaba imbabazi kandi nzi ko nababariwe. Nakurikijeho gufunga konti yange yo muri MMM gusa n’ubu sundamena icyo nzakoresha ayo mafaranga Imana yanze.

title: Abapasiteri bageze mu zabukuru bishimiye ko bagiye gusaza neza
content:
Itorero Méthodiste Libre mu Rwanda ryagabiye inka abapasiteri 21 bageze mu zabukuru, mu rwego rwo kubafasha kugira amasaziro meza.
 Ubuyobozi bwi torero bwemeza ko ari ubwa mbere gahunda nk’iyi ibaye mu myaka hafi 75 rimaze rigeze mu Rwanda. Umwanzuro wo kugabira inka aba bapasiteri wafatiwe mu nama ya conference ya Kinyaga, yabereye muri aka karere, aho abapasiteri 20 kuri 21 bageze mu zabukuru mu Rwanda hose bagomba guhabwa izi nka bari bahari. Umwepisikopi w’iri torero akaba n’umuyobozi waryo mu Rwanda no muri Uganda, Musenyeri Samuel Kayinamura yavuze ko iki cyemezo gifashwe muri iriya nama yamaze iminsi 3, kikaba ari ikintu kitari cyarigeze gikorwa muri iri torero. Yagize ati “Hano habaye ikintu tutigeze dukora ahandi, aho twahuje abapasiteri bageze mu kiruhuko cy’izabukuru bo mu Rwanda hose, tubazana hano mu karere ka Rusizi tubakorera umwiherero, tuganira na bo, tuganira amateka y’iri torero, cyane cyane ko tunitegura Yubile y’imyaka 75 rimaze rigeze mu Rwanda. Bariya bakaba ari bo bazajya baduha amateka yaryo, tukaba twafashe gahunda yo kujya dusajisha neza uwakoreye itorero tumugabira, buri mupasiteri ugiye mu kiruhuko cy’izabukuru akazajya ahabwa inka, duhereye kuri bariya 21 bari basanzwe bari mu kiruhuko cy’izabukuru.” Avuga ko iri ari ishimwe rikomye ry’imirimo baba barakoze iriya myaka yose, kandi ko umuntu witangiye abandi mu myaka ingana kuriya aba adakwiye gusaza nabi, cyangwa ngo asaze atanywa amata kandi aba yarigomwe ibyagombaga kumuha ayo mata, akitangira bagenzi be akabateza imbere mu buryo bw’umwuka n’ubw’umubiri. Yagize ati “Ubu ni uburyo bwiza bwo kugira ngo tububahishe n’abazaza nyuma bazabone ko abababanjirije batasuzuguwe mu murimo bakoreye Imana, kandi natwe twiyubahishe, kuko natwe tugenda dusatira icyo gihe, natwe abo tuzaba dusize inyuma bazadufate neza.” Pasiteri Sibomana Jean wo mu murenge wa Nyabitekeri ufite imyaka 68 ariko we utari muri bariya 21 akazayihabwa ubutaha, yavuze ko iki ari ikintu gishimishije cyane kuko buri wese ugeze muri kiriya kigero yahageraga ahangayikishijwe n’imisazire ye, mu gihe aba yarigomwe igihe cye cyo gushaka amasaziro akitangira umurimo w’Imana. Yagize ati “Ibi ni ibishya tubonye bitigeze bibaho mu itorero ryacu, biratunejeje cyane kuko bizadufasha gusaza tunywa amata, abana bacu batandaraye, tubona mituweli, mbese tudasabiriza kandi twarakoreye Imana n’itorero.” Yanditswe na Ubwanditsi Muhabura.rw

title: Papa Francis yashyizeho Abakaridinari 17 bashobora kuzavamo uzamusimbura
content:
Umushumba wa Kiliziya Gatorika Papa Francis yatangiye guca amarenga ku isimburwa rye aho yashyizeho abakaridinali bashya 17  bo mu bihugu bitandukanye byo ku Isi, bakazaba aribo bazavamo ushobora kuzamusimbura ubwo azaba ashoje ubutumwa bwe.
 Aba bakaridinali batshyizeho n’uyu  Mushumba wa Kiliziya Gatorika ni abo mu bihugu bya Repubulika ya Centrafrique , Bangladesh, Papua , Guinea na Mauritius,Ubutaliyani, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika USA, Espagne, Brasil, Ububiligi, Venezuela, Lesotho , Malayisia, na Albania ;bose baturuka mu migabane itanu hakabamo n’intumwa y’i Vatican muri Syria. Gushyiraho abakaridinali ni imwe mu nshingano n’ububasha bya Papa dore ko bafatwa nk’ibikomangoma by’i Vatican. 13 mu bo Papa Francis yashyizeho, harimo abatagejeje ku myaka 80 bemerewe gutorwamo uzamusimbura igihe azaba yapfuye cyangwa yeguye.

title: Ese Yezu yaba yarashatse nk’uko benshi babitekereza
content:
Hirya no hiro ku isi , kuva  mu gihe cy’abasekuruza kugeza n’ubu benshi bagenda bumva inyigisho zitangwa abantu ko yezu  yaba yarashatse.  ni ukuvuga ko yaba yararongoye. Ndetse  banahamya bemye ko  Nyuma yo kujya mu ijuru ngo yagarutse  mu isi  akibanira n’umugore we.
 Ese koko  ibi ni ukuri? Ese Bibiliya twemera yo Ibivuga ho Iki? Bibiliya igaragaza neza yitonze ko rwose  Yezu atigeze ashaka, nu bwo Bibiliya itigeze igaragaza iby’ubugaragu bwe cyangwa iby’ubuzima bwe hanze y’iyobokamana  ariko ntibivuze ko  yarafite urugo hano mu Isi. Bibiliya  igaragaza iby’umuryango wa Yezu, ndetse n’abagore na bagabo bamuherekezaga umunsi ku munsi mu butumwa bwe bwo kogeza ingoma y’Imana, ndetse n’abari kumwe nawe   mu rugendo rw’urupfu rwe, ntaho Bibiliya igaragaza ibye N’umugore. Ruka (8:2-3) na Yohani (19:25). Yezu  niwe wabaye umusaseredote wa mbere, tugendeye kubahitamo kwiberaho nta gushaka Bibiliya yemera ko nabo bakorera Imana. Abigishwa baramubwira bati :Niba ari Uko Bimeze Ku mugabo n’umugore, Ikiruta ni ukudashaka. Nuko yezu arabasubiza  Ati : ’’Bose Ntibumva iyo mvugo,keretse ababihawe bonyine, kuko hari abavutse ari ibiremba n’abigize gutyo kubera ingoma y’Imana.Matayo (19:10-12) Yezu nawe yariyarahisemo kudashaka kubera ingoma y’Imana.
 Yezu Ntiyigeze ashaka umugore , kuko iyo aza kumugira ndetse n’abana, igihe yari agiye gupfa ntaba yarabwiye  Nyina na Nyina wabo Mariya muka Kilopa na Mariya Madalena ati ndetse nawamwigishwa yakundaga , maze agira ati :’’ Mubyeyi, dore  umwana wawe.; abwira na wamwigishwa yakundaga ati "dore nyoko" guhera icyo gihe, ubwo uwo mwigishwa amujyana iwe, aba yarabibwiye umugore we ndetse n’abana. Yohani (19:25-27) Bibiliya yakoresheje  Yezu nk’urugero rw’umugabo ariko  ntibisobanuye ko yari afite umugore  uretse ko yagize ati : Namwe bagabo ni mukunde abagore banyu, nk’uko Kristu yakunze kiliziya, maze akayitangiraAbanyafesi (5:25) ubwo rero iyo yezu aza kugira umugore kuri iyi si  aba yaritanzeho urugero ntaba yarakoresheje abagabo muri rusange. Benshi  bakunze kuyobya abantu bitewe n’ubushakatsi  bugenda bukorwa n’abantu batandukanye ku mibereho ya yezu ihabanye n’iy’iyokamana kuko ari yo Bibiliya yibanzeho gusa, bakavuga ko  Mariya wahoze ari Ihabara ariwe wabaye umugore wa yezu,  Gusa ibyo sibyo kuko  Bibiliya twemera igaragaza ko yari Umusaseredoti wiyeguriye Imana mu buryo bwo kudashaka. title: Gusoma Yezu ibirenge kwa Mariya ngo byaba bifite byinshi bisobanura
content:
Benshi basesengura byinshi  ku byerekeye urukundo  ndetse n’umubano wihariye wari hagati ya Yezu na Mariya wahoze ari ihabara, bamwe twavuga ko ari Anti christu( Idini) bavuga ko Mariya kuba yarasomye Yezu ndetse na Yezu akemera bifite icyo byasobanuraga ku rukundo rwabo.
 Banabiheraho banavuga ko ngo Mariya yaba yari inshuti ye ku buryo budasazwe, bagira bati "Ijambo Mariya riboneka muri bibiriya inshuro nyinshi, kandi ngo ibyo abachritu bavuga ko Uwakane mutagatifu Yezu yaremyeho Ukarisitiya ngo  byari amabeshyo ahubwo ngo  bwari ubukwe bwa Yezu na Mariya."
 Banemeza ko Yezu nyuma yo kujya mu ijuru ngo yaba yaragarutse kubana na Mariya. Banavuga ko ngo kuba  uriya mugore wagiye kumva ye bwa mbere ari uriya mariya wamusomye! Bakanamuhuza n’uriya mushiki wa Razaro Yezu yazuye bati  " yamuzuye kubera Mariya."
 Ku rundi ruhande ngo kuba yaramusomye kubirenge bifite ibintu 4 by’ingenzi byerekana: kimwe mu bintu bikomeye bitera isoni, umuntu ashobora gukorera undi ni ukumusoma ku birenge  . Bisaba kunama ugaca bugufi  ugasoma kimwe mu bice byanduye by’umubiri. Iki kimenyetso  ni kimwe mu bikorwa bikomeye umuntu akora asa nk’aho yitesheje agaciro  mu buzima bwe ku muntu w’umunyacyubahiro cyangwa ugukuriye hamwe n’uwo wubashye. Kubera icyubahiro umuntu agira mu buzima no kwirata bya muntu,  nta muntu wapfa gukora icyo gukorera undi icyo gikorwa undi , Atari uko ari umucakara we cyangwa  umuyobozi we. Ku rundi ruhande, ngo icyo gikorwa ngo  ni kimwe mubyerekana icyubahiro n’igitinyiro ( icyusa) umuntu ashobora gukorera undi mu buzima. Aya mahirwe n’amwe mu buzima  Mariya yagize igihe yasomaga  Yezu ku birenge ndetse  akanamuhanaguza umubavu ku birenge akanamuhanaguza imisatsi ye, igihe yari agiye  kwa Simoni. Mariya  wari ihabara yo ku rwego rwo hejuru muri icyo gihe, ibyo yakoze asoma Yezu ibirenge ngo bifite byinshi bisobanura. 1.      Gusoma yezu  ku birenge ngo byagaragaje kwicisha bugufi  no kwanga icyaha kwa Mariya.
Uyu mugore wari ihabara ( indaya)  akaba umunyabyaha wo kurwego rwo hejuru, ngo iki kimenyetso cyo gusoma Yezu ibirenge cyagaragaje kwicisha bugufi no kwanga ibyaha imbere ya yezu. 2.      Gusoma Yezu ibirenge byagaragaje kwirega nta buryarya  byari ku mutima wa Mariya.
Mariya yabonye ko yezu ari umukiza kandi akaba umucunguzi we, ntiwakizwa ibyaha igihe utemera ko Yezu ari umucunguzi w’abantu bose.  Mariya yaramaze kubona ko Yezu afite imbaraga zo ku mukiza kandi akababarirwa ibyaha kugira ngo azajye mu ijuru. 3.      Gusoma ibirenge bya Yezu byagaragaje urukundo n’ukwemera kwa Mariya.
Iki n’ikimenyetso k’icyizere  n’urukundo no gucungurwa kwa Mariya,  uru rukundo Mariya yeretse Yezu  byamubereye ukwemera gushyitse imbere ya Yezu . Yezu ati " genda ukwemera kwawe kuragukijije" 4.      Gusoma Yezu ibirenge ngo byagaragaje  ukwihana kwa Mariya.
Mariya ntiyagize  isoni zo kwirega imbere ya Yezu ndetse n’imbere y’imbaga y’abantu yari aho. Yirengagije ibyishimo byo ku isi maze abona ko ntakamaro ahubwo akeneye ubugingo bw’iteka Uyu mugore wari ihabara,  yakundwaga n’abagabo kandi byari bimutunze rwose ariko yahisemo kubireka maze ahitamo kwirega  kwikubita imbere ya Yezu ngo amubabarire.. Ninde witeguye gusoma ibirenge bya Yezu?  Ni uwari we wese  witeguye kureka ibibi byose bitera ibyishimo hano ku isi maze akarangamira inzira y’ijuru, aho azabona ibyishimo bitagira iherezo.  Abigishwa ba Yezu bari hafi aho ndetse n’abandi  batangajwe n’ibyo ihabara ryakoreye Yezu , ariko we yabasubije ati " udakora icyaha namutere ibuye uko bose barikubura baragenda."

title: “Turashaka kwigisha abakirisitu bacu gucika ku mfashanyo’’-  Musenyeri Onesphore Rwaje
content:
Umuyobozi mukuru w’Itorero ry’Abangilikani mu Rwanda, Musenyeri Onesphore Rwaje, arasaba abakirisitu b’iri torero muri Diyoseze ya Cyangugu gukoresha amahirwe y’iterambere igihugu n’itorero bibaha umunsi ku wundi, kugira ngo barusheho kwiteza imbere.
 Musenyeri Rwaje avuga ko bidakwiriye ko umukirisitu muzima udafite ikindi kibazo mu mubiri usanga ahora ataka ubukene, ngo abe ari we urwanira gushyirwa mu cyiciro cya mbere cy’ubudehe. Yasabye ko abayoboke b’Itorero ayoboye bakwiye guharanira kwiteza imbere bifatika, bahereye no ku bwenge n’imitekerereze Imana yabahaye, bagaharanira no guteza imbere abandi. Ni bimwe mu byo yatangarije mu karere ka Rusizi ubwo yifatanyaga n’abakirisitu ba paruwasi y’Angilikani Gashonga muri aka karere mu gutaha urusengero rw’iyi paruwasi yanabafunguriye ku mugaragaro. Nk’uko  yabitangarijwe n’umushumba wayo, Pasiteri Ndagijimana Ephrem, ngo rwuzuye rutwaye amafaranga arenga miliyoni 25. Mu ijambo rye, Nyiricyubahiro Musenyeri Onesphore Rwaje yunze mu ry’abandi bayobozi bakuru b’igihugu, aho yavuze ko bakwiriye kwagura imitekerereze bakareka kwibwira ko hari uzaturuka kure ngo aze abubakire ibyo bakagombye kwiyubakira. Abasaba guhera ku byo bafite bakabyongera bakiteza imbere, ibyo guhora bategereje imfashanyo bakabishyira ku ruhande. Yagize ati “Turashaka kwigisha abakirisitu bacu gucika ku mfashanyo kuko nubwo bavuga ngo ak’imuhana kaza imvura ihise, njye nongeraho ko iyo imvura ihise ari bwo aho yaguye harushaho kunyerera cyane n’ako k’imuhana wagafata kakaba kakunyererana kakangirika mu gihe akawe wari kuba wakabitse neza mbere y’uko iyo mvura igwa.” Yongeyeho ati “Hari abagiye batwizeza imfashanyo bakatugerekaho andi mategeko adakwiriye umuco wacu tudashobora kwihanganira, nk’ubutinganyi n’ibindi, hari n’abazifunze kandi ntacyo twashatse gukora ngo kitunanire, uyu muco wo gutegereza hanze ukaba ugomba kuva mu bakirisitu bacu, bagakora ibyabo, mu bushobozi bwabo.” Icyakora ashima abafatanyabikorwa babo b’Abanyamerika bibumbiye mu muryango ICM (International Coperation Ministries) babafasha kubaka insengero n’amashuri, aho batangiriye muri Diyoseze ya Cyangugu, bakaba bamaze gufasha mu kubaka insengero zirenga 20 zirimo n’urwo yafunguye ku mugaragaro, aho batanga miliyoni hafi 8 kuri buri rusengero, kandi bo ko nta mananiza babashyiraho. Musenyeri Nathan Rusengo Amoti, umwepisikopi wa Diyoseze ya Cyangugu, avuga ko iyi gahunda yo kwigisha abaturage kwiteza imbere bahereye ku byo bafite bayitangije mu bakirisitu babo, aho bahereye ku matsinda yo kuzigama no kugurizanya.

Umuyobozi mukuru w’Itorero ry’Abangilikani mu Rwanda, Musenyeri Onesphore Rwaje, arasaba abakirisitu b’iri torero muri Diyoseze ya Cyangugu gukoresha amahirwe y’iterambere igihugu n’itorero bibaha umunsi ku wundi, kugira ngo barusheho kwiteza imbere.

title: Urubyiruko rwo mu Itorero ERC mu giterane cy’ububyutse kiyobowe na  Apostle Joshua Masasu
content:
Urubyiruko rwo mu Itorero ry’Ivugabutumwa n’Isanamitima mu Rwanda (Evangelic Restoration Church), Paruwasi ya Nyarutarama rukomeje igiterane cy’ububyutse n’ivugabutumwa. Aho urubyiruko rusabwa kuba igitambo gishimwa n’Imana kandi rugatumbira Yesu Kristo mu buzima bwabo bwa buri munsi. 
 Iki giterane gifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti “Boneza amaso imbere yawe ugumye uhatumbire kandi utunganye inzira z’ibirenge byawe, kugira ngo ube igitambo gihindura umuryango”, iyi nsanganyamatiko iri mu Imigani 4; 25- 27. Iki giterane gikomeje kuzamo abavugabutumwa basizwe amavuta ndetse n’abahanzi bahimbaza Imana. Iki giterane cyatangiye tariki ya 25 Nzeri kugeza tariki ya 2 Ukwakira 2016, kibaba kibera i Nyarutarama hafi yo mu Kabuga ahari uru rusengero. Iki giterane cy’ububyutse kiba buri munsi kuva saa kumi kugeza saa moya n’igice z’ijoro mu minsi y’imibyizi ndetse no kuva saa munani z’amanywa kugeza saa moya n’igice z’ijoro mu minsi mu minsi y’isoza icyumweru (weekend). Umushumba wa ERC Nyarutarama, Pastor Seruhungo Alphonse yavuze ko iki giterane gifite intego yo kwegereza urubyiruko Imana ndetse no kugira ngo urubyiruko rwegere Imana runakire agakiza babere ibitambo imiryango yabo nayo ihinduke. Ubwo yatangizaga iki giterane ku mugaragaro, Apostle Masasu Joshua yavuze ko urubyiruko rufite imbaraga zihagije ku buryo babishatse bakorera Imana neza, aha kandi yatanze ubuhamya bw’uko yatangiye gukorera Imana akiri muto ku myaka gusa 22, aho yasenze akaba igitambo gishimwa n’Imana. Apostle Masasu yagize ati “Nkirangiza icyiciro cya mbere cya kaminuza nari mfite gusa imyaka 22 nibwo natangiye gukorera Imana; namwe ndabasaba kwegera Imana no kuyikorera mukiri bato mufite imbaraga kandi muzabona imigisha myinshi mu buzima bwanyu.” Umuyobozi w’urubyiruko rusengera kuri ERC Nyarutarama, Mwamini Zainabu avuga ko iki giterane kizakomeza kuba mu bihe bitandukanye kugira ngo urubyiruko rutandukanye rurusheho kubona umwanya wo kongera ubusabane bwabo n’Imana. Abavugabutumwa basizwe babwirije urubyiruko barimo Apostle Joshua Masasu, Pastor Ngoga Innocent, Pastor Seruhungo Alphonse na Pastor Masasu Patrick, Pastor Ruzindana Jean Marie na Pascale Keza. Abahanzi kandi bazataramira abazitabira igitaramo harimo Patient Bizimana, Gabby Irene Kamanzi, Liliane Kabaganza, Serge Iyamuremye, Nelson Mucyo, Arsene Tuyi na Kaneza Deborah. Ndetse hari n’abandi bahanzi benshi na worship teams zitandukanye harimo Total Praise worship team ya ERC Nyarutarama.
