title: Ese  no ku batinganyi hari amahirwe yo kuzabona  u bwami bw’ Ijuru?
content:
Ubutinganyi kimwe mu bikorwa byigarurirye isi muri iki kinyejana cya 21, kibaba kimwe mu bibazo bihangayikishije isi muri rusange, hirya no hino mu bihugu  haratorwa amategeko abyemeza, imyigaragabyo irakorwa umunsi ku munsi igamije kubisabira uburenganzira. Ubundi abahanga mu bya tewologiya bavuga ko nta cyaha kitababarirwa, bityo abafata ubutinganyi nk’icyaha, bafite amahirwe yo kujya mu ijuru mu gihe baba bihannye bakagarukira Imana nk’uko bigenda ku bindibyaha, ukuyemo “Gutuka cyangwa guhakana Imana yawe” Amadini amwe n’amwe, asezeranya abahuje ibitsina, andi agasezeranya abantu n’inyaswa. byateje impagarara mu nadini: Anglican ryo  ryamaze  gutora itegeko ryemerera ababana bahuje ibitsina,  abasenyeri muri Cotholic bari kwegura bazira ubutinganyi. Umushakashatsi Moanti ( Moe-on-tee) yagaragaje bimwe mu bintu bituma abantu bakorana imibonano mpuzabitsina bahuje ibitsina: uguhitamo kwa muntu, ibigeragezo, ubudayimoni, uburwayi bwo mu mutwe, guhungabana, kubura ubushobozi ndetse n’akamenyero. Mariya (Madagarena) uvugwa muri Bibiliya wa hose ari ihabara yo ku rwego rwo hejuru yarababariwe ntagushidikanya ubu wicaranye na Yezu mu ijuru.  Abakora imibonano mpuzabitsina bahuje ibitsina barara amajoro basenga ngo Imana izabakire. Bibiliya ihamya ko ari icyaha kandi ngo ubutinganyi buhabanye n’ugushaka kw’imana  igihe yaremaga Admu na Eva nk’umugabo n’umugore.  Yezu ati “ Naje  gupfira ibyaha  byanyu” ariko nanone ikavuga ko icyaha kimwe kitababarirwa ni icyaha cyo kwihakana Imana bakunze kwita “gutuka Imana”. Ariko se niba abatinganyi bizera Yezu nk’umucunguzi wabo ariko ntibahinduke  ese bazajya mu ijuru? Bibiliya irongera ikavuga ko niba umuntu  yemera Imana byukuri mu buzima bwe, nta kintu nakimwe kizamubuza kujya mu bwami bw’Ijuru, Yohana 10:28. “Mbahaye kubaho mu buzima buhoraho  ntibazapfa ukundi, nta muntu n’umwe ushobora kubavana mu maboko yange” Ariko se kuki twemera Imana ariko ntudukore ibyo idutegeka? Nta kwemera Yezu udahinduka, menya Yezu unahinduke ukore ibyo ashaka. Igihe  abatinganyi bazarekeraho gukora icyaha cy’ubutinganyi ba kihana   bakamesa amakanzu yabo mu maraso ya ntama nta kabuza  bazataha ijuru. Yezu ati “ Mwikorere ibitwaro yanyu  muyizane ndabaruhura, ndi umunyampuhwe n’umunyambabazi  kubaza  banzanga.” Ubwo rero igihe cyose umunyabyaha ya kwihana akababarirwa nta kabuza yakwicarana n’Imana.

title: Mu  Bwongereza, umukinnyi yasezeye ku ikipe ye yigira mu byo gusenga
content:
Umukinnyi wo hagati akaba na myugariro witwa Jeremy Helan, ku myaka 24 yatunguye ikipe ye ya Sheffield Wednesday yo muri Championship ababwira ko ashaka kuva mu byo gukina agashyira inguvu mu gusenga. Sportsmail yasesenguye iby’uyu musore wakiniye France U19, bavuga ko yari yitezweho kuzaba Pafrice Evra mushya, ntibyaje kumuhira cyane ku buryo agiye kwerekeza Saudi Arabia nyuma y’aho ngo n’ubundi yongereye cyane ibihe byo kuba mu musigiti. Amasezerano ya Helan yari atararangira, yagombaga kuzashira ku musozo w’iyi season. Uyu musore asanzwe ari nyamwigendaho, nta bantu ajya abwira amakuru ye. Hari abavuga ko ari ibiri mu rwambariro, Helan yabibwiriye icyifuzo cye mu cyumweru gishize. Yavuze ko ashaka kwigira Saudi Arabiya ku mpamvu z’amasengesho. Mu ikipe nta byinshi bavuze gusa ngo baracyari kugira ibyo bavugana.

title: Pasiteri Bizimungu  umwe mu bitabiriye umuhango wo gushyingura Mgr Ngirabanyiginya
content:
Musenyeri Alexis Habiyambere ni we wayoboye umuhango wo gushyingura Mgr Ngirabanyiginya Dominic wari umusenyeri w’icyubahiro muri diyosezi ya Nyundo witabye Imana mu ijoro rishyira kuwa 7 Nzeli 2016. Mgr Ngirabanyiginya wazize uburwayi bwa diyabeti buri wa kane yajyaga Kigali mu Bitaro Byitiriwe Umwami Faical ( King Faysal Hospital); bivugwa ko hari hashize igihe kirekire akora izi ngendo buri cyumweru. Umuhango guherekeza Nyakwigendera ubaye mu gihe Umushumba wa Diyosezi ya Nyundo yagiye i Roma mu Butaliyani mu nama yarangiye kuwa gatandatu ihuza abasenyeri bashya bo ku isi. Witabiriwe n’abandi basenyeri batandukanye ndetse na Pasteri Bizimungu wigeze kuba Perezida wa Repubulika y’u Rwanda. Mgr Ngirabanyiginya wari ufite imyaka 79 azwiho kuba yarareze abantu benshi bakomeye, barimo abapadiri, abasenyeri n’abayobozi... Azwi kandi nk’umuhanga usigiye Kiliziya Gatolika y’u Rwanda indirimbo nyinshi zihimbaza Imana. Yavukiye muri paruwasi ya Kabgayi mu 1937, atangira iseminari nto mu 1952, ahabwa ubupadiri mu 1964. Yabaye umwigisha mu iseminari amara imyaka myinshi muri seminari yitiriwe Mutagatifu Piyo wa X yo ku Nyundo. Abasenyeri bagaragaje agahinda gakomeye batewe no kuba babuze muganzi wabo wari ingirakamaro mu muryango nyarwanda ndetse n’uwa kiliziya Gatolika. Musenyeri Anaclet Mwumvaneza utabashije kwitabira uyu muhango wo gushyingura yagize ati "Nakiranye akababaro kenshi amakuru yo kubura Nyakwigendera gahunda ndimo i Roma yatumye ntaza kwifatanya namwe. Nyakwigendera yarangizaga inshingano ze natwe nka Diyosezi ya Nyundo ntituzigera kumwibagirwa."
 Yakomeje avuga ko na Seminari yitiriwe Pio wa X itazamwibagirwa kuko ari ho uyu mukambwe yabigishirije kuririmba n’ubundi bumenyi babona nk’umurage bazahora bazirikana. Ati "Nyagasani amuhe iruhuko ridashira."

title: Papa Francis ntiyitaye ku batamushyigikiye
content:
Papa Francis azaha umugisha ubutagatifu bwa Mama Teresa w’ I Calcutta kuri icyi cyumweru. Benshi mu bakozi ba Vatican ariko ntibabyumva. Kimwe n’abandi bahanga mu mateka ya Gatulika bari kubibonera mu ndorerwamo y’inyungu za papa Francis ku giti cye. Washington Post ivuga ko abakurikiranira hafi iby’ iki gikorwa bemeza ko Papa Francis ari gushyira abantu benshi mu batafatifu ku buryo butari busanzwe ho kuva no kuri Papa Yohana Pawulo wa II. Mu myaka itatu n’igice gusa amaze ku bupapa, Francis amaze gushyira abantu 29 bose mu batagatifu. Bivuze ko amaze kurusha uwo yasimbuye Papa Benedict wa XVI abantu 11 urebye abo yari amaze gushyiraho mu gihe nk’iki. Bigaragara ko hatagize igihinduka yazanakuraho agahigo kashyizweho mu kinyejana cya 15 aho babaye 813. Ikibazo si umubare gusa kuko n’uburya bikorwamo bivugwaho rumwe.  Umwe mu banditsi yitwa Austen Ivereigh, yanditse ibitabo birimo na The Great Reformer: Francis and the Making of a Radical Pope.”, yagizemo ati "mu gihe Pawulo wa II yapfaga hari amarangamutima akomeye ku buryo hari kuba harabayeho abatagatifu benshi, gusa kubikora byaritondeshejwe.”. Ubusanzwe muri Kiliziya Gatulika, gushyira umuntu mu batagatifu bitwara imyaka myinshi, hari n’ubwo bigera mu majana. Ari ko Mama Teresa ugiye gushyirwa muri iki cyikiro, amaze imyaka 19 gusa yitsbye Imana. Francis amaze guha umugisha abatagatifu batatu ku buryo bwihuse birenze urugero. Ni uyu Mama Teresa, Yohani Pawulo wa II n’umya espanyekazi witabye Imana mu 1998. Ngo ibi rero bikaba byazarangira Vatican yose yuzuye abatagafu. Edmund Arens ni umwalimu mu bijyanye n’amahame ya tewologiya muri kaminuza ya Arens mu Busuwisi, yavuze ko bigomba gutwara igihe gihagije kugira ngo hasuzumwe neza ubuzima b’umutagatifu. Yagize ati “niba umuntu yarabaye intangarugero mu buzima bwe, kuki hadafatwa umwanya uhagije wo kwimwigaho byimbitse?" Francis ashinjwa na bamwe mu bakozi ba Vatican gukora iki gikorwa uko abyumva kandi agendeye ku marangamutima ye. Rev. Robert Sarno ukorere Vatican yavuze ko n’ubwo ijambo rya nyumwa ari irya papa, bidakwiye ko yajya akora uko abyumva. Aba bafite aho bahuriye na Gatulika, bavuga ko uku kwihutisha ibintu ari uguharanira inyungu za Francis bwite cyane cyane ku bantu b’ ibirangirire nka Mama Teresa na Papa Yohani Pawulo wa II. Mana Teresa w ‘I Calcutta ho mu Buhinde, hari abatamwera nk’umuntu udasanzwe. Umunyamakuru w’Umwangereza Tariq Ali,yakoze icyegeranyo gipfabya Teresa mu 1994. Yagize ati “abantu yakizaga bari abantu bari aho ku bituro bategereje gushyingurwa, abantu batabonye ubuvuzi bukwiye. Abashavuye,”. Ibi Francis arimo si byokugira abantu bakoze ubusa abatagatifu si byo.


Mama Teresa w’i Calcutta Nyamara ariko uyu mubyeyi yatangiye no kwitwa umutagatifu na rubanda nyamwinshi n’igihe yari akiri muzima. Yamenyakanye cyane ku kwita ku bitabye Imana.  Mu 1971 niho yavuze iri jambo “indawara mbi  muri iyi minsi si Igituntu cyangwa Leprosy, ahubwo ikiruta ibyo ni ukwiyumvamo ko udakenewe,”. Umutagatifu ni umuntu uba warageregeje kuba intumwa y’Imana, akayibera aho itagaragara. Ibi bitangira gukorwa nibura nyuma y’imyaka itanu amaze gupfa. Byemerezwa I Vatican nyuma yo gusuzuma ibikorwa bye na rapora ituruka muri Dioseze aba ayrakoreregamo, biherekejwe n’ibitangaza nibura bibiri yakoze.

title: Polisi y’u Rwanda irashima amadini ku ruhare rwayo mu kurwanya ibyaha bigisha
content:
Polisi y’u Rwanda irashima amadini ku ruhare rwayo mu kurwanya ibyaha bigisha abayoboke bayo kuba intangarugero.
 
Mu rwego rwo guteza imbere ubwo bufatanye no kubushimangira Polisi y’u Rwanda igirana ibiganiro n’abayoboke b’amadini atandukanye cyane cyane urubyiruko maze ikabaha ubumenyi ku buryo  barushaho kugira uruhare  mu gukumira ibyaha. Guhugura abayoboke b’amadini atandukanye bigamije kubasobanurira uruhare rwabo  mu kurwanya ikibi mu muryango nyarwanda; kandi byabyaye umusaruro ushimishije. Ni muri urwo rwego ku itariki 29 Nyakanga Polisi y’u Rwanda yagiranye ikiganiro n’ urubyiruko  rw’Abadivantisite b’Umunsi wa Karindwi rugera kuri 438 ruri mu ngando mu karere ka Nyanza ku bubi  bw’ibiyobyabwenge. Urwo rubyiruko ruturuka mu turere twa Nyanza, Kamonyi, Muhanga na Ruhango. Polisi y’u Rwanda yarwigishije ubwoko bw’ibiyobyabwenge kandi irusobanurira ingaruka zo kubyishoramo. Mu butumwa bwe, ushinzwe imikoranire ya Polisi y’u Rwanda n’abaturage ndetse n’izindi nzego mu karere ka Nyanza, Inspector of Police (IP) Jean Baptiste Bizimana yabwiye urwo rubyiruko ati:"Zimwe mu ngaruka urubyiruko runywa ibiyobyabwenge ruhura na zo harimo gutwara inda zitateganyijwe no gukora ibyaha birimo ubujura, gukubita no gukomeretsa, n’ibindi. Ni yo mpamvu ikoreshwa n’ikwirakwizwa ryabyo bigomba kurwanywa kandi buri wese akumva ko bimureba." Yakomeje ababwira ko uretse gushyira ubuzima bw’ababinywa mu kaga  ibiyobyabwenge biteje ikibazo muri rusange kubera ko bituma abantu bakora ibikorwa binyuranije n’amategeko. IP Bizimana yabwiye kandi urwo rubyiruko ati:" Nk’uko bivugitse  ibiyobyabwenge bihindura imitekerereze y’uwabinyoye. Uretse kumutesha  ubwenge; ubinywa nta buzima aba afite. Mugomba kwirinda ikintu cyose gishobora kwangiza ahazaza hanyu." Yarusobanuriye ko urumogi, Kanyanga n’ibindi biyobyabwenge bitera uwabinyoye gukora  ibyaha nko gufata ku ngufu, gusambanya abana, n’ibindi. Yagize ati:"Akora ibyaha kubera ko nta mutimanama aba afite. Turabasaba kuba abafatanyabikorwa mu gukangurira abandi kwirinda ibiyobyabwenge n’ibindi byaha muri rusange." IP Bizimana na none yagize ati:"Abanyamadini bagira uruhare rukomeye mu gushimangira ihame ry’ubufatanye hagati ya  Polisi y’u Rwanda n’abaturage,turabasaba gukomeza kugira uruhare mu kurwanya no gukumira ibyaha kugira ngo hagerwe ku mutekano usesuye."

 
Yanditswe na Sarongo/Muhabura.rw

title: Wamenya ute  ko impanda y’Imana izavuga nk’uko bivugwa?
content:
Abigisha baragwiriye abavuga ukuri n’abavuga ibinyoma, amadini menshi aravuka ubutitsa, inyota y’abantu benshi turashaka kubwirwa ko imbere yacu ari heza, amasezerano yacu agiye gusohora, imigisha tugiye kubura aho tuyikwiza, tugiye kwishima hejuru y’abanzi bacu n’ibindi nk’ibyo bihwanye n’ukunezerwa kwacu. Ariko uje atubwira kuba maso, utubwiye ko Isi igiye gushira kandi irashirana no kwifuza kwayo, uje avuga ngo twihane ibyaha byacu tube maso Yesu ari hafi kugaruka, uvuze atyo yitwa uwavangiwe .

Ariko uje atubwira kuba maso, utubwiye ko Isi igiye gushira kandi irashirana no kwifuza kwayo, uje avuga ngo twihane ibyaha byacu tube maso Yesu ari hafi kugaruka, uvuze atyo yitwa uwavangiwe n’umuyobe. Mu by’ukuri ni byiza kandi dukeneye rwose ko Imana itugirira neza ikaduha amasezerano menshi meza cyane cyane aduhumuriza kugira ngo tudakomeza guhungabanywa n’imiyaga ya Satani, ariko icyo dukwiriye kwibuka bakundwa, ni uko kuba umuntu yaba mu rusengero, mu Kiriziya n’ahandi hasengerwa, akabona atashye amahoro ejo n’ejobundi bikaba uko akibwira ko ari amahoro nyamara hari ibyo yimitse mu mutima we bibi bibabaza Imana yananiwe kureka ngo yakire imbabazi z’Imana, ibi ntibibuza Imana kumusohoreza isezerano yagiranye na we kugira ngo atazayita inyabinyoma, ariko atakwihana akazasigara kuko isezerano ry’Imana ntaho rihurira no kwezwa kw’ubugingo bw’umuntu kuko gusohora kw’isezerano ntibibuza nyiraryo kurimbuka iyo atihannye icyaha yananiwe kureka. Bibiliya iratubwira ngo “Mu mahanga yose uyubaha agakora ibyo gukiranuka uwo niwe Imana yemera.” Muri iyi minsi tugezemo indirimbo zivuga ko amasezerano asohoye ziraririmbwa tukanezerwa tukumva ko aribwo Imana ivuze, Ijambo ry’Imana rije rivuga ko ejo hacu ari heza niryo rihabwa umwanya ariko hagira ukoma gato ku byaha bikomeje kuyogoza Isi n’abari mu itorero badasigaye, abantu bose, yewe no mu mutima w’umuntu wumvise ubwe ko ariwe ubwirwa muri iryo Jambo ry’Imana agacyahira kure ngo si ibye, undi ati ibi ni ugutera abantu ubwoba n’ibindi. Nshuti bavandimwe turye tunywe tunezerwe ni byiza, iterambere tugenda tugeraho mu mibereho yacu ni ryiza rwose turarikeneye mu buzima bwacu bwa buri munsi, ariko twongere tuzirikane ko ibi byose bidashobora guhindura icyo Bibiliya Ijambo ry’Imana rivuga ko impanda y’Uwiteka izavuga kandi izavuga itunguranye nk’uko Yesu abyihamiriza ubwe ati: “Ariko uwo munsi n’icyo gihe nta we ubizi n’aho baba abamalayika bo mu ijuru cyangwa Umwana w’Imana keretse Data wenyine… Nuko namwe mwitegure kuko igihe mudatekereza ari cyo Umwana w’umuntu azazira.” (Matayo 24: 36 - 44) Nubwo duhora tubibwirwa kenshi tukabifata nk’inkuru zisanzwe zihora zivugwa, ariko mureke twongere twibukiranye ibyo Ijambo ry’Imana ritubwira ko Impanda y’Uwiteka Imana izavuga rwose kandi abejejwe mu mitima yabo nibo bonyine bazayumva basanganire Umwami Yesu ku bicu, abanduye mu mitima yabo n’abazaba batari maso ntibazamenya rwose n’igihe byabereye kuko Bibiliya itubwira ko ari igikorwa kizaba nko guhumbya no guhumura. Uku gutungurana kw’impanda y’imperuka nk’uko tubisoma mu butumwa bwiza uko bwanditswe na Mariko, niho Yesu ubwe atanga ikigereranyo ati: “Ni nk’umuntu wasize urugo rwe ajya mu kindi gihugu, aha abagaragu be ubutware, umuntu wese ahabwa umurimo we, ategeka umukumirizi kuba maso. Ni uko namwe mube maso kuko mutazi igihe nyiri urugo azaziramo atazabatungura agasanga musinziriye. Icyo mbabwira ndakibwira bose nti ‘Mube maso’” Mariko 13: 34-37. “Nk’uko byari biri mu minsi ya Nowa: abantu bararyaga, baranywaga, barashyingiraga, barashyingirwaga bari banezerewe, bageza ku munsi Nowa yinjiriye mu nkuge ntibabimenya. Uko niko bizaba bimeze no mu minsi y’imperuka, ubwo bazaba bavuga bati ni amahoro ni amahoro nibwo kugaruka kw’Umwami wacu Yesu kuzabatungura.” (Matayo 24: 37-44). “Ubwo nibwo bazabona Umwana w’umuntu aje ku bicu afite ubushobozi bwinshi n’ubwiza. Azatuma abamalayika, ateranye intore ze mu birere bine, uhereye ku mpera y’isi ukageza ku mpera y’ijuru” (Mariko 13: 26-27) Nk’uko tubisoma mu gitabo cy’Ibyahishuwe, Yohana yerekwa iby’impanda y’imperuka, yabonye amahanga menshi aterana ati: “Mbona intebe y’ubwami nini yera mbona n’Iyicayeho, isi n’ijuru bihunga mu maso hayo, ahabyo ntihaba hakiboneka. Mbona abapfuye, abakomeye n’aboroheje bahagaze imbere y’iyo ntebe, ni uko ibitabo birabumburwa kandi mbona n’ikindi gitabo kirabumburwa ari cyo gitabo cy’ubugingo, abapfuye bacirwa imanza z’ibyanditswe muri ibyo bitabo zikwiriye ibyo bakoze… Kandi mbona umuntu wese utabonetse ko yanditse muri cya gitabo cy’ubugingo, ajugunywa muri iyo Nyanja yaka umuriro” (Ibyahishuwe 20: 11-15). Bibiliya mu Byahishuriwe Yohana nk’uko ikomeza ibitubwira, igaragaza akaga gakomeye kazakurikirwa n’uko itorero rya Kristo rikuwe mu isi rigiye. Aha ni naho tubona bamwe mubo Ijambo ry’Imana ritubwira bazasigara ubwo Kristo azaba agarutse nk’uko ibyanditswe bitubwira: Abantu ba mbere Bibiliya ivuga ni abantu bose banze kumva ubutumwa bwiza bagakerensa ubuntu bw’Imana.
2. Abantu ba kabiri ni abakiristu bishushanya mu itorero ry’Imana bakirengagiza ukuri, bakibagirwa ko no mu mutima w’umuntu Imana ihabona neza nk’ahambaye ubusa.
3. Abandi bantu ba gatatu Bibiliya itubwira ni abakiristu bose bazaba batabaye maso. Uku kuba impanda izavuga itunguye benshi, nta kundi gusubira inyuma ngo hatangwe agahenge ko kwihana ku bazaba batunguwe nayo basigaye. Ibi mu by’ukuri byari bikwiriye gutuma buri wese wo muri twe yita ku iherezo rye ku giti cye, bigatuma ahora akurikirana uko abanye n’Imana mu mutima we buri munsi, buri saha na buri mwanya, kuko impanda yo kuvuga izavuga nk’uko Ibyanditswe Byera bibitubwira. (Mariko 13: 37) Imana umuremyi wacu, nubwo tutabasha kumunezeza nk’uko bikwiriye ariko aradukunda cyane kandi ntanezezwa n’uko twazarimburanwa na Satani, ahubwo yifuza ko twamwumvira tukazabana mu Bwami bwe iteka mu ijuru. Ndabifuriza kuba maso tukazabona ibihembo by’imirimo myiza twakoze nitugera mu ijuru. Imana idufashe.Abigisha baragwiriye abavuga ukuri n’abavuga ibinyoma, amadini menshi aravuka ubutitsa, inyota y’abantu benshi turashaka kubwirwa ko imbere yacu ari heza, amasezerano yacu agiye gusohora, imigisha tugiye kubura aho tuyikwiza, tugiye kwishima hejuru y’abanzi bacu n’ibindi nk’ibyo bihwanye n’ukunezerwa kwacu. Ariko uje atubwira kuba maso, utubwiye ko Isi igiye gushira kandi irashirana no kwifuza kwayo, uje avuga ngo twihane ibyaha byacu tube maso Yesu ari hafi kugaruka, uvuze atyo yitwa uwavangiwe . Abigisha baragwiriye abavuga ukuri n’abavuga ibinyoma, amadini menshi aravuka ubutitsa, inyota y’abantu benshi turashaka kubwirwa ko imbere yacu ari heza, amasezerano yacu agiye gusohora, imigisha tugiye kubura aho tuyikwiza, tugiye kwishima hejuru y’abanzi bacu n’ibindi nk’ibyo bihwanye n’ukunezerwa kwacu. Ariko uje atubwira kuba maso, utubwiye ko Isi igiye gushira kandi irashirana no kwifuza kwayo, uje avuga ngo twihane ibyaha byacu tube maso Yesu ari hafi kugaruka, uvuze atyo yitwa uwavangiwe n’umuyobe. Mu by’ukuri ni byiza kandi dukeneye rwose ko Imana itugirira neza ikaduha amasezerano menshi meza cyane cyane aduhumuriza kugira ngo tudakomeza guhungabanywa n’imiyaga ya Satani, ariko icyo dukwiriye kwibuka bakundwa, ni uko kuba umuntu yaba mu rusengero, mu Kiriziya n’ahandi hasengerwa, akabona atashye amahoro ejo n’ejobundi bikaba uko akibwira ko ari amahoro nyamara hari ibyo yimitse mu mutima we bibi bibabaza Imana yananiwe kureka ngo yakire imbabazi z’Imana, ibi ntibibuza Imana kumusohoreza isezerano yagiranye na we kugira ngo atazayita inyabinyoma, ariko atakwihana akazasigara kuko isezerano ry’Imana ntaho rihurira no kwezwa kw’ubugingo bw’umuntu kuko gusohora kw’isezerano ntibibuza nyiraryo kurimbuka iyo atihannye icyaha yananiwe kureka. Bibiliya iratubwira ngo “Mu mahanga yose uyubaha agakora ibyo gukiranuka uwo niwe Imana yemera.” Muri iyi minsi tugezemo indirimbo zivuga ko amasezerano asohoye ziraririmbwa tukanezerwa tukumva ko aribwo Imana ivuze, Ijambo ry’Imana rije rivuga ko ejo hacu ari heza niryo rihabwa umwanya ariko hagira ukoma gato ku byaha bikomeje kuyogoza Isi n’abari mu itorero badasigaye, abantu bose, yewe no mu mutima w’umuntu wumvise ubwe ko ariwe ubwirwa muri iryo Jambo ry’Imana agacyahira kure ngo si ibye, undi ati ibi ni ugutera abantu ubwoba n’ibindi. Nshuti bavandimwe turye tunywe tunezerwe ni byiza, iterambere tugenda tugeraho mu mibereho yacu ni ryiza rwose turarikeneye mu buzima bwacu bwa buri munsi, ariko twongere tuzirikane ko ibi byose bidashobora guhindura icyo Bibiliya Ijambo ry’Imana rivuga ko impanda y’Uwiteka izavuga kandi izavuga itunguranye nk’uko Yesu abyihamiriza ubwe ati: “Ariko uwo munsi n’icyo gihe nta we ubizi n’aho baba abamalayika bo mu ijuru cyangwa Umwana w’Imana keretse Data wenyine… Nuko namwe mwitegure kuko igihe mudatekereza ari cyo Umwana w’umuntu azazira.” (Matayo 24: 36 - 44) Nubwo duhora tubibwirwa kenshi tukabifata nk’inkuru zisanzwe zihora zivugwa, ariko mureke twongere twibukiranye ibyo Ijambo ry’Imana ritubwira ko Impanda y’Uwiteka Imana izavuga rwose kandi abejejwe mu mitima yabo nibo bonyine bazayumva basanganire Umwami Yesu ku bicu, abanduye mu mitima yabo n’abazaba batari maso ntibazamenya rwose n’igihe byabereye kuko Bibiliya itubwira ko ari igikorwa kizaba nko guhumbya no guhumura. Uku gutungurana kw’impanda y’imperuka nk’uko tubisoma mu butumwa bwiza uko bwanditswe na Mariko, niho Yesu ubwe atanga ikigereranyo ati: “Ni nk’umuntu wasize urugo rwe ajya mu kindi gihugu, aha abagaragu be ubutware, umuntu wese ahabwa umurimo we, ategeka umukumirizi kuba maso. Ni uko namwe mube maso kuko mutazi igihe nyiri urugo azaziramo atazabatungura agasanga musinziriye. Icyo mbabwira ndakibwira bose nti ‘Mube maso’” Mariko 13: 34-37. “Nk’uko byari biri mu minsi ya Nowa: abantu bararyaga, baranywaga, barashyingiraga, barashyingirwaga bari banezerewe, bageza ku munsi Nowa yinjiriye mu nkuge ntibabimenya. Uko niko bizaba bimeze no mu minsi y’imperuka, ubwo bazaba bavuga bati ni amahoro ni amahoro nibwo kugaruka kw’Umwami wacu Yesu kuzabatungura.” (Matayo 24: 37-44). “Ubwo nibwo bazabona Umwana w’umuntu aje ku bicu afite ubushobozi bwinshi n’ubwiza. Azatuma abamalayika, ateranye intore ze mu birere bine, uhereye ku mpera y’isi ukageza ku mpera y’ijuru” (Mariko 13: 26-27)
Nk’uko tubisoma mu gitabo cy’Ibyahishuwe, Yohana yerekwa iby’impanda y’imperuka, yabonye amahanga menshi aterana ati: “Mbona intebe y’ubwami nini yera mbona n’Iyicayeho, isi n’ijuru bihunga mu maso hayo, ahabyo ntihaba hakiboneka. Mbona abapfuye, abakomeye n’aboroheje bahagaze imbere y’iyo ntebe, ni uko ibitabo birabumburwa kandi mbona n’ikindi gitabo kirabumburwa ari cyo gitabo cy’ubugingo, abapfuye bacirwa imanza z’ibyanditswe muri ibyo bitabo zikwiriye ibyo bakoze… Kandi mbona umuntu wese utabonetse ko yanditse muri cya gitabo cy’ubugingo, ajugunywa muri iyo Nyanja yaka umuriro” (Ibyahishuwe 20: 11-15). Bibiliya mu Byahishuriwe Yohana nk’uko ikomeza ibitubwira, igaragaza akaga gakomeye kazakurikirwa n’uko itorero rya Kristo rikuwe mu isi rigiye. Aha ni naho tubona bamwe mubo Ijambo ry’Imana ritubwira bazasigara ubwo Kristo azaba agarutse nk’uko ibyanditswe bitubwira: Abantu ba mbere Bibiliya ivuga ni abantu bose banze kumva ubutumwa bwiza bagakerensa ubuntu bw’Imana.
2. Abantu ba kabiri ni abakiristu bishushanya mu itorero ry’Imana bakirengagiza ukuri, bakibagirwa ko no mu mutima w’umuntu Imana ihabona neza nk’ahambaye ubusa.
3. Abandi bantu ba gatatu Bibiliya itubwira ni abakiristu bose bazaba batabaye maso. Uku kuba impanda izavuga itunguye benshi, nta kundi gusubira inyuma ngo hatangwe agahenge ko kwihana ku bazaba batunguwe nayo basigaye. Ibi mu by’ukuri byari bikwiriye gutuma buri wese wo muri twe yita ku iherezo rye ku giti cye, bigatuma ahora akurikirana uko abanye n’Imana mu mutima we buri munsi, buri saha na buri mwanya, kuko impanda yo kuvuga izavuga nk’uko Ibyanditswe Byera bibitubwira. (Mariko 13: 37) Imana umuremyi wacu, nubwo tutabasha kumunezeza nk’uko bikwiriye ariko aradukunda cyane kandi ntanezezwa n’uko twazarimburanwa na Satani, ahubwo yifuza ko twamwumvira tukazabana mu Bwami bwe iteka mu ijuru. Ndabifuriza kuba maso tukazabona ibihembo by’imirimo myiza twakoze nitugera mu ijuru. Imana idufashe. 

Wamenya ute  ko impanda y’Imana izavuga nk’uko bivugwa?
 Yanditswe na Sarongo Richard

title: Mufti w’u Rwanda yamaganye Abayislamukazi bambara imyambaro ihisha isura hagasigara amaso gusa
content:
Asoza ukwezi kwahariwe Igisibo Gitagatifu ku bayoboke b’idini ya Islam, Umuyobozi w’idini ya Islam mu Rwanda, Sheikh Salim Hitimana yatangaje ko abayisilamukazi bo mu Rwanda batazongera kwambara umwambaro wa Niqab, mu rwego rwo guhashya burundu ibikorwa by’iterabwoba bigirwamo uruhare n’abiyitirira idini ya Islam. Ibi yabitangaje mu muhango wo gusoza ukwezi kw’ igisibo gitagatifu cya Ramadhan uzwi nka Eid Al Fitr wabereye kuri Stade ya Kigali Nyamirambo mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa gatatu, tariki ya 6 Nyakanga. Mufti w’u Rwanda, Sheikh Salim yagaragaje ko iki cyemezo bagifashe nyuma yuko bigaragaye ko uyu mwambaro wagiye ukoreshwa n’abantu batandukanye bagambiriye inyungu zabo mu bikorwa bisebya ndetse bigamije gusenya Islam. Ati “Tugamije guhashya burundu ibikorwa by’iterabwoba twivuye inyuma kuko hari abiyitirira Islam bakijandika mu bugizi bwa nabi.”
Mu minsi ishize, Sheikh Hitimana Salim yatangaje bazicara bagasuzuma ikibazo cy’imyambarire ishobora gukurura ibikorwa by’ubugizi bwa nabi yemezaga ko ishobora gutiza umurindi abakora ibikorwa by’iterabwoba. Umwe mu bayisilamu babashije kuganira natwe batashatse ko amazina yabo atangazwa bavuze ko iki cyemezo cuyafashwe gihabanye n’imyemerere y’idini ya Islam ndetse yibaza aho yaba igana. Niqab ni umwambaro w’abakobwa n’abagore b’Abayisilamu bambara bakipfuka umubiri wose kugeza mu isura bakagaragaza amaso yonyine. U Rwanda ruje rwiyongera ku bihugu nka Cameroun, Congo Brazza Ville, Gabon, Chad, Nigeria na Guinea byaciye iyi myambaro mu rwego rwo kwirinda ibikorwa by’iterabwoba.



 Yanditswe na Ubwanditsi/Muhabura.rw

title: Abaturage b’Ubwongereza  kuva mu bihugu bigize EU bihuye n’ubuhanuzi  buri muri Bibiriya “”soma inkuru”
content:
Bizagira ingaruka zitandukanye kumadini amwe n’amwe harimo n’Itorero ry’Abadiventisiti b’Umunsi wa Karindwi.Byashoboka ko ari ubwa mbere wumvise ijambo "Brexit". Si igitangaza kuko iri ni ijambo rishya ryatangiye kwandikwa no mu nkoranyamagambo ! Brexit ni impine ya "Britain Exit" bisobanura icyemezo cyavuye muri Referandumu cg kamarampaka yabaye taliki ya 23/6/2016 yabaye mu bihugu 4 bigize ubwami bw’Ubwongereza aribyo Wales (Pays de Galles),England (Angleterre),Scotland (Ecosse) North Ireland (Ireland du Nord).  Amakuru nkesha BBC avuga ko Uretse Scotland yatoye kuguma mu Muryango wunze ubumwe w’Ibihugu by’Iburayi (EU) ku majwi 62%, ubwami bw’Ubwongereza muri rusange bwatoye kuva muri EU (European Union) ku majwi 52% ni ukuvuga abantu 17,410,742 mu gihe abasaga 48% ni ukuvuga abantu 16,141,241 batoye ko Ubwami bw’Ubwongereza bwaguma muri uyu muryango. 
Trans-Europian Division ariwe Nenad Jepuranovic
 Ushobora kuba wumva ibi ari ibisanzwe ariko siko biri kuko Ubumwe w’Uburayi (EU) ari umuryango washinzwe mu 1993 usimbuye EEC (European Economic Community) yari igamije gukemura ibibazo byatewe n’Intambara 2 z’Isi Yose,ngo Uburayi bwe kuzongera kurwana kandi ngo biteze imbere ubukungu,nk’uko bitangazwa n’urubuga rwa Wikipedia.
Kuba rero ibihugu biri gusohokamo birerekana ko bugiye gucika intege. Abadepite bamwe bo mu bihugu nk’ Ubufaransa,Ubuholande na Danmark nabo batangaje ko hakabaye kamarampaka ngo harebwe ko abaturage b’ibi bihugu bashaka ko byava muri EU. Amakuru ari ho aravuga ko Brexit kandi yatumye ifaranga ry’Abongereza bita Ipawundi (£) rigwa cyane ku buryo butigeze bubaho mu myaka 31 ishize. Ifaranga rya Euro rikoreshwa mu Bumwe bw’Iburayi naryo ryamanutse. Minisitiri w’Intebe w’Ubwongereza David Cameron nawe yaregiye,kandi abakuru b’ibihugu 27 bisigayemo bari gukora inama za huti huti ngo harebwe icyakorwa mu maguru mashya.

title: Gisagara: Urujijo mu rupfu rw’abapadiri babiri; harakekwa amarozi
content:
Mu gihe kitageze ku mezi atatu, abapadiri ba Kiliziya Gatolika bo muri paruwasi ya Byiza mu murenge wa Gikonko, mu karere ka Gisagara bitabye Imana mu buryo butavugwaho rumwe. Abaturage bahamya ko barozwe.


Nyakwigendera Padiri Felicien Hakizimana Padiri Augustin Musada na Felicien Hakizimana bazize indwara zifite ibimenyetso bijya gusa. Uwa mbere wari padiri mukuru, ari na mwarimu muri kaminuza zitandukanye, yapfuye ku wa 31 Werurwe 2016 afite imyaka 62, naho undi yapfuye ku wa 13 Kamena afite imyaka 41. Impfu zabo zakangaranyije cyane abatuye muri ako gace. Abaturage baho bavuga ko bazize uburozi “byanga byakunda” kandi bakongorerana abantu babiri bazi babishe nubwo batabavuga mu ruhame. Ubuyobozi bwa Kiliziya Gatolika mu Rwanda bwo burigengesera mu kwemeza ayo makuru. Musenyeri wa Diyosezi ya Butare akaba n’Umuvugizi wa Kiliziya Gatolika mu Rwanda, Philippe Rukamba, yagize ati” Ibizamini byo kwa muganga byagaragaje ko impyiko n’umwijima bya padiri Musada byangiritse kubera ikintu gifite ubumara yariye. Dutegereje ibisubizo by’ibizamini bya nyuma twakoresheje.” Yakomeje agira ati” Naho padiri Felicien Hakizimana ashobora kuba yarahitanwe n’indwara, yari ibihaha bye byari byarangiritse cyane, bishobora kuba byaragize ingaruka ku mutima.” Agace ka Byiza/Gisagara indiri y’imihango ya gipagani n’ubupfumu
Abaturage bo muri paruwasi ya Byiza baganiriye n’umunyamakuru wa La Nouvelle Releve bavuga ko bahora mu rwikekwe rukomeye rushingiye ku marozi.
Habineza, umuturage uturanye paruwasi avuga ko hari benshi cyane bapfa barozwe, kandi ko uburozi butangirwa cyane mu birori. Ati” Muri aka gace haba uburozi cyane, kandi butangirwa mu makwe no mu minsi mikuru. Bavuga ko padiri Musada yanyoye uburozi buvanze n’urwagwa ariko ntibavuga niba yararogewe mu kigo cya paruwasi cyangwa hanze.” Undi nawe utashatse ko izina ritangazwa yagize ati” Padiri Musada twese tuzi ko yarozwe. Na mbere y’uko yoherezwa muri Afurika y’Epfo aho yaguye amakuru yo kurogwa kwe yaracicikanaga bamwe banatangaje ko arapfa nta kabuza. Ariko ntawabyitagaho, njye ntekereza ko byanga byakunda yarozwe.” Abapadiri n’abandi bayobozi ba Kiliziya birinze kwemeza amakuru y’uburozi
Abayobozi ba diyoseze ya Butare banze gutangaza amakuru y’uko aba bapadiri barozwe. Bahisemo kuvuga ko abo bapadiri bazize “urupfu rusanzwe” kuko ibyo abaganga batangaje bitemeza ko abo bapadiri bishwe n’umuntu uturutse hanze. Abandi bapadiri bo bamaze kumva uburyo bagenzi babo bapfuye baguye mu kantu. Abakirisitu b’imena muri paruwasi ya Byiza bo birinze kubyinjiramo cyane batinya kuvuguruza amakuru yatanzwe n’ubuyobozi bwa kiliziya n’inzego z’ibanze. Umukuru wa santarari ya Musha, Onesphore Habineza yagize ati” Njye nahisemo gutegereza amakuru azatangwa n’ubuyobozi bwa kiliziya na Leta. Ariko ikigaragara ni uko hari icyihishe inyuma y’ibi bintu.”
Umuyobozi wa Caritas ya Butare, padiri Rebero we ntiyemeranya n’abavuga ko padiri Musada yaba yararogewe mu rwagwa. Ati” Nabanye na padiri Musada igihe kirekire i Nyanza n’i Butare. Ntawe bagiranaga ikibazo, aho yanyuraga hose abakirisitu baramwishimiraga. Yari umuntu wita ku buzima bwe cyane kandi yanywaga gake cyane gashoboka. Ibihuha by’uko yarozwe kuri ubu sinabyemera cyangwa ngo mbihakane, si ubwa mbere tubura abapadiri.” Musada akimara gufatwa, yabanje kuvurirwa mu bitaro bya Gikonko, amaze gukomerezwa yoherezwa muri Afurika y’Epfo ari naho yaguye. Padiri Medard Cyebambe wasimbuye Musada muri paruwasi Byiza avuga ko kugeza ubu abakirisitu baho bashenguwe n’agahinda. Ati” Birababaje sinarega abakirisitu cyangwa undi uwo ari we wese kuba yararoze bagenzi banjye. Urupfu rwa Musada na Felicien rwadusize mu gahinda gakomeye. Kuheza n’ubu ntiturabyakira ntituzabibagirwa. Nta wabura kugira ibyo akeka nyuma yo kubona uko bapfuye, turagerageza guhoza abakirisitu tubasaba gusenga cyane. Imana ibahe iruhuko ridashira.”


Fabien Hakizimana, umuvandimwe wa padiri Cyebambe afite ubwoba ko uyu mupadiri nawe ashobora kwicwa, mu igihe cyose uwishe abamubanjirije akidegembya. Ati “Mpangayikishijwe n’umuvandimwe wanjye wimuriwe muri paruwasi yica abapadiri bayo. Abantu bose bavuga ko bariya bapadiri barozwe. Ntawe uzi ngo ni inde, byagenze gute, bazize iki.” Abayobozi b’akarere ka Gisagara nabo batewe impungenge n’izi mpfu
Umuyobozi w’akarere ka Gissagara wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza y;abaturage, Clemence Gasengayire avuga urupfu rw’abo bapadiri rwasize abaturage mu rujijo n’ubwoba budasanzwe, cyane cyane abagatolika. Ati” Abakirisitu ba paruwasi Byiza baguye mu kantu kubera urupfu rw’abapadiri babo. Urebye uko bapfuye biteye urujijo. Hari byinshi byo gukemanga . Kuri ubu muri rusange ibintu byasubiye mu buryo.” Ku wa 19 Kamena, Musenyeri wa Diyosezi wa Butare, Philippe Rukamba yasuye paruwasi ya Byiza ahumuriza abakirisitu, abasaba gutegereza ibizamini bya nyuma byo kwa muganga bikemeza niba koko abo bapadiri bararo Yanditswe na LA NOUVELLE RELEVE MUHABURA.RW

title: Ndahiro Tom yatanze ubutumwa kuri Papa Francis ku byakozwe na Kiliziya ya Kabgayi
content:
Mgr Smaragde Mbonyintege wa Diyosezi ya Kabgayi ahakana ko bafite gahunda yo kwifatanya n’abapadiri mu kwizihiza yubile y’imyaka 25 barimo abahamijwe ibyaha bya Jenoside, umushakashatsi kuri Jenoside Tom Ndahiro akavuga ko nta kindi Mbonyintege yakora atari ukubihakana, ariko ko bikojeje isoni Umushumba wa Diyosezi ya Kabgayi, Smaragde Mbonyintege, aravuga ko nta gahunda kiliziya gatulika ifite yo kwifatanya n’abapadiri barimo abajenosideri mu kwihiza yubile y’imyaka 25. Ibi arabihakana hashingiwe ku butumire bwanditswe mu izina rye ariko akavuga ko atari we wabwanditse. Ni ibaruwa y’ubutumire yakwirakwijwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga nka Twitter. Umwe mu bayikwirakwije ni umushakashatsi kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, Tom Ndahiro, wemeza ko iyi baruwa yanditswe na Kiliziya Gatulika, ati “Ni bo bayanditse, ibyo kuyihakana birumvikana ko ari amatakirangoyi”. Tom Ndahiro, kuri Twitter, yabwiye Umushumba wa Kiliziya gatulika ku Isi, Papa Francis (@Pontifex) ko ibyakozwe na Kiliziya ya Kabgayi, byo gutangaza ko izifatanya n’abapadiri bizihiza yubile barimo abakoze jenoside (Rukundo Emmanuel na Ndagijimana Joseph), bikojeje isoni. 
Mgr Smaragde Mbonyintege wa Diyosezi ya Kabgayi ahakana ko bafite gahunda yo kwifatanya n’abapadiri mu kwizihiza yubile y’imyaka 25 barimo abahamijwe ibyaha bya Jenoside
Magingo aya Mgr Mbonyintege ntabwo ari mu Rwanda. Ari mu nama i Kinshasa muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo. Ubutumwa bwe bunyomoza buragira buti, “Njye nibaza n’uwabitangaje uwo ari we, icyo yashakaga. Ntabwo ari byo, ntabwo ari byo! Nabyumvise, tuzakora yubile y’abapadiri bitwaye neza bari mu gihugu. Ayo ni yo makuru twabatangariza.” Abajijwe uwo akeka waba wanditse ubwo butumire bwazamuye uburakari bwa benshi, Mgr Mbonyintege yagize ati “Ubwo butumire uwabukoze ni ibyo yiyandikiye ntaho bihuriye n’ubutumwa bw’umwepiskopi kuko ntabwo nakoze njyewe. Abazakorerwa yubile ni abari mu gihugu, ntabwo ari abafunze cyangwa abari mu mahanga. Abazakorerwa yubile ni batatu.” Nyuma yo kumva Mgr Mbonyintege ahakana ibyo kwandika iyi baruwa, Izubarirashe.rw ryashatse kumenya aho Tom Ndahiro yayikuye, yanga kuhatubwira ariko aduhamiriza ko yayihawe n’umuntu wo muri kiliziya kandi yizeye cyane ku buryo adatekereza ko yamupfunyikiye ikibiribiri. Ati “Ikibazo ni ukuvuga ngo, nibasohore lisite bariya bantu batarimo kuko ni abantu bari bagiye gukora yubile y’imyaka 25, icya kabiri nibavuge position yabo (aho bahagaze) ku muntu wakoze jenoside, ko amategeko y’isi yabahannye bo babagenje gute?” Tom Ndahiro avuga ko kuba kiliziya ibihakana n’ubundi nta kindi yakora atari ukubihakana. Ati “Ntabwo twavuga ababiduhaye kugira ngo batabamerera nabi, ariko birahari ntabwo duhubuka dutyo. Mu gihe gito nerekanye umupadiri wakatiwe ufungiye ku Gisenyi warimo asomana misa na musenyeri…” Aha yakomozaga ku mupadiri witwa Edouard Ntuliye wakatiwe gufungwa burundu nyuma yo guhamwa n’uruhare muri jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ugaragara ku ifoto ari kumwe na Musenyeri wa Diyosezi ya Nyundo Anaclet, barimo basoma misa muri gereza, iyi foto na yo Tom Ndahiro akaba yayishyize kuri Twitter. Abajijwe n’umunyamakuru w’Izubarirashe.rw aho yo yayikuye, yabaye nk’utangara ati “Erega mwibimbaza mugende murebe, nonese ntihari abafungwa imbere yabo? Erega ntabwo bari bonyine, hari n’abapadiri bandi babiri.” Mgr Mbonyintege avuga ko mu mategeko ya kiliziya gatulika bitemewe ko umupadiri wakatiwe uri muri gereza asoma misa, akavuga ko adakeka ko ibyo byabayeho, ko ababikwirakwije babeshya. Tom Ndahiro ushinjwa kubeshya ariko, akabaza ati “Ko ubutumire bwabo ubusanzwe butangwa mbere y’amezi abiri, ubu ngubu bazabukora ryari? (cyane ko yubile izaba kuwa 16 Nyakanga 2016).” Ashingira kuri ibi yemeza ko ubutumire yakwirakwije adashidikanya ko bwanditswe na kiliziya gatulika kuko yubile isigaje ukwezi kutagera no kuri kumwe. Musenyeri Mbonyintege avuga ko nagera mu Rwanda gukora ubwo butumire ari cyo kintu azaheraho, agahakana yivuye inyuma ko ubwakwirakwijwe ari ubwabo, agasaba abantu kutabuha agaciro, ati “ni iby’abantu bikorera ku bwo gushyushya imitwe, ibyo mwe kubyitaho.” Ku kibazo cy’umupadiri wagaragaye yambaye imyenda ya gipadiri asoma misa ari kumwe na Musenyeri wa Diyosezi wa Nyundo, byo avuga ko adakeka ko byabaye, ko umupadiri wakatiwe atemerewe gusoma misa, ariko ko kuba yakwambara umwenda wa gipadiri byo ntawe byagakwiye gutangaza. Ati “Ikibazo mugomba kumva, nka Leta, iyo umuntu ari umujenosideri aba ari Umunyarwanda nk’abandi. Leta iramutunga iramugaburira, iramwambika, nonese umupadiri wakoze jenoside ni we utatungwa, ni we utagaburirwa nk’abandi? Ntabwo akorerwa ibirori, ntabwo avuga misa, keretse igihe bavuze ko ari umwere cyangwa se afunguwe arangije ibihano. Ariko igihe ari muri gereza afunzwe arasurwa nk’izindi mfungwa zose, ahabwa ukarisitiya nk’abandi kuko biba bifatwa nk’aho yicujije. Iyaba bayisomaga ntabwo twagombaga kujyayo (abapadiri baturuka hanze ya gereza). Tujyayo kuzisoma kandi bahari, zisomwa n’umupadiri uvuye hanze. Umunyamakuru: Ariko uriya biragaragagara yambaye imyenda ya gipadiri asoma misa… Mgr Mbonyintege: Ariko se kwambara abandi baba barimo bo ntibaba bambaye? Nta kintu kimubuza kuyambara kuko niba imfungwa tuzikurikiranira hafi, tukazigaburira tukazambika, ntabwo bimubuza kuba ari umunyacyaha, ariko hariho uburenganzira bw’ibanze bugenerwa imfungwa. title: Papa Francis, yavuze ko Kiliziya Gatolika ikwiye gusaba imbabazi abatinganyi
content:
Papa Francis, yavuze ko Kiliziya Gatolika ayoboye ikwiye gusaba imbabazi abatinganyi kubera uburyo yabahaye akato mu gihe cyashize. Ibi yabivuze ubwo yari avuye muri Armenia ku Cyumweru mu kiganiro yagiranye n’itangazamakuru ari mu ndege.

title: Umushumba wa Kiliziya Gatolika yahumurije ibihumbi by’abanya-Armenia mu muhango wo kwibuka jenoside yabakorewe
content:
Umushumba wa Kiliziya Gatolika yahumurije ibihumbi by’abanya-Armenia bari bateraniye mu murwa mukuru Yerevan, abasaba kwifashisha ingufu z’urukundo mu guhindura ibikomere “isoko y’imbabazi n’amahoro” no gushaka ubwiyunge n’igihugu cy’abaturanyi cya Turikiya. Ubwo yasuraga urwibutso rwa Jenoside muri Yerevan, Papa yanditse mu gitabo cy’abashyitsi ati “Kwibuka ntibigomba gupfobywa cyangwa ngo byibagirane, kandi kwibuka ni isoko y’amahoro n’ahazaza heza.” Papa akomeza avuga ko kwibuka byuzuye urukundo bifasha umuntu gushaka ibisubizo bishya, aho icyari urwango gihinduka imishinga y’ubwiyunge. Gusa ibyo Papa yavuze ntibyanyuze Leta ya Turikiya, kuko Minisitiri w’Intebe wungirije Nurettin Canikli yavuze ko ayo magambo ye adakwiriye kuvugwa. Gusa mu isengesho rya Papa Francis yasabye Imana guha abanya-Armenia na Turikiya imbaraga ziberekeza mu nzira y’ubwiyunge. The NewYork Times yatangaje ko ubwo Papa yaherukaga kuvuga amagambo nk’aya muri Mata 2015, Turikiya yahise ihamagaza igitaraganya Ambasaderi wayo i Vatican, hashira amezi 10 nta wundi bohereje. Jenoside yakorewe abanya-Armenia yahitanye ababarirwa muri miliyoni n’igice, ikozwe n’ubwami bwa Ottoman, ariko Turikiya ntivuga rumwe n’abita ubwo bwicanyi ‘Jenoside’.

title: Abafurere bo mu Rwanda bafite impungenge zo gukendera burundu
content:
Abasore b’Abanyarwanda bagana inzira yo kwiha Imana “Ubufurere” bararushaho kugabanuka ndetse n’abagezeyo bagakurikirana inyungu bamara kuzibona bakigarukira mu buzima busanzwe. Iki kibazo gihangayikishije cyane abihaye Imana b’Abafurere Maristes bo mu Rwanda, bavuga ko bibagiraho ingaruka nyinshi, zirimo umurimo wo kurera abana benshi cyane barenze ubushobozi bwabo no kuba bafite impungenge z’ejo hazaza habo, igihe abarimo bazaba bashaje. Furere Rusanganwa Protais uyobora ishuri TTC Mururu yabwiye Imvaho Nshya ko kugeza ubu umubare w’abasore babagana ari muke cyane, aho bafite abafurere 25 gusa kandi hakurikijwe imirimo bakenewemo bagombye kuba nibura nka 50. Avuga ko aba 25 kandi na bo, bose badakora mu Rwanda gusa kuko hari n’abari mu bihugu byo hanze, akabona ari ikibazo cy’ingorabahizi. Avuga ko Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 yashegeshe cyane uyu muryango, kuko uretse guhitana abana benshi barererwaga mu mashuri yabo, n’abarimu babigishaga, Abafurere Maristes 7 na bo bishwe ku buryo byasize icyuho gikomeye cyane. Abajijwe impamvu abona abasore batakitabira kwiha Imana, yagize ati “Ntabwo ari uko bataza. Baraza ahubwo usanga baza bakurikiye izindi nyungu, nk’amashuri kuko ahenda cyane kandi twe tubigisha ku buntu, bakagera kure mu mahanga biga batarishye, barangiza ibyo hanze, cyane cyane imirimo yinjiza menshi, n’ibindi bihari bikabakurura kuko baba bafite ubumenyi bukenewe, abenshi bagahita bavamo bakigendera.’’ Ikindi abona kibakuramo ni uko ubundi ugiyemo arahirira kwiyemeza ubukene, aho umuntu atagira umutungo yigengaho, kandi bamwe baba bashaka gufasha imiryango yabo, atanga urugero nko ku baba barasigaye bonyine cyangwa barasigaye ari mbarwa mu miryango yabo kubera Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Abo ngo babona batazabishobora bagahitamo kuvamo bakajya gushaka akazi ahandi bazigengaho no kungura umuryango wabo bashaka abagore. Avuga ko bituma bavunika ndetse bamwe bakanavunika cyane kugeza ubwo bahabwa ibiruhuko bitari ngombwa, ariko ko babaye benshi byafasha. Yagize ati “Nk’ubu hano hari abanyeshuri benshi cyane kandi turi Abafurere 4 gusa, tugomba kuyobora no kwigisha, ugasanga biratuvunnye cyane kandi n’ahandi ni ko bimeze, ku buryo hari n’abaduha amashuri twitaho tukayanga kuko tutayashobora.” Avuga ko bagiye gukora ubukangurambaga bahereye ku bana biga mu byaro bakabakundisha uyu muryango, kugira ngo babone abawuzamo, akavuga ko ikibazo kiri hose, ku buryo amaherezo bizakorwa ku rwego rwa Kiliziya Gatulika yose. Ibi byanakozwe n’umushumba wa Diyoseze Gatulika ya Cyangugu, Musenyeri Bimenyimana Jean Damascène; ubwo yari muri TTC Mururu mu kwizihiza Mutagatifu Marcellin Champagnat washinze uyu muryango, yakanguriye abanyeshuri bahiga kuza kuziba icyuho kiri mu bihaye Imana bake muri rusange kandi ko bazakirwa neza.

title: Islam mu Rwanda yabonye umuyobozi Mushya
content: Mufti mushya w’Idini ya Islam mu Rwanda, Sheikh Salim Hitimana yatangaje ko agiye kurwanya iterabwoba ryitirirwa abayisilamu bo mu Rwanda aho riva rikagera. Ibi uyu muyobozi mushya w’umuryango w’abayisilamu mu Rwanda (RMC)yabitangaje mu muhango w’ihererekanyabubasha n’uwo asimbuye wabaye kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 3 Kamena 2016. Yagize ati “ Ndemeza ko ishusho y’abayislamu bo mu Rwanda ikiri nziza kandi turifuza ko yakomeza kuba nziza igihe cyose , n’utwo tubazo twabonetse twabonetse ku bantu bakeya cyane cyane ko abayislamu benshi badafite imyumvire y’iterabwoba kandi turi mu nkundura yo guhashya ibitekerezo nk’ibyo byototeye bamwe mu rubyiruko rwacu.” Mufti Sheikh Salim Hitimana yakomeje ashimangira ko afite ingamba zikomeye zo kurwanya iterabwoba ryitirirwa idini ya Islam. Yagize ati “ Ingamba zo kurirwanya zo zirahari kandi nyinshi ndetse zirimo no kugerageza no kuba twagera ku rwego rwo gushaka bariya bantu twibaza ko baba bafite ibitekerezo nka biriya tukabegeranya tukabashyira hamwe mu rwego rwo kugira ngo tubigishe tunabaha ishusho ndetse n’inyigisho z’ukuri za islam zitandukanye n’iriya myumvire kugira ngo ibavemo.” Uretse kurwanya iterabwoba ryitirirwa idini ya Islam, Mufti Sheikh Salim Hitimana yanemeje ko agiye kwita ku ireme ry’uburezi cyane cyane mu bigo by’abayisilamu birimo n’ibyigisha imyuga mu rwego rwo kuzamura urubyiruko mu bihe biri imbere. Mufti ucyuye igihe Sheikh Kayitare Ibrahimu, we yasabye umuyobozi mushya w’abayisilamu mu Rwanda gukomeza kunga ubumwe mu bayisilamu bo mu Rwanda. Yagize ati “ Imbogamizi ikomeye ni imwe nta yindi ni ubumwe bw’abayisilamu kuko amakimbirane yaranze abayisilamu ubwabo no mu nzego zabo zitandukanye.” Yakomeje avuga ko icyamushimishije ari uko asoje manda uku gushyamirana kose kwagiye kugaragara mu nzego zose zitandukanye za RMC kwararangiye, abayizilamu bose bavuga rumwe, ku buryo yizeye ko ikigiye kujyaho ari ugutangira kureba uko bakomeza kubaka uyu muryango. title: Bukavu: Urugendo rw’amahoro rwahuje abakirisitu Gatorika b’Abanyarwanda n’Abanye Congo
content:
Mu rwego rwo gushimangira ubufatanye n’ubuvandimwe busanzwe buranga Diyoseze gatulika ya Cyangugu yo mu Rwanda na Arikidiyoseze ya Bukavu muri RDC, abakirisitu bagera ku 3000 barimo abagera kuri 500 baturutse muri Diyoseze gatulika ya Cyangugu bahuriye mu rugendo rw’amahoro n’igitambo cya misa i Bukavu. Mu rugendo rw’ibilometero birenga 6 kuva ku mupaka w’u Rwanda na RDC wa Rusizi ya mbere mu karere ka Rusizi, kugera ku cyicaro cya Arikidiyoseze gatulika ya Bukavu, mu mujyi rwagati wa Bukavu, aba banyarwanda n’abanyekongo berekanye ko ari abavandimwe koko. Mu rugendo bakoze baririmbaga indirimbo zihimbaza Imana, bagaragaza ibyiza byo kubana kivandimwe nk’abana b’Imana imwe. Mu gitambo cya misa cyanitabiriwe na Minisitiri w’intara ya Kivu y’amajyepfo ushinzwe ubutegetsi bw’igihugu, umutekano, umuco no kwegereza abaturage ubuyobozi, Pasiteri Eciba Mboko Lutho na Perezida w’inteko ishinga amategeko y’intara ya Kivu y’amajyepfo Emile Baleke, abakirisitu bibukijwe guharanira amahoro. Musenyeri François Xavier Maroyi, umushumba wa Arikidiyoseze gatulika ya Bukavu, yabwiye iyo mbaga ko kiliziya zombi zafashe umurongo wo guharanira amahoro n’ubufatanye mu bakirisitu babo. Yakomeje avuga ko buri wese agomba guharanira ko mugenzi we abaho neza, ikiyaga cya Kivu n’umugezi wa Rusizi ntibibe umupaka, ahubwo bigafatwa nk’isangano rihuza abavandimwe bombi, bakagenderanira nta nkomyi. Minisitiri Eciba Mboko Lutho, yagize ati:“ Abanyarwanda n’abanyekongo turi abavandimwe kuva kera, nubwo muri kano gace dutuyemo hagiye hagaragara umutekano muke watewe n’intambara zagiye zihibasira, hakaba n’imitwe y’abagizi ba nabi yakomeje kuhashinga ibirindiro, bigasa n’ibihungabanije umubano w’abaturage bacu. Ariko turishimira ko icyizere cyagarutse, mukaba mukora ibikorwa byinshi bibahuza, nk’ibi by’amasengesho, ubusabane, ubucuruzi n’ibindi, tugashimira abasenyeri bombi imbaraga mushyira mu kubanisha abaturage bacu, tukaba tubari inyuma muri ibi bikorwa byiza mukora.” Musenyeri Bimenyimana Jean Damascène, umushumba wa Diyoseze gatulika ya Cyangugu, yatangarije Imvaho Nshya ko hamaze gukorwa byinshi mu mubano mwiza w’abakirisitu ba Diyoseze zombi, bikaba bigomba kongerwamo ingufu bigakomeza. Yagize ati:“Twashyizeho ihuriro COSOPAX ry’abagore bakora ubucuruzi bwambukiranya imipaka muri Diyoseze za Cyangugu, Uvira, Bujumbura na Arikidiyoseze ya Bukavu, rihuje abagore 60, hateganijwe n’ibindi byinshi tuzahuriraho. Kuba tubasha guhuza imbaga ingana gutya y’ibihugu byombi, bagasengana, bagasabana nta bwishishanye, ni intambwe ikomeye yatewe mu mubano w’abaturage bombi kandi tuzayikomeza, tukifuza ko yagera mu madini n’amatorero yose, ari yo mpamvu nazanye na bamwe mu bapasiteri ngo baturebereho.” Abakirisitu na bo bagaragaje ibyishimo baterwa n’ibi bikorwa byiza bibahuza, biyemeza gukomeza kubishyigikira.

title: Minisitiri w’Intebe yitabiriye umuhango wo kwimika Musenyeri wa Diyosezi ya Nyundo
content:
Ubwo yari mu birori byo kwimika Umushumba mukuru wa Diyosezi Gaturika ya Nyundo, Mwumvaneza Anaclet , Minisitiri w’Intebe Murekezi Anastase yongeye gusaba abanyamadini bamamaza ibihuha n’ubuhanuzi bw’ibinyoma ko bakwihana.  Umuhango wo kwimika Musenyeri mushya wa Diyosezi Gatolika ya Nyundo wabaye ejo hashize ku wa gatandatu tariki ya 21 Gicurasi 2016. Muri uyu muhango, Musenyeri Mwumvaneza Anaclet yasimbuye Alexis Habiyambere. Uyu muhango witabiriwe na Minisitiri w’Intebe Murekezi Anastase wasabye Abanyarwanda, abanyamadini n’amatorero guhora babyaza umusaruro amahirwe bahabwa n’ubuvandimwe, kuko ubuvandimwe babutozwa na gahunda ya “Ndi Umunyarwanda” ifasha komora ibikomere Abanyarwanda batewe n’ibihe bibi igihugu cyanyuzemo. Minisitiri w’Intebe akaba yaraboneyeho kwamagana abanyamadini bitwaza amadini yabo bakayifashisha mu kwamamaza ibihuha n’ubuhanuzi bw’ibinyoma, maze abasaba kwihana. Ati “Dukwiye kubana n’Imana duharanira kubana neza nk’abanyagihugu, dukunda igihugu n’abagituye.” Murekezi akaba yarasabye abanyamaini n’amatorero kurwanya abafite ibitecyerezo bibi birimo gusenya, kwiba, amacakubiri, bakayoboka inzira y’Imana n’inzira y’iterambere ry’u Rwanda. Yavuze ko iyo nzira nziza izirana n’amakimbirane. Minisitiri w’Intebe yavuze ko ibibazo byose bikwiye gukemuka, dore ko ahanini biterwa n’imiryango itakigendera ku ndangagaciro na kirazira y’umuco nyarwada. Yavuze ko Abanyarwanda bose nibakundana bizatuma igihugu kirushaho gutera imbere. Murekezi akaba yaravuze ko leta izashyigikira imibereho myiza ya Diyosezi ya Nyundo kuko ihuye na gahunda ya leta yo guteza imbere Abanyarwanda. Yashimiye Musenyeri Habiyambere uruhare yagize mu guteza imbere Abakirisitu n’abaturage muri rusange. Yasabye Musenyeri mushya Mwumvaneza Anaclet kugira uruhare mu guhanangana n’ibibazo byose biri muri Diyoseze ye. Yanamusabye gukomeza amateka iyi diyoseze yasigiwe na Musenyeri Aloyizi Bigirumwami washize Diyosezi Gaturiaka ya Nyundo, akanaba musenyeri wa mbere w’u Rwanda w’Umwirabura. Yamusabye kugendera ku nama nziza azakomeza kugirwa na Musenyeri ucyuye igihe. Yongeyeho ko Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ishima uburyo higishwa ijambo ry’Imana, ikanashima Kirizaya Gaturika ubufatanye mu burezi, ubuvuzi, imibereho myiza y’abaturage, ubumwe n’ubwiyunge. Ati “Turifuza gukomeza gukorana neza, duharanira kwihutisha iterambere ry’Abanyarwanda muri rusange.” Musenyeri Habiyambere Alexis ucyuye igihe yari amaze imyaka 19 ayobora Diyosezi Gatolika ya Nyundo, akaba agiye mu kiruhuko cy’izabukuru. Yashimye abakirisitu n’abaturage bahinduye imyumvire bakamufasha kugera ku byo yari yari yariyemeje. Naho Musenyeri Mwumvaneza Anaclet yashimiye Perezida Paul Kagame uburyo ashyigikiye Kiriziya Gaturika n’Abanyarwada muri rusamge mu iterambere ryabo. Yijeje gukomeza umurongo abamubanjirije batangiye wo guteza imbere iyi diyoseze.
Kugeza ubu Diyosezi Gatolika ya Nyundo ifite abapadiri bakababaka 100, n’abadiyakoni n’abapadiri icyenda bazabuhabwa uyu mwaka. Iyi diyosezi ifite amaparuwasi 24. Musenyeri mushya wimitswe, Mwumvaneza Anaclet, ni uwa gatanu mu bayoboye iyi Diyosezi imaze imyaka 64 ishinzwe.

title: Rubavu:Umuyobozi w’Itorero ry’Abadivantisiti yahaye u Rwanda Umugisha
content:
Umuyobozi W’Itorero ry’Abadivantisiti b’Umunsi wa Karindwi, Ted Wilson, yahamije umugisha Imana yahaye ubutaka bw’u Rwanda mu ruzinduko yagiriye mu karere ka Rubavu guhera kuri uyu wa Gatanu. Ted Wilson, wageze mu Rwanda guhera ku mugoroba wok u wa Kane yakiriwe bidasanzwe mu Karere ka Rubavu aho azamara ibyumweru bibiri mu ivugabutumwa rigamije gukangurira abanyarwanda kugandukira Imana bumvira amategeko yayo n’ay’igihugu. Iri vugabutumwa riteganyijwe mu turere 30 tw’u Rwanda rizakorerwa mu duce dusaga 2300. Akigera mu karere ka Rubavu kuri uyu wa gatanu, Ted Wilson yakiranywe ibyishimo byinshi n’imbaga y’Abadivantisiti bari bamaze iminsi myinshi bamwiteguye cyane ko ibikorwa byo kumwitegura byari bimaze igihe kitari gito bikorwa. Ted Wilson yavuze ko na we yashimishijwe n’uburyo yakiriwe n’abakirisito, anavuga ko ubutaka bw’u Rwanda bwahawe umugisha ndetse yongera gusaba Imana gukomeza kurwongerera imigisha. Yahamije ko kuba u Rwanda rufite ibyiza nyaburanga byinshi n’umutekano usesuye nta gisa na byo, ati “Mufite igihugu cyiza gituje, ni ahantu nabonye heza ho kuba; muri Abanyamugisha banyarwanda. Naje kubasura ngira ngo tumarane ibyumweru bibiri nabakunze cyane kandi nakunze igihugu cyanyu muratekanye. Ubutumwa nzatanga mfite icyizere ko buzacengera imitima kuko ibisabwa byose mubyujuje murusheho gukundana.” Abakirisito b’Abadivantisite bavuga ko uku gusura u Rwanda n’Akarere ka Rubavu by’umwihariko hari umusaruro mwinshi bizatanga yaba mu ivugabutumwa ndetse no mu bikorwa bifatika dore ko hazabaho kuvura abaturage ku buntu, kuremera abatishoboye n’ibindi. Murenzi Janvier, Umuyobozi w’akarere ka Rubavu wungirije ushinzwe iterambere, imari n’ubukungu yishimiye uru ruzinduko anavuga ko ari amahirwe menshi ku baturage muri rusange. Yagize ati “Uyu ni umugisha udasanzwe ku Rwanda cyane abakiristo kuko ni amahirwe adapfa kubonwa n’igihugu icyo aricyo cyose. Uru ruzinduko ruzafasha mu iyogezabutumwa no mu buzima busanzwe bwongera ubukungu bw’Akarere muri rusange. Iirimo yo kwitegura yakozwe neza kandi yatanze akazi abaturage barinjiza, amahoteli agiye kwakira abashyitsi, turabona inyungu zizagera ku bantu benshi muri rusange.” Yakomeje ashimira uburyo Abadivantisiti bakomeje gufasha mu iterambere ry’ibikorwa remezo mu karere ka Rubavu no mu gihugu muri rusange. Biteganyijwe ko Ted Wilson azigishiriza ku itorero y’Abadiventiste ryitwa Gate of Hope riri mu mujyi wa Gisenyi i Rubavu.Src:Imvaho

title: Ese Waba uzi ibitangaza bitanu biruta ibindi byose ?
content:
Abantu benshi, cyane cyane mu Matorero y’Ubutumwa Bwiza, yizera Yesu (Evangelical churches), bifuza kubona ibitangaza by’Imana, kandi koko birakenewe (Abaheburayo 2: 4). MUHABURA.RW  yabashakiye Ibitangaza bitanu biruta ibindi byose, ngo bitumen nawe  ibindi ubishaka kurushaho.  1.Kuremwa n’Imana  Iki ni igitangaza kibimburira ibindi byose, kuko Ibyanditswe Byera bitubwira ko Imana yaremye umuntu mw’ishusho yayo (Itangiriro 1: 26-27). Kandi wibuke ko Imana yakuremye kubera ubushake bwayo (Ibyahishuwe 4:11). Kuko iyo Imana itakurema ubu uba uri ubusa gusa, kandi nta n’uwakizwa ngo azajye mw’Ijuru atarabanje kuremwa! Imana ihabwe icyubahiro, kandi ishyirwe hejuru.
 Iki gitangaza cyo ntawe utaragikorewe, uriho wese yakagombye guha Imana icyubahiro.

2.Kumva Inkuru nziza y’agakiza Kumva Inkuru Nziza y’Agakiza gatangwa ku buntu kubwo kwizera Yesu Kristo, Umwana w’Imana (Abefeso 2:8), ni igitangaza gikomeye cyane, kuko ntawakwizera atumvise, “kuko kwizera kuzanwa no kumva, kumva kukazanwa n’ Ijambo rya Kristo” (Abaroma 10: 14, 17). Hari abantu benshi bapfira mu byaha batumvise Inkuru Nziza y’Agakiza, barumvise inyigisho z’ibinyoma zitera kurimbuka.
Hari ibihugu byinshi, ubu bigera hafi kuri 50! bitemera ko Inkuru Nziza y’Agakiza ibwirizwa-dukwiriye kubibuka mu masengesho, kandi Imana yadushoboza, tumaze kuzura Umwuka wera, tukabashyira Ubutumwa Bwiza.

3. Guhinduka Icyiremwa gishya   Guhinduka icyaremwe gishya, umwana w’Imana, n’umuragwa w’ubugingo buhoraho, kubwo kwihana ibyaha (kubabazwa n’ibyaha, ukabyatura, ukabireka burundu) no kwizera Yesu Kristo, Umwuka Wera akaguturamo (Yohana 1: 12/2 Abakorinto 7: 10/Abaroma 8: 15-17). Iki gitangaza kirakomeye cyane, kuko utarakiriye icyo gitangaza, ntabwo azajya mw’Ijuru, ahubwo azarimbuka iteka ryose, mu muriro utazima (Ibyahishuwe 21: 8).  4.Kunesha icyaha  Ibyanditswe Byera bitubwira ko icyibi kidakwiriye kutunesha, ahubwo dukwiriye kuneshesha ikibi icyiza (Abaroma 12: 21). Iki ni igitangaza nacyo gikomeye cyane, kuko unesha niwe ufite icyo azaragwa mu bwami bw’Imana (Ibyahishuwe 2: 7, 11, 17, 26/ 3: 5, 12, 21). Nicyo gituma, niba koko warakiriye Yesu Kristo nk’Umukiza n’Umwami, ukwiriye gusaba Imana ikakuzuza Umwuka Wera, kubika mu mutima Ijambo ry’Imana no gurihishurirwa ngo ubashe kunesha icyaha (Abafiripi 4: 13/ Zaburi 119 : 11, 130). Kunesha ni kimwe mu bimenyetso biranga abana b’Imana nyakuri (1 Yohana 5: 4-5).  5. Gupfa upfiriye  mu  Mumwami Yesu  Ijambo ry’Imana ritubwira ngo hahirwa abapfa bapfira mu Mwami wacu (Ibyahishuwe 14: 13). Kuki iki gitangaza aricyo kiruta ibindi bitangaza byose?
Iherezo ry’ikintu riruta itangiriro ryacyo (Umubwiriza 7: 8)
Umunsi wo gupfamo uruta umunsi wo kuvukamo (Umubwiriza 7: 1)
Urupfu rw’abakunzi b’Uwiteka ni urw’igiciro cyinshi mu maso yayo (Zaburi 116: 15)
Imiruho yose iba ishize, umuntu atabarutse amahoro, ategereje ingororano ze (Ibyahishuwe 14: 13) Umuntu aba akijijwe ibyago byenda kuza (Yesaya 57: 1-2)
Bene Data, dukwiriye kwihangana kugeza igihe Yesu Kristo azazira, kandi, dukwiriye kuguma muri Yesu, nawe akaguma muri twe kugeza igihe tuviriye mu mubiri, cyangwa agarutse (Yakobo 5: 7-8/ Yoh. 15: 4-5) Niho Agakiza kacu kazaba kagize agaciro kako. Yanditswe na Sarongo Richard/Muhabura.rw

title: Bagore, mwubahe cyane abagabo banyu!
content:
“ Bagore, mugandukire abagabo banyu.”—ABEFESO 5:22. 1. Kuki kumvira umugabo akenshi bigorana?
 MU BIHUGU byinshi, iyo umugabo n’umugore bashyingiranywe, umugeni ahiga umuhigo avuga ko azubaha cyane umugabo we
. 
Icyakora, uburyo abagabo benshi bafata abagore babo butuma guhigura uwo muhigo byoroha cyangwa bikagorana. Ariko rero, umuryango wari watangiye neza. Imana yakuye urubavu mu muntu wa mbere, ari we Adamu, iruhinduramo umugore. Adamu yavuganye ibyishimo ati “uyu ni igufwa ryo mu magufwa yanjye, ni akara ko mu mara yanjye.”—Itangiriro 2:19-23. 2. Ni gute mu bihe bya vuba aha inshingano z’abagore mu muryango ndetse n’uko babona ishyingiranwa byahindutse? 2 Nubwo umuryango wari waragize iyo ntangiriro nziza, mu ntangiriro y’imyaka ya za 60 muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika hatangiye poropagande yiswe kwibohoza kw’abagore, ni ukuvuga ko abagore baharaniraga kwibohoza ku butegetsi bw’abagabo. 
Icyo gihe, ugereranyije abagabo 300 ku mugore 1 bataga imiryango yabo. Mu mpera y’imyaka ya za 60, uwo mubare wari warahindutse, abagabo bata imiryango yabo baba 100 ku mugore 1. Muri iki gihe usanga abagore bavuga amagambo y’urukozasoni, bagasinda, bakanywa itabi kandi bakiyandarika kimwe n’abagabo. None se ubu ni bwo abagore barushijeho kugira ibyishimo? Ashwi da! Mu bihugu bimwe na bimwe, hafi kimwe cya kabiri cy’abantu bashyingiranwa, amaherezo baratana. Ese imihati abagore bamwe bashyizeho kugira ngo bakemure ibibazo byo mu miryango yabo, yaba yaratumye ibintu birushaho kuba byiza cyangwa byarushijeho kuzamba?—2 Timoteyo 3:1-5. 3. Ni ikihe kibazo cy’ibanze kigira ingaruka mbi ku bashakanye?
 3 Ikibazo cy’ibanze ni ikihe? Mu rugero runaka, ni ikibazo cyavutse igihe Eva yashukwaga na marayika wigometse, ari we “ya nzoka ya kera yitwa Umwanzi na Satani” (Ibyahishuwe 12:9; 1 Timoteyo 2:13, 14). Satani yagoretse ibyo Imana yigisha. Urugero, Satani yatumye abantu babona ko umuryango ubabuza kwisanzura kandi ko ugoranye. Imitekerereze akwirakwiza mu binyamakuru byo muri iyi si ategeka, igamije kwereka abantu ko inama Imana itanga atari iz’ukuri kandi ko zidahuje n’igihe (2 Abakorinto 4:3, 4).  Ariko rero, nidusuzuma icyo Imana ivuga ku birebana n’inshingano z’umugore mu muryango nta ho tubogamiye, turasanga inama zo mu Ijambo ry’Imana zihuje n’ubwenge kandi ari ingirakamaro.
Inama ku bantu bashinga imiryango 4, 5. (a) Kuki umuntu w’igitsina gore yagombye kwitonda mu gihe ateganya gushaka? (b) Ni iki umuntu w’igitsina gore yagombye gukora mbere y’uko yemerera umugabo kuzashakana na we?
 4 Hari umuburo Bibiliya itanga. Ivuga ko muri iyi si iyoborwa na Satani, n’abafite ishyingiranwa ryiza bazagira “imibabaro.” Bityo rero, nubwo ishyingiranwa ryatangijwe n’Imana, Bibiliya iburira abashyingiranwa. Umwanditsi umwe wahumekewe yavuze ibyo umugore wapfushije umugabo, bityo akaba afite uburenganzira bwo kongera gushaka ati “naguma uko ari ni ho azarushaho guhirwa.” Nanone, Yesu yatanze inama yo kudashyingiranwa ku ‘babasha kubyemera.’ Icyakora, niba umuntu ahisemo gushaka, yagombye gushaka “uri mu Mwami,” ni ukuvuga umuntu usenga Imana, wayiyeguriye kandi wabatijwe.—1 Abakorinto 7:28, 36-40; Matayo 19:10-12. 5 Impamvu umuntu w’igitsina gore by’umwihariko yagombye kwitonda mu gihe ashaka uwo babana, ni umuburo watanzwe na Bibiliya ugira uti “amategeko ahambira umugore ku mugabo we. ” Iyo umugabo apfuye cyangwa agasambana maze agatandukana n’umugore we, umugore “ntaba agitegekwa n’ayo mategeko” (Abaroma 7:2, 3).  Kubona umuntu ugahita umukunda bishobora gutuma abantu bagirana ubucuti bw’agahararo, ariko si rwo rufatiro rukwiriye rwo kugira umuryango wishimye. Ku bw’ibyo rero, umuntu w’igitsina gore utarashaka agomba kwibaza ati ‘ese niteguye gusezerana n’uyu mugabo ko nzumvira amategeko ye?’ Umuntu asuzuma icyo kibazo mbere yo gushyingiranwa, ntabwo ari nyuma yaho. 6. Ni uwuhe mwanzuro abantu b’igitsina gore benshi bashobora gufata muri iki gihe, kandi se kuki ari uw’ingenzi cyane?
 6 Muri iki gihe, ahantu henshi umuntu w’igitsina gore ashobora kwemerera umuntu umusaba ko babana cyangwa akamuhakanira. 
Ariko kandi, guhitamo neza bishobora kuba ari cyo kintu gikomeye kurusha ibindi umuntu w’igitsina gore ashobora gukora. Ibyo biterwa n’uko ashobora kuba yifuza cyane kubona umugabo umuba hafi kandi umukunda, ibyo bikaba bishoboka mu ishyingiranwa. Hari umwanditsi wagize ati “uko turushaho kumva dushaka gukora ikintu, cyaba gushaka cyangwa kuzamuka umusozi runaka, ni ko turushaho kwibwira ko ari nta kibazo gihari maze tukita gusa ku makuru atubwira ibyo twifuza kumva. ” Umuntu uzamuka umusozi aramutse afashe umwanzuro udahuje n’ubwenge, bishobora gutuma atakaza ubuzima bwe; umuntu ahisemo nabi uwo bazabana, na byo bishobora kumuteza akaga. 7. Ni iyihe nama ihuje n’ubwenge yatanzwe ku birebana no gushaka umugabo?
 7 Umuntu w’igitsina gore yagombye gutekereza cyane ku bintu bikubiye mu kugandukira itegeko ry’umugabo umusaba gushyingiranwa na we.
 Mu myaka ishize, hari umukobwa w’Umuhinde wemeye yicishije bugufi ati “ababyeyi bacu barakuze kandi baturusha ubwenge, kandi ntibashobora gushukwa mu buryo bworoshye nkatwe. . . . Jye nshobora gukora ikosa mu buryo bworoshye. ” Ubufasha ababyeyi hamwe n’abandi bashobora gutanga ni ingenzi. Hari umusaza w’Umukristo w’inararibonye umaze igihe kirekire atera abakiri bato inkunga yo kumenya ababyeyi b’umuntu bifuza kuzashyingiranwa na we no kwitegereza bitonze imishyikirano uwo muntu agirana n’ababyeyi be hamwe n’abandi bagize umuryango we. Yanditswe na Sarongo Richard/Muhabura.rw

title: Ibyifuzo 3 abantu bafite bifuza kubaza Imana!
content:
Uruhurirane rw’ibibazo bitari bimwe abari mu Isi bahura nabyo , bituma rimwe na rimwe bumva hari ibibazo babaza Imana baramutse bayibonye.Hari abibaza impamvu Imana yemera ko abantu babazwa, abanti bati kuki turi ku Isi, naho abandi ngo kuki amadini yuzuyemo uburyarya n’ibindi. Abantu benshi bahuye n’ibyago cyangwa bakibonera abantu bahura na byo, ntibabona ibisubizo by’ibibazo bibaza. Hari n’abageze aho bahakana ko Imana ibaho, abandi bo bashobora kudahakana burundu ko Imana ibaho ariko bakabishidikanyaho. Abatemera ko Imana ibaho n’ababishidikanyaho, si ko buri gihe baba badafite idini babarizwamo, ahubwo ibyo baba barigishijwe n’amadini ni byo akenshi bituma bareka kwizera Imana. Bashobora gutekereza ko amadini akomeye yananiwe gusubiza ibibazo bikomeye abantu bibaza. Igishishikaje ni uko ibyo bibazo akenshi usanga ari na byo abantu bavuga ko bemera Imana baburiye ibisubizo. Reka dusuzume ibibazo bitatu abantu benshi bifuza kubaza Imana n’ibisubizo byabyo biboneka muri Bibiliya nkuko bitangazwa n’akanyamakuru k’Abahamya ba Yehova. 1.Kuki Imana ireka imibabaro ikabaho ? Abenshi baravuga bati “Niba Imana idukunda yagombye kuturinda imibabaro.” Abenshi bavuga ko kuba hariho imibabaro bigaragaza ko Imana itabaho. Ariko iyo bamaze kumenya impamvu ireka imibabaro ikabaho, bahita bemera ko Imana ibaho. Ibitekerezo by’Imana n’inzira zayo bitandukanye n’ibyacu (Yesaya 55:8, 9). Ku bw’ibyo, ntidushobora guhita dusobanukirwa ibikorwa byayo n’impamvu yifata ntihite ikora ibintu runaka. 2.Kuki amadini yuzuyemo uburyarya? Hari abashobora gutekereza bati “Niba Imana yanga uburyarya, n’abayisenga ntibagombye kuba indyarya.”
Urugero, reka tuvuge ko umubyeyi areze neza umwana we, ariko umwana akanga akamunanira, bikagera ubwo avuye mu rugo maze akitwara nabi. Uwo mubyeyi areke uwo mwana akora ibyo ashaka, nubwo atabishyigikiye? Ese byaba bikwiriye kuvuga ko uwo mubyeyi yareze nabi, tukaba twanavuga ko umwana atagira se? Urwo rugero rugaragaza ko Imana itemera uburyarya burangwa mu madini, ahubwo ko ireka abantu bagahitamo ibibanogeye. Imana yanga uburyarya burangwa mu madini (Yeremiya 7:29-31; 32:35). Ariko nanone yemerera abantu guhitamo ibibanogeye. Abenshi mu bavuga ko bemera Imana, bahitamo gukurikiza inyigisho zahimbwe n’abantu kandi bakishyiriraho amahame agenga umuco. Matayo 15:7-9. Icyakora idini Imana yemera ryo ntirirangwamo uburyarya. Yesu yaravuze ati “ibyo ni byo bose bazabamenyeraho ko muri abigishwa banjye, nimukundana” (Yohana 13:35). Urwo rukundo ntirugomba “kugira uburyarya” (Abaroma 12:9).
Amadini menshi ntiyubahiriza iryo hame. Urugero, igihe Jenoside yabaga mu Rwanda mu wa 1994, abantu babarirwa mu bihumbi bishe bagenzi babo bahuje idini, bitewe gusa n’uko badahuje ubwoko. 3. Kuki turi mu Isi? Hari abashobora kwibaza bati “ Kuki abantu babaho imyaka 80 cyangwa 90 gusa, hanyuma bagapfa? Kubaho igihe gito nk’icyo bimaze iki?” Nubwo hari abantu benshi babona ko igihe gito tumara ku Isi ari ikimenyetso kigaragaza ko nta Mana iriho, ibidukikije byo bihamya mu buryo bwuzuye ko hariho Umuremyi (Abaroma 1:20). Yabiremye abifitiye umugambi kandi kuba turiho bifitanye isano n’uwo mugambi. Imana yaremeye abantu kubaho iteka ku Isi, kandi izabikora nta kabuza. Zaburi 37:11, 29; Yesaya 55:11. Ibi ni bimwe mu bibazo abantu bamwe bifuza kubaza Imana baramutse bayibonye , nk’uko akanyamakuru ‘Réveillez vous’ ko mu Kwakira 2015 kabitangaje. Yanditswe na Ubwanditsi/MUHABURA.RW

title: Papa Francis yahinduye Musenyeri wa Diyosezi ya Nyundo
content:
Papa Francis, Umushumba wa Kiliziya Gatolika yatoye Padiri Anaclet Mwumvaneza wari Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa Caritas mu Rwanda gusimbura Musenyeri Alexis Habiyambere ku buyobozi bwa Diyosezi ya Nyundo. Nk’uko bitangazwa n’urubuga rwa Vatikani, news.va, Musenyeri Alexis Habiyambere w’imyaka 76,   asimbuwe kubera ko yasabye gusezera kuko yari ageze mu za bukuru. Padiri Anaclet Mwumvaneza yavutse ku ya 4 Ukuboza 1956, avukira i Murambi, muri paruwasi ya Rulindo, muri Arkidiyosezi ya Kigali. Hagati ya 1963 na 1969 yize amashuri  abanza i Rulindo, ayarangije akomeza ajya mu Iseminari nto ya Kabgayi guhera mu mwaka wa 1969 na 1973. Mu kigero cy’imyaka 25 yaje gusubira mu iseminari nto i Kabgayi mu cyiciro cy’abigaga bakuze.

 Musenyeri Habyarimana Alexis wasimbuwe kubushumba bwa Diyoseze ya Nyundo
  Nyuma y’imyaka 4 yatangiye iseminari nkuru i Rutongo (1984-1985), ahavuye yakomeje mu cyiciro cya Filozofiya (1985-1987), akomereza muri Tewolojiya (1987-1991) muri Seminari nkuru ya Nyakibanda, muri Diyosezi ya Butare. Yahawe Isakaramentu ry’Ubusaseridoti ku ya 25 Nyakanga 1991. Ubutumwa bwe yabukoreye muri Paruwasi ya Kabuye 1991-1992 no Paruwasi y’Umuryango Mutagatifu mu mwaka wa 1992-2000, aho yavuye agiye gukomeza amasomo ye i Roma hagati y’umwaka wa 2000 na 2004 akaba yarahavanye impamyabumenyi y’ikirenga mu by’amategeko ya Kiliziya.

 Mwumvaneza Anaclet ugiye kuba umushumba wa Diyoseze ya Nyundo  Agarutse mu Rwanda yakoze ubutumwa bwe muri paruwasi Kicukiro (2004-2005), akaba yari n’umwarimu mu iseminari nkuru ya Nyakibanda; yabaye kandi umuyobozi wa Caritas ya Arkidiyosezi ya Kigali hagati y’umwaka wa 2005 na 2013. Guhera muri uwo mwaka akaba yari Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa Caritas Rwanda. Musenyeri Alexis Habiyambere ucyuye igihe yatangiye kuyobora Diyoseze ya Nyundo guhera mu mwaka wa 1997.

Yanditswe na Akayezu Snappy/Muhabura.rw

title: Ijambo ry’Imana: Ibi byagufasha niba uri umugore wamenye Imana
content: Ubuzima tubamo bwa buri munsi usigaye ubona ingo nyinshi zitakirangwa n’ubwumvikane buhamye ndetse usanga abenshi muri bo baba wenda ugansanga mu rugo rw’umugabo n’umugore umwe arakijijwe cyangwa akunda gusenga ariko ku rundi ruhande undi nawe ntago abikozwa. aha rero twaguteguriye zimwe mu ngingo zagufasha kumenya umugore wamenye Imana 1. Ntugacire umugabo wawe urubanza kuko nta mugabo numwe unezezwa n’umugore w’ingare (abef 4.29) 2. Umugore w’umunebwe ntagira icyo yitaho. Ntanamenya ko umubiri we ukeneye gusukurwa no kwoga (imigani 24.27, imigani 20.13) 3. Hari imitekere umugabo wawe akunda? Ujye ugerageza guhinduranya amafunguro. Nta mugabo utita kw’ifunguro ategurirwa (imigani 31.14) 4. Ntukifuze ibintu cyane ku mugabo, unezezwe iteka n’ibibonetse (luka 11.3) 5. Ujye umenya kwakira neza umugabo wawe cg undi wese winjiye iwawe. Niyo yaba ari ikirahure cy’amazi ufite. Umutima n’imyitwarire myiza nibwo bwiza bw’umugore mwiza (imigani 31.11) 6. Ntukifatanye n’abagore bananiwe ingo zabo cg bananiwe urushako rwabo (imigani 22.14) 7. Urugo rwawe rugira agaciro kuko uruhaye agaciro. Kwifata nabi ntibyemewe (abaheburayo 13.4) 8. Imbuto zo munda yawe ni umugisha uva ku Mana, ujye ukunda abana bawe ubigishe neza (imigani 22.6) 9. Ntabwo ukuze cyane byagira ingaruka ku rugo rwawe ngo urutererane. Ntukareke kurwitaho ku mpamvu iyo ariyo yose. (Imigani 31.28) 10. Umugore usenga Imana (cg wizera Yesu) aba yuzuye kandi aba yujuje ibisabwa. Iteka ujye usengera umugabo wawe n’umuryango wawe. (Abates 5.27 Yanditswe na Pastor Sarongo Richard/Muhabura.rw

title: Abapasiteri n’abandi bakozi b’Imana barinubira imishahara
content: Abakora imirimo itandukanye mu itorero ry’abapantekote mu Rwanda (ADEPR) bazwi ku izina ry’Abakozi b’Imana, bo mu turere twa Rusizi na Nyamasheke, ntibavuga rumwe ku mishahara mishya itorero ryabo ryemeje ko bagomba kujya bahembwa, aho bamwe batayishimiye na gato. Imishahara ya bamwe mu bakozi b’Imana yagabanyijwe hagamijwe kuringaniza imishahara yabo, kuko kuba imishahara itaringaniye ngo byatezaga ibibazo bitandukanye nk’uko ubuyobozi bw’iri torero bubivuga. Iri ringaniza ry’imishahara muri iri torero ryatangiranye n’ukwezi kwa Mutarama, ngo ryari rimaze igihe ryigwaho. Ubuyobozi bwa ADEPR buvuga ko noneho abayobozi bo ku rwego rumwe bahembwa amafaranga angana, mu gihe mu bihe bishize umuntu yahembwaga bitewe n’aho ari, umushumba uri muri paruwasi yinjiza menshi agahembwa menshi, uri muri paruwasi ikennye agahabwa make, bikaba ngo byarakururaga amakimbirane muri aba Bakozi b’Imana. Umwe mu bashumba ba paruwasi mu karere ka Nyamasheke, yabwiye Imvaho Nshya ati:“Twe tumaze igihe baratubangamiye rwose.Nkanjye nahembwaga arenze 200.000 none banshyize ku mafaranga 101.000. Ubwo se azantunga n’umuryango wanjye, nzarivamo se, nzaka pansiyo y’imburagihe cyangwa?” Umuvugizi w’iri torero wungirije ushinzwe ubuzima bw’itorero, Rev. Pasiteri Rwagasana Tom, ubwo yari mu muhango wo kwimika abakozi b’Imana muri Paruwasi ya Muraza mu karere ka Nyamasheke, yasobanuye ko icyemezo cyo kuringaniza imishahara cyafashwe hagamije gukemura bimwe mu bibazo bikomeye. Yagize ati:“Kuringaniza imishahara byunguye byinshi nubwo hari bamwe batabyishimiye, ariko icya mbere ni uko byaciye ingeso ya ruswa no guhakwa, ahari hamaze gukwira imvugo yitwa ‘Agaparuwasi keza’, ushyizwe muri paruwasi ikize cyane ntashake kuyivamo, ushyizwe mu ikennye cyane agahorana ishyari ridashira kandi ari umukozi w’Imana. Hakaba abahora bapfukamye imbere y’abavugizi ngo babashyire aheza cyangwa ntibabakure aho babashyize, dusanga byaraterwaga ahanini n’imishahara bahabonaga duhitamo kuyiringaniza.” Uyu muyobozi mu itorero rya ADEPR yakomeje avuga ko byanaciye ingeso yo gupfunyikira abayobozi bakuru b’itorero amabahasha y’amafaranga, kuko hari igihe umuyobozi mukuru yatumagaho ko azasura paruwasi runaka, umushumba wayo agategura ‘ibahasha ya shefu’ kugira ngo akomeze atoneshwe. Rev.Pasiteri Rwagasana Tom yavuze ko abakozi b’Imana bakwiye kururuka mu byubahiro bishyiramo bagakorera Imana, aho kurarikira ibihembo, ibyo umuntu ahembwe bikamunyura.Src:Imvaho Yanditswe na Ubwanditsi/Muhabura.rw

title: Musanze: Abayobozi b’Idini ya Islam ntibavuga rumwe n’abayiharabika
content:
Mufti w’u Rwanda, Sheikh Kayitare Ibrahim yavuze ko ingengabitekerezo y’ubutagondwa, ari kimwe mu biharabika idini rya Islam, ashishikariza urubyiruko kwima amatwi ababashukisha amafaranga na za buruse zo kujya kwiga mu mahanga, bagamije kubashora mu bikorwa by’iterabwoba.
 Mu biganiro nyunguranabitekerezo byahuje Mufti w’u Rwanda, Abayobozi b’Abayisilamu mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru ndetse n’urubyiruko rw’aba Islam kuwa Kane tariki ya 11 Gashyantare, hagamijwe gukumira ingengabitekerezo y’ubutagondwa no gushishikariza urubyiruko kugendera kure iyo mitekerereze. Muri ibyo biganiro, Guverineri w’Intara y’Amajyaruguru, Aimé Bosenibamwe, yasabye Abayisilamu kudahishira abihisha inyuma y’idini yabo bigisha ingengabitekerezo y’ubutagondwa ahubwo ko bakwiye gutanga amakuru ku bashinzwe umutekano k’uwo bakekaho iyo mikorere. Mu kubikumira, Mufti w’u Rwanda Sheikh Kayitare Ibrahim, yasabye urwo rubyiruko kumvira abarimu babo b’idini no kwima amatwi abaza babashukisha amafaranga na za buruse zo kujya kwiga mu mahanga. Urubyiruko rw’abayisilamu rwo mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru, rwavuze ko rugiye gushishikariza bagenzi babo kwirinda ababashuka babigisha ibijyanye n’ingengabitekerezo y’ubutagondwa n’iterabwoba, bya bamwe mu bagoreka amahame y’idini ya Islam, bagamije ahanini kuryanisha abayisilamu n’andi madini. Abo basore n’inkumi bavuze ko ari ngombwa kubana mu mahoro n’abandi bo mu yandi madini. Nkuko babigaragaza akenshi ngo kutubaha imyemerere y’abandi ni kimwe mu bishobora gukurura amakimbirane, bikaba byateza ibibazo mu gihugu. Ibyo kandi ngo byaba bitandukanye n’amahame y’idini ya Islam, abasaba gukunda igihugu, nk’uko Mutuyimana yabivuze. Yagize ati ‘‘Mu kubikumira no kubyirinda, ni ngombwa kubaha no gukurikiza ibyo abarimu b’idini ryacu batwigisha, tukirinda abatubibamo urwango no kwironda’’. Ibiganiro nk’ibyo birakorwa nyuma y’uko mu mpera za Mutarama, Mohammed Mugemangango wakekwagaho iterabwoba no kwinjiza Abanyarwanda mu mutwe w’iterabwoba ISIS arashwe agerageza gutoroka polisi.Src:Igihe Yanditswe na Ubwanditsi/Muhabura.rw

title: ADEPR yamaganiye kure abahanura intambara mu Rwanda
content:
Itorero ry’abapantekote mu Rwanda (ADEPR) “ryongeye kwikoma bamwe mu bahanuzi bakwirakwiza amakuru y’uko mu Rwanda hazaba intambara, ryibutsa abayoboke baryo n’abanyarwanda muri rusange, kwima amatwi aya makuru agamije kubakura umutima. Mu muhango wo kwimika abashumba bashya wabereye mu karere ka Rwamagana mu mpera z’icyumweru gishize, umuvugizi wungirije w’itorero rya ADEPR Rev. Pasiteri Rwagasana Tom, yamaganiye kure abahanura intambara mu Rwanda. Rwagasana yavuze ko uwumva afite ubuhanuzi bw’intambara adakwiye kuyihanurira abasiviri, amugira inama yo kujya ajyana ubuhanuzi bwe mu kigo cya gisirikare kuko aribo barebwa no kwitegura no guhangana n’intambara. Yagize ati:“Twebwe kuza kuduhanurira iby’intambara ntabwo turi abasirikare, niba ari iby’intambara akaba ari umuntu ukunze igihugu najye mu kigo cy’abasirikare ababwire ko hari abashaka kurwana, babitegure niba bahari. Ariko twebwe kutubwira iby’intambara ntacyo babitubwiraho ibyacu ni ugusengera abantu kugira ngo bakizwe, turinda iby’ubugingo, naho iby’intambara bifite ba nyirabyo, ibyo kandi nibyo abakristo bacu bumva neza kandi bakabishyira mu bikorwa.” Yakomeje asaba abakirisitu kwitondera aba bahanura ibyo yise ibinyoma.Ati:“Bibiliya iravuga ngo uhanura ahanure ibihumuriza abantu umutima niko Pawulo yandikiye Abakorinto, mu byakozwe n’intumwa haravuga ngo mwirinde kandi murinde n’umukumbi mwaragijwe na Pawulo. Yavugaga ko hari amasega aryana azaca inyuma agatangira kujya mu mukumbi, ayo masega rero ni ayo, ni abantu bashaka kwikurura ku bandi kubera indamu zabo, twabikanguriye abakristo kandi itorero ryafashe ingamba.” Ubuhanuzi nk’ubu bwakunze kuvugwa cyane mu gihugu hose, ndetse iri torero ryumvikanye kenshi ribwamaganira kure ndetse rikabwita ubw’ibinyoma. title: Musenyeri Kambanda yikomye abagore baboneza urubyaro bakoresheje imiti
content:
Musenyeri wa Diyosezi ya Kibungo, aravuga ko biteye agahinda kubona hari abagore bahitamo kwica imbyaro kuko ngo aribyo bituma bisanzura. Musenyeri Antoine Kambanda avuga ko ibi biri mu bikomeje gutuma ingo z’iki gihe zikomeje gusenyuka uko bukeye n’uko bwije zitamaze kabiri. Ibi Musenyeri Kambanda yabivuze ubwo yatangaga ikiganiro kigamije mu kumenya ibanga ry’umuryango Nyarwanda ku bibazo byugarije isi. Bimwe mu bibazo bikomeye ngo birimo kugaragara mu miryango y’abashakanye, birimo ingo zirimo gusenyuka zitamaze kabiri, abagore bahitamo kwanga kubyara bavuga ko bagamije kuringaniza imbyaro. Ibi ngo babikora birengagije ko impamvu yo gushakana ari ukubona urubyaro. Gusa Musenyeri Kambanda aravuga ko bidakwiye kumvikana ko Kiliziya gaturika idashaka ko abantu babyara abo bashoboye kurera, gusa ngo imiti ntabwo ari yo yagombye gukoreshwa. Uyu muyobozi agira ati “Kuringaniza imbyaro bigera aho bigafata indi sura itari yo, bigera aho bikaba nk’ikintu cyo kwanga urubyaro, hari abo ubona ukabona banze imbyaro, hari abagore bamwe basigaye babona kubyara nk’uburyo bubabuza kwisanzura!.” Yakomeje agira ati “Ubundi umugabo aryamana n’umugore bashaka urubyaro, baba badashaka gukurikiza umwana akiri muto bakifata ntibagire imibonano mu gihe cy’uburumbuke, ubu nibwo buryo bwa kamere kiriziya yigisha kuko nibwo buha agaciro urugo,  nibyo biha agaciro abashakanye kandi bukabafasha kurushaho kubana mu bw’umvikane no mu rukundo.” Uyu muyobozi gusa avuga ko ibirimo kuba usanga byaragiye byandikwa. Avuga ko bifite amateka kuko mu mwaka wa 1960 aribwo hadutse impinduramatwara mu mubinano mpuzabitsinda aho abantu batangiye gukoresha cyane iyi miti. Ku birebana n’uko Kiliziya gaturika yaba ibuza kuringaniza imbyaro, Musenyeri Kambanda arabihakana akagira ati “hari igihe bagira ngo kiliziya ibuza guteganya kw’imbyaro, nyamara kiliziya yigisha ingo kubyara abo zishobora kurera kuko ntabwo bihagije kubyara gusa,  umuntu afite n’inshigano zo kurera neza abo abyaye.” Aravuga ko aho kugira ngo abagore bakoreshe imiti, ahubwo bakoresha uburyo bwa kamere. Musenyari Kambanda avuga ko ibirimo kuba aho ingo inyinshi zisenyuka, biri no mi ibaruwa yanditswe na Papa Muhire wa 6, mu ibaruwa yanditse mu mwaka wa 1960, aho yavugaga ko gusenyuka ku ingo usanga kurimo guterwa n’abantu batacyubaha ubuzima, bakaba barashyize imbere ikoreshwa ry’imiti yica imbyaro. Avuga ko “Gufata imiti yica imbyaro mu gihe nyamara imibona yabashakanye ari  ukurema ubuzima, ibi rwose bigira ingaruka ku mibano n’ubumwe bw’abashakanye kuko aho kubaha ubuzima no kubukunda, ahubwo abantu basigaye baburwanya bakabuhiga bakoresheje imiti, ndetse bakaba bageza n’aho bakuramo inda mu gihe imiti itakoze ibyo umugore yashakaga.” Avuga ko iyo abantu bimitse irari ry’umubiri rigasimbura  Imana, igikurikiraho ari uko nta mategeko yandi baba bakigenderaho. Nubwo kugeza ubu Minisiteri ifite umuryango munshingano zayo ivuga ko idafite imibare igaragaza ingo zirimo gusenyuka, gusa iravuga ko iki kibazo gikomeje gufata indi ntera.
