title: Minisitiri  Uwacu Julienne yashimiye  Abakinnyi b’ikipe y’igihugu y’abatarengeje imyaka 18
content:
kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 11 Kanama 2016 mu rwego rwo gushimira abakinnyi b’ikipe y’igihugu ya Basketball y’abatarengeje imyaka 18 n’abandi batandukanye bafite aho bahurira nabo.
  Iyi kipe y’igihugu ya Basketball y’abatarengeje imyaka 18, yakinnye mu mikino Nyafurika yegukana umwanya wa 5 mu makipe agera kuri 11 yari yitabiriye irushanwa. Minisitiri w’Umuco na Siporo mu Rwanda, Uwacu Julienne yakiriye abakinnyi b’ikipe y’igihugu y’abatarengeje imyaka 18 bitabiriye imikino Nyafurika iherutse guhuriza ibihugu bigera kuri 11 i Kigali. Abasore b’u Rwanda bagerageje kwitwara neza nubwo batabashije kugera ku ntego nyamukuru bari biyemeje yo kugera muri 1/2. Usibye umwanya wa 5 begukanye mu irushanwa, bahawe igihembo cy’ikipe cy’ishimwe ryo koroherana mu kibuga aribyo bakunze kwita "Fair Play" mu ndimi z’amahanga. U Rwanda rwanagize umwe mu bakinnyi 5 b’irushanwa ariwe Gasana Sano. Minisitiri w’Umuco na Siporo yaganirije aba bakinnyi bahagarariye u Rwanda. 
Ikipe y’igihugu ya Basketball y’abatarengeje imyaka 18, yakinnye mu mikino Nyafurika yegukana umwanya wa 5 mu makipe agera
 Ubutumwa bwagiye butangwa bukaba bwibanze ku gushimira aba bakinnyi uburyo bitwaye muri AfroBasket U18 yabereye mu Rwanda, no kubatera imbaraga zo gukomeza kwitwara neza haba mu kibuga; ndetse no mu buzima busanzwe, bagategura ejo hazaza heza h’umukino wa Basketball. Usibye abakinnyi bakinnye mu ikipe y’Igihugu muri AfroBasket U18, uyu muhango wo gushimira ikipe y’igihugu wanitabiriwe n’ababyeyi babo, ndetse n’abagize komite Nyobozi y’ishyirahamwe Nyarwanda ry’umukino wa Basketball mu Rwanda Irushanwa Nyafurika rya AfroBasket mu batarengeje imyaka 18 ryabereye i Kigali guhera ku itariki ya 22 kugeza 31, Nyakanga muri uyu mwaka wa 2016. Ikipe ya Angola niyo yegukanye igikombe idatsinzwe umukino n’umwe. Amakipe atatu yabaye aya mbere muri iryo rushanwa azaserukira umugabane wa Afurika mu mikino y’igikombe cy’Isi mu batarengeje imyaka 19 harimo na Misiri izaryakira.

Abo basore babengutswe n’aba-scouts ni kapiteni w’ikipe y’igihugu ya Basketball U18 Nkusi Arnaud wigaga St Ignatius, Furaha Cadeau de Dieu wiga muri IPRC Kigali Secondary School, Kisa Kyeyune Enoch wiga muri Well Spring Academy, Shema Osborn wiga Lycee de Kigali na Nshobozwabyosenumukiza Jean Jacques Wilson wiga muri APE Rugunga.

title: Mu mikino ya Gisirikare Kenya yegukanye imidali yose
content:
kuri uyu wa Kabiri hakinwe imikino yo gusiganwa ku maguru‘Cross Country’ , abahagarariye Kenya biharira imyanya y’imbere ndetse begukana imidali yose mu bagabo no mu bagore. Iyi mikino yabereye ku kibuga cy’ishuri rikuru ry’imyuga rya Kigali (IPRC Kigali), aho abasiganwa birutse ku ntera ya kirometero 10. Mu bakobwa n’abahungu, abaserukiye Kenya nibo bihariye imyanya ya mbere. Sheila Chepkirui Kiprotich yatwaye umudali wa zahabu akoresheje iminota 31’ 17”n’iby’ijana 18. Ku mwanya wa kabiri yakurikiwe na Juicly Jepkosgei wegukanye uwa Feza( Silver) akoresheje iminota 31’ 17” n’iby’ijana 98 naho Judy Kiyei yegukana uw’umuringa (Bronze) akoresheje iminota 31’31” n’iby’ijana 28. Umunyarwandakazi waje hafi ni Iranzi Celine wabaye uwa 12 akoresheje iminota 33’25” n’iby’ijana 32. Mu cyiciro cy’abagabo, abanya Kenya bongeye gushimangira ubudahangarwa begukana imidali yose. Emmanuel Kipsang yegukanye uwa Zahabu akoresheje iminota 27’ 15” n’iby’ijana 68, Frank Nyelei uwa Feza akoresheje iminota 27’ 16” n’iby’ijana 10 mu gihe Stephen Arita yegukanye umudali w’umuringa akoresheje iminota 27’ 17” n’iby’ijana 15. Umunyarwanda waje hafi ni Nzirorera Joseph wasoje ari uwa munani akoresheje iminota 28’ 20”.

title: Rayon Sport ntago yari yava ku isoko ry’abakinnyi- “Gakwaya Olivier”
content:
Amakuru aturuka mu bunyamanga bwa Rayon Sport aremeza ko ikipe yabo igikeneye byibuze abakinnyi batatu izifashisha muri Shampiyona y’umupira w’amaguru 2016-2017 ndetse no muyindi mikino bazitabira doreko bazaserukira n’igihugu mu mikino mpuzamahanga. Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa Rayon Sports, Gakwaya Olivier yatangarije izubarirashe.rw ko bashobora kongeramo abakinnyi 3 bazabafasha mu gihe kiri imbere nubwo hari abo bamaze kugura. Ati “dukeneye umukinnyi nk’umwe n’abandi bakinnyi 2 b’imbere urebye baba ari abo”. Gakwaya avuga ko Rayon Sports atari ikipe nto ahubwo ko ari nkuru kandi igomba kugura umukinnyi uwo ariwe wese kandi yifuza abakinnyi beza. Uyu munyamabanga atangaza ko hari abakinnyi bamaze kugura n’abo bamaze kongerera amasezerano, ariko bagomba gushaka abandi. Gakwaya yemeza ko bamaze kugura Rwatubyaye Abdoul kuva mu ikipe ya APR FC na Nahimana Shassir  wakiniraga Vital’O yo mu Burundi. Abajijwe ku bakinnyi bifuza kuba bagura n’aho bazabakura, yirinze kugira icyo abivugaho kubera ko basigaye babavuga bagahita batangira gukurikiranwa n’andi makipe. Abo bakinnyi bombi bamaze gusinya amasezerano y’imyaka ibiri muri Rayon Sports. Ismaila Diarra, Kwizera Pierrot ni abakinnyi bakiniraga Rayon Sports ariko bamaze kongera amasezerano muri iyo kipe. Rayon Sports yagurishije rutahizamu Davis Kasirye werekeje muri Darling Motema Pembe yo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Iyi kipe ya Rayon Sports iracyafite ikibazo kitarakemuka cya Imanishimwe Emmanuel bivugwa ko yasinyiye amasezerano ikipe APR FC. Mu mwaka ushize ikipe ya Rayon Sports yegukanye igikombe cy’Amahoro (Peace Cup). Rayon Sports muri shampiyona yarangije iri ku mwanya wa 2 n’amanota 61 inyuma ya APR FC yegukanye igikombe n’amanota 67.

title: Umutoza mushya wa Chelsea mu gihirahiro ku hazaza ha Diego Costa
content:
Antonio Conte umutoza mushya w’ikipe ya Chelsea ari hagati nk’ururimi ku bijyanye n’ahazaza ha rutahizamu we Diego Costa, ni mu gihe ibinjyamakuru byo muri Espanye biri gukwirakwiza amakuru avugako uyu musore ari mu nzira zo kugaruka mu gihugu cye cyane cyane mu ikipe yamureze ya Atletico Madrid. Inkuru dukesha igitangazamakuru cya Supersport ivugaga kop ku myaka 27 uyu munya espaanye ashobora kwigendera nyuma ty’imyaka ibiri yari amaze mu ikipe y’I London ya Chelsea. Ibi byagarutsweho cyane na nyuma y’uko atanifashishijwe mu mukino Chelsea yatsinzwemo na Real Madrid 3-2 bitewe n’imvune. Ikimenyetso simusiga ni inkuru zirikugaragara mu itangazamakuri hirya no hino mu Bwongereza zijyanye na Romelu Lukaka muri Chelsea. Mu gihe Everton yaba yoroheje ibya Lukaku akagaruka muri Chelsea byaba ari ugufungura umuryango usezerera Costa wari watsindiye iyi kipe ibitego 12 mu mwaka w’imikino ushize. Mu magambo ye Antonio Conte yagize ati “Ubu Costa ni umukinnyi wacu. Uramutse umbajije niba ejo azaba akiri kumwe na twe, ntabyo nzi. Ubu ndabihamya ko ari umukinnyi wa Chelsea. Nta mukino n’umwe yari yakina kubera imvune gusa nakiranuka n’imvune nkabona ameze neza mu myitozo, birashoboka ko mwazamubona mu mukino utaha wa Milan AC.” Conte kandi yanagize icyo avuga ku mukinnyi we w’inkingi ya mwampa Eden Hazard nyuma yo kuza agatsinda ibitego bibiri avuye ku gatebe k’abasimbura. Yagize ati “Eden Hazard yakinnye iminota 30 ayikoramo ibitangaza. Namukunze muri ubu buryo ataha izamu, byongeye ashobora no kutubera igisubizo cyiza anakinnye anyura ku mpande. Uyu munsi yakinnye inyuma y’umwataka arabikora azi neza ko ari ngombwa gukora cyane kuko ameze neza nk’abandi.” Umukino wa mbere wa Chelsea muri Shampiyona ni kuri uyu wa 15 Kanama aho bazakira mukeba basangiye umugi, Westham United.

title: Ubuyobozi bwa APR FC bwamaze kwemeza ko bwatandukanye n’umunyezamu Kwizera Olivier
content:
Nyuma yo gushaka ibyangombwa byo kujya gukina muri Afurika y’Epfo aho yari amaze igihe muri Uganda, ubuyobozi bwa APR FC bwamaze kwemeza ko bwatandukanye n’umunyezamu Kwizera Olivier aho yemerewe gushaka indi kipe.
 Mu minsi ishize twanditse ko Umuzamu wa APR FC ashobora kwerekeza muri shampiyona y’ Afurika y’Epfo byatumye ajya muri Uganda gushaka ibyangongombwa.  Kwizera yavuze ko yakomeje gushaka ibi byangombwa muri Uganda ariko byabuze ndetse aheruka kuvugana n’abayobozi b’ikipe yamwifuzaga bamubwira ko igihe cyarenze bashatse undi munyezamu kuko shampiyona igiye gutangira. Yagize ati “Ibyangombwa byo kujya muri Afurika y’Epfo byarabuze, bambwiye ko igihe cyarenze bashaka undi munyezamu. Ubu ngiye gushaka indi kipe ariko ntayo mu Rwanda turavugana.  ”
Kuri uyu wa Gatanu, nibwo ubuyobozi bwa APR FC bwatangaje ko butandukanye ku mugaragaro na Kwizera Olivier ndetse yemerewe gushaka indi kipe yakinira haba mu Rwanda cyangwa hanze. Kazungu Claver, umuvugizi wa APR FC yavuze ko babishyize ku muragaro kuko hari urujijo ku bantu babonye uyu munyezamu kuwa Mbere akorera imyitozo mu ikipe. Yagize ati “ Shampiyona ikirangira, hari abakinnyi bane APR FC yakuye muri gahunda zayo bashakaga kujya gukina hanze harimo na Kwizera, ubu turi gukoresha imyitozo abakinnyi tuzifashisha mu marushanwa atandukanye.”
 Ku ruhande rwa APR FC bashatse umunyezamu Mvuyekure Emery baguze muri Police FC nk’umusimbura wa Kwizera Olivier wiyongereye kuri Kimenyi Yves na Ntalibi Steven. APR FC ikomeje imyitozo aho bari kwitegura imikino ya gisirikare igiye gukinwa ku nshuro ya 10 izabera mu Rwanda kuva tariki ya 5-18 Kanama 2016.

title: Perezida mushya wa FIFA yagaragaje imigambi myiza afitiye Afurika mu mupira w’Amaguru
content:
Perezida w’ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru ku Isi yatangaje ko umugabane wa Afurika ugomba kongererwa umubare w’ibihugu biwuhagararia m mikino ya nyuma y’igikombe cy’Isi, Uyu muyobozi wa Fifa kandi yemeje ko byibuze Afurika igiye kongererwa ibihugu bibiri ku mubare w’ibyari bisanzwe byitabira imikino ya nyuma y’Igikome cy’Isi. Ni mu ruzinduko rw’iminsi ibiri yagiriye muri Nigeria aho yavuze ko Afurika igomba kongererwa amakipe abiri mu gihe iki gikombe cyazazamurwa kigashyirwa ku makipe 40, Kimwe mu byo yahavugiye bigashimisha abatuye uyu mugabane ni uko ubwo igitekerezo cyo kuzamura umubare w’amakipe yitabira imikino ya nyuma y’igikombe cyisi cyizashyirwa mu bikorwa, Afurika izongererwa ibihugu bibiri. Kugeza ubu amakipe yitabira iyo mikino ni 32. Muri ayo 32 Afurika iba ihagarariwe n’amakipe atanu gusa. Perezida wa Fifa Yanabonanye na Perezida wa Nigeria Muhammadu Buhari baganira ku iterambere ry’umupira w’amaguru muri Afurika  Nk’uko tubikesha ikinyamakuru cya Supersport, Gianni Infantino usigaye ari perezida wa FIFA guhera mu kwezi k’ Ukwarira Aganira n’itangazamakuri I Abuja Infatino yagize ati “ndizere ko mu mikino ya nyuma y’igikombe cy’isi yo muri 2026, tuzaba dufite amakipe 40. Muri ayo umunani azaba yiyongereyeho, nibura abiri azaba avuye muri Afurika” yongereye ho ko ibiganiro n’ibitekerezo kuri iyi ngingo bikirimbanyije ngo ariko yiyumvamo ubushobozi bwo kubyemeza buri wese. Muri urwo ruzinduko kandi yari aherekejwe n’umunyamabanga mukuru we ari we Fatma Samoura bakaba barabonanye n’abayobozi 18 b’amafedarasiyo ya ruhago muri Afurika ar nako barebye umukino wa nyuma wa national youth tournament. Infantino kandi yanabonanye na perezidawa Nigeria Muhammadu Buhari. Infatino agereranya perezida Buhari nk’inshuti ya ruhago. Yavuze ko afata Nigeria nk’ibuye fatizo ryubatse umupira wa Afurika. Yagize ati “Mbona Nigeria nk’ibuye fatizo ryubatse umupirawa Afurika,n’ubwo hagikenewe ibikorwaremezo, umutekano ndetse n’umutuzo byo kubishimangira.” N’ubwo avuga ibi ariko nta wakwiyibagiza ko iyi Nigeria imaze inshuro ebyiri zikurikirana ititabira imkino ya nyuma y’igikombe cya Afurika.

title: Ku nshuro ya mbere u Rwanda rubonye umusifuzi uruhagararira mu mikino mpuzamahanga
content:
Bwa mbere mu mateka y’u Rwanda hagiye kuboneka umusifuzi uhagararira u Rwanda mu mikino mpuzamahanga ya Paralempike izabera I Rio de Janeiro mu gihugu cya Brazil. Umunyarwanda Gaju Erick yatoranijwe mu basifuzi bazasifura Ku nshuro ya mbere, Sitting Volleyball w’Umunyarwanda mu mikino Paralempike ahereye ku yizabera i Rio de Janeiro muri Brazil muri Nzeli 2016. Kuri ubu uyu Gaju akaba yemeza ko yamaze kubona ubutumire bwo kujya gusifura mu mikino Paralempike ku makipe y’abagabo ndetse n’abagore yabonye tike yo kuyitabira. Gaju ubusanzwe ni umusifuzi mpuzamahanga wa Volleyball y’abadafite ubumuga akaba n’umusifuzi mpuzamahanga wa Sitting Volleyball mu bafite ubumuga. Muri 2010 yasifuye igikombe cy’isi cya Sitting Volleyball muri Amerika , ubu akaba ari ubwa mbere agiye gusifura imikino Paralempike iba nyuma y’imyaka ine. Nzeyimana Celestin umuyobozi wa Komite y’Igihugu y’Imikino y’abantu bafite ubumuga (NPC Rwanda) yatangarije izubarirashe.rw ko kuba Gaju azasifura mu mikino Paralempike ari ishema rikomeye kuri we no kuri NPC Rwanda, kuko niwe musifuzi wa mbere wo mu bihugu byo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara uzaba usifuye imikino Paralempike bwa mbere. Nzeyimana avuga ko ubumenyi bwa Gaju buzagirira akamaro abandi basifuzi bo mu Rwanda ndetse no ku iterambere  rya Sitting Volleyball mu Rwanda. Gaju yabwiye Izubarirashe ko yatangiye asifura imikino yo mu gihugu yaba iya Sitting Volleyball na Sitball, ariko nyuma yatangiye kuzamuka mu ntera asifura imikino y’igikombe cy’isi cya Sitting Volleyball, asifura imikino yo gushaka itike yo kujya mu mikino Paralempike ya 2012 yabereye i London mu Bwongereza, nyuma y’aho ubu akaba aribwo yemerewe gusifura imikino Paralempike ya 2016 igiye kubera muri Brazil. Imikino Paralempike izatangira kuwa 7 kugeza 18 Nzeli 2016, aho ikipe y’u Rwanda ya Sitting Volleyball mu bagore izaserukira umugabane wa Afurika. Mu mikino ngororamubiri u Rwanda ruzaserukirwa na Muvunyi Hermas uzasiganwa ahareshya na metero 400 na 1500. Ikipe y’u Rwanda y’abagabo ku nshuro ya mbere yitabiriye imikino Paralempike yabereye i London mu Bwongereza, ariko ihagarariye ibihugu byo munsi y’Ubutayu bwa Sahara, muri iyi mikino yabaye muri 2012 ikipe y’u Rwanda yatsinze ikipe ya Maroc.

title: Kuba Manchester United yarandagajwe na Dortmund ntibyabuza Mourinho gusinzira
content:
Jose Mourinho ni umutoza mushya w’ikipe ya Manchester United, nyuma yo kwandagazwa na Borussia Dortmund ku bitego 4-1, yavuzeko kuba ikipe ye yaratakaje imbere y’abana ba Borussia Dortmund atari ishyano ryaguye, Ni mu mukino wa mu bihe bya Pre-season yo kwitegura umwaka mushya w’imikino wa 2016/2017. Ngo byaba ari ukudashyira mu kuri aramutse yibasiye abakinnyi be kuko uyu mukino bawukinnye bamaze iminsi 10 gusa mu myitozo. Ibi ariko ntabyumva kimwe na benshi cyane ko na Dortmund yamutsinze, nta wakwirengagiza uburyo iyi Dortmund yasahuwe. Kuri uyu wa 22 Kanama, niho Mourinho na Manchester United ye bakinnye umukino wa Gicuti na Borussia Dortmund yo mu Budage. Ni umukino wabereye mu Bushinwa. N’ubwo ubushyuhe bwari hejuru (kuri dogere selisiyusi 35), ntibyabujije ikipe ya Dortmund gusebya Manchester United na Mourinho ku bitego 4-1. Ibitego bya Dortmund byatsinzwe na Gonzalo Castro watsinzemo bibiri, Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang watsinze Penalite na Ousmane Dembele  wagaragaje ko ari we mukinnyi muto utanga ikizere ku mugabane w’I Burayi. Ni umukino wa mbere Mourinho atsinzwe ari umutoza wa Man.U. ukaba ari umukino wa kabiri atoje, ni nyuma yo gutsinda Wigan 2-0. Mourinho yavuze ko nta byacitse. Yagize ati “pre-season ni imikino yo gutangira kandi ni imyitozo. Birakwiyeko habaho gutangira neza. Ikipe twakinnye imaze hafi ukwezi yitoza. Ku ruhande rwacu, ukuri ni uko tugifite abakinnyi batandatu bakiri mu bya Europe. Ongeraho Rooney n Chris Smalling bakiri mu myitozo gusa,abo si umunani? Zlatan Ibrahimovic, Anthony Martial, Marouane Fellaini, Morgan Schneiderlin ntabahari.” Yongereyeho ko agikeneye abakinnyi bake kugira ngo agire ikipe yuzuye. Ati “ isoko ryacu ryamaze gukorwa 75 ku ijana, nidusinyisha undi mukinnyi wo hagati bizaba birangiye. Twari dukeneye bane none twaguze batatu bivuze ko hasigaye umwe kandi mwiza.” Uwo bari bahanganye ari we Thomas Tuchel (umutoza wa Dortmund), we isoko asa nkuwarikose neza kuko uretse kugarura Mario Goetze, yanasinyishije Andre Schurrle.

title: U Rwanda rugiye kwakira imikino ihuza ingabo zo mu Muryango w’Ibihugu by’Afurika
content:
U Rwanda rugiye kwakira imikino ihuza ingabo zo mu Muryango w’Ibihugu by’Afurika y’Iburasirazuba (EAC)
 Iyi mikino n’iserukiramuco bizaba bibaye ku nshuro ya 10 bizatangira ku itariki 7 Kanama 2016 kuri Stade Amahoro no kuri Stade ya Kigali i Nyamirambo n’iya Kicukiro aho kwinjira bizaba ari ubuntu. Icyo iyi mikino igamije si ukurushanwa ahubwo ni ugushimangira ubusabane no gufatanya hagati y’Ingabo zo mu bihugu by’Afurika y’Iburasirazuba no guteza imbere impano mu mikino ziri mu basirikare hamwe n’umuco mu bihugu bya EAC nk’uko byatangajwe n’Umuvugizi w’Ingabo z’u Rwanda Lt Col Rene Ngendahimana. Lt Col Rene Ngendahimana yatangaje ko abarenga 500 ari bo bazitabira iyi mikino izabera mu Rwanda.
Hazakinwa umupira w’amaguru n’iy’amaboko harimo Handball, Netball na Basketball hamwe no gusiganwa (Cross Country). Iyi mikino n’iserukiramuco bihuza ingabo zo mu bihugu by’Afurika y’Iburasirazuba byatangiye kuva mu mwaka wa 2005 ubwo imikino ya mbere yaberaga i Kampala muri Uganda. Iba buri mwaka hashingiwe ku masezerano y’ubufatanye ya EAC mu bya gisirikare. Aya masezerano agena uburyo ingabo zo muri ibi bihugu zifatanya mu mikoranire, mu guhanahana amakuru hamwe no guteza imbere ubusabane mu muco na siporo. Insanganyamatsiko y’uyu mwaka igira iti" Turi umwe mu cyerekezo kimwe mu mikino n’umuco bihuza Ingabo z’Umuryango wa EAC, 2016 ".

title: Police FC ikomeje kwiyubaka igura abakinnyi
content:
Nyuma yo kurangiza umwaka wa shampiyona ku mwanya wa gatanu n’amanota 53, Police FC  ubu ikomeje kwiyubaka igura abakinnyi mu rwego rwo kongera imbaraga no kwitegura shampiyona y’umwaka utaha.
 Nyuma kandi yo gusezerera bamwe mu bari bagize ikipe yakinnye umwaka ushize ,  Police FC yazanye umutoza mushya ariwe Innocent Seninga ndetse ikomeje kongeramo amaraso mashya. Ni muri urwo rwego Police FC imaze kugura abatoza babiri bazafasha  umutoza mukuru aribo Bisengimana Justin uzaba yungirije akaba yaravuye muri Gicumbi FC n’umutoza w’abazamu Claude Maniraho  wavuye muri Etincelles. Police FC kandi imaze kugura abakinnyi batandatu aribo: Habimana Hussein, umuzamu Nduwayo Danny na Nizeyimana Milafa bose bavuye muri Etincelle; hari kandi  Jean Bosco Akayezu wavuye muri Muhanga  na Ndayishimiye Antoine Dominique wavuye muri Gicumbi FC. Ku italiki ya 21 Nyakanga kandi,  nibwo Police FC nabwo yaguze abakinnyi babiri aribo  myugariro wakiniraga Mukura VS ukinira n’Amavubi Celestin Ndayishimiye  na rutahizamu wavuye muri AS Kigali witwa Mwizerwa Amini. Umuvugizi akaba n’umunyamabanga wa Police FC, Chief Inspector of Police(CIP) Jean de Dieu Mayira, atangaza ko aba bakinnyi baje mu rwego rwo kongera ingufu mu ikipe kugirango irusheho kwitwara neza. CIP Mayira yagize ati:” Aba bakinnyi twabaguze mu rwego rwo kongera ingufu kuko hari  abavuye mu ikipe berekeza ahandi, ni muri urwo rwego twahaye umutoza mushya ububasha  bwo gushakisha abandi bakinnyi abona yakwifashisha mu mwaka utaha wa shampiyona” Abakinnyi ba Police FC ubu bari mu kiruhuko nyuma y’aho umwaka wa shampiyona ushojwe, nk’uko bitangazwa n’ubuyobozi bw’iyo kipe

title: Iranzi, Ombalenga na Rachid intego ni ugukina Europa League
content:
Umuyobozi w’ikipe ya MFK TOPVAR TOPOLCANY yo muri Slovakia, yaguze abakinnyi bane b’abanyarwanda yatangaje ko yabarangiwe na Samuel Eto’o ndetse ngo kuba agiye kugira aba bakinnyi bizamufasha kuba yagera ku ntego ze zo gukina igikombe cy’Uburayi.
 Abdelaziz Patrick Benaoudia, umuyobozi akaba na nyir’iyi kipe yo mu cyiciro cya gatatu, akaba yakomeje atangaza ko yategurije aba basore mu gihugu cya Slovakia ku buryo bazakwakirwa n’abafana benshi ndetse ngo umukinnyi uzajya ugaragaza impano y’umupira w’amaguru mu Rwanda, azajya amuha amahirwe yo kujya ku mugabane w’u Burayi.
ikiganiro kirambuye na Abdelaziz Benaoudia
Iranzi Jean Claude, Kalisa Rachid na Ombalenga Fitina bakaba bahagurutse mu Rwanda kuri uyu wa Gatanu saa Cyenda n’igice, aho bazaca i Dubai, bakagera muri Slovakia kuri uyu wa Gatandatu mu gihe Rwatubyaye Abdoul ashobora kuzabasangayo nyuma y’ibyumweru 2 cyangwa 3.
 Umbajije ikibazo kiza, nabamenye binyuze kuri Eto’O, ndetse n’abantu beza barimo umuyobozi w’ikipe ya APR, ubwo navuganaga na we ku nshuro ya mbere, byaranshimishije cyane, ku buryo yari ashiyigikiye ko abakinnyi babareka bakagenda. Ni ibintu by’igiciro, ni kubw’iyo mpamvu nahisemo kugaruka nkagura aba bakinnyi.
Twumvise ko mwatangiye kugirana ibiganiro n’ikipe ya Police ariko ntibyakunda, Ese ntabwo byabaciye intege? Yego, ariko oya ibyo ntacyo byari bidutwaye, cyane ko icyo twarebagaho ni umukinnyi Rachid Kalisa, nashakaga ko aza mu ikipe yanjye muri Gashyantare, ariko sinahura na perezida w’ikipe ye, ndetse yakoze kuburyo tutabona umukinnyi ariko ibyo ni amakosa akomeye. Ni iki cyabateye kuba mwahitamo kugura aba bakinnyi b’abanyarwanda?
 Ni impano, kandi biterwa n’abakinnyi, twagiye tubibona kuri interineti, za You tube, kimwe n’aba-agent barimo Eto’O kandi najye nakoze igenzura ndi kumwe n’aba-Manager banjye bo muri Slovakia. Tugaruke ku ikipe yanyu, twumvise ko iri mu cyiciro cya gatatu muri Slovakia, tunyuriremo muri make ibya ekipe yanyu Hahaha, ikipe ikipe yanjye yari ntoya, ubu mfite abanyamahanga benshi , mfite abanya-kenya, Abafaransa, Ababiligi ... nashakaga abanyarwanda, ndashaka kubaka ikipe ikomeye kandi ikomeye koko, uretse amagambo, muzaba mureba umusaruro . Ku ikipe nsanzwe mfite nageze muri 1/8 cy’igikombe cya Slovakia ariko ubu mfite ikizere ko ubu nagera ku mukino wa nyuma. Intego yanjye ni ukuzamuka mu cyiciro cya kabiri kandi ndashaka no gutwara igikombe cya Slovakia, kuko ndamutse ngitwaye nakina igikombe cy’Uburayi. Perezida, mbere yuko dusoza iki kiganiro namwe, twashakaga kongera kubabaza ku ikipe yanyu, ese ifite ibikoresho byose, sitade yayo, ibarizwa he?.... Ikipe yanjye ifite ibikoresho byose bihagije, mfite sitade yanjye ifite ikibuga cy’ubwatsi kandi ifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira abantu 8,500. Topolcany ni umujyi utuwe n’abagera ku 45,000 ndetse n’umujyi ukunda cyane umupira w’amaguru ndetse ibijyanye n’ibikorwa remezo by’ingenzi ku bakinnyi birimo piscine na sauna birahari. Perezida, twumva ko ku banyafurika cyane abirabura bitaborohera kuba mu burayi bw’uburasirazuba, kuri aba banyarwanda nta kibazo bizateza? Oya oya, nta kibazo rwose, muri Slovakia bakunda abirabura b’abanyafurika ndetse nta vanguraruhu rihaba. Dufite abanya-Cameroun, Nigeria, Ghana, abanya-Sierra Leone. Mu ikipe yanjye bakunda abanyafurika, ndetse mfitemo abanya-Kenya kandi iyo bakina baba bafite abafana benshi ndetse kuri ubu nakoze publicite kuri aba bakinnyi b’abanyarwanda, mbateguza kubakira kuri uyu wa Gatandatu ubwo baza kuba bagezeyo. Ndabivuze kandi ndabibasezeranyije, nimbona umukinnyi w’umunyarwanda ufite impano nzamuzana iwanjye, azamure urwego rwe ku mugabane w’uburayi.

title: Umwamikazi wa ruhago yatoranyijwe mu ikipe ya Brazil (Amafoto)
content:
Marta Vieira da Silva ni umunya Brazil wavutse kuwa 19 Gashyantare 1986. Azwi nka Marta, akinira ikipe ya FC Rosengård yo muri   Swedish Damallsvenskan.  Abantu benshi bamufata nk’umwamikazi mu ‘isi ya ruhago.
  Ndetse iwabo muri Brazil bamwita  "Pele in skirts,". Kuri ubu yahamagawe mu ikipe y’igihugu cya Brazil y’abagore izakina  imikino ya Olympic bazakira iwabo mu mugi wa  Rio De Janeiro. Muri batatu barengeje imyaka baba bemewe harimo kandi na myugariro w’umuvetera Formiga w’imyaka 38. Marta w’imyaka 30, ni urugereo rw’umukinnyi w’igitsinagore wabayeho mu mateka y’isi ya ruhago. Yatwaye igikombe cy’umukinnyi w’umwaka wa FIFA inshuro eshanu kuva muri 2006 kugeza muri 2010, inshuro anganya na Lionel Messi. Mugenzi we Forgima ku myaka 38 ni we mukinnyi rukumbi umaze guca agahigo ko kuba yaritabiriye imikino yose ya Olympic kuva umupir w’amaguru washyirwa muri iyi mikino mu 1996. Iyi kipe ya Brazi y’abagore, irigutozwa na Vadao ugiye guhatanira igikombe cye cya mbere gikomeye. Ni nyuma yuko ntacyo bakoze ubwo bageraga ku mukino wa nyuma w’igikombe cy’isi muri 2007, ndetse no mu mikino nk’iyi ya Olympic yo muri 2004 na 2008. title: APR FC yasinyishije abakinnyi 4 bose bahawe amasezerano y’imyaka ibiri
content:
APR FC yasinyishije Amran Nshimiyimana wakiniraga Police FC, Imanishimwe Emmanuel wavuye muri Rayon Sports, Itangishaka Blaise na Nsabimana Aimable bakiniraga Marines bose bahawe amasezerano y’imyaka ibiri. Mu minsi ishize, ubuyobozi bwa APR FC bwatangaje ko imiryango ifunguye kuri bamwe mu bakinnyi bashaka kwerekeza mu makipe yo hanze. Abakinnyi bashobora gusohoka muri iyi kipe barimo Iranzi Jean Claude na Rwatubyaye Abdoul bifuzwa n’ikipe ya MFK Topvar Topoľčany yo mu kiciro cya gatatu muri Slovakia, Kwizera Olivier waguzwe muri Maritzburg United yo muri Afurika y’Epfo, ndetse na Bayisenge Emery ushobora kwerekeza ku mugabane w’Uburayi. Kuri uyu wa kane, APR FC yazindukiye mu nkubiri yo gusinyisha abakinnyi bashya mu rwego rwo kurushaho kwiyubaka no kuziba icyuho cya bamwe mu nkingi za mwamba batazakomeza kuyikinira. Mu kiganiro IGIHE yagiranye na Amran Nshimiyimana yemeje ko ubu ari umukinnyi wa APR FC mu gihe cy’imyaka ibiri ndetse akaba yashyize umukono ku masezerano kuri uyu mugoroba. Yagize ati "Ubu ndi umukinnyi wa APR FC nta banga. Mvuye kubonana n’abayobozi ba APR FC nshyize umukono ku masezerano y’imyaka ibiri." Uyu mukinnyi w’imyaka 28 yavuze ko avuye muri Police FC kuko yabonye ari ikipe itazi guha agaciro abakinnyi bityo kuba yari abonye ikipe imwegera ikamwereka ko imukeneye kandi hari ibyo yayifasha nta mpamvu yari kumubuza kwigendera. Ati "Nabonye ikipe izi agaciro kanjye. Bansabye ko najyayo kuko bambonyemo ko nshoboye kandi hari aho nageza ikipe.”
Uretse uyu mukinnyi wemeza ko yamaze kuba uwa APR FC, myugariro wakiniraga Marines FC Nsabimana Aimable nawe yemereye IGIHE ko yashyize umukono ku masezerano y’imyaka ibiri. Nsabimana yagombaga kuzatangirana imyitozo n’abandi muri APR FC shampiyona irangiye ariko kubera imvune afite akaba ashobora kuzatinda kubasanga mu mwiherero. Itangishaka Blaise we avuga ko ibiganiro byose byarangiye agomba kwerekeza muri APR FC ariko yabaye aretse gushyira umukono ku masezerano hari ingingo imwe batarumvikanaho ariko ejo ashobora gusinya. Yagize ati “Ibiganiro byararangiye nagombaga gusinya uyu munsi ariko hari ingingo APR FC icyumvikana n’ushinzwe kunshakira amakipe ijyanye no kuba bandekura nta mananiza igihe mbonye ikipe hanze. Abayobozi ba APR FC bambwiye ko bagiye kubitekerezaho ahari n’ejo bambwira ngasinya.”
 Uyu munsi kandi nibwo APR FC yasinyishije Imanishimwe Emmanuel, myugariro wigaragaje cyane muri Rayon Sports byari byatangajwe ko yongereye amasezerano muri iyi kipe. APR FC kandi ishobora gusinyisha mu minsi ya vuba umunyezamu wa Police FC, Emery Mvuyekure ugomba gusimbura Kwizera Olivier wamaze kwerekeza mu ikipe ya Maritzburg United ibarizwa muri Afurika y’Epfo.

title: Marcus Rashford yakiriye impano idasanzwe ivuye Kwa David Beckham
content:
Marcus Rashford  ni umwe mu bakinnyi b’abongereza bigaragarako ashobora kuzagera ikirenge mu cya bakurube bo muri Macnhester United nka David Beckham, Eric Cantona na Christiano Ronaldo. Ni nyuma yo kwitwara neza mu ntangiriro ze mu ikipe nkuru ya Mancherster united byatumye anahamagarwa mu ikipe y’Ubwongereza yakinnye Euro2016 mu Bufaransa. Biravugwa ko ashobora no kuzahabwa numero 7 yambawe n’ibi  bihangange. Mu gihe arikwitegura Preseason na Mourinho, yashize kuri Twitter ye ifoto igaragaza impano y’umupira wo kwambara yagenewe na David Beckham Ni ifoto yari iherekejwe n’ubutumwa yoherejwe n’uwo munyabigwi. Ubwo butumwa bwari mu rurimi rw’icyongereza buvuga gutya “To Marcus, good luck and continue working hard and playing with joy and passion. Love David” tugenekereje mu Kinyarwanda, “kuri Marcus, amahirwe masa kandi ukomeze gukora cyane no gukinana urukundo n’ibyishimo.” David Beckham ni umufana ukomeye wa Rashford. Iyi foto Rashford yashikwirakwije ku mbuga nkoranyambaga by’umwihario Twitter aho akurikirwa n’abantu 984,000 nawe ubwe yongeragaho iyi nteruro "Nice to be appreciated by one of the best." Bishatse kugugako ari byiza kwishimimwa n’umwe mu bantu beza. Ku myaka 41 Beckham wahoze ari kapiteni w’ubwongereza akoze ibi mu rwego rwo gushyigikira uyu mwana w’imyaka 18 cyane ko bamwe bari batangiye kwibaza ku kazoza ke nyuma yo kuza kwa Zlatan Ibrahimovic. title: Rayon sport igiye gutakaza abakinnyi babiri bakomeye
content: Ikipe ya Rayon sport Fc yaba igiye gutakaza Abakinnyi babiri bayo harimo myugariro Imanishimwe Emmanuel na rutahizamu Ismaila Diarra bategerejwe mu gihugu cya Kenya mu mpera z’iki Cyumweru, aho bazajya gukinira ikipe ya AFC Leoprds itozwa na Ivan Minnaert. Aba bakinnyi babiri ni bamwe mu bategerejwe muri iyi kipe ifite abafana batari bake muri Kenya, kimwe n’undi munya-Mali Mousa Sissoko wakiniraga AC Djoliba. Uyu we, yari ategerejwe muri Kenya kuri uyu wa Mbere, ariko azagera mu ikipe kuwa Gatatu nyuma yo kugira ikibazo cya tike y’indege. “Sissoko yagombaga kuza kuri uyu wa Mbere ariko yaje kugira ikibazo cya tike y’indege, kubw’ibyo tumutegereje mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatatu. Bitarenze impera z’iki Cyumweru tuzakira Emmanul na Diarra kuko bagomba kuza nyuma yo gusoza umwaka w’imikino muri Rayon.”- umutoza Ivan Minnert atangariza Capital Sport, Ivan Minnaert yakomeje atangaza ko kugira aba basore batatu b’abanyamahanga, bizamufasha kugira ikipe ihangana, ndetse izakomereza aho yari ageze, dore ko mu mpera z’icyumweru gishize, kuwa Gatandatu, AFC Leopards yatsinze Thika United ibitego 4-0. “Ahazaza ha AFC Leporads hagiye kuba heza. Sissoko, Diarra na Emmanuel bose bazaza, bitume tugira ikipe ishoboye guhangana. Ntabwo twavuga ngo tuzahita tubigeraho ariko tuzagerageza buri munsi.” Kugeza ubu, ikipe ya AFC Leopards iri ku mwanya wa 11 n’amanota 20 nyuma y’imikino 17 imaze gukina muri shampiyona y’icyiciro cya mbere muri iki gihugu cya Kenya. title: Imyaka 10 irashize: “Materazzi yahishuye impamvu yatumye Zinedine Zidane amukubita umutwe”
content:
Hari mu mikino y’igikombe cy’Isi cyo mu mwaka wa 2006 ubwo Zinedine Zidane wakiniraga Ubufaransa muri icyo gihe yakubise umutwe mugenzi we Marco Materazzi bakinaga nawe wakiniraga ikipe y’Igihugu y’Ubutariyani, kuri ubu uyu Materazzi aka yahishuye impamvu yatumye uyu Zinedine amukubita umutwe dore ko ari inkuru yavuzweho byinshi bitandukanye harimo n’abavugaga ko yamututse ku mubyeyi we.
 Mu kiganiro yagiranye n’ikinyamakuru L’Equipe, Marco Materazzi yatangaje ko anenga cyane abanyamakuru bakomeje gushimangira ko yatutse Zinedine Zidane ku babyeyi akaba yagize ati “ Ngewe singeze ntuka Zidane ku babyeyi be gusa we yarahindukiye arambaza ati :Ese ushaka umwenda wanjye nambaye kuburyo umukino nurangira nza kuwuguha? Nuko nange ndamubwira nti ngewe sinshaka umupira wawe ahubwo uze kumpa mushiki wawe w’indaya” . Materazzi kandi akomeza abwira iki kinyamakuru ko icyo gihe yaje no kubisubiramo akabishimangira ati umukino nurangira uze kumpa mushiki wawe w’indaya ubwo nibwo ngo Zidane yaje guhita ahindukira amukubita umutwe ako kanya. Materazzi kandi yahamije ko atigeze atuka Zinedine Zidane ku mubyeyi we kuko azi agaciro ka maman w’umuntu cyane ko uwe yapfuye ubwo yari afite imyaka 15 y’amavuko gusa akaba yavuze rero ko atabasha gutuka mugenzi we ku mubyeyi.

title: Umutoza wa Etincelles yahamije ko ari kurambagizwa n’amakipe atanu

title: Antoine Griezmann yongeye guhura na Christiano ku mukino wa nyuma
content:
Kuwa 28 Gicurasi, Christiano Ronaldo yahuriye na Antoine Griezmann ku mu kino wa nyuma wa UEFA Champions Lague, Hari I Roma mu Butaliyani, Icyo gihe Christiano wari uri muri Real Madrid yahigitse Griezmann wari uri muri Atletico Madrid amutwara igikombe. Mu gihe kitarenza amezi abiri gusa aba basore bongeye guhurira ku mukino wa nyuma. Ni kuri uyu wa 10 Nyakanga aho bazacakiranira ku mukino wa nyuma wa Euro 2016, France vs Portugal. Ni nyuma y’uko France yamaze gusezerera Ubudage ku bitego 2-0 bya Griezmann byombi. Byaje bikurikira Portugal yasezereye Wales kuri 2-0 bya Christiano na Nani. Ese ni umwanya mwiza wa Griezmann wo kwihorera cyangwa Christiano azamubwirako uwamutsinze ntaho yagiye? Ni abasore bamaze kugera mu bihe byabo byiza. Ku nshuro ye yambere Griezmann akinnye bene iyi mikino niwe uyoboye ba rutahizamu bari muri iri rushamwa n’ibitego bitanu. Ibi kandi byanatumya asatira abanyabigwi batsinze ibitego byinshi mu mateka y’iri rushanwa muri rusange. Kuri ubu ahagaze ku mwanya wa kane ahuriyeho na Ruud van Nistelrooy, Patrick Kluivert, Wayne Rooney, Thierry Henry, Zlatan Ibrahimović, Nuno Gomes bose bafite bitandatu, babanjirijwea na Alan Shearer ufite birindwi maze ku mwanya wa mbere hakaza Michel Platini na Christiano Ronaldo bafite icyenda Kuri Christiano Ronaldo we urugamba si urw’igikombe gusa kuko aha agomba no kuhakura Ballon d’Or. Agomba n kurwana n’amateka mabi yamubaye hamwe na Portugal muri 2004 ubwo Batsindirwaga kumu kino wa nyuma n’Ubugereki. Twabutsa ko icyo gihe numero 7 Christiano yambera ubu yari yambawe na Luis Figo. Christiano yambaraga 17. Ikindi kizasunika Christiano, ni uko yiguza gushyiraho ake gahigo ko kuba rutahizamu w’ibihe byose wa Euro kuko kuri ubu anganya na Michel Platin ibitego, 9. Aba bagabo bombi kandi nibo bamaze gutsindira ibihugu byabo ibitego byinshi muri iyi mikino. Christiano afite bitatu n’imipira itatu ivamo ibitego. Griezmann unayoboye ba rutahizamu bose muri iri rushamwa amaze gutsindira ubufaransa ibitego 5 n’imipira ibiri ivamo ibitego. Ibitego 6 uyu musore Griezmann afite abitsinze mu irushanwa rimwe mu gihe 9 bya Christiano yabitsinze mu marushanwa ane. Griezmann ntazaba ashaka kwihorere kuri Christiano gusa kuko na myugariro wa Portugal Pepe ari mu bamubujije guterure UEFA Champions League.

title: Euro 2016: Christiano Ronaldo n’ikipe ye Portugal bageze ku mukino wa nyuma
content:
Umukino wa kimwe cya kabiri mu irushanwa rihuza ibihugu byo ku mugabane w’Uburayi, usize ikipe ya Portugal ikatishije ikipe yo kuzakina umukino wa nyuma (final) nyuma yo gutsinda Wales ibitego 2-0. Mu gice cya mbere ikipe ya Wales yatangiye ishakisha uburyo yabona igitego, Portugal nayo ikanyuzamo igasatira izamu, amakipe yombi yaragije igice cya mbere nta kipe ibashije kubona igitego. Mu gice cya kabiri ikipe ya Portugal yaje bigaragara yuko yari imaze kumva inama z’umutoza wayo ku munota wa 50 Cristiano Ronaldo yinjije igitego cya mbere, nyuma y’iminota 3 gusa atanga na pase yavuyemo igitego cya kabiri cyatsinzwe na Nani. Wales yakoze ibishoboka byose ngo irebe ko yakwishyura ibyo bitego, umuzamu wa Portugal ababera ibamba. Umukinnyi Bale wagerageje kujya atera mu izamu rya Portugal, umukino warangiye Portugal itsinze Wales ibitego 2-0. Ihita ibona itike zo kuzakina umukino wa nyuma uteganyijwe ku cyumweru tariki ya 10/07/2016, izahura n’ikipe iza kwitwara neza hagati ya France na Germany.

title: Umugabo wanjye ahora anyanduza indwara zo mu myanya ndangagitsina- Miss Shanel aratabariza Mukamana
content: Mu mashusho yuzuye agahinda kenshi cyane, Miss Shanel yasobanuye iby’umugore uhora arwaye indwara zo mu myanya ndangagitsina (infections) ariko akaba atabasha kwivuza kuko niyo amaze gukira umugabo we yongera akamwanduza. Ni amashusho Miss Shanel yashyize ku rukuta rwe rwa Instagram aho asobanura ahaginda k’umugore witwa Mukamana, ubangamiwe bikomeye n’umugabo we uhora amwanduza indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina ariko akanga ko bivuza. Muri aya mashusho Shanel avuga ko nyuma yo kumenya ko arwaye iyi ndwara ya ’Infection’ yo mu gitsina yagiye kwivuza ariko nyuma akongera akarwara, kuko bisaba ko yivuzanya n’umugabo we, undi akamubera ibamba, agatsemba akanga kwivuza burundu, ibi bigatuma undi ahora ajya kwa muganga kwivuza indwara imwe kandi umuti woroshye kuboneka. Akomeza agira ati "Ndamutse nanze kubonana na we yajya hanze noneho akanzanira n’izindi zirenze izo. Ariko nanone guhora ku miti, guhora kwa muganga, no guhora mbangamirwa kuko infections zirabangama cyane pe, no kuba ntivuza bya nyabyo ngo birangire, ni ikibazo kimbangamiye pe." Mu magambo aherekeje aya mashusho, Shanel arasaba buri wese uyabona kumugira inama y’icyakorwa ndetse n’ubufasha ubwo aribwo bwose bwatangwa ngo iki kibazo uyu mugore afite gikemuke. Ibi akaba abikoze mu rwego rwo gukomeza ubukangurambaga yatangiye bwo kurwanya ihohoterwa rikorerwa abagore yise ’Atura Campaign’

title: Michaël Sengazi yahawe igihembo cy’Umunyarwenya w’umwaka muri Afurika
content:
Umunyarwenya ufite inkomoko mu Burundi no mu Rwanda, Michaël Sengazi yegukanye igihembo cy’umunyarwenya w’umwaka muri Afurika gitanzwe ku nshuro ya 5 na Radiyo Mpuzamahanga y’Abafaransa (RFI). Inkuru dukesha urubuga rwa RFI ruvuga ko Sengazi azwi mu Rwanda cyane aho yanditse akanakina mu mikino ine ya ’One-man-show’ ndetse akaba yaranashyizeho amaserukiramuco abiri mu Burundi no mu Rwanda.

Ni umwe mu batangije itsinda rya Comedy Knights mu Rwanda Ku myaka 31, Michaël Sengazi amaze imyaka irenga 10 atangiye gusurutsa abantu binyuze mu mpano ye yo gusetsa, gusa muri iyi minsi ya vuba izina rye ryagiye ritumbagizwa n’ibitaramo bitandukanye yagiye yitabira mu mijyi itandukanye yo mu burengerazuba bwa Afurika mu bihugu bikoresha cyane ururimi rw’Igifaransa. Avoma he inganzo? Kuri micro ya RFI, Sengazi yagize ati "Issoko mvumamo inganzo iteka ni umuryango ariko kandi n’imiziro (tabous) kuko tugira nanone ibizira byinshi mu muryango mugari wacu. Ntawuvuga ibitsina (sexe). Nyamara dukunda kubikora, ariko ntibivugwe. Tuvuga ubuzima bwa buri munsi, bw’ishuri, amadini, imibonano mpuzabitsina na politike." Yatangiriye i Kinshasa Michaël Sengazi arakibuka neza ibihe bya mbere byatumye impano ye isakara hanze agatangira kuzamuka urubyiniro agiye gusetsa abantu. "Byari mu iserukiramuco, mu iserukiramuco rya Toseka muri Congo. Muri icyo gihe ntabwo byari umunezero hagati y’u Rwanda na Congo. Hari umwuka mubi n’ibindi, ariko twagombaga kujyayo hamwe n’umwe mu nshuti zanjye, Hervé Kimenyi undi munyarwenya w’Umunyarwanda, ufite impano ikomeye.", Sengazi. Yakomeje ati "Icyo gihe cyabaye icy’ingenzi cyane. Ni uwo munsi kandi nabashije guhura n’ibyamamare bikomeye byansunitse : Michel Gohou, Digbeu Cravate, Mamane. Nabonye ko hamwe n’urwenya nshobora guhuza abantu. Njyewe nk’umurundi uvanze n’umunyarwanda, natangiriye mu by’ukuri i Kinshasa. Twahujwe n’urwenya ndetse ku bw’urwenya tubasha gushyira ku ruhande ibidutandukanya. Aho niho nahise nanzurira ko ari byo nshaka gukora"  

Yavukiye i Gitega mu Burundi kuri se w’Umurundi na nyina wavukiye i Burundi ariko ukomoka mu Rwanda  Azahererwa ibihembo bye mu iserukiramuco rikomeye  Umunyarwenya wubatse izina muri Afurika y’abakoresha Igifaransa, Mamane usanzwe anakorera Radio Mpuzamahanga y’Abafaransa, afatanije n’iyi radiyo na Gondwana-City Productions batangije ibi bihembo bya "prix RFI Talents du rire" biherekezwa na miliyoni enye z’amayero (asaga miliyoni 4 040 518frw) bigahabwa umunyempano mushya mu rwenya aho gihemba urubyiruko rukoresha Igifaransa muri Afurika no mu nyanja y’Ubuhinde n’ibirwa bya Caraïbes. 
 Michaël Sengazi biteganijwe ko azashyikirizwa iki gihembo ku ya 07 Ukuboza 2019 ku rubyiniro rw’iserukiramuco y’urwenya izwi nka Abidjan Capitale du Rire.

Sengazi yize amashuri abanza mu Burundi n’ayisumbuye kuri Michel Archange i Bujumbura, yiga amategeko muri Kaminuza ya ULK i Kigali

title: Abahatanye na Nimwiza Meghan muri Miss World bashyizwe mu matsinda
content: Abitabiriye irushanwa rya Miss World 2019 bashyizwe mu matsinda y’abakobwa batandatu kuri buri rimwe, bazayahuriramo bahatana mu cyiciro cyizwi nka ’Head to Head Challenge’ cyo gusuzuma ubumenyi bwabo. Iki gikorwa cyabimburiye ibindi bizaranga Miss World cyabaye ku isaha ya saa tanu z’amanywa mu Bwongereza aho iri rushanwa riri kubera. Miss World 2018, Vanessa Ponce ni we watoranyaga udupapuro turiho amazina y’ibihugu mu bwo kubashyira mu matsinda. Miss Nimwiza Meghan ubwo iki gikorwa cyabaga yisanze mu itsinda rimwe n’umukobwa witwa Ghislaine Mejia ukomoka muri Aruba. Abategura Miss World biseguye ku bayikurikira ko uko abakobwa bagenda basesekara mu Bwongereza ari ko amatsinda yose aza kuzura harimo n’iry’u Rwanda. Kugeza ubu Miss Nimwiza Meghan ari mu itsinda rimwe na Ghislaine Mejia (Aruba), Michelle Daniela DEE (Philippines), Alba Blair (Dominican Republic) na Rebecca Kwabi (Ghana) amaze kugera mu Bwongereza mu gihe hagitegerejwe undi umwe ubura ngo itsinda ryabo ryuzure. Uzegukana irushanwa azamenyekana ku wa 14 Ukuboza 2019 mu birori bikomeye bizabera ahitwa ExCel i Londres, bigasusurutswa n’abahanzi bakomeye mu Bwongereza. Ibi birori bizatambuka kuri shene ya televiziyo yitwa London Live, abo mu bihugu birenga 150 ku Isi bemerewe kubikurikirana. Src:MissRwanda.rw

title: Miss Rwanda 2020: Abifuza guhatanira ikamba rya Nyampinga batangiye kwiyandikisha -Ibisabwa
content:
Kuva kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 20 Ugushyingo 2019, abakobwa bo mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu bifuza guhatanira ikamba rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda w’umwaka wa 2020, batangiye kwiyandikisha binyuze ku rubuga rwa Miss Rwanda. Ni ku nshuro ya 9 hagiye kuba iri rushanwa rigaragaza umukobwa wahize abandi mu bwiza, ubwenge n’umuco. Mu itangazo ryashyizwe hanze na Rwanda Inspiration Back Up itegura aya marushanwa yavuze ko "intego yacu ni iyo guteza imbere ubushobozi bw’umwana w’umukobwa no kumuha urubuga rwo kugira uruhare mu iterambere ry’umuryango nyarwanda".

Ishimwe Dieudonne, Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Rwanda Inspiration Back Up Nkuko bigaragara muri iri tangazo imwe mu mpinduka ikomeye yagaragayemo ni uko ururimi rw’Ikinyarwanda rwahawe agaciro gakomeye dore ko ari rwo rwagizwe ishingiro kugira ngo umukobwa yemererwe kwitabira nubwo n’izindi ndimi zinyongera kuri kavukire mu zemewe n’amategeko mu Rwanda nazo zemewe. Dore iby’ingenzi bisabwa abakobwa bazahatana: *Kuba ari umunyarwandakazi (Indangamuntu cg Pasiporo)
 *Kuba afite imyaka hagati ya 18 na 24
 * Kuba yararangije amashuri yisumbuye
 *Kuba avuga neza Ikinyarwanda. (Urundi rurimi rwiyongera kuri kavukire mu zemewe n’amategeko mu Rwanda narwo ruremewe)
  *Kuba afite uburebure guhera kuri 1,70 m
  *Kuba afite BMI iri hagati ya 18.5 na 24.9
  *Kuba atarigeze abyara
  *Kuba yiteguye kuguma mu Rwanda byibuze mu gihe cy’umwaka nyuma yo gutorwa nka Nyampinga
 *Ntagomba gushyingirwa cyangwa gushinga urugo mu gihe akiri Nyampinga
 *Kuba yiteguye guhagararira u Rwanda ahantu hose n’igihe cyose abisabwe cyangwa biri ngombwa ;
  *Kuba yiteguye gukurikiza no kubahiriza amahame yose n’amabwiriza agenga ba Nyampinga.

Miss Nimwiza Meghan ufite ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2019, ubu ari mu Bwongereza mu irushanwa rya Miss World  Tubibutse ko kuva mu 2009, irushanwa rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda ryubakiye ku nkingi eshatu ari zo : Uburanga, Ubumenyi n’Umuco.

title: Meddy yatawe muri yombi, afungiye i Remera
content:
Umuhanzi Meddy ari mu maboko y’inzego z’umutekano kuva mu ijoro rishyira igitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 21 Ukwakira 2019 aho afungiye kuri sitasiyo ya polisi y’i Remera. Ni nyuma yaho uyu muhanzi afashwe ahagana saa munani z’ijoro atwaye imodoka yanyweye ibisindisha. Umuvugizi wa polisi mu mujyi wa Kigali yemereye itangazamakuru ko koko uyu muhanzi yafashwe kubera ’gutwara imodoka yanyweye inzoga’ maze ahita afungwa.

Meddy afunze azira gutwara imodoka yanyweye inzoga Uyu muhanzi atawe muri yombi nyuma y’abandi benshi bari kugenda bafatwa muri iyi minsi nyuma yaho polisi y’u Rwanda ishami ry’umutekano wo mu muhanda itangije ubukangurambaga bwa ’Gerayo amahoro’ aho basaba abatwara ibinyabiziga kwirinda gutwara banyoye inzoga kuko bishobora guteza impanuka yahitana ubuzima bwabo n’ubwa bandi bakoresha umuhanda. Umuntu ufashwe atwaye imodoka yanyoye ibisindisha, afungwa iminsi itanu, akanatanga ihazabu y’amafaranga ibihumbi ijana na mirongo itanu (150,000 Frw).

Mba numva kandi nakomeza kugora uruganda rwa muzika, mba numva ari inshingano zanjye guhimba ibintu bishya nkaba urugero. Ni ikintu kitoroshye ariko niyo mpamvu yonyine yambashishije kubaho iki gihe cyose muri uru ruganda. Njye numva ko abantu baba bashobora kumenya ibyo witegura gukora, ibyo rero ntibyaba bishimishije, byatera abantu kurambirwa no kubihirwa. Nanjye ubwo naba ndambiwe kandi ndambiwe n’abandi babihirwa.

Yirinda ko ibintu beye bihora ahantu hamwe, aharanira gutera imbere iteka 5. Kudacika intege Navuga gukomeza gukora cyane kandi ntucike intege. Njye rero nemera ko gukora cyane wihaye n’intego, urukundo no gutekereza mu buryo bwiza, ibyo biguha icyizere cyo kumera neza. 6. Njye rero numva twese turi ibyamamare. Tugomba gusa kuvumbura icyo kintu tugomba kuba dukora muri ubu buzima. title: Nicki Minaj yabaye ahagaritse umuziki kubera umuryango
content: Umuraperikazi w’Umunyamerika, Nicki Minaj yatunguye abafana be kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 05 Nzeri 2019 ubwo yatangazaga ko yafashe akaruhuko mu gukora ibikorwa bya muzika mu rwego rwo kwita byihariye ku muryango we. Uyu muhanzikazi w’imyaka 36 ukomoka i New York uzwiho imyambarire ikurura ab’igitsinagabo ndetse kandi agahararwa mu ndirimbo nka "Anaconda", aherutse kurambagizwa n’umushoramari mu muziki Kenneth Petty ndetse baritegura kurushinga mu mezi make ari imbere. "Nahisemo gufata akaruhuko, ubundi nkita ku muryango wanjye", bimwe mu bigize ubutumwa Nicki Minaj yanyujije kuri konti ye ya Twitter. Kuva mu 2010, Nicki Minaj amaze gushyira hanze album enye ndetse yagiye akorana n’abahanzi bakomeye barimo Drake na Lil Wayne. Umwihariko we mu myambarire n’uburyo agaragara no gukunda kugaruka ku bijyanye n’imibonano mpuzabitsina ni bimwe mu byamufashije kwigarurira imyanya y’imbere ku isoko ry’ibihangano muri Amerika. Mu minsi ishize yaherukaga kugaragara cyane mu itangazamakuru mu nkuru z’ubushyamirane hagati ye na mukeba we ugezweho muri iki gihe muri iyi njyana ya rap, Cardi B. Ni kenshi abahanzi bakora injyana ya rap muri Amerika bakunze gutangaza ko bahagaritse umuziki, gusa benshi muri bo birangira bongeye gusubukura ibikorwa byabo bya muzika.

title: Ne-Yo yageze i Kigali aje mu gitaramo no mu muhango wo Kwita Izina ingagi
content:
Umuhanzi w’icyamamare muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika Ne-Yo yasesekaye i Kigali mu rukerera rwo kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 06 Nzeri 2019 aho aje mu gitaramo yatumiwemo cyateguwe mu rwego rwo kwizihiza ibirori byo Kwita Izina Ingagi. Ni ku nshuro ya mbere uyu muhanzi yari ageze mu rw’Imisozi Igihumbi. Saa saba n’iminota 10 z’ijoro nibwo yari yururutse indege. Mu bamwakiriye harimo Mushyoma Joseph (Boubou) uyobora East African Promoters iri gufasha mu mitegurire y’iki gitaramo.

Ne-Yo yageze i Kigali agaragaza umunaniro kubera urugendo rurerure Ne-yo yavuze ko rwari urugendo rurerure ndetse yanagaragazaga umunaniro ariko yasezeranije abanyarwanda igitaramo cyiza cyane ngo ’kuko ahora yiteguye’ kandi nawe ngo yiteze guhura n’abantu beza. Tubibutse ko Ne-Yo ari umwe mu byamamare mpuzamahanga biz kugaragara mu muhango wo Kwita Izina Ingagi ubera mu Kinigi kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 06 Nzeri 2019. Aha haraza kugaragara abandi barimo Tonny Adams wabaye umukinnyi ukomeye wa Arsenal na Louis Van Gaal watoje amakipe y’ibigugu arimo Manchester United, FC Barcelona, Bayern Munich n’ayandi.

Yabwiye abanyamakuru ko yiteguye gutaramira abanyarwanda bakanyurwa Uyu muhanzi kandi wakunzwe cyane mu ndirimbo nka ’Miss Independent’ na ’So sick’ by’umwihariko abakunzi b’ibihangano bye bashonje bahishiwe kuko azabataramira mu gitaramo gitegerejwe kuri uyu wa Gatandatu muri Kigali Arena aho azafatanya n’abahanzi b’abanyarwanda barimo Meddy, Riderman, Bruce Melody na Charly&Nina.

title: Nsanzamahoro wamamaye nka ’Rwasa’ muri filime yitabye Imana
content:
Nsanzamahoro Denis wamenyekanye muri filime nyarwanda nka ’Rwasa’, yitabye Imana kuri uyu wa Kane azize indwara ya diabète yari amaranye iminsi. Nsanzamahoro yari arwariye mu Bitaro Bikuru bya Kaminuza bya Kigali, CHUK, kuva ku wa Mbere. Yitabye Imana ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 5 Nzeri 2019. Mushiki wa Nsanzamahoro wari umurwarije muri CHUK, yabwiye IGIHE ko uyu musore yitabye Imana azize diabète. Ati "Yitabye Imana uyu munsi nibyo, yari amaze iminsi kwa muganga yahageze ku wa mbere." Yakinnye muri filime nyinshi kuva mu 1998 ubwo yinjiraga muri uyu mwuga. Yatangiriye muri filime yitwa 100 Days yakozwe n’umwongereza Jack Hughes, itunganywa na Eric Kabera, ikinirwa ku Kibuye. Mu 2003 yakinnye mu yitwa ’Sometimes in April’ yayobowe na Raoul Peck, wanakoze filime ya Patrice Lumumba. Nsanzamahoro kandi yakinnye muri filime ’Operation Turquoise’, ’A Walk With A Lion’ yakiniwe muri Kenya na ’Shooting Dogs’ ivuga kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda, by’umwihariko igaruka ku biciwe muri ETO Kicukiro.

Yakinnye muri filime zitandukanye mpuzamahanga zivuga k’u Rwanda Nsanzamahoro kandi yikoreye filime ze zinyuranye zirimo n’izamamaye hano mu Rwanda nka filime y’uruhererekane yacaga kuri Televiziyo Rwanda yitwa Sakabaka na Rwasa yanitiriwe. Yitabye Imana atararushinga, icyakora mu biganiro yagiye agirana n’ibinyamakuru binyuranye yakunze kwemeza ko afite umwana w’umuhungu nubwo atigeze yifuza kumugaragaza. Inkuru ya IGIHE

title: Tijara Kabendera yambuwe amafaranga n’umutekamutwe, RIB iratabara
content:
Ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa mbere nibwo Tijara yatekewe umutwe hakoreshejwe telefoni, yamburwa amafaranga ariko yitabaza inzego z’umutekano zirahagoboka. Nk’uko uyu munyamakurukazi abitangaza, ngo yahamagawe n’umuntu amubwira ko yibeshye akamwoherereza amafaranga yari agenewe umugore we uri mu bitaro maze undi na we n’umutima ubabaye amwoherereza amafaranga atazi ko arimo kwamburwa. Mu magambo ye yagize ati "Mu ma saa cyenda na 30 z’amanywa nakiriye fone y’umuntu ambwira ababaye ko yibeshye akohereza amafaranga kuri numero yanjye kdi yashakaga kuyoherereza umugore we urwaje umwana kwa muganga ansaba kuyamusubiza, mbona na message koko ngira ngo ni iya Momo kumbe ni iyo we yakiriye nawe arayinyoherereza! Nkimara kumva ko yibeshye,cyane cyane mpangayikishwa nuko arwaje mbikora ntazuyaje ngo nyamusubize kumbe ndibwe"

 Yamenye ko yahamagawe n’umutekamutwe amaze kohereza amafaranga  Akimara kumenya ko yibwe, Tijara yamenyesheje MTN ndetse na RIB ababwira uko bimugendekeye, hanyuma bashakisha uwabikoze afatirwa i Rusizi. "Nkimara kuyamwoherereza nibwo nahise mbona ko nibwe. Nahise muhamagara aranseka cyaneee arankupa. Nahise nitabaza MTN na RIB bambwira ko bagiye kubikurikirana.
Mumasaha atarenze abiri bari bamaze kumenya ko umujura aherereye mu karere ka Rusizi batangira kumushaka, nyuma y’isaha yari afashwe ubu araye mu maboko ya Police" Inzego z’umutekano ntizahwemye kuburira abantu zibasaba kuba maso bakitondera ibyaha bikoreshwa ikoranabuhanga bitasibye kwiyongera muri iyi minsi. Mu gusoza Tijara yashimiye cyane inzego z’umutekano uburyo zamufashije ndetse anakangurira abantu gukomeza kwitonda kuko bishobora kuba kuri buri wese.

title: Shania Twain yujuje imyaka 54. Dore amwe mu mateka y’ubuzima bugoye cyane yaciyemo

Yakunzwe na benshi mu ndirimbo ziganjemo izituje ziri mu njyana ya Country pop na Country Rock harimo nka Forever and for always, From this moment, When you kiss me n’izindi nyinshi. Shania Twain yavutse ari umwana wa 2 wa Sharon Morrison w’umunyekanada na Edwards Clarence w’umunyamerika. Ababyeyi be batandukanye mu wa 1967, ubwo yari afite imyaka 2 gusa maze nyina ahita yimukira mu kandi gace kitwa Timmins ajyana n’abana be bombi maze aza gushakana n’undi mugabo witwa Jerry Twain ahita aba se w’aba bana ba Sharon.

 Nubwo yaciye muri byinshi bimugore, Shania ni umwe mu bahanzi bakomeye ku isi  Shania afite inkomoko mu Bufaransa ugendeye ku bisekuruza by’abimukira baje muri Canada, binavugwa ko yaba afitanye isano na Celine Dion, Madona, Hillary Clinton n’ibindi byamamare bitandukanye. Uyu muryango wo kwa se mushya, Jerry Twain ntiwari wifashije ndetse rimwe na rimwe baburaga n’ibyo kurya, bigera n’aho ku myaka 8 gusa atangira gukora mu tubari dutandukanye aririmba mu gicuku kugira ngo aze kubona amafaranga ajyana mu rugo ngo bahahe. Nubwo ibyo byari ibihe bimugoye ariko, Shania we yaje gusanga byaramubereye isomo rikomeye ryatumye akomera muri muzika, dore ko kugeza ubu ari we muhanzikazi wa 2 muri Canada wagurishije album nyinshi cyane nyuma ya Celine Dion uza ku isonga.

 Shania na Celine Dion nibo baza ku isonga muri Canada  Yaravuze ati “Ikintu nkunda kindimo kurusha ibindi ni umuziki kandi byaramfashije. Hari ubwo nibwiraga nti ‘ibi ndabyanga’. Nangaga cyane kurara mu tubari hamwe n’abasinzi. Ariko nakundaga umuziki, bityo rero nabashije kubicamo” Nyuma y’aka kazi yaje kujyana na se mu mashyamba gucuruza ibiti. Nubwo aka kazi kari kavunanye cyane ndetse n’umushahara wari muto cyane, Shania we yavuze ko yabyishimiraga kuko byamuhaye agahenge, akaruhuka ibyo mu mujyi nk’amavuta ahumura cyane, amasabune ahenze yo koga n’ibindi nk’ibyo ahubwo bakabaho mu buzima bworoshye kandi bubanogeye. Ku itariki 1 Ugushyingo, 1987, nibwo inkuru mbi yatashye kwa Shania Twain ivuga ko se Jerry na nyina Sharon bose bahitanywe n’impanuka y’imodoka. Nyuma y’ibi byago Shania byabaye ngombwa ko yita kuri basaza be bato Mark na Darryl ndetse na murumuna we Carrie Ann (bavutse kuri Jerry), maze aba nyina w’aba bana, arabarera, yishyura ibyo bakeneye byose ndetse akanabahagararira mu nama z’ababyeyi ku ishuri. Aka gahinda gakomeye n’uyu muruho byabaye inganzo mu myaka myinshi aho yakoze indirimbo ‘God bless the Child’. Yumve hano Mu mwaka wa 1993 ku itariki ya 28 Ukuboza, Shania yarushinganye na Robert John Lange, wari producer (utunganya umuziki) baza kubyarana umwana w’umuhungu Eja D’Angelo ku ya 12 Kanama, 2001. Baje gutandukana mu mwaka wa 2008 nyuma y’uko amuciye inyuma n’umunyamabanga we (secretaire). Ku isabukuru ye y’imyaka 44 y’amavuko (ku ya 28 Kanama 2009) , abicishije ku rubuga rwe yerekanye amashusho y’umukunzi we mushya Frédéric Thiebaul wari umugabo wa wa mukobwa wabateye gutana, barushinga ku bunani bw’umwaka wa 2011 mu birwa bya Caraibes. Urugendo rwe muri muzika Shania Twain yatangiye umuziki neza mu 1984 ubwo yigaga kuririmba maze DJ Stan aramushima cyane maze amuhuza n’umuhanzi yakoreraga indirimbo icyo gihe witwaga Tim Denis maze amufasha mu ndirimbo ye, ahera ubwo azamuka kugeza ubwo abaye uwo tuzi uyu munsi wakoze indirimbo twishimira turi benshi.

 Shania Twain ni umuhanzi unyura abakuru n’abato  Album ye ya mbere yakoze yayitiriye izina rye ‘Shania Twain’ isohoka mu mwaka wa 1993 maze iba iya 67 ikunzwe muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ndetse n’iya 6 muri Canada mu njyana ya Country, nyuma yaho yakoze indi album yise ‘The Woman in Me’ ari nayo ya mbere yarakoranyeho n’umugabo we wa mbere Robert John Mutt Lange, cyakora album yamumenyekanishije cyane ku ruhando mpuzamahanga ni iya gatatu yitwa Come on Over yasohoye mu 1997 dore ko ari album yagurishijwe kurusha izindi mu mateka y’abahanzikazi baririmba ku giti cyabo (solo) ndetse n’iya mbere yagurishisjwe mu mateka ya muzika ya Country. Indirimbo Forever and For Always yakunzwe na benshi Mu mwaka wa 2000, yashyize hanze iyitwa Impressions of a Woman, mu wa 2001 akora iyitwa Up, hamwe n’izindi zitandukanye zagiye zikundwa cyane.
Mu mwaka wa 2008 ubwo yari amaze gutandukana na Lange wari umugabo we, Shania yahise ahagarika ibitaramo n’izindi gahunda za muzika, maze mu ibaruwa yandikiye abafana be abasaba imbabazi ababwira ko akeneye kwiyomora ibikomere yari yatewe no gutandukana n’umugabo we ariko ko azagarukana indirimbo nziza.

 Shania Twain  Mu mwaka wa 2011, nibwo yongeye kugaruka muri muzika, dore ko aribwo yari amaze no kurushinga. Yahise yongera gukora indirimbo nshya n’ibitaramo ndetse anagaragara mu kiganiro cya Oprah Winfrey cyari cyahawe izina rya "Why not? with Shania” Mu rugendo rwe rurerure rwa muzika Shania yegukanye ibihembo byinshi cyane birimo BMI Songwriter Awards 39, Canadian Country Music Awards 26, Prix Juno130 12, Billboard Music Awards 9, Grammy Awards 5, American Music Awards 5, ACMAs 4, na CMAs 2.

title: Zari yise imbwa abakomeza kumuhatira gushyira Diamond abana be muri Tanzania
content:
Zari Hassan wahoze ari umugore wa Diamond Platnumz banabyaranye abana 2, yiyamye abafana b’umuhanzi Diamond n’abandi bantu batandukanye badahwema kumusaba gusubiza abana 2 yabyaranye na Diamond muri Tanzania ngo babonane na se. Uyu mugore usigaye aba muri Afurika y’Epfo, akoresheje amashusho yacishije kuri Instagram n’umujinya mwinshi yabwiye abakomeza kumusaba abana ko badakwiye na gato kwivanga mu buzima bwe n’umuryango we. "Ubundi wowe urinde, wa mbwa we. Urashaka abana b’iki? Tumeze neza, tubayeho ubuzima bwiza, ibyiza ni uko wakwita kubikureba kandi ntutume ntangira kugira ibyo nkubwira kuko iyo bigeze ku bana banjye ndarwanda. Rero ceceka urebe ibikureba."

 We n’abana yabyaranye na Diamond bibereyeho neza muri Afurika y’Epfo  Mu minsi ishize Zari yashinje Diamond kutita ku bana babyaranye, aho avuga ko amaze amezi 9 yose atazi amakuru y’abana be. "Hashize amezi 9 tutavuganye. Ntiyigeze abona cyangwa ngo avugishe abana be mu mezi 9 yose ashize. Ibyo avuga ko hashize iminsi mike avugishije abana be ni ukubeshya. Nzi neza ko hashize igihe dutandukanye ni yo mpamvu ngomba gutangaza ukuri." Diamond na Zari batandukanye mu mwaka wa 2018, nyuma y’uko Diamond yari amaze kubyarana na Hamisa Mobeto ndetse anashinjwa guca inyuma bikabije Zari.

 Zari ari muri Afurika yEpfo aho arerera abana be 5 barimo 2 yabyaranye na Diamond n’abandi 3 yabyaranye n’umugabo we wa mbere Ivan Semwanga  
 Muri iyi minsi Diamond ari mu rukundo n’undi mukobwa, Tanasha na we bitegura kubyarana

title: Kigali: Louis Van Gaal, Tony Adams, Ne-Yo na Meddy bazaza Kwita Izina
content: Ibirangirire birimo umuririmbyi w’Umunyamerika Ne-Yo, umukinnyi Tony Adams wakanyujijeho muri Arsenal, umutoza Louis van Gaal, n’umunyarwanda Meddy bazitabira ibirori byo Kwita Izina Abana b’Ingagi biteganyijwe tariki 06 Nzeri. Umuyobozi Ushinzwe ubukerarugendo mu kigo k’Igihugu k’Iterambere (RDB), Belise Kariza yatangaje aya makuru mu kiganiro n’Abanyamakuru gitegura biriya birori Ngarukamwaka bizabera mu Karere ka Musanze. Belise Kariza yavuze ko ibiro byo kwita abana b’ingagi by’uyu mwaka bizagaragaramo udushya twinshi turimo abashyitsi bakomeye barimo abasanzwe ari ibirangirire ku Isi. Umuhanzi w’Umunyamerika uririmba injyana ya R&B azamanukana n’umunyarwanda Ngabo Medard Jobert uzwi nka Meddy baze kwita Ingagi mu birori bizabera mu karere ka Musanze tariki ya 06 Nzeri. Aba bombi bukeye bwaho bazakora igitaramo cyo kizabera mu mujyi wa Kigali cyo kwishimira ibi birori bibumbatiye ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda. Kwinjira mu gitaramo kimwe kizabanziriza umuhango wo Kwita Izina kizwi nka Gala Dinner, abantu 10 bazajya bishyura 2000 USD ku meza, abantu babiri (couple) bishyure ibihumbi 230 Frw, mu gihe umuntu ku giti ke azishyura ibihumbi 137 Frw. Naho igitaramo kizaba nyuma yo kwita Izina ku wa 07 Nzeri, tike ya VVIP ni ibihumbi 50 Frw, VIP ikaba ibihumbi 25 Frw naho ahasigaye hose bikaba 15 000 Frw. Mu birori byo kwita izina kandi hazaba hari abakinnyi n’abahoze baconga ruhago n’abandi bakomeye mu mupira w’amaguru ku isi barimo Louis Van Gaal watozaga Manchester United na Tony Adams wakanyujijeho muri Arsenal. Umunyarwandakazi Sherrie Silver umaze kumenyekana ku isi kubera imibyinire ye, na we azaba ari mu bazita izina umwe mu bana b’ingagi. Abana b’ingagi bateganyijwe kwitwa amazina ni 25 bavutse nyuma y’uko abandi bana biswe umwaka ushize. Inkuru y’Umuseke

title: Shaddy Boo ni nka mushiki wanjye - Diamond
content: Umuhanzi w’icyamamare mu karere Diamond Platnumz yavuze ko Shaddy Boo umukobwa uzwi cyane mu Rwanda byavuzwe hambere ko bakundana atari byo ahubwo ari nka mushiki we. Diamond, ubundi witwa Nasibu Abdul Juma, yanyuze i Kigali kuri uyu wa Gatanu yerekeza i Bujumbura mu Burundi aho yaraye akoreye igitaramo mbere y’uko agaruka i Kigali mu gitaramo gisoza uruhererekane rw’ibitaramo bya Iwacu Muzika Festival. Mu rugendo rwe yahagaze i Kigali agirana ikiganiro n’abanyamakuru bamubajije ibibazo bitandukanye kuri muzika akora no ku buzima bwe busanzwe. Umwaka ushize umugore wamamaye ku mbuga nkoranyambaga mu Rwanda uzwi cyane nka Shaddy Boo yagaragaje amafoto ari kumwe na Diamond bari aho abahanzi bitegurira (back stage), uyu muhanzi atambaye umwambaro hejuru. Shaddy Boo nyuma yahakanye ko akundana n’uyu muhanzi, icyo gihe wari ufite umugore wo muri Uganda nawe uzwi cyane mu myidagaduro witwa Zarinah Hassan "Zari", nyuma bombi baje gutandukana. I Kigali uyu munsi, Diamond yabajijwe iby’umubano we na Shaddy Boo wo mu Rwanda. Yasubije ati: "Ni nka mushiki wanjye, kimwe n’abandi bashiki banjye bo mu Rwanda, namumenye biciye kuri ’manager’ we, yigeze gutumirwa mu birori bimwe hariya iwacu, ni uko muzi gusa". Uyu muhanzi ukunda kwiyita Simba, yavuze ko we n’umugore bakundana ukomoka muri Kenya witwa Tanasha mu kwezi gutaha biteguye kubyara umwana w’umuhungu. Diamond, ubu ukunzwe cyane mu ndirimbo ye igezweho ’Kanyaga’, yavuze ko yubahiriza inshingano ze nk’umubyeyi ku bana afitanye na Zari batandukanye. Ibanga rye Diamond ni umuhanzi wo muri Tanzania umaze imyaka irenga itanu akunzwe cyane muri aka karere. Yabwiye abanyamakuru ko ibanga rye ari ugushyira udushya mubyo akora no kumenya ibyo abantu bashaka. Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 17 Kanama 2019 ni bwo Diamond aza gutaramira abanyarwanda mu Rwanda muri parikingi ya stade Amahoro. Inkuru ya BBC Gahuza

title: Katy Perry yashinjijwe n’umusore yakoresheje mu mashusho y’indirimbo ye ’ihohotera rishingiye ku gitsina’
content:
Umunyamideri Josh Kloss wamenyekanye cyane muri filime y’uruhererekane ya “Newport Beach” no mu mashusho y’indirimbo “Teenage dream” ya Katy Perry, kuri ubu arashinja uyu muhanzikazi w’icyamamare kuba yaramukoreye ihohotera rishingiye ku gitsina. Ibi uyu musore yabihishuye mu ruhererekane rw’ubutumwa burebure yanyujije kuri konti ye ya Instagram  ku wa Mbere w’iki Cyumweru tariki ya 12 Kamena 2019.

Katy Perry na Josh Kloss mu mashusho ya ’Teenage dream’ mu myaka 9 ishize Ni mu gihe hibukagwa imyaka icyenda ishize amashusho y’iyi ndirimbo agiye hanze. Josh Kloss yavuze ko mu ifatwa ry’aya mashusho yahahuriye n’ibihe bibi atazibagirwa kuko uyu muhanzikazi yamubangamiye cyane.

Katy Perry arashinjwa gushyira ku karubanda ubugabo bw’umusore yifashishije muri video Avuga ko ngo yamutumiye mu kabyiniro (strip club) ka Santa Barbara nyuma y’umunsi wa mbere batangiye gukorana, ibyo Josh yemeza ko yari yabyanze kugira ngo aruhuke. Yanahishuye uburyo uyu muhanzikazi yavuze ko yabihiwe cyane no gusomana nawe ubwo bari mu ifatwa ry’aya mashusho abivugira imbere y’abantu bari babakikije. "Yari umwana mwiza. Ariko iyo twabaga dukikijwe n’abantu yahitaga yijima. Yabwiye ikipe yafataga amashusho ko kunsoma byari bibishye. Narabangamiwe ariko nkomeza kwitanga.", Josh Reba hano amashusho ya ’Teenage Dream’ Josh Kloss yavuze ko yakomeje kugenda abonana bya hato na hato na Katy Perry nyuma y’uko yari amaze gutandukana n’uwahoze ari umugabo we Russell Brand (ku ya 30 Ukuboza 2011). Umunsi umwe ngo uyu muririmbyikazi yambuye ubusa uyu musore imbere y’inshuti ze abereka igitsina cye. Ibi yabisobanuye muri aya magambo: "Ubwo twari kubonana, nazanye inshuti yanjye yarotaga kumubona bya nyabyo amaso ku yandi. Wari umunsi mukuru w’amavuko wa Johny Wujek (umunyamideri). Ubwo twabonanaga, twarahoberanye, iteka numvaga umutima wanjye umukunze. Ariko ubwo nagarukaga ngiye kumwereka inshuti yanjye, yamanuye umwenda wanjye w’imbere wa Adidas n’ikariso ku buryo abasha kwereka igitsina cyanjye itsinda ry’inshuti ze z’abagabo bari kumwe n’abandi bose bari badukikije. Ese muribaza uburyo niyumvaga mbangamiwe kandi nteshejwe agaciro?"  You know. After I met Katy, we sang a worship song, “open the eyes of my heart” She was cool and kind. When other people were around she was cold as ice even called the act of kissing me “gross” to the entire set while filming. Now I was pretty embarrassed but kept giving my all, as my ex was busy cheating on me and my daughter was just a toddler, I knew I had to endure for her sake. After the first day of shooting, Katy invited me to a strip club in Santa Barbara. I declined and told her “I have to go back to hotel and rest, because this job is all I have right now” So I saw Katy a couple times after her break up with Russel. This one time I brought a friend who was dying to meet her. It was Johny Wujek’s birthday party at moonlight roller way. And when I saw her, we hugged and she was still my crush. But as I turned to introduce my friend, she pulled my Adidas sweats and underwear out as far as she could to show a couple of her guy friends and the crowd around us, my penis. Can you imagine how pathetic and embarrassed i felt? I just say this now because our culture is set on proving men of power are perverse. But females with power are just as disgusting. So for all her good she is an amazing leader, hers songs are mainly great empowering anthems. And that is it. I continued to watch her use clips of her music videos for her world tour and then her dvd, only highlighting one of her male co-stars, and it was me. I made around 650 in total off of teenage dream. I was lorded over by her reps, about not discussing a single thing about anything regarding Katy publicly. And a couple interviews they edited and answered for me. So, happy anniversary to one of the most confusing, assaulting, and belittling jobs I’ve ever done. Yay #teenagedream I was actually gonna play the song and sing it on ukele for the anniversary, but then as I was tuning I thought, fuck this, I’m not helping her bs image another second. title: Côte d’Ivoire: Umuhanzi w’icyamamare, DJ Arafat yagonzwe n’umunyamakuru arapfa
content:
Abanya- Côte d’Ivoire n’abanyafurika muri rusange cyane cyane abakunzi ba muzika bashenguwe n’inkuru y’akababaro y’urupfu rwa DJ Arafat wari umwe mu bahanzi bakunzwe cyane ndetse wafatwaga nk’umwami w’injyana ya « coupé-décalé ». Ni inkuru yamenyekanye ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 12 Kanama 2019 nyuma yaho uyu muhanzi aguye mu bitaro azize ibikomere by’imbere mu mutwe yagiriye mu mpanuka ubwo yagongwaga ari kuri moto ye mu murwa mukuru Abidjan mu ijoro ryo ku Cyumweru.

Dj Arafat yari akunzwe cyane mu bihugu bikoresha Igifaransa Radiyo na televiziyo by’igihugu cya Côte d’Ivoire (RTI) yatangaje urupfu rw’uyu muhanzi ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa Mbere mu gihe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga hari hakomeje gukwirakwira amakuru ku mpanuka yagize. Iyi mpanuka yabereye mu gace ka Angré gaherereye mu majyaruguru ya Abidjan. Bivugwa ko moto yari atwaye yagonzwe n’imodoka y’uwitwa Denise Delaphafiet, umunyamakurukazi wa Radio Côte d’Ivoire. Uyu musore wari ufite imyaka 33 y’amavuko ngo yahise ava amaraso menshi ndetse anaviramo imbere. Abashinzwe ubutabazi ngo basa nk’abahageze batinze ho gato. Bahise bamujyana mu bitaro bya Polyclinique des Deux-Plateaux (Cocody) ari naho yaje kugwa. Uyu munyamakurukazi nawe wahise agira ihungabana yajyanwe mu bindi bitaro ariko ubu umuryango we uravuga ko arimo koroherwa.

Dj Arafat yari afite umugore n’abana babiri Dj Arafat yari asanzwe akunda cyane moto nini ndetse ubwo yakoraga iyi mpanuka, we n’inshuti ze zo mu itsinda rya Yôrôgang bari barimo  bishimisha bigaragaza kuri moto zabo.
 Tubibutse ko uyu muhanzi yakoze amateka muri Côte d’Ivoire aba umuhanzi wa mbere wagize indirimbo yarebwe n’abagera kuri miliyoni mu gihe cy’umunsi umwe gusa. Iyi ikaba ari indirimbo ye ’Moto moto’. Kanda hano hasi urebe indirimbo ’Moto moto’ yaherukaga gushyira hanze muri Gicurasi Kanda hano hasi urebe indirimbo ’Naughty’ yakoranye na Davido

title: Tekno yatawe muri yombi azira kubyinira mu ruhame n’abakobwa bambaye ubusa (Video)
content:
Umuhanzi w’umunya-Nigeria, Tekno yatawe muri yombi kubera amashusho amugaragaza abyinana n’abakobwa bambaye ubusa mu ikamyo mu murwa mukuru w’ubucuruzi wa Nigeria, Lagos. Iyi kamyo yari ifite ibirahure bibonerana kugira ngo abantu bari hanze babashe kubona ababyiniragamo imbere. Polisi yo muri iki gihugu yahamije ko yataye muri yombi uyu muhanzi w’imyaka 26 ukunzwe cyane muri Afurika aho yavuze ko yamutaye muri yombi ku wa Kabiri w’iki cyumweru "kubera gutwara abakobwa bambaye hafi ubusa" mu gace ka Lekki i Lagos. 

Bagendaga babyina bari mu ikamyo ifite ibirahure bibonerana Umuvugizi wa Polisi yongeyeho ko abandi bakobwa babiri bari kumwe n’uyu muhanzi nabo batawe muri yombi. Tekno ubusanzwe witwa Augustine Kelechi, uyu akaba ari n’umwe mu bahanzi bakoranye na Beyonce kuri album ye iheruka, yatunguye abantu benshi mu cyumweru gishize ubwo yari ari mu gisa nko kwamamaza akabyiniro k’abamansuzi cyangwa se abagore babyina bambaye ubusa hafi buri buri (strip-tease). Abagenzi bari mu muhanda baheze mu bwinshi bw’imodoka ’embouteillages’ batunguwe no kubona uyu muhanzi n’aba babyinnyi b’abakobwa babyina aho bari mu gasanduku k’ibirahure bibonerana kari kashyizwe muri iyo kamyo. Mu mashusho yakwirakwijwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga Tekno agaragara anyanyagiza amafaranga kuri aba bakobwa mu gihe barimo babyina. Reba hano hasi amwe mu mashusho yafashwe Tekno ari kubyinana n’aba bakobwa Nyuma yaho abaturage banenze ibyo uyu muhanzi yakoze ndetse n’ikigo cya leta gishinzwe kugenzura ibikorwa byo kwamamaza kigahagarika aka kabyiniro kavugagwa ko kari inyuma y’iki gikorwa, Tekno yahise asaba imbabazi yisegura ku byabaye ariko ahakana ko ntaho bihuriye no kwamamaza akabyiniro k’abamansuzi. Yagize ati "Twarimo dufata amashusho y’indirimbo, ariko twari twabuze imodoka yo gutwara abantu ahagombaga kubera iki gikorwa." Polisi yavuze ko "ibi bikorwa by’urukozasoni byo mu ruhame" binyuranije n’amategeko ahana y’iki gihugu, ndetse umuvugizi yongeraho ko Tekno n’abo bafatanywe bashobora kugezwa imbere y’urukiko nyuma y’iperereza.

title: Meghan Markle: Ku isabukuru ye, ab’ibwami bamwifurije isakukuru nziza, umugabo we arushaho
content:

title: Sonia Rolland yifotoje yambaye ubusa buriburi, anasobanura impamvu adahisha ubwambure bwe (AMAFOTO)
content:
Uyu munyarwandakazi wabaye nyampinga w’u Bufaransa mu mwaka wa 2000, yakunze kujya ashyira ahagaragara amafoto ye adahishe ubwambure bwe, ibitarashimwe na benshi, ariko ntibimubuze gukomeza kubikora kenshi. Kuri iyi nshuro, Sonia yifotoje bwa mbere yambaye ubusa buriburi anaboneraho gusobanura impamvu akunze kwifotoza agaragaza ibice bitandukanye ubundi biba ari iby’ibanga ku mugore. Ni mu kiganiro yagiranye n’ikinyamakuru Gala, nyuma y’uko yemeye kwifotoza ifoto yambaye ubusa buriburi ku nshuro ya mbere, dore ko ubusanzwe aba yambaye igice gito cy’umubiri we. 

 Ni ubwa mbere Sonia yifotoje nta mwenda numwe yambaye  Yabanje kubazwa uko yumva ubwambure bwe, maze arasubiza ati "Ubu numva nyuzwe n’ubwambure bwanjye uyu munsi kurusha uko byari bimeze ku myaka yanjye 20. Nagiraga isoni cyane, kandi ngatinya ko abagabo bandeba. Ubwo nabaga Nyampinga w’u Bufaransa, ubyemere cyangwa ubihakane, gutambuka mu myambaro yo kogana (bikini) byarangoye bikomeye. Ibihe byarahise, ndakundwa, ndabyara, byose birahinduka." Yavuze ko yemera ko umubiri we atari mwiza 100% ariko kandi ko yise kwikunda uko ari. Ati "Nakiriye inkovu zaho nabazwe mbyara, ko amabere yanjye atakiri nka mbere ndetse n’izo nkovu ntizikiri nkambere, mbere nakiriye ko ntatunganye ku mubiri. Njye nkoresha uko nshoboye ngo ngaragare neza ariko nemera ibitameze neza kuri njye. Rero nita ku mubiri wanjye hanyuma nkawerekana mu gihe nkibishoboye."

 Ati "Nakomeza kwerekana umubiri wanjye mu gihe nkibishoboye  Sonia afite imyaka 38 y’amavuko akaba afite abana 2 b’abakobwa, Tess w’imyaka 11 na Kahima w’imyaka 9 akaba nyuma yo kuba nyampinga w’u Bufaransa muri 2000 yarinjiye mu mwiga wo gukora, gutunganya no gukina filime.

title: John Legend yise Trump ’umwanda’ amusabira kweguzwa
content:

title: Ifoto yafotorewe muri Tanzaniya yegukanye igihembo cy’ifoto y’umwaka ya iPhone
content:
Kuva ubwoko bwa telefone zigezweho (smartphone) bwa iPhone bwajya hanze mu 2007, buri mwaka amafoto meza yafotowe n’izi telefone z’uruganda rwa Apple, agenerwa ibihembo byiswe ’iPhone Photography Awards’. Kuri iyi nshuro nabwo hatangajwe ifoto yahize iyindi mu zafotowe na iPhone muri uyu mwaka aho Apple yari ifite ba gafotozi 140 bo mu bice bitandukanye by’isi bagabanyijwe mu byiciro 19. Igihembo nyamukuru cyegukanywe n’ifoto yafashwe na iPhone X muri Tanzaniya ifotowe n’Umutaliyanikazi Gabriella Cigliano ku ifoto ye “Big Sister”.

Ifoto yafatiwe i Zanzbar muri Tanzaniya Diogo Lage yahembwe nk’Umufotozi w’umwaka kubera ifoto ye “Sea Stripes” yafashwe na iPhone SE. 

Iyi foto ya Diogo Lage yafatiwe muri Portugal kuri Santa Rita Beach Umwanya wa kabiri wegukanywe na Yuliya Ibraeva kubera ifoto ye “Sorry, no movie today” yafashwe na iPhone 7 Plus, naho umwanya wa gatatu wegukanywe na Peng Hao ku bw’ifoto ye “Come Across” yafotowe na iPhone X.

Iyi yafotowe n’Umurusiya Yuliya Ibraeva, i Roma mu Butaliyani aho yari ari mu biruhuko mu mpeshyi, aha biteguraga kureba filime ariko hahita hagwa imvura itunguranye ntibabasha kureba filime ariko we atahana ifoto avuga ko yishimiye cyane

Iyi yafashwe n’umushinwa Peng Hao, ifatirwa mu butayu bwa Navada muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika Uretse izi foto, hari harimo n’ibindi byiciro bitandukanye harimo nk’ifoto z’inyamaswa, iz’urugendo, iz’abana, ibiti, izuba, abantu, ibidukikije n’ibindi byinshi.

title: Afurika y’Epfo: Umuhanzi Johnny Clegg bitaga ’Umuzulu w’umuzungu’ yapfuye -Amwe mu mateka ye
content:
Umuhanzi wari warubatse ibigwi bikomeye muri Afurika y’Epfo, Johnny Clegg wahuzaga injyana z’umuziki w’ikizulu n’ibicurangisho bya kizungu ndetse akaba umwe mu bifashishije ubuhanzi mu kurwanya politike y’ivangura-ruhu (apartheid), yatabarutse kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 16 Nyakanga 2019. Ni amakuru yemejwe n’uwari uhagarariye inyungu ze (manager) wavuze ko yashizemo umwuka nyuma y’igihe kinini ahanganye n’indwara ya kanseri. Kanda hano hasi wumve indirimbo ye "Asimbonanga" yamamaye cyane Johnny Clegg yavukiye mu Bwongereza ariko akurira mu gace ka Kwa Zulu Natal ndetse akaba yaravugaga akanaririmba mu Kizulu. Yacuranze mu matsinda agizwe n’abafite impu zitandukanye (multiraciaux) ya Juluka na Savua mu myaka ya 1970 na 1980 mbere y’uko atangira kuririmba ku giti cye (solo).

Johnny Clegg yapfuye afite imyaka 66 y’amavuko kuko yavutse ku ya 7 Kamena 1953 Johnny Clegg yakundwaga kubera umuziki we. Ariko muri Afurika y’Epfo uyu mugabo yari afite icyo asobanuye kinini kirenze gusa kuba umuhanzi. Ni umugabo w’umuzungu warenze ku mategeko agacurangana n’abirabura mu gihe cya Apartheid aho byari bibujijwe. Ni umugabo w’umuzungu wize kuvuga no kuririmba Ikizulu. Yari ikimenyetso cy’ubumwe, umunyafurika, ikiraro hagati y’imico itandukanye mu gihugu nka Afurika y’Epfo kigihangana no kurenga amateka y’ivangura cyanyuzemo.

Johnny Clegg n’ababyinnyi ba Savuka ubwo bataramiraga Zénith de Paris ku ya 10 Gicurasi 1988, mu bitaramo byo kurwanya Aparthaid Umuziki we wagize uruhare runini mu kunga abanyafurika y’epfo mu gihe guverinoma ya Apartheid yategekaga abaturage ko bagomba kwivangura bashingiye ku ibara ry’uruhu ryabo maze abazungu akaba aribo bashyirwa imbere naho abirabura bagatsikamirwa. Clegg n’umuziki we byabaye ihurizo rikomeye kuri guverinoma y’agatsiko gato k’abazungu yayoboraga Afurika y’Epfo, aho yagaragazaga ko Apartheid ari amahitamo ya politike ariko uwo mupaka ukaba ushobora kurengwa n’abaturage.

Ku myaka 17 yatangiye kuririmbana n’abirabura mu gihe abazungu basabwaga kutagira aho bahurira n’abirabura Ubushake bukomeye yagaragaje mu kurwanya Apartheid byatumye akundwa cyane n’abirabura bo muri Afurika y’Epfo ndetse ahinduka ikimenyetso cya Afurika y’Epfo igendera kuri demokarasi, ndetse uyu muhanzi ni umwe mu batoranijwe mu birori byo kwibuka Nelson Mandela mu 2013. "Johnny yaruhukiye mu mahoro uyu munsi (ku wa Kabiri), yari akikijwe n’umuryango we i Johannesburg (...), nyuma y’imyaka ine n’igice yari ishize ahangana na kanseri. (…) Yagize uruhare rukomeye muri Afurika y’Epfo agaragariza abantu imico itandukanye ndetse abashyira hamwe (…) Yatweretse icyo bisobanuye guha agaciro indi mico ariko adatakaje ibimuranga.", ibyatangajwe n’uwari umujyanama we Roddy Quin kuri shene ya televiziyo ya SABC.

Ibinyamakuru bitandukanye byagiye byandika ku mateka adasanzwe ye Johnny Clegg yavomye mu muco wa kizulu inganzo ye yamufashije gukora umuziki w’impinduramatwara  aho ijyana nyafurika ihuzwa n’imirya ya gitari n’ibindi bicurangisho bya kizungu. Alubumu ye "Scatterlings of Africa" yo mu 1982 yatumye amenyekana cyane ndetse ikundwa muri hit-parades mu Bwongereza no mu Bufaransa. Imwe mu ndirimbo ye yamamaye cyane ku isi hose ni "Asimbonanga" (ijambo ry’ikizulu, bisobanuye ntabwo twamubonye) yahimbiye Nelson Mandela ufatwa nk’uri ku isonga mu ntwari zarwanyije apartheid. Kanda hano urebe ubwo yaririmbaga "Asimbonanga" agasanganirwa ku rubyiniro na Nelson Mandela mu 1999 mu Budage Uyu muhanzi akanaba umubyinnyi wahitanywe na kanseri y’impindura (pancréas) yari aherutse gukora ibitaramo mu bice bitandukanye by’isi asezera ku bafana be cyane cyane aho yari akunzwe mu Burayi.

title: Kigali: Hateguwe amarushanwa yo kubyina agamije gufasha abanyeshuri baje mu biruhuko
content:
’250 Youth’ ni ihuriro ry’urubyiruko rwishyize hamwe mu rwego rwo kuzamura impano za bagenzi babo aho basanzwe bategura amarushanwa ahuriza hamwe urubyiruko rufite impano, ibikorwa bategura kenshi mu biruhuko. Kuri ubu ’250 Youth’ ikaba yongeye gutegurira urubyiruko ruje mu biruhuko amarushanwa yo kubyina agamije kubahuriza hamwe bakagaragaza impano aho kujya mu bindi bishuko byakwangiza ubuzima bwabo.

Abafite impano zo kubyina barahamagarirwa kudacikwa Nkuko abari gutegura aya marushanwa babidutangarije, ngo amatsinda yishyize hamwe ndetse abishaka azajya anyura ku rubuga rw’iyi kompanyi rwa 250youth.rw akiyandikisha naho amarushanwa nyirizina yo akazabera kuri Club Rafiki i Nyamirambo ahasanzwe habera imikino itandukanye y’imyidagaduro. Muri aya marushanwa ateganijwe gutangira tariki ya 2 Kanama 2019 aho abarushanwa bazatoranywamo abazagera finali mu biruhuko bikuru. 

Uko ubigenza ngo wiyandikishe Abazatsinda aya marushanwa bazegukana  amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi magana atanu (500,000frw) ku itsinda rya mbere, ibihumbi 400frw ku itsinda rya kabiri n’ibihumbi 200frw ku itsinda rya gatatu. Mu kiganiro n’umwe mu bari gutegura aya marushanwa yabwiye Kigalipost ko ’ikigamijwe ari uguhuriza hamwe urubyiruko rufite impano rukaba hamwe mu biruhuko rukagira icyo ruhugiraho aho kwishora mu biyobyabwenge cyangwa ibindi byakwangiza ubuzima bwabo!’ 

Nubwo abategura iri rushanwa bifashishije Kigali Convention Centre nk’akarango ka Kigali mu kwamamaza, biteganijwe ko bizabera i Nyamirambo kuri Club Rafiki

title: James Bond: ’Agent 007’ azaba ari umugore w’umwirabura
content:
Byaragoranye cyane kumva ko filime James Bond yakinwa n’umwirabura, ariko kuri iyi nshuro uretse kuba ari umwirabura ahubwo ni n’umugore. Lashana Lynch ni we uzakira ari ’Agent 007’ muri James Bond nshya. Hagitangira kuvugwa ibya filime nshya ya James Bond n’isezera rya Daniel Craig, agiye gusimburwa aho umwongereza Idris Elba ari we wahabwaga amahirwe yo gukina muri iyo filime ariko aza gucibwa intege n’uburyo abantu batabyakiriye neza ndetse ntibatinye kumugaragariza ivanguraruhu, bahamya ko nta mwirabura ushobora gukina ari ’Agent 007’. Kuri ubu rero, Lashana wamenyekanye cyane nka Maria Rambeau muri filime ya ’Captain Marvel’ ni we ugiye gusimbura Daniel Craig, ndetse ubu filime yatangiye gukorwa ikazajya hanze mu mwaka utaha wa 2020. Azagaragara mu mwambaro ndetse na nimero 007 ubusanzwe byari bifitwe n’abagabo gusa kandi nabo b’abazungu.

 Lashana ni we ugiye kuba Agent 007  "Mu ntangiriro za filime, hari aho M, azaba 007 kwinjira. Niho Lashana ahita agaragara, umugore, mwiza w’umwiraburakazi... Bond aracyari Bond. Gusa nka 007 yasimbujwe umugore udasanzwe." Umwe mu bagize ikipe itunganya iyi filime waganiriye na DailyMail. Lashana Lynch w’imyaka 31 y’amavuko abaye 007 wa 9 nyuma ya Barry Nelson, Sean Connery, David Niven, George Lazenby, Roger Moore, Timothy Dalton, Pierce Brosnan na Daniel Craig bose bari abagabo b’abazungu. Agiye gukina James Bond ya 25, izaba yitwa Bond 25.
