title: Amerika: Rutamu Elie Joe yashyize hanze amafoto y’ubukwe bwe
content:
Mu mpera z’icyumweru gishize ni bwo Rutamu Elie Joe wamamaye cyane mu Rwanda mu kogeza imipira, yarushinganye n’umukunzi we Nyinawabeza Rebecca, ubukwe bw’agatangaza bwabereye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika aho aba bombi basanzwe batuye. Benshi mu bakunzi b’uyu mugabo wabaye ikimenyabose kubera ubuhanga n’uturingoshyo yagiraga mu kogeza umupira cyane cyane y’i Burayi, batunguwe n’ifoto imwe rukumbi yasakaye ku mbuga nkoranyambaga igaragaza ko yarushinze. Gusa cyera kabaye Rutamu n’umukunzi we basohoye amafoto agera ku 10 agaragaza ishusho y’uko ibi birori byabo byagenze ku buryo n’abashidikanyaga bahise bemera ko koko ubu bukwe bwabaye.

Rutamu na Rebecca bamaze kuba umugabo n’umugore 

Basezeranye imbere y’Imana

Inshuti n’abavandimwe bari baje kubashyigikira


Byari ibyishimo bikomeye nyuma yo guhamya isezerano ryabo Imbere y’Imana


Byari ibirori binogeye ijisho



Aya mafoto ni yo Rutamu yasangije abamukurikira ku mbuga ze nkoranyambaga Hagati mu kwezi kwa Mata 2019 ni bwo yasangije abamukurikira ku mbuga nkoranyamba, ifoto ari kumwe n’uyu mukunzi we bari muri resitora, umukobwa yambaye impeta y’urukundo (Bagues de Fiançailles). Yayikurikije ubutumwa bugaragiwe n’imitima bugira buti "Nakweguriye umutima wanjye wose kuva ku munsi wa mbere twahuye. Ndagukunda"

Ifoto ya mbere Rutamu yashyize hanze muri Mata agaragaza ko ari mu rukundo Umwe mu nshuti ye waganiriye na Kigali Post nyuma yo gushyira hanze iyi foto, yagize ati "Kuva namenya Rutamu ni ubwa mbere agaragaje umukobwa bakundana, ubundi ntiyigeze akunda gukururana n’inkumi bimwe bya gisore. Kuba yagaragaje uriya nta kabuza nuko bafite gahunda ihamye mu rukundo rwabo." Rutamu Elie Joe yavuye mu Rwanda mu 2018 ahita yerekeza muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Hari nyuma gato y’igikombe cy’isi cyabereye mu Burusiya kikegukanwa n’Ubufaransa. Rutamu yari yarahaye intego abakunzi be ko Argentine ya Lionel Messi niramuka idatwaye iki gikombe azahita asezera itangazamakuru agashaka ibindi ajya gukora. Ubu bivugwa ko yaba yiga ibijyanye no guhagararira inyungu z’abakinnyi no kubagurisha.

Rutamu Elie Joe yamamaye kuri Radio Flash FM, Radio 10, Radio Rwanda na Radio One

title: R. Kelly yongeye gufungwa azira gukinisha abana filimi z’imibonano mpuzabitsina
content:
R Kelly yongeye gufungwa kuri uyu wa Kane ashinjwa gukoresha abana filime z’imibonano mpuzabitsina n’ibindi birego bitandukanye. Kelly yatawe muri yombi ashinjwa ibirego 13, harimo gukinisha abana filime z’imibonano mpuzabitsina, kureshya abana ndetse no kubangamira ubutabera, nk’uko byatangajwe na Joseph D. Fitzpatrick ukora mu biro by’ubushinjacyaha bya Illinois, ubwo yaganiraga na New York Times.

 Arashinjwa ibyaha 13  R Kelly yatawe muri yombi na polisi ya New York ndetse n’inzego za gisirikare. Mu myaka ishize Kelly yagiye ashinjwa cyane ibyaha bijyanye n’ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina, birimo gukinisha abakiri bato filime z’imibonano mpuzabitsina, gusambanya abakiri bato n’ibindi.

title: Wema Sepetu yakuye muri gereza indwara yayobeye abaganga
content:
Wema Sepetu, Nyampinga wa Tanzania wa 2006, umukinnyi wa filime akaba no ku rutonde rw’abakundanye na Diamond, aravuga uburyo nyuma y’icyumweru muri gereza yahavanye indwara yayobeye abaganga. Ubwo yaganiraga n’itangazamakuru yavuze ko muri gereza hari ubuzima bubi ndetse ko n’ubuzima bwe bwahatikiriye kuva yafungwa. Ati "Haba imibu myinshi cyane. Bansuzumye malariya bafata n’ibipimo by’inkari n’ibindi byinshi ariko uburwayi ntiburamwnyekana. Muganga wanjye yambwiye ko tugomba gukoresha ibindi bizamini kugira ngo abashe kumenya uko bimeze."

 Nubu muganga ntaramenya icyo arwaye  Wema kandi yakomeje avuga ko muganga yamusabye ko yakwisuzumisha indi ndwara iterwa no kurumwa n’umubu yitwa ’Dengue’, mu gihe yumvise akomeje kumererwa nabi. Abajijwe niba ubu burwayi yaba yabukuye muri gereza koko cyangwa ko ashobora kuba yarabwanduye mbere y’uko afungwa, ibyo yamaganiye kure. Ati "Oya, ubwo najyaga muri gereza nari  maze igihe kinini cyane narakize neza. Ibibazo byavukiye muri gereza. Ndetse ndi muri gereza nariwe cyane mu nda n’umutwe ndetse nshika n’intege cyane mu mubiri. Sinari merewe neza."

 Yafashwe n’ubu burwayi ari muri gereza  Wema yarekuwe nyuma yo kwishyura amafaranga nsimburagifungo (caution/bail), urubanza rwe rukaba ruzasomwa kuri uyu wa Kane, tariki ya 4 Nyakanga, 2019. Akaba yarihanangirijwe kutazasiba isomwa ryarwo kuko bishobora kumugiraho ingaruka zikomeye.

title: Umupira Princess Diana yakoranaga siporo uragurishwa asaga miliyoni 5
content:
Umupira nyakwigendera Princess Diana, wari umukazana w’umwamikazi w’Ubwongereza, yambaraga akora imyitozo ngororamubiri, wamaze gushyirwa ku isoko. Ni umupira, Princess Diana yahawemo impano n’uwashinze ikigo cy’ingendo zo mu ndege Richard Branson. Akaba yarawambaraga buri gihe ubwo yabaga agiye gukora imyitozo mu rwego rwo kwihisha itangazamakuru.

 Princess Diana yari umugore wa Prince Charles, imfura y’umwamikazi Elizabeth II  Jenni Rivett, wari umutoza wihariye wa Diana ni we urimo kugurisha uyu mupira, yahawe na Diana mbere y’urupfu rwe muri 1997. Azawugurisha kuri murandasi akaba ahamya ko uzagurwa amadorari asaga ibihumbi 5. Mu ibaruwa iherekeje uyu mupira Rivett yanditse ko Diana yatekerezaga ko hari ibibazo byinshi iyi si ifite, bityo ko kwambara umwenda umwe buri gihe aje mu myitozo byari uburyo bwiza bwo kwirinda gukurikiranwa n’itangazamakuru



 Ni umupira yambaraga buri gihe agiye muri siporo

title: Taylor Swift arashinja Big Machine kumwiba album 6. Justin Bieber n’abandi babyinjiyemo
content:
Taylor Swift mu ntambara ikomeye n’inzu y’umuziki yakoreragamo nyuma y’uko igizwe n’umugabo atishimira na gato ndetse agahamya ko azamubuza amahirwe yo kugira uruhare ku muziki yakoreye hafi ubuzima bwe bwose. Inzu y’umuziki ya Big Machine, Taylor Swift yakoreragamo, yaguzwe na Scooter Braun, ibitashimishije na gato uyu muririmbyikazi, dore ko ahamya ko atajya imbizi n’uyu mugabo ufite izina rikomeye mu muziki dore ko areberera inyungu z’abahanzi bakomeye nka Justin Bieber, Demi Lovato na Kanye West.

 Taylor Swift ntiyishimiye na gato ko Big Machine yaguze na Scooter  Uku kutishimira iri gurwa rya Big Machine kwa Taylor Swift, gushingiye ku kuba kuva Scooter yaguze iyi nzu bisobanuye ko afite uruhare kuri album 6 zose uyu muhanzikazi yakoreyemo hagati y’umwaka wa 2006 na 2017, mbere y’uko ayivuyemo akajya muri Universal Records muri 2018. Taylor ahamya ko kuba ataragiranye ibihe byiza  na Scooter mu bihe byashize, bizatuma atabasha kugira uruhare ku muziki yakoze ubuzima bwe bwose. Yanditse ati "Umuziki nanditse nicaye hasi mu cyumba cyanjye na video narose nkanazishyura amafaranga nakoreye nshuranga mu tubari, utunyiniro, sitade n’ahandi(…) Ubu Scooter yanyibye umurimo w’ubuzima bwanjye bwose(…) Ubu umurage wa muzika yanjye uri mu biganza by’umuntu washatse kunsenya. Ibi nibyo biba iyo usinye imyaka 15." Taylor kandi ahamya ko yagerageje kugura umuziki we nyuma yo kuhava ariko ntibamwemerere. Kuri iyi ngingo Scott Borchetta, washinze Big Machine yavuze ko yamenyesheje Taylor ko agiye kugurisha iyi nzu ko rwose yari afite igihe cyo kuba yagura umuziki we ariko akaba atarabikoze.

 Borchetta ahamya ko Taylor yagize umwanya uhagije wo kuba yagura umuziki we  Nyuma y’ubu butumwa bamwe mu bahanzi bafashwa na Scooter barimo Justin na Demi bagize icyo bavuga kuri ubu butumwa bwa Swift aho bose bavuga ko uyu muhanzikazi akabya iyo avuga ku ububi bwa Scooter kuko bo bakorana na we bazi ko atari umuntu mubi. Mu butumwa burebure Justin Bieber yanditse kuri Instagram yamunenze cyane gucisha ubutumwa bwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, avuga ko ibyo byose atabikorera ko ababaye ahubwo ko ashaka gusenya Scooter. Nyuma yamugiriye inama ko ibyiza ari uko yakwicarana na we bakaganira ku bibazo byabo n’ibindi byiyumviro bitandukanye yaba yifitemo.

 Bieber ntashyigikiye Taylor Swift  Ati "(…) Sibyo rwose gukoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga ugira ngo abantu bange Scooter. Washakaga kugera kuki wandika biriya ku rubuga? Birasa naho washakaga ko abantu bakugirira impuhwe, wari ubizi kandi ko nubyandika abafana bazahita bibasira Scooter. Icyo nzi nuko njye na Scooter tugukunda. Ndumva uburyo bwiza bwo gukemura ibyo bibazo ari ibiganiro. (…) Ndahamya neza ko njye na Scooter tuzishimira kuganira nawe tukagerageza gukemura ibibazo byose.(…)"

title: Will Smith, Agelina na Brad Pitt,… Abana babo ni abatinganyi (AMAFOTO)

 Uyu mukobwa wa Will na Jada Pinkett Smith yatangaje ko ari umutinganyi utavangura, kuko ashobora gukundana n’abahungu kimwe n’uko yanakundana n’abakobwa. Ahamya kandi ko kubagira icyarimwe aribyo byiza kurushaho. Jaden Smith

 Umuhungu wa Will na Jada Pinkett Smith na we, mu mwaka ushize wa 2018 yatangaje ko kuri we ntaho yibona haba mu bahungu cyangwa abakobwa. Ngo kuri we icy’ingenzi ni urukundo. Mu minsi yashize yanahamije ko ari mu rukundo n’umuraperi Tyler The Creator. Sam Greisman

 Umuhungu w’umukinnyi wa filime, Sally Field na we yamaze gutangaza ko ari umutinganyi wikundira abahungu gusa, ndetse na nyina aramushyigikiye ndetse ntasiba kumuhuza n’abandi basore b’abatinganyi b’ibyamamare. Shiloh/John Jolie Pitt

 Umukobwa wa Angelina Jolie na Brad Pitt ngo yamaze kujya ku ruhande rw’abagabo, dore ko ngo muri we yiyumva nk’umuhungu, yambara imyenda y’abahungu, akina umupira w’amaguru ndetse akaba yaramaze igihe kinini yingingira abantu kumuhamagara John aho kumuhamagara Shiloh. Nubwo benshi mu bamuzengurutse n’inshuti z’umuryango batishimiye na gato icyemezo cye, Angelina Jolie na Brad Pitt bo bahamya ko bazakomeza kumushyigikira mu byemezo byose azafata. Paris Jackson

 Uyu mukobwa wa nyakwigendera Michael Jackson, yatangaje ko ari umutinganyi mu mwaka wa 2018. Na we avuga ko ari imvange, ko kuri we kwitwa umuhungu cyangwa umukobwa ntacyo biba bimubwiye ku wo akunda. Jason Gould

 Umuhungu w’umuririmbyikazi ukomeye Barbra Streisand na we ni umutinganyi, akaba yarabitangaje mu mwaka wa 1990. Ni igihe cyari kigoye ku batinganyi ariko nyina yaje kwiga cyane ku bijyanye n’iyi ngingo kugira ngo abashe kumuba hafi uko bikwiye.

title: Pamela Anderson yahishuye amabaruwa ye n’uwari umugore wa Adil Rami
content:
Muri iki cyumweru nibwo Pamela Anderson yatangaje ko yatandukanye ku mugaragaro na Adil Rami, anamushinja ko yamucaga inyuma ndetse akanamukubita Uyu mukinnyi w’ikipe ya Marseille ndetse n’ikipe y’igihugu y’Ubufaransa we wahamya ko atigeze amuca inyuma ahubwo ko yakomeje kugirana umubano na nyina w’abana be, ibi bikaba byatumye Pamela ashyira hanze ibiganiro yagiranye na Sidonie Biémont wahoze ari umugore wa Adil.

 Adil ahamya ko yakomeje kuvugana na Sidonie nka nyina w’abana be  Adil na Sedonie batandukanye mu mwaka wa 2017 ariko uyu mugore bafitanye abana babiri ahamya ko atari uko byagenze. Mu burumwa bandikiranye, yabwiye Pamela ati "Twakomeje kujya tubonana ndi nk’inshoreke ye, akabigira ibanga rikomeye ahamya ko bizarangira vuba. Nyuma twaje kubihagarika burundu mu ntangiriro za 2019, kuko numvaga ko nkwiriye kubaho neza, atari ukubana n’umuntu mu bwihisho kandi amfata nabi." Sidonie ahamya ko Adil yaramuhamirije ko atabana na Pamela, undi aramusibiza ati "Ngusabye imbabazi pe. Mbana na Adil kuva mu myaka 2 ishize. Sinigeze mbona umugabo umeze nka we. Kubaho ubuzima bwinshi. Ndatunguwe. Ndababaye kubwawe n’abahungu bawe. Ngiye gutandukana na we. Kuri iyi nshuro ndarambiwe. Biratangaje cyane. Nagerageje kugenda inshuro icumi, ariko buri gihe akansanga akanyingingira kugaruka."

 Ngo Pamela yari amaze kurambirwa guhora asabwa imbabazi na Rami  Pamela na Adil babanaga mu nzu uyu mugore yaguze muri Gicurasi, 2017 ubwo batangiraga kubana.  Ahamya ko igihe cyose babanaga cyabaye nk’igifungo kuko ngo uyu mugabo yamuciye ku nshuti ze kuko ngo atashoboraga kunywa batari kumwe, ikindi kandi ngo uyu mugabo we akaba yarakomeje kugenda atereta abandi bakobwa kuri Instagram. Sidonie yaramubwiye ati "Mushiki we yampamagaye uyu munsi. Bambwira ko uri ikirumirahai. Njye ntekereza ko uri umuntu mwiza kandi utaryarya. Ntabwo nzongera kubonana na we, sinzongera no kumuvugisha n’ubwo byaba ari ukubera abana. Ni umuntu mubi. Kandi rwose ndabizi ko hari abandi bakobwa. Wowe wari uzwi na bose naho njye nkaba inshoreke ye izwi na bose." Nyuma yaho, Sidonie yashimiye cyane Pamela kubw’amagambo meza yamubwiye ati "Mbabajwe nawe. Ndagushimira ko wamvugishije kandi ukaba wambereye umwana mwiza utekereza ku bana bacu. Byibura hano hari umuntu utekereza nk’abakuze. Uri umuntu mwiza rwose, imbere n’inyuma."

 Nyina yamubwiye ko ari uburenganzira bwe  Uyu mukobwa wa Will Smith yakomeje gutungurana mu kiganiro ahita yerura ko akunda abahungu n’abakobwa, ati"Njye nkunda abagabo kimwe n’uko nkunda abagore, rero ntekereza ko nakwishimira kugira umukunzi w’umuhungu n’uw’umukobwa. title: Miss Tanja Dexters wabaye nyampinga w’Ububiligi yatawe muri yombi mu mukwabo w’abacuruza ibiyobyabwenge
content:
Mu mukwabo wo gufatira mu cyuho abacuruzi b’ibiyobyabwenge wabereye mu majyaruguru y’Ububiligi mu gace ka Herentals mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Kabiri, polisi yo muri aka gace yataye muri yombi abantu batanu harimo na Tanja Dexters wabaye Nyampinga w’Ububiligi mu 1998. Nkuko parike ya Anvers yabitangaje ngo mu mikwabo irindwi yabaye hafashwe abantu batanu barimo n’uyu mugore Tanja Dexters usanzwe anazwi nk’umunyamideri, umuririmbyikazi n’umunyamakuru wa televiziyo, akaba yarafatanywe n’umugabo we nkuko ikinyamakuru Belga cyabitangaje.

Tanja Dexters yambitswe ikamba rya Nyampinga w’Ububiligi mu 1998 Abapolisi bagera kuri 40 hamwe n’imbwa eshanu zihumurirwa n’ibiyobyabwenge nibo bari muri uyu mukwabo wo gusaka ibiyobyabwenge. Ntabwo byatangajwe niba haba hari ibiyobyabwenge byafashwe gusa parike yavuze ko hafashwe imodoka eshatu.

Tanja Dexters ngo ni n’umuririmbyikazi Aya makuru akomeza avuga ko hasatswe amashami y’imodoka zo mu bwoko bwa Kia, Daf na Jaguar. Ubugenzacyaha ntibwatanze imyirondoro y’abantu bose bafashwe, ariko bwatangaje ko bazitaba bakiregura ndetse bagashyikirizwa umushinjacyaha.

title: Justin Bieber na Tom Cruise baba bagiye kurwanira muri ’octagon’
content:
Justin Bieber na Tom Cruise bashobora kuba bagiye kumvana imitsi mu rugamba rwo guhigana ubutwari rwashojwe n’umuririmbyi Justin asaba uyu mukinnyi wa filime w’icyamamare i Hollywood ko barwana. N’ubwo byatangiye bimeze nk’ibidashoboka, kuri ubu umuyobozi wa UFC (Ultimate Fighting Championship), itegura imikino njyarugamba ivanze ibera mu kibuga cy’imirwano cyizwi nka ’octagon’, akaba yiteguye gutegura iki gikorwa.

Sosiyete z’imikino y’amahirwe zatangiye kubaza niba uyu mukino uzaba hagati ya Justin Bieber na Tom Cruise Mu ntangiriro z’ukwezi kwa Kamena nibwo, abicishije kuri Twitter, Justin Bieber yasabye Tom Cruise ko yaza bakarwana, anasaba umuyobozi wa UFC, Dana White ko yabafasha gutegura iki gikorwa.

Justin Bieber na Tom Cruise batangiye kugereranywa mu gushyushya umukino wabo Ubutumwa bwe bwabanje gufatwa nk’urwenya ariko ubu abakurikiranira hafi baremeza ko uyu mukino waba watangiye gutegurwa kuko impande zombi ziteguye. Ubutumwa bwa Justin Bieber bwaragiraga buti "Ndashaka guhangana na Tom Cruise muri octogone (ikibuga cyabugenewe abakina imikino njyarugamba bahuriramo). Tom nutemera iyi ntambara biraba bisobanuye ko uri umunyabwoba kandi ntuzabasha kubyikuramo. Ninde witeguye gutegura iki gikorwa? Dana White?"

Ubutumwa bwa Justin Bieber kuri konti ye ya Twitter Dana White we avuga ko ntacyamubuza gutegura iki gikorwa mu gihe aba bagabo bombi baba biteguye kubikora. Mu kiganiro yahaye TMZ yagize ati "Barashaka rwose kurwana, na Tom Cruise ubwe ariteguye. Njye nababwiye ko niba koko babishaka kandi abo bireba bose bakaba biteguye, rwose dushobora kubivugana. Naba ndi ikigoryi ndamutse nanze gutegura uru rugamba!"

Justin Bieber asanzwe ari inshuti y’umuteramakofi Floyd Mayweather Justin na Tom bose bafite ubushobozi bwo kurwana iyi ntambara, dore ko mu minsi ishize Justin Bieber yatojwe na Floyd Mayweather, wanahamije ko uyu muririmbyi afite impano yamugira umukinnyi ukomeye wa Box. 

Tom Cruise Ni mugihe Tom we yari umuhanga mu mikino yo gukirana ubwo yigaga mu mashuri yisumbuye ndetse akaba n’umwe mu bakinnyi bake ba filime bikinira ibice birimo imirwano mu gihe abandi baba bafite abasimbura.

title: Rayon Sports yasezereye Manzi Thierry na Niyonzima Olivier Sefu
content:
Manzi Thierry wari kapiteni wa Rayon Sports kuva yasezerera Ndayishimiye Eric (Bakame) hamwe na Niyonzima Olivier Sefu bamaze guhabwa amabaruwa abamenyesha ko iyi kipe yabarekuye kubera banze kongera amasezerano, ariko abasesengura basanga hari indi mpamvu nyamukuru yatumye basezererwa. Ni amaburawa asa yagiye ahagaragara ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu Mbere tariki ya 17 Kamena 2019 aho byasobanuwe ko iki cyemezo gishingiye ku biganiro aba bakinnyi bagiranye n’ubuyobozi bwa Rayon Sports ku wa 08 Kamena 2019. Bati "Dushingiye ku cyemezo cyawe cyo kutongera amasezerano na Rayon Sports FC, dusanze ari ngombwa kukumenya ibi bikurikira."

Manzi Thierry yasezerewe, ikipe ye ikiri mu marushanwa y’igikombe cy’Amahoro Mu byo babamenyesheje harimo ko kuva kuri uyu wa 17 Kamena 2019, aba bakinnyi bemerewe gutandukana na Rayon Sports bakaba bamenyeshejwe ko bagera ku Bunyamabanga Bukuru bw’iyi kipe bagahabwa ibyemezo bibemerera kwishakira andi makipe. Bakomeje bashimira aba bakinnyi ngo ubwitange bwabaranze mu myaka bamaze muri iyi kipe banabifuriza ishya n’ihirwe aho bazerekeza.


Amabaruwa yashyikirijwe aba bakinnyi yasinyweho na Visi Perezida wa Rayon Sports, Muhirwa Freddy Abakurikiranira hafi iby’iyi kipe bahamya ko impamvu yashyizwe muri iyi baruwa ntaho ihuriye n’ukuri. Bavuga ko isezererwa by’umwihariko rya Manzi Thierry rishingiye ku kuba uyu mukinnyi wari kapiteni yarasabye bagenzi be kuva muri local ubwo biteguraga umukino wa Marines FC basaba guhabwa uduhimbazamusyi twabo, bikongeraho ikiganiro yahaye abanyamakuru nyuma y’uyu mukino basezereyemo Marines FC avuga ko ibibazo by’amafaranga bisanzwe muri Rayon Sports ariko bikwiye gukemuka kuko bimaze imyaka irenga 20.

Niyonzima Olivier Sefu ni umwe mu bakinnyi bafashije cyane Rayon Sports muri uyu mwaka Aba bakinnyi bari bamaze muri Rayon Sports imyaka ine, bakaba barayifashije kwegukana ibikombe bibiri bya shampiyona(2016/17, 2018/19), kimwe cy’Amahoro ndetse no kugera mu mikino ya 1/4 cya Confederation Cup.

title: Adele yaguriye inzu y’agatangaza uwahoze ari umugabo we -Amafoto
content:
Za gatanya hari igihe ziba mu mahoro abantu bagatandukana neza nubwo bidakunze kubaho. Ibi byashimangiwe n’umuririmbyikazi rurangiranwa Adele wahaye se w’umuhungu we inzu y’akataraboneka hafi yaho asanzwe atuye nyuma y’igihe gito bitangajwe ko batandukanye. Uyu muhanzikazi w’imyaka 31 y’amavuko usanzwe uzwiho kudashyira hanze ubuzima bwe bwite, hari ibitamushobokera kubera uburyo akurikiranirwa hafi n’itangazamakuru ryo muri Amerika ari naryo ryahishuye ko Simon Konecki wahoze ari umugabo we yamweguriye inzu ’villa’ ifite agaciro k’asaga miliyoni 9 z’amdorali ya Amerika (agera kuri miliyari 9 z’amanyarwanda) iherereye mu gace gahenze cyane ka Beverly Hills. Reba hano hasi indirimbo ’Hello’ ya Adele yakunzwe cyane Nubwo batandukanye nk’umugabo n’umugore ngo bifuza ko umwana wabo w’umuhungu Angelo w’imyaka itandatu yakomeza gukura abona hafi ababyeyi be bombi. Iyi nzu nshya ya Simon yubatswe mu ntangiriro zo mu myaka yo mu 1960, ikaba igizwe n’ibyumba bitanu n’ubwiyuhagiriro butandatu. Uruganiriro rwayo ruragutse ndetse inafite isomero rishobora kwakira ibitabo ibihumbi bibiri. Mu bindi iyi ’villa’ ifite harimo studio nto y’umuziki, icyumba cy’imyitoza ngororamubiri ndetse n’ibiro bitagebwamo n’izuba.


Iyi nzu ifite ubuganiriro bwagutse Nubwo akomoka mu Bwongereza, Adela yagaragaje ko akunda cyane kwibera mu burengerazuba bwa Amerika akaba yarahisemo agace gasanzwe gakundwa cyane n’ibyamamare dore ko hanatuye abarimo Katy Perry, Cameron Diaz, Penelope Cruz, Nicole Kidman ndetse n’inshuti ye Jennifer Lawrence nawe ahafite inzu. Itangazwa rya gatanya ya Adele na Simon ryatunguye cyane abafana. Iki cyamamare nticyahwemye iteka kuvuga neza umugabo we mu bihe byashize. Simon Konecki w’imyaka 45 asanzwe ayobora ikigo cy’ibikorwa by’ubugiraneza. Yabyaranye na Adele mu 2012 ndetse baza kurushinga mu ibanga mu 2016 nyuma y’imyaka itanu yari ishize bakundana.

Adele na Simon Nyuma y’umwaka umwe babana nibwo Adele yaje guhishura ko bashakanye, icyo gihe hari mu birori bya Grammy Awards aho yagize ati "Ndubatse. Umugabo wanjye n’umwana wanjye, ni imwe mpamvu yonyine ituma nkora ibi.", gusa nyuma yaho aba bombi batangiye kutabana cyane ndetse ababakikije bahamya ko batandukanye burundu. Gatanya yabaye intangiriro y’ubuzima bushya kuri Adele. Ubwo yizihizaga isabukuru y’imyaka 31 y’amavuko yavuze ko yanyuze mu bihe bikomeye ariko ko yahisemo kwifata ukuboko, aha yaboneye kugira inama abafana be, ati "Mwiyiteho ubwanyu. Turi abantu. Muryoherwe n’ubuzima. Mushyire ku ruhande telefoni zanyu, hanyuma museke igihe cyose bibashobokeye. Mwige kwikunda by’ukuri." Reba amwe mu mafoto y’iyi nzu yeguriye uwahoze ari umugabo we

Ifite ubwiyuhagiriro butandatu

Ni inzu nziza bivugwa yayiguze miliyoni 10 z’amadorali ya Amerika (asaga miliyari 9 z’amanyarwanda)


Hagati mu kwezi gushize kwa Gicuruzi nibwo byavuzwe ko Adele yaguze iyi nzu, ariko muri iki cyumweru turi gusoza nibwo ibinyamakuru byo muri Amerika byahishuye ko yayeguriye Simon

title: Umuraperi Tupac iyo aza kuba akiriho aba yujuje imyaka 48 y’amavuko -Amateka n’impaka k’urupfu rwe
content:
Kugeza ubu impaka ziracyari zose k’urupfu rwe, hari na bamwe bavuga ko Tupac yaba kugeza ubu akiriho bakabishingira ku ngingo nyinshi zitandukanye bagenda bagaragaza, ariko amateka yo atwereka ko mu ijoro ryo ku ya 07 Nzeri 1996 ari bwo uyu muraperi yarashwe arakomereka bikomeye ndetse nyuma y’iminsi 6 aza gushiramo umwuka, abafana be barira ayo kwarika. Tupac Amaru Shakur cyangwa 2pac cyangwa Pac cyangwa se Makaveli, amazina yose yakunze kujya yiyita mu bihe bye, yavutse ku itariki ya 16 Kamena 1971 avukira Harlem agace ka Manhattan muri New York. Ni umuhungu wa Afeni Shakur na Billy Garland. 

Ifoto ya Tupac imugaragaza akiri umwana muto cyane Ni umwe mu baraperi baranze cyane iyi njyana mu myaka ya 90, yagurishije amakopi asaga miliyoni 75 y’album ze ndetse kugeza ubu aracyafatwa nk’umuraperi w’ibihe byose. Urupfu rwa 2pac, impaka n’amayobera yarwo n’ibindi byagiye bivugwa bifitanye isano n’iherezo rye ku isi… Mu gitondo cyo ku itariki ya 7/09/1996, 2Pac yazindutse yerekeza mu mujyi wa Las Vegas ubarizwa muri Leta ya Nevada, kugira ngo abashe gukurikira umukino wa Boxe, wari guhuza inshuti ye Mike Tyson na Bruce Seldon.

Tupac umuraperi ukigenderwaho na benshi Akigera Las Vegas mu masaha y’amanywa yahise afata icyumba muri Hotel izwi cyane yitwa Luxal Hotel Casino. Uwo murwano wari witezwe n’abantu benshi ku buryo MGM Grand Hotel yari kuberamo yari yakubise yuzuye. Tupac akaba yari yazanye na Boss we Marion Suge Knight umwe mu bashinze Studio 2Pac yakoreragamo ibihangano bye, ngo birebere uwo mukino. Tupac hamwe n’abari bamuherekeje ari bo Suge Knight, umurinzi we Frank Alexander, ndetse n’indi nshuti imwe ya Suge Knight bafashe imyanya mu gice cy’abiyubashye, aho umwanya umwe wishyurwaga amafaranga 1 000 cy’amadorari. Hashize iminota ibiri gusa, nk’umurabyo, Mike Tyson yateye igipfunsi cy’akataraboneka Bruce Seldom ahita agwa hasi, umukino urangira utyo. Iyi nayo yahise ijya mu mateka, nk’imwe muri kawo zihuse zabayeho mu mateka ya boxe. Abantu batangiye gusohoka banyuranamo bamwe bijujuta. 2 Pac, Suge Knight ndetse n’abo bari kumwe, batangiye gusohoka na bo bageze ku muryango, habayeho kurwana gutunguranye hagati ya 2 Pac n’abo bari kumwe, aho bacakiranye na Orlando Anderson umusore w’umuraperi wo mu gace ka Compton i California hamwe n’inkoramutima ze. Imirwano yahagaritswe n’abarinzi ba Hotel ku bw’amahirwe, 2 Pac ahita yerekeza ku cyumba cye aho yari asanze fiancé we Kadada Jons. Amaze guhindura imyambaro , 2 Pac na Suge Knight bahise berekeza mu gace ka Paradise Valley mu Mujyi wa Las Vegas, kuri Villa y’akataraboneka ya Suge Knight.

Tupac na Suge Knight wari boss we akanaba inshuti ye Ahagana mu ma saa yine z’ijoro, 2Pac, Suge Knight ndetse n’abarinzi babo, berekeje mu nzu y’urubyiniro Club 662 ya Suge Knight iri ku muhanda witwa flamingo, aha 2Pac akaba yaragombaga kuririmbana na Groupe Run DMC, bikaba byari biteganyijwe ko na Mike Tyson na we yagombaga kuba ahari. Agana kuri iyi nzu y’urubyiniro, 2Pac yari yicaye mu modoka ya BMW y’umukara Suge Knight ari we umutwaye aho bari baherekejwe n’imodoka 4 zirimo abarinzi babo. Saa 23h05 habura ibirometero bike ngo bagere kuri Club 662, Suge Knight yahagaritswe na Polisi kubera ko yagendaga avuza umuziki mwinshi mu modoka, no kuba imodoka ye itari ifite Plaque, ibi bikaba byaragaragajwe n’ifoto yafashwe n’umupaparazi wari hafi aho, iyi ikaba ari nayo foto yafashwe bwa nyuma 2Pac akiri muzima.

Ifoto ya nyuma 2pac yafotowe akiri muzima, aha ari kumwe na Suge Knight Barenze aho uwo mu polisi yarari, imodoka yabo yahise izengurukwa n’imodoka ebyiri batazi aho zivuye, imwe imbere, indi inyuma. Iy’inyuma yarabasatiriye iciye mu ruhande rw’ibumoso, abakobwa b’abirabura bane bari bicaye muri iyo modoka bamwenyurira 2Pac na Suge Knight, nabo barabasuhuza. Muri ako kanya umwe mu basore batatu bari bari mu modoka y’imbere, yahise asohora umutwe mu idirishya ry’imodoka, arekurira urufaya rw’amasasu agera kuri 13 ku modoka 2Pac na Suge Knight bari barimo. Tupac mu gushaka guhungira mu mwanya w’inyuma ntibyamworoheye kuko yari yambaye umukandara wo mu modoka, bituma ahita afatwa n’amasasu atatu. Ntiyari yambaye umwenda umurinda gukomeretswa n’amasasu kandi ubusanzwe yarasanzwe awuhorana. Suge Knight bari bicaranye we yarashwe ahagana kw’irugu, ndetse n’amapine abiri y’imodoka araraswa. Ababarashe bahita bava aho bihuta cyane, bafata umuhanda w’ahitwa Coverlane. Mu buhamya Suge Knight nyuma yo kurokoka yabwiye urukiko, avuga ko bakimara kuraswa, yabajije 2 Pac niba ameze neza, maze ngo bitewe nuko 2Pac yabonaga amaraso menshi ku ijosi rya Suge Knight, aramusubiza ati:’’Ni njyewe warashwe cyangwa ni wowe? Ndabona bakurashe mu mutwe”. Bitewe no kumva urufaya rw’amasasu Polisi yahise ihagera berekeza kwa muganga, ariko kubera umuvuduko mwinshi mu nzira bakoze impanuka amapine yari yasigaye ari mazina nayo aratoboka, batabarwa n’ingobyi y’abarwayi yahise igera aho maze bose berekeza ku bitaro.

Imodoka yabo nyuma yo kuraswa Nk’uko abaganga babitangaje, ngo mu nzira bagana ku bitaro 2Pac yagendaga avuga ngo ndapfuye, simbasha guhumeka. Kwa muganga bahise bamubaga inshuro eshatu, ngo barebe ko bahagarika kuvira imbere, banamuvanamo igihaha cy’iburyo. Iminsi igera kuri 6 yamaze muri koma, MC Hammer, Mike Tyson, Jasmine Guy, Pasiteri Hary Chalton ndetse na Mama we Afeni Shakur, basimburanaga kuza kumusura bose bakahava n’amarira menshi. Bitewe no gukomereka bikabije, kuwa gatanu itariki ya 13/09, saa kumi z’ijoro zirenzeho iminota itatu 2Pac Amaru Shakur yashizemo umwuka.

Tupac yakundaga kwambara bandana mu mutwe Hari mu ma saa kumi n’imwe za mugitondo ubwo umubyeyi we yahageraga agashyikirizwa umurambo. Hakozwe imihango yoroheje i Las Vegas, aho umurambo wa Amaru 2 Pac Shakur watwitswe, bikaba bivugwa ko ivu rye ryahise rijugunywa mu Nyanja. Ntabyo kumushyingura ku mugaragaro byabayeho. Bivugwa ko kandi nyuma yo gutwika umubiri wa 2pac, bimwe mu bisigazwa bye abagize itsinda ryari inshuti ze kuva kera babivanga na Marijuana(urumugi) bakajya babinywa. Umuntu wishe 2pac ntiyashakishijwe cyane kuko umuryango we utabisahatse gusa bakeka ko yishwe n’abigeze kumurasa mbere n’ubundi ariko ntapfe. 

Hari n’abahamya ko Suge Knight ari we waba ari inyuma y’urupfu rwa Tupac Kuva Tupac yapfa yabaye umu martyr mpuzamahanga nka Bob marley na Che Guevara, ubuzima bwe bwatumye habaho abitwa Tupacistas ku mihanda ya Bresil, ibikuta byo kumwibuka byubatswe ahantu hatandukanye muri Espagne, ubudage na Bresil, ndetse no kwambara bandana ku rubyiruko rwo muri Africa y’epfo n’ahandi bikorwa nk’urwibutso rwa 2pac. N’ubwo 2Pac atakiriho haracyibazwa n’ubu icyihishe inyuma y’urupfu rwe. Umwe mu bari inkoramutima ze Yafeo Kadafi Fara, wari no mu bari bamuherekeje igihe yaraswaga, yavuze ko yari yiteguye gutanga ubuhamya, kuko yiboneye n’amaso ye ababarashe, ariko nyuma y’amezi abiri atangaje ibyo, umurambo we waje gutoragurwa i New Jersey.

Tupac na Snoop Dogg Bamwe bavuga ko 2Pac yaba yarishwe n’aba Gangstar bagenzi be, abandi bakavuga ko yaba yarishwe kubera nyina yaba yarahoze ari umu Black Panthers, ku rundi ruhande hacyekwa ko Suge Knight yaba yari yihishe inyuma y’urupfu rwa 2 Pac kubera umwenda w’ikirenga yaba yari amubereyemo ariko uyu yakunze kubihakana avuga ko ari ukumushinyagurira, abantu kandi ntibashira amakenga itsinda rya Bad Boys ryo mu mujyi wa New York ryari rikuriwe nuwo bita Sean John Combs wamenyekanye cyane nka Puff Daddy, P. Diddy. Ibi bakaba babivuga bitewe n’ubwumvikane buke bwari buri hagati ya 2Pac ndetse na Christopher Waless uzwi ku izina rya Notorious BIG abandi bati 2Pac yashatse kwigana Elivis Presley ntiyapfuye ahubwo arihishe.

Natorious B.I.G na P.Diddy cyangwa se Puff Daddy ni bamwe mu bashyizwe mu majwi cyane nyuma y’urupfu rwa 2Pac ANDI MATEKA YA 2PAC Nk’uko urubuga rwa Wikipedia rubivuga ngo amazina ya 2pac nyakuri yaba ari “Lesane Parish Crooks”, ryaje guhindurwa kuko ngo nyina yatinyaga ko abanzi be bazagirira umwana we nabi dore ko yari anafitanye ibibazo na guverinoma ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Nyuma yo gutandukana n’umugabo we, Billy Garland ari na we papa wa 2pac akajya kubana na Mutulu Shakur ni bwo ngo amazina ya 2pac yahinduwe.

Tupac na nyina bari inshuti magara 2pac yatangiye guhura n’ibibazo kuva akiri umwana, yavutse sekuru Elmer "Geronimo" Pratt, yaratawe muri yombi ashinjwa kwica umwarimu mu mwaka w’1968, mu gihe umugabo wa mama we na we yari ari ku rutonde rw’abantu bashakishwaga na FBI mu mwaka w’1982 akaba yarashinjwaga kuba yarafashije mushiki we gutoroka uburoko ubwo yari afunze na we ashinjwa kwica umuntu. Mutulu yaje gutabwa muri yombi mu mwaka w’1986. Tupac yari afite abavandimwe batatu bari no muri zimwe mu ndirimbo ze.

Tupac akiri umwana muto Mu mwaka w’1986, umuryango wa 2Pc wavuye Harlem wimukira i Baltimore muri Maryland, icyo gihe yari arangije umwaka wa kabiri w’amashuri yisumbuye. Bageze Baltimore yagiye mu ishuri ryigisha ubugeni yiga ibijyanye no gukora imivugo ndetse na Jazz. Igihe yigaga muri iri shuri, 2pac yahawe ibihembo bitandukanye by’uko ari we wari umuraperi mwiza kuko habaga ibitaramo. Muri iri shuri kandi yibukwa nk’umwana wamenyekanye kubera kwitwara neza mu bandi bana, kumenya kurapa no gushobora kumenyerana n’abandi bana uko baba bameze kose. Tupac yakundanye na Jada Pinket ubu witwa Jada Pinkett Smith (umugore wa Will Smith) bakiri abana, kugeza igihe 2pac yapfiriye. 

Tupac yari inshuti y’akadasohoka na Jada Pinket waje kuba umugore wa Will Smith bakinabana magingo aya Muri documentaire Tupac: Resurrection, Shakur yaravuze ati “Jada ni umutima wanjye, azaba inshuti yanjye mu buzima bwanjye bwose”. Pinket na we yamwitaga inshuti ye. Akanavuga ko yari nk’umuvandimwe we, ngo kuko ukuntu babanaga byari birenze n’ubucuti busanzwe. 2pac yanditse ibitabo n’imivugo kuri Pinket bigaragaza ukuntu yamukundaga, ndetse bakiri no ku ishuri bahoraga bajyana mu birori. Mu 1988, umuryango we wimukiye Marin City muri California, ahita ajya mu ishuri rya Tamalpais High School. Uko yatangiye kuba umuraperi Tupac yatangiye kuzamura ubumenyi bwe bwo kurapa mu mwaka w’1990 atangira gukora indirimbo. Muri uyu mwaka yahise asohora album ya mbere 2Pacalypse Now. Mu mwaka w’1993 yakoze album ya kabiri Strictly 4 My N.I.G.G.A.Z. Mu 1993 yakoze itsinda ryari ririmo Big Syke, Macadoshis, umuvandimwee we Mopreme Shakur, na Rated R. Iri tsinda bakoranye album imwe “Thug Life: Volume 1” mu mwaka w’1994 ikaba yarakunzwe cyane. Muri iyi album kandi harimo indirimbo "Pour Out a Little Liquor” ya 2pac yakozwe na Johnny "J" Jackson wahise unamukorera album yakurikiyeho “All Eyez on Me”. Umuziki wa 2pac wibandaga cyane ku birabura, ubwigenge, akarengane, ubukene n’ubugome bw’abapolisi. Bamwe mu bantu 2pac yashakaga kwigana harimo William Shakespeare, Niccolò Machiavelli, Donald Goines, Sun Tzu, Kurt Vonnegut, Mikhail Bakunin, Maya Angelou, Alice Walker, na Khalil Gibran nk’uko yabigaragazaga mu ndirimbo ze. Tupac nta dini na rimwe yemeraga, gusa zimwe mu ndirimbo ze nka ’Only God Can Judge Me” n’imwe mu mvugo ze zigaragaza ko yemeraga Imana.

Tupac akiri umusore muto 2pac yagiranye ibibazo bitandukanye na leta, akenshi akaba yarabazwaga amagambo ari mu ndirimbo kenshi wasangaga avuga abagabo b’abirabura. Kenshi iyo mu bitaramo bye habaga ikintu kitagenze neza kuko hari n’igihe abantu barwanaga bashaka ko abasinyira autographe bakanarasana ibi byose byaramubazwaga rimwe na rimwe bakanamufunga akanatanga amafaranga menshi y’amende. Mu 1993 uyu muraperi yatawe muri yombi na bagenzi be bashinjwa gufata ku ngufu umugore wo muri hotel, n’ubwo yahakanye ko nta byo yakoze ntibyamubujije gufungwa ndetse amaze kurangza igihano agisohoka muri gereza yahise asubizwamo ngo kubera ukuntu yitwaye bamufunguye ahita asabirwa kumara iminsi 120 mu munyururu na none. Mu Ugushyingo 1994 habura umunsi umwe ngo aburane icyaha cy’ubusambanyi yaregwaga yarashwe inshuro eshanu ku bw’amahirwe ntiyapfa, nyuma yo kuva mu bitaro byahise bimwakira amaze kuraswa yahise ajya mu rukiko kuburana ibyaha bigera ku icyenda yaregwaga, ahamwa na bitatu, ku bindi bitandatu aba umwere. Yahise akatirwa igifungo kiri hagati y’umwaka n’igice n’imyaka ine n’igice kubera icyaha cy’ubusambanyi cyari cyamufashe. Kuva mu mwaka w’1995 yakoraga igihano mu buroko anasohora album Me Against the World. Yabaye iya mbere kuri billboard. Undi muntu wakoze album igakundwa kandi ari muri prison nyuma ya 2pac ni Lil Wayne. Ngo 2pac igihe cyose yari ari mu buroko bagenzi be bamubwiraga ibya illiminati. Amwe mu magambo atangaje yavuze mbere y’uko yitaba Imana Nizera ko iyo ukoze ikibi kikugarukira, ku bw’ibyo ikibi cyose nakoze ngiye kubona ingaruka zacyo, ariko mu mutima wanjye ndumva nkora ibyiza, bityo ndumva meze nk’ugiye kujya mu ijuru. Nimara gutabaruka abantu bazamenya ibyo navugaga. Aya ni amwe mu magambo 2Pac yavuze mbere yuko yitaba Imana.

Tupac na Janet Jackson bahuriye muri filim yitwa Poetic Justice Bimwe mu bihembo byahawe 2Pac mu rwego rwo kumwibuka *Muri 2005 Rolling Stones Magazine yatoye 2pac nk’umuhanzi wa 6 udapfa *MTV yamugize uwa kabiri ku rutonde rw’aba MC bakomeye b’ibihe byose *Yabaye No.3 mu bahanzi 50 ba hiphop bakomeye. *Muri 2003, yahawe igihembo cy’umu MC wa mbere atowe n’abafana *2006, yahawe igihembo n’iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga y’amafilm kubera ijwi rye no gukina ku bijyanye n’ivangura ry’uruhu n’ubwoko. Iki gihembo cyashimishije mama we cyane.

title: Diamond na Tanasha baritegura kwibaruka umwana wabo wa mbere (AMAFOTO)
content:
Diamond Platnumz akomeje kwigarurira East Africa atari mu muziki gusa, ahubwo arasa n’ushaka kugira igisekuru cye muri buri gihugu cy’aka gace, dore ko afite abana muri Uganda, yabyaranye na Zari, uwo muri Tanzania yabyaranye na Hamisa Mobeto, ubu akaba agiye kwibaruka uwo muri Kenya. Amafoto menshi agenda ashyirwa ku mbuga nkoranyambaga aragaragaza ko umukunzi wa Diamond, Tanasha atwite ndetse benshi batangiye kumwifuriza kuzibaruka neza.

 Tanasha yaba yitegura kwibaruka umwana wa 4 wa Diamond  Urukundo rwa Diamond Platnumz n’umunyamideri akaba n’umunyamakuru Tanasha rumaze igihe rushyushye cyane ndetse Diamond ntatinya kumuvuga nk’umugore we n’ubwo amatariki y’ubukwe bwabo ataramenyekana neza. Ibyo gutwita kwa Tanasha byatangiye kuvugwa cyane, ubwo Diamond yashyiraga kuri Instagram ye amashusho yabo bombi barimo kubyina indirimbo ye nshya yafatanyije na Fally Ipupa, hanyuma abantu ntibibuza kuvuga ku buryo inda y’uyu munyamideli isa n’irimo umwana ndetse banabashimira ko bagiye kuba ababyeyi, nubwo hataburaga abavuga ko yaba yariye byinshi akijuta.

 Aya mashusho niyo yahamirije benshi ko Tanasha atwite  Nyuma abantu batandukanye bagiye bashyira hanze amafoto atandukanye agaragaza koko ko Tanasha atwite, harimo ayagiye akurwa ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ndetse n’ibitangazamakuru bitandukanye. Mu ntangiriro za Gashyantare uyu mwaka, Tanasha yari yahakanye iby’aya makuru ahamya ko yagiye kwa muganga agasanga adatwite, ariko abakurikiranira hafi uyu mukobwa bavuga ko uko inda ye igenda ikura, bigenda bigaragaza ko nta kabuza yitegura kubyara 
 Diamond afata Tanasha nk’umugore we, ndetse yamaze no kumwerekana iwabo 

 Urukundo rwabo rumaze iminsi ruvugisha benshi 




 Nubwo ahakana iby’aya makuru, inda ye igenda ikura mu buryo bugaragara

title: Amafoto: Perezida wa Turikiya, Erdogan yambariye Mesut Ozil mu bukwe bwe na Miss Emine
content:
Kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 07 Kamena 2019 ni bwo umukinnyi w’umupira w’amaguru w’Umudage ariko ufite inkomoko muri Turikiya, Mesut Ozil ukinira Arsenal, yakoze ubukwe n’umukunzi we Amine Gulse wahoze ari nyampinga wa Turikiya. Icyagarutsweho cyane nyuma y’ubu bukwe bwabereye Istanbul, ni uburyo Mesut Ozil yambariwe na Perezida wa Turukiya Recep Tayyip Erdogan ufatwa nk’umunyagitugu mu bihugu by’i Burayi bw’uburengerazuba by’umwihariko mu Budage aho Ozil yakuriye dore ko no mu mwaka ushize bifotoranyije bigakurura impaka.

Perezida Recep Tayyip Erdogan yambariye (Best Man) Mesut Ozil Ibi birori byabereye muri Turikiya muri imwe muri hoteli ziyubashye iherereye hafi y’umugezi wa Bosphorus. Urukundo rwa Mesut Ozil na Miss Amine Gulse rwatangiye kwigaragaza mu mwaka wa 2017 kugeza ubwo hagati mu mwaka ushize wa 2018 bemeranijwe kuzarushinga.


Mesut Ozil n’umugore we Amine Gulse barushinze nyuma y’imyaka isaga itatu bari bamaze bakundana

Perezida Erdogan n’umugore we Emine bashyigikiye Ozil n’umugore we mu bukwe bwabo Abanyepolitike mu Budage ntibahwemye kugaragaza ko batishimiye umubano wa Ozil na Perezida Erdogan ariko uyu musore w’imyaka 30 yabyimye amatwi, ndetse ni kimwe mu byatumye asezera bitunguranye mu ikipe y’igihugu y’Ubudage aho yavuze ko bamukorera ivangura rishingiye ku nkomoko ye, bakabigaraga=za cyane iyo ikipe itari mu bihe byiza.

title: Iby’ingenzi wamenya kuri Najila Trindade, umugore ushinja Neymar kumufata ku ngufu
content:
Umukinnyi kugeza ubu ufite agahigo ko kuba yaraguzwe amafaranga menshi kurusha abandi ku isi, Neymar, ntiyorohewe muri iyi minsi kubera umunyamideli w’iwabo muri Brazil umushinja kumusambanya ku gahato. Uyu mukobwa umaze kwamamara cyane ku isi mu gihe gito yitwa Najila Trindade Mendes de Souza w’imyaka 26 y’amavuko, akaba ari umunyamideli w’umunyamwuga uvuka i Sao Paulo. 

 Najila Trindade Mendes de Souza Ni umubyeyi w’umwana w’umwe w’umuhungu w’imyaka 6 y’amavuko ariko akaba amaze umwaka umwe atabana na se w’uyu mwana. "Afite icyizere, aratuje, ariko ntanezerewe (…) Ku mubiri ntameze neza, yarananutse kuko ntacyo agishyira mu kanwa.", ibyatangajwe n’uwahoze ari umukunzi we ubwo yaganiraga na à O Globo Estivens Alves. Uyu kandi banabyaranye umwana yanahishuye ko aka gahungu kabo katakibasha kujya ku ishuri kubera uburyo bagenzi be bamutera ubwoba kubera iki kibazo nyina afitanye na Neymar. Mbere y’iki kibazo cye na Neymar, Najila Trindade, ntabwo yari azwi cyane ku ruhando mpuzamahanga ariko mu gihugu cye ho yari azwi nubwo bitari ku rugaro ruhambaye. Yagiye agaragara mu bikorwa bitandukanye byo kwamamaza ndetse no mu mashusho y’indirimbo harimo iy’umuririmbyi uzwi cyane witwa Zula yagaragayemo muri Kanama 2017. Reba amashusho y’indirimbo ’Fogo Cruzado’ ya Zula uyu mukobwa agaragaramo Nkuko itangazamakuru ryo muri Brazil ribitangaza ngo yaba afite basaza be batatu n’undi ukobwa bavukaba, hakaba hashize imyaka ine avuye iwabo mu muryango. Nyuma yaho iki kibazo gisandaye ndetse akagaragara mu kiganiro yagiranye n’ikinyamakuru STB cyo muri Brazil, ngo uyu mukobwa yahise yimuka aho yari atuye mu rusisiro rwa Salvador ahita ajya ahandi hagizwe ibanga rikomeye.

Najila Trindade yatumye abanya-Brazil bacikamo ibice bibiri, bamwe bamushyigikiye abandi bashyigikiye Neymar Ibinyamakuru byo muri iki gihugu kandi bivuga ko atari ubwa mbere uyu mukobwa agaragara imbere y’ubucamanza kuko umunsi wabanjirije uwo yatangiyeho ikirego cya Neymar, Najila Trindade yari yaciwe amande y’ibihumbi 26 by’ama- réaux (asaga miliyoni 6 frw) kubera ubukode bw’inzu yabagamo amaze igihe atishyura kuva muri Kanama 2018, byatumye anahabwa integuza yo kuyirukanwamo. Ikindi cyagaragajwe n’iri tangazamakuru ni uko uyu mukobwa afite umwenda ungana na 4160 réaux( akabakaba miliyoni y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda) abereyemo ishuri rya Pan American School of Art and Design.

Uyu mukobwa avuga ko Neymar yahindutse mu gihe gito nyuma yo kumutegera indege akamusanga mu Bufaransa aho bahuriye muri imwe mu mahoteli y’i Paris Mu kiganiro aheruka kugirana na BuzzFeed uyu mukobwa yahamije ko afite ubwoba bw’ubuzima bwe, avuga ko Neymar afite amafaranga ashobora kugura buri wese. Ati "Afite amafaranga ndetse ashobora kugura buri wese, ariko ndavuga ukuri." Muri iki kiganiro cya kabiri, uyu mukobwa yagarutse ku buryo ibyo ashinja Neymar byagenze. Ati "Yamfashe ku ngufu, yarampohoteye ntakindi, nta muntu uzahindura ibyabaye. Biroroshye kumfata nk’indaya maze ikibazo ntibakiteho. Turi mu isi y’umwanda. Uzi ikigiye kuba? Bazanyica maze bavuge ko niyahuye, ko nabeshyaga, maze ubuzima bukomeze. Abagore bazakomeza guhohoterwa ndetse bafatwe nk’aho bashyira imyanda." Uyu mukobwa yavuze ko ubu atorohewe n’ubuzima aho atakibasha kurya, kuryama n’ibindi byibanze mu buzima bwe.

Bamwe bari kumufata nk’umubeshyi wateze umutego Neymar ngo amukuremo amafaranga

title: Yavugishije Jay Z imbere ya Beyoncé biramurakaza, aterwa ubwoba bwo kwicwa
content:
Beyoncé na Jay Z bagaragaye ku mukino wa NBA. Mu mashusho yabo yakwirakwijwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga hagaragayemo umugore utahwemye gukomeza kuvugisha Jay Z yirengagije Beyonce wari ubicaye hagati, ibitabuze kurakaza cyane uyu muririmbyikazi. Uyu mugore waje kumenyekana ko ari Madamu Nicole Curran, umugore wa nyir’ikipe ya Golden State Warriors, ntiyorohewe na gato nyuma y’uko aya mashusho ashyizwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga zitandukanye nka Twitter na Instagram, dore ko hari n’abatatinye kumubwira ko akwiriye kwicwa.

 Uyu mugore yatewe ubwoba bwo kwicwa kuko yasuzuguye akanababaza Beyoncé  Nubwo aya mashusho agishyirwa ku mbuga nkoranyambaga yabanje gusetsa abantu, ibintu byaje guhindura isura mu gihe gito. Nicole yasobanuriye Dailymai ko yatutswe cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. "Narenganye… Bari abatumirwa bacu. Nk’uwabakiraga, nahaye icyo kunywa Beyoncé nyuma ngiha na Jay Z. Byabaye ngombwa ko nunama kugira ngo numve ibyo ambwira. Ni uko byagenze nta kindi cyo kongeraho." Akimara kubona ko abareba amashusho yashyize ku nkuta ze za Twitter na Instagram ari kumwe n’ibi byamamare atishimiwe na benshi yabanje guhisha ibitekerezo abantu bandikaga ariko nyuma yo kubona ko hari abatangiye kuyashyira ku mbuga zabo ndetse harimo n’abamwifuriza gupfa ahitamo kuyasiba burundu, kugeza n’ubwo yavuye burundu kuri Instagram kugira ngo abone gutuza.

title: Lionel Sentore (Ingangare) yashyize hanze indirimbo yakoze atari kumwe na mugenzi we -Yumve Hano
content:
Lionel Sentore ni umwe mu basore babiri bagize itsinda rya muzika Ingagare rikorera umuziki mu Bubiligi aho bamaze kumenyekana ku muziki wubakije ahanini k’umwimerere w’injyana gakondo, muri iyi minsi bakaba bakunzwe mu ndirimbo ’Rayon yacu’ bamwe bita ’Murera’ ndetse na Imena bakoranye na Cécile Kayirebwa. 
Ingangare bakoranye indirimbo n’umwamikazi wa muzika nyarwanda Cécile Kayirebwa (hagati), Charles Uwizihize (ibumoso) na Lionel Sentore (iburyo) Kuri ubu Lionel Sentore akaba yashyize hanze indirimbo ye itumvikanamo ijwi rya mugenzi we Charles Uwizihiwe nkuko byari bisanzwe, ahubwo akaba yifashishije umuhanzikazi witwa Chanty. Kanda hano hasi wumve indirimbo ’Rayon yacu’ y’Ingangare Mu kiganiro yahaye Kigali Post, Lionel Sentore yavuze ko iyi ndirimbo yise ’Isoko’ yari imaze imyaka myinshi ikoze, aza gusanga byaba byiza ayishyize hanze kugira ngo iki gihangano gifite ubutumwa bw’urukundo kitazapfa ubusa, ariko mbere yo kuyisohora yabanje kubiganirizaho mugenzi we. Ati "Ariko twaje kwicara jyewe na Charles nk’abagize INGANGARE tubiganiraho, musaba niba ntakibazo iyi ndirimbo nyishize hanze, arabinyemerera."

Lionel Sentore Lionel Sentore avuga ko iki gihangano yagitekereje nk’impano yaha abakundana bose. Akomoza ku muhanzikazi Chanty yifashishije, yagize ati "Uyu mukobwa naramwumvise aririmba nsanga ni umuhanga cyane aho yasubiyemo indirimbo ya Kamliza yitwa Laurette, nanjye numva ko dukoranye iyi ndirimbo byatanga umusaruro kurushaho." Kanda hano hasi wumve Isoko, indirimbo ya Lionel Sentore ft Chanty yakozwe na Didier Touch Lionel Sentore yaboneyeho kudutangariza ko nk’Ingangare bafite imishinga myinshi muri iyi minsi bahugiyemo irangajwe imbere na album ndetse mu minsi mike ngo baritegura gushyira hanze amashusho y’indirimbo bakoranye na Cécile Kayirebwa bakayita Imena. Uyu muhanzi yanahishuye Kanda hano hasi wumve indirimbo Imena y’itsinda Ingangare na Cecile Kayirebwa

title: Schwarzenegger ’Commando’ yadukiriwe n’umufana wamwubikiriye akamukubitira imbere y’abantu (Video)
content:
Arnold Schwarzenegger benshi mu bakunzi ba filime bamenye nka ’Commando’ yahuye n’umufana muri Afurika y’Epfo utishimye maze aramwubikira amukubita umugeri, undi abandagara hasi. Nk’uko benshi bamumenye muri filime ze nka Commando, Schwarzenegger ni umuntu ufatwa nk’umunyembaraga nyinshi ndetse ko ntawamuhangara. Nyamara uyu mugabo wo muri Afurika y’Epfo yirengagije ibyo byose, maze aramwubikira amukubita umugeri amuturutse inyuma.


 Nubwo benshi bamufata nk’umunyembaraga, uyu mufana we ntacyo byari bimubwiye  Schwarzenegger, umukinnyi wa filime ndetse akaba n’umunyapolitike yari i Johannesburg mu gushyigikira no kwamamaza irushwanwa rye rya siporo. Nyuma y’ibi yahumurije abafana be abicishije kuri Twitter aho yanditse ati "Murakoze cyane kumpangayikira, ariko muhumure. Njye natekerezaga ko ari umuntu wansitayeho mu mubyigano w’abantu nk’uko bikunze kumbaho. Naje kumenya ko nakubiswe umugeri mbibonye muri video kimwe namwe. Nishimiye ko kiriya gicucu kitambujije kurangiza Snapchat cyanjye."


 Schwarzenegger yavuze ko ntacyo bimutwaye  Abategura ibi bikorwa by’irushanwa batangaje ko uwakoze ibi yatawe muri yombi na polisi ya Afurika y’Epfo, yanatangaje ko yari isanzwe imuziho ibikorwa by’urugomo nk’ibi. Commando we yatangaje ko atifuza ko akurikiranwa. Dore amashusho y’uko byagenze

title: Hollywood: Jennifer Lopez na Card B mu b’imbere bafite ibibuno byiza yaba karemano n’ibyongerewe -Urutonde&Amafoto
content:
Kugira ikibuno kinini ubu ni bimwe mu bigezweho cyane kurusha uko byahoze muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ku buryo bimwe mu byamamare bitagize amahirwe yo kuvukana ikibuno kinini, ubu bayoboka ku bwinshi inzira yo kwibagisha ngo bacyongere barusheho gukurura abafana. Mu myaka mirongo ishize kugira ikibuno kinini i Hollywood byagereranywaga nko kugira ibiro byinshi, nyamara ubu muri iyi myaka ya vuba byahinduye isura bifatwa nk’uburyo bukurura cyane ab’igitsina gabo ndetse n’imiterere ihamye y’umugore. Hashingiwe ku bushakashatsi bwagiye bukorerwa mu mavuriro afasha abashaka kwibagisha ngo bahindure imiterere y’umubiri wabo (chirurgie esthétique), bigaragara ko umubare wabashaka kongeresha ikibuno wikubye kabiri ndetse bigera no kuri gatatu hagati ya 2007 na 2017. Ikinyamakuru Public dukesha iyi nkuru cyagiye kigaruka kuri amwe mu mazina y’ibyamamare i Hollywood bafite ibibuno bininini kandi byiza aho nta gushidikanya Jennifer Lopez uri hafi kuzuza imyaka 50 y’amavuko, ari we benshi bahurizaho ko afite ikibuno cyiza kandi karemano kuko atigeze yibagisha.

title: Umunyafurika-y’epfo yabaye umugore wa mbere wo muri Afurika y’Abirabura ugeze ku gasongero ka Everest
content:
Ku nshuro ya kane agerageza kuzamuka umusozi muremure ku isi wa Everest, Saray Khumalo ukomoka muri Afurika y’epfo, kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 16 Gicurasi 2019 yabaye umunyafurikakazi wirabura ugeze ku gasongero k’uyu musozi uri ku butumburuke (altitude)bwa metero 8 848. Nkuko abari bayoboye uru rugendo babitangaje, uyu mugore yahise aba umugore wa mbere w’umunyafurika wirabura ukandagije ikirenge ku gasongero k’uyu musozi. Ni mu gihe kandi mu 2003 umunyafurika y’epfo witwa Sibusiso Vilane yabaye umwirabura wa mbere ugeze kuri Everest. Minisitiri w’ubukerarugendo muri Nepal yahamije aya makuru ko uyu mugore ukora siporo yo kuzamuka imisozi (alpiniste) koko yageze kuri Everest, ariko ntiyagaragaje niba yaba ari we mugore wa mbere wirabura w’umunyafurika ubashije kubigeraho nubwo ibinyamakuru byinshi n’abakurikiranira hafi bo babihamije.

Everest ni umusozi muremure gusumba indi ku isi uri mu ishene y’imisozi ya Himalaya muri Aziya, hagati ya Nepal n’Ubushinwa Mu nshuro eshyatu ziheruka, Saray Khumalo w’imyaka 47 y’amavuko  yari yagerageje kuzamuka uyu musozi ariko bikamunanira kugera ku gasongero. Nyuma yo kubigeraho yashimiwe n’abantu batandukanye barimo na Perezida wa Afurika y’Epfo, Cyril Ramaphosa. Abinyujije kuri Twitter yagize ati "Saray Khumalo ni we mugore wa mbere w’umunyafurika ubashije kuzamuka akagera ku gasongero ka Everest mu rwego rwo guteza imbere ukugera ku burezi bw’abana bo muri Afurika." Yakomeje agira ati "Yatweretse ko ishyaka no kwihangana bifasha kugera ku migambi ikomeye." Uyu mugore yifashisha izi ngendo ze mu kwamamaza no kumenyekanisha umushinga we wo gukusanya amafaranga agamije gutera inkunga amasomero (bibliothèques) y’abana.

Uyu musozi ukurura ba mukerarugendo cyane cyane abakunda kuzamuka imisozi (Alpinistes) Mu 2017 uyu munyafurika y’epfo yahagaritse urugendo rwe ubwo haburaga metero nke ngo agere ku gasongero ka Everest, kubera imiyaga myinshi n’imbeho byari bihari. Saray Khumalo asanzwe yarageze kuri Kilimandjaro (Tanzanie), Aconcagua (Argentine) no ku musozi wa Elbrouz mu Burusiya. "Inzozi zanjye ni ukugera iteka kure hashoboka mu gihe cyose nzaba nkiriho. Kugira ngo nereke abantu basanzwe ko abantu bashobora kugera ku dusongero tutakekwa.", Saray Khumalo ku rubuga rwe rwa Interneti.

Saray Khumalo yabaye umwiraburakazi wa mbere w’umugore wo muri Afurika ugeze ku gasongero ka Everest Ku nshuro ya mbere ubwo yageragezaga kuzamuka uyu musozi mu 2014, injishi zose zari mu nzira izamuka uyu musozi zarangiritse nyuma y’urubura rwinshi rwanahitanye abayobora (guides) bagera kuri 16. Kuri iyi nshuro nabwo nubwo uyu mugore ari kwishimira ko yabaye umwiraburakazi wa mbere w’umunyafurika ubashije kugera kuri aka gasongero, ibi byaje biherekejwe n’inkuru mbi yamenyekanye mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatanu aho umwe mu Bahinde bari bari mu itsinda rimwe witwa Ravi Thakar w’imyaka 28 yabonywe yapfuye aho yari ari mu ihema rye ryari riri ku butumburuke bwa metero 7 920, aba uwa mbere muri uyu mwaka upfiriye kuri uyu musozi wahitanye batanu umwaka ushize. Mu gihe harimo hashakishwa uburyo umurambo wa nyakwigendera wamanurwa, undi muzamutsi w’imisozi w’umunya-Irland witwa Seamus Lawless w’imyaka 39 y’amavuko kugeza ubu yaburiwe irengero aho bikekwa ko yaengewe ubwo bari bageze ku butumburuke bwa metero 8300.

title: Britney Spears uri kwitabwaho n’ibitaro by’indwara zo mu mutwe ashobora kutazongera gutaramira abafana
content:
Umuririmbyikazi w’Umunyamerika, Britney Spears wamamaye cyane mu ndirimbo zinyuranye mu bihe bishize, kuri ubu ubuzima bwe bwo mu mutwe ntibwifashe neza ndetse bishobora kumuviramo kutazongera gutaramira abafana nkuko umuhagarariye (manager) Larry Rudolph yabitangaje. Mu bihe by’ubukonje bw’impera z’umwaka ushize, Britney Spears yari yagerageje gukomeza ibitaramo bye i Las Vegas yise “Britney: Domination”, gusa ntibyatinze muri Mata uyu mwaka abafana be babazwa no kumva inkuru mbi y’uko uyu muririmbyikazi yoherejwe mu bitaro by’indwara zo mu mutwe.

Britney Spears afite ibibazo by’uburwayi bwo mu mutwe Mu kiganiro yagiranye na TMZ, Larry Rudolph umuhagarariye yagize ati "Nshingiye ku makuru nakiriye y’umuganga umuri hafi, biragaraga ko atazasubira ku rubyiniro (scène) i Las Vegas. Ndetse no mu bihe biri imbere kandi biranashoboka ko byanaba burundu." Larry Rudolph wagaragazaga ko ahangayikishijwe n’ubuzima bwa Britney Spears, yakomeje agira ati "Nakwishimira ko yagaruka mu kazi mu gihe yazaba yumva amaze kumererwa neza mu mutwe (mentalement) no mu mbaraga. Agomba kuba kandi abyiyumvamo. Mu gihe ibyo byaba bidakunze, ubwo nyine nta kundi. Ntabwo mfite ubushake n’ubushobozi bwo kumuhatira gusubira mu kazi. Nzaba mpari iteka ryose mu gihe azaba ankeneye."

Britney Spears n’umuhagarariye bamaranye igihe kirekire Larry Rudolph Britney Spears yaherukaga n’ubundi gufatwa kubera guhungabana bikomeye yagize bitewe n’umuhangayiko (stress) w’akazi ke, ubuzima bwe nk’umubyeyi ndetse n’impungenge y’ubuzima bwa se. Ku bw’uyu umuhagarariye, ngo ibi byose byamwirundiyeho biramuhungabanya binamuviramo kurwara agahinda gakabije (dépression) ku buryo ngo imiti yonyine itari ihagije kuba yamuvura.

Britney Spears ubwo yaherukaga gutaramira i Las Vegas Reba hano hasi indirimbo ’I’m Not A Girl, Not Yet A Woman’ yamamaye cyane mu za Britney

title: Barack Obama n’umugore we bagiye gutangira gutambutsa filime y’uruhererekane (série) yabo kuri Netflix
content:
Bidasubirwaho, nyuma yo kwemeranya n’urubuga runyuzwaho ibiganiro na filime kuri murandasi rwa Netflix, Barack Obama n’umugore we Michelle Obama bagiye gutangira gutambutsa filime yabo ya mbere y’uruhererekane (série). Iyi filime y’uruhererekane y’uwahoze uyobora Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Barack Obama n’umufasha we Michelle bagiye gutangiza izaba igamije ahanini kwigisha uburyo buboneye bwo kurya. "Listen to Your Vegetables & Eat Your Parents" ni ryo zina ryahawe iyi filime y’uruhererekane aho buri gace (épisode) kazaba kagizwe n’iminota 30, ahanini ikazafasha abana kumenya gufata mu buryo bwiza amafunguro n’ingaruka bigira ku buzima bwabo.

Barack Obama n’umufasha we Michelle ni umwe mu muryango ukunzwe cyane muri Amerika Uyu muryango usanzwe wariyemeje kurwanya umubyibuho ukabije (obésité), uhamya ko uyu mushinga wabo mushya wa filime uzafasha abana n’ababyeyi babo kubigisha nkuko urubuga Eater rwabitangaje. Bivugwa ko mu gukora iyi filime bazibanda mu kugaragaza inkomoko y’amafunguro atandukanye aho bazagenda basura imiryango inyuranye yo hirya no hino ku isi. Gusa nubwo byatangajwe ko ibice bya mbere by’iyi filime bizaba byasohotse mu gihe cya vuba, ntabwo itariki nyirizina yahise itangazwa.

Barack Obama na Michelle bazajya banatambutsa ibiganiro na filime zisanzwe kuri Netflix Muri Gicurasi umwaka ushize ni bwo Barack Obama n’umugore we Michelle basinye amasezerano y’imyaka myinshi hamwe na Netflix yo gukora filime n’ibiganiro. Nk’uko icyo gihe Netflix yari yabitangaje, ngo bazategura ibiganiro bitandukanye birimo filime z’uruhererekane (series), filime mbarankuru ndetse na filime zisanzwe.

Umwaka ushize, Netflix yemeje ko yagiranye amasezerano na Barack Obama na Michelle Obama Tubibutse ko imibare yo muri Mata uyu mwaka yagaragaje ko uru rubuga rwa Netflix  rufite abasaga miliyoni 148 baherereye mu bice bitandukanye by’isi barukurikiraniraho filime n’ibiganiro mu buryo bwo kwishyura harimo miliyoni 60 ziherereye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.

title: Umunyamakuru wa BBC yirukanwe nyuma yo kugereranya umwana wa Prince Harry na Meghan ’n’inguge’
content:
Umunyamakuru wa BBC Radio 5 live, witwa Danny Baker yirukanwe mu kazi kubera ubutumwa (post) yanyujije kuri konti ye ya Twitter avuga ku mwana uheruka kwibarukwa n’Igikomangoma Harry na Meghan Markle. Ku wa Mbere w’iki Cyumweru tariki ya 06 Gicurasi 2019 ni bwo uyu muryango w’I Bwami wibarutse umwana w’umuhungu w’imfura yabo aho nyuma y’iminsi ibiri bibarutse batangaje ko bamwise Archie uyu akaba ari umuragwa wa 7 mu rutonde rw’Abami b’Ubwongereza. "umwana w’ibwami yavuye mu bitaro", aya ni yo magambo uyu munyamakuru yakoresheje maze ayaherekeresha ifoto iri mu ibara ry’umweru n’umukara igaragaza umugore n’umugabo basa nk’abasohoka mu nzu, umugore afashe mu ntoki inguge nayo yambaye imyambaro.

Ifoto uyu munyamakuru yakoresheje igatungura benshi bigafatwa nk’ivanguraruhu Uyu munyamakuru w’imyaka 61 y’amavuko wari usanzwe ukora ikiganiro cyo muri weekend, yahise ashinjwa kuba yaninuraga uyu mwana amugereranya n’inguge kubera ivanguraruhu kuko nyina Meghan Markle afite amaraso y’abirabura dore ko nyina umubyara ari umwiraburakazi w’umunyamerika (afro-américaine).

Archie yamurikiwe abantu kuri uyu wa Gatatu Umuvugizi wa BBC yavuze ko "Baker yakoze ikosa rikomeye ndetse yanyuranyije bikomeye n’indangagaciro twifuza kwimakaza imbere nk’igitangazamakuru." Uyu munyamakuru Danny Baker yaje guhita yisegura kuri ibi yatangaje kuri Twitter ye, avuga ko ari ubucucu kandi yabihubukiye, gusa nanone anenga icyemezo BBC yafashe cyo kumwirukana.

Nyina wa Meghan Markle hamwe n’umukobwa we n’Igikomangoma Harry Ni ku nshuro ya kabiri uyu munyamakuru ukunze kugaragaza imyitwarire idasanzwe, yirukanwe n’iyi shene ya 5 live, ikaba inshuro ya gatatu muri rusange yirukanwa na BBC. Mu 1997 yirukanwe na BBC azira gushishikariza abafana ba ruhago guhindura ubuzima bw’umusifuzi ikuzimu, uyu yari yatanze penaliri itaravuzweho rumwe mu mukino wa FA Cup. Mu 2012, ibyumweru bibiri mbere yo kumurikwa kuri Radio Hall of Fame, yaje gusezera ndetse atuka abayobozi be ba BBC Londres abaziza kumusaba gukora ikiganiro mu minsi y’imibyizi n’ikindi muri weekend.

Umunyamakuru Danny Baker

title: Umunyamakuru Usher Olivier agiye kurushingana n’umunyarwandakazi utuye muri Norvège
content:
Mu mpera z’umwaka ushize ni bwo Kagiraneza Olivier bamwe bazi ku izina rya ’Usher’, uyu akaba ari umunyamakuru wakoze igihe kinini ku Izuba Rirashe, yateye ivi asaba umukunzi we Munezero Liliane kumubera umugore, undi abyemera atazuyaje, none ubu imyiteguro y’ubukwe bwabo irarimbanije. Nyuma y’uko tariki ya 11 Ukuboza 2018 aba bombi basezeranye imbere y’amategeko mu muhango wabereye i Kampala muri Ambasade ya Norvège dore ko uyu mukunzi we asanzwe atuye muri iki gihugu, kuri ubu bamaze gusohora impapuro (invitation) zitumira inshuti n’abavandimwe mu bukwe nyirizina bwabo.

Ubwo Usher Olivier na Munezero Liliane basezeranaga kubana mu mategeko Nkuko bigaragara kuri ubu butumire biteganijwe ko tariki ya 14 Nyakanga 2019 ari bwo ubu bukwe buzataha aho ku isaha ya saa tatu (9h00) hazaba imihango yo gusaba no gukwa ikabera mu busitani bwo kwa Rujugiro mu rugo i Gikondo, aha ni naho bzasezeranira imbere y’Imana ku isaha ya saa munani (14h00), maze nyuma y’iyo mihango abatumiwe bakirirwe n’ubundi muri ubu busitani.

Kagiraneza Olivier yabaye umunyamakuru w’imyidagaduro igihe kinini ku kinyamakuru Izuba Rirashe Mu kiganiro twagiranye na Usher Olivier nyuma yo gushyira hanze ubutumire, yavuze ko yishimiye cyane uyu munsi udasanzwe mu buzima bwe. Ati "Ndumva nishimye cyane, azaba ari umunsi udasanzwe mu buzima bwanjye kuko bizaba bibaye ubwa kabiri nishimye nyuma yo gusoza kaminuza. Muri make umutima wanjye uranezerewe!"

title: Filime iterwa inkunga na Selana Gomez yongereye kwiyahura kw’abana
content:
Kuva filime ’13 Reasons Why’, ivuga iby’inkuru y’umwana w’umunyeshuri wiyahura, yajya ahagaragara mu mwaka wa 2017, benshi bagiye bahangayikishwa n’ingaruka izagira ku bakiri bato ndetse ubushakashatsi bukaba bigaragaza ko ari nyinshi cyane. Jeffrey Bridge n’itsinda ry’ibitaro by’abana bya Nationwide muri Ohio muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika bakoze ubushakashatsi ku kwiyahura kwabaye hagati ya tariki ya 1 Mutarama, 2013 n’iya 31 Ukuboza, 2017, imibare igaragaza ko hapfuye abagera ku 180.655. Iyi mibare igaragaza ko ku bana bari hagati y’imyaka 10 na 17 kwiyahura kwariyongereye cyane kuva ubwo iyi filime yashyirwaga kuri Netflix muri Werurwe, 2017. Ukwezi kwa Mata ko ubwako kwabonetsemo umubare munini cyane w’abana biyahuye nk’uko ubu bushakashatsi bukomeza kubigaragaza.

 Ngo iyi filime yateye abana kumva ko kwiyahura byaba igisubizo cy’ibibazo bahura nabyo  Abakoze ubu bushakashatsi bavuga ko guhera igihe iyi filime yagiriye ahagaragara kwiyahura kw’abana bari hagati y’imyaka 10 na 17 kwiyongereyeho 29%. Nubwo muri iyi filime ari umwana w’umukobwa wiyahura ndetse benshi bakaba baribwiraga ko bizatuma ingaruka nyinshi ziba ku bana b’abakobwa, si uko byagenze ahubwo abahungu nibo babaye benshi. Dr Bridge ahamya ko filime ’13 Reasons Why’ yagize uruhare cyane muri uku kwiyongera kw’abiyahura, dore ko igaragaza neza uburyo uyu mwana w’umukobwa yiyahura, mu buryo burimo ibikabyo bidafite aho bihuriye n’ubuzima nyakuri. "Ni ibintu bishobora gutera ihungabana uwaba afite uwe wiyahuye cyangwa se n’uwagerageje ubwe kwiyahura, nk’uko bishobora no kubera urugero abandi." Dr Bridge

 Kuba igaragaza neza uburyo uyu mwana yakoresheje nabyo byongerera abana kubona ko byoroshye  Netflix yamaze gushyira ahagaragara season ya 3 y’iyi filime yatangarije AFP ko igiye gukurikirana neza iby’ubu bushakashatsi hanyuma igafata umwanzuro imaze kubyigaho neza. Nubwo atagaragara mu bakinnyi bayo, umuririmbyikazi akaba n’umukinnyi wa filime, Selena Gomez agira uruhare rukomeye mu ikorwa ry’iyi filime, dore ko ari umwe mu bayiha umurongo ndetse agatangamo n’amafaranga.

 Selena Gomez ni umuterankunga ukomeye w’iyi filime ndetse ahamya ko ari umushinga umukoze ku mutima cyane

title: Ibi byamamare ni inshuti magara (AMAFOTO)
content:
I Hollywood biba bigoye cyane kubona mu bantu barwanira ubukire no kwamamara habonekamo inshuti, nyamara mu buryo butunguranye muri iyi ntambara hagiye haboneka inshuti ndetse zikaba inshuti magara. Muri izi nshuti harimo abamenyanye hanze ya sinema nk’uko hari n’abamenyaniye mu ifatwa rya filime bikarangira babaye inshuti magara. Dore urutonde rwa bamwe mu byamamare b’inshuti z’akadasohoka ndetse magara. Taylor Swift na Selena Gomez

 Aba baririmbyikazi ndetse bakaba n’abakinnyi ba filime, ni bamwe mu bafite amazina akomeye I Hollywood, ariko ntibibabuza kuba inshuti magara. Jennifer Aniston na Courteney Cox


Aba bagore bombi, bamenyanye ubwo bakinaga filime ’Friends’ yanatumye bombi bamenyekana cyane mu ruhando rwa sinema, ariko kandi kuva ubwo, ni inshuti magara. Brad Pitt na George Clooney  


Aba bagabo bahuriye muri filime nyinshi ndetse bagahuza n’urukundo rwa moto, ukwamamara kwabo ntikubabuza kuba inshuti magara. Rihanna na Katy Perry


Aba baririmbyikazi bombi bafite amazina akomeye muri muzika mpuzamahanga, ni inshuti magara. Sandra Bullock na Ryan Reynolds


Sandra na Ryan bamenyanye ubwo bahuriraga muri filime ’La proposition’ mu mwaka wa 2008, guhera ubwo ni inshuti z’akadasohoka. Victoria Beckham na Eva Longoria


Umunyamiderikazi, umuririmbyi akaba n’umugore w’icyamamare muri ruhago Victoria Beckham ni inshuti magara y’umukinnyi wa filime Eva Longoria, ndetse Eva yabyaye Harper, umuhungu wa Beckham muri batisimu. Blake Lively na Florence Welch  


Byatangiye Blake ari umufana wa Florence, nyuma baza guhurira muri filime ’Gossip Girl’, guhera ubwo baba inshuti zikomeye ndetse Florence yaririmbye mu bukwe bwa Blake na Ryan Reynolds. Jessica Biel na Jennifer Garner


Biel, umugore wa Justin Timberlake na Garner wahoze ari umugore wa Ben Affleck ni inshuti magara ndetse, Biel we ahamya ko afata Garner nk’urugero akurikiza mu buzima bwe. Leonardo Di Caprio na Tobey Maguire


Aba bakinnyi ba filime ni inshuti kuva kera dore ko bahuye mu minsi yabo ya mbere bagerageza kwinjira muri sinema. Selena Gomez na Vanessa Hudgens


Aba bakinnyi ba filime bamaze igihe kitari gito ari inshuti zikomeye, dore ko batangiye kuba inshuti ubwo bakoranaga filime za Disney. Drew Barrymore na Cameron Diaz


Aba bakinnyi ba filime bombi baziranye guhera mu bwangavu bwabo. Ni inshuti zikomeye.

title: Miss Muhikira wari uherutse kurushinga na mukuru wa Buravan yitabye Imana
content:

Amakuru Kigali Post yabashije kumenya ni uko nyakwigendera wari waranabaye Nyampinga wa kaminuza ya UNILAK, yaguye mu bitaro biri muri Angola aho yabanaga n’umugabo we Burabyo Ghislain, uyu akaba ari mukuru w’umuhanzi Burabyo Yvan (Buravan). Nyakwigendera hari hashize amezi asaga 9 arushinze na mukuru wa Buravan

Yvan Buravan ni umwe mu basore bari babambariye mu bukwe bwabo bwo ku ya 28 Nyakanga 2018

title: Kigali: Itsinda Souls rikora ubugeni bwo gushushanya ryateguye ’exhibition’
content:
Souls ni itsinda rigizwe n’abanyabugeni batatu bakora ibyitwa ’Street painting’ aho bashushanya ku nkuta, kuri ubu bakaba bateguriye abakunzi b’ubu buhanzi imurika (exhibition) bise ’Colors of a Soul’. Aba banyabugeni barimo Dukuzumuremyi Hamza, Salma Seif na Shingiro Ntigurirwa bihuje mu mwaka wa 2016, biha intego yo kwigisha no gutanga ubutumwa muri sosiyete binyuze mu bugeni bwabo.

Abagize itsinda Souls

Biyemeje gutambutsa ubutumwa bwigisha babinyujije bu buhanzi bw’ubugeni Iri murika abagize ’Souls’ bateguye rizamara icyumweru, bikaba biteganijwe ko rigomba gutangira kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 04 Gicurasi 2019, ku isaha ya saa kumi n’ebyiri, rikazasozwa ku ya 11 Gicurasi 2019.
 Mu kiganiro twagiranye n’umwe mu bagize iri tsinda witwa Salma Seif yadutangarije ko intego y’iki gikorwa bateguye ari ugusangiza urubyiruko impano zabo no kubakangurira kwitinyuka bagakora cyane kuko byose birashoboka. Ati "Tuzagerageza no gufasha ababa bumva bafite impano yubugeni(art painting) ariko bagifite ubwoba. Ubusanzwe dukora street painting ku nkuta ni ubwa mbere dukoreye kuri canvas ikaba ari nayo exhibition ya mbere dukoze kuva itsinda ryatangira."

Bafite ubuhanga mu bugeni bwo gushushanya ku nkuta Tubabwire ko iki gikorwa bari gutegura kizabera ku Gishushu ahitwa kwa Buregeya Art Studio ahateganye na Question Coffee (Q), bakazafatanya na Nat Kristyan.

title: Turaza kubireba neza niba koko Gahongayire ntacyo tumumariye -Ikiganiro n’Urugaga rw’Abanyamakuru b’Imyidagaduro
content:
"Ntawumuhatiye gusaba imbabazi, ariko yisuzume!", aya ni amwe mu magambo Kigali Post yatangarijwe na Joel Rutaganda umunyamakuru wa City Radio uhagarariye Urugaga rw’Abanyamakuru b’Imyidagaduro ubwo yakomozaga ku itangazo uru rugaga rwashyize hanze bamagana amagambo yatangajwe na Aline Gahongayire. Ni nyuma y’uko uyu muhanzikazi wamamaye mu ndirimbo zo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana hano mu Rwanda, Aline Gahongayire yumvikanye atanga ubuhamya avuga ko atari ku rwego rw’itangazamakuru ryo mu Rwanda ari nayo mpamvu iby’isenyuka ry’urugo rwe yagiye Washington DC kubibwira Voice of Amerika, ibitangazamakuru byose byo mu Rwanda akaba ariho bibikura.

Aline Gahongayire aherutse gutanga ubuhamya bwafashwe nk’ubwo kwishongora ku bantu by’umwihariko itangazamakuru ryo mu Rwanda Mu itangazo ryasohowe kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, Urugaga rw’Abanyamakuru b’Imyidagaduro mu Rwanda rwavuze ko babajwe cyane n’amashusho yakomeje kuzenguruka ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ’Aline Gahongayire yishongora ndetse anasebya itangazamakuru ry’u Rwanda’. Iri tangazo ryasinyweho na Joel Rutaganda uhagarariye uru rugaga rikomeza ryemeza ko itangazamakuru ry’imyidagaduro ryagize uruhare runini mu kumenyekanisha ibihangano by’uyu muhanziakazi n’abandi bahanzi nyarwanda muri rusange kandi ritazatezuka kuri iyo ntego ryirengagije abafite imyumvire nk’iyi yagaragajwe na Gahongayire. Iri tangazo kandi risaba abanyarwanda kudaha agaciro ibyo uyu muhanzikazi yatangaje kuko byuzuye ’isebanya n’ubwibone bushingiye ku myumvire’.

Itangazo ryasohowe n’Urugaga rw’Abanyamakuru b’Imyidagaduro mu Rwanda Mu kiganiro Kigali Post twagiranye na Joel Rutaganda wakoreye ibitangazamakuru bitandukanye birimo Igihe, Umuseke, ubu akaba ari kuri City Radio yashimangiye ibikubiye muri iyi baruwa, bavuga ko batari kureka ngo ubutumwa bwa Gahongayire buhite ntacyo babuvuzeho mu gihe baziko yirengagije ukuri.

Joel Rutaganda Mu magambo ye, Rutaganda yagize ati "Nta muntu udakosa ariko biriya yakoze biratanga isomo, ko umuntu uziko ari indorerwamo ya rubanda niba agiye imbere y’abantu agomba kuba yabanje gutegura neza ibyo ari buvuge ntahubuke ngo atwarwe n’intekerezo ze.". Joel Rutaganda yakomeje avuga ko batagamije gusaba Gahongayire guca bugufi agasaba imbabazi, ariko ko abonye bikwiye yabikora. Ati "Niba yumva ko nta kazi twigeze tumukorera, nta bufasha, nta kintu twigeze tumumarira….hari ibintu byinshi yirengagije. Ni yo mpamvu rero twavuze ko nk’umuntu natekereza akumva hari ikosa afite azabibwire abanyarwanda, niyumva ntakosa afite ntawumuhatira cyangwa umutegeka kuba yasaba imbabazi cyangwa kuba yakumva iryo kosa." Yasoje agira ati "Ubwo kandi niba nta kamaro tumumariye n’ubundi ubwo turaza kubireba neza niba koko ntacyo tumumariye." Tubibutse ko iyi mvugo ya Aline Gahongayire yakiriwe nk’iy’ubwishongozi no kwirata yayitangaje ubwo yatangaga ubuhamya mu gikorwa cyiswe ’Because there is hope’ tariki 19 Mata 2019. Aha yumvikanye avuga ati "Hanyuma bakambaza ngo ‘nyuma y’ibyakubayeho uzarongorwa?’ (…) Gute ntarongorwa se? Nabibajijwe hehe (…) Voice of America. Njyewe nari kubivugira muri radiyo za hano? Jamais (ntibibaho)! Voice of America. Bakajya bavuga ngo ‘bitangazwa na Voice of America…’ ariko umva ibyo bintu!" Yongeraho ati "Nyine! I was there (nari mpari), Washington DC. Ntabwo nari ndi hano ku Isango Star. Ni yo mpamvu n’ujya kubimbaza, tugomba kuba turi mu rwego rumwe. title: Umunyamakuru Christelle yabaye iciro ry’imigani kubera kuza mu kiganiro kuri Televiziyo y’igihugu yasinze
content:
Kabagire Christelle, umunyamakurukazi usanzwe akorera Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Itangazamakuru (RBA), akomeje kuba iciro ry’imigani nyuma yaho agaragaye kuri televiziyo y’igihugu agwirirana anavuga amateshwa kandi ururimi rudasohoka kubera isindwe. Ibi byabaye ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 26 Mata 2019 ubwo yari mu kiganiro The Jam asanzwe akorana na Dj Bissosso.

Kabagire ntiyorohewe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga Abari bakurikiye iki kiganiro batunguwe no kubona uyu munyamakurukazi atungutse mu kiganiro atangira kuvuga ahuzagurika, anavuga ibintu bidahuye. Muri iki kiganiro bari batumiye itsinda ry’abanyarwenya Day Makers. Christelle yavuze inkuru nyinshi azivangavanga mu gihe gito, ariko yitsa cyane kuri Diamond na Zari. Yavuze uburyo Zari ari umugore udasobanutse. Mbere yaho yabanje akomoza kuri Dj Bissosso, ati "Turi kumwe na Dj Bissosso ukora akazi kadasanzwe, asetsa abantu mu buryo budashobotse, agasetsa abantu badashaka guseka ariko akabasetsa ku ngufu…" Ururimi rudasohoka yongeye ati "Mbere y’uko dukomeza, reka tugaruka kuri Zari, umugore udasobanutse, yakundanye n’umuntu bita Diamond Platnumz…ariko aramuhiga hejuru no hasi, hirya y’ejo yerekanye amafoto y’ukuntu afite umugabo mushya umuha indabyo ….cheri uzi gutanga indabyo ugatanga n’ibihumbi 5000 by’amadorali?! Byaraducanze ariko ndavuga nti ariko se Zari bimeze gute? Aravuga ngo umugabo yarankunze arashaka no kuzankoresha ubukwe ariko ndacyabitekerezaho, ubukwe bwanjye nzabuhe valeur (agaciro) y’amafaranga angana gute?" Yahise abaza umwe muri iri tsinda ry’abanyarwenya ati "Urumva ko Zari amafaranga yaha valeur y’ubukwe bwe bwaba buhagaze gute? Tubwire byinshi kuri byo ndabizi ko Zari bashobora kuba bafite piscine mu rugo iwe, ziriya ndabyo zizakura, zishobora no kubyara abana!" 
Uyu munyamakurukazi yabaye iciro ry’imigani Hari amakuru Kigali Post ifite avuga ko ubwo Christelle yageraga ku kazi yari yangiwe gukora iki kiganiro kuko abakiyobora babonaga yaganjwe na manyinya ariko akomeza guhatiriza ndetse abaca mu rihumye ubwo ikiganiro cyarimo kiba (Live) abatumirwa bari kumwe na Dj Bissosso, nawe aba arahasesekaye afata micro. Mu mashusho yashyizwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, benshi bagaragaje ko banenze cyane uyu munyamakuru utiyubashye ntiyubahe na televiziyo y’igihugu.



 Kugeza ubu, ubuyobozi bw’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Itangazamakuru, RBA natacyo buratangaza kuri ibi byabaye.

title: Uwahoze ari umurinzi wa Michael Jackson yakomoje ku rukundo yakundaga ’princesse Diana’
content:
Matt Fiddes yabaye umurinzi w’umwami w’injyana ya Pop, Michael Jackson mu gihe cy’imyaka 10. Nyuma y’igihe kinini yarifashe akanga kugira ikintu na kimwe atangaza ku buzima bw’uyu muhanzi, kuri ubu yatoboye atangaza byinshi. Ku bwe uyu mugabo nkuko yabitangaje asanga igihe kigeze ngo ’arengere inshuti ye’. "Michael Jackson iteka yabaye umuntu mwiza cyane ku muryango wanjye hamwe no ku bakozi be muri rusange. Numva ibimuvugwaho kuva mu myaka ishize, ariko abantu bashaka kwibagirwa ko kubera uburyo yari icyamamare bituma yibasirwa cyane.", amagambo Matt Fiddes yanyujije ku mbuga ze nkoranyambaga.

Michael Jackson na Matt Fiddes wahoze ari ’ Uyu murinzi yasangiye ubuzima na nyakwigendera Michael Jackson mu myaka ye ya nyuma y’ubuzima ku isi. Avuga ko nkuko yarinze ubuzima bwe bwite akiri mu isi y’abazima, ubu atagihari nabwo afite inshingano zo kurinda ibigwi n’umurage yasize. Yari yaranze na rimwe kugira icyo atangariza abanyamakuru bifuzaga kuganira nawe (interview), ariko filime mbarankuru "Leaving Neverland" iherutse gusohoka ivuga kuri uyu muhanzi aharimo ibirego bishya bivuga ko yahohoteye abana b’abahungu, yatumye uyu murinzi yemera kugira icyo avuga arengera uwahoze ari sebuja.
 Matt Fiddes yagize ati "Yifuzaga (Michael Jackson) kurinda ubuzima bwe bwite, bugakomeza kuba ubwiru. Ubu ntawugihari ngo abirengere, ariko ukuri kwe kuzahoraho iteka." Michael Jackson iyo aza kuba akiriho ngo yashoboraga gufungwa Matt Fiddes yabwiye Daily Star ko ahamya y’uko "iyo umwami wa Pop (Michael Jackson) aza kuba akiriho byashobokaga cyane ko igihe cyari kugera agafungwa ku cyaha atigeze na rimwe akora." Urukundo Michael Jackson yakundaga igikomangoma Diana Uyu murinzi muri byinshi yatangaje, yanahishuye uburyo nyakwigendera yikundiraga by’ikirenga Princesse Diana umubyeyi wa Prince Harry na William, wabaye umugore w’igikomangoma Charles umuhungu w’imfura w’Umwamikazi w’Ubwongereza Elizabeth II. Yagize ati "Michael yambwiye ko yakundaga by’ikirenga igikomangoma Diana. Yifuzaga kumushaka akamubera umugore, kuko kuri we yari yujuje iby’umugore w’indoto ze. Kuri we, Diana yari umuntu umwe rukumbi washoboraga mu by’ukuri kumwumva kuko yabaga ahigwa iteka n’abagafotozi. Bombi bagiraga amasonisoni (bari bacecetse) cyane."

Princess Diana ngo yakundwaga cyane na Michael Jackson wumvaga yamurongora akamugira umugore Ikindi gitangaje uyu murinzi yavuze ngo ni uko ashobora kuba ari we se wa Blancket (Prince Michael Jackson II), umwana w’umuhererezi wa Michael Jackson. Ibi abishingira kuba mu 2001 uyu muhanzi yaramusabye kumuha impano y’intangangabo ndetse amwishyura asaga miliyari 500 mu mafaranga y’u Rwanda, ariko undi arayanga amwemerera kuzimuha ku buntu, gusa ngo Michael Jackson yaje kumubwira ko uyu mwana ari uwundi muntu, ibintu n’ubu agishidikanyaho.

Uyu mwana ngo ashobora kuba atari uwa Michael Jackson ahubwo ari uwa Matt Fiddes

Matt Fiddes yari umurinzi w’umwizerwa wa Michael Jackson ariko avuga ko ashobora kuba yaramunyanganyije umwana

title: Ubutumwa bwa Anita Pendo kuri se w’abana be wizihiza isabukuru, batakibana
content:
Umunyamakuru, umushyushyabirori akanaba umuhanga mu kuvangavanga imiziki (Dj), MC Anita Pendo, kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 25 Mata 2019 yifurije isabukuru nziza Nzeyimana Alphonse bakunze kwita Ndanda, babyaranye abana babiri b’abahungu. Nubwo batabashije guhuza ngo bakomeze inzira y’urukundo bari baratangiye, Anita Pendo yagaragaje ko yubahira Ndanda ko ari se w’’abana be babiri maze amugenera ubutumwa bumwereka ko bari kumwe kuri uyu munsi udasanzwe mu buzima bwe. Ni ubutumwa yanyujije kuri konti ye ya Instagram, ariko mu gutebya avuga ko atari we wabwanditse ahubwo yatije abana be telefone, bakaba aribo bandika bifuriza se isabukuru nziza. Anita Pendo yagize ati "Isabukuru nziza kuri se w’abahungu banjye…ndakwifuriza ibyiza, amahirwe, iterambere, imigisha, amahoro no kurama." Yongeyeho ati "Tiran na Ryan (abana babo) nubwo bataramenya kuvuga ariko ndabizi ko bakwifuriza ibyiza gusa..ntiwiyime kabisa ..iyi message yanditswe na Tiran na Ryan nabatije phone."

Ubutumwa bwa Anita yabuherekeresheje ifoto ya Ndanda ari kumwe n’imfura yabo Tiran yabonye izuba ku ya 29 Kanama 2017 Urukundo hagati ya Anita Pendo na Ndanda rwatangiye kwigaragaza ku mbuga nkoranyambaga mu mpera za 2016, ubwabo bashimangira ko biheberanye mu ntangiriro za 2017, ariko ubwo yari atwite imfura yabo hatangiye kugenda havugwa umwuka utari mwiza hagati yabo ndetse bagiye bashwana mu bihe bitandukanye bakongera bakiyunga. Gusa mu Ukwakira 2018 nyuma gato yo kwibaruka umwana wabo wa kabiri nibwo uyu mugabo yahishuye ko atakibana mu nzu na Anita ko ubu basigaye bahujwe n’abana babo.

Anita Pendo na Ndanda usanzwe ari umuzamu wa AS Kigali bakanyujijeho mu rukundo rwanabahaye imbuto z’abana babiri b’abahungu

title: Hakoreshejwe ibyuka biryana mu maso, Polisi yataye muri yombi Bobi Wine
content:
Umuririmbyi akaba n’umudepite Bobi Wine yatawe muri yombi na polisi kuri uyu wa mbere, hifashishijwe ibyuka biryana mu maso byatewe abantu benshi bari bamukurikiye ndetse n’imodoka yarimo, bagana aho igitaramo cye cyagombaga kubera. "Yafatiwe mu gace ka Busabala, aho yagombaga kuvugana n’itangazamakuru iby’igitaramo cye cyahagaritswe na polisi. Ntwahamagaye abamuhagarariye mu mategeko (avocats) kugira ngo tubashe kumenya aho bamujyanye" Barbie Itungo Kyagulanyi, umugore wa Bobi Wine Umuvugizi wa polisi ya Uganda we ntiyigeze yemera ko yamutaye muri yombi ariko atangaza ko bamufashe bakamutwara mu modoka.
Umwe mu bateguraga igitaramo ndetse akaba n’umwe mu bashyigikiye cyane Bobi Wine, Moses Mugwanya, wari aho ibi byabereye, yemeza ko "Polisi yinjiye mu modoka yari arimo bamukuramo ku ngufu, bamushyira mu modoka ya polisi baramutwara"
 Yongereyeho ati "Abandi bose bari hafi y’imodoka babaraga cyane kubera ibyuka biryana mu maso bari bateye ahntu hose." Bobi Wine yari yateguye gukora igitaramo mu kabyiniro ke ke kari ku nkengero z’ikiraga cya Victoria. Ubuyobozi bwahagaritse iki gitaramo buvuga ko hatari umutekano uhagije. Kuba Bobie yashakaga kujya aho iki gitaramo nibyo byatumye polisi ihita imuta muri yombi.

title: Game of Thrones: Jon Snow yenze gucika agasabo k’intanga
content:
Mu gihe hafatwaga amashusho ya saison ya 8 ya filime "Game of Thrones", Kit Harrington ukina yitwa Jon Snow yakoze impanuka yari igiye gutuma atakaza agasabo k’intanga kamwe (testicule) Hari mu ntangiriro rya saison ya 8, ubwo Jon Snow yicaye kuri dragon; nubwo muri filime bigaragara neza mu by’ukuri ntibyamworoheye ndetse byenze no kumwangiriza imyanya yibanga. Mu gihe hafatwaga amashusho, Snow ntiyicaye kuri dragon ahubwo yicaye ku ifarasi y’icyuma. "Ntabwo biba byoroshye. Ntekereza igisobanura neza uko byangendekeye, ni igihe nagombaga gukora nkaho Jon agiye kugwa.Dragon yahengamiye uruhande rumwe hanyuma agasabo kanjye k’intanga gafatwa mu kintu. Sinashoboraga kuvuga ngo bahagarike kandi byakomezaga kwizunguza mu mpande zose."


  Kit Harrington akina yitwa Jon Snow   Arakomeza ati "Mu mutwe wanjye naribwiraga nti ’ Birabaye, ni uku bigiye kurangira, kuri iyi farasi y’icyuma, nicundacunda mu mpande zose nitendetse ku dusabo tw’intanga’." Siwe gusa wagiriye ibibazo mu ifatwa ry’amashusho y’iyi filime kuko na Emilia Clarke ukina yitwa Daenerys yigeze guhanuka ku ifarasi.
