title: Yvan Buravan yataramiye i Paris anashyikirizwa igihembo cye cya Prix Découvertes RFI 2018
content:
Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 16 Mata 2019, Yvan Buravan yakoreye igitaramo i Paris aho mbere yo gutaramira abafana bari baje kumushyigikira yabanje akanashyikirizwa igihembo yegukanye cya Prix Découvertes RFI 2018. Tariki 8 Ugushyingo 2018 ni bwo Yvan Buravan yegukanye iki gihembo nyuma yo guhigika abandi bahanzi barenga 1000 bari bagihataniye bo muri Afurika ikoresha igifaransa. 

Iki gihembo yagishyikirijwe na Cecile Magie, umuyobozi wa Radio Mpuzamahanga y’Abafaransa, RFI Iki gitaramo yakoreye i Paris cyari gikurikiye ibindi 12 yakoze muri uyu mwaka mu bihugu bitandukanye bya Afurika nka kimwe mu bihembo yahawe byo kuzenguruka amenyekanisha ibihangano bye. Ibi byiyongeraho igihembo nyamukuru cy’ibihumbi 10 by’amadorali ya Amerika.
 Mu gitaramo yakoreye i Paris, Buravan yari ashyigikiwe n’abiganjemo umuryango nyarwanda utuye mu Bufaransa harimo abazwi nka Ben Kayiranga na Miss Akiwacu Colombe. Mu gihe kirenga isaha yamaze abatamiye yaririmbye indirimbo ze zitandukanye zakunzwe cyane zo kuri album ye Love Lab.

Yvan Buravan yihanganishije abafaransa kubera gushya kwa Kiliziya Notre-Dame de Paris, anaboneraho gusaba abitabiriye igitaramo cye gufata umunota umwe wo kwibuka inzirakarengane zazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994

Yvan Buravan n’abacuranzi be bashimishije cyane abitabiriye iki gitaramo

Uyu mugabo yazamutse ku rubyiniro afasha Buravan guhamiriza gitore bishimisha benshi

Igitaramo cyarangiye, abitabiriye bagishaka gutarama Reba hano uko iki gitaramo cyagenze n’uburyo Yvan Buravan yashyikirijwe igihembo cye

title: Kwibuka 25: Ishavu rya Senderi wamenye umubabaro ukomeye nyina yishwemo
content:
Umuhanzi Eric Nzaramba uzwi cyane nka Senderi International Hits ari mu gahinda gakomeye cyane nyuma yo kumenya neza uburyo nyina yishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ni nyuma y’ubuhamya bwatanzwe n’umwe mu barokokeye muri Paruwasi ya Nyarubuye aho umubyeyi wa Senderi yiciwe, wagarutse ku buryo uyu mubyeyi yamaze igihe kinini atarashiramo umwuka. Nyuma yo kumva ubu buhamya, Senderi yongeye gusubira inyuma cyane, agahinda ke kikuba inshuro nyinshi kubwo kumva urupfu rwuje umubabaro mwinshi nyina yapfiriyemo. Abicishije kuri Instagram Senderi yanditse ubutumwa bw’agahinda kenshi, ati "Mama, Uyunsi nibwo menye neza amakuru y’uko bakwishe. Nari nzi neza ko wiciwe muri Kiriziya ya Nyarubuye. Ndagushimira Ngabire kuba waduhaye ubuhamya, bitumye menya ukuri neza nyuma y’imyaka 25. Mama nogeye kugira agahinda. Narinzi ko bakwishe ugahita ufpa, ariko natunguwe nuko wamaze iminsi ine utabaza bagutemye uteguka. Namenye neza ko wishwe n’igitero cyanyuma cyazanye urusenda na aside mu mirambo myinshi mwari kumwe. Namenye neza ko wishwe bwanyuma sa yine za mugitondo. Namenye neza ko bucura yarakuryamye mugituza ariko we yahise afpa ako kanya; namenye neza uko bakwishe wambaye .Namenye ko n’imyenda wari wambaye bukeye abagore b’interahamwe baje kuyigucuza barayitwara. Hari ibindi namenye kubo mwicanwe ntarondora hano. Nasubiye inyuma mu mutima. Ntibyoroshye kubyakira."

 Senderi afite agahinda gakomeye  I Nyarubuye habereye ubwicanyi bukomeye bwuje ubunyamaswa aho batemaguraga abantu, amaraso yabo agashyirwa mu muvure, bakarya imitima yabo babanje kuyisya ngo amaraso yabo atazabahama. Mu bundi bugome bari bafite ngo ni uko bamenaga urusenda na aside (acid) mu mirambo kugira ngo bamenye abakiri bazima.

title: Ubwongereza: Umunyarwenya yapfiriye ku rubyiniro abantu bakeka ko ari urwenya
content:
Umunyarwenya w’Umwongereza, Ian Cognito yapfuye ubwo yari imbere y’abantu mu gitaramo mu majyepfo y’Ubwongereza ahitwa Bicester mu kabari kitwa The Atic. Uyu musaza w’imyaka 60 y’amavuko akaba yaritabye Imana ku wa Kane w’iki cyumweru turi gusoza azize indwara y’umutima. Uwari wateguye iki gitaramo, Andrew Bird yabwiye BBC ko Ian Cognito mbere yo kujya ku rubyiniro yumvaga atameze neza ariko akomeza gusaba ko yabanza akajya gutaramira abafana akabona kujya kwivuza. Ubwo yari imbere yabo (abafana) ngo yavuze atebya akomoza ku buzima bwe yumvaga butameze neza , ati "Mutekereze ndamutse mfiriye imbere yanyu!" 

 Yabanje kubicamo amarenga, abantu bagira ngo ni urwenya yateguye  Nyuma yaho yahise yicara hasi amara iminota myinshi atavuga ariko abitabiriye iki gitaramo bo bakomeza guseka cyane bibwira ko ari umwe mu mikino yabateguriye, nyamara byari byarangiye.

title: Ubuhamya bwa Ally Soudy wavuze uko interahamwe zabakuye mu kazu k’imbwa bari bihishemo
content:
Mu gihe u Rwanda n’abanyarwanda muri rusange binjiye mu cyumweru cyo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 25 Jenosde yakorewe Abatutsi, benshi bakomeje gutanga ubutumwa bwo kwifatanya n’abandi muri ibi bihe ndetse n’ubuhamya bw’amateka bibuka banyuzemo. Umunyarwanda utuye muri Amerika, Ally Soudy wamenyekanye mu itangazamakuru nk’umunyamakuru, umuririmbyi n’umushyushyabirori (MC), nawe yaboneyeho atanga ubuhamya bw’inzira y’umusaraba yanyuzemo yanasize abuze benshi mu bo mu muryango we barimo nyina umubyara Wibabara Daphrose, ba nyina wabo, ba se wabo, babyara be, sekuru na nyirakuru n’abandi.

Ally Soudy yabuze nyina ubwo yari afite imyaka 10 gusa y’amavuko Mu butumwa yanyujije kuri konti ye ya Instagram, Ally Soudy yavuze ko ku itariki ya 08 Mata 1994 ari bwo Interahamwe "zaje gutera iwacu zigamije kutwica, twabaga i Kabuga ya Kigali. Twumvishe urusaku rwazo, induru n’uburyo bahondaguraga urupangu rwari rufunze bashaka kurusenya ngo binjire, twahise duca mu gikari dusimbuka urupangu inyuma twese abo mu rugo turi kumwe na mama dore ko yaturerega wenyine kuko uwakamufashije yari yaritabye Imana mu 1993." Yakomeje agira ati "Twarasimbutse tugwa i nyuma mu rugo rw’umuturanyi wari umupasiteri. Kubera ubwoba nawe yagize kuko bari batangiye kudushakisha mu ngo z’abaturanyi yaduhishe mu kazu gato cyane imbwa ye yabagamo ariko itagihari." Ubuhamya bwa Ally Soudy burakomeza ati "Twagiyemo twese kandi dukwirwamo twari abantu bagera kuri 7, maze imbwa(iyi yari iyacu) yaradukurikiye iraza iryama imbere yako kazu yanga kuhava. Twabayemo iminsi ntazi umubare, gusa interahamwe zarazaga gusaka ahantu hose zagera kuri ako kazu imbwa ikabamokera cyane bagasubirayo bavuga ngo ni akazu k’imbwa, ngo Daphrose ntiyakwirwamo n’urubyaro rwe!{}" "Nyuma interahamwe zaje gusaka muri urwo rugo nanone zigeze kuri ka kazu zigira amakenga ziti ni gute iyi imbwa itajya iva hano kandi igahora itumokera cyane? Bafata umwanzuro wo kuyihakura maze bafungura ka kazu badukuramo twese, batangira kutugera amacumu, n’imihoro...Gusa iyo isaha itaragera iba itaragera!", ubuhamya bwa Ally Soudy.

title: Corneille uteganya igitaramo i Kigali, yahishuye uburyo mu bukwe bwe, umugore we yazirikanye umuryango we wishwe muri Jenoside
content:
Nyungura Corneille, azwi nk’umuhanzi w’umunye-Canada ariko ufite inkomoko mu Rwanda ndetse akaba ni umwe mu banyarwanda bagizweho ingaruka n’amateka mabi ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda aho ku myaka 17 gusa y’amavuko yabonye n’amaso ye ababyeyi be n’abavandimwe bose bicwa, akaba ari we urokoka. Corneille usanzwe atuye muri Canada, kuri ubu ari kubarizwa mu Bufaransa aho ari mu bitaramo n’ibikorwa byo kumenyekanisha album ye nshya ’Parce qu’on aime’ ya 8, aha akaba ari naho yanagiranye ikiganiro n’ikinyamakuru "Libération" asubiza ibibazo bitandukanye yabajijwe ku mateka ye, ibyaranze intangiriro y’ubwamamare bwe, indoto ze n’ibindi.

Corneille yakoreye i Gitaramo i Paris kuri uyu wa Gatatu Uyu muhanzi avuga ko yongeye kubona ibyishimo bisendeye nyuma yaho ahuye n’umugore we Sofia de Medeiros bamenyanye mu myaka 16 ishize ubwo bahuriraga mu ifatwa ry’amashusho y’imwe mu ndirimbo zo kuri album ya mbere y’uyu muhanzi ’Parce qu’on vient de loin’ yasohotse mu 2002. Akomoza ku rukundo rwe n’uyu munyamideli w’umunye-Canada ariko ufite n’inkomoko muri Portugal, Corneille yagize ati "Hagati yacu ibintu birikora kandi neza, ntabwo duhatiriza. (…) Ikintu gitangaje nakoze ni ugukunda (tombé amoureux )!"

Corneille n’umugore we Sofia de Medeiros bafatanije kwandika album ye nshya ’Parce qu’on aime’ Corneille wavukiye ahitwa Fribourg-en-Brisgau mu Budage aho ababyeyi be bari baragiye gukurikirana amasomo, yahavuye akiri muto akurira mu Rwanda. Nyina Pascasie na se Emile bari bamwe mu banyarwanda bajijutse kandi b’abanyepolitike. Mu kubavuga yagize ati "Nagize ayo mahirwe yo kutagira ikintu na kimwe mbura no gukundwa n’ababyeyi banjye.", gusa ibintu byaje guhinduka nabi mu ijoro ryo ku wa 15 Mata 1994 ubwo umuryango we wose wicwaga. Ati "Icyo gihe, igice kimwe cyanjye cyarapfuye." Corneille avuga ko yarokowe nuko yari yihishe inyuma y’intebe. Nyuma yaho yahise ahunga aho mu nzira yagiye ahura n’ibindi bizazane birimo kurwara malaria kugeza ubwo yageraga i Düsseldorf mu Budage ahari umuryango w’inshuti z’ababyeyi be kuri ubu afata nk’abe. Ati "Nifuzaga gukora ibishoboka byose ngo mbanyure, ariko urukundo rwinshi rwari rumboshye."

Corneille Nyuma yo kurangiza amashuri yisumbuye mu Budage, nibwo yaje kwerekeza muri Canada aho yize ibijyanye n’itumanaho muri kaminuza ya Concordia i Montréal. Mbere yo kwinjira muri muzika by’umwuga yabanje kuba ushinzwe serivisi z’abakiliya muri Air France ariko aza kwirukanwa kubera gusiba cyane, ari nabwo ’manager’ we icyo gihe yamusabye kudakomeza guta umwanya ahubwo akinjira bya nyabyo mu muziki. Ubwo yahuraga n’abanyamuziki Gage na Gardy ni bwo yahise atangira urundi rugendo rwe rushya ari nabwo benshi mu bakunzi b’umuziki cyane cyane uw’igifaransa bamumenye. Hamwe n’aba basore bashinze itsinda baryita ONE, maze mu 2001 batangira gufashwa na Francis Jullien, uyu ari nawe producer w’inzu y’umuziki (label) akoreramo magingo aya ya ’Wagram’, aho avuga ko nyuma yo kubona Corneille yahise akururwa n’impano ye, imyitwarire n’ikinyabupfura.

Corneille yahishuye ko arota gukorera igitaramo i Nyamirambo kuri stade ya Kigali Muri iki kiganiro, Corneille yongeye kuvuga ko mu Rwanda ari ho hantu hambere yatangiye kugirira inyota yo kuririmba ndetse ngo se wakundaga cyane umuziki yavugaga ko aririmba nka Tracy Chapman, ariko undi ntabyiteho. Ati "Nabashije kubisobanukirwa nyuma ya Jenoside. Wari umuhamagaro w’igeno. Kugira ngo uhange ntabwo ugomba kurota kwishima, ugomba kuba warahuye n’ihungabana." Mu bukwe bwe, umugore we Sofia de Medeiros yatumiye umuryango we wishwe muri Jenoside Corneille iteka ukunda kubazwa ku mubano we n’umugore we Sofia de Medeiros, yanavuze uburyo mu bukwe bwabo uyu mugore we yamutunguye agasiga ameza amwe atariho abantu mu rwego rwo kuzirikana umuryango we wapfuye muri Jenoside nkuko "Libération" yabigarutseho. Corneille ati "Muri ubwo buryo, babashije kwitabira umwe mu minsi myiza y’ubuzima bwanjye."

Barahuye barahuza amufasha kwakira ibyamubayeho akiri muto Mu bindi Corneille yahishuye, uyu mugabo ufatwa nk’umuturage wa Canada, yavuze ko ’atitabira amatora ndetse ntiyizerere muri politike kuko abifata nk’ikinamico cyangwa filime mpamo’. Corneille yasesaguye amafaranga akiba icyamamare Uyu muhanzi yibuka uburyo mu bihe bye bya mbere yasesaguye amafaranga ariko akaba atabyicuza kuko cyari cyo gihe. Ati "Nasesaguye cyane amafaranga mu bintu by’ubucucu ariko nticuza. Ukoresha amafaranga kuko ahari. Naguze Porsche (ubwoko bw’imodoka ziri mu zihenze) mu gihe nta n’ibyangombwa byo kuyitwara (Permit) nagiraga." Igitaramo i Kigali… Mu myaka ya vuba iri imbere, ngo adahatirije igeno rye, Corneille avuga ko arota gukorera igitaramo mu Rwanda kuri stade ya Kigali i Nyamirambo, ariko kandi ikindi kimuraje ishinga ni ukuzahabwa igihembo cya ’prix Goncourt’ gihabwa abanditsi b’intyoza mu Gifaransa dore ko ibijyanye no kwandika nabyo yumva ashaka kubikora ku rwego ruhambaye. Ati "Gufata iri shimwe bizatuma hari icyo niyunguraho mu bwenge. Nabonye ubu buryo bundi bwo gusohora ibikurimo binduhura mu mitekerereze cyane kurusha n’umuziki nubwo mu kwandika habamo imitego myinshi."
 Inkuru y’ikinyamakuru "Libération" isoza ivuga ko Corneille iyo arakaye, umujinya we awutura imifuka ikorerwaho imyitozo y’iteramakofe, ariko ibi ngo bikunze kubaho gake cyane kuko yishimiye ubuzima bwe. Ati "Ndi mu bihe nishimye cyane kuva nabaho. Uyu munsi mfite abana babiri, Merrick [w’imyaka 8] na Mila [w’imyaka 3]. (…) Ikintu kintera ubwoba cyane ni ukubura ikinzanira umunezero: mbese umuryango wanjye."

Corneille, umugore we n’abana babo, ni umuryango unezerewe

title: Asinah yibasiye Riderman aramutuka aramwandagaza
content:
Umuhanzikazi Asinah Erra, kuri ubu uhararanye n’umukinnyi wa Rayon Sports ukomoka muri Ghana, Michael Sarpong, yongeye gutungurana yibasira abasore babiri bahoze bakundana ari bo Riderman na Nazil wo muri Family Squad ndetse n’abandi bakora injyana imwe ya Dancehall. Uyu muhanzi yabikoze abinyujije mu gace gato k’indirimbo yasubiyemo y’umuhanzi wo muri Nigeria, Kiss Daniel yise ’Fuck U’ iharawe cyane muri iyi minsi.

Asinah na Sarpong bahararanye muri iyi minsi Iyi ndirimbo nshya iri kubica bigacika ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, imaze gusubirwamo n’abantu benshi, Asinah akaba yateye ikirenge mu cyabo ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatatu ubwo yashyiraga agace gato kayo kuri konti ye ya Instagram.
 Mu rurimi rw’icyongereza, tugenekereje mu kinyarwanda, Asinah aterura agira ati "Wagombaga kuba uri uwanjye, uri ubuzima bwanjye ariko warabeshye kuko wambwiraga ko uriya mukobwa ari umufana wawe, nza kuvumbura ko yari indaya yaje kuba umugore wawe kuko uri impumyi! Ukeka ko uri nde? Ukeka ko njye nari iki? (… ) Ubu utangiye kugaruka hafi yanjye ushaka igitsina cyanjye! F*ck u man”, aha benshi bakaba baketse ko ari ubutumwa yageneraga Riderman bakanyujijeho mu gihe cy’imyaka ikabakaba 8 ariko bakaza gushwana ndetse uyu muraperi agahita yishakira Miss Agasaro Farid Nadia wahoze ari umufana we. Aya ni amwe mu magambo yumvikana muri aya mashusho Asinah yashyize kuri konti aho inyikirizo yayo ikomeza kugenda yumvikanamo iri jambo nyandaqazi ’F*ck u" riza riherekeza amazina atandukanye y’abantu avuga barimo Riderman, Mc Tino, Davy Ranks, Papito, Nazil, Dee Rugz, Vaga Vybz n’abandi.

Asinah na Riderman bakanyujijeho mbere y’uyu uyu muraperi amutera umugongo akirongorera Agasaro Nadia mu buryo butunguranye Nyuma y’iyi ndirimbo, abantu benshi bamukurikira kuri konti ye ya Instagram bamututse bagaragaza ko ari ihungabana akigendana naryo ry’uko yabenzwe na Riderman, bakamusaba gushaka abaganga bavura indwara zo mu mutwe, gusa buri wese wamugaragarije ko atishimiye ibyo yakoze, nawe yahitaga amusubiza yewe ntanatinye kumutuka igitutsi gisa nk’icyo yatutse aba bahanzi bagenzi be barimo nabo bakundanye.

title: Tom Close yagizwe Umuyobozi w’Ikigo gishinzwe gutanga amaraso, Ishami rya Kigali
content:
Inama y’Abaminisitiri yateranye kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 03 Mata 2019 iyobowe na Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika, Paul KAGAME yafatiwemo ibyemezo bitandukanye inashyira mu myanya abayobozi batandukanye aho Dr Muyombo Thomas yagizwe Umuyobozi w’Ikigo gishinzwe gutanga amaraso, Ishami rya Kigali (RCBT-Kigali). Dr Muyombo Thomas, abenshi bamumenye mu ruhando rwa muzika nka Tom Close kuva mu 2009 ubwo yatangiraga gusohora indirimbo zitandukanye zagiye zikundwa, gusa uyu mwuga yawufatanyaga  na serivisi z’ubuzima n’ubuvuzi nk’umwuga yize muri kaminuza. 

Tom Close yagizwe Umuyobozi w’Ikigo gishinzwe gutanga amaraso, Ishami rya Kigali (RCBT-Kigali) Tom Close yashyizwe muri uyu mwanya nyuma y’uko muri Gashyantare 2017, yari yatorewe kuba Perezida w’Ihuriro Nyafurika rishinzwe ibyo gutanga amaraso mu bihugu 13 biri mu gace k’Uburasirazuba bwa Afurika.
 Tom Close yabaye umukozi w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ubuzima (RBC) mu ishami rishinzwe gutanga amaraso akaba yari ashinzwe ibikorwa byo gushaka abatanga amaraso bashya bujuje ubuziranenge no kongera umubare w’abayatanze bakongera kuyatanga, aho yageze muri Kanama 2015 avuye mu byahoze ari ibitaro bya Polisi ku Kacyiru aho yakoraga nk’umuganga bw’indwara z’abana.

title: Justin Bieber yabeshye abafana be ko we n’umukunzi we bitegura umwana, ababyizeye abereka akabwana
content:
Kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 01 Mata 2019 ni bwo umuhanzi Justin Bieber yatunguye abafana be ashyira kuri konti ye ya Instagram ifoto igaragaza umwana ukiri mu nda (échographie), gusa bamwe babanje gukeka ko yaba ababeshya kuko wari umunsi ufatwa nk’uwo kubeshya (Poisson d’Avril/April fools). Abashidikanyaga baje kubyemera nyuma yaho gato ubwo Justin Bieber umaze igihe atagaragara mu bikorwa bya showbiz ngo abanze yiyiteho nyuma yo kurwara agahinda gakabije, yashyiraga hanze indi foto y’umugore we Hailey Baldwin bigaragara ko akuriwe ndetse aryamye kwa muganga, avuga ko atarimo abeshya.

Iyi foto yatumye n’abashidikanyaga ko Justin Bieber yaba ababeshya, babyemera Iyi foto ya mbere igaragaza umwana utangiye kugira ishusho ya muntu mu nda, Justin Bieber yayishyize hanze atagize ikintu na kimwe ayivugaho, aho bidatinze yahise ikundwa (like) n’abasanga miliyoni 5 inakurikirwa n’ibitekerezo byinshi (comments) harimo iz’ibyamamare nka Ellen DeGeneres, Patrick Schwarzenegger, Kris Jenner, Luis Fonsi n’abandi bahise babifata nk’ukuri bose bamushimiraga intambwe ateye.

Justin Bieber yabeshye abasaga miliyoni 107 bamukurikira kuri Instagram Gusa nyuma y’akanya gato, uyu muhanzi w’imyaka 25 yashyize hanze indi foto ya échographie ariko noneho itagaragaza ishusho y’uruhinja ahubwo hibereyemo akabwana. Aha niho benshi batangiye kubabara baranamutuka.

Justin Bieber yabwiye abafana be ko yababeshye bakemera Nyina wa Justin Bieber, Pattie Mallette na we ni umwe mu bagize icyo bavuga, aho byamusekeje ndetse avuga ko itariki ya 01 Mata ahora yiteguye kubeshywa. Atebya uyu mubyeyi yibajije niba igihe cyo kwitwa nyogokuru kitaragera. Ati Ntabwo mbizi niba niteguye."

title: Nicolas Cage yasabye gatanya nyuma y’iminsi 4 gusa akoze ubukwe ’ngo yabukoze yasinze!’
content:
Umukinnyi wa filimi akaba umwanditsi wazo n’umushoramari, Nicolas Cage yasabye ko yabona gatanya nyuma y’iminsi ine gusa akoze ubukwe na Erika Koike usanzwe akora umwuga wo gusiga abantu (makeup artist) i Las Vegas. Ku wa Gatandatu ushize tariki ya 23 Werurwe 2019 ni bwo Nicolas Cage wamamaye muri filime bakunze kwita iz’imirwano (film d’action) nka Rock, Volte-face, 60 secondes chrono n’izindi, yashyingiranwe n’uyu wari umukunzi we Erika Koike i Las Vegas. Uwo munsi ni nawo bahise baboneraho icyemezo cy’abashakanye (certificat de mariage) Gusa ku wa Gatatu tariki ya 27 Werurwe, ni ukuvuga nyuma y’iminsi ine bakoze ubukwe, mu buryo butunguranye Nicolas Cage w’imyaka 55 y’amavuko yasabye ko ubu bukwe buseswa. Yasobanuye ko bombi bari basinze bikomeye ko ndetse ’atarasobanukiwe ibyo arimo ubwo yarongoraga Koike’.
 Abunganizi ba Nicolas Cage mu by’amategeko (avocats) bavuze ko "bari banyweye (Cage na Koike), hanyuma ubwo Koike yasabaga Nicolas Cage ko bashyingiranwa, yahise abyemera atabitekerejeho ataniyumvishije ingaruka zabyo." Nicolas Cage asobanura kandi ko Erika atari yarigeze amubwira "imiterere nyayo  y’umubano yari afitanye n’undi mugabo". Yanavuze ko yamenye amakuru ko uyu mukobwa "yari afite ibyaha aregwa, ndetse harimo ibirego bishya", gusa ntiyasobanuye neza ibyo yavugaga.

Amasaha make nyuma y’ubukwe bwabo bafotowe bari gutongana Nicolas Cage na Erika bari bamaze igihe bakundana urukundo rw’ibanga bahishe itangazamakuru. Bwa mbere babonywe bari kumwe mu biruhuko muri Porto Rico muri Mata 2018, bongera gufotorwa bari kumwe muri Gicurasi uwo mwaka ubwo bari muri imwe muri resitora iherereye i Los Angeles. Nicolas Cage amaze gushyingiranwa inshuro eshatu. Yabanje gushakana na Patricia Arquette bakoze ubukwe mu 1995 baza gutandukana mu 2001. Nyuma yaho yacuditse na Penelope Cruz amezi make mbere y’uko arongora umuhanzikazi Lisa Marie Presley muri Kanama 2002 gusa baza gutandukana mu Ugushyingo uwo mwaka nyuma y’igihe kitageze ku mezi ane. 

Nicolas Cage n’umugore we wa mbere Patricia Arquette

Nicolas Cage n’umugore we wa kabiri Lisa Marie Presley wanabanje kuba umugore wa Michael Jackson hagati ya 1994-1996 Umugore wa gatatu yashatse ni Alice Kim wakoraga muri resitora (serveuse) bashyingiranwe mu 2004 ndetse banibaruka umwana w’umuhungu nyuma y’umwaka, uyu bakaba baraje gutandukana mu 2016 nyuma y’imyaka 12 babana.

title: Umukobwa wa Michael Jackson, Paris Jackson yanyomoje ibyo kwiyahura, TMZ irabishimangira
content:
Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 16 Werurwe 2019 ni bwo inkuru yabaye kimomo ko umukobwa wa nyakwigendera Michael Jackson yaba yagerageje kwiyahura ariko agatabarwa atarashiramo umwuka agahita ajyanwa kwa muganga. Abinyujije ku mbuga ze nkoranyambaga, Paris Micheal Katherine Jackson yanyomoje aya makuru, akoresha imvugo ikarishye ndetse atuka mu buryo bukomeye ikinyamakuru TMZ cyabitangaje bwa mbere avuga ko ari ibinyoma bidashinga.

Paris Jackson ngo yagerageje kwiyahura kubera inkuru ziri kuvuga ko se yasambanyije abana b’abahungu TMZ yari yatangaje ko uyu mukobwa ubyarwa n’ikirangirire mu njyana ya Pop, Michael Jackson yaba yaragerageje kwiyambura ubuzima ’kubera kunanirwa kwakira ibirego bishya bishinja se byagaragaye muri filime mbarankuru ’Leaving Neverland’ ivuga ko yahohoteye abana b’abahungu’. Iki kinyamakuru kivuga ko gifite amakuru gikura ku bantu bari hafi y’uyu muryango aho cyahamyaga ko Paris Jackson yajyanywe mu bitaro biherereye i Los Angeles aho yitabwagaho n’umuganga w’indwara zo mu mutwe.

Paris Jackson afite imyaka 21 y’amavuko, akaba ari umunyamideri n’umukinnyi wa filime Uyu mukobwa yashyize kuri konti ye ya Instagram amafoto abiri harimo imwe imugaragaza ari mu modoka aseka, indi afite ibiryo. Nubwo uyu mukobwa yamaganye aya makuru, akagaragaza ko yishimye nta kibazo afite, TMZ yaje gusohora indi nkuru ishimangira aya makuru, ivuga ko Paris Jackson yasohotse mu bitaro ariko akomeza kwitabwaho n’abaganga mu rugo.

title: Young Grace yahishuye ko atwite
content:
Umuraperikazi Abayizera Marie Grace wamenyekanye cyane nka Young Grace, aritegura kwibaruka imfura ye mu gihe cya vuba. Abicishije kuri konti ye ya Instagram, kuri uyu wa Gatanu umunsi wizihirizwaho Umunsi w’Abagore, Young Grace yasangije abamukurikirana, amashusho y’umwana uri gukina mu nda, arangije yandika amagambo agaragaza ko anezerewe. Ati "Ndimo kuba muri bya bihe by’ubufindo buri mugore wese aba ategereje mu buzima bwose. Ubu inda yanjye ni iy’agaciro nk’umutima wanjye. Imbaraga z’umugore."

Young Grace yagaragaje ko atwite Young Grace amaze iminsi akundana n’umusore witwa Rwabuhihi Hubert bakunze kwita Piqué, ukina umupira w’amaguru aho abarizwa mu cyiciro cya kabiri mu ikipe ya Heroes.

title: R Kelly yahakanye ibyo aregwa ariko aguma muri gereza ’ku bwo kubura ibihumbi 100 $’
content:
Ku wa Gatanu w’icyumweru gishize nibwo umuhanzi R Kelly yishyikirije polisi, imuta muri yombi ashinjwa ibyaha 10 by’ihohotera rishingiye ku gitsina yakoreye abakobwa 4 barimo 3 batujuje imyaka y’ubukure. Akigera mu maboko y’ubutabera, R Kelly yabujijwe kwegera umuntu wese uri munsi y’imyaka 18 cyangwa undi muntu wese ufite aho ahuriye n’ibyo aregwa ndetse ahita yamburwa urwandiko rwe rw’inzira. Urukiko kandi rwategetse ko akurikiranwa ari mu buroko gusa akaba yari yemerewe gusohoka abanje kwishyura amafaranga ibihumbi 100 by’amadorari (88 500 000frw); angana n’icumi ku ijana (10%) ry’amande asabwa gutanga ngo aburane ari hanze ya gereza ni ukuvuga miliyoni yose y’amadorali ya Amerika.

R.Kelly yabuze ibihumbi 100 by’amadorali ya Amerika ngo aburane ari hanze Uburanira R.Kelly yatangarije AFP ko uyu muhanzi adafite ubushobozi bwo kwishyura aya mafaranga bityo bituma agumishwa muri gereza. Yagize ati "Ni umuntu wakagombye kuba ari umukire urebye urwego agezeho, ariko kubera imucungire mibi y’umutungo we ndetse n’amasezerano mabi yagiye asinya cyane cyane nk’ibijyanye na studio ye, nta mafaranga agifite." Mu rubanza rwe kuri uyu wa mbere, Robert Sylvester Kelly yashinjwaga ibyaha 10 ariko byose akaba yabihakanye, aho umuburanira wanamuvugiye mu rubanza rwose, yahamije ko abarega bose babeshya, kuko Kelly nta n’umwe yigeze akoresha imibonano mpuzabitsina batabyumvikanyeho, akomeza avuga ko Kelly ari ’icyamamare bitari ngombwa ko akoresha imibonano mpuzabitsina abantu batabyumvikanyeho’ Ku ruhande rw’abarega bo bavuze ko bashyikirije urukiko andi mashusho agaragaza R Kelly afata ku ngufu umwana utagejeje imyaka ubukure. Uru ruhande kandi rwari rwaramaze gutanga andi mashusho agaragaza uyu muhanzi ahohotera undi w’imyaka 14, bakaba biteguye no gutanga andi mashusho mu gihe cya vuba cyane cyane ko hari abandi batangabuhamya bagaragaje ubushake bwo gushinja Kelly nyuma y’uko atawe muri yombi. Mu mwaka wa 2002, Kelly yafungiwe gufata amashusho asambanya umwana w’imyaka 14 ariko aza kugirwa umwere muri 2008. Muri 1994, Kelly yashyingiranywe n’umwana w’imyaka 15, Aaliyah, ariko ababyeyi be bihutira gusesa ubu bukwe. Mu gihe akigumye muri gereza kuko atabasha kwishyura amafaranga yasabwe, Kelly azongera kugera imbere y’urukiko ku ya 22 Werurwe, 2019.

title: R.Kelly yamaze gutabwa muri yombi kubera guhohotera no gusambanya abarimo abangavu
content:
Umuhanzi w’umunyamerika, R.Kelly wari umaze igihe kirekire ashinjwa ibyaha byo gusambanya abangavu no guhohotera abagore muri rusange, yamaze kwishyikiriza ubuyobozi ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatanu. R.Kelly w’imyaka 52 y’amavuko akurikiranyweho ibyaha 10 by’ihohotera rishingiye ku gitsina aho bitatu muri bine bikomeye ashinjwa yabikoreye abana b’abakobwa bataregeza myaka y’ubukure.


Mu modoka y’umukara, R.Kelly yagejwejwe kuri sitasiyo ya polisi saa mbili z’ijoro z’i Chicago Umwunganizi we mu mategeko yari yabanje kuvuga ko ari ibinyoma, ko abagore bari gushinja umukiliya we ari ababeshyi bagamije kubikuramo inyungu. R.Kelly yagejejwe kuri sitasiyo ya polisi i Chicago ku mugoroba wo ku wa Gatanu, bikaba biteganijwe ko mu masaha ya nyuma ya saa sita yo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu agezwa imbere y’ umushinjacyaha nkuko byatangajwe n’umuvugizi wa polisi y’ Illinois, Anthony Guglielmi abinyujije kuri tweet.

Robert Sylvester Kelly (R.Kelly) yaruciye ararumira ubwo abanyamakuru bamwuzuragaho bamubaza ibibazo bitandukanye Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru, mbere y’uko uyu muhanzi atabwa muri yombi, kimberly Foxx, porokureri wa Cook i Chicago umujyi R.Kelly yavukiyemo akaba ri naho atuye magingo aya, yavuze ko ibirego 10 shinjwa, buri kimwe gihanishwa igifungo kiri hagati y’imyaka 3 -7.

Filime mbarankuru yagiye hanze mu ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka ikubiyemo ubuhamya bw’abagizweho ingaruka n’ibikorwa bya R.kelly iri mu byatumye yongera guhagurukirwa Nkuko uyu muporokureri abivuga, ibyaha R.Kelly ashinjwa yabikoze hagati y’umwaka 1998 na 2010, harimo ibyo yakoze ku bangavu batarengeje imyaka 17. Umwe mu bakorera mu rukiko rwa Cook muri leta ya Illinois yabwiye AFP ko abo bana bari hagati y’imyaka 13 na 16 ubwo uyu muririmbyi yabakoreraga ayo mahano.

Yafashwe nyuma gato y’uko hari hamaze kugaragazwa andi mashusho mashya, asambana n’umwana w’imyaka 14

title: Rayon Sports yirukanye uwari umutoza wayo Javier Martinez Espinoza nyuma yo gutsindwa na APR FC
content:
Nyuma y’iminsi ibiri itsinzwe na mukeba wayo APR FC ibitego 2-0, ikipe ya Rayon Sports yirukanye Javier Martinez Espinoza, umunya-Mexique wari umaze amezi atatu ayitoza. Nkuko urubuga rw’iyi kipe rwabitangaje mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 24 Ukuboza 2019, ubuyobozi bwa Rayon Sports bwateranye bufata umwanzuro wo gutandukana mu buryo bwemewe n’amategeko n’uyu mutoza wayitozaga kuva muri Nzeri. Mu kiganiro Perezida wa Rayon Sports, Munyakazi Sadati yagiranye na Ten Sports, yavuze ko impamvu yo gusezererwa k’uyu mutoza idashingiye gusa ku kuba yaratsinzwe na APR FC ko ahubwo n’uburyo ikipe muri rusange yitwaye mu kibuga bitatangaga icyizere cy’uburyo izitwara mu mikino iri imbere kuko yari iri ku rwego rwo hasi cyane. Yavuze ko bateganya guhura n’uyu mutoza ku wa Kane w’iki cyumweru maze bakamuha ibyo bamugomba harimo umushahara w’ukwezi kwa Ukuboza n’imperekeza maze nawe akabaha ibyo abagomba harimo gusubiza ibikoresho by’akazi birimo imodoka n’ibindi.

Javier Martinez mu myitozo ye ya mbere yakoresheje i Ngoma muri Nzeri 2019 Uyu munya-Mexique ntiyahuzaga na benshi mu ba Rayon mu buryo apanga ikipe, by’umwihariko benshi bakaba bababazwaga n’uburyo adakinisha Mugheni Kakule Fabrice utari no mu bakinnyi 18 yifashishije ubwo yatsindwaga na APR FC k’umukino wa 15 wa shampiyona ari nawo wasozaga imikino y’igice kibanza cya shampiyona aho iyi kipe yasoje iri ku mwanya wa 3 n’amanota 31 irushwa na APR FC ya mbere amanota 6, ikanarushwa inota rimwe na Police FC ya kabiri. Bivugwa ko Javier Martinez Espinoza atumvikanaga n’abatoza bamwungirije, bamwe mu bakinnyi ndetse na komite muri rusange ikaba yari ifite ibyo itumvikanaho nawe. Kugeza ubu biravugwa ko Rayon Sports ishobora kuba yatangiye ibiganiro n’umutoza w’umunyarwanda Casa Mbongo Andre uheruka gutandukana na AFC Leopard yo muri Kenya kubera ibibazo by’amikoro. Iyi kipe kandi yamaze gutandukana na Nyandwi Sadam utari ukibona umwanya uhagije wo gukina mu gihe yamaze kwinjizamo Kayumba Sother na we wavuye muri AFC Leopard.

title: APR FC itsinze Rayon Sports iha Noheli n’Ubunani abakunzi bayo
content: Ibitego bibiri bya Byiringiro Lague na Manzi Thierry ni byo bitandukanije APR FC na Rayon Sports mu mukino w’ishiraniro w’umunsi wa 15 wa shampiyona wari wahuje aya makipe yombi kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 21 Ukuboza 2019. Ni umukino wari utegerejwe cyane nyuma yaho APR FC iguze bamwe mu bari abakinnyi b’inkingi ya mwamba bafashije Rayon Sports kwegukana igikombe cya shampiyona ishize barimo Djabel Imanishimwe, Manzi Thierry, Niyonzima Olivier Sefu na Mutsinzi Ange mu gihe Rayon Sports nayo yishumbushije abari basezerewe na mukeba barimo Kimenyi Yves, Rugwiro Herve, Iranzi Jean Claude, Imran Nshimiyimana, Nizeyimana Mirafa na Sekamana Maxime. Mu bakinnyi 11 APR FC yabanje mu kibuga harimo batanu bari muri Rayon Sports yegukanye igikombe umwaka ushize aribo Kapiteni Manzi Thierry, Manishimwe Djabel, Mutsinzi Ange, Niyonzima Olivier Sefu na Bukuru Christophe. Abandi bari mu kibuga ni Omar, Omborenga Fitina, Manishimwe Emmanuel Mangwende,  Claude, Byiringiro Lague na Danny Usengimana. Ku ruhande rwa Rayon Sports nayo muri 11 yabanjemo harimo batatu basezerewe muri APR FC mbere y’uko uyu mwaka w’imikino utangira barimo Kimenyi Yves, Mirafa na Iranzi Jean Claude. Mu bandi bari barimo ni :Iragire Saidi, Samuel, Rutanga Eric, Commodore, Omar Sidibe, Micheal Sarpong, Iradukunda Eric Radu na Yannick Mukunzi. Uretse ibitego bibiri bya APR FC harimo icya mbere cya Byiringiro Lague ku munota wa 18 nyuma y’akazi gakomeye kari kamaze gukorwa na Ombolenga Fitina ndetse n’igitego cya Manzi Thierry ku munota wa 88 kuri coup franc nziza, ikindi cyaranze uyu mukino ni ikarita itukura yahawe Byiringiro Lague ku munota wa 49 nyuma y’ikosa yari akoreye rutanga agahabwa ikarita ya kabiri y’umuhundo kuko iya mbere yari yayibonye ubwo yishimiraga igitego akuramo umupira. Iyi ntsinzi ya APR FC ifashije iyi kipe y’ingabo z’igihugu gukomeza kuyobora urutonde rw’agateganyo rwa shampiyona aho irangije imikino ibanza ifite amanota 37 iri imbere ya Rayon Sports ho amanota atandatu.

title: Amagare: Iperereza kuri ruswa n’ihohotera rishingiye ku gitsina kuri Aimable Bayingana weguye ku buyobozi bwa FERWACY
content: Uwari perezida w’ishyirahamwe ry’umukino w’amagare mu Rwanda (FERWACY) ari gukorwaho iperereza nyuma yo kwegura ku mirimo ye ku birego bya ruswa n’ihohotera rishingiye ku gitsina byavuzwe muri iryo shyiharamwe. Amakuru avuga ko Aimable Bayingana n’abandi bose bari bagize inama nyobozi y’iryo shyirahamwe beguye. Urwego rw’ubugenzacyaha rw’u Rwanda (RIB) ruvuga ko ruri gukora iperereza kuri ibyo birego, ariko ko kuri ubu nta kindi rwabivugaho. Bwana Bayingana ahakana avuga ko nta kibi yakoze. Ibyo birego byagiye ahagaragara nyuma yaho Umunyamerika Jonathan Boyer wahoze atoza ikipe y’u Rwanda y’umikino w’amagare, atangaje ku mugaragaro ibivugwa ko ari imyitwarire mibi muri FERWACY. Hari nyuma yaho agiraniye ibibazo na Bwana Bayingana. Bwana Boyer, wabaye Umunyamerika wa mbere witabiriye irushanwa rya Tour de France, yagize uruhare rukomeye mu iterambere ry’umukino wo gushiganwa ku magare mu Rwanda, atuma uba mu mikino ikunzwe cyane mu gihugu. Bwana Boyer, wasezeye ku butoza mu 2017, yanditse ibaruwa ifunguye ashinja Bwana Bayingana kubangamira ibikorwa byo guteza imbere umukino wo gusiganwa ku magare. Muri iyo baruwa, yanamushinje kandi gukoresha nabi umwanya we no gukora ibidahagije mu gufasha abasiganwa ku magare b’abagore bivugwa ko bakorerwa ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina n’abatoza. Yemeza iyegura rya Bwana Bayingana, minisiteri y’imikino mu Rwanda yavuze ko nayo izakora iperereza kuri ibyo birego. Iyo minisiteri yabwiye ibiro ntaramakuru AFP ko iteganya gushyiraho gahunda yo kurwanya ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina ireba imikino yose mu gihugu. AFP isubiramo amagambo ya Shema Maboko Didier, umunyamabanga uhoraho muri minisiteri y’imikino, agira ati: "Turabizi ko habaho ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina ndetse n’ibibazo bya ruswa, kandi biri mu nshingano zacu kubirwanya". Src:BBC

title: U Rwanda rwasinye amasezerano n’ikipe ya PSG yo mu Bufaransa
content:
Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yasinyanye amasezerano y’ubufatanye hagati yayo n’ikipe ya Paris Saint Germain yo mu gihugu cy’ u Bufaransa. Ni amasezerano y’imyaka itatu ibinyamakuru nka Le Figaro bivuga ko yaba yatwaye u Rwanda akayabo ka miliyoni hagati y’umunani n’icumi z’amayero, aho ikigenderewe ahanini ari ugukomeza kumenyekanisha ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda ndetse cyane cyane kwerekana ibikorerwa mu Rwanda.

Ku mukino batsinzemo Nantes FC 2-0 kuri uyu wa Gatatu, Neymar, Mbappe na bagenzi babo bakoze imyitozo bambaye ’Visit Rwanda’ Aganira na Le Figaro, Clare Akamanzi, Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere, RDB, yagize ati "Umugambi wacu ni ukwerekana ibyiza by’u Rwanda. Twahisemo Paris Saint-Germain kuko irenze kuba gusa ikipe y’umupira w’amaguru, ahubwo ni n’ikirango cy’imibereho n’imyidagaduro." Yakomeje avuga ko iyi kipe "Niyo bucura mu makipe akomeye y’i Burayi kandi isangiye indangagaciro nyinshi z’ingenzi n’u Rwanda nko kwiha intego, kureba isi mu buryo bwihariye, umubano wa hafi n’abakiri bato ndetse no gushakisha kuba indashyikirwa." Nkuko Le Figaro yatangaje iyi nkuru bwa mbere yakomeje ibivuga, hari hashize umwaka hari ibiganiro hagati y’izi mpande zombi aho bimwe mu byo bemeranije harimo kuba PSG izajya yambara ikirang cya ’Visit Rwanda’ mu myitozo ya buri mbere y’umukino, ndetse iki kirango kijye ku kibuga ahamamazwa mu mikino PSG yakiriye ndetse ikindi gikomeye ni uko muri stade Parc des Princes y’iyi kipe hazajya hacururizwa ikawa n’icyayi by’u Rwanda gusa. Ikindi cyavuzwe ni uko bamwe mu bakinnyi bibirangirire b’iyi kipe bazajya basura u Rwanda mu bihe bitandukanye mu mezi ari imbere ndetse hakaba hanatekerezwa uburyo hashingwa ishuri ry’umupira w’amaguru (académie) i Kigali.

PSG yatangiye ubufatanye n’u Rwanda Marc Armstrong, Umuyobozi ushinzwe ibikorwa byo kwamamaza muri PSG, yavuze ko gukorana n’u Rwanda ari ibintu by’ingenzi kuri bo bizabafasha gukomeza kwigarurira umugabane wa Afurika. Uyu mugabo wahoze ari Visi Perezida wa NBA i Burayi wageze muri PSG mu 2018 aje gushyira ingufu mu bijyanye n’ibikorwa byo kwamamaza muri iyi kipe, yakomeje avuga ko mu gukorana n’u Rwanda bazi neza ko bari gukorana n’igihugu gihagaze neza muri Afurika gifite iterambere riri kuzamuka neza. Tubibutse ko aya masezerano aje nyuma y’umwaka urenga u Rwanda rusinyanye andi n’ikipe ya Arsenal aho iyi kipe na yo yamamaza ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda binyuze mu kwambara ikirango cya Visit Rwanda ku kuboko kw’imyambaro yabo, gushyira ibyapa byamamaza muri stade no ku mbuga z’ikipe, abakinnyi bamwe gusura u Rwanda n’ibindi.

title: Lionel Messi yahigitse Virgil van Dijk na Cristiano Ronaldo yegukana ’Ballon d’Or’ ya 6
content:
Lionel Messi ni we waraye wegukanye Ballon d’Or 2019, igihembo kigenerwa umukinnyi wa ruhago wahize abandi bose bakina ku mugabane w’Uburayi gitangwa n’ikinyamakuru France Football, mu birori byabereye ahitwa Châtelet mu murwa mukuru w’u Bufaransa, Paris. Uyu munya-Argentine ukinira FC Barcelona, iki gihembo cyari icya 6 ahawe aho asimbuye umunya-Croatie, Luka Modric utaragaragaye mu bagihataniye muri uyu mwaka. Messi akaba yaciyeho mukeba w’ibihe bye byose umunya-Portugal Cristiano Ronaldo usanganywe iki gihembo inshuro eshanu, ubu akaba yasoje ku mwanya wa gatatu mu gihe umuholande Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) yasoje ku mwanya wa kabiri.

Messi yaciyeho Ronolado yegukana Ballon d’Or ya 6 Messi yari asanganywe iki gihembo mu 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012 na 2015. Uyu mugabo w’imyaka 32 kandi yanaherukaga guhabwa igihembo cy’umukinnyi w’umwaka gitangwa n’Impuzamashyirahamwe y’Umupira w’Amaguru ku Isi (FIFA) cya FIFA The Best muri Nzeri aho yegukanye igikombe cya shampiyona ya Esipanye hamwe na FC Barcelona, aba umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi muri iyi shampiyona no muri Champions League mu mwaka w’imikino 2018-2019. Messi yageze mu ntara ya Catalogne afite imyaka 13 gusa y’amavuko, ubu akaba amaze gukinira Barça imikino 701 aho amaze kuyitsindira ibitego 614 anatanga imipira 250 yabyaye ibitego kuri bagenzi be. "Ndashimira abanyamakuru, abakinnyi bagenzi banjye bamfashije kwegukana iki gihembo (…) Ndibuka Ballon d’Or yanjye ya mbere, ni ibintu ntatekerezaga muri icyo gihe, ariko ubu ngize iya gatandatu. Ni ibihe bitandukanye cyane, ndifuza gushimira umuryango wanjye, abana banjye. Ntugomba guhagarara kugira inzozi, gukora, kugira ibyishimo iyo urimo ukina ruhago. Ndi umunyamugisha, ndizera gukomeza mu bihe by’imbere, ndatekereza ko mfite indi myaka myiza imbere yanjye nubwo imyaka yo gusoza nayo yegereje.", Messi Muri ibi birori, Cristiano Ronaldo ntabwo yigeze ahagaragara aho yari yibereye mu birori byishimira shampiyona yo mu Butaliyani bya “Gran Gala Del Calcio” i Milan.

Mu gihe Messi yahabwaga Ballon d’Or nk’umukinnyi mwiza ku isi, ku rundi ruhande Cristiano yahabwaga igihembo cy’umukinnyi mwiza muri shampiyona y’Abataliyani Seria A Virgil van Dijk wabaye inkingi ya mwamba mu bwugarizi bwa Livelpool akayifasha kwegukana igikombe cya Champions League benshi bamuhaga amahirwe bibwira ko ashobora kuba myugariro wa kane mu mateka utwaye iki gihembo nyuma ya Franz Beckenbauer (1972, 1976), Matthias Sammer (1996) na Fabio Cannavaro (2006).

Virgil van Dijk ubwo yageraga ahatangiwe ibi bihembo aherekejwe n’umugore we Uretse Van Dijk, ikipe ya Livelpool yagize abakinnyi benshi baje mu myanya 10 ya mbere barimo Sadio Mane wabaye uwa kane, Muhamed Salah aba uwa gatanu mu gihe umuzamu wabo, umunya-Brazil Alisson Becker yabaye uwa 7. Mu bindi bihembo byatanzwe harimo igihembo cy’Umugore w’umwaka cyegukanywe n’Umunyamerikakazi Megan Rapinoe, igihembo cy’umukinnyi muto w’umwaka cyegukanywe n’Umuholande Matthijs de Ligt ukinira Juventus Turin ariko umwaka ushize wakiniraga Ajax hamwe n’igihembo cy’umuzamu w’umwaka cyahawe Umunya-Brazil Alisson Becker ukinira Liverpool.

title: Salomon Nirisarike yamaze kongera amasezerano muri FC Pyunik
content:
Myugariro mpuzamahanga w’umunyarwanda, Salomon Nirisarike unafite ubwenegihugu bw’Ububiligi, yamaze kongererwa amasezerano mashya mu ikipe ye nshya ya FC Pyunik yo muri Armenia. Ni nyuma y’igihe gito ageze muri iyi kipe iri mu zikomeye mu Burayi bw’iburasirazuba aho yari amaze amezi atatu gusa dore ko yageze muri iyi kipe mu mpeshyi ishize avuye muri AFC Tubize. Kongerererwa amasezerano mu buryo bwihuse bigaragaza uburyo uyu musore amaze kwemeza abatoza, abayobozi n’abafana b’iyi kike isanzwe ari imwe mu zihatanira igikombe n’umwanya wo gukina imikino y’I Burayi gusa ubu ikaba iri ku mwanya wa 7 irushwa amanota 8 n’ikipe ya mbere nyuma y’umunsi wa 15 wa shampiyona.

Nirisarike yongerewe amasezerano y’umwaka muri iyi kipe ifite ibikombe 14 bya shampiyona ya Armenia Mu kiganiro Kigali Post yagiranye na Salomon Nirisarike yadutangarije ko yishimiye cyane amasezerano y’umwaka yongerewe. Mu magambo ye yagize ati " Byashimishije cyane kandi impamvu banyongereye amasezerano ni uko ndimo kwitwara neza ndetse ndimo gufasha ikipe yanjye. Perezida, abatoza n’abakunzi b’ikipe bishimira uburyo nitwara."

FC Pyunik ni ikipe y’ubukombe muri Armenia yazamuye abakinnyi b’amazina akomeye muri iki gihugu barimo Henrik Mikhitaryan Salomon Nirisarike w’imyaka 26 y’amavuko yazamukiye mu ikipe ya Isonga FC aho yavuye mu 2012 yerekeza mu ikipe ya Royal Antwerp yo mu Bubiligi yavuyemo ajya muri K Saint-Trond VV ndetse anayifasha kuzamuka mu cyiciro cya mbere nyuma yo gutwarana nayo igikombe cya shampiyona y’icyiciro cya kabiri. Yaje kwerekeza muri AFC Tubize ari nayo yavuyemo yerekeza muri FC Pyunik.

title: UEFA Euro 2020:  Ubufaransa, Ubudage na Portugal mu itsinda ry’urupfu - Uko tombola yagenze
content:
Mu gihe abakunzi ba ruhago bategerezanije amashyushyu menshi igikombe cy’ibihugu ku mugabane w’Uburayi, Euro 2020 kizabera mu mijyi 12 yo mu bihugu 12 biri kuri uyu mugabane hagati ya tariki 12 Kamena na 12 Nyakanga 2020, kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 30 Ugushyingo habaye tombola y’uburyo amatsinda azaba ateye. Ni tombola yabereye ahitwa Romexpo mu mujyi wa Bucharest muri Romania aho amakipe 24 yagabanyijwe mu matsinda 6 y’amakipe ane. Gusa hari amakipe ane agitegereje imikino ya kamarampaka. Iyi tombola yasize itsinda ry’urupfu ribaye irya 6 (Groupe F) aho Portugal ifite iki gikombe n’Ubufaransa bwatsindiwe k’umukino wa nyuma w’iki gikombe ariko nabwo bukaba bufite igikombe cy’isi giheruka ndetse n’Ubudage bazaba bari kumwe muri iri tsinda mu gihe indi kipe izamenyekana nyuma y’imikino ya kamarampaka. Dore uko amatsinda ateye: Itsinda A: Ubutaliyani, Ubusuwisi, Turikiya, Wales Itsinda B: Uburusiya, Denmark, Ububiligi, Finland Itsinda C: Ubuholande, Ukraine, Austria ( haziyongeraho ikipe izabona itike ya kamarampaka hagati ya Georgia, Kosovo, Belarus, North Macedonia). Itsinda D: Ubwongereza, Croatia, Czech Republic (haziyongeraho ikipe izabona itike ya kamarampaka hagati ya Scotland, Israel, Norway, Serbia) Itsinda E: Esipanye, Polanye, Suwede (haziyongeraho ikipe izabona itike ya kamarampaka hagati ya N Ireland, Bosnia, Slovakia na Ireland). Itsinda F: Ubudage, France, Portugal (haziyongeramo ikipe izabona itike hagati ya Iceland, Romania, Bulgaria, Hungary). Dore imijyi amatsinda azakiniramo *Group A: Rome (Ubutaliyani) na Baku (Azerbaijan)
*Group B: Saint Petersburg (Uburusiya) na Copenhagen (Denmark)
*Group C: Amsterdam (Ubuholande) na Bucharest (Romania)
*Group D: London (Ubwongereza) na Glasgow (Scotland)
*Group E: Bilbao (Esipanye) na Dublin (Republic of Ireland)
*Group F: Munich (Ubudage) na Budapest (Hungary) Umukino wa mbere ufungura iri rushanwa uzakinirwa mu mujyi wa Rome mu Butaliyani uhuze Ubutaliyani na Turikiya. Stade nkuru y’Ubwongereza, Wembley Stadium ni yo izakira umukino wa nyuma ndetse n’imikino ya 1/2 mu gihe imikino ya 1/4 izakinirwa i Munich mu Budage, Baku muri Azerbaijan, Saint Petersburg mu Burusiya na Rome mu Butaliyani.

title: Rayon Sports yakubise ahababaza Kiyovu SC, ihita isingira  umwanya wa kabiri -Uko shampiyona yagenze

title: Arsenal yirukanye Unai Emery n’abari bamwungirije
content:
Kuri uyu wa Gatanu, nibwo ikipe ya Arsenal yatangaje ko yamaze gutandukana n’uwari umutoza wayo, Unai Emery ndetse ajyana n’abari bamwungirije mu gutoza iyi kipe. Mu itangazo Arsenal yashyize ahagaragara bagize bati "Uyu munsi turatangaza ko icyemezo cyamaze gufatwa cyo gutandukana n’umutoza mukuru Unai Emery ndetse n’abari bamwungirije" Josh Kroenke wavuze mu izina rya Arsenal na banyirayo Kroenke Sports&Entertainment, yagize ati "Turashimira cyane Unai na bagenzi be batahwemye gukoreshe uko bashoboye kose ngo bagarure ikipe mu irushanwa ku rwego twifuzaga ndetse twabasabaga. Turifuriza Unai n’abo bakorana intsinzi mu bihe biri imbere."

 Arsenal yifurije Emery amahirwe mu bihe bye biri imbere  Nk’uko iri tangazo rikomeza ribisobanura, iki cyemezo cyafashwe kubera umusaruro utari ku rwego uyu mutoza yasabwaga gutanga. Kugeza ubu iyi kipe yashyizwe mu maboko ya Freddie Ljungberg wari usanzwe ari umwe mu bungirije Unai Emery, wagizwe umutoza mukuru by’agateganyo. Bati "Dufitiye Freddie icyizere cyuzuye cyo kudufasha kuzamuka. Gushakisha umutoza mushya biracyakomeje kandi ibizavamo muzabitangarizwa mu gihe iki gikorwa kizaba cyarangiye."

 Freddie ni we wahawe ikipe ya Arsenal by’agateganyo  Freddi yatangiye kuba umutoza wungirije muri Arsenal muri uyu mwaka wa 2019 akaba ari n’umwe mu bakinnyi bayo b’igihe kirekire aho yayikiniye guhera muri 1998 kugeza muri 2007 nyuma akaza kuhava yerekeje muri West Ham

title: José Mourinho ni we wasimbuye Mauricio Pochettino muri Tottenham
content:
Mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 20 Ugushyingo ni bwo byemejwe ko umunya-Portugal Jose Mourinho yagizwe umutoza mushya wa Tottenham asimbuye umunya-Argentine Mauricio Pochettino wirukanwe ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kabiri. Mu itangazo ryashyizwe hanze n’iyi kipe y’i London, Jose Mourinho wari umaze iminsi adafite ikipe kuva yakwirukanwa muri Manchester United mu Ukuboza 2018, byatangajwe ko yahawe amasezerano azamugeza mu mwaka w’imikino 2022-2023.

Jose Mourinho uzajya uhembwa amapawundi miliyoni 15 k’umwaka, yahawe akubye hafi kabiri ayahabwaga Mauricio Pochettino Ku rubuga rwa Tottenham, Mourinho yavuze ko ashimishijwe cyane no kuza ’mu ikipe ifite ibigwi bikomeye kandi y’abafana badasanzwe’. Yongeyeho ko anyuzwe n’Urwego rw’ikipe ndetse kimwe mu byamukururiye kuyitoza akaba ari abakinnyi bayo beza. 

Mauricio Pochettino yirukanwe mu buryo butunguranye ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kabiri Tottenham ibaye ikipe ya gatatu mu Bwongereza, Jose Mourinho atoje nyuma ya Chelsea (2004-2007, 2013-2015) na Manchester United (2016-2019). Andi makipe y’ibigugu i Burayi amaze gutoza ni FC Porto yo muri Portugal (2002-2004), Inter Milan yo mu Butaliyani(2008-2010) na Real Madrid yo muri Esipanye (2010-2013). Aho byibuze afite igikombe kimwe cya shampiyona muri ibi bihugu bine amaze gutozamo.

Mourinho yari amaze iminsi ari umusesenguzi kuri Sky Sports Kugeza ubu Jose Mourinho ni umwe mu batoza batatu gusa bamaze gutwara Champions League inshuro ebyiri mu makipe abiri atandukanye harimo mu 2004 muri FC Porto na Inter Milan mu 2010. Ndetse amaze kwegukana ibikombe bitatu bya Premier League hamwe na Chelsea (2005, 2006, 2015). “Muri Jose, dufite umwe mu batoza b’indashyikirwa muri ruhago (…) Afite ubunararibonye buhagije…”Umuyobozi w’ikipe ya Tottenham, Daniel Levy ubwo yavugaga kuza rya Mourinho aho yashimangiye ko ari umutoza w’umuhanga kandi wagiye yegukana ibikombe n’imidari aho yagiye anyura hose.

Mourinho arasabwa gusubiza Tottenham mu myanya myiza nyuma yo gutangira nabi Umunya-Argentine Mauricio Pochettino wari wabashije kugeza Spurs ku mukino wa nyuma wa UEFA Champions League umwaka ushize, yirukanwe nyuma yo gutangira nabi umwaka mushya w’imikino aho ubu iyi kipe iri ku mwanya wa 14 muri shampiyona y’Ubwongereza. "Umusaruro wo mu rugo mu mpera z’umwaka w’imikino ushize ndetse no mu ntagiriro z’uyu byari uruca ntege.", ibyatangajwe n’iyi kipe mu itangazo yashyize hanze ubwo yasezereraga uyu mutoza ku wa Kabiri. Ikindi cyababaje ubuyobozi n’abafana ba Tottenham harimo kuba barasezerewe mu gikombe cy’igihugu n’ikipe yo mu cyiciro cya kane  ndetse ikaba itaratsinda umukino n’umwe  kuva yatsinda Southampton ku ya 28 Nzeri 2019, aho ubu imaze kunganya gatatu itsindwa kabiri.

Jose Mourinho aje asanga Tottenham iri nyuma ho amanota 11 muri Top4

Daniel Levy (iburyo), Umuyobozi wa Tottenham na Mauricio Pochettino bari bamaze kugerana kuri byinshi ndetse uyu muyobozi yavuze ko nubwo batandukanye n’uyu mutoza, azahora mu mateka y’ikipe yabo

Harry Kane yashimiye Mauricio Pochettino ibyo bageranyeho mu myaka itanu n’igice bamaranye, amwifuriza ishya n’ihirwe

Mu 2015 ubwo yatozaga Chelsea, Mourinho yavuze ko adashobora na rimwe gutoza Tottenham kubera urukundo afitiye abafana ba Chelsea, ariko ibi yabishyize ku ruhande ayerekezamo

Mourinho muri iyi minsi ubwo yasesenguraga kuri Sky Sports, yanengaga cyane Tottenham

title: CAN2021: Amavubi yaherewe isomo rya ruhango muri Mozambique
content:
Ikipe y’igihugu y’u Rwanda yatangiye nabi urugendo rwo gushaka itike y’igikombe cya Afurika kizabera muri Cameroun mu 2021, aho yatsinzwe ibitego 2-0 n’ikipe y’igihugu ya Mozambique mu mukino wa mbere wabereye kuri Estadio Zimpeto iherereye i Maputo ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 14 Ugushyingo 2019. Ni umukino abasore b’umutoza Mashami Vincent barushijwe bigaragara cyane cyane mu kibuga hagati ahanini bitewe nuko abasore barimo Yannick Mukunzi, Niyonzima Ally na Amran Nshimiyimana basanzwe bifashishwa batari bahari. Ikipe ya Mozambique yakiniraga imbere y’abafana bayo yatangiye yotsa igitutu izamu rya Kimenyi Yves ariko uyu muzamu n’abamyugariro be babanza kwihagararaho kugeza ubwo ku munota wa 24 akagozi kacitse nyuma yaho izamu rya Amavubi ryugarijwe maze bikaviramo Rwatubyaye gukora umupira mu rubuga rw’amahina, umusifuzi agatanga penaliti yinjijwe neza na Edson Andre Stoe. Nyuma y’iminota ibiri gusa Stanley Ernesto yaboneye Mozambique igitego cya kabiri arobye umuzamu Kimenyi Yves ku mupira wari uhinduwe na Francisco Lopez Albino. Nyuma yo kubona ko hari icyuho gikomeye ku bakinnyi bo hagati bakina bafasha ba myugariro, umutoza Mashami Vincent ntiyarindiriye ko igice cya mbere kirangira kuko yahise akora impinduka zihuse yinjiza Niyonzima Olivier Sefu mu kibuga asimbuye Muhire Kevin ku munota wa  41. Uyu mukinnyi yazanye impinduka agerageza gutunganya amakosa yagaragaraga hagati mu kibuga.

Abakinnyi 11 Mashami yari yahisemo gutangiza mu kibuga/ Funclub Igice cya kabiri Amavubi yagerageje gushaka uko yakwishyura ariko Mozambique iyibera ibamba ahubwo ikomeza kugenda inahusha ubundi buryo nubwo ho byibuze abasore ba Mashami nabo banyuzagamo ukabona bageze imbere y’izamu. Ku munota wa 74 Sibomana Patrick Pappy yinjiye mu kibuga asimbuye Muhadjili Hakizimana wagize umukino mwiza. Ku munota wa 88 umuriro wabuze muri stade umukino uhagarara iminota hafi itatu, ugarutse ntihagira indi mpinduka iba umukino urangira ari 2-0. Iyi ntsinzi ya Mozambique yahise iyihesha umwanya wa mbere n’amanota atatu mu itsinda F dore ko undi mukino wakinwe ku wa Gatatu wahuje Cap-Vert yari yasuye Cameroun banganyije 0-0 bityo aya makipe akaba akurikira n’inota 1 mu gihe Amavubi aza ku mwanya wa nyuma mbere y’uko kuri iki Cyumweru tariki ya 17 Ugushyingo 2019 yakira Cameroun kuri stade ya Kigali i Nyamirambo mu gihe Cap-Vert izaba yakiriye Mozambique. Tubibutse ko muri iri tsinda F, ikipe ya Cameroun yo ifite itike bidasubirwaho kuko ari yo izakira imikino ya nyuma y’igikombe cya Afurika (CAN 2021) bivuze ko indi tike imwe igomba gushakirwa hagati y’u Rwanda, Mozambique na Cap-Vert.

title: Klyian Mbappe wifuzwa bikomeye na Real Madrid ashobora guca agahigo ko kugurwa akayabo
content:
Ikipe ya Real Madrid biravugwa ko yiteguye gukora ibishoboka byose ikazana Umufaransa Kylian Mbappe i Santiago Bernabeu. Ibinyamakuru bitandukanye birimo Le Parisien na CalcioMercato byatangaje ko iyi kipe y’ikigugu muri Esipanye yiteguye guhara asaga miliyoni 400 z’amayero kugira ngo igure uyu mukinnyi w’imyaka 20 y’amavuko ukinira Paris Saint-Germain. Ibi biramutse bibaye uyu rutahizamu ufite impano idashidikanywaho yahita aca agahigo ko kuba umukinnyi wa mbere uguzwe amafaranga menshi ku isi kari gasanganywe Neymar ubwo yavaga muri Barcelona yerekeza muri PSG mu 2017 aguzwe amapawundi miliyoni 198.

Mbappe ashobora kuba umukinnyi wa mbere ku isi uguzwe amafaranga menshi Hashize igihe kinini Mbappe bivugwa ko agomba kuzerekeza muri Esipanye, ibi byatangiye kunuganugwa kuva yatangira kwigaragaza ku ruhando mpuzamahanga ubwo yari akiri muri Monaco ku myaka 17 gusa y’amavuko. Kugeza ubu amaze gutsinda ibitego 67  anatanga imipira 31 yabyaye ibitego mu mikino 104 gusa amaze gukina ndetse ubu abakurikiranira hafi bemeza ko ashobora kuzaba umukinnyi watsinze byinshi muri shampiyona y’Abarasansa muri uyu mwaka.

Zidane arifuza bikomeye Mbappe ngo aze afashe ubusatirizi bwa Real Madrid Mbappe yari umukinnyi wazaga ku isonga mu bashakagwa na Zidane mu mpeshyi ishize aho yashakaga kumusimbuza Gareth Bale gusa byarangiye uyu musore agumye i Paris maze Real Madrid ibasha kugura Luka Jovic imukuye muri Eintracht Frankfurt na Eden Hazard yakuye muri Chelsea. Kuba ikipe ya PSG nayo yifuza Umunya-Brazil, Vinicius Junior, ibi bishobora gutuma aya makipe yakwicara akaganira kuko nubwo uyu munya-Brazil yari yitezweho byinshi muri Real Madrid kuva yatangira kuyikinira mu mwaka w’imikino ushize, nyuma yaho Zidane agarutse ntiyakomeje kubona umwanya uhagije wo gukina aho muri uyu mwaka ubu amaze gukina imikino ine gusa abanje mu kibuga, indi itanu akinjira asimbuye.

Mbappe ashobora kubisikana na Vinicius Junior Gusa mu byumweru bishize hagaragaye gyterana amagambo hagati y’Umuyobozi wa siporo muri PSG, Leonaldo n’umutoza Zinedine Zidane nyuma yaho uyu mutoza avuze ko inzozi za Mbappe ari ukuzakinira Real Madrid maze Leonaldo akamwiyama guhoza mu kanwa umukinnyi wabo.

title: Ibigo 10 birimo Rwandair na Radisson Blu bigiye guhurira mu irushanwa ry’umupira w’amaguru
content:
Ikigo cya Thousand Hills Events cyateguye irushanwa ry’umupira w’amaguru na Basketball rigamije gukangurira urwego rw’abikorera gushishikariza abakozi babo gukora siporo hirindwa indwara zitandura n’umubyibuho ukabije, rikazahuza ibigo 10 by’abikorera. Ni irushanwa ry’umunsi umwe rizaba kuri iki Cyumweru tariki ya 03 Ugushyingo 2019 rikabera ku bibuga bibiri bya IPRC Kicukiro kuva saa moya za mu gitondo (07h00). Ibigo 10 byiyandikishije mu mupira w’amaguru bigabanyije mu matsinda abiri aho itsinda rizakinira ku kibuga cya mbere rizaba rigizwe n’amakipe ane ari yo : Isango Star, Sulfo, Inos na Igihe naho itsinda rizakinira ku kibuga cya kabiri rikazaba rigizwe n’amakipe 6 ari yo : Radisson Blu, Rwandair, Toyota, Duru Juba, Inyange na Star Times. Ibigo bibiri gusa ni byo bizakina umukino wa Basketball ari byo Radisson Blu na Rwandair. Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru cyabaye kuri uyu wa Gatanu kigamije gusobanura uko iri rushanwa rizagenda n’intego yaryo, hahise hanakorwa tombola y’uko amakipe azahura aho mu itsinda rya mbere naho mu itsinda rya kabiri Radisson Blu na Rwandair nibyo bizafungura imikino yo muri iri tsinda naho Toyota izakurikireho icakirana na Duru Juba mu gihe Inyange izisobanura na Star Times.

Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru Hasobanuwe ko aya makipe azagenda akuranamo maze haboneke abiri ajya ku mukino wa nyuma aho bazajya bakina iminota 60 (igice kimwe 30 n’ikindi 30). Abajijwe ku bihembo biteganijwe, Nathan uyobora Thousand Hills Events yavuze ko ibihembo bidahambaye kuko intego nyamukuru ari ugushishikariza abakora mu bigo by’abikorera kudaheranwa n’akazi bakibagirwa kubungabunga ubuzima bwabo bakora siporo. Nathan yagize ati "Insanganyamatsiko ni umukozi wagize ubuzima bwiza ni we utanga umusaruro utubutse. (…) ni mu rwego rwo gukangurira urwego rw’abikorera gushishikariza abakozi babo gukora siporo mu rwego rwo kurwanya indwara zitandura n’umubyibuho ukabije kuko akenshi na kenshi urwego rw’abikorera baragenda bakareba inyungu batareba ubuzima bw’umukozi."

Nathan, umuyobozi wa Thousand Hills Event Uyu muyobozi yakomeje avuga ko ku bw’ibyo bateganije ko ikipe izaba iya mbere izegukana ibihumbi ijana by’amafaranga y’u Rwanda (100,000frw) mu mupira w’amaguru n’ibihumbi mirongo itanu (50,000frw) muri Basketball ndetse n’abakinnyi bitwaye neza bagahembwa aho uretse ibi bihembo by’amafaranga hazanatangwa ibihembo byo kwitabira siporo ngororamubiri (GYM) ihoraho muri kimwe mu bigo byiza biherereye i Kigali bitanga iyi serivisi. Nathan yavuze ko amafaranga y’ibihembo iyo abaye menshi usanga ibigo bibigira ubucuruzi ugasanga birimo birashaka abakinnyi basanzwe badakorera ibyo bigo kandi nyamara ikigamijwe ari uko bazakinisha abakozi babo bakaboneraho gukora siporo no gusabana na bagenzi babo bityo bakazajya bahora bakora siporo. Thousand Hills Events isanzwe ifasha ibigo byigenga n’ibya Leta gutegura ibirori, gutanga ibihembo, inama n’ibindi bikorwa, ivuga ko yifuza ko iki gikorwa bajya bagitegura mu buryo ngarukamwaka ndetse ibigo byinshi bikakitabira aho bashaka ko ubutaha bazongeramo n’indi mikino irimo nka Cricket, Golf n’indi.

title: Afurika y’Epfo izahurira n’Ubwongereza ku mukino wa nyuma w’igikombe cy’isi cya Rugby
content:
Springboks, ikipe y’igihugu ya Afurika y’Epfo muri rugby yerekeje ku mukino wa nyuma w’igikombe cy’isi kiri kubera mu Buyapani nyuma yaho isezereye kuri iki Cyumweru tariki ya 27 Ukwakira 2019 Wales iyitsinze 19-16, ikaba izahahurira n’ikipe y’Ubwongereza yo yasezereye All Blacks ya Nouvelle-Zélande. Afurika y’Epfo yageze ku mukino wa nyuma yiyushye icyuya kuko Wales itayoroheye aho bageze mu minota itanu ya nyuma bangana amanota 16 kuri 16 mbere y’uko umusore wa yo Handré Pollard ayitsindira penaliti yabonetse muri metero 35, uyu mugabo kandi akaba yatsinze amanota 14 muri 19 ikipe ye yabonye.

Afurika y’Epfo yasezereye bigoranye Wales Umukino wa nyuma utegerejwe ku wa Gatandatu tariki 02 Ugushyingo 2019 i Yokohama, akaba ari ku nshuro ya kabiri izi kipe zihuriye kuri finali dore ko mu gikombe cy’isi cya 2007 nabwo bahuye maze abasore ba Springboks batsinda Abongereza 15-6 begukana igikombe cy’isi cya kabiri cyazaga gisanga icya mbere batwaye mu 1995. Abongereza bo begukanye iki gikombe cy’isi cya rugby mu 2003, ubu bakaba baza bashaka kureba ko bakongera kugitwara nyuma yo gusezerera muri 1/2 Nouvelle-Zélande yari yegukanye ibikombe bibiri biheruka. Iyi Nouvelle-Zélande ikzakina na Wales umukino wo guhatanira umwanya wa 3 ku wa Gatanu tariki ya 01 Ugushyingo 2019.

title: Umunsi wa 5 wa shampiyona usize APR FC ku isonga, AS kigali ibona itsinzi yayo ya mbere, Rayon Sports yo iratsikira -Urutonde
content:
Kuva mu mpera z’iki cyumweru shampiyona y’umupira w’amaguru mu Rwanda yarakomeje hakinwa umunsi wayo wa gatanu aho ikipe ya APR FC yari yakiriye Muhanga FC kuri iki cyumweru ikayitsinda ibitego 2-0 ari yo ikomeje kuyobora urutonde mu gihe mukeba wayo Rayon Sports yo yatsindiwe I Nyagatare ku wa Gatandatu ibitego 2-1 na Sunrise FC. Uyu munsi watangiye ku wa Gatanu tariki 25 Ukwakira 2019 Police FC yatsinze Heroes FC 2-0, SC Kiyovu itsinda  Gicumbi FC 1-0 bituma iyi kipe yatangiranye ibibazo by’amikoro igwiza imikino itanu itarabona itarabona n’inota na rimwe ndetse ihita yirukana umutoza wayo mu gihe Espoir FC yo yatsinze Musanze C 2-1. Ku wa Gatandatu iyi shampiyona yakomeje AS Kigali yinyara mu isunzu ibona itsinzi yayo ya mbere muri iyi shampiyona nyuma yo gutsinda Marines FC 1-0 naho Mukura VS mu rugo i Huye iba ikipe ya mbere ibashije gufungura amazamu ya Gasogi United iyitsinda ibitego 2-1 ari na bwo bwa mbere iyi kipe yazamutse mu cyiciro cya mbere muri uyu mwaka yari itsinzwe. Kuri uyu munsi kandi Bugesera FC mu rugo yahatsindiwe na Etincelles ibitego 2-0 mu gihe Rayon Sports yahabwaga isomo rya ruhago na Sunrise FC inyagatare iyitsinda ibitego 2-1 icyafunguye amazamu cy’umugande Manjanjaro Suleiman ku munota wa 17 cyaje kwishyurwa na Yannick Bizimana ku munota wa 71 ariko iyi kipe y’i Nyagatare yari yarushije Rayon Sports ibona igitego cya kabiri ku munota wa 87 gitsinzwe n’undi mugande Wangi Pius, iyi iba itsinzi ya mbere iyi kipe ibonye imbere ya Rayon Sports kuva yazamuka. Kuri iki Cyumweru ho habaye umukino umwe ikipe ya APR FCyari yakiriyemo Muhanga FC maze ba myugariro babiri iyi kipe yakuye mu Rayon Sports, Manzi Thierry na Mutsinzi Ange bayifasha gutsinda ibitego 2-0. Ni ibitego byombi bytsindishijwe umutwe mu gice cya mbere aho Mutsinzi yafunguye amazamu ku munota wa 34 ku mupira wari uvuye muri kuruneli yatewe na Buteera Andrew maze nyuma y’iminota itatu gusa Manzi Thieery aterekamo icya kabiri ku mupira wari uhinduwe na Ishimwe Kevin. Uretse kuba iyi tsinzi yatumye ikipe y’ingabo z’igihugu yihimura kuri Muhanga FC iri mu makipe yayitesheje amanota mu mpera za shampiyona ishize ubwo yakubanaga na Rayon Sports bikayiviramo kugitakaza, iyi tsinzi yanafashije APR FC gukomeza gufata umwanya wa mbere.

title: APR FC yahagaritse Sugira Ernest
content:
Ikipe y’ingabo z’igihugu, APR FC yatangaje ko yahagaritse by’agateganyo rutahizamu wayo Sugira Ernest kubera amagambo aherutse kubwira itangazamakuru ubwo yagarukaga ku mpamvu yitwara neza mu ikipe y’igihugu ariko yagera muri APR FC bikanga. Amakuru yihagarikwa rya Sugira Ernest mu gihe APR FC yitegura gucakirana na Marines FC ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 22 Ukwakira 2019, yahamijwe n’Umuvugizi wa yo Kazungu Claver.
 Mu butumwa yatanze asobanura impamvu uyu mukinnyi yahagaritswe yagize ati "Nyuma y’uko Sugira atitwaye neza mu kibuga mu buryo bunogeye Umutoza wa APR FC agahitamo kutamukoresha ku mikino ibiri ya Shampiyona; Bugesera Fc na Etincelles Fc, we akabwira itangazamakuru ko akinishwa yugarira muri APR FC ariyo mpamvu adatanga umusaruro kandi ataribyo kuko umupira twese turawureba n’umwanya akina muri APR FC. Yongeye kuvuga ko atisanga muri APR FC ikipe yamufashe yirukanywe muri AS Vita Club, ikipe yamuvuje inshuro ebyiri mu gihugu no hanze amaze kuvunika kandi ikomeza kumuhemba adakina mu gihe cy’imyaka ibiri. Kubera iyo myitwarire mibi yagaragaje ikipe ya APR FC yamufatiye ibihano muzamenyeshwa.” Nyuma yaho ibitego bibiri Sugira yatsinze Etiyopiya mu mukino ubanza n’uwo kwishyura bifashije Amavubi y’abakina imbere mu gihugu gukatisha itike ya CHAN 2020 izabera muri Cameroun, itangazamakuru ryongeye kugaruka cyane ku buryo uyu musore ari mu bihe byiza mu ikipe y’igihugu nyamara mu mikino ibiri iheruka ya shampiyona muri APR FC atanabasha kuza mu bakinnyi 18.

Sugira yitwara neza mu Amavubi, abafana bakanabimuhembera ariko muri APR FC bikomeje kwanga Aha, Sugira yirinze kugira byinshi abivugaho asubiza ko "Ikipe y’Igihugu n’ikipe isanzwe ni ibintu bibiri bitandukanye. Buri muntu agira aho yisanga, ni ko navuga. Niba ari ugukunda igihugu bindimo cyane nk’uko mu kirango cy’igihugu birimo, ntabwo babimpora. Nkunda ikipe y’igihugu, ni nayo nisangamo cyane. Nta kundi nyine ubwo n’ahandi bizagenda biza.” Abajijwe impamvu atsinda mu Amavubi ariko muri APR FC bikaba bikomeje kwanga, yagize ati "Icyo kibazo gikunda kunteranya n’ikipe yanjye, byaba byiza aka kanya ntakivuzeho wenda nkazakivugaho mu minsi iri imbere kubera y’uko ubushize naragisobanuye bimbera bibi, binsanga n’aho twari mu mwiherero. Kubisubiramo mfite umutima mwiza w’intsinzi aka kanya, ntabwo byaba ari byiza.”

Sugira yahetse Amavubi ayageza muri CHAN bituma asingizwa Ibi yabitangaje nyuma yaho hagati mu cyumweru ubwo yari mu myitozo y’ikipe y’igihugu nabwo yari yabibajijwe maze icyo gihe avuga ko imikinishirize itandukanye ko muri APR FC abatoza bamusaba kugaruka inyuma akugarira mu gihe mu ikipe y’igihugu ho asabwa kubuza amahwemo ba myugariro ashaka ibitego. Mu magambo ye yari yagize ati "Ntabwo abatoza bagira imikinishirize imwe, muri APR FC bansaba kugaruka hagati imbere mu gihe mu ikipe y’Amavubi nsabwa kubuza amahwemo ba myugariro nishakira ibitego, ni ibintu bitandukanye bimwe bigenda neza, ndetse bikananyorohera ahandi bikangora. Gusa nzagerageza kwitwara neza hose.”

title: Sugira yongeye gucungura Amavubi yasezereye Etiyopiya agakatisha itike ya CHAN 2020
content:
Ikipe y’igihugu y’u Rwanda, Amavubi y’abakina imbere mu gihugu ni imwe mu makipe 16 azaba ari muri Cameroun mu ntangiriro z’umwaka utaha ahazabera igikombe cya Afurika cy’abakina imbere mu bihugu byabo (CHAN2020). Ibi Amavubi yabigezeho yiyushye icyuya nyuma yo kunganyiriza i Kigali na Etiyopiya igitego 1-1 mu mukino wabereye kuri stade ya Kigali i Nyamirambo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 19 Ukwakira 2019 maze ayisezerera ku giteranyo cy’ibitego 2-1 kuko umukino ubanza abasore b’umutoza Mashami Vincent bari babashije gutsindira Etiyopiya iwayo igitego 1-0. Nkuko byagenze mu mukino ubanza, rutahizamu Sugira Ernest ni we waboneye Amavubi igitego cyaruhuye imitima y’abanyarwanda ku munota wa 82 kuko cyazaga kishyura icyo Lemeen Tafesse yari yaboneye Etiyopiya ku munota wa 71 ku makosa ya Manzi Thierry n’umuzamu Kimenyi Yves.

Herve Rugwiro ahetse Sugira
 Ni umukino waranzwe ni uko igice cya mbere ikipe y’igihugu ya Etiyopiya yageragezaga guhanahana neza ikina umupira wo hasi ariko uburyo bukomeye imbere y’izamu bukaremwa n’Amavubi yakoraga bike by’ingenzi ibifashijwemo na kapiteni wayo Haruna Niyonzima. Ku munota wa 13 Nsabimana Eric yahushije igitego cyari cyabazwe ku mupira mwiza yari ahinduriwe na Manishimwe Djabel mu gihe mbere y’uko igice cya mbere kirangira Sugira Ernest nawe yashatse gutungura umuzamu ariko umupira awushyira muri kuroneli. Igice cya kabiri Etiyopiya yaje yahinduye imikinire itangira gukina imipira yihuta itera icyugazi izamu rya Kimenyi Yves kugeza ubwo yabonaga igitego ku munota wa 71cyahise gikangura ndetse gishyira ku gitutu abasore ba Mashami kugeza ubwo Sugira yatabaraga ku mupira mwiza yateye adahagaritse wari uhinduwe na Omborenga Fitina.

Sugira yari yazonze ab’inyuma ba Etiyopiya Amavubi yerekeje muri CHAN ku nshuro ya gatatu yikurikiranije dore ko kuva yayakira mu 2016 akaviramo muri 1/4 atarasiba. Mu 2018 nabwo yabonye itike asezereye Etiyopiya ariko ntiyabasha kurenga imikino yo mu matsinda. Indi nshuro u Rwanda rwitabiriye aya marushanwa ni mu 2011 ubwo ryaberaga muri Sudani naho mu nshuro esheshatu rimaze gukinwa akaba ari inshuro ebyri gusa rutabonye itike harimo ubwo ryakinwaga bwa mbere mu 2009 no mu 2014.

Nyuma y’umukino abafana bahaye Sugira amafaranga Kugeza ubu ibintu ni byiza k’umutoza Mashami Vincent uri kugenda akora neza inshingano yari yahawe mu masezerano y’amezi atatu aho amaze kugera kuri bibiri muri bitatu yasabwaga ari byo gusezerera ibirwa bya Seychelles agashyira u Rwanda mu matsinda yo guhatanira itike y’igikombe cy’isi no gusezerera Etiyopiya akabona itike ya CHAN. Ubu hakaba hasigaye kureba uko azitwara mu kwezi gutaha ari nako kwa nyuma mu masezerano ye aho asabwa kubona byibuze amanota ane mu mikino ibiri yo gushaka itike yo kwerekeza mu gikombe cya Afurika (CAN) kizabera muri Cameroun mu 2021 aho azasura Mozambique ku ya 14 Ugushyingo, akanakira Cameroun i Kigali ku ya 19 maze yabyitwaramo neza agahita ahabwa amasezerano y’igihe kirekire.

title: Amerika:Umuteramakofi yishwe n’ibikomere yakuye mu murwano (Video)
content:
Umuteramakofe Patrick Day wari ufite imyaka 27 y’amavuko byatangajwe ko yapfuye ku wa Gatatu w’iki cyumweru nyuma n’ingumi nyinshi yakubiswe zikangiza ubwonko bwe ku wa Gatandatu ushize tariki ya 12 Ukwakira 2019. "Patrick Day yapfuye uyu munsi ku ya 16 Ukwakira 2019 azize ibikomere byo mu bwonko yagize mu murwano (combat) wari wamuhuje na mugenzi we Charles Conwell.", Itangazo ryashyizwe hanze na Lou DiBella wari wateguye uyu murwano.

Day yaguye muri uyu murwano wamuhuzaga na mugenzi we Charles Conwell Patrick Day yari yavanywe mu kibuga (ring) yatakaje ubwenge nyuma yo gukibitwa KO muri uyu mukino wari wabereye i Chicago aho yahise yerekezwa mu bitaro abagwa by’igitaraganya mu bwonko.

Day yavanywe muri ring yabuze ubwenge Uyu muteramakofi wari ukiri muto yakubiswe bikomeye na Conwell ubwo bahuraga mu cyiciro cya super-welters ( cy’abafite ibiro biri munsi ya 69,853 kg) i Chicago Winstrust Arena. Reba umukino watumye Patrick Day asezera ku isi y’abazima Uyu murwano wamuviriyemo urupfu yari awukinnye nyuma yo kugaruka muri ring bwa mbere kuva yatsindwa muri Kamena uyu mwaka I New York ubwo yahuraga na Carlos Adames. Muri rusange Patrick Day yari amaze gutsinda imikino 17, atsindwa inshuro enye mu gihe yananganyije inshuro imwe kuva yatangira gukina ku rwego rwo hejuru nk’uwabigize umwuga mu 2013.

Nyakwigendera Patrick Day Urupfu rw’uyu musore ruje rukurikira urwa Christian Daghio, umutaliyani wari ufite imikandara ya zahabu 7 y’isi mu mukino jyarugamba y’iteramakofi gakondo rikomoka muri Thailande (Muay Thai) wapfuye muntangiriro z’Ugushyingo 2018, ibi bikaba bikomeje kugaragaza uburyo uyu mukino w’iteramakofi uteye ubwoba.

Christian Daghio yapfuye nyuma y’umurwano yarwanye ku ya 26 Ukwakira 2018 i Bangkok aho yari ahanganiye na mugenzi we Don Pareuang umukandara wa WBC w’ifeza (silver) utangwa na Asian Boxing Council

title: Visi Perezida wa mbere wa Rayon Sports, Twagirayezu Thadée na we yeguye
content:
Ubuyobozi bukuru bw’ikipe ya Rayon Sports bwemeje kuri uyu wa Kane ko Twagirayezu Thadée wari visi perezida wa mbere wa yo yeguye, ibi bikaba bije nyuma y’iminsi mike hari ukutumvikana hagati ya Perezida w’iyi kipe Sadate Munyakazi n’uwari visi perezida we wa kabiri Prosper. Mu itangazo rigenewe abanyamakuru ryasinyweho na Perezida Sadate Munyakazi, ryavugaga ko Twagirayezu Thadée yeguye ku bw’impamvu ze bwite ndetse ubwegure bwe bukaba bwemewe kuri uyu wa 17 Ukwakira 2019 na komite nyobozi y’umuryango wa Rayon Sports. Iri tangazo rikomeza rivuga ko "Umuryango wa Rayon Sports ushimira byimazeyo ubushake n’ubwitange Twagirayezu Thadée yagaragaje mu myaka amaze mu buyobozi bwayo."

Itangazo rigenewe abanyamakuru ryemeza ubwegure bwa Twagirayezu Hari ibinyamakuru byanditse ko mu ibaruwa y’ubwegure uyu Twagirayezu Thadée wari umaze amezi abiri muri zi nshingano yandikiye Rayon Sports yaba yamenyesheje ubuyobozi bw’iyi kipe ko yabonye imirimo imutunguye irimo isoko yatsindiye bisaba ko yakwitabwaho cyane bityo umwanya ukaba ari muto kuri we.

title: Jacques Tuyisenge na Kagere Meddie mu bakinnyi 27 Amavubi yahamagaye yitegura Tanzaniya
content: Mu gihe kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 14 Ukwakira 2019 hategerejwe umukino wa gicuti hagati y’ikipe y’igihugu y’u Rwanda, Amavubi n’iya Tanzaniya, Taifa Stars, umutoza Mashami Vincent yamaze gushyira hanze lisite y’abakinnyi 27 yahamagaye azakuramo abo azifashisha kuri uyu mukino. Ni umukino ahanini umutoza Mashami Vincent avuga ko yifuza ko wamuasha kwitegura neza umukino wo kwishyura uzamuhuza na Etiyopiya mu gushaka itike yerekeza muri CHAN 2020 ari nayo mpamvu ikipe yahamagaye igizwe n’abakinnyi bakina imbere mu gihugu uretse ba rutahizamu Jacques Tuyisenge wa Petro Atletico y’i Luanda muri Angola na Kaere Meddie wa Simba SC yo muri Tanzaniya. Aba basore bitabajwe mu rwego rwo kuzana ubunararibonye mu ikipe y’igihugu ariko kandi ukaba n’umwanya mwiza wo gukomeza kumenyerana dore ko bagomba no kwitegura imikino ya Mozambique na Cameroun mu gushaka itike yerekeza mu gikombe cya Afurika 2021 nacyo kizabera muri Cameroun. Mu bakinnyi bahamagawe hongeye kugaragaramo abakinnyi batari bagize amahirwe yo guhamagarwa mu mikino ishize ya Congo Kinshasa na Etiyopiya barimo Nshuti Dominique Savio wa Police, Jimmy Mbaraga wa Bugesera FC, Byiringiro Lague wa APR FC, Kalisa Rachid wa AS Kigali, Iyabivuze Osee wa Police FC , Rugwiro Herve wa Rayon Sports hamwe n’abo babiri bakina hanze y’u Rwanda twavuze. Ikipe y’igihugu ya Tanzaniya nayo ikaba yamaze kugera mu Rwanda, aho izava nyuma y’uyu mukino wa gicuti ijya gucakirana na Sudani yari yabatsindiye i Dar-es-Salam igitego 1-0 mu gushaka itike ya CHAN naho Amavubi yo akazakomeza kwitegura Etiyopiya mu mukino uzaba ku wa Gatandatu utaha, aho Amavubi asabwa guhagarara ku gitego 1-0 yabashije gutsindira i Addis Ababa. title: David Luiz yageze mu Rwanda aherekejwe na nyina n’umukunzi we
content:
Myugariro w’Umunya-Brazi , David Luiz ukinira ikipe ya Arsenal  y’i London mu Bwongereza, yasesekaye i Kigali ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 10 Ukwakira 2019 aho aje mu bikorwa by’ubukerarugendo bifitanye isano na gahunda ya Visit Rwanda. Uyu musore w’imyaka 32 yaje aherekejwe n’umukunzi we ndetse n’umubyeyi we. Akigera ku kibuga cy’indege yavuze ko anyotewe cyane no gusura ingagi zo mu birunga. David Luiz utarahamagawe n’ikipe y’igihugu ya Brazil, ibi bihe by’ibiruhuko bifugi by’amakipe y’ibihugu we akaba agiye kubyifashisha asura u Rwanda aho bivugwa ko azasubira mu Bwongereza mu ijoro ryo ku wa Gatandatu tariki ya 12 Ukwakira 2019.

David Luiz yaje gusura u Rwanda binyuze muri gahunda ya Visit Rwanda Ikipe ya Arsenal isanzwe ifitanye amasezerano na leta y’u Rwanda yo kwamamaza, mu mugambi wa leta y’u Rwanda wo guteza imbere ubukerarugendo binyuze mu Kigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere, RDB aho iyi kipe yambara ikirango cya ’Visit Rwanda’ ku kuboko. David Luiz akaba abaye umukinnyi wa mbere wa Arsenal mu bakiyikinira usuye u Rwanda. Ni  nyuma ya Tony Adams n’umunya Cameroon Lauren Etame Maye bagiye baza mu bihe bishize.

title: Kigali: Ibikubiye mu mpanuro Didier Drogba yahaye urubyiruko
content: Mu biganiro by’umunsi wa 2 w’ihuriro nyafrika ry’urubyiruko, Didier Drogba wamamaye mu mupira w’amaguru yaganirije rumwe mu rubyiruko rwaryitabiriye, aho yarushishikarije kubyaza umusaruro ibyo rukunda, rukigirira icyizere mu guhangana n’imbogamizi bahuriramo na zo. Ikindi yagarutseho ni uko rugomba gukunda ibihugu byabo n’umugabane wa Afurika muri rusange. Urubyiruko rwitabiriye ’Youth Connekt Africa Summit’ rwaganirizwaga ku buryo wabyaza inyungu ibyo ukunda gukora, rwagaragaje ibyishimo bidasanzwe ubwo bamenyeshwaga ko bagiye kuganirizwa n’umunya Cote d’Ivoire Didier Drogba wamenyekanye cyane mu mupira w’amaguru ku migabane hafi ya yose igize isi. Uyu mugabo uvuga ko yari azi ko azaba umuganga, ariko yahura na nyirarume wakinaga umupira w’amaguru mu Bufransa, inzozi ze zigahinduka ubwo yari afite imyaka 6, ari na bwo bajyanye mu  Bufaransa anatangirirayo ishuli. Ari nabwo yahise akunda umupira w’amaguru yemeza ko utari ukunzwe ku babyeyi nk’uko bimeze ubu. Yagize ati "Ntabwo ari nko muri iki gihe. Kuri ubu buri mubyeyi aba abwira umwana ngo jya gukina umupira w’amaguru, genda ukine bizatuma ubona amafaranga. Oya, oya rwose, umupira w’amaguru muri icyo gihe ntiwafatwaga nk’akazi, tukiri ku ishuri bajyaga badusaba kwandika ibyo twifuza kuzakora nidukura. Ubwo nagombaga kuzuza ko nzaba umukinnyi w’umupira w’amaguru wabigize umwuga, kandi papa yagombaga gusinya. Huum, yafashe urupapuro araruca arambwira ati ’nubona umwuga nyawo uzakora uzazane ngusinyire.’ Ndavuga nti nta kundi. Nandikaho ikindi. Ndavuga ngo nshaka kuzajya nkora imigati." Muri uru rugendo rwo kubaka ubunyamwuga bwe, ngo yahuriyemo n’imbogamizi nyinshi zirimo yemwe no gukora amahitamo ku makipe yagombaga gukinira. Ati "Sinigeze nifuza kujya muri Chelsea mbere na mbere, inzozi zanjye kwari ugukinira Marseille kuko nari umukunzi wayo cyane. Ikindi mvugishije ukuri, ibintu byanjeho byose byihuta, mu myaka ibiri mbere y’uko mbona aya mahirwe nari umusimbura mu ikipe yo mu cyiciro cya 2 mu Bufaransa, icyiciro cya 2. None ikipe ikomeye ku isi irashaka ko nyikinira. Yari indi mbogamizi kandi nini ngomba guhangana na yo. Aho nagize impungenge. Ariko kubera ko nize uburyo bwo guhangana n’imbogamizi, guhangana n’ibyanca intege, niyemeje guhangana n’iyo mbogamizi, kuko nari niyizeye." Kugira ishyaka ry’umugabane wa Afurika n’ubwo hari amahirwe ngo byamuvukije ku bashakaga kwamamaza bimunyujijweho kuko atakiniraga ikipe y’igihugu y’i Burayi, ariko abona hari umusaruro byatanze muri iki gihe. Ati "Narabibwiye nti hari icyo mutazi. Ubu rero ngiye kubereka. (amashyi) Ubu ngiye kubereka, ngiye kubereka ko aho nkomoka, simfite gusa igihugu kindi inyuma, ahubwo mfite umugabane wose unshyigikiye. (amashyi) Kandi aha ni ahantu mwakabaye mushora imari yanyu. Ubwo hari mu 2004-2005. Nti aha ni ho mwakagombye kuba mukorera ishoramari. Noneho umwaka ushize, ubwo nabonaga ikigo cya Nike kiri muri Nigeria mu bikorwa byo kwamamaza, bagurisha amamiliyoni y’amashati, naricaye ndabareba ndavuga nti si byo nababwiraga? (amashyi)… narabibabwiye." Didier Drogba agira inama urubyiruko rwa Afurika kumva ko kuguma ku mugane wabo ari ikibazo kuko ari rwo rugomba kuwuteza imbere rufatiye urugero ku baruboneye izuba, ndetse no ku bihugu nk’u Rwanda Yagize ati "Ndagira ngo mbabwire ko mudakwiriye kujya mu mahanga kwiga ngo mugire ubumenyi buhambaye mubone kugaruka gushora imari mu bihugu byanyu ku mugabane wanyu, ndagira ngo mbabwira rwose ko ibyo mushobora kubikorera ku mugabane wanyu.(amashyi) Si ndi uwa mbere kandi ndizera ko ntagiye no kuba uwa nyuma, ubibabwiye, gusa niba nshobora kubereka inzira mwanyura nk’uko abambanjirije babigenje, nk’uko Amadou yabikoze, nk’uko Serge Backer yabigenje, si abakinnyi gusa babikoze ahubwo reka mbivuge, nk’uko nyakubahwa Paul Kagame yabikoze, kuko nimurebe igihugu cyanyu. Nari hano mu 2009, igihugu cyanyu cyanyuze mu bintu byinshi mu gihe cyahise, ariko se ni gute mwagize imbaraga zo kongera kucyubaka? (Amashyi) Ibi biratangaje, ni gute mwabashije kwiyubaka, mwabonye gute imbaraga zo kongera kwicara hamwe? Ibi nta handi byabaye uretse muri Afrika. Muri urugero, muri urugero. Mu bunararibonye buke bwanjye, ubwo mu gihugu cyanjye Cote d’Ivoire habaga ubushyamirane hagati y’abaturage, nabakoresheje nk’urugero. Muri urugero.  " Ku myaka 19 ni bwo Didier Drogba yatangiye gukina nk’umukinnyi wabigize umwuga, ariko akemeza ko uku gukina atakoreshaga amaguru gusa, ahubwo ngo yakoreshaga ubwonko cyane. Na ho gukina ku migabane inyuranye ngo hari icyo byamufashaga kwiga no kwigisha abandi bakinaga hamwe. Src:RBA

title: David Luiz wa Arsenal ategerejwe mu Rwanda kuri uyu wa Kane
content:
David Luiz Moreira Marinho myugariro w’ikipe ya Arsenal FC yo mu Bwongereza ejo kuwa kane azaza mu Rwanda nk’uko umuyobozi ushinzwe itumanaho wa Arsenal yabibwiye BBC. David Luiz w’imyaka 32, azaba ari mu Rwanda kugeza ku cyumweru nkuko BBC dukesha iyi nkuru yabyanditse. Arsenal FC ifitanye amasezerano na leta y’u Rwanda yo kwamamaza, mu mugambi wa leta y’u Rwanda wo guteza imbere ubukerarugendo.
 aho iyi kipe yambara ikirango cya ’Visit Rwanda’ ku kuboko. Abatavuga rumwe na Leta y’u Rwanda bavuga ko amafaranga yishyuwe Arsenal muri iki gikorwa ari umurengera ndetse bitari bikwiye kuko nta nyungu ikomeye abanyarwanda bazabikuramo, ariko Leta yo yatangaje ko kwamamazwa n’ikipe ikomeye ku isi nka Arsenal ari ishoramari rizaha inyungu nini ubukungu bw’u Rwanda biciye mu bukerarugendo. David Luiz yageze muri Arsenal muri uyu mwaka avuye muri Chelsea, agiye kuza mu Rwanda mu gihe shampiyona z’i Burayi ziri mu karuhuko kubera imikino mpuzamahanga y’amakipe y’ibihugu. Ikipe ye ya Arsenal ubu iri ku mwanya wa gatatu ku rutonde rwa shampiyona y’Ubwongereza imaze gukinwa imikino umunani(8). Didier Drogba wahoze akina muri Chelsea nawe azaba ari mu Rwanda mu gikorwa cya Youth Connect nk’uko abagitegura babitangaje, iki gikorwa cyatangiye uyu munsi kugeza tariki 11 z’uku kwezi i Kigali.

title: Rayon Sports yigaranzuye AS Kigali, irarara ku isonga, APR FC nayo itsinda Bugesera
content:
Kuri uyu wa Kabiri tarki ya 08 Ukwakira 2019, shampiyona y’icyiciro cya mbere mu mupira w’amaguru mu Rwanda yakomezaga aho hakinwe imikino ibiri y’umunsi wa kabiri wa shampiyona yabimburiwe na Bugesera FC yari yakiriye APR FC, waje gukurikirwa n’uwa Rayon Sports yari yakiriye AS Kigali. Duhereye ku mukino wa mbere watangiye ku isaha ya saa cyenda z’amanywa kuri stade nshya ya Bugesera, iyi kipe ya Bugesera FC yari imbere y’abafana bayo ntiyabashije kwihagararaho imbere y’ikipe z’ingabo z’igihugu zari zanganyije na AS Kigali ku mukino ufungura shampiyona. Igitego kimwe rukumbi cya Manishimwe Djabel cyabonetse ku munota wa 33 nicyo cyatandukanije impande zombi muri uyu mukino Bugesera FC yakinnye igihe kinini ari abakinnyi 10 gusa nyuma yaho Peter Otema ahawe ikarita itukutura ku munota wa 6 ku bw’ikosa rikomeye yari amaze gukorera umuzamu Rwabugiri Omar. Ku rundi ruhande ku isaha ya saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba kuri stade ya Kigali i Nyamirambo naho hari hategerejwe undi mukino w’ishiraniro wagombaga guhuza Rayon Sports yatangiye nabi inganya shampiyona na AS Kigali yari iherutse kuyitwara igikombe kiruta ibindi (Super Cup) ndetse ikanya na APR FC ku munsi wa mbere wa shampiyona. Ni umukino abasore ba Rayon Sports bagaragazaga cyane inyota yo gushaka ibitego ndetse byake kubahira ku munota wa 68 ubwo Mugisha Gilbert yafunguraga amazamu nyuma gato y’ikindi gitego cyari cyabazwe yari amaze guhusha. Iyi kipe y’umutoza Martinez Espinoza yaje kubona igitego cya kabiri kuri penaliti nyuma y’ikosa ryari rikorewe rutahizamu mpuzamahanga wayo Michael Sarpong ari nawe wayiteye ayinjiza neza ku munota wa 82.
