title: Super Cup: AS Kigali yatsinze Rayon Sports kuri penaliti iyitwara igikombe kiruta ibindi
content: Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 01 Ukwakira 2019, ikipe zitwaye neza kurusha izindi mu mwaka w’imikino ushize mu Rwanda, Rayon Sports yegukanye shampiyona na AS Kigali yegukanye igikombe cy’Amahoro, zahuriye mu gikombe kiruta ibindi (Super Cup) gitangiza umwaka w’imikino mushya. Ikipe ya AS Kigali ni yo yitwaye neza yegukana iki gikombe nyuma yaho iminota 90 y’umukino irangiye izi kipe ziguye miswi ibitego 2-2 maze hakitabazwa penaliti igatsinda 3-1. Rayon Sports ni yo yinjiye neza muri uyu mukino ndetse ifungura amazamu ku munota wa 29 ku gitego cyitsinzwe na Bishira Latif nyuma y’akazi gakomeye kari kamaze gukorwa na Iradukunda Eric Radu wazamukanye umupira akawuhindura mu rubuga rw’amahina rwa AS Kigali. Ku munota wa 31 Ssentongo Farouq Saifi yishyuriye igitego AS Kigali mbere y’uko Allongo Martel Mba Rick aterekamo icya kabiri cya AS Kigali ku mutwe nyuma ya koruneli yari itewe neza na Haruna Niyonzima ku munota wa 36 ari nako igice cya mbere cyarangiye. Mu gice cya kabiri AS Kigali yakomeje kwihagararaho kugeza ubwo ku munota wa 95 habura umunota umwe gusa ngo iminota itandatu y’inyongera umusifuzi yari yongeyeho irangire, Rutanga Eric yagomboye igitego cya kabiri ku mupira wari uhinduwe na Mugisha Gilbert maze ikizere cy’aba-Rayon kiragaruka. Michael Sarpong yahushije penaliti ya mbere yakuwemo na Bakame mu gihe ku ruhande rwa AS Kigali Ntamuhanga Tumaini ’Tity’ yayinjije neza. Iya kabiri ya Rayon Sports yinjijwe na Rugwiro Herve, ku ruhande rwa AS Kigali Niyonzima Haruna nawe ayinjiza neza. Bizimana Yannick yahushije penaliti ya gatatuya Rayon Sports yakuwemo na Bakame mu gihe ku ruhande rwa AS Kigali Benedata Janvier nawe yayiteye Kimenyi Yves akayikuramo. Mugisha Gilbert yateye penaliti ya kane ya Rayon Sports mu bicu maze Fosso Raymond atera neza iya 4 ya AS Kigali, yahise iyihesha bidasubirwaho igikombe yaherukaga mu 2013 nabwo itsinze Rayon Sports, iyi yo ikaba igiheruka mu 2017 itsinze APR FC.

title: CAF Confederation Cup: AS Kigali na yo yasezerewe mu marushanwa nyafurika
content:
Ikipe ya AS Kigali yari ihagarariye u Rwanda mu irushanwa rya CAF Confederation Cup yamaze gusezererwa muri aya marushanwa nyuma yo gutsindwa na Proline FC 2-1 mu mukino wo kwishyura wabereye i Kampala kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 28 Nzeri 2019. Ni nyuma yaho umukino ubanza wari wabereye i Kigali aya makipe yombi yari yanganyije 1-1 bityo Proline FC ikaba yakomeje ku giteranyo cy’ibitego 3-2. Ni umukino AS Kigali yinjiyemo nabi kuko mu minota 20 gusa, abasore b’umutoza Eric Nshimiyimana bari bamaze kwinjizwa ibitego bibiri byatsinzwe byombi na Ivan Bogere ( ku munota wa 11 n’uwa 20) mu gihe igitego cy’impozamarira bakibonye ku munota wa 85 gitsinzwe na Farouk Ssentogo.

Nsabimana Eric Zidane na bagenzi be ntibabashije kwikura kuri  Startimes Stadium Lugogo Kugeza ubu nta kipe ihagarariye u Rwanda mu marushanwa nyafurika y’uyu mwaka kuko na Rayon Sports yari iri muri Champions League yasezerwe rugikubita na Al Hilal yo muri Sudan. Uretse amakipe yo mu Rwanda, abakinnyi mpuzamahanga b’abanyarwanda nabo aho bakina mu makipe atandukanye muri Afurika benshi bamaze gusezererwa uretse Petro Atletico y’i Luanda muri Angola ya Jacques Tuyisenge yabashije kwinjira mu matsinda ya CAF Champions League. Young Africans ya Sibomana Patrick Pappy yo nubwo yasezerewe mu iri rushanwa rya Champions League, iacyafite andi mahirwe yo kuba yakwinjira mu matsinda ya Confederation Cup mu gihe yaramuka itsinze iyo bizahura mu mukino wa kamarampaka uzayihuza n’imwe mu makipe yabashije gukomeza mu kindi kiciro muri iri rushanwa.

title: Bitunguranye, Lionel Messi yatowe nk’umukinnyi w’umwaka mu bihembo ’FIFA The Best’
content:
Kabuhariwe w’umunya-Argentine, Lionel Messi yahigitse mukeba we Cristiano Ronaldo na Virgil van Dijk maze atorwa nk’umukinnyi wahize abandi mu mwaka w’imikino ushize mu bihembo by’impuzamashyirahamwe y’umupira w’amaguru ku isi, FIFA. Ni ibintu byatunguranye cyane kuko benshi mu bakurikiranira hafi ruhago bahaga amahirwe umuholande Virgil van Dijk kubera uburyo yitwaye mu mwaka w’imikino ushize afasha Liverpool kwegukana UEFA Champions League no kurangiza ku mwanya wa kabiri muri shampiyona ndetse agafasha Ubuholande kwegukana umwanya wa kabiri mu irushanwa rya Nations League.

Messi yashimiye buri wese wamutoye avuga ko nyuma y’ibihembo atwarana na bagenzi be nk’ikipe, ibihembo byo ku giti cye biza ku mwanya wa kabiri Messi yasimbuye Luka Modric wari wegukanye iki gihembo umwaka ushize. Kuva FIFA yakwitandukanya na France Football mu gutanga ’Ballon d’Or’, ni ubwa mbere Messi yegukanye iki gihembo mu gihe Cristiano Ronaldo yacyegukanye inshuro ebyiri zikurikiranije ubwo byatangiraga gutangwa mu 2016 na 2017.

Ikipe y’igihugu ya Portugal, ibinyujije kuri Twitter yayo yahise ivuga ko Cristiano ahiga bose 11 beza b’umwaka ba FIFA Ikipe ya 11 beza muri ibi bihembo bya The Best igizwe n’umuzamu w’umunya-Brazil, Alisson Becker wanegukanye igimbo cy’umuzamu w’umwaka, ba myugariro ni abaholande Virgil van Dijk na Matthijs de Ligt, umunya-Brazil, Marcelo n’umunya-Esipanye Sergio Ramos. Hagati mu kibuga hatowe umholande Frenkie de Jong, umunya-Croatia Luka Modric n’umubiligi Eden Hazard mu gihe ba rutahizamu ari umunya-Portugal Cristiano Ronaldo, umufaransa Kylian Mbappé n’umunya-Argentine Lionel Messi. Ku ya 05 Nzeri 2019 ni bwo FIFA yashyize hanze urutonde rw’abakinnyi 55 bagomba kuvamo abagize 11 beza b’umwaka (FIFA FIFPro World 11). Iyi kipe y’umwaka itorwa binyuze mu mutora y’abakinnyi babigize umwuga mu bice bitandukanye by’isi, aho buri mukinnyi atora umuzamu umwe, ba myugariro bane, abo hagati batatu n’abarutahizamu batatu. Hakaba haragendewe ku buryo bitwaye hagata ya tariki ya 16 Nyakanga 2018 na 19 Nyakanga 2019.

Virgil Van Dijk yahabwaga amahirwe menshi, ariko Messi ni we watowe nk’uwahize abandi Muri ibi bihembo bya The Best Fifa Football Awards byabereye ahitwa Scala de Milan mu Butaliyani hanatowe umutoza w’umwaka wabaye Umudage, Jurgen Klopp W’imyaka 52 y’amavuko waje imbere y’Umunya-Esipanye, Pep Guardiola n’Umunya-Argentine, Mauricio Pochettino.

Nyuma yo kwegukana UEFA Champions League,  Jurgen Klopp yatowe nk’umukinnyi w’umwaka

Megan Rapinoe, rutahizamu w’icyamamare mu ikipe y’igihugu y’abagore ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ni we watowe nk’uwahize abandi mu cyiciro cy’abagore

Umuzamu wa Liverpool, Alisson Becker yabaye umuzamu w’umwaka Tubibutse ko kuva ibi bihembo bya FIFA The Best byatangira gutangwa mu 2016, ucyegukanye ari nawe wagiye yegukana Ballon d’or muri uwo mwaka, ibihembo bitangwa mu Ukuboza, ibi bikaba byatumye benshi bitega kureba niba Messi azabasha no kwegukana iki gihembo  gitangwa n’ikinyamakuru France Football nyuma yaho atunguranye muri ibi bya FIFA.

title: Amavubi yakiriwe neza ubwo yagarukaga i Kigali akubutse muri Etiyopiya -Amafoto
content:
Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 23 Nzeri 2019 ahagana ku isaya ya saa cyenda ni bwo abasore b’ikipe y’igihugu y’u Rwanda, Amavubi y’abakina imbere mu gihugu yasesekaye ku kibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga cya Kigali avuye muri Etiyopiya. Ni ikipe yakiriwe neza na bamwe mu bakunzi bayo bishimiye uko yitwaye aho yabashije gutsinda Etiyopiya igitego 1-0 mu mukino ubanza wo guhatanira kwerekeza mu gikombe cya Afurika cy’abakina imbere muri shampiyona z’ibihugu byabo (CHAN 2020) kizabera muri Cameroun mu ntangiriro za 2020.

Abafana basanganiye umutoza Mashami Vincent bamugaragariza ko bishimiye imyitwarire y’ikipe Iyi ntsinzi yahise ituma Amavubi agira imwe mu myitwarire myiza mu mateka yayo yo gutsinda imikino ine yikurikiranije aho itatu muri yo yanayitsindiye hanze y’u Rwanda. Yabashije gutsinda ibirwa bya Seychelles ibitego 3-0 mu mukino ubanza wabereye i Victoria muri ibi birwa naho uwo kwishyura batsinda 7-0 bahita bakatisha itike yerekeza mu matsinda yo gushaka itike y’igikombe cy’isi. Hahise hakurikiraho imyiteguro y’Amavubi y’abakina imbere mu gihugu aho yakinnye umukino wa gicuti na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo wabereye i Kinshasa maze babasha kuhatsindira ibitego 3-2 mbere yo kwerekeza muri Etiyopiya aho igitego cya Sugira Ernest ku munota wa 60 cyatumye batera intambwe yerekeza muri Cameroun.

Sugira Ernest ubwo yagera i Kigali Nyuma yo kugera mu Rwanda, abakinnyi bagomba gusubira mu makipe yabo aho umutoza w’Amavubi, Mashami Vincent yabasabye gukomeza kwitwara neza bazamura urwego rwabo ndetse n’abatari bagize amahirwe yo kuba muri iyi kipe nabo akaba yabibukije ko imiryango ifunguye mu gihe baba bagaragaje urwego rwiza mu mikino iri imbere. Amavubi y’abakina imbere muri shampiyona azongera guhura bitegura umukino wo kwishyura na Etiyopiya uzaba ku ya 19 Ukwakira 2019.

title: CHAN 2020: Amavubi yatsindiye Etiyopiya iwayo, atera intambwe yerekeza muri Cameroun
content: Ikipe y’igihugu y’u Rwanda, Amavubi igizwe n’abakinnyi bakina imbere mu gihugu yitwaye neza ibasha gutsinda Etiyopiya mu mukino ubanza wo gushaka itike yerekeza muri Cameroun ahazabera igikombe cya Afurika cy’abakina imbere muri shampiyona z’ibihugu byabo muri Mutarama 2020. Ni umukino wabereye ahitwa Makelle aho igitego cya Sugira Ernest cyabonetse ku munota wa 60 ari cyo cyatandukanije izi mpande zombi bityo u Rwanda rutera intambwe ya mbere mu gihe hategerejwe umukino wo kwishyura mu byumweru bitatu biri imbere. Uyu wahise uba umukino wa kane wikurikiranije Amavubi atsinze mu mikino yose muri rusange ine aheruka gukina harimo ibiri yatsinzemo ibirwa bya Seychelles, hamwe n’umukino wa gicuti batsinzemo Congo Kinshasa. Ni umukino utagaragayemo Haruna Niyonzima na Kimenyi Yves kubera ibibazo by’ibyangombwa bikomeje kubakurikirana. Umukino wo kwishyura uteganijwe kuzabera kuri stade ya Kigali i Nyamirambo ku ya 19 Ukwakira aho Amavubi aramutse yitwaye neza yaba akatishije itike ku nshuro yayo ya kane yo kwerekeza muri iri rushanwa rya CHAN rigiye kuba ku nshuro ya 6.

title: CHAN 2020: AMAVUBI yageze muri Etiyopiya
content:
Ikipe y’Igihugu y’abakina muri shampiyona y’imbere mu Rwanda, yageze muri Etiyopiya aho ifite umukino kuri iki Cyumweru tariki 22 Nzeri 2019 uzayihuza n’ikipe y’igihugu ya Etiyopiya ubanza mu gushaka itike yerekeza mu gikombe cya Afurika cy’abakina imbere mu bihugu byabo kizabera muri Cameroun umwaka utaha. Amavubi yageze i Addis Ababa ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kane avuye i Kinshasa aho yari yakiniye umukino wa gicuti n’ikipe y’igihugu ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo wabereye kuri stade de Martrys ku wa Gatatu ndetse baje no kwitwaramo neza abasore ba Mashami Vincent bawutsinda ibitego 3-2.

Abakozi ba Ambasade y’u Rwanda muri Ethiopia bafata ifoto n’ikipe y’igihugu Ubwo basesekaraga ku kibuga cy’indege cya Addis Ababa, bakiriwe n’abanyarwanda biga n’ababa muri iki gihugu bayobowe na Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Etiyopiya, Hope Tumukunde wabashimiye uko bitwaye mu mukino wa Congo ndetse abasezeranya ko abanyarwanda bazaba ari benshi baje kubashyigikira mu mukino bazahuramo na Etiyopiya kandi nawo bizeye ko bazawutsinda.

Amavubi yakiriwe n’abanyarwanda biga muri Etiyopiya n’abahatuye Amavubi yacumbikiwe muri hotel Hub Hotel mbere y’uko mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatanu bafata indege iberekeza i Mekele aho uyu mukino uzabera, akaba ari urugendo rw’isaha hafi n’igice mu ndege. Nyuma y’uyu mukino uteganijwe kuri iki Cyumweru, umukino wo kwishyura uzabera i Kigali ku ya 19 Ukwakira, maze ikipe izaba yitwaye neza ihite ikatisha itike. Tubibutse ko u Rwanda ubwo ruheruka muri CHAN ya 2018 yabereye muri Maroc rwari rwabonye itike rusezereye Etiyopiya aho rwari rwayitsinze ibitego 2-1 mu mukino ubanza wabereye Addis Ababa naho uwo kwishyura wabereye i Kigali banganya 0-0.

title: Lionel Messi yahishuye uko yakiriye kuba Barcelona itarabashije kugura Neymar
content:
Kabuhariwe Lionel Messi, yahishuye ko yifuzaga bikomeye ko Neymar yagaruka i Camp Nou ariko atazi neza niba ubuyobozi bwa FC Barcelona bwaba bwarakoze ibishoboka ngo ibi bigerweho. Ibi ’La Pulga’ nk’uko bamwe mu bakunzi be bamwita yabitangaje mu kiganiro kihariye yahaye Sport, aho uyu munya-Argentine ubusanzwe uzwiho kudakunda kuganira n’itangazamakuru yagarutse cyane ku makuru yavugishije benshi mu bakunzi ba ruhago yerekeye igaruka rya Neymar muri FC Barcelona ariko isoko ry’impeshyi ryo kugura abakinnyi rigafunga bidakunze, uyu munya-Brezil akaguma muri PSG. "Mvugishije ukuri, nibyo. Nari gushimishwa nuko Neymar agaruka. Numva ababirwanije kandi ni ibisanzwe nyuma y’ibyabaye byose hamwe na Ney, uburyo yavuye mu ikipe n’uburyo yadusize. Ni ibisanzwe kandi birumvikana ko hari abantu benshi barwanya igaruka rye. Ariko urebye ku ruhande rwo mu kibuga (sportif), Neymar kuri njye ni umwe mu bakinnyi beza ku  isi ndetse kumugira mu ikipe yacu byari kongera amahirwe yacu yo kugera ku musaruro twifuza kugeraho.", Messi aganira n’iki kinyamakuru kegamiye ku ntara ya Catalan ibarizwamo FC Barcelona.

Messi na Neymar bagiranye ibihe byiza muri FC Barcelona ndetse bahinduka inshuti Bitandukanye n’ibyakunze kugarukwaho mu itangazamakuru, Messi yanyomoje ko atigeze asaba abayobozi b’ikipe ye kugarura byanze bikunze Neymar. "Havugwa byinshi…Gusaba ko agurwa (Neymar), sibyo. Ariko kandi twabiganiriyeho hagati yacu mu rwambariro ubwo twumvaga ko hari ayo mahirwe y’uko yagaruka. Twatanze ibitekerezo byacu ku kuba tubishyigikiye cyangwa tudashaka iryo garuka. Ariko ntabwo twigeze na rimwe tubwira ubuyobozi ko bagomba kumugura. Nta na kimwe twategetse (…) Ndi umukinnyi mu bandi. Ntabwo ari njye usaba ibyagakozwe. Ikintu kimwe gusa nifuza ni ugukomeza gutwara ibikombe.", Messi

Ubutatu bwabo, Messi, Neymar na Luis Suarez bwararyanaga Uyu kabuhariwe wa Barça yahamije ko Neymar "yifuzaga kugaruka", ashingiye ku biganiro byihariye bagiye bagirana, gusa Leo Messi avuga ko ku ruhande rw’ubuyobozi  bw’iyi kipe atazi neza niba bwarakoze ibishoboka byose ngo ibashe kumugarura. “Ntabwo mbizi. Mu kuri sinzi niba ikipe yarakoze ibyashobokaga byose kuko ntabwo mfite amakuru menshi ajyanye n’uburyo ibiganiro byagendaga (hagati ya PSG na Barcelona)”.
 Ikindi Messi yagarutseho muri iki kiganiro ni igurwa ry’Umufaransa Antoine Griezmann muri FC Barcelona avuye muri Atletico Madrid aho benshi mu bakurikiranira hafi bari bagiye bahamya ko abakinnyi benshi bakomeye mu rwambariro rw’iyi kipe batamushakaga muri abo hakaba harimo na Messi ubwe. Messi utashakaga kwinjira cyane muri iki kibazo yasubije umunyamakuru ati "Simuzi cyane (Antoine Griezmann). Ukuri ni uko bagiye (abandi bakinnyi ba FC Barcelona) mu mikino itegura shampiyona. Ubwo nazaga nari naravunitse ndetse sinitozanyaga n’abandi. Bagiye gukina imikino ya gicuti kandi ubwo bagarukaga twabonanye gake mu rwambariro. Ntabwo nari mu myitozo. Tuzagira umwanya wo gusangira ibintu byinshi." Ikiganiro kirambuye cya Messi

title: Xénophobe: Abanya-Nigeria ba mbere bageze i Lagos bahunze urugomo rw’Abanyafurika y’Epfo
content: Itsinda rya mbere ry’abanya-Nigeria bahunze urugomo rukorerwa abanyamahanga bakorera muri Afurika y’Epfo (xénophobe), bageze mu mujyi wa Lagos. Ku ikubitiro abantu 188 ni bo baje mu ndege yatanzwe na leta ya Nigeria mu rwego rwo kugoboka abagera kuri 600 banditse basaba ko basubira iwabo nyuma y’ibikorwa by’urwango rukomeye Abanyafurika y’Epfo bakomeje gukorera abimukira bari muri iki gihugu mu mijyi ya Pretoria na Johannesburg. Isaha byari biteganijwe ko bahagurukiraho ku kibuga cy’indege cya OR Tambo i Johannesburg yakerereweho amasaha umunani aho nkuko byatangajwe na komisiyo yihariye y’ububanyi n’amahanga  ya Nigeria muri Afurika y’Epfo byatewe ni uko imyirondoro ya bamwe mu bagombaga guhagurukana n’abana itari yuzuye neza. Abike Dabiri-Erewa, perezida wa komisiyo ya diyasipora y’Abanya-Nigeria yavuze ko indege ya kabiri biteganijwe ko igaruka i Johannesburg igatwara abasigaye. Uru rugomo rumaze iminsi muri Afurika y’Epfo rwatumye havuka agatotsi mu mubano w’ibi bihugu byombi bisanzwe biza mu myanya ibiri ya mbere y’ibikize kurusha ibindi muri Afurika. Abantu 12 ni bo bishwe barimo abanyamahanga babiri mu bitero bya nyuma biheruka kugabwa ku banyamahanga n’amaduka yabo muri Afurika y’Epfo. Mu gihe hari hakwiriye amakuru y’ibihuha yavugaga ko mu bapfuye harimo abanya-Nigeria, Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga wa Nigeria yanyomoje aya makuru avuga ko ibyatangajwe atari byo.

title: CHAN 2020: Mashami Vincent yahamagaye abakinnyi 26 bitegura Congo Kinshasa na Etiyopiya
content:
Ikipe y’igihugu y’abakinnyi bakina imbere mu gihugu yamaze guhamagarwa mu rwego rwo kwitegura umukino ubanza uzayihuza na Etiyopiya mu gushaka itike yo kuzerekeza mu mikino ya nyuma nyafurika y’amakipe y’abakinnyi bakina imbere mu bihugu byabo (CHAN) izabera umwaka utaha muri Cameroun. Biteganijwe ko Amavubi azabanza gukina umukino wa gicuti na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo kuri ’Stade de Martyrs’ ku ya 18 Nzeri 2019, mbere yo gufata indege bukeye bwaho yerekeza Addis-Ababa aho bazakina na Etiyopiya ku ya 22 Nzeri 2019 mu mukino ubanza uzabera kuri stade Mekelle naho uwo kwishyura ukazabera i Kigali ku ya 19 Ukwakira 2019.

U Rwanda rumaze gukina na RDC imikino 3 mu myaka 15 ishize aho Amavubi yatsinze ibiri, Congo itsinda umwe Mu 2009 ni bwo iki gikombe cya Afurika cy’abakina imbere mu bihugu byabo cyatangiye guhatanirwa, ubu akaba ari ku nshuro ya 6 kigiye guhatanirwa. U Rwanda nirubasha gusezerera Etiyopiya ruzaba rukitabiriye ku nshuro ya kane aho kure rwageze ari muri 1/4 ubwo cyaberaga mu Rwanda mu 2016. Nkuko tubikesha urubuga rwa Ferwafa, ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 11 Nzeri 2019 ni bwo umutoza mukuru Mashami Vincent yahamagaye abakinnyi 26 bagomba gutangira umwiherero kuri uyu wa Kane aho biteganijwe ko bakora imyitozo yabo ya mbere kuri stade ya Kigali i Nyamirambo kuri uyu mugoroba. title: Qatar 2022: Amavubi yanyagiye Seychelles ibitego 10 mu mikino ibiri ahita yerekeza mu matsinda
content:
Mu rugamba rwo gushaka itike yerekeza mu matsinda yo gushaka itike y’igikombe cy’isi 2022 muri Qatar, ikipe y’igihugu y’u Rwanda, Amavubi yashimangiye intsinzi yayo inyagira Seychelles ibitego 7-0 mu mukino wo kwishyura wabereye kuri stade ya Kigali i Nyamirambo, byasangaga 3-0 yari yayitsindiye iwayo mu mukino ubanza. Ni umukino byari byitezwe ko Amavubi agomba kwitwaramo neza akongera kwiyunga n’abakunzi bayo bataherukaga kuyabona atsinda imbere yabo. Ntibyatinze kuko ku munota wa 16 gusa w’igice cya mbere Bizimana Djihad yafunguye amazamu nyuma ya coup franc yari itewe neza na Muhadjili Hakizimana. Ku munota wa 27 Kagere Meddie yatsinze igitego cya kabiri cyahise gikurikirwa n’icya Jacques Tuyisenge nyuma y’amasegonda make ndetse uyu musore anatsinda igitego cya kane ku munota wa 33 ari nako igice cya mbere cyarangiye. Igice cya kabiri kigitangira ahagana ku munota wa 52 Meddie Kagere yatsinze igitego cya 5, mu gihe Yannick Mukunzi yaje gutsinda icya gatandati ku munota wa 56. Igitego cy’agashinguracumu cyatsinzwe na Muhadjili Hakizimana ku munota wa 79.

11 babanjemo, uhereye ibumoso: Emery Bayisenge, Yannick Mukunzi (yasimbuwe na Niyonzima Olivier Sefu), Djihad Bizimana, Ombolenga Fitina, Manishimwe Emmanuel (Mangwende), Kagere Meddie (yasimbuwe Sugira Ernest), Rwatubyaye Abdoul (yasimbuwe na Manzi Thierry), Kevin Muhire, Muhadjili Hakizimana, Kimenyi Yves na Jacques Tuyisenge Nyuma y’iyi ntsinzi u Rwanda rwahise ruba imwe mu makipe 14 yabashije gusanga izindi kipe 26 zo zitanyuze muri iri jonjora ryaciyemo amakipe yari ahagaze nabi muri Afurik ku rutonde ngarukakwezi rwa FIFA, bityo zihita ziba ikipe 40 ari zo zizavamo amatsinda 10 y’amakipe ane azashaka itike y’igikombe cy’isi. Ikipe 10 za mbere zizaba zazamutse ari iza mbere muri aya matsinda, hazongera habe tombola izahuza ebyiri ebyiri maze eshanu zizitwara neza abe arizo zizaserukira Afurika mu gikombe cy’isi. Uretse u Rwanda dore andi makipe yabonye iyi tike: Ethiopia,Tanzania, Equatorial Guinea, Liberia, Malawi, Zimbabwe, Djibouti, Mozambique, Angola, Togo, Guinea-Bissau, Sudan na Namibia.

title: AMAVUBI yanyagiye Ibirwa bya Seychelles ibitego 3-0, yizera kwinjira mu rugamba rw’Igikombe cy’isi -Video
content: Mu mukino ubanza w’ijonjora ry’ibanze ryo gushaka itike yerekeza mu matsinda, mu rugendo rwo gushaka itike y’amakipe atanu azahagararira umugabane wa Afurika mu gikombe cy’isi cya 2022 kizabera muri Qatar, ikipe y’igihugu y’u Rwanda yanyagiye Seychelles ibitego 3-0 itera intambwe ikomeye yo kwerekeza mu cyiciro gikurikiyeho. Nyuma y’iyi ntsinzi ikomeye bakuye kuri Seychelles yari imbere y’abafana bayo muri uyu mukino wakiniwe mu mujyi wa Victoria kuri stade Linité, abasore b’umutoza Mashami Vincent bakaba boroheje akazi mu mukino wo kwishyura uzabera i Kigali ku wa Kabiri tariki ya 10 Nzeri. Muhadjili Hakizimana ni we wafunguye amazamu ku munota wa 32 mu gihe Yannick Mukunzi yaje kubonera Amavubi igitego cya kabiri ku munota wa 36 naho kabuhariwe Kagere Meddie ashimangira itsinzi ku munota wa 80. Mu bakinnyi umutoza Mashami yari yahisemo kubanza mu kibuga, batatu gusa nibo basanzwe bakina imbere mu gihugu barimo umuzamu Kimenyi Yves wa Rayon Sports n’aba myugariro Ombalenga Fitina na Manishimwe Emmanuel (Mangwende) ba APR FC. Abandi bakinnyi 8 bose bakina hanze y’u Rwanda barimo Kagere Meddie ukinira Simba SC, Bizimana Djihad ukinira Waasland Beveren, Rwatubyaye Abdoul ukinira Colorado Springs Switchbacks Football Club yo muri Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika, Muhadjili Hakizimana ukinira Emirates yo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Abarabu, Emery Bayisenge ukinira Saif Sporting Club yo muri Bangladesh, Jacques Tuyisenge ukinira Petro Atletico de Luanda, Kevin Muhire ukinira Misr Lel Makkasa na Yannick Mukunzi ukinira Sandvikens IF yo muri Suwede. Kanda hano hasi urebe ibihe by’ingenzi byaranze uyu mukino Tubibutse ko iri jonjora u Rwanda rwanyuzemo ari iry’amakipe yari ahagaze nabi muri Afurika ku rutonde ngarukakwezi rwa FIFA aho agera kuri 28 yatomboranye akazakina umukino ubanza n’uwo kwishyura maze 14 zizarokoka zikazahita ziyunga ku zindi 26 zo zari imbere, zikaba amakipe 40 ari yo azavamo amatsinda 10 y’amakipe ane. Amakipe 10 ya mbere azaba yaje ku isonga muri buri tsinda azongera atomborane (abiri abiri) maze eshanu zizabasha kwitwara neza zikatishe itike y’igikombe cy’isi cyo muri Qatar mu 2022.

title: Amavubi yageze muri Seychelles nyuma y’iminsi ibiri y’urugendo rw’inzitane
content:
Ikipe y’igihugu y’umupira w’amaguru, Amavubi yageze mu birwa bya Seychelles mu rukerera rwo kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 04 Nzeri 2019 nyuma y’iminsi ibiri y’urugendo dore ko bahagurutse I Kigali ku wa Mbere w’iki cyumweru. Nkuko tubikesha urubuga Funclub.rw, Amavubi yasesekaye ku kibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga cya Seychelles ‘Aéroport de la Pointe Larue’ mu rukerera ahagana saa 02:45 aho bahise bajya gucumbika muri Hotel Berjaya Colombo iri mu murwa mukuru Victoria, bahasanga mugenzi wabo Jacques Tuyisenge we uhamaze iminsi ibiri, kuko yavuye muri Angola aho asanzwe akina ahita yerekeza yo adaciye mu Rwanda.

Umutoza w’Amavubi, Mashami Vincent na Muhadjili Hakizimana ubwo bageraga muri Seychelles Uru rubuga rukomeza ruvuga ko nyuma yo kumara amajoro abiri abakinnyi bataryama, kapiteni wabo Haruna Niyonzima yavuze ko ubuzima babayeho butoroshye ariko bitagomba kuba urwitwazo rwo kudatanga umusaruro mu mukino bagiye guhanganamo n’ibirwa bya Seychelles mu gushaka itike y’igikombe cy’isi 2022 kizabera muri Qatar.

Niyonzima Haruna Niyonzima yagize ati: ‘‘Ndashimira imana ko tuhageze amahoro nyuma y’iminsi ibiri y’urugendo rutoroshye. Ntabwo natinya kuvuga ko tunaniwe ariko ikituzanye ni ugushaka intsinzi niyo mpamvu tudashobora kubigira urwitwazo. Amasaha make asigaye turagerageza kuyakoresha neza kuko twiyemeje gukorera mu mimerere yose ishoboka ngo dutsinde natwe twigarurire icyizere.’’ Ikipe ikigera ku kibuga cy’indege muri Seychelles, abareberera ikipe y’igihugu bafashe umwanzuro wo kwambura abakinnyi bose telefoni mu rwego rwo kwirinda ko hagira abarangara ntibaruhuke neza mu masaha make asigaye.

Sibomana Patrick na Yannick Mukunzi Umutoza Mashami Vincent uhangayikishijwe n’imiterere y’urugendo bakoze nawe yatanze icyizere yemeza ko intego ari ugushakira intsinzi i Mahanga. Mashami Vincent yavuze ati: ‘‘Ni urugendo runaniza. Nta gushidikanya abakinnyi barananiwe bitewe n’amasaha tugenze. Ndashima imana ko ntawe urwaye. Maze kuvugana n’abakinnyi ko aho turi, imimerere turimo, n’uko ikipe imaze igihe yitwara, nta rwitwazo twemerewe kuko tutitaye ku munaniro w’urugendo tugomba gushaka intsinzi kuko abatarurimo ntabwo wabasobanurira ingaruka mbi zarwo.’’

Ndayishimiye Eric (Bakame) na Yannick Mukunzi Biteganyijwe ko abakinnyi baryama amasaha ya mu gitondo bakabyuka saa 13:00 bagafata amafunguro y’amanywa bakaza gukora imyitozo saa 16:00 za Victoria, saa 14:00 zo mu Rwanda. Umukino uzahuza Amavubi y’u Rwanda n’ibirwa n’Imihari ya Seychelles uteganyijwe kubera kuri Stade Linité kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 5 Nzeri 2019 saa 14:00 ku masaha y’i Kigali.

title: Haruna Niyonzima mu batoza 12 babonye Licence C ya CAF
content:
Kapiteni w’ikipe y’igihugu ‘Amavubi’, Haruna Niyonzima ni umwe mu batoza 12 b’abanyarwanda babonye ibyangombwa byo gutoza byo ku rwego rwa C ‘Licence C’ bitangwa n’Impuzamashyirahamwe y’Umupira w’Amaguru muri Afurika ‘CAF’. Aba batoza bitabiriye amahugurwa yabaye mu myaka ibiri ishize mu gihe hari n’andi masomo yo gupima ubumenyi bafite yabaye muri Nyakanga uyu mwaka. Muri Nyakanga 2017 ni bwo abatoza 35 bitabiriye aya mahugurwa yo gushaka Licence C y’ubutoza ariko nyuma yo kutabona impamyabushobozi zabo, bahabwa andi masomo yo gupima urwego rwabo yabaye hagati ya tariki ya 17 na 30 Nyakanga uyu mwaka. Nyuma yo gusoza aya masomo yatanzwe n’Umunya-Maroc Nasser Larquet, abatoza 12 ni bo batsinze mu gihe abandi 17 bazayasubiramo kugira ngo babashe guhabwa iyi Licence. Kapiteni w’Amavubi, Haruna Niyonzima, Nshutinamagara Ismail ‘Kodo’ wongerera ingufu abakinnyi ba AS Kigali na Mutarambirwa Djabil wamaze kongera amasezerano y’umwaka umwe nk’umutoza wongerera ingufu abakinnyi ba Kiyovu Sports, bari muri abo babonye iyi Licence C ya CAF.

 Haruna ubu aranganya ubushobozi bwo gutoza na Kodo umutoza muri AS Kigali  Abandi ni Namahoro Yves, Byusa Wilson, Sekamana Léandre, Twagirayezu Jean Marie, Safari Mustafa, Niyirema Aimable, Kalimba Richard, Twagirayezu Isaac na Tugirimana Gilbert. Uretse Namahoro Yves washyizwe mu cyiciro cya mbere, abandi bashyizwe mu cya kabiri basabwa gukora andi mahugurwa kugira ngo bongere ubumenyi bwabo. Aba batoza bose uko ari 12 bazakora andi mahugurwa yo gushaka Licence B mu mpera z’uyu mwaka kugira ngo bagere ku rwego rwo gutoza mu cyiciro cya mbere mu Rwanda. Kugeza ubu Shampiyona y’icyiciro cya mbere mu Rwanda irimo abatoza benshi b’abanyamahanga bitewe n’uko ab’abanyarwanda badafite Licence A na B zibemerera gutoza mu cyiciro cya mbere mu gihe mu mikino nyafurika ho bisaba kugira Licence A ya CAF. Abatoza 17 bazasubiramo amasomo yo gushaka Licence C ya CAF ni: Dusange Sasha, Harerimana Innocent, Uwintwali Jean Claude, Rwibutso Pierre Claver, Uwintwari Jean Claude, Simba Théophile, Nzeyimana Alex, Fikiri Abdulkarim, Twagirayezu Jean Baptiste, Uwitonze Jean Cliff, Kabalisa Calliope, Ndahiro Mbonigaba, Kabanyana Scovia, Kubwimana Jean Marie Vianney, Mbungira Ismail, Mukiza Abdulkarim na Ndoli Innocent. Kugeza ubu u Rwanda rufite abatoza basaga 100 bamaze kubona Licence C y’ubutoza itangwa na CAF. Inkuru ya Igihe

title: Perezida Macron yihanije Perezida wa Brazil amushinja gutuka umugore we
content:
Perezida w’Ubufaransa Emmanuel Macron yanenze Perezida Jair Bolsonaro wa Brazil kubera imvugo "mbi" yakoresheje avuga ku mugore we. Umwe mu bashyigikiye Perezida wa Brazil yaneguye kuri Facebook Brigitte w’imyaka 66 akaba umugore wa Macron. Ibyo yashyizeho kuri Facebook ni ifoto igereranya umugore wa Macron n’uwa Bolsonaro, Michelle w’imyaka 37. Uyu yarengejeho amagambo agira ati: "Ubu noneho murumva impamvu Macron ari kubuza uburyo Bolsonaro?" Perezida Bolsonaro w’imyaka 64 yanditse asubiza kuri ibi byanditse mu rurimi rw’Igiportugal ati: "Wisebya uwo mugabo (Macron), ha ha."

Perezida Bolsonaro yaninuye Perezida Macron n’umugore we Brigitte Abajijwe ku byavuzwe na Bwana Bolsonaro, Perezida Macron yavuze ko ari "ibintu bibi cyane" kandi "bibabaje". Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru kuri uyu wa mbere, Bwana Macron yagize ati: "Yavuze ibintu biteye isoni cyane ku mugore wanjye. Nubaha cyane abaturage ba Brazil kandi nizeye ko vuba bazabona perezida ushoboye akazi ke".

Perezida Macron w’imyaka 41 n’umugore we Brigitte w’imyaka 66 bakunze kwibasirwa kubera iryo tandukaniro mu myaka Hashize iminsi hari uguhangana hagati y’aba bagabo gushingiye ku miriro iri gutwika ishyamba rya Amazone muri Brazil. Bwana Macron ayoboye abagaya ubutegetsi bwa Brazil ko ntacyo buri gukora mu kuyizimya ndetse akaba yifuza ko hari icyo abategetsi bandi ku isi babikoraho. Bwana Macron yavuze ko iyi miriro ari "ikibazo gihangayikishije isi", gusa Bwana Bolsonaro ibi yabyise "imitekerereze ya gikoroni".

Perezida Bolsonaro w’imyaka 64 n’umugore we Michelle w’imyaka 37 ikinyuranyo cy’imyaka yabo (27), ni cyo kinini Perezida Bolsonaro azwiho kuvuga amagambo atari meza ku bagore, abirabura na ba nyamucye. Rimwe mu magambo mabi cyane yavuze ni mu gihe yari ahanganye n’umugore uri mu bagize inteko witwa Maria do Rosario mu 2014. Icyo gihe yabwiye uyu mugore ati: "Nta nubwo nagufata ku ngufu kuko utabikwiriye". Bwana Bolsonaro kandi yigeze gutangaza abantu ubwo yavugaga ku mukobwa mu ruhame mu 2017. Yagize ati: "Mfite abana batanu. Nabyaye abahungu bane, maze ngeze ku wa gatanu ncika intege haza umukobwa". BBC

title: All-African Games: Mugisha Moïse yegukanye umudali w’Umuringa
content:
Umusore w’umunyarwanda Mugisha Moïse yahesheje ishema u Rwanda mu marushanwa nyafurika ya All-African Games ari kubera muri Maroc aho yegukanye umudari w’Umuringa (Bronze) nyuma yo kuza ku mwanya wa gatatu mu isigarwa ry’amagare ku muntu ku giti cye basiganwa n’ibihe. Ni irushanwa ryabaye kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 26 Kanama 2019 aho uyu mukinnyi afatanije na Areruya Joseph ari bo bari bahagarariye u Rwanda.

Mugisha Moise usanzwe akinira Skol Fly Cycling Club Mugisha Moise yaje akurikira abanyafurika y’Epfo Ryan Gibbons wegukanye umwanya wa mbere akoresheje iminota 46, amasegonda 50 n’ibice 34, na Kent Warwick Main waje ku mwanya wa kabiri arushwa n’uwambere amasegonda 23. Areruya Joseph usanzwe akina mu Bufaransa mu ikipe ya Delko Marseille Province, muri iri siganwa yabaye uwa karindwi akoresha iminota 49 n’amasegonda 14. Umudari wa Mugisha wiyongereye ku yindi ibiri u Rwanda rwari rumaze kwegukana muri iri rushanwa harimo umudari w’umuringa wegukanywe n’ikipe y’abagabo ya Beach Volleyball n’undi nk’uwo wegukanywe n’ikipe y’igihugu y’Amagare mu gusiganwa n’ibihe nk’ikipe.
 Tubibutse ko kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 29 Kanama ari bwo abasore b’u Rwanda bagizwe na Areruya Joseph, Munyaneza Didier, Nzafashwanayo Jean Claude na Mugisha Moïse bazasiganwa mu isiganwa ryo mu muhanda (Road Race) mu gihe bagenzi babo Hitimana Noël na Yankurije Marthe bahagariye u Rwanda mu mikino Ngororamubiri, barasiganwa ku maguru ku ntera ya metero ibihumbi 10, kuri uyu wa Kabiri no ku wa Kane.

title: Mashami Vincent yahamagaye abakinnyi 25 bitegura Seychelles -Urotonde
content: Kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 26 Kanama 2019 umutoza w’ikipe y’igihugu Amavubi, Mashami Vincent agaragiwe n’abamwungirije yamurikiye itangazamakuru abakinnyi 25 bagomba gutangirana urugamba rwo gushaka itike yerekeza mu matsinda yo guhatanira kwerekeza mu gikombe cy’isi cya 2022 kizabera muri Qatar. Amavubi agomba gukina n’Ibirwa bya Seychelles mu ijonjora ry’ibanze aho umukino wa mbere uzabera muri Seychelles ku ya 05 Nzeri 2019 naho uwokwishyura ubere i Kigali ku ya 10 uko kwezi. Ikipe izaba yasezereye indi izahura n’izindi 13 nazo zizaba zasezereye izo bihanganye muri iri jonjora maze zisange andi makipe 26 yo ataranyuze muri iri jonjora kubera ko ahagaze neza, maze ahite aba amakipe 40 azagabanywa mu matsinda 10 y’amakipe atanu. Ikipe zizaba iza mbere muri aya matsinda zizongera zitomborane bitewe nuko zihagaze ku rutonde ngarukakwezi rwa FIFA maze zihure mu mikino ibiri (ubanza n’uwo kwishyura) izagaragaza bidasubirwaho amakipe atanu azaserukira Afurika mu mikino ya nyuma y’igikombe cy’isi muri Qatar. Tugarutse ku bakinnyi 25 Mashami Vincent yahamagaye bagomba gutangira umwiherero kuri uyu wa Kabiri harimo abakinnyi 10 basanzwe bakina hanze y’u Rwanda, abakinnyi 8 ba APR FC, bane ba Rayon Sports, babiri ba AS Kigali n’umwe wa Police FC. Dore urutonde: Abanyezamu: Rwabugiri Umar (APR FC), Kimenyi Yves (Rayon Sports), Ndayishimiye Eric (AS Kigali) Ba myugariro: Rwatubyaye Abdul (Colorado Rapids, USA), Nirisarike Salomon (FC Tubize, U Bubiligi), Manzi Thierry (APR FC), Fitina Omborenga (APR FC), Imanishimwe Emmanuel (APR FC), Rutanga Eric (Rayon Sports), Bayisenge Emery (Saif Sporting Club, Bangladesh), Iradukunda Eric (Rayon Sports). Abakina Hagati: Butera Andrew (APR FC), Muhire Kevin (Misr El Makkasa, Misiri), Mukunzi Yannick (Sandvikens IF, Suede), Niyonzima Olivier (APR FC), Bizimana Djihad (Waasland Beveren, Mu Bubligi), Niyonzima Haruna (AS Kigali) na Iranzi Jean Claude (Rayon Sports). Ba rutahizamu: Kagere Meddie (Simba SC, Tanzania), Tuyisenge Jacques (Petro Atletico, Angola), Hakizimana Muhadjiri (Emirates Club, EAU), Mico Justin (Police FC), Sugira Ernest (APR FC), Manishimwe Djabel (APR FC) na Sibomana Patrick (Young Africans).

title: Rayon Sports yasezerewe na Al Hilal itarenze umutaru muri CAF Champions League
content: Ikipe ya Rayon Sports yari ifite inzozi zo kuzagera kure mu mikino nyafurika zayoyotse nyuma yo kunganya 0-0 na Al Hilal mu mukino wo kwishyura wabereye i Kharthoum muri Sudani ku mugoroba wo kuri iki Cyumweru tariki ya 25 Kanama 2019. Rayon sports yasezerewe kubera igitego cyo hanze yatsindiwe i Kigali aho umukino ubanza wari warangiye amakipe anganya 1-1. Iyi kipe iheruka gutandukana n’umutoza Robertinho yatozwaga na Kayiranga Baptiste uherutse kugirwa umuyobozi mukuru wa tekinike. Wari umukino ufunguye cyane cyane mu gice cya mbere aho amakipe yombi yasatiranaga ariko ab’inyuma bagaragarara neza.

title: CAF Confederation Cup: AS Kigali yatsindiye KMC i Dar es Salaam irayisezerera
content: Ikipe ya AS Kigali yitwaye neza cyane mu mukino wo kwishyura wa CAF confederation Cup isezerera KMC y’i Dar es Salaam muri Tanzaniya iyitsindiye iwayo ibitego 2-1 maze ikatisha itike iyerekeza mu ijonjora rya kabiri. Ni umukino wagiye gutangira AS Kigali idahabwa amahirwe nyuma y’uko umukino ubanza wari wabereye i Kigali yari yananiwe kureba mu izamu, umukino ukarangira amakipe yombi aguye miswi 0-0. Gusa ku izuba rikaze ry’o muri Tanzaniya abasore b’umutoza Eric Nshimiyimana binjiye neza muri uyu mukino maze ku munota wa 30 Kalisa Rachid iyi yikpe yaguze muri Kiyovu Sports afungura amazamu mu gihe Nsabimana Eric Zidane yaje guterekamo igitego cya kabiri ku munota wa 63 naho igitego cy’impozamarira cya KMC cyatsinzwe na  Ndikumana Yusuf  kuri penaliti ku munota wa 86. MU ijonjora rikurikira AS Kigali ishobora  guhura na Proline FC yo muri Uganda yo yatsinze umukino ubanza ikipe ya Masters Security ibitego 3-0 ariko hakaba hategerejwe umukino wo kwishyura kuri uyu wa Gatandatu.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo arateganya kuzatumira Messi bagasangira ifunguro
content: Muri iki cyumweru turi kugana ku musozo, kabuhariwe Cristiano Ronaldo yahishuye uburyo yemera kandi akubaha mukeba we w’ibihe byose muri ruhago, Lionel Messi avuga ko ihangana ryabo ryababereye ingirakamaro mu myaka yose ishize bahigana ubutwari mu kibuga. Ni mu kiganiro cyatambukijwe na televiziyo yo muri Portugal yitwa TVI ku wa Gatatu tariki 21 Kanama 2019. "Nemera cyane urwego yakinnyeho kugeza ubu ndetse no kuruhande rwe yavuze ko yababajwe no kuba naravuye muri shampiyona yo muri Esipanye kuko ni ihangana yishimiraga", Cristiano Ronaldo aganira n’iyi shene ya televiziyo avuga kuri Messi. Uyu munya-Portugal yakomeje agira ati "Ni ubukeba bwiza buba muri ruhago ariko ntabwo ari umwihariko. Michael Jordan yari afite abakeba muri basket, Ayrton Senna na Alain Prost bari abakeba bakomeye muri Formule 1, ikintu kimwe gihuriweho hagati y’ihangana rikomeye muri siporo ni uko nta rwango", a ajouté l’attaquant de la Juventus Turin. Ku bwa CR7 ngo kugira umukinnyi bahangana nka Messi byamufashije guhozaho no guhora ashaka kurenga urwego umwaka ku wundi. "Ntabwo nshidikanya na gato ko Messi yangize umukinnyi mwiza cyane kandi nawe bimeze gutyo (…) iyo negukanye ibikombe bigomba kumurya kandi nanjye ni gutyo iyo yatsinze", ibyahamijwe n’uyu mugabo wibitseho ibihembo by’imipira ine y’azahabu (Ballon d’or). Cristiano Ronaldo bashobora kuzasangira amafunguro mu bihe biri imbere Abajijwe ku mubano we na Messi hanze y’ikibuga, Cristiano Ronaldo yavuze ko uyu kabuhariwe mugenzi we bahuje agahigo ko gutwara Ballon d’or enye, babana mu bwubahane. Yagize ati "Mfite imibanire ya kinyamwuga myiza hamwe na Messi kuko ubu hashize imyaka 15 dusangira ibihe bimwe (…) nta na rimwe turasangira ku meza, ariko se kuki bitabaho mu bihe biri imbere?! Nta kibazo na kimwe byantera kubikora." Tubibutse ko Cristiano Ronaldo na Lionel Messi bongeye kwisanga muri batatu beza bazahatanira igihembo cya UEFA cy’umukinnyi wabaye indashyikirwa mu mwaka w’imikino ushize aho bari kumwe na myugariro w’umuholande Virgil Van Dijk ukinira Liverpool. Ibi bihembo bikaba bizatangirwa i Monaco ku ya 29 Kanama 2019 ubwo hazaba haba tombola y’amatsinda ya UEFA Champions League.

title: UEFA Super Cup: Amarangamutima ya Stéphanie Frappart, umugore usifura umukino wa Liverpool na Chelsea
content:
Umufaransakazi Stéphanie Frappart yinjiye mu mateka aho agiye kuba umusifuzi wa mbere w’umugore umugore ugiye kuyobora umukino wo ku rwego rwo hejuru uhuje abagabo, dore ko ari we uza kuba ari mu kibuga hagati mu mukino utegerejwe mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 14 Kanama 2019 hagati ya Liverpool na Chelsea. Ubwo yabazwaga uko yiyumva mbere y’uyu mukino wa UEFA Super Cup uhuza amakipe abiri yo mu Bwongereza, Liverpool yegukanye Champions League na Chelsea yatwaye Europa League, uyu mufaransakazi yahamije ko nta gitutu kihariye afite. "Tugomba kugaragaza mu buryo bw’imbaraga (physiquement), tekinike (techniquement) na takitike (tactiquement) ko tumeze kimwe nk’abagabo. Ntabwo mfite ubwoba bw’ibyo. Nta na kimwe cyahindutse kuri njye.", Frappart w’imyaka 35 y’amavuko ubwo yaganiraga n’abanyamakuru umunsi umwe mbere y’uyu mukino wa nyuma ugomba kubera i Istanbul muri Turikiya. Muri Kamena yari yabaye umugore wa mbere uhawe amahirwe yo gusifura umukino wa shampiyona y’u Bufaransa. “Ubuzima bwanjye bwarahindutse” "Ni byo rwose, ubuzima bwanjye bwarahindutse kuko namenyekanye cyane ku isi", Frappart kuri uyu wa Kabiri i Istanbul aho yakomeje ashimangira ko kuri we gusifura umukino w’abagabo n’uwa bagore byose kuri we ari kimwe.
 Mu kwezi gushize, agaragiwe n’abasifuzi aza kuba ari kumwe nabo kuri uyu mukino wa Liverpool na Chelsea barimo umufaransakazi Manuela Nicolosi n’umunya-Irlande-kazi Michelle O’Neill, Frappart yayoboye umukino ukomeye wa nyuma w’igikombe cy’isi cy’abagore wahuje Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’Ubuholandi. Abatoza bombi baramuvugaho iki? Roberto Rosetti, ushinzwe imisifurire muri UEFA (ishyirahamwe rya ruhago ku mugabane w’Uburayi) yavuze ko yagize igitekerezo cyo guha Frappart umukino w’abagabo nk’uyu ukomeye nyuma yo kumwitegereza mu gikombe cy’isi giheruka. Ku ruhande rw’abatoza bombi baza kuba bari muri uyu mukino, Frappart arasa nk’uwamaze kubemeza mbere y’umukino nyirizina. Frank Lampard wa Chelsea yavuze ati "Ni amakuru akomeye, nshimishijwe no kuba ndi umwe mu bagize ibi bihe by’amateka." Jurgen Klopp wa Liverpool we yagize ati "Ni icyemezo mu by’ukuri cy’ubwenge cyo kwemeza umugore kugira ngo ayobore umukino w’ingenzi cyane nk’uyu."

title: Bidasubirwaho Robertinho yamaze gutandukana na Rayon Sports
content:
Umutoza Roberto Oliveira Gonçalves do Carmo wari umaze ibyumweru bitatu gusa agarutse muri Rayon Sports ashobora kuba agiye kwisubirira iwabo muri Brazil kuko kuri ubu yamaze gusezera ubuyobozi bwa Rayon Sports. Ni amakuru yahamijwe mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 14 Kamena 2019 ubwo umuvugizi mukuru wa Rayon Sports, Jean Paul Nkurunziza yabihamirizaga mu kiganiro Rayon Time gitambuka ku Isango Star avuga ko uyu mutoza yasezeye Rayon Sports ku mugoroba wo ku wa Kabiri. Ubwo yari ahamagawe ngo asobanure aya makuru, Jean Paul Nkurunziza yagize ati " Ni byo koko yaraye adusezeye. Twatunguwe nuko yadusezeye kandi twaganiraga neza. Ubu ubuyobozi bw’ikipe burimo gushaka plan B (amahitamo ya kabiri) gusa ikipe iraba isigaranywe n’umutoza wungirije Alain Kirasa." Uyu muvugizi yakomeje avuga ko barimo bashaka umutoza ugomba kuzagumana iyi kipe dore ko Kirasa Alain baherutse gukura muri Kiyovu Sports we ibyangombwa bye bitamwemerera gutoza ku ruhando nyafurika n’imbere mu gihugu nk’umutoza mukuru.

Robertinho yasezeye Rayon Sports Hari amakuru avuga ko uyu mutoza yahisemo gusezera ubuyobozi bwa Rayon Sports nyuma yo kubona butarimo bwubahiriza amasezerano bari bemeranijweho mbere y’uko ava muri Brazil agarutse muri iyi kipe yahesheje igikombe cya shampiyona giheruka ndetse akaba yaranayigejeje muri 1/4 cya CAF Confederation Cup. Kugeza ubu Robertinho yari atarahabwa amasezerano bikavugwa ko ubuyobozi bwari butegereje kureba uko azitwara mu mukino wo kwishyura uzabahuza na Al Hilal nyuma yaho banganyije 1-1 mu mukino ubanza wabereye i Kigali. Biravugwa ko mu batoza bashobora gusimbura uyu munya-Brazil harimo Mashami Vincent usanzwe utoza ikipe y’igihugu Amavubi, ariko nawe akaba ataramenya ahazaza he nyuma yaho amasezerano ye arangiye akaba atarayongererwa mu gihe nyamara ikipe y’igihugu igiye gutangira imikino mu ntangiriro z’ukwezi kwa Nzeri 2019.

title: Kigali Arena iratahwa ku mugaragaro kuri uyu wa Gatanu
content:
Kuri uyu wa Gatanu i Kigali haratahwa ku mugaragaro inzu nshya y’imikino n’imyidagaduro yitwa Kigali Arena. Ni inzu yubatse hanze ya Stade Amahoro i Remera ifite imyanya ibihumbi 10 yo kwicaramo, ikaba imwe mu nzu 10 za mbere zakira imikino yo mu nzu nini muri Afurika. Iyi nzu ni yo ya mbere mu karere ka Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Yubatse ku buso bwa metero kare ibihumbi 28 ikagira parkingi yajyamo imodoka 600. Ifite  amakafetariya n’amaresitora 13, ibyumba 6 abakinnyi bambariramo, ibyumba bibiri by’abatoza, icyumba kimwe cy’imyitozo ngogoramubiri, icyumba cy’abanyamakuru n’icyumba gisuzumirwamo niba abakinnyi badakoresha ibiyobyabwenge. Ifite ahantu 4 ho kwinjirira, hari aho kwinjirirwa n’abantu bose, hari ahinjirira abanyacyubahiro, hari ahinjirira abanyamakuru hakaba n’aho amakipe yinjirira.

Imbere muri Kigali Arena Iyi nzu kandi  yubatswe mu gihe kitageze ku mezi atandatu, ikaba yarubatswe n’abafundi 1700 barimo 1200 b’Abanyarwanda na 500 b’Abanyaturukiya. Biteganyijwe ko mu 2021 iyi nzu izakinirwamo irushanwa ry’igikombe cya afrika cy’ibihugu mu mukIno w’intoki wa Basket ball. Mu mwaka  mu kwezi kwa 3.utaha iyi nzu izakinirwamo imikino ya nyuma n’iya kimwe cya kabiri cy’irangiza mu mikino yo gutangiza shampiyona ya Afurika ya Basketball. Src:RBA

title: Hatanzwe miliyari 1.41 y’amapawundi mu igura n’igurishwa ry’abakinnyi, Arsenal ni yo yasohoye menshi
content: Abakinnyi baguzwe ku munota wa nyuma muri Premier League batumye kuri iyi mpeshyi hasohorwa miliyari imwe na miliyoni 41 z’amapawundi, habuze gato ngo akureho umuhigo wa miliyari imwe na miliyoni 43 z’amapawundi yatanzwe mu 2017 yabaye aya mbere menshi mu igura n’igurishwa ry’abakinnyi. Ejo ku wa kane ni wo wari umunsi wa nyuma w’igura n’igurishwa ry’abakinnyi ku mugabane w’Uburayi. Ku munsi w’ejo wonyine, amakipe yo muri Premier League yasohoye miliyoni 170 z’amapawundi - ku masezerano y’abakinnyi 17, amasezerano y’abakinnyi bacye gutyo ku munsi wa nyuma yaherukaga ku mpeshyi ya 2009. Igurwa rya rutahizamu Alex Iwobi na Everton kuri miliyoni 34 z’amapawundi avuye muri Arsenal ryatumye aba ari we mukinnyi uhenze uvuye mu ikipe imwe ajya mu yindi zombi zo muri Premier League ku munsi wa nyuma. Kuva muri Manchester United ajya muri Inter Milan kwa Romelu Lukaku kuri miliyoni 74 z’amapawundi - harimo igihombo cya miliyoni imwe y’amapawundi ku yo yari yaguzwe ava muri Everton - kwatumye aba ari we mukinnyi wahenze kuri iyi mpeshyi avuye muri Premier League. Arsenal yasohoye akayabo Arsenal ni yo yasohoye amafaranga menshi cyane kurusha andi makipe yo mu Bwongereza mu kugura abakinnyi kuri iyi mpeshyi - miliyoni 155 z’amapawundi. Ejo ku munsi wa nyuma w’igura n’igurishwa ry’abakinnyi, yaguze myugariro Kieran Tierney kuri miliyoni 25 z’amapawundi imukuye muri Celtic, igura na myugariro David Luiz kuri miliyoni 8 z’amapawundi imuvanye muri Chelsea. Tottenham yaguze ku nguzanyo umukinnyi wo hagati Giovani Lo Celso imukuye muri Real Betis ndetse igura n’umukinnyi wo ku ruhande Ryan Sessegnon kuri miliyoni 25 z’amapawundi imuvanye muri Fulham. Ariko kugambirira kugura rutahizamu Paulo Dybala imukuye muri Juventus - byari byakomeje kuvugwaho cyane ku munsi w’ejo, byo Tottenham ntabwo yabigezeho. Watford yasohoye avugwa ko ari miliyoni 25 z’amapawundi mu kugura umukinnyi wo ku ruhande Ismaila Sarr imuvanye muri Rennes - amafaranga ya mbere menshi iguze umukinnyi. Leicester yo yaguze umukinnyi wo hagati ukina asatira izamu Dennis Praet bivugwa ko yaguzwe miliyoni 18 z’amapawundi imuvana muri Sampdoria. Burnley yaguze ku nguzanyo umukinnyi wo hagati Danny Drinkwater avuye muri Chelsea, Manchester City igura ku nguzanyo umunyezamu Scott Carson avuye muri Derby, naho Newcastle yongera kugura rutahizamu Andy Carroll utari ufite ikipe akinira. Inkuru ya BBC

title: Nicolas Pepe yabaye umukinnyi wa mbere uhenze Arsenal n’umunyafurika uguzwe menshi
content:
Ikipe ya Arsenal yatangaje ku mugaragaro kuri uyu wa Kane ko yamaze gusinyisha Nicolas Pepe, rutahizamu wavukiye mu Bufaransa ariko w’umunye-Cote d’Ivoire wakiniraga ikipe ya Lille yo mu majyaruguru y’u Bufaransa. Nicolas Pepe w’imyaka 24 y’amavuko yari amaze imyaka ibiri akinira Lille aho yigaragaje cyane mu mwaka w’imikino ushize atangira kurambagizwa n’amakipe menshi y’ibigugu ku mugabane w’u Burayi ariko birangira iyi kipe y’i London imwegukanye nyuma yo kwemera kumugura miliyoni 80 z’amayero ariko izishyura mu byiciro.

Nicolas Pepe yasinye imyaka itanu Uyu rutahizamu ukina aca ku ruhande rw’iburyo yasinye imyaka itanu muri The Gunners. Yabaye umukinnyi wa mbere mu mateka y’iyi kipe uguzwe amafaranga menshi Ku rubuga rwa Arsenal, Nicolas Pepe yagaragaje uburyo yishimiye kwerekeza muri iyi kipe. Yagize ati "Kuba hano ni ibintu bishimishije cyane kuko bitari byoroshye kuri njye. Nirutse urugendo rurerure ndetse mpura n’inzitizi nyinshi, rero kuba umwe mu bagize umuryango w’iyi kipe y’ikigugu ni igihembo cyiza kuri njye."

Nicolas Pepe azajya yambara numero 19 Uyu rutahizamu watsindiye Lille ibitego 35 mu myaka ibiri yavuze ko iki cyemezo yagifashe nyuma y’igihe kinini cyo kubitekerezaho no kugisha inama abamukikije barimo umuryango we n’abahagarariye inyungu ze bakomezaga kuvugana mbera ya CAN, muri CAN nyirizina na nyuma yayo. Ati "Byari ingenzi gufata icyemezo cyiza kandi ndahamya ko Arsenal ari amahitamo meza." Nicolas Pepe yavuze ko yishimiye kuba agiye gukinana n’abakinnyi barimo Lacazette, Aubameyang, Özil n’abandi.
 Nicolas Pepe kandi yahise aba umunyafurika wa mbere uguzwe amafaranga menshi akaba ateye ikirenge mu cya bene wabo b’abanya-Cote d’Ivoire Kolo Touré, Emmanuel Eboué na Gervinho nabo bakiniye Arsenal aho yanahishuye ko Kolo Touré yagize uruhare runini mu kumugira inama yo kwerekeza muri iyi kipe.

title: Abanyafurika batatu mu bahatanira ibihembo bya FIFA by’abakinnyi n’abatoza bahize abandi 2018/19
content:
Umunya-Senegal, Sadio Mane na mugenzi we w’umunya-Misiri bakinana muri Liverpool, Mohamed Salah ni bamwe mu bakinnyi 10 bashyizwe hanze n’impuzamashyirahamwe y’Umupira w’Amaguru ku isi (FIFA) bazahataniira igihembo cy’umukinnyi wahize abandi mu mwaka w’imikino ushize, FIFA - The Best 2019. Ku rutonde rwatangajwe ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 31 Nyakanga 2019 hagaragaraho kandi umutoza w’umunya-Algeria, Djamel Belmadi wafashije Algeria kwegukana igikombe cya Afurika, uyu akaba ari umwe mu 10 bazaba bahatanira igihembo cy’umutoza w’umwaka.

Abakinnyi 10 bishakamo uzasimbura Luka Modric wegukanye iki gihembo umwaka ushize Ibi bihembo bya FIFA-The Best bizatangwa ku ya 23 Nzeri 2019 mu birori bizabera i Milan. Bizahemba abakinnyi n’abatoza yaba mu cyiciro cy’abagabo n’abagore babaye indashyikirwa hagati ya tariki 16 Nyakanga 2018 kugeza ku ya 19 Nyakanga 2019.

Sadio Mane na Mohamed Salah nyuma yo gufasha Liverpool kwegukana Champions League barahabwa amahirwe Kuva ubu kugeza tariki ya 19 Kanama 2019 abafana bemerewe gutora binyuze kuri murandasi, uwo babona yahize abandi, gusa uretse abafana, abanyamakuru nabo ba siporo, abatoza b’amakipe y’ibihugu n’abakapiteni nk’ibisanzwe nabo bazatora mbere y’iyo tariki maze bukeye bwaho FIFA izagaragaze batatu ba mbere muri buri cyiciro bazavamo uwa mbere. Amanota y’abafana anganya agaciro n’aya batoza, abanyamakuru n’abakapiteni b’ibihugu. Bazajya batora batatu ba mbere muri buri cyiciro. Uwa mbere azajya ahabwa amanota 5, uwa kabiri ahabwe atatu naho uwa gatatu ahabwe inota rimwe. title: Brazil: Ronaldinho wugarijwe n’imyenda, ubutabera bwafatiriye pasiporo ye
content:
Ibihe ntabwo byoroheye kabuhariwe Ronaldinho, kuri ubu utemerewe gusohoka mu gihugu cye cya Brazil kuko uruhushya rw’inzira rwe (pasiporo) rwafatiriwe n’inzego z’ubutabera zo muri iki gihugu. Uyu mugabo wahoze abica bigacika muri FC Barcelona no mu ikipe y’igihugu ya Brazil amaze igihe afitanye ibibazo n’ubutabera bwo muri Brazil bwanafashe icyemezo cyo gufatira pasiporo ye ngo abanze akemure ibibazo afite, gusa ntibyoroshye kuko yugarijwe n’imyenda myinshi arimo. Kuri ubu Ronaldinho arishyuzwa umwenda yagiyemo nyuma yo kutishyura amande angana na miliyoni 2,2 z’amayero (asaga miliyari 2 frw) yaciwe kubera kuvogera ibidukikije aho yubatse inyubako mu buryo butemewe n’amategeko mu gace kadatuwe hafi y’ikiyaga cya Guaiba.

Ronaldinho yugarijwe n’imyenda Mu 2012 ni bwo umushinjacyaha yaciye amande uyu mukinnyi ndetse ategeka ko iyi nyubako ye isenywa. Nyuma y’uko ananiwe kwishyura amande, mu mpera za 2018, ubutabera bwafashe icyemezo cyo gufatira konti ze zose ariko basangaho amayero atandatu gusa (6 135 frw). Kugeza magingo aya, ibibazo bya Ronaldinho ntibyashize ari nayo mpamvu pasiporo ye ubu yafatiriwe ndetse n’ibikorwa bye (imitungo ye) bigera kuri 57 yiteguraga kugurisha nabyo byafatiriwe. Nkuko ikinyamakuru cyo muri Brazil, Folha gikorera i S.Paulo cyabyanditse ngo intara ya Porto Alegre nayo iramwishyuza miliyoni 2,3 z’amayero y’imisoro mu gihe muri rusange indi myenda yose asanganywe ibarirwa ku yarenga ibihumbi 470 by’amayero (asaga miliyoni 480 z’amanyarwanda). title: Amavubi azacakirana na Seychelles mu ijonjora rya mbere ryo gushaka itike y’igikombe cy’isi 2022
content:
U Rwanda ni kimwe mu bihugu 28 bihagaze nabi muri ruhago muri Afurika bigomba kunyura mu ijonjora ry’ibanze hashakwa amakipe azashyirwa mu matsinda mu gushaka itike y’igikombe cy’isi cya 2022 kizabera muri Qatar. Ubu rwamaze kumenya aho ruzatangirira urugendo. Kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 29 Nyakanga 2019 ni bwo habaye tombola y’uburyo aya makipe adahagaze neza (hashingiwe ku rutonde ngarukakwezi rwa FIFA ruheruka) agomba guhura yishakamo 14 azajya mu matsinda. U Rwanda rwisanze rugomba guhatana n’Ibirwa bya Seychelles aho umukino ubanza uzabera muri Seychelles naho uwo kwishyura ukabera i Kigali. Iyi mikino izaba hagati ya tariki 02 n’iya 10 Nzeli uyu mwaka.

Dore uko aya makipe yose azaca mu ijonjora rya mbere azahura Amakipe 14 azaba yabashije gutambuka azongerwa kuri 26 ahagaze neza, maze hagakorwa amatsinda 10 y’amakipe ane. Amakipe 10 azaba yabaye aya mbere muri buri tsinda, hazongera hkorwe tombola hashingiwe ku buryo aya makipe ahagaze ku rutonde ngarukakwezi rwa FIFA, maze abiri abiri ahure. Eshanu zizaba zitwaye neza mu mikino ibiri abe ari zo zibona itike y’igikombe cy’isi kizaba ari icya nyuma gikinwe n’amakipe 32.

title: Video: Umuteramakofe w’Umurusiya yishwe n’ingumi yakubiswe
content:
Umuteramakofe w’Umurusiya witwa Maxim Dadashev wari wajyanywe mu bitaro igitaraganya ku wa Gatandatu ushize muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ngo abagwe ubwonko nyuma y’umukino yatsinzwemo akubiswe bikomeye, byaje kurangira apfuye. Ni amakuru yatangajwe kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki 23 Nyakanga 2019 n’ishyirahamwe ry’umukino w’iteramakofe mu Burusiya.

Dadashev (ibumoso) na Matias (iburyo) ubwo bahuriraga mu mukino ku wa Gatanu ushize muri Amerika "Maxim Dadashev yaguye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika azize ibikomere yagize mu mukino jyarugamba (combat) wamuhuje na Subriel Matias", ibyatangajwe n’ishyirahamwe ry’umukino w’iteramakofe mu Burusiya  mu itangazo bashyize hanze baboneraho kwihanganisha umuryango we n’inshuti.

Maxim Dadashev asize umugore n’umwana umwe w’imyaka ibiri Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’ishyirahamwe ry’umukino w’iteramakofe mu Burusiya yatangarije ibinyamakuru byo muri iki gihugu ko umurambo wa nyakwigendera ugomba koherezwa mu Burusiya ndetse n’umuryango we ukagenerwa ubufasha bw’amafaranga.

Dadashev yari umuteramakofe ukiri muto Uyu mukino wari wabereye ahitwa Oxon Hill (Maryland), aho uyu Dadashev yari ahanganye n’umunya-Porto Rico Subriel Matias mu cyiciro cya ’super-légers’, gusa umutoza wa Dadashev, umurusiya witwa James "Buddy" McGirt yasabye ko umukino wahagarara ubwo wari ugeze ku gace kawo ka 11 kubera uburyo umukinnyi yari yakubiswe bikomeye. Dadashev bahimbaga "Mad Max", yahise yerekezwa kwa muganga byigitaraganya ngo abagwe mu bwonko kuko yari yangijwe cyane n’ingumi yakubiswe bigatuma aviramo imbere. Umutoza wamwongereraga imbaraga Donatas Janusevicius icyo gihe yatangarije ibinyamakuru byo muri Amerika ko Dadashev ’yari amerewe nabi cyane, ariko (…) byagiye ku murongo ndetse no kuvirirana byahagaze.’

Subriel Matias wakubise Dadashev binamuviramo urupfu, aha yishimiraga intsinzi ye ariko yarataramenya ko mugenzi we ari bupfe Dadashev yari afite imyaka 28 y’amavuko akaba yari ataratsindwa mu mirwano 13 aho 11 muri yo yayitsenze kuri KO (akanesha uwo bahanganye mbere y’uko umukino urangira) mbere y’uko ahura n’uyu witwa Matias wamutsinze bikanamuviramo urupfu.

Umugore we yanditse avuga ko atabyiyumvisha, ahamya ko azahora azirikana imyaka 11 yashize bakundana. Ati "imyaka 11 y’umunezero hamwe n’umwana mwiza w’umuhungu! Ibi nibyo nsigaranye." Reba incamake z’umurwano wari wahuje Dadashev na Matias

title: Imikino nyafurika: Rayon Sports yatomboye Al Hilal naho AS Kigali itombola KMC
content: Kuri iki cyumweru ni bwo amakipe yo muri Afurika yamenye uko azahura mu ijonjora ry’ibanze mu mikino nyafurika ya CAF Champions League na CAF Confederation Cup aho ikipe ya Rayon Sports izaca mu nzira itoroshye ya Al Hilal yo muri Sudani na Enyimba yo muri Nigeria mbere yo kugera mu matsinda. Iyi tombola yasize Rayon Sports igomba kwisobanura mu mukino wa mbere na AL Hilal yasezereye umwaka ushize ikipe ya Mukura VS mu mikino ya Confederation Cup. Ntabwo ari ubwa mbere izi kipe zigiye guhura mu mikino nyafurika kuko mu 1994 Rayon Sports yari yasezereye Al Hilal ariko ntiyakomeza kuko u Rwanda rwahise rwinjira mu icuraburindi rya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Biteganijwe ko kuri iyi nshuro umukino ubanza uzabera i Kigali naho umukino wo kwishyura ubere i Khartoum muri Sudani aho imikino yombi izaba hagati ya tariki 09 na 24 Kanama 2019. Ikipe izarokoka hagati ya Rayon Sports na Al Hilal izaba igifite undi musozi wo kurira mbere yo kujya mu matsinda kuko izahura n’izaba yatambutse hagati ya Enyimba yo muri Nigeria na Rahimo FC yo muri Burkina Faso. Ku rundi ruhande ikipe ya AS Kigali nayo yamenye iyo bizahura muri CAF Confederation Cup aho izatangira uru rugendo ihura na KMC FC (Kinondoni Municipal Council Football Club) yo muri Tanzaniya iherutse gusinyisha Mugiraneza Jean Baptiste (Migi) ndetse ikaba yaranitabiriye imikino ya CECAFA Kagame Cup 2019 yabereye i Kigali aho itarenze amatsinda ariko ikaba yarabashije gutsinda Rayon Sports inanganya na Atlabara itahana amanota ane. Ikipe izakomeza hagati ya AS Kigali na KMC FC izahura n’izaba yatambutse hagati ya Proline FC yo muri Uganda na Masters Security Services yo muri Malawi.

title: KCCA y’i Bugande ni yo yegukanye CECAFA Kagame Cup 2019
content:
Ku nshuro ya kabiri mu mateka yayo, ikipe ya KCCA yegukanye igikombe cya Cecafa Kagame Cup nyuma yo gutsinda ku mukino wa nyuma Azam FC yari isiganywe ibikombe bibiri biheruka by’iri rushanwa. Kimwe n’umukino ubanza wari wahuje aya makipe yari aherereye mu itsinda rimwe rya B ryakiniye i Huye, ku mukino wa nyuma KCCA yongeye gutsinda Azam FC igitego 1-0. Iki gitego kimwe rukumbi cyabonetse kuri uyu mukino cyatsinzwe na Mustafa Kizza ku ishoti rikomeye yarekuye ku munota wa 63 maze gihesha KCCA igikombe yaherukaga mu 1978 ubwo yatsindaga ku mukino wa nyuma Simba SC.



Abakinnyi ba KCCA bishimira igitego cyabo KCCA yatwaye igikombe giherekejwe n’ibihumbi 30 by’amadorali (27 514 200 Frw) mu gihe Azam FC yabaye iya kabiri yegukanye ibihumbi 20 by’amadorali (18 342 800Frw) naho Green Eagles yabaye iya gatatu itsinze AS Maniema Union, ikaba yegukanye ibihumbi 10 by’amadorali (9 171 400 Frw).

Azam FC yifuzaga kwegukana iki gikombe ku nshuro ya gatatu yikurikiranya ariko ntibbyayishobokeye, yatahanye umwanya wa kabiri

Kapiteni wa KCCA, Charles Lukwago ashyikirizwa igikombe na Minisitiri wa MINISPOC, Hon. Nyirasafari Esperance

Nubwo yitabiriye iri rushanwa ibura abakinnyi b’inkingi za mwamba bari muri CAN, ntibyabujije KCCA y’i Bugande kwegukana igikombe

title: Algeria yatsinze Senegal, yegukana igikombe cya Afurika cya kabiri mu mateka yayo -Amafoto
content:
Ikipe y’igihugu ya Algerie, Les Fennecs ni yo yegukanye igikombe cya Afurika cya 2019 nyuma yo gutsinda ku mukino wa nyuma Senegal igitego 1-0 cyabonetse ku munota wa kabiri gusa ku ishoti ryarekuwe na Baghdad Bounedjah maze Salif Sané awukoraho gato aroba umuzamu we. Ni ku nshuro ya kabiri izi kipe zahuraga muri iri rushanwa ry’uyu mwaka dore ko bari no mu itsinda rimwe aho nabwo Algeria yatsinze Senegal igitego 1-0 izamuka iyoboye itsinda.

Donia Samir Ghanem, umuhanzikazi w’umunya-Misiri nawe yataramiye abafana

Kabuhariwe Samuel Eto’o ni we wazanye igikombe Algeria yaherukaga ku mukino wa nyuma mu 1990 ubwo yanegukanaga igikombe kimwe rukumbi yari ifite mbere y’uko itwara iki cya kabiri, naho Senegal yo yaherukaga ku mukino wa nyuma mu 2002 ubwo nabwo yatsindwaga na Cameroun kuri penaliti. Uyu mukino wa nyuma wahuje amakipe abiri yari yitwaye neza muri iri rushanwa aho Senegal muri 1/8 yasezereye Uganda naho muri 1/4 ikuramo Benin mu gihe muri 1/2 yasezereye Tuniziya. Ku ruhande rwa Algeria yo yasezereye muri 1/8 Guinea, mbere yo gukuramo Cote d’Ivore muri 1/4 naho muri 1/2 basezerera Nigeria. Tugarutse kuri uyu mukino wa nyuma, ikipe y’igihugu ya Senegal nyuma yo gutungurwa igatsindwa igitego hakiri kare ku munota wa kabiri gusa, yagerageje gusatira izamu rya Algeria igenda inakorerwa amakosa menshi ariko ab’inyuma ba Algeria hamwe n’umuzamu wabo Rais M’Bolhi watowe nk’umukinnyi w’uyu mukino babera ibamba Sadio Mane na bagenzi be babasha guhagarara ku gitego cyabo kugeza iminota 90 y’umukino irangiye.

title: CECAFA Kagame Cup: KCCA na Azam FC nizo zizahurira ku mukino wa nyuma
content: Ku nshuro ya gatatu yikurikiranya ikipe ya Azam FC yo muri Tanzaniya igiye gukina umukino wa nyuma w’igikombe gihuza amakipe yo mu karere ka Afurika yo hagati n’uburasirazuba (Cecafa Kagame Cup), aho izisobanura na KCCA y’i Bugande ku Cyumweru tariki ya 21 Nyakanga 2019. Izi kipe zari no mu itsinda rimwe rya B ryakiniye i Huye aho KCCA yatsinze Azam FC 1-0 izamuka ari iya mbere, zigiye kongera guhurira ku mukino wa nyuma, nyuma yo gusezerera izo byari bihanganye muri 1/2 aho Azam FC yatsinze Maniema kuri penaliti 5-4 nyuma yaho amakipe yombi aguye miswi 0-0 mu minota 120. KCCA yo yatsinze Green Eagles ibitego 4-3 mu mukino utari woroshye kuko iminota 90 y’umukino yarangiye amakipe yombi anganya 2-2 maze hitabazwa iminota 30 yinyongera KCCA ihita itsindamo ibitego bibiri mu gihe mu minota ya nyuma Green Eagles yagomboyemo igitego 1. Tubibutse ko muri 1/4 KCCA yari yasezereye Rayon Sports iyitsinze 2-1 mu gihe Azam FC yo yari yasezereye TP Mazembe iyitsinze ibitego 2-1. Umukino wa nyuma biteganijwe ko uzaba ku isaha ya saa kumi n’imwe(17h00) zo ku Cyumweru nyuma y’umukino w’umwanya wa gatatu uzahuza Green Eagles na Maniema ku isaha ya saa munani (14h00).

title: Amavubi mu itsinda rimwe na Cameroun mu gushaka itike y’igikombe cya Afurika cya 2021 -Uko amatsinda ateye
content:
Impuzamashyirahamwe y’umupira w’amaguru muri Afurika (CAF) ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 18 Nyakanga 2019 yayoboye tombola y’ijonjora rya CAN 2021 yabaye mbere y’umunsi umwe ngo habe umukino wa nyuma w’igikombe cya Afurika uzahuza Senegal na Algeria i Cairo kuri uyu wa Gatanu. Nubwo Cameroun ari yo izakira iyi mikino ya nyuma ya CAN 2021 ndetse ikaba ifite bidasubirwaho itike, nayo yashyizwe mu matsinda y’ijonjora aho iherereye mu itsinda F hamwe n’ikipe y’igihugu y’u Rwanda, Amavubi.

Nwankwo Kanu ni umwe mu bayoboye iyi tombola Amakipe y’ibihugu yagabanyijwe mu matsinda 12 agizwe n’amakipe ane azagenda ahura maze ebyiri za mbere zigahita zikatisha itike. Gusa ku ikubitiro amakie 8 adafite imyanya myiza azabanza anyure mu ijonjora aho abiri abiri azahura mu mukino ubanza n’uwo kwishyura maze ane yitwaye neza ariyo asanga izindi. Ayo ni Liberia izisobanura na Tchad, Sudani y’Amajyepfo icakirane n’Ibirwa bya Seychelles mu gihe ibirwa bya Maurice byo bizisobanura na Sao-Tome naho Djibouti ihure na Gambie. Iyi mikino y’ijonjora ry’ibanze  izaba hagati ya tariki ya 07 na 15 Ukwakira 2019. Nyuma y’uko izi kipe zizanyura mu ijonjora rya mbere zizaba zimaze kwisobanura, imikino y’ijonjora nyirizina yo gushaka itike izatangira tariki ya 11 Ugushyingo 2019 naho iya nyuma ibe hagati ya tariki ya 09 na 17 Ugushyingo 2020.

Samuel Etoo nawe yari ahari Tugarutse ku itsinda F riherereyemo u Rwanda, benshi mu bakunzi ba ruhago bakimara kuribona bagize icyizere ndetse abasesenguzi bemeza ko ikipe y’igihugu iramutse iteguwe neza yazazamukana na Cameroun yo ifite itike bidasubirwaho nubwo Mozambique na Cape Vert nazo zitoroshye. title: CAN 2019: Nigeria yatsinze Tuniziya, yegukana umwanya wa 3
content:
Ikipe y’igihugu ya Nigeria, Super Eagles yegukanye umwanya wa 3 mu irushanwa risumba ayandi ry’amakipe y’ibihugu muri Afurika (CAN/AFCON 2019) nyuma yo gutsinda Tuniziya. Igitego cyabonetse kare cyane ku munota wa gatatu w’igice cya mbere gitsinzwe na rutahizamu Odion Ighalo nicyo rukumbi cyatandukanije impande zombi maze Nigeria yegukana umudari wayo wa Bronze ku nshuro umunani imaze guhatanira umwanya wa gatatu ikaba itaratakaza.

Nigeria iteka iyo igeze muri 1/2, yegukana umudari Igitego Odion Ighalo yatsinze cyari icya gatanu abonye muri iyi mikino kuri ubu akaba ari we uyoboye abamaze gutsinda ibitego byinshi gusa Sadio Mane na Riyad Mahrez bamugwa mu ntege n’ibitego 3 bashobora kongera ibitego byabo ku mukino wa nyuma utegerejwe kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 19 Nyakanga 2019.

Umutoza Gernot Rohr n’abasore be bishimira umwanya wa gatatu begukanye

Wahbi Khazri wari kapiteni wa Tuniziya na bagenzi be ntibabashije kugombora igitego batsinzwe hakiri kare

title: CECAFA Kagame Cup: APR FC nayo yasezerewe, amakipe yo mu Rwanda yose abura muri 1/2
content: Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 17 Nyakanga 2019, ikipe ya APR FC yari isigaye ari yo rukumbi ihagarariye u Rwanda mu marushanwa ya Cecafa Kagame Cup ari kubera mu rw’imisozi igihumbi, nayo yasezerewe muri 1/4. Ikipe y’ingabo z’igihugu yari yinjiranye muri iri rushanwa intego yo kuryegukana nyuma yo kugira umwaka mubi warangiye nta gikombe na kimwe itwaye, gusa ikipe ya FC Maniema yayikubise ahababaza iyisezerera kuri penaliti 4-3 nyuma yaho iminota 90 y’umukino yarangiye nta kipe ibashije kureba mu izamu ry’indi. Iyi kipe yo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo yitabiriye aya marushanwa nk’umutumirwa benshi bibwiraga ko iza korohera APR FC ariko siko byagenze. Manzi Thierry wateye penaliti ya mbere ya APR FC yayihushije na Byiringiro Lague wateye iya nyuma nawe arayirata mu gihe Butera Andrew, Omborenga Fitina na Ishimwe Kevin bari bazinjije neza. APR FC yaje yiyongera kuri Rayon Sports yari yasezerewe na KCCA umunsi wari wabanje na Mukura VS itararenze amatsinda, maze bwa mbere mu mateka habura ikipe n’imwe yo mu Rwanda igera byibuze muri 1/2 mu gihe iri rushanwa ryabereye ku butaka bw’u Rwanda. Ku ruhande rwa APR FC yo ni ubwa mbere inaniwe kugera ku mukino wa nyuma mu gihe CEcafa Kagame Cup yabereye mu Rwanda. Tubibutse ko muri 1/2 ikipe ya Azam FC yasezereye TP Mazembe izahura na AS Maniema yakuyemo APR FC, umukino uzaba kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 19 Nyakanga 2019 ku isaha ya saa kumi (16h00), ugakurikirwa n’uzahuza KCCA yakuyemo Rayon Sports na Green Eagles yasezereye Gor Mahia.

title: CECAFA Kagame Cup: Ibigugu Rayon Sports na TP Mazembe byasezerewe, Azam FC na KCCA zikatisha itike ya 1/2
content: Abiri mu makipe yahabwaga amahirwe yo kwegukana igikombe cya Cecafa Kagame Cup, Rayon Sports yo mu Rwanda na TP Mazembe yo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo yatunguwe asezererwa muri 1/4. Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 16 Nyakanga 2019 I bwo kuri stade ya Kigali hatangiye imikino ya 1/4 cy’iyi mikino ahakinwe imikino ibiri ya mbere yabimburiwe n’uwahuje TP Mazembe yazamutse ari iya mbere mu itsinda A hamwe na Azam FC yazamutse ari iya kabiri mu itsinda B. Ni umukino ikipe ya TP Mazembe yahabwagamo amahirwe ariko yaje gutungurwa n’iyi kipe yo muri Tanzaniya ifite iki gikombe cya Cecafa giheruka. Igitego cya mbere cyatsinzwe na TP Mazembe ku munota wa 22 gitsinzwe na Ipamy Giovani ariko ku munota wa 27 gusa Selman Iddi ahita yishyurira Azam FC mu gihe igitego cya kabiri cyanahaye itsinzi iyi kipe cyatsinzwe na Obrey Chirwa ku munota wa 69. Nyuma y’uyu mukino hahise hakurikiraho uwahuje Rayon Sports ifite igikombe cya shampiyona yo mu Rwanda ikaba yarazamutse ari iya kabiri mu itsinda A hamwe na KCCA ifite igikombe cya shampiyona cyo muri Uganda yazamutse ari iya mbere mu itsinda B. Ikipe ya KCCA ni yo yafunguye amazamu ku munota wa 33 gitsinzwe na Kizza Mustafa mu gihe Rugwiro Herve yaje kwishyurira Rayon Sports ku munota wa 48 ndetse ikomeza gusatira ishaka igitego cya kabiri, ariko icyizere cy’Aba-Rayon nticyamaze kabiri kuko ku munota wa 66 Jackson Nunda yateretsemo igitego cya kabiri nyuma y’amakosa ya kapiteni Rutanga Eric na Cyiza Hussein bagonganye mu kibuga hagati bagatakaza umupira. Kuri uyu wa Gatatu iyi mikino irakomeza aho ikipe ya Gor Mahia yo muri Kenya icakirana na Green Eagles yo muri Zambia maze irokoka ikazahura muri 1/2 na KCCA FC mu gihe undi mukino utegerejwe uhuza APR FC na AS Maniema maze ikomeza ikazahura muri 1/2 na Azam FC.

title: Umwaka w’imikino ushize Rayon Sports yinjije miliyoni 323,149,135 Frw, ikoresha 322,740,450, yunguka ibihumbi 408 Frw
content: Mu rwego rwo kumurikira Komite nshya yatorewe kuyobora Rayon Sports uko ihagaze, iyi kipe yagaragaje uko yakoresheje umutungo yari ifite ndetse n’ayo yinjije mu mwaka ushize w’imikino wa 2018/19. Kuri iki Cyumweru ni bwo Rayon Sports yabonye ubuyobozi bushya bukuriwe na Munyakazi Sadate wasimbuye Muvunyi Paul wari umaze hafi imyaka ibiri ari Perezida wayo. Nkuko inkuru dukesha IGIHE ibivuga, iyi kipe yagaragaje ko mu mwaka ushize w’imikino, yungutse ibihumbi 408 725 Frw nyuma yo gukoresha asaga miliyoni 322 (322,740,410 Frw). Rayon Sports igaragaza ko yinjije asaga gato miliyoni 80 mu mikino yakiriye ku bibuga bitandukanye mu gihe ayo yahawe n’Ishyirahamwe ry’Umupira w’Amaguru mu Rwanda (FERWAFA) agera kuri miliyoni 27 n’ibihumbi 700 Frw. Abafatanyabikorwa bayo batandatu bayihaye miliyoni 114 Frw zirimo 30 zatanzwe n’Uruganda rwenga ibinyobwa bisembuye n’ibidasembuye rwa Skol; Impuzamashyirahamwe y’Umupira w’Amaguru muri Afurika (CAF) iyiha ibihumbi $30 mu gihe amafaranga yagurishijwe abakinnyi agera kuri miliyoni 59 Frw naho iyi raporo ikagaragaza ko kandi abafana b’iyi kipe bayihaye asaga miliyoni 13.65 Frw binyuze mu cyiswe Fan Base. Abakinnyi n’abakozi ba Rayon Sports bahembwe miliyoni 120.35 Frw, miliyoni 22.34 zitangwa nk’uduhimbazamusyi mu gihe izisaga 90 Frw zakoreshejwe mu kwitegura imikino. Rayon Sports yakoresheje asaga miliyoni 13 Frw mu kugura abakinnyi mu mwaka ushize w’imikino, miliyoni 34 Frw zishyurwa Akagera Business Group nka avance y’imodoka y’abakinnyi mu gihe kandi hakoreshejwe agera kuri miliyoni 42 Frw mu matike y’indege ubwo iyi kipe yakinaga CAF Confederation Cup mu mwaka ushize. Muri rusange, Rayon Sports yinjije 323,149,135 Frw, ikoresha 322,740,450, aho igaragaza ko yungutse 408,725 Frw. Iyi kipe izahura na KCCA muri ¼ cya CECAFA Kagame Cup kuri uyu wa Kabiri, tariki ya 16 Nyakanga 2019, izahagararira u Rwanda muri CAF Champions League nyuma yo kwegukana Igikombe cya Shampiyona mu mwaka ushize w’imikino. Rayon Sports iri kwitegura umwaka mushya w’imikino, yaguze abakinnyi 14 bashya.

title: Munyakazi Sadate watorewe kuyobora Rayon Sports, yijeje kuyigeza muri 1/2 cya ’Champion League’
content:
Kuri iki Cyumweru tariki ya 14 Nyakanga 2019 ni bwo habaye inama y’Inteko rusange y’ikipe ya Rayon Sports yabereye ’Tuza Inn’ mu karere ka Bugesera, ahatowe komite nshya maze Perezida aba Munyakazi Sadate wasimbuye Paul Muvunyi wagizwe Perezida w’icyubahiro. Ni mu gihe Visi Perezida yabaye Twagirayezu Thadee wari usanzwe ashinzwe imyitwarire (discipline), akaba yasimbuye Muhirwa Frederic. Uyu Munyakazi Sadate wagizwe Perezida ni umugabo w’imyaka 38 ufite umugore n’abana batanu. Muri iyi minsi yagaragaraga cyane mu bikorwa bya Rayon Sports dore ko ari we usanzwe akuriye MK SKy Vision iherutse gutangiza umushinga wo gufasha iyi kipe kubaka Stade wiswe ’Gikundiro Stadium’. Uyu mugabo kandi yari umwe mu bajyanama ba komite icyuye igihe mu myaka ibiri ishize, akaba yari anakuriye Fan Club yitwa Trust Supporters, imwe mu zikomeye zishyigikira Rayon Sports. Itangishaka King Bernard wari usanzwe ari Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa Rayon Sports, ubu yagizwe CEO naho Muhire Jean Paul wahoze ari umubitsi wa Rayon Sports, agirwa umunyamabanga, asimburwa na Cyiza Richard ku mwanya w’Umubitsi mu gihe Zitoni Pierre Claver yakomeje kuba umunyamategeko. Mu ijambo rye, Munyakazi Sadate yashimiye Komite icyuye igihe ibyo yagezeho harimo kwegukana igikombe cya shampiyona no kugera muri 1/4 cya Total CAF Confederation Cup, aboneraho kubasezeranya ko azakomereza aho bari bagejeje. Ati "Igikombe cyo sinavuga ngo nzacyegukana ahubwo nzakirinda, mu marushanwa nyafurika ngere muri 1/2." title: CAN 2019: Algerie na Senegal zageze ku mukino wa nyuma
content:
Ikipe y’igihugu ya Senegal hamwe na Algerie ni zo zizahurira ku mukino wa nyuma w’igikombe cy’ibihugu cya Afurika (CAN 2019) uteganijwe kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 19 Nyakanga 2019. Algerie ifite igikombe cya Afurika cyo mu 1990 yageze ku mukino wa nyuma nyuma yo gutsinda Nigeria ibitego 2-1 mu mukino w’ishiraniro aho kapiteni wabo Riyad Mahrez yababoneye igitego cya kabiri cy’intsinzi ku munota wa nyuma w’inyongera muri ine umusifuzi yari yongeyeho. 

Riyad Mahrez na abgenzi be bishimira igitego cy’intsinzi Uyu musore yari yanagize uruhare ku gitego cya mbere cyitsinzwe na William Troost-Ekong ku munota wa 40 mu gihe rutahizamu Odion Ighalo yaje kukishyura kuri penaliti ku munota wa 72.

Abanya-Algerie bashimishijwe n’intsinzi yabo yaturutse kure Ikipe ya Senegal yo yerekeje ku mukino wa nyuma itsinze Tuniziya igitego 1-0 mu mukino nawo utari woroshye aho iminota 90 isanzwe y’umukino yarangiye ari 0-0 mu gihe hagati mu mukino amakipe yombi yabonye penaliti ikazihusha. Umunya-Tuniziya Ferjani Sassi ni we wabanje kuyihusha ku munota wa 75 nyuma yaho Kalidou Koulibaly akoreye umupira mu rubuga rw’amahina. Ku unota wa 81 Senegal nayo yabonye penaliti nyuma y’ikosa ryari rikorewe Ismail Sarr ariko Henri Saivet arayihusha.

Sadio Mane na bagenzi be bafashije Senegal kwerekeza ku mukino wa nyuma nyuma y’imyaka 17 Igitego cy’intsinzi cyabonetse ku munota wa 101 cyitsinzwe na Dylan Bronn nyuma y’amakosa y’umuzamu, maze bihesha Senegal kwerekeza ku mukino wa nyuma yaherukagaho mu myaka 17 ishize ubwo yatsindirwaga ku mukino wa nyuma na Cameroun mu 2002 kuri penaliti. Senegal na Algerie zigiye kongera guhura mu gihe zari no mu itsinda rimwe aho Algerie yatsinze Senegal igitego 1-0 izamuka iyoboye itsinda.
