title: Antoine Griezmann yamaze kwerekeza muri FC Barcelona, Atletico yo igiye kugana inkiko
content:
Ikipe ya FC Barcelone yamaze kwemeza ko yaguze rutahizamu mpuzamahanga w’Umufaransa Antoine Griezmann wakiniraga Atletico Madrid. Iyi kipe y’i Catalan  yavuze ko yishyuye amasezerano Griezmann yari asigaranye muri Atletico, aho yatanze miliyoni 120 z’amayero gusa ku ruhande rwa Atlético Madrid yavuze ko aya mafaranga ari make ndetse yiteguye kwitabaza inkiko.

FC Barcelone yatangaje ko yamaze gusinyisha Antoine Griezmann Antoine Griezmann yari afite amasezerano muri Atletico Madrid ageza muri Kamena 2023 aho amafaranga yari yashyizweho ku ikipe yakwifuza kumugura ari miliyoni 120 z’amayero. Ubu FC Barcelone yo yatangaje ko igiciro gishya ku ikipe izifuza kumugura ari miliyoni 800 z’amayero. Uyu mugabo wavukiye i Mâcon yatangiye gukina ruhago nk’uwabigize umwuga mu ikipe ya Real Sociedad mu 2009 aho yayikiniye imikino 202 atsinda ibitego 52 mbere yo kwerekeza mu murwa mukuru i Madrid mu ikipe ya Atletico mu 2014 ari naho yaje kwamamarira cyane ubwo yari atangiye gutozwa na Diego Simeone.

Antoine Griezmann yari amaze imyaka ikabakaba itanu muri Atletico Madrid Antoine Griezmann yafashije Atletico Madrid kugera ku mukino wa nyuma wa UEFA Champions League mu 2016 ndetse aza ku mwanya wa 3 wa Ballon d’Or muri uwo mwaka mu gihe kandi yanatsindiwe ku mukino wa nyuma w’igikombe cy’Uburayi (Euro 2016) hamwe n’ikipe ye y’u Bufaransa batsinzwe na Portugal. Hamwe na Atletico Madrid yatsinze ibitego 133 atanga imipira 50 yavuyemo ibitego mu mikino 257 yayikiniye. Mu gikombe cy’isi cya 2018 yari umwe mu bakinnyi b’inkingi za mwamba bafashije Ubufaransa kwegukana iki gikombe, ndetse yanatowe nk’umukinnyi w’umukino ku mukino wa nyuma batsinzemo Croitie.  ✌ Life is all about second chances. 👍 La vida tiene segundas oportunidades. 🙌 La vida té segones oportunitats. @antogriezmann 🔵🔴 A post shared by  FC Barcelona (@fcbarcelona) on Jul 12, 2019 at 11:32am PDT Mu butumwa bwe bwa mbere bwanyujijwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga za FC Barcelone, Antoine Griezmann yagize ati "Nkiri muto, data yanyigishije ko gariyamoshi ihita inshuro imwe gusa. Guhera ubu, igihe kirageze ngo ngere ku ntego y’icyerekezo gishya. Inzira zacu birangiye zihuye. Nzarwanirira amabara ya Barca n’umwete wanjye wose. Ni igihe cyacu. Ni inzira yacu." Muri Barça, byitezwe ko uyu mufaransa azakorana inyabutatu ikaze y’ubusatirizi hamwe na Lionel Messi na Luis Suarez mu gihe ibya Neymar bitarasobanuka neza. Griezmann kandi ashobora guhurira na bene wabo b’Abafaransa muri iyi kipe barimo Samuel Umtiti, Clément Lenglet, Jean-Clair Todibo na Ousmane Dembélé mu gihe baramuka bahagumye bose. 
Antoine Griezmann yitezweho gufatanya na Messi na Suarez bagakaza ubusatirizi bwa Barca “Grizou” nkuko bamwe mu nshuti ze bamwita ntabwo yari yigeze agaragara na rimwe mu myitozo ya Atletico yatangiye ku Cyumweru gishize aho yari ashishikajwe no kwihutisha iri gurwa rye ndetse hagiye havugwa umwuka mubi hagati y’amakipe yombi ku bijyanye no kumvikana ku igurwa ry’uyu mukinnyi. Nyuma yaho FC Barcelone itangaje ko yamaze kugura Griezmann, kuri uyu wa Gatanu Atlético Madrid nayo yahise itangaza ko itangiye inzira yo kurengera inyungu zayo aho iyi kipe y’i Madrid ivuga ko uyu mukinnyi yasheshe amasezerano mu buryo bubogamye yirengagije uruhande rumwe. Iyi kipe ivuga ko uyu mufaransa na Barca bumvikanye mbere ya tariki ya 01 Nyakanga kandi icyo gihe amafaranga yo gusohoka muri Atletico yari miliyoni 200 z’amayero aho kuba 120 bityo iyi kipe bita “colchonero” ikaba ivuga ko amafaranga yishyuwe na Barca ari make kugira ngo irekure uyu mukinnyi bari bafitanye amasezerano azageza mu 2023.

title: CAN 2019: Algerie yasezereye Cote d’Ivoire, Madagascar ihagarikwa na Tunisie -Uko imikino ya 1/2 izakinwa
content: Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 11 Nyakanga 2019 nibwo hasojwe imikino ya nyuma ya 1/4 aho Algerie na Tuniziya ziyongereye kuri Senegal na Nigeria zari zabonye itike ya 1/2 ku munsi wari wabanje. Duhereye ku mukino wabanje wari ukomeye cyane ikipe ya Algerie yatsinze Cote d’Ivoire kuri penaliti 4-3 nyuma yaho iminota 120 yari yarangiye amakipe yombi aguye miswi 1-1. Sofiane Feghouli ni we wafunguye amazamu ku ruhande rwa Algerie ku munota wa 20 w’igice cya mbere, igitego cyaje kwishyurwa na Jonathan Kodjia ku munota wa 62 ndetse ntihagira ikindi kinyuranyo kibaho kuko iminota 90 y’umukino n’inyongera ya 30 yarangiye amakipe yombi akinganya 1-1. Kuri penaliti Wilfried Bony na Geoffroy Serey Die bazihushije ku ruhande rwa Cote d’Ivoire mu gihe bagenzi babo Franck Kessie, Maxwel Cornet na Max-Alain Gradel bari bazinjije. Ku ruhande rw’ikipe ya Algeria bo bahushije penaliti imwe yatewe na Mohamed Youcef Belaili mu gihe bagenzi be Ramy Bensebaini, Islam Slimani, Andy Delort na Adam Ounas bari bazinjije bafasha Algerie kwihorera kuri Cote d’Ivoire yari yabasezereye muri 1/4 mu 2015 babatsinze 4-1. Algerie yerekeje muri 1/2 cya CAN ku nshuro ya munani yo mu 1980, 1982, 1984, 1988, 1990 na 2010. Yabashije kwegukana umukino wa nyuma inshuro imwe mu 1990 mu gihe mu 1980 batsindiwe ku mukino wa nyuma. Undi mukino Tuniziya yahagaritse inzozi za Madagascar, ikipe yitabiriye ku nshuro ya mbere iri rushanwa ariko igatungurana ikagera muri 1/4 aho yazamutse mu itsinda yari kumwe na Nigeria ari iya mbere ndetse igasezerera muri 1/8 ikipe ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Gusa Tuniziya ntiyaboroheye kuko yabanyagiye 3-0. Ku munota wa 52 nibwo Tuniziya yafunguye amazamu ku gitego cyatsinzwe na Ferjani Sassi. Ku munota wa 60 Youssef Msakni yashyizemo igitego cya kabiri mu gihe igitego cy’agashinguracumu cyatsinzwe na Naim Sliti ku munota wa 90. Tubibutse ko imikino ya 1/2 izaba ku Cyumweru tariki 14 Nyakanga 2019 aho umukino wa mbere uzaba ku isaha ya saa kumi n’ebyiri (18h00) uzahuza Sénégal na Tunisie naho nyuma yaho saa tatu (21h00) Algerie izacakirane na Nigeria.

title: CECAFA Kagame Cup: Rayon Sports yatsinze Atlabala isanga APR FC muri 1/4
content: Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 09 Nyakanga 2019 irushanwa rya Cecafa Kagame Cup ryakomezaga  aho hakinwe imikino ya kabiri mu itsinda A ryakiniye kuri stade ya Kigali i Nyamirambo n’itsinda B rikinira i Huye. Duhereye mu itsinda A, ikipe ya TP Mazembe nyuma yo gutsindwa umukino wayo wa mbere na Rayon Sports 1-0, yagarutse mu kibuga ishaka amanota yayo ya mbere imbere ya KMC yo muri Tanzania, ndetse byayikundiye ibona igitego kimwe rukumbi cyabonetse muri uyu mukino gitsinzwe na Mondeko Zatu ku munota wa 61. Nyuma y’uyu mukino hari hategerejwe umukino wa Rayon Sports na Atlabala FC yo muri Sudani y’Amajyepfo yari yabashije kunganya umukino wayo wa mbere na KMC (1-1). Gikundiro yasabwaga gutsinda uyu mukino igahita igira amanota atandatu ayerekeza muri 1/4 mbere y’uko ikina umukino wa nyuma. Jules Ulimwengu yongeye kwigaragaza kuko ari we wayitsindiye ibitego 2 byabonetse muri uyu mukino. Uyu rutahizamu mpuzamahanga w’Umurundi yafunguye amazamu ku munota wa 12 nyuma yo guhererekanya neza hagati ya Nshimiyimana Imran na Iranzi Jean Claude wahise asunikira uyu Jules Ulimwengu. Rayon Sports yakomeje guhererekanya neza isatira bikomeye izamu rya Atlabala ndetse iza kubona penaliti ku munota wa nyuma w’igice cya mbere nyuma yaho Ciza Hussein agushirijwe mu rubuga rw’amahina. Iranzi Jean Claude ni we wahawe amahirwe yo kuyitera ariko ayikubita ku giti cyo hasi cy’izamu. Mu gice cya kabiri Rayon Sports yakomeje gusatira kugeza ubwo Jules Ulimwengu ku munota wa 79 yatsindaga igitego cya kabiri ku mupira mwiza cyane wari uhinduwe na Mugheni Fabrice nawe wari uwuhawe na Bizimana Yannick wari ukinjira mu kibuga mu mukino we wa mbere muri Rayon nyuma yo kuva muri Muhanga FC. Amanota 3 Rayon Sports ibonye aje yiyongea ku yo yabonye mu mukino ubanza ubwo yatsinda TP Mazembe ibi biyihesha kuyobora itsinda A n’amanota atandatu, igakurikirwa na TP Mazembe ifite atatu mu gihe KMC ifite inota 1 n’umwenda w’igitego kimwe ku mwanya wa gatatu naho Atlabara ikaba ifite inota n’umwenda w’ibitego 2. Rayon Sports ibaye ikipe ya kabiri ikatishije itike nyuma ya APR FC yabigezeho ku wa Mbere nyuma yo gutsinda umukino wayo wa kabiri wayihuje na Green Eagles igitego 1-0. Umutoza Mathurin Ovambe Olivier watozaga umukino we wa kabiri muri Rayon Sports yari yongeye kugirira icyizere abakinnyi 11 bari babanje mu kibuga bahura na TP Mazembe ari bo: Kimenyi Yves, Iragire Saidi, Rugwiro Herve, Iradukunda Eric Radu, Rutanga Eric (c), Nshimiyimana Amran, Mugheni Kakule Fabrice, Comodore Olokwei (yasimbuwe na Nizeyimana Mirafa ku munota wa 66), Ciza Hussein (Bizimana Yannick 78’), Iranzi Jean Claude (yasimbuwe na Irakoze Saidi ku munota wa 48) na Ulimwengu Jules. Iri tsinda rizasubira mu kibuga rikina imikino ya nyuma mu itsinda ku wa Gatandatu tariki ya 13 Nyakanga 2019 aho TP Mazembe izaba icakirana na Atlabala naho Rayon Sports igahura na KMC. Indi mikino yabaye kuri uyu wa Kabiri mu itsinda B ikipe ya Mukura VS yanganyije na Bandari FC ibitego 2-2 naho KCCA FC yo muri Uganda itsinda igitego 1-0 Azam FC yo muri Tanzaniya inafite iki gikombe.

title: Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika zisubije igikombe cy’isi cy’abagore muri ruhago zitsinze Ubuholande -Amafoto
content:
Ku nshuro ya kane mu mateka, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika yegukanye igikombe cy’isi cy’abagore itsinze ibitego 2-0 Ubuholande byatsinzwe na Rapinoe na Lavelle mu mukino wa nyuma wabaye kuri iki Cyumweru tariki ya 07 Nyakanga 2019 mu mujyi wa Lyon mu Bufaransa. Bari baragitwaye mu 1991, 1999 na 2015. Igice cya mbere cyari cyarangiye ari 0-0 nubwo Amerikayagaragazaga gusatira bikomeye ndetse ikaba yahushije uburyo bukomeye ku munota wa 38 aho Alex Morgan yateye umupira ugarurwa n’igiti cy’izamu mu gihe ku munota wa 40 umuzamu w’Abaholande Oranje Sari van Veenendaal yakuyemo ikindi gitego cyari cyabazwe.

Megan Rapinoe wigaragaje cyane muri iri rushanwa, ni we wafunguye amazamu Mu gice cya kabiri nibwo akagozi kacitse maze ku munota wa 61 Megan Rapinoe afungura amazamu kuri penaliti, iki kikaba cyari igitego cya 50 uyu rutahizamu w’imyaka 34 y’amavuko atsinze ku ruhando mpuzamahanga. Ku munota wa 69 Rose Lavelle yashyizemo agashinguracumu.

Ubwo umukino wari urangiye, Abanyamerikakazi birukira mu kibuga kubyina intsinzi Ubuholande bufite igikombe cy’Uburayi giheruka bwari butegerejweho kureba niba bwabasha guhangamura Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ariko ntibyashobotse kuko iki gihugu kinafite ibikombe bine by’imikino olempike (1996, 2004, 2008, 2012) yakomeje kwigaragaza nk’ikigugu muri iyi myaka ndetse iba ikipe ya kabiri y’abagore ibashije kwisubiza igikombe cy’isi nyuma y’Ubudage bwabikoze (2003 na 2007).

Abaholandekazi barahatanye ariko ntibabashije guhangamura Abanyamerikakazi Mu nshuro umunani iki gikombe cy’isi cyakinwe, nta na rimwe Leta Zune Ubumwe za Amerika zirabura byibuze mu myanya itatu ya mbere. Umwanya mubi zabonye ni uwa gatatu  (1995, 2003 na 2007) mu gihe zatsindiwe ku mukino wa nyuma inshuro imwe mu 2011 mu gihe ku rundi ruhande Abaholande bo bwari ubwa mbere bagera byibuze muri 1/2. Rutahizamukazi Megan Rapinoe ni we watowe nk’umukinnyi mwiza w’irushanwa ndetse anahabwa igihembo cy’umukinnyi watsinze ibitego byinshi nubwo ibitego bitandatu yatsinze abinganya na mugenzi we bakinana Alex Morgan ndetse n’Umwongerezakazi Ellen White, gusa we yakinnye iminota mike ugereranije na bagenzi be bandi. 


Megan Rapinoe yatowe nk’umukinnyi w’irushanwa anahabwa urukweto rwa zahabu rw’uwatsinze ibitego byinshi Uyu Megan Rapinoe uretse kwigaragaza mu kibuga, hanze y’ikibuga naho azwi cyane kubera ibikorwa bye bishyigikira ’kurwanya ivangura iryo ariryo ryose’ n’imvugogo ye inenga kenshi Perezida Donald Trump ndetse yavuze ko mu gihe baba batumiwe nawe, atakwitabira kuko "Trump batari mu murongo umwe".

title: CAN 2019: Cameroun na Misiri zahuriye ku mukino wa nyuma uheruka, zasezerewe
content:
Harabura imikino ibiri gusa iri bukinwe ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa mbere tukamenya amakipe 8 yerekeza muri 1/4 cy’Igikombe cya Afurika, CAN 2019 irushanwa riri kubera mu Misiri ahakomeje kugaragara gutungurana gukomeye. Kugeza ubu imikino ya 1/8 yamaze kwivugana amwe mu makipe y’ibigugu harimo Cameroun ifite igikombe giheruka yasezerewe ku wa Gatandatu tariki 06 Nyakanga itsinzwe na Nigeria ibitego 3-2. Odion Ighalo ni we wafunguye amazamu ku ruhande rwa Nigeria ahagana ku munota wa 19 ariko mu minota itanu ya nyuma y’igice cya mbere Cameroun igomba iki gitego inashyiramo ikindi byatsinzwe na Stephane Bahoken na Clinton N’Jie ku munota wa 41 n’uwa 44 ari nako igice cya mbere cyarangiye. Mu gice cya kabiri Nigeria yongeye kwigaranzura Cameroun maze ku munota wa 63 Odion Ighalo atsinda igitego cya kabiri mbere gato y’uko Alex Iwobi ku munota wa 66 abonera Super Eagles igitego cy’intsinzi.

Mohamed Salah ntacyo yabashije gufasha ikipe ye Ku rundi ruhande Misiri yari yakiriye iki gikombe ndetse yanageze ku mukino wa nyuma uheruka ikaba inafite umukinnyi mwiza muri Afurika mu myaka ibiri ishize Mohamed Salah, yaratunguwe cyane isezererwa na Afurika y’Epfo yari yazamutse ari iya nyuma mu makipe ane yazamutse nk’ayatsinzwe neza ku mwanya wa 3 (Best Loser). Ni igitego kimwe rukumbi cyabonetse ku munota wa 85 gitsinzwe na Thembinkosi Lorch. Nyuma y’uyu mukino umutoza wa Misiri, Javier Aguirre yahise yirukanwa ndetse n’umuyobozi w’ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru muri iki gihugu aregura. Ukundi gutungurana kwabaye ni Benin yasezereye Marocco y’umutoza Herve Renard kuri penaliti nyuma yaho amakipe yombi aguye miswi ibitego 1-1 mu minota 120. Ni mu gihe Madagascar yitabiriye iri rushanwa bwa mbere ikomeje gutungurana ikaba yerekeje muri 1/4 nyuma yo gusezerera Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo kuri penaliti 4-2 nyuma yaho iminota 120 yari yarangiye baguye miswi 2-2.

title: CECAFA Kagame Cup 2019: APR FC na Rayon Sports zatangiye neza, Mukura iratsikira -Uko imikino yose yagenze
content:
Muri iyi weekend dusoje nibwo irushanwa rihuza amakipe yo mu karere ka Afurika y’Uburasirazuba no hagati, Cecafa Kagame Cup ryatangiraga aho rigiye kumara ibyumweru bibiri ribera ku butaka bw’u Rwanda ruhagarariwe n’amakipe atatu ari yo: APR FC, Rayon Sports na Mukura VS. Ku wa Gatandatu ubwo iri rushanwa ryatangiraga ikipe ya APR FC yari yakinnye na Proline FC yo muri Uganda maze umukino urangira ku ntsinzi y’ingabo z’igihugu y’igitego 1-0. Ni umukino abakinnyi bashya iheruka kugura muri mukeba Rayon Sports bigaragaje barimo Mutsinzi Ange, Niyonzima Olivier Sefu, Manishimwe Djabel na Manzi Thierry watsinze iki gitego cyabonetse ku munota wa nyuma. Ikipe ya Rayon Sports yo yagiye mu kibuga kuri iki Cyumweru ubwo yacakiranaga na TP Mazembe, umwe mu mikino yari itegerejwe cyane aho by’umwihariko abakunzi ba Rayon Sports bashakaga kureba uko abakinnyi bashya baguze bahagaze. Rayon Sports yinjiye mu mukino neza ndetse ku munota wa 4 gusa Jules Ulimwengu yari yamaze guhindukiza umuzamu wa TP Mazembe ku mupira wari uhinduwe na Iranzi Jean Claude wakinaga umukino we wa mbere yambaye ubururu n’umweru. Amakipe yombi yakomeje gusatirana ariko TP Mazembe yotsa igitutu izamu rya Kimenyi Yves gusa uyu muzamu nawe wakinaga umukino we wa mbere muri Rayon Sports agerageza kwihagararaho kugeza ubwo uyu mukino warangiraga ari 1-0. Abasore bashya barimo Kimenyi Yves, Iragire Saidi, Rugwiro Herve, Nshimiyimana Imran, Iranzi Jean Claude, Commodore Olokwei na Ciza Hussein bigaragaje mu gihe uyu mukino watojwe n’umutoza waturutse mu Bwongereza ariko ufite inkomoko muri Cameroun witwa Mathurin Olivier Ovambe, uyu akaba ari mu igeragezwa. Ku rundi ruhande Mukura Vs yo ntiyabashije gutangira neza kuko yatakaje umukino wayo wa mbere yatsinzwemo 1-0 na AZAM FC ifite iki gikombe giheruka. title: AS Kigali yegukanye igikombe cy’Amahoro itsinze Kiyovu ku mukino wa nyuma
content:
Ikipe y’umujyi, AS Kigali yatwaye igikombe cya kabiri mu mateka yayo cy’igihugu nyuma yo gutsinda ku mukino wa nyuma Kiyovu SC ibitego 2-1 mu mukino w’ishiraniro wakinwe iminota 120 nyuma yaho iminota 90 isanzwe y’umukino irangiye amakipe yombi aguye miswi 1-1. Aya makipe yisanze ku mukino wa nyuma mu gihe muri iyi minsi havugwa umugambi wo kwihuriza hamwe akavamo ikipe imwe iterwa inkunga n’umujyi wa Kigali dore ko Kiyovu isanzwe ifashwa n’akarere ka Nyarugenge ikunze guhura n’ibibazo by’amikoro mu gihe AS Kigali ifashwa n’umujyi wa Kigali yo muri iyi myaka yagaragaye nk’ikipe ifite ubushobozi ariko itagira abafana.

Abafana ba Kiyovu bari benshi cyane baje gushyigikira ikipe yabo Ni umukino wari wongeye guhuruza abakunzi benshi ba Kiyovu SC bari benshi cyane kuri stade ya Kigali mu ibara ryabo ry’icyatsi n’umweru baje gutera ingabo mu bitugu ikipe yabo ngo barebe ko bakwegukana iki gikombe cy’Amahoro nyuma yo kugera ku mukino wa nyuma inshuro enye ariko iteka bikarangira itacyegukanye. SC Kiyovu niyo yafunguye amazamu mbere ku gitego cyatsinzwe na Rwabuhihi Placide n’umutwe nyuma y’ikosa ryari rihanwe na Kalisa Rachid umuzamu Bate Shamiru agasohoka nabi. Hari ku munota wa 39 maze uyu musore binavugwa ko yamaze gusinyira APR FC afasha Kiyovu kujya mu kiruhuki cy’igice cya bere iri imbere n’igitego kimwe ku busa bwa AS Kigali. Nubwo Kiyovu SC yatangiye neza igice cya kabiri isatira, ibyishimo by’Abayovu ntibyateye kabiri kuko Niyomugabo Jean Claude nawe wamaze gusinyira APR FC yagomboreye AS Kigali ku munota wa 54 ku mupira yari ahawe na Nsabimana Eric bita Zidane. Amakipe yombi yakomeje gusatirana ariko iminota 90 irangira nta mpinduka zibayeho hahita hitabazwa iminota 30 y’inyongera. Nyuma y’iminota itatu gusa ni ukuvuga ku munota wa 93 Nsabimana Eric Zidane yatsindiye AS Kigali igitego cya 2 maze abayovu bari baje biteguye gutahana igikombe bagwa mu kantu. Iminota 30 yarangiye nta mpinduka zibayeho maze AS Kigali iba yegukanye igikombe yaherukaga gutwaa mu 2013 mu gige Kiyovu SC yo yaherukaga ku mukino wa nyuma mu 1998 aho itageze ku kibuga igaterwa mpanga na Rayon Sports, yongeye kubona igikombe kiyica mu myanya y’intoki.

Kiyovu yatakaje umukino wa nyuma w’igikombe cy’igihugu ku nshuro ya gatanu

title: Frank Lampard yamaze kugirwa umutoza mushya wa Chelsea
content:
Mu buryo budasubirwaho, Frank Lampard yamaze gusinyira inshingano nshya mu ikipe ya Chelsea nk’umutoza mukuru wayo. Ni amakuru yahamijwe na Chelsea kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 04 Nyakanga 2019 aho Frank Lampard ufatwa nk’umukinnyi w’ibihe byose muri iyi kipe yakiniye imyaka 13, yahawe amasezerano y’imyaka itatu.

Chelsea yatangaje ko Frank Lampard yagizwe umutoza mukuru wayo, bati "Urakaza neza mu rugo" Frank Lampard w’imyaka 41 y’amavuko aje muri Chelsea avuye muri Derby County yo mu cyiciro cya kabiri mu Bwongereza, akaba asimbuye umutaliyani Maurizio Sarri wavuye muri iyi kipe mu kwezi gushize nyuma yo kuyihesha Europa League maze akerekeza muri Juventus Turin.

Frank Lampard agarutse i Stamford Bridge nk’umutoza nyuma y’imyaka 13 yahamaze nk’umukinnyi Mu myaka 13 yamaze muri Chelsea nk’umukinnyi, Frank Lampard yayitsindiye ibitego 211 aca agahigo ko kuytsindira ibitego byinshi. Mu 2012 yakoranye amateka n’iyi kipe yo gutwara Champions League ndetse mu 2013 batwarana Europa League. Yatwaranye nayo kandi ibikombe bitatu bya shampiyona (2005, 2006 na 2010), bine by’igihugu (2007, 2009, 2010 na 2012) n’ibikombe bibiri bya League Cup (2005 na 2007).

Chelsea yamurambagije nyuma yo kwitwara neza mu mwaka umwe yari amaze muri Derby County yafashije kwitwara neza mu cyiciro cya kabiri aho yatsindiwe mu mukino wa nyuma wa kamarampaka wo kuzamuka mu cyiciro cya mbere Mu butumwa bwe Frank Lampard yavuze ko yishimiye kugaruka muri Chelsea. Ati "Buri wese azi urukundo mfitiye iyi kipe n’ibihe twagiranye. (...) Ndi hano kugira ngo nkore, mfashe ikipe gukomeza gutsinda kandi sijye uzabona ntangiye aka kazi."

Lampard ni umwe mu bakanyujijeho muri Chelsea ukundwa cyane n’abafana kubera ubwitange n’ubuhanga byamuranze

title: Igikombe cy’Amahoro: AS Kigali isezereye Rayon Sports, yerekeza ku mukino wa nyuma
content: Ikipe y’umujyi, AS Kigali yigaranzuye Rayon Sports mu mukino wo kwishyura wakinwe kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 29 Kamena 2019 iyitsinda ibitego 2-1 yari yatsinzwe mu mukino ubanza maze bitabaza penaliti ihita iyisezerera kuri 4-2 yerekeza ku mukino wa nyuma. Ni umukino ikipe ya Rayon Sports yakinnye bigaragara ko idafite intego yo gushyiramo ingufu ngo ibe yatsinda. Mbere gato y’uko igice cya mbere kirangira ku munota wa 45 nibwo Ndayisenga Fuadi yafunguye amazamu ndetse nyuma y’iminota itatu gusa bavuye mu karuhuko ku munota wa 48 Kalanda Frank aterekamo igitego cya kabiri. Ibintu byaje kurushaho kuba bibi ku ruhande rwa Rayon Sports ubwo ku munota wa 72, rutahizamu wayo w’umunye-Ghana Michael Sarpong yerekagwa ikarita itukura. Ikipe ya Rayon Sports yaje gutsinda igitego cyaje ku munota wa nyuma muri ine y’inyongera bari bongeyeho gitsinzwe na Mutsinzi Ange, igitego cyasanze bamwe mu bafana bitahiye kuko bari baziko byarangiye mu gihe abandi bake bari basigaye babyina ko APR FC itazasohoka nubwo ikipe yabo yari  itsinzwe bakaba batagaragaza ko bababaye cyane. Igitego cya Mutsinzi Ange cyatumye aya makipe yombi ahita agira ibiteranyo by’ibitego 3-3 mu mikino yombi maze hahita hitabazwa penaliti. Nyandwi Sadam na Prosper Dankor binjije iza Rayon Sports mu gihe Bukuru Christophe yahushije iya kabiri na Manishimwe Djabel agahusha iya gatatu. Ntamuhanga Tumaini Tity, Benedata Janvier, Bishira Latif na Nsabimana Eric Zidane nibo binjije penliti za AS Kigali mu gihe Ntate Djumaini  yari yahujije iya gatatu y’iyi kipe. Kuri iki Cyumweru nibwo hamenyekana indi kipe izasanga AS Kigali ku mukino wa nyuma hagati ya Police FC na Kiyovu SC yari yatsinze umukino ubanza ibitego 2-0. Ikindi ni uko APR FC itazasohokera u Rwanda mu mikino nyafurika ya ’CAF Confederation Cup’ kuko ibi byashobokaga mu gihe gusa Rayon Sports yaba itwaye igikombe cy’Amahoro maze ikipe y’ingabo igasohoka nk’iyabaye iya kabiri muri shampiyona none ubu ikipe izatwara iki gikombe cy’Amahoro niyo izaserukira u Rwanda muri aya marushanwa mu gihe Rayon Sports izaba iri muri CAF Champions League.

title: APR FC yirukanye abakinnyi 16! Miggy, Iranzi, Savio,…mu birukanywe -Urutonde

title: CAN 2019: Nigeria na Misiri zamaze kwizera itike ya 1/8, RD Congo ijya mu mazi abira
content:
Nyuma yo gutsinda imikino yazo ya kabiri mu matsinda ziherereyemo, ikipe y’igihugu ya Nigeria na Misiri zamaze kugeza amanota 6 azemerera gukatisha bidasubirwaho itike ya 1/8 mu gikombe cya Afurika mu gihe Ubugande nabwo bwateye intambwe ikomeye naho Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo icyizere cyayo kirayoyoka. Kuri uyu wa Gatatu mu Misiri nibwo hatangiye gukinwa imikino ya kabiri yo mu matsinda aho mu itsinda A ikipe ya Uganda yanganyije na Zimbabwe 1-1 bituma igira amanota 4 nyuma yo kwitwara neza mu mukino ubanza igatsinda Congo Kinshasa ibitego 2-0. 

Emmanuel Okwi na bagenzi be bakomeje gutungurana Uganda niyo yafunguye amazamu hakiri kare ku munota wa 12 ku gitego cyatsinzwe na Emmanuel Okwi mu gihe Zimbabwe yishyuriwe na Khama Billiat ku munota wa 40. Ibi biraha amahirwe iki gihugu cyo mu majyaruguru y’u Rwanda kuba cyazarangiza ku mwanya wa 2 muri iri tsinda cyangwa kikazamuka nk’igihugu cya 3 kitwaye neza.

Khama Billiat nyuma yo kubonera Zimbabwe igitego cyatumye igumana icyizere Ku rundi ruhande Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo yasabwaga guterera umusozi ukomeye ikareba uko yabona amanota atatu yayo ya mbere imbere ya Misiri iri gukinira mu rugo, ariko ntiyorohewe n’uyu mukino kuko yongeye kuwutakaza ku bitego 2-0 byatsinzwe na Ahmed El Mohamady ku munota wa 25 na Mohamed Salah ku munota wa 43.

Mohamed Salah na bagenzi be bafashije igihugu cyabo kubona itike ya 1/8 Ibi byahise biha bidasubirwaho itike Misiri ya 1/8 mu gihe Congo yahise ifata umwanya wa nyuma mu itsinda nta nota na rimwe n’umwenda w’ibitego 4 ndetse ikaba isa nk’iyamaze gusezererwa mbere y’uko izakina umukino wa nyuma na Zimbabwe yo ifite inota rimwe izaba ishaka kureba uko yayitsinda ikazamuka nk’iya kabiri cyangwa iya gatatu yitwaye neza. Kuri uyu wa Gatatu kandi hakinwe umukino umwe wo mu itsinda B wahuje Nigeria na Guinea, aho Guinea yasabwaga gutsinda ikagira amanota ane igakomeza guhatanira kuzamuka naho Nigeria yo yasabwaga gutsinda igahita yizera gukomeza ndetse byaje kuyihira ibona igitego kimwe rukumbi cyabonetse muri uyu mukino gitsinzwe na Kenneth Omeruo ku munota wa 73.

Nigeria ifite CAN eshatu, ariko ikaba yaherukagamo mu 2013, ubu yabaye iya mbere yakatishije itikr ya 1/8 Undi mukino wo mu itsinda B uraza gukinwa kuri uyu wa Kane aho ku isaha ya saa kumi n’igice z’umugoroba Madagascar yanganyije na Guinea mu mukino ubanza iza kuba icakirana n’u Burundi bwatsinzwe na Nigeria mu mukino ubanza 1-0. Kuri uyu wa Kane kandi hategerejwe indi mikino ibiri yo mu itsinda C harimo utegerejwe cyane ku isaha ya saa moya uhuza Senegal ya Sadio Mane na Algeria ya Riyad Mahrez. Nyuma yaho izi kipe zitwaye neza mu mikino yazo ya mbere zigatsinda Tanzania na Kenya ibitego 2-0, iza gutsinda irahita ikatisha itike ya 1/8. Ku rundi ruhande ku isaha ya saa yine z’ijoro haraha ’derby’ yo mu karere ka Afurika y’Uburasirazuba aho Tanzaniya yagaragaje urwego rwo hasi cyane mu mukino ubanza yatsinzwemo na Senegal 2-0 iza kwisobanura na Kenya yatsinzwe na Algeria 2-0 ariko byibuze yo ikaba yari yagerageje kwerekana umukino ufite intego.

title: Igikombe cy’Amahoro: Rayon Sports y’abakinnyi 10 itsinze AS Kigali mu mukino ubanza wa 1/2
content: Ikipe ya Rayon Sports iteye intambwe ikomeye yo kwerekeza ku mukino wa nyuma w’igikombe cy’Amahoro ku nshuro ya kabiri yikurikiranije nyuma yo gutsinda AS Kigali ibitego 2-1 mu mukino ubanza wakiniwe kuri stade ya Kigali kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 26 Kamena 2019. title: Igikombe cy’Amahoro: Rayon Sports na AS Kigali zigiye kongera gucakiranira muri 1/2
content: Nyuma yo guhurira mu mikino y’ijonjora ry’ibanze ry’Igikombe cy’Amahoro, ikipe ya Rayon Sports igasezerera AS Kigali kuri penaliti ariko nayo ikazamuka nk’iyatsinzwe byoroheje, izi kipe zombi zongeye kwisanga zigomba gucakirana muri 1/2. Rayon Sports yageze muri 1/2 itsinze Gicumbi FC ibitego 9-1 mu mikino yombi kuko umukino wa mbere wabereye kuri stade ya Kigali yari yayitsinze ibitego 7-1 none kuri iki Cyumweru yayisubiriye iyitsinda ibitego 2-0. Ku rundi ruhande AS Kigali yo yasezereye bigoranye Gasogi United ku kinyuranyo cy’ibitego 3-2. Mu mukino ubanza wari wakiriwe na AS Kigali kuri stade ya Kigali yari yabashije gutsinda 2-1, mu gihe mu mukino wo kwishyura izi kipe zanganyije 1-1 aho AS kigali yagomboye ku munota wa 84, igitego yari yatsinzwe na Gasogi FC mu ntangiriro z’igice cya mbere. Izindi kipe zizacakirana muri 1/2 ni Kiyovu SC na Police FC. Kiyovu FC yageze muri iki cyiciro isezereye Intare FC ku giteranyo cy’ibitego 5-2 nyuma yaho umukino wo kwishyura wakinwe kuri iki Cyumweru izi kipe zanganyije 2-2 mu gihe umukino ubanza Kiyovu SC yari yatsinze ibitego 3-0. Police FC yo yasezereye Etincelles ku giteranyo cy’ibitego 4-2 nyuma yaho banganyije 2-2 mu mukino wo kwishyura wabereye i Kigali mu gihe mu mukino ubanza Police FC yari yatsindiye Etincelles i Rubavu ibitego 2-0. Umukino ubanza wa Rayon Sports na AS Kigali uzaba ku wa Gatatu tariki ya 26 Kamena mu gihe uwo kwishyura uzaba ku wa Gatandatu uzakurikiraho naho Kiyovu SC na Police FC zo zizakine umukino ubanza ku wa Kane tariki ya 27 Kamena maze bazongere bahure ku Cyumweru mu mukino wo kwishyura.

title: Uko byari byifashe mu birori byo gufungura CAN, Misiri yatangiye itsinda Zimbabwe -Amafoto
content:
Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 21 Kamena 2019 i Cairo mu Misiri nibwo hafunguwe irushanwa ry’igikombe cya Afurika, CAN 2019 mu birori bibereye ijisho byabanjirije umukino wa mbere wahuje Misiri na Zimbabwe. Abafana bakabakaba ibihumbi 75,000 nibo bari kuri stade Mpuzamahanga ya Cairo. Hari abanyacyubahiro kandi batandukanye barimo Perezida wa Misiri, Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, Perezida wa FIFA, Gianni Infatino, Perezida wa CAF, Ahmad Ahmad n’abandi. Ibirori byo gutangiza ku mugaragaro iri rushanwa riri kuba ku nshuro ya 32 byatangiye ahagana ku isaha ya saa tatu z’umugoroba bimara iminota hafi 30 aho byaranzwe no guturitsa ibishashi by’umuriro, kwerekana piramide, umuco wa Misiri ya cyera n’iy’ubu n’ibindi byari binogeye ijisho. Umukino nyirizina, abafana ba Misiri byabasabye gutegereza kugeza ku munota wa 41 ubwo Mahmoud Hassan uzwi nka "Trézéguet" yabonaga igitego kimwe rukumbi cyabonetse muri uyu mukino. Ikipe ya Zimbabwe yagerageje kwihagararaho ndetse nayo yashoboraga kuba yabona igitego ariko abasore bayo barimo Kama Briyant ntibabyaza umusaruro amahirwe babonye imbere y’izamu. title: CECAFA Kagame Cup 2019: Rayon Sports na TP Mazembe mu itsinda ry’urupfu
content: Ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 21 Kamena 2019 nibwo habaye tombola y’uburyo amakipe 16 agiye kwitabira irushanwa rya Cecafa Kagame Cup, azaba agabanyije mu matsinda aho ikipe ya Rayon Sports ifite igikombe cya shampiyona yisanze iri kumwe na TP Mazembe mu itsinda A. Irushanwa rya CECAFA Kagame Cup rizatangira ku ya 7 kugeza ku ya 21 Nyakanga 2019 rikazakinirwa mu mijyi itatu y’u Rwanda ari yo Kigali, Huye na Rubavu. TP Mazembe ni imwe mu makipe y’ibigugu muri Afurika, ikaba ariyo yegukanye igikombe cya shampiyona muri Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo. Iyi kipe y’umuherwe Moise Katumbi ni imwe mu makipe atatu yatumiwe muri iyi mikino ya CECAFA iterwa inkunga na Perezida Kagame kuva mu myaka 20 ishize. Ikipe ya Mukura yo yisanze mu itsinda B hamwe na Azam FC ifite iki gikombe giheruka mu gihe APR FC iri mu itsinda C hamwe na Green Buffaloes yo muri Zambia nayo yitabiriye nk’umutumirwa. Ikipe ya Gor Mahia yo muri Kenya ihagaze neza mu karere izaba iri mu itsinda D. Dore uko amatsinda ateye Group A: Rayon Sports, TP Mazembe, KMC, Atlabara Group B: Azam FC, Mukura VS, Bandari FC, KCCA FC Group C: APR FC, Proline FC, Green Buffaloes, Heegan FC Group D: Gor Mahia, DCMP, KMKM, AS Ports Itsinda A na C bizakinira i Kigali mu gihe itsinda C rizakinira i Huye naho itsinda D rikinira i Rubavu.

title: CAN 2019: Ndikumana Seleman yirukanwe mu kipe y’igihugu y’u Burundi iri mu Misiri
content:
Rutahizamu mpuzamahanga w’ikipe y’igihugu y’u Burundi, Ndikumana Seleman ntakiri ku rutonde rw‘abakinyi 23 b’Intamba mu rugamba bagiye kwitabira imikino ya nyuma y’igikombe cya Afurika, CAN 2019 gitangira kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 21 Kamena 2019 mu Misiri. Ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru mu Burundi ryasohoye itangazo rivuga ko uyu mukinnyi yakuwe ku rutonde rw’abakinyi 23 bagiye gukina CAN 2019 kubera imyitwarire mibi ndetse no kutubaha umutoza  mukuru w’Intamba mu rugamba n’abungiriza be.

Ndikumana Yamini Selemani ni umwe mu bakinnyi bari bakuze ndetse bajya banambara igitambaro cya kapiteni mu Burundi Ibi ngo ni byo byatumye umutoza mukuru amuhagarika. Abakinyi 22 b’intamba mu rugamba nibo basigaye ku rutonde rumaze gutangwa muri CAF akaba aribo bagiye kwitabira iyi mikino iki gihugu kigiye gukina ku nshuro yacyo ya mbere mu mateka.

Ikipe y’u Burundi iherereye mu mujyi wa Alexandria Biteganijwe ko ikipe y’igihugu y’u Burundi izakina umukino wayo wa mbere kuri uyu wa Gatandatu  tariki ya 22 Kamena 2019 bahura na Nigeria.

title: Rayon Sports yatumiye abanyamuryango ba yo mu nama y’inteko rusange, izasiga hatowe inzego za komite nshya
content:
Muri uku kwezi kwa Nzeli nibwo hateganijwe inama y’inteko rusange y’abanyamuryango ba Rayon sports ndetse iyi kipe yamaze kubatumira bose muri iyi nama igomba gusiga ibakuye mu rujijo bakamenya uburyo inzego zayo ziteye n’abagize komite nshya yazo. Nkuko bigaragara ku rupapuro rw’ubutumire rwatambukijwe ku rubuga rw’iyi kipe, biteganijwe ko iyi nama y’inteko rusange izaba tariki ya 17 Nzeli 2017 kuva ku isaha ya saa yine za mugitondo, ikabera kuri hotel Sports View Kicukiro. Abakurikiranira hafi iby’iyi kipe yambaara ubururu n’umweru bahamya ko iyi nama izaba ari ingirakamaro kuko uretse gutora inzego z’abagize komite, izanafatirwamo ibyemezo ku ngingo zitandukanye harimo nko kurebera hamwe raporo y’umuryango y’umwaka wa 2016/17, umushinga w’ingengo y’imari y’umwaka ugiye gutangira mu minsi micye iri imbere wa 2017-18, raporo y’abagenzuzi b’imari, gushyiraho no kwemeza amategeko ngengamikorere y’umuryango n’ibindi.

Iri niryo tangazo rigenewe abanyamuryango b’iyi kipe Iyi nama y’inteko rusange y’abanyamuryango b’ikipe ya Rayon Sports igiye kuba mu gihe ibintu byari bimaze iminsi atari shyashya mu miyoborerwe y’iyi kipe aho mu minsi ishize hagiye humvikana ibibazo byinshi bitandukanye bishingiye ku kutumvikana ku ngingo zimwe na zimwe hagati y’inzego zitandukanye zisanzwe ziyiyobora harimo Komite ya Rayon Sports FC nk’ikipe y’umupira w’amaguru, komite y’umuryango wa Rayon Sports na komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi. Aho buri ruhande rwashinjaga urundi kwivanga mu miyoborere no kwinjira mu nshingano z’abandi, ibintu byateje impaka ndende ndetse bivugwa ko bamwe mu bayobozi bagiye banafatana mu mashati, umuti uza kuba ugusesa izi komite zose hashyirwaho ubuyobozi bw’agateganyo bwari bumaze iminsi ari bwo bureberera iyi kipe.

title: Nzamwita Vincent DeGaule yahamije ko ‘urupfu’ arirwo rwamubuza gutsindira kuyobora Ferwafa!
content:
Nyuma y’ibibazo bimaze iminsi bivugwa mu matora y’umuyobozi mukuru wa Ferwafa, ndetse byanatumye FIFA isaba iri shyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru mu Rwanda gusubika aya matora yari ateganijwe ku Cyumweri tariki ya 10/09/2017, Nzamwita Vincent DeGaule usanzwe ayobora iri shyirahamwe yabwiye abo ku ruhande rwe ko nubwo amatora yasubitswe, nta kabuza ariwe uzayatsinda igihe azaba yasubukuwe ngo kuko ntayindi ntambamyi bafite uretse urupfu. Nkuko tubikesha inkuru ya IGIHE, uyu mugabo ibi yabivugiye ku rubuga rwa ‘WhatsApp’ muri gurupe abanamo n’abandi bamushyigikiye, aho yavuze amagambo akomeye mu rwego rwo kubamara impungenge no kubereka ko nta gikuba cyacitse nyuma y’amakuru y’isubikwa ry’aya matora byagaragaraga ku ruhande rumwe nk’intsinzi y’abatavuga rumwe nawe(barimo Albert Mwanafunzi barimo guhatanira uyu mwanya) kuko ari nabo bahanitse amajwi bagaragaza ko aya matora adafututse ndetse bifuza ko yasubikwa.

 Nzamwita Vincent De Gaule usanzwe uyobora Ferwafa  Kuwa Gatanu tariki 1 Nzeri, Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa FIFA, Fatma Samba Diouf Samoura, yandikiye Ferwafa asaba ko amatora ya Perezida w’iri shyirahamwe yari ateganyijwe ahagarikwa kubera ko kuyategura bitakurikije amategeko noneho akazakorwa nyuma y’amezi atatu mu buryo bwiza. Iyi baruwa yahise isubizwa kuwa Gatandatu tariki 2 Nzeri n’Umunyamabanga wa Ferwafa, Uwamahoro Latifah Tharcille, yemera ko icyifuzo cya FIFA kigiye kubahirizwa ndetse n’inama babahaye zo gutunganya amategeko anenga amatora zigakurikizwa. Gusa nkuko IGIHE cyabitangaje ngo Perezida wa Ferwafa, Nzamwita Vincent de Gaulle, ntiyumvikanye n’Umunyamabanga we kuko yifuzaga ko iyo baruwa yasubizwa kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki 4 Nzeri 2017, igaragaza ko impungenge z’uko muri Ferwafa hatari umwuka mwiza ku buryo amatora yagenda neza nta shingiro zifite ahubwo babanza kunoza amategeko gusa noneho akazaba mu gihe cy’amezi abiri.
Aya makuru yakomeje gucicikana nyuma yuko ikiganiro De Gaulle yagiranye n’abamushyigikiye binyuze mu itsinda rya WhatsApp bahuriyemo cyaje gushyirwa hanze n’umwe muri bo utarashatse ko amazina ye atangazwa. Nzamwita yagize ati “Nshuti zanjye bavandimwe kwandika nanditse cyane (yavugaga ibyo yanditse kuri WhatsApp) kugeza ubu umutwe urandiye gusa ubu murabyumva mwese (yahise yifata ijwi araribohereza). Nagerageje guhamagara Umunyamabanga wa FIFA biranga ariko we amaze kumpamagara tuganiriye isaha yose.”
Muri iyo saha aba bayobozi baganiriye, Nzamwita yavuze ko Fatma yamusobanuriye ko gusubika amatora bitatewe cyane n’ikirego cyatanzwe n’abatavuga rumwe nawe ku wa 23 Kanama ahubwo byatewe n’uko n’ubundi FIFA yagiye inahagarika n’amatora yabaye mu yandi mashyirahamwe atarubahirije amategeko mashya agenga amatora. Yagize ati “We (Fatma) arambwiye ngo icyo areba si ukuvuga ngo ni abantu bangahe banditse ahubwo ashaka ikintu kimubwira ko u Rwanda rukeye rutajya mu bintu byo gufunga amatora bikaba akavuyo…tubikosore nta mpamvu yo kwirukankira mu matora kandi hari ibintu biri inyuma bitarakorwa.” Yakomeje abwira abamushyigikiye ko kuwa Mbere tariki ya 04/09/2017 amwandikira amubwira ko yakiriye ibaruwa noneho anamubwire ko agiye gushaka impuguke vuba zizaza gufasha mu gutegura aya matora nyuma hazashyirweho akandi kanama gashya kazagira uruhare mu mitegurire yayo. Yavuze ko akurikije ibyo Fatma yamusabye gukosora no gushyira mu buryo biramutse bikozwe vuba amatora yaba bitarenze tariki 2 Ugushyingo 2017. Yahise anababwira ko we nta kibazo afite kuko amajwi yari yizeye ubu adashobora guhinduka keretse hagize umwe witaba Imana mu bamushyigikiye.
Yagize ati “Njye nta kibazo mfite, amajwi y’ubu ntashobora guhinduka keretse Imana ihamagaye umwe muri twe. Ubwo rero dutuze ibi bintu ntibiduteshe umutwe. Tugomba kubahiriza amategeko.”

title: Kanyankore Gilbert Yawunde yahambirijwe muri Bugesera FC
content:
Nyuma yo gufata ikipe ya Bugesera FC muri Mata uyu mwaka asimbuye Mashami Vincent wagizwe umutoza wungirije mu ikipe y’igihugu ubwo shampiyona yasatiraga iminsi ya nyuma, kuri ubu umutoza Kanyankore Gilbert Yawunde yamaze guhambirizwa n’ubuyobozi bw’iyi kipe. Ni inkuru yasesekaye mu bitangazamakuru mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Mbere, iza itunguranye cyane dore ko uyu mutoza yaherukaga kongererwa amasezerano ndetse kuri iki Cyumweru akaba yari yerekanwe nk’umutoza mukuru wa Bugesera FC ubwo iyi kipe yamurikaga abakinnyi n’abatoza izifashisha mu mwaka w’imikino uri hafi gutangira.

Uyu mutoza yari yabashije kugeza Bugesera FC ku mwanya wa 5 muri shampiyona ishize, aho yayitoje imikino 6, atsindwa umwe, anganya ibiri, abasha gutsinda itatu Biravugwa ko Kanyankore Gilbert Yawunde yaba yazize imyitwarire mibi ngo irimo guta ikipe akigira i Burundi ndetse agatinda gutangiza imyitozo nkuko byagiye binemezwa n’ubuyobozi bw’iyi kipe mu biganiro bitandukanye bagiye bagirana n’ibitangazamakuru byo mu Rwanda, ariko ku rundi ruhande abegereye Kanyankore bo barahakana ayo makuru bavuga ko ari urw’itwazo ubuyobozi bwa Bugesera FC bwahimbye kugirango bumusezerere kubera izindi mpamvu. Kanyankore Gilbert ni umwe mu batoza b’inararibonye muri kano Karere by’umwihariko akaba yaragize ibihe byiza mu Rwanda no mu Burundi aho yatoje amakipe atandukanye arimo Vitalo’O, Les Citadins, Rayons Sport n’andi ariko muri iyi minsi ya vuba akaba atarakunze guhirwa no kuramba mu maipe yo mu Rwanda dore ko mbere y’uko shampiyona y’umwaka ushize itangira yari yerekanwe nk’umutoza mukuru wa APR FC gusa nyuma y’ibyumweru bitarenze bitatu gusa aza guhita yerekwa umuryango, icyo gihe kandi yari yanagiriwe icyizere cyo kuba afashe ikipe y’igihugu yari imaze gusesa amasezerano yari ifitanye na Johnny McKinstry gusa nabwo aza guhita asezererwa hadashize amasaha 24, none Bugesera FC nayo imweretse umuryango.

title: Ku busabe bwa FIFA, ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru mu Rwanda(FERWAFA) ryimuye amatora
content:
Nkuko bigaragara ku rubuga rw’ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru mu Rwanda, Ferwafa, iri shyirahamwe ryamaze gusubika amatora y’umuyobozi mukuru waryo yari ateganijwe ku Cyumweru tariki ya 10 Nzeli 2017. Ni nyuma yaho kuri uyu wa Gatanu ushize, FIFA yandikiye Ferwafa iyisaba gusubika aya matora ikabanza ikayakoraho iperereza kubera urusobe rw’ibibazo byakomeje kuyavugwamo mbere y’uko aba.

Iyi ni ibaruwa umunyamabanga mukuru wa Ferwafa yandikiye mugenzi we wa Fifa amumenyesha ko bemeye gusuika amatora. Ifoto/Ruhagoyacu.com Umuyobozi mukuru w’ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru mu Rwanda, Nzamwita Vincent DeGaulle aganira n’urubuga rwa Ferwafa yagize ati “ Naganiriye n’umunyamabanga mukuru wa FIFA, madame Fatma Samoura kuri iki kibazo, ndetse yatugiriye inama y’icyo dukwiye gukora kugirango tutanyuranya n’amategeko ya status ya Fifa. Fifa yemeye kutwoherereza itsinda ry’impuguke rigomba kudufasha gushyira mu bikorwa amategeko agenga status ya fifa, hanyuma hazaba inama idasanzwe y’inteko rusange yo kubagaragariza uko biteye mbere y’uko hahamagazwa inama y’inteko rusange y’amatora nyirizina.”
Nkuko iyi nkuru iri ku rubuga rwa Ferwafa ikomeza ibivuga, inama y’inteko rusange yari iteganijwe ku Cyumweru tariki ya 10 Nzeli 2017 yo ntabwo yigeze isubikwa gusa ngo hazigwa ku zindi ngingo zari ziteganijwe, naho ibijyanye n’amatora byo byamaze gusubikwa. 
Tubibutse ko Fifa yafashe icyemezo cyo gusaba Ferwafa gusubika aya matora nyuma yaho bamwe mu banyamuryango b’iri shyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru mu Rwanda bandikiye Fifa bayigaragariza impungenge bafite z’ibyo bagaragaza nk’amanyanga arimo akorwa ahanini n’uruhande rwa perezida Vincent Degaulle usanzwe uyobora iri shyirahamwe n’abamushyigikiye.

title: Ikipe y’igihugu y’Ubudage yamaganye abafana baranzwe n’imico y’abanazi ku mukino wabahuje na Repubulika ya Tcheque
content:
Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 02/09/2017, abakinnyi n’abatoza b’ikipe y’igihugu y’ Ubudage banenze agatsiko ka bamwe mu bafana babo bateye hejuru bakarogoya indirimbo z’ibihugu ndetse bagatangira no gutera intero(slogan) y’abanazi mu mukino w’amajonjora yo guhatanira itike yo kwitabira igikombe cy’isi cya 2018, wabahuzaga na Repubulika ya Tcheque i Prague ku mugoroba wo kuwa Gatanu. Nyuma y’umukino aba bakinnyi basanzwe bafite iki gikombe, ntibagiye gusuhuza abafana babo nk’uko byari bisanzwe mu kamenyero kabo, ahubwo bahise bose berekeza mu rwambariro umukino ukirangira. 

Nyuma y’umukino abakinnyi bahise bisubirira mu rwambariro badashimiye abafana bari babaherekeje i Prague Abajijwe impamvu y’icyo cyemezo, Mats Hummels ntabwo yariye iminwa, yagize ati “Ni agahomamunwa, ni bibi cyane! Batutse cyane Timo Werner hanyuma abafana batangira gusakuza ayo mahomvu. Twitandukanyije nabyo rwose, ntabwo dushaka kugira aho duhurira nabyo. Ntabwo ari abafana ni amabandi, abahuriga bagomba kwirukanwa kuri stade.”

Mats Hummels waboneye ikipe y’U Budage igitego cya kabiri cy’intsinzi, ni umwe mu babajwe n’imyifatire y’abafana babo aho yabise ’Aba-hooligans’ Igikundi kimwe cy’abadage cyabanje kurogoya indirimbo z’ibihugu hanyuma hafatwa umunota wo kwibuka abayobozi b’umupira w’amaguru muri Tcheque, nawo utorohewe n’aba badage batukaga «Timo Werner» w’imyaka 21 watutswe cyane mu mpera z’iki cyumweru n’igice cy’abahezanguni b’abadage (Ultras) basanzwe bazira kubi ikipe ya RB Leipzig, uyu mukinnyi asanzwe akinira ikaba ari n’umutungo wa Red Bull.
Nyuma yaho batangiye gutera indirimbo zirimo amagambo y’abanazi. Umuyobozi Ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru mu Budage (DFB), Reinhard Grindel yemeranyijwe n’icyemezo aba bakinnyi bafashe. Yagize ati “Ntabwo tujya twihanganira amagambo atukana, avangura ashingiye ku ruhu, ashingiye ku bihugu cyangwa arwanya abatinganyi (homophobe). Twese hamwe, ikipe y’igihugu, abafana na DFB tugomba kurwanya abarangwa n’iyo myifatire.”

Joachim Low, umudage utoza ikipe y’igihugu cye nawe yavuze ko aba bafana babasebeje bikomeye
Bamwe mu bafana baguriye amatike muri DFB bashoboraga kuba bakurikiranwa ariko ntabwo bo babigizemo uruhare, ahubwo muri stade hari harimo abandi baguze amatike ku bandi bacuruzi ari nabo bakoze ibyo.
Ibitangazamakuru bitandukanye byo mu Budage bivuga ko aba bafana bakoze ibi bashyize no mu majwi DFB yatangiye ibiganiro n’amashyirahamwe y’abafana kugira ngo birukane ku bibuga abafana barangwa n’imyitwarire idahwitse.
Tubibutse ko uyu mukino warangiye u Budage butsinze Repubulika ya Tcheque ibitego 2-1 .

title: ICASA 2019: Abagore b’abakuru b’ibihugu by’Afurika mu cyerekezo kugira Afurika izira SIDA
content:
Abagore b’abakuru b’ibihugu muri Afurika basanga ikibazo cy’umubare uri hejuru cyane w’abangavu n’abagore bandura Virusi itera SIDA kigomba guhagurukirwa ndetse bitarenze 2030 Afurika ikaba yaramaze kugera ku ntego yo kuba umugabane uzira SIDA, dore ko abagera ku bihumbi 6 na 200 aribo bayandura buri mwaka. U Rwanda ruri mu bihugu byo muri Afurika byagerageje guhangana n’iki cyorezo cya SIDA ku buryo kiri ku kigero cyishimiwe na bamwe mu bagore b’abakuru b’ibihugu binyuranye byo muri Afurika bitabiriye inama mpuzamahanga ku kurwanya icyorezo cya SIDA yatangiye imirimo yayo i Kigali kuri uyu wa Mbere. Madamu wa Perezida wa Pepubulika Jeannette Kagame agaragaza ko nubwo hishimirwa cyane intambwe imaze guterwa mu kurwanya icyorezo cya SIDA hakiri imbogamizi Yagize ati ‘‘Mu Rwanda kugeza muri 2018 ubwandu bushya bwa virusi itera SIDA bwagabanutseho 83% ndetse n’ipfu ziterwa na SIDA zagabanutseho 82% mu myaka 20 ishize. Bashyitsi bahire kwishimira ibyagezweho bigomba kujyana no gusesengura byimbitse iby’urugendo rwacu. Ni uburyo bwo kugira ibiganiro bihamye cyane no kubibazo biterwa n’ubusumbune hagati y’abagabo n’abagore bituma n’ubwo dukomeza gukora cyane bisubiza uyu mugabane inyuma mu rwego rwo guhangana no gusubiza ibibazo bya SIDA bibangamiye abantu bacu.’’ 

 Madame Jeannette Kagame yavuze ko hagikenewe imbaraga mu kurwanya SIDA 
Madamu wa Perezida wa Congo-Brazaville Antoinette Sassou N’guesso yemeza ko ihuriro ryabo ayoboye rizafasha uyu mugabane kugera ku ntego wihaye wo kugira Afurika idafite SIDA muri 2030. Ati ‘‘Iri huriro ryo mu rwego rwo hejuru rigiye kudufasha binyuze mu biganiro  tubashe kungurana ibitekerezo  ku ruhare n’inshingano rw’abagore b’abakuru b’ibihugu  bya Afurika duhereye ku rwego rw’igihugu, akarere no ku isi hose mu kurwanya agakoko gatera SIDA n’icyorezo  cya SIDA. Gushyira ku mugaragaro imbogamizi z’ingenzi, amasomo twavanamo n’amahirwe ahari yafasha mu guca burundu icyorezo cya SIDA bitarenze mu mwaka wa 2030. Gushyiraho no kunoza ubufatanye  mu kurwanya icyorezo cya SIDA muri gahunda zose z’ubuzima n’iterambere.’’ Umuyobozi w’inama y’ubutegetsi y’ikigega  mpuzamahanga gishinzwe kurwanya icyorezo cya SIDA, igituntu na malariya, Global Fund, Dr. Donald Kaberuka avuga ko n’ubwo ubukungu bw’ibihugu bwakomeje kuzamuka neza muri iyi myaka, ingengo y’imari yagenewe ibikorwa by’ubuzima y’ibihugu  binyuranye ntiyigeze izamurwa ndetse ibihugu byinshi iyo ngengo y’imari n’uburezi ikaburizwamo kubera ibibazo by’umutekano muke. Mu nama yabereye Abuja, abari bayirimo biyemeje ko ingengo y’imari y’ubuzima izamurwa ku kigero cya 15% gusa ngo ibihugu byinshi byarinumiye. Ati ‘‘Mu gace ka sahel ingengo y’imari y’umutekano igenda irushaho kumira ingengo y’imari y’ubuzima. Muri ibyo bihugu byugarijwe n’ingaruka z’iterabwoba bafite imitwe nka boko haram n’indi ituruka mu majyaruguru, nko muri Chad, Cameroon ya ruguru, amajyaruguru ya Nigeriya , Bukina Faso , Mali n’ahandi. Iingengo y’imari iremerewe n’ibyo bikorwa bituruka hanze.’’ Abagore b’abakuru b’ibihugu bitabiriye iy’inama mpuzamahanga kuri SIDA n’indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina, ICASA barimo uwa  Botswana Neo Jane Masisi, Hinda Deby Itno wa Chad, uwa Niger Aissata Issoufou Mahamadou, Rebecca Akufo-Addo wa Ghana  n’uwa Congo Brazaville Antoinette Sassou N’guesso uyoboye iri huriro ryabo rimaze imyaka igera kuri 17.

title: Dore impamvu 4 zifatwa nk’izoroheje nyamara zimunga umubano kugeza kuri gatanya (divorce)
content: Buri gihe urukundo ruba ari rwinshi iyo abantu bashyingiranwa ndetse bakiyemeza kubana by’iteka ryose, bagasangira ibyiza n’ibibi kugeza batandukanijwe n’urupfu. Nyamara ibi ntibibuza kumva za gatanya ziyongera umunsi ku wundi. Amafaranga no gucana inyuma byakomeje kugenda bigaragazwa nk’impamvu zikomeye za gatanya, ariko ibi nubwo biba bibaye imbarutso yo gufata umwanzuro, burya biba byarapfuye kera, buhoro buhoro. Mu bushakashatsi bwashyizwe hanze na kaminuza ya Copenhague muri Danemark bwakozwe n’abahanga mu by’umubano w’abashakanye, bwakorewe ku bantu 2371 bamaze igihe gito batandukanye n’abo bashakanye; byagaragaye ko hari impamvu 4 zagarutsweho na benshi muri bo. Muri iyi nkuru tugiye kubagezaho izi mpamvu 4 zifatwa nk’izoroheje nyamara zimunga umubano w’abashakanye kugeza biyemeje gutesha agaciro urukundo rukomeye rwabahuje. 1. Guhagarika kwerekana urukundo Hafi 47% bavuze ko batandukanye n’abo bakundaga kuko batari bakigaragarizwa ko bakunzwe. Mu gihe cya mbere cy’umubano w’abashakanye, ubuzima burabaryohera, ahanini kuko baba bagiha agaciro kubwirana ngo ’Ndagukunda’ ndetse no gukora utuntu twinshi uduto n’utunini, bagaragarizanya ko bakundanye. Nyamara uko iminsi yegera imbere, wa mubano basa n’abawumenyera bakawufata nk’ikintu gisanzwe, ikosa rikomeye cyane kuko buri wese mu bashakanye aba afite uburyo yifuza kubonamo ko agifitiwe urukundo. 2. Kutaganira bihagije Ibiganiro ku bakundana ni ingirakamaro cyane bikaba akarusho ku bashakanye. Kubwirana amagambo meza, ibyo mukunda, ibyo mwanga, icyabababaje, icyabashimishije n’ibindi nk’ibyo ndetse mukamenya no kujya inama mbere yo gufata imyanzuro. Ibi iyo bidakozwe rero nibwo usanga buri wese afite byinshi ku mutima ugasanga bigenda bizimya rwa rukundo wari ufitiye uwawe kugeza utakibona ikintu cyiza ahubwo bya bibi akaba aribyo wibonera gusa. 3. Gutakaza icyubahiro n’icyizere Icyubahiro n’icyizere nabyo ni ibintu bikomeye cyane mu mubano w’abashakanye. Niba umwe muri bo abona ko atacyubashywe cyangwa ko nta cyizere akigirirwa usanga ashobora guhitamo kubivamo. 4. Gutandukanya icyerekezo Bivugwa ko abashakanye baba bahindutse umuntu umwe, murumva rero uko bigenda iyo abari umwe batangiye kureba mu nzira zitandukanye. Aho umwe yifuza kuganisha ubuzima undi akabirwanya na we akerekana ikindi cyerekezo. Akenshi ibi biba impamvu z’igihe kinini, maze imbarutso ikaza ibyutsa bimwe muri ibi biba bisinziriye mu muntu. Ni byiza rero ko niba ufite uwo mubana kandi ukaba wifuza ko mugirana umubano urambye, wakwita kuri ibi bintu n’utundi tuntu duto kuko aritwo dusenya cyangwa tugakomeza umubano wanyu. Src: 7sur7

title: Ni gute wakwirinda cyangwa ukivura uburwayi bwo kunuka mu kanwa
content: Buri gitondo iyo ubyutse wisangana impumuro iteye ubwoba ituruka mu kanwa kawe, ariko ibyo ntibikwiye kuguhangayikisha kuko ariko abatuye ku isi bose bibagendekera. Gusa ibyo sibyo burwayi bwo kunuka mu kanwa. Akenshi abafite indwara yo kunuka mu kanwa ntibabimenya kuko burya badashobora kubyumva. Burya kumva ubusharire mu kanwa cyangwa ibindi byatuma ukeka ko unuka mu kanwa ntaho bihurira n’ukuri ahubwo iyi mpumuro mbi yumvirwa mu mazuru gusa kandi akenshi ikumvwa n’undi muntu cyangwa se nyirubwite iyo ashyize ikiganza ku munwa akohereza umwuka usohoka mu kanwa ke ku izuru.  Ese ubundi kunuka mu kanwa biterwa n’iki?  Hari ubwo umuntu anuka mu kanwa kubera ibyo yuriye cyangwa yanyoye, nka tungurusumu, amagi, inzoga, itabi n’ibindi nk’ibyo ariko uyu munuko siwo witwa uburwayi kuko akenshi uhita ushira nyuma y’igihe runaka cyangwa se uriye sikarete cyangwa wogeje mu kanwa. Ibi rero ntaho bihuriye n’uburwayi nyirizina. Ubundi uyu munuko ukabije wo mu kanwa uterwa n’indwara zo mu kanwa nk’iryinyo ryangiritse bityo rikaba ririmo udukoko dutuma mu kanwa hanuka. Bishobora no guturuka ku bundi burwayi butandukanye bwo mu kanwa, nk’ubw’ishinya, ururimi cyangwa se n’udusabo tuvubura amacandwe. Mu gihe umenye ko ufite uburwayi bwo kunuka mu kanwa rero dore inama zagufasha kubikira cyangwa se ukaba wabyirinda mu gihe utarafatwa 1.Isuku y’amenyo: Ni ngombwa cyane koza amenyo byibura inshuro 2 ku munsi kandi ukamara iminota 2 yuzuye cyangwa irenga urimo koza amenyo. Ukibuka kugera ku bice byose by’amenyo kandi ugakoresha umuti wamenyo. 2. Isuku y’ururimi:  Akenshi iyo abantu boza mu kanwa bibanda ku menyo bakirengagiza ururimi nyamara burya narwo rubika imyanda n’udukoko twinshi cyane maze ugasanga rwateza ubu burwayi. Niwoza mu kanwa rero ntuzirengagize ururimi. 3. Kunywa amazi menshi: Amazi ni ikinyobwa gikomeye cyane mu gusukura amenyo, iyo unyoye amazi cyane cyane umaze kurya bigufasha kwiyunyuguza mu kanwa no gukuramo ibiryo. 4.Guhindura uburoso bw’amenyo: Nubwo uburoso bw’amenyo ari igikoresho gikomeye ku isuku yo mu kanwa ariko burya nyuma y’igihe ubukoresha bugenda bubika udukoko. Ni ngombwa rero ko umuntu abwitaho akabukorera isuku ndetse bukaba bugomba guhindurwa buri mezi 3. 5. Kwisuzumisha:  Ni ngombwa ko umuntu wese afata umwanya akajya kwa muganga gusuzumisha amenyo ye nubwo yaba atibonaho ibimenyetso by’uburwayi. Ibi bituma muganga akurikiranira hafi ubuzima bw’amenyo yawe bityo akurinda kuba wagira ubu burwayi n’igihe buje akabufatirana hakiri kare.

title: Ku myaka 73 yibarutse impanga
content:
Umukecuru w’imyaka 73 ukomoka mu gihutu cy’Ubuhinde yibarutse impanga, ibyo abaganga bahamya nk’igitangaza cy’Imana. Erramatti Mangayamma yari amaze imyaka 57 yose ashakanye na Sitharama Rajarao ariko ntibari barigeze bagira amahirwe yo kwitwa ababyeyi. Erramatti yaje kugira igitekerezo cyo gukoresha uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga kugira ngo abashe gusama, ubwo yari yabonye umuturanyi we abigerageza ku myaka 55, yibwira ko na we yagerageza aya mahirwe, none byaramuhiriye.

 Erramatti, umugabo we n’abana babo  Nk’uko abaganga bamukurikiranye babitangaza, izi mpanga za madamu Erramatti zasamwe hifashishijwe ibyuma, ’Fécondation in vitro’ nyuma aza kubatwita aranabibaruka, iki ngo kikaba ari igitangaza. "Ni igitangaza cy’ubuvuzi bugezweho. Gusama ahakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga ntibigenda neza kubera iterambere ry’ubumenyi (science) gusa, ahubwo n’impuhwe z’Imana zibigiramo uruhare." Amagambo ya muganga wabakurikiraniye hafi, unahamya ko umubyeyi n’abana bameze neza nta kibazo.


 Erramati na Sitharama, umuryango wabo n’abaganga babo baranezerewe kwakira aba bana   Erramatti yavutse ku itariki ya 1 Nyakanga, 1946 nk’uko bigaragara ku byangombwa bye by’ishuri. Kugeza ubu umubyeyi wabyaye akuze cyane ku isi nk’uko byanditswe mu gitabo cya Guinness World Records ni ukomoka muri Espagne, wabyaye afite imyaka 66, mu mwaka wa 2006.

title: Huye: Umugore afunzwe akekwaho kwica umwana we w’ukwezi kumwe amuroze
content:
Mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Kabiri, tariki ya 24 Nzeri, 2019 nibwo Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe ubugenzacyaha, RIB rwataye umuri yombi umugore witwa Mukakaremera Immacuée akurikiranyweho kwica umwana we w’ukwezi kumwe amuroze. Uwo mubyeyi w’imyaka 32 y’amavuko asanzwe atuye mu Mudugudu wa Agahenerezo mu Kagali ka Rukira. Yari amaze kugira abana batatu badahuje ba se kuko nta mugabo babana. Bamwe mu baturanyi be bavuga ko mu munsi ushize nabwo yashatse kumwica avuga ko kumurera bimunaniye bitewe n’uko umugabo babyaranye nta bufasha amuha. Umwe yagize ati “Yahoraga avuga ngo azamwica cyangwa amujugunye kuko ngo umugabo babyaranye nta n’igikoma yigeze amuha. Aherutse no gushaka kumujugunya mu musarani turabimubuza.”
 Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo, CIP Twajamahoro Sylvestre, yabwiye ikinyamakuru Igihe, dukesha iyi nkuru,  ko uwo mubyeyi yatawe muri yombi kugira ngo hakorwe ipereza hamenyekane amakuru y’ukuri. Ati “RIB iramufite irimo gukora iperereza kugira ngo mu by’ukuri tumenye uko byagenze n’icyishe uwo mwana. We avuga ko ari imiti y’uduheri yamuhaye ikamwica, ubundi akavuga ko ari mukuru we wamuryamiye; iperereza riri gukorwa.” Umurambo w’uwo mwana witabye Imana wajyanywe ku bitaro bya CHUB gukorerwa isuzuma. Mukakaremera afungiye kuri Sitasiyo ya RIB ya Ngoma mu Karere ka Huye.

title: Algerie: Impinja umunani zapfiriye mu nkongi y’umuriro yibasiye ibitaro
content:
Muri Algerie hari kuvugwa inkuru y’akababaro y’impinja umunani zaburiye ubuzima mu nkongi y’umuriro yibasiye ibitaro bya Bachir Bennacer biherereye ahitwa El Oued mu burasirazuba bw’iki gihugu. Amakuru yatangajwe na televiziyo Channel 3 ngo iyi nkongi y’umuriro yibasiye ibi bitaro mu ijoro ryakeye yahoshejwe ahagana saa kumi z’igicuku ku isaha yo muri Algeria (saa cyenda z’igicuku ku isaha ngengamasaha, GMT). Minisitiri w’Intebe wa Algeria, Noureddine Bedoui yasabye ko hatangizwa iperereza  ku cyateye iyi nkongi ndetse yasabye minisitiri w’ubuzima kugera kuri ibi bitaro.
 Muri rusange abana 11 n’abagore 107 ni bo babashije gutabarwa ubwo iyi nkongi yabaga nkuko umuvugizi w’ibikorwa by’ubutabazi yabitangarije AFP. Abandi bakozi b’ibi bitaro bagera kuri 30 nabo bkijijwe nkuko kapiteni Nassim Bernaoui yakomeje abibwira AFP. Ati "Ariko ikibabaje, tubabajwe n’urupfu rw’impinja umunani, bamwe bahiye, abandi bahera umwuka kubera imyotsi." Src:BBC Afrique

title: Nyarugenge: Imibiri irenga 100 imaze gutabururwa mu rugo rwiciwemo abantu muri Jenoside
content:
Urugo ruherereye mu Murenge wa Rwezamenyo, mu Karere ka Nyarugenge, rwavumbuwemo ko rwiciwemo abantu muri jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu 1994, rumaze gutabururwamo imibiri y’abarenga 100. Nk’uko tubikesha IGIHE, Kuwa Gatanu tariki ya 13 Nzeri 2019, nibwo amakuru y’uko muri uru rugo rwa Nyakwigendera Rwagasana wishwe muri Jenoside hiciwe abantu bari hagati ya 80 n’ijana yamenyekanye atanzwe n’umukobwa witwa Aline Bicunda waharokokeye muri Jenoside uba mu Bufaransa. Iyi nkuru ikimenyekana abana ba nyakwigendera Rwagasana baba ku mugabane w’u Burayi n’indi miryango ikomoka ku bari barahungiye muri urwo rugo bakahicirwa, bahise baza mu Rwanda gushakisha imibiri y’ababo biciwe muri urwo rugo kugira ngo ishyingurwe mu cyubahiro. Gusa kimwe mu byatunguye abari mu gikorwa cyo gutaburura iyi mirambo n’uburyo imaze kuboneka irenga 100 mu gihe iki gikorwa kigikomeje

Na bamwe mu banyeshuri bifatanyije n’umuryango wo kwa Rwagasana mu gushakisha imibiri y’abiciwe muri urwo rugo Karambizi Carine warokokeye muri uru rugo yabwiye IGIHE ko ari we wahawe amakuru y’uko kwa Nyakwigendera Rwagasana hashobora kuba harimo imibiri y’abazize jenoside. Yagize ati “Nagiye kumureba mvuye mu Bubiligi we aba mu Bufaransa kugira ngo ambwire amakuru y’aho papa bamwiciye kuko bari kumwe mu mirambo muri icyo cyobo ariko we abasha kugisohokamo, kubera ko yabaga atabisubiyemo neza ngo abitekereze ntabwo yamenyaga neza aho iyo mirambo yagiye nyuma nibwo yaje kwibuka ambwira aho icyo cyobo giherereye.” Yongeyeho ko nyuma yo guhabwa ayo makuru yahise ajya gushakisha abo mu muryango wo kwa Nyakwigendera Rwagasana babiganiraho ndetse banemeranya umunsi bazaza mu Rwanda kugirango bashakishe icyo cyobo bakuremo imibiri y’ababo. Yongeyeho ko nk’abarokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi bababazwa cyane n’uko hari abantu bafite amakuru y’ahiciwe abatutsi muri jenoside ariko bakinangira kuyatanga.

Inkweto za bamwe biciwe kwa Nyakwigendera Rwagasana Uwimabera Rosalia umwana wa Nyakwigendera Rwagasana, we avuga ko bababajwe cyane n’uko hari abaturanyi babo bahise bahunga nyuma y’aho bamenyeye ko hagiye kuba umuhango wo gushakisha imibiri y’abiciwe iwabo. Ati “Iyo umuturanyi ahunze aba ari gupfobya, kuko kubona warakoze ikintu cyangwa mugenzi wawe yaragikoze ukanga kubwira nyirabyo uwabikoze n’aho yabikoreye ahubwo yabyimenyera yaza kugira ngo aze aheshe agaciro abo bantu bari aho ugahunga, ni uko nawe uba ufite icyaha wishinja.” Yongeyeho ko imibiri imaze kuboneka iwabo irenga 100 ndetse iki gikorwa gikomeje aboneraho gusaba buri muntu wese wabuze uwe muri jenoside akeka ko yiciwe muri ibyo bice yahagera kugira ngo arebe ko hari abo yamenya cyane ko igikorwa cyo gushakisha imibiri y’abahiciwe gikomeje.
