title: Video: Ustha Ituze yasubiyemo indirimbo ’Naraye ndose’ ya Kamaliza
content:
Amazina yiswe n’ababyeyi ni Ituze Justine ariko akaba yarahisemo gukoresha ’Ustha Ituze’ mu ruhando rwa muzika, aho yihebeye injyana za kinyafurika by’umwihariko injyana Gakondo nyarwanda. Ustha Ituze akaba yateye ikirenge mu cy’umuvandimwe we Liza Kamikazi usanzwe azwi cyane mu muziki nyarwanda, aho mu minsi ishize aherutse kwiyegurira izihimbaza Imana. Ustha Ituze asanzwe akora umuziki wa live ahantu hatandukanye aho atumirwa mu minsi mikuru n’ahandi. Avuga ko yahisemo mbere na mbere gufata amajwi n’amashusho ya zimwe mu ndirimbo z’abahanzi nyarwanda zakunzwe mu myaka yashize azisubiyemo mu buryo bwihariye ibyo bita ’cover’. 
Ustha Ituze, murumuna wa Liza Kamikazi winjiye mu muziki nyuma y’undi muvandimwe wabo Izere Noella Ku ikubitiro yashyize hanze indirimbo yasubiyemo y’umuhanzikazi Kamaliza yamenyekanye cyane yise ’Naraye ndose’. Reba hano hasi ’Naraye ndose’ yasubiwemo na Ustha Ituze Mu kiganiro yahaye Kigali Post, Ustha Ituze yavuze ko yifuje gusangiza abanyarwanda izi ndirimbo zabiciye bigacika mu myaka ishize. Ati "Ni indirimbo zankoze ku mutima, nsanzwe ndirimba nkabona abantu barazishimiye cyane, nkaba nifuje  kubisangiza abanyarwanda muri rusange." Ustha Ituze yadutangarije ko uretse iyi ndirimbo yahereyeho, afite indi mishinga myinshi y’indirimbo yarangije gufatira amajwi n’amashusho yaba iz’abahanzi bo ha mbere ndetse n’ize bwite, ku buryo azagenda azishyira hanze mu bihe biri imbere, aboneraho gusaba abakunzi ba muzika kumushyigikira.

title: Abagore babiri bo muri Kenya baguranye abagabo babo
content: Abagore babiri bo mu karere ka Busia mu burengerazuba bwa Kenya bumije abantu ubwo baguranaga abagabo babo bagamije gushaka ibyishimo. Lilian Weta w’imyaka 28 y’amavuko ufite abana batatu, na Millicent Auma w’imyaka 29 ufite abana babiri, bagarutsweho cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga muri Kenya, kubera kugaragara nk’abakoze ikintu kidasanzwe ku bashakanye. Mu cyumweru gishize, bemeranyijwe imbere y’abategetsi uko abana babo bazajya bitabwaho nyuma yaho abo bagore baguraniye abagabo babo n’abana. Abo bagore bavuga ko bafashe icyo cyemezo kubera ubushyamirane budashira mu miryango yabo. Ibitangazamakuru byo muri Kenya byasubiyemo amagambo ya Lilian avuga ko yafashe icyo cyemezo nyuma yaho umugabo we azanye undi mugore mu nzu yabo mu kwezi gushize. Yagize ati: "Umugabo wanjye yarambeshye ngo mubyara we uvuye ahitwa Bungoma azaza kudusura, rero ngo ntegure amafunguro ndetse n’aho umushyitsi azarara. Hashize akanya gato mbona umugore arinjiye, aravuga ngo nimuharire akanya kuko iyi ari inzu ye ubu ngubu, bitihi se antere icyuma". Amagambo ya Lilian yakomeje asubirwamo n’ibitangazamakuru byo muri Kenya avuga ko Millecent yamusabye gushaka umugabo we, yamubona bagashakana, nuko koko aragenda ajya kumushaka ndetse bakorana ubukwe mu byumweru bitatu bishize. Bwire, wari umugabo wa Millicent, yagize ati: "Uyu mugore yaje arira anatabaza yinubira ko umugore wanjye yamutwariye umugabo n’inzu ye". "Ndamubwira nti, kubera ko umugore wanjye ari we wakwirukanye iwawe, rero jyenda ufate ibyawe byose n’abana bawe ubundi uze ubane nanjye hano". Ubu hashize ibyumweru bibiri uyu Lilian Weta ashakanye na Christopher Bwire nyuma yaho abakunzi babo babagambaniye, ariko bavuga ko nta nzika babafitiye ku byo bakorewe. Bwire yabwiye ibitangazamakuru byo muri Kenya uko ubuzima bwe bwahindutse kuri ubu, bukaba ari ibyishimo. Ati: "Ababi babiri babane, n’abeza babiri babane, nta cyo nicuza iyo mbitekerejeho". "Muri iyi minsi mbyukira igihe nshakiye, kandi nkaryama igihe nshakiye, ndya neza, mfite ibyishimo byinshi kubera kubana na Lilian". Lilian na we avuga ko yishimiye cyane kubana na Bwire. Barasa wahoze ari umugabo wa Lilian, avuga ko adateganya kongera kubana na we ndetse ko nta makuru ye ashaka kumenya kuko avuga ko we na Millicent babanye mu munezero. Src:BBC

title: Kirehe: Imvura idasanzwe yasenye inzu 52 n’insengero eshatu
content:
Imvura idasanzwe yiganjemo umuyaga mwinshi yaguye mu Karere ka Kirehe mu Murenge wa Nasho, yasambuye inzu z’abaturage 52, insengero eshatu, isenya ibikoni 33 n’ubwiherero 52. Iyi mvura yaguye kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 19 Nzeri ahagana saa munani kugeza saa cyenda z’amanywa ngo yari yiganjemo umuyaga mwinshi cyane ari nawo watumye hangirika inzu nyinshi. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Nasho, Nzirabatinya Modeste yabwiye ikinyamakuru Igihe dukesha iyi nkuru ko iyi mvura yaguye mu gihe gito ariko ikangiza ibintu byinshi, usibye inzu n’insengero yangije ngo yangije n’urutoki.

 Urutoki narwo rwangiritse bikomeye  Ati “Yangije urutoki rungana na hegitari icumi aho ibitoki byari birimo ibyinshi byaguye, yanangije insinga z’amashanyarazi zatwaraga umuriro mu midugudu ibiri ya Gatare na Gatarama yo mu Kagari ka Rugoma.” Yakomeje agira ati “Kugeza ubu turi gutegura umuganda udasanzwe kugira ngo dusubizeho ibisenge ku nzu ba nyirazo babone uko bazisubiramo, ikindi kuri uyu mugoroba tubashije kubashakira aho bacumbika mu baturanyi.”

 Byabaye ngombwa ko bajya gucumbika mu baturanyi  Iyi mvura kandi yatumye Mukampore Gaudence agwirwa n’igisenge kubw’amahirwe aza kuba muzima kuri ubu ari kuvurirwa ku Kigo Nderabuzima cya Mulindi. Akarere ka Kirehe ni kamwe mu dukunda kwibasirwa n’imvura, nko muri Mata uyu mwaka nabwo imvura idasanzwe yangije inzu nyinshi cyane. Muri Mutarama uyu mwaka nabwo haguye imvura yiganjemo umuyaga yangiza inzu 228 z’abaturage, hegitari 183 z’imyaka.

title: Nagambanye na basaza banjye ngo twice umugabo wanjye kuko yancaga inyuma
content:
Umugore witwa Shanita na basaza be babiri umwe witwa Olivier undi akitwa Francois beretswe itangazamakuru kuri uyu wa Kabiri nyuma yo gufatwa na RIB bakurikiranyweho ubufatanyacyaha mu kwica Callixte Ndahimana wari umugabo wa Shanita. Shanita avuga ko mugabo we yamucaga inyuma cyane biza kumutera umutima mubi wo kumwicisha afatanyije na basaza be. Uyu mugore na Ndahimana bari bafitanye abana babiri, avuga ko umugabo we yakundaga indaya cyane ndetse ngo ubwo yapangaga umugambi wo kumwica na bwo yari azivuyemo.  Ngo we na basaza be babiri bamwishe ku Cyumweru mu gitondo kandi ngo yari yaraye mu ndaya ataha bukeye. Ati: “Umugabo wange yari yarananiye ajya mu bagore kenshi kandi nkamusaba ko yabireka ntanyumve. Mu minsi ishize na bwo namufashe asambana n’umukozi wacu wo mu rugo.” Uyu mugore ukiri muto avuga ko umugabo we Callixte Ndahimana hari n’undi mugore yari yarubakiye inzu akajya ajyayo. Abanyamakuru bamubajije uko byaje kugenda kugira ngo ategure umugambi wo kumwica, undi avuga ko yamuganirizaga ku by’ubusambanyi bwe amusaba kubureka undi akinangira. Nyuma ngo uyu mugore yaje kubiganirizaho basaza be bemeranya na we ko bazamufasha ‘gukora icyo ari cyo cyose ikibazo kigakemuka.’  Ati: “Nabazaga umugabo na we akambwira ko amfitiye umugambi utari mwiza. Mufatira gahunda itari nziza. Nabonaga nta heza hange ni uko bintera umutima mubi.”
 Ngo yegereye basaza be bategura umugambi. Musaza we mukuru witwa Francois (uyu asanzwe ari umushoferi) avuga ko mushiki wabo yabasabye kuza bakarangiza cya kibazo. Ngo hari ku Cyumweru. Murumuna we muto yarinjiye afata uwo mugabo amupfukisha umusego mu maso undi ashatse kubarwanya mukuru we (Francois) amutera icyuma mu ijosi. Nyuma yo kwica Callixte Ndahimana bamushyize mu modoka bayisohora mu gipangu bayisiga hanze barayikinga barigendera. Umuvugizi wa RIB ku rwego rw’igihugu Modeste Mbabazi avuga ko amakuru akimenyekana bahise batangira iperereza baza kubona ibimenyetso bibaganisha kuri bariya bantu. Kuri uyu wa Mbere nibwo bafashwe. Mbabazi asaba abashakanye n’abandi Banyarwanda muri rusange kwirinda amakimbirane yavamo inzangano ziganisha ku gukora ibyaha, ugize icyo apfa n’undi bakiyunga mu miryango cyangwa ahandi aho kugira ngo bicane.

Uyu mugabo avuga ko ari we witerete icyuma mu ijosi nyakwigendera

Uyu yiyemereye ko ariwe watwaye umurambo wa nyakwigendera mu modoka bamaze kumutera icyuma

Bose ubu bari mu maboko ya RIB ejo ikazabashyikiriza ubushinjacyaha Inkuru y’Umuseke

title: RIB yafashe abakekwaho kwica umugabo bakamusiga mu ivatiri barimo umugore we n’abasaza be
content: Urwego rw’Igihugu rw’Ubugenzacyaha (RIB) rwatangaje ko rwataye muri yombi abantu batatu bakekwaho kugira uruhare mu rupfu rwa Ndahiriwe Calllixte wasanzwe mu modoka yapfiriye mu karere ka Gasabo, barimo n’umugore we. Muri abo batawe muri yombi harimo umugore witwa Mukamazimpaka Shanita ukurikiranyweho icyaha cyo kwica uwo bari barashakanye. Mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Mbere nibwo umurambo w’umugabo witwa Ndahimana Callixte wagaragaye mu Kagari ka Kagugu mu Murenge wa Kanyinya mu Karere ka Gasabo, uri mu ivatiri ihagaze ku muhanda. Nkuko iyi nkuru dukesha IGIHE ibivuga, amakuru avuga ko ababonye umurambo bwa mbere ari abanyeshuri bari bagiye kwiga, niko guhita babimenyesha ubuyobozi, nabwo butanga amakuru kuri RIB itangira iperereza. RIB yakoze iperereza kuri uwo murambo aho kuri uyu wa Kabiri yatangaje ko abakekwaho kwica uwo mugabo bafashwe barimo n’umugore we. Amakuru agera kuri IGIHE avuga ko umugore wa nyakwigendera witwa Mukamazimpaka Shanita yakunze kugirana ibibazo n’umugabo we, aho yamushinjaga kumuca inyuma, ubwo bwumvikane buke buza gukaza umurego bigeza aho hazamo amakimbirane akomeye. Umugore ngo yashatse uko yakwikiza umugabo, ashaka kumwica akoresheje uburozi ariko undi arabimenya acika ku kongera kurya mu rugo. Bivugwa ko umugore yaganirije basaze be, akatekerereza ibibazo afitanye n’umugabo yaba ibyo kuba amuca inyuma n’ibijyanye n’imikoreshereze y’umutungo, niko kwemeranya kuzamufasha kumwica. Ku munsi umugabo yiciweho, ngo umugore yari yasabye basaza be ko baza kugera mu rugo saa tanu z’ijoro, bahageze basanga umugore amaze gucyocyorana n’umugabo. Ngo abo baramu b’umugabo bamubajije icyo apfa na mushiki wabo, undi ahitamo guceceka ageze aho arabahunga ajya mu cyumba araryama. Umugore na basaza be ngo bamusanze mu cyumba, aba ariho bamwicira bamuteye icyuma mu ijosi, barangije bamushyira mu modoka bajya kuyiparika ku muhanda basiga bamufungiranyemo. Umuvugizi w’Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Ubugenzacyaha, Mbabazi Modetse, yabwiye IGIHE ko amakuru y’uburyo umugore n’umugabo bari bafitanye amakimbirane nabo bayabonye kandi ko abakekwa bari kuyabazwaho kugira ngo bashyikirizwe Ubushinjacyaha. Mbabazi yasabye ubuyobozi bw’inzego z’ibanze n’abaturage muri rusange kugira uruhare mu kurwanya amakimbirane, no gutanga amakuru ku miryango ibanye nabi. Ati “Abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze badufashe kumenya amakuru y’ingo bayobora cyane izirangwamo amakimbirane kugira ngo habeho gukumira ibyaha bitaraba. Ikindi n’ababana bafitanye ibibazo, birinde kwihorera, ahubwo begere ubuyobozi cyangwa imiryango kuko iyo bihoreye bibaviramo ibyaha bikomeye.” Uyu mugore na basaza be bakurikiranyweho icyaha cyo kwica. Kiramutse kibahamye bahanishwa igifungo cya burundu nkuko biteganywa n’ingingo z’amategeko ahana ibyaha mu Rwanda.

title: Umugore n’umwana we bakize Ebola berekanywe i Goma muri Congo
content:
Abashinzwe ubuzima muri Congo hamwe n’ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku buzima, muri iki gitondo i Goma muri Congo bagaragaje Eben-Ezer na nyina Espérance bakize Ebola. Iyi ndwara y’icyorezo imaze guhitana abantu barenga 1800 mu burasirazuba bwa Congo kuva yakwaduka mu kwezi kwa munani umwaka ushize. Uyu munsi abahanga muri siyansi bemeje ko hari imiti ine yageragejwe ku barwayi muri Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo ikagaragaza ubushobozi bwo kubakiza. Umugore n’umwana we, ni babiri mu bantu bane bafashwe na Ebola mu mujyi wa Goma, babiri bandi yarabahitanye. Mu bo yahitanye harimo umugabo we, uyu yari abaye umuntu wa kabiri basanzemo Ebola mu mujyi wa Goma. Eben-Ezer utaruzuza imyaka ibiri na nyina Espérance bamaze iminsi bavurirwa mu kigo cyagenewe kwita ku bafashwe n’abakekwaho iki cyorezo i Goma.

Umugore n’umwana we bakize ebola Ni inkuru nziza ku bakozi bo mu nzego z’ubuzima no ku baturage b’imijyi ya Goma na Gisenyi mu Rwanda ubu itakigenderanira nk’ibisanzwe kubera ubwoba bw’iki cyorezo. Uyu munsi berekanywe mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru i Goma nk’abantu bakize Ebola bakijijwe n’imiti iri mu igeragezwa. Bamwe bagaragaje ibyishimo byabo ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Dr Sabue Mulangu inzobere muri Ebola, yabwiye BBC ko aba bombi ubu bashobora gusubira mu miryango yabo kuko bakize neza. Dr Mulangu avuga ko ku bantu 681 bakoreweho igeragezwa ry’iyi miti ya Ebola 60% bari kuyikira. Impungenge z’uko iyi ndwara ishobora gukwirakwira zatumye urujya n’uruza hagati y’imijyi ya Goma na Gisenyi rugabanywa cyane n’abategetsi b’impande zombi kugeza ubu. Inkuru ya BBC

title: Kayonza: Umusore yishe mukase amukase umutwe
content: Umusore ufite imyaka 25 bivugwa ko afite uburwayi bwo mu mutwe yaciye umutwe mukase akoresheje umuhoro nyuma yo kumushinja kumuterereza amarozi yatumye agira ibi bibazo. Nkuko tubikesha IGIHE, ibi byabaye mu ijoro ryo ku Cyumweru rishyira kuwa Mbere, mu mudugudu wa Nyarusange, Akagari ka Rubimba mu Murenge wa Kabare. Uyu mugore ngo yari amaze igihe kinini avuga ko azica mukase kuko ngo yamushinjaga kumuroga bikamuviramo kugira uburwayi bwo mu mutwe. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Kabare, Mbarwa Semugeshi, yemereye IGIHE ko uyu musore yishe mukase gusa ngo yahise atabwa muri yombi. Ati “ Ubundi uriya musore asanzwe afite uburwayi bwo mu mutwe, akaba n’ubundi yakundaga kwangiza imitungo y’iwabo akenshi yakundaga kujya mu rutoki agatema insina zose, yakundaga kuvuga ko ibibazo byose afite abitezwa n’uwo mukase ni uko amusanga mu rugo aramutema.” Uyu muyobozi yakomeje avuga ko mu byangombwa uwo musore afite yahawe na muganga bigaragaza ko afite ikibazo cyo mu mutwe ku kigero cya 92% ariko ngo mu bigaragara ni uko yishe mukase yari amaze igihe abipanga ngo kuko nyuma yo kumwica yahise ahunga ariko aza gufatwa n’abaturage. Uyu muyobozi yasabye abaturage kuba maso abo babonye bafitanye amakimbirane bakabimenyesha ubuyobozi kugira ngo bubikurikirane hakiri kare. Kuri ubu Nsanzamahoro yashyikirijwe Urwego rw’Igihugu rw’Ubugenzacyaha, RIB, Sitasiyo ya Kabarondo.

title: Gicumbi: Babiiri bapfuye, harakekwa ubushera banyoye
content: Mu Karere ka Gicumbi mu murenge wa Kaniga, hari abantu babiri bapfuye icyarimwe bikekwa ko bahitanywe n’ubushera bivugwa ko bwahumanye banyoye kuwa Gatandatu, aho bari bagiye mu rugo rw’uwitwa Byiringiro Alain wari waje guhembwa na sebukwe. Abagera kuri 63 ni bo bagaragaje ibimenyetso byo kuribwa mu nda ndetse bakaruka bajyanywa ku Kigo Nderabuzima cya Mulindi. Muri bo batanu byagaragaye ku barembye bari kuvurirwa mu Bitaro bikuru bya Gicumbi, 25 bo bari bakomeje gukurikiranwa aho ku kigo nderabuzima, abagera kuri 30 bo baravuwe barataha kandi bameze neza. Nyiri ugutanga ubwo bushera ari mu maboko y’ubugenzacyaha kugira ngo hakorwe iperereza ku cyateye ihumana ry’ubwo bushera. Src:RBA

title: Abagore baburiwe nyuma y’uko hari uhiye igitsina ari ‘kucyotesha’
content:
Abaganga b’imyanya ndangagitsina y’abagore baraburira abagore n’abakobwa ku byago bashobora kuvana mu buryo buri kwamamara ku isi bwo kotesha igitsina nyuma y’uko hari umugore wo muri Canada wahiye abigerageza. Urugero rwatanzwe ku mugore w’imyaka 62, rutangazwa mu gitangazamakuru ’Journal of Obstetrics and Gynaecology’ muri Canada. Uyu mugore yari afite uburwayi mu gitsina bwitwa ’vaginal prolapse’ akizera ko ubu buryo bita ’vaginal steaming’ buzamukiza bukamurinda kubagwa byari biteganyijwe. Ubu buryo bwo kotesha igitsina, umuntu yicara hejuru y’uruvange rw’ ibyatsi n’amazi ashyushye, buri kugenda burushaho kwamamara no gukoreshwa ahanyuranye ku isi. Mu nzu zitunganya umubiri zizwi nka ’spa’ na ’salons’ ’vigina steaming’ iri kugenda ikenerwa na benshi, kimwe n’ubundi buryo bunyuranye bwo kwita ku myanya y’ibanga. Umwaka ushize, umunyamideri wo muri Amerika witwa Chrissy Teigen akanaba umugore w’umuhanzi w’icyamamare John Legend, yagaragaje ifoto ye ariho yotesha igitsina cye.  face mask / heat pad / vagina steam no I don’t know if any of this works but it can’t hurt right? *vagina dissolves* A post shared by  chrissy teigen (@chrissyteigen) on Jun 18, 2018 at 9:24pm PDT Ifoto Chrissy Teigen yasangije abamukurikira kuri Instagram muri Kamena umwaka ushize arimo akora iyi migenzo Tambuka Instagram ubutumwa bwa chrissyteigenImpera ya socialnetworck ubutumwa bwa chrissyteigen
Inzu zimwe na zimwe za ’spa’ zo mu mahanga zamamaza "V-steaming" zivuga ko ari uburyo bwakoreshejwe kuva na cyera mu mateka mu bihugu byo muri Aziya na Afurika. Bene zo bavuga ko ubu ari uburyo bwo ’gukiza imyanda mibi’ mu gitsina. Abaganga ariko, bavuga ko ubu buryo bushobora guteza akaga, ndetse nta byemezo bya gihanga byerekanye ko bworohereza abaribwa n’imihango cyangwa bufasha abatabyara nk’uko bivugwa. Dr Vanessa Mackay, umuvugizi wa ’Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists’ avuga ko abavuga ko igitsina cy’umugore/umukobwa gikenera ubuvuzi nk’ubu ari nk’abaca umugani. Avuga ko ari byiza kandi bihagije gusukura igitsina inyuma gusa n’isabune isanzwe. Mu itangazo basohoye, agira ati: "Igitsina ubwacyo kiba kifitemo udukoko (bacteria) tw’ingirakamaro tuberaho kukirinda". Kotesha igitsina bishobora kugira ingaruka kuri ubu buryo karemano bw’udukoko n’igipimo cya pH bigatera gututubikana, indwara n’uburibwe, bishobora no gutwika uduhu tworoshye dukikije igitsina(vulva)". Hashize iminsi micye abaganga banyuranye babwira abantu inkuru y’uriya mugore kugira ngo baburire ku byago bahurira nabyo mu kotesha igitsina. Uyu mugore wemeye ko inkuru ye ivugwa, mu gihe cy’iminota 20 yicaye hejuru y’uru ruvange rushyushye yotesha igitsina cye mu minsi ibiri yikurikiranya, nyuma ajya kwa muganga ahakirirwa indembe kubera uburibwe n’ibikomere mu gitsina. Yagize ubushye bwo ku kiciro cya kabiri, bikerereza kubagwa yari kuzakorerwa kugirango abanze akire. Abaganga bavuga ko buriya buryo bwo kotesha igitsina bugenda bwamamazwa n’abantu kuri Internet cyangwa kububwira abandi ku magambo, benshi bakabwemera. Mu nyandiko ya bariya baganga, bavuga ko ubuvuzi busanzwe butanga imiti ku bagira ikibazo mu myanya y’ibanga aho kuyotesha. Source: BBC Gahuza

title: Nyabihu: Hadutse uburwayi bufata abanyeshuri bakagwa hasi bakabyukana imbaraga zidasanzwe
content: Mu Rwunge rw’amashuri rwa Rega ruherereye mu Murenge wa Bigogwe, Akarere ka Nyabihu, hadutse uburwayi budasanzwe bufata abanyeshuri bagahita bagwa hasi bagarura ubwenge bagahagurukana imbaraga nyinshi. Nkuko tubikesha IGIHE, ubu burwayi bwatangiye kugaragara muri iki kigo cya GS Rega ku wa Gatatu tariki ya 07 Kanama 2019 ubwo bwafataga abana babiri b’abakobwa biga mu mwaka wa Gatanu w’amashuri abanza. Iki kinyamakuru cyatangaje ko amakuru akigeraho yemeza ko iyi indwara iyo imaze gufata abanyeshuri bahita batabaza bakagwa hasi nyuma baza guhaguruka bagahugurukana imbaraga nyinshi cyane. Aya makuru akimenyekana ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Nyabihu gaherereyemo iki kigo n’inzobere z’abaganga ndetse n’abajyanama b’ubuzima bagakoreramo, bahise bajya kureba iby’iyi ndwara idasanzwe yadutse muri iki kigo. Umuyobozi wungirije w’Akarere ka Nyabihu Ushinzwe Imibereho myiza y’abaturage, Simpenzwe Pascal, yabwiye IGIHE ko iyi ndwara irimo gufata abanyeshuri nyuma y’iminota 30 bagahagurukana imbaraga zidasanzwe. Yagize ati “Nibyo n’ubu turi kuvugana niho ndi. Bari gufatwa batabaza bakagagara bagatera imigeri ariko nyuma y’iminota 30 bakongera bagasubira mu ishuri. Ubu turi hamwe n’abaganga b’ibitaro bya Shyira n’abajyanama b’ubuzima.” Yakomeje agira ati “N’ubu tukihagera hari abo ihise ifata ariko biri kugaragara ko ari za ndwara z’imitekerereze.” Yasabye ababyeyi n’abarimu kuba hafi y’abana babo bakamenya ibindi bibazo bafite mu rwego rwo gukomeza gukurikirana ubuzima bwabo.

title: Ebola: Abaganga batatu bakekwaho kwicisha mugenzi wabo muri RDC batawe muri yombi
content:
Abaganga batatu batawe muri yombi muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo bashinjwa kuba inyuma y’urupfu rw’umuganga wakoreraga Ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku buzima (OMS). Uyu muganga wakomokaga muri Cameroun witwaga Richard Mouzoko yishwe arashwe mu gitero cyagabwe mu kwezi kwa Mata uyu mwaka ku bitaro bya Butembo mu burasirazuba bw’uyu mujyi ahari agace kihariye kavurirwamo icyorezo cya Ebola. Aba baganga batatu bafashwe bakurikiranyweho ’iterabwoba n’ubufatanyacyaha mu kwica’ nkuko byatangajwe n’umushinjacyaha wa gisirikare, lieutenant-colonel Jean-Baptiste Kumbu ubwo yaganiraga na AFP. Uyu mushinjacyaha yavuze ko inyeshyamba zateye aho bavurira harimo n’ibitaro bya Butembo, babajijwe maze bagaragaza ko hari abaganga bane bari bafatanyije mu itegurwa ry’ibi bitero. Lieutenant-colonel Jean-Baptiste Kumbu yakomeje avuga ko umuganga wa kane yatorotse kugeza na n’ubu akaba atarafatwa gusa ntiyatanze amakuru yisumbuyeho. Ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku buzima (OMS) ryatangaje ko Dr Mouzoko yari yoherejwe mu itsinda ry’abaganga kugira ngo afashe mu guhangana n’icyorezo cya Ebola cyatangiye muri Kanama umwaka ushize muri Kivu y’Amajyaruguru (Nord-Kivu). Mu ibaruwa bandikiye Meya wa Butembo, itsinda rihagarariye abaganga b’imbere mu gihugu bavuze ko bitari bikwiye ko aba baganga batabwa muri yombi kuko ku bwabo babona bihungabanya ibikorwa by’ubuvuzi by’ingenzi muri ako gace. Iri tsinda ryakomezaga rivuga ko aba baganga bari bakwiye kurekurwa by’agateganyo bakaba batanze ingwate, bavuga ko nibakomeza gufungwa mu masaha 48 nabo bahita bigaragambya. Ariko umushinjacyaha wa gisirikare yanze ubusabe bwabo agaragaza ko bidashoboka ko yakubahiriza ibyo basaba. Kugeza ubu abarenga 1800 bamaze guhitanwa na Ebola kuva yakongera kwaduka mu burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo.
Ibitero byibasira abakozi b’ubuzima bigenda bigira ingaruka ndetse bigafata intera, aho hamaze kwicwa barindwi naho abarenga 50 bakaba bamaze kuhakomerekera. Lt-Col Kumbu yatangaje ko abagera kuri 54 bamaze gutabwa muri yombi bakurikiranyweho ibitero byibasira ibigo bikurikiranirwamo icyorezo cya Ebola.

title: Burundi: Abantu 1800 bamaze guhitanwa na malaria mu 2019
content: Ubutegetsi bw’u Burundi bwatangaje ko kuva mu kwezi kwa mbere uyu mwaka abantu miliyoni 4,3 barwaye malaria muri bo igahitana 1400, ariko ngo ntabwo iraba icyorezo, gusa iyi mibare ihabanye n’iyagaragajwe n’Ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku buzima (OMS). Nkuko inkuru dukesha BBC Gahuza ibivuga, muri iki cyumweru, ishami rya ONU rishinzwe ubutabazi ryatangaje ko mu Burundi malaria imaze guhitana abantu 1800 kuva uyu mwaka utangiye, ikavuga ko iyi mibare irenze ikigero cy’uko indwara yitwa icyorezo. Ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku buzima (OMS) naryo ryemeza ko kuva mu cyumweru cya mbere cy’ukwezi kwa mbere kugera mu mpera y’ukwezi gushize kwa karindwi, abantu barenga miliyoni eshanu mu Burundi barwaye malaria - ni hafi 1/2 cy’abatuye iki gihugu. Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru, Minisitiri w’ubuzima Dr Thaddée Ndikumana yasobanuye ko malaria mu Burundi ubu atari icyorezo agereranyije n’imibare yo mu 2017 ubwo iyi ndwara ubutegetsi bwemezaga ko yabaye icyorezo. Dr Ndikumana yavuze ko mu 2017 mu Burundi abandi miliyoni 4,9 barwaye malaria ikica abantu 4,300 mu mezi atandatu, naho kugeza ubu muri uyu mwaka abayirwaye ari miliyoni 4,3 naho abo yishe ari 1,400, nkuko bivugwa n’ikinyamakuru Nawe cyo mu Burundi. Iyo indwara itangajwe nk’icyorezo mu gihugu hafatwa ingamba zikomeye kandi zidasanzwe mu kuyirwanya. Indwara ya Ebola iheruka gutangazwa nk’icyorezo gihangayikishije isi, nubwo ivugwa mu burasirazuba bwa Kongo aho imaze guhitana abarenga 1800 kuva mu kwezi kwa munani umwaka ushize.

title: Ku myaka 107, arahamya ko kudashaka ari ibanga ryo kurama
content:
Louise Singore yizihije isabukuru y’imyaka 107 y’amavuko mu cyumweru gishize. Uyu mukecuru ugenda neza adafite inkoni cyangwa akagare, yakorewe ibirori ndetse anahishura ibanga ryamufashije kurama. "Ntekereza ko ibanga ryo kurama kwanjye ari uko ntigeze nshaka umugabo. Igihamya nuko murumuna wanjye ahora ansubiriramo ko yicuza impamvu yashatse." Nubwo ashaje kandi akaba nta rukundo rw’umugabo yigeze, Louise ahamya ko ubuzima butamubihiye ndetse n’ubu akibasha kwinezeza. Ati "Nkora imyitozo ngororamubiri ndetse rimwe na rimwe ndabyina. Nyuma yo gufata amafunguro yo ku manywa, nyuma ya saa sita nkina umukino wa Bingo."

 Nubwo ashaje, Louise aracyafite ubuzima buzima  Ibi ntibivugwa na Louise gusa kandi, kuko byemezwa na Jessie Gallan,  umukecuru w’umyaka 109 ukomoka muri Ecosse. Yagize ati "Ntabwo nigeze nshaka. Tugomba kugendera kure abagabo kuko batuzanira ingaruka nyinshi kurusha inyungu." Nubwo aba bakecuru batanga kuba ingaragu nk’ibanga ryo kurama, ntibabyumva kimwe na Dr Valter D. Longo, umuyobozi w’ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi k’uburambe muri Kaminuza ya California, we avuga ko nta muti umwe wihariye umuntu yakoresha ngo azamare imyaka 100. Ati "Uzaganirize abasaza n’abakecuru 100, uzumva inkuru 100 zitandukanye."

title: Umupaka wa Rubavu na Goma uhuza u Rwanda na RDC wafunzwe kubera Ebola
content:
Nyuma y’umunsi umwe umuntu wa kabiri yishwe na Ebola mu mujyi wa Goma uri mu burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demkarasi ya Congo ukaba uhana imbibi n’umujyi wa Rubavu mu Ntara y’Uburengerazuba bw’u Rwanda, kuri ubu imipaka yahuzaga iyi mijyi yafunzwe. Ni imipaka ibiri ’Grande barriere’ na ’Petite barriere’ isanzwe iza mu ya mbere muri Afurika mu rujya n’uruza rw’ibintu n’abantu yafunzwe mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 01 Kanama 2019. Abaturage basanzwe bakora akazi kabo ka buri munsi bibasabye kwambukiranya iyi mapaka batunguwe no gusanga muri iki gitondo yafunzwe. N’ubwo kugeza ubu ibihugu byombi ntacyo biratangaza ku ifungwa ry’iyi mipaka, nta gushidikanya ko impamvu ari impungenge y’iki cyorezo cya Ebola cyatangiye gushinga imizi i Goma umujyi uhahirana cyane n’uwa Rubavu aho abaturage b’ibihugu byombi baba banyuranamo bashaka imibereho.

Goma ni umurwa mukuru wa Kivu y’Amajyaruguru (Nord-Kivu), ikaba ihana imbibi n’akarere ka Rubavu Ku itariki ya 17 Nyakanga 2019 ni bwo umuntu wa mbere yapfuye azize Ebola I Goma, uyu akaba yari umugabo w’umupasiteri, waje gukurikirwa n’undi wapfuye kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 31 Nyakanga 2019 bivugwa ko we yakoraga akazi ko gucukura amabuye y’agaciro, ndetse ubu nubwo bitaremezwa neza hari amakuru avuga ko i Goma haba hamaze kugaragara n’umurwayi wa gatatu. Nyuma y’umwaka umwe Ebola yongeye kugaragara mu burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Umuryango Mpuzamahanga wita ku Buzima (OMS) utangaza ko abarenga 1700 bamaze guhitanwa n’iki cyorezo yanavuze ko gihangayikishije isi muri iki gihe.

title: RDC: Umurwayi wa kabiri wagaragaweho Ebola i Goma, yapfuye
content: Nyuma y’uko ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 30 Nyakanga 2019, i Goma hagaragaye umurwayi wa kabiri wanduye icyorezo cya Ebola, mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatatu byatangajwe ko yapfuye. Ni amakuru yahamijwe na Porofeseri Jean Jacques Muyembe, uyobora ikipe y’ubutabazi bwa Ebola ya guverinoma ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Uyu nyakwigendera yari amaze ibyumweru bibiri ageze i Goma aho yari aturutse i Turi aho yakoraga ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro. Yabanje kujyanwa kuvurirwa i Kiziba mu nkengero za Goma ku ya 13 Nyakanga , ariko nyuma yaho gato atangira kugaragaza ibimenyetso byo kuvirira bya Ebola ndetse ubwo bamupimaga kuri uyu wa Kabiri basanga yaranduye. Itangazwa ry’urupfu rwe ryongeye gutera impungenge n’ubwoba abatuye i Goma muri uyu mujyi munini wo mu burasirazuba bwa Congo uhana imbibi n’umujyi wa Rubavu mu Burengerazuba bw’u Rwanda. Ikipe z’ubutabazi zirimo ziragerageza gushaka abantu bose baba baragize aho bahurira n’uyu murwayi upfuye nyuma y’undi mu pasiteri nawe uherutse guhitanwa na Ebola i Goma, ngo bubahe inkingo banitabweho. Src:BBC Afrique

title: Basize isomo ry’urukundo: Bapfuye ku munsi umwe, nyuma y’imyaka 71 bashyingiranwe
content:
Iyi ntabwo ari inkuru ishyira imbere cyane urupfu, ahubwo irazirikana inkuru nziza n’isomo ry’ubuzima n’urukundo mu isi y’iki gihe benshi bemeza ko yahindutse, imibanire mu bantu n’urukundo hagati y’abashakanye bikangirika cyane. Herbert Delaigle wari ufite imyaka 94 y’amavuko n’umugore we Marilyn Frances DeLaigle wari ufite imyaka 88 y’amavuko, bashizemo umwuka mu gihe cy’intera y’amasaha 12 gusa hagati yabo maze basiga inkuru y’urukundo ruhamye dore ko bari bamaze imyaka 71 yose barushinganye.

Basigiye isi inkuru nziza y’urukundo Uyu musaza n’umukecuru bari batuye Georgie, bapfuye ku wa Gatanu ushize tariki ya 12 Nyakanga. Basize abana batandatu, abuzukuru 16 n’abuzukuruza 25 ndetse n’ubuvivi butatu. “Birashimishije cyane uburyo babanye imyaka 71 none ubu bakaba bari kumwe mu ijuru”, umuryango wabo mu kubabika mu itangazo bahaye WRDW. Marilyn Frances na Herbert bahuriye mu gace ka Waynesboro muri Georgia ho muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ubwo yari afite imyaka 16 gusa mu gihe uwaje kumubera umugabo yari afite imyaka 22. Marilyn Frances DeLaigle yakoraga muri resitora ubwo Herbert yamurabukagwa akamubenguka akamusaba ko basohoka, maze nyuma y’umwaka umwe basohokanye bwa mbere, bararushinga. "Frances yakoraga mu ka resitora (café) twari dufite muri Waynesboro bitaga White Way Café (…) nakomeje kumwitegereza uko yinjiraga asohoka, maze muhanga amaso. Nyuma nishyizemo akanyabugabo ndagenda musaba niba yanyemerera igihe kimwe tukazasohokana.", Herbert mu 2018 ubwo yaganiraga na WRDW yari yabasuye ubwo bizihizaga imyaka 70 bamaze babana.

Ubwo bizihizaga imyaka 70 bamaranye basuwe na WRDW-TV ibakorera ikiganiro kihariye Muri iki kiganiro cyo mu 2018, Herbert yahishuye ko bwa mbere basohokana bagiye kureba filime ari nabwo uyu musore wari wamaze gukunda bihebuje uyu mukobwa yamubajije niba yamwemerera akamubera umugabo, undi abyemera atazuyaje. Frances avuga ko byamurenze kumva agiye kuba umugore wa Herbert Delaigle, ariko yari afite impungenge ko bitazaba. Aganira na WRDW yagize ati "Iteka yarakerererwaga." Ku munsi w’ubukwe habuze gato ngo pasiteri yange kubasezeranya kuko bari bakerereweho hafi isaha kugera ku rusengero nkuko Herbert yabitangaje, ariko nyuma yo kugerageza kumwinginga aza kubemerera kubashyingiranya.

Herbert na Frances bakundanye imyaka 72 ubariyemo n’umwaka bamaze bateretana Herbert yabaye umusirikare wa Amerika mu gihe cy’imyaka 22. Yarwanye urugamba rwo muri Koreya na Vietnam ndetse banabaye imyaka 6 mu Budage ubwo yari mu rugamba rw’intambara ya kabiri y’isi. Frances yavuze ko ’igihe kinini yakundaga (umugabo we) kuba ari ku rugamba, ariko iyo yabaga ari mu rugo yamusetsaga cyane akamushimisha ndetse bagakunda gufatana ibiganza’. Ubwo bizihizaga isabukuru y’imyaka 70 ishize babana, babajijwe ibanga ryatumye bakundaga cyane ndetse urukundo rwabo rukaramba. Frances yagize ati "Iteka yagaragazaga (umugabo we) ubwuzu bw’urukundo, kwihangana n’umutima mwiza." Herbert we mu magambo make yagize ati ibanga ni "garagaza urukundo rwawe", maze Frances yongeraho ati "kandi mubane hafi."

Bakundaga gufatana mu kiganza Herbert yapfuye saa munani n’iminota 20 zo mu ijoro rishyira igitondo (2:20 a.m.) naho Frances aramukurikira nyuma y’amasaha 12 kuko yapfuye saa munani n’iminota 20 zo ku mugoroba (2:20 p.m.).
 Umwe mu bahungu babo yavuze ko nyina yari aryamye ku buriri iruhande rwa se ubwo yapfaga, ngo ubwo bazaga gufata se, imihumekere ya nyina yarahindutse, atangira guhumeka nabi, aranatitira cyane nk’aho yamenye ko umugabo we yapfuye. Abahanga mu by’ubuzima bagaragaza ko mu gihe umwe mu bashakanye yitabye Imana nyuma y’urupfu rw’uwo bashakanye cyangwa se iyo umuntu apfuye nyuma yo gupfusha inshuti ye magara akenshi biba bitewe n’umutima umenetse unanirwa kwihanganira kubura uwo wakundaga. Ngo imvamutima zikomeye zishobora guca intege umutima bigatuma uhagarara mu buryo butunguranye.

title: RDC: Wa mu pasiteri wanduye Ebola wagaragaye i Goma, byarangiye apfuye
content: Nyuma y’uko i Goma mu murwa mukuru w’Intara ya Nord-Kivu, umujyi uhana imbibi n’akarere ka Rubavu mu Ntara y’Uburengerazuba bw’u Rwanda, hagaragaye umuntu wa mbere udwaye Ebola, ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kabiri byatangajwe ko yapfuye. Mu ijoro ryo ku Cyumweru ni bwo uyu murwayi yagaragaye maze ku wa Mbere abayobozi bafata icyemezo cyo kumwohereza i Butembo mu mujyi yaturutsemo. Uyu murwayi yapfiriye mu mbagukiragutabara (ambulance) yari imujyanye i Butembo kamwe mu duce iki cyorezo cya Ebola cyashinzemo imizi mu burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Mu nzira agenda nibwo uyu murwayi yaje gushiramo umwuka nkuko byemejwe na Sylvain Kanyamanda uyobora umujyi wa Butembo. Uyu nyakwigendera ni umugabo w’umupasiteri wanduye Ebola mu gihe yasengeraga abayoboke i Butembo abarambitseho ibiganza. Ibimenyetso bya mbere byatangiye kugaragara mu cyumweru gishize, ariko akomeza kuvurirwa mu rugo n’umuganga. Ubwo yageraga i Goma muri iyi weekend ishize, isuzuma ryo muri laboratwari ni ryo ryemeje ko uyu mupasiteri yanduye virus ya Ebola. Mbere y’uko hagaragara uyu muntu wa mbere wanduye Ebola i Goma, iyi ndwara byari byagaragajwe ko iri mu bilometero bisaga ijana mu majyaruguru mu gace ka Butembo, Beni  hamwe na Ituri yari iri ku rugero rwo hasi. Iki cyorezo ni ku nshuro ya kabiri kibasiye iki gihugu  ndetse kikaba icya mbere kimaze guhitana benshi aho kugeza magingo aya abarenga 1600 bamaze guhitanwa nacyo mu gihe abagore, abagabo n’abana barenga 2500 bamaze kwandura iki cyorezo kuva cyagaragara, ubu hashize umwaka.

title: Goma: Bwa mbere hagaragaye umurwayi wa Ebola
content: Mu Burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo i Goma, umujyi uhana imbibi n’akarere ka Rubavu mu Ntara y’Uburengerazuba bw’u Rwanda, hagaragaye umuntu udwaye Ebola. Ni amakuru yahamijwe na Minisiteri y’Ubuzima muri iki gihugu ndetse na OMS nyuma y’isuzuma rya laboratwari. Uyu murwayi ni umupasiteri w’imyaka 46 wageze muri aka gace mu gitondo cyo kuri iki Cyumweru cyashize avuye ahitwa Butembo, kamwe mu duce twashegeshwe n’iyi ndwara. Minisiteri y’Ubuzima muri RDC yasabye abaturage gukomeza kuba maso no kurangwa n’ituze. Ubuyobozi kandi bwavuze ko ibyago byo kuba iyi ndwara yakwirakwira cyane muri uyu mujyi wa Goma biri hasi cyane kuko uyu murwayo yabonywe byihuse ndetse n’abandi bagenzi 18 bari kumwe muri bus bahise bamenyekana ndetse baratangira gukurikiranwa kuva kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 15 Nyakanga 2019 nkuko itangazo rya Minisiteri y’Ubuzima yabishimangiye mu itangazo yashyize hanze.

title: Uganda: Mzee Mukwano nyiri ’Mukwano Group of Companies’ yapfuye
content:
Amirali Karmali Amooti uzwi cyane ku izina rya Mzee Mukwano yapfuye mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa gatatu, itangazamakuru muri Uganda rivuga ko ari amakuru yemezwa n’abo mu muryango we. Mukwano yari atuye mu gace ka Kololo ari naho bivugwa ko yaguye, mu rugo rwe. Yari umusaza wavukiye muri Uganda mu myaka ya 1930. Mzee Mukwano, ni se wa Alykhan Karmali, umugabo ubu uyoboye ibikorwa by’ubushabitsi by’umuryango wa Mukwano birimo ubwubatsi, amabanki, ubwikorezi n’inganda. Ali Mohamed Karmari, se w’uyu wapfuye, umunyaziya wageze muri Uganda mu 1904 ajya gutura ahitwa Fort Portal mu burengerazuba bwa Uganda. Kubera imibanire ye n’abo yahasanze bamuhimbye ’Mukwano’ mu kigande, bivuga Inshuti mu Kirundi n’ikinyarwanda.

Karmali (wicaye mu ntebe) ubwo aheruka gufotorwa ari kumwe n’abandi bahagarariye Diaspora y’Abahinde Mu myaka ya 1960 yatangiye ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi yitiriye iri zina, biyoborwa n’umuhungu we Amirali Karmali Amooti (Mzee Mukwano) nk’uko bivugwa mu mateka y’uyu muryango. Inganda za Mukwano zaramenyekanye kubera ibicuruzwa byazo, nk’amazi, amavuta, amazi, amasabune n’ibindi byifashishwa mu buzima busanzwe bw’abantu mu bihugu byo mu karere. Mukwano Group of Companies ni umwe mu bashoramari bakomeye muri aka karere, mu kwezi kwa 12 umwaka ushize yaguze Ubumwe Grand Hotel muri cyamunara i Kigali kuri miliyoni zirenga 34 z’amadorari. Mu mwaka ushize, ikinyamakuru Forbes cyanditse ko uyu mukambwe Alykhan Karmali, umuhungu wa Mzee Mukwano, ari ku mwanya wa gatatu mu bakire 10 ba mbere muri Uganda n’umutungo ubarirwa kuri miliyoni 700 z’amadorari. Inkuru ya BBC Gahuza

title: Muhanga: Umupolisi witeguraga ubukwe, yagonzwe n’imodoka yitaba Imana
content: Imodoka ya Coaster yagonganye na moto yari iriho umupolisi witwa AIP Ndayisaba Alexis ubwo yari igeze hafi y’Ibiro by’Akarere ka Muhanga ahita ahasiga ubuzima. Nkuko inkuru dukesha IGIHE ibivuga, iyi mpanuka yabaye ku mugoroba w’ejo ku wa Kabiri tariki ya 9 Nyakanga 2019. Umuvugizi wa Polisi ishami rishinzwe umutekano wo mu muhanda, SSP Ndushabandi Jean Marie Vianney, yemeje iby’iyi mpanuka. Ati “ Nibyo impanuka yabaye, ni umupolisi wari utwaye moto avuye ku kazi agongana na Coaster ya Horizon arakomereka bamujyana kwa muganga aba ariho apfira.” Meya w’Akarere ka Muhanga, Uwamariya Beatrice, yabwiye IGIHE ko umurambo wa AIP Ndayisaba uri mu buruhukiro bw’ibitaro bya Kabgayi. Hari amakuru avuga ko uyu mupolisi yari mu myiteguro yo gushinga urugo, ndetse ko ubukwe bwari buteganyijwe muri Nzeri uyu mwaka.

title: Ibanga ry’umunezero w’abashakanye mu nama za Michelle Obama
content:
Michelle na Barack Obama, ni umwe mu miryango yishimiwe cyane ubwo yari ituye muri ’White House’, benshi bakaba babafata nk’urugero rwiza rw’urugo rwiza. Uyu mugore w’uwahoze ari Perezida wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, yafashe umwanya wo gutanga inama ku ngo z’uyu munsi, avuga ibanga rye kugira ngo we na Barack bagire urugo rwiza. Ati "Urugo ni amahitamo ya buri munsi. Ntabwo dushinga urugo kuko byoroshye, tubikora kuko tubifitiye icyizere. Kuko twizeranye."

 Barck na Michelle Obama bamaze imyaka 27 barushinze  Aya mahitamo yavuze kandi, ngo ahera ku guhitamo uwo muzarushingana ubwe, aho ahamya ko uwo uhitamo agomba kuba uwo mureshya. ati "Dore impamvu ari ngombwa gushakana n’uwo mureshya, kubana n’ubifuriza ko mugera kure mu buzima kimwe na we. Kureshya ntigusuzumirwa ku mutungo ahubwo ku ndangagaciro zanyu mwembi." Michelle yagereranyije urugo n’ikipe aho yagereranyije Barack Obama n’umukinnyi bakinira ikipe imwe mu kibuga. Ati "Niba dushaka gutsinda umukino hamwe, agomba kuba akomeye kandi akemera ko nanjye nkomeye. Sinkeneye umukinnyi w’umunyantegenke na we ni uko."

 Intsinzi y’umwe ibanezeza bombi kimwe  Michelle na Barack barushinze mu mwaka wa 1992, bakaba barabaye muri ’White House’ guhera ku itariki ya 20 Mutarama, 2009 kugeza ku ya 20 Mutarama, 2017. Bafitanye abana 2 b’abakobwa.




  Src:Le Monde

title: Yifashishije Bibiliya Ange Kagame yavuze uko yiyumva nyuma y’ubukwe bwe
content:
Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, tariki ya 5 Nyakanga, 2019 nibwo Ange Kagame yambikanye iy’urudashira n’umukunzi we  Bertrand Ndengeyingoma bari bamaze amezi 6 bakoze imihango yo gusaba no gukwa. Ubu bukwe bwabereye mu Mujyi wa Kigali aho abatumiwe bakiriwe muri  Intare Conference Centre mu karere ka Gasabo, maze umukobwa umwe rukumbi wa Perezida Kagame ataha mu rugo rw’uwamukunze na we akamukunda. Nubwo nta mafoto y’ubu bukwe yagiye ahagaragara, mu ijoro ryo kuri iki Cyumweru, abicishije kuri Twitter ye, yifashishije Bibiliya abwira isi yose uko yiyumva nyuma yo kuba ku mugaragaro umugore wa Ndengeyingona. Akoresheje amagambo aboneka mu Indirimbo ya Salomo 3:4, ahanditse hati "Tugitandukana gato, Mbona uwo umutima wanjye ukunda. Ndamufata nanga kumurekura, Kugeza ubwo namugejeje mu nzu ya mama, Mu cyumba cy’uwambyaye" Yafasheho uyu murongo ugira uti "Nabonye uwo umutima wanjye ukunda", yongeraho umutima n’impeta, hanyuma biza biherekeje ifoto ye n’umugabo we mu bukwe.
 Nyuma y’igihe gito, Bertrand na we yahise asangiza ubu butumwa kuri twitter ye (retweet). Ku itariki ya 28 Ukuboza, 2018 nibwo Ndengeyingoma yasabye anakwa Ange Kagame.

title: Ubushakashatsi: Abagabo baryama kare bagira intanga nziza
content: Ubushakashatsi bushya bwa kaminuza ya Aarhus yo muri Danemark bwatangarijwe muri The Independent bwagaragaje ko abagabo baryama mbere ya saa yine n’igice z’ijoro (22hh30) baba bagira intanga (sperme) nziza inshuro enye kurusha abaryama nyuma yaho. Nkuko abashakashatsi babigaragaje, abagabo baryama byibuze amasaha umunani mu ijoro nibo bahabwa amahirwe yo kugira intanga nzima kandi zifite ubuzima bwiza kurusha abaryama amasaha ari munsi y’arindwi mu ijoro. Kuryama kare kandi bihagije Ubu bushakashatsi bwibanze ku kamenyero ko kuryama ku bagabo bagera ku ijana baganaga ibitaro byita ku burumbuke no kubona urubyayo muri Denemark, aho 48 muribo bari bafite intanga zimeze neza naho 56 bafite izidatunganye. Abagabo baryama mbere ya saa yine n’igice z’umugoroba (22h30) bagaragaje ko baba bafite amahirwe yikubye inshuro enye yo kugira intanga nzima ugereranyije n’ababa bakiri maso nyuma ya saa tanu n’igiche (23h30). Abahanga bemeza ko ibyavuye muri ubu bushakashatsi , bigaragaza ko abifuza urubyaro bagombye kwirinda ibibarangaza byababuza kuryama neza mu ijoro, nko gukoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga cyangwa kureba filime. Ibitotsi bigira umumaro ukomeye mu gushyira ku murongo imisemburo ndetse n’umunaniro ukabije wagira ingaruka ku myororokere n’uburumbuke.  Umunaniro ugendanye no kubura ibitotsi ushobora gutera ibibazo ku bwirinzi bw’umubiri ndetse bikaba byanakwangiriza intanga, nk’uko aba bashakashatsi babyemeza.

title: Gicumbi: Umukecuru w’imyaka 78 arakekwaho kwica umugabo we w’imyaka 85
content: Mporwiki Philomene w’imyaka 78 y’amavuko wo mu Murenge wa Mukarange mu Karere ka Gicumbi, yatawe muri yombi akekwaho kwica umugabo we w’imyaka 85 witwa Gatarayiha Damascene. Bivugwa ko uyu mukecuru n’umugabo we bose bari banyoye inzoga, baza gushyamirana, umugore asunika umugabo akubita umutwe hasi. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Akagari ka Mutarama, Mukantibiringirwa Seraphine, yatangarije IGIHE dukesha iyi nkuru ko uyu musaza yapfuye mu ijoro ryo ku wa Mbere. Ati “Niko bimeze koko uwo musaza yari yiriwe ahantu ari kunywa inzoga ariko n’umugore we ari kuzinywera ahandi, noneho umugore aza gutaha mbere, umugabo we aje bagirana amakimbirane bararwana.” Yongeyeho ko uyu mukecuru yaje gusunika umugabo we agakubita umutwe ku ibuye riri mu mbuga iwabo, ava amaraso menshi, bamujyanye kwa muganga apfira mu nzira. Yakomeje avuga ko uyu mukecuru n’umugabo we bakundaga kugirana amakimbirane, anashimangira ko babanaga n’abuzukuru babo gusa. Uyu muyobozi yongeyeho ko uyu mukecuru yahise atabwa muri yombi, aho afungiye kuri stasiyo ya polisi ya Byumba mu gihe iperereza rikomeje, mu gihe nyakwigendera ari bushyingurwe saa munani z’amanywa yo kuri uyu wa Kabiri.

title: Akazi ukora wicaye hamwe kagira ingaruka nyinshi mbi ku buzima. Menya icyo wakora
content: Gukora umuntu yicaye amasaha umunani ku munsi bigira ingaruka zikomeye cyane ku buzima bw’umuntu. Nyamara aya niyo masaha y’akazi ya benshi mu bakozi, nyuma y’uko ikoranabuhanga ryinjiye mu mikorere y’abantu. Nubwo muri iki gihe kwicara no guhama hamwe byamaze kwinjira mu buzima  bwa buri munsi bwa muntu, siko byahoze hambere kuko umuntu yatungwaga n’ibyo yahize ndetse n’ibyo yasaruye, ibi bikaba byaratumaga umuntu ataguma hamwe ahubwo agahora agenda ndetse agakoresha ibice by’umubiri we byose mu kazi ke ka buri munsi. Uku gukora kwa muntu, yifashishije ibice byose by’umubiri, byagiraga icyo bifasha ku mikorere y’umubiri we. Uyu munsi, umuntu iyo afite urugendo, atangira gutekereza ku buryo akoresha bw’urugendo; ese ndatega imodoka, moto, igare se cyangwa ndagenda n’amaguru? Ni bake cyane bahitamo ubu buryo bwa nyuma. Iyo urugendo rurengeje iminota 30, buri wese ahita ashakisha ikinyabiziga cyamufasha kugerayo vuba. Ikirenze kuri ibyo benshi bava mu modoka bahita binjira mu biro aho bamara amasaha menshi mu kazi kadakoresha ingufu na nke, ahubwo bakamara umwanya bakoresha ubwonko gusa, mu gihe ibindi bice by’umubiri bisa n’ibisinziriye. Mu gutaha nabwo abantu barongera bagakoresha ibinyabiziga ndetse bagera no mu rugo bakaruhukira mu ntebe, bamwe imbere ya televiziyo abandi mu bindi bitandukanye ariko bidatuma bagira igice na kimwe cy’umubiri gikora. Muri iyi minsi indwara z’umutima, imitsi, diyabete, kanseri n’izindi zitandukanye zigenda ziyongera mu bantu ari nako imyaka yo kubaho ku muntu igenda igabanuka. Kubera izi mpamvu, abaganga bagira abantu inama yo gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri itandukanye no kurya ibyo kurya bigabanya ibyago byo kurwara indwara zitandukanye. Nubwo imyitozo ngororamubiri igira icyo ifasha, burya ngo ntigera ku rugero rw’imirimo ba sogokuruza bacu bakoraga, ndetse rwose abahanga mu by’ubuzima bagira abantu inama yo kugerageza gushakisha uburyo bwose bwo gukoresha ibice by’umubiri atari mu myitozo gusa. Ingero zitangwa ni nko kuva ku kazi n’amaguru buri munsi, gufasha mu mirimo yo mu rugo kandi nayo igakorwa mu buryo budusaba gukoresha umubiri, nko gukubura ukoresheje umweyo ugusaba kunama, gukoropa ukoresheje itorosho n’amaboko gusa, guteka nta ntebe ikuri hafi, gukina n’abana n’ibindi nk’ibyo.

title: Afurika y’Epfo: Bakura amenyo y’imbere ngo biyongerere ubwiza n’igikundiro
content:
Cap, muri Afurika y’Epfo, mu bato n’abakuru hagezweho icyitwa ’Passion gap’ aho ngo umuntu wifuza kuba mwiza ndetse agakundwa, yikurisha amenyo y’imbere. Iyo usubiye inyuma mu mateka, uyu wari umuco w’abacakara bo hambere muri Afurika y’Epfo, babaga baratururutse mu bindi bihugu bya Afurika, hanyuma bagakura amenyo yabo y’imbere kugira ngo babashe kumenyana.

 Hari ababikorera kubahiriza umuco wa kera  Nyuma uyu muco wagiye ukomeza gukorwa n’ababakomokagaho, barimo abo babaga barabyaranye n’abazungu (metis) bamwe bakabikora bagira ngo bubahirize uyu muco wa basekuruza ariko abandi bakabikora bagira ngo bisanishe n’ibigezweho.

 Abasore b’ingimbo bakuramo amenyo yabo kugira ngo bakurure inkumi  "Nayikuriyemo kugira ngendane n’ibigezweho. Byarambabaje cyane ariko uburibwe bwabyo simbwicuza. Ubu ndasa n’abagezweho. Sogokuru na we yarabikoze kugira ngo ajye abasha kuvugiriza cyane mu gihe yagiye mu nyanja."- Samuel w’imyaka 31 Wedaad, umubyeyi w’umwana umwe, na we yakuyemo amenyo ye acyiga mu mashuri yisumbuye kandi ngo ntabyicuza kuko ngo bituma yumva arushijeho kuba mwiza. "Nakuyemo amenyo yanjye 6 y’imbere. Kuva ubwo sinigeze nambara ayasimbura. Mu by’ukuri ndabikunda, nabikoze kuko bigezweho hano. Bituma umuntu yumva ari mwiza kurushaho kandi akunzwe kurushaho."

 Gukuramo amenyo ngo bituma barushaho gukundwa  Abakuramo aya menyo akenshi bahita bagura andi ayasimbura bambara rimwe na rimwe, bitewe n’aho bagiye, nko ku ishuri cyangwa mu kazi ariko bakagira n’igihe cyo kugenda batayashyizemo. Nubwo hari ababikorera kubaha amateka, abandi bakabikora ngo bagendane n’ibigezweho, abandi bahamya ko bituma abakundana barushaho kuryoherwa mu gihe basomana.

title: Uganda: Ebola yahitanye undi muntu, abandi 3 mu 10 bari mu kato baratoroka
content:
Nyuma y’uko kuri uyu wa.. umwana w’imyaka 5 abaye uwa mbere uhitanywe na Ebola muri Uganda, nyirakuru na we yitabye Imana, mu gihe abandi 10 nabo bakekwaho kwandura iyi ndwara bashyizwe mu kato ariko 3 bagatoroka. Kuri uyu wa Mbere, tariki ya 10 Kamena, 2019 nibwo byavuzwe ko Ebola yageze muri Uganda, ihagejejwe n’umwana w’imyaka itanu wari waturukanye n’umuryango we muri Repuburika iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Bose bahise batangira kwitabwaho ndetse bashyirwa no mu kato kugira ngo batanduza abandi. Daily Monitor dukesha iyi nkuru ivuga ko nyuma y’iminsi 3, iki cyorezo kigeze muri Uganda, hamaze kugaragara abandi bantu 10 bakekwaho kuba bayirwaye ndetse bose bashyizwe mu kato, gusa batatu muri bo bakaba batorotse ibitaro; barimo Saddi Muhima umugabo w’imyaka 46, umuhungu we Issa Muhima w’imyaka 19 na Milton Nsenga bose bivugwa ko bavuye muri DR Congo.

 Batorotse aho bari bashyizwe mu kato  Aba bose bagejejwe ku bitaro bagaragaza ibimenyetso bya Ebola birimo umuriro ukabije n’ibindi bitandukanye, gusa bakaba batorotse batarakorerwa ibizamini nyabyo byo kugaragaza niba koko bari bafite Ebola, gusa nanone kuba bari bari kumwe n’abandi barwayi bikaba bibongerera ibyago byo kuba bayitorokanye, aho bikekwa ko basubiye iwabo muri Congo.

title: Etiyopiya: Umugore yakoze ikizamini nyuma y’iminota 30 abyaye
content:
Mu gihugu cya Etiyopiya haravugwa inkuru y’umugore wakoreye ikizamini ku buriri bwo mu bitaro  nyuma y’iminota mike abyaye. Almaz Derese w’imyaka 21 y’amavuko ukomoka mu gace kitwa Metu mu burengerazuba bwa Etiyopiya yibwiraga ko azakora ikizamini mbere yo kwibaruka umwana we ariko ibizamini bisoza amashuri yisumbuye byigijwe inyuma kubera igisibo cya Ramazani. Uyu mugore yarimo abyara ku wa Mbere mbere gato y’uko ibizamini bitangira. Almaz yavuze ko kuba yarigaga atwite bitigeze bimuteza ikibazo kandi ngo ntiyifuzaga gutegereza umwaka utaha ngo abone impamyabumenyi ye (diplôme).

 Ntiyifuzaga ko kuvuka k’umwana we kumubera imbogamizi yamubuza kurangiza amashuri  Almaz Derese yakoreye mu bitaro ibizamini birimo icy’Icyongereza, icy’ururimi rwa Amarik ruvugwa iwabo n’icy’Imibare kuri uyu wa Mbere mu gihe ibindi bizamini azabikorera aho abandi barimo gukorera. "Kubera ko nari nshishikajwe cyane no gukora ibizamini , ntabwo ibise byanjye byigeze bingora na gato.", Almaz aganira na BBC dukesha iyi nkuru. Umugabo we, Tadese Tulu yavuze ko  yagombaga kwemeza ishuri ko rigomba kumwemerera umugore we gukorera ibizamini kwa muganga.

 Ubusabe bwabo bwarumvikanye maze yemererwa gukorera kwa muganga  Almaz ngo ubu arifuza gukurikirana amasomo y’imyaka ibiri amutegurira kwinjira muri kaminuza, ndetse avuga ko yanyuzwe n’uburyo yitwaye mu bizamini yakoreye mu bitaro, akanahamya ko umwana we w’umuhungu yibarutse ameze neza. Muri Etiyopiya  bisanzwe bimenyerewe ko abakobwa benshi bakunze kuva mu mashuri yisumbuye bakazasubiramo nyuma kugira ngo barangize amasomo yabo.

 Almaz we ntiyashakaga gutakaza uyu mwaka

title: Uganda: Hagaragaye umurwayi wa Ebola
content: Umurwayi wa mbere wanduye virusi ya Ebola wagaragaye hanze ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, ni umwana w’imyaka itanu w’umunye-Congo wari werekeje mu burasirazuba bwa Uganda. Uyu mwana yahise yitabwaho mu kigo nderabuzima cyo muri Uganda aho umuryango mpuzamahanga wita ku buzima (OMS) hamwe n’ubuyobozi bwo muri Uganda bahise bohereza ubutabazi bwihuse muri aka gace kugira ngo bahangane n’ikwirakwira ry’iyi ndwara. Abaganga bagize aho bahurira n’uyu mwana, barahita basuzumwa nabo byihariye nkuko byatangajwe na OMS na guverinoma ya Uganda. Byagiye bivugwa kenshi ko Uganda ifite ibyago byinshi byo kugerwaho n’iki cyorezo ariko ni ubwa mbere hagaragaye umurwayi wa Eboka ku butaka bw’iki gihugu. "Umwana n’umuryango binjiye mu gihugu banyuze ku mupaka wa Bwera aho bari baje kwivuza.", ibyatangajwe na OMS mu itangazo banyujije kuri Twitter. OMS hamwe na minisiteri y’ubuzima muri iki gihugu bohereje abaganga bahuguriwe kuvura iyi ndwara mu mujyi wa Kasese kugira ngo barebe niba babona abandi barwayi.

title: Yategetswe n’urukiko guhembera umugore we imirimo yo mu rugo yakoze yose
content: Urukiko rwo mu gihugu cya Argentine rwakatiye umugabo igihano cyo guha umugore we asaga miliyoni 150 z’amanyarwanda nk’igihembo cy’imirimo yo mu rugo yose yakoze. Ni umwanzuro wafashwe n’urukiko kuri uyu wa Mbere, aho uyu mugabo yakatiwe igihano cyo guha umugore we w’imyaka 70, aya mafaranga nk’umushahara w’igihe cyose yamaze amukorera imirimo itandukanye yo mu rugo, ni ukuvuga imyaka 27 bamaze barashakanye. Aba bombi bashyingiranywe mu mwaka wa 1982. Uyu mugore wari warize iby’icungamutungo, byabaye ngombwa ko areka akazi yari afite kugira ngo abashe kwita ku rugo n’abana, ibyo abikora kugeza mu mwaka wa 2009 ubwo yatandukanye n’umugabo we. Nyuma yo gutandukana n’umugabo we, ku myaka 60 y’amavuko, uyu mugore ntiyigeze yoroherwa n’ubuzima, dore ko atari akibasha kubona akazi , ibitandukanye n’uwari umugabo we wari warabashije kwizigamira bityo ubuzima bwe bugakomeza nta kibazo. Mu gufata umwanzuro kuri uru rubanza , urukiko rwahaye agaciro kuba uyu mugore yararetse akazi ke akiyegurira imirimo yo mu rugo irimo kwita ku bana babyaranye ndetse no ku mugabo ubwe. "Mu miryango myinshi, abagore biharira imirimo yose yo mu rugo no kwita ku bana, n’ubwo baba bafite akandi kazi." Umucamanza. Iki cyemezo cy’uru rukiko cyashimwe cyane n’abantu batandukanye baharanira uburenganzira bw’abagore barimo n’umuyobozi wungirije w’itsinda rikurikirana ubutabera bw’uburinganire muri Amerika y’amajyepfo. Muri Argentine, abagore baracyaharirwa imirimo yo mu rugo kurusha abagabo aho ubugore akoresha amasaha 6,4 mu gihe umugabo wakoze iyi mirimo adashobora kurenza amasaha 3,4 nk’uko bitangazwa n’ikinyamakuru cyaho cyitwa Clarín. "Imirimo yo mu rugo iracyakomeje guharirwa abagore"

title: Kwizera uheruka kurushinga n’umugore umurusha imyaka 27, afunzwe akurikiranyweho gutera inda umwana
content:
Kwizera Evariste ni izina ryamamaye cyane mu ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka ubwa hasakaraga inkuru y’uko agiye kurushinga n’uwitwa Mukaperezida Clotilde umurusha imyaka 27 kuko afite imyaka 48 mu gihe umusore afite 21. Kuri ubu uyu mugabo ari mu maboko y’Urwego rw’Igihugu rw’Ubugenzacyaha, RIB. Uyu mugabo warushinze ku ya 31 Mutarama 2019, ubu yongeye kugaruka mu itangazamakuru nyuma y’uko RIB itangaje ko yamutaye muri yombi akurikiranyweho gufata ku ngufu no gutera inda umwana w’umukobwa utarageza imyaka y’ubukure. Kwizera Evariste  ngo yaba yarasambanije ndetse anatera inda umwana w’umukobwa ufite imyaka 15 y’amavuko maze ahita ahunga ajya kuba i Kigali kugira ngo adakurikiranwa dore ko yari asanzwe atuye i Rwamagana aho akomoka. Amakuru y’itabwa muri yombi rya Kwizera yemejwe n’Umuvugizi wa RIB, Mbabazi Modeste. Aganira na Igihe yagize ati “Nibyo ari gukurikiranwa n’ubugenzacyaha ku cyaha cyo gusambanya umwana. Afungiwe kuri Sitasiyo ya Kigabiro.”

Ubukwe bwa Kwizera na Mukaperezida bwaravuzwe cyane Mu gihe iki cyaha cyaba kimuhamye uyu mugabo w’imyaka 21 y’amavuko wari umaze amezi ane n’icyumweru arushinze yahanishwa n’ Ingingo ya 133 y’Igitabo cy’amategeko ahana ibyaha mu Rwanda iteganya ko umuntu usambanya umwana utarageza imyaka y’ubukure iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko, ahanishwa igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka 20 ariko kitarenze imyaka 25.

title: Binyavanga wari impirimbanyi y’uburenganzira bw’abatinganyi muri Kenya yapfuye
content:
Umwanditsi w’umunya-Kenya wari ikimenyabose kubera ahanini ijwi riranguruye mu kurengera abiyumvanamo bahuje igitsina (abatinganyi), Binyavanga Wainaina yapfuye mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 22 Gicurasi 2019. Uyu mugabo wari ufite imyaka 48 yapfuye nyuma y’uburwayi bw’igihe gito. Yatangiye kumenyekana mu 2002 ubwo yegukanaga igihembo cya Caine Prize cyatangiye gutangwa mu 2000 gihabwa umwanditsi mwiza w’inkuru ngufi zanditswe mu cyongereza w’umunyafurika ndetse anamenyekana ku nyandiko ye yise ’How to Write About Africa’. Wainaina ni n’umwe mu bantu 100 bashyizwe ku rutonde rwa Time Magazine rw’abavuga rikijyana mu 2014 ’Time Magazine’s 100 most influential people’ kubera guhirimbanira kuvugira ababana bahuje ibitsina.

Mu bantu bazwi muri Kenya yabaye uwa mbere watuye ko ari umutinganyi Binyavanga Wainaina kandi ni umwe mu bantu bazwi cyane mu Kenya wafashe iya mbere mu kwemerera mu ruhame akavuga ko ari umutinganyi. Umunditsi Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie avuga ko Wainaina ’yagerageje kumvikanisha ubutinganyi abugaragaza nk’ibintu bisanzwe ku kiremwa muntu’. Uyu mwanditsi kandi avuga ko uyu mugabo "yiyumvishemo inshingano yo kugabanya ikimwaro ku batinganyi."

Binyavanga Wainaina yari umwanditsi uzwi cyane kubera kuvuganira abatinganyi Undi mwanditsi akanaba umusesenguzi w’umunya-Kenya witwa Nanjala Nyabola ubwo yavugaga kuri nyakwigendera Wainaina aganira na BBC dukesha iyi nkuru yavuze ko uyu nyakwigendera yeretse abanya-Kenya ko ubuvanganzo  atari uburyo gusa bwo gusohora ibikurimo, ko ahubwo ishobora kuba umwuga mwiza w’ingirakamaro. Ati "Yongeye gufungurira amahirwe menshi ubuvanganzo bwo muri Kenya." Uyu mwanditsi akomeza avuga ko Wainaina asigiye abanya-Kenya isomo ko bakwiye kongera gutekereza kuri imwe mu myitwarire mibi bagirira abatinganyi.
 Tubibutse ko nyuma y’uko Binyavanga Wainaina yegukanye igihembo cy’umwanditsi mwiza cya Caine Prize mu 2002 ku nkuru ye ngufi ’Discovering Home’, yahise atangiza ikinyamakuru cy’ubuvanganzo yise Kwani, cyazamuye abandi banditsi benshi ndetse bamwe nabo begukana igihembo cya Caine Prize Award. Mu 2014 ni bwo uyu mugabo ubuzima bwe bwafashe indi sura ubwo yaturaga akavuga ko yamenye ko ari umutinganyi ubwo yari afite imyaka itanu gusa y’amavuko. Nyuma y’umwaka umwe yagize ikibazo cy’umutsi wo mu bwonko. Umwaka wakurikiyeho mu 2016 ku munsi mpuzamahanga wa SIDA yahamije ko yanduye virus ya HIV. Mu 2018 yavuze ko yitegura gushyingiranwa n’umuhungu w’inshuti ye muri Afurika y’epfo ariko ubu bukwe apfuye butabaye.

title: Muhanga: Yabwiwe ko babyaye umwana upfuye, bagiye kureba umurambo basanga ni muzima
content:
Umubyeyi witwa Benimana Adeline utuye mu karere ka Nyanza, we n’abagize umuryango we bari mu gahinda gakomeye nyuma y’uko abyariye ku bitaro bya Kabgayi biherere mu mujyi wa Muhanga, umwana muzima ariko abaganga baramurangarana bamubwira ko yapfuye bamujyana mu buruhukiro bw’ibitaro bimuviramo gupfa. Ibi byabaye ku wa Kane w’icyumweru gishize tariki ya 16 Gicurasi 2019 nkuko mukuru w’uyu mubyeyi witwa Musabyimana Alice atuye mu murenge wa Nyamabuye mu karere ka Muhanga yabihamirije umunyamakuru wa Tv1 dukesha iyi nkuru. Alice avuga ko inkuru y’uko uyu mwana yapfuye akimara kubyarwa, abo mu muryango we bayibwiwe mu rukerera rwo ku wa Kane, noneho mu masaha ya nimugoroba baje gutora umurambo batungurwa no gusanga akiri muzima.

Musabyimana Alice Yatangiye avuga uko bageze kwa muganga. Ati "Ku wa Gatatu (tariki ya 13/05/2019) saa mbili za mugitondo najyanye umurwayi  (umubyeyi) kwa muganga tugezeyo biba ngombwa ko abyara umwana utuzuye, noneho abaganga b’i Kabgayi barangije baramubwira ngo abyaye umwana upfuye, birangiye umwana baramufashe bamushyira mu bitambaro byabo bashyiramo abana, noneho umubyeyi akababwira ati ’umwana wanjye mubyaye ari muzima’ barakomeza baramuhatiriza ngo umwana yapfuye,…" Yakomeje ati "Bagiye kumpa umurambo bajyanye aho umurambo w’umwana wari uri,  baziritseho ’papier collant’ bafunguye mbona umwana acometse intoki, birantungura ngira ubwoba ndababaza nti ’ese muganga ni gute muvuga ngo umuntu yapfuye kandi mbona akiri muzima?’ (…)Akana kahise kazamura akaboko kamwe akandi gacometse, kubera umuyaga wari ugakubise gatangira kurira" Bikimara kugaragara ko uyu mwana byari byemejwe ko yapfuye akiri muzima, ariko yanegekaye ngo abaganga b’ibitaro bya Kabgayi bihutiye kumushyira mu byuma bimufasha kumererwa neza ariko birangira apfuye. Musabyimana ati"Bahise birukanka bafata umwana batangira kumujyana mu byuma, umwana warangaranywe wabyawe saa munani z’ijoro, ku wundi munsi yirirwa mu bitambaro bari bamuzirikiyemo barangije bamushyira ahantu ku kimeza gikonje umwana ari agaprématuré (atuzuye) urumva ko ari ikibazo gikomeye…noneho saa cyenda z’ijoro natunguwe no kumpamagara ngo wa mwana arapfuye." Musabyimana wari ubabaye ku bw’urupfu rw’amaherere rw’uyu mwana wa murumuna we yakomeje avuga ko atari ubwa mbere bibayeho kuri ibi bitaro. Ati "Hari n’undi mubyeyi witwa Mutoni byabayeho, nawe yabyaye umwana bamubwira ko yapfuye noneho umuryango we ugiye kumutora ngo bajye kumushyingura, basanga ni muzima, ariko nawe nyuma yaje gupfa."

Ngo si ubwa mbere ibi ibitaro bikoze iri kosa Ubuyobozi bw’ibi bitaro buvuga ko hagitegerejwe raporo izakorwa n’urugaga rw’abaforomo n’ababyaza mu Rwanda ku bivugwa n’uyu mubyeyi, gusa bigahakana iby’uko byaba atari ubwa mbere bibabayeho. Nteziryayo Philippe uyobora ibi bitaro, aganira na TV1 yagize ati "Buriya ni ibintu biri tekinike, bisaba urwego rushinzwe abaganga n’urushinzwe ababyaza n’aba-nurse nibo tubwira bakaza bakareba uko ikibazo cyagenze, ubu rero niyo process ndimo kubahamagara bakazaza bakareba ibyo ari byo, njye nta kuri kw’impamo ndabona, ubwo rero ntegereje abongabo kuko nibo babyemerewe bakabisesengura…Ese ibyo umuntu avuga nibyo? Ese ikosa ryabaye ni irihe? Ni bo babimenya mu rwego ruri tekinike." Tubibutse ko atari ku nshuro ya mbere ibi bitaro bivuzweho uburangare mu itangazamakuru dore ko muri Nyakanga umwaka ushize umubyeyi yasezerewe akirimo serumu kandi arembye birangira nyuma y’umunsi umwe yitabye Imana.

title: Isomo ry’ubuzima wakwigira kuri Cassidy, umwana wavutse nta zuru n’amaso agira
content:
Cassidy Hooper yavutse nta maso nta n’amazuru afite. Ibi ntibyamubujije kubaho ubuzima bwe nk’uko byagombaga kugenda, dore ko ubu afite impamyabumenyi ya kaminuza. Cassidy yavutse mu mwaka wa 1996, avukira mu mujyi wa Charlotte muri Caroline y’Amajyaruguru muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Mu myaka 22 yose amaze ku isi abaganga ntibigeze babasha gusobanura impamvu yavutse adafite izuru n’amaso.

 Yavutse afite umwenge mu mwanya w’izuru  Uyu mwana w’umukobwa wabanye n’ubumuga bwo kutabona kuva akivuka, afite n’umwenge mu mwanya w’izuru kugira ngo abashe guhumeka neza. Mu mwaka wa 2013, Cassidy yashyiriweho  izuru nyuma yo kubagwa inshuro nyinshi nk’uko bitangazwa na RTL Info.

 Baramubaze, bamuteraho izuru  Mu minsi ishize, Cassidy yahawe impamyabumenyi ya kaminuza. Mu kwishimira iyi ntambwe ikomeye yagezeho, yagize ati "Nari ndi aho, hanyuma ndebye ndibwira nti ’Ba uretse gato, ibi koko birimo kumbaho? Ndimo kurota cyangwa ndi maso?’ Igihe kirihuta…" 


 Nawe ntiyabyumvaga neza  Kuri ubu Cassidy afite intego yo gukora ku itangazamakuru, cyane cyane muri radio. Bitaba ibyo agakora mu bijyanye n’iyobokamana. Isomo: Cassidy yaravuze ati  "Sinkeneye ibyoroshye, nkeneye ibishoboka"  Uyu mwana w’umukobwa yabayeho mu buzima bugoranye cyane. Yararwaragurikaga kuko yari yaravukanye ibibazo by’ubuzima. Ikirenze kuri ibyo abantu benshi baramuhutazaga cyangwa bakamutuka bamuhora uko asa. Nyamara ibi ntibyamuteye kwiheba no kwiganyira ahubwo yarwanye gitwari arakomeza ariga, arakomeza ashakisha icyatuma ubuzima burushako kuba bwiza. Nawe rero nubwo wavuka usanga ufite ubuzima bugoranye cyangwa butakunyuze mu buryo butandukanye, Cassidy akubere isomo ry’uko kwicara uhora usubiramo ko ubuzima bwawe butameze nk’uko wabyifuzaga ntacyo bishobora kugufasha, ahubwo ko guhaguruka ukarwana ukirengagiza amagambo y’abantu ahubwo ugashakisha ibisubizo ku bibazo uhura nabyo, icyo aricyo kikugira umuntu nyamuntu.

title: Ku myaka 81 y’amavuko yabonanye bwa mbere na nyina umubyara
content:
Eileen Macken, umukecuru w’imyaka 81 y’amavuko yabashije kubona nyina umubyara, umukecuru w’imyaka 104. Eileen yakuriye mu kigo cy’imfubyi i Dublin. Ubwo yari afite imyaka 19, uyu munya-Irlande yafashe umwanzuro wo gushaka ababyeyi be. Nyuma yo gushakisha igihe kinini ariko nta musaruro, Eileen yahisemo kwitabaza ikiganiro cya radio Liveline, mu mwaka ushize asaba ubufasha. Mu minsi mike ishize, umwe mu mpuguke mu by’imibanire y’umuryango wamwumvise ubwo yasabaga ubufasha kuri radio, yaje kumugezaho inkuru y’uko yabonye nyina muri Ecosse. "Nkimara kumva iyi nkuru numvaga ntacyampagarika, numvaga nkeneye guhura na we.", Eileen Macken Ubwo yahise ajya muri Ecosse mu kwezi gushize aho yahuye na nyina, Elizabeth, umukecuru rukukuri wizihije isabukuru y’imyaka 104 ku wa Gatandatu ushize. "Nagiye kumureba, nasanze ari umugore mwiza. Afite umuryango mwiza, banyakiriye neza." Eileen aganira na Liveline Elizabeth yasomaga ikinyamakuru ubwo umukobwa we yinjiraga aho yari ari. "Namubwiye ko nkomoka muri Irlande hanyuma aransubiza ati ’Navukiye muri Irlande’. Nahise mubwira nti ’Urabizi ko ndi umukobwa wawe’ na we arandeba hanyuma amfata mu kiganza(…) Hari rukuruzi ikomeye hagati yacu. Byari byiza cyane."

Ubwo babonanaga byari ibyishimo bikomeye Eileen ntiyahuye na nyina gusa kandi kuko yabashije kumenyana na basaza be babiri bahuje uyu mubyeyi. Eileen yahoraga yifuza kuzabonana n’umubyeyi we. Ntiyigeze acika intege. Kumubona byamuhaye umunezero ukomeye "Naribwiraga nti ’ni gute naba kuri uyu mubumbe ndi njyenyine?’ Twamaranye iminsi 3 y’umunezero ukomeye, sinari narigeze menya umunezero nk’uwo mbere." Ibitangazamakuru byo mu Bwongereza ntabwo bigaragaza uburyo uyu mukecuru ubwo yari umwana yatandukanye na nyina akajya kurererwa mu bigo by’imfubyi.

title: Bakundanye mu bwana, ku myaka 5 baraburana, bongera kubonana nyuma y’imyaka 12, baza kurushinga
content:
Natalie na Austin bafite inkuru y’urukundo itangaje kandi itanga isomo. Aba bombi bahuye bakira abana bato cyane ubwo bigaga mu mashuri y’inshuke. Kuva bahurira ku kigo cy’inshuke, Natalie Crowe na Austin Tatman babaye inshuti  zidasigana, gusa ubwo bari bafite imyaka itanu, ubu bushuti bwabo bwaje gusinzira bya maherere ubwo baburanaga kubera ko ababyeyi ba Natalie baje gutandukana (divorce) maze uyu mukobwa ahita yimukana na nyina bava i Floride berekeza Connecticut.

Agafoto bifotoje bakiri abana, mbere gato y’uko baburana Kuva ubwo Natalie na Austin ntibongeye guhura mu myaka 12 yakurikiyeho. Umunsi umwe rero Natalie wari ufite imyaka 17 wahoraga atekereza Austin, yaje kureba mu gatabo ka aderesi ka cyera ka nyina abonamo ahatangizwa na T izina ry’uyu mukunzi we bari baraburanye. 
 Natalie avuga ko atibukaga izina riheruka (last name) rya Austin ariko ko nyuma yo kuribona mu gatabo ka nyina yahise yibwira ko ari we. Yagiye kuri Facebook asanga nta nshuti bahuje ariko yitegereje amafoto ahita abona nta kabuza ni isura y’inshuti yeyo mu bwana, ahita amwandikira ubutumwa.

Biyumvanyemo bakiri abana
 Kimwe na Natalie, Austin nawe ngo ntabwo yari yarigeze yibagirwa iyi nshuti ye yabuze ku myaka itanu. Baraganiriye ndetse bategura uburyo bagomba guhuza imiryango yabo bakongera bagahurira hamwe bagasabana.

Ahantu hose babaga begeranye Aganira na People, Natalie yagize ati "Kuva nakongera kumubona, twaragumanye. Byari nk’ubwa kabiri mubonye, bwari ubushuti bugarutse mu buzima."

Ku munsi w’ubukwe bwabo Mu kwezi gushize, tariki ya 13 Mata uyu mwaka, Natalie na Austin bari bafite imyaka 24 barashyingiranywe, ubukwe bwabereye New Smyrna Beach i Floride. Ifoto y’ubukwe bwabo basangije inshuti zabo kuri Facebook bari bayifatanije n’indi bifotoje mu myaka 19 ishize ubwo bari bagifite imyaka 5.
