title: Igitera impatwe (constipation) ku ruhinja, uko yakwirindwa n’uko ivurwa
content: Kimwe mu bibazo bikunze guhangayikisha ababyeyi ni ukubona abana babo bahinduye amasaha yabo yo kwituma, aho umubyeyi aba yumva yakora uko ashoboye kose ariko umwana we akabasha kujya ku musarane dore ko iyo amaze n’igihe kinini atajyayo, aribwa mu nda bityo amarira akaba menshi no gusinzira bikaba ikibazo. Mu rwego rwo gusobanukirwa byinshi kuri ubu burwayi, ikibutera,  ndetse no gufasha ababyeyi kumenya uko bwakwirindwa n’uko bwavurwa, twegereye Dr Rivuzwe, umuganga w’abana ku bitaro bya Muhima maze adusobanurira byinshi. Ese indwara y’impatwe (constipation) iterwa n’iki? Ubundi kugira ngo umwana agire ikibazo cy’impatwe (constipation) bituruka ku mpamvu ebyiri. Iya mbere ni iy’imiterere cyangwa imikorere y’amara ye naho iya kabiri ni ibyo arya.  Amara adakora neza  Iyo amara adakora neza bituma imyanda yo mu nda itabasha gusohoka. Kudakora neza kw’amara rero bishobora guterwa n’impamvu nyinshi zitandukanye birimo nko kuba ari maremare, atazinze neza cyangwa se bigaterwa n’uko umwana aba yavutse ananiwe cyane, amara ntakore neza. Amara kandi aba ashobora kuba arwaye indwara zitandukanye nk’iyitwa Hirschsprung, aho imitsi (nerfs) yo ku mara ahagana hasi, iba idakora neza. Iyi ndwara ikunze gufata abahungu, umubyeyi akaba abimenya iyo umwana ukivuka amaze amasaha 24 ataratangira kwituma. Izindi ndwara zifata amara zikaba zatuma umwana atabasha kwituma harimo iyitwa Hypothyroidie, umwana akomora kuri nyina, iyitwa Cystic Fibrosis cyangwa Mucoviscidose ndetse n’iyitwa Down Syndrome. Kumara igihe umwana atituma kandi bishobora guterwa no kuba afite ubwoba bwo kubabara kubera amaze iminsi mike agize ikimubabaje mu kibuno, bityo yashaka kwituma akabifunga kuko aba agitinya kubabara.  Ibyo umwana arya/anywa  Ibyo umubyeyi arya nibyo bijya mu mashereka agaburira umwana. Iyo umubyeyi atarya neza rero bituma n’umwana aba atarya neza ari nayo mpamvu usanga akenshi iyo umwana atituma neza na nyina aba ari uko bimeze. Iyo umubyeyi atanywa bihagije yaba amazi cyangwa se n’ibindi binyobwa byoroheje ngo byoroshye amashereka ase n’afunguye(arimo amazi), ndetse n’iyo umubyeyi atarya imboga n’imbuto bituma umwana atituma neza kuko aba anywa amashereka atsindagiye cyane (adafunguye). Ni nyuma y’igihe kingana gite umwana atituma, bavuga ko yaba yarwaye? Igihe bimara giterwa n’igihe umwana amaze avutse, ariko abana kimwe n’abantu bakuru, iyo ari bazima nta kibazo bafite, bituma inshuro zingana n’umubare w’inshuro bariye. Umwana rero muzima yagombye kwituma inshuro nk’izo yonka ku munsi. Mu gihe umwana amaze umunsi wose atitumye rero, umubyeyi ahita amenya ko umwana we yarwaye impatwe. Ni iki umubyeyi yakora mu gihe umwana yarwaye impatwe? Mu bihe nk’ibi umubyeyi wonsa agomba guhita ahindura indyo, akongera ibyo kunywa byinshi, imboga n’imbuto ngo umwana yonke amashereka afunguye. Niba umwana yaratangiye kunywa amata, ni byiza ko umuha amata yabugenewe, amwe aba ari ayo mu bikombe kuko aba yarakozwe hakuwemo ibituma aba atsindagiye cyane. Abo bidashobokeye bagura amata asanzwe y’inka ariko bakayashyiramo amazi, amata akaba kimwe cya kabiri (1/2)  n’amazi akaba ikindi, cyangwa se amata akaba kimwe cya kane (1/4) naho amazi akaba bitatu bya kane (3/4). Mu gihe umwana yamaze kugeza ku mezi 4, umubyeyi ashobora kumukorera mu mbuto zigira utubuto mo imbere nk’amaronji(orange), marakuja,… gusa akirinda kugira ikindi avangamo, ahubwo akayungurura umutobe wayo agakuramo utubuto hanyuma akayimuha, nabyo byoroshya mu nda h’umwana. Mu gihe umubyeyi akoze ibi byose ariko umwana agakomeza kutituma, ni ngombwa ko yihutira kwa muganga akamukorera ibizamini akareba ko bitaba bitewe n’uburwayi twavuze haruguru.

title: Kenya: Impanga zatandukanyijwe zikivuka zongeye guhuzwa na Facebook nyuma y’imyaka 19 (VIDEO)
content:
Mu gihugu cya Kenya hamaze iminsi mike havugwa inkuru idasanzwe y’abana babiri b’abakobwa bikekwa ko ari impanga bahujwe n’urubuga nkoranyambaga rwa Facebook nyuma y’imyaka 19 yari ishize batandukanijwe bakivuka kwa muganga. Inkuru dukesha Nairobi News ivuga ko kuri ubu umuryango utuye mu gace ka Kakamega utegereje ibisubizo bya ADN kugira ngo bamenye neza niba koko abana babo b’impanga baratandukanijwe ubwo bavukaga mu myaka 19 ishize.

Ibyishimo ni byose kuri izi mpanga nyuma yo guhura, zemeza ko uretse kuba zisa, zinahuriye ku bintu byinshi Uku kubonana bitunguranye kw’aba bana byanyuze ku rubuga rwa Facebook aho impanga imwe yitwa Melon Lutenyo yakuriye Likuyani muri Kakamega yabonye konti y’umuntu basa cyane we witwa Sharon Mathias uba Nairobi yamusabye ubushuti (friend request) kuko nawe yabonaga basa cyane ndetse yajyaga ahura n’abantu bakamubwira ko yaba afite impanga. Bagihurira kuri facebook ngo babanje guterana amagambo bashinjanya kwibana amafoto, bakanitana amajyini, kuko buri wese yabonaga asa foto kopi n’undi, gusa uyu Melon wari warakuranye na Mevis (uwo babahinduranije n’impanga ye), yinginga nyina amusaba ko yazajya i Nairobi kureba uwo mukobwa basa kuko ubwo yajyaga mu mashuri yisumbuye yakundaga kumva bamwitiranya n’uyu cyane maze bimutera amatsiko yo kumubona. Nyuma yo kwinginga nyina, mu ntangiriro z’uku kwezi kwa Mata ni bwo aherekejwe na Mevis bakuranye aziko ariyo mpanga ye, berekeje i Nairobi mu rugendo rutari rworoshye kuko ari bwo bwa mbere yari agiyeyo. 
Sharon, Mevis na Melon abana batatu bavukiye ku bitaro bya Kakamenga mu gihe kimwe, babiri bakuranye mu vyaro cya Likuyani bikekwa ko batavukana mu gihe undi yakuriye Nairobi Nyina ahamya ko yari yabyaye impanga ku bitaro bya Kakamega aho yari yabyaye abazwe ariko uduhinja twe tubanza kujyanwa kwitabwaho kuko twari twavukanye ibiro bike, gusa aza gutungurwa no kubona badasa na gato kuko umwe yiraburaga cyane undi ari inzobe, ariko ntiyabitindaho kuko mu muryango wabo banagiraga abantu b’inzobe. Uyu mukobwa usa n’umukobwa we, nawe yavanwe kuri ibi bitaro ku munsi ukurikiye. Uyu muryango kuri ubu urakeka ko umwe muri izi mpanga yaguranwe ubwo bavukaga. "Ubu mugenzi wanjye ari kumbwira ko ubwo abana bamaraga amezi abiri hariya, mu ijoro baba barabaguranye, ni nkaho umubyeyi yashyize umwana mu gasanduku kanjye, bakamubwira ko umwana yavutse gutyo.", nyina w’izi mpanga aganira na KTN.

Izi mpanga hamwe n’ababyeyi bazo Izi mpanga zasabye ibitaro bya Kakamega ko byabafasha kuvanaho urujijo, ndetse bakabaha indishyi z’akababaro mu gihe byagaragara ko babahinduranije bavuka. "Niba uyu ari umuvandimwe wanjye, ibitaro bya Kakamega bizaba byaradukosereje cyane kubera ko bazaba baradutandukanije maze buri wese abaho ubuzima butari ubwe.", umwe mu mpanga Indi mpanga yo yagize iti "Sinavuga ko mama ari umujura (…), ngo yaranyibye, ntabwo ariko mbitekereza, ndamukunda kuko yaranyonkeje, arangaburira aranyigisha, niyo twasanga ibizamini bya AND bigaragaza ko mvukana na Sharon, nzakomeza gukunda umubyeyi wandeze."

Ababyeyi b’impanga Richard Olukhakha (se), Rosemary Onyango (nyina) bareze Melon na Mevis (w’inzobe hagati bikekwa ko ari we waguranwe na Sharon ubanza ibumoso) Gusa ku rundi ruhande nyina w’iyi mpanga yindi yamaganye ibiri kuvugwa, ko yaba yaragize uruhare mu kwiba umwana, mu magambo ye ahamya ko nawe yari yabyariye muri ibi bitaro umwana w’umukobwa. Ati "Abantu bo ku isi ni gutyo bateye. Naje ku bitaro mfite umwana w’umukobwa, none ni gute naba naramwibye?" Kugeza ubu uyu muryango utegereje ADN kugira ngo bemeze ko aba bana baba ari impanga zatandukanyirijwe kwa muganga zikivuka. Reba mu mashusho icyo ibinyamakuru byo muri Kenya byagiye bivuga kuri iyi nkuru

title: Inyungu 5 umubiri ukura mu gufatana ifunguro ubwitonzi
content: Kugabanya ibyago byo kurwara diyabete, kubungabunga umutima, kurwanya umubyibuho ukabije,… zimwe mu ngero z’ibyiza gufata amafunguro twitonze. Guhekenya uko bikwiye no kudatamira byinshi, bihindura byinshi cyane ku mafunguro dufata. Ubwoko bw’ibyo kurya biri mu isahani yacu ni ingirakamaro ku buzima bwacu, ariko umuvuduko byinjiraho mu mubiri wacu nawo ugira ingaruka zikomeye ku buryo umubiri ubyakira ndetse n’uburyo ubibyaza umusaruro.  Dore impamvu 5, ugomba kwitonda mu gihe ufata amafunguro  1. Koroshya igogora Benshi bakunze kwirengagiza ko guhekenya ariyo ntambwe ya mbere y’igogonrwa, bibwira ko ritangirira mu gifu, nyamara siko biri. Iyo umuntu adahekenye neza ibyo kurya, biryuma bigera mu gifu ari byinshi icyarimwe. Ibi bituma igogorwa rikorwa nabi cyane, ari naho uzasanga akenshi ibyo kurya bigaruka mu muhogo birimo na aside nyinshi. Uretse ibi bigaruka rero, burya igifu ntigikora neza umurimo wacyo kubyo cyohereza mu bindi bice by’urwungano ngogozi, bityo intungamubiri ntizigere mu mubiri uko bikwiye ndetse n’umubiri ukananirwa nyamara bitari ngombwa. 2. Guha umubiri intungamubiri nyinshi zishoboka Iyo ibyo kurya bidahekenywe neza, bikomeza inzira y’igogorwa bikiri mu bice binini. Ibi bituma urura ruto rutabasha kubikuramo intungamubiri nyinshi ahubwo zikigira mu mwanda twituma. 3. Kurinda umutima NK’uko ubushakashatsi bubigaragaza, abantu barya vuba cyane, biyongerera ibyago byo kurwara indwara z’umutima kuko umubiri utabasha gukoresha neza amavuta, bityo bigatuma ibinure biba byinshi mu maraso, inkomoko y’indwara nyinshi z’umutima. 4. Kurinda diyabete Iyo umuntu ariye vuba bimwongerera ibyago byo kurwara diyabete yo mu bwoko bwa 2. Iyo umuntu ariye vuba nubwo yaba ariye ibingana n’iby’uwariye gake, arakomeza agashaka kura, ibituma arya byinshi bigatuma umubiri utabasha kwakira neza isukari iri mubyo umuntu arya, ibishobora gutera diyabete. 5. Kumererwa neza k’umubiri Iyo umuntu ariye vuba, ibyo kurya byirunda mu gifu ari byinshi, ibituma umuntu yumva asa n’ufite umutwaro mu gifu. Kuri bamwe bitera uburibwe mu nda cyangwa n’isereri idakabije igera aho igafatwa nk’akamenyero. Nyamara ibyo byose ntushobora guhura nabyo iyo wariye witonze.

title: Icyo umubyeyi yakora ngo yirinde kwangiriza umugongo nyuma yo kubyara
content: Ababyeyi bose iyo bamaze kubyara usanga bataka uburibwe bukabije bw’umugongo, ubafatanya n’umunaniro baba basanzwe bifitiye nyuma y’amezi icyenda yose batwite. Ese uyu mugongo uterwa n’iki? Umubyeyi se yakora iki ngo yirinde kwangirika by’igihe kinini? Ubu bubabare bwakunze kwitwa uburibwe bw’ikinyejana (mal du siècle) kubera uburyo buba bukabije ndetse bufatanije n’inshingano yo kwita ku mwana wavutse, iyo umubyeyi atabwitondeye buba bushobora kwangiriza uruti rw’umugongo rwe bikabije ari nayo mpamvu twegereye muganga akadusobanurira uko umubyeyi yabyirinda. Ese uyu mugongo uterwa n’iki? Dr Rulisa, umuganga w’indwara z’abagore(Gynecologue), avuga ko ibi atari uburwayi ahubwo ko biba ku babyeyi bose. Ati “Ubwo buribwe bukabije bw’umugongo si uburwayi ahubwo ni ingaruka z’igihe kinini umubyeyi aba amaze atwite. Uko umwana akura mu nda niko agenda yagura inda, uko inda igenda yaguka rero niko n’imitsi yayo igenda ikurura uruti rw’umugongo. Icyo gihe rero uruti rw’umugongo rumenyera kumera uko, kuko biba bimaze iminsi myinshi ariko rumeze, umubyeyi aribwa ariko bitari cyane. Iyo amaze kubyara rero, ya mitsi yakururaga irarekura maze rwa ruti rw’umugongo rwari rumaze kumenyera, rukabura ikirufata nibwo umubyeyi atangira kumva ubwo buribwe bukabije. Si uburwayi rero kuko nyuma y’ikindi gihe nanone umugongo urongera ukamenyera bityo n’uburibwe bugashira ariko umubyeyi atabyitondeye byamuviramo uburwayi budakira” Ni iki se umubyeyi asabwa kugira ngo ubwo buribwe bugabanuke kandi atanangirije umugongo we? Dr Rulisa yakomeje agira ati “Ibyo umubyeyi yakora ni byinshi ngo agabanye uburibwe, ariko icyo nabagiramo inama ni ugukora ubuvuzi ngororamubiri (physiotherapy), gusa ku bo bidashobokera kubera impamvu zitandukanye, bo bagomba kuruhura umugongo mu gihe kitari munsi y’ibyumweru bitandatu. Iki gihe agomba kukimara ahanini aryamye, yabyuka akicara ahantu hamuguye neza akirinda ikintu cyose gituma yunama, kuko uretse no kuba bimubabaza bituma atinda gukira n’uruti rw’umugongo ntirukomere neza. Gukanda umugongo ukoresheje amazi ashyushye byo rero n’ubwo bigabanya uburibwe ntacyo bifasha mu gukiza umugongo, ariko nanone ntacyo biwutwara.” Urubuga mumtobeparty.com narwo rutanga inama kubyo umubyeyi yakora ngo yoroshye uburibwe bw’umugongo aho bavuga ko ibyiza ari uko umubyeyi yirinda gukora cyane ariko nanone ntatume umugongo we uba umunebwe ahubwo akawukoresha imyitozo ngororamubiri yoroheje, nko gutembera n’amaguru buhoro buhoro no koga (natation), agomba kandi kuryama kuri matela nzima itavuna umugongo, kurya indyo yuzuye kandi agahaga neza yirengagije iby’umubyibuho n’ibindi bituma yirinda kurya, kwambara isutiye ibasha kuzirika neza amabere ye aba yagize uburemere bunini kubera amashereka ndetse akanaha umwana abandi bakamumufasha kugira ngo yirinde umunaniro ukabije. Bavuga kandi ko ngo atari byiza ko umugore uri muri ibi bihe agira ibitekerezo byinshi, kuko bivuna ubwonko kandi muri icyo gihe buba bukora ku bice byinshi by’umubiri birimo uwo mugongo, amashereka n’ibindi. Ni byiza rero ko abantu bari kumwe nawe bamurinda ibimutera gutekereza cyane, bakamuha umwanya akaruhuka bihagije.

title: Dr Murugu uvura yifashishije ibimera yabwiye abifuza gutakaza ibiro mu gihe gito ko bacikanwe
content:
Nyuma y’amezi akabakaba abiri ashize afunguye ishami ry’ivuriro ’Murugu Herbal Clinic’ i Kigali, umunya-Kenya, Dr Murugu wubatse izina mu kuvura indwara zitandukanye yifashishije ibimera, arahamagarira abanyarwanda gukomeza kumugana kuko abafitiye imiti ibafasha mu ngeri zose. Kugeza ubu Dr Murugu ufite ubunararibonye bw’imyaka 20 mu kuvurisha imiti gakondo, amaze gufasha abanyarwanda bayoboka ivuriro rye I Nyarutarama aho avuga ko abo akunze kwakira ari abafite indwara zo mu nda nka amibe, igifu n’izindi ndwara zishamikiyeho. Abandi bamugannye kandi bagahabwa imiti ibafasha gukira harimo abarwaye asima, umuvuduko w’amaraso, diyabeti, tifoyide ndetse na buruserosisi (brucellosis) itaramenyekana cyane hano mu Rwanda. 

Dr Murugu yubatse izina muri Kenya, ubu arimo gukorera no mu Rwanda Uyu muganga nyuma yo kubona ko hari benshi bibasiwe n’umubyibuho kandi bifuza kunanuka ariko bikabananira, arimo kubabwira ko baramutse bamugannye nabo yabafasha ku buryo mu gihe kitarenze ibyumweru bibiri baba banyuzwe n’imiterere y’umubiri wabo. Tubibutse ko uretse izi ndwara twavuze ruguru, ibitaro bya Dr Murugu bivura indwara zirenga 200 harimo n’iz’ubuhumekero muri rusange, indwara zikunze kwibasira igitsinagore nk’imihango itaza neza, indwara zo mu myanya myiyororokero y’ibitsina byombi n’izindi zitandukanye. Muri izi ndwara harimo izikira mu gihe cy’amezi ane, ukwezi kumwe, ibyumweru bitanu, ibyumweru 3, ibyumweri bibiri, iminsi 25, iminsi 6, iminsi 3 ndetse n’izitwara amasaha 6.

Ibitaro bya Dr Murugu biherereye i Nyarutarama Ku bifuza kugana ibitaro bya Murugu Rwanda Clinical bahamagara kuri numero igendanwa 0783786569.

title: Kamonyi : Hari abakirarana n’amatungo batinya ubujura bwayakorerwa araye hanze
content: Abaturage bo mu mirenge ya Mugina na Rukoma yo mu karere ka Kamonyi bavuga ko bigoranye gucika ku ngeso yo kurarana n’amatungo cyane cyane amagufi mu gihe mu duce batuyemo hakigaragara ubujura butuma batinya ko nayo matungo bayaraje hanze yakwibwa. Mu gihe leta y’u Rwanda ishishikariza abanyarwanda kutararana n’amatungo mu rwego rwo kwita ku isuku no guhangana n’ingaruka z’isuku nke zirimo indwara za hato na hato cyane cyane amavunja n’izindi, ingo 1965 zo mu karere ka Kamonyi baracyararana n’amatungo. Mukabahizi wo mu murenge wa Rukoma yagize ati "Byagorana ko iyi ngeso yacika kuko akenshi abararana n’amatungo biterwa nuko baba batinya ubujura bwa hato na hato bukorerwa muri aka gace ubwo rero bizasaba kuduhindura ariko bizagorana.” Kayitesi Alice, Umuyobozi w’Akarere we avuga ko akurikije aho bavuye naho bageze iki kibazo kizacika burundu gusa ngo iki kibazo kizacika binyuze muri gahunda y’ibiraro by’umudugudu kuko ngo byoroshye gushakira hamwe umutekano w’amatungo kurusha uko umwe yabikorera amatungo ye. Mu magambo ye yagize ati "Ibikumba by’umudugudu (ibiraro rusange) ni gahunda twatangiye kuko bizafasha abaturage kurindira hamwe umutekano w’amatungo yabo nubwo kubyumva bizagorana bizasaba kubigisha bihoraho ngo nibura bumve akamaro ko kuvana amatungo mu mazu babamo.” Mu rwego rwo gukangurira abaturage kugira isuku, akarere ka kamonyi gafite gahunda yitwa igitondo cy’isuku aho buri wa Kabiri ubuyobozi bwo mu nzego z’ibanze bujya ahahurira abantu benshi bakabigisha gahunda y’isuku n’uburyo bwo kuyitaho.

title: Umwana w’imyaka 10 yapfuye nyuma yo kurwanira ku ishuri
content: Raniya Wright, umwana w’umukobwa wari ufite imyaka 10 y’amavuko wigaga ku ishuri ribanza rya Forest Hills riherereye muri Caroline y’Amajyepfo yapfuye azize ibikomere yakuye mu mirwano yagiranye na mugenzi we ku ishuri. Uyu mwana ngo yashyamiranye na mugenzi we ku mugoroba wo kuwa Mbere w’iki cyumweru. Raniya ngo yahise ajyanwa igitaraganya kwa muganga ’aho yari yataye ubwenge ariko akibasha guhumeka’, gusa ngo nyuma yo kugezwa kwa muganga yaje guhita yitaba Imana. Kugeza ubu ntiharamenyekana impamvu yateye aya makimbirane gusa polisi yahamije ko nta ntwaro yakoreshejwe muri uko kurwana. Ku rundi ruhandi undi munyeshuri barwanye, yahagaritswe ku kigo mu gihe iperereza rikomeje. Abinyujije kuri konti ye ya Facebook, nyina wa Raniya yanditse ko akeka ko umwana we yahohotewe. Abayobozi bo ntibemeza ayo makuru. Raniya yasobanurwaga nk’umwana wari umunyeshuri mwiza, ukunda kwandika, kuba ari kumwe n’inshuti ze no gukina basketball.

title: Kamonyi: Abavuye Iwawa barahamagarirwa kwishyira hamwe bakerekwa uburyo bafashwa
content:
Ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Kamonyi burahamagarira abavuye mu Kigo Ngororamuco cya Iwawa kwishyira hamwe bagafashwa kwihangira imirimo bagendeye ku masomo bahakuye. Akarere ka Kamonyi ni kamwe mu dufite urubyiruko rwagororewe mu Kigo Ngororamuco cya Iwawa, ariko ababashije kugaruka mu miryango bagashyira mu bikorwa ibyo bigiyeyo ni mbarwa. Ubwo umunyamakuru wa Kigalipost.com yasuraga agakiriro ka Bishenyi gaherereye mu Murenge wa Runda yahasanze bamwe mu rubyiruko rwavuye Iwawa bahakorera. Bamwe baragerageza kwiteza imbere bashyira mu bikorwa imyuga bize, abandi ni abakarani gusa ngo babuze ibikoresho byo gukora imyuga bize mu gihe hari n’abandi bivugwa ko basubiye mu ngeso mbi zirimo kunywa ibiyobyabwenge. Nkundimana Regis ukomoka mu Murenge wa Jabana mu Karere ka Gasabo, akaba yaragiye gushakishiriza akazi mu gakiriro ka Bishenyi nyuma yo kuva Iwawa, avuga ko yagowe no kubura ibikoresho. Ati "Nkora akazi k’ubukarani, ibyo nize ntabwo nabashije kubishyira mu bikorwa kubera nta bushobozi."

Nkundimana Regis yagororewe i Iwawa Ngo hari bagenzi be basubira kwijandika mu ngeso mbi zatumye bajya kugororerwa Iwawa, ahanini kubera kubatwa n’ibiyobyabwenge bagera hanze bakananirwa gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo bigishijwe. Asaba ko bahabwa ibikoresho by’ibanze kugira ngo bibafashe gutangira gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo bigiye Iwawa. Ati "Icyifuzo mfite, baratwigishije baduha uburere bwiza n’imyuga twize bimwe na bimwe umuntu agenda abimenya ndetse n’ibyo utazi aba bakuru bacu baba barabikoze mbere bagenda bakunganira ariko icyo njye numva cya mbere ni uko badutera inkunga bakaduha ibyo bikoresho, kuko burya iyo ufite igikoresho n’umuntu aguha akazi ashingiye ko ufite ibikoresho nta waguha akazi utabifite." Bizimana Yozefu, na we wagororewe Iwawa akanahigira umwuga w’ububaji avuga ko nyuma yo gutaha akabura ibikoresho yahisemo kwihangira umurimo wo gutwaza abaguze mu gakiriro ka Bishenyi. Ati "Iyo umuntu aguze ndamutwaza. Ibikoresho bari kuduha ku Karere nta byo twabonye, tuhageze baratubwiye ngo keretse utanze ingwate ukagwatiriza ibyawe, njyewe mpita nitahira sinakongera gusubirayo, mpita nza hano aba ariho mpangira umurimo. Njye ntwaza abantu, iyo mbonye nka 2000frw mpita nitahira."

Bizimana Yozefu yagororewe Iwawa ahigira ububaji ariko ubu ni umukarani mu gakiriro ka Bishenyi Bizimana avuga ko bigoye kwihuza n’abandi bavuye Iwawa kuko bigoranye kumenya aho baba. Ati"Abantu bose twavanye yo nta numwe mbona. Ubwo se njye najya guhiga umuntu ntabona? Batubwiye kwibumbira hamwe ariko njye simbabona, rero mpitamo kwiyizira hano." Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Kamonyi Kayitesi Alice agaragaza ko bamwe mu bahawe ibikoresho mbere babigurishije basubira mu ngeso mbi, ubu bakaba barimo gushakisha uru rubyiruko rwose rwanyuze Iwawa hagamijwe kubabumbira hamwe mu makoperative kuko aribyo babona bishobora gutanga umusaruro wisumbuyeho. Ati "Turimo kubabumbira hamwe mu makoperative kuko abenshi suko ibyo bikoresho tutabitanze ahubwo harimo abo twabihaye twibwira ko bigiye kubafasha kwiteza imbere ahubwo bakabigurisha bakagenda bakazongera bagafatirwa mu mihanda." Yongeyeho ati "Uburyo bwiza twabonye bwo kugira ngo tubashe kubacunga ni ukubabumbira hamwe bagafashanya kandi tukajya tubaha ibiganiro bose bari hamwe. Ubu rero nicyo gihe turimo hanyuma tukazabafasha kubona ibikoresho bijyanye n’ibyo bize. Twatanze amatangazo mu nsengero, mu midugudu, kuko n’intonde zabo tuba tuzifite, umwana uwo ari we wese wabonetse yariyandikishije kandi igikorwa kiracyakomeje." Ngo hari amafaranga ari mu ngengo y’imari, n’andi y’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Igororamuco (NRS) yo kubishingira yashyizwe muri SACCO, aya akaba ariyo baheraho babatera inkunga. Abatarenze 20 bari muri koperativu ihinga ibitoki i Rukoma n’abandi bari i Ngamba bakora ububaje n’ubwubatsi batarenze batatu, nibo kugeza ubu bamaze kwiteza imbere muri aka Karere. Uwamahoro Prisca Umuyobozi wungirije w’Akarere ka Kamonyi ushinzwe Imibereho myiza avuga ko babashishikariza kujya mu makoperative kuko bafashanya kandi bakaba banabona inkunga yisumbuyeho. Ati"Umurongo mwiza ni ukwishyira hamwe kuko iyo ari umwe ntarenza ibihumbi 500 frw ariko iyo ari benshi ashobora no kugera muri miliyoni 10frw."

Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Kamonyi Kayitesi Alice (iburyo) hamwe n’Umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage, Uwamahoro Prisca (ibumoso) Mu Karere ka Kamonyi hari urubyiruko 793 rwanyuze mu kigo ngororamuco cya Iwawa, kuri ubu abavuye yo bizwi aho baherereye mu miryango yabo babumbiwe mu makoperative ni 519, hari abatazwi aho bari banganana 262, abaje bagasubira Iwawa ni 8, abavuyeyo ariko bakongera bakagwa mu bindi byaha bihanwa n’amategeko ni 4. Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Igororamuco (NRS) kivuga ko buri kwezi Leta y’u Rwanda itanga miliyoni 80 z’Amafaranga y’u Rwanda mu Kigo Ngororamuco cya Iwawa.

title: Muhanga: Ubuyobozi buravuga ko mu kuvugutira umuti indaya ziri gusenya ingo, bahereye mu muryango
content:
Umujyi wa Muhanga ni umwe mu mijyi iri gutera imbere cyane, gusa iri terambere rigenda rinakuza indi mico itari myiza, uburaya bukaba umwe mu myuga mibi igaragara hano ibangamiye abaturage n’iterambere ry’umuryango muri rusange. Iyo utembera uyu mujyi mu masaha y’ijoro ugenda ubisikana n’abakobwa n’abagore bari ku mihanda bategereje abagabo babagura bakajya kwinezeza mu buriri. Umenya ko iki kibazo gihangayikishije iyo uganiriye na bamwe mu baturage bakaguha ubuhamya bwa zimwe mu ngo zimaze gusenyuka cyangwa zikajegajega. Kamikazi ni umwe mu bagore twaganiriye ukorera muri uyu mujyi, yatubwiye ko atajyaga aha agaciro uburaya buvugwa i Muhanga kugeza ubwo inshuti ze zatangiye gusenya ingo. Yagize ati "Njyewe mfite urugo narinzi rubanye neza, ariko umugabo atangira kujya yirarira mu tubari n’izi ndaya kugeza ubwo urugo rusenyutse, hari n’abandi mbona amaherezo bazasenya, uburaya hano buri kwiyongera cyane." Umumotari ukorera muri uyu mujyi utifuje ko dutangaza izina rye, nawe yatangarije Kigali Post ati "Indaya zo rwose zirahari zirara mu mihanda yaba indaya z’abagore yaba indaya z’abagabo bararikesha tujya duhura mu gitondo iyo tuzindutse tuje mu kazi."

Uburaya ngo bugeze ku rwego rwo gusenya ingo nyinshi i Muhanga Ku ruhande rw’ubuyobozi bw’Akarere buvuga ko koko iki ari kimwe mu bibazo bibuhangayikishije, aho burimo bugerageza guhuriza hamwe abakora uyu mwuga w’uburaya bakabigisha ariko by’umwihariko mu guca iki kibazo bifuje guhera mu miryango. Umutoniwase Kamana Sosthène, Umuyobozi w’Ishami ry’Ubuzima mu karere ka Muhanga avuga ko iki kibazo babizi ko gihari ndetse kugeza ubu hari bamwe mu bakora uyu mwuga babashije kwigisha barawureka bashaka ibindi bakora, bakaba barimo bigisha n’abandi. Ati "Dufite indaya zikijya ku muhanda n’abagabo baza kuzishaka, ibyo rero bituruka kuri bwa bwumvikane buke buri mu muryango. Bivuga ngo ubukangurambaga turabukora muri rusange, ntabwo turimo kujya kuri aba ng’aba (abicuruza) gusa, ahubwo turahera mu miryango tugasaba padiri urimo kwigisha abagiye kurushinga, pasiteri, umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa ugiye kubasezeranya tukabasaba ko babigarukaho." Nyuma yo kubashyira hamwe bagakangurirwa kuva mu buraya bagashaka ikindi bakora, ubu hari ishyirahamwe rya bamwe mu bavuye mu Buraya ryitwa ’Tubusezerere’. Aba, nkuko umuyobozi ushinzwe ubuzima mu karere yakomeje abidutangariza, ubu bafite ibyuzi by’amafi, abandi banyamuryango babo bakora isuku mu mujyi, mu gihe abandi bahawe ibibanza mu isoko. Ati "Ubwo rero ni urugendo dukomeje kuburyo numva ko tuticaye, ariko kuba byibuza tubasha kubahuza tukanabatumira mu nama tukababona icyo ni icyerekana ko hari icyo turi gukora." Umutoniwase Kamana Sosthène yaboneyeho kugira inama umuryango muri rusange mu guca uburaya n’ingaruka zabwo mu muryango. Ati " Turigisha umuryango kuko batabonye abakiliya nabo ntibakomeza. Abo bagabo turabasa ngo nibagumane nabo bashakanye kandi tugasaba nabo bagore bashakanye n’abo bagabo nibongere bagaruke bamenye uko bita ku mugabo." Umwuga w’uburaya mu karere ka Muhanga akenshi ngo abawujyamo babiterwa no kuba batewe inda z’imburagihe, umuryango ukabatererana bakajya kwishakishiriza ubuzima. Mu bakora uyu mwuga wo kwicuruza 94 bapimwe virusi itera SIDA, 14 basanze ari bo babana n’iyi virusi.

title: Kamonyi: Bamwe mu babyeyi bafite abana bafite ikibazo cy’imirire mibi bacumbikiwe mu bitaro
content:
Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Rukoma giherereye mu Murenge wa Rukoma mu Karere ka Kamonyi, gicumbikiye ababyeyi 10 n’abana babo bafite imirire mibi ikabije, kugira ngo babashe kwitabwaho by’umwihariko. Kuri iki kigo Nderabuzima cya Rukoma hubatswe igikoni aho batekera aba bana. Iyo winjiyemo uhasanga ibiribwa bitandukanye birimo imboga, ibijumba, ibishyimbo, igikoma n’ibindi. 

Iki ni igikoni cyubatswe aho ababyeyi bigishirizwa uburyo bategura amafunguro y’abana babo

Inzu bacumbikiwemo Uwiduhaye Jeannette wo mu kagali ka Mwirute, afite umwana uri mu mutuku avuga ko yabitewe n’ubukene bwo kujya gushakisha amafaranga bigatuma umwana arya igihe kidakwiriye. Aganira na Kigali Post yagize ati"Ubu ndabona ntakibazo umwana yiyongera, twabyakiriye neza, nanjye nimpava nzamukurikirana kuburyo atazongera gusubira inyuma kuko nabonye agaciro kabyo." Yongeraho ati "Umwana twamusigaga tukagenda, akageza saa sita atararya, ariko ubu kubera ko umuntu aba amwitayeho amwicaye iruhande, ubona hari icyo ari kwiyongeraho, ingamba mfite ni izo gukurikirana umwana, nzajya ndeba ukuntu namukurikirana byihariye ntabwo nzongera gutererana umwana."

Icyumba abana babamo Umutoni Clementine Umuganga ushinzwe imirire mu bitaro bya Remera-Rukoma, asobanura ko aba babyeyi bataza hano kurya gusa ko ahubwo icy’ibanze kigamijwe ari uguhindura imyumvire. 

Umutoni Clementine Umuganga ushinzwe imirire mu bitaro bya Remera-Rukoma Ati "Bariga, tubafasha guhindura imyumvire kugira ngo ibyo bakorera hano bazanakomeza kubikora nibasubira iwabo, tukumva ko bizabafasha ko abana batazasubira inyuma mu mirire kuko hano dufite tekinike nyinshi tubigisha mu mitekere, uburyo bategura ibiryo by’abana batari bazi cyangwa batajyaga bitaho, tukabereka ko bigirira akamaro abana kandi nabo baba babibona ko abana biyongera mu gihe gito."


Mu bubiko hari ibiribwa bitandukanye harimo ibitera imbaraga, ibyubaka umubiri n’ibiwurinda Kayitesi Alice, Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Akarere ka Kamonyi avuga ko gahunda yo gukurikirana abana bafite imirire mibi ikabije ku bigo nderabuzima iri mu karere kose. Ati "Ikigambiriwe kurushaho ntabwo ari ukuvura abana gusa, ahubwo harimo no kwigisha ababyeyi b’aba bana. Igikomeye cyane kirimo ni uburyo dufatanije n’ibitaro ndetse n’abajyanama b’ubuzima n’abakozi bashinzwe imirire tubanza tukazamura imyumvire y’umubyeyi n’inshingano afite ku mwana we." Kayitesi akomeza avuga ko babigisha kugira isuku, bakabigisha amasaha umwana arira, gutegura indyo yuzuye n’ibindi. 

Kayitesi Alice, Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Akarere ka Kamonyi Uyu muyobozi avuga ko ibyo bagaburira aba bana biva mu bafatanya bikorwa b’akarere barimo abanyamadin in’indimiryango ariko kandi abaturage nabo bakangurirwa kumva ko icyo gikorwa ari ingirakamaro kandi hakenewe uruhare rwa buri wese bityo ariu wejeje ibishyimbo, ufite ibijumba, n’ibindi akaba yabizana. Kayitesi avuga ko hari amafaranga bashyizemo mu ngengo y’imari y’Akarere agera kuri miliyoni eshanu(5,000,000frw) yo kubakorera za pepiniyeri z’imboga bagakorerwa uturima tw’igikoni ariko bagashishikarizwa no kubyigiriramo uruhare hanyuma Akarere kakabunganira. Imibare igaragaza ko Akarere ka Kamonyi gafite 36% ku bijyanye n’abana bangwingiye (aho umwana atareshya n’imyaka yagakwiye kuba afite),naho igipimo cy’ibiro ugereranije n’imyaka umwana afite bari kuri 17%, na 4% ku bafite ibiro bike ugereranije n’uburebure, iyi ari nayo mirire mibi ishobora kuvurwa igakira, kandi itanitaweho umwana ashobora kungwingira igatuma abana nayo ubuzima bwose.

title: Nyagatare: Umugabo yasanganywe imirambo y’abana bane mu nzu
content:
Umugabo w’imyaka 30 wo mu Murenge wa Katabagemu muri Nyagatare yasanganywe imirambo y’abana bane b’abaturanyi mu nzu ye yiyemerera ko ari we wabishe. Umuvugizi w’Urwego rw’Ubugenzacyaha (RIB), Modeste Mbabazi, yabwiye IGIHE dukesha iyi nkuru ko amakuru yamenyekanye kuri uyu wa Mbere ubwo umwe mu baturanyi yaburaga umwana we. Ngo hari hashize iminsi abana babura muri ako gace ariko abaturage batangira gukeka uyu mugabo babimenyesha inzego z’umutekano. Mbabazi ati “Kubera ko hari abandi bana bari bamaze iminsi baburirwa irengero, bagiye kumusaka iwe basanga hari indi mirambo itatu ahita yemera ko ari we wabishe ariko ntasobanura impamvu yabyo. Turacyakurikirana kugira ngo adusobanurire neza icyatumye yica abo bana.” Uyu mugabo yahise atabwa muri yombi kugira ngo akurikiranwe.
Umuvugizi wa RIB yavuze ko imirambo yasanzwe mu rugo rw’uyu mugabo ari iy’abana b’abaturanyi badafite icyo bapfana. Muri abo bana harimo uwari ufite imyaka itanu, uw’imyaka irindwi, uw’imyaka umunani n’uw’imyaka 13 y’amavuko. Ingingo ya 107 mu gitabo cy’amategeko ahana ibyaha mu Rwanda ivuga ko umuntu wica undi abishaka, aba akoze icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko, ahanishwa igihano cy’igifungo cya burundu.

title: Kubyara ubazwe (Césarienne) bishobora gushwanyura umura. Dore ingaruka nyinshi zabyo
content: Iyo umubyeyi atwite, ntasiba gutekereza ku munsi azabyariraho, aho abenshi batekereza ku buribwe bukabije bubategereje ndetse kubera amagambo babwirwa n’abandi ku buryo inda iryana cyangwa se nabo ubwabo baramaze kubyara bazi uburyo ibise bibabaza. Ubwoba bwo kuribwa rero nibwo butuma benshi bihitiramo kubyara babazwe ariko bakirengagiza ko n’ubwo batumva uburibwe iyo babyara hari ingaruka nyinshi kandi zikomeye bigira ku buzima bwabo. Twaganiriye na Dr Rulisa, inzobere mu kuvura indwara z’abagore atubwira zimwe mu ngaruka ziterwa no kubyara ubazwe. Twatangiye tumubaza niba kubyara ubazwe ari inama yagira umubyeyi utinya ibise. Yagize ati “Reka reka rwose nta muntu n’umwe nagira inama yo kubyara abazwe. Ubundi ibi ni uburyo dukoresha mu gihe cyihutirwa, ku munota wa nyuma ari uko tubona byananiranye mbese tubona ko ubuzima bw’umwana cyangwa ubw’umubyeyi we buri mu kaga." Yongeyeho ati "Ntabwo gutinya ibise ari impamvu yo kubyara ubazwe. Abantu bagomba kuzirikana ko ibise ntawe byishe ariko kubyara ubazwe byo byishe benshi. Iyo umuntu bamubaze aba afite ibibazo. Ashobora kugirira ibibazo mu ibagwa harimo n’impanuka z’ibinya, ikindi kandi iyo abazwe aba agabanyije amahirwe manini yo kuzongera kubyara neza." Ku bivugwa ko iyo wabyaye ubazwe bigabanya umubare w’abana uba ushobora kubyara, Dr Rulisa yagize ati “Nta mubare twavuga, kuko n’ubundi ntawe tugira inama yo kubyara abana benshi. Ariko iyo ubyaye kabiri ubagwa, ubwo ntibiba bishoboka ko wazigera ubyara neza, ubwo izindi nshuro zose uba uzabyara ubazwe. Kubyara ubazwe bishobora kwangiriza umura (nyababyeyi) Dr Rulisa yagize ati “Uko ugenda ukomeza kubyara ubazwe niko uba wiyongerera ibyago byo gushwanyuka umura, kuko inkovu yaho igenda yoroha. Ntabwo ari byiza rero kubagwa, ababyeyi bose nabagira inama yo kubyara neza keretse mu gihe babigiriwemo inama na muganga kubera ibibazo yabonye bishobora kugirira nabi ubuzima bw’umwana n’umubyeyi.” Urubuga baby-magazine.fr rutubwira ko mu ngaruka zindi ziterwa no kubyara ubazwe, harimo no kuva bikabije bishobora gutuma umuganga akuramo umura burundu mu rwego rwo kurinda umubyeyi ngo adapfa.

title: Asipirine, ikinini kigabanya ibyago byo kurwara kanseri zitandukanye
content: Asipirine ni umuti ukunze gukoreshwa mu kugabanya uburimbwe ndetse na bimwe mu bimenyetso by’uburwayi nk’umuriro. Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’abaganga batandukanye b’inzobere mu kuvura kanseri bwagaragaje ko uretse kwifashishwa muri ibi bihe by’uburibwe, burya ngo gufata Aspirine buri munsi bigabanya ibyago byo kurwara kanseri zitandukanye cyane cyane iy’urwagashya. Dr Harvey Risch inzobere mu buvuzi bwa kanseri avuga ko akenshi kanseri zikunze kunanirana kuko benshi bazivuza batinze kandi kanseri y’urwagashya ikiba ariyo ikunze kugorana cyane, nyamara kandi umuntu aramutse afashe asipirine n’ubwo yaba nke cyane buri munsi ngo byamugabanyiriza ibyago byo kuyirwara. Mu bushakashatsi bwakorewe ku basaga 1500, barimo n’abamaze kurwara kanseri, byagaragaye ko gufata asipirine bigabanya ibi byago kuri 50 ku ijana ndetse n’ubwo umuntu yaba yaramaze kurwara iyi ndwara akaba yakongera iminsi ye yo kubaho mu gihe abimenye itaragera kure. Gufata asipirine kandi bigabanya n’ibyago byo kurwara kanseri y’urura runini ndetse n’iy’umwijima.

title: Umunya-Kenya, Dr Murugu arahamagarira abanyarwanda bafite indwara zananiranye kumugana ku ivuriro rye rishya i Nyarutarama
content:
Hashize iminsi mike inzobere mu kuvura yifashishije ibimera, Dr Murugu umaze imyaka 20 akorera muri Kenya, yaguriye ubuvuzi bwe mu Rwanda aho yafunguye ibitaro i Nyarutarama aho yiyemeje gufasha abanyarwanda bafite indwara zananiranye. Uyu mugabo aratangaza ko nyuma yo gusanga abanyarwanda benshi bafite ibibazo byo mu nda muri rusange biterwa na amibe, yiyemeje ko nyuma yo kubavura azajya abagira inama y’uburyo bakwirinda bakoresheje amazi.

Dr Murugu ubwo yazaga gutangiza ivuriro mu Rwanda Ati "Twasuye ibitaro byinshi bitandukanye tubasha gukusanya amakuru mpamo agaragaza ko ari ikibazo. Si mu Rwanda gusa no muri Kenya nuko, gusa hano mu Rwanda turateganya kwagura ubu buvuzi aho mu byumweru bine izajya iba ikize." Yakomeje ati "Nk’uko tubikora muri Kenya, turateganya kubigeza no ku banyarwanda, hari benshi bafite ibibazo cyane cyane ibyo mu nda (...) muri rusange biterwa na amibe tubivura dukoresheje ibimera ndetse iyo tumaze kuvura abantu amibe tunabagire inama y’uburyo bakwirinda bakoresheje amazi ku buryo itagaruka."

title: Nyagatare: Yatwikishije umugore Essence amuziza ko yamuteranyije n’umukunzi we
content: Mugisha Bahati w’imyaka 17 wo mu Murenge wa Matimba, Akarere ka Nyagatare, yatwitse umugore witwa Mutuyimana Odyle, ashya umubiri wose amuziza ko yatumye umukunzi we amwanga. title: Gatsata: Umurambo w’umuturage wakuwe mu musarani
content: Mu mudugudu wa Kanyonyomba, Akagari ka Nyamugari ho mu Murenge wa Gatsata, inzego z’umutekano zifatanije n’abaturage bakuye mu musarani umurambo w’umusore wari umaze icyumweru yarabuze. Umuseke dukesha iyi nkuru wanditse ko bamuvanye muri uyu musarane w’imbaho ahagana saa yine z’igitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki 04 Gashyantare 2019. Birakekwa ko yaba yarishwe akajugunywamo, iperereza ryatangiye Inkuru y’iki kinyamakuru ikomeza ivuga ko uyu musore abo muri aka gace bari bazi ku izina rya Thacien gusa, abaturanyi batangaje ko inkuru y’uko yaba ari mu musarani w’aho acumbitse yamenyekanye nijoro kuri iki cyumweru. Hari hashize icyumweru baramubuze. Jacques Ntabanganimana yabwiye Umuseke ko Thacien, wari usanzwe acuruza boutique hafi aho, anakodesha muri iki gipangu, ariko atari ahamaze igihe kinini. Ati “Ni umusore w’ikigero cy’imyaka 27 hano yari ahamaze ukwezi n’igice. Yari umusore ubona witonda, ukunda gusenga, yari hafi gukora ubukwe. Yari yarabuze kuva muri week end ishize.” Abatuye hano bavuga ko uyu musore Boutique ye yari aherutse kuyigurisha n’undi muntu ariko ngo bagirana amakimbirane n’uwo wayiguze kuko ngo yari amusigayemo 200 000Frw. Bavuga ko aya makimbirane yigeze guteza ikibazo bagera no ku Murenge birangira bumvikanye uko azishyurwa. Umwe mu baturanyi be utifuje ko  amazina ye ashyirwa hanze, avuga ko mu nzu y’uyu musore naho basanze mu bintu yari afitemo nta kintu na kimwe kikirimo. Umuyobozi w’Umudugudu wa Kanyonyomba Ndatengwa Etienne yabwiye Umuseke ko iyi nkuru yamenyekanye nijiro nyiri igipangu agiye mu musarani ngo agezemo asanga isazi ni nyinshi cyane yumva n’umunuko udasanzwe, maze ngo bareba mu musarani abona ikintu bakeka ko ari umuntu. Ndatengwa ati “ Yitabaje inzego z’umutekano aho yagiye kubivuga kuri polisi ko yabonye umurambo mu musarani y’urugo rwe , nibwo muri iki gitondo nibwo baje kumukuramo basanga ari umusore wapangaga muri urwo rugo nyirizina. Ubu umurambo watwawe na Polisi bawujyanye ku bitaro bikuru bya Polisi kuwusuzuma, kandi ubu hahise hatangira gukorwa iperereza kugira ngo bamenye ababiri inyuma .” Mu bari gukorwaho iperereza harimo nyiri igipangu hamwe n’uwaguze Boutique n’uyu musore Thacien bajyanywe n’Urwego rw’Ubugenzacyaha,RIB.

title: Ubukwe bwa Mukaperezida n’umusore arusha imyaka 27 bwatashye, ikinege cye kitabishaka -AMAFOTO
content:
Ubukwe bwa Mukaperezida Clotilde w’imyaka 48 na Kwizera Evariste w’imyaka 21 bwavuzweho byinshi bwashyize burataha, kuri uyu wa Kane basezerana imbere y’amategeko mu Murenge wa Musha, mu Karere ka Rwamagana. Ni ubukwe bwatashywe n’imbaga y’abantu barimo abaturutse hirya no hino bagiye kwihera ijisho abageni, bamwe bakajujura ko bagiye kubana ku mpamvu zirenze urukundo rusanzwe. Kwizera yazamuye ukuboko atewe ishema no kuba Mukaperezida amubereye umugore imbere y’amategeko. Mukaperezida nta kuzuyaza yazamuye ukuboko, mu ijwi rituje yemeza ko Kwizera amubera umugabo nk’uko amategeko abiteganya. Uyu mugore utuye mu murenge wa Gishali muri Rwamagana akora akazi ko kuvura yifashishije imiti ya Kinyarwanda. Ni akazi yakuyemo ibipangu bibiri birimo icyo abanamo na Kwizera n’ikindi akoreramo ahazwi nko kwa Karangara. Kwizera Evariste we nibwo akirangiza amashuri yisumbuye, aracyari ku rugerero. Ngo nyuma yo gusezerana, ateganya kwiga Kaminuza akabifatanya no kwita ku mugore we. Ubukwe bwagezwe intorezo n’umwana wa Mukaperezida… Nk’uko bigenda mu gusezerana mu mategeko, Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Musha, Muhoza Théogene, mbere yo gusezeranya Kwizera na Mukaperezida yabanje kubaza niba nta muntu ufite impamvu zatuma bombi badashyingiranywa. Umukobwa w’ikinege wa Mukaperezida witwa Uwamariya Francine, washatse ubu ufite abana babiri, yahise azamura ukuboko, ajya imbere avuga ko ku myaka 31 afite atakwemera ko umusore w’umwana ajya kuvimvira mu mitungo se yaruhiye.
Ati "Impamvu ntifuza ko bavanga umutungo ni uko nibawuvanga bizatuma banavanga umutungo wa Data kandi batabyemerewe." Mukaperezida wahise afatwa n’ikiniga, ahawe umwanya yemera ko uwo mwana ari uwe ariko ko atumva impamvu adashaka ko asoza urugendo rw’urukundo yatangiye mu mahoro. Yavuze ko yarihiye umukobwa we amashuri akamuha n’inzu, akamushakira akazi ndetse akamuha inka n’ibibanza bibiri. Ati "Siniyumvisha impamvu umwana wanjye watambamira ko nshakana n’uwo nakunze kuko n’abaturanyi barabizi, umutungo mfite ni uwo nishakiye ntabwo nigeze nsezerana na Se w’uyu mwana.” Hifashishijwe igitabo cy’amategeko, Umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa yahise avuga ko ibyatambamira ugushakana ari ibintu bibiri; Icya mbere ni ukubura kwa kimwe mu bisabwa byerekeye ugushyingirwa, icya kabiri ni imiziro yerekeye ugushyingirwa. Yahise atesha agaciro ubusabe bwa Uwamariya kuko bamutumye ibimenyetso byerekana ko koko imitungo yose Mukaperezida afite ari iya Se akabibura. Ibirori bihumuje ubwo Kwizera na Mukaperezida bari imbere y’imbaga, benshi batunguwe no kubona bombi basomana umunwa ku wundi. Mu kiganiro gito na IGIHE, umwe mu babyeyi ba Kwizera bavuze ko ashyigikiye umwana we kuko yujuje imyaka y’ubukure, bityo bagomba kumwubahira icyo yahisemo. Ati "Kuva kera na kare iyo umwana wawe yujuje imyaka y’ubukure, iyo afashe icyemezo ugomba kukimwubahira kuko aba azi impamvu yagifashe, natwe ntabwo twatambamira urukundo rwabo kuko bose barakuze, ikindi kuba barahuje icyemezo cyo kubana ni uko babyumvikanye neza." title: Burera: Umunyeshuri w’imyaka 12, yafatiwe ku ngufu muri ‘dortoire’ mu gicuku
content: Inkuru dukesha Umuseke ivuga byaba byarabaye ku cyumweru nijoro ubwo umwana w’umukobwa w’imyaka 12 wiga ku kigo cy’amashuri cya APAPEDUC Bungwe yafashwe ku ngufu agasambanywa ari mu cyumba aho n’abandi barara. Iki kinyamakuru gikomeza kivuga ko hari amakuru yemeza ko uyu mwana wiga muwa mbere w’amashuri yisumbuye yasambanyijwe ahagana saa saba z’ijoro aryamye muri ‘dortoire’ bigakorwa n’abantu b’igitsina gabo babiri. Iri shuri riherereye mu mudugudu wa Rweru, Akagali Bungwe, Umurenge wa Bungwe ngo ntabwo rizitiye. Ndetse ni kimwe mu byo ryahise risaba gukemura mu nama n’abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze yahise iba. Jean de la Paix Manirakiza Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Bungwe yabwiye Umuseke ko ngo umwana yababwiye ko yafashwe sa saba ubwo yari aryamye n’abandi. Kugeza ubu ngo abakekwaho iki gikorwa kibi babiri ngo ni babiri barafashwe barafungirwa kuri station ya Police ya Bungwe. Umuyobozi w’Ikigo cya APAPEDUC Bungwe Arsène Dukundigena yabwiye Umuseke ko abafunzwe bakekwaho gukora kiriya cyaha ari abazamu babiri bamaze imyaka itanu bakora kuri kiriya kigo. Dukundigena avuga ko kumenya uko binjiye muri dortoire bagasambanya uriya mwana bikiri mu iperereza bityo ko ntacyo yabitangazaho. Ku rundi ruhande ariko, avuga ko umwana wahohotewe ngo atigeze atabaza nubwo yari kumwa na bagenzi be baryamye. Ngo yari asanzwe ari umunyeshuri w’imico myiza, nta myitwarire mibi bari bamuziho. Uyu muyobozi avuga ko ikigo ayobora kidafite uruzitiro rukomeye kuko ngo kizitiwe na senyenge

title: Gasabo: Umugabo yishe umugore we amushyingura mu rugo
content: Umugabo w’imyaka 21 y’amavuko wo mu Kagari ka Butare, Umurenge wa Nduba mu Karere ka Gasabo, yatawe muri yombi akekwaho kwica umugore we w’imyaka 20 bari bamaranye ibyumweru bibiri, akamushyingura mu rugo. (inkuru dukesha IGIHE) Amakuru avuga ko mu gitondo cyo ku wa Mbere ku tariki ya 7 Mutarama 2019 ari bwo uyu mugabo yabwiye abaturage ko yabuze umugore we, agakeka ko yahukanye. Byatumye abaturanyi be bibaza cyane uburyo uwo mugore wakoraga akazi k’ubudozi yagiye adasezeye n’umuntu n’umwe, ntihanagire n’umubona. Gusa mu gushakisha baje kubona ko yamwishe, akamushyingura mu cyobo yari yaracukuye nmu mbuga. Umwe mu baturage yagize ati “Batubwiraga ko ku Cyumweru yagiye ku kazi aho yadoderaga, ngo nyuma asezeraho abo yakoranaga nabo ngo muramuke ni ah’ejo, ubwo n’ejo ntago yagarutse baramubura.” Undi yagize ati “Yishe uriya mugore yarabigambiriye kuko uriya mwobo yawucukuye umugore yagiye mu kazi, yadodaga mu gasanteri i Butare, amaze kuwucukura ku Cyumweru nijoro nibwo yamwishe noneho ku wa Mbere bucya avuga ngo umuntu yamubuze yagiye.” Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’umusigire w’Umurenge wa Nduba, Harerimana Jean Damascène, yabwiye IGIHE ko ku wa Kabiri tariki ya 14 Mutarama ari bwo mu rugo rw’uyu mugabo hagaragaye icyobo yashyinguyemo umugore we. Ati “Uwo mugabo n’uwo mugore bari bamaranye ibyumweru bibiri, ku tariki ya 7 niho yaburiwe irengero noneho abaturage bakamubaza ngo ko aha habaga umugore tukaba tutamubona arihe? Rimwe ngo yagiye iwabo ubundi agatangira kurya indimi.” Yakomeje avuga ko nyuma baje kubona iminsi itangiye kwicuma bafata icyemezo cyo gukorera umuganda mu rugo rwe, ku wa Mbere w’iki cyumweru. Ati “Bahakoze umuganda noneho babona matola iriho amaraso ariko yagiye apfura kugira ngo asiribanganye ibimenyetso nyuma baza kubona icyobo yari yacukuye yashyizeho amakoma n’ifumbire ariko kiriho isazi nyinshi, bagicukuye bamusangamo n’imyenda ye.” Hari amakuru ko uwo mugabo nyuma yo kwica umugore we, yahise ajya gucyura uwo babanaga mbere akaza kwahukana. Uwo mugabo yahise ashyikirizwa Urwego rw’Ubugenzacyaha, RIB, ndetse n’abandi bagabo babiri barimo Se ushinjwa kudatanga amakuru akimenya ko umukazana we yishwe, n’umuturanyi wamubonye arimo gucukura icyobo yatabyemo nyakwigendera, ntatange amakuru.

title: RDB yanditse ishoramari rirenga gato miliyari 2 z’amadorali ya Amerika mu 2018
content: Umwaka wa 2018 wasize Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB) cyanditse imishinga mishya y’ishoramari 173 ikorera mu Rwanda ifite agaciro ka miliyari 2.006 z’amadorali ya Amerika mu gihe u Rwanda rwari rwihaye intego ya miliyali 2 z’amadorali muri uyu mwaka. Ibi bivuze ko hiyongereyeho miliyoni 331 z’amadorali ya Amerika ni ukuvuga 20% ugereranije n’ishoramari ryari ryanditswe na RDB mu 2017. Muri uwo mwaka wa 2017 ishoramari ryari ryanditswe ryinjije miliyari 1,675. Mu ishoramari ryabaruwe muri rusange mu 2018, habarurwa 26% by’imishinga y’ibicuruzwa mu mahanga. Mu zindi nzego harimo inganda, amabuye y’agaciro, ubuhinzi n’ibworozi byo handitswe 57% by’ishoramari rishya. Izindi nzego zakuruye ishoramari harimo ubukerarugendo, ubuzima, ikoranabuhanga na serivisi z’ubucuruzi. Mu ishoramari rishya ryanditswe mu 2018, 49% ryihariwe n’abashoramari b’imbere mu gihugu mu gihe ishoramari ry’abanyamahanga rigizwe na 47%. Ishoramari rihuriweho n’abanyagihugu n’abanyamahanga ryo ryari rigizwe na 4% ry’ishoramari muri rusange ryo mu 2018. Ubigereranije n’umwaka wa 2017 ishoramari ry’abanyagihugu ryari 28%, iry’abanyamahanga rikaba 62% naho iryo bahuriyeho rikagirwa na 10%, ibi bikaba bigaragaza ko ishoramari ry’abanyagihugu ryiyongereye cyane. Bamwe mu bashoramari baranze umwaka wa 2018 bagashora imari iri hejuru ya miliyoni 70 y’amadorali ya Amerika, harimo Emerald Park ltd; Millennial Construction Ltd; Fonds d’innovation du Rwanda; Jali Transport na Mara Phones. Mu yindi mishinga y’ingenzi y’ishoramari ryanditswe mu 2018 harimo Andela Software Development umushinga wa Pan African Hub ukorera mu Rwanda, uruganda rutunganya coltan rwa PRG rwo muri Macedonia, ikinyobwa gishya cya Bralirwa kengewe mu Rwanda cy’inzoga izwi ya Heineken, uruganda rwo muri Maroc rutunganya inyongeramusaruro, uruganda rwa MasterSteel rukora amabati n’ibikoresho by’ubwubatsi, uruganda rukora inzitiramibu rwa Vision Garments rwo mu Rwanda, uruganda rw’ibikoresho by’ubwubatsi rwo mu Buhinde, ikigo gitunganya amabuye y’agaciro Luna Smelter cyo mu Rwanda hamwe n’uruganda ruteranya imodoka rwa Volkswagen. Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere, RDB cyasobanuye ko aka gaciro k’imishinga yanditswe mu 2018 kabazwe hitawe ku mafaranga umushoramari yagaragaje ko azakoresha mu myaka itanu iri imbere, yaba ayo asanganywe cyangwa umwenda. RDB yanagaragaje ko byibuze imyaka itatu ari yo rugero fatizo kugira ngo umushinga utangire gukora neza. Ubwo yavugaga kuri iyi mibare, Guy Baron, Umuyobozi Ushinzwe Ishoramari muri RDB yavuze ko bishimiye urwego bagezeho. Guy Baron yagize ati "Mu myaka 8 ishize ishoramari ryanditswe mu Rwanda ryavuye kuri miliyoni 398 z’amadprali ya Amerika mu 2010 rigera kuri miliyari 2 n’imisago mu 2018. Umwaka ushize twarengeje miliyar ebyiri z’amadorali ya Amerika ku nshura ya mbere mu mateka y’igihugu." Yakomeje agira ati "Ibi bigaragaza ko u Rwanda rugaragara nk’ahantu heza ho gukorera ubucuruzi, guhanga udushya no kubaka igicumbi cyo kugea ku mahirwe y’ishoramari ku mugabane wa Afurika." Guy Baron kandi yavuze ko ’uku kuzamuka ku ishoramari ryandikwa mu gihugu ari umusaruro w’ubushake bwa Guverinoma y’u Rwanda binyuze muri RDB ku gira ngo u Rwanda ruhinduke amahitamo ya mbere ku ishoramari’. Yanavuze ko ’ibi byanatumye mu 2018 u Rwanda rushyirwa ku mwanya wa 29 ku isi nk’ahantu horoshye mu gukorera ishoramari ndetse n’umwanya wa kabiri muri Afurika’.

title: Kuki havuka abahungu benshi kurusha abakobwa buri mwaka?
content: Guhera mu ntangiriro ry’ibarura mu kinyejanya cya 19, imibare igaragaza ko havuka abana benshi b’abahungu kurusha abakobwa nyamara amabarura y’abakuze akagaragaza ko umubare w’abagore ari munini kuruta uw’abagabo. Guhera mu mwaka wa 1838, ubwo hashyirwaga hanze imibare yambere y’iri barura, umubare w’abana b’abahungu bavuga uhora usumbaho gato umubare w’abakobwa mu bihugu byose uretse mu Bushinwa n’Ubuhinde usanga byo biri ku kigero cyo hejuru cyane; ahandi hose ku isi havuka abahungu 105 ku bakobwa 100. Bivugwa ko ari ibintu byikora gutyo gusa, bigasa n’aho isi ihitamo ko havuka abahungu benshi kurusha abakobwa kuko ngo burya bagira ibyago byinshi byo gupfa kurusha abakobwa, ari na yo mpamvu nubwo havuka abahungu benshi, iyo hakozwe ibarura ry’abantu bakuze, usanga abagore ari benshi kurusha abagabo. "Mu bihe byose, ku myaka yose n’ahantu hose ku isi, umugabo aba afite ibyago byinshi byo gupfa kurusha umugore" Ibyemejwe na Pr David Steinsaltz wo muri kaminuza ya Oxford. Bivuze rero ko isi ihitamo ko havuka abana benshi b’abahungu kurusha ab’abakobwa kugira ngo mu bukuru bazabe byibura bari ku kigero kimwe. Ikindi gitekerezwa nk’impamvu y’uku kuvuka kw’abana b’abahungu ari benshi kuruta abakobwa, ni ibijyanye no gusama no gutwita. Burya ngo uko umugore utwite yarya kose, uko yakwitwararika kose, uko yarwara kose n’uko yakwivuza ngo inda y’umuhungu iba ifite amahirwe menshi yo kuvuka neza kurusha iy’umukobwa.

title: Philippines: Abantu 68 bamaze guhitanwa n’imvura idasanzwe -Amafoto
content:
Mu gihugu cya Philippines abantu 68 nibo kugeza ubu bamaze kubarurwa ko basize ubuzima mu mvura idasanzwe yibasiye iki gihugu kuva mu cyumweru gishize ndetse ngo iyi mibare ishobora kwiyongera nkuko abayobozi babitangaje kuri uyu wa Mbere. 57 muri aba bapfuye baguye mu gace k’imisozi ka Bicol mu majyepfo ashyira uburasirazuba bwa Manille mu gihe abandi 11 baguye ku kirwa cya Samar. Benshi mu bapfuye barohamye abandi bahitanwa n’inkangu. Ku ikubitiro abantu 22 nibo babanje gutangazwa ko bapfuye ariko uko iminsi yigira imbere iyi mibare igenda yiyongera. Claudio Yucot umuyobozi ushinzwe kurinda abaturage ibiza mu gace ka Bicol yavuze ko "afite ubwoba ko imibare yakwiyongera kuko hari uduce batarabasha kugeramo." Byibuze abantu 17 kugeza ubu baburiwe irengero mu gihe abandi barenga ibihumbi 40 bavuye mu byabo kubera iyi mvura idasanzwe n’umuhengeri. Iyi mvura idasanzwe yiswe ’Usman’ yibasiye Philippines kuva ku wa Gatandatu tariki ya 29 Ukuboza 2018. Ntabwo wari uherekejwe n’umuyaga ukomeye nkuko byagenze ku biza by’inkubi y’umuyaga ya typhons. title: Umugore yijugunye muri Nyabarongo ahetse umwana
content:

title: Kamonyi: Abantu 5 bari baheze mu nda y’isi amasaha asaga 30, bakuwemo ari bazima -Amafoto
content:
Mu Ijuru hari Imana, umuturage wa Kagame koko arakomeye,...iyi ni yo yari intero ikaba n’inyikirizo y’abaturage b’i Rukoma bari bishimiye kubona bagenzi babo batanu bakurwa mu kirombe giherereye mu kagari ka Mwirutse mu Murenge wa Rukomo, ari bazima nyuma y’amasaha asaga 30 bahezemo. Ni igikorwa cyagizwemo uruhare rukomeye n’Ingabo na Polisi by’u Rwanda bafatanije n’abaturage bakoze ijoro n’amanywa maze kuri iki Cyumweru ahagana saa tanu n’iminota 48 z’amanywa babasha kurokora ubuzima bw’aba bantu bari baheze muri iki kirombe kuva ku wa Gatandatu tariki 29 Ukuboza 2018 ahagana saa kumi zo mu rukerera.


Polisi, ingabo n’abaturage bose batahirije umugozi umwe bafatanya kurokora aba bantu Umunyamakuru wa Intyoza.com, ikinyamakuru cyakurikiranye iki gikorwa ari nacyo dukesha iyi nkuru yanditse ko ’aba bantu batangiye gushakishwa kuva saa munani z’amanywa yo kuwa 29 ukuboza 2018 ariko bikageza saa sita z’ijoro byanze ndetse bamwe mu bari muri iki gikorwa cyo kubashaka bagahitamo kuharara, aho bazindukiye bakomeza gushakisha kugeza babashije kubakura mu musozi wari wabamize.

Nyuma yo kubavanamo bagihumeka umwuka w’abazima, bahise bajyanwa kwa muganga Bamwe mu baturage ngo bakibona abakuwemo ari bazima, batereye amajwi hejuru barasakabaka, bamwe bati "mu Ijuru hari Imana!", abandi bati "Umuturage wa Kagame koko arakomeye!" Mu kuvuga ibi, Intyoza yanditse ko ngo babishingiraga ku imbaraga zidasanzwe babonye Polisi, ingabo hamwe n’izindi nzego bashyize mu gushakisha aba bantu kuko kuva bagwirwa n’ikirombe inzego zose zarahabaye, ziraharara, zirahirirwa zishaka ibikoresho bishoboka kugeza bakuwemo.

Hifashishijwe imashine eshatu zicukura za sosiyete y’ubwubatsi Horizon Uretse ibikoresho birimo imashini nini n’amatara Polisi n’ingabo bagiye gukura i Kigali, abaturage banatangajwe no kubona abakoreshaga izi mashini kabuhariwe mu gucukura bashaka aba bantu, Polisi n’Ingabo bagiye kubagurira amata n’ibindi ngo bongere akabaraga mu gikorwa barimo. Agaciro k’uyu muturage wa Kagame kavugwa n’abaturage kaje kurushaho kugaragara ngo ubwo babonaga umuyobozi w’ingabo Col Gishayija, Guverineri w’Intara y’Amajyepfo Gasana Emmanuel, ukuriye Polisi ku ntara y’amajyepfo ndetse n’umukuru wa polisi ushinzwe ibikorwa by’ubutabazi bose baje kwifatanya n’aba baturage kandi bakahava abantu babonetse. Kayitesi Alice, Meya w’Akarere ka Kamonyi yavuze ko aba batanu bose bavanywe mu kirombe bari bameze neza, gusa bajyanywe kwa muganga kugira ngo basuzume niba nta kibazo kihariye cy’ubuzima bafite. Uyu muyobozi yavuze ko iyi mpanuka ishobora kuba yatewe nuko iki kirombe kidatunganyije neza nkuko amabwiriza agenga ibirombe abiteganya. Kugeza ubu Urwego rushinzwe ubugenzacyaha rukaba rwamaze guta muri yombi uwari nyir’iki kirombe.

Abaturage bagiriwe inama yo kwitondera gucukura mu birombe nta byanyombwa byuzuye bafite Mu butumwa inzego zose zatanze, basabye abaturage kudashyira ubuzima bwabo mu kaga, kumenya ko agaciro k’ubuzima bwabo ariyo maboko y’igihugu. Ko badakwiye kuyashyira mu kaga bajya gucukura mu birombe nta byanyombwa byuzuye bafite bibasha gutuma bikingira ibyago nk’ibyababayeho none. Amafoto:Intyoza.com

title: Amagambo yuje imitoma ya Ange Kagame ku mugabo wamusabye ndetse no ku muryango we
content:
Kuri uyu Gatanu tariki ya 28 Ukuboza 2018 ni bwo Ange Ingabire Kagame umukobwa rukumbi wa Perezida wa Repubulika y’u Rwanda, Paul Kagame yasabwe n’umukunzi we Bertrand Ndengeyingoma. Nyuma y’umunsi umwe uyu muhango ubaye, Ange I.Kagame abinyujije kuri konti ye ya Instagram yafashe umwanya ashimira abamushyigikiye, by’ubwihariko ababyeyi be, basaza be, abakobwa bamugaragiye ariko noneho agenera ubutumwa bwihariye umukunzi we. Mu butumwa buri mu rurimi rw’icyongereza, tugenekereje mu kinyarwanda, Ange Kagame yagize ati "Ku rukundo rw’ubuzima bwanjye . Nishimiye gukomezanya ubuzima nawe. Ku buzima bwacu n’ubw’ibihe byose.."

Umutoma wa Ange Kagame ku mukunzi we Bertrand Ndengeyingoma (Billy)

Yanashimiye basaza be

Abakobwa bari bamuherekeje nabo yabashimiye uburyo bamubaye hafi muri uyu muhango ndetse no mu bindi bihe byashize

Ange I.Kagame yanashimiye ababyeyi be ku byo bamukorera byose Ange I. Kagame afite imyaka 25 y’amavuko, akaba ari umwana wa kabiri mu bana bane ba Perezida Paul Kagame na Jeannette Kagame aho akurikira imfura y’uyu muryango, Yvan Cyomoro. Amashuri ye yayize mu Rwanda no muri Amerika aho yasoreje icyiciro cya gatatu cya Kaminuza muri Smith College muri Northampton, Massachusetts.

Abageni n’abari babagaragiye (Parrain na marraine) Bertrand Ndengeyingoma afite imyaka 26 y’amavuko. Hagati muri uyu mwaka ni bwo amakuru y’urukundo hagati ye na Ange I.Kagame yatangiye kuvugwa cyane. Uyu musore uzwi cyane nka Billy ni umuhungu wa Cyrille Ndengeyingoma usanzwe yikorera ku giti cye. Amashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye yayize i Kigali naho kaminuza ayiga muri Amerika muri Massachusetts University of Technology aho yize Civil Engineering mu cyiciro cya kabiri, icyiciro cya gatatu cya Kaminuza yiga Architecture muri iyi Kaminuza.


Ifoto y’urwibutso igaragaraho basaza ba Ange I.Kagame hamwe n’abari bagaragiye Billy

Abageni n’ababyeyi babo bari bishimiye uyu munsi ukomeye mu mateka y’abana babo n’imiryango yabo Tubibutse ko uyu muhango wo gusaba no gukwa wabereye mu rugo rwa Perezida Kagame ruherereye mu ntara y’Uburasirazuba, mu karere ka Rwamagana, Umurenge wa Muhazi Akagari ka Ntebe mu mudugudu w’Amagaju.

title: NTIBISANZWE: I Rusizi, umukecuru usatira imyaka 70 aratwite
content:
Mu mudugudu wa Rubumba, akagali ka Nyange, mu murenge wa Bugarama, akarere ka Rusizi haraturuka inkuru itangaje y’umukecuru urimo usatira imyaka 70 dore ko azayuzuza muri Mutarama 2019, kuri ubu utwite inda y’imvutsi. Uyu mukecuru witwa Mukandutiye Placide wabonye izuba muri Mutarama 1949 yari asanzwe ari umubyeyi w’imbyaro 12. Ngo agisama iyi nda ntabwo yahise amenya ko atwite kuko yabanje kugira ngo n’ikindi kibazo cy’uburwayi afite mu nda ajya kwa muganga agiye kwivuza, ariko agezeyo batahura ko atwite.

Uyu mukecuru arakuriwe Mu kiganiro yagiranye na radio na tv1 dukesha iyi nkuru, uyu mukecuru yavuze ko kwa muganga bamubwiye ko atwite umuhungu ndetse nta gihindutse azibaruka muri Mata 2019. Mu magambo ye yagize ati "Inda ndayifite kuko nabonye ibimenyetso byayo. Nabibonye mu kwezi kwa munani. Iyi nda nari nayitwaye mu 2000 noneho iza guhirima, ihirimye ejobundi mbona ibimenyetso, numva ntangiye kubyimba inda, ni bwo najyaga kuri islamique barapima, bampa icyemezo cyo kujya i Gihundwe, ngeze yo barambwira ngo harimo umwana."

Mukandutiye Placide ahamya ko iki ari igitangaza yasezeranijwe n’Imana Uyu mukecuru akomeza avuga ko kugeza ubu na we umwana amwumva kandi nta kindi kibazo afite. Yemeza ko uyu mwana agiye kubyara mu zabukuru ari igitangaza yari yarasezeranijwe n’Imana. Ati "Nanjye ubu aho bigereye ndamwumva aracura, bambwiye ko mu kwa kane ari bwo nzabyara. (...) Ni ibitangaza by’Imana kuko yajyaga imbwira ko izankorera ibitangaza simenye ari ikihe. Noneho wenda n’icyo cy’iki kije." Umugabo we, umusaza Ndimubanzi Omar David na we avuga ko uretse ibyo babwiwe kwa muganga, na we uyu mwana amwumva mu kiryamo bityo nta kabuza bamwiteguye ndetse yamaze no kumushakira izina azitwa. Ati "Kwa muganga babonye ko atwite umwana w’umuhungu kandi nanjye ubwanjye ndamwumva mu kiryamo. (...) Azitwa Tuyishime!"

Ndimubanzi Omar David, umugabo wa Mukandutiye Ku ruhande rw’inzobere mu kuvura abagore, Dogiteri Nyirinkwaya Jean Chrysostome ubwo yabazwaga niba ibi bisanzwe ko umukecuru w’imyaka 70 atwita, yavuze ko ari ubwa mbere abyumvise. Asa nk’utangaye yagize ati "Ibyo bintu umbwiye ndumva ari amayobera." Uyu muganga ufite ibitaro bya La croix du sud byubatse izina mu kubyaza abagore, yasobanuye ko uretse mu 2008 yabonye umugore w’imyaka 54 atwita nta kindi gihe yigeze ahura n’umugore ukuze atyo utwite. Ati "Njyewe icyo nzi gusa mu 2008 nabonye umugore w’imyaka 54 waje kwivuza ikibyimba mu nda, tumusuzumye dusanga afite inda iri hafi kuvuka, ariko ku myaka 70 Mana yanjye ibyo ntabwo mbizi." Yakomeje avuga ko niba koko uyu mukecuru atwite ’umwana azamubyara, ariko atanga inama ko icyaba cyiza ari uko yazabagwa’.

Uyu mukecuru yari asanzwe yarabyaye imbyaro 12 Dr Nyirinkwaya avuga ko ubundi gucura ku mugore nta gahunda bigira kuko hari abacura vuba, cyane cyane abagore bahora mu mihangayiko (stress) y’ubuzima, akazi, urugo, abana n’ibindi, abandi bo bakarenzaho gato, ariko hakaba n’ibihe bidasanzwe kuko hari abashobora gucura ku myaka 32 gusa y’amavuko hakaba n’abandi bagira imyaka 57 bakijya mu mihango.

title: Menya uko wakwita ku ruhu rw’umwana kuva akivuka
content: Buri mubyeyi wese, usanga yifuza ko umwana we agira ubuzima bwiza. Uruhu rw’umwana rero ni ikintu gikunze kuvugwaho byinshi, aho usanga ababyeyi badasobanukiwe neza n’uburyo barwitaho mu buryo bwiza kandi bworoshye. Kubw’iyo mpamvu rero usanga hagenda hakwirakwizwa amakuru atandukanye ku buryo bwakoreshwa mu kwita ku ruhu rw’umwana akivuka, ku masabuni n’amavuta meza yo gukoresha, ku nshuro zo kumwoza n’ibindi nk’ibyo. Twegereye umuganga w’abana mu bitaro bya Muhima, Dr Rivuzwe, atubwira ubundi uko umubyeyi yagombye kwita ku ruhu rwe kuva akivuka. Ese umwana agomba koga ryari? Dr Rivuzwe yatubwiye ko atari byiza koza umwana mu masaha ye ya mbere yo kuvuka. Yagize ati “Umwana ukivuka, aba avuye mu bushyuhe bwo mu nda ya nyina, guhita umudubika mu mazi rero si byiza kuko bituma imbeho yo hanze ibona urwaho, ugasanga wicishije umwana imbeho kandi kutamwoza ntacyo byari bimutwaye.” Urubuga naitreetgrandir.com rusobanura ko iyo umwana akivuka abaganga bamuhanagura, bakamwambika. Ngo ni byiza rero ko utegereza andi masaha yewe n’umunsi umwe cyangwa ibiri ukabona kumwoza. Gusa ukita ku isuku ya bimwe mu bice by’umubiri we, aho uba ugomba kumuhanagura neza mu maso, ukoresheje agatambaro gatose (gant), ndetse ukanakamuhanaguza ku kibuno mu gihe umuhinduriye ibyahi (couches/pampers). Dr Rivuzwe nawe yashimangiye ibi aho yavuze ko burya atari ngombwa ndetse atari na byiza koza umwana buri munsi, ko ibyiza ari ugutegereza byibura iminsi 2 cyangwa 3. Yagize ati “Uruhu rw’umwana nicyo gice kiba ari kinini kurusha ibindi byose bisigaye. Niyo mpamvu rero ari ngombwa ko urwitaho ukoresheje ubushishozi. Impamvu atari byiza koza umwana buri munsi kuko bituma uruhu ruba rufungukiye kwakira ibirujyaho birimo na mikorobe zakwanduza umwana. Ikindi kandi nuko bikonjesha umwana bikaba byamutera ubundi burwayi. Ni byiza rero kumwoza nyuma y’iminsi 2 cyangwa 3 mu rwego rwo kwirinda ibyo byose.” Umubyeyi yakoresha iki yita ku ruhu rw’umwana? Amasabuni, amavuta, puderi(poudre) n’ibindi nk’ibi nibyo ababyeyi bagenda babazanya, bibaza ibyaba byiza ku ruhu rw’abana babo. Dr Rivuzwe yagiriye ababyeyi inama y’uko bagomba kwirinda amasabuni ahumura. Ati “ Amasabuni menshi abamo imiti itandukanye yo kwita ku ruhu. Uruhu rw’umwana rero rwo ruba ari umwimerere ntabwo ruba rukeneye iyi miti, ahubwo iyi miti irarwangiriza. Buriya isabuni nziza zo koza abana ni izi abantu bameshesha imyenda, niyo atabamo bene iyo miti. Ku bijyanye n’amavuta yo kumusiga, ubundi umwana ukivuka si byiza kumusiga. Ubusanzwe abantu bakuru twisiga ngo uruhu rwacu rworohe. Uruhu rw’uruhunja rero rwo ruba rworoshye nta mpamvu yo kongeraho amavuta, gusa uko agenda akura, ureba ko uruhu rwe rugenda rukomera, bityo ukaba aribwo utangira kumusiga kandi nabwo ugakoresha amavuta atarimo imiti myinshi, ahubwo amavuta meza ni aya bita ‘vaseline’ atagira impumuro.”

title: Kigeme: Abasigajwe inyuma n’amateka banduye SIDA bazahazwa no kubura indyo yuzuye
content:
Abasigajwe inyuma n’amateka barwaye SIDA batuye mu mudugudu wa Gakoma, Akagari ka Kigeme mu Murenge wa Gasaka ho mu Karere ka Nyamagabe bavuga ko babura ibiribwa bikize ku ntungamubiri byabafasha kutazahazwa n’ingaruka zo kunywa iriya miti ikomeye bafata. Aba bakaba basaba Leta ubufasha bwihariye kuko batorohewe, nubwo bashima ko bahabwa imiti igabanya ubukana. Kagoyire, umugore ufite ubwandu bwa Virusi itera Sida, ufite abana 4 arera wenyine kuko umugabo we yamutaye, mu kiganiro yagiranye na KIGALI POST yagize ati "Imiti ndayibona. Ikibazo ni uko umuntu ayibona atabona ibiryo bihagije bisa nko kwiyahura. Umubiri nta ntege uba ufite, imbeho iratwica."

Kagoyire usaba ko Abasigajwe inyuma n’amateka barwaye SIDA bakwitabwaho by’umwihariko Avuga ko hari ubwo umuntu yibagirwa kuyinywa kubera kwihugiraho cyane atekereza aho ari bukure icyo ashyira mu nda. Ati "Hariho n’igihe wibagirwa kuyinywa kubera uba wacanganyikiwe mu mutwe." Undi witwa Mukamana avuga ko kuba nta munsi y’urugo afite bituma adahinga ngo yeze hanyuma imyaka yejeje imufashe kunoza imirire, agahamya ko imiti idahagije kugira ngo barengere amagara yabo.

Juliette Yankurije ni umwe mu babashije kwiga amashuri 6 yisumbuye batuye muri uyu mudugudu w’Abasigajwe inyuma n’amateka Juliette Yankurije, umuyobozi w’imwe muri Koperative z’ababumbyi muri uyu mudugudu, ahamya ko hari bamwe mu basigajwe inyuma n’amateka banga kujya gufata imiti kuko baba banga ko nibayinywa ntibarye iri bubagwe nabi ndetse akanenga bamwe mu bakozi mu  nzego z’ibanze n’abo kwa muganga babaheza kuko basigajwe inyuma n’amateka. Ubusanzwe ibigenerwa abantu bafite ubwandu bwa Virusi itera Sida ntabwo bishingira ko umuntu ari iki n’iki cyangwa akomoka aha n’aha, bishingira ko abikeneye kandi muganga yamaze kwemeza ko ageze kuri urwo rwego rwo kubihabwa nk’uko byanashimangiwe n’Umuyobozi Mukuru w’akarere ka Nyamagabe. Uwamahoro Bonaventure uyobora akarere ka Nyamagabe yagize ati "Habaye hari uwabyimwe kubera ko yasigajwe inyuma n’amateka cyaba ari ikibazo gikomeye cyane. Hari ibipimo bifatwa, hari imiryango (association) barimo n’indi miryango iharanira uburenganzira bwabo unakorera mu nzu batijwe n’akarere. Kuba rero haba hari ufite ikibazo cyo kuvangurwa, icyo cyaba ari ikibazo twagomba gushakisha tugahindura iyo myumvire."

Uwamahoro Bonaventure, Meya w’akarere ka Nyamagabe Uyu muyobozi ariko yanavuze ko kuba uwasigajwe inyuma n’amateka cyangwa kurwara Sida bitaguha uburenganzira bwo guhita ufashwa mu buryo bwihariye kuko bifite inzira zisobanutse binyuramo, agaragaza ko hari n’abibwira ko kuba ari aba n’aba bituma bagomba gufashwa.

title: Huye: Hari abagabo bumva ko uburinganire bwaje kubangamira ubutware bwabo mu ngo
content:
Nyuma y’uko u Rwanda rutangije gahunda yo gushishikariza abaturage kumva no kubahiriza ihame ry’uburinganire, hari bamwe mu bagabo batuye mu Karere Huye mu murenge wa Karama bavuga ko basanga iri hame ryaratumye abagore babo babasuzugara ndetse bamwe barifashe nk’uburyo bwo kubaka ubutware. Bruno Keretsimana we yemeza ko ririya hame rishyira imbere abagore kurusha abagabo. Ngo nubwo we bitaramubaho uyu mugabo ugeze mu zabukuru ahamya ko abibona cyane mu baturanyi. Yemeza ko abagabo barenganywa n’abagore babo ariko bakirinda kujyana ibibazo byabo imbere y’ubuyobozi ngo bubarenganure bagahitamo kwicecekera.

Bruno Keretsimana avuga ko ihame ry’uburinganire ryambuye abagabo ubutware "Nta nyundo iremera ngo irute uwayicuze! Nonese ubu ko abagore basigaye bashaka kuremera ngo bikuze barute abagabo kandi Imana yaradushyizeho (abagabo)? Imana yagugaye umufasha wawe ngo mwumvikane mufashanye ariko wowe ugashaka kwikuza ukajya hejuru ngo ni uburinganire. Iyo byanze rero wowe udafite intege urabyihorera, umugore akakwigiraho ibyo ashaka.", Keretsimana asobanura uburyo uburringanire bwambuye abagabo ubutware Bavuga ko basigaye barenganywa n’abagore babo bishingikirije ’Uburinganire’ Mu gusobanura uburyo abagabo basigaye bahohoterwa n’abagore babo, umuturage witwa Ntaribi Venanti aganira na KIGALI POST yagize ati “Biriho rwose, usanga hari abagore bishyira imbere, ugasanga bararenganya abagabo. Njyewe hari abo nzi benshi bakubita abagabo babo. Umugore agakubita umugabo cyangwa ugasanga afashe nk’itungo ararigurishije atamugishije inama.”
 Undi musaza nawe avuga ko uburenganzira bw’abagore ari bwo asanga buvugwa cyane mu bayobozi no mu itangazamakuru, yewe bukanitabwaho cyane kurusha ubw’abagabo, bigatuma abagabo batinya kugaragaza ihohoterwa bakorerwa. Ati:“Ukuntu biteye rero hari abagore barengana hari n’abagabo barengana, ariko uburenganzira bw’abagore bukaba aribwo bwitabwaho. Iyo wenda habaye amakimbirane usanga umugore yumvwa cyane." Ubuyobozi bw’uyu murenge wa Karama nabwo bwemeza ko kiriya kibazo gihari ariko giterwa ahanini n’imyumvire ya bamwe mu bagore n’abagabo itari yo kuri iri hame. Arsène Kabalisa uyobora Umurenge wa Karama avuga ko bo bakira abagabo n’abagore baje kubagezaho ihohotera bakorerwa, gusa agahamya ko benshi mu bamugezaho ihohoterwa ari abagore. Ibi ngo biterwa n’uko abagabo bamaze kwishyiramo imyumvire y’uko badashobora kurenganurwa, abandi bakagira ipfunwe ryo kwerura ngo bavuge ihohoterwa bakorerwa n’abagore babo.

Arsène Kabalisa, Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Karama Mu magambo ye, Arsène Kabalisa yagize ati: “Ntekereza ko nk’abayobozi dufite inshingano zo kumva buri wese yaba umwana, umugore, umugabo n’ugeze mu zabukuru. Ahubwo hari imbogamizi kuri bamwe mu bagabo kuko baterura ngo bavuge ko bahohoterwa n’abagore babo, ntibarabyumva cyane.” Avuga ko kimwe mu bibabuza kubivuga ariko niyo hagize ubivugira mu ruhame bagenzi be bamuha urw’amenyo, bakamwita inganzwa. Kabalisa avuga ko bakomeza gushishikariza abagabo kumva ko kuvuga ko bahohoterwa ari uburenganzira bwabo kandi ngo n’abaturage muri rusange bakumvishwa ko n’abagabo bashobora guhohoterwa mu buryo runaka. Ihame ry’uburinganire ni gahunda ya Leta y’u Rwanda  igamije kunoza uburenganzira n’inshingano bingana hagati y’igitsina gore n’igitsina gabo nk’uko biteganywa n’itegeko no 51/2007 ryo ku wa 20/09/2007 rigena inshingano, imiterere n’imikorere by’urwego rushinzwe kugenzura iyubahirizwa ry’uburinganire n’ubwuzuzanye bw’abagabo n’abagore mu iterambere ry’igihugu.

title: Thailand: Abana b’impanga bafite imyaka 6 y’amavuko, bashyingiranywe
content:
Aba bana b’impanga bashyingiwe mu muhango w’ababudiste (Buddhist ceremony) nyuma y’uko ababyeyi babo bemeje ntagushidikanya ko aba bombi bakundanaga mu buzima bwabo bwo hambere. Kiwi na musaza we Guitar, bombi bafite imyaka 6 bakorewe ibirori bikomeye byatwaye akayabo k’amamiliyoni menshi. Umuryango, inshuti n’abaturanyi bari baje kubashyigikira. Muri uyu muhango, hari harimo imikino itandukanye harimo n’uwo Guitar yagombaga kurenga imiryango 9 kugira ngo agere kuri mushiki we Kiwi.

 Kiwi na musaza we Guitar ubu ni umugabo n’umugore  Guitar yagombye gutanga inkwano y’akabakaba miliyoni 5 n’igice y’amanyarwanda ndetse na zahabu y’agaciro k’asaga miliyoni y’amanyarwanda kugira ngo ahabwe umugeni ndetse n’ubukwe bwe buhabwe umugisha. Guhera muri 2012, ubwo aba bana bavukaga ababyeyi babo babateguriye gushyingiranwa, dore ko mu myemerere yabo ya Buddhism, iyo umuhungu n’umukobwa bavukanye ari impanga, biba bivuze ko mu buzima bwabo bwa mbere bakundanaga, bityo bakaba bagomba gukomezanya ubuzima mu rwego rwo kwirinda imivumo n’ibindi bibazo.
