title: Umukecuru Zula Karuhimbi warokoye Abatutsi barenga 100 muri Jenoside, yatabarutse
content: Ku myaka 109 y’amavuko, umukecuru Zula Karuhimbi wari umuyoboke w’idini ya Islam, wabaye ikimenyabose kubera ubwitange budasanzwe bwamuranze mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, yitabye Imana. Ni inkuru yatangiye kuvugwa ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa 17 Ukuboza 2018 aho bivugwa ko nyakwigendera yazize uburwayi. Zula Karuhimbi yahawe igihembo na erezida wa Repubulika, Paul Kagame nk’umurinzi w’igihango. Mu 2009 ni bwo uyu mubyeyi yahawe umudari w’ishimwe kubera ubutwari yagaragaje muri Jenoside ndetse yubakiwe inzu mu karere ka Ruhango mu murenge wa Ruhango ho mu kagari ka Musamo. Mu 2015, Ubuyobozi bw’Umuryango w’Abayisilamu mu Rwanda (RMC) nabwo bwahembye Karuhimbi kubera uruhare mu kurokora Abatutsi barenga 100. Karuhimbi yakoresheje amayeri atangaje mu kurokora Abatutsi bahigwaga bari bahungiye iwe, aho avuga ko yashyiraga igisura n’isusa mu nzu ye, akanabisiga ku bikuta by’inzu ngo birye interahamwe zashakaga abantu yahishe ndetse akanababwira ko abateza Nyabingi, bigatuma bahunga badakoze umugambi mubisha wabagenzaga.

title: Sobanukirwa n’uko imiti yo kuboneza urubyaro ikora n’ukuri ku bihuha bivugwa ku ngaruka zayo
content: Nk’uko Leta y’u Rwanda ibikangurira abanyarwanda, ni ngombwa ko iyo umuntu abyaye, biba ari ibyo yatekerejeho, atari ibintu bimutunguye, mu rwego rwo gutegura ejo hazaza heza. Niyo mpamvu abantu bakangurirwa kuboneza urubyaro hakoreshejwe uburyo butandukanye, gusa benshi mu babukoresha ntibasobanukiwe n’uko bukora ndetse hari n’ibihuha byinshi bikwirakwizwa ku ngaruka zaba ziterwa n’uburyo. Mu rwego rwo gufasha abantu gusobanukirwa n’ibi, twegereye muganga ukurikirana indwara z’abagore (Gynecologue), adusobanurira byinshi ku ikoreshwa ry’uburyo butandukanye bwo kuboneza urubyaro ndetse anatumara impungenge ku bihuha by’ingaruka zaba ziterwa n’ubu buryo. Mu kiganiro twagiranye Dr Rulisa Stephen, ubusanzwe ukora muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda, ishami ry’ubumenyi mu buzima(UR/CHS), yahoze ari KHI, yatangiye atubwira uko  iyi miti ikora iyo igeze mu mubiri w’umuntu. “Ubundi iyi miti abantu bafata yo kuboneza urubyaro, ikora mu buryo butandukanye, bitewe n’uko ikoze." Uburyo bwa mbere: Imiti ikoreshwa mu guhindura imikorere y’umubiri

title: Kicukiro: Umugabo n’umugore baketsweho gusambana hitabazwa gupima amakariso yabo
content: Umugabo n’umugore bo mu Murenge wa Masaka mu Karere ka Kicukiro, bivugwa ko bose bafite abo bashakanye byemewe n’amategeko baketsweho gusambana biba ngombwa ko hitabazwa gupima amakariso yabo. Ku wa Kabiri tariki ya 4 Ukuboza 2018, nibwo uyu mugabo n’umugore bivugwa ko bacaga inyuma abo bashakanye baguwe gitumo bari kumwe bavanye ahantu bikekwa ko ari mu icumbi nkuko iyi nkuru dukesha IGIHE ibivuga. Bivugwa ko abaturage bari barabwiye umugabo w’uyu mugore ko hari umuntu ujya usambana n’uwo bashakanye. Bavuga ko uyu mugore yabeshye umugabo we ko arwaye, maze undi amutiza imodoka ngo ajye kwivuza ku Bitaro bya Masaka. Akihagera yinjijemo imodoka arayiparika ahita ahamagara iy’undi [bivugwa ko ari inshoreke ye] araza baragenda. Ababonye bagenda bahise bahamagara uwo mugabo nawe ahita afata indi modoka ajya kuri ibyo bitaro. Ahageze yahamagaye umugore we ariko ntiyitaba. Byabaye ngombwa ko ategereza, hashira igihe kigera ku isaha n’igice aba aribwo umugore we n’undi mugabo bari bajyanye baza, akibakubita amaso ati “Ndabafashe muvuye gusambana” atangira gushaka kurwana n’uwo mugabo wundi. Muri ako kanya umugore ngo yahise abwira uwo bari kumwe ngo agonge umugabo we, abashinzwe umutekano aho barahagoboka. Abari aho ntibajijinganyije kwitabaza inzego z’umutekano zifata uyu mugore n’uwo bari kumwe. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Masaka, Donatien Murenzi, yabwiye IGIHE, ko abaganga bo ku bitaro bya Masaka bakimara kubapima n’amakariso yabo bombi, yahise yoherezwa ku bitaro bya Kacyiru. Ati “Nibyo byarabaye ariko hakimara kuza inzego z’umutekano hifashishijwe ibitaro bya Masaka biba ngombwa ko babapima ku buryo nyuma banohereje amakariso yabo ku bitaro bya Polisi n’ibindi bimenyetso.” Uyu mugore n’umugabo bivugwa ko ari inshoreke ye kuri ubu bafungiye kuri Sitasiyo ya Polisi ya Masaka.

title: Burera: Umugabo yishe umugore we amutemesheje umuhoro
content: Umugabo w’imyaka 36 yishe umugore we witwa Mujawamariya Marceline w’imyaka 35, amutemesheje umuhoro. Bivugwa ko uyu muryango wari umaze igihe kinini ufitanye amakimbirane. Uyu muryango wari utuye mu Murenge Rwerere, Akagari ka Gashoro, mu Karere ka Burera. Amakuru y’urupfu rw’uyu mugore yamenyekanye muri gitondo cyo ku wa 25 Ugushyingo 2018. Abaturanyi b’uyu muryango bahamije ko bari basanzwe babana mu makimbirane ahanini ashigiye ku mitungo no kuba uyu mugabo yari azwiho guca inyuma umugore we gusa batari bazi ko bigeze aho umwe yakwica undi. Umuvugizi w’Urwego rw’Igihugu rw’Ubugenzacyaha, RIB, Mbabazi Modeste, avuga bakimara kubimenya uyu mugabo yahise afatwa ubu akaba afungiye kuri sitasiyo ya Polisi ya Rusarabuye. Ati “Tukimara kumenya ko uyu Nshimiyimana yishe umugore we, twahise dutangira kumukurikirana, yafashwe muri iki gitondo [cyo ku cyumweru] anagerageza gutoroka, ubu akaba afungiye kuri Sitasiyo ya Polisi ya Rusarabuye kugira ngo akurikiranweho iki cyaha akekwaho.” Umunyamabanga Nhingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Rwerere, Nsengimana Aloys, yavuze ko uyu muryango wari usanzwemo amakimbirane yo kutumvikana ku mikoreshereze y’umutungo wabo. Ati “ Mbere nko mu mezi umunani ashize, uyu muryango wabagamo amakimbirane akabije ashingiye ku mutungo, umugore yangaga ko umugabo awusesagura awujyana mu nshoreke, twarabaganirije ndetse banatwemerera ko bagiye kubana mu bwumvikane.” “Intandaro y’uru rupfu bivugwa ko yatewe n’uko umugabo yashakaga kwaka inguzanyo muri Sacco, umugore akamwima ibyangombwa by’ubutaka kuko atizeraga ko aya mafaranga azayazana mu rugo, ahubwo azayajyana mu ndaya.” Uyu mugabo na Mujawamariya Marceline bari bafitanye abana bane. Umurambo wa nyakwigendera wahise ujyanwa mu bitaro bikuru bya Butaro. Inkuru ya IGIHE

title: Perezida Kagame yasabye ko hafatwa ingamba zikumira amavuta atukuza
content: Perezida Kagame yasabye Minisiteri y’Ubuzima na Polisi y’Igihugu kugira icyo zikora bwangu mu gukumira amavuta ahindura uruhu. Ibi yabitangarije kuri Twitter, nyuma y’ibitekerezo byinshi byatanzwe kuri iyi ngingo aho benshi bagarukaga ku buryo byangiriza uruhu ndetse bikanatera uburwayi, naho abandi bagahamya ko binangiriza ubwiza karemano bw’abanyarwanda. Uretse kubinenga gusa, abandikaga kuri Twitter banasabaga Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ubuziranenge, RBS ndetse na Minisiteri y’Ubuzima kugira icyo babikoraho kuko benshi bakomeje kubyirunduriramo, nyamara bifite ingaruka zikomeye ku buzima bw’abantu. Nyuma Nyakubahwa Paul Kagame, abicishije kuri Twitter ye, yanditse ati " Ni bimwe mu byangiriza ubuzima. Birimo ikoreshwa ry’ibinyabutabire bibujijwe. Minisiteri y’Ubuzima na Polisi y’Igihugu bakwiye kubihagurukira vuba cyane." Amavuta atukuza benshi bita Mukorogo amaze gusakara henshi mu gihugu ndetse n’ubwo amavutsa arimo ikinyabutabire cya Hydroquinone cyangiriza cyane uruhu akaba yarabujijwe kwinjira mu gihugu, ariko ntihabura abakiyakoresha.

title: Kirehe: Umunyeshuri wakoraga ibizamini bya leta yitabye Imana
content:
Mutesi Auxilia wakoreraga ibizamini bya leta bisoza amashuri yisumbuye mu Karere ka Kirehe yitabye Imana nyuma y’igihe gito avuye kwa muganga. Uyu mukobwa w’imyaka 20 yigaga ku Ishuri rya APAPEN i Kirehe mu bijyanye n’Ubukerarugendo. Mutesi yabanje kurwarira mu Bitaro bya Kirehe biri i Nyakarambi. Abaganga babonye atoye agatege bamwoherezwa mu rugo, ari naho yaguye mu ijoro ryo ku wa 24 Ugushyingo rishyira ku Cyumweru, ku wa 25 Ugushyingo 2018. Aya makuru yemejwe n’Umukozi w’Akarere ushinzwe Amashuri Yisumbuye n’ay’Imyuga, Hatsindintwari Télesphore. Yatangarije ikinyamakuru Igihe ko “Uyu mwana yatangiranye ibizamini n’abandi ku wa kabiri. Ku wa Gatatu yagize ikibazo tumujyana kwa muganga ikizamini cy’uwo munsi ntiyagikora gusa ibindi bizamini byose yarabikoze nubwo yabikoreraga kwa muganga. Ku wa Gatanu ni bwo bamusezereye ajya iwabo kuko ari hafi. Mu ijoro ryacyeye nibwo batubikiye ko byarangiye.”
 Umurambo wa nyakwigendera wajyanwe mu bitaro mu rukerera ahagana saa cyenda z’ijoro ngo ukorerwe isuzuma, mbere yo kugarurwa mu rugo. Amakuru dukesha abo mu muryango we ni uko yarafite ikibazo cy’impyiko n’urwagashya. Yitabye Imana yari asigaje ibizamini bibiri ngo asoze amasomo.

title: Uburyo abagabo bica  buhoro buhoro ariko nta gushidikanya urukundo rw’abagore babo
content: Urukundo ruravuka, rugakura ndetse rukaba rwanapfa mu gihe rudafashwe neza. Nubwo benshi bibwira ko iyo wakunze umuntu na we akagukunda kandi akanakwemerera ko mubana ubuzima bwose biba bihagije, nyamara sibyo kuko tubona benshi batandukana cyangwa ukumva bicanye; birumvikana ko urukundo rwabo ruba rwapfuye burundu Abahanga bagereranya urukundo n’ikimera, bakavuga ko kimwe n’urubuto ruterwa mu butaka kugira ngo rwere uko bikwiye ruba rukomba kubagarirwa, rukuhirwa, rugashyirwamo ifumbire n’ibindi byinshi, n’urukundo iyo utarwitayeho rurarumba cyangwa rugapfa ndetse rukaba rwanahindura isura rukabyara urwango rukomeye. Nubwo gupfa k’urukundo byaba impamvu ituruka ku mpande zombi, yaba ku mugore cyangwa umugabo, kuri ubu tugiye kugaruka ku makosa mato abagabo bakora akaba yakwica buhoro buhoro urukundo abagore babo babakunda kugeza ubwo basigara ntana gake basigaranye ndetse bikaba byahinduka urwango. 1. Kutabaha umwanya  Biragoranye cyane ko umugore abaho mu gihe adahawe umwanya, ngo yitabweho. Ni nk’umwuka ahumeka, ibyo kurya bimutungira umutima. Nubwo waba wagize umunsi bubi ntabwo ari impamvu yo kumwima umwanya. Niba utabona umwanya wo kumwibutsa ko afite imbaraga kandi ko umukunda, birasa n’aho ibyanyu bitarimo guhura. Ibi bizatuma atangira gutekereza ko utakimukenye. Iyo utita ku mugore wawe, uba usa n’umweruriye ko iherezo riri bugufi. 2. Kutamubwira amagambo meza Abagore bakunze cyane kubwira abagabo babo ibyiza bababonamo kuko bazi neza ko ari ingirakamaro. Nyamara nabo burya baba babikeneye. Niba yagutekeye neza, niba yakiriye neza abashyitsi, niba yakoze isuku uko bikwiye, niba ari umunyabwenge, niba azi kuganira n’ibindi byiza byinshi agira; ni byiza kumwereka ko wabibonye kandi byagushimishije ndetse ukaba wanamugaragariza ko ari umugore ukubereye. 3. Kutamukorera ibikorwa by’urukundo (Romance) Benshi ibi babiheruka mu gihe cy’ukwezi kwa buki. Indabyo zihumura neza, amagambo aryoheye amatwi, uturirimbo dutuje turimo amagambo y’urukundo, impano zitunguranye n’ibindi nk’ibyo.   Bene utu tumenyetso duto duto ku bagabo ntabwo ari ingenzi cyane ndetse babibona nk’umuteto, ko atari ibintu bidakenewe. Nyamara ku bagore ni ibindi bintu kuko bimuha icyizere ko uha agaciro umubano wanyu. Umugore anezezwa cyane n’akantu gato akorewe n’umugabo we amugaragariza ko urukundo amukunda ruri mu bimuraje ishinga, bityo nawe akagira umurava wo kurusigasira. 4. Guhora umubwira amakosa ye Kunenga umuntu ukoze ikosa bishobora kubaka cyangwa gusenya. Kunenga umugore kenshi cyane nubwo yaba ari mu makosa biramubangamira cyane. Aha mwumve neza ko bidasobanuye ko utagomba kwereka umugore wawe aho yakosheje, ariko mu gihe habaye ikosa mu rugo igisubizo si uguhita umwereka ko ibibaye ariwe ntandaro yabyo, ngo n’irindi kosa niriba bigende bityo, bihore ari nk’indirimbo. Iyo bigenze bityo, umugore atangira kwibona nk’utagira akamaro. Nyamara burya umugore wawe ni umuntu mukuru, niba akoze ikosa  bikaba bigaragara ko ariwe biturutseho wabimubwira ariko ntibibe ibihoraho. Ikindi kandi mwirinde cyane kubashyiraho amakosa rusange agaragara mu rugo kuko ibyo bituma akubona nk’umunyagitugu kurusha uko akubona nk’umufasha kwisubiraho. Niba ubonye umugore wawe hari aho afite intege nke, gerageza kumwereka inzira nziza yo kwisubiraho aho kumugira umunyabyaha. 5. Kumugereranya n’abandi Ese wakwishimira ko umugore wawe ahora akugereranya n’abandi? Wakwishimira kumva ko umugabo bakorana afite ubwanwa bwiza kurusha ubwawe, ko umugabo muturanye atekereza neza kukurusha n’ibindi nk’ibyo? Ndahamya ko byakubabaza. Ni kimwe rero no kuri we. Niba utinyuka kubwira umugore wawe ko undi mugore uzi hari ibyo amurusha rwose bimuhwaniye no kumubwira ko ntacyo agikora mu rugo rwawe.  Ikindi kandi nubwo utabimubwira ariko ubitekereza burya uba watangiye kubona ko wibeshye mu mahitamo yawe bityo ukaba wabimugaragariza mu bundi buryo. Bagabo, nimureke gufata abagore banyu nk’umurima mwamaze gusarura ahubwo mubabone nk’urubuto mwateye mu murima, mugomba kwitaho mu buryo bwose kugira ngo rujye rubaha umusaruro ukwiye.

title: Kwambara inkweto ndende, uburyo bwo kuberwa ariko butera uburwayi bukomeye
content:
Bimwe mu bishimisha umuntu ni ukwambara akaberwa. Ku bagore n’abakobwa bo rero biba umwihariko kuko ari abantu bakunze guhangayikishwa n’uko bagaragara mu bandi. Uretse imyenda rero, inkweto bambara bitewe n’uko zireshya zishobora kubagiraho ingaruka ku buzima bwabo, ahanini bitewe n’uko ziba zireshya. Twifuje kumenya ingaruka iyi myambarire ishobora kugira ku buzima bwabo maze twegera Dr Mugenzi Dominiue Savio, Muganga w’inzobere mu kuvura indwara n’imvune z’amagufa ukorera ku ivuriro ‘Ejo Heza Surgical Center’ riherereye mu Kiyovu munsi ya Galaxy Hotel, maze adusobanurira byinshi kuri zo. Yagize ati “Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko uburwayi bw’ibirenge bugaragara ku bagore kurusha abagabo (inshuro 4) kandi ibi biterwa cyane cyane n’inkweto ndende abagore bambara. Muri rusange iyo umuntu ahagaze cyangwa agenda, ibiro bye byose biba byikorewe n’ibirenge. Dukurikije uko ikirenge giteye, iyo umuntu agenda nta nkweto yambaye, 43% y’ibiro bye biba byikorewe n’igice cy’imbere cy’ikirenge, naho 57% biri ku gatsinsino. Iyo agatsinsino kigiye ruguru kuri sentimetero 2 (2cm), 50% by’ibiro biba biri imbere, hanyuma na 50% bisigaye bikajya mu gatsinsino. Uko sentimetero zuzamuka rero niko ibiro byo ku gatsinzino bigenda bigabanuka bijya ku gice cy’imbere cy’ikirenge. Bitewe rero n’uko inkweto umuntu yambaye zireshya, uko agatsinsino kagenda kajya hejuru niko amagufa yo mu matako n’umugongo ahengamira imbere. Ibi rero bigira ingaruka ku buzima cyane cyane ubw’amagufa yo mu birenge, amaguru n’umugongo. Mu ngaruka ziterwa no kwambara izi nkweto harimo nko kubabara mu kagombambari (aho ikirenge gifataniye n’ukuguru), kubabara no guhinyagara mu gice cy’akaguru munsi y’intege, kubabara aho inyama z’umubiri w’umuntu ziba zitereye ku magufa, kugorama no kubyimba amagufa y’ikirenge, kubyimba ibirenge, kwangirika cyangwa gusaza vuba kw’amagufa y’ikirenge, byatera kandi n’uburwayi bw’umugongo.” Asoza, Dr Dominique Savio, yagiriye inama abagore bakunze kwambara inkweto ndende, ati “Abantu bambara izi nkweto nabagira inama yo kubigabanya, bakazambara mu gihe ari ngombwa koko kandi bakirinda kurenza byibura sentimetero 4 cyangwa 5. Mu gihe kandi bahitamo inkweto bambara, bajye bahitamo inkweto zikozwe mu buryo n’igice cy’imbere kiba kiri hejuru, bityo agatsinsino ntikazazamuka cyane. Ikindi kandi abantu bakuru bajye barinda abana bato bagikura kwambara inkweto ndende kuko bituma amagufa yangirika kandi zikagira n’ingaruka ku mikurire yabo.” Urubuga sain-et-naturel.com, rwo nyuma y’ibi byose, rugira abagore inama yo kwambara inkweto zitaremereye kuko ngo bivuna cyane amavi, ruvuga kandi ko mu gihe uzikuyemo ugomba gurora massage (massage), y’ibirenge kugira ngo uruhure amagufa n’imikaya by’ibirenge kuko biba byiriwe bikora umurimo utabyoroheye. 
Abagore rero bagomba kuzirikana ko n’ubwo inkweto ndende zibongerera ubwiza no kuberwa, ingaruka ku buzima bwabo nazo ni nyinshi kandi ngo kwirinda  biruta kwivuza.

title: Kigali: RIB yatangije iperereza k’umugore wahanutse mu igorofa ya 10 muri Hotel, bikekwa ko yiyahuye
content:
Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Ubugenzacyaha (RIB), rwatangiye iperereza ku cyateye urupfu rw’umugore uri mu kigero cy’imyaka 36, wahanutse mu igorofa ya 10 ya Ubumwe Grande Hotel iherereye mu Mujyi wa Kigali rwagati. Byabaye kuri uyu wa Gatandatu saa tatu n’iminota itanu z’ijoro, gusa ngo yari yahageze saa munani z’amanywa. Amakuru avuga ko uyu mugore witwa Mugege Olga ukomoka mu Burundi ariko ufite ubwenegihugu bw’u Bubiligi, yari asanzwe ajya kunywera muri iyi hoteli ari kumwe n’umugabo w’umuzungu.

Nyakwigendera yari umurundikazi ufite ubwenegihugu bw’Ububiligi Bivugwa ko akihagera yatse Fanta, ubwa nyuma yaka Mützig ntoya imwe mbere yo kwiyahura. Umuvugizi wa RIB Mbabazi Modeste yabwiye Igihe, dukesha iyi nkuru ati “Umurambo wageze ku bitaro bya Kacyiru, igisigaye ni ugukora iperereza kugira ngo tumenye icyateye uru rupfu, twahawe amakuru ko hari umuntu wiyahuye umanutse ku igorofa ya 10 akikubita hasi agahita apfa, turashaka kumenya amakuru uko yari abayeho, abo yabanaga nabo n’ibindi byose.”
 Mbabazi avuga ko uwo mugore ngo yagiye mu kabari bisanzwe, babona arasimbutse aguye hasi.

title: Ibibazo 6 by’ingenzi wibaza kugira ngo wubake umubano uhamye n’uwo muzarushinga
content: Gushinga urugo rugakomera kandi rukaramba muri iyi minsi si ikintu cyorohera benshi. Amezi ya mbere y’uburyohe, hanyuma buri wese agatangira kubona ukuri gutandukanye n’uko yari yarabyishyizemo, ibikunze gutuma ububabare bwo gutandukana buba igikomere cy’ibihe byose. Ariko se ni irihe banga abarambana bakoresha? Nubwo igisubizo kidahita kiboneka cyuzuye, umunezero abakundana bahuriyeho, ni imbuto zera ku mubano wabo bombi. Dore ibibazo bimwe umuntu yakagombye kwibaza ndetse akagira icyo abikoraho kugira ngo umubano we n’uwo yahisemo uzarambe. 1.  Njye ku giti cyanjye mpagaze nte mu buzima bwacu twembi? Akenshi iyo abakundanye bahisemo gukomezanya urugendo nk’abahuje icyerekezo, ukunze gusanga uko imyaka igenda ihita umuntu agera aho yiyibagirwa burundu nk’umuntu ku giti cye. Buri gihe ugasanga uratekereza kuwo mwashakanye, urubyaro, umuryango n’ibindi biba byaraje mu buzima bwawe, bigatuma wowe ubwawe nk’umuntu ku giti cye wibagirana. Ibuka ko mu mubano wawe n’umuryango mushya washinze na we uri umuntu ku giti cyawe, ufite inshingano ariko kandi ugomba kubaho ubuzima bwe ku giti cye. Kugerageza guhuza ubuzima bwawe bwite n’ubuzima bw’umuryango nta bibangamiye ibindi ni ikintu buri wese yakagobye gukora; bitabaye ibyo usubiza amaso inyuma ugasanga usigaye ubereyeho kunezeza abandi gusa bigatuma utangira kwanga ubuzima ubayemo. 2. Ni iki mugenzi wanjye anzaniye mu mubano wacu no mu buzima bwanjye Mu bihe byiza n’ibihe by’ibibazo, ni ngombwa ko wibaza umwanya uwo mukundana ahagazemo mu buzima bwawe. Na we afite itandukaniro, hari byinshi byiza ashyira mu buzima bwanjye mu buryo butandukanye. Ariko se ni ibiki? Ni ibihe byiza afiye binyuzuza? Nabaho nte adahari? Ni gute kubana na we bimfasha gutera imbere mu buzima bwanjye? Uku guha agaciro uwo mukundana, ukazirikana ibyiza afite bigufitiye akamaro mu burizma, bituma mu bihe bigoye mubasha gufatanya nta guseta ibirenge. 3. Ni ubuhe buryo bwiza bwo kuganira mu bakundana? Nta bantu bashobora kubana neza ngo barambane, badafite uburyo bwiza bwo kuganira. Mu mubano nyawo, abakundana bagomba kugira igihe cyo kubwirana amakuru, gutegana amatwi, kubwirana ibyifuzo byabo  byose. Hari kandi n’ubundi buryo bwo kuganira mu by’urukundo, bakarema isi ya bombi, bakaganira ku gutera akabariro, guteteshanya, kubwirana amagambo meza y’urukundo n’ibindi nk’ibyo bituma urukundo rukura. 4. Ni gute dushaka gukorana nk’abahisemo kubana Iki ni ikibazo gikunze kwirengagizwe ariko gikunze kugusha benshi mu mutego.  Gutandukanya ubuzima bw’akazi n’ubuzima bwawe bwite, kugabana imirimo yo mu rugo, uburyo bwo gukurikirana ubuzima bw’abana, n’ibindi nk’ibi. Ni ibintu abantu bakunze kwibwira ko byikora gutyo gusa, nyamara biba byiza iyo ibi ubiganiriyeho n’uwo ukunda mugahuza ibitekerezo by’uburyo muzatwara urugo rwanyu mu rwego rwo kwirinda amakimbirane. 5. Ese dufite icyerekezo kimwe? Amarangamutima ni ikintu cy’ingenzi, no kugira icyerekezo nabyo ni uko. Kugira inzozi zimwe no kubaka intambwe ku yindi imishinga izatuma muhumeka umwuka umwe mu gihe kizaza. Niba mwifuza gushinga umuryango, umubare w’abana muzabyara, aho muzatura, n’ibindi nk’ibi. Mu gihe ibyo mwifuzaga bigenda bihinduka nabyo mugenda mubiganiraho mukagira aho muhuriza, ibi bigatuma mwubaka icyizere kirambye hagati yanyu. 6. Twembi duhagaze dute mu mubano wacu n’abandi? Nubwo mu bihe bya mbere, ibya rubanda muba mutarabiha agaciro, uko iminsi igenda yicuma niko bagenda binjira mu buzima bwanyu buhoro buhoro. Ni gute se mwabasha kwisanga mu mubano wanyu na rubanda? Inshuti n’umuryango mwabahaye uwuhe mwanya? Uruhare bagira ku mibanire yanyu ni uruhe? Ibi byose ni ibibazo buri wese ushaka ko urugo rwe rukomera agomba kwibaza kugira ngo mutazaba ba nyamwigendaho ariko kandi ntimuzasamare ngo mube muri rubanda nyamwinshi nk’abatagira ubwigenge.

title: Uretse SIDA, menya indwara umubyeyi yakwanduza umwana mu gihe amutwite
content: Iyo umwana ari mu nda ya nyina atungwa n’ibiturutse kuri nyina, akenshi bica mu ngobyi umwana aba arimo (placenta) ari nayo imuhitiramo ibigomba kumutunga ngo akure ndetse ikanamurinda ibyamugirira nabi Ariko kandi hari indwara zimwe na zimwe iyi ngobyi idashobora kurwanya ngo izibuze kwinjira mu ngobyi. Twaganiriye na Dr Rulisa, umuganga w’inzobere mu kuvura indwara z’abagore (Gynecologue) maze atubwira zimwe muri zo. Dr Rulisa ati “Ni nyinshi ariko wenda mpereye hano mu Rwanda hari nka VIH/SIDA, Hepatite , ndetse no mu bushakashatsi twakoze twasanze na malaria umubyeyi ashobora kuyanduza umwana ari mu nda. Hari na Infections zandura ni nk’izitwa toxoplasmose, rubeole(iseru), ariko nka ziriya abagore bakunze kugira mu gitsina zo ntabwo zanduza umwana ari mu nda.” Nyamara nubwo muganga yatubwiye ko izi ndwara umubyeyi ashobora kurwara mu gitsina zidashobora kugera ku mwana, ababyeyi benshi bavuga ko hari ubwo umwana avukana ibibazo by’uburwayi bw’amaso maze abaforomo bakamubwira ko yabitewe na bene izi ndwara zo mu gitsina. Kuri iyi ngingo, Dr Rulisa yadusobanuriye agira ati “Iyo yarwaye bene izo ndwara zo mu gitsina, umwana akavuka mu buryo busanzwe (ibi abantu bakunzwe kwita kubyara neza), ariko umuganga wamubyaje atabanje kubitegura ngo  amuhe umuti, nibyo ashobora kumwanduza ariko ntaba yamwanduje akiri mu nda ahubwo umwana yandura ari uko ageze mu gice iyo ndwara irimo. Nta handi hantu umwana ashobora kurwara, ayo mavangingo yanduye aba ari mu gitsina cy’umugore, aho umwana aca ntashobora kwanduza uruhu cyangwa ahandi keretse mu maso gusa.” Dr Rulisa kandi yatubwiye ko n’igihe umuganga wabyaje umwana atabashije guha umubyeyi umuti ngo arinde umwana kwandura avuka, hari umuti uhabwa umwana agakira mu gihe gito. Yagize ati “Aya maso arakira. Iyo muganga yabiketse, ko umubyeyi afite ubwo burwayi, akamubyaza neza hanyuma akamuhanagura, hari umuti dutanga wo gushyira mu maso witwa Tetracycline kugira ngo umwana atazahura n’ibibazo bikomeye by’amaso. Akenshi mu bitaro abana iyo bavutse bakunda kubaha uwo muti kugira ngo niba umwana yanduye abe yakira kuko ntabwo ari uburwayi bukomeye akenshi bihita bikira. Hari n’ubwo umwana atabona uyu muti ariko kubera ubwirinzi bw’umubiri we bikikiza.” Twasuye n’urubuga passeportsante.net, aho bavuga izindi ndwara umubyeyi ashobora kwanduza umwana mu gihe amutwite harimo nka diyabete. Niyo mpamvu buri gihe umubyeyi utwite aba agomba kwisuzumisha kenshi gashoboka, yaba yumva ari muzima cyangwa atameze neza kugira ngo ubuzima bwe bubungwabungwe ariko kandi hanitabwe cyane kubw’uwo atwite arindwe kuzavukana bimwe muri ibi bibazo.

title: Rusizi: Umugabo ari gushakishwa nyuma yo gusambanya umwana w’imyaka 14 akamuha 2000Frw
content: Urwego rw’ubugenzacyaha mu Rwanda RIB, ruri gushakisha umugabo witwa Davide Nsengiyumva wo mu kagari ka Mashesha umurenge wa Gitambi w’akarere ka Rusizi ukekwaho gusambanya umwana w’imyaka 14, akamuha amafaranga 2000 y’u Rwanda. Uyu mwana avuga ko ku itariki 7 Ukwakira ahagana saa munani z’amanywa ubwo yari agiye kuvoma yahuye n’uyu Davide akamusaba ko bajyana iwe akamuha amazi, ngo bahageze yamwinjije mu nzu aramusambanya arangije amuha amafararana ibihumbi bibiri y’u Rwamda anamusaba ko nihagira ingaruka zizamubaho ngo ntazigere avuga ko ariwe wamusambanyije ahubwo ngo azajye abeshya ko hari umugabo wo mu murenge wa Kamembe wamusambanyije. Uyu mwana yaje kujya aribwa n’umugongo ndetse akajya aguma mu buriri aryamye, aza gusaba iwabo ko yajya kwa muganga ngo kuko yumvaga arwaye cyane. Iwabo bamuhaye mukuru we aramuherekeza bageze ku kigo nderabuzima cya Mashesha bahita bamwohereza by’igitaraganya mu bitaro bya Mibirizi, ahageze bahise bamuha imiti ndetse banamujyana muri One Stop Center bamuha amafaranga ibihumbi icumi ya tike arataha, muri uwo mugoroba mukuru we bari bajyanye yahise abwira nyina ko murumuna we yafashwe ku ngufu maze tariki ya 24 Ukwakira Nyirandegeya Uwera Domina ajya kuregera urwego rw’ubugenzacyaha. Uyu mubyeyi avuga ko akimara kugera kuri Sitasiyo ya Nyakabuye uru rwego rwamuhaye urwandiko arujyana ku bitaro bya Mibirizi ari kumwe na wa mwana we maze ku bitaro naho bamuha urundi rwandiko aruzanira RIB ngo bahise bamusaba gutaha maze akazajya aneka aho uwo mugabo ukekwaho gusambanya uyu mwana ari yamubona yinjiye mu nzu agahita ahamagara RIB ngo ikaza ikamuta muri yombi. Uyu mubyeyi we avuga ko asanzwe abona uyu mugabo yidegembya bityo akaba asaba ko umwana we yahabwa ubutabera bukwiye kuko uwo bakeka ko yamufashe ku ngufu ntaho yagiye kuko agikora imirimo y’ubucuruzi ku isanteri ya Mashesha. Bitewe nuko uyu mwana akimara gufatwa ku ngufu ababyeyi be batigeze babimenyesha urwego rw’ubugenzacyaha ngo aho uru rwego rubimenyeye rwabafashije ibishoboka byose bityo uyu mugabo Davide ukekwaho gukora iki cyaha akaba akiri gushakishwa ngo dore ko RIB yamaze kumukorera dosiye igihe cyose yaboneka yahita atabwa muri yombi nkuko byagarutsweho na Mbabazi Modeste umuvugizi w’uru rwego. Ni kenshi mu bice bigiye bitandukanye hakunze kumvikana amakuru y’abana baba bafashwe ku ngufu gusa bitewe nuko ababyeyi babo babimenya impitagihe ibimenyetso bikaba byasibanganye kuko akenshi abana baba bahohotewe babatera ubwoba ko nibaramuka babivuze bazabica. Inkuru ya TV1

title: Kuma mu kanwa, xérostomie; indwara isuzugurwa kandi yica
content: Kuma kw’akanwa yitwa xérostomie ni indwara ikunze kwirengagizwa na benshi ariko ni indwara igira ingaruka nyinshi ku buzima bw’umuntu ariko iravurwa igakira. Kubura amacandwe  mu kanwa, inyota ikabije, kuma iminwa n’ibindi nk’ibyo iyo bibaye ku muntu atangira kunywa kuko aba yumva ari iby’akanya gato ariko ntiyumve ko ari uburwayi bukwiriye gukurikiranwa. Mu busanzwe iyi ni indwara iterwa n’impamvu zitandukanye kandi uretse kuba indwara ubwayo, ishobora no kuba ikimenyetso cy’ubundi burwayi bwihishe umuntu atazi. Akamaro k’amacandwe Amacandwe afite akamaro gakomeye; atosa mu kanwa ndetse akahoza. Atunganya amatama, ishinya, amenyo ndetse n’ibindi bice by’akanwa agakuramo imyanda yose irimo. Amacandwe kandi afasha cyane mu igogorwa ry’ibiryo kandi akarinda indwara nyinshi zo mu kanwa. Impamvu zitera kuma mu kanwa Kuma mu kanwa bishobora guterwa n’impamvu zitandukanye: Itabi, imiti imwe n’imwe, inzoga, ndetse ikaba n’ikimenyetso by’uburwayi bumwe bwihishe burimo igifu, diyabete, agahinda gakabije ndetse na kanseri. Gukura mu myaka ndetse n’umwuma nabyo bishobira gutera uburwayi bwo kuma mu kanwa. Ingaruka  Xérostomie ni indwara igira ingaruka nyinshi zirangajwe imbere no kubangamirwa umuntu agira iyo nta macandwe ahagije afite mu kanwa, aho ururimi ruba rwumye. Ibi bituma umuntu agorwa no kuvuga no kurya, agatangira kujya yokerwa mu kanwa ndetse no kwikomeretsa mu kanwa mu buryo bwa hato na hato. Kubura amacandwe mu kanwa kandi bitera akanwa kwandura indwara ziterwa n’umwanda, kunuka mu kanwa ndetse umuntu agahorana inyota. Ibi bitera umuntu kubuhirwa n’ibiryo ugasanga ntagishaka kurya binatuma atakaza ibiro byinshi. Iyo bigitangira, umuntu aba yumva ari ibintu byoroheje nyamara ubu ni uburwayi bushobora guhitana umuntu mu gihe atavuwe ngo akire. Uko urwaye xérostomie yakwiyitaho Icya mbere yakora ni ukumenya impamvu nyayo igutera kuma mu kanwa; ukamenya niba atari ikibazo giterwa n’ubundi burwayi bugomba kuvurwa cyangwa niba ari nk’umuti wanyoye wabiguteye. Ibi muganga agufasha kubisobanukirwa. Ikindi kandi ugomba gusobanukirwa niba birimo guterwa n’imyaka ugezemo cyangwa niba ari umwuma, ibi ukabibwira n’uko iyo inyweye amazi wumva bikemuye iki kibazo cyangwa ntibyemere. Isuku yo mu kanwa nyinshi cyane ni ngombwa ku muntu ufite ikibazo cyo mu kanwa, ibi bikagabanya ibyago byo kwandura uburwayi butandukanye twavuze haruguru. Mu gihe iyi suku yo mu kanwa ndetse no kunywa amazi menshi bidakemuye ikibazo cyo kuma mu kanwa ni ngombwa cyane ko ugana muganga kugira ngo agufashe kumenya neza ikibazo ufite ndetse n’uburyo cyakemuka.

title: Imiterere y’abantu ukurikije  ubwoko bw’amaraso yabo(Groupe Sanguin)
content: Abantu bagira amaraso yo mu bwoko butandukanye bitewe n’imiterere y’umubiri wabo ndetse n’ibigize amaraso yabo. Uko amaraso y’abantu atandukanye rero bituma n’imiterere yabo igenda itandukana nk’uko ubushakashatsi butandukanye bugenda bubigaragaza. Habaho ubwoko 4 y’amaraso aribwo A,B,O na AB. Abafite ubwoko bw’amaraso bwa A Abantu bafite amaraso yo mu bwoko bwa A bakunze kugaragaraho intege nke ku bijyanye no kugaragaza cyangwa se guhesha agaciro uburenganzira bwabo. Ni abantu bakunze kuba ari abanyamagambo make.  Aba bantu kandi bakunze kumva ibibazo by’abandi bakagerageza kwishyira mu mwanya wa buri wese ngo biyumvishe agaciro k’ibyiyumviro cyane cyane iby’agahinda abandi baba bafite. Ni abantu bakunze kugirirwa icyizere cyane kuko bubahiriza amasezerano bagiranye n’abandi. Bubahiriza kandi inshingano zabo uko bikwiriye. Bakunze kugira icyizere gikabije kuburyo abandi bashobora kubabeshya ku buryo bworoshye kubera ko bakunda kugirira abandi impuhwe. Akenshi rero aba bantu bagirwa inama yo kujya bakurikiza ibyo umutima wabo ubabwiye bakirinda kugendera kubyo abandi bababwira. Abafite ubwoko bw’amaraso bwa B Abantu bafite amaraso yo mu bwoko bwa B ni abantu batajya baha agaciro ibintu byose. Ibibazo byose bahuye nabyo batitaye ku buremere bwabyo bashakisha uburyo bwose bakabikemura kandi ibintu byose babitekereza mu ruhande rwiza gusa. Iyo bagiye ahantu batari basanzwe bahamenyera vuba cyane. Bakunze kugira ibitekerezo byigenga cyane kandi ntibakunda kumvira abandi ndetse akenshi barahindagurika bitewe n’abo bari kumwe. Ni abantu kandi badakunda kwihishira, iyo babonye ikintu kibashimishije ntibatinda kubyerekana.Iyo bakunze ikintu kandi bagiha agaciro gahambaye. Bagira umwete cyane kandi bakita cyane kubyo abandi bananiwe. Barasabana cyane ugereranije n’andi moko y’amaraso. Ntibatinya no kuvugisha umuntu batazi ndetse bakunze kumenyerana n’abantu bashya mu buzima bwabo ku buryo buboroheye. Bakunda gahunda mu bintu byose kandi ntibakunda umuntu ubivangira mu buzima. Abafite ubwoko bw’amaraso bwa O Abantu bafite ubwoko bw’amaraso bwa O ni abantu bafungutse, mbese kumenya icyo batekereza biroroshye. Uko bagaragara inyuma akenshi niko baba bateketeza, ibi bigatuma bagira inshuti nyinshi. Ikindi kandi aba bantu bakunze kugira inyota yo gutsinda no gutera imbere kandi n’akazi kabo bagakora bagakunze. Biyitaho cyane kandi bagahora basa neza. Bakunda kwiha intego ibi bigatuma bagera kuri byinshi mu birebana n’imirimo yabo ibi bituma aba bantu baba abo kwizerwa cyane kurusha abafite ubundi bwoko bw’amaraso. Bakunda amategeko cyane ndetse akenshi mubyo bakora byinshi babwirisha abandi amagambo ategeka. Abafite ubwoko bw’amaraso bwa AB Abantu bafite ubwoko bw’aya maraso ni bake cyane.  Aba bantu ni abahanga cyane kurusha abandi. Ni abantu bareba kure kandi ibikorwa byabo bigahora biri ku murongo ugororotse. Nta buriganya bagira, ntibakunda gutekereza byinshi ku bandi kandi n’igitekerezo cyabo kiba kiri mu magambo make mbese kigusha ku ntego batarinze guca hirya no hino. Ntibakunda kujya mu bintu bibakururira ibibazo kandi ni abantu bagira ibanga ku buryo bukomeye. Twifashishije imbuga zitandukanye nka histoiresetmysteres.com, sainetnaturel.com ndetse na esante.fr

title: RIB yaburijemo umugambi wo kwica umugore witwa Nzitukuze wacuzwe n’umugabo we, amoko kimwe mu byo bapfaga!
content: Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Ubugenzacyaha, RIB, rwaburijemo umugambi w’umugabo witwa Ntirenganya Jean Maurice, wari wagambaniye umugore we Nzitukuze Yvette ngo yicwe, kugira ngo urubanza rwa gatanya bafitanye ruburizwemo. (Inkuru ya IGIHE) Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kane nibwo uyu mugabo witwa Ntirenganya yatawe muri yombi afatiwe mu kabari kitwa Chez Musoni kari ku muhanda uva ku Kicukiro (Sonatube) werekeza mu Mujyi rwagati. Umuvugizi w’Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Ubugenzacyaha, RIB, Mbabazi Modeste, yatangaje ko uyu mugabo yafashwe biturutse ku mikoranire myiza y’uru rwego n’abaturage. Imvano yo kugambanira umugore we Uyu mugabo yashakanye n’umugore we witwa Nzitukuze Yvette mu 2007 nyuma y’imyaka ibiri bakundana, ubu bafitanye abana babiri. Mu gushaka kumenya imvano y’umwuka mubi, IGIHE yegereye Nzitukuze. Yavuze ko agisama inda y’umwana wa mbere, yasabye umugabo ko bajyana kwa muganga undi akamusubiza ko akwiye kwitoza kubaho nk’utamufite, amubaza ati ‘abatagira abagabo ntibababyaza?’. Amakimbirane hagati y’uyu mugore n’umugabo yarakomeje kugeza ubwo ngo ntacyo yigeze amufasha no mu kurera abana. Umugore ngo niwe wimenye muri byose kuko yari asigaye ari umucuruzi ufite ’alimentation’, nyuma yo kugurisha moto ebyiri yari afite akiri inkumi. Yitabaje Polisi Nzitukuze avuga ko igihe cyageze umugabo akajya amukubita ubutitsa, akahukanira mu kindi cyumba mu nzu yabo iri mu Gatenga. Gukubitwa bimaze nko kuba umuco, umunsi umwe ngo yasabye umukozi we ko niyumva umugabo ari kumukubita yaza guhamagara kuri polisi. Impamvu we atashoboraga guhamagara ngo ni uko telefoni umugabo yabaga yazimwatse. Mu 2014 Polisi yataye muri yombi uyu mugabo, arafungwa gusa aza gufungurwa amaze kwandika ibaruwa isaba imbabazi umugore, n’umugore amaze kwandika indi imuha imbabazi. Bemereye imbere y’ubuyobozi ko bagiye kubana mu mahoro, ariko yasubiye ku nkoni nyuma y’iminsi itatu gusa. Uyu mugore amaze kwahukana inshuro eshatu bitewe n’aya makimbirane, umugabo nawe amaze gufungwa inshuro ebyiri azira guhoza ku nkeke uwo bashakanye. Bapfuye ibijyanye n’amoko Magingo aya uyu mugabo afungiye kuri station ya Polisi ya Kicukiro aho akurikiranyweho ubwinjiracyaha bw’icyaha cy’ubugome. Yabwiye IGIHE ko imvano yo gushwana n’uwo bashakanye ari uko yamubeshye ku bijyanye n’ubwoko bwe. Ati “Nakomeje kubaririza nsanga hari ibyo ajya ambeshya. Namenye ko yambeshye.” Ntirenganya yavuze ko umugore yamusuzuguraga kuko yari asigaye acuruza kandi anafite imodoka. Avuga ko yaje gusa n’urambiwe, ashaka uburyo yakemura ikibazo cye. Mu mugambi we wo gushaka kwica umugore we, ngo hari umuvuzi gakondo yashatse, amubwira ikibazo asanganywe cy’uburwayi bw’ibintu bimufata mu kuboko bikamurya cyane. Uyu muvuzi ngo yamubwiye ko azamuvura. Undi amubwira ko ubimuteza ari umugore ko akwiye kuzamumukiza dore ko bari batakibana kuko yahukanye we n’abana bakajya gukodesha. Ntirenganya yemereye uyu muvuzi miliyoni y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda kugira ngo azamwicire umugore, ku ikubitiro amuha ibihumbi ijana amubwira ko andi azayamuha amaze kurangiza akazi kandi amweretse ikimenyetso. Yafashwe amaze guha andi mafaranga ibihumbi ijana uyu muvuzi wamubwiraga ko umugore we yamaze gupfa. Uko RIB yatabaye uyu mugore Uyu muvuzi amaze guhabwa ikiraka cyo kwica Nzitukuze, yahise amenyesha Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Ubugenzacyaha, rutangira iperereza ryimbitse, atanga n’amakuru yose yaganishije ku ifatwa rya Ntirenganya. RIB yacungiye uyu mugore umutekano atazi ibyo aribyo, ku buryo yamenye umugambi wo kumwica umugabo yamaze gutabwa muri yombi agwa mu kantu. Umuvugizi w’Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Ubugenzacyaha, RIB, Mbabazi Modeste, yashimiye uwatanze amakuru hakaburizwamo icyaha. Ati “Yafashwe hashingiwe ku makuru twahawe biturutse ahanini ku mikoranire myiza ya RIB n’abaturage, turashimira uwahawe ubutumwa bwo kwica agasanga gukora amaraso atariwo muti. Yafatiwe mu cyuho ari kwishyura ko igikorwa cyarangiye." Nyuma yo kuburizamo uyu mugambi w’ubwicanyi, uyu mugabo ari mu maboko ya RIB. Ntaramenya ko umugore we ari muzima kuko azi neza ko yapfuye dore ko yahawe icyo yita ibimenyetso. Yumvikanye abwira abakozi b’uru rwego ati “Ndasaba imbabazi kuba narishe umugore wanjye […] mwandeka nkazajya nibura kumushyingura?”. Ntirenganya akekwaho icyaha by’ubwinjiracyaha giteganywa n’ingingo ya 21 mu itegeko rigena ibyaha n’ibihano. Iyi ngingo isobanura ko ubwinjiracyaha buhanirwa n’ubwo icyari kigambiriwe kitashoboraga kugerwaho bitewe n’impamvu nyir’ugukora icyaha atashoboye kumenya. Ubwinjiracyaha bw’icyaha cy’ubugome cyangwa icyaha gikomeye buhanishwa ½ cy’igihano giteganyirijwe icyo cyaha. Ku cyaha gihanishwa igifungo cya burundu, ubwinjiracyaha buhanishwa igihano cy’igifungo kingana n’imyaka 25.

title: Gakenke: Yasanzwe mu mazi yapfuye apfunyitswe mu mufuka (Amafoto)
content:
Ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa gatatu tariki 31 Ukwakira ni bwo umurambo wa nyakwigendera NIYONZIMA Jean Pierre wasanzwe mu mugezi wa Gaseke uherereye mu murenge wa Rusasa mu karere ka gakenke. Amakuru atangwa n’abaturanyi ndetse n’abo mu muryango we, avuga ko uyu NIYONZIMA Pierre wasanzwe mu mazi yamaze gupfa bamuherukaga kuwa kabiri ubwo yavaga mu rugo agiye gufata amafaranga agera ku bihumbi 250 Frw ngo yari yasaguriwe ku cyamunara yari aherutse guterezwa, yavayo agahitira mu kabari k’ahitwa muri Gaseke katari kure y’aho yari asanzwe atuye, bigakekwa ko yishwe avuye muri ako kabari.

Aha niho umurambo wa nyakwigendera wasanzwe Ubuyobozi bw’akagari ka Rumbi uyu nyakwigendera yari atuyemo na bwo bwemeza ko mu bimenyetso bigaragarira amaso ari uko uyu nyakwigendera yishwe kuko bamusanze azirikiye mu mufuka ndetse uwamuroshye ngo akanashyiramo ibuye kugirango yibire hasi mu mazi nk’uko NSABIMANA Samuel uyobora aka kagari yabibwiye TV/Radio1.

Abaturage bari baje kureba ibyabaye Abatuye muri aka gace bavuga ko uyu atari we muntu wa mbere uhiciwe muri ubu buryo, ahubwo ngo bisa nk’ibintu bimaze kuhaba akamenyero kuko ngo mu myaka itatu ishize muri aka gace hamaze kwicirwa abantu batanu muri ubu buryo, ari na byo baheraho basaba inzego z’umutekano ko zahitaho by’umwihariko. title: Dore uburyo 10 bwagufasha kugabanya ibinure n’ubunini bwo mu nda
content:
Abantu benshi bagira mu nda hanini ariko bakaba badashobora kumenya impamvu yabyo ndetse n’ushatse kubigabanya akayoberwa uburyo yabikoramo cyangwa se haba hangana nk’uko ubyifuza ukifuza ko hagumana ingano yaho. Dore zimwe mu nama twabagira kugira ngo mu nda hanyu hangane nk’uko ubyifuza 1.Gerageza umenye aho ibiro byawe byinshi bihererye. Iyo turya ibidutunga bigira aho bijya kurusha ahandi bitewe n’imiterere yacu, hari abo byirunda ku kibuno cyangwa ku bibero, abandi ku nda cyangwa se mu gituza. Mbere yo gushaka gutangira gukora ibyagufasha kugabanya ubunini bwo mu nda hawe rero banza umenye niba ariho koko hari ibiro byinshi. 2.Itonde mu gihe urimo gufata ifunguro ryawe: Kurya vuba vuba bituma umira umwuka mwinshi bityo igogorwa ntirikorwe nk’uko bikwiriye. Rya wicaye,witonze byibura mu minota 30 uhekenye neza ibyo kurya byose ushyize mu kanwa maze ubone kumira. 3. Gerageza kongera imboga n’imbuto  mu byo urya kuko byoroshya igogorwa ndetse bigafasha. Iyo bibuze mu mubiri bifata mu mara maze bigatera kubyimba kw’inda.
4. Mu biryo urya jya ugerageza urye inyama, amafi n’amagi kuko ni bimwe mu byongera imbaraga mu mubiri  hatabayeho kubyimba kw’igifu. 5.Jya urya ibiryo biteguye neza kandi bihiye neza. Burya imitegurire y’ibyo turya nayo igira uruhare mu igogorwa ryabyo. 6.Gabanya umunyu mu byo urya. Umunyu mwinshi utuma habaho kwireka kw’amazi mu nda. Jya urya umunyu muke ushoboka. 7.Irinde kuba wa muntu uhora ahekenya. Burya buri gihe uko ugize icyo ushyira hagati y’amenyo niyo kaba ari akantu gato cyane, amatembabuzi yo mu gifu yitegura kwakira iryo funguro. Igifu rero gicibwa intege n’uburyo uba ukivangiye kandi udahaze. Rya ariko  ku gihe kandi urye uhage. 8.Gerageza gufata umwanya wo guhumeka neza uruhutse nta bikubuza amahoro. Ibi bifasha cyane mu kwirinda uburwayi bwa hato na hato. 9.Imyitozo ngororamubiri:  Ntugahore mu mwanya umwe, ujye ugerageza kunyeganyega. Iyo umuntu arya ibinure biragenda bikibika mu mubiri wacu, ni ngombwa rero ko tubivoma aho byiretse. Kora imyitozo ngororamubiri byibura inshuro ebyiri mu cyumweru, iminota 30 kuri buri nshuro. Ushobora kwiruka, koga mu mazi menshi(natation), kugenda ku igare, … 10.Gabanya isukari n’ibiyikomokaho byose cyane cyane byakorewe mu nganda: Ibi bitera kwireka kw’amaraso mu bice bitandukanye mu mubiri bityo ugasanga umuntu yarabyibushye ibice bimwe na bimwe by’umubiri. Gerageza ushakishe isukari itaraciye mu ruganda nk’iyo mu mbuto n’ibindi nk’ibyo.

title: Birashyushye, Safi Madiba nyuma yo kubengwa na Knowless na Parfine, birangiye arushinze na Judithe
content:
Amakuru yizewe agera kuri Kigalipost ni uko tariki ya 01 Ukwakira 2017 aribwo Safi Madiba(Urban boys) azarushingana n’umukunzi we mushya Judithe Niyonizera. Hari hashize iminsi havugwa ko uyu muhanzi arimo ategura ubukwe mu ibanga nyuma yo gutandukana na Parfine, ariko we akabihakana gusa kuri iyi nshuro yisanze agomba kubyemera nyuma yaho ubutumire bw’ubukwe bwasesekaye ku mbuga nkoranyambaga.

Ntabwo asanzwe azwi cyane, ariko Judithe bivugwa ko afite amafaranga menshi yakuye muri gatanya n’umugabo we wa mbere Nkuko amwe mu makuru abivuga ngo uyu Judithe Niyonizera ugiye kubana na Safi, asanzwe ari umugore watandukanye n’umugabo w’umuzungu w’umunya-Canada ndetse birashoboka ko uyu mugore yaba afite ubwenegihugu bw’iki gihugu ku buryo nyuma gato y’ubukwe bwabo bashobora kuba ariho bazajya kwiturira bakahakomereza ubuzima. Biteganijwe ko imihango yo gusaba no gukwa y’aba bombi izabera i Rebero tariki ya 01 Ukwakira, 2017. Gusa ngo nubwo bataremererwa kubana byemewe n’amategeko ngo aba bombi kugeza ubu bari kubana mu nzu imwe iherereye Kimironko aho Safi asanzwe akodesha.

Bwa mbere avugwa mu rukundo, Safi Madiba yari kumwe na Knowless waje kumubenga amuziza kutubaha urukundo rwabo no kutamwubahisha muri rusange Safi Madiba agiye kubana n’uyu mukobwa nyuma yo kudahirwa mu buzima bwe bwabanje bw’urukundo dore ko yari amaze gutandukana n’abagera kuri batatu bazwi harimo Butera Knowless wamenyekanye nk’umukunzi we wa mbere ariko azakumubenga yikundanira na Producer Ishimwe Clement ndetse baje gukora ubukwe babana nk’umugabo n’umugore. Nyuma yaje gucudika n’uwitwa Fabiola batamaranye kabiri, ubundi amusimbuza Parfine nawe bagiranye urukundo rushyushye ariko baherutse gushwana nyuma y’imyaka ikabakaba ibiri n’igice bari bamaranye.

Safi Madiba na Parfine(umugore watandukanye n’umugabo w’umuzungu) yari yaravuze ko bazabana ariko inshuti za hafi z’uyu mukobwa ziherutse gutangaza ko bapfuye ubushurashuzi no kutagira intego y’ubuzima

title: Nyuma y’imyaka 75 babana, umusaza warwanye intambara ya 2 y’isi n’umukecuru we batabarukiye rimwe
content:
George na Jean Spear bahuye bwa mbere mu 1941 baza kurushinga mu mwaka wakurikiyeho. Nyuma y’imyaka 75 babana, George Spear w’imyaka 97 y’amavuko ntiyabashije kurama ku isi igihe kinini nyuma y’amasaha make umugore we Jean w’imyaka 94 yitabye Imana. Aba bombi bose batabarukiye umunsi umwe mu bitaro bya Carleton d’Ottawa (Canada) mu cyumweru gishize nk’uko Huffington Post yabitangaje. Jean yari yajyanywe mu bitaro ku wa Gatatu w’icyumweru gishize kubera uburwayi bwo mu bihaha yari afite maze kuwa Gatanu mu gitondo ahagana ku isaha ya saa kumi n’igice ashiramo umwuka. Amasaha make yakurikiyeho George yarasinziriye aherayo(endormi profondément) ntiyongera gukanguka, biza kwemezwa k’umugaragaro ko yapfuye ahagana ku isaha ya saa tatu na 45. 

Tariki 22/08/2017 bari bizihizanyije imyaka 75 ishize babana George, yari umwe mu basirikare b’abanye-Canada barwanye intambara ya 2 y’isi, akaba yari yarahuriye n’umugore we Jean i Londres mu Bwongereza mu gihe yari muri iyi ntambara maze baza gushyingiranwa muri Kanama 1942 i Kingston ahitwa Thames aho George yari akambitse mu nkambi ya gisirikare.  Uburyo bahuye... 
Nkuko Jean yigeze kubitangariza ikinyamakuru cya CBC News mu 2006, ngo umugabo we yamubengutswe bahuriye mu kabyiniro. Yagize ati " Nari mpari(mu kabyiniro) mu ikanzu yanjye itukura, umugabo wanjye arabibabwira, yaraje ansaba ko tubyinana, yari yambaye inkweto ze za gisirikare ariko rwose yashoboraga kubyina kandi uburyo(rhythm) yabyinaga byari byiza. Rero kuva ubwo ntawundi twigeze tubyinana ijoro ryose."

George na Jean Spear bahuye mu bihe by’intambara ya 2 y’isi Nyuma y’intambara y’isi, bahise bava i Burayi, bajya gutura muri Canada aho bakomereje ubuzima bwaranzwe no kuryoherwa n’urukundo rwabo kugeza ubwo urupfu rwabatwariye rimwe.

title: Gisagara: Umugabo n’umwana w’imyaka 7 bishwe batemaguwe
content:
Ntezirembo Jean  w’imyaka 50  n’umwana witwaga  Kwizera  Jean de Dieu, bo  mu Kagali ka  Nyaruteja mu Murenge wa Nyanza mu Karere ka Gisagara, bishwe batemaguwe nyuma umugabo akorerwa iyica rubozo ritamenyerewe, kuri uyu wa 19 Nzeli 2017. Uwo bivugwa ko yabahitanye yitwa Niyibizi Jean Damascene, abaturage n’ubuyobozi bakaba bemeza ko mu gihe cyashize yari arwaye mu mutwe, ariko bakaba bari bazi ko yakize. Abageze aho Niyibizi yakoreye aya mahano bavuga ko yateye icyuma Ntezirembo akanamutemesha umuhoro yari yitwaje yerekeza mu murima. Ngo nyuma yo kumutemagura akica umwana wari wahuye ihene, yagarutse aca umutwe wa Nteziyaremye awumanika ku muhanda ahari iteme. Ni amakuru ubuyobozi bw’umurenge buvuga ko ababaje; bikaba byatumye Niyibizi ahita asubizwa mu bitaro by’indwara zo mu mutwe cya CARAES Ndera mu Mujyi wa Kigali. “Niyibizi yabyukanye icyuma ahuye na Ntezirembo ajya guhinga arakimutera ariko cyanga kwinjira noneho amwambura umuhoro yari afite amutema imipaga myinshi, ako kanya abona akana gashoreye ihene atema ihene, arakomeza arakirukankana nako aragatema karapfa.”
 Aya ni amwe mu magambo Izubarirashe.rw twatangarijwe n’uwitwa Misigaro Theoneste, uvuga ko nyuma yo kwica nyakwigendera, Niyibizi yanagarutse agafata umupanga akaza agaca ijosi rye akarishyira ku iteme riri hafi aho. Niyibizi ngo yaje gufatwa n’abaturage ubwo yashakaga gutera mu rundi rugo, avuga ko bimubabaje kuba ngo atashoboye gutema abanyeshuri bava ku ishuri. Hategekimana Emmanuel we aragira ati, “Tukimara kumufata yaravuze ngo ntabwo arangije mu mudugudu ashigajemo 5 arabavuga arabarangiza.”
 Abaturage bavuga ko aya mahano yaje atunguranye, kuko nubwo Niyibizi yigeze kurwara mu mutwe bari bazi ko atakirwaye, kuko yari amaze amezi atandatu ahagaritse imiti. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Nyanza, Uwimana Jean Bosco, yabwiye Izubarirashe ati “Mu by’ukuri Niyibizi twe twari twamujyanye kwa muganga mu mwaka wa 2014 bamutugarurira amaze hafi imyaka 2, batwereka ko yakize kandi imiti yayifataga ariko biragoye kumenya iby’umuntu ufite ikibazo cyo mu mutwe.” Uwimana avuga ko ibyakozwe na Niyibizi byatumye ubuyobozi batekereza ku bandi bantu bafite ikibazo cyo mu mutwe, ngo bakaba bamaze kubona 2 muri uwo mudugudu, bityo na bo bakaba bagiye kuvuzwa. Avuga ko abaturage bakwiye kujya bakurikirana bakareba niba uwagiye kuvuzwa yarakize koko, kugira ngo uwo bigaragaye ko yateza ikibazo asubizwe kwa muganga, hakarebwa niba mu mutwe bitarahindutse ku buryo yateza ibindi bibazo. Ati “Tugiye gukurikirana imyitwarire y’umuntu wese waba yaragize ikibazo cyo mu mutwe turebe imyitwarire ye dukoresheje ya gahunda ya menya nkumenye” Avuga kandi ko abarwayi bo mu mutwe bakuwe kwa muganga ngo bagiye gusaba kujya babasuzuma nibura nyuma y’amezi 3 hazirikanwa ko ibisazi atari indwara ikira nk’izindi. Inkuru ya Izubarirashe.rw

title: Burera: Inkuba yakubise abana babiri bavukana umwe ahasiga ubuzima
content: Ku mugoroba wo ku wa Gatatu tariki ya 14 Nzeri 2017 nibwo abana babiri bavukana bo mu Kagari ka Rukandabyuma mu Murenge Rugengabari mu Karere ka Burere mu ntara y’Amajyaruguru, bakubiswe n’inkuba umwe ahita yitaba Imana. Ibi byabaye ahagana ku Saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba aho umwana w’imyaka 13 ari we wahise ahasiga ubuzima, mukuru we w’imyaka 16 abasha kubaho. Aganira na IGIHE dukesha iyi nkuru, umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Rugengabari, Mbarushimana Emmanuel, yemereye iby’aya makuru avuga ko inkuba yabakubitiye ku rugo. Yagize ati “ Nibyo yabakubise ari babiri umuto w’imyaka 13 ahita apfa, mukuru we we bahise bamujyana kwa muganga ako kanya.” Yakomeje avuga ko ubuzima bw’uyu mwana wundi wahise ujyanwa kwa muganga bumeze neza kuko mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 14 Nzeri 2017 yahise asezererwa mu bitaro agataha. Uyu muyobozi yasoje avuga ko ari bwo bwa mbere abantu bo muri aka gace bakubiswe n’inkuba anagira inama abaturage yo kujya bashyira imirindankuba ahantu hose hahurira abantu benshi mu rwego rwo kwirinda ibi biza.

title: Rulindo: Umugabo yishe umwana wa mukuru we amujombaguye ibyuma mu mutwe
content:
Umugabo witwa Gatera Aime wo mu mudugudu wa Gatwa Akagari ka Bubangu Umurenge wa Murambi mu Karere ka Rulindo, yishe umwana w’imyaka 2 wa mukuru we amujombaguye ibyuma. Bivugwa ko uyu mugabo yari afite ikibazo cyo mu mutwe. Mu gitondo cy’uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 13 Nzeri nibwo uyu mugabo witwa Gatera Aime yishe umwana wa mukuru we ubwo yamusangaga mu rugo iwabo akamutera icyuma nk’uko bitangazwa n’abaturage bo muri aka gace. Uyu mugabo Gatera ngo ubusanzwe yari afite imyitwarire idahwitse kuko mu minsi ishize aheruka gutema undi muntu witwa Mwiririza Jean de la Croix kugeza magingo aya uyu watemwe akaba akiri mu bitaro aho ari kuvuzwa. Umuturage witwa Uwamahoro Christine yabwiye ikinyamakuru Ukwezi.com ko uyu mugabo Gatera wo mu kigero k’imyaka 30 ubyarwa na Wilson ndetse na Viviane yishe umwana wa mukuru we ndetse mu minsi ishize akaba yari aherutse gutema undi muntu. Yagize ati “Nibyo koko mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatatu umugabo witwa Gatera yishe umwana wa mukuru we amuteye icyuma.Yari aherutse gutema musaza wanjye ubu nawe aracyari mu bitaro.” Bivugwa ko uyu mugabo yigeze kugira ikibazo cy’ihungabana biturutse ku bibazo byavutse mu muryango wabo bitewe n’ubushyamirane bagiranye kubera amasambu.
Abayobozi b’umudugugu bagejejweho ikibazo cy’uyu mugabo bavuga ko ngo nabo bamutinya kuko agendana ibyuma ( imihoro n’amacumu) n’ibindi bishobora kwangiza umuntu. Umuyobozi w’uyu mudugudu wa Karwa, Nkurijimana Aimable yemeje amakuru y’ubu bwicanyi avuga ko uyu Gatera Aime wishe umwana wa mukuru we yari asanzwe afite ikibazo cyo mu mutwe. Yagize ati " Gatera Aime yari asanzwe afite ikibazo cyo mu mutwe, ahagana nka saa mbili n’iminota 2 nibwo yagiye iwabo agezeyo arwana na mushiki we aranamukomeretsa ku gutwi, ubwo mushiki we yavugije induru ahita yiruka maze ageze ku irembo asanga akana ka mukuru we kicaye kari kurya agakubita ibintu by’ibyuma yagendanaga maze akana gahita gapfa." Uyu muyobozi w’umudugudu yavuze ko akibimenya yahise ahamagaza ingabo na polisi maze baraza basanga Gatera aho yari yihishe mu kizu yabagamo bamukuramo, ubu akaba ari kuri sitasiyo ya polisi ikorera muri uyu murenge wa Murambi.
Inkuru ya Ukwezi.com

title: Ibyago biterwa no kwishushanya ku mubiri (tattoo)
content: Ubushakashatsi bushya bwakozwe, bugaragaza ko hari ibyago ndetse bikomeye biterwa no kwishushanya ku mubiri biturutse kuri wino (ink/encre) ikoreshwa. Inkuru dukesha 7su7.be ivuga ko ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’abahanga mu by’ubuzima b’abafaransa n’abadage bwagaragaje ko muri wino ikoreshwa mu gushushanya ku bantu harimo uburozi bwangiriza cyane umubiri w’umuntu. Ubu bushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko mu turemangingo tw’umubiri twitwa ganglions lymphatique w’umuntu ufite tattoo hagaragaramo ikinyabutabire cya Dioxyde de titane (TiO2), abakora tattoo bifashisha mu gukora amabara atandukanye. Aba kandi bakoresha ibindi binyabutabire bitandukanye nka nickel, chrome, manganèse na cobalt. Ibi byose rero biragenda bigatemera mu mubiri w’umuntu, abakoze ubu bushakashatsi baragira bati “Icyo tutari tuzi ni uko ibi binyabutabire byose bigenda bitembera mu mubiri kandi ni ikibazo gikomeye ku buzima bw’umuntu kuko ni uburozi.” Aba bashakashatsi rero ndetse natwe nka Kigalipost.com turabagira inama zo kurinda ubuzima bwanyu niba mutarashyiraho tattoo, hanyuma niba muyifite mukumva mutamerewe neza mu mubiri mwegere abaganga babakorere ibizamini barebe ko ibi binyabutabire bitabaye byinshi mu mubiri wanyu.

title: Ibibazo 10 ugomba kubaza umuganga mbere yo kubagwa
content: Ni byiza ko umurwayi asobanukirwa neza n’ibyo agiye gukorerwa, uko bikorwa, icyo bimumariye ndetse n’ingaruka bishobora kugira bityo akamenya uko yitwara muri urwo rugendo rutoroshye. Dore rero ibibazo by’ingenzi umurwayi ugiye kubagwa aba agomba gusobanuza   1.Ese ni ngombwa kubagwa?  Iki kibazo umurwayi akibaza muganga akimubwira ko agomba kubagwa. Aha akaba agomba gusobanuza niba nta bundi buryo bushobora kumukiza indwara afite atabanje guca ku cyuma. Nta mpamvu yo gutinya kugira ikibazo icyo aricyo cyose umubaza yewe nubwo waba utekereza ko urondogora cyangwa uruhanya, si byiza kugira icyo wihererana kuko ni ubuzima bwawe buba buri mu kibazo ndetse uba ushobora no gushaka undi muganga mu gihe uwa mbere yaguhaye ibisobanuro bitakunyuze.  2. Kubagwa birakorwa bite?  Aha ntabwo muganga yabigisha uko babaga nk’uko abizi, ariko aba agomba kubabwira imirongo migari y’ibyo mugomba kumenya kugira ngo namwe mwitegure mu ntekerezo, mwumve neza ibigiye kubakorerwa n’uko mugenda mubyitwaramo.  3. Ni ibihe bibazo bishobora kuvuka?  Birumvikana ko utakwizera 100% ko biza kugenda nea, bityo uba ugomba kubaza ibibazo wahura nabyo ndetse n’ingaruka byakugiraho kugira ngo na muganga yumve impungege ufite anamenye uko ubuzima bwawe busanzwe buhagaze maze umwanzuro muwufatane buri wese atagize icyo yihererana ndetse munarebe ko izo ngaruka ziramutse zije hari uko mwazikemura.  4. Hari uko ngomba kwitwara mbere yo kubagwa?  Mu gihe ugiye kubagwa ugomba kubaza muganga uko ugomba kwitwara ndetse niba hari n’imyitwarire wahagarika cyangwa ukayihindura kuko mu buzima bwacu bwa buri munsi usanga twitwara mu buryo butandukanye kandi wenda bushobora kugira icyo buhindura ku buzima bwacu.  5. Nitegure nte?  Hari ubwo usanga umuntu yitegura kubangwa nk’ejo, uyu munsi agafata nk’urugendo rurerure, cyangwa akarya ibintu runaka kandi wenda bitewe n’igice cy’umubiri azabagwa, ibyo bitemewe. Ni byiza rero kubaza muganga uko ugomba kwitegura ibagwa ryawe bityo ngo bizagende neza.  6. Ikinya muntera nta ngaruka kingiraho?  Hari imiterere y’umuntu ishobora gutuma ikinya kimugiraho ingaruka, bityo rero ni byiza gusobanuza muganga niba ubuzima bwanyu cyane cyane ubw’ubuhumekero buhagaze neza ngo amenye icyo gukora.  7. Kuki ntagomba kurya mbere yo kubagwa?  Iri tegeko rihabwa umuntu wese ubagwa, ariko abenshi usanga barikurikiza buhumyi batazi impamvu. Ariko impamvu nyayo nuko baba birindo ko mu gihe usinzirijwe n’ikinya waruka maze ibirutsi bikigira mu bihaha. Aha rero umuntu aba agomba gusobanuza neza niba asinzirizwa wese cyangwa igice kimwe, akaba yabasha kuruka bigasohoka bityo akaba yakwirira byoroheje ntiyicwe n’inzara cyane ko usanga hari n’abiyima ibiryo mu masaha 24 abanziriza kubagwa.  8. Gukanguka biragenda bite?  Mu gihe wabazwe, ikinya kimara igihe runaka kitarashira, biyo ugashyirwa mu cyumba bakangukiramo. Ariko se bigenda bite? Aho sinzinzira ubutaza gukanguka? Ninkanguka se ndaba mbasha kuvuga? Ndaba numva ububabare se? Ndaba nshobora kunyeganyega se? N’ibindi nk’ibyo, umuntu aba agomba gusobanukirwa ngo nakanguka amenye icyo agomba gukora ndetse n’abaganga bamwizeze kumuba hafi kugeza akangutse.  9. Nyuma yo kubagwa biragenda bite?  Iyo umuntu amaze kubagwa ntahita akira ngo atahe. Ni ngombwa rero ko usobanuza uko uza kwitwara nyuma yo kubagwa, igihe bizafata ngo ukire neza ndetse n’ibindi byose usabwa ngo igihe uzamara urwaye kizabe kigufi kandi kigende neza.  10. Birantwara amafaranga angahe?  Ni byiza kubaza iki kibazo mbere mu rwego rwo kwirinda gutungurwa nyuma. Hari ubwo wasanga uburyo ubagwa bwaba buri hejuru y’ubushobozi bwawe cyangwa se n’iba n’ubwishingizi ukoresha bushobora kubyishyura bityo ugende uzi neza uko bihagaze

title: Nyagatare: Umugore yataye umwana mu bwogero bw’umukuru w’umudugudu ahita acika
content:
Mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa 07 Nzeri 2017, mu mudugudu wa Kinihira, mu kagari ka Barija ho mu murenge wa Nyagatare mu karere ka Nyagatare, habonetse uruhinja ruri mu kigero cy’ibyumweru bibiri rwari rwatawe mu bwogero bw’urugo rwa BIZIMANA Alphonse na Mbarushimana Donatille bivugwa ko uwasize uru ruhinja yinjiye muri uru rugo ayoboza hanyuma bikarangira agiye mu bwogero agasigamo uru ruhinja akagenda uwamperezayo kugeza n’ubu akaba yaburiwe irengero . Uyu Bizimana wari usanzwe ari umukuru w’umudugudu avuga ko haje umugore usa n’uyoboza, nyuma ngo yaje kugenda hashize akanya Mbarushimana Donatille, umugore wa Bizimana, yumva umwana araririra mu bwiyuhagiriro, ahita ajya kureba asanga ari umwana w’uruhinja batayemo. Ku bw’amahirwe yasanze uwo mwana akiri muzima, gusa ntiyamenye uko byagenze kuko ubwo bwiyuhagiriro butaba mu gikari. Icyahise gikorwa ngo ni ukumenyesha inzego z’ibanze. Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu Ntara y’Uburasirazuba, IP Jean Bosco Dusabe, yahamirije Ikinyamakuru Ukwezi.com iby’iri tabwa ry’uyu mwana ariko avuga ko kugeza ubu hagishakishwa nyina w’umwana ndetse umwana akaba akiri kuri uyu muyobozi w’umudugudu. IP Dusabe yagize ati “Nibyo koko umwana uri mu kigero cy’ibyumweru bibiri yatoraguwe mu bwiherero bw’umukuru w’umudugudu ariko kugeza ubu ntiharamenyekana nyina w’umwana kuko iperereza rigikomeje” Umuvugizi wa Polisi muri iyi Ntara kandi yakomeje asaba abaturage kugira umuco wo gutangira amakuru ku gihe. Aha yagize ati “Urabona nk’ubu niba uwo mudamu yari amaze igihe atwite cyane ko n’ubwo ntawabihamya ariko ntabwo umubyeyi ufite umugabo yaba yaragiye kujugunya uruhinja ahubwo birashoboka ko uwamutaye ari uwatwise inda atateguye ari nayo mpamvu nk’abaturanyi baba barabashije kubimenyesha ubuyobozi mbere akaba yakurikiranwa niba hari n’ubufasha ahabwa akabuhabwa ariko atagiye kujugunya uruhinja” Ingingo ya 231 mu gitabo cy’amategeko ahana y’u Rwanda, iteganya igifungo kuva ku myaka ibiri kugeza kuri itanu, n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi 20 kugeza ku bihumbi 100 ku wahamwe n’icyaha cyo guta umwana cyangwa kumutererana.

title: Amakosa akomeye akorerwa ku meza agatera uburwayi bw’igifu
content: Ubundi umubiri wacu utungwa n’ibyo turya, ariko abahanga mu mikorere y’umubiri wa muntu bahamya ko n’uburyo turya ibidutunga bugira ingaruka zikomeye ku kamaro bitugirira, bityo tukaba tugomba kugira amabwiriza tugenderaho ku meza, haba ku gihe, ubwoko bw’ibiryo tubanza n’ubuheruka, ibivangwa n’ibitavangwa n’ibindi nk’ibyo. Muri iyi nkuru turerekana amwe mu makosa abantu bakora ku meza akaba yabaviramo uburwayi bukomeye bw’igifu ndetse n’ikirungurira giterwa n’ukuzamuka kwa aside (acide) yo mu gifu ikagera mu muhogo. Ikosa rya mbere umuntu agomba kwirinda ni ukurya vuba, ahubwo ugafata umwanya uhagije wo guhekenya ibyo urya ukabinoza neza ukabona kubimira. Irinde guhita uryama nubwo byaba kwirambura mu ntebe cyangwa ahandi hatari mu buriri ukimara kurya ahubwo umare byibura isaha imwe nyuma Si byiza kurya cyangwa kunywa ibyo kunywa birimo gaz nka fanta na byeri Irinde cyane kwambara imyenda igufata mu nda cyane nk’umukandara n’ibindi mu gihe urya cyangwa nyuma yo kurya kuko bigora igogora Ni byiza ko umuntu ava ku meza yijuse, ariko kirazira cyane kugwa ivutu.

title: Nyaruguru: Amakimbirane yo mu ngo yatumye hashyirwaho inzu rusange yo kwahukaniramo
content:
Hagamijwe gukemura ibibazo n’amakimbirane akunze kugaragara mu ngo, aho abashakanye bashwana umwe akaba yahohotera mugenzi we ubuyobozi bw’akarere ka Nyaruguru ku bufatanye n’abafatanyabikorwa bashyizeho inzu izajya ikemurirwamo ibyo bibazo igatangirwamo n’inama. Iyo nzu yubatse mu Murenge wa Nyagisozi aho irimo abakozi bashinzwe gufasha abantu bahuye n’ihohoterwa bakabahuza n’abo bagiranye ibibazo bakabafasha gushaka umuti, byaba ngombwa bakabafasha no kubona ubutabera.
Ni inzu igaragaramo ibyumba n’uburyamo bishobora kurarwamo n’umuntu wahohotewe akaruhuka, aho kujya kurara ahandi mu gasozi cyangwa akahukanira iwabo.
Muri iyi nzu kandi hatangirwa n’izindi serivisi nko gutanga inama ku bafite ibibazo bitandukanye nk’abatewe inda zitifuzwa no kubagira inama mu bijyanye n’amategeko ndetse bagafashwa guhindura imyumvire bakamenya uko bakwirinda ihohohoterwa.
Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Nyaruguru, Habitegeko François, yavuze ko iyo nzu yubatswe ku nkunga y’umuryango mpuzamahanga witwa Health Poverty Action (HPA), ikaba imaze gutanga umusanzu munini mu kunga ingo zirimo ibibazo by’ihohotera.
Habitegeko ati “Iriya nzu yashyizweho mu buryo bwo gukemura ikibazo cy’ihohotera rigaragara, cyane cyane irishingiye ku gitsina no guhozwa ku nkeke. Ihohotera rikunze kuba nijoro bigatuma hari abantu babura aho bahungira; iriya nzu nibyo idufasha”.

 Muri iyi nzu harimo n’aho uwayigannye ashobora kuruhukira  Obed Bizumutima, umwe mu bagabo bagannye iyo nzu nyuma yuko mu rugo rwe harangwaga ihohotera, avuga ko we n’umugore we bagiriwe inama bakaba batagihohoterana.
Ati “Nari mfite ikibazo mu rugo kuko narwanaga n’umugore dupfa ko nasesaguye umutungo. Kuko ari njyewe watezaga imvururu mu rugo umugore yaje kundega ku murenge batwohereza hano ngo batugire inama”.
Umugore we Christine Nyiraneza, avuga ko mu rugo rwabo hahoraga ihohotera aho yarwanaga n’umugabo we buri munsi kubera gupfa umutungo, ariko kuri ubu bakaba babanye neza kubera inama bagiriwe.
Ati “Umugabo wanjye yatahaga yasinze akaza ambwira nabi, natekereza n’imitungo asesagura n’abana baburaye nkamutuka tukarwana, ariko ubu nta kibazo dufite mu rugo n’imirimo yose turayifatanya, ubu ntabwo tukirwana ngo nahukane njye iwacu. Mbere iki kigo kitarubakwa narahukanaga nkajya iwacu, ariko ubu nta makimbirane akigaragara mu rugo rwacu”.
Umwe mu bakozi bashinzwe kwakira abagana iyo nzu, Odette Uwikunda, avuga ko mu kwezi bakira abantu bari hagati ya 20 na 30 kandi baza bafite ibibazo bitandukanye bifitanye isano n’ihohotera mu bo bakira hakaba harimo n’abagabo bahohoterwa n’abagore babo.

 Bamwe mu bagannye iyi nzu 
Ati “Dukora buri munsi amasaha yose, mu gihe cy’ukwezi dushobora kwakira abantu bagera kuri 20, abantu twakira baba bafite ibibazo bitandukanye birimo gusesagura umutungo bakabipfa, gucana inyuma no guharika ndetse no guhozanya ku nkeke.
N’abagore bahohotera abagabo babo, kuko hari umugabo nakiriye umugore yamukubise inkono mu mutwe amusatura umutwe, icyo gihe yaraje n’umugore tubagira inama umugabo amusabira imbabazi, turabigisha ubu babanye neza”.
Ubuyobozi bw’akarere ka Nyaruguru buvuga ko usibye iyi nzu hari n’izindi ngamba zashyizweho mu gukemura ibibazo by’amakimbirane yo mu ngo birimo umugoroba w’ababyeyi, inteko z’abaturage, itorero, ibiganiro n’ibindi. Source: igihe.com

title: Perezida Kagame yageneye ubutumwa busoza umwaka, igisirikare n’inzego z’umutekano -Dore ibikubiyemo
content:
Mu gihe turi mu minsi ya nyuma isoza umwaka wa 2019, Perezida wa Repubulika y’u Rwanda, akanaba umugaba w’ikirenga w’ingabo, Paul Kagame, kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 27 Ukuboza 2019 yageneye ubutumwa busoza umwaka igisirikare n’inzego z’igihugu zishinzwe umutekano. Ni ubutumwa bukubiye mu bice 7 aho Umukuru w’igihugu yatangiye abifuriza n’imiryango yabo kugira ibihe byiza. Yabashimiye uburyo bakomeza gukorana ubwitange barinda ubwigenge avuga ko ibyo bakora ari ibikorwa ntagereranywa bihabwa agaciro n’igihugu. 
 Perezida Kagame kandi yabashimiye imbaraga zikomeye bagaragaje mu bihe bitoroshye igihugu cyanyuzemo muri uyu mwaka anaboneraho guha icyubahiro abatakaje ubuzima. Yashimye ubunyamwuga bukomeje kuranga izi nzego asoza abasaba gukomeza kurangwa n’ubunyamwuga n’indagagaciro zo gukunda igihugu, by’umwihariko abifuriza ishya n’ihirwe mu mwaka mushya wa 2020. Dore ubutumwa mu buryo burambuye Perezida Kagame yageneye igisirikare n’izindi nzego zishinzwe umutekano
 Bagabo namwe bagore bo mu gisirikare n’inzego z’umutekano; 1.Umwaka wa 2019 ugeze ku musozo, kandi turitegura ibirori mu gihe twinjira mu mwaka mushya wa 2020. Ndifuza gufata aka kanya ngo mu izina rya Guverinoma y’u Rwanda, umuryango wanjye ndetse nanjye ubwanjye, mbifuriza ibyiza kuri mwe n’imiryango yanyu. 2. Ndifuza kandi kubashimira uburyo mukomeza gukorana ubwitange mutizigama murinda ubwingenge ndetse n’umutekano w’abantu bacu n’igihugu. 3. U Rwanda rubashimira cyane ubwitange bwanyu ntagereranywa mugaragaza mu guharanira kubungabunga amahoro n’umutekano mu gihugu no hanze yacyo. Ibikorwa bikomeye buri wese muri mwe akorera igihugu cyacu mu gusohoza inshingano zanyu ntabwo ari uw’ubusa, ufite agaciro gakomeye… Turazirikana kandi umubabaro mufite mwe n’abo mukunda muri iki gihe cy’umwaka, kuri mwe muri gukorera kure yo mu rugo n’imiryango yanyu. 4. Kimwe n’indi myaka yatambutse, 2019 yagize ibihe bitari byiza by’umutekano ku bantu n’ubutaka bw’u Rwanda. Imbaraga zikomeye mwagaragaje, buri wese ku giti cye ndetse no mu bufatanye, mukabona ibisubizo biboneye, ku gihe kandi by’ingirakamaro kuri izo ngorane ntabwo byibagirana mu ntekerezo zacu. 5.Ntewe cyane ishema no kubagezaho ishimwe ry’abanyarwanda babahozaho intekerezo n’amasengesho mu gihe murimo kubakira ku byiza byagezweho, mu ntego muhorana yo kugera ku bunyamwuga ndetse no gukunda igihugu biri ku rwego rwo hejuru mu kazi kanyu. 6. Mboneyeho kandi guha icyubahiro, bagenzi bacu batakarije ubuzima mu gihe bitangiraga igihugu ndetse n’isi yose muri 2019. Ku miryango yabuze abo mwakundaga, ndabihanganisha cyane. 
Abanyarwanda bazirikana abo mwabuze, nk’impano ikomeye cyane ku Gihugu, kuko gikomeje gutekana, gukomera no kumera neza. 7. Reka nsoze ubu butumwa, mbasaba mwese kugumana ndetse no kurushaho kunoza ubunyamwuga ndetse n’indagagaciro yo gukunda igihugu mwagaragaje muri 2019. Ndabifuriza mwese n’imiryango yanyu Umwaka mushya muhire wa 2020.  Imana ibahe umugisha mwese

title: Col Byabagamba na Rusagara urukiko rw’ubujurire rwabagabanyirije igifungo, bakatirwa 15
content: Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rwakatiye Col Tom Byabagamba na Rtd Brig Gen Frank Rusagara igifungo cy’imyaka 15, bari bajuriye nyuma yo kutanyurwa n’igihano bakatiwe n’Urukiko Rukuru rwa Gisirikare mu 2016. Mu mwanzuro watangajwe ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 27 Ukuboza 2019, umucamanza yatangaje iki gifungo nyuma yo gusanga Byabagamba ahamwa n’ibyaha birimo gusuzugura ibendera ry’igihugu. Umucamanza yavuze ko iki cyaha cyasuzumwe hashingiwe ku mashusho yagaragaye, ubwo we ubwe [Byabagamba] atigeze aterera isaluti ibendera ry’igihugu ryazamurwaga, mu gihe nk’umusirikare yari abitegetswe. Mu bindi byaha yahamijwe harimo icyo kwamamaza nkana ibihuha no kugomesha rubanda arwangisha ubutegetsi buriho, gukora igikorwa kigamije gusebya Leta ari Umuyobozi ndetse no gutunga imbunda binyuranije n’amategeko. Mu gihe ibyaha yahamijwe ari nabyo urukiko rwa gisirikare rwashingiyeho rumukatira gufungwa imyaka 21, umucamanza w’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire yavuze ko basanze hari ibyo urukiko rwa mbere rwirengagije, kuko ibyaha Byabagamba yarezwe bihanishwa igifungo kiri hagati y’imyaka 10 na 15. We yajuriraga asaba urukiko ko yagirwa umwere, ariko urukiko rw’ubujurire rumuhanisha igihano kinini mu biteganywa ku byaha aregwa, ni ukuvuga gufungwa imyaka 15. Rtd Brig Gen Frank Rusagara na we yakatiwe gufungwa imyaka 15, nyuma y’uko Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rwasanze ahamwa n’ibyaha byose nk’uko Urukiko rukuru rwa Gisirikare rwabimuhamije, rukamukatira gufungwa imyaka 20. Birimo kwamamaza nkana ibihuha no kugomesha rubanda arwangisha ubutegetsi buriho, gukora igikorwa kigamije gusebya Leta ari Umuyobozi ndetse no gutunga imbunda binyuranije n’amategeko. Na we Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rwavuze ko ibyaha yahamijwe n’Urukiko rukuru rwa gisirikare bimuhama, ariko ko urukiko rwa mbere hari ibyo rwirengagije, kuko itegeko rihana ibyaha yaregwaga riteganya igifungo kiri hagati y’imyaka 10 na 15, bityo ahanishwa ikinini muri ibyo, ni ukuvuga gufungwa imyaka 15. Byabagamba na Rusagara bakatiwe mu bujurire nyuma y’imyaka itanu bamaze muri gereza, kuko batawe muri yombi mu 2014. Ni ukuvuga ko basigaje indi myaka 10 ngo barekurwe, kereka bafunguwe by’agateganyo kubera imyitwarire yabo n’igihe bazaba barangije ku gihano cyabo. Isomwa ry’urubanza rwabo ribayeho nyuma yo gusubikwa inshuro eshatu kubera ko imyanzuro yari itararangiza kwandikwa. Ubwo iburanisha mu bujurire ryasozwaga muri Nzeri 2019, urukiko rwatangaje ko umwanzuro uzasomwa tariki 15 Ugushyingo, biza kwimurirwa ku wa 13 Ukuboza, nyuma bishyirwa kuri uyu wa 27 Ukuboza. Aba uko ari babiri bari banafunganywe na Sgt Kabayiza François wahoze ari umushoferi wa Rusagara, we igifungo cy’imyaka itanu yari yakatiwe cyarangiye urubanza rukiburanwa mu bujurire, ahita arekurwa. Me Buhuru Pierre Celestin wunganira Rusagara, yavuze ko bishimiye umwanzuro w’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rwagabanyije igihano cy’uwo yunganira, ariko avuga ko asanga nta mpamvu yagombaga gutuma akatirwa igifungo kuko ari umwere. Yavuze ko agiye gufata igihe akavugana n’umukiliya we, ku buryo bibaye ngombwa banajuririra Urukiko rwa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Src:Igihe

title: RDC: Muzito wahoze ari Minisitiri w’Intebe yasabye Congo gutera u Rwanda ikarwegukana
content:
Muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (RDC), Adolphe Muzito wahoze ari Minisitiri w’Intebe w’iki gihugu, kuri ubu akaba ari Umuhuzabikorwa w’ihuriro ry’amashyaka atavuga rumwe na Leta muri icyo gihugu ryitwa Lamuka, yatunguranye ahamagarira igihugu cye gushoza intambara k’u Rwanda. Nk’uko inkuru dukesha urubuga rwa Radiyo Mpuzamahanga y’Abafaransa, RFI ibivuga, ibi Muzito yabitangaje kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 23 Ukuboza 2019 mu murwa mukuru i Kinshasa ubwo yakoraga ikiganiro cye cya mbere n’itangazamakuru nk’umuhuzabikorwa wa Lamuka, aho yashinjaga u Rwanda kuba inyuma y’ibikorwa by’umutekano muke mu burasirazuba bw’iki gihugu, gusa iyi mvugo ye ntiyahuriweho n’abandi bayobozi ba Lamuka.

Adolphe Muzito yabaye Minisitiri w’Intebe wa Congo hagati ya 2008 na 2012 Ku bwa Adolphe Muzito, gushyira imbaraga mu ngabo ziri mu butumwa bw’Umuryango w’Abibumbye, Monusco ntibitanga igisubizo kirambye mu kugarura amahoro mu Burasirazuba bwa Congo, ahubwo we akaba asaba ko hashyirwaho ingamba zikaze. Yagize ati "Gukemura ikibazo, hagomba gushozwa intambara k’u Rwanda. Niba dushaka kugenzura uburasirazuba bwa Repubulika, u Rwanda rugomba guterwa. Kugira ngo intambara ibe, hakenewe igisirikare, hakenewe ubuyobozi bukomeye n’amikoro ahagije maze tukigarurira u Rwanda. Nyuma u Rwanda tukarwomeka kuri Congo."

Adolphe Muzito avuga ashize amanga ko u Rwanda rwivanga muri politike ya Congo Kinshasa na Uganda ariko nta gihamya y’ibyo avuga Muri iki kiganiro n’abanyamakuru cyamaze hafi amasaha abiri, Adolphe Muzito yanasobanuye ko yifuza ko Umuryango w’Ubukungu w’ibihugu byo mu biyiga bigari  (CEPGL) wagakwiye gukora kurushaho mu rwego rwo kwirinda amakimbirane hagati y’abanyamuryango bityo kwitabaza intambara ntibibe bikenewe. Muzito ati "Iyo mvuga gutera u Rwanda, bivuga ko hari ubwo bizaba ngombwa ko bikora, niba hagati aho ibintu bitagiye mu buryo. Ntabwo ari intego ubwayo." Gusa iki gitekerezo cya Adolphe Muzito ntabwo agihuriyeho n’abandi bayobozi ba Lamuka. Urugero ni nka Moïse Katumbi na Jean Pierre Bemba, bo bahise bashyira hanze itangazo ryo kwitandukanya na we ku mugaragaro, bavuga ko ibyo Muzito avuga ari "Icyifuzo gihishe byinshi bibi" ndetse kirimo kuremereza ibintu no gukabya, bityo bagasaba Muzito kwivuguruza mu rwego rwo kwirinda gutatira ibyo Lamuka iharanira. Uku kutavuga rumwe muri Lamuka, kuje mu gihe abayobozi bayo biteguraga kujya i Beni mu rwego rwo kugaragariza abahatuye ubufatanye. Ku ruhande rwa Leta y’u Rwanda, Umunyamabanga Mukuru muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga, Olivier Nduhungirehe yanenze imvugo y’uyu munyapolitike, agaragaza ko nta bwenge buyirimo, mu butumwa yanyujije ku rukuta rwe rwa Twitter agira ati "Umunsi Adolphe Muzito azagarura amahoro mu gace kitwa ’Ntekerezo nzima (Raison)’ n’umunsi azigarurira ubutaka bwitwa ’Ubwonko (cerveau)’ bizaba ari intambwe ikomeye."

Ubutumwa bwa Olivier Nduhungirehe bunnyega amagambo ya Muzito

title: Abagize umuryango wa Perezida Kagame na bo bitanze mu gikorwa cyo gufasha buri rugo gutunga Smart Phone
content:
Perezida Paul Kagame yagaragaje ko umuryango we na wo wemeye kuzatanga inkunga mu gikorwa cyo gufasha buri rugo gutunga Smart Phone. Yagiye yerekana abo mu muryango we inkunga yabo barimo na Brian Kagame wimenyereza umwuga. Ubu butumwa Perezida Kagame Paul yabunyujije kuri Twitter ye ashimira uuryango we wemeye kwifatanya n’abandi bakomeje kwitanga muri iki gikorwa we ubwe yatangije mu mpera z’icyumweru gishize cyiswe Connect Rwanda. Yagize ati “Ishimwe ku muryango wange wakiriye umukoro wange wo kugira uruhare muri gahunda ya Connect Rwanda no gutanga inkunga yabo ya Smart Phone.” Yakomeje agaragaza buri umwe wo mu muryango we inkunga yemeye kwitanga, Madamu Jeannette Kagame yemeye gutanga Telephone 27. Naho abana be, yavuze ko Yvan Cyomoro Kagame yemeye Smart Phones 23, Ange Kagame n’umugabo we Bertrand bakaba bemeye 15 naho Ian Kagame akaba yemeye 15. Yavuze kandi ko na bucura wabo Brian Kagame ku mafaranga yizigamiye mu kwimenyereza umwuga yemeye gutanga smart Phone 5 naho Mwisengeneza wa Jeannette Kagame witwa Nana ukiri muri Kaminuza akaba yitanze Smart Phones 3.
 Abantu batandukanye bagaragaje ko bakozwe ku mutima n’ibi byakozwe n’umuryango wa Perezida Kagame banawushimira guhora ari intangarugero. Abandi baboneyeho no kwifuriza uyu muryango kugira Noheli nziza n’Umwaka mushya muhire, bavugaga ko abana ba Perezida Kagame ari nka ya mvugo y’Umunyarwanda wagize uti “Kwibyara gutera ababyeyi ineza.” Izi Smart Phones 88 zemewe n’umuryango wa Perezida Paul Kagame ziriyongera ku zindi 1 500 zemewe na Perezida Kagame ubwe wanatangije iki gikorwa gikomeje gushyigikirwa n’abantu banyuranye.

Perezida Kagame n’umuryango we bazatanga telefone 1588 Minisiteri y’Ikoranabuhanga na Inovasiyo mu kiganiro yaraye igiranye n’Itangazamakuru, yavuze ko hari gahunda yatangijwe y’Intore mu Ikoranabuhanga zigenda zigisha abanyarwanda gukoresha ikoranabuhanga. Minisitiri w’Ikoranabuhanga na Inovasiyo yavuze ko ko iyi gahunda igiye gutizwa umurindi kugira ngo imiryango itishoboye izahabwa ziriya Telephone izabashe kuzikoresha mu kugera kuri serivisi zinyuranye. Minisitiri w’Ikoranabuhanga na Inovasiyo yavuze kandi ko hazanubakwa iminara mishya izafasha abazatunga izi telephone kubona ihuzanzira [network] ryihuta. Src:Umuseke

title: Urubanza rwa Nsabimana Callixte ‘Sankara’ rwasubitswe
content: Urubanza mu mizi rwa Nsabimana Callixte uzwi nka Sankara, uburana yemera ibyaha ashinjwa, rwasubitswe biturutse ku kuba ubushinjacyaha bwarakiriye dosiye y’undi muntu ufite aho ahuriye n’ibyaha ashinjwa. Urubanza ruregwamo Nsabimana wigambye ibitero bitandukanye byagiye bigabwa mu gice cyegereye Pariki y’Igihugu ya Nyungwe, rwagombaga gutangira kuri uyu munsi tariki 24 Ukuboza 2019 mu rugereko rw’Urukiko Rukuru ruburanisha ibyaha Mpuzamahanga n’ibyambukiranya imbibi ruri i Nyanza. Nsabimana yagejejwe mu rukiko ahagana Saa tatu zuzuye yambaye imyambaro iranga abagororwa, inkweto za sandale n’amasogosi ya Orange arimo akabara k’umweru. Yari yunganiwe n’Umunyamategeko we Nkundabarashi Moïse, wanamwunganiye mu bugenzacyaha no mu kuburana ku ifungwa n’ifungurwa ry’agateganyo. Ku rukiko umutekano wakajijwe ucunzwe n’abapolisi bari imbere mu rukiko no hanze yarwo. Hari kandi abanyamakuru benshi baba abakorera ibinyamakuru byo mu Rwanda na mpuzamahanga. Akigera mu rukiko yabanje gusomerwa imyirondoro ye yemera ko ari yo. Ubushinjacyaha bwagaragaje ko bwamenye amakuru ko muri dosiye ya Nsabimana hajemo abandi bakekwaho gukorana na we barimo uwitwa Private Muhire Dieudonné, bityo bwifuza ko habanza gukurikiranwa neza iyo dosiye hakamenyekana niba koko ifitanye isano n’iya Nsabimana kugira ngo urubanza ruzaburanishirizwe hamwe. Me Nkundabarashi yavuze ko bigoye kuvuga kuri uwo Private Muhire Dieudonné, kuko uwo yunganira atamuzi kandi ngo batigeze bakorana. Umucamanza yabahaye umwanya wo kubanza kuyisoma; Me Nkundabarashi avuga ko uwo Private Muhire atazwi na Nsabimana. Nsabimana yahawe ijambo avuga ko uwo Private Muhire atamuzi bityo ntacyo yamuvugaho. Ubushinjacyaha bwavuze ko kuba Nsabimana, avuga ko atamuzi urukiko rukwiye gutanga umwanya hakabanza kwigwa neza iyo dosiye. Urukiko rumaze kumva impande zombi rwanzuye ko urubanza rusubikwa rukazaburanywa mu mizi 17 Mutarama 2020. Ibyaha 16 ashinjwa ni iremwa ry’umutwe w’ingabo ritemewe, Icyaha cy’iterabobwoba ku nyungu za politiki, gukora no kugira uruhare mu bikorwa by’iterabwoba, gutanga amabwiriza mu gikorwa cy’iterabwoba, kuba mu mutwe w’iterabwoba, icyaha cyo kugambana no gushishikariza abandi gukora iterabwoba, ubwicanyi n’ubwinjiracyaha bw’ubwicanyi, gufata bugwate, gukwiza amakuru atariyo cyangwa icengezamatwara rigamije kwangisha leta y’u Rwanda mu bihugu by’amahanga, guhakana Jenoside. Hari ukwiba yitwaje intwaro, gutwika, kugirana umubano na leta y’amahanga hagamijwe gushoza intambara, gukora cyangwa gukoresha impapuro mpimbano, gukubita no gukomeretsa ku bushake no gutanga, kwakira no gushishikariza kwakira ibikomoka ku iterabwoba. Ubwo yaburanaga ku ifungwa n’ifungurwa ry’agateganyo, Nsabimana yemeye ibyaha byose ashinjwa, asaba abanyarwanda n’Umukuru w’Igihugu imbabazi. Nsabimana yari umuvugizi w’umutwe wa politiki, MRCD, udahwema kwigamba ibikorwa by’ubugizi bwa nabi nk’igitero cyagabwe umwaka ushize i Nyabimata mu Karere ka Nyaruguru, n’icya Kitabi byose byahitanye ubuzima bw’abaturage ndetse imodoka zigatwikwa.
