title: Perezida Paul Kagame yizihije isabukuru y’imyaka 62 amaze avutse – INCAMAKE Y’AMATEKA YE
content:
Kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 23 Ukwakira, 2019 ni umunsi ukomeye kuri Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika y’u Rwanda Paul Kagame n’umuryango we, aho yizihiza isabukuru y’imyaka 62 amaze abonye izuba. Nk’uko Kigali Post isanzwe igaruka ku mateka y’abantu b’ikitegererezo mu gihe haba hazirikanwa iminsi yabo ikomeye mu buzima, ubu twahisemo kugaruka ku ncamake y’amateka ya Perezida Paul Kagame ufatwa n’abatari bake nk’ikitegererezo bishingiye ku bikorwa bitandukanye agenda afasha umuryango nyarwanda, Afurika n’isi muri rusange.

 Perezida Paul Kagame yahaye u Rwanda icyerekezo gihamye nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994  Perezida Paul Kagame yavutse ku itariki ya 23 Ukwakira, 1957 avukira ku musozi wa Nyarutovu mu cyari Komini Tambwe mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Gitarama, ubu ni mu karere ka Ruhango. Amateka avuga ko se wa Paul Kagame ari we Deogratius Rutagambwa, akomoka mu muryango umwe n’umwami Mutara III, ariko ntiyahisemo kubaho ubuzima bushamikiye cyane ku ngoma ya cyami ahubwo yahisemo kubaho ubuzima bwe busanzwe. Asteria Rutagambwa; nyina wa Paul Kagame, akomoka mu muryango w’umugabekazi wa nyuma u Rwanda rwagize mbere y’uko ingoma ya cyami icyura igihe, uwo akaba ari Rosalie Gicanda. Paul Kagame niwe muhererezi mu muryango wabo, akaba avukana n’abandi bana batanu bakuru kuri we, na we wa gatandatu Mu 1961 ubwo yari afite imyaka ine gusa y’amavuko, Paul Kagame yavuye mu gihugu n’umuryango we, kubera ibikorwa by’ubwicanyi n’itoteza ryakorerwaga Abatutsi kuva mu nkubiri y’icyiswe impinduramatwara (revolisiyo) yo mu mwaka w’1959. Umuryango we wahungiye ahitwa Gahunge, mu karere ka Toro mu gihugu cya Uganda. Paul Kagame amashuri ye yisumbuye yayigiye ku ishuri ryisumbuye rya Ntare School i Mbarara, ayakomereza kuri Old School i Kampala kuva mu 1972 kugeza mu 1976. Ku myaka 22, ni ukuvuga muri 1979, yagiye muri Tanzaniya ahari ikigo cyitorezagamo ingabo zigamije kurwanya akarengane muri aka karere, aha ni naho yahuriye n’uwaje kuvamo Perezida wa Uganda,Yoweri Kaguta Museveni, aho bafatanyije mu ntambara yo guhirika ingoma y’igitugu ya Idi Amin Dada, hifashishijwe umutwe wa NRA (National Resistance Army) wari ushyigikiwe na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Mu mwaka w’ 1986, nibwo Yoweri Kaguta Museveni yabaye Perezida wa Uganda maze abenshi mu banyarwanda bafatanyije kurwana iyo ntambara bagirwa abasirikare bakomeye mu gisirikare cya Uganda, Paul Kagame ahabwa ipeti rya Major ndetse ahabwa umwanya w’umuyobozi wungirije mu rwego rw’iperereza mu ngabo za Uganda. Nyuma gato yaje kwerekeza mu gihugu cya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika kwiga ibijyanye n’igisirikare.

 Intwari Fred Gisa Rwigema(ibumoso) na Paul Kagame(iburyo), batangiranye urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu  Nyuma y’urupfu rutunguranye rwa Gen.Fred Rwigema mu 1990, Paul Kagame yahise ava muri Amerika aza kuyobora ingabo zari iza RPA ku rugamba rwo kubohora igihugu rwari rurimbanyije icyo gihe. Paul Kagame yayoboye izi ngabo kugeza n’igihe zahagarikaga Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu mwaka w’1994.


 Perezida Kagame yayoboye igisirikare cyahagaritse Jenoside  Ku itariki ya 19 Nyakanga 1994 kugeza muri Mata 2000 nyuma y’urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu Paul Kagame yabaye Visi Perezida w’u Rwanda ndetse na Minisitiri w’Ingabo. Ku itariki ya 17 Mata 2000, Paul Kagame yabaye Perezida w’u Rwanda nyuma yo kwegura kwa Pasteur Bizimungu. Ku itariki ya 25 Kanama 2003 yatorewe kuyobora igihugu kuri manda ye ya mbere. Ku itariki ya 9 Kanama 2010 Paul Kagame yongeye gutorerwa kuyobora manda ye ya kabiri, ndetse muri Kanama uyu mwaka wa 2017 yongeye kurahirira kuyobora u Rwanda nyuma yo kwegukana intsinzi mu matora ya Perezida wa Repubulika yaje akurikira aya referandumu aho abaturage bari basabye ko itegeko nshinga rya Repubulika y’u Rwanda ryahindurwa hakavugururwa ingingo zakumiraga perezida Paul Kagame kwiyamamaza.  Paul Kagame n’umuryango we…  Tariki ya 10 Kamena 1989, mu gihugu cya Uganda nibwo Perezida Paul Kagame n’umufasha we Jeannette Kagame bambikanye impeta basezerana kubana mu rukundo n’ubwuzuzanye nk’umugabo n’umugore. Kugeza ubu uyu muryango ufitanye abana bane barimo abahungu batatu n’umukobwa umwe.

 K’umunsi w’ubukwe bwabo  Nk’uko tubikesha urubuga rwa interineti rwa Wikipedia, Jeanette Kagame yari yarahungiye mu gihugu cya Kenya, cyo kimwe na Nyakubahwa Paul Kagame nawe akaba yari umwe mu banyarwanda bari barahejejwe ishyanga na politike y’ivangura yahozeho mu gihe cya Leta ya mbere ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ndetse nawe akaba yari umunyamuryango wa FPR anashyigikiye igitekerezo cyo gutahuka mu Rwanda. Uyu muryango nyuma yo gusezerana kubana batangiranye urugendo rurerure rw’ubuzima ndetse bombi bongera gutahuka mu gihugu cyabo mu mwaka w’1994 nyuma y’intambara y’urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu no guhagarika Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Urugamba rwari ruyobowe na Paul Kagame nyuma y’uko Fred Rwigema yitabye Imana mu ntangiriro y’uru rugendo rurerure. Nyuma yo gutahuka mu gihugu cyababyaye, bakomeje gutanga umusanzu wo kubaka igihugu cyari kimaze kuzahazwa n’intambara, politike mbi ndetse na Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yari imaze guhitana abarenga miliyoni.

 Jeannette Kagame yabaye hafi abapfakazi ba Jenoside n’indi miryango itishoboye

title: Perezida Kagame yatashye Icyambu gishya kidakora ku mazi k’i Masaka
content:
Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame arahamagarira abacuruzi bo mu Rwanda no mu karere ruherereyemo kubyaza umusaruro icyambu kidakora ku mazi magari cyatashywe ku mugaragaro kuri uyu wa Mbere mu karere ka Kicukiro mu Mujyi wa Kigali, kuko cyizafasha kugabanya ikiguzi cy’ubucuruzi ndetse n’igihe ibicuruzwa byabo byamaraga mu nzira. Ibi ni mu gihe isoko ryo mu karere no ku mugabane wa Afrika rikomeje kwaguka. Kigali Logistics Platform, ni icyambu kidakora ku mazi magari giherereye i Masaka mu Karere ka Kicukiro, kikaba icya mbere cyo muri ubu bwoko cyubatswe ku mugabane wa Afurika no mu karere u Rwanda ruherereyemo, kikaba cyarubatswe ku bufatanye bwa Leta y’u Rwanda na sosiyete Dubai Ports World, cyangwa DP World mu mpine.
 Uretse ikoranabuhanga mu gupakira no gupakurura kontineri y’ibicuruzwa biva ku minsi iri hagati ya 10 na 14 ikagera ku minsi 3 gusa, iki cyambu gitanga zimwe muri serivisi za gasutamo ubusanzwe zatangirwaga ku byambu byo ku mazi magari, nkuko Fred Seka, umwe mu bunganira abacuruzi muri gasutamo abisobanura. Ububiko bw’ibicuruzwa bw’iki cyambu bwubatse kuri metero kare 19 600, bufite ubushobozi bwo kwakira toni 50 ku munsi, ni ukuvuga toni ibihumbi 640 buri mwaka ndetse na kontineri z’ibicuruzwa zigera ku bihumbi 50, ni ukuvuga hafi inshuro 10 ubwa MAGERWA.
 Nyuma yo kwerekwa ibice binyuranye by’iki cyambu, Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame yashimiye Sosiyete Dubai Ports World ku bw’iri shoramari, agaragaza ko aya ari amahirwe ku Rwanda muri iki gihe isoko rikomeje kwaguka. Yagize ati “U Rwanda ruri mu miryango y’ubukungu irimo uwa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, EAC, ndetse na COMESA. Ahazaza h’ubucuruzi n’ubuhahirane ku mugabane wacu, ni isoko rusange rya Afurika, ubucuruzi n’ubuhahirane bikazatangira muri Nyakanga umwaka utaha. Ariko nanone amasezerano y’ubucuruzi ubwayo nta mpinduka yazana mu gihe nta bikorwa remezo bihari. Hamwe no gufungura iki cyambu rero, u Rwanda rurimo gukora ibyo rusabwa kugira ngo rugere ku isoko rigari ry’abaguzi basaga miliyari na miliyoni 200 muri Afurika n’ahandi.”

Sultan Ahmed Bin Sulayem, Umuyobozi wa Sosiyete DP World ku Isi Umuyobozi wa Sosiyete DP World ku Isi, Sultan Ahmed Bin Sulayem, we yagaragaje ko atewe ishema no gushora imari mu Rwanda, igihugu yashimangiye ko gifite imiyoborere ireba kure kikaba amarembo meza yo kwagura ubucuruzi mu karere no muri Afurika muri rusange. Yagize ati “Twe tubona u Rwanda nk’amarembo meza kuko ruri mu mutima wa Afurika. Ibi ni mwe mwabikoze natwe rero reka tubikoreshe, kandi turabashimiye ku bw’ayo mahirwe mwaduhaye! Icyiza twe twabonye ku Rwanda ni urugwiro abayobozi bagira, ni igihugu gifite imiyoborere myiza kandi ikora mu buryo bunoze. Ibyo mureba hano ntabwo ari iby’u Rwanda gusa, kuko twabwiye abantu ko tuzajya tugeza ibicuruzwa no muri Centrafurika, mu Burundi, Malawi, Congo ndetse na Tanzania na Kenya.” Aha ni ho Umukuru w’igihugu yahereye, asaba abacuruzi n’abashoramari kubyaza umusaruro amahirwe begerejwe n’iki cyambu. Yagize ati “Turifuza guhamagarira abacuruzi n’abashoramari bacu duhereye ku nganda ziri muri aka gace, mu karere n’ahandi, kubyaza umusaruro iki cyambu. Nta rwitwazo na rumwe rwatuma amahirwe menshi nk’aya tutayabyaza inyungu.”
 Kigali Logistics Platform yatangiye kubakwa mu mwaka ushize wa 2018 hashingiwe ku masezerano y’imyaka 25 Leta y’u Rwanda yagiranye na sosiyete DP World. Mu gihe gito imirimo itangiye, iki cyambu cyahaye akazi abagera kuri 667, aho 98% ari Abanyarwanda. Igice cya mbere cyatashywe kuri uyu wa mbere, cyatwaye miliyoni 50 z’amadorali ya Amerika, ni ukuvuga asaga miliyari 40 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda, hakaba hatahiwe igice cya 2 cyo kubaka ibyumba bikonjesha, cold rooms, kikazatwara abarirwa muri miliyoni 35 z’amadorali, ni ukuvuga asaga miliyari 30 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda.

title: Rusizi: Hatewe grenade mu mujyi wa Kamembe ikomeretse bane
content:
Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 19 Ukwakira 2019 ni bwo umuntu utaramenyekana yateye igisasu cya grenade mu mujyi wa Kamembe, mu kagari ka Kamashangi mu murenge wa Kamembe mu karere ka Rusizi. BBC yavuze ko aho iyi grenade yaturikiye ari mu mujyi hafi y’akabari ahari abantu benshi bari bamaze kurebera umupira w’u Rwanda na Ethiopia nk’uko umuturage witwa Jean Pierre Nshimiyimana wo muri aka kagari yabyemeje. Nshimiyimana utuye muri aka gace yabwiye BBC ko iki gisasu bagiteye imbere y’akabari hafi y’ahitwa ku muhanda wa kane mu gace bita ’site’, avuga ko bakeka ko uwateye iyi grenade yashakaga kuyitera mu bantu bari mu kabari bamaze kureba umupira ariko ntabigereho neza. Itangazo ryahise rishyirwa hanze na Polisi y’u Rwanda rigenewe abanyamakuru ryemeza ko iki gisasu cyatewe ahagana saa moya n’igice kigakomeretsa byoroheje abantu bane bahise bajyanwa mu bitaro. Inzego z’umutekano zikaba zatangiye iperereza rigamije gutahura uwo ari we wese wabigizemo uruhare.

title: Dr Iyamuremye Augustin ni we watorewe kuba Perezida muri manda ya gatatu ya Sena
content:
Nkuko byari biteganijwe, mu muhango witabiriwe na Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 17 Ukwakira 2019 ni bwo Abasenateri bagize manda ya 3 ya Sena barahiriye gusohoza inshingano zabo neza aho Dr. Iyamuremye Augustin yatorewe kuyobora Sena y’u Rwanda muri manda y’imyaka itanu iri imbere. Dr Iyamuremye Augustin wari wamamajwe na Prof. Karangwa Chrysologue yaje ku isonga n’amajwi 25 mu gihe Zephirin Kalimba bari bahatanye yagize ijwi rimwe.

Dr Iyamuremye Augustin watorewe kuba Perezida wa Sena yari asanzwe ayobora Urwego Ngishwanama rw’Inararibonye Madame Nyirasafari Esperance wari usanzwe ari Minisitiri w’Umuco yatorewe kuba Visi Perezida wa Sena ushinzwe iby’amategeko no kugenzura ibikorwa bya Guverinoma aho yagize amajwi 23 mu gihe Hadija Ndangiza Murangwa bahataniraga uyu mwanya we yagize amajwi atatu. Mukabaramba Alvera we yatowe ku mwanya wa Visi Perezida ushinzwe imari n’abakozi agize amajwi 22 mu gihe Umuhire Adrie bahatanye yagize amajwi 4.

Bamwe mu basenateri barahiye Uretse abasenateri 20 binjiye muri manda ya gatatu ya sena barahiriye imbere y’Umukuru w’igihugu, hanarahiye Umukuru w’Urwego rw’Igihugu rw’Imiyoborere RGB, Dr Usta Kaitesi, umwungirije ari we Dr Emmanuel Nibishaka na Maj. Gen. Emmanuel Bayingana warahiye ku mwanya w’umugaba w’ingabo zirwanira mu kirere.

Maj. Gen Bayingana Emmanuel, uherutse kugirwa Umugaba w’Ingabo zirwanira mu kirere na we yarahiye Nyuma yo kwakira indahiro z’aba basenateri n’abandi bayobozi mu nzego zitandukanye, Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame yabwiye abayobozi ko gukorera igihugu ari ishema n’amahirwe, kandi ko ayo mahirwe bagomba kuyakoresha bageza ku Banyarwanda ibyo babategerejeho. 

Perezida Kagame yasabye abasenateri gusohoza neza inshingano zabo Perezida Kagame yashimiye abasenateri bacyuye igihe, by’umwihariko abari bagize biro, ku bw’imirimo bakoze, kuko ari yo ababasimbuye bazubakira. Yabwiye abashya ko ubunararibonye bafite ari bwo bwatumye bagirirwa icyizere, abasaba kwegera abaturage cyane kuko babategerejeho byinshi. Tubibutse ko aba basenateri 20 batangiye imirimo mishya baje basanga abandi 6 basanzwe muri Sena, bazasoza manda yabo mu mwaka utaha wa 2020 ari na bwo hazashyirwaho ababasimbura, barimo bane bazashyirwaho na Perezida wa Repubulika abandi 2 bakazashyirwaho n’Ihuriro Nyunguranabitekerezo ry’Imitwe ya Politiki yemewe mu Rwanda.

title: Manda ya 3 ya Sena iratangira uyu munsi, icyo abaturage bayitezeho
content: Abasenateri bagize manda ya 3 ya Sena barahira kuri uyu wa Kane, abaturage barasaba ko uru rwego rwacukumbura ibibazo by’ingutu byugarije umuryango nyarwanda. Abanyarwanda b’ingeri zitandukanye baragaraza Sena nk’urwego bafitiye icyizere ndetse bitezeho gukemura mu buryo bumwe cyangwa ubundi ibibazo abaturage bagaragaza nk’ibibahangayijishije. Mukantabana Assia utuye mu Mujyi wa Kigali yagize ati ‘‘Abasenateri tubitezeho guhagararira igihugu no kuvugira abaturage ku mategeko tugenderaho.’’ Ilunga Longin we yavuze ko abasenateri bashya bakwiye kwita ku bibazo bikiri mu bwisungane mu kwivuza buzwi nka mituweli ndetse no kubaka mu kajagari. Yagize ati ‘‘Ntabwo ari n’abasenateri bonyine navuga ko ari abayobozi muri rusange, hari ibibazo ubona bimaze kuba birebire cyane kandi byakagombye gukemuka. Nk’ikibazo cya mituweli, icyo kibazo kimaze kuba kirekire kandi bitari ngombwa. Ugasanga umuturage amaze hafi imyaka itatu akiri kuburana avuga ngo kuki nkiri muri iki cyiciro kandi ntakagombye kuba nkirimo.Ikindi kibazo cya kabiri bakagombye kurebaho cyane ni ikibazo cy’utujagari, barakemura akajagari hamwe ahandi kari kuvuka kandi abayobozi bari kurebera ntibagire ikintu bavuga. Ejo bakazongera bagasohora amafaranga ya Leta, yavuye mu misoro y’abaturage ngo bagiye kongera kwimura abantu.’’ Mukamana Annonciata avuga ko hari ibibazo biri mu misoro abasenateri bakwiye gukoraho ubuvugizi. Yagize ati ‘‘Batugabangirize rero, batuvugire abo basenateri ku kibazo cy’imisoro y’inzu rwose n’imisoro muri rusange.’’ Nyuma y’imyaka 16 igiyeho, Sena y’u Rwanda igeze muri manda yayo ya 3. Abagabo n’abagore 20 barimo 12 batorewe mu Ntara n’Umujyi wa Kigali, 2 batowe mu mashuri makuru na kaminuza za Leta n’izigenga, 2 batorwa n’Ihuriro Nyunguranabitekerero ry’Imitwe ya Politiki yemewe mu Rwanda mu gihe  4 bashyizweho na Perezida wa Repubulika, ni bo banditse amateka yo kubimburira abandi muri manda ya 3 ya Sena. Kuri ubu amashyushyu ni yose ku bibaza uzayobora Sena y’u Rwanda. Ese amateka zizubiramo ukomoka muri PSD yomgere kuyobora uru rwego? Ese aba visi perezida barongera umwe aturuke muri FPR undi muri  PDI nk’uko byari bimeze muri manda ishize? Umunyamakuru Oswal Mutuyeyezu aragaragaza ibyo ashingiraho avuga uwo abona ko yaba nomero ya Kabiri mu gihugu ari we muyobozi wa Sena. Yagize ati ‘‘Niba uyobora Umutwe w’Abadepite ari umu PL, hanyuma Perezida wa Repubulika akaba aturuka mu Murwango RPF Inkotanyi, byanze bikunze nimero ya kabiri mu gihugu arava mu rindi shyaka kandi muri ariya ahari irifite imbara ni PSD. Agomba kuva muri PSD byanze bikunze.’’ Yunzemo ati ‘‘Ndatekereza umusaza Dr Augustin Iyamuremye, inararibonye, afite imyaka 73, urebye ’domaines’ zose yazibayeho minisitiri, yabaye minisitiri wa za minisiteri zitandukanye, ikindi yayoborga iyi nama y’inararibonye. Byanze bikunze ni we ubona ko nibura azi ibintu byinshi.’’ Abasenateri bashya basanze muri Sena 6 bayinjiye muri Sena umwaka umwe nyuma ya bagenzi babo hakurikijwe uburyo abagize uru rwego batorwa bakanashyirwaho. Aba bazamarana umwaka n’abasenateri bashya mbere y’uko basimburwa n’abarimo 4 bazashyirwaho na Perezida wa Repubulika na 2 bazatorwa n’Ihuriro Nyunguranabitekerezo ry’Imitwe ya Politi yemewe mu Rwanda. Iyi manda ya 3 y’abagize Sena ni yo yambere y’imyaka 5 ishobora kongerwa rimwe kuko manda ebyiri zabanje zari iz’imyaka 8, aho abasenateri batorerwaga manda imwe gusa. Ashingiye ku byakozwe muri manda ebyiri zabanje, Ingabire Marie Immaculée, Umuyobozi wa Transparency International Rwanda, ngo asanga abagize manda ya 3 ya Sena bakwiye gucukumbura ibibazo bisa nk’ibyabaye akarande. Ati ‘‘Iyi Sena ijye ku bibazo biri mu muryango nyarwanda, bigaragara, idukorere ubushakashatsi, ivugane n’abaturage, imenye neza ikibazo uko gihagaze, noneho nirangiza idue inama, ijye inama, igir inama guverinoma igire inama Abanyarwanda iyakorwa. Sena itubwire kugeza ubu impamvu imanza za Gacaca zananiranye kurangira. Kuki zitarangira harabura iki? Byagenze bite? N’ibyo njyewe nshaka, bya bintu abantu buri munsi ugasanga nta gisubizo biri kubona. Dufite ibibazo mu miyoborere, kuki mu nzego z’abayobozi baho bahorana ibibazo? Ese kuki mu bakozi ba Leta n’uteje ibibazo aba aho, abantu bakazavuga bakarambirwa, hanyum nyuma igihe bamaze kumwibagirwa bakaba ari bwo bibuka kumukuraho?’’ N’ubwo abagize Sena badashyirwaho hashigiwe ku mitwe ya Politiki, kuva uru rwego rwatangira 2 kuri 3 baruyoboye bakomoka mu ishyaka riharanira Demukarasi n’imibereho y’abaturage PSD. Arangije manda ye, Dr Vincent Biruta yasimbuwe na Dr Ntawukuriryayo Jean Damascene, wasimbuwe kuri uyu mwanya na Bernard Makuza, wamaze imyaka igera ku 10 ari Minisitiri w’intebe icyakora akaba ntashya rizwi abarizwamo. Ukurikije aho ibintu bigeze PL ntishobora kuyobora Sena kuko iyoboye Umutwe w’Abadepite uko akaba ari na ko bimeze ku mitwe ya Politiki PS Imberakuri na Green Part idafite abayo batowe muri Sena. Icyakora Inararibonye muri Politiki Sheikh Abdull Kharim Harelimana avuga ko bigoye ko umunyamuryango wa FPR ayobora Sena. Yagize ati ‘‘Icyo tumenyereye ni uko FPR  n’ubundi idakunze guhatanira imyanya nk’iyi ngiyi, ahanini kubera ko iba ishaka ko isaranganya n’abandi.  Mu kuri igiye guhatanira umwanya nk’uyu nguyu akenshi ishobora kuwutsindira, urebye ubushobozi ifite, urebye n’imbaraga ifite n’akamenyero ifite n’uburyo Abanyarwanda muri rusange bayibona n’uburyo bayikunze, n’uburyo bakunda ko iyobora ariko ndumva izakomeza uburyo bwayo yari isanganywe bwo kugira ngo n’abandi mu myanya itandukanye na bo babonemo  imyanya kugira ngo dufatanye  mu kuzamura igihugu cyacu.’’ Sena ni rumwe mu nzego zikomeye mu buyobozi bw’u Rwanda rukaba rumaze imyaka 16 kuko rwagiyeho muri 2003. Sena y’u Rwanda igizwe n’abasenateri 26 barimo 12 batorerwa mu Ntara n’Umujyi wa Kigali, 8 basyirwaho na Perezida wa Repubulika, 4 batorwa n’Ihuriro nyunguranabitekerezo y’imitwe ya Politiki yemewe mu Rwanda na 2 batorwa mu barimu b’abashakashatsi muri Kaminuza n’amashuri makuru ya Leta n’ayigenga. Abasenateri 6 barimo 4 bahsyirwaho na Perezida wa Repubulika na 2 batorwa n’Ihuriro nyunguranabitekerezo ry’imitwe ya Politiki yemewe mu Rwanda bashyirwaho nyuma y’umwaka 1 bagenzi babo batangiye imirimo ari nabo barangiza manda ny’uma y’umwaka 1 bagenzi babo bayisoje. Inkuru ya RBA

title: Perezida Kagame yakiriye David Luiz na Didier Drogba mu bihe bitandukanye
content:
Nyuma yaho muri iki cyumweru U Rwanda rugize umugisha wo kwakira ibihangage bibiri muri ruhago, Didier Drogba wakanyujijeho muri Chelsea na David Luiz na we wubatse amateka muri Chelsea, PSG, ubu akaba ari kubarizwa muri Arsenal, Kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 11 Ukwakira 2019 bakiriwe n’umukuru w’igihugu, Perezida Kagame. Nkuko imbuga nkoranyambaga z’ibiro by’umukuru w’igihugu zabitangaje, ku ikubitiro Perezida Kagame yakiriye Umunye-Brazil David Luiz wari uherekejwe n’umukunzi we ndetse na nyina baraye bageze mu Rwanda ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kane.

Perezida Kagame yakiriye David Luiz, umukinnyi wa Arsenal wa mbere usuye u Rwanda mu bakiri mu kibuga

David Luiz yaje mu Rwanda aherekejwe n’umukunzi we, nyina ndetse n’inshuti yabo, Perezida Kagame ari kumwe na Clara Akamanzi uyobora RDB bakaba babahaye ikaze

David Luiz yahaye Perezida Kagame impano y’umwambaro wa Arsenal uriho numero ’23’ yambara ndetse n’izina PK bisobanuye Paul Kagame Ntihatangajwe icyo baganiriye, gusa ibiro by’umukuru w’igihugu, Village Urugwiro byavuze ko "Perezida Kagame yakiriye umukinnyi wa Arsenal David Luiz uri mu gihugu ku bw’amasezerano y’ubufatanye  hagati y’iyi kipe n’u Rwanda binyuze muri #VisitRwanda."

Uruzinduko rwa David Luiz mu Rwanda rufitanye isano n’amasezerano yo kwamamaza ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda Arsenal yasinyanye n’u Rwanda Mu masaha yakurikiyeho kandi ni bwo Perezida Kagame yakiriye Umunye-Cote d’Ivoire Didier Drogba n’itsinda bari kumwe. Uyu mugabo washinze fondasiyo yitiriye izina rye ’Didier Drogba Foundation’ ari mu Rwanda kuva ku mugoroba wo ku wa Gatatu aho yari yaje mu ihuriru ry’urubyiruko nyafurika ’YouthConnekt Africa Summit’ aho yaganirije urubyiruko rwitabiriye iri huriro aruha impanuro.

Mbere y’uko abonana n’umukuru w’igihugu, David Luiz yasuye urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali aho yashenguwe n’icuraburindi ryagwiriye u Rwanda, gusa avuga ko "binatanga isomo rikomeye kubona uburyo abanyarwanda bunze ubumwe bagafatanya kubaka ahazaza habo n’ah’abandi", maze abashimira mu izina ry’umuryango wa Arsenal

title: Minisitiri w’Intebe wa Etiyopiya, Abiy Ahmed yegukanye igihembo cy’amahoro cy’ijana cya Nobel
content: Ku bw’uruhare rwe n’ubushake agaragaza mu gusigasira amahoro mu gihugu cye no mu karere muri rusange, Abiy Ahmed, Minisitiri w’Intebe wa Etiyopiya ni we wahawe igihembo cy’amahoro kitiriwe ’Nobel’ cyari icy’ijana gitanzwe. Uyu mugabo yagize uruhare rufatika mu masezerano y’amahoro yasinywe umwaka ushize yashyize akadomo mu bushyamirane bwa gisirikare bwari bumaze imyaka hafi 20 hagati ya Etiyopiya na Eritereya nyuma y’intambara y’imipaka hagati yo mu 1998 na 2000. Nyuma yo guhabwa iki gihembo, Abey yagize ati "Nishimiye by’ikirenga kumva aya makuru, mwakoze cyane. Ni igihembo cyahawe Afurika, cyahawe Etiyopiya kandi ndibwira ko bandi bayobozi b’abanyafurika bari bubyakire neza kugira ngo dukomeze urugendo rwo kubaka amahoro ku mugabane wacu." Abiy Ahmed w’imyaka 43 y’amavuko mu bihe bishize yanashimiwe cyane uruhare yagize mu masezerano yo kugabana ubutegetsi mu gihugu gituranyi cya Sudani nyuma yaho igisirikare gihiritse Perezida Omar el-Béchir. Uyu mugabo yabaye Minisitiri w’Intebe wa Etiyopiya muri Mata 2018, ndetse kuva ubwo atangira gushyiraho impinduka za politike zahinduye byinshi mu gihugu cye. Abiy Ahmed yatanze imbabazi ku mfungwa za politike, yemerera amatsinda atavuga rumwe na leta gukora nyuma y’igihe kinini batotezwa ndetse aha rugari ibinyamakuru byari byarigijweyo. Src:BBC Afrique

title: Izindi mpunzi 123 zivuye muri Libya zageze mu Rwanda
content:
U Rwanda rwakiriye abashaka ubuhungiro 123 babaga muri Libya, bakaba bahise bajyanwa mu nkambi y’agateganyo ya Gashora iherereye mu Karere ka Bugesera aho basanze bagenzi babo 66 bageze mu Rwanda mu mpera z’ukwezi gushize. Ni abasore n’inkumi bari mu kigero kiri hagati y’imyaka 14 na 20 baturutse mu gihugu cya Libya, bakaba baje mu Rwanda ku masezerano hagati y’u Rwanda, Umuryango w’Afurika yunze Ubumwe ndetse n’Umuryango w’abibumbye ishami ryita ku mpunzi. Urugendo rwabo rwo kuva muri Libya kugera mu Rwanda rukaba rwagenze neza ubu bakaba bagiye kwitabwaho nk’uko byatangajwe n’umunyamabanga uhoraho muri Minisiteri ishinzwe ibikorwa by’ubutabazi Kayumba Olivier. Yagize ati "Ibintu byose birateguye naho bari bugere hari amafunguro abategereje Polisi irabajya imbere ibintu byose bimeze neza ntakibazo, nta muntu warwariye mu nzira bose bahageze amahoro.Hari benshi dushobora gusanga barwaye aho bavuye murahazi ko batari bameze neza riko turi bubanze tubavuze, tubiteho bashire impumpu nyuma turebe igikurikiraho."

Izi mpunzi zigizwe n’abakiri bato Umunyamabanga uhoraho muri Minisiteri ishinzwe ibikorwa by’ubutabazi Kayumba Olivier kandi avuga ko abashaka ubuhungiri 66 baje mu Rwanda ku ikubitiro mu mpera z’ukwezi gushize bameze neza. Ati "Abari i Gashora bariya 66 bameze neza, batangiye kumenyera, batangiye gusohoka bagatembera." Umuyobozi wungirije w’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku mpunzi mu Rwanda Barbara William Bentum avuga ko imibereho y’aba bantu bazanywe mu Rwanda itari imeze neza. Yagize ati "Ni abantu bari mu byiciro 2, dufite impunzi zemejwe na UNCHR muri Libya dufite kandi abashaka ubuhungiro banditswe na UNCHR, itsinda rije uyu munsi abenshi baturutse muri Eretrea, Somalia, Sudan na Ethiopia, urugendo rwabo muri Libya kuri bamwe ntabwo rwari rworoshye bamwe bari mu maboko y’abacuruza abantu, abandi mu bigo bifungirwamo abantu ubwo bageragezaga kwambuka ngo bajye mu Burayi."
 Abamaze kugera mu nkambi ya Gashora batangiye kwigishwa ururimi rw’icyongereza n’Ikinyarwanda kugira ngo bajye babona uko bavugana n’abantu baturanye cyangwa batembereye mu bindi bice by’igihugu. Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame ubwo yaganirizaga urubyiruko rwitabiriye Youth Connekt Afrika irimo kubera mu Rwanda, yagaragaje ko u Rwanda rukize ku mutima. Yagize ati "Reka ngire icyo mbibabwiraho, ntabwo ari ibanga, U Rwanda ntabwo ari igihugu gikize mu bijyanye no kugira ibintu, ariko ndatekereza ko dukize mu bundi buryo, dufite ibuntu tunameze neza ku mutima, twabwiye abo twashakaga kubwira ko n;ubwo aba bantu batageze aho bashakaga kujya, bashakaga kujya mu Burayi bafatirwa muri Libya batambuka inyanja ya mediterane kandi icyari gihari ni uko hari abapfaga cyangwa bazapfa bashaka kwambuka, ndavuga nti twatanga ubundi buryo bushobora kuba ataribwo bwiza cyane, ariko buruta ubu, tuzi u Rwanda ndetse n’aho rugarukira, tugiye gutanga uburyo bushoboka buruta gufatirwa mu nkambi cyangwa mu ahandi hantu wicwa utazi aho uzaba uri umunsi ukurikiyeho cyangwa ushonje ntacyo ufite tuzi ko hano twakora ibirenze kuri ibyo." Aba baje mu Rwanda ku masezerano yabaye hagati y’u Rwanda, Umuryango w’ubumwe bwa Afurika ndetse n’Ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku mpunzi taliki 10 nzeri. Mu bantu 500 bagomba kuza mu Rwanda 189 ni bo bamaze kuhagera hakaba hasigaye abandi 311 bagomba kuza mu minsi iri imbere. Src:RBA

title: Umunyamerika Gregg Schoof yirukanwe ku butaka bw’u Rwanda
content:
Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 07 Ukwakira 2019, Ikigo cy’Igihugu Gishinzwe Abinjira n’Abasohoka (DGIE), kirukanye ku butaka bw’u Rwanda, Umunyamerika Gregg Schoof Brian wari umuvugabutumwa akanaba umuyobozi wa Radio Ubuntu butangaje (Amazing Grace Radio) yahagaritswe. Ibi bije bikurikira ko mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Mbere uyu mugabo yari yafashwe na Polisi y’Igihugu azira kurenga ku mategeko y’igihugu aho yari yatumije abanyamakuru mu kiganiro (Press conference) atabisabiye uburenganzira cyari kigiye kubera i Remera iruhande rwa stade Amahoro.

Ubwo Polisi yambikaga amapingu Gregg Schoof Brian, imusanze aho yari agiye kuganirira n’abanyamakuru Nkuko Ikigo cy’Igihugu Gishinzwe Abinjira n’Abasohoka cyabitangarije The New Times ngo ibi sibyo byonyine byatumye uyu mugabo ahambirizwa agasubizwa iwabo igitaraganya, ahubwo ngo n’ibyangombwa bye byo kuba k’ubutaka bw’u Rwanda byari byararangiye nyuma yaho asabye kongererwa uruhushya rwo gukorera mu Rwanda ariko ntabyemererwe. Schoof yari yarashinze radio ya gikirisitu yitwa Ubuntu Butangaje (Amazing Grace), iherutse guhagarikwa muri Mata umwaka ushize n’ Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe kugenzura imirimo ifitiye igihugu akamaro (RURA), kibisabwe n’Urwego rw’Abanyamakuru Bigenzura (RMC). Ni nyuma yaho iyi radio yari yarenze ku bihano yahawe biturutse ku kuba yarumvikanyeho ikiganiro cyapfobyaga abagore cyatambutse ku ya 29 Mutarama 2018 kigakorwa n’umuvugabutumwa Nicolas Niyibikora wavugaga ko ’abagore ari bo batumye icyaha kiza mu isi, ko nta kintu cyiza cyabakomokaho cyangwa se ko imbaraga zonyine bafite ari izo gukora ibibi’.

Muri Gashyantare ubwo yari yitabye RMC Lt Col Regis Gatarayiha uyobora Ikigo cy’Igihugu Gishinzwe Abinjira n’Abasojoka, yabwiye The New Times ko uyu mugabo yari yasabye kongererwa uruhushya rwo gukorera mu Rwanda ariko arabyangirwa kuko imirimo yakoraga ijyanye na radio Amazing Grace ndetse n’ivugabutumwa byose byahagaze dore ko n’urusengero rwe ari rumwe muri nyinshi zafunzwe muri Gashyantare umwaka ushize kubera kutuzuza ibisabwa. "Uruhushya rwe rwo gukorera mu Rwanda (Work permit) rwarangiye ku ya 06 Nyakanga 2019. Yemerewe kongererwa iminsi yo kuba mu Rwanda ku busabe bwe bwo kwitegura kugenda (gutaha), ariko imyitwarire ye yo guhungabanya umudendezo ntabwo wari uri mu byo yemerewe byo kwitegura kuva mu gihugu.", Gatarayiha. Muri Gicurasi umwaka ushize nibwo Schoof yari yatsinzwe mu rubanza yaregagamo RURA, yifuza kongera gutangiza radiyo ye. Mu butumwa yari yahaye abanyamakuru mbere abatumira muri iki kiganiro cyaburijwemo n’inzego z’umutekano yavugaga ko agiye gusubira iwabo ariko akagenda avuze ukuri akagaragaza icyo yita akarengane yakorewe n’inzego zirimo RURA na RMC na bamwe mu bakozi bazo. Yanakoresheje imvugo ikarishye avuga ko Guverimo y’u Rwanda irimo ijyana abanyarwanda mu muriro kuko yafunze insengero nyinshi ndetse mu bigo by’amashuri hakaba hari ubukangurambaga bwo kujyanayo udukingirizo.

title: Perezida Kagame yafunguye uruganda rwa mbere muri Afurika rukora telefoni
content:
Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame kuri uyu wa Mbere yafunguye ku mugaragaro uruganda rukorera mu Rwanda telefoni zigendanwa zigezweho za Mara Phone. Perezida Kagame avuga ko kuba 50% by’Abanyarwanda ari bo kuri ubu bakoresha smart phone ndetse ko uyu mubare ukiri hasi hari intego yo kongera umubare w’abazikoresha  ari na yo ntego y’uru ruganda.

Perezida Kagame yatashye uruganda rwa Mara Phone rubaye urwa mbere muri Aurika mu gukora teleone Umukuru w’Igihugu yabanje kwerekwa anasobanurirwa ibice bitandukanye bigize uru ruganda. Yavuze mu rwego rwo korohereza Abanyarwanda gutunga izi telefoni, uru ruganda rwashyizeho uburyo bwo kuzigurisha Abanyarwanda bakishyura mu byiciro. Perezida Kagame yanavuze ko ishoramari ry’uru ruganda rihuye neza neza n’icyerekezo cy’u Rwanda mu guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga riri mu nyungu z’abaturage. Izi telefoni zizajya zikorerwa mu Rwanda zizajya zinagurishwa mu bindi bihugu byo mu karere u Rwanda ruherereyemo. Umukuru w’Igihugu kaba yasabye urwego rw’abikorera gukora ku buryo ruhangana kuisoko mpuzamahanga. Ni telefoni za mbere zigezweho za smartphone zigiye gukorerwa mu Rwanda z’uruganda rw’ikigo cya Mara Corporation Ltd. 
 Mu kwezi kwa 6 umuyobozi wa Mara Corporation Ltd,  Ashish J. Thakkar yavuze ko uru ruganda rukorera telefoni mu Rwanda ruzatanga akazi ku bantu barenga 200, 16% bazaba ari abagore. Mu kwezi kwa gatanu telefoni zakozwe na Mara Corporation Ltd zamuritswe i Paris mu Bufaransa mu gikorwa ngarukamwaka cya Viva Technology (VivaTech). Thakkar yavuze ko izo telefoni zifite ikoranabuhanga rigezweho kandi zujuje ubuziranenge. Ni telefoni z’ubwoko butandukanye ziri ku biciro bitandukanye kandi bivugwa ko zizaba ziri mu biciro bibereye buri wese.
 Uretse gutangiza ku mugaragaro ikorwa rya telephone ya mara phone i Kigali, iki kigo kizahita kinatangiza uruganda nk’uru muri Afurika y’Epfo mu Mujyi wa Durban ku itariki ya 17 y’uku kwezi.

title: Abantu 19 mu bagabye igitero i Musanze bishwe, batanu bafatwa mpiri bavuga ko batumwe na FDLR
content:
Polisi y’u Rwanda yatangaje ko inzego z’umutekano zimaze kwica abantu 19 bari mu bagizi ba nabi bagabye igitero ku baturage mu Kinigi mu Karere ka Musanze, mu gihe abaturage bakiguyemo bamaze kuba 14, bavuye ku munani bari bamaze kumenyekana kuri uyu wa Gatandatu. Icyo gitero cyabaye mu ijoro ryo ku wa 4 Ukwakira rishyira ku wa 5 Ukwakira 2019, abagizi ba nabi biganjemo abitwaje intwaro gakondo batera mu Murenge wa Kinigi mu Karere ka Musanze bica kandi banakomeretsa abaturage.

Abantu 14 bishwe n’aba bagize ba nabi bashyinguwe kuri iki Cyumweru Inzego z’umutekano zahise zijya gutabara no guhumuriza abaturage n’imiryango y’abagizweho ingaruka n’iki gitero, mu gihe hari hakomeje ibikorwa byo guhiga bukware abagize uruhare muri ubwo bwicanyi. Mu itangazo ryashyizweho umukono n’Umuvugizi wa Polisi y’u Rwanda, CP John Bosco Kabera, yemeje ko abo bagizi na nabi bakoze ubwicanyi mu bugome bukabije. Ati "Mu bishwe harimo abasanzwe mu ngo zabo bicishwa ibyuma, abandi bicishwa amabuye. Ibi bigaragaza ubugome bukabije bw’aba bagizi ba nabi." "Mu gikorwa cyo guhiga aba bagizi ba nabi, inzego z’umutekano zimaze kwica 19, ndetse 5 bafatwa mpiri. Ibikorwa byo gushakisha uwo ari we wese wagize uruhare muri iki gitero birakomeje.”

Bamwe mu bagabye iki gitero bakiguyemo/Ifoto:Umuseke CP Kabera yavuze ko kugeza ubu mu Kinigi umutekano wagarutse, ashimira abaturage n’inzego z’ibanze ku bufatanye bakomeje kugaragaza mu kwicungira umutekano. Ku mugoroba wo kuri iki cyumweru nibwo hateganyijwe umuhango wo gushyingura mu cyubahiro abaturage bishwe, ari nabwo abafatiwe muri uyu mugambi wahitanye ubuzima bw’inzirakarengane berekwa abaturage. Mu gihe mu Kinigi hazwi nk’izingiro ry’ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo bukorerwa muri Pariki y’Igihugu y’Ibirunga ibamo ingagi, Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere, RDB, cyatangaje ko umutekano ubu umeze neza, ku buryo ibikorwa byose bikomeje. Itangazo ryayo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu rikomeza riti “Umudendezo n’umutekano ni ikirango cy’ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda kandi bizakomeza kuba iby’ibanze kuri twe”.

title: Murangwa Hadidja yatorewe gusimbura Uwamurera Salama muri Sena
content: Nyuma y’uko urukiko rw’ikirenga rwanzuye ko Uwamurera Salama adafite ubunaribonye bwatuma aba umusenateri, Ihuriro Nyunguranabitekerezo ry’Imitwe ya Politiki yemewe gukorera mu Rwanda, ryatoye Madamu Murangwa Ndangiza Hadidja ngo amusimbure muri Sena. Uyu Murangwa Hadidja w’imyaka 44, na we yatanzwe n’ishyaka rya PDI kimwe na Uwamurera Salama utaremejwe n’urukiko rw’ikirenga. Tariki ya mbere z’uku kwezi k’Ukwakira 2019, ni bwo urukiko rw’ikirenga rwatangaje ko rutemeje umukandida Uwamurera Salama wari watanzwe n’ihuriro ry’imitwe ya Pilitiki, avuye mu ishyaka rya PDI, bivugwa ko impamvu yari uko nta bunararibonye yari afite. Uwamurera Salama yari asanzwe ari umukozi w’Akarere ka Rusizi ushinzwe imisoro mu kigo cy’ubutaka cy’ako karere (Billing Officer) naho Murangwa Hadidja wamusimbuye muri Sena, ni impuguke mu bwakirizi bw’imisoro, akaba n’umunyamategeko nkuko tubikesha Kigalitoday. Murangwa Hadidja ni umwe mu bagize ikigo mpuzamahanga nkemurampaka (Kigali International Arbitration Center), akaba anabifitiye seritifika yavanye i London mu Bwongereza. Yakoze imirimo inyuranye mu bijyanye n’imisoro ndetse n’ubujyanama mu mategeko haba mu bigo bya Leta n’ibyigenga. Murangwa ni umunyamayegeko ubimazemo igihe kandi akaba n’umujyanama mu by’imisoro. Yabaye mu nama z’ubutegetsi za MMI, RBC na BRD ubu akaba ari mu nama y’ubutegetsi ya Banki nkuru y’igihugu (BNR).

title: PDI ntiyanyuzwe no kuba umukandida wayo atemerewe kujya muri Sena
content: Nyuma y’uko urukiko rw’ikirenga rwanzuye ko Uwamurera Salama adafite ubunaribonye bwatuma aba umusenateri, ishyaka PDI akomokamo riravuga ko ritanyuzwe n’iki cyemezo na ho Ihuriro Nyunguranabitekerezo ry’imitwe ya Politiki yemewe mu Rwanda rikaba ryavuze ko amatora y’umukandida uzamusimbura azaba ku wa Kane w’iki Cyumweru. Inkuru y’uko urukiko rw’ikirenga rwanzuye ko Madamu Uwamurera Salama atujuje ibisabwa n’amategeko ku mwanya w’umusenateri, yabaye kimomo kuri uyu wa Kabiri. Kopi y’urubanza rwaciwe n’urukiko rw’ikirenga rurebana no kwemeza abakandida ku myanya y’abasenateri umunyamakuru wa RBA dukesha iyi nkuru yabonye, ihamya ko icyemezo cy’urukiko gishingiye ku kuba umukandida adafite ubunararibonye bukwiye ku mwanya w’umusenateri, nk’uko biteganywa n’itegeko no 001/2019.OL ryo kuwa 29/07/2019 rigenga amatora. Bimwe mu bika bibiri bya kopi y’uru rubanza bigira biti ’’Ku bijyanye n’ubunararibonye (great experience/grande experience) busabwa mu gace ka mbere k’ingingo ya 102 imaze kuvugwa kugira ngo umuntu atorerwe cyangwa agirwe umusenateri, urukiko rurasanga bukwiye kureberwa mu mirimo umukandida yakoze ugereranyije n’inshingano z’umutwe wa Sena. Urukiko rw’Ikirenga rwemeje ko Uwamurera Salama atujuje ibyangombwa bisabwa n’amategeko kugira ngo agirwe umusenateri, bityo kandidature ye ikaba itemejwe.’’ Umuvugizi w’Ihuriro Nyunguranabitekerezo ry’Imitwe ya politiki yemewe mu Rwanda, Mukabunani Christine avuga ko ihuriro ryamaze kugezwaho icyemezo cy’urukiko ndetse kuri uyu wa Kane hazaba amatora yo gushaka undi mukandida. Yagize ati "Iyo tumaze gutora abo dutoye tubashyikiriza urukiko kugirango rubemeze. Rero tuba twiteze ibintu 2 hari igihe babemeza bombi hari n’igihe nk’uku byatugendekeye bemeza umwe undi ntibamwemeze. Twabyakiriye rero kuko ni inshingano yabo kandi iri mu bushishozi bwabo nk’uko bikwiriye kuba bigenda. Twebwe twahise dutumiza inama yihuta kugira ngo twongere dutore, tuzatora kuwa Kane. Imiryango iba ifunguye n’ubundi nk’uko bisanzwe abazumva bakongera kuza bagapiganwa bazaza bapiganwe dutoremo umuntu umwe." Umuyobozi w’Ishyaka Ntangarugero muri Demukarasi, PDI, Uwamurera Salama abereye Umuhuzabikorwa mu Ntara y’Iburengerazuba, Mussa Fazil Harelimana avuga ko iri shyaka ryubaha icyemezo cy’Urukiko  rw’Ikirenga icyakora  akavuga ko ritanyuzwe nacyo. Yagize ati "Mu ishyaka ryacu kugira ngo tumwamamaze tunamwamamaza, turebye yujuje imyaka 40, turebye ko ari umuhuzabikorwa w’ishyaka PDI ku rwego rw’intara, turebye yuko yari amaze imyaka 16 akorera ku rwego rw’Akarere, twe twabonaga afite ubunararibonye buhagije. Ariko ibyo ngibyo twe twabonye urukiko na rwo rurigenga rwabonye ibindi kandi tugomba kwakira. Icyemezo cy’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga ntikijuririrwa ariko nta nubwo twavuga yuko cyatunyuze." Ishyaka PDI rivuga ko ryiteguye kongera gutanga umukandida kuri uwo mwanya mu matora y’Ihuriro Nyunguranabitekerezo ry’Imitwe ya politiki yemewe mu Rwanda ateganyijwe kuri uyu wa Kane. Tariki 19 Nzeri ni bwo byari byatangajwe ko Madamu Uwamurera  Salama na Nkusi Juvenal, ari bo bakandida b’iri huriro ku myanya y’abasenateri bahagarariye iryo huriro muri manda ya gatatu ya Sena.

title: Nyagatare: Hasojwe ukwezi ko Gusoma no Kwandika hazirikanwa abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona
content:
Kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 30 Nzeri 2019 mu Murenge wa Karangazi mu karere ka Nyagatare hasorejwe ku rwego rw’igihugu ukwezi kwahariwe gusoma no kwandika kwari kwatangiye ku ya 08 Nzeri kukarangwa n’ibikorwa binyuranye bigamije guteza imbere umuco wo gusoma no kwandika bihereye mu bana. Muri uyu muhango, umwanya munini wahariwe abana biga mu mashuri abanza n’ay’isumbuye by’umwihariko abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona bagaragaje ko nabo batasigaye inyuma mu gusoma no kwandika dore ko mu bahembwe harimo abatari bake bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona.

Aba bana babiri bayoboye gahunda z’uyu muhango nk’aba-Mcs 
Mu bana bahembwe hagaragayemo cyane abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona Uwitwa Jean Damascene ufite ubumuga bwo kutabona wiga indimi n’ubuvanganzo mu mwaka wa gatandatu w’amashuri yisumbuye kuri HVP Gatagara ya Rwamagana yasomeye abitabiriye uyu muhango inkuru yahimbye yise ’ubucuti’ yakuruye cyane amarangamutima y’abantu kubera ubuhanga bwumvikanagamo.

Uyu mwana yishimiwe cyane kubera ubuhanga yagaragaje mu busizi kandi nyamara afite ubumuga bwo kutabona Mu kaganiro yahaye Kigali Post yavuze ko bashimira leta uburyo ibashyigikiye n’ubwo agaragaza ko hakiri imbogamizi zikomeye bahura nazo. Ati "Leta iragerageza kudufasha tukiga, ariko usanga hari imbogamizi tugihura nazo. Urugero nk’izi mpapuro mubona nanditseho ni 15 kandi bikiri ku mashini yacu byari ku mpapuro enye gusa. Ikindi izi mpapuro niyo wazifata neza gute ntizibikika igihe kinini kuko birasibama. Twifuza ko ikoranabuhanga ryazamuka cyane, ikindi abifuza kwiga siyanse nabo birabagora kubera ibikoresho bikiri bike." Muri uyu muhango hanahembwe abana batatu ba mbere muri 53 bahize abandi muri uyu mwaka mu marushanwa y’ubukangurambaga bwiswe ’Gira igitabo’ bwatangiye mu 2016, ndetse ku bufatanye na UNICEF ibitabo byabo bikaba byaratubuwemo ibitabo 500 kuri buri mwana bikazagenda bikwirakwizwa mu mashuri.

Dr Rose Baguma, Umuyobozi ushinzwe Uburezi muri Minisiteri y’Uburezi Dr Rose Baguma, ushinzwe politike n’igenamigambi ry’Uburezi muri Minisiteri y’Uburezi, wari umushyitsi mukuru muri uyu muhango yavuze ko nubwo hasojwe ukwezi kwari kwahariwe gusoma no kwandika bidasobanuye ko gusoma no kwandika bihise birangira ko ahubwo bashishikariza abana, ababyeyi n’abandi gukomeza kwimakaza uyu muco wo gusoma no kwandika kuko ari isoko y’ubumenyi. Uyu muyobozi yavuze ko Leta y’u Rwanda yifuzaga ko mu 2020 abanyarwanda baba bazi gusoma no kwandika baba bageze ku 100% ariko kugeza ubu bakaba bageze ku kigero cya 75% aboneraho gushimira abafatanyabikorwa babafasha umunsi k’uwundi gushyira mu ngiro gahunda yo gusoma no kwandika.


Abana bahize abandi mu gusoma neza no kwandika ibitabo bahembwe Luann Gronhovd, Umuyobozi ushinzwe Uburezi muri USAID-Rwanda yavuze ko iki kigo kizakomeza kuba umufatanyabikorwa w’ingenzi mu kwimakaza umuco wo gusoma no kwandika binyuze mu mishinga yacyo inyuranye harimo nka Soma Umenye yita ku guha ibitabo amashuri atatu abanza na Mureke Dusome yibanda ku muryango mugari uri hanze y’amashuri.

title: Robert Mugabe yashyinguwe mu cyaro avukamo
content:
Abantu amagana, barimo abari bambaye imipira y’umweru, bitabiriye umuhango wo gushyingura uwahoze ari perezida wa Zimbabwe, Robert Mugabe, wabereye mu gace ka Kutama aho akomoka. Ni nyuma y’aho habaye impaka, guverinoma yifuzaga ko yashyingurwa mu irimbi ry’intwari ariko umuryango we ukavuga ko agomba gushyingurwa aho akomoka, bikarangira icyifuzo cyabo aricyo cyubahirijwe.

 Mu irimbi ry’intwari, niho guverinoma yifuzaga ko yashyingurwa  Mugabe yabaye intwari ya Zimbabwe nyuma yo kuyirwanirira intambara yayihesheje ubwigenge, ndetse anayobora iki gihugu mu gihe cy’imyaka hafi 40. Yatabarutse mu ntangiriro z’uku kwezi kwa Nzeri i Singapour ku myaka 95 y’amavuko, akaba yashyinguwe n’umuryango we urangajwe imbere n’uwari umugore we Grace Mugabe wari wambaye umukara gusa ndetse n’inshuti ze za hafi mu isanduku itwikiriwe n’ibendera ry’igihugu.

title: Kamonyi: Ubudasa mu muganda wo gusoma witabiriwe n’abana n’ababyeyi babo -Amafoto
content:
Umuganda wo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 28 Nzeri 2019 wagizwe umwihariko wahurije hamwe ababyeyi n’abana hirya no hino mu gihugu aho mu gihe ababyeyi batangaga umuganda w’amaboko, ku rundi ruhande abana babo bari bahuze basoma inkuru zitandukanye. Mu karere ka Kamonyi, Umurenge wa Gacurabwenge mu kagali ka Kigembe aho umunyamakuru wa Kigali Post yari ari, aha akaba ari naho habereye umuganda wo ku rwego rw’akarere, abana baturutse k’Urwunge rw’Amashuri rwa Gatizo biga mu mwaka wa mbere kugeza mu wa gatatu w’amashuri abanza ni bo bitabiriye uyu muganda wihariye wo gusoma.

Umuganda ku rwego rw’akarere ka Kamonyi wabereye i Rugobagoba Mu gihe ababyeyi babo bari mu muganda wo kubakira abatishoboye ndetse no gusukura aho batuye mu mudugudu wa Rugobagoba, aba bana bari hafi yabo ku rusengero rwa E.A.R Rugobagoba hamwe n’abarezi babo buri wese afite igitabo asoma.


Abana bari bishimiye uyu muganda udasanzwe wo gusoma bazindukiyemo Mu nama ikurikira umuganda hatoranijwe abana batatu (uhagarariye buri mwaka) basomera inkuru abitabiriye umuganda maze nyuma abayobozi bari bitabiriye uyu muganda barimo Visi Meya w’Akarere ka Kamonyi ushinzwe Ubukungu, Tuyizere Thadée, Uhagarariye Njyanama y’Akarere ka Kamonyi, Habimana Deogratias na Raphael Karanganwa uhagarariye umushinga Soma Umenye mu turere twa Bugesera, Kamonyi, Muhanga n’Umujyi wa Kigali.


Nyuma y’umuganda, abana n’ababyeyi bahuriye hamwe Mu ijambo rye, Umuyobozi wungirije w’akarere ushinzwe ubukungu, Tuyizere Thadee yashishikarije ababyeyi gukunda gusoma bityo bakabikundisha ndetse bakanabitoza abana. Ati "Umwana azitabira gusoma ari uko n’ababyeyi babikora, bakanabimutoza (...). Birasaba ko abana tubafasha ibyo bitabo tukabibagurira ariko n’uwo mwanya tukawubashakira kuko hari ubwo umwana agera mu rugo imirimo yo mu rugo ikamubuza gukora ibindi byose yari akwiye gukora. Umwana rero icy’ibanze ni ukwiga, wenda akanafasha ababyeyi ariko umwanya munini tuwuharire kwiga"

Tuyizere Thadée. Umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe ubukungu mu karere ka Kamonyi asomera abana inkuru Tuyizere yaboneyeho gushimira Minisiteri y’Uburezi n’abafatanyabikorwa bayo ku ngufu bashyize mu gukwirakwiza ibitabo by’abana hirya no hino. Yongeyeho ko abana bakwiye kumenya gusoma mu ndimi nyinshi zishoboka ariko bahereye ku Kinyarwanda. Raphael Karanganwa wari uhagarariye USAID-Soma Umenye yavuze ko gusoma mu ndimi zitandukanye ari umusingi w’ubumenyi, by’umwihariko Ikinyarwanda kikaba ishingiro rya byose. Yagize ati "Gusoma no kwandika indimi zose ni wo musingi w’ubumenyi niho byose bishingiye kuko ubumenyi bwose buturuka mu ndimi. Ikinyarwanda by’umwihariko twagihaye imbaraga cyane."

Karanganwa Raphael wari uhagarariye USAID Soma Umenye muri uyu muganda wahawe izina rya ’Umuganda Literacy’ Karanganwa kandi yavuze ko nta mwana n’umwe ukwiye guhezwa yaba abahungu cyangwa abakobwa, ndetse n’abafite ubumuga. Ati "Abana bose ni abana, abahungu, abakobwa ndetse n’abandi bose bafite ubumuga bose mujye mubaha igihe mubafashe gusoma no kwandika. Niba utazi gusoma ujye umubaza amashusho areba mu gitabo urebe ko yumva icyo ayo mashusho avuga cyangwa se wisunge abaturanyi n’abavandimwe bazi gusoma."

Abana bitegura kwerekeza aho ababyeyi barangije umuganda bari bari Uyu muganda wo gusoma wateguwe na Minisiteri y’Uburezi ifatanije na REB ndetse n’abafatanyabikorwa n’abaterankunga babo barimo Mureke Dusome na USAID Soma Umenye, ukaba wateguwe mu gihe u Rwanda ruri mu kwezi kwahariwe gusoma no kwandika kwatangiye ku ya 08 Nzeri 2019 ubwo kuri uwo munsi hizihizwaga ’Umunsi Mpuzamahanga wahariwe Gusoma no Kwandika’.

title: Bidasubirwaho, Robert Mugabe ntazashyingurwa ku irimbi ry’intwari
content: Nyuma y’impaka ndende zo kutumvikana ku ho azashyingurwa, umuryango wa nyakwigendera Robert Mugabe wahoze ayobora Zimbabwe hamwe na guverinoma y’iki gihugu, kuri uyu wa Kane bashyize bemeranya ko uyu mukambwe azashyingurwa aho avuka mu cyaro cya Zvimba. Ni nyuma y’ibyumweru bitatu byari bishize hari ibiganiro hagati ya leta n’umuryango w’uyu mukambwe wafatwaga nk’intwari y’ubwigenge bwa Zimbabwe, aho leta yifuzaga ko yashyingurwa mu gicumbi cy’intwari i Harare na ho umuryango ukifuza ko ashyingurwa aho yavukaga. Nkuko tubikesha BBC Afrique, iki kemezo cyemejwe n’umuvugizi wa guverinoma wavuze ko "Umuryango wagaragaje icyifuzo cy’uko gushyingurwa byabera i Zvimba.", yongeyeho ko "Guverinoma  izatanga ubufasha bwose bukenewe kugira ngo uyu wahoze ari perezida ashyingurwa mu buryo bukwiye hashingiwe ku bushake bw’umuryango we." Icyaro cya Zvimba kiri mu bilometero bisaga ijana uvuye mu murwa mukuru Harare, aha akaba ariho kuri uyu wa Gatandatu hazabera imihango yo gushyingura Robert Mugabe. Tariki ya 06 Nzeri 2019 ni bwo hamenyekanye inkuru y’urupfu rw’uyu mukambwe waguye i Singapour aho yari arwariye.

title: Impunzi 66 za mbere ziturutse muri Libya zageze mu Rwanda -Amafoto
content:
Nkuko byari biteganijwe, ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 26 Nzeri 2019, u Rwanda rwakiriye itsinda rya mbere ry’impunzi n’abimukira b’abanyafurika bari baraheze muri Libya aho bageze mu bihe bitandukanye bari kwerekeza i Burayi aho bashakaga kuruhukira. Ku ikubitiro hakaba haje impunzi n’abimukira 66 muri 500 biteganijwe ko u Rwanda ruzakira nkuko bikubiye mu masezerano yemeranijwe hagati y’u Rwanda, Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe (AU) hamwe n’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku mpunzi, UNHCR.

Ubwo impunzi za mbere zururukaga indege Izi mpunzi zageze ku kibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga cya Kigali i Kanombe ahagana ku isaha ya saa tatu n’igice aho zahise zinjira muri bisi zari zateguwe zerekeza mu Nkambi y’Agateganyo ya Gashora iri mu Karere ka Bugesera.
 Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku mpunzi, UNHCR ryavuze ko izi mpunzi za mbere zageze mu Rwanda ziganjemo abana batari kumwe n’imiryango yabo, hamwe n’abagore b’abapfakazi, uyu muryango ukaba uvuga ko nyuma y’igihe cyari gishize ubuzima bwabo buri mu kangaratete aho bagiye bahura n’ibibazo bitandukanye muri Libya, ubu bizeye umutekano wabo mu Rwanda.

Izi mpunzi zari zaraheze muri Libya aho zageze zerekeza i Burayi

title: Jacques Chirac wayoboye Ubufaransa yapfuye
content:
Mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 26 Nzeri 2019 ni bwo Jacques Chirac wabaye Perezida wa 22 wa Repubulika y’u Bufaransa, yapfuye ku myaka 86. Ni amakuru yemejwe n’umukwe we Frédéric Salat-Baroux abimenyesha ibitangazamakuru byinshi byo mu Bufaransa. "Perezida Jacques Chirac yashizemo umwuka muri iki gitondo akikijwe n’abe. Mu mahoro.", AFP ubwo yasubiragamo ibyatangajwe na Salat-Baroux, umugabo wa Claude Chirac, umukobwa wa nyakwigendera. Mu bihe bishize Jacques Chirac yagiye ajya mu bitaro bya Pitié-Salpêtrière biherereye i Paris aho yivurizaga indwara z’imyanya y’ubuhumekero (infection pulmonaire) mu bihe bitandukanye nko mu 2010, mu Ukuboza 2015 na Nzeri 2016.

Abafaransa bashenguwe n’inkuru y’urupfu rwa Jacque Chirac Jacques Chirac ni umwe mu bantu b’ingenzi baranze politike y’u Bufaransa mu myaka ishize aho yatangiriye urugendo rwe rwa politike i Corrèze aho yabaye umuyobozi (conseiller municipal)  mu gace ka Sainte-Féréole mu 1965 mbere y’uko azamuka mu buryo bwihuse muri politike y’iki gihugu. Yaje kuba umudepite mu 1967 ahagarariye Corrèze, mbere y’uko mu 1971 atangira kuyobora minisiteri zitandukanye harimo Minisiteri ikurikirana imirimo y’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko, iy’Ubuhinzi, iy’Ubutegetsi bw’igihugu ndetse mu 1974 aba Minisitiri w’Intebe ku butegetsi bwa Perezida Valéry Giscard d’Estaing. Jacques Chirac yaje kuba umuyobozi w’umujyi wa Paris mu 1977, mbere yo kongera kuba Minisitiri w’Intebe mu 1986 kuri repubulika ya gatanu yayobowe na François Mitterrand ndetse aza kuba Perezida w’u Bufaransa kuva ku ya 17 Gicurasi 1995 kugeza 16 Gicurasi 2007.

title: Gen Mudacumura wayoboraga FDLR-FOCA uherutse kwicwa, yasimbuwe na Gen Pacifique Ntawunguka
content:
Gen Maj Pacifique Ntawunguka uzwi ku mazina nka Omega, Nzeri na Israel ni we wagizwe umuyobozi w’agateganyo ku buyobozi bw’umutwe w’igisirikare cya FDLR. Ni amakuru yamenyekanye ku wa 20 Nzeri 2019 nyuma y’urupfu rwa Lt Gen Sylvestre Mudacumura warashwe n’ingabo za Congo (FARDC) ku wa 17 Nzeri 2019 zimusanze mu birindiro bye ahitwa Makomalehe muri Rutshuru. Gen Maj Pacifique Ntawunguka ni we wari umugaba w’ingabo (Etat Major) wa FDLR, akaba yatoranyijwe n’abandi basirikare bakuru kugira ngo abe ayobora by’agateganyo igisirikare cy’uyu mutwe ubu uri mu bibazo bitoroshye. Gen Maj Pacifique Ntawunguka wavutse mu 1964, yarushwaga imyaka 10 na Lt Gen Mudacumura. Avuka i Kageshi muri Gasebeya mu cyahoze ari Komini Gaseke aho azwi ku izina rya Mulefu. Gen Maj Pacifique Ntawunguka (Omega) yize amashuri abanza ahitwa Mbandari akomereza mu Rwankeri mu cyari Komini Nkuri aho yavuye akomereza muri Christ-Roi mu Karere ka Nyanza, aho yarangije yinjira mu ishuri rya Gisirikare ESM icyiciro cya 25 kuri Leta ya Habyarimana ndetse akaba yarize ibyo gutwara indege. Avugwa mu bayobozi ba batayo 94 yarwanye n’ingabo za RPA mu Mutara ahazwi nka Komini Muvumba agatsindwa akerekeza i Kigali. Muri Gicurasi 1994 yakomerekeye mu mirwano, ajyanwa mu kigo cya Gisirikare cya Mukamira, aho yavuye ahungira mu nkambi ya Katale inyuma y’ibirunga.

Gen Maj Pacifique Ntawunguka uzwi nka Omega Mu gihe cy’umutwe wa ALIR yabaye umuyobozi w’ibikorwa bya gisirikare bizwi nka Bethlehem muri Komini Satinsyi, Gakenke na Ramba ariko nyuma yo gutsindwa asubira muri Congo. Igitabo ‘Leadership of Rwandese armed groups in DRC’ kivuga ko azwi nk’umuntu utava ku izima, ibi bikaba intandaro ituma atumvikanaga n’umuyobozi we Lt Gen Mudacumura. Yabaye umuyobozi w’igisirkare cya FDLR mu bice bya Rutshuru na Masisi ndetse akajya asuzugura ibyemezo bya Mudacumura. Yari umwe mu barwanyi ba FDLR bifuzaga impinduka mu gisirikare binubira ko bayoborwa n’abasaza n’abanyabwoba. Gen Kabarebe muri 2016 yatangaje ko Ingabo z’u Rwanda na we ubwe bavuganaga n’abarwanyi bari mu mashyamba bafite imigambi mibi ku Rwanda, babumvisha gutaha kandi mu bo yashishikarije gutaha harimo Ntawunguka Pacifique udakozwa ibyo gutaha. Gen. Kabarebe ati ‘‘Njye ubwanjye naramwihamagariye nti ‘Pacifique ko wize, uri umupilote wigiye mu Bufaransa, ntabwo uri injiji, ayo mashyamba ya Congo urimo imyaka makumyabiri n’ingahe, ntugeraho ugashishoza ibyo urimo, n’intambara yarananiranye ntabwo uzayitsinda, ntugeraho ukibwira?" Undi na we ati “Jenerali, reka nkubwire ikintu kimwe. Njyewe kugaruka mu Rwanda, nzagaruka mu Rwanda nta Mututsi n’uyu n’umwe uri muri icyo gihugu, niba hari ikindi washakaga kongeraho kumbwira, ikiganiro tukirekere ahangaha." Omega ucumbagira kubera ibikomere yavanye mu Rwanda, yageze muri Congo ayobora Sonoki yashinze itsinda ry’abakirisitu riyoborwa n’uwitwa Muzimangane ariko riza kwamaganwa na Lt Gen Mudacumura. Yahoze ari nimero enye mu gisirikare cya FDLR-FOCA ariko ubu ni we ugezweho ku kiyobora nyuma y’uko abamubanjirije bagiye batakaza ubuzima barimo Lt Gen Sylvestre Mudacumura, Brig Gen Stanislas Nzeyimana wari uzwi nka Bigaruka waburiwe irengero yagiye muri Tanzania hamwe na Brig Gen Léodimir Mugaragu, uzwi nka Léo Manzi warasiwe mu birindiro bye. Icyakora afite abandi barwanyi bamukirikiye batagiye muri CNR ya Irategeka Wilson witandukanyije na FOCA barimo Col Donat Habimana, Col Bonaventure Bunane, Col Diogène Masengesho, Col Cyprien Uzabakiriho, Col Lucien Nzabamwita, uzwi nka Kaluma André wagize uruhare mu guhungabanya umutekano mu Rwanda muri 2012 hamwe na .Col. Védaste Hatangumuremyi uzwi nka Kaleb , Col. Ezéchiel Gakwerere uzwi nka Sibo Stany na Julius Mokoko, hamwe na Col Jean-Damascène Rutiganda uzwi nka Mazizi wayoboraga Komini Murama. Src:Kigalitoday

title: Gasana wahoze ayobora WDA mu bantu 8 bafunzwe bakekwaho gukoresha nabi umutungo wa Leta
content: Mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 21 Nzeri 2019, Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Ubugenzacyaha (RIB) rwatangaje ko rwafashe abantu umunani bakekwaho gukoresha nabi no kunyereza umutungo wa leta. Abo bakaba barimo Gasana Jérôme wahoze ayobora WDA n’abandi bayobozi mu bigo bya WDA, WASAC na RSSB. Mu itangazo RIB yanyujije kuri konti yabo ya Twitter yagize iti "RIB yafashe abantu umunani(08) bakekwaho gukoresha nabi/ kunyereza umutungo wa Leta. Abo ni uwari Umuyobozi mukuru, uwari ushinzwe imishinga, Umuyobozi w’Ubutegetsi n’imali n’umukozi ushinzwe abakozi muri WDA; Umuyobozi ushinzwe ishoramali n’ushinzwe abakozi muri RSSB..." Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Ubugenzacyaha (RIB) rwavuze ko kandi iperereza rikomeje no mu bindi bigo bya Leta byavuzweho kunyereza no gukoresha nabi umutungo wa leta muri raporo y’Umugenzuzi mukuru w’Imali, kugira ngo ababigizemo uruhare bakurikiranwe kandi n’umutungo wa leta wanyerejwe ugaruzwe hashingiwe ku mategeko.

title: Perezida Kagame yashyizeho Abasenateri bane bashya barimo Nyirasafari na Mukabaramba
content:
Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame yashyizeho abasenateri bane bashya nk’uko tubikesha itangazo ryavuye muri Perezidansi ya Repubulika. Iryo tangazo rigira riti "Ashingiye ku Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika y’u Rwanda ryo mu 2003 ryavuguruwe mu 2015, cyane cyane mu ngingo yaryo ya 80 igika cya mbere, agace ka 2, n’igika cya 5, none ku wa 20 Nzeri 2019,Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika ashyizeho Abasenateri bakurikira: 1. Dogiteri IYAMUREMYE Augustin 2. Madamu NYIRASAFARI Espérance 3. Bwana HABIYAKARE François 4. Dogiteri MUKABARAMBA Alvera Dr Iyamuremye Augustin yari Perezida rw’Urwego rw’Igihugu ngishwanama rw’inararibonye, Nyirasafari Espérance yari Minisitiri wa Siporo n’Umuco, Dr Mukabaramba akaba yari Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu. Na ho Habiyakare Françoisakaba yari Perezida w’Inama y’Ubuyobozi ya Komisiyo y’Igihugu y’Abakozi ba Leta. Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika y’u Rwanda riteganya ko hari abandi basenateri 8 bashyirwaho na Perezida wa Repubulika. Ku ikubitiro hashyirwaho abasenateri 4, abandi 4 bakazinjira muri sena nyuma y’umwaka. Kuri ubu muri Sena hakaba harimo abasenateri 4 bazarangiza manda yabo umwaka utaha kuko bashyizweho manda imaze umwaka itangiye. title: Ibihugu bya EAC byemeje ko ku wa Gatanu hazajya hambarwa imyenda yakorewe mu karere
content: Inama yahuje ba Minisitiri b’Ubucuruzi n’Inganda muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba (EAC), yemeje ko ku munsi wa Gatanu w’icyumweru, abatuye ibihugu biyigize bazajya bambara imyenda yakorewe muri aka karere, maze uwo munsi uhabwa izina rya ‘Afrika Mashariki Fashion Day’ Mu nama idasanzwe ya 36 yabaye kuri uyu wa Kane ku cyicaro cy’uyu muryango i Arusha muri Tanzania, hanemejwe ko “Icyumweru cya mbere cya Nzeri nka ‘Afrika Mashariki Fashion Week’, buri mwaka kikazajya kibamo imurikagurisha ry’imyenda yakorewe muri EAC.” Akanama gashinzwe ibjyanye n’ubucuruzi, inganda, imari n’ishoramari muri EAC ( Sectoral Council on Trade, Industry, Finance and Investment, SCTIFI) kafashe iyi myanzuro kagamije gukangurira ibihugu byo mu karere kurushaho guteza imbere inganda z’imyenda, bijyanye na gahunda bifite yo guca caguwa. Minisitiri w’Ubucuruzi n’Inganda, Soraya M. Hakuziyaremye wayoboye iyi nama, yavuze ko kugira ngo akarere kazungukire mu Isoko rusange rya Afurika (AfCTA), ari ngombwa ko kongera umusaruro wako, nyamara ngo hari imyanzuro n’amabwiriza byemezwa ariko ntibishyirwe mu bikorwa. Yibukije abandi baminisitiri ko itangizwa rya AfCFTA ari ku wa 1 Nyakanga 2020, bityo ibihugu bigize EAC bikwiye kuba byarangije gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo byiyemeje mbere y’uko iyo tariki igera. Abandi bitabiriye iyi nama ni Minisitiri w’Ubucuruzi w’u Burundi, Jean Marie Niyokindi; Minisitiri w’Ubucuruzi, Inganda n’Amakoperative muri Kenya, Peter Munya; Umunyamabanga wa Leta Ushinzwe Ubucuruzi n’Inganda muri Uganda, Kafabusa Michael; Minisitiri wungirije Ushinzwe Imari n’Igenamigambi muri Sudani y’Epfo, John Dor Majok na Minisitiri w’Inganda n’ubucuruzi muri Tanzania, Innocent Bashungwa. Aba baminisitiri bemeranyije ko ibihugu byabo byihutisha gushyira mu bikorwa gahunda yemejwe ku bijyanye n’iterambere ry’ipamba no gukora imyenda (Cotton, Textiles and Apparels (CTA) Strategy), binyuze mu gutanga ingengo y’imari ikenewe muri uru rwego mwaka w’ingengo y’imari wa 2020/2021. Mu kugaragaza ko iyi ari imishinga ishoboka, hatanzwe ingero ku bihugu bya Vietnam na Ethiopia byateje imbere izi nzego, aho ubu Vietnam ari cyo gihugu cya kabiri ku Isi mu kohereza inkweto mu mahanga nyuma y’u Bushinwa, aho cyohereza nibura miliyari imwe y’imiguru y’inkweto ku mwaka, bingana na 7.4% ku inama ry’izoherezwa ku Isi. Ni kimwe na Ethiopia nayo ikomeje kuzamuka cyane muri uru rwego rwo gukora inkweto mu mpu, ndetse ubu inkweto zaho zigezweho no mu bihugu bya Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Mu guteza imbere ibikorwa by’imyenda n’inkweto, u Rwanda rwatangije gahunda ya ’Made in Rwanda’, ndetse imaze gutanga umusaruro, kuko inganda zitandukanye zimaze kurufunguramo imiryango n’inzu nyinshi zitunganya ibijyanye n’imyenda. Src:IGIHE

title: RDC: Ingabo za Congo zishe Sylvestre Mudacumura wayoboraga umutwe wa FDLR
content: Umuyobozi w’umutwe w’iterabwoba wa FDLR Sylvestre Mudacumura yishwe arasiwe i Rutshuru ho muri Kivu y’amajyaruguru. Yarashwe n’umutwe wihariye w’ingabo za Kongo FARDC, mu bikorwa izi ngabo zimaze iminsi zaratangije byo guhashya imitwe yose yitwaje intwaro ibarizwa mu burasirazuba bw’iki gihugu. Umuvugizi w’Igisirikare cya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo Gen Richard Kasonga ni we watangaje amakuru y’urupfu rw’uyu muyobozi w’umutwe wa FDLR ugizwe na bamwe mu basize bakoze jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda. Mudacumura yari akurikiranyweho, aho muri Kongo ibyaha binyuranye birimo gusambanya abagore ku gahato, ubusahuzi, gutwikira abaturage n’ubundi bwoko bunyuranye bw’ibyaha by’ihohotera yakoreye abaturange ba Kongo. Kuva muri 2005 kandi, uyu Sylvestre Mudacumura yari yarashyiriweho ibihano n’Umuryango w’Abibumbye byo gukomanyirizwa ku bijyanye n’intwaro. Muri nyakanga 2012 na bwo Urukiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha rw’i La Haye mu Buholandi na rwo rwamushyiriyeho impapuro mpuzamahanga zo kumuta muri yombi kubera ibyaha by’intambara rwari rumukurikiranyeho ngo yaba yarakoze hagati ya 2009 na 2010 mu ntara  zombi za Kivu. Uretse ibyo kandi yanashinjwaga kugira uruhare muri jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda. Src:RBA

title: I Kigali hateraniye inama yiga ku masezerano u Rwanda na Uganda byasinyanye
content:
Kuri uyu wa Mbere intumwa z’u Rwanda n’iz’igihugu cya Uganda zitabiriye ibiganiro bya mbere ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’amasezerano ya Luanda agamije kuzahura umubano hagati y’ibihugu byombi. Bikaba biri kubera muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga n’ubutwererane y’u Rwanda. Ni ibiganiro biteganyijwe n’amasezerano y’ubwumvikane  yashyizweho umukono na ba Perezida Paul Kagame,  Ku ruhande rw’u Rwanda na Yoweri Kaguta Museveni, ku ruhande rwa Uganda muri Kanama 2019 muri Angola. Intumwa za Uganda muri ibi biganiro zirangajwe imbere na Minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga Sam Kutesa mu gihe ku ruhande rw’u Rwanda ziyobowe n’Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga, Amb. Olivier Nduhungirehe na we uri kumwe na bamwe mu bagize guverinoma barimo Minisitiri w’Ubutabera akaba n’Intumwa Nkuru ya Leta, Johnston Busingye ndetse na Minisitiri w’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu Prof. Shyaka Anastase. Ku ruhande rw’ibihugu by’ibihuza kandi, ibi biganiro byitabiriwe na minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga wa Angola Hon. Manuel Domingos Augusto ndetse na Minisitiri w’Intebe wungirije wa DRC, Gilbert Kankonde Malamba. Guverinoma y’u Rwanda iratangaza ko haramutse habayeho gusasa inzobe mu biganiro ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’amasezerano ya Luanda, byaba ari intangiriro nziza mu rugendo rugamije gusubiza ibintu mu buryo hagati y’u Rwanda n’igihugu cya Uganda. 

Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga, Amb. Olivier Nduhungirehe Ubwo yatangizaga ku mugaragaro iyi nama Umunyamabanga wa leta muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga, Amb. Olivier Nduhungirehe, yagaragaje ko amasezerano ya Luanda akwiye gukurikirwa n’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo kugira ngo umusaruro yitezweho ugerweho. Yibukije byumwihariko ko ibiyakubiyemo bisubiza ibirego u Rwanda rurega Leta ya Uganda birimo gushimuta no guhohotera Abanyarwanda baba cyangwa  batemberera muri icyo gihugu, gutera inkunga imitwe yitwaje intwaro igamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda, kubangamira inyungu z’ubucuruzi n’ubungu n’ibindi. Aha yagaragaje ko amasezerano ya Luanda asubiza ibyo bibazo byose, ariko ashimangira ko gusasa inzobe mu biganiro ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo ari urufunguzo ruganisha ku gisubizo kirambye ku mubano hagati y’ibihugu byombi ko kandi buri ruhande rukwiye kugaragaza ubushake bwo kuyashyira mu bikorwa. Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga wa Uganda, Sam Kutesa na we avuga ko abaturage b’ibihugu byombi bafite byinshi bibahuza bifite imizi mu mateka y’ibihugu byombi, bityo ko bitari bikwiye ko bagira ibyo bapfa. Yagaragaje ko Leta ya Uganda yemera ibikubiye mu masezerano ya Luanda kandi ko yiteguye kuyashyira mu bikorwa uko yakabaye, avuga ko ibiganiro bya mbere bihuje impande zombi byitezweho gutanga umurongo. Nyuma yo gutangiza ibi biganiro ku mugaragaro, ababiteraniyemo barimo kuganira mu muhezo mbere y’uko abakuriye intumwa z’u Rwanda na Uganda bagirana ikiganiro n’abanyamakuru ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa Mbere. Inkuru ya RBA

title: Umurambo w’umukambwe Robert Mugabe wagejejwe muri Zimbabwe
content: Indege yazanye umurambo wa nyakwigenera Robert Mugabe wabaye Perezida wa Zimbabwe yageze ku kibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga cya Harare ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 11 Nzeri 2019 ivuye i Singapour aho yaguye. Isanduku ye yururukijwe mu ndege imbere y’uwamusimbuye Perezida Mnangagwa hamwe n’umugore asize Grace Mugabe. Nkuko byatangajwe na Minisitiri w’Itangazamakuru muri Zimbabwe, Monica Mutsvangwa, mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Kane umurambo wa Robert Mugabe uraba uri kuri stade Rufaro mu nkengero z’umurwa mukuru Harare mu rwego rwo gufasha abanya-Zimbabwe gusezera kuri uyu mugabo bitaga "Bob" bafata nk’intwari y’urugamba rwo kubohora iki gihugu. Naho ku mugoroba uyu murambo urajyanwa mu cyaro cya Zvimba mu birometero bisaga ijana uvuye mu murwa mukuru. Imihango ya nyuma yo gushyingura Mugabe iteganijwe ku cyumweru ariko kugeza ubu ntiharatangazwa aho azashyingurwa kubera ko ubutegetsi n’umuryango we batarahuriza ku ho agomba gushyingurwa. Tubibutse ko Robert Mugabe yatabarutse ku myaka 95 y’amavuko ku wa Gatanu tariki ya 06 Nzeri 2019 aguye mu bitaro by’i Singapour. Uyu mukambwe yaharaniye ubwigenge bwa Zimbabwe binyuze mu ishyaka Zanu-PF yashinze ndetse ayobora iki gihugu imyaka 37 kuva mu 1980 kugeza mu 2017 ubwo yahirikagwa n’abasirikare agasimburwa na Nelson Mnangagwa.
