title: Kenya: Minisitiri w’Imari yatawe muri yombi ashinjwa ruswa
content: Henry Rotich wari minisitiri w’Imari muri Kenya, yafashwe ajyanwa ku biro bya polisi nyuma yaho umushinjacyaha mukuru ategetse ko atabwa muri yombi ashingiye ku birego bya ruswa akekwaho. Henry Roctich agomba kwitaba ibiro by’iperereza ku byaha kugira ngo abazwe ku mafaranga yishyuwe afite aho ahuriye n’ibikorwa byo kubaka ingomero ebyiri muri Kenya. Ashinjwa kuba yarishe amategeko y’itangwa ry’isoko ubwo yahaga sosiyete y’Abataliyani amasezerano y’agaciro gasaga miliyoni 450 z’amadorali ya Amerika yo ku baka izi ngomero. Rotich yari yamaganye ibi birego ubwo itangazamakuru ryo muri Kenya ryatangiraga kubivuga muri Werurwe uyu mwaka. Sosiyete y’Abataliyani ya CMC de Ravenna yahawe aya masoko nayo yari yabihakanye. Ubutabera bwo muri Kenya burakora iperereza ku buryo iri soko ryatanzwe aho bikekwa ko hari amafaranga y’inyongera agera kuri miliyoni 170 z’amadorali ya Amerika yaba yararengejwe ku mafanga agaragara mu masezerano asanzwe yo kubaka izi ngomero. Umwe mu bari gukora iperereza kuri ibi byaha witwa Noordin Haji yavuze ko biragaragara ko hashobora kuba harabayemo uburiganya bukabije kuva ku miterere y’isoko, itangwa ryaryo n’uburyo bw’imyishyurire n’ibindi byose bijyanye n’itangwa ry’iri soko. Uretse uyu mu Minisitiri watawe muri yombi, hanasabwe ko abandi bantu 20 biganjemo abo mu nzego zo hejuru z’ubuyobozi ndetse na bamwe mu bakozi ba CMC de Ravenna nabo batabwa muri yombi hagakurikiranwa uruhare rwabo muri iki kibazo. Src: BBC Afrique

title: Ubufaransa: Habonetse ibisigazwa by’ubwato bwari bumaze imyaka 50 bwaraburiwe irengero
content: Ibisigazwa by’ubwato bw’igisirikare cy’Abafaransa kirwanira mu mazi bwitwa La Minerve bwabuze mu 1968 butwaye abantu 58, kuri ubu bwabonetse nyuma y’imyaka 50 nkuko minisitiri w’Ingabo mu Bufaransa, Florence Parly yabitangaje kuri uyu wa Mbere. Ibi bisagazwa by’ubu bwato byabonetse muri metero ibihumbi 2,370 by’ubujyakuzimu mu nyanja ya Mediteraniya (Méditerranée) mu bilometero 45 uvuye i Toulon mu majyepfo ashyira uburasirazuba bw’Ubufaransa. Hari ku ya 27 Mutarama 1968 ubwo ubu bwato bwa gisirikare bwari mu myitozo mu birometero bibarirwa kuri 30 uvuye Toulon bwarohamaga mu minota ine gusa. Nubwo hahise haba ibikorwa bikomeye byo kubushakisha kugeza ubu bwari butaraboneka. Mu Ukwakira umwaka ushize ni bwo imiryango yababuriye ababo muri ubu bwato yatangiye impuruza kugira ngo ibikorwa byo gushakisha ubu bwato byongere bisubukurwe. Kuva Minisitiri w’Ingabo Florence Parly yatangaza ko ibi bikorwa bisubukuwe mu ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka, impuguke zitandukanye zihutiye kumenya amerekezo nyayo ibisigazwa by’ubu bwato yaba aherereyemo ari nabwo hatangiye gukusanywa amakuru. Havugwa impamvu nyinshi zishobora kuba zarateye iyi mpanuka harimo ibibazo bya tekinike, kuba yaba yaragonganye n’ubundi bwato, kuba bwaba bwaraturikanwe n’igisasu (missile) cyangwa bukaraswa n’ibindi bitandukanye bigenda bikekwa.

title: Constantin Tuyishimire ukorera Radio/Tv1 hashize iminsi itatu aburiwe irengero
content:
Ni amakuru yagiye ahagaragara mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 19 Nyakanga 2019 nyuma y’iminsi itatu Constantin Tuyishimire, umunyamakuru wa TV na Radio 1 aburiwe irengero. Ibi biremezwa ni abakoresha be, umuryango we ndetse n’uwo babanaga ku kazi mu karere ka Gicumbi aho kugeza ubu RIB ivuga ko yatangiye kumushakisha nyuma yaho imenyeshejwe ayo makuru. Olivier Ngabirano, Umwanditsi mukuru wa Radio na TV One yabwiye Umuseke ko aheruka kuvugana na Constantin Tuyishimire mu gitondo cyo ku wa Kabiri amuha amabwiriza y’akazi ariko ngo ntarongera kumubona haba kuri telefoni cyangwa ahandi. "Mperuka kuvugana na we ejo bundi kuwa kabiri mu gitondo 7h 54 nyuma naramubuze”, Olivier Ngabirano aganira n’Umuseke aho yakomeje avuga ko atamenya niba yarabuze kubera inkuru yakoze cyangwa ikindi yaba akurikiranyweho ku giti cye.

Uyu mugabo yari umunyamakuru wa Televiziyo na Radio One i Gicumbi mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru Uwo babanaga i Gicumbi aho yabaga yagiye mu kazi mu minsi y’imibyizi yabwiye Umuseke ko kuri uyu wa Kane  yagiye kubwira RIB ko umuntu yajyaga acumbikira yamubuze. Ati “Ibi nabikoze kugira ngo ejo hatazagira umbaza aho yarengeye kuko arinjye wamucumbikiraga.” Umuvugizi w’Urwego rw’igihugu rw’ubugenzacyaha Modeste Mbabazi yabwiye Umuseke ko ejo ari bwo umugore wa Tuyishimire yaje gutanga ikirego kuri RIB, avuga ko atazi aho umugabo we yarengeye ndetse ngo n’umwanditsi mukuru wa Radio na TV One iki kibazo yakigejeje kuri RIB. Ati “Abagenzacyaha bakibimenya bahise batangira gukurikirana iby’ibura rye kugeza ubu hakaba ntayandi makuru araboneka.”

title: Prof Romain Murenzi yongeye kugirirwa icyizere cyo kuyobora Inteko y’intiti mu bya siyansi ku isi
content:
Nyuma y’amezi 14 ari mu ishami ry’Umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku burezi UNESCO, umunyarwanda Prof Romain Murenzi yongeye kugirwa umuyobozi w’Inteko y’intiti mu bya siyansi ku isi (TWAS:The World Academy of Sciences). Prof Romain Murenzi wigeze kuba na minisitiri w’uburezi hano mu Rwanda, si ubwa mbere agiye kwicara kuri iyi ntebe, dore ko yayicayeho mu gihe cy’imyaka itanu, uhereye muri 2011 kugeza muri 2016, akahava yerekeza muri UNESCO aho yamaze amezi 14 ayoboye igice cy’Ubumenyi no kubaka ubushobozi mu bumenyi karemano (Division of Science Policy and Capacity Building in the Natural Sciences).

 Prof Romain Murenzi(iburyo) na Mohamed Hassan(ibumoso) ubwo bahererekanyaga ububasha mu 2016, ari nawe yongeye gusimbura  Nkuko inkuru dukesha urubuga rwa TWAS ibivuga, Prof Murenzi Romain yavuze ko yishimiye uyu mwanya asubijwe ndetse anavuga ko yizeye kugira icyo afasha ibihugu bikennye. Yagize ati “Ntewe ishema no gusubira muri TWAS ndetse n’i Trieste mu Butaliyani, umurwa mpuzamahanga wa siyansi ufite intego ikomeye yo guteza imbere isi. Mu gukorana na guverinoma y’Ubutaliyani, UNESCO n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa, nizera ko TWAS ishobora gukomeza amateka yayo yo kuzamura iterambere rya siyansi, cyane cyane mu bihugu bikennye kurusha ibindi.” Uyu mwanya Prof Romain Murenzi awusimbuyeho umunya-Soudan, Mohamed Hassan wari umuyobozi wayo w’agateganyo.

title: Polisi yasobanuye ikibazo cy’abanyamakuru bavuga ko bahohotewe n’abarinda umukuru w’igihugu
content:
Ku wa Gatanu w’icyumweru gishize, abanyamakuru bane bavuze ko bahohotewe n’abarinda umutekano w’umukuru w’igihugu (Republican Guard) ubwo bageragezaga kugera mu rugo rw’umuryango wa Rwigara ruherereye mu Kiyovu mu mujyi wa Kigali, agace gasanzwe karindwa n’aba bacunga umutekano w’umukuru w’igihugu kuko ari hafi y’aho atuye. Mu gusobanura uko byagenze, umuvugizi wa polisi y’u Rwanda Theos Badege yagize ati “Abasirikare (Officers) bagize amatsiko y’abo bantu barimo batembera aho hantu, barabegera babasaba kwivuga, hanyuma bituma batangira kutumvikana. Ibi rero byari ikosa ryo kudatanga imyirondoro ndetse n’ihanahana makuru ridashyitse(miscommunication). Ibi ntibyagombaga kuba byabaye dore ko ari aba basirikare ndetse n’abanyamakuru bose bakoraga inshingano zabo mu buryo bwemewe n’amategeko.”
Abanyamakuru bihutiye kugeza ikibazo kuri polisi yahise ibasobanurira ko nta mpamvu n’imwe yagombaga gutuma bavuga ko bahohotewe. Polisi y’igihugu yababwiye ko yubaha uburenganzira bw’abanyamakuru bwo gukusanya amakuru, hakurikijwe amategeko. Iki gihe rero nta tegeko ryishwe.
Ku byerekeranye n’ibivugwa ku bagize umuryango wa Rwigara, ACP Badege yagize ati “Nta n’umwe muri bo ufunze kandi Polisi izi neza ko bavugana n’abababuranira (avocat) basura kenshi urugo rwabo. Aba kandi bitaba buri gihe polisi mu gihe ibahamagaje muri iki gihe iperereza rigikomeje. Basabye ko igihe cyo kongera kubazwa cyakwegezwa inyuma kugira ngo babanze babivuganeho neza n’abababuranira (avocat) kandi barabyemerewe.”
Src: www.police.gov.rw

title: Ubushinwa bwahagurukiye kugabanya kwikinisha mu basirikari babwo
content:
Igisirikare cy’ubushinwa cyashyizeho amategeko mashya azajya agenderwamo mu gusuzuma abashaka kucyiyandikishamo, hakaba harimo n’irisuzuma umuntu ko atabaswe no kwikinisha. Le Quotidien de l’APL, ikinyamakuru cy’igisirikare cyashyize hanze urutonde rw’impamvu zatumye benshi mu bifuje kwinjira mu gisirikare cyabo bakuwe mu igeragezwa rugikubita. Umwe muri 5 yakuwemo kuko abyibushye cyane naho 8 ku ijana bakuwemo kuko umuyoboro w’igitsina witwa “veine testiculaire hypertrophiée” wangiritse, ibi bikaba biterwa ahanini no kuba umuntu yarabaswe no kwikinisha.
Ibindi byagiye bigaragara kuri uru rutonde ni ugukina cyane imikino yo kuri mudasobwa (Jeux Video/PlayStation) cyangwa se ikindi kintu cyose kigaragaza ko udakora imirimo y’amaboko ihagije cyangwa siporo. 
Hari kandi kuba ufite ibishushanyo byo ku mubiri(tatouage) biri ahagarahara cyangwa binini cyane naho abandi bakaba barabujijwe amahirwe n’ibibazo by’umwijima batewe no kunywa inzoga nyinshi.
Mu mujyi umwe wo mu Bushinwa abarenga kimwe cya kabiri bangiwe kugeragezwa kuko ngo ingano yabo itari ihagije aha minisiteri y’ingabo muri iki gihugu igasobanura ko ibi bigendanye n’amahame akakaye iki gihugu kigenderaho cyubaka igisirikare cyacyo.

title: Indoneziya: Hagaragaye inzoka y’imitwe ibiri
content: Abaturage bo mu cyaro cya Bali muri Indoneziya batunguwe ubwo babonaga inzoka ifite imitwe ibiri, ibidakunze kubaho. Iyi nzoka yabonywe mu cyumweru gishize muri kamwe mu duce dukorerwamo ubukerarugendo cyane. "Nari ntashye mvuye ku kazi ubwo nahagarikaga moto yanjye iruhande rw’inzoka.", umuturage witwa Gusti Bagus Eka Budaya wayibonye mbere. Uyu muturage yakomeje ati "Nayirebye nitonze maze mbona ko ifite imitwe ibiri. Ibi byarantunguye cyane." Hari amashusho agaragaza abana bateranye bazengurutse iyi nzoka ikiri nto kuburyo ibasha gukwira mu kiganza cy’umuntu, aho yakorerwagaho imigenzo gakondo y’abahindu b’i Bali. Ubwoko bw’iyi nzoka ntibwamenyekanye. Mu bihe bishize, impuguke zemeje ko inzoka z’imitwe ibiri byari bigoranye kuzibona ziryana.

title: Isake, Maurice yatsinze urubanza yaregagwamo gusakuriza abaturanyi
content:
Kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 05 Nzeri 2019,  ubutabera bwo mu Bufaransa bwemereye isake yitwa Maurice uburenganzira bwo gukomeza kubika nta nkomyi nyuma yo gutera utwatsi ibirego by’abaturanyi bayo bavugaga ko ibibuza amahwemo ikabakangura mu rukerera. "Maurice (izina ry’iyi sake) yatsinze ndetse abayiregaga bagomba kwishyura nyirayo amayero 1000 (asaga miliyoni imwe y’amanyarwanda) z’indishyi y’akababaro n’inyungu ", ibyatangajwe na Me Papineau, umunyamategeko waburaniraga nyiri iyi sake mu rukiko ubwo yatangazaga imwe mu myanzuro y’uru rubanza rwasomwe n’urukiko rwa Rochefort, wanavuze ko abayiregaga bagomba no gutanga amafaranga yayo y’urukiko. Nyiri iyi sake witwa Corinne Fesseau nyuma yo gutsinda urubanza yavuze ko yarenzwe n’ibyishimo ndetse yabuze icyo avuga. Ati "Ni intsinzi ku bantu bose bari mu kibazo nk’icyanjye."

Corinne Fesseau hamwe n’isake ye Maurice nyuma yo gutsinda urubanza Ku ruhande rw’uyu mwunganizi mu mategeko waburaniye iyi sake, yavuze ko yizeye ko hashobora no kujyaho itegeko ryitiriwe iyi sake (une loi Maurice ) rishobora kurenganura urusaku rwose ruturuka ku nyamaswa mu bice by’icyaro. Iki kibazo cyari cyatangiye ubwo abaturanyi b’iyi sake batangaga ikirego bavuga ko urusaku rwayo rubabangamiye. Abo ni umusaza n’umukecuru b’abahanzi bari mu kiruhuko kizabukuru bahitwa Haute-Vienne, bavugaga ko urusaku rwayo rugera aho bari kuruhukira ku kirwa cya Oléron.

Iyi sake yaramamaye cyane kubera kuregwa mu rukiko ’kubika’  Abantu bagera ku bihumbi 140 bari basinye bagaragaza ko bifuza kurengera uburenganzira bwa Maurice mu nkuru yatambukijwe mu kinyamakuru The New York Times, T-shirts "Let me sing" (reka ndirimbe/mbike) aho bari bagamije kurengera iyi sake yo kuri iki kirwa kiri muri bimwe mu bigaragaza uburyo bimwe mu bice by’ibyaro mu Bufaransa bigenda bibangamirwa n’iterambere. 7sur7

title: Umugabo arashinjwa kurunguruka abagore barenga 550 i Madrid
content: Umugabo yatawe muri yombi mu murwa mukuru Madrid wa Espanye acyekwaho gufata videwo mu ibanga abagore barenga 550 abarunguruka mu myanya yabo y’ibanga, akayashyira ku rubuga rwa internet. Bivugwa ko uyu mugabo ukomoka muri Colombia w’imyaka 53, yafataga izo videwo kuri telefone ye igendanwa yayihishe mu gikapu cyo mu mugongo. Polisi ivuga ko nyuma yahise ashyira videwo zigera kuri 283 ku mbuga za internet z’urukozasoni, zikarebwa n’abantu babarirwa muri za miliyoni. Benshi muri abo bagore 555 aregwa gufata videwo - bamwe muri bo ntibarageza imyaka y’ubukure - bivugwa ko yabafashe videwo bari mu gice cy’ingendo zo munsi y’ubutaka (’metro’) muri uwo mujyi. Uyu mugabo ashinjwa kurunguruka abagore buri munsi guhera ku mpeshyi y’umwaka ushize ubwo yatangiraga gushyira izo videwo ku mbuga za internet. Bivugwa ko yajyaga akora mu maguriro (’supermarkets’), rimwe na rimwe akabanza no kwibwira abo yafataga izo videwo agamije kubona uburyo bwiza bwo gufata videwo. Polisi ivuga ko yari imaze igihe igenzura ibikorwa by’uyu mugabo ucyekwa, iza kumuta muri yombi ubwo yarimo afata videwo y’umugore wari uri muri ’metro’. Polisi yatangaje videwo ku rubuga nkoranyambaga rwa Twitter ivuga ko uyu ucyekwaho icyaha "ari umwe mu babangamiye bikomeye ubuzima bwite bw’abagore". Ubwo polisi yajyaga gusaka aho aba, ivuga ko yahasanze mudasobwa igendanwa na ’hard drives’ (’disques durs’) ziriho videwo zibarirwa mu magana. Polisi ivuga ko urubuga rwe bwite rwa internet rwiyandikishijweho abantu 3,519. Uyu ucyekwa ubu ari mu maboko ya polisi. Muri Espanye, kurunguruka bifatwa nk’ihohotera rishingiye ku gitsina ndetse abo bihamye bashobora gufungwa. Kurunguruka biherutse gushyirwa mu byaha bihanwa n’amategeko mu Bwongereza no muri ’Wales’ (’Pays de Galles’), nyuma y’ubukangurambaga bwakozwe n’impirimbanyi y’umwanditsi Gina Martin. Inkuru ya BBC

title: Gasabo: Umurambo w’umugabo wasanzwe mu modoka
content: Umurambo w’umugabo witwa Ndahimana Callixte wagaragaye mu Kagari ka Kagugu mu Murenge wa Kanyinya mu Karere ka Kinyinya uri mu ivatiri. Mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Mbere, nibwo umurambo w’uyu mugabo wasanzwe mu modoka yari ihagaze ku muhanda nkuko tubikesha IGIHE. Amakuru ava muri aka gace avuga ko abaturage aribo babonye uyu murambo bwa mbere bahita babimenyesha umukuru w’Akagari ka Kagugu nawe abimenyesha inzego z’umutekano Aya amakuru akimara kumenyekana Urwego rw’Ubugenzacyaha, RIB rwahise rujya ahagaragaye uyu murambo zisanga koko ayo makuru ariyo. Umuyobozi wungirije w’Akarere ka Gasabo ushinzwe imibereho y’abaturage, Nyirabahire Languida, yagize ati “Twabimenye mugitondo ari uko abaturage babivuze, hari abaciyeho babona imodoka irimo umuntu wapfuye ariko nta byangombwa ndetse n’imodoka yari arimo ntabwo izwi polisi n’abandi bashinzwe umutekano bari gukora iperereza kugira ngo barebe icyamwishe.” Yakomeje avuga ko ikigaragara ari uko uyu muntu ashobora kuba yiciwe ahandi agahita arambikwa muri iyo modoka akazanwa muri aka gace. Umuvugizi w’Urwego rw’Ubugenzacyaha, Mbabazi Modeste yabwiye IGIHE ko uwapfuye yitwaga Ndahimana Callixte anashimangira ko iperereza ryatangiye kugira ngo hamenyekane iby’urupfu rwe. Yagize ati “Twamenye ko hari umuntu babonye mu modoka yapfuye mu murenge wa Kinyinya noneho abagenzacyaha bajyayo basanga koko hari imodoka irimo umuntu kandi bigaragra ko yapfuye, bafunguye biza kugaragako hari ibimenyetso bigaragaza ko yishwe hanyma abagenzacyaha bakora ibyo bagombaga gukora bashakisha amakuru." Yongeyeho ko umurambo wahise ujyanwa ku Bitaro bya Kacyiru ndetse iperereza ryatangiye kugira ngo bamenye aho nyakwigendera ari atuye niba hari n’ibibazo yari afitanye n’abandi n’ibyo yakoraga n’ibindi byose mu rwego rwo gukurikirana n’ ibigendanye n’urupfu rwe.

title: Amenyo 526 yakuwe mu kanwa k’umwana w’imyaka 7
content:
Nyuma y’uko amaze igihe ataka kurimbwa mu rwasaya rw’iburyo, abaganga bo mu bitaro byo mu Buhinde baramusuzumye bamusangana uruhago rurimo amenyo 526 mu kanwa. Ubwo uyu mwana yagezwaga kwa muganga, yari abyimbye mu isura, anataka kubabara cyane mu rwasaya. Byabaye ngombwa ko acishwa mu cyuma(scanner), bahita babona ko afite indwara yitwa ’Odontome’, kanseri y’amenyo igaragazwa n’imera ry’amenyo adasanzwe aba ari mu ruhago.

 Aya menyo yose yari mu kanwa k’umwana w’imyaka 7  Byabaye ngombwa ko uyu mwana abagwa ndetse arakurikiranwa bihagije. "Ni amenyo 526 yose hamwe, afite hagati ya sentimetero 0,1 na sentimetero 15. N’iryinyo rito cyane muri yo ryari rifite imizi n’ibindi bice byose bigaragaza ko ari iryinyo nyaryo." Prathiba Ramani, aganira na CNN

title: Ku myaka 6 gusa, ni umuherwe abikesha YouTube
content:
Ababyeyi ba Boram, umwana wamamaye kuri YouTube muri Koreya, bamaze kugura inzu ifite agaciro k’asaga miliyari 7 z’amanyarwanda, babikesha umutungo umwana wabo w’imyaka 6 akura kuri YouTube. Ni umwana utazwi n’abantu benshi ku isi ariko iwabo muri Koreya y’Epfo ni icyamamare bikomeye. Uyu mwana w’imyaka 6 y’amavuko afite konti 2 kuri YouTube, harimo imwe yahariye gukina no gusesengura ibikinisho, ikurikirwa n’abasaga miliyoni 13, naho indi ikaba ivuga ku buzima bwe bwa buri munsi yo igakurikiranwa n’abarenga miliyoni 17.

 Boram akurikirwa na benshi ku mashusho atandukanye ashyira kuri YouTube  Amashusho ashyira kuri YouTube arebwa inshuro zirenga miliyoni 100 ndetse kugeza ubu akaba amaze kurebwa inshuro zirenga miliyari 4. Ibi rero byamugize icyamamare cyane ndetse bimwagurira n’isoko kuko abifuza kwamamaza bamutekereza mbere kandi igiciro cye ntikiba cyoroshye. Ibi byatumye ababyeyi be binjira mu mubare w’abakire bakomeye muri Seoul, dore ko ubu bamaze no kwigurira umuturirwa w’amagorofa 5 i Gangnam, agace gatuwe n’abakire cyane i Seoul, bayiguze agera kuri miliyari 9 na 500 z’amawons yo muri Koreya ni ukuvuga asaga miliyari 7 z’amanyarwanda. Kwamamara no kwinjiza amafaranga k’uyu mwana ariko ntibivugwaho rumwe na bose. Mu myaka ibiri ishize umuryango  mpuzamahanga wita ku bana Save The Children, nyuma yo kuregerwa n’abantu benshi wareze ababyeyi ba Boram ubashinja kumubyaza umusaruro bamushakamo ubukire, bavuga ko ku myaka ye atazi uburyo akoreshwa.

 Ababyeyi be bashinjwa kumubyaza umusaruro  Icyo gihe ababyeyi be basabye imbabazi ndetse bakuraho n’amwe mu mashusho atarishimiwe, hari nk’iyo Boram yakinnye atwite akanabyara. Nyuma yo kugura iyi nzu, amagambo yongeye kubyuka, abantu bamwe batabariza uyu mwana.

title: Umurambo we wabonetse inyuma ya frigo nyuma y’imyaka 10 aburiwe irengero
content: Umurambo we wabonetse muri Mutarama uyu mwaka, aboneka inyuma ya firigo mu cyumba cy’ubukonje cyo mu iduka, bikaba byamenyekanye ko ari umugabo wari waraburiwe irengero mu myaka 10 ishize. Ni inkuru yatangaje benshi cyane. Umurambo wabonetse ku ya 24 Mutarama 2019, ubonywe n’abafundi bari mu kazi ko gusenya iri duka ryakinze imiryango yaryo hagati ya 2015 na 2016. Kuri uyu wa Mbere nibwo polisi ikurikirana ibyaha muri Leta ya Iowa yatangaje ko ibizamini byakozwe byagaragaje izina rya nyakwigendera. Ni Larry Ely Murillo-Moncada, umugabo wari waraburiwe irengero mu mwaka wa 2009 nk’uko CNN ibitangaza. Ibura rye ryatangajwe n’ababyeyi be, icyo gihe yari afite imyaka 25 akora mu iduka akaba yari yavuye mu rugo arakaye, ku itariki ya 28 Ugushyingo, 2009. "Yari yavuye mu rugo atambaye inkweto n’amasogosi, nta n’imfunguzo z’imodoka." nk’uko bisobanurwa na Brandon Danielson umupolisi muri Council Bluffs. Polisi ivuga ko uyu musore yazamutse kuri frigo agahanuka inyuma yayo. Aha hantu hafite ubugari bwa sentimetero 45, ntiyabonye uko yongera kuzamuka bituma ahaburira ubzima. "Imashini zarasakuzaga cyane, ntibyari gupfa koroha ko hagira umuntu umwumva atabaza." nk’uko polisi ikomeza ibisobanura. Nyuma y’imyaka 6 iyi mpanuka ibaye ntawari warigeze abona uyu murambo. Ikizamini cyagaragaje ko atigeze akomeretswa. Dosiye ye yanditswemo ko yishwe n’impanuka.

title: Miss Mwiseneza Josiane yapfushije umubyeyi
content: Miss Mwiseneza Josiane wegukanye ikamba rya Nyampinga wakunzwe cyane mu marushanwa ya Miss Rwanda 2019, kuri ubu ari mu ahinda ko kubura se umubyara witabye Imana aguye muri Uganda. Uyu mubyeyi bivugwa ko yapfuye ku wa Mbere w’iki Cyumweru tariki ya 22 Nyakanga 2019, ariko bimenyekana kuri uyu wa Kabiri. Kuri ubu icyo yazize ntabwo cyatangajwe mu gihe abo mu muryango we n’inshuti bategereje umurambo ko ugezwa mu Rwanda maze agashyingurwa aho akomoka mu karere ka Rubengera.

title: Nigeria: Umugabo yafatiwe ku ibaba ry’indege yitegura gufata ikirere (Video)
content: Ikigo cy’indege muri Nigeria kiri mu rujijo rw’uburyo umugabo yageze hejuru y’ibaba ry’indege  yiteguraga guhaguruka i Lagos mu mpera z’icyumweru gishize. Ibi bikaba byarabereye ku kibuga cy’indege cya Murtala Muhammed ku wa Gatanu ushize. Amashusho yafashwe n’umwe mu bagenzi bari imbere muri iyi ndege ya kompanyi ya Azman Air yerekana abagenzi barimo imbere bahiye ubwoba bibaza ibyo uwo mugabo arimo dore ko iyi ndege haburaga gato cyane ngo ifate ikirere. Umupilote wari uyitwaye yahise aba ahagaze abanza kumenyesha iby’uyu mugabo wahise atabwa muri yombi nkuko byasohowe mu itangazo rya Henrietta Yakubu umuvugizi w’ikigo cy’ibibuga by’indege muri Nigeria wahamijwe ko hahise hanatangizwa iperereza kugira ngo hamenyekane uko yageze hejuru y’iri baba n’impamvu yabimuteye. Ngo nyuma y’iminota mike yo gusuzuma ko nta kindi kibazo, iyi ndege yari yerekeje Port Harcourt mu majyepfo ya Nigeria yaje gufata ikirere, naho amashusho y’uyu mugabo utatangajwe umwirondoro we yo yahererekanyijwe n’abantu benshi ku mbuga nkoranyambaga gusa kugeza n’ubu ntiharamenyekana icyo yaragamije. title: Ubuhinde: Umugabo yarumwe n’inzoka, arihorera nawe arayiruma barapfana
content: Mu gihugu cy’Ubuhinde haravuwa inkuru idasanzwe y’umugabo warumwe n’inzoka maze agira umujinya ashaka kwihorera nawe arayiruma bikomeye ku buryo yayishe ariko nawe nyuma byarangiye apfuye azize ibikomere. Umuyobozi w’umudugudu uyu mugabo witwaga Parvat Gala Baria yari atuyemo, aganira n’imwe muri televiziyo yo muri aka gace yagize ati "Yafashe inzoka ihita imuhindukirana imuruma ku kiganza no mu isura. Parvat nawe yahise ayiruma inzoka irapfa." Uyu muyobozi yakomeje avuga ko Parvat Gala Baria yari aherereye bugufi y’ahantu hari ikamyo yarimo ibigori ari naho haturutse inzoka maze abandi bantu barahunga, ariko we arahaguma avuga ko yari asanzwe ahangana n’inzoka akazica. Nyuma yo kurumwa n’inzoka, Parvat Gala Baria yahise yerekezwa ku bitaro biri bugufi, gusa ntiyabashije kubaho kuko mu masaha yakurikiyeho yahise apfa nkuko byatangajwe n’ikinyamakuru La Republica. title: AMAFOTO: Amaze imyaka 40 atogosha atanoga imisatsi
content:
Sakal Dev Tuddu umuhinde w’imyaka 63 y’amavuko, amaze imyaka 40 yose atarogosha umusatsi we ndetse ataranawukarabamo, ahamya ko ari Imana yabimusabye Tuddu ahamya ko Imana yamusanze mu nzozi ikamusaba kutongera kogosha imisatsi ye kuko ngo ari umugisha imuhaye. 	Yumviye ngo ukugusaba kw’Imana guhera ubwo ntiyongera kuwogosha kugeza aho ubu ufite metero 1 na sentimetero 8 (1,8m).

 Imyaka ibaye 40 atogosha umusatsi we, atanawukarabamo  Nyuma y’uku guhura n’Imana, Tuddu yabaye umuvuzi gakondo aho ubu ategura imiti ifasha abaturage bo mu gace atuyemo batabasha kubyara. Amaze kuba icyamamare ndetse abantu benshi baza no kumureba bagira gusa ngo babashe kwifotozanya na we. Nubwo uburebure bw’uyu musatsi butangaje, ni bugufi cyane ugereranyije n’ufite imisatsi miremire kurusha indi ku isi, aho ufitwe na Asha Mandela ureshya na metero 34.

title: Amerika: Umugabo yaciye igitsina cya mugenzi we wamucaga inyuma
content:
I Floride muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika haravugwa umugabo waciye igitsina cya mugenzi we kubera gufuha kuko yari afitanye umubano udasanzwe n’umugore we ngo bakaba bihereraga bakamuca inyuma. Ibi ngo byabaye ku Cyumweru gishize aho Alex Bonilla, umunyamerika ukomoka i Floride w’imyaka 49 y’amavuko, yateye urugo rw’umuturanyi we anitwaje imbunda maze amutera ubwoba ko amwica natamwumvira. Yamutegetse kujya mu cyumba araramo, nuko amuhambira amaboko n’amaguru maze amukata ubugabo bwe yifashishije umukasi. Amakuru avuga ko nyuma yo kumara guca igitsina cya mugenzi we, uyu mugabo yahise ahunga ndetse agenda nacyo akijyanye, asiga undi ahongaho avirirana. Ubwo ibi byabaga ngo abana babiri bato b’uyu mugabo waciwe igitsina bari mu nzu. 

Alex Bonilla yafashwe nyuma yo guca igitsina cya mugenzi we Nkuko amakuru yatangajwe n’ibiro bishinzwe umutekano (shérif) byo mu gace ka Gilchrist ibi byabereyemo abihamya, ngo Alex Bonilla ibi yakoze yabitewe no gufuha  nyuma yo kubona muri Gicurasi uyu mwaka umugore we n’uyu muturanyi we bari gusambana. Uyu mugabo waciwe igitsina yahise ajyanwa kwa muganga ngo avurwe ibisebe aho kugeza ubu bitaratangazwa niba ubuyobozi bwo muri ako gace bwaba bwarabashije kubona igitsina cye cyaciwe. Ku rundi ruhande, Alex Bonilla we arashinjwa gutera urugo rw’abandi, gukorera ibikorwa by’ubugome imbere y’abana, kuboha umuntu mu buryo bunyuranije n’amategeko no gukoresha imbunda. Source:7sur7

title: Yirukanywe mu ndege kuko yambaye ishati igaragaza amabere
content:
Harriet Osborne, umugore w’imyaka 31 y’amavuko yagombaga gusubira mu Bwongereza avuye i Malaga muri Espagne ariko ntibyamugendeye nk’uko yabyifuzaga, kuko uyu mubyeyi w’abana babiri yirukanwe mu ndege kubera uko yari yambaye Yari yambaye ijipo n’agashati kabengerana cyane ndetse gafunguye cyane mu gatuza ndetse nta n’isutiye yarimo. Nyuma yo kubwirwa n’umukozi wo mu ndege ko atagomba gukomeza kwambara atyo, yarengejeho umupira w’umugabo we ariko umwe mu bagenzi akomeza ubwira abakozi b’indege ko atanejewe n’imyambarire y’uyu mugore. 

 Ngo iyi myambarire ntiyemewe mu ndege za Easyjet   "Itsinda ry’abakozi bo mu ndege ryari rikabije kuba ribi. Numvise merewe nai. Banshyize imbere y’abandi bagenzi bose mu ndege, ambwira ko ntemerewe kuguma mu ndege nambaye iyo shati. Nyuma nifubitse ariko ntibyagira icyo bihindura. Bamperekeje hanze y’indege. Byarambabaje. Ni ivangura rishingiye ku gitsina (Sexisme)" Harriet

 Ngo na nyuma yo kwifubika ntibyakunze ko ahaguma  Easyjet, sosiyete yo gutwara abantu mu ndege ibi byabereyemo, nayo yagize icyo ibivugaho, aho bahamya ko uyu mugore yirukanywe kuko yabwiye nabi abakozi babo, ko ntaho bihuriye n’imyambarire ye. "Umukozi yamubwiye mu kinyabupfura ko agomba guhindura iyo shati kugira ngo agende mu ndege. Yabyemeye ariko ahita atangira kugira imyitwarire yabangamiye itsinda ryose ry’abakozi bari muri urwo rugendo. Ntabwo tujya twihanganira imyitwarire ihohotera abakozi bacu." Nyuma yo kwirukanwa mu ndege, Harriet yaraye ku kibuga cy’indege cya Malaga, hanyuma afata indi ndege umunsi wakurikiyeho.

title: Ububiligi: Abagendera ku magare bigaragambije bambaye ubusa -Amafoto
content:
Ku wa Gatandatu ushize tariki ya 15 Kamena 2019, abanyonzi barenga ijana b’Ababiligi bakoze imyiyerekano mu mihanda yo mu murwa mukuru Bruxelles bambaye uko bavutse mu rwego rwo kumvikanisha ibyifuzo byabo. Ni ku nshuro ya 15 ya Cyclonudista, igikorwa kigamije gusaba ko havugururwa uburyo abagendera ku igare bakwisanzura mu mihanda yo mu mijyi. 

Ubwo biteguraga gutangira urugendo Abahuje umugambi bakaba barahuriye ahitwa Square Frère Orban mu murwa mukuru Bruxelles ku isaha ya saa cyenda maze batangira urugendo bari hejuru y’ibi binyabiziga byabo by’amapine abiri, bambaye ubusa bagamije kugaragaza ibyifuzo byabo. Mu byo abahuriye muri Cyclonudista basaba harimo umutekano uhagije w’abagendera ku igare mu mihanda yo mu mujyi (bagahabwa umwanya wisanzuye bagenderamo mu buryo bumwe nk’ubw’imodoka,...), kugabanya ibyotsi bihumanya ikirere n’ibindi birimo gushyiraho ubwikorezi rusange bw’abantu ku buntu.

Bahitamo kwmbara ubusa kugira ngo ubutumwa bwabo burusheho kumvikana Abitabira uru rugendo baza ku magare ariko kandi banambaye ubusa bagaragaza ko bakunda imibiri yabo kandi bisanisha n’intege nke abagendera ku igare baba bafite mu mihanda bahuriramo n’imodoka mu mijyi. Imyigaragambyo y’aba-Cyclonudista (abanyonzi bambaye ubusa) ni imyiyerekano mpuzamahanga ibera mu mijyi itandukanye, ikaba yaratangiriye muri Esipanye mu 2001 nyuma igenda ikwira mu yindi mijyi itandukanye y’i Burayi, Amerika na Aziya.

title: Umukecuru w’imyaka 102 arakekwaho kwica umuturanyi we
content:
Mu Bufaransa haravugwa inkuru y’umukecuru w’imyaka 102 wabaga mu nzu y’abageze mu zabukuru ahitwa Chézy-sur-Marne (Aisne) ukurikiranyweho kwica mugenzi we w’imyaka 92 bari baturanye mu cyumba. Ikinyamakuru Le Parisien dukesha iyi nkuru kivuga ko uyu nyakwigendera umurambo we wasanzwe mu ijoro ryo ku wa Gatanu ushize ushyira ku wa Gatandatu muri iyi nzu y’izabukuru, bigakekwa ko yahondaguwe n’uyu mugenzi we bari baturanye wari wagize ibibazo byo mu mutwe bimugira nk’umusazi (crise de démence).

Aya mahano yabereye mu nyubako yakira abageze mu zabukuru Umukozi w’ijoro ni we wabonye uyu nyakwigendera w’imyaka 92 yashizemo umwuka aho yasanzwe ari wenyine muri iki cyumba yari asanzwe asangiye n’uyu mugenzi we w’imyaka 102 wakurikiranwaga n’abaganga kubera ibibazo byo mu mutwe nkuko byahamijwe n’umushinjacyaha wa Repubulika ya Soissons, imwe muri komine zigize Ubufaransa. Ku wa Mbere w’iki Cyumweru, isuzuma ry’umurambo (autopsie) ryagaragaje ko nyakwigendera yazize ingumi nyinshi yatewe mu isura, kugeza ubu hakaba harimo hakorwa iperereza kugira ngo harebwe niba koko uyu muturanyi we w’imyaka 102 ari we waba waramuhuhuye.

title: Washington yabaye leta ya mbere ya Amerika yemeye ko umuntu wapfuye azajya ahindurwa ifumbire
content: Leta ya Washington yabaye iya mbere muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika yemeye ko umurambo uzajya ugirwa ifumbire. Ubusanzwe iyi leta yageneraga uburyo butatu abaturage bayo mu gihe umwe mu bo mu muryango wabo yapfuye. Muri ubwo buryo harimo: Kumushyingura (inhumation), gutwika umurambo (crémation) n’uburyo bwa gatatu bwo gukoresha tekinike zo kumubika neza akagumana isura isa nk’iyo yari afite akiriho ibyo bita mu gifaransa ’embaumement’. Kuri ubu rero Leta ya Washington yamaze kwemeza ko kuva mu mwaka utaha, kuri ubu buryo butatu bwari busanzwe haziyongeraho uburyo bwa kane bwo guhindura umurambo ifumbire ikaba yakwifashishwa n’umuryango wa nyakwigendera mu gufumbira imboga, indabo cyangwa ibiti. Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yo muri Leta ya Washington yatoye itegeko ryemerera umurambo kuba wakorwamo ifumbire ndetse abaturage biteguye gutangira gukoresha ubu  buryo buzatangira gushyirwa mu bikorwa muri Gicurasi umwaka utaha wa 2020. « Itegeko rirebana n’ibisigazwa by’umubiri » nk’uko ari ryo zina ryahawe, ryasinywe kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 21 Gicurasi 2019 na Guverineri w’iyi Leta iri mu majyaruguru y’uburengezazuba, bwana Jay Inslee. Iri tegeko ribonwa nk’irije kurengera cyangwa kubungabunga ibidukikije n’ubutaka kuko ubutaka bushyingurwaho bukomeje kugenda buba buke. Hari ikigo giherereye mu mujyi wa Seattle kimaze imyaka irenga 10 kiga kuri uyu mushinga aho cyamaze gukora igerageza ku bantu batandatu babyiyemereye, mu rwego rwo kwiga uko umubiri w’umuntu ubora. Hashingiwe ku mwanzuro w’iki kigo ifumbire yavuye mu bisigazwa by’umuntu itanga umusaruro inshuro zikubye kabiri: Mbere na mbere kuko iyi fumbire ari nziza cyane ku bwoko bwose bw’imboga n’indabyo kandi ikaba itagira impumuro mbi, ikindi ikaba ituma habaho igabanuka ry’umwuka wa CO2 w’umurambo utanga. Iki kigo gihindura ifumbire umuntu wapfuye, gihamya ko cyashyizeho uburyo ibi bizajya bikorwa  aho umubiri uzajya ushyirwa muri kontineri bita « vaisseau » yuzuye ibyatsi n’igihingwa cya luzerne aho ubukonje buzajya butuma havuka udukoko two mu bwoko bwa ’bacterie’ Nyuma y’ukwezi kumwe gusa ngo umubiri w’uwapfuye uzajya uba ushobora gusubizwa abo mu muryango we uri mu gafuka umeze nk’ibumba cyangwa itaka. Aba ngo bazajya baba bafite uburenganzira bwo kumufumbiza indabo zabo cyangwa imboga mu gihe mbere yo gupfa yemeye ko azagirwa ifumbire. Washington ibaye iya mbere muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ishyizeho ubu buryo, ikaba ije ikurikira Suède nayo yamaze gutora iri tegeko.

title: Polonye: Bwa mbere mu mateka umubyeyi yibarutse abana batandatu
content:
Umugore wo muri Polonye wari usanzwe ari umubyeyi w’umwana umwe, yabyaye abana batandatu icyarimwe ahitwa Cracovie (Kraków) mu majyepfo y’iki gihugu, ibintu bibaye bwa mbere mu mateka ya Polonye. Aba bana bavukiye mu bitaro bya kaminuza biherereye muri uyu mujyi wa Kraków kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 20 Gicurasi 2019. Kubyara abana batandutu ni ibintu bidakunze kubaho ku isi kuko biba inshuro ku mubyeyi umwe gusa mu babyeyi miliyari 4,7 babyara nkuko byagarutsweho n’umuganga wo muri Cracovie. Andrzej Duda, Perezida wa Polonye yashimiye uyu mubyeyi n’umutware we, maze abinyujije kuri konti ye ya Twitter avuga ko "ari ubwa mbere bibayeho muri Polonye."

Ubutumwa bwa Perezida bushimira abaganga n’ababyeyi baba bana Uyu mubyeyi wabyaye abazwe yibarutse abakobwa bane n’abahungu babiri aho buri wese apima hafi ikilo, bakaba bavutse ku cyumweru cya 29 (ni ukuvuga nyuma y’amezi arindwi arengaho gake). Uyu mubyeyi  ufite munsi y’imyaka 30 hamwe n’abana be bose bameze neza nkuko byemejwe n’ibitaro. Umuyobozi w’ibi bitaro yavuze ko batunguwe no kubona havutse abana batandatu kuko bari biteguye batanu. Ikipe yo muri aka gace bavukiyemo iri mu zimaze igihe kinini muri Polonye yitwa KS Cracovia kuri ubu iri ku mwanya wa kane muri shampiyona y’icyiciro cya mbere yatangaje ko aba bana izakomeza kubafatira iry’ibiryo kandi ibemereye amatike y’ubuzima bwabo bwose yo kwitabira imikino izajya iba yakiriye.

title: Video: Umwana w’imyaka 5 y’amavuko yahanutse mu igorofa ya 11 ya hoteli asinziriye, ntiyapfa
content: Uyu mwana w’umukobwa w’imyaka 5 y’amavuko urwaye indwara yo kugenda asinziriye (somnambulisme), yasimbutse urupfu mu buryo butangaje ku Cyumweru gishize nyuma yaho mu ijoro hagati abyutse, agasohoka hanze akiri mu bitotsi ariko ntiyabasha kongera kwinjira mu cyumba yarimo hamwe na se, ahera hanze. Ibi byabereye muri imwe muri hoteli iherereye mu mujyi wa Pattaya muri Thaïlande. Amashusho yafashwe na camera zo muri iyi hoteli agaragaza ko nyuma yo kugerageza kwinjira mu cyumba cye bikanga, yagerageje ibindi byumba begeranye. Nyuma yaho yamanutse ava mu igorofa ya 12 aho yari ari, ajya mu ya 11 agerageza gufungura icyuma kiri munsi y’icyabo.Acyambaye imyenda ararana (pyjama), uyu mwana yafashe umwanzuro wo kurira uruzitiro rw’ibaraza (garde-fou) ahita asimbukira hasi muri metero 30. Abakozi ba hoteli bashidutse bumvise urusaku n’induru bye bahita baza gutabara basanga umwana aryamye hasi yataye ubwenge, niko guhita bamwihutishiriza kwa muganga ku bitaro bya Bangkok i Pattaya. Se wahise akangurwa na we akajyanwa kureba umwana we kwa muganga, yatangaje ko atari azi ko umwana we arwaye indwara yo kugenda asinziriye (somnambulisme) ko we yibwiraga ko umwana we asinziriye, yamenye ko atakiryamye ari uko abakozi ba hoteli bamukanguye. Uyu mwana w’umukobwa yabashije kurokoka iyi mpanuka, ariko yakomeretse cyane ku maguru n’amaboko. Polisi yavuze ko ibi umwana yabitewe n’amatsiko no kutagira ubwoba, isaba ababeyi kujya bitondera imyitwarire y’abana babo. title: Umukobwa yagishije inama kuri Instagram yo ’gupfa no kubaho’ bamuhitiramo gupfa, arabikora
content:
Umwangavu wo mu gihugu cya Malaisie yiyahuye nyuma y’uko ashyize kuri konti ye ya instagram ubutumwa busaba abantu (sondage) kumufasha kumenya niba akwiye kubaho cyangwa gushyira iherezo ku buzima bwe, maze akaza gusanga abenshi mu batoye bamuhitiyemo urupfu. Uyu mukobwa witwaga Davia Emilia wari ufite imyaka 16 yari atuye ahitwa Kuching muri leta ya Sarawak yiyahuye mu buryo butandukanye nyuma y’uko yari yashyize kuri konti ye ya Instagram iyi ’sondage’ kuri uyu wa Mbere nkuko byemejwe n’ibinyamakuru byo muri iki gihugu ndetse bigashimangirwa na polisi. Mu butumwa yari yanditse yateruye agira ati "Ni ingenzi cyane, mumfashe guhitamo hagati ya D/L.", nkuko urubuga rwa Astro Awani rwabyanditse ngo ’D’ yari ihagarariye urupfu mu cyongereza (death) naho ’L’ yari ihagarariye ubuzima (life). 69% yabatoye batoye urupfu mu gihe 31% gusa ari bo batoye ubuzima nkuko polisi yabitangaje. Ni inkuru yavugishije benshi muri iki gihugu byatumye ushinzwe itumanaho mu gice cya Aziya yegereye inyanja ya Pasufika, Ching Yee Wong yihanganisha umuryango wa nyakwigendera anaboneraho kuvuga ko uru rubuga "rwari rufite uruhare rukomeye rwo kumenya ko abantu bakoresha Instagram biyumva batekanye kandi bashyigikiwe". Yakomeje asaba abayikoresha "kujya bahamagara serivisi zihuse z’ubutabazi mu gihe babonye ubuzima bw’umwe muri bo buri mu kaga."

title: Ubuhamya bw’umukecuru w’imyaka 95 ugitwara imodoka yaguze Ububiligi bugikoloniza u Rwanda
content:
Yvonne Abgrall yaguze imodoka ye yo mu bwoko bwa Peugeot 203 mu 1954, aho kuva ubwo kugeza ubu atigeze na rimwe ayihindura, byumvikane ko ubu hashize imyaka isaga 65 ari yo agendamo. Uyu mukecuru w’imyaka 95 y’amavuko w’Umufaransa utuye mu gace ka Calvados (Normandie), ubwo yaganiraga na Paris-Normandie yavuze ko iteka uko atwaye iyi modoka ye aba abona byateye amatsiko abantu cyane cyane abapolisi, ariko ubu akaba ahangayikishijwe nuko bashobora kumwaka uruhushya rutwara imodoka. "Buri gihe iyo nsohotse, mpagarikwa n’abapolisi. Bambaza ibyangombwa, ubundi hagakurikiraho ibibazo. Bifasha abapolisi gushira amatsiko. Buri gihe usanga hari umwe ubaza mugenzi we niba yari yarigeze abibona, bavuga ku ruhushya rwanjye rwo gutwara imodoka  (permis de conduire). Birasekeje! Imodoka yanjye yo itungura benshi kurusha n’uruhushya rwo gutwara imodoka. Ibyangombwa byose bikurikije amategeko. Inyura mu isuzuma (contrôles techniques) nta ngorane.", Yvonne Mu myaka 67 ishize nta mpanuka na nto arakora Uyu mukecuru ugenda mu modoka yaguze mu gihe ibihugu byinshi bya Afurika n’u Rwanda rurimo byari bitarabona ubwigenge ku banyaburayi babakolonizaga, avuga ko kuva yabona uruhuhya rwo gutwara imodoka mu 1952 nta mpanuka na nto yari yateza cyangwa ngo akoreshe.

Yvonne Abgrall mu modoka ye ya Peugeot 203 yaguze mu 1954 Cyakoze kuri ubu Yvonne utuye mu gace ka wenyine kitaruye umujyi ho ibirometero 12, afite impungenge ku bizamini byo kwa muganga barimo kumusaba gukora kimwe n’abandi batwara imodoka bakuze, bishobora gutuma bamwambura uru ruhushya rwe rwo gutwara imodoka bavuga ko akuze cyane. Iki cyifuzo gikunda kuzamuka akenshi iyo habaye impanuka itejwe n’umuntu ukuze, gusa uyu mukecuru we avuga ko kuba imbaraga n’ubushobozi bye byo gutekereza vuba ku cyo gukora mu gihe cy’impanuka bigenda bigabanuka uko asaza, ibi abisimbuza kuba maso cyane no kwitonda mu muhanda. Ubwo yakomozaga ku byo kuba yababazwa no kwamburwa uruhushya rwe, yagize ati "Nkoresha imodoka yanjye mu kujya guhaha, buri byumweru bibiri cyangwa bitatu, ndetse rimwe na rimwe iyo nasohotse n’inshuti zanjye. Imodoka yanjye ni ingenzi , nzabaho mbabaye mu gihe ntayifite." Icyifuzo gisaba abantu bose barengeje imyaka 70 mu Bufaransa kuba babanza gukora isuzuma ryo kwa muganga ngo harebwe niba bagifite ubushobozi bwo gutwara imodoka, ubu kirimo kugibwaho impaka muri iki gihugu nyuma yaho mu Ukwakira umwaka ushize umusaza w’imyaka 92 yagoze umugore amuca amaguru.

title: USA: Idini ya Satani yahawe uburenganzira bwo gukora byemewe n’amategeko
content:
Abayoboke b’idini ya Satani muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika barabyinira ku rukoma nyuma yo kwemerwa n’amategeko nk’idini nyuma y’imyaka myinshi basenga mu buryo butemewe. Ikigo cya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika cy’imisoro cyemeje ko iri dini ryujuje ibisabwa ngi biba ryakwemerwa nk’idini rishobora gutanga imisoro, ibitandukanye n’ishyirahamwe rifasha abantu. Ni amateka akomeye ku bayoboke b’iri dini, dore ko ari ubwa mbere ryemewe mu imbere y’amategeko. Bahamya ko bazakomeza gukora mu mujyo wo gutandukanya idini na leta ndetse bakarwanya ivangura bakorerwa n’abayoboke b’andi madini.

 Barasaba kudakorerwa ivangura n’abasenga Imana  Abasengera muri iri dini, basenga ’Lucifer’ baririmba basubiramo bati ’Ave Satan’ aho baba bambaye amahembe ya Satani, byose bakabikora batumbiriye umusaraba utukura ucuramye. Nyuma yo kwemererwa gukora mu buryo bwemewe n’amategeko, iri dini rya Satani rimo gukora ubukangurambaga bwo gukuraho ibimenyetso byo gusenga Imana ahantu hahurirwa n’abantu benshi nk’imihanda, parike n’ahandi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. title: Cote d’Ivoire: Padiri wakekagwaho gusambanya abana, yiyahuye asiga yanditse ubutumwa bwicuza
content:
Mu gitondo cyo ku wa Gatatu w’iki cyumweru ni bwo Padiri Richard Bilé w’imyaka 51 y’amavuko wari umushumba wa kiliziya muri Paruwasi ya Saint François d’Assise d’Affiénou muri diyoseze ya Grand-Bassam muri Cote d’Ivoire yasanzwe yapfuye yinaganitse mu mugozi. Ni amakuru yahamijwe n’ibiro by’itumanaho bya diyoseze mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru i Port Bouët ku mugoroba nyakwigendera yitabiyeho Imana, ku ya 24 Mata 2019 aho batangaje akababaro batewe n’urupfu rwa nyakwigendera.

Abaturage bakimara kumva urupfu rwa padiri wiyahuye baje gushungera "Muri iki gitondo, umubiri wa padiri Richard wabonywe nyuma ya missa ya mu gitondo na padiri wa paruwasi. Mu bimenyetso bihita bigaragarira amaso, Padiri ashobora kuba yiyahuye yimanitse mu mugozi.", ibyatangajwe na padiri Lambert Lath Yedo, umuyobozi w’ibiro bya diyoseze by’itumanaho. Uyu mupadiri ushinzwe itumanaho yakomeje avuga ko polisi yatangije iperereza ngo hamenyakane impamvu nyayo y’urupfu rwa nyakwigendera. Yaboneyeho gutangaza ibyaranze iminsi ya nyuma y’ubuzima bwa padiri Richard Bilé. Ati "Icyumweru kimwe mbere y’uyu munsi (yapfuyeho), Musenyeri Raymond Ahoua yari yamenyesheje uyu mushumba we ibyaha ashinjwa byo gukorera ibyamfura mbi abana. Ibyemezo biboneye byafashwe hitegurwa isozwa ry’icyumweru gitagatifu (kibanziriza Pasika)." Yakomeje asobanura ko iby’iki kibazo byari bigikurikiranwa ubwo Musenyeri Ahoua yumvaga urupfu rw’uyu mupadiri. Padiri Lambert Lath Yedo yasoje avuga ko diyeseze nyakwigendera yabarizwagamo ihamagarira abakirisitu bayo kuzirikana no gusenga cyane muri ibi bihe bibabaje basengera Kiliziya Gatolika ndetse n’umuryango we. Nkuko ibinyamakuru bitandukanye byo muri iki gihugu byabigarutseho, mu nyandiko nyakwigendera yasize yanditse asaba imbabazi abo yakoreye ibyaha bose, umuryango we, uwa kiliziya gatolika, inshuti ze n’abandi bantu batandukanye. Asaba abashumba n’abakirisitu kumusengera kandi akavuga ko yizeye ko Imana izamwakira ikamubabarira. Uyu mupadiri kandi anavuga aho yifuza gushyingurwa. Ati "Ndifuza kuba nashyingurwa I Bongouanou imbere ya kiliziya ya Mutagatifu Andereya aho nakuriye iruhande rw’imva ya padiri Alexandre. Bityo sinzabe ndi kure ya mama wanjye Marie-Cécile Tanoh. Data Pierre Kadjo ugomba gukora ibishoboka ukumvikana n’umushumba Boniface na Musenyeri Raymond Ahoua kugira ngo ibyo bikunde. Biramutse binaniranye amahitamo ya kabiri (plan B) yaba Abrobakroeigneur Dacoury Priera kuri njye."

title: Umugore yagaruye ubwenge nyuma y’imyaka 27 muri koma, ubu yatangiye gutembera no gusenga!
content:
Umugore ukomoka muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Abarabu, Mounira Abdulla yari yagize ikibazo gikomeye mu bwonko nyuma y’impanuka yagize mu 1991. Mu kiganiro umuhungu we yagiranye n’ikinyamakuru The national yahamije ko nyina yazanzamutse mu buryo bw’igitangaza. Icyo gihe ahura n’impanuka Munira Abdullah yari afite imyaka 32 y’amavuko, yari avanye ku ishuri umuhungu we w’imyaka 4 ubwo imodoka ye nto yagonganaga na bisi y’abanyeshuri (school bus). Umuhungu we Omar Webair yabashije kurokoka iyi mpanuka, ariko nyina agira ikibazo gikomeye yangirika mu bwonko. Uyu musore avuga ko nyina ubwo yabonaga imodoka ije kubagonga yagerageje kumwitangira amubumbatira mu maboko ku buryo uretse agakomere kohereje ku mutwe nta kintu yabaye. Nyina we wari urembye yoherejwe mu bitaro by’i London mu Bwongereza mbere yo gusubizwa mu gihugu cye cy’amavuko. 

Mounira Abdulla yamaze imyaka 27 muri coma Mu 2017 yajyanywe mu bitaro byo mu Budage kugira ngo yitabweho ahanini abagwe. Umwaka umwe nyuma yaho, Mounira Abdullah yavuye muri coma nkuko ubuhamya bw’umuhungu we bubyemeza. Ngo yakangutse mu buryo bugoye kubusobanura muri Gicurasi 2018, ariko umuryango we uhitamo kudatanga aya makuru kugira ngo barengere ubuzima bwite bwe. Umuhungu we yagize ati "Ntabwo nigeze ncika intege na rimwe kuri we kuko nahoraga niringiye ko umunsi umwe azakanguka. (...) Kuri njye yari nka zahabu, uko yarushagaho gutinda gukanguka niko yarushagaho kuba umunyu w’agaciro kuri njye." Uyu musore wari warahisemo guta akazi akajya kwita kuri nyina akomeza avuga ko ubwo bari Mubudage ari bwo yatangiye kubona ibimenyetso kuri nyina ko arimo yumva ariko abaganga bakamubwira ko ari intekerezo ze zirimo zimushuka. Hari n’igihe ngo yarimo ashwana cyane n’abaganga nuko nabwo nyina agasa nk’umuntu ushaka kuvuga. Umunsi umwe mu gitondo nibwo yakangutse yumva hari umuntu uri kumuhamagara, maze asanga ni nyina. Ati "Yari mama! Yarimo ahamagara izina ryanjye, numva ndi nko kuguruka kubera ibyishimo. Imyaka yose yari ishize ndota izi nzozi, izina ryanjye ni ryo jambo rya mbere yavuze"

Uretse kuganira n’umwana we ku ngingo ahisemo, ikindi Mounira agerageza kuvuga ni imirongo yo muri korowani, aha yari yatemberejwe ku musigiti wa Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque wubatswe imyaka 16 nyuma y’impanuka yatumye ajya muri koma Mounira kuri ubu ufite imyaka 60 y’amavuko ngo ari mu buzima busanzwe aho ari kwitabwaho n’abaganga muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Abarabu.

Mounira Abdulla arimo gutemberezwa ku kagare, nubwo nta mbaraga aragira, ikidashidikanywaho ni uko yagaruye ubwenge, umuhungu we ahamya ko amubyutsa akamusaba ko bafatanya gusenga Src:BBC

title: Umusore yikinishirije imbere y’umukobwa ukina imikino njyarugamba (MMA), aramukubita -Amafoto
content:
Umukobwa witwa Joyce Vieira usanzwe azwi mu mikino jyarugamba (MMA) mu gihugu cya Brazil, mu minsi micye ishize ubwo yari yibereye hamwe n’imwe mu nshuti ze ku mucaga wa Praia do Braga ahitwa Cabo Frio, hafi ya Rio de Janeiro, yahuye n’ibihe bidasanzwe aho umusore yikinishije amuhanze amaso. Ibi byabaye ubwo uyu mukobwa w’imyaka 27 y’amavuko yari mu gikorwa cyo kwifata amafoto (séance photos) yambaye umwambaro wa bikini, maze uyu musore udasanzwe, aza kumuvangira amushakiraho ibyishimo by’imibonano mpuzabitsina.

Umukobwa amaze kurakara Uyu musore ngo yatangiye kwikinisha atumbereye uyu mukobwa wari uhugiye mu kwifotoza atizigamye imbere ya camera. Ubwo yamurabukwaga, Joyce yahise asaba uyu musore guhagarika ibyo arimo ku neza nta yandi mananiza. Nyuma yaho yishe amatwi ni bwo ngo uyu mukobwa wari wiyizeye ku mbaraga yahise amwadukira aramukubita undi na we ntiyaviramo aho, amukubita ingumi. Ingumi ye yanyongereye umujinya. Numvaga namwica."

Joyce Vieira usanzwe ari indwanyi yahise akosora uyu musore Uyu mukobwa wanahise ajyana ikirego kuri polisi, yongeyeho ati "Ubwo namubonaga yari hagati mu nzira ahanyura abantu benshi harimo n’abana. Ikabutura ye yari yayimanuye kandi byagaragara ko igitsina cye cyafashe umurego(érection). Yarasakuzaga kandi aniha cyane."

Uyu mukobwa yabwiye polisi ko yegereye uyu musore amubaza ibyo arimo, undi aramwihorera Uyu musore yitwa Josenei Viana Ferreira akaba afite imyaka 26 y’amavuko, yaje guhita atabwa muri yombi ariko we ahakana ibyo ashinjwa byose akavuga ko we yarimo yihagarika.

Uyu musore yahaswe ibipfunsi ku bwo kwikinishiriza imbere y’uyu mukobwa Joyce Vieira avuga ko ibyo yakorewe n’uyu musore bitangaje kuko basanzwe banatuye mu mujyi umwe kuburyo bashobora guhurira aho ariho hose, ku bwe asaba ko hajyaho ibihano biremereye kugira ngo uyu muco ucike, anemeza ko amaze kwakira ubutumwa bwinshi bumwihanganisha bw’abagore bahuye n’ikibazo nk’iki.

title: Umuyapani yabaye umusare (navigateur) wa mbere ufite ubumuga bwo kutabona wambutse inyanja ya Pasifika
content:
Umusare w’umuyapani yabaye umuntu wa mbere ’utareba’ wabashije kwambuka adahagaze inyanja ya Pasifika yifashishije ubwato bwe, ibi akaba yabigezeho kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 20 Mata 2019 nkuko byatangajwe n’ibinyamakuru byo mu Buyapani. Mitsuhiro Iwamoto w’imyaka 52 y’amavuko, mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu ni bwo yasesekaye ku cyambu cya Fukushima (mu Buyapani) ari mu bwato bwe ’Dream Weaver’ bufite uburebure bwa metero 12, akaba yahageze nyuma y’amezi abiri ahagurutse i Californie muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.

Mitsuhiro Iwamoto yabashije kwambukiranya inyanja ya Pasufika Mitsuhiro Iwamoto, usanzwe atuye i San Diego, agace kari ku nkombe za Pasifike i Californie, yahagurutse muri uyu mujyi ku ya 24 Gashyantare 2019 ari kumwe n’umusare w’umunyamerika witwa Doug Smith wamufashije kugenda amubwira amakuru y’urugendo nk’icyerekezo cy’umuyaga n’ibindi.

Mitsuhiro Iwamoto hamwe na Doug Smith wamuherekeje Ni ku nshuro ya kabiri uyu muyapani yari agerageje uru rugendo rw’amateka. Mu myaka itandatu ishize ni bwo Mitsuhiro Iwamoto yakoze urugendo rwe rwa mbere ariko ruza gusubikirwa hagati ubwo ubwato bwe bwagonganaga na baleine bukangirika. "Ndi mu rugo, Murakoze", ijambo uyu muyapani yahereyeho avuga mu birori yari yateguriwe ubwo yageraga kuri iki cyambu cya Fukushima akoze urugendo rw’ibilometero 14 (14,000km). Mitsuhiro aganira n’Ibiro Ntaramakuru by’Abayapani, Kyodo News yagize ati "Ntabwo nigeze ncika intege none nabashije kugera ku ndoto zanjye."

Mitsuhiro Iwamoto yabashije kwambukiranya inyanja ya Pasifika atwaye ubwato ava muri Amerika agera mu Buyapani Ubwo yari afite imyaka 16 y’amavuko ni bwo Mitsuhiro Iwamoto yatakaje ubushobozi bwo kureba, ngo akaba yaratekereje gukora uru rugendo kugira ngo akusanye inkunga mu rwego rwo gushyigikira ibiorwa by’ubugiraneza birimo gufasha imbaraga z’abaganga mu guhashya indwara zitera ’ubumuga bwo kutabona’.

title: Ubufaransa: Imodoka iparitse ku rukuta rw’igorofa yateye urujijo
content:
Guhera ku itariki ya 12 Mata, 2019, abaturage bo mu mujyi wa Nantes mu Bufaransa bakomeje gutangazwa n’imodoka iparitse ku rukuta rw’igorofa. Iyi modoka itukura yo mu bwoko bwa Fiat 500 itukura, yaparitswe aha n’inzu ikora sinema yo ku muhanda Royal de Luxe, ikaba yagize iki gitekerezo igikuye ku nkuru ikunze kubwirwa abana y’uwitwa Bwana Bourgogne; ivuga uburyo uyu mugabo yakundaga gutembera, hanyuma igihe kimwe ananiwe akaza gushyira ihema rye ku rukuta rw’inzu mu gihe ategereje gukomeza urugendo rwe.

 Ni igihangano kiri mu ishusho y’imodoka  Muri iyi nkuru nshya ya Royal de Luxe, yo yagize iti "Ni inkuru y’umugenzi ushinga ihema rye ku rukuta rw’inzu. Ijoro rimugereyeho, ashakisha aho aparika imodoka ye, kugeza ku itariki ya 23 Mata. Nyuma yaho azakomeza urugendo rwe, mu ishyamba aho azaba yandika inkuru z’abana." Royal de Luxe, guhera muri 2018, igenda ikora ibihangano bitandukanye mu mihanda ya Nantes cyane cyane ibicishije mu kirere.

title: Umuherwe yapfuye agerageza kongeresha ingano y’igitsina cye
content: Umugabo w’imyaka 65 y’amavuko wari utuye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ariko afite inkomoko mu Bubiligi na Israel, yitabye Imana ubwo yarimo abagwa bagerageza kongera ingano y’igitsina cye. Ni nyuma y’uko ku wa Gatandatu ushize uyu mugabo wari usanzwe akora ubucuruzi bwa diyama, yerekeje mu bitaro biherereye i Paris mu Bufaransa aho yari agiye kongeresha uburebure bw’igitsina cye muri ibi bitaro bisanzwe bizobereye mu buvuzi bwo kubaga bagamije gusubiza itoto abagana mu za bukuru. Uyu mugabo rero wari umuherwe kubera akayabo yakuraga mu ruganda rw’ibijyanye na diyama, ntiyabashije kugera ku ntego ye ahubwo yakuyemo urupfu. Ubwo bari mu gikorwa nyirizina bamaze kumutera inshinge ku gitsina cye, ibintu byahindutse bibi, umutima urahagarara. Ikinyamakuru Le Point cyanditse ko uyu mugabo yagize ikibazo mu myanya y’ubuhumekero n’umutima. Abaganga ngo bagerageje kongera guhagurutsa umutima we ariko ntibyagira icyo bitanga nubwo bari bamaze isaha yose bakora massage ndetse banagerageza gushitura umutima we. Polisi yatangiye gukora iperereza kuri iyi operasiyo n’uburyo byakozwe dore ko ngo uyu muherwe yakiriwe akavurwa mu masaha ibi bitaro ubusanzwe biba byafungiyeho.

title: Karidinali w’igikomerezwa i Vatican yahamijwe gusambanya no gukorera ihohotera rishingiye ku gitsina abana
content:
Umukaridinali w’umunya-Australia, George Pell ufatwa nka numero ya gatatu i Vatican, yahamijwe ibyaha byo guhohotera mu buryo bw’imibonano mpuzabitsina abana b’abahungu, maze aba umuyobozi wa mbere wo ku rwego rwo hejuru muri Kiliziya Gatolika uhamijwe ibyaha nk’ibi. Ibi byahamijwe n’urukiko rwo muri Australia kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 26 Gashyantare 2019. Uru rukiko ruherereye mu mujyi wa Melbourne rwavuze ko uyu mu karidinali w’imyaka 77 y’amavuko ahamwa n’ibyaha bine yakoreye abana babiri b’imyaka hagati ya 12 na 13 y’amavuko baririmbaga muri korali, ibyaha byakorewe muri katederali ya Mutagatifu Patrick i Melbourne ahagana mu 1990.

Karidinali George Pell ubwo yasohokaga mu rukiko kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 26/02/2019 Uyu mukaridinali yabanje guhakana ibyo aregwa byose, ndetse ubushinjacyaha ntabwo bwari bwabashije kugera ku mwanzuro mu isomwa ry’urubanza rwa mbere muri Nzeri umwaka ushize. Ariko ubu byavuzwe ko yahamwe n’ibyaha by’urubanza rwa kabiri rwo ku ya 11 Ukuboza 2018. Urukiko rwa Melbourne rwari rwabanje gushyiraho amategeko abuza itangazamakuru kugira icyo rivuga kuri iki kibazo kuko rwari rugikurikirana mu mizi ibyacyo ruvuga ko abazabirengaho nabo bazakurikiranwa, ibi bikaba byari mu rwego rwo kurengera ubacamanza bwakurikiranaga urubanza rwa kabiri aho karidinali Pell yagombaga gushinjwa ku bindi byaha yakoze. Gusa urukiko rwahisemo guhagarika gukurikirana ibindi byaha, ibi byatumye kuri uyu wa Kabiri itangazamakuru rikomorerwa gutangaza iby’iki kibazo cya mbere aho uyu mukaridinali yahamwe n’ibyaha ashinjwa.

Karidinali George Pell ntiyorohewe Kugeza ubu, igihano uyu mu karidinali George Pell azahabwa ntikiratangazwa, aho biteganijwe ko kuri uyu wa Gatatu uru rubanza ruzongera gusomwa. Abunganizi mu mategeko be batangarije AFP ko nta kabuza bazitaba urukiko. George Pell, yari yafashe akaruhuko mu mirimo ye y’i Vatican kugira ngo abanze yisobanure, gusa kugeza ubu aracyari ku isonga ku rupapuro ku bunyamabanga bw’ubukungu ku cyicaro gitagatifu (Saint-Siège) bimugira umuntu wa 3 ukomeye i Vatican.

title: Uyu munyamiderikazi yagurishije ubusugi bwe mu cyamunara ngo ashimishe nyina (AMAFOTO)
content:
Mahbuba Mammadzada, umunyamiderikazi w’imyaka 23 y’amavuko wo mu gihugu cya Azerbaijan yashyize ubusugi bwe mu cyamunara. Ibi akaba yabikoze ngo atere nyina ishema. Ni icyamunara yabereye mu Budage. Mu ikorwa ryayo habanje kwerekanwa icyemezo cya muganga cyemeza ko uyu mwari ari isugi koko. Ibi byose uyu mukobwa akaba yabikoze kugira ngo ashake amafaranga azamufasha gutura muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika hamwe na nyina umubyara bakabasha kubaho neza batuye mu nzu biguriye.

 Mahbuba arashaka kwibeshaho neza akita no kuri nyina  "Ndashaka kugura inzu nzabanamo na mama kugira ngo tugire aho gutura hitwa ahacu. Ndifuza gutembera mu bice bitandukanye by’isi, gutura muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ngakomeza umwuga wanjye w’ubunyamideri."

 Ubusugi bwe bwegukanywe n’umunyapolitike wo mu Buyapani  Nubwo uyu muyapani w’umunyapolitike utatangajwe izina ari we wegukanye ubusugi bwa Mahbuba, ngo ntibyari byoroshye kuko byari byahuruje abaherwe bo mu bihugu bitandukanye harimo umunyamategeko w’Umwongereza na we wari wiyemeje gutahana iyi nkumi ndetse ngo harimo n’umukinnyi w’umupira w’amaguru ukinira ikipe ya Bayern Munich, baje bakurikiranye ku mwanya wa kabiri n’uwa gatatu, ariko bose amazina yabo akaba yagizwe ibanga.
 Mahbuba ngo ntabwo agarukiriza ku gurisha ubusugi bwe kuko ngo yamaze no gutangaza ko ubwo azagera muri USA, azashaka umugabo ukuze ufite amafaranga wifuza umukobwa ukiri muto (sugar daddy) uzajya amwitaho ubundi akamuhemba  asaga miliyoni 30 z’amanyarwanda buri kwezi. title: Ubufaransa: Mu gushyigikira abatinganyi, amagambo ‘Se’ na ‘Nyina’ yasimbujwe mu mashuri
content:
Abadepite mu gihugu cy’Ubufaransa bamaze kwemeza kuvugurura amagambo yari asanzwe akoreshwa ku byangombwa aho ’Umubyeyi 1 n’Umubyeyi2’ (Parent 1 na parent 2) bigomba gusimbura ayari asanzwe akoreshwa ’Se na nyina’ (père na mère). Ibi Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yabyemeje ku wa Kabiri w’iki cyumweru, bavuga ko ubu bugororangingo bugamije kureshyeshya ababyeyi b’ibitsina byombi by’umwihariko mu kuzuza amafishi (formulaires) yo ku ishuri aho abanyeshuri batazongera kuvuga igitsina cy’ababyeyi, ahanini mu rwego rwo kutabangamira ababyeyi b’abatinganyi.

Hagamijwe kurengera abana barerwa n’ababyeyi bahuje ibitsina Umwe mu badepite wagize uruhare muri izi mpinduka, Valérie Petit (LREM), yagize ati "Ubu bugororangingo bugamije kunoza amategeko anyuranye yo mu muryango y’abana mu mafishe buzuza ku mashuri." Uyu mudepite akomeza avuga ko umubare w’amafishe y’irangamimerere, kwiyandikisha aho bafatira amafunguro cyangwa guhabwa impushya zo gusohoka ku ishuri iteka yabaga afite ahanditse ’se’«père» na ’nyina’«mère», hatitawe ku mwanzuro w’itegeko ku gushyingiranwa kuri bose ndetse n’imiryango y’ababyeyi bahuje ibitsina (homoparentales/bagena inshingano z’uburyo barera abana babo).

Umuryango w’ababana bahuje igitsina n’umwana wabo "Dufite imiryango isa nk’iyahejwe ku bw’imibereho y’imiryango n’ingo bishaje. Uyumunsi, nta muntu ugomba kwiyumva nk’uwahejwe n’imiterere y’intekerezo yasigaye inyuma. Kuri twe, iri tegeko ni uburyo bwo kureshyeshya abantu (égalité sociale)", ibyatangajwe nundi mudepite Jennifer de Temmerman (LREM). Izi mpinduka ntizavuzweho rumwe Minisitiri w’Uburezi, Jean-Michel Blanquer, ni umwe mu batemeranijwe n’iri vugurura avuga ko ntaho impinduka zifuzwaga zihuriye n’amategeko.

Ubu umwe azajya yitwa umubyeyi 1, undi yitwe umubyeyi 2 Undi wagaragaje ko atanyuzwe ni umudepite wa LR, Xavier Breton wamaganye izi mpinduka avuga ko "rishingiye ku bitekerezo byihariye kandi bya politike bidahuye n’ukuri." Yongeyeho ati "Ubwo numvaga bavuga ko ari imyitwarire ishaje, nibutse ko ubu mu bukwe bwinshi twitabira, hejuru ya 95% baba ari umugabo n’umugore" Ku rundi ruhande, mugenzi we w’umu-socialiste, Joaquim Pueyot we yagaragaje ko abishyigikiye. Ati "Iki ni ikibazo cyo kubahwa no guhabwa agaciro...ntabwo mutekereza ingaruka mu gihe abana batiyumva ko bafashwe kimwe n’abandi."

Ku mafishe yo ku ishuri kwandikaho ’se na nyina’ byasimbujwe ’umubyeyi1 n’umubyeyi2’ Source:Le Parisien

title: Ifoto y’intare ebyiri z’ingabo zo muri Tanzaniya zahuje urugwiro, yegukanye igihembo cy’ifoto y’umwaka
content:
Gafotozi witwa David Lloyd yegukanye igihembo cya Lumix cy’ifoto nziza y’ubuzima bw’inyamaswa mu 2018, kubera ifoto yafotoye igaragaza intare ebyiri z’ingabo zahuje imitwe bigaragara ko zishimanye. Ibi byatangajwe kuri uyu wa Kane n’ingoro ndangamurage y’amateka kamere y’i London. Amafoto agera ku bihumbi 45,000 ni yo yari yoherejwe muri iri rushanwa, maze ifoto y’uyu munya Nouvelle-Zélande, David Lloyd iza ku isonga aho yatowe inshuro zigera ku bihumbi 16. "Ndishimye cyane kuko iyi foto yerekana ibyiyumvo n’amarangamutima y’inyamaswa, ikanagaragaza ko bitagirwa n’ikiremwa muntu gusa. Ndatekereza ko abantu bakwiye kubyitaho ku bw’inyungu z’inyamaswa zose.", Lloyd nyuma yo kwegukana igihembo.

Izi ntare zafotorewe muri Parike y’igihugu ya Tanzania Uyu mufotozi avuga ko akeka ko izi ntare ebyiri zishobora kuba ziva inda imwe, zikaba zarahuje imitwe amasegonda  arenga 30, iyi foto ikaba yarafatiwe muri parike ya Serengeti muri Tanzanie. Uretse iyi foto yegukanye igihembo, andi mafoto ane yaje ayikurikiye yagaragajwe, akaba azamurikwa muri iyi ngoro ndangamurage y’amateka kamere y’i London mu Bwongereza ku ya 30 Kamena 2019. Andi mafoto yaje mu myanya itanu ya mbere

title: Umunyamerikakazi yakoze ubukwe n’igipupe cy’umuzimu ’zombie’ -Amafoto
content:
Felicity Kadlec, umukobwa w’imyaka 21 y’amavuko ukomoka i Massachusetts yateguye ubukwe n’igipupe cye Kelly Rossi gifite isura iteye nk’iy’abazimu (zombie). Abagera kuri bane mu nshuti ze nibo yari yatumiye muri ibi birori hamwe n’ibindi bipupe 8 nabyo biteye gutyo.

Felicity avuga ko isi ye yuzuye nyuma yo kurushingana n’iki gipupe ahamya ko gifite imyaka 37 Uyu muhango wabereye ahitwa Tiverton, umujyi muto  uri ku nkombe z’inyanja mu Majyaruguru ashyira Uburasirazuba bwa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Muri ubu bukwe Felicity yakoresheje amafaranga hafi ibihumbi 500 y’amanyarwanda harimo ayo yishyuye ikanzu yari yambaye na kositimu y’umugeni we.

Felicity yishyingiye igipupe gifite isura ya zombie Felicity ahamya ko amaze imyaka ine yisanze mu rukundo rukomeye n’iki gipupe cye banahuje igitsina (kuko nacyo ari ikigore). Ku bwe yumva ko ubukwe bwatumye barushaho kwiyumvananamo ndetse buhamya kurushaho ibibahuza. Ati " Ubukwe bwari nta makemwa, neza neza nkuko nahoraga iteka mbitekereza. (...) Nakoze ibishoboka ngo byose bijye kumugaragaro, maze dukora ubukwe."

Ubwo bashyingiranwaga hari hari ibindi bipupe

Ubukwe bwatashye butungura benshi Ubwo yari afite imyaka 13 gusa y’amavuko ni bwo uyu mukobwa yahawe impano y’igipupe gifite isura iteye ubwoba ya ’zombie’ na se. Hagati aho se yaje gupfa maze Felicity atangira kwihebera kureba filime ziteye ubwoba (les films d’horreur) n’ibipupe byo muri ubu bwoko (zombie). Ati "Ku bwanjye aranyuze (igipupe cye), niyumva ntekanye turi kumwe kandi kamere ye ni yo ituma numva nakwishimira kumarana igihe cy’ubuzima bwanjye busigaye na we."

title: Yabuze mu 1999 ari umwana ufite imyaka 14, yongeye kuboneka ari muzima mu 2019
content:
Nyuma y’imyaka 20 ishize, Simon Lembi wari waraburiwe irengero mu 1999 ubwo yari afite imyaka 14 gusa y’amavuko, kuri ubu yangeye kuboneka ari muzima. Ni inkuru yatunguranye cyane mu  Bubiligi aho uyu yari yaraburiye, ndetse ubwo yongeraga kuboneka, parike ya Bruxelles kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 06 Gashyantare 2019 yavuze ko mu by’ukuri yari yarahunze ubuzima bugoye bwo mu muryango we gusa ubu ntihatanzwe amakuru ku buzima bwe bushya mu rwego rwo kubahiriza ubuzima bwe bwite. Yahinduye imyirondoro Simon Lembi yageze mu Bubiligi avuye muri Angola aho akomoka. Yahageze ari kumwe n’umuryango we iminsi ibarirwa mu icumi n’imisango mbere y’uko abura mu 1999. Nyina n’abana be batatu barimo uyu Simon wari imfura ye, bakigera mu Bubiligi batuye mu macumbi y’abatishoboye mu gace ka Barrière de Saint-Gilles. Hari ku wa Gatanu tariki ya 12 Ugushingo 2019 ahagana saa kumi n’imwe z’umugoroba (17h00), ubwo uyu mwana yasabaga yinginga nyina ko yajya kureba televiziyo hafi yaho bari batuye, maze agiye ntiyagaruka.

Hatanzwe amatangazo yo kumushakisha Simon Lembi yarashakishijwe arabura burundu, kugeza ubwo yongeye kuboneka ubu afite imyaka 33 y’amavuko, yaranahinduye imyirondoro ye, ndetse aba hanze y’Ububiligi. Amakuru yatanzwe n’umuntu umuzi magingo aya wakekaga ko yaba ari we Lembi wabuze Simon Lembi ngo yaje kuboneka hashingiwe ku buhamya bw’umwe mu bantu bamuzi, aho iperereza ryari rimaze igihe kinini ricecetse ryongeye gufungurwa mu Ugushyingo 2018.

Simon Lembi yabonetse nyuma y’imyaka 20 abuze Uyu muntu ngo usanzwe aba hafi ye, bivugwa ko yagerageje guhuza uwo azi ubu (wahinduye imyirondoro) n’umuhungu w’imyaka 14 y’amavuko wabuze mu 1999 witwaga Simon Lembi, maze nyuma y’uko ifoto ye nshya igaragaye babasha kumenya aho aherereye. "Mu kwezi ku Ugushyingo 2018, nibwo ishami rya polisi y’Ububiligi rishinzwe ibijyanye n’ababuriwe irengero ryahamagawe n’umuntu wavugaga ko aba hafi ya Simon Lembi, ko uyu yahinduye imyirondoro akaba asigaye aba mu kindi gihugu cy’amahanga.", Denis Goeman na Ine Van Wymeersch, abavugizi ba parike ya Bruxelles. Bakomeje bagira bati "Iri shami rya polisi rikurikirana iperereza ry’ababuriwe irengero, ryahise ritangiza ibikorwa bitandukanye by’iperereza ndetse bakorana n’abapolisi bo mu gace ka Bruxelles-Midi kugira ngo bakusanye ibimenyetso by’ingenzi (hagereranywa amafoto ye y’ubu n’aya kera, itariki naho yavukiye,...). Muri iryo perereza ni nabwo nyiri ubwite ubwo yabazwaga yaje kwiyemerera ko koko ari we Simon Lembi." Haribazwa ibibazo byinshi ariko ikizwi cyo ni uko yatorongeye kubushake, ubu akaba ameze neza Ni gute umwana w’imyaka 14 gusa y’amavuko yabashije gusohoka mu Bubiligi? Ese ni he yahise ajya gutangirira ubuzima bushya? Ibi bibazo byose kugeza ubu nta gisubizo bifite. Parike ya Bruxelles nta kintu yabivuzeho mu rwego rwo kubahiriza ubuzima bwite bw’uyu mugabo wabonetse. "Asobanura ko yiburishije abigendereye mu mpera z’umwaka w’1999, akaba yarafashe uyu mwanzuro nyuma yo kubona ko atari anyuzwe n’umwuka uri mu muryango we. Nyuma y’imyaka 20 ishize, ubu yifuza ko yaba imyirondoro ye mishya (identité actuelle) akoresha ubu, yaba aho atuye ubu, byose bitajya hanze. Ni ku bw’impamvu zo kubaha ubuzima bwe bwite. Icyo cyakoze twaba dutangaje ni uko ubu ameze neza kandi umuryango we wo mu Bubiligi wamenyeshejwe gukemura mu buryo bwiza iyi dosiye.", Umuvugizi wa parike. Uyu muvugizi wa parike, Denis Goeman yaboneyeho gutangaza ko ibi byibutsa ko dosiye z’ijyanye n’iburirwa irengero ry’abantu ari yo mpamvu zitajya zifungwa burundu kuko ’buri gihe hahora hari icyizere cy’uko uwabuze yaboneka’, ndetse ubu ngo bafite izindi dosiye esheshatu z’abana baburiwe irengero mbere y’umwaka 2000, bagikurikirana. Nubwo parike yirinze gutangaza igihugu uyu Simon Lembi yaba aherereyemo, hari bimwe mu binyamakuru byatangaje ko yaba ari mu Buholande, kimwe mu bihugu bihana imbibe n’Ububiligi, ndetse ngo ubu ari mu buzima yishimiye. Bavuga ko yakuze ari umusore witonda kandi w’imico myiza. Src:7sur7

title: Umwana w’imyaka itatu wari wabuze, yaba yarokowe n’idubu (ours) bararanye amajoro abiri mu ishyamba
content: Umwana w’imyaka itatu gusa y’amavuko w’umunyamerika wari waburiwe irengero, yabashije kuboneka nyuma yo kwihanganira amajoro abiri y’ubukonje bukomeye n’inyamaswa z’inkazi zo mu ishyamba abikesha idubu (ours) yamwikundiye ikamwitaho ikimubona. Polisi yatangaje ko uyu mwana witwa Casey Hathaway yabonywe mu bihuru mu ijoro ryo ku wa Kane w’icyumweru gishize rishyira ku wa Gatanu ubwo abari mu gikorwa cyo kumushaka bari batangiye gucika intege ndetse bateganyaga gusubika iki gikorwa kubera ikirere kitari kimeze neza. Uyu mwana w’umunyamahirwe, umuryango we uvuga ko wari witeguye kwakira inkuru mbi kubera imyaka ye micye, ubukonje bw’urubura n’imyenda idashyushye yari yambaye ubwo yaburaga, bigakubitiraho inyamaswa z’inkazi ziherereye mu mashyamba ya Caroline du Nord harimo n’amadubu y’ibara ry’ibihogo, ariko imwe muri zo y’inyamahoro niyo yaje kurokora ubuzima bw’uyu mwana nkuko na we yabyivugiye. Nubwo ataramenya kuvuga neza, Casey Hathaway yavuze ko iyi dubu (ours) yamugumye iruhande kuva yamubona, aho mu bukonje bukabije yamushyushyaga ndetse ikamurinda n’izindi nyamaswa. Ku bwe ayisobanura ’nk’inshuti ye yo mu ishyamba’. Abari mu gikorwa cyo gushaka uyu mwana bavuga ko bigoye guhamya ko uko abisobanura ariko koko byagenze cyangwa ari ibyo yishyize mu mutwe kugira ngo abashe guhangana n’ubwoba yari afite, ariko ntibahakana ko byanashoboka. Gusa uyu mwana inshuro nyinshi mu biganiro bye nyuma yo kuboneka, akomeza gusubiramo ko yibaniraga n’iyi nyamaswa, ndetse nyirasenge nawe yabyizeye atyo. Abinyujije ku rukuta rwe rwa Facebook yanditse ati "Avuga ko yamaze icyo gihe cy’iminsi ibiri ari kumwe n’idubu. Imana yamwoherereje inshuti yo kumurinda. Imana ni nziza. Ibitangaza bibaho rwose." Casey yari yabuze ku gicamunsi cyo ku wa Kabiri aburira mu ishyamba rya Caroline du Nord ahari ubukonje buri munsi ya zero muri iki gihe. Uyu mwana akaba yarimo akinana na bagenzi be mu busitani bwa nyirakuru ariko nyuma ntiyaza gutahana n’abandi bana. Kuva ubwo polisi yahise itangira kumushakisha yifashishije ibikoresho byabugenewe birimo kajugujugu, drones n’ibindi byifashishwa muri iki gikorwa ariko ntibabasha kubona irengero rye mu ijoro rya mbere ubwo basubikaga ibikorwa kubera ikirere kibi, aha bakaba baratashye bakeka ko yapfuye kubera ubukonje, imvura n’imiyaga ikomeye yari ihari. Kera kabaye mu ijoro ryo ku wa Kane rishyira ku wa Gatanu abamushakaga baje kumva arira maze bagana aho yaririraga basanga akiri muzima. Chip Hughes uhagarariye abasherifu bo muri aka gace yagize ati "Yararokotse. Abamushakaga bakomeje inzira y’ibihuru yari yarengewe n’amazi yabageraga mu mayunguyungu kugira ngo bamugereho. Yari yahagamye muri santimetero 66 uvuye ku butaka ariko yavuyemo neza uretse ibikomere byoroheje yari afite, nta kindi yasabye uretse amazi na nyina." Uyu mugabo akaba yanavuze ko aho bamusanze atari kumwe n’iyi nyamaswa uyu mwana avuga ko yamurinze. Src:7sur7

title: Umugore yafashwe n’indwara idasanzwe yo kutumva ijwi ry’abagabo
content: Mu gihugu cy’Ubushinwa haravugwa umugore wafashwe n’indwara idasanzwe imubuza kumva ijwi riremereye ry’abagabo. Mu ijoro rimwe ni bwo uyu mugore yumvise ibintu muri we bihindutse mu buryo budasanzwe. Byose byatangiye yumva isesemi n’urusaku mu matwi, maze mu gitondo cyaho yisanga atakibasha kumva ijwi ry’umugabo we. Nyuma y’uko izi mpinduka zari zimubayeho mu gihe gito zimuhangayikishije, yahise yihutira kujya kwa muganga aho yahise yitabwaho na Lin Xiaoqing, impuguke ku ndwara zo mu gutwi. "Yaranyumvaga ubwo namuvugishaga. Ariko ubwo undi musore yahageraga ntabwo yamwumvaga na gato avuga.", uyu mugangakazi aganira na Dail Mail aho yayihamirije ko uyu murwayi atabasha kumva na gato amajwi y’abagabo mu gihe abagore abumva neza. Nkuko muganga akomeza abisobanura ngo uyu mugore yaba yarahuye n’uburwayi bwihariye bwo bwo mu gutwi mu rurimi rw’igifaransa bwitwa "surdité en pente inversée" cyangwa "perte auditive en pente de ski inverse". Ibi bikaba biterwa no kugabanuka gukabije ko kubasha kumva amajwi aremereye akunze kumvikana mu miterere y’abagabo, mu gihe ijwi ryoroshye ryo rikomeza kumvikana neza, iri rika rikunze kurangwa n’abagore.

title: Brazil: Imvura y’ibitagangurirwa mu kirere cya Minas Gerais iherutse gutungura benshi (VIDEO)
content:
Ibihe by’ubushyuhe muri Brazil bikunze kurangwa n’udushya tudakunze kubaho. Mu kirere cy’ahitwa Espirito Santo do Dourado muri Leta ya Minas Gerais iherereye mu majyepfo y’iki gihugu haherutse kugaragara ibitangangurirwa byinshi cyane mu buryo bwatangaje benshi mu ntangiriro z’uku kwezi. Mu by’ukuri ngo uyu wari umugambi uhuriweho n’ibitagangurirwa byinshi wo gusohoka mu ndiri yabyo maze bikajya gufata udusimba tuzitunga (insectes) bibifatiye mu mutego w’inzira yabyo (intagangurwa/toile d’araignée). Ku mashusho yazengurutse hirya no hino, ibi bitagangurirwa bikomoka mu muryango wa Parawixia bistriata bigaragara byuzuye ikirere aho byari byakoze intagangurwa idapfa kuboneshwa amaso ya muntu.

Ibi bitagangurirwa byari byuzuye mu kirere ibindi bikanamanuka hasi "Ni amayeri yo kongera ubuso bugahije kugira ngo bifate ibiryo byabyo by’umwihariko udusimba tuguruka (insectes)", Thaiz Moreira inzobere mu buzima bw’ibinyabuzima aganira na kimwe mu binyamakuru byo muri Brazil. Joao Pedro Martinelli Fonseca, umuturage wo muri aka gace ni we wafashe aya mashusho arayasakaza ubwo yari kumwe n’ababyeyi be berekeza ku isambu ya sekuru, maze ngo abona ibi bitagangurirwa mu kirere, ibintu byamutunguye bikanamutera ubwoba cyane dore ko kimwe mu bitagangurirwa cyanahanutse mu modoka ye kinyuze mu idirishya ryari rifunguye. Gusa inzobere zimeza ko ibi bitangangurirwa bya parawixia bistriata nta ngaruka mbi biteza ubuzima bw’ikiremwa muntu. Reba amashusho magufi agaragaza uko ibi bitagangurirwa byagaragaraga Src:7sur7

title: Malaisie: Ibyihariye ku rukundo rw’Umwami uheruka guhara ingoma, akihitiramo ’Miss Moscow’ wasambanye (Amafoto)
content:
Ku Cyumweru tariki ya 06 Mutarama 2019 ni bwo uwari umwami wa Malaisie, Muhammad V yeguye mu buryo butunguranye, ibi bikaba byaraje nyuma y’igihe gito ashyingiranywe na Miss Oksana Voevodina wabaye nyampinga w’umurwa mukuru w’u Burusiya, Moscow mu 2015. Ni ku nshuro ya mbere mu mateka y’iki gihugu Umwami yegura kuva cyabona ubwigenge ku Bwongereza mu 1957. Ubusanzwe Umwami muri Malaisie amara imyaka itanu akabona gusimburwa, uyu Sultan Muhammad V yari yaratowe mu Ukuboza 2016 akaba yagombaga kuzatanga ingoma mu 2021.

Umwami wa 15 wa Malaisie, Muhammad V uheruka kwegura bigakekwa ko bifitanye isano n’ubukwe bwe na Miss Oksana Voevodina Nta mpamvu n’imwe yigeze ishyirwa ahagaragara n’ubu Bwami yaba yatumye habaho kwegura kwa Muhammad V w’imyaka 49 y’amavuko akaba umwe mu bari bimye ingoma akiri muto. Gusa hari hashize ibyumweru byinshi atagaragara ndetse iminsi ye ya nyuma yaranzwe n’ibihuha byinshi byazamuwe n’ubukwe bwe bw’ibanga na Miss Moscow, Oksana Voevodina w’imyaka 25 y’amavuko.

Ubukwe bw’uyu mwami na Nyampinga bwabereye i Moscow mu Burusiya mu birori by’akataraboneka Uyu Nyampinga mu bihe byashize yagaragaraga muri kimwe mu biganiro mpamo (téléréalité) aho yaje no kugirana imibonano mpuzabitsina n’umwe mu bagaragaraga muri iki kiganiro ubwo bari muri pisine. 

Ubwo Miss Oksana Voevodina yagaragaraga kuri televiziyo yishimana n’umwe mu basore bakoranaga ’Reality TV show’ Bivugwa ko muri Mata 2018 ubwo biteguraga ubu bukwe, Miss Oksana Voevodina yabanje guhindura idini aba umuyoboke wa Islam dore ko uyu mwami uretse kuba yari umuyoboke w’iri dini, yanayoboraga igihugu kigendera ahanini ku mahame n’imyemerere y’iri dini.

Mu bukwe bwabo ngo nta nzoga zarimo kandi ibiryo byose byari ’halal’ Mu Ugushyingo 2018 ni bwo Umwami Muhammad V yari yatse ikiruhuko (congé) cy’amezi abiri bivugwa ko ari ukugira ngo yivuze. Nyuma gato mu mpera z’uko kwezi ni bwo ibinyamakuru byo mu Bwongereza nka DailyMail ndetse n’ibyo mu Burusiya byasohoye inkuru ivuga ko ibyari ibirori byahindutse ubukwe hagati y’uyu mwami n’uyu mukobwa wahize ubwiza Abarusiyakazi bose b’i Moscow mu 2015. 

Umwami Muhammad V wari wimye ingoma asimbura se, yeguye nyuma y’igihe gito arushinze na Miss Moscow 2015, Oksana Voevodina

Umwami yahisemo Nyampinga, ibindi abishyira ku ruhande

Nyuma yo kwinjira muri Islam ngo Miss Oksana Voevodina asigaye yitwa Rihana Oxana Gorbatenko Ubusanzwe Umwami muri Malaisie arubashywe cyane muri iki gihugu ku buryo bibujijwe kumuseka cyangwa kumuvuga nabi, bityo kuba yavuyeho bikaba bifatwa nko kuruhura abaturage benshi batafashe neza iby’ubu bukwe n’uyu mukobwa udafite ahahise heza, nubwo yaba Umwami ubwe ndetse n’Ubwami muri rusange nta numwe wagize icyo abivugaho. 

Uyu mwami nta hantu na hamwe yigeze asobanura uburyo yahuye n’uyu Nyampinga arusha imyaka 24 y’amavuko

Imwe mu mafoto bafotowe ku munsi w’ubukwe bwabo

Uretse kuba yarambaye ikamba rya Nyampinga wa Moscow mu 2015, nta byinshi bizwi ku makuru yerekeye ubuzima bwite bwa Oksana Voevodina

Bamwe mu banya-Malaisie ntabwo bakiriye neza uyu mugore w’uwari umwami wabo

Nyina nawe yahataniye ikamba ry’ubwiza mu gace yakomokagamo ka Penza nyuma gato y’isenyuka rya Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Abasoviyete mu 1990

Ibinyamakuru byo muri Malaisie bivuga ko yinjiye muri Islam ku ya 16 Mata 2018

Miss Oksana Voevodina ntibizwi niba haba hari undi mugabo yigeze, yavugaga ko akunda ibijyanye n’imideri ndetse mu bihe bishize yabikoreraga mu Bushinwa na Thailand

Ifoto yafotowe ku ya 17 Nyakanga 2018 ubwo Umwami Muhammad V (iburyo) yiteguraga kuvuga ijambo rifungura umuhango w’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko i Kuala Lumpur, aha ari kumwe na Minisitiri w’intebe w’iki gihugu Mahathir Mohamad (ibumoso) Muri Malaisie, Umwami uretse kuyobora imihango yo ku rwego rw’igihugu ni na we muyobozi w’ikirenga w’Ingabo, akanaba Umuyobozi w’icyubahiro w’idini ya Islam. Amafoto ye uyasanga ahahurira abantu benshi mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu. Biteganijwe ko umwami mushya ugomba gusimbura uyu, azatorwa ku ya 24 Mutarama 2019 maze yime ingoma icyumweru kimwe nyuma yaho. Umwami atorwa mu bagize umuryango w’ibwami uyobora leta 9 muri 13 zigize iki gihugu. Bakaba basimburana buri nyuma y’imyaka itanu.

title: Nyarugenge: Umusore akurikiranyweho gusambanya abana bo mu muhanda bahuje igitsina
content: Inzego z’umutekano mu Karere ka Nyarugenge zafashe umusore w’imyaka 25 ushinjwa gusambanya ku gahato abana bo mu muhanda bahuje igitsina. Nkuko ikinyamakuru Igihe dukesha iyi nkuru cyabyanditse, uyu musore ukomoka mu Karere ka Huye yafashwe mu ijoro ryo ku wa Gatandatu tariki ya 5 Mutarama 2019, bigizwemo uruhare n’urwego rwunganira uturere mu gucunga umutekano, DASSO, mu Karere ka Nyarugenge. Ifatwa rye ryakurikiye ubusabe bw’abana b’abahungu bo mu mihanda muri ako karere, bavugaga ko bahangayikishijwe n’ubuzima bwabo biturutse ku buryo uwo musore abasambanya nta n’agakingirizo akoresheje. Umwe muri bo yabwiye IGIHE ati “Adufata ku ngufu, abanza akagushukisha utundi tuntu na kore, ugashiduka yamaze kukwambura ikabutura, ukabyemera kugira ngo atagukomeretsa.” Uwo musore ariko yavuze ko ingeso yo gusambanya bagenzi be bahuje igitsina yayicitseho, nyuma yo kugirwa inama na bagenzi be. Ati “Narabikoraga gusa bagenzi banjye twaricaye bangira inama bambwira ko ibyo bintu atari byiza ngomba kubyihana kuko ari ingeso mbi, mpitamo ku bireka.” Yavuze ko yiteguye gutungira agatoki inzego bireba abandi bantu basambanya abana bo mu muhanda. Itegeko risobanura gusambanya umwana nko gushyira igitsina mu gitsina, mu kibuno cyangwa mu kanwa k’umwana; gushyira urugingo urwo arirwo rwose rw’umubiri w’umuntu mu gitsina, cyangwa mu kibuno cy’umwana no gukora ikindi gikorwa cyose ku mubiri w’umwana hagamijwe ishimishamubiri. Ubihamijwe n’urukiko ahanishwa igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka 20 ariko kitarenze imyaka 25. Iyo gusambanya umwana byakorewe ku mwana uri munsi y’imyaka cumi n’ine 14, igihano kiba igifungo cya burundu kidashobora kugabanywa kubera impamvu nyoroshyacyaha.

title: Ububiligi: Umuganga yakatiwe gufungwa imyaka 8 azira gusambanya umwuzukuru we w’amezi 5
content: Umuganga w’imyaka 61 y’amavuko yakatiwe gufungwa imyaka 8 nyuma y’uko urukiko rw’i Liège mu Bubiligi rumuhamije icyaha cyo guhohotera umwuzukuru we w’amezi atanu gusa y’amavuko akamusambanya. Ni icyaha cyakozwe ku mugoroba wo ku ya 04 Gashyantare 2017 ubwo uyu musaza yasabaga ababyeyi b’uyu mwana kuba bamumuhaye akamwitaho maze birangira ahohoteye umwuzukuru we. Uyu musaza usanzwe ari umuganga yabanje guhakana ibyo ashinjwa avuga ko ibikomere umwana afite bifitanye isano n’ibibazo by’igogora, mbere y’uko yemera ko yakoresheje intoki yinjira mu gitsina cy’urwo ruhinja (pénétration digitale). Impamvu ebyiri zitanyuze ababyeyi ndetse n’inkiko kubera uturemangingo (ADN) twabonetse ku gitsina cy’uwahohotewe. Uyu musaza wangije umwuzukuru we, ngo yari amaze imyaka myinshi akunda gusura imbuga z’amashusho y’ubusambanyi hagati y’abakuze n’abato (pédopornographiques), gusa ngo mu bamukikije ntibyigeze bituma hari uhita amukekaho ko yagira iyo myitwarire. Ubu yamaze gukatirwa imyaka 8 ari mu gihome n’indi 10 azamara akurikiranwa n’inkiko ku myitwarire ye.
