title: Kigali: Camera zerekanye abagore bari kwiba inzoga mu iguriro bakazihisha mu makariso (Video)
content:
Camera zicunga umutekano mu iguriro ‘Supermarket’ yitwa Sagacité iherereye mu Mujyi wa Kigali rwagati, zagaragaje abagore babiri bibyemo ibicuruzwa birimo inzoga zihenze bakazihisha mu makariso. Mu mpera z’Ukwakira nibwo aba bagore bagaragajwe n’izi camera z’iri guriro riherereye munsi y’Umurenge wa Nyarugenge. Aba bagore ngo binjiye muri iri guriro mu gitondo bigize nk’abaguzi, batangira kujijisha uwari urimo gucuruza bamubaza ibiciro by’ibicuruzwa bitandukanye biri muri iri duka kugira ngo babone uko bamwiba.

Ubwo uwa mbere yibaga Amashusho yerekana ko nyuma y’umwanya muto umwe yahise azenguruka nk’uri gushaka ibyo agura, mugenzi we asigara ajijisha uwacuruzaga, ku buryo ari bwo yaje kugera ahari inzoga zihenze ahita afata icupa rya Handas rigura ibihumbi 70 Frw, arihisha mu ikariso yambaye. Arangije yahise asubira aho uwo mucuruzi aba yicaye maze uwo bari kumwe na we ahita agenda asa nk’uri kureba icyo agura, ahita afata icupa ry’inzoga ya Martins igura ibihumbi 56 Frw, arihisha mu ikariso.

Uwa kabiri nawe yaciye mu rihumye umucuruzi aba abatuye inzoga ahisha mu ikariso Nyir’iguriro Bagaragaza Maurice, yabwiye IGIHE ko bakibura izo nzoga yaketse ko ari abakozi be bazibye. Yagize ati “Baje mu gitondo bajijisha bigize nk’abakiriya noneho umwe ajijisha umukozi bahasanze akajya kumwereka ibicuruzwa amubaza ibiciro, undi ajya kwiba inzoga azihisha hagati y’amaguru nyuma arangije yaragarutsena mugenzi we ajya kwiba indi.” Akomeza avuga ko ku munsi ukurikira ari bwo bagenzuye ibyo camera zafashe zibereka amashusho y’uburyo abo bagore babibye inzoga bakazishyira mu makariso bari bambaye. Yongeyeho ko ababonye amashusho y’aba bagore bavuze ko batunzwe no kwiba muri za Supermarket zitandukanye ndetse ko yahise ashyikiriza ikirego cye Urwego rw’Ubugenzacyaha (RIB) kugira ngo bazafatwe. Reba hano hasi uburyo aba bagore bibye izi nzoga Umuvugizi w’Urwego rw’Ubugenzacyaha, Mbabazi Modeste, yemeza ko ikirego cy’uyu mucuruzi cyakiriwe ndetse anamushishikariza gutanga amakuru y’aho abo bagore baba bari kugira ngo bazafatwe. Yagize ati “Nibyo ikirego cye kirahari ariko yanasabwe amakuru y’aho abo bagore baboneka kuko agomba gufasha urwego rubishinzwe kugira ngo narwo rumufashe kubafata.” Yongeyeho ko izi Camera zicunga umutekano zijya zifasha inzego z’umutekano kuko zerekana uko ibyaha byagiye bikorwa. Inkuru ya IGIHE

title: Yiyemeye kuri bagenzi be bituma amarana umwaka ikiyiko mu muhogo
content:
Umushinwa w’imyaka 25 witwa Zhang yamaze umwaka wose afite ikiyiko mu muhogo nyuma yo gutsindwa intego yari yateze n’inshuti ze. Uyu musore wari wasinze, yiyemeye kuri bagenzi be basangiraga ababwira ko ashobora kumira ikiyiko cyose hanyuma akongera akagicira akoresheje umugozi uziritse mu mayunguyungu. Mu buryo butangaje, uyu musore yabashije kumira iki kiyiko ariko mu kukiruka biba ibibazo, ikiyiko kiguma mu muhogo aho cyamaze umwaka wose, dore ko uyu musore yari yiyemeje kutajya kwa muganga ngo kuko kitamubuzaga kunywa cyangwa kurya.

Iki nicyo kiyiko yari yaramize Mu gihe cy’umwaka wose, Zhang yawumaze abayeho afite iki kiyiko mu muhogo, kugeza ubwo yatangiye kugira ibibazo byo guhumeka ari nabyo byamujyanye kwa muganga. Muganga we Yu Xiwu yatangaje ko yamaze amasaha 2 amubaga anahamya ko ari ubwa mbere yari ahuye n’umurwayi nka Zhang. Ati "Naratunguwe cyane, sinari narigeze mbona ibintu nk’ibi. Nizeye ko yahakuye isomo" Iki kiyiko cya santimetero 20 cyarabazwe hanyuma uyu musore ava mu bitaro nyuma y’iminsi 2.

title: Roma: Ku butaka bwa Vatican hasanzwe ibisigazwa by’imibiri
content:
Ibisigazwa by’imibiri byabonywe ku butaka bwa Vatican i Roma, ndetse ibi bishobora gutuma polisi y’Ubutaliyani isubukura iperereza ku bantu babiri babuze mu buryo budasobanutse mu 1983. Ni amakuru yatangajwe kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 30 Ukwakira 2018 n’iki cyicaro gikuru gitagatifu cya Kiliziya Gatolika. Mu itangazo bashyize hanze bagize bati "Ubwo hakorwaga imirimo yo kuvugurura inzu y’ambasade ya Vatican mu Butaliyani, havumbuwe ibice by’amagufwa y’abantu.", Polisi yo mu Butaliyani yahise imenyeshwa, ndetse iperereza rigiye gutangira kugira ngo hamenyekane imyaka, igitsina ndetse n’igihe aba bantu baba barapfiriye. Abazakora iri perereza bazaba bareba by’umwihariko niba ADN y’ibi bisigarizwa by’imibiri byaba bihuye na Emanuela Orlandi cyangwa Mirella Gregori, abana babiri babuze mu bihe bitandukanye i Roma mu 1983.

Ibyapa bigaragaza aba bana bombi babuze bafite imyaka 15 y’amavuko Emanuela Orlandi, wari umukobwa w’umwe mu bapolisi b’i Vatican yabonywe bwa nyuma ku ya 22 Kamena 1983 ubwo yari avuye kwiga isomo ry’umuziki.  

Ibyapa bigaragaza Emanuela Orlandi, ubwo basaba ko Vatican yavuga irengero rye mu 2012 mu isengesho rya Papa Benedigito XVI Hari bamwe bavuga ko uyu mwana w’umukobwa wari ufite imyaka 15 y’amavuko yaba yarashimuswe n’agatsiko k’abagizi ba nabi bashakaga gushyira igitutu ku bayobozi b’i Vatican kugira ngo bahanagurweho umwenda w’amafaranga, abandi bakavuga ko yaba yarashimuswe kugira ngo harekurwe Mehmet Ali Agca, umunya-Turikiya wagerageje guhitana Papa Yohani Pawulo II mu 1981.

Ku ya 22/06/2014 kuri Saint Peter’s Square ubwo abiyerekanaga bibukaga imyaka 30 ishize Emanuela Orlandi aburiwe irengero Musaza we Pietro, umaze imyaka myinshi myinshi atangije ubukangurambaga bugamije gukurikirana iby’aya mayobera mu irengero rye, yanenze Vatican kuba yararuciye ikarumira ndetse n’uruhare ifite muri iki kibazo. Ku ruhande rwa Vatican yo yakunze kuvuga inshuro nyinshi ko yakoranye uko bikwiye na Polisi yo mu Butaliyani kuri iki kibazo. Mirella Gregori we yabuze iminsi 40 mbere y’uko Emanuela Orlandi abura. Nyina w’uyu mwana w’umukobwa we avuga ko umwana we yasubizaga telefone avuga ko ari kumwe na mugenzi we bigana ko hari ibyo yagiye kumuganiriza mbere y’uko ataha, ariko kuva ubwo ntiyongeye kuboneka. title: Ubuyapani: Igikomangomakazi cyemeye gusezera umuryango wa cyami kubera urukundo
content:
Ayako w’imyaka 28 y’amavuko yasezeye burundu ku kuba Igikomangoma kizaragwa ingoma kubera urukundo. Nk’uko itegeko ry’ubwami bw’Ubuyapani ryashyizweho muri 1947 ribivuga, abagore bo mu muryango w’i Bwami bashakana n’umugabo utari uwo mu muryango w’i Bwami, bahita basezera ku burenganzira bwabo bwo kuba abaragwa b’ingoma. Kuri uyu wa Mbere, Igikomangomakazi Ayako wa Takamado, umukobwa wa Nyakwigendera Igikomangoma Norihito ndetse akaba n’umwishywa w’umwami Akihito w’Ubuyapani, yiyemeje gushyira hasi izi nshingano ashakana na Kei Moria, umucuruzi w’imyaka 32.

 Yashakanye n’umugabo udafite inkomoko i Bwami  Ni ubukwe bwabereye i Tokyo, Ayako akaba avuga ko asanga ari amahirwe agize kuko ashatse uwo yakunze ndetse akaba avuga ko nubwo atakiri mu muryango wa cyami, azakomeza kubaha ubufasha. Ati "Nishimiye cyane amahirwe mfite. Kuri uyu munsi ndava mu muryango wa cyami ariko nzakomeza guha ubufasha bwanjye abo mu muryango wawo." Umugabo we na we wagaragazaga umunezero mwinshi cyane yatangaje ko yiteguye gufatanya n’umugore we "kubaka, agatoki mukandi. Umuryango unezerewe uzahorana ibitwenge."

 Biyemeje gutangira umuryango wabo  Si Igikomangomakazi  Ayako wa Takamado wenyine ukoze ibi kandi, kuko n’ Igikomangomakazi Mako wa Akishino na we azashyingiranwa n’udafite amaraso y’i Bwami muri 2020, bityo na we agasezera ku murage w’i Bwami. Nyuma yo gusezera mu muryango w’i Bwami bazahabwa amafaranga asaga miliyoni 829 mu manyarwanda. Nubwo ibi bikorwa n’abakobwa ariko, ku bagabo ho siko bigenda kuko  bo bemerewe gushaka abakobwa badafite amaraso ya cyami.

title: Inyoni ebyiri z’ingabo zo mu bwoko bwa pingouins zabyaranye
content:
Sphen na Magic, inyoni ebyiri zo mu bwoko bwa pingouins zombi z’ingabo ziba muri Aquarium (ahaba inyamaswa zo mu mazi) i Sydney muri Australia zabyaranye icyana ku ya 19 Ukwakira, 2018 ndetse zikomeje gufatanya kumwitaho. Izi pingouins zombi zagaragaje kera ko zakundanye kandi zombi ari ingabo, dore ko zahoranaga ahantu hose n’igihe cyose. Nyuma baje gutungurwa no kubona zirimo gufatanya kubaka icyari ndetse abita ku nyamaswa ziba muri iyi  Aquarium  baziha igi ripfuye barebe ko zizabasha kuryitaho.

 Byombi ni ibigabo ariko byahisemo gushakana no gukora umuryango  Sphen na Magic zerekanye ko zibasha kuba ababyeyi ndetse rwose ko zibyishimiye, ibi bituma baziha igi rizima ryatewe n’ingore, zirarirarira neza maze ku ya 19 Ukwakira, 2018 rivamo icyana cyazo, zifatanya kurera mu buryo butangaje. Hannan Tish umuyobozi wa Aquarium zibamo, yagize ati "Buri imwe imenya ijwi ry’iyindi, kandi ubusanzwe pingouins zikundana cyangwa twakita ko zashakanye nizo zonyine zibasha kubonana mu gihe zaburanye zikoresheje amajwi."

 Zafatanyije kukitaho kakiri akagi none kavutse, zivatanya no kukarera  Ubusanzwe pingouins zabyaranye zifatanya kurera umwana mu buryo bungana. Hannan yagize ati "Ntabwo hari itandukaniro rinini hagati y’ingabo n’ingore mu kurera. Bijya bibaho ko habaho ibigabo cyangwa ibigore bifatanya, bikabyarana, bikanarerana ibyana byazo, nubwo bidakunze kubaho."

title: WARI UZI KO: Hari hashize imyaka 25 nta weekendi yihirika New York hatarashwe isasu? Ibi byabaye...
content: Umujyi wa New York wagize ’weekend’ idasanzwe aho nyuma y’imyaka 25 ishize ari ubwa mbere weekend irangiye nta sasu rirashwe cyangwa ngo hagire uwiyahura, ibi bikaba byarabashije kubaho muri weekendi ishize yo ku ya 12 na 14 Ukwakira 2018. Nkuko ishami rya Polisi yo muri uyu mujyi (NYPD) ryabitangaje mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru, bavuze ko ari ibintu by’imbonekarimwe ndetse byo kwishimira. "Kuva kuwa Gatanu, Kuwa Gatandatu, ku Cyumweru byarangiye nta sasu(nta muntu wishwe n’amasasu), nta n’uwiyahuye. Ni ubwa mbere  mu myaka mirongo kandi ni ibintu bidateye ishema gusa polisi ya New York ahubwo n’abaturage muri rusange ba New York", James O’Neill umuyobozi wa NYPD aganira n’itangazamakuru. Weekend ishize nta sasu rirashwe i New York byaherukaga kubaho mu 1993 nkuko Polisi yo muri uyu mujyi utuwe n’abaturage miliyoni 8,5 ibitangaza. Ibi kandi ni n’ibintu byishimiwe na Meya w’uyu mujyi, umu-Demokarate, Bill de Blasio. Isasu rya nyuma ryumvikanye ku gicamunsi cyo ku wa Kane ubwo umugabo wari utwaye imodoka ya Nissan y’umukara yarasaga undi mu gace ka Brooklyn ahagana saa cyenda na 37 ku isaha ngengamasaha (15H37 GMT) maze agahunga. Kuva icyo gihe nta rindi sasu ryongeye kumvikana kugeza ku wa Mbere ku isaha ya saa saba na 15 (13h15) ubwo umugabo w’imyaka 27 yaraswaga isasu mu kuguru mu gace ka Bronx. Umubare w’amasasu yumvikana muri uyu mujyi w’ubucuruzi wa New York wagiye ugabanuka muri ibi bihe bya vuba: Ku ya 07 Ukwakira 2018, abantu bagera kuri 600 nibo babaruwe ko bagiye bisanga bafashwe n’isasu kuva mu ntangiriro z’umwaka, bivuze ko habayeho igabanuka rya 1,1% ugereranije n’umwaka wa 2017. Nyamara ariko nubwo iri gabanuka rito ryabayeho ntibibujije ko ibihe bya weekend bihora byitezweho kubona ingaruka z’amasasu ndetse hakaba weekendi ziba ziteye ubwoba cyane,  nkuko M.Monahan aherutse kubigarukaho akomoza kuri weekendi yo ku ya 06 na 07 Ukwakira ahumvikanye amasasu menshi i Brooklyn na Bronx nubwo atatangaje imibare nyayo. Ikindi nuko umubare wabapfa bazize amasasu nawo wagabanutse, aho mu 2017 bari 292, ibintu byaherukaga mu mwaka wa 1950, kandi uyu mwaka nawo wa 2018 abicwa n’amasasu bashobora kugabanuka. Mu mezi atandatu ya mbere y’umwaka wa 2018, umujyi wa New York wari ufite abantu 147 bari bamaze kwicwa n’amasasu, bivuga ko hari habayeho igabanuka rya 8% ugereranije nuko byari byifashe icyo gihe mu 2017, abenshi mu bapfuye bakaba ari abaruriwe Brooklyn na Bronx. Source:7sur7

title: Ububiligi: Ukina filime z’ubusambanyi ari kwiyamamaza mu matora y’Intara
content:
Christian Sinclair ni uwa 8 kuri lisite y’ishyaka rya DéFi mu ntara ya Liège, uyu kandi akaba ari n’umukinnyi wa filime z’ubusambanyi (porno) utarabigize umwuga (amateur) ibi ndetse ntabwo abihisha. Christian Sinclair watunguranye muri aya matora, afite intero (slogan) igira iti "Christian Sinclair, umukinnyi w’impinduka". Uyu mukinnnyi wa politike akanaba umukinnyi wa ’porno’ nkuko arimo kwitwa n’ibinyamakuru by’i Liège. Ishusho idasanzwe y’umuntu wiyamamariza ubuyobozi. Ku myaka 43, uyu mugabo azwi nk’umuntu ukora ibintu byinshi bitandukanye aho yagaragaye muri filime "Le Gamin au vélo" y’abavandimwe Dardenne, ndetse yandika n’imivugo mu masaha ye y’ikiruhuko, by’akarusho yinjiye mu bya filime z’ubusambanyi aho amaze imyaka 20 muri izo nzira ndetse mu 2011 yatangiye gukora bene izi filime, ndetse akaba yemeza ko amaze kugaragara mu zirenga esheshatu.

Christian Sinclair ntatewe ipfunwe no kuba akora mu ruganda rwa filime z’ubusambanyi Christian Sinclair, uhamya ko aganira na Marc Dorcel hamwe na Jacquie na Michel, abantu bazwi cyane mu ruganda rwa filime z’ubusambanyi, avuga ko atewe ishema no guhagararira ’igice benshi bafata nk’igisuzuguritse cyangwa urukozasoni’. Nubwo ku ikubitiro, kandidature ye yari yakuruye impaka mu ishyaka rya DéFi, nyuma ntabwo bigeze bamubuza guhisha ibikorwa bye. Iyo agerageje guhuza uyu mwuga we hamwe na politike n’ibikorwa bye byo kwiyamamaza, Christian Sinclair avuga ko azagerageza gukumira indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina ndetse no kuringaniza imishahara hagati y’abagabo n’abagore. Ati "Kubera ko muri porno(filime z’ubusambanyi) ni ikinyuranyo: Abagore ni bo bahembwa neza kurusha abagabo." Src:7sur7

title: Nyamirambo: Umukobwa yabuze amafaranga yo kwishyura umumotari amuvanamo inkweto (Amafoto)
content:
Umukobwa utuye i Nyamirambo mu Karere ka Nyarugenge utunzwe no kwicuruza, yateze moto abura amafaranga yo kwishyura umumotari, bimuviramo gukurwamo inkweto mu ruhame. Nkuko iyi nkuru dukesha IGIHE, ibivuga ngo ibi byabaye mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 9 Ukwakira 2018 ubwo uyu mukobwa bivugwa ko yari yanasinze yashungerewe ahitwa kuri 40 i Nyamirambo, nyuma yo kubura amafaranga yo kwishyura umumotari.

Uyu mukobwa yambuwe inkweto nyuma yo kubura ayo kwishyura Umunyamakuru wa IGIHE avuga ko abamubonye bavuze ko yasuye umuhungu ku Kacyiru mu Karere ka Gasabo bagasangira inzoga bakanaryamana, yajya gutaha ntamuhe amafaranga ku buryo yabuze ayo yishyura moto yateze. Bageze i Nyamirambo, umumotari yavuze ko uyu mukobwa ari umutekamitwe ahita afatira inkweto yari yambaye. Bivugwa ko yagombaga kumwishyura 800 Frw.

Abantu benshi bari bashungereye ubwo ibi byabaga Gusa icyatangaje benshi ni uko ubwo yakurwagamo inkweto, uwo mukobwa yashatse no gukuramo ipantalo ngo nayo ayihe uwo mumotari. Uwitwa Byukusenge Emmanuel wari uhari agize ati “Twatangajwe n’uburyo bamukuyemo inkweto noneho agashaka no kwambura ipantalo ngo nayo ayitange ngo asigare yambaye ubusa.”
 Abari bamushungereye ngo nibo bahise bitambika bamubuza kwiyambura imyenda. Umumotari wari umutwaye, we avuga ko yabikoze kugira ngo ataviramo aho. Yabwiye uwo mukobwa ati “Ndazitwaye nimbona uzazigura nzazigurisha kuko sinakwemera ko mpomba lisansi nakoresheje mva Kacyiru kuko si ubwa mbere abantu b’i Nyamirambo bashaka ko mbatwarira ubuntu.”

Uyu mukobwa ngo yari yanasinze Si ubwa mbere hagaragaye cyangwa humvikanye ingeso y’abantu batega moto bagera iyo bajya bagashaka kugenda batishyuye, ku buryo ibi byatumye hari n’abo abamotari bishyuza mbere bitewe n’aho bagiye.

title: Bakoresheje intanga z’umwana wabo wapfuye ngo babone umwuzukuru
content: Umuryango umwe wo mu gihugu w’Ubwongereza wakoresheje intanga z’umwana wabo wapfuye, mu rwego rwo kubyara umwuzukuru wabo uzaba umuragwa w’umuryango. Uyu muryango wagizwe ibanga wapfushije umwana umwe rukumbi bari bafite azize impanuka ya moto ubwo yari afite imyaka 26 y’amavuko. Nyuma y’iminsi 2 yitabye Imana, nibwo babonye umurambo we maze bahita bafata umwanzuro wo gukonjesha intanga z’uyu mwana wabo kugira ngo bazabashe kubona umwuzukuru wabo. Nubwo ibi bibujijwe mu Bwongereza mu gihe uwapfuye atasize abyisabiye, uyu muryango warabyirengagije maze ufata izi ntanga uzohereza muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ku muganga w’inzobere mubyerekeye urubyaro witwa David Smotrich, habikwa izi ntanga ndetse n’umwana aba ariho avukira abona koherezwa mu Bwongereza. Uyu muganga aganira na Mail on Sunday yavuze amabwiriza bamuhaye, arimo no kuba barashakaga umuhungu ndetse uteye nk’uko babishaka birimo no guhaka umukobwa ukwiriye. Yagize ati "Uyu muryango washakaga umugore umwana wabo yashoboraga kuba yakunda kugira ngo havuke umwana nk’uwo yashoboraga kubyara kandi w’umuhungu." Dr Smotrich n’itsinda ry’abaganga bakorana bakoze uko bashoboye bakora amagi 4 ariko baza kwemeza 1 ryavuyemo uwo mwana. Kuri ubu uyu mwana w’umuhungu yarakuze ubu afite imyaka 3 y’amavuko. Nubwo uyu muryango wahishwe, amakuru akomeje kuvugwa, avuga ko waba ari umuryango ukomeye kandi ukize cyane ku buryo witeguye kwishyura ibyo urukiko ruzabategeka kuko bo icyo bari bakeneye ari umuragwa wabo kandi bakaba baramubonye.

title: Ibiro 67 bya Cocaine byasanzwe mu nanasi i Madrid
content:
Polisi yo muri Esipanye yatangaje kuri uyu wa Mbere ko yavumbuye mu isoko ry’imbuto n’imboga i Madrid, ibiro 67 bya cocaïne byari bihishe mu nanasi zaturutse muri Costa Rica. Izi nanasi zarimo nubwo zagaragaraga nk’izuzuye, ibi siko byari bimeze kuko ahubwo zari zipakiyemo iki kiyobyabwenge cyapimaga hagati y’amagarama 800 n’ikilo kimwe kuri buri nanasi ya baringa, ubundi batwikiraho igishishwa cy’inyuma cy’inanasi cyanafashaga mu gukumira impumuro ya cocaine nkuko polisi yabitangaje mu itangazo yatanze.

Urebeye inyuma wakeka ko ari inanasi isanzwe Abantu barindwi nibo bahise batabwa muri yombi, batatu  Madrid n’abandi bane i Barcelone. Imizigo y’inanasi iturutse muri Costa Rica yururukiraga i Setubal muri Portugal ubundi ikanyuza inzira y’ubutaka kugeza i Madrid.

Mu mayeri atangaje, imbere harimo uducupa twa cocaine dupfukishijwe ikintu basize ibara ry’umuhondo nk’inanasi Kompanyi yari ishinzwe gutumizaho ibi bicuruzwa yai imaze igihe igenzurwa na polisi nyuma yo gukurikiranwaho inshuro nyinshi ibi byaha bijyanye no kuzana ibiyobyabwenge mu miziho y’inanasi.


Ibiro 67 bya cocaine nibyo byasanzwemo Abacuruza n’abakwirakwiza ibiyobyabwenge bivanywe muri Amerika y’Amajyepfo babizana muri Esipanye ahafatwa nk’umuryango byinjiriraho biza ku isoko ry’i Burayi, bafite uburyo butangaje n’inzira babinyuzamo aho mu minsi ishize inzego z’umutekano zagiye zivumbura cocaïne mu mabere y’abagore, imisatsi (perruques), intebe z’utugare tw’abafite ubumuga bw’ingingo, mu bipfuko bihambiriye ukugura kuvunitse(bivunikishije) n’ahandi.

title: Ubushakashatsi: Pekin, umwe mu mijyi y’ibihugu izaba itagituwe mu 2070 kubera ubushyuhe n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere
content: Ubushakashatsi bw’umuburo bwa Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) bwahamije ko ibihugu bimwe bizaba bidashobora guturwamo burundu mu gihe kiri imbere kubera kwiyongera k’ubushyuhe bukabije bw’ikirere buzatuma umwuka waho utabasha guhumekwa ndetse ugahitana abantu. Ni mu gihe ubushyuhe bukabije muri iki gihe buteye inkeke abatuye isi, bituma abasesenguzi n’abashakashatsi bakomeza kureba icyakorwa mu gihe bahuriza ku kuba buziyongera bikabije mu myaka iri imbere. Ngo haramutse nta gikozwe ibi byazaviramo ibyago bikomeye isi. Ibihugu byinshi ntawo bizaba byaturwamo mu myaka 50 iri imbere kubera ubushyuhe n’ubuhehere. Ubushinwa ni kimwe mu bihugu bishobora kugerwamo n’iki kibazo cyane cyane mu majyaruguru hayo ahaherereye umujyi wa Pekin, intara ituwe namiliyoni 400 z’abaturage, aha mu 2070 ngo hashobora kuzaba ari ko gace gashyuha cyane kurusha ahandi ku isi. “Aka gace kazaba gashyushye cyane hari ubushyuhe bwica mu bihe biri imbere, by’umwihariko ku bw’ihindagurika ry’ikirere.”, porofiseri Elfatig Eltahir wa MIT(Massachusetts Institute of Technology) wayoboye ubu bushakashatsi bwatangajwe na Le Parisien. Kugira ngo wenda wumve uburemere bw’ibi, ubu bushakashatsi bugaragaza ko umuntu wari usanzwe afite ubuzima bwiza nta ndwara afite, ashobora gupfa mu masaha atandatu gusa kubera ubu bushyuhe buzaba burengeje urugero. Bangladesh nacyo ni ikindi gihugu gishobora kuzaba kitagituwemo. MIT yari yigeze kubikomozaho mu bundi bushakashatsi bwabo bwo mu 2017 bwagaragazaga ko iki gihugu kizahura n’ubwiyongere bw’ubushyuhe bukabije. “Kwiyongera k’ubushuhe n’ubuhehere bishobora kurenga urugero rwo kubyihanganira mu miterere y’ikiremwa muntu ngo abeho nta bwirinzi.” Umurwamukuru Dacca uzahura n’isaganya yo kuzurirwa n’amazi. Mu 2070 uyu mujyi utuwe n’abasaga miliyoni 11 ngo ushobora wo kumirwa bunguri n’amazi cyangwa se kurengerwa. Ibihugu byo mu kigobe (les pays du Golfe) ubwo ni ukuvuga ibihugu birimo Koweït, Irak, Bahreïn, Oman, Qatar, Arabie saoudite na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Abarabu nabyo bigomba guterwa inkeke n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere n’imyuka ihumanya ikirere. Source:7sur7

title: Uburayi: Ubushyuhe bumaze kwica batatu, umusozi wari muremure washonze utakaza agahigo
content:
Icyumweru gishize gisize ubushyuhe bukabije bwisasiye abany-Esipanyolo batatu mu gihe abanyaburayi bose bakomeje guhangayikishwa n’ubu bushyuhe budasanzwe bubugarije muri iyi mpeshyi. I Barcelone, umugabo utishoboye utagira aho aba (SDF) yabonywe arambaraye mu muhanda, bamugejeje kwa muganga apfirayo azize ‘ubushyuhe’ nkuko byatangajwe ku wa Gatanu ushize n’ikigo gishinzwe kubungabunga abaturage mu ntara ya Catalogne. Abandi babiri nabo barapfuye harimo umwubatsi w’imyaka 40 ukomoka muri Niger wari urimo akora mu muhanda mugari, hamwe n’umusaza w’imyaka 78 warimo atunganya ubusitani bwe bose bitabye Imana mu cyumweru gishize muri Esipanye aho ku wa Gatanu ubushyuhe bwageze kuri 44 °C i Badajoz. I Madrid ho ubushyuhe bwageze kuri  (40 °C) naho i Séville byari (42 °C) nkuko ikigo cy’iteganyagihe cyabitangaje.

I Lisbonne ba mukerarugendo bari kwikinga ubushyuhe Mu bihugu byinshi by’i Burayi hari ubushyuhe bukabije buteye inkeke abaturage n’ubuyobozi, by’umwihariko muri Portugal bwaciye agahigo aho iyi weekend yasize bageze kuri 45,2 °C i Alvega mu bilometero 150 uvuye i Lisbonne. Suwede naho nyuma y’imyaka 250 bahuye n’ubushyuhe budasanzwe mu kwezi gushize kwa Nyakanga bwatumye habaho impinduka zikomeye mu miterere y’iki gihugu aho nk’umusozi wari muremure wa Kebnekaise ugizwe ku gasongero n’urubura mu majyepfo washonze aho watakazaga santimetero 14 ku munsi bituma usimburwa na Kebnekaise yo mu majyaruguru yo igizwe n’amabuye.

Ninis Rosqvist, porofiseri wo muri kaminuza ya Stockholm apima agasongero ka Kebnekaise y’igice cy’Amajyepfo yari isanzwe ariyo ndende muri Arctique muri Suwede

Uyu musozi warashonze utakaza agahigo ko kuba umusozi muremure muri Suwede wari ufite uburebure bwa 2111 m, usimburwa n’uwo mu majyaruguru ufite 2097 m Mu Butaliyani harimo gutangwa amazi y’ubuntu ku baturage na ba mukerarugendo, mu Bufaransa naho ntiborohewe, Ububiligi ngo impanuka ziyongereyeho 15% kubera ubushyuhe.

title: Papa Francis yahinduye Gatigisimu ku birebana n’igihano cy’urupfu
content:
Papa Francis yahinduye inyigisho y’ukwemera Gatorika mu rwego rwo kwamagana burundu igihano cy’urupfu nk’uko Vatican ibitangaza. Gatigisimu ya Kiliziya, ihuriza hamwe mu nshamake yari imaze igihe gito yemeye ko igihano cyo gupfa gishobora gukoreshwa mu bihe bimwe na bimwe. Kuri ubu rero iragira iti "Si ibyo kwihanganira kuko ari ukubangamira ukudahohoterwa n’agaciro k’umuntu." Mu ukwezi k’Ukwakira kwa 2017, yavuze ko politiki ya Kiliziya ku gihano cy’urupfu ari ingingo ishobora ghinduka bitewe n’uko ibihe bigenda bihinduka.
Ubwo Papa Yohani Pawulo wa kabiri yandikaga ibijyanye n’iyi ngingo muri Gatigisimu muri 1992, we yavuze ko igihano cy’urupfu cyari "igisubizo gikwiye ku byaha bimwe na bimwe ndetse n’uburyo bushobora gukoreshwa, n’ubwo bigoranye ko cyasigasira ibyiza rusange."

 Mu bihe byashize, Papa Francis yagaragaje ko adashyigikiye na gato igihano cy’urupfu  Iyi nyandiko nshya rero yo ivuga ko hari "ukuzirikana ko agaciro k’umuntu kadatakara n’ubwo umuntu yaba yakoze icyaha gikomeye cyane.". Ivuga kandi ko uburyo bwo guhana bukora neza kuri ubu, burinda abaturage kandi "butima burundu uwakoze icyaha, ubushobozi bwo kwihana no kubabarirwa." Kugeza ubu ibihugu 53 ku isi yose nibyo bigifite igihano cy’urupfu, birimo na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika byemewe muri leta 32, bakaba bafite abakristu Gatolika bagera kuri 22%. Src: BBC

title: Ubuhinde: Abagabo 8 bari guhigishwa uruhindu kubera gusambanya ihene bikayiviramo urupfu
content: Kuri uyu wa Kabiri, polisi yo mu mu gihugu cy’Ubuhinde yatangaje ko irimo ishakisha abagabo 8 bakurikiranyweho gusambanya ku ngufu ihene yiteguraga kubyara bikaza kuyiviramo urupfu. Abagabo bakekwaho iki cyaha, bakurikiranywe ku ‘bw’itegeko ryo mu Buhinde rihana buri wese ukorana imibonano mpuzabitsina n’amatungo cyangwa inyamaswa’, iri tegeko rikaba rinahana ’abaryamana bahuje ibitsina’. Aba banyacyaha kandi baranashijwa kugirira nabi amatungo. Polisi iri gushakira aba bagabo mu gace ka leta ya Haryana mu bilometero hafi ijana uvuye i New Delhi. “Twamaze kumenya 3 mu bageraku 8 bakekwaho icyaha ndetse amatsinda y’abapolisi ari kubahiga ngo batabwe muri yombi vuba cyane bishoboka.”, umuvugizi wa polisi, Naazneen Bhasin aganira na AFP. Iki cyaha ngo cyabaye mu cyumweru gishize ubwo nyiri iyi hene yagwaga gitumo abagabo batatu barimo bamusambanyiriza ihene bitwikiriye ijoro.

title: Rusizi: Umugeni yabenzwe abimenyera ku rusengero ku munsi w’ubukwe, akuramo agatimba yurira moto arataha
content:
Umukobwa usengera mu Itorero rya ADEPR mu Karere ka Rusizi, yambaye agatimba ajya ku rusengero muri Paruwasi ya Rwahi aho yagombaga gusezeranira n’umusore w’inshuti ye, ariko atungurwa no kumutegereza agaheba, aho aziye amubwira ko ubukwe butakibaye maze ahinduka iciro ry’imigani nkuko tubikesha IGIHE. Amakuru avuga inkomoko yabaye ko umusore yatahuye ko uwari yaramaze kuba umugore we imbere y’amategeko hasigaye gusa umugisha wa pasiteri, yagiye amuca inyuma akaryamana n’umwe mu bacuruzi bakomeye i Rusizi. Umuyobozi w’imwe muri korali muri ako gace yabwiye IGIHE ko inkuru zo gucana inyuma zikijya hanze, byamenyeshejwe urusengero ko ubukwe bwabo butakibaye ku wa 28 Nyakanga 2018 nk’uko byari byarapanzwe. Nyamara umusore yabitse ku mutima ko atazajya mu rusengero, ararenga abwira umukobwa ko yasabye urusengero ko ubukwe bwasubukurwa nyamara byahe byo kajya! Nawe yivayo mu myiteguro ndetse ku wa Gatandatu mu gitondo umusore yagiye gusaba no gukwa. Byageze nyuma ya saa sita umugeni yambaraga agatimba aherekezwa n’inshuti n’umuryango, bageze ku rusengero umugabo arabura nubwo yaje kuhagera hashize umwanya nta n’icyo aramira. Bombi ni abo muri Paruwasi ya Muramba ariko bagombaga gusezeranira muri Paruwasi ya Rwahi kuko bo urusengero rwabo rwafunzwe. Kayobera Joseph usanzwe ari Umunyamabanga wa Pasiteri wa Paruwasi Muramba, yabwiye IGIHE ko nta gahunda yo gusezerana yari ihari uwo munsi. Yagize ati “Mbere barabenganye batumenyesha ko ubukwe butakibaye, kuvuga ko basabanye imbazi ntibatubwiye.” Bikekwa ko umusore yashakaga kwihimura ku mukobwa nyuma yo gutahura ko bamaze gusezerana byemewe n’amategeko akamuca inyuma. Umukobwa amaze kubura umugabo we abari batashye ubukwe babaye nk’abakubiswe n’inkuba, nyuma babona umusore aje wenyine ndetse ngo n’ikoti yaritiye nzira, avugisha umukobwa amumenyesha ko ubukwe bwapfubye, abantu barashungera bamuha inkwenene inzego z’umutekano ziratabara. Uyu mugeni nawe yabonye ashobewe akuramo ikanzu yambara igitege, yurira moto iramucyura.

Uyu ni we mugeni wabenzwe akabimenyera ku rusengero Iyi nkuru yo gupfuba k’ubukwe mu Karere ka Rusizi ikurikiye iy’ubwapfubye mu Karere ka Gatsibo mu mpera za Gicurasi 2018, ariko bwo byakomotse ku musore washatse gukoresha ubukwe buhenze nta mafaranga afite. Src:IGIHE

title: Imbwa yahagaritse igitaraganya indege yari yafashe ikirere
content: Mu buryo butunguranye, indege ya Boeing 737 ihuza umujyi wa Saint-Pétersbourg na Moscou mu Burusiya, biherutse kuba ngombwa ko yururuka by’igitaraganya kubera imbwa yari itwaye. Iyi mbwa yari iherereye mu gice cy’imizigo nk’ibisanzwe, gusa yaje gusohoka mu kazu kayo(cage) katari gafunze neza, maze kubera igihunga kinshi yari ifite itangira gutera imigeri ku rukuta rw’indege kugeza ubwo yakoraga kuri buto(bouton) ifungura umuryango. Inzogera itabaza yahise isakuza maze bihita biba ngombwa ko indege yari iri ku butumburuke bwa metero 4000, isubira hasi igwa by’igitaraganya ku kibuga cy’indege cya Moscou Sheremetyevo. Ikinyamakuru Le Parisien kivuga ko abagenzi bari bahiye ubwoba ariko indege yahagaze neza nta muntu ugize ikibazo cyangwa ngo hagire icyangirika.

title: Karongi: Umugore araregwa guta umwana w’abaturanyi mu ‘cyobo cy’imyanda’
content:
Inkuru y’Umuseke.rw: Kuwa mbere w’iki cyumweru saa yine za mugitondo mu mudugudu wa Nyabaguma Akagari ka Kiniha Umurenge wa Bwishyura Nyirabitonda Therese yatumye umwana kuvoma, abonye atinze asiga mu rugo bucura bwe ngo ajye kureba uwagiye kuvoma, agarutse ntiyongeye kubona ukundi uyu bucura bwe ari muzima. Umuturanyi batavuga rumwe niwe ukekwaho kumuhekura. Umwana wa Nyirabitonda yari umuhungu ufite amezi 13 gusa, nyina yamusize mu mbuga yo mu gipangu bakodeshamo n’igikinisho agarutse asanga igikinisho gusa.
Yarashakishije araheba, n’umugabo we araza bafatanya gushaka uyu mwana w’igitambambuga utaramenya kugenda, baraheba. Uyu muryango uturanye inzu ku yindi aho bakodesha n’umugore witwa Mukantaganzwa Josephine ngo utajyaga imbizi na Nyirabitonda, ndetse ngo yavugaga kenshi ko azamubabaza. Umwe mu baturanyi babo yabwiye Umuseke ko aba babyeyi babajije umuturanyi wabo Mukantaganzwa niba atabonye umwana wabo ngo yarabashenguye ati “Sinzi aho ari, si njye wababwiye kubyara abana beza.” Bahise babwira ubuyobozi bw’Umudugudu bubafasha gushaka, kuri uwo wa mbere no kuwa kabiri baraheba. Musabyimana Drocella uyobora Umudugudu wa Nyabaguma yabwiye Umuseke ko iby’amakimbirane ya Nyirabitonda na Mukantaganzwa babizi kandi koko Mukantaganzwa yavugaga amagambo ko uyu muryango azawubabaza. Uyu muyobozi avuga ko kuwa kabiri bakomeje gushakisha maze bigira inama yo kurebera mu cyobo cy’imyanda (fosse septique) ingo zo muri iki gipangu. Ni icyobo gisanzwe gipfundikirwa. Uyu mwana ni mwo bamusanze yapfuye, nta gikomere kindi afite. Ahita ajyanwa kwa muganga. Kuwa mbere nimugoroba abayobozi bagiye gushaka Mukantaganzwa Josephine ngo bamubaze niba ataba yabonye uriya mwana w’abaturanyi, maze aho bamusanze abuka inabi nk’uko umwe mu bayobozi b’ibanze abivuga. Ngo ababwira ko amenya iby’umwana we atamenya iby’ab’abandi. Uyu mwana amaze kuboneka Mukantaganzwa Josephine ufitanye amakimbirane n’ababyeyi b’uyu mwana wapfuye niwe wahise utabwa muri yombi mu gihe hagikorwa iperereza. Ubu afungiye kuri station ya Police ya Bwishyura ashinjwa kwica uyu mwana akamujugunya mu cyobo. Umugore n’umugabo babuze umwana Umuseke wagerageje kuvugana nabo birananirana kuko bajyaga kuvuga agahinda kakabarenga bakarira kubera urupfu rubabaje rw’umwana wabo.

title: Ubwirakabiri bw’ukwezi kw’amaraso kuzagaragara mu Rwanda kwaba ari ikimenyetso cy’imperuka
content:
Ibi byahamijwe n’umuvugabutumwa wo mu gihugu cy’Ubuhinde, nyuma y’uko hatangajwe ko kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 27 Nyakanga hazaba ubwirakabiri burebure mu mateka y’ikinyejana cya 21, buzamara isaha imwe n’iminota 43 aho ukwezi kuzaba kwahinduye ibara kukijima kugasa nk’ikigina cyangwa umutuku ari nayo mpamvu kwitirirwa ukwezi kw’amaraso (blood moon). Ubu bwirakabiri bw’ukwezi (lunar eclipse) bubaho mu gihe isi, izuba n’ukwezi biri ku murongo umwe cyangwa kwegeranye n’isi cyane noneho kandi isi iba iri hagati igakingiriza imirasire y’izuba ntigere ku kwezi uko bisanzwe, bigatuma kwijima. 

 Ibi bizamara amasaha agera kuri 4, ariko ukwezi kube umutuku nyirizina mu gihe cy’isaha n’iminota 43  Mu gihe ubu bwirakabiri buteganijwe mu mpera z’iki cyumweru, ndetse bikazaba no mu kirere cy’u Rwanda, umupasiteri witwa Paul Begley yavuze ko iki ari ikimenyetso cy’itangiriro ry’imperuka y’isi n’abayituye. Hari abantu benshi bafata ubu bwirakabiri bw’ukwezi kw’amaraso nk’ikimenyetso cy’ibihe bya nyuma ndetse ngo byanahishuwe mu mirongo ya bibiliya ntibavuge rumwe n’abagendera ku bumenyi bw’isi. Uyu mupasiteri ubarizwa mu Buhinde ni umwe mu bazwi cyane bashimangira ko uku kwezi kw’amaraso guhuye n’ibihe by’imperuka, mu ivugabutumwa rye akora abicishije kuri interineti. Ubwo yabwirizaga abamukurikira kuri Youtube, Pasteur Begley yasomye imirongo itandukanye yo muri Bibiliya harimo iyo mu Ibyahishuwe, Yoweli n’Ibyakozwe n’intumwa, yose ivuga ko guhinduka umutuku k’ukwezi bizaba mbere y’imperuka y’isi. Mu kibwirizwa cye aravuga ati "Ubuhanuzi: Ukwezi kw’amaraso kugiye kuboneka. Murazi, muri Kamena, Imana yarambwiye iti ’genda urebe ukwezi kw’amaraso’ . Iti ’ Ugomba gusobanukirwa ibirimo kuba’ rero namenye ko ukwezi kw’amaraso kwagombaga kuboneka ariko twamaze kukuboina inshuro 4 muri 2014 na 2015, rero nta bwoba byanteye."

 Paul Begley ahamya ko yavuganye n’Imana  "Nyagasani ambwiye ko ngomba kujya kureba ibirimo kuba, naragiye mbona ni ukwezi kw’amaraso kurekure kuzamara igihe kinini mu kinyejana cya 21. Nsanga kuzagaragara hejuru ya Yeruzaremu kandi mbona ko hazaba hari abantu badasanzwe." Pastor Begley mu gukomeza gusobanura ibyo avuga ahamya ko Imana ariyo yamutumye kubwira abari mu isi ko uku kwezi kw’amaraso ari intangiriro y’iherezo ry’isi, aho ahamya ko ku ya 27 Nyakanga azaba ari n’umunsi igihugu cya Israel kizaba cyizihiza isabukuru y’imyaka 70 kibaye igihugu. Ati "Ibyo mvuga ni ukuri. Muri Yoweli, 2 havuga ko izuba rizijima n’ukwezi kugahinduka amaraso mbere y’uko iminsi myiza n’imibi ya Nyagasani iza. Mu Ibyakozwe n’intumwa 2 naho havuga ibisa n’ibyo." Mu Rwanda uku kwezi kw’amaraso kuzagaragara mu buryo bwuzuye guhera saa tatu n’igice kugeza saa tanu n’iminota cumi n’itatu (21h30-23h13).

title: Iran irashinja Israel kubibira ibicu bitanga imvura
content:
Umujenerari wo mu gihugu cya Iran kuri uyu wa Mbere yatangaje ko Israel yaba yiba ibicu byo mu kirere cya Iran, bigatuma imvura itagwa iwabo. "Guhindagurika kw’ibihe muri Iran ntabwo ari shyashya. Turakeka ko batwinjiriye bagahindura ikirere cyacu. Ibigo by’ubushakashatsi muri siyansi byabikozeho ubushakashatsi kandi burabyemeza. Israel n’ikindi gihugu bafite amatsinda y’ubufatanye, akoresha uko ashoboye kugira ngo ibicu byinjira mu kirere cya Iran bidatanga imvura." Amagambo ya Gen. Gholam Reza Jalali

 General Gholam Reza Jalali ahamya ko afite ibimenyetsi by’ibyo avuga  Ikigo cy’iteganyagihe muri Iran cyo cyahakanye aya makuru gihamya ko ibi bidashoboka ko igihugu cyiba ibicu by’ikindi. Ahad Vazife umuyobozi w’iki kigo yagize ati "Igihugu ntabwo gishobora kwiba ibicu. Iyo biza kuba bimeze bityo ntihaba hari abapolisi barinda amazi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, kuko abanyamerika bakwiba ibicu by’ibindi bihugu nta nkomyi... title: CECAFA Kagame Cup: Kagere Meddie yatangiye neza muri Simba SC akubita ahababaza APR FC
content:
Ikipe ya APR FC ikomeje kutitwara neza imbere y’amakipe yo muri Tanzaniya mu mikino ya Cecafa Kagame Cup aho nyuma yo gutsindwa na Singida umukino wayo wa mbere (2-1), ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Mbere yatakaje umukino wa kabiri yatsinzwe na Simba SC 2-1. Ku munota wa 66 nibwo iyi kipe y’ingabo z’igihugu yasabwaga gutsinda uyu mukino cyangwa ikanganya byibuze kugira ngo ikomeza kureba ko yabona umwanya mwiza mu itsinda, yafunguye amazamu ku gitego cya Nkinzingabo Fiston, gusa ibyishimo byabo ntibyamaze kabiri kuko Adam Salamba, umukinnyi mushya wa Simba yahise akishyura 6 gusa.

Aha Salamba watsinze igitego cya mbere cya Simba yari ahanganye na Nsabimana Emmanuel na Buregeye Prince Ku munota wa nyuma w’umukino nibwo APR FC yatsinzwe igitego cya 2 kuri penaliti yinjijwe neza na rutahizamu mpuzamahanga w’umunyarwanda Kagere Meddie nyuma y’ikosa yakorewe mu rubuga rw’amahina maze uyu musore atangira aha intsinzi ikipe ye nshya iheruka kumugura muri Gor Mahia. Kugeza ubu APR FC kugira ngo yerekeze muri 1/4 irasabwa kuzatsinda byanze bikunze umukino wayo wa nyuma mu itsinda uzayihuza na Dakadaha yo muri Somalia maze igategereza uko mu yandi matsinda bizagenda aho yazamuka nk’ikipe ya 3 muzitwaye neza. Simba SC y’umutoza Masudi Djuma niyo ikomeje kuyobora itsinda n’amanota 6 inganya na Singida ariko imwe izigamye ibitego 5, indi 2. APR FC na Dakadaha ziri ku mwanya wa nyuma, abasore ba Petrovic barimo umwenda w’ibitego 2 naho iyi kipe irimo umwenda w’ibitego 5.

title: Yabonye musaza we atari azi bahitamo gushyingiranwa
content: Debby w’imyaka 50 na Joe w’imyaka 37 bamaze gushyingiranwa nyamara bazi neza ko bavukana, gusa bo bagahamya ko biyumvamo urukundo rurenze urwa kivandimwe. "Nzi ko dufite amaraso amwe, ariko ntitwigeze dukurana. Murumva rero ko dutandukanye n’abandi bavandimwe. Nahoraga nifuza kubona umuryango nyawo."-Debby wahisemo gushyingiranwa na musaza we. Ubwo Debby yari afite imyaka 3 gusa y’amavuko yavuye mu muryango we ajya kurererwa ahandi (adopte) ariko amaze gukura yifuza kumenya ababyeyi be nyakuri, amaze kubona se, amubwira ko afite musaza we bahuriye kuri se, ari we Joe ubu wamaze kumubera umugabo. Debby na Joe bakibonana bahise bakundana ako kanya. Nyuma y’iminsi ibiri gusa bahise batangira gusohokana ndetse baranararana. Nyuma y’ibyumweru 2 bahise bimukira mu nzu imwe, kimwe n’abandi bantu bakundana bafite gahunda yo kurushinga. "Ntibyari ibidasanzwe gukorana imibonano mpuzabitsina na Joe. Byari ibisanzwe nk’aho rwose twaremewe kubana."-Debby Bamaze imyaka igera ku 10 yose barahishe iby’urukundo rwabo ariko baza gufata umwanzuro wo kubibwira umuryango, muri 2014 ubwo se yari amaze imyaka 7 apfuye. Nyuma baje gushingirirwa mu bwato mu gihugu cya Cuba, ubu bakaba babanye neza nk’umugabo n’umugore.

title: Umupadiri yahagaritswe ku mirimo ye azira kwigisha abayoboke akoresheje injyana ya Rap
content:
Ni umupadiri wo mu gihugu cya Kenya wamaze guhabwa igihano cyo guhagarikwa by’igihe gito ngo yisubirehp nyuma yo gukoresha indirimbo ziri mu njyana ya Rap ngo akangurire urubyiruko kuza gusenga. Padiri Paul Ogalo yarapaga mu Kiriziya bigatuma urubyiruko rwinshi rwitabira gusenga ndetse muri Rap ze akaba yatangiragamo ubutumwa bwo kureka gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge n’izindi ngeso mbi, ibyari bitangiye gutanga umuseruro ufatika nk’uko we ubwe na bamwe mu bakristu babivuga.

 Nyuma yo gusoma Misa, Padiri Ogolo yakuragamo ikanzu akambara ibijyanye na Rap ubundi agatangira akarapa  Padiri Ogalo yagize ati "Dukeneye guha agaciro inyungu z’urubyiruko. Tugomba guhindura uburyo dukora ibintu." Violet Menya uyobora urubyiruko muri iyi Kiriziya we ati "Twishimira cyane kuba uburyo bwe bwo kwigisha bwarakururiye urubyiruko kwitabira gusenga. Yatoje urubyiruko rwinshi kureka ibiyobyabwenge, batangira kwitabira umurimo nk’ubuhinzi, ubucuruzi n’ibindi byinshi."

 Padiri Ogolo yafashije urubyiruko rwinshi kugaruka mu Kiriziya  "Padiri Ogolo yatubereye umuyobozi mwiza. Akoresha imvugo urubyiruko rwumva. Yakijije ibihumbi by’urubyiruko gutwarwa n’ibiyobyabwenge." Uwitwa Bernard Oketch wahamije ko atazasubira mu kiriziya kugeza Padiri Ogalo akuwe mu gihano. Nubwo aba bakristu bakomeje kugaragaza ko babajwe no guhagarikwa kwe, ubuyobozi bwa Kiriziya bwo buhamya ko ibyo yakoze bitandukanye n’amahame ya Kiriziya bityo ko agomba guhabwa umwanya wo kwisubiraho.

title: Abambaye ubusa bakoze umutanbagiro wo kwigaragambya mu mihanda y’i Buruseli (AMAFOTO)
content:
Abasaga 300 bagendera ku magare i Buruseri mu Bubiligi bazindukiye mu myigaragambyo kuri iki Cyumweru, aho batambagiye mu mihanda itandukanye y’uyu mujyi bambaye ubusa. title: Ubufaransa: Jocelin Sparapan yegukanye irushanwa ry’igihugu ry’abafite ubwanwa bwihariye -Amafoto
content:
Ku cyumweru tariki ya 10 Kamena i Paris mu Bufaransa habereye irushanwa ry’abafite ubwana bwiza ndetse bwihariye ku rwego rw’igihugu (Championnat de France de Barbe 2018) aho ku nshuro yaryo ya kabiri ryegukanywe na Jocelin Sparapan mu cyiciro rusange naho Hugo Saladon de Paulhac wo mu mujyi wa Toulouse atorwa nk’ufite ubwanwa bwiza bwo hejuru (moustache). 
Hugo SALADON wegukanye igihembo cy’ufite ubwanwa bwiza bwo hejuru Abagera kuri 62 ni bo bari bitabiriye iri rushanwa aho bari babukereye baje kugaragaza amoko yabo atandukanye y’ubwanwa imbere y’akanama nkemurampaka kari kagizwe n’impuguke zirimo: Michel Dervyn(umwogoshi wubatse izina), Garey FAULKNER (ufite igihembo cy’ubwanwa bwiza mu cyiciro cya Freestyle), Philippe DUMAS (umukinnyi wa filime akanaba umunyamideli), Marine BOISSET (umuyobozi w’igice cyandika ku bwiza Beauté mu kinyamakuru Public) na Fabrice LEONARD (umunyamakuru w’imideri muri Le Point).
 Ni ibirori byari byitabiriwe n’abarenga 300 bari baje kwihera amaso. Mu by’ingenzi bagendeyeho harimo kureba ubwoko bw’ubwanwa bwabo ubwo hasi n’ubwo hejuru y’umunwa, ingano yabwo, ibara bufite, uko bureshya, niba bugendanye n’isura ya nyirabwo n’ibindi byihariye.

Ababaye aba mbere bahembwe ibihembo bitandukanye birimo kuzajya bakorerwa ubwanwa bwabo, amadarubindi y’izuba, amafunguro muri resitora zikomeye n’ibindi Jocelin Sparapan yaje guhiga abandi bose aho akanama nkemurampaka kashimye ubwiza bw’ubwana bwe, insokozo ya bwo, uburyo abwitaho n’imyumvire abufiteho. 

Jocelin Sparapan wavuze ko ari ubwa mbere yari ageze i Paris, yahavanye intsinzi Uretse uyu mugabo w’imyaka 27 ukomoka i Moselle ariko akaba atuye Vervins wahize abandi, hanatowe abandi banyabwanwa mu byiciro bitandukanye barimo: Neil TANKES JOBET mu cyiciro cy’ubwanwa karemano buri munsi ya santimetero 20, Mikhail LOUAIB (mu cyiciro cy’ubwanwa karemano buri hejuru ya santimetero 20), Jordan LOURDEL ( Barbe Freestyle), Loïc PAPILLON ( Barbe Garibaldi), Guillaume RENOUF ( Barbe Verdi) na Hugo SALADON watowe mu cyiciro cy’ubwanwa bwo hejuru y’umunwa (Moustache).

title: Bwa mbere mu mateka, abagore bo muri Arabia Saudite bahawe impushya zo gutwara ibinyabiziga
content:
Kuri uyu wa Mbere nibwo igihugu cya Arabia Saudite cyatangiye gutanga impushya zo gutwara ibinyabiziga ku bagore, nyuma y’uko Ubwami bw’iki gihugu bwemeje ko umugore na we afite uburenganzira bwo gutwara imodoka. Itangazo ryashyishyizwe ahagaragara ryagaragaje ko nyuma y’impinduka zirimo gukorwa ku mpushya zo gutwara ibinyabiziga, abagore nabo bazazihabwa ku nshuro ya mbere mu mateka.

 Ni ubwa mbere mu mateka, iki gihugu gitanze izi mpushya ku bagore  “Ubuyobozi bw’umutekano wo mu muhanda, uyu munsi bwatangiye gusimbuza impushya mpuzamahanga zari zisanzwe muri ubu bwami, zigasimbuzwa iza Arabia Saudite mbere yo guha ku mugaragaro abagore uburenganzira bwo gutwara ibinyabiziga, ku ya 24 Kamena.” Kugeza ubu Arabia Saudite nicyo gihugu cyonyine ku isi kitemerera abagore gutwara ibinyabiziga.

 Ubu ibi byabaye amateka, abagore bo muri iki gihugu na bo bemerewe gutwara imodoka 
Muri Nzeri, 2017 nibwo Umwami Salmane yari yatangaje ko iri tegeko ribuza abagore gutwara ibinyabiziga, rizakurwaho muri uyu mwaka wa 2018, ibyo ahamya ko yakomoye ku muhungu we muto, Igikomangoma cyarazwe Ubwami (prince héritier), Mohammed ben Salmane. Tubibutse ko nubwo nyuma yo gukora ibizamini byabugenere, kugeza ubu hari abagore bamaze guhabwa izi mpushya, bazemererwa gutangira gutwara ku ya 24 Kamena, 2018.

title: Mu Buyapani, umukoresha ni we utanga uburenganzira bwo gusama
content: Muri iki gihe Ubuyapani ni igihugu gifite umubare muto cyane w’abana bavuka. Ubu abagore bari mu mirimo bafite ikibazo gikomeye cyo kubanza guhabwa uruhushya n’abakoresha babo mbere yo gusama ndetse bamwe muri bo bikababuza akazi. Nk’uko inkuru ya 7sur7 ibisobanura, ngo gutwita k’umugore mu Buyapani biracyafatwa nk’ikibazo cyane mu kazi ndetse abagore bari mu mirimo babanza guhabwa uburenganzira n’abakoresha babo mbere yo gusama no kubyara. Umwe mu bagore bahaye AFP ubuhamya yavuze uburyo yatunguwe cyane no kubuzwa n’umukoresha we kubyara umwana wa 2 kandi yari amaze igihe gito abwiwe na muganga ko ashobora kuba afite ikibazo cy’ubugumba. “Kuki udafata akaruhuko, kuko ufite n’undi mwana?” uku niko yabajijwe mbere yo kubwirwa ko hari undi mugore bakorana, umuruta ubukuru kandi ushyingiwe vuba, ariwe utahiwe gusama. Uyu mubyeyi wahise ahindura akazi ndetse ubu akaba amaze kwibaruka umukobwa yabwiye AFP ati “Nabuze icyo mvuga. Nagombaga gusaba imbabazi iyo nsama nkiri mu kazi.” Iri hame ryo gushyiraho urutonde rw’uko abagore bari mu kazi bagomba gukurikirana mu gusama, ntabwo ribangamira abayapani bose, ariko hari benshi ribuza uburenganzira, dore ko hari n’abo gusama bibera ibyago bikomeye byatera no kubura akazi. Umugabo umwe wababajwe bikomeye n’ibyakorewe umugore we, yavuze uburyo byabaye ngombwa ko basaba imbabazi nyuma y’uko umugore we agize ‘ibyago’ byo gusama kandi atari we wari ugezweho ku rutonde, bityo ko yari abangamiye uwagombaga gukurikiraho. “Ni gute watinyutse kwica amahame, utanabisabiye uruhushya?” Ikibazo umugore we yabajijwe n’uwo yibye umwanya wo gusama. Umugore witwa Kanako Amano ukorera ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi cya NLI, wahamije ko na we ategereje kugerwaho ku rutonde kugira ngo asame, yagize ati “Ntabwo ari ibintu bidasanzwe, ni ibintu bimaze kumenyerwa mu bigo bitandukanye bikoresha abagore. Ntabwo babifata nko guhohoterwa ahubwo bababazwa cyane no kumara igihe kinini badakora kubera kubyara.” Abagore benshi bahitamo guhara amahirwe yo gushinga umuryango naho abandi bakiyemeza kureka akazi mu gihe bumva bakeneye gusama. Kanako yahamije ko abagore n’abagabo bumva ko akazi kahariwe abagabo gusa. Ati “Abagore kimwe n’abagabo bumva rwose ko kujya ku kazi ari ibyahariwe abagabo, bityo ni ibisanzwe kuba abagore bagomba kuva ku kazi mu gihe batwite.” Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko 40% by’abayapani batekereza ko umurimo w’umugore ari ukwita ku rugo naho abagabo bakajya ku kazi ndetse ibi bikaba aribyo bigenda byongera ikibazo cyo kugabanuka gukabije kw’abana bavuka muri iki gihugu, ikibazo Ubuyapani bumaranye imyaka itari mike.

title: Togo: Inyubako yahirimye ihitana ubuzima bw’abantu
content: Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 01 Kamena 2018, ni bwo ibice bimwe by’inyubako ndende igizwe n’amagorofa atandatu (six étages) iherereye mu isoko rinini ry’i Lomé mu murwa mukuru wa Togo byahirimye. Imibare y’agateganyo yatanzwe na Minisiteri y’umutekano yabaruraga ko uretse abantu babiri bahise bahasiga ubuzima, abandi bagera kuri batanu bakomeretse bikomeye. Iyi nyubako ngo ituye bugufi y’ikigo ndangamuco cy’Abadage, Goethe Institut mu murwa mukuru wa Togo. title: Rwamagana: Ubukwe bwapfuye kubera kwirarira ku musore, umugeni agwa igihumure -Amafoto
content:
Ku wa Gatandatu tariki ya 26 Gicurasi 2018, umusore ukomoka mu Karere ka Gatsibo yashatse gukoresha ubukwe nta mafaranga ahagije afite, bupfa ku munota wa nyuma, inshuti n’abavandimwe bamaze kugera aho imihango yose yari kubera. Ubukwe bwo gusaba no gukwa bwapfubye bwari kubera muri Centre d’Accueile Sainte Agnès i Rwamagana. Bamwe mu bari babutumiwemo babwiye IGIHE dukesha iyi nkuru ko uyu musore n’umukunzi we basezeranye imbere y’amategeko mu biro by’Umurenge wa Rugarama, Akarere ka Gatsibo bahita berekeza aho hari kubera ibirori. Bageze kuri Centre d’Accueile Sainte Agnès, ababutashye batunguwe no kumva umusore abwiye umuryango we ko nta kintu na kimwe mu bikinerwa mu gusaba no gukwa birimo amasuka, ibicuba n’ibindi afite.

Umugeni yananiwe kwihanganira ibyamubayeho, agwa igihumure arandatwa n’umuryango bamwihutana kwa muganga Umwe mu bari muri ubu bukwe utarifuje ko atangazwa amazina ye yagize ati “Nta kintu na kimwe yari arifite kandi yashakaga ubukwe buhenze, kuko n’ibicuba n’amasuka yo kwifashisha mu gusaba abo mu muryango we nibo bagiye babigura nyuma abageni n’abatumirwa bari muri Salle.” Ibyo bimaze kuhagera, banasanze uyu musore nta nkoni n’ingofero byo guha sebukwe yaguze, nta n’impano yo guha nyirabukwe yari yazanye ku buryo umwe mu bo mu muryango we yahise atega igare ajya kubigurira mu mujyi wa Rwamagana. Iby’ibanze nkenerwa bimaze kugurwa n’abisakasatse byihuse ngo ubukwe budapfuba, ahagana ku gicamunsi abashinzwe umutekano w’aho biyakirira (salle) bakinze amarembo kuko bari bataramara kwishyurwa amafaranga yo kuyikodesha. Uretse salle, ibyabo byose imbwa zabirwaniyemo, umutangabuhamya avuga ko n’umugeni yageze aho yambarira, abura imyambaro kuko umusore atari yarangije kwishyura amafaranga ibihumbi 100 yasigayemo aho bakodesheje imyenda irimo iyo bajyanye gusezerana mu murenge. Yagize ati “Nyuma uwari wabakoreye decoration yaraje noneho abima undi mwenda w’ubukwe, umukobwa yari agiye kwambara ababwira ko awubaha ari uko bamwishyuye amafaranga yose bamusigayemo.”

Salle yari kuberamo ubukwe yari yatatswe ariko umusore atarangije kwishyura amafaranga ayikodesha Umukobwa akimara kumenya aya makuru yose y’uko salle yafunzwe, itorero gakondo ndetse n’abafotoraga nabo banzuye ko nta kindi kintu bari bwongere gukora nabo batishyuwe, yahise agwa igihumure bahita bamujyana igitaranganya kwa muganga, umusore asigara yumiwe. Ibi bikimara kuba abari bambariye umusore bose n’abari batumiwe bahise bakwira imishwaro, banga igisebo ngo hatagira n’uwabafotora.

title: Amerika: Igitangaza? Ishusho ya Bikiramariya yabonywe irimo irira amarira y’iroza –Amafoto&Video
content:
Ishusho(statue) ya Bikiramariya iherereye muri kiliziya ya Notre-Dame de Guadalupe i Hobbs muri New Mexico (imwe muri Leta zigize Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika), yabonywe irimo kurira ngo amarira yasaga nk’ibara ry’iroza kandi amezi nk’amavuta aho kuba nk’amazi bisanzwe. Inkuru dukesha Daily Mail ivuga ko abakirisitu ba mbere babonye iyi shusho irira ubwo bari mu misa yo ku Cyumweru cyabanjirije iki gishize, ni ukuvuga ku wa 20 Gicurasi 2018.

Iyi shusho cyangwa se ikibumbano cya Mariya nyina wa Yezu cyabonywe n’abakirisitu kirimo kurira

Abantu baturutse mu bice bitandukanye bya New Mexico no mu nkengero zaho baza kureba no kwifatanya na Bikiramariya arira

Kiliziya yafunguwe amasaha 24 baha umwanya abazaga gusenga no gufata ku ishusho ya Bikiramariya arira Padiri José ’Pepe’ Segura uyobora iyi kiliziya yavuze ko umwe mu bagize iyi paruwasi (paroisse) yamubwiye iby’uko iyi shusho irimo kurira, ndetse nawe abona abantu barimo bayihanagura ariko amarira agakomeza gutemba. Yagize ati “Ubwo ni bwo nabonye ko rwose arimo(Bikiramariya) arira.” Aganira na Las Cruces Sun Sentinel, padiri  yongeyeho ati “Ndibwira ko ari inyibutsa(rappel) kuri twese ngo twiyegereze Imana, tureke kuba abanyarugomo.”

Abari bahari bavuga ko uko bahanaguraga iyi shusho amarira, andi yahitaga atemba Iyi kiliziya yagumye ifunguye amasaha 24 mu gihe abantu baturutse imihanda yose muri New Mexico ndetse kugeza na Texas bazaga baje kureba ibyo abakirisitu bitaga igitangaza. Umugabo witwa Peter McDonald utuye i Midland muri Texas, yakuye abana be batanu mu ishuri ngo bajye kureba Nyina wa Yezu arira. Yabwiye KVIA-TV ati "Ni umugisha udasanzwe kuba turi hano mu burengerazuba bwa Texas, kubona ishusho hano irira gutya, ni ibitangaza.” Ku wa Kane w’iki Cyumweru gishize, Diyoseze ya Las Cruces New Mexico yaje gusuzuma ayo marira kugira ngo imenye niba koko iki ari ikimenyetso(fact) cy’igitangaza.

Buri wese yari ategereje ngo abashe kwegera iyi shusho Deacon Jim Winder, umuyobozi wungirije wa Diyoseze yavuze ko bizatwara igihe kinini hakorwa isuzuma, yabwiye KOB-TV ko ‘udashobora kugaragaza igitangaza, ariko ushobora guhakana ibindi bisobanuro.’ Kiliziya yafunzwe amasaha ane, mu gihe abayobozi bageranyaga amwe mu ‘marira’. Ngo iyi shusho nayo igomba kunyuzwa mu cyuma (radiographier), hakanabazwa abatangabuhamya babonye ibi biba, ndetse hakanakurikiranwa inkomoko kugeza aho iyi shusho yakorewe, ibintu bishobora gufata igihe kitari gito. Ariko uko byagenda kose, abakirisitu babonye ibyo biba bo bavuga ko ari abahamya b’igitangaza biboneye. Laura Wright, utuye Hobbs yagize ati “Ibi byari impamo, yariraga rwose.Arababaye.” Kanda hano hasi urebe agace gato k’uburyo byari byifashe

title: RDC: Abarwayi ba Ebola bavuye mu bitaro bajya mu rusengero bapfirayo
content:
Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatatu ni bwo World Health Organization (WHO) yatangaje ko abarwayi batatu ba Ebola baherutse kuva mu kigo bavurirwagamo  muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo nyuma yaho imiryango yabo yari yasabye ko yabajyana mu rusengero. Babiri muri bo baje guhita bapfa, mu gihe uwa gatatu we yagaruwe muri iki kigo giherereye Mbandaka. Nk’uko umunyamakuru wa BBC uri muri iki gihugu yabitangaje ngo ibi byongeye kugaragaza imbogamizi zikomeye abari guhangana no guhagarika ikwirakwira ryihuse ry’iki cyorezo bafite.

Hamwe mu hitaruye havurirwa abakekwaho Ebola mu mujyi wa Mbandaka Ngo bamwe mu bo mu miryango y’aba barwayi baje ku bitaro biyobowe n’abaganga batagira umupaka (Medecins Sans Frontieres/MSF), maze basaba ko babajyana mu masengesho nk’uko byemejwe na Eugéne Kabambi ubikuriye. Nyuma baje guhita babatwara kuri moto, ariko polisi ihita itangira gushakisha. Umurwayi umwe basanze yapfiriye mu rugo aho umubiri we wahise ugarurwa kwa muganga ngo ashyingurwe mu buryo bwihariye. Undi yahise agarurwa kwa muganga ku wa 22 Gicurasi maze ahapfira ku mugoroba. Ubuyobozi bw’iki kigo buvuga ko bwari bwagerageje gukora ibishoboka ngo bumvishe aba barwayi ko badakwiye kugenda ahubwo bakwiye gukomeza gusuzumwa. “Ubu, guhatira kwivuza ntabwo ari cyo gisubizo kuri iki cyorezo. Urahare rw’abarwayi ni ingenzi.” Bamwe mu bagize umuryango w’abo barwayi batatu batangiye gukurikiranwa aho ndetse bamwe muri bo bahawe imiti y’urukingo rwa Ebola. Uburyo iyi ndwara ikomeje gukwirakwira iva mu byaro iza Mbandaka, iherereye ku ruzi rwa Congo byatangiye gutera ubwoba ko bishobora kugera mu murwa mukuru i Kinshasa no mu bihugu bituranye.

Aho iki cyorezo kimaze kugera Abishinzwe ubuzima bavuga ko muri uyu mujyi wa Mbandaka utuwe mu bucucuke  n’abaturage bagera kuri miliyoni, Ebola ishobora gufata indi ntera, uburyo bwonyine bwo guhangana mu buryo bworoshye n’iki cyorezo bukaba bushoboka mu gihe abantu batuye mu buryo butatanye. World Health Organization ivuga ko kuva aho iki cyorezo cyongeye kubonekera tariki ya 8 Gicurasi 2018, ubu hamaze kugaragara abantu 58 bakekwaho Ebola, aho 27muri bo bamaze gupfa.

title: Ubushinwa: Hadutse amashuri yigisha abagabo urugamba rwo kureshya no gutereta abagore
content: Ubushinwa ni igihugu gituwe n’abasaga miliyari 1,3 aho ibarura ryo mu 2016 ryagaragaje ko umubare w’abagabo urengaho miliyoni 33,6 ku mubare w’abagore, birumvikana ko kugira ngo ubone umugore w’inzozi zawe ari urugamba mu zindi, ariko bikaba bishobora byibuze kurohera umuhanga mu kureshya no gutereta cyangwa uwabyize. Mu gihe kandi muri iki gihugu usanga amasaha menshi baba bari mu kazi ntihaboneke umwanya uhagije wo kwidagadura, gukoresha amatelefone ndetse no kujya kuri internet bikaba bitakwizeza 100% ko wabona umugore wifuza, bamwe barebye kure maze batangiza amashuri yigisha abagabo kureshya no gutereta byimbitse bakaba banabafasha kubahuza n’abagore. Abo batoza bihariye b’abahanga mu byo kureshya igitsinagore, ngo bigisha abagabo kugira ngo bazabashe kumva neza abagore no kumenya uburyo babagusha neza kuko ari bacye kandi bashakwa na benshi bityo uwo wabonye bigusaba kumwemeza kugira ngo umwegukane. Kugira ngo uwiga azabashe gutsinda ikizamini cyo kuba yasohokana n’umukunzi bari bonyine kandi bigacamo, asabwa gukurikirana amasomo ari ku giciro cya 4,500 by’amadorali (ni ukuvuga asaga miliyoni eshatu n’ibihumbi 800frw), aha umwarimu akaba ashobra no kukwigisha uri wenyine. Mu gihe abandi bo bahitamo kwigira ayo masomo kuri murandasi, ari byo bidahenze,  aho bishyura amadorali 30 (25, 400frw) kuri buri somo. Mu bindi kandi bigendana n’ayo masomo harimo kwigishwa amasomo yo kubyina hanyuma ukanigishwa imitekerereze y’igitsinagore n’uburyo bwo kuganira. Kwambara bikurura abagore, insokozo n’inyogosho y’ubwanwa, imibavu n’imirimbo bikwiye, n’ibindi by’ingenzi washingiraho wigarurira umutima w’uwo wakunze na byo ni bimwe mu byigishwa. Nyuma yo kumara igihe abanyeshuri biga aya masomo mu magambo n’inyandiko gusa (théorie), bagera aho bakinjira mu gikorwa nyirizina aho baba bakurikiwe n’ibyuma bifata amashusho byihishe(camera cachée) kugira ngo baze kureba amakosa yabo maze babashe kuyakosora iyo bageze mu mwanya wo kwinenga no kurebera aho babyiciye. Ngo ikigereranyo cy’imyaka y’abakunze kwitabira ayo masomo bari hagati y’imyaka 23 na 33. Ariko Yi Cui, watangije ikigo cyitwa Love Power, avuga ko mu ishuri rye umunyeshuri muto urimo afite imyaka 19 naho umukuru akagira 59. Tubibutse ko ngo intego y’aya mashuri ari ukwigisha urubyiruko rw’abashinwa uburyo babasha kureshya no gutereta abagore bababereye.

title: AGASHYA: Urukiko rwasabye ko hapimwa ingano y’igitsina cy’uregwa
content: Urukiko rwo mu gihugu cya Nouvelles Zelandes rwategetse ko hapimwa ingano y’igitsina cy’uregwa mu rubanza ashinjwamo ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina. Urukiko rwafashe uyu mwanzuro nyuma y’uko uwaregaga yari yahamije ko azi neza ingano y’igitsina cy’uwo arega. David Scott, uregwa we ahamya ko arengana ndetse agahakana yivuye inyuma ibyo aregwa. David arashinjwa n’umwe mu bagore yakoreshaga umwaka washize, uvuga ko uyu mugabo yamukubye igitsina mu mugongo, ariko we akiregura avuga ko uyu mugore ashobora kuba yaritiranyije ibintu ikaba ari nk’ikofi ye cyangwa telefoni yari mu mufuka w’ipantaro yamukozeho. Uyu mugore we ahamya neza ko azi itandukaniro ry’igitsina na telefoni ndetse akemeza ko icyo gitsina cyari gifite santimetero hagati y’icumi na 12. Umucamanza wababuranishaga yahise afata umwanzuro, maze asaba umuganga w’uregwa kwihererana na we maze agapima indeshyo y’igitsina cye ngo barebe ko bihuza n’ibyo umurega avuga, gusa ntiyigeze atangaza ibyavuyemo.

title: Ku myaka 121, Garcia Hernandez ashobora kuba ari we muntu ushaje kurusha abandi ku isi
content:
Uyu musaza worora inkoko mu rugo rwe ruri mu majyaruguru ya Mexico, nk’uko ibyangombwa bye birimo indangamuntu n’inyandiko y’ivukabibigaragaza, akaba amaze imyaka 121 ku isi. Manuel Garcia Hernandez yavutse ku ya 24 Ukuboza mu wa 1896, ariko ntiyigeze ashaka kumenyesha Guinness des Records ngo abamenyeshe ko aruta benshi bafatwa nk’abashaje kurusha abandi ku isi.

Manuel Garcia ashobora kuba ariwe muntu uruta abariho bose ku isi Imyaka ye iramutse yemejwe, Garcia yakwambura izina ry’umuntu ushaje kurusha abandi ku isi, umusaza w’umuyapani Masazo Nonaka ufite imyaka 113, wavutse ku ya 25 Nyakanga, 1905. Aganira na AFP, Garcia yahamije ko nubwo ashaje, we yumva akimeze nk’ufite imyaka 80. Ati “Ndanezerewe ariko ndananiwe. Nkoresha uko nshoboye, kuko ndamutse ngumye mu buriri cyangwa nkicara ntacyo nkora, narwara. Mba numva meze nkaho mfite imyaka 80, ariko rimwe na rimwe hari ubwo ngwa ntakingwishije.”

Nubwo afite intege nke, ntiyishimira kuguma iwe aryamye Uyu mugabo atuye ahitwa Ciudad Juarez ku mupaka w’iki gihugu na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika akaba abana n’umukobwa we witwa Tomasa. Nubwo ananiwe cyane ariko Garcia ahora avuga ko ababazwa cyane no kuba atakibasha gukora nka mbere kuko kuriwe umurimo aricyo kimufasha kubaho. Ati“Nakwishimira gukora nk’uko nakoraga mbere, sinkibishoboye, mba numva bimbabaje. Nkiri muto nari umukozi cyane, ariko ubu byararangiye. Mba nita ku nkoko zanjye, bitabaye ibyo nicwa n’agahinda.”

Yorora inkoko Guinness des Records yo ivuga ko biramutse aribyo koko ariwe wafatwa nk’umusaza uruta abariho bose ariko ko bisaba ko abavugisha hanyuma hagakorwa ubushakashatsi bwimbitse. Uwitwa Alice Pagan uyikorera yabwiye AFP ati “Dusaba ibyangombwa byinshi ndetse tugakora n’ubushakashatsi bwimbitse.” Kugeza ubu umuntu wanditswe muri Guiness de Records nk’uwamaze imyaka myinshi ku isi, mu bagabo n’abagore ni umufaransakazi witwaga Jeanne Calment, wapfuye muri 1997 ku myaka 122 n’iminsi 164.

title: Umunyamerika yarashwe n’imbwa ye, ubu ari mu bitaro!
content: Richard Remme w’imyaka 51 y’amavuko, akaba atuye Iowa, yakomerekejwe n’isasu yarashwe n’imbwa ye ku wa Gatatu w’iki cyumweru. Ibi byabaye ngo ubwo uyu mugabo yarimo akina n’iyi mbwa ye yitwa Balew maze ubwo yayururutsaga ashaka kuyishyira hasi, ihita imusimbukira ishaka kugaruka ku mavi ya sebuja ari nabwo yaje guhita ikora mu mbarutso dore ko uyu mugabo yari akenyereye ku mukandara pisitori(pistolet). “Narindi mu ntebe (canapé) aho twakoraga ubusazi(tunezerewe), imbwa hamwe nanjye. Nayimanuye ku mavi yanjye maze ihita igaruka isimbutse”, Richard Remme aganira na The Messenger. Iri sasu ngo ryafashe mu kuguru, maze uyu mugabo ahita ahamagara numero y’ubutabazi (911) aho kuvaku wa Kane ari mu bitaro. Ati “Narashwe n’imbwa yanjye.” Umuyobozi wa Polisi mu mujyi wa Fort Dodge, Roger Porter yatangarije Messenger ko ari ubwa mbere yari yumvise ibyo bintu. Ati “Ntabwo nari narigeze numva ikintu nk’icyo.” “ Kuraswa n’imbwa yawe nta handi bibauretse muri Amerika ”, amagambo yavuzwe na Shannon Watts washinze umuryango witwa ‘Moms Demand Action for Gun Sense in America’, urwanya ikwirakwizwa ry’intwaro muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.

title: Zimbabwe: Yashakanye n’umukunzi we wamukijije ingona imaze kumuca ukuboko –Amafoto& Video
content:
Nyuma y’iminsi mike ishize asagariwe n’ingona ikamuca akaboko, umunyazimbabwekazi yakoze ubukwe bw’agatangaza bwabereye kwa muganga ashyingiranwa n’umukunzi we wanamurokoye. Mu ikanzu nziza y’umweru, ukuboko kwe kw’iburyo ku gipfutse aho kwacikiye, Zanele Ndlovu-Fox yabwiye ‘Yego’ umukunzi we Jamie Fox mu cyumba cy’amasengesho (chapelle) cy’ibitaro bya Bulawayo ahari hateraniye abatumirwa bagera muri 60 mu mpera z’icyumweru gishize.

Bakoze ubukwe umukobwa akiri kwa muganga Ni nyuma y’iminsi mike ubwo aba bombi bari mu biruhuko ku isumo (chutes) ya Victoria, uyu mukobwa ubwo yari mu bwato buto bwa ‘canot pneumatique’ ku ruzi rwa Zambèze ari nabwo yaje kuribwa n’ingona.  “Ingona yaturutse mu mazi maze ihita irya igice cy’ukuboko kwanjye hamwe n’agace k’ubwato.”, Zanele Ndlovu-Fox aganira n’ikinyamakuru Herald.

Zanele Ndlovu-Fox na Jamie Fox urukundo n’ubukwe bwabo byamamaye ku isi kubera ibihe bikomeye banyuzemo


Nyuma y’iminsi itanu gusa ariwe n’ingona yahise akoraubukwe n’umukunzi we wanamukijije iyo ngona Zanele Ndlovu-Fox avuga ko yakijijwe n’umugabo we wahise atabara. Yakomeje abisobanura ati “Ingona yongeye kunsingira maze injugunya mu mazi, hanyuma araza (umukunzi we) atangira kuyikubita ari nako amfashe mu nda.” Zanele yahise yerekezwa kwa muganga na kajugujugu, aho yahise acibwa ukuboko ingona yari yariye inshuro 2 zose. “Nibwiye ko ari urwenya, ko ari umuntu wari watwihishe. Ibi bintu byatumye numva neza igisobanuro cy’urukundo rwacu…Mu byiza no mu bibi, mu buzima no mu burwayi. Ntabwo nigeze ntekereza n’isegonda na rimwe guhagarika ubukwe.”, Jamie Fox wakijije umukunzi we akamuvana mu kanwa k’ingona.

Jamie Fox na Zanele Ndlovu-Fox atararibwa n’ingona


Ibyishimo byari byose kuri bombi

Jamie Fox ni umwongereza naho umukunzi we ni umunyazimbabwekazi Imigezi myinshi muri Zimbabwe yuzuyemo ingona zikunze gusagarira ba mukerarugendo n’abaturage begeranye nayo. Muri Werurwe uyu mwaka abarinzi bishe ingona yari yarabibye ubwoba mu baturage mu mu mujyi muto uri mu majyaruguru y’iki gihugu wa Hwange aho yari yarafunze inzira igana ku bitaro.

title: Gicumbi: Umusore wari ufite akamenyero ko gusambanya amatungo yo mu rugo, yabikoreye intama izana amagara -AMAFOTO
content:
Mu kagari ka Gihembe, mu murenge wa Kageyo mu karere ka Gicumbi ho mu ntara y’Amajyaruguru haravugwa inkuru idasanzwe y’umusore w’imyaka 27 y’amavuko wasambanije intama ikazana amagara nyuma agahita atoroka. Nk’uko tubikesha TV1 uyu musore ngo wari uzwi ku kazina ka ‘Gacengo’ yari asanzwe aba mu nkambi y’impunzi z’abanya-Kongo ya Gihembe ndetse akaba yogoshaga mu gasantere.

Uyu musore ngo yasanze iyi ntama muri iki kiraro, ubundi ayikorera ibya mpfurambi “Naje mbona arimo arunama akunamuka akongera akunama, maze ambonye ahita arorera kongera kunama, mbona aranzamukanye aza ansaga. Yitwa Gacengo ni umuhungu wogosha kuri salon iri ruguru y’iwanjye, ni we wari uri hejuru y’iyo ntama.”, umukecuru wasambanirijwe intama ubwo yaganiraga na Tv1. Uyu mukecuru yongeyeho ati “Yayirongoye, yayizanishije amagara, yazanye amara. None rero intama yanjye rwose igiye gupfa. Akimara kuyiva hejuru yazamutse ari kuntuka ibitutsi byinshi, nanjye muzamuka inyuma mvuga nti ‘muntabere Gacengo anyiciye intama’. Ubu koko ko nari nyoroye nyikunze kandi narayiguze nk’ubu ngubu rwose mwamarira iki kugira ngo nibura nzongere norore ko itazabaho.”

Bigaragara ko iyi ntama yababaye cyane Ibi kandi byemezwa na bamwe mu baturanyi b’uyu mukecuru ndetse bavuga ko atari ubwambere uyu musore abikora. Umugore umwe yagize ati “Njyewe ku mugoroba nahageze bikimara kuba, iyo aza kuba ari umuntu yabikoreye aba yashwanyaguritse yapfuye, ntabwo aba akiriho. Ndikumva bashakisha uriya muhungu, ndikubona na we atari muzima.”

Uyu mugore we ahamya ko iyo ibyakorewe iyi ntama iyo bikorerwa umuntu aba yashwanyaguritse! Undi mugabo yunzemo ati “Ahari yari yasaze kuko ntabwo warongora intama uri umuntu muzima, ariko bavuga ko atari nabwo bwa mbere n’ubundi asanzwe abikora.” Undi mukecuru we uri mu kigero cy’imyaka 60 yavuze ko habuze gato ngo uyu musore na we amufate ku ngufu gusa ngo yakijijwe nuko yamurumye maze aranatabaza. Yagize ati “Uwo watunze intama, yigeze kumfatira imbere ya hariya kwa pasiteri Claude Mutabazi, mukizwa n’umugore wa Claude Mutabazi, atangiye kunkubita inshyi mu maso, icyo namukoreye namuciye umunwa mo kabiri, ntabwo yandangije, njye namurumye umunwa. Urumva ko ari akamenyero.”

Uyu mukecuru ngo uwafashe intama nawe yari agiye kumufata ariko yirwanaho amuruma umunwa awucamo kabiri Mwine Ronald umunyamabanga Nshwingwa Bikorwa w’akagari ka Gihembe yatangaje ko uyu mugabo ari gushakishwa. Yagize ati “Kugeza ubu ngubu uyu muhungu yatorotse ntabwo tuzi aho ari, turacyamushakisha, turakorana n’inzego z’umutekano zo mu nkambi, twabimenyesheje na polisi n’izindi nzego z’umutekano zibishinzwe kugira ngo zimudufashe, cyane cyane izo mu nkambi kugira ngo tumufate ashobore kwisobanura."

Mwine Ronald, gitifu wa Kagali ka Kageyo Gitifu yongeyeho ati "Ubwo uwo mukecuru turaza kureba intama ye tubifashijwemo n’impuguke veterineri w’umurenge apime iyo ntama, nibiza kumenyekana ko koko yangijwe ubwo uwo musore ashobora no kumuriha intama ye.”

Intama yahohotewe yacitse intege Muri aka karere ka Gicumbi kandi mu murenge wa Byumba hari uwasambanije inka yamwene nyina hanyuma baza kumuzirikira ku kiraro bategereje abayobozi nk’uko Tv1 yakomeje ibitangaza. Umwe mu babonye ibi yagize ati “ Hepfo iyi uwitwa Ndekezi na we yafashe inka, bamuzirikiye ku kiraro bategereje ko abayobozi baza. Yagiye mu kiraro cya mwene nyina ajya gufata inka, bamuzirikiyemo yambaye ubusa.” Ingingo y’i 186 mu gitabo cy’amategeko ahana ibyaha mu Rwanda ivuga ko ukoresheje itungo imibonano mpuzabitsina ahanishwa igifungo kuva ku mezi atandatu kugeza ku myaka ibiri.

Uyu mukobwa we yahamije ko inkumi zitabuze ko ahubwo iki ari ikibazo aba basore bifitiye

title: Urumogi rusaga igice cya toni rwaburiwe irengero mu bubiko bwa polisi, ishinja imbeba kurunyereza
content: Mu gihugu cya Argentine hamaze iminsi havugwa inkuru idasanzwe aho ibiro 540 by’urumogi byari mu bubiko bw’imwe muri burigade ishinzwe guhashya ibiyobyabwenge muri Argentine byaburiwe irengero mu buryo budasobanutse maze abapolisi bashyirwaga mu majwi bagereka icyaha ku mbeba. Nk’uko CNews yabitangaje ngo ibiro ibihumbi bitandatu( 6000 kg) by’urumogi ni byo byari byarafashwe mu myaka ibiri ishize maze bibikwa ahitwa Pilar mu birometero 60 uvuye Buenos Aires, gusa ubwo biheruka gusuzumwa hasanzwe hasigaye ibiro 5 460, byumvikana ko hafi igice cya toni cyose cyaburiwe irengero. Emilio Portero, komiseri mushya ni we watangije iperereza nyuma yo gukemanga aho ibi biyobyabwenge byari byarakusanyirijwe. Nyuma yo gukekwa komiseri ucyuye igihe, Javier Specia hamwe n’abo bakoranaga baje kubwira bashize amanga umushinjacyaha witwa Adrian Gonzalez Charvay ko imbeba arizo zagiye zirya buhoro buhoro uru rumogi kugeza ubwo zamaraga ibiro 540. Nk’uko abahanga bagiye babisobanura, ibi bisobanuro by’aba bapolisi birasa nk’ibidashoboka, ntabwo inkegesi (rongeurs) zarya ibiro bingana gutyo by’urumogi. Ngo ibi biramutse bibaye byibuze hari kuboneka imbeba zapfuye kubera guhumana(intoxication).Ariko nanone umubare munini w’imbeba wifitemo ubushobozi bwo kurya icyo gice cya toni gusa nanone zifitemo ubushobozi bwo gutandukanya urumogi n’ibyo kurya bisanzwe, nk’uko byemejwe na The Garduan. Kugeza ubu iperereza rirakomeje kugira ngo hagaragare abapolisi bagize uburangare cyangwa se baba ari bo banyereje ibi biyobyabwenge byaburiwe irengero. Src:7sur7

title: Abageni 2 bataye ubukwe bwabo bajya mu kizamini
content:
Mu gihugu cya Nigeria abakobwa 2 bavuye mu bukwe bwabo hagati bajya ku ishuri mu kizamini. Dorcas Atsea na Deborah Atoh ni abakobwa babiri bari barateguye ubukwe ku itariki ya 7 Mata, 2018 ariko baza kugira ikibazo cy’uko ikizamini bari bafite ku ishuri cyigijwe inyuma kivanwa ku itariki yacyo gishyirwa kuri iyi tariki y’ubukwe bwabo. Bakoresheje uko bashoboye binginga abayobozi b’ishuri ryabo ngo babahindurire umunsi w’ikizamini ariko ntibyakunda bityo basanga nta kundi babigenza uretse kuva mu bukwe bagakora ikizamini kuko no gusubika ubukwe nabyo bitari gushoboka.

 Ntibashoboraga gusubika ubukwe bwabo, ariko ntibagombaga no gusiba ikizamini  Deborah aganira na CNN yagize ati "Ubukwe bwanjye bwari bwaramaze gutegurwa, narabwiye abantu bose ko nzashyingirwa ku ya 7 Mata ndetse narohereje n’impapuro z’ubutumire. Twahisemo rero kudahindura umunsi w’ubukwe ahubwo tubikora kuriya." Aba bageni bombi rero, nyuma yo gusezerana imbere y’Imana bahise bihutira ku ishuri ryabo maze bakora ikizamini babona gusanga abandi mu birori byo kwiyakira.
