title: Umwana w’imyaka 7 mu bahize abandi mu marushanwa ya ’Andika Rwanda 2019’
content:
Kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 21 Kamena 2019, Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe guteza imbere Uburezi (REB), ku bufatanye n’umushinga wa USAID Soma Umenye, batangaje ku mugaragaro urutonde rw’abana bahize abandi k’urwego rw’Igihugu mu marushanwa ngarukamwaka ya ’Andika Rwanda’. Mu 2014 nibwo Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe guteza imbere Uburezi (REB ) cyatangije amarushanwa ya ’Andika Rwanda’ ari ku rwego rw’igihugu agamije kwandikira abana inkuru zishimishije kugira ngo batozwe umuco wo gusoma. Ubwo yabaga ku nshuro ya 3, aya marushanwa yeguriwe USAID Soma Umenye, umushinga w’imyaka itanu (2016-2021) ugamije kuzamura umubare w’abanyeshuri bamenya gusoma no kwandika Ikinyarwanda neza batararenga umwaka wa 3 w’amashuri abanza.

Angelique Tusiime, Umuyobozi Mukuru wungirije w’ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe guteza imbere uburezi (REB) Nkuko byasobanuwe n’Umuyobozi Mukuru wungirije w’ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe guteza imbere uburezi, Angelique Tusiime aya marushanwa yitabirwa n’abanyeshuri biga mu mashuri abanza, ayisumbuye n’inderaburezi, maze bagahimba inkuru cyangwa imivugo by’umwimerere biri mu kinyarwanda. Aya marushanwa atangirira ku bigo by’amashuri, bagatoranyamo ibihangano byahize ibindi bikajyanwa ku karere nako kagatoranyamo ibirusha ibindi, bikazamuka ku rwego rw’intara kugeza bigeze ku rwego rw’igihugu. Muri uyu mwaka wa 2019 hatsinze abana 30 (hatoranijwe umwana umwe muri buri karere)  barimo abakobwa 21 n’abahungu 9. Umwana muto urimo afite imyaka 7 akaba yitwa Giraso Ella Parfaite wiga mu mwaka wa 4 w’amashuri abanza kuri G.S Kiruri mu karere ka Rulindo, uyu yahimbye umuvugo witwa "Reka guhohotera umwana". Muri rusange ku mashuri yose hari hakiriwe ibihangano ibihumbi 102,634 maze hatoranywamo ibihangano ibihumbi 30,615 byoherejwe ku mirenge nayo ibitanga ku turere, mu gihe ibihangano byatoranijwe ku turere bikoherezwa muri REB byari 450  ari nabyo byavuyemo 30 byatsinze ku rwego rw’igihugu.
 Umuyobozi Mukuru wungirije w’ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe guteza imbere uburezi, Angelique Tusiime yashimiye umushinga wa Soma Umenye ubafasha kuva mu 2017 gushyira mu bikorwa aya marushanwa, avuga ko uretse gukundisha abana umuco wo gusoma no kwandika, muri ibi bihangano banakuramo ’imfashanyigisho’’ Angelique Tusiime yagize ati "Birimo gutanga umusaruro. Abana baragenda barushaho kubyitabira kandi bararushaho no ku bikunda. (…) Tunejejwe n’aya marushanwa kuko umwana utazi kwandika ntiyamenya gusoma."

 Umuyobozi ushinzwe uburezi muri USAID-Rwanda, Luann Gronhovd (wa kabiri uturutse ibumoso) Ku ruhande rwa Luann Gronhovd wari uhagarariye USAID Rwanda, yavuze ko bishimiye gukomeza gufatanya na REB kuzamura umuco wo gusoma bahereye ku bana batararenga umwaka wa 3 w’amashuri abanza. Yakomeje avuga ko iyo bamaze kunononsora ibihangano byiza, bikorwamo udutabo bakwirakwiza mu bigo by’amashuri yose ya Leta n’afashwa nayo. Ikimonyo n’umuswa, Inkomoko y’amashyuza, Imvura n’izuba,Mugabo n’icyana cy’inyoni, Twirinde kuzerera, Nzakugirira akamaro Rwanda, Umusambi n’inuma bikora umugati, Bakame n’akanyamasyo, Isazi yahemukiye ikimonyo…ibi ni bimwe mu bihangano 30 byaturanijwe.

Itangazamakuru ryari ryaje gukurikirana iki gikorwa Biteganijwe ko aba bana bahize abandi bazahembwa ibihembo bitandukanye bishimishije birimo no gutegurirwa amahugurwa yo kunoza no kunononsora inkuru zabo neza nkuko REB yabitangaje ku bufatanye na USAID Soma Umenye bakaba banateganya gushaka abahanga mu nkuru zishushanyije kugira ngo bazashushanye ibi bihangano birusheho gukurura no kuryohera abana bigenewe.

title: IEE na Mastercard batangije umushinga ugamije gukundisha ’ubwarimu’ abakobwa 150 batsinze neza siyansi
content:
Umuryango utegamiye kuri leta ufasha mu burezi, Inspire Empower and Educate (IEE), ufatanije na MasterCard foundation hamwe n’ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe uburezi (REB) batangije igeragezwa ry’umushinga ugamije gukundisha abana b’abahanga umwuga w’ubwarimu no gukundisha amasomo ya siyanse abana b’abakobwa. Ni umushinga wiswe ’Teaching Assistantship Project’ aho bafashe abana b’abakobwa bagera ku 150 batsinze neza amasomo ya siyanse mu bizamini bya leta bisoza umwaka wa 6 w’amashuri yisumbuye maze boherezwa mu mashuri 73 aherereye mu turere 15 two mu ntara zose z’igihugu ngo barebe uko abarimu bigisha, banafashe abana kumva neza amasomo. Ubwo uyu mushinga wamurikagwa ku mugaragaro kuri uyu Gatanu tariki ya 31 Gicurasi 2019, Murenzi Emmanuel, umuyobozi wa Inspire Empower and Educate yatangarije itangazamakuru ko "Ni umushinga uri mu igeragezwa ngo turebe niba koko ushobora kubyara umusaruro." 
Murenzi Emmanuel, Umuyobozi ku rwego rw’igihugu wa Inspire Empower and Educate Uyu muyobozi avuga ko uyu mushinga ugiye kugeragezwa ku ikubitiro mu gihe cy’umwaka, aho aba bana b’abakobwa basanzwe barishyuriwe na Mastercard na FAWE aho kwicara umwaka wose ntacyo bakora mu gihe bagitegereje kwinjira muri kaminuza, ubu barimo bifashishwa mu gufasha bagenzi babo kumva neza amasomo biga mu cyiciro rusange (tronc commun), ari nako nabo biga uko umwuga w’ubwarimu ukorwa. Murenzi Emmanuel avuga ko intego nyamukuru y’uyu mushinga ari ebyiri harimo gukundisha abana b’abahanga umwuga w’uburezi no kubifashisha mu kwereka bagenzi babo b’abakobwa ko nabo bakwiga siyansi kandi bagatsinda neza. Yagize ati "Ibi tubifata nk’amahirwe akomeye mu gihe bamwe muri aba bana baba bakunze uburezi bazaba ari abarimu b’abahanga bizamure rya reme ry’uburezi twirirwa tuvuga ko ari ikibazo, ikindi aba bana baba nk’abahuza hagati y’abanyeshuri n’abarimu babo kuko barabegera bakumva aho bafite ibibazo mu masomo yabo kandi by’umwihariko batinyura abana b’abakobwa babereka ko nabo bakwiga siyanse aho kumva ko ikomeye ndetse ari iy’abahungu gusa." Kayirangwa Marie Assumpta, umwe mu barezi bafasha aba bana kwibona mu mwuga w’ubwarimu aho afite abana 11 b’abakobwa akurikirana mu bigo bitanu byo muri Gasabo, avuga ko mu kwezi kumwe amaranye nabo abona hari umusaruro uyu mushinga uzabyara ushimishije. Kayirangwa Marie Asumpta  ati "Ikigamijwe ni ukubakundisha umwuga w’ubwarimu kandi ntibawukunda bari hanze, bigira ku barimu. Tumaranye ukwezi bari mu mashuri, ariko ubu bamwe bamaze kuba abarimu, iyo umubajije arakubwira ngo ndi mwarimu, urabona ko hari ikintu kigenda gihinduka muri bo." Kayirangwa yakomeje ati "Ubundi abantu bishyiragamo ko umwarimu ari umuntu w’umuswa ariko uyu mushinga washingiye ku bana b’abahanga cyane cyane bize siyansi,..tugize amahirwe bakabikunda mu by’ukuri abarimu b’ejo hazaza bazaba ari abarimu bafite ireme ry’uburezi, iyi akaba ariyo ntego cyane cyane y’uyu mushinga." Umwe muri aba bana witwa Ishimwe Ange Liza uri gukurikiranira iyi gahunda ku kigo cya Saint Famille i Kigali, we avuga ko atarinjira muri iyi gahunda yabonaga ubwarimu ari umwuga uciriritse mu buryo bwo kubyara amafaranga ku buryo atanashoboraga kurota kubukora cyangwa kugira uwo abishishikariza ariko ubu ngo iyo mitekerereze yarahindutse. Ati "umwarimu ashobora gukora cyane akagira ahantu agera kandi umwuga w’ubwarimu ni umwuga mwiza cyane kuko iyo urimo uratanga ibyo wahawe nawe wumva biguteye ishema kuko uba unubaka igihugu. Kugeza ubu ubwarimu ndabukunze nubwo bitavuze ko  ari wo mwuga nzakurikira ariko nshobora no kuwukundisha abandi kandi aho uri hose njye nsanga ushobora kuba umwarimu."

Bafashe ifoto y’urwibutso Aba bana uko ari 150 bagiye bagabanywa mu bigo bakurikije ibyegereye aho batuye ariko hejuru y’ibyo banahabwa amafaranga abafasha mu rugendo bava iwabo bagera kuri ibi bigo, ikindi nuko ibi bigo nabyo byahise bigenerwa ibikoresho byifashishwa muri laboratwari.

title: Alabama: Habonetse ibisigazwa by’ubwato bwa nyuma ’bwatwaye ABACAKARA muri Amerika’
content:
Clotilda, ubwato bwa nyuma bwamenyekanye cyane kubera gukoreshwa mu gutunda abacakara bavaga ku mugabane wa Afurika bajya ku mugabane wa Amerika, kuri ubu bwabonetse nyuma y’umwaka hatangijwe iperereza ribuganishaho. Ibisigazwa by’ubu bwato bikaba byagaragaye ku ndiba y’umugezi wa Mobile uherereye muri Alabama muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Ubu bwato bwa Clotilda bwakoreshwaga rwihishwa cyangwa se mu ibanga mu gutwara abagabo, abagore n’abana ba Afurika berekezwa muri Amerika. Ubu bwato bwatangiye gukora mu ibanga nyuma y’imyaka isaga 10 hateranye inama (Congrès) yaciye ubu bucuruzi bw’abacakara, kugeza ubwo mu 1860 bwarohamye bigambiriwe kugira ngo hahishwe ibimenyetso bw’uko bwakoreshwaga. "Ubuvumbuzi bwa Clotilda ni ubuvumbuzi bw’ibyataburuwe (archéologique) budasanzwe", Lisa Demetropoulos Jones, umuyobozi mukuru wa Alabama Historical Commission (AHC) aganira n’IBiro Ntaramakuru bya Associated Press (AP). Yakomeje avuga ko ubu bwato "bugaragaza kimwe mu bihe bikomeye by’umwijima by’ikiragano cy’amateka y’isi y’ubu."

Aha ni i Nantes mu Bufaransa ahashyizwe ikimenyetso cyo kwibuka gucika k’ubucakara Ubu bwato bwa Clotilda bwavumbuwe n’ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi bw’ibyataburuwe Search Inc, cyari cyahamagawe na Komisiyo y’ibyamateka muri Alabama ngo igihe ubufasha mu gukora iperereza ku bisigazwa by’ubu bwato nkuko byemejwe na National Geographic Society yatangaje iyi nkuru y’ubu buvumbuzi. Abashakashatsi babonye ubwato ku ndiba y’amazi n’ibirango byawo biburanga mu gace k’umugezi wa Mobile nkuko byasobanuwe na National Geographic muri iri tangazo ry’iyi komisiyo ryakomeje rivuga ko ingano n’ibyubakishije iki gisate cyabonetse bihura neza n’ibya Clotilda. "Turigengesera cyane iyo bigeze ku bijyanye no gutanga amazina ku bisigazwa bitagaragaza ibirango cyangwa ikindi cyose nk’ikimenyetso kigaragaza izina ry’ubwato. Ariko ibisigazwa twabonye bigaragaza mu buryo bukomeye ibimenyetso bifatika n’ibyanditse ko ari Clotilda.", umuvumbuzi w’ibyatabwe mu mazi James Delgado mu itangazo. Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika yaciye burundu kugurwa kw’abacakara mu 1808, ariko ubucuruzi bw’abacakara bavanwa muri Afurika bajyanwa muri Amerika bwarakomenye nyuma y’icyo gihe kuko hari hakiri ubusabe bwinshi cyane bwaturukaga kuri ba nyiri mirima y’ubuhinzi basaba abakoze mu mirima y’igice cy’amajyepfo. Abanya-Benin ni bo ba Nyafurika ba nyuma bagiye muri Clotilda Umukire witwaga Timothy Meaher wari ufite ubutaka bunini bw’ubuhinzi akanaba umwubatsi w’ubwato ngo yateze n’abagabo b’abacuruzi bo mu majyaruguru ko azajya atambutsa imizigo y’abacakara b’abanyafurika ku kigobe cya Mobile anyuze mu  bakozi ba leta nkuko bitangazwa na National Geographic. Abanyamateka bavuga ko ubu bwato bwa Clotilda bwari butwaye abantu 110 barimo abagabo, abagore n’abana bari bavanwe muri Bénin berekejwe Alabama mu 1860.

title: Ramadan: Ese kwiyiriza ubusa bigira izihe ngaruka mu mubiri?
content:
Buri mwaka, ku isi yose abayisilamu bafata iminsi 30 yo kwiyiriza ubusa basenga mu gisibo cya Ramadan buri munsi kuva umuseke utambitse kugeza izuba rirenze. Nubwo hari benshi bashobora kwibwira ko kwiyiriza ubusa bibangamira ubuzima, ubushakashatsi bwakoze bwagaragaje ko ibi ahubwo ngo byaba bifasha umubiri mu buryo bwo kubungabunga ubuzima. Biragorana mu minsi 2 ya mbere Umubiri w’umuntu umenya ko wiyirije ubusa nyuma y’amasaha 8 utagize icyo urya cyangwa ngo unywe. Nicyo gihe amara aba amaze gukura intungamubiri zose mubyo kurya uba wafashe. Iyo iki gihe gishize umubiri uhita utangira gukoresha isukari (glucose) iba yibitse mu mwijima no mu mikaya, kugira ngo umuntu akomeze kugira imbaraga. Iyo ibi bishize, umubiri utangira kuvoma imbaraga mu binure.

Ifunguro ry’uwiyirije rigomba kuba ryuzuye Iyo umubiri utangiye gutwika cyangwa kwifashisha ibinure, ibi bituma umuntu atangira gutakaza ibiro, amavuta akagabanuka mu mubiri ndetse ibyago byo kurwara diyabete bikaba hafi ya ntabyo. Gusa ibi ni ibyo kwitonderwa cyane kuko kugabanuka kw’isukari mu maraso gutera gucika intege n’umunaniro. Aha niho ushobora kugaragaza ibimenyetso bitandukanye nko kuribwa umutwe, umunaniro mwinshi, isesemi n’impumuro mbi yo mu kanwa. Aho niho inzara iba yatangiye kuba nyinshi. Itondere umwuma hagati y’umunsi wa 3 n’uwa 7 Kuko umubiri uba utangiye kumenyera kwirirwa utariye ndetse utanyoye, ibinure bitangira guhinduka isukari ijya mu maraso, ibitera umubiri gukenera amazi menshi. Kuko uwiyirije ubusa anywa gake, ni ngombwa cyane ko mu mafunguro afata agomba kwibanda cyane ku kunywa kugira ngo yirinde umwuma kandi mu byo afata hagomba kuba harimo amasukari akirinda n’ibinure byinshi. Amafunguro kandi agomba kubamo ibitera imbaraga ndetse n’ibyubaka umubiri cyane. Ni iby’ingenzi cyane gufata amafunguro arimo porotoyine, umunyu n’amazi. Umubiri umenyera neza hagati y’umunsi wa 8 n’uwa 15 Muri iki gice cya 3, umuntu aba atagiye kumva kwiyiriza ubusa ari akamenyero kuko umubiri uba umaze kujya kuri iyi gahunda. Dr Razeen Mahroof, umujyanama mu byo gusinziriza abarwayi ndetse no kuvura indembe mu bitaro bya Addenbrooke i Cambridge, we avuga ko uretse ibi, burya igisibo kigira izindi nyungu nyinshi kizanira umubiri w’umuntu.

Abiyirije ubusa bashishikarizwa kwita ku mirire yabo mu gihe amasaha yo kujya ku meza ageze "Mu buzima bwa buri munsi, turya ibivumbikisho (calories) byinshi, ibi bikaba byabuza umubiri wacu gukora indi mirimo nko kwisana (kwiyubaka). Ibi bikosoka mu gihe cy’igisibo, aho umubiri uba uretse ibyo kwita kuri ibi ahubwo ugafata n’izindi nshingano. Kwiyiriza ubusa rero bishobora koroshya, kurinda ndetse no kurwanya indwara zitandukanye." Umunsi wa 16 kugeza Igisibo kirangiye Mu gice cya kabiri cy’Igisibo, umubiri w’umuntu uba waramaze kumenyera neza cyane kwiyiriza ubusa. Amara, umwijima, impyiko n’uruhu biba biri mu gihe cyo kwikuramo imyanda cyangwa ibihumanya umubiri (cure de détoxification). "Kuri iki kigero cy’igisibo, ubuzima bw’usiba buba bwakangutse ku rugero rwuzuye. Ubwonko buba bukora neza kurushaho ndetse n’imbaraga ziba ziyongereye.", nk’uko bisobanurwa na Dr Mahroof. Akomeza agira ati "Umubiri w’umuntu ntuba ugikoresha ibiva mu byo umuntu arya kugira ngo ubone imbaraga. Iki nicyo gihe umuntu aba yinjiye mu gihe cy’inzara iremereye, bityo umubiri ugatangira kuvoma imbaraga mu mikaya. Ibi biba mu gihe umuntu yiyirije ubusa igihe kinini cyane. Kuko Ramadan iba gusa hagati yo kurasa no kurenga kw’izuba, umuntu aba afite ubushobozi bwo kurya no kunywa ibimuhagije, bimuha n’imbaraga zihagije. Ibi bituma imikaya idakorwaho ariko bigafasha mu gutakaza ibiro." Twemeze rero ko Ramadan igirira akamaro umubiri w’umuntu? Dr Mahroof yemeje ibi ariko yongeraho ko hari ibigomba kwitonderwa. "Igisibo ni cyiza k’ubuzima bw’umuntu kuko gifasha umuntu kwitondera ibyo arya n’igihe abirira. Gusa, nubwo igisibo cy’ukwezi kumwe ari cyiza kukirenza si byiza. Iyo igisibo kibaye kirekire, umubiri ntuba ugikomeje gukoresha ibinure gusa ahubwo utangira no gufata ku mikaya. Ibi rero ni bibi cyane kuko byinjiza umubiri mu nzara ikabije (imirire mibi)." Avuga ko kubabyifuza yabagira inama yo kwiyiriza ubusa mu bihe bitandukanye nyuma ya Ramadan, aho umuntu aba asabwa kwiyiriza ubusa iminsi mike mu cyumweru ariko akiyemeza kurya neza iminsi itari munsi y’ibiri. "Igisibo cya Ramadan, gikozwe neza, cyongera ubushobozi bwo kongerera umubiri imbaraga buri munsi, ibi bisobanuye ko umuntu yatakaza ibiro ariko atangije umubiri we." Ibyo Dr Mahroof yasorejeho. Source:BBC Afrique

title: Iby’ingenzi wamenya ku gisibo cy’ukwezi kwa Ramazani (Ramadhan), abayoboke b’idini ya Islam batangiye
content: Kuva umuseke utambitse mu gitondo cyo ku wa Mbere tariki ya 06 Gicurasi 2019, abagandukiramana b’Abayislamu batangiye ukwezi gutagatifu kw’igisibo kwa Ramadhan kugomba kumara ukwezi. Igisibo cyangwa Swaumu (izina mu cyarabu: صوم‎ ) ni inkingi ya kane mu nkingi eshanu z’idini ya Islam. Igisibo ni ukwigomwa kurya, kunywa, imibonano mpuzabitsina ku bashakanye n’ibindi bibujijwe uwasibye bijyanye ahanini no kwinezeza, kuva umuseke utambitse kugeza izuba rirenze, wagambiriye gusiba no kwiyegereza Imana. Igisibo cy’ukwezi kwa Ramadhan kimara iminsi iri hagati ya 29 na 30 bitewe n’igihe ukwezi kwigaragarije, kikaba itegeko ry’Imana kuri buri muyislamu ugimbutse, ufite ubwenge, ushoboye kuba yasiba, utari ku rugendo, yaba umugabo, cyangwa umugore udafite imiziro nk’imihango, ibisanza n’ibindi. Imana ikaba yarategetse abayislamu gusiba nk’uko yabitegetse abababanjirije. Imana iragira iti "Yemwe abemeye, mwategetswe gusiba nk’uko byategetswe abababanjirije, wenda mwarushaho gutinya Imana", Qor’ani 2:183 Igisibo cy’ukwezi gutagatifu kwa Ramadhan kandi kigabanyijemo ibice bitatu binyuranye: Igice cya mbere kigizwe n’iminsi icumi y’impuhwe, icya kabiri kigizwe nacyo n’iminsi icumi yo kwicuza cyangwa y’imbabazi indi minsi isigaye ikaba ari iminsi y’ubusabe. Impamvu z’itegekwa ry’igisibo Igisibo ni inzira ituma habaho gutinya Imana, ukora ibyo yategetse ukareka ibyo yabujije. Igisibo kimenyereza umuntu uburyo bwo kurinda umutima no kureka ibibi byawo, kikanawutoza kwirengera inshingano no kwihangana mu gihe cy’ibibazo. Igisibo gituma umuyislamu abasha kwiyumvamo ububabare buri kuri mugenzi we ushonje, ibyo bigatuma arushaho gutanga no kugirira neza abakene n’abatindi, bityo bigatuma habaho urukundo n’ubuvandimwe hagati y’abakire n’abakene. Igisibo cyeza umutima, kikawusukura kiwukura mu bikorwa bidahwitse. Mu gisibo niho haboneka ikiruhuko k’urwungano ngogozi, kikaruruhura mu guhora rwuzuriwe, bikarufasha kugarura ingufu. Ibyiza by’ukwezi kwa RAMADHANI Imana iragira iti “Mu by’ukuri Qor’ani, twayimanuye mu ijoro ry’icyubahiro (AL QAD’RI). Ese ni iki cyakumenyesha iryo joro? Iryo joro ririmo ibyiza biruta iby’amezi igihumbi, Imana irimanuramo Abamalayika bari kumwe na DJIBRIL ku itegeko rya Nyagasani wabo mu mutuzo uganje. Iryo joro rikarangwa n’amahoro n’ituze kugeza umuseke utambitse", Qor’ani 97:1-5 Umusangirangendo w’Intumwa y’Imana witwa ABU HURAY’RAT (Imana imwishimire) yaravuze ati: Intumwa y’Imana (Imana imuhe amahoro n’imigisha) yaravuze iti "Iyo igihe cya Ramadhani kigeze, imiryango y’ijuru irafungurwa n’iy’umuriro igafungwa, amashitani akabohwa", Yakiriwe na BUKHARIY na MUSLIMU. Ibi ni bimwe mu by’ingenzi twahisemo kubasangiza kuri uyu munsi. Dukora iyi nkuru twifashishije urubuga rw’Ijwi rya Islam, Ishami ry’ivugabutumwa mu buyobozi bukuru bw’umuryango w’abayisilamu mu Rwanda. Muri iki gihe cy’Igisibo tuzakomeza kugenda twungurana ubumenyi ku bijyanye n’igisibo cy’ukwezi kwa Ramadhani n’idini ya Islam muri rusange, aho uramutse ufite ikibazo watwandikira mu mwanya wahajya ibitekerezo cyangwa kuri e-mail:kigalipost250@gmail.com, maze tukazakubariza abamenyi b’idini ukarushaho gusobanukirwa.  Tubonereho kwifuriza abayislamu bose kuzagira igisibo cyiza, Nyagasani azaborohereze kandi yumve ubusabe bwabo.

title: U Rwanda rushobora kwibasirwa n’akaga k’umuyaga wiswe Kenneth, ugeze Tanzaniya
content:
Akarere k’amajyepfo y’uburasirazuba bwa Afurika gashobora guhura n’akaga gakomeye k’inkubi y’umuyaga wiswe ’Kenneth’ waturutse mu nyanja y’Ubuhinde ruguru y’ibirwa bya Madagascar unyura mu majyaruguru ya Mozambique none ubu ukaba urimo uyogoza ibintu muri Tanzaniya ugana mu Rwanda. BBC dukesha iyi nkuru yanditse ko uyu muyaga ari umwe mu yiremereye cyane kandi ifite umuvuduko ukabije muri aka gace ishobora guteza ibiza birimo imyunzure.

Ikigo cy’iteganyagihe mu Rwanda cyagaragaje ko uyu muyaga ushobora kugera mu Rwanda Iyi nkubi y’umuyaga ikiva mu nyanja y’Abahinde yatungukiye mu gace k’amajyaruguru ya Mozambique, igihugu n’ubundi cyaherukaga guhura n’umuyaga wa Idai wasize wangije byinshi ukanahitana abatari bake. Nkuko byari byagaragajwe kuri uyu wa Kane n’ikigo cy’iteganyagihe cy’Abafaransa gikorera mu birwa bya Réunion, uyu muyaga wa Kenneth uragendera ku muvuduko wa kilometero 215 ku isaha (215 km/h).

Uyu muyaga wiyubakiye mu nyanja y’Abahinde ku gice gishyira uburasirazuba bwa Afurika Ubwo uyu muyaga wageraga muri Tanzaniya amashuri yafunzwe ndetse abantu basabwa kujya mu duce twizewe, ingendo zo mu mazi nazo zahagaritswe. Ahandi uyu muyaga witezwe ni mu birwa bya Comores ndetse ukaba ushobora no kugera mu Rwanda nkuko byemejwe n’ikigo cy’iteganyagiye, Meteo Rwanda. Mu butumwa Meteo Rwanda yanyujije kuri konti yayo ya Twitter iburira abanyarwanda, yagize iti "Meteo Rwanda iramenyesha abaturarwanda bose ko hari inkubi y’umuyaga yahawe izina rya "Kenneth" yaturutse mu Nyanja y’Ubuhinde yerekeza mu karere u Rwanda ruherereyemo ubu ikaba igeze mu majyepfo y’i Burasirazuba bw’igihugu cya Tanzania no mu majyaruguru ya Mozambique." Iri tangazo rikomeza rigira riti "Mu Rwanda, hateganyijwe ko izateza imvura nyinshi mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru, Amajyepfo, n’Amajyaruguru y’intara y’i Burengerazuba kuva uyu mugoroba wo ku wa Kane taliki ya 25 Mata kugeza ku ya 27 Mata 2019." Meteo Rwanda isoza ivuga ko ’Umuyaga mwinshi uteganyijwe cyane cyane mu Ntara y’i Burasirazuba." Iki kigo gishinzwe iteganyagihe kivuga ko gikomeza gukurikirana ku buryo haramutse habayeho izindi mpinduka cyamenyesha abaturwanda.

title: Ibintu 5 by’ingenzi wamenya k’Umwamikazi Elizabeth II
content:
Umwamikazi Elizabeth II yizihije isabukuru y’imyaka 93 kuri iki cyumweru, tariki ya 21 Mata, 2019. Dore ibintu 5 by’ingenzi byagufasha kumumenya neza. 1. Uburame n’uburambe Yabaye Umwamikazi nyuma y’urupfu rwa se, umwami George VI, ku itariki ya 6 Gashyantare, 1952. Amaze imyaka 67 ku ntebe y’Ubwami bw’Ubwongereza, akaba ariwe umaze igihe kinini kurusha abandi bose bamubanjirije. 

 Amaze imyaka 67 ku ntebe y’Ubwami  Ibi byatumye akorana n’abaminisitiri b’intebe 14 bose, uhereye kuri Winston Churchill kugeza kuri Theresa May uriho ubu. Imibare igaragaza kandi ko 83% by’abaturage b’Ubwami bw’Ubwongereza batigeze bamenya undi mwami. 2. Amavuko ye n’isabukuru yayo Elizabeth II yavutse ku itariki ya 21 Mata, 1926, avukira i Londres; ubu inzu yavukiyemo ikaba yarabaye resitora y’abashinwa ikomeye. Ku munsi w’isabukuru ye buri mwaka, haraswa amasasu menshi hakoreshejwe intwaro za kera, akarasirwa muri Hyde Park, kuri Tour de Londres ndetse muri Parike ya Windsor mu burengerazuba bwa Londres.

 Haraswa hakoreshejwe canon  Gusa ibirori byo kwizihiza isabukuru ye ntibiba ku itariki ye y’amavuko, ahubwo bikorwa buri wa Gatandatu wa kabiri wo Kamena, aho abagize umuryango w’i Bwami bahurira hamwe bakareba akarasisi k’abasirikare. Izi mpinduka zakozwe n’umwami George II wari waravutse mu kwezi k’Ugushyingo, 1683, hanyuma muri 1748 ashyiraho ubu buryo bwi kwizihiza isabukuru inshuro 2 kugira ngo ibirori bijye biba mu gihe ikirere kirimo izuba.

 Isabukuru ye ikorwa mu cyi, mu kwirinda ikirere kibi  3. Imisoro Umwamikazi ntabwo ategetswe gusora. Gusa guhera mu mwaka wa 1993, abikora ku bushake, aho atanga imisoro ivuye mu mutungo we bwite mu rwego rwo gushyigikira ikigega cy’isanwa ry’ingoro ya Windsor yasenywe n’inkongi y’umuriro muri 1992. Umwamikazi ariko ntabwo atanga imisoro ku mafaranga ahabwa nk’umwamikazi kuko aya akoreshwa mu mirimo yose akora ya cyami. 4. Inyamaswa n’amatungo Elizabet II akunda cyane amafarashi n’imbwa. Kugeza ubu amaze gutunga imbwa 30 zo mu bwoko nwa Corgis akunda cyane, ndetse akaba yaranakoze ubundi bwoko buzwi nka "Dorgi" imvange ya corgi na teckel. Elizabeth II kandi atunze ifarashi nyinshi cyane harimo izo yarazwe na se.



 Atunze amatungo n’inyamaswa nyinshi  Mu myaka amaze ku ntebe y’Ubwami, yahawe impano nyinshi z’inyamaswa zirimo indogobe n’amafarashi, ifuku, kangourou, ingona, imvubu, ingwe n’ibindi byinshi, hafi ya byose bikaba byarashyizwe muri ’zoo’ ya Londres. Hanyuma kandi umuco wo muri iki gihugu uvuga ko imbata zo mu mazi zose ari ize. 5. Ikoranabuhanga Umwamikazi Elizabeth II, yakoze nk’umukanishi w’igisirikare mu ntambara ya kabiri y’isi akaba ari umuntu wakomeje kugenda agaragaza urukundo afitiye ikoranabuhanga. Yanditse ’Email’ ye ya mbere muri 1976, ubwo yari mu kigo cya gisirikare. Ni we kandi watangije k’umugaragaro urubuga rw’umuryanwo w’u bwami mu mwaka wa 1997.

 Elizabeth mu ntambara ya 2 y’isi  Ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, umwamikazi yanditse kuri Twitter bwa mbere muri 2014, yandika kuri Instagram bwa mbere muri Werurwe, 2019 ashyizeho ifoto y’urwandiko rwanditswe na Charles Babbage, umuhanga mu mibare w’Umwongereza, ayandikiye sekuru wa sekuruza, Igikomangoma Albert.

title: Ibisobanuro by’izina Briella n’imico ikunze kuranga abaryitwa
content: Briella ni izina ry’abakobwa rikomoka ku rurimi rw’Igiheburayo risobanura "Imana niyo mbaraga zanjye" Ba Briella ni abantu usanga badakunze kwigaragaza cyane akenshi bagamije kwihesha agaciro. Ba Briella ntabwo ari abantu umuntu ashobora gusobanukirwa, byose biterwa n’uko yaramutse. Ntabwo bakunze guha icyizere ubonetse wese. Ntibishimira akarengane. Bakunda umuryango wabo kandi baba ababyeyi beza cyane, ntabwo babasha kwihanganira kubaho badafite abana. Ni abajyanama beza kandi babasha kuba abahuza cyangwa abunzi beza. Mu rukundo, Briella yifuza umugabo ugira ubuntu kandi umugaragariza urukundo amufitiye, ariko akamenya kumuhakanira mu gihe biri ngombwa. Aba akeneye gukunda kugira ngo amererwe neza kandi ntaba yifuza na gato kubaho wenyine. Nubwo aba akeneye kugira uwo yita umukunzi ariko aba yifuza ko amuha umwanya we, kandi ntiyihanganira na gato umuntu ufuha. Akeneye umugabo utuma yumva atekanye haba ku mubiri ndetse no mu butunzi.

title: Ibisobanuro by’inzozi zirimo umusarane
content:
Ni kenshi abantu bakunze kugira inzozi ariko zikababera amayobera. Mu ruhererekane rw’inkuru nyinshi zivuye ahanini mu byifuzo byanyu, tugenda tubasobanurira zimwe mu nzozi zihurirwaho na benshi cyangwa izo umwe muri mwe yadusabye kumusobanurira. Kuri iyi nshuro turasubiza icyifuzo cy’umwe mu basomyi bacu utashatse ko tumuvuga mu izina , watwandikiye ati  "Muraho, mu ijoro ryakeye narose ngiye mu musarane mbishaka cyane ariko mpageze nsanga urasa nabi cyane ndetse rwose wuzuye. Sinzi niba hari igisobanuro cyihariye bifite ariko byanteye kwibaza byinshi. Ndabasabye munsobanurire ariko mumbabarire ntimumvuge izina." Mu rwego rwo kumusubiza rero, reka turebere hamwe inzozi zitandukanye zirimo umusarane, bityo yaba we cyangwa n’undi wese wifuza kugira icyo azimenyaho abashe gusobanukirwa. Kurota umusarani akanshi bisobanura ko umuntu aba akeneye kwibohora ku mihangayiko itandukanye y’ubuzima. Uku kuwurota rero biba bigukangurira kwita ku kibazo kirimo kukubuza amahoro muri iyo minsi. Kuri bamwe, kurota umusarani biterwa gusa n’uko nubundi bakeneye kwituma cyangwa kwihagarika, bityo niba wabirose ugahita ukanguka wumva ubishaka, nta kindi gisobanuro cyihariye biba bifite. Kurota usukura umusarani byo bisobanuye ko bimwe mu byo ubujijwe bigiye kuvaho. Ibi bizatuma mubasha gutambukana umucyo n’ishema mu bibazo muzahura nabyo muri iyo minsi. Kurota umusarani wuzuye, byo bivuze ko muri iyo minsi mutifuza na gato kugaragaza amarangamutima yanyu. Hari byinshi mutekereza mudashaka ko abandi bamenya. 
Kurota umusarani wanduye kandi biteguza intambara y’ibibazo bitoroshye mugiye kurwana.
Kurota usanga umusarani ukinze bivuze ko wigirira icyizere gikabije kandi ko bizakugiraho ingaruka, mu gihe kurota usanga harimo undi muntu, bivuze ko icyizere ufite nta shingiro gifite. Kurota umusarani wo mu kabari cyangwa hoteri, bivuze ko hari utubazo duto duto tuzakubihiriza ubuzima.

title: Ubushakashatsi: Havumbuwe baleine y’amaguru ane yabaga ku butaka mu myaka miliyoni 42,6 ishize
content:
Abahanga mu bushakashatsi bw’ibisigazwa by’amagufa n’imibiri y’ibiremwa (paléontologues), bavumbuye ku butaka buherereye muri Pérou ibisigazwa by’inyamaswa yo mu bwoko bw’ibisekuruza bya ’baleine’ y’amaguru ane ifite ubushobozi bwo kuba ku butaka no ku mazi (amphibie). Ni ubuvumbuzi bwatumye aba bashakashatsi babasha kugera ku mwanzuro w’ubushakashatsi bwabo bwo kumenya uburyo izi nyamaswa z’inyamabere zavuye ku buzima bwo kuba ku butaka zikigira mu nyanja. Bivugwa ko ibisekuruza by’ubwoko bw’amafi manini ya baleines na dauphins yabaga ku butaka mu myaka miliyoni 50 ishize mu gace k’u Buhinde na Pakistan y’ubu. Aba bashakashatsi bari baranavumbuye muri Amerika y’Amajyaruguru ibisigazwa bituzuye bimaze imyaka miliyoni 41,2 byatumye batekereza ko muri icyo gihe izi nyamaswa nini zo mu mazi zishobora kuba zaratakaje ubushobozi bwo guhaguruka no kugenda ku butaka.

Baleine ni bumwe bwoko bw’inyamaswa y’amafi manini kandi y’inkazi ziba mu mazi Ubu bwoko bushya bwavumbuwe bwasobanuwe mu bushakashatsi bwashyizwe hanze n’ikinyamakuru Current Biology ko bumaze imyaka miliyoni 42,6 ndetse bukaba bwuzuza imbonerahamwe igaragaza imihindagurikire (évolution) y’ibi binyabuzima by’ibinyamabere biba mu mazi. Byavumbuwe ku kilometero kimwe uvuye ku nkengero y’inyanja ya Pacifique ahitwa Playa Media Luna mu bilometero 250 mu majyepfo ya Lima umurwa mukuru wa Pérou. Urutwe (mandibules) rw’iyi nyamaswa rwagaragaye ruhinguka ku butaka bw’ubutayu, maze mu gucukura aba bashakashatsi babasha kuvumbura ibindi bice byose harimo urwasaya rwo hasi (mâchoire inférieure), amenyo, urutirigongo, imbavu, ibice by’amaguru by’imbere n’inyuma kugeza ku magufwa y’intoki. 

Abashakashatsi bavuga ko bakurikije imiterere y’amagufa y’iyi nyamaswa basanga yari ifite metero enye z’uburebure Bashingiye ku miterere y’ibisigazwa by’iyi nyamaswa bavumbuye, abashakashatsi bavuga ko yashoboraga kuba yagenda bisanzwe ku butaka ikaba yanakoga mu mazi. "Igice kimwe cy’amagufa agize urutirigongo ugana ku murizo agaragaza ibimenyetso bihuye n’inyamabere z’iki gihe zibasha kuba ku mazi no k’ubutaka (mammifères semi-aquatiques) nka loutres (udusimba tugira ubwoya bwinshi tubasha kuba mu mazi no ku butaka).", Olivier Lambert inzobere mu by’ibisigazwa by’inyamaswa mu kigo cya siyansi kamere mu Bubiligi (Institut royal des Sciences naturelles de Belgique), aganira na AFP. Olivier Lambert akomeza agira ati "turabona inyamaswa ishobora gutangira kugenda ikoresha umurizo mu koga mu mazi, ibi bikayitandukanya n’imiterere y’izindi za kera cyane zo mu Buhinde na Pakistan."

Baleine ubu zisigaye ziba mu mazi gusa Ha mbere ibice bya baleines y’amaguru ane byari byaragiye bibonwa mu Misiri, Sahara y’uburengerazuba, Sénégal, Togo no muri Nigeria...Ariko ibi bisigazwa ntibyabaga bifite ibice byuzuye neza (fragmentaires) ku buryo bitashoboraga guhita byemezwa ko izi nyamaswa zashoboraga koga mu mazi. Olivier Lambert akomeza avuga ko ’ubu bwoko bwavumbuwe ari bwo bwuzuye bwa baleine bugaragaye hanze y’u Buhinde na Pakistan’. Aba bashakashatsi bavuga ko kuba iyi baleine yo muri Pérou yashoboraga koga mu mazi nka loutre, bigaragara ko nta gushidikanya yambutse inyanja ya Atlantique inyuze mu gice cy’uburengerazuba bwa Afurika igana muri Amerika y’Amajyepfo, imigabane bivugwa ko yahoze yegeranye cyane inshuro ebyiri kurusha uko biri ubu, hafi kilometero igihumbi na maganatatu (1,300km), iyi nyamaswa ngo ikaba yarafashijwe muri icyo gihe n’umuyaga wavaga mu burengerazuba werekeza mu burasirazuba, ibi bikaba bitandukanye n’ibyari byaragaragajwe ko baleines zageze muri Amerika zinyuze mu majyaruguru, zigaca muri Groenland.


Loutre, inyamaswa ifite imiterere igereranywa n’iya baleine yo mu myaka miliyoni 42 ishize, ibasha kuba mu mazi no ku butaka

title: Amanota y’ibizamini bisoza ayisumbuye yasohotse, amashuri asanzwe abatsinze ni 88.22%, ayigisha imyuga ni 95.2%
content:
Mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 21 Gashyantare 2019 ni bwo Minisiteri y’Uburezi yatangaje amanota y’ibizamini bisoza amashuri yisumbuye yaba asanzwe n’ayigisha imyuga ( General Education, TVET, TTC ). Ni mu muhango wabereye mu cyumba cy’inama cy’iyi Minisiteri ku Kacyiru. Muri uyu muhango, byatangajwe ko mu mwaka ushize wa 2018 hakoze abanyeshuri 42 145 maze mu mashuri yisumbuye asanzwe batsinda ku kigero cya 88.22% mu gihe mu mashuri yisumbuye yigisha imyuga abatsinze bari ku kigero cya 95.2%. Muri uyu mwaka abahungu batsinze ku kigero cyo hejuru kurusha abakobwa aho abahungu muri rusange batsinze ari 93.3% naho abakobwa batsinda ku kigero cya 84.0%.

Abanyeshuri bahize abandi bahembwe Umunyeshuri wifuza kureba amanota, ajya ku rubuga rwa www.reb.rw hanyuma ukajya mu ruhande rw’iburyo ahanditse ’View result’.

title: Abanyamakuru bifuza guhatanira igihembo cya ’BBC Komla Dumor 2019’ bafunguriwe amarembo -Ibisabwa
content:
Ku nshuro ya gatanu, igitangazamakuru mpuzamahanga cy’Abongereza BBC kigiye gutanga igihembo cya ’BBC World News Komla Dumor Award’ ku munyamakuru w’indashyikirwa muri Afurika mu 2019. Abanyamakuru bose bo kuri uyu mugabane bakaba bemerewe kuba bahatanira iki gihembo kigamije kugaragaza no guteza imbere impano nshya z’abanyafurika bari mu mwuga w’itangazamakuru. Uzegukana iki gihembo, azamara amezi atatu ari ku cyicaro gikuru cya BBC i London mu Bwongereza aho azahabwa amahugurwa n’inzobere mu mwuga w’itangazamakuru, abanyamakuru babigize umwuga n’abafite ubunararibonye bazamufasha kwiyungura ubumenyi. Itariki ntarengwa yo gutanga ubusabe (candidatures) ni ku ya 26 Gashyantare 2019 ku isaha ya saa tanu z’ijoro n’iminota 59 ku isaha ngengamasaha ya GMT.

Komla Dumor, umunyamakuru w’umunye-Ghana wakoreraga BBC watumye iki gihembo gishyirwaho Iki gihembo cyashyizweho mu rwego rwo guha icyubahiro Komla Dumor, umunyamakuru w’umunya-Ghana wakoreraga BBC World News witabye Imana bitunguranye ku myaka 41 y’amavuko mu 2014. Muri uyu mwaka iki gihembo kizatangirwa ku mugaragaro mu mujyi wa Lagos muri Nigeria, kikazahabwa umunyamakuru w’indashyikirwa ukorera akaba anatuye muri Afurika, akaba kandi agaragaza ubuhanga mu mwuga w’itangazamakuru by’umwihariko akaba yifitemo impano yo gushakira umuti ibibazo bireba abanyafurika. Uretse amahugurwa azahererwa i London ku cyicaro gikuru cya BBC, uyu munyamakuru azanazenguruka ibihugu bitandukanye bya Afurika ndetse n’imigabane itandukanye atanga ubuhamya bwe. Urutonde rw’ababashije kwegukana ibihembo bine biheruka 2015 : Nancy Kacungira, Ouganda
2016 : Didi Akinyelure, Nigeria
2017 : Amina Yuguda, Nigeria
2018 : Waihiga Mwaura, Kenya Kanda hano hasi urebe ibisabwa n’inzira wanyuramo ngo uhatanire iki gihembo Link: https://careerssearch.bbc.co.uk/jobs/job/BBC-World-News-Komla-Dumor-Award/35006

title: Ibisobanuro by’inzozi zitandukanye zirimo inzuki
content:
Uburyo umuntu arota akenshi usanga buba bihuye n’ubuzima arimo kubamo bityo umuntu ashobora kurota inzozi nyinshi zifite ubusobanuro butandukanye ariko wabihuriza hamwe ugasanga biratanga ubundi busobanuro bwihariye ahanini ugendeye kubyo urimo kubamo muri iyo minsi. Ubundi inzozi zigira ibisobanuro bigiye bitandukanye, ahanini bitewe n’ibihe uzirota arimo. Ushobora gusanga abantu 2 cyangwa barenga, barose inzozi zimwe ariko zigasobanurwa mu buryo butandukanye, bitewe n’uko nabo barimo kubaho ubuzima butandukanye. Ni nako bimeze rero ku nzozi twasabwe gusobanura uyu munsi, aho umukunzi wacu witwa Gakuba Shakur yadusabye kumusobanurira inzozi ebyiri zitandukanye ariko zikaba zishobora guhuzwa zigatanga igisobanuro kimwe bitewe n’uko muri icyo gihe arota izo nzozi yari abayeho. Yatweandikiye ati "Mwiriwe neza ndabashimira ku bisobanuro byanyu byiza muduha ndetse no kubaka Umuryango Nyarwanda, Imana ijye ibaha umugisha. None mwamfasha mukansobanurira inzozo zo ’Kubona umuntu ari kukuniga, hanyuma ukabona inzuki nyinshi ziraje. Murakoze kubw’igisobanuro cyanyu muzampa." Murabyumva ko harimo ibice bibiri, Kurota unigwa no kurota inzuki. Reka duhere ku bisobanuro bitandukanye byo kurota inzuki Ubundi muri rusange kurota inzuki bisobanura ikintu cyiza cyane, aho biba bigusurira ubukire ndetse n’amahirwe menshi. Gusa mu gihe urota inzuki zikurya byo biba bivuze ko muri uko gihirwa no gukira uzahuriramo n’abantu benshi batazabyishimira bakakurwanya, biba bisaba rero kwitonderwa. Kurota uzibona zirimo gukora, bisobanuye umunezero no gutsinda.
Kuzirota uzifashe mu ntoki, bivuze ko uzabona amahirwe muri iyo minsi kandi muzagira inyungu z’amafaranga.
Kuzibona zijya ku ndabo bivuze ko niba mufite ubucuruzi, muzunguka cyane.
Kurota wica inzuki byo ni ikintu kibi cyane, kuko biba bisobanuye ko ugiye kugira ibihe bibi ubigizemo uruhare cyangwa bitewe no gusuzugura cyangwa kwirengagiza inshingano zawe. Nubirota rero uzitondere ibyo ugiye gukora muri icyo gihe.
Kurota inzuzi zikugwaho zitonze, bisobanuye urukundo n’umunezero.
Kuzibona zinjira mu muzinga wazo, bivuze ko ugiye kubona umurage mwiza. Kurota bakuniga Nabyo bigira ibisobanuro byinshi birimo kuba wowe ubwawe winiga ushaka nko kwiyahura, kunigwa n’ibiryo, kubona umuntu aniga undi, kunigwa n’uburwayi bukaguheza umwuka cyane cyane izo mu myanya y’ubuhumekero.Gusa mu rwego rwo gusubiza Shakur, turasobanura kurota hari undi muntu ukuniga. Kurota bakuniga bivuze ko abantu cyane cyane abo hafi yawe batagushimira ibyiza ukora. Nta muntu ugiha agaciro ibyo uvuga, mbese muri iyi minsi abantu babimye agaciro cyane cyane ku byerekeranye  n’amagambo muvuga cyangwa ayo mubwirwa. Bifite kandi igisobanuro cyo kuba ahazaza hawe hagiye kuza ibihe bitoroshye bizabasaba imbaraga nyinshi cyane kugira ngo muhikure cyane cyane ko nta cyizere cy’ubufasha buturutse ku bandi bantu mwizeye kubona. Imbaraga zanyu mu bitekerezo no mu butunzi nizo gusa zizabafasha kwikura mu bihe bibi mugiye guhura nabyo. Mu gusubiza Shakur rero, cyane cyane ko yatubwiye ko mu nzozi ze abanza kubona umuntu umuniga, hanyuma hakaza inzuki. Namubwira ko mu minsi iri imbere waba ugiye guhura n’ibibazo bitoroshye kandi ukazaba udafite n’umwe ugutega amatwi ngo abe yagira icyo agufasha, yewe n’abo wagize icyo ufasha ntibazabiha agaciro ngo bagerageze kugufasha nk’uko wabafashije, bityo uzasabwa imbaraga nyinshi no kwihangana gukomeye. title: Ibisobanuro by’inzozi zitandukanye zirimo umuriro
content: Ni kenshi abantu bakunze kugira inzozi ariko zikababera amayobera. Muri iyi nkuru turasobanuro inzozi twabajijwe n’umukunzi watwandikiye mu izina rya Kush, wadusabye ko tumusobanurira inzozi akunda kurota zirimo umuriro. Kurota umuriro ni inzozi zikunze gukanga benshi ariko burya umuriro mu nzozi ni igisobanuro cy’imbaraga nyinshi. Kurota umuriro utukura ukabona hari aho ukubuza guhita ni ikimenyetso cyo kudacika intege. Kurota umuriro mwinshi ariko ubengerana bisobanuye ko uri hafi kwiyumvamo amarangamutima mashya cyangwa igitekerezo kidasanzwe. Kurota umuriro mu rukundo bisobanura ko ufite amarangamutima ashyushye cyane. Kurota ubona uruziga rw’umuriro rukuzengurutse cyangwa hari undi ruzengurutse bivuze ko mufitanye umurunga ukomeye n’uwo mukunda cyangwa undi mubonye muri urwo ruziga rw’umuriro. Kurota umuriro kandi bigira igisobanuro cyo gutsinda n’uburumbuke. Kurota ubona umugore cyangwa umugabo ukuze acana umuriro bisobanuye umunezero wo kwitwa umubyeyi Kurota uzimya umuriro, bivuze ko ukeneye guhindura imishinga yawe. Kurota umuriro mu nzu y’umuturanyi bisobanuye ko hari umuturanyi ugiye kukwitabaza mu minsi ya vuba. Kurota umwotsi mwinshi bisobanuye ko hari ahantu muri kwibeshya mu byemezo murimo gufata muri iyo minsi. Kurota ushya imisatsi bivuze ko hari inshingano urimo gushaka kwihunza. Kurota ubona umuriro wo mu ishyamba byo bisobanuye ko impinduka zizaba mu buzima bwawe ariko ko ari wowe uzabigiramo uruhare bitewe n’uko witwara mu bikugora. Bishobora kandi gusobanura ko muri iyo minsi wagize umujinya mwinshi, waguteye gutakaza ubushobozi bwo gutekereza uko bikwiye. Kurota umuriro mu buriri bwawe bivuze ko ugiye guhura n’uburwayi ariko butazatinda. Kurota ubona umuriro mu kirere bisobanura ubukene Twizere ko Kush n’abandi bibazaga ibyo kurota umuriro musubijwe. title: Sobanukirwa akamaro k’umuziki ku mikorere y’ubwonko
content:
Abashakashatsi batandukanye ku birebana n’imikorere y’umubiri w’umuntu cyane cyane ubwonko, bahamya ko umuziki ugira uruhare runini mu kongerera ubwonko ubushobozi bwo gutekereza mu buryo bwiza kandi bworoshye. Nk’uko tubikesha urubuga mouv.fr, iyo umuntu yumvise umuziki ugera mu bwonko ugakangura tumwe mu duce tw’ubwonko dushinzwe kumva injyana, utu duce rero ngo twifitemo ubushobozi butangaje bwo gufasha ubwonko gutekereza vuba cyane. Uru rubuga kandi nyuma yo kuganiro n’umwe mu bashakashatsi ku mikorere y’ubwonko, rwatangaje ko iyo umuntu yumva umuziki kenshi byongera ubunini bw’agace gahuza ibice 2 by’ubwonko. Ibi bituma ibi bice bikorana mu buryo bworoshye bityo umuntu akarushaho gutekereza neza kandi vuba. Kumva umuziki bituma ubwonko bubasha kubika ibintu byinshi, bwihuta mu gutekereza no kwibuka ndetse bikoroha gushaka ibisubizo ku bibazo bitandukanye. Urubuga sciencesetavenir.fr rwo rwagaragaje ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’abahanga mu mikorere y’ubwonko bo mu gihugu cya Finland muri kaminuza ya Helsinki batangaje ko nyuma yo kubigerageza ku bantu bari hagati y’imyaka 18 na 73, basanze buri muntu wese wumvise umuziki byibura iminota itari munsi ya 20 ubwonko bwe buba bumaze kwakira byishi kuburyo bubasha gukora neza kurusha ubw’umuntu utumva muzika.
 Uru rubuga kandi rutangaza ko umuntu wumva umuziki cyane aba yifitemo ubushobozi bwo kubasha kumenya icyo abantu batekereza n’ubwo baba ntacyo bamubwiye. Abashakashatsi basobanura ko iyo umuntu akunda kumva umuziki ubwonko bwe bwiremamo ubushobozi bwo kumenya no gusobanukirwa amarangamutima y’abantu ku rwego ruri hejuru, mu gihe umuntu udakunda kumva umuziki akunze kwibeshya cyane ku bantu. Umuziki kandi ngo ugira uruhare mu gufasha ubwonko gukoresha ibice byabwo bikwirakwiza umunezero, umutuzo n’amahoro mu muntu, ari nayo mpamvu akenshi iyo umuntu yumva ananiwe cyangwa abangamiwe mu buryo butandukanye ari byiza ko yumva umuziki kuko ufasha ubwonko gukwirakwiza ibyishimo mu mubiri. Ninayo mpamvu akenshi iyo umuntu atabasha gusinzira cyane cyane umwana, bisaba kumuririmbira umubiri we ukumva utuje kandi utekanye akabona gusinzira. Si umuziki uwo ariwo wose ariko umuntu agomba kumva nk’uko urubuga franceculture.fr rubitangaza, kuko bisaba kuba ari umuziki udafite akavuyo kenshi cyane muri wo. Mu ngero z’injyana uru rubuga rwatanze harimo nka rumba yo mu gihugu cya Congo, Pop y’abahinde, zouk, zumba n’izindi njyana zikozwe mu buryo bunogeye amatwi ariko butari urusaku nanone ku muntu uzumva. By’umwihariko kandi, umuziki ufasha cyane ubwonko bw’umwana gukura. Urubuga e-sante.fr rutangaza ko umuziki wongera umwana ubwenge n’ubushobozi bwo kumva, gusobanukirwa no kuvuga. Umuganga w’inararibonye mu mikurire y’umwana yatangarije uru rubuga ko umuziki ugirira cyane akamaro umwana w’imyaka hagati y’ine n’itanu aho umuziki ufasha ubwonko kubasha gusobanukirwa ibyo abantu bavuga bityo akaba yabasha kubyumva neza, kubivuga uko bikwiriye ndetse no kubasha gutekereza mu buryo bwihuse kandi bwuje ubwenge. Ibi kandi bihita byumvikana ko umuziki worohereza n’abana bakiri bato bafite ikibazo cyo kuvuga cyangwa se kwandika. Iyo bumvise umuziki ubwonko bwabo bwakira ayo majwi bukayabyaza umusaruro kimwe n’abantu bakuru twabinye haruguru, maze bigatuma bukanguka mu bice bimwe na bimwe birimo n’ibifasha umwana kubasha kumva no gusubiramo ibyo yumvanye abandi ndetse no kubisobanukirwa mu buryo bworoshye. Mu gihe uri mu kazi, mu kiruhuko, mu bikorwa byawe bitandukanye by’umunsi aho bigushobokera hose, ni byiza ko wumva umuziki mu rwego rwo gufasha ubwonko gutekereza neza ndetse no gukora uko bikwiriye kugira ngo ubashe kubaho mu buzima bukunogeye ndetse n’abo mubana.

title: Ibice bimwe by’u Rwanda bizagusha imvura idasanzwe muri Nzeri 2018
content:
Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Ubumenyi bw’Ikirere, Meteo Rwanda, cyatangaje ko muri uku kwezi kwa Nzeri hazagwa imvura ihagije hose mu gihugu, ikagera ku kigero cyo hejuru y’isanzwe iboneka mu majyepfo, uburengerazuba n’amajyaruguru. Imibare yashyizwe ahagaragara n’iki kigo igaragaza ko muri uku kwezi, mu Mujyi wa Kigali hazagwa iri hagati ya mm 25-75, mu Burasirazuba hagwe iri hagati ya mm 10-75 ariko ho ikazaba iri ku kigero cy’isanzwe kihaboneka. Mu ntara y’Amajyepfo n’Uburengerazuba hazagwa imvura iri hagati ya Milimetero 50 na 150, ikazaba ari imvura irenze isanzwe ihaboneka, ndetse no mu Majyepfo hazaboneka iri hagati ya Milimetero 25 na 100, nayo izaba iri hejuru y’ihasanzwe. Mu kwezi gushize kwa Kanama 2018, mu gihugu hose haguye imvura irenze isanzwe igwa, nk’uko bitangazwa na Meteo Rwanda. Imvura idasanzwe yaguye mu gice cya kabiri kigana ku mpera z’uko kwezi. Imvura yaguye muri Kanama 2018 yazamutse ku buryo budasanzwe, kuko nko kuri Sitasiyo ya Busogo honyine, hari hitezwe imvura ihwanye na milimetero 77.6, hagwa ihwanye na Milimetero 96.7 ari naho haguye imvura ikabije mu Rwanda. Byumvikana ko hiyongereyeho imvura ihwanye na milimetero 19.1. Ahantu hatunguranye mu kugusha imvura irenze isanzwe muri uko kwezi ni mu Bugarama mu Karere ka Rusizi. Hari hitezwe imvura ya milimetero 21.7, bikarangira haguye milimetero 95.0, byumvikanisha ko habayeho ikinyuranyo cya milimetero 73.3, bisobanuye ko ibipimo by’imvura byikubye kane ku yari isanzwe. Imvura kandi yikubye hafi enye kuri Sitasiyo ya Gitega mu Mujyi wa Kigali, aho yavuye kuri milimetero 17.9 igera kuri 64.8, harimo ikinyuranyo cya milimetero 46.9. Mu gihe i Musanze habonetse milimetero 96.3 hari hateganijwe 55.6, bivuze ko naho imvura yiyongereye cyane ho milimetero 40.7.

title: Dore uko icyumweru kizakugendekera bitewe n’igihe wavukiye (Horoscope)
content:
Iyi ni inkuru ngaruka-cyumweru ikubiyemo icyo abahanga mu byo kwitegereza ahazaza (les voyants) bavuga ku bizaba ku muntu uko icyumweru gitashye, ukurikije igihe yavukiye. Dore uko icyumweru cyo ku ya 03 kugeza ku ya 09 Nzeri kizagenda  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Werurwe na 19 Mata (Belier)  Mu rukundo  Urukundo rwanyu ruzagira imbaraga nyinshi muri iki cyumweru. Abafite abakunzi muzagira amahirwe yo kongeramo imbaraga naho abatarababona muzahura n’ibizabafasha gushinga imizi y’urukundo rw’igihe kirekire. Murasabwa kwihangana no kwirinda guhubuka kugira ngo ibi bibashobokere. Mu butunzi Iki cyumweru kizabaryohera cyane mu bijyanye n’umutungo wanyu kuko muzagira amahirwe yo kwinjiza bitunguranye bityo mubashe gukemura bimwe mu bibazo mufite. Ni byiza ko wakwicara ugasubiza amaso inyuma ukamenya iby’intego wihaye ndetse ukanategura ejo hawe mu buryo bwimbitse. Ikindi musabwa ni ukwirinda ubuntu bukabije ngo ukabye gusohora umutungo wawe bikabije. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru murasabwa kugaragaza imbaraga n’ubushobozi mwifitemo kuko abo mukorana cyangwa abakoresha banyu bazaba babahanze amaso n’icyizere cyinshi. Murasabwa ariko kwibanda ku nshingano zanyu mwirinda kwitanga bikabije ngo mwinjire no mu nshingano z’abandi kuko nimubigerageza, benshi bazabigenderaho bababyeze umusaruro.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 20 Mata na 20 Gicurasi (Taureau)  Mu rukundo Iki cyumweru kizabaera gishya haba ku bafite abakunzi ndetse no kubatabafite kuko mushobora kubona urukundo rw’ubuzima bwanyu. Niba nta mukunzi ufite amahirwe ari kumwe n’iki cyumweru, muzabasha guhura n’abo muzakundana kandi bizahindura ubuzima bwanyu. Umunezero ukomeye cyane muzagira ushobora gutuma muba muhagaritse imishinga mufite bityo murasabwa kwirinda gutwarwa bikabije. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muzagira igihe gihagije cyo gutekereza bya nyabyo ku mutungo wanyu. Bizabagora cyane ndetse bamwe mwumve ko mucitse intege ariko icyo musabwa ni ukwirinda kwitekerezaho nk’umunyantege nke ahubwo mugashaka icyo mwakora ngo mutangire imishinga y’igihe kirekire nta gucika intege. Mu kazi Akazi kanyu kazagira ingufu nyinshi kuko muzahura n’impinduka nyinshi. Izo mpinduka zishobora guturuka ku bakoresha babaha undi murongo ngenderwaho cyangwa se bigaturuka kuri mwe ubwanyu mushobora kubona ko mugomba guhindura imikorere. Bishobora kuzabagora ariko mufite icyizere cyo kubirenga. Iki cyumweru kizabafasha kongera ubumenyi bwanyu mu kazi.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Gicurasi na 21 Kamena (Gemaux)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru urukundo rwanyu ruzazamuka ku rwego rwo hejuru. Ntabwo muzagarukira gusa ku bigaragarira amaso. Muzinjira neza mu buryo mubanyemo n’uwo mukunda maze mubashe gukuramo ibibanezeza cyane. Muzitonde mu mpano muzatanga muzirinde gukabya kuko muri iki cyumweru urukundo rubari hafi nta gushakisha. Ntimuzate umwanya mutekereza byinshi kuko muzi neza icyo mwifuza muzagikore nta gushidikanya. Mu butunzi Muzasubira neza mu mibare muri iki cyumweru maze bitume mutangira kwiga uburyo bwo gukoresha umutungo muke. Ubushake bwo gutera imbere buzatuma mwunguka ubwenge bwo gutekereza kabiri mbere yo gusohora n’igiceri kimwe. Muzatungurwa n’ibikenewe mu rugo mugomba guhaha. Mu kazi Muzakenera impinduka muri iki cyumweru mu kazi. Muzakora byinshi kandi mu gihe gito, nta kanya na gato muzaba mufite ko kwicara ahubwo muzifuza gukora cyane no guhanga udushya.  Ni byiza ko muganiriza abandi ibijyanye n’utwo dushya kandi muhitemo neza abo mubiganiriza mwirinda ababaca intege.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Kamena na 22 Nyakanga (Cancer)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzahura n’abantu babazamuramo amarangamutima aremereye. Haba abifuza kugira ibyo muhindura mu mubano mufitanye n’abo mukunda cyangwa se n’abashaka gutangira umubano mushya, muzashinga imizi y’ibizaramba. Muzagira uruhare muri ibi byose, bityo murasabwa gushishoza ngo hato mutazatsikira ibintu bikaba bibi kurusha uko byari biri. Mu butunzi  Ubuzima bwanyu burebana n’umutungo buzahura n’amahirwe muri iki cyumweru. Muzashaka guhindura uko musanzwe mubamo mu rugo kandi muzagira ibiborohereza kubigeraho bitandukanye n’iby’icyumweru gishize. Mu kazi Abo muhurira mu kazi bazababera isoko y’imbaraga zibafasha gutunganya neza akazi kanyu. Umubano wanyu n’abo mukorana uzabafasha kuzamuka mu mikorere mwirinda kwikorana maze bizamure urwego rwanyu rw’imikorere n’imitunganyirize y’inshingano zanyu  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nyakanga na 22 Kanama(Lion)  Mu rukundo Urukundo ruzababera ubuhungiro muri iki cyumweru. Muzagira amahirwe yo guhura n’abantu babona ibintu mu buryo butandukanye n’ubwo mu bibona ariko bizabafasha kuryoherwa kurushaho n’urukundo nyarwo. Abafitanye ibibazo bizaborohera kwiyunga kuko muzaba mubona urukundo mu mfuruka zose zarwo. Ikindi kandi si byiza ko mwirengagiza aya mahirwe kuko byazabagora kongera kuyabona vuba. Mu butunzi Ibintu byose muzabikora ku murongo n’imikorere mishya mu bijyanye n’umutungo wanyu. Muzatekereza cyane ku bibateza imbere ku buryo muzaba mwiteguye kurwanya buri kintu cyose cyabaca intege. Mufite amahirwe yo kwirinda amakosa mwakoze mu minsi yashize maze mukubaka umutungo ushinze imizi ifatika. Mu kazi Guhanga udushya, gutekereza byimbitse, gutunganya neza akazi kanyu muzagaragaza muri iki cyumweru bizabafasha gutera imbere cyane mu bijyanye n’umurimo.  Muzahura na bimwe bibagora ariko muzarwana nabyo kuko mwifitemo ubushake bwo gukorana imbaraga nyinshi no gutanga umusaruro ufatika kandi ugaragarira bose.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Kanama na 22 Nzeri (Vierge)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzabasha guha umwanya uwo mukunda mumutege amatwi kandi muhe agaciro ibyiyumviro bye.  Ibi bizaturuka ku kuba muri iyi minsi murimo kwiyumvamo umutima wo gutega amatwi mu bijyanye no gukunda by’ukuri. Niba nta mukunzi ufite ushobora kugira urukundo rutunguranye kandi rukamara igihe kirekire. Mu butunzi Muzafata umwanya wo gushyiraho intego zo kwiteza imbere. Mu mpera z’iki cyumweru muzunguka ubwenge buzababashisha kwiha intego nyazo kandi mubona ko zishoboka. Mushobora kandi guhindura uburyo mwabonagamo amafaranga, yaba guhindura akazi cyangwa se n’uburyo mwagakoraga. Mu kazi Muzatangira iki cyumweru mukora nk’abigenga, nta bidasanzwe muhura nabyo bityo mutangire gukora uko mubyiyumvamo mutagendeye ku mategeko muhabwa n’abandi. Ibi bizababashisha kwerekana ibyo mushoboye muri iki cyumweru cyose kandi muragirwa inama yo kugisha inama aho mubona mudasobanukiwe neza.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nzeri na 22 Ukwakira (Balance)  Mu rukundo Muzanyurwa cyane mu rukundo kuko muzaruhundagazwaho yaba n’abo mukunda cyangwa se n’umuryango. Muziyumvamo icyizere cyinshi cyo gukomeza ubuzima kuko muzibona nk’abantu bakunzwe cyane. Muzafata umwanya wo kwiyegurira bya nyabyo uwo mukundana kandi bizabanyura mwembi mu gihe kirekire cyane. Mu butunzi 
Muzatangira gukora imibare ubabashisha gutangira gusohora amafaranga make cyane. Ibyifuzo byanyu byo gutera imbere no kugera kure bizababashisha kwiyima kugira ngo mubashe kwibikira iby’ejo. Mwitegure kandi kugira ibintu bitunguranye byo guhaha mu rugo. Mu kazi Gutekereza mu buryo bwiza bizabafasha mu kazi kanyu ka buri munsi muri iki cyumweru. Murasabwa kwitegereza cyane ibijyanye n’ejo hanyu mu murimo mukora kandi ibi mukabitangira nta gutinda kuko iki cyumweru ari icy’amahirwe kuri mwe.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ukwakira na 22 Ugushyingo (Scorpion)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru iminsi yose izababera iy’urukundo rugurumana nta na kimwe mwirengagije. Uburyo mutekereza bizabafasha nta gushidikanya  kwinjira neza mu rukundo. Ntimuzishimira ibyo mwari musanzwe mumenyereye ahubwo muzashaka udushya. Mu butunzi Muzifuza impinduka mu bijyanye n’umutungo wanyu. Icy’ingenzi kuri mwe ni ugushyira ku murongo ibijyanye n’uko umutungo wanyu ukoreshwa mwibanda ku mishinga ibabyarira inyungu. Nimwiyemeza gukoresha imbaraga nyinshi muzagira amahirwe yo kunguka ku rwego rwo hejuru. Mufite amahirwe menshi muri iki cyumweru. Mu kazi Muzakora akazi kanyu mu buryo bwihariye iki cyumweru. Muzibanda cyane ku by’uhutirwa n’iby’ingenzi kurusha mu cyumweru gishize. Muziyumvamo ubushobozi budasanzwe bwo gukemura ibyo mumaze igihe mushyize ku ruhande maze mutegure neza ikindi cyumweru.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ugushyingo na 21 Ukoboza (Sagittaire)  Mu rukundo
 Uburyo mwifuza urukundo nyarwo bizabafasha kwinjiramo mu buryo bwose bushoboka kandi mukoreshe umutima wanyu wose. Muziyumvamo igisobanuro nyacyo cyarwo kandi murusheho kwiyumva mu wo mukundana ari na we uzabaha icyo gisobanuro nyakuri. Ibiganiro muzagirana muri iki cyumweru bizabaganisha ku rukundo rurambye nimuramuka mubyitondeye mukirinda guhubuka no kuvuga ibidakwiye. Mu butunzi Murasabwa gupangira amafaranga mwinjiza bitandukanye cyane n’uko musanzwe mubigenza kandi murasabwa kwitwara neza mu mpinduka muzahura nazo muri iki cyumweru.  Muzahura n’ibintu byisnhi muzakoreshamo amafaranga bibatunguye ariko ibi ntabwo bizahungabanya umutungo mwari musanzwe mufite. Gusa murumva neza ko musabwa kubikorana ubushishozi. Mu kazi Uguhanga udushya kwanyu niko kuzabafasha gutunganya akazi kanyu mu mutuzo. Bizabafasha kubaka akazi kanyu yaba umunsi ndetse no mu minsi iri imbere kuko bizabagirira inyungu zirenze izo murimo gutekereza ubu. Ntimugashidikanye ku bushobozi mwifitemo ahubwo ni byiza ko mwiyizera ngo mubashe gukora ibyo mushinzwe nta kibazo.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Ukuboza na 20 Mutarama (Capricorne)  Mu rukundo Muzakunda uko muziyumva mu rukundo muri iki cyumweru. Murasabwa kubyungukiramo mugasubiza amaso inyuma mugakemura ibibazo musanzwe mugira kuri iyi ngingo . Muri iki cyumweru kandi muzagira umutuzo n’urukundo rukomeye. Muzareba uwo mukunda n’ijisho ryuzuye urukundo n’amarangamutima aremereye. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru iby’umutungo wanyu nta kavuyo kazagaragaramo. Mbere yo gutangira umushinga mushya cyangwa se kugira aho mushora imari yanyu muzabanze mubitekerezeho neza. Abari mu biruhuko murasabwa kugenzura uko mukoresha amafaranga yanyu. Murasabwa gutunganya neza uburyo mupangira umutungo. Mu kazi Muzagira amahirwe yo kongera ubushobozi mu kazi kanyu mu mutuzo. Iki cyumweru ni icy’amahoro mu kazi kanyu nimwe ubwanyu muzikoresha bityo muzitondera ibyo mukora ngo mugaragaze ko mushoboye ariko byose mu mutuzo. Gusa ariko imishinga yanyu mwite yo izabasaba imbaraga nyinshi mushobora guhura n’amahirwe ariko murasabwa kubigiramo uruhare.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Mutarama na 18 Gashyantare (Verseau)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzakanguka mubone neza uburyo bwo kuryoherwa n’urukundo mu buzima bwa buri munsi bityo mumenye neza uko mwazana impinduka haba mu mubano wanyu n’abandi cyangwa se no mu buzima bwanyu bwite. Muzakora isuzuma ry’uko muhagaze mu rukundo bitume muzana impinduka zishimishije. Ni igihe cyiza cyo kwiyegereza inshuti n’umuryango ariko by’umwihariko n’uwo mukundana. Mu butunzi Muziyumvamo imbaraga zo kuzamura umutungo wanyu ndetse mwifuze kurya ibyo mwavunikiye. Ni byiza rero ko mwatunganya neza imishinga yose mufite igira aho ihurira n’amafaranga kugira ngo bijye ku murongo. Nimumara kubitunganya bizabarinda kugira ikibahagarika. Muzabigiriramo amahirwe akomeye nimuramuka mwemeye gukoresha imbaraga zanyu zose. Ibyo mukeneye bizabaha imbaraga zo kongera umutungo wanyu. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru muzagira ibiganiro bibaha icyizere cyo gukemura ibibazo byinshi by’akazi ariko muzakenera n’ibihamya birenze amagambo kandi ibi muzabibona nimuramuka mwirinze guhisha ikibarimo. Guhanga udushya kwanyu bizabagirira akamaro muri iki cyumweru, ni byiza rero ko mwinjira neza mu ntekerezo zanyu maze ibitekerezo bije mukamenya kubibyaza umusaruro uko bikwiye.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 19 Gashyantare na 20 Werurwe (Poissons)
  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru urukundo rwanyu muzarubamo nta bikabyo. Muziyerekana uko muri ndetse muzakuraho ugushidikanya kose abo mukundana bari babafiteho. Muzakenera ariko kwagura urukundo rwanyu bityo muzagirana ibiganiro byubaka n’abo mukunda. Kuri mwe ukuri kose muzishimira kukuvuga ahubwo munoze amagambo mukoresha mukuvuga. Mu butunzi Umutungo wanyu ushobora guhura n’amahirwe awuzamura muri iki cyumweru. Muzahura n’ibigeragezo binshi bibasaba gukoresha amafaranga mwibwira ko murimo kuvugurura ubuzima bwanyu. Muzabyitondere maze mubanze mubare neza mbere yo kugira amafaranga cyangwa undi mutungo wose musohora bitari ngombwa. Mu kazi  Muri iki cyumweru muzumva mushaka cyane gushimwa bityo muzakora mutikoresheje ngo mubigereho. Akazi kanyu kazaborohera kandi muzabona ubufasha buturutse hirya no hino kandi muzabwakirane ineza gusa muzabanze mushishoze kuko siko bose bazaba babifuriza ibyiza gusa. Ni aha mpiniye, ahasigaye mugire icyumweru gihire! Ni aho mu cyumweru gitaha.

title: Karande! Amayobera ku masezerano adasanzwe asinywa n’abakirisitu mu Itorero rya Masasu
content:
Kuva hambere, abizera Yesu nk’Umwami n’Umukiza wabo bahamya badashidikanya ko imbaraga z’Imana zitanga ubwihisho mu gihe cy’ibitero by’umwanzi satani, byaba ibishingiye ku mitekerereze, imibanire n’abandi, ubukungu, karande zo mu miryango n’ibindi. Hari bamwe banarenzaho ko inkomoko y’umuntu n’ahahise he bishobora kumuzanira imivumo imuzitira mu nzira igana Siyoni, mu gihe atabohowe ngo akorerwe icyo bita “deliverance”. Ni ukuvuga ko niba ukomoka mu muryango wimitse ibigirwamana cyangwa watwawe n’imigenzo ya gipagani, bigukurikirana igihe utabyiyomoyeho ngo utangire amateka mashya ku giti cyawe, bamwe bagasabwa no guhindura amazina igihe ayo basanganywe atejejwe.

 Muri iri torero bakorerwa icyitwa ’Delivrance’  ngo bakurweho imivumo ya karande  Ni aho ‘deliverance’ itangirira, bisobanuye kubohorwa cyangwa gutabarwa. Mu gusobanura icyo gikorwa gisa n’iyobera, hari abifashisha umurongo wo muri Bibiliya, 1 Abakorinto 7: 21, handitse ngo “Mbese wahamagawe uri imbata? Ntibikubabaze. Icyakora niba ushobora kubaturwa ubikore.” Mu Isezerano rya Kera, ukubohorwa gushushanya uko Imana yarengeraga abari mu minwe y’abanzi na Satani, ikabarinda inzara no gukenyuka. Urugero ni Iyimukamisiri, ubwo yakuraga Abisiraheli mu buretwa ikabambutsa Inyanja Itukura, ikabatuza mu gihugu cy’isezerano. U Rwanda nk’igihugu giha abagituye ubwisanzure bwo gusengera mu idini n’itorero bifuza, hari abakataje mu buryo bushya bwo kubohorwa. Urugero ni Evangelical Restoration Church, itorero rizwi nk’irya Apôtre Joshua Masasu.

 Abasengera muri Restoration Church babanza gusinya  Kubohorwa: Igihango gishyirwaho umukono Muri Restoration Church uwamaze kwakira agakiza ushaka kubohorwa yatura mu magambo cyangwa akuzuza urwandiko rwitwa urwo “kwitandukanya n’Umwanzi Satani, kwiyegurira Imana wese no gutangaza amateka mashya muri Yesu.”
Inyandiko IGIHE ifitiye kopi igizwe n’ingingo 11 zigenderwaho kugira ngo indahiro ifatwa nk’igihamya cyo kwitandukanya na karande zose ziri ku buzima bw’umukirisitu yemerwe. Izi ngingo zirimo gusesa igihango abakurambere be bagiranye na Satani; kwiyegurira Imana y’umubyeyi Intumwa Yoshua Ndagijimana Masasu no kuzayiraga abazamukomokaho kugeza ku buvivure; kwitandukanya n’amazina ahesha Satani uburenganzira ku buzima no guhabwa amashya; kwitandukanya n’ubusambanyi, ubutinganyi, kwikinisha, umujinya, ubwicanyi (gukuramo inda), ibinyoma, ubusinzi; kwitandukanya n’umwuka wo gukenyuka n’uw’indwara zikomoka ku bakurambere zirimo umuvuduko w’amaraso, diabète n’izindi.

 Mubyo basinyira harimo no kutarwara indwara zikomeye nka diyabete n’umuvuduko w’amaraso  Nyuma yo gusoma iyo nyandiko, umukirisitu yiyemeza gukurikiza ibikubiyemo ndetse umushumba akemeza ko yakiriwe mu Ijuru no mu Isi. Umwe mu basengera muri Restoration Church yatangarije IGIHE ko amasezerano yo kubohorwa ajyana n’imyizerere y’umuntu. Ati “Byose biterwa n’uburyo wabyizeye. Deliverance ni nziza kuko ituma hari ibyo abantu bahamuriweho n’ababyeyi babo bityo bagusengera bikavaho. Hari ababa bafite imiryango ikenyuka, iyo bayigukoreye birashira kuko uba wakiriye ubundi buzima, uri icyaremwe gishya. Nanjye mfite gahunda yo kujya kuyikoresha.” Uwitwa Tuyiringire Arsène wamaze gukorerwaho uyu mugenzo ndetse wanasinye amasezerano nk’igihamya cyo kubohorwa gusendereye, ashimangira ko banashobora kuwugukoreraho inshuro nyinshi igihe ubyifuza. Yagize ati “Hari igihe usanga hari ikintu kikubase wibagiwe bikaba ngombwa ko nacyo kiva mu nzira. Nkanjye nagiraga umujinya mwinshi ariko ubu byarashize. Biba byiza gusinya ku nyandiko kuko aba ari gihamya igaragara kuko no mu buzima busanzwe ibintu byinshi bishyirwa mu nyandiko.”

 Abasinya iyi nyandiko ngo baba babohotse burundu  Muri Restauration Church, buri pasiteri akora ‘deliverance’ ariko abashaka guhura na Apôtre Masasu ubwe bashyirwa ku rutonde bagahabwa igihe bazabonanira. Hari n’abayikorerwa muri rusange ku bahuriye mu itsinda rikora umurimo runaka mu itorero. Bishop Murekezi Simon Masasu uyobora Restoration Church Rubavu yasobanuye ko urwandiko rusinywa rushushanya urwo Yesu yashyize ku musaraba. Yakomeje agira ati “Hari umurage n’ingoyi umuntu avukana, avuga ko hari umugayo n’agasuzuguro umwanzi yamushyizeho bisaba kwitandukanya nabyo mu izina rya Yesu. Hari abari bafite icyangiro, abananiwe n’urushako, indwara karande, gukenyuka, bose iyo babitahuye, rwa rwandiko rwaturegaga rurabikemura. Ubisobanukiwe mu mwuka umenya ko hari karande ikugendaho ikwiye gusenywa ngo umwanzi ntakomeze kubyitwaza. Umuntu ni we ukenera umwuka ubimusobanurira neza ukavuga uti nkeneye kujya imbere y’umukozi w’Imana, uriya ni nka noteri, uvuga ngo uyu munsi ndabohotse.”

title: Ibisobanuro by’inzozi zo kuguruka no kugendera mu kirere
content: "Muraho nshuti! Ndifuza ko mwansobanurira inzozi nkunda kurota cyane: ’Nkunda kurota ndimo kugendera mukirere nguruka cyangwa n’amaguru ariko ntakintu nkandagiyeho. Wenda nkarota ikintu kigiye kumfata ngo kingirire nabi ngahita ntumbagira ibirere kikambura.’ " Mu gusubiza uyu mukunzi wacu, tugiye gusobanura inzozi zitandukanye zirimo kugendera mu kirere. *Muri rusange inzozi zo kugendera mu kirere zifite ibisobanuro bitandukanye ariko ibigenda bigaruka no ukuba uzirota akeneye kwiyogerera ubwigenge, mbese nyumva afite ibimuboshye akeneye ko bimurekura. * Urose urimo kuguruka mu kirere hejuru cyane ndetse bikoroheye cyane bivuze ko aho mugeze mu buzima mwifitemo ubushobozi buhagije bwo kwikemurira ibibazo. *Niba ariko urota izi nzozi inshuro nyinshi, bivuze ko utangiye kwifata nk’ushoboye byose udafite icyaguhagarika. Ni ngombwa rero ko utangira kwitondera ibyemezo ufata kouko bishoboka ko waba utangiye guhubuka ugakora ibishobora kukugeza ahabi. * Benshi bakunze kubigereranya no gukura nyamara burya ntibiba ari ugukura mu gihagararo ahubwo ni mu bitekerezo kuko ubwonko buba bwiyubakamo aho gukemurira ibibazo. Niba na we hari inzozi ushaka ko tugusobanurira wazitwandikira mu gitekerezo cyawe tukazagushakira ibisobanuro byazo.

title: Ibisobanuro by’inzozi zitandukanye zirimo inzoka
content: Ni kenshi abantu bakunze kugira inzozi ariko zikababera amayobera. Mu ruhererekane rw’inkuru nyinshi zivuye ahanini mu byifuzo byanyu, tugenda tubasobanurira zimwe mu nzozi zihurirwaho na benshi cyangwa izo umwe muri mwe yadusabye kumusobanurira. Kurota inzoka ni inzozi zikunze gutera ubwoba dore ko ari inyamaswa ishushanya urupfu no kubabazwa ndetse rimwe na rimwe igasobanura ubusambanyi. Muri iyi nkuru turagaruka ku nzozi zimwe na zimwe zirimo inzoka mu rwego rwo gusubiza umwe mu bakunzi bacu wabidusabye. *Kurota urumwa n’inzoka:  Ibi bigaragaza ubwoba no guhangayika bikwihishemo. Bishobora kandi gusobanura ko ushobora guhura n’ikibazo mu bihe bya vuba. Izi nzozi kandi kuri bamwe zishobora gusobanura ukwifuza gukomeye kw’imibonano mpuzabitsina ku rwego rukabije. Ku mugore cyangwa umukobwa ni nk’umuburo ukubwira ko hari umugabo w’umugome ndetse w’umuhemu ukubeshya ko ari inshuti yawe. *Kurota inzoka y’imitwe ibiri:  Biteguza ubukire mu mpande zose ariko kandi kuri bamwe bishobora kuvuga akavuyo no kwivanga kw’ibintu. * Kurota ukandagira inzoka ugenda: Bifite ubusobanuro bubiri; ubwa mbere nuko uba ugirwa inama yo kwiyitaho mu by’ubuzima, ubwa kabiri ni ukuguteguza ko abanzi bawe barimo kugerageza kuguhemukira. * Kurota inzoka wica inzoka mu buryo butandukanye, kimwe n’umukunzi wacu witwa ’Jolie’ watwandikiye, bivuze byinshi bitewe n’ibihe urimo ariko akenshi bisobanuye ko hari intambara urimo kandi ko nubwo ikugoye imbaraga wifitemo zihagije ngo uyitsinde kandi ko byanga byakunda uzayitsinda. *Kurota ubona uruhu rw’inzoka yiyuburuye byo bisobanura ubuzima bushya kandi bwiza. * Kurota inzoka iri mu buriri bwawe bisobanuye ko wiyumvamo intege nke mu buzima bwawe bwerekeranye n’imibonano mpuzabitsina cyangwa ko biguteye ubwoba.

title: Menya byinshi ku munsi mukuru wa Eid el-fitr usoza ukwezi kwa Ramadhan, n’uburyo wizihijwe hirya no hino ku isi -AMAFOTO
content:
Kuri uyu wa Gatanu, tariki ya 15 Kamena 2018, amamiliyoni y’abayoboke b’idini ya islamu mu bice bitandukanye by’isi bahuriye mu isengesho rusange rya Eid Al Fitr risoza ukwezi gutagatifu kuri bo kwa Ramadhan, aho baba bamaze ukwezi biyiriza ubusa bakora ibikorwa bitandukanye byo kugandukira Imana. Kuri uyu munsi abayisilamu baramukira mu isengesho rusange riba mu gitondo cya kare, maze nyuma abenshi bagasubira mu miryango yabo bakajya gukomerezayo ibirori. Twifashishije imbuga za internet zitandukanye zirimo Express, Dailymail na Aljazeera tugiye kubereka uko uyu munsi wizihijwe mu bice bitandukanye byo ku isi, ariko mbere yaho, reka turebere hamwe bimwe mu byo wamenya kuri uyu munsi mukuru.
 Umunsi mukuru wa Eid El Fitr uvuze iki? Eid El Fitr ni umunsi usoza iminsi 30 abemeramana b’idini ya Islam baba bamaze biyiriza ubusa basenga ndetse bakora n’ibikorwa byinshi byo kwiyegereza Imana no kwibombarika imbere y’amategeko yayo. Reka turebere hamwe bimwe mu biranga uyu munsi ndetse n’agaciro uhabwa mu myemerere y’idini ya Islam.
Uyu munsi ukomeye cyane mu myemerere y’idini ya Islam ni umunsi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa Chawwal, ukwezi  kwa cumi  ku ngengabihe(calendar) ya Islam gukurikira ukwa Ramadan, uku kwezi kwa cyenda mu mezi ya kiyisilamu kukaba ukwezi gukorwamo igisibo kimwe mu nkingi eshanu zikomeye z’idini ya Islam. 
 Uku kwezi guhabwa agaciro gakomeye cyane ndetse kukaba ari n’ukwezi gutagatifu mu myemerere y’iri dini kuko ari ukwezi intumwa y’Imana Muhammad yahishuriwemo igitabo gitagatifu(Koroan) gikubiyemo amahame y’idini ya Islam. Muri uku kwezi abayisilamu bose bagomba gusiba bagakurikiza ingengabihe y’amasengesho n’iyo gufatiraho ifunguro buri munsi. Ramadhan kandi nk’uko Koroan ibivuga ikaba ari umuyoboro ku bantu. Muri uku kwezi abayisilamu baba bagomba gukoresha uko bashoboye kose ngo bakurikize amahame yose y’idini kandi bakirinda ingeso zose n’imyitwarire idahuza n’amategeko y’idini. 


 Amagana n’amagana y’abayisilamu ku isi bazindukira mu isengesho kuri uyu munsi  Igisibo cyagenewe ibikorwa bigaragaza ukwemera guhamye, aho abayisilamu bashakisha uburyo bwose bakwiyegeranya n’Imana. Muri uku kwezi baba bagomba kwirinda ibibanezeza bakiyegereza Imana. Nyuma y’iminsi 30 rero abayoboke b’idini ya Islam basenga cyane, biyiriza ubusa ndetse birinda kwishimisha mu buryo bwose ngo begerane n’Imana,  haza ukwezi kwa Chawwal, aho ku munsi wako wa mbere bizihiza ibirori bya Aid el Fitr, ibirori byo gusoza igisibo, bakishima ndetse bagasangira.



 Uba ari umunsi w’ibirori bikomeye  Kuri uyu munsi abayisilamu bajya mu Misigiti mu gitondo, bambaye imyenda myiza cyane,(akenshi iba ari na mishya) kugira ngo basenge isengesho ry’uyu munsi. Nyuma y’isengesho inshuti n’abavandimwe mu miryango barahura bakishimana ndetse abishoboye bagaha ibyo kurya abatabasha kubibona (Zakat al-fitr). Bamwe mu bayisilamu bakaba bizihiza uyu munsi mukuru igihe cy’iminsi igera kuri 3. Muri uku kwezi kwa Chawwal abayisilamu bose bakaba basabwa kongera gusiba byibuza indi minsi 6 yitwa ‘As-sitta al-bid’. ANDI MAFOTO

title: Uburyo bworoshye bwo guteka amakaroni mu nyama z’inkoko
content:
Mu gikoni habamo amabanga menshi ashobora kuryoshya ibyo kurya akenshi bitewe n’ubuhanga bw’ubuteka ndetse n’uko atinyuka gukora udushya, bityo abo atekera bakishimira kurya indyo zitandukanye. Benshi barya amakaroni bayatetse ukwayo ndetse n’inkoko bakaba bayirya ukwayo ku ifunguro rimwe nyamara ntibakamenye ko hari uburyo umuntu ashobora kubivanga bityo akaba yabona ya ndyo n’ubundi yaryaga ariko akayibona ifite indi sura ndetse n’ubundi buryohe. Inyanya cyangwa Sauce tomate Uko bitegurwa *Fata inkoko wamaze gutunganya neza hanyuma ukagenda ukatamo duto duto kandi turambuye. *Shyushya amavuta make mu isafuriya hanyuma ushyiremo za nkoko kugeza igihe ubona ko zamaze gufata irangi cyangwa se guhindura ibara. *Shyiramo inyanya cyangwa sauce tomate, ugenda uvanga ubirinda gushirira. *Ongeramo tungurusumu imwe cyangwa ebyiri bitewe n’uko zingana, kandi zibe ziseye neza. *Ongeramo kandi umunyu, igitunguru na puwaro (poireau) n’ibihumyo niba bigushobokera, hanyuma ureke bishye ku muriro uringaniye. *Nibimara gushya neza, fata ikiyiko kimwe cy’ifarini ukivange n’utuzi duke nk’ikiyiko kimwe cyangwa bibiri hanyum a na byo ubisukemo, hanyuma ugende uvanga neza. *Ku rundi ruhande, teka mazi abire hanyuma ushyiremo ya makaroni n’umunyu. Namara gushya (mu minota mike cyane) uyakure muri ya mazi uyavange muri bya bindi byamaze gushya kare. *Hanyuma ubitegure. Ku bakunda n’urusenda na rwo urubegereze kuko birajyana. Icyitonderwa: Mu gikoni nta mategeko ahamye ahaba, umuntu utahakubaganiye ngo agende ahimba ibyo ateka ntaba umutetsi mwiza. Ikindi kandi nuteka ibiryo ukabona bitabaye neza, ntugacike intege ahubwo uzagenzure ikitagenze neza ugikosore ubutaha.

title: Ibisobanuro by’inzozi zitandukanye zirimo umugezi
content:
Ni kenshi abantu bakunze kugira inzozi ariko zikababera amayobera. Mu ruhererekane rw’inkuru nyinshi zivuye ahanini mu byifuzo byanyu, tugenda tubasobanurira zimwe mu nzozi zihurirwaho na benshi cyangwa izo umwe muri mwe yadusabye kumusobanurira. Muri iyi nkuru, turasubiza umukunzi wacu utatubwiye izina ariko atubwira ko akunda kurota ageze kuri Nyabarongo akabura ikiraro akayivogagira akarenga akayambuka ari muzima’, hanyuma tubonereho no gusobanura izindi nzozi zifite aho zihurira n’umugezi. Kurota wambuka umugezi n’amaguru ndetse ukagera iyo ujya amahoro, bisobanuye ikintu cyiza cyane. Bivuze ko niba usanzwe ufite intego y’aho ushaka kugera mu buzima, ugiye guhura n’inzitizi cyangwa ikigeragezo kikubuza kubigeraho byoroshye, ariwo mugezi nyine. Niba rero ufata umwanzuro wo kuwambuka nubwo nta kiraro ubonaho, bivuze ko uri umuntu utajya upfa gucika integer, ndetse ko wiyemeje kurwana n’ibikunaniza. title: Ubusobanuro bw’inzozi: Kurota iruka ry’ikirunga
content:
Kurota ikirunga cyaba kirimo kuruka cyangwa se kitaruka ni inzozi zidakunze kugaragara cyane ariko zifite igisobanuro gikomeye mu buzima bwite bw’uzirota. Izi nzozi zifite ubusobanuro bwinshi ariko bugaruka muri ibi bice bitatu Igice cya mbere Kurota ikirunga bisobanuye ko urimo kugorwa cyane no guhisha amarangamutima yawe. Niba urota kirimo kuruka byo biba bivuze ko bikabije rwose, amarangamutima yawe arimo akuvuna bikabije mbese biba bivuze ko uri hafi no gusandara kandi bikaba byagira ingaruka zikomeya ku bakuzengurutse. Niba warose ikirunga kizimye, mbese kitaruka, bigaragaza ibibazo by’ahashize wabashije gukemura. Igice cya kabiri Kurota ikirunga bishobora gusobanura, kubyuka kw’ibintu bishobora kugira ingaruka ku cyubahiro cyawe. Ku mugore, kurota ikirunga bivuze ko aba agomba kureka gukabya gushaka cyangwa kwifuza amafaranga ndetse no kwikunda gukabije; ibyo bizamurinda ibibazo bikomeye. Igice cya gatatu Niba warose utekereza iruka ry’ikirunga, bivuza ko igihe kigeze ngo ushyire mu bikorwa imishinga yawe.
Ikirunga kizimye cyo cyaba gisobanuye ko ukabije cyane guhisha amarangamutima yawe. Kubona umushongi w’ikirunga kiruka (lave) cyangwa umwotsi uturuka mu kirunga bivuze ko waba urimo guta umwanya utekereza ku kintu nyamara uzi neza uko kigomba kugenda nubwo urimo gukoresha imbaraga nyinshi ngo ugihindure ariko rwose uzi neza ko bidashoboka.
