title: Ibizami bya leta bisoza amashuri abanza bishobora gukurwaho
content: Minisiteri y’Uburezi (MINEDUC) yatangiye gusuzuma umushinga wo gukuraho ibizami bya leta bisoza amashuri abanza bizwi nka “Exetat”, abanyeshuri bakajya barangiza amashuli abanza bahita bakomereza mu yisumbuye. Iyo gahunda ubwayo ngo ntaho ihuriye n’ireme ry’uburezi ahubwo igamije gufasha iyo Minisiteri kurengera ingengo y’imari igera muri miliyari 3.7Frw zikoreshwa buri mwaka mu gutegura ibyo bizamini. Minisitiri w’Uburezi Eugene Mutimura yabimenyesheje Inteko y’Abadepite, ubwo yabagezagaho umushinga w’ingengo y’imari ya 2018/2019 n’integuzamushinga ya 2018/19-2020/21. Yagize ati “Gukuraho ibizami bisoza amashuri abanza, dutekereza ko ari ikintu cyatekerezwaho mu minsi iza, kuko hari ibihugu byateye imbere,bireka abanyeshuri bagakomeza nta bizami bakoze kandi uburezi buhagaze neza.” Minisitiri Mutimura yavuze ko gukuraho ibyo bizami bitazarengera amafaranga yakoreshwaga, kuko bizongera umubare w’abanyeshuri bakomeza mu mashuri makuru kugeza ku 100%, kuko kuri ubu ugeze kuri 75%. Gusa bamwe mu barezi basanga gukuraho ibyo bizami bizabangamira ireme ry’uburezi, nk’uko byemezwa na Prof Wenceslas Nzabalirwa, wahoze ayobora Kaminuza y’Uburezi (KIE). Ati “Hari uburyo bishobora gukorwa. Harimo gukomeza gahunda y’ibizami bya leta ariko hagakazwa uburyo abanyeshuri bigamo bushobora kubaha ubumenyi bukenewe cyangwa hagakomeza isuzuma ryafasha kwigisha abana ku buryo ubumenyi bwabo budapimirwa ku kizami cya leta.” Prof Nzabalirwa avuga ko leta iramutse isanze ibizami bya leta bitagikenewe, yasabwa gushyiraho isuzuma ku buryo nibura hari amanota ari hejuru umunyeshuri yasabwa kugira, kugira ngo uwo ari we wese atimurwa kandi atabishoboye. Patrick Murenzi uhagarariye abarimu mu ishuri ribanza rya Remera Academy, we agira ati “Kuri buri cyiciro umunyeshuri agomba kwerekana ko abifitiye ubushobozi kugira ngo abashe kwimuka, ni yo mpamvu tutagomba kwirengagiza ibizami bya leta. Ariko leta nisanga ari ngombwa ko ibizami bivaho, bizadusaba guhindura imyigishirize yose ariko usange bigabanije umuhate wo gutsinda washyirwaga mu banyeshuri.”

title: Nkore iki ko nakundanye n’uwo dukorana?- Inama
content:
Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko 40% by’abantu bagiye bashinduka bari mu rukundo n’abantu bakorana. Nyamara hari ubwo biba badahuye na politiki y’ikigo mukorera cyangwa se bikaba namwe ubwanyu byababangamira kwerekana muri bagenzi banyu ko ibyari ubucuti byabyaye ikintu gikomeye. Muri iyi nkuru turabagira inama y’uburyo umuntu yakwitwara mu gihe akundanye n’uwari inshuti ye mu kazi cyangwa se n’undi muntu uwo ariwe wese mu kazi. 1. Shishikara ku murimo
Ikintu cya mbere ugomba kuzirikana ni uko waje aho uje gukora akazi, bityo inshingano zawe mu kazi nizo zitumye uhaguma bitabaye ibyo uzaba uteshutse bityo ube waha isura mbi umubano wanyu. Hari n’ubwo ushobora gusanga mu kigo mukorera bibujijwe kugirana umubano wihariye cyangwa gukundana n’uwo mukorana bitewe n’impamvu zitandukanye. Urumva rero ko mu gihe nk’iki uba ushobora kwishyira mu kaga mu gihe wongereyeho no kuba udatunganya neza inshingano wahawe. 2. Mbivuge cyangwa ndyumeho? Gutangaza ku mugaragaro ku kazi ko mukundana bishobora kubakururira ibihano runaka, ariko kubivuga bizabafaha guha umwanya akazi aho kumara umwanya mutekereza uburyo  bwo guhisha amarangamutima yanyu. Birumvikana ariko ko ari ngombwa kumenya amategeko agenga umubano nk’uwo n’ingamba zifatwa muri icyo gihe. Ibi bizagufasha kumenya guhitamo ikigufitiye akamaro ari urukundo cyangwa kugumana akazi. Gusa muri byose icyiza ni ukuvana ibintu mu ibanga. 3. Ntugakabye kubyerekana Nubwo ku kazi kawe  byemewe cyangwa se wowe ukaba warabyemerewe kubera impamvu runaka, si byiza ko ku kazi muba abakunzi ahubwo mugomba kuba abantu bakorana. Ibi ntibivuze ko mudashaka kwereka abandi uko mutwara amarangamutima yanyu gusa, ahubwo binafite igisobanuro ko n’ubwo mufitanye umubano wihariye, iyo mugeze mu kazi ari ko gusa muha agaciro. Ni byiza rero ko mutegereza ko akazi karangira kugira ngo mugaragarizanye amarangamutima abarimo. Ibi birushaho kugira agaciro iyo uwo mukundana ari ugukuriye mu kazi, kuko bibafasha kwerekana ko ibyo gukundana kwanyu bidafite aho bihurira n’akazi. 4. Itegure guhangana amashyari menshi n’ibijyanye na yo Birumvikana ko niba uri mu rukundo  n’ugukuriye ugombwa kwitegura guhura na bamwe bazakeka ko wabitewe no kwifuza kugera kure mu kazi nko kuzamurwa mu nzego n’ibindi nk’ibyo. Ibyo bizatuma ishyari rizamuka usange ushobora kubura inshuti nyazo mu kazi. Uzitegure kubyakira kuko nicyo wahisemo. 5. Guhindura akazi Ni icyemezo kigoye ariko gishobora gutuma ubana n’uwo wankunze. Hari ubwo bigorana cyane kubana n’uwo ukunda amasaha yose y’umunsi ariko ukabana na we arimo babiri, rimwe ari umukunzi ubundi ari boss cyangwa uwo mukorana. Kuvanga ibyo bintu iyo bikunaniye rero uba ugomba guhitamo ukareba ikikuri ku mutima, niba ari akazi cyangwa urukundo umufitiye.

title: Ku myaka 43, igitagangurirwa cyari gikuze kurusha ibindi cyapfuye -Amateka yacyo
content:
Igitagangurirwa cyari kizwi nk’igikuze kurusha ibindi ku isi ya rurema, cyapfiriye muri Australie ku myaka 43 y’amavuko.  Ngo ntabwo cyakenyuwe n’izabukuru ahubwo cyazize urupfu rutunguranye kuko cyarumwe na gasimba ko mu bwoko bw’uruyuki (guêpe), nkuko abashakashatsi babitangarije AFP. Nk’uko ubushakashatsi bwatangajwe n’ikinyamakuru Pacific Conservation Biology Journal cyabigaragaje iki gitagangurirwa cyari cyaresheje bikomeye agahigo ko kumara igihe kirekire ku isi kuko icya kigasanganywe cyo muri Mexique cyo cyapfuye gifite imyaka 28.
 Iki gitagangurirwa cyari igitsina gore cyari cyariswe ‘numero 16’, cyafashaga abahanga n’abashakashatsi mu kumenya byisumbuyeho imyitwarire ya buri gitagangurirwa giherereye ku butaka bwa Australia. “Ku bumenyi bwacu, ni cyo gitagangurirwa cyari gikuze cyane ndetse kubaho igihe kirekire kwacyo byadufashije kumenya byisumbuyeho kamere y’ibitagangurirwa n’imigirire yabyo”, Leanda Mason umushakashatsikazi wa kaminuza ya Curtin de Perth muri leta ya Australia y’Uburengerazuba.
 Numero 16, cyari cyaravumbuwe mu 1974 ubwo hatangizwaga ubushakashatsi , mu kigo giherereye mu gace ka Wheatbelt ku bwoko bw’ibitangangurirwa bicukura mu butaka bikiturira mu bihuru, aho cyavumbuwe n’inzobere mu buzima bw’ibitagangurirwa, umunya-Australiyakazi, Barbara York Main kuri ubu ufite imyaka 88 y’amavuko. “Tugendeye ku bushakashatsi bwa Barbara, twabashije gusobanukirwa ko uburambe/ubuzima (longévité) bw’ibitagangurirwa byicukurira aho kuba(isenga), igendera ku buzima bibaho, by’umwihariko uburyo bibaho mu gihuru kidatunganyije (non défrichées), muri kamere yabyo yo kudakunda kugendagenda cyane n’uburyo bw’imikorere yoroheje y’umubiri wa byo.”, Leanda Mason.

Ibanga ryo kuramba kwa cyo ngo ni ubunebwe, nta mbaraga nyinshi cyatakazaga, The Telegraph ivuga ko no guhiga ibyo kurya yabikoraga yitonze Numéro 16 cyakorerwagaho ubushakashatsi aho cyari cyituriye mu isenga ryacyo. Ibitangangurirwa byo muri ubu bwoko bwa ’Gaius villosus,’ by’akarusho by’igitsina gore igihe cyabyo kinini cy’ubuzima bikimara biba cyangwa byegereye isenga yabyo. Ni nayo mpamvu byoroheye abashakashatsi guhora bakurikiranira hafi iki gitagangurirwa cyiswe numero 16 kuko kitahindaguranyaga aho kiba.
 Ubundi ibi bitagangurirwa bibaho hagati y’imyaka 5 na 20 muri rusange. Ntabwo bigira ingaruka zikomeye ku kiremwa muntu ariko iyo kikurumye ubumara bwacyo bushobora kukubabaza mu gihe runaka. Muri kamere yabyo bibangamirwa n’ubushyuhe bukabije bw’ikirere ndetse n’iyangizwa ry’amashyamba. Iki gitagangurirwa Dailymail yo ivugako kisanze muri Australia nyuma yo gukora urugendo rungana n’ibirometero ibihumbi 10 mu nyanja y’abahinde(Ocean Indien) ubwo cyazaga ku bihuru byari byatemwe muri Afurika y’epfo mu myaka hagati ya miliyoni 2 na 16 ishize. 

Ubushakashatsi bugaragaza ko cyaje mu myanda yaturutse muri Afurika yepfo ikajyanwa n’inyanja y’Abahinde ikayigeza ku nkombe ya Australia

Numero 16 ubu ntikikibarizwa ku isi y’ibinyabuzima bihumeka nyuma y’imyaka 43

title: Wibwiraga ko guseka ukirigiswe biterwa no kwishima? Sibyo -Ubushakashatsi
content:
Buri wese agira ahantu ku mubiri we, atinya ko bamukirigita kuko bituma aturika agaseka ndetse akaba adashobora kubyihanganira cyangwa ngo yiyumbanganye. Ariko se koko biterwa n’uko umuntu aba anezerewe cyangwa hari ikindi kibyihishe inyuma? Iyo ukirikiga umuntu ukangura uturemangingo turi munsi y’uruhu hanyuma tugahita tugeza ayo makuru mu bwonko agasuzumwa n’ibice 3 byabwo. Igice kimwe (cortex somatosensoriel) gisobanura ibyo byiyumviro, kigashaka aho biturutse ndetse n’uburemere bifite; igice cya kabiri (cortex cingulaire antérieur) cyo kigaragaza amarangamutima ajyana n’ibyo byiyumviro hanyuma igice cya gatatu (cortex prefrontal) kigatanga igisubizo kuri ibyo byose, ariko si aho bigarukira.

Guseka ukirigiswe ni gisubizo cy’ubwonko Iyo ibyo byose bitewe no gukirigitwa hazamo n’ikindi gice cy’ubwonko cyitwa ‘hypothalamus’ gishinzwe guhuza ibyiyumviro by’ubwoba n’uburyo bwo kwirinda umwanzi. Ibi rero bikaba bitera abashakashatsi guhamya ko mu gihe umuntu akozweho mu buryo bwo gukirigitwa, agaseka mu by’ukuri atari uko aba anezerewe ahubwo ko aba ashaka n’uburyo bwo kwirwanaho. Niyo mpamvu uzasanga umuntu urimo gukirigitwa atishimira ibyo byiyumviro ngo areke bakomeze bamukirigite, ahubwo nubwo azaba aseka, azakoresha uko ashoboye kose ngo arwanye umukirigita, amusunika akoresheje amaboko, avuza induru, amuhunga, amwingingira kurekeraho cyangwa se ibyo byakwanga akaba yakwirwanaho akoresheje imbaraga ndetse ku bafite intege nke nk’abana, bashobora no kurira.


Ukirigitwa koresha uko ashoboye ngo ahunge, ndetse iyo byanze bamwe bararira Niyo mpamvu utabasha kwikirigita ngo useke Kuko nyine guseka ukirigiswe ari ukwirwanaho kuko umuntu aba yumva ko hari ikimuteye giturutse ahandi, iyo wikirigita, ubwonko bubasha kumva neza ko ibyo atari ibiturutse hanze bityo ko nta kibazo bishobora kuguteza, bityo ntibwirirwe bwohereza cya gisubizo cyo guseka. title: Dore uko icyumweru kizakugendekera bitewe n’igihe wavukiye (Horoscope)
content:
Iyi ni inkuru ngaruka-cyumweru ikubiyemo icyo abahanga mu byo kwitegereza ahazaza (les voyants) bavuga ku bizaba ku muntu uko icyumweru gitashye, ukurikije igihe yavukiye. Dore uko icyumweru cyo ku ya 23 kugeza ku ya 29 Mata kizagenda Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Werurwe na 19 Mata (Belier)  Mu rukundo   Kuba umwimerere ndetse no kwerekana ibibarimo nibyo bizabahesha amahirwe mu rukundo muri iki cyumweru. Bizaborohera kugaragariza abo mukunda amarangamutima yanyu bityo nabo bishimire kuyasangira namwe. Urukundo no kubohoka nibyo bizaranga ibiganiro byanyu.  Mu butunzi  Mu mpera z’iki cyumweru birashoboka ko mwabona amafaranga. Ayo mahirwe azahurirana n’ibikorwa byanyu bwite mwihimbiye, ikemurwa ry’imanza mwaba mufite cyangwa se n’ibyo mwagurisha. Muzahura n’imishinga mishya ariko nubwo mufite ibindi mukora ntibizababuze kugerageza n’ibishya kuko wasanga ariyo mbarutso y’iterambere ryanyu cyane cyane mu bijyanye no kwigwizaho umutungo.  Mu kazi  Akazi kazabagendekera neza muri iki cyumweru. Ntabwo muzigera mubura icyo mukora ahubwo bizajya bigenda bisimburana vuba na vuba. Muzarangwa no guhanga udushya kandi ibi bizabafasha guhangana n’impinduka. Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 20 Mata na 20 Gicurasi (Taureau)  Mu rukundo  Bamwe muri mwe bazatangira umubano w’igihe kirekire nyuma yo gukunda by’ako kanya kandi rwose ayo mahirwe azaboneka, nimwe gusa mwifitemo kuyakira cyangwa kuyareka agahita gusa murasabwa kumvira umutima wanyu, hanyuma mukazabitekerezaho nyuma. Nimubitekerezaho cyane bizabangamira kwisanzura kwanyu bitumen urukundo rutagira imbaraga.  Mu butunzi  Muzabasha gufunga burundu bimwe mubyabagoraga mu giha cyashize. Muzafata umwanya wo kwirengagiza iby’ahashize maze musohoke aho mwazitiriwe n’amateka. Muzakire neza impinduka mu igenamigambi ryanyu kuko ari ingenzi cyane mu iterambere ryanyu.  Mu kazi  Muri iki cyumweru akazi kanyu kazaba kari ku murongi, ntabwo muzatuma hari ubavangira cyangwa ngo hagire ikintu kibarogoya. Muzatangirana n’ingamba nshya kandi ibi ibizahindura byinshi ku mikorere yanyu kandi bizabaha umusaruro ushimishije. Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Gicurasi na 21 Kamena (Gemaux)  Mu rukundo  Muri iki cyumweru muzagira igihe nyacyo cyo kwitekerezaho kandi ibi bizababera intandaro yo kumenya gutandukanya ubuzima rusange n’ubuzima bwanyu bwite. Muzashyira ku murongo amarangamutima yanyu hanyuma bibazanire impinduka nziza mu rukundo. Ibi bizababera inzira yo kwegerana biruseho n’abo mukunda ndetse n’inshuti n’umuryango nta kavuyo kabirimo ahubwo buri wese mumuhe ibimukwiriye.  Mu butunzi  Nubwo mutarabasha kugera ku ntego mwiyemeje, muri iki cyumweru muzasa n’abafata akaruhuko gato. Ibyifuzo byanyu byo guha agaciro kwigenga no kubohoka kurusha amafaranga muzabiha imbaraga nyinshi. Ibi bizatuma mwongera imbaraga nyinshi mu kwizigamira ubwo muzatangira icyumweru gitaha. Muragirwa inama yo kwirinda gusesagura amafaranga ahubwo mukabanza kubara mbere yo kugira icyo muhaha.  Mu kazi  Ubuzima bwanyu bw’akazi buzabamo gukora cyane muri iki cyumweru kandi uku gukora kuzabagirira inyungu mu gihe kizaza. Benshi muri mwe bazagira amahirwe yo kubona ibibegereza ku gusohoza inshingano bihaye. Muzagira amahirwe menshi kandi nimugira igitekerezo kizaba kiremereye ndetse bishobora no kubagora kugishyira mu bikorwa. Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Kamena na 22 Nyakanga (Cancer)  Mu rukundo  Muri iki cyumweru mugomba gufata umwanzuro. Muzahura rwose n’ibizabasaba gutanga igisubizo cyihuse. Ababazengurutse bagomba kwakira igisubizo icyo aricyo cyose mubahaye kandi birashoboka rwose ko igisubizo cyanyu cyatangwa nta bwumvikane bubayeho.  Mu butunzi  Muzagira imikorere ifatika kandi imigambi yanyu mu bijyanye no gucunga umutungo izaba irimo ubwenge na gahunda nyinshi. Ibitekerezo byanyu bizaba biremereye kandi muzamenya kubitondeka neza muhereye kubyihutirwa.  Mu kazi  Akazi kari mu by’ibanze muzashyiraho umutima muri iki cyumweru. Muzakora ku buryo bubongerera icyizere cyane. Muzagaragaza ibyo mushoboye kandi ibijyanye no guhanga udushya muzabishobora cyane. Ababazengurutse bazabona ko mwatangiye kurenga imipaka yari ibazitiye. Ababaha ubufasha baziyongera rero ntimuzatinye kugira uwo mwaka ubufasha
.
 Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nyakanga na 22 Kanama(Lion)   Mu rukundo  Ibiganiro bizagenda byerekeza aho mushaka. Iki cyumweru muzumvwa n’abo mukunda rwose, ibyo bikazaterwa n’uko namwe mwagaragaje ko muzi gutega amatwi n’uburyo mukunda. Mushobora kandi no guhura n’urukundo rubatunguye kandi rukaba rufite amahirwe menshi yo gukomeza mu gihe mwaba muri mwenyine.  Mu butunzi  Muri iki cyumweru muzatera intamwe ishimishije mu kwinjiza amafaranga ndetse no kubona ibindi byinshi biyinjiza. Amahirwe azabahora iruhande kandi uguhizaho kwanyu niko kuzabazanira uwo musaruro. Inshingano zanyu ziziyongera kandi kudacika intege kwanyu niko kuzabafasha kuzitunganya uko bikwiye.  Mu kazi  Muri iki cyumweru bizabagora cyane gufatanya akazi n’ubundi buzima busanzwe ariko muzagerageza kwirinda kugira icyo mwica n’ubwo bizabagora cyane kumenya guhitamo aho mushyira imbaraga kurusha ahandi. Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Kanama na 22 Nzeri (Vierge)  Mu rukundo  Nubwo ibiganiro byanyu bizasa n’ibitameze neza, muzabasha kugumana cya kibatsi cy’urukundo. Muzasa n’abiyibagirwa kugira ngo munezeze abo mukunda. Ibi bishobora kugera kure bigatuma uwo mukundana abyitwaza cyane hanyuma namwe mukaba mwakwisubiraho bikabatera gutekereza ibindi.  Mu butunzi  Ntabwo muzatagaguza umutungo wanyu ahubwo muzashyiraho amategeko y’icungamutungo akomeye azafasha umuryango wanyu kumererwa neza no kutagira icyo ubura. Mushobora kandi kwinjiza amafaranga mu buryo bubatunguye mu mpera z’iki cyumweru.  Mu kazi  Muri iki cyumweru nta kintu na kimwe muzemera ko kibavangira mu kazi. Muzagira amahame mashya yihariye azabagenga kandi ntimuzakundira uwo ariwe wese kubabuza kuyakurikiza, ibi bikazabafasha guhindura byinshi ku buzima bwanyu bwa buri munsi bw’akazi. Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nzeri na 22 Ukwakira (Balance)  Mu rukundo  Muri iki cyumweru muzita cyane ku bintu bigaragarira amaso kandi kbi bizabafasha kwinjira mu buzima bw’urukundo bukuze. Bizaba ngombwa ko mufata ibyemezo bikomeye bizabakurikirana igihe kirekire. Mwifitemo amahame ashobora guhindura ubuzima bwanyu muri iki cyumweru, ni byiza rero ko mwiyumva maze kugafata imyanzuro ihamye.  Mu butunzi  Mugomba gushyira ku murongo uburyo mukoreshamo amafaranga muri iki cyumweru kandi mukabyitaho mu buryo bukomeye. Muzagira amatsiko yo kumenya inama mugirwa n’amategeko kugira ngo mugere ku ntego mwihaye. Mushobora kandi kubona ikiraka cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo kubinjiriza amafaranga butari busanzwe.

Mu kazi Bizaba ngombwa ko muhindura imikorere muri iki cyumweru mugashakisha ngo mumenyane na benshi. Ibi bizabaha imyumvire n’amakuru mashya kandi bishobora kubafasha mu bibagora. Muzitonde cyane kuko muri iki cyumweru mushobora kwiremamo ibitekerezo bidafite aho bihuriye n’ukuri bityo mugatangira kuyoba mu kazi.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ukwakira na 22 Ugushyingo (Scorpion)   Mu rukundo  Ibyo mubona hanze aha bizabatera gutekereza cyane hanyuma bibahe ingufu zo gukomeza kuyoboka inzira iboneye mu rukundo. Muzarenga byinshi byabagoraga ndetse muzitanga cyane kugira ngo mubashe kubaho ubuzima mwishimiye.

Mu butunzi Mwitegure gukemura ibintu byihutirwa bizabatungura muri iki cyumweru. Amafaranga yanyu azinjira anasohoke mu buryo bwihuse cyane. Ibi rero birabasaba kwitonda mugashishoza ngo mumenye uko mubigenza, mwirinda gusesagura no guheranwa n’ibibazo. Mu kazi Muzagira ibyifuzo bikomeye byo guhindura imikorere muri iki cyumweru. Gukora wenyine bizabagora ahuwo muzumva mukeneye kuganira n’abandi hanyuma ibi bibafashe guhimba ibishya byinshi mu kazi ndetse n’inshuti nyinshi usangiza imishinga yawe zikugire inama.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ugushyingo na 21 Ukoboza (Sagittaire)   Mu rukundo  Ubuzima bwanyu bw’urukundo buzahinduka muri iki cyumweru. Muzahura na byinshi byiza bizafasha urukundo rwanyu kuvuka bwa kabiri kandi icyo kibatsi gishya umukunzi wanyu azacyishimira. Amahirwe abari iruhande niba ibintu byari byabakomereye. Muzarenga kure ibitekerezo byinshi mwari mwarishyizemo ahubwo kudacika intege bibongere amahirwe yo kugera aheza.  Mu butunzi  Hagati muri iki cyumweru muzagira ibiganiro bibazanira inyungu, byumvikane rero ko ikofi yanyu hari icyo izabona ariko mugomba kwitonda ngo hatagira ubatwara amahirwe. Muzagishe inama bizabafasha kumenya icyo gukora, ibi bikazanabafasha mu gihe cy’amezi ari imbere.  Mu kazi

 Muzagira akazi kenshi cyane muri iki cyumweru. Bizabasaba guhindura imikorere kandi munakomeza akazi. Ariko kandi imibanire yanyu n’ababakuriye mu kazi izazamo agatotsi ariko ntibizabahangayikishe kuko niko impinduka zigenda. Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Ukuboza na 20 Mutarama (Capricorne)
  Mu rukundo  Mugiye kugira icyumweru kigoye cyane mu rukundo. Muzasubizwa inyuma mu mateka bityo muzatangira kwifata cyane ngo hato mutavaho mugwa mu mitego nk’iyo mwigeze kugwamo mu gihe cyashize. Gusa nanone ibyo bishobora kubatera kwibonamo ibyo mwari mwarihishe bityo mukaba mwatangira ubuzima bwiza cyane bw’urukundo butuje kandi bukomeye.  Mu butunzi  Muzinjiza neza muri iki cyumweru ariko kandi mugomba kwitonda kuko muzasa n’abatobotse intoki ku bijyanye no gukoresha amafaranga kuko buzagira intege nke cyane mu kubika ahubwo inyota yo kugura ibitagira umumaro iziyongera.  Mu kazi
 Muzishimira byinshi muzageraho muri iki cyumweru kandi muzoroherezwa cyane mu kazi. Muzahura na benshi bazabafasha bityo muzamuke neza ariko kandi ubufasha bwose muzabona muzabanze mubusuzume butazagira ikindi bubazanira cyazabagora mu minsi iri imbere. Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Mutarama na 18 Gashyantare (Verseau)  Mu rukundo  Mwifitemo gukurura abantu mu buryo mutagizemo uruhare kandi mutazi iyo bituruka. Ariko kandi muzirinde gutwarwa cyane ngo mwibagirwe kugenda buhoro buhoro cyane cyane niba mukiri mu rukundo rushya. Nib anta mukunzi mufite, muzabonana n’abantu bazaborohereza cyane kurusha uko byari bimaze iminsi bibagora.  Mu butunzi  Ibibazo by’amafaranga ntibyihutirwa kuri mwe muri iki cyumweru. Ahubwo muzibanda cyane ku kureba ikizatuma ejo hazaza hazababera heza mwizigamira. Uburyo mubayeho uyu munsi ntacyo buzaba bubabwiye cyane muri iki cyumweru ahubwo muzibanda ku kutegura ejo heza.  Mu kazi  Muzabohoka cyane muri iki cyumweru mu kazi kanyu. Nta kintu gihambaye kizababaho kandi ibi bizabaha umutuzo mu kazi maze murusheho gutunganya ibyo mushinzwe. Muzirengagiza ibikunze kubagora mu kazi hanyuma mwishakemo uko mwakanoza kurushaho.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 19 Gashyantare na 20 Werurwe (Poissons)   Mu rukundo  Muziyumvamo gahunda yo kuganira byimbitse n’uwo mukundana ntacyo musize inyuma. Nicyo gihe rwose muzasasa inzobe mugashyira ahagaragara icyo mutekereza. Niba hari ibyo mwashidikanyagaho iki cyumweru kizaba icyo kubifataho umwanzuro mugire amahitamo afatika.  Mu butunzi  Ubutunzi bwanyu buzagwirwa n’amahirwe. Muzagira amahirwe yo kwaguka, mbese muzoroherezwa cyane ku bijyanye no gusohora amafaranga ndetse no gutangira ubucuruzi.  Mu kazi   Muzagira amhirwe mashya kandi muzagarura ya nyota yo kwiga mu kazi ndetse hari benshi bazabibafashamo. Muzabona amahirwe yo gutangira ibintu bishya kandi mu byumweru bibiri biri imbere muzatangira kubona inyungu zabyo. Ni aha mpiniye, ahasigaye mugire icyumweru gihire! Ni aho mu cyumweru gitaha.

title: Ko inkuba zikomeje gutwara ubuzima bw’abantu, wakora iki ngo uzirinde?
content:
Muri iyi minsi mu gihugu no muri aka Karere u Rwanda ruherereyemo, haragaragara ibihe bidasanzwe by’imvura nyinshi ivanze n’imirabyo n’imiyaga ndetse n’inkuba. Ibi biba intandaro y’ibiza byinshi birimo n’inkuba zimaze gutwara ubuzima bw’abatari bake. Inkuba ni uruhurirane rw’ingufu zihurira mu kirere maze ikubitana ryazo rigatanga izindi ngufu zo mu bwoko bw’amashanyarazi; aribyo twumva cyangwa tubona bikubita nk’inkuba n’imirabyo. Ibi nibyo bikomeretsa cyangwa bikica uwo bihuye nawe. Nyamara nubwo ibiza bidateguza, hari uburyo twakwitwara kugira ngo tugabanye ubukana n’ingaruka bishobora kutugiraho. Mu gihe hagwa imvura ivanze n’inkuba n’imirabyo abaturage barasabwa ibi bikurukira: 1. Kwirinda kugama munsi y’igiti kiri cyonyine, ahantu hari amazu ya telefoni rusange ndetse no ku misozi hejuru, kuko ibyo byose byagira uruhare mu gukubitwa n’inkuba.
2. Kwirinda gukorakora no gutwara ibintu bizwiho gutwara umuriro vuba ni ukuvuga ibyuma binyuranye nk’amakanya, umutaka, ferabeto n’ibindi mu gihe ibyo byuma bisumba umutwe w’ubitwaye. 3. Igihe uri mu modoka; ibuka gufunga ibirahure byose, 
4. Kwirinda gukorakora (gushyira intoki) mu madirishya arimo ibyuma bya giriyaje.
5. Kwirinda kuba hafi cyangwa gukorakora ahantu hari za senyenge cyangwa se ibindi bikoresho bikoze mu byuma. 6. Niba wumvise inkuba uri mu ishyamba, ibyiza ni ukuguma hagati ukirinda kujya mu nkengero zaryo. 7. Kwirinda koga, kuguma cyangwa kugenda mu mazi  mu gihe cy’inkuba. Abana bakunda gukinira mu bidendezi by’amazi bakabyirinda ndetse n’abandi mukirinda gukandagira mu mazi mu nzu ukoropa cyangwa umesa. 8. Kwirinda gukoresha ibyuma bizamuka mu nyubako z’amagorofa, bita ascenceur (lift) igihe cy’imirabyo n’inkuba. 9. Kwirinda gukoresha ibintu byose bikoresha amashanyarazi mu gihe utizeye neza ko inyubako yawe ifite “akarindankuba” (paratonerre). 10. Kwirinda kuryama hasi ku butaka kuko byakurura gukubitwa n’inkuba. 11. Niba uri ku igare  cyangwa kuri moto, ibyiza ni ukubivaho kuko bishobora gutuma inkuba igukubita. 12. Gukoresha ibyuma birinda inkuba (paratonnerre) ku nyubako. 13. Kurinda ibikoresho bikoreshwa n’amashanyarazi hifashishwa ibyuma byabugenewe. 14. Kuzimya ibikoresho byose bikoresha amashanyarazi, nka Radio, Televiziyo, telefoni n’ibindi

title: Mu mafoto 25, yavuguruje abavuga ko abanini badashobora kuberwa nk’ibyamamare
content: Kwambara neza umuntu akaberwa ni ibintu bihesha ishema benshi ndetse buri wese usohotse mu nzu arabanza akareba neza ko aberewe. Ku bakiri bato cyane cyane abagore n’abakobwa bakunze kurebera ku byamamare, ugasanga aribyo bibaha isura nyayo yo kuberwa. Abenshi mu byamamare benshi bareberaho usanga bananutse, bafite umubiri benshi bifuza kugira ndetse benshi bagatekereza ko imiterere yabo yo kunanuka ku bice bimwe na bimwe by’umubiri wabo aribyo bibahesha kuberwa. Uyu mukobwa we rero siko abibona ndetse akoresheje imwe mu myambarire ya bamwe mu byamamare, yifotoje agaragaza ko n’ubwo adateye nk’ibyo byamamare, we akaba abyibushye, ashobora kwambara nkabo kandi akaberwa. Dore amwe mu mafoto ye

title: Ikosa rikomeye ugomba kwirinda ku munsi wa mbere w’akazi
content: Iyo umuntu atangiye akazi, ku munsi we wa mbere aba ashaka kugaragara neza ndetse no gushakisha igikundiro muri bagenzi be ndetse no ku mukoresha we. Gusa hari ikosa benshi bakunze gukora kandi byoroshye kuryirinda. Iryo kosa rikomeye benshi bahuriraho ni ukwivuga ibigwi, ugasanga umuntu aragerageza kwerekanako ari umuntu ukomeye, ko ashoboye akazi, ko yakoze byinshi byiza n’ibindi nk’ibyo nyamara ntukamenye ko ibi aho gutuma abantu bakwiyumvamo ahubwo bishobora gutuma batagukunda na mba. Umwe mu bahanga mu gutoza mu kubaka umwuga witwa Jason Sackett yabwiye urubuga Well and Good ati “Kugira ngo umuntu abone ucyubahiro n’igikundiro muri bagenzi be ku kazi ndetse n’abakoresha ku munsi wa mbere w’akazi, ni byiza ko ubanza kubitaho, ugashakisha kubamenya aho kubibwira igihe kinini.” Kwivuga cyane ku munsi wa mbere w’akazi bikunze gutera umujinya abo usanze ku kazi ni yo mpamvu biba byiza ko ubanza gushakisha amakuru ku bakozi usanze mu murimo. “Ugomba kumenya icyo buri wese ashinzwe, impano yifitemo, ibyo yagiye ageraho bikomeye kugira ngo urusheho kubereka ko ubizeye kandi ko uje mu kazi gufatanya nabo, ukeneye ko bakwereka uko bikorwa, ntuze kwigize bamenya.” Jason Sackett Ibi bituma batakubona nk’umwanzi ahubwo bakakubona nk’uje gufatanya nabo bityo bakakugururira amarembo y’ubufatanye ,mu kazi ndetse n’ubucuti.

title: Dore uko icyumweru kizakugendekera bitewe n’igihe wavukiye (Horoscope)
content: Iyi ni inkuru ngaruka-cyumweru ikubiyemo icyo abahanga mu byo kwitegereza ahazaza (les voyants) bavuga ku bizaba ku muntu uko icyumweru gitashye, ukurikije igihe yavukiye. Dore uko icyumweru cyo ku ya 26 Werurwe kugeza ku ya 01 Mata, 2018  kizagenda  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Werurwe na 19 Mata (Belier)  Mu rukundo Mu iki cyumweru gisoza Werurwe, ntabwo muzabasha kwihishira mu rukundo. Muzagaragaza amarangamutima yanyu mu buryo bugaragara kandi muzabikora mureba kure. Muzifuza kubaka urukundo rwiza kandi rurambye, mugendeye kubyo umutima ubabwira. Nimuhuza nabo mukunda bizaba akarusho gusa ntibizorohera bose muri mwe, hari abo bizasaba kurwana intambara itoroshye. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru akazi kanyu kazazana impinduka nziza. Benshi muri mwe bazabona amahirwe mashya kandi bizaborohera kuyabyaza umusaruro. Gusa murasabwa kugira ukwihangana gukomeye mukabigenza buhoro kuko guhubuka bishobora gusenya ibyo mwubatse ndetse n’ahazaza hakagorana. Mu butunzi Iki cyumweru kizababera icyo gusubiza amaso inyuma mukamenya neza icyo mukeneye. Muziga gukoresha amafaranga ari mu rugero rw’ibyo mukeneye koko, mwirinda ibyo umutima ushaka ariko bidafite akamaro nubwo kuri benshi muri mwe bitazaba icyemezo kiboroheye.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 20 Mata na 20 Gicurasi (Taureau)  Mu rukundo Uburyo mwifuza urukundo nyarwo bizabafasha kwinjiramo mu buryo bwose bushoboka kandi mukoreshe umutima wanyu wose. Muziyumvamo igisobanuro nyacyo cyarwo kandi murusheho kwiyumva mu wo mukundana ari na we uzabaha icyo gisobanuro nyakuri. Ibiganiro muzagirana muri iki cyumweru bizabaganisha ku rukundo rurambye nimuramuka mubyitondeye mukirinda guhubuka no kuvuga ibidakwiye. Mu butunzi Murasabwa gupangira amafaranga mwinjiza bitandukanye cyane n’uko musanzwe mubigenza kandi murasabwa kwitwara neza mu mpinduka muzahura nazo muri iki cyumweru. Muzahura n’ibintu byisnhi muzakoreshamo amafaranga bibatunguye ariko ibi ntabwo bizahungabanya umutungo mwari musanzwe mufite. Gusa murumva neza ko musabwa kubikorana ubushishozi. Mu kazi Uguhanga udushya kwanyu niko kuzabafasha gutunganya akazi kanyu mu mutuzo. Bizabafasha kubaka akazi kanyu yaba umunsi ndetse no mu minsi iri imbere kuko bizabagirira inyungu zirenze izo murimo gutekereza ubu. Ntimugashidikanye ku bushobozi mwifitemo ahubwo ni byiza ko mwiyizera ngo mubashe gukora ibyo mushinzwe nta kibazo.   Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Gicurasi na 21 Kamena (Gemaux)  Mu rukundo Muzanyurwa cyane mu rukundo kuko muzaruhundagazwaho yaba n’abo mukunda cyangwa se n’umuryango. Muziyumvamo icyizere cyinshi cyo gukomeza ubuzima kuko muzibona nk’abantu bakunzwe cyane. Muzafata umwanya wo kwiyegurira bya nyabyo uwo mukundana kandi bizabanyura mwembi mu gihe kirekire cyane. Mu butunzi Muzatangira gukora imibare ubabashisha gutangira gusohora amafaranga make cyane. Ibyifuzo byanyu byo gutera imbere no kugera kure bizababashisha kwiyima kugira ngo mubashe kwibikira iby’ejo. Mwitegure kandi kugira ibintu bitunguranye byo guhaha mu rugo. Mu kazi Kurushaho gutekereza mu buryo bwiza bizabafasha mu kazi kanyu ka buri munsi muri iki cyumweru. Murasabwa kwitegereza cyane ibijyanye n’ejo hanyu mu murimo mukora kandi ibi mukabitangira nta gutinda kuko iki cyumweru ari icy’amahirwe kuri mwe.   Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Kamena na 22 Nyakanga (Cancer)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzakanguka mubone neza uburyo bwo kuryoherwa n’urukundo mu buzima bwa buri munsi bityo mumenye neza uko mwazana impinduka haba mu mubano wanyu n’abandi cyangwa se no mu buzima bwanyu bwite. Muzakora isuzuma ry’uko muhagaze mu rukundo bitume muzana impinduka zishimishije. Ni igihe cyiza cyo kwiyegereza inshuti n’umuryango ariko by’umwihariko n’uwo mukundana. Mu butunzi Muziyumvamo imbaraga zo kuzamura umutungo wanyu ndetse mwifuze kurya ibyo mwavunikiye. Ni byiza rero ko mwatunganya neza imishinga yose mufite igira aho ihurira n’amafaranga kugira ngo bijye ku murongo. Nimumara kubitunganya bizabarinda kugira ikibahagarika. Muzabigiriramo amahirwe akomeye nimuramuka mwemeye gukoresha imbaraga zanyu zose. Ibyo mukeneye bizabaha imbaraga zo kongera umutungo wanyu. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru muzagira ibiganiro bibaha icyizere cyo gukemura ibibazo byinshi by’akazi ariko muzakenera n’ibihamya birenze amagambo kandi ibi muzabibona nimuramuka mwirinze guhisha ikibarimo. Guhanga udushya kwanyu bizabagirira akamaro muri iki cyumweru, ni byiza rero ko mwinjira neza mu ntekerezo zanyu maze ibitekerezo bije mukamenya kubibyaza umusaruro uko bikwiye.   Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nyakanga na 22 Kanama(Lion)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru iminsi yose izababera iy’urukundo rugurumana nta na kimwe mwirengagije. Uburyo mutekereza bizabafasha nta gushidikanya kwinjira neza mu rukundo. Ntimuzishimira ibyo mwari musanzwe mumenyereye ahubwo muzashaka udushya. Mu butunzi Muzifuza impinduka mu bijyanye n’umutungo wanyu. Icy’ingenzi kuri mwe ni ugushyira ku murongo ibijyanye n’uko umutungo wanyu ukoreshwa mwibanda ku mishinga ibabyarira inyungu. Nimwiyemeza gukoresha imbaraga nyinshi muzagira amahirwe yo kunguka ku rwego rwo hejuru. Mufite amahirwe menshi muri iki cyumweru. Mu kazi Muzakora akazi kanyu mu buryo bwihariye iki cyumweru. Muzibanda cyane ku by’uhutirwa n’iby’ingenzi kurusha mu cyumweru gishize. Muziyumvamo ubushobozi budasanzwe bwo gukemura ibyo mumaze igihe mushyize ku ruhande maze mutegure neza ikindi cyumweru.   Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Kanama na 22 Nzeri (Vierge)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru urukundo rwanyu muzarubamo nta bikabyo. Muziyerekana uko muri ndetse muzakuraho ugushidikanya kose abo mukundana bari babafiteho. Muzakenera ariko kwagura urukundo rwanyu bityo muzagirana ibiganiro byubaka n’abo mukunda. Kuri mwe ukuri kose muzishimira kukuvuga ahubwo munoze amagambo mukoresha mukuvuga. Mu butunzi Umutungo wanyu ushobora guhura n’amahirwe awuzamura muri iki cyumweru. Muzahura n’ibigeragezo binshi bibasaba gukoresha amafaranga mwibwira ko murimo kuvugurura ubuzima bwanyu. Muzabyitondere maze mubanze mubare neza mbere yo kugira amafaranga cyangwa undi mutungo wose musohora bitari ngombwa. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru muzumva mushaka cyane gushimwa bityo muzakora mutikoresheje ngo mubigereho. Akazi kanyu kazaborohera kandi muzabona ubufasha buturutse hirya no hino kandi muzabwakirane ineza gusa muzabanze mushishoze kuko siko bose bazaba babifuriza ibyiza gusa.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nzeri na 22 Ukwakira (Balance) Mu rukundo Uburyo mwifuza urukundo nyarwo bizabafasha kwinjiramo mu buryo bwose bushoboka kandi mukoreshe umutima wanyu wose. Mu kazi Uguhanga udushya kwanyu niko kuzabafasha gutunganya akazi kanyu mu mutuzo. Ntimugashidikanye ku bushobozi mwifitemo ahubwo ni byiza ko mwiyizera ngo mubashe gukora ibyo mushinzwe nta kibazo.   Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ukwakira na 22 Ugushyingo (Scorpion)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru urukundo rwanyu muzifuza kurusangira n’abo mukunda ntaho mubahishe. muziyumvamo umutima wo kumva no gufasha abo mukunda kandi mu buryo bubanogeye mwembi. Niba nta mukunzi ufite ni byiza ko wirinda gushakisha cyane kuko ushobra guhura n’abatagukwiriye, ubanze ushishoze. Mu butunzi Ni icyumweru cyiza cyane ku mishinga irebana no guteza imbere urugo ndetse no kurutunga uko bikwiriye. Muzamenyana n’abantu bazabagirira akamaro mu minsi iri imbere. Muzagira ibitekerezo bishya ndetse rimwe na rimwe ibyuyimviro byanyu bizabaherekeza mu gufata umwanzuro ufatika. Gusa mugomba kurangwa no kwihangana kugira ngo ibintu banyu mutabyihutisha hakabamo guhubuka. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru, abo mukorana cyane cyane ababakuriye bazagaragaza imbaraga nyinshi mu kazi. Murasabwa ibakwe rero ngo mubashe kugendera ku muvuduko nk’uwabo. Muri iki cyumweru igikomeye kizabagora ni ukugendana n’impinduka mu micungire no kugena uko mukoresha umutungo wanyu mwibanda ku kwizigamira cyane. Mushobora kuzabona amafaranga ku buryo buboroheye ariko ikizabagora ni ukumenya kuyakoresha uku bikwiye. Mu kazi Akazi kanyu muri iki cyumweru kazaba kihuta cyane kandi bizabashimisha cyane niba mukora ibyo mukunda, ariko niba ibyo mukora mubikoreshwa n’amaramuko gusa iki cyumweru kizabavuna cyane bityo murasabwa kwitonda cyane hato bitazabateranya n’abakoresha banyu. Muzashyiremo agatege bityo mwirinde ingaruka zaterwa no kwiteranya n’ababahemba.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Gicurasi na 21 Kamena (Gemaux)  Mu rukundo Urukundo rwanyu muri iki cyumweru ruzarangwa n’intekerezo nyinshi. Muzagira umwanya uhagije wo kwitekerezaho no kureba aho muhagaze mu rukundo kandi imyanzuro muzafata izabaherekeza mu gihe kirekire mu buzima bw’urukundo mwaba mufite abakunzi cyangwa ntabo. Mu butunzi  Gutekereza kwanyu kuzabageza mu nzira ikwiriye, mbese uko muzarushaho gutekereza mu buryo bwiza niko muzaba mwiyegereza inzira mukwiriye kunyuramo ngo ubutunzi bwanyu bumere neza. Bizaba ngombwa ko mwisuzuma kandi mukita ku bintu byose ntacyo mwirengagije kuko uku kwirengagiza n’ubwo kaba ari akantu gato gushobora kubagusha mu mutego wabatera igihombo gikomeye Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru akazi kanyu kazakurikiranamu buryo budasanzwe kandi bwihuse cyane. Muzabona impinduka nyinshi ariko kujyana nazo nibyo bizabafasha kubaka neza umwuga wanyu, muwuha inking zikomeye z’ejo hazaza.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Kamena na 22 Nyakanga (Cancer)  Mu rukundo Ni byiza ko muri iki cyumweru mwirinda kwibikamo ibyifuzo byanyu ahubwo mukabigaragaza bityo mukimwa mutiyimye. Benshi muri mwe bazagera kure batigeze bagera na rimwe mu rukundo. Niba mufite abakunzi, bazabereka cyane urukundo ndetse no ku bumva mu mabanga y’urukundo. Ukwihangana kwanyu niko kuzabahesha gutuza mu rukundo kandi n’abo mukunda bazabiha agaciro. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muzongera musubire mu mibare, mwitegereze neza aho amafaranga yanyu ajya ndetse n’inyungu abazanira. Mushobora kuzabona amafaranga mu buryo butunguranye kandi butangaje nk’inshuti ibarangiye ikiraka, amahirwe yo kubona umukiliya ubagurira umwe mu mitungo mwifuza kugurisha kandi byose biri mu nyungu zanyu. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru muzagira ibiganiro bibaha icyizere cyo gukemura ibibazo byinshi by’akazi ariko muzakenera n’ibihamya birenze amagambo kandi ibi muzabibona nimuramuka mwirinze guhisha ikibarimo. Guhanga udushya kwanyu bizabagirira akamaro muri iki cyumweru, ni byiza rero ko mwinjira neza mu ntekerezo zanyu maze ibitekerezo bije mukamenya kubibyaza umusaruro uko bikwiye.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nyakanga na 22 Kanama(Lion)  Urukundo rwanyu muri iki cyumweru ruzarangwa n’intekerezo nyinshi. Muzagira umwanya uhagije wo kwitekerezaho no kureba aho muhagaze mu rukundo kandi imyanzuro muzafata izabaherekeza mu gihe kirekire mu buzima bw’urukundo mwaba mufite abakunzi cyangwa ntabo. Mu butunzi  Gutekereza kwanyu kuzabageza mu nzira ikwiriye, mbese uko muzarushaho gutekereza mu buryo bwiza niko muzaba mwiyegereza inzira mukwiriye kunyuramo ngo ubutunzi bwanyu bumere neza. Bizaba ngombwa ko mwisuzuma kandi mukita ku bintu byose ntacyo mwirengagije kuko uku kwirengagiza n’ubwo kaba ari akantu gato gushobora kubagusha mu mutego wabatera igihombo gikomeye Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru akazi kanyu kazakurikiranamu buryo budasanzwe kandi bwihuse cyane. Muzabona impinduka nyinshi ariko kujyana nazo nibyo bizabafasha kubaka neza umwuga wanyu, muwuha inking zikomeye z’ejo hazaza.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Kanama na 22 Nzeri (Vierge)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzagira inzozi nke ahubwo mubeho mu rukundo rubaryoheye. Muzakora byinshi kurusha uko muzatekereza cyane ndetse na bike muzatekerezaho bizaba ari uburyo bwo kunoza neza ibyo muteganya gukora ngo urukundo rwanyu rubaryohere kurushaho. Abo mukundana bazatungurwa no kubona ko mufite ibikorwa byinshi biruta amagambo kandi bizabanezeza gusa muri iki cyumweru murasa n’abazashyira hanze amabanga menshi n’ubwo mwaba mutizeye neza uko abakunzi banyu babyakira. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muzarushaho kubona neza uko umutungo wanyu uhagaze bityo biborohere kumenya uko mwawubyaza umusaruro. Nta gushidikanya kwinshi muzafata umurongo uhamye uzabageza ku gutunga nta bwoba bwo gusubira inyuma mufite ahubwo murangamiye kuzamuka. Niba mufite amadeni menshi, iki nicyo gihe cyo gufata umwanzuro mukayishyura kuko gutera imbere ufite imyenda bidashoboka. Mu kazi Muzakorana ingufu nyinshi muri iki cyumweru ngo muteze imbere imishinga yanyu. Uburyo muzafatanya n’abo mukorana bazabyishimira cyane. Imbaraga muzakoresha zizaba nke kurusha izo mwakoresheje mu byumweru 2 bishize. Muzagira amahirwe yo gutera imbere kandi ibyo mukora nibyo pfundo rizabageza kuri iri terambere.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nzeri na 22 Ukwakira (Balance)  Mu rukundo Amarangamutima azababana menshi cyane muri iki cyumweru. Ibyo bazabakorera, ibyo bazababwira, uko bazabitaho ndetse n’impano bazabaha bizakangura cyane ibishashi by’urukundo bibarimo. Urukundo ruzaza ku mwanya wa mbere mubyo mukora niyo byaba bitameze neza cyane muzihutira gukemura ikibazo cyose mubona kibangamira uburyohe bw’urukundo rwanyu. Mu butunzi Muzashaka gutangira impinduka mu bijyanye no gukoresha amafaranga yanyu. Umuryango wanyu uzababera umujyanama mwiza kubyo mushidikanyaho bitandukanye. Nyubwo aba bazasa n’ababagira inama zibagoye ariko nizo zizabafasha kwiga neza ku igenamigambi ryanyu bityo mugire imyifatire ikwiriye mu gukoresha amafaranga. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru murasabwa cyane gushyira ingufu mu mitekerereze ibafasha gufata imyanzuro yongera imbaraga mu kazi mushinzwe gutunganya. Muzarangwa n’imbaraga zidasanzwe zo gukemura ibibazo bimaze iminsi byarababereye ingutu mu kazi. Ntimuzaheze ubufasha ubwo aribwo bwosemuzahabwa kuko buzaza bwuzuza imbaraga zanyu bityo ibintu birusheho kugenda neza kurusha uko mwabyirundaho bikaba byababaho byinshi.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ukwakira na 22 Ugushyingo (Scorpion)  Mu rukundo Muzagira umwanya wo gutekereza cyane ku marangamutima mwiyumvamo. Ugushidikanya muzagira muhumure kuzaba kubaganisha ku mpinduka nziza, ntimuzumve mucitse intege ahubwo muzatekereze byimbitse kugira ngo mufate imyanzuro n’ingamba bizatuma muba mu rukundo rwuzuye. Muri mu nzira nziza rwose niba mutekereza ko hari ibyo mugomba guhindura mu biganiro biyoborwa n’amarangamutima yanyu. Mu butunzi Muzongera imbaraga mu bijyanye no gushaka kwigenga mu mutungo. Muzagira impinduka cyane mu bijyanye no gucunga umutungo wanyu, cyane cyane ku birebana no guhaha. Muzirukana rwose akavuyo no gahunda zidafatika zibatwarira amafaranga buri munsi maze mufate gahunda ihamye yo gucunga umutungo wanyu. Mu kazi Hari impinduka mu birebana n’imirimo yanyu. Iki cyumweru nimwe muzaba umutima w’ikipe mukorana, bityo rero niba mwari musanzwe mufite akavuyo birabasaba kwisubiraho mugatuza kugira ngo akazi kanyu katabapfana. Muzagira amahirwe menshi ni muramuka mugaragaje icyo mushoboye, mwita ku bintu byose ibito n’ibinini kandi muzagera kuby’ingenzi bityo bibafungurire imiryango.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ugushyingo na 21 Ukoboza (Sagittaire)  Mu rukundo Abo mukunda babategerejeho byinshi muri iki cyumweru bityo murasabwa gukora iyo bwabaga ngo mubashe guhaza kwifuza kwabo niba mugikeneye kubana nabo mu mahoro. Muzirinde kuvuga byinshi ahubwo mugaragaze ibikorwa, bizabafasha kwirinda gutanga amasezerano mudashobora gusohoza. Mu butunzi Umutungo wanyu ushobora guhura n’amahirwe awuzamura muri iki cyumweru. Muzahura n’ibigeragezo binshi bibasaba gukoresha amafaranga mwibwira ko murimo kuvugurura ubuzima bwanyu. Muzabyitondere maze mubanze mubare neza mbere yo kugira amafaranga cyangwa undi mutungo wose musohora bitari ngombwa. Mu kazi  Muri iki cyumweru muzumva mushaka cyane gushimwa bityo muzakora mutikoresheje ngo mubigereho. Akazi kanyu kazaborohera kandi muzabona ubufasha buturutse hirya no hino kandi muzabwakirane ineza gusa muzabanze mushishoze kuko siko bose bazaba babifuriza ibyiza gusa.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Ukuboza na 20 Mutarama (Capricorne)  Mu rukundo Urukundo rwanyu rushobora kuzahura n’ibihe byiza ariko nimwe ubwanyu mufite uruhare mu kubifata no kubibyaza umusaruro. Murasabwa kwishimira ibyiza byose mubona mu rukundo rwanyu rwaba urw’umuryango, inshuti cyangwa se n’uwo mukundana kuko bizatuma urwo mufite rushinga imizi ndetse rugafata icyerekezo nyacyo. Mu butunzi Iki cyumweru gisa n’ikigoranye mu bijyanye n’umutungo wanyu bityo murasabwa kugabanya ibyo mutanga mu gukoresha amafaranga cyane cyane mu guhahira urugo mwige guhaha bike by’ingenzi. Mushobora kugira amahirwe yo kubona ikibafasha kongera inyungu ariko birasaba ko mukoresha imbaraga nyinshi kandi ntimwiteshe amahirwe abizanira nubwo mwaba mubona ari make. Mu kazi  Nta byinshi bishya muzahura nabyo mu kazi kanyu k’iki cyumweru, muzakora akazi nk’uko bisanzwe. Mushobora kugirana ikibazo n’umukoresha wanyu cyangwa se umukiriya w’imena ariko birasa n’aho kidakomeye bitewe n’uko muzacyitwaramo.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Mutarama na 18 Gashyantare (Verseau)  Mu rukundo Niba nta mukunzi ufite muri iyi minsi, iki cyumweru kizakubera cyiza ariko kandi bitewe n’icyerekezo ufite mu rukundo gishobora no kukugora mu gihe waba nta  gahunda ufite yo kuguma wenyine by’igihe kirekire. Mu butunzi Mushobora guhura n’amahirwe menshi yo kongera umutungo wanyu ariko by’igihe gito. Murasabwa kutayapfusha ubusa ariko kandi mukirinda kwitwara nk’abagezeyo ahubwo mukayabyaza umusaruro, bityo mukongera uburemere bw’ikofi yanyu. Mu kazi  Akazi k’iki cyumweru kazihuta cyane, murasabwa kugendera kuri uwo muvuduko mugakora ibintu byose nk’uko bikwiriye kuko muzaba muhanzwe amaso cyane. Sibyiza ko mwagirana ibibazo n’abakoresha cyangwa abakiliya banyu kuko bishobora gutuma mugira ingaruka ziremereye.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 19 Gashyantare na 20 Werurwe (Poissons)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzasa n’abadasobanukirwa neza aho muhagaze mu rukundo rwanyu, ariko ntampamvu yo guhangayika kuko bizamara igihe gito. Muri iki gihe ariko murasabwa kwirinda kuvuga amagambo yakomeretsa abo mukunda by’igihe kirekire, ahubwo mugasa n’abarebera iby’urukundo ku ruhande hato mutazicuza. Mu butunzi
Iki cyumweru kizababera cyiza mu buryo bw’umutungo. Birashoboka ko mwagira amahirwe yo kubona amafaranga mutateganyaga kubona ariko murumva ko musabwa kuyakoresha neza kuko afite igisobanuro ku hazaza hanyu. Mu kazi  Muri iki cyumweru murasabwa kwerekana icyo mushoboye. Muzakoresha ingufu nyinshi kandi muzatunganya neza ibyo mushinzwe gusa muzirinde kwivanga mu kazi k’abandi mugatunganya ibyanyu mwirengagije ibyo abandi babasaba. Ni aha mpiniye, ahasigaye mugire icyumweru gihire! Ni aho mu cyumweru gitaha.

title: Dore uko icyumweru kizakugendekera bitewe n’igihe wavukiye (Horoscope)
content: Iyi ni inkuru ngaruka-cyumweru ikubiyemo icyo abahanga mu byo kwitegereza ahazaza (les voyants) bavuga ku bizaba ku muntu uko icyumweru gitashye, ukurikije igihe yavukiye. Dore uko icyumweru cyo ku ya 29 Mutarama kugeza ku ya  4 Gashyantare kizagenda  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Werurwe na 19 Mata (Belier)  Mu rukundo Kuba umwimerere ndetse no kwerekana ibibarimo nibyo bizabahesha amahirwe mu rukundo muri iki cyumweru. Bizaborohera kugaragariza abo mukunda amarangamutima yanyu bityo nabo bishimire kuyasangira namwe. Urukundo no kubohoka nibyo bizaranga ibiganiro byanyu. Mu butunzi Mu mpera z’iki cyumweru birashoboka ko mwabona amafaranga. Ayo mahirwe azahurirana n’ibikorwa byanyu bwite mwihimbiye, ikemurwa ry’imanza mwaba mufite cyangwa se n’ibyo mwagurisha. Muzahura n’imishinga mishya ariko nubwo mufite ibindi mukora ntibizababuze kugerageza n’ibishya kuko wasanga ariyo mbarutso y’iterambere ryanyu cyane cyane mu bijyanye no kwigwizaho umutungo. Mu kazi Akazi kazabagendekera neza muri iki cyumweru. Ntabwo muzigera mubura icyo mukora ahubwo bizajya bigenda bisimburana vuba na vuba. Muzarangwa no guhanga udushya kandi ibi bizabafasha guhangana n’impinduka.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 20 Mata na 20 Gicurasi (Taureau)  Mu rukundo Bamwe muri mwe bazatangira umubano w’igihe kirekire nyuma yo gukunda by’ako kanya kandi rwose ayo mahirwe azaboneka, nimwe gusa mwifitemo kuyakira cyangwa kuyareka agahita gusa murasabwa kumvira umutima wanyu, hanyuma mukazabitekerezaho nyuma. Nimubitekerezaho cyane bizabangamira kwisanzura kwanyu bitumen urukundo rutagira imbaraga. Mu butunzi Muzabasha gufunga burundu bimwe mubyabagoraga mu giha cyashize. Muzafata umwanya wo kwirengagiza iby’ahashize maze musohoke aho mwazitiriwe n’amateka. Muzakire neza impinduka mu igenamigambi ryanyu kuko ari ingenzi cyane mu iterambere ryanyu. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru akazi kanyu kazaba kari ku murongi, ntabwo muzatuma hari ubavangira cyangwa ngo hagire ikintu kibarogoya. Muzatangirana n’ingamba nshya kandi ibi ibizahindura byinshi ku mikorere yanyu kandi bizabaha umusaruro ushimishije.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Gicurasi na 21 Kamena (Gemaux)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzahura na byinshi bizatuma murushaho kwegera inzozi mufite mu rukundo. Benshi muri mwe muzahura n’abazababera urukundo rw’ibihe byose kandi bazabazanamo intekerezo zagutse ku rukundo rwanyu maze rukure kandi rwaguke mu buryo buzabanezeza. Mu butunzi Imbaraga muzashyira mu gukora nizo zizaba umusaruro w’ibyo muzunguka muri iki cyumweru. Ikindi kandi ababazengurutse bazababera inkingi ya mwamba ngo mubashe gufata ibyemezo bibateza imbere. Iki cyumweru kizababera icyo gufata ibyemezo bibageza ku iterambere rirambye ariko nimudashishoza gishobora kubabera intandaro yo gusububira inyuma mu buryo bukomeye. Mu kazi Gukabya cyane mu kazi bizababera inzitizi ikomeye mu gutera imbere kwanyu mu mwuga. Imikoranire n’ababazengurutse ntizabanyura muri iki cyumweru gusa murasabwa kutiharira imirimo yose cyangwa ngo mukoreshe amategeko menshi mu kazi ahubwo muzagerageze koroherana kugira ngo byose bigende nk’uko mubyifuza.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Kamena na 22 Nyakanga (Cancer)  Mu rukundo Urukundo ruzatuma mutanga amafaranga muri iki cyumweru. Muzifuza gutanga impano nyinshi ariko nimukabya birashoboka cyane ko muzaseba mwashiriwe n’amafaranga, icyiza rero ni ukubanza kureba uko ikofi ihagaze maze mukabona gufata umwanzuro wo guhahira uwo mukunda. Inshuti za hafi zizagira uruhare mu kukugarura ngo udasesagura cyane umutungo wawe, inama zabo ntimuzazirengagize. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muziyumvamo impinduka zubaka ubutunzi bwanyu. Muzakoresha uko mushoboye ngo mukoreshe amafaranga make ashoboka. Muzagira intekerezo nyinshi maze mufate umwanya wo guhitamo ibyiza byabateza imbere. Ntimuzagire igitekerezo musuzugura kuko kimwe muri byo ari ipfundo ryo gutera imbere mu minsi iri imbere. Mu kazi Muziyumvamo imbaraga zo guhatana ku murimo. Biragaragara ko muri iki cyumweru muzagira impamvu nyinshi zibahatira guhatana no kwerekana ibyo mushoboye ku rwego rwo hejuru. Muzahura n’imbogamizi ariko nimudacika intege umusaruro muzakuramo uzabanogera.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nyakanga na 22 Kanama(Lion)  Mu rukundo Ibiganiro bizagenda byerekeza aho mushaka. Iki cyumweru muzumvwa n’abo mukunda rwose, ibyo bikazaterwa n’uko namwe mwagaragaje ko muzi gutega amatwi n’uburyo mukunda. Mushobora kandi no guhura n’urukundo rubatunguye kandi rukaba rufite amahirwe menshi yo gukomeza mu gihe mwaba muri mwenyine. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muzatera intamwe ishimishije mu kwinjiza amafaranga ndetse no kubona ibindi byinshi biyinjiza. Amahirwe azabahora iruhande kandi uguhizaho kwanyu niko kuzabazanira uwo musaruro. Inshingano zanyu ziziyongera kandi kudacika intege kwanyu niko kuzabafasha kuzitunganya uko bikwiye. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru bizabagora cyane gufatanya akazi n’ubundi buzima busanzwe ariko muzagerageza kwirinda kugira icyo mwica n’ubwo bizabagora cyane kumenya guhitamo aho mushyira imbaraga kurusha ahandi.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Kanama na 22 Nzeri (Vierge)  Mu rukundo Nubwo ibiganiro byanyu bizasa n’ibitameze neza, muzabasha kugumana cya kibatsi cy’urukundo. Muzasa n’abiyibagirwa kugira ngo munezeze abo mukunda. Ibi bishobora kugera kure bigatuma uwo mukundana abyitwaza cyane hanyuma namwe mukaba mwakwisubiraho bikabatera gutekereza ibindi. Mu butunzi Ntabwo muzatagaguza umutungo wanyu ahubwo muzashyiraho amategeko y’icungamutungo akomeye azafasha umuryango wanyu kumererwa neza no kutagira icyo ubura. Mushobora kandi kwinjiza amafaranga mu buryo bubatunguye mu mpera z’iki cyumweru. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru nta kintu na kimwe muzemera ko kibavangira mu kazi. Muzagira amahame mashya yihariye azabagenga kandi ntimuzakundira uwo ariwe wese kubabuza kuyakurikiza, ibi bikazabafasha guhindura byinshi ku buzima bwanyu bwa buri munsi bw’akazi.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nzeri na 22 Ukwakira (Balance)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzarushaho gufungura amarangamutima yanyu maze muryoherwe n’urukundo rubarimo. Benshi muri mwe bazabona urukundo rushya kandi ruzabahira. Nta mpamvu yo kuzuyaza gufatirana ayo mahirwe hanyuma ku basanzwe bari mu rukundo ni igihe cyo kuzamura ibishashi byarwo ngo uwo mukunda arusheho kubabonamo icyizere. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru ubutunzi bwanyu buzahura n’impinduka nyinshi . Niba hari umushinga mushya mwatangiye mugomba kwitondera ibintu byose kuko ikosa rito rishobora kubasubiza inyuma cyane. Iki cyumweru kizaborohera mu gukoresha amafaranga yanyu ndetse no gushakisha andi. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru niho muzagira amahirwe yo gukemura ibibazo mumaranye iminsi ku kazi ndetse no gutunganya ibirarane by’imirimo mutatuganyije neza mu gihe cyashize. Mwitegure rero impinduka mu kazi kuko muri iki cyumweru muzsabwa kubaka izina rihanagura iryo mwari mumaranye iminsi cyangwa se rikarikomeza. Amahitamo ari mu biganza byanyu.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ukwakira na 22 Ugushyingo (Scorpion)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muziyumvamvo ubusahake budasanzwe bwo kwigenga. Abo mukundana bazababura nubwo mwaba muhari intekerezo zanyu zizaba zira ahandi. Bizabagora gusobanurira abakunzi banyu uko mwumva ibintu ariko muzitonde kugira ngo mutazarema ikibazo kuremereye cyasenya urukundo rwanyu, muzabigendemo gake. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muragirwa inama yo kwishakamo ubuhanga bwo guhanga imirimo mishya ishobora kubyara inyungu ariko ibi ntibizababuze kwibuka ko hari ibindi mukeneye ndetse n’ibyo abari hafi yanyu bifuza kandi mugomba guhaza ibyifuzo byabo. Gusa intekerezo zanyu nizo zizababera intwaro ituma ubutunzi bwanyu bukoreshwa neza muri iki cyumweru. title: Dore uko icyumweru kizakugendekera bitewe n’igihe wavukiye (Horoscope)

Ibyanyu muzabikora mwitonze kandi mufate imyanzuro mwabanje kuyitekerezaho neza bityo n’intambwe muzatera mu rukundo izaba ihamye kandi iki cyumweru kizasiga muzi neza icyo mushaka. Muzamenya gutanga ndetse no kwakira urukundo mu buryo bwuzuzanya kandi buryoshye. Mu butunzi Akazi kanyu kazihuta cyane muri iki cyumweru. Mbese muzagira ibyihutrwa byinshi muzagomba gukemura vuba na vuba.  Hazaba impinduka muzasabwa kwihutira kujyana nazo ariko biragaragara ko muzabasha rwose kubisohokamo neza mwirinda ababatesha gutunganya neza ibyo mukora cyane cyane bakoresheje ururimi rwabo. Muzagira ibitekerezo bishya ndetse rimwe na rimwe ibyuyimviro byanyu bizabaherekeza mu gufata umwanzuro ufatika. Gusa mugomba kurangwa no kwihangana kugira ngo ibintu banyu mutabyihutisha hakabamo guhubuka. Ugushidikanya muzagira muhumure kuzaba kubaganisha ku mpinduka nziza, ntimuzumve mucitse intege ahubwo muzatekereze byimbitse kugira ngo mufate imyanzuro n’ingamba bizatuma muba mu rukundo rwuzuye. Muri mu nzira nziza rwose niba mutekereza ko hari ibyo mugomba guhindura mu biganiro biyoborwa n’amarangamutima yanyu. Mu butunzi Muzongera imbaraga mu bijyanye no gushaka kwigenga mu mutungo. Muzagira impinduka cyane mu bijyanye no gucunga umutungo wanyu, cyane cyane ku birebana no guhaha. Muzirukana rwose akavuyo no gahunda zidafatika zibatwarira amafaranga buri munsi maze mufate gahunda ihamye yo gucunga umutungo wanyu. Mu kazi Hari impinduka mu birebana n’imirimo yanyu. Iki cyumweru nimwe muzaba umutima w’ikipe mukorana, bityo rero niba mwari musanzwe mufite akavuyo birabasaba kwisubiraho mugatuza kugira ngo akazi kanyu katabapfana. Muzagira amahirwe menshi ni muramuka mugaragaje icyo mushoboye, mwita ku bintu byose ibito n’ibinini kandi muzagera kuby’ingenzi bityo bibafungurire imiryango. Muri iki cyumweru igikomeye kizabagora ni ukugendana n’impinduka mu micungire no kugena uko mukoresha umutungo wanyu mwibanda ku kwizigamira cyane. Mushobora kuzabona amafaranga ku buryo buboroheye ariko ikizabagora ni ukumenya kuyakoresha uku bikwiye. Gusa mugomba kurangwa no kwihangana kugira ngo ibintu banyu mutabyihutisha hakabamo guhubuka. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru, abo mukorana cyane cyane ababakuriye bazagaragaza imbaraga nyinshi mu kazi. Murasabwa ibakwe rero ngo mubashe kugendera ku muvuduko nk’uwabo. Niba ukorana n’abantu benshi, birashoboka ko bashaka kukurusha imbaraga, bityo nawe urasabwa gukorana umwete ntabyo kujenjeka bitabaye ibyo uzasigara.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 20 Mata na 20 Gicurasi (Taureau)  Mu rukundo Muzanyurwa cyane mu rukundo kuko muzaruhundagazwaho yaba n’abo mukunda cyangwa se n’umuryango. Muziyumvamo icyizere cyinshi cyo gukomeza ubuzima kuko muzibona nk’abantu bakunzwe cyane. Muzafata umwanya wo kwiyegurira bya nyabyo uwo mukundana kandi bizabanyura mwembi mu gihe kirekire cyane. Mu butunzi
Muzatangira gukora imibare ubabashisha gutangira gusohora amafaranga make cyane. Ibyifuzo byanyu byo gutera imbere no kugera kure bizababashisha kwiyima kugira ngo mubashe kwibikira iby’ejo. Mwitegure kandi kugira ibintu bitunguranye byo guhaha mu rugo. Mu kazi Gutekereza mu buryo bwiza bizabafasha mu kazi kanyu ka buri munsi muri iki cyumweru. Murasabwa kwitegereza cyane ibijyanye n’ejo hanyu mu murimo mukora kandi ibi mukabitangira nta gutinda kuko iki cyumweru ari icy’amahirwe kuri mwe.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Gicurasi na 21 Kamena (Gemaux)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru urukundo rwanyu ruzazamuka ku rwego rwo hejuru. Ntabwo muzagarukira gusa ku bigaragarira amaso. Muzinjira neza mu buryo mubanyemo n’uwo mukunda maze mubashe gukuramo ibibanezeza cyane. Muzitonde mu mpano muzatanga muzirinde gukabya kuko muri iki cyumweru urukundo rubari hafi nta gushakisha. Ntimuzate umwanya mutekereza byinshi kuko muzi neza icyo mwifuza muzagikore nta gushidikanya. Mu butunzi Muzasubira neza mu mibare muri iki cyumweru maze bitume mutangira kwiga uburyo bwo gukoresha umutungo muke. Ubushake bwo gutera imbere buzatuma mwunguka ubwenge bwo gutekereza kabiri mbere yo gusohora n’igiceri kimwe. Muzatungurwa n’ibikenewe mu rugo mugomba guhaha. Mu kazi Muzakenera impinduka muri iki cyumweru mu kazi. Muzakora byinshi kandi mu gihe gito, nta kanya na gato muzaba mufite ko kwicara ahubwo muzifuza gukora cyane no guhanga udushya. Ni byiza ko muganiriza abandi ibijyanye n’utwo dushya kandi muhitemo neza abo mubiganiriza mwirinda ababaca intege.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Kamena na 22 Nyakanga (Cancer)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muziyumvamvo ubusahake budasanzwe bwo gutuza mu bijyanye n’urukundo. Ibyo muzakora byose muzarangwa no kugusha ku ntego mu kuri kutagize ibyo kwangiriza. Muziyumvamo ko mukeneye gufasha cyane abo mukunda ndetse ko mubafitiye akamaro. Ni ngombwa rero ko mugenzura neza ibyo mukora hato abo mukunda batazabigenderaho bagakabya kubasaba byinshi.
Mu butunzi  Muri iki cyumweru muzongera mugenzure neza uko mukoresha umutungo wanyu. Muri iki cyumweru birashoboka ko uko mwari mumenyereye kwinjiza bitinda ntibigende nk’uko byari bisanzwe bityo rero murasabwa kwitonda mukihangana ngo mwirinde ingaruka z’igihe kirekire. Mu kazi Uburyo bwanyu bwo kuyobora abandi mudategwa nibwo buzagira ingufu nyinshi mu kazi kanyu ka muri munsi muri iki cyumweru. Imikorere yanyu yihariye izababera isoko y’imbaraga nyinshi zizabageza ku ntego mwihaye. Gusa muzajya mukoresha imbaraga nyinshi ku buryo umunsi uzajya urangira mwananiwe bikabije ariko ntimuzacike intege kuko bizabongerera amahirwe yo gukura mu mwuga.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nyakanga na 22 Kanama(Lion)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muziyumvamvo ubusahake budasanzwe bwo kwigenga. Abo mukundana bazababura nubwo mwaba muhari intekerezo zanyu zizaba zira ahandi. Bizabagora gusobanurira abakunzi banyu uko mwumva ibintu ariko muzitonde kugira ngo mutazarema ikibazo kuremereye cyasenya urukundo rwanyu, muzabigendemo gake. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muragirwa inama yo kwishakamo ubuhanga bwo guhanga imirimo mishya ishobora kubyara inyungu kandi amahirwe ari mu ruhande rwanyu ku buryo iyi mirimo ishobora ku babyarira inyungu z’igihe kirekire. Mu kazi Uburyo budasanzwe bwo gutunganya akazi mu buryo bw’umwihariko nibwo buzabaranga muri iki cyumweru kandi ibi bizagira ingaruka nziza mu kazi kanyu. Muzagira amahirwe ya gusobanura ibyo mukora n’uburyo mubikora kandi ntimuzayapfusha ubusa, muzamenya icyo kuvuga mu gihe cyayo. Ni byiza rero kwitegura hakiri kare.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Kanama na 22 Nzeri (Vierge)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzahura n’abantu mudahuje imico ariko nibo bazabaviramo inshuti nziza. Muzaryoherwa n’ubuzima bwo kugira uwo mukundana. Muziyumvamo umutima wo koroherana maze murusheho kuryoherwa n’ubuzima bw’urukundo ruzira intonganya. Muzatekereza byinshi binezeza abo mukunda. Mu butunzi Iki cyumweru muziyumvamo inyota ikomeye yo gutera imbere maze muhereye ku kugabanya ibyo muhaha bitari ngombwa cyane, mutangire gutekereza kuzigama umutungo wanyu. Muzagira amahirwe yo kunoza ubuzima bwanyu bwo guhaha no gusohora umutungo. Mu kazi Iki cyumweru kizabahira cyane ku murimo. Kubo bishobokera ni byiza ko mwasubira mu ishuri mukongera ubumenyi cyane cyane mu byo mukunda. Mushobora kwiyumvamo integer nke mu mubiri ariko akazi kanyu niba mugakunda kazabibagiza ibyo bibazo murusheho gukora neza.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nzeri na 22 Ukwakira (Balance)  Mu rukundo Urukundo rwanyu muri iki cyumweru ruzarangwa n’intekerezo nyinshi. Muzagira umwanya uhagije wo kwitekerezaho no kureba aho muhagaze mu rukundo kandi imyanzuro muzafata izabaherekeza mu gihe kirekire mu buzima bw’urukundo mwaba mufite abakunzi cyangwa ntabo. Mu butunzi  Gutekereza kwanyu kuzabageza mu nzira ikwiriye, mbese uko muzarushaho gutekereza mu buryo bwiza niko muzaba mwiyegereza inzira mukwiriye kunyuramo ngo ubutunzi bwanyu bumere neza. Bizaba ngombwa ko mwisuzuma kandi mukita ku bintu byose ntacyo mwirengagije kuko uku kwirengagiza n’ubwo kaba ari akantu gato gushobora kubagusha mu mutego wabatera igihombo gikomeye. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru akazi kanyu kazakurikiranamu buryo budasanzwe kandi bwihuse cyane. Muzabona impinduka nyinshi ariko kujyana nazo nibyo bizabafasha kubaka neza umwuga wanyu, muwuha inking zikomeye z’ejo hazaza.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ukwakira na 22 Ugushyingo (Scorpion)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muziyumvamvo ubusahake budasanzwe bwo kwigenga. Abo mukundana bazababura nubwo mwaba muhari intekerezo zanyu zizaba zira ahandi. Bizabagora gusobanurira abakunzi banyu uko mwumva ibintu ariko muzitonde kugira ngo mutazarema ikibazo kuremereye cyasenya urukundo rwanyu, muzabigendemo gake. Mu butunzi
Muri iki cyumweru muragirwa inama yo kwishakamo ubuhanga bwo guhanga imirimo mishya ishobora kubyara inyungu ariko ibi ntibizababuze kwibuka ko hari ibindi mukeneye ndetse n’ibyo abari hafi yanyu bifuza kandi mugomba guhaza ibyifuzo byabo. Gusa intekerezo zanyu nizo zizababera intwaro ituma ubutunzi bwanyu bukoreshwa neza muri iki cyumweru. Mu kazi
Akazi kanyu kazahura n’intambara zitoroshye ariko nimuzitwaramo kigabo muzabona umusaruro mwiza nko guhindurirwa imirimo. Niba mwikoresha muzatangira imishinga mishya kandi namwe muragirwa inama yo kubigendamo gitwari kuko ikosa rimwe rishobora kubagusha mu mutego ukomeye.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ugushyingo na 21 Ukoboza (Sagittaire)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru ubuzima bw’urukundo rwanyu buzahindura inzira. Muzahura n’impinduka nyinshi kandi muzabasha kuzisangira n’abo mukunda. Niba ibintu bitameze neza, iki cyumweru cyuzuye amahirwe menshi yo kubikemura. Muzirengagiza bimwe mu bitekerezo bibaca intege mwari mumaranye iminsi mutangire gukora ibintu uko mubyumva. Mu butunzi
Muri iki cyumweru muzongera mugenzure neza uko mukoresha umutungo wanyu. Muri iki cyumweru birashoboka ko uko mwari mumenyereye kwinjiza bitinda ntibigende nk’uko byari bisanzwe bityo rero murasabwa kwitonda mukihangana ngo mwirinde ingaruka z’igihe kirekire. Mu kazi Uburyo bwanyu bwo kuyobora abandi mudategwa nibwo buzagira ingufu nyinshi mu kazi kanyu ka muri munsi muri iki cyumweru. Imikorere yanyu yihariye izababera isoko y’imbaraga nyinshi zizabageza ku ntego mwihaye. Gusa muzajya mukoresha imbaraga nyinshi ku buryo umunsi uzajya urangira mwananiwe bikabije ariko ntimuzacike intege kuko bizabongerera amahirwe yo gukura mu mwuga.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Ukuboza na 20 Mutarama (Capricorne)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru urukundo rwanyu ruzagurumana kandi muzatangira gushaka impinduka ntabyo gushyira imbaraga nyinshi mu bintu ngo ubashe gukundana neza. Muzakuraho ya mipaka mwishyiriyeho maze mwirekure kugira ngo mwebwe n’abo mukundana murusheho kubana neza kandi mubohotse nta kwishishana. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muzongera imbaraga mu mibare mukora ku bijyanye n’amafaranga yanyu. Inyota yo gutera imbere izabatera gutangira kwizigamira mwirinda ibishuko bibatera gukoresha amafaranga yanyu nabi. Mushobora gutungurwa no guhaha ibintu bitari bisanzwe muri gahunda. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru muzakora cyane ndetse mwerekane ko mushoboye. Mushobora kutiyumvamo umwete ariko inshingano mufite zizabatera gukora mutikoresheje kandi ibi bizabazanira inyungu z’igihe kirekire cyane cyane ku birebana n’iterambere ry’umwuga wanyu.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Mutarama na 18 Gashyantare (Verseau)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzirinda cyane gukora byabindi mumenyereye ahubwo muzatangira gutungurana muzana udushya. Abakunzi banyu bazarangwa no kubaba hafi maze mwiyumvemo icyizere maze namwe murusheho kubahaza mu byifuzo byabo kandi mwongere ikibatsi cy’urukundo rubarimo. Uramutse ushaka urukundo rushya iki cyumweru si cyiza kuri wowe kuko benshi mubo muzahura bazakuvangira, ntimuzahuza na gato. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru uburemere bw’ibyo mukora buzatanga umusaruro. Muzabona amahirwe atunguranye yo kwinjiza ariko igikomeye ni ukumenya guhitamo ibibafitiye akamaro kuko ikosa rito rishobora gutuma musubira inyuma cyane. Ntimuzakururwe cyane n’imishinga mubonana abandi ahubwo muzitegereze neza imibare yanyu muyibyaze umusaruro ufatika mudatwawe n’ibya rubanda. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru akazi kazabisukiranyaho ari kenshi cyane. Muzagira byinshi bibatunguye ariko murasabwa kubyitwaramo kigabo bitabaye ibyo akazi kanyu kazapfa kandi bizagira ingaruka z’igihe kirekire. Gusa muragaragaza icyizere cyo kumenya kwihangana no gukoresha ubwenge bwanyu byihuse mu gukemura bene ibyo bibazo bitunguranye. Umusaruro muzatanga uzatungurana kuburyo benshi bazatangira kugenda babavuga.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 19 Gashyantare na 20 Werurwe (Poissons)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru urukundo rwanyu muzarubamo nta bikabyo. Muziyerekana uko muri ndetse muzakuraho ugushidikanya kose abo mukundana bari babafiteho. Muzakenera ariko kwagura urukundo rwanyu bityo muzagirana ibiganiro byubaka n’abo mukunda. Kuri mwe ukuri kose muzishimira kukuvuga ahubwo munoze amagambo mukoresha mukuvuga. Mu butunzi Umutungo wanyu ushobora guhura n’amahirwe awuzamura muri iki cyumweru. Muzahura n’ibigeragezo binshi bibasaba gukoresha amafaranga mwibwira ko murimo kuvugurura ubuzima bwanyu. Muzabyitondere maze mubanze mubare neza mbere yo kugira amafaranga cyangwa undi mutungo wose musohora bitari ngombwa. Mu kazi  Muri iki cyumweru muzumva mushaka cyane gushimwa bityo muzakora mutikoresheje ngo mubigereho. Akazi kanyu kazaborohera kandi muzabona ubufasha buturutse hirya no hino kandi muzabwakirane ineza gusa muzabanze mushishoze kuko siko bose bazaba babifuriza ibyiza gusa. Ni aha mpiniye, ahasigaye mugire icyumweru gihire! Ni aho mu cyumweru gitaha.

title: Umwaka wa 2017: Mu mafoto yihariye y’ibyawuranze mu mpande zose z’isi
content:
Iyi si iberamo byinshi kandi byinshi muri byo bivugwa mu makuru. Mu mwaka ushize wa 2017 nawo wavuzwemo amakuru atari make, ariko yose siko twayagarukaho ngo bishoboke. Muri iyi nkuru dukesha urubuga rwa BBC, turabagaragariza amwe mu mafoto yagarutsweho cyane mu makuru yavuzwe muri uyu mwaka wa 2017. 
Umukirisitu wo mu gihugu cya Eritereya yabatirijwe ahitwa Qasr El-Yahud, ku nkengero zigana mu burengerazuba bw’uruzi rwa Yorodani, ku munsi abakristu bo muri iki gihugu bizihizaga Mesiya waje mu isi, uba ku ya 1 Mutarama. Aha yabatirijwe hakaba bivugwa ko ariho Yezu yabatirijwe na Yohani Umubatiza. 
Kandu Freeman yitabiriye imyigaragambyo ya ‘Black Lives Matter’ imbere y’inyumbako ya Trump, i New York. Iyi myigaragambyo ikaba yarakozwe nyuma y’uko hari hamaze iminsi abirabura benshi bicwa n’abapolisi. 
Ikinyugunyugu cyaguye ku izuru rya Raphael Nadal, umukinnyi wa Tennis ukomoka muri Esipanye, wamamaye ku isi. Hari mu mukino wa kimwe cya kane cy’irangiza cy’irushanwa rya Australian Open Grand Slam, aho yakinaga na Milos Raonic wo muri Canada. 
Ku ya 20 Mutarama, perezida wa Amerika Donald Jr. Trump  yarahiriye kuba perezida wa 45 w’iki gihugu. 
USA: Abagore benshi bateguye imyigaragambyo, yo kuvuga no kwibutsa uburenganzira bw’abagore umunsi wa mbere wa Donald Trump ku butegetsi. Uyu mugabo yari yazanye umwana we w’umukobwa. 
Mu majyepfo ashyira uburengerazuba bw’Ubufaransa, igisiga cyafashe akadege kadafite abaderevu(drone), kari mu igeragezwa rya gisirikare. 
Mu kwizihiza isabukuru ya Charlie Chaplin, umukinnyi wa filime wakunzwe cyane mu myaka ya kera, abantu basaga 600 bambaye nk’uko uyu mugabo yambaraga. Charlie ubundi yapfuye  ku ya 25 Ukuboza, 1977 apfira mu mujyi wa Corsier-sur-Vevey mu Busuwisi  aho yari amaze imyaka 24, nyuma yo kuva mu Bwongereza aho yavukiye. 
Kurika kw’ ikirunga cya Etna, ikirunga kirekire kurusha ibindi mu Burayi giherereye mu Butariyani 
Aibhin Kenneally w’imyaka 13. Yafotowe iyi foto arimo kwishyushya mbere yo kwitabira irushanwa ry’imbyino i Dublin muri Irlande. 
Ku ya 21 Kanama, abasaga miliyoni 7 z’abatuye USA babashije kubona ubwirakabiri bwuzuye bwabaye mu majyaruguru y’umugabane wa Amerika, bwaherukaga mu mwaka wa 1918. Aha izuba riragaragara inyuma y’ukwezi. 
Uyu ni umuyisilamu w’umu- Rohingya warimo gufaswa na ba gafotozi kwambuka uyu mugenzi uri hagati ya Myanmar na Bangladesh. Aba- Rohingya ni abayisilamu bake bakunze guhohoterwa cyane. Abasanga ibihumbi 467 bahunze Bangladesh guhera muri Kanama 
Aha hari mu myigaragambyo mu gihugu cya Kenya nyuma y’uko habaye amatora ya mbere ya Perezida w’iki gihugu yaje no gusubirwamo. Uyu ni depite Caleb Amisi Luyai, utavuga rumwe na leta ya Kenya urimo gushakisha umwuka nyuma y’uko imodoka ye yuzuyemo ibyotsi polisi yakoreshaga mu gutatanya abigaragambyaga. 
Muri Nzeri, Perezida wa Koreya ya Ruguru, Kim Jong-un yari mu igeragezwa ry’igisasu cyitwa Hwasong-12. Iki gihugu cyagerageje ibisasu byinshi mu ihangana n’ibindi bihugu bikomeye ku isi harimo Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. 
Aha ni mu myigaragambyo yaberaga i Barcelona imbere y’ahaberaga amatora ya Referandumu yo kugira intara ya Catalonya leta yigenga ikiyomora kuri Esipanye, ariko ibyavuye mu matora bigateshwa agaciro n’iki gihugu. 
I Pekin, Inama ya 19 y’ishyaka ry’abakominisite b’abashinwe yashyizeho ugomba kuyobora igihugu muri manda ikurikira. Perezida Xi Jinping niwe wakomeje kuriyobora mu gihe cy’imyaka 5 kugeza ubwo hazaba indi nama. 
Aha hari ku itariki ya 29 Ukwakira, ubwo hasozwaha icyunamo cy’umwaka wose abaturage ba Thailand bari bamaze bunamira umwami wabo Bhumibol Adulyadej. Yari umwami umaze igihe kirekire ku ngoma ku isi, dore ko yayimazeho imyaka 70 yose, agapfa afite imyaka 88. 
Uyu ni umwimukira wari ucumbikiwe mu nkambi ya gisirikare i Tripoli muri Libiya nyuma y’uko abasirikare baho bamutabaye yendaga kurohama muri Mediterane agerageza kwinjira ku mugabane w’Uburayi kimwe n’abandi benshi babikoraga muri icyo gihe ndetse benshi bakahaburira ubuzima. 
I Guatemala, uyu mukobwa yaciye hagati y’amabuye abantu bateraga bizihiza umunsi w’abapfuye mu irimbi bagerageza gutera ubwoba imyukamibi ngo abakurambere babo bashime ibitambo bari baje kubatambira. 
Rose McGowan yazamuraga igipfunsi nyuma yo kugeza ijambo ku bagore bari bitabiriya inama y’abagore yari yabereye i Detroit muri Michigan. Uyu yavuzwe cyane nyumay’uko ashinje umugabo utunganya filime ukomeye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Harvey Weinstein ihohotera rishingiye ku gitsina, akaba ari umwe muri benshi cyane banjinjije uyu mugabo. 
Abanya-Zimbabwe i Harare bishimiraga kwegura ku butegetsi k’umukabwe Robert Gabriel Mugabe wari umaze imyaka 37 ayobora iki gihugu. Ni nyuma y’icyumweru igisirikare gifashe ubutegetsi ariko kigahakana Coup d’Etat.

title: Bimwe mu bintu bikomeye byabayeho bwa mbere bikamamara mu mateka y’isi- AMAFOTO
content:
Mu mateka y’isi buri kintu cyose tuzi ubu, cyabayeho ku nshuro ya mbere ndetse usanga byinshi byaragiye bivugururwa kubera ikoranabuhanga rigezweho ku buryo bitandukanye n’uburyo byasaga bigihangwa cyangwa bikigera ku isi. Amafoto y’ibintu byagiye bigera ku isi bwa mbere bikamamara ni byinshi ntabwo twabivuga byose ariko hari ibyo Kigali Post yaguhitiyemo yifashishije urubuga rwa Bright Inside, harimo igiti gikoreshwa ku munsi wa noheli, telefone ya mbere n’ibindi byinshi. Insimbura ngingo y’umutima ukozwe mu buryo budasanzwe
 Iyi nsimbura ngingo yiswe AbioCor yakozwe mu mwaka wa 2015 niyo ya mbere yari ibayeho ku ikubitiro yakoreweho ubugenzuzi ku barwayi 15. Selfie ya mbere, 1839
 Robert  Cornelius yakoresheje tekinoloji y’umugabo witwa Louis Daguerre mu byo yabonye harimo n’iyi foto, si ifoto ya selfie gusa ahubwo ni nayo foto ya mbere igaragara mu buryo bwa portrait. Telefone ya mbere, 1973
 Iyi telefone yapimaga ikiro kimwe, washoboraga kuyishyiramo umuriro amasaha agera ku icumi ukayikoresha igice cy’isaha imwe gusa. Igiti gikoreshwa ku munsi wa noheli, 1931
 Igiti gikoreshwa mu kwizihiza noheli kizwi nk’ikirugu, bwa mbere cyashyizwe mu mujyi wa Manhattan hari mu mwaka wa 1931, hanyuma kuva mu mwaka wa 1933 gitangira gukoreshwa nk’umuco mu byo kwizihiza umunsi mukuru wa noheli. Umugore wabonye uruhushya rwo gutwara ipikipiki,1937
 Uyu ni Sally Halterman, umugore wa mbere muri Washington wabonye uruhushya rwo gutwara ipikipiki, byaramugoye kubona urwo ruhushya kubera ko yari akiri muto kandi ari umukobwa gusa nyuma yo gukora ibizamini byinshi Sally yatsinze ikizamini abona uruhushya rwe. Bikini ya mbere mu ruhame, 1946
 Uyu mwambaro wakozwe n’inzu itunganya imideri ya Parisian Fashion ikorwa n’umudozi witwa Louis Reard, bikini yerekanywe bwa mbere mu ruhame ku itariki ya 05 Nyakanga, 1946, yerekanwa n’umukobwa wabyinaga mu kabari ko muri Paris mu Bufaransa yitwaga Micheline Bernardini. Mudasobwa(Computer) ya mbere ya APPLE
 Iyi ni computer ya mbere yakozwe na Steve Wozniak ishyirwa ku mugaragaro na Steve Jobs nyiri uruganda rukora APPLE hari mu mwaka wa 1976. Icyogajuru cya Sputnik 1, 1957
 Iki ni icyogajuru(satellite) cya mbere cyoherejwe mu ikirere n’icyahoze ari Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Abasoviyete. Hari tariki ya 04 Ukwakira, 1957 ubwo hatutumbaga intambara y’ubutita yari ishyamiranije iki gihugu na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Iki ni igice cya mbere cy’ibyo twari twabahitiyemo
