title: Dore uko icyumweru kizakugendekera bitewe n’igihe wavukiye (Horoscope)
content: Iyi ni inkuru ngaruka-cyumweru ikubiyemo icyo abahanga mu byo kwitegereza ahazaza (les voyants) bavuga ku bizaba ku muntu uko icyumweru gitashye, ukurikije igihe yavukiye. Dore uko icyumweru cyo ku ya 30 Ukwakira kugeza ku ya 05 Ugushyingo kizagenda  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Werurwe na 19 Mata (Belier)  Mu rukundo Kuba umwimerere ndetse no kwerekana ibibarimo nibyo bizabahesha amahirwe mu rukundo muri iki cyumweru. Bizaborohera kugaragariza abo mukunda amarangamutima yanyu bityo nabo bishimire kuyasangira namwe. Urukundo no kubohoka nibyo bizaranga ibiganiro byanyu. Mu butunzi Mu mpera z’iki cyumweru birashoboka ko mwabona amafaranga. Ayo mahirwe azahurirana n’ibikorwa byanyu bwite mwihimbiye, ikemurwa ry’imanza mwaba mufite cyangwa se n’ibyo mwagurisha. Muzahura n’imishinga mishya ariko nubwo mufite ibindi mukora ntibizababuze kugerageza n’ibishya kuko wasanga ariyo mbarutso y’iterambere ryanyu cyane cyane mu bijyanye no kwigwizaho umutungo. Mu kazi Akazi kazabagendekera neza muri iki cyumweru. Ntabwo muzigera mubura icyo mukora ahubwo bizajya bigenda bisimburana vuba na vuba. Muzarangwa no guhanga udushya kandi ibi bizabafasha guhangana n’impinduka.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 20 Mata na 20 Gicurasi (Taureau)  Mu rukundo Bamwe muri mwe bazatangira umubano w’igihe kirekire nyuma yo gukunda by’ako kanya kandi rwose ayo mahirwe azaboneka, nimwe gusa mwifitemo kuyakira cyangwa kuyareka agahita gusa murasabwa kumvira umutima wanyu, hanyuma mukazabitekerezaho nyuma. Nimubitekerezaho cyane bizabangamira kwisanzura kwanyu bitumen urukundo rutagira imbaraga. Mu butunzi Muzabasha gufunga burundu bimwe mubyabagoraga mu giha cyashize. Muzafata umwanya wo kwirengagiza iby’ahashize maze musohoke aho mwazitiriwe n’amateka. Muzakire neza impinduka mu igenamigambi ryanyu kuko ari ingenzi cyane mu iterambere ryanyu. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru akazi kanyu kazaba kari ku murongi, ntabwo muzatuma hari ubavangira cyangwa ngo hagire ikintu kibarogoya. Muzatangirana n’ingamba nshya kandi ibi ibizahindura byinshi ku mikorere yanyu kandi bizabaha umusaruro ushimishije.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Gicurasi na 21 Kamena (Gemaux)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzahura na byinshi bizatuma murushaho kwegera inzozi mufite mu rukundo. Benshi muri mwe muzahura n’abazababera urukundo rw’ibihe byose kandi bazabazanamo intekerezo zagutse ku rukundo rwanyu maze rukure kandi rwaguke mu buryo buzabanezeza. Mu butunzi Imbaraga muzashyira mu gukora nizo zizaba umusaruro w’ibyo muzunguka muri iki cyumweru. Ikindi kandi ababazengurutse bazababera inkingi ya mwamba ngo mubashe gufata ibyemezo bibateza imbere. Iki cyumweru kizababera icyo gufata ibyemezo bibageza ku iterambere rirambye ariko nimudashishoza gishobora kubabera intandaro yo gusububira inyuma mu buryo bukomeye. Mu kazi Gukabya cyane mu kazi bizababera inzitizi ikomeye mu gutera imbere kwanyu mu mwuga. Imikoranire n’ababazengurutse ntizabanyura muri iki cyumweru gusa murasabwa kutiharira imirimo yose cyangwa ngo mukoreshe amategeko menshi mu kazi ahubwo muzagerageze koroherana kugira ngo byose bigende nk’uko mubyifuza.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Kamena na 22 Nyakanga (Cancer)  Mu rukundo Urukundo ruzatuma mutanga amafaranga muri iki cyumweru. Muzifuza gutanga impano nyinshi ariko nimukabya birashoboka cyane ko muzaseba mwashiriwe n’amafaranga, icyiza rero ni ukubanza kureba uko ikofi ihagaze maze mukabona gufata umwanzuro wo guhahira uwo mukunda. Inshuti za hafi zizagira uruhare mu kukugarura ngo udasesagura cyane umutungo wawe, inama zabo ntimuzazirengagize. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muziyumvamo impinduka zubaka ubutunzi bwanyu. Muzakoresha uko mushoboye ngo mukoreshe amafaranga make ashoboka. Muzagira intekerezo nyinshi maze mufate umwanya wo guhitamo ibyiza byabateza imbere. Ntimuzagire igitekerezo musuzugura kuko kimwe muri byo ari ipfundo ryo gutera imbere mu minsi iri imbere. Mu kazi Muziyumvamo imbaraga zo guhatana ku murimo. Biragaragara ko muri iki cyumweru muzagira impamvu nyinshi zibahatira guhatana no kwerekana ibyo mushoboye ku rwego rwo hejuru. Muzahura n’imbogamizi ariko nimudacika intege umusaruro muzakuramo uzabanogera.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nyakanga na 22 Kanama(Lion)  Mu rukundo Ibiganiro bizagenda byerekeza aho mushaka. Iki cyumweru muzumvwa n’abo mukunda rwose, ibyo bikazaterwa n’uko namwe mwagaragaje ko muzi gutega amatwi n’uburyo mukunda. Mushobora kandi no guhura n’urukundo rubatunguye kandi rukaba rufite amahirwe menshi yo gukomeza mu gihe mwaba muri mwenyine. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muzatera intamwe ishimishije mu kwinjiza amafaranga ndetse no kubona ibindi byinshi biyinjiza. Amahirwe azabahora iruhande kandi uguhizaho kwanyu niko kuzabazanira uwo musaruro. Inshingano zanyu ziziyongera kandi kudacika intege kwanyu niko kuzabafasha kuzitunganya uko bikwiye. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru bizabagora cyane gufatanya akazi n’ubundi buzima busanzwe ariko muzagerageza kwirinda kugira icyo mwica n’ubwo bizabagora cyane kumenya guhitamo aho mushyira imbaraga kurusha ahandi.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Kanama na 22 Nzeri (Vierge)  Mu rukundo Nubwo ibiganiro byanyu bizasa n’ibitameze neza, muzabasha kugumana cya kibatsi cy’urukundo. Muzasa n’abiyibagirwa kugira ngo munezeze abo mukunda. Ibi bishobora kugera kure bigatuma uwo mukundana abyitwaza cyane hanyuma namwe mukaba mwakwisubiraho bikabatera gutekereza ibindi. Mu butunzi Ntabwo muzatagaguza umutungo wanyu ahubwo muzashyiraho amategeko y’icungamutungo akomeye azafasha umuryango wanyu kumererwa neza no kutagira icyo ubura. Mushobora kandi kwinjiza amafaranga mu buryo bubatunguye mu mpera z’iki cyumweru. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru nta kintu na kimwe muzemera ko kibavangira mu kazi. Muzagira amahame mashya yihariye azabagenga kandi ntimuzakundira uwo ariwe wese kubabuza kuyakurikiza, ibi bikazabafasha guhindura byinshi ku buzima bwanyu bwa buri munsi bw’akazi.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nzeri na 22 Ukwakira (Balance)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzarushaho gufungura amarangamutima yanyu maze muryoherwe n’urukundo rubarimo. Benshi muri mwe bazabona urukundo rushya kandi ruzabahira. Nta mpamvu yo kuzuyaza gufatirana ayo mahirwe hanyuma ku basanzwe bari mu rukundo ni igihe cyo kuzamura ibishashi byarwo ngo uwo mukunda arusheho kubabonamo icyizere. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru ubutunzi bwanyu buzahura n’impinduka nyinshi . Niba hari umushinga mushya mwatangiye mugomba kwitondera ibintu byose kuko ikosa rito rishobora kubasubiza inyuma cyane. Iki cyumweru kizaborohera mu gukoresha amafaranga yanyu ndetse no gushakisha andi. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru niho muzagira amahirwe yo gukemura ibibazo mumaranye iminsi ku kazi ndetse no gutunganya ibirarane by’imirimo mutatuganyije neza mu gihe cyashize. Mwitegure rero impinduka mu kazi kuko muri iki cyumweru muzsabwa kubaka izina rihanagura iryo mwari mumaranye iminsi cyangwa se rikarikomeza. Amahitamo ari mu biganza byanyu.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ukwakira na 22 Ugushyingo (Scorpion)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muziyumvamvo ubusahake budasanzwe bwo kwigenga. Abo mukundana bazababura nubwo mwaba muhari intekerezo zanyu zizaba zira ahandi. Bizabagora gusobanurira abakunzi banyu uko mwumva ibintu ariko muzitonde kugira ngo mutazarema ikibazo kuremereye cyasenya urukundo rwanyu, muzabigendemo gake. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muragirwa inama yo kwishakamo ubuhanga bwo guhanga imirimo mishya ishobora kubyara inyungu ariko ibi ntibizababuze kwibuka ko hari ibindi mukeneye ndetse n’ibyo abari hafi yanyu bifuza kandi mugomba guhaza ibyifuzo byabo. Gusa intekerezo zanyu nizo zizababera intwaro ituma ubutunzi bwanyu bukoreshwa neza muri iki cyumweru. Mu kazi Akazi kanyu kazahura n’intambara zitoroshye ariko nimuzitwaramo kigabo muzabona umusaruro mwiza nko guhindurirwa imirimo. Niba mwikoresha muzatangira imishinga mishya kandi namwe muragirwa inama yo kubigendamo gitwari kuko ikosa rimwe rishobora kubagusha mu mutego ukomeye.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ugushyingo na 21 Ukoboza (Sagittaire)  Mu rukundo Ubuzima bwanyu bw’urukundo buzahinduka muri iki cyumweru. Muzahura na byinshi byiza bizafasha urukundo rwanyu kuvuka bwa kabiri kandi icyo kibatsi gishya umukunzi wanyu azacyishimira. Amahirwe abari iruhande niba ibintu byari byabakomereye. Muzarenga kure ibitekerezo byinshi mwari mwarishyizemo ahubwo kudacika intege bibongere amahirwe yo kugera aheza. Mu butunzi Hagati muri iki cyumweru muzagira ibiganiro bibazanira inyungu, byumvikane rero ko ikofi yanyu hari icyo izabona ariko mugomba kwitonda ngo hatagira ubatwara amahirwe. Muzagishe inama bizabafasha kumenya icyo gukora, ibi bikazanabafasha mu gihe cy’amezi ari imbere. Mu kazi Muzagira akazi kenshi cyane muri iki cyumweru. Bizabasaba guhindura imikorere kandi munakomeza akazi. Ariko kandi imibanire yanyu n’ababakuriye mu kazi izazamo agatotsi ariko ntibizabahangayikishe kuko niko impinduka zigenda.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Ukuboza na 20 Mutarama (Capricorne) Mu rukundo Mugiye kugira icyumweru kigoye cyane mu rukundo. Muzasubizwa inyuma mu mateka bityo muzatangira kwifata cyane ngo hato mutavaho mugwa mu mitego nk’iyo mwigeze kugwamo mu gihe cyashize. Gusa nanone ibyo bishobora kubatera kwibonamo ibyo mwari mwarihishe bityo mukaba mwatangira ubuzima bwiza cyane bw’urukundo butuje kandi bukomeye. Mu butunzi Muzinjiza neza muri iki cyumweru ariko kandi mugomba kwitonda kuko muzasa n’abatobotse intoki ku bijyanye no gukoresha amafaranga kuko buzagira intege nke cyane mu kubika ahubwo inyota yo kugura ibitagira umumaro iziyongera. Mu kazi Muzishimira byinshi muzageraho muri iki cyumweru kandi muzoroherezwa cyane mu kazi. Muzahura na benshi bazabafasha bityo muzamuke neza ariko kandi ubufasha bwose muzabona muzabanze mubusuzume butazagira ikindi bubazanira cyazabagora mu minsi iri imbere.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Mutarama na 18 Gashyantare (Verseau)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzirinda cyane gukora byabindi mumenyereye ahubwo muzatangira gutungurana muzana udushya. Abakunzi banyu bazarangwa no kubaba hafi maze mwiyumvemo icyizere maze namwe murusheho kubahaza mu byifuzo byabo kandi mwongere ikibatsi cy’urukundo rubarimo. Uramutse ushaka urukundo rushya iki cyumweru si cyiza kuri wowe kuko benshi mubo muzahura bazakuvangira, ntimuzahuza na gato. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru uburemere bw’ibyo mukora buzatanga umusaruro. Muzabona amahirwe atunguranye yo kwinjiza ariko igikomeye ni ukumenya guhitamo ibibafitiye akamaro kuko ikosa rito rishobora gutuma musubira inyuma cyane. Ntimuzakururwe cyane n’imishinga mubonana abandi ahubwo muzitegereze neza imibare yanyu muyibyaze umusaruro ufatika mudatwawe n’ibya rubanda. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru akazi kazabisukiranyaho ari kenshi cyane. Muzagira byinshi bibatunguye ariko murasabwa kubyitwaramo kigabo bitabaye ibyo akazi kanyu kazapfa kandi bizagira ingaruka z’igihe kirekire. Gusa muragaragaza icyizere cyo kumenya kwihangana no gukoresha ubwenge bwanyu byihuse mu gukemura bene ibyo bibazo bitunguranye. Umusaruro muzatanga uzatungurana kuburyo benshi bazatangira kugenda babavuga.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 19 Gashyantare na 20 Werurwe (Poissons)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru urukundo rwanyu muzarubamo nta bikabyo. Muziyerekana uko muri ndetse muzakuraho ugushidikanya kose abo mukundana bari babafiteho. Muzakenera ariko kwagura urukundo rwanyu bityo muzagirana ibiganiro byubaka n’abo mukunda. Kuri mwe ukuri kose muzishimira kukuvuga ahubwo munoze amagambo mukoresha mukuvuga. Mu butunzi Umutungo wanyu ushobora guhura n’amahirwe awuzamura muri iki cyumweru. Muzahura n’ibigeragezo binshi bibasaba gukoresha amafaranga mwibwira ko murimo kuvugurura ubuzima bwanyu. Muzabyitondere maze mubanze mubare neza mbere yo kugira amafaranga cyangwa undi mutungo wose musohora bitari ngombwa. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru muzumva mushaka cyane gushimwa bityo muzakora mutikoresheje ngo mubigereho. Akazi kanyu kazaborohera kandi muzabona ubufasha buturutse hirya no hino kandi muzabwakirane ineza gusa muzabanze mushishoze kuko siko bose bazaba babifuriza ibyiza gusa. Ni aha mpiniye, ahasigaye mugire icyumweru gihire! Ni aho mu cyumweru gitaha.

title: Ibisobanuro by’izina Hassan n’imico ikunze kuranga abaryitwa
content:
Hassan ni izina ry’abahungu rikomoka mu rurimi rw’Icyarabu risobanura ‘Umusore w’uburanga’. Ba Hassan usanga ari abantu bakunze kurangwa no kumenya gusohoza inshingano zabo ndetse no gufasha abandi gusohoza izabo. Guhora ahangayikiye uko azabaho ejo bituma aba umukozi w’umunyamwete wubaha akazi ke. Hassan akunda ibintu biri ku murongo, akanga ibimutungura cyangwa ibituma ata igihe cye. Akoresha uko ashoboye kose ngo ubuzima bwe buhore kuri gahunda nta kavuyo. Uburyo yifuza umutuzo na gahunda mu buzima bwe butuma adakora byinshi mubyo yifuza nko gutembera kuko aba yumva agomba kuguma mu rugo ngo adahindura ubuzima bwari buri kuri gahunda yipangiye. Hassan ni umunyakuri kandi akunda gutega amatwi abandi. Ahora yifuza kubana n’abandi neza. Ni umuntu wizirika cyane ku gushyira ibintu ku murongo ku buryo adashobora kwihanganira umuntu umuvangira. Umuryango n’inshuti ni ikintu gifite agaciro gakomeye mu maso ya Hassan
Mu rukundo Hassan ni umugabo uzi kwita k’umugore akunda. Ntahubuka cyangwa ngo abe yabangamira umukunzi we, azi gutega amatwi abagore kandi nibyo baba bifuza. Hassan ntashobora kugira ijambo abwira umukobwa mu gihe atizeye neza ko ibyo amubwira abyumva neza kuko yirinda igisubizo kidahuye n’ibyifuzo bye. Aba ashaka umuntu witonda kandi udafite ibibazo kimwe n’uko na we aba ameze. Akunda kumva ibyiyumviro by’abakobwa kurusha abandi bagabo, ibi bikaba bituma abasha kubana nabo mu buryo bubanyuze. Ni umusore ukurura abagore ariko kandi biragoye kumushimisha. Iyo Hassan yakunze ntabwo abangamira umukunzi we ahubwo amuha uburenganzira bwo kwiberaho uko abishaka. Gusa aba ashaka umunyakuri ndetse n’uwishimira kubana n’umuryango we nabo bakamwishimira. Hassan ahorana inzozi zo kubana n’umugore umwe ntaba yifuza gukundwa na benshi.

title: Dore uko icyumweru kizakugendekera bitewe n’igihe wavukiye (Horoscope)
content:
Iyi ni inkuru ngaruka-cyumweru ikubiyemo icyo abahanga mu byo kwitegereza ahazaza (les voyants) bavuga ku bizaba ku muntu uko icyumweru gitashye, ukurikije igihe yavukiye. Dore uko icyumweru cyo ku ya 23 kugeza ku ya 29 Ukwakira kizagenda  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Werurwe na 19 Mata (Belier)  Mu rukundo  Mu iki cyumweru muziyumvamo ubushake budasanzwe bwo gukunda no kubigaragariza abo mukunda ku rwego rwo hejuru. Imyitwarire yanyu izatuma ababakunda banyurwa n’uburyo mubatega amatwi ndetse mukishimira kuzuza ibyifuzo byabo. Gusa kubakiri bonyine muzarangwa no gushidikanya kwinshi muri iki cyumweru. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru ubutunzi bwanyu buzahungabana bityo bibe ngombwa ko mugira ibyo mwigomwa kugira ngo ubuzima bukomeze. Murasabwa kandi gushyira hamwe n’abandi cyane cyane mu gushora imari kugira ngo uko guhungabana kutazamara igihe kirekire. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru muzagira inyota ikomeye yo gutera imbere no kumenya birushijeho umwuga mukora. Muzabasha kubona byinshi mwasaga n’aho mwirengagije kandi bibafitiye akamaro mu kazi. Hagati yo ku wa 2 no ku wa 5 muzagira akazi karemereye ariko intego izaba ari iyo kwiyubaka by’igihe kirekire.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 20 Mata na 20 Gicurasi (Taureau)  Mu rukundo Ku bafite abakunzi iki cyumweru kizababera icyo kubaka urukundo rwanyu mu buryo bwimbitse naho kubakiri mwenyine muzabasha gutangira urukundo rukomeye kandi rw’igihe kirekire ariko mwese murasabwa kwigiramo ukwihangana gukomeye. Muzabasha kumva no gukemura ibibazo by’abo mukunda ariko kuri iyi ngingo murasabwa gushishoza no kubigendamo gake. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muziyumvamo imbaraga zo gukemura ibibazo by’imitungo mumaranye iminsi ndetse benshi muri mwe muzatangira gushyira mu bikorwa ya mishinga mwabitse. Muzarangwa n’ubwenge n’ubushishozi mutari musanganywe mu gucunga umutungo wanyu. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru muzaba nk’abigenga mu kazi mbese ababakoresha bazabaha umutuzo n’uburenganzira bwo gukora ibintu uko mubyumva. Ni byiza rero ko mudapfusha ubusa uyu mwanya muzabona bityo mugatangira gutekereza uko mwanoza akazi kanyu bidashingiye ku mategeko muhabwa ahubwo bishingiye ku dushya mwihimbira (creativity)  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Gicurasi na 21 Kamena (Gemaux)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru murasabwa gushishoza ku marangamutima abarimo kuko azababana menshi ariko hakabamo n’ashobora kubabaza muramutse muyatwaye nabi. Murasabwa gusubiza amaso inyuma mukamenye neza abo muribo mu rukundo ndetse n’abi mwifuza kuba mu buzima bw’urukundo. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muzagira amahirwe yo kongera inyungu zanyu byaba bikomotse mu kazi mukora cyangwa no mu bindi biri hanze y’akazi. Murasabwa gukoresha neza ayo mahirwe kuko amafaranga muzayakuramo azababera impamba y’igihe kirekire. Mu kazi Ibiganiro muzagirana n’ababakuriye ku murimo cyangwa se ababazanira inyungu mu kazi bizatuma mwongererwa icyizere cyo gukoresha ubwenge bwanyu mu kazi mudahagarikiwe. Muzagaragaza ko mushoboye ariko kandi muzirinde kwinjira mu kazi k’abandi kuko bishobora kubateranya. Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Kamena na 22 Nyakanga (Cancer) Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzagira umwanya n’imbaraga zo kuganira byimbitse n’abo mukunda, mubatege amatwi kugira ngo bababwire akabari ku mutima nta ngingimira. Ibi bizabongerera amahirwe yo gukuza urukundo rubarimo naho abakiri bonyine iki cyumweru barasabwa kutirengagiza icyo umutima wabo ubabwira ahubwo bakawumvira bakoresheje ubushishozi. Mu butunzi  Muri iki cyumweru murasabwa kutirengagiza iby’ingenzi mukeneye ngo murarinda ubutunzi bwanyu. Muzumva inkuru nziza muri iki cyumweru kandi izagabanya guhangayika kujyanye n’umutungo. Iki cyumweru kandi kizahira abazaba bifuza gutangira imishinga mishya. Mu kazi Gutuza kwanyu no gukora ibintu bucece nibyo bizabaranga muri iki cyumweru. Muzagira igihe cyo gutuza mugatekereza neza kubyo mukora maze umusaruro wikube inshuro nyinshi ndetse bibahe n’isura nshya y’akazi mukora. Muzakorana umwete ariko ntimuzaba mukeneye abivanga mu byanyu ari nayo mpamvu muzakorana umutuzo mwinshi. Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nyakanga na 22 Kanama(Lion) Mu rukundo Amarangamutima azababana menshi cyane muri iki cyumweru ndetse kubihisha abo mukunda bizabagora. Umutima wanyu uzabategeka kwerekana akawurimo mwabishaka mutabishaka. Muzagira kandi umwanya wo kwiga neza uburyo bwo gutwara amarangamutima yanyu mu buryo butababangamiye cyangwa ngo bubangamire abo mukunda. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muzafata umwanya wo kwishyura imyenda yose mufite kugira ngo mubone uko mubarira amafaranga mufite kandi nta kibazo mufitanye n’abantu. Mu cyumweru hagati muzagira amahirwe yo kongera gusubira mu mishinga mumaranye iminsi n’abatayifite muzatangira kuyitekerezaho. Mubyo mukora byose murasabwa gushishoza kuko ikosa rimwe rishobora gutuma byose bipfa kandi bikabagiraho ingaruka z’igihe kirekire. Mu kazi Ntibizaborohera gutunganya akazi kose mufite muri iki cyumweru ariko murasabwa gushyiramo imbaraga nyinshi kuko iki cyumweru kivuze byinshi ku iterambere ryanyu mu mwuga mukora. Muzahura na byinshi bizabasaba gufata ibyemezo byihuse ariko mwifitemo ubushobozi bwo kubirenga.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Kanama na 22 Nzeri (Vierge)  Mu rukundo
 Muri iki cyumweru murasabwa guhitamo mu buryo bwihuse. Muzahura na byinshi bizabasaba gufata ibyemezo haba ku ruhande rw’urukundi rwanyu bwite n’uko mushaka kurutwara ndetse no kubo mukunda. Ibyemezo muzafata bizaba iby’igihe kirekire ndetse nta muntu n’umwe uzaba afite ubushobozi bwo kubavuguruza kuko muzafata umwanya uhagije wo kubitekerezaho mbere yo kubifata. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muzabasha kwiyubaka mu butunzi bwanyu kandi muzongera umutekano wabwo by’igihe kirekire. Muzatangira kumenya ababangamira iterambere ryanyu mubacikeho mwige kubana n’ababafasha gutera imbere. Imbaraga zanyu nimuzongeraho kwihangana muziyubaka mu buryo muhamye ku bijyanye n’umutungo wanyu. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru muzarushaho gukunda akazi kanyu mukorane umwete kandi mutangire guhindura bimwe byatumaga akazi kanyu gapfa. Ntimuzagira umwanya wo kwicara ahubwo muzahora mwiyumvamo gushaka kugira ibyo mutunganya. Gusa mushobora kugirana ibibazo n’ababakoresha kuko muzaba mutangiye gukora akazi uko mubyumva kurusha kugendera ku mategeko babaha.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nzeri na 22 Ukwakira (Balance)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru nimwe muzafata ibyemezo mu rukundo rwanyu kugira ngo rudahungabana. Wenda bizaba ngombwa ko mukenera inama z’inshuti cyangwa abavandimwe kugira ngo ibyo byemezo bibe ari bizima. Ikindi kandi muri iki cyumweru murasabwa kwirinda guhururira urukundo rw’ako kanya ahubwo muzitonde mushishoze mwubake urukundo ruzaramba. Mu butunzi  Murasabwa gukora umurongo ngenderwaho ufatika muri iki cyumweru kugira ngo mu minsi iza muzabeho mu buryo butabagoye. Murasabwa gusubira mu mibare mugatangira kuzigama mwirinda guhaha ibitari ngombwa kandi kugisha inama ni ngombwa kugira ngo mwirinde guhubuka no kubangamira abo muhahira. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru akazi kanyu kazababera nk’ishuri aho muzigira uburyo bwinshi bwo kugatunganya bitandukanye n’uko bisanzwe. Iki cyumweru kandi kizaba gituje nta kavuyo cyangwa umunaniro ukabije muzahurira nabyo mu kazi gusa muzirinde kugendera muri icyo kigare ngo bitumen akazi gapfa.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ukwakira na 22 Ugushyingo (Scorpion)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru murasa n’abashaka gusohoka mubyo murimo maze mugatangira ibishya. Benshi bazava mu rukundo bari barimo maze batangire ubuzima bwo kwibana cyangwa se bakundane n’abandi gusa murasabwa gushishoza mukirinda gufata iki cyemezo muhubutse hato mutazicuza. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muzasa n’abaruhuka ibibazo by’amafaranga mumaranye iminsi maze abo bishobokera mutangire gutekereza ku buryo mwatangira kwinjiza amafaranga aruta ayo mwinjizaga gusa ibi mukabikorana ubushishozi ngo mudasubira inyuma mu bibazo birenze ibyo mwari musanganywe. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru murasabwa gushishoza ku magambo cyangwa ibindi byose biturutse hanze biza mu kazi kanyu. Muzatangira gufata ibyemezo bituma mwigenga mu kazi kanyu mukagakora mwirengagije iby’abandi. Ibi bizabongerera icyizere yaba muri mwe ubwanyu cyangwa se no mu maso y’abo mukorana.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ugushyingo na 21 Ukoboza (Sagittaire)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzakangukira gutega amatwi abo mukunda kandi ibi bizababera intangiriro nziza yo kwiyumvanamo mu buryo burenze. Ibiganiro muzakomeza kugirana bizatuma mwumvikana kuri byinshi byatumaga mutamerana neza. Ku badafite abakunzi, muri iki cyumweru mufite amahirwe yo gukunda no gukundwa. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muzahagariko gushidikanya mwahoranaga mu gufata ibyemezo byerekeranye n’amafaranga yanyu. Nubwo muzakomeza guhaha byinshi ariko muzatangira kubona ko ari uko bigomba kugenda murekere aho kwishinja byinshi ndetse bizabaha n’ubushobozi bwo gutangira kugira amafaranga mwizigamira. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru akazi kazaba gatuje kurusha mu cyumweru gishize, maze mugire igihe cyo kwiyitaho no gushyira ku murongo ibitaragenze neza. Muzirinde kumva ibivugwa muzahe umwanya ibitekerezo byanyu. Niba mukora akazi gasaba abakiliya muzabasha kwigarurira abakiliya b’igihe kirekire.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Ukuboza na 20 Mutarama (Capricorne)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru urukundo rwanyu ruzagurumana kandi muzatangira gushaka impinduka ntabyo gushyira imbaraga nyinshi mu bintu ngo ubashe gukundana neza. Muzakuraho ya mipaka mwishyiriyeho maze mwirekure kugira ngo mwebwe n’abo mukundana murusheho kubana neza kandi mubohotse nta kwishishana. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muzongera imbaraga mu mibare mukora ku bijyanye n’amafaranga yanyu. Inyota yo gutera imbere izabatera gutangira kwizigamira mwirinda ibishuko bibatera gukoresha amafaranga yanyu nabi.  Mushobora gutungurwa no guhaha ibintu bitari bisanzwe muri gahunda. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru muzakora cyane ndetse mwerekane ko mushoboye. Mushobora kutiyumvamo umwete ariko inshingano mufite zizabatera gukora mutikoresheje kandi ibi bizabazanira inyungu z’igihe kirekire cyane cyane ku birebana n’iterambere ry’umwuga wanyu.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Mutarama na 18 Gashyantare (Verseau)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzarangwa no kwita cyane kubo mukunda mu buryo buboroheye cyane. Iki cyumweru kizasiga muhaye imizi ihamye urukundo rwanyu mu mahoro kandi munezerewe, mudahatwa.  Ibyo muzavuga bizakirirwa vuba kandi neza. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muzagabanya ibibazo byinshi mwibazaga ku buryo bwo kwiteza imbere ahubwo mutangire gukoresha ubwenge bwanyu mu kwiteza imbere. Benshi muri mwe bazatangira imishinga yabo cyane cyane ijyanye n’ubucuruzi kandi amahirwe ari ku ruhande rwanyu. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru muzagira akazi kenshi kandi muzaba mukenewe cyane bityo muzarangwa no gukora byinshi mufatanyije n’abandi. Gusa murasabwa kutirengagiza izindi nshingano mufite ngo mwiyegurire gufasha abandi gusa. Ubwenge n’ubuhanga mufite niyo ntwaro izabaherekeza mu kazi kanyu iki cyumweru.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 19 Gashyantare na 20 Werurwe (Poissons)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru murasabwa gukora amahitamo ahamye. Muzahura na byinshi bizatuma aya mahitamo abagora ariko murasabwa gushishoza. Muzifuza cyane kwigaragariza abo mukunda mu buryo butari busanzwe kandi muzaba mwiteguye kwakira neza urukundo muzahabwa. Mu butunzi Umutungo wanyu ushobora guhura n’amahirwe awuzamura muri iki cyumweru. Birashoboka ko mwaba mumaze iminsi mwifuza icyatuma murushaho kongera umutungo wanyu, iki cyumweru nicyo kizabafasha ngo mutangire ya mishinga mumaranye iminsi. Muzoroherwa cyane no kwishyura ibyo mukeneye ndetse no kwinjiza bitabagoye. Mu kazi  Iki cyumweru kizatangira kibagoye cyane mu kazi ariko nikigera hagati bizashira. Muri iyo minsi muzagira igihe cyo kwitekerezaho, murebe ubumenyi n’impano mufite maze mufate umurongo nyawo ngenderwaho. Ibiganiro muzagirana n’abantu batandukanye mu kazi bizabafasha kufata icyerekezo nyacyo mu mwuga wanyu. Ni aha mpiniye, ahasigaye mugire icyumweru gihire! Ni aho mu cyumweru gitaha.

title: Igisobanuro cy’izina Diane n’imico ikunze kuranga abaryitwa
content: Diane ni izina ry’abakobwa rikomoka mu muririmi rw’Ikilatini. Mu mateka y’abaromani iri zina barihaye imana yabo y’umuhiigo(chasse). Mu miterere yabo ba Diane usanga ari abantu bahora bifuza gucya no kugendana n’ibigezweho bityo bagakunda no kwamamara. Usanga bifitemo umwihariko kandi bashobora kuba abahanga mu bijyanye n’ubuhanzi cyangwa gukina filime ndetse n’izindi mpano zikorerwa mu ruhame rw’abantu benshi. Diane ntakunda umuntu umunenga ndetse rimwe na rimwe agaragara nk’umwibone. Akunda abamushimira ibyo yakoze bityo mu kazi ke akorana imbaraga nyinshi ngo aze gutanga umusaruro wishimirwa na bose. Diane azi kugira neza kandi akoresha uko ashoboye ngo abo akunda bahore banezerewe ndetse n’ubwo bitamugaragaraho cyane Diane akunda abantu kandi yishimira kubana n’abandi amahoro. Diane ariko ntiyizirika ku mico ya kera ahubwo usanga akunze kwishyiriraho amahame n’amategeko amugenga ndetse n’inyurabwenge ye usanga yihariye. Ni umugore wigenga kandi wiyizera buri gihe. Mu rukundo, Diane usanga yikundira babandi badahora bamwiruka inyuma. Ntabwo yishimira na mba kugira umukunzi uhora amwiziritseho ahubwo akunda wawundi umwereka urukundo ariko kandi akanamuha ubwigenge. Ntakunda umusore ugaragaza amarangamutima ye cyane ahubwo aba ashaka ko amuhundagazaho imitoma kugira ngo yumve ko urukundo ruhari koko ariko umukunze agomba kumenya aho agarukuiraza mutoma ngo bitarenga bikaba kwa kugaragaza amarangamutima bya cyane. Ukunze Diane kandi ntagomba gufuha bitabaye ibyo yajya ahorana agahinda kuko ubwigenge Diane agira mu rukundo butuma yirekura mu zindi nshuti nubwo biba bidasobanuye ko atabakunze kurusha uko akunze umukunzi we. Mu rugo Diane ni umubyeyi ukunda kandi uzi kurera abana cyane.

Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muragirwa inama yo kwishakamo ubuhanga bwo guhanga imirimo mishya ishobora kubyara inyungu ariko ibi ntibizababuze kwibuka ko hari ibindi mukeneye ndetse n’ibyo abari hafi yanyu bifuza kandi mugomba guhaza ibyifuzo byabo. Gusa intekerezo zanyu nizo zizababera intwaro ituma ubutunzi bwanyu bukoreshwa neza muri iki cyumweru. Mu kazi Akazi kanyu kazahura n’intambara zitoroshye ariko nimuzitwaramo kigabo muzabona umusaruro mwiza nko guhindurirwa imirimo. Niba mwikoresha muzatangira imishinga mishya kandi namwe muragirwa inama yo kubigendamo gitwari kuko ikosa rimwe rishobora kubagusha mu mutego ukomeye.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ugushyingo na 21 Ukoboza (Sagittaire)   Mu rukundo Urukundo ruzababamo bwinshi muri iki cyumweru. Benshi muri mwe muzahura n’impinduka  cyangwa bafate ingamba zitegura ejo hazaza mu rukundo. Biragaragara ko iki cyumweru kizabongerera gahunda ihamye y’urukundo rutari ruke rurimo. Niba mwari mu rukundo rubagoye, iki cyumweru kiraje ngo kiborohereze maze mureke kubona urukundo nk’umutwaro ahubwo nk’isoko y’ibyishimo n’umutuzo. Mu butunzi Inyota mwifitemo yo gutera imbere izatuma mwongera gutekereza neza, mwongere kubona impamvu nyazo zo gukora mutikoresheje. Mushobora kubona amafaranga abatunguye muri iki cyumweru muzirinde kuyapfusha ubusa muyabyaze umusaruro kuko bigaragara ko mufite amahirwe yo kwaguka muri iki cyumweru. Mu kazi Iki cyumweru kizaba icyo gutekerezaku buryo mwakwiteza imbere mu mwuga wanyu. Muzareba cyane ejo hazaza mushyire imbaraga nyinshi mu kuhubaka. Kubana neza n’abo mukorana bizabafasha kubona ubufasha ngo mwiyubake ku buryo buhamye.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Ukuboza na 20 Mutarama (Capricorne)  Mu rukundo Buhoro buhoro, nta rusaku, iki cyumweru kizababera icy’impinduka zituje. kugenza make no gutunganya ibyo mwifuza mu rukundo bizabazanira impinduka nziza cyane. Muzahura na byinshi bizabafasha gufata ibyemezo bikwiriye. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru muziga neza ku buryo bwo gutunga urugo rwanyu niba murufite. Mushobora kugira amahirwe abashoboza kwinjiza mu buryo butabagoye. Mushobora kwishyurwa n’umuntu ubafitiye umwenda w’igihe kirekire. Nicyo gihe cyo kubyaza umusaruro ayo mahirwe kandi ntimuzime amatwi ababagira inama. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru muzagira impinduka mu kazi. Muzitegereza neza mumenye icyo gukora kandi nimukoresha ubwenge bwanyu neza izi mpinduka zizabazanira umusaruro ushimishije dore ko muzagarariza rubanda ubushobozi mwifitemo.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Mutarama na 18 Gashyantare (Verseau)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzirinda cyane gukora byabindi mumenyereye ahubwo muzatangira gutungurana muzana udushya. Abakunzi banyu bazarangwa no kubaba hafi maze mwiyumvemo icyizere maze namwe murusheho kubahaza mu byifuzo byabo kandi mwongere ikibatsi cy’urukundo rubarimo. Uramutse ushaka urukundo rushya iki cyumweru si cyiza kuri wowe kuko benshi mubo muzahura bazakuvangira, ntimuzahuza na gato. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru uburemere bw’ibyo mukora buzatanga umusaruro. Muzabona amahirwe atunguranye yo kwinjiza ariko igikomeye ni ukumenya guhitamo ibibafitiye akamaro kuko ikosa rito rishobora gutuma musubira inyuma cyane. Ntimuzakururwe cyane n’imishinga mubonana abandi ahubwo muzitegereze neza imibare yanyu muyibyaze umusaruro ufatika mudatwawe n’ibya rubanda. Mu kazi Muri iki cyumweru akazi kazabisukiranyaho ari kenshi cyane. Muzagira byinshi bibatunguye ariko murasabwa kubyitwaramo kigabo bitabaye ibyo akazi kanyu kazapfa kandi bizagira ingaruka z’igihe kirekire. Gusa muragaragaza icyizere cyo kumenya kwihangana no gukoresha ubwenge bwanyu byihuse mu gukemura bene ibyo bibazo bitunguranye. Umusaruro muzatanga uzatungurana kuburyo benshi bazatangira kugenda babavuga.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 19 Gashyantare na 20 Werurwe (Poissons)  Mu rukundo Muri iki cyumweru muzaha agaciro umwanya urukundo rufite mu buzima bwanyu. Muzashaka gutunganya neza inzira z’urukundo rwanyu ngo rube neza urwo mwifuje kuva kera. Ntibizabagora cyane kubyemeza abo mukunda ahubwo abenshi muzasanga muhuje. Abifuza abakunzi, iki cyumweru kizababera cyiza nta gushidikanya. Mu butunzi Muri iki cyumweru murasabwa cyane kongera gusubira mu mibare mukareba neza uko mukoresha amafaranga yanyu kandi nimubyitaho mugashishoza muzakuraho imbogamizi mumaranye iminsi. Amafaranga ashobora kujya abaca mu myanya y’intoki nyamara mubona ntacyo abamariye. Murasabwa rero kwirinda ibishuko bituma muhaha ibitari mu mibare yanyu ahubwo mugakora ingengo y’imari ifatika. Mu kazi  Muri iki cyumweru muzarangwa no gukorana umwete cyane. Imbaraga zanyu zizabaha umusaruro ufatika nimuzikoresha neza. Biragaragara ko mwifuza guhaguruka mugakora impinduka nziza ariko kandi muzitonde kuko guhubuka bishobora kubasubiza inyuma cyane. Ni aha mpiniye, ahasigaye mugire icyumweru gihire! Ni aho mu cyumweru gitaha.

title: Kazuo Ishiguro umwanditsi wegukanye igihembo cyitiriwe Nobeli muri 2017 ni muntu ki?
content:
Kazuo Ishiguro ni umwanditsi w’umuhanga ubizi kandi ubikunda wabonye izuba tariki ya 08 Ugushyingo 1954. Uyu mugabo wavukiye i Nagasaki mu Buyapani agakurira mu Bwongereza niwe uherutse guhabwa igihembo cy’amahoro cy’abanditsi kitiriwe Nobel, yashyikirijwe ku wa Kane w’iki cyumweru gishize tariki ya 05 Ukwakira 2017. Kazuo Ishiguro ni Umwongereza ufite inkomoko mu Buyapani, avuka mu muryango w’abana batatu akaba ari we muhungu wenyine, akomoka kuri se witwa Shizuo Ishiguro, wari umuhanga mu byo gusesengura amazi y’inyanja ndetse na nyina Shizuko. 
Mu 1960, umuryango we wose werekeje mu Bwongereza bajya gutura i Guildford, muri Surrey mu majyepfo ashyira iburasirazuba bw’u Bwongereza kugira ngo se Shizuo Ishiguro abashe gukora nk’umushakashatsi mu kigo cya ‘National Institute of Oceanography’, giherereye  Southampton.
Kazuo Ishiguro yatangiriye amashuri abanza i Surrey ariko ababyeyi be batekerezaga ko batazatinda mu Bwongereza ku buryo bibwiraga ko amasomo ye azayakomereza mu Buyapani ariko ntibyakunze.

 Nubwo yavukiye mu Buyapani Kazuo ni umwongereza  Ku myaka 20  nibwo Kazuo Ishiguro yemejwe bidasubirwaho nk’umunyeshuri wa kaminuza ya Kent( Kent University), aho yanakuye impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza mu bijyanye n’ubugeni(art) mu gashami k’Icyongereza na Firozofi(philosophy). Akirangiza icyiciro cya mbere cya kaminuza yahise atangira kwandika ibitabo birimo inkuru mpimbano(fiction novels). Mu mwaka wa 1980 yahise ajya kwiga icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza(masters degree) muri kaminuza ya East Anglia mu bijyanye n’ubuhanzi nyandiko(creative writing), aha yahise anabona akazi ko gufasha abantu i Glasgow na Londres kugeza ubwo mu 1982 yahisemo kwihebera ibijyanye no kwandika, anaguma burundu mu Bwongereza iruhande rw’umugore we Lorna MacDougall yashatse mu 1986 hamwe n’umukobwa wabo Naomi.

 Kazuo yaminuje mu bijyanye n’ubuhanzi nyandiko  Kazuo Ishiguro yagiye yandika ibitabo byinshi byakunzwe, aha twavuga nka The reamains of the day mu 1980, Unconsoled mu 1995, When We Were Orphans  muri 2005 ndetse n’ibindi byinshi cyane. Zimwe mu nkuru yagiye yandika zifashishijwe muri cinema, urugero nka The Remains of the Day yakinwemo filimi yakozwe na James Ivory mu 1993 hamwe na Never Let Me Go yakinwemo filimi yakozwe na Mark Romanek isohoka mu 2010. Kazuo Ishiguro yanafashije umuhanzi w’umunyamerika ukora injyana ya Jazz witwa Stacey Kent kwandika nyinshi mu ndirimbo ze zigize album ze Breakfast on The Morning Tram (EMI, 2007) na The Changing Lights (2013).

 Yanditse ibitabo byinshi byakozwemo filime 
Yahatanye mu marushanwa menshi atwara ibihembo byinshi birimo  Prix Whitbread yegukanye mu 1986(kimwe mu bihembo byari byubashywe cyane mu buvanganzo bwo mu Bwongereza kugeza mu 2006), Booker Prize mu 1989(Iki nacyo ni igihembo ngarukamwaka gihabwa abanditsi b’intyoza mu rurimi rw’icyongereza), ariko noneho 2017 imubereye agahebuzo kuko yegukanye igihembo gihabwa ingenzi mu ndashyikirwa kuri uyu mubumbe cya Nobel.

title: Igisobanuro cy’izina Alice n’imico ikunze kuranga abaryitwa
content:
Izina Alice rifite inkomoka mu rurimi rw’Ikidage rikaba risobanura ukomoka mu muryango w’abanyacyubahiro. Ba Alice akenshi usanga ari abakobwa bahora basa neza kandi bifitemo akantu ko kwamamara ku buryo bashobo kuba baba abahanzi, abakinnyi ba filime cyangwa undi muntu wese ukunzwe n’abantu benshi. Usanga bakunze kuba umwihariko mu bandi bityo benshi bagakunda kubigiraho ariko nanone haba ubwo bakabya bityo bakarambirana. Ba Alice ntibakira neza ubabwira amakosa yabo ndetse usanga ari abibone bibwira ko nta kosa na mba bagira. 
Alice akunda abamushimagiza kubw’ibyo yakoze bityo usanga bakora n’imbaraga nyinshi cyane kugira ngo ababona umusaruro w’ibyo bakoze babashime. Akunda ibisa neza kandi agendana n’ibigezweho agakunda kuberwa. 
Alice agira umutima w’impuhwe bityo usanga ahora akora ngo abandi cyane cyane abo akunda banezererwe mu buzima bwabo. Nubwo bitamugaragaraho cyane, Alice agira umuco kandi azi gukora ibikwiriye mu gihe cyabyo. 
Alice ntakunda kwizirika ku mico ya kera kandi usanga yishyiriraho amategeko amugenga n’imitekerereze ye usanga itita kubyo abandi batekereza cyangwa ngo azitirwe n’uko abamuzengurutse babona ibintu, mbese afite ukwigenga gukomeye.
Mu rukundo, Alice usanga yikundira babandi badahora bamwiruka inyuma. Ntabwo yishimira na mba kugira umukunzi uhora amwiziritseho ahubwo akunda wawundi umwereka urukundo ariko kandi akanamuha ubwigenge. Ntakunda umusore ugaragaza amarangamutima ye cyane ahubwo aba ashaka ko amuhundagazaho imitoma kugira ngo yumve ko urukundo ruhari koko ariko umukunze agomba kumenya aho agarukuiraza mutoma ngo bitarenga bikaba kwa kugaragaza amarangamutima bya cyane.
Ukunze Alice kandi ntagomba gufuha bitabaye ibyo yajya ahorana agahinda kuko ubwigenge Alice agira mu rukundo butuma yirekura mu zindi nshuti nubwo biba bidasobanuye ko atabakunze kurusha uko akunze umukunzi we. Mu rugo Alice ni umubyeyi ukunda kandi uzi kurera abana cyane.

title: Bashenguwe n’ubuvumbuzi bakoze. Dore ibya Mikhail Kalashnikov wavumbuye imbunda ya AK47 (IGICE CYA 1)
content:
Ubwenge karemano impano bahawe na Nyagasani byabaye intandaro yo guhora bigunze no kubura ibitotsi bitewe n’amarira n’urusaku by’abarira batabaza ku bwo kubuzwa amahwemo n’ibihangano bavumbuye nk’abahanga nyamara nta ntego yo kwica no kurimbura bafite! Abo nibande? Igice cya mbere. Amezi icyenda niyo bavukiye nk’abandi, batobye utwondo ndetse bakinnye iby’abana nk’abandi bana bose ariko nyamara impano ntiyihishira, uko ibihe bigenda biha ibindi bavuyemo abavumbuzi rurangiranwa isi yigeze mu mateka. Byinshi mu byo bagezeho bisa naho ntacyo byabamariye kuko intimba n’agahinda umunsi ku munsi bitahwemaga kubashengura bitewe n’uburyo babonaga ibihangano byabo biri kuyogoza binakoreshwa mu gutsemba abatuye isi. Aha rero twabateguriye batanu mu bahanga bavumbuye byinshi ariko nyuma bakabuzwa amahoro n’imikoreshereze y’ibyo bavumbuye ndetse bamwe bakicuza kuba barabivumbuye. Umwe muri abo turi buvugeho muri iki gice ni MikhaiI Timofevic Kalashnikov.

 Nyakwigendera Kalachnikov wapfuye afite imyaka 94 yashyinguwe nk’intwari ikomeye y’Uburusiya dore ko yanabaye umusirikare wo ku rwego rwo hejuru ku ipeti rya lieutenant-général  Mikhail Kalachnikov yavukiye mu Burusiya, tariki ya 10 Ugushyingo, 1919 apfa kuri 23 Ukuboza 2013. Niwe wavumbuye imbunda y’akataraboneka yaje no gusa naho ibaye imbunda y’ibinyejana byose idakonja hakonje, ntishyuhe hashyushye AK-47, igihangano cya Mikhail cyanamwitiriwe. AK-47 ni imbunda yamamaye cyane kandi ikoreshwa n’abatari bake dore ko ihendutse cyane, irakomeye, irizerwa ndetse biroroshye cyane kuyikorera isuku. Iyi mbunda yakunze kwifashishwa n’inyeshyamba zitandukanye ndetse n’ibihugu bifite ubushobozi buke. Ni imbunda kandi ikorwa cyane mu bihugu bifite inganda z’imbunda cyane cyane mu bihugu byahoze muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Abasoviyetike ndetse no mu gice cy’uburasirazuba (bloc de l’Est).

 AK-47 zakozwe mu 1947, aha ni bumwe mu bwoko bwazo butandukanye  Mu mbunda zose zariho mu gihe iyi mbunda yavumburwaga, AK-47 yari imwe mu zizerwaga n’abazikoresha. Yari imbunda idapfa guterwa n’umugese, haba mu mazi, mu musenyi, mu kirere gikonje n’izindo mpamvu zose. Ni yo mpamvu inyeshyamba n’andi matsinda y’ingabo z’impinduramatwara wasangaga arizo bitwaza haba mu butayu, mu mashyamba n’ahandi hantu hataroshye kuba. Gusa nanone ku birebana no gusaza kubera kuyikoresha igihe kinini ntibyabura 100% kandi iba ikeneye gukorerwa isuku kimwe n’izindi mbunda zose. Iziri hagati ya miliyoni 70 na miliyoni 110 nizo zakozwe kandi ubundi bwoko bushya bwazo buracyakorwa muri iki kinyejana cya 21, ibi bigatuma iba imbunda ikwirakwiye cyane ku isi yose kurusha izindi. Tugarutse kuri Kalachnikov wahanze izi mbunda, mu minsi ya mbere asa naho ibyo kuba igikoresho cye cyari kirimo kurimbura abantu ntacyo byari bimubwiye, ariko burya ngo umutima ntabwo ujya wihishira, mu myaka ye ya nyuma yandikiye ibaruwa umuyobozi w’idini yakuriyemo ry’aba-Orthodox asobanuza niba ariwe ugomba kubazwa amaraso y’inzirakarengane zahitanywe n’imbunda yiremeye.

 Kalachnikov n’imbunda ya AK-47 yamwitiriwe  Mu ibaruwa ye yagize ati “Mporana intimba irenze ukwemera nibaza ibibazo iteka ntajya mbonera ibisubizo. Ese niba koko intwaro kirimbuzi nihangiye yarabaye urupfu nakururiye abantu ubu bivuze ko jyewe Mikhail umwana w’umuhinzi n’umukiristu w’umu-orthodox ipfu z’abahitanwa nayo ziri ku mutwe wanjye? Uko ndama ni nako iki kibazo kiganza mu ntekerezo zanjye kandi kikanshengura umutima.”

 Nyakwigendera kalachnikov  Gusa mbere y’uko yandika iyi baruwa yajyaga avuga ko aryama agasinzira neza kuko ikibazo atari imbunda ye ahubwo ikibazo ari abanyepolitike bananirwa kugera ku masezerano y’amahoro ari nabyo bikururira rubanda ibyago. Gusa uyu mugabo yahumurijwe n’ubuyobozi bw’iri torero aho bamusubije bamubwira ko iyi mbunda atayikoze agambiriye kurimbura abantu ahubwo ko yari afite intego yo kurinda igihugu cye bamurema agatima ko ikibazo kiri ku bayikoresha nabi. Ubutaha tuzababwira ku bandi bane basigaye

title: Ku myaka 13 gusa y’amavuko, yerekeje muri kaminuza
content:
Ku myaka 13 y’amavuko umwana w’umukobwa witwa Elsa Verhoye ukomoka muri Guadeloupe, kuri ubu aritegura kwinjira muri kaminuza ya Montpellier mu Bufaransa, mu ishami rya sinema. Uyu mwana akaba asanzwe afite ubushobozi bw’ubwenge budasanzwe (surdouée) ugereranyije n’imyaka ye. Ibintu byose kuri uyu mwana birihuta, umwaka ushize muri Nyakanga ni bwo yabaye umuntu wa mbere muto ubashije gusoza amashuri yisumbuye mu gihugu cy’Ubufaransa.
 “Benshi mu nshuti zanjye ntabwo bari bazi ko mfite imyaka 13, batekereza ko mfite imyaka 18. Ariko ntacyo bintwaye.”, Elsa

 Ng’uwo Elsa Verhoye ku ntebe y’ishuri  Uyu mwana ufite ubwenge buri hejuru ya QI(igipimo fatizo cy’ubuhanga) ya 146, yagiye asimbuka imyaka myinshi. Mu kubisobanura agira ati “ Nakurikiye amasomo amwe n’amwe mu wa 5 no mu wa 4 ariko byarangiye mpise nisanga mu buryo bwihuse mu wa 1. Byarandambiraga. Byari byoroshye.”

 Elsa atungura abarimu kubera ubwenge budasanzwe afite  Nyina w’uyu mwana, witwa Zoubida aganira n’ikinyamakuru Midi Libre yavuze ko buri gihe atariko byabaga byoroheye umukobwa we. Ati “Elsa yatangiye kuvuga ku mezi 8 gusa, agira ubwenge bwo gutekereza kuri 13. Mu mashuri y’incuke nabonaga ababaje, naramwumvaga kuko nanjye nanyuze mu bintu bijya gusa nabyo.”


 Iyi kaminuza yitiriwe Paul-Valéry yishimiye guhaikaze uyu mwana  Elsa asanzwe akunda bikomeye ibijyanye na Sinema ari nayo mpamvu yahisemo gukomereza aya masomo muri kaminuza. Ati” Ndifuza gukorera lisansi yanjye kugeza ku myaka 16, kuko ishuri kugeza ubu ni ingenzi. Nibingendekera neza, nzinjira muri iyi si(ya sinema).”
