title: Dore uko icyumweru kizakugendekera bitewe n’igihe wavukiye (Horoscope)
content:
Iyi ni inkuru ngaruka-cyumweru ikubiyemo icyo abahanga mu byo kwitegereza ahazaza (les voyants) bavuga ku bizaba ku muntu uko icyumweru gitashye, ukurikije igihe yavukiye. Dore uko icyumweru cyo ku ya 11 kugeza ku ya 17 Nzeri kizagenda
Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Werurwe na 19 Mata (Belier)  Mu rukundo   Kuba umwimerere ndetse no kwerekana ibibarimo nibyo bizabahesha amahirwe mu rukundo muri iki cyumweru. Bizaborohera kugaragariza abo mukunda amarangamutima yanyu bityo nabo bishimire kuyasangira namwe. Urukundo no kubohoka nibyo bizaranga ibiganiro byanyu.  Mu butunzi  Mu mpera z’iki cyumweru birashoboka ko mwabona amafaranga. Ayo mahirwe azahurirana n’ibikorwa byanyu bwite mwihimbiye, ikemurwa ry’imanza mwaba mufite cyangwa se n’ibyo mwagurisha. Muzahura n’imishinga mishya ariko nubwo mufite ibindi mukora ntibizababuze kugerageza n’ibishya kuko wasanga ariyo mbarutso y’iterambere ryanyu cyane cyane mu bijyanye no kwigwizaho umutungo.  Mu kazi  Akazi kazabagendekera neza muri iki cyumweru. Ntabwo muzigera mubura icyo mukora ahubwo bizajya bigenda bisimburana vuba na vuba. Muzarangwa no guhanga udushya kandi ibi bizabafasha guhangana n’impinduka. Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 20 Mata na 20 Gicurasi (Taureau)  Mu rukundo  Bamwe muri mwe bazatangira umubano w’igihe kirekire nyuma yo gukunda by’ako kanya kandi rwose ayo mahirwe azaboneka, nimwe gusa mwifitemo kuyakira cyangwa kuyareka agahita gusa murasabwa kumvira umutima wanyu, hanyuma mukazabitekerezaho nyuma. Nimubitekerezaho cyane bizabangamira kwisanzura kwanyu bitumen urukundo rutagira imbaraga.  Mu butunzi  Muzabasha gufunga burundu bimwe mubyabagoraga mu giha cyashize. Muzafata umwanya wo kwirengagiza iby’ahashize maze musohoke aho mwazitiriwe n’amateka. Muzakire neza impinduka mu igenamigambi ryanyu kuko ari ingenzi cyane mu iterambere ryanyu.  Mu kazi
 Muri iki cyumweru akazi kanyu kazaba kari ku murongi, ntabwo muzatuma hari ubavangira cyangwa ngo hagire ikintu kibarogoya. Muzatangirana n’ingamba nshya kandi ibi ibizahindura byinshi ku mikorere yanyu kandi bizabaha umusaruro ushimishije. Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Gicurasi na 21 Kamena (Gemaux)  Mu rukundo
 Muri iki cyumweru muzagira igihe nyacyo cyo kwitekerezaho kandi ibi bizababera intandaro yo kumenya gutandukanya ubuzima rusange n’ubuzima bwanyu bwite. Muzashyira ku murongo amarangamutima yanyu hanyuma bibazanire impinduka nziza mu rukundo. Ibi bizababera inzira yo kwegerana biruseho n’abo mukunda ndetse n’inshuti n’umuryango nta kavuyo kabirimo ahubwo buri wese mumuhe ibimukwiriye.  Mu butunzi  Nubwo mutarabasha kugera ku ntego mwiyemeje, muri iki cyumweru muzasa n’abafata akaruhuko gato. Ibyifuzo byanyu byo guha agaciro kwigenga no kubohoka kurusha amafaranga muzabiha imbaraga nyinshi. Ibi bizatuma mwongera imbaraga nyinshi mu kwizigamira ubwo muzatangira icyumweru gitaha. Muragirwa inama yo kwirinda gusesagura amafaranga ahubwo mukabanza kubara mbere yo kugira icyo muhaha.  Mu kazi  Ubuzima bwanyu bw’akazi buzabamo gukora cyane muri iki cyumweru kandi uku gukora kuzabagirira inyungu mu gihe kizaza. Benshi muri mwe bazagira amahirwe yo kubona ibibegereza ku gusohoza inshingano bihaye. Muzagira amahirwe menshi kandi nimugira igitekerezo kizaba kiremereye ndetse bishobora no kubagora kugishyira mu bikorwa. Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Kamena na 22 Nyakanga (Cancer)  Mu rukundo  Muri iki cyumweru mugomba gufata umwanzuro. Muzahura rwose n’ibizabasaba gutanga igisubizo cyihuse. Ababazengurutse bagomba kwakira igisubizo icyo aricyo cyose mubahaye kandi birashoboka rwose ko igisubizo cyanyu cyatangwa nta bwumvikane bubayeho.  Mu butunzi  Muzagira imikorere ifatika kandi imigambi yanyu mu bijyanye no gucunga umutungo izaba irimo ubwenge na gahunda nyinshi. Ibitekerezo byanyu bizaba biremereye kandi muzamenya kubitondeka neza muhereye kubyihutirwa.  Mu kazi  Akazi kari mu by’ibanze muzashyiraho umutima muri iki cyumweru. Muzakora ku buryo bubongerera icyizere cyane. Muzagaragaza ibyo mushoboye kandi ibijyanye no guhanga udushya muzabishobora cyane. Ababazengurutse bazabona ko mwatangiye kurenga imipaka yari ibazitiye. Ababaha ubufasha baziyongera rero ntimuzatinye kugira uwo mwaka ubufasha
.
 Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nyakanga na 22 Kanama(Lion)   Mu rukundo  Ibiganiro bizagenda byerekeza aho mushaka. Iki cyumweru muzumvwa n’abo mukunda rwose, ibyo bikazaterwa n’uko namwe mwagaragaje ko muzi gutega amatwi n’uburyo mukunda. Mushobora kandi no guhura n’urukundo rubatunguye kandi rukaba rufite amahirwe menshi yo gukomeza mu gihe mwaba muri mwenyine.  Mu butunzi  Muri iki cyumweru muzatera intamwe ishimishije mu kwinjiza amafaranga ndetse no kubona ibindi byinshi biyinjiza. Amahirwe azabahora iruhande kandi uguhizaho kwanyu niko kuzabazanira uwo musaruro. Inshingano zanyu ziziyongera kandi kudacika intege kwanyu niko kuzabafasha kuzitunganya uko bikwiye.  Mu kazi  Muri iki cyumweru bizabagora cyane gufatanya akazi n’ubundi buzima busanzwe ariko muzagerageza kwirinda kugira icyo mwica n’ubwo bizabagora cyane kumenya guhitamo aho mushyira imbaraga kurusha ahandi. Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Kanama na 22 Nzeri (Vierge)  Mu rukundo  Nubwo ibiganiro byanyu bizasa n’ibitameze neza, muzabasha kugumana cya kibatsi cy’urukundo. Muzasa n’abiyibagirwa kugira ngo munezeze abo mukunda. Ibi bishobora kugera kure bigatuma uwo mukundana abyitwaza cyane hanyuma namwe mukaba mwakwisubiraho bikabatera gutekereza ibindi.  Mu butunzi

 Ntabwo muzatagaguza umutungo wanyu ahubwo muzashyiraho amategeko y’icungamutungo akomeye azafasha umuryango wanyu kumererwa neza no kutagira icyo ubura. Mushobora kandi kwinjiza amafaranga mu buryo bubatunguye mu mpera z’iki cyumweru.  Mu kazi  Muri iki cyumweru nta kintu na kimwe muzemera ko kibavangira mu kazi. Muzagira amahame mashya yihariye azabagenga kandi ntimuzakundira uwo ariwe wese kubabuza kuyakurikiza, ibi bikazabafasha guhindura byinshi ku buzima bwanyu bwa buri munsi bw’akazi. Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Nzeri na 22 Ukwakira (Balance)  Mu rukundo  Muri iki cyumweru muzita cyane ku bintu bigaragarira amaso kandi kbi bizabafasha kwinjira mu buzima bw’urukundo bukuze. Bizaba ngombwa ko mufata ibyemezo bikomeye bizabakurikirana igihe kirekire. Mwifitemo amahame ashobora guhindura ubuzima bwanyu muri iki cyumweru, ni byiza rero ko mwiyumva maze kugafata imyanzuro ihamye.  Mu butunzi  Mugomba gushyira ku murongo uburyo mukoreshamo amafaranga muri iki cyumweru kandi mukabyitaho mu buryo bukomeye. Muzagira amatsiko yo kumenya inama mugirwa n’amategeko kugira ngo mugere ku ntego mwihaye. Mushobora kandi kubona ikiraka cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo kubinjiriza amafaranga butari busanzwe.

Mu kazi Bizaba ngombwa ko muhindura imikorere muri iki cyumweru mugashakisha ngo mumenyane na benshi. Ibi bizabaha imyumvire n’amakuru mashya kandi bishobora kubafasha mu bibagora. Muzitonde cyane kuko muri iki cyumweru mushobora kwiremamo ibitekerezo bidafite aho bihuriye n’ukuri bityo mugatangira kuyoba mu kazi.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ukwakira na 22 Ugushyingo (Scorpion)   Mu rukundo  Ibyo mubona hanze aha bizabatera gutekereza cyane hanyuma bibahe ingufu zo gukomeza kuyoboka inzira iboneye mu rukundo. Muzarenga byinshi byabagoraga ndetse muzitanga cyane kugira ngo mubashe kubaho ubuzima mwishimiye.

Mu butunzi Mwitegure gukemura ibintu byihutirwa bizabatungura muri iki cyumweru. Amafaranga yanyu azinjira anasohoke mu buryo bwihuse cyane. Ibi rero birabasaba kwitonda mugashishoza ngo mumenye uko mubigenza, mwirinda gusesagura no guheranwa n’ibibazo. Mu kazi Muzagira ibyifuzo bikomeye byo guhindura imikorere muri iki cyumweru. Gukora wenyine bizabagora ahuwo muzumva mukeneye kuganira n’abandi hanyuma ibi bibafashe guhimba ibishya byinshi mu kazi ndetse n’inshuti nyinshi usangiza imishinga yawe zikugire inama.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 23 Ugushyingo na 21 Ukoboza (Sagittaire)   Mu rukundo  Ubuzima bwanyu bw’urukundo buzahinduka muri iki cyumweru. Muzahura na byinshi byiza bizafasha urukundo rwanyu kuvuka bwa kabiri kandi icyo kibatsi gishya umukunzi wanyu azacyishimira. Amahirwe abari iruhande niba ibintu byari byabakomereye. Muzarenga kure ibitekerezo byinshi mwari mwarishyizemo ahubwo kudacika intege bibongere amahirwe yo kugera aheza.  Mu butunzi  Hagati muri iki cyumweru muzagira ibiganiro bibazanira inyungu, byumvikane rero ko ikofi yanyu hari icyo izabona ariko mugomba kwitonda ngo hatagira ubatwara amahirwe. Muzagishe inama bizabafasha kumenya icyo gukora, ibi bikazanabafasha mu gihe cy’amezi ari imbere.  Mu kazi

 Muzagira akazi kenshi cyane muri iki cyumweru. Bizabasaba guhindura imikorere kandi munakomeza akazi. Ariko kandi imibanire yanyu n’ababakuriye mu kazi izazamo agatotsi ariko ntibizabahangayikishe kuko niko impinduka zigenda. Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 22 Ukuboza na 20 Mutarama (Capricorne)
  Mu rukundo  Mugiye kugira icyumweru kigoye cyane mu rukundo. Muzasubizwa inyuma mu mateka bityo muzatangira kwifata cyane ngo hato mutavaho mugwa mu mitego nk’iyo mwigeze kugwamo mu gihe cyashize. Gusa nanone ibyo bishobora kubatera kwibonamo ibyo mwari mwarihishe bityo mukaba mwatangira ubuzima bwiza cyane bw’urukundo butuje kandi bukomeye.  Mu butunzi  Muzinjiza neza muri iki cyumweru ariko kandi mugomba kwitonda kuko muzasa n’abatobotse intoki ku bijyanye no gukoresha amafaranga kuko buzagira intege nke cyane mu kubika ahubwo inyota yo kugura ibitagira umumaro iziyongera.  Mu kazi
 Muzishimira byinshi muzageraho muri iki cyumweru kandi muzoroherezwa cyane mu kazi. Muzahura na benshi bazabafasha bityo muzamuke neza ariko kandi ubufasha bwose muzabona muzabanze mubusuzume butazagira ikindi bubazanira cyazabagora mu minsi iri imbere. Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 21 Mutarama na 18 Gashyantare (Verseau)  Mu rukundo  Mwifitemo gukurura abantu mu buryo mutagizemo uruhare kandi mutazi iyo bituruka. Ariko kandi muzirinde gutwarwa cyane ngo mwibagirwe kugenda buhoro buhoro cyane cyane niba mukiri mu rukundo rushya. Nib anta mukunzi mufite, muzabonana n’abantu bazaborohereza cyane kurusha uko byari bimaze iminsi bibagora.  Mu butunzi  Ibibazo by’amafaranga ntibyihutirwa kuri mwe muri iki cyumweru. Ahubwo muzibanda cyane ku kureba ikizatuma ejo hazaza hazababera heza mwizigamira. Uburyo mubayeho uyu munsi ntacyo buzaba bubabwiye cyane muri iki cyumweru ahubwo muzibanda ku kutegura ejo heza.  Mu kazi  Muzabohoka cyane muri iki cyumweru mu kazi kanyu. Nta kintu gihambaye kizababaho kandi ibi bizabaha umutuzo mu kazi maze murusheho gutunganya ibyo mushinzwe. Muzirengagiza ibikunze kubagora mu kazi hanyuma mwishakemo uko mwakanoza kurushaho.  Uwavutse hagati y’itariki ya 19 Gashyantare na 20 Werurwe (Poissons)   Mu rukundo  Muziyumvamo gahunda yo kuganira byimbitse n’uwo mukundana ntacyo musize inyuma. Nicyo gihe rwose muzasasa inzobe mugashyira ahagaragara icyo mutekereza. Niba hari ibyo mwashidikanyagaho iki cyumweru kizaba icyo kubifataho umwanzuro mugire amahitamo afatika.  Mu butunzi  Ubutunzi bwanyu buzagwirwa n’amahirwe. Muzagira amahirwe yo kwaguka, mbese muzoroherezwa cyane ku bijyanye no gusohora amafaranga ndetse no gutangira ubucuruzi.  Mu kazi   Muzagira amhirwe mashya kandi muzagarura ya nyota yo kwiga mu kazi ndetse hari benshi bazabibafashamo. Muzabona amahirwe yo gutangira ibintu bishya kandi mu byumweru bibiri biri imbere muzatangira kubona inyungu zabyo. Ni aha mpiniye, ahasigaye mugire icyumweru gihire!
Ni aho mu cyumweru gitaha.

title: Busasamana: Imihango y’ubukwe ihangayikishije abifuza ku rushinga n’ababyeyi babo
content:
Kwishyingira, bizwi nko kwicikiza ni ingeso yeze cyane muri tumwe mu tugari tugize umurenge wa Busasamana ho mu Karere ka Rubavu mu Ntara y’Uburengerazuba aho benshi mu bakobwa bakomoka mu miryango itifite bimaze kuba nk’umuco ko aho gusabwa ngo banakwe, ubukwe butahe, bahitamo kugenda ninjoro. Ni ibintu bimaze gufata intera ikomeye ndetse ubu bimaze kumenyerwa by’umwihariko mu kagari ka Kageshi aho yaba ababyeyi, abasore n’inkumi bose bahuriza ku kuba haramutse hatagize igikozwe mu maguru mashya ubukwe bushobora gucika burundu ku batishoboye. Umukecuru witwa Ikitegetse Sesiliya wavutse mu 1942, ubwo twaganiraga, yagize ati "Twe twarasabwe turasezerana, turashyingirwa none ubu bari gushyingira umukobwa ufite ibintu gusa, udafite inka, intama,...ntibamujyana. Ibi biri gutuma abakobwa bagenda ninjoro." 

Ikitegetse Sesiliya aganira n’abanyamakuru bahuguriwe gukora inkuru z’umuco n’ururimi bari basuye umurenge wa Busasamana ku bufatanye bw’Inteko Nyarwanda y’Ururimi n’Umuco hamwe n’Inama Nkuru y’Itangazamakuru Yakomeje asobanura ko imiryango isa nk’iyamaze kwakira ibi kuko bitagitungurana nka mbere. Ati "Usanga rero ba bakobwa bafite iwabo bagufi (bakennye) bahura n’abasore nabo bagufi, bakitwikira ijoro. Ukoze ubukwe biba ari gake cyane kandi ari byiza, ariko uwijyanye aherekezwa n’uducurama kandi ibyo nibyo biri kuba cyane." Abicikije, baharanira gusezerana imbere y’amategeko, iby’ubukwe babifata nk’amateka atabareba Nyirabufite Florence w’imyaka 31 y’amavuko, utuye mu kagari ka Kageshi, mu murenge wa Busasamana, akaba ari umwe mu bagore bubatse ingo ’baricikije’ ubwo twaganiraga, yatangiye asobanura uko kwicikiza bikorwa. Yagize ati "Ni nko kuvuga ngo umusore araje arakubariye, mukajya inama akakubwira ngo ntabwo tuzagenda ku manywa nawe urabibona ntibyoroshye, nuko mukagenda ninjoro, ababyeyi bo barabyakiriye, ibyo birakorwa cyane hano." Tumubajije uko byakirwa mu muryango w’aho batuye, yagize ati "Aho dutuye, iyo umaze kugerayo, urabona nyine mugize nk’ubushobozi bwo gusezerana, muragerageza mu gasezerana mu murenge, iby’ubukwe byo rwose ntawubitekereza."

Nyirabufite Florence (iburyo) na Munsabire Marie Chantal (ibumoso), abagore babiri ’bicikije’ ijoro riguye Munsabire Marie Chantal nawe yagiye yicikije, iyo muganira akubwira ko ubu rwose bitoroshye ndetse nta n’uwamuseka ku musozi w’iwabo kuko nta kundi byagombaga kugenda. Ati "Mbere ku bintu byerekeranye n’ubukwe byari byoroshye, ariko ubu ni ibintu bitoroshye kubera ko uri umukobwa utifite ntabwo wakwifuza gukora ubukwe, kuko ubu ni ugukora ubukwe akenshi imirima ikagenda, amatungo agashira ku babyeyi, ukabona wa mubyeyi nyiri umukobwa iyo amaze gushyingira asigarana ubukene bukabije. Baravunika bikabije, byabaye agahomamunwa." Mukanoheli Immaculée, umubyeyi w’imyaka 49 y’amavuko w’umupfakazi ufite abana bane harimo umwe washinze urugo, we avuga ko asanga inkwano zariyongereye ariko bikanajyana n’uko birangira ababyeyi b’umukobwa aribo bakoresheje amafaranga menshi mu bukwe bigatuma cyane cyane abatifite bicikiza. Ati "Mu gusaba no gukwa, ubu inkwano zariyongereye, ariko mu bigaragara nubwo ziyongereye usanga akenshi ababyeyi b’umukobwa aribo bavunika cyane. Hari igihe iwabo w’umuhungu batanga nk’ibihumbi magana atanu (500,000Frw) ngo ni inkwano z’umukobwa ariko mu bigaragara yazajya gushyingirwa ugasanga hari kugendamo nka za miliyoni n’imigereka."

Mukanoheli Immaculée umubyeyi uvuga ko ababyeyi b’abakobwa basigaye bakubitikira mu bukwe bw’abana babo bagahitamo kwakira kwicikiza(kwishyingira) Yakomeje agira ati "Kera batangaga inka, none ubu ufite inka arayitanga n’ufite amafaranga arayatanga ariko ubu ikintu mbona kiri kugora umubyeyi w’umukobwa nuko muri ya mafaranga havamo ibyambikwa by’iwabo w’umuhungu, nyuma nanone tukabona banashoreye n’inyana nyine, n’imirima, uri kumva rero, njye nasanze umubyeyi w’umukobwa ari we uri kuvunika cyane." Bizumuremyi Petero Selesitini bakunda kwita Depite, nawe ni umugabo w’imyaka 46 wubatse ufite umugore n’abana batanu, imfura ye ikaba yarubatse urugo, gusa nawe ashimangira ko ubu ibintu byahindutse. Yagize ati "Njyewe navutse ababyeyi banjye bakiriho, hari ibya kera rero mu byo gushyingira ariko ubu byarahindutse, ukumva bamwe barabyita ngo vision ariko njye nsanga atari vision, cyane cyane iyo urebye ku bakobwa n’abasore usanga abantu bafite ikibazo cyane cyane ari nk’abakobwa, aribyo bakunze kuvuga ngo ’kwicikiza’, urumva rero cyane cyane abakobwa bafite amikoro make kuvuga ngo arabona umugabo ni ikibazo, ariko kera siko byahoze, kera mu kurambagiza, barambagizaga ibyo bita imbuga,..ariko ubu byinshi byarahindutse."

Bizumuremyi Petero Selesitini Yakomeje agira ati "Gukwa ntabwo byari ikiguzi ahubwo byari ishimwe ku babyeyi b’umukobwa, ariko ubu usanga ari ikibazo ari n’igihombo ku babyeyi babyaye umukobwa aho kugira ngo agire ibyiza usanga ari ibibazo, ugasanga agurishije agasambu amatungo, ugasanga abana basigaye mu rugo basigaye bari gupfapfana, bityo benshi bagahitamo kugenda ninjoro." Nyuma yo kumva ibitekerezo bitandukanye by’ababyeyi, twavugishije Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’akagari ka Kageshi, Bwana Gacamena Jean Nepo udahakana ko iki kibazo kimaze gufata indi ntera, ariko avuga ko nk’ubuyobozi bagerageza gusaba abaturage by’umwihariko ababyeyi kutananizanya mu gukora ubukwe, ariko bugataha. Tubibutse ko uku kugenda ninjoro byeze mu murenge wa Busasamana, bishimangira ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’Inteko Nyarwanda y’Ururimi n’Umuco bugashyirwa ahagaragara muri Kamena 2017, aho bwagaragaje ko ikibazo cy’inkwano mu turere dutandukanye tw’igihugu ari inzitizi mu bashaka gushinga ingo kubera amananiza bashyirwaho. Ubu bushakashatsi bukagira inama abaturage yo gukora ubukwe bujyanye n’amikoro bafite ariko bugataha kuko ari umwe mu mirage myiza twarazwe n’abakurambere .

title: Gitwe: Abanyeshuri bigaragambije, Directeur arirukanwa
content: kwigaragambya kw’aba banyeshuri bashinja umuyobozi w’ikigo kubakubita byamuviriyemo guhagarikwa by’agateganyo ku kazi. Abanyeshuri barenga 150 bo muri College Adventiste de Gitwe kuri uyu mugoroba bigaragambije basohoka mu kigo cyabo n’ibikapu n’ibiryamirwa byabo bavuga ko bagiye kureba ubuyobozi bw’Akarere kubera ikibazo bafitanye n’ubuyobozi bw’ishuri. Aba banyeshuri bashinja umuyobozi w’ikigo kubakubita. Abanyeshuri benshi bahise bafata ibikoresho byabo basohoka mu kigo bafata umuhanda bavuga ko bagiye ku biro by’Akarere ka Ruhango kuvuga ikibazo cyabo. Umuyobozi w’iri shuri ryisumbuye Ndayisenga Wilton we avuga ko iki kibazo cyavuye ku munyeshuri umwe ngo yambuye telephone akanamwirukana akanga gutaha maze agakangurira bagenzi be kwigaragambya. Abanyeshuri benshi bahise bafata ibikoresho byabo basohoka mu kigo bafata umuhanda bavuga ko bagiye ku biro by’Akarere ka Ruhango kuvuga ikibazo cyabo. Amakuru agera k’Umuseke ni uko umuyobozi w’Akarere yahise ahaguruka akaza gusanganira aba banyeshuri mu rwego rwo gushakira ikibazo umuti. Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Ruhango yabonanye n’aba banyeshuri abasaba gusubira mu kigo ikibazo cyabo kikigwaho. Uyu muyobozi yabwiye Umuseke ko yagiranye ibiganiro n’abayobozi b’Itorero ry’Abadiventiste b’Umunsi wa 7 aha i Gitwe bufite iri shuri akabusaba gukosora n’ibindi bibazo abanyeshuri bamugejejeho bijyanye n’ibikoresho ku biga muri TVET. Uyu muyobozi yavuze kandi ko baganiriye ku kibazo abana namubwiye cy’umuyobozi w’ikigo Ndayisenga Wilton ngo ukubita abanyeshuri ari nabyo byabaye imbarutso y’ikibazo. Mayor wa Ruhango Habarurema Valens yasabye ko hakorwa iperereza basanga ari ugukubita bikomeye n’urwego rw’ubugenzacyaha bugakurikirana icyo cyaha kuko n’ubundi gukubita abanyeshuri bitemewe. Amakuru atugeraho aremeza ko nyuma y’iyi nama Ndayisenga Wilton yahise ahagarikwa ku mirimo by’agateganyo na ba nyiri iri shuri asimbuzwa umuyobozi umwungirije ushinzwe  amasomo. Bahagaritse kandi Niyonsaba Eugene uhagarariye ishami rya TVET aba banyeshuri bigagamo. Aba nabo bahagarirswe by’agateganyo. Ikigo cya College Adventiste de Gitwe gifite abanyeshuri bakabakaba kuri 500. Inkuru y’UMUSEKE

title: Icyo abanyamadini bavuze kuri Gitwaza wiyise ‘umuhanuzi uruta abandi’
content:
Guhera mu ntangiriro z’iki Cyumweru ku mbuga nkoranyamabaga mu Rwanda hari gucicikana amashusho agaragaza Umuyobozi w’Itorero Zion Temple, Apôtre Dr Gitwaza Paul, aho avuga ko nta wundi muhanuzi umuruta mu Rwanda no muri Afurika. Ni amashusho yafashwe ku mugoroba wa tariki 30 Kanama 2018 ku rusengero rwa Zion Temple Gatenga, aho yatangaga icyigisho gifite umutwe ugira uti “ibimenyetso by’ibitangaza’. Uwo munsi Gitwaza yagize ati “Sinzi niba muri iki gihugu hari umuhanuzi unduta. Ibi mbabwira si ukwirata kandi Imana ibimbababarire niba hari akantu ko kwirata kandimo. Sinzi ko muri iki gihugu, muri Afurika mufite umuhanuzi umeze nkanjye [amashyi]. Birashoboka ko azaza ariko muri iki gihe ndiho ntimuzamubona. Muzamushakishe mumumbwire.”

 Gitwaza yemeje ko nta muhanuzi umuruta mu gihugu  Gitwaza yagarukaga ku byo yari amaze kuvuga, by’uko yagiye ahura n’ibigeragezo byinshi, akitwa igisambo, umusambanyi, umupfumu n’ibindi ariko agakomeza gukora umurimo w’Imana kandi akabitsinda. Yavuze ko nubwo batakwemera ko ari we muhanuzi ukomeye ubu, ngo bazabyemera atakiriho. Ati “Ndababwiza ukuri muzabimenya naragiye. Hari ahandi bazanyemera. Kubakwa kw’iki gihugu mbifitemo uruhare runini cyane. Nahanuye nka Ezekiyeli kugira no amagufwa yongere abeho kandi intambara naciyemo nta wundi mukozi w’Imana uzazicamo cyangwa waziciyemo.” Nyuma yo gusakara kw’ayo mashusho ya Gitwaza, ntiyavuzweho rumwe haba mu binyamakuru no ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Ubusanzwe amadini yose ntiyemera abahanuzi batari abagaragara muri Bibiliya. Ku babemera, umuhanuzi ni umuntu ushobora kubona ibizaba akoreshejwe n’umwuka w’Imana akabivuga, igihe cyagera bikazagaragara uko yabivuze. Ikinyamakuru Igihe cyaganiriye n’abandi banyamadini batandukanye mu Rwanda, bagaragaza uko bafashe ayo magambo ya Gitwaza. Umuvugizi wa Kiliziya Gatolika akaba n’umwepiskopi wa Diyosezi ya Butare, Philippe Rukamba yavuze ko batemera iby’ubuhanuzi. Yagize ati “Hari ibintu wenda nk’amabonekerwa ashobora kubaho, nayo tuyemera buhoro cyane. Buriya nka Kibeho kugira ngo yemerwe hari hashize imyaka 25 nibura. [Ibyo dukora] ni ibisanzwe aho ufata Bibiliya ukayisoma, ukagerageza kuyishyira mu buzima bwawe ariko ibyo kuvuga ngo isi izashira ejobundi cyangwa hagiye kuba ibi, ntabwo tubyemera.”

 Musenyeri Philippe Rukamba  Rukamba avuga ko na we ahubwo hari ubuhanuzi asigaye yumva bukamutera ubwoba. Ati “Hari ubuhanuzi bukomeye buntera n’ubwoba busigaye buriho. Barakubwira bati ‘turahanura wowe Imana iragukiza ntuzongere no kunywa imiti, ntuzongere kureba muganga, emera gusa usenge.’ Ibyo ntabwo ari byo, twe ntitubyemera, ni amafuti. Niba Imana igukijije yerekana ko wakize. Kuvuga gusa ngo emera nta kintu kibigaragaza, ushobora no kubimbwira utarakize.” Bishop Marguerite Rwandamura, Umushumba w’itorero United Christian Church, Ishami rya Gikondo, yavuze ko mu Itorero rye bemera ubuhanuzi gusa ngo nta bwo yamenya ikigenderwaho ngo umuntu avuge ko ari we wa mbere. Yagize ati “Njye simuhakanya ko ari umuhanuzi ariko kumenya urwego ariho sindi Imana cyangwa umwuka wera. Ntabwo nzi abarusha abandi, ntabwo nzi abaza ku mwanya wa mbere (…) icyo nemera nuko abahanuzi bariho kandi ubuhanuzi bw’ukuri n’ubw’ibinyoma bubaho.” Rwandamura avuga ko abakiristo basabwa guhagarara ku ijambo ry’Imana kugira ngo babashe gutahura abahanura ukuri n’ibinyoma. Ati “Iyo umuntu ahamye ku ijambo ry’Imana akaryiga akarisobanukirwa, akaryemera, abahanuzi iyo baje ntibashobora kumutesha umurongo.” Bishop Murekezi Simon Masasu uyobora Restoration Church i Rubavu, yavuze ko bemera ubuhanuzi ariko uvuga ko ari hari uruta ngo sibyo. Avuga ko mu ivugabutumwa hagomba kubaho abantu batanu bafite imihamagaro itandukanye barimo intumwa, umuhanuzi, umuvugabutumwa, umupasitori n’umwarimu kandi bose buzuzanya. Yagize ati “Uwo aribeshya kuko Bibiliya ivuga ko mu mihamagaro uko ari itanu biruzuzanya kugira ngo Imana ikore. Uwo rero afite ya kamere gusa imukoresha.Umuntu w’Imana ni umuntu uca bugufi akumva, akagirwa inama kandi akamenya ko iyo Imana imuhaye ubutumwa kugira ngo abusoze neza umwuka w’Imana niwo umukoresha.” Masasu we yavuze ko bitanashoboka ko umuntu aba umuhanuzi ngo abe n’intumwa icyarimwe. Ati “Kuki yiyita intumwa kandi akiyita n’umuhanuzi? Urumva ko agiye ukuvanga ibintu bibiri icyarimwe. Haba harimo akantu k’ubuyobe. Abahanuzi babayeho na kera, baracyariho kandi si we wenyine.” Umuyobozi w’Itorero Zeraphath Holy Church, Bishop Harerimana Jean Bosco, yavuze ko nta muhanuzi umenya ko ari we, ngo abo akorera ibitangaza nibo bamumenya. Ati “Eliya yigeze kubwira Imana ko ari we muhanuzi usigaye, Imana iramubwira iti uribeshye hari ibindi bihumbi by’abahanuzi biri inyuma. Imana yahise imusaba kurangiza umurimo we, imusaba kwimika uzamusimbura Elisa akarangiza urugendo rwe.” Yavuze ko igihe umuntu atangiye kwivuga ibigwi mu murimo w’Imana ngo aba atangiye kunanirwa. Ati “Ibyo ukora nibyo bikwamamaza, iyo utangiya kwiyamamaza uba watangiye kunanirwa.” Apôtre Paul Gitwaza yakunze kumvikana mu buhanuzi bwo mu bihe bitandukanye butavuzweho rumwe. Mu 2015 yahanuye iby’imperuka y’Isi, bica igikuba muri rubanda ariko birangira itabaye. Ibi nyuma yarabihakanye avuga ko “ ari ibinyoma. Sinavuze ko Isi izarangira ku itariki 28 Nzeli. Impamvu ntabivuga ni uko Bibiliya itatubwira umunsi, icya kabiri nanjye nzi umunsi isi izarangirira nta ngendo najyamo, sinakwigisha abantu gukora no gutekereza no kureba imbere.’’

 Gitwaza yahanuye imperuka  Si Gitwaza wenyine wakunze guhanura ibintu ntibivugweho rumwe, kuko umwaka ushize Bishop Innocent Rugagi uyobora Redeemed Gospel Church, yahanuriye umwe mu bakobwa bahataniraga ikamba rya Miss Rwanda ko azaritwara, ntibyakunda. Muri uwo mwaka kandi hari amashusho ataravuzweho rumwe yamugaragaje yaturira imigisha ku bakiristo be bifuza amafaranga, imodoka, inzu n’ibindi bitewe n’icyo umuntu yifuza, ko bagiye kubibona mu gihe gito. Inkuru ya Igihe

title: Ibisigazwa bya Mutagatifu Tereza w’Umwana Yezu byagejejwe mu Rwanda -Amafoto
content:
Kiliziya Gatolika yo mu Rwanda yakiriye ibisigazwa bitagatifu bya Tereza w’Umwana Yezu, ufatwa nk’umurinzi w’iyogezabutumwa ku Isi hose, akaba n’Umutagatifu washyizwe mu rwego rw’abahanga ba Kiliziya. Mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatatu nibwo ibyasigaye bitagatifu (Reliques) bya Tereza w’Umwana Yezu byasesekaye ku Kibuga Mpuzamahanga cy’Indege cya Kigali i Kanombe, aho byakiriwe n’abakristu, Abihayimana n’Abasaserdoti benshi. Muri iyo myizerere, Mutagatifu Tereza w’Umwana azaba ari mu Rwanda kugeza ku wa 30 Nyakanga 2018, aho azahava yerekeza i Burundi.

Abihayimana bari benshi ku Kibuga Mpuzamahanga cy’Indege cya Kanombe mu kwakira ibisigazwa bya Mutagatifu Tereza w’Umwana Yezu Gahunda y’urugendo rwa Mutagatifu Tereza w’Umwana Yezu igaragaza ko azagera muri Diyosezi Gatolika zose uko ari icyenda, agahera muri Arikidiyosezi ya Kigali, agakomereza mu ya Kibungo, Byumba, Kabgayi, Nyundo, Ruhengeri, Gikongoro, Butare na Cyangugu azava yerekeza i Burundi. Azasura gereza ya Nyarugenge, Rwamagana, Muhanga, Musanze, Nyanza. Tereza w’Umwana Yezu kandi azasura abakiriisitu muri Paruwasi zitandukanye, amatsinda y’abasenga, ingo z’Abihayimana n’iz’Abasaserdoti. Mutagatifu Tereza w’umwana Yezu yari umubikira w’Umukarumerita ahwait Liziye mu Bufaransa. Yavutse mu 1873 ahitwa Alençon muri icyo gihugu, yitaba Imana akiri muto mu w’1897 afite imyaka 24 gusa. Abepisikopi Gatolika bo mu Rwanda basobanura ko Tereza w’Umwana Yezu, aje kwibutsa umuhamagaro wa mbere w’Abakirisitu ari wo w’ubutagatifu no kubigisha inzira ye ngufi yo kubugeraho. Basobanura kandi ko azaba aje guhishurira abakirisitu ibanga rikomeye ryo kumenya no gukunda Kiliziya n’ubutumwa bw’ibanze bahuriyeho nk’abana bayo.

Abemera gatolika bari bacyereye kumwakira na nyuma yo kuva ku kibuga cy’indege Kiliziya Gatolika yemera ko Tereza w’Umwana Yezu, ari Umutagatifu ufite ubuhanga bw’umwimerere abakirisitu bashobora kwigiraho guhuza urukundo rw’Imana n’urwa bagenzi babo. Ibi bigaragarira mu mvugo ye aho yagize ati “Nasobanukiwe ko urukundo mfitiye abavandimwe banjye b’ababikira rucagase, nabonye ko ntabakunda nk’uko Imana ibakunda.” “Noneho numva neza ko urukundo nyakuri rwa kivandimwe, ari urutuma umuntu yihanganira amafuti y’abandi, ntangazwe na busa n’intege nke zabo, ahubwo agafashwa n’udukorwa duto twiza uumntu abona bakora, ariko cyane cyane numvise ko urukundo rwa kivandimwe rutagomba na rimwe kugumya gupfukiranwa mu ndiba y’umutima.” Abakirisitu kandi bazamwigiraho kutagamburuzwa n’inabi iyo ari yo yose no kudacibwa intege n’ububabare bwabo mu rugamba rw’urukundo. Mutagatifu Tereza w’Umwana Yezu ni umwe mu batagatifu bakundwa cyane ku Isi kandi wiyambazwa n’abantu benshi. Papa Yohani Pawulo wa II washyize Tereza w’Umwana Yezu mu barimu ba Kiliziya (Docteur de l’Église), yatangaje ko Tereza ari we Mwarimu wa Kiliziya muto cyane mu bandi, yongeraho ko ari ‘Umwarimu ukwiye muri ibi bihe byacu; ibihe binyoteye Ijambo rizima kandi rya ngombwa; ibihe by’ubuhamya bw’ubutwari kandi bwizewe.’ Ni ku nshuro ya gatatu Kiliziya Gatolika mu Rwanda yakiriye ibisigazwa by’Umutagatifu, nyuma y’ibya Mutagatifu Marigarita Mariya Alakoke na Mutagatifu Yohani Bosiko. Mutagatifu Marigarita Mariya Alakoke yaje mu Rwanda kuva tariki 8 Kamena 2012 kugeza tariki ya 22 Kamena 2012 hakurikiraho Mutagatifu Yohani Bosiko.

Abakirisitu benshi biteguye kwakira Tereza w’Umwana Yezu n’iwabo muri za Diyosezi Inkuru ya Igihe

title: Musenyeri Mbonyintege yanenze bimwe mu byavugiwe mu Kwibuka i Kabgayi
content:
Umushumba wa Diyosezi ya Kabgayi Smaragde Mbonyintege avuga ko hari amwe mu magambo yavuzwe n’Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa Komisiyo y’igihugu ishinzwe kurwanya Jenoside Dr Bizimana Jean Damascene atarafashije benshi mu bazi amateka yabereye i Kabgayi. Icyo yita kwitirira abantu ibyo batakoze. Nk’uko inkuru dukesha Umuseke ibivuga, mu mpera z’icyumweru gishize i Kabgayi habereye umuhango wo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 24 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Muri uyu muhango, mu ijambo rye, Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa CNLG, Dr Bizimana Jean Damascene yibanze ku mateka, yerekana uruhare rw’Abasenyeri n’Abapadiri bo muri Kabgayi mu kubiba urwango hagati y’Abahutu n’Abatutsi. Dr Jean Damascene Bizimana yavuze ko kuva ku bwa Perezida Kayibanda bamwe mu bakuriye Kiliziya Gatulika i Kabgayi bafashije Leta mu kubiba urwango. Dr Bizimana yagarutse ndetse ku mazina ya bamwe barimo Musenyeri Peraudin yagarutseho kenshi, avuga ko uyu ari mu bashyigikiye inyandiko zirimo iy’amategeko 10 y’Abahutu yiswe (Manifeste des Bahutu).

Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa CNLG Dr Bizimana Jean Damascene mu muhango wo kwibuka i Kabgayi Muri uyu muhango, warimo umunyamakuru w’Umuseke hakinnwe ikinamico yerekana uruhare bamwe mu bapadiri  bagize mu kwica Abatutsi. ‘Abakinnye iyi kinamico bari bambaye  amakanzu y’Abapadiri bakavangura abaturage bashingiye ku moko bagatwara uwo bise Umututsi bakamushyikiriza Interahamwe zikamwica’. Musenyeri Smaragde Mbonyintege, Umushumba wa Diyosezi ya Kabgayi yabwiye Umuseke ko hari ibintu byahavugiwe bidashimishije muri iki gihe nyuma y’imyaka 24 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ibaye. Yagize ati “Ntabwo biriya biganiro byafashije impande zombi, kandi nta n’ubwo Peraudin witiriwe iyo nyandiko ibiba urwango ku Batutsi ariwe wayanditse, nta kimenyetso na kimwe kibyerekana n’ubwo atabyamaganye.” Musenyeri Mbonyintege avuga ko bitari bikwiye ko bavuga ku bibi gusa by’Abatutsi biciwe i Kabgayi, ko bari bakwiye no gushima ibyiza byahabereye nk’abitangiye abantu bashaka kubarokora hakaba ngo n’abahasize ubuzima. Musenyeri Mbonyinege avuga ko muri aba bagaragaje ubutwari harimo abapadiri n’umugore w’umuhutukazi witwa Mukandanga Dorothee wishwe ashaka kurengera abakobwa b’abanyeshuri yayoboraga mu ishuri ry’abaforomo n’ababyaza. Musenyeri avuga ko uburyo ikinamico yakozwe yerekana Abapadiri mu bwicanyi ari iyo kwanduza isura ya Kiliziya, kandi ko n’ibyabaye icyo gihe kuri bamwe mu bihayimana imyumvire yahindutse ubu. Inkuru y’Umuseke

title: ‘Abataramyi b’i Rwanda’ bateguye igitaramo cy’umuco bise “ NGWINO KU GICUMBI IWACU”
content: Itsinda  ry’abasore n’inkumi rizwi nk’ Abataramyi b’i Rwanda risanzwe ritegura ibikorwa byinshi byo gushyigikira no gusigasira umuco binyuze mu buhanzi, kuri iyi nshuro ryateguye igitaramo kizagaragaramo bimwe mu bigize umuco nyarwanda. Ku cyumweru gitaha tariki 10 kamena 2018 ni bwo biteganyijwe ko iki gitaramo cy’imbaturamugabo gifite intego yo gutera ingabo mu bitugu umuco nyarwanda kizaba. Kigali Post ikimara kumenya aya makuru twegereye umwe mu bari kugitegura uzwi nka “Rwihimba Celestin” atubwira byinshi kuri iki gitaramo ni intego yacyo. Mu magambo ye yagize ati “Mu by’ukuri impamvu nyamukuru yatumye dutegura iki gitaramo twatekereje ku ngeri ebyiri z’abantu arizo urubyiruko n’abanyamahanga , iyo urebye abo bantu bombi twavuze haruguru ni abanu batumva neza agaciro k’umuco nyarwanda niyo mpamvu twateguye iki gitaramo kizaba kinakubiyemo byinshi bigaragaza umwimerere w’umuco nyarwanda.” Yongeyeo ati “Iki gitaramo kizagaragaramo itorero Inzora rikunzwe muri iyi minsi mu gucuranga inanga ya Kinyarwanda riri muyategerezanyijwe amatsiko menshi n’abazitabira iki gitaramo, hari n’abandi bahanzi b’imivugo ndetse n’abahanzi ku giti cyabo baririmba ibijyanye n’umuco.” Tubibutseko iki gitaramo kizabera muri Kigali Cultural Village iherereye muri KCEV  (ahahoze hitwa Camp Kigali). Igitaramo kizatangira ku isaha ya saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba  kugeza ku isaha ya saa mbili zijoro, naho kwinjira akaba ntakindi bisaba usibye kuhagerera igihe aho abategura iki gitaramo bashishikariza abantu kuzaza ari benshi bagasogongera ku mwimerere n’ubwiza bw’umuco nyarwanda.

title: Amateka: Ibyo wamenya ku muhango wo guterekera wakorwaga mu Rwanda rwo hambere
content:
Abantu benshi bakunda kwibaza ku mihango imwe n’imwe yakorwaga mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere na n’ubu igikorwa cyangwa se itagikorwa, byagera ku muhango wo guterekera wo bikaba ibindi bindi! * Ni iyihe nkomoko y’umuhango wo guterekera
* Guterekera si icyeza-Mana
* Akamaro guterekera byari bifitiye Abanyarwanda
* Uko Guterekera byacyendereye mu Rwanda Amashirakinyoma y’uwo muhango wo guterekera aboneka mu gitabo “Umuco mu Buvanganzo’’ cyanditswe n’Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, umaze kwandika ibigera kuri 86 bigaruka ku mateka y’u Rwanda mu byiciro bitandukanye by’ubuzima bw’igihugu. Mu mushinga w’iyubaka gihugu cy’u Rwanda, abanyarwanda bakozemo ibikorwa byinshi bitagira ingano, bakizirika umukanda, bakarwana inkundura kugira ngo igihugu barimo kubaka gihamye ibirindiro. Ibikorwa byose bamaraga kubishyitsa aho bagomba kubigeza, bagashyiraho umurinzi wo kubirinda icyabyangiza cyangwa se umwanzi wabagwa gitumo akabisenya. Umurinzi w’ibikorwa byakozwe mu kubaka igihugu yari Imihango, Imigenzo n’imiziro bisaga 5,000. Umwe muri iyo mihango wari uwo guterekera. ‘Guterekera’ ni ijambo rikomoka ku muga abiri, irya mbere ni: Guteka [Bivuga kwicara k’umwami cyangwa se kwicara kw’abakomeye] rikunganirwa n’irindi rivuga: Gutereka [Bivuga gufata ikintu ukagishyira mu mwanya wacyo cyangwa se guterura ibinyobwa ukabizanira abatumirwa]. Ayo muga yombi yavuyemo ijambo guterekera yari abumbiye hamwe ibisobanuro by’ibyakorwaga mu muhango wo Guterekera. Dukurikije ibirari by’amateka y’abakurambere mpangarwanda, guterekera ni umuhango ufite icyo usobanuye kinini mu muryango nyarwanda. Byari umuhango usobanuye kwibuka abakurambere b’intwari babayeho mu muryango nyarwanda. Hanaterekerwaga kandi abandi bantu bakomeye mu muryango nyarwanda babayeho mu mibereho ituma baziririzwa mu bihe byose. Ijambo rikunda gukoreshwa mu muhango wo guterekera ni Abazimu bivuga abantu bapfuye batakiriho, bagiye ikuzimu kwa Nyamuzinda. Nyamuzinda ni ijambo rijimije ariko ry’amarenga rishaka kuvuga iyo umuntu ajya ntagaruke. Nk’uko habaho umuzimu nk’umuntu wapfuye ni nako habaho Umuzima nk’umuntu ugihumeka, Umuzimu ni imbusane y’umuzima. Niyo mpamvu muri uwo muhango bakoreshaga imvugo yo guterekera abazimu nk’abantu babo batakiriho. Ibi bikaba bitandukanye n’uko benshi babyibwira ko abazimu ari abadayimoni, bakunze kuvugwa ko ari ingabo za Satani. Abo bakurambere baterekerwaga, nibo bashyizeho itafari ryabo mu mushinga wo kubaka u Rwanda, barwana inkundura ngo barugeze aheza hishimirwa. Abanyarwanda b’ingeri zitandukanye bagiye bafata igihe cyabo kitari gito, baterekera abo bakurambere mu rwego rwo guha agaciro ibyo bakoze mu miryango yabo no ku gihugu muri rusange no kurushaho kuzirikana urugero rwiza batanze bakazarukurikiza. Aha bikaba bitandukanye cyane n’uko benshi babyibwiraga ko ari umuhango wakorwaga mu Icyeza-Mana, aho bavuga ko baterekeraga abazimu mu rwego rwo kubiyambaza ngo bagire ibyo babamarira. Guterekera ni umuhango wagaragazaga uko Abanyarwanda babanye n’ababo batakiriho n’uko babafataga mu kubaha icyubahiro, nk’uko biri mu muco w’Abanyarwanda Intwari iribukwa ntizimizwa. Kandi ku isi ya Rurema nta muryango utagira Intwari uhora wibuka, nta n’umuryango utagira ikigwari kigayirwa ibyo cyakoze. Umuhango wo guterekera wari wubashywe mu rwego ruhanitse, ari nayo mpamvu abawukoraga bahabwaga icyubahiro nk’icy’umwami utetse ijabiro. Ntabwo babaga bicaye nka rubanda rusanzwe, ahubwo babaga batetse nk’umwami nyir’Igihugu. Iyo babaga binikije uwo muhango, byabaga ari ngombwa ko basangirira hamwe amwe mu mafunguro yabaga yateguwe, umuzimu barimo guterekera yakundaga ubwo yari agihumeka umwuka w’abazima ataraba umuzimu. Binikizaga igitaramo kirimo imbyino n’ibindi yakundaga mu buzima bwe. Mu guterekera, abazimu babaga ari benshi buri wese agaterekerwa ukwe hakurikijwe icyubahiro yabaga afite mu muryango no mu gihugu. Abari bazwiho ubuhangange baterekerwaga mu Rwanda barimo: Ryangombe, Mashira, Kagoro, Nyabirungu, Binego, Mugasa na Ruhanga. Aha bikaba bigaragara ko habagaho abazimu baterekerwa n’umuryango, abaterekerwa n’umusozi abaterekerwa n’akarere n’abaterekerwa mu rwego rw’igihugu. Mbere yo guterekera umuzimu runaka, babanzaga kumwubakira inzu ntoya bitaga indaro y’umuzimu. Uko umuhango wo guterekera wagendaga usakara mu muryango, ni nako abazimu bagombaga guterekerwa babaga benshi, nuko batangira kubashyira mu matsinda baterekererwamo bakagira umukuru wabo bitaga “Ingabwa” bivuga umuzimu uhagarariye abandi, baterekeraga mu izina ry’abandi benshi bari mu itsinda rimwe. Habagaho n’abazimu baterekerwaga ukwabo k’umwihariko kuko babaga bakomeye mu muryango, baba abari bafite ibikorwa by’ubutwari bakoze cyangwa se abari bafite ibikorwa bituma baziririzwa mu muryango nyarwanda, bagaterekerwa batabanje kunyura ku Ngabwa, muri abo harimo: Umwami nyir’igihugu: Byakorwaga gutyo kuko yabaga yaratanze ari ikirenga mu gihugu, ntawe bacagaho bamuterekera, kuko na we ubwe yabaga yihagije. Umugore: Umugore baterekeraga ukwe, ni uwabaga yarapfuye asize abana benshi. Umugore waciye inzigo mu muryango: Yabaga ari umugore wemeye gushyingirwa mu muryango udacana uwaka n’uwo avukamo, agahuza imiryango yombi, ikongera ikaba neza. Kuko yabaga ari igihangange, na we yaterekerwaga ukwe. Umugabo: Uvugwa aha, ni uwabaga ari umutunzi, nta kindi gikorwa cy’ubuhangange yakoze. Icyo bakoraga bamuterekera, ni uko babagaga ihene kuko ari ryo tungo bakundaga guterekereza, ariko yabaga ari umutunzi, bayigerekagaho inka. Umuzimu w’umugwagasi: Yabaga ari uwapfiriye kure y’iwabo, ku buryo n’intumbi ye ntawabaga yarayibonye ngo ayishyingure, uwo na we yaterekerwaga ukwe, kuko indaro ye yubakwaga ku gasozi hitaruye ingo hadatuwe n’abantu. Umuzimu w’Umwangande: Ni umuntu wabaga yarapfuye atabyaye, cyangwa se ari ikinege, na we yabagirwaga kimwe n’abandi bazimu, ariko akazira gusangira n’abandi bazimu, nta mwana muto wageraga aho bamuterekerera, inka bamubagiye nta muntu wo muri urwo rugo rwe uyiryaho, iribwa n’ab’ahandi batari muri uwo muryango. Umuzimu w’ikigirazina: N’ubwo bamwitaga gutyo, yabaga ari ikiburazina, kuko yabaga ari umwana wapfuye akivuka, cyangwa se amaze iminsi ibiri cyangwa itatu gusa. Uwo muzimu yaterekerwaga na nyina umubyara wenyine. Umukobwa wapfuye akiri inkumi, atararongorwa: Uwo muzimu yaterekerwaga n’abo bava inda imwe b’abagore gusa, nta mukobwa wahageraga. Abazimu b’ibihari: Ni abakundaga gusangira, abo baterekerwa n’abagabo babiri, aho bashyiraga imiheha ibiri mu kibindi cy’iminwa ibiri, bakabaterekera basomaho bombi. Umuzimu w’irembo: Ni umugabo wapfuye atarubaka, uwo aterekerwa na se gusa. Umuzimu w’umunyamahanga: Ni uwabaga yaje gusura abantu mu gihugu kitari icye, hanyuma akaza kuhapfira, uwo bamuterekereraga inyuma y’urugo, inyuma y’irembo, cyaraziraga kumuterekerera mu rugo imbere, ubwo byabaga ari ukumucyura bamusubije iwabo. Mu myumvire y’abanyarwanda bo ha mbere, ntabwo bari bazi ko satani abaho, icyo bari bazi ni uko umwanzi w’umuntu ari umubiri we, akaba agomba kuwufata neza kugira ngo utazamubyarira amazi nk’ibisusa. Undi mwanzi bagiraga ni umuturanyi mubi umeze nk’igisebe cy’umufunzo, bityo bakaba bagomba kubana na we neza, bagatsura umubano n’amahoro kugira ngo batazagirwaho n’ingaruka zitari nziza. Iyo myumvire niyo yatumaga bafata abantu babo bapfuye ari bo bazimu nk’abanyabubasha babasha kubaha ibyiza nk’ibyo bari bafite bakiri ku isi, cyangwa se uwapfuye ahemukiwe, bagahora bamwikanga ko ibyago byose bahura nabyo byaba bikomoka ku kuba baramuhemukiye. Abantu benshi, bibaza umumaro nyawo wo guterekera, byakorwaga mu Rwanda rwo hambere. Mmu guterekera harimo Imigenzo n’imiziro myinshi itinyisha abantu gukora ibibi, bagahora bigengesereye ku kugira ibyo bakwangiza cyangwa ngo bahemukirane, kuko umuzimu wabo yazabagaya akazabihimuraho Mu guterekera habagamo igihango cyari gikomeye, habagamo imigenzo n’imiziririzo yazirikaga abanyarwanda mu rukundo. Abavuye mu mahanga n’abamamazabutumwa, ntibafashije kurobanura ibyiza n’ibibi ngo birekwe, ahubwo bigishije ko ibyahozeho ari ibishenzi n’ibishitani gusa, bakagenda baca isano y’abanyarwanda bahereye ku migenzo n’imiziro yabahuzaga. Ni na ko bigenda iyo umuntu ashaka gukomeza ibye, asenya iby’undi. Ariko na none ntiwashimishwa n’uwaza iwawe akavuga ko nta kiza na kimwe ugira. Nyamara nibyo abakoloni n’abanyamadini bakoze. Umuhango wo guterekera watangiye gukendera ubwo mu Rwanda hinjiraga ibishya by’Icyeza-Mana ryadukanywe n’abanyamadini. Nuko abanyarwanda bahabwa izina rishya [Home Singe] bishaka kuvuga “Umuntu-Nguge,” n’ibyo bakoze bikitwa [Ibisenje], bivuga ibikorwa bitari iby’abantu ahubwo ari nk’iby’inyamaswa yitwa inguge. Kuva ubwo abanyarwanda bakuwemo umuco wo guterekera bibuka Intwari z’iwabo, babacengezamo umuco mvamahanga wo guterekera abazimu b’Abanyaburayi n’ahandi, batigeze bamenya. Hinjizwa umuco wo kwiyambaza Abahire n’Abatagatifu, mu mateka bibagirwa abakurambere mpangarwanda barwubatse rugahamya igitinyiro, batangira kubwirizwa guha icyubahiro ibihangange by’iwabo, Intwari z’I Rwanda ziribagirana! title: Pasiteri Mpyisi yitabiriye umuhango wo kwita izina imfura y’umupfumu Rutangarwamaboko -Amafoto
content:
Mu muhango utagira uko usa wuje umwimerere gakondo, Rutangarwamaboko umwigisha w’Ubuzima Bushingiye Ku Muco uniyemerera ko ari umupfumu aherutse gukoresha ibirori mu rugo rwe byo gusohora no kwita amazina imfura ye. Nk’uko uyu mugabo yabitangarije abamukurikirana kuri paji ye ya Facebook, ibi birori byabaye mu cyumweru gishize ku wa 16-17 Gicurasi 2018.

Rutangarwamaboko yasohoye umwana we w’imfura mu muhango gakondo wa kinyarwanda Ni ibirori byitabiriwe n’inshuti n’abavandimwe ahagaragaye n’umusaza Pasteri Ezra Mpyisi, ndetse n’abandi biganjemo abahanzi, abasizi n’abanditsi b’amateka n’umuco nyarwanda. Kurya ubunnyano, Kwita Amazina Umwana, Guterura Umwana,...ni bimwe mu byaranze uyu muhango nk’uko byakorwaga mu Rwanda rwo hambere, umuco usigaranye abatari benshi, ariko Rutangarwamaboko avuga ko ashaka kuwugarura dore ko yasezeranije abamukurikira ko ‘mu gihe cya vuba tuziga neza byimbitse buri kintu cyose gikorerwa muri uyu muhango’.

Abana bahinga imbuto ziterwa bahingira umwana wavutse Uyu mugabo yaboneyeho gushimira abaje kwifatanya na we muri ibi birori. Ati “Mwarakoze cyane Benimana nshuti nk’amaguru mwese tudahujwe n’ikindi keretse umutima w’i Rwanda niwo murage utagajuka w’Umuco wacu mu nzira y’ubuzima bushingiye ku muco bitwigisha ko kubaho ari ukubana kandi ko iteka umuntu ari abandi aribyo bisigasira umubano mu bantu.”

Pasiteri Ezra Mpyisi ni umwe mu baje kwifatanya na Rutangarwamaboko Rutangarwamaboko kandi yifurije umwana we yise Rutangarwamaboko Umugiramana, kuzaba umukobwa w’i Rwanda ndetse mutima w’urugo w’umwimerere uko byahoze i Rwanda. Ati “Uramenye utazarwanisha urugamba rw’ubuzima ingufu ahubwo imbaraga z’umutima niwo ntimatima ya byose! Ntuzatatire So na Nyoko utaretse kuzaba wowe ubwawe, urumve umuhanano wa Sokuru na Sokuruza utaretse Nyogokuru na Nyogokuruza, urahore wumva kandi wumvire cyane ba Nyogosenge utaretse ba Nyakowanyu!”

Rutangarwamaboko hamwe n’umukobwa we Umugiramana Asoza yanashimiye by’umwihariko umugore we, ati “NDAGUKUNDA CYANE Njishi yanjye. Nagukunze ga rwinshi Byombero by’Umudende kabishywe unambyariye imfura iserukanye isura nasesekaranye ku isi yemwega ngo ndazuka ntarapfa none nimpfa bizacura iki...? Turi imfura zikomoka ku mfura ntakabuza ko imfura yacu izaba imfura nyayo!”

Umugore wa Rutangarwamaboko aha umwana abashyitsi Tubibutse ko uretse kuba yiyemerera ko ari umupfumu, Rutangarwamaboko Modeste Nzayisenga avuga ko ari umugaga, akanaba umwigisha w’ubuzima bushingiye ku muco ndetse n’Umuyobozi w’Ikigo Nyarwanda cy’Ubuzima Bushingiye ku Muco (RCHC) aho ibitekerezo n’inyigisho ze bifasha benshi. title: Iby’ingenzi wamenya ku gisibo cy’ukwezi kwa Ramadhan, abayoboke b’idini ya Islam batangiye
content:
Kuva umuseke utambitse mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Kane, abagandukiramana b’Abayislamu batangiye ukwezi gutagatifu kw’igisibo kwa Ramadhan. Igisibo cyangwa Swaumu (izina mu cyarabu: صوم‎ ) ni inkingi ya kane mu nkingi eshanu z’idini ya Islam. Igisibo ni ukwigomwa kurya, kunywa, imibonano mpuzabitsina ku bashakanye n’ibindi bibujijwe uwasibye bijyanye ahanini no kwinezeza, kuva umuseke utambitse kugeza izuba rirenze, wagambiriye gusiba no kwiyegereza Imana. 
 Igisibo cy’ukwezi kwa Ramadhan kimara iminsi iri hagati ya 29 na 30 bitewe n’igihe ukwezi kwigaragarije, kikaba itegeko ry’Imana kuri buri muyislamu ugimbutse, ufite ubwenge, ushoboye kuba yasiba, utari ku rugendo, yaba umugabo, cyangwa umugore udafite imiziro nk’imihango, ibisanza n’ibindi. Imana ikaba yarategetse abayislamu gusiba nk’uko yabitegetse abababanjirije. Imana iragira iti "Yemwe abemeye, mwategetswe gusiba nk’uko byategetswe abababanjirije, wenda mwarushaho gutinya Imana", Qor’ani 2:183 Igisibo cy’ukwezi gutagatifu kwa Ramadhan kandi kigabanyijemo ibice bitatu binyuranye: Igice cya mbere kigizwe n’iminsi icumi y’impuhwe, icya kabiri kigizwe nacyo n’iminsi icumi yo kwicuza cyangwa y’imbabazi indi minsi isigaye ikaba ari iminsi y’ubusabe. Impamvu z’itegekwa ry’igisibo Igisibo ni inzira ituma habaho gutinya Imana, ukora ibyo yategetse ukareka ibyo yabujije. Igisibo kimenyereza umuntu uburyo bwo kurinda umutima no kureka ibibi byawo, kikanawutoza kwirengera inshingano no kwihangana mu gihe cy’ibibazo. Igisibo gituma umuyislamu abasha kwiyumvamo ububabare buri kuri mugenzi we ushonje, ibyo bigatuma arushaho gutanga no kugirira neza abakene n’abatindi, bityo bigatuma habaho urukundo n’ubuvandimwe hagati y’abakire n’abakene.
 Igisibo cyeza umutima, kikawusukura kiwukura mu bikorwa bidahwitse. Mu gisibo niho haboneka ikiruhuko k’urwungano ngogozi, kikaruruhura mu guhora rwuzuriwe, bikarufasha kugarura ingufu. Ibyiza by’ukwezi kwa RAMADHANI Imana iragira iti “Mu by’ukuri Qor’ani, twayimanuye mu ijoro ry’icyubahiro (AL QAD’RI). Ese ni iki cyakumenyesha iryo joro? Iryo joro ririmo ibyiza biruta iby’amezi igihumbi, Imana irimanuramo Abamalayika bari kumwe na DJIBRIL ku itegeko rya Nyagasani wabo mu mutuzo uganje. Iryo joro rikarangwa n’amahoro n’ituze kugeza umuseke utambitse", Qor’ani 97:1-5 Umusangirangendo w’Intumwa y’Imana witwa ABU HURAY’RAT (Imana imwishimire) yaravuze ati: Intumwa y’Imana (Imana imuhe amahoro n’imigisha) yaravuze iti "Iyo igihe cya Ramadhani kigeze, imiryango y’ijuru irafungurwa n’iy’umuriro igafungwa, amashitani akabohwa", Yakiriwe na BUKHARIY na MUSLIMU. Ibi ni bimwe mu by’ingenzi twahisemo kubasangiza kuri uyu munsi. Dukora iyi nkuru twifashishije urubuga rw’Ijwi rya Islam, Ishami ry’ivugabutumwa mu buyobozi bukuru bw’umuryango w’abayisilamu mu Rwanda. Muri iki gihe cy’Igisibo tuzakomeza kugenda twungurana ubumenyi ku bijyanye n’igisibo cy’ukwezi kwa Ramadhani n’idini ya Islam muri rusange, aho uramutse ufite ikibazo watwandikira mu mwanya wahajya ibitekerezo cyangwakuri e-mail:kigalipost250@gmail.com. maze tukazakubariza abamenyi b’idini ukarushaho gusobanukirwa.  Tubonereho kwifuriza abayislamu bose kuzagira igisibo cyiza, Nyagasani azaborohereze kandi yumve ubusabe bwabo.

title: Somaliya: Umugore yishwe atewe amabuye azira gushaka abagabo benshi
content:
Mu gihugu cya Somaliya, umugore yatewe amabuye kugeza apfuye nyuma yaho urukiko rw’umutwe wa Al-Shabab rumuhamije icyaha cyo kugira abagabo benshi nk’uko uyu mutwe wabyitangarije. Shukri Abdullahi Warsame yahamijwe gushinga urugo inshuro 11 akabikora adatandukanye n’abagabo be ba mbere. Nk’uko byemejwe n’abaturage bo mu gace ka Sablale, uyu mugore yatabwe ari muzima, umutwe aba ariwo usigara hejuru, maze aterwa amabuye n’intangorwa za Al-Shabab kugeza apfuye.

Ibi byabereye ahitwa Sablale mu birometero 200 mu majyepfo ashyira uburengerazuba bw’umurwa mukuru Mogadiscio Mohamed Abu Usama, guverineri wa Al-Shabab mu gace ka Lower Shabelle yabwiye ibiro ntaramakuru by’Abongereza, Reuters ati “Shukri Abdullahi n’abagabo 9 be barimo n’umugabo we wemewe n’amategeko, bagejejwe imbere y’urukiko, buri wese avuga ko ari umugore we.” Nk’uko amategeko ya Islam abitegeka nta mugore wemerewe gushaka umugabo urenze umwe ariko ku bagabo bo bemerewe gushaka abagore bagera kuri bane. Gatanya iremewe kuri buri ruhande, ariko ku bagabo bo bashobora gutandukana n’abagore babo, mu gihe umugore we agomba kubanza kubyemererwa n’umugabo we. Iyo umugabo abyanze, umugore ashobora kujya mu butabera bw’idini kugira ngo abe yakomorerwa.

Bamwe mu barwanyi ba Al-Shabab Al-Shabab isanzwe izwiho kugendera ku mahame ya charia no gufata ibyemezo bikarishye k’uwo ariwe wese ihaije ko yishe amahame n’imyemerere ya Islam. Uyu mutwe kandi uyobora igice kinini cya Somalia ndetse rimwe na rimwe ugaba ibitero mu bice bitandukanye ushaka guhirika burundu guverinoma y’iki gihugu iherereye mu murwa mukuru Mogadiscio. title: Ibanga ry’Amahoro kuri bene Gihanga ku bwa Padiri Obalidi
content:
Ku Cyumweru tariki ya 15 Mata ni bwo abakristu ba kiliziya Gatolika baturutse imihanda yose bahuriye kuri stade Amahoro mu isengesho ngarukamwaka ryo gusengera abarwayi n’abandi bose bafite ibikomere batewe na Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, uyu akaba ariwo wari umwihariko w’uyu mwaka. Ni isengesho ryatangiye mu masaha ya mu gitondo ribimburirwa n’igitambo cya misa cyayobowe na Padiri Ubald Rugirangoga mu nyigisho yagarutse ku gikorwa kibi cyaranze abakristu bo mu gihe cya Jenoside avuga ko umukristu wica undi akwiye guhindurirwa izina agashakirwa irindi. 

Padiri Ubald amaze kwamamara cyane mu gusengera abantu ibikomere bikomoka Uyu mupadiri wibanze cyane ku nyungu ikomeye yo gutanga imbabazi no kuzisaba yabwiye abakristu ko buri muntu nicyo ari cyo cyose afite urufunguzo rwo kubohora mugenzi we. Mu magambo ye yagize ati “Wowe wacitse ku icumu ufite urufunguzo rwo kubohora no gukiza ibikomere uwakwiciye umuha imbabazi, nawe ufite abo wiciye ufite urufunguzo rwo gusaba imbabazi!”
 Padiri Ubalidi yaboneyeho anamurika filimi yise ‘Gusaba no Gutanga imbabazi niryo banga ry’Amahoro’, filimi yakozwe n’abakristu ba Paruwasi ya Mushaka asanzwe ayobora, akaba yarayigizemo uruhare rukomeye mu ikorwa ryayo. Ni filimi igaragaramo ubutwari bukomeye bugaragazwa nabo bakristu bwo gusaba no gutanga imbabazi.

Abakirisitu ba kiliziya Gatolika bari bitabiriye ku bwinshi Nyuma y’igitambo cya misa, Ubalidi yazengurukije isakaramentu ry’ukarisitiya abayoboke biri dini bemeza ko rikirizwamo ibyaha. Nyuma y’ibi nibwo hatangiye kugaragara ibitangaza, ibikomere birakira ku bwinshi abari baranangiye gusaba no gutanga imbabazi nabo bahava biyemeje kwihambura iyo migozi yari baziritse yo kutiyunga.








 Isengesho kandi ryitabiriwe na Minisitiri w’Umuco na Siporo, Uwacu Julienne aho mu ijambo rye yabwiye abari aho ko ubukristu nyabwo bukwiye kujyana n’ubunyarwanda nyabwo. “Nkuko mukora ibindi bikorwa bitandukanye bya kiliziya muvugurura ubukiristu bwanyu ni nako mukwiye no kwitabira ibikorwa bya Leta cyane cyane nk’iki gihe turimo mufasha abacitse ku icumu munitabira ibikorwa byo kwibuka.”, Minisitiri Uwacu Julienne wasoje arema agatima abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi abihanganisha ababwira ko imbere ari heza. title: Itorero Indekwe ryateguye igitaramo kigamije kwigisha no gukundisha abato umuco gakondo
content:
Abahanzi gakondo bafite intego yo kwigisha ndetse no gukundisha umuco abato n’abakuru bishyize hamwe bakora Itorero ryitwa Indekwe bategura igitaramo cy’umuco gakondo bise ‘Ibyivugo by’ingoma’. Kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 30 Werurwe ni bwo aba bahanzi gakondo bishyize hamwe, bateguye igitaramo cy’umuco kigamije kwibutsa urubyiruko ndetse no kurukundisha iby’iwabo, ni igitaramo kizaba kirimo imbyino, ibisigo ndetse n’indirimbo. 

 Urupapuro rwamamaza iki gitaramo(affiche)  Umuhanzi wamenyakanye mu ndirimbo zakunzwe na benshi mu myaka yatambutse ndetse n’ubu ugikunzwe n’abatari bake kubera ijwi n’amagambo byuje ubuhanga aririmba, Nyiranyamibwa Suzana yavuze ko iki gitaramo ari ingirakamaro kuko urubyiruko rufite inyota yo kumenya iby’iwabo cyane cyane amateka. Yagize ati “Twateguye iki gitaramo kugira ngo twegere urubyiruko turwigishe kandi tugire icyo natwe tuzasiga mu bana hato ejo umuco utazasibangana. Hari igihe batubaza aho dukorera tukabura icyo tuvuga kuko ntaho twari twagira gusa iki gitaramo n’intambwe ya mbere izadufasha kugira aho dukorera hahoraho ku buryo tuzajya tugira abatugana tukabafasha mu bijyanye no kumenya umuco, ababyeyi nabo nibagire uruhare mu kwigisha abana babo umuco ndetse n’ururimi rwacu barukunde”.

 Nyiranyamibwa Suzanne ni umwe mu bagize itorero Indekwe  Nyiranyamibwa wamenyakanye mu ndirimbo nka Ndavunyisha, Urwo ngukunda, Mbwira uko rwaje ndetse n’izindi nyinshi, yijeje abizitabira icyo gitaramo ko bazabona ibintu byiza kandi bazataha bishimye cyane ko azaririmba muri iki gitaramo. Umuhanzi mu bisigo n’imivugo Kalisa Rugano ari nawe uhagarariye abategura iki gitaramo na we yemeza ko urubyiruko rufite inyota yo kumenya umuco ahubwo rwabuze aho rubyigira bityo, bakaba bafite intego yo kwigisha bihoraho urubyiruko umuco.

 Kalisa Rugano, umwe mu bahanzi bazwiho gusigasira umuco  Yagize ati “Iki gitaramo Ibyivugo by’ingoma kizahuza imbyino gakondo, ibisigo ndetse n’indirimbo, urumva ko abanyarwanda bahishiwe byinshi mu gitaramo nk’iki kitwibutsa umuco wacu kandi kikatwigisha ibyo tutari tuzi.” Tubibutse ko iki gitaramo kizabera muri Hotel Umubano, kuri uyu wa Gatanu aho kwinjira ari amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi 10(10,000frw).

title: Inkomoko y’insigamigani ‘Burya si Buno’
content: Uyu mugani abanyarwanda badatuza guca cyane cyane iyo bacyurirana, umuntu awuca iyo abonye urwaho rwo kwigaranzura uwari waramuzambije akamubuza amahwemo, cyangwa se iyo ashaka kumvisha ko umuntu ari “mutimukwe” ni bwo bavuga ngo “Burya si Buno”. Wakomotse kuri Burya na Buno, bene Rugomwa rwa Maronko mu Gisaka (Kibungo) ahagana umwaka w’1400. Abo bahungu bombi bari impanga, bakaba bene Rugomwa yari umugesera w’umuzirankende, akaba umutware w’umutoni mu b’ingenzi kwa Kimenyi Musaya umwami w’i Gisaka. Bukeye Kimenyi atoresha abakobwa beza mu Gisaka, babazana mu rugo rwe rw’i Remera ry’i Mukiza (hari muri komini Kigarama: mu Gisaka i Mukiza hari nk’ibwami mu Rwanda). Bamaze kuhateranira yohereza abagore bakuru bo guhitamo abasumbije abandi ubwiza, kugira ngo bamwe azabarongore abandi abashyingire abahungu akunda. N’i Rwanda niko byagendaga, ni ko ibwami barambagizaga. Nuko abagore bajya kurobanura abakwobwa, babakenyeza impu z’imikane, babareba imbere n’inyuma , babambika ubusa barabahindura bareba intantu n’ibibero. Umukobwa wa mbere aba Barakagwira ba Numugabo. Igihe bakibisiganira, Kimenyi aba arahageze na wa muhungu Rugomwa dore ko yamukundaga cyane. Ba bagore n’abakobwa babonye abatunguye barikanga. Arabasatira arabaramutsa n’abakobwa bose. Ubwo abagore bari bakikije Barakagwira. Kimenyi arababaza ati “ko nduzi mukikije uyu mukobwa mwese ni ibiki?” Abagore batinya kumubwira ko ari we uruta abandi ubwiza, kugira ngo bagenzi be batagira ipfunwe n’ishyari. Kimenyi na we arabimenya aroroshya. Ati “Nimuze mbabaze”. Abajyana mu yindi ngombe dore ko ibyo byagirirwaga mu gikari. Bahageze babona kumutekerereza ko Barakagwira aruta bagenzi be bandi ubwiza. Ubwo wa muhungu Rugomwa akaba ari aho. Kimenyi arashimikira ati “Arabaruta bose koko?”, bati “arabaruta turakakuroga”. Kimenyi akebuka Rugomwa ati “ Muguhaye wanshima?” Rugomwa ati “ Nagushima mba nkuroga”. Kimenyi ati “Ndamuguhaye uzamurongore”. Rugomwa rero arongora Barakagwira, atahirira i Mukiza kwa Kimenyi. Barakagwira amaze kurongorwa ntiyazuyaza, aherako asama. Igihe cyo kubyara kigeze, yibaruka abahungu babiri b’impanga: umwe bamwita Burya indi bamwita Buno. Bamaze gukambakamba, Kimenyi atekesha Rugomwa ubutware aramusezerera ajya kuburereramo abana be. Bamaze kuba ingaragu, Kimenyi abajyana iwe bareranwa n’abe. Bamaze kugimbuka arabashyingira, abaha inka n’imisozi. Biba aho bishyize kera Rugomwa arapfa. Abahungu be basigara mu bye babitungana n’ibyabo. Bitinze abantu bo mu Gisaka babagirira ishyari barabanga babateranya na Kimenyi. Na we atangira kubareba nabi. Burya na Buno babibonye bagira ubwoba baracika bamucikira i Bujinja. Bamaze kugerayo bakeza umwami waho. Arabakira arabahaka. Hagati aho abanyagisaka bayoberwa aho bacikiye. Birarambanya hashira imyaka ariko bigeze aho barahamenya. Babwira Kimenyi bati “Burya na Buno bari i Bujinja”. Kimenyi yohereza abantu bajya kubagarura kuko yabakundaga cyane. Bagezeyo barabaririza barababona bararamukanya barashyikirana. Bari bamaze kuba amajigija. Intumwa zibabwira ubutumwa bwa Kimenyi bw’uko bagaruka iwabo. Bamaze kubyumva, Burya arabyemera, Buno araricurika ararahira yanga kugaruka. Burya agarukana n’intumwa, Kimenyi amusubiza ibyabo byose, na ho Buno yigumira iyo. Nuko atindaharirayo kugeza igihe agwiriyeyo yiseguye ubutindi. Rubanda rero rumaze kubona uko izo mpanga zanyuranije ibitekerezo byari mahwi amambere, babikurizaho imvugo yahindutse umugani baca bagira ngo “Burya si Buno!” Bawuca bashaka kuvuga ko umuntu ari mutimukwe: nk’uko abo bahungu babusanije ibitekerezo kandi bari akara kamwe. Ku ruhande baba bashima Burya, ku rundi bagaya Buno. Ariko mu mvugo bisobanura ko ibihe biha ibindi ni nk’aho umuntu yagize ati “Birya wangiriraga burya ntishoboye ubu noneho byarahindutse” Naho rero iyo umuntu abajije undi ati “Mbese Burya ni Buno?”. Ubwo aba ashaka kumubaza ngo “Mbese biracyari kwakundi?” Burya si Buno=umuntu ni mutimukwe (mutima ukwe) cyangwa se ibihe biha ibindi. Nta gahora gahanze. Burya na Buno = Biracyari kwakundi: nta cyahindutse. Inkuru dekesha Gakondo.com

title: UMUCO WACU: Inkomoko y’insigamigani ‘Yigize Syoli’
content: Uyu mugani ngo “Yigize syoli” bawuca iyo babonye umuntu wese wigize umushirasoni kabuhariwe, akaba ikinani muri byose, ni bwo bagira bati “kanaka yigize Syoli!” Ngo byakomotse kuri Syoli w’i Nyagahanga hazwi nka Byumba ahagana mu mwaka w’i 1600. Syoli yabyirukiye ku Cyuru ku ngoma ya Mutara Semugeshi, abyiruka akunda guhiga, aba umuhigi w’umukogoto. Ngo yari abizi cyane akica inyamaswa z’ishyamba ndetse ntakangwe n’iz’inkazi nk’intare, ingwe, imbogo n’izindi. Umunsi umwe abandi bahigi baza kumurarika ngo bazajyane guhiga, ariko we arabakabukana ngo ntibazi kurasa ntabwo yajyana nabo guhiga. Bavuga ko ngo yababwiraga ati “Nzijyana n’umuheto wanjye!” Umugore we ngo yamugiraga inama yo gufatanya n’abandi kuko nta mugabo umwe, ariko Syoli akamutwama agira ati “Aho ntugira ngo nanjye ndi nka bamwe mupfa kwita abahigi! Uretse no kwitwaza umuheto wanjye, n’aho najyana inkoni yanjye nta nyamaswa yandinda!” Umugore ngo yaramwihoreraga, ariko akomeje kugira amakenga bimwanga mu nda, bukeye ashaka inzoga, ayijyana ku Cyuru kwa sebukwe, iwabo wa Syoli, agezeyo abwira sebukwe ikimugenza agira ati “Dawe iyi nzoga nkuzaniye ni iyo kugira ngo uzampanire umuhungu wawe yarananiye. Yihaye kujya ahiga mu ishyamba rya Nyagahanga wenyine, kandi muzi uko rimeze. Buriya n’abandi bahigi bamuraritse arabirukana ngo ni we uzi umuheto wenyine, batirimuka, nagira ngo mwumvishe ukuri kwabo akantwama akandaza ku nkeke ankoba.” Sebukwe ngo yaramwumvise amusubiza agira ati “Genda mwana wanjye, ndamara gatatu ku munsi wa kane nkaza kubaza icyo kiroge uko cyigize.” Ya minsi ishize yarashize ngo umukambwe arashyogoza ajya i Nyagahanga iw’umuhungu we. Agezeyo asanga Syoli yagiye guhiga wenyine, ku mugoroba abungukana ingwe yishe, asanga se yicaye iwe amwereka umuhigo. Amaze kwicara, se aramubaza, ati: “Mbese ko uje uri umwe, abandi mwahiganye bari hehe?” Syoli, ati: “Ntabwo mpigana n’abandi mpiga jyenyine.” Se ati: “Ese mwana wanjye niba uri n’umukogoto, harya urasa umuhinyoro ntiyarengera uzi kwinjiza?” Syoli ati: “Aho nabereye sindahigana n’abandi.” Se yaramuhanuye yanga kumva, aramukangara ararakara, ni uko agira ati: “Nkabona n’umugore wawe yaraguhannye ukamunanira, koko wigize intabikozwa!” Yungamo, ati: “Harya ngo wica ingwe sha! Hari ubwo urutoni urunguru ruzakwihererana ubure kivurira!” Umusaza arara ataraye, bukeye azinduka yitahira. Amaze gutaha muka Syoli asigara mu mazi abira kuko yareze umugabo kuri sebukwe. Syoli arabisha, abwira umugore; ati: “Ubu ngiye mu ishyamba kandi sinjyana umuheto, ndajyana icumu n’inkoni yanjye nkuzanire intare; ariko nimara kuyikwereka wiyimbire! Noye ayo!” Ni uko aturumbukana icumu n’umujinya wica inka. Ubwo ngo hari ku kagoroba, ageze ku ishyamba ajya ku nama mu rucucu rwari mu nsi y’inzira, agisutama urukwavu rumuturumbuka mu nsi yiterera hejuru, agira igihunga, aragwaguza, yishita ku icumu rye ryari rimushinze imbere, rimwahuranya umutima arahwera; azimira atyo azize guhinyura ay’abakuru. Kuva ubwo rero rubanda bibuka uko yajyaga ananira abamuhana ntakangwe n’inyamaswa z’inkazi, bakurizaho bavuga ko umuntu wese wananiranye mu mico akigira intabikangwa yigize syoli. Kwigira Syoli ngo bikavuga Kunanirana mu mico. Inkuru dukesha Gakondo.com

title: AMATEKA-Bimwe mu byaranze Ingoma ya Kigeli II Nyamuheshera
content: Kigeli II Nyamuheshera yabaye indwanyi y’ikirangirire, akagira umutwe w’ingabo w’ikirangirire na wo, ukitwa “Inkingi”. Ariko rimwe mu matorero yawo ryitwa “Iziruguru” wamazwe n’abanyabungo mu burengerezuba bw’i Kivu. Hari mu gihe yari amaze kwigarurira ubwami bw’i Bukunzi n’u Busozo bwari mu burasirazuba bw’i Kinyaga. Ni bwo ingabo zambutse Rusizi zitera n’ubwami bw’i Bishugi barahatsinda ariko barekeraho abatware bahasanze babategeka kujya bohereza amakoro mu Rwanda gusa. Arenga aho sekuru Ruganzu II Ndoli yagarukiye, atera inyuma y’ibirunga ahitwa i Kamuronsi, Gishali n’ahitwaga Tongo (Masisi).  Yahagaritswe n’ishyamba ry’inzitane rya Congo kuko bibwiraga ko isi ituwe ariho irangirira. Ni muri icyo gihe kandi yigaruriye u Buhunde n’u Buzi, mu majyaruguru agana iburengerazuba bw’ikiyaga cya Kivu, ariko nabo abategeka kujya bohereza amakoro mu Rwanda gusa. Ubu bwami bwagiye bugabwaho udutero twinshi ku zindi ngoma bitaga ko ari utwo kubahana. Agana mu majyaruguru yigarurira uduce dukikije ikiyaga cya Rwicanzige(Edouard), ageza inkiko(umupaka) ku rutare rwa Kabasha kuko nyuma yarwo ariho hatangiriraga ubwami bw’i Gitara akaba ariho Ryangombe yakomokaga. Icyo gihe rero byari umuziro kuhatera byabaye ngombwa ko bagarukira aho. Kigeli II atera u Buberuka yica umwami waho Mweru,afata ingoma yabo yitwaga Icyungo. Yohereza ibitero byinshi muri Kigezi (Uganda). Kimwe mu bitero cyari kivuye mu Bushengero kiza kizanye “ibishyimbo” bihingwa ubu mu Rwanda. Ibyo bishyimbo nibyo byasimbuye ibyahingwaga icyo gihe byitwaga “ibiharo”. Ikindi gitero kinyaga umukumbi w’ihene zibyibushye cyane, umwami arazigumana  azita “akamenesho”(kumenesha= kwirukana), ziba nk’ubushyo bw’inka agena abazishinzwe. Ubworozi bw’izo hene rimwe na rimwe zajyaga ibwami kumurikwa bwarakomeje kugeza ku ngoma ya Yuhi V Musinga aho uwari uzishinzwe yitwaga Bunyereli wa Muhozi wari utuye mu Gishubi i Gitarama. U Bwanacyambwe busubizwa u Rwanda Ibyo bitero byinshi byo kwagura igihugu ntibyaranze ingoma ya Kigeli II nko kugarurira u Rwanda intara rwari rwarabuze y’u Bwanacyambwe aho rwavukiye. Kuva Kimenyi II Shumbusho yabwigarurira, u Rwanda rwari rutari rwumva rwashobora gutera i Gisaka ngo buhagarure. Mu Gisaka haza kwima uwitwa Kimenyi III Rwahashya maze intambara irubura hagati y’i Gisaka na Ndorwa bwagengwaga na Gahaya I Rutindageli. Abo bami bombi bari bato cyane badashobora kuyobora bayoborerwa naba Nyina aribo Nyiragahaya I mu Ndorwa  na Nyirakimenyi III Kabonde i Gisaka. Amateka ntatubwira neza icyo bapfaga ariko yemeza ko abo bagabekazi bombi bigereye ku rugamba rwa nyuma rwabereye ahitwa i Muzizi hafi ya Ryamanyoni i Kibungo, kuri Muhazi. Ako gace icyo gihe kari mu Gisaka abateraga rero bari abanyandorwa bakubita inshuro abanyagisaka Nyirakimenyi III afatwa mpiri,mukeba we amuha igihano cyuko acibwa amabere ubundi agatabwa ku ngoyi. I Gisaka mu  gisebo cyinshi gihungishiriza umwami wacyo mu Rwanda. Kigeli II amwakirira i Kamonyi, Kimenyi III amwaka ubufasha. Kigeli II Nyamuheshera aramwemerera gusa na we amusaba ko namusubiza ku ngoma yirukanye abanyandorwa ko Kimenyi agomba kumusubiza u Bwanacyambwe. Kimenyi aremera nuko bombi bashyira nzira baragenda, Kigeli II atabarana n’ingabo ze. Abanyandorwa batsindwa rugikubita birukanwa mu Gisaka. Dushobora kwibaza impamvu Kigeli II atahise aboneraho ngo yigarurire i Gisaka byagaragaraga ko kidashoboye kumurwanya.  Ahari wenda indagu ntizabyemeye?  Gusa ikizwi nuko kuva ubwo i Gisaka cyasaga n’igifitanye amasezerano n’u Rwanda, u Rwanda arirwo rukirinda. Ibi bivugwa cyane mu bisigo byinshi. U Bwanacyambwe busubizwa u Rwanda harimo umusozi wa Kigali n’iriba rya Rwezangoro ryashimijije cyane cyane abiru. Kuva ubwo abiru bakoraga umuhango w’Inzira y’ishora bidasabye ko bajya kugira ibyo bashaka mu mahanga. Agasozi ka Gasabo ko ntikari karimo kuko kari mu Buganza. Iyi ngoma yagize ibihe bibi aho umugabekazi Nyirakigeli II Ncendeli anywereye (yiyahuriye) yaketse ko yazabeshya ntihazagire umenya ko atwite ageze aho abonye ko ntakundi byamenyekanye yiyemeza kunywa ashyingurwa  i Butangampundu hari hagenewe  abami n’abagabekazi bapfuye muri ubwo buryo. Kigeli II Nyamuheshera na we yaje gutanga atabarizwa (ashyingurwa) i Burenga hafi ya Sayo muri Byumba. Ntibyashobokaga kugera i Rutare aho ubundi ba Kigeli batabarizwaga kuko hari harigaruriwe na Ndorwa. Iyo niyo mpamvu yatumye ku ngoma y’umwuzukuru we Cyilima II Rujugira, bayoye ivu  rikajyanwa i Rutare kuko hari hamaze kugaruka ku Rwanda. Muri ubwo buryo Kigeli II Nyamuheshera yari atabarijwe ahahuye n’izina rye. Yari yarambitswe umudende, bahaga umuntu wese wishe ababisha barindwi; kubera abami barindwi b’abanyamahanga bishwe ku ngoma ye. Source:Gakondo.com

title: Umuco gakondo- Umugani wa Nkuba na Gikeli
content:
Nkuba yibereye aho agatura mu ijuru, Gikeli akaba mu nsi. Gikeli yagenda akagenda asimbuka. Nkuba akibera hejuru agakubita hirya no hino. Umunsi umwe aza gukubita ajya hasi, asanga Gikeli yarubatse, arasakara, afite urugo rukomeye. Nkuba abaza Gikeli ati “Ese Gikeli, ko wubatse utya, wowe usakaza iki, ubwatsi ubukura he? Ubutemesha iki?” Gikeli ati “Mfite umuhoro wanjye ngomba gusakara inzu yanjye simvirwe.” Nkuba ati “Nanjye rero ndi umukene, untize uwo muhoro wawe nitemere ubwatsi njyane ku ijuru, njye kwisakarira inzu. Umugore n’abana ntibagira aho bicara.” Cyakora Gikeli abyumva vuba, abaza Nkuba ati “Ese Nkuba ndaguha umuhoro wanjye nzawushyikirizwe n’iki, ko ureba ntagira amaguru?”  Nkuba ati “Nzawuzana vuba.”  Gikeli ahereza Nkuba umuhoro, aragenda atema ubwatsi. Ariko ubwo Nkuba yatemaga ubwatsi, Gikeli yaribwiraga ati “Ndabizi, Nkuba ni umuntu ugira amahane, kandi ntazongera kugera ino ubwo ashyikiriye umuhoro wanjye.” Gikeli aranyaruka yigira mu kiba cy’ubwatsi. Nkuba akubita ubwatsi abugeza mu ijuru, abutura ku kibero cy’inzu iwe. Umugore ati “Ese noneho ubu bwatsi ubukuye he?” Undi ati “Wa mugore we ceceka, ibintu mbonye ntibigira uko bisa. Nahuye n’umugabo Gikeli ampereza uyu muhoro, ariko nzarebe aka Gikeli na Nkuba. Ntabwo rwose uyu muhoro nzawumusubiza. Reka njye nitemera ubwatsi, nisakarize inzu, ntabwo Gikeli azagera ino.” Umugore ati “Uzaba umuhemukiye cyane.” Undi ati “Reka da, ntabwo namuhemukira.” Nkuba akajya aca ubwatsi, arasakara, amererwa neza. Gikeli aranyaruka yitura mu kibero cy’inzu, noneho Nkuba akibwira ngo ntabwo ibyo avuga Gikeli abyumva. Gikeli yibera ahongaho, iminsi munani basezeranye igeze, Gikeli aranyaruka ajya mu irembo kwa Nkuba. Arakorora. Ati “Yemwe abo kwa Nkuba?”  Nkuba ati “Yee! Nimwumve abo bantu, sinzi umpamagaye.” Gikeli arakorora, ati “Erega ni jye Gikeli. Umuhoro wanjye warawutindanye, none narinje kuwureba.” Undi ati “Koko iminsi ibaye miremire. Ariko utahe usubire imuhira, nanone iminsi ni umunani, uwa cyenda, nkakuzanira umuhoro wawe.” Gikeli yisubirira mu kibero cy’inzu. Nkuba yibera aho. Atarisha ibitoki birashya, barenga. Inzoga imaze gushya, abwira umugaragu we ati “Genda ujye guca ibihunda, uzane n’urutete utekere inzoga tugende, nshyire Gikeli umuhoro we ataziyahura.” Ubwo Gikeli aramwumva. Umugaragu aragenda azana ibihunda n’urutete araza atekera inzoga. Uko atekera Gikeli yiterera muri rwa rutete. Noneho umugaragu arikorera, Nkuba arakubita, umugaragu na shebuja bitura ku isi. Umugaragu aragenda atura inzoga mu nzu. Gikeli ava muri rwa rutete ajya ku buriri. Umugaragu asubira ku irembo asanga shebuja. Shebuja ati “Ese wahamagaye?”  Umugaragu ati “Nahamagaye databuja, ariko nta muntu wanyitabye.” Ngo agere ku irembo arongera arahamagara ati “Yemwe kwa Gikeli?” Gikeli ati “Yee! Arakorora. Nta muntu umpamagave ?”  Bati “Arahamagaye. Ni Nkuba waje kugutarurira umuhoro.” Gikeli abyuka vuba vuba, ati “Ni uko, ni uko. Ibitotsi ni umwana w’undi ga! Nari nsinziriye.” Aherako arabyuka, ajya mu kirambi. Arakorora, ati “Mbega mwanzaniye inzoga?”  Bati “Twakuzaniye inzoga y’ishimwe kandi twakuzaniye n’umuhoro wawe.”
Banywa inzoga. Barangije bamubwira imisango yayo. Birangiye Nkuba n’umugaragu we bisubirira mu ijuru, Gikeli asigara iwe n’umuhoro we. Si jye wahera hahera Umugani!

title: Menya zimwe mu nyito zihariye z’inka n’amata mu muco wa Kinyarwanda
