title: Ese wari uzi ibya Nyakibi w’i Nyarugenge wasuze mu misango? Inkomoko y’umugani Nyakibi ntirara bushyitsi!
content: Uyu mugani bawucira ku muntu utabasha kwihishira ngo yihe akabanga akagaragaza ingeso ze mbi naho adasanzwe agenda, aha niho bahera bavuga bati ‘burya koko nyakibi ntirara bushyitsi’. Wakomotse kuri Nyakibi wo mu bwanacyambwe mu Rwampara rwa Nyarugenge ahasaga mu 1400. Nkuko tubikesha igitabo ibirari by’insigamigani cyo mu 1986 ngo uyu mugabo nyakibi bikekwa ko yaba yarabayeho ku ngoma ya YUHI Gahima, uyu Nyakibi rero yari umugaragu wa Ruganintwari bukeye sebuja aza kumwohereza ku musabira umugeni kwa Sinayobye  i Nzaratsi, Nyakibi arakugendeye arara i Mushubati na Kanyarira bukeye asohora kwa Sinayobye no kwa Sinayobye aravunyisha abo asanze ku irembo baramuvunyishiriza aratambuka bararamukanya baramuzimanira yica akanyota ubundi ababwira ikimugenza ati “Ruganintwari yantumye ngo mwarabanye murashyingirana none yumvise ko ufite abakobwa arashaka kubasabamo umugeni. “ Sinayobye ntiyazuyaza amwemerera umugeni, ariko Nyakibi akagira ingeso ebyiri zari zaramubushabushe, gusuragura no kwiba! Nyakibi akiganira na Sinayobye n’umugore we(wa Sinayobye) ingeso iba iranze umusuzi uti “bwi” mu kandi kanya nabwo yongera gusura Sinayobye n’umugore we bararebana batangira kwiciranirana ijisho Nyakibi aba yababonye nk’ejo aratanguranwa abwira Sinayobye  ati” mu byo Ruganintwari yantumye icyo mwiciraniraho ijisho ntakirimo!” Mu gihe cyo kuryama Nyakibi bamusasira mu nzu y’abashyitsi mu gikari hamwe n’abandi ariko iyo nzu ikabamo inzoga, ijoro rijigije Nyakibi arabyuka ajya gushingamo umuheha aragotomera umunyenzoga nawe wari uryamye muri iyo nzu aba yamwumvishe aramwombokera aba amucetse urushyi barasakuza na ba nyiri urugo baraza bose batungurwa no gusanga ari ya ntumwa yaje kurambagiza. Nyakibi akubise amaso ba nyirurugo acika intege abasaba ko bamugirira ibanga ntibabibwire shebuja  maze bamubera imfura baramusezerera arataha. Asohoje ubutumwa ababwira ko umugeni bamumwemereye maze Ruganintwari ashaka inka n’inzoga aziha Nyakibi ngo ajye gusaba maze Nyakibi ageze i Nzaratsi arasaba baramwemerera, amaze gusaba nanone ararara kuko yari yaturutse kure. Ijoro rijigije ingeso iranga arabyuka ajya mu nkono y’inyama ariko asanga umunyagikari yaryamiye amajanja aba arombotse aramucakiye amuceka urushyi undi avuza induru basanga nanone ni Nyakibi noneho Sinayobye ntiyamwihanganira arategeka baramuboha bamushyira Ruganintwari amutumaho ati "Nyakibi yaraje bwa mbere aransurira arananyiba ndamwihanganira none yongeye kugaruka aranyiba none rero Ruganirwari nguhaye umugeni ariko singuhaye kunyiba.” Nyakibi baramushorera bamugejeje kwa Ruganintwari bamutekerereza byose maze avuma Nyakibi ati ‘Genda shahu Nyakibi nturara bushyitsi!’ Inkuru ikwira hose Nyakibi aba iciro ry’imigani atyo.

title: Inkomoko y’insigamigani ‘Urugiye kera ruhinyuza intwari’
content: Uyu mugani bawuca iyo babonye uwari intwari ageze aho akagamburuzwa n’ibibazo by’urukurikirane yabona bimucikiyeho akava ku izima nibwo bamugarukira bashaka kumvikanisha ko ntako atari yagize bati “Burya koko urugiye kera ruhinyuza intwari”. Uyu mugani  wakomowe kuri Mpongo  umusaza w’i Bwanamukali mu bashumba (ubu ni mu karere ka Huye) ahasaga mu w’i 1800. Mpongo yabayeho ku ngoma ya Yuhi Gahindiro ahaba intwari cyane ubutwari bwe burambukiranya buva ku ngoma imwe bufata n’indi ariyo ya Mutara  Rwogera, abarundi bakamutera ubutitsa bashaka kumunyagira inka akabarwanya akabatsinda bidasubirwaho kugeza bazinutswe urugo rwe. Umunsi umwe abarundi bitwikira igicuku bajya gutera u Rwanda ariko muri iryo joro Mpongo akaba yari yaraye atongana n’umugore we maze aramuhunga ajya kwigandurira imyambi bwenda gucya umuhungu wa Mpongo ajya mu bwiherero aba akubise amaso igitero cy’abarundi arakimirana aragaruka abwira se noneho ko igitero kije ari simusiga ati” Mpongo dawe noneho izacu(inka) ziranyazwe” Mpongo aramubaza ati” Mu baduteye harimo na nyoko? Umwana ati Oya. None se mama yaba yarageze i Burundi ryari?” Mpongo ati “ Subirayo undebere neza witonze mbona agira ubucakura bwinshi  wasanga yaraye agezeyo”.  Ako kanya mukampongo aba arasohotse ati " Ariko Mpongo urubwa rwawe uzarugeza he?” Mpongo ati” Mbese burya uri hano?! Ahita ahumuriza umuhungu we ati mwana wanjye humura kuva nyoko atarimo ntawuri butunyagire inka.” Nkuko yakabivuze babaye bakihagera abarasira kubamara baramuhunga bajya gutera mu bashumba naho ntibyabahira baraneshwa. Nyuma yuko babonye ko Mpongo ari igihangange nta wamutsimbura ngo abe yamutwara utwe bigira inama yo kumutega iminsi ageze mu zabukuru bagaruka kumunyaga ariko kuko nta mbaraga yari agifite yirinda kubarwanya arahagarara arebera uko bagabagabana inka ze arababwira ati” Nimuzijyane muragatsindwa n’uruhanga rwa Rwogera nta kindi!” Bumvise ayo magambo ye baramuseka bati "Genda Mpongo urashaje koko, nta gacumu nta gaheto(utanarwanye) bararebana abakuru muribo bagira impuhwe bati kera agishoboye yaraturwanyaga akadutsinda none tumufatiranye n’izabukuru aturetse nta no kurwana mureke tumusubize inka ze kuko ibi ntibyaba ari ukunyaga byaba ari ugushimuta. “ Nuko Rubanda rwo muri ako gace rutangarira ukuntu Mpongo wajyaga arwana n’ababisha akabanesha yari yemeye kunyagwa nta no kurwana baheraho bavuga bati” Burya koko urugiye kera ruhinyuza intwari” umugani ukwira igihugu cyose abantu babona ugamburujwe n’iminsi bakagira bati burya koko urugiye kera ruhinyuza intwari. Inkuru dukesha: Ibirari by’insigamigani 1980 page 191

title: Impaka kuri Bridal Shower/ Kitchen party bivugwa ko isenya aho kubaka n’uburyo kera yakorwaga
content: Bridal Shower ni igikorwa kigezweho cyane muri iki gihe gikorwa n’abagore ndetse n’abakobwa mu rwego rwo gusezera no kugira inama umukobwa uba agiye gushyingirwa bakanamugenera impano. Ariko nyamara nubwo ubusobanuro bw’iki gikorwa bugaragara nk’aho ari bwiza ndetse ari ingirakamaro, kuri ubu abenshi usanga batabivugaho rumwe kubera imico imwe n’imwe igenda yinjiramo. Mu kiganiro nyungurana bitekerezo cyabaye mu mpera z’icyumweru gishize cyari gifite intego yo gushaka umuti ku bibazo byugarije umuryango nyarwanda ariko ahanini bishingiye ku bukwe abafashe ijambo bose banenze uburyo Bridal Shower ikorwamo nubwo ngo ibisa n’ibi na kera byakorwaga nkuko Musenyeri Smaragde Mbonyintege yabivuze ariko ko agendeye ku byo yari amaze kumva ndetse nibyo asanzwe yumva bivugwa kuri Bridal Shower asanga bihabanye cyane nuko byagakozwe aho we avuga ko byari bikwiye gushyigikira umwari anaterwa akanyabugabo aho kumuca intege bamwumvisha ko ariko zubakwa ndetse ngo zirara zishya. Ku bwa Madame Marie Immacule ngo Bridal Shower yateye ubu ni igikorwa cy’ubutekamutwe kigamije gusa kwaka intwererano ku ngufu. Naho ku bwa minisitiri w’Umuco na Siporo, Madame Uwacu Julienne we ngo asanga ibivugirwa muri Bridal Shower bidakwiye kuko nta mpampu yo gukura umwari umutima umubwira ko asanze igisimba ndetse ko aho agiye nta kiza azasangayo nyamara bizwi neza ko udashobora kohereza umwana wawe ahantu habi, bivuze ngo ibyo baba bavuga ni ibinyoma. Ese ibyitwa Bridal Shower ubu, kera byakorwaga bite? Mu gushaka kumenya ibirambuye ku byakorwaga kera bigereranywa na Bridal Shower y’ubu, Kigali post yanyarukiye mu majyepfo y’u Rwanda, akarere ka Muhanga, umurenge Cyeza, akagali ka Makera umudugudu wa Binunga aho twaganiriye n’umukecuru Mukasimisi Salama ufite imyaka iyingayinga 90 atubwira uko mu bihe bye byabaga byifashe. Yagize ati “ Twebwe kera gusezera k’umukobwa no kumugira inama byabaga mu byiciro bitandukanye bwa mbere abakobwa b’urungano rwawe n’abagore birumvikana bakuruta barimo nabo mufitanye amasano barazaga bakakuganiriza bakagira inama n’impanuro baguha abarira bakarira ubundi bagataha hagakurikiraho abo mu muryango n’inshuti zabo babaga barimo n’abagabo nka ba so wanyu ba nyokorome n’abandi, icyo abo bagabo babaga baje kugufasha s’ikindi rero bakugira inama z’uburyo ugomba kubaha sobukwe ndetse n’imico myinshi y’abagabo.” Mukasimisi yakomeje agira ati “Ubwo hahitaga hakurikiraho ba nyogosenge na ba nyoko wanyu noneho bakubwiraga bakakubwira n’akari imurori bakubwira uko ugomba kwitwara k’umugabo n’ibindi.” Tumubajije ku bijyanye n’inama zitangwa ubu, cyane cyane bakura abakobwa umutima bababwira ko umugabo ari umwana w’undi kandi ko abagabo ari inyamaswa yagize ati “Ibyo ntabwo ari inzaduka kuko na kera na kare byahozeho ariko kandi banakuremaga agatima bakubwira ko abagabo bose atari bamwe naho kugutera ubwoba ho babaga bagengeye kuri wa mugani uvuga ko ushaka kubaka nyina amara amazu babaga bashaka kukumvisha ko umugabo ushatse hari ubwo yaba atandukanye na so mu mico bityo ntakubanire nkuko so yabaniye umubyeyi wawe(nyoko) ariko ntabwo babaga bagamije kugukura umutima da!” Twakomereje mu majyepfo tugana hafi y’umujyi wa Nyanza tuganira na Samila Dada uzi byinshi kuri Bridal Shower y’ubu cyane ko yitabiriye nyinshi ndetse n’iye ikitabirwa, yagize ati “Ubu hari nubwo itegurwa nyiri kuyikorerwa atabizi byapangiwe mu magroupe ya Wats’App bakabimukorera nka surprise!” Tumubajije ku nama zitangirwamo zitavugwaho rumwe nawe yagize ati “ Nanjye hari ibyo mbona bivugirwamo bigasa no kurengera kuko bizana umwuka utari mwiza bigahita binagira icyo bihindura ku buryo umukobwa yafatagamo umugabo agiye gushaka yego byinshi bivugirwamo biba ari iby’ingirakamaro ariko duke tutajyanye tuvugiwemo hari ubwo twangiza byinshi.” Uyu mubyeyi yaduhaye urugero nk’aho babwira umukobwa ko atagomba kwizera umugabo ijana ku ijana, kuko ababa bagira inama umukobwa baba baramutanze muri urwo rugendo rw’ubuzima ahita abifata nk’ihame ugasanga atangiye kumwishisha kandi mbere y’izo nama ibintu byari amahoro masa.

title: Inkomoko y’insigamugani umugabo mbwa aseka imbohe
content:
Umugabo mbwa aseka imbohe. Uyu mugani bawuca iyo babonye umuntu usekera cyangwa agashinyagurira undi ugeze mu y’abagabo nibwo bagira bati burya koko umugabo mbwa aseka imbohe. Rugaju rero wari umutoni kwa Gahindiro wisanzuraga akidagadura akanakora icyo ashatse mu ngoma ya Gahindiro byaje kumukomerera nyuma y’aho shebuja Gahindiro atangiye kuko haje igihuha kivuga ko Rugaju rwa Mutimbo ariwe waroze umwami hose biremerwa kugera n’ibwami ariko babura aho bamuhera bamutanga ngo akanirwe urumukwiye kuko yari umunyamaboko cyane. Nkuko bisanzwe nyuma y’uko umwami atanze yagombaga kugira umusimbura ku ngoma. Igihe cyo kwimika Rwogera cyarageze indagu zigaragaza ko agomba kuzimikirwa i Musambira kw’ibuye rya Ruyumba ariko babihisha Rugaju. Baragiye barahubaka, bimika rwogera bamwita Mutara nkuko byagomba. Rugaju akibimenya byaramubabaje cyane ajya i bwami kubaza impamvu bimitse umwami bakabimuhisha akigerayo baba baramufashe bamutaye ku wa kajwiga(Baramuboha) Rubanda bakimara kumva irigwiriye Rugaju wahoze ari umutoni i bwami barashika baza gushungera bamunnyega ariko Rugaju wari umuhanga w’akataraboneka mu gusubiza neza kandi binyuze ubwenge bamubwira bamunnyega akabasubiza abanegura. Mu kivunge cy’abari bashungereye havuyemo Rufari rwa Nturo atangira kumutuka ati ” Ceceka uri imbwa wa mbwa we! Haraho Gahindiro yagutonesheje ukamwitura kumuroga?”, Rugaju ati” Icyampa ngo Semukanya(rimwe mu mazina ya Gahindiro) azuke iyi ngoyi yayinkuraho akayiboha uwayimboshye. Najyaga kumuroga se ngo undi wimye ampe iki nari naraburiye kwa Gahindiro?” Burya rero koko ngo akazapfa kabungira akazakica nibwo haje umugabo aba azanye ikibando atangira guhuragura Rugaju nawe arataka wa mugabo aramuseka cyane ati “ umva ngo kirataka.”, maze mu magambo yuje ubwenge Rugaju yari asanganywe ati “Koko umugabo mbwa aseka imbohe, iyaba hari hambere ngo nsabe i bwami bakubohe maze wowe kuko uri ntwari wihanganire ingoyi we gutaka!”
Akivuga ibyo abari aho bararakara basaba Nyiramavugo(umugabekazi) gutanga uwo mugabo nawe ntiyazuyaza aramutanga. Ibirari by’Insigamigani 1980

title: Rukara rwa Bishingwe na Bisangwa bya Rugombituri bafite ubahagarariye mu Ntwari z’igihugu! Uwo ninde?
content:
Ba Rukara rwa Bishingwe, Bisangwa bya Rugombituri ndetse n’abandi bagiye bakora ibikorwa by’ubutwari bafite ubahagarariye mu ntwari z’igihugu. Ibi byatangajwe na Nicolas Rwaka, umuyobozi w’ishami ry’Ubushakashatsi mu Rwego rushinzwe Intwari z’Igihugu, Imidari n’Impeta by’Ishimwe(CHENO), ubwo yaganiraga n’abanyeshuri bo muri ICK(Institut Catholique de Kabgayi) kuri uyu wa kane talki 02 Ugushyingo 2017 ku byerekeye intwari z’igihugu.

 Rwaka Nicolas/Foto:Internet  Yatangiye asobanura zimwe mu ntwari zabayeho zakoze byinshi zikanitanga ngo tube dufite U Rwanda dufite ubu, avuga kuri Nyabunyana indagu zagaragaje ko u Rwanda ruzasenywa ariko rukaza gutabarwa n’umwami uzaba yarabundiye i Karagwe biba ngombwa ko Nyabunyana yitanga ajya gushaka i Karagwe ngo igihe nikigera indagu zikera Umwami azabone umwakira muri make asa n’uwisanga. Ibi ni nabyo byaje kubaho nyuma yaho mu Rwanda hadutse intambara maze Ndahiro II Cyamatare agahungishiriza Ruganzu Ndoli kwa nyirasenge Nyabunyana nkuko indagu zari zarabigaragaje. Yavuze kuri Robwa ndetse n’abandi batandukanye maze anatangaza ko bimwe mu bimubabaza kugeza ubu biramutse bitanakosowe bishobora kurangira umuco w’ubutwari ukendereye harimo kuba abana babyiruka batigishwa icyo ubutwari aricyo ngo bakure banafata ingero ku ntwari z‘igihugu ahubwo  ugasanga umwana akuze yiyumvamo Rihanna, Messi n’ibindi byamamare mpuzamahanga, ariko wamubaza imwe mu ntwari z’igihugu azi akirenga akarahira ati: “ibyo nabimenya nte?!” Uyu muyobozi yakomeje avuga ko impamvu abana batemenya amateka y’intwari z’igihugu atari amakosa yabo ahubwo amakosa akorwa n’abananirwa kubaha ibikenewe(amateka y’izo ntwari) maze babura ibyari ngombwa bakajya kwshakira ibitabagoye, yakomeje agira ati: “ Njya ntangara nk’iyo mbonye bimwe mu bigo by’amashuri hano mu Rwanda harimo amafoto ya ba Patrice Rumumba ba Thomas Sankara bituma nibaza nti umwana azagira amatsiko yo kumenya amateka ya Rwigema abikuye he? Ntabwo azashishikazwa na Rwigema atazi ahubwo azashishikazwa n’aya Sankara umuhora imbere rero ibyo ni bimwe mu byo tugomba gukosora ibyacu bikitirirwa abacu kugirango n’abana bacu bazakure bazi neza ko dufite intwari kandi bakure baharanira gukora nka zo.” Mu mwanya w’ibibazo habajijwe aho bamwe mu bumvikana nk’intwari z’igihugu zabayeho mbere ndetse no mu gihe cy’ubukoroni barimo abo ba Robwa, Nyabunyana, Rukara rwa Bishingwe na ba Bisangwa bya Rugombituri baba babarizwa mu byiciro tuzi by’intwari birimo Imena, Imanzi ndetse n’icyiciro cy’Ingenzi kitarashyirwamo umuntu n’umwe. 

 Rukara rwa Bishingwe yabanje kuboheshwa iminyururu n’abazungu mbere y’uko anyongwa  Mu gusubiza, Rwaka yavuze ko intwari itemezwa n’umuntu umwe kandi ko hari amakuru menshi kandi atarimo amakabyankuru akenerwa kugirango umuntu ashyirwe mu ntwari bityo bakiri kwiga ku makuru bagenda babona kuri buri umwe muri abo nubwo biba bigoranye ariko mu gihe batarabona amakuru ya ngombwa ngo ubu bahagarariwe n’umusirikare utazwi kuko aba ahagarariye buri wese wakoze  iby’ubutwari ariko akaba atarahabwa icyiciro kihariye bitewe wenda n’amakuru ataraboneka ahagije kuri we. Twabibutsa ko intwari z’igihugu ziri mu byiciro bitatu aribyo Imena, Imanzi ndetse n’Ingenzi kugeza ubu iki kiciro cy’ingenzi kikaba kitarashyirwamo Intwari n’imwe naho mu cy’iciro cy’Imena hakaba harimo abanyeshuri 47 b’i Nyange, Uwiringiyimana Agatha, Mutara III Rudahigwa, Rwagasana Micheal na Niyitegweka Felecite naho mu ntwari z’Imanzi ho hakaba habarizwamo M G Fred Gisa Rwigema ndetse n’umusirikare utazwi.

title: Imigani y’imigenurano(IGICE GISOZA): Dukomereze ku migani itangizwa na ‘U, V, W, Y na Z’ maze twiyibutse tuniyungure ubumenyi

title: Miss Belgique: Gafotozi yanze kubafotota bambaye bikini -IMPAMVU
content:
Gafotozi w’irushanwa rya Nyampinga w’Ububiligi(Miss Belgique) yahakanye aratsemba yanga gufotora abakobwa bahatanira ikamba rya Nyampinga w’iki gihugu bambaye bikini. Ibi byabereye mu gihugu cya Misiri aho abakobwa 30 bahatanira ikamba rya Nyampinga w’igihugu cy’Ububiligi berekeje, ngo bafatwe amafoto azakoreshwa mu kwamamariza ibigo bitandukanye ariko abategura iki gikorwa bagowe cyane n’umukobwa wanze kubafata amafoto bambaye utwenda tw’imbere(bikini).

 Gafotozi Selina De Maeyer we ni uku aba yiyambariye  Uyu gafotozi yasobanuye ko impamvu nyamukuru yamubujije gufotora aya mafoto ari uko yemera Imana bityo akaba yumva hagombye guhabwa agaciro ubwiza bw’imbere kurusha ubugaragara inyuma bityo ko adashobora kwifata ngo afotore abakobwa bambaye imyenda iri hafi ya ntayo.

 Ngo kuri we bene ubu bwiza bugaragara inyuma ntabwo aribwo bwakagombye guhabwa agaciro  Aganira n’ikinyamakuru Sudpresse uyu gafotozi witwa Selina De Maeyer yagize ati “Njye ndifuza kwerekana ubwiza bw’imbere ba nyampinga bifitemo. Sinanshaka gufotora abakobwa bambaye bikini kubera imyemerere yanjye, bitandukanye n’umurongo ngenderaho. Baba basa n’abambaye ubusa, sinshobora kubifotora. Umubiri w’umuntu ni mutagatifu. Ikibazo kiri mu isi yose nuko abantu basigaye babona ari nk’ibisanzwe kugenda bambaye imyenda y’imbere gusa.” Imyemerere ya Selina iraremereye cyane dore ko mu myaka 3 cyangwa 4 iri imbere yifuza guhabwa uburenganzira bwo kwiberaho burundu ari isugi akiyegurira gukunda Imana gusa.

title: AMATEKA-Uko umwami yimaga ingoma mu Rwanda
content:
Amateka agaragaza ko abami bose b’u Rwanda bakomokaga mu muryango umwe wo mu bwoko bw’Abanyiginya. Iyo miterere y’inkomoko y’abami ikavuga ko umwami iyo yatangaga yagombaga gusimburwa n’umuhungu we, bityo bityo kugeza ku ndunduro. Ikindi kivugwa k’ubwami ni uko ngo umwana wagombaga gusimbura se ku ngoma yagombaga kuba yaravukanye imbuto nk’uko Abiru(abanyabwenge b’i Bwami) babibwiraga rubanda. Hari abavuga ko bitumvikana neza uko byagendaga kugira ngo uwo mwana w’umwami avukane imbuto, ariko ibyo byari amabanga y’ubwiru nk’uko iyo nyito yabwo iri. Umwami wimye yagiraga izina ry’ubwami Umwami wimye yagiraga izina ry’ubwami hakiyongeraho n’izina rye bwite yiswe n’ababyeyi be. Umwami yahitagamo izina uko abyumva, akiha amatwara y’imitegekere uko abishaka, agashyiraho abatware b’intara z’igihugu ab’ingabo, ab’ubutaka n’abandi, akabikora uko abyumva ntawe agishije inama. Ahasaga mu mwaka wa 1576 kugeza mu wa 1609, ku ngoma y’umwami w’i Gasabo Kigeli II Nyamuheshera niwe washyizeho umurongo ngenderwaho ntakuka w’ubutegetsi bwa Cyami. Ashyiraho itonde ry’amazina y’ubwami uko azajya akurikirana ku ngoma, n’amatwara y’abo bami ndetse n’igihe izina iri n’iri rizaba rigezweho. Iryo tonde ryabaga riteye ritya:
*MUTARA, KIGELI, MIBAMBWE, YUHI
*CYILIMA, KIGELI, MIBAMBWE, YUHI Ni ukuvuga ko buri zina ry’ubwami ryagarukaga buri ngoma eshatu, usibye Mutara na Cyilima zagendaga zisimburana.
Ayo mazina yabaga afite icyo asobanura kijyanye n’amatwara n’inshingano umwami uzitwa iryo zina agomba kugenderaho. Ayo mazina yasobanuraga gutya ukurikije amatwara yayo nuko akurikirana. 1.Harebwe uko Kigeli II Nyamuheshera yagiye ayakurikiranya habanzaga MUTARA aribyo bivuga “ Umwami w’Amatungo ”. Iryo zina yarisimburanagaho na CYILIMA, ariko bose intego n’amatwara yabo ari amwe. title: Mu Rwanda hagiye kubera ibirori byo kumurika imisatsi n’inyogosho zinyuranye
content: Ku nshuro ya mbere mu Rwanda hagiye kubera ibirori byo kumurika imisatsi n’inyogosho zitandukanye zo ku mutwe. Ni ibirori bigamije gufasha abanyarwandakazi by’umwihariko kubumbatira ubwiza bwabo, bikaba byiswe ‘Kigali Natural Hair Show &Beauty Expo’. Natural Hair Show &Beauty Expo ni uburyo bwo kwerekana imideri y’imisatsi butari bumenyerewe hano mu Rwanda kuko hari hamenyerewe kwerekana ahanini imideri y’imyenda, ariko ibi birori byo bizaba byerekana amoko(styles) menshi y’imisatsi kandi atandukanye umuntu ashobora kurimba haba mu bukwe, mu birori bisanzwe, kuri piscine n’ahandi. Nk’uko twabitangarijwe na Ntawirema Celestine ushinzwe gukurikirana itegurwa n’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’iki gikorwa ngo ibi birori bizamara iminsi ibiri aho bizatangira tariki ya 3 Ugushyingo bisozwe bukeye bwaho tariki 4 Ugushyingo, 2017, aho ibijyanye n’igice cya Expo bizajya bitangira saa mbili za mugitondo(8am) kugeza saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba(6:00am), naho ku munsi wanyuma ibirori bizatangira saa moya z’umugoroba(7pm) bisozwe saa yine(10pm). Ntawirema Celestine aganira na Kigali Post yagize ati “Ku munsi wa mbere n’uwa kabiri hazajya haba Expo(imurika) ku buryo abantu bazajya baza bakagura ndetse banashaka bakabashyira muri Salon bakabatunganya. Ikindi hazaba hari amarushmwa ku munsi wa kabiri yo kogosha no gutunganya imisatsi, naho ibirori nyirizina byo gusoza iki gikorwa bizatangira saa moya tariki ya 04 Ugushyingo.” Ibi birori bizahuza abanyarwanda, abanyakenya, abagande, abanyamerika n’abanyafurikay’epfo byateguwe na Alexianrdria abinyujije muri Bella Salon & Comestics. Ikindi kizanga ibi birori ni amarushanwa y’abantu bafite imisatsi cyangwa se inyogosho nziza gusumbya abandi, abogoshi beza, umuziki walive n’ibindi. Tubibutse ko ibi birori bizabera kuri The Mirror Hotel aho ku munsi wa mbere kwinjira bizaba ari ubuntu, naho mu birori byo ku munsi wa nyuma bizaba ari 10,000frw ku muntu na 15,000frw mu myanyaya VIP.

title: Ruhango: Ikigo cy’amashuri kiravugwamo abakobwa 40 batwite, diregiteri agahamya ko ari 5
content:
Mu murenge wa Kinazi ho mu karere ka Ruhango mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo hamaze iminsi humvikana inkuru ivuga ko abanyeshuri b’abakobwa abagera kuri 40 bo mu Rwunge rw’Amashuri rwa Nyarugenge baba batwite. Iyi nkuru yo gutwitwa kw’aba banyeshuri yasakaye cyane nyuma yuko bamwe muri bo bafatiwe mu kabari. Nubwo nta gihamya ifatika yari ihari ariko burya ngo nta nduru ivugira ubusa ku musozi ari nayo mpamvu Kigali Post yasuye iki kigo maze Nsanzimana Jean Bosco umuyobozi wacyo aduha amashirakinyoma. Uyu muyobozi yahakanye amakuru avuga ko abagera kuri 40 bo muri iki kigo cye baba batwite, cyakora ahamya ko mu minsi yashize bo bakekaga ko abafite iki kibazo baba ari 10 gusa nyuma y’iperereza abagera kuri 5 baba aribo basanga batwite. Bwana Nsanzimana yagize ati "Bon! Ntabwo aribyo harimo gukabya kuko no mu bakekwaga ntabwo 40 bageramo. Hakekwaga 10 ariko nyirizina abatwite ni batanu banabyiyemerera."

 Nsanzimana Jean Bosco, umuyobozi wa GS Nyarugenge  Umuyobozi w’iri shuri kandi yavuze ko atazi neza impamvu nyayo itera iki kibazo dore ko ngo bo ntako baba batagize ngo babagire inama ndetse agira n’icyo asaba ababyeyi dore ko abanyeshuri bose biga bataha iwabo. Yagize ati "Byagorana gupfa kumenya ikibitera ariko nkeka ko ari ukutareba kure. Ikigo ntako kiba kitagize ariko kandi ababyeyi bakirereramo bajye batwumva baniyumvishe ko ntako tuba tutagize pe! Cyane ko ushobora gusanga muri abo batwite nta numwe wayitwariye mu kigo kuko biga bataha." Diregiteri Nsanzimana yavuze ko ishuri ayobora ryatangiye ingamba zo kurwanya izi nda zitateganyijwe mu bari baryigamo aho bifashishije n’akarere. Ati "Turi gukora inama nyinshi hamwe n’abanyeshuri, ubuyobozi bw’umurenge ndetse n’akarere bari kudufasha kuganira n’abana gusa ntituganiriye nabo kubera icyo kibazo gusa, kuko ni umuco dusanganywe kubegera tukaganira nabo." Urwunge rw’amashuri rwa Nyarugenge rwubatswe ahagana 1960 ari ishuri ribanza haza kongerwaho icyiciro rusange(9 years basic education) 2009 naho 2012 rugirwa uburezi bw’ibanze bw’imyaka 12.

title: Nyuma y’imyaka isaga 600 mu Nduga haracyagaragara bimwe mu bisigisigi by’Umwami Mashira -TWAHASUYE
content:
Mashira wa Nkuba ya Sabugabo, umwami wa Nduga y’ababanda wari ufite umukobwa w’agatangaza uwo bose bari guhigamira agatambuka iyo amarushanwa ya ba nyampinga tubona ubu ajya kuba yari ariho muri biriya bihe, uwo ni Bwiza bwa Mashira budashira irora n’irongorwa. Uyu Mashira niwe wabaye umwami wa nyuma wa Nduga kuko akimara gutanga hahise homekwa ku Rwanda. Hamwe mu duce twa Nduga twasuye ubu ni mu ntara y’Amajyepfo, akarere ka Ruhango, umurenge wa Kinazi, akagali ka Rubona, umudugudu wa Kagazii, ahakigaragara bimwe mu bimenyetso by’uyu mwami. Ntabwo byoroshye kuba wapfa kugira uwo ubona ufite byinshi azi kuri Mashira cyane ko nta bakuze benshi babarizwa muri biriya bice n’abahari abenshi bavuga ko nta na gito bazi kuri Mashira kuko bose bavuga ko ari bato ugereranije n’igihe Mashira yabereyeho ariko umukambwe witwa Munyakazi Francois w’imyaka 97 nkuko ibimuranga bibyerekana nubwo we avuga ko irenga yemeye kutubwira ibyo azi kuri Mashira. Uyu mukabwe avuga ko Mashira yari atuye mu bice bya Nyanza y’ubu, akaba yari umwami w’igitangaza wakundaga rubanda ariko kandi ngo ntabwo yakundaga intambara. Tumubajije ikintu kidasanzwe cyamugiraga igitangaza, umusaza Munyakazi yabaye nk’uwikanze yeguka ku gatebe yari yegamyeho maze mu magambo ye asubiza agira ati “ Kera mbyiruka mu bitaramo sogokuru yajyaga atubwira ko ngo se(sogokuruza) yajyaga amubwira ko ngo Mashira wo mu Nduga yagiraga amagini, ngo ntazindi nkuru birirwagamo mu Ndorwa, uretse ko ngo nka ba Ruganzu, Mashira nawe iyo yabishakaga yicaraga ahantu nko ku rutare ikibuno cye kikahishushanya kuko ngo rwahitaga rufobagana!“ 


 Intebe(urutare) ishushanyijeho igisoro ndetse n’aho Mashira yari atetse(yicaye) umunsi ahanga iriba  Mu bindi Munyakazi Francois uvuga ko ibisekuruza bye byabaga mu Mutara w’Indorwa yatubwiye nuko ngo rimwe Mashira yagiye guhiga maze abahigi barembywa n’inyota nuko yaka umwe icumu arizibukira arihamya mu rutare hahita havamo amazi atajya akama kugeza magingo aya.


 Aho Mashira yateye icumu abatuye mu mpinga ya Rubona baracyahavoma  Agasozi iryo riba rya Mashira ririho kiswe Akamashira. Twabibutsa kandi ko icyahoze ari Nduga ubu ari igice kinini cyo mu ntara y’Amajyepfo kigizwe na Muhanga, Kamonyi, Ruhango na tumwe mu duce twa Huye na Nyanza. 

 Agasozi kitiriwe Mashira kitwa Akamashira  Mashira rero bivugwa ko yaje kuzira kwa kwiringira kwibeshya kuko yabeshywe umubano na Mibambwe I Sekarongoro I Mutabazi bakanashyingirana Mibambwe arongora Bwiza bwa Mashira naho Mashira we arongora Nyirantorwa wa Mibambwe, isano yari hagati ya Mashira na Mibambwe yo yasaga n’idafututse kuko buri umwe muri bo yari umukwe akaba na sebukwe w’undi mu gihe kimwe. Iyo sano ntiyari ikanganye kuko ntiyabujije Mibambwe kwivugana Mashira umukwe we akaba na sebukwe.  Inkuru dukesha ikiganiro twagiranye na Francois Munyakazi ndetse n’igitabo Inganji Kalinga 1943 cya Alex Kagame.

title: Amateka ya Gafuku, umupadiri wa mbere w’umunyarwanda wabayeho mu mateka
content:
Mu mwaka ushize ku ya 07 Ukwakira 2017 ni bwo kiliziya gatolika yo mu Rwanda yizihije Yubile y’imyaka 100 y’Ubusaserdoti mu Rwanda aho bibukaga abapadiri babiri b’abanyarwanda ba mbere babayeho mu mateka ari bo Padiri GAFUKU Baritazari na Padiri REBERAHO Donati bahawe ubupadiri ku wa 07 Ukwakira 1917. Muri iyi nkuru twifuje gusangiza abasomyi bacu amwe mu mateka yaranze Padiri GAFUKU Baritazari, tunabasezeranya ko nyuma y’aya mateka tuzanagaruka no ku mateka ya mugenzi we Padiri Reberaho Donati.

Perezida Paul Kagame yifatanije na Kiliziya Gatolika kwizihiza iyi Yubile y’imyaka 100 y’Ubusasaridoti mu birori byabereye kuri stade ya Seminari Nkuru ya Kabgayi  Ibice by’ingenzi by’ubuzima bwa Padiri Gafuku Baritazari  GAFUKU yavutse mu mwaka wa 1885 ku ngoma y’umwami RWABUGIRI. Ni mwene Kamurama na Nyirahabimana, yavukiye muri misiyoni ya Zaza muri Diyosezi ya Kibungo y’ubu. 

Padiri Baritazari Gafuku Amateka ye avuga ko akiri muto, GAFUKU yarwaye cyane, umunsi umwe ababyeyi be baza gukeka ko yapfuye maze bamujugunya mu gishanga. Aho niho ku bw’amahirwe abamisiyoneri bamutoraguye maze bamugira umwe mu banyeshuri babo. Yakurikiye inyigisho za gatigisimu muri misiyoni ya Zaza ariko abatirizwa i Mibirizi(Cyangugu) afite imyaka 18 y’amavuko. Yiragije mutagatifu Balitazari, umwe mu bami batatu bagiye kureba Umwana Yezu i Batalahamu. Mu wa 1904, Musenyeri Yozefu HIRITI yimuriwe muri Vicariyati nshya ya Kivu yari ihuje u Rwanda, u Burundi n’igice kimwe cya Tanzaniya (Buha na Bugufi), ashyira icyicaro cyayo mu Rwanda afata n’icyemezo cyo kugarura abaseminari b’abanyarwanda iwabo. Abo baseminari bageze i Kabgayi mu wa 1913 maze bahahurira n’abari bamaze umwaka umwe i Nyaruhengeli (Kansi). Mbere yo guhabwa ubusudiyakoni Gafuku yakoreye umwaka w’igeragezwa(probation) muri misiyoni ya Kabgayi. Yahawe ubudiyakoni ku ya 08/10/1916, ahabwa ubupadiri hamwe na Donati Reberaho w’i save kuwa 07/10/1917, abuhererwa i Kabgayi abuhawe na Myr HIRITI.  Ubutumwa yakoze  Amaze guhabwa ubupadiri, Balitazari GAFUKU yatangiriye ubutumwa bwe mu iseminari nkuru ya Kabgayi. Yahashyiriwe kugira ngo abere barumuna be umuhamya w’uko kwiyegurira Imana mu nzira y’ubusaserdoti bishoboka ku banyarwanda. Nyuma y’ubwo butumwa mu iseminari yamazemo imyaka ibiri, Padiri Gafuku yahawe n’ubundi butumwa: Mu 1919 : Yahawe ubutumwa muri misiyoni ya Murunda (Diyosezi Nyundo)
Mu 1922 : Yoherejwe muri misiyoni ya Kabgayi
Mu 1925 : Yagarutse mu iseminari Nkuru nyuma y’uko kujya i Rulindo byanze.
Kuwa 17/12/1927 : Myr Lewo Klasi yahaye ubusaserdoti abarundi babiri ( Matiyasi BAZAHUHA na Gabriel HARUSHAKAMWE). Padiri Balitazari niwe wahawe ijambo ngo ashime izo ntore.
Mu 1930 : Padiri Gafuku yoherejwe muri misiyoni ya Mibilizi aho yabatirijwe.
Mu 1932 : Yagarutse i Kabgayi
Mu 1941 : Yahawe ubutumwa i Mugombwa ahakorera yubile y’imyaka 25 y’ubusaserdoti (1942) na yubile y’imyaka 40 (1957). Aha i Mugombwa, ni naho padiri Baritazari GAFUKU yarangirije ubuzima bwe bwa hano ku isi mu 1959 afite imyaka 74.  Urupfu rwa Padiri Gafuku  Mu gitondo cyo kuwa 15/04/1959, padiri Gafuku yakangutse atagishobora kuvuga kubera ko yari yaviriye mu bwonko. N’uko bamuha isakramentu ry’Ugusigwa kw’abarwayi maze bamujyana bwangu mu bitaro bya Astrida (Butare). Yamaze amezi abiri yose ari muri koma n’ubwo abaganga batahwemaga kumwitaho. Yaje koherezwa Usumbura (burundi) biba iby’ubusa ntihagira igihinduka ku buzima bwe. Bamugaruye i Astrida aho yitabiye Imana kuwa 14 Kamena 1959 ahagana 11h00 za mugitondo. Bukeye tariki 15/06/1959 Myr Andreya PERRAUDIN niwe wayoboye imihango yo kumushyingura i Mugombwa muri Diyosezi ya Butare. Padiri Gafuku yatabarutse u Rwanda rugeze ku basaseridoti 140 b’abanyarwanda barimo umwepiskopi wa mbere Myr Aloys BIGIRUMWAMI nawe wavukaga muri misiyoni ya Zaza.

Abakirisitu Gatolika bitabiriye umuhango wo kwizihiza Yubie y’imyaka 100 y’Ubusaseridoti mu Rwanda  Umurage wa Padiri Gafuku  Padiri Baritazari Gafuku yabaye indahemuka ku butumwa bwe bwa gisaserdoti mu myaka 42 yose yamaze akorera Nyagasani. Yaranzwe n’urukundo rwa gishumba. Yari afite impano yo kuvura indwara(yari umuvuzi gakondo). Yari n’umwanditsi(yanditse za broshire z’ikibonezamvugo cy’ikinyarwanda). Mu 1929 yanditse igitabo yise « Igitabo cy’abanyekori bo mu Rwanda » cyari kizwi ku izina rya Nyirambonera cyifashishwaga mu nyigisho zihabwa abana. Aya ni amwe mu mateka y’uyu mupadiri wafunguriye abandi amarembo. Mu gukora iyi nkuru tukaba twifashishije urubuga rwa Diyoseze ya Kibungo. Ijambo Perezida Paul Kagame yagejeje ku bitabiriye umuhango wo kwizihiza Yubile y’imyaka 100 u Rwanda rubonye abapadiri ba mbere ba bene gihugu

title: Yiswe ‘mayibobo’ ku muhanda, afashwa kuhava none ubu nawe arakataje yitura ineza abahasigaye
content:
Building Hope for Africa ni umuryango washingiwe muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ku gitekerezo cy’umunyarwanda Ngabonziza Philippe, wabaye ku muhanda imyaka isaga ibiri abifashijwemo n’umufasha we Christine Ngabonziza. Uyu muryango ugamije gufasha abana bo muri Afurika gutegura no kubaka ejo habo heza harangwa n’ibyishimo no kubakorera ubuvugizi bwose bushoboka. Ngabonziza Philippe yagize igitekerezo cyo gushinga uyu muryango nyuma y’uko yakuriye mu buzima bugoye bwa gipfubyi yisanzemo nyuma yo kubura ababyeyi be muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi akagenda arererwa mu miryango y’abagiraneza ndetse akaba yaranabaye ku muhanda.

 Ngabonziza Philippe aganiriza abana bafashwa na Building Hope For Africa
  Kigali Post iherutse kuganira n’uyu mugabo wari waje mu Rwanda mu mpera z’ukwezi gushize n’umufasha we aho bari baje gusura bamwe mu bana bafasha kwiga nyuma yo kubavana mu buzima bwo ku muhanda. “ Njyewe nabaye imfubyi, mba umwana wo ku muhanda iyo hataza kubaho  abagiraneza sinari kuhava wenda ariko narahavuye ndafashwa niyo mpamvu mfite inshingano zo gufasha nanjye.”, Ngabonziza Philippe asobanura impamvu yatekereje gushinga uyu muryango.


 Ubwo bari mu Rwanda basangiye n’abana bafasha kwiga hamwe n’abo bakuye ku muhanda  Ijya kurisha ihera ku rugo, nubwo bafite igitekerezo cyo gufasha abana babaye mu bice bitandukanye bya Afurika, ku ikubitiro bahereye mu Rwanda kuko ubushobozi bukiri buto. Ngabonziza Philippe  ati “ Umuryango wacu rero washinzwe ufite intego cyangwa se dushaka gufasha abana muri rusange, by’umwihariko abagenda bahura n’ibibazo bitandukanye cyane cyane ko muri Afurika hagenda haboneka ibibazo byinshi kandi abana nibo ba mbere bigiraho ingaruka nyamara mu by’ukuri nta ruhare na ruto baba bafite mu biba biri kuba, ni muri urwo twahisemo gukora umuryango wita ku bana bahura n’ibibazo bitandukanye.“ Yakomeje agira ati “Turacyari gukorana n’abanyarwanda gusa ariko turimo gushaka kwaguka tugakorana na diyasipora y’abanyafurika baba mu mahanga  tukabumvisha ibyo dukora, bakadufasha muri uru rugamba.”

 Uretse gufasha abana kwiga no kubavuza, banabigisha izindi mpano zihariye harimo gukina amakinamico n’indi mikino  Tumubajije niba hari umusaruro babona bamaze kugeraho kuva batangiza uyu muryango, Philippe yagize ati “ Biramutse ntacyo bimaze twaba twarahagaze, tumaze imyaka hafi 3 dutangiye gukora bino bintu, abana turabarihira ishuri, barajya kwiga, tubigisha kuvuga mu ruhame, iyo umwana abasha gukina ikinamico ahagaze imbere y’abantu ubwo ni ubushobozi, tubigisha kwihesha agaciro, tubigisha kuva ku muhanda, tubakorera n’ubuvugizi butandukanye.” Yongeyeho ati “ Icy’ingenzi dukora, tubarihira ishuri kuko umuntu wamuha amafaranga ariko amafaranga aragenda, ariko iyo uhaye umuntu ubumenyi arabugumana  ahubwo agahitamo uburyo abukoresha, yego ashobora kubukoresha nabi ariko ubumenyi bwo mu ishuri muri rusange ni inkingi ya mwamba nta muntu utabukeneye.”

 Aba bana bigisha abandi babinyujije mu butumwa buba bukubiye mu makinamico yabo
 Tumubajije aho bakura ubushobozi, yagize ati “ Uburyo tubonamo amafaranga dukora ibikorwa by’ubuvugizi tugatumira abantu tukababwira ibibazo abana bafite hanyuma tukabasaba ubufasha tugakusanya inkunga, amafaranga rero avuyemo niyo duha  imwe mu miryango y’abanyarwanda ikorera imbere mu gihugu akaba ariyo iyakoresha mu bikorwa bitandukanye. Aho dukura  ubushobozi , ni inshuti z’u Rwanda, ni abantu bakunda u Rwanda, ni abantu bakunda gufasha harimo nuko natwe ubwacu twikoramo tugaha abana.”

 Bafashe ifoto y’urwibutso  Tuganira n’uyu mugabo kandi twaboneyeho kumubaza uburyo yaje kwisanga ku muhanda n’uko yahavuye. Aha yavuze ko yisanze ku muhanda nyuma yo kuburira abayeyi be muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, aho yatangiye kugenda aba mu miryango ariko ubuzima ntibumworohere. Mu magambo ye yagize ati "Nyuma yo kubura ababyeyi nagiye mbana n’imiryango itandukanye y’abavandimwe n’abandi bari bazi ababyeyi banjye ariko hakabaho ibibazo by’ubushobozi ugasanga umuntu aragaburira abana nk’umunani(8) ugasanga hari ibibazo byinshi byagiye bituma rimwe na rimwe umuntu avuga ati ‘reka ngende njye gushaka ko hari icyo njye nakwigezaho’ ni muri ubwo buryo nisanze ku muhanda. Nahabye imyaka nk’ibiri, rimwe abanzi bakahankura nkongera nkahasubira kugeza ubwo mukuru wanjye wari waragiye kwiga yaje abasha kunkura muri ubwo buzima turahuza turabana nsubira http://kigalipost.com/Yiswe-mayibobo-ku-muhanda-afashwa-kuhava-none-ubu-nawe-aritura-ineza.htmlno mu ishuri.”

 Ngabonziza Philippe n’umufasha we Ngabonziza Christine mu mwaka wa 2014 ubwo bari basuye abana bafasha i Nyakinama mu Karere ka Musanze  Nyuma yo kuganira na Ngabonziza Philippe twanaganiriye n’umwe mu bana uyu muryango urimo ufasha kwiga nyuma yo kuva ku muhanda. Uyu mwana w’imyaka 10 y’amavuko ugeze mu mwaka wa 3 w’amashuri abanza yatubwiye ko Building Hope For Africa yagize uruhare rukomeye mu kumuhindurira ubuzima ndetse ko nawe yiteguye kuzafasha abandi bana namara kugira icyo ageraho. Naho Ndagijimana uhagarariye ADBEF, umwe mu miryango nyarwanda iharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu, iterambere n’imibereho myiza y’umuryango nyarwanda, uyu muryango ukaba ufashwa mu bikorwa byo gukura abana ku mahanda na Building Hope For Africa nawe yashimiye uyu muryango, anaboneraho gusaba buri wese kwita ku bana bo ku muhanda.

title: Rwagasana,Sibomana n’abandi bari bakurikiranyweho kunyereza umutungo wa ADEPR bambuwe ubupasitori
content:
Uwahoze ari umuvugizi mukuru wa ADEPR Sibomana Jean n’uwari umwungirije Tom Rwagasana kimwe n’abandi 4 bakurikiranyweho kunyereza umutungo w’iri torero bamaze kwamburwa ubupasitori. Nk’uko byagaragaye ku rukuta rwa Facebook rw’iri torero aba bantu uko ari 6 bose bambuwe burundu inshingano za gipasitori kubera impamvu z’imyitwarire mibi yabagaragayeho.
Kuri uru rukuta kandi bashyizeho n’amafoto y’amabaruwa bandikiwe kuri uyu wa gatanu tariki ya 6 Ukwakira, 2017, babwirwa ko inama ya Biro Nyobozi ya ADEPR yafashe umwanzuro wo kubahagarika burundu kuri izi nshingano kubera imyitwarire itari myiza yabagaragayeho.

 Iyi ni yo baruwa yandikiwe, Tom Rwagasana n’izabanda zikaba ari uku zimeze uretse ko hahinduwe amazina gusa 
Ku batabasha kuyisoma neza iyi baruwa iragira iti “Mwene Data. Dushingiye ku myitwarire mibi yakugaragayeho mu micungire y’umutungo w’itorero no kutaba inyangamugayo muri byo nkuko bigaragazwa na raporo y’igenzura ku mikoreshereze y’umutungo w’itorero ryacu rya ADEPR (External Forensic Audit Report), dushingiye kandi ku mwanzuro w’inama ya Biro Nyobozi ya ADEPR yateranye kuwa 05/10/2017, tubabajwe no kukumenyesha ko wambuwe inshingano za gipasitori muri ADEPR uhereye kuri iyi tariki 06/10/2017. Tukwifurije amahoro y’Imana.”

 Bishop Tom Rwagasana, ubu ntakiri pasitori muri ADEPR  Bishop Tom Rwagasana yari Umuvugizi wungirije akaba n’ushinzwe ubuzima bw’itorero rya ADEPR. Akurikiranywe hamwe na Bishop Sibomana Jean wari Umuvugizi, Mutuyemariya Christine wari ushinzwe ubutegetsi n’imari, Sindayigaya Theophile, Sebagabo Bernard, Niyitanga Straton na Gasana Valens. Bose barashinjwa ko hagati ya 2015 na 2017 banyereje 2 530 395 614 Frw. Aya akaba akomoka ku misanzu abakirisitu batanze ngo hishyurwe umwenda wa BRD urenga miliyari eshatu watanzwe ngo hubakwe Dove Hotel ya ADEPR. Uretse Christine utari umupasitori abandi bose bandikiwe amabaruwa bahagarikwa burundu kuri izi nshingano

title: Inkomo y’insigamugani ’ukenze rimwe ntabwo aba akimaze’ hamwe n’isomo dukuramo
content:
Uyu mugani bawuca iyo babonye umugore uhindutswe n’urushako nibwo bamuhumuriza bagira bati “ Humura uzabona undi kuko burya ucyenze rimwe ntabwo aba akimaze!”. Wakomotse kuri Gasharankwanzi ka Bureshyo ahagana mu mu mwaka wa 1800. Gasharankwanzi ubwo yari amaze kuba inkumi yasabwe na Gatibita ka Gihinira. Igihe cyo gukwa kigeze Gihinira ajya kwa bamwana we Bureshyo bamaze gucoca imisango bahamanya igihe Gatibita azagira kurongora kwa sebukwe(gutahira). Igihe kigeze Gatibita araherekezwa bashyitseyo bakiranwa ubwuzu Gatibita ahabwa umwanya wo kujya gukora icyamuzanye. Ku gicamunsi cy’uwundi munsi Gatibita ajya kugira icyo yibariza Gasharankwanzi amwumva vuba amuha rugari ntiyanamukiranya Gatibita agwa mu kantu. Asohoka arakaye abwira abari bamuherekeje ati" Ntimunsiga turasubiranayo”, bamubaza impamvu arabasonurira koko bumva afite ishingiro maze bashyira nzira barataha. Bageze kwa Gihinira barisobanura Gatibita ashakirwa undi mugore Gasharankwanzi nawe aguma kwa se Bureshyo. Bidateye kabiri Gasharakwanzi yabengutswe na Rugaju rwa Mutimbo aramurongora anamucyura mu rugo rwe rw’ibunyonga ho mu gishubi ari narwo rugo Gihinira se wa Gatibita(umwe wabenze Gasharakwanzi) yari ahatswemo. Bukeye Gihinira akenera umukura(umusimbura) ngo ko ubuze uko agira agwa neza Gatibita aseta ibirenge ariko amaherezo arashyira ajya gusimbura se kwa Rugaju na Gasharankwanzi. Gatibita ahakanwa ubwoba n’ipfunwe byuko ahatswe n’umugore yabenze banararanye. Bukeye Gasharankwanzi ateranya abo mu rugo rwe ahamagara Gatibita aramubaza ati" Gatibito ko ukorana umususu imirimo ushinzwe aho ntiwaba ukeka ko nkwanga ko wambenze twashyingiranywe iryo joro?”
Arakomeza ati: “Tuza utekane sinkwanga, wakenze rimwe ntiwakimara, rero tuza kuko ukenze rimwe ntabwo aba akimaze.” Nuko amugabira inka abari aho baraseka banashima umutima, ubupfura no kutagira inzika kwa Gasharakwanzi. Source: Ibirari by’insigamigani 1980 igice cya kabiri

title: Amaherezo y’uduhanga bivugwa ko ari utw’abanyarwanda twajyanywe mu Budage
content: Umwaka ugiye gushira umuryango Prussian Cultural Heritage Foundation ucunga inzu ndangamurage z’i Berlin utangaje ko ubitse uduhanga dusaga igihumbi tw’Abanyarwanda, twajyanywe ubwo u Budage bwari bukolonije u Rwanda. Mu duhanga uwo muryango watangaje ko ubitse harimo kandi n’udusaga 60 twaturutse muri Tanzania. U Budage bwakolonije u Rwanda kuva mu mwaka wa 1885 kugeza mu 1918. Bivugwa ko utwo duhanga twajyanwaga mu Budage ngo hakorwe ubushakashatsi ku bwoko bw’abantu. Inkuru yagaragaye bwa mbere mu binyamakuru, abayobozi batandukanye bo mu Budage basaba ko utwo duhanga dusubizwa mu bihugu twaturutsemo. Mu kiganiro na IGIHE dukesha iyi nkuru, Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Budage, Igor César, yatangaje ko hari byinshi bigikorwaho ubushakashatsi mbere yo kuba utwo duhanga twagarurwa mu Rwanda, ngo kuko nta nubwo haremezwa niba koko ari utw’abanyarwanda. Umuryango Prussian Cultural Heritage Foundation wavuze ko nta kibazo kiri mu gusubiza utwo duhanga mu bihugu twaturutsemo ariko ko hazabanza kwerekanwa ibyangombwa ko koko abo bantu bahoze ari abaturage b’ibyo bihugu. Ambasaderi César yatangaje ko baganiriye n’uwo muryango, bakemeranya kubanza gukora ubushakashatsi kugira ngo hemezwe niba koko abo bantu barakomokaga mu Rwanda. Ati “Ikintu cy’ibanze kandi cyihutirwa twibanzeho ni ugushaka kumenya neza niba koko utwo duhanga ari utw’abanyarwanda n’uburyo twageze mu Budage. Twaganiriye n’ubuyobozi bw’inzu ndangamurage y’aho utwo duhanga tubitse, twemeranya ko hakwiye gukorwa ubushakashatsi bugamije kumenya amakuru y’impamo ku bijyanye n’inkomoko y’abo bantu.” Prussian Cultural Heritage Foundation ngo yamenyesheje Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Budage ko iri mu myiteguro y’ibanze y’igikorwa cy’ubushakashatsi kizahuza inzobere zo mu Budage n’izo mu Rwanda hagamijwe kumenya inkomoko ya bene utwo duhanga. Utwo duhanga aho turi tubitse mu nzu ndangamurage, ariko igihugu kigaragaje ko ari utwacyo gishobora kudukoresha ikindi nko kudushyingura. Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Budage ivuga ko ibiganiro bitaragera ku rwego rwo kumenya icyo uduhanga tuzakoreshwa, ariko ngo nibirangira inzego za Leta bireba zizagena icyo tuzakorerwa. Deutsche Welle umwaka ushize yatangaje ko utwo duhanga ari utw’inyeshyamba zabaga zigometse ku bakoloni b’Abadage hanyuma bakazica. Kuri ibi, Ambasaderi César yagize ati “Twe nta gihamya dufite ko bishwe, icyo twumva ni uko hari uduhanga tw’abantu bivugwa ko bafite inkomoko mu Rwanda. Twizeye ko ubushakashatsi buzatugeza ku kuri kw’amateka y’utwo duhanga.” U Budage bumaze gutsindwa intambara ya mbere y’isi yose, mu bihano bwahawe harimo kwamburwa ibihugu bwari bukolonije. U Rwanda rwahise ruhabwa Ababiligi kugeza mu 1962 rubonye ubwigenge. Src:IGIHE

title: Ubufaransa: Uwihaye Imana yatawe muri yombi ashinjwa gufata ku ngufu abana
content: Umufurere witwa Albert ubarizwa mu muryango w’abafurere bitwa Sacré-Coeur yafatiwe mu Bufaransa akurikiranyweho ibyaha byo gufata ku ngufu abana bato(bari munsi y’imyaka 15), ibyaha yakoreye muri Afurika mu gihugu cya Guinea Conakry. Uyu mufurere yafatiwe na polisi mu nzu yabagamo y’abasheshakanguhe iherereye hafi yahitwa Puy-en-Velay mu Bufaransa rwagati, aho yashyikirijwe urukiko rwa Clermont-Ferrand aza kurekurwa nyuma gato ariko akomeza gukurikiranwa n’ubutabera. “ Ntabwo bimuteye ikimwaro. Yemeye bimwe mu byo aregwa. Muri we hagaragayemo ko umutima umucira urubanza. Uyu wihaye Imana wifuza gusubiza ubutabera bw’abantu” ibi ni ibyavuzwe n’umujyanama we, Me Cédric Augeyre. Kuvamu 1992 kugeza mu 2002, yari diregiteri w’ikigo cy’amashuri mu mujyi wa Conakry. Ni muri urwo rwego yagiye ashinjwa gufata ku ngufu ingimbi yatozaga mu ikipe y’umupira w’amaguru yo muri ako gace. Nyuma yo kuregwa ibi byaha, abamukuriye bahise bamutumizaho mu Bufaransa. Muri Werurwe uyu mufurere yagiye mu ntebe ya penetensiyakwicuza ibi byaha, nkuko byagaragajwe n’amashusho yafashwe mu ibanga (caméra cache)na shene ya televiziyo ya France 2. " Muri Guinée, hari igihe cyageze nsa nk’indakorwaho (…) niyumvaga nk’utavogerwa(…)  bimenyekanye, bahise bansaba gutaha ", amwe mu magambo yatangarije umunyamakuru wamubazaga. Nkuko ikinyamakuru Le Parisien cyabitangaje, furere Albert ashinjwa gusambanya abana bagera kuri 40. Abakora iperereza bagiye gukomereza ipererereza muri Guinee aho bazakusanya ubuhamya bw’abahohotewe. Tubabwire ko uyu muryango uyu mufurere abarizwamo w’aba Sacré-Coeur ufite inkomoko mu mujyi wa Lyon mu Bufaransa, ukaba wibanda mu guteza imbere uburezi bw’abakiri bato aho ari nabo bayobora amashuri menshi i Burayi, Amerika, Afrika no muri Aziya.

Nkuko amateka y’ubuvanganzo nyarwanda abigaragaza, umugani ni ipfundo ry’amagambo atonze neza, Gacamigani yakagiriyemo ihame ridutoza gukora iki cyangwa se kudakora kiriya. Mbese muri make umugani ni umwanzuro w’amarenga y’intekerezo. Umugani uvuga ukuri, ariko muri kamere yawo ntabwo wo uba ari ukuri. Tugarutse by’umwihariko ku migani migufi ariyo bakunze kwita “Imigani y’imigenurano” nubwo ivugitse mu buryo bunyarutse, irusha ibindi byose kuranga umuco rusange w’abanyarwanda. Ushaka kumenya uburezi n’uburere cyangwa imibanire y’abantu bya Kinyarwanda wabisangamo. Imigani migufi y’ikinyarwanda ni myinshi cyane ari nayo mpamvu, mu rwego rwo kwiyungura ubumenyi no kuyibukiranya tuzakora inkuru zirenze imwe aho twifashishije uwitwa Icyimaye Jean Paul washyize iyi migani kuri internet tuzajya duhera ku migani iyi n’iyi tugendeye kuyihuriye ku nyajwi cyangwa ingombajwi imwe ziyibanziriza kugirango bigire umurongo bigenderaho. title: Zimbabwe: Inzovu 55 zishwe n’inzara n’inyota
content: Muri Zimbabwe biravugwa ko amapfa akomeye ari imwe mu mpamvu zatumye inzovu zirenga 50 zipfa aho umuvugizi wa pariki z’igihugu muri iki gihugu yabwiye itangazamakuru ko habonetse imirambo y’inzovu yari hafi y’imigezi yumye (yakamye) mu bice bimwe by’iki gihugu. Hari umwe mu mpuguke watangaje ko uretse ibura ry’imvura, ubucucike ari ikindi kintu kibangamira inzovu bigatuma zishaka guhunga parike zijya gushaka ibyo kurya, aha mu nzira muri uru rugendo zimuka ari ho ku bwe yemeza ko nyinshi muri zo zipfira Indi mpamvu ivugwa ko yaba ari imwe mu yateye inzovu zingana gutya gupfa harimo kuba leta nta ngengo y’imari ihagije itanga yo gufasha mu kwitabwaho kw’izi nyamaswa. Umwe mu bayobozi muri Zimbabwe yatangaje ko kubera uburyo iki gihugu cyugarijwe n’ikibazo cy’ubukungu butifashe neza, idafite amafaranga ahagije yo kwita ku nyamaswa zo muri parike. Ngo igisubizo kuri ibi ni ukugurisha inzovu zikajyanwa muri parike zo mu bindi bihugu gusa ibi byazamuye impaka ndende ku miryango irengera inyamaswa ivuga ko ibyana by’inzovu byagiye bitandukanywa n’imiryango yabyo byatumye bigira ihungabana bijyanwa kurererwa muri ’zoo’ zidakwiye mu Bushinwa. Src:BBC Afrique

title: Banki y’iterambere y’Afurika y’Epfo (DBSA) irifuza gushyira itafari ku bikorwa remezo by’u Rwanda
content:
Ku bufatanye na Banki Itsura Amajyambere y’u Rwanda (BRD), kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 17 Ukwakira 2019, i Kigali hateraniye inama yahuje Banki y’iterambere y’Afurika y’Epfo (DBSA) n’abafatanyabikorwa banyuranye biganjemo inzego zifite aho zihuriye n’ibikorwa remezo. Nk’uko byatangarijwe muri iyi nama yafunguwe na Minisitiri w’Ibikorwa remezo Amb. Gatete Claver, iyi banki ya DBSA ije kwifatanya n’u Rwanda aho izakorana n’inzego z’abikorera, andi mabanki akorera mu Rwanda ndetse by’umwihariko na Leta y’u Rwanda, ikaba yiteguye gushyira amafaranga mu bikorwaremezo birimo amashanyarazi, amazi, ubwubatsi, ubwikorezi, ubuvuzi, amashuri n’ibindi.

Minisitiri Gatete Claver ageza ijambo ku bafatanyabikorwa bitabiriye iyi nama Minisitiri Gatete yagaragaje ko u Rwanda rusanzwe rufitanye imikoranire myiza n’iyi banki kuva mu myaka 15 ishize, kuri ubu ikaba yaje mu Rwanda "baganire n’abafatanyabikorwa batandukanye hano mu Rwanda, inzego zose zifite aho zihuriye n’ibikorwa remezo kugira ngo barebe ubufatanye bushoboka, bashobore kuba bazana amafaranga yabo hano." Minisitiri Gatete kandi avuga ko kimwe mu byakuruye iyi banki gushora imari yayo mu Rwanda harimo kuba ubukungu buhagaze neza, umutekano n’ikizere amahanga agenda aha u Rwanda n’ibindi bigaragaza ko uwashora amafaranga mu Rwanda yamubyarira umusaruro.

Minisitiri Gatete avuga ko Leta yashyiraga amafaranga arenga 95% mu bikorwa remezo, ariko DBSA ikaba ije kuyunganira dore ko nta bandi bafatanyabikorwa yagiraga Abajijwe niba ubu bufatanye hari inyungu ifatika u Rwanda ruzabyungukiramo muri gahunda yarwo y’imyaka 7 iri imbere, Minisitiri Gatete yasubije ati "Yego umusanzu uragaragara, kuko ubundi iyo tuvuga gahunda y’imyaka 7 ndetse no mu gihe kiri imbere ni ukuvuga ngo tubonye amafaranga yiyongera mu gihugu. Ayo mafaranga yiyongereye mu gihugu ajya mu bikorwa remezo bigafasha ubukungu gukomeza kuzamuka, umusanzu uragaragara cyane, ije kunganira andi mabanki dufite hano mu Rwanda harimo na banki y’iterambere yacu y’u Rwanda."

Iyi nama yari yahuje abafatanyabikorwa batandukanye bafite aho bahuriye n’ibikorwa remezo Ku ruhande rw’Umuyobozi wa Banki y’iterambere y’Afurika y’Epfo  ushinzwe ibigo by’imari, Mduduzi Dlamini yavuze ko banyotewe no gukorana n’u Rwanda babitewe ahanini no kuba ari igihugu gikomeje kwiyubaka bigaragara kandi kibaka kigaragaza ubushake mu koroshya ubuhahirane n’ishoramari ndetse kikaba cyari ku ruhembe mu masezerano y’isoko rusange rya Afurika. Ati "(…) Kugira ubushake bwo gukorera mu Rwanda biri mu bituma igihugu ubwacyo gitera imbere ndetse n’abagituye ariko na DBSA nayo igatera imbere. Twizeye ko abashora imari mu bikorwa remezo by’umwihariko mu mashanyarazi, amazi, isuku n’isukura, uburezi, ubuvuzi n’ibindi tuzakorana neza."

Mduduzi Dlamini, Umuyobozi wa Banki y’iterambere y’Afurika y’Epfo  ushinzwe ibigo by’imari Umuyobozi wa BRD, Eric Rutabana yagaragaje ko Banki y’Iterambere y’u Rwanda isanzwe ihuriye na DBSA mu huriro ry’Ibigo by’Imari bigamije Iterambere muri Afurika, ari naho umubano wayo n’u Rwanda wavukiye. Rutabana yakomeje avuga ko iyi banki ifite ubunararibonye kandi ishobora kuzazana n’abafatanyabikorwa bayo mu Rwanda bakunganira ishoramari rikiyongera.
