title: Iposita y’u Rwanda ihamya ko ICT atari mukeba wayo
content:
Kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 09 Ukwakira 2019, Iposita y’u Rwanda yifatanije n’isi mu kwizihiza ku nshuro ya 50 Umunsi Mpuzamahanga w’Amaposita wizihizwa n’Ihuriro Mpuzamahanga ry’Amaposita (Universal Postal Union/UPU) ryabayeho kuva mu 1874, u Rwanda rukayinjiramo mu 1963, ubu kikaba ari kimwe mu bihugu 192 bibarizwa muri iri huriro. Mu kwizihiza uyu Munsi Mpuzamahanga w’Amaposita, Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Iposita y’u Rwanda, Célestin Kayitare yavuze ko hari byinshi bishimira bamaze kugeraho avuga ko nubwo hari abibwira ko iposita yaciwe intege n’umuvuduko w’ikoranabuhanga, ibi atari byo ndetse iposita ’yahozeho, iriho kandi izahoraho’.

Iposita y’u Rwanda yifatanije n’isi kwizihiza Umunsi Mpuzamahanga w’Amaposita Kayitare yavuze ko ubu iki kigo ari kimwe muri bibiri bya leta biyinjiriza amafaranga menshi kandi kuva mu 2007 kikaba nta nkunga na nke gihabwa na yo. Avuga ko bakorera mu nyungu aho ubukungu bugenda buzamuka umwaka k’uwundi. "Turi mu nzira, turushaho kunoza ibyo dukora umunsi k’uwundi. Ikoranabuhanga ryaraje abantu bagira impungenge bibwira ko iposita ibyayo birangiye…turakora neza, turakora tukunguka, turi mu bigo bibiri bya leta bikora byunguka.", Umuyobozi w’iposita, Kayitare Celestin aganira n’abanyamakuru.

Umutsima wari wateguwe mu kwizihiza uyu munsi ngarukamwaka watangiye kwizihizwa mu 1969 Umuyobozi w’posita y’u Rwanda yavuze ko icyagabanutse ari amabaruwa bagezaga ku bantu kubera uburyo ikoranabuhanga ryoroheje itumanaho, ariko hari ibindi bagikora neza kandi nabo bagendana naryo. Ati "Hari ibindi bitasimbuwe, icyagabanutse ni bwa butumwa busanzwe kuko ubu ibintu biroroshye kubera izi mbuga (…). Ntabwo twasigaye inyuma natwe tugerageza kujyana n’ikoranabuhanga, cyera umuntu yabaga aho afite ubutumwa akazamara iminsi ataramenya niba abufite kubera ko byamusabaga ngo abanze aze hano areba mu gasanduku ke arebe icyo bamwoherereje ariko yaje atabizi. Ubu ng’ubu tubwira abantu ko hari ubutumwa bwabo bakwiye kuza kubufata tukanabarangira aho agomba kuza kubufata." Yongeyeho ati "Twagabanyije ibyo dukorera mu mpapuro, ushobora kujya k’urubuga rwacu ukamanura (download) urupapuro (formulaire) bitewe na serivise ukeneye ntibikiri ngombwa ko wirirwa uza hano (…) ikoranabuhanga rifasha mu kwihutisha ibintu,…"

Abakozi b’iposita bizihije Umunsi Mpuzamahanga wahariwe Amaposita Bimwe mu bikorwa by’iposita, ubu harimo kwihutisha ubutumwa, udusanduku tw’amaposita abantu bakodesha, ubutumwa buturuka mu bindi bihugu, udupfunyika duto n’ibinini, amazu bakodesha n’ibindi bikorwa by’ubucuruzi bibabyarira inyungu, by’umwihariko magingo aya iposita ifite ’Forex Bureau’ ikorera ku kibuga cy’indege Mpuzamahanga cya Kigali i Kanombe ifite umwihariko wo kuba ari yo yonyine mu gihugu ikora amasaha 24/24, iminsi 7/7 ndetse no mu minsi mikuru ikaba itajya ihagarara. Kayitare avuga ko ubu iposita y’u Rwanda iri mu ba mbere bamaze kugira umuyoboro  ufasha abantu mu bucuruzi bwifashishije ikoranabuhanga (e-commerce) aboneraho gutangaza ko "hari ihuriro (platform) ry’igihugu ku bijyanye no gucuruza no guhahirana n’amahanga hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga igiye gutangira, iyo gahunda ku rwego rw’igihugu izatangazwa tariki 15 Ugushyingo 2019 muri iyo gahunda iposita nitwebwe tuzaba dushinzwe kuzana ibintu no kubyohereza."

Umuyobozi w’Iposita y’u Rwanda, Kayitare Celestin (ibumoso) hamwe n’umukiliya wari uhagarariye abandi ubwo bakataga umutsima bizihiza uyu munsi Mu myaka itanu ishize (kuva 2014 kugeza 2018), inyungu yabo yiyongereyeho 78% by’umwihariko ubutumwa bwihuse (Express Mail Service) batanga bwavuye kuri miliyoni 280 bugera kuri miliyoni 420 hiyongereho inshuro 67% mu gihe inyungu muri rusange kuri ubu imaze kurenga miliyari eshanu ivuye kuri miliyari ebyiri mu 2012. Nubwo iposita y’u Rwanda yishimira ibyo imaze kugeraho n’umusanzu wayo mu iterambere ry’igihugu, bavuga ko bahangayikishijwe n’inyubako zabo ziherereye mu turere dutandukanye zitakijyanye n’igihe n’imishara y’abakozi bikiri hasi, bagasaba ko leta yabafasha.

title: Barinubira serivisi mbi z’ibyuma bitanga amafaranga bizwi nka ATM
content: Abakoresha ibyuma bitanga amafranga, bizwi nka ATM, barifuza ko hagira ibikosorwamo, nko gusaba amafaranga ntaboneke kandi ntanasubire kuri konti ya nyirayo ku buryo hari n’umaze amezi 7 yaraburiye irengero amafranga ye ubwo yakoreshaga icyuma cy’indi banki. Abakoresha ibyuma byifashishwa mu kubitsa no kubikuza amafaranga, ATM, bavuga ko harimo bidatanga amafaranga kandi byayavanye kuri konti y’umukiriya mu gihe akoresheje ikarita y’indi banki, hagashira iminsi isaga 40 atarasubira kuri konti yavuyeho nkuko iyi nkuru dukesha RBA ibivuga. Muhawenimana Antoinette wo mu karere ka Ngororero we avuga ko hashize amezi hafi 7 ahuye n’iki kibazo. Byamubayeho ku itariki 30 z’ukwezi kwa 1 uyu mwaka ubwo yashyiraga ikarita ye ya BK mu cyuma cya Banki y’Abaturage yifuza amafaranga ibihumbi 48. Yagize ati "Kuri BK nagiyeyo ku itariki 2 z’ukwa 2 barambwira bati ’nyuma y’iminsi 45 uzaba wayabonye’  ubwo rero kugeza ubu nkaba ntarayabona ariko buri gihe mpora mbaza BK kuko jye ndi umukiriya wa BK ntabwo mbaza populaire. Urumva nagiye mu bukererwe bwa minerval, kwaka amadeni ubukene byose. Nifuzaga kuyabona kuko byaba byiza kuko ndayakeneye n’ubu ariko ikindi kintu mfite muri gahunda ntabwo nzogera gukoresha ikarita kuri populaire ubwo narabizinutswe." Guverineri w’Intara y’Amajyaruguru Gatabazi JMV na we asanga muri iyi mikorere harimo akarengane mu mitangire ya serivisi. Yagize ati "Tuvuge niba amafaranga yawe ugomba kuyafata ntuyabone akwiye guhita ajya kuri banki yawe ako kanya kuko ushobora kuyakenera. Kubona amafaranga wayasabye, ntuyabone ku cyuma bakayasubirana akamara ukwezi utarayasubirana, hari ikintu washakaga gukora ako kanya ? ako karengane uba wagize kishyurwa gute? Kugusubiza amafaranga yawe gusa nyuma y’ukwezi nta kintu baguhaye cy’indishyi z’akababaro? Ntabwo ari byo kandi amakosa yaturutse kuri system yabo atari nawe wayateye." Umuyobozi ushinzwe urwego rw’imari muri Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda, Uwase Peace avuga ko iki ari ikibazo na bo barimo gushakira igisubizo. Yagize ati "Aho tukibona ikibazo ni igihe uri umukiriya wa BK nk’urugero ugakoresha ATM tuvuge ya BPR icyo gihe ibyo bigo 2 bigomba kugira uburyo bivugana kugira ngo byizere ko amafaranga utayatwaye babone kuyagusubiza aho ni ho twabonaga harimo gutinda cyane ku iminsi 40 na 45. Aho ukabona ko abakiriya badafashwe neza. Mu ivugurura ry’itegeko twashyizemo ko ayo mafaranga agomba gusubizwa bitarenze byibuze iminsi 5." Uretse gutinda gusubizwa amafaranga yakaswe na ATM y’indi banki, hari n’ababura amafaranga bakeneye ku byuma bya banki bakorana na zo, cyane cyane mu mpera z’icyumweru. Uyu ni mukiriya  byabayeho kuri iki cyumweru. Yagize ati "Nkaba nifuza ko imitangire ya serivisi bagerageza kuyinoza kuko hashize igihe iki kibazo gihari si muri BK gusa no muri Banque Populaire n’ahandi hantu hose uragenda ugasanga ibyuma byapfuye, hari n’abakubwira ngo ntibishoboka. Hari igihe uba urwaje umwana, cyangwa ari ikibazo ufite ugomba gucyemura ukagenda amajoro ariko ukanyura ahantu uva Kicukiro, Kimironko hehe... ukagera no mu mujyi ukabura umuntu n’umwe waguha serivisi." Ikindi abakoresha amakarita bavuga ni amafaranga akatwa umuntu iyo agiye kuri ATM akabura serivisi yari akeneye yakwinjira muri banki bakamuca amafaranga menshi kuko nta sheki aba yitwaje. Umuyobozi w’Ihuriro ry’Amabanki mu Rwanda, (Rwanda Bankers Association), Maurice Toroitich Kiprotich avuga ko ibibazo bitaho ari ibibazo rusange urwego rw’amabanki rufite na ho abakiriya bakaba bafite uburenganzira bwo kujya muri banki ibaha serivisi nziza. Yagize ati "Kuri Rwanda Bankers Association tuba twifuza gukemura ibibazo bigari bireba urwego rwa banki, urugero niba ATM zidakora neza kubera ko ibigo by’itumanaho bitarimo gutanga imiyoboro myiza icyo twagikurikirana bitewe n’uko ari ikintu gifata urwego rw’amabanki rwose ariko niba ibigo by’itumanaho nta kibazo bifite akaba ari ikibazo cya banki  imwe itarimo gukora akazi kayo neza ntabwo icyo gihe biba bireba RBA. Abanyamuryango b’ihuriro baravuga bati niba hari udakora neza ni amarushanwa umukirliya w’iyo banki azareba ingorane acamo ahindure banki. Ntabwo tujya tuvuga kuri banki ku giti cyayo ahubwo twita ku bibazo rusange mu mabanki Mu Rwanda habarurwa ibyuma bya ATM bigera kuri 400, amabanki 16 n’ibigo by’imari biciriritse 470.

title: Amazon yibeshye igabanya ibicuruzwa byayo ho 99% ab’inkwakuzi bayiha isomo
content: Amazon yakoze ikosa rikomeye cyane ryahesheje bamwe mu bahahira kuri murandasi amahirwe, nyamara Amazon yo ihomba atari make. Mu ntangiriro z’icyumweri gishize, muri “Amazon Prime Day” nibwo iyi sosiyete yibeshye maze igabanya ibiciro kugeza kuri 99% birimo ibikoresho byifashishwa mu gukurura amashusho (lens) aho bimwe byashoboraga kugurwa ari munsi y’amadorori 100 kandi igiciro cyabyo nyacyo ari ibihumbi 13 (13.000USD). Ni ikosa ryakozwe mu kugena ibiciro ku bikoresho byose byerekeranye no gufotora bicuruzwa na Amazon mu minsi yayo idasanzwe. Iri kosa ryatumye habaho igabanuka rikomeye ry’ibi biciro. Ibyari byageze ku isoko byahise bishira. Amazon yahise ikuraho iri gabanya ry’ibiciro ariko bamwe mu bakiliya bari bamaze guhaha, bityo bibonera iyi mpano ikomeye. Mu buhamya bwagaragaye ku rubuga Gizmodo, hari uwatanze amadorari 500 (angana n’ibihumbi 458 412frw) ku gikoresho cy’agaciro k’ibihumbi 65 (miliyoni 59 593 625frw). Nkuko BFMTV yabitangaje ngo muri “Amazon Prime Day”, aho uru rubuga rw’ikirangirire mu gucuruza ibikoresho kuri murandasi ruba rwamanuye ibiciro mu gihe cy’iminsi ibiri ku bakiliya bayo, ngo kuri iyi nshuro yacuruje ibifite agaciro ka miliyoni 175 z’amadorali ya Amerika mu bihugu 18. Mu 2018 iyi gahunda yihariye yari yatumye uru ruganda rwunguka asaga miliyari 3,2 y’amadorali ya Amerika, ariko ubu ta kabuza ko muri uyu mwaka aya mafaranga azagabanuka kubera iri kosa bakoze bakibeshya bakagabanya ibiciro kugeza kuri 99%.

title: Agakiriro ka Gisozi kongeye kwibasirwa n’inkongi y’umuriro
content:
Mu masaha ya mu gitondo kuri uyu wa  Gatatu agakiriro ka Gisozi kongeye gushya mu gihe kitageze ku kwezi. Kugeza ubu icyateye iriya nkongi ntikiramenyekana ariko hari abakeka ko byaba byatewe n’intsinga zishaje, abandi bakavuga ko hari soudure yakozwe ejo. Umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Gisozi, Theophile Niragire yabwiye BTN yari iri aho uriya muriro wabereye ko bitaramenyekana neza niba uwagizweho ingaruka n’uriya muriro yari afite ubwishingizi.

Polisi ishami rishinzwe kurwanya inkongi yahise itabara Umuvugizi wa Police mu mujyi wa Kigali CIP Marie Goretti Umutesi yabwiye Umuseke ko iriya nkongi yibasiye igice gituranye n’aho iy’ubushize yabaye ariko ko Police yari yahageze kare iri kuzimya, avuga ko aza gutanga amakuru arambuye akazi ko kuzimya karangiye hakababo kubarura ibyangiritse byose.


Ntiharamenyekana neza icyateye iyi nkongi
 Taliki 03, Kamena, 2019 aka gakiriro nabwo karahiye cyane. Icyo gihe hibasiwe igice kiri haruguru hafi y’inzu yitwa Umukindo House. Ibyahiye icyo gihe harimo imbaho nyinshi, intebe n’ibitanda. (Inkuru y’Umuseke)

title: Tanzaniya: Ab’igitsina gore barinubira umusoro wa 25% washyizwe ku misatsi y’imikorano y’abagore
content: Minisitiri w’imari wa Tanzaniya yatangaje umusoro ungana na 25 ku ijana (25%) ku misatsi yose y’imikorano itumizwa mu mahanga ndetse n’umusoro ungana na 10 ku ijana (10%) ku misatsi y’imikorano ikorerwa imbere mu gihugu, mu rwego rwo kongera amafaranga iki gihugu cyinjiza. Nkuko tubikesha BBC, Minisitiri Philip Mpango yatangaje izo ngamba  byitezwe ko zitangira gukurikizwa guhera mu ntangiriro y’ukwezi gutaha kwa karindwi ubwo ku munsi w’ejo ku wa kane yatangazaga ingengo y’imari y’umwaka utaha. Myinshi mu misatsi y’imikorano yambarwa n’abagore muri Tanzaniya itumizwa mu mahanga. Muri iki gihugu, imisatsi nk’iyo ihendutse cyane kuri ubu igura amadolari y’Amerika arenga ane, ariko ishobora no kugeza ku madolari 130 y’Amerika. Bwana Mpango yanakuyeho isonerwa ry’umusoro ku nyongeragaciro ku bikoresho abagore bifashisha mu gihe bari mu mihango. Yavuze ko impamvu ari uko abaguzi babyo nta nyungu baboneye mu igabanuka ry’igiciro kuko abacuruzi batagabanyije igiciro nyuma yo gusonerwa uwo musoro. Iyi nkuru ya BBC ikomeza ivuga ko abagore benshi muri Tanzaniya bagannye amatsinda atandukanye yo ku rubuga rwa WhatsApp mu kwinubira izo ngamba nshya, bagashinja leta kubahana. Izindi nyongera ku musoro zatangajwe zirimo nk’umusoro kuri za shokola (chocolat / chocolate) n’ibisuguti (biscuits) washyizwe kuri 35 ku ijana (35%), mu gihe wari usanzwe uri kuri 25 ku ijana (25%).

title: Mu karere: Kenya niyo izakoresha ingengo y’imari nini mu 2019/2020, u Burundi bukoreshe iri hasi -Menya ingengo y’imari ya buri gihugu
content: Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 13 Kamena 2019, mu gihe kimwe ba minisitiri b’imari ba Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania na Uganda batangaje imari ibihugu byabo bizakoresha mu mwaka w’imari utaha (2019/2020), mu gihe uw’u Burundi we yayigaragaje mu mpera z’ukwezi gushize. Ingengo z’imari z’ibi bihugu zizatangira mu kwezi gutaha kwa Nyakanga nizimara kwemerwa n’Inteko nshingamategeko z’ibi bihugu, ari nazo aba ba Minisitiri bagezagaho iyo mishinga y’imari. Kenya niyo izakoresha menshi. Mu nteko, aba ba Minisitiri babanje kuvuga ko ubukungu bw’ibihugu bigize umuryango w’Afurika y’Iburasirazuba mu mwaka wa 2018 bwazamutse ku kigero cya 4%. Ikigero bavuze ko ari gito ugereranyijwe n’icyari kitezwe kubera impamvu zinyuranye zirimo ingaruka zo guhangana mu bukungu kw’ibihangange kw’isi, Amerika n’Ubushinwa. Ingengo z’imari z’ibi bihugu zatangajwe mu buryo bukurikira; Kenya: Tiriyari 3.02 z’amashilingi ya Kenya (asanga miliyari 30 z’amadorari y’Amerika) Rwanda: Tiriyari 2,8 z’amanyarwanda (asaga miliyari 3.2 z’amadorari y’Amerika) Tanzania: Tiriyari 33,1 z’amashilingi ya Tanzania (asaga miliyari 14.3 z’Amadorari y’Amerika) Uganda: Tiriyari 40.4 z’amashilingi ya Uganda (asaga miliyari 10.9 z’amadorari y’Amerika) Tariki 30 z’ukwezi gushize kwa gatanu Minisitiri w’imari w’u Burundi nawe yabwiye Inteko yaho ko ingengo y’imari y’iki gihugu izaba miliyari 1,500 z’amarundi (asaga miliyoni 824 z’amadorari y’Amerika). Muri rusange, ba minisitiri b’ibi bihugu batangaje ko igice kinini k’ingengo y’imari y’ibihugu byabo kizava mu misoro igihugu gisoresha, inguzanyo z’amahanga zishyurwa, inguzanyo z’imbere mu gihugu n’inkunga z’amahanga zitishyurwa. Mu Rwanda, Minisitiri Uzziel Ndagijimana yavuze ko amafaranga azava imbere mu gihugu kongeraho inguzanyo zishyurwa yose hamwe azaba agize 85,8% by’ingengo y’imari y’u Rwanda. Yavuze ko u Rwanda rwavuguruye uburyo bwo gusoresha ibicuruzwa na serivisi hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga kugira ngo bongere imisoro iva imbere mu gihugu. Minisitiri Philippo Mpango wa Tanzania yavuze ko hari ibicuruzwa biva hanze bongereye imisoro, ndetse n’igiciro cyo kwandikisha imodoka na moto cyazamuwe mu kongera imari Leta ivana imbere mu gihugu. Henry Rotich umunyamabanga ushinzwe imari wa Kenya yavuze ko hari ingamba zirimo umusoro mushya wa 10% ku byinjijwe n’abakora n’abakina imikino y’amahirwe, n’umusoro wazamuwe ugera kuri 15% ku nzoga n’itabi. Imari ibi bihugu bizakoresha umwaka utaha izashyirwa cyane cyane mu bikorwa by’iterambere birimo kuzamura umusaruro w’ubuhinzi, kubaka inzu ziciriritse, uburezi, gushora imari mu mishinga y’iterambere, guhanga imirimo mishya n’igisirikare. Src: BBC

title: Zimbabwe irashaka kugurisha amahembe y’inzovu abarirwa agaciro ka miliyoni 300 z’amadorali
content: Igihugu cya Zimbabwe kirimo kirateganya kwikura mu masezerano abuza ubucuruzi bw’inyamaswa ziri mu nzira yo gushira, mu rwego rwo kubona uko bagurisha ihunikiro ry’amahembe y’inzovu bafite. Ni mu gihe iki gihugu kimaze igihe kitorohewe n’ibibazo by’ubukungu. Ubu bucuruzi ngo bwatuma Zimbabwe ibasha kuvugurura parike zacyo ndetse n’ibyanya by’inzovu. Kuva mu myaka 30 ishize yabashije guhunika amahembe y’inzovu afite agaciro ka miliyoni 300 z’amadorali ya Amerika itashoboraga kugurisha irenze ku masezerano mpuzamahanga ya CITES yasinye mu 1989. Iki gihugu hamwe na Botswana, Zambie na Namibie bemeranije muri aya masezerano ya CITES ko bagomba gushyira inzovu kuri lisite ya 2, yemerera ubucuruzi bw’amahembe ku mpamvu zimwe na zimwe zirimo nko kuzibika nk’ibikombe cyangwa ibihembo by’umuhigo. Abayobozi ba Zimbabwe  basanga "abaturage babayeho hafi y’aya mahunikiro bagomba gutezwa imbere n’inzovu binyujijwe mu kugurisha amahembe yazo." Tinashe Farawo, umuvugizi w’ubuyobozi bushinzwe kubungabunga parike n’ibinyabuzima asanga ’CITES  igomba kwita ku mategeko agenzura ubucuruzi burebana n’inyamaswa ziri mu nzira zo kuzima.’ Ati "Ubucuruzi buramutse butariho, izi nyamaswa ntacyo zaba zikimaze." Zimbabwe yakira inzovu zisaga ibihumbi 84, ikunze kuzigurisha mu Bushinwa kugira ngo babone ubushobozi bwo kuzitaho no kuzirinda. Botswana yo, mu kwezi gushize, yafashe umwanzuro wo gukuraho itegeko ribuza kuzihiga mu rwego rwo kugabanya umubare wazo wiyongera buri munsi. Source:BBCAfrique

title: Botswana: Bongeye kwemererwa guhiga inzovu mu rwego rwo guhangana nazo
content: Minisitiri w’Ibidukikije wa Botswana yemeye ko inzovu zongera guhigwa muri iki gihugu mu buryo bukwiye. Mu 2014 nibwo Perezida Ian Khama wahoze ayobora Botswana, wafatwaga nk’urengera ibidukikije, yari yaraciye ibikorwa byose bigamije guhiga inyamaswa harimo n’inzovu mu buryo bw’ubucuruzi. Ariko abadepite b’ishyaka riri ku butegetsi bazamuye igitutu kugira ngo bahagarike iki cyemezo bavuga ko mu bice bimwe na bimwe by’iki gihugu inzovu zahindutse ikibazo kidafite igaruriro (ingérables). Umukuru w’igihugu mushya wa Botswana, Perezida Mokgweetsi Masisi wageze ku butegetsi umwaka ushize yasabye ko iki cyemezo cyongera kwigwaho. Hashingiwe ku itangazo rya Minisitiri w’Ibidukikije, ubushakashatsi bwerekanye ko ubushyamirane hagati y’inzovu n’abantu  bwiyongereye cyane  ndetse bikagenda bihungabanya uburyo bw’imibereho ya muntu mu buzima bwa buri munsi. Botswana ni igihugu kiza ku isonga mu kugira inzovu nyinshi muri Afurika  aho mu 2015 habaruwe izigera ku bihumbi 135.000. Bamwe mu nzobere bemeza ko umubare wazo wiyongereye cyane  hafi kwikuba gatatu  mu myaka 30 ishize ndetse vuba aha ngo zizaba zikabakaba ibihumbi 160.000.

title: Hibwe amashanyarazi y’asaga miliyari 1,9Frw mu mezi abiri! REG irabivugaho iki?
content:
Muri iyi minsi, Ikigo cy’u Rwanda Gishinzwe Ingufu, REG cyakajije ingufu mu guhiga abafatabuguzi bakoresha mu buryo budakwiye cyangwa bakiba amashanyarazi, aho bagiye bazenguruka mu turere dutandukanye tw’u Rwanda. REG ivuga ko ibyavuye mu bugenzuzi yakoze mu mezi abiri ashize biteye inkeke kandi ari ibyo guhagurikirwa bikamaganwa buri wese abigizemo uruhare kuko bidindiza iterambere ry’igihugu.

Abanyamakuru bari bitabiriye ikiganiro batumiwemo na REG kuri uyu wa Kane Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru cyabereye ku cyicaro gikuru cy’iki kigo, ubuyobozi bwa REG bwagaragaje ko mu turere 14 bagiyemo, 9 muri two mu mezi abiri ashize bafatiye mu cyuho abafatabuguzi 28 biba amashanyarazi. Abo bagizwe n’ingo, ubucuruzi buciriritse, amahoteli, ibyuma bisya, utubari, amaresitora n’inganda aho bari bamaze kwiba amashanyarazi abarirwa kuri Miliyari 1,9 y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Muri aba bafashwe biba, ibyuma bisya ibigori byihariye hafi 27%, ibigo by’amashuri bibiri harimo na kaminuza, utubari na resitora enye, hoteli 8 n’urusengero rumwe. Musanze, Gasabo, Rulindo, Rusizi na Rutsiro ni tumwe mu turere hasanzwemo ubu bujuru ku kigero cyo hejuru. Umuyobozi mukuru wa REG,  Eng. Ron WEISS mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru yavuze ko ibi bibabaje mu gihe guverinoma y’u Rwanda ishishikajwe no kwimakaza indangagaciro zo gukorera hamwe ngo abanyarwanda bose bagere ku iterambere, by’umwihariko ikaba yarihaye intego ko bitarenze 2024 izaba yagejeje ku Baturarwanda bose amashanyarazi. Uyu muyobozi yakomeje avuga ko REG ifite gahunda yo gutanga amashanyarazi yizewe kandi ahendutse no kurushaho kunoza serivisi itanga ariko hakaba hakiri igihombo gikomoka ku muriro ucuruzwa gisaga 6,5% giterwa ahanini n’abiba amashanyarazi.

Umuyobozi mukuru wa REG,  Eng. Ron WEISS(ibumoso) na Maj.Eng. Jean Claude Kalisa ukuriye EUCL (iburyo) mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru Eng. Ron WEISS yongeyeho ko kugeza ubu REG ifite ubushobozi bwo gutanga amashanyarazi agera kuri Megawati 221,1 mu gihe ingo zisaga miliyoni 1,34 zifite amashanyarazi, naho mu 2024 akazaba yiyongereyeho Megawati 556 ari nabwo abaturarwanda bose bazaba babasha kubona amashanyarazi. Ubu ngo hari imishinga yo kubaka ingomero nshya nini harimo Rusumo izatanga Megawati 27, Nyabarongo II izatanga Megawati 43, Simbiyoni yo mu kiyaga cya Kivu izatanga Megawati 53,... Eng. Ron WEISS yagize ati "Ibyo twiyemeje bizashoboka mu gihe twese twakoresheje neza amashanyarazi. (...) Ntabwo rwose tuzigera twihanganira umuntu wiba ibikoresho n’amashanyarazi. Tuzakomeza kugenda urugo ku rundi, akarere ku kandi dushakisha abantu bakoresha amashanyarazi nabi." Maj.Eng. Jean Claude Kalisa ukuriye EUCL ishinzwe gukora amashanyarazi, na we yunganiye Umuyobozi wa REG, maze ashimangira ko bagiye gukomeza guhiga aba biba amashanyarazi, bakagezwa imbere y’ubutabera kuko iki ari icyaha gihanwa. Yanavuze ko abafashwe ubu bari kwishyura amashanyarazi yibwe, aho hifashishwa ikoranabuhanga bakareba igihe bamaze batishyura maze bakabarirwa hakurikijwe ibikoresho bafite bikoresha amashanyarazi, wongeyeho amande. REG yaboneyeho gusaba abaturage bose ubufatanye mu kurwanya ubu bujura no kwangiza ibikorwaremezo by’amashanyarazi aho hari umurongo utishyurwa wa REG (3535) cyangwa bakamenyesha inzego z’umutekano n’ishami rya REG ribegereye.

title: Jeff Bezos, umuherwe wa mbere ku isi yatandukanye n’umugore we
content:
Jeff Bezos, washinze Amazon ndetse kugeza ubu akaba ari we muherwe wa mbere ku isi ya rurema, nyuma y’imyaka 25 abana n’umugore we kuri ubu batandukanye maze biyongera mu zindi ngero nyinshi z’uko amafaranga iteka atazana umunezero. Jeff Bezos abinyujije kuri konti ye ya Twitter yavuze ko bagergeje ibishoboka byose ariko umwanzuro mwiza uba ku gushyira akadomo ku mateka y’urukundo rwabo.

Jeff Bezos na Mackenzie batandukanye ku bwumvikane "(...) Twagize amahirwe adasanzwe yo guhura kandi tuzirikana buri mwaka twamaze tubana. Iyo tumenya ko tuzatandukana nyuma y’imaka 25, ntibyari kutubuza kubikora n’ubundi. (...)", ubutumwa Jeff n’umugore we Mackenzie Nkuko bigaragara muri iri tangazo bakomeje bavuga ko bagiranye ibihe byiza mu gihe cyose bamaranye kandi bazanakomeza kubana neza nk’ababyeyi, inshuti kandi nk’abantu bafite imishinga ibahuza ngo bazakomeza kuba umuryango.

Ubutumwa bashyize hanze batangaza ko bahisemo gutandukana ku bwumvikane Jeff Bezos na Mackenzie bahuye mu 1993. Nyuma y’amezi atatu bakundana nibwo bemeranijwe kuzarushinga maze barushinga nyuma y’amezi atandatu. Jeff Bezos yashinze Amazon nyuma y’umwaka umwe barushinze. Bafite abana bane harimo abahungu batatu babyaranye n’umukobwa umwe barera.

Jeff Bezos na Mackenzie bahisemo gutandukana ku bwumvikane nyuma yo kugerana kuri byinshi mu myaka 25 bari bamaranye Jeff Bezos, ubu abarirwa umutungo wa miliyari 137 z’amadorali ya Amerika. CNBC ivuga ko uku gushobora kuba ariko gutandukana (divorce) guhenze kubayeho mu mateka. Jeff n’uwari umugore we babaga muri leta ya Washington aho amategeko agena ko umutungo bakoreye mu gihe cyose babanaga bagomba kuwugabana.

Jeff Bezos na Mackenzie mu myaka yabo yo hambere Abunganizi mu by’amategeko bazobereye ku bijyanye na zagatanya batekereza ko Mackenzie atazasaba icyakabiri cy’umutungo wa Jeff. Ibi ngo byashyira Amazon mu gihombo kandi birumvikana ko yifuza ko umutungo w’umuryango ukomeza kwaguka.

title: Perezida wa Banki y’Isi, Jim Yong Kim yeguye
content: Umunyamerika ufite inkomoko muri Koreya y’Amajyepfo, Jim Yong Kim wayoboraga Banki y’Isi yeguye kuri uyu mwanya mu buryo butunguranye. Jim Yong Kim yari yaratangiye kuyobora iyi banki kuva mu 2012, aza kongera gutorerwa kuyiyobora mu 2016 bikaba byari biteganijwe ko manda ye izageza mu 2022, gusa kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 07 Mutarama 2019 mu itangazo iyi banki yashyize hanze yavuze ko kuva ku ya 01 Gashyantare 2019 atazaba akiri umuyobozi mukuru wa Banki y’Isi. Jim Yong Kim yavuze ko agiye kujya mu kindi kigo aho azajya yita ku bijyanye n’ishoramari mu by’ibikorwa remezo mu bihugu biri mu nzira y’iterambere. "Byari icyubahiro gikomeye gukora nka Perezida w’ikigo cy’intangarugero, gifite abakozi bihebeye gukuraho burundu ubukene mu batuye isi,..", bimwe mu byo yagarutseho muri iri tangazo. Kristalina Georgieva wari umwe mu bayobozi bamwungirije, byitezwe ko ari we uzaba ari Perezida w’iyi banki mu gihe cy’inzibacyuho.

title: Huawei yahannye abakozi bayo bakoresheje iPhone mu kwifuriza abakiliya umwaka mushya
content:
Uruganda rw’abashinwa rukora telefone zigezweho (smartphones) rwa Huawei ruherutse gufatira ibihano abakozi barwo babiri bakoresheje iPhone y’uruganda mukeba wabo ukomeye cyane Apple ubwo baandikaga ubutumwa kuri konti ya Twitter y’uru ruganda bifuriza abakiliya umwaka mushya muhire. Ibi byabaye ku ya 01 Mutarama 2019, ubwo kuri konti ya Twitter y’uruganda Huawei hagaragaraga ubutumwa bugenewe abafatabuguzi, bugira buti "Umwaka mushya muhire #2019 kuri twese muri Huawei. Intego yacu muri uyu mwaka mushya ni ukubaha impamvu nyinshi yo kwegerana n’abo mukunda.", ni ubutumwa bwagiyeho bugaragara ko bwanditswe hifashishijwe iPhone. Nubwo ku ikubitiro benshi batari babyitayeho, ibintu byaje gufata indi sura ubwo umunyamerika Marques Brownlee umaze kwamamara cyane kubera youtube, yafotoraga ubwo butumwa maze akabusangiza abarenga miliyoni eshatu bamukurikira. Nyuma gato y’uko ubu butumwa bukomeje guhererekanywa, uru ruganda rw’abashinwa rwahise rwihutira kubusiba.

Marques Brownlee ni we wakongeje umuriro Umukozi washinjijwe gukora ayo makosa hamwe n’umuyobozi mukuru w’ishami ry’Iyamamaza bikorwa bivugwa ko bahise bakatwa ku mushahara wabo w’ukwezi ama-yuans ibihumbi 5(angana n’ibihumbi 638 151frw) bitewe n’ingaruka mbi amakosa yabo yagize nk’uko byakwirakwijwe ku rubuga nkoranyambaga rwa Weibo na bamwe mu b’imbere muri uru ruganda ndetse bikanashimangirwa na AFP. Ku ruhande rw’uyu muyobozi w’Iyamamazabikorwa we ngo ntazanahembwa ukwezi kose ndetse mu gihe cy’amezi 12 ari imbere ntashobora kuzamurwa mu ntera (promotion). Ibibazo bya VPN byaba ariyo ntandaro yo gukoresha iPhone Chen Lifang, umuyobozi w’inama y’ubutegetsi ya Huawei yasobanuye ko ikigo gishinzwe gukoresha konti z’imbuga nkoranyambaga za Huawei yaba yarakoresheje iPhone hamwe na SIM yo muri Hong Kong nyuma ’y’ibibazo bya VPN. Twitter cyo kimwe n’izindi mbuga zo mu burengerazuba bw’isi nka Google cyangwa Facebook, ubutegetsi bw’i Beijing bwarazihagaritse ku butakaka bw’Ubushinwa ntabwo zifunguka. Gusa abifuza kuzikoresha bashobora kwifashisha ’software’ yitwa VPN (virtual private networks) bakabasha kuzifungura. Kwanga gukora kw’iyi software ngo ni ko kwaba kwaratumye habaho gukoresha telefone ifite SIM yo muri Hong Kong, ubutaka bw’Ubushinwa ariko bwigenga bukaba bwo butanafungirwa interineti na Beijing. Ku ruhande rwa Huawei ntabwo yigeze yifuza kugira icyo itangaza kuri aya makuru ubwo yavugishwaga na AFP. Ihangana rikomeye ry’inganda zo mu Bushinwa n’inganda zo muri Amerika Uru ruganda rukomeye rwo mu Bushinwa umwaka ushize rwaciye kuri Apple ruba uruganda rwa kabiri ku isi mu gucuruza smartphones nyuma y’uruganda rwo muri Koreya rwa Samsung. Ariko rwaje gufatirwa ibihano na Washington yasabye ibihugu by’inshuti (alliés ) byo mu burengerazuba bw’isi kudakoresha ibikoresho by’itumanaho byayo. Meng Wanzhou, wari umuyobozi w’imari muri Huawei yafatiwe muri Canada mu Ukoboza 2018 ku busabe bwa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Aho ashinjwa n’iki gihugu kuba yari mu bikorwa by’uburiganya (fraude) byari bigamije kubangamira ibihano Amerika yafatiye Iran.

Meng Wanzhou yatawe muri yombi na Canada ku busabe bwa Amerika Iki kibazo cyatumye inganda zimwe zo mu Bushinwa zifata ingamba zo gutera inkunga abakozi bazo kugira ngo batunge ibikoresho bya Huawei, hanyuma abakoresha iPhone bakirukanwa. Src:Parismatch

title: Gicumbi: Umusirikare witwaje intwaro yateshejwe n’umurinzi wa Sacco, agerageza kuyiba
content: Mu murenge wa Kaniga ho mu karere ka Gicumbi mu ntara y’Amajyaruguru haravugwa inkuru y’ umusirikare w’u Rwanda ufite ipeti rya Private wagerageje gutera ’Sacco Tugendane n’igihe Kaniga’, ariko ateshwa atabashije kugera kuri uyu mugambi Nk’uko umunyamakuru wa Kigali Post wageze ahabereye ibi, yabitangaje ngo uyu musirikare yarashe amasasu agera kuri atandatu mu butaka  arwana n’umusekurite wari uri ku burinzi, birangira yirutse ariko bamwirukaho baramufata. Uyu musirikare bivugwa ko yuriye urugo, asimbukira ahagana ku muryango imbere, aho yahise asanga umurinzi baragundagurana agerageza kumwaka imbunda anabasha kubigeraho nubwo yamurumye amaboko akamukomeretsa. Uyu murinzi w’iyi Sacco yaje kunganirwa n’abantu bahanyuze ahagana saa tanu z’ijoro bavuye ku mirimo babasha gufata uyu musirikare ubwo yageragezaga guhunga nyuma yo guteshwa akanakwa ibikoresho yari yitwaje harimo imbunda, ’ scie à métaux’ n’ibindi yari kwifashisha ashyira mu bikorwa umugambi we. Nyiraneza Edith, umucungamutungo  w’iyi sacco ubwo yaganiraga n’umunyamakuru wa Kigali Post yagize ati "Sacco yatewe, iterwa n’umuntu wari witwaje intwaro  ku bw’amahirwe umukozi wa Isco umurinzi wacu yabashishije kumurwanya ndetse anamwaka n’intwaro yari yitwaje, aratoroka aragenda ariko arafatwa." Amakuru y’uko uyu wafashwe ari umusirikare w’u Rwanda, yemejwe na Lt Colonel Mugemangango Innocent umuvugizi w’Ingabo z’u Rwanda. Ati "Hari umusirikare wa RDF uri mu bakekwa, uwo musirikare yafashwe (...) ubu iperereza ryatangiye." Bamwe mu batuye muri aka gace ibi byabereyemo by’umwihariko abanyamuryango b’iyi Sacco batangaje ko bishimiye ko iki kigo cy’imari cyabo kitibwe gusa bakavuga ko batewe impungenge n’ibi byabaye aho uwagakwiye kubacungira umutekano ari we wafashwe agerageza kuwuhungabanya, bakaba basaba ko yakanirwa urumukwiye.

title: Ibiciro by’inyubako zo muri Vision City byagabanyijweho 60% ku bakozi ba leta
content:
Ibiciro by’inzu zo guturamo mu mudugudu uzwi nka Vision City, byagabanyijweho 60% ku bakozi ba leta bakeneye inzu zo guturamo zijyanye n’icyiciro bariho. Izi nyubako ziherereye i Gacuriro mu Karere ka Gasabo. (inkuru ya IGIHE) Itangazo ryashyizwe ahagaragara n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere, RDB n’ikigo Ultimate Developers Ltd (UDL) gikurikirana uyu mushinga, rigaragaza ko abashyiriweho aya mahirwe ari abakozi ba leta batari ku rwego ruri hejuru y’Umuyobozi w’Ishami cyangwa urwego bingana. Rivuga ko kandi bagomba kuba ari ubwa mbere bagiye gutunga inzu haba no ku bo bashakanye ku bashyigniwe. Bazaba bemerewe kugura za ‘appartement’ zirimo iy’ibyumba bibiri, bitatu cyangwa bine, ku giciro cyagabanyijwe. Muri ubu buryo, inzu y’ibyumba bibiri izajya igurishwa miliyoni 63,000,000 Frw, zivuye ku giciro gisanzwe cya miliyoni 108 Frw. Iy’ibyumba bitatu izajya igurishwa miliyoni 94Frw mu gihe ubusnzwe yagurishwaga miliyoni 163, naho iy’ibyumba bine igurishwe miliyoni 108Frw mu gihe yagurishwaga miliyoni 187Frw. Ibi bigo byatangaje ko ku bakeneye inguzanyo, bazajya bayihabwa kuri 11% ishobora kwishyurwa mu myaka 20. Umuntu ukeneye inzu ku nguzanyo ashobora gusabwa 10% by’igiciro n’ubwo atari icyitonderwa. Nk’uko byatangajwe, abakeneye kugura izi nzu bazatanga ubusabe bwabo hagati ya tariki 16-31 Ukwakira 2018. Isuzuma ry’abemerewe inzu rizakorwa hagati ya tariki 1-21 Ugushyingo 2018. Umuyobozi wa Banki ya Kigali yemeye gutanga inguzanyo kuri izi nzu, Dr Diane Karusisi aheruka kubwira IGIHE ko iyi banki yemeye gutanga inguzanyo ku nyungu iri hasi kandi yishyurwa mu gihe kirekire, kuko ku isoko hamaze kuboneka inzu zijyanye n’igihe kandi bigaragara ko zikeneye igihe ngo zishyurwe bitewe n’igiciro ziriho. Icyo gihe byatekerezwaga ko inyungu kuri nguzanyo y’izi nzu yazaba ari ku nyungu ya 12%. Yagize ati “Iyi ni intangiriro ya gahunda yacu y’igihe kirekire yo gufasha Abanyarwanda mu mikoro yose bafite, ngo babashe kugira inzu; turi kwita iyi gahunda uburyo bushya bwo gutanga inguzanyo y’inzu.” Yakomeje agira ati “Inyungu ya 12 ku ijana ku nzu za Vision City ni umwihariko twagezeho hamwe n’abafatanyabikorwa bacu. Kongera imyaka yo kwishyura inguzanyo ikava kuri 15 ikagera kuri 20 ni ikimenyetso cy’uburyo tworohereje abantu, ku buryo bitewe n’amikoro y’umuntu, ashobora kwishyura munsi yayo, mu myaka irindwi, ariko ntirenge 20.” Iyi gahunda nshya yo gutanga inguzanyo z’inzu yashobotse ku bufatanye bw’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ubwishingizi, RSSB, gifite imigabane igera kuri 25.1% muri BK, kikaba ari nacyo muterankunga w’umushinga w’ubwubatsi ushyirwa mu bikorwa na UDL. Icyo gihe Umuyobozi w’agateganyo wa UDL, Eng. Alain Abimana, we yabwiye IGIHE ko bazajya babanza kumvikana n’umukiliya, bakabona kumwohereza muri banki. Yagize ati “Umuntu ushaka inzu azajya aza twumvikane, noneho tumwohereze muri banki, irebe ibisabwa kuko iyo banki igiye guha umuntu inguzanyo hari ibyo igomba kubanza gusesengura. Nibamara kumvikana na banki twe tuzasinyana amasezerano y’ubugure nawe, tuyohereze muri banki itwishyure, ubundi nawe asigare ayishyura.” Yakomeje avuga ko ari uburyo bwo gufasha abantu kugura inzu mu buryo buboroheje, kuko uyu munsi kujya muri banki gufata inguzanyo y’igihe kirekire, nibura baguha kuri 17.5%, ikinyuranyo hagati yayo n’iyi nguzanyo kikazaba ari amafaranga menshi. UDL ifite umushinga wo kubaka inzu zisaga 4,500 mu byiciro bine mu gihe cy’imyaka umunani. Mu cyiciro cya mbere hubatswe inzu 504, muri Mata izigera ku 120 zari zimaze kugurishwa.

title: BNR igiye kongera inoti za 500Frw ku isoko
content: Guverineri wa Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda yatangaje ko mu ntangiro z’umwaka utaha izongera umubare w’inoti za 500Frw ku isoko, nyuma y’uko abaturage bamaze iminsi bavuga ko izi noti zitakiri ku isoko mu buryo buhagije, n’izihari zikaba zishaje. Yabigarutseho kuri uyu wa kabiri nyuma y’inama y’Akanama gashinzwe politiki y’ifaranga, iba buri gihembwe. Yagize ati “Ikibazo turakizi, twaracyumvise ariko twakoranye n’amabanki kugira ngo, iyo abantu baje kubikuza burya abenshi baba bashaka gutwara inoti nini, noneho dusaba amabanki ko yakongera umubare w’inoti za 500Frw batanga iyo abantu baje kubikuza.” “Ikindi kubera ko ari inoti zimaze igihe zikoreshwa, ubu turi muri gahunda yo kuzisimbura cyangwa kuzongermo izindi nshyashya.” Yavuze ko ubusanzwe iyo inoti zimaze igihe zikoreshwa zigera aho zigasaza, gusa ngo izikenewe zirahari. Yakomeje agira ati “Twavuganye n’amabanki ko yarushaho kuziha abantu bajya kubikuza, ndetse tubongera n’izindi nshyashya twari dufite hano, ariko twatangiye gahunda yo kuzana izindi nshyashya, izo tuzazitanga igihe cyazo kigeze, twumva ko mu ntangiro z’umwaka utaha.” Yavuze ko ari ibisanzwe ko buri gihe inoti nyuma y’imyaka itatu zisimbuzwa, gusa ngo inoti za 500Frw zaherukaga gushyirwa ku isoko mu 2013. title: U Rwanda rwasinye amasezerano azafasha abasaga ibihumbi 50 gutunga inzu i Kinyinya
content:
Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yasinyanye amasezerano y’ubufatanye n’Ikigega cya Banki y’Isi cy’Imari gitera Inkunga imishinga y’Ishoramari (IFC) agamije kurufasha mu kubaka inzu ziciriritse i Kinyinya mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Aya masezerano yashyizweho umukono kuri uyu wa Kabiri, mu muhango wahuriranye n’itangizwa ry’Inama y’Iterambere ry’Ubukungu muri Afurika (DFF) yitabiriwe n’abantu barenga 300. Uyu mushinga uzashyirwa mu bikorwa ku bufatanye bwa IFC, Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ubwiteganyirize mu Rwanda (RSSB), Banki Itsura Amajyambere y’u Rwanda (BRD) n’Ikigo cy’Abashinwa kizobereye mu Bwubatsi cya Broad Homes Industrial International Co. Ltd. Biteganyijwe ko uzasozwa huzuye inyubako 10 000 zirimo izo guturamo n’izigenewe ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi muri Kinyinya. Uyu mushinga uzungukiramo abagera ku 50,000 uzatwara asaga miliyoni $200 (akabakaba miliyari 176 Frw). Visi Perezida ushinzwe Itumanaho n’Imikoranire muri IFC, Karin Finkelston, yavuze ko abikorera bafite uruhare mu kunoza imiturire mu mijyi ya Afurika. Yagize ati “IFC ishyigikira imishinga igamije kwagura uburyo bw’imiturire no kwegereza abaturage ba Afurika inzu nziza kandi ziciriritse.” Mu myaka 10 ishize, Ikigega Mpuzamahanga Gitsura Amajyambere (IDA) n’Igitanga Ingwate (MIGA) na IFC byatanze miliyari $100 mu ishoramari ry’abikorera.
Minisitiri w’Imari n’Igenamigambi, Dr Uzziel Ndagijimana, yatangaje ko imiturire ikirimo icyuho kinini ariko hari ingamba zafashwe. Ati “Muri gahunda ya Guverinoma y’imyaka irindwi harimo iyihariye yo kunoza imiturire muri Kigali no mu mijyi iyunganira. Dufitanye ubufatanye na Banki y’Isi.” “Hari imishinga ibiri igiye gutangira irimo uwa Kinyinya tumaze no gusinya amasezerano y’ibanze. Turateganya no gushyiraho ikigega cyihariye giteza imbere imiturire mu mijyi, kizatangirana na miliyoni $150 azakoreshwa mu gufasha abifuza inzu.” Inyigo yakozwe n’Umujyi wa Kigali, Minisitiri y’Ibikorwa remezo n’Umuryango w’Abibumbye mu 2012, yagaragaje ko hazaba hari icyuho cy’inzu 344,000 ku bazikeneye mu 2020. Imibare igaragaza ko buri mwaka hubakwa iziri hagati ya 800 na 1000 zo gutuzamo abaturage mu gihe ikibazo cy’imiturire cyakemuka hubatswe nibura 31,000. Mu Ukuboza 2016, Banki y’Isi yemeye gutanga miliyari $75 mu kurandura ubukene bukabije. Afurika yagenewe miliyari $45. Banki y’Isi iheruka guha u Rwanda miliyoni $95, azashorwa mu bikorwa remezo birimo imihanda ireshya n’ibilometero 81 izubakwa mu mijyi itandatu yunganira Kigali.

title: Polisi yatangiye umukwabu wo gufata imodoka zifite ibirahure byijimye
content:
Umuvugizi w’Ishami rya Polisi rishinzwe umutekano wo mu muhanda, SSP Jean Marie Vianney Ndushabandi, yatangaje ko Polisi y’u Rwanda, ishami ryayo rishinzwe umutekano wo mu muhanda ryatangiye gukora umukwabu wo gufata imodoka zifite ibirahure byijimye mu gihugu hose. Polisi ivuga ko imodoka zifite ibirahure byijimye rimwe na rimwe zikorerwamo ibyaha nko kunywebwamo ibiyobyabwenge, kujyana abana mu bikorwa bitemewe n’amategeko nko kubajyana mu tubari, mu tubyiniro ndetse rimwe na rimwe mu bikorwa by’urukozasoni. Ivuga ko mu mukwabu wakorewe mu gihugu hose, ku munsi wa mbere w’uyu mukwabu hafashwe imodoka hafi 100 zifite ibirahure byijimye.

 Ku munsi wa mbere hafashwe imodoka 100  SSP Ndushabandi yavuze ko imodoka zifite ibirahure byijimye zitemewe, ko ababifite ku modoka baba bica amategeko n’amabwiriza agenga ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda, ashingiye ku iteka rya Perezida wa Repubulika n°85/01 ryo ku wa 02/09/2002 rishyiraho amabwiriza rusange agenga imihanda n’uburyo bwo kuyigendamo. Yakomeje agira ati “By’umwihariko ingingo yaryo ya 85 ndetse n’ubukangurambaga twakoze mu bihe bishize ariko abatunze ibinyabiziga bifite ibi birahure bakavunira ibiti mu matwi, kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 18 Nyakanga twatangiye umukwabu mu gihugu hose wo gufata imodoka zigifite ibirahure byijimye no guhana ba nyirazo, tutaretse no kubasaba kubikuraho.”

 Abazifatanywe barahanwa bakanategekwa kubikuramo  Iyi ngingo ya 85 ivuga ko ibintu bibonerana bigize umubiri w’inyuma w’ikinyabiziga habariwemo ikirahuri gihagarika umuyaga cyangwa ibigize ikibambasi cy’imbere, bigomba kuba bikoze ku buryo iyo bimenetse, ibyago byo gukomereka byagabanuka uko bishoboka kwose. Ikomeza ivuga ko ibirahure byo guhagarika umuyaga bigomba kuba bikozwe mu bintu bibonerana bidacuya kandi bikaba bikozwe ku buryo bidahindura isura y’ibireberwamo kandi mu gihe bimenetse, umuyobozi agakomeza kubona bihagije inzira nyabagendwa. SSP Ndushabandi yakomeje avuga ati “Nubwo twakomeje gukora ubukangurambaga tukanagira inama abafite imodoka zifite ibirahure byijimye ngo babikureho kuko baba bica amategeko n’amabwiriza agenga ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda, byaragaragaye ko imodoka nk’izi zikomeza kwiyongera, bikaba aribyo byatumye dukora uyu mukwabu ngo tubakangurire kubahiriza amategeko.” “Turagira inama abafite imodoka zifite ibi birahure byijimye kubihindura, kugirango batazabihanirwa hakurikijwe amategeko.”

 Abazifite bose baragirwa inama yo kubikuramo  SSP Ndushabandi yashimangiye ko nk’uko bisanzwe, guhana abanyamakosa bikorwa ari uko izindi ngamba zose zananiranye, bityo Polisi ikaba yasabye abafite imodoka zifite ibirahure byijimye gukurikiza amategeko n’amabwiriza aho kugirango bazabikore bamaze no kubihanirwa. title: Kuba ‘Rwiyemezamirimo’ bivuze iki? Ese Rwiyemezamirimo ugamije gukora neza arangwa n’iki? Menya ibyo ab’indashyikirwa bahuriyeho
content: Kuba rwiyemezamirimo birenze kure gutangira ubucuruzi. Ba rwiyemezamirimo nyabo bahora bahanga udushya, bashishikariye gutera imbere, bahora bafata iya mbere mu byo bakora byose, bahora bahugiye ku murimo wabo, mbese bashishikajwe no kugera ku nzozi zabo. Ba rwiyemezamirimo usanga bafite uburyo bumwe batekerezamo kandi buri rwiyemezamirimo akaba afite ibintu bimuranga bituma ashobora gukora neza umurimo we. Ibi bikaba biruta kure kugira impamyabushobozi ihanitse mu bucuruzi iturutse mu ishuri ry’ubucuruzi rya Havard, cyangwa se kugira ubumenyi bwa tekinike mu kintu runaka. Muri iyi nkuru tugiye kurebera hamwe ibintu 7 by’ingenzi biranga rwiyemezamirimo ukora neza nkuko tubikesha ikinyamakuru The Service Mag, mu nyandiko nabo bakesha umwanditsi Kristine Geimure yanyujije ku rubuga rwa interneri rwa Woopidoo.com 1.Kuba yifitemo ikibatsi cyo kugera ku ntego Ba rwiyemezamirimo baba bifitemo ikibatsi  cyo kugera ku musaruro mwiza  no kwagura ibikorwa byabo. Bareba kure kandi ugasanga bahora bashakisha uko bakomeza gutera imbere. Biha intego nyinshi kandi bagahora baharanira kuzigeraho batitaye ku nzitizi bahura nazo mu rugendo rwabo. 2.Kwigirira icyizere gikomeye Ba rwiyemezamirimo bakora neza baba bifitiye icyizere kandi ugasanga ari abantu badahindagurika mu migirire yabo. Bibanda ku cyo bakora ntibatatanye ingufu kugira ngo bagere ku ntego bihaye kandi bahora bizeye ubushobozi bwabo mu gukora icyo biyemeje. Bahora babona ko ibyiza biri imbere abandi bakababona nk’abihazi. Ba rwiyemezamirimo usanga bashyira ingufu zabo zose ku cyo bakora ntibate igihe ku bitekerezo byo kunenga bitubaka. 3.Gushaka ibitekerezo bishya no guhanga udushya Ba rwiyemezamirimo usanga bahora bifuza kunoza ibyo bakora no kuvugurura ibyo bagurisha. Bahora bashakisha uko ibyo bakora byavugururwa, bahora bahanga udushya, bashakisha ibitekerezo bishya n’aho babivoma. 4.Guhora biteguye guhindura ibintu Iyo babonye hari ikintu kitagenda neza bahita bagihindura. Ba rwiyemezamirimo bazi akamaro ko guhora bakora ibikorwa by’indashyikirwa, kandi uburyo bwo guhora ari aba mbere bugenda butera imbere bunajyana n’igihe. Bahora bazi ibigezweho, tekinoloji na serivisi bigezweho kandi bagahora biteguye kugira icyo bahindura iyo babonye amahirwe mashya. 5.Kugira umuco wo gupiganwa n’abandi Ba rwiyemezamirimo beza bahora bapiganwa. Uburyo bwonyine bubafasha kugera ku ntego zabo no guhora bakora ibikorwa by’indashyikirwa ni uguhora bapigana n’abandi. 6.Bahorana ibakwe n’ubushake Ba rwiyemezamirimo ntibicara hamwe bahorana ibakwe n’imbaraga nyinshi. Ikibabamo ni ukugera ku ntego bihaye kandi bagahora bifitemo akanyabugabo. Guhora bafite ibikorwa by’indashyikirwa no guhora bifuza gutera imbere bisaba ko baba bifitemo ubushake. 7.Kwemera kunengwa ku buryo bwubaka Ba rwiyemezamirimo bahora bahanga udushya, bahora hafi y’ibikorwa byabo bakumva gake ibivugwa ngo ‘ntibishoboka’. Baremera bagahindura iyo banenzwe ku buryo bwubaka kandi bubafasha muri gahunda zabo, ntibaha agaciro ibitekerezo biterekana ko ibyiza biri imbere. Ba rwiyemezamirimo beza bazi ko kunengwa n’inzitizi bitabura iyo ukora ubucuruzi bugenda neza, bityo bagakemura ibibazo bafite ku buryo bukwiye. Ngayo ng’uko, ng’ibi iby’ingenzi biranga rwiyemezamirimo nyawe, ufite intumbero yo gutera imbere no kwagura ibikorwa bye. *Ifoto ibanza ni Mark Zuckerberg washinze urubuga rwa Facebook, akaba ari umwe muri ba rwiyemezamirimo bakomeye ndetse bakiri bato isi ifite hamwe na Sina Gerrard, umwe muri ba rwiyemezamirimo bazwi cyane mu Rwanda ku bw’ibikorwa bye

title: Gatsata: Abatuye mu manegeka bari kwimurwa ku ngufu
content:
Abatuye mu manegeka mu Murenge wa Gatsata, Akarere ka Gasabo, batangiye kwimurwa ku ngufu mu gihe bo baseta ibirenge bavuga ko ntaho kwerekeza bafite. Aba baturage biganjemo abacuruzi bakorera mu nyubako zitagenewe ubucuruzi, bavuga ko bahangayikishijwe cyane n’uburyo ubuyobozi bubasaba kwimuka huti huti kandi nta ngurane bahawe. Abaganiriye n’ikinyamakuru Igihe dukesha iyi nkuru, mu basabwe kwimurwa, bagaragaje ko batewe impungenge n’aho kwerekeza.

 Nubwo bari mu manegeka, baravuga ko bigoye kubona ahandi berekeza  Umwe mu bafite inyubako mu Kagari ka Nyamabuye utarashatse ko izina rye ritangazwa, yagize ati “Ni gute ubuyobozi bufata icyemezo cyo kutwimura ku ngufu mu byacu butaraduha ingurane kandi amabwiriza ariko abiteganya? None se babona twakwimukira hehe nta mafaranga byibuze twahawe ngo tujye kugura ahandi?” Uwitwa Bizimungu Armand we yavuze ko atiyumvisha igikurikizwa kugira ngo ingo zimwe na zimwe zishyirwe mu manegeka izindi ntiziyashyirwemo kandi ziba zegeranye cyangwa zifatanye. Yagize ati “Harimo akarengane kuko ntabwo byumvikana uko umuntu bavuga ko ari mu manegeka agomba kwimuka umuturanyi we ntibabimubwire kandi inzu zabo zisa nk’aho zifatanye, numva niba twese dutuye mu gishanga twagakwiye kwimurwa twese ntawe barenganyije?” Umucuruzi w’ibyuma by’imodoka, Mugabo Rénald, we yavuze ko biteguye gukurikiza ibyo basabwa n’ubuyobozi ariko akagaragaza ko babangamiwe n’igihe gito cyo kuba bimutse. Yagize ati “Turabyiteguye cyane ko tuzimuka ariko dufite ikibazo kuko baduhaye iminsi mike yo kuba twavuye aha ku buryo tutazi aho tuzimukira, kuko kubona inzu nacyo ni ikindi kibazo.”

 Abacururiza ahatarabigenewe nabo batagetswe kwimuka  Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge wa Gatsata, Ntiyamira Faustin, yavuze ko bari gushyira mu bikorwa imyanzuro yafashwe ndetse muri aka gace hateganywa kwimurwa ingo zirenga 600. Yagize ati “Turi gushyira mu bikorwa imyanzuro kuko bahawe inyandiko z’Umujyi wa Kigali n’iza REMA n’iz’Umurenge kandi bagaragarijwe mu ibarura ryakozwe ko bubatse mu gishanga; ikindi inzu zishobora kuba zubatse hamwe ariko zidafite ibibazo bimwe kuko hari abakorera mu nzu zagenewe ubucuruzi n’abari mu zagenewe guturwamo.” Yongeyeho ko iki gikorwa cyatangiriye mu kagali ka Nyamabuye kagaragaramo abacururiza mu nzu zitagenewe ubucuruzi ariko kizakomereza n’ahandi.

Inkuru ya Igihe

title: Kayonza: Impyisi ziraye mu ihene z’umuturage zica hafi 20
content: Impyisi bikekwa ko zasigaye inyuma y’uruzitiro rugabanya Pariki y’Akagera n’abaturage mu Murenge wa Mwili zishe ihene 17 z’umuturage, izindi 12 ziburirwa irengero. Ku mugoroba wo ku wa Kane nibwo impyisi zateye ihene za Nteziryayo Célèstin wo mu Murenge wa Mwili, Akagali ka Kageyo, Umudugudu wa Gisunzu. Uyu muturage yabwiye IGIHE dukesha iyi nkuru ko bagerageje kwirukana izo mpyisi ariko bikanga. Yagize ati “Zateye ku mugoroba rwose, ihene ziraturumbuka impyisi zizirukaho zigenda zizica umugenda abashumba barahurura. Ubu zimwe turi kugenda tuzitoragura ari imitumbi.” Nteziryaryo yavuze ko bidasanzwe kubona inyamaswa zo muri pariki zibarira amatungo angana atyo. Ati “Uyu munsi nibwo bikabije. Ubundi zatwiciraga inka, ihene rimwe zikanayitwara ntituyibone ariko uyu munsi nibwo bwa mbere zishe ihene zirenga 20 ingunga imwe.” Mu gitondo cyo ku wa Gatanu, Nteziryayo yavuze ko yari amaze kubona ihene 17 ze zapfuye n’izindi eshatu zakomeretse bikabije ku buryo bigoye ko zabaho. Yavuze ko hari izindi hene 12 baburiye irengero batazi niba zapfuye cyangwa zahunze. Leta y’u Rwanda yashyizeho ikigega Social Grant Fund cyishyura abangirijwe n’inyamaswa zaturutse muri Pariki. Icyakora Nteziryayo afite impungenge ko ihene atabonye atazazishyurwa kuko bisabwa kwerekana ibisigazwa by’itungo ryishwe kugira ngo ryishyurwe. Ati “Nk’ubu nk’izi ntabonye ntabwo nshobora kuzirihwa kuko iyo zifasha ihene zikayitwara ntabwo ushobora kubabwira ngo hari ihene yanjye yabuze uterekanye igisigazwa ngo wishyurwe.” Ubwo yaganiraga na IGIHE, Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Kayonza, Murenzi Jean Claude, yavuze ko ubusanzwe iyo hari inyamaswa za pariki zageze hanze, abaturage babimenyesha pariki zigasubizwamo, abangirijwe bakishyurwa. Nteziryayo yavuze ko pariki bayimenyesheje iby’izo mpyisi, izana imitego yo kuzifata ngo zisubizwe muri pariki imbere ariko ngo zamenye amayeri yo kwivana muri iyo mitego ku buryo ubu izasigaye hanze zitagifatwa. Pariki y’Akagera ifite uruzitiro rw’ibilometero 110 rurimo amashanyarazi rutandukanya pariki n’ikindi gice gikorerwamo imirimo n’abaturage. Urwo ruzitiro nirwo rufasha mu kubuza inyamaswa ziri imbere kujya konera cyangwa kwangiriza abaturage.

title: Umuhanda wa Kigali-Gatuna-Kampala wongeye kwangirika bikomeye
content:
Mu minsi mike ishize nibwo umuhanda wa Gatuna uhuza u Rwanda na Uganda wari wangiritse ndetse imodoka nini zibuzwa kuwucamo mu gihe cy’iminsi 4 maze urasanwa urongera urakora. Kuri ubu ariko uyu muhanda wongeye kwangirika bikomeye, ariko noneho wangirikira ku ruhande rwa Uganda aho wangirikiye mu karere ka Kabale ahitwa Kyonyo, ndetse ubuyobozi na Polisi bakaba basaba abantu kwirinda kuwukoresha. Aganira n’urubuga Chimpreports, Umuvugizi wa Polisi Emilian Kayima, yatangaje ko bafatanyije n’inzego z’ibanze barimo kugerageza kuyobora abakoresha uyu muhanda ngo batagerageza kuwukoresha kuko wangiritse bikomeye.

Uyu muhanda wangiritse cyane kubera imvura Yagize ati “Abakoresha umuhanda baragirwa inama yo kunyura mu muhanda mushya wuzuye wa Ntungamo - Mirama Hills uhuza n’u Rwanda. Twashyizeho ibimenyetso biyobora abantu.” Mu Rwanda, uyu muhanda wari wangirikiye mu murenge wa Cyumba, mu karere ka Gicumbi bituma ku wa 14 Gicurasi, 2018 maze imodoka nini ziwukoresha ahanini zerekeza Uganda zicishwa ku muhanda wa Kagitumba. Ku wa 18 Gicurasi 2018, nibwo wongeye kuba nyabagendwa.

title: Kigali: Ibikoresho bya Family TV byafatiriwe
content:
Ibikoresho bya Family TV byafatiriwe n’umuhesha w’inkiko, mu gikorwa cyo gukurikira irangizarubanza iki kigo cyatsinzwemo, ariko ubuyobozi bwacyo ntibwubahirize umwanzuro w’urukiko ngo bwishyure ideni bwaregwaga. Igihe, dukesha iyi nkuru yanditse ko ifite amakuru ko kuri uyu wa Gatatu ubwo abanyamakuru bo kuri iyi televiziyo bateguraga amakuru ya saa sita, aribwo umuhesha w’inkiko aherekejwe n’abapolisi babiri, yinjiye mu nyubako Family TV ikoreramo ku Kacyiru hafi na Minisiteri y’Ubuhinzi n’Ubworozi. Umwe mu bakozi b’iyi televiziyo yavuze ko yari mu cyumba bagenzuriramo ibikorwa bya televiziyo, bamubwira guhagarika ibikorwa byose, maze ibikoresho batangira kubizinga.

 Ibikoresho byapakiwe birajyanwa  Yavuze ko ikibazo nyamukuru ari ideni bivugwa ko ari irya “miliyoni umunani” (hari n’uwavuze miliyoni 80Frw) Family TV ifitiye ikigo cyayigurishaga internet, maze itinda kwishyura kugeza ubwo hitabajwe inkiko. Undi mukozi yagize ati “Ntabwo twamenye ngo ni iki cyabaye, ariko twumvise ko hari abantu bashobora kuba barareze mu rukiko bitewe n’amadeni bari bafitiwe kera, bakajya mu rukiko rero.” “Ntabwo twamenye ngo ni iki cyabaye, twari turi mu kazi tubona abantu baraje baratubwira ngo twebwe tube dusohotse, bavugana n’abayobozi, birangira ibintu byose babishyize hanze, natwe nta kindi kintu twamenye.”

 Abakozi ba Family TV batunguwe  Amakuru agera kuri Igihe kandi aturutse mu kigo cyahaye internet iyi televiziyo, ashimangira ko iryo deni ryabayeho mu 2016 nubwo hatamenyekanye neza ingano yaryo, bagerageza inzira z’ibiganiro ariko kwishyura birananirana, biyambaza urukiko rw’ubucuruzi. Uwatanze amakuru yagize ati “Sinzi impamvu yatumye atishyura, ikibazo cyarabaye, hari serivisi twabahaye, ariko haza kugera aho bananirwa gukomeza kwishyura, duhagarika amasezerano. Ariko nk’uko amategeko abiteganya, urubanza rwarabaye hagera igihe cy’ubwishyu, ubu umuhesha w’inkiko niwe uri kubikurikirana.” Hari n’amakuru avuga ko ubuyobozi bwa Family TV bwanze kwitaba urukiko, kugeza ubwo urubanza rwageze aho ruba itegeko.

 Ibi bikoresho byafatiriwe hifashishijwe umuhesha w’inkiko  Umunyamakuru yagerageje kubaza amakuru ubwo ibikoresho byajyanwaga, Umuyobozi wa Family TV, Nsabimana John, amusaba gutegerereza hanze y’ikigo kugeza ubwo kuvugana binaniranye. Na nyuma yanagerageje kumuhamagara kuri telefoni aritaba, umunyamakuru aramwibwira undi arikiriza, amubwira icyo amushakira, aho kumusubiza ahita agira ati “Wakwihangana gato kuko ndi mu nama ihangane gatoya, waza kumpamagara nka nyuma y’isaha.” Nyuma y’isaha ntabwo yitabye telefoni. Hari n’abakozi bareze ubuyobozi bwa Family TV Bamwe mu bakozi b’iyi televiziyo babwiye Igihe, ko iki kigo gifite abakozi benshi cyagiye gikoresha kibereyemo imyenda, ku buryo hari abagiye bagana inkiko abandi bakagana abagenzuzi b’umurimo. Umwe yagize ati “Harimo na bamwe bagiye batanga ibirego ntibigire icyo bitanga, barahari. Nanjye byambayeho, ukwezi kwa mbere kurashira, ukwa kabiri, ukwa gatatu, ukwa kane ubundi bakaza bakaguha make, bandimo nk’ibihumbi 800 Frw.” Undi nawe yavuze ko babagiyemo amadeni ku buryo byageze aho umuntu wumva arambiwe ahita asezera. Yakomeje agira ati “Yirukanye umuyobozi wa gahunda za televiziyo nawe kubera ko yamwishyuje, nanjye namaze kubona amaze kungeramo menshi ndigendera, njye yari andimo ibihumbi 750 Frw.” Inkuru ya Igihe

title: Abapilote ba Brussels Airlines bari mu myigaragabyo batumye 75% by’ingendo zari ziteganijwe zisubikwa kuri uyu wa Mbere
content:
Ubwumvikane buke hagati y’ubuyobozi n’abapilote ba kompanyi y’indege y’Ububiligi, Brussels Airlines bukomeje gufata indi ntera aho kuri uyu wa Mbere imyigaragabyo yabo yatumye 75% y’ingendo zari ziteganijwe zitaba. Nk’uko byahamijwe n’umuvugizi w’iyi kompanyi, Wencke Lemmes, 25% gusa by’ingendo zari ziteganijwe nizo zabashije gukorwa ndetse ngo ku kibuga cy’indege cya Brussels airport haramukiye umutuzo. Ni mugihe kandi kuri uyu wa mbere ubuyobozi bwa Brussels Airlines bwongeye guhura n’amashyirahamwe (syndicats) y’abapilote kugira ngo bongere barebere hamwe uko bakumvikana.

Ingendo nyinshi zasubitswe Hagati yo kuri uyu wa Mbere no ku wa Gatatu w’iki cyumweru, Brussels airlines izahura n’imyigaragabyo yakabiri mu mateka yayo y’abapilote kubera kutumvikana ku bijyanye no kuzamurirwa imishahara n’ibindi bijyanye n’imibereho myiza mu kazi kabo. Muri rusange abagenzi ibihumbi 60 nibo bagizweho ingaruka n’iki kibazo cy’iyi kompanyi inakorera mu Rwanda. Iyi kompanyi yabashije kuvugisha abasaga ibihumbi 55, aho abenshi bahawe amatike mashya naho abandi bafite uburenganzira bwo gusubizwa amafaranga yabo cyangwa bakaba banatanga ibirego.

Abagenzi babigendeyemo Imyigaragabyo y’iminsi ibiri abapilote ba Brussels airlines badakora kugeza ku wa Gatatu, izateza igihombo gikomeye iyi kompanyi aho biteganijwe ko ishobora gutakaza arenga miliyoni 10 z’ama-Euro (ni ukuvuga arenga miliyari 10frw) nk’uko byatangajwe na perezida w’inama y’ubutegetsi ya SN Airholding ihagarariye iyi kompanyi.

title: Gakenke: Polisi yafashe Abakozi babiri ba SACCO bakekwaho kunyereza asaga Miliyoni 15
content: Polisi y’u Rwanda mu karere ka Gakenke, ku cyumweru tariki 6 z’uku kwezi yafashe abakozi babiri ba SACCO Nemba iri mu karere ka Gakenke bakekwaho kunyereza amafaranga y’u Rwanda asaga Miliyoni 15. Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru, Chief Inspector of Police (CIP) Hamdun Twizeyimana yavuze ko abafashwe ari Clothilde Mukantabana w’imyaka  34 y’amavuko wari Umuyobozi w’iyi SACCO ukekwaho kunyereza amafaranga y’u Rwanda 15,465,000 na Aphrodis Nsabimana ufite imyaka 26 y’amavuko ukekwaho kunyereza  amafaranga y’u Rwanda 346,500. CIP Twizeyimana yavuze bafashwe nyuma y’igenzura ryakozwe n’Abakozi ba Banki Nkuru y’Igihugu (BNR) basanze amafaranga angana kuriya yaranyerejwe; aba bombi bafatwa bakekwa kuba ari bo bayanyereje bashyikirizwa Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ubugenzacyaha (RIB). Yongeyeho ko amakuru y’inyereza ry’amafaranga muri iyo SACCO yatanzwe n’umwe mu bakozi bayo wayahaye Ubuyobozi bwa BNR; imenyekana ryabyo rikaba ryarakurikiwe n’igenzura. Yagarutse ku ngaruka zo kunyereza umutungo agira ati,"Irigiswa ry’umutungo; waba uwa  Leta cyangwa n’undi wose rigira ingaruka ku bukungu n’iterambere by’Igihugu kubera ko uribwa n’umuntu cyangwa abantu kandi ugenewe rubanda. Umuntu ushinzwe ibya rubanda akwiriye kubicunga neza. Agomba kwirinda kunyereza amafaranga ndetse n’ikindi cyose ashinzwe gucunga." Umuvugizi wa Polisi muri iyi Ntara yashimye uwatanze amakuru yatumwe aba bombi bafatwa; aboneraho gusaba ibayituye kwirinda ibyaha aho biva bikagera no gutanga amakuru ku gihe atuma inzego zibishinzwe zibikumira zikanafata ababikoze. Ingingo ya 325 y’Igitabo cy’Amategeko ahana ibyaha mu Rwanda ivuga ko Umukozi wese urigisa umutungo, amafaranga, impapuro zivunjwa amafaranga, ibyemezo by’imari n’inyandiko bya Leta cyangwa bitari ibya Leta cyangwa ibintu byimukanwa by’undi yabikijwe ku bw’umurimo ashinzwe;  wonona cyangwa urigisa, akoresheje uburiganya, impapuro zifite agaciro k’imari, yabikijwe cyangwa yahawe ku bw’umurimo ashinzwe; ahanishwa igifungo kuva ku myaka irindwi (7) kugeza ku myaka icumi (10) n’ihazabu y’amafaranga yikubye inshuro kuva kuri ebyiri (2) kugeza kuri eshanu (5) z’agaciro k’umutungo warigishijwe cyangwa wononwe. Inkuru y’urubuga rwa Polisi

title: Abapilote ba Brussels Airlines batanze integuza yo kwigaragambya
content:
Brussels Airlines imwe mu makompanyi y’indege mpuzamahanga akorera mu Rwanda kuri ubu yahawe integuza n’abapilote bayo bayibwira ko mu mpera z’icyumweru gitaha bazigaragambya niba ntagihindutse. Ibi aba bapilote babyanditse nyuma y’uko ubuyobozi bw’iyi kompanyi bushyizeho impinduka zitishimwe n’abagera kuri 80% b’abapilote, bityo barasaba ko izo mpinduka zisubirwamo bitabaye ibyo ku ya 11 Gicurasi, 2018, bagakora imyigaragambyo. Hagati aho muri iyi minsi 7 isigaye, abakozi n’ubuyobozi bafite umwanya wo gutekereza ku kigomba gukorwa, hanyuma bakarebera hamwe uko babikemura.

 Abatwara indege barateganya kwigaragambya mu cyumweru gitaha  Si ubwa mbere ibi bibaye kuri Brussels Airlines kuko mu mwaka wa 2013 habayeho ibisa n’imyigaragambyo maze abapilote bahagarika akazi mu gihe cy’isaha yose ndetse no mu ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka, abapilote b’iyi kompanyi bahagaritse akazi mu gihe cy’iminota mike kugira ngo bumvikanishe ijwi ryabo.

title: USA: Bamwe mu barimu ba leta biraye mu mihanda basaba kongererwa umushahara-AMAFOTO
content:
Ibihumbi by’abarimu muri Leta ya Kentucky na Oklahoma bahuriye mu myigaragambyo kuri uyu wa Mbere aho basaba kongererwa umushahara ndetse hagashyirwaho uburyo bwisumbuye bwo gufasha amashuri ya Leta. Amasomo menshi yahagaritswe muri izi leta uko ari ebyiri. Mu duce tumwe byahuriranye n’uko ibigo by’amashuri bifunze kubera ibiruhuko by’itumba (printemps) ariko mu tundi duce ubuyobozi ntibwabashije kubona abasimbura bahagije.
 Abarimu basaga ibihumbi 30 bagombaga kwigaragambya muri Oklahoma (mu majyepfo) no mu bindi bice bitandukanye birimo Frankfort, umurwa mukuru wa Kentucky. Iyi myigaragambyo ni yo ya nyuma iheruka ikomeye ibayeho y’abarimu b’ibigo bya leta nyuma y’imyigarambyo y’iminsi 9 yo muri Werurwe muri Virginie yatumye abarimo bo muri iyo leta bongererwa umushahara nyuma y’imyaka ine yari ishize.



 Muri Kentucky bigaragambirije imbere y’Inteko y’iyi Leta barwanya umushinga wo guhindura uburyo bw’ikiruhuko cy’izabakuru ndetse banasaba ko amashuri ya leta yakongererwa ubushobozi mu buryo bw’amafaranga.

Muri Oklahoma ho ngo abarimu bamwe bavuga ko bibasaba kugira akandi kazi ka kabiri kugira ngo babashe kubaho mu buzima bwabo bwa buri munsi, harimo nko gukora muri resitora bakira abakiliya no gusukura ubusitani. Kongererwa ibihumbi 6,100 by’amadorali(asaga miliyoni 6 n’ibihumbi 300frw) ku mwaka bavuga ko bidahagije. Ni mu gihe iyi leta yari imwe muri 12 zagabanyije ingengo y’imari yageneraga uburezi nyuma y’ihungabana ry’ubukungu ryo mu 2008 ariko n’ubwo muri iki gihe ubukungu bwasubiye ku murongo ngo ntabwo yigeze yongera kuzamurwa mu burezi ahubwo amafaranga yongerewe mu bindi bice by’ubuzima.

title: Amerika yafatiye u Rwanda ibihano kubera guca caguwa
content: Kuva u Rwanda rwafata icyemezo cyo guca imyenda ya caguwa, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ntiyasibye kugaragaza ko itishimiye iki cyemezo ndetse yamaze no gufatira u Rwanda ibihano. Mu ibaruwa Perezida wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Donald Trump yandikiye Inteko Ishingamategeko, yavuze ko by’agateganyo agiye guhagarika inyungu u Rwanda rwakuraga muri gahunda ihuza iki gihugu n’ibindi bya Afurika yo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara “African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA), nko kugabanyirizwa imisoro n’ibindi. Ibi ariko ntibivuze ko u Rwanda rwakuwe muri AGOA, ahubwo ni ibihano by’igihe gito, nk’uko ibaruwa ya Trump ibivuga, bakaba bizeye ko ibi bituma u Rwanda rwongera kugirana na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ibiganiro ikongera gukomorera caguwa ziva muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Ibihugu byo mu muryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba (EAC), byafashe icyemezo cyo guca intege imyenda n’inkweto za Caguwa bituruka muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Canada, u Bwongereza n’ahandi, aho nko mu Rwanda kuva ku itariki 1 Nyakanga 2016, ibyinjizwa mu gihugu byongererewe umusoro ukubye inshuro 25 ugereranyije n’uwari usanzwe.

title: Ibiciro by’ingendo mu mujyi wa Kigali no mu ntara byazamuwe
content:
Ku ri uyu wa Kane, tariki ya 29 Werurwe, 2018 nibwo Urwego Ngenzuramikorere, RURA rwatangaje ko ibiciro by’ingendo byazamuwe haba ku bagenda hagati mu Mujyi wa Kigali, haba no kubagenda mu Ntara zose z’igihugu. Mu itangazo RURA yashyize ahagaragara yavuze ko igiciro cy’urugendo ruva mu mujyi umwe ujya mu wundi byavuye ku mafaranga 19 ku kilometero bijya ku mafaranga 21 ku kilometero, mu gihe umugenzi ugenda mu mujyi wa Kigali yishyuraga amafaranga 20 ku kilometero agiye kujya yishyura 22.

 Ibi biciro byaherukaga guhindurwa muri 2015  Ibi biciro byazamuwe nyuma y’imyaka 3, dore ko RURA yaherukaga guhindura ibi biciro mu mwaka wa 2015, bikaba byemeranyijwe ko bizajya bihindurwa buri myaka 2, mu gihe igiciro cya mazutu kitagiye hejuru y’amafaranga 959 cyangwa munsi ya 817. Ibi biciro bishya bizatangira gushyirwa mu bikorwa ku wa Mbere, tariki ya 2 Mata, 2018. RURA yavuze ko mbere y’uko ibi biciro bitangira gushyirwa mu bikorwa bazashyira ahagaragara gahunda y’ibiciro nyirizina bishya bigiye kujyabikurikizwa mu ngendo, maze abaturage bakabimenyeshwa.

title: France: Ikigo gicuruza indaya z’ibikinisho cyateje impaka
content:
Mu gihugu y’Ubufaransa, haje ubucuruzi bw’indaya zo mu bipupe ariko bwateje impaka zikomeye haba ku ruhande rw’abaturage ubwabo ndetse n’ubuyobozi. Ibi bikinisho cyangwa se ibipupe biteye nk’umuntu bicuruzwa n’ikigo cyitwa  Xdolls guhera mu ntangiriro za Gashyantare, 2018 aho ubikeneye aza akavugana n’ubuyobozi akishyura mu ibanga akijyanira indaya ye.

 Ibi ibikinisho biba bimeze nk’abantu  Uretse kandi n’ubigura agiye aho biri, hari n’ababigura kuri internet aho igipupe kimwe gikodeshwa amayero 98 (92,395frw) ku isaha imwe n’amayero 149(154,685frw) ku masaha abiri mu gihe ugiye kugikoresha uri umwe ariko mwaba muri babiri mukishyura amayero 120 (124,578frw) ku isaha imwe. Ababirwanya bavuga ko ibi ari ukunyuranya n’amategeko ndetse ko ari no gutesha agaciro umugore. Umwe muri bo yagize ati "Bica amategeko, bagaha abakiriya babo indaya zo mu bipupe, turasaba Umujyi kubikurikirana mu mategeko bityo hafungwe." 

 Indaya zisanzwe zikora aka kazi nazo zatangiye kwigaragambya  Uyoboye ababirwanya, Nicolas Bonnet-Oulaldj we yahamije ko ibi bikinisho bikodeshwa ku isaha "Bitanga isura iciriritse ku bagore ndetse n’amajwi yabyo asa n’agaragaza ihohotera rishingiye ku gitsina cyangwa ifatwa ku ngufu. Turashaka kumenya icyo amategeko abivugaho."
 Meya wa Paris, Anne Hidalgo we avuga ko "Ibyo bitari mu bishishikaje umujyi" arakomeza ati "Gushaka kubuzanya ubucuruzi bw’ibikoresho by’imibonano mpuzabitsina, ikorwa mu buryo uyikora aba akuze kandi ariwe ubigizemo ubushake, ntabwo byemewe n’amategeko." Ese wowe ubona ute kuba umuntu  yakorana imibonano mpuzabitsina n’igipupe? Src:BBC

title: Kigali: Igiciro cya lisansi na mazutu cyazamutse

title: Polisi yatahuye ibindi bimenyetso byerekana bwa bujura bwa miliyoni 10 muri T2000
content: Iperereza ku bujura bwa miliyoni 10 bwabaye mu ntangiriro z’uku kwezi muri T2000 ryerekanye ibindi bimenyetso byerekana ko koko Nsengimana ashobora kuba yaribye aya mafaranga. Ibimenyetso byatahuwe birimo moto eshatu zari zaraguzwe na Nsengimana aziguze muri ya mafaranga bikekwa ko yibye. Nsengimana Ismael yahoze ari umukozi muri T2000, akaba akekwaho kwiba ayo mafaranga ku itariki ya 9 Gashyantare, akaza gufatwa asigaranye ibihumbi Magana ane na mirongo ine (440, 000Frw )by’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Nsengimana arakekwaho gukora ubu bujura bwa miliyoni icumi ubwo yasabwaga n’umukoresha we kubitsa miliyoni 36, ariko we akabitsa miliyoni 26 hanyuma agatorokana ziriya 10 akajya i Huye. Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo Chief Inspector of Police (CIP) Emmanuel Kayigi yavuze ko izi moto yari yaraguze zari zaratangiye gukoreshwa mu gutwara abagenzi mu karere ka Huye ari naho Nsengimana yafatiwe mu mpera z’icyumweru gishize. Yakomeje avuga ati:”Kugeza ubu kandi, abantu babiri nabo bamaze gufatwa barimo uwitwa Sikubwabo Eric wari waragurijwe na Nsengimana Miliyoni ebyiri, na mwene wabo wa Nsengimana witwa Ndayishimiye Samuel wari waranditsweho moto ebyiri.” Uyu Sikubwabo ni nawe wari waracumbikiye Nsengimana mu minsi ya mbere ubwo yatorokeraga i Huye mbere y’uko yikodeshereza iye nzu. CIP Kayigi yavuze  ko aba bakekwa uko ari batatu bamaze koherezwa i Kigali aho icyaha cyabereye ngo abe ari naho gikurikiranirwa.

title: Rwanda: Harabarurwa miliyari 35,000,000,000 Frw yahererekanijwe muri ruswa mu 2017
content: Transparency International, umuryango urwanya ruswa n’akarengane ku isi, ubinyujije mu cyereranyo ngarukamwaka cyayo kizwi nka Corruption Perception index ugaragaza ko u Rwanda mu mwaka wa 2017 rwazamutseho imyanya 2 mu bihugu byarwanyije ruswa, gusa ibi ntibihagije kuko habarurwa akayabo ka miliyari zisaga 35 z’amanyarwanda zatikiriye mu byaha bifitanye isano na ruswa mu mwaka ushize. Nkuko iyi raporo ya Corruption Perception index ibigaragaza u Rwanda rwavuye ku mwanya wa 50 rwariho mu 2016 rugera ku mwanya wa 48 mu 2017 mu kurwanya no gukumira ruswa. Ni mu gihe amanota yavuye kuri 54% akagera kuri 55%. Apollinaire Mupiganyi , Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa wa Transparency international-Rwanda asobanura ko ruswa igomba gukomeza kurwanywa kuko abakene babigenderamo n’iterambere ry’igihugu rikahazaharira. Yagize ati, "Byibuze miliyari 35 nizo zagiye hagati y’uwatse cyangwa uwatanze ruswa, ayo ni amafaranga menshi cyane nk’uko twabigaragaje hari gahunda nyinshi igihugu cyakwiye kuba cyageraho. Mu mwaka wa 2017 mu gipimo twashyize ahagaragara byibuza ibihumbi 36 byatanzwe na miliyoni imwe na 600 urumva ko umukene atabona serivisi." Transparency International igaragaza ko impuzandengo y’amanota yo ku rwego rw’isi mu kurwanya ruswa iri ku gipimo cya 43%  mu gihe muri Afrika yo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara iri ku gipimo cya 32%. New Zealand nicyo gihugu kiza ku isonga mu kurangwamo ruswa nke ku isi aho gifite amanota 89. Somaliya yo iheruka urutonde kuko ariyo bigaragara ko irimo ruswa nyinshi ndetse yazahajwe nayo, ikaba ifite amanota 9. Mu bindi bihugu bya nyuma harimo byinshi byo muri Afurika ndetse n’ibyazahajwe n’intambara mu bice bitandukanye by’isi. U Rwanda ruza ku mwanya wa mbere mu bihugu birangwamo ruswa nke mu karere ka Afurika y’Uburasirazuba n’iyo hagati rukaba urwa gatatu mu bihugu byo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara runganya amanota na Cape verde, naho Botswana iza ku isonga igakurikirwa n’ibirwa bya Seychelles. Dukurikije iyi raporo, nubwo bigaragara ko hari ikiri gukorwa, urugendo rurasa nkaho rukiri rurerure ndetse buri wese akwiye kubigira ibye kuko uretse kuba aya mafaranga angana na miliyari 35 Frw ari menshi, binasobanuye ko hari bamwe ashyira mu myanya itabakwiriye cyangwa akabageza ku bitari ibyabo mu gihe abandi barenganywa. Ibyo bigaragarira cyane mu itangwa rya serivisi n’akazi nk’uko benshi bakunze kubitangaho ubuhamya, ndetse ibi byose muri rusange bikaba bidindiza iterambere ry’igihugu.

title: Kicukiro: Bafatanywe asaga ibihumbi 500 by’amayero y’amahimbano
content: Ku itariki ya 18 Gashyantare 2018, Polisi y’u Rwanda ikorera mu karere ka Kicukiro yataye muri yombi abasore babiri nyuma yo kubasangana inoti z’inyiganano cumi n’imwe z’ibihumbi 50  y’amayero. Sinayobye Valens w’imyaka 22 na Hakorimana Jean Bosco w’imyaka 23, bafatiwe i Gikondo mu kagari ka Kanserege, umudugudu wa Marembo ya kabiri, bagerageza gukwirakwiza ayo mayero. Umuvugizi wa Polisi y’u Rwanda mu mujyi wa Kigali, Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP) Emmanuel Hitayezu, yavuze ko aba basore bafashwe barimo gushaka kuvunjiisha aya mayero y’amahimbano. SSP Hitayezu yagize ati "Aba bombi bafashwe ubwo bari barimo gushaka gukwirakwiza aya mafaranga y’amayero, aho bagendaga basaba abantu kubavunjira ngo babahe amafaranga y’u Rwanda hanyuma bo bazivunjishirize. Mu gihe bari bamaze guha uwitwa Ntezimana Emmanuel amayero 550 aho bamusabaga kubavunjira amayero 500 gusa andi akayasigarana nk’inyungu, nyuma yaje kumenya ko amafaranga yahawe ari amahimbano abimenyesha Polisi, nibwo aba basore bahise bafatwa ubu bakaba bafungiye kuri Sitasiyo ya Polisi ya Gikondo” Yakomeje asaba abaturage kwirinda kwakira amafaranga badashishoje ngo bamenye niba amafaranga bahawe atari amiganano, abasaba kandi kwirinda kurarikira inyungu z’umurengera no gushaka gukira vuba binyuze mu nzira zitemewe n’amategeko kuko ari ho ababashuka bahera babafatira mu kurarikira bakabambura n’ibyo bari bifitiye. SSP Hitayezu, yashoje asaba abaturage kujya bihutira kumenyesha inzego z’umutekano mu gihe hari uwo baketse ko yaba akwirakwiza amafaranga y’amahimbano, kuko bisubiza ubukungu bw’igihugu inyuma. Baramutse bahamwe n’iki cyaha, bahanishwa ingingo ya 603 yo mu gitabo cy’amategeko ahana ibyaha mu Rwanda, ivuga ko “Umuntu wese wihesheje cyangwa wakiriye abizi amafaranga y’ibiceri cyangwa y’inoti, akanayakwiza mu bandi, n’ubwo ataba umwe mu bakoze ayo mafaranga cyangwa abayinjije mu gihugu, ahanishwa igifungo kuva ku mwaka umwe (1) kugeza ku myaka itatu (3).” Src: Police.gov.rw

title: Rubavu: Akarere kafashe icyemezo cyo gufunga ‘lodges’ 27
content: Akarere ka Rubavu kafashe icyemezo cyo gufunga amacumbi ‘lodges’ 27, afite ikibazo cy’umwanda no gukora nta byangombwa bisabwa mu bakora muri serivise z’ubukerarugendo bw’amacumbi n’amahoteli. Ayo macumbi yandikiwe n’Umurenge ku wa 18 Mutarama 2018 ko agomba gufunga ntibyakorwa, akarere kabishimangira ku wa Kabiri w’iki cyumweru. Meya w’Akarere ka Rubabu, Habyarimana Gilbert, agaragaza ko gufunga ayo macumbi ari icyemezo cyafashwe gikwiye. Yagize ati "Mu by’ukuri ikibazo gihari ni uko abenshi bagiye bafata inzu zo kubamo bakagenda bazihindura ama-lodges , abandi bazita amahoteli. Iyo ugiye ukagenzura isuku y’ahantu hakirirwa abantu benshi ntabwo ari kimwe nk’iyahakirirwa abantu batanu b’umuryango.’’ Mu nama yahuje Meya n’abatanga serivise z’ama lodges, hemejwe ko hagiye gushyirwaho uburyo nibura abagaragaza ko bafite isuku, babura ibindi bike bahabwa igihe cy’ukwezi kuba babyujuje ariko bakaba bakora. Meya Habyarimana ati “Ubugenzuzi burakomeza, ni ukuvuga ngo abantu bagomba kumenyera gukora bujuje ibyangombwa tukava mu kajagari, tukajya gukora ibintu bisobanutse bifasha koko abanyarwanda ndetse n’abanyamahanga bagana ibi bigo bikora ibijyanye n’ubukerarugendo. Nabo barabyishimiye bavuga ko bagiye gushyira imbaraga mu kuzuza ibisabwa.’’ Amacumbi agaragaramo isuku nke yo hemejwe ko afungwa kugeza igihe azakemura ikibazo. Abarebwa n’iki kibazo cyo gufungirwa ntibifuza kuvugana n’itangazamakuru. Inkuru ya Igihe.com

title: Lesotho: Havumbuwe diyama yinjiye mu mateka ifite agaciro ka miliyari zisaga 44 Frw
content:
Sosiyete y’Ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro y’abongereza, Gem Diamonds kuri uyu wa Mbere yatangaje ko yabonye diyama ifite ingano idasanzwe dore ko ipima 910 carats(ni ukuvuga ko ifite amagarama 182), kuri ubu ikaba ifatwa nk’imwe muri eshanu nini zavumbuwe ku isi. Iri buye ry’agaciro ryavanywe mu majyepfo ya Lesotho mu kirombe cya Letseng rishobora kugira agaciro kagera kuri miliyoni 33 z’ama-Euro (ni ukuvuga asaga miliyari 34 638 384 000,00 RWF) nkuko byagaragajwe n’umusesenguzi witwa Ben Davis wa cabinet ya Liberum Capital. Clifford Elphick, umuyobozi mukuru w’iki kigo cy’Abongereza gifite isoko ryo gucukura muri iki kirombe yagize ati “ Kuva Gem Diamonds yegukanye ikirombe cya Letseng mu 2006, yagiye ishyira ku isoko amwe mu madiyama yihariye ku isi(…) Iyi diyama y’agaciro gahebuje ntagushidikanya ko ari yo nini kugeza ubu mu kirombe cya Letseng.” Iyi nkuru y’iyi diyama ikimenyekana yakiranywe yombi mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Mbere i London mu Bwongereza aho ku isoko ry’imigabane ikigo cya Gem Diamonds cyahise kizamukaho 14%.

 Letseng Diamonds mine, guverinoma ya Lesotho ifitemo imigabane 30%, indi isigaye ikaba iya Gem Diamonds, Ltd  Iki kirombe cya diyama cya Letseng kiri mu maboko ya Gem Diamonds, Ltd. na guverinoma ya Lesotho nicyo kirombe kinini ku isi cya diyama kikaba kiri k’ubutumburuke(altitude) bwa metero 3 100. Gusa ibi ntibibujije ko ubwami bwa Lesotho ari kimwe mu bihugu bya Afurika bikennye cyane ku isi. Tubibutse ko diyama nini ku isi ari Cullinan yari ifite 3.106 carats (ni ukuvuga amagarama 621,2) ikaba yaravuye muri Afurika y’Epfo mu 1905. Iyi diyama yasatuwemo ibice byinshi aho iby’ibanze byagizwe imitako y’inkoni y’Umwamikazi w’Ubwongereza ndetse n’ikamba ry’ubwami bimwe mu bintu by’agaciro bigize ubu bwami bufite ingoro i London. Naho Diyama nini yavumbuwe muri iki kinyejana turimo ikaba ari iyavumbuwe mu 2015 muri Botswana  yari ifite 1.111 carats(amagarama 222,2). Src:7sur7

title: Kigali: Ibiciro bya Lisansi na mazutu byongeye kuzamuka
content: Igiciro cya lisansi na mazutu cyazamutse mu Rwanda nkuko byemejwe na RURA(Urwego Rugenzura Imirimo Ifitiye Igihugu Akamaro), aho ibiciro bishya bizatangira gukoreshwa kuva kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 10 Mutarama, 2018. Mu itangazo RURA yashyize ahagaragara yavuze ko iri zamuka ry’ibiciro rishingiye ku izamuka ry’ibiciro by’ibikomoka kuri peteroli ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Kuri ubu igiciro cya lisanzi i Kigali ngo ntikigomba kurenga amafaranga 1,042frw kuri litiro mu gihe igiciro cya mazutu cyo kitagombakurenga amafaranga 1, 005 Frw kuri litiro. Ibi bivuze ko igiciro muri rusange kiyongereyeho amafaranga 11 y’u Rwanda. Tubibutse ko igiciro cy’ibikomoka kuri peteroli cyaherukaga kuzamuka mu Ugushyingo 2017, aho litiro ya lisansi yageze ku mafaranga y’u Rwanda 1031 ivuye kuri 993 ni ukuvuga ko yinyongereyeho 3.8% naho mazutu ikaba yaraguraga 994 ivuye kuri 954 kuri litiro, izamuka ringana na 4%.

title: Urubanza rwa Gacinya Denis rwasubitswe kubera murandasi
content: Kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 03 Mutarama, 2018 ni bwo byari biteganijwe ko hasomwa urubanza rwa Gacinya Chance Denis ku bijyanye n’ifungwa n’ifungurwa rye by’agateganyo, ariko isomwa ry’uyu mwanzuro ntiryabaye kubera ibura rya murandasi(internet). Umwanditsi w’Urukiko rw’Ibanze rwa Nyarugunga yasobanuye ko isomwa ry’uru rubanza ryasubitswe kubera ko abacamanza bagowe no kwinjira muri ‘system’ ikoreshwa mu butabera ngo bagera kuri dosiye ya Gacinya, ibi bikaba byatewe n’ibibazo bya internet, ku bw’ibyo urukiko rukaba rwimuriye uru rubanza kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 04 Mutarama, 2018. Ni mu gihe mu cyumweru gishize Ubushinjacyha bwari bwasabiye uyu mugabo uzwi cyane mu mupira w’amaguru mu Rwanda gufungwa iminsi 30 y’agateganyo kubera impamvu zikomeye zo kuba yaba yarakoze icyaha ashinjwa. Gacinya Chance Denis wayoboye Rayon Sports kuva muri Kanama 2015 kugeza mu mpera za 2017 aho yayihesheje igikombe cy’Amahoro mu 2016 n’igikombe cya shampiyona cya 2017, kuri ubu akaba ari visi perezida w’iyi kipe iza ku isonga mu kugira abafana, yatawe muri yombi tariki ya 19 Ukuboza 2017 aho ubushinjacyaha bumukurikiranyeho ibyaha byakozwe mu masezerano sosiyete ye y’ubucuruzi ya MICON yari yagiranye n’Akarere ka Rusizi arimo kukazanira amapoto y’umuriro w’amashanyarazi, aho yagombaga kuzana 830, amasezerano akaba yari afite agaciro ka miliyoni 636 Frw. Nubwo Gacinya avuga ko yishyuwe miliyoni 460, ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko iyi sosiyete ye yishyuwe miliyoni 495 nyamara ngo igenzura ryakozwe n’Ikigo gishinzwe amashanyarazi (REG) ryasanze ibikorwa byakozwe byaragombaga kwishyurwa 253 Frw. Ubushinjacyaha kandi buvuga ko bimwe mu bikoresho iyi sosiyete yazanye bitari byujuje ubuziranenge aho ngo amapoto amwe yari ahengamye ndetse kubera ko MICON itarangije imirimo nk’uko yari iteganyijwe, Akarere ka Rusizi kashatse undi rwiyemezamirimo kamwishyura miliyoni 338 Frw. Mu cyumweru gishize ubwo Gacinya yireguraga yavuze ko  Akarere ka Rusizi kamwishyuye amafaranga make atajyanye n’ibyo yakoze, anahakana ibyo kuzana ibikoresho bitujuje ubuziranenge asobanura ko byabanzaga kunyura muri Magerwa bikagenzurwa. Uyu mugabo yavuze ko amakosa yakozwe n’Akarere kamwokeje igitutu gashaka kubona ibyo kamurika mu mihigo ko we ari umwere ndetse asaba ko yahita arekurwa akajya kwita ku muryango we.

title: AMAFOTO: Ora Restaurant, ahantu hashya wafatira amafunguro ateguye neza i Nyamirambo
content:
Gufata amafunguro ateguwe neza kandi afite isuku nibyo buri muntu wese aba yifuza niyo mpamvu Ora restaurant ije gutanga amafunguro ateguranye isuku, ubuhanga kandi afite uburyohe budasanzwe. 
Aya mafunguro aryoheye ijisho uyasanga muri Ora Restaurant

Imbere uhasanga isuku ntagereranywa Iyi resitora yafunguye amarembo iherereye i Nyamirambo neza ku muhanda KN 2 AVE imbere gato yo Kwa Mayaka utaragera ku muhanda wo Kwa Mutwe. 
Ng’icyo icyapa kiranga Ora Restaurant, hano uba wahageze Ushobora kuhasanga ibiryo bitandukanye biteguranywe isuku n’ubuhanga kandi ku giciro gito. Amwe mu mafunguro wahasanga harimo: 
* umuceri w’ipilau, 
* umuceri w’umweru ndetse n’umuceri utekanye n’imboga (vegetable rice), 
* Inyama zitekanye ubuhanga 
* Ubugari 
* Burgers na sandwitches
* Hari ama jus atandukanye akozwe mu buryo bw’umwimerere (fresh juices), n’ibindi byinshi bitandukanye, byose ukabibona ku giciro gishimishje. 

Uramutse uri i Nyamirambo ukifuza gusohokana n’umukunzi wawe, tuguhitiyemo gusohokera muri Ora Restaurant Uretse ibyo kurya kandi, muri Ora restaurant bazajya berekana umupira w’amaguru shampiyona zitandukanye ku buntu. Uramutse ufite ibirori nka anniversaire, Ubukwe, Graduation ndetse n’Inama bashobora kugufasha kubitegura no kukwakirira abantu uko ubyifuza  bakanabikuzanira aho uri (outside catering).
