title: Rubavu na Rusizi hafatiwe abasore 2 bakwirakwiza amafaranga y’amiganano
content: Abasore 2 aribo Sadi Muhamedi na Tuyishime Pascal bari mu maboko ya Polisi mu turere twa Rubavu na Rusizi mu Ntara y’Uburengerazuba, bakaba bakurikiranyweho icyaha cyo gukwirakwiza amafaranga y’amiganano. Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu Ntara y’Uburengerazuba Inspector of Police (IP) Eulade Gakwaya yavuze ko Sadi yafatiwe mu karere ka Rubavu mu murenge wa Gisenyi. Aha yavuze ati “Yagiye kugura ibintu mu iduka, hanyuma yishyura amafaranga y’amiganano, umucuruzi abibonye abibwira abaturage bari hafi aho baramufata, mu kanya gato hahise haza n’undi muturage nawe avuga ko uwo musore yamwishyuye amiganano akaba yari yamuburiye irengero. Abo baturage rero nibo bahise babitumenyesha turamufata ubu afungiye kuri Sitasiyo ya Polisi ya Gisenyi.” IP Gakwaya yavuze kandi ko undi witwa Tuyishime yafatiwe mu kagari ka Gahunga mu murenge wa Mururu Akarere ka Rusizi, nawe akaba yaraguze ibintu yishyura inoti ya 5000, amafaranga yishyuye abaturage bayagiriye amakenga bahita bahamagara Polisi, bayasuzumye basanga ari amiganano,  hanyuma bamusatse bamusangana n’izindi noti 3 za 5000 nazo z’inyiganano, ubu akaba afungiye kuri Sitasiyo ya Polisi ya Kamembe. Yavuze ko muri rusange amafaranga y’amiganano adakunze kugaragara mu Ntara y’Uburengerazuba, ariko ko mu bice byegereye umupaka hari ubwo ahaboneka, asaba abaturage kugira amakenga ku mafaranga yose bahawe cyane cyane amashya. Yavuze ati ‘Iyiganwa ry’amafaranga ntiriratera intera ndende mu Rwanda, ariko n’iyo yaba make, agira ingaruka mbi ku bukungu niyo mpamvu buri wese akwiye kubyirinda no kubirwanya. Turagira inama abacuruzi kugira amakenga no gusuzuma amafaranga bahabwa n’abakiriya cyane  cyane mu masaha y’umugoroba kuko aribwo abo batekamutwe babonamo icyuho cyo gutanga amafaranga y’amiganano, ndetse bakanihutira kumenyesha Polisi igihe hari uwo baketse ko ayafite.” IP Gakwaya yashimye abaturage batanze amakuru kuri aba banyabyaha, ari nayo yatumye bafatwa. Yakomeje avuga ko kwigana amafaranga bitesha agaciro ifaranga ry’igihugu ndetse bikanagira ingaruka mbi ku iterambere ry’igihugu muri rusange. Yasabye abaturage kwirinda ibikorwa ibyo aribyo byose byo gushaka amafaranga mu buryo bunyuranije n’amategeko, kuko uretse no gufatwa bagafungwa binagira ingaruka ku miryango yabo. Yavuze ko iperereza rikomeje kugirango harebwe niba nta bandi bakorana n’aba bafashwe bityo nabo bashyikirizwe ubutabera. Yibukije ko kwigana no gukoresha amafaranga y’amahimbano ari icyaha gihanwa n’amategeko. Ingingo ya 604 yo mu gitabo cy’amategeko ahana ibyaha mu Rwanda ivuga ko umuntu wese ukwirakwiza ibintu byose byakwitiranywa n’amafaranga cyangwa izindi mpapuro zivunjwamo amafaranga, ahanishwa igifungo kuva ku myaka ibiri (2) kugeza kuri itanu (5), n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda yikubye inshuro kuva kuri ebyiri (2) kugeza ku icumi (10) z’agaciro k’amafaranga y’amiganano. Src: police.gov.rw

title: Inyubako yari UTC,yahoze ari iya Rujugiro yahindutse KCM
content: Inyubako ya Union Trade Center(UTC) iyo benshi bakunze kwita kwa Rujugiro nyuma yo gutezwa cyamunara ubu yamaze guhindurirwa inyito. Ibi byakozwe n’ikigo Kigali Investment Company cyaguze iyi nzu muri cyamunara ku ya 25 Nzeri, 2017 ku mafaranga miliyari 6.8 mu rwego rwo guhuza izina ryayo n’iry’isoko rya Nyarugenge na ryo ryabo. Aganira na Igihe dukesha iyi nkuru, Kayumba Godfrey umuyobozi wa Kigali Investment Company yabisobanuye agira ati “Ni ukuvuga ngo dufite inyubako yitwa ‘Kigali City Market’ twongeyemo ijambo rimwe ‘Mall’ kugira ngo izina ryacu hose ribe rimwe”. Ibi bivuze ko iyari Union Trade Center (UTC) yahindutse Kigali City Mall(KCM)  igahuza inyito mu mpine na Kigali City Market(KCM). Abajijwe niba nta mpungenge bafite ko iri zina rishya ritazabasha gusibanganya UTC mu mitwe y’abantu, Kayumba yagize ati “Erega twe turi abantu bazwi kandi ibikorwa byacu ni indashyikirwa; twebwe dutekereza ko izina ryacu ahubwo rizakomera kuruta iryari rihari kubera ko turi abacuruzi n’abatugize bose ni abacuruzi nta kuntu izina ritafata kuko n’irisanzwe ryo ku isoko rya Nyarugenge ryarafashe.” Kigali Investment Company yizeye ko izaba yagaruje amafaranga yashoye kuri Kigali City Mall mu myaka mike iri hagati y’itanu n’irindwi.

title: BNR yaburiye abakoresha uburyo bwo kuzigama no kugurizanya amafaranga mu bimina
content: Banki nkuru y’u Rwanda iragira inama abakoresha ibimina nk’uburyo bwo kuzigama no kugurizanya ko bari bakwiye kunyuza amafaranga yabo mu bigo by’imari n’amabanki kugira ngo babe bizeye umutekano w’amafaranga yabo. Kuzigama no kugurizanya binyuze mu bimina, ni uburyo bumaze kumenyerwa kuko bukoreshwa n’abatari bake mu guhererekanya amafaranga. Bamwe mu bamaze igihe bakoresha ubu buryo bemeza ko bwabafashije kwiteza imbere. K’urundi ruhande ariko, kuba amafaranga yo mu bimina ahererekanywa mu ntoki, ngo bigira ingaruka zirimo n’ibihombo bya hato na hato ahanini biterwa n’ubunyangamugayo buke bwa bamwe mu banyamurango b’ibyo bimina. Ku ruhande rwa Banki nkuru y’u Rwanda, BNR, ivuga ko nayo yemera akamaro k’ibimina, gusa ngo byaba byiza kurushaho ibimina bikoranye n’ibigo by’imari n’amabanki. Banki nkuru y’u Rwanda igaragaza ko nubwo abanyarwanda bagera hafi kuri 90% bakorana n’ibigo by’imari, ngo abagera kuri 20% byabo ni abibumbiye mu bimina. Src: RBA

title: Nyamagabe: Umukozi wa mu rugo yafashwe yibye asaga miliyoni 2 n’igice
content: Mu murenge wa Mbazi ho mu karere ka Nyamagabe mu ntara y’Amajyepfo, polisi yafashe umukozi wo mu rugo wari watorotse aho yakoraga abibye amafaranga akabakaba miliyoni 3 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Amakuru dukesha urubuga rwa polisi y’u Rwanda avuga ko uyu mukobwa witwa Ayingeneye Claudette yakoraga mu rugo rw’uwitwa Nelly Ishimwe nk’umukozi wo mu rugo ariko ku itariki ya 18 muri uku kwezi, uwo mukobwa arabura ndetse basanga yabibye n’amafaranga ibihumbi 3 by’amadolari ya Amerika (3,000$), ni ukuvuga akabakaba 2,532,000 frw hamwe n’ibihumbi 150 by’amanyarwanda(150,000Rfw) hanyuma bahita bitabaza polisi yamufashe mu minsi 3 yakurikiyeho. Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo  IP Emmanuel Kayigi yahamije iby’aya makuru ariko avuga ko nubwo bamufashe iperereza rigikomeza dore ko we ahamya ko amafaranga yibye ari ibihumbi 120 by’amafaranga y’u Rwanda nubwo yafashwe asigaranye ibihumbi 97 gusa. IP Kayigi yagize ati “Yahakanye umubare w’amafaranga abakoresha bamushinja ko yabibye ariko iperereza riracyakomeza kugira ngo tumenye aho ukuri guherereye.” Yasoje kandi agira inama abakoresha abakozi mu ngo zabo abasaba kujya bitonda bakabika neza ibintu by’agaciro bafite mu rugo ndetse n’amafaranga yabo bakayashyira muri banki kugira ngo birinde ibibazo nkibi. Kugeza ubu Ayingeneye Claudette afungiye kuri Station ya Polisi ya Musange mu gihe iperereza rigikomeza

title: Kamonyi: Imvura idasanzwe yasenye inzu 22 yangiza ibishanga n’imirima
content: Imvura idasanzwe yaguye ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 17 Ukwakira, 2017, yasize imiryango 22 idafite aho kwikinga ndetse yangiza burundu imyaka yose iri mu bishanga bya Bishenyi na Kamiranzovu mu Karere ka Kamonyi. Nkuko tubikesha Voicemagnews iyi mvura yibasiye bikomeye umurenge wa Runda na Rugarika dore ko n’ingaruka zayo ziganje cyane mu rugabano rw’iyi mirenge. Prisca Uwamahoro, umuyobozi w’akarere ka Kamonyi wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage yatangaje ko iyi mvura yangije inzu 22 ndetse ngo bari gushaka uko inzu zabo zisanwa bagasubira mu byabo. Yagize ati “Abaraye bagize ikibazo inzu zabo zikangirika cyane bagenzi babo baraye babacumbikiye, igisigaye ni ingamba zo kureba uko inzu zabo zasanwa, ngira ngo murabizi ko dukoresha umuganda ariko tunakora raporo tukayishyikiriza Minisiteri y’Imicungire y’Ibiza n’impunzi kugira ngo babone isakaro ariko bitanashobotse natwe nk’akarere turiyegeranya tukabafasha.” Mu nzu zangijwe n’iyi mvura, 19 ziherereye mu murenge wa Runda mu tugari twa Muganza na Kabagesera, izindi eshatu ziri mu murenge wa Nyamiyaga. Uyu muyobozi avuga ko hegitari 60 z’ibigori mu bishanga  bitatu biri mu murenge we Runda na Bishenyi ari zo zimaze kubarurwa ko zangiritse. Mu gishanga cya Bishenyi hangiritse hegitari 15 z’ibigori, icya Kamiranzovu yangije ibigori biri kuri hegitari 5 no mu gishanga cya Rwubushyashya yangije ibigori biri kuri hegitari 40. Bamwe mu baturage bari bafite imyaka mu bishanga byangiritse bavuga ko bakoragamo ubuhinzi bwa kijyambere bakoresha imashini zuhira imyaka baguze muri gahunda ya nkunganire. Umwe muri bo ati “urabona ko byose byarengewe, duhuye n’igihombo gikomeye cyane ku buryo nk’uko Leta yari yaradufashije muri gahunda ya nkunganire ku mafumbire n’imbuto twongeye tukabona indi nkunganire twakongera tugasubizamo kuko haracyari kare” Kuri iki kibazo Uwamahoro yasobanuye ko kuba igishanga cyasubiye kuba nk’intabire, bisaba ko abari barahahinze bahavugurura ubundi bagashakirwa indi mbuto bagatera bundi bushya kuko igihembwe cy’ihinga kitararenga.

title: Hasohotse urutonde rw’imijyi 60 itekanye ku isi, Afurika ifitemo 3- URUTONDE
content:
The Economist, ikinyamakuru cy’abongereza cyibanda ku bukungu bw’isi cyashyize hanze urutonde rw’imijyi 60 ikomeye kandi itekanye ku isi. Ku myanya 3 ya mbere hari imijyi yo muri Aziya iyobowe na Tokyo umurwa mukuru w’Ubuyapani mu gihe umujyi wa mbere muri Afurika ari Casablanca muri Maroc iza ku mwanya wa 48. Mu gukora uru rutonde hagendewe ku ngingo 4 z’ingenzi harimo umutekano w’umuntu ku giti cye, ibyaha bikorwa ndetse n’iterabwoba. Harebwa umutekano w’ubuzima, ibiciro by’ubwishingizi mu kwivuza, ubuziranenge bw’ibitaro, kwita ku bidukikije, ubuziranenge bw’amazi n’umwuka bahumeka. Harebwe kandi ku mutekano w’ikoranabuhanga, ibyaha bikorerwa kuri murandasi no kubaha ubuzima bwite bw’abantu ndetse n’umutekano w’ibikorwa remezo, uko imihanda yubatse, inyubako zikomeye ku buryo zahangana n’ibiza.

 Umujyi wa Tokyo wahize indi yose  Nyuma yo kugenda batanga amanota muri buri cyiciro, hakozwe urutonde rw’imijyi yahize iyindi mu giteranyo aho Tokyo yegukanye umwanya wa mbere, ikurikirwa na Singapour na Osaka(Ubuyapani). Nyuma y’ibi haza Toronto yo muri Canada na Melbourne yo muri Australia.

 Melbourne muri Australia haje ku mwanya wa 5  Umujyi wa mbere ku mugabane w’Uburayi ni Amsterdam wo mu Buholandi waje ku mwanya wa 6 naho uwa mbere wo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ni San Francisco waje ku mwanya wa 15.
