Ndashimira Perezida Kagame, abavandimwe bacu b’abanyarwanda n’abaturage ba Uganda.” Ambasaderi Adonia Ayebare wakiriwe muri Village Urugwiro ku mugoroba wo ku Cyumweru tariki ya 29 Ukuboza 2019. Asanzwe ari Intumwa ihoraho ya Uganda mu Muryango w’Abibumbye i New York. Ubutumwa bwanyujijwe ku rukuta rwa Twitter rw’Ibiro by’Umukuru w’Igihugu bwavugaga ko ubutumwa Ambasaderi Ayebare yari afite, “butanga icyizere” mu gukemura ibibazo bimaze igihe mu mubano w’ibihugu byombi. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na RBA kuri uyu wa Kabiri, Perezida Kagame yavuze ko iyo ntumwa yari i Kigali mu bikorwa bimaze igihe bigamije gushaka umuti w’ibibazo, ariko ko nyuma y’ibiganiro ikiba ari ingenzi ari ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’imyanzuro yabyo. Ati “Kuvuga rero ngo haje intumwa icyizere cyabonetse, ntabwo nibwira ko ari uko nabivuga, njye navuga ko iyo ari indi ntambwe ikomeje guterwa muri ubwo buryo bwo gushakisha icyatuma ikibazo icyo aricyo cyose cyaba gihari gishobora gukemuka kandi nyine ibyo biva mu bantu mu kuvugana, kuganira.” Ubutumwa bwa Museveni ku kibazo cya Uganda n’u Rwanda biragoye ko umuntu yabwizera 100%, ngo yishyiremo ko hari ikigiye gukorwa kuko mu gihe yabwandikaga, ibimenyetso bigaragaza ibihabanye n’ibyo yavugaga. Mbere na mbere ubwo hasinywaga amasezerano y’amahoro ya Luanda, abanyarwanda baketse ko ikibazo gikemutse, ko nta n’umwe uzongera guhohoterwa ari muri Uganda ndetse ko n’abafungiyeyo bagiye kurekurwa. Gusa siko byagenze, kuko byakomeje nk’uko byari bisanzwe, abafungwa bagafungwa, abakorerwa iyicarubozo rigakomeza bakajya bajugunywa ku mipaka bagizwe intere. Ni nako Uganda kandi yakomeje umubano wayo n’imitwe igamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda irimo RNC na FDLR ndetse irinangira ubwo yasabaga kubahiriza amasezerano Museveni yasinywe. Ibi nibyo byatumye intumwa z’u Rwanda na Uganda zinanirwa kumvikana mu biganiro biheruka kubera i Kampala. Mu gihe Museveni yandikaga ko umuti ugiye kuboneka, ku rundi ruhande ikinyamakuru Red Pepper cyari kimaze gutangaza inkuru ivuga ko abanyarwanda 200 bagamije ibikorwa by’iterabwoba binjiye muri Uganda mu mugambi wo guhungabanya iki gihugu mu bihe by’iminsi mikuru. Muri iyo nkuru havugwamo ko bamwe muri abo bakora ibikorwa by’iterabwoba batawe muri yombi n’Urwego rushinzwe Umutekano imbere mu gihugu, ISO. Red Pepper isanzwe iterwa inkunga n’umuvandimwe wa Museveni, Salim Saleh ni kimwe mu binyamakuru byakunze gusiga u Rwanda icyasha no guha rugari abarwanya ubutegetsi bwarwo. Umwe mu bo cyanditse ko ari abanyarwanda bagamije ibikorwa by’iterabwoba kuri Uganda ni uwitwa Abdul Razak Subwanone, umunyarwanda uba muri Uganda aho acuruza ibyuma by’imodoka akura i Dubai. We n’undi munyarwanda witwa Edward Nsenga ucuruza telefoni bafashwe na ISO mu mukwabu watwawemo abagera kuri 200. Ikigaragaza umugambi wa Uganda udahinduka ni uko aba banyarwanda bakuwe mu bandi na mbere y’uko bagezwa imbere y’ubutabera ngo biregure, ubu bivugwa ko bafunzwe mu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko na ISO mu nzu zayo z’ibanga ahitwa Kyengera, bashinjwa kuba intasi ziturutse mu gihugu cy’igituranyi. Perezida Kagame mu kiganiro yagiranye na Televiziyo y’u Rwanda, yavuze ko bitumvikana uburyo abanyarwanda bafatirwa muri Uganda bitwa intasi kuko bamwe muri bo batanafite ubwo bushobozi ahubwo baba bashaka imibereho kimwe n’abandi. Ati “Ibyo kugera ahantu igihugu gihiga abanyagihugu b’abaturanyi kuri ubwo buryo ntabwo byasobanuka. Abandi bakavuga ngo abo baba bagiyeyo, baba bagiye gutata, gutata iki kirimo abana, kirimo abagore, abagabo, kirimo abantu batazi kwandika no gusoma, abantu bari aho bashakisha uko biberaho nk’uko abanya-Uganda benshi bari hano. ” Perezida Kagame yavuze ko u Rwanda rutigeze rukora nk’umuturanyi warwo ngo rutangire ruhige abaturage ba Uganda. Ibimenyetso byagiye bijya hanze nyuma y’ibyo abayobozi ba Uganda bakunze kuvuga ku mubano n’u Rwanda, bigaragaza ko abantu bakwiye kwishima mu rugero, ntibizere ko ikibazo cyakemutse ahubwo bagategereza bibaye. Ni uko ubutumwa bwa Museveni bwakwakirwa.

title: Tito Rutaremara yavuze ku ‘bajura’ bahungiye muri Politiki, bashyize imbere kwibasira FPR na Perezida Kagame
content: Rutaremera agaragaza ko hari bamwe bitwa ko banafite amashyaka mu mahanga, ubundi atari akwiye kubaho kuko icyo bashyize imbere ari urwango no kurimbura Abatutsi. Ibi bikubiye mu kiganiro yatanze kuri One Nation Radio ubwo yari kumwe na Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Vincent Karega, n’Umuyobozi wungirije Urwego rw’Igihugu rw’Imiyobore, RGB, Dr Nibishaka Emmanuel. Iki kiganiro cyagarukaga ku gusonukirwa icyo kutavuga rumwe na Leta bisobanuye n’imikorere y’abari muri icyo gice. Mu gihe hirya no hino ku Isi usanga abenegihugu baterwa ishema no kurengera isura y’ibihugu byabo n’uko byagaragara neza mu ruhando mpuzamahanga, hari bamwe mu Banyarwanda bihaye icyerekezo cyo guhindanya isura y’urwababyaye, ngo barebe ko bucya kabiri aho baherereye mu mahanga. Gushakisha iyi mbehe no gushyira mu bikorwa urwango bafitiye u Rwanda, usanga ari bimwe mu bituma babaho barangwa n’ibinyoma no gufata ibyiza u Rwanda rwagezeho bakabyita ibibi. Bamwe muri bo bavuga ko bahunze u Rwanda, bavuga ko bahunze politiki mbi. Tito Rutaremara yagize ati “Nk’abo birirwa bavuga ko bashaka kuza kwica Abatutsi ntibakwiye, igisekeje ni uko ba bandi bavuga ko babahagarariye barimo nka ba Kayumba n’abandi, usanga bavuga ko bo batabikora nyamara ugasanga barimo gukorana.” “Hari abandi batangira amashyaka kandi bari abajura ndetse n’abantu bakaba bazi ko wari umujura, bivuze ko n’aho uzazira n’ubundi uzongera ukiba, ubundi uwo muntu ntaba akwiye kwemerwa. Iyo ukurikiranye abo bose sindabona gahunda zabo za politike nzima, utavuze ko ashaka gukuraho FPR, usanga avuga ko ashaka gukuraho Kagame.” Rutaremara yavuze ko ikibabaje ari uko usanga aba bose aho kuvuga politike zabo nzima, birirwa bashyira imbere ibyo kuvuga uwo bashaka gukuraho mu gihugu. Yagize ati “Ugera mu ishyaka ugasanga baravuga ngo ndashaka gukuraho kanaka, politike batanga wumva ntazo bafite ahubwo ari ukuvuga ngo ndakuraho. Muri iki gihe hari ijambo babonye birirwa bavuga ngo ndashaka kubaka demokarasi, iryo niryo babonye ariko iyo urebye usanga ari ugutesha igihe.” Umuyobozi wungirije w’Urwego rw’Igihugu rw’Imiyobore, Dr Nibishaka Emmanuel, yavuze ko abo bantu bakwiye gufatwa nk’abiyitirira politike n’amashyaka, kuko ibyo bakora bitemewe n’amategeko. Ati “Ibyo za FDLR zikora na RNC ntabwo ari opozisiyo ahubwo hari izindi nyito wabita, wanabita imitwe y’iterabwoba bitewe n’ibikorwa bakora. Ubundi niba bashaka kugera ku butegetsi bakaje mu Rwanda bakandikisha imitwe yabo ya politike kuko hari ibisabwa, barangiza bagatangira gukora mu buryo bwa demokarasi n’amahoro kuko kuba utavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi si ukubuza abandi umutekano.” Kuki bataza gusaba kwandikisha imitwe yabo muri RGB? Dr Nibishaka Emmanuel avuga ko “Kugeza ubu nta muntu wo muri opozisiyo wagerageje kwandikisha ishyaka, ariko icya mbere twareba ni ukumenya ngo abo bantu ni bantu baki? Abenshi muri aba iyo urebye usanga ari abantu bahunze ubutabera.” Yakomeje agira ati “Abandi ni RNC kandi murabazi ko bashakishwa n’ubutabera, FDLR nabo basize bakoze Jenoside.” Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Vincent Karega, yavuze ko muri iki gihe usanga abantu barapfuye guterura ijambo demokarasi, bakumva ko ari inzira ibageza mu butegetsi, ariko ugasanga nta murongo ngenderwaho bafite. Ati “Ibyo barabyitwaza bakavuga ngo ntabwo mwaduhaye urubuga rwa politike niyo rwaba rusenya, usanga ari abantu barangwa na vamo njyemo.” “Twe nk’u Rwanda twagize n’ibyago kuko abo bose si uko ari abantu bafite ibitekerezo byubaka igihugu, ahubwo ni abantu badutse kubera ko batabonye umugati ugasanga bigize abarakare, bagakoresha uburyo bwose niyo bwaba ubuteza umutekano muke ariko bakabona ubutegetsi.” Karega yavuze ko ariyo mpamvu usanga bahisemo kujya mu mahanga bakabeshya ko mu Rwanda nta rubuga ruhari kandi hari amashyaka menshi, ariko kubera ko abahari badaterena intebe bo bagahitamo kuvuga ko nta opozisiyo ihari. Imitwe ya politiki 11 niyo yemewe mu Rwanda nyuma yo kwandikwa agahabwa ibyangombwa byo gukorera mu gihugu. Yose mu 2018 yatsindiye imyanya itandukanye mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko.

title: Museveni yijeje gukemura ibibazo yagaragarijwe n’u Rwanda umunsi Coronavirus yavuye mu nzira
content: Hashize imyaka itatu u Rwanda na Uganda bidacana uwaka, nyuma y’aho abaturage barwo bahohotewe n’Inzego za Gisirikare muri Uganda, kugeza ubwo bamwe babura ubuzima abandi bakahakura ubumuga bw’iteka. Usibye ihohotera rikorerwa abanyarwanda baba muri Uganda, u Rwanda rushinja Uganda gushyigikira imitwe igamije guhungabanya umutekano warwo irimo RNC, FDLR, FLN, na RUD-Urunana. U Rwanda rwasabye Angola na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo kuba abahuza mu kibazo kuko inzira y’ibiganiro isanzwe yari imaze igihe idatanga umusaruro. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na Televiziyo ya NBS, Museveni yatangaje ko akiri mu biganiro n’abahuza mu rugendo ruganisha ku kubona igisubizo kirambye cy’ikibazo. Ati “Turavugana, tuvugana na Guverinoma ya Angola na RDC. Twagombaga kugira indi nama ariko Coronavirus irabyitambika. Iyo yagombaga kuba inama ya nyuma. Mu gihe Coronavirus irangiye tuzasubukura.” Yakomeje avuga ko mu gushaka gukemura ikibazo “nohereje Ambasaderi Adonia Ayebare, rero bizakemuka.” Uyu Ambasaderi Adonia Ayebare yakiriwe muri Village Urugwiro ku mugoroba wo ku Cyumweru tariki ya 29 Ukuboza 2019. Yahuye na Perezida Kagame amushyikiriza ubutumwa bwa Museveni. Nyuma yaho, Perezida Kagame yavuze ko iyo ntumwa yari i Kigali mu bikorwa bimaze igihe bigamije gushaka umuti w’ibibazo, ariko ko nyuma y’ibiganiro ikiba ari ingenzi ari ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’imyanzuro yabyo. Ati “Kuvuga rero ngo haje intumwa icyizere cyabonetse, ntabwo nibwira ko ari uko nabivuga, njye navuga ko iyo ari indi ntambwe ikomeje guterwa muri ubwo buryo bwo gushakisha icyatuma ikibazo icyo aricyo cyose cyaba gihari gishobora gukemuka, kandi nyine ibyo biva mu bantu, mu kuvugana, kuganira.” Museveni yakomeje avuga ko yizeye neza ko nyuma y’icyorezo cya Coronavirus, ibibazo bizakemuka kuko ngo igihugu cye kidafitanye ibibazo n’ikindi icyo aricyo cyose, yewe n’u Rwanda. Ati “Ndabyizeye kuko twe nta kibazo na kimwe dufitanye n’u Rwanda cyangwa ikindi gihugu cya Afurika.” Imvugo nk’izi za Museveni si igitangaza kuko si ubwa mbere avuze mu buryo butanga icyizere mu gukemura ikibazo, ariko ibikorwa bikagaragaza ibindi. Nko mu butumwa yashyize kuri Twitter ku wa 31 Ukuboza 2019, yagize ati “Vuba aha, impande zombi zigiye gufata imyanzuro ihamye mu guhosha umwuka mubi. Ndabizeza ko Uganda izakora ibyo isabwa mu gushyira mu buryo umubano mwiza w’ibihugu byombi.” Gusa mu minsi ishize ubwo Coronavirus yakazaga umurego, Abanyarwanda 342 bashyizwe hamwe n’inzego z’ubuyobozi muri Uganda, zibajugunya ku mipaka itemewe mu Rwanda mu turere twa Burera na Gicumbi mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru zibashinja ko bari gukwirakwiza Coronavirus muri Uganda. Imitwe igamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda irimo RNC, FDLR, RUD-Urunana nayo ntiyigeze ihagarika gukorera muri Uganda, yakomeje guhabwa icyicaro mu buryo bweruye, nta n’ikimenyetso cyerekana ko Uganda iri guca ukubiri nabo. Mu byo Uganda yasabwaga n’u Rwanda kandi, harimo no kohereza abantu baruhungabanyiriza umutekano bari muri Uganda, barimo n’abakomeje kugira uruhare mu bikorwa bya RNC muri icyo gihugu. Ni icyemezo cyagombaga gushyirwa mu bikorwa nyuma y’uko impande zombi zari zimaze gusinya amasezerano agena uburyo bwo guhererekanya abanyabyaha. Hari amakuru ko mu bashoboraga koherezwa ku ikubitiro barimo Sulah Nuwamanya Wakabiligi na Prossy Bonabaana, bakorana na CMI na RNC mu icengezamatwara ryibasira u Rwanda, binyuze mu muryango bashinze, Self-worth Initiative. Ni ibikorwa u Rwanda rwakomeje kwamaganira kure. Gusa ku rundi ruhande, bivugwa ko bashobora guhungishwa bakajyanwa mu bindi bihugu. Umusesenguzi mu bya politiki n’umwanditsi, Gatete Thierry, aherutse kubwira IGIHE ko Uganda idateze kureka gufasha RNC n’indi mitwe kuko byo ubwabyo byayibera ikibazo gikomeye bitewe n’ubufasha imaze kuyiha. Atanga urugero rw’uburyo FLDR yakirijwe yombi muri RDC, u Rwanda rwashaka gusaba Congo kuyitsinsura ikinangira, “nyuma abarwanyi bayo batangiye gufata ku ngufu, kwica urubozo abanye-Congo”. Ati “Na RNC ubona hariya ukuntu Uganda yayifashe neza, yari iziko iri guhima u Rwanda, Uganda iramutse yumvikanye n’u Rwanda ntabwo RNC [Uganda] yayikira kandi ariyo yayizaniye. Umutego mubi ushibukana nyirawo. Kwirahuriraho amakara, ni wowe atwika. Biragoye ko [Uganda] yakwitandukanya na bariya bantu.” Ibi byose bituma abantu bakwiye gutegereza bakazabonesha amaso koko ko ibibazo bikemutse aho kugira icyizere gishingiye ku mvugo za Museveni gishobora kuraza amasinde.

title: Imwe mu myanzuro yafatiwe mu nama ya EAC yayobowe na Perezida Kagame
content: Uyu ni umwe mu myanzuro yafatiwe mu nama yabaye hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga ry’amashusho, yitabirwa na Perezida w’u Rwanda Paul Kagame, Perezida Yoweri Kaguta Museveni wa Uganda, Perezida Uhuru Kenyatta wa Kenya na Perezida wa Sudani y’Epfo, Salva Kiir. Iyi nama yigaga ku ngamba zihuriweho zafatwa mu guhangana n’icyorezo cya coronavirus muri aka karere. Ibihugu bya Tanzania n’u Burundi ntabwo byitabiriye iyi nama nyunguranabitekerezo. Hashize iminsi ibihugu by’u Rwanda na Uganda, bigaragaza ko ubwandu bushya bwa coronavirus buri kuboneka cyane mu bashoferi b’amakamyo yambukiranya imipaka. Byatumye u Rwanda rufata ingamba zirimo gushyiraho uburyo abashoferi b’amakamyo baturuka hanze bajya bagarukira ku mupaka ntibagere mu gihugu, imodoka zabo zigatwarwa n’abandi bakazigeza aho zipakururira. Uwo mwanzuro ntiwishimiwe n’abashoferi bo muri Tanzania kuko bavugaga ko bizongera ikiguzi cy’urugendo. Abakuru b’ibihugu bigize EAC banzuye ko hashyirwaho uburyo bwo gutanga ibyangombwa by’abapimwe coronavirus, no gusangira ibyavuye mu bizamini by’abapimwe. Abaminisitiri b’ubuzima, Ubucuruzi n’ubutwererane ari nabo bashinzwe gukurikirana ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’iyo myanzuro, basabwe gushyiraho uburyo bwo gupima no guha ibyangombwa abashoferi b’amakamyo nyuma yo kubapima mbere y’uko bakora ingendo bavuye mu bihugu byabo, no kujya bapimwa buri byumweru bibiri kandi raporo igahabwa abakuru b’ibihugu. Abakuru b’ibihugu bemeje ko mu gihe cy’iki cy’icyorezo guhanahana amakuru ari ingenzi, basaba abaminisitiri babishinzwe gushyiraho uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga buhoraho, bwo kugenzura abashoferi b’amakamyo n’ababaherekeza ku buryo ubwo buryo butangira gukoreshwa n’ibihugu binyamuryango. Bagaragaje ko inzego z’ingenzi zifashe ubukungu bw’ibihugu mu karere ziri kugenda gahoro kubera icyorezo cya coronavirus. Izo nzego zirimo nk’ubuhinzi, ubucuruzi, inganda, ubukerarugendo n’imyidagaduro, maze basaba ibihugu korohereza inganda z’imbere mu bihugu ziri gukora ibikoresho biri kwifashishwa mu guhangana na coronavirus nk’udupfukamunwa, imiti isukura intoki, amasabune, imyambaro itwikira isura, ibiribwa, ibyuma bifasha abarwayi guhumeka n’ibindi. Basabye ko abahinzi n’aborozi boroherezwa bagakomeza ibikorwa byabo haba muri ibi bihe by’icyorezo na nyuma yacyo, no gufasha mu kuzahura ubucuruzi buto n’ubuciriritse bwagizweho ingaruka na coronavirus, hashyirwaho uburyo bwo kubona amikoro. Aba bakuru b’ibihugu bishimiye ibiri gukorwa mu guhangana na Coronavirus mu karere, biyemeza gukomeza kubishyigikira. Kugeza kuri uyu wa Kabiri, abantu bamaze kwandura Coronavirus muri Uganda ni 122, u Rwanda ni 285, Sudani y’Epfo ni 156 naho Kenya ni 700.

title: USA: Batangiye guteganya icyakorwa Joe Biden ahagaritse kwiyamamaza; Hillary na Obama bahanzwe amaso
content:
Amatora yo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika azaba mu Ugushyingo uyu mwaka. Joe Biden niwe mukandida uhabwa amahirwe yose yo guhangana na Perezida Donald Trump uhagarariye aba-républicains. Douglas MacKinnon wahoze ashinzwe itumanaho mu biro bya Perezida wa Amerika yatangaje ko aba- démocrates batangiye gutekereza ku wasimbura Joe Biden mu gihe yaba akuyemo kandidatire. MacKinnon yavuze ko Biden afite ibisitaza bitatu bishobora kubangamira kandidatire ye. Muri byo harimo imyaka ye dore ko afite 77, umugore witwa Tara Reade umushinja ko yigeze kumufata ku ngufu n’ibibazo by’umuhungu we Hunter Biden ushinjwa gukorana ubucuruzi rwihishwa n’abanya-Ukraine. MacKinnon yagize ati “Kubera izo mpamvu n’izindi nyinshi, ese twakwitega ko Biden azava mu isiganarwa cyangwa akabikora ku bushake gusa? Reka tuvuge biramutse bibaye mbere cyangwa nyuma y’inteko rusange y’ishyaka, byagenda gute?” Mu gihe Biden yaba yikuye mu irushanwa, hatorwa undi mukandida umusimbura.
MacKinnon avuga ko Hillary Clinton wiyamamaje mu 2016 agatsindwa na Trump ari we ufite amahirwe menshi yo kuba yatoranywa agasimbura Biden akuyemo akarenge, naho Barack Obama wigeze kuba Perezida akamubera visi Perezida. Icyo gitekerezo cya MacKinnon icyakora kiracyahura n’imbogamizi mu mategeko, aho Itegeko Nshinga Amerika rikirimo icyuho ku kuba Visi Perezida warigeze gutorerwa kuba Perezida inshuro ebyiri. Itegeko Nshinga rya Amerika ubwo ryavugururwaga ku nshuro ya 22, ryemeje ko nta muntu wemerewe gutorerwa manda zirenze ebyiri ari Perezida wa Amerika. Ubusanzwe mu gihe Perezida agize ikibazo gituma atabasha kuyobora, Visi Perezida we niwe uhita amusimbura by’agateganyo. Ibyo bivuze ko Obama abaye Visi Perezida, Clinton akagira ikibazo gituma adakomeza kuba Perezida, Obama yahita amusimbura akaba abaye Perezida inshuro eshatu kandi bitemewe. Icyakora, abasesenguzi bavuga ko Obama abaye Visi Perezida muri ubwo buryo ataba yishe Itegeko Nshinga kuko ryo rivuga ko ‘umuntu atemerewe gutorerwa manda zirenze ebyiri’ kandi uburyo Obama yaba agiyeho ngo ntibwaba bunyuze mu matora. Itegeko Nshinga kandi rya Amerika ku bijyanye na Visi Perezida, rivuga ko umuntu ufite imiziro yo kutaba Perezida atemerewe no kuba Visi Perezida. Ibyo abasesenguzi bavuga ko bituma Obama atakwemererwa kuba Visi Perezida kuko no kuba Perezida atabyemerewe.

title: Byatewe n’iki ngo mu Burundi bagere aho basenga bifuriza u Rwanda amakuba?
content: Mu bitabo bitandukanye, Bibiliya isobanura neza ko mu isengesho usabira abantu bose, yaba abo mubanye neza n’abo mutabanye neza. Kuko Imana ari urukundo, yigisha gukunda mugenzi wawe ukamukunda nk’uko wikunda ubwawe, n’uwo mutabanye neza ukamusabira guhinduka aho kumusabira umuriro utazima. U Burundi bwakoze ibitandukanye kuko ku wa Gatatu mu bikorwa byo kwamamaza umukandida w’ishyaka CNDD-FDD, Gen Evaritse Ndayishimiye, byari byitabiriwe na Perezida Pierre Nkurunziza, umugore w’umuvugabutumwa yateye isengesho asaba Imana guheza mu nzu abo yita abanzi barimo u Rwanda [Perezida Kagame], Amerika n’Umuryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi. Ni ibintu bidatunguranye kuko magingo aya imyaka igeze kuri itanu u Burundi buvuga nabi u Rwanda, ariko rwo rukinumira. Byakajije umurego ubwo mu 2015 hapfubaga Coup d’État. Icyo gihe abatavuga rumwe n’u Burundi bahungiye mu bihugu bihana imbibi birimo u Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, Kenya yewe no mu bihugu bya kure nko mu Burayi na Amerika. Abarundi batumbiriye u Rwanda barushinja ko rucumbikiye abashaka kugirira nabi ubutegetsi bwabo gusa birengagiza ko abahunze bagiye no mu bindi bihugu. Icyo gihe barikoze, bategura buri wa Gatandatu imyigaragambyo yo kwamagana u Rwanda, bigera n’aho ejo bundi aha hari impunzi z’Abarundi ziri mu Rwanda zitabiriye irushanwa rya East Africa Got Talent zivuza ingoma ndundi, Minisiteri y’Umuco mu Burundi ihaguruka itaka ko ari u Rwanda rwibye umuco w’Abarundi. Ibi byose ariko bibaye mu gihe gito cyane, kuko ejo bundi aha mu 2013 Nkurunziza yitabiriye inama mu Rwanda, avuga ko Perezida Kagame ari nka “mukuru wanjye” ko ibyo yavuze “ntacyo nakongeraho”. Pasiteri Rutayisire Antoine yabwiye IGIHE ko kumva umukirisitu usenga mu buryo Abarundi basenze bifuriza inabi abandi, bigaragaza umuntu ushobora gukora n’ibirenze ibyo ndetse ko bimwibutsa amateka ashaririye u Rwanda rwanyuzemo. Ati “Birababaje. Hitler yabishyize mu Badage aravuga ngo bariya Bayahudi nibo batuma ubukungu bwacu bumera nabi, Abadage barabanga barabica. Uriya arabivuga mu magambo ariko n’uwamubwira ngo akore nabi yabikora.” “Mu Bakirisitu mu Rwanda se ntitwari dufite 90%, usubiye inyuma ukareba amasengesho yasenzwe Inkotanyi zateye mu kwa 10 mu 1990 asengwa n’Abanyamadini bati udutsindire izo Nyangarwanda uzikubite uzice amaguru uzijugunye hanze y’igihugu.” Pasiteri Rutayisire avuga ko bibabaje kuba mu kinyejana cya 21 hari abantu bagifite iriya mitekerereze, kuri we asanga aho kugira ngo abatuye Isi barusheho kwiyungura ubwenge, barushaho “kunguka ubuswa mu butagondwa”. Umwarimu muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda, Dr Ismael Buchanan, yavuze ko amasengesho nk’ariya ashobora gutuma abaturage b’Abarundi bagirira nabi Abanyarwanda. Ati “Kuba bigeze aho abaturage basenga bagashyira mu magambo igihugu, ni imyumvire mu rwego rwa politiki iri hasi kuko sinumva ko abantu bazi neza imibanire y’igihugu, kuba bashyira amagambo nk’ariya mu masengesho, bishobora kugumura abaturage ku buryo Umunyarwanda ashobora kugira ikibazo ahuye n’Umurundi.” U Burundi bwahindutse bute? Mu 2009, u Rwanda ni kimwe mu bihugu byagobotse u Burundi, rubwishyurira ideni bwari bufite mu muryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Icyo gihe rwikoze ku mufuka rutanga miliyoni 550 Frw. Nyuma ubwo isoko rya kijyambere rya Bujumbura ryafatwaga n’inkongi mu 2013, ba nyir’ubwite bakubise hirya no hino babura icyo bafata, u Rwanda rwoherezayo kajugujugu maze iyo nkongi irahashywa. Umwe mu bakurikiranira hafi politiki yo mu karere yabwiye IGIHE ko mbere ibihugu byombi byabanaga neza ndetse n’abakuru b’ibihugu bakagenderanirana ariko ubuyobozi butangiye kuba bubi mu Burundi, politiki irahinduka. Mbere ya manda ya gatatu ya Perezida Nkurunziza mu 2015, yaje mu Rwanda ahurira na Perezida Kagame mu Karere ka Huye ariko nyuma ibintu biza guhinduka. Ati “Atangiye gushaka manda ya gatatu arahindukira, ariko n’abanya-Tanzania babigizemo uruhare kubera Jakaya Kikwete. Mu gihe cy’umuhora wa Ruguru bashakaga kurema uwabo w’Abanya-Tanzania, RDC n’Abarundi. Kikwete yari amufiteho ijambo rinini noneho hajemo n’ibya Coup d’État yijundika u Rwanda atyo.” Asobanura ko ibyo byose ari ingaruka z’imiyoborere mibi kugeza n’aho Isi yose ihangayika kubera icyorezo cya Coronavirus, ariko u Burundi bwo bugasa nk’ubutarebwa nacyo. Ati “Icyorezo cya Coronavirus cyamaze Isi yose, ariko wowe ukaba ufite intumbero yo kwikorera amatora. Sinzi ko navuga ngo ni ubutegetsi bubi ahubwo nta nubwo bafite.” Kuba Nkurunziza yugarijwe n’ibibazo bitandukanye mu gihugu cye uhereye ku bukene buzamuka umunsi ku wundi, mu gushaka icyo asobanurira abaturage, yitwaza ibindi bihugu kugira ngo bumve ko aribyo bibabuza iterambere. Umusaruro mbumbe w’u Burundi mu 2018 wazamutseho 1.6%, mu 2017 wari wazamutseho 0.5 %. Mu 2016 wari wazamutseho -0.6 % mu gihe mu 2015 wazamutseho -4.0%. Umusaruro mbumbe w’umuturage mu Burundi ku mwaka wa 2018 wabaye amadolari 275, mu 2017 wari amadolari 293, mu 2016 wari amadolari 282 mu gihe mu 2015 yari amadolari 296. Uretse Sudani y’Epfo, u Burundi nicyo gihugu muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba ubukungu bwacyo bwazamutse gahoro ugereranyije n’ibindi. Ati “Abanye-Congo ibyabo birabagora, barangiza bati u Rwanda. Muri make, u Rwanda twagize amahirwe yo kugira ubuyobozi bwiza abaturage biyumvamo, bikaba ikibazo ku baturanyi ahubwo. Bakavuga bati iki gihugu gituma abaturage babona ko hari ibitagenda iwacu, abantu bagahindukira.” Amoko yongeye gufata icyicaro Mu Burundi amoko yahawe intebe ku buryo mu myanya yose ya politiki ashyirwa imbere iyo hari igikorwa kigiye gukorwa. Abasesenguzi bagaragaza ko mu myumvire y’Abarundi bumva ko igihugu cyabo kiyobowe n’Abahutu hanyuma u Rwanda rukaba igihugu cy’Abatutsi. Umusesenguzi muri politiki y’akarere, Albert Rudatsimburwa yagize ati “bo bumva ko impungenge ku Bahutu, ari wa mututsi uri ku isonga mu gihugu cy’Abaturanyi. Ntabwo babivuga muri ayo magambo ariko nibyo baba bashatse kuvuga. Bajyaga babivuga mbere ariko baje kwerura ubwo u Rwanda rwabaga igihugu cya mbere kivuze ku bibazo biri mu Burundi.” Kubera ko u Rwanda rutacecetse rukavuga uko rubona ibibazo mu Burundi kandi ko bigomba gukemurwa n’Abarundi ubwabo, nibwo nabo batangiye kuvuga ngo “umwanzi ni iyu”. Perezida Kagame mu kiganiro aherutse kugirana n’abanyamakuru, yagarutse ku bibazo biri muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, avuga ko Ingabo z’u Burundi ari zimwe mu ziri guteza ibibazo muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo. Amashusho agaragaza kajugujuru y’u Rwanda iri mu bikorwa byo kuzimya inkongi yari yibasiye isoko rya Bujumbura Hari igaruriro? Umusesenguzi, Albert Rudatsimburwa, avuga ko ibintu bishobora kuzahinduka nyuma y’amatora mu Burundi, politiki y’urwango yari yarimakajwe ikaba yahinduka kuko abaturage aribo bahazaharira. Ati “U Burundi buramutse bwumvikanye nibura no ku isura, bishobora gutuma n’aka karere kanabwira amahanga kati namwe mugire icyo mukora. EAC ifite ububasha.” Dr Ismaël Buchanan avuga ko n’ibihugu nka Eritrea na Ethiopia byagiranye amakimbirane igihe kinini bikaza kuvamo n’intambara ariko nyuma byageze aho byiyunga ibintu bisubira mu buryo. Ati “Biriya ntibyabuza abanyarwanda gukomeza ubuzima bwabo, ubundi ubuyobozi bufite ukuntu buhura mu buryo bwa politiki bukabiganiraho. Mu bihugu byinshi byageze aho abantu bicana ariko nyuma bagasubirana, naguha urugero rwa Ethiopia na Eritrea, Sudani na Sudani y’Epfo. Twe biriya abanyarwanda twabirenga tukikomereza icyerekezo turimo”. U Burundi mu mikoranire na FDLR Nubwo bigaragara ko RDC imereye nabi abarwanyi ba FDLR, ku rundi ruhande havugwa ubushuti bukomeye hagati yayo n’u Burundi ku buryo ngo bamwe mu barinda Perezida Nkurunziza ariwo bakomokamo. Muri Mata 2015 nibwo, byatangiye kuvugwa ko bamwe mu barwanyi ba FDLR binjiye mu Burundi baturutse muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Ni amakuru yaje mu gihe u Burundi bwari butangiye kwinjira mu bihe bikomeye, ariko nyuma ya Coup d’État yaje kuburizwamo, nibwo byatangiye kuvugwa byeruye ko FDLR, umutwe ushinjwa kugira uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, iganje mu Burundi, mu mpuzankano y’abapolisi n’abasirikare. Ibihamya by’uko u Burundi bukorana n’uyu, binagaragazwa n’ibitero bya hato na hato abashaka guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda bagabye muri Nyungwe, aho babaga baturutse mu Burundi, bakisangayo nta muntu n’umwe ubakoma mu nkokora. Usibye FDLR kandi, Raporo ya Loni yo mu mpera za 2018, yashimangiye imikoranire y’u Burundi n’ihuriro P5 ribarizwamo RNC ya Kayumba Nyamwasa. Yavugaga ko intwaro, ibiryo, imiti n’imyambaro byose uwo mutwe ukoresha bituruka i Burundi, ndetse igenda igaragaza n’ingero z’intwaro zinjijwe mu nyeshyamba ziturutse i Bujumbura. U Burundi nta nshuti bukigira Guhera mu 2015 u Burundi busa nk’aho nta nshuti yaba igihugu cyangwa imiryango mpuzamahanga bukigira. Uhereye ku bihugu bituranyi nk’u Rwanda, kwakira impunzi zahunze ubutegetsi bwa Nkurunziza byarubereye icyaha gikomeye. Kuva rwakwakira impunzi zisaga ibihumbi 70 z’Abarundi, u Burundi bwikanze baringa maze si ugushinja u Rwanda gucumbikira no gutoza abashaka guhirika Nkurunziza burasizora. Ibihugu by’i Burayi byahoze ari umuterankunga ukomeye w’icyo gihugu kikiri mu bikennye cyane ku Isi, nabyo ibyinshi byacanye umubano kuko byatanganga inkunga ku baturage b’u Burundi bafatwa nk’abadashyigikiye Nkurunziza, bikanamagana ubwicanyi bwakorerwaga abaturage. Manda ya gatatu ya Nkurunziza yaranzwe no kwirukana imiryango mpuzamahanga cyangwa yigenga yakoreraga mu gihugu cye. Nko mu 2016 Ishami rya Loni rishinzwe uburenganzira bwa muntu ryarahagaritswe, 2019 rirafungwa kuko ryakoze icyegeranyo kigaragaza ko inzego za Leta zishe abaturage abandi zikabafunga nyuma ya Coup d’État yaburijwemo mu 2015. Umuryango w’Ubumwe bw’Ibihugu by’u Burayi (EU) wafatiye ibihano bamwe mu bayobozi bakuru b’u Burundi birimo iby’ingendo, kubera uruhare rwabo mu mvururu za 2015. Aho gukemura ikibazo, u Burundi bwatangiye gushinja u Bubiligi bwahoze bukolonije icyo gihugu kuba inyuma y’abashatse guhirika Nkurunziza. Guhera mu 2016, inkunga ya EU ku Burundi ntabwo ikinyuzwa muri Guverinoma ahubwo ijya ako kanya mu bikorwa bigamije gufasha abaturage. Kwitazwa n’amahanga byarakomeje bigera no muri dipolomasi. Guhera mu 2015, uretse muri Nyakanga 2017 ubwo Nkurunziza yasuraga Tanzania nabwo akagarukira mu Ntara ya Ngara iri hafi y’igihugu cye, nta handi hantu hanze y’igihugu arajya. Uko kwifungirana kwajyanye no kwiheza kw’abakuru b’ibindi bihugu. Mu myaka ine amaze muri manda ya gatatu, abakuru b’ibihugu babiri nibo bamaze gusura u Burundi, ni ukuvuga Mohamed Abdullahi “Farmajo” wa Somalia wamusuye muri Gashyantare 2019, na Felix Tshisekedi wa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo wasuye icyo gihugu muri Kamena 2019. Bajya baca umugani mu Kinyarwanda ngo "Urucira muka so rugatwara nyoko", gusa twizere ko ibyo uriya murundikazi yifurije u Rwanda mu ruhame itazabibaturiraho ubwabo, kuko bisanzwe bizwi ko "Umwanzi agucira akobo, Imana ikagucira akanzu". #Burundi — Before campaigning in Muramvya on Tuesday, the ruling party started with a prayer where they asked God that their “enemies” stay in lockdown and for: 1) Kagame to not find them2) America w/ its weapons to miss them3) EU leaders to meet and disagree on Burundi😆🤔 pic.twitter.com/4nBZjwgeqO — iBurundi (@iburundi) April 30, 2020

title: FDLR mu marembera nyuma y’ifatwa mpiri rya Lt Col Museme Festus wari ushinzwe iperereza
content: Muri iyi mirwano yabaye ku Cyumweru tariki 19 Mata 2020 yaguyemo abarwanyi 22 ba FDLR. Mu cyumweru gishize nibwo imirwano ikomeye yongeye kubura hagati ya FARDC n’inyeshyamba za FDLR, mu bikorwa by’ingabo z’igihugu byo kurwanya imitwe yitwaje intwaro. Izo nyeshyamba kugeza ubu zimaze gutakaza abarenga 118 naho abagera kuri 67 bishyikiriza ingabo z’Umuryango w’Abibumbye, MONUSCO, amakuru akavuga ko abandi bahungiye muri Uganda mu nkambi za Cyaka ya I na Rwamanja. Ni imirwano yasize ibirindiro bikuru bya FDLR biri ahitwa Kazaroho na Tongo, muri Teritwari ya Rutshuru, inkambi y’ahitwa Mayi ya Chumvi na Biruma mu byose biri mu maboko ya FARDC. Gutakaza Kazaroho ni nk’aho ntaho FDLR isigaye. Mu myaka itanu ishize ubwo ibirindiro bikuru bya FDLR byatwikwaga n’Inyeshyamba z’Abandandi zizwi nka Mai Mai Candayira, zikayirukana mu birindiro byayo ahitwa Bulewusa muri Teritwari ya Lubero, yahise ijya muri Rutshuru ishinga ibirindiro muri Kazaroho. Aho niho FDLR yari imaze guhanga ubuzima kuko mu mugezi wa Milindi, uhakikije yakuragamo umusaruro w’uburobyi bwinjiza 40% by’amafaranga yinjiza. Mu ishyamba riri muri Pariki ya Nyamuragira niho FDLR yatwikiraga amakara ku buryo 45% byayo yagemurwaga i Goma. Hari bariyeri FDLR yasoresherezagaho abahinzi b’abanye-Congo yabaga ahitwa ku Rusovu yinjizaga ibihumbi 8 by’amadorari ku munsi, hakiyongeraho amasambu yahingwagamo imyaka nk’ibigori, ibishyimbo n’urumogi kuri hegitari ibihumbi bitatu. Kazaroho yari yegereye ibigo nderabuzima bya Kabizo na Tongo basahuragaho imiti ubundi bakahivuriza. Uyu mutwe wa FDLR ukuriwe na Gen Rumuri Byiringiro Victor washatse kwigerezaho ngo wongere kwisubiza ibirindiro byabo ariko biba iby’ubusa. Ku Cyumweru taliki ya 19 Mata mu ma saa kumi z’umugoroba, imirwano ya mbere yabereye mu gace k’ahitwa Kabarozi ubwo FDLR yashakaga gufata bugwate imodoka yari igemuriye ingabo za FARDC ibiribwa mu mirwano yamaze iminota 45. Imirwano yahise yubura FARDC yica abarwanyi batatu ba FDLR, ibambura n’imbunda eshatu, imwe yo mu bwoko bwa PKM n’ebyiri zo mu bwoko bwa AK47. FDLR yashakaga ibiribwa kuko FARDC yabafungiye inzira zose babikuragamo. Imirwano yakomereje mu nkengero z’ishyamba za Kazaroho, uturutse ahitwa Kawunga, ubwo inyeshyamba za FDLR zibarizwa muri Batayo ya Sinayi zageragezaga kwisubiza Kazaroho zigasakirana n’umutwe udasanzwe w’ingabo za Congo ‘Hibou Special Force’ mu mirwano yamaze amasaha ane. FADLR yakubiswe inshuro ndetse Lt.Col Museme Festus wari ubayoboye afatwa mpiri n’izi ngabo, abandi barwanyi 18 bahasiga ubuzima, inkomere eshanu zikaba zarishyikirije MONUSCO ahitwa Kiwanja. FDLR yatewe n’ubundi irimo umwuka mubi wo kutumvikana kuko bamwe bagaragazaga ko binjiza amafaranga menshi ariko ntibamenye aho bajya. Umwe mu bahoze muri uwo mutwe uri mu kigo cya Monusco ahitwa Kiwanja aherutse kuvuga ko FDLR yatakaje ibyiringiro. Ati “Murabona ko aba basaza badashaka kurekura ngo haze ibitekerezo. Urebye nka Gen Byiringiro yirirwana ishapule mu ntoki asaba Bikira Mariya kumutsindira urugamba, undi mujenerali dufite navuga nk’uwitwa Gen. Powete ni umusaza ufite nk’imyaka 75 arwara igicuri, ahora asusumira, mbese aba ofisiye benshi dufite barashaje.” Umutwe wa FDLR umaze imyaka irenga 20 urwanira mu mashyamba ya Congo. Igihe FDLR yashingwaga yari ifite abarwanyi barenga 7000, ubu isigaranye abatarenga 700 nabo abagera kuri 60% bakora akazi ko kurinda aba ofisiye bakuru. Hari nka Gen.Omega urindwa n’abarwanyi 180, Gen Byiringiro Victor urindwa na 130. Abandi birirwa mu gusoresha, gutwika amakara, gusatura imbaho, guhinga no gucukura amabuye y’agaciro. Umutwe wa FDLR ni umwe mu yazahajwe cyane n’ibitero bya FARDC byubuwe umwaka ushize bigamije guhashya imitwe yitwaje intwaro. Muri Mata 2019 nibwo inkuru yabaye kimomo ko Dr Ignace Murwanashyaka wayoboraga FDLR yaguye muri gereza atarangije igifungo cy’imyaka 13 yakatiwe, maze urwamutwaye rutangira kototera abamukoreye mu ngata. Hari hashize iminsi hafashwe Nsekanabo Jean Pierre uzwi nka Lt. Col Abega Kamara wari ushinzwe iperereza muri FDLR na Nkaka Ignace uzwi nka La Forge Fils Bazeye wari umuvugizi wayo, batawe muri yombi mu Ukuboza 2018 ku mupaka wa Bunagana bavuye muri Uganda mu nama yahuje abahagarariye RNC ya Kayumba Nyamwasa na FDLR. Muri Nzeri 2019 uwari Umuyobozi wa FDLR ushinzwe ibya gisirikare, Gen Mudacumura Sylvestre yarishwe mu mirwano bagabweho n’ingabo za Congo. Gen. Mudacumura yishwe nyuma y’uko mu 2016, Major Sabimana Iraguha uzwi ku mazina ya Mugisha Vainqueur wari ukuriye abamurindaga, yafashwe n’Ingabo za Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (FARDC). Mu Ukuboza 2019 hafashwe mpiri uwari umuyobozi mukuru wungirije w’umutwe udasanzwe w’inyeshyamba za FDLR (FDLR-CRAP).

title: Uburakari bw’Abanyafurika nyuma y’isesengura ry’u Bufaransa ritega iminsi abayobozi babo kubera Coronavirus
content: Iyo nyandiko yiswe ‘L’effet pangolin: la tempête qui vient en Afrique ?’. yasohotse kuwa 24 Werurwe, ivuga ko u Bufaransa bukwiriye gushaka uko bushyigikira abandi bayobozi bashya batanga icyizere muri Afurika, bazafasha Afurika kwigobotora ibibazo bya Coronavirus nyuma y’uko ubutegetsi budashoboye buzaba bumaze guhirima. Iyi nyandiko yitiriwe ‘Effet Pangolin’ hashingiwe ku makuru atandukanye avuga ko Coronavirus yaturutse ku nyamaswa izwi nk’igisamujyonjyo (Pangolin) gikunze kuba mu bihugu bya Afurika no muri Aziya. Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga y’u Bufaransa yateguriwe iyo nyandiko n’ikigo CAPS, gifasha Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga y’u Bufaransa mu busesenguzi no gufata ingamba ku bibazo bijyanye n’ububanyi n’amahanga. Iyo nyandiko yohererejwe abadipolomate n’abakora mu nzego z’ubutasi z’u Bufaransa muri Afurika. Yaje kubacikira muri Ambasade y’u Bufaransa muri Niger, ijya hanze. U Bufaransa buvuga ko coronavirus izagaragaza neza ubushobozi buke bwa za Leta zo muri Afurika. Hari aho bagira bati “ Muri Afurika by’umwihariko, bizaba ikibazo gikomeye kizibasira benshi cyane kizabashegesha igihe kinini kandi kigasiga gihanuye ubutegetsi budashinga (muri Sahel) no muri Afurika yo hagati.” “Leta zizagaragaza uburyo nta bubasha bwo kurinda abaturage bazo zifite. Iki cyorezo gishobora kuba urubanza rwa nyuma hagati y’abaturage na za Leta zananiwe guhangana n’ingaruka z’ubukungu, politiki n’umutekano.” Iyo nyandiko ivuga ko kunanirwa guhangana na Coronavirus k’ubutegetsi bwo muri Afurika, kuzakurikirwa no kwivumbura kw’abaturage. Bavuga ko muri Afurika y’Iburengerazuba, ubukungu buzagwa kubera gushyira imbaraga mu guhashya Coronavirus, abaturage babure uko bajya gukora, imibereho yabo ibe mibi bitume bivumbura. Afurika yo hagati, aho ubukungu bushingiye kuri peteroli bizagira ingaruka ku bihugu nka Cameroun, Gabon na Congo Brazzaville. Ngo ibiciro bya peteroli bizagwa maze ubushobozi bwo kwita ku baturage bubure. Inyandiko y’Abafaransa ivuga ko imyivumbagatanyo muri Afurika izahera mu bice by’imijyi. Bagira bati “Mu byumweru bike uburyo bwo kugeza ibyangombwa nkenerwa mu nsisiro bizakomera mu buryo butatu: Amazi, ibiribwa n’umuriro. Kwivumbura mu mijyi bishobora gutangira kugaragara. Niho hazatangirira imyivumbagatanyo y’abaturage.” Kuba Leta zo muri Afurika zitanga amakuru atizewe kuri Coronavirus, nabyo Abafaransa bavuga ko bizaba impamvu izahirika ubutegetsi kuko ibihuha biziyongera, kubigenzura bikananira za Leta. Abanyafurika barakaye Iyo nyandiko abayikoze batanze n’umuti, ko u Bufaransa bukwiriye gutegura abantu b’inzobere bazafasha mu gushyira Afurika ku murongo igihe ibibazo bizaba bivutse. Hari aho bagira bati “Ni ugufatirana uko kunanirwa kw’abayobozi ba Afurika, hafashwa abandi banyafurika bizewe bari kuzamuka kugira ngo bashyire abaturage ku murongo kubera ingaruka zizasigwa na COVID-19.” Ibyavuye mu nyandiko y’Abafaransa, byababaje benshi mu banyafurika ndetse batanga ibitekerezo bitandukanye bigaragaza ko u Bufaransa bwibeshye kuri Afurika. Hari umudipolomate wabwiye Jeune Afrique ko buri gihe “abakozi ba Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga mu Bufaransa, bahora bashaka icyahungabanya ubutegetsi bwo muri Afurika iyo hari ikibazo kibaye.” Jean-Claude Gakosso, Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga wa Congo Brazzaville we yavuze ko abayobozi ba Afurika nta mwanya bafite wo guta kuri iyo nyandiko. Ati “Abayobozi ba Afurika bafite byinshi byo gukora muri ibi bihe kurusha kuvuga ku nyandiko z’abantu runaka cyangwa se Minisiteri runaka.” No muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga y’u Bufaransa, abakoramo ntibemeranya n’ibyatangajwe muri iyo nyandiko, kuko hari abagaragaza ko ibogamye. Umwe mu bakozi ba Perezidansi y’u Bufaransa yagize ati “ Iriya nyandiko ni ibitekerezo biteganya, kandi hari inyandiko nkayo nyinshi. Hari abatanga ibitekerezo bitanga icyizere abandi bagatanga ibidatanga icyizere. Ibyo biduha kumva ibintu mu buryo butandukanye ariko ntibivuze ko aribyo tugenderaho.” Kuwa 3 Mata, Perezida w’u Bufaransa Emmanuel Macron yagiranye inama hifashishje ikoranabuhanga n’abayobozi b’ibihugu bya Afurika, hashakwa ingamba zo guhashya coronavirus. Iyo nama yarimo abayobozi arimo Perezida wa Mali, Ibrahim Boubacar Keïta, inyandiko igaragaza “nk’igihugu kidashoboye”. Jeune Afrique yavuze ko iyo nyandiko itigeze iganirwaho mu biganiro bya Macron n’abayobozi bo muri Afurika. Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’ishyaka MPS riri ku butegetsi muri Tchad, Jean-Bernard Padaré yavuze ko Abafaransa bibeshya cyane kuko ingaruka za Coronavirus zizashegesha u Burayi cyane kurusha Afurika. Ati “Biriya ni ibyemeza ko muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga mu Bufaransa, basuzugura ibihugu byose byo mu gace ka Sahel. Ikibabaje kuri bo, ni uko COVID-19 izangiza byinshi mu Burayi kurusha Afurika. Buriya butumwa ni icyaha gikomeye, ntacyo burafasha mu kunga Abanyafurika n’u Bufaransa.” Inzobere mu itangazamakuru Hamd H wo muri Algeria, yavuze ko mu gihe abanyaburayi barajwe ishinga no gutega imitego Afurika, yo iri kurushaho kunoza umubano n’abafatanyabikorwa ba nyabo, barimo u Bushinwa. Yagize ati “Abadipolomate banyu ntibazi na gato ibiri kuba muri Afurika. Barakibereye mu kinyejana cya 20 […] Ukwigira ababyeyi ba Afurika kw’abanditse iriya nyandiko ntacyo birabafasha mu kumva neza ibiri kuhabera. Ahubwo iki cyorezo kirafasha ibihugu bya Afurika gukomeza umubano wabwo n’abafatanyabikorwa bayo bizewe nk’u Bushinwa n’u Budage ku isonga.” Tariki 8 Mata, imbere y’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko, Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga, Jean-Yves Le Drian yavuze ko na we atameranywa n’abakoze iyo nyandiko.

title: Hagaragajwe uko guhera mu 1959 hashinzwe ibinyamakuru byinshi byo kubiba amacakubiri mbere ya za ‘Kangura’
content: Guhera mu 1956 amashyaka ya Politiki yakoraga nk’amashyirahamwe, yaje kwemererwa gukora ku mugaragaro nk’amashyaka ya Politiki muri Gashyantare 1959. Ayo mashyaka yatangiye gushinga ibinyamakuru kugira ngo biyafashe gutambutsa ibitekerezo byayo. Mu kiganiro ku ruhare rw’Itangazamakuru muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, Dr. Bizimana Jean Damascene yavuze ko muri ibyo binyamakuru hashinzwemo ‘Ijwi rya rubanda rugufi’ cyari icya APROSOMA (Association pour la promotion sociale de la masse, APROSOMA) naho Parmehutu ishyiraho icyitwaga ‘Jya mbere’. Ibyo binyamakuru byombi byakanguriye Abahutu kwanga no kwica Abatutsi. Dr Bizimana avuga ko mu nyandiko za mbere zirimo iyo ku wa 27 Nzeri 1959 y’Ijwi rya rubanda rugufi yasohotsemo amategeko 10 y’Abahutu. Ni amategeko Gitera Joseph yavugiye mu nama (mitingi) y’ishyaka rye ndetse yamaze kuyandika muri icyo kinyamakuru ahita atangira kugikwirakwiza uwo munsi. Mu kukigeza ku bantu benshi ngo yahoranaga isakoshi yajyanaga mu misa igihe abantu basuhuzanya ihumuje akagenda akibaha. Banakoreshaga iposita ya Kiliziya gatolika yitwa ‘Courier missionaire’. Ayo mategeko yigishaga urwango akavuga koo umuhutu n’umututsi badashobora kubana, gusangira cyangwa kugirana indi mishyikirano. Ati “Icyo Kinyamakuru rero tugomba kukivuga kuko nicyo kinyamakuru cya mbere, cyatangiye kubiba urwango ku mugaragaro.” Uretse ayo mategeko 10 y’Abahutu Gitera yasohoye, yanasohoye indi nyandiko ibwira abahutu uko bagombaga kwitwara mu gihe cy’amatora dore ko hari ayari ari gutegurwa mu mezi atatu yari gukurikira mu Ukuboza. Yasabaga ko batora Abahutu, bakanga abatutsi n’abahutu babanye neza n’Abatutsi. Ati “Murumva ko Kangura tujya tuvuga ngo niyo yatangiye kwigisha urwango nyamara siyo ni Ijwi rya rubanda rugufi.” Itangazamakuru rishinjwa kugira uruhare rukomeye cyane mu gushishikariza abahutu kwica abatutsi ndetse mu gihe cya Jenoside abanyamakuru barangaga aho Abatutsi banyuze bahunga cyangwa bihishe. Uretse ibyo binyamakuru hari Radiyo RTLM. Yatangiye kuvuga ku wa 8 Nyakanga 1993 ariko yagize uruhare rugaragara muri Jenoside hagati ya Mata na Nyakanga 1994. Iyi radiyo yumvwaga n’abaturage benshi cyane, byatumye ikwirakwiza urwango mu buryo bworoshye. Mu bintu byatumye ubwicanyi bugira imbaraga kandi bugakwirakwira vuba, harimo amagambo y’ikangura yavugirwaga kuri iyi Radiyo.

title: Imitwe ya Politiki irenga 200 ku Isi yahamagariye ibihugu gushyira hamwe bikarandura COVID-19
content: Iyi mitwe ya politiki isohoye iri tangazo mu gihe kuri uyu wa Gatanu ku Isi habarurwa abantu 1016401 bamaze kwandura icyorezo cya Coronavirus, aba bakaba biganjemo abo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Kugeza ubu kandi abagera 245559 mu gihe abamaze gupfa muri rusange ari 53160. Iyi mitwe ya politiki ivuga ko iki ari icyorezo kireba Isi yose muri rusange, bityo ko ibihugu bigomba gushyira hamwe niba bikeneye kugitsinda. Ni ku nshuro ya mbere amashyaka atandukanye ku Isi ahuriza hamwe, akavuga ko ibihugu bikwiye kurwanya ibyorezo biba byibasiye Isi. Muri iri tangazo, iyi Imitwe ya Politiki yavuze ko uyu munsi Coronavirus imaze kuba icyorezo kibasiye Isi, kikaba kirimo kubangamira mu buryo bukomeye ubuzima bwa muntu, amahoro y’Isi n’ibikorwa by’iterambere. Iyi mitwe ya Politiki yabanje kunamira buri wese harimo abaganga n’abandi bapfuye kubera iki cyorezo na buri wese urimo kugirwaho ingaruka na Covid-19. Ivuga ko “Mu gihe Covid-19 yaba idakumiriwe hakiri kare, izagira ingaruka zikomeye ku buzuma bwa muntu, imibereho y’abaturage n’ibindi, bizagira ingaruka zikomeye ku mibereho ya muntu ndetse n’iterambere ry’ibihugu utaretse n’ubufatanye bw’ibihugu.” Yakanguriye ibihugu byose gushyira imbere ubuzima bwa muntu, kurengera ubuzima bw’abari mu kaga imbere ya byose no gushyiraho ingamba zikomeye kugira ngo iki cyorezo gihashywe. Iyi mitwe ya politiki kandi igira iti “Dushyigikiye ko ibihugu bishyiraho ingamba zifatika n’uburyo buhamye bwo gutsinda Coronavirus, iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga ririho uyu munsi rigomba gukoreshwa kugira ngo hashakwe igisubizo nyakuri.” Abagize iyi mitwe ya politiki bagaragaza ko abantu bose mu bihugu bitandukanye bagomba gukurikiza amabwirizwa yashyizweho n’ingamba zo kwirinda. Bagira bati “Turahamagarira ibihugu byose ko mu gihe bafashe ingamba zo kurandura iki cyorezo, banashyiraho uburyo buhamye bwo gufasha mu bikorwa by’iterambere, bagashyiraho uburyo bufatika bufasha abatishoboye n’ibigo bikiri bito muri ibi bihe.” Iyi mitwe ya Politiki yahamagariye ibihugu byose gushyiraho uburyo mpuzamahanga buhuriweho, bufasha mu guhangana n’ibiciro ku masoko n’ibindi, gufasha ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi kugira ngo harwanywe ko Isi yazahura n’ihungabana ry’ubukungu. Basabye kandi ko hakomeza kubaho kungurana ibitekerezo no gufashanya, ku buryo igihugu gifite ibikoresho runaka gifasha ikindi mu kurengera abafite ibibazo bya coronavirus. Abagize aya mashyaka bagize bati “Tuzi neza ko iki cyorezo nta mupaka kigira, nta gihugu cyahangana n’ingaruka z’iki cyorezo cyonyine, ibihugu bigomba gushyira imbere uburyo bw’ubufatanye.” Bashimiye kandi igihugu cy’u Bushinwa uburyo cyarwanyije iki cyorezo kimwe n’ibindi, bagishimira ko cyatanze ubumenyi ku bindi bihugu by’uburyo bwiza bwo kurwanya Coronavirus. Bagize bati “Turashimira cyane ibihugu birimo u Bushinwa uburyo byakoreye mu mucyo no gutanga amakuru, gutanga ubumenyi mu guhangana n’iki cyorezo ariko cyane cyane no gutanga imiti n’ibindi bikenerwa ku bihgugu byugarijwe cyane.” Abagize aya mashyaka kandi bashimiye inama yahuje ibihugu bikize ku Isi bihuriye mu muryango wa G20, uburyo byiyemeje guhangana na Coronavirus. Iyi mitwe ya politiki kandi yamaganye uburyo bwose bwabaho bwibasira igihugu runaka muri ibi bihe, ubwoko runaka, inahamagarira ibihugu byose kurengera ubuzima bw’abakora mu bikorwa by’ubuvuzi no kwita ku banyamahanga babirimo, harimo n’abanyeshuri babyigamo. Iyi mitwe ya politiki ivuga ko ibihe Isi irimo uyu munsi ari iby’igihe gito, ko umuryango mpuzamahanga nukomeza gushyira hamwe iki cyorezo kizatsindwa.

title: Igisiga cy’urwara rurerure: Rudasingwa yahishuye uruhare rwe mu bitero bya gerenade byigeze kwibasira Kigali
content: Iyi myaka iyo uyivuze hari abasesa urumeza bibutse ibisasu bya gerenade byagiye bihitana abantu abandi bagakomereka ku buryo hari n’abasigiwe ubumuga na byo. Uruhare rw’umutwe w’iterabwoba wa RNC, washinzwe n’abagamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda, rwagiye rugarukwaho mu manza z’abatawe muri yombi bakurikiranyweho gutera izo gerenade. Urugero ni Nshimiyimana Joseph uzwi nka Camarade wakurikiranyweho uruhare mu bitero bya gerenade byagabwe mu isoko rya Kicukiro tariki 13 Nzeri 2013. Nshimiyimana icyo gihe yivugiye ko yinjijwe muri ibyo bikorwa na Jean Paul Turayishimiye wari Umuvugizi w’Umutwe w’Iterabwoba (RNC) ndetse ko ari na we wamuhaye amabwiriza n’amafaranga yo kujya kugaba icyo gitero. Kuri ubu, uru ruhare rwa RNC ntawe ukirushidikanyaho nyuma y’uko uwahoze ari inkingi ya mwamba muri uyu mutwe, Théogène Rudasingwa, yeruye akiyemerera ko ibi bitero babigabye bagamije guhungabanya ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda. Rudasingwa yimennye inda mu gikorwa abo mu ishyirahamwe Jambo Asbl ry’urubyiruko rwiyemeje guhakana Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi no kuburanira abayikoze ndetse n’abo muri Institut Seth Sendashonga, bari bateguye cyo kunamira Kizito Mihigo wiyahuye kuwa 17 Gashyantare 2020. Théogène Rudasingwa yabaye Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’Umuyobozi mu Biro bya Perezida wa Repubulika. Abazi ibye neza bamwibukira ku buriganya mu iyubakwa ry’ibikorwa remezo bikomeye birimo na Hotel Intercontinental (Serena tubona ubu), icyo gihe ifaranga ryaratikiriye karahava abigizemo uruhare. Yari ageze ku kigero cyo kwandika imitungo ku bantu batari bo, byigeze no gutuma afungwa, acitse umunyururu, nawe ayabangira ingata. Rudasingwa yavuze ko mu gushinga RNC bashakaga guhuza abantu benshi b’ingeri zose, kuko bumvaga bakeneye gushyiraho ikintu cyagira ingufu zahubanganya ubuyobozi bw’u Rwanda burangajwe imbere na Perezida Kagame. Ati “Turi muri RNC nagize uruhare rwo gushyiraho ikintu cyagira ingufu kigahungabanya ubutegetsi bwa Kagame, twashatse abantu benshi, dufatanyije na FDU-Inkingi, kandi mubyibuke neza mu mwaka 2011, 2012…byagize ingaruka ubutegetsi bwa Kagame bwarahungabanye”. Iyi myaka ya 2011, 2012...ni yo muri Kigali n’ahandi hagabwe ibitero bya gerenade. Mu ntangiriro, ibisasu bya gerenade byatewe ku rwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi rwa Kigali, ruri ku Gisozi, biterwayo inshuro eshatu zose. Uretse aha, tariki ya 19 Gashyantare 2010, mu Mujyi wa Kigali hatewe gerenade eshatu ahagana mu ma saa mbili z’joro. Izi gerenade zatewe mu bice bitatu bitandukanye bihurirwamo n’abantu benshi, zahitanye abantu babiri, abagera kuri 30 barakomereka, batanu muri bo bakomereka ku buryo bukabije. Hari iyatewe ahazwi nko Kwa Rubangura, hakaba icyo gihe hari hagitegerwa imodoka zerekeza Kimironko, indi iterwa ahitwaga Chez Venant, ahategerwaga tagisi zerekeza mu byerekezo bitandukanye by’umujyi, iya gatatu yatewe muri gare nini ya Nyabugogo hahurirwa n’abantu benshi. Hari kandi nk’izatewe Kimironko, ku Gitega, Kicukiro Centre n’izindi zatewe no mu ntara mu turere twa Nyamagabe, Gisagara, Muhanga, Huye na Rubavu. Kuva muri Werurwe 2010, kugera muri Mutarama 2013, inzego z’iperereza zashoboye guta muri yombi abagera kuri 30 bakekwagaho kuba bafite uruhare cyangwa aho bahuriye n’ibi bikorwa. Ubutabera bwaratanzwe bamwe bakatirwa igifungo cya burundu, abandi bahanishwa igifungo cy’imyaka itandukanye. Irondabwoko mu bikomeje gushegesha abatavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi Rudasingwa yavuze ko irondabwoko mu mashyaka atavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda rikomeje kuyashegesha, aho usanga hakorwa amashyaka y’abatutsi, ay’abahutu. Ati “Umbajije ngo opozisiyo ubu mumeze mute nakubwira ngo ubu opozisiyo turi mu mwanya w’imbaraga nke ahubwo yaba byashobokaga hari ikintu mu gisirikare iyo watsinzwe, ugapfusha abantu benshi, umusozi wari uriho bakawukuvanaho ukora icyo bita ‘reorg’ [kwisuganya]”. Rudasingwa avuga ko mu batavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi bananiwe kubwizanya ukuri, iki kikaba nacyo kiri mu bikomeje kubasenya ijoro n’umunsi. Ati “Dushoboye gukemura ikibazo cyo kubwizanya ukuri...tutareba ngo aba ni abahutu, abatutsi, abameze bate...ni cyo cyatunaniye, nicyo gituma RNC yarasenyutse, FDU ijya mu bibazo na yo”. RNC Rudasingwa avuga ko yasenyutse, abayishinze bavugaga ko ari ihuriro ry’abanyarwanda rigamije impinduka mu Rwanda binyuze mu nzira z’amahoro. Ijya gushingwa, yari irangajwe imbere n’abagabo bane. Abo ni Théogène Rudasingwa, Kayumba Nyamwasa, Gérald Gahima, na Patrick Karegeya nibo bari ku ruhembe rw’ishingwa rya RNC mu 2010, umugambi wabo bawunogereza muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, batangira ibikorwa ubwo. Kugeza ubu ariko uyu mutwe uyobowe na Kayumba Nyamwasa uri mu marembera n’umwiryane udashira ukomeje gutuma abari inkingi za mwamba zawo bawuvamo ubutitsa abandi bakirukanwa.

title: Minisitiri Biruta asanga Uganda ifite ubushake, ibibazo byayo n’u Rwanda byakemuka mu cyumweru kimwe
content: Kuwa Gatanu tariki 21 Gashyantare 2020 nibwo Inama yabereye i Gatuna ihuje abayobozi b’u Rwanda, Uganda, Angola na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, yahaye Uganda ukwezi kumwe ko kugenzura ibirego bya Repubulika y’u Rwanda ku bikorwa bibera ku butaka bwayo by’imitwe ibangamiye guverinoma y’u Rwanda, byaba ari ukuri, Uganda igafata ingamba zose zo kubihagarika no kwirinda ko byakongera kubaho nyuma hakabaho ibiganiro byo gufungura imipaka. Mu kiganiro Majuscule Propos cya Televiziyo y’u Rwanda, cyavugaga ku bibazo by’u Rwanda na Uganda cyatambutse kuri iki Cyumweru, Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga, Dr. Vincent Biruta, yabajijwe ku cyizere cy’uko Uganda yaba izubahiriza ibyo yasabwe mu kwezi kumwe yahawe, asubiza ko ikibazo atari igihe cyo kubikemura ahubwo ikibazo ari ubushake bwa Politiki. Yavuze ko ibyo u Rwanda rusaba byumvikana kandi ko ari ibintu bitatwara icyumweru kimwe kugira ngo bikemuke Uganda iramutse ifite ubushake bwo kubikemura. Ati “Njye ntekereza ko iyo haba ubushake bwa Politiki bitajyaga gusaba iminsi 30 kubera ko ibyo u Rwanda rusaba birumvikana: Dufite abanyarwanda bafashwe bari muri gereza dusaba ko barekurwa. Turasaba ko gufata abanyarwanda no kubatoteza mu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko bihagarara. Turasaba ko ibikorwa byo gushyigikira imitwe irwanya u Rwanda bihagarara. Ndatekereza ko itari inakenewe, ibyo ni ibintu abantu bakora mu cyumweru kimwe.” Uganda iri mu bibazo by’ubukungu ndetse na Banki nkuru y’icyo gihugu iherutse kwerurira abagize Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ko yaguye mu gihombo cya miliyoni 545 z’amadorali ya Amerika mu myaka 15 ishize. Abasesenguzi basanga Uganda ikeneye cyane ko umupaka ufungurwa nubwo n’abanyarwanda bawukeneye. Ku ruhande rumwe bisa nk’aho Museveni yari yizeye ko inama iheruka isiga iwufunguye nkuko n’ubutumwa yanditse kuri Twitter bibugaragaza. Nyuma gato y’iyo nama yanditse ati “Mfitiye impuhwe abaturage ba Uganda n’ab’u Rwanda bagizweho ingaruka n’ifungwa ry’umupaka wa Gatuna. Ndabasaza kwihangana mu gihe turi gushaka igisubizo kirambye. Nizeye ko ukuri kuzagaragara kubera Guverinoma ya NRM [Ishyaka riri ku butegetsi] ihagaze ku kuri.” My sympathies go out to the citizens of Uganda and Rwanda that have been affected by the closure of the Katuna border. I call upon you to be patient as we pursue a lasting solution. I am very optimistic that the truth will come out because the NRM government stands for the truth. pic.twitter.com/940BtM2kTK — Yoweri K Museveni (@KagutaMuseveni) February 21, 2020 Dr. Vincent Biruta wari mu nama yabereye i Gatuna, yavuze ko abahuza bari bateguye gahunda irimo n’ikimenyetso cyo kwambuka umupaka, ariko abakuru b’ibihugu baza kuyihindura nyuma ari nabwo ikiganiro n’itangazamakuru cyakuwemo, hagasomwa itangazo. Birashoboka ko ariho icyizere Museveni yari afite cyari gishingiye. Ati “Ndakeka iyo nyandiko ya Twitter yaranditswe inama irimo cyangwa itararangira, wenda bikozwe n’ushinzwe konti ye ya Twitter.” Umujyanama wa Perezida Kagame, Dr Jean Paul Kimonyo, yavuze ko Museveni ashobora kuzubahiriza ibyo yasabwe kubera igitutu ariho cyerekeye ubukungu bwa Uganda buri kuzahara. Ati “Turebye uko ibintu bihagaze ubu Perezida Museveni ari ku gitutu gikomeye. Bisa nk’aho Museveni yatekerezaga ko inama yabaye ku wa Gatanu izafungura umupaka ariko si ko byagenze. Kuri we hari igitutu ku ruhande rw’ubukungu nubwo n’abanyarwanda bawukeneye [Umupaka].” Dr. Kimonyo asanga Uganda yaratunguwe n’uburyo u Rwanda rwitwaye ku bijyanye n’ifungwa ry’umupaka, itangira gufata ibyemezo bitandukanye. Ati “Ikibazo gitangira Uganda yaravuze ngo u Rwanda ruze rupfukame ariko ibyo ntibyashobotse. Ntabwo Museveni yakuyeho pasiporo ya Charlotte Mukankusi, [ushinzwe dipolomasi mu mutwe w’iterabwoba wa RNC, washinzwe na Kayumba Nyamwasa], ntabwo ari ku busa batangiye kurekura bamwe mu bo bafunze. Ndatekereza ko azakora ibyo asabwa niba bikenewe ko umupaka ufungurwa nkuko yabivuze.” Hashize imyaka itatu hari ubwumvikane buke hagati y’ibihugu byombi, u Rwanda rushinja Uganda gukorana no gukingira ikibaba ibikorwa by’imitwe igamije kuruhungabanyiriza umutekano, birimo iby’imitwe ya RNC, FDLR, RUD Urunana n’indi. Hari gufata no gufunga abanyarwanda mu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko bagakorerwa iyicarubozo ndetse no kubangamira ubucuruzi bwarwo. Intambwe imaze guterwa mu kuzahura umubano hagati y’ibihugu byombi, irimo kurekura abaturage bari bafunzwe kuri buri ruhande, no gusinya amasezerano yo guhererekanya abanyabyaha. Ibyo u Rwanda rusaba Uganda Kimwe mu byo u Rwanda rwari rwasabye mbere y’inama ya Kane y’i Gatuma cyo gutesha agaciro pasiporo yahawe Charlotte Mukankusi wo muri RNC ari nayo yakoreshaga mu ngendo ze, cyarubahirijwe. U Rwanda kandi rwari rwasabye Uganda kohereza abantu bagize uruhare mu bitero byo mu Kinigi mu mwaka ushize, byahitanye abantu 14 abandi bagakomereka. Ku wa Gatatu hari babiri boherejwe, nubwo hari abandi bataroherezwa. U Rwanda rukomeje gusaba Uganda gukurikirana ibikorwa n’ikusanywa ry’inkunga ihabwa imitwe yo guhungabanya u Rwanda, bikorwa n’abarimo Prossy Bonabaana, Sula Nuwamanya, Dr Rukundo Rugali, Emerithe Gahongayire na Emmanuel Mutarambirwa, byose bigashyigikirwa na RNC, binyuze mu muryango utari uwa leta Self-Worth Initiative. Mu bandi rusaba kohererezwa bari muri RUD Urunana yagabye igitero mu Kinigi, uretse Sous Lieutenant Selemani Kabayija na Private Fidèle Nzabonimpa bagejejwe mu Rwanda, hari Mugwaneza Eric na Capt. Nshimiye uzwi nka Governor ari na we wayoboye igitero cyo mu Kinigi. U Rwanda kandi rusaba Uganda gukurikirana abayobozi bakorana na RNC na RUD Urunana barimo Umunyamabanga wa Leta Philemon Mateke, Brig Gen Abel Kandiho uyobora CMI, Brig Gen Fred Karara, Col Sike Asiimwe, Major Fred Mushambo, Col Kaka Bagyenda n’abandi bayobozi bagira uruhare muri ibyo bikorwa.

title: Simva mu muryango ukomeye, aho ndi ni igihugu cyiza- Ikiganiro na Kamanzi uhagarariye urubyiruko mu Nteko (Video)
content: Mu matora yabaye muri uwo mwaka, abakandida 26 nibo bashakwagamo babiri bagombaga guhagararira urubyiruko muri manda y’imyaka itanu izageza mu 2023. Kamanzi Ernest yabonye amajwi 66.8%, Maniriho Clarisse abona amajwi 52.9%. Kamanzi w’imyaka 30, avuka mu karere ka Kamonyi mu Majyepfo y’u Rwanda, ni umusore. Uyu umusore iyo muganiriye bigaragara ko aba acishije make, akavuga ko umwanya ariho uyu munsi nubwo ari umwanya ukomeye, we awufata nk’ikirango cy’imiyoborere myiza igihugu giha abakiri bato. Avuga ko nubwo abenshi bashobora kwibwira ko yaba akomoka mu muryango ukomeye, bikaba aribyo byamugize uwo ariwe uyu munsi, ibi ngo sibyo kuko ava mu muryango utifashije cyane. Mu kiganiro yahaye IGIHE, Depite Kamanzi yavuze byinshi ku buzima bwe, uko agira uruhare mu kubaka igihugu n’uburyo abona ikibazo cy’ubushomeri mu rubyiruko. Ikiganiro na Depite Kamanzi Ernest IGIHE: Ukiri muto inzozi zawe wumvaga wifuza kuzakora iki? Kamanzi: Burya umwana wese agira inzozi, hari uvuga ati nzaba muganga, umusirakari n’ibindi, ariko uko ugenda ukura inzozi wari ufite zigenda zihinduka, njye rero nkiri muto numvaga nzaba umusirikari, ibi nabiterwaga n’amateka y’igihugu kuko nagiye mbona ko muri uru rugendo tumazemo imyaka 25, urubyiruko rwagize uruhare rukomeye ngo igihugu cyacu kibe kiri aho kiri uyu munsi, njye nabonye ko abasirikari aribo babigizemo uruhare mu kukibohora kugeza aho turi uyu munsi. Nubwo ibi byose nabyumvaga nkiri muto ariko byatumaga numva nzaba umusirikari, ariko uko ugenda ukura bitewe n’amahirwe igihugu gitanga numvise hari n’ubundi buryo nagikoreramo, ni uko naje kwisanga muri politike. IGIHE: Kuba depite abantu bashobora kwibwira ko biterwa n’umuryango ukomeye uvukamo, niko bimeze? Kamanzi: Amateka ya mbere ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, abakiri bato ntabwo bahabwaga amahirwe ngo batange umusanzu ariko ubu byarahindutse, uyu munsi bareba ubushobozi umuntu afite bitari aho uturuka. Nanjye rero nkomoka mu muryango utifashije cyane. IGIHE: Ni gute watekereje kwiyamamariza kuba umudepite? Kamanzi: Kuri njye nakuze numva hari icyo ngomba igihugu cyanjye, burya uko ugenda ugira inshingano kandi ukazikora neza uba wumva ugomba gutera intambwe, igihe cyo gutanga kandidatire cyarageze numva nanjye ndi umwe mu bagomba kuzitanga ndetse ndayitanga, ariko ntibihagije kuko uba guhangana n’abandi ukagaragaza ibyo uzamarira abaturage, mu guhitamo rero nsanga bampisemo. IGIHE: Umaze gutorwa aho uvuka babyakiriye gute? Kamanzi: Birumvikana buri muntu wese aho akomoka iyo umwana wabo yateye intambwe barishima, navuga ko banejejwe n’uko umwana wabo yateye intambwe ariko ntibyabatunguye cyane kuko muri kwa kundi umuntu ashaka icyo amarira igihugu cye, akenshi abantu baba bakubona mu bikorwa bitandukanye, ntabwo batunguwe cyane ahubwo banejejwe n’ibyo nagezeho. IGIHE: Wumvaga ari iki wagombaga gukorera urubyiruko ugeze mu Nteko? Kamanzi: Iyo ugiye kwiyamamaza kujya mu Nteko uba ugomba kubanza kumenya inshingano zayo, harimo gutora amategeko, kugenzura ibikorwa bya guverinoma no guhagararira abaturage. Iyo ugiyemo nk’uhagarariye urubyiruko mbere y’uko ugeramo uba wumva uzavuganira urubyiruko, ukareba niba amategeko atorwa ababereye, ukareba niba uko gahunda zigenerwa urubyiruko koko zibateza imbere, ibyo nibyo twumvaga tuzakorera urubyiruko. Iyo tugiye mu Nteko tureba niba gahunda igihugu cyihaye ariyo irimo gushyirwa mu bikorwa, ariko iyo ugezemo usanga n’abandi mukorana mufite izo nshingano mukagendera muri wa murongo. IGIHE: Ese koko abadepite bakorera abaturage uko bikwiye? Kamanzi: Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ntidukwiye kuyireba nk’urwego ruri ku ruhande rudashinzwe gufasha abaturage, iyo turi hariya Inteko icyo ikora ni ukureba niba icyerekezo guverinoma yihaye aricyo gishyirwa mu bikorwa, dufashe nk’urugero nk’abaturage bagombaga kuva mu manegeka, iriya ntabwo yari gahunda yo kubangamira abaturage ahubwo ni ukugira ngo bibarengere. Iyo umuturage ari hariya aba yabura ubuzima , icyo gihe Inteko tuba tugomba kureba uko bava mu manegeka. Mwarabibonye ko nyuma yo kuhabakura imvura yaraguye itwara amazu yabo, twe nk’abadepite iyo tubonye ko ibyo leta ikora biri mu nyungu z’umuturage, duhama muri uwo murongo. IGIHE: Mugeze mu Nteko nta gihe mwigeze kugira ubwoba bwo kuvuga? Kamanzi: Burya tugira umugisha kuko tugira ubuyobozi butanga umwanya ku bakiri bato nabo bakagaragaza icyo bashoboye. Mbere twumvaga kuzakorana nabo bizagorana ariko twaje kwishimira gukorana n’abantu bafite uburambe. Ibyo ariko biba bisaba ko ukora ubushakashatsi kugira ngo ibitekerezo utanga koko bitaba bihabanye n’ibyabo. IGIHE: Ikibazo cy’ubushomeri ukibona gute mu rubyiruko? Kamanzi: Kuba tuvuga ubushomeri uyu munsi ni uko mbere ya Jenoside bitavugawga, uyu munsi turabivuga kuko igihugu cyatanze amahirwe, ayo mahirwe ni uko iyo tuvuze uburezi kuri wese, umuntu wese ugejeje imyaka yo kwiga yiga, iyo yize biba bivuze ko dufite abantu benshi bize ariko bitari ugusaba akazi leta ahubwo kugahanga. Iki ntabwo rero ari ikibazo gikomeye, icyo twita ikibazo dukwiye kukibyazamo amahirwe, ayo mahirwe ya mbere ni uko igihugu cyakwigishije mbere ntibyari biriho. Ikindi abantu bakwishimira ni uko urubyiruko tubona uyu munsi ruratanga icyizere. Nk’ubu tugiye mu ikoranabuhanga imishinga myinshi irimo guhangwa ni urubyuko rurimo, muri Made in Rwanda abakiri bato nibo barimo kugaragaramo, abantu barangije Kaminuza barimo kubyaza ubuhinzi amafaranga menshi. Depite Kamanzi avuga ko icyo abakiri bato bakwiye kureba ari ayo mahirwe igihugu cyabahaye bakayabyaza umusaruro, kuko guverinoma ngo yiteguye kubafasha.

title: Urwishe ya nka ruracyayirimo: Leah Karegeya yahize guhirika ubuyobozi bwa Kayumba Nyamwasa muri RNC
content: Ibibaso bikomeje kuba urusobe ku bayobozi bawo barimo Kayumba Nyamwasa, kugeza n’aho Leah Karegeya, umugore w’umwe mu bashinze uyu mutwe, avuze ko agiye kwihuza n’abandi badashyigikiye Kayumba Nyamwasa bakamuhirika. Ni nyuma y’uko abari basigaye bakomeye muri uyu mutwe bose basa n’abitandukanyije na Kayumba Nyamwasa kuko na Frank Ruhinda, musaza wa Leah Karegeya wabaga muri Uganda, yamaze gutoroka RNC agahungira muri Canada aho yagiye kwifatanya na ba Tabita Gwiza, uheruka kwirukanwa muri RNC. Uyu Tabitha Gwiza yahoze ari Komiseri ushinzwe abari n’abategarugoli mu ntara ya RNC ya Canada akaba n’umubitsi w’Akarere ka Windsor, ariko mu minsi ishize yarirukanwe. Uyu Gwiza ni mushiki wa Ben Rutabana uheruka kuburirwa irengero, ikibazo cyasembuye umwiryane muri uyu mutwe. Frank Ruhinda ni umwe mu bagize uruhare runini mu gushora abanyarwanda baba muri uganda mu mutwe wa P5 afatanyije na CMI, ababyanze bagakorerwa ibikorwa by’iyicarubozo abandi bakanicwa. Kwihuza kwa Leah Karegeya, Frank Ruhinda, Tabita Gwiza n’abandi bafatwa nk’abari ibikomerezwa muri uyu mutwe bigamije kotsa igitutu Kayumba ushinjwa kurigisa umutungo wa RNC, akawushora mu bikorwa bye by’ubucuruzi biri muri Afurika y’Epfo, Mozambique n’ahandi. Leah Karegeya wahoze mu kanama gashinzwe imyitwarire n’imikorere muri RNC, mu minsi ishize ni bwo yashyize hanze ibaruwa ifunguye ikubiyemo ubwegure bwe ku nshingano yari yarahawe. Muri urwo rwandiko, yavuze ko yeguye kubera ko komite yari ayoboye itizewe, ku buryo imyanzuro bafata idahabwa agaciro. Ati "Nasanze nta mpamvu yo kuguma kuba umuyobozi mu gihe nka komite yahawe inshingano zo gufata ibyemezo ku bayobozi, nta gaciro babiha". Imwe muri iyo myanzuro harimo irebana n’uwari umuvugizi wayo, Jean Paul Turayishimye uheruka kwirukanwa nyuma yo kuzamura ikibazo kirimo ibura ry’umwe muri ba komiseri muri RNC, Benjamin Rutabana. Leah yavuze ko itsinda rye ryemeje ko Turayishimye yirukanwe kubera ko yagaragaje impungenge ku ibura rya Rutabana. Gusa Nyamwasa we yahisemo ahubwo kumwirukana atabagishije inama. Leah Karegeya yafatwaga nk’inararibonye muri RNC kuko yari umuyobozi mu kanama k’inararibonye kagishwaga inama mu bikorwa bitandukanye by’uyu mutwe kandi akaba umwe mu bantu bakunzwe n’abayoboke benshi ba RNC. Amakuru avuga ko benshi mu bashyigikiye Leah Karegeya batuye muri Afurika y’Epfo, i Burayi na Canada bari gukora uko bashoboye kose ngo bitandukanye na RNC, ariko bakabinyuza mu buryo bwo kwegura bavuga ko ari ku mpamvu zabo bwite, birinda kwiteranya na Kayumba. Kuva hamenyekana amakuru y’ibura rya Ben Rutabana bikekwa ko ryagizwemo uruhare na Kayumba Nyamwasa, benshi mu bayobozi muri uyu mutwe w’iterabwoba bareguye abandi bareguzwa baranirukanwa. Ibi byahise bitanga ishusho ko RNC yabaye nk’ubwato buri kurohama kandi butagifite umusare ubuyoboye. Ibi kandi byaje bikurikiye icyemezo cya leta ya Afurika y’Epfo kibuza impunzi ziri ku butaka bwayo gukora ibikorwa n’inama zifite aho zihuriye na politiki. Kugeza ubu abafatwaga nk’inkingi za mwamba muri RNC bitandukanyije nayo ni Dr. Théogène Rudasingwa, Kazungu Jean Paul, Dr. Muvunyi Paulin, Bwayihuku Mathias, na Nsabimana Callixte wiyita Sankara uri mu maboko y’ubutabera mu Rwanda. Mu baburiwe irengero mu buryo budasobanutse bikekwa ko byakozwe n’ubuyobozi bwa RNC ni Maj Nkubana Emmanuel, Rwarinda Michel, na Benjamin Rutabana wari ukuriye ikigega cyitiriwe umuryango wa Rwigara cyanyuzwamo hafi 75% by’inkunga yatungaga RNC. Umuzi w’ibibazo Leah Karegeya afitanye n’ubuyobozi bwa RNC si uwa vuba aha kuko kuva umugabo we, Patrick Karegeya, yapfa, abasigaye mu buyobozi bwawo ntibigeze bamuha ijambo. Nyamwasa n’umugore we ni inzobere mu kunyereza umutungo, bashoye umutungo wa RNC mu bucuruzi bw’umuryango wabo harimo amahahiro akomeye muri Afurika y’Epfo, muri Mozambique n’ahandi nk’uko amakuru abivuga. Nyamwasa ashinjwa kwiharira RNC, aho bagenzi be bafatanyije gushinga uyu mutwe bamushinja kunyereza umutungo, kutagira imiyoborere inoze, kwironda, gukoresha icyenewabo no kwigwizaho iby’uyu mutwe. Kayumba yagiye akorana bya hafi n’abo mu muryango we barimo muramu we, Frank Ntwari, uyu akaba yaranamuhaye imbaraga zo kuba komiseri ushinzwe urubyiruko. Ntwari yagiye ashinjwa n’umugore wa Rutabana, Diane Rutabana ko ari umuntu wagiye atera ubwoba umugabo we. Diane yavuze ko inshuro nyinshi yagiye agaragaza ikibazo afite, aho yanabwiye Ijwi rya Amerika ko Ntwari yagiye atera ubwoba Rutabana, ko mu gihe yaba asubiye muri Uganda azamufunga.

title: Perezida Kagame yavuze uko Uganda yamusabye ko Abanyarwanda basubukurayo ingendo akabyanga
content: Mu ntangiriro z’uku kwezi nibwo Uganda yarekuye abanyarwanda icyenda mu magana y’abari bafungiye ku butaka bwayo, barimo abari bamaze imyaka igera kuri ibiri bafunzwe nta byaha bigaragara bashinjwa ahubwo bakorerwa iyicarubozo amanywa n’ijoro. Abo banyarwanda barekuwe ni bamwe mu magana y’abo u Rwanda rwakunze gusaba Uganda kurekura, ruvuga ko bafashwe mu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko bagatotezwa, ntibagezwe mu butabera bamwe bagakurizmao no gupfa. U Rwanda kandi rwagiye rwinubira uburyo Uganda ikorana n’imitwe ishaka kuruhungabanyiriza umutekano irimo RNC ya Kayumba Nyamwasa. Byatumye muri Werurwe umwaka ushize, rugira inama abaturage barwo yo guhagarika ingendo zijya muri Uganda kuko umutekano wabo utizewe. Kuri uyu wa Gatatu ubwo Perezida Kagame yakiraga ku meza abahagarariye ibihugu byabo n’imiryango mpuzamahanga mu Rwanda, anabifuriza umwaka mushya wa 2020, yavuze ko Uganda iherutse kumusaba kubwira abanyarwanda ko bakongera gutemberera muri icyo gihugu. Yavuze ko Uganda yabihereye kuri abo banyarwanda icyenda yari imaze kurekura n’abandi bake barekuwe mbere, ikumva ko nawe yahita abwira Abanyarwanda ngo basubire gukorera ingendo muri Uganda bisanzuye. Ati “Bahise bambwira bati mukwiriye kugira icyo mukora. Ngo mubwire Abanyarwanda baze muri Uganda. Uwabimbwiraga naramubwiye nti nta kibazo, ariko se nindamuka mbyemeye, uyu munsi n’ejo, n’ejo bundi Abanyarwanda bakongera bagafungwa n’abafunzwe mbere batararekurwa?” Yakomeje agira ati “Murumva nzasubira kubwira Abanyarwanda ngo narababeshye, nimwongere muhagarike kujya muri Uganda ? Naramubwiye nti mutubabarire, mureke gufata abanyarwanda kuko n’abafashwe ntibigeze bagira ibyo bashinjwa imyaka n’imyaka. Ikindi nimurekere aho gukorana n’iriya mitwe ishaka guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda, nibikorwa gufungura umupaka bizahita byikora.” Perezida Kagame yavuze ko kubera umubano w’u Rwanda na Uganda utari wifashe neza, byanatumye umwaka ushize kuyobora umuryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba (EAC) bikomera, kurusha uko byamworoheye mu 2017 ubwo yari ayoboye umuryango wa Afurika yunze Ubumwe. Ati “Nubwo ari ibihugu bike ariko byari bigoye kurusha kuyobora umugabane wose ariko ubuyobozi bwaba ubw’igihugu kimwe n’igihugu cyanjye mpura n’impogamizi kandi ari igihugu kimwe nkanswe umuryango. Ngira ngo muzi ibibazo twahuye nabyo n’abaturanyi bacu ariko by’umwihariko umuturanyi wacu mu majyaruguru, Uganda.” Yavuze ko intego za EAC ari ubufatanye , kwihuza n’imigenderanire myiza y’abayituye , gusa ngo ntabwo bipfa kwikora. Yavuze kuba EAC yifuza gufungurirana amarembo hagati y’ibihugu biyigize bitazikora. Ati “Kuyikuraho [imipaka] ugomba kugira icyo ukora, ugomba gutsura umubano n’abaturanyi. Ukabafata nk’uko bagufata. Ntabwo wahiga abantu bo mu kindi gihugu ngo ugaruke uvuga ngo ibintu by’imipaka ntacyo bivuze.” Yavuze ko nubwo imipaka yakurwaho hagati y’ibihugu, kuba abaturanyi bitazavaho kandi bizahora bisaba kubanirana neza. Perezida Kagame yavuze ko igihe cyose udashaka ko umuturanyi wawe agera iwawe, uba wamaze gushyiraho umupaka ubatandukanya nubwo mu bigaragara nta yindi mipaka yaba ihari. Ati “Nzatembera ariko ningera ku rugo rwawe mvuge nti oya aha sinaharenga, uzaba wamaze gushyiraho umupaka hagati y’imiryango. Nibyo byabaye hagati y’u Rwanda na Uganda mu minsi ishize.” Kubana nk’abaturanyi, Perezida Kagame yabigereranyije nko guturana mufite inzu z’ibyatsi, ko igihe cyose mwirinda icyatuma imwe ifatwa n’umuriro kuko ikongeza izindi. Ati “ Iyo ufite inzu z’ibyatsi zegeranye, wirinda kunagamo umuriro kuko n’inzu yawe izashya. Inzu y’umuturanyi nifatwa n’umuriro, izakongeza n’iyawe. Niko ikibazo giteye, niyo mpamvu ubufatanye aricyo kintu cyiza.” Yakomeje agira ati “Twize amasomo menshi. Tuzi ububi bwo gutwika inzu z’abandi, turabizi neza icyo bisaba. Twe ntabwo tujya dukina iyo mikino yo gutwika inzu z’abandi ariko dushyira imbaraga mu kurinda izacu ngo zidashya mu buryo bworoshye, kandi tugaharanira ko ushaka gutwika inzu zacu bizamutwara ikiguzi kinini.” Perezida Kagame yavuze ko amasezerano yo kubyutsa umubano hagati y’u Rwanda na Uganda ku buhuza bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo na Angola, yitezweho kurangiza ibyo bibazo byose.
