title: Ibyo wamenya ku ndwara zo mu mutwe zishobora gutera uzirwaye kureba ibitandukanye n’ibyo abandi babona
content:
Umuganga w’inzobere mu kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe, unakuriye iryo shami mu Bitaro bikuru bya Kaminuza bya Kigali (CHUK), Dr Simon Kanyandekwe, yabwiye IGIHE ko ziterwa n’uruhererekane rw’impamvu nyinshi. Ati “Ziterwa n’uburyo ubwonko bw’umuntu bwaremwe [nta budahangarwa], akenshi usanga bavuga ko umuntu ashobora kurwara kurusha abandi. Uko umuntu yabayeho mu muryango akomokamo cyangwa aho yakuriye, ibibazo yahuye nabyo akiri umwana [nk’ihungabanga] n’imibereho y’umuntu aho asanzwe aba byaba mu muryango cyangwa n’ahandi.” Mu bushakashatsi bwakozwe, nta burerekana ko indwara zo mu mutwe umuntu ashobora kuzirwara bitewe n’uko hari uwo akomokaho cyangwa uwo bafitanye isano wazirwaye. Zitandukanira he? Ni indwara ziri mu byiciro bitandukanye zirimo izifata amarangamutima ya muntu nk’agahinda gakabije [Depression] cyangwa agahinda gakabije kavanze n’imihindukire y’umubiri aho umuntu ashobora kugira ibishimo bidasanzwe, akabura ibitotsi, agakora byinshi icya rimwe [Bipolar disorder]. Hari kandi izifata abantu bakagira imyitwarire idasanzwe mu gusabana n’abandi zikunze kwitwa ibisazi, aho usanga umuntu yumva ibyo abandi batumva cyangwa akabona ibyo abandi batabona. Iyi ikunze gufata abantu bari mu cyiciro cy’imyaka guhera kuri 17 kuzamura. Dr Kanyandekwe yasobanuye ko hari umuntu urwara yari umunyeshuri agahita arivamo, kuko aba atakibona cyangwa ngo yumve kimwe n’abandi, akagira ubwoba mu mubiri atazi aho buturuka, bikanamubuza gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo asabwe. Ibi abatabizi iyo bifashe umwana batangira kumushyira mu cyiciro cy’utazi ubwenge cyangwa wananiwe n’amasomo amwe n’amwe. Ati “Byakomera agatangira gusakuza cyangwa kumenagura ibintu, kugendagenda nta gahunda afite. Aba ashakisha amahoro ariko atazi aho ayashakisha, rimwe na rimwe akumva ikintu cy’ubwoba budasanzwe atazi impamvu, rimwe na rimwe ugasanga yikingiranye mu cyumba yumva abantu bose bashaka kumugirira nabi.” Ugeze muri iki cyiciro atangira kugenda ashakisha icyamufasha gutuza yabona nk’ibiyobyabwenge akabinywa, akongera igihe akoresha ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga nka telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa ashaka kuganira n’abantu bategeranye. Hari kandi idwara yo mu mutwe ifata umuntu akagira ubwoba budasanzwe, ifata abantu bo mu byiciro byose ku buryo ashobora kwibonaho ibimenyetso bishobora no kuba iby’izindi ndwara. Aha Dr Kanyandekwe yasobanuye ko umuntu ashobora kugira ubwoba nk’umutima we ugatera mu buryo budasanzwe, agatitira, akabira ibyuya ku buryo bishobora kumufata akajyanwa mu byiciro by’indembe ariko bamupima ntihaboneke indwara afite. Iyo ndwara ngo ishobora gufata umuntu yari nk’umuyobozi agatangira gutinya kuvugira mu ruhame cyangwa kuyobora inama ariko atazi icyabimuteye, bikamenyekana ko ari indwara ari uko bitangiye kugira ingaruka ku kazi akora. Gusa hari indwara zisanzwe nka mugiga, ibibyimba byo mu mutwe n’izindi zishobora gufata umuntu akagira ibimenyetso nk’iby’indwara zo mu mutwe. Ubusanzwe abantu batandukana mu myitwarire. Hari abo usanga batuje abandi ugasanga bashabutse. Dr Kanyandekwe yasobanuye ko kugira ngo umenye niba umuntu afite agahinda gakabije kavanze n’ibyishimo bidasanzwe (Bipolar Disorder) hagenderwa ku bimenyetso yagiraga mbere y’uko afatwa. Iyi ndwara iyo ifashe umutu atangira gukora ibitandukanye n’ibyo yakoraga, yaba afite nk’umukoresha agatangira kumubwira ibintu atajyaga amubwira birimo kumwubahuka cyangwa kumusuzugura cyangwa umuntu mutaziranye ukabona akwisanzuraho nk’aho muziranye. Nyir’ubwite ntamenya ko hari icyahindutse n’ubimubwiye arakara.
Ati “Mpuye n’umuntu bwa mbere ndi kwinywera icyayi, ndi kuganira n’undi wowe ukaza ako kanya ukansuhuza nk’aho tuziranye hanyuma ugafata nk’igikombe cyanjye ugatangira kukinyweramo. Nubwo waba utari umuganga, wakwibaza habaye iki kugira ngo yitware gutyo.” Uwo muntu ngo arangwa no kumenyera abantu bose n’abo bataziranye akababonamo inshuti n’abavandimwe. Icyo gihe ngo biba bisaba kumwegereza inzobere mu kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe bakareba niba adafite ikibazo. Dr Kanyandekwe ati “Maze imyaka 20 maze muri uyu mwuga hari ubwo bigeze kumpamagara ngo hari umuntu muri Round Point [amasangano y’imihanda] nini yo mu Mujyi ari kuvuga menshi, witwara mu buryo budasanzwe, wabujije n’imodoka gutambuka. Akanga kuva mu muhanda avuga ko abandi aribo barwaye batamushakira amahoro.” Izi ndwara abazirwaye bakunze kugira imbaraga zidasanzwe, rimwe na rimwe bakumva bafite n’ubutumwa bwihariye bakwiye kugeza ku bandi. Aho ngo iyo ari umuntu usenga cyane ukunze gusanga ashaka kubwiriza abandi ko hari ibyo Imana bavuganye ikamutuma, akizeza abantu ibitangaza ko yahawe ububasha n’Imana. Ibi ariko ngo si kimwe n’uko umuntu ashobora gucengerwa n’ijambo ry’Imana agashaka kuryigisha aho ageze hose ariko ngo “Uryigisha agateza umutekano muke mu bandi, ugasanga muri we hatarimo kumva ko ibyo bitemewe, bibangamiye abandi kugeza ubwo bamubuza akananirana, utamwise umurwayi wo mu mutwe ushobora kwibaza niba adakenewe kugezwa ku nzobere.” 
Ubufasha buhabwa uwarwaye indwara zo mu mutwe Umuntu ufite imyitwarire idasanzwe kugera ubwo ibangamira abandi cyangwa ikagira ingaruka ku kazi akora, icyo umuntu asabwa ni ukwihutira kumwegereza abaganga bamwegereye kugira ngo ahabwe ubufasha hakiri kare. Dr Kanyandekwe avuga ko kuboha umurwayi wo mu mutwe utera amahane iyo bidakwiriye kuko ngo bishobora kumutera ibikomere. Umuganga w’inzobere amwitaho binyuze mu biganiro bagirana n’imiti imufasha bijyanye n’ibimenyetso yagaragaje cyangwa impamvu nyamukuru zamuteye kugira imyitwarire idasanzwe. Ati “Umuganga agomba kumenya uwo muntu yari abayeho gute mbere y’uko atugana, ni ikihe kibazo yahuye nacyo kimukomereye, wamara kukibona ukamufasha kugarura icyizere.” Uburwayi bwo mu mutwe n’amarozi Dr Kanyandekwe yasobanye ko imiryango imwe n’imwe cyane cyane muri Afurika ikunze guha ibisobanuro indwara zo mu mutwe ibuhuje n’amarozi cyangwa amadayimoni kimwe n’uko umuntu ahuye n’ikibazo icyo aricyo cyose agishakira imvano aho kubishakira mu mubiri imbere. Ati “Nabyita ko ari imyumvire y’abantu ariko ntitwapfa kubyirengagiza. Kimwe [imyumvire] ntabwo kirwanya ikindi [ibishingira ku bimenyetso byo mu mubiri imbere] ariko ubundi ubihuje nibwo wafasha umuntu neza. Ntabwo dufite uburyo bwo gupima amarozi.” Indwara zo mu mutwe ni indwara zivurwa zigakira ariko bigatwara igihe gitandukanye bitewe n’ubukana zifite, hari n’izishobora gutuma umurwayi afata imiti igihe kirekire, igikenewe ni ugukurikiza inama ahabwa na muganga kandi akavuzwa hakiri kare. Ni umutwaro ku gihugu? Dr Kanyandekwe yashimangiye ko indwara zo mu mutwe ari umutwaro ku gihugu, uzirwaye no ku muryango muri rusange. Imibare y’ikigo cy’ubuzima, RBC yerekana ko 50% by’indwara zo mu mutwe zitangira mbere gato y’imyaka 14 y’amavuko. Abasaga ibihumbi 200 barwaye indwara zo mu mutwe bazitewe n’ibiyobyabwenge. Abahanga mu by’ubuzima bwo mu mutwe batangaza ko akenshi kwiyahura kuba gufite aho guhuriye n’ibibazo byo mu mutwe uwiyahuye yari afite. Imibare ya Polisi y’u Rwanda igaragaza ko abantu 121 bapfuye biyahuye mu mezi icyenda ya 2019. Imibare y’Ishami rya Loni ryita ku Buzima (OMS) igaragaza ko 60 % y’abagerageza kwiyahura baba bafite agahinda gakabije naho 90 % baba bafite imwe mu ndwara zo mu mutwe. [email protected]

title: Coronavirus ku wa 29 Gicurasi: Abanduye ku Isi biyongereyeho ibihumbi 116 ku munsi umwe
content: Iyi mibare ikomeje kwiyongera mu gihe ibihugu hirya no hino ku Isi bikomeje koroshya gahunda yari yarashyizweho yo kuguma mu ngo. OMS yagaragaje ko kuri uyu wa Kane, Isi yapfushije abantu 4600, ibi byatumye abamaze gupfa baba 362 102. Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika zapfushije abantu 1 223 umunsi umwe, mu gihe abandi barenga ibihumbi 22 banduye. Ibi byatumye abamaze gupfa muri iki gihugu baba 103 330 naho abamaze kwandura bamaze kugera kuri 1 768 461. Brésil iri mu bihugu byugarijwe cyane ku Isi kuko kuri uyu wa Kane yapfushije abantu 1 067 abandi barenga ibihumbi 24 barandura. Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika kandi nizo zikomeje kugira abanduye benshi inaza imbere mu kugira abamaze gupfa benshi ku Isi. Brésil iri ku mwanya wa kabiri mu banduye kuko ari 438 812, mu gihe hamaze gupfa 26 764. U Burusiya buza ku mwanya wa gatatu kuko bufite abanduye 379 051, hamaze gupfa abarenga 4142, muri Espagne handuye 284 986 hamaze gupfa 27 119, naho mu Bwongereza handuye 269 127, hamaze gupfa 37 837. Ku mugabane wa Afurika wose hamaze kugaragara abantu 131 587 banduye Coronavirus, abamaze gupfa basaga 3 814 naho abakize ni 55 126. Afurika y’Epfo iri imbere mu kugira abafite ubwandu benshi kuko ari 27 403, abamaze gupfa ni 577, ikurikirwa na Misiri ubu ifite abamaze gupfa benshi kuri uyu mugabane kuko bageze kuri 845 naho abamaze kwandura ni 20 793. Muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, Kenya nicyo gihugu cyugarijwe cyane kuko kuri uyu wa Kane gusa, cyabonye abandi bantu bashya banduye 123. Kugeza ubu ni igihugu cyo mu karere kiza imbere mu bwandu kuko hamaze kwandura abantu 1 618, hapfuye 58. U Rwanda rufite abanduye 349, abamaze gukira ni 245, muri Uganda ubu hari abanduye 317, mu Burundi handuye abantu 42 hapfa umwe naho muri Sudani y’Epfo hamaze kwandura abantu 994 hamaze gupfa 10. Mu bihugu bihana imbibi n’u Rwanda, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo niyo yibasiwe cyane, kuko ubu ifite abanduye 2 660 barimo 69 bamaze gupfa. Kuri uyu wa Kane iki gihugu cyagize abanduye 114.

title: Abanduye Coronavirus mu Rwanda biyongereyeho 3 baba 349, abayikize baguma kuri 245
content: Muri iyi minsi abarwayi ba Coronavirus bari gutahurwa ni abiganjemo abashoferi b’amakamyo yambukiranya imipaka n’abo bakorana. Itangazo rya Minisiteri y’Ubuzima ryo kuri uyu wa 28 Gicurasi 2020 rivuga ko "abarwayi bashya bose bahise bashyirwa mu kato bakihagera.’’ Umurwayi wa mbere wa COVID-19 iterwa n’agakoko ka Coronavirus yabonetse mu Rwanda ku wa 14 Werurwe 2020. Kuva icyo gihe abantu 349 bamaze kwandura mu gihe 245 basezerewe mu bitaro nyuma yo gukira. Abantu 104 ni bo bari kwitabwaho mu bitaro byagenewe gushyirwamo abasanganywe Coronavirus. Ibimenyetso bya Coronavirus birimo inkorora, ibicurane, guhumeka bigoranye n’umuriro. Yandura binyuze mu matembabuzi aturuka mu myanya y’ubuhumekero. Abaturarwanda basabwa gukomeza kubahiriza amabwiriza ya Leta hitabwa cyane cyane ku gukaraba intoki kenshi n’amazi n’isabune, kwambara udupfukamunwa n’amazuru mu gihe umuntu avuye mu rugo cyangwa ahuye n’abantu benshi. Ibimenyetso bya Coronavirus birimo inkorora, ibicurane, guhumeka bigoranye n’umuriro. Yandura binyuze mu matembabuzi aturuka mu myanya y’ubuhumekero. Coronavirus yagaragaye bwa mbere mu Mujyi wa Wuhan mu Bushinwa mu Ukuboza 2019; kuri ubu 5 858 573 bamaze kuyandura ku Isi yose, barimo 359 991 yahitanye na 2 540 838 bamaze kuyikira.

title: Ishusho ya Coronavirus mu minsi 10: Nta murwayi waturutse mu baturage hagati
content: Kuri uyu wa Gatatu gusa habonetse abantu barindwi basanganywe Coronavirus mu bipimo 2059 byafashwe mu gihe umwe ariwe wasezerewe mu bitaro nyuma yo gukira. Imibare y’abanduye Coronavirus, irerekana ko muri iyi minsi bari kuboneka cyane mu bashoferi b’amakamyo yambukiranya imipaka n’abo bakorana ndetse n’abaturuka hanze y’igihugu batashye. Minisitiri w’ubuzima Dr Ngamije Daniel, yavuze ko mu bushakashatsi butandukanye bwo kureba uko icyorezo gihagaze mu gihugu, byagaragaye ko kitari mu baturage ku buryo gikwirakwizwa ntawe uzi uwanduza undi mu baturage. Ibi ni nabyo byagendeweho hafatwa icyemezo cyo kugira ngo imirimo itandukanye isubukurwe. Yakomeje avuga ko muri iyi minsi imibare y’abanduye Coronavirus itangazwa nta muturage w’imbere mu gihugu urimo. Ati “Abantu duhora dutangaza muri iyi minsi abenshi ni abava mu cyiciro cy’abatwara amakamyo ya rukururana cyangwa se abantu bari bagiye mu bihugu hanze”. Minisitiri Ngamije atanga icyizere ko hari ingamba zafashwe zo gutuma Coronavirus, itambuka imipaka y’u Rwanda ngo yinjire mu gihugu, aho uwambutse wese asuzumwa, yaba yaranduye akajyanwa aho avurirwa yaba ataranduye agashyirwa mu kato nk’uko amabwiriza abiteganya. Ati “Ingamba zihari ni uko ntabwo twafunga imipaka ibyo birumvikana ariko abinjira turabasuzuma, ku buryo muri bo uwanduye ntaho aducikira rwose, turamwakira, tukamusuzuma, ufite ubwandu tukajya kumuvurira ahantu habugenewe, udafite ikibazo agakomeza ubuzima bwe busanzwe”. Ku mipaka yose y’u Rwanda hashyizwe amatsinda y’abaganga bakira abantu baje, bakareba ufite ibimenyetso, bagasuzumwa bakajya gupimwa, bagategereza ya minsi yo kuba mu kato, ugaragayeho uburwayi ajya kuvurwa, udafite ikibazo akarekurwa amaze kurangiza iminsi ye y’akato. Imiterere y’ubwandu mu mibare  Tariki 18 Gicurasi: Habonetse abantu batanu bose baturutse hanze  Tariki 19 Gicurasi: Habonetse abantu 10 baturutse hanze n’umwe wahuye n’uwanduye  Tariki 20 Gicurasi: Habonetse batandatu baturutse hanze  Tariki 21 Gicurasi: Habonetse batanu baturutse hanze n’umwe wahuye n’uwanduye  Tariki 22 Gicurasi: Habonetse umwe waturutse hanze  Tariki 23 Gicurasi: Habonetse bane baturutse hanze  Tariki 24 Gicurasi: Habonetse babiri baturutse hanze  Tariki 25 Gicurasi: Habonetse icyenda baturutse hanze  Tariki 26 Gicurasi: Habonetse umwe waturutse hanze na babiri bahuye n’uwanduye  Tariki 27 Gicurasi: Habonetse abantu barindwi baturutse hanze Kuba imibare yerekana ko mu baturage imbere mu gihugu nta bwandu burimo, biri mu byatumye inama y’Abaminisitiri yo kuwa 18 Gicurasi, yemeza ko ingendo zihuza intara n’Umujyi wa Kigali zizongera gusubukurwa ku wa 1 Kamena ndetse ko ari nawo munsi moto zitwara abantu zizemererwa kongera gukora. Mu ngamba zatangiye kubahirizwa kuwa 4 Gicurasi, imihango yo gushyingura yagombaga kujyamo abantu batarenze 10 ariko barongerewe bagirwa 30. Ishyingirwa imbere y’Ubuyobozi ryaremewe ariko rigomba kwitabirwa n’abantu batarenze 15. Iyindi mihango nko gusezerana mu nsengero cyangwa byo kwiyakira ntibyemewe. Izi ngamba zizakomeza gukurikizwa mu gihe cy’iminsi 15, kugeza kuwa 4 Kamena ari nabwo hazasohoka andi mabwiriza mashya yo gukurikiza. Bisobanuye ko habura iminsi itandatu ngo hatangwe andi mabwiriza mashya. Imibare yerekana ko kuva kuwa 18 Gicurasi kugeza kuwa 27 Gicurasi, abantu 48 bakize Coronavirus bagasezererwa. Icyizere ku bikorwa bitarafungurwa Inama y’abaminisitiri iheruka yemeje ko insengero zizakomeza gufunga, utubari tuzakomeza gufunga n’Inama n’amateraniro rusange cyangwa mu ngo z’abantu bibujijwe. Bamwe mu baturage bavuga ko nubwo icyorezo kigihari, basanga ubukwe n’insengero byafungurwa ariko hakubahirizwa amabwiriza yo kwirinda nko gukaraba intoki n’ayandi. Minisitiri w’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu, Prof Shyaka Anastase, aherutse kuvuga ko ‘ibyakozwe atari ukugora amadini n’amatorero, aboneraho gusaba abifuza gukora ubukwe bwabo bwiza ko bategereza igihe izi gahunda zose zizaba zemewe’. Yagize ati “Ntabwo ari ukugora abanyamadini n’amatorero ahubwo imikurikiranire yayo tubihuza no kwirinda ntabwo byashoboka...abashobora gutegereza twabagira inama yo gutegereza bakazabikorera hamwe mu bukwe bwiza bari hamwe.” Minisitiri w’Ubuzima, Dr Ngamije, avuga ko abantu bakomeje kubahiriza amabwiriza yo kwirinda Coronavirus nta kabuza u Rwanda ruzatsinda iki cyorezo, ariko habayeho kwirara gato, byafata indi ntera. Avuga ko mu mahanga iki cyorezo gikomeje kwica abantu, ku buryo abaturarwanda badakwiriye gutegereza ko kigira abo gihitana ngo babone kwemera ko gikaze. Ati “Ahubwo imibare ibaye mibi, n’ingamba zafashwe zo kugira ibirekurwa zakongera zigasubirwamo, hagafatwa izindi ngamba zikaze. Ni ukuvuga rero ko abantu bakwiye gushyira mu gaciro, bakirinda icyatuma imibare yacu iba mibi, haboneka abantu benshi banduye, ahubwo tukagenda tubagabanya buhoro buhoro, abarwaye bagakira, kugeza igihe icyorezo kizarangira.” Minisiteri y’Ubuzima kandi ikomeje ubushakashatsi ahantu hose hagenda hahurira abantu benshi nko muri za restaurants, za hotel, Salon biyogosheramo, mu mabanki n’ahandi kugira ngo yongere ifate amakuru ajyanye n’uko kuva hafungurwa bimwe mu bikorwa uko ibintu bihagaze ubungubu.

title: Umwongereza umwe muri batanu atekereza ko Coronavirus yakozwe n’Abayahudi
content: Aba bashakashatsi bavuga ko umuntu umwe mu Bongereza batanu, atekereza ko iki cyorezo cyakozwe n’Abayahudi, kugira ngo bagushe ubukungu bw’Isi naho ubwabo buzamuke. Kuva mu Mpera w’umwaka ushize, Isi yugarijwe n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus aho cyatangiriye mu Mujyi wa Wuhan mu Bushinwa. Kugeza ubu abantu barenga miliyoni eshanu bamaze kwandura abandi barenga ibihumbi 300 bamaze gupfa. Mu Bwongereza, abanduye bararenga ibihumbi 260, abandi barenga ibihumbi 37 bamaze gupfa. Muri Israel abanduye bararenga ibihumbi 16, naho abandi hafi 300 bamaze gupfa. Aba bashakashatsi bavuga ko ubu bushakashatsi bugiye hanze mu gihe hakomeje kugaragara imyitwarire abantu bamwe bafite kuri iki cyorezo. Prof Daniel Freeman wayoboye ubu bushakashatsi ukora muri iyi Kaminuza yavuze ko “mu gihe ibikorwa bya guma mu rugo byakomerega ku Isi, gukeka ahavuye iki cyorezo nabyo byakomeje kwiyongera.” Ubu bushakashatsi bwakozwe kuva tariki 4 kugeza tariki 11 Gicurasi uyu mwaka, bukorerwa ku bantu 2 500. Mu babajijwe, bavuze ko “Abayahudi nibo bakoze iki cyorezo kugira ngo bagushe ubukungu bw’Isi naho ubwabo buzamuke.” Bugaragaza ko abantu bangana na 5.3% by’ababajijwe, babyemeje gake, 6.8% babyemeye ku rwego rwo hagati, 4.6% babyemeje ko ari cyane, 2.4% bemeje ko aribyo, naho 80.8% ntabwo bigeze byabyemeza. Muri ubu bushakashatsi, hari n’abavuze ko Abayisilamu aribo bagiye bakwiza iki cyorezo kugira ngo ngo cyibasire abatuye mu Burengerazuba bw’Isi. Ikinyamakuru The Jerusalem Post kivuga ko abangana na kimwe cya kane cy’ababajijwe, bavuze ko hari ibyamamare ku Isi byahawe amafaranga kugira ngo bijye bivuga ko byanduye Coronavirus. Hari n’abavuze ko Minisitiri w’Intebe w’u Bwongereza, Boris Johnson, nawe yabeshye ko yarwaye iki cyorezo. Abandi 45.4% bo bemeje ko Coronavirus ari virusi yakozwe muri laboratwari zo mu Bushinwa, kugira ngo bwibasire ibihugu byo mu Burengerazuba bw’Isi. Freeman avuga ko “Niba umuntu ashobora gushyira iki cyorezo ku Bayahudi, abandi bagashinja Abayisilamu, abandi Bill Gates ndetse na laboratwari, icyo tuvanamo ni uko hari imitekerereze mibi.” Aba bashakashatsi kandi bagaragaza ko abenshi muri aba bafite iyi mitekereze, akenshi ngo usanga batanubahiriza amabwiriza y’inzego z’ubuyobzi yo kwirinda Coronavirus. Avuga ko abenshi mu bafite iyi mitekereze, ari abafite amakuru make ku buryo usanga bayakura mu nshuti, ku mbuga nkoranyambaga na Youtube. Umuryango urengera inyungu z’Abayuhudi b’Abongereza, uherutse kuvuga ko hari amagambo mabi amaze igihe acishwa ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, yibasira Abayahudi kubera Coronavirus. Aba bashakashatsi bavuga ko bazakomeza gukora ubundi bushakashatsi kuri iki cyorezo no kuri iyi ngingo, kugira ngo barusheho gutanga amakuru ahamye. Umuyobozi w’Umuryango, JNF-UK, Samuel Hayek, we avuga ivangura usanga ryarabibwe mu Bwongereza, ku buryo buri gihe iyo habaye ikintu nka Coronavirus byongera umurego w’ivangura bashinja abandi guteza ibibazo byose Isi, ati “ntabwo ntunguwe n’ibyabaye kuko ivangura rikomeje kwiyongera”. Yavuze ko Abayahudi batuye mu Bwongereza no mu Burayi, bagomba kumenya ko ivangura rizashira ari uko bafashe amahitamo yo gusubira mu gihugu cyabo.

title: Coronavirus ku wa 28 Gicurasi: Abanyamerika 1500 bapfuye ku munsi umwe, ibihumbi 104 barandura ku Isi
content: Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima, OMS, ryagaragaje ku wa Gatatu handuye abantu ibihumbi 104 ku Isi, abandi barenga ibihumbi bitanu barapfa. Abamaze kwandura muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ni 1 745 803 mu gihe abamaze gupfa ni 102 107. Ku rwego rw’Isi, OMS yavuze ko abantu 5 792 874 aribo bamaze kwandura naho abandi 357 479 bamaze gupfa. Kugeza ubu Brésil iri mu bihugu byugarijwe cyane ku Isi kuko kuri uyu wa Gatatu yapfushije abantu 1 148 abandi barenga ibihumbi 22 barandura. Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika nizo zikomeje kugira abanduye benshi inaza imbere mu kugira abamaze gupfa benshi ku Isi. Brésil iri ku mwanya wa kabiri mu banduye kuko ari ibihumbi 414 66, mu gihe hamaze gupfa ibihumbi 25 697. U Burusiya buza ku mwanya wa gatatu kuko bufite abanduye ibihumbi 370 680, hamaze gupfa abarenga 3 968, muri Espagne handuye ibihumbi 283 849 hamaze gupfa ibihumbi 27 118, naho mu Bwongereza handuye ibihumbi 267 240, hamaze gupfa ibihumbi 37 460. Ku mugabane wa Afurika wose hamaze kugaragara abantu ibihumbi 126 838 banduye Coronavirus, abamaze gupfa basaga 3 721 naho abakize ni ibihumbi 52 784. Afurika y’Epfo iri imbere mu kugira abafite ubwandu benshi kuko ari ibihumbi 25 937, abamaze gupfa ni 552, ikurikirwa na Misiri ubu ifite abamaze gupfa benshi kuri uyu mugabane, kuko bageze kuri 816 naho abamaze kwandura ni 19 666. Muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, kugeza ubu igihugu kiza imbere mu bwandu ni Kenya kuko hamaze kwandura abantu 1,471, hapfuye 55. U Rwanda rufite abanduye 346, abamaze gukira ni 245, muri Uganda ubu hari abanduye 281, mu Burundi handuye abantu 42 hapfa umwe naho muri Sudani y’Epfo hamaze kwandura abantu 994, hamaze gupfa 10. Mu bihugu bihana imbibi n’u Rwanda Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo niyo yibasiwe cyane, kuko ifite abanduye 2 546 barimo 68 bamaze gupfa.

title: Dr. Sinarinzi Paméla wa Baho Hospital yakomoje ku byo ukwiye kumenya ku nkingo zihabwa abana
content:
Mu rwego rw’ubuzima, buri gihugu kigira inkingo giha abana bitewe n’ubuzima bw’abagituye, virusi zikibamo, indwara zishobora kwandura zihagaragara n’izindi mpamvu z’ubuzima zitandukanye. Mu Rwanda buri mwana akingirwa Imbasa, Igituntu, Kokorishi, Agakwega (Tetanosi), Akaniga, Hapatite B, Pinemokoke, impiswi (Rotavirus), Iseru na Rubeyole. Ni inkingo zitangwa kuva umwana akivuka kugeza ku mezi 15, umubyeyi wese akagirwa inama yo kubahiriza gahunda ya muganga yo kuzikurikiranya. Mu kiganiro IGIHE yagiranye na muganga w’abana muri Baho International Hospital, Dr. Sinarinzi Paméla, yavuze ko gukingira umwana byongerera umubiri we ubudahangarwa. Ati “Impamvu dukingira abana ni ukongera ubwo budahangarwa mu mubiri bigatuma ba basirikari baturwanirira bakomera […] Inkingo ziri mu bifasha umwana gukura atarwaragurika.” Nubwo gukingiza umwana bidasobanuye ko atazarwara, ni byiza gukurikiza gahunda ya muganga yo gukingiza. Dr. Sinarinzi avuga ko hari ababyeyi bibwira ko umwana avukana uburyo kamere bwo kwirwanirira k’umubiri, ntibakingize cyangwa bakajyayo uko bishakiye. Ibyo ngo bigira ingaruka zikomeye ku mwana, zamuviramo ubumuga, kuzahazwa n’indwara cyangwa gutinda gukira igihe yakomeretse ku mubiri. Ati “Nk’urugero kudakingira imbasa bishobora gutera ubumuga bw’ingingo. Akaniga n’Agakwega bidakingiwe bishobora gutera ibibazo byo mu buhumekero. Hari na Tetanus idakingiwe, umwana agakomereka cyangwa agashya, ibisebe bye bishobora gitinda gukira kandi bikagira ubwandu (infection) bukomeye kurusha uwakingiwe.” Kimwe n’indi miti umuntu ashobora kunywa ikamuvura ariko akaba yagira impinduka ku mubiri cyangwa mu mubiri, umwana wakingiwe na we ashobora kugira umuriro, gufuruta, kubyimbirwa aho bateye urukingo cyangwa kugira utubyimba ku mubiri, gucika intege ntabashe konka, rimwe na rimwe hakaba n’abagira ibibazo bikomeye byo kugagara. Dr. Sinarinzi avuga ko kenshi izo ngaruka z’inkingo zitamara igihe kirekire. Cyakora ngo hari igihe umubyeyi aba akwiye kugana kwa muganga, bitewe n’uko umwana amerewe. Ati “ Nk’uyu munsi yakingiwe ukabona agize umuriro mwinshi, ejo arawugize no ku munsi wa Gatatu arawugize. Ukabona agize umuriro uri hejuru ya 38.5 kandi bikaguma gutyo buri masaha ane kugeza ku munsi wa gatatu kandi uri no kumuha umuti w’umuriro aho haba harimo n’ikindi kibazo aba akwiye kujya kwa muganga.” Impamvu zishobora gutuma umwana adahabwa inkingo cyangwa zigahagarikwa
 Nubwo amabwiriza ya Minsiteri y’Ubuzima asaba ababyeyi gukingiza kandi bakurikiranya neza inkingo, hari igihe umwana adahabwa urukingo runaka, kurusiba cyangwa rugahagarikwa ariko bitegetswe na muganga. Dr. Sinarinzi avuga ko ibyo bikunze kuba ku nkingo umwana ahabwa inshuro zirenze imwe. Iyo umwana agize ikibazo gikomeye ku rwa mbere ntabwo aterwa izikurikiraho kuko umubiri we uba wagaragaje ko utakira ibyo rukozemo. Ati “Iyo habayeho inkurikizi zikomeye ku rukingo runaka, biba bisobanuye ko uwo mwana atazongera guhabwa urwo rukingo n’urukurikira rwa kabiri cyangwa urwa gatatu biba bihagaze kuko aba yagaragaje ibimenyetso ko umubiri we utakira, ibikoze urwo rukingo.” Uburwayi umwana afite bushobora kuba impamvu yo gusibywa urukingo kubera indi miti ari gufata cyangwa ubushobozi bw’umubiri we. Icyo gihe umubyeyi ashobora gusabwa na muganga gusiba uko kwezi akazasubirayo ku gukurikiyeho. Hari kandi abana bavukana indwara zikomeye nka kanseri nabo badashobora gukurikiranya inkingo nk’abandi. Ati “Hari n’abana bari mu rwego rwihariye, bariya bavukana indwara zikomeye nka za Kanseri abo bo ntabwo bashobora gukurikiranya inkingo nk’uko bigenda ku bandi bana bavutse nta kibazo bafite.” Uretse inkingo, mu gukurikirana ubuzima bw’umwana mu Rwanda, umwana ahabwa Ikinini cya Vitamini A rimwe mu mezi atandatu kuva agize amezi atandatu kugeza ku myaka itanu. Buri mwana wujuje amezi 12 kandi ahabwa ikinini kivura inzoka zo mu nda buri mezi atandatu kugeza yujuje imyaka itanu.

title: Abantu barindwi banduye Coronavirus mu Rwanda, umwe ni we wakize
content: Umurwayi wa mbere wa COVID-19 iterwa n’agakoko ka Coronavirus yabonetse mu Rwanda ku wa 14 Werurwe 2020, yari Umuhinde ukorera rimwe mu mashami ya Loni mu gihugu wari uvuye mu Mujyi wa Mumbai. Kuva icyo gihe imibare yerekana ko abantu 346 bamaze kwandura mu gihe 245 basezerewe mu bitaro nyuma yo gukira ndetse ibipimo bikerekana ko nta virusi bagifite mu mibiri yabo. Mu bitaro byita ku barwayi ba Coronavirus, umubare w’abarwariyemo wongeye kuzamuka ugera ku 101 mu gihe mu minsi ishize wagendaga ugabanuka. Abarwaye baritabwaho n’ababishinzwe kandi ntawe urembye. Muri iyi minsi abarwayi ba Coronavirus bari kuboneka biganjemo abashoferi b’amakamyo yambukiranya imipaka n’abo bakorana. Itangazo rya Minisante ryo kuri uyu wa 27 Gicurasi 2020 rivuga ko "abarwayi bashya bose bahise bashyirwa mu kato bakihagera.’’ Abaturarwanda basabwa gukomeza kubahiriza amabwiriza ya Leta hitabwa cyane cyane ku gukaraba intoki kenshi n’amazi n’isabune, kwambara udupfukamunwa n’amazuru mu gihe umuntu avuye mu rugo cyangwa ahuye n’abantu benshi. Ibimenyetso bya Coronavirus birimo inkorora, ibicurane, guhumeka bigoranye n’umuriro. Yandura binyuze mu matembabuzi aturuka mu myanya y’ubuhumekero. Coronavirus yagaragaye bwa mbere mu Mujyi wa Wuhan mu Bushinwa mu Ukuboza 2019; kuri ubu 5 741 807 bamaze kuyandura ku Isi yose, barimo 354 762 yahitanye na 2 470 546 bamaze kuyikira.

title: Leta yatangiye gupima Coronavirus mu bamotari mbere y’uko basubira mu muhanda
content: Inama y’Abaminisitiri yo ku wa 18 Gicurasi 2020 yemeje ko ingendo zihuza Intara n’Umujyi wa Kigali zizongera gusubukurwa ku wa 1 Kamena, ndetse ko ari na wo munsi moto zitwara abantu zizemererwa kongera gukora. Mu gihe habura iminsi ibarirwa ku ntoki ngo moto zongere gutwara abagenzi, kuri uyu wa Kabiri bamwe mu bamotari bapimwe Coronavirus, kugira ngo hirindwe ko bazaba intandaro yo gukwirakwiza iki cyorezo. Minisitiri w’Ubuzima Dr Ngamije Daniel, yavugiye kuri televiziyo y’igihugu ko igituma abamotari bari gusuzumwa ari uko bizwi ko bazahura n’abantu benshi, bityo akaba ari ngombwa ko hamenywa uko bahagaze mbere yo gutangira imirimo yabo. Ati “Turashaka rero kugira itsinda risaga nka 1000 banyanyagiye mu mujyi ahangaha, buri gihe tuzajya dusuzuma turebe muri bo niba nta wanduye kuko bazaduha amakuru niba nta cyorezo cyaba kiri mu baturage, kuko ukuntu bagenda bahura n’abantu babatwara, nihagira umumotari wandura bizaduha amakuru y’uko hari ikibazo kiri mu baturage”. Yakomeje agira ati “Twabasuzumye, ubu twabifashe nk’igipimo fatizo muri kiriya cyiciro cy’abamotari, tuzabikurikirana buri gihe kugira ngo turebe uko icyorezo cyaba gihagaze mu Mujyi wa Kigali ndetse n’ahandi.” Minisitiri Ngamije avuga ko gusuzuma abamotari kandi bigamije kumenya uko ubwandu buhagaze muri bo, aho hafashwe ibipimo bimwe hagendewe ku myaka, aho batuye, ku buryo bizatanga ishusho y’uko icyorezo cyaba gihagaze mu bamotari. Umuvugizi wa Polisi y’u Rwanda, CP Kabera Jean Bosco, yavuze ko hari umuco abamotari bakwiye kujyana ku itariki ya 1 Kamena 2020, wo gukaraba intoki, kwambara agapfukamunwa no kubahiriza intera. Ati “Bagomba kumva ko uwo muti wo gukaraba intoki bawufite, icya kabiri ni uguhana intera...kumva ko bagomba kwambara agapfukamunwa. Nibajyane umuco wo kumva ko amasaha yashyizweho ntarengwa yo kuba bavuye mu muhanda ari umuco”. Umuyobozi wa Ferwacotamo, Ngarambe Daniel, yavuze ko abamotari biteguye yaba mu buryo bazahagarara neza muri metero imwe, gukaraba ndetse no kugendana umuti wo gukaraba ‘alcohol’, ku buryo umugenzi ashobora gukaraba ndetse ugapuriza muri casque. Ati “Ibyo byose turi kubitegura ku buryo uzatega moto azaba yumva ko ubwirinzi buhari kandi ntagire impungenge ko ashobora kwandura ari kuri moto, kubigisha uburyo bashobora kuzaba bafite agapfukamunwa n’umugenzi utagafite ntibamutware”. Ngarambe yavuze ko hari uburyo buzakoreshwa mu kwishyura moto bwa ‘cashless’, aho hari uburyo bwo gushyira mubazi kuri moto ku buryo izajya yereka umugenzi amafaranga agiye kwishyura noneho hagakoreshwa ikoranabuhanga umuntu adafata amafaranga mu ntoki. Imibare yo kuri uyu wa Kabiri yerekana ko mu Rwanda abanduye Coronavirus ari 339, abakize ari 244, abakirwaye ari 95, nta muntu uritaba Imana. Ibipimo bimaze gufatwa ni 60 443.

title: Coronavirus: I Nyanza ahazwi nko kwa Hadji hafunzwe
content: Umuyobozi w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Ubuzima, Dr Sabin Nsanzimana, yabwiye IGIHE ko uwo muntu wagaragaweho Coronavirus, ari umushoferi wari uturutse hanze y’u Rwanda. Ati “Hari umwe mu bagaragaweho Coronavirus wahahagaze utwara imodoka zambukiranya imipaka, yaje kugaragara yanduye ubwo burwayi hanyuma aho yahagaze, biba ngombwa ko naho hagomba gukurikiranwa. Niyo mpamvu hariya hafashwe ibipimo, kugira ngo hirindwe ko hari umuntu waba warahuye nawe.” Ku murongo wa telefone, Havugimana Saidi uzwi nka ‘Haji’ yabwiye IGIHE ko we n’abakozi be 29 bari mu kato mu Ishuri ry’Ubumenyi rya Nyanza (Ecole de Sciences de Nyanza) kubera ko hamenyekanye amakuru ko hari abantu b’i Rusizi bagiye kuhahahira, nyuma baza gusanga baranduye icyorezo cya COVID-19. Ati “Turi mu kato hamwe n’abakozi banjye twese turi abantu 30; amakuru Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Nyanza yaduhaye ni uko ngo hari abantu b’i Rusizi basanzwemo icyorezo cya Coronavirus bavuga ko bariye kwa Haji.” Haji avuga ko mu bo bari kumwe mu kato harimo abakobwa be babiri bakuru n’umusore w’umuturanyi bari basanzwe babana mu rugo, bose bakaba basanzwe bamufasha mu kazi ku ruganda rwe rwitwa HAJI Enterprise Nyanza. Yavuze aho bari bari kwitabwaho kandi bamaze gupimwa bakaba bategereje ibisubizo byose kuri iki Cyumweru kuko hari ibigera ku munani bitaraza. Ati “Baradupimye kandi ibisubizo byatangiye kuza kuko hasigaye abantu umunani gusa, nibo batarabona ibisubizo. Hari ibisubizo byaje birimo n’icyanjye dusanga nta muntu wanduye turi bazima; dutegereje ibyo umunani bisigaye.” Haji avuga ko kuri uyu wa Gatandatu inzego z’ubuzima zagiye gupima umugore we n’abahungu be batatu basigaranye mu rugo kugira ngo barebe ko baba baranduye icyo cyerezo. Ati “Ejo nibwo babapimiye mu rugo; twe twapimwe ku wa Gatanu bo bapimwa ku wa Gatandatu. Urumva ko ibisubizo byabo bishobora kuboneka ejo ku wa Mbere.” Ahitwa kwa ‘Haji’ i Nyanza hazwi n’abantu benshi bakorera ingendo mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo n’abakunda amata ahatunganyirizwa kuko afite uruganda rwitwa ‘HAJI Enterprise Nyanza’ ruherereye ku muhanda Kigali-Huye, mu Murenge wa Busasamana. Imodoka zihanyura zikunze kuhahagarara, abagenzi bakagura amata cyangwa bakahafatira amafunguro. Mu Rwanda hamaze kugaragara abantu 431 banduye Coronavirus, mu gihe babiri aribo bamaze kwitaba Imana bazize iki cyorezo naho 283 bakaba barakize. Mu banduye bose, umubare munini ni abagabo kuko bihariye 81.44% bingana n’abantu 351. Ikindi ni uko abari mu kigero cy’imyaka iri hagati ya 30 na 39 aribo bibasiwe cyane kuko abamaze kugaragaza iki cyorezo bari muri iyi myaka ari 173.

title: Ubuzima i Rusizi: Gupima Coronavirus biri gukorwa urugo ku rundi, hamaze gupimwa abarenga 3000
content: Mu ntangiriro za Gicurasi, Rusizi yari mu turere 17 tw’u Rwanda tutari twakagezemo Coronavirus cyo kimwe na Nyamasheke, Rubavu, Gakenke, Burera, Nyagatare, Gatsibo, Nyabihu, Ngororero, Rutsiro, Gisagara, Nyanza, Ruhango, Nyaruguru, Rwamagana, Kayonza na Nyamagabe. Gusa ku wa 31 Gicurasi 2020, aka karere kabaye izingiro rya Coronavirus mu Rwanda, nyuma y’uko abantu batanu ba mbere bagaragaweho iki cyorezo barimo abacuruzi, abashoferi batwara ibintu babivanye cyangwa babijyanye i Bukavu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo ndetse n’umumotari umwe watwaraga ibintu byari byemewe. Byatumye ku wa 4 Kamena Imirenge ya Kamembe, Nyakarenzo, Mururu n’igice cya Gihundwe igize Umujyi wa Kamembe mu Karere ka Rusizi ishyirwa muri gahunda ya Guma mu Rugo mu gihe cy’ibyumweru bibiri mu kwirinda ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus. Abayobozi hafi ya bose bo mu nzego z’ubuzima cyane abari mu bikorwa byo gukumira iki cyorezo niho bimukiye, ndetse n’itsinda ryagize uruhare mu kurwanya ikwirakwira ryacyo muri Kigali rijyanwayo kugira ngo ritange umusanzu mu bikorwa bifasha gukumira iyi ndwara. Umuyobozi w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Ubuzima, RBC, Dr Sabin Nsanzimana, uri mu Karere ka Rusizi, yabwiye IGIHE ko ubu muri aka karere hamaze kugaragara abantu 43 banduye Coronavirus. Ikiri gukorwa ni ugupima abantu benshi bashoboka cyane ingo zegereye umupaka w’u Rwanda na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, bigakorwa urugo ku rundi. Ati “Ubu abaturage bari mu ngo, bari muri gahunda ya guma mu rugo, biratworohereza kuko niba hari uwaba urwaye tukaba tutaramubona, ntabwo ari kwanduza abandi mu masoko no mu kandi kazi. Ubu turi gupima abantu tuva ku rugo tujya ku rundi, hari gahunda y’uko muri ibi byumweru bibiri twahawe abantu bari mu ngo tuza kubikora nk’uko twabikoze muri Kigali igihe twari twatangiye kubona abantu bafite uburwayi mu kwezi kwa gatatu n’ukwa kane.” Muri aka karere, nta bantu bafite ibimenyetso bari guhamagara inzego z’ubuzima basaba kwitabwaho, abashinzwe ubuzima basobanura ko bishobora kuba biterwa n’uko niba hari n’uwanduye yaba yaranduye vuba ku buryo ataragaragaza ibimenyetso. Yakomeje agira ati “Twe ntabwo turi gupima dushingiye no ku bimenyetso, ni ukugenda urugo ku rundi, tukanapima n’abahuye n’abo twamaze kubona barwaye.” Muri gahunda ni uko hagombaga gupimwa abantu barenga ibihumbi icumi, by’umwihariko mu minsi itatu iri imbere harafatwa ibipimo by’abantu barenga ibihumbi bitanu. Kubera uburyo umupaka ari munini kandi ugizwe n’amazi, inzego z’umutekano zakajije ingamba ku buryo nta baturage bambuka banyuze mu nzira zitari zo nkuko byakundaga kugenda. Ati “I Rusizi honyine tumaze gusuzuma abantu barenga ibihumbi bitatu, turateganya gufata ibipimo birenga nk’ibihumbi bitanu mu minsi nk’itatu iri imbere, i Rusizi honyine dushobora kugera mu bipimo nk’ibihumbi icumi. Icyo gihe ni nk’imirenge nk’ibiri yose. Ariko tugenda tureba urugo ku rundi, tureba abantu bakoze ingendo. Hari n’abatwihamagarira bakatubwira bati natwe turatekereza ko twahuye n’abo bantu.” Ibi bipimo bishobora kwiyongera mu gihe haba hagaragaye abantu benshi banduye, ku buryo barenga n’uwo mubare uteganyijwe. Usibye Rusizi, uturere twose turi mu nkengero z’Ikiyaga cya Kivu, ni ukuvuga Nyamasheke, Karongi, Rubavu hose hari gufatwa ibipimo ku buryo hashakishwa abanduye Coronavirus. Mu Rwanda hamaze kugaragara abantu 431 banduye Coronavirus, mu gihe babiri aribo bamaze kwitaba Imana bazize iki cyorezo naho 283 bakaba barakize. Mu banduye bose, umubare munini ni abagabo kuko bihariye 81.44% bingana n’abantu 351. Ikindi ni uko abari mu kigero cy’imyaka iri hagati ya 30 na 39 aribo bibasiwe cyane kuko abamaze kugaragaza iki cyorezo bari muri iyi myaka ari 173.

title: Abandi bantu 11 basanganywe Coronavirus i Rusizi no ku Rusumo
content: Itangazo rya Minisante ryo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, ryerekana ko abantu babiri bashya aribo bakize Coronavirus, banasezererwa mu bitaro. Abarwayi bashya bagaragaye kuri uyu wa 6 Kamena 2020, barimo abakuwe i Rusizi n’abo ku Rusumo. Minisante yatangaje ko bose ‘‘Bashyizwe mu kato n’abo bahuye bahise bakurikiranwa.’’ Ni ku munsi wa kabiri wikurikiranya mu Rwanda habonetse abarwayi bakuwe mu bice bya Rusizi no ku Rusumo. Kuva umurwayi wa mbere wa Coronavirus agaragaye mu Rwanda ku wa 13 Werurwe 2020, hamaze kuboneka 431 banduye mu bipimo 75 013 bimaze gufatwa, 283 barayikize mu gihe 146 bakirwaye naho babiri bitabye Imana. Kuva umurwayi wa mbere wa Coronavirus agaragaye mu Rwanda ku wa 13 Werurwe 2020, hamaze kuboneka 420 banduye mu bipimo 74 068 bimaze gufatwa, 282 barayikize mu gihe 136 bakirwaye naho babiri bitabye Imana. Ibimenyetso bya Coronavirus birimo inkorora, ibicurane, guhumeka bigoranye n’umuriro. Yandura binyuze mu matembabuzi aturuka mu myanya y’ubuhumekero. Abaturarwanda muri rusange basabwa gukomeza kubahiriza amabwiriza ya Leta hitabwa cyane cyane ku gukaraba intoki kenshi n’amazi n’isabune, kwambara udupfukamunwa n’amazuru mu gihe umuntu avuye mu rugo cyangwa ahuye n’abantu benshi. Coronavirus yagaragaye bwa mbere mu Mujyi wa Wuhan mu Bushinwa mu Ukuboza 2019; kuri ubu 6 795 669 bamaze kuyandura ku Isi yose, barimo 396 409 yahitanye na 3 307 915 bamaze kuyikira.

title: Abantu 13 basanganywe Coronavirus i Rusizi, abanduye mu Rwanda baba 410

title: Ingendo zahagaritswe mu Mujyi wa Kamembe, abaturage bategekwa kuguma mu ngo
content: Mu masaha ya saa Yine n’igice nibwo bamwe mu baturage bari mu Mujyi wa Kamembe basabwe n’inzego z’umutekano gusubira mu ngo zabo mu rwego rwo gukomeza kwirinda icyorezo cya COVOID- 19 gikomeje gufata indi ntera. Rusizi iri mu duce turi kubonekamo ubwandu bwinshi bw’abarwayi ba Coronavirus kuko mu minsi ine ishize muri aka karere hagaragaye abantu 24 banduye COVID-19. Abaganiriye na IGIHE bemeje ko babwiwe ko nta muntu ugomba kuva mu rugo ndetse ibikorwa byose bifungwa uretse ahagurirwa ibiribwa, ahacururizwa imiti ndetse n’amavuriro. Umwe yagize ati “Habanje kuza imodoka igenda itanga ubutumwa ko abaturage basubira mu ngo zabo. Ubu ndatashye nari ndi mu Mujyi wa Kamembe mu isoko bavuga ko tugomba gusubira mu rugo hagasigara abacuruza ibiribwa gusa no hanze hagiye gukora farumasi gusa, twe ngo bishobotse ni ku wa 15 z’uku kwezi (Kamena) twasubira mu kazi.”  Undi na we ati “Abashinzwe umutekano baje badusanga mu maduka batubwira ngo dukurikize gahunda ya Guma mu rugo.’’ Icyemezo cyo gushyira Umujyi wa Rusizi muri gahunda ya Guma mu Rugo mu gihe cy’ibyumweru bibiri cyafashwe kuri uyu wa 4 Kamena 2020 ari nabwo cyatangiye kubahirizwa, cyashyizweho umukono na Minisitiri w’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu, Prof Shyaka Anastase.  	Serivisi zemerewe gukomeza gukora n’izakumiriwe  	Mu bindi bice byose by’Akarere ka Rusizi harakomeza kubahirizwa amabwiriza yo kwirinda Coronavirus nk’uko biteganywa n’ibyemezo by’Inama y’Abaminisitiri yo ku wa 2 Kamena 2020.  	Inzego zibishinzwe zirakomeza kugenzura ko hari n’ahandi hashobora gushyirwa muri Guma mu Rugo mu gihe bibaye ngombwa.  	Inzego z’ibanze n’iz’umutekano zirasabwa gukurikirana ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’aya mabwiriza. Abaturage basabwe gukomeza kuguma mu rugo no kubahiriza amabwiriza yo kwirinda Coronavirus yatanzwe n’inzego z’ubuzima kandi niba ugaragayeho ibimenyetso cyangwa ubonye ubifite agahamagara 114.

title: Ibinini bya Ibuprofen byatangiye kugeragezwa mu kuvura Coronavirus
content:
Itsinda ry’abaganga muri ibi bitaro by’i Londres bizera ko uyu muti usanzwe ukoreshwa mu kugabanya ububabare, wakwifashishwa mu gufasha abantu barwaye Coronavirus bafite ibibazo by’ubuhumekero. Bizera ko uyu muti uri mu ihendutse iboneka ku isoko ushobora gufasha abarwayi ku buryo batashyirwa ku mashini zibongerera umwuka. Mu bushakashatsi bwabo, abazabukorerwaho barwaye bazahabwa uyu muti bawufatanye n’ubufasha basanzwe bahabwa n’ibitaro. Ubushakashatsi bwakorewe ku nyamaswa bwagaragaje ko uyu muti ushobora gufasha mu bijyanye n’ibibazo by’ubuhumekero, kimwe mu bibazo abarwaye Coronavirus bahura nabyo. Prof Mitul Mehta wigisha muri King’s College London yavuze ko bakeneye gukora igerageza kugira ngo babone ibimenyetso bya nyabyo bihura n’ibyo bakeka ku ikoreshwa ry’uyu muti. Ubwo iki cyorezo cyadukaga ku Isi, hari impungenge ko umuti wa Ibuprofen ushobora kugira ingaruka ku buzima bw’abantu bafite ibimenyetso by’iki cyorezo.
Minisitiri w’Ubuzima mu Bufaransa, Oliver Veran, yigeze kuvuga ko gukoresha uyu muti byakongera ibibazo ku muntu urwaye iki cyorezo ahubwo ko byarutwa no gukoresha paracetamol. Nyuma abahanga baje kwemeza ko paracetamol ishobora kwifashishwa mu kuvura ibimenyetso bya Coronavirus, harimo nko kugabanya umuriro ndetse ko yanafasha abarwaye ibicurane.

title: Ntabwo Coronavirus yatwibagije abakeneye ubundi buvuzi - Minisanté
content: Ubushakashatsi bushya bw’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku buzima (OMS), bwagaragaje ko icyorezo cya Coronavirus cyagize ingaruka zikomeye ku buvuzi ndetse na serivisi zihabwa abafite izindi ndwara cyane cyane izitandura zirimo Cancer, Diabète n’indwara z’umutima. OMS yavuze ko yasanze benshi mu barwaye indwara zitandura batitabwaho uko bikwiye muri iki gihe cy’icyorezo, kandi ari bo bafite ibyago byinshi byo gushegeshwa na cyo. Umuyobozi muri Minisiteri y’Ubuzima ushinzwe imikoranire n’Itangazamakuru, Julien Mahoro Niyingabira, yabwiye IGIHE ko mu Rwanda iki kibazo kidahari kuko ubundi buvuzi bwakomeje gutangwa uko bisanzwe, utitaye ku kuba bigaragara ko imbaraga nyinshi ziri gushyirwa mu gukumira indwara ya Coronavirus. Yagize ati “Abagomba kuvurwa baravurwa, amavuriro yacu yari afunguye, no mu gihe ingendo zitari zemewe, kuba umuntu yari afite ‘transfert’ cyangwa se yari afite ‘rendez-vous’ ya muganga, ibyongibyo byamuberaga icyangombwa cyo kwambukiranya intara akajya aho iyo rendez-vous yagombaga kuyubahiriza”. Niyingabira yakomeje avuga ko izindi gahunda zirimo inkingo zakomeje guhabwa abana, abarwayi bakomeza kuvurwa nk’uko bisanzwe ku buryo ku ruhande rw’u Rwanda, nta muntu wari ukeneye ubuvuzi ubwo ari bwo bwose ngo abubure. Ati “Ntabwo rero mu by’ukuri ku ruhande rw’u Rwanda twavuga ko hariho icyo cyuho cyo kuvuga ngo Coronavirus yatwibagije cyangwa yatumye abari bakeneye ubundi buvuzi batabubona”. Indege nto zitagira abapilote ‘Drones’, zisanzwe zimenyerewe mu gutwara amaraso n’imiti ku bitaro bitandukanye mu Rwanda, zifashishijwe mu kugeza ibinini n’indi miti ku barwayi ba kanseri mu gihe cya guma mu rugo. Imiti yohererezwa abarwayi hifashishijwe ibitaro bibegereye. Iyi gahunda igamije korohereza abarwayi kubona imiti hafi kandi biboroheye, bigendanye n’igihe bamaraga bagiye gufata umuti. Uretse kwifashisha Drones mu gufasha abarwayi ba kanseri, hari abasigaye bohererezwa imodoka zijya kubafata aho batuye bakajya kwivuza i Butaro. Hashyizweho kandi uburyo mu Bitaro bya gisirikare i Kanombe, havurirwa abarwayi ba Kanseri bavuye mu Ntara y’Iburasirazuba no mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Kugira ngo bahagere ni uko ku bufasha bwa Partners in Health, hashyizweho imodoka zigenda zikabakura aho aho batuye, abasigaye mu zindi Ntara bavurirwa i Butaro. Niyingabira yakomeje avuga ko n’izindi ndwara zandura zari zikeneye ubuvuzi nka virusi itera Sida hari ibisubizo byagiye bishyirwaho kugira ngo abantu batabura imiti, aho bahabwa iy’amezi abiri aho kugira ngo bahabwe iy’ukwezi kumwe nikurangira bongere bajye mu ngendo. Ati “Byakozwe mu buryo bwo kugabanya ingendo ariko imiti bakeneye bakayibona. Umuntu ashobora kureba imbaraga zashyizwe mu kurwanya Coronavirus akibwira ko ibindi byibagiranye, ariko ntabwo ari ko bimeze”. Gushyira abaganga benshi mu kurwanya Coronavirus Ubushakashatsi bwa OMS bwerekana ko mu bihugu birenga 90% bwakorewemo, abakozi bo mu rwego rw’ubuzima bimuriwe mu nshingano zo kurwanya Coronavirus ndetse ingamba zo gukumira ikwirakwira ryayo zituma gahunda nyinshi zo kwivuza ziburizwamo. Umuyobozi wa OMS, Dr Tedros Ghebreyesus yagize ati “Ni ingenzi ko ibihugu bishaka ubundi buryo butuma serivisi z’ibanze zihabwa abafite indwara zitandura zikomeza gutangwa no muri iki gihe cyo kurwanya Coronavirus”. Ubushakashatsi bwa OMS bwerekana ko kuba ubuvuzi butari ukurwanya Coronavirus budatangwa uko bisanzwe bizagira ingaruka nyinshi ku bihugu bikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere. Niyingabira avuga ko ku ruhande rw’u Rwanda, hashyizweho ibigo bivura Coronavirus by’ibanze bibiri ariko kandi nanone hanagenwa uburyo muri buri bitaro by’akarere hajya havurirwa Coronavirus. Yakomeje avuga ko ibitaro by’akarere bigera kuri 48, byose byashyizwemo uburyo hashobora gukorwa akato k’umurwayi akaba yavurirwa kuri ibyo bitaro akarinda akira atarindiriye kujya muri biriya bigo bibiri biri i Kanyinya na Nyamata. Ati “Hashyizweho uburyo bwo kuvura hirya no hino mu gihugu ariko butanabangamiye indi mirimo y’ibitaro cyangwa se y’inzego z’ubuzima. Ntabwo rero abaganga bose b’igihugu bafashwe ngo bajyanwe muri bya bigo bibiri byashyizweho byihariye”. Kuva umurwayi wa mbere wa COVID-19 iterwa n’agakoko gashya ka Coronavirus agaragaye mu Rwanda ku wa 14 Werurwe 2020, hamaze kuboneka 377 banduye mu bipimo 69 151 bimaze gufatwa, 262 barayikize mu gihe 114 bitabwaho n’abaganga naho umwe yitabye Imana. OMS yerekana ko buri mwaka abagera kuri miliyoni 41 bicwa n’indwara zitandura, bikaba bigize 71% by’impfu zose ku Isi.

title: OMS yahishuye ko Coronavirus yagize ingaruka ku buvuzi bwa Cancer na Diabète
content: Muri ubu bushakashatsi bwakorewe mu bihugu 155 mu kwezi gushize, OMS yasanze ko benshi mu barwaye indwara zitandura batitabwaho uko bikwiye muri iki gihe cy’icyorezo, kandi ari bo bafite ibyago byinshi byo gushegeshwa na Coronavirus. Umuyobozi wa OMS, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, yagize ati “Abantu benshi bakeneye ubuvuzi bw’indwara nka cancer, indwara z’umutima na Diabète, ntabwo barimo guhabwa serivisi z’ubuzima ndetse n’ubuvuzi bakeneye kuva Coronavirus yatangira”. Ubu bushakashatsi bwerekana ko 31% by’ibihugu bwakorewemo byagabanyije cyangwa bihagarika by’agateganyo ubuvuzi bw’abafite indwara z’umutima, ibigera kuri 42% bibikora ku barwaye cancer naho 49% bihagarika cyangwa bigabanya serivisi zihabwa abarwaye Diabète. title: Abantu barindwi barimo ab’i Rusizi bakoze ingendo zambuka imipaka basanzwemo Coronavirus
content: Minisiteri y’Ubuzima mu itangazo ryayo ryo kuri uyu wa Mbere yatangaje ko ‘‘Abarwayi bashya bakoze ingendo zambukiranya imipaka, cyane cyane i Rusizi. Bashyizwe mu kato.’’ Ku wa 31 Gicurasi 2020 nibwo mu Karere ka Rusizi hagaragaye abantu batanu banduye Coronavirus barimo abacuruzi, abashoferi n’umumotari umwe. Ibi byanatumye ingendo hagati y’intara n’Umujyi wa Kigali n’izikorwa na moto zitwara abagenzi zikomeza gusubikwa. Minisitiri w’Ubuzima, Dr Ngamije, yatangaje ko uyu mwanzuro waturutse ku bwandu bushya bwagaragaye mu Karere ka Rusizi, biba ngombwa ko habanza kunozwa ingamba zo gukumira ko bwakwira hose. Ati “Hari ikibazo cy’ubwandu mu bantu bamwe harimo abagenzi baturuka hanze. Hari abava mu karere kacu mu bihugu duturanye hari n’abavuye hanze baturutse kure mu bihugu bitandukanye. Kuva umurwayi wa mbere wa COVID-19 iterwa n’agakoko gashya ka Coronavirus agaragaye mu Rwanda ku wa 13 Werurwe 2020, hamaze kuboneka 377 banduye mu bipimo 69 151 bimaze gufatwa, 262 barayikize mu gihe 114 bitabwaho n’abaganga naho umwe yitabye Imana. Yitaweho n’abaganga mu kigo cyagenewe kuvura Coronavirus ariko yaje gupfa azize kwangirika imyanya y’ubuhumekero. Kugeza ubu nta muti n’urukingo bya Coronavirus biraboneka, hakoreshwa uburyo bwo kuvura ibimenyetso by’iki cyorezo gusa, kugeza umubiri w’umuntu wubatse ubudahangarwa, virus igashira ityo mu maraso. Ibimenyetso bya Coronavirus birimo inkorora, ibicurane, guhumeka bigoranye n’umuriro. Yandura binyuze mu matembabuzi aturuka mu myanya y’ubuhumekero. Abaturarwanda basabwa gukomeza kubahiriza amabwiriza ya Leta hitabwa cyane cyane ku gukaraba intoki kenshi n’amazi n’isabune, kwambara udupfukamunwa n’amazuru mu gihe umuntu avuye mu rugo cyangwa ahuye n’abantu benshi.

title: RSSB yagaragaje ko Mutuelle de Santé ifite icyuho cya miliyari 20 Frw
content: Umuyobozi Mukuru wa RSSB, Regis Rugemanshuro, yabitangaje kuri uyu wa Gatanu muri Komisiyo y’Ingengo y’Imari n’Umutungo by’Igihugu mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, mu biganiro n’inzego zinyuranye ku mbanzirizamushinga y’itegeko rigena ingengo y’imari ya Leta y’umwaka wa 2020/2021. Rugemanshuro yagarutse kuri ibi ubwo yagarukaga ku kibazo cyo gutinda kwishyura fagitire z’ibigo nderabuzima ndetse n’ibitaro. Yavuze ko “Kugeza uyu munsi dufite icyuho cya miliyari 20 Frw muri gahunda ya Mituelle de santé, nubwo hari miliyari 35. 6 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda yatanzwe muri iyi gahunda mu ngengo y’imari y’uyu mwaka, hari miliyari zisaga 39 Frw zakoreshejwe mu kwishyura amafaranga yo kwivuza, ubu haracyari miliyari zirenga 15 z’amafaranga y’inyemezabuguzi atarishyurwa.” Yavuze ko rimwe na rimwe usanga bagera aho bakoresha amafaranga atangwa n’abakozi bakoresha ubwisungane bwa RAMA, kugira ngo bazibe icyuho. Yatangaje ko RSSB yagiranye ibiganiro na Minisiteri y’imari n’igenamigambi, harebwa uko hazibwa iki cyuho. Minisitiri w’Ubuzima, Dr Ngamije Daniel, yavuze ko “ Rimwe na rimwe RSSB itinda kwishyura ibitaro kuri serivizi biba byarahaye abarwayi, ku buryo bigera ku mezi ane cyangwa atanu.” Yavuze ko ikibazo nk’iki kigira ingaruka ku mikorere yabyo, kandi bituma bahanishwa ibihano mu gihe badashoboye kubahiriza igihe ntarengwa cy’iminsi 15 yo kwishyura amafaranga y’amazi n’amashanyarazi akenerwa mu kazi kabo. Kugeza ubu gahunda y’ubwisungane mu kwivuza ahanini ibona amafaranga mu baturage, aho abayikoresha benshi batanga amafaranga ibihumbi bitatu buri mwaka, naho guverinoma yo yishyura amafaranga ibihumbi bibiri kuri buri muntu ukennye. Guverinoma iherutse gusaba uburyo bushya bwo gutera inkunga iyi gahunda, harimo no kongera umusanzu kuri buri muntu ukennye kuva ku bihumbi bibiri isanzwe itanga ikagera kuri bitatu. Ubu buryo bushya bukaba bushobora gutanga arenga miliyari 27 buri mwaka. Aya mafaranga kandi azava ahantu hatandukanye harimo miliyari esheshatu z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda azatangwa na leta, hagati ya 2,5% na 3% akazava mi bigo by’’itumanaho. Hariho kandi 0.5% azava ku mushahara wa buri mukozi ukora mu bikorera ndetse n’abo mu nzego za Leta, ubu buryo bukaba bushobora kuzana miliyari 7.5 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda buri mwaka n’ibindi bikorwa bitandukanye. Abantu bagera kuri 80% nibo bakoresha ubu buryo ubwisungane bwa Mutuelle, mu baturage bagera kuri miliyoni 12 batuye u Rwanda.

title: Coronavirus: Ubwandu bushya i Rusizi bwatumye ingendo zihuza Intara zikomeza gufungwa
content: Byari biteganyijwe ko kuri uyu wa Mbere Kamena aribwo ingendo hagati y’intara zitandukanye cyangwa Intara n’Umujyi wa Kigali zisubukurwa ndetse ko moto n’amagare aribwo nabyo byongera gutwara abagenzi. Imyiteguro mu gihugu hose yari yakajijwe hitegurwa uburyo izi serivisi zakongera gusubukura imirimo nta nkomyi, aho hari nk’abatanga serivisi zo gutwara abantu mu Mujyi wa Kigali bapimwe icyorezo cya COVID-19 ndetse bakanasobanurirwa ibikwiye gukurikizwa mu kwirinda ikwirakwira ry’iki cyorezo. Mu masaha ya saa tanu z’ijoro kuri iki Cyumweru, Guverinoma yatangaje ko yongereye igihe cyo gusubukuriraho ingendo zihuza intara n’Umujyi wa Kigali kizajyana no kwemerera moto zitwara abagenzi kongera gukora, ivuga ko mu nama y’Abaminisitiri iteganyijwe ku wa 2 Kamena aribwo hazatangazwa amabwiriza mashya. Nyuma y’isesengura, ingendo hagati y’intara zitandukanye, hagati y’intara n’Umujyi wa Kigali hamwe na moto zitwara abagenzi biracyabujijwe mu rwego rwo kurengera ubuzima bw’abaturage. Ingamba nshya zo kurwanya Covid-19 zizatangazwa n’Inama y’Abaminisitiri yo ku wa 2 Kamena 2020. — Office of the PM | Rwanda (@PrimatureRwanda) May 31, 2020 Minisitiri w’Ubuzima, Dr Ngamije, yatangaje ko uyu mwanzuro waturutse ku bwandu bushya bwagaragaye mu Karere ka Rusizi, biba ngombwa ko habanza kunozwa ingamba zo gukumira ko bwakwira hose. Ati “Hari ikibazo cy’ubwandu mu bantu bamwe harimo abagenzi baturuka hanze. Hari abava mu karere kacu mu bihugu duturanye hari n’abavuye hanze baturutse kure mu bihugu bitandukanye. Cyane ku barwayi bagaragaye mu Karere ka Rusizi bituma hafatwa ingamba zo kugira ngo ingendo hagati y’intara n’umujyi wa Kigali n’intara na za moto zitwara abantu ibyo byose bisubikwa kugira ngo tubanze tunoze neza icyo amakuru yadutangarije hanyuma hafatwe n’ingamba zatuma turinda ubuzima bw’abanyarwanda.” Minisitiri Dr Ngamije yavuze ko ari abantu batanu bagaragaye muri kariya karere nk’abarwayi bashya, barimo abakora ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi n’abatwara ibicuruzwa bijya i Bukavu muri RDC n’umumotari umwe watwaraga ibintu bisanzwe byari byemewe. Ati “Barazwi, dufite amakuru yose ahagije y’abo bahuye nabo ku buryo tukiyanoza ngo turebe niba muri bo nta wanduye.” Abo bantu batanu, bari mu barwayi 11 baraye batangajwe na Minisiteri y’Ubuzima nk’abashya bagaragaye kuri iki Cyumweru. Bose batangiye kwitabwaho mu bitaro byita ku banduye iki cyorezo. Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo ihana imbibi n’aka karere ka Rusizi ni kimwe mu bihugu bituranye n’u Rwanda byibasiwe cyane n’iki cyorezo kuko kugeza ubu ifite abantu 3070 bamaze kwandura mu gihe abapfuye bo ari 72. Ni mu gihe mu Rwanda ubu habarurwa abantu 370 bamaze kwandura iki cyorezo barimo umwe witabye Imana na 256 bakize. Muri abose abantu 267 banduye iki cyorezo bagikuye hanze mu gihe 103 bo bandujwe n’abo bari baravuye hanze. Dr Ngamije yavuze ko mu gihe hataranozwa neza uburyo bwo gukumira iki cyorezo mu Karere ka Rusizi, byaba bidakwiye gusubukura ingendo. Usibye Rusizi nta kandi karere kagaragaramo ubu bwand keretse ababukura hanze y’u Rwanda nabo batahurwa bakigera ku mipaka. Yavuze ko iyi mibare igaragaza ko hari ikibazo gihari mu buhahirane bw’u Rwanda na RDC, aho bukwiye gukorwa ariko abantu batandura. Mu ntangiriro za Gicurasi, Rusizi kari akarere kamwe muri 17 tw’u Rwanda tutari twakagezemo iki cyorezo cyo kimwe na Nyamasheke, Rubavu, Gakenke, Burera, Nyagatare, Gatsibo, Nyabihu, Ngororero, Rutsiro, Gisagara, Nyanza, Ruhango, Nyaruguru, Rwamagana, Kayonza na Nyamagabe. Itsinda ry’abashinzwe kurwanya ikwirakwira ry’iki cyorezo ryamaze kwerekeza mu Karere ka Rusizi kugira ngo hamenyekane abo abanduye baba barahuye nabo hanyuma nabo bitabweho. Si ubwa mbere mu turere hagaragaye ubwandu ariko hagakazwa ingamba kugira ngo budakwirakwira, urugero rwa hafi ni urwo muri Mata ubwo ubu bwandu bwagaragaraga ku baturage bo mu Karere ka Gicumbi. Dr Ngamije yavuze ko “byigeze kuba n’ahandi, umuntu umwe bwamubonetseho mu Karere ka Huye no muri Musanze” ariko iyo amabwiriza ashyizwe mu bikorwa mu minsi mike ikibazo kiba gikemutse.

title: Ingendo za moto n’izihuza Umujyi wa Kigali n’intara zakomeje guhagarikwa
content: Hashize amezi asaga abiri [kuva ku wa 22 Werurwe 2020] leta ishyizeho ingamba zikomeye zirimo gufunga ibikorwa hafi ya byose mu gihugu hagakora ibyangombwa gusa nk’amavuriro n’amaguriro y’ibiribwa ndetse abaturage bose bagasabwa kuguma mu ngo. Kuva ku wa Mbere tariki ya 4 Gicurasi 2020 hanzuwe ko serivisi zimwe na zimwe zirimo ibikorwa bya leta n’iby’abikorera, amasoko na hoteli zisubukura imirimo ariko ibirimo amahuriro y’abantu benshi, insengero, ibitaramo, imikino n’ingendo zambukiranya intara bikomeza gufungwa. Inama y’Abaminisitiri yateranye ku wa 18 Gicurasi 2020 yari yemeje ko n’ingendo zihuza intara n’Umujyi wa Kigali zizasubukurwa ku wa 1 Kamena ndetse ko ari nawo munsi na moto zitwara abagenzi zizemererwa gukora. Itangazo ryanyujijwe ku rukuta rw’Ibiro bya Minisitiri w’Intebe ku wa 31 Gicurasi 2020 mbere y’amasaha make ngo itariki yo gusubukura ibyo bikorwa igere, ryerekana ko bikibujijwe kugeza hafashwe izindi ngamba. Rigira riti “Nyuma y’isesengura, ingendo hagati y’intara zitandukanye, hagati y’intara n’Umujyi wa Kigali hamwe na moto zitwara abagenzi biracyabujijwe mu rwego rwo kurengera ubuzima bw’abaturage.’’ Rikomeza rivuga ko "Ingamba nshya zo kurwanya COVID-19 zizatangazwa n’Inama y’Abaminisitiri yo ku wa 2 Kamena 2020.’’ Nyuma y’isesengura, ingendo hagati y’intara zitandukanye, hagati y’intara n’Umujyi wa Kigali hamwe na moto zitwara abagenzi biracyabujijwe mu rwego rwo kurengera ubuzima bw’abaturage. Ingamba nshya zo kurwanya Covid-19 zizatangazwa n’Inama y’Abaminisitiri yo ku wa 2 Kamena 2020. — Office of the PM | Rwanda (@PrimatureRwanda) May 31, 2020 Uyu mwanzuro wafashwe nyuma y’umunsi umwe umurwayi wa mbere ahitanywe na Coronavirus mu Rwanda. Minisiteri y’Ubuzima yatangaje ko uwitabye Imana ari umushoferi w’imyaka 65 wari utuye mu gihugu cy’abaturanyi, wahisemo gutaha mu Rwanda nyuma yo kuremba, akaza gupfa azize kwangirika imyanya y’ubuhumekero. Kuva umurwayi wa mbere wa COVID-19 iterwa n’agakoko gashya ka Coronavirus agaragaye mu Rwanda ku wa 13 Werurwe 2020, hamaze kuboneka 370 banduye, 256 barayikize mu gihe 113 bakitabwaho n’abaganga naho umwe yitabye Imana. Mu ngamba Leta yashyizemo imbaraga mu guhangana na Coronavirus, harimo ko gahunda yo gupima abantu indwara ya COVID-19 izakomeza mu gihugu hose ndetse kwambara udupfukamunwa bizakomeza igihe cyose umuntu agiye aho ahurira n’abandi. Ikindi ni uko serivisi zemerewe gukora zigomba kubahiriza amabwiriza atangwa n’inzego z’ubuzima (gukaraba intoki, kwambara udupfukamunwa, gusiga intera hagati y’umuntu n’undi). Abacuruzi bose barasabwa kwemera kwishyurwa hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga nka bumwe mu buryo bwemewe bwo kwishyurana. a. Ibikorwa by’inzego za Leta n’iby’abikorera bizakomeza ariko buri rwego rugakoresha abakozi b’ingenzi, abandi bagakomeza gukorera mu rugo bifashishije ikoranabuhanga. b. Ibikorwa bya siporo y’umuntu umwe hanze biremewe, ariko inyubako zikorerwamo imyidagaduro (gyms) zizakomeza gufunga. c. Ingendo zemewe gusa hagati mu ntara. Ingendo hagati y’intara zitandukanye cyangwa Intara n’Umujyi wa Kigali zirabujijwe ariko [Byari biteganyijwe ko] zizasubukurwa ku itariki ya 1 Kamena 2020. d. Imihango yo gushyingura igomba kujyamo abantu batarenze 30. e. Ishyingirwa imbere y’Ubuyobozi riremewe ariko rigomba kwitabirwa n’abantu batarenze 15. Iyindi mihango nko gusezerana mu nsengero cyangwa byo kwiyakira ntibyemewe. a. Imipaka izakomeza gufungwa, kereka ubwikorezi bw’ibicuruzwa (cargo trucks). Abanyarwanda n’abandi bantu basanzwe batuye mu Rwanda bemerewe gutaha ariko bagahita bashyirwa mu kato (isolation) nk’uko amabwiriza y’ubuzima abiteganya. Abari mu kato baziyishyurira ikiguzi cya serivisi zose bazahabwa. b. Amashuri azakomeza gufunga kugeza muri Nzeri 2020. c. Insengero zizakomeza gufunga. d. Utubari tuzakomeza gufunga. e. Moto n’amagare ntibyemerewe gutwara abagenzi, ariko bishobora gukomeza kwifashishwa mu gutwara ibintu babigeza ku bandi. [Byari biteganyijwe ko] Bizongera kwifashishwa mu gutwara abagenzi guhera ku itariki ya 1 Kamena 2020. f. Inama n’amateraniro rusange cyangwa mu ngo z’abantu birabujijwe.

title: Umuntu wa mbere wahitanwe na Coronavirus mu Rwanda yashyinguwe (Amafoto)
content: Ku wa 30 Gicurasi 2020 nibwo Minisiteri y’Ubuzima yatangaje ko umurwayi wa mbere yishwe na Coronavirus ku butaka bw’u Rwanda. Uyu mugabo yashyinguwe kuri uyu wa 31 Gicurasi 2020, hubahirizwa amabwiriza yo kwirinda ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus n’ay’idini ya Islam yabarizwagamo. Ahagana saa Cyenda nibwo umurambo we wagejejwe ku irimbi rya Nyamirambo. Yasezeweho bijyanye n’imyemerere ya Kiyisilamu yose kuva ku isengesho ryo kumusabira n’uburyo arambikwa mu mva. Itsinda ryamushyinguye ryasoje igikorwa rikurikizaho gutera imiti yica udukoko ahantu hose hashyizwe umurambo wa nyakwigendera ndetse n’imyenda bari bambaye. title: Amabwiriza yo gushyingura umuntu wahitanywe na COVID-19 mu Rwanda
content: Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu u Rwanda rwatangaje ko umuntu wa mbere yapfuye ahitanywe na Coronavirus. Yari umushoferi w’imyaka 65 wari utuye “mu gihugu cy’abaturanyi” wahisemo gutaha mu Rwanda nyuma yo kuremba. Yitaweho n’abaganga mu kigo cyagenewe kuvura Coronavirus ariko yaje gupfa azize kwangirika imyanya y’ubuhumekero. Umuyobozi w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Ubuzima, RBC, Dr Sabin Nsanzimana, yabwiye IGIHE ko usibye amabwiriza ya OMS n’igihugu gifite ayacyo y’uburyo bwo gushyingura umuntu wahitanywe n’icyorezo gishobora kwanduza abandi, aho icyitabwaho cyane ariko hatagira umuntu ukura uburwayi muri icyo gikorwa. Ati “Ikijya kigorana cyane ni ukubyumvisha nk’umuryango bitewe n’imico y’abantu uko igenda itandukana, mu muryango abantu baba bafite agahinda bashaka kumwegera kurushaho, kandi birumvikana, ibyo byose ni ukubyitaho kugira ngo tutabura umuntu ngo tubone n’abarwayi bashya.” Kubera ko ari inshuro ya mbere u Rwanda rugize iki kibazo, umuryango wa nyakwigendera wasobanuriwe byimbitse uko igikorwa kigomba kugenda, dore ko ari ubwa mbere Coronavirus itwaye ubuzima bw’umuntu mu gihugu. Mu bindi byitabwaho, ni isuku, guhana intera hagati y’abantu n’abandi, kwambara udupfukamunwa n’ibindi. Ayo mabwiriza ya OMS yo mu 2017 agena uburyo bwo gushyingura abahitanywe n’indwara zandura akubiye mu ngingo 12 zihera ku bantu baba bagomba kujya muri icyo gikorwa cyo gushyingura kugeza ku ibwirizwa rya nyuma rivuga uburyo abantu bataha bavuye muri uwo muhango. Aya mabwiriza avuga ko mbere yo kujya ahari umurambo, hari itsinda ry’abantu bane riba rigomba kuhagera mbere. Iryo tsinda riba ririmo umuntu ufite igicuba gitera umuti wica udukoko aho hantu, umuntu ugenzura niba ibikorwa byose bikorwa mu buryo bwubahirije amabwiriza, uba uganiriza umuryango wagize ibyago n’umuntu uhagarariye idini. Umuti ukoreshwa mu gusukura intoki ugomba kuba urimo chlorine ingana na 0.05% naho uterwa aho hantu mu kwica udukoko wo ugomba kuba urimo chlorine ingana na 0.5%. Uyoboye itsinda rigiye gushyingura, aba agomba gusobanurira neza abo bafatanyije uko igikorwa kigomba gukorwa mbere y’uko berekeza aho bagomba gusanga umurambo. Basabwa kwihanganisha umuryango mu gihe bahuye nawo, ndetse ushinzwe guhanahana amakuru muri iryo tsinda niwe ufatanya n’umuryango mu guhamagara umunyedini uza kuyobora umuhango mu buryo nyobokamana. Basabwa kubaza umuryango niba hari ibyifuzo nyakwigendera yasize mu buryo agomba gushyingurwamo [aha harebwa cyane ku kuba umurambo watwikwa, gushyingurwa mu mva bisanzwe cyangwa se kuwutera imiti]. Umuryango uba wemerewe gufata amafoto y’uburyo gushyingura bigiye gukorwa. Umuryango kandi ugira uruhare mu gushaka aho nyakwigendera azashyingurwa, byaba na ngombwa akaba ariwo wicukurira imva, mu gihe kandi umurambo ugejejwe mu mva, umuryango uhabwa uburenganzira bwo gusezera bwa nyuma unagamo itaka cyangwa se utera amazi. Yaba ku bakirisitu no ku Bayisilamu, gushyingura bikorwa hakurikijwe imyemerere y’idini kandi umuryango utanze ibitekerezo. Abagomba gushyingura iyo bageze ahari umurambo, bane bakora mu nzego z’ubuzima bambara imyenda ibakingira kwandura [amasarubeti aba akoze mu byo umuntu yakwita nk’amashashi], niba isanduku ariyo iza gushyirwamo umurambo, basabwa ko bayishyira hanze mbere yo kuwushyiramo, hanyuma bakabaza umuryango ubwiherero, ibyumba, urwogero n’ahandi hantu nyakwigendera yakoreshaga, bakahatera umuti wica udukoko. Muri ba bantu bane bari mu itsinda ryo gushyingura bambaye imyenda ibakingira kwandura, babiri nibo bemererwa kujya mu cyumba kirimo umurambo. Bawushyira mu ishashi itwarwamo imirambo, umwe ateruye amaguru undi ateruye amaboko barangiza bakayifunga bagateraho umuti wica udukoko ugomba kuba urimo chlorine ingana na 0.5%. Basohokana umurambo bakagana ha handi baba basize isanduku, barangiza bakawushyiramo. Mu gihe uwapfuye yari afite ibiro byinshi ku buryo abantu babiri bataterura umurambo, bikorwa na bane. Muri iyo sanduku, abo bantu nibo bashyiramo imyenda cyangwa se ibindi umuryango uba wifuza ko byashyinguranwa na nyakwigendera. Ariko basabwa kwemerera umwe mu bagize umuryango ko ariwe wafunga isanduku irimo uwapfuye, ariko abikora yambaye uturindantoki. Nyuma isanduku iterwa umuti wica udukoko. Aya mabwiriza avuga ko umuryango uba ukwiriye guhabwa umwanya wo kuririra uwabo witabye Imana. Mu gihe ushyingurwa atagombera gushyirwa mu isanduku [nko ku Bayisilamu], abantu babiri nibo baterura umurambo bakawushyira mu modoka iwujyana ku irimbi. Iyo ibyo birangiye, muri rwa rugo harongera hagaterwa umuti, ibikoresho bimwe byakoreshejwe byaba ngombwa bigahita bitwikirwa aho. Ba bantu bambaye ya myenda irinda ko umuntu yandura udukoko bayikuriramo aho ariko nabo bakurikije amabwiriza yagenwe. Mu gushyira umurambo mu modoka, ababikora bagomba kuba bambaye uturindantoki, ntabwo byemewe ko hagira umuntu wo mu muryango ugenda yicaye iruhande rw’isanduku irimo umurambo. Abamanura isanduku mu mva nabo bagomba kuba bambaye uturindantoki, bagashyingura nk’ibisanzwe, niba ari amasengesho avugwa umuryango ugahabwa umwanya. Rya tsinda ryagize uruhare mu gushyingura risabwa gusubira ku bitaro rikisukura, hanyuma ya modoka yatwaye umurambo nayo akaba ariho ijyanwa ikozwa ndetse igaterwa umuti. Buri muntu wese wagiye gushyingura, nawe asabwa gusukura ibiganza bye neza akoresheje umuti wica udukoko. Mu Butaliyani, abakora mu bikorwa byo gushyingura, bavuga ko COVID-19 itandukanya umuryango inshuro ebyiri, harimo kuba iyo umuntu ayirwaye aba asabwa kuba ahantu ha wenyine, noneho bikarusha iyo apfuye kuko bwo n’umuryango utemererwa kujya gusezera uwapfuye. Massimo Mancastroppa ukora mu irimbi ryo mu Mujyi wa Cremona yagize ati “abantu benshi bo mu muryango badusaba kureba umurambo inshuro ya nyuma. Gusa birabujijwe”. Yavuze ko umurambo uba udashobora gushyingurwa mu myenda myiza nyakwigendera yakundaga, ahubwo ko mu guha icyubahiro ubusabe bw’umuryango, bayifata bakayishyira hejuru y’umurambo, ishati cyangwa umupira ku gice cy’igihimba, ipantalo cyangwa ijipo hasi.

title: Uwishema wiga muri Turikiya yifashishije intiti mu buvuzi mu bukangurambaga kuri Coronavirus
content: Coronavirus yagaragaye bwa mbere mu Mujyi wa Wuhan mu Bushinwa mu Ukuboza 2019; kuri ubu 6 175 290 bamaze kuyandura ku Isi yose, barimo 371 228 yahitanye na 2 744 546 bamaze kuyikira. Mu gihe cy’umwaduko w’icyorezo nk’iki, amakuru y’ibihuha ariyongera ku buryo agendeweho ashobora gushyira ubuzima bwa benshi mu kaga. Ibi bituma inzego z’ubuzima na za Guverinoma ziba maso mu gukangurira abaturage babyo kubona amakuru mpamo cyane ko nko kuri Coronavirus ari icyorezo kitarabonerwa umuti n’urukingo. Mu gushyigikira itangwa ry’amakuru y’impamo ku batuye Isi, Uwishema Olivier, umunyeshuri w’Umunyarwanda wiga mu Ishami ry’Ubuvuzi rusange muri Turikiya yinjiye mu bukangurambaga bugamije gukemura icyuho cy’amakuru kuri COVID-19. Muri uyu mushinga, Uwishema yashinze Oli Health Magazine itangaza amakuru yizewe ku buzima akusanywa bigizwemo uruhare n’abanyeshuri biga ubuvuzi, abaganga, abigisha ubuvuzi n’abandi bafite inararibonye ku makuru y’ubuzima ku ndwara zitandukanye. Mu gihe COVID-19 yatangazwaga ko ari icyorezo ku Isi yose, Kaminuza Uwishema yigaho nayo yahise ifunga mu rwego rwo kwirinda ikwirakwizwa ryacyo. Mu kiganiro yahaye IGIHE, yavuze kaminuza igifunga yatekereje icyo yakora mu rwego rwo gukemura ikibazo cy’amakuru atizewe n’ibihuha byavugwaga kuri COVID-19. Yagize ati “Mu rwego rwo gukemura amakuru y’ibihuha ku kibazo cya COVID-19 no kumenya ko hakenewe amakuru ku gihe kandı yizewe ajyanye n’ubuvuzi bw’ibanze, nahise ntangiza umushinga w’ubukangurambaga kuri Coronavirus ku Isi hose ( Coronavirus Global Awareness Project) kugira ngo hatagira ucikanwa no kumenya amakuru nyayo kuri iki cyorezo.’’ Uwishema afatanyije n’abanyeshuri biga mu Ishami ry’Ubuvuzi muri Kaminuza ya Harvard, Oli Health Magazine yashinze ikora kandi igahindura amakuru ya COVID-19 mu ndimi zitandukanye kugira ngo abantu bose hatabayeho imbogamizi ku rurimi bavuga, babashe kuyabona. Kugeza uyu munsi amakuru aboneka mu ndimi 25 harimo Icyongereza, Igiturikiya, Igifaransa, Ikinyarwanda, Igiswahili, Ikidage, Igiportugal, Icyesipagnol, Ikirusiya, Icyarabu, Igitaliyani, Igishinwa n’izindi. Ni igikorwa kandi kinakomeje. Nyuma yo gutangiza ubu bukangurambaga, Uwishema yahise abona abanyeshuri baturutse impande zose z’Isi biga mu mashami y’ubuvuzi n’abaganga bashyigikira igitekerezo cye bahuza imbaraga binatuma amakuru batanga asakara henshi. Yakomeje avuga ko “Hakorwa ubushakashatsi bwimbitse mu gutangaza amakuru yerekeye COVID-19 ku buryo n’umuturage utarigeze ukandagira mu ishuri cyangwa udafite ubumenyi buhagije muri siyansi abasha gusobanukirwa neza.’’ Buri muntu anyuze ku rubuga rwa Oli Health Magazine ashobora kubona amakuru cyangwa akareba amashusho asobanura COVID-19 no gufasha abagize ibibazo by’ubuzima bwo mu mutwe bitewe n’iki cyorezo kwiyitaho. Mu butumwa bwe, Uwishema yasabye urubyiruko gukangukira guhanga udushya. Ati “Ubutumwa naha urubyiruko bagenzi banjye ku Isi, ni ukuzirikana ko Coronavirus iri kuduha impano y’igihe. Reka rero tumenye neza uko tuyikoresha mu guhanga udushya kandi tunashyigikirana kugira ngo tubashe kugera kure hashoboka. Twese hamwe dushobora gukwirakwiza ibyiza n’imbaraga dukomeza kuba maso kugira ngo turwanye ikwirakwizwa rya Coronavirusi.” Umushinga wa Uwishema Olivier uhuriweho n’abanyeshuri biga mu mashami y’ubuvuzi arimo irya Harvard n’abaganga barenga 150 ku Isi.

title: Batandatu banduye Coronavirus mu Rwanda, babiri barayikira
content: Itangazo rya Minisiteri y’Ubuzima ryo kuri uyu wa Gatanu, tariki ya 29 Gicurasi 2020, ryerekanye ko umubare w’abagaragayeho Coronavirus mu Rwanda umaze kugera kuri 355 ’ubariyemo batandatu bashya’ kuva umurwayi wa mbere abonetse mu gihugu ku wa 14 Werurwe 2020. Rikomeza rivuga ko “Abarwayi bashya bose bahise bashyirwa mu kato bakihagera.’’ Abantu bari gusanganwa ubwandu bushya muri iyi minsi biganjemo abakurwa mu bashoferi b’amakamyo yambukiranya imipaka n’abo bakorana. Icyizere cyo guhashya Coronavirus kiriyongera cyane ko kuva mu minsi isaga 11 ishize, nta murwayi n’umwe urakurwa hagati y’abaturage. Mu bantu 65 608 bose bamaze gupimwa Coronavirus mu Rwanda, 355 barayanduye mu gihe 247 basezerewe mu bitaro nyuma yo gukira. Abakirwaye ni 108, muri bo nta we uraremba. U Rwanda ruri mu bihugu bitarabonekamo umuntu witabye Imana azize Coronavirus. Ibimenyetso bya Coronavirus birimo inkorora, ibicurane, guhumeka bigoranye n’umuriro. Yandura binyuze mu matembabuzi aturuka mu myanya y’ubuhumekero. Abaturarwanda basabwa gukomeza kubahiriza amabwiriza ya Leta hitabwa cyane cyane ku gukaraba intoki kenshi n’amazi n’isabune, kwambara udupfukamunwa n’amazuru mu gihe umuntu avuye mu rugo cyangwa ahuye n’abantu benshi. Coronavirus yagaragaye bwa mbere mu Mujyi wa Wuhan mu Bushinwa mu Ukuboza 2019; kuri ubu 5 974 553 bamaze kuyandura ku Isi yose, barimo 364 430 yahitanye na 2 631 165 bamaze kuyikira.

title: Ibyo wamenya ku ndwara zo mu mutwe zishobora gutera uzirwaye kureba ibitandukanye n’ibyo abandi babona
content:
Umuganga w’inzobere mu kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe, unakuriye iryo shami mu Bitaro bikuru bya Kaminuza bya Kigali (CHUK), Dr Simon Kanyandekwe, yabwiye IGIHE ko ziterwa n’uruhererekane rw’impamvu nyinshi. Ati “Ziterwa n’uburyo ubwonko bw’umuntu bwaremwe [nta budahangarwa], akenshi usanga bavuga ko umuntu ashobora kurwara kurusha abandi. Uko umuntu yabayeho mu muryango akomokamo cyangwa aho yakuriye, ibibazo yahuye nabyo akiri umwana [nk’ihungabanga] n’imibereho y’umuntu aho asanzwe aba byaba mu muryango cyangwa n’ahandi.” Mu bushakashatsi bwakozwe, nta burerekana ko indwara zo mu mutwe umuntu ashobora kuzirwara bitewe n’uko hari uwo akomokaho cyangwa uwo bafitanye isano wazirwaye. Zitandukanira he? Ni indwara ziri mu byiciro bitandukanye zirimo izifata amarangamutima ya muntu nk’agahinda gakabije [Depression] cyangwa agahinda gakabije kavanze n’imihindukire y’umubiri aho umuntu ashobora kugira ibishimo bidasanzwe, akabura ibitotsi, agakora byinshi icya rimwe [Bipolar disorder]. Hari kandi izifata abantu bakagira imyitwarire idasanzwe mu gusabana n’abandi zikunze kwitwa ibisazi, aho usanga umuntu yumva ibyo abandi batumva cyangwa akabona ibyo abandi batabona. Iyi ikunze gufata abantu bari mu cyiciro cy’imyaka guhera kuri 17 kuzamura. Dr Kanyandekwe yasobanuye ko hari umuntu urwara yari umunyeshuri agahita arivamo, kuko aba atakibona cyangwa ngo yumve kimwe n’abandi, akagira ubwoba mu mubiri atazi aho buturuka, bikanamubuza gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo asabwe. Ibi abatabizi iyo bifashe umwana batangira kumushyira mu cyiciro cy’utazi ubwenge cyangwa wananiwe n’amasomo amwe n’amwe. Ati “Byakomera agatangira gusakuza cyangwa kumenagura ibintu, kugendagenda nta gahunda afite. Aba ashakisha amahoro ariko atazi aho ayashakisha, rimwe na rimwe akumva ikintu cy’ubwoba budasanzwe atazi impamvu, rimwe na rimwe ugasanga yikingiranye mu cyumba yumva abantu bose bashaka kumugirira nabi.” Ugeze muri iki cyiciro atangira kugenda ashakisha icyamufasha gutuza yabona nk’ibiyobyabwenge akabinywa, akongera igihe akoresha ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga nka telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa ashaka kuganira n’abantu bategeranye. Hari kandi idwara yo mu mutwe ifata umuntu akagira ubwoba budasanzwe, ifata abantu bo mu byiciro byose ku buryo ashobora kwibonaho ibimenyetso bishobora no kuba iby’izindi ndwara. Aha Dr Kanyandekwe yasobanuye ko umuntu ashobora kugira ubwoba nk’umutima we ugatera mu buryo budasanzwe, agatitira, akabira ibyuya ku buryo bishobora kumufata akajyanwa mu byiciro by’indembe ariko bamupima ntihaboneke indwara afite. Iyo ndwara ngo ishobora gufata umuntu yari nk’umuyobozi agatangira gutinya kuvugira mu ruhame cyangwa kuyobora inama ariko atazi icyabimuteye, bikamenyekana ko ari indwara ari uko bitangiye kugira ingaruka ku kazi akora. Gusa hari indwara zisanzwe nka mugiga, ibibyimba byo mu mutwe n’izindi zishobora gufata umuntu akagira ibimenyetso nk’iby’indwara zo mu mutwe. Ubusanzwe abantu batandukana mu myitwarire. Hari abo usanga batuje abandi ugasanga bashabutse. Dr Kanyandekwe yasobanuye ko kugira ngo umenye niba umuntu afite agahinda gakabije kavanze n’ibyishimo bidasanzwe (Bipolar Disorder) hagenderwa ku bimenyetso yagiraga mbere y’uko afatwa. Iyi ndwara iyo ifashe umutu atangira gukora ibitandukanye n’ibyo yakoraga, yaba afite nk’umukoresha agatangira kumubwira ibintu atajyaga amubwira birimo kumwubahuka cyangwa kumusuzugura cyangwa umuntu mutaziranye ukabona akwisanzuraho nk’aho muziranye. Nyir’ubwite ntamenya ko hari icyahindutse n’ubimubwiye arakara.
Ati “Mpuye n’umuntu bwa mbere ndi kwinywera icyayi, ndi kuganira n’undi wowe ukaza ako kanya ukansuhuza nk’aho tuziranye hanyuma ugafata nk’igikombe cyanjye ugatangira kukinyweramo. Nubwo waba utari umuganga, wakwibaza habaye iki kugira ngo yitware gutyo.” Uwo muntu ngo arangwa no kumenyera abantu bose n’abo bataziranye akababonamo inshuti n’abavandimwe. Icyo gihe ngo biba bisaba kumwegereza inzobere mu kuvura indwara zo mu mutwe bakareba niba adafite ikibazo. Dr Kanyandekwe ati “Maze imyaka 20 maze muri uyu mwuga hari ubwo bigeze kumpamagara ngo hari umuntu muri Round Point [amasangano y’imihanda] nini yo mu Mujyi ari kuvuga menshi, witwara mu buryo budasanzwe, wabujije n’imodoka gutambuka. Akanga kuva mu muhanda avuga ko abandi aribo barwaye batamushakira amahoro.” Izi ndwara abazirwaye bakunze kugira imbaraga zidasanzwe, rimwe na rimwe bakumva bafite n’ubutumwa bwihariye bakwiye kugeza ku bandi. Aho ngo iyo ari umuntu usenga cyane ukunze gusanga ashaka kubwiriza abandi ko hari ibyo Imana bavuganye ikamutuma, akizeza abantu ibitangaza ko yahawe ububasha n’Imana. Ibi ariko ngo si kimwe n’uko umuntu ashobora gucengerwa n’ijambo ry’Imana agashaka kuryigisha aho ageze hose ariko ngo “Uryigisha agateza umutekano muke mu bandi, ugasanga muri we hatarimo kumva ko ibyo bitemewe, bibangamiye abandi kugeza ubwo bamubuza akananirana, utamwise umurwayi wo mu mutwe ushobora kwibaza niba adakenewe kugezwa ku nzobere.” 
Ubufasha buhabwa uwarwaye indwara zo mu mutwe Umuntu ufite imyitwarire idasanzwe kugera ubwo ibangamira abandi cyangwa ikagira ingaruka ku kazi akora, icyo umuntu asabwa ni ukwihutira kumwegereza abaganga bamwegereye kugira ngo ahabwe ubufasha hakiri kare. Dr Kanyandekwe avuga ko kuboha umurwayi wo mu mutwe utera amahane iyo bidakwiriye kuko ngo bishobora kumutera ibikomere. Umuganga w’inzobere amwitaho binyuze mu biganiro bagirana n’imiti imufasha bijyanye n’ibimenyetso yagaragaje cyangwa impamvu nyamukuru zamuteye kugira imyitwarire idasanzwe. Ati “Umuganga agomba kumenya uwo muntu yari abayeho gute mbere y’uko atugana, ni ikihe kibazo yahuye nacyo kimukomereye, wamara kukibona ukamufasha kugarura icyizere.” Uburwayi bwo mu mutwe n’amarozi Dr Kanyandekwe yasobanye ko imiryango imwe n’imwe cyane cyane muri Afurika ikunze guha ibisobanuro indwara zo mu mutwe ibuhuje n’amarozi cyangwa amadayimoni kimwe n’uko umuntu ahuye n’ikibazo icyo aricyo cyose agishakira imvano aho kubishakira mu mubiri imbere. Ati “Nabyita ko ari imyumvire y’abantu ariko ntitwapfa kubyirengagiza. Kimwe [imyumvire] ntabwo kirwanya ikindi [ibishingira ku bimenyetso byo mu mubiri imbere] ariko ubundi ubihuje nibwo wafasha umuntu neza. Ntabwo dufite uburyo bwo gupima amarozi.” Indwara zo mu mutwe ni indwara zivurwa zigakira ariko bigatwara igihe gitandukanye bitewe n’ubukana zifite, hari n’izishobora gutuma umurwayi afata imiti igihe kirekire, igikenewe ni ugukurikiza inama ahabwa na muganga kandi akavuzwa hakiri kare. Ni umutwaro ku gihugu? Dr Kanyandekwe yashimangiye ko indwara zo mu mutwe ari umutwaro ku gihugu, uzirwaye no ku muryango muri rusange. Imibare y’ikigo cy’ubuzima, RBC yerekana ko 50% by’indwara zo mu mutwe zitangira mbere gato y’imyaka 14 y’amavuko. Abasaga ibihumbi 200 barwaye indwara zo mu mutwe bazitewe n’ibiyobyabwenge. Abahanga mu by’ubuzima bwo mu mutwe batangaza ko akenshi kwiyahura kuba gufite aho guhuriye n’ibibazo byo mu mutwe uwiyahuye yari afite. Imibare ya Polisi y’u Rwanda igaragaza ko abantu 121 bapfuye biyahuye mu mezi icyenda ya 2019. Imibare y’Ishami rya Loni ryita ku Buzima (OMS) igaragaza ko 60 % y’abagerageza kwiyahura baba bafite agahinda gakabije naho 90 % baba bafite imwe mu ndwara zo mu mutwe. [email protected]

title: Coronavirus ku wa 29 Gicurasi: Abanduye ku Isi biyongereyeho ibihumbi 116 ku munsi umwe
content: Iyi mibare ikomeje kwiyongera mu gihe ibihugu hirya no hino ku Isi bikomeje koroshya gahunda yari yarashyizweho yo kuguma mu ngo. OMS yagaragaje ko kuri uyu wa Kane, Isi yapfushije abantu 4600, ibi byatumye abamaze gupfa baba 362 102. Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika zapfushije abantu 1 223 umunsi umwe, mu gihe abandi barenga ibihumbi 22 banduye. Ibi byatumye abamaze gupfa muri iki gihugu baba 103 330 naho abamaze kwandura bamaze kugera kuri 1 768 461. Brésil iri mu bihugu byugarijwe cyane ku Isi kuko kuri uyu wa Kane yapfushije abantu 1 067 abandi barenga ibihumbi 24 barandura. Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika kandi nizo zikomeje kugira abanduye benshi inaza imbere mu kugira abamaze gupfa benshi ku Isi. Brésil iri ku mwanya wa kabiri mu banduye kuko ari 438 812, mu gihe hamaze gupfa 26 764. U Burusiya buza ku mwanya wa gatatu kuko bufite abanduye 379 051, hamaze gupfa abarenga 4142, muri Espagne handuye 284 986 hamaze gupfa 27 119, naho mu Bwongereza handuye 269 127, hamaze gupfa 37 837. Ku mugabane wa Afurika wose hamaze kugaragara abantu 131 587 banduye Coronavirus, abamaze gupfa basaga 3 814 naho abakize ni 55 126. Afurika y’Epfo iri imbere mu kugira abafite ubwandu benshi kuko ari 27 403, abamaze gupfa ni 577, ikurikirwa na Misiri ubu ifite abamaze gupfa benshi kuri uyu mugabane kuko bageze kuri 845 naho abamaze kwandura ni 20 793. Muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, Kenya nicyo gihugu cyugarijwe cyane kuko kuri uyu wa Kane gusa, cyabonye abandi bantu bashya banduye 123. Kugeza ubu ni igihugu cyo mu karere kiza imbere mu bwandu kuko hamaze kwandura abantu 1 618, hapfuye 58. U Rwanda rufite abanduye 349, abamaze gukira ni 245, muri Uganda ubu hari abanduye 317, mu Burundi handuye abantu 42 hapfa umwe naho muri Sudani y’Epfo hamaze kwandura abantu 994 hamaze gupfa 10. Mu bihugu bihana imbibi n’u Rwanda, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo niyo yibasiwe cyane, kuko ubu ifite abanduye 2 660 barimo 69 bamaze gupfa. Kuri uyu wa Kane iki gihugu cyagize abanduye 114.
