title: Neymar bamwibeshyeho bamugenera inkunga y’ibihumbi 113 Frw mu bihe bya Coronavirus
content: Izina ry’uyu mukinnyi wa Paris Saint-Germain, itariki ye y’amavuko na nimero y’indangamuntu ye, byakoreshejwe mu kwiyandikisha kw’abakozi b’imirimo iciriritse bahembwa make, bagenewe inkunga na guverinoma mu bihe bya Coronavirus. Iyi nkunga y’ingoboka igamije gufasha abakozi bo muri Brésil barimo abakora amasuku n’abatetsi, imirimo yabo yahagaze kubera ingamba zo kuguma mu rugo mu kwirinda ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus. Neymar ufite amasezerano yamwinjirije miliyoni 95.5$ uyu mwaka (hafi miliyari 90 Frw) ndetse akaba ari we mukinnyi wahenze mu mateka y’umupira w’amaguru ubwo yagurwa miliyoni 222€ mu 2017, ntabwo yemerewe kuba muri abo bahabwa ubufasha. Gusa, ubusabe bwakozwe hakoreshejwe izina rye bwabanje kwemerwa ndetse bushyirwa mu bazishyurwa mbere y’uko bushyirwa ‘mu bwigwaho’ bitewe n’uko butujuje ibisabwa byose. Abashinzwe itumanaho ry’uyu mukinnyi usatira izamu, ntacyo bigeze basubiza Ibiro Ntaramakuru by’Abafansa (AFP) byashatse kumenya byinshi kuri aya makuru. Ikinyamakuru cyo muri Brésil, UOL, cyatangaje ko abakozi ba Neymar bavuze ko atigeze asaba guhabwa iyo nkunga ndetse atazi n’uwaba warabikoze muri ubwo buryo. Brésil ni kimwe mu bihugu byakozweho cyane n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus cyibasiye Isi. Ni icya gatatu mu bihugu byapfushije abantu benshi, inyuma ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’u Bwongereza aho abantu basaga ibihumbi 34 bamaze gupfa. Neymar w’imyaka 28 ubu ari mu nzu ye ihenze iri ahitwa Mangaratiba, umujyi uri hanze ya Rio de Janeiro.

title: Police FC niyo yatanze agahimbazamusyi gahanitse mu 2019/20: Uko andi makipe ahagaze
content: Amakipe y’abashinzwe umutekano, Police FC na APR FC, ni yo ayoboye andi mu gutanga agahimbazamusyi kari hejuru ku bakinnyi bayo mu mwaka ushize w’imikino wa 2019/20. Agahimbazamusyi ni ishimwe ku bantu bakoze neza, bakuzuza inshingano zabo, ndetse na Bibiliya bene abo batungwa n’ibyo bakoze. No mu mirimo itandukanye irimo imikino, hatangwa agahimbazamusyi ku bakinnyi kugira ngo barusheho guharanira intsinzi dore ko bamwe imishahara bayikumbura, abandi bakayitegereza amezi asaga arindwi. Police FC ni yo yatanze agahimbazamusyi kari hejuru Ikipe y’abashinzwe umutekano ni yo yatanze agahimbazamusyi gahanitse kurusha andi makipe mu mwaka ushize w’imikino. Mu 2019/20, buri mukinnyi wa Police FC yahabwaga ibihumbi 60 Frw ku mukino batsinze, by’akarusho agahabwa ibihumbi 150 Frw mu gihe batsinze umukino wabahuje na ya makipe akomeye. Ikipe ya kabiri kuri uru rutonde ni APR FC itanga ibihumbi 50 Frw kuri buri mukinnyi, iyo batsinze umukino bakiriye mu gihe ku mukino bakiniye hanze, iyo bawutsinze buri umwe ahabwa ibihumbi 80 Frw. Aha ariko, ku mukino wa Rayon Sports, biba bitandukanye ndetse bivugwa ko abakinnyi ba APR FC bakubiwe inshuro zirenga eshatu agahimbazamusyi ubwo batsindaga mukeba ibitego 2-0 mu Ukuboza 2019. Mu buryo busa n’ubutunguranye, Musanze FC niyo kipe ya gatatu yatanze agahimbazamusyi kari hejuru ku bakinnyi bayo, aho ku mukino iyi kipe yatsinze, buri umwe yahabwaga ibihumbi 40 Frw. Ubusanzwe Musanze FC itanga agahimbazamusyi k’ibihumbi 20 Frw ku mukino, ariko Umuyobozi wayo, Tuyishime Placide, yatangaga andi ibihumbi 20 Frw. AS Kigali, Bugesera FC na Kiyovu Sports zose zitanga agahimbazamusyi k’ibihumbi 30 Frw gusa nk’uko bimeze no ku yandi makipe, amafaranga ashobora kwiyongera bitewe n’ikipe bagiye gukina. Rayon Sports, Sunrise FC na Gicumbi FC zitanga agahimbazamusyi k’ibihumbi 25 Frw ku mukino. Amafaranga menshi abakinnyi ba Rayon Sports babonye muri uyu mwaka w’imikino ni kuri Kiyovu Sports aho bahawe ibihumbi 50 Frw ubwo bayitsinda igitego 1-0 mu Ukuboza 2019. Kuri Gicumbi FC yamanutse mu cyiciro cya kabiri, imikino ine abakinnyi bayo batsinze birashoboka ko hari icyo yabafashije mu buryo bumwe cyangwa ubundi kuko baheruka umushahara mu Ugushyingo 2019. Mukura Victory Sports, Gasogi United, Etincelle FC na Espoir FC zose zitanga agahimbazamusyi k’ibihumbi 20 Frw ku mukino. Mukura ifite umwihariko wo kuba iyo abakinnyi batsinze imikino yikurikiranya, hagenda hiyongeraho ibihumbi 10 Frw. Heroes FC yasubiye mu cyiciro cya kabiri nyuma y’umwaka umwe, yatangaga agahimbazamushyi k’ibihumbi 15 Frw ku mukino mu gihe AS Muhanga na Marines FC zatanga ibihumbi 10 Frw ku mukino, ashobora kwiyongera bitewe n’ikipe bagiye guhura nayo. Uwashushanyije: Umurerwa Delphin

title: Rayon Sports yashinje Kimenyi na Rutanga amakosa
content: Mu Cyumweru gishize nibwo Rutanga Eric yasinyiye Police FC imyaka ibiri kuri miliyoni 15 Frw mu gihe Kimenyi Yves yasinyiye Kiyovu Sports imyaka ibiri kuri miliyoni 16 Frw. Aba bakinnyi bombi bari bagifite amasezerano y’umwaka muri Rayon Sports, ariko ubwo basinyaga amasezerano y’imyaka ibiri muri iyo kipe mu mpeshyi y’umwaka ushize, Kimenyi wari uvuye muri APR FC, yahawe miliyoni 2 Frw muri miliyoni 8 Frw mu gihe Rutanga yahawe miliyoni 2 Frw muri miliyoni 9 Frw yari yasabye ngo yongere amasezerano. Mu masezerano basinye icyo gihe bashyizemo ingingo ivuga ko nibigera tariki ya 30 Kanama 2019 batarishyurwa yose, amasezerano ashobora guseswa. Ayo mafaranga yari asigaye ntayo bigeze babona, ku buryo basinye mu yandi makipe bumva ko amasezerano yabo yataye agaciro. Ku wa Mbere tariki ya 1 Kamena, Rayon Sports ihagarariwe n’Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa wayo Itangishaka King Bernard, yandikiye Kiyovu Sports na Police FC, izibwira ko zaguze Kimenyi Yves na Rutanga mu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko. Bukeye bwaho, aba bakinnyi bombi bandikiye Rayon Sports basaba gusesa amasezerano kugira ngo hubahirizwe ibikubiye mu masezerano bagiranye mu mpeshyi ya 2019, mu ngingo yayo ya gatandatu. Mu ibaruwa Rayon Sports yabasubije ku wa Gatatu, yagize iti “Nshingiye ko iyo tariki ya 30/09/2019 (mu masezerano harimo 30/08/2019) yageze tukakubwira ko itabashije kubahirizwa, ugahitamo kudashaka indi kipe, ahubwo ugahitamo kubahiriza amasezerano dufitanye ndetse binashimangirwa n’imvugo yawe mu ibaruwa watwandikiye aho wemeza ko wiyemeje gukomeza amasezerano ugakora akazi wuzuza inshingano zawe. Ibi ukaba warabikoze wirengagije iriya ngingo [...] bityo iyo ngingo ikaba yaratakaje agaciro igihe wemeraga gukomeza akazi.” Rayon Sports yakomeje ibwira aba bakinnyi ko idashobora kubaha urupapuro rubarekura ngo bajye mu yandi makipe kuko bagombaga kubanza kuyandikira bayimenyesha ikibazo bafite mbere yo gusinyira ayo makipe, bityo kugira ngo baruhabwe bisaba ko habaho ibiganiro n’ayo makipe (yamaze kumenyeshwa). Iti “Nkwandikiye nkumenyesha ko iseswa ry’amasezerano watugejejeho ridakurikije amategeko n’amasezerano dufitanye cyane ko mbere yo kurikora, wasinye andi masezerano n’indi kipe mu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko.” Rayon Sports yibukije aba bakinnyi bombi ko ingingo ya kane n’iya gatanu mu masezerano bagiranye, ikibazo cyakemurwa binyuze mu bwumvikane mu gihe hashize iminsi 15 hazitabazwa amategeko.

title: Imikino ikorwa abantu bategeranye yemerewe gusubukurwa mu Rwanda
content: Kuva tariki ya 15 Werurwe 2020 nta gikorwa cya siporo cyari cyemewe mu Rwanda nyuma y’uko hari hashize umunsi umwe Minisiteri y’Ubuzima itangaje ko mu Rwanda habonetse umurwayi wa mbere wa COVID-19. Mu kwezi gushize, tariki ya 5 Gicurasi, Minisiteri ya Siporo yagiranye inama na Komite Olempike n’abahagarariye amashyirahamwe y’imikino n’ingaga za Siporo, hemezwa ko kare imikino ishobora gusubukurwa mu Rwanda ari muri Nzeri haba amarushanwa mu gihe muri Kanama hashobora gutangira imyitozo. Nk’uko bigaragaragara mu itangazo iyi Minisiteri yashyize ahagaragara ku wa Kane tariki ya 4 Kamena, imikino ikorwa abantu bategeranye irimo uwo kunyoga igare, gutwara imodoka, Tennis, Golf, kugenda n’amagare (Hiking) n’imikino ngororamubiri ishobora gusubukurwa ariko hakurikizwa amabwiriza yo kwirinda. Yagize iti “Hashingiwe ku myanzuro y’Inama y’Abaminisitiri yo ku wa 2 Kanama 2020 ku ngamba zafashwe zo gukumira ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo cya COVID-19, Minisiteri ya Siporo mu bufatanye na Minisiteri y’Ubuzima, iratangaza ingamba zikurikira zo kubahiriza hasubukurwa ibikorwa bya siporo y’umuntu umwe cyangwa izindi zikorwa bategeranye.” “Ibikorwa bya siporo n’imikino byemerewe gusubukurwa ni: kwiruka (jogging), imikino ngororamubiri, kunyonga igare, imyitozo yo kugenda n’amaguru (hiking), Golf, Tennis, Umukino wo gutwara imodoka na Fencing (barwanisha inkota).” "Isubukurwa ry’ibikorwa bya siporo zavuzwe bitangirana na tariki ya 8 Kamena. Aya mabwiriza azavugurwa nyuma y’iminsi 15 hashingiwe ku isesengura ry’inzego z’ubuzima." Amabwiriza azubahirizwa ubwo iyi mikino izaba isubukuwe harimo kwambara agapfukamunwa mbere na nyuma y’imyitozo, kubahiriza intera ya metero imwe n’igice hagati y’abakorera siporo n’imyitozo hanze, kwitwaza imiti yo gusukura intoki mu gihe ukorera siporo no kuyikoresha igihe cyose bibaye ngombwa. Hari kandi kwitwararira ku isuku y’ahakorerwa siporo n’imikino hakoreshejwe imiti yemewe yica udukoko, gusukura ibikoresho byifashishwa no kwita by’umwihariko ahakorwa kenshi nko ku nzugi. Buri mukinnyi azajya ashyira ibikoresho bye ukwe, imikino yasubukuwe ntiyemewe gukoresha Stade Amahoro uretse hanze yayo (umuzenguruko wayo) mu gihe abagaragaje ibimenyetso birimo inkorora, kuribwa umutwe, ibicurane no kwitsamura, batemerewe gukorera imyitozo ngororamubiri mu ruhame ahubwo bagomba kwegera inzego z’ubuzima zikabakurikirana.

title: FERWAFA igiye gutanga ibiribwa ku banyamuryango bayo 54
content: Amakipe menshi mu Rwanda yagowe no guhembera igihe abakozi bayo muri ibi bihe bya Coronavirus ndetse bamwe mu bakinnyi bataka ubukene. Kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 4 Kamena 2020, FERWAFA yandikiye abanyamuryango bayo bose ibamenyesha ko hari inkunga y’ibiribwa yemerewe n’umufatanyabikorwa wayo, bityo hagomba kuba inama yiga uburyo yazagabanywa. Yagize iti “Tunejejwe no kubandikira tugira ngo tubamenyeshe ko mu rwego rwo guhangana n’ingaruka z’icyorezo cya COVID-19, hari umufatanyabikorwa watwemereye inkunga y’ibiribwa.” “Ni muri urwo rwego tubandikiye tugira ngo tubasabe umuntu uzabahagararira mu nama mutumiwemo yo kwiga uburyo ibyo biribwa byazabageraho.” FERWAFA yamenyesheje abanyamuryango bayo ko iyo nama izaba ku wa Gatanu, tariki ya 5 Kamena saa Kumi n’ebyiri (18:00) hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga rya Webex. FERWAFA igizwe n’abanyamuryango 54 barimo amakipe y’umupira w’amaguru mu cyiciro cya mbere n’icya kabiri mu bagabo n’abagore, ishyirahamwe ry’abasifuzi, iry’abatoza n’abandi. Ishyirahamwe ry’Umupira w’Amaguru mu Rwanda kandi riherutse kwakira amakuru meza yo guhabwa asaga miliyoni 465 Frw na FIFA ndetse rikaba riri no mu mashyirahamwe 54 ya CAF azagabanywa miliyoni 10$muri ibi bihe bya COVID-19.

title: Abasimbura muri Shampiyona y’u Bwongereza bagizwe batanu bavuye kuri batatu
content: Kuri uyu wa Kane nibwo habaye indi nama yiga ku buryo shampiyona mu Bwongereza yazakinwa nta nkomyi, amakipe yari yaratanze ibitekerezo by’uko umubare w’abasimbura mu kibuga wakwiyongera mu kwirinda imvune kubera ubwinshi bw’imikino mu gihe gito. Ku wa 17 Kamena biteganyijwe ko hazaha imikino ibiri irimo uwa Aston Villa na Sheffield United n’uzahuza Manchester City na Arsenal. Mu mpinduka zakozwe, ni uko ku ntebe y’abasimbura hazajya haba hariho abakinnyi icyenda, ariko abatoza bakaba bemerewe gusimbuza abakinnyi batanu, bigakorwa mu byiciro bitatu mu minota 90. Chelsea niyo yari yatanze ubu busabe bwo kongera umubare w’abasimbura ku ntebe bakava kuri barindwi bakaba icyenda kugeza igihe shampiyona izarangirira.

title: Gasogi United yasinyishije abandi bakinnyi babiri
content: Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatatu nibwo Gasogi United yemeje ko yamaze gusinyisha abakinnyi bombi, inaberekana ku mugaragaro. Nzitonda Eric ukina asatira izamu haba imbere cyangwa ku mpande zombi, yari Kapiteni wa Gicumbi FC yamanutse Cyiciro cya Kabiri. Yahawe amasezerano y’imyaka ibiri muri Gasogi United. Undi wasinyiye Gasogi United imaze umwaka umwe mu cyiciro cya mbere ni Bugingo Hakim wakinaga muri Rwamagana City FC yo mu cyiciro cya kabiri. Uyu musore wazamukiye muri Isonga FA, akina ku mpande zombi, agakoreshwa cyane ibumoso. Yahawe amasezerano y’imyaka itatu. Muri Gasogi United, Nzitonda na Bugingo bahasanze Iradukunda Bertrand wavuye muri Mukura Victory Sports na Beya Beya Hervé wavuye muri AS Maniema yo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo.

title: Undi muntu yanduye Coronavirus muri Premier League
content: Kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 3 Kamena nibwo hashyizwe ahagaragara ibyavuye mu cyiciro cya gatanu cy’ibizamini byafashwe amakipe n’abayagize muri Premier League. Ibyavuyemo byagaragaje ko mu bipimo1197 byafashwe ku wa Mbere no ku wa Kabiri, harimo umuntu umwe wanduye Coronavirus. Premier League yatangaje ko uyu wanduye, azishyira mu kato mu gihe cy’iminsi irindwi. Tottenham yatangaje ko umuntu umwe byagaragaye ko yanduye ari uwayo ariko amazine ye ntiyashyizwe ahagaragara. Mu byiciro bitanu by’ibipimo bimaze gufatwa muri Shampiyona y’Icyiciro cya Mbere mu Bwongereza, hamaze kuboneka abantu 13 banduye Coronavirus mu bipimo 5079. Abakinnyi n’abandi bagize amakipe, bapimwa inshuro ebyiri mu cyumweru mu gihe biteganyijwe ko shampiyona izasubukurwa tariki ya 17 Kamena. Guhera mu mpera z’icyumweru gishize, amakipe yose uko ari 20 akina Premier League, yemerewe gukora imyitozo yuzuye, abakinnyi bakoranaho. Amakipe yemerewe kandi gukina imikino hagati yayo, ahabwa amabwiriza arimo kuba nta kipe ikora urugendo rurengeje iminota 90, buri mukinnyi agomba kugenda mu modoka ye, afite imyambaro ye, kuba nta musifuzi wemewe uzayobora umukino (bamwe mu bagize amakipe akaba aribo babyikorera) no kugenzura uko ahagiye gukinirwa hameze neza.

title: Masudi Djuma yavuze icyamugoye muri Bugesera FC, icyo APR FC yarushije Rayon Sports no kuri Karekezi Olivier
content: Shampiyona ishize, yasojwe imburagije Bugesera FC iri ku mwanya wa munani n’amanota 30 mu mikino 23. Masudi watangiye kuyitoza mu Ugushyingo 2019, aho yari ku mwanya wa 10 n’amanota umunani mu mikino umunani, yabwiye TV1 ko abakinnyi yahasanze batari bajyanye n’imikorere ye bityo bikica akazi. Ati “Naje nsanga, mbere na mbere ni ikipe iri hasi, yari itandukanye na Bukavu Dawa navuyemo. Yaguze amazina, bitandukanye n’ibyo nakora kuko nagura abakinnyi bato benshi bazi gukina noneho ugashyiraho abamenyereye bake babafasha. Ni uko Masudi akora, simvuze abandi. Bugesera sibyo yakoze, yaguze abakinnyi benshi bamenyereye, abakinnyi bato bakina ari bake.” Yakomeje avuga ko aricyo cyabaye ikibazo ubwo hakinwaga imikino myinshi yegeranye kuko abakinnyi bakuze barananirwaga kandi aribo bagomba gushingirwaho buri gihe. Ati “Rimwe uratsinda, ugasanga umukino wo hagati mu cyumweru uratsindwa kuko benshi bazi gukina ni ba bandi bafite amazina kandi ubwo uba usabwa ko 80% ubasubizamo. Niyo mpamvu wasangaga Bugesera itsinda umukino uyu munsi, ejo igatsindwa.” Masudi yavuze ko Bugesera FC ifite abafana beza bakunda ikipe yabo ndetse mu bayobozi bose yakoranye nabo, uw’iyi kipe [Gahigi Jean Claude] ari we wumvikana kurusha bose. APR FC yagombaga gutwara igikombe Masudi Djuma wakiniye APR FC na Rayon Sports ndetse by’umwihariko akaba yaratwaranye igikombe cya Shampiyona n’Igikombe cy’Amahoro na Rayon Sports, yavuze ko icyo kipe y’ingabo yarushije umukeba wayo ari abakinnyi batanu yayitwaye bigatuma ikina umukino mwiza kuyirusha. Ati “Reka mpere kuri APR FC kuko niyo nakiniye mbere, baguze neza. Abantu narababwiye ngo abakinnyi APR yakuye muri Rayon Sports, izatwara igikombe kuko umupira Rayon Sports yakinaga, ubu APR ni wo ikina. Rayon Sports ihindure imikorere yabo, bashyire hamwe kuko iyo bari hamwe baba bameze neza, ni Rayon Sports, APR itinya.” Yizeye ko Karekezi Olivier ashobora gufasha Kiyovu Sports Asabwe kugira icyo avuga kuri Karekezi Olivier bakinannye, witezwe muri shampiyona y’u Rwanda mu mwaka utaha w’imikino, aho azatoza Kiyovu, Masudi yavuze ko nubwo atahiriwe muri Rayon Sports, yizeye ko mu ikipe yo ku Mumena bizakunda. Ati “Ni umuntu twakinannye umupira muri APR, nta bintu byinshi mubwira ‘amahirwe masa’ kuko umupira wo mu Rwanda arawuzi. Ni Umunyarwanda, yabaye mu Rwanda, wenda ntiyagize amahirwe muri Rayon Sports ariko niba akora neza, akaba afite ikipe nziza, azakora muri Kiyovu Sports.” Muri Bugesera FC, Masudi Djuma w’imyaka 43, aherutse gusimbuzwa Mbarushimana Abdu watozaga AS Muhanga.

title: Kiyovu Sports yaguze Ngendahimana Eric, isigaje undi mukinnyi umwe
content: Ngendahimana uzwi ku izina rya ‘Gasongo’ asanzwe akina hagati mu kibuga imbere ya ba myugariro ndetse yari mu bakinnyi bifuzwa cyane na Kiyovu Sports ngo azajya afatanya na Habamahoro Vincent. Nyuma y’ibiganiro byahuje impande zombi, kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 1 Kamena nibwo Ngendahimana Eric yasinye imyaka ibiri mu ikipe yo ku Mumena. Yabaye umukinnyi wa kane mushya usinyiye Kiyovu Sports nyuma ya rutahizamu Babuwa Samson wavuye muri Sunrise FC, myugariro Irambona Gisa Eric wavuye muri Rayon Sports n’umunyezamu Kimenyi Yves wavuye muri Rayon Sports. Amakuru IGIHE yamenye ni uko Kiyovu Sports ikeneye undi mukinnyi wo hagati ufasha ba rutahizamu ndetse uri gutekerezwaho cyane ni Oumar Sidibé wa Rayon Sports kugira ngo asimbure Twizeyimana Martin Fabrice wagiye muri Police FC. Kiyovu Sports izatozwa na Karekezi Olivier guhera mu mwaka utaha w’imikino, yongereye amasezerano abarimo Serumogo Ally, Mbogo Ally na Mutangana Derrick. Kugeza ubu ntiharamenyekana ahazaza h’abatoza barimo; Ruremesha Emmanuel watozaga iyi kipe na Mutarambirwa Djabil wari umwungirije mu gihe bivugwa ko Banamwana Camarade na Nshutinamagara Ismael ‘Kodo’ ari bo bashobora gukorana na Karekezi. Kiyovu Sports yabayeho nyuma yo kwemezwa n’iteka rya minisitiri mu 1961, imaze kwegukana shampiyona y’u Rwanda inshuro eshanu zirimo iyo mu 1990 yatwaye idatsinzwe. Iyi kipe ifite kandi ibikombe bitatu by’igihugu, aho icya nyuma igiheruka mu 1993 ubwo yanatwaraga shampiyona.

title: Iserukiramuco rya Giants of Africa ryari guhuriza ibihugu 11 i Kigali ryasubitswe
content: Tariki ya 20 Gashyantare 2020 nibwo Perezida Kagame ari kumwe na Masai Ujiri, bamuritse iserukiramuco rya Giants of Africa rizabera i Kigali, rigahuza ibihugu 11. Byari biteganyijwe ko rizaba hagati ya tariki ya tariki ya 16 n’iya 22 Kanama 2020. Kuri uyu wa 3 Kamena, Umuryango Giants of Africa watangijwe na Masai Ujiri usanzwe ari Umuyobozi wa Toronto Raptors yo muri NBA, wavuze ko iryo serukiramuco ryimuriwe mu 2021. Wavuze ko “ubuzima n’imibereho myiza y’abafatanyabikorwa bawo, abatoza, abana bawubamo n’abaturage bagenerwa ibikorwa byawo ari cyo cy’ingenzi.” “Mu byumweru bishize, ikipe y’ubuyobozi bwacu yakomeje gukurikirana uko COVID-19 ihagaze ndetse ivugana n’abafatanyabikorwa bacu n’abayobozi b’u Rwanda. Nubwo iki ari icyemezo kitoroshye, twiyemeje gukurikiza umurongo ngenderwaho n’amabwiriza yashyizweho n’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima (WHO).” Masai Ujiri wari mu Rwanda ubwo hamurikwaga iri serukiramuco muri Gashyantare, yavuze ko bizeye ko ubwo rizaba riba mu 2021, abana bazungukiramo byinshi byiza. Ati “Imwe mu ntego z’iri serukiramuco ni uguhiriza hamwe imico itandukanye igize Afurika mu Rwanda. Guhana intera ni kimwe mu bifasha kurwanya iki cyorezo cyibasiye Isi kandi guhurira hamwe byaba bivuguruza ibyo inzobere mu by’ubuzima zishimangira ko twese dukora kugira ngo dufashe kugabanya iki cyorezo.” “Urubyiruko rwo muri Afurika rukwiye ibyiza byacu kandi mu 2021 iserukiramuco rizabitanga.” Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB), Clare Akamanzi, yavuze ko u Rwanda rwiteguye kwakira iri serukiramuco mu 2021. Ati “U Rwanda rurajwe ishinga no guhangana na Covid-19 ndetse n’ingaruka zishingiye ku bukungu n’imibereho y’abaturage bacu. Tugomba guhagarika ibikorwa byinshi by’ingenzi ariko tugakora kugira ngo dukomeze kwitegura inama zishingiye ku ngendo mu gihe iki kibazo kizaba kirangiye.” “Ubuyobozi bw’igihugu cyacu bwabaye ingirakamaro mu gushaka uko dutsinda iki cyorezo. Dutegereje kuzakira iserukiramuco rya mbere rya Giants of Africa i Kigali mu mwaka utaha.” Giants of Africa ni gahunda igamije guteza imbere urubyiruko binyuze mu mukino wa Basketball. Abahungu n’abakobwa 200 bazitabira iserukiramuco rizabera i Kigali ni bo muri Sénégal, Mali, Nigeria, Cameroun, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Sudani y’Epfo, Uganda, Rwanda, Tanzania, Kenya na Somalia.

title: Amakipe ya Premier League yemerewe gukina imikino ya gicuti ariko hashyirwaho amabwiriza yihariye
content: Amakipe yo mu cyiciro cya mbere mu Bwongereza yasabye ko yahura n’ayandi mu kurushaho kwitegura isubukurwa rya shampiyona ndetse byamaze kwemerwa. Ku wa Mbere tariki ya 1 Kamena, Liverpool ya mbere muri Premier League, yakinnye umukino wa gicuti hagati y’abakinnyi bayo bitoranyijemo amakipe abiri. Byemejwe ko imikino ya gicuti izajya ikinwa hagati y’amakipe atandukanye, izajya ibera ku bibuga bisanzwe cyangwa iby’imyitozo. Gusa Premier League yashyizeho zimwe mu ngingo zigomba kubahirizwa zirimo kuba nta kipe ikora urugendo rurengeje iminota 90, buri mukinnyi agomba kugenda mu modoka ye, afite imyambaro ye, kuba nta musifuzi wemewe uzayobora umukino (bamwe mu bagize amakipe akaba aribo babyikorera) no kugenzura uko ahagiye gukinirwa hameze neza. Ubwo shampiyona izaba isubukuwe, imwe mu mikino izajya ibera ku bibuga byihariye (bitagize ikipe bibogamiyeho kuri abiri ari gukina). Umutoza wa Liverpool, Jürgen Klopp, yatangarije BBC ko “yakwishimira” ko imikino ikipe ye izakira, yakinirwa kuri Anfield. Ati “Ntabwo tuzaba dufite ubufasha bw’abafana ariko nta kipe izaba ibufite, ni iki cyiza se ku ikipe yakiriye umukino? Uwo twakina wese ni uko bizaba bimeze, ntacyo bintwaye.” “Twagerageje gukorera imyitozo kuri sitade nk’uko bizaba bimeze turi gukina.” Umukino wagombaga guhuza Manchester City na Arsenal n’uwari guhuza Aston Villa na Sheffield United muri Werurwe, ni yo izakinwa tariki ya 17 Kamena mbere y’uko hakinwa umunsi wa 30 wa Premier League.

title: StarTimes ikomeje kwerekana Bundesliga, Bayern Munich irakoza imitwe y’intoki ku gikombe
content: Mu mpera z’iki cyumweru turimo, Bayer Leverkusen ni yo byitezwe ko hari icyo ishobora gukora igakoma mu nkokora uru rugendo rwa Bayern Munich. Ikipe y’umutoza Peter Bosz, imaze iminsi ifite umusaruro uvanze, aho yatsinze Werder Bremen ibitego 4-1 na Borussia Mönchengladbach ibitego 3-1, ariko ikaba yaratsinzwe na Wolfsburg mbere yo gutsinda Freiburg igitego 1-0 ku wa Gatandatu. Kai Havertz w’imyaka 20, ni umwe mu bakinnyi beza ba Bayer Leverkusen. Ahagaze neza muri uyu mwaka w’imikino ndetse yifuzwa n’amakipe akomeye i Burayi. Nyuma yo gutsinda igitego cyahesheje intsinzi ye kuri Freiburg, akaba n’umukinnyi wa mbere wo munsi y’imyaka 21 watsinze ibitego 35 muri Bundesliga, Havertz yasimbuwe kubera imvune. Umutoza we, Peter Bosz, yizeye ko azaba ameze neza ku mukino wa Bayern Munich uzaba ku wa Gatandatu. Ati “Ameze neza. Ntabwo nzi neza uko imvune ye iteye, ariko ndizera ko azaba ameze neza.” Bosz yungukiye ku kuba imikino ibera mu muhezo, akinisha Florian Wirtz w’imyaka 17 mu gihe nta gitutu cy’abafana ashobora guhura nacyo. Bayern Munich bazahura, iherutse kuzuza imikino umunani yikurikiranya yose iyitsinda. Yinjijemo ibitego 28, itsindwa bitanu. Mu mukino uheruka kuyihuza na Düsseldorf, rutahizamu Robert Lewandowski yatsinzemo igitego cya 29 muri uyu mwaka w’imikino bituma asigara abura kimwe ngo yuzuze ibitego 30 yatsinze mu mwaka w’imikino wa 2015/16 n’uwa 2016/17. Mu mikino itanu isigaye, afite amahirwe menshi yo gutsinda ibindi bitego. Borussia Dortmund, ikipe imwe igifite icyizere ko yafata Bayern Munich iyirusha amanota arindwi, yo izaba yakiriye Hertha Berlin ku wa Gatandatu, ibizi ko gutsikira gato bizashyira iherezo ku cyizere cyo kwegukana igikombe. Mu mpera z’icyumweru, na none StarTimes izerekana shampiyona y’u Budage, Bundesliga, iri kuba ku mashene yayo y’umupira w’amaguru nk’ikigo rukumbi kibifitiye uburenganzira muri Afurika.

title: Urupfu rwa George Floyd: FIFA yasabye ubushishozi mu guhana abakinnyi bashyigikiye abigaragambya
content: Ibi FIFA yabitangaje nyuma y’uko Ishyirahamwe ry’Umupira w’Amaguru mu Budage (DFB) rivuze ko riri kwiga uburyo ryahana abakinnyi bagaragaje ko badashyigikiye ibyakorewe umwirabura George Floyd wapfukamiwe n’umupoilisi w’umuzungu muri Amerika, bikarangira yitabye Imana. Yabwiye Ibiro Ntaramakuru by’Abanyamerika, Associated Press, iti “FIFA irumva neza uburemere bw’ibyumviro n’impungenge zagaragajwe n’abakinnyi benshi zijyanye n’ikibazo cy’ibyabaye kuri George Floyd.” “Ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’amategeko y’umukino…ibyo biharirwa abategura amarushanwa, bagomba gukoresha ubushishozi ndetse bagatekereza icyo bakora bagendeye ku byabaye.” Umwongereza Jadon Sancho watsinze ibitego bitatu ku Cyumweru, yeretswe ikarita y’umuhondo nyuma yo kwerekana agapira k’imbere kanditseho "Justice for George Floyd". Mugenzi we bakinana, Achraf Hakimi na we yerekanye ubutumwa nk’ubu busabira ubutabera George Floyd. Kuri uwo munsi kandi, Marcus Thuram yapfukamishije ivi rimwe nyuma yo gutsindira Borussia Monchengladbach mu gihe ku wa Gatandatu, Weston McKennie wa Schalke, yambaye igitambaro cy’ubukapiteni cyanditseho “Justice for George”. Visi Perezida w’Ishyirahamwe ry’Umupira w’Amaguru mu Budage, Rainer Koch, yavuze ko “Nk’uko bimeze ku rwego mpuzamahanga, umupira w’amaguru ugomba kutagira aho uhurira n’amagambo ya politiki cyangwa ubutumwa ubwo aribwo bwose.” Imyigarambyo ikomeje gufata indi ntera muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika yatumye Perezida Donald Trump afata icyemezo cyo kwifashisha igisirikare ngo kiyihoshe. Abakinnyi batandukanye barimo aba Liverpool, Lewis Hamilton, Paul Pogba, Mario Balotelli na Marcus Rashford bagaragaje ko bababajwe n’urupfu rwa George Floyd.

title: Ntabwo tuzahora mu itangazamakuru tuvuga ibintu bipfuye- Kiyovu Sports ivuga ku ibaruwa ya Rayon Sports
content: Mu cyumweru gishize nibwo Kimenyi Yves wari umaze umwaka umwe muri Rayon Sports, yasinye imyaka ibiri muri Kiyovu Sports atanzweho miliyoni 16 Frw. Ku wa Mbere tariki ya 1 Kamena, Rayon Sports yandikiye Kiyovu Sports iyimenyesha ko umukinnyi wayo yasinyishije, yari agifite amasezerano ndetse niba koko bamwifuza, bagomba gukurikiza amategeko, bakegera Rayon Sports, hakabaho ibiganiro. Mu kiganiro kigufi yagiranye na IGIHE, Visi Perezida wa mbere wa Kiyovu Sports akaba n’Umuvugizi wayo, Ntalindwa Théodore, yavuze ko Rayon Sports igomba kumenya ibikubiye mu masezerano y’umukinnyi kuko batazahora mu itangazamakuru bavuga ibintu bipfuye. Ati “Ntacyo nyivugaho iriya. Ntacyo nayivugaho kuko bazabanze basome amasezerano y’umukinnyi wabo, ntabwo tuzajya twirirwa mu binyamakuru no mu maradiyo tuvuga ibintu bipfuye amaso. Twaba tubahaye ibyo batagombwa.” Ubwo yagurwaga na Rayon Sports muri Nyakanga 2019, Kimenyi Yves yahawe miliyoni 2 Frw gusa muri miliyoni 8 Frw yari yemerewe. Amakuru IGIHE yamenye ni uko mu masezerano Kimenyi Yves , Rutanga Eric na bamwe mu bakinnyi ba Rayon Sports basinye mu mpeshyi ya 2019, bashyizemo ingingo ivuga ko nibigera tariki ya 30 Kanama 2019 batarishyurwa amafaranga yose, amasezerano nta gaciro azaba agifite. Iyi ngingo ikaba ari kimwe mu byashingiweho Kimenyi na Rutanga [waguzwe na Police FC] bava muri Rayon Sports iheruka guhemba muri Mutarama 2020 ndetse ikaba yarahagaritse imishahara y’abakozi kuva muri Mata kubera icyorezo cya Coronavirus.

title: Abakinnyi batanu ba FC Barcelone banduye Coronavirus bigirwa ibanga
content: Radiyo RAC1 yo mur Catalonia, yabitangaje binyuze mu kiganiro cyayo “Tu Diras” mu gihe FC Barcelone n’andi makipe asigaye, yitegura gusubukura shampiyona tariki ya 11 Kamena 2020. Abakinnyi batanu banduye Coronavirus ntibatangajwe muri icyo kiganiro ariko hemejwe ko nta bimenyetso bagaragazaga, aho byagaragaye bamaze gufatwa ibizimini by’amaraso. Amakuru ya RAC1 yahurijweho kandi n’aya El Chiringuito de Jugones, avuga ko hari n’abandi babiri mu batoza ba FC Barcelone banduye Coronavirus. Abakinnyi batanu bari barwaye, barakize ndetse ubu ngo byizerwa ko bamaze kugaruka mu myitozo n’abandi mu gihe ngo abayobozi b’ikipe bahangayikishijwe n’uko bashobora kwibasirwa n’imvune. FC Barcelone ifite Igikombe cya Shampiyona ya Espagne giheruka, yirinze kugira icyo ivuga kuri ayo makuru mu gihe ikinyamakuru AS cyatangaje ko iyi kipe yari yizeye ko icyemezo cyo kubitangaza kizafatwa na La Liga. Mu cyumweru gishize, Kapiteni wa FC Barcelone, Lionel Messi, yavuze ko nk’abakinnyi bari bamaze iminsi bafite impungenge z’uko buri kimwe kizaba kimeze bitewe n’ibyabaye mu bice bitandukanye by’Isi kubera Coronavirus. FC Barcelone izasubukura shampiyona tariki ya 13 Kamena, ihura na Mallorca. Espagne iri mu bihugu byugarijwe bikomeye na Coronavirus, aho handuye abantu bagera ku bihumbi 240, abasaga ibihumbi 27 bamaze kwicwa n’icyo cyorezo. Ku wa Mbere, byatangajwe ko abandi bantu bahitanywe na COVID-19 babonetse, bikaba ari ubwa mbere byari bibaye kuva muri Werurwe.

title: Rayon Sports yamenyesheje Police FC na Kiyovu Sports ko zasinyishije abakinnyi bayo binyuranyije n’amategeko
content: Mu mpera z’ukwezi gushize nibwo Kimenyi Yves yaguzwe na Kiyovu Sports kuri miliyoni 16 Frw mu gihe Rutanga Eric yaguzwe na Police FC kuri miliyoni 15 Frw. Aba bakinnyi bombi bari bagifite amasezerano y’umwaka muri Rayon Sports, ariko ubwo basinyaga amasezerano y’imyaka ibiri muri iyo kipe mu mpeshyi y’umwaka ushize, bahawe 25% by’amafaranga baguzwe. Mu masezerano basinye icyo gihe bashyizemo ingingo ivuga ko nibigera tariki ya 30 Kanama 2019 batarishyurwa yose, amasezerano nta gaciro azaba agifite. Amakuru avuga ko ayo mafaranga yari asigaye ntayo bigeze babona, ku buryo bsinye mu yandi makipe bumva ko amasezerano yabo yataye agaciro. Ku wa Mbere tariki ya 1 Kamena, Rayon Sports ihagariwe n’Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa wayo Itangishaka King Bernard, yandikiye Kiyovu Sports iyibwira ko “yaguze Kimenyi Yves mu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko.” Rayon Sports yavuze ko yatunguwe no kubona Kimenyi yasinyijwe n’umwe mu bayobozi ba Kiyovu Sports kandi akiyifitiye amasezerano, bikorwa nta biganiro byigeze bibaho hagati y’impande zombi. Ni ibaruwa yanandikiwe Police FC. Rayons Sports ivuga ko niba aya makipe akeneye abo bakinnyi, hagomba kubaho ibiganiro hagati y’impande zombi, kuko bagifite amasezerano.

title: Munyakazi Sadate yavuze ku bayobozi bafashije andi makipe gutwara Rayon Sports abakinnyi
content: Munyakazi Sadate yabigarutseho mu butumwa yageneye abakunzi ba Rayon Sports mu mpera z’icyumweru abinyujije ku rubuga rwa WhatsApp. Muri ubu butumwa burebure, Munyakazi yavuze ko hari abashakaga kuyobora iyi kipe (abagize Akanama Ngishwanama) bashoye miliyoni 25 Frw mu yandi makipe ngo atware abakinnyi ba Rayon Sports. Ati “Mpereye ku bibazo bimaze iminsi bihari mu buyobozi, nagira ngo mbabwire ko mu bibazo bikomeye tugira 90% bishingiye kuri icyo, impamvu mvuga gutyo nuko usanga Umuryango wacu umeze nk’urugo rutagira nyirarwo aho usanga buri wese arukoramo ibyo ashatse.” “Niyo mpamvu mwumvise amakuru anyuranye aho abantu kuko bayoboye bahaguruka bagatangaza ko birukanye ubuyobozi bwatowe, bagashora amafaranga arenga miliyoni 25 Frw mukwangiza isura y’ubuyobozi, bagatanga ayo mafaranga mu bikorwa byo kujyana abakinnyi mu yandi makipe ngo bakunde bananize ubuyobozi, nibaza niba arirwo rukundo dukunda ikipe yacu bikanyobera!” Umuyobozi wa Rayon Sports yavuze ko abavuga ko abakinnyi bashize muri iyi kipe bagenda, ibyo atari byo kuko hakiri abakinnyi 24 basigaye kandi hari n’abandi bazongerwamo. Ati “Abababwira ko ikipe yasenyutse kubera ko umukinnyi runaka yagiye, ababivuga ni ba bandi bashyira igitutu ku buyobozi ariko mu by’ukuri bashaka ko dukomeza kubaho uko bidakwiriye. Dufite abakinnyi 29, hamaze kugenda batanu uretse ko dufite abazongerwamo ariko rwose nta byacitse ihari.” Munyakazi Sadate yibukije abafana ba Rayon Sports ko ikipe yagize ibihe byiza hagati ya 2015 na 2019 (igatwara Igikombe cy’Amahoro mu 2016, Shampiyona ya 2016/17 na 2018/19 no kugera mu matsinda ya CAF Confederation Cup mu 2018) yari igizwe cyane n’abakinnyi benshi bayigezemo bakiri bato kandi batanzweho amafaranga make ku buryo ariyo gahunda ikipe igiye kongera gukoresha aho kwifashisha abayisaba ibyo idashobora kubona. Ati “Ntabwo tuzakomeza kubaho uko tudashoboye, niyo mpamvu ubu umukinnyi tumuha ibyo dushoboye kandi tuzabona, uzabyemera tuzakomezanya utazabyemera tuzatandukana naho abumva ko abakinnyi b’amazina ari bo bakora ibyo dushaka, nkeka ko iyo biba ibyo ubu tuba twaratwaye igikombe kuko nitwe dufite amazina akomeye, ariko ntibyabujije ko turangiza turi aba kabiri.” “Ikindi kandi ndabibutsa ko kuva 2004 kugera 2012 nta gikombe twatwaye, nyamara tuzanye abana barimo Manzi, Seif, Djabel, Djihadi, Kevin, Bonheur, … uwo mwaka twageze ku mukino wa nyuma, ukurikiyeho dutwara igikombe ndetse na nyuma yaho ibikombe biraboneka karahava. Urwo ni urugero twakagombye kwigiraho, tugashaka abana bafite impano badafite amazina (kuko nitwe twubaka amazina yabo si bo bubaka amazina yacu) tukabaha abakuru bafite ubunararibonye bwiza kuko hari n’abafite ubunararibonye ariko bubi, ubundi hakaba guhuza muburyo bw’amikoro ndetse na tekinike. Nidukora ibi muzambaze ibikombe.” Mu butumwa bwe yasabye abakunzi ba Rayon Sports kwemera no gushyigikira izo mpinduka. Ati "Mukemera tukabaho uko tubishoboye, tukiyemeza gukora icyo tuzabasha.” Mu bakinnyi Rayon Sports yakoresheje mu mwaka ushize w’imikino wa 2019/20, hamaze gusohokamo Iradukunda Eric na Rutanga Eric (bombi baguzwe na Police FC), Kimenyi Yves na Irambona Eric (bombi baguzwe na Kiyovu Sports), Michael Sarpong wirukanwe na Mugheni Kakule Fabrice wasezeye iyi kipe ku wa Gatandatu.

title: Conor McGregor yasezeye kurwana mu mikino njyarugamba
content: Umunya-Irlande McGregor w’imyaka 31, yamamaye mu iteramakofe ariko mu buryo bwa MMA. Yegukanye irushanwa rya UFC (Ultimate Fighting Championship) mu 2016. Mu gitondo cyo kuri iki cyumweru, McGregor abinyujije kuri Twitter, yatangaje ko yamaze gusezera kuri uyu mukino ndetse atazongera kurwana. Yagize ati “Muraho nshuti, nafashe icyemezo cyo gusezera kurwana. Mwarakoze ku bihe byiza twagiranye! Mbega urugendo! Iyi ni ifoto yanjye n’umubyeyi wanjye muri Las Vegas natwaye rimwe mu marushanwa y’Isi!” Si ubwa mbere uyu mugabo wamamaye mu mikino njyarugamba ya MMA, asezeye akoresheje imbuga nkoranyambaga. Muri Werurwe 2019, yatangaje ko yasezeye ariko mu ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka asubira mu rurwaniro ahanganye n’Umunyamerika Donald "Cowboy" Cerrone mu murwano wabereye i Las Vegas. Yatsinze uwo murwano nyuma y’amezi 15 asezeye. Mu 2016, nabwo yari yagize ati “Nafashe icyemezo cyo gusezera nkiri muto. Mwarakoze ku buryo mwanshyigikiye. Tuzongere dusubire.” Conor McGregor afatwa nk’umwe mu ndwanyi nziza zabaye muri UFC, aho yasezeye ari ku mwanya wa munani ku rutonde rw’iryo rushanwa. Mu 2019, ishyaka rye ryo kurwana ryateje amakimbirane ubwo yari amaze gutsindwa n’Umurusiya Khabib Nurmagomedov mu gace ka kane k’umurwano. Izi ndwanyi zombi, zafatiwe ibihano: McGregor ahagarikwa amezi atandatu n’amande y’ibihumbi 50$ mu gihe Nurmagomedov yahagaritswe amezi icyenda bitewe n’uruhare yabigizemo.

title: APR FC yamenyeshejwe igihe ntarengwa cyo gutanga urutonde rw’abakinnyi izakoresha muri Champions League
content: APR FC yegukanye igikombe cya shampiona ya 2019/20 idatsinzwe nyuma y’uko isojwe imburagihe kubera icyorezo cya Coronavirus, ni yo izahagararira u Rwanda muri CAF Champions League ya 2020/21. Kugeza uyu munsi ntiharamenyekana ikipe izasohoka muri CAF Confederation Cup hagati ya Rayon Sports yabaye iya kabiri nyuma ya APR FC cyangwa AS Kigali yatwaye Igikombe cy’Amahoro cya 2019 (uyu mwaka cyasheshwe burundu kitarangiye) ikaba yakongera gukina iri rushanwa. Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa FERWAFA, Uwayezu François Régis, aheruka kuvuga ko “nta mwanzuro barabifataho, bategereje ko bazabisabwa na CAF.” Nk’uko byatangajwe n’Ikinyamakuru Kawarji cyo muri Tunisie, CAF yatangaje ko amakipe azatangaza urutonde rw’abakinyi azakoresha hagati ya tariki ya 1 n’iya 20 Nzeri 2020 mbere y’uko atanga urundi rutonde rwa kabiri kuva tariki ya 21 kugeza kuya 30 Nzeri. Abakinnyi bazandikishwa mu cyiciro cya kabiri bemerewe gusa gutangira gukina uhereye muri 1/16 cy’irushanwa. Mu mwaka ushize w’imikino, amakipe yatanze abakinnyi azakoresha muri Nyakanga mu gihe amarushanwa Nyafurika yatangiye muri Kanama 2019, ariko ubu itangira ryayo ryigijwe inyuma kubera icyorezo cya Coronavirus cyibasiye Isi. Kubera iyo mpamvu, imikino y’ijonjora ry’ibanza (1/32) n’iya 1/16 izaba mu Ukwakira uyu mwaka mu gihe icyiciro gikurikira gishobora gukinwa mu Ugushyingo. Hari gutekerezwa uburyo mu mwaka utaha w’imikino, nta mikino ya ¼ yabaho mu marushanwa yombi, ikipe ya mbere muri buri tsinda ikabona itike ya ½. Amarushanwa y’uyu mwaka (2019/20) yahagaze ageze muri ½ ndetse biteganyijwe ko azasubukurwa hagati y’ukwezi gutaha na Nzeri, kure umukino wa nyuma waba bikaba tariki ya 25 Nzeri 2020. Muri CAF Champions League, Raja Casablanca yo muri Maroc izahura na Zamalek yo mu Misiri mu gihe Wydad Casablanca yo muri Maroc izahura na Al Ahly yo mu Misiri. Muri Confederation Cup, Pyramids FC yo mu Misiri izahura na Horoya FC yo muri Guinée mu gihe RS Berkane na Hassania Agadir zo muri Maroc nazo zizahura mu wundi mukino.

title: Sunrise FC yasinyishije Ndayishimiye Célestin
content: Ndayishimiye Célestin ukina inyuma ku ruhande rw’ibumoso, yari amaze imyaka ine akina muri Police FC nyuma yo kuyigeramo avuye muri Mukura Victory Sports. Igurwa rya Rutanga Eric wakiniraga Rayon Sports, riri mu byatumye uyu mukinnyi w’imyaka 25 atekereza gusohoka muri Police FC. Mu ikipe yo mu Burasirazuba, Ndayishimiye Célestin agiye kuhasimbura Niyonshuti Gad ‘Evra’, we waguzwe na Musanze FC ku wa Gatanu. Ndayishimiye yazamukiye mu Isonga FC nyuma yo kuva mu Gikombe cy’Isi cy’abatarengeje imyaka 17 cyabereye muri Mexique mu 2011, ahava ajya muri Kiyovu Sports. Nyuma y’umwaka umwe, yerekeje muri Mukura Victory Sports mu 2015 ndetse atangira guhamagarwa mu ikipe y’Igihugu nkuru yakinnye CHAN 2016. Mu mpeshyi y’uwo mwaka nibwo Ndayishimiye Célestin yerekeje muri Police FC, ariko akaba atarorohewe n’imyaka ibiri ishize aho yagiye asimburana na Muvandimwe Jean Marie Vianney wakinnye imikino myinshi.

title: Nta murwayi mushya wa Coronavirus wabonetse mu cyiciro cya gatandatu cy’ibipimo byafashwe muri Premier League
content: Icyiciro cya gatandatu cy’ibipimo bimaze gufatwa mu gihe cy’ibyumweru bitatu, cyakozwe ku wa Kane no ku wa Gatanu nyuma y’uko amakipe amaze icyumweru akora imyitozo abakinnyi bakoranaho ndetse amwe akaba yaratangiye gukina imikino ya gicuti. Itangazo ryashyizwe ahagaragara ku wa Gatandatu, rigira riti “Premier League uyu munsi iremeza ko ku wa Kane tariki ya 4 Kamena no ku wa Gatanu tariki ya 5 Kamena, abakinnyi n’abandi bo mu makipe 1195 bapimwe COVID-19. Muri abo, nta wasanganywe icyo cyorezo.” Iyi ni inkuru nziza kuri Shampiyona y’Icyiciro cya Mbere mu Bwongereza iteganya gusubukurwa mu minsi 10 iri imbere. Ni ku nshuro ya kabiri hatabonetse umurwayi mu bipimo byafashwe amakipe yose 20 mu byiciro bitandatu by’ibipimo bimaze gufatwa mu gihe umuntu umwe ari we byagaragaye ko yanduye Coronavirus mu byiciro bitatu biheruka. Kuva iyi gahunda itangiye, Premier League imaze gufata ibipimo 6274. Abanduye icyorezo cya COVID-19 ni 13 gusa. Umukinnyi uzongera kugaragaraho iki cyorezo azajya yishyira mu kato mu gihe cy’iminsi 14. Premier League izongera gusubukurwa nyuma y’iminsi 100 ihagaritswe n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus cyibasiye Isi. Uko amakipe azahura mu mikino 32 y’iminsi itatu ibanza byatangajwe ku wa Gatanu tariki ya 5 Kamena, hamwe n’iya ¼ y’Igikombe cy’Ishyirahamwe ry’Umupira w’Amaguru mu Bwongereza (FA Cup) kizakinwa hagati ya tariki ya 27 n’iya 28 Kamena. Imikino 92 isigaye muri Premier League, izaba mu muhezo, yerekanwe na Sky Sports, BT Sport, BBC Sport cyangwa Amazon Prime. Premier League izasubukurwa Aston Villa ihura na Sheffield United tariki ya 17 Kamena mbere y’uko Manchester City yakira Arsenal kuri uwo mugoroba.

title: Rugwiro Hervé yagizwe kapiteni wa Rayon Sports
content: Rugwiro amaze umwaka umwe muri Rayon Sports nyuma yo kuyigeramo asezerewe na APR FC mu mpeshyi y’umwaka ushize wa 2019. Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, ubuyobozi bwa Rayon Sports bubinyujije ku rubuga rwa Twitter, bwagize buti “Rugwiro Hervé ni we kapiteni wacu mushya.” #RugwiroHervé.... our new captain!!!#Gikundiro pic.twitter.com/AF0LiGDpNH — Official Rayon Sports (@rayon_sports) June 6, 2020 Rugwiro yajyaga yambara igitambaro cy’abakapiteni muri APR FC ubwo Mugiraneza Jean Baptiste ‘Migi’ yabaga atakinnye. Muri Rayon Sports, yasimbuye Rutanga Eric waguzwe na Police FC mu gihe na Irambona Eric wari kapiteni wa kabiri w’iyi kipe, na we yerekeje muri Kiyovu Sports. Mugheni Kakule Fabrice wasezeye Rayon Sports kuri uyu wa Gatandatu nyuma yo kubwirwa ko “ifite gahunda yo gukinisha abana bahembwa amafaranga make”, yari mu batekerezwagaho kuba kapiteni.

title: Ubwegure bw’Umunyamabanga wa Rayon Sports bwateshejwe agaciro
content: Tariki ya 28 Gicurasi nibwo Abraham Kelly wari umaze amezi atanu ari Umunyamabanga wa Rayon Sports, yandikiye Umuyobozi w’ikipe avuga ko yeguye “kubera impamvu ze bwite”. Mu itangazo ryashyizwe hanze na Rayon Sports kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, ryasinyweho n’uyu Ibrahim Kelly, iyi kipe yatangaje ko ubwegure bw’Umunyamabanga wayo bwateshejwe agaciro bityo azakomeza imirimo ye. Rigira riti “None ku wa 6 Kamena 2020 hateranye inama ya Komite Nyobozi y’Umuryango wa Rayon Sports hubahirijwe amabwiriza yo kwirinda COVID-19, ku murongo w’ibyigwa harimo ingingo yo gusuzuma ubwegure bw’Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Umuryango wa Rayon Sports, Bwana Abraham Kelly. Nyuma yo kubisuzuma no kungurana ibitekerezo, Inama ntiyemeye ubwegure bwe ndetse na we yiyemeza gukomeza inshingano yatorewe.” Ku wa 19 Mutarama 2019 nibwo Abraham Kelly, yagizwe Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa Rayon Sports, mu nama y’Inteko Rusange y’ikipe yabereye kuri King Fisher Hotel Muhazi mu Karere ka Gasabo. Yasimbuye Muhire Jean Paul wabaye Visi Perezida wa mbere wa Rayon Sports. Abraham Kelly asubiye mu nshingano ze mu gihe amakuru yizewe IGIHE yamenye ari uko n’Umuvugizi, Nkurunziza Jean Paul, na we yasubiye mu nshingano nyuma yo kuvuga ko yeguye ariko we akaba nta baruwa y’ubwegure yagiye ahagaragara.

title: Mugheni Fabrice yasezeye Rayon Sports igiye gukinisha abakinnyi bato badahenze
content: Mugheni Fabrice yari amaze imyaka ibiri akinira Rayon Sports nyuma yo kuva muri mukeba Kiyovu Sports. Mu minsi ishize, Ubuyobozi bwa Rayon Sports bwatangaje ko uyu mukinnyi wari usoje amasezerano, ari umwe mu bari kuganirizwa ngo bagume muri iyi kipe ndetse byavugwaga ko ashobora guhabwa igitambaro cya kapiteni nyuma y’igenda rya Rutanga Eric waguzwe na Police FC. Abinyujije kuri Instagram, Mugheni Kakule Fabrice yagize ati “Rimwe na rimwe biragoye gusezera inshuti. Ntabwo nsezeye ahubwo tuzabonane vuba kuko tuzakumburana mu minsi mike. Ibyumweru, amezi, imyaka…Ntabwo byoroshye gusezera inshuti yagushyigikiye kenshi mu bihe bikomeye ariko ndatekereza ko iki aricyo gihe cyo gutandukana. Amahiwe masa Rayon Sports Rwanda.” Mugheni yavuze ko kandi Ubuyobozi bwa Rayon Sports bwamubwiye ko bufite "gahunda yo gukinisha abakinnyi bato badahembwa umushahara w’umurengera." Ubwo yagarukaga muri Rayon Sports mu mpeshyi ya 2018, ni ku nshuro ya kabiri Mugheni yari ageze muri iyi kipe yatwaranye nayo igikombe cya shampiyona ya 2018/19 nyuma y’uko bwa mbere yakiniye ari hagati ya 2015 na 2017. Yabaye umukinnyi wa gatanu wari muri Rayon Sports ya 2019/20 uyisohotsemo nyuma ya Michael Sarpong wirukanwe, Kimenyi Yves na Irambona Eric (baguzwe na Kiyovu Sports), Iradukunda Eric na Rutanga Eric, bombi baguzwe na Police FC.

title: Michael Jordan agiye gutanga miliyoni $100 zo kurwanya irondaruhu
content: Jordan na sosiyete ye, batangaje ko bazatanga izi miliyoni 100$ mu gihe cy’imyaka 10 nyuma y’uko muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika hakomeje kuba imyigaragambyo yo kugaragaza ko batishimiye urupfu rw’umwirabura George Floyd mu cyumweru gishize. George Floyd wari udafite intwaro, yafashwe n’umupolisi w’umuzungu wamutsikamiye ku ijosi mu gihe cy’iminota umunani bimuviramo kwitaba Imana, ibi byabereye muri Minnesota. Mu itangazo sosiyete ya Michael Jordan yashyize ahagaragara, yagize iti “Ubuzima bw’abirabura bufite akamaro. Ibi ntabwo ari amagambo atavugwaho rumwe. Kugeza igihe ivanguramoko rimaze gushinga imizi rigatuma inzego z’igihugu cyacu zinanirwa rishize burundu, tuzakomeza kwiyemeza kurengera no kuzamura imibereho y’abirabura.” “Uyu munsi, turatangaza ko Michael Jordan na sosiyete ye (Jordan Brand) tuzatanga miliyoni $100 mu gihe kirenga imyaka 10 iri imbere ku miryango iharanira kurwanya irondaruhu, gushyigikira ubutabera mbonezamubano no guteza imbere uburezi.” Mu ntangiriro z’iki cyumweru, Michael Jordan agaruka ku byabaye kuri George Floyd, yavuze ko "yababajwe cyane kandi ko afite uburakari bukabije" ndetse ashyigikiye "abamagana irondaruhu n’ihohoterwa muri Amerika.”

title: Musanze FC yaguze abakinnyi batatu, yumvikanye n’abandi batatu, isezerera umunani
content: Mu ijoro ryakeye nibwo ubuyobozi bwa Musanze FC bwicaranye n’abakinnyi bose buteganya gukoresha mu mwaka utaha w’imikino ubwo iyi kipe izaba itozwa na Seninga Innocent. Abakinnyi baraye bumvikanye n’ikipe bagashyira umukono ku masezerano barimo Ndizeye Innocent ‘Kigeme’ wari umaze imyaka ibiri muri Mukura Victory nyuma yo kuva mu Amagaju FC, akaba akina hagati mu kibuga ku ruhande rw’iburyo. Kigeme yahawe amasezerano y’imyaka ibiri kimwe na rutahizamu Munyeshaka Gilbert wakiniraga Heroes FC ndetse na Niyonshuti Gad ‘Evra’ ukina inyuma ibumoso, we akaba yavuye muri Sunrise FC. Umunya-Nigeria Samson Okwecuku wakiniye Bugesera FC, Umugande Kyambadde Fred wakiniraga Espoir FC n’umunyezamu Ntaribi Steven wakiniraga Gorilla FC yo mu cyiciro cya kabiri, bose baraye bumvikanye n’ubuyobozi ariko bazabanza kuzana impapuro zibakura mu makipe yabo. Uretse aba bakinnyi bashya, Musanze FC yongereye amasezerano y’imyaka ibiri Dushimumugenzi Jean, Habyarimana Eugène na Moussa Ally Sova wari usigaje umwaka umwe, ariko akaba yemeye kongezwa undi. Abakinnyi basoje amasezerano muri Musanze FC, batazongerwa, barimo Maombi Jean Pierre, Nduwayezu Jean Paul ‘Chouchou’, Jean Didier Touya, Gabiro Jean Claude na Mugenzi Cédric ‘Ramires’. Abari bagifite amasezerano basezerewe ni Abanya-Nigeria; Ernest Adeola na Okwecuku Okay bari basigaranye imyaka ibiri y’amasezerano nyuma yo kumara umwe kimwe n’umunyezamu Muhawenayo Gad. Peter Otema wakiniraga Bugesera FC mu mwaka ushize w’imikino, yifuza kugaruka muri Musanze FC yarimo mu mwaka w’imikino wa 2017/18, akayikinira aniga gutoza.

title: Gicumbi FC na Heroes FC zashakaga kuguma mu cyiciro cya mbere zatewe utwatsi
content: Mu bujurire amakipe yombi yatanze tariki ya 30 Gicurasi, yasabye ko icyemezo cya Komite Nyobozi ya FERWAFA cyafashwe tariki ya 22 z’uko kwezi, giteshwa agaciro, imikino yari isigaye igakinwa cyangwa hakongerwa amakipe y’icyiciro cya mbere akaba 18. Komisiyo y’Ubujurire muri FERWAFA yateranye kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 5 Kamena 2020 yiga kuri ubwo bujurire. Iyi Komisiyo yari iyobowe na Me Kajangwe Joseph, yemeje ko ubujurire bwa Gicumbi FC na Heroes FC nta shingiro bufite bityo icyemezo cya Komite Nyobozi ya FERWAFA cyo ku wa 22 Gicurasi 2020 cyo kumanura mu cyiciro cya kabiri amakipe yombi kidahindutse. Heroes FC yari imaze umwaka umwe mu cyiciro cya mbere mu gihe Gicumbi FC yazamutse mu cyiciro cya mbere mu 2013, ikaba yari ikimazemo imyaka irindwi.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo yabaye umukinnyi wa mbere wa ruhago utunze miliyari y’amadolari
content: Ronaldo waherukaga kuza ku mwanya wa kabiri w’abakinnyi binjije amafaranga menshi mu mikino itandukanye ku Isi mu 2020- akaba uwa mbere mu mupira w’amaguru n’uwa kane mu byamamare 100- yinjije miliyoni 105$ mbere yo gukuraho imisoro. Uyu mugabo w’imyaka 35, umushahara aheruka kubona watumye aba umukinnyi wa mbere w’umupira w’amaguru utunze miliyari y’amadolari mu yo amaze kubona ndetse ni umukinnyi wa gatatu (mu mikino yose) ubashije kugera kuri urwo rwego. Ronaldo ni we mukinnyi ukinana n’abandi mu ikipe ubashije kugeza miliyari y’amadolari mu gihe abandi bakinnyi babiri babigezeho ari Tiger Woods ukina Golf (wabigezeho mu 2009) na Floyd Mayweather ukina iteramakofe (wabigezeho mu 2017). Umutungo uyu mukinnyi wa Juventus amaze kwinjiza mu myaka 17 amaze akina ruhago ugera kuri miliyoni 650$ ndetse byitezwe ko azageza kuri miliyoni 765$ ubwo amasezerano ye azaba arangira mu 2022. Lionel Messi watangiye gukina imyaka itatu nyuma ya Ronaldo, amaze gukorera miliyoni 605$ kuva mu 2005. Forbes yatangaje ko kandi Ronaldo umaze gutorwa nk’umukinnyi mwiza w’umwaka ku Isi inshuro eshanu, amafaranga yinjije ari hejuru kure y’ayinjijwe na David Beckham wasezeye umupira amaze kubona miliyoni 500$. Amafaranga Cristiano Ronaldo yinjije mu 2020 arimo miliyoni 60$ z’umushahara wagabanutse ugereranyije n’uw’umwaka ushize bitewe n’uko we na bagenzi be bo muri Juventus, muri Mata, bemeye gukatwa 30% kubera icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Lionel Messi winjije miliyoni 104$, akaba uwa gatanu ku rutonde rw’ibyamamare 100 byinjije menshi ku Isi, we yakaswe 70% by’umushahara kubera Coronavirus ndetse byitezwe ko azagera kuri miliyari y’amadolari mu mwaka utaha mbere y’uko amasezerano ye arangira muri FC Barcelone.
