title: Clapton Kibonge yatangiye gusohora filime “Umuturanyi” yanditse mu bihe bya #Gumamurugo
content: Hashize amezi asaga abiri [kuva ku wa 22 Werurwe 2020] leta ishyizeho ingamba zikomeye zirimo gufunga ibikorwa hafi ya byose mu gihugu hagakora ibyangombwa gusa nk’amavuriro n’amaguriro y’ibiribwa ndetse abaturage bose bagasabwa kuguma mu ngo. Kuva ku wa Mbere tariki ya 4 Gicurasi 2020 hanzuwe ko serivisi zimwe na zimwe zirimo ibikorwa bya leta n’iby’abikorera, amasoko na hoteli zisubukura imirimo. Mu gihe cya gahunda yo kuguma mu rugo, umunyarwenya akaba n’umukinnyi wa Filime, Clapton Kibonge, yakibyaje umusaruro yandika filime ye ya mbere. Yabwiye IGIHE ko muri icyo gihe yatekereje icyo yakora bitewe n’ubuzima yarimo agahitamo kwandika filime yise “Umuturanyi”. Yagize ati ”Igihe twari mu rugo erega wasangaga nta muntu mbona hafi usibye umuturanyi wanjye, naburaye ni we washoboraga kungoboka, iyo ndwara ni we wari kuntabariza ndamutse ntewe niwe wantabara.” “Umuturanyi” ni yo filime ya mbere, Clapton yashoyemo imbaraga ze akanayikina kuko mbere wasangaga akina izo bamwishyuye ameze nkuri mu kazi. Yakomeje avuga ko "Iyi ni iya mbere yanjye kandi numva igihe cyari kigeze.” Iyi filime izagaragaramo abakinnyi banyuranye ariko biganjemo abafite impano nka Khalfan usanzwe ari umunyamuziki, Kamanzi Didier uzwi cyane muri Filime Nyarwanda n’abandi bakizamuka. Clapton avuga ko iyi filime izajya isohoka buri wa Mbere w’Icyumweru hanyuma ku wa Gatatu hasohoke ‘DayMakers Comedy’ nayo ikaba umusaruro w’ibitekerezo uyu mugabo yagize mu gihe cya Covid-19. Filime “Umuturanyi” yayobowe na Nsengumuremyi Valens. Agace ka mbere ka filime "Umuturanyi" ya Clapton Kibonge

title: Batandukanye nyuma y’ukwezi ateye ivi! Inkuru y’urukundo rwa Kamayirese wigisha umuziki ku Nyundo
content: Mu kiganiro na IGIHE uyu muhanzi yaduhishuriye uko yaje kubabazwa n’umukobwa bakundanaga nyuma y’uko amwambitse impeta bakaza gutandukana mu kwezi kumwe gusa. Bahuye gute? Uko yamwambitse impeta kubera ikigare Kamayirese Erasme yamenyekanye nk’umuhanzi wafashwaga na TOP5Sai mu myaka ishize, kuri ubu akaba ni umwarimu mu ishuri rya muzika rya Nyundo, aho yanize akarangiriza amasomo y’umuziki. Avuga ku mukobwa bakundanye akamwambika impeta bagatandukana mu kwezi kumwe, yagize ati “Mu ntangiriro za 2018 dusoza 2017 nibwo twamenyanye ariko sinabishyiramo imbaraga kuko nari mfite akazi, nyuma yaje kumpamagara aza i Muhanga mushingira iduka kuko n’ubundi i Kigali nta kindi yahakoraga nubwo hari iwabo.” Nyuma y’umwaka urenga bakundana muri Kamena 2019 uyu muhanzi yaje gufata icyemezo yambika impeta uyu mukobwa amusaba ko yamubera umugore. Ati “Abantu bari batuzi bakomeje kungira inama zo kumwambika impeta, nabikoze kubera ikigare, icyakora byampaye isomo. Byanzagamo ariko ntaragira gahunda ifatika hanyuma abantu bakomeza kumbwira ngo tubikore, nguko uko naje kubikora mwambika impeta.” Kamayirese avuga ko nyuma yo kwambika impeta uyu mukobwa yaje gusanga yarihuse ndetse akumva n’amagambo y’abandi we ntashishoze ngo afate icyemezo gikwiye. Yagize ati “Nkimara gutera ivi, yahise ahinduka rwose, ntabwo twakomeje kuvugana. Ndibuka ko nigeze kumubwira ko nshaka ko tuvugana arabyanga ngiye no kumureba ku iduka yanga ko tubonana, aho niho nahise mfatira icyemezo.” Kamayirese yavuze ko uretse ibyo, hari amakuru yari amaze igihe abona y’uko uyu mukobwa yaba asigaye afite abandi basore bakundana ndetse ajya anamuca inyuma. Avuga ko ikintu cyamutangaje bikomeye ari uko ubwo yasabaga umukobwa ko batandukana bitigeze bimubabaza. Ati” Icyanyeretse ko ibyo nakekaga ari byo, ni uko igihe namubwiraga ngo tubireke nabonye ntacyo bimubwiye.” Nyuma yo gutandukana umukobwa yateruye iduka yisubirira i Kigali Kamayirese yavuze ko nyuma yo gutandukana umukobwa bakundanaga yagiye abura abakiriya bigera ku rwego rw’uko abonye ko bitari kugenda neza, duke twari dusigayemo araduterura adusubirana i Kigali ari naho iwabo. Usibye iri duka, Kamayirese avuga ko hari amafaranga menshi yatakaje kuri uyu mukobwa, harimo ayo yamuhaga muri gahunda zitandukanye. Ati” Ubundi nari nageze ku rwego rwuko ntekereza ko uwa mbere kuri njye ari umukunzi wanjye njye nkaza nyuma ariko nasanze nkeneye kwikunda.” Kamayirese ahamya ko atazi icyabaye kuri uyu mukobwa ariko agakeka ko ari amateka y’urukundo yanyuzemo yamukomerekeje ntiyizere urwo yerekwaga n’uyu muhanzi. Ikindi akeka ko cyateye uku gutandukana ni uko uyu mukobwa yaba yari yarakurikiye amafaranga y’umusore. Ati” Birashoboka ko afite ibikomere by’urukundo ariko nanone wasanga yari akurikiye amafaranga wenda yari yambonyeho.” Nyuma y’amezi atatu batandukanye Kamayirese yaje kwishumbusha uwo bari bariganye ku Nyundo Aba batandukanye mu kwezi kwa Kamena 2019 ari nako n’ubundi yamwambikiyemo impeta, byaje gutuma muri Nzeri uwo mwaka noneho yongera guhura n’undi mukobwa bari bariganye ku ishuri. Ati” Hari undi turi kumwe, tubana, yize ku ishuri ku Nyundo, yigaga ubugeni njye ndi mu muziki. Twongeye guhurira kuri Facebook, twibukiranya ibihe byahise bituma aza i Muhanga turaganira twiyemeza kuba tubana ngo tumenyerane noneho tubone twakora ubukwe.” Kamayirese avuga ko nyuma y’igihe gito bahise batangira kubana mu rwego rwo kumenyerana bakazaba batekereza ibijyanye n’ubukwe bitewe nuko babonye ko bahuza. Uyu mugabo avuga ku byo yigiye muri uru rukundo, yagize ati ”Abantu bakuru bakunda kuvuga ko gushaka atari imikino ariko kuko twe tuba turi mu rukundo tukumva barivugira ariko utaranigwa agaramye […]” Uru rugendo rwe mu rukundo amaze kurwandikamo indirimbo nibura eshatu ziri mu zo agomba kuzasohora mu minsi iri imbere. Kamayirese ni umwe mu banyeshuri barangije mu ishuri rya muzika rya Nyundo, uyu akaba yaragiye kwigayo avuye muri kaminuza arangije icyiciro cya mbere cya kaminuza muri “Water treatment”. Ikiganiro na Kamayirese Erasme

title: DJ Kelly na Dj Traxxy bagiye gukora igitaramo kizabinjiza mu 10 ba mbere ku Isi bacuranze igihe kirekire
content: Aba basore babiri bari mu bakunzwe cyane mu kuryoshya ibirori mu karere ka Rubavu bagiye gukora igitaramo bise ” 25 hours live party” kizaba kuva saa sita z’amanywa tariki 13 Kamena 2020 kugeza saa saba z’amanywa tariki 14 Kamena 2020. Ibi bisobanura ko aba basore bazaba bacuranze amasaha arenga 25, umunsi wose urengaho gato. Iki gitaramo kizaca ku mbuga nkoranyambaga kizatambuka ku rukuta rwa Instagram rwa Dj Traxx. Dj Kelly avuga kuri iki gitaramo yagize ati” Twe dushaka gukora amasaha arenga 25, twamamaza tuzakoresha 25 ariko abazakurikira igitaramo bazabibona kuko tuzakoresha 26 bityo tube tubaye aba cumi ku Isi besheje ako gahigo, birashoboka ko twazagera no ku bindi ariko twabanje gutekereza bino kuko nibyo twizeye kuzakora.” Uyu mugabo yavuze ko muri ibi bihe bya Covid-19 we na mugenzi we aribwo bafashe umwanya wo kuganira basanga hari byinshi bakora mu rwego rwo kuzamura impano zabo. "Twahisemo kwihuza kuko dukoranye igihe kirekire, turaziranye kandi turahuza cyane no mu buzima busanzwe rero turizeza abantu bazadukurikira kuzaryoherwa n’igitaramo cyacu." Yasabye Abanyarwanda n’abakunzi b’umuziki kuzabereka urukundo bakababa hafi kugira ngo bagere ku nzozi zabo nkuko bazirose. Nibaramuka babashije kubikora nkuko babiteganyije bazaba besheje agahigo kazabinjiza mu icumi bacuranze igihe kirekire ku Isi bakuyeho Joseph Capriati ubarizwa muri (Heart Night Club muri Miami) wacuranze amasaha 25 yuzuye akaba ariwe wari uwacumi akaba yarabikoze mu 2018. Iyo urebye ku rutonde rw’ababashije gucuranga igihe kirekire usanga umunya Nigeria uzwi ku izina rya DJ Obi ariwe wacuranze igihe kinini ku Isi ataruhuka kuko yamaze amasaha 240. Ibi akaba yarabikoreye i Lagos mu 2016. Aba basore nibaramuka babikoze bazaba besheje agahigo k’abanyarwanda bamaze igihe kinini bacuranga badahagaze aka kakazabagira aba cumi ku Isi.

title: Ben Nganji yaririmbye agaragaza ko kubaho neza uturanye n’ababayeho nabi nta mutekano bitanga
content: Uyu muhanzi yabwiye IGIHE ko yakoze iyi ndirimbo ashaka kwibutsa ko igihe cyose abantu babayeho neza ariko baturanye n’ababayeho nabi; nta mahoro baba bafite. Ati “Iyi ni indirimbo iri mu njyana ya Reggae, nakoze nshaka kwibutsa abantu ko mu gihe cyose ubayeho neza uzi ko hari abari hafi yawe babayeho nabi, jya umenya ko nta mutekano ufite.” Yakomeje agira ati “Muri iyi ndirimbo, nifuje kuvuga ku mibereho y’abana bo mu muhanda. Ikibazo cy’abana bo mu muhanda, si icyabo gusa, si icy’abababyaye bonyine, ahubwo ni icyacu twese. Muri iyi ndirimbo nagaragaje ko abakora ibyaha bashobora kubashora mu byangiza cyangwa ibibangamira imibereho yacu kandi twajyaga tubanyuraho tukumva ibibazo barimo bitatureba.” Yakomeje agira inama abantu ko guhura n’ubuzima bugoye atari igisubizo cyo kwishora mu byaha. Yashatse kumvisha abantu babona abana baba mu muhanda nk’abatagifite igaruriro ko atari byo. Muri iyi ndirimbo atangamo urugero rugaragaza uko ibyihebe , byashimuse aba bana bikabigisha kwiba, kwica no gusahura, ariko umwe akabyanga nubwo nta mahitamo yari afite. Akababwira ko adashobora kubikora. Ben Nganji yamamaye mu ndirimbo zitandukanye zirimo “Mbonye umusaza”, “Nsazanye inzara”, “Rehema”, “Habe n’akabizu” n’izindi. Uretse kuririmba, Ben Nganji yamamaye no mu nkirigito. Iyi ni inganzo y’umwihariko yahimbye, ni izinga rizingiyemo igitwenge gituruka mu ruhererekane rw’amagambo, ahindagurikira mu nteko z’amazina. Inkirigito itera gutwenga, ikubiyemo inyigisho haba izo mu Rwanda no mu bindi bice by’Isi, haba mu gihe cyashize n’ikizaza.

title: Platini yasohoye indirimbo “Veronika” ikubiyemo amagambo yumvikana nk’acyurira uwahoze ari umukunzi we
content: Muri iyi ndirimbo Platini atangira agira ati ”Veronika wibwiraga ko nugenda ukansiga bazanseka, yamashagaga yawe yagiye he, ya mababa yatumaga uguruka yarapfutse? […] ntiwamenye ko uzankumbura iby’Isi ni amabanga snapchat, Instagram nta post nkibona ntugitwika, Veronika ko ntakubona ntugitwika? ko wakonje[…] ko wakonje?” Uyu muhanzi akomeza agira ati” Icyo nari nkumariye urakizi n’abagushutse barahari mu kibuga wabanzagamo cumi n’umwe ntuburemo no mu basimbura sinkikubona […]” Mu mashusho y’iyi ndirimbo uyu muhanzi agaragazamo inkuru y’umukobwa baba bakundana agashukishwa ibintu ndetse n’amafaranga nawe akararuka akamwanga ariko naho agiye ntibimare kabiri bagatandukana. Wumvise iyi ndirimbo ukaba uzi neza amateka ya Platini na Diane mu rukundo nta kabuza wahita utekereza ko ariwe yabwiraga. Uyu muhanzi icyakora ahakana amakuru avuga ko yacyuriraga uwahoze ari umukunzi we, agahamya ko atamuvuga nabi kuko nubwo batandukanye mu rukundo ariko bakiri inshuti. Ati” Ntabwo nakwitukira umuntu twakundanye, ni inshuti yanjye nawe arabizi ntabwo ariwe naririmbaga rwose.” Itandukana rya Platini n’uwari umukunzi we ryabaye inkuru ikomeye cyane mu itangazamakuru ndetse no ku mbuga nkoranyambaga zitandukanye z’abakurikiranira hafi imyidagaduro mu Rwanda cyane ko aba bari bamaze igihe bakundana ndetse mu 2017 ubwo batandukanaga benshi mu babakurikira bari baratangiye gutekereza ku bukwe bwabo. Iyi ndirimbo ibaye iya mbere Platini asohoye nyuma yuko mugenzi we baririmbanaga mu itsinda rya Dream Boys, TMC agiye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ndetse bikanavugwa ko batandukanye buri wese akaba agiye gutangira kwikorera ku giti cye. Ni indirimbo ya gatatu Platini akoze mu gihe gito atari kumwe na TMC nyuma ya “Ya motema” yakoranye na Nel Ngabo na Fata amano yakoranye na Safi Madiba. Reba iyi ndirimbo nshya ya Platini Nemeye wamaze kwiha akazina ka "P"

title: Inkuru y’urukundo rwa Iyakare na Nyirandayishimiye bahujwe no gucuranga igisope mu kabari
content: Iri tsinda abarizi bakunze kubonamo umugabo w’ibigango ufite igikara gisa neza n’umusatsi mwinshi uzi gucuranga ibikoresho hafi ya byose bya muzika akagerekaho no kuririmba. Uyu mugabo aririmbana n’umugore we ufite ijwi ryihariye akanagira ubuhanga mu gucuranga gitari. Uwo mugabo yitwa Iyakare Wenceslas [Rickson] akaba umuyobozi wanashinze iri tsinda, ribarizwamo n’umugore we Consolée Nyirandashimye. Bamaze imyaka ibiri babana nk’umugore n’umugabo ndetse banamaze kwibaruka imfura z’impanga. Mu kiganiro na IGIHE, Iyakare yavuze ko ahura bwa mbere n’umugore we byari mu 2018 ubwo yamusangaga ari gucuranga mu kabari. Ati “Nari nsanzwe muzi kuri Youtube acuranga inanga, umunsi umwe ari ku wa Gatanu sinari nakoze, nanjye nsohoka nk’abandi basore, icyo gihe aho nari nasohokeye nahasanze umwana w’umukobwa ucuranga neza ngira igitekerezo cyo kumuzana mu itsinda nari mfite.” Nyuma yo kuzana Nyirandayishimiye mu itsinda rye, hagati ye na Iyakare urukundo rwatangiye kuziramo, birangira biyemeje kubana. Ati “Hashize nk’amezi atandatu byaje guhinduka bizamo urukundo duhita twiyemeza kubana.” Nyirandayishimiye avuga ko na we ubwo yageraga mu itsinda rya Iyakare yari yaramaze gufatwa n’ubwiza bw’uwo musore ndetse n’imico ye byatumye birangira bakundanye. Yaba umugabo cyangwa umugore bemeza ko kuba bakorana bibafasha mu kazi kabo, bakajya inama y’uko bakanoza biboroheye. Nyirandayishimiye yize umuziki mu ishuri rya muzika rya Nyundo akaba umwe mu mfura zaryo mu gihe Iyakare na we yawize ahantu hatandukanye harimo Kigali Music School no mu mujyi wa Kampala muri Uganda. Kugeza ubu batunzwe no gukora umuziki ndetse bavuga ko ubuzima bwabo mirongo inani ku ijana babufashwamo n’ibyo bakura mu muziki. His voice band mu minsi ishize yitabiriye irushanwa ry’amatsinda y’abacuranzi ryateguwe na Marriott Hotel bitwara neza kuko nubwo bategukanye igihembo ariko bari mu bageze mu byiciro bya nyuma. Ikiganiro n’abagize umuryango utunzwe no gucuranga icyo benshi bita "Igisope"

title: Shaddyboo watangiye umushinga wo guteka, yasubije abamutuka anasobanura amashusho yafashwe muri Miss Rwanda 2020
content: Mbabazi Shadia benshi bamenye nka Shaddyboo ni umwe mu bakurikirwa cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Uyu mushinga yatangije ni uwo guteka ndetse agacuruza ibiryo ku babikenera bya buri munsi. Mu kiganiro na IGIHE yagize ati” Ni ibintu nsanzwe nkunda, mu minsi ishize nibwo niyemeje kubikora nkanabishakamo amafaranga kuko nari umutetsi mwiza noneho abantu bantera imbaraga zo kubigira umwuga.” Shaddyboo kugeza ubu yatangiye kujya atekera mu rugo agashyira abantu ibyo kurya aho bakorera cyangwa mu ngo zabo. Ibijyanye n’ibiciro ndetse n’amakuru arambuye kuri ubu bucuruzi azayatangaza ku wa mbere tariki 8 Kamena 2020 binyuze ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Shaddyboo avuga ko icyorezo cya Covid-19 nikirangira azafungura restaurant aho noneho abantu bazamenya aho bajya bafatira amafunguro yateguwe na we. Abajijwe umwihariko w’amafunguro ye yagize ati” Njye ngira urukundo, nzi guteka ibaze rero ibiryo bitetse neza birimo n’urukundo rwanjye. Ndabizi bazabikunda.” Shaddyboo ari mu bakurikirwa ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ndetse avuga ko ari byo bimutunze Shaddyboo avuga ko kuba ari mu bakurikirwa cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga bimufasha cyane mu buzima bwa buri munsi kuko abikoramo ubucuruzi ndetse bukaba aribwo bumutunze. Ati “Nibyo bintunze njye iyo nshyize amafoto yamamaza kuri Instagram n’izindi mbuga nkoranyambaga nkoresha ndinjiza, bimfasha kubona akazi ko kujya mu mashusho y’indirimbo z’abahanzi kandi byose bimpa ubushobozi bwo kubaho.” Kugeza ubwo twandikaga iyi nkuru Shaddyboo yari akurikiwe n’abarenga ibihumbi 715 kuri Instagram. Yasubije abakunda kumutuka avuga ko bamufata uko atari Shaddyboo yavuze ko kenshi abantu bakunda kumutuka ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ariko ahamya ko abenshi ari abamwibeshyaho. Ati” Njye mba ndi gushaka amafaranga abamvuga nabi bo ntacyo baba bambwiye kuko icyo mba nshaka mba nkizi, ariko kandi nanjye ndi umuntu ndababara iyo mbibonye, ariko se kuki natinda ku muntu unyanga kandi nziko hari abandi bankunda? Iyo mbibonye gutyo mpita nkureka nkikomereza ibyanjye n’abankunda.” Shaddyboo icyakora avuga ko hari igihe abantu barengera kuko hari ubwo basohora n’amashusho y’abantu bambaye ubusa cyangwa bari mu busambanyi bakabimwitirira nyamara atari we. Yagize ati” Abantu bajye bibuka ko ndi umubyeyi, nabo bazabyara. Ese kuki umuntu yashimishwa no kugushyira ku karubanda? Kuki umuntu atatekereza ku bana banjye, ese nk’umubyeyi cyangwa umuntu uzabyara uba wumva ukoze neza? Ni ukuri nta muntu udakosa wenda nanjye ndakosa ariko ntibagakabye rwose.” Icyakora yibukije abamwanga n’abakunda kumutuka ko ntacyo bimutwara ahubwo bimufasha. Ati” Iyo muntuka cyangwa mumvuga nabi njye ntacyo biba bimbwiye kuko abankurikira ntibasiba kwiyongera kandi nibo batuma mbona akazi kuko nakubwiye ko ntunzwe no gukoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga.” Yavuze ku mashusho yafashwe mu birori Miss Rwanda 2020 bikavugwa ko yari yasinze Mu birori bya Miss Rwanda 2020, Shaddyboo yasizemo inkuru kubera ukuntu yabyinnye n’ukuntu yishimiye gutsinda kwa Naomie Nishimwe. Shaddyboo wavuzweho kuba yari yasinze abandi bakamwita umusazi yahishuye ko yari yishimiye uko ibirori byari byiza, uko uwo yafanaga yatsinze ariko by’umwihariko ngo yari yishimiye ko atsinze intego yari yagiranye n’inshuti ze. Ati” Njye nirirwaga mu mpaka n’abantu hano, buriya nari nateze nabo. Rero ibaze umuntu ufana atsinze noneho ukaba wariye n’intego mu birori byari bimeze kuriya.” Ibibazo by’amatsiko wakwibaza kuri Shaddyboo Urukundo rwe na Diamond, Shaddyboo yavuze ko nta rwigeze rubaho ahubwo ko ari inshuti bisanzwe, “Diamond ni inshuti yanjye ikomeye mufata nk’umuvandimwe kubera ukuntu amfasha.” Shaddyboo nubwo ari umubyeyi w’abana babiri yabyaranye na Meddy Saleh, ari mu rukundo n’undi mugabo. Ati ” Mfite undi mukunzi, ntabwo aba mu Rwanda ariko si umuhanzi Shaffy nkuko benshi babitekereza cyangwa bajya babivuga ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Shaffy ni inshuti yanjye isanzwe ntabwo dukundana.” Shaddyboo nubwo adashyize imbere ibyo gukora ubukwe avuga ko Imana nimufasha azabukora kuko niba ariwo mugambi wayo ntaho yabikwepera. Ubusanzwe uyu mubyeyi yahishuye ko yishimira gutembera, guteka, kwambara neza ndetse no kubyina. Mu Rwanda ni umufana wa Bruce Melodie na Yvan Buravan, muri Afurika ni umufana wa Wizkid naho ku Isi akunda bikomeye Chris Brown.

title: Yvan Buravan uri gukora kuri album ye ya kabiri, yasohoye indirimbo ye nshya yise “Low key”
content: Uyu muhanzi nyuma yo kwegukana igihembo cya Prix Decouvertes akaza no kumurika Album ye ya mbere yakoze ibitaramo birenga icumi mu bihugu bitandukanye bya Afurika. Nyuma y’ibi bitaramo yafashe ikiruhuko yari amazemo igihe mbere yuko atangira gukora kuri album ye ya kabiri, kuri ubu Yvan Buravan yatangiye gusohora indirimbo ziyigize cyane ko ayigeze kure. Ubwo bashyiraga hanze iyi ndirimbo nshya bise “Low key” uyu muhanzi yagize ati ”Nyuma yo kumurika Album ‘The love lab’ byanagenze neza, n’ibitaramo nitabiriye nyuma yo kwegukana igihembo cya Prix Decouvertes, nafashe icyemezo cyo gufata akaruhuko no gukora ku yindi mishinga itandukanye. Kuri ubu ngarukanye indirimbo nshya ikaba imwe mu ziri kuri Album yanjye ya kabiri.” Iyi ndirimbo nshya ikubiyemo amagambo y’urukundo n’ubundi uyu ukaba ariwo mujyo uyu muhanzi azwiho mu gukora ibihangano bye. Yumvikana asaba umukobwa baba bakundana kumuha urukundo ntakindi yitayeho kuko iyo bakundana aryoherwa n’uko babanye, ni indirimbo iririmbye mu ndimi enye arizo Ikinyarwanda, Igifaransa, Igiswahili ndetse n’Icyongereza. Indirimbo “Low Key” Yvan Buravan mu buryo bw’amajwi yakozwe na Bob Pro mu gihe amashusho yayo yo yafashwe anatunganywa na Dric Ent. Kompanyi y’umusore uzwi cyane mu gufatira abahanzi amashusho magufi yaba mu bitaramo no mu bindi birori. Reba "Low Key" indirimbo nshya ya Yvan Buravan

title: Nelly Kelba, umuhanzi mushya uhanze amaso isoko mpuzamahanga
content: Uyu musore yatangiye gukora umuziki we mu ntangiriro za 2019. Mbere yari asanzwe ari umuririmbyi wa karaoke aho yakoranaga na band no mu bindi birori bitandukanye nk’ubukwe. Ubusanzwe yitwa Dusingizimana Clebert Nelly. Yavukiye mu Karere ka Rubavu, atuye i Kigali ari naho akorera umuziki we wibanda ku njyana ya RnB, Afro-Zouk na Afropop. Aherutse icyiciro cya Kabiri muri kaminuza mu Ishami ry’Ikoranabuhanga. Yabwiye IGIHE ko intego ye mu muziki ari ugukora cyane akamenyekanisha impano ye ikagera kure ikanamubyarira umusaruro. Ati “Ikintu cya mbere numva nshyize imbere ni ugukora ibihangano bifasha benshi mu Rwanda. Nshaka gukora umuziki ku buryo nzagera ku isoko mpuzamahanga, ntabwo byoroshye ariko niyo ntumbero yanjye.” Yemeza ko n’ubwo atari yatangira gusarura mu muziki ariko yizeye ko uko iminsi izagenda yicuma ariwo azakora ukaba akazi ke ka buri munsi kamutunze we n’umuryango we. Aheruka gushyira hanze indirimbo nshya yitwa ‘Ndatuje’ irimo amagambo y’urukundo agaragaza uburyo umuntu atuza iyo yahisemo neza umukunzi bazabana kugeza gupfa. Akaba agira Inama abashaka abakunzi kubanza gushishoza kuko ibishashagirana siko byose biba Ari zahabu. Amajwi yayo yatunganyirijwe muri Touch music akorwa na Trackslyayer, mu gihe amashusho yakozwe na Fab lab. Kugeza ubu afite indirimbo enye , harimo nk’iyitwa ‘Uzaperereze’ yakoranye na Mc Tino, ‘Ijana Ku Ijana’, ‘Guaranty’ ndetse na ‘Ndatuje’ aheruka gushyira hanze.

title: Kylie Jenner ayoboye urutonde rw’abinjije amafaranga menshi mu 2019
content: Kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 4 Kamena 2020, Kylie Jenner nibwo yasohotse ku rutonde rw’ibyamamare byinjije amafaranga menshi ku isi. Ni ku rutonde ngarukamwaka rwa Forbes ariko iki kinyamakuru gisanzwe cyandika ku bijyanye n’imari kivuga n’ubundi bitamugira umwe mu batunze Miliyari nk’uko cyari cyabitangaje. Nk’uko Forbes yabivuze, Kylie Jenner w’imyaka 22 y’amavuko yinjije miliyoni 590 z’amadolari mu mwaka ushize bitewe ahanini na Coty Inc. yaguze imigabane 51% ya Kylie Cosmetics muri Mutarama umwaka ushize. Yayigurishije miliyoni 600 z’amadolari, bituma yinjiza miliyoni 540 z’amadolari mbere yo kwishyura umusoro. Kuri uru rutonde rw’ibyamamare 10 byinjije agatubutse ahuriramo na muramu we Kanye West winjije Miliyoni $170, akurikirwa n’abakinnyi nka Roger Federer winjije miliyoni $106.3, Cristiano Ronaldo winjije miliyoni $105 million, Lionel Messi winjije miliyoni $104 million, Tyler Perry wabonye miliyoni $97 , Neymar winjije miliyoni $95.5, Howard Stern winjije miliyoni $90, LeBron James winjije miliyoni $88.2 na Dwayne Johnson (The Rock) winjije miliyoni $87.5. Mu cyumweru gishize, Forbes yari yasohoye inkuru igaragaza ko Kylie Jenner yabeshye iki kinyamakuru ko atunze arenga miliyari y’amadolari kikamugira umwe mu bakiri bato bayitunze mu 2018. Icyo gihe uyu mukobwa yabyamaganiye kure avuga ko ataribyo.

title: Kanye West yatanze miliyoni $2, anemera kurihira ishuri umwana wa George Floyd
content: Kuva mu byumweru hafi bibiri bishize, ibihumbi by’abaturage bo muri Leta zitandukanye muri Amerika bari mu myigaragambyo ikomeye yo kwamagana urupfu rwa George Floyd. Ku mugoroba wo ku wa Kane, tariki 4 Kamena 2020, nibwo ibyamamare bitandukanye byasezeye bwa nyuma kuri nyakwigendera. Kanye West ari mu bitabiriye imyigaragambyo yo kwamagana akarengane n’ihohoterwa rikorerwa abirabura muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika yabanjirije ibikorwa byo kumusezeraho. Saa kumi n’ebyiri zirengaho iminota mike z’umugoroba nibwo Kanye West n’ikipe y’abo bari kumwe biganjemo abashinzwe kumurindira umutekano bageze aho abigaragambyaga bari bari muri Chicago. Yifatanyije n’abanyeshuri basabaga ubuyobozi bw’ibigo guhagarika amasezerano n’imikoranire bagirana na Polisi ya Chicago. Kanye West yatanze miliyoni ebyiri z’amadolari, anemera gufasha umwana wa nyakwigendera kugeza arangije amashuri. Iyi nkunga yatanzwe na Kanye West, ikubiyemo amafaranga azishyura umusanzu w’abanyamategeko ku miryango ya Arbery ndetse na Taylor, hamwe n’ ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi by’abirabura bidahagaze neza. Hashyizweho kandi gahunda y’uburezi izafasha umwana w’umukobwa wa Floyd, Gianna Floyd ufite imyaka itandatu kuba yasoza amashuri ye yose. Usibye Kanye West, abantu batandukanye bakomeje gufasha umuryango wa nyakwigendera. Urugero ni aho ku rubuga rwa Go Fund rukusanyirizwaho inkunga yo gufasha abantu hari hatekerejwe gukusanya 1 500 000 y’amadorari ya Amerika kuri ubu hakaba hamaze kuboneka arenga miliyoni $10. Ku wa 23 Gashyantare, nibwo umwirabura Arbery yarashwe mu gihe yarimo akora imyitozo ngororamubiri hanze ahitwa Brunswick, GA. Abagabo batatu b’ Abera barafunzwe bahorwa urupfu rwe. Ni mu gihe Taylor we yishwe muri Werurwe arashwe inshuro nibura zigera ku munani, ubwo abapolisi batatu bari binjiye aho atuye muri Kentucky ku mbaraga. Ibintu byaje kuba bibi abantu barahumuka nyuma yuko ku wa 25, Gicurasi George Floyd yapfaga azize umupolisi wari wamunize akoresheje ivi hafi iminota 9, bikaza kumuviramo urupfu. Urupfu rwa Floyd rwamaganwe n’ibihumbi by’Abanyamerika ndetse birenga umupaka w’icyo gihugu bigera n’ahandi ku Isi, abatari bake bamagana ihohoterwa rikorerwa abirabura, rimwe na rimwe bikabaviramo gupfa. Umuhango wo gusezera kuri George Floyd witabiriwe n’abanyacyubahiro batandukanye barimo Meya wa Minneapolis, Jacob Frey na Senateri Amy Klobuchar. Uyu muhango kandi witabiriwe na Martin Luther King III, imfura y’umugabo wamenyekanye cyane mu guharanira uburenganzira bw’abirabura muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Martin Luther King Jr. Umunyarwenya Kevin Hart n’umuraperi Ludacris ni bamwe mu byamamare byagiye gusezera kuri George Floyd.

title: Data ni we wa mbere wishwe na COVID-19 mu Rwanda! Producer Fayzo yiyemeje kurwanya Coronavirus
content: Minisiteri y’Ubuzima yatangaje ko uwitabye Imana ari umushoferi w’imyaka 65 wari utuye mu gihugu cy’abaturanyi, wahisemo gutaha mu Rwanda nyuma yo kuremba. Yakomeje iti "Yitaweho n’abaganga mu kigo cyagenewe kuvura Coronavirus. Ariko yaje gupfa azize kwangirika imyanya y’ubuhumekero." Uyu mugabo inzego z’ubuzima ntizigeze zitangaza imyirondoro ye gusa amakuru yageraga ku IGIHE ni uko ari umubyeyi wa Tuyishime Faycal Hassan wamenyekanye cyane nka Fayzo mu gutunganya amashusho y’indirimbo z’abahanzi. Fayzo yasangije IGIHE inkuru y’uburwayi bw’umubyeyi we, uko yiyumvaga agitangira kurembera muri Tanzania n’uko yoherejwe mu gihugu cye cyamwibarutse. Yagize ati "Yavuye muri Tanzania azi ko arwaye Malariya, ageze mu Rwanda bamubonyemo ibimenyetso bya Coronavirus bahita bamujyana i Kanyinya bagerageza kumwitaho ariko nyine biza kwanga yitaba Imana.” Fayzo ni we wasigaye mu rugo ari mukuru mu muryango ndetse anafite inshingano zo kuwitaho kuko na nyina yitabye Imana mu 2017. Yiyemeje kongera imbaraga mu guhangana na COVID-19 yamugize imfubyi Fayzo yari yaratangiye ibikorwa byo kurwanya COVID-19 iterwa n’agakoko gashya ka Coronavirus ategura ibikorwa byo kuyirwanya binyuze mu ndirimbo yakoreye abahanzi batandukanye. Nyuma yo kubura se umubyara kubera Coronavirus yiyemeje gukomeza kwigisha Abanyarwanda ububi bwayo. Ati “Nari nabitangiye mbere ariko ubu nibwo ngiye gushyiramo imbaraga nyinshi bitewe n’akazi nkora. Nzafatanya n’ibyamamare binyuranye mu rwego rwo gukangurira Abanyarwanda kwirinda COVID-19.’’ Yashimye Leta y’u Rwanda yashyize imbaraga mu gufata ingamba zo kwirinda ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus. Fayzo yavuze ko nk’Umunyarwanda uzi ububi bwa Coronavirus na we akwiye gutanga umusanzu wihariye mu kuyihashya. Yagize ati “Wenda abantu bagiye bahura n’ingaruka zavuye kuri iki cyorezo ariko njye ho birarenze kuko yanyiciye umubyeyi; bivuze ko ndi mu bumva uburibwe bukomeye bwayo, niyo mpamvu nahagurutse mfata icyemezo cyo kuyirwanya nivuye inyuma. Fayzo mu magambo ye yumvikanisha ko yakiriye inkuru y’urupfu rwa se ndetse yanatangiye n’akazi. Uyu mugabo ari mu nyigo z’imishinga itandukanye y’uburyo yakoramo ubukangurambaga bugaragaza ubukana bwa COVID-19 ku buryo mu minsi mike cyane aba yatangiye kubukora. Mu butumwa bwe yasabye Abanyarwanda kwirinda icyorezo cya Coronavirus bakurikiza amabwiriza yose y’inzego z’ubuzima mu Rwanda; yanibukije by’umwihariko urubyiruko kureka kugikerensa. Ati “Hari benshi batekereza ko iyi ndwara itabaho, hari n’abadatinya kuvuga ko ntacyo itwara uwayirwaye. Njye wabuze uwanjye kubera yo ngomba kugerageza gufatanya na Leta mu bukangurambaga bwo kugaragaza ubukana bwayo no gufasha Abanyarwanda kumva neza uko bayirinda.” Abaturarwanda muri rusange basabwa gukomeza kubahiriza amabwiriza ya Leta hitabwa cyane cyane ku gukaraba intoki kenshi n’amazi n’isabune, kwambara udupfukamunwa n’amazuru mu gihe umuntu avuye mu rugo cyangwa ahuye n’abantu benshi. Kuva umurwayi wa mbere wa COVID-19 iterwa n’agakoko gashya ka Coronavirus agaragaye mu Rwanda ku wa 13 Werurwe 2020, hamaze kuboneka 410 banduye mu bipimo 72 510 bimaze gufatwa, 280 barayikize mu gihe 128 bakirwaye naho babiri bitabye Imana. Ibimenyetso bya Coronavirus birimo inkorora, ibicurane, guhumeka bigoranye n’umuriro. Yandura binyuze mu matembabuzi aturuka mu myanya y’ubuhumekero. Ikiganiro na Fayzo uherutse kubura se umubyara wishwe na Coronavirus

title: Princess Priscilla “Scillah” yasohoye indirimbo ikubiyemo inkuru mpamo y’inshuti ye yahiriwe n’urushako
content: Mutima ni indirimbo ikubiyemo ubutumwa bw’urukundo igaragaza umuntu wihebeye undi mu buryo bukomeye. Hari aho uyu mukobwa aririmba ati “Umwe mu myanzuro nafashe ntazigera nicuza ni ukuguha umutima wanjye ngo uwuyobore wibere uwawe, butunzi ntabara, rukundo ntahara, sinibona udahari kukubura biragatsindwa. Ubuzima bufite injyana kuko ndi kumwe nawe mukunzi.” Avuga kuri iyi ndirimbo Scillah yahishuye ko ishingiye ku nkuru mpamo y’ubuzima bw’urukundo bw’inshuti ye. Ati “Iyi ndirimbo ni inkuru mpamo y’inshuti yanjye, yari amaze igihe kingana n’umwaka ashyingiwe twari turi kuganira ambwira ukuntu Imana yamugiriye ubuntu agashaka neza. Umugabo yashatse ngo aricara akumva ni umutima we uterera hanze y’umubiri.” “Hari amafoto angaragaza ntwite mu mashusho y’iyi ndirimbo, yo asobanura uko nyuma yaho baje kwibaruka umwana mwiza cyane w’umuhungu, yishimye cyane agereranya umwana we n’umutima we. Iyi ndirimbo nyituye umuntu wese wumva undi yaba umutware we cyangwa umwana yibarutse ari umutima we kuko ababashije kugirirwa ubuntu bwo kwibaruka cyangwa gushaka neza ni uko baba biyumva.” Mu minsi ishize uyu muhanzikazi yavuze ko atari we uzabona igihe kigeze ngo akorere igitaramo mu Rwanda yishimane n’abakunzi b’ibihangano bye dore ko yigaruriye benshi. Scillah wari uherutse gushyira hanze indirimbo yise ’Ihumure’ yavuze ko agiye gusohora indirimbo nyinshi. Album ye ya mbere izaba iriho indirimbo zakozwe n’aba-Producers batandukanye barimo Lick Lick, Umunya-Kenya Giggz n’abandi batandukanye. Uyu muhanzikazi yakunzwe mu Rwanda mu ndirimbo nka ‘Icyo Mbarusha’, ‘Nka Paradizo’, ‘Ntacyadutanya yafatanyije na The Ben’, ‘Nkeneye Umukunzi’, ‘Itangazo’, ‘Mbabarira’ n’izindi nyinshi zitandukanye. Yerekeje muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika tariki ya 6 Kanama 2013 aho yagiye gukomereza amasomo ye ya kaminuza. Yiga ibijyanye n’inozabubanyi (International Relations) gusa nyuma yaje kuvangamo n’ibijyanye n’umuziki aho azarangiza kwiga muri uyu mwaka.

title: Mico The Best agiye kugirana ikiganiro n’Umuyobozi ushinzwe kurwanya Igituntu muri OMS
content: Ibi biganiro bije nyuma y’aho Mico The Best muri Mutarama 2020 yatangaje ku mugaragaro ko yinjiye mu bukangurambaga bwo kurwanya indwara y’Igituntu. Ikiganiro Mico The Best azagirana na Dr Lucica Ditiu ushinzwe kurwanya igituntu muri OMS kizaba kigamije kurebera hamwe uko Igituntu cyifashe muri ibi bihe bya COVID-19. Mico azagirana ibiganiro n’uyu muyobozi nk’uwafashe iya mbere mu kurwanya Igituntu mu Rwanda, wanamaze kwemerwa ku rwego rw’igihugu. Ibi biganiro bitegerejwe ku wa 11 Kamena 2020 saa kumi z’umugoroba mu Rwanda no mu Busuwisi bikazanyuzwa ku rukuta rwa Facebook rwa “Stop TB”. Ibi biganiro bije nyuma yuko Mico The Best asubitse ibikorwa yari yateganyije byo kurwanya Igituntu binyuze mu bitaramo yagombaga gukora bizenguruka igihugu. Mico The Best yahagaritse ibi bitaramo nyuma yuko icyorezo cya COVID-19 cyari kimaze kugera mu Rwanda ndetse hatangiye no gukazwa ingamba zo kucyirinda. Uhujimfura Claude, umwe mu bayobozi ba KIKAC Music ihagarariye inyungu za Mico The Best yavuze ko nyuma y’uko iki cyorezo kizaba kigenjeje make bazasubukura ibi bitaramo byo guhangana n’Igituntu.

title: Clarisse Karasira yakoze indirimbo ikubiyemo inkuru mpamo y’abajya gushakira ubuzima mu mahanga
content: Yabwiye IGIHE ko ari indirimbo yatuye abantu bose basize iwabo bakajya gushakira ubuzima ahandi cyane cyane hanze y’u Rwanda. Ati “‘Uwacu’ ni Indirimbo ituwe abantu basize iwabo bakajya gushakira ubuzima ahandi cyane cyane mu mahanga. Ni inkuru mpamo yanjye nakuye ku buzima inshuti zanjye ziba mu mahanga zibamo. Iributsa urukundo rw’umuryango igatanga intashyo kuri ba ‘Uwacu’ ibakumbuza iwabo.” Iyi ndirimbo nshya yise ‘Uwacu’ mu buryo bw’amajwi yakozwe na Evydecks naho amashusho yayo afatwa na Fefe faith. Karasira yavukiye i Masaka mu Mujyi wa Kigali, yiga amashuri mu bigo binyuranye arangiza ayisumbuye mu ndimi. Kaminuza yize Itangazamakuru muri Mount Kenya University. Nyuma y’umwaka umwe yaje kurisubika atangira kwiga ibijyanye na Politiki Mpuzamahanga muri ULK ubu ari mu mwaka wa kabiri. Uyu mukobwa yatangiriye itangazamakuru i Gicumbi kuri Radio Ishingiro, akomereza kuri Flash Fm na Flash Tv ahakora igihe kitari gito aza gusezera muri Kanama 2018 ubwo yatekerezaga kwinjira mu muziki. Clarisse Karasira yakoze indirimbo zitandukanye zakunzwe zirimo ‘Gira neza’, ‘Twapfaga Iki?’, ‘Ubuto’, ‘Kabeho’, ‘Imitamenwa’, ‘Ntizagushuke’, ‘Uzibukirwa kuki?” n’izindi. Reba indirimbo nshya ya Karasira

title: Diamond Platnumz yanze gutanga indezo y’umwana we na Tanasha
content:
Mu ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka nibwo Tanasha yafashe umwanzuro wo kuva muri Tanzania aho yabanaga mu nzu imwe na Diamond, azinga utwe asubira iwabo muri Kenya we n’umuhungu yabyaranye n’uyu muhanzi witwa Naseeb Junior. Nyuma yo gutandukana, Diamond ntabwo yakunze kumvikana mu itangazamakuru avuga ku by’urukundo rwe n’uyu mukobwa; gusa umukobwa we yagiye agaragaza ubutumwa bwerekana ko yashavuzwe n’uyu mugabo. Mu kiganiro cya mu gitondo kuri Milele FM, Tanasha yumvikanye agaragaza ko ubu ari kurera umwana wenyine. Umunyamakuru yamubajije niba Diamond amufasha kurera umwana undi mu gusubiza ati “ Ushatse kuvuga mu buryo bw’amafaranga se ? maze igihe mbikora byose njyenyine, mvugishije ukuri. Ndaza kuba umunyakuri 100% kuri wowe, ntabwo ngiye kuvuga ibintu bitari byo. Ku cyubahiro cyose mugomba kandi nkaba ntafite inda y’umujinya kuri we; Oya ntari kumfasha ndi kubyikorera byose ku bwanjye.” Yakomeje avuga ko atanakeneye ko Diamond amufasha kurera umwana, mu magambo ye ati “Ntabwo nkeneye ko amfasha mvugishije ukuri, ndi kurera umwana wanjye neza. Nta kindi, umuhungu wacu ameze neza mu buzima bwe nicyo cy’ingenzi.” Diamond yabaye iciro ry’imigani mu kutita ku bana be
 Zari umwaka ushize mu butumwa bwari buhekejwe n’amashusho yasobanuye ukuntu Diamond Platnumz yirengagije inshingano za kibyeyi, akaba atagikozwa ibyo kuvugana n’abana babyaranye (Prince Nillan na Tiffah Dangote) kuri telefoni, kandi hari n’igihe umukobwa we (Tiffah) ajya arira avuga ko ashaka kuvugana na se ntibikunde kubera ko uyu muhanzi yabateye umugongo. Ntabwo bwari ubwa mbere Diamond ashinjwa ibintu nk’ibi kuko n’umwana yabyaranye na Hamisa Mobetto yabanje kumwihakana, yanamwemera akamara igihe ajyanwa mu nkiko kubera kudatanga indezo, yagera aho akava ku izima. Mu gihe Tanasha yari atwite, Zari yamwishongoyeho amubwira ko ashatse atategereza ko Diamond azamufasha kurera umwana bazabyarana none nibyo biri kumubaho uyu munsi.

title: Ngabo Evy wageze kure muri ArtRwanda – Ubuhanzi yashyize hanze indirimbo nshya
content: Iyi ndirimbo nshya ya Ngabo yise ‘Mr Lover’ ni iya gatatu mu zo amaze gukora kuva yatangira urugendo rw’ubuhanzi. Ije ikurikira iyitwa ‘Ntibizasubira’ yo kwibuka ndetse na ‘Nkwihoreze’. Yabwiye IGIHE ko iyi ndirimbo ye nshya yayihimbye atekereza ku musore usezeranya umukobwa ko azamubera mwiza, akamuryohereza mu rugendo rwabo rw’urukundo. Ati “Iyi ndirimbo yanjye nshya nayanditse ntekereza ku musore usaba umukunzi we urukundo amusezeranya ko azamubera mwiza.” Uyu musore wari umaze igihe adakora indirimbo yari ahugiye mu mishinga irimo na Studio ye nshya yise ‘Evvy Music’ yanakorewemo iyi ndirimbo ye nshya. Ngabo Evy ubusanzwe yitwa Ngabo Evode. Yavutse ku itariki 4 Mata 1996. Yatangiye urugendo rw’umuziki mu 2018, ni umucuranzi wa ‘piano,’ ‘guitar,’ ‘umwirongi’ akabihuza no kuririmba. Ngabo akiri umwana yakundaga kurema amatsinda mu bana biganaga akabigisha kuririmba indirimbo yandikaga ariko aza gutungurwa ageze mu mashuri yisumbuye. Muri icyo gihe yatangiye kubona ko uko yaririmbaga biciriritse abitewe n’abandi banyempano mu kuririmba yagiye abona bituma afata umwanzuro wo gutangira bundi bushya agaha icyerekezo ubuhanzi bwe. Yize icyiciro Rusange muri Groupe Scolaire Officiel de Butare aba ari naho asoreza amashuri yisumbuye mu Ishami ry’Imibare, Ubugenge n’Ubutabire [MPC]. Aha niho yigiye ubumenyi bw’ibanze mu gucuranga ibicurangisho byinshi. Yize Ikoranabuhanga muri Kaminuza ya Jomo Kenyatta yafunzwe burundu mu Rwanda bituma aba umwe mu bacikirije amasomo. Ngabo yigeze kubwira IGIHE ko urufatiro rw’ubumenyi bwisumbuye afite mu muziki akora ubu ari ubumenyi bundi yavomye kuri ‘internet’ aho yigiye byimbitse gucuranga no kuba yakora umuziki mu buryo bw’umwuga. Nta rindi shuri ryihariye yabyizemo nubwo agaragaza impano idasanzwe. Uyu musore asanzwe afite Band bakorana yitwa ‘Umurage Live Band’. Reba indirimbo nshya ya Ngabo Evy yise ’Mr Lover’

title: Ubuhamya bwa Olga Lorie, umuhanzikazi wavuye i Burundi agana mu Rwanda kuhashakira amaronko (Video)
content: Mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE yavuze ko yatangiye aririmba zihimbaza ndetse agakorana n’abaramyi bakomeye mu gihugu cy’ivuko rye cy’u Burundi nyuma akaza gufata umwanzuro wo kubivamo. Ati “Natangiye ndirimbo zihimbaza Imana ndirimbana na Fortrant Bigirimana hagati yo mu 2007 na 2009. Nyuma njye mu itsinda ryitwa The Cousin na none ndongera ntangira kuririmbana na Lorilo indirimbo zitari nkeya rero nyuma mpita ninjira mu gucuranga muri band.” Uyu mukobwa yamamaye mu ndirimbo nyinshi iwabo mu Burundi zirimo iyitwa ‘Akarorero’, ariko ahita areka kuririmba nk’umuhanzi ku giti cye ahubwo ajya kuririmbana na Peace & Love bamamaye cyane mu ndirimbo ‘Ic’Imana Yifatanirije’ ayifasha mu bitaramo bitandukanye we n’abandi bagenzi be. Mu 2015 bahisemo gutandukana n’iri tsinda ryakunzwe cyane mu bihugu byo muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba baza mu Rwanda gushakisha ko babona aho bazajya baririmbira abantu muri ‘Karaoke’ ndetse no mu buryo bwa live music. Ati “Mu 2015 nibwo twafashe icyemezo cyo kureba twaza mu Rwanda, tukaza tukareba ibyo abandi bakora, icyo gihe Peace & Love twayisize mu Burundi. Twazanye n’abandi twafatanyaga muri iri tsinda, twaje turi abakobwa babiri n’abahungu bane. Twaje tuvuga tuti ikiba kibe kuko nta n’umuntu twari tuzi mu Rwanda.” Akomeza avuga byari bikomeye cyane bageze mu Rwanda. Babanje kuba muri Hotel igihe gito batangira kubona akazi nyuma banitabaza inshuti bagiye bahura nazo zirabacumbikira. Avuga ko hari igihe baryaga ubundi ntibarye kubera ko nta kintu babaga babonye. Ubu Olga Lorie wasaga n’uwaretse umuziki yawugarutsemo ndetse ahita indirimbo nshya. Arifuza gukorana n’abahanzi bakomeye bo mu Rwanda kugira ngo akomeze guhamya ibigwi bye. Reba indirimbo nshya ya Olga Lorie

title: Danny Vumbi ageze kure imyiteguro ya album nshya azamurikira kuri internet (Video)
content: Semivumbi Daniel uzwi nka Danny Vumbi yamenyekanye cyane mu ndirimbo zandikanye ubuhanga ariko ziri no mu mudiho wa Kinyafurika zirimo nka "Ni danger", "Ni uwacu", "Abana babi" n’izindi. Kuri ubu uyu mugabo ari mu myiteguro ikomeye yo kumurika album azashyira hanze mu ntangiriro za Nyakanga yifashishije imbuga nkoranyambaga. Mu myitozo Danny Vumbi ari gufatanya n’itsinda ry’abacuranzi rizwi nka Neptunez Band, rizamufasha mu gitaramo ari gutegura. Mu kiganiro na IGIHE uyu muhanzi yijeje Abanyarwanda kuzabona igitaramo cyiza. Yakomeje avuga ati ”Ndi gutegura ibintu byiza cyane, natangiye imyiteguro kare kandi yaba njye cyangwa abo turi gufatanya ndabizi ko tuzaha abakunzi b’umuziki igitaramo cyiza.” Danny Vumbi yavuze ko ateganya gukora igitaramo mu ntangiriro za Nyakanga 2020. Ati "Turi gutekereza tariki 4 Nyakanga 2020 ariko ntabwo turabyemeza, turacyashakisha igihe cyiza twabikorera tuzakomeza kubamenyesha.” Uyu muhanzi ahamya ko kumurika iyi album yifashishije imbuga nkoranyambaga byatewe n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus cyahinduye uburyo bifuzaga kubikoramo. Yagize ati “Twateganyaga ko muri Kanama 2020 nzajya kumurikira album yanjye mu Bufaransa no mu bindi bihugu by’u Burayi ibiganiro byari bigeze kure. Mu gihe twiteguraga gutangaza aya makuru hahise haduka icyorezo cya COVID-19 cyashegeshe ibijyanye n’imyidagaduro ku Isi yose, tubonye ko bitagishobotse nibwo twatekereje uko twabyitwaramo.” Nyuma yo kwicara bagatekereza bakabona ko bishobora kugorana ko ibitaramo batekerezaga byabaho, yaba Danny Vumbi n’abamufasha biyemeje kumurikira album ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Avuga ko ”Hari amakuru menshi tutaratangaza ariko tuzababwira mu minsi iri imbere kuko hari ibyo tucyumvikana n’abaterankunga nubwo hari abandi bari kwiyongera. Mu minsi mike amakuru yose kuri iki gitaramo cyo kumurika album turaza kuyabaha.” Byitezwe ko nta gihindutse muri iki gitaramo Danny Vumbi yafatanya n’abahanzi nka Bruce Melodie, Mico The Best na Riderman. Album Danny Vumbi yitegura kumurika yise “Inkuru nziza” ni iya gatatu agiye gushyira hanze nyuma ya “Umudendezo” yakoze mu 2012 na ”Kuri twese” yasohoye mu 2015. Ikiganiro na Danny Vumbi ugeze kure imyiteguro y’igitaramo cye

title: King James yifashishije Miss Mutoni Queen mu mashusho y’indirimbo ye nshya
content: Muri iyi ndirimbo King James yisanisha n’umusore ukundana n’umukobwa, agashaka kumuturisha amubwira ko yaryohewe n’urukundo ndetse nta wundi uba mu bitekerezo bye uretse we. Hari aho agira ati “Uru rukundo ruzagera kure, kuko ni njye nawe gusa dutuma rufatika tunoza inzira yarwo dukora nk’umuntu umwe njye nawe, ibyerekezo ni bine icyanjye ni kimwe ni wowe gusa. Wowe mfata unkomeze ntundekure, unkunde ntujye kure, nubwira unyongorere urukundo rwigaragaze. Nkomeze nkwite ma Poupette.” King James yabwiye IGIHE ko igitekerezo cy’iyi ndirimbo cyaje bisanzwe nk’umuhanzi ahita akibyaza umusaruro. Yakomeje ati “Igitekerezo cyayo ntabwo gifite ukundi cyaje byihariye. Byanjemo mbyiyumvamo ndangije ndayandika.” Mu mashusho y’iyi ndirimbo King James yifashishije Mutoni Queen Peace wabaye Miss Populality mu irushanwa rya Miss Supranational Rwanda 2019, yanabaye Miss Congeniality muri Miss High School 2016. King James yavuze ko yamurangiwe n’abantu b’inshuti ze bari basanzwe bamuzi. Ati “Nashakaga umukobwa w’umunyamideli wajya mu ndirimbo yanjye. Nabajije inshuti zanjye umukobwa nakoresha, nyinshi muri zo zihuriza kuri Mutoni. Dukorana gutyo.” Amajwi y’iyi ndirimbo yakozwe na Knox muri Monster Records ya DJ Zizou naho amashusho akorwa na Meddy Saleh uri mu barambye mu mwuga wo gutunganya amashusho y’indirimbo z’abahanzi. “Poupette" ni indirimbo iri kuri album ya King James yise ‘‘Meze Neza’’. Yaje ikurikira izindi uyu muhanzi yashyize hanze mbere zirimo “Hari ukuntu’’, ‘‘Uri Mwiza’’, ‘‘Nyuma Yawe’’, ‘‘Agatimatima’’, ‘‘Abo Bose’’, ‘‘Igitekerezo’’, ‘‘Meze Neza’’ yanitiriye album, ‘‘Ese uracyamukunda’’, ‘‘Icyangombwa’’ na "Yabigize birebire.”

title: Abahanzi b’ibyamamare mu Rwanda bahuriye mu ndirimbo ivuga kuri Coronavirus
content: Aba bahanzi barimo Ngarambe François Xavier, Bruce Melodie , Tom Close, Butera Knowless, Jules Sentore, itsinda rya Charly na Nina, Aline Gahongayire, Uncle Austin, Danny Vumbi na Riderman; bahurijwe hamwe bigizwemo uruhare na 1K Entertainment ya Dj Pius. Mu gitero cya mbere cy’iyi ndirimbo itangirwa na Bruce Melodie, agira ati “Agaciro k’ubuzima ntawe utakazi, kwirinda mu buzima ni ingenzi jya ubimenya mu bihe by’icyorezo bibe akarusho. Menya ko Coronavirus ari indwara ivurwa igakira n’ikimenyimenyi benshi barayikize, ibanga ni ukuyisuzumisha ubonye ibimenyetso.” Mu nyikirizo abandi bahanzi barimo Charly bahumuriza abantu bababwira ko ‘nidufatanya tuzayitsinda’, bagashishikariza abantu gukurikiza amabwiriza yo kwirinda iki cyorezo. Dj Pius yavuze ko abantu nibafatanya bizoroha gutsinda Coronavirus yugarije Isi ashishikariza abandi bahanzi bagenzi be n’izindi nzego gufatanya guhashya iki cyorezo. Ati “Abafatanyije ntakibagora, twese hamwe dushobora gutsinda covid-19. Nk’abahanzi b’abanyarwanda n’izindi nzego reka twongere imbaraga mu gukumira no kurwanya iki cyorezo.” Iyi ndirimbo n’ubwo yiswe ‘Corona’, aba bahanzi banashishikariza ababyeyi kwigisha abana babo ibijyanye n’ubuzima bw’imyororokere. Bakanashishikariza urubyiruko kwirinda ibiyobyabwenge n’ubusambanyi bakimiriza imbere umurimo. Mu Rwanda abantu bamaze kwandura Coronavirus ni 384, abamaze gukira ni 269 mu gihe abo imaze kwica ari babiri.

title: Ibyamamare byo mu Rwanda byinjiye mu bukangurambaga bwo kwamagana iyicwa ry’abirabura muri Amerika
content: Kuri ubu Isi yose ihanze amaso Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika nyuma y’umwirabura George Floyd wishwe anigishijwe ivi n’umupolisi w’umuzungu ndetse bamwe bari kwiroha mu mihanda mu rwego rwo kwamagana iyicwa rikorerwa abirabura babayo. Ni urupfu rwababaje benshi biturutse ku mashusho yasakajwe uyu mwirabura ari gutakamba avuga ko ‘ari guhera umwuka’ ariko bikirengagizwa kugeza aho yajyanywe kwa muganga agahita ahuhuka. Ndetse muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika imyigaragambyo ikomeje gufata indi ntera, ibihumbi by’abaturage bagiye mu mihanda bitwaje ibyapa bigaragaza uburakari batewe n’urupfu rw’umwirabura George Floyd. Abandi bari kwifashisha imbuga nkoranyambaga bagaragaza akababaro kabo ndetse bagasabira ubutabera uyu mugabo wishwe ahowe ubusa. Ibyamamare byo mu Rwanda nabyo byinjiye muri ubu bukangurambaga byo ku mbuga nkoranyambaga bifashishije hashtag zirimo #BlackLivesMatter cyangwa #JusticeForFloyd, mu kwamagana ubwicanyi bukorerwa abirabura baba muri Amerika. Ibi byamamare birimo Akiwacu Colombe wabaye nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2014, Mutesi Jolly wambitswe iryo kamba mu 2016, Nimwiza Meghan waryambaye mu 2019, Nishimwe Naomie uherutse gutorerwa kuba Miss Rwanda 2020 na Bahati Grace wabaye nyampinga w’u Rwanda mu 2009. Aba bose mu butumwa bashyize ku nkuta zabo bagaragaza ko ‘ubuzima bw’abirabura baba muri Amerika bukwiye guhabwa agaciro. Nka Nimwiza Meghan yanditse ubutumwa burebure agira ati “ Kugeza igihe bazarekera kuduhiga nk’inyamanswa, kugeza igihe tuzareka gusaba kutureka tugahumeka, kugeza igihe tuzatangira kugenda twiruka mu muhanda dukora siporo nta kibazo dufite tutari kwiruka ku buzima bwacu, kugeza igihe bazabona ko dukozwe n’amaraso ameze neza […]” Arongera ati “Kugeza igihe imitima yacu izaba itumva iremerewe n’agahinda k’abacu bicwa n’abakabaye babarinda, kugeza igihe tuzatsinda urugamba; kugeza icyo gihe; ntabwo tuzigera duceceka, imitima yacu yarashenjaguritse, kandi ntabwo duteze kurekera kugeza igihe tuzumvwa hakagira igikorwa.” Abandi bagaragaje ko bifatanyije n’Isi yose mu kwamagana iyicwa rikorerwa abirabura nta mpamvu harimo umuhanzi The Ben, Princess Priscillah, Nirere Shanel, Igor Mabano, Nel Ngabo, Shaddy Boo, Jules Sentore, Buravan na Dj Toxxyk. Abandi barimo Nadja Giramata Umunyarwandakazi mu maraso ariko afite ubwenegihugu bw’u Bwongereza akaba n’Umunyamerika, ubu atuye mu Mujyi wa New York. Uyu mukobwa usanzwe ari umunyamideli yanditse kuri Instagram ati “Ku bwa George Floyd ariko na none n’abandi ba mbere ye, kandi ndizera ko nta kundi nyuma y’ibi.” Floyd w’imyaka 46 witabye Imana, yakoraga mu barinda umutekano mu nzu icuruza amafunguro, yishwe n’umupolisi wo muri leta ya Minnesota.

title: Abakobwa 10 bo mu Majyepfo ya Afurika babonye itike yo kwitabira Miss Career Africa 2020 izasorezwa mu Rwanda
content: Abakobwa batoranyijwe barimo Lerato Moeko , Prudence Maloka, Gift Wezzie Somakwabe, Nelisiwe Ntuli na Mpho Phasa bo muri Afurika y’Epfo; Jessica Mundie Uiras na Ester Shifotoka bo muri Namibia; Victoria Rutendo Maphosa , Natasha Dlamini na Nothabo Ncumbe bo muri Zimbabwe. Ubuyobozi bwa Miss Career bwabandikiye bubashimira ku bw’imishinga yabo ndetse bunabaha ikaze mu muryango w’abazitabira iri rushanwa mu Rwanda mu mpera z’umwaka haramutse hatagize imbogamizi zizamo. Buti “Mwakoze cyane amanywa n’ijoro n’amanywa ngo mubone amanota. Wari umukino utoroshye ariko mwabonye intsinzi.” Bwakomeje buvuga ko nta n’umwe wari woroshye muri 15 bahataniraga kugera mu cyiciro kibahesha itike y’i Kigali. Ndetse banabwirwa ko bemerewe itike y’indege izabazana muri Kigali mu mwiherero wa Miss Career Africa 2020 uzaba guhera ku wa 23 kugeza ku wa 27 Ugushyingo 2020. Aba bakobwa bose bagaragaje ibyishimo bikomeye ndetse bavuga ko ari iby’agaciro kuri bo kuba babonye itike yo kuzaza mu Rwanda mu irushanwa rya Miss Career Africa 2020. Nka Victoria Rutendo Maphosa wo muri Zimbabwe yagize ati “ Aya ni amahirwe aza rimwe mu buzima kuba mu irushanwa nk’iri, nasazwe n’ibyishimo kuba bahagarariye ibihugu byabo.” Umushinga w’uyu mukobwa witwa ‘Educate’ ufatanye n’undi witwa ‘Love Me Campaign International’ yagize igitekezo cyawo kuko agamije gutanga ubufasha ku rubyiruko mu nzira yo kubaha umurongo wo kumenya ibyo guhitamo mu buzima bwabo. Bakabereka ukuri ndetse bagakosora imyumvire baba bifitemo ku bijyanye n’utuzi duciriritse. Uyu mushinga ujyanye no kwigisha abantu cyane cyane urubyiruko, uburyo bategura imishinga yabo mu buryo bugendanye n’igihe. Mu Majyepfo ya Afurika abakobwa 100 nibo bari banditse basaba kwitabira irushanwa rya Miss Career Africa aho buri wese yagaragaje umushinga we, nyuma hatoranywamo 15, bavuyemo 10 bazahagararira Afurika y’Amajyepfo. Bamwe mu bakobwa bihariye bari guhatana harimo uwitwa Jessica Mundie Uiras wo muri Namibia ugaragaza ko amaze kwegukana amakamba atanu kuva atangiye kwitabira amarushanwa y’ubwiza. Yegukanye ikamba rya World Miss University Namibia 2017, Tera Queen 28th World Miss University 2017, Miss Grand Namibia 2018, Miss Heritage 2019 ndetse na Miss Charm 2019/2020. Undi mukobwa ni Dlamini Natasha wo muri Zimbabwe. Ni umukinnyi wa filime akaba n’umusizi usanzwe ari umuvugizi w’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Mpunzi (UNHCR). Yatoranyijwe nk’umukinnyi mwiza mu iserukiramuco rya Pan-African ryabereye mu Mujyi wa Los Angeles. Dlamini yanatoranyijwe nka Ambasaderi wa Global Peace mu gihugu cye. Muri aba bakobwa kandi harimo uwitwa Nelisiwe Ntuli uvuga ko amaze gutsindira ibihembo 30. Yivuga nk’umukobwa wifashije kwinjira mu bushabitsi aho ubu akora mu bijyanye no gutegura ahabera ibirori. Anabifatanya n’akazi ko kwakira abantu bagana ikigo cy’itangazamakuru akorera. Mu myaka itanu yifuza ko ikigo cye yise "Bianca Exquisite events" kizaba cyatanze akazi ku bantu 25. Iri rushanwa rizazenguruka mu bice bitandukanye bya Afurika. Miss Career Africa ifite intumbero y’imyaka 30, aho byibura abakobwa 450 000 bazaba bamaze kuvamo ba rwiyemezamirimo bato, abahanga mu mirimo n’inganda zitandukanye muri Afurika. Iri rushanwa rizajya riba hasimbukwe umwaka umwe ryongere kuba. Ku ikubitiro Miss Career Africa 2020 azatorerwa mu Rwanda mu birori bikomeye bizaba ku wa 27 Ugushyingo 2020, mu gihe mu 2022 iri rushanwa rizabera muri Nigeria. Hazatorwa uzahiga abandi abe ariwe ugirwa Miss Career Africa 2020, mu gihe hazatangwa andi makamba arimo nka Miss Speaker, Miss Technology, Miss Hospitality, Miss Science, Miss Talent na Miss Art. Ibisabwa mu bashaka guhatana ni ukuba uri hagati y’imyaka 18-24, uri umushabitsi wasoje amashuri yisumbuye cyangwa wiga muri kaminuza unabarizwa muri Afurika.

title: USA: Shizzo wujuje Album ye ya kane “My trap life” akomeje gusohora indirimbo ziyigize
content: Uyu muhanzi muri iyi minsi ugaragaza gushyira imbaraga nyinshi mu gukora umuziki yamaze kurangiza Album ye ya kane ndetse umunsi ku wundi ari gusohora indirimbo ziyigize kugeza igihe zose azaba amaze kuzishyirira hanze. Ati “Ni uburyo bugezweho bwo kumurika Album, usohora indirimbo imwe imwe ku buryo uha umwanya abakunzi b’umuziki wawe bakazumva kandi ukizera ko zose zibagezeho noneho ukabona gutangira kuzamamaza.” Iyi Album igizwe n’indirimbo 15, harimo izo yagiye akorana n’abandi bahanzi nka Young Grace, Queen Cha, B Threy, Bull Dogg, Yvanny Mpano n’abandi batandukanye. Shizzo aganira na IGIHE yavuze ko muri iyi minsi ahugiye ku gusohora indirimbo ze ziri kuri Album, nyuma azatangira imirimo yo kuzimenyekanisha ndetse ibintu nibiba byasubiye mu buryo abe yanakora ibitaramo. Ati ”Imipango myinshi nari mfite yarapfuye kubera Covid-19, nk’ubu sinakora ibitaramo, ubu ni uguha abantu album yanjye nshya nkasohora indirimbo ziyigize, ndi gushaka uko nakomeza gukora amashusho yazo kuko hari zimwe zitayafite ndetse hari n’ayo namaze gukora ariko atarasohoka mu minsi mike mwitege byinshi kurushaho.” Mu mpera za 2018 nibwo Shizzo yamuritse Album ye ya gatatu “The home coming” mu gitaramo cyabereye i Rubavu ku ivuko rye n’ubundi aho yakuriye. Icyo gihe Ishimwe Agape wamamaye nka Shizzo yongeye kugaruka mu Rwanda nyuma y’imyaka 10 yari amaze muri Amerika. Zimwe mu ndirimbo nshya ziri kuri iyi Album ya Shizzo

title: Bwa mbere mu mateka uwatorewe kuba Miss America agiye kumarana ikamba imyaka ibiri
content: Mu itangazo ryashyizwe hanze n’abategura iri rushanwa bavuze ko iri iryo mu 2021 ryasubitswe kubera icyorezo cya COVID-19. Uyu mukobwa yabwiye ikinyamakuru People ko gukora muri ibi bihe kuri we bigoye, kuko hari byinshi asabwa gukorera kuri internet. Ati “Iki kintu ntabwo Miss America yari yarigeze ihura nacyo, ni ikigo kimaze imyaka irenga ijana none ninjye wa mbere ibintu nk’ibi bibayeho. Ni gute nabyakira, ni gute nzahangana no gushyira mu bikorwa ibintu nakoreraga ahantu hatandukanye noneho nkabikora nifashishije Internet?” Camille Schrier, usanzwe ari inzobere mu butabire ni we wambitswe ikamba rya 99 rya Miss America 2020 nyuma yo gutungurana akagaragara mu cyumba cyaberagamo irushanwa avangavanga ibinyabutabire bitandukanye muri ‘laboratoire’. Uyu mukobwa w’imyaka 24 y’amavuko muri Miss America 2020 yageze imbere y’Akanama Nkemurampaka yambaye umwambaro w’abakora muri laboratoire avangavanga bimwe mu byo yari yitwaje harimo na ‘Hydrogen peroxide’. Ndetse biza no kuba kimwe mu bintu bikomeye byatumye yambikwa ikamba rya Miss America 2020.

title: Abaririmbyi bakomeye mu makorali yo muri Kiliziya Gatolika bahuriye mu ndirimbo
content: Iyi ndirimbo bahuriyemo yitwa ‘Twaje Mana Yacu’ yahimbwe na Padiri Hakolimana Jean ubarizwa muri Espagne. Emmy Pro wagize igitekerezo cyo gukora iyi ndirimbo yabwiye IGIHE ko yatangiye umushinga wo kujya ahuriza mu ndirimbo imwe bamwe mu baririmbyi bakomeye bo muri Kiliziya Gatolika. Ati “Bitewe n’amakorali menshi nkorera indirimbo nagiye mpura n’abaririmbyi bazigize b’abahanga numva ngize igitekerezo cy’uko umunsi umwe nzabahuriza mu ndirimbo abantu bakumva uburyohe bw’umuziki w’abahanga.” Yakomeje ati “ ’Twaje Mana yacu’ ni indirimbo nkunda cyane ndetse hari n’abandi bantu basanzwe bayikunda kubera amagambo meza ayigize ndetse n’umuziki mwiza wumvikanamo. Nifuje rero ko aba baririmbyi bamfasha ikongera gutanga ibyishimo.” Iyi ndirimbo irimo Padiri Hakolimana Jean wayihimbye , uba muri Espagne aho ari Chanoine, akaba na Perezida wa Bazilika ya Mutagatifu Mariya wa Manresa; irimo kandi Eugène Havugimana ndetse n’umuzungu witwa Shaprov babarizwa mu Butaliyani. Hagaragaramo kandi Nyituriki Nizeyimana Denis, umuririmbyi ukomeye wahimbye indirimbo ‘Gikundiro’ ya Rayon Sport, ‘Gitinyiro’ ya APR FC n’izindi na Irakoze Nicole umuririmbyi Choeur International akaba n’umuhanga ufite impamyabumenyi y’ikirenga mu muziki. Harimo Cyriaque Ngoboka wo muri Chorale Christus Regnat, Iraguha Alain Marius, Karangwa Fabrice, Kamanzi Henry Prosper na Niyonkuru Fabrice babarizwa mu itsinda The Bright Five Singers, Dr Aristote Hakizimana umuganga, umuhanzi akaba n’umuririmbyi muri Chœur International, Niyobuhungiro Donat umucuranzi wa Christus Regnat ndetse n’umuhanzi, Kamana Marius na Iyakaremye Samuel bo muri chorale Inyange za Mariya. Assoumpta [Dudu] umuririmbyikazi wo muri Chorale La Fraternité, Gloria umuririmbyikazi wa Chorale St Paul Kicukiro na Iratwibuka Salome wa Chorale de Kigali, Isimbi umuririmbyi wa Christus Regnat, Intaramirwa Christelle umuririmbyikazi wa Chorale St Paul Kicukiro, umuhanzikazi Senga Diane, Ruzigamanzi Robert Bellarmin, umunyamuziki ukomeye cyane muri Gatolika: yahimbye indirimbo nyinshi zirimo ‘Umugisha Utagimba’, ‘Ukuboko K’uhoraho’ n’izindi; ubu aririmba muri Chorale Harmonic Voices na Niyonzima Oreste usanzwe ari umucuranzi wa Christus Regnat, Chœur International ndetse na Chorale le Bon Berger. Iyi ndirimbo mu buryo bw’amajwi yakozwe na Emmy Pro muri studio ye ‘Universal Records’ n’aho amashusho akorwa na Aime pride nawe wo muri iyi studio. Iyi ndirimbo ‘Twaje Mana yacu’ ije ikurikira indi yitwa ‘Mana idukunda byahebuje’ yaririmbwemo n’abaririmbyi bakomeye muri kiliziya Gatolika n’ubundi biganjemo abo muri aya makorali twavuze.

title: Yacuruje amagi n’amasahane! Ibyo wamenya ku buzima bushaririye Clapton Kibonge yanyuzemo
content: Ubonye Clapton mu buzima busanzwe cyangwa ku rubyiniro ntiwamenya ko ubuzima bwe bugizwe n’amakorosi ndetse amwe yamusigiye ibikomere. Clapton Kibonge yavukiye muri Uganda, we n’umuryango we baje gutaha mu Rwanda nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Kibonge avuka mu muryango w’abana batandatu. Bakigera mu Rwanda bahise bajya gutura Nyagatare mu Ntara y’Iburasirazuba; nyuma y’igihe gito baba mu Mutara baje kwimukira mu Karere ka Bugesera ari naho Clapton yakuriye. Clapton mu bwana, yavanywe iwabo n’uko se amucyuriye Nyuma yo gusoza amashuri yisumbuye, Clapton yaje gucyurirwa na se bituma ahita ava mu cyaro gutyo. Yagize ati "Umunsi umwe nariyemeye ndavuga ngo njye narize. Papa yahise ambwira ngo iyo diplôme yawe itagura umunyu imaze iki? Nahise ntangira gushaka uko najya i Kigali.” Akigera i Kigali, Clapton Kibonge yabanje gucuruza amagi. Mu kubara iyo nkuru agira ati ”Sinjye wayazengurukanaga, nararanguraga nkayaha umwana akajya kuyacuruza akanyishyura 1500 Frw ku munsi.” Iri shoramari yaje kurivamo, yinjira mu bucuruzi bwa telefoni ku Iposita. Yakomeje ati "Mu mpera za 2012 naje kurwara njya mu bitaro mara nk’amezi atatu.” Akimara gukira, Kibonge yasubiye mu cyaro ariko aza kongera kuhava abonye akazi ko gucuruza amasahani muri Kigali City Tower. Ati ”Aho niho naje kumenyanira na Ramjaane kuko yakoraga kuri KFM yakoreraga mu nyubako nanjye nacururizagamo, twarahuje birangira dutangiye gukinana.” Akazi ka se karanze, Kibonge afata inshingano z’umukuru mu muryango Umubyeyi wa Clapton yacuruzaga amata mu mujyi ndetse anazana barumuna be babiri kuhiga. Avuga ko "Akazi kaje kugenda nabi biba ngombwa ko we asubira mu cyaro. Nk’umwana mukuru nagombaga gufata icyemezo cyo kurera barumuna banjye. Icyo gihe nakoraga akazi ariko nkazirikana ko hari abana ngomba kwitaho.” Yakomeje kwita kuri barumuna be ndetse n’umuryango we kugeza bose barangije kwiga uretse umuto ubu uri mu wa Gatanu mu mashuri yisumbuye. Kwita kuri barumuna be byatumye Clapton areka ishuri. Yagize ati ”Rimwe nari ku ishuri aho nari natangiye mu wa Mbere muri Kaminuza ya Kigali mu 2015, bampamagaye bambwiye ko murumuna wanjye bamwirukanye bituma amafaranga nari mfite mpitamo kuyamuha ajya kwiga, njye mva mu ishuri kugira ngo mbanze nkemure ibibazo bye.” Filime zamuhinduriye ubuzima Clapton uzwi cyane mu bijyanye no gutera urwenya no gukina filime aho yakinnye muri Seburikoko n’izindi zinyuranye avuga ko filime zamuhinduriye ubuzima cyane ko kugeza ubu arizo zimutunze n’umuryango we. Ati “Nta kandi kazi ngira, nkina filime nizo zintunze kuva nahura na Ramjaane akabinyinjizamo kugeza magingo aya nizo zintunze.” Avuga ko yakunze kugaragara muri filime z’abandi ndetse n’izamwitirirwaga ariko yishyuwe kugira ngo azikine gusa kugeza ubu uyu mugabo yatangiye kwikorera iye yise “Umuturanyi”. Clapton atangaza ko iyo atanyura mu buzima yabayemo, kuri ubu aba afite nk’igorofa ariko ngo byahuye n’inshingano nyinshi yari afite. Yakoze ubukwe amagambo aba menshi… Abantu benshi batunguwe no kumva inkuru y’ubukwe bwa Clapton bitewe no kuba yarabigize ubwiru. Yagize ati "Nari naranze ariya magambo yose yakurikiyeho, byonyine nyuma y’ubukwe mwayabonye ayo bavuze, ibaze rero iyo bayavuga tutarabana ariko narabibonaga nakwibuka ko turi kumwe nkumva nta ribi.” “Kwari ukuri yari atwite, nari mbizi ko nyuma y’amezi abiri nzabyara. Muri ayo mezi nari mfitemo n’igitaramo cya Life is funny, nakoze igitaramo nkivuyemo ku wa Kane turabyara. Igitaramo ntabwo cyagenze neza kuko nateguraga ibintu bibiri.” Clapton ahamya ko kimwe mu byatumye akora ubukwe n’umugore we ku buryo bwihuse ari uko yifuzaga ko umwana we amuvukira iruhande. Yagize ati “sinigeze nifuzaga ko umwana wanjye avukira kure yanjye.” Kugeza ubu uyu munyarwenya unakina filime avuga ko ari gukora cyane ngo azamure impano nshya mu gusetsa no gukina filime. Clapton ni we wafashije abasore bagize itsinda rya “Bigomba Guhinduka” ndetse ari no gufasha abandi banyarwenya n’abakinnyi ba filime batandukanye.

title: Umunya-Nigeria Majek Fashek wamamaye mu njyana ya Reggae yitabye Imana
content: Uyu musaza yitabye Imana apfuye urw’ikirago nyuma yo kuryama agasinzirira ko nk’uko Omenka Uzoma wari umujyanama we yabitangarije BBC. Omenka Uzoma mu magambo yanditse kuri Instagram, yavuze ko ‘ni igihe ngo twishimire ibyo yagezeho si igihe cyo kubabara tumuherekeza, yakoreye byinshi Nigeria na Afurika muri rusange’. Majek Fashek yajyaga afatwa n’uburwayi rimwe na rimwe ariko ubu icyamwishe ntikiramenyekana neza. Uyu muhanzi afatwa nk’uwahirimbaniye umuziki muri Nigeria kuva mu myaka yo mu 1980. Yigeze kuvuga ko Bob Marley ari we wamuteye imbaraga zo gukora Reggae. Mu 1991 yakoze indirimbo yise ‘So Long Too Long’ yari irimo ubutumwa bukomeye bukangurira Abanyafurika gukunda umugabo wabo, yahamagariraga guhaguruka yaba abari mu mugabane cyangwa aba hanze yawo. Yaririmbye izindi ndirimbo nyinshi zirimo ‘Holly Spirit’, ‘Religion na Politics’, ‘African Unity’, ‘Free Africa, Free Mandela’ n’izindi nyinshi. Mu 2000 hatangiye gusakazwa inkuru z’uko Majek ubuzima bwe butameze neza gusa biza kurangira amahoro nta gikuba gicitse. Mu 2015 yajyanywe mu Kigo Ngororamuco i Abuja muri Nigeria kubera gusabikwa n’ibiyobyabwenge. Majek Fashek yakoranye n’abahanzi b’ibihangange barimo nka Jimmy Cliff, Tracy Chapman na Snoop Dogg.  	Reba imwe mu ndirimbo za Majek

title: Ncuti Gatwa: Uwari umunyabibazo ari kurya ku mbuto zeze kuri filime Sex Education yamugize ikimenyabose
content: Uyu musore w’imyaka 27 yatangiye kumenyekana muri Mutarama 2019, ubwo igice cya mbere cya filime Sex Education cyajyaga hanze. Bamwe bati nyamara hari umunyarwanda uri kubica kuri Netflix, abandi ntibabyemere kuko bumvaga ari ibintu bikomeye, ariko nyuma baza kubona ko ari ukuri kwambaye ubusa. Ncuti atangira kumenyekana yari afite abamukurikira ku rubuga rwa Instagram babarirwa mu bihumbi ijana ariko ubu ageze kuri miliyoni ebyiri n’imisago, ikintu cyerekana ko izina rye rimaze gutumbagira mu buryo bukomeye. Ubu biragoye ko mu bihembo byibanda ku bari mu ruganda rwa sinema bitangirwa mu Bwongereza aho abarizwa ubu, wasanga atari mu bahatana ndetse hari n’ibyo agenda yegukana. Ubu, uretse mu Bwongereza no muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika Ncuti Gatwa arubashywe bikomeye, ku buryo kuzamwumva i Hollywood mu gihe kiri imbere ari ibintu byoroshye cyane. Yatangiye gukina muri filime zitandukanye mu 2014 mu yitwa Bob Servant, mu 2015 akina mu yitwa Stonemouth, mu 2019 muri Sex Education yamwubakiye izina bikomeye na Horrible Histories: The Movie – Rotten Romans. Nyuma yo gukina muri Sex Eduction yahatanye mu bihembo bitandukanye birimo MTV Tv & Movie Awards itangirwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu byiciro bibiri; icy’umukinnyi wa filime uri kuzamuka ndetse n’icy’uwasomanye neza, hombi ntiyabashije kwegukana igihembo na kimwe. Mu 2019 kandi nabwo yahatanye mu bihembo birimo BAFTA Scotland nk’umukinnyi mwiza wa filime y’uruhererekane icishwa kuri televiziyo, ariko ntiyabasha kwegukana igihembo. Mu mwaka ushize ikinyamakuru gikomeye cya Elle cyari cyashyize Ncuti Gatwa ku rutonde rw’abanyempano 50 bari kugaragaza impinduka kurusha abandi [50 Game-changers]. Mu 2019 kandi yashyizwe n’ikinyamakuru The New York Times ku rutonde rw’abantu 10 icyo kinyamakuru kibona bitwaye neza mu myuga itandukanye bakora. Tariki 13 Werurwe 2020 yegukanye igihembo cy’umukinnyi uri kuzamuka neza mu bihembo bya The Broadcasting Press Guild [BPG], bitegurwa n’ishyirahamwe ry’abanyamakuru bandika, abo ku mateleviziyo ndetse n’abo kuri Radio. Ibi bihembo byatangwaga ku nshuro ya 46, byatangiwe ahitwa Banking Hall mu Mujyi wa Londres mu Bwongereza. Umunyabibazo uri kurya ku mbuto … Mu ntangiro za 2020, Ncuti Gatwa yabwiye Ikinyamakuru Independent cyo mu Bwongereza ko yakuriye mu buzima bukomeye, we n’abandi bavandimwe babiri bakarerwa na nyina gusa. Uyu musore iyo yivuga agaragaza ko kubera kuvukira mu muryango wa gikirisitu, yakuze abwirizwa kujya gusenga gusa yagera mu myaka 15 y’amavuko, bamubwiye ko igihe yumva abangamiwe no kubyuka ku Cyumweru, nta mpungenge akwiye kugira kuko kujya gusenga ari amahitamo ye. Mu murwa Mukuru wa Ecosse witwa Edinburgh aho Ncuti Gatwa yakuriye, yagiye ahura n’ibibazo rimwe na rimwe kubera kwirabura, agakunda kwibasirwa abazwa inkomoko ye, akavuga ko ari Umunya-Ecosse. Ati “Abantu bagerageje kundwanya. Hari ibihe nabaga ndi gutembera nijoro abantu bakambaza aho nkomoka. Nanjye nti ndi Umunya-Ecosse, bati oya ntabwo aribyo. Nkongera nti ndiwe. Kuki uvuga Icyongereza gutyo? Nti biva mu munwa wanjye. Kuki uri kwishyira ukizana bingana gutyo ntutekereze ku ngaruka byakugiraho? Ubwo byahitaga biba birebire. Inshuro nyinshi bashatse kunkubita kubera ko navuze ko ndi Umunya-Ecosse […].” Ncuti Gatwa avuga ko yigiye byinshi kuri Nyina wamureze wenyine n’abavandimwe be babiri, bigatuma adacika intege mu byo akora byose kuko hari aho yageraga mu bibazo akibuka ibyo nyina yaciyemo, nawe agakomeza guhatana. Ati “Kudacika intege ni ikintu buri gihe nabonye kandi nkacyishimira. Nakuranye na mama watureze, Papa ntabwo twabanaga. Umugore wari umunyamahanga waje gutura muri Ecosse, utarabashaga kuvuga ururimi rwaho, nta mafaranga, n’abana batatu agomba kurera, waturutse mu Rwanda […]” “Nabonye ibihe bibi yanyuzemo, nabonye uko yahatanaga buri gihe. Buri munsi wabaga ari urundi rugamba, kandi buri gihe yakoreshaga imbaraga ze zose kubera twe batatu. Yageragezaga kunyura mu gikomeye uko cyaba kimeze kose cyaje mu nzira ye. Ntekereza ko ari cyo cyatumye mba umuntu udacika intege. Nareberaga kuri mama, nkavuga nti niba yaranyuze muri biriya nanjye nshobora kunyura muri ibi kandi nkabitsinda.” Ncuti Gatwa aheruka gukina muri filime igiye kujya hanze yiswe ‘Last Letter from Your Lover’ izaba agaragaramo ibikomerezwa muri sinema ku Isi nk’umunyamerika Shailene Woodley, Umwongerezakazi Felicity Jones n’abandi benshi. ‘Last Letter from Your Lover’ ishingiye ku gatabo gato ka Jojo Moyes nako gafite izina nk’iri. Yayobowe na Augustine Frizzell, itunganywa n’abarimo Graham Broadbent, Peter Czernin, Simone Urdl na Jennifer Weiss. Gatwa yavukiye muri Nyarugenge mu Mujyi wa Kigali ku wa 15 Ukwakira 1992. Avuka kuri Dr. Tharcisse Gatwa, umunyamakuru akaba n’umwanditsi ukomeye ufite impamyabumenyi y’ikirenga mu by’iyobokamana ufite inkomoko i Karongi mu Burengerazuba bw’ u Rwanda. Gatwa Ncuti n’umuryango we bimukiye muri Écosse mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 ndetse ni naho uyu musore yakuriye, yize ibijyanye no gukina filime muri kaminuza Royal Conservatoire of Scotland, yahawe impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya kabiri cya Kaminuza mu ishami ryo gukina filime mu 2013. Kuri ubu we n’umuryango we na nyina batuye mu mujyi wa Londres mu Bwongereza.

title: Umusore ukundana na Diane wo muri City Maid yahishuye byinshi birimo n’ubukwe bitegura vuba
content: Fleury Legend na Diane bakundana bamenyanye mu 2015 ariko baba inshuti mu 2016. Kugeza ubu uretse kuba barakundanye bagahuza ubu banafatanya akazi cyane cyane ko Fleury ariwe utunganya filime nshya ya Diane yitwa ‘Impanga’. Mu kiganiro cyihariye na IGIHE, Fleury Legend yahishuye ko bahujwe n’akazi kajyanye na sinema nyuma bakaza gukundana, we n’uyu mukobwa bari kwitegura no gukora ubukwe mu bihe bya vuba. Ati “Jeannette ni umukunzi wanjye. Twamenyanye mu 2016. Nyuma yaho nibwo twatangiye gukundana. Hari filime twakoranye nyuma y’akazi tuza gukundana. Kuba yaragiye avugwa cyane mu zindi nkuru n’urukundo icya mbere ni ubuzima tubamo. Ni umuntu uzwi n’abantu benshi, ararebwa cyane, kandi nanjye mba muri showbiz. Turanywa vuba aha. Gahunda y’ubukwe irahari, twatangiye kubiganiraho tuzabitangaza vuba, ni vuba cyane.” Abajijwe icyo akundira Bahavu asubiza ko “Mukundira ibintu byinshi; icya mbere azi ubwenge. Ni mwiza. Indeshyo n’uko ameze byahuriyemo, ni Goût yanjye.” Filime nshya ya Diane yise “Impanga” ubu hamaze gushyirwa hanze uduce twayo tune ducishwa kuri Youtube channel ye yise “Impanga TV”. Inandikwa na Bahavu. Usanase Bahavu Jeannette uzwi nka Diane yamenyekanye cyane muri filime y’uruhererekane ica kuri Televiziyo Rwanda bise Citymaid, aho ari umwe mu bakinnyi b’ingenzi bayikinamo.
