title: Sosiyete ya Andela yahagaritse abakozi bayo 135 batarimo abo mu Rwanda
content: Andela yashinzwe mu 2014 ifite intego yo gufasha Afurika, kugira abahanga mu ikoranabuhanga binyuze mu ikorwa rya porogaramu za mudasobwa na telefone. Ifite amashami mu bihugu bitandukanye birimo Nigeria, Uganda, Kenya, mu Rwanda, Ghana, Misiri na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Kuri uyu wa Kabiri mu nama yahuje umuyobozi mukuru wa Andela, Jeremy Johnson n’abakozi basaga 1300 ba Andela, bamenyeshejwe ko bamwe muri bo babaye bahagaritswe ku kazi kubera abakiliya b’iyo sosiyete abenshi bashegeshwe n’isubira hasi ry’ubukungu ryatewe n’icyorezo cya coronavirus. Mu butumwa bwo kuri email, Johnson yandikiye abakozi bose, yabamenyesheje ko benshi mu bakiliya ba Andela b’imena bahuye n’ibibazo by’ubukungu. Yavuze ko kugabanyuka kw’abakiliya ba Andela bizateza ikibazo ku byo yinjizaga, bityo ko ari ngombwa kugabanya ikiguzi cy’icyo yatakazaga kugira ngo ingaruka zo kugabanyuka kw’amikoro zidasenya burundu iyo sosiyete. Ubuyobozi bwa Andela bwemereye ikinyamakuru cyandika ku ikoranabuhanga, Tech Cabal ko 50 % by’abakiliya bayo bari mu bibazo by’ubukungu. Abakozi basezerewe muri Andela, bangana na 10 % by’abakozi bose b’iyo sosiyete. Ni ku nshuro ya gatatu iyo sosiyete igabanya abakozi mu gihe cy’amezi icyenda. Hari abakozi 420 bato bakoraga za porogaramu z’ikoranabuhanga basezerewe umwaka ushize muri Nzeri, abandi basezererwa muri Mutarama na Gashyantare uyu mwaka. Mu myanzuro kandi yafashwe, abayobozi b’amashami bose bazakatwa umushahara ku kigero kiri hagati ya 10% na 30 %. Hari n’ibindi byagenerwaga abakozi bizagabanywa mu kugabanya ikiguzi, nk’uburyo bwo kuborohereza ingendo, aho byitezwe ko bizatuma iyo sosiyete izigama miliyoni 25 z’amadolari. Guhagarika abakozi byitezwe ko bizafasha iyo sosiyete kuzigama miliyoni eshanu z’amadolari. Tariki 8 Gicurasi 2020 niwo munsi wo gusezerera bamwe mu bakozi ba Andela. Mu kubafasha, bazahabwa imperekeza ihagije n’ubwishingizi bwo kwivuza mu gihe cy’amezi ane. Mu 2018 nibwo Andela yasinyanye amasezerano n’u Rwanda yo guhugura abanyarwanda 500 mu gukora porogaramu zitandukanye z’ikoranabuhanga (software), bakazanashakirwa akazi mu bigo by’ikoranabuhanga ku Isi. Gahunda ya Andela igamije kurema abahanga mu by’ikoranabuhanga muri Afurika bafite umurava wo kurikoresha no kuba ku isonga ry’abaryifashisha mu gukemura ibibazo byugarije ikiremwamuntu. Andela iterwa inkunga n’ibigo birimo Google Ventures, and Spark Google Ventures, Spark Capital na Chan Zuckerberg Initiative n’ibindi.

title: Samsung yashyize ku isoko “laptop” eshatu z’akataraboneka
content: Izi mudasobwa zikoranywe Processeur izibashisha kwihuta kurusha izo Samsung yari yarashyize ku isoko mbere. Zose Processeur yazo yakozwe na Intel ndetse ziri mu kiragano cy’izihuta zizwi nka 10th Gen. Processeur zo mu kiragano cya cumi (10th Gen Intel) ziri mu moko ane ariyo Core i7, Core i9, Core i7 na Core i3. Bene izi Processeur zifasha imashini kwihuta kurusha izo mu bwoko bwa “inside” zabanje ku buryo bene izo mashini zishobora kwifashishwa n’abatunganya amashusho, abashaka gukina imikino ya mudasobwa n’ibindi bisaba ko imashini yihuta. Undi mwihariko w’izi Processeur ni uko ifasha imashini mu kubika umuriro kandi ntushire vuba kuko iba ifite ubushobozi bwo kumara amasaha nibura icyenda utarashiramo. Ibi ntibikuyeho ko hari za mudasobwa umuntu ashobora kugura akabwirwa ko umuriro umaramo amasaha 24, gusa aho icyo biba bisobanuye ni uko ayo masaha abarwa mu gihe iyo mashini itari gukoresha urumuri rwinshi, itari kureberwaho amashusho mu gihe WiFi ifunze mbese ari nko kuba umuntu ari kwandika muri Word gusa nta kindi akora. Gusa wakwibaza umuntu ukoresha imashini muri ubwo buryo! Undi mwihariko w’izi laptop, ni uko nka Galaxy Book Flex na Ion zishobora gushyirwamo umuriro bitagombeye ko ucomeka ku mashanyarazi ahubwo ugakoresha uburyo nziramugozi. Ibi bisobanuye ko ugura Chargeur yabugenewe ukayicomeka ikajyamo umuriro hanyuma ukaza kuyegereza mudasobwa ubundi umuriro ukajyamo. Undi mwihariko ni uko izi mudasobwa zose zikoranye ikoranabuhanga ribashisha umuntu kubona amashusho neza, kuko zirimo QLED (Quantum dot LED), ikoranabuhanga rifasha amashusho kugaragara acyeye, rikunze gukoreshwa mu birahure bya za televiziyo za rutura. Galaxy Flex Alpha yashyizwe ku isoko igura $849.99 ariko igiciro cyayo gishobora kuzamuka kikagera ku $999.99 uko ugenda wifuza ko iba ifite ubushobozi bwisumbuyeho. Galaxy Book Ion yo iri kugura $1,199.99, iyo ni ingana na santimetero 33 mu gihe iya santimetero 38,1 yo igura $1,299.99. Galaxy Book Flex yo igiciro cyayo ni $1,349.99 na $ 1,399.99 kuri izo santimetero zombi.

title: Hakozwe agakoresho k’ikoranabuhanga gashyirwa mu ijosi kakagaragaza ibimenyetso bya Coronavirus
content: Ako gakoresho umuntu agashyira mu ijosi [aho igituza n’ijosi bihurira, ahantu hameze nk’ahari akobo munsi y’ingoto], hanyuma ugakorera kakerekana amakuru niba ufite ibimenyetso bya Coronavirus binyuze muri telefoni iba irimo porogaramu igakoresha. Aka gakoresho kashyizwe hanze ku wa Mbere w’iki Cyumweru, gafite ubushobozi bwo kugaragaza ibimenyetso by’ibanze bya Coronavirus ndetse n’uburyo umuntu urwaye ari koroherwa. Mu byumweru bibiri, aka gakoresho kamaze gukorerwaho ibizamini 25. Mu minsi ya mbere, ibizamini byarongeraga bikagenzurwa n’abaganga b’inzobere kugira ngo harebwe neza niba koko amakuru katanze ari ay’ukuri.

title: Ibuye ryaturutse ku kwezi ryashyizwe mu cyamunara kuri miliyoni 2.49 z’amadolari
content: Iri buye rikomeye nk’urutare, bikekwa ko rishobora kuba ryaravungutse ku kwezi bitewe n’ukugongana n’umubumbe muto cyangwa ikindi kintu mu bigize isanzure, rikavungukaho rikagwa mu butayu bwa Sahara. Icyo kintu cyiswe NWA 12691, bikekwa ko ari ryo buye rya gatanu mu bunini mu yavuye ku kwezi yabashije kugaragara ku Isi, aho habarurwa agera ku biro 650 amaze kuboneka ku Isi yavuye ku kwezi. Umuhanga muri Siyansi n’amateka karemano, James Hyslop, yavuze ko ari iby’agaciro kuba nk’umuntu yatunga mu biganza bye ikintu azi neza ko cyaturutse ku wundi mubumbe, ku buryo “ari ibintu udashobora kwibagirwa”. Yabwiye Reuters ati “Ni igice gito cy’ukwezi. Kijya kungana n’uko umupira w’amaguru ungana, ariko kijya kuba kirekire kurutaho,” Ntabwo haramenyekana umuntu watahuye iri buye mu butayu bwa Sahara nyuma yo kuhagera rikoze intera y’ibilometero 386243 uturutse ku kwezi. Ryakoreweho ubushakashatsi biza kwemezwa ko ryaturutse ku wundi mugabane. Abahanga bamenye neza inkomoko yaryo nyuma yo kurigereranya bya gihanga n’amabuye abashakashatsi b’Abanyamerika bavanye ku rutare rwo ku kwezi, ubwo icyogajuru cya Apollo cyajyaga mu isanzure mu myaka ya 1960. Icyo gihe Abanyamerika bakuye ku kwezi amabuye angana n’ibiro 400 ku rutare rwaho. Abahanga bavuga ko ari gake cyane amabuye nk’aya ushobora kuyabona ku Isi ndetse nibura rimwe mu mabuye igihumbi gusa niryo wasanga ryaravuye ku kwezi, ku buryo iki cyafashwe nk’ikintu kidasanzwe. Ingoro ndangamateka nyinshi ziba zishaka kubika aya mabuye ku buryo abashaka kwiga iby’isanzure bajya bazisura bakayabona.

title: Samsung igiye gushyira ku isoko Galaxy Fold 2 na Galaxy Note 20
content: Samsung Galaxy Fold 2 na Samsung Galaxy Note 20 nizo telefoni ebyiri Samsung iteganya gushyira ku isoko muri uyu mwaka. Nk’ubwoko bwa Note, ni bumwe mu bwagiye bumanuka ku isoko kuko butacyitabirwa cyane, ariko Samsung irashaka kureba uburyo bwakongera gukundwa n’abandi benshi. Samsung Galaxy Fold 2 bivugwa ko izaba ifite Camera eshatu zirimo iya megapixel 12, 16 na 64. Igiciro cyayo nacyo gishobora kuzamanuka ugereranyije n’uko byari byitezwe aho ishobora kugura hagati ya $1780 na $1980 kugira ngo hongerwe umubare w’izishobora kuba zagurwa. Ni telefoni izaba ifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira internet yihuta ya 5G ndetse ifite n’ikaramu zimenyerewe (S-Pen) kuri telefoni za Samsung. Byitezwe ko kandi izaba ifite RAM ya GB 8, n’ububiko bwa GB 256 cyangwa 512. Galaxy Fold ya mbere yagiye hanze iri hejuru y’iyi igiye gusohoka kuko nko mu Bufaransa yaguraga amayero 2020. Byitezwe ko izi telefoni zombi zizamurikwa muri Kanama hanyuma muri Nzeri zikagera ku isoko.

title: Microsoft yungutse miliyari zisaga 10 z’amadolari mu mezi atatu kubera Coronavirus
content: Mu gihe cy’amezi asaga atatu abantu basaga kimwe cya kabiri cy’abatuye isi basabwe kuguma mu ngo za bo, abafite imirimo bakaba ari ho bayikomereza, byatumye uburyo bwo kubika amakuru kuri internet hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga rya Microsoft bukoreshwa cyane. Kuri uyu wa gatatu, tariki ya 29 Werurwe 2020, iki kigo cyatangaje ko inyungu cyabonye kuva muri Mutarama kugera muri Werurwe 2020, zazamutseho 15% ugereranyije n’umwaka ushize. Ibi byatumye umugabane umwe w’iki kigo ku isoko ry’imari n’imigabane rya Wall Street, ugera ku idolari 1.40, mu gihe byari biteganyijwe ko ugurwa ku idolari 1.27. Kuba abantu benshi baritabiriye gukoresha uburyo bwo kubika no kohererezanya ibijyanye n’akazi bakora, bifashishije uburyo bwa internet bwa Microsoft, byazibye icyuho cyari cyatewe no kudakoresha izindi serivisi iki kigo gisanzwe gitanga. Amafaranga yinjizwaga n’ibikorwa byo kwamamaza ndetse na porogaramu y’ishakiro ry’amakuru kuri internet (Bing) by’iki kigo yaragabanutse cyane kubera COVID-19. Gusa iki kigo kivuga ko porogaramu y’imikino yo kuri mudasobwa (Xbox games) n’indi ifasha abantu guhamagarana imbonankubone ku mashusho byakoreshejwe ku rwego rutari rwarigeze rubaho mbere. Umuyobozi mukuru wa Microsoft, Satya Nadella, avuga ko mu mezi abiri gusa babonye impinduka mu ikoranabuhanga bari kuzabona mu myaka ibiri iri imbere. Ati “Gukorana kandi buri wese ari mu rugo no kwiga, gucuruza no gutanga serivisi, kwitondera ibikorwa remezo bidufasha kubika no guhanahana amakuru kuri internet n’umutekano wa byo […] byatumye turushaho gukorana n’abakiriya bacu umunsi ku wundi, tukabafasha kumenyera ubu buryo kandi ubucuruzi bwa bo bugakomeza muri iyi si, aho ibintu byose biri gukorwa mu buryo bw’iyakure.” Uburyo bwo kubika amakuru kuri internet bwakozwe na Microsoft, burimo n’urubuga rwa ‘Azur’ bukoreshwa n’ibigo bitandukanye, bwinjije miliyari 12.8 z’amadolari agaragaza izamuka rya 27% mu mezi atatu ya mbere ya 2020.

title: Sobanukirwa neza itandukaniro rya ‘Operating System’ zikoreshwa muri mudasobwa
content: Mu ntangiriro z’Ikinyejana cya 19, Umwongereza Charles Babbage ni we wakoze mudasobwa ya mbere, ifatwa nk’iyahereweho hahimbwa izindi zirimo n’izo dukoresha ubu. Bishingiye ku nyota yo kongera ubushobozi bwa mudasobwa no kurushaho kuyibyaza umusaruro, abahanga bo mu Kinyejana cya 20 bakoze uko bashoboye kose, bakora mudasobwa zisumbya ubushobozi izari zarakozwe hashingiwe ku buhanga bwa Charles Babbage kuko zitari zikijyanye n’igihe ndetse ntizitange n’umusaruro ujyanye n’ubumenyi bwari bugezweho icyo gihe. Uramutse ukoresha mudasobwa mu kazi kawe cyangwa mu buryo busanzwe, birashoboka ko waba warumvise ijambo ‘Operating System’ rimwe cyangwa inshuro nyinshi. ‘Operating System’ ni gahunda ya mudasobwa ituma ibice byayo bifatika bigirana isano n’imikoranire ihuye neza, ku buryo nk’igihe umuntu ari kwandika akoresheje mudasobwa, inyuguti akanze ahita ayibona imbere mu kirahure cyayo nk’uko abyifuza. Muri make nta muntu ukwiye kugira ingingimira mu gushimangira ko ‘Operating System’ ari yo bwonko n’umutima bya mudasobwa, nubwo na yo ibarirwa mu bice bidafatika bigize mudasobwa (Softwares). Kubera ko iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga ryazanye n’ubucuruzi bujyanye na ryo; abakora porogaramu za mudasobwa (Softwares) bakoze ‘Operating System’ nke ugereranyije n’ubwinshi bw’izindi porogaramu zikora ibintu bimwe cyangwa se bijya gusa. ‘Operating System’ zizwi cyane kurusha izindi mu Isi y’ikoranabuhanga rya mudasobwa ni enye: Windows, MacOS, Chrome OS na Ubuntu Linux. Umuntu uguze mudasobwa bwa mbere nta guhitamo guhagije aba afite ku ikoreshwa rya ‘Operating System’ ijyanye n’ibyifuzo bye byose ijana ku ijana, kuko iziyoboye izindi mu gukoreshwa na benshi, na zo zigiye zifite buri imwe icyo itandukaniyeho cyangwa irusha iyindi. ‘Operating System’ ni yo ituma n’izindi porogaramu za mudasobwa zose zikora ibyo zagenewe nyuma yo gushyirwa muri mudasobwa. Buri ‘Operating System’ ifite ibyiza n’inenge yihariye Windows na MacOS ni zo zifatwa nk’izikomeye kurusha izindi, hashingiwe ku bikoresho zikoreshwamo, za porogaramu zijyana na zo ndetse n’imigaragarire ya zo (interface) muri mudasobwa. Chrome OS ikundirwa uburyo yubakitse neza kandi ikaba ikoreshwa mu bikoresho bihendutse, mu gihe Ubuntu Linux yo ikundirwa umutekano wa yo ndetse no kuba iboneka nta kiguzi. Windows: ni yo iri muri za mudasobwa nyinshi kurusha izindi zose ku Isi, bituma ari na yo izwi n’abantu benshi cyane. Ikoreshwa muri mudasobwa z’amoko atandukanye usibye Apple, ndetse ikagira ubushobozi bwo gukorana na porogaramu nyinshi bitagoranye cyangwa ngo bisabe undi mwihariko. Muri iki gihe, igezweho ni Windows 10 ivugwaho kuba igaragara neza kurusha izayibanjirije zo mu bwoko bumwe (Windows XP, Windows 7, Windows Vista na Windows 8). Nubwo Windows ishimirwa kuba ikora neza ibintu byinshi, inengwa kuba itaragira uburyo butekanye kandi budahindagurika nka ngenzi zayo za MacOS na Ubuntu Linux. Apple MacOS: Izwiho kugira ubushobozi buhambaye mu ikoranabuhanga rya mudasobwa rigezweho muri iki kinyejana cya 21 ndetse ikaba igaragara neza. Kubera ubukorikori n’ubuhanga abakoze iyi ‘Operating System’ bayihaye, byafashije abakoresha za porogaramu ziremereye nk’izifashishwa mu gukora amafoto, video, gushushanya imbata n’ibishushanyo mbonera by’ibikorwaremezo […] koroherwa n’akazi kabo. Abakoresha ikoranabuhanga bayinengera ko ikoreshwa muri mudasobwa, iPad na iPhone z’ubwoko bumwe bukorwa n’Uruganda rwa Apple gusa. Ikindi kibazo cya MacOS ni uko ugize ikibazo mu kuyikoresha, bigoranye ko abona umuha ubufasha mu buryo bworoshye kuko bisaba kubona abasanzwe bazobereye ibikoresho bya Apple, na bo bakiri bake cyane ku isi. Porogaramu z’imikino kuri MacOS ziracyari nke kuko zitorohera abazikora kuzihuza neza nayo. Ubuntu Linux: Icyo irusha izindi ‘Operating System’ ni uko yo nta kiguzi isaba mu kuyitunga kandi ikaba iguha ibyo ukeneye byose mu buryo bworoshye cyane. Nta buhanga bwinshi cyane bugamije inyungu Ubuntu Linux ikoranye kandi ishobora gushyirwa muri mudasobwa iyo ari yo yose ikoreshwamo Windows. Ubuntu Linux ishobora no gukoreshwa bitabaye ngombwa ko umuntu abanza kuyishyira muri mudasobwa, ahubwo ikaba iri ku kintu icyo ari cyo cyose wabasha kubikaho porogaramu ya mudasobwa nka USB n’ibindi. Iyi ‘Operating System’ ivugwaho kugaragara neza kandi ikorohereza abakoresha porogaramu zijyana na yo. Ku rundi ruhande ariko ivugwaho kuba ikoranye ubuhanga butamenyerewe na benshi kandi porogaramu zijyana na yo zikaba ziri inyuma mu ikoranabuhanga ugereranyije na Windows, Chrome OS na MacOS. Indi nenge ya Ubuntu Linux ni uko itajya ikoreshwaho porogaramu za Photoshop na Microsoft Office, nubwo hari izindi ifite zijya gukora kimwe n’izo zindi. Ubuntu Linux ishimirwa kuba itekanye kandi idahindagurika, bituma ikoreshwa cyane mu byitwa ‘servers’ kandi ikaba yubakanywe ubushobozi bwo guhangana na virus n’abazikora bagamije kwiba cyangwa kwangiza amakuru y’ikoranabuhanga. Google Chrome OS: Ni ‘Operating System’ ifatwa nk’iyaje korohereza ku buryo bukomeye abakoresha internet na porogaramu zijyana na yo. Igitekerezo cyo kuyikora gishingiye ku kuyigira ububiko bwo kuri internet bwa mbere bugezweho kandi bisa n’aho yarenze urwo rugero, kuko isigaye inafasha kuba umuntu yakoresha porogaramu zisanzwe zihariwe na telephone ngendanwa gusa. Imigaragarire ya Google Chrome OS iroroshye cyane kandi ibereye ijisho ry’abayikoresha ku buryo ntaho ihuriye na MacOS ndetse na Windows. Ikibazo gikomeye kinengwa kuri Chrome OS ni uko porogaramu za telephone yifashisha zihindagurika cyane kubera ko nyinshi muri zo ziba zarakorewe telephone kuruta mudasobwa. Chrome OS kandi ntikorana na porogaramu ya Adobe Photoshop, Microsoft Word n’izindi zitunganya video. Ku rundi ruhande ariko yihariye uburyo bwinshi bukurura abakoresha mudasobwa bashya, by’umwihariko abanyeshuri kuko hari porogaramu nyinshi zikubiyemo imfashanyigisho. Mu gihe ugiye guhitamo ‘Operating System’ ushyira muri mudasobwa yawe ni byiza ko ubanza kureba ubushobozi bwa mudasobwa cyangwa ikindi gikoresho nka telephone, iPad n’ibindi ushaka kuyikoreshamo. Ni ingenzi kandi kubanza ukareba za porogaramu zose zishobora gukoreshwamo, zirimo iz’imikino n’izikora ibintu byihariye nk’amafoto na video. Ugomba kandi kureba imigaragarire (Interface) y’iyo ‘Operating System’, applications z’inyongera ifite, uburyo ikorana na telephone ngendanwa ndetse n’ububiko bwo kuri internet. Icy’ingenzi kandi utagomba kwibagirwa ni ubushobozi bwa yo bwo kudahindagurika, umutekano wa yo n’amavugurura mashya (Updates) zigufasha kurushaho gukoresha mudasobwa yawe neza.

title: Google Meet ikoreshwa mu kuganira mu buryo bw’amashusho, yagizwe ubuntu ku bantu bose
content: Iyi sosiyete yatangaje ko ubu buri muntu wese ufite konti yayo [ni ukuvuga Gmail] ashobora gukoresha Google Meet ku buntu, agakorana inama n’abandi bagera ku ijana icyarimwe mu buryo bw’amashusho ikamara iminota yose bashaka. Nyuma ya tariki 30 Nzeri uyu mwaka, Google yatangaje ko izatangira kugena iminota 60 nk’igihe inama idashobora kurenza ku bifashisha Meet. Ni uburyo buje guhangana n’ubundi bwari busanzwe kuko nko kuri Zoom, iminota ntarengwa yari 40, gusa Facebook yo iherutse gutangaza ko nta minota ntarengwa ku bazajya bayikoresha baganira mu buryo bw’amashusho. Ubu buryo bwiswe “Google Meet” mu ntangiriro z’uku kwezi, mbere iyi serivisi yitwaga Hangouts Meet. Uku kuyihindurira izina kwaje mu gihe Google Meet yari itangiye gukura ku kigero cyo hejuru muri ibi bihe bya Coronavirus aho inama nyinshi zisigaye ziba hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga. Abantu bakoresha Google Meet biyongereye inshuro 25 ugereranyije n’abayikoreshaga muri Mutarama uyu mwaka. Mu kwezi gushize Google yatangaje ko iyi serivisi iri kwitabirwa n’abantu bashya barenga miliyoni ebyiri buri munsi.

title: Ikibuye kinini kiraza guca hafi y’Isi
content: Kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 29 Mata saa 11:53 nibwo iki kibuye kiza guca hafi y’Isi. Abahanga mu by’isanzure batangaje ko iki kibuye gifite ubugari bwa kilometero ziri hagati ya 1.5 na 4.1. Ikizwi magingo aya ni uko gifite ubugari kwa kilometero nibura ebyiri, ni ingano ishobora kwangiza Isi mu buryo bukomeye mu gihe iki kibuye cyaba kiyigonze, gusa ibyo ntibiza kubaho. Mu gihe kiraza kuba gica ku Isi, umuntu yavuga ko kiraza kuba ari umuturanyi wa hafi cyane wayo. Impamvu ni uko kiza kuba kiri mu ntera ya kilometero miliyoni 6,29; intera yikubye inshuro 16 y’iziri hagati y’Isi n’Ukwezi.

title: Facebook yavuguruye uburyo abantu baganira hifashishijwe amashusho
content: Magingo aya, Facebook yakoze porogaramu nshya yo kuganira hifashishijwe amashusho igendeye ku yitwa Messenger yari isanzweho. Ubu uburyo bushya Facebook bwitwa Messenger Rooms. Buzafasha nibura abantu 50 kuba bagirana inama mu buryo bw’amashusho, hatabayeho kugena igihe icyo kiganiro kigomba kumara. Ubusanzwe nka Zoom, ifite ubushobozi bwo guhurirwaho n’abantu 100 ariko ntibemerewe kumara iminota irenze 40 muri icyo kiganiro. Abakoresha Facebook bashobora gutumira abantu kuri Messenger Rooms nubwo bo baba batagira konti za Facebook. Ubu buryo Facebook irateganya no kubushyira ku zindi mbuga nkoranyambaga zayo nka WhatsApp na Instagram.

title: Motorola yashyize ku isoko telefoni zigezweho za Edge na Edge Plus
content: Uruganda rwa Motorola rwari rumenyerewe mu gukora telefoni ziciriritse, muri iki cyumweru rwashyize ku isoko telefoni zigezweho, Motorola Edge na Edge Plus. Zije ku isoko zisanga iyazibimburiye, Motorola Razr yasohotse mu 2019, ndetse zitezweho guhindura uburyo uru ruganda rwafatwaga ku isoko kubera ikoranabuhanga zifite. Telefoni za Motorola Edge na Edge Plus zitezweho guhangana ku isoko n’izindi za Samsung, OnePlus na Apple. Motorola Edge Plus igura $ 1000 kimwe na Samsung Galaxy S20, ifite ikirahuri kingana n’icya Galaxy S20 Plus na batiri ifite ubushobozi bwo kurambana umuriro ya mAh 5.000, n’akarusho ka camera y’inyuma ifite ubushobozi bwa megapixel 108 nka Galaxy S20 Ultra. Motorola Edge Plus ni telefoni kandi yubakiye kuri Android 10, camera y’imbere ifite ubushobozi bwa megapixels 25, ubushobozi bwo gufata amashusho ya 6K, ububiko bwa 256GB na RAM ya 12GB. Ni mu gihe nka Motorola Edge nayo ikoresha Android 10, camera y’imbere ya megapixels 25, ubushobozi bwo gufata amashusho ya 4K, ububiko bwa 128GB na RAM ya 10GB. Edge Plus kandio ifite batiri ya 5,000 mAh mu gihe Edge gusa ifite iya 4500 mAh. Izi telefoni zombi kandi zishobora gukoresha internet ya 5G.

title: Hatangiye gukoreshwa ikoranabuhanga ryitezweho kugoboka abarimu 10 000 bahagaritswe mu kazi
content: Iri koranabuhanga ryitezweho gutanga igisubizo ku kibazo cyatangiye kugaragara nyuma y’aho Inama y’Abaminisitiri yo ku wa 30 Mata 2020 igamije kwiga ku cyorezo cya COVID-19 n’ingamba zo gukomeza kukirwanya, ifashe umwanzuro ko amashuri azakomeza gufunga kugeza muri Nzeri. Aya makuru akimenyekana abanyeshuri batangiye kwibaza niba batagiye kudindira mu masomo yabo ndetse biba intandaro yo kubura akazi ku barimu bo mu mashuri yigenga kuko ibigo bakorera byahise bibahagarika. Kuva aba barimu bahagarikwa ntibasibye kugaragaza ko iki cyemezo cyagize ingaruka ku mibereho yabo. Mu rwego rwo kuziba icyuho, hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga Loxotech yashyizeho urubuga rwitwa Homeskull. Binyuze kuri uru rubuga abarimu bazajya biyandikisha ubundi basabwe gutanga imyirondoro yabo igaragaza aho bigishije, nyuma yo kugenzurwa n’ikipe ifite ubumenyi buhagije mu burezi bigenwe niba bahabwa akazi cyangwa batagahabwa. Ku banyeshuri bifuza guhabwa aya masomo nabo bazajya bafungura konti kuri uru rubuga, ubundi batange amafaranga runaka azanifashishwa mu kwishyura abarimu. Amasomo azajya atangirwa kuri uru buga ni ayo mu mashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye ariko umwana akazajya aba afite uburenganzira bw’umubare runaka w’amasomo ashaka kwiga. Umwe mu bashinze uru rubuga Nshizirungu Olivier avuga ko ruzaba isoko y’akazi ku barimu. Yagize ati “Dushobora guha akazi abarimu ibihumbi 10, mu gihe abana baba bamaze kubyitabira, ntabwo tuzafata abarimu 10 000 bose ngo tubahere akazi icyarimwe abana bose bataramara kuza ku rubuga, uko bazajya biyongera niko tuzajya twongera n’umubare w’abarimu” Nshizirungu akomeza avuga ko uru rubuga rutaje gusimbura amashuri asanzwe. Yakomeje agira ati “Ni ubufasha turi gutanga ntabwo uru rubuga ruje gusimbura amashuri yari asanzwe, icyo rugiye gukora ni ugufasha abana kwiga kugira ngo bazajye gusubira mu mashuri bataratakaye.” Uru rubuga ruzanafasha abanyeshuri bifuza gukomeza amasomo yabo muri ibi bihe bya COVID-19 ariko bakaba bafite imbogamizi zo kubona abarimu cyane ko batabasanga mu rugo kuko bitemewe. Kuri Nshizirungu yemeza ko ubu buryo buzaba bufite umwihariko “ku rubuga rwacu umwana azajya agira ubushobozi bwo kwiga arebana na mwarimu hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga kandi amubaze ibibazo byose ashaka kumubaza ndetse mu gihe umwana azaba atabyumvise amashusho yafashwe azajya yibika abashe kongera kuyareba.” Yakomeje avuga hazajya hagenzurwa uburyo umwarimu yigisha “Mu gihe tubonye ko hari abarimu batari gutanga ibyo abanyeshuri babitezeho tuzabasaba kwikosora n’ibinanirana bibe byabaganisha mu gukurwaho.” Nshizirungu avuga ko ubu buryo buzorohereza abana bazaba bagiye gukora ibizamini bya Leta kuko amasomo yose bazaba barahawe azabikwa ahantu hamwe bakazajya babasha kuyasubiramo uko babishaka. Abarimu bazahabwa akazi ko kwigisha binyuze kuri uru rubuga bazajya babona umushahara udashobora kujya munsi y’ibihumbi 150 Frw ariko unashobora kwiyongera bitewe n’umubare w’amasomo n’abanyeshuri yigisha. Mu gihe gito uru rubuga rumaze rutangiye abanyeshuri 50 n’abarimu 15 batangiye kurukoresha.

title: MTN yashyizeho uburyo bworoshye bwo kwishyura abamotari n’ibihembo ku bazabukoresha cyane
content: Ubu buryo kandi MTN Rwanda ibutangije nyuma y’amabwiriza yatanzwe n’Urwego Ngenzuramikorere, RURA rusaba abamotari bose kwishyurwa hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga. Binyuze muri MoMoPay, abagenzi bazajya babasha kwishyura abamotari amafaranga y’urugendo mu buryo bworoshye kandi bwizewe. Gukoresha ubwo buryo birasaba gukanda *182*8*1#, ugashyiramo kode umumotari akoresha kuri MoMoPay ubundi ushyiremo amafaranga y’urugendo ugiye kumwishyura wemeze. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi muri MTN Rwanda, Chantal Kagame yavuze ko MTN Rwanda yiyemeje kuba ku isonga mu guteza imbere ihererekanya ry’amafaranga ryifashishije ikoranabuhanga no gukumira icyorezo cya coronavirus. Yagize ati “Twishimiye gufasha abamotari kwakira amafaranga yabo bifashishije MoMoPay. Mu gihe twubahiriza ingamba zashyizweho na Guverinoma y’u Rwanda mu kwirinda ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus, twiyemeje kugendana na gahunda y’igihugu yo kudahererekanya amafaranga mu ntoki.” MTN Rwanda yatangaje ko mu gukomeza gushishikariza abamotari gukoresha ubwo buryo bishyurwa, hagiye kujya hatangwa ibihembo kabiri mu cyumweru ku bahiga abandi mu kubukoresha. Ibihembo bazahabwa bizaba birimo moto nshyashya, casques, kugabanyirizwa ibiciro ku bikomoka kuri peteroli moto zabo zikoresha kuri sitasiyo za lisansi n’ibindi. MTN Rwanda kandi yiyemeje gufasha abamotari kubona udupfukamunwa tuzajya dutangirwa kuri sitasiyo za lisansi zitandukanye zikorana na MTN mu mujyi wa Kigali. MTN Rwanda kandi mu bufatanya na banki ya NCBA, yiyemeje gutanga inguzanyo ku bakiliya bayo muri ibi bihe byo kwirinda icyorezo hifashishijwe MoKash, mu bo iyo nguzanyo igenewe harimo n’abamotari. Ku bari barafashe inguzanyo bakananirwa kuyishyura mu gihe cy’iminsi 30 yagenwe, MTN Rwanda na NCBA babakuriyeho amande y’ubukererwe ndetse bongererwa indi minsi 30 yo kuba bishyuye. Umukiliya utabashije kwishyura ideni rye mu minsi 60 cyangwa 90, ntabwo azajya agabanyirizwa ingano y’amafaranga yemerewe kuguza nkuko byari bisanzwe. Mu gihe kandi inguzanyo ntarengwa igiye kugabanywa, umukiliya azajya ahabwa iminsi 30 yo kwitegura. MoKash ni uburyo bwo kubitsa, kubikuza no kugurizwa buboneka kuri MTN Rwanda ukanze *182*5#). Inguzanyo yo kuri MoKash yishyurwa mu gihe cy’iminsi 30, hiyongereyeho inyungu ya 9 %, naho uwabikijeho amafaranga yungukirwa 7 % ku mwaka.

title: Sobanukirwa uko internet ya 5G izahindura ubuzima bwa muntu
content: Ni umuyoboro ugereranywa nk’intambwe nshya ndetse na none nk’itafari rizaganisha ku rugendo ruhindura buri kimwe, uhereye ku buvuzi bwifashishije ikoranabuhanga nk’aho umuganga ashobora kubaga umuntu kandi batari kumwe, ikoranabuhanga mu modoka, mu buzima busanzwe ku buryo waba uri ku kazi ugacana imbabura wasize mu rugo n’ibindi bizwi nka Internet of Things. Ni byinshi, ariko wakwibaza impamvu abantu muri iki gihe bashishikariye 5G! Ni iki cyayo cyiza gitandukanye n’ibisanzwe cyangwa se ni ibiki izahindura mu buzima bwa muntu? Mu Kinyarwanda cyoroshye, 5G wayisobanura nk’icyiciro cya gatanu cy’ikoranabuhanga ryihutisha amakuru kurusha ibisanzwe. Gusa iyo tuvuze kwihuta bisobanurwa kwinshi. Nko muri Amerika, sosiyete y’itumanaho ya Verizon iherutse gukora igerageza kuri 5G, isanga ishobora kwihuta nk’igihe umuntu amanura ibintu (download), akabona gigabits 1.0 ku isegonda (1.0 Gbps). Ni ukuvuga ngo ni nk’inshuro ziri hagati y’icumi na 100 z’umuvuduko usanzwe, ndetse ni umuvuduko mwinshi utanabona no ku miyoboro ya fibre optique, bisobanuye ko uyifashishije ushobora kumanura kuri internet ibintu amagana ku muvuduko wo hejuru. Ntabwo ari umuvuduko gusa. Niba uri kuri internet ugakanda ku kintu runaka ugiye gusoma, hari umwanya bifata kugira ngo rwa rupapuro wakanzeho rufunguke (mu cyongereza bizwi nka Latency). Ubusanzwe bishobora kumara milliseconde 20 [mu isegonda rimwe harimo milliseconde 1000) kugira ngo rwa rupapuro rufunguke, ariko kuri 5G ni munsi ya milliseconde imwe. Bifate nk’aho ari nk’igihe bitwara kugira ngo telefoni yawe itere umurabyo mu gihe uri gufotora. Ikindi cyiza cyayo ni uko yo ifite ubushobozi bwo kuba wacomekaho ibikoresho byinshi by’ikoranabuhanga kurusha ibyo washyira kuri internet isanzwe, ukayifashisha mu rugo wenda ucometseho firigo yawe ikaza kuguha amakuru ko ibintu birimo harimo ibyakonje cyane cyangwa se ibigiye kubora n’ibindi. Wumvise ibyo ikora, uhita wibaza ku giciro cyayo. Ubu mu Rwanda ntabwo ihari wenda ku buryo twarebera ku bintu byo hafi yacu, ariko nko muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, sosiyete z’itumanaho ziri kwishyuza nibura amadolari 10 yiyongera ku yari asanzwe yishyurwa n’umuntu ku kwezi; uru ni urugero rwa Verizon. Kugira ngo ukoreshe 5G bisaba ko uba ufite igikoresho kiyakira, ntabwo ari ikibonetse cyose. Urugero nka telefoni, nyinshi ziri gusohoka zigezweho zakira 5G, kimwe n’uko hamaze iminsi hasohoka izakira 4G. Umwaka ushize Sumsung yashyize ku isoko Samsung Galaxy S10 ishobora kwakira 5G. Ikindi ni uko telefoni nyinshi zashyizwe ku isoko mu ntangiriro z’umwaka ushize usanga zikoresha ikoranabuhanga rizifasha kwakira no gutanga amakuru ryakozwe na Qualcomm, [Snapdragon X50], rizibashisha no kwakira 5G. Uyu mwaka byitezwe ko hazashyirwa ku isoko telefoni nyinshi zakira 5G kurusha ushize.

title: Bwa mbere mu myaka icyenda, icyogajuru cyagiye mu isanzure gihagurukiye ku butaka bwa Amerika
content: Hari hashize imyaka icyenda nta cyogajuru gihagurutse ku butaka bwa Amerika kijyanye abanyamerika ku isanzure, gusa ubu byashobotse nyuma y’icyo gihe kinini cyari gishize. Muri iyi myaka yose yari ishize [kuva mu 2011], abanyamerika bajyaga ku isanzure bakoresheje ibyogajuru by’Abarusiya ndetse akaba ariho banakoreraga imyitozo, ni ibintu byatwaye Amerika miliyoni 86 z’amadolari. Iki cyogajuru cyagombaga kuba cyaroherejwe mu isanzure ku wa Gatatu w’icyumweru gishize gusa biza gusubikwa nyuma yo kubona ko mu kirere harimo imirabyo gahunda ishyirwa kuri uyu wa Gatandatu. Cyohererejwe muri Leta ya Florida ahari ikigo kimwe mu icumi bya Nasa bigenzura ibijyanye n’isanzure cyitwa Kennedy Space Center. Kohereza iki cyogajuru bitumye Amerika itera indi ntambwe mu rugendo ruganisha ku kuba ba mukerarugendo bashobora kujya ku isanzure. Iki cyogajuru cyari gitwaye Robert Behnken w’imyaka 49 na Douglas Hurley wa 53. Bazamara mu isanzure amasaha 19. Cyahagurutse 21:20 z’ijoro kuri uyu wa Gatandatu ku isaha y’i Kigali. Iki cyogajuru kiri mu mushinga wa SpaceX witwa Dragon 2, cyari kimaze imyaka 15 gikorwa.

title: Facebook yatangije ihahiro ku mbuga zayo zitandukanye
content: Ibi ngo bizafasha ibigo bito n’ibiciriritse kureshya abakiliya babyo aho baherereye hose, bagure ibicuruzwa bitandukanye bifashishije uburyo bwa “Facebook Shops”. Mark Zuckerberg uyobora Facebook yavuze ko gukora iduka hifashishijwe Facebook ari ubuntu ku bigo byose bibyifuza kuko ikigamijwe ari ukwamamaza ibicuruzwa bitandukanye. Yongeyeho ko iduka runaka niryaguka rikagira agaciro nk’ak’ikigo kinini mu bucuruzi, na bo bazunguka amafaranga kuko abantu bakoresha Facebook bagura ibicuruzwa bazaba biyongereye. Ibigo bito n’ibiciriritse bizakoresha ‘Facebook Shops’ bizaba bifite uburyo bwo kwishyura amatangazo yamamaza, azabifasha gukurura abaguzi batandukanye bakerekeza ku iduka ryabo mu buryo bworoshye haba kuri Facebook na Instagram. Biteganyijwe ko ubu buryo bw’iduka ryo kuri internet Facebook izanabushyira ku zindi mbuga nkoranyambaga zayo za Messenger na WhatsApp, ku buryo bizongera n’igihe abakoresha izo mbuga nkoranyambaga bamara bazikoresha. Byitezwe ko abazashaka kugurira ibintu bitandukanye kuri Facebook bazajya babona amoko menshi y’ibintu bigezweho kandi bakaba banakwishyura ibyo bahashye bitabasabye kujya ku zindi mbuga za internet. Imikorere yagutse y’iri hahiro Facebook yatangije izaba iri gukora neza mu mezi abiri ari imbere, aho ibigo bisaga miliyoni 160 bizaba byamaze gushyirwaho neza. Facebook ivuga ko iri koranabuhanga rizafasha cyane ibigo byari bitangiye guhungabana kubera Coronavirus kandi rikazarushaho gukoreshwa cyane muri iki gihe Isi iri kwitabira isoko ryo kuri internet. Kwamamaza hakoreshejwe video z’ako kanya ni bumwe mu buryo buzabyazwa umusaruro muri iri soko rya Facebook kuko abantu basaga miliyoni 800 bareba video zo kuri Facebook na Instagram buri munsi.

title: Abakoreshaga Google Play Music bahawe uburyo bwo kwimukira kuri YouTube Music
content: Kubera kunanirwa guhangana ku isoko rya porogaramu zumvirwaho imiziki, Google Play Music yahisemo gukuramo akayo karenge. Mu butumwa buherutse kunyuzwa ku rubuga rwa Youtube, Google Play yatangaje ko abayikoreshaga bemerewe kohereza ibintu byabo bari bayifiteho ku bubiko bwa YouTube Music. Hashyizweho uburyo, aho uwari usanzwe afite indirimbo ze yashyize kuri Google Play Music azajya yinjiramo akabona ahantu hamusaba kuba yakohereza indirimbo ze kuri YouTube Music. Yaba ibyo yamanuye kuri internet, umuziki, ibyo yakunze cyangwa atakunze n’ibindi bizahita byoherezwa ako kanya kuri YouTube Music, ku buryo ibyo yari asanzwe abona azakomeza kubibona uko byakabaye. Google Play Music ntabwo yigeze ihirwa cyane mu isoko ryo gucuruza no gucuranga umuziki kuko sosiyete Spotify ariyo iza imbere kuko yihariye 36 % by’isoko ryose, igakurikirwa na Apple Music yihariye 18 % mu gihe Google Play Music iza mu myanya y’inyuma kuko yihariye 5 %.

title: Netflix igiye guhagarika konti z’abantu bamaze igihe batayikoresha kandi bishyura
content: Netflix yerekana ibiganiro byo mu bihugu bitandukanye biciye kuri internet birimo nka filime mbarankuru n’iz’ubundi bwoko, ariko bigasaba kubanza kuba umufatabuguzi. Kuba umufatabuguzi wa Netflix, umuntu asabwa amafaranga ari hagati y’amadolari arindwi na $ 14 ku kwezi bitewe n’icyiciro ashaka kubarizwamo. Akurwa kuri konti ye yatanze yiyandikasha bwa mbere. Ubuyobozi bwa Netflix bwatangaje ko bwasanze hari abantu bakurwaho amafaranga buri kwezi nyamara badaheruka kugira icyo bareba kuri urwo rubuga. Bwatangaje ko konti zigaragaza kumara umwaka zitanga amafaranga ariko nta kintu zireba zigiye guhagarikwa. Ni umwanzuro ugamije gufasha abakiliya bibagiwe ko biyandikishije kuri Netflix, kudasesagura amafaranga yabo. Abakiliya bamaze umwaka batareba amashusho kuri Netflix ariko bishyura, bazandikirwa bamenyeshwe, babazwe niba bagikeneye kubana na Netflix. Mu gihe uwabajijwe adasubije, konti ye izahagarikwa. Uzashaka kongera kuba umukiliya azabisaba konti ye ikangurwe. Netflix yatangaje ko abantu bangana na 0.5 % by’abakiliya bayo aribo babarizwa muri icyo cyiciro cy’abishyura batareba. Netflix irebwa mu bihugu 190 hirya no hino ku Isi, aho ifite abakiliya basaga miliyoni 182. Yabonye abayikoresha bashya bagera kuri miliyoni 16 muri ibi bihe bya Coronavirus.

title: Australie yaciye agahigo mu kugira internet yihuta kurusha izindi ku Isi
content: Itsinda ryo muri Kaminuza yitwa Monash, Swinburne na RMIT niryo ryakoze ubwo bushakashatsi. Ryifashishije agakoresho gato bashyize mu muyoboro ukoreshwa mu guhanahana amakuru mu itumanaho rikoreshwa mu Mujyi wa Melbourne. Ako gakoresho bagashyize ku muyoboro usanzwe ukoreshwa n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu muri Australie gishinzwe umuyoboro wa internet, aba ariwo wakoreraho ubushakashatsi. Aba bahanga bavuze ko mu gihe cy’imyaka ibiri cyangwa itatu, bene ako gakoresho kazaba kaboneka ku buryo kakoreshwa mu bushakashatsi hanyuma mu gihe cy’imyaka itanu kagatangira gucuruzwa. Magingo aya, Singapore niyo icuruza internet yihuta kurusha izindi zose aho umuturage ashobora kugura internet imuha megabyte (mbps) 197.3 mu isegonda. Ubusanzwe muri Australie, ikigereranyo cy’uburyo internet yihuta kiri kuri mbps 43.4, igenda gahoro nibura inshuro 1000 ugereranyije n’iyo aba bashakashatsi babonye mu igerageza ryabo. Iyo internet babonye, ihesha umuntu uri kuyikoresho ubushobozi bwo kuba yamanura (download) filimi nibura 1000 zifite amashusho ya HD mu gihe cy’isegonda. Nko mu Bwongereza ho, umuyoboro mugari wa internet uvuduka ku kigero cya mbps 64. Ako gakoresho bifashishije kugira ngo babone iyi internet, kari mu bwoko bumwe n’akifashishwa mu miyoboro migari ya internet (fibre-optique) hirya no hino ku Isi. Ibyavuye muri ubu bushakashatsi, byatanze isura y’uko mu gihe kiri imbere internet izaba imeze hirya no hino ku Isi.

title: Hakozwe agapfukamunwa korohereza abantu kurya batagakuyemo
content: Ni agapfukamunwa kameze nk’utundi twose ariko gafite umwanya hasi ushobora kunyuzwamo ibiryo mu gihe umuntu ari ku meza. Uwo mwanya ufungurwa iyo umuntu agiye kurya, yarangiza akongera akawufunga cyangwa ukifunga. Asaf Gitelis, Umuyobozi w’ikigo Avtipus Patents and Inventions cyakoze utwo dupfukamunwa, yavuze ko hari udufungurwa mu buryo busanzwe hakoreshejwe intoki n’utundi twifungura iyo ikanya cyangwa ikiyiko cyegereye umunwa, dukoze mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga. Yagize ati “Ushobora kurya, kunywa ukishimisha hanyuma wamara kurangiza kurya ugafunga ukirinda kandi ukanarinda abo muri kumwe.” Icyo kigo cyatangaje ko mu gihe kitarenze ukwezi baraba atangiye gukora udupfukamunwa tw’ubwo bwoko twinshi. Kamwe kazajya kagurwa hagati y’amadolari 0.85 n’amadolari 2.85.

title: Google Chrome igiye gutangira gukumira amatangazo yamamaza amara internet n’umuriro by’abakiliya bayo
content: Amatangazo azibandwaho akaba ari akoresha internet nyinshi n’umuriro mwinshi wa telefone cyangwa mudasobwa by’abakiliya. Google yatangaje ko ubwo buryo buzatangira gukoreshwa muri Kanama uyu mwaka. Iyo sosiyete yatangaje ko baje kuvumbura ko hari amatangazo yamamaza aza iyo umuntu ari kureba ibintu runaka kuri internet, agatwara umuriro mwinshi wa telefone ye cyangwa ama-inite ya telefone nyirayo atabizi. Google ivuga ko akenshi ayo matangazo abayakoze baba batarayakoze neza ku buryo akoresha umuriro mwinshi cyangwa internet nyinshi. Yatangaje ko bihombya umukiliya ukoresha Google Chrome kuko ama-inite ye ashobora gushira atayakoresheje cyangwa umuriro wa telefone ye ugashira atabizi. Amatangazo azajya akumirwa ku bakoresha Google Chrome ni ashobora gukoresha internet ya megabit 4 cyangwa se ashobora kwiharira 27 % bya internet yose yakoreshejwe n’amatangazo yamamaza. Google chrome ni isiakiro rya Internet ryatangijwe mu 2008, rihanganye n’andi mashakiro nka Internet Explorer na Firefox yari yarabanje mu kibuga. Chrome yakomeje guhatana iza kwigarurira benshi mu bakoresha internet. Kugeza mu mpera za 2019, telefone miliyari eshanu ku isi zari zirimo porogaramu ya Google Chrome.

title: My Airtel app: Uburyo bworoshye bwo kwishyura serivisi nyinshi ukoresheje telefone yawe
content: Igitangaje, ntabwo ari benshi bifashisha icyo gikoresho nkoranabuhanga mu gihe bishyura amafaranga ya internet ituma icyo gikoresho gikora, turacyahata inzira amaguru tujya mu maduka kugura ama-inite yo gukoresha, tukirirwana amafaranga mu mufuka hato akaba yanakwibwa ngo tugiye guhaha. Airtel iri guhindura iyo migirire ya kera, itangiza uburyo bwa MyAirtel app aho serivisi hafi ya zose ushobora kuzishyurira kuri telefone yawe bitabaye ngombwa ko uva aho uri. Serivise ziri muri ‘My Airtel App’ zirimo izo kugura ama-inite, internet, kwishyura ibyo ukeneye byose nk’amazi, amashanyarazi, ifatabuguzi rya televiziyo, kohereza amafaranga haba mu Rwanda no mu mahanga, byose bigakorwa hifashishijwe ikarita ya banki cyangwa Airtel Money. Iyi porogaramu ya telefone ikumenya guhera ku munsi wa mbere ukiyikoresha, ibiri kuri nimero yawe ya telefone ibimenya uko biri kose ku buryo igihe ugiye kuyikoresha bitakugora. Iyi porogaramu ibika ibyo wayikoreyeho bitewe n’icyo wishyuye cyangwa waguze, icyo wohereje n’ibindi, ku buryo iyo wongeye kugira icyo ukoraho wakoreyeho ubushize, ikwereka ibisigaye. Urugero niba uguze megabytes zo gukoresha kuri internet, zishira uzireba ku buryo utajya mu ihurizo ryo kwisanga internet yashize. Ni uburyo bukorwa mu kanya gato kurusha kubikorera kuri internet. Hari n’uburyo bwo kwiyoherereza inyemezabwishyu y’icyo umaze kugura ukoresheje iyo porogaramu. Iyi porogaramu ya MyAirtel app ikomeje gushimwa na benshi batangiye kuyikoresha. Ntabwo ari ngombwa gukoresha ubundi buryo bwo kwishyura urenze telefone yawe, manura iyo porogaramu ubuzima bworohe. ‘My Airtel App’ ikora igihe cyose (amasaha 24 ku minsi 7), inafasha abayikoresha gukurikirana buri gihe ibibera kuri konti za bo za banki na Airtel Money bitabagoye na gato, ndetse ikaba idasaba kuba umuntu afite internet mu gihe ari kuyikoresha. Umutekano w’iyi ‘Application’ wizewe ku rwego rwo hejuru kuko itemerera undi muntu kuba yakoresha imyirondoro yawe agamije kwiba amafaranga ufite kuri konti iyo ari yo yose, cyangwa gukora ikindi kintu cyabangamira umukiliya wa Airtel uyikoresha. Akarusho kandi ni uko kugura ama-inite ukoresheje iyi porogaramu biguhesha uburenganzira bwo guhabwa inyongera ndetse koherereza undi muntu byo bikaguhesha inyongera ya 5% by’ama-inite yose wohereje. Iyi porogaramu izorohereza abajyaga bagorwa no gufata mu mutwe za kode zitandukanye mu kugura cyangwa gukoresha serivise za Airtel, kuko buri kimwe cyose cyorohejwe muri ‘My Airtel App’ igisigarana. Umuntu ukeneye gukoresha iyi porogaramu ajya muri ’Play Store’ kubakoresha telefoni za ’Android’ cyangwa ’App Store’ ku bakoresha iOS; ukandika mu ishakiro "My Airtel", hakaza ifite amagambo ya ’Airtel Africa’, ubundi ukayishyira muri telefone yawe nk’uko bikorwa ku zindi porogaramu. Umaze kuyishyiramo, urayifungura, ukuzuzamo nomero yawe, ubundi ugakurikiza amabwiriza ajyanye n’ibyo bagusaba.

title: Ikoranabuhanga rya Tap&Go rigeze kure rinozwa ngo risakazwe mu gihugu hose
content: Serivizi zo gutwara abantu mu modoka niho hakunze kugaragara cyane ihererekanya ry’amafaranga, gusa mu Mujyi wa Kigali ho byaracitse kuko abakoresha imodoka rusange bashyiriweho amakarita azwi nka Tap&Go aho umuntu ayishyira ku modoka akagenda, ikibazo kikaba kikigaragara cyane ku modoka zikora ingendo mu Ntara. Urwego Ngenzuramikorere RURA, rwavuze ko iyi gahunda y’ikoranabuhanga imaze kugezwa hamwe na mu gihugu ariko bagikomeje kuyinoza kugira ngo abantu bareke guhererekanya amafaranga hirindwa icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa RURA, Lt Col Patrick Nyirishema, yabwiye itangazamakuru ati “No mu Ntara iryo koranabuhanga ryarahageze gusa iki cyorezo cyaje bitarakwirakwiza mu ngendo zose, gusa nk’ubu abantu bagana mu Majyaruguru mu nzira zijya i Musanze, Rubavu cyangwa se ujya i Huye uvuye i Kigali birakora, muri make ahantu hamwe na hamwe mu gihugu rirakoreshwa, turimo kureba uko ryakwirakwizwa n’ahandi ritaragera kugira ngo aho bagikoresha amafaranga biveho.” Yavuze ko uburyo ryateganyijwe ari uko bigenda bitandukanaho gato n’uko bimeze mu Mujyi Kigali. Ati “Ubundi ingendo zo mu Ntara uko ziteye ni uko umuntu agura itike akava wenda i Kigali akajya i Musanze, turimo kureba uko byahuzwa n’irikoreshwa i Kigali, ariko hakaba hanabaho gukoresha telefoni ku buryo nayo yajya ikora nk’ikarita kandi iryo koranabuhanga tumaze kurigera kure.” Niba umuntu ashaka kujya nk’i Rubavu azajya afata telefone ye ashake Porogaramu ya Tap&Go yinjiremo hanyuma ufungure konti akoresheje amazina na nimero za telefone, abone aho kugurira itike bitewe n’aho agiye. Yongeyeho ati “Twagiye kwinjira mu cyorezo cya Coronavirus hari byinshi bimaze gukorwa nubwo byose byari bitarajya ahagaragara, ubu twongeye kubisubukura kugira ngo tubyihutishe, icyo twifuza ni uko mu minsi iri imbere abantu bava mu gukoresha amafaranga mu ntoki.” Yavuze ko ibi bitazakorwa gusa ku modoka ahubwo RURA iteganya ko mu gihe moto zizaba zitangiye gukora, harebwa uko abantu bazajya bakoresha amatelefoni bakishyura. Hashize imyaka irenga ine mu Rwanda hatangiye uburyo bwo kwishyura ingendo hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga rizwi nka Tap&Go. Ryakemuye byinshi, rinanoza imitangire ya serivisi mu gutwara abantu.

title: Kurangiza imanza za cyamunara n’inyandiko mpesha byatangiye gukorerwa mu ikoranabuhanga (Video)
content: Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru cyo kuri uyu wa Gatatu, tariki ya 13 Gicurasi 2020, cyari kigamije gusobanura byimbitse ibijyanye n’iteka rya Minisitiri ryerekeye uburyo bwo guca imanza hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga; Minisiteri y’Ubutabera yasobanuye ibizahinduka mu mirangirize y’imanza za cyamunara n’inyandiko mpesha [inyandiko itegeka ko umuntu ahabwa umutungo runaka]. Umuyobozi Mukuru Ushinzwe Serivisi yo Kwegereza Ubutabera abaturage muri MINIJUST, Urujeni Martine, yavuze ko gutangira gukoresha iri koranabuhanga bifitiye akamaro impande zitandukanye zifite aho zihuriye n’ubutabera, haherewe ku muturage. Kuva iri teka ritangajwe, hashyizweho urubuga rwa internet ruzajya rwifashishwa n’abahesha b’inkiko bose, abaturage bafite imitungo byanzuwe n’urwego rubifitiye ububasha cyangwa habarabayeho ubwumvikane hagati y’impande ebyiri ko izatezwa cyamunara, n’izindi nzego zizajya zikurikirana ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’imyanzuro y’imanza zishingiye ku mitungo itezwa cyamunara. Urujeni yavuze ko zimwe mu mpinduka zazanywe n’iri koranabuhanga ari uko nta rubanza rwa cyamunara cyangwa inyandiko mpesha bizongera kurangizwa bidakorewe mu ikoranabuhanga, kandi ko hari n’uburyo bwateganyijwe igihe habayeho ikibazo muri iryo koranabuhanga. Ati "Bizihutisha irangizamanza n’inyandiko mpesha; ubundi hari hari ibibazo bitandukanye byaturukaga ku mpande zose, ugasanga uregwa, urega cyangwa umuhesha w’inkiko […] umwe muri bo agize uruhare mu kudindira kw’irangizarubanza." Yakomeje avuga ko bizongera umucyo mu guca urubanza, aho umuhesha w’inkiko azaba afite inzira zose zifashishwa mu kurangiza urubanza mu buryo bukwiye, byose bikorewe mu ikoranabuhanga. Bizafasha kandi inzego zitandukanye gukurikirana no kugenzura imikorere y’abahesha b’inkiko ku buryo bukurikije amategeko. Umwanditsi Mukuru mu Kigo cy’Iterambere, RDB, Richard Kayibanda, ashimangira ko iri koranabuhanga rishya rizagura isoko muri cyamunara kuko buri wese azagira uburenganzira bungana n’ubwa mugenzi we mu kugura umutungo aho yaba ari hose. Ati "Bizanakemura ikibazo cy’abakomisiyoneri bajyaga bateza akavuyo ku munsi wa cyamurana, bikanica isoko rimwe na rimwe ku buryo hari n’aho cyamunara yasubikwaga." Mu byo umuntu unyuze muri iri koranabuhanga azajya asabwa kugira ngo yemererwe gupiganwa muri cyamunara, harimo ko azajya atanga ingwate ingana na 5% y’agaciro k’umutungo upiganirwa; akayasubizwa igihe atawegukanye, mu gihe kitarenze iminsi itatu, uwawegukanye we akazajya ayaheraho yishyura igiciro cyose. Ingwate ya 5% iteganyijwe ku mitungo ifite agaciro gahera kuri miliyoni eshanu kuzamura, mu gihe umutungo ufite agaciro kari munsi yayo nta ngwate itangwa. Ibindi byitezwe ko bizahindurwa n’ikoranabuhanga mu kurangiza imanza za cyamunara n’inyandiko mpesha harimo gukurikirana uburyo imanza zirangizwa mu gihugu hose ku buryo bwizewe, harebwa umusaruro bitanga. Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Imisoro n’Amahoro na cyo kizabasha gukurikirana neza itangwa ry’umusoro ku bahesha b’inkiko, hashingiwe kuri raporo y’imirimo bakoze. RDB ivuga ko gutangizwa kw’iri koranabuhanga bizunganira gahunda yo kurushaho guteza imbere ishoramari no gukora ubucuruzi binyuze mu mucyo. Iteka rya Minisitiri ryerekeye uburyo bwo guca imanza hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga, riteganya ko mu gihe hatatanzwe byibura 75% by’agaciro k’umutungo utezwa cyamunara; nyir’umutungo cyangwa ikigo cy’imari gicunga uwo mutungo bafite uburenganzira bwo gusaba ko cyamunara ihagarikwa, hagashakwa ubundi buryo cyangwa ikimurwa.

title: Airtel yatangije ‘Application’ ya mbere ihuriza hamwe serivise zose isanzwe itanga
content: Iri koranabuhanga rikubiye muri porogaramu yiswe ‘My Airtel App’, rifasha urikoresha kuryoherwa na serivisi zose zitangwa na Airtel bitamugoye na gato kandi ziri ahantu hamwe. Serivise ziri muri ‘My Airtel App’ zirimo izo “kugura ama-inite, internet, kwishyura ibyo ukeneye byose nk’amazi, amashanyarazi, ifatabuguzi rya televiziyo, […] kohereza amafaranga haba mu Rwanda no mu mahanga, byose bigakorwa hifashishijwe ikarita ya banki cyangwa Airtel Money.” Umukiriya wa Airtel kandi azaba ashobora kureba uko ibikorwa byo kwishyura byagenze no kugenzura ibyakorewe kuri simukadi ye ya Airtel byose yinjiriye ahantu hamwe. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Airtel Rwanda, Amit Chawla, yavuze ko ibihe bidasanzwe isi irimo byo guhangana n’ingaruka za COVID-19 byatumye habaho impinduka zikomeye by’umwihariko mu bucuruzi n’ibindi bikorwa bihuza bantu benshi, bityo ko izo mpinduka zikwiye kubyazwa amahirwe, abantu bagaterana imbere na zo. Ati “ Twashyizeho iyi porogaramu nyuma y’igihe kinini dukora ubushakashatsi ku byo abakiriya bakunze gukenera, tumaze no kumva neza ko bakeneye urubuga bakoreraho ibintu byose, bitabatwaye umwanya kandi bakabikora ku buryo buboroheye.” Yakomeje avuga ko gukoresha iyi porogaramu nshya bizarushaho gufasha abakiriya ba Airtel Rwanda kumenyera serivise zifashisha ikoranabuhanga rikomeje gushyirwa imbere mu bikorwa bitandukanye mu Rwanda. Ati “Gukoresha iyi porogaramu yo kwihereza biroroshye, birizewe kandi bizorohereza abakiriya ba Airtel gukora ibintu byinshi harimo kureba ama inite bafite kuri telephone zabo, interineti bafiteho, ayo bafite kuri Airtel Money, banabashe kongeramo ama inite, kureba no kugura pack zihari zitandukanye.” ‘My Airtel App’ ikora igihe cyose (24/7), izanafasha abayikoresha gukurikirana buri gihe ibibera kuri konti za bo za banki na Airtel Money bitabagoye na gato, ndetse ikaba idasaba kuba umuntu afite internet mu gihe ari kuyikoresha. Umutekano w’iyi ‘Application’ wizewe ku rwego rwo hejuru kuko itemerera undi muntu kuba yakoresha imyirondoro yawe agamije kwiba amafaranga ufite kuri konti iyo ari yo yose cyangwa gukora ikindi kintu cyabangamira umukiriya wa Airtel uyikoresha. Ibi kandi bijyana n’uko telefone zose zigaragaweho kuba imiterere ya zo yakorohereza abajura kwiba uyikoresha, itemera kuyijyamo. Akarusho kandi ni uko kugura ama-inite ukoresheje iyi ‘application’ biguhesha uburenganzira bwo guhabwa inyongera ndetse koherereza undi muntu byo bikaguhesha ubwasisi bwa 5% by’ama-inite yose wohereje. Iyi application izorohereza abajyaga bagorwa no gufata mu mutwe za kode zitandukanye mu kugura cyangwa gukoresha serivise za Airtel kuko buri kimwe cyose cyorohejwe muri ‘My Airtel App’. Ubuyobozi bwa Airtel Rwanda buvuga ko gukoresha iyi application bizarushaho kugabanya guhura kw’abantu muri ibi bihe byo guhangana na COVID-19. Umuntu ukeneye gukoresha iyi porogaramu ya ’My Airtel App’ ajya muri ’Play Store’ kubakoresha telefoni za ’Android’ cyangwa ’App Store’ ku bakoresha iOS; ukandika mu ishakiro "My Airtel", hakaza ifite amagambo ya ’Airtel Africa’, ubundi ukayishyira muri telefone yawe nk’uko bikorwa ku zindi porogaramu. Umaze kuyishyiramo, urayifungura, ukuzuzamo nomero yawe, ubundi ugakurikiza amabwiriza ajyanye n’ibyo bagusaba. Mu gutangaza ku mugaragaro imikorere y’iyi porogaramu, Airtel Rwanda yaboneyeho no gushimira uburyo abanyarwanda muri rusange bari kwitwara muri ibi bihe byo guhangana na COVID-19, ndetse yongera kubasaba kurushaho kubahiriza amabwiriza yashyizweho na Minisiteri y’Ubuzima muri ibi bihe bidasanzwe. Ishyirwa hanze ry’ububasha bwo kwihereza bwahawe abakiriya ba Airtel ni kimwe mu bikorwa bigaragaza umuhati wa Airtel mu kugeza ku mukiriya serivise nziza zijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga no kubaha ubushobozi bwo kwicungira ibikorwa byose byo ku murongo wabo wa Airtel, nta wundi bitabaje.

title: Zoom niyo porogaramu yamanuwe cyane kuri internet muri Mata
content: Zoom ni porogaramu y’ikoranabuhanga yatangiye kwifashishwa cyane ubwo icyorezo cya Coronavirus cyakazaga umurego kuko yafashije benshi kuganira mu buryo bw’amashusho hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga. Abantu miliyoni 131 bamanuye Zoom mu kwezi gushize, barimo 18 % bayimanuye bari mu Buhinde mu gihe 14 % bayimanuye bari muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.  Porogaramu ya TikTok nayo ikoresha uburyo bw’amashusho mu kuganira yaje ku mwanya wa kabiri kuko yamanuwe n’abantu basaga miliyoni 107 ku Isi. Uburyo bwo kuganira hifashishijwe amashusho nibwo bwatoranyijwe n’ibigo bimwe na bimwe ku Isi kugira ngo aho gukomeza akazi bari mu ngo bishoboka, bagakomeze nta nkomyi. Izi porogaramu zagiye zifasha benshi gukomeza gukurikirana imikorere y’abakozi babo hatabayeho guhurira mu nama nkuko byari bisanzwe. Ku rutonde rwa porogaramu zamanuwe cyane kandi harimo Facebook, WhatsApp, Instagram na Messenger. Izindi porogaramu zifashishwa mu kuganira hifashishijwe amashuho nka Google Meet na Microsoft Team nazo zigaragara ku rutonde rwa porogaramu zamanuwe cyane ariko mu myanya ya nyuma.

title: Impamvu igitabo kidakwiriye kubura mu mpano uha uwo ukunda
content:
Abantu bamwe baha agaciro kadakwiye igitabo, ntibazi ko igitabo aricyo shingiro ry’iterambere rirambye, ishingiro ry’ubuzima bwiza, ishingiro ry’ubwenge, ishingiro ry’imibereho myiza, ishingiro ryo kubaka igihugu, ishingiro ryo gusigasira igihango ndetse igitabo ni ishingiro ryo kugira igenamigambi rirambye. Njya nibaza ibibazo bikurikira: Kuki umuntu agura umwenda w’ibihumbi ijana ariko akumva atagura igitabo cy’ibihumbi ijana? Kuki umuntu agura mudasobwa y’ibihumbi magana atanu ariko akumva atagura igitabo cy’ibihumbi magana atanu? Kuki umuntu agura ururabo rwo guha inshuti ye ariko akaba atamuha impano y’igitabo?. Mu mwaka wa 2016, hari inshuti yanjye yitwa Ken Chartrand twigeze kuganira turi gutembera i New York, ambwira ko mu mpano nziza ashobora guha umuntu akunda ko hadashobora kuburamo igitabo, mubajije impamvu arambwira ngo igitabo ni inshuti nziza muganira ukunguka ubwenge n’ubuhanga, kikaba urwibutso rurambye kandi rudashira. Ken yambwiye ko igitabo ari urwibutso rw’ubushuti, ko buri kwezi agura ibitabo bibiri byo gusoma kandi ko adashobora kuryama adasomye igitabo kuko gituma aruhuka neza, akunguka ubumenyi burushijeho. Nyuma y’ikiganiro twagiranye, nahise nkunda birushijeho igitabo, mpitamo kwimakaza umuco wo kwandika, kugura ndetse no gusoma ibitabo. Kugeza ubu maze kwandika ibitabo bine. Mu biro byanjye harimo ibitabo naguze nsoma kenshi, mu rugo umuryango wanjye nawuguriye ibitabo byo gusoma kandi bamaze kubikunda. Birakwiye ko twimakaza uyu muco mwiza ufasha kubaka u Rwanda twifuza ndetse n’Afurika, tugura ibitabo, tubiha agaciro gakomeye, tubitangamo impano ku nshuti dukunda, tubisoma aho turi hose, bityo bizadufashe kurushaho gutera imbere dufite ubuhanga bwimbitse. Ibi kandi bizadufasha kwihuta mu iterambere ndetse turusheho kumenya aho tuva, aho tugeze ndetse n’icyerekezo cy’u Rwanda na Afurika. Bizadufasha kurushaho kuba abarinzi b’ibyagezweho mu Rwanda no muri Afurika bityo tubisigasire ndetse tunabyubakireho ibindi bikorwa byinshi kandi byiza. HATEGEKIMANA Richard

title: Amafoto mpangano y’abami batwaye u Rwanda imyaka 870 n’abagabekazi babo
content: Hifashishijwe ibisigo by’Abasizi bisingiza Abami n’ingoma zabo ndetse n’Abacurabwenge bari abarinzi b’amateka n’intekerezo z’igihugu, hiyongereyeho n’Abiru bari abanyamabanga n’abagaragu b’ingoma, hakusanyijwe amateka y’u Rwanda kuva mu ntango yarwo ubwo Gihanga I Ngomijana yashyiragaho imfatiro z’igihugu kugera ubwo Ingoma cya cyami yasimburwaga na Repubulika. Mu bakoreye mu ngata Gihanga I Ngomijana harimo ubuvivi bwe Ndoba watwaye u Rwanda ahasaga mu wa 1213 kugera 1246 arangwa n’ibitekerezo bihanitse mu bumenyi mu by’ibidukikije, inyamaswa n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Muri make Ndoba yari afite ubuhanga karemano muri siyansi, dore ko ari nawe dukesha ibirangamuryango nko kuba Abasinga barangwa na Sakabaka, Abashambo bakarangwa n’Intare, Abenengwe bakarangwa n’Ingwe mu gihe Abega barangwa n’Ibikeri, byose ni we tubikesha. Hari kandi na Ruganzu Bwimba watwaye u Rwanda kuva mu 1312 kugera mu 1345 wabaye imbimbuzi mu ndwanyi zaranze amateka y’u Rwanda mu guhirimbanira ubuhangange bw’igihugu. Niwe wagabye igitero cya mbere atera Gisaka yashakaga gusibanganya u Rwanda we arayitanga arayitera. Ni we dukesha kurwanira ishyaka igihugu, cyane cyane mu guhangana n’abagomera umurage wa Gihanga w’igihugu gisangiwe. Nta n’uwarenza ingohe Cyilima Rugwe, watwaye u Rwanda kuva mu 1345 kugera mu 1378, umutekerereza w’ubutabera bwunga mu mateka y’u Rwanda. Ni we washyizeho Inkiko z’Umuryango, iz’Abunzi n’iza Gacaca agena n’uko ibihano bizajya bitangwa ku bagomye. Yashakaga ko u Rwanda ruba igihugu kizira icyaha, abyubakira ku guhana igihango nk’uburyo bwo gukumira icyaha kitaraba. Nta n’uwakwibagirwa Ruganzu II Ndoli, watwaye u Rwanda kuva mu 1510 kugera mu 1543 wari indwanyi karundura, wadukanye amatwara yo guhangana n’amahanga adakunda u Rwanda akayagusha ruhabo, akarwagura kurusha abandi bami bose dore ko yarwometseho ibihugu icyenda. Hari inzobere kandi muri dipolomasi Mutara Semugeshi, watwaye u Rwanda mu 1543 kugera mu 1576, ni we mwami dukesha politiki ya mbere y’ububanyi n’amahanga, yubatse kandi imiyoborere ihamye mu kwegereza ubuyobozi abaturage aho yashyizeho inzego zisaga 75 nk’Intebe y’Abasizi, Abatware b’Ubutaka, Abatware b’Inyambo, Intebe y’Abahaditsi (abavuzi b’amatungo - vétérinaire), Intebe y’Abahoryo (Agronome), Intebe y’Abamotsi (abari bashinzwe itangazamakuru ry’ibwami) n’izindi. Ni we washyizeho uburyo bw’imisimburanire y’Abami ku ngoma bijyanye n’inshingano zabo nk’aho Umwami Mutara yabaga ashinzwe kwagura ubworozi bw’inka yakurikirwaga na Kigeli wari umwami w’intambara, Mibambwe wari ushinzwe uburumbuke, Yuhi wari umwami usigasira amahoro bityo bityo. Ntitwakwibagirwa n’abandi nka Cyilima Rujugira (1675 – 1708), wadukanye intero y’u Rwanda rutera rudaterwa, Yuhi Gahindiro (1746-1802) wazanye gahunda z’ubugiraneza nka Girinka na Kigeli Rwabugili (1859-1895) wacecekesheje ibihugu byashakaga kwiyomora ku Rwanda. Mu mateka y’Isi n’ibihangange byayibayemo nk’Abami b’u Rwanda, benshi baburiwe irengero, amasura yabo aribagirana kuko nta buryo bwariho bwo gufata amafoto no kuyashyingura ariko ibikorwa byabo bikaba bikibukwa kuko basize imusozi amavugwa y’ibikorwa bihanitse. Umushakashatsi ku mateka y’u Rwanda, Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, yahereye aho maze akusanya ibitekerezo by’ubuzima bwaranze aba bakurambere, yifashisha abahanga mu gushushanya bahanga amafoto y’abami b’u Rwanda, cyane umwami wa mbere wafotowe yari Kigeli Rwabugili mu 1894, abandi bamubanjirije ntawe uzi neza uko basaga. Aya mafoto mpangano y’Abami b’u Rwanda n’Abagabekazi babo, yakozwe n’umunyabugeni Mugisha Paul wize ku Nyundo, yashyizwe hanze bwa mbere mu gitabo ‘‘Intwari z’Imbanza, zubatse u Rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro” cyasohotse muri Gicurasi 2018. Uko ubumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga bigenda bikwira ku Isi yose rero, abahanga bagiye bitabaza inyurabwenge maze bakazimbura amasura y’abo bantu babayeho mu myaka ibihumbi kugira ngo bajye bayifashisha mu kubavuga ibigwi no kubagiraho icyitegererezo, ariko batari za baringa cyangwa umuntu udashobora kubonwa. Ni muri urwo rwego hariho amafoto ya Yesu, Mariya, Yozefu, intumwa za Yesu 12, Musa wavanye Abayisiraheli mu Misiri n’abandi. Nsanzabera avuga ko ‘‘Abo bagize ibikorwa bakora ku Isi n’ubu bikiri intangarirwa, kandi amafoto yabo mpangano akaba yaramamaye mu buryo buhanitse ndetse ntashidikanyweho ko aribo koko.’’ Nk’abakoze ishusho ya Yezu, icyo bakoze ni ukureba ku bikorwa bye, amateka yamuranze n’imyitwarire ye ku Isi, barema amafoto mpangano ye kugira ngo buri wese ajye abasha kumubona mu buryo bugenekereje. Mu gushushanya amafoto mpangano agenekereje y’abami b’u Rwanda, hagendewe ku bushakashatsi bushingiye ku bikorwa byabaranze, uruhererekane-mvugo rw’ibyabaye ku ngoma zabo, imishyingiranire y’umuryango w’abami b’u Rwanda n’indi miryango migari y’Abanyarwanda, igenantekerezo (Philosophie) n’imyitwarire yaranze Abami b’u Rwanda ndetse n’ikigero cy’imyaka y’ubukure mu iyimikwa ryabo. Nsanzabera ati “Ese niba umwami runaka yarakoze ibikorwa bikomeye mu kubaka u Rwanda, aho ntiyasaga atya? Iyo ni imwe mu ngingo yitaweho cyane mu kugenekereza amafoto y’abami b’u Rwanda. Kuko kenshi imirimo y’umuntu isa n’isura ye, ikanahamya umutima wamuranze mu bihe byose.’’ Aya mafoto mpangano yanashingiye ku kigero cy’ubukure cy’abami n’abagabekazi. Hari aho atandukanye mu kigero cy’ubukure bitewe n’uko hari abagiye bimikwa bafite imyaka ibiri, abari abasore b’ibihame, abahawe ingoma bakiri ingimbi n’abayihawe bakuze cyane. Ni nako byagenze ku Bagabekazi kuko hari abagiye bapfakara bakiri bato, umwami agatanga, bakiri ibirongore, abandi ugasanga bari bakiri abagore b’amariza n’ibindi. Intego ya Nsanzabera ni uko ababyifuza bakoresha amafoto mpangano mu nyandiko na filime zirebana n’amateka y’u Rwanda mu kwerekana amashusho y’abami n’abagabekazi. Aya mafoto ni uburiza bw’andi yaranze u Rwanda mu bihe bitandukanye, azasohoka mu bindi bitabo.

title: Tariki 15 Gicurasi: Umunsi umwanditsi n’umunyamateka Mgr Alexis Kagame yaboneyeho izuba
content: Musenyeri Alexis Kagame, yabaye umuhanga udasanzwe, umwanditsi n’umunyamateka ukomeye, akibukirwa ku bitabo byuje ubuhanga yanditse n’ibisigo birimo Indyoheshabirayi, Inganji Karinga, Umuririmbyi wa Nyiribiremwa, Isoko y’Amajyambere n’ibindi. Yavutse kuwa 15 Gicurasi 1912 i Kiyanza mu Buliza, ubu ni mu murenge wa Ntarabana mu Karere ka Rulindo mu Majyaruguru. Mu myaka 69 y’ubuzima bwe, Kagame yasize umusanzu ukomeye asiga u Rwanda na Afurika bamumenye nk’umunyamateka, umuhanga mu ndimi n’umuhanga mu byo gutekereza (filozofiya). Ubuzima bwe mu buto Kagame yakuze ari umuhanga haba mu bitekerezo no mu mivugire, yaje kuba inshuti ya hafi y’umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa waje no kumuha uburenganzira bwo gukusanya ibitekerezo by’Abiru ngo abyandikemo igitabo. Yatangiye kwiga mu Ishuri rya Leta Mbiligi Gatolika mu Ruhengeri mu 1925, icyo gihe yari afite imyaka 13. Yaharangije nyuma y’imyaka itatu mu 1928, asaba kujya mu iseminari nto i Kabgayi mu karere ka Muhanga mu 1929, aharangiriza mu 1933. Yakomeje mu iseminari nkuru ari umuhanga mu buryo budasanzwe, kugeza abaye umupadiri mu 1941. Alexis Kagame nk’umwanditsi Mu 1943 nibwo Kagame yasohoye igitabo cye cya mbere cyagarukaga ku mateka y’u Rwanda yise Inganji Karinga, gikurikirwa n’ibindi byinshi bigaruka no ku busizi, agenda ahuza imyemerere gakondo n’ubuzima bwa gikirisitu, ingingo yanditseho cyane. Alexis Kagame kandi yagiye akora inyingo nyinshi zirebana n’ubusizi nyabami. Musenyeri Kagame yifashishije ibyiciro biboneka mu rurimi rw’Ikinyarwanda agaragaza ubuhanga bw’Abanyafurika mu mitekerereze, mu bushakashatsi bwamuhesheje impamyabushobozi y’ikirenga mu bya filozofiya muri Kaminuza ya Mutagatifu Gregoire i Roma, igitabo gishingiye ku iyigandimi nyarwanda, yise “La philosophie Bantu-Rwandaise de l’être”, hari mu 1956. Agarutse mu Rwanda, yatangiye kwigisha mu iseminari asohora n’ibitabo byinshi, bitari ku mateka y’u Rwanda gusa, ahubwo bigera no ku rurimi rw’Ikinyarwanda. Mu 1959 nyuma y’itanga ry’Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa, ingoma ya Cyami yatangiye gusa n’ivaho, ariko Alexis Kagame we kubera ibitekerezo bikomeye yari afite ntiyagira ikindi kibazo, ahubwo ahabwa kujya kwigisha muri Kaminuza Nkuru y’u Rwanda ubwo yashigwaga mu 1963. Icyo gihe kandi yari n’umwarimu muri Kaminuza y’Igihugu ya Zaire i Lubumbashi, ubu ni muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, aho yigishaga amateka ya Afurika y’iburasirazuba n’iyo hagati. Kuwa 5 Nyakanga mu 1979 yahawe na leta impeta y’ishimwe ubwo yagirwaga “Officier de l’ordre national des Grands lacs”, ndetse amaze kugirwa igisonga cya Musenyeri muri diyosezi ya Butare muri 1980, Papa Yahani Pawulo wa II yamugize Musenyeri w’icyubahiro ku ya 4 Nyakanga 1981, aba Musenyeri atyo nubwo atari umwepisikopi nk’abo tuzi ubu. Kuwa 2 Ukuboza 1981 nibwo Musenyeri Alexis Kagame yitabye Imana aguye mu bitaro by’i Nairobi muri Kenya aho yari yagiye kwivuza, ndetse umurambo we leta yishingira kuwuzana mu Rwanda kubera agaciro yari afite mu gihugu. Kagame yabaye mu Nama y’Ubuyobozi bwa Rwanda-Urundi kuva muri 1956 kugeza ku bwigenge bw’u Rwanda. Uretse ibihembo mpuzamahanga, kuwa 3 Nzeri 2014, Musenyeri Alexis Kagame yashyikirijwe igihembo n’Inteko Nyarwanda y’Ururimi n’Umuco cyiswe “Igihembo Cya Akademi”, cyashyizweho hagamijwe gushima abantu bakora ibikorwa by’indashyikirwa mu kubungabunga ubusugire n’iterambere by’ururimi n’umuco by’u Rwanda.

title: Abanyabugeni b’abagore bahawe umwihariko mu kwizihiza Umunsi Mpuzamahanga w’Ingoro Ndangamurage
content: Buri mwaka tariki 18 Gicurasi Isi yizihiza Umunsi Mpuzamahanga wahariwe Ingoro Ndangamurage, hazirikanwa umuco, amateka n’imibereho gakondo by’abatuye Isi. U Rwanda narwo rwifatanya n’amahanga mu kwizihiza uwo munsi ushimangira agaciro ko guhererekanya amateka no guteza imbere umuco ufatwa nk’umusingi w’imibereho y’igihugu. Urwa Gasabo rubarizwa mu Muryango Mpuzamahanga w’Ingoro Ndangamurage (ICOM) uhuriyemo abanyamuryango basaga 44 000 bakora mu ngoro ndangamurage 20 000 zo mu bihugu 138. Muri uyu mwaka, uyu munsi wahawe insanganyamatsiko ivuga ku kugira “Ingoro ndangamurage zigamije uburinganire, ubudasa no kudaheza’’. Kuri iyi nshuro iki gikorwa cyateguwe mu buryo bwihariye aho hazifashishwa ikoranabuhanga bitewe n’ingamba zashyizweho zo guhangana n’ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo cya COVID-19. Ni muri urwo rwego Ingoro ndangamurage zo mu bihugu binyamuryango bya ICOM zasabwe kucyizihiza hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga. Ikigo cy’Ingoro z’Igihugu z’Umurage w’u Rwanda (INMR) cyizizihiza ibi birori hafungurwa ku mugaragaro imurika rishya mu Ngoro y’Ubugeni n’Ubuhanzi iherereye i Kanombe, ku wa 18 Gicurasi 2020. Iri murika ry’ibihangano by’ubugeni ryahawe insanganyamatsiko ivuga iti “Ubutumwa bw’abanyabugeni b’Abanyarwandakazi: Uburinganire kuri bose.’’ Ni insanganyamatsiko yari yagenwe ku Munsi Mpuzamahanga w’Abari n’Abategarugori [yasubitswe kubera ingamba zo guhangana na Coronavirus], ariko inahurirana n’iyatanzwe na ICOM uyu mwaka wa 2020. Iyo urebye mu byiciro bitandukanye bibarizwamo abari n’abategarugori mu Rwanda, usanga baragize uruhare mu bikorwa by’iterambere ry’ubukungu n’imibereho myiza y’abaturage nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994; ariko basigara inyuma mu bijyanye n’ubugeni bitewe n’impamvu zirimo ubushobozi buke, kubura amahugurwa ahagije mu bijyanye n’ubugeni n’izindi mbogamizi zo mu buzima busanzwe. Ushingiye no ku bihangano bimuritse mu Ngoro y’Ubugeni n’Ubuhanzi y’i Kanombe “Hari icyuho kinini hagati y’ibihangano by’abagore n’abagabo. Ibi ntibisobanuye ko badashoboye, bafite impano muri bo kuko na bake bari muri uwo mwuga bakora ibihangano byiza cyane, bimwe muri byo bifite ubwiza burenze ibya basaza babo.’’ Imurika rizakorwa nk’uburyo bwo gukora ubukangurambaga mu bari n’abategarugori, binyuze mu butumwa bukubiye mu nsanganyamatsiko y’imurika no mu bihangano byabo byateguwe kandi bizamurikwa, bakangurirwa kwigirira icyizere, gutinyuka no kugaragaza impano bafite mu by’ubugeni. Iri murika ryateguwe hagamijwe gufasha abahanzikazi bato no kubaharurira inzira zo kungukira mu bikorwa byabo; gufasha abanyabugeni b’abagore gutegura ibikorwa byo kumurika ibihangano byabo; kwerekana agaciro ko gushora mu bushobozi bw’umugore no kubafasha kugeza imishinga yabo ku rwego mpuzamahanga, byanafasha abandi kubigiraho. Rizahuza abanyabugeni b’abari n’abategarugori 35 bo mu bihugu bitandatu birimo u Rwanda, Amerika, u Bufaransa, u Bubiligi, Serbia na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. INMR yateguye iri murika ifatanyije n’Ikigo Ndangamuco cy’Abadage Goethe Institut-Kigali. Ibyo bigo byombi byafashije abari n’abategarugori b’abanyabugeni mu kuritegura, kubaha amahugurwa n’ubushobozi bwo gukora ibihangano byabo no gutunganya imurika riboneye. Umuhango wo kwizihiza Umunsi Mpuzamahanga w’Ingoro Ndangamurage uzanyuzwa kuri murandasi (Webex) ku wa 18 Gicurasi 2020 saa Cyenda. Abifuza kuwukurikirana baziyandikisha bohereza ubutumwa kuri [email protected] cyangwa bakandikira ikigo banyuze ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Biteganyijwe ko umukozi w’Ingoro ndangamurage azasobanurira abazakurikira iki gikorwa ibijyanye n’imurika, ababwira ubutumwa bukubiye mu bihangano bigize imurika nkuko bigenda mu gihe bari gusura bisanzwe. U Rwanda rufite Ingoro z’Umurage umunani zimuritse umurage n’amateka by’igihugu ku mibereho y’abagituye, imyemerere, imyidagaduro, imyambarire, imiziro n’imiziririzo, amateka yacyo. Nyuma ya gahunda ya Guma mu rugo yashyizweho mu kwirinda ikwirakwira rya COVID-19, ibikorwa byo gufungura imiryango ku basura ingoro ndangamurage byarasubukuwe ku wa 5 Gicurasi 2020.

title: Imihango n’imigenzo yakorwaga n’Abanyarwanda mu kwirukana ibiza n’ibyorezo
content: Imihango yakorwaga ahanini yabaga ishingiye ku biteganywa n’Ubwiru, umwuga w’Ubupfumu, Ubuvubyi Ubuhennyi, Ubuhoryo n’Ubuhaditsi. Igitabo “Imizi y’u Rwanda” cyanditswe n’Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, inzobere mu muco, amateka n’Ubuvanganzo, havugwamo ko buri cyorezo cyateraga u Rwanda, habaga hari uburyo bwateguwe bwo kucyohera cyangwa kukirukana bakoreshejwe imwe muri iyo migenzo n’imihango yashyizwe u Rwanda rwahangwaga. Inzira ya Kivu: Ni inzira yabagamo urwunge rw’imihango yakorwaga mu gihe mu gihugu habaga hateye umwuzure ukangiza byinshi mu gihugu. Bakoraga imihango yo kwirunka uwo mwuzure. Inzira ya Muhekenyi: Ni inzira yabagamo urwunge rw’imihango yakorwaga mu gihe habaga hateye ibyonnyi n’indwara z’amatungo, bityo hagakorwa imihango n’imigenzo yo kuyohera. Nyuma y’imihango y’ibwami ijyanye n’ubwiru bwo kohera ibiza n’ibyorezo, hakurikiragaho abahanga gakondo mu kuvura icyateye icyo cyorezo no kucyohera ntikizagaruke. Bamwe muri bo bakoraga iyo mihango, ni aba bakurikira: Abavubyi: Mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere, abavubyi bari bafite umumaro uhanitse mu mibereho myiza y’abaturage cyane cyane mu buhinzi . Umwuga wabo gakondo wari uwo kuvuba imvura ikagwa iyo yabaga yahagamye, no kuyohera ikagenda iyo yabaga yaciye ibintu. Iyo habaga hateye amapfa cyangwa se umwuzure, icyo gihe nibwo abavubyi nk’inzobere mu kumanura imvura bahagurukaga bagakora imihango yo kuyimanura ikagwa, amapfa akagenda. Iyo yabaga yaciye ibintu hakaba umwuzure, nabwo bakoraga imihango yo kuyohera. Abahoryo: Abahoryo nabo ni bamwe mu banyamihango b’ibwami bagiraga uruhare runini ku gukurikirana ibihingwa mu murima no kuvura ibyonnyi by’indwara zabaga zadutse mu myaka. Barahagurukaga bagakora imihango yo kuvuma ibyo byonnyi no kuvuguta imiti yo kubyamurura ku butaka bw’u Rwanda. Abahaditsi: Ni bamwe mu banyamihango b’ibwami bari bagiraga uruhare runini ku gukurikirana indwara z’amatungo zabaga zadutse mu bworozi bw’I Rwanda. Icyo gihe nibwo Abahaditsi barahagurukaga bagakora imihango yo kuvuguta imiti yo kubyamurura mu Rwanda. Abahennyi: Abahennyi nabo bari bamwe mu banyamihango b’ibwami bifashishwaga mu kuvura indwara z’ibyorezo zibasiye abantu no kuvuma ababisha banga u Rwanda. Iyo habaga hateye ibyorezo by’indwara, icya mbere bakoraga ni ukumenya inkomoko yabyo, basanga ari ibirogano bagahenera uwabikoze akaba ikivume, basanga ari icyorezo cy’inzaduka bakagishakira amasubyo yo kucyohera. Nibo batangaga amasubyo yo kuvura amahumane, ibinyoro, ubushita n’izindi. Mu kwamurura no kohera ibyozezo by’indwara z’abantu n’amatungo, Abanyarwanda bifashishaga kandi amazi y’ubuhoro, yeza igihugu agakiza ubwandure akamurura ibiza by’indwara n’umuze byazengereje igihugu. Bigaragaza ko kuva kera Abanyarwanda bari bafite ubuhanga n’ubushobozi bifashishaga mu guhashya umwanzi w’ubuzima bwabo n’ibyabo. Ni abantu bakoresheje ubwenge bw’umwimerere mu kwirwanaho bahagarara ku buzima bwabo ngo butaganzwa n’ibyorezo by’indwara n’ibiza by’amapfa n’imyuzure.

title: Inkomoko y’amazina y’uduce tumwe two muri Kigali nka Nyarugenge, Kacyiru n’utundi
content: Icyo kigo kivuga ko hari amazina yatanzwe hagendewe ku bwoko bw’igiti biri cyangwa byiganje ahantu runaka. Izina ”Nyarugenge” rituruka ku giti cyitwa Imigenge (Acacia hochii). Ariryo ubu ryitwa Akarere ka Nyarugenge. Abahanga mu mateka bavuga ko hari ahandi nka ‘Kimironko’ hiswe hatyo hagendewe ku ishyamba ry’ibiti byitwa ‘Imironko’ ryatewe na Cyilima Rujugira, kugira ngo ajye aritemamo ibiti byo kuramvura imiheto yo guhangana n’amahanga adakunda u Rwanda. Kimihurura habaga ibyatsi bivura byitwa ‘imihurura’ n’ahandi. Ikigo cy’Ingoro z’Igihugu z’Umurage w’u Rwanda (INMR) kivuga ko hari amazina yaturutse ku bantu bakomeye babaga ahantu runaka. Nka “Kacyiru” bivugwa ko ryatanzwe hagendewe ku mugabo witwaga Cyiru; wari umutware na “Rwabutabura” ryatanzwe riturutse ku witwaga Rwabutabura wari utuye ahitwa iryo zina muri iki gihe, ubu ni mu Karere ka Nyarugenge. Umushakashatsi ku muco n’amateka Nsanzabera Jean De Dieu avuga ko ‘Kacyiru (agasozi k’icyiru)’ byitiriwe agasozi katangiweho ‘Ibyiru’ byinshi, bikomotse ku manza zacirwaga Abanyabwanacyambwe banze kuyoboka ingoma ya Mukobanya, nyuma yo kuhigarurira ahasaga mu wa 1378 ubwo yicaga Nkuba ya Nyabakonjo umwami w’u Bwanacyambwe. ‘Gacuriro’ hiswe hatyo kubera uruganda rucura amacumu yo kwagura u Rwanda rwubatswe na Kigeli Mukobanya. Andi mazina yatanzwe afatiwe ku bikorwa byo kubaka u Rwanda nk’ubworozi bw’inka. “Kicukiro” risobanuye umusozi amacukiro (ibirundo by’amase y’inka). Mu bihe byo hambere, Kicukiro izwi nka kamwe mu turere tw’umujyi wa Kigali kororerwagaho inka nyinshi. Niho hari hubatse ibiraro by’inka za Kigeli Mukobanya n’umuhungu we Mibambwe Sekarongoro Mutabazi. Hari ahazwi nka ‘Kabusunzu’ hiswe hatyo kubera umupfumu w’umuhanga wari waraturutse i Karagwe witwa ‘Gasunzu’ nyuma aho atuye bahita ‘Kagasunzu’ nyuma umunyamakuru wo kuri Radiyo Rwanda yagiye gutara amakuru avugira kuri Radiyo ko ari ‘Kabusunzu’ rihama rityo. Hazwi nk’i Nyamirambo hiswe hatyo biturutse ku mirambo myinshi yahabonetse ubwo abanyoro bateraga u Rwanda. Amateka nk’ayo aboneka mu nzu ndangamateka yitiriwe Richard Kandt (Kandt House Museum). Mu busanzwe hari ahandi mu Rwanda hagiye hitwa amazina hagendewe ku bikorwa bitandukanye byagiye bihabera. Hari nko ku Kivumu cya Mpushi, ahacirwaga abarwaye ibinyoro, ku cya Semakamba habereye urubanza rwa Semakamba n’Umwami Kigeli Rwabugiri n’ahandi. Kigali yagizwe umurwa mukuru w’u Rwanda bwa mbere ku bwa Kigeli Mukobanya ahasaga 1378. Umurwa mukuru w’Umwami wari mu Mudugudu wa Vugavuge mu Kagali ka Gasabo mu Murenge wa Rutunga h’ubu.

title: Imyaka 26 irashize umwamikazi wa nyuma w’u Rwanda, Rosalie Gicanda yishwe
content: Gicanda yashakanye n’Umwami Mutara wa III Rudahigwa Charles Léon Pierre Kuwa 13 Mutarama 1942. Yabayeho nabi asuzugurwa nyuma y’urupfu rw’umwami Rudahigwa, ubwo yatangiraga i Bujumbura ku buryo bw’amayobera tariki 25 Nyakanga 1959. Nyuma yo gutanga kw’umugabo we byajyanye n’ihurura ry’abarwaniraga Repubulika, ariko barushaho gutesha agaciro ingoma ya Cyami n’ibimenyetso byayo. Mu 1961 Perezida Kayibanda Grégoire yirukanye mu rukari Umwamikazi Gicanda. Yaje gutura mu Mujyi wa Butare mu Karere ka Huye, ari naho abahoze ari abasirikare ba Habyarimana hamwe n’Interahamwe bamusanze bakamwica kuwa 20 Mata 1994. Urupfu rw’Umwamikazi Rosali Gicanda Muri Repubulika ya mbere n’iya kabiri, umwamikazi Gicanda nubwo yari mu gihugu, yabayeho nta gaciro afite nk’uwahoze mu buyobozi bukuru bw’igihugu. Gicanda wari umuyoboke ukomeye wa Kiliziya Gatolika, yabayeho mu buzima bworoheje mu mujyi wa Huye, abana n’umubyeyi we ndetse n’abandi bagore bake bamufashaga mu mirimo itandukanye. Ubwo Jenoside yatangiraga, Umwamikazi Gicanda yagiye yishingikiriza Jean Baptiste Habyarimana wari Perefe wa Butare, warwanyije cyane umugambi wo gutsemba Abatutsi. Tariki 17 Mata, Perefe Habyarimana yatawe muri yombi, nyuma aza kwicwa. Umwamikazi Rosalia Gicanda yatangiye guterwa ubwoba ko nawe agiye kwicwa n’umuryango we. Raporo ya Human Rights Watch yasohotse mu 1999, ivuga ko Umwamikazi Gicanda wari ufite imyaka 66 yasabye Joseph Kanyabashi wari Burugumesitiri wa Komini ya Ngoma i Butare kumurinda, undi akabyanga. Tariki 20 Mata ahagana saa tanu z’amanywa , abasirikare bayobowe na Lt Pierre Bizimana binjiye mu rugo rw’umwamikazi Gicanda ku mabwiriza yari yatanzwe na Capt Ildephonse Nizeyimana wari umuyobozi ushinzwe ubutasi n’ibikorwa mu ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare, ESO ubwo Jenoside yakorwaga. Abo basirikare bamaze kwinjira mu rugo rw’umwamikazi, baramufashe we n’abandi bagore batandatu babanaga barabatwara. Muri urwo rugo hasigaye mama wa Gicanda wari ufite imyaka 80 n’undi mukobwa wo kumwitaho. Abasirikare bafashe Gicanda n’abo bari bafatanywe bajyana inyuma y’ingoro y’inzu ndangamurage y’u Rwanda barabarasa, barapfa. Ku gicamunsi abasirikare bagarutse mu rugo rwa Gicanda gusahura, hashize iminsi ibiri baragaruka bica umubyeyi we. Raporo ya Huma Rihgts Watch ivuga ko hari umupadiri wasabye ko umubiri wa Gicanda washyingurwa mu cyubahiro, burugumesitiri Kanyabashi yohereza abagororwa bo kuwujyana bawushyingura hafi y’urugo rwe. Umwe mu baganiriye n’umukobwa wabashije kurokoka witaga ku mubyeyi wa Gicanda, ngo yamubwiye ko mbere y’uko Gicanda n’abo bari kumwe bicwa babanje kuvuga isengesho bishyira mu maboko y’Imana. Muri 2012, urukiko rwashyiriweho u Rwanda rwakatiye Capt Ildephonse Nizeyimana igifungo cya burundu ashinjwa kwica Umwamikazi Gicanda n’abandi batutsi muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Nizeyimana yari yafatiwe muri Uganda mu 2009. Mu 1998 Lt Pierre Bizimana yakatiwe urwo gupfa n’urukiko rwa gisirikare i Kigali ariko icyo gihano kiza guhindurwamo igifungo cya burundu nyuma y’uko u Rwanda rukuyeho igihano cy’urupfu. Umwamikazi wicishaga bugufi, akagira impuhwe Ababanye n’abazi neza Umwamikazi Gicanda, bavuga ko yari umubyeyi wicisha bugufi kandi agakunda abantu bose atarobanuye. Mu buhamya Perezida Paul Kagame yatanze mu 2017 avuga ku mateka y’ubuto bwe kuva afite imyaka ine y’amavuko ubwo yatangiraga ubuzima bw’ubuhunzi, yashimiye na Gicanda nk’umwe mu bamufashije akabasha kurokoka. Ubwo buhamya bugaragara mu nimero 2944 ya Jeune Afrique yasohotse ku wa 11 Kamena 2017, yiswe amabanga y’ubuto [Secrets de Jeunesse] bw’abakuru b’ibihugu barimo Perezida Kagame, Ali Bongo Ondimba, Umwami Mohammed VI wa Maroc na Alpha Condé. Perezida Kagame yasobanuye ko mu 1961 mbere gato y’uko u Rwanda rubona ubwigenge, ubwo yari afite imyaka ine, Abahutu bari batuye ku musozi wa Tambwe bashyigikiwe n’ubuyobozi, bigabije aho umuryango we wari utuye batwika inzu zaho ndetse bagirira nabi Abatutsi. Icyo gihe umubyeyi we yatangiye kumutegura ngo bahunge. Hahise haza imodoka, umushoferi wayo ashyikiriza umubyeyi wa Perezida Kagame ibaruwa ivuga ko atumwe n’Umwamikazi Gicanda wari utuye i Nyanza mu rugendo rw’iminota nka 45 uvuye aho bo bari batuye. Rosalie Gicanda yari amusabye kubahungisha muri ibyo bihe by’amakuba. Perezida Kagame n’abantu bari baturanye binjiye muri iyo modoka mu gihe igihiriri cy’ababahigaga cyaturukaga ku wundi musozi, gihita cyirara mu byo bari batunze. Icyo gihe ngo basanze Umwamikazi i Nyanza, mbere y’uko bafata inzira bakerekeza mu Mutara aho naho ubwicanyi bwabasanze bakabuhungira muri Uganda. Gicanda yavukiye i Rwamagana mu 1928. Yakuze arangwa n’ikinyabupfura ari nabyo byatumye abengukwa n’Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa. Umwamikazi Gicanda aruhukiye i Mwima ya Nyanza ahatabarijwe Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa na Kigeli V Ndahindurwa. Buri mwaka tariki 20 Mata hategurwa gahunda yo kwibuka Umwamikazi Rosalie Gicanda, itegurwa ku bufatanye bw’umuryango we n’ubuyobozi bw’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ingoro Ndangamurage z’u Rwanda.

title: Imyaka 20 irashize Paul Kagame atorewe kuyobora u Rwanda
content: Tariki 17 Mata 2000 nibwo Perezida Kagame yatowe n’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ndetse n’abagize Guverinoma ngo asimbure Pasteur Bizimungu wari umaze ibyumweru bibiri yeguye. Umuryango FPR Inkotanyi niwo wari ufite inshingano zo gushaka Perezida usimbura uwari umaze kwegura, ryitoyemo abakandida babiri bagombaga gushyikirizwa Inteko Ishinga Amategeko y’inzibacyuho kugira ngo itoremo uba Perezida. Mu bakandida batanzwe hari harimo General Major Paul Kagame wari Visi Perezida na Charles Muligande wari Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa FPR Inkotanyi. Mu badepite n’abagize Guverinoma 86 batoye, Gen Maj Paul Kagame yagize amajwi 81, naho Charles Muligande agira amajwi atanu. Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yari igizwe n’abadepite 70 naho Guverinoma igizwe n’abaminisitiri 18. Tito Rutaremara, Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Urwego rw’Igihugu Ngishwanama rw’Inararibonye yabwiye IGIHE ko nta mpungenge bari bafite niba Gen Maj Kagame aremera kuba Perezida, kuko bari bamaze kubimusaba yabyemeye. Ati “Byari byaganiriwe mu nama ya FPR twabimusabye yabyemeye ariko bigomba kunyura mu Nteko kuko na Perezida wundi Inteko niyo yari yamukuyeho.” Perezida Kagame yatorewe kuyobora u Rwanda ari umwuka utari mwiza muri politiki kuko mu mezi atatu yari ashize, uwari Perezida na Minisitiri w’intebe bari bamaze kwegura bashinjwa imikorere mibi. Kuwa 22 Mata 2000 nibwo Perezida Paul Kagame yarahiriye kuba Perezida nyuma yo kwemezwa n’urukiko rw’ikirenga.
