Yongeye gutorerwa kuba Perezida mu matora rusange yo kuwa 25 Kanama 2003, aho yatsinze ku majwi 95 %. U Rwanda rwari rutegereje kuguma hasi cyangwa kubyuka Perezida Paul Kagame yatowe hashize iminsi mike hasojwe inama ziswe izo mu ‘Rugwiro’, zahuje abanyarwanda b’ingeri zose hakaganirirwamo ahazaza h’igihugu. Ibyavuyemo nibyo byaje kugenderwaho mu cyerecyezo cyiswe ‘2020’. Ibyari bikubiye muri icyo cyerecyezo byasaga n’inzozi ukurikije aho igihugu cyari kiri nyuma y’imyaka itandatu kivuye muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ni igihugu cyifuzaga kumvisha amahanga kurekera aho kukirebera mu ndorerwamo ya Jenoside, ahubwo kigafatwa nk’igihugu cyiteje imbere nk’ibindi bihugu bya Afurika. Tito Rutaremara avuga ko hari hakenewe umuyobozi ufata ibyo byifuzo byose akabihindura ingiro. Ati “Ibyo bitekerezo byashakaga umuntu ubishoboye wabishyira ku murongo. Abo mu Rugwiro baravugaga bati rwose nyuma y’imyaka 20 dukwiriye kuba twarahindutse turi nk’ibindi bihugu byo muri Afurika. Bakavuga bati hazajyeho Leta igendera ku mategeko, abaturage bazegerezwe ubuyobozi, tuzandike amateka y’igihugu cyacu uko akwiriye kumera n’ibindi”. Mu by’ingenzi u Rwanda rwari rukeneye cyane, hari hariho gushyiraho Itegeko Nshinga, kubaka inzego z’ubuyobozi, guteza imbere ubukungu, uburezi, imibereho myiza y’abaturage, ubuzima n’ibindi. Rutaremara avuga ko iyo hataba umuyobozi ushoboye, byari kuguma mu bitekerezo gusa. Ati “Twari tuvuye mu nzibacyuho, tugira Imana tubona umuyobozi mwiza ufite icyerecyezo. Burya biba byiza iyo uvuye mu nzibacyuho ugatangira kubaka neza, ukagira umuyobozi mwiza ubishoboye.” Yakomeje avuga ko mu gutora Perezida Kagame nta mpungenge nyinshi bari bafite, kubera ko bari bamwizeye kandi bakabona nta handi habi u Rwanda rushobora kugera harenze Jenoside yabaye. Ati “Twari twaravuye ahabi nta handi twashoboraga kujya handi. U Rwanda rwageze habi cyane icyari gisigaye ni ukubyuka. Iyo uri hasi nta handi wajya, wenda waguma aho, icyari gisigaye rero ni ukugumayo cyangwa kubyuka. Kubyuka rero kandi bikihuta twagize Imana tubona umuyobozi ubishoboye.” Kubaka u Rwanda nyuma y’umwaka wa 2000 byakozwe mu byiciro. Icyiciro cya mbere cyari kuva mu 2000 kugeza mu 2010 cyarimo gushyiraho amategeko, no kubaka inzego z’ubuyobozi. Ikindi cyari icya 2010 kugeza 2020 cyo kubaka inzego z’ubukungu bw’igihugu no guteza imbere imibereho myiza y’abaturage ku buryo bugaragara. Kugeza ubu u Rwanda rufatwa nka kimwe mu bihugu bike bya Afurika bifite ubukungu buzamuka ku gipimo cyo hejuru, aho kiri ku mpuzandengo ya 7 % buri mwaka uhereye mu 2000. Mu 1990 umusaruro ku muturage ku mwaka wari amadolari 374, mu 1994 yari amadolari 146 mu 2000 yari 225 $. Mu 2010 yari 579 $, mu 2015 yari 728 $, mu 2017 yari 774 $ naho mu 2018 yari 788$ ku mwaka Ingengo y’imari y’igihugu yikubye inshuro 14, mu gihe ingengo y’imari ituruka imbere mu gihugu yo yazamutse inshuro 20 mu myaka 20 ishize.

title: Intwaro z’ingenzi Abanyarwanda bifashishaga mu guhangana n’ibyorezo by’inzara n’indwara
content: Hari ibyorezo bitandukanye byagiye byibasira u Rwanda birimo nk’Indwara z’umuze no gusogobwa byahitanye abatagira ingano mu iyima rya Mutara Semugeshi, hari indwara y’ubushita yateye mu Gisaka ku ngoma ya Mibambwe Sentabyo.  Hari ibindi biza byaje ubwo u Rwanda rwar ruhanganye n’ubukoloni hagati y’umwaka wa 1890 n’uwa 1946. Muri ibyo bihe u Rwanda rwibasiwe n’indwara z’amatungo zirimo uburenge, iragara, muryamo n’amashuya. Hateye kandi indwara z’abantu zirimo Mugiga, ubushita n’ibihara, haza no gutera inzara karundura zahitanye abatagira ingano zirimo Muhatibicumuro, Ruyaga, Rumanura, Gakwege, Rwakayihura na Ruzagayura. N’ubwo ibyo byorezo byazaga bikidegembya, ndetse hakaba n’ibimara iminsi itari mike, ntibyabuzaga ko Abanyarwanda bafata ingamba zo kubitsinda ubutazagaruka. Mu murage wa Gihanga yahaye u Rwanda mu ihangwa ry’igihugu cya Gasabo, yahaye abazamukomokaho n’umuryango mugari w’abenegihugu, umurage ukomeye ugomba kugenga imiyoborere y’igihugu n’imibereho n’imibanire y’Abanyarwanda, mu myaka amagana n’amagana ubwo azaba atakiriho. Imitekerereze- murage ya Gihanga, yabaga inakubiye mu mihango y’ubwiru yakorwaga mu rwego rwo kohera ibiza bizaza mu gihugu. Mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere, bagiraga amahame y’imiyoborere, imibereho n’imibanire akurikira: Gukunda Imana yaremye u Rwanda n’Abanyarwanda, Gukunda u Rwanda nk’umurage ukomeye ugomba kubungabungwa, Gukunda no gukeza umwami cyangwa se kubaha no kumvira ubuyobozi, Kubaha no kurengera ikiremwamuntu n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima no kugendera ku mahame ya za kirazira yo kugira ibyo utinya n’ibyo wubaha. Ayo mahame uko ari 5, niyo ngenderwaho mu kwesa imihigo y’ibyo babaga barahize kugeraho ibihe byose. Muri ayo mahame, ni naho habonekagamo intwaro zikomeye zifashishwaga mu guhangana n’ibiza, ibyorezo by’inzara n’indwara z’abantu n’amatungo. Izo ntwaro zarimo: Gukunda no kuramya umwami: Nubwo iyo mvugo yakoreshwaga ityo mu bihe byo ha mbere, yabaga ishaka kugaragaza ko Abanyarwanda bahawe umurage w’ihame ryo gukunda no kubaha ubuyobozi bwabo. Ibyo bikabarinda amakimbirane yo kurwanira ubuyobozi no kubangamira gahunda za Leta. Iyo ikaba ariyo nkomoko-muzi yo kumvira abayobozi kw’Abanyarwanda, ari nayo mpamvu mu gihe cy’amatora yo kubashyiraho, biba bimeze nk’ubukwe, naho mu yandi mahanga, amatora akaba ari intambara zihitana benshi. Kumvira ubuyobozi kw’Abanyarwanda, kwababereye intwaro idasaza yabafashije guhangana n’ibyorezo bikaze byabaga byarazengereje igihugu. Iyo ubuyobozi bwafatanga ingamba zo kurwanya no kwagiriza ibyo byorezo, abaturage bazakiranaga yombi, bikanaborohera no kuzishyira mu bikorwa, kuko zabaga zatanzwe n’ubuyobozi bakunda. Kugira za kirazira: Mu murage w’Abanyarwanda, batojwe kugira ibyo baziririza, bibafasha kwigengesera mu byo bakora, no kugira ubushishozi bubatoza kudakora iki cyangwa se kiriya. Izo za kirazira, nizo zabafashije guhangana n’ibyorezo byadukaga mu gihugu, kuko babibonaga nk’ibizira bigomba kwirindwa, bakabirwanya bivuye inyuma.

title: Kurara imbere ku mugabo, ivure ku mugore: Ingingo y’umuco itavugwaho rumwe
content: Hamwe muhabyukiye izi mpaka ni ku rubuga nkoranyambaga rwa Twitter aho uwitwa Iliza Nelly yabajije abamukurikira uwabwiye abagabo ko aribo bagomba kuryama imbere. Ese ninde wambwiye abagabo ko bagomba kuryama imbere bataryama inyuma kugikuta?😂🤷🏿♀️ — Iliza Nelly (@ilizanina) April 15, 2020 Iki kibazo cya Iliza cyakuruye impaka mu bamukurikira,ibintu byagaragazwaga n’ibisubizo batangaga. Bamwe bavuze ko umugabo agomba kuryama imbere kugira ngo arinde umutekano ndetse abe yiteguye guhangana n’uwabatera. Mu bashyigikiye iki gitekerezo harimo Danny wagize ati “Ikindi ni uko umugabo ari umutware w’urugo iyo hagize igitera urugo ahita ajya kurwana ngo atabare urugo kandi umugore we ahita yirukira ku rukuta yihisha” Ikindi nuko umugabo arumutware wurugo iyo hagize igitera urugo ahita ajya gukora fight ngo atabare urugo kdi umugore we ahita yirukira kurukuta yihisha✍️ — Danny (@dannyha2020) April 15, 2020 Azzah we yagize ati “Ni ukugira ngo bacunge umutekano w’urugo.” Nukugir bacunge umutekano w urugo🤷🏾♂️ — AZ ZAH (@AZZAH20161) April 15, 2020 Uretse aba bavuga ko umugabo aryama imbere kubera impamvu zo kurinda umutekano w’urugo, abandi barimo Nsanzurwanda Leandre bagaragaje ko biterwa ahanini n’uko abagore bakunze kuryama mbere y’abagabo. Ati “Buri igihe abagabo baryama nyuma y’abagore.” Uwitwa Icyeza we agaragaza ko afite inzozi zo kuryama imbere “ Nanjye njya mbyibaza?? Gusa numva rimwe nzaryama imbere nkumva icyo ambwira.” Nanjye jya byibaza ?? Gusa numva rimwe nzaryama imbere nkumva icyo ambwira 😂😂😂 — Y A K A 🍻 (@BIcyeza) April 15, 2020 Ku bandi barimo Innocent bagaragaje ko byose bishingira ku myumvire ko ubu yaba umugore cyangwa umugore buri wese yaryama aho ashaka. Ati“Iyo niyo yari imyumvire yanjye mbere...aho ariho hose waharyama.” That was myth before...ahariho hose waharyama — Viboyinnocent (@Viboyinnocent1) April 15, 2020 Umwe mu bagore bubatse waganiriye na IGIHE ariko ntiyifuze ko amazina ye ajya hanze, yavuze ari uburyo bwo gupfobya ubushobozi bw’abagore hitwajwe kubarindira umutekano. Yagize ati “Icyo gitekerezo abakizanye sinzi icyo bari bagamije ariko njye kuri ubu mbona ari ukudupfobya, kuki twe tutaryama imbere nk’abagabo, ibyo bavuga ngo baba bagira ngo igikomye babe aba mbere gutabara natwe twabikora.” Uyu mugore asanga hakwiye kubaho ubwumvikane hagati y’umugabo n’umugore buri wese akaryama ahamunogeye ndetse yumva yishimiye. Impuguke mu muco n’amateka by’u Rwanda, Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, avuga ko uyu mugenzo wari ufite agaciro gakomeye mu muco Nyarwanda kuko wagaragaza ihame rya ‘umbere inyuma nkubere imbere aho “mu gihe umugabo ari kurwana n’ibikomeye umugore akaba ari guhisha abana cyangwa abacisha mu cyanzu ngo bahunge. Ati “Mu gihe umugabo ari kwakira abashyitsi ku irembo, umugore akaba atunganya mu ruganiriro.” Nsanzabera avuga ko uku kuryama imbere ku mugabo bituruka ku nshingano ahabwa n’umuco nyarwanda zo kubungabunga umutekano w’urugo. Mu muco Nyarwanda umugabo wararaga ivure yagaragaraga nk’umunyabwoba ndetse agafatwa nk’ikigwari gitinya kujya aho rukomeye.

title: RALC yakebuye abanena Ikinyarwanda ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, ibyita ‘ubujiji’
content: Muri iyi minsi y’ikoranabuhanga, imbuga nkoranyambaga zabaye urubuga rukomeye rutangirwamo ibitekerezo, aho abantu bagaragariza amarangamutima yabo, ibibababaje, ibibashimishije n’ibindi. Kubera ko akenshi izo mbuga ziba zarakozwe n’abanyamahanga, indimi zikoreshwaho zikunze kuba ari iz’amahanga nubwo nta we ubuza abavuga cyangwa abandika indimi gakondo kuzikoreshaho. Hari bamwe bumva ko kwandika ubutumwa mu rurimi rw’Icyongereza ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ari bwo busirimu, aribwo abantu bakubaha naho kubwandika mu Kinyarwanda bikaba ubuturage. Umuyobozi w’Ishami ry’Ururimi muri RALC, Nsanzabaganwa Modeste, yabwiye IGIHE ko abatekereza gutyo baba bafite ubujiji no gushaka kwigaragaza uko batari. Ati “Iyo wiyerekana uko uri , si kimwe n’iyo wiyerekana wambaye isura y’undi muntu. Uri umunyarwanda ushaka kugaragara nk’umunyarwanda, ushaka gutanga ibitekerezo nk’umunyarwanda, ubivuze mu rurimi rwawe rero rw’Ikinyarwanda nibyo byiza ni nabyo bikuranga. Ni nabwo ushobora gutanga igitekerezo neza uko ugitekereza.” “Ntabwo wajya guha abaturage ikiganiro ku kintu, uri gitifu ngo ugende wambaye ikanzu ya padiri, ntibihuye. Barakubonamo Padiri ntabwo bakubonamo gitifu.” Nsanzabaganwa yavuze ko bitumvikana uburyo wasimbuka abaturage bagera kuri miliyoni 12 bumva Ikinyarwanda ari nabo bagenewe ibyo wanditse ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, ngo ubyandike mu Cyongereza kitumvwa n’abanyarwanda bose. Ati “Harimo ubwirasi, tujye tuvuga ibintu uko bimeze. Kuvuga ngo njye ndakoresha Icyongereza, kuki usimbuka abanyarwanda? Urasimbuka miliyoni 12 z’abanyarwanda ukajya kubwira noneho abantu batagera kuri miliyoni bavuga Icyongereza, ubwo urumva ukora ibiki?” Yongeyeho ati “Kumva ko uzagira agaciro ari uko uvuze ururimi rutari Ikinyarwanda, aho ndahagaya cyane harimo n’ubujiji. Kumva ko uboneka neza uhunga kuba umunyarwanda, ko uzagira agaciro kuko wahunze kuba umunyarwanda, ni ikibazo gikomeye.” U Rwanda rurajwe ishinga no guteza imbere ibyakorewe mu Rwanda (Made in Rwanda ) kugira ngo rukomeze kugira agaciro mu ruhando mpuzamahanga. Nsanzabaganwa avuga ko Made in Rwanda ya mbere ari ukuvuga Ikinyarwanda ibindi bikubakiraho, kuko ari rwo rurimi ruhuza abanyarwanda runakubiyemo indangagaciro zabo zose. Kuri iyo ngingo, hari na bamwe mu banyarwanda bagiye bagaragaza ko badashyigikiye abahunga Ikinyarwanda, bagakoresha indimi z’amahanga ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ngo bubahwe. Ku nyandiko RALC yacishije kuri Twitter kuwa 17 Werurwe 2020 ivuga ko nta busirimu buri mu kutavuga Ikinyarwanda, uwitwa Ndagimijamana Emmanuel yatanze igitekerezo agira ati “Ibi nibyo nirirwa buri gihe ndwana nabyo kuri WatsApp Status za bamwe mu nshuti zanjye ariko bamwe barumva abandi ntibabyumva." Undi yagize ati “Ibi ndabihamya gusa imbogamizi ni imwe, urubyiruko ruri kubyiruka ntabwo ruzi Ikinyarwanda kandi ntirushishikajwe kukimenya nk’ururimi ruhuza bene kanyarwanda, ahubwo barufata nk’ururimi rwiyongera mu zivugwa bityo bagaha agaciro indimi mvamahanga.” RALC ivuga ko Ikinyarwanda kivugwa n’umubare munini w’abatuye Isi, kugera kuri miliyoni 36 z’abatuye mu Karere k’Ibiyaga Bigari. Mu Rwanda, 93 % by’abaturage bavuga Ikinyarwanda.

title: Uko ubuhanzi nyarwanda bwakoreshejwe mu gucengeza amacakubiri yagejeje kuri Jenoside
content: Abahanzi bamwe na bamwe babaye igikoresho cya Leta mu gucengeza amacakubiri no kubiba urwango rwa Jenoside yahitanye Abatutsi bagera kuri 1.074.017. Umuco bawuhindura ico, ushakirwamo ubuhanga n’ubumenyi bwo gucengeza amacakubiri. Bitewe nuko Abahanzi ari bamwe mu bifashishwa mu gutanga ubutumwa bukagera kuri benshi, no mu gucengeza amacakubiri barifashishijwe. Twagerageje gushaka bamwe mu bahanzi n’indirimbo bahimbye zifashishijwe mu gucamo ibice abanyarwanda no gushishikariza abahutu kwanga abatutsi. Chorale Abanyuramatwi Chorale Abanyuramatwi y’i Gitarama yari izwi cyane kubera ubuhanga bwari mu ndirimbo zabo, abenshi muri bo bari barize mu Iseminari bazi guhimba no gucuranga injyana ya muzika. Uwari umuyobozi wabo ni Michel HABARUREMA. Abanyuramatwi bakwije ingengabitekerezo y’urwango na Jenoside bakoresheje indirimbo nyinshi zanyuzwaga kuri Radio Rwanda no mu bitaramo. Nibo baririmbye indirimbo yubahiriza igihugu ya mbere “Rwanda Rwacu”. Zimwe mu ndirimbo z’Abanyuramatwi zatwitse igihugu zirimo “Jya mbere Rwanda” aho Umututsi yitirirwaga kuba nk’Umukoroni, Umunyamahanga, Umwanzi w’u Rwanda, Gashakabuhake,... Amwe mu magambo y’iyo ndirimbo hari aho bagize bati “U Rwanda rwari rute? Kazungu na Gatutsi bari bararumize.” Nibo kandi bahimbye indirimbo “Turatsinze” ivuga ko Rwanda rubonye bene rwo Gahutu akwiye kuganza. Mu ndirimbo yabo “ Ibigwi by’Abaparmehutu” bashimira Abahutu kuba baratsinze, bakaba baharanira inyungu za Gahutu. Ikintu kibi gikomeye muri iyi ndirimbo nuko nta jambo Umunyarwanda ririmo. Icyari gishishikaje Abanyarumatwi ni imibereho myiza y’Abahutu n’ikandamizwa ry’Abatutsi. Abanyuramatwi bigishije mu ndirimbo zabo ko Igihugu n’ibyacyo ari icy’Abahutu. Niwo murongo indirimbo zabo zagendeyeho. Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994 yaje isoza ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’iyo ngengabitekerezo yakwijwe mu Rwanda kuva kera. Umuhanzi Simon Bikindi Simoni Bikindi ni Umuhanzi akaba n’umunyaporitiki ukomeye wari mu Ishyaka rya MRND. Bikindi yavutse tariki 28 Ukwakira 1954 avukira muri Komini Rwerere ku Gisenyi, ubu ni mu Karere ka Rubavu. Bikindi yari umuntu umwe mu bavugaga rikijyana kuri Leta ya Perezida Habyarimana bitewe n’uko yari umuntu wa hafi wa Perezida. Muri 1994 yakoraga muri Minisiteri y’urubyiruko n’amashyirahamwe (MIJEUMA) akaba yarayoboraga Itorero ryitwaga Irindiro. Abinyujije mu buhanzi bwe, yagize uruhare runini mu gushishikariza Abahutu gutsemba Abatutsi. Indirimbo za Bikindi zakoreshejwe cyane n’amashyaka ya poritiki MRND na CDR n’andi yari ahuriye mu cyitwaga HUTU POWER mu gutegura no gushyira mu bikorwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri Mata 1994. Indirimbo “Twasezereye ingoma ya Cyami” yahimbwe mu wa 1987, u Rwanda rwibuka imyaka 25 y’ubwigenge. Ni indirimbo yerekana ko icyiswe ingoma ya cyami nta kiza na kimwe yamariye u Rwanda, nyamara u Rwanda rwaguwe n’abami, ni nabo baruremye batanga igihe cyabo bizirika umukanda mu gihe kingana n’imyaka 221 [1091-1312] bashyiraho inkingi za mwamba ruzubakirwaho rukaba igihugu gihamye ubwo bazaba batakiriho. Abami Bikindi yamaganaga, nibo bubatse u Rwanda ruhamya igitinyiro hagati y’amahanga aruzengurutse, bararwagura ruba rugari. Byafashe igihe kitari gito kugira ngo uwo mugambi wo kurwagura ugerweho, ukurikije ibirari by’amateka urugamba rwo kubaka igihugu no kucyagura, abami b’u Rwanda bawakuranweho mu gihe kingana n’imyaka 583[1312-1895]. Ntawafata ibibazo n’akaga k’ubwicanyi u Rwanda rwahuye nabyo ngo abyitirire abami yiyibagije ububi bw’Abakoroni, PARMEHUTU na MRND.  Ikindi kandi, umuntu nka Bikindi wari warize akaminuza, byongeye w’umuyobozi mu gihugu, ntiyari akwiriye gupfobya bigeze hariya Abakurambere mpangarwanda bakuturanyije bakarema igihugu kikabaho none akaba yari akiganjemo nk’umuyobozi, ajaramye mu byo baruhiye, asoroma ku mbuto z’umuruho wabo kandi bo batakiriho. Indirimbo “Akabyutso” izwi cyane ku izina rya “Nanga Abahutu” yahimbwe muri 1992. Bikindi yakanguriraga Abahutu kwishyira hamwe bakarwanya Abatutsi kuko aribo mwanzi ubahuje. Bikindi avuga ko yanga Abahutu b’inda ndende banga abandi Bahutu, ko Abahutu bose bagomba guhuriza ku mugambi umwe wo kwanga Abatutsi. Muri rusange iyi ndirimbo irahamagarira ubumwe bw’Abahutu mu kurwanya Umututsi iyo ava akagera. Bikindi anibasira Abahutu barwanya ingengabitekerezo ya jenoside, cyane cyane abari bari mu mashyaka ataravugaga rumwe n’ubutegetsi bw’ibyob bihe, nibo ashinja ko bahawe igiceri ngo bice abandi Bahutu. Indirimbo nk’iyi yaterega Interahamwe akanyabugabo zikumva ko kwishyira hamwe no kwica bagakora jenoside ari umurimo mwiza ku Muhutu wese. Indirimbo ya gatatu ni iyiswe “Impuruza” izwi ku izina rya “Bene Sebahinzi” nayo yahimbwe muri 1992 ikaba itanga ubutumwa bw’ubumwe bw’Abahutu mu mugambi wo kwanga Abatutsi. Muri iyi ndirimbo, Bikindi aririmba Intara zose ze kera zari zigize u Rwanda, akavuga ko hose yahageze agasanga bahujwe n’agahinda ko kuba hari umwanzi wabateye ushaka kubamara, ariko Abahutu bakaba batabyumva, bakaba bagomba gutabarwa no kurindwa ko bamarana. Uwo mwanzi niwe Bikindi yita INTERANYABAGABO. Iyi ndirimbo igaragaza agahinda Bikindi yatewe nuko ngo Abahutu basa nk’abataye ubwenge, ngo bariho baramarana kandi bagombye gushyira hamwe no kumvikana bakarwanya umwanzi umwe bahuriyeho ariwe Ikontanyi. Iyo bavugaga Inkotanyi byabaga bivuga Umututsi. Iyi ndirimbo Bikindi yayihimbye mu gihe Abatutsi bicwaga Bugesera. Izi ndirimbo zanyuzwaga kuri Radio Rwanda no kuri RTLM.  Ku itariki 02 Ukwakira 2008, Urukiko mpuzamahanga (TPIR) rwakatiye Bikindi igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu rumaze kumuhamya icyaha cyo gukangurira Abahutu gutsemba Abatutsi. Ng’uko uko umuco mwiza w’u Rwanda, ubuhanzi bw’ibinyurabwenge n’ibinyuramatwi byanyuzwagamo iyerekwa ry’Abanyarwanda, bwifashishijwe mu gucengeza amacakubiri yo kurimbura Abatutsi batagira ingano.

title: Uko Kofi Annan yasuye u Rwanda mu 1998, abayobozi bakuru bose bakanga kumwakira
content: Uruzinduko rw’iminsi itatu yagiriye mu Rwanda rwamubereye agahomamunwa, atahana ipfunwe. Ibikomere byari bikivirirana haba mu mutima no ku mibiri. Icyo gihe kuri lisiti y’abantu Abanyarwanda batari bishimiye, Kofi Annan yari mu ba mbere. Impamvu ni uko ubwo Abatutsi bicwaga hakabura gitabara Annan ari we wari ukuriye ibikorwa byo kugarura amahoro ku Isi muri Loni. Ingabo za MINUAR ubwo zahambiraga utwazo zigasiga Abatutsi ku Kicukiro mu maboko y’Interahamwe, Annan ni umwe mu bafashe icyemezo bashize amanga cyo kugenda kwazo, abo zatereranye basigara bicwa uruhondogo. Kofi Annan yari umugabo ucisha make, wiyoroshya cyane mu mvugo ndetse wari wubashywe ku rwego mpuzamahanga biri no mu byamuhesheje kuyobora Loni. Umurage we wononwe n’icyasha yiteye kubera kutagira icyo akora ngo ahagarike Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi n’ubwicanyi bwakorewe muri Bosnia na Herzegovina. Annan yaje mu Rwanda yumva ari nka rumwe mu ngendo nyinshi yakoreraga hirya no hino ku Isi, yumva ari bukoreshe amagambo asize umunyu amwe y’abanyapolitiki ariko Abanyarwanda bamubera ibamba. Muri urwo ruzinduko rw’iminsi itatu, yabanje guhagamwa n’abadepite mu Nteko, avuyeyo umugoroba wo kumwakira ku meza abayobozi bakuru mu Rwanda barimo Perezida, Visi Perezida na Minisitiri w’Intebe birangira batawitabiriye, mu gitondo agiye guhura n’abacitse ku icumu banga kumwitaba. Umunsi wa mbere wamubereye ihurizo Kofi Annan yageze mu Rwanda kuwa Gatatu tariki 6 Gicurasi 1998. Yaje nyuma y’igitutu amahanga yashyiraga kuri Loni, agaragaza ko ntacyo yakoze ngo itabare Abatutsi bicwaga mu Rwanda kandi byari mu bushobozi bwayo. Yageze mu Rwanda hashize iminsi ibiri ikinyamakuru The New Yorker cyanditse inkuru icukumbuye, yagaragazaga uburyo tariki 11 Mutarama 1994 hari ubutumwa Major General Roméo Dallaire wari ukuriye ingabo za Loni mu Rwanda, yandikiye Kofi Annan n’abandi bari bamukuriye abamenyesha ko Leta ya Habyarimana iri gutegura Jenoside ariko ntibabihe agaciro. Ngo ayo makuru Major General Roméo Dallaire yari yayahawe n’umuntu wamuhaga amakuru y’imbere muri Leta, wahoze ari mu bashinzwe umutekano wa Habyarimana. Uwo muntu ajya kumenera ibanga Dallaire, ngo yari yasabwe n’ishyaka rya Habyarimana gukora urutonde rw’Abatutsi no gutoza Interahamwe zari bwice Abatutsi bari baruriho. Inkuru ya The New Yorker yaciye igikuba muri Loni, iza habura umunsi umwe ngo Kofi Annan ahaguruke aze mu maso y’abo ashinjwa kwanga gutabara. Loni yamaganye ayo makuru ariko ntibyagira icyo bitanga kuko abayatanze banafotoye Fax Dallaire yohereje muri Loni bakanga kumwumva. Mu Rwanda naho abayobozi basaga nk’abadashishikajwe n’uruzinduko rwa Kofi Annan ndetse hari umuyobozi umwe wabwiye The New Yorker, ati“Abantu benshi mu gihugu cyanjye ntabwo bishimiye Annan. Niwe wari ukuriye ibijyanye n’ubutumwa bw’amahoro muri Loni kandi ingabo za Loni nizo zatumye Jenoside ikomeza. Mumureke ariko aze azabyiyumvire imbonankubone.” Umunsi wa mbere Annan yari amaze kwibonera akababaro k’Abanyarwanda. Ku gicamunsi cy’umunsi yagereyeho mu Rwanda yagiye mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, abadepite bamwima agahenge. Ubwo Ibiro Ntaramakuru by’Abanya-Canada [ntibikiri iby’Abongereza], Reuters byandikaga ku ruzinduko rwa Annan mu Rwanda, byagize biti “Annan yeretswe uburakari mu ruhame na Minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga, yibasirwa n’abadepite, asananirwa n’abayobozi bakuru b’igihugu, yimwa amatwi n’abarokotse Jenoside.” Mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, Annan wari kumwe n’umufasha we, abadepite bakomezaga kumwibutsa ko afite uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yabyanga yabyemera. Nyuma yo kubona ko atishimiwe, Annan ntibyamuciye intege yarakomeje ageza ku badepite ijambo ry’umunsi yari yateguye ari naryo ryasembuye uburakari kurushaho. Mbere yo gutangira ijambo rye, yagize ati “Ntabwo naje hano kujya mu mpaka kandi muzi ko hari umugani uvuga ngo umushyitsi buri gihe ahora ari imbohe y’umusangwa.” Muri iryo jambo rye, yavuze ko icyamuzanye mu Rwanda ari ukomora ibikomere n’amacakubiri byari bigishegeshe igihugu ndetse no kwizeza ubufasha bw’Umuryango w’Abibumbye mu gushakira u Rwanda amahoro n’iterambere. Annan yavuze ko ibyabaye ari “Amakuba yaturutse imbere, akukumba imiryango. Ni amakuba yasigiye abarokotse ihungabana ritavugwa.” Yakomeje agira ati “Turemera ko Isi yatereranye u Rwanda mu gihe ikibi cyari kirwugarije. Isi ikwiriye kwihana ntizongere gutsindwa gutya. Ubu noneho tuzi ko ibyo twakoze bitari bihagije mu gutabara u Rwanda, ntabwo twahesheje agaciro amahame yatumye Loni ishingwa.” Mu ijambo ryose yavuze, ntaho Kofi Annan yigeze agaragaza uruhare rwe mu kudatabara u Rwanda nk’uwari uhagarariye ibikorwa byo kugarura amahoro muri Loni. Ntacyo yavuze ku nkuru ya The New Yorker yari imaze kumushinja kwirengagiza ibyabaga mu Rwanda kandi yarabibwiwe. Kofi Annan yavuze ko kudatabarwa k’u Rwanda byatewe n’ubushake buke bwa politiki mpuzamahanga, aho kuba Loni ubwayo. Ijambo yavugiye mu nteko ryasubije ibintu irudubi! Yarinze ava mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko uwo mugoroba abadepite batanyuzwe. Ijambo yavugiye mu Nteko ryo ryasubije ibintu irudubi. Abari biteze ko nibura asaba imbabazi basubije amerwe mu isaho. Uretse kudasaba imbabazi, yari yongereyeho ikindi ko Jenoside ari ‘Amakuba yaturutse imbere’, bivuze ko ari ibyago Abanyarwanda biteye, nta ruhare rw’amahanga. Ubuyobozi bw’u Rwanda bwatangiye gushinja Kofi Annan ubwirasi agihari, anagayirwa kutava ku izima ngo asabe imbabazi. Ni uruzinduko rwaranzwe ahanini n’ibimenyetso bikomeye bigaragaza uburyo u Rwanda rutari rwiteguye kwakira Kofi Annan utari busabe imbabazi ku bw’uruhare rwe muri Jenoside. Iburizwamo ry’umuhango wo kwakirwa ku meza n’uwari Perezida wa Repubulika, Visi Perezida na Minisitiri w’Intebe ryatunguye benshi icyo gihe. Uwari Umuvugizi wa Guverinoma, Joseph Bideri yabwiye Reuters ko babikoze bashaka kwamagana ‘ubwirasi’ buri mu ijambo Kofi Annan yagejeje ku Nteko Ishinga Amategeko. Bukeye tariki 7 Gicurasi, Kofi Annan yagombaga kuganira n’itsinda ry’abarokotse Jenoside kuri ETO Kicukiro ariko ubwo abari bamuherekeje bahageraga nta muntu n’umwe bahasanze. Ntabwo icyatumye abarokotse Jenoside batahagera cyatangajwe ariko cyari ikindi kimenyetso cy’uko ijambo rye mu Nteko ryari ryagawe bikomeye. Kofi Annan amaze kubura abantu kuri ETO Kicukiro, yakomeje urugendo ajya ku rwibutso rwa Nyanza ya Kicukiro. Aho ku rwibutso yashyize indabo ku mva, atemberezwa mu nzu y’amabati yari irimo imibiri y’abazize Jenoside itarashyingurwa mu cyubahiro. Imbere y’abarokotse Jenoside i Nyanza yemeye ko ‘iyo baza guha Dallaire ingabo zihagije, aba yaratabaye abicwaga.” Mbere yo kuva mu Rwanda yerekeza muri Uganda, Kofi Annan abanyamakuru bamubajije uko yakiriye uburakari Abanyarwanda bamugaragarije, avuga ko yabiganiriye n’abayobozi b’u Rwanda bakiyunga. Yavuze ko Abanyarwanda bamugejejeho ibibazo bafite, kandi ko byerekeye Loni muri rusange aho kuba we ku giti cye. Ibinyamakuru bitandukanye byanditse ko uruzinduko rwa Annan mu Rwanda ari rumwe mu zamukojeje isoni mu buzima bwe muri Loni ndetse ko rwahinduye uburyo Loni yafataga imyanzuro ku bibazo bihari. Tariki 7 Mata 2004 ubwo hibukwaga imyaka 10 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ibaye, Kofi Annan yarashyize asaba imbabazi za Loni nawe ubwe ku giti cye kuko batatabaye Abanyarwanda. Yagize ati “Njye ubwanjye nk’uwari umuyobozi w’ishami rya Loni rishinzwe kugarura amahoro ku isi, nasunitse ibihugu byinshi ngo bitange ingabo. Nyuma ya Jenoside naje kubona ko hari ibindi nashoboraga gukora. Uru rwibutso rubi rwatwaje imitekerereze yanjye n’imyanzuro mfata nk’Umunyamabanga Mukuru.” Isomo ry’ikimwaro yatewe no kudatabara muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ryakomeje gutuma Kofi Annan yigengesera cyane. Mu 2012 yeguye ku mwanya w’intumwa idasanzwe mu gushakira umuti intambara yo muri Syria. Ngo uwanga amazimwe abandwa habona! Kofi Annan yavuze ku mugaragaro ko yatabaje akanama ka Loni gashinzwe umutekano n’umuryango mpuzamahanga bakamwima amatwi, ahitamo kwegura. Ku myaka 80, tariki 18 Kanama 2018 nibwo hamenyekanye inkuru y’urupfu rwa Kofi Annan.

title: Ibitabo by’abana byanditse mu Kinyarwanda byatangiye gushyirwa kuri internet ku buntu
content: Hashize iminsi Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ifashe ingamba zirimo gusubiza abanyeshuri mu miryango yabo hirindwa ikwirakwizwa ry’icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Perdua Publishers, Uwera Perpétue, yabwiye IGIHE ko batangiye gushyira ibitabo byabo kuri internet mu rwego rwo gufasha abanyeshuri biga mu mashuri y’incuke n’abanza. Yagize ati “Kubera iki kibazo gituma abana batari ku ishuri, twatekereje uburyo twabafasha kubona ibitabo ku buryo ababyeyi bashobora kubibasomera. Ni ukugira ngo mu gihe bari mu rugo batarambirwa, baniyungura ubwenge kuko mu bitabo abana bigiramo ubumenyi bwinshi.” Ku rubuga rwabo Www.perduap.com batangiye bashyiraho ibitabo icumi birimo inkuru z’abana, icyenda byanditse mu rurimi rw’Ikinyarwanda na kimwe kiri mu Cyongereza. Uwera yavuze ko nk’abana bataramenya gusoma, ababyeyi babo bashobora kubafasha babasomera ndetse n’abazi gusoma badafite mudasobwa cyangwa telefoni zigezweho, ababyeyi bakabafasha. Inzu yandika isohora ibitabo by’abana, Sankofa Creatives Ltd nayo yatangiye gushyira kuri internet ibitabo by’abana ku buntu ibicishije ku rukuta rwayo rwa Facebook, rwitwa Sankofa Creatives Ltd. Uwacu Karekezi Martine ukuriye Sankofa Creative Ltd, yabwiye IGIHE ko icyo bifuza ari ugufasha abana bari mu rugo iwabo kutarambirwa, basoma ibitabo bibafasha kwiyungura ubwenge. Minisiteri y’Uburezi iherutse gutangiza uburyo butandukanye buzafasha abana bari mu ngo iwabo gukomeza gusubiramo amasomo bifashishije internet, radio na televiziyo. Inzu y’ibitabo by’Abana ya Editions Bakame nayo yatangije ikiganiro kuri Televiziyo Rwanda cyiswe ’Dusome" gitambuka buri munsi kuva ku wa Mbere kugeza ku wa Gatanu saa tatu n’igice za mu gitondo. Muri icyo kiganiro hasomwa ibitabo by’abana byanditswe na Editions Bakame. Uwera yashishikarije n’izindi nzu zandika ibitabo by’abana korohereza abari mu ngo, babagezaho ibitabo mu buryo bworoshye. Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Uburezi (REB) giherutse gushishikariza abanyeshuri bari mu ngo iwabo gukoresha urubuga elearning.reb.rw rubonekaho incamake ya buri somo mu yigishwa mu mashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye, iby’ingenzi birimo n’aho umunyeshuri yakura ibirambuye kuri iryo somo. Haba hariho kandi ibindi bimufasha kurushaho gusobanukirwa nk’amafoto n’amashusho ndetse n’ibibazo byatuma umunyeshuri yisuzuma. Urubuga rwa REB (Www.reb.rw) narwo rubonekaho ibitabo by’amasomo atandukanye bikoreshwa mu mashuri yo mu Rwanda.

title: Byinshi kuri Ruzagayura, inzara yashegeshe u Rwanda igahitana abasaga ibihumbi 300
content: Iyo inzara yatangiye ahagana mu Ukwakira 1942, itewe n’amapfa yamaze imyaka ibiri. Ayo mapfa yatangiye muri Nzeri 1941, yongera kubaho nyuma gato y’itumba ryo mu 1942. Igitabo “Imizi y’u Rwanda” cy’Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, kigaragaza ko iyo nzara yenyegejwe yatewe n’igabanyuka ry’ibiribwa ryaturutse ku ndwara y’ibirayi bita “mildiou/mildew”, ndetse no ku ndwara y’ibishyimbo bita “chortophila”. N’ibijumba muri ibyo bihe byari byibasiwe n’indwara bita “rhizoctonia/rhizoctonie”. Inzara ya Ruzagayura yongerewe ubukana kandi n’intambara ya kabiri y’isi yose, ndetse n’uko icyo gihe Abanyarwanda bagombaga guha umusanzu abakoroni b’Ababiligi bari bahanganye n’ingabo za Adolf Hitler mu ntambara ya kabiri y’isi yose . Uwo musanzu wari ugizwe n’ibiribwa n’amatungo. Icyo gihe imbuto gakondo z’Abanyarwanda, ari nazo zari zishoboye guhangana n’ibihe n’uburwayi bw’ibihingwa, zari zimaze gucika, bazisimbuje ibirayi, imyumbati, soya n’ibindi. Abanyarwanda batangaga inka, ibishyimbo, amasaka, amashaza byo kugaburira abasirikare b’abanyekongo ndetse n’abakozi bo mu birombe byo muri Congo. Usibye ibiribwa n’amatungo, umusanzu w’Abanyarwanda muri iyo ntambara wari ugizwe n’imirimo y’agahato irimo guharura imihanda, kubumba amatafari, gutwara imizigo y’abakoloni, gukora mu birombe bya zahabu, Gasegereti na Wolufuramu, guhinga ibireti byakoreshwaga mu gutunganya umuti wica udukoko . Inzara ya Ruzagayura yiswe amazina menshi bitewe n’ubukana yagiye igaragaza mu turere dutandukanye tw’u Rwanda. Mu majyepfo yiswe “Ruzagayura”. Mu duce dutandukanye tw’Iburasirazuba yiswe Rujukundi, Rwanyirarushenyi, Rwakinyebuye cyangwa se Rwakabetezi. Mu Majyaruguru mu bice bya za Rubavu, Nyabihu , Burera na Musanze yiswe amazina nka Rudakangwimishanana, Rugaragazabadakekwa na Nyirahuku. Hagati mu gihugu ndetse n’Amajyaruguru y’Iburasirazuba yari izwi nka Matemane naho mu Burengerazuba yitwa Gahoro. Iyo nzara yagize ubukana bwinshi mu Majyaruguru, mu Burasirazuba no mu Majyepfo y’igihugu. Mu bice bya Rusizi na Nyamasheke, niho honyine hatigeze hahura n’iyo nzara ku mpamvu z’ikirere cyaho. Ikindi, iyo ntara yari yegeranye na Congo Mbiligi ku buryo itari kugira ikibazo cyo kubura ibiribwa. Ahubwo yakiraga abantu bavuye mu zindi ntara nka Astrida (Butare) na Gisenyi. Mu gihe cya Ruzagayura, uduce tw’imisozi ihanamye, uduce tw’ubutaka busharira, uduce turangwamo isuri nitwo twababaye cyane kurusha utundi. Muri utwo duce kimwe n’ahandi, abaturage barazahaye ku buryo benshi bamaraga iminsi ibir cyangwa se itatu badakoze ku munwa. Benshi inzara yarabicaga. Abaryaga, wasangaga barya inguri (imizi y’insina), imizi y’ibiti, amareberebe, umutsima uvuye mu ifu ya barakatsi (acacia) cyangwa se y’intembe y’insina. Iyo ndyo idasanzwe nta gushidikanya ko nayo yishe abantu benshi muri ibyo bihe. Abafite agatege barasuhukaga bakajya gushaka aho bakura ibiribwa cyangwa se aho bagurana ibikoresho byabo n’ibiribwa. Benshi wasangaga barananutse nk’uko bigaragara ku mafoto y’icyo gihe. Babitaga ingarisi kubera uko babaga barashizemo. Ni nako bitaga imirambo y’abo yahitanye. Iyo mirambo yasangwaga hafi y’imihanda, mu mirima, mu mashyamba, ku nkengero z’inzuzi n’ahandi henshi. Nyuma y’uko hafashwe ingamba zinyuranye zo kurwanya inzara ya Ruzagayura, abaturage babishishikarijwemo n’abategetsi b’abakoloni ndetse n’abatware bahinganye ubwira. Guhera mu ntangiriro zo mu wa 1944, Abanyarwanda bahinze ibishyimbo, amashaza, ibirayi, imyumbati n’ibijumba. Kubera uburumbuke bw’imvura yaguye mu buryo buhagije, umusaruro wariyongereye, ibigega byongera guhunikwamo, abari barasuhutse bagaruka mu ngo zabo. Ubwo abamisiyoneri bahagaritse gutanga amafunguro. Inkambi z’ingarisi zirafungwa. Ahagana muri Nyakanga 1944, abategetsi b’abakoloni bahagaritse kohereza amakamyo y’ibiribwa mu Rwanda yavaga muri Kongo. Mu mpera z’umwaka wa 1944, aba aribwo hatangazwa ko inzara yarangiye mu gihugu. Nubwo inzara ya Ruzagayura yamaze igihe gito, yahitanye abantu benshi cyane. Abamisiyoneri b’abagatolika batangaje muri raporo ngarumwaka yo hagati yo mu wa 1939-1945, ko u Rwanda rwatakaje abantu bagera ku 300. 000, harimo n’abasuhukiye mu bindi bihugu nka Tanganyika, Uganda na Congo Mbiligi. Muri iyo raporo bavugaga ko abasuhutse bageraga ku 75, 000. Ababaruraga hari ubwo bibagirwaga rimwe na rimwe kubara abana, abagore, abarwayi n’abasheshe akanguhe bapfuye cyangwa se bahunze iyo nzara ku buryo abo yahitanye bashobora kurenga. Inzara ya Ruzagayura yangije kandi byinshi, itera n’ubujura bukabije mu gihugu. Ubwo bujura bwakwiye mu turere twose tw’u Rwanda, cyane cyane utwari twarayogojwe n’inzara. Bwakorwaga n’ingeri zose z’Abanyarwanda. Mu turere tumwe na tumwe tw’u Rwanda, nko muri teritwari ya Gisenyi, ubwo bujura bwafashe indi ntera kugera aho abaturage batatinyaga gutega ku nzira bagenzi babo bavuye kuri za misiyoni bakabagusha mu gico cyabo ,maze bakabambura ibiribwa bahawe. Izo ngaruka za Ruzagayura, zateje umutekano muke mu gihugu, bizana urwikekwe n’umujinya mwinshi mu Banyarwanda. Ahanini, uwo mujinya waturukaga ku bukarihe bw’inzara no ku buremere bw’umusanzu watangwaga n’Abanyarwanda.

title: Amateka y’ibyorezo by’inzara, indwara z’abantu n’amatungo byayogoje u Rwanda kugeza mu 1946
content: Igitabo “Imizi y’u Rwanda” cyanditswe n’umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, kigaragaza ko ubwo hari hashize imyaka mike umwami Mibambwe Sentabyo yimye ingoma, ni ukuvuga ahasaga mu wa 1746, mu Gisaka hateye ubushita burimbura abatagira ingano.  Icyo ihe mu Rwanda hari intambara itoroshye hagati ya Mibambwe Sentabyo na Gatarabuhura washakaga ingoma ku mbaraga. Sentabyo yahashyije Gatarabuhura ahungira mu Gisaka. Mu gihe biteguraga gutera mu Gisaka hateye indwara y’ubushita bituma Abanyarwanda batinya gutera yo ngo batazana icyo cyorezo ndetse n’ umwami ubwe aca iteka ko nta muntu ugomba kwambuka Nyabarongo agana iburasirazuba bw’u Rwanda kugira ngo atagira aho ahurira n’iyo ndwara. Umwami na we yarimutse aza gutura muri Taba ya Gitarama ahitwa i Remera ndetse n’amato yose yambutsaga abantu muri Nyabarongo abuzwa kongera kwambutsa abantu mu rwego rwo gushyira mu kato igice cy’uburasirazuba. Kimenyi Getura umwami wategekaga i Gisaka icyo gihe ; na we yatinyaga u Rwanda kandi ahora azi neza ko isaha ku isaha igihugu cye cyaterwa n’abanyarwanda bakacyigarurira. Ibyo byatumye yigira inama yo gushyigikira Gatarabuhura akanamutiza amaboko bagafata ubutegetsi mu Rwanda bityo na we igihugu cye kikagira amahoro. Yashyizeho Inkoto( Bariyeri) hirya no hino mu gihugu cyane cyane ku mbibi zihuza u Rwanda n’i Gisaka. Uyu mwami Kimenyi Getura yaje guhimba amayeri yo kohereza umuntu mu Rwanda agenda yiyita ko ahunze igihugu bityo akaba ashaka ubuhungiro ku mwami Sentabyo. Uwo muntu ngo yaje yitwaje n’impano y’impuzu ikoze neza, ariko iyi mpano yari iy’uburozi kuko ngo yari yarambawe n’umunyabushita. Sentabyo ntiyagize amakenga y’ikigambiriwe, yahise akenyera iyo mpuzu imwanduza ubushita ari nabwo bwamuhitanye. Nubwo Sentabyo yahitanywe n’ubushita, yagerageje gukingira abanyarwanda, ntibabwandura ngo bubakukumbe. Yategetse ko nta munya-Gisaka winjira mu Rwanda, abanyarwanda nabo babuzwa kujyayo ndetse mu gihugu hose hashyirwaho za bariyeri (Inkoto) zikumira abashoboraga kukinjirana mu Rwanda. Hagati y’umwaka wa 1746 na 1946, mu Rwanda hadutse indwara z’ibyorezo zitandukanye zahitanye n’amatungo. Muri zo twavuga nko mu 1890-1891 ubwo hateraga indwara y’amatungo yitwa Muryamo yibasiraga cyane amatungo magufi, mu 1907-1908 hateye indwara y’amatungo yitwa Uburenge bwibasiraga cyane inka, mu 1920-1927 hateye indwara y’amatungo yitwa Iragara, mu 1934-1935 hongeye gutera Muryamo yibasira cyane cyane amatungo magufi n’indwara y’amatungo yitwa Amashuye bwibasiraga cyane inka inka yadutse mu 1936-1937. Kugira ngo abami b’u Rwanda bahoshe ibyo byorezo byibasiraga amatungo, bakoraga imihango yo gufukura amariba mashya bakayatera n’ibyuhagiro bivura izo ndwara n’indi mihango yateganywaga n’Ubwiru. U Rwanda kandi rwigeze kugira n’ibihe by’amapfa akomeye hatera ibyorezo by’inzara, zihitana abatari bake. Nko mu 1890 hateye inzara bise Muhatibicumuro, mu 1902 -1903 hateye inzara bise Ruyaga, mu 1917-1918 hateye Rumanura( Rumanurimbaba), mu 1924-1925 hateye Gakwege, mu 1927-1928 hateye Urwakayihura ( Yitiriwe Kayihura wataraga u Bugoyi kuko ariho yatangiriye), mu 1931 hateye inzige ziyogoza imyaka naho mu 1942-1944 hatera Ruzagayura. Mu bihe by’inzara n’amapfa, Abami b’amatungo n’imyaka bajyaga mu miterekero, bagatanga imbuto n’ibyuhagiro by’imyaka kugira ngo irumbuke. Kera mu Rwanda hakundaga gutera Inzara bitaga amazina bahereye ku cyayiteye, cyangwa se ku bimenyetso byayo no ku nkurikizi zayo Mu byorezo by’inzara , Abami b’imbuto bajyaga ku misozi miremire, bakahaca ibiraro, bagaterekera, ari na ko bavuza ingoma; imvura yabaga yahagamye, ikagwa. Ibyonnyi na byo byatera mu mirima, Abahoryo bakazivuma zikagenda. Hari n’indwara z’ ibyorezo zateraga mu bantu ku mpamvu zo kubura imiti zikarimbura imbaga , abarokotse zikabasigira ubusembwa. Indwara z’ibyorezo zateye mu Rwanda zikibasira abantu, zirimo ubushita bwateye hagati ya 1893 na 1894, mu 1916-1917 bwarongeye buratera, mu 1917-1918 ; hateye Mugiga inagaruka mu 1935 naho mu 1945 hatera ibihara. Iyo ibyorezo by’indwara nk’izo byateraga, Abami b’ imbuto n’amatungo batangaga amasubyo, ariyo miti y’amahumane yo gucubya ibyo byorezo by’indwara. Mu Rwanda rwa kera habaga n’indi mihango yajyanaga n’ingoma, igakorwa n’abavubyi b’imvura, bakayikorera ahantu inkuba yabaga yakubise, bakahaterekerera , kugira ngo bahavane umwaku wayo , bakahagangahura.

title: Incamake ku gitabo “Stop Working for Uncle Sam” gikebura abahora barambirije ku mushahara
content: Abafite akazi na bo bararira, bamwe binubira umushahara w’intica ntikize bahabwa, abandi barambiwe guhora bafatirwa imyanzuro y’icyo bakora, igihe bagikorera n’uko bagikora nta ruhare babigizemo. Sunday Adelaja ni umupasiteri wo muri Nigeria, yabavunnye amaguru mu gitabo cye ‘Stop Working for Uncle Sam’ cyasohotse mu 2017. Ni igitabo kigaragaza inzira zose wanyuramo ukareka gukorera abandi, aho gukoreshwa ugatangira gukoresha abandi. Iki gitabo kigereranya abakorera umushahara nk’abacakara bahorana ubukene bw’amafaranga, bagenerwa utuvungukira ku murundo w’ibyo baba babiriye icyuya, kandi hari uburyo nabo bakwiteza imbere. Umwanditsi asobanura Uncle Sam nk’ahantu hose ujya gushaka akazi cyangwa uburyo bw’imikorere aho imibereho yawe yose uyikesha uwo muntu cyangwa urwo rwego ruguha umushahara. Kubaho ukorera abandi Sunday abigereranya nk’ubucakara buburizamo ubwigenge bw’umuntu, aho ukora icyo bakubwiye cyose nta mwanya wo gutekereza cyangwa gukora ibintu nk’uko wowe ubishaka. Ati “Mu gihe ukorera Uncle Sam, uba wishyira mu bucakara ku bushake bwawe kubera ko akwishyura udufaranga tw’intica ntikize. Kubera utwo tuntu duke, uremera ukagurisha ubuzima bwawe, ukagurisha ukwishyira ukizana kwawe, uba uboshye udashobora guhindukira ngo ugane iburyo cyangwa ibumoso.” “Ntushobora kuvuga ngo ugiye mu biruhuko igihe ushakiye umukoresha wawe atabyemeye. Ntushobora kwihitiramo ngo ngiye aha n’aha mu gihe wenda cy’ukwezi, uba uziritswe.” Ni igitabo kigaragaza uburyo bwo guhunga ubucakara bwo kuba umukozi ahubwo ukaba umukoresha, ukareka kuba wa muntu uhorana ubukene kandi ukora buri munsi. Iki gitabo kigaragaza kandi ko abantu bose badakwiye kumva ko bakwikorera, ahubwo bashobora gukorera abandi, bakitanga bishoboka ariko batameze nk’abacakara. Agira inama abantu ko bakwiriye kwirinda kuguma mu kazi banga, kuko uko kukagumamo bituma bagakora nabi kurusha, bikarangira bashwanye n’abakoresha babo. Ingingo yo gukoresha igihe neza, nayo umwanditsi ayigarukaho, aho asobanura ko igihe kigereranywa n’ubuzima, kugikoresha nabi bikaba bisa no kwangiza ubuzima bwawe. Asobanura kandi ibyiza byo kwiga, ariko mu bundi buryo, aho usanga abantu benshi bumva ko kwiga bakaminuza bihagije kugira ngo babeho mu buzima bwiza bifuza, aho avuga ko atari byo ndetse bitanahuye. Iki gitabo cy’amapaji 292 kiboneka kuri Amazon.

title: Iby’ingenzi mu gitabo ‘Let the People Pick the President’ kinenga uburyo amatora muri Amerika akorwamo
content: Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ya Amerika yagerageje inshuro zisaga 700 guhindura cyangwa kuvanaho iryo tegeko ariko byaranze. Ni uburyo bwo gutora butumvwa kimwe n’abatuye Amerika. Electoral College muri Amerika, abatora babarwa ni abo bise ‘electors’ 538 muri Leta 50, barimo abasenateri 100, abadepite 435 n’abandi batatu ba District of Columbia. Abo mu bigaragara nibo batora ugomba kuba Perezida wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Leta zigenda zirushanya umubare w’abatora nk’uko zirutanwa mu bunini cyangwa umubare w’abaturage. Hagendewe ku ibarura ry’abaturage rya 2015, California ituwe na 39 144 818 ibarirwa abatora 55; Texas ifite 27 469 114 ikagira abatora 34; New York ituwe na 19 795 791 ikagira abatora 31 naho Pennsylvania ituwe na 12 802 503 ifite abatora 21. Kugira ngo byumvikane, igihe umukandida runaka atowe n’abaturage benshi muri California, ahita ahabwa abatora (electors) 55 hatitawe ku majwi abandi bari bahanganye bagize. Bivuze ko afatwa nk’uwatowe n’abatuye iyo Leta bose kandi atari ko biri. Utsinda ni ugira hejuru ya kimwe cya kabiri cya ba electors 538 kingana n’abantu 270. Ni uburyo bamwe bafata nk’ubudatanga ubwisanzure, kuko ibyo abaturage benshi bahisemo atari ihame ko ari byo byemezwa nkuko amahame ya demokarasi abiteganya. Umukandida ashobora gutorwa n’abaturage benshi ariko kuko yatowe n’abo muri Leta zidatuwe cyane kabone n’aho zaba ari nyinshi, agatsindwa kuko abo muri Leta zituwe cyane bamutoye ku bwinshi, akikubira ba ba ‘electors’ iyo Leta igenerwa. Ikindi gishobora kubitera ni uko muri Leta atagizemo ubwiganze, ayo majwi y’abamutoye asa nk’abaye imfabusa kandi wenda iyo aza guteranywa n’ay’ahandi yagize ubwiganze bwinshi, ari we washoboraga kuza imbere. Byarabaye mu 2016, ubwo Hillary Clinton yatsindwaga ku munota wa nyuma na Donald Trump nyamara Clinton ari we watowe na benshi. Mu matora atanu ya Perezida wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika aherutse, inshuro ebyiri zose hari abagiye batorwa atari uko batowe n’abaturage benshi ahubwo kuko uburyo bwa Electoral College bwabahaye ababahagararaira benshi kubera Leta zituwe cyane batsinzemo, nyamara wabara abaturage bose babatoye no muri za Leta zituwe na bake, ugasanga nibo bari batsinze cyane. N’iyo uwatowe na benshi ari we ubaye Perezida, akenshi abaturage ntibabona uruhare rwabo rw’ako kanya mu kumushyiraho, kuko amajwi yabo avunjwamo ibyo bindi byiswe ‘electors’ hakagira ababanza kuyaha umugisha mbere yo gutangaza uwatsinze. Igitabo cya Jesse Wegman kigaragaza ko mu gihe Amerika igiye kujya mu matora ya Perezida mu Ugushyingo 2020, uburyo bukoreshwa Perezida atorwa bukwiriye guhindurwa kuko budakoresha ukuri n’umucyo. Let the People Pick the President ni igitabo kijya mu mizi itangiriro ry’ubwo buryo bwiswe ‘Electoral College’ n’amakuru atandukanye yagiye atangwa na bamwe mu bagiye bagira uruhare mu matora ya Perezida yagiye aba guhera mu mwaka wa 2000, bagaragaza impamvu ubwo buryo butakijyanye n’igihe. Iki gitabo cyasohotse tariki 17 Werurwe 2020, kiboneka ku iguriro rya internet rya Amazon no ku zindi mbuga za internet zisomerwaho ibitabo.

title: Bimwe mu bitabo by’Abanyarwanda byagufasha muri iki gihe cya coronavirus
content: Muri ibi bihe Abanyarwanda bagiriwe inama yo kuguma mu ngo kugira ngo hahashywe icyorezo cya Coronavirus, gusoma igitabo ni bumwe mu buryo bwafasha kubyitwaramo neza, ntikibe igihe cy’ubwoba no gupfusha ubusa ahubwo kikaba umwanya wo kwiyungura ubwenge no kumenya byinshi. Ubwanditsi bw’ibitabo mu Rwanda bukomeje gutera imbere, ariyo mpamvu IGIHE yatoranyije bimwe mu bitabo by’Abanyarwanda biri mu ngeri zitandukanye bishobora gufasha abantu kumererwa neza muri ibi bihe. La mort ne veut pas de moi, Yolande Mukagasana La mort ne veut pas de moi ni igitabo Yolande Mukagasana yanditse mu mwaka wa 1997 nyuma y’imyaka itatu Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ibaye. Kigaruka ku buzima bubi Abatutsi baciyemo mu gihe cya Jenoside. Bavuga ko ‘Imana yirirwa ahandi igataha i Rwanda’, ariko Mukagasana mu gitabo yibaza niba guhera tariki 6 Mata 1994 yari ikiri mu Rwanda koko, cyangwa niba yari yarusigiye sekibi. Intwari z’Imbanza, zubatse u Rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro, Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu Iki gitabo cyasohotse mu mwaka wa 2018. Gikubiyemo amateka y’imyubakire y’u Rwanda nk’igihugu, umushinga waraje benshi rwantambi bawutekereza, na nyuma yo kuwunoza, ukabaraza ishinga mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryawo. Indege y’ubumwe Rwanda rw’ubu, François Xavier Gasimba Munezero Igitabo ‘Indege y’ubumwe Rwanda rw’ubu’ cya François Xavier Gasimba Munezero, cyasohotse mu 1999. Ni igitabo cy’inkuru mpimbano ikoze mu buryo bw’igisigo, ivuga kuri Guverinoma y’Ubumwe yagiyeho nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Mu buryo busa nk’ubutebya, Gasimba agaragaza u Rwanda nk’indege, itwawe n’abayobozi batandukanye bagenda bafata imyanzuro itandukanye ngo indege itarohama. Petit Pays, Gaël Faye  Iki gitabo cyanditswe mu mwaka wa 2016, cyandikwa na Gaël Faye, Umufaransa uvuka ku mubyeyi w’umunyarwanda. Avugamo ubuzima bwe, aho agaruka ku buzima bw’umwana wavukiye i Burundi akabyarwa n’umunyarwandakazi w’impunzi n’umuzungu w’umufaransa wakoreraga i Burundi. Uwo mwana avuga uko yabonaga ubuzima muri icyo gihe, ibibazo by’amoko, Hutu na Tutsi. Uwo mwana ufite hagati y’imyaka 10 na 15 aba yibuka uburyo ubuto bwe bwaje kwicwa n’ibibazo bya politike zo muri aka karere. Anavuga ku kibazo cyo kuvuka ku babyeyi badahuje uruhu. Gukira Bishobokera Buri Wese, Ariko Biraharanirwa, Dieudonne D’amour Nordkvist Hakizimana Cyanditswe na Dieudonne D’amour Nordkvist Hakizimana mu mwaka wa 2019. Gikubiyemo amabanga menshi yatuma ukira mu kanya gato abari bakuzi udafite n’urwara rwo kwishima bagatangira gutangazwa n’impinduka zaje mu buzima bwawe. Rwanda means The Universe, Louise Mushikiwabo Mu mwaka wa 2006 ubwo yabaga muri Leta Zuze Ubumwe za Amerika, Louise Mushikiwabo yasohoye igitabo ‘Rwanda means The Universe’ (U Rwanda bisobanuye Isanzure) cy’amapaji 384 yafatanyije n’umunyamakuru Jack Kramer. Igitabo cya Mushikiwabo cyanditse mu buryo bw’ibarankuru n’itangabuhamya. Inkuru ya Mushikiwabo ayitangira mbere gato y’ihanurwa ry’indege yari itwaye Perezida Juvenal Habyarimana mu 1994, avuga uko yari abayeho muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika aho yabaga ndetse n’ibyo inshuti ze zakundaga kumubaza ku mubano, amateka n’imibereho y’abanyarwanda. Mushikiwabo na Kramer bagaragaza ubugome Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yakoranywe n’uburyo bigaragara ko yari yarabanje gutegurwa. Iki gitabo kijya mu mizi y’imibereho y’abanyarwanda mbere y’abakoloni, ubwo abanyarwanda babagaho nta yindi si bazi ari naho izina ry’igitabo ryaturutse. Untamed, Beyond Freedom, Uwineza Celine Igitabo ‘Untamed, Beyond Freedom’ cyanditswe na Uwineza Celine, gisohoka muri Mata 2019. Yanditse ku buzima yabayemo we n’umuryango we muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, ubwo yicirwaga benshi mu muryango akiri umwana muto. Iki gitabo cy’amapaji 149 cyanditse mu buryo bwo kubara inkuru. Uwineza atangirana ibaruwa yandikiye mama we wishwe tariki 10 Mata 1994 hamwe na bakuru be babiri na musaza we, abamenyesha agahinda afite nyuma yo kubabura n’uburyo akumbuye kuzongera kubabona. Intwari Mpinduramatwara Paul Kagame, Richard Hategekimana Iki gitabo “Intwari Mpinduramatwara Paul Kagame”, kigaragaza ibikorwa bya Perezida Kagame by’indashyikirwa nuko yagaruriye u Rwanda ikuzo nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Icyo gitabo cy’amapaji 98 kigaragaza uburyo igice kimwe cy’Abanyarwanda bari barahejejwe hanze ariko akabacyura, ndetse akanahagarika Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, yanaguyemo abasaga miliyoni mu gihe cy’amezi atatu. Mitingi Jenosideri, Imbundo, Imbarutso y’imbunda yarimbuye imbaga , Edouard Bamporiki Iki gitabo cyasohotse mu 2017, ni icya Edouard Bamporiki. Gikubiyemo ubuhamya bw’abantu 67 bakoze Jenoside ndetse na bamwe mu bana bavutse ku babyeyi barokotse nyuma yo gufatwa ku ngufu n’abajenosideri. L’oncle Gynécologue, Numuhire Caroline Iki gitabo cya Numuhire Caroline, gikubiyemo inkuru y’umwana w’umukobwa wahohotewe na nyirarume wamusuzumaga igihe yari atwite. Inkuru iri muri iki gitabo ishingiye ku mwana w’umukobwa watewe inda nk’urwibutso asigiwe n’inshuti ye magara yari irwaye kanseri, nyuma yo gutereranwa n’umuryango we, ahitamo kubiganiriza nyirarume wari inzobere mu kuvura indwara z’abagore ariko ntiyamubera imfura, amufata ku ngufu. Moi, Le dernier Tutsi, Charles Habonimana ‘Moi le dernier Tutsi’, ni igitabo cyanditswe na Charles Habonimana gisohoka mu 2019. Gikubiyemo ubuhamya bw’imibereho y’Umututsi mbere ya Jenoside, inzira y’umusaraba we ubwe yanyuzemo mu gihe cya Jenoside n’uburyo Ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi zamurokoye. Ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda mu mateka yabo, Innocent Nizeyimana Iki ni gitabo cyasohotse mu mwaka wa 2015. Umwanditsi agaragaza imibanire y’Abanyarwanda mbere y’uko abazungu baza mu Rwanda, uko iyo mibanire myiza yaje kugenda ihinduka mibi buhoro buhoro bitewe n’imiyoborere mibi y’ubukoroni ndetse n’uburyo Abatutsi batangiye kwirukanwa mu Rwanda. Iki gitabo gisoza kivuga uko abakoroni basizeho Repubulika ya mbere yagombaga gukomeza gukora ku nyungu zabo Inzira y’Inzitane yo kwibohora, NDAHIRO Logan Iki gitabo cyanditswe na nyakwigendera Ndahiro Logan mu mwaka wa 2017. Gikubiyemo inzira igoye ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi zanyuzemo mu rugendo rwo kubohora Abanyarwanda. Un abrege de l’ethno histoire du Rwanda, Alexis Kagame Ni igitabo cyanditswe n’inzobere mu mateka y’u Rwanda, Padiri Alexis Kagame. Kivuga ku mateka y’u Rwanda guhera mu 1853 kugeza mu 1972, kikaba cyarasohotse mu 1972. Rwanda demain! Une Longue Marche vers la transformation, Dr Kimonyo Jean Paul Iki gitabo cyasohotse mu 2018, kivuga ku mbogamizi n’ibitekerezo byiza byaranze inzira yo kongera kwiyubaka k’u Rwanda nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Goliyati Araguye, Mgr Birindabagabo Alexis Iki gitabo cyasohotse mu 2019, cyanditswe na Musenyeri Birindabagabo Alexis. Gikubiyemo inzira n’uburyo bwakwifashishwa mu guca ibiyobyabwenge mu Rwanda. Harimo inshingano za buri wese mu kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge, icyo buri wese asabwa, inyungu zo kubirandura mu Rwanda n’ubuhamya bw’abasore bakoreshejwe n’ibiyobyabwenge bakica mugenzi wabo. Rwanda 1959-1962, La Révolution manquée, Antoine Mugesera Iki gitabo cyasohotse mu 2018, gisobanura uburyo impinduramatwara yo mu 1959 yiswe ‘revolisiyo’ atari yo kuko icyo impinduramatwara ziba zigamije kitagezweho. Undi Munsi, Maniraguha Ferdinand Iki gitabo cyiswe ‘Undi Munsi’ cyasohotse mu wa 2019, gikubiyemo inkuru mpimbano y’urukundo rw’umukobwa Naila n’umusore Gisa bakundanye, urukundo rwabo rukaza kwicwa n’ishyari ry’abatarabifurizaga ineza. New Rwanda From Hell to Heaven, Bamurangirwa Patricia Iki gitabo cyamuritswe muri Mutarama 2020. Havugwamo uburyo u Rwanda rwabashije kwivana mu mahano ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, ubu akaba ari igihugu cy’icyitegererezo muri Afurika.

title: Rutangarwamaboko yasobanuye uko ubupfumu yaburazwe na sekuruza n’impamvu yo guterekera (video)
content: Rutangarwamaboko usanzwe ari umushakashatsi, umwigisha w’ubuzima bushingiye ku muco akaba n’inzobere mu by’umuco, amateka, imbonezabitekerezo (Filosofiya) n’ubuzima bwa muntu bushingiye ku myizerere, imyumvire, imitekerereze, imyitwarire ndetse n’imigirire. Ni umugabo w’abana babiri yabyaranye na Umuziranenge Sana Cynthia, barimo imfura yabo bise Umugiramana n’ubuheta bise Benimana. Izina Rutangarwamaboko arikomora kuri sekuruza wari umukuru w’imandwa. IGIHE yamusuye imuganiriza byinshi ku buzima bwe abantu benshi batazi. Uko yabaye umupfumu… Ubusanzwe yitwa Nzayisenga Modeste ni umuganga ubugira gatatu, kuko yabyize muri kaminuza mu bijyanye n’ubuzima bwo mu mutwe, akaba umuganga nk’umupfumu ndetse akanaba we nk’umunyempano wabirazwe. Ati “Sogokuruza Rutangarwamaboko yari umugangahuzi, umuganga akaba n’umupfumu akaba n’umukuru w’imandwa mu nduga hose, ari iki gihe twamugereranya na ba musenyeri. Niho nabikuye nk’umurage. Hari uburyo umubyeyi agenda abiraga abazakurikiraho, ni naho izina Rutangarwamaboko bituruka.” Yumvikanisha ko akiri umwana aribwo yatangiye kwiyumvamo impano yo kuvura ndetse akajya abiganiriza se, utaramuciye intege ahubwo akamwumvisha ko ari ibintu agomba gukorera. Ati “Ndi umuganga kandi nk’impano kuko mvuka kumwe umwana akura afite imyaka itanu cyangwa irindwi, barambazaga bati uzakora iki? Data yarabimbazaga nkamubwira ko nzaba umuganga, akambwira ko ngomba kubyitaho, nanjye nkamubwira nti sinzaba umuswa. Akavuga ati nk’ubu mu Rwanda dufite umuganga umwe ubaga umutwe ntigeze menya, nkamubwira nti nzaba uwa kabiri kandi nzamurusha.” Yashoje kaminuza atangiza uburyo bushingiye ku muco nyarwanda mu kuvura indwara n’ibibazo byo mu mutwe avura abarwayi bari barananiranye, by’umwihariko baraciye kuri za kirazira barasara ibintu ahanini ubuvuzi mvamahanga bwigwa mu ishuri buyoberwa. Rutangarwamaboko yakuriye kwa Sekuruza, ndetse aza kugenda akurira mu maboko ye kuko akenshi yamutumaga imiti bigatuma agenda akerebuka mu Kinyarwanda no mu kuvura. Yamusigiye imiringa yambara ku maboko yise ‘Imiringa y’imirinda’ imurinda ibintu byakototera umuntu by’amandu n’amarozi ndetse ikaba n’umurimbo. Impamvu akunda gukora imihango yo kubandwa no guterekera kandi abenshi batakibikozwa muri iki gihe Rutangarwamaboko akunda gukora imihango itandukanye itagikorwa cyane mu Rwanda rw’ubu irimo kubandwa, guterekera n’indi itandukanye yakorwaga mu gihe cyo hambere. Avuga ko impamvu abantu benshi batakiyikora ari uko bafite ukutamenya kuko ariwo muco w’abanyarwanda kandi bikaba byakabaye akarango kuri buri wese ukomoka mu Rwanda. Ati “Hari igitabo kimwe ndi kwandika cyitwa nyina w’umugome ni ubugoryi. Ubugome abantu tugirira abandi natwe twigirira bituruka ku kutamenya, n’ubu rero hariho ibintu byacu byabaye nk’ibishitani cyangwa bikaba interamatsiko ku bandi ku buryo abantu babikubonamo bagatangara kandi ubundi bwari bwo buzima. Ni ukutamenya, ni uguhona, ni ubugoryi. Ntekereza ko abantu nibahonoka bazagenda bamenya ko umuco arirwo rutirigongo twigoragorezaho gutsinda ubugorogoro bwose, niwo uduha akito mu bandi tukagira icyo twitirirwa, bakavuga bati uriya ni umunyarwanda kubera ibi n’ibi. Arangwa n’imihango n’imigenzo.” “Nko kubandwa no guterekera ni imihango, nkimara gusobanukirwa ibyo aribyo, kirazira aribyo, maze gukura nabonye abo byasajije kubera ko baciye kuri iyo kirazira. Utagira imihango ntagira ibyo ahanga ntagira n’ibyo ahangamura byamuhangaye kimwe n’utagira imigenzo ntagira uko agenza.” Kuri we yemeza ko abantu b’iki gihe kubera ko badashamadukira kubandwa no guterekera ari ikibazo gikomeye kuko bifite umumaro mu kwegeranya umuntu n’abakurambere be. Ati “Ninde wamenya icyo kubandwa aricyo ntabandwe cyangwa ntabyifuze kuko biva ku nshinga ‘kubanda’ bivuga komatanywa. Abanyarwanda rero babandwa kabiri, bwa mbere bomatanywa n’Imana y’i Rwanda bwa kabiri bomatanywa n’abakurambere. Abazimu nibo batuma tutazima, ariko uramuvuga abantu bakikanga. Hatari iyo mihango n’imigenzo wazamenya aho uvuka se ? wazamenya agasozi kanyu ? Guterekera biva ku nshinga gutereka, umuteguro ugiriye abakuru, abanyacyubahiro, abegeramana, ababyeyi mu mutima wawe kugira ngo ubwo urya urye nkabo, ubwo unywa unywe nkabo.” Rutangarwamaboko asanzwe atuye ku Gisozi ho mu Karere ka Gasabo mu Mujyi wa Kigali ndetse anafite ivuriro ry’ubuvuzi bushingiye ku muco riherereye i Nyarutarama.

title: Uko u Rwanda rwahuye n’ibyorezo by’inzara, ibisebe n’indwara z’amatungo ku ngoma ya Mutara Semugeshi
content:
Ibyorezo bikomeye u Rwanda rwahuye nabyo, byabimburiwe n’icyatangiye ku ngoma ya Mutara Semugeshi mu ntango y’urwimo rwe ahasaga mu wa 1543. Muri ibyo bihe Ruganzu Ndoli yatanze atunguranye ubwo yicwaga n’umuhinza Bitibibisi. Kubera amakimbirane yari ibwami umugabekazi Nyirarumaga yaranze kurekura ubugabekazi, Semugeshi yabuze umwiru wamwimika akamuha Inyonga ( Ibimenyetso by’ubwami) ngo abe umugenga w’ingoma y’u Rwanda. Mpande ya Rusanga wari umwiru mukuru w’ingoma ya Ndoli, niwe wafashe iya mbere mu kugumura abandi Biru mu kwanga kugaragaza aho bahagaze mu kwimika Semugeshi na Nyina Nyirakabogo. Semugeshi agisha nyina inama, nyina aramusubiza ati “So Ruganzu Ndoli, yari yaranywanye na Mutaga Nyamubi umwami w’u Burundi, none genda aguhe Abiru baze bakore imihango yo kukwimika. Ubundi utware ingoma ya so, kuko nta wundi wo kuyizungura uhari”.  Semugeshi ashyira nzira yitabaza Mutaga Nyamubi umwami w’u Burundi amuha abiru bimitsi barimo Nyamwonda wa Rurenge na Gahenda ka Nyabayobya. Imihango yo kwimika Semugeshi yabereye i Mwaka wa Rukoma muri Mushubati ( ubu ni mu Karare ka Muhanga mu Murenge wa Nyarusange), imihango irakorwa, bamuha izina ry’ubwami rya Bicuba I Semugeshi. Nyuma y’iyimikwa rya Bicuba Semugeshi, yahuye n’akaga gakomeye cyane arwara ijisho rirabyimba, ryitambikwamo n’ikintu kimeza nk’umwashi n’inkingi. Mu gisenge cy’inzu ye hitambikamo ikintu kimeze nk’ukwezi. Abaturage b’u Rwanda nabo, ntibabonye amahwemo, bahuye n’amahano y’umuze utarigeze ubaho bokamwa n’inzara n’indwara z’ibinyoro n’ibisebe by’umufunzo. Abantu ba hafi ya Semugeshi baje kumubwira bati “Bariya Biru Mutaga yakoherereje ntibazi imihango y’iyimikabami ry’I Rwanda, mubwire akoherereze abandi, bakureho iyi miziro yatumye uberama igakururira rubanda rw’umwami umuze n’amapfa”. Nuko Semugeshi atuma kuri Mutaga Nyamubi umwami w’u Burundi amwoherereza umuvuzi gakondo we ngo atange umuhamuro w’ibyo biza, na we amwoherereza Kiniga cya Rumanura ngo aze ahoshe ayo mahano. Kiniga cya Rumanura asesekara ibwami kwa Semugeshi, asanga ibintu byacitse, ibinyoro n’ibisebe by’umufunzo n’ibindi bigeze banyarwanda habi! Abantu ba hafi ba Semugeshi bari aho, bati “Nimushake Mpande ya Rusanga, aduhe umuzi n’umuhamuro w’izi manza zagwiririye u Rwanda”. Umwami Semugeshi atuma abantu be ngo babaririze aho Mpande ya Rusanga yaba aherereye, basanga yaragiye kure cyane ahitwa: I Cyotamakara cy’I Buhanga ( ubu ni mu Murenge wa Ntyazo wo mu karere ka Nyanza), ari umusaza wa cyane, yarakennye bitavugwa inzara imugeze kure. Ubwo Mpande ya Rusanga asubiza abantu bari boherejwe na Semugeshi ati “Ndashaje, ndashonje, nambaye ubusa, nahinguka nte imbere y’umwami?’, bajya kubibwira umwami Semugeshi, afata inka ebyiri z’imbyeyi, imyambaro ikoze mu mpu n’ingobyi yo ku muheka, bamujyana ibwami. Kera kabaye Mpande ya Rusanga arashyira agera ibwami, akigera ibwami akabona ibirimo kuhabera. Nuko aramubaza ati “Wimitswe na ba nde?” Semugeshi ati “Ni Abiru b’i Burundi barimo Nyamwonda wa Burenge na Nyagahenda ka Nyabayobya.” Mpande ya Rusanga ati “Wimikiwe he?” Semugeshi ati “Nimikiwe i Mwaka wa Rukoma”. Mpande ya Rusanga abwira Semugeshi ati “Bariya Biru b’i Burundi bakwimitse, nta kiza bashakira u Rwanda. Kukwimikira i Mwaka ugasohokera ku Ntosho, ni ikimenyetso cy’uko Abanyarwanda babaroze kwicwa n’inzara ikomotse ku mapfa bakazajya birirwa bahonda inguri z’ibikoro n’amateke bashaka amaramuko. Gushokera inka z’amashashi, ni ikimenyetso cyo kutagira uburumbuke bw’abantu, imyaka n’amatungo mu gihugu. Gusohokana igicuba cyaramvuwe mu Mutake, ni ukwifuriza Abanyarwanda guhora bataka nta kugoheka n’amahoro muri bo. Gusohokera mu Mutobo, ni ukurwara ibinyoro n’ibisebe by’imifunzo bizabahitana igihugu kikaba umwirare.” Mpande ya Rusanga abwira Nyirarumaga ati “Impamvu igihugu cyahuye n’akaga k’iriya mize n’amapfa akaze, ni ariya marira ya Nyirakabogo urara arira ko wanze kurekura ingoma, kandi Ruganzu yaraguhaye umuhungu we Semugeshi ngo umubere umujyanama, none kugira ngo igihugu gikire nuko amarira ya Nyirakabogo yakama, kuko nta mugisha wo guhora umugabekazi aririra mu gihugu, fata inzira uhunge uve mu gihugu ujye i Burundi ubise Nyirakabogo n’umuhungu we Semugeshi bime ingoma.” Nyirarumaga ashorera inka ze ashyira nzira n’abaja be bacikira i Burundi. Nyirarumaga akigera ku cyambu, haje inkuba itagira imvura irivovota, nyuma haza imirabyo iramukubakuba iramuyora imujyana mu kirere aburirwa irengero. Nuko Mpande ya Rusanga wari wabaherekeje ngo abambutse, abonye ibyo bibaye, abwira abakobwa ba Nyirarumaga ati “Nimuhumure buriya Nyirarumaga asanze Ruganzu Ndoli, mujye muri ubu bwato n’inka zanyu mwambuke mwigire i Burundi mu Rwanda nta mwanya mukihafite”. 
Mpande ya Rusanga ageze ibwami ahamagara Abiru bose n’abakuru bari barigumuye, bakora inama yo kohera ayo mahano yagwiririye igihugu, akaba amaze kugitsembamo abenegihugu. Nuko batangira inzira yo gukora imihango n’imigenzo y’ubwiru bw’iyakorwaga mu kohera amahano yabaga yagwiririye igihugu. Mbere yuko batangira imihango yo kweza igihugu no gukiza ubwandure bw’abaturage babanje kubakira Semugeshi urugo I Bunyogombe ngo abe ariho atura bamugangahure, bamutera ibyuhagiro n’imitsindo y’ingoma y’u Rwanda, kuko mbere yaho yari atuye mu rugo rwa se Ruganzu Ndoli rwari I Ruhashya. Kandi umwami yagombaga gukorerwa imihango yose ari mu ngoro ye nshya.  Kugira ngo umuhango wo kohera ayo mahano ukorwe, bitabaje amazi y’Ubuhoro yo mu mariba ya Rwezangoro ( mu Murenge wa Muhima), ayo mu iriba rya Shaki, ayo mu iriba rya Kabuye ka Jabana, ayo mu iriba rya Mbizi, amariba yavomwagaho amazi y’ubuhoro, akiza ubwandure agahumanura abahumanye. Yose bayahuriza hamwe mu iriba rya Kabyaza ryari munsi y’umusozi wa Nyamweru nuko bayakoreraho imihango yo kwiyeza no kweza igihugu, ngo abaturage bakire ubwandure, bagire ubuhoro n’amahoro, bagire uburame n’ubuziramuze. Nyuma y’iyo mihango Mpande ya Rusanga yahise ahakorera imihango y’ubwimitsi yimika Semugeshi, amwambura izina yari yahawe n’Abiru b’I Burundi rya Bicuba, amuha izina ry’ubwami rya Mutara Nsoro. Niko gukurizaho kwitwa Mutara Nsoro Semugeshi. Mu gihe bakiri muri ibyo, nibwo babonye ikirere gihindutse, igicu kirakuba babona imvura iraguye, icyorezo gicika mu Rwanda, amapfa arazima, Abanyarwanda bava ibuzimu bajya ibuzima.

title: Impamvu y’imiziro imwe n’imwe yari yihariye ku bagore bo mu Rwanda rwo hambere
content: Abenshi bagaragaza ko imyumvire y’Abanyarwanda bo ha mbere yakandamizaga umugore hashingiwe ku miziro bamushyiragaho. Muri iyi nkuru, twabakusanyirije amateka y’imwe mu miziro yashyirwaga ku mugore n’impamvu yayo, ikamutoza kudakora iki cyangwa se kiriya, kugira ngo urujijo rw’iyo miziro rushire. Nk’uko tubikesha igitabo “Umuco mu Buvanganzo’’ cyanditswe n’Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, inzobere ku muco, amateka n’ubuvanganzo, mu muco n’amateka y’u Rwanda hagabamo imibereho ishigiye ku miziro, imigenzo n’imihango, yose igendanye no kunoza imibereho yabo ya buri munsi. Imiziro ni ibintu byaziraga mu muco nyarwanda cyangwa byagombaga kubahwa, gufatwa neza no gutinywa, kurinda ibyiza byagezweho ngo hatagira ikibyangiza cyangwa se ubyangiza. Kenshi na kenshi yanatozaga kwirinda ingeso mbi, kugira ibyo wubaha n’ibyo utinya, kwirinda kwandavura, kwiyandarika n’ibindi. Imiziro ni imyemerere-hame idutoza kudakora iki cyangwa se kiriya. Za kirazira zose zigendana n’intera iyi n’iyi igihugu kigezeho, niyo mpamvu usanga za kirazira izi n’izi zaracyuye igihe, ugasanga izindi ziganje, hakavuka n’izindi nshya. Zimwe muri za kirazira zagengaga ubuzima bw’umugore benshi bakunze kwikoma kubera kutazisobakukirwa, ni izi zikurikira: Nta mugore wurira inzu: Mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere cyaraziraga ko umugore yuyira inzu. Byaterwaga nuko nta makabutura cyangwa se amakariso yabagaho, byatumye bashyiraho uyu muziririzo ngo hatazagira umugore wurira inzu maze abari hasi ye bakamurunguruka bakabona ubwambure bwe bakamwubahuka. Bityo agata agaciro mu muryango kandi ari nyina w’umuntu. Nta mugore ujya aho abagabo bicaye: Mu Rwanda rwo hambere cyaraziraga ko umugore ataramira aho abagabo bicaye. Byaterwaga nuko kera nta bibindo (Cotex) byabagaho. Iyo abagore bajyaga mu mihango, biberaga iyo mu mbere no mu bikari kugeza igihe imihango ishiriye, umugore akabona kujya ahabona. Niyo mpamvu hashyizweho uyu muzizirizo ku bagore, kugira ngo atazajya ajya aho abantu bateraniye ari mu mihango bityo bakamwubahuka bakanamusuzugura. Ariko nubwo aticaraga hagati muri bo, yicaraga hafi yabo nk’uri kumwe nabo, ariko ku buryo ntawe umukenguza ngo amenye uko amerewe muri ibyo bihe. N’iyo yabaga atari mu mihango, cyaraziraga kwicara mu bagabo kubera ko bashoboraga kumureba ikimero, bagatangira kumuzeyuka, bamukorakora uko biboneye. Yicaraga kure aho adashobora kwegerana n’abagabo. Biba intandaro yo kumurinda ahantu hose hateraniye abagabo. Nta mugore ukama inka: Uyu muziro ujya gusa n’uwo kurira inzu, kuko byose bisangiye impamvu. Nta myambarire yikwije abagore bagiraga mu bihe byo hambere yabafashaga guhisha ubwambure bwabo, ku buryo ubegereye cyangwa se ubari imbere atabasha kubarunguruka. Niyo mpamvu bashyizeho umuziro wo kudakama inka kw’abagore, kugira ngo batazatera iry’abakamyi imbere y’abashumba n’abarenzamase, bakabona icyo bambariyeho. Iyi miziro imwe n’imwe twagaragaje, yari iyo guhesha umugore agaciro no kumurinda igisuzuguriro, nta mpamvu yo kuyigaya tuyigira icyasha ko yakandamizaga abagore, nyamara bwari uburyo bwo kubarinda no kubungabunga ubusugire n’icyubahiro cyabo mu muryango nyarwanda.

title: Ibitazibagirana mu gitero cyiswe icy’Imigogo u Rwanda rwatsinzemo abanyankore
content: Igitabo “Intwari z’imbanza, zubatse u Rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro’’ cyanditswe n’Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, kigaragaza ko muri Gashyantare 1894 ubwo Rwabugili yafataga umwanzuro wo kugaba igitero muri Nkore Abahinda b’Abanyankore, bari batangiye guhangara u Rwanda bitwaje agashya k’imbunda bahawe n’Abongereza. Ibyateye umujinya Rwabugili, ni igitero Ntare V Rugingiza rwa Migereka Umwami wa Ankole yari yagabye mbere ahengereye Rwabugili ari i Bunyabungo aza kunyaga inyambo z’u Rwanda atwika ingoro y’i Rutaraka hafi ya Nyagatare. Mu kwihimura, abanyarwanda bagabye igitero muri Nkore batamitse umuheto, imyambi ivuza ubuhuha, inkota zihogera. Abanyankore batangiye gupfa mu buryo bubatunguye, babaga bahagararanye ari babiri cyangwa se barenze, barimo gukokinga ( gushyira amasasu mu mbunda), umwe akabona mugenzi we aravuza induru n’umwambi mu gituza wamwinjiye. Mu gihe nawe akibaza ibibaye, akumva nawe bamufashe mpiri bambambuye imbunda bamucumita n’inkota mu gituza, abandi barimo kubaca imitwe, noneho imiriro n’urusaku rw’amasasu, rurahagarara humvikana induru z’abarimo gupfa n’abarimo guhunga batabaza. Rwabugili n’Ingabo ze babonye ko umugambi wabo urimo kugera ku ntego, yahise asaba ingabo zose guhindura uburyo bwo kurwana, bose bagafata umurongo umwe wo kwirukankana Abanyankore barimo guhunga, ubundi bakaboherezamo urufaya rw’imyambi n’amacumu atagira ingano n’inkota zihogera bica uwo bafashe mpiri.  Gusubira mu buryo bwa gakondo, nuko aribwo bari bamenyereye, kandi bwihuta butanahusha umuntu uhunga, kandi bari bamaze kubona ko ntawe urasa ahunga. Abanyankore barashishaga imbunda bahiye ubwoba barimo guhunga. Ikindi kandi n’ubwo Abanyarwanda bari bamaze kwambura imbunda Abanyankore, ntabwo bari bafite ubumenyi n’ubuhanga bwo kuzirashisha. Bituma bazihorera bikoreshereza ubumenyi bwabo gakondo bw’imirwano. Amateka agaragaza ko muri icyo gitero Rwabugili yagabye mu Nkore yagitsinze mu buryo budasubirwaho, anyaga Abanyankore imbunda zigera ku Bihumbi Bibiri, ari nazo Musinga n’Ingabo ze bifashishije barwana n’Abadage nazo zikabananira, bakarashisha imiheto bakanatsindwa burundu, Abadage bagatangira gukoroniza u Rwanda. Rwabugili n’ingabo ze barakomeje baratanya bagana mu Majyaruguru y’i Burengerazuba bw’ingoma ya Nkore, bagera ku mugezi wa “Rwizi” ubabera inzambi mu kuwambuka ngo bakurikirane inkirirahato z’Abanyankore zarokotse inzara z’umuheto w’inkotanyi cyane. Bitewe nuko ikiraro cyambuka uwo Mugezi Abanyankore bari bagiciye kugira ngo Ingabo z’u Rwanda zitabakurikira, Rwabugili nabo bari kumwe, bahise biga ubucakura bukomeye, bwo gushaka icyo batindisha uwo mugezi ngo bagomere amazi yawo babone uko bawambuka ngo bakurikirane inkirirahato z’Abanyankore. Rwabugili wari ufite ishyaka ryinshi no kunyaruka mu mitekerereze, yahise yigira inama yo kurunda imirambo yose y’Abanyankore muri uwo mugezi ngo babakoreho ikiraro babone uko bambuka kuko ibyo gutema ibiti byari kubatinza bagasanga Abanyankore babacitse. Nuko barunda imirambo y’Abanyankore itagira ingano muri uwo mugezi wa Rwizi nk’abarunda amasiteri y’ibiti, bakora ikiraro gikomeye cyane, maze barambuka, bajya guhigisha uruhindu Umunyankore aho yari yahungiye hose. Icyo gitero kiswe icy’Imigogo, cyabaye icyorezo mu Banyankore, cyaguyemo abatagira ingano, abamenyekanye ni umuhungu wa Ntare witwaga Rumukwe wari umutasi wa Nkore, akarashisha n’imbunda ifite amadarubindi kandi ikarasa kure. Ingabo z’u Rwanda zikimara kumwica, Rwabugili yahise afata iyo mbunda ye, atangira kuyirashisha kugeza amasasu ashizemo. Ni imwe mu zabaye iminyago bakuye mu ngoma ya Nkore bayizana ibwami, usibye ko yahiriye mu nzu mu bihe by’intambara yo ku Rucunshu. Abongereza barahurujwe n’Abanyankore ngo baze kubatabara, umwongereza wari ugaragiwe n’ingabo zikomeye n’intwaro nyinshi z’ikirenga, ageze i Nyagakoni Abanyankore bakunze kwita Nkoni abona imirambo y’Abanyankore inyanyagiye hirya no hino mu gihugu, ashya ubwoba, ku mutima ati “Aba bantu bishe ingabo bene aka kageni, ni nde wabikorereza?”, bahitamo kwisubirira inyuma urugamba ararureka. Igitero cya Rwabugili yagabye muri Nkore, cyabaye inkomoko y’insigamugani n’amarenga yabaye kimomo mu Rwanda no mu mahanga, aho bagira bati “ Kanaka yagaritse ingogo” Byo kuvuga ko yishe abantu batagira ingano. Uburyo bushya bw’imirwano uko ari butati nibwo bwatumye Abanyarwanda barushaho gutangarirwa n’Amahanga, bunatanga umusaruro ugaragara maze bagiriza Abanyankore babagusha ruhabo. Ubwo buryo burimo ubwo gukusha, kurashisha amano aribwo bakunze kwita “Kurasa umugaramirizo” no gukambakamba ushaka gufata mpiri umwanzi ngo umwambure intwaro. Bamwe mu ngabo z’ibihangange zazengereje amahanga ku ngoma ya Rwabugili harimo Kamananga ka Sebajura umwuzukuru wa Rwakagara, warasaga umwambi ugahitana batanu, Nyamuhenda wa Kejeje, umwega w’Umuhenda, Umutekereza karundura w’ubucakura mu mirwano yo muri Nkore, Bisangwa bya Rugombituri, Umugaba w’imitwe y’Ingabo yose ku ngoma ya Rwabugili, akaba n’umuyobozi wigirira Icyizere nk’icya Sebuja Rwabugili, akaba umutware w’ingabo z’Ingangurarugo. Hari kandi Rwanyonga rwa Mugabwambere wari umugaba w’Ingangurarugo Indwanyi idahusha wivuganye Kabego umwami wo ku Ijwi. Baramu ba Rwabugili barimo Kabare ka Rwakagara, wari umuhanga cyane mu kurwanira mu mazi mu bwato bwe bwitwaga “Imbabazi” Cyigenza cya Rwakagara watwaraga Ingoma za Rwabugili mu bwato bwitwaga ‘Ishyaka’ na Ruhinankiko wari indwanyi by’akaburarugero.

title: Ibikoresho gakondo bya Muzika, byabicaga bigacika mu Rwanda rwo hambere
content:
Abanyarwanda nabo bagiraga umuziki ubafasha kwizihirwa, bakagira ibikoresho byabo bwite bakoreshaga bacuranga ngo uwo muziki urusheho kubanogera. Mu Rwanda rwo hambere, bagiraga ibitaramo by’ingeri eshanu, bikaba isoko y’akayunguruzo k’umutima-mutindi, umwe wa kinyamaswa, hakimakazwa umutimamana n’umutimanama mu Banyarwanda.  Ibitaramo byakorwaga mu Rwanda rwo hambere, byarimo ibitaramo by’umuryango, Ibitaramo by’uburere mboneraagihugu, Ibitaramo nyizihizangoma, ibitaramo by’imihigo n’ibitaramo by’umuganura. Buri gitaramo cyabaga gifite abagomba kukitabira n’ibikoresho by’umuziki bigomba kwizihiza ibyo birori. Hakaba ibikoresho byakoraga mu bitaramo by’ibwami n’ibyakoreshwaga mu bitaramo byo muri rubanda. Ibikoresho by’umuziki byo mu Rwanda rwo hambere, byari bigabanyijemo ingeri eshatu bitewe n’uko bikoreshwa kugira ngo bitange umuriri nyizihizagitaramo. Ibikoresho by’Inyamirya: Ni ibikoresho bifite uburyo bakomaho imbarutso, bukarema imirya inyuranye kandi yirangira, ari nayo isimburana mu kwizihiza indirimbo. Ibikoresho by’ubuhuha: Ni ibikoresho bakoreshaga mu muziki gakondo, ariko bigatanga umwirangiro ari uko bahushyemo,
Ibikoresho by’inkomangano: Ni ibikoresho byakoreshwagwa mu muziki nyarwanda, bigatanga umwirangiro, ari uko babikomyeho n’ikiganza, igititi cyangwa se ikirenge. Izo ngeri z’ibikoresho by’umuziki nyarwanda, byabiciye bigacika zari zigizwe n’ibicurangisho bitandukanye. Muri byo hari nka: Urusengo: Urusengo, ni kimwe mu bikoresho by’umuziki gakondo by’inyabuhuha. Kubera umuriri ntagereranywa bifite, byatumye ruba kimwe mu bikoresho mpuzamuriri by’ibwami. Gihanga aruha isumbwe rikomeye, ruba rumwe mu birango by’u Rwanda nk’ikirango cy’amahoro n’ubusabane. Urusengo rwo rugira imirya y’ishakwe , inyahura n’igihumurizo. Urusengo rwarangaga ingoma y’u Rwanda, mu bihe bya Gihanga, nirwo bitaga ‘Nyamilinga’. Inanga: Inanga ni igikoresho cy’umuziki cya kera na kare, cyo mu bwoko bw’ibinyamirya, ni kimwe mu byahanganywe n’u Rwanda. Nk’uko yabaga mu buvanganzo nyemvugo bwo muri rubanda, ni nako n’ibwami bayikeneraga, mu bitaramo byaberaga ibwami. Inanga igira imirya irenga yitwa “imiyuki”n’inihira yitwa “imihumurizo”cyangwa se ibihumurizo. Umurya w’inanga, ni kimwe mu byizihizaga ibitaramo bya kera, bigakesha ijoro, na n’ubu kandi, inanga ni igikoresho kitajya kiva ku gihe, aho mu bitaramo ndangamuco ariyo iba ku ruhembe rw’imbere mu kuranga u Rwanda. Ingoma z’imisango: Ni iza kera cyane mu Rwanda, zari zifite umwanya ukomeye mu Rwanda rwo hambere. Ni kimwe mu bikoresho by’umuziki byo mu bwoko bw’inkomangano. Haba mu mbyino, mu mihamirizo, no mu yindi myidagaduro, ingoma yabaga iya mbere.  Ingoma z’imisango, ni zimwe mu bikoresho by’umuziki gakondo, byabiciye bigacika mu bihe byo ha mbere. N’ubwo zadutse hagati mu iyubakwa ry’igihugu, zagize ibigwi by’ikirenga kuruta ibindi bikoresho mpuzamuriri. Ingoma z’imisango, arizo izi tuzi zikoreshwa mu birori zadutse ku ngoma y’umwami Cyilima I Rugwe, ahasaga mu mwaka wa 1345. Zadukanywe n’umunyamahanga Rwamuhama w’Umutoro. Mbere y’uko izo ngoma zaduka, mu Rwanda hari ubwoko bw’ Ingoma- Ngabe gusa, yari ikirango cy’igihugu.  Ubuhanga n’ubuhangange Abanyarwanda bahaye ingoma, byatumye barema amoko yazo agera kuri 4, arushaho gutanga umwirangiro utandukanye uryoshya ibirori by’umurishyo w’ingoma. Mu moko y’ingoma harimo Ishakwe, Inyahura, Inumvu cyangwa Inumbiri n’Ibihumurizo. Amakondera: Amakondera ni ibikoresho byakoreshwaga mu bitaramo bikomeye ndangamuco, akaba yari afite umwanya ukomeye mu bitaramo by’ibwami cyane cyane mu bitaramo by‘Intore. Ni amwe mu bikoresho by’umuziki nyarwanda by’Inyabuhuha. Amakondera akomoka ku ngoma y’umwami Rwabugili akaba yarayaramvuye i Bujinja kuri ubu habarizwa mu gihugu cya Tanzaniya. Umuduri: Ni umwe mu bikoresho by’umuziki byakundaga gukoreshwa mu buvanganzo nyemvugo bwo muri rubanda, ni umwe mu bikoresho by’Inyamirya nk’ibikoresho mpuzamuriri bifite imirya bakoraho ikabona kwirangira nk’ Umuduri bita Umunahi cyangwa ibubura n’iningiri. Ihembe: Ihembe ,ni igikoresho cy’umuziki kiri mu bwoko bw’Inyabuhuha, atanga umwirangiro ari uko babanje guhuhamo.Ni igikoresho mpuzamuriri cyakoreshwaga cyane mu muhamirizo w’intore, mu buvanganzo nyemvugo bw’ibwami. Umwirongi: Ni igikoresho cy’umuziki cyamenyekanye cyane mu gukoreshwa n’abashumba mu rwuri, kikaba ikirango cy’amahoro. Iyo umushumba yahuhagamo, shebuja yahitaga yumva ko mu nama y’inka ari amahoro. Hari n’ibindi bikoresho by’umuziki byakoreshwaga mu buryo bwihariye cyangwa se bitakundaga no gukoreshwa cyane, akaba ari nayo mpamvu nta bwamamare bifite. Muri byo twavuga nk’Ikinyuguri kijya mu mihango y’imandwa, Urujegerezo, agakoko k’inkomane kajegera bunyuguri kajya mu mihango irimo indirimbo, Urutaro rwari ikidasesa gicurangwa mu bitaramo by’akarere aka n’aka n’ibindi.

title: Uko umunaniro wazahaje Perezida Kayibanda agashaka kwegura
content: Iyo ndwara yazahaje Perezida Grégoire Kayibanda mu myaka ya 1970 kugeza ubwo asabye kwegura ku mwanya wa Perezida ngo hashakwe umusimbura, abaminisitiri be bakabyanga. Kayibanda yayoboye u Rwanda guhera mu 1961 kugeza mu 1973 ubwo yahirikwaga ku butegetsi na Juvénal Habyarimana wahoze ari Minisitiri we w’Ingabo. Mu ntangiriro z’ubutegetsi bwe, ibintu byasaga n’ibigenda neza mu ishyaka rye MDR Parmehutu ndetse benshi bamubonamo icyerecyezo kizima dore ko ari we wari waranashinze iryo shyaka, nyuma yo gushyigikirwa n’Ababiligi bakaza gukuraho ubwami bwari bumaze imyaka amagana mu gihugu. Akijya ku butegetsi, Kayibanda yatowe n’abadepite muri manda y’imyaka ine yagombaga kuzarangira mu 1965. Mu mwaka wa 1962 ubwo u Rwanda rwabonaga ubwigenge, hatowe Itegeko Nshinga, rishyiraho umubare wa manda ebyiri kuri Perezida, manda imwe ikamara imyaka ine. Manda yatorewe mu 1961, yarangiye mu 1965 yiyamamariza indi yagombaga kurangira mu 1969 ndetse aranayitorerwa. Mu buryo bugaragara kugeza mu 1969, Kayibanda yari amaze kuyobora manda ebyiri ariko we siko yabibaraga ahubwo yumvaga ko amaze kuyobora manda imwe kuko iya mbere yatowe Itegeko Nshinga ritarajyaho kandi agatorwa n’abadepite aho kuba abaturage. Imvururu mu ishyaka, intandaro yo gushaka kwegura Mu 1968, mu ishyaka MDR Parmehutu ari naryo ryari ryemewe mu gihugu, ryavutsemo imvururu, bamwe mu batangiranye ishyaka na Kayibanda batangira kumwivumburaho banenga imiyoborere ye. Mu nyandiko yo mu 2010 ya Bagaragaza Thadée wabaye umudepite akaba na Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga muri Repubulika ya mbere, yagaragaje ko nyuma ya 1965; ruswa, ikimenyane n’indi myitwarire mibi yatangiye kwigaragaza mu bayobozi batandukanye ndetse no mu bucamanza, kugeza aho byavuzwe cyane bikagera no ku baturage bo hasi. Ibintu byarushijeho kuba bibi mu 1968 ubwo bamwe mu bikomerezwa byo muri Leta ya Kayibanda byabonaga ko afite imigambi yo kwiyamamariza manda ya gatatu kandi Itegeko Nshinga ryaravugaga manda ebyiri gusa. Muri uwo mwaka, bamwe mu badepite ba MDR Parmehutu bakoze raporo yagaragazaga imikorere mibi ya bamwe mu bayobozi bakuru b’igihugu bashaka ko bamwe begura, ku munsi wa nyuma wo kuyemeza ishyaka ritera ubwoba abadepite bayo birangira raporo batinye kuyemeza. Igitabo kivuga ku buzima bwa Kayibanda, Toute ma Vie pour vous mes frères cyanditswe na Baudoin Paternostre, kivuga ko Itegeko Nshinga ryabuzaga Kayibanda kongera kwiyamamaza ryavuguruwe muri Gicurasi 1969 rikuraho umubare wa manda ntarengwa, ahubwo manda imwe igenerwa imyaka itanu aho kuba ine nkuko byari bisanzwe ndetse n’imyaka 60 umukandida ushaka kuba Perezida yagombaga kuba atarengeje ivanwamo. Kuri ba bayobozi n’abarwanashyaka ba MDR Parmehutu bari bamaze kurambirwa Kayibanda, babaye nk’abakubiswe n’inkuba kuko inzozi zo kubona undi Perezida usimbura Kayibanda zari ziyoyotse. Igitabo cya Paternostre kigira kiti “Ba bantu bakekaga ko guhererekanya ubutegetsi bishoboka cyangwa se bumvaga ko ubutegetsi bwahabwa abandi, bahise babona ko bidashoboka. Batangiye kumushinja irondakarere cyane cyane gutonesha abo baturuka mu gace kamwe ka Gitarama no mu Majyepfo y’igihugu”. Kayibanda amaze kubona ko bamwe bashinganye ishyaka batangiye kumumenyera, yatangiye kugenda abasimbuza muri Guverinoma ashyiramo abandi bato bari barangije za Kaminuza, noneho umujinya ku bamurwanyaga urushaho kwiyongera. Ibintu byarushijeho gukomera ubwo n’abasirikare bakuru cyane cyane abo mu bice by’Amajyaruguru batangiraga kwivumbura, bamushinja gutonesha abo bakomoka mu gace kamwe. Kayibanda bivugwa ko muri iyo myaka ya 1969, yatangiye gucika intege no kugaragaza kwiheba kubera kubona bamwe bahoze ari inshuti ze aribo bari kumurwanya.
