Paternostre ati “Hari ubwo kenshi yajyaga agira irungu ryo kuba iruhande rwe atari kumwe na ba bayobozi bakuru bahoranye, yagiye akura mu duce twabo nyuma bakagenda bamwitaza kubera ubuzima.” Kwigunga no kwiheba kwa Kayibanda, byarakomeye biza kuvamo indwara kuko icyo gihe yasaga n’uhanganye n’ibibazo by’igihugu ariko anahanganye n’abahoze ari inshuti ze batari bakimwishimiye kubera ko yarenze ku masezerano. Inyandiko z’ibanga z’Ikigo cy’Ubutasi cya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika (CIA) zo kuwa 10 Nzeri 1970, zigaragaza ko Kayibanda yageze aho arwara indwara y’umunaniro ukabije w’ubwonko, agasaba ko yegura abaminisitiri be bakabyanga. Iyi nyandiko igira iti “Biravugwa ko Perezida Kayibanda arwaye umunaniro akaba ari gupanga gufata ikiruhuko akajya mu Burayi. Icyifuzo cye cyo kwegura giherutse kwamaganwa n’abaminisitiri be ahubwo bamusaba kuba ashyizeho Perezida w’agateganyo.” “Muri iyi minsi ubutegetsi bwa Kayibanda bwacitse intege cyane ku buryo aza gake mu murwa mukuru avuye mu mirima ye kandi asigaye agaragara gake mu ruhame. Ku butegetsi bwa Kayibanda, u Rwanda rwabaye nk’urutagaragara ku buryo bisa nk’aho abanyarwanda bakwishimira impinduka mu buyobozi n’iyo yaba ari inzibacyuho.” Mu buyobozi bukuru bw’ingabo, abasirikare bo mu bice by’Amajyaruguru n’Iburengerazuba nibo bari biganje. Nabo bari baratangiye gutera umugongo Kayibanda. Paternostre mu gitabo cye yagarutse ku munaniro Kayibanda yari asigaye agaragaza kugeza ubwo n’abasirikare buririye ku bushobozi buke yari asigaranye. Ati “Abo basirikare bato babonye umunaniro Kayibanda yari afite n’umutima uhagaze, batangira gutekereza kureka inshingano zabo za gisirikare ahubwo bakajya mu myanya y’ubutegetsi bwa gisivile, biyumvamo uburyo bushya bwo gutuma igihugu gikomeza kujya mbere abandi bashaka kubyuririraho ku nyungu zabo bwite.” Paternostre avuga ko mu ntangiriro za 1973, buri wese yabonaga ko impinduka z’ubutegetsi mu Rwanda ari ikintu gishoboka cyane cyane cyane hashingiwe ku matora ya Perezida n’ay’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yari ateganyijwe muri Nzeri uwo mwaka ndetse no ku mvururu zari zimaze iminsi mu gihugu, abahutu bakomeje kumenesha abatutsi mu mashuri no mu kazi kandi bigaragara ko ntacyo ubutegetsi bwa Kayibanda bukora ngo buhoshe izo mvururu. Uko kunanirwa guhosha imvururu z’abahutu bibasiraga abatutsi, nizo Habyarimana yuririyeho ahirika Kayibanda ku butegetsi muri Nyakanga 1973 ariko bikavugwa ko ako kavuyo n’ubundi katerwaga n’abasirikare kugira ngo babone ibirego baheraho bahirika Perezida.

title: Abakoresha ururimi rw’Ikirera bafite impungenge ko rushobora gucika
content: Nk’uko byemezwa na bamwe mu baturage batuye mu Turere dukoresha urwo rurimi rw’Ikirera nka Musanze na Burera, ngo iyo bicaye hamwe baganira muri uru rurimi bumva bisanzuye cyane bagasabana. Nyirakagori Thacienne, umukecuru w’imyaka 72 y’amavuko utuye mu Karere ka Musanze, avuga ko ururimi bavuga rurimo Ikinyarwanda cyiza n’ubwo hari abacyumva baruvuga bakabaseka. Yagize ati “Iyo tugeze ahantu hatari iwacu nko mu yindi Ntara, uragambaga(uravuga) bagahita bamenya aho uturuka, hari n’ibyo tugamba, ukabona badufashe nk’abanyamahanga. Nk’ubu iyo umusore yazanye umugore, tubyitaga gusohoza, mu gihe usanga hari abagamba ngo yasezeranye, yarongoye n’ibindi." Akomeza ati " Nk’ubu ibyo bita gukubura, twe tubyitaga gukondora, iyo umubyeyi yabyaye abazwe, twe tuvuga ko yashyizwe ku ndiga kuko icyo abandi bitaga icyuma tukita indiga. Iyo turi hamwe dukoresha Ikirera cyacu tuba twisanzuye kandi twumva ari Ikinyarwanda cy’umwimerere" Munyazikwiye Rabani we yagize ati “Ubu iyo nganiriye n’umuntu nkumva ururimi agamba(avuga) mpita menya aho akomoka, nkamenya ngo akomoka mu Nduga, ku Gisenyi n’ahandi. Dukunze kugamba twongeraho Ga, nka ndabiryaga, amazi garabuze. Guhamagara umuntu tugamba kwakura umuntu n’ibindi, ubundi iki ni Ikinyarwanda cyumvikana" N’ubwo bavuga ko guhurira ku rurimi rwabo gakondo rw’Ikirera bituma bumva bisanzuye, ngo haracyari bimwe mu bimenyetso bibagaragariza ko rushobora kuzacika burundu, birimo kuba abana babakomokaho basigaye bagira ipfunwe ryo kurukoresha, aho biga ku mashuri bitewe n’uko hari bagenzi babo babaseka. Ibi ngo bituma iyo babasetse bagerageza kugorora imvugo y’abo bigana bagenzi babo, bigatuma noneho barwica kurushaho. Ikindi ngo ni uko kuba haragiye haza gutura abantu baturutse mu zindi Ntara, nabyo ari kimwe mu byatumye ururimi rwabo rukendera, bikaba bibateye impungenge ko ururimi rwabo rushobora gusigara mu bakuze gusa, naho mu rubyiruko rukibagirana, kandi ariho bakagombye kurubungabungira. Ibi kandi babihuza no kuba ngo ntaho wasanga rwigishwa, cyangwa ngo rube rufite aho rwanditse mu bitabo, ibintu ngo babona ko kubungabunga ururimi rwabo bitakoroha na gato, bagasaba ko rwahabwa agaciro yaba mu nyandiko, kurwigisha mu mashuri n’ibindi. Inteko Nyarwanda y’Ururimi n’Umuco (RALC) iherutse gutangaza ko indimi shami zishamikiye ku Kinyarwanda nk’Ikigoyi, Ikirera n’izindi, zikwiye kwitabwaho kuko ari umutungo w’Igihugu ushobora no kugira akamaro mu rwego rwo gukungahaza Ikinyarwanda. RALC ivuga ko izo ndimi shami ari nk’ikigega cyajya cyitabazwa mu kongera andi magambo mu Kinyarwanda aho kujya kuyatira mu ndimi z’amahanga. Inteko Nyarwanda y’Ururimi n’Umuco itangaza ko ifite ikigega cy’amagambo ibihumbi 97 akoreshwa mu myuga inyuranye aho kigenda gikurwamo amagambo ashyirwa mu nkoranyamagambo.

title: Scholastique Mukasonga yasohoye igitabo kivuga kuri Kibogo wafatwaga nk’umukiza w’abanyarwanda
content: Mbere y’uko abamisiyoneri bazana inkuru nziza ya Yezu i Rwanda bivugwa ko uwo Kibogo ari we wafatwaga nkuko Abakristu bafata Yezu . Scholastique Mukasonga ni Umwanditsi w’umunyarwanda abakunda gusoma ibitabo n’abakurikiranira hafi ibijyanye na sinema bibuka filimi Notre Dame du Nil ishingiye ku gitabo cye yasohotse muri Gashyantare 2020. Igitabo cya Mukasonga ’ Kibogo est monté au Ciel’gifite paji 160. Cyasohowe n’inzu isohora ibitabo yo mu Bufaransa, éditions Gallimard. Ni ubwoko bw’ibitabo by’inkuru ndende mpimbano cyangwa se Roman (Novel).  Ugendeye ku mateka ya Kibogo uvugwa mu mateka y’u Rwanda wumva ari igitabo kigaragaza ko imyemerere cyangwa ibisa n’ibyo abanyamadini bigisha kuri Yezu hari uwari uhari kandi abifite mbere. Agace gasa no gutera amatsiko yashyize ku rubuga Gallimard, kabaza uwaba yaragiye mu Ijuru hagati ya Kibogo w’i Rwanda na Yezu yita uw’abamisiyoneri ndetse nyuma yo kujya mu Ijuru akagirira abantu ineza. Ati "Ari Kibogo, umuhungu w’umwami na Yezu w’abamisiyoneri ni nde wazamutse mu Ijuru? wongeye kugusha imvura, agakiza abantu amapfa n’inzara?" Akomeza yibaza niba abantu bakwiye kwizera inkuru cyangwa imigani baciriwe n’abera kurusha kwizera izo babwiye n’ababyeyi babo amanywa n’ijoro. Ati "Ese birakwiye ko twakwizera imigani twaciriwe n’abagabo b’abera b’ubwanwa burebure cyangwa twakwemera iyo ababyeyi bacu baducira buri mugoroba." Igitabo cyitwa Le Rwanda ancien cyanditswe na De Lacger, kuva ku rupapuro rwa 167 kugeza ku rwa 68 kigaragaza ko mbere y’umwaduko w’ubukirisitu mu Rwanda hari imyizerere gakondo idafite aho itandukaniye n’ubukirisitu ndetse ikaba yari ifite akarusho ko kuba ishingiye ku muco gakondo w’abanyarwanda. Ayo makuru yemeza ko mu Rwanda hahoze inkuru nziza y’“umukiza (umutabazi) Kibogo", yaje guteshwa agaciro n’inkuru nziza y’“umukiza (umutabazi) Yezu“ yazanywe n’abakoloni. Mu Rwanda rwa kera umutabazi yari umuntu wemeraga gutanga amaraso ye ku bushake akameneka ku butaka bw’umwanzi bigatuma umwica cyangwa uwo amenekeye mu gihugu atsindwa. Ibi ngo byaba byaratangiwe na “Kibogo“, izina ry’Ikinyarwanda rikomoka ku nshinga kubogora ihwanye n’iyo mu gifaransa bita “sauver“, “redresser“ cyangwa se ‘Gutabara’. Igitekerezonkomoko cy‘umutabazi Kibogo mu Rwanda Mu mateka y’u Rwanda dutangira kumva iby’Umutabazi bwa mbere muri wa mugani w’Ibimanuka mu gice cya wo cy’Umugani uvanze n’igitekerezo. Lacger yanditse agira ati “Ubwo Kigwa n’umuvandimwe we Mututsi na mushiki wabo Nyampundu bacibwaga mu ijuru bitewe n’icyaha cya nyina wamennye ibanga ry’Imana, bururukiye mu Mubali bavuye mu ijuru. Bagera mu Mubali rero, bibonye bambaye ubusa bakennye. Hashize iminsi icumi bafite agahinda gakabije, bafite inzara, inyota n’imbeho bifuza gupfa gusa, bambaza Imana bati: Mana y’u Rwanda tugirire impuhwe utubabarire. Muri ako kanya inkuba ikubitira mu kirere maze umurabyo ukongeza ibyatsi byumye maze babona agashirira baragafatisha babona umuriro barota.” “Hashize iminsi ijuru rirakinguka babona hamanutse impeke, ibishyimbo, amasaka n’insina y’imineke. Hashize iminsi na none mu ijuru hamanuka ikibumbe cy’ubutare bwo gucuramo ibyuma n’amasuka bati: Imana ni yo itwoherereje ibi byose”. Ngo icyo gihe maze ni bahinze batihingishije! Muri ako karere bamanukiyemo, hari hatuye imiryango itatu: Abasinga, Abazigaba n’Abatwa bo mu ishyamba. Abo bantu bose bari barakomotse mu ijuru aho ba sekuruza bari barirukanywe bitewe n’icyaha bahakoreye. Kubera ko bo batari barigeze basaba Imana imbabazi, ni cyo cyatumye ibarekera mu butindi n’ubukene. Abo baje nyuma nibo babatungishije. Ubwo Kibogo yicwaga n’abagome nyuma Imana ikamuzura Kugira ngo abo bantu batazarimbuka bagashiraho, byatumye Imana yohereza Umutabazi Kibogo aza ku ruhembe rw’umurabyo arababwira ati “Mwitinya nimuhumure ni Imana ibantumyeho! Nzaba umuhuza wanyu n’Imana kandi icyo muzasaba cyose niba ari cyiza Imana izakibaha!. Umutabazi ni impongano y’Imana ku bana bayo bayiringira.” Nyuma ariko abagome ngo baramufashe bamumanika ku giti bakoresheje ibyuma bisongoye baramwica. Imana yaje komora ibikomere bye imugaruramo ubuzima hanyuma Imana yohereza umurabyo umuzamura mu kirere asubira ku Mana. Lacger yavuze ko iyo u Rwanda rugize amakuba, umuzimu w’Umutabazi aza gutura muri umwe mu bana b’Umwami agahinduka Umutabazi agakiza igihugu. Bavuga ko abatambyi bo mu Mubali aribo bamubambye bakamwica ariko ko “Imana yomoye ibikomere bye imugaruramo ubugingo hanyuma yohereza n‘umurabyo umuzamura mu kirere asubira ku Mana”.

title: Indirimbo umwami Yuhi Musinga yaririmbye ubwo yacibwaga mu Rwanda
content:
Musinga yimye ingoma ahagana muri Werurwe 1897, ayambuye mukuru we bahuje se, Mibambwe IV Rutarindwa. Byakurikiwe no kwitwikira mu nzu kwa Rutarindwa n’umuryango we wose amaze kumenya ko yagambaniwe. Musinga yimye ingoma akiri muto, ku myaka 14 gusa, ari nayo mpamvu mu minsi ye ya mbere yayoborerwaga na nyina Kanjogera. Ni imyaka yari iruhije kuko Abakoloni b’Abadage n’abamisiyoneri ba mbere bari bari kwinjira mu Rwanda, bashaka abayoboke mu banyarwanda. Kubera kwanga amabwiriza bamuhaga n’uburyo bashakaga kuyobora u Rwanda, Abakoloni birukanye umwami Musinga mu Rwanda mu Ukwakira 1931. Saa yine n’igice ku wa 14 Ukwakira 1931 igihiriri ry’abaja cyahagurutse i Nyanza giherekeje Musinga, abagore be batanu n’abana be icyenda na nyina Kanjogera n’abo mu muryango wabo, bajyanwa mu nzu yari yabateguriwe i Kamembe. Mu gitabo cyiswe Rucunshu, cya Ruhashya Épimaque, ku ipaji ya 94 kugeza kuya 95, hagaragara indirimbo bivugwa ko yahimbwe n’Umwami Musinga ubwo yacibwaga akajyanwa i Kamembe akavaha ajya i Moba. Muri iyo ndirimbo, Musinga agaragaza ko yari umwami mwiza uzi kurinda igihugu kandi ufasha abababaye. Agaragaza ko yaciwe mu gihugu nta cyaha yakoze, n’agahinda atewe no gusiga igihugu cye, abaturage be n’abana be. Ntabwo bizwi neza niba iyo ndirimbo ariyo Musinga yihimbiye ubwe dore ko ntaho amateka amugaragaza nk’umusizi, cyangwa niba ari iyo yahimbiwe ikamwitirirwa. Indirimbo ya Musinga acibwa Nali Rugwiza

title: Itandukaniro ry’imitako gakondo y’Abanyarwanda bo hambere n’icyo yabaga isobanuye
content: Icyo gitabo gikubiyemo imitako igera ku 137 y’ubwoko butandukanye cyasohotse mu 2019; buri umwe ufite umwihariko wawo bitewe n’imiterere, uburyo ukoze n’amabara awugize. Benshi bayizi ku izina ry’Imigongo ariko nk’uko bigaragara muri icyo gitabo cyitwa "Ingeri z’Imitako Gakondo" iyo mitako yose ntabwo yitwa imigongo ahubwo imigongo nayo ni bumwe mu bwoko bw’imitako. Nk’uko bigaragara muri icyo gitabo harimo imitako yitwa Umwashi, Amababa y’Intashya, Umuhigo, Igitoki, Amanyamanza, Ibaba, Itangaza, Ibigobe by’uruzi, Inyemera n’Akarizo k’ingwe. Hari kandi Ishobe, Igembe, Igishyamirane, Basangira, Intege z’Abasaza, Imikako, Ingondo, Umugongo w’Inzovu, Ibigobe by’Uruzi, Ubusonga, Itangaza n’iyindi. Umushakashatsi mu Kigo cy’Igihugu cy’Inzu Ndangamurage z’u Rwanda akaba ari na we wayoboye itsinda ry’abanditse icyo gitabo, Ntagwabira André, yavuze ko bacyanditse bafite intego eshatu arizo gusigasira amateka, kuyarinda no kuyamenyesha abakiri bato. Yasobanuye ko iyo mitako n’ubu ikoreshwa kandi ibisobanuro byayo bitahindutse ahubwo ikigamijwe ari ukugira ngo hatazagira abayiyitirira cyangwa bakayivangira bagatuma ita umwimerere wayo. Ati “Iyi mitako n’ubu iracyakoreshwa kandi ibisobanuro byayo biracyari bya bindi n’ubwo benshi batakibimenya.” Muri yo yasobanuye igera ku 10 avuga n’akamaro kayo ahereye k’uwitwa ‘Ibaba’ avuga ko ari umutako gakondo ushushe nk’icyubi cy’inyoni iguruka ari nayo mpamvu wahawe iryo zina. Naho ‘Itangaza’ yavuze ko ari umutako ufite imvano ku ijambo rikomoka ku nshinga ‘gutangaza’ isobanura gushimisha cyangwa kureshya abareba, gutamuruka kw’ahantu hatabonaga cyangwa mu gitondo. Ati “Mu yandi magambo, uyu mutako witwa itangaza kubera ko utangaza abawubonye.” Umutako witwa ‘Igishyamirane’ ufite inkomoko ku ijambo igishyamirane rikomoka ku nshinga ‘gushyama’ bisobanura kwibanga kw’inka ishaka kurwana cyangwa kwica umuntu. Uyu mutako witwa igishyamirane kubera ko ushushe nk’amahembe y’ibimasa bishyamiranye. Undi mutako gakondo witwa ‘Inyemera’ cyangwa ‘Impala’ wibutsa uko inyamaswa y’impala iba imeze mu kirere iyo yiruka isimbuka cyane. Hari kandi uwitwa ‘Ibigobe by’uruzi’ ukomoka ku ijambo ikigobe (ibigobe mu bwinshi) rivuga igice cy’uruzi cyangwa ikiyaga cyinjira mu butaka. Ntagwabira ati “Ibigobe by’uruzi rero ni ahantu uruzi rwaremye ibigonzi. Umutako gakondo witwa utyo wahawe iryo zina kubera ko imisusire yawo yibutsa ibigonzi by’uruzi.” Umutako gakondo w’Abanyarwanda witwa ‘Akarizo k’ingwe’ wakomotse kuri iyo nyamaswa y’inkazi iba mu ishyamba. Igira umurizo muremure uhora uberamye kandi umutwe wawo uhese ureba hejuru. Uwo mutako nawo uba ari muremure, uberamye kandi uhese. Iyo miterere yawo isa n’iy’umurizo w’iyo nyamaswa niyo ituma bawita akarizo k’ingwe. Muri icyo gitabo harimo n’umutako gakondo witwa ‘Ishobe’ bikomoka ku nshinga ‘gushoberwa’ isobanura kujya mu kaga ukananirwa kukivanamo. Wahawe iryo zina kubera ko ugoranye kuwukora. Ntagwabira ati “Umutako w’ishobe ugoranye gukora kurusha indi witwa iryuzuye cyangwa ishobe ryuzuye.” Undi mutako ni uwitwa ‘Igitoke’ kuko ufite ishusho isa n’iseri ry’igitoke gifite amabere manini. Hari kandi n’umutako witwa ‘Inkora y’Abahigi’; mu rurimi rw’Ikinyarwanda, ijambo inkora risobanura ikirari cy’ahantu haciye itsinda ry’abantu, amatungo cyangwa inyamaswa. Uwo mutako ugaragaza ishusho y’ikirari kuko ari umurongo uvunaguye ariko ukomeza guhera ku ruhande rumwe rw’igikoresho utatseho kugeza ku rundi. Umutako wundi ugaragara muri icyo gitabo cy’abashakashatsi ni ‘Umutweka’ ukomoka ku myenda y’Abadage. Izina itweka rikomoka ku ijambo umutweka bisobanura ubwoko bw’imyenda yadukanywe n’Abadage mu Rwanda mbere ya 1916. Kuri iyo myenda habagaho amabara afite impande enye; abanyabugeni n’abanyabukorikori b’Abanyarwanda bagakora imitako isa nayo bayigana, iyo mitako ikitwa itweka. Umutako w’itweka urimo ubwoko bwitwa ishobe. Umushakashatsi mu Kigo cy’Igihugu cy’Inzu Ndangamurage z’u Rwanda, Ntagwabira André, yavuze ko igitabo gikubiyemo iyo mitako n’ibisobanuro byayo bacyanditse mu gihe cy’umwaka umwe ari itsinda ry’abashakashatsi barindwi. Yasobanuye ko n’ubwo icyo gitabo gikubiyemo imitako 137 hari indi bavumbuye nyuma bityo bakaba nayo bateganya kuyishyira mu kindi gitabo bazandika. Kugeza ubu Akarere ka Nyanza kafashe umwanzuro wo kurimbisha inzu n’inyubako ziri mu Mujyi wa Nyanza hagamijwe kwimakaza isuku no kugaragaza ko aho hantu ari igicumbi cy’umuco kuva hambere. Inkuru wasoma: Ikigo cy’Inzu Ndangamurage z’u Rwanda cyamuritse igitabo gikubiyemo ingeri z’imitako gakondo [email protected]

title: Imiterere y’amasano y’ibanze ya Kinyarwanda
content: Kubera kwinjirirwa n’indimi z’amahanga, amasano nyarwanda agenda atakara, ugasanga aho kwita umuntu ‘Mama wacu’ abana baramwita Tante cyangwa Aunt, mubyara wawe ngo ni ‘cousin’ n’ibindi. Ubusanzwe mu muco nyarwanda umwana yakuraga azi amasano n’abo mu muryango akomokamo bikamufasha kumenya uko yitwara kuri buri wese, ibyo aziririjwe kumukorera n’ibindi. Ibyo kandi byajyanaga n’umuco, ku buryo ayo masano yageraga no ku gushyingirwa, hakaba abo umuco wemerera umuntu kuba yashyingiranwa na we n’abo bibujijwe rwose. Mu muco nyarwanda habamo ubwoko bubiri bw’amasano, aya bugufi n’aya kure. Akenshi ahabwaga umwanya ukomeye ni aya bugufi nubwo hari n’aho aya kure yarebwagaho cyane. Mu masano ya bugufi, hazaga data, uwo akaba ari umubyeyi w’umugabo. Mama, ni umubyeyi w’umugore. Mu yandi ya bugufi hari: Mama wacu: Ni umuvandimwe wa Mama w’igitsina-gore. Iyi sano ishobora kugera no kwa ba Sewabo wa Mama.  Data wacu: Ni umuvandimwe wa Data w’igitsina-gabo. Iyi sano ishobora kugera no ku kwa ba Se wabo wa Data. Masenge: Ni umuvandimwe wa Data w’Igitsina-gore (Mushiki wa Data). Iyi sano ishobora kugera no kwa ba Se wabo wa Data. Marume: Ni umuvandimwe wa Mama w’igitsina-gabo (Musaza wa Mama). Iyi sano ishobora kugera no kwa ba Se wabo wa Mama.  Sogokuru: Ni umubyeyi w’igitsina-gabo ubyara Data cyangwa se Mama. Iyi sano ishobora kugera no ku bavukana na we kugera no kwa ba Sewabo. Nyogokuru: Ni umubyeyi w’igitsina-gore ubyara Data cyangwa se Mama. Iyi sano ishobora kugera no ku bavukana na we kugera no kwa ba Se wabo. Mushiki wanjye: Ni uwo tuvukana duhuje ababyeyi bombi w’igitsina-gore, ashobora no kuba avuka ku mwihariko wa Mama cyangwa se wa Data, ni ukuvuga tudasangiye ababyeyi bombi. Undi ushobora guhabwa iyo sano, ni uw’igitsina-gore ukomoka ku bavandimwe ba Mama b’igitsina-gore cyangwa se abavandimwe ba Data b’igitsina-gabo. Musaza wanjye: Ni uwo tuvukana duhuje ababyeyi bombi w’igitsina-gabo, ashobora no kuba avuka ku mwihariko wa Mama cyangwa se wa Data, ni ukuvuga tudasangiye ababyeyi bombi. Undi ushobora guhabwa iyo sano,ni uw’igitsina-gabo ukomoka ku bavandimwe ba Mama b’igitsina-gore cyangwa se abavandimwe ba Data b’igitsina-gabo. Murumuna wanjye:  Ni uwo tuvukana duhuje ababyeyi bombi, ariko muruta ubukuru, ashobora no kuba avuka ku mwihariko wa Mama cyangwa se wa Data, ni ukuvuga tudasangiye ababyeyi bombi. Undi ushobora guhabwa iyo sano, ni uw’igitsina-gabo ukomoka ku bavandimwe ba Mama b’igitsina-gore cyangwa se abavandimwe ba Data b’igitsina-gabo, ariko muruta ubukuru, iyi nyito ikoreshwa ku bitsina byombi (gore na gabo). Mukuru wanjye: Ni uwo tuvukana duhuje ababyeyi bombi, ashobora no kuba avuka ku mwihariko wa Mama cyangwa se wa Data, ni ukuvuga tudasangiye ababyeyi bombi. Undi ushobora guhabwa iyo sano, ni uw’igitsina-gabo ukomoka ku bavandimwe ba Mama b’igitsina-gore cyangwa se abavandimwe ba Data b’igitsina-gabo ariko anduta ubukuru, iyi nyito ikoreshwa ku bitsina byombi (gore na gabo). Iyo Sano ikoreshwa kandi ku bakomoka kwa Data wacu cyangwa se kwa Mama wacu, iyi nyito ikoreshwa ku bitsina byombi (gore na gabo). Mukuru wanjye wo kwa Mama wacu: Ni umuvandimwe unduta ubukuru, ariko akomoka kwa kwa Mama wacu, iyi nyito ikoreshwa ku bitsina byombi (gore na gabo). Mukuru wanjye wo kwa Data wacu: Ni umuvandimwe nduta ubukuru, ariko akomoka kwa kwa Data wacu, iyi nyito ikoreshwa ku bitsina byombi (gore na gabo). Murumuna wanjye wo kwa Mama wacu: Ni umuvandimwe nduta ubukuru, ariko akomoka kwa kwa Mama wacu, iyi nyito ikoreshwa ku bitsina byombi (gore na gabo). Murumuna wanjye wo kwa Data wacu: Ni umuvandimwe nduta ubukuru, ariko akomoka kwa kwa Data wacu, iyi nyito ikoreshwa ku bitsina byombi (gore na gabo). Amasano ya kure-kuziguye Muramu wawe: Ni umuvandimwe w’umugore wawe, iyi nyito ikoreshwa ku bitsina byombi (gabo na gore). Iyi sano ishobora kugera no kwa ba Se wabo w’umugore wawe. Iyi sano kandi abayifitanye ni abo muva inda imwe bose b’ibitsina byombi. Muramukazi wawe: Ni umuntu w’igitsina –gore uva inda imwe n’umugabo wawe, iyi nyito ikoreshwa ku gitsina gore gusa. Iyi sano ishobora kugera no kwa ba Sewabo w’umugabo wawe. Iyi sano kandi aba ayifitanye n’abo muva inda imwe bose b’ibitsina byombi. Mubyara wawe: Ni umukobwa cyangwa se umuhungu uvuka kwa Nyokorome cyangwa se kwa Nyogosenge. Iyo sano ishobora no kugera ku bisanira byo kwa ba Sewabo wa Nyokorome cyangwa se cyangwa wa Nyogosenge. Amasano ya kure kutaziguye Umwinjira: Ni umugabo washatse mama wawe nyuma y’urupfu rwa So, ariko akamutungira mu rugo rwa So. Iyo amutwaye iwe, aba yabaye umugore we undi ari umugabe. Icyo gihe abana babyaranye bose baba ari abavandimwe bawe, musangiye amaraso ya mama wawe. Mukeba wa mama wawe: Ni undi mugore wa So cyangwa se uwo babyaranye. Abana abyaye baba bafitanye isano ya hafi na we. Iyi sano na none igera no ku bagore ba Baramu bawe. Musanzire wa So: Ni umuntu w’igitsina gabo washatse mu muryango umwe na So (agashaka Nyokowanyu), muri make abagore babo bavukana. Bakunze no kubita “Abendahamwe”. Abana bamuvutseho muba mufitanye isano ya bugufi. Mukaso: Ni umugore wa Kabiri wa So, ashobora kuba yaramushatse umugore we wa mbere yarapfuye cyangwa se akiriho. Icyo gihe abana babyaranye bose baba ari abavandimwe bawe, musangiye amaraso kuri So. Sobukwe: Ni umugabo ubyara uwo mwashakanye, iyi nyito ikoreshwa n’ibitsina byombi. Iyi Sano irakomeza ikazagera no ku bo bavukana no kubo bava inda imwe kwa Se wabo. Nyokobukwe: Ni umugore ubyara uwo mwashakanye, iyi nyito ikoreshwa n’ibitsina byombi. Iyi Sano irakomeza ikazagera no ku bo bavukana no ku bo bava inda imwe kwa Se wabo. Umukwe: Ni umugabo washatse umukobwa wawe. Iyi sano irakomeza ikagera no ku bo bavukana, ndetse ikazagera no ku bashatse n’abakobwa ubereye Se wabo cyangwa Nyinawabo. Umukazana: Ni umugore washatswe n’umuhungu wawe. Iyi sano irakomeza ikagera no ku bo bavukana ndetse ikazagera no ku bashatswe n’abagabo ubereye Se wabo cyangwa Nyinawabo.

title: Impamvu igitabo kidakwiriye kubura mu mpano uha uwo ukunda
content:
Abantu bamwe baha agaciro kadakwiye igitabo, ntibazi ko igitabo aricyo shingiro ry’iterambere rirambye, ishingiro ry’ubuzima bwiza, ishingiro ry’ubwenge, ishingiro ry’imibereho myiza, ishingiro ryo kubaka igihugu, ishingiro ryo gusigasira igihango ndetse igitabo ni ishingiro ryo kugira igenamigambi rirambye. Njya nibaza ibibazo bikurikira: Kuki umuntu agura umwenda w’ibihumbi ijana ariko akumva atagura igitabo cy’ibihumbi ijana? Kuki umuntu agura mudasobwa y’ibihumbi magana atanu ariko akumva atagura igitabo cy’ibihumbi magana atanu? Kuki umuntu agura ururabo rwo guha inshuti ye ariko akaba atamuha impano y’igitabo?. Mu mwaka wa 2016, hari inshuti yanjye yitwa Ken Chartrand twigeze kuganira turi gutembera i New York, ambwira ko mu mpano nziza ashobora guha umuntu akunda ko hadashobora kuburamo igitabo, mubajije impamvu arambwira ngo igitabo ni inshuti nziza muganira ukunguka ubwenge n’ubuhanga, kikaba urwibutso rurambye kandi rudashira. Ken yambwiye ko igitabo ari urwibutso rw’ubushuti, ko buri kwezi agura ibitabo bibiri byo gusoma kandi ko adashobora kuryama adasomye igitabo kuko gituma aruhuka neza, akunguka ubumenyi burushijeho. Nyuma y’ikiganiro twagiranye, nahise nkunda birushijeho igitabo, mpitamo kwimakaza umuco wo kwandika, kugura ndetse no gusoma ibitabo. Kugeza ubu maze kwandika ibitabo bine. Mu biro byanjye harimo ibitabo naguze nsoma kenshi, mu rugo umuryango wanjye nawuguriye ibitabo byo gusoma kandi bamaze kubikunda. Birakwiye ko twimakaza uyu muco mwiza ufasha kubaka u Rwanda twifuza ndetse n’Afurika, tugura ibitabo, tubiha agaciro gakomeye, tubitangamo impano ku nshuti dukunda, tubisoma aho turi hose, bityo bizadufashe kurushaho gutera imbere dufite ubuhanga bwimbitse. Ibi kandi bizadufasha kwihuta mu iterambere ndetse turusheho kumenya aho tuva, aho tugeze ndetse n’icyerekezo cy’u Rwanda na Afurika. Bizadufasha kurushaho kuba abarinzi b’ibyagezweho mu Rwanda no muri Afurika bityo tubisigasire ndetse tunabyubakireho ibindi bikorwa byinshi kandi byiza. HATEGEKIMANA Richard

title: Amafoto mpangano y’abami batwaye u Rwanda imyaka 870 n’abagabekazi babo
content: Hifashishijwe ibisigo by’Abasizi bisingiza Abami n’ingoma zabo ndetse n’Abacurabwenge bari abarinzi b’amateka n’intekerezo z’igihugu, hiyongereyeho n’Abiru bari abanyamabanga n’abagaragu b’ingoma, hakusanyijwe amateka y’u Rwanda kuva mu ntango yarwo ubwo Gihanga I Ngomijana yashyiragaho imfatiro z’igihugu kugera ubwo Ingoma cya cyami yasimburwaga na Repubulika. Mu bakoreye mu ngata Gihanga I Ngomijana harimo ubuvivi bwe Ndoba watwaye u Rwanda ahasaga mu wa 1213 kugera 1246 arangwa n’ibitekerezo bihanitse mu bumenyi mu by’ibidukikije, inyamaswa n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Muri make Ndoba yari afite ubuhanga karemano muri siyansi, dore ko ari nawe dukesha ibirangamuryango nko kuba Abasinga barangwa na Sakabaka, Abashambo bakarangwa n’Intare, Abenengwe bakarangwa n’Ingwe mu gihe Abega barangwa n’Ibikeri, byose ni we tubikesha. Hari kandi na Ruganzu Bwimba watwaye u Rwanda kuva mu 1312 kugera mu 1345 wabaye imbimbuzi mu ndwanyi zaranze amateka y’u Rwanda mu guhirimbanira ubuhangange bw’igihugu. Niwe wagabye igitero cya mbere atera Gisaka yashakaga gusibanganya u Rwanda we arayitanga arayitera. Ni we dukesha kurwanira ishyaka igihugu, cyane cyane mu guhangana n’abagomera umurage wa Gihanga w’igihugu gisangiwe. Nta n’uwarenza ingohe Cyilima Rugwe, watwaye u Rwanda kuva mu 1345 kugera mu 1378, umutekerereza w’ubutabera bwunga mu mateka y’u Rwanda. Ni we washyizeho Inkiko z’Umuryango, iz’Abunzi n’iza Gacaca agena n’uko ibihano bizajya bitangwa ku bagomye. Yashakaga ko u Rwanda ruba igihugu kizira icyaha, abyubakira ku guhana igihango nk’uburyo bwo gukumira icyaha kitaraba. Nta n’uwakwibagirwa Ruganzu II Ndoli, watwaye u Rwanda kuva mu 1510 kugera mu 1543 wari indwanyi karundura, wadukanye amatwara yo guhangana n’amahanga adakunda u Rwanda akayagusha ruhabo, akarwagura kurusha abandi bami bose dore ko yarwometseho ibihugu icyenda. Hari inzobere kandi muri dipolomasi Mutara Semugeshi, watwaye u Rwanda mu 1543 kugera mu 1576, ni we mwami dukesha politiki ya mbere y’ububanyi n’amahanga, yubatse kandi imiyoborere ihamye mu kwegereza ubuyobozi abaturage aho yashyizeho inzego zisaga 75 nk’Intebe y’Abasizi, Abatware b’Ubutaka, Abatware b’Inyambo, Intebe y’Abahaditsi (abavuzi b’amatungo - vétérinaire), Intebe y’Abahoryo (Agronome), Intebe y’Abamotsi (abari bashinzwe itangazamakuru ry’ibwami) n’izindi. Ni we washyizeho uburyo bw’imisimburanire y’Abami ku ngoma bijyanye n’inshingano zabo nk’aho Umwami Mutara yabaga ashinzwe kwagura ubworozi bw’inka yakurikirwaga na Kigeli wari umwami w’intambara, Mibambwe wari ushinzwe uburumbuke, Yuhi wari umwami usigasira amahoro bityo bityo. Ntitwakwibagirwa n’abandi nka Cyilima Rujugira (1675 – 1708), wadukanye intero y’u Rwanda rutera rudaterwa, Yuhi Gahindiro (1746-1802) wazanye gahunda z’ubugiraneza nka Girinka na Kigeli Rwabugili (1859-1895) wacecekesheje ibihugu byashakaga kwiyomora ku Rwanda. Mu mateka y’Isi n’ibihangange byayibayemo nk’Abami b’u Rwanda, benshi baburiwe irengero, amasura yabo aribagirana kuko nta buryo bwariho bwo gufata amafoto no kuyashyingura ariko ibikorwa byabo bikaba bikibukwa kuko basize imusozi amavugwa y’ibikorwa bihanitse. Umushakashatsi ku mateka y’u Rwanda, Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, yahereye aho maze akusanya ibitekerezo by’ubuzima bwaranze aba bakurambere, yifashisha abahanga mu gushushanya bahanga amafoto y’abami b’u Rwanda, cyane umwami wa mbere wafotowe yari Kigeli Rwabugili mu 1894, abandi bamubanjirije ntawe uzi neza uko basaga. Aya mafoto mpangano y’Abami b’u Rwanda n’Abagabekazi babo, yakozwe n’umunyabugeni Mugisha Paul wize ku Nyundo, yashyizwe hanze bwa mbere mu gitabo ‘‘Intwari z’Imbanza, zubatse u Rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro” cyasohotse muri Gicurasi 2018. Uko ubumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga bigenda bikwira ku Isi yose rero, abahanga bagiye bitabaza inyurabwenge maze bakazimbura amasura y’abo bantu babayeho mu myaka ibihumbi kugira ngo bajye bayifashisha mu kubavuga ibigwi no kubagiraho icyitegererezo, ariko batari za baringa cyangwa umuntu udashobora kubonwa. Ni muri urwo rwego hariho amafoto ya Yesu, Mariya, Yozefu, intumwa za Yesu 12, Musa wavanye Abayisiraheli mu Misiri n’abandi. Nsanzabera avuga ko ‘‘Abo bagize ibikorwa bakora ku Isi n’ubu bikiri intangarirwa, kandi amafoto yabo mpangano akaba yaramamaye mu buryo buhanitse ndetse ntashidikanyweho ko aribo koko.’’ Nk’abakoze ishusho ya Yezu, icyo bakoze ni ukureba ku bikorwa bye, amateka yamuranze n’imyitwarire ye ku Isi, barema amafoto mpangano ye kugira ngo buri wese ajye abasha kumubona mu buryo bugenekereje. Mu gushushanya amafoto mpangano agenekereje y’abami b’u Rwanda, hagendewe ku bushakashatsi bushingiye ku bikorwa byabaranze, uruhererekane-mvugo rw’ibyabaye ku ngoma zabo, imishyingiranire y’umuryango w’abami b’u Rwanda n’indi miryango migari y’Abanyarwanda, igenantekerezo (Philosophie) n’imyitwarire yaranze Abami b’u Rwanda ndetse n’ikigero cy’imyaka y’ubukure mu iyimikwa ryabo. Nsanzabera ati “Ese niba umwami runaka yarakoze ibikorwa bikomeye mu kubaka u Rwanda, aho ntiyasaga atya? Iyo ni imwe mu ngingo yitaweho cyane mu kugenekereza amafoto y’abami b’u Rwanda. Kuko kenshi imirimo y’umuntu isa n’isura ye, ikanahamya umutima wamuranze mu bihe byose.’’ Aya mafoto mpangano yanashingiye ku kigero cy’ubukure cy’abami n’abagabekazi. Hari aho atandukanye mu kigero cy’ubukure bitewe n’uko hari abagiye bimikwa bafite imyaka ibiri, abari abasore b’ibihame, abahawe ingoma bakiri ingimbi n’abayihawe bakuze cyane. Ni nako byagenze ku Bagabekazi kuko hari abagiye bapfakara bakiri bato, umwami agatanga, bakiri ibirongore, abandi ugasanga bari bakiri abagore b’amariza n’ibindi. Intego ya Nsanzabera ni uko ababyifuza bakoresha amafoto mpangano mu nyandiko na filime zirebana n’amateka y’u Rwanda mu kwerekana amashusho y’abami n’abagabekazi. Aya mafoto ni uburiza bw’andi yaranze u Rwanda mu bihe bitandukanye, azasohoka mu bindi bitabo.

title: Tariki 15 Gicurasi: Umunsi umwanditsi n’umunyamateka Mgr Alexis Kagame yaboneyeho izuba
content: Musenyeri Alexis Kagame, yabaye umuhanga udasanzwe, umwanditsi n’umunyamateka ukomeye, akibukirwa ku bitabo byuje ubuhanga yanditse n’ibisigo birimo Indyoheshabirayi, Inganji Karinga, Umuririmbyi wa Nyiribiremwa, Isoko y’Amajyambere n’ibindi. Yavutse kuwa 15 Gicurasi 1912 i Kiyanza mu Buliza, ubu ni mu murenge wa Ntarabana mu Karere ka Rulindo mu Majyaruguru. Mu myaka 69 y’ubuzima bwe, Kagame yasize umusanzu ukomeye asiga u Rwanda na Afurika bamumenye nk’umunyamateka, umuhanga mu ndimi n’umuhanga mu byo gutekereza (filozofiya). Ubuzima bwe mu buto Kagame yakuze ari umuhanga haba mu bitekerezo no mu mivugire, yaje kuba inshuti ya hafi y’umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa waje no kumuha uburenganzira bwo gukusanya ibitekerezo by’Abiru ngo abyandikemo igitabo. Yatangiye kwiga mu Ishuri rya Leta Mbiligi Gatolika mu Ruhengeri mu 1925, icyo gihe yari afite imyaka 13. Yaharangije nyuma y’imyaka itatu mu 1928, asaba kujya mu iseminari nto i Kabgayi mu karere ka Muhanga mu 1929, aharangiriza mu 1933. Yakomeje mu iseminari nkuru ari umuhanga mu buryo budasanzwe, kugeza abaye umupadiri mu 1941. Alexis Kagame nk’umwanditsi Mu 1943 nibwo Kagame yasohoye igitabo cye cya mbere cyagarukaga ku mateka y’u Rwanda yise Inganji Karinga, gikurikirwa n’ibindi byinshi bigaruka no ku busizi, agenda ahuza imyemerere gakondo n’ubuzima bwa gikirisitu, ingingo yanditseho cyane. Alexis Kagame kandi yagiye akora inyingo nyinshi zirebana n’ubusizi nyabami. Musenyeri Kagame yifashishije ibyiciro biboneka mu rurimi rw’Ikinyarwanda agaragaza ubuhanga bw’Abanyafurika mu mitekerereze, mu bushakashatsi bwamuhesheje impamyabushobozi y’ikirenga mu bya filozofiya muri Kaminuza ya Mutagatifu Gregoire i Roma, igitabo gishingiye ku iyigandimi nyarwanda, yise “La philosophie Bantu-Rwandaise de l’être”, hari mu 1956. Agarutse mu Rwanda, yatangiye kwigisha mu iseminari asohora n’ibitabo byinshi, bitari ku mateka y’u Rwanda gusa, ahubwo bigera no ku rurimi rw’Ikinyarwanda. Mu 1959 nyuma y’itanga ry’Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa, ingoma ya Cyami yatangiye gusa n’ivaho, ariko Alexis Kagame we kubera ibitekerezo bikomeye yari afite ntiyagira ikindi kibazo, ahubwo ahabwa kujya kwigisha muri Kaminuza Nkuru y’u Rwanda ubwo yashigwaga mu 1963. Icyo gihe kandi yari n’umwarimu muri Kaminuza y’Igihugu ya Zaire i Lubumbashi, ubu ni muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, aho yigishaga amateka ya Afurika y’iburasirazuba n’iyo hagati. Kuwa 5 Nyakanga mu 1979 yahawe na leta impeta y’ishimwe ubwo yagirwaga “Officier de l’ordre national des Grands lacs”, ndetse amaze kugirwa igisonga cya Musenyeri muri diyosezi ya Butare muri 1980, Papa Yahani Pawulo wa II yamugize Musenyeri w’icyubahiro ku ya 4 Nyakanga 1981, aba Musenyeri atyo nubwo atari umwepisikopi nk’abo tuzi ubu. Kuwa 2 Ukuboza 1981 nibwo Musenyeri Alexis Kagame yitabye Imana aguye mu bitaro by’i Nairobi muri Kenya aho yari yagiye kwivuza, ndetse umurambo we leta yishingira kuwuzana mu Rwanda kubera agaciro yari afite mu gihugu. Kagame yabaye mu Nama y’Ubuyobozi bwa Rwanda-Urundi kuva muri 1956 kugeza ku bwigenge bw’u Rwanda. Uretse ibihembo mpuzamahanga, kuwa 3 Nzeri 2014, Musenyeri Alexis Kagame yashyikirijwe igihembo n’Inteko Nyarwanda y’Ururimi n’Umuco cyiswe “Igihembo Cya Akademi”, cyashyizweho hagamijwe gushima abantu bakora ibikorwa by’indashyikirwa mu kubungabunga ubusugire n’iterambere by’ururimi n’umuco by’u Rwanda.

title: Abanyabugeni b’abagore bahawe umwihariko mu kwizihiza Umunsi Mpuzamahanga w’Ingoro Ndangamurage
content: Buri mwaka tariki 18 Gicurasi Isi yizihiza Umunsi Mpuzamahanga wahariwe Ingoro Ndangamurage, hazirikanwa umuco, amateka n’imibereho gakondo by’abatuye Isi. U Rwanda narwo rwifatanya n’amahanga mu kwizihiza uwo munsi ushimangira agaciro ko guhererekanya amateka no guteza imbere umuco ufatwa nk’umusingi w’imibereho y’igihugu. Urwa Gasabo rubarizwa mu Muryango Mpuzamahanga w’Ingoro Ndangamurage (ICOM) uhuriyemo abanyamuryango basaga 44 000 bakora mu ngoro ndangamurage 20 000 zo mu bihugu 138. Muri uyu mwaka, uyu munsi wahawe insanganyamatsiko ivuga ku kugira “Ingoro ndangamurage zigamije uburinganire, ubudasa no kudaheza’’. Kuri iyi nshuro iki gikorwa cyateguwe mu buryo bwihariye aho hazifashishwa ikoranabuhanga bitewe n’ingamba zashyizweho zo guhangana n’ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo cya COVID-19. Ni muri urwo rwego Ingoro ndangamurage zo mu bihugu binyamuryango bya ICOM zasabwe kucyizihiza hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga. Ikigo cy’Ingoro z’Igihugu z’Umurage w’u Rwanda (INMR) cyizizihiza ibi birori hafungurwa ku mugaragaro imurika rishya mu Ngoro y’Ubugeni n’Ubuhanzi iherereye i Kanombe, ku wa 18 Gicurasi 2020. Iri murika ry’ibihangano by’ubugeni ryahawe insanganyamatsiko ivuga iti “Ubutumwa bw’abanyabugeni b’Abanyarwandakazi: Uburinganire kuri bose.’’ Ni insanganyamatsiko yari yagenwe ku Munsi Mpuzamahanga w’Abari n’Abategarugori [yasubitswe kubera ingamba zo guhangana na Coronavirus], ariko inahurirana n’iyatanzwe na ICOM uyu mwaka wa 2020. Iyo urebye mu byiciro bitandukanye bibarizwamo abari n’abategarugori mu Rwanda, usanga baragize uruhare mu bikorwa by’iterambere ry’ubukungu n’imibereho myiza y’abaturage nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994; ariko basigara inyuma mu bijyanye n’ubugeni bitewe n’impamvu zirimo ubushobozi buke, kubura amahugurwa ahagije mu bijyanye n’ubugeni n’izindi mbogamizi zo mu buzima busanzwe. Ushingiye no ku bihangano bimuritse mu Ngoro y’Ubugeni n’Ubuhanzi y’i Kanombe “Hari icyuho kinini hagati y’ibihangano by’abagore n’abagabo. Ibi ntibisobanuye ko badashoboye, bafite impano muri bo kuko na bake bari muri uwo mwuga bakora ibihangano byiza cyane, bimwe muri byo bifite ubwiza burenze ibya basaza babo.’’ Imurika rizakorwa nk’uburyo bwo gukora ubukangurambaga mu bari n’abategarugori, binyuze mu butumwa bukubiye mu nsanganyamatsiko y’imurika no mu bihangano byabo byateguwe kandi bizamurikwa, bakangurirwa kwigirira icyizere, gutinyuka no kugaragaza impano bafite mu by’ubugeni. Iri murika ryateguwe hagamijwe gufasha abahanzikazi bato no kubaharurira inzira zo kungukira mu bikorwa byabo; gufasha abanyabugeni b’abagore gutegura ibikorwa byo kumurika ibihangano byabo; kwerekana agaciro ko gushora mu bushobozi bw’umugore no kubafasha kugeza imishinga yabo ku rwego mpuzamahanga, byanafasha abandi kubigiraho. Rizahuza abanyabugeni b’abari n’abategarugori 35 bo mu bihugu bitandatu birimo u Rwanda, Amerika, u Bufaransa, u Bubiligi, Serbia na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. INMR yateguye iri murika ifatanyije n’Ikigo Ndangamuco cy’Abadage Goethe Institut-Kigali. Ibyo bigo byombi byafashije abari n’abategarugori b’abanyabugeni mu kuritegura, kubaha amahugurwa n’ubushobozi bwo gukora ibihangano byabo no gutunganya imurika riboneye. Umuhango wo kwizihiza Umunsi Mpuzamahanga w’Ingoro Ndangamurage uzanyuzwa kuri murandasi (Webex) ku wa 18 Gicurasi 2020 saa Cyenda. Abifuza kuwukurikirana baziyandikisha bohereza ubutumwa kuri [email protected] cyangwa bakandikira ikigo banyuze ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Biteganyijwe ko umukozi w’Ingoro ndangamurage azasobanurira abazakurikira iki gikorwa ibijyanye n’imurika, ababwira ubutumwa bukubiye mu bihangano bigize imurika nkuko bigenda mu gihe bari gusura bisanzwe. U Rwanda rufite Ingoro z’Umurage umunani zimuritse umurage n’amateka by’igihugu ku mibereho y’abagituye, imyemerere, imyidagaduro, imyambarire, imiziro n’imiziririzo, amateka yacyo. Nyuma ya gahunda ya Guma mu rugo yashyizweho mu kwirinda ikwirakwira rya COVID-19, ibikorwa byo gufungura imiryango ku basura ingoro ndangamurage byarasubukuwe ku wa 5 Gicurasi 2020.

title: Imihango n’imigenzo yakorwaga n’Abanyarwanda mu kwirukana ibiza n’ibyorezo
content: Imihango yakorwaga ahanini yabaga ishingiye ku biteganywa n’Ubwiru, umwuga w’Ubupfumu, Ubuvubyi Ubuhennyi, Ubuhoryo n’Ubuhaditsi. Igitabo “Imizi y’u Rwanda” cyanditswe n’Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, inzobere mu muco, amateka n’Ubuvanganzo, havugwamo ko buri cyorezo cyateraga u Rwanda, habaga hari uburyo bwateguwe bwo kucyohera cyangwa kukirukana bakoreshejwe imwe muri iyo migenzo n’imihango yashyizwe u Rwanda rwahangwaga. Inzira ya Kivu: Ni inzira yabagamo urwunge rw’imihango yakorwaga mu gihe mu gihugu habaga hateye umwuzure ukangiza byinshi mu gihugu. Bakoraga imihango yo kwirunka uwo mwuzure. Inzira ya Muhekenyi: Ni inzira yabagamo urwunge rw’imihango yakorwaga mu gihe habaga hateye ibyonnyi n’indwara z’amatungo, bityo hagakorwa imihango n’imigenzo yo kuyohera. Nyuma y’imihango y’ibwami ijyanye n’ubwiru bwo kohera ibiza n’ibyorezo, hakurikiragaho abahanga gakondo mu kuvura icyateye icyo cyorezo no kucyohera ntikizagaruke. Bamwe muri bo bakoraga iyo mihango, ni aba bakurikira: Abavubyi: Mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere, abavubyi bari bafite umumaro uhanitse mu mibereho myiza y’abaturage cyane cyane mu buhinzi . Umwuga wabo gakondo wari uwo kuvuba imvura ikagwa iyo yabaga yahagamye, no kuyohera ikagenda iyo yabaga yaciye ibintu. Iyo habaga hateye amapfa cyangwa se umwuzure, icyo gihe nibwo abavubyi nk’inzobere mu kumanura imvura bahagurukaga bagakora imihango yo kuyimanura ikagwa, amapfa akagenda. Iyo yabaga yaciye ibintu hakaba umwuzure, nabwo bakoraga imihango yo kuyohera. Abahoryo: Abahoryo nabo ni bamwe mu banyamihango b’ibwami bagiraga uruhare runini ku gukurikirana ibihingwa mu murima no kuvura ibyonnyi by’indwara zabaga zadutse mu myaka. Barahagurukaga bagakora imihango yo kuvuma ibyo byonnyi no kuvuguta imiti yo kubyamurura ku butaka bw’u Rwanda. Abahaditsi: Ni bamwe mu banyamihango b’ibwami bari bagiraga uruhare runini ku gukurikirana indwara z’amatungo zabaga zadutse mu bworozi bw’I Rwanda. Icyo gihe nibwo Abahaditsi barahagurukaga bagakora imihango yo kuvuguta imiti yo kubyamurura mu Rwanda. Abahennyi: Abahennyi nabo bari bamwe mu banyamihango b’ibwami bifashishwaga mu kuvura indwara z’ibyorezo zibasiye abantu no kuvuma ababisha banga u Rwanda. Iyo habaga hateye ibyorezo by’indwara, icya mbere bakoraga ni ukumenya inkomoko yabyo, basanga ari ibirogano bagahenera uwabikoze akaba ikivume, basanga ari icyorezo cy’inzaduka bakagishakira amasubyo yo kucyohera. Nibo batangaga amasubyo yo kuvura amahumane, ibinyoro, ubushita n’izindi. Mu kwamurura no kohera ibyozezo by’indwara z’abantu n’amatungo, Abanyarwanda bifashishaga kandi amazi y’ubuhoro, yeza igihugu agakiza ubwandure akamurura ibiza by’indwara n’umuze byazengereje igihugu. Bigaragaza ko kuva kera Abanyarwanda bari bafite ubuhanga n’ubushobozi bifashishaga mu guhashya umwanzi w’ubuzima bwabo n’ibyabo. Ni abantu bakoresheje ubwenge bw’umwimerere mu kwirwanaho bahagarara ku buzima bwabo ngo butaganzwa n’ibyorezo by’indwara n’ibiza by’amapfa n’imyuzure.

title: Inkomoko y’amazina y’uduce tumwe two muri Kigali nka Nyarugenge, Kacyiru n’utundi
content: Icyo kigo kivuga ko hari amazina yatanzwe hagendewe ku bwoko bw’igiti biri cyangwa byiganje ahantu runaka. Izina ”Nyarugenge” rituruka ku giti cyitwa Imigenge (Acacia hochii). Ariryo ubu ryitwa Akarere ka Nyarugenge. Abahanga mu mateka bavuga ko hari ahandi nka ‘Kimironko’ hiswe hatyo hagendewe ku ishyamba ry’ibiti byitwa ‘Imironko’ ryatewe na Cyilima Rujugira, kugira ngo ajye aritemamo ibiti byo kuramvura imiheto yo guhangana n’amahanga adakunda u Rwanda. Kimihurura habaga ibyatsi bivura byitwa ‘imihurura’ n’ahandi. Ikigo cy’Ingoro z’Igihugu z’Umurage w’u Rwanda (INMR) kivuga ko hari amazina yaturutse ku bantu bakomeye babaga ahantu runaka. Nka “Kacyiru” bivugwa ko ryatanzwe hagendewe ku mugabo witwaga Cyiru; wari umutware na “Rwabutabura” ryatanzwe riturutse ku witwaga Rwabutabura wari utuye ahitwa iryo zina muri iki gihe, ubu ni mu Karere ka Nyarugenge. Umushakashatsi ku muco n’amateka Nsanzabera Jean De Dieu avuga ko ‘Kacyiru (agasozi k’icyiru)’ byitiriwe agasozi katangiweho ‘Ibyiru’ byinshi, bikomotse ku manza zacirwaga Abanyabwanacyambwe banze kuyoboka ingoma ya Mukobanya, nyuma yo kuhigarurira ahasaga mu wa 1378 ubwo yicaga Nkuba ya Nyabakonjo umwami w’u Bwanacyambwe. ‘Gacuriro’ hiswe hatyo kubera uruganda rucura amacumu yo kwagura u Rwanda rwubatswe na Kigeli Mukobanya. Andi mazina yatanzwe afatiwe ku bikorwa byo kubaka u Rwanda nk’ubworozi bw’inka. “Kicukiro” risobanuye umusozi amacukiro (ibirundo by’amase y’inka). Mu bihe byo hambere, Kicukiro izwi nka kamwe mu turere tw’umujyi wa Kigali kororerwagaho inka nyinshi. Niho hari hubatse ibiraro by’inka za Kigeli Mukobanya n’umuhungu we Mibambwe Sekarongoro Mutabazi. Hari ahazwi nka ‘Kabusunzu’ hiswe hatyo kubera umupfumu w’umuhanga wari waraturutse i Karagwe witwa ‘Gasunzu’ nyuma aho atuye bahita ‘Kagasunzu’ nyuma umunyamakuru wo kuri Radiyo Rwanda yagiye gutara amakuru avugira kuri Radiyo ko ari ‘Kabusunzu’ rihama rityo. Hazwi nk’i Nyamirambo hiswe hatyo biturutse ku mirambo myinshi yahabonetse ubwo abanyoro bateraga u Rwanda. Amateka nk’ayo aboneka mu nzu ndangamateka yitiriwe Richard Kandt (Kandt House Museum). Mu busanzwe hari ahandi mu Rwanda hagiye hitwa amazina hagendewe ku bikorwa bitandukanye byagiye bihabera. Hari nko ku Kivumu cya Mpushi, ahacirwaga abarwaye ibinyoro, ku cya Semakamba habereye urubanza rwa Semakamba n’Umwami Kigeli Rwabugiri n’ahandi. Kigali yagizwe umurwa mukuru w’u Rwanda bwa mbere ku bwa Kigeli Mukobanya ahasaga 1378. Umurwa mukuru w’Umwami wari mu Mudugudu wa Vugavuge mu Kagali ka Gasabo mu Murenge wa Rutunga h’ubu.

title: Imyaka 26 irashize umwamikazi wa nyuma w’u Rwanda, Rosalie Gicanda yishwe
content: Gicanda yashakanye n’Umwami Mutara wa III Rudahigwa Charles Léon Pierre Kuwa 13 Mutarama 1942. Yabayeho nabi asuzugurwa nyuma y’urupfu rw’umwami Rudahigwa, ubwo yatangiraga i Bujumbura ku buryo bw’amayobera tariki 25 Nyakanga 1959. Nyuma yo gutanga kw’umugabo we byajyanye n’ihurura ry’abarwaniraga Repubulika, ariko barushaho gutesha agaciro ingoma ya Cyami n’ibimenyetso byayo. Mu 1961 Perezida Kayibanda Grégoire yirukanye mu rukari Umwamikazi Gicanda. Yaje gutura mu Mujyi wa Butare mu Karere ka Huye, ari naho abahoze ari abasirikare ba Habyarimana hamwe n’Interahamwe bamusanze bakamwica kuwa 20 Mata 1994. Urupfu rw’Umwamikazi Rosali Gicanda Muri Repubulika ya mbere n’iya kabiri, umwamikazi Gicanda nubwo yari mu gihugu, yabayeho nta gaciro afite nk’uwahoze mu buyobozi bukuru bw’igihugu. Gicanda wari umuyoboke ukomeye wa Kiliziya Gatolika, yabayeho mu buzima bworoheje mu mujyi wa Huye, abana n’umubyeyi we ndetse n’abandi bagore bake bamufashaga mu mirimo itandukanye. Ubwo Jenoside yatangiraga, Umwamikazi Gicanda yagiye yishingikiriza Jean Baptiste Habyarimana wari Perefe wa Butare, warwanyije cyane umugambi wo gutsemba Abatutsi. Tariki 17 Mata, Perefe Habyarimana yatawe muri yombi, nyuma aza kwicwa. Umwamikazi Rosalia Gicanda yatangiye guterwa ubwoba ko nawe agiye kwicwa n’umuryango we. Raporo ya Human Rights Watch yasohotse mu 1999, ivuga ko Umwamikazi Gicanda wari ufite imyaka 66 yasabye Joseph Kanyabashi wari Burugumesitiri wa Komini ya Ngoma i Butare kumurinda, undi akabyanga. Tariki 20 Mata ahagana saa tanu z’amanywa , abasirikare bayobowe na Lt Pierre Bizimana binjiye mu rugo rw’umwamikazi Gicanda ku mabwiriza yari yatanzwe na Capt Ildephonse Nizeyimana wari umuyobozi ushinzwe ubutasi n’ibikorwa mu ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare, ESO ubwo Jenoside yakorwaga. Abo basirikare bamaze kwinjira mu rugo rw’umwamikazi, baramufashe we n’abandi bagore batandatu babanaga barabatwara. Muri urwo rugo hasigaye mama wa Gicanda wari ufite imyaka 80 n’undi mukobwa wo kumwitaho. Abasirikare bafashe Gicanda n’abo bari bafatanywe bajyana inyuma y’ingoro y’inzu ndangamurage y’u Rwanda barabarasa, barapfa. Ku gicamunsi abasirikare bagarutse mu rugo rwa Gicanda gusahura, hashize iminsi ibiri baragaruka bica umubyeyi we. Raporo ya Huma Rihgts Watch ivuga ko hari umupadiri wasabye ko umubiri wa Gicanda washyingurwa mu cyubahiro, burugumesitiri Kanyabashi yohereza abagororwa bo kuwujyana bawushyingura hafi y’urugo rwe. Umwe mu baganiriye n’umukobwa wabashije kurokoka witaga ku mubyeyi wa Gicanda, ngo yamubwiye ko mbere y’uko Gicanda n’abo bari kumwe bicwa babanje kuvuga isengesho bishyira mu maboko y’Imana. Muri 2012, urukiko rwashyiriweho u Rwanda rwakatiye Capt Ildephonse Nizeyimana igifungo cya burundu ashinjwa kwica Umwamikazi Gicanda n’abandi batutsi muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Nizeyimana yari yafatiwe muri Uganda mu 2009. Mu 1998 Lt Pierre Bizimana yakatiwe urwo gupfa n’urukiko rwa gisirikare i Kigali ariko icyo gihano kiza guhindurwamo igifungo cya burundu nyuma y’uko u Rwanda rukuyeho igihano cy’urupfu. Umwamikazi wicishaga bugufi, akagira impuhwe Ababanye n’abazi neza Umwamikazi Gicanda, bavuga ko yari umubyeyi wicisha bugufi kandi agakunda abantu bose atarobanuye. Mu buhamya Perezida Paul Kagame yatanze mu 2017 avuga ku mateka y’ubuto bwe kuva afite imyaka ine y’amavuko ubwo yatangiraga ubuzima bw’ubuhunzi, yashimiye na Gicanda nk’umwe mu bamufashije akabasha kurokoka. Ubwo buhamya bugaragara mu nimero 2944 ya Jeune Afrique yasohotse ku wa 11 Kamena 2017, yiswe amabanga y’ubuto [Secrets de Jeunesse] bw’abakuru b’ibihugu barimo Perezida Kagame, Ali Bongo Ondimba, Umwami Mohammed VI wa Maroc na Alpha Condé. Perezida Kagame yasobanuye ko mu 1961 mbere gato y’uko u Rwanda rubona ubwigenge, ubwo yari afite imyaka ine, Abahutu bari batuye ku musozi wa Tambwe bashyigikiwe n’ubuyobozi, bigabije aho umuryango we wari utuye batwika inzu zaho ndetse bagirira nabi Abatutsi. Icyo gihe umubyeyi we yatangiye kumutegura ngo bahunge. Hahise haza imodoka, umushoferi wayo ashyikiriza umubyeyi wa Perezida Kagame ibaruwa ivuga ko atumwe n’Umwamikazi Gicanda wari utuye i Nyanza mu rugendo rw’iminota nka 45 uvuye aho bo bari batuye. Rosalie Gicanda yari amusabye kubahungisha muri ibyo bihe by’amakuba. Perezida Kagame n’abantu bari baturanye binjiye muri iyo modoka mu gihe igihiriri cy’ababahigaga cyaturukaga ku wundi musozi, gihita cyirara mu byo bari batunze. Icyo gihe ngo basanze Umwamikazi i Nyanza, mbere y’uko bafata inzira bakerekeza mu Mutara aho naho ubwicanyi bwabasanze bakabuhungira muri Uganda. Gicanda yavukiye i Rwamagana mu 1928. Yakuze arangwa n’ikinyabupfura ari nabyo byatumye abengukwa n’Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa. Umwamikazi Gicanda aruhukiye i Mwima ya Nyanza ahatabarijwe Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa na Kigeli V Ndahindurwa. Buri mwaka tariki 20 Mata hategurwa gahunda yo kwibuka Umwamikazi Rosalie Gicanda, itegurwa ku bufatanye bw’umuryango we n’ubuyobozi bw’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ingoro Ndangamurage z’u Rwanda.

title: Imyaka 20 irashize Paul Kagame atorewe kuyobora u Rwanda
content: Tariki 17 Mata 2000 nibwo Perezida Kagame yatowe n’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ndetse n’abagize Guverinoma ngo asimbure Pasteur Bizimungu wari umaze ibyumweru bibiri yeguye. Umuryango FPR Inkotanyi niwo wari ufite inshingano zo gushaka Perezida usimbura uwari umaze kwegura, ryitoyemo abakandida babiri bagombaga gushyikirizwa Inteko Ishinga Amategeko y’inzibacyuho kugira ngo itoremo uba Perezida. Mu bakandida batanzwe hari harimo General Major Paul Kagame wari Visi Perezida na Charles Muligande wari Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa FPR Inkotanyi. Mu badepite n’abagize Guverinoma 86 batoye, Gen Maj Paul Kagame yagize amajwi 81, naho Charles Muligande agira amajwi atanu. Inteko Ishinga Amategeko yari igizwe n’abadepite 70 naho Guverinoma igizwe n’abaminisitiri 18. Tito Rutaremara, Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Urwego rw’Igihugu Ngishwanama rw’Inararibonye yabwiye IGIHE ko nta mpungenge bari bafite niba Gen Maj Kagame aremera kuba Perezida, kuko bari bamaze kubimusaba yabyemeye. Ati “Byari byaganiriwe mu nama ya FPR twabimusabye yabyemeye ariko bigomba kunyura mu Nteko kuko na Perezida wundi Inteko niyo yari yamukuyeho.” Perezida Kagame yatorewe kuyobora u Rwanda ari umwuka utari mwiza muri politiki kuko mu mezi atatu yari ashize, uwari Perezida na Minisitiri w’intebe bari bamaze kwegura bashinjwa imikorere mibi. Kuwa 22 Mata 2000 nibwo Perezida Paul Kagame yarahiriye kuba Perezida nyuma yo kwemezwa n’urukiko rw’ikirenga. Yongeye gutorerwa kuba Perezida mu matora rusange yo kuwa 25 Kanama 2003, aho yatsinze ku majwi 95 %. U Rwanda rwari rutegereje kuguma hasi cyangwa kubyuka Perezida Paul Kagame yatowe hashize iminsi mike hasojwe inama ziswe izo mu ‘Rugwiro’, zahuje abanyarwanda b’ingeri zose hakaganirirwamo ahazaza h’igihugu. Ibyavuyemo nibyo byaje kugenderwaho mu cyerecyezo cyiswe ‘2020’. Ibyari bikubiye muri icyo cyerecyezo byasaga n’inzozi ukurikije aho igihugu cyari kiri nyuma y’imyaka itandatu kivuye muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ni igihugu cyifuzaga kumvisha amahanga kurekera aho kukirebera mu ndorerwamo ya Jenoside, ahubwo kigafatwa nk’igihugu cyiteje imbere nk’ibindi bihugu bya Afurika. Tito Rutaremara avuga ko hari hakenewe umuyobozi ufata ibyo byifuzo byose akabihindura ingiro. Ati “Ibyo bitekerezo byashakaga umuntu ubishoboye wabishyira ku murongo. Abo mu Rugwiro baravugaga bati rwose nyuma y’imyaka 20 dukwiriye kuba twarahindutse turi nk’ibindi bihugu byo muri Afurika. Bakavuga bati hazajyeho Leta igendera ku mategeko, abaturage bazegerezwe ubuyobozi, tuzandike amateka y’igihugu cyacu uko akwiriye kumera n’ibindi”. Mu by’ingenzi u Rwanda rwari rukeneye cyane, hari hariho gushyiraho Itegeko Nshinga, kubaka inzego z’ubuyobozi, guteza imbere ubukungu, uburezi, imibereho myiza y’abaturage, ubuzima n’ibindi. Rutaremara avuga ko iyo hataba umuyobozi ushoboye, byari kuguma mu bitekerezo gusa. Ati “Twari tuvuye mu nzibacyuho, tugira Imana tubona umuyobozi mwiza ufite icyerecyezo. Burya biba byiza iyo uvuye mu nzibacyuho ugatangira kubaka neza, ukagira umuyobozi mwiza ubishoboye.” Yakomeje avuga ko mu gutora Perezida Kagame nta mpungenge nyinshi bari bafite, kubera ko bari bamwizeye kandi bakabona nta handi habi u Rwanda rushobora kugera harenze Jenoside yabaye. Ati “Twari twaravuye ahabi nta handi twashoboraga kujya handi. U Rwanda rwageze habi cyane icyari gisigaye ni ukubyuka. Iyo uri hasi nta handi wajya, wenda waguma aho, icyari gisigaye rero ni ukugumayo cyangwa kubyuka. Kubyuka rero kandi bikihuta twagize Imana tubona umuyobozi ubishoboye.” Kubaka u Rwanda nyuma y’umwaka wa 2000 byakozwe mu byiciro. Icyiciro cya mbere cyari kuva mu 2000 kugeza mu 2010 cyarimo gushyiraho amategeko, no kubaka inzego z’ubuyobozi. Ikindi cyari icya 2010 kugeza 2020 cyo kubaka inzego z’ubukungu bw’igihugu no guteza imbere imibereho myiza y’abaturage ku buryo bugaragara. Kugeza ubu u Rwanda rufatwa nka kimwe mu bihugu bike bya Afurika bifite ubukungu buzamuka ku gipimo cyo hejuru, aho kiri ku mpuzandengo ya 7 % buri mwaka uhereye mu 2000. Mu 1990 umusaruro ku muturage ku mwaka wari amadolari 374, mu 1994 yari amadolari 146 mu 2000 yari 225 $. Mu 2010 yari 579 $, mu 2015 yari 728 $, mu 2017 yari 774 $ naho mu 2018 yari 788$ ku mwaka Ingengo y’imari y’igihugu yikubye inshuro 14, mu gihe ingengo y’imari ituruka imbere mu gihugu yo yazamutse inshuro 20 mu myaka 20 ishize.

title: Intwaro z’ingenzi Abanyarwanda bifashishaga mu guhangana n’ibyorezo by’inzara n’indwara
content: Hari ibyorezo bitandukanye byagiye byibasira u Rwanda birimo nk’Indwara z’umuze no gusogobwa byahitanye abatagira ingano mu iyima rya Mutara Semugeshi, hari indwara y’ubushita yateye mu Gisaka ku ngoma ya Mibambwe Sentabyo.  Hari ibindi biza byaje ubwo u Rwanda rwar ruhanganye n’ubukoloni hagati y’umwaka wa 1890 n’uwa 1946. Muri ibyo bihe u Rwanda rwibasiwe n’indwara z’amatungo zirimo uburenge, iragara, muryamo n’amashuya. Hateye kandi indwara z’abantu zirimo Mugiga, ubushita n’ibihara, haza no gutera inzara karundura zahitanye abatagira ingano zirimo Muhatibicumuro, Ruyaga, Rumanura, Gakwege, Rwakayihura na Ruzagayura. N’ubwo ibyo byorezo byazaga bikidegembya, ndetse hakaba n’ibimara iminsi itari mike, ntibyabuzaga ko Abanyarwanda bafata ingamba zo kubitsinda ubutazagaruka. Mu murage wa Gihanga yahaye u Rwanda mu ihangwa ry’igihugu cya Gasabo, yahaye abazamukomokaho n’umuryango mugari w’abenegihugu, umurage ukomeye ugomba kugenga imiyoborere y’igihugu n’imibereho n’imibanire y’Abanyarwanda, mu myaka amagana n’amagana ubwo azaba atakiriho. Imitekerereze- murage ya Gihanga, yabaga inakubiye mu mihango y’ubwiru yakorwaga mu rwego rwo kohera ibiza bizaza mu gihugu. Mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere, bagiraga amahame y’imiyoborere, imibereho n’imibanire akurikira: Gukunda Imana yaremye u Rwanda n’Abanyarwanda, Gukunda u Rwanda nk’umurage ukomeye ugomba kubungabungwa, Gukunda no gukeza umwami cyangwa se kubaha no kumvira ubuyobozi, Kubaha no kurengera ikiremwamuntu n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima no kugendera ku mahame ya za kirazira yo kugira ibyo utinya n’ibyo wubaha. Ayo mahame uko ari 5, niyo ngenderwaho mu kwesa imihigo y’ibyo babaga barahize kugeraho ibihe byose. Muri ayo mahame, ni naho habonekagamo intwaro zikomeye zifashishwaga mu guhangana n’ibiza, ibyorezo by’inzara n’indwara z’abantu n’amatungo. Izo ntwaro zarimo: Gukunda no kuramya umwami: Nubwo iyo mvugo yakoreshwaga ityo mu bihe byo ha mbere, yabaga ishaka kugaragaza ko Abanyarwanda bahawe umurage w’ihame ryo gukunda no kubaha ubuyobozi bwabo. Ibyo bikabarinda amakimbirane yo kurwanira ubuyobozi no kubangamira gahunda za Leta. Iyo ikaba ariyo nkomoko-muzi yo kumvira abayobozi kw’Abanyarwanda, ari nayo mpamvu mu gihe cy’amatora yo kubashyiraho, biba bimeze nk’ubukwe, naho mu yandi mahanga, amatora akaba ari intambara zihitana benshi. Kumvira ubuyobozi kw’Abanyarwanda, kwababereye intwaro idasaza yabafashije guhangana n’ibyorezo bikaze byabaga byarazengereje igihugu. Iyo ubuyobozi bwafatanga ingamba zo kurwanya no kwagiriza ibyo byorezo, abaturage bazakiranaga yombi, bikanaborohera no kuzishyira mu bikorwa, kuko zabaga zatanzwe n’ubuyobozi bakunda. Kugira za kirazira: Mu murage w’Abanyarwanda, batojwe kugira ibyo baziririza, bibafasha kwigengesera mu byo bakora, no kugira ubushishozi bubatoza kudakora iki cyangwa se kiriya. Izo za kirazira, nizo zabafashije guhangana n’ibyorezo byadukaga mu gihugu, kuko babibonaga nk’ibizira bigomba kwirindwa, bakabirwanya bivuye inyuma.

title: Kurara imbere ku mugabo, ivure ku mugore: Ingingo y’umuco itavugwaho rumwe
content: Hamwe muhabyukiye izi mpaka ni ku rubuga nkoranyambaga rwa Twitter aho uwitwa Iliza Nelly yabajije abamukurikira uwabwiye abagabo ko aribo bagomba kuryama imbere. Ese ninde wambwiye abagabo ko bagomba kuryama imbere bataryama inyuma kugikuta?😂🤷🏿♀️ — Iliza Nelly (@ilizanina) April 15, 2020 Iki kibazo cya Iliza cyakuruye impaka mu bamukurikira,ibintu byagaragazwaga n’ibisubizo batangaga. Bamwe bavuze ko umugabo agomba kuryama imbere kugira ngo arinde umutekano ndetse abe yiteguye guhangana n’uwabatera. Mu bashyigikiye iki gitekerezo harimo Danny wagize ati “Ikindi ni uko umugabo ari umutware w’urugo iyo hagize igitera urugo ahita ajya kurwana ngo atabare urugo kandi umugore we ahita yirukira ku rukuta yihisha” Ikindi nuko umugabo arumutware wurugo iyo hagize igitera urugo ahita ajya gukora fight ngo atabare urugo kdi umugore we ahita yirukira kurukuta yihisha✍️ — Danny (@dannyha2020) April 15, 2020 Azzah we yagize ati “Ni ukugira ngo bacunge umutekano w’urugo.” Nukugir bacunge umutekano w urugo🤷🏾♂️ — AZ ZAH (@AZZAH20161) April 15, 2020 Uretse aba bavuga ko umugabo aryama imbere kubera impamvu zo kurinda umutekano w’urugo, abandi barimo Nsanzurwanda Leandre bagaragaje ko biterwa ahanini n’uko abagore bakunze kuryama mbere y’abagabo. Ati “Buri igihe abagabo baryama nyuma y’abagore.” Uwitwa Icyeza we agaragaza ko afite inzozi zo kuryama imbere “ Nanjye njya mbyibaza?? Gusa numva rimwe nzaryama imbere nkumva icyo ambwira.” Nanjye jya byibaza ?? Gusa numva rimwe nzaryama imbere nkumva icyo ambwira 😂😂😂 — Y A K A 🍻 (@BIcyeza) April 15, 2020 Ku bandi barimo Innocent bagaragaje ko byose bishingira ku myumvire ko ubu yaba umugore cyangwa umugore buri wese yaryama aho ashaka. Ati“Iyo niyo yari imyumvire yanjye mbere...aho ariho hose waharyama.” That was myth before...ahariho hose waharyama — Viboyinnocent (@Viboyinnocent1) April 15, 2020 Umwe mu bagore bubatse waganiriye na IGIHE ariko ntiyifuze ko amazina ye ajya hanze, yavuze ari uburyo bwo gupfobya ubushobozi bw’abagore hitwajwe kubarindira umutekano. Yagize ati “Icyo gitekerezo abakizanye sinzi icyo bari bagamije ariko njye kuri ubu mbona ari ukudupfobya, kuki twe tutaryama imbere nk’abagabo, ibyo bavuga ngo baba bagira ngo igikomye babe aba mbere gutabara natwe twabikora.” Uyu mugore asanga hakwiye kubaho ubwumvikane hagati y’umugabo n’umugore buri wese akaryama ahamunogeye ndetse yumva yishimiye. Impuguke mu muco n’amateka by’u Rwanda, Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, avuga ko uyu mugenzo wari ufite agaciro gakomeye mu muco Nyarwanda kuko wagaragaza ihame rya ‘umbere inyuma nkubere imbere aho “mu gihe umugabo ari kurwana n’ibikomeye umugore akaba ari guhisha abana cyangwa abacisha mu cyanzu ngo bahunge. Ati “Mu gihe umugabo ari kwakira abashyitsi ku irembo, umugore akaba atunganya mu ruganiriro.” Nsanzabera avuga ko uku kuryama imbere ku mugabo bituruka ku nshingano ahabwa n’umuco nyarwanda zo kubungabunga umutekano w’urugo. Mu muco Nyarwanda umugabo wararaga ivure yagaragaraga nk’umunyabwoba ndetse agafatwa nk’ikigwari gitinya kujya aho rukomeye.

title: RALC yakebuye abanena Ikinyarwanda ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, ibyita ‘ubujiji’
content: Muri iyi minsi y’ikoranabuhanga, imbuga nkoranyambaga zabaye urubuga rukomeye rutangirwamo ibitekerezo, aho abantu bagaragariza amarangamutima yabo, ibibababaje, ibibashimishije n’ibindi. Kubera ko akenshi izo mbuga ziba zarakozwe n’abanyamahanga, indimi zikoreshwaho zikunze kuba ari iz’amahanga nubwo nta we ubuza abavuga cyangwa abandika indimi gakondo kuzikoreshaho. Hari bamwe bumva ko kwandika ubutumwa mu rurimi rw’Icyongereza ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ari bwo busirimu, aribwo abantu bakubaha naho kubwandika mu Kinyarwanda bikaba ubuturage. Umuyobozi w’Ishami ry’Ururimi muri RALC, Nsanzabaganwa Modeste, yabwiye IGIHE ko abatekereza gutyo baba bafite ubujiji no gushaka kwigaragaza uko batari. Ati “Iyo wiyerekana uko uri , si kimwe n’iyo wiyerekana wambaye isura y’undi muntu. Uri umunyarwanda ushaka kugaragara nk’umunyarwanda, ushaka gutanga ibitekerezo nk’umunyarwanda, ubivuze mu rurimi rwawe rero rw’Ikinyarwanda nibyo byiza ni nabyo bikuranga. Ni nabwo ushobora gutanga igitekerezo neza uko ugitekereza.” “Ntabwo wajya guha abaturage ikiganiro ku kintu, uri gitifu ngo ugende wambaye ikanzu ya padiri, ntibihuye. Barakubonamo Padiri ntabwo bakubonamo gitifu.” Nsanzabaganwa yavuze ko bitumvikana uburyo wasimbuka abaturage bagera kuri miliyoni 12 bumva Ikinyarwanda ari nabo bagenewe ibyo wanditse ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, ngo ubyandike mu Cyongereza kitumvwa n’abanyarwanda bose. Ati “Harimo ubwirasi, tujye tuvuga ibintu uko bimeze. Kuvuga ngo njye ndakoresha Icyongereza, kuki usimbuka abanyarwanda? Urasimbuka miliyoni 12 z’abanyarwanda ukajya kubwira noneho abantu batagera kuri miliyoni bavuga Icyongereza, ubwo urumva ukora ibiki?” Yongeyeho ati “Kumva ko uzagira agaciro ari uko uvuze ururimi rutari Ikinyarwanda, aho ndahagaya cyane harimo n’ubujiji. Kumva ko uboneka neza uhunga kuba umunyarwanda, ko uzagira agaciro kuko wahunze kuba umunyarwanda, ni ikibazo gikomeye.” U Rwanda rurajwe ishinga no guteza imbere ibyakorewe mu Rwanda (Made in Rwanda ) kugira ngo rukomeze kugira agaciro mu ruhando mpuzamahanga. Nsanzabaganwa avuga ko Made in Rwanda ya mbere ari ukuvuga Ikinyarwanda ibindi bikubakiraho, kuko ari rwo rurimi ruhuza abanyarwanda runakubiyemo indangagaciro zabo zose. Kuri iyo ngingo, hari na bamwe mu banyarwanda bagiye bagaragaza ko badashyigikiye abahunga Ikinyarwanda, bagakoresha indimi z’amahanga ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ngo bubahwe. Ku nyandiko RALC yacishije kuri Twitter kuwa 17 Werurwe 2020 ivuga ko nta busirimu buri mu kutavuga Ikinyarwanda, uwitwa Ndagimijamana Emmanuel yatanze igitekerezo agira ati “Ibi nibyo nirirwa buri gihe ndwana nabyo kuri WatsApp Status za bamwe mu nshuti zanjye ariko bamwe barumva abandi ntibabyumva." Undi yagize ati “Ibi ndabihamya gusa imbogamizi ni imwe, urubyiruko ruri kubyiruka ntabwo ruzi Ikinyarwanda kandi ntirushishikajwe kukimenya nk’ururimi ruhuza bene kanyarwanda, ahubwo barufata nk’ururimi rwiyongera mu zivugwa bityo bagaha agaciro indimi mvamahanga.” RALC ivuga ko Ikinyarwanda kivugwa n’umubare munini w’abatuye Isi, kugera kuri miliyoni 36 z’abatuye mu Karere k’Ibiyaga Bigari. Mu Rwanda, 93 % by’abaturage bavuga Ikinyarwanda.

title: Uko ubuhanzi nyarwanda bwakoreshejwe mu gucengeza amacakubiri yagejeje kuri Jenoside
content: Abahanzi bamwe na bamwe babaye igikoresho cya Leta mu gucengeza amacakubiri no kubiba urwango rwa Jenoside yahitanye Abatutsi bagera kuri 1.074.017. Umuco bawuhindura ico, ushakirwamo ubuhanga n’ubumenyi bwo gucengeza amacakubiri. Bitewe nuko Abahanzi ari bamwe mu bifashishwa mu gutanga ubutumwa bukagera kuri benshi, no mu gucengeza amacakubiri barifashishijwe. Twagerageje gushaka bamwe mu bahanzi n’indirimbo bahimbye zifashishijwe mu gucamo ibice abanyarwanda no gushishikariza abahutu kwanga abatutsi. Chorale Abanyuramatwi Chorale Abanyuramatwi y’i Gitarama yari izwi cyane kubera ubuhanga bwari mu ndirimbo zabo, abenshi muri bo bari barize mu Iseminari bazi guhimba no gucuranga injyana ya muzika. Uwari umuyobozi wabo ni Michel HABARUREMA. Abanyuramatwi bakwije ingengabitekerezo y’urwango na Jenoside bakoresheje indirimbo nyinshi zanyuzwaga kuri Radio Rwanda no mu bitaramo. Nibo baririmbye indirimbo yubahiriza igihugu ya mbere “Rwanda Rwacu”. Zimwe mu ndirimbo z’Abanyuramatwi zatwitse igihugu zirimo “Jya mbere Rwanda” aho Umututsi yitirirwaga kuba nk’Umukoroni, Umunyamahanga, Umwanzi w’u Rwanda, Gashakabuhake,... Amwe mu magambo y’iyo ndirimbo hari aho bagize bati “U Rwanda rwari rute? Kazungu na Gatutsi bari bararumize.” Nibo kandi bahimbye indirimbo “Turatsinze” ivuga ko Rwanda rubonye bene rwo Gahutu akwiye kuganza. Mu ndirimbo yabo “ Ibigwi by’Abaparmehutu” bashimira Abahutu kuba baratsinze, bakaba baharanira inyungu za Gahutu. Ikintu kibi gikomeye muri iyi ndirimbo nuko nta jambo Umunyarwanda ririmo. Icyari gishishikaje Abanyarumatwi ni imibereho myiza y’Abahutu n’ikandamizwa ry’Abatutsi. Abanyuramatwi bigishije mu ndirimbo zabo ko Igihugu n’ibyacyo ari icy’Abahutu. Niwo murongo indirimbo zabo zagendeyeho. Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994 yaje isoza ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’iyo ngengabitekerezo yakwijwe mu Rwanda kuva kera. Umuhanzi Simon Bikindi Simoni Bikindi ni Umuhanzi akaba n’umunyaporitiki ukomeye wari mu Ishyaka rya MRND. Bikindi yavutse tariki 28 Ukwakira 1954 avukira muri Komini Rwerere ku Gisenyi, ubu ni mu Karere ka Rubavu. Bikindi yari umuntu umwe mu bavugaga rikijyana kuri Leta ya Perezida Habyarimana bitewe n’uko yari umuntu wa hafi wa Perezida. Muri 1994 yakoraga muri Minisiteri y’urubyiruko n’amashyirahamwe (MIJEUMA) akaba yarayoboraga Itorero ryitwaga Irindiro. Abinyujije mu buhanzi bwe, yagize uruhare runini mu gushishikariza Abahutu gutsemba Abatutsi. Indirimbo za Bikindi zakoreshejwe cyane n’amashyaka ya poritiki MRND na CDR n’andi yari ahuriye mu cyitwaga HUTU POWER mu gutegura no gushyira mu bikorwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri Mata 1994. Indirimbo “Twasezereye ingoma ya Cyami” yahimbwe mu wa 1987, u Rwanda rwibuka imyaka 25 y’ubwigenge. Ni indirimbo yerekana ko icyiswe ingoma ya cyami nta kiza na kimwe yamariye u Rwanda, nyamara u Rwanda rwaguwe n’abami, ni nabo baruremye batanga igihe cyabo bizirika umukanda mu gihe kingana n’imyaka 221 [1091-1312] bashyiraho inkingi za mwamba ruzubakirwaho rukaba igihugu gihamye ubwo bazaba batakiriho. Abami Bikindi yamaganaga, nibo bubatse u Rwanda ruhamya igitinyiro hagati y’amahanga aruzengurutse, bararwagura ruba rugari. Byafashe igihe kitari gito kugira ngo uwo mugambi wo kurwagura ugerweho, ukurikije ibirari by’amateka urugamba rwo kubaka igihugu no kucyagura, abami b’u Rwanda bawakuranweho mu gihe kingana n’imyaka 583[1312-1895]. Ntawafata ibibazo n’akaga k’ubwicanyi u Rwanda rwahuye nabyo ngo abyitirire abami yiyibagije ububi bw’Abakoroni, PARMEHUTU na MRND.  Ikindi kandi, umuntu nka Bikindi wari warize akaminuza, byongeye w’umuyobozi mu gihugu, ntiyari akwiriye gupfobya bigeze hariya Abakurambere mpangarwanda bakuturanyije bakarema igihugu kikabaho none akaba yari akiganjemo nk’umuyobozi, ajaramye mu byo baruhiye, asoroma ku mbuto z’umuruho wabo kandi bo batakiriho. Indirimbo “Akabyutso” izwi cyane ku izina rya “Nanga Abahutu” yahimbwe muri 1992. Bikindi yakanguriraga Abahutu kwishyira hamwe bakarwanya Abatutsi kuko aribo mwanzi ubahuje. Bikindi avuga ko yanga Abahutu b’inda ndende banga abandi Bahutu, ko Abahutu bose bagomba guhuriza ku mugambi umwe wo kwanga Abatutsi. Muri rusange iyi ndirimbo irahamagarira ubumwe bw’Abahutu mu kurwanya Umututsi iyo ava akagera. Bikindi anibasira Abahutu barwanya ingengabitekerezo ya jenoside, cyane cyane abari bari mu mashyaka ataravugaga rumwe n’ubutegetsi bw’ibyob bihe, nibo ashinja ko bahawe igiceri ngo bice abandi Bahutu. Indirimbo nk’iyi yaterega Interahamwe akanyabugabo zikumva ko kwishyira hamwe no kwica bagakora jenoside ari umurimo mwiza ku Muhutu wese. Indirimbo ya gatatu ni iyiswe “Impuruza” izwi ku izina rya “Bene Sebahinzi” nayo yahimbwe muri 1992 ikaba itanga ubutumwa bw’ubumwe bw’Abahutu mu mugambi wo kwanga Abatutsi. Muri iyi ndirimbo, Bikindi aririmba Intara zose ze kera zari zigize u Rwanda, akavuga ko hose yahageze agasanga bahujwe n’agahinda ko kuba hari umwanzi wabateye ushaka kubamara, ariko Abahutu bakaba batabyumva, bakaba bagomba gutabarwa no kurindwa ko bamarana. Uwo mwanzi niwe Bikindi yita INTERANYABAGABO. Iyi ndirimbo igaragaza agahinda Bikindi yatewe nuko ngo Abahutu basa nk’abataye ubwenge, ngo bariho baramarana kandi bagombye gushyira hamwe no kumvikana bakarwanya umwanzi umwe bahuriyeho ariwe Ikontanyi. Iyo bavugaga Inkotanyi byabaga bivuga Umututsi. Iyi ndirimbo Bikindi yayihimbye mu gihe Abatutsi bicwaga Bugesera. Izi ndirimbo zanyuzwaga kuri Radio Rwanda no kuri RTLM.  Ku itariki 02 Ukwakira 2008, Urukiko mpuzamahanga (TPIR) rwakatiye Bikindi igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu rumaze kumuhamya icyaha cyo gukangurira Abahutu gutsemba Abatutsi. Ng’uko uko umuco mwiza w’u Rwanda, ubuhanzi bw’ibinyurabwenge n’ibinyuramatwi byanyuzwagamo iyerekwa ry’Abanyarwanda, bwifashishijwe mu gucengeza amacakubiri yo kurimbura Abatutsi batagira ingano.

title: Uko Kofi Annan yasuye u Rwanda mu 1998, abayobozi bakuru bose bakanga kumwakira
content: Uruzinduko rw’iminsi itatu yagiriye mu Rwanda rwamubereye agahomamunwa, atahana ipfunwe. Ibikomere byari bikivirirana haba mu mutima no ku mibiri. Icyo gihe kuri lisiti y’abantu Abanyarwanda batari bishimiye, Kofi Annan yari mu ba mbere. Impamvu ni uko ubwo Abatutsi bicwaga hakabura gitabara Annan ari we wari ukuriye ibikorwa byo kugarura amahoro ku Isi muri Loni. Ingabo za MINUAR ubwo zahambiraga utwazo zigasiga Abatutsi ku Kicukiro mu maboko y’Interahamwe, Annan ni umwe mu bafashe icyemezo bashize amanga cyo kugenda kwazo, abo zatereranye basigara bicwa uruhondogo. Kofi Annan yari umugabo ucisha make, wiyoroshya cyane mu mvugo ndetse wari wubashywe ku rwego mpuzamahanga biri no mu byamuhesheje kuyobora Loni. Umurage we wononwe n’icyasha yiteye kubera kutagira icyo akora ngo ahagarike Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi n’ubwicanyi bwakorewe muri Bosnia na Herzegovina. Annan yaje mu Rwanda yumva ari nka rumwe mu ngendo nyinshi yakoreraga hirya no hino ku Isi, yumva ari bukoreshe amagambo asize umunyu amwe y’abanyapolitiki ariko Abanyarwanda bamubera ibamba. Muri urwo ruzinduko rw’iminsi itatu, yabanje guhagamwa n’abadepite mu Nteko, avuyeyo umugoroba wo kumwakira ku meza abayobozi bakuru mu Rwanda barimo Perezida, Visi Perezida na Minisitiri w’Intebe birangira batawitabiriye, mu gitondo agiye guhura n’abacitse ku icumu banga kumwitaba. Umunsi wa mbere wamubereye ihurizo Kofi Annan yageze mu Rwanda kuwa Gatatu tariki 6 Gicurasi 1998. Yaje nyuma y’igitutu amahanga yashyiraga kuri Loni, agaragaza ko ntacyo yakoze ngo itabare Abatutsi bicwaga mu Rwanda kandi byari mu bushobozi bwayo. Yageze mu Rwanda hashize iminsi ibiri ikinyamakuru The New Yorker cyanditse inkuru icukumbuye, yagaragazaga uburyo tariki 11 Mutarama 1994 hari ubutumwa Major General Roméo Dallaire wari ukuriye ingabo za Loni mu Rwanda, yandikiye Kofi Annan n’abandi bari bamukuriye abamenyesha ko Leta ya Habyarimana iri gutegura Jenoside ariko ntibabihe agaciro. Ngo ayo makuru Major General Roméo Dallaire yari yayahawe n’umuntu wamuhaga amakuru y’imbere muri Leta, wahoze ari mu bashinzwe umutekano wa Habyarimana. Uwo muntu ajya kumenera ibanga Dallaire, ngo yari yasabwe n’ishyaka rya Habyarimana gukora urutonde rw’Abatutsi no gutoza Interahamwe zari bwice Abatutsi bari baruriho. Inkuru ya The New Yorker yaciye igikuba muri Loni, iza habura umunsi umwe ngo Kofi Annan ahaguruke aze mu maso y’abo ashinjwa kwanga gutabara. Loni yamaganye ayo makuru ariko ntibyagira icyo bitanga kuko abayatanze banafotoye Fax Dallaire yohereje muri Loni bakanga kumwumva. Mu Rwanda naho abayobozi basaga nk’abadashishikajwe n’uruzinduko rwa Kofi Annan ndetse hari umuyobozi umwe wabwiye The New Yorker, ati“Abantu benshi mu gihugu cyanjye ntabwo bishimiye Annan. Niwe wari ukuriye ibijyanye n’ubutumwa bw’amahoro muri Loni kandi ingabo za Loni nizo zatumye Jenoside ikomeza. Mumureke ariko aze azabyiyumvire imbonankubone.” Umunsi wa mbere Annan yari amaze kwibonera akababaro k’Abanyarwanda. Ku gicamunsi cy’umunsi yagereyeho mu Rwanda yagiye mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, abadepite bamwima agahenge. Ubwo Ibiro Ntaramakuru by’Abanya-Canada [ntibikiri iby’Abongereza], Reuters byandikaga ku ruzinduko rwa Annan mu Rwanda, byagize biti “Annan yeretswe uburakari mu ruhame na Minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga, yibasirwa n’abadepite, asananirwa n’abayobozi bakuru b’igihugu, yimwa amatwi n’abarokotse Jenoside.” Mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, Annan wari kumwe n’umufasha we, abadepite bakomezaga kumwibutsa ko afite uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yabyanga yabyemera. Nyuma yo kubona ko atishimiwe, Annan ntibyamuciye intege yarakomeje ageza ku badepite ijambo ry’umunsi yari yateguye ari naryo ryasembuye uburakari kurushaho. Mbere yo gutangira ijambo rye, yagize ati “Ntabwo naje hano kujya mu mpaka kandi muzi ko hari umugani uvuga ngo umushyitsi buri gihe ahora ari imbohe y’umusangwa.” Muri iryo jambo rye, yavuze ko icyamuzanye mu Rwanda ari ukomora ibikomere n’amacakubiri byari bigishegeshe igihugu ndetse no kwizeza ubufasha bw’Umuryango w’Abibumbye mu gushakira u Rwanda amahoro n’iterambere. Annan yavuze ko ibyabaye ari “Amakuba yaturutse imbere, akukumba imiryango. Ni amakuba yasigiye abarokotse ihungabana ritavugwa.” Yakomeje agira ati “Turemera ko Isi yatereranye u Rwanda mu gihe ikibi cyari kirwugarije. Isi ikwiriye kwihana ntizongere gutsindwa gutya. Ubu noneho tuzi ko ibyo twakoze bitari bihagije mu gutabara u Rwanda, ntabwo twahesheje agaciro amahame yatumye Loni ishingwa.” Mu ijambo ryose yavuze, ntaho Kofi Annan yigeze agaragaza uruhare rwe mu kudatabara u Rwanda nk’uwari uhagarariye ibikorwa byo kugarura amahoro muri Loni. Ntacyo yavuze ku nkuru ya The New Yorker yari imaze kumushinja kwirengagiza ibyabaga mu Rwanda kandi yarabibwiwe. Kofi Annan yavuze ko kudatabarwa k’u Rwanda byatewe n’ubushake buke bwa politiki mpuzamahanga, aho kuba Loni ubwayo. Ijambo yavugiye mu nteko ryasubije ibintu irudubi! Yarinze ava mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko uwo mugoroba abadepite batanyuzwe. Ijambo yavugiye mu Nteko ryo ryasubije ibintu irudubi. Abari biteze ko nibura asaba imbabazi basubije amerwe mu isaho. Uretse kudasaba imbabazi, yari yongereyeho ikindi ko Jenoside ari ‘Amakuba yaturutse imbere’, bivuze ko ari ibyago Abanyarwanda biteye, nta ruhare rw’amahanga. Ubuyobozi bw’u Rwanda bwatangiye gushinja Kofi Annan ubwirasi agihari, anagayirwa kutava ku izima ngo asabe imbabazi. Ni uruzinduko rwaranzwe ahanini n’ibimenyetso bikomeye bigaragaza uburyo u Rwanda rutari rwiteguye kwakira Kofi Annan utari busabe imbabazi ku bw’uruhare rwe muri Jenoside. Iburizwamo ry’umuhango wo kwakirwa ku meza n’uwari Perezida wa Repubulika, Visi Perezida na Minisitiri w’Intebe ryatunguye benshi icyo gihe. Uwari Umuvugizi wa Guverinoma, Joseph Bideri yabwiye Reuters ko babikoze bashaka kwamagana ‘ubwirasi’ buri mu ijambo Kofi Annan yagejeje ku Nteko Ishinga Amategeko. Bukeye tariki 7 Gicurasi, Kofi Annan yagombaga kuganira n’itsinda ry’abarokotse Jenoside kuri ETO Kicukiro ariko ubwo abari bamuherekeje bahageraga nta muntu n’umwe bahasanze. Ntabwo icyatumye abarokotse Jenoside batahagera cyatangajwe ariko cyari ikindi kimenyetso cy’uko ijambo rye mu Nteko ryari ryagawe bikomeye. Kofi Annan amaze kubura abantu kuri ETO Kicukiro, yakomeje urugendo ajya ku rwibutso rwa Nyanza ya Kicukiro. Aho ku rwibutso yashyize indabo ku mva, atemberezwa mu nzu y’amabati yari irimo imibiri y’abazize Jenoside itarashyingurwa mu cyubahiro. Imbere y’abarokotse Jenoside i Nyanza yemeye ko ‘iyo baza guha Dallaire ingabo zihagije, aba yaratabaye abicwaga.” Mbere yo kuva mu Rwanda yerekeza muri Uganda, Kofi Annan abanyamakuru bamubajije uko yakiriye uburakari Abanyarwanda bamugaragarije, avuga ko yabiganiriye n’abayobozi b’u Rwanda bakiyunga. Yavuze ko Abanyarwanda bamugejejeho ibibazo bafite, kandi ko byerekeye Loni muri rusange aho kuba we ku giti cye. Ibinyamakuru bitandukanye byanditse ko uruzinduko rwa Annan mu Rwanda ari rumwe mu zamukojeje isoni mu buzima bwe muri Loni ndetse ko rwahinduye uburyo Loni yafataga imyanzuro ku bibazo bihari. Tariki 7 Mata 2004 ubwo hibukwaga imyaka 10 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ibaye, Kofi Annan yarashyize asaba imbabazi za Loni nawe ubwe ku giti cye kuko batatabaye Abanyarwanda. Yagize ati “Njye ubwanjye nk’uwari umuyobozi w’ishami rya Loni rishinzwe kugarura amahoro ku isi, nasunitse ibihugu byinshi ngo bitange ingabo. Nyuma ya Jenoside naje kubona ko hari ibindi nashoboraga gukora. Uru rwibutso rubi rwatwaje imitekerereze yanjye n’imyanzuro mfata nk’Umunyamabanga Mukuru.” Isomo ry’ikimwaro yatewe no kudatabara muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ryakomeje gutuma Kofi Annan yigengesera cyane. Mu 2012 yeguye ku mwanya w’intumwa idasanzwe mu gushakira umuti intambara yo muri Syria. Ngo uwanga amazimwe abandwa habona! Kofi Annan yavuze ku mugaragaro ko yatabaje akanama ka Loni gashinzwe umutekano n’umuryango mpuzamahanga bakamwima amatwi, ahitamo kwegura. Ku myaka 80, tariki 18 Kanama 2018 nibwo hamenyekanye inkuru y’urupfu rwa Kofi Annan.

title: Ibitabo by’abana byanditse mu Kinyarwanda byatangiye gushyirwa kuri internet ku buntu
content: Hashize iminsi Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ifashe ingamba zirimo gusubiza abanyeshuri mu miryango yabo hirindwa ikwirakwizwa ry’icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Perdua Publishers, Uwera Perpétue, yabwiye IGIHE ko batangiye gushyira ibitabo byabo kuri internet mu rwego rwo gufasha abanyeshuri biga mu mashuri y’incuke n’abanza. Yagize ati “Kubera iki kibazo gituma abana batari ku ishuri, twatekereje uburyo twabafasha kubona ibitabo ku buryo ababyeyi bashobora kubibasomera. Ni ukugira ngo mu gihe bari mu rugo batarambirwa, baniyungura ubwenge kuko mu bitabo abana bigiramo ubumenyi bwinshi.” Ku rubuga rwabo Www.perduap.com batangiye bashyiraho ibitabo icumi birimo inkuru z’abana, icyenda byanditse mu rurimi rw’Ikinyarwanda na kimwe kiri mu Cyongereza. Uwera yavuze ko nk’abana bataramenya gusoma, ababyeyi babo bashobora kubafasha babasomera ndetse n’abazi gusoma badafite mudasobwa cyangwa telefoni zigezweho, ababyeyi bakabafasha. Inzu yandika isohora ibitabo by’abana, Sankofa Creatives Ltd nayo yatangiye gushyira kuri internet ibitabo by’abana ku buntu ibicishije ku rukuta rwayo rwa Facebook, rwitwa Sankofa Creatives Ltd. Uwacu Karekezi Martine ukuriye Sankofa Creative Ltd, yabwiye IGIHE ko icyo bifuza ari ugufasha abana bari mu rugo iwabo kutarambirwa, basoma ibitabo bibafasha kwiyungura ubwenge. Minisiteri y’Uburezi iherutse gutangiza uburyo butandukanye buzafasha abana bari mu ngo iwabo gukomeza gusubiramo amasomo bifashishije internet, radio na televiziyo. Inzu y’ibitabo by’Abana ya Editions Bakame nayo yatangije ikiganiro kuri Televiziyo Rwanda cyiswe ’Dusome" gitambuka buri munsi kuva ku wa Mbere kugeza ku wa Gatanu saa tatu n’igice za mu gitondo. Muri icyo kiganiro hasomwa ibitabo by’abana byanditswe na Editions Bakame. Uwera yashishikarije n’izindi nzu zandika ibitabo by’abana korohereza abari mu ngo, babagezaho ibitabo mu buryo bworoshye. Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Uburezi (REB) giherutse gushishikariza abanyeshuri bari mu ngo iwabo gukoresha urubuga elearning.reb.rw rubonekaho incamake ya buri somo mu yigishwa mu mashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye, iby’ingenzi birimo n’aho umunyeshuri yakura ibirambuye kuri iryo somo. Haba hariho kandi ibindi bimufasha kurushaho gusobanukirwa nk’amafoto n’amashusho ndetse n’ibibazo byatuma umunyeshuri yisuzuma. Urubuga rwa REB (Www.reb.rw) narwo rubonekaho ibitabo by’amasomo atandukanye bikoreshwa mu mashuri yo mu Rwanda.

title: Byinshi kuri Ruzagayura, inzara yashegeshe u Rwanda igahitana abasaga ibihumbi 300
content: Iyo inzara yatangiye ahagana mu Ukwakira 1942, itewe n’amapfa yamaze imyaka ibiri. Ayo mapfa yatangiye muri Nzeri 1941, yongera kubaho nyuma gato y’itumba ryo mu 1942. Igitabo “Imizi y’u Rwanda” cy’Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, kigaragaza ko iyo nzara yenyegejwe yatewe n’igabanyuka ry’ibiribwa ryaturutse ku ndwara y’ibirayi bita “mildiou/mildew”, ndetse no ku ndwara y’ibishyimbo bita “chortophila”. N’ibijumba muri ibyo bihe byari byibasiwe n’indwara bita “rhizoctonia/rhizoctonie”. Inzara ya Ruzagayura yongerewe ubukana kandi n’intambara ya kabiri y’isi yose, ndetse n’uko icyo gihe Abanyarwanda bagombaga guha umusanzu abakoroni b’Ababiligi bari bahanganye n’ingabo za Adolf Hitler mu ntambara ya kabiri y’isi yose . Uwo musanzu wari ugizwe n’ibiribwa n’amatungo. Icyo gihe imbuto gakondo z’Abanyarwanda, ari nazo zari zishoboye guhangana n’ibihe n’uburwayi bw’ibihingwa, zari zimaze gucika, bazisimbuje ibirayi, imyumbati, soya n’ibindi. Abanyarwanda batangaga inka, ibishyimbo, amasaka, amashaza byo kugaburira abasirikare b’abanyekongo ndetse n’abakozi bo mu birombe byo muri Congo.
