Guverinoma yihaye intego ko mu 2024 inyungu u Rwanda ruvana mu bukerarugendo izagera kuri miliyoni $800 zivuye kuri miliyoni $404 yinjiye mu 2017. title: Nyamasheke:Bishimiye ibyiza bakomeje kugezwaho nyuma yo kureka ibyangiza ishyamba rya Nyungwe
content: Ibi babigarutseho kuri uyu wa Gatandatu nyuma y’igikorwa cyo gusiganwa ku maguru cyabereye mu ishyamba rya Nyungwe cyateguwe ku bufatanye bw’ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe iterambere RDB, akarere ka Nyamasheke ndetse n’abikorera. Mbere wasangaga abaturiye Pariki ya Nyungwe batunzwe no guhiga inyamanswa, gutwika amakara no gutema ibiti muri iri shyamba. Kuri ubu ngo siko bikimeze kuko aho batangiye kwitabwaho bakubakirwa ibikorwa remezo biva mu musaruro w’amafaranga ava mu bukerarugendo, amakoperative yabo agatezwa imbere ngo ubuzima bwarahindutse kuburyo bafata iya mbere mu guhashya ba rushimusi. Ntirenganya Sylver yagize ati “Kugira ngo utijandika mu bikorwa byo kwangiza ishyamba hari ibikorwa bigomba kuguhuza birimo kubona imyidagaduro nk’iyi kandi urabona ko cyatumye tunezerwa kandi abakora ubucuruzi bacuruje n’abafite ibikorwa by’umuco bungutse. Uyu ni umwanya wo gukangurira abantu kubungabunga ibidukikije.” Munganyinka Esther ati “Iki gikorwa ni kiza cyaje gikenewe kubera ko iyo abakerarugendo baje batugana mu gihugu cyacu tubona bidususurutsa. Mbere twarashimutaga ariko ibikorwa nk’ibi biradufasha cyane bikaduhuza. Nkanjye nkora ubukorikori bushingiye ku mateka.” Umuyobozi w’akarere ka Nyamasheke, Mukamasabo Apollonie yavuze ko icyo gikorwa kibafasha kwerekana ibyiza bya Nyungwe kandi kikaba igikorwa cyo gushishikariza abaturage kureka ubushimusi. Ati “iki gikorwa giha isura nziza abaturage bacu iyo turi kubereka ko ari igikorwa gishobora kuzana abashoramari mu karere kacu bituma n’umuturage wacu avuga ko ya nyamanswa izana umushoramari akinjiza amadovize bigatuma adashobora kuyigirira nabi cyangwa ngo abe yayica. Ibi nabyo biri gutuma abaturage babona za nyamanswa ko zibafitiye akamaro.” Abasiganwe bari biganjemo abanyamahanga n’Abanyarwanda bahagurukiye ku Kitabi mu karere ka Nyamagabe, abandi baturuka Pindura (hagati muri Nyungwe), abandi bava Kamiranzovu biruka n’amaguru, bose basoreza mu marembo asohoka muri Pariki ya Nyungwe mu karere ka Nyamasheke. Abasoganywe bose bambitswe imidari kuko iri rushanwa ryari rigamije gukora siporo mu rwego rwo kugira ubuzima bwiza, kwerekana ibyiza bya Nyungwe no gushishikariza abaturiye Pariki kuyibungabunga.

title: Perezida Kagame yafunguye “One&Only Gorilla’s Nest”, hoteli yuzuye itwaye miliyoni 65 z’amadolari
content: Iyi hoteli yuzuye umwaka ushize itwaye miliyoni 65 z’amadolari ya Amerika nyuma y’imyaka ibiri yubakwa. Ifite ibyumba 21 biri mu byiciro bine, icya mbere gifite ibyumba 10, igikurikiraho gifite ibyumba bine, ikindi bitanu naho icya nyuma kikagira ibyumba bibiri. Uko bikurikirana, ni nako bitandukanye mu biciro, mu bunini no mu bwiza. Bitatse mu buryo bwa Kinyarwanda hakoreshejwe imigongo, hakabamo n’ibindi bikoresho by’ubugeni. Perezida Kagame na Madamu Jeannette Kagame nibo bitabiriye umuhango wo kuyifungura ku mugaragaro wabaye kuri uyu wa Kane. Witabiriwe na Mohammed Ibrahim Al Shaibani, ukuriye “Kerzner International” igenzura amahoteli ya One&Only. Perezida Kagame yashimye iri shoramari, avuga ko ribereye u Rwanda n’inshuti zarwo zarigizemo uruhare zo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Abarabu i Dubai. Ati “Ndashaka kubashimira ku ishoramari ryanyu mwakoze hamwe natwe. Dufite inshingano zo guharanira ko twese twungukira muri iri shoramari.” Yavuze ko iri shoramari riri ku rwego rwo hejuru rijyanye n’icyerekezo cy’u Rwanda cyo kugira ibikorwa remezo byiza nka One & Only zombi yaba iyi yafunguwe n’indi iri muri Nyungwe. Ati “Tuzabifata nk’ibyacu, nk’ibyanyu, kandi tuzakomeza kubyongerera agaciro mu buryo butandukanye.” Mohammed Ibrahim Al Shaibani uyobora Kerzner International icunga amahoteli ya One & Only, yashimiye abagize uruhare mu kuba iyi hoteli yatashywe. Yavuze ko muri uyu mwaka wa 2020 bazafungura amahoteli nk’aya ane ahantu hatandukanye ariko ko “mbabwije ukuri, nta muntu n’umwe wambajije ahandi usibye mu Rwanda, buri wese yambazaga ngo ni ryari mu Rwanda muzasoza kugira ngo tujye gusura. Birasa n’aho iki gihugu gifite ibintu byinshi byiza bikurura abantu, kureba amafoto y’aha yatangariwe n’abantu benshi”. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Iterambere, RDB, Clare Akamanzi, yavuze ko u Rwanda rugize izi hoteli ebyiri, ashimira Kerzner ku cyizere yagiriye u Rwanda. Yavuze ko u Rwanda rukomeje gukora ibishoboka byose kugira ngo mu gihe ba mukerarugendo barusuye, babe ahantu hatekanye kandi ko bikomeje gutanga umusaruro. One and Only Gorilla’s Nest yiyongereye ku zindi nyubako ebyiri zikomeye zakira ba mukerarugendo bo ku rwego rwo hejuru mu bice by’ibirunga, zirimo Bisate lodge kuri uyu wa Gatanu yahawe inyenyeri eshanu na Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House, yatangije ibikorwa mu Rwanda ku wa 1 Kanama 2019. title: Ubwiza bwa One&Only Gorilla’s Nest, hoteli y’i Musanze yishyurwa 3600 $ ku ijoro (Amafoto)
content: Ifite ibyumba 21 biri mu byiciro bine, icyiciro cya mbere gifite ibyumba 10, igikurikiraho gifite ibyumba bine, ikindi bitanu naho icya nyuma kikagira ibyumba bibiri. Ibyumba icumi biri mu cyiciro cya mbere, byishyurwa 3600 by’amadolari ku ijoro rimwe naho icyumba cya menshi ni ibihumbi 10500 by’amadolari gishobora kwakira nk’abakuru b’ibihugu. Mu mafaranga umuntu yishyura, haba harimo ibyo kurya n’ibyo kunywa. Ibintu byose byubatse ibyumba by’iyi hoteli bikozwe mu mbaho nubwo bifashwe n’ibyumba. Iyi hoteli yubatse ku buso bungana na hegitari 35, aho yubatse hahoze hari hoteli yitwa Gorilla’s Nest. Imirimo yo kuyubaka yamaze imyaka igera kuri ibiri, yuzura itwaye miliyoni 65 z’amadolari ya Amerika. Imaze gutanga akazi ku bantu 120 bahoraho barimo abanyarwanda 100. Mu Ukwakira 2019 nibwo iyi hoteli yatangiye gukora ariko ntabwo yari yagafunguwe ku mugaragaro. Kuva mu kwa gatanu kugera mu kwa cyenda, nibwo iba ifite abashyitsi benshi. Imboga zose zitekerwa abashyitsi muri iyi hoteli, zihinze mu bice byayo. Amoko y’ibyatsi ibihumbi 36 niyo yatewe mu ishyamba ririmo iyi hoteli. One and Only Gorilla’s Nest yiyongereye ku zindi nyubako ebyiri zikomeye zakira ba mukerarugendo bo ku rwego rwo hejuru mu bice by’ibirunga, zirimo Bisate lodge kuri uyu wa Gatanu yahawe inyenyeri eshanu na Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House, yatangije ibikorwa mu Rwanda ku wa 1 Kanama 2019. Ije nyuma ya hoteli igezweho imaze igihe muri Pariki y’Igihugu ya Nyungwe, International One & Only Resorts, iyi ikaba ari ishami ryayo. title: Nyamasheke: Bubakiwe ibyumba 11 by’amashuri nk’inyungu ku mafaranga ava mu bukerarugendo
content: Ibi babigarutseho ubwo batahaga ku mugaragaro ibyumba by’amashuri 11 byubatswe n’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere RDB. Ibyumba bitatu byubatswe ku ishuri ribanza rya Mutagatifu Paul rya Rugabe mu Murenge wa Karambi n’ ibyumba umunani byubatswe ku ishuri ribanza rya Nyarusiza riherereye mu Murenge wa Mahembe mu karere ka Nyamasheke. Aya mashuri yose ari munsi ya Pariki ya Nyungwe. Ababyeyi barerera muri ibi bigo by’amashuri bavuga ko ibikorwa bakorerwa bibagaragariza ko pariki ari iyabo bigatuma barushaho kuyirinda abashaka kuyangiza. Mukeshimana Zacharie ati “Byatunejeje cyane, twahise tubona akamaro ka Nyungwe twumva tugomba kuyibungabunga kuko abana bacu bigiraraga mu mashuri mabi.” Nyirambarushimana Cecile ati“Badukoreye ibintu byiza kuko batumye abana bacu bigira ahantu heza, urumva ko tugomba kurinda pariki yacu kugira ngo amafaranga avamo akomeze yiyongere, bizatuma dukomeza kubona ibikorwa byinshi.” Bamwe mu banyeshuri biga muri ibi bigo by’amashuri bavuga ko bigiraga mu byumba bishaje ndetse bakicara ari benshi ku ntebe ariko kuri ubu bakaba biga neza, akaba ariyo mpamvu biyemeje gukomeza kurwanya ba rushimusi. Mugabo Aime wiga mu mwaka wa Gatandatu w’amashuri abanza yagize ati “Turishimye cyane twabaga turi abana benshi bigatuma tudatsinda kubera hari aho twicaraga turi batanu, ubu twicara turi batatu kubera amashuri mashyashya. Tumaze kandi gusobanukirwa no kubungabunga ibinyabuzima biba muri parike ya Nyungwe kuburyo tubonye ushaka kubyangiza twamushyikiriza abayobozi.” Ngoga Thelesphore, ushinzwe imicungire ya pariki z’igihugu mu kigo cy’igihugu Iterambere RDB avuga ko bashora mu mishinga y’uburezi mu rwego rwo kugira ngo abaturiye za pariki barusheho gusobanurirwa kuyibungabunga ariko kandi ngo hari n’indi mishinga itandukanye batera inkunga. Ati “Ntabwo ari imishinga y’Uburezi gusa ariko n’ibindi bikorwa bishobora kuzamura abaturage kugira ngo banabone ko parike baturiye bagomba kugira uruhare mu kuyibungabunga. Abaturage nibiga bakamenya nibwo tuzabasha kubasobanurira akamaro ka parike bakakumva. Umwana aziga narangiza ajye gushaka akazi aho kujya gushimuta muri pariki. ” Ibi byumba by’amashuri 11 byatwaye miliyoni zisaga 64, ni mu gihe amafaranga yagenewe gukora imishinga mu mirenge 7 ikora kuri Nyungwe muri Nyamasheke ari miliyoni 423.

title: Akarere ka Bugesera karifuza kubyaza umusaruro ibiyaga gafite mu bukerarugendo
content: Ubusanzwe akarere ka Bugesera gafite ibiyaga icyenda birimo bibiri binini nka Rweru na Cyohoha. Nubwo ari kamwe mu turere dufite ibiyaga byinshi, nta musaruro ugaragra bitanga haba mu bijyanye n’ubukerarugendo cyangwa kuba byakwifashishwa mu buhinzi buteye imbere bwifashisha kuhira muri ako karere kakunze kurangwamo amapfa cyane. Meya w’akarere ka Bugesera, Mutabazi Richard aherutse kubwira IGIHE ko bifuza kubyaza umusaruro ibyo biyaga, bagahamagarira abashoramari kuhubaka amahoteli n’ibindi bigezweho bikurura ba mukerarugendo. Yagize ati “Turi gukangurira abashoramari gukora muri icyo cyiciro. Dufite ibiyaga icyenda ariko nta na kimwe kiriho inkombe zigezweho ikindi ugendeye ku miterere yacu ntabwo ari bya biyaga bifite umucanga, ni bigufi ariko uko byaba bimeze kose hakenewe abashoramo imari mu bijyanye n’imyidagaduro.” Mu Bugesera ni hamwe mu bice by’igihugu biri gutera imbere cyane, by’umwihariko umujyi wa Nyamata uri hafi y’ahari kubakwa ikibuga cy’indege gishya kizaba ari icya mbere kinini mu Rwanda. Ni agace kari kuzamurwamo inzu nyinshi kandi zigezweho zo guturamo. Meya Mutabazi avuga ko ikibura ari uburyo bw’imyidagaduro ku buryo abantu benshi bifuza kuza gutura muri ako karere, bakajya gukora ahandi ariho baturutse. Ati “Akarere kacu gakwiriye kuba akarere gasurwa, abantu bakaza kuharuhukira bakava mu murwa mukuru bakaza hano, bakabona ibikorwa byinshi by’imyidagadauro bakaruhuka , abashaka kuhatura bakaza bakajya gukora baturutse hano.” Mu guhamagaririra abashoramari kuza muri ako karere, Meya Mutabazi avuga ko bakeneye abantu bahubaka ibikorwa by’imyidagaduro nk’utubyiniro n’ibindi bituma urubyiruko ruhuga, aho gushidukira kujya mu mujyi wa Kigali. Ati “Inaha usanga nta kabyiniro gahari, ugasanga urubyiruko ruri inaha rushaka gusohokera i Kigali. Kwambuka amazi ugiye kubyina twumva bidasobanutse mu karere kacu, twagombye kuba dufite ibyo bikorwa byose. Turakorana n’abashoramari batandukanye, turebe ko harimo ababyumva vuba.” Aka karere gaherutse kuzurizwa stade nshya igezweho, nka kimwe mu bikorwa remezo by’imyidagaduro. Mutabazi avuga ko ibiyaga bihari biramutse bibyajwe umusaruro, bigashyirwaho ibikurura ba mukerarugendo byakwinjiriza akarere, n’abagatuye bakabona imirimo. Ibiyaga icyenda biboneka mu karere ka Bugesera bifite ubuso bwa hegitari 10,635 byose hamwe.

title: Maria Sharapova n’umukunzi we bahishuye ibihe bidasanzwe bagize ubwo basuraga u Rwanda na Botswana
content: Mu nyandiko yasohotse mu kinyamakuru Vogue cyo mu Bwongereza, Sharapova na Alexander bagaruka ku bihe bidasanzwe bagiriye mu Rwanda na Botswana umwaka ushize, aho babonye inyamaswa zinyuranye bagahura n’abantu batandukanye. Maria atangirira kuri Botswana, aho bageze n’indege bakahagirira igice cya mbere cy’urugendo rwabo rw’iminsi ine bamaze basura ibyiza nyaburanga binyuranye. Muri Botswana baraye muri Wilderness Vumbura Plains amajoro abiri. Ku munsi wa mbere basuye inyamaswa zitandukanye zirimo intare mbere yo kwerekeza mu Rwanda kureba ingagi zitaba ahandi ku Isi. Alexander avuga ko muri icyo gihugu babonye inyamaswa zitandukanye zirimo intare, imvubu, ingona, imparage, udusumbashyamba n’izindi. Maria yongeraho ko banabonye ingwe n’imwe mu nyamaswa ibarizwa mu muryango w’ibisimba bitanu bikaze cyangwa ‘Big Five. Yakomeje ati “Ingwe zo zari zitangaje cyane; twaricaye twitegereza zirimo gushaka amafunguro y’umugoroba, zikikinga ku mashami y’ibiti ziteze Impala zicaracara. Mu ijoro ryakeye, nakangutse mbona Inzovu irimo kunywa amazi muri piscine yacu.”  “Nabanje gukeka ko mbonye Intare irimo kugenda inyuma y’inzu yacu, ariko Alexander arambwira ngo nimpumure ni ingwe – nk’aho ari byo biroroshya ikibazo!” Nyuma yo gusura ibyo byiza nyaburanga, Alexander yavuze uburyo berekeje muri Bisate Lodge mu Ruhengeli, hoteli igizwe n’inzu esheshatu ziteye mu buryo bwihariye, aho uba witegeye Ikirunga cya Bisoke n’indi misozi itatse u Rwanda. Ati “Ni mu gihe cy’imvura, turagerageza kota ku muriro ku mugoroba, ari nako tureba uko ibihe bigenda bihinduka buri minota 30. Batubwiye ko inkende ndetse rimwe na rimwe ingagi zishobora kuza hafi y’inzu.” Maria Sharapova ahita avuga uburyo babonye inkende mbere y’ingagi, ariko aho baziboneye, bifuje kuba baramaranye nazo igihe cyose bamaze basura ibyiza by’aka karere. Yakomeje “Uburyo uhura n’ibi bisamuntu wiyoroheje ntabwo nzabyibagirwa. Ni umunsi wacu wa nyuma, ariko ntabwo nshaka kuhava.” Alexander avuga uburyo mu ijoro ryabo rya nyuma mbere yo gusura Johannesburg muri Afurika y’Epfo, batewe ishema no guhura na Perezida Paul Kagame. Ati “Birashimishije iyo urebye ibyo yabashije kugeraho mu myaka 25 nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, akunga abantu kandi ni abaturage beza cyane. Uyu munsi buri kwezi u Rwanda rugira umunsi wo gukora isuku rusange, Guverinoma igizwe n’abagabo n’abagore 50/50, ubukungu bukomeje gutera imbere. Sitwe tuzabona tugarutse.” Maria Sharapova yabaye nimero ya mbere ku Isi guhera mu 2005, ariko kuri ubu ari kubarizwa ku mwanya wa 369 nyuma yo kwitabira amarushanwa 12 gusa mu mwaka ushize.

title: Rusizi: Ni iki cyadindije umushinga wa hoteli imeze nk’ubwato yagombaga kubakwa ku kirwa?
content: Gihaya Island Resort yagombaga kuba ifite ishusho nk’iy’ubwato bwa Titanic ndetse igizwe n’amagorofa atatu, ikubakwa mu Kagari ka Gihaya mu murenge wa Gihundwe, ku buso buri hagati ya hegitari 20 na 40. Ugeze kuri iki kirwa usanga abahatuye bari mu mirimo yabo nk’ibisanzwe ndetse nta n’igikorwa kigaragaza iyubakwa ry’iyi hoteli. Nyabyenda Faustin, umwe mu bahatuye ati “Urebye imirimo y’abaturage irakomeje ariko hoteli yo ntituzi ibyayo kuko tubona nta cyahindutse uretse ko hari abaturage bacye baguriye.” Muneza Nira, nyiri uyu mushinga avuga ko bahuye n’imbogamizi nyinshi zituma badatangira ibikorwa ariko ko ubu ziri kugenda zicyemuka kuburyo imirimo yo kubaka izatangira muri Nyakanga cyangwa Kanama uyu mwaka. Ati “Twagize ikibazo cy’ibyangombwa, ibyangombwa byaho byangombaga guhuzwa bikaba icyangombwa kimwe kuko hari ubutaka bw’abaturage benshi, hagiye haza n’ibindi bibazo byinshi byo kugurira abantu aho hari abaturage wasangaga ubutaka butabanditseho.” Yakomeje agira ati “ Twahuye n’ikindi kibazo kuko hatari haragenewe amahotei cyangwa ubuhinzi, ubu turi mu ndunduro twabonye inyandiko ko aho hantu hashobora guhuzwa, hakaba ubutaka bumwe. Tuzatangira ibikorwa by’ibanze kuburyo bitakagombye kurenza muri 2022.” Muneza yavuze mu gice cya mbere himuwe imiryango igera muri 50 ariko ko hoteli ifite ibice bitatu kuburyo bizarangira abaturage bose bimuwe hakubakwa ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo. Gihaya Island Resort biteganyijwe ko izuzura itwaye akayabo ka miliyoni 56 z’amadolari ya Amerika.

title: RDB yahuguye abayobora ba mukerarugendo ku mateka y’urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu
content: Liberation History Tourism Trail ni gahunda nshya yinjijwe mu rwego rw’ubukerarugendo, igamije gusobanurira ba mukerarugendo b’abanyarwanda n’abanyamahanga, amateka y’urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu n’impamvu rwabayeho. Igizwe n’urugendo runyura ahantu (sites) 29 mu turere dutandatu tw’u Rwanda, hafite icyo hasobanuye gikomeye ku rugamba rwo kubohora igihugu rwatangiye ku itariki 1 Ukwakira 1990 rukarangira ku itariki 4 Nyakanga 1994. Kuri uyu wa mbere tariki 3 Gashyantare 2020, Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere na Minisiteri y’Ingabo, batangiye guhugura abayobora ba mukerarugendo n’abafatanyabikorwa b’urwego rw’ubukerarugendo hagamijwe kubongerera ubushobozi n’ubumenyi bwo gusobanurira abo bayobora iby’amateka y’aho hantu. Umuyobozi w’ishami ry’amabwiriza agenga ubukerarugendo muri RDB, Emmanuel Nsabimana yavuze ko muri ayo mahugurwa bazasobanurirwa byinshi ku hantu habumbatiye amateka y’urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu ndetse bakanahasura. Ati “Amateka y’urugamba rwo kubobohra igihugu mu bukerarugendo ni igice gikomeye mu mateka n’umurage mu guteza imbere ubukerarugendo. Twateguye amahugurwa ku bayobora ba mukerarugendo ngo tubongerere ubumenyi kuri urwo ruhererekane. Hari ibyo bigira hano ariko bazajye no kuhasura kugira ngo bazafashe ba mukerarugendo mu buryo bwuzuye.” Umugaba w’Ingabo zirwanira mu kirere, Maj Gen Emmanuel Bayingana; yavuze ko kumenya amateka y’urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu bizatuma abo basobanurira by’umwihariko abakiri bato bamenya impamvu rwabayeho. Ati “Twishimiye gukorana n’abayobora ba mukerarrugendo, tubongerera ubumenyi ku mateka y’urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu no kubafasha kwigisha abakiri bato kumenya impamvu y’urwo rugamba.” Ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku mateka y’urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu, bwatangijwe ku mugaragaro muri Kanama 2019. title: Mbatembereze i Strasbourg, Umujyi ubumbatiye amateka y’Abafaransa n’Abadage (Amafoto)
content: Ni umujyi uhana imbibi n’u Budage ndetse ubitse amateka menshi hagati y’ibi bihugu byombi, uherereye mu gace ka Alsace. Ntabwo ari umujyi utuwe cyane kuko uri ku buso bwa kilometero kare 7826, ibarura ryo mu 2017 rigaragaza ko wari utuwe n’abaturage 280966. Ufatwa nk’Umurwa Mukuru w’u Burayi kubera ko ariwo ubarizwamo ibikorwa by’inama y’ubujyanama bw’u Burayi, Urukiko rw’u Burayi rw’uburenganzira bwa muntu, Inteko Ishinga Amategeko y’u Burayi n’ibindi. Ni umujyi kandi ubarizwamo ibikorwa byinshi bibungabungwa na UNESCO nk’umutungo kamere w’Isi. Muri ibyo harimo nka Cathédrale Notre-Dame de Strasbourg n’agace gakundwa na ba mukerarugendo kazwi kitwa Petite France. Ni agace karimo imigezi myinshi ndetse mu myaka yo hambere kakundaga kubamo abarobyi cyane, magingo aya ni ko gace gasurwa cyane muri Strasbourg yose. Imiterere yako igaragaza imyubakire yo mu Bufaransa kera mu kinyejana cya 17 ari nayo mpamvu UNESCO yahisemo kugashyira mu duce tubungabunzwe kubera amateka yako. Naho Cathédrale Notre-Dame de Strasbourg igizwe n’inyubako zigaragaza amateka ya kera y’Abaromani, ndetse igaragazwa nk’urugero rwiza rwo kwerekana amateka yo hambere dore ko mu myaka ya 1647 na 1874 yabaye inzu ya mbere ndende ku Isi, ireshya na metero 142. Uyu munsi ni kiliziya iri mu nsengero esheshatu ndende mu mateka y’Isi ndetse yihariye agahigo ko kuba ariyo ya mbere ndende mu mateka y’Isi yubatswe hagati y’ikinyejana cya Gatanu n’icya 15. Umusizi Victor Hugo n’umudage Goethe nawe wari umwanditsi, bakunze kuyigereranya n’igiti cy’Imana bashaka kuvuga uburebure bwayo. Bitewe n’uko iteye, ahantu hose hari umusozi muri uyu mujyi, iyo uwugiyeho bituma umuntu abasha kuyibona neza Ku bantu bakunda gutembera bihera amaso ibyiza bitatse Isi, ni umujyi mwiza cyane. Mu 2009 ubwo habaga inama ya NATO, Barack Obama na Chancelier w’u Budage, Angela Merkel, bakoze urugendo rw’amateka n’amaguru, bava Strasbourg bagera mu Kehl banyuze ku kiraro cya Passerelle des Deux Rives cyubatswe mu 2004 nk’ikimenyetso cy’ubumwe mu Burayi. Nta passport bisaba ku muntu ushaka gukora uru rugendo nk’urwabo, ugera mu Budage mu gace ka Rhine. Alsace agace ka Strasbourg kazwi ho kugira umuvinyo uryoheye ijigo ndetse n’inzoga nyinshi zituruka mu baturanyi b’Abadage. Mu masaha y’ijoro usanga hafi ya Notre-Dame hari abantu benshi bari ku gacupa bungurana ibitekerezo, Umujyi wa Strasbourg guhera mu 2008 uyoborwa na Roland Ries nyuma yo kuba Umwarimu muri Kaminuza ya Strasbourg n’Umusenateri muri aka Karere imyaka icyenda. Amafoto: Karirima A. Ngarambe

title: Twitege Visit Rwanda muri Formula 1 na NBA?
content: Muri ubu bufatanye, ikirango cya Visit Rwanda kigaragazwa kuri Stade ya Parc des Princes aho PSG yakirira imikino yayo ndetse no ku mugongo ku myenda iyi kipe ikoresha mu myitozo no mu gihe cyo kwishyushya mbere y’imikino, yaba iyo yambara yasuye indi kipe cyangwa iyo yambara iwayo muri Shampiyona y’u Bufaransa, Ligue 1 mu gihe kandi aya magambo agaragara ku myambaro y’ikipe y’abagore. Mu masezerano harimo kandi icyumweru cy’imishinga y’abanyempano b’abanyarwanda n’Abafaransa. Icyo cyumweru cyiswe “Semaine du Rwanda à Paris” kizajya gitegurwa na PSG mu kumenyekanisha ibintu byose bikorerwa mu Rwanda. Ubu bufatanye bwatangajwe nyuma y’umwaka umwe n’igice, RDB itangiye gukorana n’ikipe ya Arsenal yo mu Bwongereza, aho binyuze muri Visit Rwanda, iyi kipe yo mu Mujyi wa Londres yamamaza ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda. Kuva icyo gihe, hari abanyabigwi benshi bakomeye ba Arsenal baje mu Rwanda barimo Tony Adams wabaye kapiteni wayo igihe kirekire, Lauren Etame Mayer, Alex Scott wabaye kapiteni w’ikipe y’abagore na David Luiz kuri ubu ukinira iyi kipe, bose baje mu Rwanda. Muri ubu bufatanye kandi, abatoza babiri b’Ingimbi za Arsenal FC, Simon McManus usanzwe ari Umutoza Mukuru w’Amashuri yigisha umupira w’amaguru ya Arsenal na Kerry Green, bahugura ab’Abanyarwanda mu kubafasha kubatoza umupira ugezweho nk’uwo iyi kipe ikina. RDB ivuga ko kuva u Rwanda rutangiye gukorana na Arsenal binyuze muri Visit Rwanda mu 2018, ba mukerarungo baza mu Rwanda bamaze kugera kuri miliyoni imwe na 700 (byatangajwe mu Ukuboza 2019) ndetse yizeye ko bazakomeza kwiyongera mu myaka iri imbere. Ese birashoboka ko tuzabona Visit Rwanda mu marushanwa nka Tour de France, Formula 1 cyangwa NBA? Imwe mu mpamvu ituma habaho ubu bufatanye bw’u Rwanda n’amakipe akomeye i Burayi, ni ugutekereza kure kugira ngo u Rwanda ruzabe igihugu gikize mu myaka iri imbere ndetse n’Abanyarwanda bagire ubushobozi buhagije bwo gukora ibyishimirwa n’abanyamahanga. Tour de France niryo siganwa rya mbere ry’amagare rikomeye ku Isi, Formula 1 naryo ni isiganwa rya mbere rikomeye mu mukino wo gusiganwa mu modoka mu gihe NBA yo muri Amerika ari yo Shampiyona ya Basketball ikunzwe na benshi ku Isi. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami ry’Ubukerarugendo no kubungabunga za Pariki muri RDB, Ariella Kageruka, yavuze ko bishoboka ko u Rwanda rwagirana ubufatanye n’imwe mu makipe agaragara muri aya marushanwa kuko byose bisaba kwiha intego ndetse bikagira uko bikorwa. Ati “Sinavuga ko hari igihe runaka bizabera, ariko nta kintu kidashoboka kuko iyo urebye ikintu gisabwa ni ukureba niba ibikorwaremezo dufite bihuye n’ibyo. Nko kuri Formula 1, icya mbere ni imihanda kandi nkeka imbaraga Leta yashyize mu kubaka imihanda dushobora kuyibyaza umusaruro.” “Ku kwerekana Visit Rwanda muri NBA, BAL (Basketball Africa League yashyizweho na NBA) yo ubwo yaje aha, mwabonye ko ikipe yacu (Patriots BBC) yari ihagarariye u Rwanda yari yambaye Visit Rwanda. Ni ukuvuga ngo ni ukugenda intambwe ku ntambwe kandi byose birashoboka. Icya mbere ni ukugira ngo tubyaze umusaruro ubufatanye dufite uyu munsi kuko ni ukubanza kureba icyo dukuramo, tukaba twava mu mupira w’amaguru tukajya muri Basketball.” Kageruka avuga ko nubwo kuri ubu ubufatanye bw’u Rwanda mu bukerarugendo bushingiye ku mugabane w’u Burayi, bitabuza ko n’Abanyamerika barumenya kuko nka Arsenal ikunda gukorerayo imyiteguro ya Shampiyona ijyanye n’itangazamakuru ryayo rigari ndetse ubwo David Luiz yazaga mu Rwanda, byavuzwe cyane muri Brésil. Ni iki cyakorwa ngo Siporo y’u Rwanda itange umusaruro mu bukungu bw’igihugu?  Siporo ni umwe mu nkingi z’iterambere u Rwanda rushaka kubakiraho ndetse igihugu kiri gushora cyane mu mikino kuko bitanga icyerekezo cyiza cy’igihugu ndetse bigafasha n’Abanyarwanda gutera imbere. Mu kiganiro yatanze ubwo yari yatumiwe mu mahugurwa yahuje abagize ingaga za Siporo, yateguwe n’Umuryango FPR Inkotanyi, Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami ry’Ubukerarugendo no kubungabunga za Pariki muri RDB, Ariella Kageruka, yavuze ko muri Siporo hari amahirwe menshi arimo ashobora kwinjiriza igihugu nko gukora imyenda n’inkweto bya Siporo. Kageruka yakomeje avuga ko itangazamakuru rishobora kwifashishwa mu kumenyakanisha Siporo y’u Rwanda, abakinnyi n’abatoza b’Abanyarwanda bagahabawa amahugurwa abafasha kugira ubumenyi buri ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Ati “Hari uburyo bwinshi bwo kubyaza umusaruro muri siporo, nko gushyiraho inganda zikora ibikoresho bya Siporo mu gihugu. Mu bijyanye n’ubukerarungo bushingiye kuri siporo, ubufatanye twagiranye n’abatwamamaza bwarengeje ibyo twari twiteze. Twari twiteze ko binyuze muri uku kwamamaza tuzabona miliyoni 28£, ariko mu mwaka umwe twabonye miliyoni 36£.” Indi nzira yafasha u Rwanda kwinjiza binyuze muri Siporo hari ugutegura amarushanwa akomeye abera mu gihugu hakanategurwa ibikorwa byishimirwa n’Abanyamahanga baje muri iyi mikino, nko gusura ingagi n’izindi Pariki, gutembera mu Kivu no kuzamuka imisozi. RDB ivuga ko kuva u Rwanda rutangiye gukorana na Arsenal mu myaka ibiri ishize, hamaze gutozwa abana n’abatoza basaga 120 ndetse no mu bufatanye na Paris Saint-Germain hazakorwa gahunda nk’iyi. Inzu y’imikino ya Kigali Arena, ikibuga cya Cricket kiri i Gahanga, ikibuga cya Kigali Golf Club kiri kuvugurwa biri mu byitezweho kuzazamura ubukeragendo bunyuze muri siporo. Mu 2017 ubukerarugendo bwinjirije u Rwanda miliyoni 401 z’Amadolari, ariko intego ya Guverinoma ni ukuzamura ayo madolari akaba miliyoni 800 mu 2024. Amafoto: Umurerwa Delphin

title: RDB yitabiriye imurika rikomeye ry’ubukerarugendo muri Amerika
content: Iri murika ry’ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo riri mu ya mbere akomeye muri Amerika y’Amajyaruguru. Riri kubera mu Mujyi wa Manhattan ahazwi nka Jacob K.Javits. Ryatangaiye taraiki 24 Mutarama, rirasozwa kuri iki Cyumweru tariki 26 Mutarama 2020. Nyuma y’imurika, itsinda rihagarariye u Rwanda rizakomereza ibikorwa byo kumenyekanisha ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda hirya no hino mu bice bya Leta ya California nka San Diego, Orange County na Los Angeles mbere yo kugaruka mu Rwanda. Ibigo byigenga bikora iby’ubukerarugendo bihagarariye u Rwanda birimo Mantis Rwanda, Akagera Aviation, New Dawn Associates, Heritage Safaris, Far Trek Africa Safaris, Silverback Africa na FCM Charleston. Mu byo bari kwerekana harimo umuco w’u Rwanda, urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima ruboneka mu Rwanda, ubwiza bw’u Rwanda n’ibijyanye no kwakira abakerarugendo. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ubukerarugendo muri RDB, Belise Kariza, yavuze ko muri Amerika y’Amajyaruguru ari hamwe mu haturuka ba mukerarugendo benshi basura u Rwanda, ko ari iby’ingenzi gukomeza kuhamenyekanisha ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda. Ati “Kuba twitabiriye iri murika rizwi rya New York Times Travel Show, tukagaragara mu bandi bamurika basaga 700 baturutse hirya no hino ku isi biratuma abitabiriye bamenya ko u Rwanda ari ahantu heza ho gusura ku isi. Twiteguye guha ikaze abakerarugendo bashaka gusura igihugu cyacu cyiza.” New York Times Travel Show ni imurika ry’ubukerarugendo riri mu akomeye ku Isi. Ryitabirwa n’abantu basaga 35 000, barimo abamurika basaga 700 bavuye mu bihugu bigera ku 175.

title: Abaholandi barimo Van Gaal bagaragaje urwibutso basigaranye mu rugendo bagiriye mu Rwanda
content: Louis Van Gaal yabigarutseho ku wa 20 Mutarama 2020 mu gikorwa cyiswe B2B cyahuje abaserukiye ibigo bitwara abakerarugendo mu Rwanda n’ibigo binini byo mu Buholandi bicuruza ubukerarugendo. Iki gikorwa cyateguwe na Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Buholandi cyabereye i LaHaye, u Rwanda rwari ruhagarariwe n’ibigo birimo Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB), Sosiyete Nyarwanda y’Ubwikorezi bwo mu Kirere, RwandAir, Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Buholandi n’ibigo by’ubukerarugendo birimo Amahoro Tours, Palast Tours and Travel na Wildlife Tours-Rwanda. Ibi bigo byari byitabiriye Imurikagurisha Mpuzamahanga ry’Ubukerarugendo rya Vakantiebeurs mu Mujyi wa Utrecht mu Buholandi. Byarimurikiyemo amahirwe y’ubukerarugendo ari mu gihugu binyuze muri gahunda ya ‘Visit Rwanda’. Abayobozi babyo ku mugoroba wo ku wa Mbere bahuye n’Abaholandi basuye u Rwanda hagamijwe kungurana ibitekerezo, kugaragaza uko bakiriwe no gutanga inama ku byanozwa kugira ngo bakomeze bishimire serivisi bahabwa nk’abakerarugendo. Muri Nzeri 2019, Van Gaal ni umwe mu banyacyubahiro 25 bise amazina abana b’ingagi mu Rwanda, ni umuhango wabereye mu karere ka Musanze witabirwa kandi na Perezida Paul Kagame. Aloysius Paulus Maria van Gaal OON w’imyaka 68 yavuze ko ibyo yishimiye mu Rwanda harimo kuba yarise izina umwana w’ingagi, igikorwa yavuze ko ari iby’agaciro. Yagize ati “Ikindi nahabonye ni abantu badasanzwe kubera ko mu Rwanda mu myaka 25 ishize ibintu byari bimeze nabi, ariko iyo urebye uko bimeze bakemuye ibyo bibazo, ibi kandi ni ukubera umukuru w’igihugu, njye nk’umutoza ndabizi ko bitoroshye guhindura imyumvire mu buryo bworoshye, bitwara igihe ariko we yarabikoze.” “Abantu baho baratandukanye, ni abantu ubona ko bitonze kandi bazi kwakira abashyitsi, mu Rwanda ni abantu bazi kureba kure kandi ikirere cyaho ni cyiza, twagiye mu modoka nini, byari bishimishije.” Yavuze ko amahoteli yo mu Rwanda ari meza, agaragaza ko abantu bashobora gukeka ko wenda yagiye muri hoteli y’inyenyeri eshanu ariko ko atari byo. Yavuze ko aho wajya hose uhasanga ibintu byiza, ibiryo ndetse hakaba hari n’isuku iri hejuru. Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Buholandi, Karabaranga Jean Pierre, yavuze ko hari byinshi ibihugu byombi bisangiye, harimo ko haba mu Rwanda no muri iki gihugu abantu usanga bafite inzozi zo kugera kure mu kubaho neza. Yagize ati “Iyo urebye mu myaka 25 ishize ukareba aho twavuye n’aho turi uyu munsi, ni ukubera ko Abanyarwanda twavuze tuti tugomba kugira imibereho myiza kandi turabiharanira.” Ku birebana no gusura u Rwanda, Amb. Karabaranga yagize ati “Dufite iterambere, dufite ahantu hafite ikirere cyiza, imisozi myiza kandi nzi neza ko abenshi muri mwe usanga bagenda ahantu harambitse ariko twe byose turabyishimira.” Umuyobozi muri RDB Ushinzwe kumenyekanisha Ubukerarugendo, Mutesi Linda, yavuze ko u Rwanda ari igihugu gitekanye, benshi bishimira gusura. Ati “U Rwanda ni igihugu gishimishije, ni igihugu cyiza kandi kigira ibihe byiza, iki ni kimwe mu bihugu byiza mu kugira umutekano mu kubitemberamo. Dufite ahantu heza ho gusura harimo mu Burasirazuba bw’u Rwanda, mu Majyepfo, mu Majyaruguru y’u Rwanda dufite ingagi z’Ibirunga zisangwa gusa mu bihugu bitatu ku Isi.” “Mu Burengerazuba bw’u Rwanda tuhafite Ikiyaga cya Kivu ukaba wahafatira amafoto meza, dufite kandi uburyo bwiza bwo kugera muri izo parike kuko dufite kajugujugu zishobora kuva ku Kibuga cy’indege i Kanombe zijyayo, uramutse ushaka kujyayo hari RwandAir iva Brussels mu Bubiligi inshuro enye mu cyumweru ukagera i Kigali.” Yababwiye kandi ko kugira ngo ubone VISA bidasaba ko uyakira mu gihugu urimo, ahubwo iyo ugeze ku kibuga cy’indege mu Rwanda uhita uyibahwa. Kuri ubu isoko ryo mu Buholandi riza mu myanya umunani ya mbere, mu kugira abakerarugendo benshi bakorana n’u Rwanda. Abarusura biyongereyeho 11.9 %, bavuye ku 4918 mu 2017 bagera kuri 5501 mu 2018. Guverinoma yihaye intego ko mu 2024 inyungu u Rwanda ruvana mu bukerarugendo izagera kuri miliyoni $800 zivuye kuri miliyoni $404 yinjiye mu 2017.

title: Mu basuye Pariki y’Akagera umwaka ushize, 48 % ni Abanyarwanda
content: Ugereranyije abasuye iyo pariki umwaka ushize n’abayisuye mu 2018, habayeho ubwiyongere bwa 12 %. Parike #Akagera yakiriye abakerurgendo basaga 49,000 muri 2019. Habayeho ubwiyongere bwa 12% ugereranyije na 2018. 48% by'abasuye parike uyu mwaka ni ABANYARWANDA. #Ibyaranze2019#VisitRwanda — Akagera (@AkageraPark) January 21, 2020 Iyi pariki kuva mu 2010 icungwa n’umuryango wita ku rusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, African Parks. Mu myaka itanu ishize hagiye haba amavugurura agamije guteza imbere urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima muri iyo pariki no kurushaho gukurura ba mukerarugendo bayisura. Nubwo umubare w’amafaranga yinjijwe umwaka ushize utatangajwe, ashobora kuba yariyongereye ugendeye ku bwiyongere bw’abayisuye. African Parks icunga iyi pariki igaragaza ko amafaranga yinjiza yavuye ku madolari 200 000 mu 2010, akagera ku madolari miliyoni ebyiri mu 2018. Ibyo byatumye iyo pariki ibasha kwihaza ku ngengo y’imari ikoresha ku kigero cya 75 %. Iyi pariki irimo amoko atandukanye y’inyamaswa, ikaba imwe mu zikomeye muri Afurika nyuma yo kuzanwamo intare n’inkura. Pariki y’Akagera irimo n’izindi nyamaswa zitandukanye nk’impala n’imparage, impongo, inzovu, imvubu, ingwe, inyoni z’amoko asaga 500 n’ibindi. Mu 2015, Pariki y’Akagera yazanywemo intare zaherukagamo mu myaka ya 1990. Mu mwaka wa mbere zigaruwemo, umubare w’intare wikubye kabiri kuko zahise zibyara ibyana 11. Mu 2017, hazanywemo izindi ntare ebyiri z’ingabo zivuye muri Afurika y’Epfo. Mu 2017 kandi, muri iyo pariki hazanywemo inkura z’umukara 18, nyuma y’imyaka icumi ubwo bwoko bw’inyamaswa bwarazimiye. Umwaka ushize, Pariki y’Akagera yari yasuwe n’abakerarugendo 44000, kimwe cya kabiri ari Abanyarwanda.

title: Ibigo nyarwanda byacanye umucyo mu imurikagurisha ry’ubukerarugendo mu Buholandi (Amafoto)
content:
Ni imurikagurisha riri kuba ku nshuro ya 13, ryabereyemwo gahunda zitandukanye mu bijyanye no kumenyekanisha u Rwanda, aho ryitabiriwe n’ibigo byo mu Rwanda bitandukanye bikora ibijyanye n’ubukerarugendo n’izindi serivisi zijyana nabwo. Ryitabiriwe uyu mwaka n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere, RDB, Sosiyete Nyarwanda y’Ubwikorezi bwo mu Kirere, RwandAir, Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Buholandi n’ibigo by’ubukerarugendo birimo Amahoro Tours, Palast Tours and Travel, Heritage Safaris na Wildlife Tours-Rwanda.  Umuyobozi w’Ishami ry’Ubukerarugendo mu rugaga rw’abikorera (PSF), Rutagarama Aimable, yabwiye IGIHE ko kwitabira iryo murikagurisha ari ubundi uburyo bwiza bwo kongera abakerarugendo basura u Rwanda. Yagize ati “ Turashimira rwose Leta y’u Rwanda uburyo idahwema kudufasha no gushyiramwo imbaraga ngo ubukerarugendo bukomeze butere imbere kandi natwe tubukora tukagiramo inyungu.” Yakomeje agira ati “ Iyo urebye muri iyi myaka ishize biragaragara cyane ko ubukerarugendo bwateye intamwe igaragara. Natwe umuntu ku giti cye muri twe tubukora nk’umwuga ni ugushyiraho akacu ntitubiharire gusa Leta, twongera ingufu n’umubare w’ibigo bikora ubukerarugendo, dukomeza kubaka amahoteli n’ibindi bijyanye no kwakira abantu.” Muri gahunda yo kumenyekanisha u Rwanda izwi nka ‘Visit Rwanda’, abahagarariye ibigo byo mu Rwanda beretse bagenzi babo bo mu Buholandi amahirwe ari mu bukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda n’uko yabyazwa umusaruro. Abayobozi baryitabiriye barimo Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Buholandi, Karabaranga Jean Pierre; Umuyobozi muri RDB Ushinzwe kumenyekanisha ubukerarugendo, Mutesi Linda na Ildephonse Kambogo ushinzwe ibijyanye n’Ubusesenguzi mu by’Ubukerarugendo. Vakantiebeurs ni imurika rifatwa nk’amahirwe ku bukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda yo gukorana n’ubw’u Buholandi n’andi masoko akomeye yabufasha gutera imbere.
Umuyobozi uhagarariye Visit Rwanda mu Buholandi, Harry Betist, yagize ati “Ni umwanya mwiza wo guhura n’abafatanyabikorwa bacu no kwishimira intambwe ubukerarugendo bumaze gutera no kureba uko itasubira inyuma.’’ Kuri ubu isoko ryo mu Buholandi riza mu myanya umunani ya mbere, mu kugira abakerarugendo benshi bakorana n’u Rwanda. Abarusura biyongereyeho 11.9 %, bavuye ku 4918 mu 2017 bagera kuri 5501 mu 2018. Ibi bikorwa by’imurikagurisha rigamije kumenyekanisha ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda byiyongera ku bikorwa bikomeye mu kubumenyekanisha birimo amasezerano rwasinye n’amakipe ya Arsenal na Paris St Germain ndetse na Filime ya Rwanda: The Royal Tour. title: Umunyamakuru w’icyamamare mu Buholandi yaryohewe n’ibyiza by’u Rwanda
content: Humberto ni umunyamakuru w’icyamamare kuri Televiziyo ya RTL mu Buholandi, ayobora ibiganiro kuri iyi televiziyo ya mbere mu gutambutsa ibiganiro by’ubucuruzi. Uretse kuba umunyamakuru w’umwuga, Humberto ni umufotozi utarabigize umwuga, akurikirwa n’abasaga 378,000 kuri Instagram. Ishingiye ku kuba ari umunyamakuru w’icyamamare kandi akurikirwa n’abantu benshi ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Buholandi ifatanyije n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB), yamutumiye ngo asure u Rwanda mu rwego rwo kumenyekanisha ibyiza by’igihugu, muri gahunda ya Visit Rwanda. Humberto Tan yakiriye ubwo butumire neza, asura u Rwanda tariki 15 uku kwezi, yishimira uburyo Abanyarwanda bamwakiriye, umuco n’ahantu nyaburanga yasuye harimo Pariki z’Akagera n’Ibirunga, ikiyaga cya Kivu n’Umujyi wa Kigali. Urugendo rwo gusura Ingagi ni rumwe mu byo avuga yabonye mu Rwanda atazibagirwa. Yagize ati “Icyantangaje cyane ni ukuntu Ingagi zicisha bugufi kandi bigaragara ko zifite imbaraga, Ingagi y’ingabo ya Silverback ifite ubudahangarwa, iguma yitegereza buri kimwe cyose kandi ihora yiteguye kuba yatabara hagize icyinjirira umuryango wayo. Twakoze urugendo rw’amasaha abiri n’igice yo kujya guhura n’Ingagi kandi guhura nazo ni iby’agaciro cyane”. Abamukurikira ku mbuga nkoranyambaga nabo batangariye urugendo rwe mu Rwanda. Umwe yagize ati “Byiza cyane, uri umunyamahirwe kuba warabashije gukora uru rugendo, ubu noneho warukura ku rutonde rw’ibyo wari wariyemeje kuzageraho mu buzima bwawe”. Undi nawe ati “Nibyo se koko warazibonye amaso ku maso ku manywa y’ihangu? Amafoto wahafatiye ni meza cyane”. Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Buholandi, Jean Pierre Karabaranga, mu gusobanura iby’uru rugendo yagize ati “Gahunda ya Visit Rwanda imaze kwamamara mu gihugu cy’u Buholandi, kuva aho itangiriye twahafunguje ibiro bishinzwe kuyamamaza ndetse mu mwaka wa 2019, twatunganije ingendo zitandukanye z’abanyamakuru na ba rwiyemezamirimo mu by’ubukerarugendo bw’Abaholandi batandukanye baje gusura u Rwanda.” Yakomeje agira ati “Uretse ibyo Humberto Tan yatangaje ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, hari n’indi nkuru yasohotse ku wa Gatandatu w’icyumweru gishize ku rupapuro rwa mbere rw’ikinyamakuru cya mbere mu binyamakuru bisohora inkuru zanditse cyitwa, TELEGRAAF.” Yavuze ko “Kuva tariki ya 15 kugera 19 Mutarama uyu mwaka, gahunda ya Visit Rwanda irimo kwitabira imurikabikorwa ry’ubukererarugendo rya mbere mu Buholandi, ryitwa ‘Vakantiebeurs’, riri kubera mu mujyi wa Utrecht.” Yavuze ko bakiriye intumwa z’u Rwanda zirimo abahagarariye RDB ndetse na ba rwiyemezamirimo batandukanye barimo abavuye muri Sosiyete y’ubwokerezi bwo mu kirere, RwandAir, Amahoro Tours, Heritage Travel, Palast Tours & Travel na Wildlife Tours Rwanda. Yagaragaje ko mu gutangiza iri murikabikorwa ku munsi wa mbere, bafatanyije n’ikigo cyitwa Untamed Travellers mu kwakira kuri stand yabo ya Visit Rwanda, ba rwiyemezamirimo n’abanyamakuru mu bukerarugendo basaga 200. title: Singita Kwitonda Lodge yashyizwe ku mwanya wa gatatu muri hoteli nziza ku Isi
content: Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House igizwe n’inyubako zigezweho zubatse mu Murenge wa Nyange mu Karere ka Musanze, ku birenge by’Ikirunga cya Sabyinyo, aho uba unitegeye ibirunga bya Gahinga na Muhabura. Yafunguwe ku mugaragararo na Perezida Paul Kagame muri Kanama 2019. LTI yashyize ahagaragara urutonde rwa hoteli 15 nziza kurusha izindi mu 2019, Singita Kwitonda Lodge iza ku mwanya wa gatatu. Hoteli ya mbere ni iyitwa The Nautilus yo muri Maldives, ifite umwihariko w’inzu 26 zihariye ku bakiliya (Private Homes) n’ibindi bintu bitandukanye igenera abakiliya, igakurikirwa na Grantly Hall yo mu Ntara ya Yorkshire yo mu Bwongereza. Singita yo mu Rwanda iza ku mwanya wa gatatu, ni inyubako nshya iherereye hafi ya Pariki y’Igihugu y’Ibirunga, ahantu hakururiye LTI cyane mu myaka ishize. Kuri urwo rutonde hoteli 12 za mbere zashyizwe ku rutonde hagendewe ku buryo zakira abakiliya n’agaciro ziha abazigana. Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House yubatswe ahantu hahoze igishanga cyari urwuri, ariko ubu hashibutse umushinga ukomeye w’ubukerarugendo ugizwe n’inzu umunani zubatswe mu buryo zirengera ibidukikije. Zirimo zirindwi zagenewe umuntu umwe cyangwa uherekejwe kuko buri imwe ifite uburiri bumwe, uruganiriro rwagutse n’ibindi byangombwa nkenerwa, hakaba indi imwe yiswe Kataza House yo igizwe n’ibyumba bine byo kuraramo. Yubatswe n’ibikoresho byinshi byakorewe mu Rwanda, ibyinshi ni ibiboneka i Musanze birimo amakoro n’imigano. Singita Kwitonda Lodge yashoweho miliyoni $25. Yahawe izina rya Kwitonda, yitiriwe ingagi y’ingabo yari izwiho ubwitonzi, yapfuye mu 2012 ifite imyaka 40, icyo gihe yabonetse itagihumeka nyuma y’iminsi yari ishize itakigaragara mu muryango wayo. Uyu mushinga wa Singita ni umwe mu izatuma u Rwanda rwesa umuhigo wo kwinjiza miliyoni $800 avuye mu bukerarugendo mu 2024, avuye kuri miliyoni $438 rwasaruye mu 2017. Singita ni izina risobanura ’ahantu h’ibitangaza’ mu rurimi rwa Shangaan rwo muri Afurika y’Epfo, ari naho iki kigo gikomoka. Cyatangiye ishoramari mu bukerarugendo mu 1993, gisanganwe izindi hotel zo mu bwoko bwa Lodge muri Tanzania (muri Grumeti Game Reserve na Lamai), muri Zimbabwe (Singita Pamushana Lodge) no muri Afurika y’Epfo (Singita Sweni Lodge na Singita Sabi Sand.)  	Urutonde rwa hoteli 15 za mbere ku Isi mu 2019  1. title: Wild Connector Safaris yatanze umwihariko mu gutembereza abantu Pariki y’Akagera mu minsi mikuru
content: Uruzinduko ruzaba kuwa Gatandatu tariki 21 Ukuboza 2019, muri Pariki y’Akagera icumbikiye inyamaswa nyinshi. Abazitabira bazabasha kubona amoko atandukanye y’inyamaswa ziba muri iyo pariki, imwe mu zikomeye muri Afurika nyuma yo kuzanwamo intare n’inkura. Pariki y’akagera irimo n’izindi nyamaswa zitanduknaye nk’impala n’imparage, impongo, inzovu, imvubu, ingwe, inyoni z’amoko asaga 500 n’ibindi. Ushinzwe iyamamazabikorwa muri Wild Connector Safaris , Rugamba Alexis yakanguriye cyane cyane ababyeyi kuzana abana bari mu biruhuko, babafasha gusobanukirwa neza ibitatse igihugu cyabo. Ni n’umwanya kandi ku muryango n’abakundana gusoza umwaka bishimye batembera ibyiza bitatse u Rwanda. Ati “Iki gihe abana benshi baba bari mu biruhuko. Ni umwanya mwiza kuri bo wo gutembera no kumenya byinshi ku gihugu cyabo. N’abakuru ni uko, muze dusure pariki yacu y’Akagera tunezezwe no kureba inyamaswa za mbere zikomeye ku isi.” Kujyana na Wild Connector Safaris muri Pariki y’Akagera, umuntu umwe arasabwa kwishyura amafaranga 30 000 Frw mu gihe abanyamahanga badaturuka mu muryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba bazishyura amadolari 110. Muri ayo mafaranga harimo itike, uburenganzira bwo kwinjira muri pariki, ifunguro rya ku manywa, abakuyobora n’ibindi. Abantu bakundana baziye rimwe ndetse n’abana bazagabanyirizwaho 10 %. Undi mwihariko w’uru rugendo ni uko hazaba hari umufotozi wabigize umwuga uzafata amafoto kandi buri wese akazahabwa umwanya wo kubaza ibibazo byose ku bijyanye n’ibyiza bitatse u Rwanda. Ku bindi bisobanuro kandi aha: Www.Wildconnectorsafaris.com

title: Imbamutima z’inzego zitandukanye ku bufatanye bw’u Rwanda na PSG
content: Inzego zitandukanye zirimo abakora mu bijyanye n’ubukerarugendo, abikorera, abashinzwe siporo n’abohereza ibikomoka ku buhinzi n’ubworozi bavuga ko bubumbatiye amahirwe menshi. Muri ubu bufatanye, abakinnyi ba Paris Saint Germain n’abahoze bayikinira bazashobora gusura u Rwanda bagaragaze ibyiza by’u Rwanda bakoresheje imbuga nkoranyambaga zabo na PSG ibikore gutyo. Umuyobozi w’Ishami ry’Ubukerarugendo muri RDB, Belise Kariza, avuga ko ‘gukoresha abakinnyi bazwi, bemerwa n’abantu benshi n’abafana babo ari ikintu cyiza kizadufasha mu imenyekanishabikorwa ryacu’. Ikirango cya Visit Rwanda kigaragara muri Stade ya Parc des Princes nk’uburyo bwo kumenyekanisha ibikorwa. Ibi byaraye bitangiye mu mukino PSG yakiriyemo Nantes. Visit Rwanda izajya igaragara ku mwambaro w’abakinnyi b’ikipe y’abagore ya PSG, ikaba igaragara ku myenda y’imyitozo y’abakinnyi yaba abagabo n’abagore, ikaba igaragara inyuma ku ikoti ryo kwishyushyanya mbere y’umukino. Mu guteza imbere ibikorerwa mu Rwanda, Made in Rwanda, mu bufatanye harimo igikorwa cyitwa ‘Icyumweru i Paris’, aho abakora imyenda, ubugeni, ubukorikori, bazashobora kugaragaza ibikorwa byabo mu Bufaransa icyumweru cyose ku bufatanye na Paris Saint Germain. Kariza avuga ko ubu bufatanye ari ‘ibintu bishimishije kuri twe, turabona amahirwe menshi afunguka hano by’umwihariko ku bikorerwa mu Rwanda no kubona Visit Rwanda igera kure ku bantu benshi’. Perezida wa Kabiri w’igice cy’abakora ibijyanye n’Ubukerarugendo akaba n’Umuyobozi wa Serena Hotel mu Rwanda, Daniel Sambai, mu kiganiro n’itangazamakuru kuri uyu wa Kane yavuze ko ubu bufatanye babubonamo amahirwe menshi. Ati “Nk’urwego rw’ubukerarugendo turishimye ku bw’ubu bufatanye, twiteze kubona ubukerarugendo butera imbere nk’uko butahwemye gutera imbere mu myaka ishize, ni iby’agaciro kuri twe.” Muri ubu bufatanye biteganyijwe ko hazabaho gahunda z’imyitozo ku bana b’abahungu n’abakobwa, gushaka uko amashuri y’umupira w’amaguru ‘academy’ yo mu Rwanda yazakorana n’Ikipe ya PSG. Umunyamabanga Uhoraho muri Minisiteri ya Siporo, Shema Maboko Didier, yavuze ko ubu bufatanye buzateza imbere siporo cyane. Ati “Nishimiye ubu bufatanye na PSG nk’ushinzwe siporo, aya ni amahirwe meza kuri twe yo gukomeza guteza imbere siporo yacu by’umwihariko mu rwego rw’umupira w’amaguru.” Muri ubu bufatanye kandi ikawa n’icyayi cy’u Rwanda kizaba gicuruzwa cyonyine muri Stade ya Parc des Princes, aho abafana baturutse ahantu hose bazashobora kunywa ku cyayi n’ikawa by’u Rwanda. Uwacu Cynthia wo mu kigo gishinzwe kohereza mu mahanga ibikomoka ku Buhinzi n’Ubworozi (NAEB) yavuze ko ibi bizafasha mu kohereza ibicuruzwa mu mahanga kuko n’ubundi ikawa n’icyayi bitoherezwaga cyane mu Bufaransa. Ati “Tugendeye ku mwaka tumaze dukorana na Alibaba ubona ikawa twohereza mu Bushinwa yariyongereyeho 700%, noneho tubirebe muri stade irimo abantu ibihumbi 47 buri cyumweru turimo gutanga icyayi n’ikawa twenyine.” “Turitegura iterambere rinini atari gusa amafaranga tuzakura muri ubu bufatanye ahubwo n’abantu bazaba baje ku mukino baturutse hirya no hino ku Isi bazabimenya, kuko ikawa n’icyayi cyacu bishimwa cyane ku Isi yose. Ubu bufatanye bw’u Rwanda na PSG buriyongera kubwo rwagiranye na Arsenal FC yo mu Bwongereza. Icyakora bwombi nta kiguzi cyabwo gitangazwa nk’uko impande zombi zabyemeranyijwe ko bikomeza kuba ibanga.

title: Icyo u Rwanda ruzungukira mu bufatanye na PSG n’impamvu rwaguye imbibi zikarenga ubukerarugendo
content: Muri ubu bufatanye, ikirango cya Visit Rwanda kigaragazwa kuri Stade ya Parc des Princes aho PSG yakirira imikino yayo ndetse no ku mugongo ku myenda iyi kipe ikoresha mu myitozo no mu gihe cyo kwishyushya mbere y’imikino, yaba iyo yambara yasuye indi kipe cyangwa iyo yambara iwayo muri Shampiyona y’u Bufaransa, Ligue 1. Ubu bufatanye bwatangajwe nyuma y’umwaka umwe n’igice, RDB itangiye gukorana n’ikipe ya Arsenal yo mu Bwongereza, aho binyuze muri Visit Rwanda, iyi kipe yo mu Mujyi wa Londres yamamaza ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na Televiziyo Rwanda, Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere, RDB, Clare Akamanzi, yavuze ko impamvu u Rwanda rwahisemo kurenga imbibi z’ubukerarugendo muri ubu bufatanye rwagiranye na Paris Saint-Germain ari ukugira ngo bifashe no kuzamura Abanyarwanda binyuze mu byo bakora, bimenyekane no mu mahanga. Ati "Mu gukomeza guteza imbere ubukungu bw’igihugu cyacu n’ubukungu ndetse n’ubuzima bw’abanyarwanda dukomeza gushaka uburyo twakongera ubushobozi bw’ubukungu bwacu mu gihugu ndetse no hanze y’igihugu.’’ ’’ Twasinyanye nabo kugira ngo tumenyekanishe Visit Rwanda mu rwego rw’ubukerarugendo, ariko ntabwo aribyo gusa no mu rwego rwa Visit Rwanda tuzakoresha n’abakurikirana PSG mu Bufaransa n’ahandi hose, bafitanye ubufatanye n’abantu bari mu nzego zitandukanye, yaba abakora imyenda, gukora icyayi n’ikawa […]. Tuzacuruza icyayi cyacu muri Parc des Princes aho PSG ikinira n’ikawa imenyekanishwe mu Bufarana ndetse ducuruze byinshi kurushaho.’’ Akamanzi avuga ko ubu ari uburyo bwiza bwo kumenyekanisha ibikorerwa mu Rwanda n’Ubukerarungendo bwarwo kugira ngo abanyamahanga barusheho kubumenya ariko nabo baze bagure ibintu byo mu Rwanda. Ati’’ Mu kugura ibyo bintu, bizatanga akazi ku Banyarwanda bakora ibi bintu, bakomeze kubikora kandi babikore ku bwinshi, babone amafaranga bitume n‘igihugu cyacu gikomeza gutera imbere.’’ Agaruka ku mpamvu ubufatanye na Paris Saint Germain butarebye gusa ku bukerarugendo, Akamanzi yavuze ko byatewe n’uburyo iyi kipe yo mu Bufaransa imeze ku buryo babona nayo ikoresha umupira w’amaguru mu kumenyekanisha bindi bikorwa bitandukanye abantu bakunda. Ati’’ Impamvu twagiye mu bukerarugendo n’ibindi ni uko twabonye umufatanyabikorwa tugiye gusinyana na we [PSG] adakina umupira gusa, bakoresha umupira kugira ngo abantu bagaragaze ibintu bakunda, haba mu myidagaduro, umuco, byose barabishyigikira, bakagaragaza ko ushobora gukoresha umupira kugira ngo uteze imbere ibindi bintu bituma ubaho neza.’’ " Ni ukureba uburyo twakoresha izina bafite kugira ngo dukore ibindi bashyigikira mu buzima no mu bukungu. Niyo mpamvu twahisemo kugira ngo turenge ubukerarugendo, dushake uko twakorana duteza imbere ibikorerwa mu Rwanda.’’ Muri ubu bufatanye bw’u Rwanda na Paris Saint Germain, hazabaho kandi icyumweru cy’imishinga y’abanyempano b’abanyarwanda n’Abafaransa. Icyo cyumweru cyiswe “Semaine du Rwanda à Paris” kizajya gitegurwa na PSG mu kumenyekanisha ibintu byose bikorerwa mu Rwanda. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa RDB avuga ko muri iki cyumweru Abanyarwanda bakora ibintu bitandukanye bazajya bahabwa umwanya wo kujya kubyerekana mu Mujyi wa Paris. Ati"Tuzacuruza ikawa n’icyayi cy’u Rwanda muri Stade. Nta kindi gihugu kizabikora, nitwe gusa. Bivuze ko bazatumenya cyane kurusha uko batuzi ubu.’’ "Ntabwo ari ibyo gusa, tuzakomeza tumenyekanishe u Rwanda mu Bufaransa, buri mwaka tuzagira ikintu cyitwa ‘’Icyumweru muri Paris’’, aho tuzana abantu batandukanye bakora imyenda, bakora ubukorikori, bakora ibintu bitandukanye bashobora gucuruza hanze, tubahe umwanya wo kwerekana ibyo bintu no kwerekana Umuco wacu ku buryo bizatuma abantu baza mu Rwanda bakagura n’ibintu byaho.’’ Akamanzi yashimangiye ko ubufatanye u Rwanda ruri kugirana n’amakipe akomeye i Burayi bugamije gutekereza kure kugira ngo u Rwanda ruzabe igihugu gikize mu myaka iri imbere ndetse n’Abanyarwanda bagire ubushobozi buhagije bwo gukora ibyishimirwa n’abanyamahanga. Ati "Turashaka gucuruza ibintu byinshi kurushaho hanze y’igihugu. Turashaka ko byakwiyongera mu bwinshi ndetse no mu bwiza bwabyo. Icyo tumaze kubona nk’igihugu ni uko tugomba kugira icyerekezo cy’igihe kirekire cyane. Dutekereze ngo mu myaka 10, 20 cyangwa 50 tuzaba turi hehe? Turifuza kuba igihugu gikize, Abanyarwanda bize kandi bafite ubushobozi, bashobora gukora ibintu bifite agaciro kari hejuru.’’ Umuyobozi wa RDB avuga ko kuri ubu umubano w’u Rwanda n’u Bufaransa ari mwiza ndetse bahisemo gukorana na Paris Saint Germain nk’ikipe ishaka kuzamura abato n’urubyiruko no gushyikira gukora ibintu binoze nk’uko bimeze no k’u Rwanda. Yakomeje avuga ko kuba u Rwanda ruri gushora cyane mu mikino ari uko rwabonye ko bitanga icyerekezo cyiza cy’igihugu ndetse bizafasha n’Abanyarwanda gutera imbere. Ati’’ Nk’igihugu turimo gushora mu mikino. Twubatse Kigali Arena kugira ngo Basketball ikinwe, hari ikibuga cya Cricket, hari amagare ndetse Abanyarwanda bitwara neza, hari Golf Club turi kubaka kugira ngo igere ku rwego mpuzamahanga, bigaragaza ko Leta iri gushora cyane mu mikino kugira ngo izamuke kandi nayo bizatuma itanga umusaruro mu bukungu bwacu.’’ PSG izagira uruhare mu kuzamura abakiri bato binyuze mu gushinga ishuri ry’umupira w’amaguru i Kigali, aho iyi kipe izajya itegura imyitozo y’abatoza n’abakiri bato mu kubafasha kugira ubunararibonye bw’iyi kipe ikomeye ku mugabane w’u Burayi, by’umwihariko yanditse amateka mu Bufaransa. RDB ivuga kuva u Rwanda rutangiye gukorana na Arsenal binyuze muri Visit Rwanda mu mwaka ushize, kuri ubu ba mukerarungo baza mu Rwanda bamaze kugera kuri miliyoni imwe na 700 ndetse yizeye ko bazakomeza kwiyongera mu myaka iri imbere.

title: Nyanza: Inzira z’Ubukerarugendo gakondo zahawe icyangombwa cyo mu rwego rwa mbere (Amafoto)
content:
Ni igikorwa cyabaye kuri uyu wa Gatatu ubwo izo nzira zafungurwaga ku mugaragaro zihabwa n’amanota bitewe n’imiterere yazo igaragaza ibyiza ndangamateka na nyaburanga. Cyitabiriwe n’abayobozi barimo Minisitiri w’Urubyiruko n’Umuco, Mbabazi Rosemary; Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ingoro z’Igihugu z’Umurage w’u Rwanda, Amb. Masozera Robert; Guverineri w’Intara y’Amajyepfo, Gasana Emmanuel na Perezida w’ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku kugenda n’amaguru mu gihugu cy’u Budage, Klaus Eber, n’abandi. Amanota yatanzwe n’abarimo inzobere mu bukerarugendo akaba na Perezida w’ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku kugenda n’amaguru mu gihugu cy’u Budage, Klaus Eber. Izo nzira zitwa Nyanza Cultural Trials ni eshatu zitandukanye ariko zuzuzanya. Iya mbere yitwa ‘Royal Trail’ ifite kilometero 10 izenguruka Umujyi wa Nyanza igakikiza Ingoro z’Umurage ebyiri zihari ari zo Ingoro y’Abami mu Rukari n’Ingoro y’Umurage wo kwigira iherereye ku Rwesero ahahoze hatuye Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa. Iyo nzira kandi inyura ahari ibindi byiza biranga amateka y’u Rwanda mu Karere ka Nyanza nk’Umusezero w’Abami i Mwima hatabarijwe Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa tariki ya 28 Nyakanga 1959; Umwami Kigeli V watabarijwe ku ya 15 Mutarama 2017 ndetse n’Umwamikazi Gicanda Rosalie wahatabarijwe tariki ya 20 Mata 1995. Inzira ya kabiri yitwa ‘Big View’ y’ibirometero umunani ituruka mu Mujyi wa Nyanza ikagera ku musozi wa Remera. Iyo uri kuri uwo musozi wa Remera uba ushobora kureba ku ntera y’umurambararo wa kilometero 50. Ubasha kureba imisozi itandukanye ikikije Nyanza ndetse waterera amaso kure ukaba wabona ibindi bice by’u Rwanda birimo n’ibirunga biri mu Majyaruguru y’igihugu. Inzira ya gatatu yitwa ‘Gatagara Trail’ y’ibiromtero 12 ituruka mu Mujyi wa Nyanza ikagenda ikikiza ibishanga ikagera i Gatagara ahari ibikorwa by’ububumbyi biteye imbere ndetse n’ikigo cyita ku bafite ubumuga. Klaus Eber yavuze ko bamaze iminsi basura izo nzira baziha n’amanota ariko basanze zifite umwihariko ugeranyije n’izo mu bihugu by’i Burayi. Ati “Abantu benshi bakora ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku kugenda n’amaguru bakunda inzira zirimo ibyerekezo bishushanyije birimo n’amakuru atandukanye. Rero nishimiye kubamenyesha ko izi nzira zo mu Karere ka Nyanza zujuje ibyo byose.” Yasobanuye ko mu gutanga icyangombwa hari byinshi bishingirwaho birimo ibyerekezo n’ibindi byiza nyaburanga n’ibiranga amateka bikabafasha kugenda bishimye batarambirwa. Yavuze ko kimwe mu byahesheje amanota menshi inzira zo mu Karere ka Nyanza ari amateka y’Ubwami ahaboneka. Yasobanuye ko ubusanzwe batanga amanota bakurikije ukuntu ahantu hagenda hahinduka kuko abagira amanota menshi baba bafite byibura ahantu hagera kuri 50 muri izo nzira hatandukanye. Ati “Ni ukuvuga ngo ukagenda ukava mu ishyamba ukagera mu mirima ihinzemo imyaka, ukagera mu mibaya, mu misozi, mu bisiza, muri kaburimbo, ahatuye abantu, ahadatuwe n’ahandi. Uko guhindagurika kw’ahantu ni ko gutuma inzira zigira amanota meza.” Yakomeje avuga ko inzira zo mu Karere ka Nyanza bazisuzumye basanga zifite ahantu hagera kuri 75 hatandukanye kandi hari ibyiza byinshi bishimisha abazinyuramo. Ati “Twe twaje gusanga inzira za hano zifite ahantu 75; ni igipimo kirenze ibindi byose. Ntewe ishema n’uko u Rwanda rugeze kuri icyo gipimo cyo hejuru; mwabonye amanota 75.” Klaus Eber yavuze ko ku mugabane w’u Burayi aho izo nzira zimaze igihe; izo mu rwego rwa mbere ziba zifite amanota 60 ariko hari iyo mu Budage ifite amanota 80. Yavuze ko ari igikorwa gikomeye gikwiriye kubyazwa umusaruro kigafasha igihugu mu iterambere. Asobanura inzego zitandukanye izo nzira ziba zirimo yavuze ko hari urwa mbere rwo hejuru ruba rwitwa ‘Premium’ ari narwo izo mu Karere ka Nyanza bazishyizemo. Ati “Ubu ku Isi hose cyane cyane mu Burayi hari izigera kuri 600 zo muri urwo rwego rwa premium.” Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ingoro z’Igihugu z’Umurage w’u Rwanda, Amb. Masozera Robert, yavuze ko bishimiye amanota babonye bityo nyuma yo gutangiza izo nzira ku mugaragaro hagiye gukurikira ibikorwa byo kuzimenyekanisha no kuzibyaza umusaruro. Ati “Izi nzira eshatu zimaze gutangizwa zagiye ku rwego mpuzamahanga; ubu hagiye gukurikiraho kuzimenyekanisha kugira ngo zimenyerwe; abantu bakora mu bukerarugendo batangire bazicuruze bazimenyakanishe.” Amb. Masozera yavuze ko usibye izo nzira eshatu hari izindi enye zizatangira gukorwa guhera umwaka utaha. Bamwe mu baturage bitabiriye igikorwa cyo gutaha izo nzira banifatanya n’abayobozi gukora urugendo rwa kilometero 10 mu nzira yitwa ‘Royal Trail’ bavuze ko bazishimiye cyane. Dusabimana Francine waturutse mu Mujyi wa Kigali ati “Icyanshimishije ni ibintu nabonye bitandukanye birimo utuyira twiza tuzamuka n’utumanuka imisozi; mbese ntabwo umuntu ashobora gucika intege ngo ananirwe. Nabonye Ingoro z’Abami ni ubwa mbere nari mpageze byanshimishije kuhabona.” Hari bamwe batangiye kubibyaza umusaruro
 Bamwe mu baturage batangiye ibikorwa byo kubyaza umusaruro ubwo bukerarugendo bushingiye ku kugenda n’amaguru aho bakora ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi kuri izo nzira. Umusore witwa Nsanzintwari Augustin wo mu Murenge wa Busasamana yatangiye gucuruza inkoni abantu bashobora kwicumba bazamuka imisozi ndetse n’ingofero zishobora kubakingira izuba. Ati “Hari ba mukerarugendo bahora baza hano mu Rukari gusura bagakenera inkoni zo kwicumba cyangwa ingofero zo kwambara.” Minisitiri w’Urubyiruko n’Umuco, Mbabazi Rosemary, yasabye abaturage bo mu Karere ka Nyanza kubyaza umusaruro ubwo bukerarugendo. Yavuze ko ubukerarugendo ari ikintu u Rwanda rwiyemeje gushyiramo imbaraga ruganisha ku murage n’umuco w’Abanyarwanda. Ati “Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika yifuza ko Intara y’Amajyepfo iba igicumbi cy’umuco n’umurage wacu. Iyi nzira yose ugakomeza ukagera muri Nyungwe hari byinshi cyane bigize amateka yacu n’umurage wacu dushobora kubyaza umusaruro kandi n’abato bakabimenya bagakura babizi” Yasabye ubufatanye bw’Akarere ka Nyanza, abari mu bukerarugendo n’abikorera gukora ibikorwa bihabyaza umusaruro mwiza. Ati “Mumenyekanishe hano hantu ibikorwa bihari baze babisure bahamare umwanya munini bahasige amadevize n’abaturage bacu batere imbere kurushaho.” Yagiriye inama abaturage yo gucuruza inkoni, ibyo kwitwikira, ibyo umuntu yakwihanaguza icyuya, amazi, imitako n’ibindi bishobora gukenerwa na ba mukerarugendo banyura muri izo nzira. Yasabye abasanzwe batanga serivise z’amafunguro kwagura ibikorwa no kunoza ibyo bakora ku buryo nta mukerarugendo uzasohoka i Nyanza ngo ajye gushaka icyo kurya cyangwa icyo kunywa ahandi. Ati “Abanyabugeni, abanyabukorikori n’abatanga serivise mwumve ko ari amahirwe tugomba kubyaza umusaruro.” Abitabiriye urugendo rwo gutangiza izo nzira ku mugaragaro kuri uyu wa gatatu babarirwa mu bantu 400 barimo n’abanyamahanga. Icyangombwa inzira z’i Nyanza zahawe kimara imyaka itatu, nyuma yayo nibwo hongera gutangwa ikindi.

title: Abakora mu bukerarugendo bagiriwe inama yo kugabanya ibiciro mu kureshya abakiliya b’imbere mu gihugu
content: Urwego rw’ubukeraugendo mu Rwanda ni rumwe mu zari zifashe cyane ubukungu bw’igihugu. Benshi mu bakiliya barwo akenshi babaga ari abanyamahanga ariko ingamba zashyizweho zo kwirinda coronavirus zishobora gukoma mu nkokora urwo rwego, kuko abakerarugendo mpuzamahanga bizatwara igihe ngo batangire kugaruka. Gahunda yo kuzahura ubukungu iri gutegurwa n’urwego rw’ubukerarugendo n’amahoteli mu Rwanda, iragaragaza ko imbaraga nyinshi zigiye gushyirwa mu bukerarugendo bw’imbere mu gihugu guhera muri Gicurasi 2020 kugeza mu Ukuboza 2021. Ishami ry’Umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku bukerarugendo, rivuga ko umubare w’abakerarugendo mpuzamahanga ushobora kuzagabanyuka ku kigero kiri hagati ya 60 na 80%. Urugaga rw’Abikorera mu Muryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, East African Business Council, EABC) rugaragaza ko muri EAC nibura miliyari eshanu z’amadolari yagombaga kwinjizwa n’ubukerarugendo azagabanuka mu 2020 kubera icyo cyorezo, mu gihe abakerarugendo bagera kuri miliyoni 6.2 bagombaga kuza gusura akarere bashobora kugabanuka. Izo mbogamizi zose zizagira ingaruka ku rwego rw’ubukerarugendo rw’imbere mu gihugu, ariyo mpamvu hakenewe kuvugurura ibiciro kugira ngo byorohere Abanyarwanda. Gahunda yo kuzahura urwego rw’ubukerarugendo iri gutegurwa, igira iti “Nubwo bimwe mu bikorwa by’ubukerarugendo bisanzwe bihendutse kandi hari igabanyirizwa ku bantu b’imbere mu gihugu, hakenewe irindi gabanywa ry’ibiciro.” Nk’ibiciro byo gusura ingagi byari biri hejuru cyane cyane ku baturage b’imbere mu Rwanda, mu korohereza no gushishikariza benshi kubyitabira kugabanya ibiciro birakenewe. Muri iyo nyigo nshya kandi irashishikariza guteza imbere abantu bagiye mu bukerarugendo bukozwe mu matsinda, bakagabanyirizwa. Aho harimo kandi no kugabanyirizwa ku bashaka gusura ibice runaka nyaburanga mu bihe byihariye by’umwaka. Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB) kizakorana n’Ishami ry’Ubukerarugendo mu rugaga rw’abikorera mu Rwanda, kugira ngo hanozwe inyigo yakurikizwa mu kugabanya ibihombo urwego rw’ubukerarugendo ruri guhura nabyo. Amahoteli kandi aragirwa inama yo kugabanyiriza ibiciro abayagana b’abanyarwanda, abaturutse mu bihugu byo mu Muryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba n’abo mu bihugu bigize Umuryango w’Ubumwe bwa’Afurika. Iyo nyigo ivuga ko hari amahoteli amwe kugira ngo areshye abakiliya b’imbere mu gihugu, bizaba ngombwa ko agabanya igiciro ku kigero cya 80 %. Imbaraga kandi zizashyirwa mu bukangurambaga bugamije kureshya abakerarugendo b’imbere mu gihugu ariko hatirengagijwe ireme ry’isura y’u Rwanda mu ruhando mpuzamahanga. Raporo y’Ishami ry’Ubukerarugendo mu Rugaga rw’Abikorera, PSF, igaragaza ko muri Werurwe bwagize igihombo cya miliyari 34.9 Frw, bivuye ku nama zasubitswe n’ibindi bikorwa by’ubukerarugendo byahagaritswe, kubera ingamba zafashwe mu gukumira ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus.

title: Abagana hoteli na za restaurant bagiye kujya bandikwa
content: Aya mabwiriza yashyizweho mu rwego rwo gukaza ingamba mu kwirinda ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Hotel na Restaurant ni zimwe muri serivisi zemerewe gufungura ibikorwa nyuma y’iminsi 43 zifunze, ariko zisabwa ko zajya zifunga saa moya z’ijoro. RDB yatangaje ko mu rwego rwo gukomeza gukumira ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo cya COVID-19 “abayobozi b’ama-hotel, ama-restaurant n’ahandi hafatirwa amafunguro n’ibyo kunywa, basabwa guhita batangira kujya bandika umwirondoro w’ababagana.” Hazajya handikwa amazina yombi y’umuntu, nimero ya telefoni, isaha n’umunota yinjiriye aho hantu n’akarere atuyemo. Umwirondoro uzajya ubikwa mu buryo bw’ibanga gusa RDB ivuga ko “aho bizaba ngombwa uzakoreshwa mu gushaka amakuru ajyanye na COVID-19”. Urwego rw’ama-hotel no kwakira abantu, ni zimwe mu zashegeshwe bikomeye n’ingamba zo gufunga ibikorwa mu kwirinda icyorezo cya COVID-19, ndetse bisaba ingufu nyinshi mu kuzahura ubukungu bwarwo. Raporo y’Ishami ry’Ubukerarugendo mu Rugaga rw’Abikorera, PSF, igaragaza ko muri Werurwe bwagize igihombo cya miliyari 34.9 Frw, bivuye ku nama zasubitswe n’ibindi bikorwa by’ubukerarugendo byahagaritswe. Iyi raporo igaragaza ko nibura uru rwego ruzakenera miliyari 29.9 Frw mu kugoboka ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo no kwakira abantu, mu gihe cy’umwaka wose nyuma ya Coronavirus. Ni rumwe mu nzego leta yiyemeje gufasha binyuze mu kigega kigiye gutangira, aho ba nyir’ibi bikorwa bazafashwa kuvugurura amasezerano y’inguzanyo bari bafite muri banki, ndetse bakoroherezwa kubona amafaranga yo kongera kuzahura ibikorwa byabo. Kugeza ubu, abantu 285 nibo bamaze kwandura indwara ya COVID-19, abamaze gukira ni 150.

title: RDC: Abarinzi 12 ba Pariki y’Igihugu ya Virunga bishwe n’abantu bitwaje intwaro
content: Nk’uko AFP yabitangaje, iki nicyo gitero gihitanye abantu benshi muri iyi pariki, ndetse umuvugizi wayo yatangaje ko hari abandi bantu batandatu bakomeretse, kimwe n’abasivili bane banyuraga muri iyo pariki. Umwe mu bakozi b’inzego z’umutekano ariko yavuze ko abapfuye ari abantu 13 barinda pariki n’abasivili batanu. Pariki y’Igihugu ya Virunga ikora ku Rwanda na Uganda, ibarizwamo ingagi ariko ntabwo ku ruhande rwa Congo isurwa uko bikwiye kubera ibibazo by’umutekano. Uruhande rusurwa nta nkomyi ni ku Rwanda, uretse ko ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo byahagaze kubera icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Iyi pariki nabwo yaherukaga guhagarika ibikorwa byo kuyisura hagati ya Gicurasi na 2018 kugeza mu ntangiro z’umwaka ushize. Ni umwanzuro wafashwe nyuma y’uko ba mukerarugendo babiri b’Abongereza bari bashimutiwemo. Baje kurekurwa ariko umurinzi wa pariki yicirwa mu kubashimuta.

title: Uburyo bushya ushobora gusura ingagi zo mu birunga wibereye mu rugo
content: Muri iki cyumweru Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB), ku bufatanye na The Ellen Fund, Dian Fossey Gorilla Fund na Habitat XR, batangaje ko bazanye uburyo abantu bashobora gusura ingagi zo mu birunga bifashishije uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga buzwi nka ‘Virtual Reality (VR)’. Ubu buryo bwatangijwe kuwa 22 Mata 2020, ubwo hizihizwaga umunsi wahariwe kurengera Isi n’ibiyiriho, butuma abantu basura ingagi zo muri Pariki y’Ibirunga, bibereye mu rugo. Umunyamerikakazi akaba n’Umunyarwenya Ellen DeGeneres, uri no kubaka ikigo kizajya urimo kubaka ikigo kizajya gifasha mu bikorwa byo kubungabunga Ingagi muri Pariki y’Igihugu y’Ibirunga mu Rwanda, yavuze ko ubu buryo bwo gusura ingagi ‘budasanzwe kuko ari nk’aho uba uri kumwe n’ingagi’. Iyi filimi y’iminota itandatu n’amasegonda atatu ikwereka imbonankubone ingagi zo mu birunga mu buryo butangaje ziri aho zisanzwe ziba mu birunga kandi ziri mu buzima busanzwe bwa buri munsi. Bugufasha kuryoherwa n’ubwiza bwo gusura ingagi zo mu birunga mu Rwanda ukamera neza neza nk’uri kumwe na zo kuko amajwi yazo n’ay’inyoni z’aho ziri byose uba ubyumva nk’uri kumwe nazo. Iyi filimi kuyireba ni ubuntu, ushobora kuyireba ku mbuga nka Oculus, Within, Samsung VR, Littlstar na VeeR. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ubukerarugendo na Pariki z’igihugu muri RDB, Belise Kariza, avuga ko urwego rw’ubukerarugendo ku Isi rwashegeshwe bikomeye na Coronavirus, yatumye ibihugu bihagarika by’agateganyo gusura ingagi. Avuga ko bibabaje kuba badashobora kwakira abashyitsi baje kureba no kwishimira ibyiza bitatse u Rwanda ariko ari mu nyungu za buri wese kuguma mu rugo mu gihe bakomeje gukorana n’abafatanyabikorwa mu gukora no gusangiza abantu ibyiza nk’ibiri muri iyi filimi yo gusura ingagi uri mu rugo. Iyi filimi ushobora kuyireba no kuyimanura ku buntu (download) unyuze hano

title: Afurika y’Epfo: COVID-19 yatumye intare zibona ubwisanzure , ziri kugaragara ziryamye mu mihanda (amafoto)
content: Amafoto yakwirakwijwe kuri internet agaragaza intare zo muri iyo pariki ziryamye mu mutuzo, mu mihanda ya kaburimbo inyuramo imodoka zitwaye ba mukerarugendo basura iyo pariki. Ubuyobozi bwa pariki ya Kruger buherutse gushyira hanze amafoto y’izo ntare ziryamye mu mihanda , buvuga ko ubusanzwe zitajyaga zihagera kubera ko hanyuraga ba mukerarugendo benshi. Guhera tariki 25 Werurwe uyu mwaka, ibikorwa byo gusura pariki muri Afurika y’Epfo byarahagaritswe, bituma abakerarugendo bakundaga kuza muri iyo pariki babihagarika. Umuvugizi w’iyo pariki, Isaac Phaahla yabwiye CNN ati “Ubusanzwe kuzibona ziryamye mu muhanda ku manywa ntibyakundaga kubaho kuko hahoraga urujya n’uruza bigatuma zihungira mu bihuru.” Icyakora, Isaac Phaahla yavuze ko kuba abakerarugendo batakiza kureba inyamaswa, nta byinshi byahinduye ku myitwarire yazo kuko nubundi aho zari zisanzwe ziba ari ho zikiba. Perezida wa Afurika y’Epfo Cyril Ramaphosa yatangaje ko kuguma mu rugo hirindwa coronavirus bizakomeza kugeza mu mpera za Mata uyu mwaka.

title: Urwego rw’Ubukerarugendo rwahombye hafi miliyari 35 Frw muri Werurwe kubera Coronavirus
content: Iyi raporo yashyikirijwe Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere ku wa 14 Mata, igaragaza ko urwego rw’ubukerarugendo rukeneye inkunga mu gihe na nyuma y’icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Mu gukusanya amakuru ku bihombo byabayeho muri Werurwe uyu mwaka, PSF yegereye ibikorwa 207 bingana na 24% byo mu rwego rw’ubukerarugendo. Imibare yerekanye ko abakira ba mukerarugendo barimo amahoteli, muri Werurwe bagize igihombo cya miliyari 13.6 Frw, abatembereza ba mukerarugendo bahomba miliyari 20.01 Frw; abanyamwuga bategura inama bahombye miliyari 1.09 Frw naho ibindi bigo bifasha ba mukerarugendo bihomba miliyoni 152.7 Frw. Ibi bihombo byaje bisanga urwego rw’ubukerarugendo mu Rwanda rufite inguzanyo za miliyari 87.7 Frw, aho urwego rw’amahoteli arirwo rwihariye inguzanyo nini kuko rufite izingana na miliyari 83.8 Frw. Ababajijwe bagaragaje ko nibura 82% by’abakozi mu rwego rw’ubukerarugendo bahagaritswe mu kazi, ndetse 18% basigaye bagizwe na ba nyir’ibigo bakomeje gukora mu bijyanye n’igenamigambi no kwiga ku mikorere ya nyuma y’iki cyorezo. Amahoteli yakoreweho ubushakashatsi yagaragaje ko yamaze guhagarika abakozi 3515; abatwara ba mukerarugendo bo bahagarika 239, abategura inama bahagarika 20 naho abandi bafasha ba mukerarugendo bahagarika 114. Urebye ku mishahara yatangwaga n’uru rwego, amahoteli yahembaga miliyari 1.3 Frw buri kwezi, wateranya n’izindi nzego eshatu bigendana, bikaba miliyari 1.7 Frw. Iyi raporo igaragaza ko nibura uru rwego ruzakenera miliyari 29.9 Frw mu kugoboka ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo no kwakira abantu, mu gihe cy’umwaka wose nyuma ya Coronavirus. Ba nyir’ibi bikorwa bagaragaje ko kugira ngo ibyo bakora bizongere kuzura umutwe, bafashwa kubona amafaranga nibura yakwifashishwa mu kwishyura imishahara n’ibindi, ibintu byatuma abakozi bangana na 82% bagumana akazi kabo aho kuba bagakurwaho mu mwaka wa mbere nyuma y’icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Basaba kandi gukorerwa ubuvugizi ku mabanki hakavugururwa uburyo inguzanyo bafashe zakwishyurwa bitabahenze cyane, bakagabanyirizwa cyangwa bagakurirwaho inyungu ku nguzanyo mu kubabafasha kuzahura ibikorwa mu mwaka wose wa 2020. Mu bindi basaba ni uko basonerwa na Rwanda Revenue Authority mu kwishyura imisoro mu gihe runaka. Uretse ibijyanye n’amikoro, 30% by’abatanze amakuru bagaragaje ko banakeneye guhabwa ubundi bufasha mu bumenyi, bwabafasha kuzahura ibikorwa byabo nyuma y’icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Banki zitandukanye z’ubucuruzi ziheruka kwemerera abakiliya bazo bafite ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi byahungabanyijwe na Coronavirus, guhabwa amahirwe yo kutishyura inguzanyo mu gihe gishobora kugera ku mezi atatu, haba ku mafaranga bagurijwe cyangwa inyungu zayo, bitewe n’ikibazo cy’umukiliya. Gusa PSF ivuga ko banki zitorohereza abanyamahoteli mu buryo bukwiye, ku buryo ikibazo cyo guhomba kwa hoteli kimaze iminsi gishobora gufata indi ntera. Raporo ikomeza iti “Urugero nko mu myaka ine ishize, hoteli zisaga 50 zaguye mu bihombo zitezwa cyamunara cyangwa zihindurirwa icyo zakoreshwaga. Hoteli zasimbutse ibihe byo guhomba cyane zari zigihanganye n’imyenda minini ya banki, ku buryo kwishyura inyungu zose ubwo ibikorwa bizaba bisubukuwe kugeza bisubiye ku rwego byari ho mbere, nyuma ya Covid-19, bishobora kuzatuma ikibazo kirushaho kuba kibi.” Ibyo bigatuma uru rwego rusaba ko habaho uburyo bwo koroshya inyungu ku nguzanyo kugeza ibintu bisubiye ku murongo, kuba leta yabaha inkunga mu kwishyura imishahara no gushyiraho uburyo bwafasha uru rwego kubona amafaranga adahenze yatuma ibikorwa bikomeza nibura mu gihe cy’amezi 12. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ubucuruzi n’imenyekanishabikorwa muri Hilltop Hotel, Innocent Tuyishime, aherutse kubwira IGIHE ko mu rwego rw’amahoteli ho babara igihombo cy’igihe kirekire, kuko n’abari barabateguje mu mpera z’umwaka, batarafata umwanzuro uhamye kuko batazi igihe icyorezo kizarangirira. Ati “Igihombo twe mu mahoteli dufite ntabwo kiri mu kwa gatatu cyangwa ukwa kane gusa, cyamaze gufata n’amezi ari imbere. Nk’abari baratwandikiye bagombaga kuzaza mu kwa cyenda n’ukwa cumi ntabwo barafata umwanzuro ariko batwandikiye mu minsi ishize bavuga ngo tuzareba, tuzavugana.” Igihombo kandi ku mahoteli gishobora gukomeza kuko n’iyo Coronavirus yagabanya umurego, itashirira rimwe ku Isi yose ku buryo ibihugu bifungura amarembo bitikanga nka mbere. Umuryango Mpuzamahanga ushinzwe Ubukerarugendo, The World Tourism Organization (UNWTO) ugaragaza ko ubukerarugendo buzagira igihombo cya miliyari ziri hagati ya 300 na 450 z’amadolari mu 2020.

title: Imwe mu nkura eshanu zazanywe mu Rwanda zivuye i Burayi, yarapfuye
content: Ishyirahamwe ry’u Burayi rishinzwe ibijyanye n’ahororerwa Inyamaswa, EAZA; Umuryango Nyafurika urengera urusobe rw’Ibinyabuzima, African Parks na RDB, nibo batangaje ko iyi nkura yapfuye. Iyi nkura yapfuye yitwaga Manny, yari imwe muri ebyiri z’ingabo zikuze zakuwe muri Safari Park Dvůr Králové muri Tchèque. Yapfuye ku wa 10 Gashyantare 2020. Zari zazanywe ari eshatu z’ingore mu gihe ebyiri zari ingabo. Zari hagati y’imyaka ibiri n’icyenda. Harimo izavukiye muri Safari Park Dvůr Králové muri Tchèque zitwa Jasiri, Jasmina na Manny. Iyitwa Olmoti yaturutse muri Flamingo Land mu Bwongereza naho iyitwa Mandela ituruka muri Ree Park Safari muri Denmark. Izi nkura zoherejwe mu Rwanda nk’impano yahawe Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB). Itangazo ryashyizwe agaharagara na EAZA, African Parks na RDB, rivuga ko iyi nkura itishwe na ba rushimusi, ahubwo ko ibimenyetso bigaragaza ko yapfuye kubera ibibazo by’igogora ry’ibyo yabaga yariye gusa “impamvu ya nyuma y’urupfu rwayo ntiratahurwa”. Rigira riti “Dutegereje ko ibisubizo by’ibizamini byisumbuyeho bya laboratwari bigaragaza umucyo, gusa kubera amabwiriza akomeye yashyizweho mu kwirinda COVID-19, biragoye ko twakira ibi bisubizo mu gihe cya vuba”. Iyi nkura yagenzurwaga umunsi ku wundi n’impuguke ndetse yahabwaga ibiribwa biyifasha kumera neza. Gusa nyuma y’aho ubuzima bwayo buhindutse ahanini mu myitwarire yayo mu mirire, ubuyobozi bwa pariki bwahise bumenyesha abaganga b’amatungo n’inyamaswa, iza gupfa mbere y’uko bayiha ubufasha. Izindi nkura zazanye zo ziri mu buzima bwiza nta kibazo na kimwe zifite. Uburyo bwo kwimura inyamaswa nk’ubu bugamije ko zongerwa mu kindi gihugu, gusa imiterere y’ikirere ishobora gutuma zigorwa no kumenyera aho zimuriwe. Mbere yo kuzanwa mu Rwanda, zamaze amezi zitegurwa ku buryo zitazagira ibibazo muri uru rugendo rwamaze amasaha 30. Zazanywe mu buryo bugezweho ziri mu cyo umuntu yakwita nk’igisanduku aho zahererwaga amazi n’ibyo kurya. Kuri ubu Pariki y’Igihugu y’Akagera ifite inyamaswa nini eshanu zikunze gukurura ba mukerarugendo ari zo; Intare, Inzovu, Ingwe, Inkura n’Imbogo.
