title: BPR Plc yavuguruye inguzanyo ku mushahara, iyo gutunga inzu n’iyo kugura imodoka
content: Ku bijyanye n’imodoka Banki y’Abaturage yari isanzwe itanga inguzanyo yo kuyigura itarengeje imyaka itandatu ikozwe. Yatangaje ko yaje gusanga abashoboye kugura iyo modoka ari bake kubera ko inshya ihenda. Ibyo byatumye bahindura bashyiraho guha umuntu inguzanyo yo kugura imodoka imaze imyaka 10 ikozwe, igihe cyo kwishyura kiva ku myaka ine gishyirwa ku myaka itanu. Banki y’Abaturage itangaza ko bizorohereza abakiliya kuko imodoka nyinshi mu zinjira mu Rwanda ziri muri icyo cyiciro kandi zikaba ziri no mu cyiciro ibigo by’ubwishingizi byishingira. Inguzanyo yo kugura cyangwa kubaka inzu yakuwe ku myaka 20 ishyirwa ku myaka 25. Amezi umushahara ugomba kuba umaze unyura kuri konti wikurikiranya kugira ngo umuntu ayemererwe yo yakuwe ku mezi 12 ashyirwa ku mezi atandatu. Ni mu gihe inguzanyo ku mushahara yashyizwe kuri miliyoni 15 Frw zidafite ingwate avuye kuri miliyoni 6 Frw. Igihe cyo kwishyura cyongerewe kigera ku myaka itanu kivuye kuri ine. Umuyobozi ushinzwe Ubucuruzi muri BPR, Mugisha Shema Xavier, yavuze ko bahinduye kugira bajyanishe n’impinduka zabayeho mu buzima bw’abaturage no gukomeza kuba Banki y’Abaturage koko kandi yumva abakiliya. Ati “Hari impamvu nyinshi zatumye tuvugurura ziriya serivisi, iya mbere ni uko ibihe byagiye bihinduka.” Mugisha yatanze urugero ku nguzanyo ku mushahara avuga ko bakurikije ibibazo uyifata aba agiye gukemura n’uburyo ibiciro byahindutse ku isoko basanze ayo batangaga mbere adahagije. Yagize ati “Kenshi iyo ugiye kuyifata ni uko uba ugiye gukemura ibibazo byawe nko kugura ibikoresho byo mu nzu, kugura imodoka se, cyangwa kugura ikibanza, ibintu nk’ibyo. Ariko wajya kureba ugasanga uko ibiciro bihagaze ku isoko ugasanga miliyoni 6 Frw twatangaga mbere ntabwo zihagije, ibyo dusanga tugomba guhindura kugira ngo dukomeze tube Banki y’Abaturage, yumva ibyifuzo by’abakiliya bacu.” Ku mwihariko wo korohereza abantu ku bijyanye n’inguzanyo ibafasha gutunga inzu, Mugisha yavuze ko bizatuma abafite imishahara iringanirye n’iciriritse b’abakiliya ba Banki y’Abaturage baba bamwe mu bazungukira kuri gahunda ya leta yo gufasha abantu gutunga inzu zabo. Ni mu gihe Banki y’Abaturage y’u Rwanda ifite gahunda yo gutera inkunga umushinga wa leta wo kubaka inzu ziciriritse kandi abagenerwabikorwa bawo bakazaba abantu bafite imishahara iringaniye cyangwa iciriritse.

title: Equity Group yemeje ko uyu mwaka itazatanga inyungu ku migabane kubera Coronavirus
content: Icyorezo cya Coronavirus cyatumye habaho gufunga ibikorwa no gutegeka abaturage kuguma mu rugo, bigira ingaruka ku rwego rw’ubuzima, ubukungu n’imibereho y’abaturage mu buryo budasanzwe. Ingaruka z’iki cyorezo zirimo no kugabanuka cyane k’umusaruro mbumbe w’Isi yose, ubushomeri, byose bigatuma ubukungu buzasubira inyuma kurenza ikigero byigeze kubaho mu 1930. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Equity Group, Dr James Mwangi, yavuze ko inama y’ubutegetsi yafashe icyo cyemezo mu kwirinda ingaruka zazabaho kubera icyorezo cya Coronavirus, no gusigasira imari shingiro y’ikigo muri ibi bihe bitoroshye. Ati “Imari shingiro ihamye n’amafaranga abitse, biduha imbaraga n’ubushobozi bwo kubungabunga ubucuruzi bwacu, kudahungabana ndetse no kugendana n’abakiliya bacu muri ibi bihe bitoroshye”. Dr Mwangi yasobanuye kandi ko kutishyura inyungu ku migabane, bigamije gutuma banki izigama amafaranga azatuma ibasha gufasha abakiliya kurenga ingaruka za Coronavirus, ndetse ibashe gushora imari mu yandi mahirwe ahari. Yakomeje avuga ko mu gihe ihungabana ry’ubukungu ryahinduka ihungabana ry’urwego rw’imari, Equity Group izaba iri mu mwanya mwiza wo guhangana naryo, kuko izaba ifite igishoro n’amafaranga ibitse. Equity Group isanganywe ibikorwa muri Kenya, u Rwanda, Uganda, Sudani y’Epfo, Tanzania na RDC, ikagira ishoramari mu bikorwa birimo banki, ubwishingizi, ubugenzuzi, ibikorwa remezo n’ibindi.

title: I&M Bank igiye kongera imari shingiro igere kuri miliyari 25Frw
content: Iyi Nteko Rusange izaba hifashishijwe iyakure mu buryo bwa video mu kubahiriza ingamba zo kwirinda ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Izasuzuma inemeze ingingo 11. Itangazo rya I&M Bank Rwanda Plc ritumira muri iyi nama, rivuga ko mu bizasumwa bikanemezwa harimo ‘umwanzuro w’Inama y’Ubutegetsi wo gutangaza umugabane ku nyungu ntakuka ungana n’amafaranga 3 Frw ku mugabane mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari warangiye tariki 31 Ukuboza 2019.’ Hari kandi gusuzuma no kwemeza umwanzuro w’Inama y’Ubutegetsi wo ‘kongera imari shingiro ya banki ikava kuri miliyari 6 Frw ikagera kuri miliyari 25 Frw’. I&M Bank itangaza ko mu bindi bizigwa muri iyi nama ari ‘ugusuzuma no kwemeza umwanzuro w’Inama y’Ubutegetsi ku itangwa ry’umugabane w’inyongera mushya w’ubwasisi wishyuwe wose w’agaciro kangana na 10 Frw, kuri buri mugabane usanzwe ufite agaciro ka 10 Frw ugahabwa abanyamigabane basanzwe ba banki babaruwe mu gitabo cy’abanyamigabane ku itariki ya 2 Kamena 2020. Abanyamigabane kandi bazasuzuma banemeze umwanzuro w’Inama y’Ubutegetsi wo kongera imari shingiro ya sosiyete kugira ngo ibashe kuzamura imikorere yayo ndetse no kubahiriza ibisabwa n’inzego zibishinzwe binyuze mu gushyira imigabane ku isoko ifite agaciro kagera kuri miliyari 10 Frw. Mu Ukuboza 2018, Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda (BNR) yatangaje izamuka ry’imari shingiro isabwa kugira ngo banki cyangwa ikigo cy’ubwishingizi cyemererwe gukorera mu Rwanda. Imari shingiro isabwa kuri banki y’ubucuruzi yavuye kuri miliyari 5 Frw igera kuri miliyari 20 Frw, isabwa banki z’iterambere iva kuri miliyari 3 Frw igera kuri miliyari 50 Frw. Banki zikora nka koperative zo zisabwa miliyari 10 Frw. Ibigo by’ubwishingizi byavuye ku mari shingiro ya miliyari 1 Frw bigera kuri miliyari 3 Frw ku bitanga ubwishingizi rusange na miliyari 2 Frw ku bitanga ubwishingizi bw’ubuzima. Icyo gihe Guverineri wa BNR, John Rwangombwa, yagize ati “Ibi birafasha urwego rw’imari, bagende bazana indi miyoboro yafasha Abanyarwanda kurushaho kwizigamira amafaranga, kandi uko barushaho kwizigamira niko urwego rw’imari rugira ubushobozi bwo kuba babona amafaranga ahendutse batangaho inguzanyo ku gihe kirekire.” Banki zahawe imyaka itanu yo kongera imari shingiro ariko nibura mu myaka itatu zikaba zigejeje kuri miliyari 15 Frw, zikuzuza miliyari 20 Frw mu yindi ibiri ikurikira. Ibigo by’ubwishingizi rusange byo byahawe imyaka itatu, iby’ubwishingizi bw’ubuzima bihabwa ibiri. Abasesenguzi mu by’ubukungu bavuga ko Ikigo cy’Imari uko kigira imari shingiro nini ni nako kigira ubushobozi bwo gutanga imyenda kandi mu gihe kirekire.

title: Abanyamahoteli bagaragaje kubahiriza ingamba zo kwirinda Covid-19, basaba ko amasaha y’akazi yongerwa
content: Inama y’Abaminisitiri yateranye ku wa 30 Mata 2020 igamije kongera kwiga ku cyorezo cya Covid-19 n’ingamba nshya zo kugikumira, yemeje ko bumwe mu bucuruzi na serivisi bifungurwa harimo amahoteli na restaurants. Zatangiye gutanga serivisi kuwa 4 Gicurasi 2020 zisabwa gukomeza ibikorwa mu buryo bwubahiriza ingamba zo kwirinda Coronavirus kandi zigafunga saa moya z’umugoroba. Kuwa 11 Gicurasi Urwego rw’igihugu rw’Iterambere (RDB) rwongeyeho ibwiriza ryo kwandika abagana amahoteli, ama-restaurants n’ahandi hafatirwa amafunguro n’ibyo kunywa, ruvuga ko ari amakuru azabikwa mu ibanga aho bizaba ngombwa akazifashishwa mu gushaka amakuru ajyanye na Covid-19. Kuva ku wa Gatanu ushize, Ihuriro ry’Amahoteli na Restaurants mu Rwanda, ryafashe icyemezo cyo gusura amahoteli na restaurants mu rwego rwo kureba uburyo bene zo n’abazigana bari gufatanya kubahiriza amabwiriza yo kwirinda ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus. Umuyobozi w’iryo huriro, Barakabuye Nsengiyumva, yavuze ko muri rusange abanyamahoteli bishimira ko bahawe uburyo bwo gukomeza ibikorwa byabo kandi ko bumvise ko batagomba guha icyuho icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Muri rusange ngo amahoteli yubahirije ibisabwa birimo kwandika no gupima umuriro abayagana, gukaraba intoki, guhana intera [uburyo intebe n’ameza biterwa] , kudafungura utubari, kwirinda guhererekanya amafaranga mu ntoki n’ibindi. Zimwe muri restaurants IGIHE yasuye zashyizeho abakozi bashinzwe gutunganya ameza umukiliya yakoresheje mbere yuko haza kwicara undi, bakoresheje imiti yabugenewe. Umukozi wa Pili Pili restaurant, Ndayizigiye Obald yavuze ko “aho umukiliya ahagurutse bahita bashyiraho ikimenyetso cyerekana ko hatari kwakira abakiliya kugira ngo babanze kuhatunganya.” Umuyobozi wa restaurant yitwa Inka SteakHouse, Nikole Ansoni yavuze ko nubwo nk’abikorera bahanganye no kubaka ubucuruzi bwabo, bashyize imbere gukora barinda abakozi n’abakiliya. Ati “Ibi ni ibihe bikomeye kuri buri wese mu rwego rw’abikorera by’umwihariko ku rwego rw’amahoteli. Abakozi bacu nanjye ubwanjye tubanza gupima umuriro n’abakiliya bacu baza kugira ngo tumenye ko bameze neza, ikindi tukamenya ko hari umuti wo gusukura intoki bakaraba binjira. Nubwo turi kureba ko ubukungu bwazahuka, turi gukora mu buryo bwo kwirinda haba ku bakozi n’abakiliya bacu.” Umuyobozi w’Ihuriro ry’Amahoteli mu Rwanda, Barakabuye Nsengiyumva, yavuze bashimye uburyo amahoteli na restaurants bari kubahiriza ingamba zo kwirinda ikwirakwira rya Covid-19, avuga ko ari ikimenyetso cy’uko biteguye gukora kandi birinda icyo cyorezo. Cyakora ngo bagaragaza ko amasaha y’akazi akiri makeya. Ati “Utubazo tumwe na tumwe bagiye bagaragaza ni uko amasaha y’akazi akiri makeya. Mbonereho umwanya wo kugira ngo nsabe n’ababishinzwe ko bareba uko bakongera amasaha. Abanyamuryango biteguye gukora ariko banarwanya ikwirakwira ry’iki cyorezo.” Raporo y’Ishami ry’Ubukerarugendo mu Rugaga rw’Abikorera, PSF, iherutse kugaragaza ko muri Werurwe bwagize igihombo cya Miliyari 34.9 Frw, bitewe n’inama zasubitswe n’ibindi bikorwa by’ubukerarugendo byahagaritswe. Ibi bihombo byaje bisanga urwego rw’ubukerarugendo mu Rwanda rufite inguzanyo za miliyari 87.7 Frw, aho urwego rw’amahoteli arirwo rwihariye inguzanyo nini kuko rufite izingana na miliyari 83.8 Frw. Nsengiyumva avuga ko abanyamuryango bagaragaje ko amasaha y’akazi abaye saa sita abantu bajya bafunga saa tanu z’ijoro bikabafasha kuzahura ubukungu bwashegeshwe na Covid-19. Ati “Muri rusange bigejeje saa sita z’ijoro bisobanuye ko abantu bajya bahagarika akazi saa tanu. Ibyo byafasha mu kuzamura bizinesi, n’ubukungu kandi dukumira na cya cyorezo kandi byagira icyo bitanga.” Muri rusange ngo restaurants nyinshi zarafunguye ariko serivisi za hoteli ziracyafite ikibazo ahanini bitewe n’ingendo hagati y’Intara n’umujyi wa Kigali zigifunze, imipaka n’ingendo z’indege. Hoteli zimwe na zimwe zafunguye serivisi za Restaurants naho amahoteli manini yo ntarafungura na bike mu bikorwa byayo.

title: Ecobank yinjiye mu bufatanye na Google buzateza imbere ikoranabuhanga mu bacuruzi bato
content: Ni igikorwa kigamije gufasha abo bacuruzi kubyaza umusaruro amahirwe yose ari mu ikoranabuhanga bateza imbere kandi bagura ubucuruzi bwabo. Mu buryo bushya Ecobank izazana harimo nka porogaramu ya Google My Business na Google Ad products byose bigenewe abakora ubucuruzi buciriritse. Muri ibi bihe icyorezo cya Coronavirus gikomeje guhungabanya isi, gukorera mu rugo ni bumwe mu buryo bwagaragaje ko butanga ibisubizo birambye hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga. Ni uburyo abacuruzi bashobora kubyaza amahirwe, bagahura n’abakiliya babo bitabaye ngombwa ko bahura imbonankubone. Ecobank isanganywe uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga bufasha umucuruzi n’umuguzi kubana bitabaye ngombwa ko umwe ava aho ari haba mu kwishyura, kohererezanya amafaranga n’ibindi. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ubucuruzi muri Ecobank Group, Josephine Anan-Ankomah yavuze ko ari amahirwe akomeye kuba bagiye gukorana na Google. Yagize ati “Nk’ikigo kimaze igihe gitanga uburyo butandukanye bw’ikoranabuhanga ku bacuruzi bo muri Afurika, twishimiye gufatanya na Google ngo tubashe gutanga ibisubizo byiza birimo nka Google My Business na Google Ad products. Ni ibisubizo byakozwe bigenewe by’umwihariko guhaza ibyifuzo by’abakiliya bacu bakora ubucuruzi buto n’ubuciriritse.” Ecobank Group yizeye ko ubwo bufatanye na Google buzatuma barushaho gukorana bya hafi n’abakiliya babo ndetse no kureshya abashya. Ubu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga rya Google na Ecobank byitezwe ko butangira gukoreshwa muri uku kwezi kwa Gicurasi 2020, muri Afurika yo munsi y’Ubutayu bwa Sahara. Josephine Anan-Ankomah yavuze ko intego yabo ari ugutera inkunga ubucuruzi buto n’ubuciriritse bukarushaho guteza imbere ubukungu bw’ibihugu. Ati “Intego nyamukuru yacu ni ukuba umufatanyabikorwa wifuzwa n’abakora ubucuruzi buto n’ubuciriritse, tubatera inkunga igaragara mu iterambere. Ni iby’agaciro rero gukorana na Google mu kongera ubushobozi bw’abakiliya bacu bakora ubucuruzi buciriritse. Tuzabafasha gukoresha ikoranabuhanga rishya ari nayo makiriro asigaye ku bakora ubucuruzi muri ibi bihe.” Ecobank ni ikigo cyashinzwe mu mwaka wa 1985, gikorera mu bihugu bitandukanye byo muri Afurika y’Iburengerazuba n’iyo hagati. Gifite amashami asaga 1200 mu bihugu 36.

title: Banki zikomeye zikoresha miliyari 6 Frw mu kubungabunga amafaranga ahererekanywa mu ntoki
content: Muri iyi minsi Isi ihanze amaso ikoranabuhanga mu bikorwa bitandukanye by’umwihariko mu guhererekanya amafaranga nk’uburyo bwo kugabanya ikiguzi cyo kuyabungabunga. Banki Nkuru y’Igihugu (BNR) igaragaza ko kwishyurana hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga byihutisha ubukungu kandi amafaranga atakara mu bucuruzi akagabanuka. Imibare yo mu 2017 igaragaza ko nibura buri mwaka BNR itakaza miliyari 2 Frw zo gukoresha inoti nshya n’ibiceri bisaza kubera guhererekanywa mu ntoki. U Rwanda rwihaye intego ko mu 2024, amafaranga abarirwa ku kigero cya 80 % y’umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu azahererekanywa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga, avuye kuri 34.6% mu 2019. Guhererekanya amafaranga mu ikoranabuhanga bikorwa hifashishijwe Mobile Banking, Internet Banking, imashini zishyurirwaho zizwi nka POS n’ubundi. Mu Rwanda uburyo bwo guhererekanya amafaranga hakoreshejwe telefoni nibwo bugera ku baturage benshi kuko abasaga miliyoni enye babukoresha. Umubare w’amafaranga yahererekanyijwe mu Rwanda hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga hagati ya Mutarama na Mata 2020, wageze kuri miliyari 40 Frw, bivuze ko yiyongereye ku kigero cya 450 % avuye kuri miliyari 7.2 Frw zahererekanyijwe mu cyumweru cya mbere cya Mutarama 2020. Banki y’Igihugu BNR ivuga ko kudakoresha ikoranabuhanga bitera igihombo cya 6% mu bucuruzi mu gihe kurikoresha bituma igihombo kigabanuka kikagera kuri 2%. Gukoresha inoti n’ibiceri bitwara BNR abarirwa hagati ya miliyari 2-3 Frw buri mwaka, yose agenda ku bikorwa byo gusimbuza inoti zishaje, gukora ibiceri ariko utabariyemo imishahara y’abakozi. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa RBA, Robin Bairstow, akaba n’Umuyobozi wa I&M Bank, yatangaje ko amabanki ahendwa no kubungabunga amafaranga ahererekanywa mu ntoki. Yabwiye RBA ati “Ufashe nka banki eshanu za mbere wasanga zikoresha nka miliyari esheshatu mu mirimo yo kwita ku mafaranga harimo nk’ubwikorezi bwayo, hagati yacu na Banki Nkuru y’Igihugu. Iyo umuntu aje muri banki akishyura amafaranga, akeneye gutwara mu ntoki amafaranga menshi hari ibigo [bicunga umutekano] dukorana nabyo tuba tugomba kubyishyura. Ibyo byose ni amafaranga yishyurwa kandi kugeza uyu munsi ari ku mutwe wa za banki kuko nizo ziyishyura.’’ Yakomeje ati “Ubirebeye mu ndorerwamo y’ubucuruzi rero usanga tubashije kugabanya amafaranga ahererekanywa mu ntoki, abakiliya bakitabira gukoresha ikoranabuhanga byafasha urwego rw’imari kuzigama amafaranga atari make.’’ Muri banki z’ubucuruzi 16 zikorera mu Rwanda, 15 nizo zikoresha Mobile Banking iha umukiliya ubushobozi bwo kubitsa no kubikuza akoresheje telefoni igendanwa. Iri koranabuhanga rikoreshwa n’ababarirwa muri miliyoni ebyiri bavuye ku 155 000 mu myaka 10 ishize mu gihe amafaranga ahererekanywa yavuye kuri miliyari 5 Frw, agera kuri miliyari 85 Frw. Banki 13 ni zo zikoresha Internet Banking, yifashishwa n’abacuruzi n’ibigo by’ubucuruzi bibarirwa mu 100 000 mu bikorwa byo guhererekanya amafaranga. Mu 2019, hahererekanyijwe abarirwa muri miliyari 2000 Frw binyuze muri Internet Banking. Ibikorwa byo guhererekanya amafaranga arenze miliyoni eshanu bikorwa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga rya RIPPS rikorera muri BNR, buri mwaka abakiliya banini na za banki barinyuzaho miliyari 10 000 Frw. Umuyobozi ushinzwe Iterambere rya Serivisi muri Banki Nkuru y’Igihugu, BNR, Karamuka John, yavuze ko hari kunozwa uko umubare wa za sheke cyangwa izindi mpapuro zikoreshwa mu buryo bwo kwishyurana wagabanuka. Yagize ati “Icyo Banki Nkuru iri gukora ni uko hari icyo iri kongera kuri ubwo buryo [system] ngo ishobore gukora amasaha 24/24.’’ “Izindi serivisi zisaba ko amafaranga make yishyurwa, hari undi mushinga dufite aho duhuza za Sacco, ibigo by’imari iciriritse, za banki. Ku buryo niba uri muri Airtel ushobora koherereza uri muri MTN, cyangwa uri muri banki akoherereza uri muri Sacco. Ni ibindi bikorwa remezo bizafasha kubona izo serivisi mu buryo bwihuse.’’ Imibare ya BNR yerekana ko mu mezi abiri ashize amafaranga yahererekanyijwe hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga yikubye inshuro eshatu, bitewe n’ivanwaho ry’ikiguzi cy’iyo serivisi cyafashwe mu kwirinda ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus.

title: MTN Rwanda yagejeje ku isoko internet yihariye ikoreshwa mu rugo
content: Igitekerezo cyo gutanga internet yo mu rugo gifite imizi mu mpera za 2019, MTN Rwanda yakigize mu gukomeza gufasha abakiliya bayo no kuborohereza gukora akazi bari mu ngo zabo nta nkomyi. Ni internet nk’isanzwe ikoreshwa mu biro ariko ishyirwa mu rugo binyuze mu gushyiraho antene [ihuzwa n’umunara uri hafi] na router ishobora gutanga internet nziramugozi [wireless] cyangwa umufatabuguzi akifashisha umugozi [cable]. Umuyobozi w’Ishami ry’Ubucuruzi muri MTN Rwanda, Ndoli Didas, yabwiye IGIHE ko iyo internet ifite umwihariko kuko umuntu agura umuvuduko w’iyo ashaka aho kugura megabyte nkuko abakoresha telefoni babigenza. Yagize ati “Ni internet ifite umuvuduko nk’usanzwe dutanga mu biro hakoreshejwe fibre optique. Twazanye ikoranabuhanga ryoroshye abantu bashobora gukoresha bakayigeza mu rugo mu buryo bwihuse.’’ Ndoli yavuze ko iyo internet ishobora kuba igisubizo ku bana bigira mu rugo cyangwa abandi bahakorera akazi. Ati ‘‘Internet tuyitanga mu buryo bw’umuvuduko, nta mupaka uri ku byo umanura (dowload) n’ibyo ushyiraho (upload) mu kwezi kose.’’ MTN Rwanda yagennye ko umufatabuguzi ashobora guhitamo kuva kuri megabyte imwe ku isegonda [1Mbps-iyi aba ari ingano y’ibyo ashobora gukoresha iyo internet], kugera kuri 25 MB ku isegonda. Ndoli yavuze ko ‘‘Twasanze ari ngombwa ko tubasangisha internet mu rugo kuko ibihe tugezemo umuntu aba akorana n’abo badahuje amasaha ku buryo hari igihe bakenerana ariko atakiri mu kazi, ni byiza kugira internet mu rugo ku buryo woroherwa no gukora ibyo ushaka igihe cyose.’’ Kuva mu byumweru bibiri bishize, mu isuzuma ryo gutanga internet yo mu rugo, ingo zisaga 150 zarayihawe kandi abayigejejweho biganjemo ab’i Kigali banyuzwe n’imikorere yayo. Ati ‘‘Internet yo mu rugo urayikeneye, kuko nk’iya telefoni ushobora kuba uri kuyivugiraho ikagenda buhoro ariko iyo mu rugo ifite umuvuduko uri hejuru, buri wese ashobora kuyikoresho kandi mu buryo buhoraho.’’ Uwasabye ashobora guhabwa internet mu gihe kitarenze amasaha 48 ku bari mu Mujyi wa Kigali, mu gihe mu ntara bitarenza iminsi ine. Ikiguzi cyo guhabwa antene (point to point) igufasha kubona internet mu rugo rwawe, cyaramanuwe kivanwa ku 300 000 Frw ku biro gishyirwa ku bihumbi 50 Frw ku yo mu rugo. Iyo umuntu yayihawe hakurikiraho kugura ya yindi ya buri kwezi bitewe n’umuvuduko yifuza. MTN yatanze umurongo wa 3111 wo guhamagara ngo abakeneye ibisobanuro birambuye kuri internet cyangwa ubufasha bagerweho bwangu. MTN Rwanda ifite ubunararibonye bw’imyaka isaga 20 imaze itanga serivisi z’itumanaho mu Rwanda. Izwi muri serivisi zo guhamagara, internet, kwishyurana hifashishijwe uburyo bwa Mobile Money n’ibindi byagize uruhare rukomeye mu iterambere ry’ubukungu bw’u Rwanda. MTN ni wo muyoboro wa telefoni ukoreshwa na benshi mu Rwanda aho basaga miliyoni enye mu gihe internet yayo igera mu gihugu hose ku kigero cya 99%, ubariyemo ahakoreshwa 4G na 3.75G ndetse na fibre optique. Mu kwagura umuyoboro wayo, iyi sosiyete yashoye miliyari 130 Frw mu kubaka ibikorwa remezo mu myaka itanu.

title: Amafaranga yahererekanyijwe hifashishijwe telefoni yiyongereyeho ku kigero cya 450% mu mezi atatu
content: Imibare yumvikanisha ko kwishyurana mu ntoki byagabanyutse ku buryo bugaragara muri iyi minsi Isi yose ihangayikishijwe n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus cyandurira mu gukoranaho. Muri Werurwe nibwo Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda, BNR yemeje ko mu gihe cy’amezi atatu uhereye tariki 19 Werurwe 2020 nta kiguzi kizongera gucibwa umuntu ukura amafaranga kuri konti yo muri banki ayashyira kuri Mobile Money cyangwa ayakura kuri Mobile Money ayohereza kuri banki mu rwego rwo kugabanya ibyago byo kwandura coronavirus. Ibyo bijyana n’uko nta kiguzi gicibwa abantu bahererekanya amafaranga kuri Mobile Money. Nkuko bigaragara muri raporo yakozwe n’Ikigo insight2impact ku bufatanye na RURA, mu cyumweru cya mbere cya gahunda ya Guma mu Rugo umubare w’abahererekanya amafaranga mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga wageze kuri miliyoni 1.2, uvuye ku bantu 600 000 mu cyumweru cyari cyabanjirije Guma mu Rugo. Mu cyumweru cya nyuma cya Mata 2020, abantu miliyoni 1.8 bahererekanyije amafaranga mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda. Guhera tariki 9 Werurwe kugeza tariki 15 Werurwe, hahererekanyijwe amafaranga angana na miliyari 10.7 Frw ariko mu cyumweru cyarangiye tariki 22 Werurwe amafaranga yahererekanyijwe mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga yari ageze kuri miliyari 24 Frw. Iyi raporo igaragaza ko nubwo umubare munini w’abantu bahererekanyije amafaranga hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga ari abagabo, abagore nabo bariyongereye kuko mbere ya Guma mu Rugo, abagore boherezaga amafaranga bari ku kigero cya 31 % ariko mu cyumweru cya gatanu cya Guma mu rugo bari bageze kuri 36 %. Kwishyura ibicuruzwa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga nabyo byariyongereye. RURA na Insight2impact bigaragaza ko uhereye hagati muri Gashyantare uyu mwaka ukageza hagati muri Mata, agaciro k’amafaranga yishyurwa ibicuruzwa mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kiyongereyeho 700 % mu cyumweru. Raporo ivuga ko uko kwiyongera k’uburyo bwo kwishyura no kohereza amafaranga hifashishijwe ikoranabuganga bikwiriye gutanga amasomo kuri za Leta zishaka guteza imbere ubukungu bushingiye ku ikoranabuhanga. Bagira bati “Ni ngombwa ko bishyirwa ku giciro gito. Kuvanaho ikiguzi cyo koherereza amafaranga hifashishijwe telefone mu gihe cya Guma mu Rugo, byagaragaje ko ubwo buryo bushobora guhangana n’ubwo kwishyura mu ntoki.” Raporo ivuga ko nubwo abakoresha uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga mu kwishyurana biyongereye, byaba byiza gutegereza nyuma y’icyorezo cya Coronavirus ibintu byasubiye ku murongo akaba aribwo hafatwa umwanzuro niba ubwo buryo buramba. Banki Nkuru y’Igihugu (BNR) igaragaza ko kwishyurana hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga byihutisha ubukungu kandi amafaranga atakara mu bucuruzi akagabanuka cyane. Imibare yo mu 2017 igaragaza ko nibura buri mwaka BNR itakaza miliyari ebyiri zo gukoresha inoti nshya n’ibiceri bisaza kubera guhererekanywa mu ntoki. U Rwanda rufite intego ko mu mwaka wa 2024, amafaranga abarirwa ku kigero cya 80 % y’umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu azajya ahererekanywa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga, avuye kuri 34.6% mu 2019.

title: U Rwanda rugiye gushyira miliyari 145 Frw muri RwandAir
content: Guhera muri Gashyantare uyu mwaka ubwo Coronavirus yakazaga umurego, ingendo z’indege ni bimwe mu bikorwa byakomwe mu nkokora cyane kuko ibihugu byinshi byahise bifunga imipaka, ingendo zirahagarikwa. Ikigo Mpuzamahanga gishinzwe Ingendo zo mu Kirere (IATA) giherutse gutangaza ko urwego rwo gutwara abantu mu ndege ruzahomba miliyari zigera kuri 252$, bitewe n’uko ibihugu byinshi byafunze imipaka ku ndege zitwara abagenzi ndetse n’ibindi bikorwa. Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yafashe iya mbere mu kugabanya icyo gihombo kuri RwandAir, yongera ingengo y’imari iyigenera. Amafaranga azahabwa RwandAir azava muri miliyari 306.5 Frw zagenewe ibikorwa by’ishoramari rya Leta mu 2020/2021. Minisitiri w’Imari n’Igenamigambi, Dr Uzziel Ndagijimana, ubwo yagezaga ku Nteko Ishinga Amategeko imitwe yombi, imbanzirizamushinga y’ingengo y’imari izakoreshwa mu mwaka wa 2020/2021, yavuze ko uretse gufasha RwandAir kwivana mu ngaruka za Coronavirus, ayo mafaranga azanifashishwa muri gahunda zari zisanzwe zo kwagura ibikorwa byayo hatangizwa ibyerekezo bishya no kugura indege nshya. Ndagijimana yavuze ko urwego rwo gutwara abantu n’ibintu ari rumwe mu zashegeshwe cyane n’ingaruka z’icyo cyorezo. Mu gihe umwaka ushize serivisi z’ubwikorezi zari ziyongereye ku gipimo cya 12 %, uyu mwaka Minisiteri y’Imari n’Igenamigambi ivuga ko umusaruro w’urwo rwego uzamanuka ku gipimo cya -1.9%. Muri Mata uyu mwaka, RwandAir yafashe ingamba zirimo kugabanya imishahara y’abakozi, abandi amasezerano yabo arahagarikwa hagabanywa amafaranga isohora kubera ko aho yaturukaga hari hafunzwe. Ubukerarugendo ni bumwe mu bituma indege zibona abakiliya nyamara Urugaga rw’Abikorera mu Muryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, (East African Business Council, EABC) ruherutse gutangaza ko abakerarugendo bagera kuri miliyoni 6.2 bagombaga kuza gusura akarere bashobora kugabanuka cyane kubera Coronavirus. Muri Mata uyu mwaka, IATA yagaragazaga ko abagenzi bagera kuri 79 000 RwandAir yateganyaga kuzabona bashobora kugabanuka kubera Coronavirus, bikayigeza ku gihombo cya miliyoni 20.4 z’amadolari.

title: Depite Mutesi yasabye ko kwizigamira mu Rwanda byagirwa itegeko
content: Yabisabye kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 21 Gicurasi ubwo Minisitiri w’Imari n’Igenamigambi yagezaga ku Nteko Ishinga Amategeko imitwe yombi imbanzirizamushinga y’ingengo y’imari y’igihe giciriritse hamwe n’imibare y’ikigereranyo cy’ingengo y’imari ya 2020/2021-2022/2023. Minisitiri Dr Uzziel Ndagijimana yavuze ko Guverinoma izakomeza gushishikariza abaturage kwitabira ikigega ‘Ejo Heza’, imwe muri gahunda z’igihe kirekire ziha buri Munyarwanda wese uko amikoro ye angana, uburyo bwo kwizigamira bworoshye buzamugirira akamaro. Uretse Ejo Heza, Ndagijimana yavuze ko hari n’ikindi kigega cy’ubwizigame cyitwa Rwanda National Investment Trust Ltd (RNIT) Iterambere Fund gitanga ubundi buryo bwo kuzigama butari igihe kirekire cyane ariko bwunguka. Depite Mutesi Anita yavuze ko ubukangurambaga bwo kwizigama ari bwiza ariko ko hakenewe ko ubwizigame ku banyarwanda biba itegeko cyane ku bakorera imishahara. Ati “Mu by’ukuri umuco w’abanyarwanda wo kwizigamira uragoye cyane, ntekereza ko kwizigamira bibaye itegeko cyane cyane ku bahembwa umushahara n’iyo bakurwaho akantu gato ariko hakagira ikintu umuntu yizigamira, byaba byiza.” Isuzuma ryakozwe n’ikigo FinScope mu 2016, ryagaragaje ko abanyarwanda basaga 86 % by’abakuze bakorana n’ibigo by’imari, ni ukuvuga abagera kuri miliyoni 5.1. Icyakora umwaka ushize, Minisiteri y’imari n’igenamigambi yagaragazaga ko ubwizigame mu Rwanda bukiri munsi ya 15 % by’umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu, mu gihe rwari rwiyemeje ko muri 2020 ubwizigame bw’abaturage buzaba bungana na 20 % by’umusaruro mbumbe. Minisitiri Ndagijimana yavuze ko hari ibindi bitekerezo byagiye bitangwa mbere bisaba ko kwizigamira bigirwa itegeko, gusa ngo nta mwanzuro wigeze ufatwa. Ati “Ibiganiro byagiye bibaho kuri iki kibazo ariko nta mwanzuro wa nyuma urafatwa. Kugeza ubu abantu barakangurirwa kuzigama ku bushake bakanoroherezwa ariko abantu bakomeza kungurana ibitekerezo niba ubu buryo bwafasha abanyamishahara kuba bagira ikintu bazigama gihoraho.” Ikigega RNIT Iterambere Fund kimaze kujyamo ubwizigame busaga miliyari 11 Frw mu gihe muri Ejo Heza hamaze kujyamo asaga miliyari ebyiri. Ibihugu byose byateye imbere ni ibifite umubare munini w’abaturage bakorana na za banki n’ibindi bigo by’imari ku buryo byorohera igihugu kumenya uko ubukungu buhagaze no kumenya ahakiri icyuho ngo gikurweho. U Rwanda rufite intego yo kuzamura ubukungu bwarwo bukava ku rwego rw’ibihugu bikennye rukagera mu biyingayinga ibikize mu 2035 no kugera mu bikize mu cyerekezo cya 2050.

title: Ingengo y’imari y’u Rwanda ya 2020/2021 iziyongeraho miliyari 228 Frw
content: Ingengo y’imari izagera kuri miliyari 3245.7 Frw ivuye kuri 3017.1 Frw yakoreshejwe mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari ushize. Byatangajwe na Minisitiri w’Imari n’Igenamigambi, Dr Ndagijimana Uzziel, ubwo yagezaga ku Nteko Ishinga Amategeko imitwe yombi, imbanzirizamushinga y’ingengo y’imari izakoreshwa mu mwaka wa 2020/2021. Iyi ngengo y’imari yaje mu gihe u Rwanda n’Isi muri rusange bihanganye n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus, cyatumye bimwe mu bikorwa by’ubukungu n’iterambere bisubira inyuma. Minisitiri Dr Ndagijimana yavuze ko kubera guhungabana kw’ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi byavagamo imisoro, bizagira ingaruka ku misoro yakusanywaga ku buryo imisoro izinjizwa mu 2020/2021 izagabanuka ikagera kuri miliyari 1421 Frw ugereranyije na miliyari 1569 Frw yakusanyijwe mu ngengo y’imari iri gusozwa. Mu kuziba icyuho cy’imisoro yari kuzakusanywa, Dr Ndagijimana yavuze ko Guverinoma izongera inguzanyo ziva hanze no mu gihugu hibandwa ku zihendutse kandi hubahirizwa igipimo ntarengwa cy’umwenda w’igihugu. Amafaranga akomoka imbere mu gihugu habariwemo n’inguzanyo z’imbere mu gihugu azaba ari miliyari 1962.8 Frw, bingana na 60.5 % by’ingengo y’imari yose. Inkunga z’amahanga zizaba zingana na miliyari 492.5 Frw, ni ukuvuga 15.2 % by’ingengo y’imari yose, mu gihe inguzanyo z’amahanga zizaba ari miliyari 783.4 Frw, bingana na 24.1 % by’ingengo y’imari. Muri rusange amafaranga ava imbere mu gihugu wongeyeho inguzanyo z’amahanga igihugu kizishyura afite uruhare rungana na 84.6 % mu ngengo y’imari itaha. Dr Ndagijimana yavuze ko amafaranga menshi azakoreshwa mu ngengo y’imari isanzwe (ibikorwa bihora bigaruka) kuko angana na miliyari 1582.8 Frw (48%), azakoreshwa mu mishinga y’iterambere azagera kuri miliyari 1294.5 Frw (40%) naho Miliyari 306.5 Frw (9.4%) azakoreshwa mu bikorwa by’ishoramari rya Leta. Muri ibyo bikorwa by’ishoramari rya Leta harimo gushyigikira ibikorwa by’abikorera mu guhangana n’ingaruka z’icyorezo cya coronavirus, kwagura ibikorwa bya RwandAir, no kongerera ubushobozi Banki y’Igihugu Itsura Amajyambere (BRD). Minisiteri y’Imari n’Igenamigambi igaragaza ko Guverinoma izibanda cyane cyane ku ngamba zo kuzahura ubukungu, Kubaka urwego rw’ubuzima rukomeye hibandwa kongera ibikorwa remezo, kongera umusaruro w’ibikomoka ku buhinzi n’ubworozi, kongera imbaraga muri gahunda zo kuzamura imibereho myiza y’abaturage, kongera imirimo hihutishwa imishinga y’ibikorwa remezo n’ibindi. Ubukungu buzazamukaho 2% Kubera icyorezo cya Coronavirus, ubukungu ku Isi hose buzagabanuka, ubw’u Rwanda byitezwe ko buzazamuka ku gipimo cya 2% mu mwaka wa 2020 buvuye kuri 9.4 % bwazamutseho umwaka ushize. Icyakora Minisitiri Ndagijimana yavuze ko kubera ingamba zafashwe mu kuzahura ubukungu, biteganyijwe ko ubukungu bw’u Rwanda mu mwaka wa 2021 buzazamuka ku gipimo cya 6.3 % na 8 % mu 2022. Mu mwaka wa 2020 ibyo u Rwanda rwohereza hanze bizagabanukaho 19 % naho ibyo rutumizayo bigabanukeho 7%. Iterambere ry’urwego rw’ubuhinzi riziyongera ku gipimo cya 3 %, ibihingwa ngandurarugo biziyongera ku gipimo cya 3.4%. Urwego rw’inganda ruzazamuka ku gipimo cya 4 %, urw’ubwubatsi ruziyongera ku gipimo cya 5.4 % naho urwego rwa serivisi ruzamukeho 1 % kubera ingaruka za Coronavirus cyane cyane ku bukerarugendo no kwakira inama. Umusaruro w’amahoteli na resitora uteganyijwe kugabanuka ku kigero cya -30.7 % naho uw’ubwikorezi wo ukazamanuka ku gipimo cya -1.9%. Ku ngengo y’imari yari yateganyirijwe umwaka wa 2019/2020, hagaragajwe ko imaze gukoreshwa ku gipimo cya 89% kandi ko ukurikije ibikorwa Guverinoma izishyurwa muri Kamena 2020 umwaka w’ingengo y’imari uzarangira ikoreshejwe neza.

title: BNR yazamuye umubare w’amafaranga umuntu ashobora kubikuza akoresheje sheki
content: Ni amabwiriza ya BNR agomba gusimbura ayashyizweho ku wa 21 Werurwe, ubwo abaturarwanda basabwaga kuguma mu ngo, hirindwa ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Ayo mabwiriza yavugaga ko abakiliya ba banki bakwiye kongera uburyo bakoresha serivisi z’imari nko guhererekanya amafaranga hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga, hagamijwe kugabanya uburyo abantu bahererekanya amafaranga mu ntoki, kuko bishobora kugira uruhare mu gukwirakwiza COVID-19. Yakomeje iti “Mu rwego rwo kwirinda no kugabanya ibyago byo gukwirakwiza COVID-19, umuntu uzaba yishyuwe hakoreshejwe sheki ntazemererwa gufata amafaranga kuri ‘guichet’, ahubwo amafaranga ye azajya ashyirwa kuri konti ye. “ “Mu gihe ariko sheki ari iy’umukiliya wa banki akayikoresha agiye kubikuza kuri konti ye, umubare w’amafaranga afatira kuri ‘guichet’ ntushobora kurenga miliyoni imwe y’amanyarwanda ku munsi.” Mu mabwiriza mashya, BNR yavuze ko mu gihe umuntu atari yemerewe kubikuza kuri konti ye amafaranga arenga miliyoni imwe akoresha sheki ndetse uwayihawe ntiyemererwe kuyibikuza, abakora ubucuruzi bakomeje gusaba ko byahinduka. BNR yakomeje iti “Nyuma y’ubusabe butandukanye abakora ubucuruzi bagejeje uri Guverinoma, kandi mu rwego rwo guteza imbere uburyo bwo guhererekanya amafaranga mu Rwanda hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga, Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda iramenyesha abaturage ko guhera ku wa 21 Gicurasi 2020, amafaranga umuntu yemerewe kubikuza akoresheje sheki ye araba 5 000 000 Frw, mu gihe undi wayihawe atazarenza 2 000 000Frw.” Impinduka muri aya mabwiriza zikozwe mu gihe guhera ku wa 4 Gicurasi 2020, bijyanye n’intambwe yari imaze guterwa mu kurwanya icyorezo cya Coronavirus, Guverinoma yemeye ko ibikorwa bimwe bisubukurwa, ariko bigakoresha abakozi b’ingenzi, abandi bagakorera mu rugo hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga, aho bishoboka. Gusa abakora ubucuruzi bakomeje kugaragaza ko kwishyurana hakoreshejwe sheki ari bumwe mu buryo bifashisha cyane, ku buryo miliyoni imwe ari amafaranga make cyane. Aya mafaranga azamuwe mu gihe guhera ku wa 1 Kamena hazafungurwa ibindi bikorwa birimo nk’ingendo zihuza Intara n’Umujyi wa Kigali ndetse n’ingendo za moto zitwara abagenzi, ibikorwa bizarushaho kongera ubucuruzi bufunguye. Ibigikomeje gufungwa harimo utubari, insengero, amashuri, ibikorwa by’imyidagaduro n’ibindi bihuza abantu benshi. Kugeza kuri uyu wa Gatatu, mu Rwanda hamaze kugaragara abantu 314 banduye Coronavirus mu bipimo 53 317 bimaze gufatwa. Muri abo harimo abantu 216, basezerewe mu bitaro nyuma yo kuvurwa bagakira.

title: U Rwanda rufite icyuho cya toni zisaga 10.000 ngo rwihaze mu buki
content: Kuri uyu wa 20 Gicurasi, isi yose yizihije umunsi mpuzamahanga wahariwe inigwahabiri z’inzuki mu rwego rwo kuzirikana akamaro kazo mu buzima bwa muntu. Mu Rwanda inzuki zizwi mu buvumvu kuko ari zo zikora ubuki bwifashishwa na benshi mu bintu bitandukanye. Umuyobozi w’ishami rishinzwe ubworozi bw’inzuki mu kigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe ubuhinzi n’ubworozi, RAB, Mwiza Kazimbaya Willy, yabwiye IGIHE ko ubuvumvu bukomeje gutera imbere ariko hakenewe imbaraga mu kwita ku nzuki kugira ngo zitange umusaruro uhagije. Abavumvu bakomeje kugaragaza kenshi ko mu bituma umusaruruo wabo utiyongera, ari uko inzuki zabo zicwa n’imiti yica udusimba iterwa mu myaka, zajya guhova zigapfa. Umuvumvu wabigize umwuga, Karangwa Sewase, yabwiye IGIHE ko hakwiriye kwigwa uburyo hakorwa ubuhinzi budakoresha imiti yica inzuki. Ati “Ese umuntu ahinze ntakoreshe iriya miti yica inzuki, ntabwo yakweza? Nibwo bushakashatsi ndimo. Ubusimba bwinshi buzanwa n’ibyo twita inyongeramusaruro, umuntu akoresheje ubundi bwoko bw’ifumbire gakondo […] yo ubwayo iba yifitemo acide zikabwica ku buryo umusaruro wacu ushobora kuba mwinshi, ntihavuke utundi dusimba turya imyaka n’inzuki zikabaho.” Mwiza yemera ko hari imiti yifashishwa mu buhinzi yica inzuki, ariko akavuga ko hari n’ubumenyi buke ku bavumvu, aho badashaka ibindi biryo byunganira ibyo inzuki zihova ku buryo hari igihe zishobora kwicwa n’inzara, bakabyita ko zishwe n’imiti. Ati “Hari abigeze kumpamagara i Nyamagabe ngo ndebe ikibazo abavumvu bahuye nacyo, bo bavugaga ko ari imiti ariko maze gusuzuma neza impamvu yatumye inzuki zipfa, nasanze ari uko batazigaburiraga, zari zifite inzara.” Mu gihe hakomeje gukorwa ubushakashatsi ngo haboneke imiti yica udusimba ariko itagira ingaruka ku nzuki, Mwiza yagiriye inama abavumvu gushaka ibiryo byunganira inzuki mu rwego rwo kuzifasha kongera umusaruro. Ubusanzwe inzuki zigaburirwa ibindi birimo amazi y’isukari n’ibyo kurya bagura mu ruganda, bituma urwiru rushobora kororoka rugatera amagi menshi, umuzinga ukiyongera. Mwiza yagize ati “Iyo inzuki zitabonye ibyo byo kurya umuzinga ugenda usubira inyuma kugeza igihe umuvumvu ashobora kuzasanga inzuki zararangiye.” “Abantu bafite imirima yabo bwite bashobora gutera n’ibiti by’indabo kugira ngo inzuki zabo zitajya zijya kure ahubwo zibone ibyo kurya hafi. Twatangiye kubakangurira kororera mu mashyamba ya Leta ari hirya no hino mu turere.” Karangwa yavuze ko ubworozi bw’inzuki bwitaweho, bushobora kuza muri bimwe byinjiriza u Rwanda amadevizi menshi. Ati “Inzuki ntawe uziragira, ntabwo zirwana, ziriragira zikicyura gusa zikabangamirwa n’aho zagiye gutara. Abantu dushoyemo imari, yaba Made in Rwanda izanira amafaranga igihugu. Tubonye umusaruro mwinshi twasagurira n’amahanga, ubuki bugakurikira icyayi mu kuzanira igihugu amadovize.” Kuba ubuki bwose bukenewe mu gihugu butaboneka, biha urwaho ubuki bwo mu bindi bihugu kwigarurira isoko ry’u Rwanda. Karangwa yavuze ko ari igihombo ku banyarwanda atari mu buryo bw’amafaranga gusa ahubwo no mu buryo bw’ireme ry’ubuki bagura. Ati “Ubuki bwo mu Rwanda buraryoha by’umwihariko ubwo Majyaruguru ahantu hakonje mu mashyamba, buba buryoshye kuruta ubw’ahandi.” Umuvumvu Karangwa Sewase yavuze ko isoko ry’ubuki mu Rwanda rihari cyane ahubwo igikenewe ari ugukomeza gufasha abavumvu kongera umusaruro. Mu Rwanda habarirwa abavumvu basaga ibihumbi 80 ariko ababikora kinyamwuga ntibarenze 45 %. Habarirwa kandi imizinga ya kijyambere igera ku bihumbi 90, mu gihe isaga ibihumbi 200 ari gakondo. Mwiza yavuze ko bagiye gukomeza gukorera ubuvugizi abavumvu kugira ngo bahabwe ibyangombwa nkenerwa byose bituma bongera umusaruro. Uretse ubuki bukoreshwa mu ngeri zitandukanye nko mu nganda z’imiti, izenga inzoga, izikora amabombo n’ibindi hari n’ibindi bitandukanye kandi bikomoka ku nzuki bigira akamaro. Mu bindi biva ku nzuki bigira akamaro harimo nk’ibishashara byifashishwa mu gukora za buji, insinda zifashishwa mu buvuzi, Urucumbu (propolis) rukoreshwa mu gukora amavuta n’ibindi bikoresho by’ubwiza, ubumara bw’inzuki bukoreshwa mu buvuzi bw’indwara nka za rubagimpande ndetse n’Igikoma cy’urwiru (Gelée royale) gikorwamo amavuta afite intungamubiri. title: BK Group PLC yemeje abagize inama y’ubutegetsi, yizeza abakiliya kubaba hafi muri ibi bihe
content: Byatangajwe kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 20 Gicurasi 2020, ubwo abanyamigabane bayo bakoraga Inama Ngarukamwaka y’Inteko Rusange yabaye hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga. Barebeye hamwe uko umwaka ushize wagenze, bafata n’ingamba ngo icyo kigo gikomeze gutera imbere. Umwaka ushize wa 2019, BK Group PLC yungutse miliyari 37.3 Frw, bingana n’izamuka rya36 % ugereranyije n’umwaka wabanje. Inguzanyo zatanzwe ziyongereyeho 19.3 % ugereranyije n’umwaka wabanje zigera kuri miliyari 678 Frw, ubwizigame bw’abakiliya bwiyongereyeho 20.8 % bugera kuri miliyari 642.7 Frw mu gihe imigabane ya BK Group PLC nayo yiyongereyeho 13.4 %, igera ku gaciro ka miliyari 220.8 Frw. BK Group Plc ibumbiye hamwe ibigo birimo Banki ya Kigali, BK TecHouse, BK General Insurance na BK Capital. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa BK Group PLC, Dr Diane Karusisi yavuze ko ingamba zo kwirinda Coronavirus zagize ingaruka ku banyarwanda barimo n’abakiliya babo, ku buryo iki kigo cyishatsemo miliyoni hafi 300 Frw zo gufasha mu bihe nk’ibi. Dr Karusisi yijeje abakiliya n’abanyamigabane b’iki kigo ko nubwo hariho ibibazo by’ubukungu, kizakomeza kubaba hafi mu bikorwa byabo, kuko Banki ya Kigali imaze gushinga imizi mu bijyanye n’imari shingiro. Mu minsi ishize, Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yatangije ikigega cya miliyoni 200 z’amadolari kizafasha mu kuzahura ubukungu, hibandwa ku nzego zazahajwe cyane n’ingamba zo kwirinda Coronavirus. Dr Karusisi yavuze ko nabwo ari uburyo buzafasha BK Group Plc gukomeza gufasha abakiliya bayo, kuko ayo mafaranga azajya anyuzwa mu mabanki kandi agafasha abarimo abakiliya ba BK Group PLC gukomeza gukora. Ati “Izi nkunga zizatangwa binyuze muri za banki, hari nk’uburyo bwihariye buzafasha abakora mu rwego rw’ubukerarugendo n’amahoteli buzatuma bongera guhabwa inguzanyo ku nyungu ntoya, bikazaba ari ubufasha ku bakiliya bo mu bukerarugendo n’amahoteli.” Nka Banki ya Kigali, yagiye ishyiraho uburyo bwo korohereza abakiliya bayo bagizweho ingaruka na Coronavirus, haba mu guhabwa inguzanyo no kuzishyura. Abakiliya bafite ibikorwa byahungabanye bahawe uburyo bwo kutishyura, bushobora kugeza ku gihe cy’amezi atatu. Iyi banki kandi yashyizeho uburyo butandukanye bw’ikoranabuhanga bufasha abakiliya guhererekanya amafaranga no gukora ubucuruzi badafashe amafaranga mu ntoki, biri mu murongo wo guteza imbere ubukungu no kugabanya ibyago byo kwandura Coronavirus. Banki ya Kigali kandi yashyizeho inguzanyo idasanzwe yise ‘Turi kumwe Special Loan’, igamije kugoboka abakiliya bayo muri ibi bihe byo kurwanya Coronavirus ndetse no guhangana n’ingaruka z’iki cyorezo. Turikumwe Special Loan iboneka mu masaha 48 gusa, iguhesha inshuro ebyiri z’umushahara, wemerewe gutangira kwishyura nyuma y’amezi atatu, yishyurwa mu mezi 12 ku nyungu ya 15.5% kandi kuyisaba bizarangira ku wa 31 Gicurasi 2020. Mu bindi byaganiriwe mu Nteko Rusange y’abanyamigabane ba BK Group PLC harimo kwemeza raporo y’umwaka na raporo y’ubugenzuzi bw’imari yakozwe ku mwaka warangiye tariki 31 Ukuboza 2019 no kwemeza iyishyurwa ry’inyungu ingana na 14.4 Frw ku mugabane, ku banyamigabane ba BK Group PLC. Iyi nyungu yabonetse umwaka ushize izishyurwa ari uko bimaze kwemezwa na Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda (BNR) ikazaba igize 35% by’inyungu ikigo cyabonye. Hemejwe kandi abagize Inama y’Ubutegetsi muri BK Group PLC, bayobowe na Marc Holtzman usanzwe ayobora Inama y’Ubutegetsi y’iki kigo. Mu bashya binjiye muri iyi nama harimo Umuyobozi Mukuru wa RSSB, Rugemanshuro Régis, ahagarariye umunyamigabane munini kuko RSSB ifitemo 34.3%. Abandi bemejwe ni Alline Kabbatende, Lilian Kyatengwa na Reuben Karemera. Umwaka wa 2019, warangiye BK Group PLC ifite imitungo y’agaciro ka miliyari 1019.1, kiyongereyeho 16 % ugereranyije n’umwaka wabanje.

title: Uruganda rwa Kinazi rwasabye abantu kwita ku buziranenge igihe bagiye kugura ifu y’ubugari
content: Tariki 7 Kamena buri mwaka, Isi yizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga wahariwe ubuziranenge bw’ibiribwa, buri wese asabwa kugira uruhare mu guharanira ubwo buziranenge. Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima ku Isi, OMS, ritangaza ko ibiribwa bitujuje ubuziranenge bihitana abantu bagera ku bihumbi 420 buri mwaka. OMS igaragaza ko abana bari munsi y’imyaka itanu aribo bibasirwa cyane n’ibi biribwa, kuko abapfa bagera ku bihumbi 125 buri mwaka. Kugeza ubu imyaka umunani irashize uruganda rwa Kinazi rufite icyicaro mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo mu Karere ka Ruhango rugeza ifu ku banyarwanda n’abanyamahanga. Uru ruganda rusaba abantu gukomeza gukoresha ifu yarwo ariko banirinda izindi fu bashobora kugura kandi zitujuje ubuziranenge ku buryo byanabaviramo gupfa. Umuyobozi w’Uruganda, Mbabazi Christian, mu kiganiro yahaye IGIHE, yavuze ko kugeza ubu uru ruganda ruhagaze neza kuko rwakira umusaruro w’abaturage kuva mu bice bitandukanye by’Amajyepfo mu Turere dutanu, ariko ubu bageze no mu Burasirazuba mu Karere ka Bugesera, aho batangiye gukorana n’abaturage baho bakabagezaho umusaruro. Ati “Uruganda rufite ubushobozi bwo kwakira toni 120 z’umusaruro w’abaturage ku munsi murumva ko ari mwinshi, ibi byanatumye tuva mu Majyepfo tujya no mu Burasirazuba ariko dukomeje gukangurira n’ibindi bice by’igihugu guhinga imyumbati bakagemurira uruganda, kuko usanga uruganda rugikora ku kigero cya 35% gusa.” Ubuziranenge buhagaze gute? Mbabazi yavuze ko ku bijyanye n’ubuziranenge hari byinshi leta yakoze harimo gushyiraho ibigo bishinzwe ubwo buziranenge ku rwego rw’igihugu, ibi bikaba aribyo bigenzura ibyo bakora, bikaba ari nabyo bibaha ibyangombwa. Ati “Ibyo bigo byose bikorana na Minisiteri y’Ubucuruzi n’Inganda ku buryo bashobora no kuba baguhana mu gihe basanze ukora ibitujuje ubuziranenge cyangwa bakaba banagufungira.” “Nk’ubu mu gice cyacu cy’abakora ifu hari abandi usanga nabo bakora iy’imyumbati, twe nka Kinazi turi banini ariko hari abandi bato kandi badafite ibyo byangombwa. Abo iyo bakoze nta byangombwa cyangwa nta buziranenge nibwo usanga bakoze ibyo bashatse n’igiciro bakaba bakigira gito, ariko bikarenga aho kuko abantu barya ibintu bihumanye. Tujya tuganira na leta bakatubwira ko babikurikirana kandi nkeka ko uko ibintu biza bizagenda bikosoka.” Hari ibyago ku muntu warya ibitujuje ubuziranenge Mbabazi yavuze ko abantu bakwiye kujya bagenzura ifu bagiye kugura, bakareba niba yujuje ibisabwa ndetse ifite n’ibirango bitangwa n’Ikigo gishinzwe Ubuziranenge.’ Ati “Twebwe nk’uruganda ibyo dukwiye gukora turabikora no ku rwego rw’igihugu ni uko, hano mu ruganda dufite itsinda ku buryo nta kintu cyasohoka kitabanje kugenzurwa ko cyujuje ubuziranenge, icyo dusaba abantu ni ukurya ifu yacu ariko bakwiye kumenya ko ushobora kurya ibihumanye bikaba byakugiraho ingaruka.” Uru ruganda ruvuga ko nubwo rutarabona abantu barwiyitirira ariko hari bamwe bumva ko bashobora kuba bafata ifu ya Kinazi, bakayipfunyika mu bindi bipfunyiko byabo, bakaba bayigurisha ku mafaranga menshi mu mahanga kuko isanzwe ari nziza. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ubuziranenge muri uru ruganda, Ngabonzima Viateur, yavuze ko mu ruganda bagenzura isuku y’abantu, imashini n’ibindi byose. Ati “Ifu y’uruganda rwa Kinazi yahawe ikirango cy’ubuziranenge gitangwa n’Ikigo gitsura ubuziranenge, RSB, twanarenze imbibi ku buryo ifu yacu yemewe n’ikigo cy’Abanyamerika kigenzura ubuziranenge bw’ibiribwa, ubu ishobora gucuzwa ku isoko rya Amerika.” Umuyobozi ushinzwe umusaruro winjira muri uru ruganda, Rutagungira Eve Nicolas, we yavuze ko uruganda rukorana neza n’abaruzanira imyumbati, kuva rwatangira mu 2012. Kugeza ubu uruganda rwa Kinazi rufite isoko mu Rwanda no ku mugabane w’u Burayi, ibijya hanze bikaba biri ku kigero kirenze 40%, aho ruteganya no kwagura rukajya muri Amerika kuko naho hari isoko rinini. Uru ruganda rutangaza ko ifu yarwo idakorwamo ubugari gusa, ahubwo ishobora kuvangwa n’andi mafu igakorwamo keke, Capati, Pizza n’ibindi.

title: Prime Life Insurance yatangije “Ikimina cyacu”, ubwishingizi buzorohereza Abanyarwanda kwizigamira
content: Ikimina cyacu ni gahunda Prime Life Insurance yatekerejeho igendeye ku buryo bwa gakondo bw’Abanyarwanda bwo kwizigamira busanzwe buzwi nk’ibimina, ariko yo ibushyira mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kandi burushaho gutanga umutekano ku mafaranga y’ababugannye. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Prime Life Insurance, Habarurema Innocent, yavuze ko ’Ikimina cyacu’ cyatangijwe nyuma yo kubona hakiri imbogamizi mu buryo bwo kwiteganyiriza butekanye, bworohereza abaturage kandi bukanabungukira. Yashimangiye ko basanze bakwiye gushyiraho ubu buryo kugira ngo barusheho kugira uruhare mu iterambere ry’Abanyarwanda. Yakomeje ati “Igituma bagomba kugana Prime Life Insurance mu buryo bw’umwihariko, ni uko noneho bafite umutekano wizewe w’amafaranga yabo kandi bakayabonaho n’inyungu. Ikindi akaba ashobora kuyategurira umushinga runaka w’igihe kigufi cyangwa kirekire. Kumenya amafaranga ufitemo n’inyungu zayo ubirebera muri telefoni yawe.’’ Ku wifuza kwinjira muri ubu buryo bwo kwiteganyiriza abikora yifashishije telefoni igendanwa aho yandika *177#, agahitamo ahanditse “Ubuzima no Kwizigamira” ubundi agakurikiza amabwiriza. Ku watangiye gukoresha ubu buryo buri mwaka yungukirwa 3% by’amafaranga by’ubwiteganyirize bwe, kandi mu gihe yamaze gutanga ubwiteganyirize bw’amezi atatu akaba yabikuzaho agera kuri 50%, amezi atandatu 70% naho nyuma y’umwaka akabikuza 100%. Habarurema yagiriye inama Abanyarwanda ko kwizigama bitakabaye bikorwa n’usaguye, ahubwo ni ukureba kure. Umwe mu bamaze ukwezi batangiye gukoresha Ikimina Cyacu, Habanabariho Théoneste avuga ko kuri we amaze kubibonamo inyungu nyinshi. Yagize ati “Iki kimina iyo ukigiyemo uba wizigamye kandi ufite n’ubwishingizi icya rimwe, kuko tuzi ahahise ariko uko ejo bizagenda ntabyo tuzi, niyo mpamvu nyamukuru kuri njyewe nahisemo iki kimina.” Abanyarwanda bibukijwe kugira umuco wo kwiteganyiriza no kwigira ku bihe igihugu kimazemo iminsi kubera icyorezo cya COVID-19. Umuyobozi w’Inama y’Ubutegetsi ya Prime Life Insurance, Ceaser Nkusi Nkwesi, yavuze ko “Kwizigamira ntabwo bisaba amafaranga menshi, bisaba gusa gufata icyemezo ukabifata nk’igikorwa cy’ingirakamaro mu buzima bwawe kigufasha mu bihe biri imbere, cyane cyane ibitunguranye bisaba amafaranga.” Uwayobotse ikimina cyacu mu gihe yitabye Imana, Prime Life Insurance iha umuryango we umusanzu yari amaze kugezamo n’inyungu zawo hakaniyongeraho n’impozamarira ingana na 5% y’ubwizigame bwose. Uretse ubu bwiteganyirize bw’Ikimina Cyacu, Prime Life Insurance Ltd ifite ubundi buryo bwo kwiteganyiriza burimo guteganyiriza amashuri y’abana mu byiciro byose, Ubwishingizi bw’umuryango, guteganyiriza iza bukuru, ubwishingizi bw’abakozi mu ngeri zose, ubwishingizi bwo gutabara ndetse n’ubwishingizi ku nguzanyo. title: Imikorere y’ikigega kigamije kuzahura ubukungu bw’u Rwanda bwazahajwe na Coronavirus
content: Iki kigega kigamije gutera inkunga ibikorwa by’abikorera byahungabanyijwe n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Minisitiri w’Imari n’Igenamigambi, Dr Uzziel Ndagijimana, aherutse gutangaza ko ari ikigega kizafasha amabanki gutanga inguzanyo iciriritse ibyo byiciro byose kugira ngo bigaruke mu kazi byongere bikore, bibyare umusaruro uzagire ingaruka mu kuzamuka k’ubukungu muri rusange. Muri iki kigega hashyizwemo ingamba zihariye zifasha amahoteli kuvugurura amasezerano y’inguzanyo afite mu mabanki akaba igihe kirekire n’inyungu zikagabanuka, ndetse ku buryo mu gihe yatangiye gufungura, abona amafaranga aciriritse kugira ngo imirimo yongere ikore. Imikorere y’iki kigega ireba amabanki 16 y’ubucuruzi n’ibigo by’imari biciriritse. Banki Nkuru y’Igihugu niyo izagicunga, gusa amafaranga ku bakiliya azajya atangwa n’amabanki. Ku ikubitiro leta yemeye gushyiramo miliyari 100 Frw ariko hagakomeza gushakwa abandi bashyiramo amafaranga kugira ngo cyaguke. Usibye ku mahoteli, kizafasha mu gutanga igishoro ku bucuruzi bwagizweho ingaruka na Coronavirus kugira ngo bukomeze gukora no kudahagarika abakozi, hari kandi inguzanyo ku bucuruzi buto n’ubuciriritse nabwo bwibasiwe na COVID-19. Banki Nkuru y’Igihugu izacunga imikorere yacyo, izaguriza amabanki kugira ngo nayo agurize abakiliya bayakeneye. Gusaba inguzanyo bizakorwa binyuze muri banki zibishinzwe, nazo zizajya zikurikirana ikibazo, nyuma zohereza kuri BNR ibyifuzo by’abasabye gufashwa kugira ngo bisuzumwe biganishe no ku cyemezo cya nyuma. Nyuma yo kwemezwa, amabanki azatanga amafaranga kuri konte y’uwayasabye hanyuma ibyakozwe bigaragarizwe BNR ari nayo izatuma amafaranga agera kuwasabye. Umuyobozi w’Urugaga rw’Abikorera mu Rwanda, Robert Bapfakurera, aherutse kuvuga ati “nk’ubukerarugendo, amahoteli, byagize ibibazo bikomeye kuko barafunze burundu, nubwo [mu Rwanda] ibibazo [bya coronavirus] byarangira ntabwo ibibazo bizaba byarangiye ahandi hose kuko ubukerarugendo bukorana n’amahanga, bakeneye gufashwa cyane.” Raporo y’Ishami ry’Ubukerarugendo mu Rugaga rw’Abikorera, PSF, yagaragazaga ko muri Werurwe bwagize igihombo cya miliyari 34.9 Frw, bivuye ku nama zasubitswe n’ibindi bikorwa by’ubukerarugendo byahagaritswe. Ibi bihombo byaje bisanga urwego rw’ubukerarugendo mu Rwanda rufite inguzanyo za miliyari 87.7 Frw. Imibare ya Banki y’Isi yo kuwa 9 Mata igaragaza ko ubukungu bwo muri Afurika yo munsi y’Ubutayu bwa Sahara, bwagizweho ingaruka na Coronavirus ndetse ko buzamanuka ku kigero cya -2.1% na -5.1% buvuye kuri 2.4% bwariho mu 2019. Ikigega Mpuzamahanga cy’Imari ku Isi, IMF, nacyo giherutse gutanga ikigereranyo ko umusaruro mbumbe w’Isi muri uyu mwaka uzamanuka ku mpuzandengo ya -3% naho uw’ubukungu bw’ibihugu byateye imbere kurusha ibindi bumanuke ku kigero cya -6%. Minisitiri w’Imari n’Igenamigambi, Dr Ndagijimana Uzziel, ati “Ni ibintu bikomeye bidaheruka mu mateka y’Isi. Muri Afurika yo munsi y’Ubutayu bwa Sahara, hateganyijwe ko ubukungu buzamanuka -1.6% […] natwe rero birumvikana ko ubukungu bwacu butazagenda uko busanzwe buteganyijwe.” Minisitiri Dr Ndagijimana yavuze ko ubu igipimo cy’ubukungu bw’u Rwanda kigaragaza ko butazazamuka ku kigero cya 8% nk’uko byari byitezwe, aho ubu imibare yagiye ivugururwa ikava kuri 5.1%, nyuma biramanuka bigera kuri 3.5% “ubu turi hafi kuri 2% nubwo bitari byarangira neza”. Indi nkuru wasoma: Ikigega cya Miliyari 100 Frw, imwe mu ngamba zigiye kwifashishwa mu kuzahura ubukungu bw’u Rwanda

title: Amazon igiye kugura imigabane ya miliyari ebyiri z’amadorali muri Airtel
content: Ibiganiro byo kugura imigabane ya Bharti Airtel ntibiragera kure, ariko abasesenguzi bavuga ko bigenze uko impande zombi zibyifuza, byazamura cyane ubukungu bw’ikoranabuhanga ry’u Buhinde. Biteganyijwe ko ubwumvikane bw’ibi bigo bushobora gutuma imigabane ingana na 5% ya Bharti Airtel ijya mu maboko ya Amazon Inc. hashingiwe ku buryo isoko rihagaze muri iyi minsi. Bharti Airtel iri ku mwanya wa gatatu mu bigo bitanga serivisi z’itumanaho mu Buhinde igaragaza guhangana gukomeye hagati yayo n’ikigo cya mbere cya Reliance Jio. Abantu batifuje ko imyirondoro yabo ijya ahagaragara babwiye Reuters ko uburyo Reliance Jio yakoresheje kugira ngo ibe iyoboye ibindi bigo by’itumanaho mu Buhinde na Bharti Airtel yabushobora. Ku ikubitiro Amazon yari yifuje kugura imigabane iri hagati ya 8-10% ya Bharti Airtel. Gusa ngo kuko ibiganiro bikiri mu itangira […] bishoboka ko n’amasezerano yahinduka cyangwa agaseswa. Amazon iteganya ko yahita ireba ubundi buryo bujyanye no guhererekanya amafaranga bwazajya bufasha abakiliya ba Bharti Airtel kubona ibicuruzwa byayo bibahendukiye. Umuvugizi wa Amazon yanze kugira icyo avuga kuri aya makuru, kuko ikigo ahagarariye kitatangaza amakuru ajyanye n’ibyo bazakora cyangwa batazakora mu gihe kiri imbere. Gusa itangazo ryasohowe na Bharti Airtel rivuga ko isanzwe ikorana n’ibigo by’ikoranabuhanga bitandukanye bishaka kugeza ibicuruzwa byabyo na serivisi bitanga ku bakiliya. Imigabane ya Bharti Airtel ku isoko ry’imari n’imigabane, kuri uyu wa Kane, tariki ya 4 Kamena 2020 yazamutseho 6% nyuma yo gutangazwa kw’amakuru y’ibiganiro hagati yayo na Amazon. Mu byumweru bitandatu bishize ikigo cya Jio gihanganye na Bharti cyabonye miliyari 10 z’amadorali kiyakuye mu bashoramari barimo na Facebook. Alphabet Inc ya Google na yo iri gushaka uburyo bwo gushora imari muri Vodafone Idea ya kabiri mu Buhinde mu gutanga serivisi z’itumanaho. Amazon iri kwirukira ku isoko ry’ikoranabuhanga mu Buhinde bitewe no kuba riri kwaguka cyane kuko umubare w’abatuye iki gihugu uri kwiyongera, ukaba ugeze kuri miliyari 1,3. Amazon iteganya gushora miliyari 6,5 z’amadorali mu bikorwa byo gucururiza kuri internet, ndetse ngo ikaba izoroherwa no gukoresha internet ya Bharti ku giciro gito mu gihe ibigo byombi bizaba byemeranyije amasezerano byifuza. Mu Ukuboza 2017 nibwo Bharti Airtel ibarizwamo Airtel Rwanda yaguze imigabane yose ya Sosiyete y’Itumanaho ya Tigo Rwanda ibarizwa muri Millicom International Cellular SA. Amasezerano y’ubugure yasinyiwe i New Delhi mu Buhinde, yahaye Airtel Rwanda kwegukana 100% by’imigabane yose ya Tigo Rwanda. Bharti Airtel ni ikigo gikomeye ku Isi mu bijyanye n’itumanaho gifite abakiliya barenga miliyoni 403 mu bihugu 18 bya Afurika na Aziya gikoreramo.

title: Unguka Bank Plc yashishikarije abakiliya bayo kwifashisha ikoranabuhanga muri serivisi bakeneye
content: Ni uburyo bwongerewemo imbaraga muri iki gihe, ndetse ikiguzi cyo guhererekanya amafaranga muri ubu buryo cyagiye gikurwaho. Mu rwego rwo kurinda abakiliya bayo n’abandi bose bayigana, Unguka Bank Plc yabashishikarije gukoresha ikoranabuhanga, rishobora kubafasha kugera kuri serivisi zinyuranye iyi banki itanga. Bumwe mu buryo yashyiriyeho abakiliya bayo harimo ubwa Mobile banking, aho abakiliya b’iyi banki bashobora kugera kuri serivisi zayo bakoresheje telefoni ngendanwa zabo. Muri ubwo buryo bashobora kohereza amafaranga, kugura ibintu bitandukanye ndetse no kwishyurana. Umukiliya ushaka kuyikoresha arabanza akiyandikisha muri iyi serivisi, ubundi agakanda *951# ugakurikiza amabwiriza. Hari kandi ikarita yo kubikuza no kwishyura (Debit cards). Ni amakarita Unguka Bank Plc yageneye abakiliya bayo, bashobora kuyakoresha babikuza ku byuma bya ATM bifite ikirango cya smart cash mu Rwanda hose ndetse no kwishyura nk’ibicuruzwa mu maguriro atandukanye, aho bafite ku imashini za POS. Mu bijyanye no kwishyira imisoro, hari uburyo bwa E-TAX bw’ikoranabuhanga, abakiliya ba Unguka Bank Plc bifashisha mu kwishyura imisoro mu Kigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe imisoro n’amahoro, RRA. Ubwo buryo bwiyongeraho ubuzwi nka ‘Push and Pull’, aho umukiliya ashobora kuvana amafaranga kuri konti ya Unguka Bank Plc akayashyira kuri konti ya mobile money kandi ku buntu, cyangwa bakayavana kuri konti yo kuri telefoni akayimurira kuri konti ya banki. Iyi serivisi isaba ko ubanza guhuza konti yawe ya Unguka Bank Plc na konti yawe ya mobile money. Ku muntu ushaka kuvana amafaranga kuri konti yo muri Unguka Bank ayashyira kuri Mobile money akanda *182*4*3*9#, yaba ashaka kuyavana kuri mobile money ayashyira kuri konti ya Unguka Bank Plc, agakanda *182*4*2*9#. Unguka Bank Plc yasabye abakeneye ibindi bisobanuro kugana ishami ryayo, gahamagara umurongo utishyurwa 9591 cyangwa gusura imbuga nkoranyambaga zayo kuri @Ungukabank haba kuri Twitter, Instagram, Facebook na YouTube. Unguka Bank yashinzwe mu 2005 nk’ikigo cy’imari iciriritse, ayo yatangiranye n’abanyamigabane 214 n’imari shingiro ya miliyoni 321 Frw. Mu 2011 Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda yayemereye gukora nka banki Iciriritse (Microfinance Bank), iva ku kuba IMF-UNGUKA S.A iba Unguka Bank. Mu 2018 yavuye ku kuba Unguka Bank Ltd iba Unguka Bank Plc. Unguka Bank Plc imaze kugira amashami 15 mu turere icyenda two mu gihugu.

title: Ba rwiyemezamirimo 25 b’abagore batoranyijwe muri ‘BK Urumuri’ mu cyiciro cya kane bamenyekanye
content: Kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 1 Kamena nibwo hatangajwe iyo mishinga mu magana y’abari banditse basaba gutoranywa. Aba bagore bazahabwa amahugurwa y’amezi atandatu mu gucunga imishinga n’ubucuruzi, ku bufasha bw’ikigo Inkomoko Entrepreneur Development. Nyuma abo bagore bazatoranywamo abazahabwa inguzanyo itishyurirwa inyungu. Imishinga y’abagore yatoranyijwe iri mu ngeri zitandukanye nk’inganda ziciriritse, kubyaza umusaruruo ibiva mu buhinzi n’ubworozi, imideli, ubukerarugendo n’amahoteli, ubuvuzi, ubukorikori, itangazamakuru, ikoranabuhanga n’ibindi. Uyu mwaka gutoranya abahatanye muri BK Urumuri byakozwe mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kubera icyorezo cya coronavirus ariko abaryitabiriye bijejwe umucyo mu byakozwe ndetse na serivisi bazahabwa. Umuyobozi wa Banki ya Kigali, Dr Diane Karusisi yavuze ko uyu mwaka bahaye umwihariko abagore kuko bagira uruhare ntagereranywa mu iterambere ry’igihugu. Yasabye abagore batoranyijwe kubyaza amahirwe iki gihe bazahura ubucuruzi bwabo bwahungabanyijwe na coronavirus, no gushakisha andi mahirwe. Ati “Abagore bose batangiranye uru rugendo na BK Urumuri, turabasaba kongerera ingufu ubucuruzi bwanyu kuko twizera ko mu gihe cy’ibibazo, n’amahirwe aba ahari. Mukorane natwe ndetse n’Inkomoko, mwige ntimucike intege. Ndabizi ko muri ibi bihe mushobora gucogora ariko mukore cyane kuko tuzabitsinda.” Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Inkomoko, Nathalie Niyonzima yijeje abo ba rwiyemezamirimo kuzahabwa amahugurwa y’ingirakamaro bifashishije inararibonye. Ati “Twishimiye kongera gufatanya na BK mu gufasha abagore mu turere twose tw’u Rwanda. Nubwo turi gukora mu bihe bidasanzwe, muri Inkomoko twiyemeje gutanga serivisi nziza. Ibyo muzahabwa muri iyi gahunda ntabwo bizabafasha gusa kubona inguzanyo itagira inyungu muri BK ahubwo bizanabafasha gushaka irindi shoramari n’andi mikoro.” Nathalie Niyonzima yavuze ko abagore batewe inkunga mu byiciro byashize bagiye biteza imbere bigaragara, ari nacyo bategereje ku batoranyijwe uyu mwaka. Inkomoko imaze igihe itanga ubumenyi n’ubujyanama mu by’ubucuruzi, ikaba imaze gufasha ba rwiyemezamirimo basaga 5000 mu myaka irindwi ishize, barimo abatsinze amarushanwa ya BK Urumuri mu byiciro bitatu biherutse. Zimwe muri sosiyete z’ubucuruzi zazamuwe muri ubu buryo harimo nk’inzu y’imideli House of Tayo, Moshions, Murukali , Yummy and Fresh, Mudacumura Publishing House, Karisimbi Wines, Ki-pepeo Kids, Ishyo Foods n’abandi.
