title: Kardashian agiye guhindura izina ry’imyambaro y’imbere yatumye yamaganwa n’Abayapani
content: Ku wa 26 Kamena nibwo Kardashian yamuritse imyambaro y’imbere igamije kugaragaza imiterere y’umugore ayita ‘Kimono’. Bikimara kumenyekana ko yise iyi myambaro gutya, ntabwo byishimiwe na benshi biganjemo abo mu Buyapani bifashishije imbuga nkoranyambaga bakamwamaganira kure bavuga ko ari gusuzugura umuco wabo. Nyuma yo kutishimirwa na benshi Kardashian yahisemo guhindura izina ry’imyambaro ritavuzweho rumwe na benshi mu Bayapani. Mu butumwa yanditse ku rukuta rwe rwa Twitter, yavuze kuba rwiyemezamirimo akibera n’umuyobozi byose icya rimwe byagiye akenshi bimuzanira imbogamizi ariko zamubereye umugisha mu buzima bwe. Yemeza ko icyagiye gituma ibintu byinshi bimworohera ari uko afite imiyoboro yihuse avuganaho n’abakunzi be ndetse n’abandi bose bakurikirana ibikorwa bye. Kim Kardashian yahamije ko akunda kumva ibitekerezo by’abantu, kwiga ndetse no gushaka gukomeza gukura. Arakomeza ati “Nishimira uburyo abantu bakunda ibyo nkora n’uko bampa ibitekerezo bitandukanye. Ubwo natangazaga izina ry’iyi myenda yanjye y’imbere, nabikoze mfite intego nziza mu mutwe.” “Amazina y’ibyo nkora ndetse n’ibyo nshyira ku isoko biba bikoranywe itandukaniro nyuma yo kubitekerezaho cyane no kugira byinshi twitaho. Vuba ngiye gutangaza izina rishya ry’iyi myambaro nari nashyize hanze. Nzakomeza kuvugana namwe. Murakoze kunyumva no kunshyigikira nk’uko bisanzwe.” Kim Kardashian atangaza ubu butumwa, hari benshi mu Bayapani bamushimiye ariko n’abavuze ko ibyo yakoze bidahagije kuko nta hantu yigeze asaba imbabazi ku makosa ye. Ku wa 26 Kamena nibwo Kim Kardashian yatangaje ko agiye gushyira hanze umwambaro mushya w’imbere yise ‘Kimono Intimates’. Uyu mugore w’imyaka 38 yavuze ko uyu mwambaro ugamije kwerekana imiterere y’umugore. Yasangije abamukurikira amafoto atatu muri uyu mwambaro yifoje awambaye ndetse ari kumwe n’abandi banyamideli avuga ko yari amaze imyaka 15 yiga ku mushinga wawo yizeza abamukurikira ko urabageraho vuba. Gusa Abayapani benshi ntabwo byabashimishije, bavuze ko ari ugusuzugura umwambaro wa Kimono wo muri iki gihugu wamenyekanye mu kinyejana cya 15 nka gakondo y’Abayapani. Abayapani benshi bahise batangira kwamagana igikorwa cya Kim maze bifashisha Twitter bakoresheje hashtag ya #KimOhNo.

title: Abanyamideli 10 batoranyijwe muri 534 bitabiriye ijonjora rya Kigali Fashion Week ya 2019 (Amafoto)
content: Iki gikorwa cyabereye muri Sports View Hotel iherereye ku Kicukiro mu Mujyi wa Kigali, aho abanyamideli batandukanye bo mu Rwanda bateraniye hamwe hashakishwa abazitabira igikorwa cya Kigali Fashion Week kizaba muri Nyakanga. Abanyamideli batoranyijwe ni Mucyo Sandrine, Shema Christian, Shema Justin, Iradukunda Yassir, Teta Christelle, Munezero Christine, Iradukunda Shema Daniel, Ganza Prince, Uwizeyimana Yvette na Masabo Anaise Audrey. Ibyagenderwagaho batoranya aba banyamideli harimo kuba azi gutambuka neza, afite n’indeshyo ihuye n’iyo abagize akanama nkemurampaka bifuza. Akanama nkemurampaka kari kagizwe na Fridaus Muna ukorera ibikorwa bijyanye n’imideli muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Umurundikazi witwa Erica Murekatete unashinzwe kuzakurikirana abanyamideli mu rwambariro, Michael Thayer usanzwe ahanga imideli na Kamanzi Gisele uri mu banyamigabane ba Kigali Fashion Week. Umulisa Fiona Cécile ukuriye ‘Iby’iwacu’ yafashe inshingano zo gutegura iki gikorwa, yavuze ko icy’uyu mwaka kirimo impinduka nyinshi ugereranyije n’indi myaka yatambutse. Ku wa 1 Nyakanga hazatoranywa abamurika imideli bo ku rwego mpuzamahanga bagera kuri 15. Igikorwa cya Kigali Fashion Week izaba guhera ku wa 4-6 Nyakanga ku nshuro ya 10 ndetse abagiteguye bafunguye imiryango ku bashaka kwigaragaza muri uru ruganda rwo guhanga no kumurika imideli. Kwinjira bizaba ari 15, 000 Frw ku muntu umwe na 25, 000 Frw ku bantu babiri.

title: Miss Akiwacu Colombe yitabiriye imurika ry’imisatsi i Paris
content: Ibi byabaye ku mugoroba wo ku wa Gatandatu w’icyumweru gishize mu Mujyi wa Paris mu gace ka Place de l’Opera. Iki gikorwa cyateguwe na Mureille Kabile usanzwe akora imisatsi y’ubwoko butandukanye. Abinyujije ku rubuga rwe rwa internet, yavuze ko yateguye igikorwa cyo kumurika imisatsi y’injwiri nyuma yo kunenwa no kuvangurwa n’abandi batandukanye. Iki gikorwa cyo kumurika imisatsi cyiswe “Don’t Touch My Hair”, cyakozwe mu rwego rwo kwamagana abantu bakora mu misatsi y’abafite injwiri nk’uburyo bwo kubendereza cyangwa kubirataho, ibintu bifatwa nk’ivanguraruhu. Nyampinga w’u Rwanda mu 2014, Akiwacu ni umwe mu banyamideli biyerekanye mu muhanda bambaye imisatsi myinshi, mu gace ka Place de l’ Opera. Abinyujije ku rubuga rwe rwa Instagram, Akiwacu yavuze ko muri iki kinyejana nta muntu ukwiye kunena undi ngo ni uko afite imisatsi idasa n’iye. Akiwacu Colombe umaze imyaka ine mu Bufaransa, mu 2017 yitabiriye igikorwa cyo kumurika imisatsi cyiswe Big Hair World.ed.

title: Kigali Fashion Week yuguruye imiryango ku bahanga imideli n’abayimurika
content: Iki gikorwa kizabera muri Kigali Serena Hotel ku wa 4 kugeza ku wa 6, kwinjira bizaba ari 15, 000 Frw ku muntu umwe na 25, 000 Frw ku bantu babiri. Kuri iyi nshuro bizaba bitandukanye n’ibyabanje cyane ko ubu byamaze kujya mu maboko ya Sosiyete yitwa ‘Iby’iwacu’ ikaba ariyo izabitegura ndetse ikanabikurikirana kuva bitangiye kugeza birangiye. John Bunyeshuri wari umaze imyaka umunani ategura iki gikorwa cya Kigali Fashion Week kibera mu Rwanda, aherutse kubwira IGIHE ko bahisemo kugishyira mu maboko y’iyi kompanyi kubera ko bashaka guha umwanya n’abakiri bato bakigaragaza mu bijyanye no gutegura ibikorwa by’imideli. Yakomeje avuga ko we icyo azakora ari ukuzaba ari mu bujyanama bw’abazategura Kigali Fashion Week ibindi byose bizakurikiranwa na ‘Iby’iwacu’ ya Umulisa Fiona Cécile. Kuri ubu, ku rubuga rwa Kigali Fashion Week banditse bahamagararira abashaka gukomeza gukuza impano zabo no kwiyerekana mu gikorwa gikomeye nk’iki ko ku wa 13 Kamena 2019 hazaba gutoranya abazamurika imideli muri iki gikorwa bakomoka mu Rwanda naho ku wa 1 Nyakanga hazatoranywe abo hanze y’u Rwanda, bizabera kuri Sports View Hotel Kicukiro. Bakomeje bavuga ko kandi biteguye no kwakira abahanga imideli bashaka kugaragaza ibikorwa byabo bikamenywa na benshi. Iki gikorwa cya Kigali Fashion Week cyatangiye gutegurwa mu Rwanda kuva mu 2010, nicyo cyabimburiye ibindi mu bijyanye no kumurika imideli ndetse kiri imbere mu bifite izina rikomeye mu Rwanda no hanze. Kuva mu 2017, iki gikorwa ngarukamwaka cya Kigali Fashion Week byagejejwe ku yindi ntera n’ababitegura mu bufatanye n’ikigo cya BerexInvest Corporation, bitangira kubera i Burayi, Amerika na Aziya nyuma y’imyaka irindwi byizihizwa mu Rwanda. Nyuma y’iki gikorwa kizabera mu Rwanda uyu mwaka, hateganyijwe ikindi cya Kigali International Fashion Week kirimo ikizabera mu Mujyi wa Montreal muri Canada, i New York muri Amerika, Londres mu Bwongereza, Genève mu Busuwisi no mu Buyapani byo bikazakomeza gutegurwa na John Bunyeshuri.

title: Umunyamideli Alexia Mupende yunamiwe mu birori bya Rwanda Fashion Week 2019 (Amafoto)
content: Ibi birori byabereye muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda, Ishami ry’Ikoranabuhanga muri School Of Architecture And Environment [SABE] ku mugoroba wo ku wa 8 Kamena 2019. Ni ku nshuro ya kane byari bibaye by’umwihariko n’iya mbere bifashe izina rya Rwanda Fashion Week dore ko imyaka yindi yabanje byitwaga Collective Rwanda Fashion Week. Ni ubwa mbere kandi byari bibereye ahantu hadatwikiriye [outdoor runway] ndetse abamurika imideli bakoraga urugendo rujya kuba rurerure baca imbere y’abantu babarirwa muri 500 bari baje kwihera ijisho. Ahagana saa moya n’igice abantu benshi bari bamaze kugera mu myanya yabo, ubanyujijemo ijisho abenshi bari ab’igitsina gore kandi bambaye neza bigaragara ko ibyo kurimba babisobanukiwe. Aba barimo abana ba Perezida wa Repubulika y’u Rwanda Paul Kagame barimo Ange Ingabire Kagame n’umukunzi we Bertrand Ndengeyingoma. Uwari uyoboye ibi birori Kwizera Arnold, yatangiye avuga ko uyu munsi udasanzwe kuri we kuko itariki nk’iyi mu myaka itandatu ishize aribwo nyina yashyinguwe. Igikorwa nyirizina cyo kumurika imideli cyatangijwe na Sonia Mugabo uri mu itsinda rya Collective Rwanda. Imideli ye yerekanye ni iyambarwa n’abagore igizwe n’amakanzu, amakabutura n’ibisurubeti [Jumpsuit]. Imideli yerekanwaga n’abakobwa bafite izina muri uyu mwuga nka Fiona Muthoni, Umutoni Georgette, Neza Rachel, Isheja Morella, Umutoniwase Belise na Belinda [impanga zahatanye muri Miss Rwanda 2018] n’abandi. Inzu y’imideli imaze imyaka irindwi ikorera mu Rwanda, Rwanda Clothing niyo yakurikiyeho. Mbere y’uko abanyamideli batambuka Kwizera wari uyoboye ibirori yasabye ababyitabiriye guhaguruka bagafata umwanya wo kwibuka Alexia Mupende, umunyamideli wubatse izina wishwe muri Mutarama 2019 n’abantu bataramenyekana. Alexia Mupende yakoranaga bya hafi na Rwanda Clothing mu kwamamaza imideli yabo ndetse yafashije benshi mu banyamideli bigaragaje muri ibi birori. Rwanda Clothing yerekanye imideli y’abagabo n’abagore yambarwa mu birori, igizwe n’amakote, amakanzu n’amashati y’ubwoko butandukanye Umunya-Nigeria Emmanuel Okoro washinze inzu y’imideli ya Emmy Nesbit yanambitse Minisitiri w’Intebe w’u Bwongereza, Theresa May, yerekanye imideli ku mwanya wa gatatu. Imideli yari igizwe n’iy’abagabo n’abagore. Yari yanditseho amagambo yo mu rurimi rw’iwabo. Maison Aline na Lisa B. Marler berekanye imideli y’abagore igizwe n’amakanzu magufi n’amaremare ari mu ibara ry’umweru n’umukara gusa. Abanyamideli babaga bafite amasakoshi yakorewe mu Rwanda. House Tayo ya Mathew Rugamba yerekanye imyenda y’abagabo n’abagore, igitekerezo cyayo akaba yaragikomoye ku bashumba b’inka. Inzu y’imideli ya K’tsobe yatangijwe Sarah Legrand yerekanye imideli igaragaza umuco wa Afurika aho abakobwa bari bambaye amakanzu akoze mu bigaragara nk’ibishura bakenyereye hejuru y’amabere n’abahungu bakenyereye ku gice cyo hasi hejuru bambaye ubusa. Bose nta nkweto bari bambaye. Abahanzi b’imideli bane bakizamuka [Ingabire Claudine, Falon Rusamaza, Grace na Emmanuel] bahawe umwanya berekana imyenda yabo. Buri umwe yagendaga yerekana imideli ibiri ibiri. Nyuma y’aba bahanzi b’imideli bakizamuka, hafashwe akaruhuko abantu bica icyaka babifashijwemo n’ikinyobwa gishya cya Mutzig Class, Bralirwa iheruka gushyirwa ku isoko, cyagenewe by’umwihariko abiganjemo urubyiruko n’abakuze bakunda ibirori. Inzu y’imideli Moshions niyo yatangiye igice cya kabiri, aho Moses Turahirwa yerekanye imideli ye yise “Inkingi”. Mu banyamideli berekanye imideli ya Moshions harimo Cedric Amizero usanzwe ari umuhanzi w’imideli wafatanyije n’umukinnyi w’Ikipe ya Mukura VS Iradukunda Bertrand. Inzuki Designs yakurikiyeho yerekana imirimbo irimo amaherena, inigi, udukapu two mu ntoki ydukoze mu migwegwe n’inkweto zifunguye [sandals] ziriho imitako ikoze mu migwegwe. Munezero Jean Vainqueur washinze inzu y’imideli ya Maison Munezero wari ugaragaye ku nshuro ya mbere muri Rwanda Fashion Week, yerekanye amakanzu y’abakobwa magufi. Uzi Collection yinjiye mu ihuriro rya Collective Rwanda mu 2016 na yo yerekanye amakanzu maremare yagenewe kwambarwa mu birori bikomeye nk’ubukwe n’imyenda y’abagabo. Inzu y’imideli ya Haute Baso yerekanye imideli itandukanye irimo amashati, amakoti, amapantalo, amasarubeti [jumpsuit] ku bagore n’abagabo. Inzu y’imideli ya Orange Culture yo muri Nigeria niyo yasoje ibi birori yerekana imideli yiganjemo igaragaza imyambarire igezweho muri icyo gihugu. Amafoto: Serge Muhizi

title: Akari ku mutima wa Turahirwa uherutse kwambika Robot yitwa Sophia
content: Iyi Robot mu minsi ibiri yagaragaye muri iyi nama yose yambaye umushanana wakozwe na Moses Turahirwa washinze inzu y’imideli ya Moshions. Nyuma y’ikiganiro yatanze ku munsi wa Mbere w’iyi nama, ku rubuga rwayo handitsweho ko yishimiye gutanga ikiganiro yambaye umwambaro wahanzwe na Moshions usanzwe ari mu bahanga imideli bakomeye mu Rwanda, wayihitiyemo kwambara bya Kinyarwanda. Turahirwa mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE yatangaje byinshi bitandukanye abantu bashobora kwibaza bijyanye n’uyu mwambaro wambawe na Sophia. Ati “Kwambika Robot ya Sophia, ntabwo ari inzira ndende. Yaje mu Rwanda azanywe na Smart Africa, rero ifite abantu dusanzwe dukorana ndetse ni n’abakiliya banjye. Barabinsabye, barambwira bati urabizi ko Sophia igiye kuza, haba hari igitekerezo ufite cy’ikintu ishobora kwambara.” Yakomeje avuga ko yabikoze akohereza ishusho y’umwambaro yumva yakwambika Robot ya Sophia, bikaza gukundwa cyane n’abakoze iyi Robot bakabyemera bakavuga ko ariko igomba kwambara. Avuga ko ikintu cya mbere byamwunguye ari uko abantu bongeye gutekereza cyane ku nzu ye ihanga imideli. Ati “Icyo byanyunguye ni uko abantu bongeye gutekereza cyane kuri Moshions, bati wambitse Robot; bimbera undi muyobora wo kumenyekanisha ibyo nkora. Urumva kuba wari usanzwe wambika abantu noneho ukambika na Robot kandi Sophia ni icyamamare. Ni ikindi nagezeho mu kazi kanjye. Arongera ati “Iyo ugize amahirwe yo gukora igikorwa nka kiriya hari abantu bashya bakumenya hari n’abari basanzwe bakuzi bongera kukwiyibutsa. Ari abari hanze y’u Rwanda n’aba hano ku mbuga nkoranyambaga barambazaga bati bimeze bite? Atari kuri uriya mushanana yari yambaye gusa ahubwo no ku bindi bintu ukabona ko hari ikintu byongereye. Avuga ko igitekerezo cyo kwambika Sophia imishanana yakigize ashaka ikintu kigaragaza umuco nyarwanda, kuko yarebye agasanga ku zindi mbuga iyi robot ikunze kwambara indi myambaro isanzwe. Ati “Narabanje ndeba ku mbuga zitandukanye ze ndavuga nti ni iki cyihariye noneho k’u Rwanda, twambara umushanana ndavuga nti reka mwambike uyu mwambaro kugira ngo yisanishe n’umuco nyarwanda.” Sophia ni imashini ifite imisusire y’abantu ikagira n’ubwenge butangaje, yakozwe n’Ikigo cyo muri Hong Kong cyitwa Hanson Robotics mu 2015. Yahawe ubushobozi bwo kuvuga neza Icyongereza n’izindi ndimi no kugaragaza ibimenyetso bisaga 50 yifashishije isura yayo. David Hanson yayikoze mu misusire y’abantu babiri: umugore we n’uwahoze akina filime uzwi nka Audrey Hepburn, imbere ikagaragara nk’umuntu ariko igice cy’inyuma kigaragaza neza ko ari imashini igizwe n’utwuma twinshi n’insinga biyiha ingufu z’amashanyarazi zituma ikora na internet iyiyobora.

title: Emmanuel Okoro wambitse Theresa May ategerejwe mu birori bya Rwanda Fashion Week 2019
content: Ibirori byo kumurika imideli bya Rwanda Fashion Week 2019 byari bimenyerewe ku izina rya Collective Rwanda Fashion Week. Byafashe iri zina rishya nyuma yo kubona uburenganzira bwo kurikoresha risimbura iryari risanzwe. Ni ibirori bigiye kuba ku nshuro kane aho bitegurwa n’itsinda ry’abahanzi b’imideli bo mu Rwanda ryitwa Collective Rwanda rigizwe na Moshions, Sonia Mugabo, Amizero, House Of Tayo na Inzuki Designs na Uzi Collections. Biteganyijwe ko Rwanda Fashion Week 2019 izatangira tariki 05 igasozwa tariki 08 Kamena 2019 ikazabera muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda Ishami ry’Ikoranabuhanga muri School of Architecture and Built Environment (SABE). Abanyarwanda bazamurika imideli yabo harimo Rwanda Clothing, Maison Munezero na Maison Aline. Moses Turahirwa uri mu bategura ibi birori yabwiye IGIHE muri uyu mwaka bazanye umwihariko wo gufasha abanyamideli bakizamuka kwerekana ibyo bakora. Ati “ Muri uyu mwaka hazagaragaramo abana bafite impano yo guhanga imideli barimo abigaragaje muri ArtRwanda-Ubuhanzi.” Hazagaragaramo kandi abanyeshuri biga mu yisumbuye bazaturuka mu bigo birimo Gashora Girls School, Kigali International Community School, Green hills Academy na Agahozo Shalom Village. Mu bahanzi b’imideli mpuzamahanga harimo Adebayo Oke-Lawale wo muri Nigeria, ufite inzu y’imideli ya Orange Culture imwe mu zifite izina rikomeye muri Afurika akaba yaranakoranye n’umuhanzi Davido. Harimo kandi Okoro Emmanuel , ufite inzu y’imideli yitwa Emmy Nesbit yatsindiye ibihembo muri Lagos Fashion Week 2017 by’umwihariko akaba yarambitse uwari Minisitiri w’Intebe w’u Bwongereza, Theresa May, uherutse kwegura. Ubwo Theresa May yasuraga Nigeria mu 2018, yambaye ikoti ryakozwe n’uyu musore w’imyaka 28 bimwongerera ikuzo mu gihugu cye no ku mugabane wa Afurika muri rusange. Uyu musore kandi asanzwe yambika abandi barimo umuhanzi Flavour, Yemi Alade n’abandi batandukanye. Hazaba kandi hari abavuga rikijyana mu bijyanye n’imideli barimo Ingrid Tamborin ukorera ikinyamakuru cyibanda ku mideli cya Vogue Italy n’abandi benshi. Hari amatike y’ubwoko butatu yemerera ushaka kwihera ijisho ibirori kwinjira: hari igura amafaranga ibihumbi 15 Frw, ibihumbi 25 Frw n’ibihumbi 45 Frw.

title: Ubwiza bw’imideli yamurikiwe mu birori bya Mercedes-Benz Fashion Week byabereye i Kigali (Amafoto)
content: Abakunda kurimba no kwizihirwa, abihebeye ibyo kumurika imideli bari bamaze iminsi bategerezanyije amatsiko ibirori bya Mercedes Benz byabereye mu Rwanda guhera ku wa 31 Gicurasi 2019. Ni ibirori byihariye kandi bifite izina rikomeye muri Ghana aho bimaze imyaka myinshi bibera. Ibyabereye mu Rwanda byari byahuruje abantu b’ingeri zitandukanye baturutse mu bihugu byose bya Afurika. Ku wa 1 Kamena 2019, ibirori bya Mercedes-Benz Fashion Week byaberaga mu Rwanda ku nshuro yabyo ya mbere nibwo byasojwe. Ibi birori byabimburiwe no kwifotoza kw’abanyamideli mu myambaro isanzwe (Street Style) mu gikorwa cyabereye hanze ya Kigali Convention Centre mbere y’uko ibirori nyirizina bitangira. Saa tatu zuzuye nibwo umushyushyarugamba yavuze abahanga imideli bagomba kumurika imyambaro bahanze. Ku ikubitiro imyambaro yahanzwe na Rupari Designs y’Umunyarwandakazi Rupari Cynthia umaze kubaka izina mu bikorwa by’imideli, niyo yabanje kwerekana imyambaro yayo. Rupari ni umwe mu bahanga imideli babigize umwuga wagiye ahagararira u Rwanda mu imurika ry’imideli mu bihugu bitandukanye. Yanaruhagarariye mu marushanwa arimo Miss Grand Lacs, East African Model Search n’ayandi. By’umwihariko ngo yagize amahirwe yo guhuza imishinga n’umunyamideli wambika umugore wa Perezida wa Côte d’Ivoire, bigeze guhurira iwabo mu 2012 ubwo yari yaserukiye u Rwanda. Mu 2016, yegukanye igihembo gikomeye mu imurika ry’imideli ryahuje abasaga 30 bakomeye muri Afurika mu Mujyi wa Conakry muri Guinée byitwa Guèssè Fashion Show. Akimara gusoza kwerekana imyambaro ye, hakurikiyeho imyambaro yahanzwe na Neopele Concepts wo muri Nigeria wari ufite imyambaro yihariye, ariko y’abagabo gusa. Abanyamideli batandukanye barimo abo mu Rwanda bayishinjagiyemo bituma abari bitabiriye iki gikorwa babasha kunyurwa n’uburyo baserutse. Uyu yakurikiwe na Karrsh Collections y’Umunyarwandakazi na we wari ufite imyambaro yihariye irimo iy’abasore n’inkumi, yamuritswe mu buryo butandukanye bwanyuze benshi. Yakuriwe ingata na Inkanda Fashion House ya Patrick Muhire nayo yerekanye imyambaro itandukanye yiganjemo iy’abakunda ibirori. George Malelu wo muri Afurika y’Epfo wambitse Beyonce wari utegerejwe n’abatari bake na we muri iki gitaramo yerekanye imyambaro ikoranywe ubuhanga buhambaye, yatumye akurirwa ingofero na benshi. Uyu musore imyambaro yerekaniwe i Kigali ni iy’abakobwa gusa nta y’igitsina gabo yari irimo. Clavon Leonard wo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika na we ari mu bahanga imideli bigaragaje muri iki gikorwa, aho yerekanye iyiganjemo amakanzu n’amakositimu y’abagabo. Iki gitaramo cyagaragarijwemo abanyempano bakomeye mu kumurika imideli baturuka mu mfuruka zose z’Isi. Cyashyizweho akadomo na Quophi Akotuah wo muri Ghana werekanye imyambaro yiganjemo iyambarwa mu muco w’iwabo, Yaserutse imbere y’imbaga yarebye iyi mideli ahagana saa tanu zirengaho iminota mike. Ndayishimiye Daniel wagize uruhare rukomeye kugira ngo iki gikorwa kibe yashimye uburyo cyagenzemo. Yakomeje ati “Ndashima uburyo iki gitaramo cyabayemo mu minsi ibiri, ntabwo ari ibintu byoroshye. Mboneyeho gutangaza ko iki kigiye kuba igikorwa ngarukamwaka mu Rwanda. Tukaba dusaba abantu mu nzego zitandukanye kudushyigikira, kuko dushaka gukora ibyabaye uyu mwaka.” Ibirori bya Mercedes Benz Fashion Week Kigali ni ku nshuro ya mbere byari bibereye mu Rwanda, rwabaye igihugu cya kabiri muri Afurika byari bibereyemo nyuma ya Ghana aho bibera mu Mujyi wa Accra. N’ubwo byaberaga mu Rwanda ariko mu miziki yifashishijwe abanyamideli batambuka kuva ibi birori bitangiye kugeza birangiye nta ndirimbo y’umuhanzi wo mu Rwanda yumvikanyemo. Imideli yamuritswe na Quophi Akotuah ukomoka muri Ghana Imideli ya Rupari Designs y’Umunyarwandakazi Rupari Cynthia Imideli yahanzwe na Neopele Concepts wo muri Nigeria Imideli ya Karrsh Collections Imideli ya Inkanda Fashion House ya Patrick Muhire George Malelu wo muri Afurika y’Epfo wambitse Beyonce Imideli ya Clavon Leonard wo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika Amafoto: Muhizi Serge

title: George Malelu wambitse Beyoncé mu bazamurika imideli muri Mercedes Benz Fashion Week Kigali
content: U Rwanda ni igihugu cya kabiri muri Afurika kigiye kuberamo ibirori byo kumurika imideli bya Mercedes Benz Fashion Week nyuma y’ibibera mu Mujyi wa Accra muri Ghana. Ibindi bikorwa nk’ibi bibera mu yindi mijyi nka Moscow, Madrid, Miami, n’ahandi. Guhera kuri uyu wa 31 Gicurasi kugera tariki 01 Kamena 2019 muri Kigali Convention Centre hazabera Mercedes Benz Fashion Week ku nshuro ya mbere. Gideon Raji uri mu bategura Mercedes Benz Fashion Week Accra yavuze ko bahisemo kuzana iki gikorwa mu Rwanda, nyuma yo kubona ubuhanga bw’abahanga n’aberekana imideli bakomoka muri iki gihigu. Yagize ati “ Twari dusanzwe dukorana n’abanyamideli bo mu Rwanda barimo Tanga Designs, Georgette, Phiona n’abandi. Twasanze abanyamideli bo mu Rwanda bafite umwihariko.” Ndayishimiye Daniel utegura Mercedes Benz Fashion Week Kigali yavuze ko bizagaragaramo abanyamideli batandukanye haba abo mu Rwanda nka Lupari Designs, Inkanda House, Karssh Collection n’abandi. Hari abaturutse mu bindi bihugu nka Quophi Akotuah wo muri Ghana, Mary Angel wo mu Burundi, Kente Christabel wo muri Uganda, Jana Ross wo mu Bubiligi, Ally Rehmutullah wo muri Tanzania na Clavon Leonard wo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika. By’umwihariko hazaba hari George Malelu Umunyafurika y’Epfo wanditse amateka yo kwambika umuhanzikazi Beyoncé ubwo yaririmbaga mu birori bya Global Citizen Festival mu mwaka ushize. Imyenda ye kandi yambawe n’ibindi byamamare birimo Terri Vaughn na Katie Logan bamamaye muri filime y’uruhererekane ya “The Bold and the Beautiful”, abahataniye ikamba rya Miss wa Afurika y’Epfo n’abandi benshi. Biteganyijwe ko imideli ya George Malelu izerekanwa tariki 01 Kanama 2019 ubwo ibirori bizaba bisozwa. Buri munsi hazajya herekanwa imideli y’abantu barindwi. Mu masaha ya mbere saa sita hazaba inama yiga ku iterambere ry’imideli.

title: Uburyo Jennifer Lopez yatumye hatangizwa Google Images
content: Google Images ni uburyo bwo gushakisha amafoto kuri internet mu ishakiro rya Google. Yatangiye ku wa 12 Nyakanga 2001 kubera Jennifer Lopez. Mu rukurikirane rw’ikiganiro gica ku rubuga rwa Youtube cyitwa Moments of Fashion, Jennifer Lopez, yavuze ku bigwi by’ikanzu ya Versace yambaye mu bihembo bya Grammy mu 2000. Avuga ko icyo gihe imirabyo ya camera z’abafotozi batandukanye yatangiye kumwerekeraho, abantu bamushyiraho ijisho biramutungura. Ati “Mu by’ukuri, ubwo nari nambaye ikanzu y’icyatsi ya Versace yo mu bwoko bwa Jungle Print, nibwo numva nagize ibihe byiza mu bijyanye no kurimba. Byari ibintu bidasanzwe, abafotozi batangiye kwerekeza camera zabo aho zitari zisanzwe zerekera. Hari hari imbaraga zidasanzwe. ” Icyo gihe ngo Jennifer n’ubwo nta gihembo yegukanye yatunguwe no kubyuka yisanga ariwe ibinyamakuru byinshi biri kwibandaho ndetse ku bifuniko byinshi byabyo ariwe uriho. Lopez muri aya mashusho amara iminota icyenda akomeza avuga ko iyi kanzu yari yambaye yahumuye benshi amaso bagatangira kuyishaka bayibura bigatuma Google ishyiraho Google Images. Ati “Twirengagije uko abantu basigaye bavuga, iyi kanzu yagize ingaruka nziza mu Isi y’ikoranabuhanga ndetse ituma Google ifata umwanzuro wo guhanga Google Images. Nyuma y’imyaka yakurikiyeho naje kuvumbura ko kubera iryo joro ndetse n’iyo kanzu, Google Images aribwo yahise ihangwa.” Icyo gihe abantu benshi batangiye kuyishakisha ariko nta buryo bwari buhari bwo gushakira ifoto kuri internet, Google ishaka uburyo bwo gukemura icyo kibazo yifashishije Google images. Yahise avuga asa nk’uri gutebya ati “ahubwo mfite impungenge, sheki yanjye irihe ?” Sergey Brin uri mu bashinze urubuga rwa Google nawe yigeze gushimangira ko ihangwa rya Google Images ryatewe na Jennifer mu nyandiko yasohowe na The Tinkerer’s Apprentice muri Mutarama 2015. Brin yagize ati “Muri icyo gihe, mu ishakiro ryacu hagaragayemo umubare munini mu buryo butari busanzwe ariko ntabwo byari kudukundira ko icyo bashakaga bakibona. Jennifer yambaye iriya kanzu. Google Images iravuka.” Lopez yakomeje ati “Ibi bikwereka imbaraga z’ibijyanye n’imideli ndetse n’imbaraga z’ibihe nk’ibyo. Ndabizi abantu bageragezaga kuyitesha agaciro muri ibyo bihe ariko icyo ibyo bintu bikora biha abantu umwuka wo guhanga. Ishyira ibihe byiza hanze mu Isi. Ikanzu imwe ishobora guhindura uburyo abantu barimbagamo mu myaka 10.” Donatella Versace niwe wambaye iyi kanzu mbere y’uko Jennifer Lopez ayambara ariko ntibyigeze bivugwa cyane. Reba amwe mu mafoto y’iyo kanzu Jennifer yambaye igatuma Google Images ibaho

title: Robot yitwa Sophia yashimye ubwiza bw’umushanana wa Moshions yambariye i Kigali
content: Abakoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga batangariye robot yitwa Sophia, yaje mu Rwanda yitabiriye iyi nama. Sophia yatangiye iganira na Nozipho Mbanjwa usanzwe ari umunyamakuru wa CNBC Africa wari uyoboye ibiganiro iranatungurana ivuga mu ndimi zitandukanye zirimo n’ikinyarwanda. Uretse ibyo mu gukomeza ikiganiro cyayo yanashimye urwego ikorabuhanga ryo mu Rwanda ririho muri iki gihe, isoza iteguza abantu kuzitabira ikiganiro kirambuye iraza kugira kuri uyu wa Kane nyuma ya saa sita. Nyuma y’iki kiganiro ku rubuga rwa Twitter rwa Sophia, yagaragaje ko yishimiye gutanga ikiganiro yambaye umwambaro wahanzwe na Moshions usanzwe ari mu bahanga imideli bakomeye mu Rwanda. Iti “Ni iby’icyubahiro kwambara umushanana muri Transform Africa 2019. Umushanana ni umwambaro gakondo wambarwa n’abanyarwandakazi, ugizwe n’akenda koroheye kambarwa hasi ndetse n’umwitero unyuzwa ku rutugu. Nishimiye kwiga byinshi binyuze mu muco wabo. Ndagaragara nte ?” Byinshi mu bitekerezo byatanzwe n’abantu batandukanye babwiye Sophia ko yari aberewe bya gakondo y’u Rwanda. Hari n’uwaje atebya ati “Urakoze cyane Sophia gusangiza abantu ibyo wabonye mu Rwanda ariko ndakwifuriza ko wanabona umusore mukundana w’Umunyarwanda.” Moses Turahirwa washinze inzu y’imideli ya Moshions yambitse Sophia, nawe yanditse kuri Twitter avuga ko yashimishijwe no kuba umwambaro yahanze, wabashije kwambarwa na Sophia ashimangira ko Made in Rwanda igomba kumenyekana ku Isi hose. Sophia ni imashini ifite imisusire y’abantu ikagira n’ubwenge butangaje, yakozwe n’Ikigo cyo muri Hong Kong cyitwa Hanson Robotics mu 2015. Yahawe ubushobozi bwo kuvuga neza Icyongereza n’izindi ndimi no kugaragaza ibimenyetso bisaga 50 yifashishije isura yayo. David Hanson yayikoze mu misusire y’abantu babiri: umugore we n’uwahoze akina filime uzwi nka Audrey Hepburn, imbere ikagaragara nk’umuntu ariko igice cy’inyuma kigaragaza neza ko ari imashini igizwe n’utwuma twinshi n’insinga biyiha ingufu z’amashanyarazi zituma ikora na internet iyiyobora. Moshions yahanze umwambaro Sophia yaserukanye, ni inzu y’imideli ikomeye mu Rwanda kandi yambika abantu batandukanye b’ibyamamare barimo n’abayobozi bakuru. Iyi nzu ya Moses Turahirwa w’imyaka 26 imaze kuba ubukombe, yayishinze mu 2013 gusa mu 2015 nibwo yayandikishije mu Kigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere, RDB, nk’uruganda rukora rukanatunganya imideli. Yatangiranye n’umudozi umwe ariko ubu afite abakozi bahoraho 13, barimo umunani bashinzwe kudoda n’abandi bashinzwe gushaka amasoko no kumenyekanisha ibikorwa binyuze ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Amafoto: Niyonzima Moise

title: Hatoranyijwe abanyamideli bazitabira ‘Mercedes Fashion Week’ i Kigali (Amafoto)
content: Itoranya ry’aba bamyamideli bagomba kuzitabira Mercedes Fashion Week Kigali ryabereye kuri Century Park Hotel i Nyarutarama. Abanyamideli batandukanye bagera ku 150 baturutse mu bice bitandukanye by’Isi nibo bitabiriye iki gikorwa, baje basanga abandi 60 bo mu mahanga basabye kuzitabira banyuze kuri internet. Ndayishimiye Daniel wari usanzwe uri mu itsinda ritegura iki gikorwa n’ubundi muri Ghana wanagize uruhare kugira ngo noneho kibere mu Rwanda, yabwiye IGIHE ko byari ibintu bidasanzwe mu ruganda rwo kumurika imideli. Ati “Abantu bitabiriye ku kigero cyo hejuru cyane kandi benshi baje n’ubundi ni abanyamideli basanzwe bazwi mu Rwanda. Ugereranyije n’ibindi bikorwa byo gutotanya abanyamideli bibera mu Rwanda iki kiri mu byitabiriwe n’abanyamahanga benshi kuko haje abagera ku 10.” Muri iki gikorwa hajemo Umudage,Umubiligi, Umuhinde, Umunye-Congo ndetse n’abanye-Ghana. Yavuze ko abahanga imideli 20 aribo bazambika abazitabira iki gikorwa, batanu akaba aribo b’abanyarwanda abandi basigaye bakaba abanyamahanga. Akanama katangaga amanota ku bagomba gukomeza mu kindi cyiciro gikurikira kari kagizwe na Munyana Cynthia, Daniel Ndayishimiye, Serge Shema, Antoinette Kabanyana na Charlotte Dukundane. Mu guha amahirwe abanyamideli bagomba gukomeza hagenderwaho ku kuberwa n’amafoto, intambuko ndetse n’uko agaragara. Abanyamideli batoranyijwe bazatangazwa mu cyumweru gitaha nyuma yo guhuza umubare w’abasabye kuzitabira bifashishije internet ndetse n’abigaragaje uyu munsi. Iki gikorwa kizaba guhera ku wa 31 Gicurasi no ku wa 1 Kamena 2019 muri Kigali Convention Centre. Amafoto: FOCUSiCON

title: Impinduka muri Kigali Fashion Week ya 2019
content: Ibi birori biteganyijwe ku wa 9 Nyakanga 2019, kuri iyi nshuro bizaba bitandukanye n’ibyabanje cyane ko ubu byamaze kujya mu maboko ya Sosiyete yitwa ‘Iby’iwacu’ ikaba ariyo izabitegura ndetse ikanabikurikirana kuva bitangiye kugeza birangiye. John Bunyeshuri wari umaze imyaka umunani ategura ibi birori bya Kigali Fashion Week bibera mu Rwanda, yabwiye IGIHE ko bahisemo gushyira iki gikorwa mu maboko y’iyi kompanyi kubera ko bashaka guha umwanya n’abakiri bato bakigaragaza mu bijyanye no gutegura ibirori by’imideli. Ati “Twatekereje gushyira iki gikorwa mu maboko ya ‘Iby’iwacu’ kubera ko dushaka guha umwanya abakiri bato bakigaragaza mu bijyanye no gutegura ibirori by’imideli.” Yakomeje avuga ko we icyo azakora ari ukuzaba ari mu bujyanama bw’abazategura ibirori bya Kigali Fashion Week ibindi byose bikazakurikiranwa na ‘Iby’iwacu’. Ibindi birori bya Kigali International Fashion Week birimo ikizabera mu Mujyi wa Montreal muri Canada, i New York muri Amerika, Londres mu Bwongereza, Genève mu Busuwisi no mu Buyapani byo bizakomeza gutegurwa na John Bunyeshuri. ‘Iby’iwacu’ isanzwe iyoborwa na Umulisa Fiona Cécile igamije kumenyekanisha ibikorerwa mu Rwanda, ndetse ijya ikora amamurikagurisha atandukanye ajyanye n’iki gikorwa. Iryo iheruka gutegura ni iryabereye mu Mujyi wa Kigali ku wa 8 Werurwe 2019, ku Munsi wahariwe Abari n’Abategarugori. Icyo gihe Umuyobozi wa ‘Iby’iwacu’, Umulisa Fiona Cécile, yatangarije IGIHE ko iri murikagurisha ryari rigamije kumenyekanisha ibikorerwa mu Rwanda ariko by’umwihariko byakozwe n’abagore. Ni ku nshuro ya cyenda Kigali Fashion Week izaba ibaye nyuma y’izabaye mu myaka umunani ishize.

title: Umunyamideli yatezwe n’imishumi y’inkweto ari kwiyerekana ahita apfa
content: Uyu munyamideli w’imyaka 26 yapfuye ari mu birori byo kumurika imideli bya São Paulo Fashion Week. Ubwo yagwaga yahise ajyanwa kwa muganga ariko ku bw’amahirwe make ntiyabasha koroherwa ahubwo ahita ashiramo umwuka. Bamwe mu bari mu gitaramo babanje kugira ngo ibibaye byari biri mu byateguwe. Abandi bamurikaga imideli bo bahise bagira icyikango, Tales Cotta ahita avanwa ku rubyiniro vuba na bwangu. Abateguye iki gitaramo babinyujije kuri Twitter bavuze ko yapfuye ariko ntibatangaza icyamuhitanye. Mu butumwa banditse bwagiraga buti “Turabiseguraho ku bw’iki gihombo ndetse turihanganisha umuryango wa Tales Cotta muri ibi bihe.” Bakomeje bavuga ko bari bakoze ibishoboka byose ariko ubuzima bwa Tales Cotta bukanga bukabaca mu myanya y’intoki. Daily Folha de S. Paulo yanditse ko uyu musore yatezwe n’imishumi y’inkweto yari yambaye akikubita hasi bikamuviramo gupfa.

title: Inzozi za Mukamusoni, Umunyamideli ubikomatanya no kwandika imivugo hanze y’u Rwanda
content: Uyu mukobwa ufite imyaka 18 y’amavuko, yakuriye mu Rwanda mu kigo kirera imfubyi kizwi nka SOS. Iyo yivuga asobanura ko atazi niba ari Umunyarwanda cyangwa Umunyakenya kuko yakuze akisanga mu Rwanda ariko akabwirwa n’abantu ko ashobora kuba akomoka muri Kenya. Ati “Nabwiwe ko ababyeyi banjye babaye muri Kenya; abantu benshi kandi bakambwira ngo nsa nk’abanyakenya ariko ntabwo ndabyizera ko ariho nkomoka. Ntabwo niyiziho ibintu byinshi nanjye ni gutyo mpora nibaza.” Nta byinshi azi ku babyeyi be ku buryo buri gihe iyo aje mu Rwanda agerageza kubaza, akajya gusura bamwe mu bo abwirwa ko bafitanye isano ashaka kumenya ukuri. Mukamusoni iyo asobanura ubuzima bwe ari amayobera kuko kugeza ubu ataramenya inkomoko ye. Ati “Nta bintu byinshi nzi ku babyeyi banjy”. Uyu mukobwa amaze imyaka hafi itatu muri Ghana aho yagiye kwiga abikesheje kuba umuhanga mu ishuri. Ati “Hari ukuntu SOS ikoresha abana b’abahanga ibizamini batsinda bakajya kwiga ku kigo nigaho.” Mu mashuri yisumbuye yize muri New Vison, New Life Christian Academy ndetse na Maranyundo Girls School. Uyu mukobwa amaze imyaka ine atangiye gukora ibijyanye no kumurika imideli ariko imyaka ibiri ishize abikora nk’umwuga. Nta birori bikomeye by’imideli aritabira muri Ghana ariko yemeza ko biri mu nzira. Kugeza ubu kumurika imideli ntabwo ari akazi kamutunze kuko akiri umunyeshuri. Afite inzozi zo kuba umunyamideli mpuzamahanga agashyira u Rwanda ku ikarita y’Isi mu ruganda rw’imideli. Ati “Ikintu nteganya mu ruganda rw’ imideli ni ukuba umunyamideli ukomeye mpuzamahanga. Mfite intego y’ibigo bikomeye nshaka kuzakorana nabyo ndetse no kuba nagaragara ku gifuniko cya Vogue Magazine n’ibindi byinshi.” Yasazwe n’agahinda ahinduka umwanditsi w’imivugo Mukamusoni yemeza ko ibyo kuvuga imivugo yabitangiye afite imyaka icyenda ndetse ngo ni ikintu akora inshuro nyinshi. Ati “Najyaga nandika nk’interuro zitandukanye nkazihuza, nkazihereza ibisobanuro nkurikije uko nabyanditse. Maze gukura, nasanze nshobora gukoresha utwo tuntu duto nandikaga ndetse nza kwiyumvamo kwandika imivugo n’inkuru nto. Ntabwo ari imivugo gusa ahubwo nkunda kwandika muri rusange. Uyu mukobwa yavuze ko yatangiye kwandika imivugo ubwo yabaga yigunze yabikora akaruhuka. Ati “Imivugo nandika ubu iterwa n’ibyo mbona n’ibitekerezo byanjye ariko bitandukanye cyane n’agahinda naba naratewe n’ubuzima.” Afite inzozi zo gukora igitabo cy’ imivugo cyafasha abanyarwanda bari mu mashuri mato kumva ibijyanye n’ubuvanganzo.

title: Umunyarwandakazi ari guhatanira ‘Top Model Europe 2019’
content:
Top Model Europe riri mu marushanwa akomeye cyane i Burayi yerekeye ibyo kumurika imideli gusa ntabwo ari kenshi umunyarwanda yagize amahirwe yo kuyitabira ngo bimenyekane nka Mukamurigo Marie Chantal wageze mu cyiciro cya nyuma muri uyu mwaka. Si urugendo rwari rworoshye kuri we kuko yatoranyijwe mu bamurika imideli 3000 mu bihugu bitandukanye i Burayi bari bitabiriye, aza gutsinda ajya mu cyiciro cya nyuma kiri gushakishwamo uzahiga abandi mu 150 bari guhatana. Ati “ Ubusanzwe murika imideli, kandi kugira ngo bagufate ni ukuba wujuje ibisabwa. Mu gutangira twageraga mu 3 000. Bagendeye ku bintu bitatu basanga ndabyujuje, hanyuma turarushanwa bagenda batoranya tuza gusigara tungana n’abantu 150.” 
Muri ibyo bagenderaho harimo kuba uhatana yiyekerekana uko ari, kuba ari umunyamideli wabigize umwuga ndetse no kwerekana igitabo gikubiyemo umushinga wawe. Avuga ko ari intambwe ikomeye cyane kuko hari n’abandi benshi bashakaga kuba bahatana muri iri rushanwa ariko bakabura amahirwe. Ubusanzwe avuka i Rwamagana. Afite imyaka 28 y’amavuko, aba mu Bubiligi gusa afite ubushabitsi mu Mujyi wa Rubavu ndetse akenshi akunda no kuza mu Rwanda. Avuga indimi esheshatu zirimo Igifaransa n’Icyongereza akaba inzobere mu Buforomo, ariko yiyeguriye ibyo kumurika imideli. Ubu akorana na Agence z’ibijyanye n’imideli nyinshi n’ikomeye i Burayi yitwa People Choice ikorera mu Bubiligi. Mukamurigo aganira na IGIHE yagiriye inama abakora ibijyanye n’imideli mu Rwanda gukomeza gukora cyane no kwiga. Ati “Muri rusange ukuntu bihagaze ntabwo ari bibi kuko bafite ubushake ariko hakenewe byinshi byo kwiga.” Mukamurigo ari guteganya gushinga ishuri ryigisha ibijyanye no kumurika imideli no gutanga amahugurwa ndetse bibaye amahire akabona ibikenewe byose muri Kanama uyu mwaka uyu mushinga we yawutangira. Ati “Kuri gahunda yanjye hagati ya Kanama no mu Ukuboza 2019 nzaba namenye uko bihagaze kuko hari byinshi bisabwa, ariko nk’abana b’Abanyarwanda bashishikariye gukora akazi nkunda kandi nkora ngomba kubafasha.” Ibirori nyir’izina byo gutoranya Top Model Europe 2019 Mukamurigo Marie Chantal ari guhatanira, bizaba ku wa 17 Werurwe 2019. Top Model mu 2018 yabaye Léa Vanderroost wahigitse abandi bari bahatanye.

title: Mizero Cedric azahagararira u Rwanda muri London Fashion Week
content: Mizero ni umwe mu bahanzi b’imideli bamaze kugira ibigwi mu Rwanda. Ari mu itsinda ry’abahanzi b’imideli bakomeye ryitwa Collective Rwanda banategura imiruka ry’imideli biyitiriye (Collective Rwanda Fashion Week.) Collective Rwanda ihuriwemo n’inzu z’imideli nka Moshions, House Of Tayo, Haute Baso, Inzuki Designs, Uzi Collections, Sonia Mugabo na Amizero ya Cedric Mizero. Urubuga rwa British Council rwatangaje ko Mizero ari we uzahagararira u Rwanda mu imurika mpuzamahanga ry’imideli (International Fashion Show) mu cyumweru cy’imideli cyibera mu Bwongereza (London Fashion Week 2019). London Fashion Week izaba kuva ku wa 11 kugera ku wa 25 Gashyantare 2019. Mizero azaba ari kumwe n’abandi banyamideli 15 baturutse mu bihugu bitandukanye byo ku Isi, batoranyijwe mu basaga 300 bari babisabye, bakazerekana imideli itandukanye bahanze. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE, yatangaje ko yishimiye gutoranywa muri aba banyamdeli bazerekana imideli bahanze. Avuga ko umwihariko we atari ukwerekana imideli acuruza, ahubwo we icyo abagamije ari ugutanga ubutumwa bushobora kuzana impinduka muri sosiyete. Ati “Fashion kuri njye ni igikoresho kimfasha kubara inkuru. Nararebye nsanga imideli ni ikintu abantu baba bashaka kureba, ni ikintu gikurura abantu. Njye nkore ibintu kugira ngo mvuge amateka. Intego yanjye ni ukugira ngo ngire impinduka muri sosiyete.” Muri London Fashion Week, Mizero azerekana imideli yise Dreaming My Memory, aho azaba agaragaza ubuzima bwe kuva mu bwana agifite imyaka 10. Ati “Nzaba nshaka ko abantu binjira mu byo nibuka ngifite imyaka 10, uko nakuze ariko muri ibyo nibuka bizaba bimeze nk’inzozi, ndi kubirota. Nzaba mvugamo inkuru nyinshi zitandukanye.” Uyu musore wakuriye mu Ntara y’Uburengerazuba, amaze iminsi yerekana imideli itarobanura ibyiciro by’abantu mu mushinga we yise “Fashion for All”. Muri uyu mushinga yifashisha abagore bo mu Karere ka Rusizi aho avuka, akagaragaza agaciro n’uburenganzira bwa buri muntu kandi bakishimira imyambarire yabo hatitawe ku myaka, ingano, ubukire cyangwa ubukene. Mu 2017 yamuritse umushinga yise Strong Women, ugaragaza imbaraga z’abagore n’inshingano zabo, cyane abo mu cyaro aho yifashishije amafoto, agaragaza ubuzima bwabo ariko bambaye imideli yakoze. Hari n’indi mideli yise Beauty In The Heart igaragaza ko ubwiza bw’umuntu budakwiye kureberwa ku isura ye. Muri Gashyante azasoza amasomo y’amezi umunani yigiye kuri internet mu ishuri rya London Fashion College mu bijyanye n’ubucuruzi mu mideli (Fashion Business).

title: Turahirwa washinze inzu y’imideli ya ‘Moshions’ yamuritse iduka rishya (Amafoto)
content: Iri duka rya Moshions riherereye mu Kiyovu hafi ya Stipp Hotel. Ryamuritswe ku mugaragaro ku mugoroba wo kuri iki Cyumweru tariki ya 2 Ukuboza 2018. Muri ibi birori byo kurimurika hari abanyamideli batandukanye bamaze kwamamara mu Rwanda, ingeri zitandukanye z’ibyamamare ndetse n’abantu bari baje kwihera ijisho imyambaro icururizwa muri iri duka. N’ababyeyi b’uyu musore baje kumushyigikira anabashimira byimazeyo kuba badahwema kumwereka urukundo no kumuba hafi. Turahirwa yagarutse cyane ku kuba yaratangiye gukora imyenda adateganya kwamamara kugeza ku rugero agezeho uyu munsi. Ati “Natangiye gukabya inzozi zanjye ndetse ndi kugenda mpura n’abantu kubera ubugeni bwanjye. Ntabwo nigeze ntekereza ko nzamamara ibyo nkora bikagera ku rwego ngezeho uyu munsi.” Uyu musore yavuze ko umunsi yamukiyeho iyi nzu ye nshya ari umunsi utazigera usibangana mu mutwe we. Ati “Uyu munsi ni uw’agaciro kuri njye no ku ikipe ya Moshions, iyi ni inkuru yo gutangirira ku nzozi zoroheje no kubakira ku ntego n’icyizere mu musaruro. Ndashimira byimazeyo buri wese unshyigikira binyuze mu cyizere mungirira iyi ni intambwe ikomeye mu gukomeza guhesha ishema u Rwanda no gukomeza kubera urugero abahanzi b’udushya bo mu mpande zose za Afurika.” Inzu y’imideli ya Moshions yatangijwe mu 2015, igitekerezo cyayo cyaje biturutse ku gushaka gukora imyambaro ifite umwahariko wa Kinyafurika by’umwihariko mu Rwanda. Izina Moshions, ni impine ya Moses yongeweho ijambo ryaturutse ku Fashion. Imyambaro itandukanye yo muri iyi nzu imaze kwamamara ndetse myinshi inambarwa n’ibyamamare bitandukanye mu Rwanda. Amafoto: Muhizi Serge

title: Inzu y’imideli ya Versace igiye kugurwa miliyari $2.1
content:
Michael Kors iri kwagura imikorere yayo ku isoko mpuzamahanga nigura Versace izahindura izina yitwe Capri Holdings Limited. Iyi nzu y’imideli ni iy’Umunyamerika Michael David Kors, yayishinze mu 1981. Versace igiye kugurwa ni sosiyete yo mu Butaliyani ikora ibijyanye n’imyenda yashinzwe na Gianni Versace mu 1978. Donatella Versace ni Umuyobozi wungirije wa Versace Group, afitemo imigabane ingana na 20%. Uyu munyamideli w’imyaka 63 ayiyoboye kuva mu 1997 nyuma y’umwaka umuvandimwe we Gianni yishwe. Yavuze ko kugurishwa “bizatuma Versace ikomeza kugira ubudahangarwa.” Umuyobozi muri Michael Kors Holdings Limited, John Idol Donatella azakomeza kuyobora icyerekezo cya Versace. BBC yanditse ko Michael iteganya kwagura ububiko bwa Versace bukava kuri 200 bukagera kuri 300 no kongera inyungu yinjiza ikagera kuri miliyari $2. Kuva kera imyenda ya Versace ikunda kwambarwa n’ibyamamare nka Michael Jackson, Igikomangoma cya Wales Diana, Umuhanzi ukomeye mu Bwongereza, Elton John. Aba biyongeraho Umuraperi Nicki Minaj, abo mu miryango ya Kardashian na David Beckham n’abandi.
Ishoramari rya Michael ryagutse mu mwaka ushize nyuma yo kugura Uruganda rukora inkweto n’ibikapu rwa Jimmy Choo PLC kuri miliyoni £900. Abasesenguzi bagaragaza ko kugura Versace bizafasha Michael Kors guhangana ku isoko n’inzu y’imideli ikomeye mu Bufaransa ya LVMH and Kering na Richemont yo mu Busuwisi. Michael Kors uyobora inzu y’imideli yamwitiriwe yavukiye muri New York mu 1959. Yize ibyo gukina film ariko yahisemo kuba umunyamideli afite imyaka 14.

title: I Kigali hagiye kubera ibirori bishya by’imideli ikorerwa mu Rwanda
content: Ibi birori byiswe Cretos Fashion Experience byitezweho kuzagaragaza imyambaro y’amoko atandukanye ikorerwa mu Rwanda, biteganyijwe kuba guhera saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba wo ku itariki 28 Nyakanga 2018 kuri Villa Portofino Hotel. Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru, Mugabushaka Jacqueline Hellevik, wabiteguye yagarutse ku bikorwa bitandukanye asanzwe akora, yibanda ku ntego afite yo kubona uruganda rw’ibijyanye no gukora imideli mu Rwanda rwagutse. Yagize ati “Ibi dukora, intego njyewe mfite ni uko bizajya bijya hanze bikerekana ishusho y’u Rwanda aho kugira ngo bigume aha dukomeze kwibaza ngo umwambaro runaka, umuhanzi runaka, umunyamideli runaka, ariko na rimwe ntihazagire ikintu kigera hanze. Nifuza kuba umwe mu bazabiharanira aho kugira ngo bariya bo hanze bave hariya baze aha, ahubwo twe tujye tubasangayo tubashyiriye ibyo dukora.” Hakizimana Abdallah uyoboye imyiteguro y’ibi birori yagize ati “Ni ibirori bizaba bifite intego yo kugaragaza imideli ikorerwa mu Rwanda no kuyitangaho amakuru, ikindi cy’ibanze hakabamo no kwerekana ubushobozi bw’Abanyarwanda mu ruganda rw’imideli. Ngira ngo ni nayo ntego mu kugaragaza ko dushobora kwikorera imyambaro itaduhenze tutarindiriye iy’abanyamahanga ijya kugera inaha ihenze.” Mugabushaka avuga ko nubwo hakiri ibikibabera ingorabahizi mu kuzamura uruganda rw’imideli ariko badacika intege, ahubwo bifuza gukomeza gukorana imbaraga bongeramo n’udushya kugira ngo bagere aho bifuza. Bamaze kubona abanyamideli umunani basanzwe bazwi mu Rwanda bazamurika imyambaro bakora nubwo batararangiza gutoranya abo bazakorana na bo bose. Ku rundi ruhande, yavuze ko ashaka ko imyambaro bakora izabasha no kuzajya ihatana ku rwego mpuzamahanga ngo kandi iyo myambaro ikoze mu buryo bunyuranye butari ubwo mu bitenge gusa nkuko hari abishyiramo ko ibitege ari byo bikoreshwa gusa muri Afurika mu gukora imyenda. Uyu mugore avuga ko yabaye umunyamideli by’igihe kirekire mu Rwanda kuva mu 1997 ndetse akaba n’umwe mu bamuritse imyambaro itandukanye ibirori by’ubu bwoko bicyaduka mu gihugu, nubwo nyuma yaje kujya gukomereza umwuga we i Burayi. Mugabushaka wiyemeje kugaragaza imbaraga z’Abanyarwanda mu gukora imyambaro myiza kandi ihendutse, yagarutse mu Rwanda aje gushinga uruganda rwayo yise Cretos Productions. Akora imyambaro itandukanye mu bitambaro biva mu mahanga ariko akayiha ishusho yifuza n’ibiciro biri hasi y’ibyo mu mahanga. Ibijyanye no kumurika imideli yabyinjijemo n’umwana we witwa Roxanne Hellevik umaze kugaragaza impano ye mu birori bitandukanye bikomeye byo ku mugabane w’i Burayi nka Paris Fashion Week, London Fashion Week, Istanbul Fashion Week n’ibindi bitandukanye.

title: Jay D wabaye Rudasumbwa wa Afurika yasezeye muri GodFather East Africa
content: Ni ku nshuro ya mbere irushanwa rya GodFather East Africa riteguwe, rikorwa mu buryo bwo kugenzura imibanire hagati y’abaryitabira biyemeza kumara amezi atatu babana mu nzu imwe yagutse, uzahiga abandi mu kwitwara neza akazahembwa amashilingi ya Kenya miliyoni 2.5. Jay D mu Rwanda yari yatambutse mu cyiciro gikurikira ari kumwe na Shiny Abdallah, Gigi Mugisha, Teta Sandra, Sissi Ngamije na Vanessa Uwase. Ubuzima bw’abazatoranywa n’abo bazahurira muri Kenya bo mu bindi bihugu butambutswa imbonankubone kuri televiziyo zitandukanye zikomeye. Jay D yabwiye IGIHE ko yamaze kwandika ibaruwa isezera muri GodFather East Africa bitewe n’impamvu bwite. Yagize ati "Ejo nandikiye abategura GodFather East Africa mbabwira ko ntazaboneka, ni ku mpamvu zanjye bwite ariko nyine hakazamo n’akazi gasanzwe umuntu aba akora, ni ibintu biba bigoye kujya hanze yako amezi angana kuriya. Habayeho guhitamo nk’umuntu. Uramutse udatsinze kandi n’akazi wari ufite keza kagutunze waragasezeye, byaba ari ibindi bindi." Jay D avuga ko afite ikigo gishakira abanyamideli akazi mu kwamamaza ariko akaba asanzwe anakora muri Park Inn Hotel. Kabagire Christelle uhagarariye itsinda rikurikirana imitegurire ya GodFather East Africa mu Rwanda yavuze ko nyuma y’aho uyu munyamideli asezeye irushanwa rizakomezanya na batanu basigaye bahagarariye u Rwanda. Yagize ati "Yabimenyesheje GodFather, nanjye yarabinganirije, yambwiye ko yazamuwe mu kazi kandi ari ingenzi cyane kuri we. Yambwiye ko wenda bishobotse yazaboneka mu mwaka utaha ariko ubu ashaka kubanza gushyira imbaraga mu kazi." Yongeyeho ati "Haragenda batanu basigaye, hazakorwa irindi jonjora rizasigamo bane, ntabwo ari ngombwa ko turi bumusimbuze. Muri Kenya hazajyayo abasigaye." Ijonjora ry’ibanze mu Rwanda ryabaye ku wa 16 Mutarama 2018; ryitabiriwe n’abanyamideli 17 babajijwe ibibazo bitandukanye. Abantu icumi barimo n’abasanzwe bazwi mu bijyanye n’imyidagaduro batambutse icyiciro cya mbere nyuma hatorwa batandatu ntakuka barimo na Jay D wasezeye. Abasigayemo bazajya muri Kenya bitabiriye irindi jonjora ku wa 3 Werurwe 2018, bahatanire kwinjira mu nzu ya GodFather. Nibagerayo hazatoranywamo bane kuri buri gihugu hanyuma abatsinze bahamare amezi atatu babana mu nzu. Irushanwa nyir’izina rizatangira ku itariki ya 1 Mata 2018.

title: Uzi Collections yimukiye mu iduka rishya, inashyira ku isoko ikanzu yise ‘Lili’
content:
Ku wa 24 Gashyantare 2018 nibwo Uzi Collections yimuriye ibikorwa byayo mu iduka ririhereye mu Karere ka Kicukiro hafi y’ahazwi nka Zinia. Remera Mukahigiro Nathalie, umwe mu bashinze Uzi Collections, yavuze ko bahisemo kwimuka nyuma y’uko aho bakoreraga kuva mu mpera za 2015 ubwo batangiraga hari hamaze kuba hato. Ati “Twatangiye dufite ubushobozi buke, dufite ahantu hatoya hadashobora gukwirwamo aho kudodera n’ibindi byose twifuzaga, ariko uko ubushobozi bugenda bwiyongera twafunguye ahandi. Twabonye ahanini hashobora guhura neza n’urwego tugezemo.” Yakomeje avuga ko nyuma yo kwimuka muri uyu mwaka bateganya ibikorwa byinshi bitandukanye, ku ikubitiro bakaba bahereye ku mideli mishya y’amakanzu yiswe ‘Lili’. Rebera ashishikariza abanyarwanda kubanza kwitera uburezi bakambara imyambaro ikorerwa mu Rwanda, aho avuga ko nubwo bataragera ku rwego rw’ibikorerwa hanze, bafite ubushobozi bwo guhanga imideli myiza kandi yihariye. Mushikiwabo Solange, umwe mu banyarwanda bambara imyenda ikorwa na Uzi Collections, yavuze ko bishimiye kuba bimukiye ahantu hagutse, kuko aha mbere hari hato ku buryo n’imyambaro yose yabaga itari hamwe. Yanagarutse kandi ku mpamvu yambara imyenda ya Uzi, avuga ko yihariye ku buryo udashobora kugera hanze ngo usange wambaye kimwe n’abandi bantu bose.
Ati “Ibitambaro bakoresha nabyo ni byiza cyane, usanga tuyimesa nticuye. Uburyo tuyiguze niko isaza imeze.” Uzi Collections ni imwe mu nzu z’imideli zimaze kumenyekana mu Rwanda, aho imaze gushyira hanze ubwoko bune (Colletions) bw’imyenda, burimo iyiswe ‘ Zuba Collection’. Bamaze kwitabira amamurika atandukanye arimo na collective Rw Fashion Week 2016 na 2017. Amafoto: Niyonzima Moses [email protected]

title: Ivumburamatsiko kuri Fred Lyon wambika benshi mu byamamare nyarwanda
content: Ubusanzwe yitwa Fred Ndicunguye, amaze imyaka ibiri n’igice akora akazi ko gucuruza imyambaro itandukanye, inkweto n’ibindi. Akundwa na benshi kuko agira imyambaro igezweho. Ubaze umubare w’ibyamamare ntiwawurangiza kuko uhereye kuri Bruce Melodie, Shaddy Boo, Queen Cha, Safi Madiba, Dj Toyxxk, Marnaud n’abandi benshi. IGIHE yamwegereye imuganiriza byinshi abantu bashobora kumwibazaho ndetse n’uko yatangiye gukora ubucuruza bw’imyenda bwaje gutuma yiharira isoko mu gukorana n’ibyamamare. Avuga ko gucuruza yabitangiye kuva kera yiga muri kaminuza mu Bushinwa, akaza kubona ko ari impano ye. Ati “Ni ibintu byari bisanzwe bindimo. Nkiri muri kaminuza nabwo nari umucuruzi, hari ukuntu ushobora kuba ukora aka kazi ariko nta biro ugira, rero niko nakoraga. Nabikoze nkiri mu ishuri mbona byavamo umugati.” “Aho nasoreje kaminuza naratangiye, abantu baramenya nanjye icyo bakeneye ndakimenya. Nize mu Bushinwa, ibijyanye n’ubushabitsi mpuzamahanga. Aho nigaga nakundaga gutembera mu masoko atandukanye ugasanga ni njye uhorana ibintu bishya, bikaba ngombwa ko bagenzi banjye banyifashisha, nkagenda mbibonamo inyungu nke ndabikomeza kuko nabonaga ari impano yanjye.” Yemeza ko atatangiye gukora agamije kwambika abantu imyenda gusa ahubwo yari afite na gahunda yo gukora ikintu cyiza gituma umuntu yambara ibijyanye kandi akaberwa. Ati “Naje nje gukemura ikibazo cyo kwambika abantu ntabwo naje gukora ubushabitsi gusa ahubwo kwari ukugira ngo abantu mbambike. Iyo ushaka kwambika umuntu ntabwo umwambika imyenda ngo agende yambaye ibirenge. Umwambika inkweto, ipantalo, ishati, amadarubindi byaba ngombwa ukamwambika n’isaha.’’ Avuga ko ashaka gutangira kujya agurisha n’imyambaro ya Made in Rwanda. Kuri we ngo abashaka kurimba buri wese aza afite igitekerezo cy’uko ashaka kuberwa ariko na Fred bitewe n’uko akubona akaba yakongeraraho ibindi bitekerezo byatuma wambara mu buryo bunogeye ijisho. Muri iki gihe akorana bya hafi na Bruce Melodie, ndetse n’imyambaro yari yambaye aririmba muri East Africa’s Got Talent yari yayambitswe n’uyu musore. Ati “Urebye Bruce Melodie wa mbere y’uko mfungura iri duka n’uw’ubu baratandukanye. Asigaye yambara bigezweho kandi bimubereye. Yambara imyambaro y’abanyamujyi. Nizo mpinduka nazanye kugira ngo ibintu abahanzi mpuzamahanga babona ku Isi bibashe kugera no ku bahanzi bacu. Imyambaro ntabwo iba ihenze. Guhera ku bihumbi icumi iwanjye ushobora kwambara.” Avuga ko yambika umuntu bitewe n’igikorwa agiyemo. Muri iyi minsi iduka rye ryambika cyane cyane abagabo ariko ubu ashaka gufungura iduka ryihariye ry’abagore. Video: Muhumuza Simeon Amafoto: Muhizi Serge & Fred Lyon Instagram

title: Miss Akiwacu Colombe yitabiriye Paris Fashion Week (Amafoto)
content: Paris Fashion Week iri mu bikorwa byo kumurika imideli bikomeye ku Isi, ku buryo buri munyamideli wese mu bihugu bitandukanye aba yifuza umunsi umwe kuzagaragara atambuka imbere y’abitabiriye iki gikorwa. Uretse kuba ari igikorwa gikomeye ni kimwe mu bihemba neza kandi ukigiyemo akaba yabasha kumenyana n’abandi bantu bakomeye muri uru ruganda bikaba byamufungurira andi marembo. Iki gikorwa ngarukamwaka kuri iyi nshuro cyabaye guhera ku wa 23 Nzeri kugeza ku wa 1 Ukwakira 2019. Akiwacu Colombe yabaye umwe mu bamurika imideli basaga ijana babashije kwitabira. Uyu mukobwa we ari mu banyamideli biyerekanye ku munsi wa nyuma. Imyambaro yamuritswe muri iki gikorwa yari iy’abadozi b’imyenda bibumbiye muri Global Fashion Collective. Miss Akiwacu Colombe yabwiye IGIHE ko kumurika imideli muri iki gikorwa byari akarusho kuri we, by’umwihariko ku mwuga asanzwe akora wo kumurika imideli. Ati “Kugira ngo njyemo nitabiriye itoranya ry’abanyamideli barankunda. Byari byiza cyane ku mwuga wanjye wo kumurika imideli, ikindi ndishyurwa gusa ndanabikunda.” Paris Fashion Week ni kimwe mu birori bimurikirwamo imideli bikomeye ku Isi, iri mu cyiciro kimwe na London Fashion Week, Milan Fashion Week na New York Fashion Week. Iki gikorwa cyatangiye guhera mu 1973 bigizwemo uruhare na French Fashion Federation. Miss Akiwacu yaherukaga ibikorwa nk’ibi muri Kamena 2019, aho yitabiriye imurika ry’imisatsi rigamije kwamagana ivangura rikorerwa abafite imisatsi y’injwiri mu Mujyi wa Paris mu gace ka Place de l’Opéra. Iki gikorwa cyari cyateguwe na Murielle Kabile usanzwe akora imisatsi y’ubwoko butandukanye. Iki gikorwa cyo kumurika imisatsi cyiswe “Don’t Touch My Hair”, cyakozwe mu rwego rwo kwamagana abantu bakora mu misatsi y’abafite injwiri nk’uburyo bwo kubendereza cyangwa kubirataho, ibintu bifatwa nk’ivanguraruhu. Akiwacu Colombe amaze imyaka ine mu Bufaransa, amaze kwimariramo ibyo kumurika imideli ndetse ni kimwe mu bimutunze n’ubwo afite akandi kazi ka buri munsi akora. Uyu mukobwa yari aherutse kuza mu Rwanda muri Nzeri 2019, ahoyatashye inzu ebyiri yubakiye imiryango ine y’ababyeyi barokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi bazwi nk’Intwaza bo mu Karere ka Rwamagana, nyuma y’ubukangurambaga yagiye akora mu buryo butandukanye. Akiwacu yatowe nka Nyampinga w’u Rwanda mu 2014 ubwo iri rushanwa ryatangiraga gutegurwa na Rwanda Inspiration Backup ikibikora kugeza n’ubu.  	Amafoto y’abandi banyamideli bitabiriye Paris Fashion Week

title: Umusore uzahagararira u Rwanda muri ‘Mister Africa 2019’ yamenyekanye
content: Uyu musore w’imyaka 20 yashyizwe mu bazatoranywamo uhiga abandi mu buranga muri Afurika mu irushanwa risanzwe rizwi cyane nka Mister Africa International ritegurwa na House of Twitch yo muri Nigeria nk’uko Promise Adebayo ukuriye iyi sosiyete itegura irushanwa yabitangarije IGIHE. Umwaka ushize u Rwanda rwagombaga guserukirwa na Nshongore wabaye Mister Elegancy Rwanda 2018, ariko ntiyabasha kwitabira. Ibirori ny’ir’izina byo kwambika ikamba umusore uzahiga abandi muri Mister Africa 2019, bizaba ku wa 1 Ukuboza 2019. U Rwanda rumaze kwitabira iri rushanwa kabiri, ubwa mbere byari mu 2015 ubwo Turahirwa Moses yabaga Igisonga cya mbere cya Rudasumbwa ndetse no mu 2017 ubwo Ntabanganyimana Jean de Dieu yahigikaga bagenzi be akegukana ikamba rya Mister Africa International 2017. Umwaka ushize ikamba rya Mister Africa International ryatwawe na Calisah Jiwa wo muri Tanzania. Yakurikiwe na Ibrahim Alton Mansaray wo muri Sierra Leone, Chuckie Ihebuzor wo muri Nigeria, Jason Asare Akoto wo muri Ghana na Makala Nganda Courtez wo muri Cameroon. Christophe Carlos, Mister Africa-France yatowe nk’uwubatse umubiri neza naho Tevin Lennox wahagarariye u Bwongereza atorwa nk’uwifotoje neza ku mucanga.

title: Abanyarwanda bacanye umucyo muri Tokyo Africa Collections (Amafoto)
content:
Ni igikorwa cyabaye ku nshuro ya mbere cyitabiriwe n’Abanyarwanda nyuma y’ubufatanye n’abategura Kigali International Fashion Week. Mbere y’igikorwa aba Banyarwanda bitabiriye Tokyo Fashion Week basuye ibigo bikomeye nka AOKI iri mu bigo bikora amakositimu akomeye mu Buyapani, kompanyi itegura icyayi cy’u Rwanda n’ibindi. Aba Banyarwanda bageze mu Buyapani ku wa 27 Kanama 2019 bazagaruka i Kigali ku wa 5 Nzeri 2019. Abahanga imideli bo mu Rwanda bitabiriye Tokyo Africa Collections barimo Murorunkwere Sandrine ufite inzu ihanga imideli ya Sahorn Fashion House na Karen Uwera ufite inzu y’imideli ya KARSSH Collection. Mu berekana imideli bitabiriye baturutse mu Rwanda barimo Bella Christa Kanyange na Kaneza Lynka Amanda. Kuva mu 2017, ibirori ngarukamwaka bya Kigali Fashion Week byagejejwe ku yindi ntera n’ababitegura bitangira kubera i Burayi nyuma y’imyaka irindwi bibera mu Rwanda gusa. Icyo gihe ku ikubitiro byatangiriye i Berlin mu Budage, bikomereza i Amsterdam mu Buholandi, hanyuma bisorezwa i Bruxelles mu Bubiligi.
Ku wa Gatandatu tariki 6 Nyakanga 2019 habayeho igikorwa cya Kigali Fashion Week ku nshuro yacyo ya cumi kuva gitangijwe mu Rwanda, cyabereye muri Kigali Serena Hotel. Cyahurije hamwe abamurika imideli batandukanye bo mu Rwanda no hanze yarwo ndetse n’abayihanga, biyerekanye mu buryo bwanyuze abacyitabiriye. Herekanwe imyambaro itandukanye irimo iy’inzu zihanga imideli nka Ucoco na The 5 Mith yo mu Burundi, By The Way Clothes yo mu Bubiligi na Gissa Fashion Design yo muri Suède. Abahanga imideli bo mu Rwanda biyerekanye barimo Aqua, Ihogoza Design, Dk Textiles, Iby’iwacu Summer Collection, Mundi Design na Karen Karsh wa Karsh Collections. Sayaka Akimoto ushinzwe kumenyekanisha Tokyo Africa Collection 2019 na Leo Sugo utegura iki gikorwa bari mu bacyitabiriye. Kigali Fashion Week yatangiye mu 2012, itangirana n’ibindi birori birimo icya Kampala, Bujumbura na Nairobi Fashion week. Inategura ibitaramo muri Ghana n’ibindi bihugu bikomeye ndetse yanatangiye ibirori birimo Kigali International Fashion Week ibera mu Buholandi, u Bubiligi, u Budage n’u Bwongereza. Uyu mwaka bazatangira ibindi birori birimo ibizabera i New York, Thailand na Singapore.

title: Kim Kardashian yahinduye izina ry’imideli ye nyuma yo kotswa igitutu n’Abayapani
content: Tariki 2 Kamena 2019 nibwo Kim Karashian yamuritse imyambaro y’imbere igaragaza imiterere y’abagore ayita “Kimono”. Bikimara kumenyekana ko yise iyi myambaro atyo, ntibyishimiwe na benshi biganjemo abo mu Buyapani bifashishije imbuga nkoranyambaga bakamwamaganira kure bavuga ko ari gusuzugura umuco wabo. Ubusanzwe Kimono ni umwambaro wubashywe mu muco w’Abayapani wambarwa mu birori bikomeye nk’ubukwe, gushyingura n’indi minsi mikuru. Nyuma y’iki gitutu, Kim Kardashian, yemeje ko agiye gushaka irindi zina risimbura Kimono yambuwe n’abayapani. Abinyujije kuri Twitter na Instagram, Kim Kardashian yatangaje ko yamaze guhindura izina ry’iyi mideli ayita ‘SKIMS’. Ati “ Abakunzi banjye n’abankurikira mbakuraho ibitekerezo byinshi. Numva ibitekerezo byabo kandi nishimiye ko bampaye ibitekerezo ku mideli yanjye mishya. Nyuma yo kubiha agaciro nishimiye kubatangariza ku mugaragaro SKIMS.” Kardashian yavuze ko umuhango wo kwerekana iyi mideli uzaba tariki 10 Nzeri 2019.

title: Uko umusore ukomoka mu Budage yafashe iya mbere mu guhanga imyambaro ya Made in Rwanda
content: Paul Böger yabwiye IGIHE ko nyuma yo gusoza amashuri yisumbuye aribwo yaje mu Rwanda mu imenyereza ry’umwaka umwe mu kigo cy’ibidukikije mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Binyuze muri iryo menyereza yakoze mu 2015, yashituwe n’uruganda rw’imideli mu Rwanda avuga ko yari amaze imyaka myinshi mu bijyanye n’uru ruganda ariko muri icyo gihe ku nshuro ye ya mbere yahisemo gutangira guhanga imyambaro ye ikozwe muri Made in Rwanda bivuye mu bitekerezo bye. Ati “Byaranshimishije cyane gukora imyambaro ivuye mu bitekerezo byacu ariko noneho ari iya ‘Made in Rwanda’.” Mu 2016 avuga ko byamushimishije gukora imyambaro yishimiwe na benshi ndetse agenda yakira inyunganizi nziza zimwereka ko yagize igitekerezo cyiza. Böger yahisemo gukorana n’abakora ibijyanye n’imyambaro bo mu Rwanda ndetse inzu ihanga imideli ye ayita ‘Izuba Clothing’. Mu 2016 yashyize hanze imyambaro yahanze ya ‘Made in Rwanda’ anayimurika mu imurikagurisha rya Shaban Masengesho ryabereye muri Mainz. Nyuma yo gukora imyambaro ayijyana iwabo mu Budage akayibika mu bubiko ahafite, iyo amaze kuyigezayo atangira kuyicuruza ku rubuga rwa internet kuri https://www.izubaclothing.com/ Uyu musore amaze kwitabira ibikorwa bitandukanye mu Budage n’ibindi bihugu bihana imbibi amenyekanisha umudeli we wihariye wa ‘Made in Rwanda’ akavuga ko benshi mu bazungu bagenzi be babyishimira. Avuga ko abantu benshi batita cyane ku ho imyenda yabo yakorewe ndetse n’uwayikoze gusa ngo kuri we ni ingenzi cyane kubivuga no kugaragaza aho imyambaro yaturutse n’uri kuyikora. Yahisemo guteza imbere ibikorerwa mu Rwanda kuko yabonye imyambaro myinshi yo mu Rwanda iva hanze. Ati “Amaduka n’amasoko yo mu Rwanda aba yuzuyemo ibyaturutse hanze y’u Rwanda mu bihugu by’ibituranyi cyangwa byinshi byaturutse i Burayi, Aziya cyangwa Amerika. Ariko imyambaro yo mu Rwanda ntabwo icuruzwa mu Burayi. Ntewe imbaraga n’ubukangurambaga nasanze mu Rwanda bwa ‘Made in Rwanda’ nasanze byaba inzira nziza yo kumenyekanisha iyi myambaro ku rwego rw’Isi.” “Hari isoko rinini mu bijyanye no gukora no gucuruza imyambaro, nshaka ko imyambaro ya ‘Made in Rwanda’ igaragara cyane mu Burayi cyane cyane muri Budage iwacu.” Avuga igitekerezo cyo kwita iduka rye ‘Izuba’ cyaturutse ku kuba izuba rirasa buri munsi, akaba ashaka ko iduka rye rikomeza kuba nk’izuba. Mu myaka itanu iri imbere ashaka kuzaba amaze gufatisha isoko ry’imyambaro ye mu Rwanda. Intego ye ni ukugira ububiko bw’imyambaro ye mu Rwanda no mu Budage.

title: Imyambarire igezweho mu banyamujyi b’abanyabirori (Amafoto)
content: Akenshi usanga ibijyanye n’imyambarire ari ibihe byisubiramo, bisa nk’aho nta kintu gishya kigihangwa ahubwo imyambaro yakanyujijeho mu bihe bya kera ariyo yongera kwadukanwa n’ikindi gisekuru. Ingero ni nyinshi zihari ariko dufatiye ku nkweto ya DH yamamaye mu bihe byo hambere, abakurikirana bazi neza ko iyi mu minsi ya vuba yagarutse mu yindi sura ya ‘All Star Converse’ yongera guhararwa na benshi mu rubyiruko ndetse na n’ubu yambarwa n’abatari bake barimo n’ibyamamare. Nta gishya mu myambarire ahubwo biba ari nko kongera kwiyibutsa ibyo abakurambere bakunze kurimba bikagenda bihererekanywa uko imyaka yahise. IGIHE yakusanyije imwe mu myambarire igezweho muri iki gihe cyane cyane mu banyamujyi ariko igenda ituruka ku mico y’ahandi bitewe n’ibiba bigezweho mu myambarire y’ibyamamare.  	Gutebeza ishati igice kimwe (Half Tuck) The Guardian itangaza ko iyi myambarire yamamaye cyane kuva mu 2013 ikaza gusa nk’aho icogora kugeza aho muri uyu mwaka yongeye kwigarurira imitima ya benshi. Ni imyambarire igezweho muri iki gihe mu banyamujyi, iyi usanga benshi mu rubyiruko bayikunda cyane. Kuva mu muhanda usanga abenshi bambaye muri ubwo buryo, aho ishati itebezwa igice kimwe ikindi kigasigara kirereta. Biragoye kugenda metero zirenze 300 utarahura n’uwarimbye muri ubwo buryo cyane mu duce duhuriramo abantu benshi. Biba akarusho rero iyo ugiye mu bitaramo kuko kuva ku bahanzi kugera mu bafana babo usanga baserutse muri uwo mwambaro. Ibi bigaragaza ko iyi myambarire ikunzwe bidasubirwaho.  	Kwambara agakapu ko mu rukenyerero (Waist Bag) Kwambara ukarenzaho agakapu nabyo biri mu bigezweho cyane muri iki gihe. Wikipedia igaragaraza ko udukapu twambarwa mu rukenyerero Abanyamerika batwita Fanny Pack, Belt bag cyangwa Belly bag mu gihe Abongereza bo batwita Bum Bag. Mu mateka, utu dukapu abantu batwambaraga bashaka kwirinda ibisambo. Utu dukapu twafatanywaga n’imikandara mu mico itandukanye guhera mu bihe byo hambere. Mu myaka yo mu 1980 nibwo utu dukapu twongeye gukorerwa ivugurura ndetse dushyirwa mu kinyamakuru cya Vogue kizwiho kwandika ku byerekeye imideli. Mu 2012 abahanga imideli batandukanye bongeye kutwadukana batwise ‘Belted Satchels’ cyangwa se ‘Hands-Free Bags’ bashaka kuzana imyambaro ihenze y’abakunda kurimba. Mu Bufaransa utu dukapu batwita Banana Bags, muri Espagne bakatwita Kidney Bags naho mu Butaliyani ho batwita Marsupio. Mu 2018, The Boston Globe yatangaje ko udukapu tunitwa ‘Fanny Packs’ twagarutse muri Vogue dufite indi myihariko tuzanywe n’abahanga imideli bakomeye barimo Gucci, Prada na Louis Vuitton. Twambawe n’ibyamamare bitandukanye birimo Kim Kardashian, Rihanna, Jaden Smith na Russell Westbrook. Uretse kutwambara mu rukenyerero utu dukapu hari n’abatwambara batunyujije mu gatuza tukamanuka tukanyura mu kwaha no mu mugongo. Ubwoko bw’udukapu dukunzwe kwambarwa turimo utwa Supreme, Adidas na Fila n’utundi.  	Kwambara Jean Jacket (Denim Jacket/Trucker Jacket) na Hoodie Mu myambarire igezweho mu Rwanda muri iki gihe harimo no kwambarira Jean Jacket (ikoti rimeze nk’ikoboyi) inyuma y’umupira w’imbeho, urubyiruko rwinshi cyane cyane i Kigali n’abandi basirimu bari mu bakunda kurimba muri ubu buryo. Kwambara gutya mu Rwanda byatangiye kwamamara cyane mu ntangiriro za 2019 nyuma y’uko mu mwaka ushize habanje kugerwaho kwambara Jean Jacket nabyo bigaca ibintu. Hari n’amakoti yitwa ‘Hooded Denim Jacket’ yo afite ishusho y’umupira w’ingofero ufatanye na Denim cyangwa se Jean Jacket. Jean Jacket yatangiye kwambarwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu kinyejana cya 19, yakunzwe n’ab’ingeri zose ukajya wambarwa n’abagabo n’abagore. Uyu mwambaro wahanzwe n’uruganda rw’imyenda rwa Levi Strauss & Co. ruri mu zikomeye muri Amerika.  	Imikandara ya Cinture Donna Ni imikandara miremire yambarwa hagamijwe kurimba, uwambaye arawuzengurutsa yawugeza imbere akawureka ukarereta igice kinini ukenda kugera ku mavi. Mu Karere ka Afurika y’Iburasirazuba iyi mikandara yamamaye cyane guhera mu 2018 biturutse ku ndirimbo yakoreshejwemo mu mashusho ya Sauti Sol na Nyashinski bise ‘Short N Sweet’ yagiye hanze muri Gicurasi umwaka ushize. Iyi ndirimbo imaze kurebwa n’abasaga miliyoni 13 mu mwaka n’amezi asaga abiri imaze hanze. Uyu na wo ni umwe mu myambaro abanyamujyi benshi usanga baserukana mu minsi ya none.  	Guheka udukapu duto Ubundi wasangaga mu minsi ishize umukobwa akenshi agenda yitwaje igikapu kinini mu ntoki; iyo yabaga yasohokanye n’abandi wasangaga bibangamye, ariko muri iki gihe siko bimeze ahubwo benshi bitwaza udukapu duto duhekwa. Utu dukapu tuba turimo ibintu nkenerwa birimo ibyo bakwifashisha mu kwiyitaho ku isuku, telefoni, indahuzo (chargeur) n’utundi dukoresho twa ngombwa umuntu ashobora gukenera mu rugendo. Kuri benshi usanga utu dukapu baradusimbuje amasakoshi yari asanzwe amenyerewe cyane.  	Do-rags (Durags) Ni udutambaro twambarwa mu mutwe duharawe na benshi muri iki gihe. Durags zatangiye kwambarwa mu kinyejana cya 19 n’abakozi b’Abanyamerika bakomoka muri Afurika b’abakene ndetse n’abakoreshwaga uburetwa bashaka kurinda imisatsi yabo ngo itandura. Mu 1930 Durags zatangiye kwambarwa nk’uturinda musatsi, nyuma y’icyiswe Black Power Movement mu 1960 ihinduka kimwe mu mirimbo mu Banyamerika bakomoka muri Afurika. Zanambarwaga n’abaraperi n’abakinnyi b’imikino itandukanye cyane ab’igitsinagabo bo mu myaka itandukanye. Mu 2000, kwambara Durags mu ruhame byabaye nk’ibitakigezweho mu bice bimwe ariko zigumana ubwamamare bwazo ahandi. Umuraperi A$AP Ferg yongeye guhesha agaciro Durags mu myaka yashize bikubitanye no kugaruka kw’inyogosho benshi bazi nka ‘Waves’, Durags zongera kugira agaciro gakomeye mu muryango w’Abanyamerika bafite inkomoko muri Afurika. Kwambara Durags muri Amerika byagiye biteza impagarara cyane, hari nk’ubwo mu 2001 abakinnyi ba Shampiyona y’Umupira w’Amaguru yo muri Amerika bigeze kubuzwa kuzambara zo na bandana. No mu mashuri yisumbuye bigeze kubuzwa kuzambara; nko mu Ishuri ryisumbuye rya John Muir riherereye i Pasadena muri California ryarabikoze mu ntangiriro za 2019 abanyeshuri barigaragambya mu mutuzo. Iyi myigaragambyo yakozwe n’Ihuriro ry’abanyeshuri b’abirabura. Aba banyeshuri bakoze imyigaragambyo bashinja ubuyobozi bw’ishuri kuvuga ko ‘Kwambara Durags bizatuma abanyeshuri bacengerwa n’imico y’amabandi’ gusa umuyobozi w’ishuri we yireguye avuga ko ataribyo ahubwo babikoze kubera ‘Indangagaciro z’ishuri z’uko bagomba kwitwara ku ishuri’.  	Athleisure Athleisure ni uburyo bw’imyambarire aho imyenda isanzwe ikoreshwa muri siporo, abantu bayambara bagiye mu kazi, ku ishuri cyangwa ibindi birori. Niba ukurikirana umuziki, indirimbo Safi Madiba yahuriyemo na Meddy bise ‘Got it It’ igaragaza neza uko uyu mugabo wahoze muri Urban Boyz aseruka yambaye amatiriningi atukura. Iyi myambarire nayo igezweho cyane muri iki gihe by’umwihariko cyane ko ari mu gihe cy’impeshyi, kwambara gutya ni uburyo bwo gusubira mu bihe byo hambere ukajyanisha n’inkweto za siporo. Abamaze gusobanukirwa n’ibijyanye n’imyambarire usanga aribo bambara muri ubu buryo cyane cyane.  	Ipantalo zicikaguritse (Déchiré Jeans) Iyi nayo ni imyambaro igezweho muri iki gihe, ni amapantalo asa nk’acikaguritse ariko akaba asohoka mu ruganda ariko akozwe. Ashobora kuba acitse ku ivi, ku kibero cyangwa ahandi. Urubuga rwa Apparelsearch rugaragaza ko uyu mwambaro watangiye gukoreshwa ukanamamara cyane kuva mu kinyejana cya 20, mu myaka ya 1980 kugeza mu 2000. Mu ntangiriro za 2010 nibwo yongeye kwambarwa cyane ku migabane itandukanye. Guhera mu 2017 uyu mwambaro benshi biganjemo urubyiruko batangiye kuwambara cyane bitandukanye n’indi myaka kugeza na n’uyu munsi n’umwe mu y’abanyabirori.  	Ipantalo za High Waist Iyi myambaro y’abakobwa nayo iri mu igezweho mu banyamujyi. Ni ipantalo z’abakobwa ziba zizamutse ugasanga zambariwe zikagera mu mayunguyungu. Ni umwe mu myambaro igezweho mu bakobwa muri Kigali ntiwatera metero 100 utarahura n’umukobwa uyambaye. Ipantaro nk’izi z’abahungu zirahari ariko mu Rwanda ho ntabwo zamamaye cyane nk’iz’abakobwa.  	Off White Iyi myenda yoroheye cyane ikorwa na ‘Off White’ ya Virgil Abloh ufite ababyeyi bo muri Ghana ariko wavukiye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika akaba ari naho akorera ibikorwa bye bitandukanye bijyanye no guhanga imyenda. Iyi myenda nayo ni myiza ku muntu ukeneye kwambara bijyanye n’igihe cy’impeshyi kuko yoroheye kandi ikaba igufasha iyo hari izuba ryinshi. Ni yo umuhanzikazi Queen Cha aheruka guserukana ku rubyiniro ubwo yari mu gitaramo cya ‘Iwacu Muzika Festival’ cyabereye mu Karere ka Rubavu ku wa 29 Kamena.  	Amadarubindi ya Tiny Sunglasses Ni amadarubindi asa nk’aho aribwo ari gukundwa na benshi cya mu Rwanda, nyamara yatangiye kwamamara cyane mu 2018 cyane muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika biturutse kuri Kanye West. Ibyamamare byayambaye birimo Kendall na Kylie Jenner, Bella na Gigi Hadid, Kim Kardashian, Kanye West n’abana b’ibyamamare barimo Zoe Kravitz, Kaia Gerber na Hailey Baldwin. Aya madarubindi yamamaye ubwo Kim Kardashian yayambaraga mu gace k’ikiganiro cyo muri Mutarama 2018 cya ‘Keeping Up With the Kardashians’ gikorwa n’uyu mugore. Icyo gihe yavuze ko umugabo yamwoherereje ubutumwa amubuza kwambara amadarubindi manini ahubwo amwoherereza amafoto yaya ya ‘Tinny’ amubwira ko ariyo agomba kwambara. Icyo gihe mu binyamakuru bitandukanye birimo E! Channel, Independent na HuffPost mu nkuru nyamukuru zabo habanzaga izivuga kuri aya madarubindi, ahita yamamara atyo. Kanye West ntabwo ariwe wahimbye aya madarubindi ahubwo icyo yakoze ni ukuyamenyekanisha kuko yakozwe na Adam Selman uhanga imideli wanahanze iyambawe n’abarimo Rihanna, Beyoncé na Lady Gaga.  	High Heels za Batzuzhi High Heels ni zimwe mu nkweto abanyamujyi benshi bakunze kwambara, zambarwa ku makanzu cyangwa se ku mapantalo. Ni inkweto zihora imbere mu bijyanye n’imyambarire y’abagore kuko akenshi nizo bambara iyo bagiye mu birori bikomeye. Iza Batzuzhi zikorwa n’inzu y’imideli ya Batzuzhi yo mu Butaliyani ni zo zigezweho muri iki gihe. Ni inkweto ndende usanga zifite talon ndende ndetse uzirebeye kure ubona ko zifite ubugenge mu kuzigenderamo. Izi nkweto zifite imiterere itandukanye ndetse ziza mu mabara anyuranye. Uzambaye aba muremure bitewe n’uko ziba zitereye mu kirere.  	Inkweto z’abagabo za Balenciaga Inkweto za Balenciaga ziri mu zikunzwe cyane mu bazi kurimba, abashaka gukora siporo cyangwa se kwambara inkweto zinepa ariko zifite talon nini. Benshi mu bakora siporo mu nzu zikomeye muri Kigali, usanga bazambaye. Ni inkweto zikorwa n’uruganda rwa Balenciaga S.A. rwashinzwe n’Umunya-Espagne, Cristóbal Balenciaga.

title: Imideli ikoranywe ubuhanga n’intambuko zinogeye ijisho mu byaranze Kigali Fashion Week 2019 (Amafoto)
content: ‘Kigali Fashion Week’ ni igitaramo kimaze kubaka izina mu Rwanda kandi gikundwa na benshi mu bakurikiranira hafi ibijyanye n’imideli. Ku wa Gatandatu tariki 6 Nyakanga 2019 nibwo iki gitaramo ku nshuro yacyo ya cumi kuva gitangijwe mu Rwanda, cyabereye muri Kigali Serena Hotel. Cyahurije hamwe abamurika imideli batandukanye bo mu Rwanda no hanze yarwo ndetse n’abayihanga, biyerekanye mu buryo bwanyuze abacyitabiriye. Herekanywe imyambaro itandukanye irimo iy’inzu zihanga imideli nka Ucoco na The 5 Mith yo mu Burundi, By The Way Clothes yo mu Bubiligi na Gissa Fashion Design yo muri Suède. Abahanga imideli bo mu Rwanda biyerekanye barimo Aqua, Ihogoza Design, Dk Textiles, Iby’iwacu Summer Collection, Mundi Design na Karen Karsh wa Karsh Collections. Ibi birori byatangijwe na John Bunyeshuri, kuri iyi nshuro byari bitandukanye n’ibyabanje cyane ko ubu byamaze kujya mu maboko ya Sosiyete yitwa ‘Iby’iwacu’ ya Umulisa Fiona Cécile ikaba ariyo yabiteguye ndetse ikanabikurikirana kuva bitangiye kugeza birangiye. Sayaka Akimoto ushinzwe kumenyekanisha Tokyo Africa Collection 2019 na Leo Sugo utegura iki gikorwa bari mu bacyitabiriye. Leo Sugo yavuze ko muri iki gikorwa batumiye abamurika imideli n’abayihanga bo mu Rwanda kuba bazacyitabira cyane ko bafitanye imikoranire. Iki gikorwa cyahujwe na Kigali International Fashion Week izabera mu Buyapani. John Bunyeshuri watangije Kigali Fashion Week akaba ari nawe wari uyoboye ibirori, yavuze ko aho Kigali Fashion Week iri uyu munsi ari aho kwishimirwa kuko hari abantu benshi yafashije. Yakomeje avuga ko icyo ashaka ari ukuzamura buri muntu ufite impano mu ruganda rw’imideli kuko aribyo bizatuma rukomeza gukura umunsi ku wundi rukagera kure. Ati “Impamvu Kigali Fashion Week itandukanye n’ibindi birori by’imideli ni uko njya ahantu hatandukanye; uyu mwaka nagiye i Musanze na Huye nkabwira umuntu nti uhanga imyenda? Reka tukuzamure. Akambwira ati ’ese nzishyura angahe?’ Nkamubwira nti ntabwo nkeneye amafaranga ahubwo icyo nshaka ni ukukumenyekanisha.” Kigali Fashion Week yatangiye mu 2012, itangirana n’ibindi birori birimo icya Kampala, Bujumbura na Nairobi Fashion week. Inategura ibitaramo muri Ghana n’ibindi bihugu bikomeye ndetse yanatangiye ibirori birimo Kigali International Fashion Week ibera mu Buholandi, u Bubiligi, u Budage n’u Bwongereza.
