title: Kardashian agiye guhindura izina ry’imyambaro y’imbere yatumye yamaganwa n’Abayapani
content: Ku wa 26 Kamena nibwo Kardashian yamuritse imyambaro y’imbere igamije kugaragaza imiterere y’umugore ayita ‘Kimono’. Bikimara kumenyekana ko yise iyi myambaro gutya, ntabwo byishimiwe na benshi biganjemo abo mu Buyapani bifashishije imbuga nkoranyambaga bakamwamaganira kure bavuga ko ari gusuzugura umuco wabo. Nyuma yo kutishimirwa na benshi Kardashian yahisemo guhindura izina ry’imyambaro ritavuzweho rumwe na benshi mu Bayapani. Mu butumwa yanditse ku rukuta rwe rwa Twitter, yavuze kuba rwiyemezamirimo akibera n’umuyobozi byose icya rimwe byagiye akenshi bimuzanira imbogamizi ariko zamubereye umugisha mu buzima bwe. Yemeza ko icyagiye gituma ibintu byinshi bimworohera ari uko afite imiyoboro yihuse avuganaho n’abakunzi be ndetse n’abandi bose bakurikirana ibikorwa bye. Kim Kardashian yahamije ko akunda kumva ibitekerezo by’abantu, kwiga ndetse no gushaka gukomeza gukura. Arakomeza ati “Nishimira uburyo abantu bakunda ibyo nkora n’uko bampa ibitekerezo bitandukanye. Ubwo natangazaga izina ry’iyi myenda yanjye y’imbere, nabikoze mfite intego nziza mu mutwe.” “Amazina y’ibyo nkora ndetse n’ibyo nshyira ku isoko biba bikoranywe itandukaniro nyuma yo kubitekerezaho cyane no kugira byinshi twitaho. Vuba ngiye gutangaza izina rishya ry’iyi myambaro nari nashyize hanze. Nzakomeza kuvugana namwe. Murakoze kunyumva no kunshyigikira nk’uko bisanzwe.” Kim Kardashian atangaza ubu butumwa, hari benshi mu Bayapani bamushimiye ariko n’abavuze ko ibyo yakoze bidahagije kuko nta hantu yigeze asaba imbabazi ku makosa ye. Ku wa 26 Kamena nibwo Kim Kardashian yatangaje ko agiye gushyira hanze umwambaro mushya w’imbere yise ‘Kimono Intimates’. Uyu mugore w’imyaka 38 yavuze ko uyu mwambaro ugamije kwerekana imiterere y’umugore. Yasangije abamukurikira amafoto atatu muri uyu mwambaro yifoje awambaye ndetse ari kumwe n’abandi banyamideli avuga ko yari amaze imyaka 15 yiga ku mushinga wawo yizeza abamukurikira ko urabageraho vuba. Gusa Abayapani benshi ntabwo byabashimishije, bavuze ko ari ugusuzugura umwambaro wa Kimono wo muri iki gihugu wamenyekanye mu kinyejana cya 15 nka gakondo y’Abayapani. Abayapani benshi bahise batangira kwamagana igikorwa cya Kim maze bifashisha Twitter bakoresheje hashtag ya #KimOhNo.

title: Abanyamideli 10 batoranyijwe muri 534 bitabiriye ijonjora rya Kigali Fashion Week ya 2019 (Amafoto)
content: Iki gikorwa cyabereye muri Sports View Hotel iherereye ku Kicukiro mu Mujyi wa Kigali, aho abanyamideli batandukanye bo mu Rwanda bateraniye hamwe hashakishwa abazitabira igikorwa cya Kigali Fashion Week kizaba muri Nyakanga. Abanyamideli batoranyijwe ni Mucyo Sandrine, Shema Christian, Shema Justin, Iradukunda Yassir, Teta Christelle, Munezero Christine, Iradukunda Shema Daniel, Ganza Prince, Uwizeyimana Yvette na Masabo Anaise Audrey. Ibyagenderwagaho batoranya aba banyamideli harimo kuba azi gutambuka neza, afite n’indeshyo ihuye n’iyo abagize akanama nkemurampaka bifuza. Akanama nkemurampaka kari kagizwe na Fridaus Muna ukorera ibikorwa bijyanye n’imideli muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Umurundikazi witwa Erica Murekatete unashinzwe kuzakurikirana abanyamideli mu rwambariro, Michael Thayer usanzwe ahanga imideli na Kamanzi Gisele uri mu banyamigabane ba Kigali Fashion Week. Umulisa Fiona Cécile ukuriye ‘Iby’iwacu’ yafashe inshingano zo gutegura iki gikorwa, yavuze ko icy’uyu mwaka kirimo impinduka nyinshi ugereranyije n’indi myaka yatambutse. Ku wa 1 Nyakanga hazatoranywa abamurika imideli bo ku rwego mpuzamahanga bagera kuri 15. Igikorwa cya Kigali Fashion Week izaba guhera ku wa 4-6 Nyakanga ku nshuro ya 10 ndetse abagiteguye bafunguye imiryango ku bashaka kwigaragaza muri uru ruganda rwo guhanga no kumurika imideli. Kwinjira bizaba ari 15, 000 Frw ku muntu umwe na 25, 000 Frw ku bantu babiri.

title: Miss Akiwacu Colombe yitabiriye imurika ry’imisatsi i Paris
content: Ibi byabaye ku mugoroba wo ku wa Gatandatu w’icyumweru gishize mu Mujyi wa Paris mu gace ka Place de l’Opera. Iki gikorwa cyateguwe na Mureille Kabile usanzwe akora imisatsi y’ubwoko butandukanye. Abinyujije ku rubuga rwe rwa internet, yavuze ko yateguye igikorwa cyo kumurika imisatsi y’injwiri nyuma yo kunenwa no kuvangurwa n’abandi batandukanye. Iki gikorwa cyo kumurika imisatsi cyiswe “Don’t Touch My Hair”, cyakozwe mu rwego rwo kwamagana abantu bakora mu misatsi y’abafite injwiri nk’uburyo bwo kubendereza cyangwa kubirataho, ibintu bifatwa nk’ivanguraruhu. Nyampinga w’u Rwanda mu 2014, Akiwacu ni umwe mu banyamideli biyerekanye mu muhanda bambaye imisatsi myinshi, mu gace ka Place de l’ Opera. Abinyujije ku rubuga rwe rwa Instagram, Akiwacu yavuze ko muri iki kinyejana nta muntu ukwiye kunena undi ngo ni uko afite imisatsi idasa n’iye. Akiwacu Colombe umaze imyaka ine mu Bufaransa, mu 2017 yitabiriye igikorwa cyo kumurika imisatsi cyiswe Big Hair World.ed.

title: Kigali Fashion Week yuguruye imiryango ku bahanga imideli n’abayimurika
content: Iki gikorwa kizabera muri Kigali Serena Hotel ku wa 4 kugeza ku wa 6, kwinjira bizaba ari 15, 000 Frw ku muntu umwe na 25, 000 Frw ku bantu babiri. Kuri iyi nshuro bizaba bitandukanye n’ibyabanje cyane ko ubu byamaze kujya mu maboko ya Sosiyete yitwa ‘Iby’iwacu’ ikaba ariyo izabitegura ndetse ikanabikurikirana kuva bitangiye kugeza birangiye. John Bunyeshuri wari umaze imyaka umunani ategura iki gikorwa cya Kigali Fashion Week kibera mu Rwanda, aherutse kubwira IGIHE ko bahisemo kugishyira mu maboko y’iyi kompanyi kubera ko bashaka guha umwanya n’abakiri bato bakigaragaza mu bijyanye no gutegura ibikorwa by’imideli. Yakomeje avuga ko we icyo azakora ari ukuzaba ari mu bujyanama bw’abazategura Kigali Fashion Week ibindi byose bizakurikiranwa na ‘Iby’iwacu’ ya Umulisa Fiona Cécile. Kuri ubu, ku rubuga rwa Kigali Fashion Week banditse bahamagararira abashaka gukomeza gukuza impano zabo no kwiyerekana mu gikorwa gikomeye nk’iki ko ku wa 13 Kamena 2019 hazaba gutoranya abazamurika imideli muri iki gikorwa bakomoka mu Rwanda naho ku wa 1 Nyakanga hazatoranywe abo hanze y’u Rwanda, bizabera kuri Sports View Hotel Kicukiro. Bakomeje bavuga ko kandi biteguye no kwakira abahanga imideli bashaka kugaragaza ibikorwa byabo bikamenywa na benshi. Iki gikorwa cya Kigali Fashion Week cyatangiye gutegurwa mu Rwanda kuva mu 2010, nicyo cyabimburiye ibindi mu bijyanye no kumurika imideli ndetse kiri imbere mu bifite izina rikomeye mu Rwanda no hanze. Kuva mu 2017, iki gikorwa ngarukamwaka cya Kigali Fashion Week byagejejwe ku yindi ntera n’ababitegura mu bufatanye n’ikigo cya BerexInvest Corporation, bitangira kubera i Burayi, Amerika na Aziya nyuma y’imyaka irindwi byizihizwa mu Rwanda. Nyuma y’iki gikorwa kizabera mu Rwanda uyu mwaka, hateganyijwe ikindi cya Kigali International Fashion Week kirimo ikizabera mu Mujyi wa Montreal muri Canada, i New York muri Amerika, Londres mu Bwongereza, Genève mu Busuwisi no mu Buyapani byo bikazakomeza gutegurwa na John Bunyeshuri.

title: Umunyamideli Alexia Mupende yunamiwe mu birori bya Rwanda Fashion Week 2019 (Amafoto)
content: Ibi birori byabereye muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda, Ishami ry’Ikoranabuhanga muri School Of Architecture And Environment [SABE] ku mugoroba wo ku wa 8 Kamena 2019. Ni ku nshuro ya kane byari bibaye by’umwihariko n’iya mbere bifashe izina rya Rwanda Fashion Week dore ko imyaka yindi yabanje byitwaga Collective Rwanda Fashion Week. Ni ubwa mbere kandi byari bibereye ahantu hadatwikiriye [outdoor runway] ndetse abamurika imideli bakoraga urugendo rujya kuba rurerure baca imbere y’abantu babarirwa muri 500 bari baje kwihera ijisho. Ahagana saa moya n’igice abantu benshi bari bamaze kugera mu myanya yabo, ubanyujijemo ijisho abenshi bari ab’igitsina gore kandi bambaye neza bigaragara ko ibyo kurimba babisobanukiwe. Aba barimo abana ba Perezida wa Repubulika y’u Rwanda Paul Kagame barimo Ange Ingabire Kagame n’umukunzi we Bertrand Ndengeyingoma. Uwari uyoboye ibi birori Kwizera Arnold, yatangiye avuga ko uyu munsi udasanzwe kuri we kuko itariki nk’iyi mu myaka itandatu ishize aribwo nyina yashyinguwe. Igikorwa nyirizina cyo kumurika imideli cyatangijwe na Sonia Mugabo uri mu itsinda rya Collective Rwanda. Imideli ye yerekanye ni iyambarwa n’abagore igizwe n’amakanzu, amakabutura n’ibisurubeti [Jumpsuit]. Imideli yerekanwaga n’abakobwa bafite izina muri uyu mwuga nka Fiona Muthoni, Umutoni Georgette, Neza Rachel, Isheja Morella, Umutoniwase Belise na Belinda [impanga zahatanye muri Miss Rwanda 2018] n’abandi. Inzu y’imideli imaze imyaka irindwi ikorera mu Rwanda, Rwanda Clothing niyo yakurikiyeho. Mbere y’uko abanyamideli batambuka Kwizera wari uyoboye ibirori yasabye ababyitabiriye guhaguruka bagafata umwanya wo kwibuka Alexia Mupende, umunyamideli wubatse izina wishwe muri Mutarama 2019 n’abantu bataramenyekana. Alexia Mupende yakoranaga bya hafi na Rwanda Clothing mu kwamamaza imideli yabo ndetse yafashije benshi mu banyamideli bigaragaje muri ibi birori. Rwanda Clothing yerekanye imideli y’abagabo n’abagore yambarwa mu birori, igizwe n’amakote, amakanzu n’amashati y’ubwoko butandukanye Umunya-Nigeria Emmanuel Okoro washinze inzu y’imideli ya Emmy Nesbit yanambitse Minisitiri w’Intebe w’u Bwongereza, Theresa May, yerekanye imideli ku mwanya wa gatatu. Imideli yari igizwe n’iy’abagabo n’abagore. Yari yanditseho amagambo yo mu rurimi rw’iwabo. Maison Aline na Lisa B. Marler berekanye imideli y’abagore igizwe n’amakanzu magufi n’amaremare ari mu ibara ry’umweru n’umukara gusa. Abanyamideli babaga bafite amasakoshi yakorewe mu Rwanda. House Tayo ya Mathew Rugamba yerekanye imyenda y’abagabo n’abagore, igitekerezo cyayo akaba yaragikomoye ku bashumba b’inka. Inzu y’imideli ya K’tsobe yatangijwe Sarah Legrand yerekanye imideli igaragaza umuco wa Afurika aho abakobwa bari bambaye amakanzu akoze mu bigaragara nk’ibishura bakenyereye hejuru y’amabere n’abahungu bakenyereye ku gice cyo hasi hejuru bambaye ubusa. Bose nta nkweto bari bambaye. Abahanzi b’imideli bane bakizamuka [Ingabire Claudine, Falon Rusamaza, Grace na Emmanuel] bahawe umwanya berekana imyenda yabo. Buri umwe yagendaga yerekana imideli ibiri ibiri. Nyuma y’aba bahanzi b’imideli bakizamuka, hafashwe akaruhuko abantu bica icyaka babifashijwemo n’ikinyobwa gishya cya Mutzig Class, Bralirwa iheruka gushyirwa ku isoko, cyagenewe by’umwihariko abiganjemo urubyiruko n’abakuze bakunda ibirori. Inzu y’imideli Moshions niyo yatangiye igice cya kabiri, aho Moses Turahirwa yerekanye imideli ye yise “Inkingi”. Mu banyamideli berekanye imideli ya Moshions harimo Cedric Amizero usanzwe ari umuhanzi w’imideli wafatanyije n’umukinnyi w’Ikipe ya Mukura VS Iradukunda Bertrand. Inzuki Designs yakurikiyeho yerekana imirimbo irimo amaherena, inigi, udukapu two mu ntoki ydukoze mu migwegwe n’inkweto zifunguye [sandals] ziriho imitako ikoze mu migwegwe. Munezero Jean Vainqueur washinze inzu y’imideli ya Maison Munezero wari ugaragaye ku nshuro ya mbere muri Rwanda Fashion Week, yerekanye amakanzu y’abakobwa magufi. Uzi Collection yinjiye mu ihuriro rya Collective Rwanda mu 2016 na yo yerekanye amakanzu maremare yagenewe kwambarwa mu birori bikomeye nk’ubukwe n’imyenda y’abagabo. Inzu y’imideli ya Haute Baso yerekanye imideli itandukanye irimo amashati, amakoti, amapantalo, amasarubeti [jumpsuit] ku bagore n’abagabo. Inzu y’imideli ya Orange Culture yo muri Nigeria niyo yasoje ibi birori yerekana imideli yiganjemo igaragaza imyambarire igezweho muri icyo gihugu. Amafoto: Serge Muhizi

title: Akari ku mutima wa Turahirwa uherutse kwambika Robot yitwa Sophia
content: Iyi Robot mu minsi ibiri yagaragaye muri iyi nama yose yambaye umushanana wakozwe na Moses Turahirwa washinze inzu y’imideli ya Moshions. Nyuma y’ikiganiro yatanze ku munsi wa Mbere w’iyi nama, ku rubuga rwayo handitsweho ko yishimiye gutanga ikiganiro yambaye umwambaro wahanzwe na Moshions usanzwe ari mu bahanga imideli bakomeye mu Rwanda, wayihitiyemo kwambara bya Kinyarwanda. Turahirwa mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE yatangaje byinshi bitandukanye abantu bashobora kwibaza bijyanye n’uyu mwambaro wambawe na Sophia. Ati “Kwambika Robot ya Sophia, ntabwo ari inzira ndende. Yaje mu Rwanda azanywe na Smart Africa, rero ifite abantu dusanzwe dukorana ndetse ni n’abakiliya banjye. Barabinsabye, barambwira bati urabizi ko Sophia igiye kuza, haba hari igitekerezo ufite cy’ikintu ishobora kwambara.” Yakomeje avuga ko yabikoze akohereza ishusho y’umwambaro yumva yakwambika Robot ya Sophia, bikaza gukundwa cyane n’abakoze iyi Robot bakabyemera bakavuga ko ariko igomba kwambara. Avuga ko ikintu cya mbere byamwunguye ari uko abantu bongeye gutekereza cyane ku nzu ye ihanga imideli. Ati “Icyo byanyunguye ni uko abantu bongeye gutekereza cyane kuri Moshions, bati wambitse Robot; bimbera undi muyobora wo kumenyekanisha ibyo nkora. Urumva kuba wari usanzwe wambika abantu noneho ukambika na Robot kandi Sophia ni icyamamare. Ni ikindi nagezeho mu kazi kanjye. Arongera ati “Iyo ugize amahirwe yo gukora igikorwa nka kiriya hari abantu bashya bakumenya hari n’abari basanzwe bakuzi bongera kukwiyibutsa. Ari abari hanze y’u Rwanda n’aba hano ku mbuga nkoranyambaga barambazaga bati bimeze bite? Atari kuri uriya mushanana yari yambaye gusa ahubwo no ku bindi bintu ukabona ko hari ikintu byongereye. Avuga ko igitekerezo cyo kwambika Sophia imishanana yakigize ashaka ikintu kigaragaza umuco nyarwanda, kuko yarebye agasanga ku zindi mbuga iyi robot ikunze kwambara indi myambaro isanzwe. Ati “Narabanje ndeba ku mbuga zitandukanye ze ndavuga nti ni iki cyihariye noneho k’u Rwanda, twambara umushanana ndavuga nti reka mwambike uyu mwambaro kugira ngo yisanishe n’umuco nyarwanda.” Sophia ni imashini ifite imisusire y’abantu ikagira n’ubwenge butangaje, yakozwe n’Ikigo cyo muri Hong Kong cyitwa Hanson Robotics mu 2015. Yahawe ubushobozi bwo kuvuga neza Icyongereza n’izindi ndimi no kugaragaza ibimenyetso bisaga 50 yifashishije isura yayo. David Hanson yayikoze mu misusire y’abantu babiri: umugore we n’uwahoze akina filime uzwi nka Audrey Hepburn, imbere ikagaragara nk’umuntu ariko igice cy’inyuma kigaragaza neza ko ari imashini igizwe n’utwuma twinshi n’insinga biyiha ingufu z’amashanyarazi zituma ikora na internet iyiyobora.

title: Emmanuel Okoro wambitse Theresa May ategerejwe mu birori bya Rwanda Fashion Week 2019
content: Ibirori byo kumurika imideli bya Rwanda Fashion Week 2019 byari bimenyerewe ku izina rya Collective Rwanda Fashion Week. Byafashe iri zina rishya nyuma yo kubona uburenganzira bwo kurikoresha risimbura iryari risanzwe. Ni ibirori bigiye kuba ku nshuro kane aho bitegurwa n’itsinda ry’abahanzi b’imideli bo mu Rwanda ryitwa Collective Rwanda rigizwe na Moshions, Sonia Mugabo, Amizero, House Of Tayo na Inzuki Designs na Uzi Collections. Biteganyijwe ko Rwanda Fashion Week 2019 izatangira tariki 05 igasozwa tariki 08 Kamena 2019 ikazabera muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda Ishami ry’Ikoranabuhanga muri School of Architecture and Built Environment (SABE). Abanyarwanda bazamurika imideli yabo harimo Rwanda Clothing, Maison Munezero na Maison Aline. Moses Turahirwa uri mu bategura ibi birori yabwiye IGIHE muri uyu mwaka bazanye umwihariko wo gufasha abanyamideli bakizamuka kwerekana ibyo bakora. Ati “ Muri uyu mwaka hazagaragaramo abana bafite impano yo guhanga imideli barimo abigaragaje muri ArtRwanda-Ubuhanzi.” Hazagaragaramo kandi abanyeshuri biga mu yisumbuye bazaturuka mu bigo birimo Gashora Girls School, Kigali International Community School, Green hills Academy na Agahozo Shalom Village. Mu bahanzi b’imideli mpuzamahanga harimo Adebayo Oke-Lawale wo muri Nigeria, ufite inzu y’imideli ya Orange Culture imwe mu zifite izina rikomeye muri Afurika akaba yaranakoranye n’umuhanzi Davido. Harimo kandi Okoro Emmanuel , ufite inzu y’imideli yitwa Emmy Nesbit yatsindiye ibihembo muri Lagos Fashion Week 2017 by’umwihariko akaba yarambitse uwari Minisitiri w’Intebe w’u Bwongereza, Theresa May, uherutse kwegura. Ubwo Theresa May yasuraga Nigeria mu 2018, yambaye ikoti ryakozwe n’uyu musore w’imyaka 28 bimwongerera ikuzo mu gihugu cye no ku mugabane wa Afurika muri rusange. Uyu musore kandi asanzwe yambika abandi barimo umuhanzi Flavour, Yemi Alade n’abandi batandukanye. Hazaba kandi hari abavuga rikijyana mu bijyanye n’imideli barimo Ingrid Tamborin ukorera ikinyamakuru cyibanda ku mideli cya Vogue Italy n’abandi benshi. Hari amatike y’ubwoko butatu yemerera ushaka kwihera ijisho ibirori kwinjira: hari igura amafaranga ibihumbi 15 Frw, ibihumbi 25 Frw n’ibihumbi 45 Frw.

title: Umuvugabutumwa wo muri ADEPR yinjiranye mu muziki indirimbo iri mu njyana ya Hip Hop
content: Izina rya Tuyishimire Diogène rirazwi cyane ariko rikunzwe by’umwihariko muri ADEPR. Yamamaye cyane mu nyigisho avugamo uko Yesu afite imbaraga zidasanzwe, akamusanisha n’ibintu byose. Agira ati “Nta kintu adasa nacyo. Mu bana yabaye umwana w’Imana, mu bagabo aba umugabo w’abapfakazi, mu bapapa aba se w’imfubyi, mu biti aba umuzabibu w’ukuri mwe [abakirisitu] muri amashami…’’ Uyu muvugabutumwa yakuranye inzozi zo kuzaba umuhanzi ariko wibanda ku butumwa bufitiye akamaro sosiyete Nyarwanda. Tuyishimire yakuze yiyumvamo cyane Hip hop ndetse indirimbo ye ya mbere yise ‘‘Byanteye ubwoba’’ icuranze muri iyo njyana. Aganira na IGIHE Tuyishimire yavuze ko gusohora indirimbo ari inzozi ze zabaye impamo. Ati ‘‘Nakuze nifuza kuba umuhanzi, igihe nyacyo cy’Imana nasanze ari iki ngo nsohore indirimbo yanjye ya mbere.’’ Mu ndirimbo ye avuga ko nubwo Isi irushya abantu ariko Imana izahindura byose bishya, akongera ati “Mu buzima nubwo tubabazwa ariko Imana izaduha guhozwa.’’ Yakomeje ati “Nashatse kugaragaza ko nubwo mu Isi umuntu ashobora kunyura mu buzima bukomeye ariko hari Imana ibuyobora; ubuzima bukomeye bugahinduka ubworoshye binyuze mu kwizera Imana.’’ “Byanteye ubwoba” ifite iminota itatu n’amasegonda 36 yakozwe mu buryo bw’amajwi na Producer Trackslayer. Tuyishimire yayiririmbye afatanyije na Dushimiyimana Emmanuel uzwi nka Manud na we ubarizwa muri ADEPR. Yiyongereye ku bandi bahanzi bake bo mu itorero rya ADEPR baririmba mu njyana ya Hip hop. Yashimangiye ko gukora umuziki muri Hip hop bidakwiye gufatwa nabi mu gihe atanga ubutumwa butomoye. Yagize ati ‘‘Ubusanzwe nta njyana iva ku Mana, zose nizo abantu bihangiye, ziva mu bwenge bwabo. Numva rero injyana atari ikibazo ahubwo ikibazo cyaba ubutumwa burimo.’’ Tuyishimire Diogène afite imyaka 27, ni umugabo wubatse, ufite umugore n’umwana umwe. Asengera mu Itorero rya ADEPR muri Paruwasi ya Jabana.  	Indi nkuru wasoma: Yavutse ku witeguraga kuba Umubikira: Ubuhamya butangaje bwa Ev. Tuyishimire wo muri ADEPR

title: Papa Francis yamaganye urupfu rwa George Floyd n’imvururu zarukurikiye muri Amerika
content: Imijyi myinshi muri Amerika no hanze yayo irimo imyigaragambyo ikomeye yamagana irondaruhu nyuma y’urupfu rwa Floyd wishwe mu Cyumweru gishize, bikozwe n’umupolisi wamushikamiye akoresheje ivi kugeza aheze umwuka. Kuri uyu wa Gatatu Papa Francis yavuze ko irondaruhu atari iryo kwihanganira, ariko yongeraho ko ubugizi bwa nabi nabwo ari inzira yo kwiyangiza no gusenya. Yavuze ko urupfu rwa Floyd rubabaje ndetse ko ari kumusengera n’abandi bose bapfuye bazize “icyaha cy’ivanguramoko’. Yagize ati “Nshuti zanjye ntabwo twakwihanganira cyangwa ngo twirengagize irondaruhu n’ihezwa ry’ubwoko bwose, hanyuma ngo tuvuge ko turengera igitinyiro cy’ubuzima bwa muntu.” Agaruka ku myigaragambyo yagaragayemo ubugizi bwa nabi imaze iminsi ikorwa muri Amerika, Papa yagize ati “Ni nako kandi tugomba kumenya ko ubugizi bwa nabi bumaze iminsi bwigaragaza, ari uburyo bwo kwiyangiza no kwitsinda. Nta na kimwe wageraho ukoresheje ubugizi bwa nabi ahubwo wangiza byinshi.” Papa Francis yasabye abanyamerika kwiragiza Imana ikabafasha kugarura amahoro n’ubwiyunge.

title: The Bright Five Singers yashyize hanze indirimbo yo gufasha abantu kwizihiza umunsi mukuru wa Pantekote
content: Kuri uyu wa 31 Gicurasi 2020 muri Kiliziya Gatolika n’andi madini yemera Yezu barazirikana igihe Yezu Kristu yasubiraga mu Ijuru maze akaboherereza Roho Mutagatifu. Mu kuzirikana uyu munsi no gufasha abakirisitu kuwizihiza, abaririmbyi ba The Bright 5 Singers bahimbye indirimbo yitwa ‘Roho, ngwino utumurikire’ ijyanye n’uwo munsi kugira ngo bafashe abakristu bose kuzirikana ibanga ryawo. Iraguha Alain Marius uhagarariye The Bright 5 Singers yabwiye IGIHE ko iyi ndirimbo bashyize hanze irimo ubutumwa busaba roho w’Imana kumurikira abantu.  Ati “Irimo ubutumwa busaba Roho w’Imana kumurikira abantu kugira ngo babashe gukorera Imana badategwa, kuko muri iyi minsi benshi bacitse intege.” Itsinda rya The Bright Five Singers ryatangiye gukora ubutumwa mu 2015 ku itariki 15 Ukwakira ariko abarigize bose bari basanzwe ari abaririmbyi dore ko benshi muri bo bize muri Seminari zitandukanye. Barangije amashuri yisumbuye, bane muri bo bahuriye mu yahoze ari Kaminuza Nkuru y’u Rwanda i Huye (NUR) muri korali yitwa Le Bon Berger. Ubwo habaga amahugurwa yari yateguwe na Choeur International et Ensemble Instrumental de Kigali agenewe abaririmbyi mu 2011 igatumira umugabo w’umuhanga muri muzika wo muri Cameroun witwa Jean Jacques Gregoire Belobo, niwe wabateye iyo nyota yo kurushaho gukunda umuziki, ariko anabasigira ubumenyi ari nabwo bifashishije mu kuzamura imiririmbire yabo. Nyuma y’aho basoreje amashuri nibwo bihuje bakora iri tsinda. Bakunda gukora ibitaramo bitandukanye biteguriye cyangwa se batumiwemo. Iri tsinda ryanashyize hanze Album ya mbere yitwa ‘Musabe Muzahabwa’. Yagiye hanze kuwa 15, Ukwakira 2017. Bafite izindi zirimo iyitwa "Uhoraho", "Sangwa Mariya", "Dusingize Imana" n’izindi. Indirimbo nshya yakozwe mu buryo bw’amajwi na Emmy Pro usanzwe akora indirimbo iz’abaririmbyi bo muri kiliziya Gatolika naho amashusho atunganywa na Gaga.

title: Ntabwo Yezu yagusize bupfubyi
content:
Mu gihe cya Yezu bawuhimbazaga bibuka umunsi bahaweho amategeko ku musozi wa Sinayi. Muri iki gihe abakristu bawuhimbaza bazirikana Roho Mutagatifu amanukira ku Ntumwa. Roho w’Imana, ni we wabwirije abahanuzi ibyo bavuze Roho Mutagatifu atuma tugira ubugingo bw’Imana, akatubera urumuri rutwumvisha Inkuru nziza ya Yezu Kristu kandi akaduha imbaraga zo kuyikurikiza twishimye!Ku buryo bwuzuye, Roho Mutagatifu yamenyekanye nyuma ya Pasika kandi amenyekanisha Imana Data na Mwana. Mbere ya Pasika ye, Yezu yatangaje iyoherezwa ry’undi Muvugizi (Umurengezi), ari we Roho Mutagatifu. We watangiye umurimo we kuva mu gihe cy’iremwa ry’ijuru n’isi akaba ari We kera wabwirije abahanuzi ibyo bavuze , ubu noneho ari kumwe n’abigishwa kandi akaba muri bo (Yh 14,26), kugira ngo abigishe kandi abayobore mu kuri kose (Yh 16, 13). Nuko rero, Roho Mutagatifu agaragazwa nk’Undi ufitanye isano na Yezu na Se. Inkomoko ihoraho ya Roho Mutagatifu yigaragariza mu butumwa bwe ku isi. Roho Mutagatifu wohererejwe intumwa na Kiliziya yatumwe n’Imana Data mu izina rya Yezu, yoherezwa kandi na Mwana ubwe amaze gusubira kwa Se. Iyoherezwa rya Roho Mutagatifu nyuma y’ikuzwa rya Yezu, rihishura byuzuye ibanga ry’Ubutatu Butagatifu. Ijambo Roho risobanura ijambo ry’igihebureyi Ruah , risobanura; umwuka, umuyaga. Tugendeye kuri icyo gisobanuro tubona ingingo ebyiri z’ingenzi dusanga muri Bibiliya : Iremwa rya mbere : « Imana ihuha mu mazuru yabo umwuka w’ubuzima » (Intg2,7) ; Habayeho irema ryo mu gihe cyahise, ivuka rya mbere ry’ubuzima mbere y’ibihe. Iremwa rya nyuma : Turisanga kwa Ez 37,9), hagira hati «Uhoraho aravuga ati :Wa mwuka we, turuka mu mpande zose uko ari enye uhuhera kuri iyi mirambo maze yongere ibeho » Hazabaho irema ryo mu gihe gishya, ukuzuka kwa nyuma, ku munsi w’imperuka maze ubuzima bwongere bwigaragaze. Ntabwo guhumeka bikorwa rimwe gusa mu mwaka Umunsi wa mbere w’icyumweru Inzugi z’aho abigishwa ba Yezu bari bari zari zifunze kubera gutinya abayahudi. Nuko Yezu agira atya ahagarara hagati yabo, arababwira , ati « nimugire amahoro». (Yh20, 19-20) Ni ukuvuga ko isi nshya n’ikiremwa gishya byavutse ; ni intangiriro nshya ! Imana yafashe muntu mu biganza byayo, imurema bundi bushya, mu ibumba rishyashya ryuje urukundo n’amahoro kandi ritsinda ubwoba. Abakristu rero, guhera ubwo ntibahwemye guhura, buri munsi wa mbere w’icyumweru. Kuva ku cyumweru kugera ku kindi. Kiliziya yavutse kuri iryo huriro rya buri gihe, rikiriho kugeza na n’ubu. Abakristu bakora iryo huriro buri cyumweru, kugeza igihe Yezu azagarukira. Ntabwo dukwiye gufata icyumweru nk’aho ari itegeko gusa, ahubwo dukwiye kugifata nk’icya ngombwa kandi cy’ingenzi mu buzima bwacu. « Birakwiye guhumeka umwuka muzima buri gihe » Ntabwo guhumeka bikorwa rimwe gusa mu mwaka. N’ubwo duhimbaje Pentekosti Kiliziya Insengero n’Imisigiti bifunze kubera Coronavirus, ntibikwiye ko twakwibagirwa uwo munsi w’Imana, mu rugo iwacu Roho Mutagatifu arahadusanga. Bavandimwe hariho irema rya buri munsi , Roho w’Imana ahora arema kandi agatanga ubugingo. Umwuka wera/Roho Mutagatifu ni ubuzima. Umwuka ni ikigereranyo rusange cy’Imana n’ibikorwa byayo mu bantu. Ikiriho cyose gihumeka kifitemo ubuzima. Ni ishusho igaragara y’Imana itugabira ubuzima ! Ubwo buzima butangirira muri Batisimu bukuzurizwa mu Butatu Butagatifu. Yezu na we yagiye akoresha icyo kigereranyo gifatika cy’umuyaga, kugira ngo yumvishe Nikodemu (natwe twese) igikorwa gishya gihebuje cy’Uwitwa Umwuka w’Imana, ari we Roho w’Imana (Yh 3, 5-8). Roho w’Imana twasezeranyijwe  Roho Mutagatifu Yezu ubwe yagiye amuvuga ku buryo bwinshi. Hari aho yamwise umuvugizi, bisobanura « Ubana na twe », ahandi amwita Umurengezi (Yh 14,16.). Ubusanzwe iryo zina ‘Umuvugizi’ risobanurwa ko ari Umuhoza, kuko Yezu ari we Muhoza w’ibanze. Ni Roho Nyir’ukuri (Yh 16, 13). Ni we uyobora ku kuri kose, kuko atavuga yitumirije ahubwo avuga ibyo yumvise byose, kandi akaduhanurira n’ibizaza. Uwo Roho asesekara kuri buri wese akurikije icyo amukeneyeho ariko byose akabyuzuriza muri Kiliziya ye, ariyo Pawulo yita umubiri umwe. Pawulo ati « Umubiri ni umwe kandi ugizwe n’ingingo nyinshi ariko izo ngingo zose n’ubwo ari nyinshi zigize umubiri umwe» (1Kor1,12). Abantu ni magirirane, baruzuzanya mu ngabire buri wese afite. Kristu niwe waduhurije hamwe mu rukundo n’amahoro bimwe isi idatanga. Bwa bumwe abantu batereye i Babeli (Ing11,1-10) bwaragarutse, bose bakumva kimwe (Intu 2,8-11), maze biba incamarenga y’ubutumwa Yezu yahaye intumwa ze bwo kwigisha amahanga yose. (Yh20, 21-22). Ubwo bumwe twese nibwo duhamagariwe kugaragaza ; kuko twabatirijwe muri Roho umwe ngo tube umubiri umwe (1Kor12,13). Nk’uko Data yantumye, nanjye ndabatumye (Yh20, 21) Muntu nk’ ikiremwa cy’Imana kidasanzwe kiri hagati y’ibindi biremwa, yagiye agaragaza ko abisumbye ndetse akajya abikoresha icyo ashaka , ibi byaje kugera ubwo na we yicamo ibice ; hazamo agasuzuguro kuri bamwe, ubwikunde n’ubwikanyize maze yubaka umunara w’itandukaniro rye n’abo batari mu rwego rumwe. N’ubwo isi yacu ishaka kuducamo ibice, Yezu We ashaka ko tuba umwe. Yaba abayahudi cyangwa se Abagereki, yaba abacakara cyangwa se abigenga yaba abazungu, abarabu cyangwa se abirabura, twese twuhiwe Roho umwe (1Kor 12,13).
Uyu munsi tuributswa ko nubwo umubiri ugizwe n’ingingo nyinshi, zose zigize umuntu umwe. Mu yandi magambo ni nk’aho twakwibutswa ko n’ubwo dutandukanye yaba ku ruhu, mu bwenge, mu bukungu,… ariko twese turi abantu.
Twese rero duhamagariwe kubahana, ntihakagire ugenera mugenzi we uko abaho. Twese turi abantu, twese tuva amaraso y’umutuku, twese turapfa, twese tugaragaza amarangamutima, twese icyorezo cya Coronavirus cyaradukanze. Yezu arashaka ko dusubira ku isoko y’ubumwe, urukundo n’amahoro. Buri wese ahamagariwe kubyamamaza, ni ubutumwa ahawe. Dusenge: Roho Mutagatifu, Nyagasani utanga ubugingo, uturuka ku Mana Data na Mwana, usengwa agasingizwa hamwe n’Imana Data na Mwana, We wabwirije abahanuzi ibyo bavuze, nakomeze atuyobore, atwumvishe natwe ubumwe dufitanye nk’abantu twaremwe n’Imana imwe, bityo imbuto z’ubwo bumwe: urukundo, ibyishimo, amahoro, kwihangana, ubugwaneza, ubuntu, ubudahemuka, imico myiza no kumenya kwifata biganze iwacu.(Gal5,22. Roho mutagatifu natuyobore. Amena. Padiri Silivani SEBACUMI

title: Umunya-Canada uririmba indirimbo zihimbaza Imana yatunguranye avuga ko atayizera
content: Mu butumwa burebure uyu muririmbyi yasangije abamukurikira kuri Instagram yagaragaje atari umwe mu bizera Imana. Ati “Maze igihe kinini nterwa ubwoba no kubasangiza ibi ariko ubu ndiyumvamo ko ari cyo gihe cyiza kuri njye kuba navugisha ukuri. Ndizera ko iri atari iherezo ry’ikiganiro ahubwo ari intangiriro.” Yakomeje avuga ko kuba yarakuriye mu muryango usenga, akaba umwana w’umupasiteri agacuranga ndetse akaba n’umuririmbyi muri band ya gikirisitu akanitwa umukirisitu mu bintu byinshi yagiye anyuramo mu buzima bwe yaje gusanga ‘ubu atacyizerera mu Mana’. Arongera ati “Amagambo aheruka make mu nteruro yari akomeye kuyandika, nashakaga no koroshya iyi nyandiko nkabyandika bitandukanye n’uko nabikoze ariko ntabwo byari kuba ukuri nk’uko bimeze gutya.” Uyu muhanzi ntabwo yigeze avuga niba ateganya kureka kuririmba indirimbo zihimbaza Imana. Steingard yari amaze igihe kinini atekereza uburyo azabyandikamo. Ngo yatangiye ashidikanya we ubwe aza kubiganiriza inshuti ze za hafi. Yaje gutungurwa no gusanga hari abandi bakuriye mu nsengero nkawe batinya kubivuga kubera ko babura buri kimwe. Abo basanzwe babana muri band bamushyigikiye bavuga ko intego yabo ari ugufasha abantu no kubatera imbaraga mu byo bakora mu kuri kuko Imana iri kumwe nabo kandi iri mu ruhande rwabo. Hawk Nelson, itsinda Jonathan Steingard abarizwamo rigizwe n’abasore batanu [Daniel Biro, Jonathan Steingard, Micah Kuiper na David Niacaris]. Ni rimwe mu matsinda akomeye aramya Imana mu buryo bw’injyana ya rock na pop punk. Ryashingiye mu Mujyi wa Peterborough, Ontario. Rimaze gukora album umunani.  I’ve been terrified to post this for a while - but it feels like it’s time for me to be honest. I hope this is not the end of the conversation, but the beginning. I hope this is encouraging to people who might feel the same but are as afraid to speak as I am. I want to be open. I want to be transparent with you all - and also open to having my heart changed in the future. I am not looking for a debate at all - just a chance to share my story in the hopes some good can come from it. I love you all. title: Yavutse ku witeguraga kuba Umubikira: Ubuhamya butangaje bwa Ev. Tuyishimire wo muri ADEPR
content: Ubusanzwe yitwa Ev.Tuyishimire Diogène. Mu byigisho bye, icyamamaye ni icyo aba avugamo ukuntu Yesu nta kintu adasa nacyo kuko ‘Mu bana yabaye umwana w’Imana, mu bagabo akaba umugabo w’abapfakazi, mu bapapa aba se w’imfubyi, mu biti akavuga ati ninjye muzabibu w’ukuri mwe muri amashami…’ Umurebye mu maso ntiwamukekera ko yakwigisha mu buryo bukomeye ariko we ahamya ko ari imirimo yakoze kugira ngo agarure benshi mu nzira y’agakiza. Uyu mugabo w’imyaka 27, ni umuvugabutumwa mu itorero rya ADEPR. Yatangiye no gukora umuziki aho yamaze kwinjira mu njyana ya Hip hop. Akurondoreye iby’urugendo rw’ubuzima ab’imitima yoroshye amarira arashoka bitewe n’uko yakubititse akiri muto ntabashe kwiga amashuri yisumbuye kubera ubuzima bugoye n’ubushobozi buke, ariko ubu ashima Imana aho igejeje ikora! Mu buhamya bwe ntajya yibagirwa kugaragaza uko yari umusinzi unakora inzoga z’inkorano ndetse n’uburyo nyina umubyara yamusamye mu gihe yigiraga kuba umubikira. Yakuriye kwa nyina wabo kuko nyina yamutaye akajya kwishakira undi mugabo. Mu kiganiro cyihariye na IGIHE yavuye imuzi iby’ubuzima bwe. Ati “Ubundi mama wanjye yigiraga kuba umubikira, yaje guhura n’umusore amutera inda rero birangira havutse njye. Icyakora ntabwo yandeze kuko we yahise ashaka undi mugabo kandi ntabwo twari kubana. Ibi byatumye nkura nderwa na mama wacu muto ku mubyeyi wanjye.” Ahamya ko yakuriye mu muryango w’abantu bakora inzoga z’inkorano, byatumye ku myaka icyenda gusa atangira kunywa inzoga. Akurira mu buzima bwo gucuruza no gukora izo nzoga. Arangije amashuri abanza ntabwo yabonye uko akomeza ayisumbuye kuko nta bushobozi bwari buhari, ati” Nyine ishuri narivuyemo mpita ninjira mu byo gukora inzoga kuko nibyo mu rugo bakoraga.” Ubu buzima yabubayemo ariko akunda umuziki, biza kumuviramo gushaka gukora indirimbo za mbere nubwo bitamuhiriye. Ati “Numvaga naba umukinnyi wa APR FC cyangwa nkaba umuhanzi wa Hip Hop nari umufana ukomeye wa Riderman.” Yavuye iwabo ababeshye ko agiye gukora umuziki, naho agiye gucuruza inzoga z’inkorano mu Karere ka Musanze aza guhomba bikomeye. Ubwo yari amaze guhomba mu by’inzoga z’inkorano yacuruzaga, Ev. Tuyishimire yisanze asigaranye amafaranga make cyane nyamara yaramaze gutoroka kwa nyina wabo. Inzoga zari zahombye abona ubuzima bwanze afata icyemezo cyo kwiyahura ndetse aranabigerageza Imana ikinga akaboko. Ati “Narahombye bikomeye numva ubuzima burarangiye, nahisemo kwiyahura icyo gihe ngura inzoga nyinshi ngo niyahure nasinze, naguze ikinini cy’imbeba nsinda ntiyahuye birangira ndyamye, ariko nkajya numva ko ndi bwiyahure mu gitondo. Bukeye hari ikiganiro cyacaga kuri Radio Flash Fm cyakorwaga na Pasiteri Ntambara. Icyo gihe yavuze ijambo ryatumye mpindura umugambi wo kwiyahura.” Tuyishimire avuga Pasiteri Ntambara yigishije avuga ko hari umwana ugiye kwiyahura kandi naramuka abiretse azaba umuntu ukomeye w’umugabo. Umugambi we uhita upfuba binyuze kuri uyu mukozi w’Imana. Ati “Igitekerezo cyo kwiyahura cyahise kimvamo gutyo nyuma njya kureba mama wanjye wabaga mu Bugesera.” Ageze mu Bugesera yasanze umubyeyi we azi ko umwana we yabuze, icyakora kuko ubuzima butari bwiza ntabwo yahatinze ahubwo yagiye gushakisha uko yabaho. Iki gihe yakoze muri restaurant, aha ni naho yatangiye gukora ibikorwa byo kwigisha ijambo ry’Imana ahereye ku hantu basengeraga. Akora muri iyi restaurant yo mu Bugesera nibwo Ev. Tuyishimire yatangiye kujya ajya gusengana n’abantu bari baturanye akarara aho basengeraga. Abo basenganaga bakundaga uko yigisha anasoma ijambo ry’Imana umugabo umwe basenganaga aza kumusaba ko yazajya kubwiriza muri ADEPR i Huye. Kuva icyo gihe yahise atangira kuba umuvugabutumwa wo mu itorero rya ADEPR atangira gutumirwa cyane mu materaniro anyuranye. Mu 2016 umugabo basenganaga yamusabye ko yamurera akava aho basengeraga bakajya babana nk’umwana na Se. Nyuma uyu mugabo yaje kwiyemeza kumwubakira inzu birangira mu 2018 akoze ubukwe aza kurushinga n’umwe mu bakirisitu bo mu itorero rya ADEPR. Yerekeje amaso ku muziki Kuva mu bwana bwe yakundaga umuziki by’umwihariko injyana ya Hip Hop, ibi byatumye uyu mugabo kuri ubu yumva yawukora ndetse indirimbo ya mbere ye ikaba igomba kujya hanze mu minsi ya vuba. Ati “Nubwo nakora iyi yonyine ngahita ndekera aho, inzozi zanjye zaba zibaye impamo kuko mpfuye ntaririmbye nagendana agahinda kuko nabikunze kuva cyera.” Avuga ko yari kuba yarabikoze cyera ariko agira ubwoba bw’ukuntu abo basengana bazabifata ahitamo kubigendamo gake. Iyi ndirimbo ye yitegura gusohora yitwa “Mfite ubwoba” yakozwe na Trackslayer, izaba ikubiyemo ubutumwa bw’ubuzima busanzwe ariko nanone buganisha ku Mana. Ikiganiro na Ev.Tuyishimire winjiye mu njyana ya Hip hop

title: Bizibukwa mu mateka! Isengesho rya Eid al-Fitr ryabereye kuri Televiziyo y’Igihugu
content: Byari bisanzwe bimenyerewe ko isengesho rusange ryo kwizihiza Eid al-Fitr ribera kuri Stade ya Kigali i Nyamirambo no mu tundi duce two hirya no hino mu gihugu. Warangwaga no kubona urujya n’uruza rw’Abayisilamu bambaye amakanzu y’urwererane, ubabona bose bafite akanyamuneza ku maso, basuhuzanya ubutitsa indamukanyo yifurizanya Eid el-Fitr nziza bagira bati “Eid Mubarak”. Kuri iyi nshuro uyu munsi iri sengesho ryizihirijwe kuri Televiziyo na Radio by’Igihugu, kubera ingamba zafashwe mu guhangana n’ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus. Isengesho ryo kuri uyu wa 24 Gicurasi 2020 ryayobowe na Mufti w’u Rwanda, Sheikh Hitimana Salim. Abayoboke b’Idini ya Islam bakaba barikurikiye bari mu ngo zabo kuko batashoboraga kujya mu misigiti kuko amakoraniro y’abantu benshi atemewe. Mu butumwa bwe, Sheikh Hitimana yikije ku kwimakaza ubucuti hagati y’Abayisilamu na bagenzi babo. Yanabibukije ko bakwiye kubahiriza ingamba zashyizweho na Guverinoma hagamijwe gukomeza kwirinda Coronavirus, anabasabira kugira ubuzima bwiza. Isengesho ryanyuze ku bitangazamakuru by’igihugu ryishimiwe cyane ndetse bamwe bagaragaza ko ari intambwe ikomeye yatewe bitandukanye n’uko byakorwaga hambere. Abinyujije ku rukuta rwe rwa Twitter, Abdul K. Harelimana, uri mu bagize Urwego Ngishwanama n’Inararibonye z’u Rwanda, REAF, yavuze ko “Ntibyigeze bibaho kuri Repubulika ya Mbere n’iya Kabiri guha agaciro Umunsi wa Iddi. Ni nkaho ntacyabaga cyabaye. Ntibyashyirwaga mu itangazamakuru rya Leta. Ni ishimwe ku Rwanda rushya kuko kuva mu 1994, isengesho ryerekanwa mu buryo bw’ako kanya.’’ Eid al-Fitr ni umunsi uba ari ikiruhuko ku bakozi bose mu Rwanda, inshuti n’abavandimwe bakishimana n’abayisilamu kuri uwo munsi mukuru. Igisibo ni rimwe mu mahame atanu ya Islam risaba abayoboke baryo kwigomwa amafunguro, ibinyobwa mu bihe bisanzwe n’ibindi bibashimisha bakarangamira Imana.
