title: The Bright Five Singers yashyize hanze indirimbo yo gufasha abantu kwizihiza umunsi mukuru wa Pantekote
content: Kuri uyu wa 31 Gicurasi 2020 muri Kiliziya Gatolika n’andi madini yemera Yezu barazirikana igihe Yezu Kristu yasubiraga mu Ijuru maze akaboherereza Roho Mutagatifu. Mu kuzirikana uyu munsi no gufasha abakirisitu kuwizihiza, abaririmbyi ba The Bright 5 Singers bahimbye indirimbo yitwa ‘Roho, ngwino utumurikire’ ijyanye n’uwo munsi kugira ngo bafashe abakristu bose kuzirikana ibanga ryawo. Iraguha Alain Marius uhagarariye The Bright 5 Singers yabwiye IGIHE ko iyi ndirimbo bashyize hanze irimo ubutumwa busaba roho w’Imana kumurikira abantu.  Ati “Irimo ubutumwa busaba Roho w’Imana kumurikira abantu kugira ngo babashe gukorera Imana badategwa, kuko muri iyi minsi benshi bacitse intege.” Itsinda rya The Bright Five Singers ryatangiye gukora ubutumwa mu 2015 ku itariki 15 Ukwakira ariko abarigize bose bari basanzwe ari abaririmbyi dore ko benshi muri bo bize muri Seminari zitandukanye. Barangije amashuri yisumbuye, bane muri bo bahuriye mu yahoze ari Kaminuza Nkuru y’u Rwanda i Huye (NUR) muri korali yitwa Le Bon Berger. Ubwo habaga amahugurwa yari yateguwe na Choeur International et Ensemble Instrumental de Kigali agenewe abaririmbyi mu 2011 igatumira umugabo w’umuhanga muri muzika wo muri Cameroun witwa Jean Jacques Gregoire Belobo, niwe wabateye iyo nyota yo kurushaho gukunda umuziki, ariko anabasigira ubumenyi ari nabwo bifashishije mu kuzamura imiririmbire yabo. Nyuma y’aho basoreje amashuri nibwo bihuje bakora iri tsinda. Bakunda gukora ibitaramo bitandukanye biteguriye cyangwa se batumiwemo. Iri tsinda ryanashyize hanze Album ya mbere yitwa ‘Musabe Muzahabwa’. Yagiye hanze kuwa 15, Ukwakira 2017. Bafite izindi zirimo iyitwa "Uhoraho", "Sangwa Mariya", "Dusingize Imana" n’izindi. Indirimbo nshya yakozwe mu buryo bw’amajwi na Emmy Pro usanzwe akora indirimbo iz’abaririmbyi bo muri kiliziya Gatolika naho amashusho atunganywa na Gaga.

title: Ntabwo Yezu yagusize bupfubyi
content:
Mu gihe cya Yezu bawuhimbazaga bibuka umunsi bahaweho amategeko ku musozi wa Sinayi. Muri iki gihe abakristu bawuhimbaza bazirikana Roho Mutagatifu amanukira ku Ntumwa. Roho w’Imana, ni we wabwirije abahanuzi ibyo bavuze Roho Mutagatifu atuma tugira ubugingo bw’Imana, akatubera urumuri rutwumvisha Inkuru nziza ya Yezu Kristu kandi akaduha imbaraga zo kuyikurikiza twishimye!Ku buryo bwuzuye, Roho Mutagatifu yamenyekanye nyuma ya Pasika kandi amenyekanisha Imana Data na Mwana. Mbere ya Pasika ye, Yezu yatangaje iyoherezwa ry’undi Muvugizi (Umurengezi), ari we Roho Mutagatifu. We watangiye umurimo we kuva mu gihe cy’iremwa ry’ijuru n’isi akaba ari We kera wabwirije abahanuzi ibyo bavuze , ubu noneho ari kumwe n’abigishwa kandi akaba muri bo (Yh 14,26), kugira ngo abigishe kandi abayobore mu kuri kose (Yh 16, 13). Nuko rero, Roho Mutagatifu agaragazwa nk’Undi ufitanye isano na Yezu na Se. Inkomoko ihoraho ya Roho Mutagatifu yigaragariza mu butumwa bwe ku isi. Roho Mutagatifu wohererejwe intumwa na Kiliziya yatumwe n’Imana Data mu izina rya Yezu, yoherezwa kandi na Mwana ubwe amaze gusubira kwa Se. Iyoherezwa rya Roho Mutagatifu nyuma y’ikuzwa rya Yezu, rihishura byuzuye ibanga ry’Ubutatu Butagatifu. Ijambo Roho risobanura ijambo ry’igihebureyi Ruah , risobanura; umwuka, umuyaga. Tugendeye kuri icyo gisobanuro tubona ingingo ebyiri z’ingenzi dusanga muri Bibiliya : Iremwa rya mbere : « Imana ihuha mu mazuru yabo umwuka w’ubuzima » (Intg2,7) ; Habayeho irema ryo mu gihe cyahise, ivuka rya mbere ry’ubuzima mbere y’ibihe. Iremwa rya nyuma : Turisanga kwa Ez 37,9), hagira hati «Uhoraho aravuga ati :Wa mwuka we, turuka mu mpande zose uko ari enye uhuhera kuri iyi mirambo maze yongere ibeho » Hazabaho irema ryo mu gihe gishya, ukuzuka kwa nyuma, ku munsi w’imperuka maze ubuzima bwongere bwigaragaze. Ntabwo guhumeka bikorwa rimwe gusa mu mwaka Umunsi wa mbere w’icyumweru Inzugi z’aho abigishwa ba Yezu bari bari zari zifunze kubera gutinya abayahudi. Nuko Yezu agira atya ahagarara hagati yabo, arababwira , ati « nimugire amahoro». (Yh20, 19-20) Ni ukuvuga ko isi nshya n’ikiremwa gishya byavutse ; ni intangiriro nshya ! Imana yafashe muntu mu biganza byayo, imurema bundi bushya, mu ibumba rishyashya ryuje urukundo n’amahoro kandi ritsinda ubwoba. Abakristu rero, guhera ubwo ntibahwemye guhura, buri munsi wa mbere w’icyumweru. Kuva ku cyumweru kugera ku kindi. Kiliziya yavutse kuri iryo huriro rya buri gihe, rikiriho kugeza na n’ubu. Abakristu bakora iryo huriro buri cyumweru, kugeza igihe Yezu azagarukira. Ntabwo dukwiye gufata icyumweru nk’aho ari itegeko gusa, ahubwo dukwiye kugifata nk’icya ngombwa kandi cy’ingenzi mu buzima bwacu. « Birakwiye guhumeka umwuka muzima buri gihe » Ntabwo guhumeka bikorwa rimwe gusa mu mwaka. N’ubwo duhimbaje Pentekosti Kiliziya Insengero n’Imisigiti bifunze kubera Coronavirus, ntibikwiye ko twakwibagirwa uwo munsi w’Imana, mu rugo iwacu Roho Mutagatifu arahadusanga. Bavandimwe hariho irema rya buri munsi , Roho w’Imana ahora arema kandi agatanga ubugingo. Umwuka wera/Roho Mutagatifu ni ubuzima. Umwuka ni ikigereranyo rusange cy’Imana n’ibikorwa byayo mu bantu. Ikiriho cyose gihumeka kifitemo ubuzima. Ni ishusho igaragara y’Imana itugabira ubuzima ! Ubwo buzima butangirira muri Batisimu bukuzurizwa mu Butatu Butagatifu. Yezu na we yagiye akoresha icyo kigereranyo gifatika cy’umuyaga, kugira ngo yumvishe Nikodemu (natwe twese) igikorwa gishya gihebuje cy’Uwitwa Umwuka w’Imana, ari we Roho w’Imana (Yh 3, 5-8). Roho w’Imana twasezeranyijwe  Roho Mutagatifu Yezu ubwe yagiye amuvuga ku buryo bwinshi. Hari aho yamwise umuvugizi, bisobanura « Ubana na twe », ahandi amwita Umurengezi (Yh 14,16.). Ubusanzwe iryo zina ‘Umuvugizi’ risobanurwa ko ari Umuhoza, kuko Yezu ari we Muhoza w’ibanze. Ni Roho Nyir’ukuri (Yh 16, 13). Ni we uyobora ku kuri kose, kuko atavuga yitumirije ahubwo avuga ibyo yumvise byose, kandi akaduhanurira n’ibizaza. Uwo Roho asesekara kuri buri wese akurikije icyo amukeneyeho ariko byose akabyuzuriza muri Kiliziya ye, ariyo Pawulo yita umubiri umwe. Pawulo ati « Umubiri ni umwe kandi ugizwe n’ingingo nyinshi ariko izo ngingo zose n’ubwo ari nyinshi zigize umubiri umwe» (1Kor1,12). Abantu ni magirirane, baruzuzanya mu ngabire buri wese afite. Kristu niwe waduhurije hamwe mu rukundo n’amahoro bimwe isi idatanga. Bwa bumwe abantu batereye i Babeli (Ing11,1-10) bwaragarutse, bose bakumva kimwe (Intu 2,8-11), maze biba incamarenga y’ubutumwa Yezu yahaye intumwa ze bwo kwigisha amahanga yose. (Yh20, 21-22). Ubwo bumwe twese nibwo duhamagariwe kugaragaza ; kuko twabatirijwe muri Roho umwe ngo tube umubiri umwe (1Kor12,13). Nk’uko Data yantumye, nanjye ndabatumye (Yh20, 21) Muntu nk’ ikiremwa cy’Imana kidasanzwe kiri hagati y’ibindi biremwa, yagiye agaragaza ko abisumbye ndetse akajya abikoresha icyo ashaka , ibi byaje kugera ubwo na we yicamo ibice ; hazamo agasuzuguro kuri bamwe, ubwikunde n’ubwikanyize maze yubaka umunara w’itandukaniro rye n’abo batari mu rwego rumwe. N’ubwo isi yacu ishaka kuducamo ibice, Yezu We ashaka ko tuba umwe. Yaba abayahudi cyangwa se Abagereki, yaba abacakara cyangwa se abigenga yaba abazungu, abarabu cyangwa se abirabura, twese twuhiwe Roho umwe (1Kor 12,13).
Uyu munsi tuributswa ko nubwo umubiri ugizwe n’ingingo nyinshi, zose zigize umuntu umwe. Mu yandi magambo ni nk’aho twakwibutswa ko n’ubwo dutandukanye yaba ku ruhu, mu bwenge, mu bukungu,… ariko twese turi abantu.
Twese rero duhamagariwe kubahana, ntihakagire ugenera mugenzi we uko abaho. Twese turi abantu, twese tuva amaraso y’umutuku, twese turapfa, twese tugaragaza amarangamutima, twese icyorezo cya Coronavirus cyaradukanze. Yezu arashaka ko dusubira ku isoko y’ubumwe, urukundo n’amahoro. Buri wese ahamagariwe kubyamamaza, ni ubutumwa ahawe. Dusenge: Roho Mutagatifu, Nyagasani utanga ubugingo, uturuka ku Mana Data na Mwana, usengwa agasingizwa hamwe n’Imana Data na Mwana, We wabwirije abahanuzi ibyo bavuze, nakomeze atuyobore, atwumvishe natwe ubumwe dufitanye nk’abantu twaremwe n’Imana imwe, bityo imbuto z’ubwo bumwe: urukundo, ibyishimo, amahoro, kwihangana, ubugwaneza, ubuntu, ubudahemuka, imico myiza no kumenya kwifata biganze iwacu.(Gal5,22. Roho mutagatifu natuyobore. Amena. Padiri Silivani SEBACUMI

title: Umunya-Canada uririmba indirimbo zihimbaza Imana yatunguranye avuga ko atayizera
content: Mu butumwa burebure uyu muririmbyi yasangije abamukurikira kuri Instagram yagaragaje atari umwe mu bizera Imana. Ati “Maze igihe kinini nterwa ubwoba no kubasangiza ibi ariko ubu ndiyumvamo ko ari cyo gihe cyiza kuri njye kuba navugisha ukuri. Ndizera ko iri atari iherezo ry’ikiganiro ahubwo ari intangiriro.” Yakomeje avuga ko kuba yarakuriye mu muryango usenga, akaba umwana w’umupasiteri agacuranga ndetse akaba n’umuririmbyi muri band ya gikirisitu akanitwa umukirisitu mu bintu byinshi yagiye anyuramo mu buzima bwe yaje gusanga ‘ubu atacyizerera mu Mana’. Arongera ati “Amagambo aheruka make mu nteruro yari akomeye kuyandika, nashakaga no koroshya iyi nyandiko nkabyandika bitandukanye n’uko nabikoze ariko ntabwo byari kuba ukuri nk’uko bimeze gutya.” Uyu muhanzi ntabwo yigeze avuga niba ateganya kureka kuririmba indirimbo zihimbaza Imana. Steingard yari amaze igihe kinini atekereza uburyo azabyandikamo. Ngo yatangiye ashidikanya we ubwe aza kubiganiriza inshuti ze za hafi. Yaje gutungurwa no gusanga hari abandi bakuriye mu nsengero nkawe batinya kubivuga kubera ko babura buri kimwe. Abo basanzwe babana muri band bamushyigikiye bavuga ko intego yabo ari ugufasha abantu no kubatera imbaraga mu byo bakora mu kuri kuko Imana iri kumwe nabo kandi iri mu ruhande rwabo. Hawk Nelson, itsinda Jonathan Steingard abarizwamo rigizwe n’abasore batanu [Daniel Biro, Jonathan Steingard, Micah Kuiper na David Niacaris]. Ni rimwe mu matsinda akomeye aramya Imana mu buryo bw’injyana ya rock na pop punk. Ryashingiye mu Mujyi wa Peterborough, Ontario. Rimaze gukora album umunani.  I’ve been terrified to post this for a while - but it feels like it’s time for me to be honest. I hope this is not the end of the conversation, but the beginning. I hope this is encouraging to people who might feel the same but are as afraid to speak as I am. I want to be open. I want to be transparent with you all - and also open to having my heart changed in the future. I am not looking for a debate at all - just a chance to share my story in the hopes some good can come from it. I love you all. title: Yavutse ku witeguraga kuba Umubikira: Ubuhamya butangaje bwa Ev. Tuyishimire wo muri ADEPR
content: Ubusanzwe yitwa Ev.Tuyishimire Diogène. Mu byigisho bye, icyamamaye ni icyo aba avugamo ukuntu Yesu nta kintu adasa nacyo kuko ‘Mu bana yabaye umwana w’Imana, mu bagabo akaba umugabo w’abapfakazi, mu bapapa aba se w’imfubyi, mu biti akavuga ati ninjye muzabibu w’ukuri mwe muri amashami…’ Umurebye mu maso ntiwamukekera ko yakwigisha mu buryo bukomeye ariko we ahamya ko ari imirimo yakoze kugira ngo agarure benshi mu nzira y’agakiza. Uyu mugabo w’imyaka 27, ni umuvugabutumwa mu itorero rya ADEPR. Yatangiye no gukora umuziki aho yamaze kwinjira mu njyana ya Hip hop. Akurondoreye iby’urugendo rw’ubuzima ab’imitima yoroshye amarira arashoka bitewe n’uko yakubititse akiri muto ntabashe kwiga amashuri yisumbuye kubera ubuzima bugoye n’ubushobozi buke, ariko ubu ashima Imana aho igejeje ikora! Mu buhamya bwe ntajya yibagirwa kugaragaza uko yari umusinzi unakora inzoga z’inkorano ndetse n’uburyo nyina umubyara yamusamye mu gihe yigiraga kuba umubikira. Yakuriye kwa nyina wabo kuko nyina yamutaye akajya kwishakira undi mugabo. Mu kiganiro cyihariye na IGIHE yavuye imuzi iby’ubuzima bwe. Ati “Ubundi mama wanjye yigiraga kuba umubikira, yaje guhura n’umusore amutera inda rero birangira havutse njye. Icyakora ntabwo yandeze kuko we yahise ashaka undi mugabo kandi ntabwo twari kubana. Ibi byatumye nkura nderwa na mama wacu muto ku mubyeyi wanjye.” Ahamya ko yakuriye mu muryango w’abantu bakora inzoga z’inkorano, byatumye ku myaka icyenda gusa atangira kunywa inzoga. Akurira mu buzima bwo gucuruza no gukora izo nzoga. Arangije amashuri abanza ntabwo yabonye uko akomeza ayisumbuye kuko nta bushobozi bwari buhari, ati” Nyine ishuri narivuyemo mpita ninjira mu byo gukora inzoga kuko nibyo mu rugo bakoraga.” Ubu buzima yabubayemo ariko akunda umuziki, biza kumuviramo gushaka gukora indirimbo za mbere nubwo bitamuhiriye. Ati “Numvaga naba umukinnyi wa APR FC cyangwa nkaba umuhanzi wa Hip Hop nari umufana ukomeye wa Riderman.” Yavuye iwabo ababeshye ko agiye gukora umuziki, naho agiye gucuruza inzoga z’inkorano mu Karere ka Musanze aza guhomba bikomeye. Ubwo yari amaze guhomba mu by’inzoga z’inkorano yacuruzaga, Ev. Tuyishimire yisanze asigaranye amafaranga make cyane nyamara yaramaze gutoroka kwa nyina wabo. Inzoga zari zahombye abona ubuzima bwanze afata icyemezo cyo kwiyahura ndetse aranabigerageza Imana ikinga akaboko. Ati “Narahombye bikomeye numva ubuzima burarangiye, nahisemo kwiyahura icyo gihe ngura inzoga nyinshi ngo niyahure nasinze, naguze ikinini cy’imbeba nsinda ntiyahuye birangira ndyamye, ariko nkajya numva ko ndi bwiyahure mu gitondo. Bukeye hari ikiganiro cyacaga kuri Radio Flash Fm cyakorwaga na Pasiteri Ntambara. Icyo gihe yavuze ijambo ryatumye mpindura umugambi wo kwiyahura.” Tuyishimire avuga Pasiteri Ntambara yigishije avuga ko hari umwana ugiye kwiyahura kandi naramuka abiretse azaba umuntu ukomeye w’umugabo. Umugambi we uhita upfuba binyuze kuri uyu mukozi w’Imana. Ati “Igitekerezo cyo kwiyahura cyahise kimvamo gutyo nyuma njya kureba mama wanjye wabaga mu Bugesera.” Ageze mu Bugesera yasanze umubyeyi we azi ko umwana we yabuze, icyakora kuko ubuzima butari bwiza ntabwo yahatinze ahubwo yagiye gushakisha uko yabaho. Iki gihe yakoze muri restaurant, aha ni naho yatangiye gukora ibikorwa byo kwigisha ijambo ry’Imana ahereye ku hantu basengeraga. Akora muri iyi restaurant yo mu Bugesera nibwo Ev. Tuyishimire yatangiye kujya ajya gusengana n’abantu bari baturanye akarara aho basengeraga. Abo basenganaga bakundaga uko yigisha anasoma ijambo ry’Imana umugabo umwe basenganaga aza kumusaba ko yazajya kubwiriza muri ADEPR i Huye. Kuva icyo gihe yahise atangira kuba umuvugabutumwa wo mu itorero rya ADEPR atangira gutumirwa cyane mu materaniro anyuranye. Mu 2016 umugabo basenganaga yamusabye ko yamurera akava aho basengeraga bakajya babana nk’umwana na Se. Nyuma uyu mugabo yaje kwiyemeza kumwubakira inzu birangira mu 2018 akoze ubukwe aza kurushinga n’umwe mu bakirisitu bo mu itorero rya ADEPR. Yerekeje amaso ku muziki Kuva mu bwana bwe yakundaga umuziki by’umwihariko injyana ya Hip Hop, ibi byatumye uyu mugabo kuri ubu yumva yawukora ndetse indirimbo ya mbere ye ikaba igomba kujya hanze mu minsi ya vuba. Ati “Nubwo nakora iyi yonyine ngahita ndekera aho, inzozi zanjye zaba zibaye impamo kuko mpfuye ntaririmbye nagendana agahinda kuko nabikunze kuva cyera.” Avuga ko yari kuba yarabikoze cyera ariko agira ubwoba bw’ukuntu abo basengana bazabifata ahitamo kubigendamo gake. Iyi ndirimbo ye yitegura gusohora yitwa “Mfite ubwoba” yakozwe na Trackslayer, izaba ikubiyemo ubutumwa bw’ubuzima busanzwe ariko nanone buganisha ku Mana. Ikiganiro na Ev.Tuyishimire winjiye mu njyana ya Hip hop

title: Bizibukwa mu mateka! Isengesho rya Eid al-Fitr ryabereye kuri Televiziyo y’Igihugu
content: Byari bisanzwe bimenyerewe ko isengesho rusange ryo kwizihiza Eid al-Fitr ribera kuri Stade ya Kigali i Nyamirambo no mu tundi duce two hirya no hino mu gihugu. Warangwaga no kubona urujya n’uruza rw’Abayisilamu bambaye amakanzu y’urwererane, ubabona bose bafite akanyamuneza ku maso, basuhuzanya ubutitsa indamukanyo yifurizanya Eid el-Fitr nziza bagira bati “Eid Mubarak”. Kuri iyi nshuro uyu munsi iri sengesho ryizihirijwe kuri Televiziyo na Radio by’Igihugu, kubera ingamba zafashwe mu guhangana n’ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus. Isengesho ryo kuri uyu wa 24 Gicurasi 2020 ryayobowe na Mufti w’u Rwanda, Sheikh Hitimana Salim. Abayoboke b’Idini ya Islam bakaba barikurikiye bari mu ngo zabo kuko batashoboraga kujya mu misigiti kuko amakoraniro y’abantu benshi atemewe. Mu butumwa bwe, Sheikh Hitimana yikije ku kwimakaza ubucuti hagati y’Abayisilamu na bagenzi babo. Yanabibukije ko bakwiye kubahiriza ingamba zashyizweho na Guverinoma hagamijwe gukomeza kwirinda Coronavirus, anabasabira kugira ubuzima bwiza. Isengesho ryanyuze ku bitangazamakuru by’igihugu ryishimiwe cyane ndetse bamwe bagaragaza ko ari intambwe ikomeye yatewe bitandukanye n’uko byakorwaga hambere. Abinyujije ku rukuta rwe rwa Twitter, Abdul K. Harelimana, uri mu bagize Urwego Ngishwanama n’Inararibonye z’u Rwanda, REAF, yavuze ko “Ntibyigeze bibaho kuri Repubulika ya Mbere n’iya Kabiri guha agaciro Umunsi wa Iddi. Ni nkaho ntacyabaga cyabaye. Ntibyashyirwaga mu itangazamakuru rya Leta. Ni ishimwe ku Rwanda rushya kuko kuva mu 1994, isengesho ryerekanwa mu buryo bw’ako kanya.’’ Eid al-Fitr ni umunsi uba ari ikiruhuko ku bakozi bose mu Rwanda, inshuti n’abavandimwe bakishimana n’abayisilamu kuri uwo munsi mukuru. Igisibo ni rimwe mu mahame atanu ya Islam risaba abayoboke baryo kwigomwa amafunguro, ibinyobwa mu bihe bisanzwe n’ibindi bibashimisha bakarangamira Imana.
