title: Ese koko abantu bake nibo bazinjira mu ngoma y’ijuru?
content: Mbere y’uko agenda yasize abasezeranyije kuzaboherereza Roho Mutagatifu, uzabafasha muri uru rugendo. Nuko arababwira ati “Namwe rero muzambere abagabo kuko twabanye kuva mu ntangiriro” (Yh 15, 26-27). Kuva na kera Imana yagiye igendana n’abayo ngo bazaronke umukiro w’iteka. Uhoraho abwira umuryango we ati“ Dore nzohereza umumalayika wanjye imbere yawe, kugira ngo akurinde mu rugendo, maze azakwinjize mu gihugu naguteguriye” (Iyim 23, 20-21). Uwo Malayika w’Imana niwe ukuza ingabire za Roho Mutagatifu muri twe, zituma tumenya gutandukanya ikibi n’’icyiza. Gukora icyiza cyonyine ni yo nzira nyayo izatugeza mu ijuru. Ni inzira itoroshye kuko kuyisoza ari ubutwari. Ijambo ry’Imana rigira riti “Nimwihatire kwinjira mu muryango ufunganye, kuko umuryango wagutse n’inzira y’igihogere ari byo bijyana mu cyorezo, kandi abahanyura ni benshi. Mbega ukuntu umuryango ugana mu bugingo ufunganye, n’inzira ijyayo ikaba impatanwa, maze bikabonwa na bake” (Mt 7, 13-14). Erega ijuru si “ahantu” ahubwo ni “ukuntu”. Ijuru ni ukuntu tuzabana n’Imana mu munezero Udakama. Ab’Imana ijuru baritangirira hano ku isi. Bamwe bati“Twaremewe kuzajya mu ijuru, niho twese tuzishima iteka” ! Abandi bati: “umubare w’abagomba kujya mu ijuru waruzuye ni 144.000. Abandi turaruhira ubusa”! Abavuga gutya bashingira ku Ijambo ry’Imana dusanga mu gitabo cy’Ibyahishuriwe Yohani Intumwa, ahanditse ngo “Nuko numva umubare w’abashyizweho ikimenyetso: abantu ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ine na bine bo mu miryango yose y’Abayisiraheli” (Hish 7, 4).  Igisobanuro cy’umubare 144.000 Tugendeye kuri Bibiliya, nk’uko twabisomye haruguru, uyu mubare ushushanya abagaragu b’Imana bashyizweho ikimenyetso ku gahanga. Bakaba bahagarariye imiryango yose ya Isiraheli (umuryango mugari w’abana b’Imana): Isiraheli igizwe n’imiryango 12 yo mu Isezerano rya Kera n’imiryango 12 yo mu isezerano Rishya, ihagarariwe n’Intumwa 12 za Yezu. Nkuko tubisanga henshi muri Bibiliya, iyo bashaka kuvuga abantu benshi baravuga ngo “Abantu igihumbi n’ibihumbagiza”! Niyo mpamvu ku buryo buhinnye umubare 144.000 wavuye aha: (12x12) x 1000 = 144.000. Ibi kandi bigashimangirwa n’ibyo benshi birengagiza gusoma nkana ku murongo wa cyenda, ahanditse ngo “Nyuma y’ibyo, mbona imbaga nyamwinshi y’abantu, umuntu atabashaga kubarura, iturutse mu mahanga yose, mu miryango yose, mu bihugu byose no mu ndimi zose. Bari bahagaze imbere y’ubwami n’imbere ya Ntama, bambaye amakanzu yererana kandi bafashe imikindo mu ntoki ” (Hish 7, 9-10). N’ubwo abantu bazaronka ijuru ari benshi, ijuru riraharanirwa nk’uko twabibonye mu ntangiriro. Bityo rizinjiramo abazaba bararikoreye, barangwa n’ibikorwa byiza n’imirimo yo gukiranuka. Iki gihe turimo cyo guhangana n’ibyorezo bitandukanye, kitubere akanya keza ko kwitagatifuza ngo natwe tuzabarirwe muri abo bazinjira mu bwami bw’ijuru. Baba bake cyangwa benshi, duharanire kuzabarirwa muri bo. Igihembo cy’abeza Ababaye kuri iyi si neza, bakera imbuto nziza kandi nyinshi igihembo cyabo kirateguwe: Nyagasani azababwira ati “Nimuze abahawe umugisha na Data, muhabwe Ingoma mwateguriwe kuva isi ikiremwa” (Mt 25, 34). Maze bahabwe ubugingo bw’iteka. Nyagasani azahanagura icyitwa amarira cyose ku maso yabo. Nk’uko Ijambo ry’Imana ribihamya: Abazaba indahemuka kugeza ku ndunduro, Uhoraho azabambika ikamba ry’ubugingo (reba Hish 2, 10). Kumvira amategeko y’Imana ni byo bizadukiza, ariko twiringire impuhwe z’Imana kuko n’ubundi ibikorwa byacu bitihagije. Nta wajya aho ngo avuge ko ibikorwa bye byonyine bihagije ngo azaronke ubugingo bw’iteka. Icy’ingenzi ni ukugira ukwemera ukwizera n’urukundo bishingiye ku kubana n’Imana igihe cyose. Pawulo Mutagatifu ati “Bavandimwe muri Kristu Yezu, ndabinginze nimureke Imana ibigarurire” (2 Kor 5, 17-21). Mva imbere sinakumenye Igihe Yezu yanyuraga mu nsisiro yigisha yerekeza i Yeruzalemu, haje umuntu aramubaza ati “Mwigisha, koko abantu bake ni bo bazarokoka”? Nuko aramusubiza ati “Muharanire kwinjira mu muryango ufunganye; ndabibabwiye: benshi bazagerageza kwinjira, ariko boye kubishobora” (Lk 13, 22-24). Ngo abatarakiranutse ku isi bazakomanga bati “Shobuja, dukingurire, azabasubize ati: Sinzi iyo muturutse, nimumve imbere sinabamenye”. Bati: “Koko ntabwo utuzi! N’ukuntu twaririye kandi tukanywera imbere yawe, twitabiriye amasengesho n’amateraniro kenshi! Ndetse twigishije Ijambo ry’Imana mu izina ryawe! Kandi twafashaga abakene uko bitegetswe” (reba Lk 13, 25-28). Nyamara uko dutakamba kube imfabusa kuko n’ubwo bibwira ko bakoze neza mu maso y’abantu, bitigeze binyura Imana. Nyagasani, uzandinde iri jambo ngo: “Mva imbere sinakumenye”! Isi izashira ryari? Hari benshi birirwa bashyushya abantu imitwe ngo: “ibi byorezo kanaka yarabihanuye! Ngo isi irarangiye”! Ijambo ry’Imana riravuga riti “ Si mwe mugenewe kumenya ibihe n’amagingo Data yageneye ubutegetsi bwe bwite, ahubwo mugiye guhabwa imbaraga za Roho Mutagatifu uzabazamo, bityo muzambere abahamya hose kuko muzahabwa Roho ubamara ubwoba (reba Intu 1, 7-8; ....). Ubwo abigishwa babazaga Yezu igihe isi izashirira, maze Imana igakora umurimo wayo wo guca imanza, yarabasubije ngo: “Uwo munsi cyangwa iyo saha, nta we ubizi, habe n’abamalayika habe ndetse na Mwana; bizwi n’Imana Data wenyine. Mwe rero, nimwitonde kandi mube maso, kuko mutazi igihe bizabera” (Mk 13, 32-33).  Bavandimwe, ni byo koko isi izashira, ariko gusesengura iby’uko bizagenda tubiharire Imana kuko nta wasobanura ibikorwa byayo byose: “Nasanze ibyo yaremye byose biberanye n’igihe cyabyo; yahaye abantu kumenya ibyahise n’ibizaza, ariko badashobora gusesengura ibikorwa by’Imana byose uko bingana” (Umubw 3,11). Tube maso kandi duhore twiteguye. Dushakishe ubutungane mu gukora ibyiza bityo tuzaronke ubugingo bw’iteka, aho kubushakira mu nyigisho z’iterabwoba zishobora kuturangaza, tukazaburira aho abandi baronkeye (reba Sir 28, 6-7). Dusenge: Nyagasani Mana, turi mu bihe bikomeye byo kwiheba no gucika intege, ibihe byo guhangana n’ingaruka z’ibyorezo bikomeye, turakwinginze bana natwe. Wadusezeranyije kugendana natwe kandi utwoherereza Roho Mutagatifu ngo adutoze gukora ugushaka kwawe maze natwe tuzabarirwe mu bo wagize abawe. Kuri wa munsi w’urubanza uzaturinde iri jambo ngo: “Nimumve imbere sinabamenye”! Turashaka kukumenya kurushaho ngo natwe uzatwibuke, maze utugabire ubugingo bw’iteka ukurikije n’ubundi impuhwe usanzwe utugirira. Ku bwa Yezu Kristu umwami wacu, wazutse mu bapfuye maze igihe kigeze agasubira mu ijuru ngo ajye kudutegurira imyanya iwawe Dawe. Amen Padiri Victor AMERIKA

title: Igisibo cy’Ukwezi kwa Ramadhan kizasozwa ku Cyumweru
content: Itangazo ryashyizweho umukono na Mufti w’u Rwanda, Sheikh Salim Hitimana, rimenyesha Abayisilamu ko isengesho ry’uwo Munsi Mukuru wa Iddil-El Fitri bazarikurikirana kuri Televiziyo y’u Rwanda guhera saa Moya kugeza saa Mbili za mu gitondo. Ibyo bikaba bisobanuye ko isengesho rizabera mu ngo kubera kwirinda ikwirakwira rya COVID-19 iterwa na Coronavirus nk’uko RMC yabishimangiye. Itangazo rigira riti “Ubuyobozi buboneyeho umwanya wo kumenyesha Abayisilamu ko mu rwego rwo kwirinda icyorezo cya COVID -19 amasengesho bazayakorera mu ngo zabo n’imiryango yabo.” Ubusanzwe mu bihugu byinshi Umunsi wa Eid al-Fitr wizihizwaga byihariye n’Abayisilamu aho babyukira mu masengesho mu misigiti, agakurikirwa n’ibirori bihuza Abayisilamu n’abandi baba batumiye bishimira ko barangije igisibo gitagatifu amahoro. Ibyo byose uyu mwaka ntibizakorwa uko byari bisanzwe kubera ingamba zashyizweho hirya no hino ku Isi zo guhangana na Coronavirus. Muri rusange Igisibo nacyo cyakozwe mu buryo budasanzwe kubera ibihe bidasanzwe. Ibyakorerwaga mu misigiti, byakorewe mu ngo, uretse gutora Adhana byakomeje nk’ibisanzwe mu kwibutsa Abayisilamu isaha yo gusenga. Ku Cyumweru azaba ari tariki 24 Gicurasi 2020 ku Ndangaminsi isanzwe, naho ku ya Islam izaba ari tariki ya 1 Ukwakira [bita Shawwar] umwaka wa 1441.

title: Imana ntizatubaza gusa 1/10, izanatubaza uko dukoresha ayo dusigarana-Bishop Dr. Masengo Fidèle
content: Ni ubutumwa yatanze ubwo itorero abereye umuyobozi ryashyikirizwaga inyubako nshya y’urusengero rwubatswe mu nkunga yakusanyijwe n’abakirisitu. Mu gihe hari imyiteguro yo kwinjira muri iyo nyubako nshya, nibwo mu Rwanda habonetse umurwayi wa mbere bikurikirwa na gahunda yo kuguma mu rugo mu kwirinda ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus. Dr. Bishop Masengo Fidèle yavuze ko mu gihe biteguraga kugaruka mu nyubako yavuguruwe aribwo igihugu cyagiye mu bihe bya Gum mu rugo. Yagize ati “Byatumye imirimo ijyanye n’inyubako nayo iba ihagaze ariko yendaga kugera ku musozo. Aho rero bafunguriye imirimo imwe n’imwe, natwe iy’inyubako yarakomeje.’’ Yashimye abayoboke b’Itorero rya Foursquare Gospel Church, Paruwasi ya Kimironko, batanze ubutunzi bwabo kugira ngo inyubako y’itorero yubakwe. Yagize ati “Imana ntizatubaza gusa icyacumi [1/10], izanatubaza uko dukoresha 9/10 dusigarana. Turashimira Imana yadufashije gukora umurimo wayo, umuntu wese witanze kugira ngo ibi bikorwa bigerweho.’’ Yashimye Leta y’u Rwanda itarahwemye gushyigikira iterambere ry’amadini n’amatorero mu Rwanda. Dr. Bishop Masengo Fidèle yavuze ko bishimishije kuba icyorezo cya COVID-19 giterwa na Coronavirus kigenda kigabanuka mu gihugu. Inyubako y’urusengero rwa Foursquare Gospel Church yubatswe na Sosiyete ECOMEM, yatsindiye isoko nyuma yo gupiganwa. Dr. Bishop Masengo Fidèle yavuze ko ari icyemezo cyafashwe mu gukuraho urujijo ku micungire y’umutungo w’itorero. Yagize ati “Mu bisanzwe abantu benshi bubaka insengero ntibakunze gukoresha sosiyete ariko twe twahisemo gukoresha ubu buryo kugira ngo tugere ku bintu byiza kandi biciye mu mucyo.’’ Mu butumwa bwe, Dr. Bishop Masengo Fidèle, yasabye abanyetorero gukomeza kwinginga Imana kugira ngo COVID-19 yugarije Isi irangire bityo inyubako zikoreshwe icyo zagenewe . Biteganyijwe ko inyubako nshya y’urusengero yazamuranywe n’iyi shuri, bizatahwa mu gihe Coronavirus izaba yatanze agahenge. FGR ikorera mu Rwanda kuva mu mwaka wa 2005, icyicaro gikuru kiri ku Kimironko mu Karere ka Gasabo. Rifite amatorero arenga 40 hirya no hino mu gihugu. Inyubako yaryo nshya yuzuye itwaye miliyoni zisaga 400 Frw. Yatangiye kubakwa mu Ukwakira 2019.

title: Paul Hagayi wari umaze imyaka ibiri atuje yasohoye indirimbo yise “Negamiye Imana”
content: Paul Hagayi ni umuramyi, umwanditsi w’indirimbo, akaba anazitunganya (Producer). Indirimbo ye nshya yasohokanye n’amashusho yayo iri mu zizaba zigize album ya kabiri ari gukoraho. “Negamiye Imana” ni indirimbo irimo ubutumwa buvuga ko mu byo abantu bakora n’ibyo banyuramo bakwiye kwizera Imana. Paul Hagayi yavuze ko mu kuyikora yahamyaga ko ubuzima bwose bushingiye ku Mana yonyine kandi ko umurimo abantu bakora ariyo yonyine izawusohoza. Igitekerezo cyo kuyandika yakigize ubwo yari mu bibazo asa n’uwaburiye ibisubizo. Yubakiye ku magambo menshi aboneka muri Bibiliya mu bitabo bitandukanye. Yakomeje ati “Indirimbo nayanditse ndimo nibaza ibibazo byinshi naburiye igisubizo, hahandi uba wumva hari intambara nyinshi urimo kurwana mu buryo bw’intekerezo aho rero ni ho Imana yanganirije mu ijambo ryayo dusanga muri Yeremiya 1:5 (Nakumenye ntarakurema kandi nakwejeje utaravuka).’’ "Numvise ngize imbaraga mu bugingo bwanjye, numva nsubijwe n’ibyo bibazo byose nibazaga muri njye. Icyo gihe nahise mfata gitari na telefoni ntangira kwandika indirimbo gutyo.’’ Paul Hagayi yavukiye mu muryango ukijijwe, se ni Pasiteri mu Itorero rya ADEPR. Yavuye mu Rwanda mu 2013, aho yasengeraga muri ADEPR, Umudugudu wa Bugunga muri Gicumbi. Uyu mugabo kuri ubu abarizwa mu Itorero rya Power of Prayer Church mu Buholandi, aho ari umwe mu baramyi bakuru mu itorero. Paul Hagayi yatangiriye umuziki mu matsinda atandukanye. Mu 2014 ni bwo yinjiye muri studio gukora indirimbo ze wenyine za mbere mu Buholandi. Mu rugendo rwe rwa muzika, amaze gusohora album imwe yise ‘‘Nta rindi zina’’. Ari gukora album ye ya kabiri ndetse afite intego yo gukomeza kwamamaza ubutumwa bwiza kugera ku mpera z’Isi yose. Hagayi avuga ko bitoroshye ariko Imana izamushoboza. Ati “Hano muri ibi bihugu usanga ikoranabuhanga ryaratumye abantu ubwabo biyizera, bibagirwa Imana. Nubwo bimeze bityo haracyari abakizwa kandi bashikamye ku byo bizeye.’’ Paul Hagayi wari umaze igihe kirekire ataboneka mu muziki, muri Nyakanga 2019 nibwo yarushinze na Bakunda Odette mu birori byabereye mu Buholandi.  	Reba indirimbo ‘‘Negamiye Imana’’ ya Paul Hagayi

title: Byemejwe ko Ilayidi izizihirizwa mu ngo, Abayisilamu bahabwa umurongo bazakurikiza
content: Gusoza ukwezi ko kwiyiriza no gusenga ku bayisilamu biteganyijwe ku mboneko z’ukwezi, ku wa Gatandatu tariki 23 Gicurasi 2020 cyangwa ku Cyumweru tariki 24 Gicurasi. Ubusanzwe mu bihugu byinshi umunsi wa Eid al-Fitr wizihizwaga byihariye n’abayisilamu aho babyukira mu masengesho ya mu gitondo, bagakurikizaho inyigisho bafatira hamwe. Akenshi ayo masengehso abera mu misigiti n’ahandi hashobora guhurira abantu benshi. Nyuma abantu bishimira ko barangije igisibo gitagatifu amahoro, bagasura inshuti n’abavandimwe basangira ari nako bafasha abakene. Ni umunsi witegurwa cyane mu bayisilamu haba ku mafunguro bateka, imyambaro, ibyo barya ndetse hari ibihugu bashyira n’imitako ku mihanda. Ibyo byose uyu mwaka ntibizakorwa uko byari bisanzwe kubera ingamba zashyizweho hirya no hino ku isi zo guhangana na coronavirus. Itangazo ryashyizwe hanze n’Ubuyobozi bw’Umuryango w’Abayisilamu mu Rwanda, rivuga ko Eid al-Fitr izakorerwa mu rugo uyu mwaka. Bugira buti “Iswala ya Eid al-Fitr 2020 izakorerwa mu rugo, abagize buri rugo bazishyira hamwe bakore iswala yonyine nta nyigisho zibayeho. Umuntu uba wenyine na we akora Iswala y’Iyaliyidi ari wenyine.” Guverinoma y’u Rwanda guhera muri Werurwe uyu mwaka yahagaritse ibikorwa bihuza abantu benshi birimo insengero n’ibitaramo, hirindwa coronavirus. RMC yasabye abayisilamu ko mbere yo gukora isengesho ryo ku munsi wa Eid al-Fitr, bazabanza kwiyuhagira umubiri wose, kwambara neza, gutegura aho gusengera no kwisiga imibavu ihumura. Gutanga ituro ry’ukwezi gutagatifu kwa Ramadan (Zackatul Fitri) bizakorwa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga rya telefone. Mu minsi ishize umujyanama wa Mufti w’u Rwanda, Sheikh Mbarushimana Suleiman yavuze ko ari ubwa mbere bibayeho ko igisibo cya Ramadan kiba mu buryo bwihariye. Icyakora, yavuze ko hari amabwiriza Intumwa y’Imana Muhamad yigeze gutanga ubwo habonekaga icyorezo mu bice birimo Ethiopia y’ubu. Ati “Hari inyigisho ihari muri Islam ivuga ko no ku gihe cy’Intumwa y’Imana byigeze kubaho ibihe by’ibyorezo. Hari habayeho icyorezo, bimenyekana ko aho hari uburwayi bw’icyorezo kandi harabagaho kugenderana, ababaga batuye i Maka baragendaga kajya muri Afurika y’amajyaruguru. Intumwa y’Imana irababuza, itanga umurongo w’uko mu gihe ahantu hari icyorezo nta muntu wemerewe kuba yajyayo ngo atandura.” Ku isi hose, abantu basaga miliyoni 4.8 bamaze kwandura coronavirus mu gihe abasaga ibihumbi 318 bamaze guhitanwa nayo.

title: Amafoto y’icyumweru: Kabuga yafatiwe i Paris, RBC yashyikirijwe ‘Casque’ zikingira abavura Coronavirus
content: Ubushinjacyaha bw’u Bufaransa bwemeje ko Kabuga yatawe muri yombi mu gitondo cyo ku wa Gatandatu. Ni inkuru yanditswe n’ibitangazamakuru byo mu Rwanda ndetse isamirwa hejuru n’ibikorera mu mahanga. Félicien Kabuga w’imyaka 84 afatwa nk’uwabaye umuterankunga ukomeye wa Jenoside, aho mu Ugushyingo 1993, icyo gihe Sosiyete ye Kabuga yinjije mu gihugu toni 25 z’imihoro ivuye mu Bushinwa, nyuma muri Werurwe 1994 agura indi mihoro ibihumbi 50. Ni intwaro zakoreshejwe mu kwica Abatutsi muri Jenoside. Uretse ibyo ashinjwa ko ari n’umwe mu banyamigabane bashinze radio RTLM, yagize uruhare rukomeye mu kubiba urwango mbere no mu gihe cya Jenoside. Muri iki cyumweru kandi hanabayemo ibikorwa bitandukanye. Ku wa Gatatu, Urukiko rwa Gisirikare i Kanombe rwafashe umwanzuro wo gufunga mu gihe cy’iminsi 30 y’agateganyo abasirikare batanu n’umusivili umwe bakurikiranyweho ibyaha birimo gukoresha imibonano mpuzabitsina ku gahato abakobwa n’abagore bo mu Murenge wa Remera mu Kagari ka Kangondo II. Kuri uwo munsi kandi nibwo Uwizeye Vivine yasezerewe mu kigo kivura abanduye Coronavirus cya Kanyinya mu Mujyi wa Kigali, aho yari amaze igihe arwariye. Uyu mugore utuye mu Gatenga yanduye muri Mata ndetse byabanje kuvugwa ko yanduje Coronavirus abandi bantu benshi, abandi baranamubika kandi akiri muzima. Icyumweru kigana ku musozo kandi ku wa Gatandatu Perezida Paul Kagame yasuye ibice byo mu Ntara y’Iburengerazuba byagizweho ingaruka n’ibiza, agaragarizwa ibirimo gukorwa mu gusana ibyangijwe, kugira ngo ubuzima bw’abaturage bubashe gukomeza nk’ibisanzwe. IGIHE yakusanyije amafoto y’ingenzi yaranze ibikorwa binini muri iki cyumweru kigana ku musozo.

title: Uwasogongeye ku rukundo rwa Kristu ntashobora kuba imfubyi
content:
Icyadutandukanya n’urukundo rwe nicyo cyatugira imfubyi nta kindi uretse icyaha cyo cyatujyana mu rupfu. Niyo mpamvu rero dusabwa kumunambaho kugira ngo tutaba imfubyi.  Yezu ubwe yarivugiye ati “Unkunda azakundwa na Data, nanjye nzamukunda kandi nzamwiyereka” (Yh14,21b)  Bavandimwe, ubusanzwe amagambo “urukundo, gukunda, umukunzi, ndagukunda, gukundana” arakoreshwa cyane mu buzima bwacu. Ni amagambo afite uburemere bukomeye k’uyavuga cyangwa se uyabwirwa, iyo babikoze babikuye ku mutima nta buryarya. Ikigaragaza ko abantu bakundana by’ukuri ni iki? Aantu byitwa ko bakundana kuko buri wese yirekurira undi, ntacyo amuhisha kandi ngo burya abakundana bagenda basa ku buryo usanga n’amasura yabo agenda arushaho kwegerana.  Abakundana by’ukuri ntibahemukirana ahubwo buri wese aba yumva ntacyo ari cyo mu gihe atari kumwe n’umukunzi we. Bavandimwe, Yezu aduhishuriye ibanga rikomeye aho agira ati “Unkunda akundwa na Data, nanjye nzamukunda kandi nzamwiyereka”!(Yh14,21b). Mbega amagambo meza! Kubwirwa ko dukunzwe na Yezu, We ukunda by’ukuri bizira uburyarya. Abakundana bahana impano Mu rukundo habamo impano zinyuranye abakundana bahana kugira ngo barushimangire. Nta mpano isumba izindi rero itari iyo kwitangira uwo ukunda maze ukamwiha wese mu byago no mu byiza! Yezu Kristu yarabikoze, yaratwihaye, aradupfira, apfa mu cyimbo cyacu ngo twe dukire ndetse none atubwiye ko atazadusiga nk’imfubyi ko azagaruka adusange, ibi byose Yezu yabikoraga kubera Urukundo ,none turi guhimbaza Pasika nk’intsinzi ye ndetse n’iyacu kuko icyago gisumba ibindi aricyo “rupfu”, kitakidufiteho ububasha. Twakora iki? Nimucyo rero bavandimwe, natwe tugerageze kwitura Yezu urwo rukundo ruhebuje yadukunze. Nta kigoye adusaba, aradusaba gusa kumukunda. Azi intege nke zacu, aziko tutabasha kumukunda nk’uko yadukunze, ariko na none aziko dushobora kumukunda uko bikwiye ku rwego rwacu. Kumukunda biturinda ubwoba no gukangwa n’amagorwa y’ubuzima nk’uko twabyumvise mu rugero rwiza rw’abakristu ba mbere, bakoraga ibitangaza byinshi maze bagahorana ibyishimo bitewe na Roho Mutagatifu bari barakiriye. Nta kindi cyabakomezaga, ni urukundo bari bafitiye Yezu! Niduhumuke rero, kabone n’ubwo twe tutatotezwa tuzira Yezu, ariko hari byinshi bishobora kutujyana kure y’uruhanga rwe, tutabaye maso. Mureke twibaze iki kibazo! Ese koko nkunda Yezu? Ubu ndamutse mpuye na Yezu akambaza ati “Kanaka,Nyirakanaka, urankunda? Namusubiza ngo iki?”. Petero intumwa yabiduhayemo urugero; kuko kwemera Kristu no kumwubaha, biduha ubuzima bwa roho kandi bikaduha n’igisubizo ku mpagarara zacu zose, cyane cyane igisubizo cy’ urukundo tugomba Yezu. Ukunda Yezu koko yubaha amategeko ye. Amategeko adufasha kwisuzuma, kwisuzumisha, kuvurwa tugakira . Umwana utazakira akomerekera kure y’icyomoro Birakwiye rwose kugana Yezu no kumuhitamo, niwe Muganga w’ukuri, niwe twisuzumishaho, niwe uduha umuti nyawo, ni nawe ubwe umuti ukiza, niwe cyomoro. Niyo mpamvu rero amategeko tutagomba kuyafata nk’umuzigo.Nituyakunde ni yo azadufasha kumwereka ko tumukunda kuko n’ubundi itegeko riruta ayandi ni iry’URUKUNDO. Tumusabe aduhe kumwumva neza!  Akenshi twumva Yezu yakabaye wa wundi dutabaza gusa iyo twugarijwe maze akaza akadukiza uburwayi, akadukiza ibyorezo, ubukene, mbega wa wundi ukemura ibyananiranye. Nyamara ni Yezu utubuza gucumura maze akadusaba gukurikiza itegeko rye, ugasanga tudashaka no kumwumva! Bavandimwe, dufite amahirwe ko Yezu uduha isezerano rye atajya abeshya cyangwa ngo yisubireho. Aradukunda kandi icyo arusha abandi, ni uko n’iyo tumuhemukiye, akomeza kudukunda. Yatwijeje Roho Mutagatifu Umuhoza! Nitumutabaze rero kugira ngo aze atuvugurure, atuvane mu bwigunge n’ubupfubyi duterwa n’icyaha. Nibyo rwose uwasogongeye ku rukundo rwa Kristu akanamunambaho yirinda icyaha, ntashobora kuba imfubyi ahubwo asabwa n’ibyishimo bidakangwa n’amagorwa y’iyi si nka coronavirus cyangwa se ibiza biri gutwara ubuzima bw’abacu.  Yezu uyu munsi aje kuvanaho uburwayi butandukanye bwabangamiraga urukundo rwe n’abe: I. Kutamenya: Nayita indwara y’ubujiji bwo kutamenya amakuru ariho. Ngo icya mbere ni amakuru. Petero na Yohani bagiye biruka bajya guhinyuza amakuru y’ibyo kugeza icyo gihe bitaga impuha z’abagore. Ntibari bamenye ko Kristu ari muzima. N’uyu munsi hari benshi bataramenya ko Kristu ari muzima. II. Kutibuka: Ni indwara yo kwibagirwa yatumye Petero na Yohani bibagirwa kubara. Babwiwe kenshi kurusha abandi iby’izuka, ko azazuka ku munsi wa gatatu: Guma mu rugo kubera virusi yo gutinya abayahudi yabibagije kubara maze babwiwe ko Yezu yazutse basa n’abavuye mu bitotsi. Iyi ndwara ituma tutita ku byo Nyagasani yadusezeranyije. Uyu munsi aratubwira ati "Sinzabasiga muri imfubyi, nzagaruka mbasange".
Tumenye kandi dukunde gusoma Bibiliya yuzuyemo amasezerano Imana yatugiriye. Ese kuki utibuka ineza Nyagasani yakugiriye ukaba uriho nk’utaramenye Imana? Ukaba uriho bupfubyi? Kudasobanukirwa ni indwara yo kutamenya neza. Ku musozi Yezu amaze kwihindura ukundi yabwiye Petero, Yakobo na Yohani ati : "Ntimuzabivuge kugeza igihe umwana w’umuntu azazuka mu bapfuye". Bamanutse babazanya ngo "Ese kuzuka mu bapfuye bisobanura iki? " Ushobora kumenya, Ushobora kwibuka, ariko Ntusobanukirwe. Isuzume neza urebe uburwayi ufite maze wisuzumishe kwa Yezu akuvure ukire kuko uwo ukunda uramumenya, uwo ukunda ntumwibagirwa, uwo ukunda uba umusobanukiwe. Umwanzuro: Twebwe rero nitumenye, twibuke kandi dusobanukirwe ko Yezu adukunda kandi akaba adusaba kumukunda kuko biba byiza iyo ukunze nawe ugakundwa ariko bizira uburyarya.
Nitumukunda tuzaronka ibyiza byinshi: Tuzakira Roho Mutagatifu, ntazadusiga turi imfubyi ahubwo azagaruka adusange, Data azadukunda. Yezu nawe ubwe azadukunda kandi azatwiyereke. Ni byiza tubiharanire. Padiri Berthille Hategekimana /Paruwasi Mwezi/Diyosezi Cyangugu

title: ADEPR yashinjwe kugabanya imishahara y’abakozi bayo binyuranye n’amategeko
content: Muri iyi minsi ubukungu bwa ADEPR bwahungabanyijwe n’ingamba zashyizweho mu guhangana na Coronavirus zirimo ihagarikwa ry’ibikorwa bihuza abantu benshi nk’amateraniro, ibitaramo n’ibindi. Ibi byajyanye n’ibihe byo kuguma mu rugo, byatumye abakirisitu b’itorero badakomeza gutanga amaturo n’ibyacumi byavagamo ibihembo by’abakozi. ADEPR mu gushaka umuti kuri iki kibazo yagaragaje umushinga wo kugabanya imishahara ihabwa abakozi bayo barimo abapasiteri n’abavugabutumwa. IGIHE yamenye ko Biro Nyobozi yegereye abashumba b’indembo n’abayobozi b’amatorero y’uturere ibamenyesha iby’impinduka mu mishahara, ibasaba kubyumvisha abandi bakozi bayoboye. Mu Mujyi wa Kigali, abo mu Karere ka Nyarugenge basinye inyandiko yemera kugabanyirizwa umushahara ariko bigeze ku bo muri Gasabo na Kicukiro barabyanga. Aya masezerano yanditse ateganya kugabanya umushahara guhera muri Gicurasi 2020 kugeza igihe ingaruka itorero ryatewe na COVID-19 zizavaho. Hari aho avuga ko “Nshingiye ku masezerano n’indahiro y’umuhamagaro narahiriye, nemeye ko igihembo cyanjye cy’umushahara, kizagabanuka kikabarwa hashingiwe ku musaruro Itorero ry’Akarere nkoreramo umurimo rizajya ribona buri kwezi. Nemeye kandi ko muri iki gihe amafaranga ntazahembwa atazabarwa nk’ikirarane.’’ Biro Nyobozi yamenyesheje Inama y’ubuyobozi (CA) iby’izo mpinduka ku wa 13 Gicurasi 2020 ibinyujije mu butumwa bwa email. Mu ibaruwa IGIHE ifitiye kopi Umuyobozi wa CA, Kayigamba Callixte, yasubije Umuvugizi wa ADEPR, Rev. Karuranga Ephrem, agaragaza ko baticaye ngo bahuze ibitekerezo ku cyemezo cyo kugabanya umushahara w’abakozi. Amategeko shingiro ya ADEPR mu gace kayo ka 21, ateganya ko CA ariyo yemeza ibigendanye n’imishahara y’abakozi b’itorero. Ikomeza ivuga ko “Kugira ngo hafatwe ibyemezo bikurikije amategeko kandi bifatwe n’urwego rubifitiye ububasha, mbona hatumizwa inama idasanzwe y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi (CA) ikiga ku bigendanye n’imishahara y’abakozi hakurikijwe uko ubukungu bw’itorero buhagaze.’’ Kayigamba yabwiye IGIHE ko ntacyo yatangaza ku mwanzuro utarafashwe n’urwego ahagarariye. Yagize ati “Uwo mwanzuro [kugabanya imishahara] sinawuvugaho. Niba ntibeshye ku cyo wabajije, ubundi abantu buri rwego ruba rufite inshingano n’amategeko arugenga. Nta mwanzuro CA yari yafata ujyanye n’imishahara. Haramutse hari urundi rwego rufite imyanzuro rwafashe sinarusubiriza. Igihe cyose twishingikiriza ku mategeko.’’ Ubusanzwe CA iterana rimwe mu gihembwe ariko ishobora no gukora inama idasanzwe mu gihe hari ikibazo cyihutirwa gikeneye kwigwaho. Rev Karuranga yasobanuye ko nta gikuba gikwiye gucika kuko ikibazo gihari kiri rusange. Yakomeje ati ‘‘Tugomba kumenyesha abakozi ko guhembwa imishahara yari isanzwe bitagishobotse bijyanye n’ibihe turimo [byo guhangana na COVID-19] ku muntu wese uhemberwa muri ADEPR.’’ Abajijwe kuba icyemezo cyafashwe na Biro Nyobozi itabyemerewe, yasobanuye ko nta tegeko ryishwe ahubwo ari ikibazo cy’igihe kumenyeshwa abakozi byagombaga gukorerwa. Ati “Biro Nyobozi ifite ububasha bwo gufata icyemezo cyihutirwa iyo ari ngombwa hanyuma ikazabibasobanurira [CA]. Iyo ngingo [itegeko rigena ishyirwaho ry’imishahara] ni iyo mu bihe bisanzwe.’’ Mu bihe bidasanzwe Biro Nyobozi ishobora gutegura umushinga w’ibyihutirwa, abagize Inama y’Ubutegetsi bakawutangaho ubugororangingo. Rev. Karuranga yavuze ko “Igihe kiracyahari, nta cyangiritse usibye ko biba byagiye mu itangazamakuru, nta kigoranye kirimo. Biro Nyobozi niyo yari ifite uburenganzira bwo kubiteguza abakozi.’’ Icyemezo cyafashwe na ADEPR ntikigamije kugabanya imishahara bihoraho, ni icyo mu bihe bidasanzwe by ingaruka za COVID-19 zitaravaho.

title: Sedy Djano yisunze Serge Iyamuremye bakorana indirimbo ‘Ni wowe’
content: Sedy Djano abarizwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, ari naho akorera umuziki. Indirimbo ye ‘Ni Wowe’ yashyize hanze ni iya gatandatu mu zo amaze gukora kuva atangiye umuziki. Mu kiganiro na IGIHE, Sedy Djano, yavuze ko indirimbo ye nshya ivuze byinshi ku buzima bw’umuntu wese utuye ku Isi na cyane ko asanga nta muntu wabura icyo ashimira Imana. Yakomeje agira ati “Twese ntawe utashima Imana nubwo benshi tubyirengagiza ariko byonyine kuba tubona bucya ndetse bukira tukiri bazima mu gihe inshuti, abavandimwe, ababyeyi, abana bacu, ndetse n’urungano bitaba Imana twe tugasigara kandi ntacyo tubarusha, ibyo byonyine ni ishimwe rikomeye." Yavuze ko iyi ndirimbo yakozwe mu buryo budasanzwe ndetse bushya mu matwi ya benshi, uburyo bwiza buri wese yisangamo ndetse akanarushaho kwibuka ibyo Imana yamukoreye. ‘Ni Wowe’ ni umushinga wa kabiri Sedy Djano yahuriyemo na Serge Iyamuremye. Yagize ati “Serge nasanze ari umuhanzi mwiza, ni inshuti nziza ndetse akaba ari n’umuntu mwiza buri wese yakwigiraho byinshi mu buzima bwacu bwa buri munsi.” Serge Iyamuremye yabwiye IGIHE ko yemeye gukorana na Sedy Djano kubera ko yabimusabye kandi akaba amaze kuba nk’umuvandimwe we. Yagize ati “Impamvu tumaze gukora indirimbo ebyiri ni uko yabinsabye kandi amaze kuba nk’umuvandimwe kuri njye. Ikirenze ibyo afite umutima ukunda ibyo nkunda. Sedy afasha cyane abatishoboye kandi ntavuze ihembe cyangwa ntiyite ku izina ahubwo ibyo yaciyemo ni byo bituma afasha. Nigiye kuri uyu mugabo ko ibyo akora nta kindi aba agamije ahubwo ikiri muri we ari ukunezezwa no kubona ushonje yariye.” Sedy Djano afite intego yo gutanga ubutumwa bwiza, inama zubaka n’indi mishinga itandukanye. Cedrick Djano yakuriye mu Karere ka Muhanga, ubuzima bubi yabagamo bwatumye afata icyemezo ava mu rugo afite imyaka 14 yerekeza muri Uganda gushakisha imibereho. Yaje kujya muri Amerika ariga, arakora, ubuzima burahinduka. Urugendo rwe mu muziki yarutangiye mu 2018. Indirimbo amaze gushyira hanze zirimo ‘Turagushima’, ‘Ntabe ari njye’ na ‘Ni wowe’ [inshya] yakoranye na Serge Iyamuremye, ‘BE KIND’ yakoranye na Social Mula & Riderman, ‘Don’t Judge Me’ yakoranye na Uncle Austin, ‘You Make Me Higher’ yakoranye na Junior Multisystem.

title: Ibihe isi irimo si ibyo gukuka umutima
content:
Agiye kuva kuri iyi si ngo asange Se, Yezu yabwiye abigishwa be ati “Ntimugakuke umutima”. Iryo humure natwe niryo dukeneye by’umwihariko muri iki gihe twabaye ingaruzwamuheto z’ubwoba twatewe n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus ndetse n’imvura idasanzwe. Ubwo Yezu yasangiraga n’Intumwa ze bwa nyuma, nta washidikanya ko icyo gihe abigishwa bari barimo cyari giteye ubwoba. Aha turumva neza ukuntu inyanja y’ububabare yari yatashye imitima yabo ndetse n’ibitekerezo byabo. Ariko Yezu arabwira ati “ntimugakuke umutima nimwemere Imana nanjye munyemere”. Yezu arashaka kuturemamo icyizere, arashaka ko tudakuka umutima ngo duhahamuke bitewe n’ibyo tubona ndetse n’ibyo tubamo. Yezu yatanze iryo humure igihe haburaga amasaha make ngo atangire inzira y’Umusaraba. Nimwemere Imana, nanjye munyemere Yezu yagiriye inama inshuti ze zari zagashwe n’agahinda, azisaba kureba mu cyerekezo kimwe rukumbi zirangwa n’ukwemera. Amahoro arambye Yezu atanga, atsinda ubwoba, ntabwo ashingiye ku muntu, ahubwo ashingiye ku Mana. Urupfu ubwarwo ntirushobora kutwambura amahoro ye , kuko atava ku muntu cyangwa kubya muntu, ahubwo amahoro ye ava ku Mana. Mu nzu ya Data hari ibyicaro byinshi Yezu ntabwo yigeze ahindura amaso y’abantu ngo amurangamire we wenyine, ahubwo icyo yari agamije ni ugukiza muntu. Yezu ati “Namanutse mu ijuru ntazanywe no gukora ibyo nshaka. Icyo uwantumye ashaka ni ukutagira n’umwe nzimiza mu bo yampaye, ahubwo nkazamuzura ku munsi w’imperuka. icyo Data ashaka, ni uko ubona mwana akamwemera yagira ubugingo bw’iteka, maze nkazamuzura ku munsi w’imperuka”(Yh6,39-40). Yezu ashikajwe no kutugeza kuri Data abantu batigeze babona na rimwe. Ariko natwe tukazabanza guca mu rupfu nk’uko na we yarunyuzemo. Kuva kuri iyi si, Yezu arabibonamo nko “gusubira mu rugo” ; gusubira kwa Data aho yahoze. Ubwo Yezu yiteguraga gusanga Se, yakoresheje amagambo atambutse kure ubwenge bwa muntu kandi yuzuyemo icyizere; inzu, ubuturo, gutegura imyanya [...] Ni amagambo atanga ihumure kandi akatwereka ko turi mu rugendo ruzasohozwa igihe azagaruka kujyana abazaba barabaye ubwoko bwatoranyijwe, imbaga y’abaherezabitambo ba cyami, ihanga ritagatifu n’ umuryango Imana yironkeye.(1Pet 2,9) . Imana ituri hafi kandi idutuyemo. Ntabwo Imana yacu itwirengagiza cyangwa ngo yibere aho, ntabwo yihunza ibibazo byacu ahubwo ni Data udukunda. Urukundo rwayo rwigaragariza mu muvandimwe wacu wemera gushavuzwa n’imibabaro y’abandi, kandi akababwira amagambo y’ihumure n’ubucuti.  Burya nta byera ngo de! N’ubwo umubare w’ abigishwa ba Yezu wakomeje kwiyongera hari ubwo hajemo akantu ko kwikanyiza bagendeye ku nkomoko (Intu 6,1). Uwacengewe n’inyigisho za Yezu nta tonesha, nta kimenyane, nta gukundwakaza agira mubyo ashizwe, ahubwo aharanira ko ubutabera n’Ijambo ry’Imana bijyana bikaba mahwi. Ibi nibyo byatumye intumwa zitora abagabo barindwi b’inyangamugayo kandi buzuye Roho Mutagatifu n’ubuhanga maze babashinga umurimo wo gutanga amafunguro. Iyo urebye umubare munini w’abatuye isi usanga ari abamenye Inkuru Nziza. Bari mu madini n’amatorero yemera Imana ndetse n’ugushaka kwayo; ariko se kuki hariho ubwikunde butuma bamwe bahinduka abacakara b’abandi? Muri iki gihe isi yose yugarijwe na coronavirus kuki usanga bamwe barabaye ba rusahuriramunduru? Dusabe Imana ikongeze mu mutima wa muntu umutima wo gusangira no kumva ibyo twigishwa mu madini n’amatorero tubarizwamo. Aho ngiye murahazi, kuva ubu muzi Data kandi mwaramubonye  Urugendo turimo rugana mu ijuru kwa Data. Yezu aratubwira ati “Ni jye Nzira, n’Ukuri, n’Ubugingo. Ntawe ugera kuri Data atanyuzeho”. Abamenyereye kugendera mu ndege, mu modoka, kuri moto , mu bwato... muzi ko haba hari abantu cyangwa se ibyuma birangira abagenzi inzira, utabyumvise cyangwa se agakererwa arasigara. Muri urwo rugendo kandi habamo amabwiriza; bamwe bambara imikandara, abandi bakambara casque n’ibindi.  Natwe mu rugendo rwacu rugana mu ijuru hari imyitwarire igomba kuturanga. Iyo irimo kwirinda itonesha maze tukarangwa n’ubunyangamugayo bwuje ubuhanga (Intu 6,3). Hari kandi kwegamira ibuye nyabuzima ryajugunywe n’abantu ariryo NyagasaniYezu Kristu (1Pet 2,4), kwamamaza ibigwi by’uwaduhamagaye atuvana mu mwijima maze akatwinjiza mu rumuri rwe rw’agatangaza ( 1Pet 2,9). Mu bindi dukwiriye gukora ni ukudakuka umutima kandi tukemera n’uwo yatumye Yezu Kristu (Yh 14,1), kudacika intege muri uru rugendo rwacu ahubwo tugaharanira kuzaba hamwe na Yezu (Yh14,4) no kumenya neza inzira Yezu aturangira mu mvugo ye ati “Ni njye Nzira, n’Ukuri, n’Ubugingo. Nta wugera kuri Data atanyuzeho”. Muri iyi nzira turabonamo Tomasi. Araduhagarariye twese mu ngorane z’ubuzima no mu bibazo byinshi bidutera gushidikanya. Tomasi ati “Nyagasani, tube tutazi aho ugiye, ukabona ko twamenya inzira dute?” (Yh14,5) Ngicyo ikibazo cy’ingenzi natwe abantu duhora twibaza. Ese turajya he? Ese turagana he ? Ni ikihe cyanga cyangwa se intego nyamukuru y’ubuzima ? Ese ni izihe nkurikizi z’urupfu ? Yezu abona neza ko ntaho twagera tudafite icyizere. Yezu ni we uducira inzira kandi ni we udukingurira amarembo yo hirya yo gupfa kwa muntu. Umuntu udafite Yezu ahora afungiye mu buroko bw’ivanguramoko, ikimenyane, urwango. “Nimuhumure Kristu aradukunda kandi urukundo rushyitse rwirukana ubwoba, kuko ubwoba buterwa n’igihano maze ufite ubwoba ntagire urukundo rushyitse” (1Yh14,18). Dusabe: Nyagasani Mana yacu, ingabire zose waduhaye, uzidukomereze maze tube ibuye nyabuzima, ubwo twemera kandi ko twacunguwe n’ububabare bw’Umwana wawe Yezu Kristu ku bwa Roho Mutagatifu, uduhe no kuzasangira na We mu ngoma y’ijuru. Amena. Padiri Sylvain SEBACUMI Padiri mukuru wa Paruwasi yisunze Mutagatifu Tereza w’Umwana Yezu KABUGA, 
Diyosezi KABGAYI

title: Inkurunziza Family Choir yo mu Badiventisiti iri gukora kuri album nshya izamurika yizihiza imyaka 20
content: Iyi album iri gutegurwa izaba ari iya gatandatu Korali Inkurunziza Family izamurikira abakunzi bayo mu kwizihiza imyaka 20 imaze mu murimo w’ivugabutumwa mu ndirimbo. Korali Inkurunziza Family ni imwe mu zifite ibigwi mu zikorera umurimo w’Imana mu Itorero ry’Abadiventisiti ndetse abayizi bayishyira muri eshanu ziza ku myanya ya mbere mu zikunzwe. Ifite ibihangano byagiye binyura benshi mu myaka yo hambere birimo nk’indirimbo yitwa ‘Zenguruka Yeriko’, ‘Yobu’ na ‘Dusabwe kimwe’. Album yayo nshya izaba igizwe n’indirimbo icumi harimo nka ‘Abazacungurwa’, ‘Dushime Imana’, ‘Uri Imana’, ‘Kora neza’, ‘Igitambo’, ‘Ndishimye’ n’izindi. Niyomwungeri Aron ushinzwe Imenyekanishamakuru muri Korali Inkurunziza Family, yabwiye IGIHE ko batangiye urugendo rushya rwo kumurikira abakunzi babo indirimbo ziri kuri album nshya. Ati “Ubu twatangiye urugendo rushya rwo kumurikira abakunzi bacu indirimbo ziri kuri album tuzamurika muri uyu mwaka nihatagira igihinduka. Zimwe mu ndirimbo ziriho ziri mu ndimi z’amahanga kuko umurimo w’Imana tuwukorera no mu karere. Ni korali ikunzwe cyane muri Tanzania, RDC, Kenya, Uganda n’i Burundi.” Indirimbo ya mbere iri kuri iyi album yagiye hanze yitwa ‘Kora neza’ ishishikariza abantu gukorera Imana kandi bagashyira imbere gusenga; yakurikiwe n’izindi zirimo ‘Bazaririmba’ na ‘Ndishimye’. Korali Inkurunziza Family yatangiye umurimo w’Imana mu 1999. Imaze gusohora album 10 z’amajwi n’eshanu z’amashusho zirimo ‘Umunsi w’urubanza’, ‘Byose birarangiye’, ‘Tunaombwa kumujua Mungu’, ‘Mubwire yesu’ na ‘Nimekumbuka’.

title: Umunyempano Sam Rushimisha yasohoye indirimbo nshya yise ‘‘Ubutunzi’’
content: Rushimisha Sam ni umukirisitu ukora ivugabutumwa abicishije mu ndirimbo zo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana, ubarizwa mu Mujyi wa Dallas muri Leta ya Texas muri Amerika. Gukizwa no kwinjira mu muziki uhimbaza Imana, abikomora ahanini ku mpanuro yahawe n’ababyeyi be dore ko we n’abavandimwe be bakuze batozwa ibijyanye n’agakiza. Mu buhamya bwe, Rushimisha avuga ko yakijijwe neza mu 2014 ari nabwo yabatijwe mu mazi menshi. Indirimbo yamwinjije mu muziki ni iyo yakoranye n’umuramyi Romulus Rushimisha na we uba muri Amerika wamamariye cyane muri Rehoboth Ministries. Mu kiganiro na IGIHE, Sam Rushimisha yavuze ko kuririmbira Imana ari umuhamagaro, akaba agamije kwamamaza ubutumwa bwiza. Ati “Kuririmba byo nabitangiye kera sinabimenya, nagiye mba no muri korali mu Rwanda no muri Amerika. Indirimbo ya mbere nayishyize hanze mu 2019, nayikoranye na Romulus. Kuririmba mbikora kuko ari umuhamagaro, ni inzira yo gucishamo ubutumwa bwiza bwiza bwa Kristo”. Uyu muhanzi avuga ko indirimbo ye nshya yise ‘‘Ubutunzi’’ yayihimbye ashaka kwerekana ibintu by’agaciro kurusha ibindi abakorera Imana bazabamo iteka ryose. Yasabye abantu bose guharanira kubitsa ubutunzi bwabo mu Ijuru aho ingesi zitagera cyane ko mu Isi harimo ibibi n’ibyiza. Ati “Iby’agaciro karusha ibindi ni byo tuzabamo iteka, ni ibyo mu bwami bwo mu Ijuru ndetse ko tugomba guhanga amaso aho ubutunzi bwacu nyakuri buri atari ubw’iyi Si benshi twirukaho ariko amaherezo tukabusiga. Ni byiza gushaka ubutunzi ariko tunazirikane ubw’ukuri ari nabwo bw’ibihe byose kandi tubugeraho twubahiriza ibyo umwami wacu Yesu adusaba twubakira ku rukundo.’’ Sam Rushimisha amaze gushyira hanze indirimbo zirimo ‘‘Shimwa Mwami’’, yakoranye na Romulus Rushimisha wamwinjije mu muziki, ‘‘Ntibikingora’’, ‘‘Inshuti nyanshuti’’ na ‘‘Nayagaciro’’. Uyu muhanzi yavukiye muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo aho bita Mirimba akurira mu Rwanda mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Yerekeje muri Amerika mu 2015 ajyanye n’umuryango we.

title: Benedigito XVI wahoze ari Papa yamaganye abashaka ‘kumucecekesha’
content: Uyu mukambwe w’imyaka 93 ubusanzwe witwa Joseph Ratzinger yeguye ku mwanya wo kuba Papa mu mwaka wa 2013. Azwi nk’umuntu ugendera ku mahame ya kera ndetse yagiye atanga ibitekerezo kenshi yamagana amavugurura amwe n’amwe agamije guhindura imikorere ya Kiliziya Gatolika. Mu gitabo kivuga ku buzima bwe, Benedigito XVI, yavuze ko hari abamurwanya badashaka ko agira icyo avuga ku ngingo zitandukanye zitavugwaho rumwe muri Kiliziya. Yagize ati “Nabaye inzirakarengane ku bantu babi bashaka kwangiza ukuri. Hari ibitekerezo bitandukanye bituruka mu nyigisho z’iyobokamana mu Budage biba biyobya ku buryo mpitamo kutazivugaho.” Yakomeje agira ati “Nahisemo kudasesengura impamvu abantu bashaka gucecekesha ijwi ryanjye.” Uyu mukambwe kandi yongeye kwibasira abaryamana bahuje ibitsina, anamagana uburyo ugerageje kubarwanya yibasirwa. Yagize ati “Mu kinyejana gitambutse, buri wese yabonaga ko bitaboneye kuvuga ku byo kuryamana abantu bahuje igitsina. Uyu munsi abatabishyigikiye bimwa ijambo mu muryango.” “Ni kimwe no gukuramo inda cyangwa ibyo kurema ubuzima bwa muntu hifashishijwe laboratwari.” Yavuze ko abantu bakabaye batinya ibikorwa nk’ibyo avuga ko ari ibya sekibi cyangwa se Anti-Kristu. Nubwo yakunze gushinjwa kubangamira amavugurura muri Kiliziya Gatolika ari gukorwa na Papa Francis, Benedigito XVI yabiteye utwatsi avuga ko umubano we na Papa Francis umeze neza kandi wiyongereye.

title: Korali ya ADEPR NAMUR mu Bubiligi yatanze ubutumwa bw’ihumure mu ndirimbo ‘‘Mu bwihisho’’
content: ‘‘Mu bwihisho’’ ni indirimbo igizwe n’iminota itandatu n’amasegonda 25. Yubakiye ku butumwa butanga ihumure ku bantu bihebye cyangwa batanejejwe n’ibihe bari kunyuramo. ‘‘Mu bwihisho’’ ni indirimbo yubakiye ku magambo aboneka muri Bibiliya mu Gitabo cya Zaburi ya 91, ikubiyemo ubutumwa bwo guhumuriza kandi inavuga uko Uwiteka arinda abantu be akabahisha bakaba amahoro. Mu magambo agize iyi ndirimbo avuga ngo ‘‘Waduhaye amahoro yawe Mana, udukiza ubwoba bw’ibiteye ubwoba. Ibitero by’umubi wabitesheje agaciro, abantu 1000 baragwa turakira.’’ Umuyobozi ureberera inyungu za Korali ya ADEPR NAMUR, Ndayisenga Jean Pierre, yabwiye IGIHE ko ubutumwa burimo buhura neza ‘n’ibihe turimo aho dukeneye ihumure riva ku Mana. Niba turiho ubu si imbaraga zacu, Uwiteka yarahabaye akwiye kubishimirwa, yaraturinze kandi yatubereye Ubwihisho.’ Yakomeje ati ‘‘Ubutumwa twashatse gutanga muri iyi ndirimbo ni ubw’ihumure, kumenyesha abazayumva kwibuka ko hari Imana yaduhishe, ikaturinda kandi izakomeza kuturinda. Ko kuba mu Mana bitanga amahoro. Hanyuma twibukiranya kwambaza Uwiteka no kumushima.’’ Mu ikorwa ry’iyi ndirimbo, Korali ya ADEPR NAMUR yifashishije abaririmbyi bayo, abakirisitu b’aho iteranira n’inshuti zayo. Korali ya ADEPR NAMUR iri kuzuza imyaka ibiri itangiye ivugabutumwa, yijeje abakunzi bayo ko izakomeza kubagezaho ibihangano bihembura abakunzi b’umusaraba. Irateganya gushyira hanze indirimbo yitwa ‘Yego’, izajya hanze mu minsi ya vuba. Itorero rya ADEPR, Ishami ryo ku Mugabane w’i Burayi ibarizwamo ryatangiye ku wa 23 Ukuboza 2016 ritangirira mu Mujyi wa Bruxelles mu Bubiligi. Mu bwihisho ni indirimbo yatunganyijwe mu buryo bw’amajwi na Aaron Nitunga mu gihe amashusho yakozwe na Weya Media iyoborwa na Sebahire Séverin Sunday.  	Reba indirimbo ‘‘Mu bwihisho’’ ya ADEPR NAMUR

title: Yezu Kristu yazanywe no kugira ngo tugire ubuzima busendereye
content:
Imana koko ni urukundo. Ibyo yagiye ibigaragariza kandi mu Muryango wayo (Israheli), uko yagiye yitorera abantu b’inkoramutima ngo bayibere inshuti kandi bayihuze n’umuryango wayo (Abrahamu, Musa, Dawudi n’abandi). Abo bahanuzi bari bafite ubutumwa bwo gushishikariza umuryango w’Imana kuyigarukira igihe bacumuye bakayitera umugongo (Iyim 24, 1-18; 32, 1-4). Ni byo koko, Imana yaradukunze bigeza n’aho itanga Umwana wayo w’ikinege ngo abe incungu yacu (Yh 3,16). Mu buzima bwe hano ku isi, nawe yagaragaje urukundo ruhebuje afitiye abantu bose, aho yagendaga agira neza aho anyuze hose kugeza ubwo yemera no gutanga ubuzima bwe agirira abo akunda (Intu 10, 38; Mt 4, 23-25, Rom 5, 7-8). Aho ni ho Yezu Kristu ahera avuga ati “Njye rero nazanywe no kugira ngo intama zanjye zigire ubugingo, kandi zibugire busagambye” (Yh 10,10). Muri uko kutwifuriza ubuzima bwiza, Imana yadushyize imbere inzira ebyiri, nitwe tugomba guhitamo. “Dore uyu munsi nshyize imbere yawe ubugingo n’amahirwe, urupfu n’ibyago; kuko uyu munsi ngutegeka kugenda mu nzira ze, kwita ku mategeko ye, ku mabwiriza ye no ku migenzo ye. Nukora utyo uzagira ubugingo” (Ivug 30, 15-16). Ibyo Yezu Kristu abishimangira mu isengesho rye asabira abe kuba umwe kugira ngo bazaronke ubugingo bw’iteka hamwe na Data wo mu ijuru (reba Yh 17). Turi mu bihe bidasanzwe byo kwirinda icyorezo cya Coronavirus no guhangana n’ingaruka zacyo ndetse n’ibindi bibazo byinshi byugarije isi muri iki gihe. Iyo witegereje ibiri kubera ku isi, wakwibaza ibibazo byinshi: Ni gute twagira ubuzima busendereye muri iyi si yuzuye ibibazo bituma ubuzima bugenda burushaho gukomera uko umuntu atera imbere? Tuzirikane ku buzima nyabwo Kristu umushumba mwiza atwifuriza twese. Igisobanuro cyo kubaho mu buzima busendereye Ubusanzwe iyo tubonye umuntu ufite ubutunzi bwinshi tuvuga ko afite ubuzima bwiza. Tukibwira ko abwo anezerewe, ko yagashize. Twibwira ko abaseka bose ariko bishimye. Kugira ubuzima busendereye ni ukubaho uriho. Ni ugutunga no gutunganirwa, ni ukubaho udakora icyaha, wanagikora ukihutira kwiyunga n’Imana n’abo wahemukiye kandi ugafata umugambi wo kutazabisubira. Nk’uko Mutagatifu Tereza w’Umwana Yezu abivuga ngo “Muri ubu buzima nzagwa mbyuke nkomeze urugendo”. Kugira ubuzima busendereye ni ukubaho mu kuri. Abantu benshi bariho batariho, barishushanya. Ariko nyamara ntawe ubeshya ubuzima bwe. Nk’uko babivuga “Ushobora guhisha ko ufite ikibyimba mu mugongo ariko ntiwahisha ko wapfuye”. 
Kubaho mu buzima busendereye ni ukubaho ufitiye abandi akamaro, mu bwihangane no mu kwicisha bugufi, Ukabaho uharanira gukora neza ngo uzasige isi ari nziza kurusha uko wayisanze. Ukabaho udaharanira ibyishimo by’akanya gato bishingiye ku guhaza ibyifuzo by’umubiri wawe, ahubwo bishingiye ku kuzaronka ubugingo bw’iteka. Guhuza ubuzima bw’isi n’ubuzima busendereye Ubuzima tubayemo bushingiye mbere na mbere ku gushakisha imibereho. Aho abantu bashakisha akazi kugira ngo babeho kandi babesheho n’imiryango yabo. Muri uko gushaka Imibereho, hari igihe duhutaza ubuzima bwacu cyangwa ubw’abandi. Ndetse n’ubwo butunzi twanabubona, tukibagirwa uwo dukesha byose. Abigishwa ba Yezu Kristu bakundaga kumukurikira, umunsi umwe baramushakisha, bamusanga hakurya y’inyanja baramubaza bati“Mwigisha, wageze hano ryari? Yezu arabasubiza ati ‘Ndababwira ukuri koko: Ntimunshakira ko mwabonye ibimenyetso, ahubwo muranshakira ko mwariye imigati mugahaga.’ Nimujye mukora mudaharanira ibiribwa bishira, ahubwo nimuharanire ibiribwa bizahoraho mu bugingo bw’iteka, ibyo Umwana w’umuntu azabaha kuko ari we Imana Data yashyizeho ikimenyetso” (Yh 6, 25-27). Erega inda ntihaga! Umuntu avuka ashaka konka agapfa ataka inyota n’inzara, kugeza n’ubwo inda igusaba kandi utakibishoboye. Hari umukecuru witwaga Yanwariya yakundaga kugaburira abuzukuru be, yarangiza nawe akotsa ikijumba mu ziko, akakigaragura igihe kirekire, cyashya akakinombera ku mbehe, agashyiramo n’amazi y’igikatsi ngo cyorohe ariko yajya kukimira bikanga. Rimwe ndamubaza nti “Mukecu, kuki utarya koko n’ukuntu biba byakuruhije”! Aransubiza ati “Mwana wanjye, erega ndabirya bikandya”! Tureke ubuzima busagambe Igihe cyose abantu bazagira ubwikunde, bakumva ko badakwiye gusangira ibyo Imana yaremye ntibazigiramo ubuzima busendereye. Kugwiza ubutunzi bw’isi si ko kugira ubuzima busagambye kuko n’ubundi iby’isi ntibigira nyirabyo, iyo nyir’umuringa aje dutega ukuboko. Tugendere kure ibibangamira ubusugire bw’ubuzima bwacu n’ubw’abandi, ahubwo dushakishe icyaduha amahoro akomoka ku Mana, nk’uko Ijambo ry’Imana ribitubwira Nyagasani ababazwa n’uko twiruka inyuma y’ibintu bitaduha amahoro nyayo: “Yezu amaze kwegera umugi no kuwitegereza, arawuririra, avuga ati Ubonye iyo uyu munsi ugera waramenye icyaguhesha amahoro! None rero byarakwihishe” (Lk 19, 41-42). Umwanzuro:Nyagasani yatuzaniye ubuzima busagambye ariko kenshi duhitamo ubuzima bw’akanya gato, igihe twitandukanyije n’Imana. Duhinduke tugarukire Imana kuko ari inyampuhwe kandi ntikora nk’abantu: Umuntu ushobora kumukorera ibintu byiza byinshi akanyurwa, akanezerwa ariko wamukorera agakosa kamwe kakamwibagiza ibyiza byose wamukoreye. Ariko Imana yo, ushobora kuyikorera amakosa menshi cyane ariko wakora igikorwa kimwe cy’urukundo kigahita kibagiza ya makosa yose wakoze, Imana ikakwishimira. Duharanire gukora ibikorwa byiza cyane cyane muri ibi bihe bigoye buri wese. Dusenge: Nyagasani turagusaba tukwinginga. Wowe Mushumba mwiza watanze ubugingo bwe kubera intama ze, tuganishe mu rugaga rw’abagenewe gusangira nawe ubuzima bw’iteka. Uhindure icyerekezo cyacu igihe duhisemo inzira yatubuza ubuzima busendereye. Ha umugisha abifuza n’abari mu nzira yo kwiyemeza kuguhamya ku isi yose. Tugutuye abitangira ubuzima bose ngo uzabiture bwa buzima buhoraho iteka bwo mu ijuru. Tubisabye twizeye, ku bwa Yezu Kristu Umwami wacu. Amen Padiri Victor AMERIKA

title: Muco Adonis wahimbye ‘Nzogera ku cyo yavuze’ yashyize hanze indirimbo nshya
content: ‘Ndategereje’ ni indirimbo Muco Adonis yakoze mu Ugushyingo 2019. Mu buryo bw’amajwi yakozwe na Nicolas Mucyo & David Madebeat naho amashusho atunganywa na Fleury Legend, usanzwe unakorera umuhanzi Israel Mbonyi. Ubutumwa buyirimo bwubakiye ku magambo aboneka muri Bibiliya mu bitabo bya Habakuki 2.1, Ezekiyeli 37, Yesaya 43.18 agusha ku kubwira abantu ko nubwo bashobora kuba bari mu mwijima, umunsi uzagera bugacya. Muco Adonis yabwiye IGIHE ko yayanditse gusubiza imbaraga mu bacitse intege. Yagize ati ‘‘Yubakiye ku butumwa bw’umuntu wiringiye ko ibihe bibi arimo bizahinduka bikaba byiza, umubabaro ugahinduka umunezero. Ni indirimbo y’ibyiringiro yo gutegereza amasezerano y’Umwami Imana.’’ Yavuze ko muri iki gihe yabonye umwanya uhagije wo kwandika ibindi bihangano kuko ‘umwanya uhari nta wagira icyo yitwaza. Byaduhaye umwanya wo kongera kwegerana n’Imana n’abantu mutaherukanaga.’ Muco Adonis yatangiye umuziki akiri umwana, aririmba muri Korali Philadelphie yo muri Guérison des Âmes yamamaye mu ndirimbo ‘Shimwa yewe Goligota’. Impano ye yagaragaye cyane ubwo yitabiraga igitaramo cyateguwe n’umuhanzi witwa Shyaka. Mu 2007, yaririmbye mu itsinda ryaririmbaga Country Music ryitwa The Bishops yaje gusohora album yayo mu 2008. Mu 2010 nibwo Muco Adonis yatangije One Nation, itsinda ryamamaye cyane kubera indirimbo zirimo ‘Nzogera ku cyo yavuze’, ‘Umurwa wera’, ‘Ku bw’ubuntu bwawe’. Uyu muhanzi yaje gutandukana na bagenzi be mu 2015, yerekeza mu Rwanda ari naho yakomereje umuziki we nk’umuhanzi wigenga. Yakoze album zirimo ‘Rizasohora’ na ‘Urwibutso’ ari nayo iriho indirimbo ‘Ndategereje’ n’izindi nka ‘Urwibutso’ , ‘Ndi amahoro’ , ‘Urukundo ruhebuje’ n’izindi. Ibikorwa byo gutangira umuziki ku butaka bw’u Rwanda yabikoze ku wa 26 Ugushyingo 2017 mu gitaramo yise ‘Made in Heaven’ cyabereye muri Kigali Serena Hotel.

title: Danny Mutabazi yasohoye indirimbo ‘Impamba y’urugendo’ ihumuriza abahagaritse imitima
content: Danny Mutabazi uri mu bahanzi bakunzwe cyane mu muziki uhimbaza Imana, yasohoye indirimbo nshya yise ‘Impamba y’urugendo’ yubakiye ku butumwa bwo guhumuriza abantu bafite ibibazo bibaremereye mu rugendo rugana mu ijuru. Ni imwe mu ndirimbo ze zidahita zigusha ku bwiza bw’umusaraba n’uburyo abemera Kirisitu bawuboneraho umukiro; ni wo murongo w’ibihangano azwiho na benshi. Mu magambo ayigize, mu nyikirizo yayo hari aho avuga ko “Impamba y’urugendo irahari ku bagenzi bakomeje ijambo. Intama zizavunika nzazunga, munaniwe nzabaheka mbageze hakurya.’’ Danny Mutabazi yabwiye IGIHE ko igitekerezo cyo kwandika iyi ndirimbo yakigize mu mpera za 2019. Avuga ko “Ubutumwa buri mu ndirimbo yitwa ‘Impamba y’Urugendo’ ni ubwo gutanga ihumure ku bantu bananijwe n’urugendo turimo rugana mu ijuru. Inarimo ubutumwa bukangura abantu kugira ngo hatagira ibirangaza ngo bibatware Imana yabo.’’ Indirimbo ‘Impamba y’Urugendo’ igizwe n’iminota itanu n’amasegonda 31, yakozwe na Producer Leopold. Danny Mutabazi afite imishinga itandukanye ikiri muri studio igamije gukomeza ivugabutumwa muri rusange. Danny Mutabazi ni umuramyi ubivanga n’ivugabutumwa akorera mu Itorero rya Pantekote mu Rwanda [ADEPR] muri Paruwasi ya Gasave. Yamamaye mu ndirimbo zirimo ‘Binkoze ku mutima’, ‘Ufite uwo mwana’, ‘Calvary’ n’izindi zirimo ‘Getsemani’, ‘Ineza yawe’, ‘Ntiyasinziriye’ na ‘Ntiwanyihakanye’. Danny Mutabazi yavukiye mu Murenge wa Gishali mu Karere ka Rwamagana ahitwa Nyarugari. Uyu musore w’imyaka 26 yatangiye kuririmba muri korali z’abana mu 2004.

title: Cubaka Justin yashyize hanze indirimbo yatunganyijwe mu 2014
content: Indirimbo ‘Vumilia’ igizwe n’iminota ine n’amasegonda 58, yakozwe na Jimmy Pro muri Level 9 Records. Yubakiye ku nkuru yo guhumuriza abantu no kubibutsa ko ibibagoye bizashira kuko hari Imana ibirusha ubushobozi. Amagambo yayo agira ati “Nshuti yanjye uri kurira cyane wibaza icyo uzakora, ahantu hose wabuze inzira. Byagucanze cyane wabuze uko ubigenza. Nshuti yanjye ndagusaba ntuhagarike umutima, ibyo unyuramo byose Imana irabibona.’’ Uyu muhanzi yabwiye IGIHE ko indirimbo ‘Vumilia’ yanditswe, inatunganywa ku wa 9 Ukwakira 2014, ishingiye ku gitekerezo cyavuye mu bibazo byari bimugose. Yagize ati “Umunsi umwe nari ndi mu rugo, ndi gutekereza ku bibazo byinshi byari binzengurutse, iby’umuryango n’ibyanjye bwite. Byarancanze mbona nta muntu wamfasha atari Imana. Mu kwibaza nasanze nkeneye gukora indirimbo izampumuriza, igahumuriza n’abandi. Cubaka yahisemo kuyisohora muri iki gihe Isi yugarijwe n’icyorezo cya COVID19 giterwa n’agakoko gashya ka Coronavirus kuko ubutumwa buyirimo bujyanye n’ibyo abantu bari kunyuramo kandi bwabahumuriza. Ati “Indirimbo yanjye ibahumurize kandi mwiringire Imana, izatanga igisubizo. Izatuvana muri ibi bihe turi gucamo.’’ Yasabye abakunzi b’ibihangano bye n’abaturarwanda bose gukomeza gukurikiza inama inzego z’igihugu zitanga mu guhangana n’ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus. Ati “Dukurikize amabwiriza yose y’igihugu, Imana nayo izaduha igisubizo muri ibi bihe.’’ Cubaka yanditse izina mu ndirimbo zirimo ‘‘Yesu Akupenda”, “Ijwi ryiza”, “Je Vivrai” n’izindi. Ni we utegura ibitaramo bya ‘‘Gospel Live Jazz’’ byibanda ku mwimerere w’umuziki wa Jazz. Jazz ni injyana y’uruvangitirane rw’umuziki, yamamaye mu kinyejana cya 19 mu Mujyi wa New Orleans muri Leta ya Louisiana. Benshi bayifata nk’injyana gakondo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika Cubaka Justin ukomora inganzo ku mubyeyi we kuva akiri muto, amaze gushyira hanze indirimbo zisaga 20 z’amajwi n’ebyiri z’amashusho. Indirimbo ye nshya ‘Vumilia’ iri mu zizaboneka kuri album ari gutunganya. Uyu muhanzi akora umuziki abifashijwemo na Moriah Entertainment Group itegura ibitaramo, ikanatanga ubujyanama ku bahanzi bahimbaza Imana.

title: Gucika intege niko gutsindwa, turi nk’abigishwa ba Yezu mu nzira ya Emawusi
content: Basaga n’abarimo kwicuza kuba barakuriyiye Yezu none ibye bikaba birangiye nabi. Bari bihebye pe! Mu gihe bagendaga, umuntu yarabegereye, agendana nabo, bigeze aho arabaganiriza, arabasobanurira, batangira gusobanukirwa no gucya mu maso. Yari Yezu Kristu wazutse, ariko bo bari batari bamumenya. Agiye kwikomereza bamusaba kugumana nabo, bati “Gumana natwe Nyagasani kuko bugorobye”. Ni uko barajyana, bageze ku meza afata umugati, arashimira, arawubahereza, bararya, baribuka, baramumenya noneho (reba Lk 24, 13-35). Bamaze kumumenya, byahinduye amateka y’ubuzima bwabo maze bagenda bishimye bati “Mbega ukuntu imitima yacu yari inezerewe igihe twari kumwe nawe!” Ni uko bajya kwamamaza hose bashize amanga ko Kristu ari muzima. Guhura na Yezu bigira imbuto nyinshi irimo kugira ibyishimo, gushira ubwoba no kugira ishyaka ryo kumwamamaza hose. Izi mbuto natwe turazikeneye. Nyamara ariko umuntu yakwibaza nanone ngo kuki abigishwa ba Emawusi banze kwemera ibyo abagore bari bababwiye? Aho si rya hinyu tukibona n’uyu munsi aho abantu batagishaka kumva Ijambo ry’Imana! Nyamara tumenye ko Ijambo ry’Imana ari ukuri nk’uko Mutagatifu Yohani intumwa abitubwira ati “Koko Ijambo ryawe ni ukuri Dawe” (Yh 17, 17). Ni byo koko nta handi tuzamumenyera atari mu Ukaristiya no mu Ijambo rye nk’uko iyi Vanjili y’abigishwa ba Emawusi ibitweretse. Bavandimwe, muri iki gihe cyo guhangana no kwirinda ikwirakwizwa ry’icyorezo cya Coronavirus kimaze gutwara ubuzima bw’abatari bake ku isi, harimo hariyongeraho n’ibindi byago: Imyuzure, inzige, inzara ikabije ndetse n’ibindi bibazo bikomeje gukomerera abatuye isi. Benshi bameze kuba nk’aba bigishwa ba Emawusi, baragira bati“Twari tuzi ko muri uyu mwaka wa 2020 tuzagera kuri ibi cyangwa se biriya, none dore tugeze mu kwezi kwa gatanu”! Haracyari ibyiringiro, Nyagasani ari kumwe natwe.  Gucika intege niko gutsindwa Burya umuntu arateganya ariko Imana niyo igena uko bigenda (L’homme propose mais Dieu dispose). Dufatire urugero kuri wa Mukungu Ivangili yita “Umukungu kiburabwenge”. Igihe cyarageze yibwira ko agiye guhunika ibye mu bigega no mu mifuka hanyuma akicara akarya ibyo yaruhiye ntawe umuhagaze hejuru. Nyamara ntiyari azi ko iryo joro ari bupfe nk’uko Imana yabimuhishuriye imubwira iti “Wa mukungu kiburabwenge we, bimaze iki gutunga iby’isi yose ariko ukabura ubugingo bw’iteka?(reba Lk 12, 13-21). Abigishwa ba Emawusi bacitse intege cyane. Bati “Twe twari tuzi ko ari we uzadukiza, none hashize iminsi itatu. Ubwo nyine twakurikiye baringa!”. Mbese Yezu bari bamaze kumufata nk’umutekamutwe. Nk’uko bigaragara, Yezu ntajya ahinduka ahubwo nibo bahindutse kuko bari baramwibwiye uko atari. Bamwe bari barapfuye kumukurikira gusa, abandi bari baramukurikiye kubera ibyifuzo n’inyungu zabo bwite. Nka Benezebedeyi, bishakiraga imyanya ikomeye igihe azaba amaze kwima ingoma (Mk 10, 35-45); Barashakaga “Yezu w’Umutegetsi”. Abandi bamukurikiraga kuko yagendaga agira neza aho anyuze hose, yigisha, akiza abarwayi, azura abapfuye ndetse akanatubura n’imigati bakirira, abo ni abakurikiye “Yezu w’ibitangaza” (reba Mt 4, 23-25; Mt 14, 13-25). Nubwo natwe hari ibyo twari dutegereje muri uyu mwaka wa 2020, twicika intege. Nyagasani ni Muzima kandi aracyagendana natwe. Ahubwo nitwifuze igifite akamaro kurusha ibindi, ari cyo kumenya Imana by’ukuri no kuyitunganira. Kuko akenshi usanga tubabazwa n’igihombo tugira cyo kubura ibi cyangwa biriya. Nyamara igihombo gikomeye ni ukubura Imana aho abandi bayiboneye. Burya Imana igendana natwe Nubwo twamera nk’abigishwa ba Emawusi batinze kumenya Yezu kandi arimo gukorana urugendo nabo, noneho tumenye ko Imana igendana natwe igihe cyose. Kuva na kera Uhoraho aravuga ngo “Ni njye ubwanjye uziragirira intama zanjye, nzazibyagiza ziruhuke. Nzashaka iyazimiye, iyakomeretse nyomore, naho irwaye nyondore, ibyibushye ikagira ubuzima bwiza nkomeze kuyitaho. Nzaziragira zose nkurikije ubutabera” (reba Ez 34, 15-16).  Dushobora kutabona ko Nyagasani ari kumwe natwe mu bibazo duhura na byo ariko ntibimubuza gukomeza kubana natwe. Tumenye ko Imana ishobora byose kandi ko ntacyashobora kuburizamo umugambi wayo(Yob 42, 2-3.5). Igihe cy’ibigeragezo ni icyo guhura n’Imana buri wese ku giti cye bitambutse uko twayibwiwe. Nyagasani agendana natwe igihe cyose kugira ngo aturwanirire aho Sekibi agambiriye kudukoza isoni ngo tugamburuzwe n’ibihe nk’ibi. Aragira ati: “Witinya kuko ndi kumwe nawe, wikwiheba kuko ndi Imana yawe. Ni byo rwose, ndagukomeje, ndagutabaye, nkuramije ukuboko kwanjye kurenganura” (reba Iz 41, 10). Agakomeza agira ati “Wicika intege, Uhoraho Imana yawe akurimo rwagati, niwe ntwari ikiza! Azishima cyane ku mpamvu yawe, mu rukundo rwe azakuvugurura; azabyina kandi azarangurure ijwi kubera wowe, mbese nko mu byinshimo by’iminsi mikuru. Uhoraho azagukuraho icyitwa icyago cyose ngo udakomeza gukorwa n’ikimwaro” (reba Sof 3, 16-18). Dukomeze dusabe Nyagasani ubutarambirwa ngo agumane natwe kuko turi mu bihe bikomeye. Gumana natwe Nyagasani  Muri iki gihe, dukeneye kugumana na Nyagasani. Mu bitekerezo byacu, mu magambo tuvuga no mu byo dukora. Kandi rwose nk’uko yabidusezeranyije atwakira igihe cyose tuje tumusanga. Nyagasani aragira ati “Nimungane mwese abarushye n’abaremerewe n’imitwaro, Ni njye ubwanjye uzabaruhura” (reba Mt 11, 28). Dufite ubutumwa n’inshingano kandi byo gukomezanya no gufashanya muri byose kugira ngo tuzaronke umukiro uturuka ku Mana. Ijambo ry’Imana riti “Nimukomeze amaboko yananiwe, mutere imbaraga amavi adandabirana, mubwire abakutse umutima, muti Nimukomere, mwoye gutinya; dore Imana yanyu ije kubakiza. Abacumbagira bazasimbuke nk’Impala maze mutere urwamo rw’ibyishimo, ubutayu buzavubuke amasoko n’imigezi itembe ahantu h’amayaga” (reba Iz 35, 3-6). Bavandimwe, dushakishe ubutungane muri ibi bihe bikomeye. Bityo twaba bazima cyangwa twapfa, ntihazagire ikidukura mu biganza by’Imana. Dukomere k’Uwo twemeye. Nimuhumure kandi mube intwari kuko n’iyo hagira abagwa kuri uru rugamba ariko bakagenda gitwari bazabihemberwa, haba muri ubu buzima cyangwa ubundi buzima buzahoraho iteka. Abo, Imibabaro n’imihangayiko by’iyi si ntibizongera kubageraho, ngo “Ntibazongera kubabara ukundi kandi ntibazagira inyota ukundi, ndetse izuba n’icyorezo cyaryo ntibizabageraho ukundi. Imana izabahanagura icyitwa amarira cyose ku maso yabo” (Hish 7, 16-17). Dusenge: Nyagasani Mana yacu, ni wowe wo kwiringirwa wenyine. Tugutuye abantu bose bihebye kubera ibyo bari biteze kugeraho muri uyu mwaka bakaba babona bisa n’ibitagishoboka. Tuzi ko ushobora byose kandi utajya ukererwa, iwawe nta byarangiye, nta byananiranye kuko n’ubusanzwe ukura umuntu mu busa ukamuha ubuzima. Mu gihe gikwiye uhindure ibitekerezo byabo maze izina ryawe rihabwe icyubahiro. Tugutuye abaganga bose n’abandi bitangira ubuzima kandi nabo bashobora kuhasiga ubwabo, tugutuye abayobozi b’ibihugu byose ngo ukomeze kubahunda ubuhanga n’ubushishozi mu byemezo bafata bigamije kurengera ubuzima bw’abo bashinzwe, tugutuye abamaze guhitanwa n’ibyago n’ibyorezo biriho muri iyi minsi. Bakire iwawe Dawe. Turakwituye natwe ubwacu ngo ukomeze utwirindindire, uturinde kwiheba, ubwoba, inzara n’ibindi byose byatuma tugayisha izina ryawe. Turakwinginze, gumana natwe Nyagasani. Tubisabye twizeye, ku izina ry’Imana Data na Mwana na Roho Mutagatifu. Amen Padiri Victor AMERIKA

title: Igisibo cya Ramadhan kizakorwa gite mu bihe bya coronavirus ?
content: Kuwa Gatanu tariki 24 Mata 2020 nibwo biteganyijwe ko igisibo cya Ramadhan kizatangira mu Rwanda. Igisibo cya Ramadan ni ukwezi gutagatifu ku bayisilamu aho biyiriza, bagahurira mu masengesho bakanasangira amafunguro ku mugoroba ari nako bakora ibikorwa by’urukundo. Nko mu Rwanda ibikorwa byose bihuriza abantu hamwe byarahagaritswe mu rwego rwo kwirinda coronavirus, ku buryo bitazakunda ko abayisilamu bakora ibyo bikorwa bari basanzwe bakora nkuko byahoze. Sheikh Mbarushimana Suleiman, ni umujyanama wa Mufti w’u Rwanda yabwiye IGIHE ati “Kubera ibi bihe by’icyorezo cya coronavirus, biteganyijwe ko igisibo cya Ramadan kizakorwa abayisilimu bose bakorera mu ngo amasengesho asanzwe akorwa mu gisibo, igihe cyo gufata amafunguro ku mugoroba abayisilamu batumiranaga bagasangira Iftar, ubu ntabwo bizashoboka kubera ibihe turimo.” Gusari byari bisanzwe bikorerwa mu misigiti, bizajya bikorerwa mu ngo icyakora gutora Adhana (kumenyesha abayisilamu ko isaha yo gusari igeze) bizakomeza gukorwa. Gufasha abatishoboye n’ibindi bikorwa by’urukundo, Sheikh Mbarushimana avuga ko nabyo bizajya bikorwa mu buryo bwihariye. Ati “Byakorwa mu buryo bwo kunganira nk’umuvandimwe ukeneye ifunguro aho kumubwira ngo aze basangirire mu rugo ahubwo akaba yamwoherereza nk’amafaranga binyuze kuri Mobile Money akigurira ifunguro.” Ku bashaka kugira abo bafasha mu buryo bwa rusange, ngo bizaba ngombwa ko bamenyesha ubuyobozi bw’Umuryango w’Abayisilamu mu Rwanda bukabafasha. Kugeza ubu coronavirus imaze gutangazwa mu bihugu 185 hirya no hino ku isi. Umuhango wo gukorera urugendo rutagatifu i Maka nkuko bisabwa abayisilamu, nabyo uyu mwaka bishobora kutazashoboka mu gisibo cya Ramadan kuko ingendo zahagaze hirya no hino. Sheikh Mbarushimana avuga ko ari ubwa mbere bibayeho ko igisibo cya Ramadan kiba mu buryo nk’ubu. Icyakora, yavuze ko hari amabwiriza Intumwa y’Imana Muhamad yigeze gutanga ubwo habonekaga icyorezo mu bice birimo Ethiopia y’ubu. Ati “Hari inyigisho ihari muri Islam ivuga ko no ku gihe cy’Intumwa y’Imana byigeze kubaho ibihe by’ibyorezo, hanyuma hakagaragazwa umurongo w’imyitwarire uko ugenda. Intumwa y’Imana yavuze ko bibujijwe kujya ahantu havugwa icyorezo.” “Hari habayeho icyorezo, bimenyekana ko aho hari uburwayi bw’icyorezo kandi harabagaho kugenderana , ababaga batuye i Maka baragendaga kajya muri Afurika y’amajyaruguru. Intumwa y’Imana irababuza, itanga umurongo w’uko mu gihe ahantu hari icyorezo nta muntu wemerewe kuba yajyayo ngo atandura.” Igitabo gitagatifu cya Korowani kivuga ko iyo umuntu arwaye mu gihe cy’igisibo, asonewe kwiyiriza cyakora akaba yazafata igihe yamaze atiyiriza akayiriza yaramaze gukira. Abantu bakuze, abagore batwite n’abonsa nabo bemerewe kutiyiriza.

title: Patient Bizimana wasezeranye n’umukunzi we mu ibanga aritegura kurushinga
content: Muri iki gitaramo cyabereye muri Parking ya Stade Amahoro, Munyaribanje yemereye Bizimana inka ariko anamusaba gushinga urugo bitarenze 2018. Yagize ati ‘‘Ndashimira Patient n’abo bafatanyije badushimishije. Umwaka ushize mu gitaramo cyawe cyabereye muri Kigali Convention Centre (17 Mata 2017) naguhaye inka, ubu iri konsa. Ngiye kuguha indi ariko ndashaka ko uyibyaza umusaruro, tuzajya tuza tuvuga ko tugiye mu rugo rwa Patient.’’ Kuva icyo gihe, Patient Bizimana wakunze kugira ibintu bye ubwiru cyane ku bijyanye n’urushako ntiyigeze agaragaza gahunda yo gushyira mu bikorwa ubusabe bwa se. Uwamubazaga kuri iyo ngingo igisubizo yatangaga ni kimwe, ‘ngomba kubahiriza ibyo yansabye. Turabyizera ko bizaba.” Amakuru yizewe avuga ko uyu muhanzi ari mu rukundo na Gentille Karamira Uwera ndetse bitegura kurushinga. Mu minsi yashize havuzwe amakuru ko mu ngendo z’uyu muhanzi i Burayi aho yakoreye ibitaramo yabaga agiye gusura umukunzi we. Amakuru afitiwe gihamya ni uko umukobwa ukundana na Patient Bizimana atuye muri Leta ya Tennessee muri Amerika. IGIHE yamenye ko Patient Bizimana yamaze gusezerana na Uwera ndetse umuryango we wafashe irembo. Patient Bizimana ni umugabo byemewe n’amategeko kuko yasezeranye na Uwera muri Kamena 2019 mu Karere ka Rubavu. Ni umuhango wabaye mu bwiru bukomeye, uhezwamo itangazamakuru ku buryo no kubona ifoto byagoranye. Nta tariki y’igihe Patient Bizimana azakorera ubukwe ariko amakuru ava mu bantu be ba hafi ashyira ku kuba bushobora kuba mu mpera za 2020, Coronavirus nitanga agahenge. Twagerageje kuvugana na Patient ariko ntiyafataga telefoni ndetse n’ubutumwa bugufi twamwandikiye ntacyo yabusubijeho. Patient Bizimana yavuzwe mu nkuru z’urukundo na bamwe mu bakobwa barimo n’abo basengana. Uwa vuba baciye amarenga yo gukundana ni Deborah Uwamahoro Masasu [warushinze], uyu akaba ari umukobwa wa Apôtre Yoshua Ndagijimana Masasu, uyobora Itorero rya Restoration Church ku Isi. Uwamahoro yaje nyuma y’andi makuru yavugaga ko Patient Bizimana yagiranye ibihe byiza mu rukundo ruhishe na Gaby Kamanzi ariko yatangaje ko amufata nk’umuvandimwe we yubaha basangiye itorero ndetse n’umuhamagaro mu murimo w’Imana. Uyu muhanzi kandi yanavuzwe mu rukundo Miss Rwanda 2015 Kundwa Doriane, na we avuga ko batagiranye ubucuti bwimbitse. Patient Bizimana ni umuramyi umaze gushinga imizi mu ndirimbo zo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana. Umuziki yawutangiye akiri muto, akiyumvamo impano yatangiye kwihatira kwiga gucuranga piano mu rusengero hanyuma bigeze mu 2007 asohora indirimbo ye bwite yitwa ‘Andyohera’ ari nabwo benshi batangiye kumubwira ko afite ijwi ryiza. Yakunzwe bidasanzwe mu ndirimbo ze nka ‘Iyo neza’, ‘Amagambo yanjye’, ‘Menye neza’, ‘Ikimenyetso’, ‘Ubwo buntu, ‘Ndaje’ n’izindi nyinshi Azwiho gutegura ibitaramo ngarukamwaka bya ‘Easter Celebration’ byitabirwa ku rwego rwo hejuru n’ibihumbi by’abakunda umuziki we. Yabiteguye ahereye ku byo yitaga ‘Poetic Evening of worship’ nyuma bibyara Easter Celebration iba buri mwaka mu kwizihiza Pasika. Yihariye kuba ariwe muhanzi rukumbi wateguye ibitaramo byinshi mu Rwanda ahereye mu 2013 aho igitaramo cya mbere cyabereye muri Sports View Hotel Remera, mu 2014 kibera Serena Hotel. Mu 2015 nibwo hatangiye ibitaramo ngarukamwaka bya Easter Celebration byo kwizihiza Pasika, icyabimburiye ibindi cyabereye muri Serena Hotel. Mu 2016 cyabereye mu Ihema rya Expo Ground gitumirwamo Umunyafurika y’Epfo Pastor Solly Mahlangu watuye amagambo y’ubutsinzi kuri Patient Bizimana; mu 2017 yafatanyije n’abaramyi barimo Apôtre Habonimana w’i Burundi n’Umunya-Kenya Marion Shako mu gitaramo cyabereye KCC. Umwaka wakurikiyeho yatumiye Umunya-Nigeria w’icyamamare, Osinachi Joseph (Sinach) wataramiye muri Parking ya Stade Amahoro mu 2018, imvura ijojoba. Mu mwaka ushize, Patient Bizimana yatumiye Alka Mbumba wo muri RDC n’Itsinda rya Redemption Voice ry’i Burundi mu gitaramo cyahembuyemo imitima ya benshi.

title: Bishop Rugagi udakunze kuvugwaho rumwe yigambye ko akiza Coronavirus
content: Ibi ahanini bishingira ku byitwa ubuhanuzi akora, kimwe n’abandi bapasiteri muri iki gihe, buvuga buhamya ibintu bizabaho, ariko abantu bagategereza amaso agahera mu kirere. Bishop Rugagi ni Umuyobozi w’Itorero Abacunguwe. Mu ntangiriro za 2018 yakoze igikorwa cyanenzwe na benshi, yagaragaye ahanurira imbere y’igiseke cy’amaturo. Uwamugeraga imbere amaze gutura, yamubazaga icyo yifuza. Icyo gihe yavuze ko atanze imiturirwa, imodoka zigezweho nka Land Cruiser n’ibindi by’agaciro. Benshi barabinenze, babyita ubuyobe no gutekera abantu imitwe kugira ngo abone amafaranga yo kugura imodoka zigezweho n’ibindi kuko uwo yahanuriraga yabaga amaze gushyira amafaranga muri icyo giseke. Ntakibarizwa mu Rwanda ubu kuko asigaye atuye muri Canada. Itorero rye n’intama yari ayoboye zaratatanye, bamwe basubiye mu matorero bahozemo ariko abamunambyeho bakurikira inyigisho ze kuri Televiziyo ya TV7 yasize ashinze isigaye ikorera kuri Youtube. Yongeye kumvikana na none mu mvugo yanenzwe bikomeye, ko agiye gukiza abantu Coronavirus binyuze mu masengesho. Mu butumwa bwanyuze kuri TV7, yavuze ko Imana iri kumwiyereka kuri COVID-19. Yakomeje ati “Nawe nuyirwara, iyo nimero iri kuri televiziyo yawe, uyihamagare. Ndakubwira nti uramutse upfuye, uzatangaze ngo ndi umuhanuzi w’ibinyoma. Uzatinye icyo ntangaje ku mugaragaro. Sindi umupfumu uragura aho bihisha. Ndavuga ku mugaragaro Isi yose ibibona.’’ Yavuze ko hari abamuhamagaye bafite COVID-19 n’abatumye abavandimwe babo gushaka ababasengera ndetse ngo hari uwo mu Bubiligi, Texas na Afurika y’Epfo bakize. Ati “Ndashima Imana, ubutumwa ndabufite bw’abakize COVID-19. Ni ibitangaza byabaye ku buzima bwawe. Abo ni bo nibuka ubutumwa mwanyoherereje, Imana ishimwe ko mwohereje izindi zivuga ko mwakize icyo cyago cyateye Isi. Icyo nicyo gitangaza, ndababwiye ngo banywe amazi ashyushye. Mwizere Yesu, nyuma yo kuyanywa kira icyo cyago cyawe.’’ Si ubwa mbere avuga amagambo nk’aya, ariko ibyo yavuze bigahera mu mvugo gusa. Nko mu ntangiriro za 2018 yagarutsweho cyane nyuma yo kuvuga ko Umunyana Shanitah azaba Miss Rwanda 2018, bikarangira atabigezeho. Byatumye abantu bamuha urw’amenyo, aba iciro ry’imigani ndetse ushatse kugaragaza umuntu uvuga ibinyoma akabyita ‘Gushanita’. title: Umuvugabutumwa wo muri ADEPR yinjiranye mu muziki indirimbo iri mu njyana ya Hip Hop
content: Izina rya Tuyishimire Diogène rirazwi cyane ariko rikunzwe by’umwihariko muri ADEPR. Yamamaye cyane mu nyigisho avugamo uko Yesu afite imbaraga zidasanzwe, akamusanisha n’ibintu byose. Agira ati “Nta kintu adasa nacyo. Mu bana yabaye umwana w’Imana, mu bagabo aba umugabo w’abapfakazi, mu bapapa aba se w’imfubyi, mu biti aba umuzabibu w’ukuri mwe [abakirisitu] muri amashami…’’ Uyu muvugabutumwa yakuranye inzozi zo kuzaba umuhanzi ariko wibanda ku butumwa bufitiye akamaro sosiyete Nyarwanda. Tuyishimire yakuze yiyumvamo cyane Hip hop ndetse indirimbo ye ya mbere yise ‘‘Byanteye ubwoba’’ icuranze muri iyo njyana. Aganira na IGIHE Tuyishimire yavuze ko gusohora indirimbo ari inzozi ze zabaye impamo. Ati ‘‘Nakuze nifuza kuba umuhanzi, igihe nyacyo cy’Imana nasanze ari iki ngo nsohore indirimbo yanjye ya mbere.’’ Mu ndirimbo ye avuga ko nubwo Isi irushya abantu ariko Imana izahindura byose bishya, akongera ati “Mu buzima nubwo tubabazwa ariko Imana izaduha guhozwa.’’ Yakomeje ati “Nashatse kugaragaza ko nubwo mu Isi umuntu ashobora kunyura mu buzima bukomeye ariko hari Imana ibuyobora; ubuzima bukomeye bugahinduka ubworoshye binyuze mu kwizera Imana.’’ “Byanteye ubwoba” ifite iminota itatu n’amasegonda 36 yakozwe mu buryo bw’amajwi na Producer Trackslayer. Tuyishimire yayiririmbye afatanyije na Dushimiyimana Emmanuel uzwi nka Manud na we ubarizwa muri ADEPR. Yiyongereye ku bandi bahanzi bake bo mu itorero rya ADEPR baririmba mu njyana ya Hip hop. Yashimangiye ko gukora umuziki muri Hip hop bidakwiye gufatwa nabi mu gihe atanga ubutumwa butomoye. Yagize ati ‘‘Ubusanzwe nta njyana iva ku Mana, zose nizo abantu bihangiye, ziva mu bwenge bwabo. Numva rero injyana atari ikibazo ahubwo ikibazo cyaba ubutumwa burimo.’’ Tuyishimire Diogène afite imyaka 27, ni umugabo wubatse, ufite umugore n’umwana umwe. Asengera mu Itorero rya ADEPR muri Paruwasi ya Jabana.  	Indi nkuru wasoma: Yavutse ku witeguraga kuba Umubikira: Ubuhamya butangaje bwa Ev. Tuyishimire wo muri ADEPR

title: Papa Francis yamaganye urupfu rwa George Floyd n’imvururu zarukurikiye muri Amerika
content: Imijyi myinshi muri Amerika no hanze yayo irimo imyigaragambyo ikomeye yamagana irondaruhu nyuma y’urupfu rwa Floyd wishwe mu Cyumweru gishize, bikozwe n’umupolisi wamushikamiye akoresheje ivi kugeza aheze umwuka. Kuri uyu wa Gatatu Papa Francis yavuze ko irondaruhu atari iryo kwihanganira, ariko yongeraho ko ubugizi bwa nabi nabwo ari inzira yo kwiyangiza no gusenya. Yavuze ko urupfu rwa Floyd rubabaje ndetse ko ari kumusengera n’abandi bose bapfuye bazize “icyaha cy’ivanguramoko’. Yagize ati “Nshuti zanjye ntabwo twakwihanganira cyangwa ngo twirengagize irondaruhu n’ihezwa ry’ubwoko bwose, hanyuma ngo tuvuge ko turengera igitinyiro cy’ubuzima bwa muntu.” Agaruka ku myigaragambyo yagaragayemo ubugizi bwa nabi imaze iminsi ikorwa muri Amerika, Papa yagize ati “Ni nako kandi tugomba kumenya ko ubugizi bwa nabi bumaze iminsi bwigaragaza, ari uburyo bwo kwiyangiza no kwitsinda. Nta na kimwe wageraho ukoresheje ubugizi bwa nabi ahubwo wangiza byinshi.” Papa Francis yasabye abanyamerika kwiragiza Imana ikabafasha kugarura amahoro n’ubwiyunge.
