title: The Bright Five Singers yashyize hanze indirimbo yo gufasha abantu kwizihiza umunsi mukuru wa Pantekote
content: Kuri uyu wa 31 Gicurasi 2020 muri Kiliziya Gatolika n’andi madini yemera Yezu barazirikana igihe Yezu Kristu yasubiraga mu Ijuru maze akaboherereza Roho Mutagatifu. Mu kuzirikana uyu munsi no gufasha abakirisitu kuwizihiza, abaririmbyi ba The Bright 5 Singers bahimbye indirimbo yitwa ‘Roho, ngwino utumurikire’ ijyanye n’uwo munsi kugira ngo bafashe abakristu bose kuzirikana ibanga ryawo. Iraguha Alain Marius uhagarariye The Bright 5 Singers yabwiye IGIHE ko iyi ndirimbo bashyize hanze irimo ubutumwa busaba roho w’Imana kumurikira abantu.  Ati “Irimo ubutumwa busaba Roho w’Imana kumurikira abantu kugira ngo babashe gukorera Imana badategwa, kuko muri iyi minsi benshi bacitse intege.” Itsinda rya The Bright Five Singers ryatangiye gukora ubutumwa mu 2015 ku itariki 15 Ukwakira ariko abarigize bose bari basanzwe ari abaririmbyi dore ko benshi muri bo bize muri Seminari zitandukanye. Barangije amashuri yisumbuye, bane muri bo bahuriye mu yahoze ari Kaminuza Nkuru y’u Rwanda i Huye (NUR) muri korali yitwa Le Bon Berger. Ubwo habaga amahugurwa yari yateguwe na Choeur International et Ensemble Instrumental de Kigali agenewe abaririmbyi mu 2011 igatumira umugabo w’umuhanga muri muzika wo muri Cameroun witwa Jean Jacques Gregoire Belobo, niwe wabateye iyo nyota yo kurushaho gukunda umuziki, ariko anabasigira ubumenyi ari nabwo bifashishije mu kuzamura imiririmbire yabo. Nyuma y’aho basoreje amashuri nibwo bihuje bakora iri tsinda. Bakunda gukora ibitaramo bitandukanye biteguriye cyangwa se batumiwemo. Iri tsinda ryanashyize hanze Album ya mbere yitwa ‘Musabe Muzahabwa’. Yagiye hanze kuwa 15, Ukwakira 2017. Bafite izindi zirimo iyitwa "Uhoraho", "Sangwa Mariya", "Dusingize Imana" n’izindi. Indirimbo nshya yakozwe mu buryo bw’amajwi na Emmy Pro usanzwe akora indirimbo iz’abaririmbyi bo muri kiliziya Gatolika naho amashusho atunganywa na Gaga.

title: Ntabwo Yezu yagusize bupfubyi
content:
Mu gihe cya Yezu bawuhimbazaga bibuka umunsi bahaweho amategeko ku musozi wa Sinayi. Muri iki gihe abakristu bawuhimbaza bazirikana Roho Mutagatifu amanukira ku Ntumwa. Roho w’Imana, ni we wabwirije abahanuzi ibyo bavuze Roho Mutagatifu atuma tugira ubugingo bw’Imana, akatubera urumuri rutwumvisha Inkuru nziza ya Yezu Kristu kandi akaduha imbaraga zo kuyikurikiza twishimye!Ku buryo bwuzuye, Roho Mutagatifu yamenyekanye nyuma ya Pasika kandi amenyekanisha Imana Data na Mwana. Mbere ya Pasika ye, Yezu yatangaje iyoherezwa ry’undi Muvugizi (Umurengezi), ari we Roho Mutagatifu. We watangiye umurimo we kuva mu gihe cy’iremwa ry’ijuru n’isi akaba ari We kera wabwirije abahanuzi ibyo bavuze , ubu noneho ari kumwe n’abigishwa kandi akaba muri bo (Yh 14,26), kugira ngo abigishe kandi abayobore mu kuri kose (Yh 16, 13). Nuko rero, Roho Mutagatifu agaragazwa nk’Undi ufitanye isano na Yezu na Se. Inkomoko ihoraho ya Roho Mutagatifu yigaragariza mu butumwa bwe ku isi. Roho Mutagatifu wohererejwe intumwa na Kiliziya yatumwe n’Imana Data mu izina rya Yezu, yoherezwa kandi na Mwana ubwe amaze gusubira kwa Se. Iyoherezwa rya Roho Mutagatifu nyuma y’ikuzwa rya Yezu, rihishura byuzuye ibanga ry’Ubutatu Butagatifu. Ijambo Roho risobanura ijambo ry’igihebureyi Ruah , risobanura; umwuka, umuyaga. Tugendeye kuri icyo gisobanuro tubona ingingo ebyiri z’ingenzi dusanga muri Bibiliya : Iremwa rya mbere : « Imana ihuha mu mazuru yabo umwuka w’ubuzima » (Intg2,7) ; Habayeho irema ryo mu gihe cyahise, ivuka rya mbere ry’ubuzima mbere y’ibihe. Iremwa rya nyuma : Turisanga kwa Ez 37,9), hagira hati «Uhoraho aravuga ati :Wa mwuka we, turuka mu mpande zose uko ari enye uhuhera kuri iyi mirambo maze yongere ibeho » Hazabaho irema ryo mu gihe gishya, ukuzuka kwa nyuma, ku munsi w’imperuka maze ubuzima bwongere bwigaragaze. Ntabwo guhumeka bikorwa rimwe gusa mu mwaka Umunsi wa mbere w’icyumweru Inzugi z’aho abigishwa ba Yezu bari bari zari zifunze kubera gutinya abayahudi. Nuko Yezu agira atya ahagarara hagati yabo, arababwira , ati « nimugire amahoro». (Yh20, 19-20) Ni ukuvuga ko isi nshya n’ikiremwa gishya byavutse ; ni intangiriro nshya ! Imana yafashe muntu mu biganza byayo, imurema bundi bushya, mu ibumba rishyashya ryuje urukundo n’amahoro kandi ritsinda ubwoba. Abakristu rero, guhera ubwo ntibahwemye guhura, buri munsi wa mbere w’icyumweru. Kuva ku cyumweru kugera ku kindi. Kiliziya yavutse kuri iryo huriro rya buri gihe, rikiriho kugeza na n’ubu. Abakristu bakora iryo huriro buri cyumweru, kugeza igihe Yezu azagarukira. Ntabwo dukwiye gufata icyumweru nk’aho ari itegeko gusa, ahubwo dukwiye kugifata nk’icya ngombwa kandi cy’ingenzi mu buzima bwacu. « Birakwiye guhumeka umwuka muzima buri gihe » Ntabwo guhumeka bikorwa rimwe gusa mu mwaka. N’ubwo duhimbaje Pentekosti Kiliziya Insengero n’Imisigiti bifunze kubera Coronavirus, ntibikwiye ko twakwibagirwa uwo munsi w’Imana, mu rugo iwacu Roho Mutagatifu arahadusanga. Bavandimwe hariho irema rya buri munsi , Roho w’Imana ahora arema kandi agatanga ubugingo. Umwuka wera/Roho Mutagatifu ni ubuzima. Umwuka ni ikigereranyo rusange cy’Imana n’ibikorwa byayo mu bantu. Ikiriho cyose gihumeka kifitemo ubuzima. Ni ishusho igaragara y’Imana itugabira ubuzima ! Ubwo buzima butangirira muri Batisimu bukuzurizwa mu Butatu Butagatifu. Yezu na we yagiye akoresha icyo kigereranyo gifatika cy’umuyaga, kugira ngo yumvishe Nikodemu (natwe twese) igikorwa gishya gihebuje cy’Uwitwa Umwuka w’Imana, ari we Roho w’Imana (Yh 3, 5-8). Roho w’Imana twasezeranyijwe  Roho Mutagatifu Yezu ubwe yagiye amuvuga ku buryo bwinshi. Hari aho yamwise umuvugizi, bisobanura « Ubana na twe », ahandi amwita Umurengezi (Yh 14,16.). Ubusanzwe iryo zina ‘Umuvugizi’ risobanurwa ko ari Umuhoza, kuko Yezu ari we Muhoza w’ibanze. Ni Roho Nyir’ukuri (Yh 16, 13). Ni we uyobora ku kuri kose, kuko atavuga yitumirije ahubwo avuga ibyo yumvise byose, kandi akaduhanurira n’ibizaza. Uwo Roho asesekara kuri buri wese akurikije icyo amukeneyeho ariko byose akabyuzuriza muri Kiliziya ye, ariyo Pawulo yita umubiri umwe. Pawulo ati « Umubiri ni umwe kandi ugizwe n’ingingo nyinshi ariko izo ngingo zose n’ubwo ari nyinshi zigize umubiri umwe» (1Kor1,12). Abantu ni magirirane, baruzuzanya mu ngabire buri wese afite. Kristu niwe waduhurije hamwe mu rukundo n’amahoro bimwe isi idatanga. Bwa bumwe abantu batereye i Babeli (Ing11,1-10) bwaragarutse, bose bakumva kimwe (Intu 2,8-11), maze biba incamarenga y’ubutumwa Yezu yahaye intumwa ze bwo kwigisha amahanga yose. (Yh20, 21-22). Ubwo bumwe twese nibwo duhamagariwe kugaragaza ; kuko twabatirijwe muri Roho umwe ngo tube umubiri umwe (1Kor12,13). Nk’uko Data yantumye, nanjye ndabatumye (Yh20, 21) Muntu nk’ ikiremwa cy’Imana kidasanzwe kiri hagati y’ibindi biremwa, yagiye agaragaza ko abisumbye ndetse akajya abikoresha icyo ashaka , ibi byaje kugera ubwo na we yicamo ibice ; hazamo agasuzuguro kuri bamwe, ubwikunde n’ubwikanyize maze yubaka umunara w’itandukaniro rye n’abo batari mu rwego rumwe. N’ubwo isi yacu ishaka kuducamo ibice, Yezu We ashaka ko tuba umwe. Yaba abayahudi cyangwa se Abagereki, yaba abacakara cyangwa se abigenga yaba abazungu, abarabu cyangwa se abirabura, twese twuhiwe Roho umwe (1Kor 12,13).
Uyu munsi tuributswa ko nubwo umubiri ugizwe n’ingingo nyinshi, zose zigize umuntu umwe. Mu yandi magambo ni nk’aho twakwibutswa ko n’ubwo dutandukanye yaba ku ruhu, mu bwenge, mu bukungu,… ariko twese turi abantu.
Twese rero duhamagariwe kubahana, ntihakagire ugenera mugenzi we uko abaho. Twese turi abantu, twese tuva amaraso y’umutuku, twese turapfa, twese tugaragaza amarangamutima, twese icyorezo cya Coronavirus cyaradukanze. Yezu arashaka ko dusubira ku isoko y’ubumwe, urukundo n’amahoro. Buri wese ahamagariwe kubyamamaza, ni ubutumwa ahawe. Dusenge: Roho Mutagatifu, Nyagasani utanga ubugingo, uturuka ku Mana Data na Mwana, usengwa agasingizwa hamwe n’Imana Data na Mwana, We wabwirije abahanuzi ibyo bavuze, nakomeze atuyobore, atwumvishe natwe ubumwe dufitanye nk’abantu twaremwe n’Imana imwe, bityo imbuto z’ubwo bumwe: urukundo, ibyishimo, amahoro, kwihangana, ubugwaneza, ubuntu, ubudahemuka, imico myiza no kumenya kwifata biganze iwacu.(Gal5,22. Roho mutagatifu natuyobore. Amena. Padiri Silivani SEBACUMI

title: Umunya-Canada uririmba indirimbo zihimbaza Imana yatunguranye avuga ko atayizera
content: Mu butumwa burebure uyu muririmbyi yasangije abamukurikira kuri Instagram yagaragaje atari umwe mu bizera Imana. Ati “Maze igihe kinini nterwa ubwoba no kubasangiza ibi ariko ubu ndiyumvamo ko ari cyo gihe cyiza kuri njye kuba navugisha ukuri. Ndizera ko iri atari iherezo ry’ikiganiro ahubwo ari intangiriro.” Yakomeje avuga ko kuba yarakuriye mu muryango usenga, akaba umwana w’umupasiteri agacuranga ndetse akaba n’umuririmbyi muri band ya gikirisitu akanitwa umukirisitu mu bintu byinshi yagiye anyuramo mu buzima bwe yaje gusanga ‘ubu atacyizerera mu Mana’. Arongera ati “Amagambo aheruka make mu nteruro yari akomeye kuyandika, nashakaga no koroshya iyi nyandiko nkabyandika bitandukanye n’uko nabikoze ariko ntabwo byari kuba ukuri nk’uko bimeze gutya.” Uyu muhanzi ntabwo yigeze avuga niba ateganya kureka kuririmba indirimbo zihimbaza Imana. Steingard yari amaze igihe kinini atekereza uburyo azabyandikamo. Ngo yatangiye ashidikanya we ubwe aza kubiganiriza inshuti ze za hafi. Yaje gutungurwa no gusanga hari abandi bakuriye mu nsengero nkawe batinya kubivuga kubera ko babura buri kimwe. Abo basanzwe babana muri band bamushyigikiye bavuga ko intego yabo ari ugufasha abantu no kubatera imbaraga mu byo bakora mu kuri kuko Imana iri kumwe nabo kandi iri mu ruhande rwabo. Hawk Nelson, itsinda Jonathan Steingard abarizwamo rigizwe n’abasore batanu [Daniel Biro, Jonathan Steingard, Micah Kuiper na David Niacaris]. Ni rimwe mu matsinda akomeye aramya Imana mu buryo bw’injyana ya rock na pop punk. Ryashingiye mu Mujyi wa Peterborough, Ontario. Rimaze gukora album umunani.  I’ve been terrified to post this for a while - but it feels like it’s time for me to be honest. I hope this is not the end of the conversation, but the beginning. I hope this is encouraging to people who might feel the same but are as afraid to speak as I am. I want to be open. I want to be transparent with you all - and also open to having my heart changed in the future. I am not looking for a debate at all - just a chance to share my story in the hopes some good can come from it. I love you all. title: Yavutse ku witeguraga kuba Umubikira: Ubuhamya butangaje bwa Ev. Tuyishimire wo muri ADEPR
content: Ubusanzwe yitwa Ev.Tuyishimire Diogène. Mu byigisho bye, icyamamaye ni icyo aba avugamo ukuntu Yesu nta kintu adasa nacyo kuko ‘Mu bana yabaye umwana w’Imana, mu bagabo akaba umugabo w’abapfakazi, mu bapapa aba se w’imfubyi, mu biti akavuga ati ninjye muzabibu w’ukuri mwe muri amashami…’ Umurebye mu maso ntiwamukekera ko yakwigisha mu buryo bukomeye ariko we ahamya ko ari imirimo yakoze kugira ngo agarure benshi mu nzira y’agakiza. Uyu mugabo w’imyaka 27, ni umuvugabutumwa mu itorero rya ADEPR. Yatangiye no gukora umuziki aho yamaze kwinjira mu njyana ya Hip hop. Akurondoreye iby’urugendo rw’ubuzima ab’imitima yoroshye amarira arashoka bitewe n’uko yakubititse akiri muto ntabashe kwiga amashuri yisumbuye kubera ubuzima bugoye n’ubushobozi buke, ariko ubu ashima Imana aho igejeje ikora! Mu buhamya bwe ntajya yibagirwa kugaragaza uko yari umusinzi unakora inzoga z’inkorano ndetse n’uburyo nyina umubyara yamusamye mu gihe yigiraga kuba umubikira. Yakuriye kwa nyina wabo kuko nyina yamutaye akajya kwishakira undi mugabo. Mu kiganiro cyihariye na IGIHE yavuye imuzi iby’ubuzima bwe. Ati “Ubundi mama wanjye yigiraga kuba umubikira, yaje guhura n’umusore amutera inda rero birangira havutse njye. Icyakora ntabwo yandeze kuko we yahise ashaka undi mugabo kandi ntabwo twari kubana. Ibi byatumye nkura nderwa na mama wacu muto ku mubyeyi wanjye.” Ahamya ko yakuriye mu muryango w’abantu bakora inzoga z’inkorano, byatumye ku myaka icyenda gusa atangira kunywa inzoga. Akurira mu buzima bwo gucuruza no gukora izo nzoga. Arangije amashuri abanza ntabwo yabonye uko akomeza ayisumbuye kuko nta bushobozi bwari buhari, ati” Nyine ishuri narivuyemo mpita ninjira mu byo gukora inzoga kuko nibyo mu rugo bakoraga.” Ubu buzima yabubayemo ariko akunda umuziki, biza kumuviramo gushaka gukora indirimbo za mbere nubwo bitamuhiriye. Ati “Numvaga naba umukinnyi wa APR FC cyangwa nkaba umuhanzi wa Hip Hop nari umufana ukomeye wa Riderman.” Yavuye iwabo ababeshye ko agiye gukora umuziki, naho agiye gucuruza inzoga z’inkorano mu Karere ka Musanze aza guhomba bikomeye. Ubwo yari amaze guhomba mu by’inzoga z’inkorano yacuruzaga, Ev. Tuyishimire yisanze asigaranye amafaranga make cyane nyamara yaramaze gutoroka kwa nyina wabo. Inzoga zari zahombye abona ubuzima bwanze afata icyemezo cyo kwiyahura ndetse aranabigerageza Imana ikinga akaboko. Ati “Narahombye bikomeye numva ubuzima burarangiye, nahisemo kwiyahura icyo gihe ngura inzoga nyinshi ngo niyahure nasinze, naguze ikinini cy’imbeba nsinda ntiyahuye birangira ndyamye, ariko nkajya numva ko ndi bwiyahure mu gitondo. Bukeye hari ikiganiro cyacaga kuri Radio Flash Fm cyakorwaga na Pasiteri Ntambara. Icyo gihe yavuze ijambo ryatumye mpindura umugambi wo kwiyahura.” Tuyishimire avuga Pasiteri Ntambara yigishije avuga ko hari umwana ugiye kwiyahura kandi naramuka abiretse azaba umuntu ukomeye w’umugabo. Umugambi we uhita upfuba binyuze kuri uyu mukozi w’Imana. Ati “Igitekerezo cyo kwiyahura cyahise kimvamo gutyo nyuma njya kureba mama wanjye wabaga mu Bugesera.” Ageze mu Bugesera yasanze umubyeyi we azi ko umwana we yabuze, icyakora kuko ubuzima butari bwiza ntabwo yahatinze ahubwo yagiye gushakisha uko yabaho. Iki gihe yakoze muri restaurant, aha ni naho yatangiye gukora ibikorwa byo kwigisha ijambo ry’Imana ahereye ku hantu basengeraga. Akora muri iyi restaurant yo mu Bugesera nibwo Ev. Tuyishimire yatangiye kujya ajya gusengana n’abantu bari baturanye akarara aho basengeraga. Abo basenganaga bakundaga uko yigisha anasoma ijambo ry’Imana umugabo umwe basenganaga aza kumusaba ko yazajya kubwiriza muri ADEPR i Huye. Kuva icyo gihe yahise atangira kuba umuvugabutumwa wo mu itorero rya ADEPR atangira gutumirwa cyane mu materaniro anyuranye. Mu 2016 umugabo basenganaga yamusabye ko yamurera akava aho basengeraga bakajya babana nk’umwana na Se. Nyuma uyu mugabo yaje kwiyemeza kumwubakira inzu birangira mu 2018 akoze ubukwe aza kurushinga n’umwe mu bakirisitu bo mu itorero rya ADEPR. Yerekeje amaso ku muziki Kuva mu bwana bwe yakundaga umuziki by’umwihariko injyana ya Hip Hop, ibi byatumye uyu mugabo kuri ubu yumva yawukora ndetse indirimbo ya mbere ye ikaba igomba kujya hanze mu minsi ya vuba. Ati “Nubwo nakora iyi yonyine ngahita ndekera aho, inzozi zanjye zaba zibaye impamo kuko mpfuye ntaririmbye nagendana agahinda kuko nabikunze kuva cyera.” Avuga ko yari kuba yarabikoze cyera ariko agira ubwoba bw’ukuntu abo basengana bazabifata ahitamo kubigendamo gake. Iyi ndirimbo ye yitegura gusohora yitwa “Mfite ubwoba” yakozwe na Trackslayer, izaba ikubiyemo ubutumwa bw’ubuzima busanzwe ariko nanone buganisha ku Mana. Ikiganiro na Ev.Tuyishimire winjiye mu njyana ya Hip hop

title: Bizibukwa mu mateka! Isengesho rya Eid al-Fitr ryabereye kuri Televiziyo y’Igihugu
content: Byari bisanzwe bimenyerewe ko isengesho rusange ryo kwizihiza Eid al-Fitr ribera kuri Stade ya Kigali i Nyamirambo no mu tundi duce two hirya no hino mu gihugu. Warangwaga no kubona urujya n’uruza rw’Abayisilamu bambaye amakanzu y’urwererane, ubabona bose bafite akanyamuneza ku maso, basuhuzanya ubutitsa indamukanyo yifurizanya Eid el-Fitr nziza bagira bati “Eid Mubarak”. Kuri iyi nshuro uyu munsi iri sengesho ryizihirijwe kuri Televiziyo na Radio by’Igihugu, kubera ingamba zafashwe mu guhangana n’ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus. Isengesho ryo kuri uyu wa 24 Gicurasi 2020 ryayobowe na Mufti w’u Rwanda, Sheikh Hitimana Salim. Abayoboke b’Idini ya Islam bakaba barikurikiye bari mu ngo zabo kuko batashoboraga kujya mu misigiti kuko amakoraniro y’abantu benshi atemewe. Mu butumwa bwe, Sheikh Hitimana yikije ku kwimakaza ubucuti hagati y’Abayisilamu na bagenzi babo. Yanabibukije ko bakwiye kubahiriza ingamba zashyizweho na Guverinoma hagamijwe gukomeza kwirinda Coronavirus, anabasabira kugira ubuzima bwiza. Isengesho ryanyuze ku bitangazamakuru by’igihugu ryishimiwe cyane ndetse bamwe bagaragaza ko ari intambwe ikomeye yatewe bitandukanye n’uko byakorwaga hambere. Abinyujije ku rukuta rwe rwa Twitter, Abdul K. Harelimana, uri mu bagize Urwego Ngishwanama n’Inararibonye z’u Rwanda, REAF, yavuze ko “Ntibyigeze bibaho kuri Repubulika ya Mbere n’iya Kabiri guha agaciro Umunsi wa Iddi. Ni nkaho ntacyabaga cyabaye. Ntibyashyirwaga mu itangazamakuru rya Leta. Ni ishimwe ku Rwanda rushya kuko kuva mu 1994, isengesho ryerekanwa mu buryo bw’ako kanya.’’ Eid al-Fitr ni umunsi uba ari ikiruhuko ku bakozi bose mu Rwanda, inshuti n’abavandimwe bakishimana n’abayisilamu kuri uwo munsi mukuru. Igisibo ni rimwe mu mahame atanu ya Islam risaba abayoboke baryo kwigomwa amafunguro, ibinyobwa mu bihe bisanzwe n’ibindi bibashimisha bakarangamira Imana. title: Ese koko abantu bake nibo bazinjira mu ngoma y’ijuru?
content: Mbere y’uko agenda yasize abasezeranyije kuzaboherereza Roho Mutagatifu, uzabafasha muri uru rugendo. Nuko arababwira ati “Namwe rero muzambere abagabo kuko twabanye kuva mu ntangiriro” (Yh 15, 26-27). Kuva na kera Imana yagiye igendana n’abayo ngo bazaronke umukiro w’iteka. Uhoraho abwira umuryango we ati“ Dore nzohereza umumalayika wanjye imbere yawe, kugira ngo akurinde mu rugendo, maze azakwinjize mu gihugu naguteguriye” (Iyim 23, 20-21). Uwo Malayika w’Imana niwe ukuza ingabire za Roho Mutagatifu muri twe, zituma tumenya gutandukanya ikibi n’’icyiza. Gukora icyiza cyonyine ni yo nzira nyayo izatugeza mu ijuru. Ni inzira itoroshye kuko kuyisoza ari ubutwari. Ijambo ry’Imana rigira riti “Nimwihatire kwinjira mu muryango ufunganye, kuko umuryango wagutse n’inzira y’igihogere ari byo bijyana mu cyorezo, kandi abahanyura ni benshi. Mbega ukuntu umuryango ugana mu bugingo ufunganye, n’inzira ijyayo ikaba impatanwa, maze bikabonwa na bake” (Mt 7, 13-14). Erega ijuru si “ahantu” ahubwo ni “ukuntu”. Ijuru ni ukuntu tuzabana n’Imana mu munezero Udakama. Ab’Imana ijuru baritangirira hano ku isi. Bamwe bati“Twaremewe kuzajya mu ijuru, niho twese tuzishima iteka” ! Abandi bati: “umubare w’abagomba kujya mu ijuru waruzuye ni 144.000. Abandi turaruhira ubusa”! Abavuga gutya bashingira ku Ijambo ry’Imana dusanga mu gitabo cy’Ibyahishuriwe Yohani Intumwa, ahanditse ngo “Nuko numva umubare w’abashyizweho ikimenyetso: abantu ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ine na bine bo mu miryango yose y’Abayisiraheli” (Hish 7, 4).  Igisobanuro cy’umubare 144.000 Tugendeye kuri Bibiliya, nk’uko twabisomye haruguru, uyu mubare ushushanya abagaragu b’Imana bashyizweho ikimenyetso ku gahanga. Bakaba bahagarariye imiryango yose ya Isiraheli (umuryango mugari w’abana b’Imana): Isiraheli igizwe n’imiryango 12 yo mu Isezerano rya Kera n’imiryango 12 yo mu isezerano Rishya, ihagarariwe n’Intumwa 12 za Yezu. Nkuko tubisanga henshi muri Bibiliya, iyo bashaka kuvuga abantu benshi baravuga ngo “Abantu igihumbi n’ibihumbagiza”! Niyo mpamvu ku buryo buhinnye umubare 144.000 wavuye aha: (12x12) x 1000 = 144.000. Ibi kandi bigashimangirwa n’ibyo benshi birengagiza gusoma nkana ku murongo wa cyenda, ahanditse ngo “Nyuma y’ibyo, mbona imbaga nyamwinshi y’abantu, umuntu atabashaga kubarura, iturutse mu mahanga yose, mu miryango yose, mu bihugu byose no mu ndimi zose. Bari bahagaze imbere y’ubwami n’imbere ya Ntama, bambaye amakanzu yererana kandi bafashe imikindo mu ntoki ” (Hish 7, 9-10). N’ubwo abantu bazaronka ijuru ari benshi, ijuru riraharanirwa nk’uko twabibonye mu ntangiriro. Bityo rizinjiramo abazaba bararikoreye, barangwa n’ibikorwa byiza n’imirimo yo gukiranuka. Iki gihe turimo cyo guhangana n’ibyorezo bitandukanye, kitubere akanya keza ko kwitagatifuza ngo natwe tuzabarirwe muri abo bazinjira mu bwami bw’ijuru. Baba bake cyangwa benshi, duharanire kuzabarirwa muri bo. Igihembo cy’abeza Ababaye kuri iyi si neza, bakera imbuto nziza kandi nyinshi igihembo cyabo kirateguwe: Nyagasani azababwira ati “Nimuze abahawe umugisha na Data, muhabwe Ingoma mwateguriwe kuva isi ikiremwa” (Mt 25, 34). Maze bahabwe ubugingo bw’iteka. Nyagasani azahanagura icyitwa amarira cyose ku maso yabo. Nk’uko Ijambo ry’Imana ribihamya: Abazaba indahemuka kugeza ku ndunduro, Uhoraho azabambika ikamba ry’ubugingo (reba Hish 2, 10). Kumvira amategeko y’Imana ni byo bizadukiza, ariko twiringire impuhwe z’Imana kuko n’ubundi ibikorwa byacu bitihagije. Nta wajya aho ngo avuge ko ibikorwa bye byonyine bihagije ngo azaronke ubugingo bw’iteka. Icy’ingenzi ni ukugira ukwemera ukwizera n’urukundo bishingiye ku kubana n’Imana igihe cyose. Pawulo Mutagatifu ati “Bavandimwe muri Kristu Yezu, ndabinginze nimureke Imana ibigarurire” (2 Kor 5, 17-21). Mva imbere sinakumenye Igihe Yezu yanyuraga mu nsisiro yigisha yerekeza i Yeruzalemu, haje umuntu aramubaza ati “Mwigisha, koko abantu bake ni bo bazarokoka”? Nuko aramusubiza ati “Muharanire kwinjira mu muryango ufunganye; ndabibabwiye: benshi bazagerageza kwinjira, ariko boye kubishobora” (Lk 13, 22-24). Ngo abatarakiranutse ku isi bazakomanga bati “Shobuja, dukingurire, azabasubize ati: Sinzi iyo muturutse, nimumve imbere sinabamenye”. Bati: “Koko ntabwo utuzi! N’ukuntu twaririye kandi tukanywera imbere yawe, twitabiriye amasengesho n’amateraniro kenshi! Ndetse twigishije Ijambo ry’Imana mu izina ryawe! Kandi twafashaga abakene uko bitegetswe” (reba Lk 13, 25-28). Nyamara uko dutakamba kube imfabusa kuko n’ubwo bibwira ko bakoze neza mu maso y’abantu, bitigeze binyura Imana. Nyagasani, uzandinde iri jambo ngo: “Mva imbere sinakumenye”! Isi izashira ryari? Hari benshi birirwa bashyushya abantu imitwe ngo: “ibi byorezo kanaka yarabihanuye! Ngo isi irarangiye”! Ijambo ry’Imana riravuga riti “ Si mwe mugenewe kumenya ibihe n’amagingo Data yageneye ubutegetsi bwe bwite, ahubwo mugiye guhabwa imbaraga za Roho Mutagatifu uzabazamo, bityo muzambere abahamya hose kuko muzahabwa Roho ubamara ubwoba (reba Intu 1, 7-8; ....). Ubwo abigishwa babazaga Yezu igihe isi izashirira, maze Imana igakora umurimo wayo wo guca imanza, yarabasubije ngo: “Uwo munsi cyangwa iyo saha, nta we ubizi, habe n’abamalayika habe ndetse na Mwana; bizwi n’Imana Data wenyine. Mwe rero, nimwitonde kandi mube maso, kuko mutazi igihe bizabera” (Mk 13, 32-33).  Bavandimwe, ni byo koko isi izashira, ariko gusesengura iby’uko bizagenda tubiharire Imana kuko nta wasobanura ibikorwa byayo byose: “Nasanze ibyo yaremye byose biberanye n’igihe cyabyo; yahaye abantu kumenya ibyahise n’ibizaza, ariko badashobora gusesengura ibikorwa by’Imana byose uko bingana” (Umubw 3,11). Tube maso kandi duhore twiteguye. Dushakishe ubutungane mu gukora ibyiza bityo tuzaronke ubugingo bw’iteka, aho kubushakira mu nyigisho z’iterabwoba zishobora kuturangaza, tukazaburira aho abandi baronkeye (reba Sir 28, 6-7). Dusenge: Nyagasani Mana, turi mu bihe bikomeye byo kwiheba no gucika intege, ibihe byo guhangana n’ingaruka z’ibyorezo bikomeye, turakwinginze bana natwe. Wadusezeranyije kugendana natwe kandi utwoherereza Roho Mutagatifu ngo adutoze gukora ugushaka kwawe maze natwe tuzabarirwe mu bo wagize abawe. Kuri wa munsi w’urubanza uzaturinde iri jambo ngo: “Nimumve imbere sinabamenye”! Turashaka kukumenya kurushaho ngo natwe uzatwibuke, maze utugabire ubugingo bw’iteka ukurikije n’ubundi impuhwe usanzwe utugirira. Ku bwa Yezu Kristu umwami wacu, wazutse mu bapfuye maze igihe kigeze agasubira mu ijuru ngo ajye kudutegurira imyanya iwawe Dawe. Amen Padiri Victor AMERIKA

title: Igisibo cy’Ukwezi kwa Ramadhan kizasozwa ku Cyumweru
content: Itangazo ryashyizweho umukono na Mufti w’u Rwanda, Sheikh Salim Hitimana, rimenyesha Abayisilamu ko isengesho ry’uwo Munsi Mukuru wa Iddil-El Fitri bazarikurikirana kuri Televiziyo y’u Rwanda guhera saa Moya kugeza saa Mbili za mu gitondo. Ibyo bikaba bisobanuye ko isengesho rizabera mu ngo kubera kwirinda ikwirakwira rya COVID-19 iterwa na Coronavirus nk’uko RMC yabishimangiye. Itangazo rigira riti “Ubuyobozi buboneyeho umwanya wo kumenyesha Abayisilamu ko mu rwego rwo kwirinda icyorezo cya COVID -19 amasengesho bazayakorera mu ngo zabo n’imiryango yabo.” Ubusanzwe mu bihugu byinshi Umunsi wa Eid al-Fitr wizihizwaga byihariye n’Abayisilamu aho babyukira mu masengesho mu misigiti, agakurikirwa n’ibirori bihuza Abayisilamu n’abandi baba batumiye bishimira ko barangije igisibo gitagatifu amahoro. Ibyo byose uyu mwaka ntibizakorwa uko byari bisanzwe kubera ingamba zashyizweho hirya no hino ku Isi zo guhangana na Coronavirus. Muri rusange Igisibo nacyo cyakozwe mu buryo budasanzwe kubera ibihe bidasanzwe. Ibyakorerwaga mu misigiti, byakorewe mu ngo, uretse gutora Adhana byakomeje nk’ibisanzwe mu kwibutsa Abayisilamu isaha yo gusenga. Ku Cyumweru azaba ari tariki 24 Gicurasi 2020 ku Ndangaminsi isanzwe, naho ku ya Islam izaba ari tariki ya 1 Ukwakira [bita Shawwar] umwaka wa 1441.

title: Imana ntizatubaza gusa 1/10, izanatubaza uko dukoresha ayo dusigarana-Bishop Dr. Masengo Fidèle
content: Ni ubutumwa yatanze ubwo itorero abereye umuyobozi ryashyikirizwaga inyubako nshya y’urusengero rwubatswe mu nkunga yakusanyijwe n’abakirisitu. Mu gihe hari imyiteguro yo kwinjira muri iyo nyubako nshya, nibwo mu Rwanda habonetse umurwayi wa mbere bikurikirwa na gahunda yo kuguma mu rugo mu kwirinda ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus. Dr. Bishop Masengo Fidèle yavuze ko mu gihe biteguraga kugaruka mu nyubako yavuguruwe aribwo igihugu cyagiye mu bihe bya Gum mu rugo. Yagize ati “Byatumye imirimo ijyanye n’inyubako nayo iba ihagaze ariko yendaga kugera ku musozo. Aho rero bafunguriye imirimo imwe n’imwe, natwe iy’inyubako yarakomeje.’’ Yashimye abayoboke b’Itorero rya Foursquare Gospel Church, Paruwasi ya Kimironko, batanze ubutunzi bwabo kugira ngo inyubako y’itorero yubakwe. Yagize ati “Imana ntizatubaza gusa icyacumi [1/10], izanatubaza uko dukoresha 9/10 dusigarana. Turashimira Imana yadufashije gukora umurimo wayo, umuntu wese witanze kugira ngo ibi bikorwa bigerweho.’’ Yashimye Leta y’u Rwanda itarahwemye gushyigikira iterambere ry’amadini n’amatorero mu Rwanda. Dr. Bishop Masengo Fidèle yavuze ko bishimishije kuba icyorezo cya COVID-19 giterwa na Coronavirus kigenda kigabanuka mu gihugu. Inyubako y’urusengero rwa Foursquare Gospel Church yubatswe na Sosiyete ECOMEM, yatsindiye isoko nyuma yo gupiganwa. Dr. Bishop Masengo Fidèle yavuze ko ari icyemezo cyafashwe mu gukuraho urujijo ku micungire y’umutungo w’itorero. Yagize ati “Mu bisanzwe abantu benshi bubaka insengero ntibakunze gukoresha sosiyete ariko twe twahisemo gukoresha ubu buryo kugira ngo tugere ku bintu byiza kandi biciye mu mucyo.’’ Mu butumwa bwe, Dr. Bishop Masengo Fidèle, yasabye abanyetorero gukomeza kwinginga Imana kugira ngo COVID-19 yugarije Isi irangire bityo inyubako zikoreshwe icyo zagenewe . Biteganyijwe ko inyubako nshya y’urusengero yazamuranywe n’iyi shuri, bizatahwa mu gihe Coronavirus izaba yatanze agahenge. FGR ikorera mu Rwanda kuva mu mwaka wa 2005, icyicaro gikuru kiri ku Kimironko mu Karere ka Gasabo. Rifite amatorero arenga 40 hirya no hino mu gihugu. Inyubako yaryo nshya yuzuye itwaye miliyoni zisaga 400 Frw. Yatangiye kubakwa mu Ukwakira 2019.

title: Paul Hagayi wari umaze imyaka ibiri atuje yasohoye indirimbo yise “Negamiye Imana”
content: Paul Hagayi ni umuramyi, umwanditsi w’indirimbo, akaba anazitunganya (Producer). Indirimbo ye nshya yasohokanye n’amashusho yayo iri mu zizaba zigize album ya kabiri ari gukoraho. “Negamiye Imana” ni indirimbo irimo ubutumwa buvuga ko mu byo abantu bakora n’ibyo banyuramo bakwiye kwizera Imana. Paul Hagayi yavuze ko mu kuyikora yahamyaga ko ubuzima bwose bushingiye ku Mana yonyine kandi ko umurimo abantu bakora ariyo yonyine izawusohoza. Igitekerezo cyo kuyandika yakigize ubwo yari mu bibazo asa n’uwaburiye ibisubizo. Yubakiye ku magambo menshi aboneka muri Bibiliya mu bitabo bitandukanye. Yakomeje ati “Indirimbo nayanditse ndimo nibaza ibibazo byinshi naburiye igisubizo, hahandi uba wumva hari intambara nyinshi urimo kurwana mu buryo bw’intekerezo aho rero ni ho Imana yanganirije mu ijambo ryayo dusanga muri Yeremiya 1:5 (Nakumenye ntarakurema kandi nakwejeje utaravuka).’’ "Numvise ngize imbaraga mu bugingo bwanjye, numva nsubijwe n’ibyo bibazo byose nibazaga muri njye. Icyo gihe nahise mfata gitari na telefoni ntangira kwandika indirimbo gutyo.’’ Paul Hagayi yavukiye mu muryango ukijijwe, se ni Pasiteri mu Itorero rya ADEPR. Yavuye mu Rwanda mu 2013, aho yasengeraga muri ADEPR, Umudugudu wa Bugunga muri Gicumbi. Uyu mugabo kuri ubu abarizwa mu Itorero rya Power of Prayer Church mu Buholandi, aho ari umwe mu baramyi bakuru mu itorero. Paul Hagayi yatangiriye umuziki mu matsinda atandukanye. Mu 2014 ni bwo yinjiye muri studio gukora indirimbo ze wenyine za mbere mu Buholandi. Mu rugendo rwe rwa muzika, amaze gusohora album imwe yise ‘‘Nta rindi zina’’. Ari gukora album ye ya kabiri ndetse afite intego yo gukomeza kwamamaza ubutumwa bwiza kugera ku mpera z’Isi yose. Hagayi avuga ko bitoroshye ariko Imana izamushoboza. Ati “Hano muri ibi bihugu usanga ikoranabuhanga ryaratumye abantu ubwabo biyizera, bibagirwa Imana. Nubwo bimeze bityo haracyari abakizwa kandi bashikamye ku byo bizeye.’’ Paul Hagayi wari umaze igihe kirekire ataboneka mu muziki, muri Nyakanga 2019 nibwo yarushinze na Bakunda Odette mu birori byabereye mu Buholandi.  	Reba indirimbo ‘‘Negamiye Imana’’ ya Paul Hagayi

title: Byemejwe ko Ilayidi izizihirizwa mu ngo, Abayisilamu bahabwa umurongo bazakurikiza
content: Gusoza ukwezi ko kwiyiriza no gusenga ku bayisilamu biteganyijwe ku mboneko z’ukwezi, ku wa Gatandatu tariki 23 Gicurasi 2020 cyangwa ku Cyumweru tariki 24 Gicurasi. Ubusanzwe mu bihugu byinshi umunsi wa Eid al-Fitr wizihizwaga byihariye n’abayisilamu aho babyukira mu masengesho ya mu gitondo, bagakurikizaho inyigisho bafatira hamwe. Akenshi ayo masengehso abera mu misigiti n’ahandi hashobora guhurira abantu benshi. Nyuma abantu bishimira ko barangije igisibo gitagatifu amahoro, bagasura inshuti n’abavandimwe basangira ari nako bafasha abakene. Ni umunsi witegurwa cyane mu bayisilamu haba ku mafunguro bateka, imyambaro, ibyo barya ndetse hari ibihugu bashyira n’imitako ku mihanda. Ibyo byose uyu mwaka ntibizakorwa uko byari bisanzwe kubera ingamba zashyizweho hirya no hino ku isi zo guhangana na coronavirus. Itangazo ryashyizwe hanze n’Ubuyobozi bw’Umuryango w’Abayisilamu mu Rwanda, rivuga ko Eid al-Fitr izakorerwa mu rugo uyu mwaka. Bugira buti “Iswala ya Eid al-Fitr 2020 izakorerwa mu rugo, abagize buri rugo bazishyira hamwe bakore iswala yonyine nta nyigisho zibayeho. Umuntu uba wenyine na we akora Iswala y’Iyaliyidi ari wenyine.” Guverinoma y’u Rwanda guhera muri Werurwe uyu mwaka yahagaritse ibikorwa bihuza abantu benshi birimo insengero n’ibitaramo, hirindwa coronavirus. RMC yasabye abayisilamu ko mbere yo gukora isengesho ryo ku munsi wa Eid al-Fitr, bazabanza kwiyuhagira umubiri wose, kwambara neza, gutegura aho gusengera no kwisiga imibavu ihumura. Gutanga ituro ry’ukwezi gutagatifu kwa Ramadan (Zackatul Fitri) bizakorwa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga rya telefone. Mu minsi ishize umujyanama wa Mufti w’u Rwanda, Sheikh Mbarushimana Suleiman yavuze ko ari ubwa mbere bibayeho ko igisibo cya Ramadan kiba mu buryo bwihariye. Icyakora, yavuze ko hari amabwiriza Intumwa y’Imana Muhamad yigeze gutanga ubwo habonekaga icyorezo mu bice birimo Ethiopia y’ubu. Ati “Hari inyigisho ihari muri Islam ivuga ko no ku gihe cy’Intumwa y’Imana byigeze kubaho ibihe by’ibyorezo. Hari habayeho icyorezo, bimenyekana ko aho hari uburwayi bw’icyorezo kandi harabagaho kugenderana, ababaga batuye i Maka baragendaga kajya muri Afurika y’amajyaruguru. Intumwa y’Imana irababuza, itanga umurongo w’uko mu gihe ahantu hari icyorezo nta muntu wemerewe kuba yajyayo ngo atandura.” Ku isi hose, abantu basaga miliyoni 4.8 bamaze kwandura coronavirus mu gihe abasaga ibihumbi 318 bamaze guhitanwa nayo.

title: Amafoto y’icyumweru: Kabuga yafatiwe i Paris, RBC yashyikirijwe ‘Casque’ zikingira abavura Coronavirus
content: Ubushinjacyaha bw’u Bufaransa bwemeje ko Kabuga yatawe muri yombi mu gitondo cyo ku wa Gatandatu. Ni inkuru yanditswe n’ibitangazamakuru byo mu Rwanda ndetse isamirwa hejuru n’ibikorera mu mahanga. Félicien Kabuga w’imyaka 84 afatwa nk’uwabaye umuterankunga ukomeye wa Jenoside, aho mu Ugushyingo 1993, icyo gihe Sosiyete ye Kabuga yinjije mu gihugu toni 25 z’imihoro ivuye mu Bushinwa, nyuma muri Werurwe 1994 agura indi mihoro ibihumbi 50. Ni intwaro zakoreshejwe mu kwica Abatutsi muri Jenoside. Uretse ibyo ashinjwa ko ari n’umwe mu banyamigabane bashinze radio RTLM, yagize uruhare rukomeye mu kubiba urwango mbere no mu gihe cya Jenoside. Muri iki cyumweru kandi hanabayemo ibikorwa bitandukanye. Ku wa Gatatu, Urukiko rwa Gisirikare i Kanombe rwafashe umwanzuro wo gufunga mu gihe cy’iminsi 30 y’agateganyo abasirikare batanu n’umusivili umwe bakurikiranyweho ibyaha birimo gukoresha imibonano mpuzabitsina ku gahato abakobwa n’abagore bo mu Murenge wa Remera mu Kagari ka Kangondo II. Kuri uwo munsi kandi nibwo Uwizeye Vivine yasezerewe mu kigo kivura abanduye Coronavirus cya Kanyinya mu Mujyi wa Kigali, aho yari amaze igihe arwariye. Uyu mugore utuye mu Gatenga yanduye muri Mata ndetse byabanje kuvugwa ko yanduje Coronavirus abandi bantu benshi, abandi baranamubika kandi akiri muzima. Icyumweru kigana ku musozo kandi ku wa Gatandatu Perezida Paul Kagame yasuye ibice byo mu Ntara y’Iburengerazuba byagizweho ingaruka n’ibiza, agaragarizwa ibirimo gukorwa mu gusana ibyangijwe, kugira ngo ubuzima bw’abaturage bubashe gukomeza nk’ibisanzwe. IGIHE yakusanyije amafoto y’ingenzi yaranze ibikorwa binini muri iki cyumweru kigana ku musozo.

title: Uwasogongeye ku rukundo rwa Kristu ntashobora kuba imfubyi
content:
Icyadutandukanya n’urukundo rwe nicyo cyatugira imfubyi nta kindi uretse icyaha cyo cyatujyana mu rupfu. Niyo mpamvu rero dusabwa kumunambaho kugira ngo tutaba imfubyi.  Yezu ubwe yarivugiye ati “Unkunda azakundwa na Data, nanjye nzamukunda kandi nzamwiyereka” (Yh14,21b)  Bavandimwe, ubusanzwe amagambo “urukundo, gukunda, umukunzi, ndagukunda, gukundana” arakoreshwa cyane mu buzima bwacu. Ni amagambo afite uburemere bukomeye k’uyavuga cyangwa se uyabwirwa, iyo babikoze babikuye ku mutima nta buryarya. Ikigaragaza ko abantu bakundana by’ukuri ni iki? Aantu byitwa ko bakundana kuko buri wese yirekurira undi, ntacyo amuhisha kandi ngo burya abakundana bagenda basa ku buryo usanga n’amasura yabo agenda arushaho kwegerana.  Abakundana by’ukuri ntibahemukirana ahubwo buri wese aba yumva ntacyo ari cyo mu gihe atari kumwe n’umukunzi we. Bavandimwe, Yezu aduhishuriye ibanga rikomeye aho agira ati “Unkunda akundwa na Data, nanjye nzamukunda kandi nzamwiyereka”!(Yh14,21b). Mbega amagambo meza! Kubwirwa ko dukunzwe na Yezu, We ukunda by’ukuri bizira uburyarya. Abakundana bahana impano Mu rukundo habamo impano zinyuranye abakundana bahana kugira ngo barushimangire. Nta mpano isumba izindi rero itari iyo kwitangira uwo ukunda maze ukamwiha wese mu byago no mu byiza! Yezu Kristu yarabikoze, yaratwihaye, aradupfira, apfa mu cyimbo cyacu ngo twe dukire ndetse none atubwiye ko atazadusiga nk’imfubyi ko azagaruka adusange, ibi byose Yezu yabikoraga kubera Urukundo ,none turi guhimbaza Pasika nk’intsinzi ye ndetse n’iyacu kuko icyago gisumba ibindi aricyo “rupfu”, kitakidufiteho ububasha. Twakora iki? Nimucyo rero bavandimwe, natwe tugerageze kwitura Yezu urwo rukundo ruhebuje yadukunze. Nta kigoye adusaba, aradusaba gusa kumukunda. Azi intege nke zacu, aziko tutabasha kumukunda nk’uko yadukunze, ariko na none aziko dushobora kumukunda uko bikwiye ku rwego rwacu. Kumukunda biturinda ubwoba no gukangwa n’amagorwa y’ubuzima nk’uko twabyumvise mu rugero rwiza rw’abakristu ba mbere, bakoraga ibitangaza byinshi maze bagahorana ibyishimo bitewe na Roho Mutagatifu bari barakiriye. Nta kindi cyabakomezaga, ni urukundo bari bafitiye Yezu! Niduhumuke rero, kabone n’ubwo twe tutatotezwa tuzira Yezu, ariko hari byinshi bishobora kutujyana kure y’uruhanga rwe, tutabaye maso. Mureke twibaze iki kibazo! Ese koko nkunda Yezu? Ubu ndamutse mpuye na Yezu akambaza ati “Kanaka,Nyirakanaka, urankunda? Namusubiza ngo iki?”. Petero intumwa yabiduhayemo urugero; kuko kwemera Kristu no kumwubaha, biduha ubuzima bwa roho kandi bikaduha n’igisubizo ku mpagarara zacu zose, cyane cyane igisubizo cy’ urukundo tugomba Yezu. Ukunda Yezu koko yubaha amategeko ye. Amategeko adufasha kwisuzuma, kwisuzumisha, kuvurwa tugakira . Umwana utazakira akomerekera kure y’icyomoro Birakwiye rwose kugana Yezu no kumuhitamo, niwe Muganga w’ukuri, niwe twisuzumishaho, niwe uduha umuti nyawo, ni nawe ubwe umuti ukiza, niwe cyomoro. Niyo mpamvu rero amategeko tutagomba kuyafata nk’umuzigo.Nituyakunde ni yo azadufasha kumwereka ko tumukunda kuko n’ubundi itegeko riruta ayandi ni iry’URUKUNDO. Tumusabe aduhe kumwumva neza!  Akenshi twumva Yezu yakabaye wa wundi dutabaza gusa iyo twugarijwe maze akaza akadukiza uburwayi, akadukiza ibyorezo, ubukene, mbega wa wundi ukemura ibyananiranye. Nyamara ni Yezu utubuza gucumura maze akadusaba gukurikiza itegeko rye, ugasanga tudashaka no kumwumva! Bavandimwe, dufite amahirwe ko Yezu uduha isezerano rye atajya abeshya cyangwa ngo yisubireho. Aradukunda kandi icyo arusha abandi, ni uko n’iyo tumuhemukiye, akomeza kudukunda. Yatwijeje Roho Mutagatifu Umuhoza! Nitumutabaze rero kugira ngo aze atuvugurure, atuvane mu bwigunge n’ubupfubyi duterwa n’icyaha. Nibyo rwose uwasogongeye ku rukundo rwa Kristu akanamunambaho yirinda icyaha, ntashobora kuba imfubyi ahubwo asabwa n’ibyishimo bidakangwa n’amagorwa y’iyi si nka coronavirus cyangwa se ibiza biri gutwara ubuzima bw’abacu.  Yezu uyu munsi aje kuvanaho uburwayi butandukanye bwabangamiraga urukundo rwe n’abe: I. Kutamenya: Nayita indwara y’ubujiji bwo kutamenya amakuru ariho. Ngo icya mbere ni amakuru. Petero na Yohani bagiye biruka bajya guhinyuza amakuru y’ibyo kugeza icyo gihe bitaga impuha z’abagore. Ntibari bamenye ko Kristu ari muzima. N’uyu munsi hari benshi bataramenya ko Kristu ari muzima. II. Kutibuka: Ni indwara yo kwibagirwa yatumye Petero na Yohani bibagirwa kubara. Babwiwe kenshi kurusha abandi iby’izuka, ko azazuka ku munsi wa gatatu: Guma mu rugo kubera virusi yo gutinya abayahudi yabibagije kubara maze babwiwe ko Yezu yazutse basa n’abavuye mu bitotsi. Iyi ndwara ituma tutita ku byo Nyagasani yadusezeranyije. Uyu munsi aratubwira ati "Sinzabasiga muri imfubyi, nzagaruka mbasange".
Tumenye kandi dukunde gusoma Bibiliya yuzuyemo amasezerano Imana yatugiriye. Ese kuki utibuka ineza Nyagasani yakugiriye ukaba uriho nk’utaramenye Imana? Ukaba uriho bupfubyi? Kudasobanukirwa ni indwara yo kutamenya neza. Ku musozi Yezu amaze kwihindura ukundi yabwiye Petero, Yakobo na Yohani ati : "Ntimuzabivuge kugeza igihe umwana w’umuntu azazuka mu bapfuye". Bamanutse babazanya ngo "Ese kuzuka mu bapfuye bisobanura iki? " Ushobora kumenya, Ushobora kwibuka, ariko Ntusobanukirwe. Isuzume neza urebe uburwayi ufite maze wisuzumishe kwa Yezu akuvure ukire kuko uwo ukunda uramumenya, uwo ukunda ntumwibagirwa, uwo ukunda uba umusobanukiwe. Umwanzuro: Twebwe rero nitumenye, twibuke kandi dusobanukirwe ko Yezu adukunda kandi akaba adusaba kumukunda kuko biba byiza iyo ukunze nawe ugakundwa ariko bizira uburyarya.
Nitumukunda tuzaronka ibyiza byinshi: Tuzakira Roho Mutagatifu, ntazadusiga turi imfubyi ahubwo azagaruka adusange, Data azadukunda. Yezu nawe ubwe azadukunda kandi azatwiyereke. Ni byiza tubiharanire. Padiri Berthille Hategekimana /Paruwasi Mwezi/Diyosezi Cyangugu

title: U Rwanda rwashimiwe kuba igihugu cya mbere cyatanze gahunda ivuguruye ijyanye n’amasezerano y’i Paris
content: Amasezerano ya Paris, yemeranyijweho mu Ukuboza 2015, agena uburyo bwo gushyira mu bikorwa ingamba zitandukanye kugira ngo igipimo cy’ubushyuhe bw’Isi kigume munsi ya dogere celcius ebyiri, ariko intego ari ukugera munsi ya dogere 1.5. Ingingo ya Kane n’iya 13 z’ayo masezerano zivuga ko buri gihugu mu byashyize umukono kuri ayo masezerano gitanga raporo ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo mbere y’imyaka itanu mu rwego rw’ikurikiranabikorwa. Umuryango w’Abibumbye wasabye ibihugu gutanga gahunda zabyo ivuguruye muri uyu mwaka. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa UNFCCC, Patricia Espinosa, yatangaje ko u Rwanda rwabaye igihugu cya mbere muri Afurika mu kubyubahiriza. Mu butumwa yanyujije kuri Twitter yagize ati “Turashimira u Rwanda rwatanze gahunda ivuguruye muri UNFCC ku bijyanye no guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere. Twishimiye ubwitange bwanyu mu guharura inzira y’ahazaza heza.” Espinosa yavuze ko Coronavirus itahagaritse ikibazo cy’imihindagurikire y’ikirere, bityo ko yizeye ko n’ibindi bihugu bizatanga gahunda bifite yo guhangana n’icyo kibazo mu myaka iri imbere. Inyandiko igaragaza ingamba u Rwanda rufite mu myaka itanu iri imbere, yerekena ko ahanini izashyira imbaraga mu zari zisanzwe zishingiye ku kubaka ubukungu butangiza ibidukikije, butanahungabanywa n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe “Green Growth and Climate Resilience Strategy.” Hakazanozwa ibijyanye n’ibarurishamibare no gushishikariza abafatanyabikorwa batandukanye kugira uruhare mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryazo. Mu ngamba zisanzwe, hashyizwe imbaraga mu guhangana n’ibinyabutabire byangiza akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba birimo Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs), Hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs), Hydrobromofluorocarbons (HBFCs), Halons, Methyl bromide na Carbon tetrachloride, bikaba biboneka mu byuma bikonjesha nka za frigo n’ibyuma bizana ubuhehere mu nzu no mu modoka. U Rwanda rwashyizeho gutera ibiti byinshi bitanga umwuka mwiza aho kuri ubu ari ku buso bungana na 30% bw’igihugu. Ibi bijyanye n’uko ubu ku isoko ry’u Rwanda hagejejwe imodoka na moto zikoresha amashanyarazi. Kimwe n’ibindi bihugu ariko u Rwanda rwagize imihindagurikire y’ibihe. Imvura yariyongereye ku kigero kiri hagati ya 5% na 10% naho ubushyuhe bwazamutse ku gipimo cya dogere celcius 1.4 kuva mu 1971 kugeza 2016 kandi mu gihe nta gikozwe, cyazamuka kugera kuri dogere celcius 2.5 mbere ya 2050. Ibyo byateje ihindagurika ry’ibihe byabaye intandaro y’ibiza by’inkangu, imyuzure, inkuba n’amapfa nabyo bifitanye isano n’iyangirika ry’ibikorwaremezo, iyangirika ry’umusaruro w’ubuhinzi, impfu z’abantu n’ibindi. Mu isesengura u Rwanda rwerekanye ko ubushyuhe buziyongeraho dogere celcius ziri hagati ya 0.1 na 0.3 mu bihe by’izuba, uretse mu Majyaruguru y’igihugu hazagabanyukaho dogere celcius 0.06 kugeza mu 2050. Muri rusange ngo biteganyijwe ko izuba riziyongera imvura ntihinduke muri icyo gihe. U Rwanda ruzakenera nibura miliyari 11 z’amadolari kugira ngo rugere kuri izi ntego zo kugabanya imyuka yangiza ikirere harimo miliyari 5.7 z’amadolari zo gushyira mu bikorwa ingamba zo kuyigabanya n’izindi miliyari 5.3 z’amadolari zo guhangana n’ingaruka z’izo ngamba. Iki kiguzi cyose harimo inkunga ingana na 60%. Ubushakashatsi buherutse gushyirwa ahagaragara na Kaminuza eshanu zirimo izo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, u Bushinwa no mu Burayi, bwamuritswe mu Kinyamakuru PNAS buvuga ko mu 2050, ubushyuhe bw’Isi buzaba bwariyongereyeho nibura dogere Celsius ziri hagati ya 2.5 na 2.7. Mu bihugu byo muri Afurika yo Munsi y’Ubutayu bwa Sahara, amasaha abantu bamara mu kazi nayo azagabanuka ku kigero cya 10 na 20%.

title: Hari kwigwa uko hakorwa amacupa ashobora kubora mu mwaka umwe
content: Iki gitekerezo gishyizwe mu bikorwa byaba ari inkuru nziza ku kurengera ibidukikije ku Isi, aho amacupa ya pulasitiki akomeje kwiyongera ari ko yangiza ibidukikije haba ubutaka, inyamaswa zo mu Nyanja n’ibindi. Avantium yatangaje ko hari ibigo bikora inzoga byatangiye gushyigikira uwo mushinga nk’Uruganda rwa Carlsberg. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Avantium, Tom van Aken, yavuze ko bizeye ko ibigo bikomeye mu gukora ibikoresho byo muri pulasitiki bizabiyungaho vuba bagateza imbere icyo gitekerezo. Ibigo bikomeye nka Coca-Cola na Danone nabyo byagaragaje ko bishyigikiye uwo mushinga mu rwego rwo kugabanya umubare w’amacupa ya pulasitiki akorwa mu bikomoka kuri peteroli. KuIisi hose buri mwaka hakorwa amacupa ya pulasitiki agera kuri miliyoni 300, agira uruhare mu iyangirika ry’ibidukikije. Aya macupa iyo ajugunywe mu nyanja ashobora kumara imyaka n’imyaka atarabora. Amacupa azajya akorwa na Avantium bivugwa ko azaba afite ubushobozi bwo kubika neza ibinyobwa birimo ikinyabutabire cya CO2. Igerageza ryakozwe rigaragaza ko ayo macupa akozwe mu bimera ashobora kubora mu mwaka umwe mu gihe ashyizwe mu kimoteri, naho yajugunywa imusozi akamara indi myaka mike. Biteganyijwe ko biramutse bigenze neza amacupa ya mbere yaba yagejejwe ku isoko bitarenze umwaka wa 2023.

title: Miliyari 10 Frw zigiye kwifashishwa mu kubungabunga icyogogo cya Sebeya
content: Kuzura kwa Sebeya bigira ingaruka ku bikorwa byinshi mu turere uwo mugezi inyuramo mu Ntara y’Iburengerazuba, aho usenya ibikorwa remezo, ugatwara ubuzima bw’abaturage no kwangiza ibikorwa by’abaturage bawuturiye. Umugezi wa Sebeya unyura mu turere twa Rubavu, Rutsiro, Nyabihu na Ngororero ku burebure bwa kilometero 336. Imirenge ya Rugerero, Nyundo na Kanama muri Rubavu ni imwe mu igerwaho cyane n’ingaruka z’iyuzura ry’umugezi wa Sebeya mu bihe by’imvura. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo gishinzwe Umutungo Kamere w’Amazi mu Rwanda, Ngabonziza Prime, yavuze ko guhera muri Nyakanga uyu mwaka hazatangira kubakwa ingomero, imiyoboro y’amazi no gutera ibiti hafi y’uwo mugezi, hagamijwe kuwubungabunga. Ngabonziza yavuze ko kuzura k’uwo mugezi ahanini guterwa n’ibikorwa by’ubuhinzi biwegereye bikorwa mu buryo butari ubwa kinyamwuga, kwangiza amashyamba, ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro bukorwa nabi n’ibindi. Ati “Iyo imvura iguye ubutaka buragenda hakaba n’imyuzure. Ibyateganyije muri uyu mushinga bigamije gukemura burundu ibibazo abaturage (baturiye Sebeya) bahura nabyo.” Ngabonziza yavuze ko abaturage baturiye uwo mugezi bazagira uruhare runini mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’uwo mushinga. Miliyari 10 Frw zigiye gushorwa mu kubungabunga Sebeya, ni amwe mu mafaranga angana na miliyari 22 yateganyijwe guhera muri Kamena 2019 agamije kubungabunga icyogogo cya Sebeya n’ibindi bice. Uyu mushinga w’imyaka ine uzashyirwa mu bikorwa n’ikigo gishinzwe Umutungo Kamere w’Amazi mu Rwanda , Umuryango urengera Ibidukikije (IUCN), Ikigo cy’Abaholandi gishinzwe Iterambere (SNV).

title: Ingaruka ubushyuhe bukabije buzagira ku Isi mu myaka 50 iri imbere
content: Ni ibigaragazwa n’ubushakashatsi bwakozwe na Kaminuza eshanu zirimo izo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, u Bushinwa no mu Burayi, bwamuritswe mu Kinyamakuru PNAS kivuga ku bushakashatsi. Abashakashatsi bakoze iyi nyigo, bagendeye ku bijyanye n’ubwiyongere bw’abaturage, uko ubutaka bukoreshwa ndetse n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere bizaba biriho mu myaka iri imbere. Barebye ibibazo ikiremwamuntu cyahuye nacyo biturutse ku mihindagurikire y’ikirere ndetse banagenzura ibishobora kuzahabo mu gihe kiri imbere. Nibura mu 2050, ubushyuhe bw’Isi buzaba bwariyongereyeho nibura dogere Celsius ziri hagati ya 2.5 na 2.7; ndetse abantu bari hagati ya miliyoni 160 na 200 baba mu Buhinde bazaba batuye mu bushyuhe bukomeye. Bizagira ingaruka ku bukungu bw’igihugu aho nibura umutungo mbumbe wabwo uzahungana ku kigero cya 2.5% na 4.5%. Mu bihugu byo muri Afurika yo munsi y’Ubutayu bwa Sahara, amasaha abantu bamara mu kazi nayo azagabanuka ku kigero cya 10 na 20%. Ibice byinshi by’Isi muri iki gihe bifite ubushyuhe bwa 13 °C, mu myaka 50 aho hantu hashobora kuzaba hashyushye ku kigero cya 20 °C, ubushyuhe bugaragara muri iki gihe mu bice byinshi bya Afurika y’Amajyaruguru nk’uburi hasi. Ubushakashatsi kandi bugaragaza ko abaturage batuye mu bice bishyushye muri iki gihe, baziyongera cyane mu myaka nibura 50 iri imbere. Miliyari 3.5 z’abatuye Isi nibura bazaba batuye ahantu hari ubushyuhe bwa 29.0 °C.

title: #GumaMuRugo: Imyuka ihumanya ikirere yagabanutseho 24% i Kigali
content: Ni inzira itoroshye cyane ko inyigo iheruka gukorwa n’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima, OMS, ku bijyanye n’ubuziranenge bw’umwuka yagaragaje ko abaturage bangana na 92% baba mu duce tubonekamo ihumana ry’ikirere ryo ku rwego rwo hejuru. Imibare igaragaza ko buri mwaka abantu miliyoni zirindwi bicwa n’indwara zituruka ku guhumana kw’ikirere. Ubwiyongere bw’abaturage n’abatura mu mijyi yo mu Rwanda biri mu byongera imirimo ituma habaho n’imyuka yoherezwa mu kirere irimo ishobora kuva imbere mu nzu no hanze yazo. Mu byangiza ikirere harimo impamvu kamere nk’iruka ry’ibirunga, ibikorwa bya muntu, ibinyabiziga bikoresha mazutu bisohora imyuka ihumanya ikirere. Muri make, ibyangiza ikirere bishobora kuba imyuka iboneshwa amaso n’itaboneshwa amaso. Muri iki gihe hafashwe ingamba zikomeye zigamije kwirinda icyorezo cya COVID-19 giterwa n’agakoko gashya ka Coronavirus, ibihugu byinshi byafashe ingamba zanatumye imyuka ihumanya ikirere igabanuka. Mu Rwanda, ku wa 21 Werurwe 2020, nibwo hafashwe icyemezo cyo guhagarika ibikorwa bitari iby’ingenzi ndetse abaturage bategekwa kuguma mu rugo. Ni icyemezo cyagize ingaruka ku bukungu bw’igihugu n’imibereho y’abagituye ariko kiba inyungu ku kirere cyongeye gusubirana umwimerere wacyo. Dr Kalisa Egide, Umwarimu muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda, Ishami ry’Ubumenyi n’Ikoranabuhanga akaba n’Umushakashatsi mu Kigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ibidukikije, REMA, ku bijyanye no kureba ibitera imyuka yanduza ikirere n’uburyo bwo kuyirinda, yabwiye IGIHE ko ihagarikwa ry’ingendo n’ibikorwa by’inganda byagize uruhare mu kugabanya imyuka ihumanya ikirere. Mu Rwanda, ibinyabiziga birimo imodoka na moto n’ibicanwa nk’inkwi n’amakara biza ku isonga mu guhumanya ikirere. Dr Kalisa Egide avuga ko “Usanga mu bihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere byugarijwe n’imyuka ihumanya ikirere iterwa cyane n’imyuka iva ku modoka, gutekesha inkwi n’imyotsi y’amakara ndetse n’ibindi.’’ Mu gihe cyo kubahiriza gahunda ya Guma mu rugo, bitewe nuko imwe mu mirimo n’ingendo byahagaze, byatumye imyuka ihumanya ikirere igabanuka. Mu Rwanda imyuka ihumanya ikirere iterwa na PM2.5 [utuvungukira duto cyane tungana n’umurambararo wa 2.5 dushobora kwinjira mu bihaha tugatera indwara] ari nayo ihangayikishije Isi, yaragabanutse. Ibipimo byafashwe mu minsi 35 y’ibihe bya Guma mu rugo byerekana ko igabanuka ry’imyuka ihumanya ikirere ryagaragaye mu Ruhango (-28%), Kigali (-24 %), Rubavu (-15 %), Rusizi (-14 %), Nyagatare (-13%), Nyabihu (-11%) na Kirehe (- 4%) mu gihe Kawangire [mu Burasirazuba] yo yazamutseho 19%. Dr Kalisa yavuze ko ubwiyongere bw’imyuka ihumanya ikirere muri Kawangire bushingiye ku kuba aka gace k’icyaro kabonekamo imyuka iva mu gucana no gutwika isanzwe ariyo yiganje mu ihumanya ikirere. Ati “Muri ako gace ibi bikorwa ntibiri mu byahagaze mu gihe cya COVID-19.’’ Asobanura impamvu mu Karere ka Ruhango habonetse igabanuka ryo hejuru, yagize ati “Ubusanzwe aho ibipimo byafatiwe ni mu Byimana ku muhanda wa Kigali-Huye. Ni umwe mu mihanda igendwa cyane mu Rwanda ariko muri iki gihe ingendo zikorwa mu ntara ni nke. Mu Rwanda umwuka waho ni mwiza ugendeye ku bipimo mpuzamahanga, intara zose zifite umwuka mwiza ugereranyije na Kigali.’’ Mu Mujyi wa Kigali aho igabanuka ry’imyuka mu kirere ryageze kuri 24% bijyanye no kuba hari ibikorwa byinshi byahagaze nk’ingendo z’ibinyabiziga, ubwubatsi, n’ibindi. Dr Kalisa akomeza avuga ko “U Rwanda ruri mu bihugu byashyizeho ingamba zikomeye mu kurwanya imyuka ihumanya ikirere REMA ifite sitasiyo zitandukanye zifata ibipimo by’imyuka ihumanya ikirere muri Kigali no mu turere dutandukanye tw’igihugu.” Igihugu kandi cyanatangije ikoreshwa rya moto n’imodoka zifashisha amashanyarazi zidasohora umwuka uhumanye no kunoza ubwikorezi rusange hagabanywa imodoka zishaje ziganje mu zohereza imyuka ihumanya cyane ikirere hifashishijwe igenzurwa ry’ibinyabiziga bisohora imyuka yangiza ikirere. Mu yindi mijyi ku Isi, ibipimo ku myuka ihumanya ikirere byerekana mu gihe cy’ibyumweru bitatu bya Guma mu rugo, Londres yagize igabanuka rya 9%, New York (-25%), Los Angeles (-32%), Madrid (-11%), Sao Paulo (-32%), Wuhan (-44%), Delhi (-60), Mumbai (-34%) na Rome yiyongereyeho 30% . Ubushakashatsi bwamuritswe na REMA mu 2017 bwagaragaje ko 95,2% y’imodoka ziri mu Rwanda zimaze imyaka irenga 10 zikozwe; 56,6 % ni iza mbere yo mu 1999 naho 77,2% zakozwe mbere ya 2000. Minisiteri y’Ubuzima igaragaza ko buri mwaka mu mavuriro hakirwa miliyoni eshatu z’abivuza indwara z’ubuhumekero barimo 13% bazitewe n’ihumana ry’ikirere.

title: Umwaka wa 2020 ushobora guca agahigo ko kugira ubushyuhe kurusha indi
content: Ibi byatuma 2020 ica agahigo kari karagiyeho mu myaka ine ishize katumaga 2016 ariwo mwaka waranzwe n’ubushyuhe bwinshi. Nubwo gufunga ibikorwa hirya no hino ku Isi byatumye ikirere gihumeka kubera ko byinshi mu bitera ubushyuhe byahagaze, abahanga bavuga ko ibi bitatumye Isi ikonja. Ubushyuhe bwinshi bwatangiye guturuka muri Antarctique kuva muri Mutarama. Abahanga bo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika bagaragaza ko ibi bituma nibura hari amahirwe angana na 75% ko Isi izashyuha cyane. Mutarama uyu mwaka yaciye agahigo mu kugira ubushyuhe buri hejuru bituma ibihugu bimwe byo mu Burayi bisigara nta rubura kandi ubusanzwe biruhorana. Bwa mbere mu majyepfo y’umugabane wa Antarctique, hagaragaye ubushyuhe bwinshi muri Gashyantare kuko bwarenze dogere celicius 20. Mu gihembwe cya mbere cy’uyu mwaka, ubushyuhe mu Burasirazuba bw’u Burayi no muri Aziya, bwarenze ikigero cyari gisanzwe kuko bwiyongereyeho dogere celicius eshatu. Ku wa Gatanu ushize, mu bice bitandukanye bya Los Angeles hagaragaye ubushyuhe buri hejuru y’ubwari busanzwe kuko bwageze kuri dogere celcius 34.

title: ‘Earth Day’, umunsi wahariwe kwiyemeza guhangana n’ibibazo byugarije ibidukikije ku Isi
content: Uyu munsi watangiye kwizihizwa mu 1970, ari cyo gihe Ihuriro ry’Abahirimbanira kurengera Ibidukikije batangiriye urugamba rweruye. Kuri iyi nshuro, uyu munsi wageze Isi yose ihanganye n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus, ariko abawutegura bagennye amasaha 72 yo kwiyemeza ibikorwa byo kurengera Isi binyuze mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga. Ibi bikaba byasimbuye kwizihiza uyu munsi mu nsanganyamatsiko yo kugira igikorwa mu kurwanya imihindagurikire y’ibihe. Uyu munsi usanze Loni yarasubitse inama mpuzamahanga yiga ku mihindagurikire y’ibihe (COP26). Amateka y’uyu munsi afite umuzi mu kuba mbere y’uko utangira kwizihizwa bwa mbere Abanyamerika benshi bari bugarijwe n’imyuka ihumanya yavaga mu binyabiziga n’inganda zasohoraga imyotsi, ibi byatumye bamwe mu baturage biyemeza kutabana nabyo bahagurukira kwerekana ingaruka bifite ku buzima bwa muntu. Senateri Gaylord Nelson wari uhagarariye Wisconsin, yari yarakunze kugaragaza cyane uko ibidukikije byangizwa cyane muri Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Muri Mutarama 1969, we n’abandi benshi batangije urugamba rwo kurengera ibidukikije. Umunsi wa mbere w’Isi ‘Earth Day’, witabiriwe n’Abanyamerika barenga miliyoni 20 icyo gihe bakaba bari 10% by’abaturage bose ba Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, bigabiza imihanda, ahategerwa imodoka n’ibyumba binini muri za Kaminuza bamagana ingaruka zikomeye ku buzima iterambere ry’inganda ryabasigiye mu myaka 150 zari zimaze. Icyo gihe ibihumbi bya za Koleji na za Kaminuza byateguye imyigaragambyo yamagana kwangiza ibidukikije ndetse hakaba hari n’abandi bahuriye mu mijyi no mu bindi bice. Bose bamaganaga inganda zihumanya ikirere, kumena peteroli n’ibiyikomokaho mu mazi no ku butaka, ahakusanyirizwa amazi yanduye hatitabwaho, imyanda ihumanya, imiti yica udukoko n’igabanuka ry’ibinyabuzima byo mu gasozi. Uyu munsi n’ibikorwa biwukorwaho byarashyigikiwe cyane n’inzego zose ku buryo mu mpera ya 1970 byatumye hashingwa Ikigo cyo kurengera Ibidukikije muri Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ndetse hashyirwaho n’amategeko abyerekeye. Aya mategeko yarinze miliyoni z’abagabo, abagore n’abana indwara n’impfu ndetse amagana y’ubwoko bw’inyamaswa ntizazimira. Uyu munsi wakunze kwifashishwa mu gutanga ubutumwa no kwiyemeza ibikorwa bigamije kurengera ibidukikije. Mu 1990, witaye cyane ku gushishikariza Isi kubyaza ibikoresho byashaje ibindi (Recycling) ndetse biharurira inzira inama yiga ku mubumbe w’Isi yo mu 1992, i Rio de Janeiro. Byanatumye Perezida Bill Clinton yambika Senateri Nelson umudali wo ku rwego rwo hejuru w’ubwisanzure, akaba ari wo ukomeye uhabwa abasivili muri Amerika kubera uruhare yagize mu guharanira ko uyu munsi ubaho. Uko iminsi yagiye ishira, uyu munsi wagiye waguka ukibanda no ku bundi bukangurambaga nko kurwanya ubushyuhe bw’Isi no gukoresha ingufu zitangiza ikirere. Mu 2000 internet yatangiye kwifashishwa mu guhuriza hamwe abantu benshi bahirimbanira kurengera ibidukikije, bakagirana ibiganiro ndetse hamwe na hamwe mu mijyi n’ibyaro bagakora ingendo bavuza ingoma biyemeza kurengera ibidukikije ari nako bamagana ibibyangiza. Kuri ubu, uyu munsi uhuza abarenga miliyari ugafatwa nk’umwanya wo kwiyemeza kugira igikorwa mu guhindura imyitwarire ya muntu no kugena impinduka ku rwego rw’Isi no mu bihugu n’uturere. Kurwanya imihindagurikire y’ikirere ni kimwe mu byitabwaho buri mwaka. Ugucumbagira cyane ku masezerano ya Paris ya 2015, ni imwe mu mpamvu ituma Isi yose igomba guhagurukira rimwe igasaba ko hagira igikorwa ku neza y’uyu mubumbe n’abawutuye. Kuri iyi nshuro imbuga nkoranyambaga zakoreshejwe cyane na za miliyoni zisaba ko hagira igikorwa cyihutirwa ku mihindagurikire y’ikirere, ni nyuma y’uko umwaka ushize mu Burayi habonetse igipimo cy’ubushyuhe kiri hejuru cyane kurenza ibindi kuva Isi yaremwa.

title: Meteo Rwanda yaburiye abaturarwanda ku mvura nyinshi izageza kuwa 20 Mata
content: Meteo Rwanda ivuga ko iyo mvura izaba irimo umuyaga mwinshi mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu. Ahateganyijwe kugira imvura nyinshi kurusha ahandi ni mu Ntara y’Iburengerazuba, Intara y’Amajyepfo, mu Mujyi wa Kigali no mu majyepfo y’Intara y’Iburasirazuba. Iyi mvura izagwa iri hagati ya milimetero 10 na 50 ku munsi. Uko babara amazi ya milimetero, urugero nk’amazi ya milimetero 10, ni litiro icumi zaguye mu butaka bwa meterokare 10. Meteo ivuga ko iyo mvura izaterwa n’isangano ry’umuyaga ndetse n’ubuhehere bw’umwuka bwiyongereye mu karere u Rwanda ruherereyemo. Umuyaga uteganyijwe uzaba ufite muvuduko uri hagati ya metero 5 na 10 ku isegonda. Meteo Rwanda yashishikarije Abaturarwanda bose kwitwararika bakurikiza amabwiriza bahabwa n’inzego zishinzwe gukumira ibiza.

title: U Rwanda rugeze he rukumira imyuka yangiza ikirere n’ibikoresho bikonjesha ikoreshwamo?
content: Aya masezerano agamije ko ibinyabutabire bya Hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs), akenshi bituruka mu byuma bikonjesha nka za frigo, ibitanga ubuhehere bizwi nka ‘Air Conditioner’ n’ibindi byacika burundu ku Isi, guhagarika ikora n’ikoreshwa ry’iyi myuka bikaba bishobora kugabanya dogere 0.5 ku gipimo mpuzandengo cy’izamuka ry’ubushyuhe bw’Isi mu myaka 100. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Ubuziranenge (RSB), Murenzi Raymond, aheruka kubwira IGIHE ko ikigo ayobora gifatanya n’igishinzwe kubungabunga ibidukikije (REMA) mu gukumira ko iyo myuka ikomeza kwinjira mu gihugu. Ati “Ubu rero iyo myuka iza muri ibyo byuma bikonjesha cyangwa se iza mu kubisana ntikinjira mu Rwanda kuko itemewe. Byumvikane ko ubu turimo kuyirwanya ndetse n’aho iri turimo kugenda dusobanurira abayifite ingaruka zayo kugira ngo aho ikoreshwa izagere igihe twihaye yarashize burundu.” Umuyobozi ushinzwe amabwiriza n’ubuziranenge muri REMA, Uwera Martine, yabwiye IGIHE ko hari imyuka imwe yamaze guhagarikwa burundu kwinjizwa ku butaka bw’u Rwanda. Ati “Ibyuma bikoresha umwuka [Gaz] witwa R22 birakumiriwe kwinjizwa ariko umwuka wo urinjizwa habanje gusaba uruhusa muri REMA. Hari ibindi byaciwe burundu byakoreshaga uwitwa R12 na R11. Ibyo yaba ibikoresho cyangwa umwuka bikoresha nta na kimwe cyemerewe kwinjira ku isoko ry’u Rwanda.” Yasobanuye ko impamvu uyu mwuka wa R22 ucyinjira mu gihugu mu gihe ibikoresho bikonjesha biwukenera byakumiriwe ari uko hari ibyinjijwe mbere kandi bigifite igihe cyo gukoreshwa. Ati “Tugomba kuba twabihagaritse burundu bitarenze 2030. Ubwo rero urumva, ntabwo umwuka bikoresha twahagarika kuwinjiza burundu. Tugomba kugera icyo gihe uwo mwuka tuwinjiza mu gihugu ku kigero cya 0%.” Uyu muyobozi yasobanuye ko hazashyirwaho gahunda yo guca burundu ibikoresho bikoresha uwo mwuka byinjijwe mbere mu gihugu ku buryo bizagera mu 2030, ababisanganywe nabo batakibikoresha. Ati “Ubu abantu bari kugura frigo n’ibindi byuma bitanga ubuhehere, turi kubashishikariza gukoresha izikoresha imyuka igezweho ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Ubu zamaze kugera ku isoko nta mpungenge n’imwe ihari, twe dufite n’icyizere ko tuzanagera icyo gihe abantu baramaze gutangira gukoresha izigezweho.” Kuba ubusanzwe ibyuma byinshi bikonjesha bimara igihe kitarenze imyaka 20, uyu muyobozi avuga ko bitanga icyizere ko bizagera mu 2030 nta muntu ugikoresha ibi byuma byahagaritswe kwinjira mu gihugu mu 2009. REMA ivuga ko hari inyigo igiye gukora izagaragaza ingano y’ibikoresho bikonjesha, bikoresha umwuka uhumanya biri ku butaka bw’u Rwanda.

title: Bimwe mu bikoresho bya pulasitiki bikoreshwa rimwe byakumiriwe mu Rwanda
content: Ibi bikoresho birimo imiheha ya pulasitiki, ibikoresho byifashishwa mu kuvanga, amakanya, ibiyiko, ibikombe n’amasahani bikoreshwa inshuro imwe, ibipurizo n’ububiko cyangwa ibitwarwamo impapuro bikoze muri pulasitiki. Izi ngamba zatangarijwe mu kiganiro n’itangazamakuru, iyi Minisiteri y’ibidukikije ifatanyije n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe kurengera ibidukikije (REMA) byagiranye n’abanyamakuru. Hasobanurwaga ku gutangiza ubukangurambaga ku icibwa ry’ibikoresho bya pulasitike bikoreshwa inshuro imwe bikajugunywa. Imibare igaragaza ko uyu munsi hakorwa toni hafi miliyoni 300 za pulasitiki buri mwaka, hakiyongeraho miliyari eshanu z’amasashi ya pulasitiki n’amacupa abarirwa muri za miliyari. Kimwe cya kabiri cya pulasitiki zikoreshwa rimwe zirajugunywa zigahinduka umwanda. Bivugwa ko bikomeje uku, pulasitiki zikorwa zizikuba inshuro eshatu mu 2050. Kuva mu 2008, u Rwanda rwabaye igihugu cyaciye ikoreshwa ry’amasashi hirya no hino mu gihugu. Naho kuva mu 2019, rushyiraho itegeko N°17/2019 ryo ku wa 10/08/2019, ryerekeye kubuza ikorwa, itumizwa mu mahanga, ikoreshwa n’icuruzwa ry’amasashi n’ibikoresho bikozwe muri pulasitiki bikoreshwa inshuro imwe. Iri tegeko ryavuguruye iryari risanzwe kugira ngo rigene ibyerekeye izi pulasitiki zindi zitari zararebwe n’itegeko rya 2008 kuko byagaragaye ko na zo zitera ihumana ry’ibidukikije. Ibi byatumye zimwe muri pulasitiki zibuzwa n’iri tegeko kongera gukoreshwa mu Rwanda. Minisiteri y’ibidukikije yabwiye abanyamakuru ko iri tegeko ribuza itumizwa mu mahanga, ikorwa, icuruzwa n’ikoreshwa ry’amasashi yose n’izindi pulasitiki zikoreshwa inshuro imwe nk’ibipfunyikwamo ibiribwa cyangwa ibindi bintu. Ibi birimo imiheha ya pulasitiki, ibikoresho byifashishwa mu kuvanga, amakanya, ibiyiko, ibikombe n’amasahani bikoreshwa inshuro imwe, ibipurizo n’ububiko cyangwa ibitwarwamo impapuro bikoze muri pulasitiki. Ivuga ko zimwe mu ngaruka ziterwa n’ikoresha rya Pulasitiki zikorerwa gukoreshwa inshuro imwe, harimo gutera umwanda ku nkengero z’imihanda no mu mazi, gufunga inzira z’amazi, kugabanya ubushobozi by’amazi bwo kwinjira mu butaka, bityo bigatuma habaho imyuzure. Inyinshi muri pulasitiki zikoreshwa inshuro imwe zikorwa mu mavuta ya peteroli zikaba zitabora burundu, ahubwo zikagaragara mu bidukikije nk’uduce duto duto tugira uruhare mu gutera umwanda, kwanduza ibiribwa n’ibindi. Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe mu 2017, bwemeje ko impfu nyinshi z’inyamaswa zo mu mazi n’inyoni ziterwa no kurya pulasitiki. Uduce twa pulasitiki zitashangutse twasanzwe muri izi nyamaswa. Minisitiri Dr Mujawamariya yagize ati “Guhera uyu munsi bimwe mu bikoresho bya pulasitiki birimo amasahane, imiheha n’izindi pulasitike zikoreshwa inshuro imwe nk’ibipfunyikwamo ibiribwa cyangwa ibindi bintu, bibujijwe kongera gukoreshwa mu Rwanda.” “Nta muntu tubujije kugura ibintu bipfunyitse muri pulasitiki, ishati zipfunyitse, amazi ari mu icupa n’ibindi, kubera ko izo nganda ntizirabona izisimbura ibi bikoresho kugeza igihe zizaba zabisimbuye, icyo tubujije ni ugupfunyika umugati muri pulasitiki, imbuto muri pulasitiki, inyama muri pulasitiki, isombe n’ibindi kuko ibyo bifite ibisimbura izo pulasitiki.” Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije ivuga ko pulasitiki zikoreshwa n’inganda mu gupfunyika zisonewe gupfunyikishwa gusa ibicuruzwa bikorerwa mu ruganda rwabiherewe uruhushya, ariko zigomba gushyirwaho ikimenyetso kigaragara n’uruganda ruzipfunyikisha ibicuruzwa byarwo. Ivuga ko ikorwa, itumizwa mu mahanga, ikoreshwa cyangwa icuruzwa ry’ibikoresho bikozwe muri pulasitiki ibora mu miterere isanzwe, bikorwa iyo byabanje gusabirwa uruhushya ku rwego rubifitiye ububasha (REMA), ariko hagaragajwe ko hari impamvu zihariye. Uruhushya rusabwa mu nyadiko. Bimwe mu bihano biteganyijwe Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije ivuga ko bimwe mu bihano bihabwa umuntu wese ukora amasashi n’ibikoresho bikozwe muri pulasitiki bikoreshwa inshuro imwe, ahanishwa gufungirwa ibikorwa, kwamburwa ayo masashi n’ibyo bikoresho no kwishyura ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi ingana na miliyoni 10 mu mafaranga y’u Rwanda. Harimo kandi kwishyura ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi ingana inshuro 10 z’agaciro k’ayo masashi n’ibyo bikoresho bikozwe muri pulasitiki bikoreshwa rimwe n’ibindi bihano. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa REMA, Eng Colette Ruhamya, yagize ati “Ibi bikoresho abantu bakwiye kujya babyitondera cyane kubishyiramo ibintu bishyushye, yego nta kintu kitagira ingaruka ku bidukikije ariko ushaka uko wagabanya za ngaruka.” Avuga ko mbere haciwe amasashi ariko ubu hatewe intambwe mu kureba n’ibindi bikoresho bikoreshwa inshuro imwe byacibwa.

title: Byinshi kuri Banki yihariye izatera inkunga imishinga irengera ibidukikije mu Rwanda
content: Iyi banki biteganywa ko izitwa ‘Rwanda Catalytic Green Investment Bank’, yitezweho kongera amafaranga yashorwaga mu mishinga igamije kurengera ibidukikije mu gihugu. Izaba ikora nk’izindi banki ariko yibanda gusa ku gutanga inguzanyo no gushora imari yayo mu mishinga igamije kurengera ibidukikije. Uru rwego rw’imari ruteganywa gushyirwaho, ruzafasha mu gukangurira ibigo byigenga gushyigikira ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’imishinga itangiza ibidukikije mu gihugu. Umukozi ushinzwe itumanaho mu kigega cya leta gisanzwe gitera inkunga imishinga irengera ibidukikije (Fonerwa), Doreen Nakure, yabwiye IGIHE ko Fonerwa ari yo ishinzwe gukurikirana by’umwihariko ishyirwaho ry’iyo banki, cyamaze gushyiraho itsinda ry’inzobere rizatanga ishusho nyayo y’imiterere n’imikorere y’iyo banki mu gihe cya vuba. Ati “Ubu twamaze guha akazi umuryango ‘Coalition for Green Capital’ kizadusesengurira ndetse kikaduha imiterere y’ishusho y’iyo banki ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Ibijyanye n’ingano y’amafaranga iyo banki izatangiza bizagaragazwa n’inyigo iri gukorwa n’icyo kigo gifatanyije n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa.” The Coalition for Green Capital ni umuryango udaharanira inyungu, wibanda cyane ku guteza imbere isoko ry’ingufu zidahumanya, binyuze mu gushyiraho banki ziteza imbere imishinga irengera ibidukikije. Kuva mu mwaka wa 2009, uyu muryango ufatanya n’ibihugu, ndetse n’imiryango itari iya Leta gushyiraho ibigo by’imari bishyigikira imishinga migari irengera ibidukikije, kigakora ubuvugizi, ndetse kigatanga ubujyanama n’ubugenzuzi mu mikorere y’ibyo bigo. Kugeza ubu ntibirasobanuka neza niba iyi banki izaba ari iya Leta cyangwa iy’abikorera; gusa Nakure avuga ko bizaterwa n’ibintu byinshi bikiri kuganirwaho ubu, ariko akagaragaza ko byagakwiye kuba igikorwa cy’abikorera. Iyi banki nitangira, izajya itera inkunga imishinga ya Leta n’abikorera igamije kurengera ibidukikije, habanje kurebwa niba yujuje ibisabwa. Nakure avuga ko iki gitekerezo cyo gushyiraho iyi banki kiri gushingira ku mahame yihariye ajyanye no kugena uburyo bwo kwifatira ibyemezo mu ishoramari, ubushobozi bwo kwiyongerera imari ivuye mu bigo by’imari ndetse no mu bikorera, hashingiwe cyane cyane ku bikorwa by’indashyikirwa bya banki mpuzamahanga zitera inkunga imishinga irengera ibidukikije, ubufasha bwa Fonerwa ndetse n’abandi bagira uruhare muri iri soko. Amakuru ajyanye n’itangizwa ry’iyi banki mu Rwanda yatangarijwe bwa mbere mu kiganiro cyatangiwe mu nama ya Cop 25 iherutse kubera muri Espagne mu mpera z’umwaka ushize yigaga ku ruhare rwa banki zigamije guteza imbere ibidukikije mu gutuma ibihugu bigera ku ntego zabyo. Igitekerezo cyo gushyiraho banki nyarwanda itera inkunga imishinga irengera ibidukikije, kije nyuma y’uko Afurika y’Epfo na yo yashyizeho iyo banki ifite imari shingiro ya miliyoni 100 z’amadorali ya Amerika. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ibijyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere muri Banki Nyafurika itsura Amajyambere (AfDB), Anthony Nyon, ubwo yari mu nama ya COP 25, yatangaje ko hakenewe ingamba zihamye mu guhanga ikoranabuhanga rishya rigamije guhangana n’ibibazo by’imihindagurikire y’ibihe. Ati “Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, Banki Nyafurika itsura Amajyambere, binyuze mu bufasha bw’ikigega kigamije kurengera ibidukikije, iri gukorana n’ihuriro rya banki zigamije kurengera ibidukikije mu kureba uburyo butandukanye bwo gushyira igishoro mu bikorwa bifasha kurengera ibidukikije ku rwego rwo hasi, ari na ko tuzamura uruhare rw’abikorera.” Leta yashyizeho ikigega Fonerwa cyahawe inshingano zo gufasha u Rwanda kugera ku bukungu butangiza ibidukikije binyuze mu gutera inkunga imishinga ya Leta n’abikorera iri muri uyu murongo. Kuva iki kigega cyashingwa muri 2013, hahanzwe imirimo 138 000 itangiza ibidukikije. Mu 2017, habarurwaga ko ubutaka bungana na hegitari 21 847 bwatunganyijwe hagamijwe kwirinda ko butwarwa n’isuri ndetse hegitari 12 998 z’inkombe n’imigezi n’ibiyaga zarasubiranyijwe, hegitari 41 116 ziterwaho amashyamba, ndetse imiryango 65,340 ifashwa kubona ingufu zikomoka ku mirasire y’izuba mu gihe toni miliyoni 65 z’imyuka ihumanya ikirere zakumiriwe. Icyo gihe Fonerwa yari imaze gutanga inkunga ya miliyoni 100 z’amadorali, iyi nkunga ikaba ihabwa imishinga yatsinze binyuze mu marushanwa. Umushinga w’uruganda rw’amashanyarazi rutanga megawati 8.5 ruri mu karere ka Rwamagana, ni urugero rwiza rw’ishoramari ryakozwe mu rwego rwo kurengera ibidukikije. U Rwanda rwihaye intego ko mu 2050, ruzaba rwagabanyije umwuka uhumanya ikirere ku rugero rwifuzwa.

title: Ingano y’umwuka wa CO2 Umunyarwanda yohereza mu kirere
content: Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe na Oxfam bwatangajwe kuri iki Cyumweru, bwagaragaje umuntu umwe mu Bwongereza bizamufata iminsi itanu kugira ngo agire uruhare mu bikorwa bituma haboneka CO2 mu gihe iyo ngano y’uyu mwuka ku muntu uri mu Rwanda bizamufata umwaka. Ku Cyumweru gitaha tariki ya 12 Mutarama, nibura Umwongereza azaba amaze kohereza mu kirere umwuka wa CO2 ungana n’uzoherezwa umwaka wose n’umuturage wo mu bihugu birimo Madagascar, Malawi, Ethiopia, Uganda, Guinea na Burkina Faso. Ubu bushakashatsi bwagaragaje ingano y’uyu mwuka woherezwa mu kirere ku batuye mu Rwanda ari toni 0.09, Malawi ni 0.19, Burkina Faso zigeze kuri toni 0.25 ku mwaka. Bwagaragaje ko umuturage wo muri Nigeria agira uruhare mu bikorwa byohereza mu kirere uyu mwuka uhumanya ungana na toni 0.49 buri mwaka naho uwo mu Buhinde akaba ari 1.68. Ikigereranyo rusange ku Isi kiri kuri toni 4.7 ku muntu buri mwaka. Mu Bwongereza honyine, umuturage abarirwa toni 8.3. Abongereza benshi bavuze ko hakwiye kugira byinshi bikorwa mu kurwanya ikibazo cy’imihindagurikire y’ikirere cyane mu kugabanya umwuka uhumanya woherezwa mu kirere. Ubwiyongere mu kirere bw’uyu mwuka wa CO2 bugira ingaruka ku bidukikije zirimo ubushyuhe bukabije ku Isi, imyuzure n’ibindi. Mu myaka 100 ishize, ibikorwa bya muntu byongereye ubushyuhe ku Isi ho dogere celcius 2.5. Uko kwiyongera k’ubushyuhe ku Isi kwagiye gutera ibibazo bitandukanye birimo ihindagurika ry’ibihe, imyuzure ya hato na hato, kuzimira kw’inyamaswa n’ibimera bitandukanye n’ibindi. Mu myaka myinshi ishize, ibikorwa bya muntu byakomeje kugira uruhare mu iyangirika ry’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima ndetse n’ihindagurika ry’imiterere y’Isi. Ahari ubutayu bwa Sahara hahoze ibyatsi, amazi ndetse n’amashyamba nkuko byatangajwe n’Umushakashatsi Dr Curt Stager wo muri Kaminuza ya Smith College, nyamara byaje guhindurwa n’imyuzure, agace gasigara kambaye ubusa. Kubera ubushyuhe, ibikorwa bya muntu n’ibindi, amoko 1000 y’inyamswa yarimutse ajya gushaka ahandi aba, andi menshi yo yarazimiye. Mu myaka 15 iri imbere, isunzu ry’umusozi wa Kilimanjaro rizwiho urubura rizaba ryambaye ubusa. Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko ubushyuhe bw’Isi buri gutuma urubura kuri uwo musozi rushonga bidasanzwe. Uyu mwuka wa CO2 ugira ingaruka nyinshi ku buzima bwa muntu. Zirimo kurwara umutwe, kugira umunaniro, kubura ibitotsi, kugira ibibazo by’ubuhumekero kimwe no gututubikana ndetse wongera uburyo umutima utera umuntu akaba yarwara indwara y’umuvuduko ukabije w’amaraso cyangwa se akaba yajya muri Coma mu buryo butunguranye kubera kubura umwuka mwiza. Ubushakashatsi buherutse kugaragaza ko ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe ku bukungu bw’u Rwanda zishobora kugera ku kigero cya 4.5% by’umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu mu mwaka wa 2030. Ubu bushakashatsi bwakozwe n’itsinda ry’ibihugu 19 bihuriye ku kuba bisangiye ingaruka bigirwaho n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere (V20), bwerekanye ko ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe ku buzima bw’abanyarwanda zishobora kurushaho gukomera harimo ukwiyongera kwa Malaria ndetse n’ibyorezo bituruka ku bukonje ndetse n’ubushyuhe bw’ikirere. Ubushakashatsi bw’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cyo kubungabunga Ibidukikije (REMA) bwo muri Gicurasi 2018, ku bitera ihumana ry’umwuka n’iyangirika ry’ikirere, bwagaragaje ko ibintu biza ku isonga mu guhumanya umwuka uhumekwa mu Rwanda harimo umwotsi w’imodoka, imyotsi y’amakara n’inkwi n’ibindi. Bwanerekanye ko uduce duto duto tutabonwa n’amaso twivanga n’umwuka uhumekwa, tubangamiye bikomeye ubuzima bw’abaturarwanda bishobora gutera indwara z’ubuhumekero n’umutima. Bwanagaragaje ko mu bice bituwe hari ubwo naho ikigero cy’utwo tuvungukira kirenga urugero rwemewe, ahanini kubera imyuka ikomoka ku gukoresha ibicanwa bikomoka ku biti no gutwika ibyatsi, ibiyorero n’amashyamba. Hari ibice bimwe na bimwe byagaragayemo ko mu mpeshyi muri metero kibe imwe y’umwuka usangamo hagati ya mikorogarama (microgram) 100 na 150 z’utwo tuvungukira mu gihe ikigero cyemewe kitagomba kurenga mikorogarama 35 kuri meterokibe y’umwuka. Mu guhangana n’ingaruka ziterwa n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe n’iyangirika ry’ikirere, u Rwanda rwashyizeho ingamba nyinshi zitandukanye zirimo gutera ibiti byinshi bitanga umwuka mwiza aho kuri ubu ari ku buso bungana na 30% bw’igihugu. Harimo kandi gukumira imodoka zisohora imyuka ihumanya ihumanya binyuze mu isuzuma zikorerwa no kwimakaza ikoreshwa ry’ingufu zidahumanya. Ibi bijyanye n’uko ubu ku isoko ry’u Rwanda hagejejwe imodoka na moto zikoresha amashanyarazi.

title: Mu Rwanda hagiye gutangizwa banki itera inkunga imishinga y’ibidukikije
content: Amakuru ajyanye n’itangizwa ry’iyi banki mu Rwanda yatangarijwe mu kiganiro cyatangangiwe mu nama ya Cop 25 iherutse kubera muri Espagne mu mpera z’umwaka ushize kireba uruhare rwa banki zigamije guteza imbere ibidukikije mu gutuma ibihugu bigera ku ntego zabyo. Muri iyo nama niho hatangarijwe ko u Rwanda ruzashyiraho banki igamije gushyigikira imishinga igamije kurengera ibidukikije, “Rwanda Catalytic Green investment bank”. Uru rwego rw’imari ruzafasha mu gukangurira ibigo byigenga gushyigikira ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’imishinga itangiza ibidukikije mu gihugu. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ibijyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere muri Banki Nyafurika itsura Amajyambere (AfDB), Anthony Nyon, yatangaje ko hakenewe ingamba zihamye mu guhanga ikoranabuhanga rishya rigamije guhangana n’ibibazo by’imihindagurikire y’ibihe. Ati “Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, Banki Nyafurika itsura Amajyambere, binyuze mu bufasha bw’ikigega kigamije kurengera ibidukikije, iri gukorana n’ihuriro rya banki zigamije kurengera ibidukikije mu kureba uburyo butandukanye bwo gushyira igishoro mu bikorwa bifasha kurengera ibidukikije ku rwego rwo hasi, ari nako tuzamura uruhare rw’abikorera.” Kubera ibibazo by’imihindagurikire y’ibihe, nibura abahinzi bo mu Rwanda batakaza 40% by’umusaruro wabo. Leta yashyizeho ikigega Fonerwa cyahawe inshingano zo gufasha u Rwanda kugera ku bukungu butangiza ibidukikije binyuze mu gutera inkunga imishinga ya Leta n’abikorera iri muri uyu murongo. Kuva iki kigega cyashingwa, hahanzwe imirimo 138000 itangiza ibidukikije. Mu 2017, habarurwaga ko ubutaka bungana na hegitari 21 847 bwatunganyijwe hagamijwe kwirinda ko butwarwa n’isuri ndetse hegitari 12,998 z’inkombe n’imigezi n’ibiyaga zarasubiranyijwe ndetse imiryango ifashwa 17 449 kubona ingufu zidakomoka ku ngomero z’amashanyarazi. Icyo gihe FONERWA yari imaze gutanga inkunga ya miliyoni 100 z’amadorali, iyi nkunga ikaba ihabwa imishinga yatsinze binyuze mu marushanwa.

title: Ubushakashatsi bwerekanye ko Umuryango w’ingagi zo mu Birunga uri kwaguka
content: Ubwo bushakashatsi bwerekana ko ingagi zo mu ishyamba rya Bwindi muri Uganda na Sarambwe muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (RDC) zavuye kuri 400 zikagera kuri 459. Mu Rwanda, imibare y’ingagi yariyongereye zigera kuri 604 zivuye kuri 480 zabarurwaga umwaka ushize. Ibyo byatumye ingagi zibarurwa mu gice cy’imisozi y’Ibirunga zigera ku 1,063. Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe bigizwemo uruhare n’Ikigega cyita ku ngagi muri Pariki y’Ibirunga (Dian Fossey Gorillas Fund) bushyirwa ahagaragara ku wa mbere tariki 16 Ukuboza 2019. Umuyobozi wa Dian Fossey, Dr Tara Stoinski, yagize ati “ Ibyavuye muri ubu bushakashatsi ni gihamya y’imbaraga zo kwita ku bidukikije, hagati ya Guverinoma zirimo iy’u Rwanda, RDC na Uganda.” Yongeyeho, ati “Ingagi zo mu misozi ni zimwe mu nyamaswa zirinzwe cyane kuri uyu mugabane, kandi uyu munsi turabona icyo imbaraga z’abafatanyabikorwa mu kuzitaho zishobora gukora. Ni akazi gakomeye ku baturage, abayobozi ba za Guverinoma n’ababungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, ariko bishobora gukorwa.” Mu bushakashatsi bwabanje, ku ngagi zo mu misozi, ababukoze bageze mu bice byose by’ishyamba bashaka ibyafasha kubona amakuru ku ngagi n’izindi z’inyamabere n’ibimenyetso by’ibikorwa bya muntu. Mu bikorwa byabo bakusanyije umwanda wazo kugira ngo harebwe inkomoko yazo, ibyo byakozwe inshuro ebyiri kuva muri Werurwe kugeza Gicurasi 2018 no kuva mu Kwakira kugeza Ukuboza 2018 kugira ngo bimenyekane neza ko buri ngagi yagezweho. Mu mwaka ushize, Ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe iterambere (RDB) cyongeye ubuso bwa Pariki y’igihugu y’Ibirunga iherereye mu Majyaruguru y’u Rwanda buva kuri Hegitari 16,000 bugera ku 16,027 hagamije kwita ku rusobe rw’ibinyabuzima biyirimo.

title: Imvura imaze guhitana abantu 15 hirya no hino mu gihugu
content:
Guhera mu Ukwakira uyu mwaka mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu hagaragaye imvura nyinshi kurusha iyari isanzwe. Ni imvura y’umuhindo Minisiteri y’ibidukikije igaragaza ko ubwinshi bwayo bwatewe n’uruhurirane rw’imiyaga ituruka mu nyanjya y’u Buhinde n’ituruka mu ishyamba rya Congo. Mu kiganiro Kubaza bitera Kumenya cyatambutse kuri Radiyo Rwanda kuri iki Cyumweru tariki 8 Ukuboza, Umunyamabanga Uhoraho muri Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije , Fatina Mukarubibi yavuze ko imvura imaze guhitana abanyarwanda 15 ikangiza n’ibindi bikorwa byinshi. Yagize ati “Muri iyi minsi imvura yabaye nyinshi, ibiza byahitanye ubuzima bw’abantu 15 n’amatungo ndetse hangiritse imyaka iri mu mirima, imihanda, ibiraro amashuri. Ahibasiwe cyane ni mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo n’Iburengerazuba.” Mu guhangana n’ibyo biza, Mukarubibi yavuze ko hakozwe ikarita igaragaza ahantu hashobora kwibasirwa n’ibiza ndetse n’ibigomba kuhakorwa mu rwego rwo kurwanya isuri inashobora gutera imyuzure. 
By’umwihariko muri ibi bihe, yasabye abaturage kuzirika ibisenge, guca imirwanyasuri no gusibura inzira z’amazi kandi bagatanga amakuru igihe hari ahabaye ibibazo by’ibiza. Mu ngamba z’igihe kirekire, Mukarubibi yavuze ko hari imirimo irimo ikorwa mu rwego rwo kurinda no gusubiranya icyogogo cya Sebeya kuko umugezi wa Sebeya nawo wagiye uteza ibiza mu myaka ishize.
