Hari kandi gusaba abubaka gushyiraho uburyo bwo gufata amazi ava ku bisenge by’inzu. Mu rwego rwo gukumira ko ibiza by’imvura byangiza ibikorwaremezo nk’imihanda n’ibiraro , Mukarubibi avuga ko begereye inzego zibishinzwe kugira ngo bijye byubakwa habanje kwegeranywa amakuru ya tekiniki azatuma ibyubatswe biramba. Yatanze urugero rw’ikiraro cya Nyabarongo cyajyaga kirengerwa n’amazi mu bihe by’imvura, ubu bikaba byarakosowe. Imvura nyinshi imaze iminsi igwa no mu bindi bihugu bya Afurika y’Iburasirazuba ndetse imaze guhitana abasaga 250. Kimwe cya kabiri cy’abapfuye ni abo muri Kenya, mu gihe yagize ingaruka ku baturage basaga miliyoni eshatu. Biteganyijwe ko muri uko kwezi imvura ikomeza kugwa ari nyinshi.

title: Minisitiri Mujawamariya yibukije abangiza ibidukikije ko nta yindi si bafite yo kuzaturaho
content: Ibi yabigarutseho kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki 19 Ugushyingo 2019, ubwo iyi Minisiteri yahuraga n’abafatanyabikorwabayo harebwa uko bakomeza kunoza ubufatanya mu kurengera ibidukikije. Iyangirika ry’amashamba, imyuka ihumanya ikirere iva mu nganda no mu binyabiziga, ndetse n’ibindi bikorwa bitandukanye bya muntu, ni bimwe mu biza ku isonga mu gukomeza kwangiza ibidukikije hirya no hino ku Isi. Minisitiri Mujawamariya avuga ko iyi nama iba igamije guhuza abafatanyabikorwa mu bikorwa bitandukanye barimo abakora mu by’amashyamba, ubutaka n’abandi, intego ari ugukokomeza kugira igihugu cyiza. Ati “Dukeneye kubungabunga ibidukije ariko n’igihugu gikeneye amajyambere byaba mu bucuruzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro n’ahandi, icyo dusaba abafatanyabikorwa ni ugukomeza mu nzira turimo nk’u Rwanda dukomeza guteza imbere ibidukikije, kandi dukomeza kugira igihugu kirangwamo n’ibidukikije byitaweho kuva ku mwana kugera ku mu kambwe.” Ati “Iyi si dutuyeho niyo yonyine dufite aho gutura, tugomba rero kuyirinda kubera ko nta handi dufite dutura ni aha gusa, buri wese uko yaba angana kose akwiye kumva ko ari inshingano ze zo kubungabunga ibidukikije.” Umuyobozi w’Ikigo gishinzwe kubungabunga ibidukikije, Eng. Coletha Ruhamya, yavuze ko hakiri imbogamizi mu kubungabunga ibidukikije zirimo ingengo y’imari igenerwa uru rwego, kudahuza ibikorwa mu nzego ndetse n’ishoramari ridahagije mu kurinda ibidukikije. Agira ati "Usanga ingengo y’imari leta yakoresheje yose, 2,9% ni yo yagiye mu bintu birengera ibidukikije, ibyo byose rero turashaka kureba ukuntu izo nzego zindi zibishyira muri gahunda yazo.’’

title: Abahanga batanze umuburo ku ngaruka zishobora kwibasira Isi kubera udusimba duto dukomeje gupfa
content: Ubushakashatsi buheruka gukorwa na Kaminuza ya Sussex mu Bwongereza, bugaragaza ko umubare w’udusimba duto turi ku Isi ukomeje kugenda ugabanuka mu buryo bukabije, by’umwihariko 41% byatwo byagabanutse bitewe n’ingaruka z’ihindagurika ry’ibihe, ibiza, ibikorwa bya muntu n’ibindi. Umwarimu wigisha amasomo y’ibinyabuzima muri kaminuza ya Sussex, akaba n’umwe mu bayoboye ubwo bushakashatsi, Dave Goulson, yavuze ko ‘Iryo gabanuka nirikomeza, ingaruka zizaba nyinshi’. Ati “Bitatu bya kane (3/4) by’ibihingwa byacu bibeshwaho n’udusimba duto. Ibihingwa bizatangira kurumba. Ntituzongera kugira imbuto zirimo nk’inkeri...Ntitwabasha kugaburira abantu barenga miliyari 7.5 utu dusimba tudahari.” Gusa iyi raporo basohoye igaragaza ko mu gihe abantu bashyize hamwe babasha kubona igisubizo ku kibazo kigaragara nka kirimbuzi. Ati “Udusimba tuba mu busitari na Pariki byacu, abazitaho bashobora gukora ibitangaza. Igikenewe cyane ni uguhindura abahizi bakaba inshuti n’inyamaswa, bakagabanya gukoresha imiti yica udukoko. Ibyo byafasha cyane.” Abayikoze batanga inama z’uko kandi abantu bakwiye guhinga ibihingwa bifasha iyororoka ry’ibimera akenshi bigizwemo uruhare n’utwo dusimba duto turimo nk’inzuki igihe zirimo gutara. Ubushakashatsi bugaragaza ko utu dusimba duto turimo kugabanuka mu buryo bukabije mu bihugu birimo u Budage na Puerto Rico. Igaragaza ko muri rusange utu disimba ku mwaka tugabanukaho nibura 2.5%. By’umwihariko mu Bwongereza iyi raporo yibanze igaragaza ko hagati ya 1968 na 2007 twagabanutseho nibura 28%. Abakoze iyi nyigo bavuga ko hari izindi zisaga 70 zakozwe ariko nta mpinduka igaragara mu kutubungabunga cyane cyane mu Burayi na Amerika ya Ruguru.

title: Intara y’Iburasirazuba yahawe umwihariko mu gutera amashyamba kubera ubuke bwayo
content: Ibi yabitangaje ubwo hatangizwaga igihembwe cyo gutera amashyamba 2019/2020 cyatangirijwe mu Murenge wa Rukumberi mu Karere ka Ngoma ahatewe ibiti ibihumbi 16 ku buso bungana na hegitari 80. Muri iki gihembwe iburasirazuba hazaterwa amashyamba ku buso bungana na hegitari 609.8, haterwe ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka kuri hegitari 5138.6. Hazavugururwa kandi amashyamba angana na hegitari 275 ndetse hanaterwe ibiti by’imbuto ibihumbi 163 505 mu rwego rwo guhangana n’ikibazo cy’ubutaka bunini budateweho ibiti burangwa muri iyi ntara. Akarere ka Kirehe niko kazaterwamo ibiti byinshi aho kazaterwamo amashyamba angana na hegitari 276, ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka bingana na hegitari 286 n’ibiti by’imbuto 9750. Mukarubibi Fitina yavuze ko bahaye umwihariko iyi ntara kugira ngo bahangane n’ikibazo cy’amashyamba make akunda kuyigaragaramo bigatuma ibice bimwe na bimwe bitabonekamo imvura nkuko bikwiye. Yakomeje avuga ko bishimira ko intego igihugu cyari cyarihaye yo gutera amashyamba ku kigero cya 30% cy’ubuso bw’igihugu yagezweho mbere ya 2020. Ati “Mu gice cy’iburasirazuba ho baracyari inyuma cyane nko mu Karere ka Ngoma turacyari kuri 12 by’ubuso buteweho amashyamba, biradusaba imbaraga kugira ngo tuzamure iyo mibare ariko n’abaturage barasabwa kubigira ibyabo kugira ngo bya biti babirere bihinduke ishyamba.” Yongeyeho ati “Ubu tugiye gufatanya dushyireho gahunda yihariye yo gutera amashyamba mu burasirazuba by’umwihariko nka Ngoma n’ahandi, hari ubwoko bw’ibiti byagaragaye ko bishobora kwera muri iki gice kandi bigatanga umusaruro harimo nk’igiti cy’umugazi, igifenesi n’ibindi bitandukanye bivangwa n’imyaka, ibyo byose nibyo tugiye gutera muri iyi ntara.” Mukarubibi yavuze ko zimwe mu mpamvu zituma iyi ntara idakunda kugira amashyamba menshi harimo kuba ubutaka bwaho bukunda kugira umuswa mwinshi hakiyongeraho n’izuba ryinshi. Yasabye abaturage bo mu burasirazuba gukoresha ibiyaga bafite buhira ibiti kugira ngo bahangane n’izuba rikunda kubyumisha. Abaturage bavuga ko zimwe mu mpamvu zituma muri iyi ntara ibiti bihaterwa bidakura ngo biterwa nuko hakunda kugaragara izuba ryinshi na bike bizamutse bikaragirwamo amatungo . Habanabakize Daniel utuye mu Murenge wa Rukumberi yagize ati “ Ibiti inaha turabitera ariko hari bamwe muri twe babiragiramo amatungo bigatuma bitazamuka, ikindi ni ubutaka bw’inaha usanga kubera izuba ryinshi ridapfa kubyorohera mu mikurire yabyo.” Mukakayibanda Verediana we yagize ati “ Hari abantu babyahuramo inka nijoro kuburyo banazishora no mu mirima yacu, kugira ngo ibiti dutera bikure rero nuko leta idufasha mu guhana abo bantu bonesha amashyamba yacu.” Ibarura riheruka gukorwa mu 2016 ryagaragaje ko amashyamba y’abaturage ari ku kigereranyo cya 67% y’ubuso, naho aya leta akaba ku kigereranyo cya 33%. Hagaragajwe kandi ko amashyamba y’abaturage afashwe nabi kandi afite umusaruro muke.

title: Miliyoni 12 z’amadolari zigiye gushorwa mu mushinga wo kwita ku bidukikije i Gicumbi
content: Umushinga wiswe uwa Gicumbi (Green Gicumbi Project), uzamara imyaka itandatu uhereye mu Ukwakira 2019, ukora ibikorwa byo kwita ku bidukikije mu Karere ka Gicumbi. Arenga miliyoni $ 12.5 muri miliyoni $ 32 azakoreshwa muri uwo mushinga wose, azajya mu bikorwa byo kubungabunga ibishanga, inkengero z’imigezi n’ibindi bikorwa byerekeye ubuhinzi. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere ka Gicumbi, Epimaque Mpayimana avuga ko kubera imiterere y’ako Karere, imvura igira ingaruka zikomeye ku buhinzi kubera imisozi itarwanyijeho isuri. Ati “Twe tugira umwihariko kuko ari imisozi miremire, iyo ahantu rero hari imisozi miremire cyane cyane itarwanyijeho isuri, duhura n’imyuzure, isuri, imihanda ikangirika, ibiraro bigacika n’amazi menshi ingaruka mu by’ukuri ni nyinshi ugereranyije no mu tundi turere, imyaka kumanurwa n’isuri, abaturage bagahinga ariko bamara gutera isuri ikaza ikabitwara.” Avuga ko mu by’ibanze uwo mushinga uzabafasha ari ugutunganya imisozi ihanamye. Agira ati “Mu buryo bw’ikubitiro azabanza kujya, kudufasha gutunganya imisozi ihanamye, ni ukuvuga ngo iyo utunganyije iyo misozi, ya mirima yo mu bishanga yajyaga itwikirwa n’isuri uba ukoze ku buryo itakwangirika. ibihinzwemo uba ufite icyizere kuko uko wahinze ushobora kweza nta suri ibitwaye.” Ni umushinga ashimangira ko uziye igihe kuburyo n’abaturage bitezweho kugaragaza ubufatanye mu bikorwa byawo. Mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari ushize Akarere ka Gicumbi kabashije gutunganya Hegitari 2,000 z’amaterasi y’indinganire. Icyakora n’ubundi kugeza ubu ngo hari imisozi itarakorerwaho ubuhinzi kubera imiterere yayo. Amaterasi namara kugera kuri iyo misozi bizaba byongereye ubutaka buhingwa n’umusaruro uva mu buhinzi ukaziyongere. nkuko Mpayimana abisobanura, agira ati “Ni ukuvuga ngo rero tubonye izindi hegitari ziyongera zirwanyijeho isuri ziriho amaterasi y’indinganire mu byukuri kiba ari igisubizo kirambye ku baturage bacu kubera ko ubutaka bwo guhinga buba bwiyongeye. Hari ahantu imisozi ihanamye kuburyo udashobora gukoreraho imirimo y’ubuhinzi ubu ngubu. Iyo ukoze amaterasi uba wongeye ubuso buhingwa kandi kongera ubuso buhingwa bisobanuye ko uba wongereye umusaruro. Imibare y’ikigo cy’ibarurishamibare mu Rwanda yerekena ko mu Karere ka Gicumbi, amaterasi ari ku buso bungana na hegitari 8,653.5 naho ubutaka burwanyijeho isuri muri rusange bungana na 88.2%. Uyu mushinga wanyujijwe mu kigega cyita ku bidukikije n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe mu Rwanda (Fonerwa). Umuyobozi w’icyo kigega Hubert Ruzibiza, avuga ko uzita no ku bindi bikorwa bireba imibereho y’abatuye Gicumbi ndetse no gutera ibiti. Ikindi kandi ukazafatwa nk’icyitegererezo cyo kwigiraho kuburyo wazakomereza mu tundi turere tw’igihugu. Ati “Uyu mushinga wa Gicumbi dufatanyije n’ikigega cy’Isi cyita ku bidukikije, twafatanyije gushyira amafaranga muri Gicumbi tumaze kubona ibibazo yanyuzemo cyane cyane ku bireba ibidukikije […] dushaka kuzamura ubuzima bw’abaturage no kureba babaho muri rusange no gutera ibiti, iki ni icyiciro cya mbere tuzayifata nk’icyitegererezo cyo gutuma ukomereza mu tundi duce tw’u Rwanda.” Imibare y’ikigo cy’ibarurishamibare mu Rwanda y’igihembwe cy’ihinga cya 2019-B yerekana mu buryo bwo kurwanya isuri, Gicumbi yari ifite amaterasi y’indinganire ku kigero cya 32.1% y’ubutaka bwahinzwe muri icyo gihembwe, 0.6% ahateye ibiti, n’imiringoti kuri 0.2%. Mu buhinzi akarere ka Gicumbi kibanda ku bishyimbo bishingirirwa, ingano, ibirayi, ibigori n’imyumbati ku butaka buhujwe burenga hegitari 32,164. Bahinga kawa ku buso bungana na hegitari 601,7 n’icyayi ku buso bungana na hegitari 1678,2.

title: Ubuso bw’u Rwanda 30 % bwamaze guterwaho amashyamba
content: Mu 2011, Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yihaye intego ko mu 2020, ubuso bungana na 30%, buzaba buteyeho amashyamba, naho mu 2030 bukaba bugeze kuri hegitari miliyoni ebyiri mu 2030, hagamijwe kurengera urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Mu isuzuma ry’aho urwego rw’amashyamba rugeze, mu ntego nyinshi zitandukanye rwihaye n’intego zo kuruteza imbere mu myaka iri imbere, hagaragajwe ko intego ya mbere yagezweho, nkuko The New Times yabitangaje. Minisitiri Vincent Biruta, yagize ati “Mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari wa 2018/19 urwego rw’ibidukikije n’umutungo kamere rwageze kuri byinshi ndashimira ubufatanye n’abafatanyabikorwa batandukanye. Ndagira ngo mbabwire ko ubwo bufatanye bwatumye tugera kuri 30% dutera amashyamba aho atari ateye n’aho yatemwe.” Iyi ni intego y’ibanze mu zigamijwe kugerwaho mu 2020. Ati “Dushobora kwishimira aho tugeze.” Inyigo yerekanye ko hagati ya 1990 na 2010, u Rwanda rwatakaje 37% by’amashyamba yarwo bitewe no kuyatema. Minisitiri Biruta yagize ati “Twongeye gutera ibiti aho byari bayatemwe kugira ngo tubungabunge imigezi kandi nishimiye kubabwira ko hegitari zirenga 3,000 zatewe kuri Nyabugogo, Muvumba, Sebeya n’igice cya ruguru cya Nyabarongo.” Yongeyeho ati “Abikorera bajya mu bijyanye no kubungabunga amashyamba nabo bariyongereye. 30% by’amashyamba ya leta ubu aracungwa n’abikorera kandi tuzakomeza gukorana n’abafatanyabikorwa mu kongera kugeza kuri 80% mu 2024.”  Amashyamba ya leta ari kuri hegitari 65,000 hatabariwemo Pariki z’igihugu. Mu gukaza politiki n’amategeko Minisitiri Biruta yavuze ko Minisiteri yashyizeho politiki nshya n’ingamba zigamije kwita ku mashyamba, ibidukikije, imihindagurikire y’ibihe, ubutaka no gucunga ibipimo by’ubushyuhe. Guverinoma yashyizeho uburyo bushya bwo kongera amashyamba bikozwe n’abikorera ndetse no kuyacunga neza. Yashyizeho amatsinda y’abikorera yo gucunga amashyamba “Private Forest Management Units:PFMU” aho amashyamba ari ku buso buto acungwa n’amakoperative. Ayo matsinda agizwe n’amakoperative 8 y’abikorera bato yageragerejwe mu turere twa Gakenke, Gicumbi, Rulindo na Rwamagana mu buryo bw’igerageza yabashije gutera amashyamba kuri hegitari 276. Umuryango Mpuzamahanga wita ku bidukije (IUCN) utangaza ko gusana hegitari imwe y’ubutaka haterwa amashyamba, bisaba amadolari asaga 1000 ariko mu Rwanda ngo ntageramo (ari hagati ya 200 na 400) kubera byinshi bikorwa n’abaturage mu muganda.

title: Minisitiri Biruta yashimye uruhare rwa Banki ya Kigali mu rugamba rwo kugira igihugu gitoshye
content: Yabigarutseho kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki 2 Ugushyingo 2019, mu muganda udasanzwe wo gutera ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka mu Murenge wa Rweru mu Karere ka Bugesera muri gahunda ya Banki ya Kigali yo gutera amashyamba, ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka n’imbuto. Banki ya Kigali yafatanyije n’ikigo mpuzamahanga cy’amashyamba, ishami ry’u Rwanda (ICRAF-Rwanda), mu gutubura imbuto no guhugura abaturage bazafasha bagenzi babo mu kubungabunga no kwita kuri ibi biti. Mu muganda wo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, mu Kagari ka Nemba, hatewe ibiti ibihumbi 61, ku buso bungana na hegitari 16. Ibiti byatewe birimo ubwoko bwa Grevillea (bibazwamo imbaho), Gracidea (bikurura umwuka), Calliandra na Leucaena. Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Bugesera, Mutabazi Richard yavuze ko iyo umuntu arebye amateka y’u Rwanda nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, ibiti byo muri aka karere byangijwe bitwikwamo amakara byaje gutuma mu 2000, akarere kaba ubutayu. Yakomeje agira ati “Byagize ingaruka ku baturage bacu murabizi bamwe baranasuhutse ariko Leta yahise ishaka icyakorwa ishyira imbaraga mu gutera amashyamba. Igikorwa cy’uyu munsi tunashimira Banki ya Kigali yatanze iyi nkunga, ni kimwe n’ibindi bigomba gukomeza gukorwa biri mu rwego rwo kugira ngo tugire Bugesera itoshye.” Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije mu Rwanda igaragaza ko u Burasirazuba bufitemo amashyamba make aho na Bugesera iri mu turere tudafite amashyamba akwiriye. Imbuto z’ibiti biri gutuburirwa i Bugesera ari nabyo byatewe uyu munsi zirimo izavanwe mu mahanga, aho Banki ya Kigali ariyo yatanze ubushobozi bwo kugura izi mbuto n’amahugurwa yahawe abafashamyumvire. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Banki ya Kigali, Dr Diane Karusisi yavuze ko nubwo batanga serivisi z’imari ariko bagomba kureba niba n’abaturage bafite imibereho myiza, ari nayo mpamvu bahisemo gutanga umusanzu mu kurengera ibidukikije ariko hanibandwa ku biti byagirira akamaro abaturage. Ati "Twarabitangiye mu myaka ishize i Gatsibo na Nyagatare ariko uyu mwaka twaje i Bugesera, ni akarere keza ariko iyo ureba mu misozi ya hano ubona nta biti bihari. Ibi biti ni ibyanyu, mugomba kubyitaho ku buryo uyu murenge wanyu uzatera imbere." Muri rusange Banki ya Kigali imaze gutera ibiti bigera ku bihumbi 500. Intego ni ugutera ibigera kuri miliyoni ariko hibandwa mu bice by’Iburasirazuba. Dr Karusisi yakomeje ati “Turashaka gukorana namwe abaturage dutera ibiti ku buryo mu bihe biri imbere nta bibazo by’imvura cyangwa amapfa n’imirire mibi bizongera kuba muri aka karere n’ahandi hose hari ibi bibazo. ” Mu 2011, Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yihaye intego ko mu 2020, ubuso bungana na 30%, buzaba buteyeho amashyamba, naho mu 2030 bukaba bugeze kuri hegitari miliyoni ebyiri mu 2030, hagamijwe kurengera urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Minisitiri Biruta avuga ko ibi bidashobora kugerwaho hatabayeho imbaraga z’abafatanyabikorwa by’umwihariko abikorera, aho yatanze urugero rwiza rwa Banki ya Kigali yatangiye kugira uruhare muri uru rugamba. Yavuze ko igice kinini cya Bugesera ari ubutaka bwiza kandi bwera ariko bwakwera neza bukanatanga umusaruro habayeho kubungabunga amashyamba. Ati "Aka karere karera neza , ariko kakwera kurushaho gateweho amashyamba. Ibyo birasaba gukomeza gufatanya kandi birashoboka. Mu 2000, aka karere kari kabaye ubutayu ariko ubu imvura yaragarutse nubwo idahagije. Bababwiye mwe nk’abaturage ko aya mashyamba turi gutera ari ayanyu mukwiye kuyitaho mukayabungabunga.” Minisitiri Biruta yashimye abafatanyabikorwa barimo BK avuga ko Mu 2015 yafatanyije na leta gutera ibiti mu Karere ka Gatsibo aho kuri ubu ishyamba rimeze neza. Yakomeje agira ati “Ibyakozwe na BK bigaragaza uruhare rw’abikorera mu kurengera ibidukikije. Dufatanyije na BK muri Bugesera ubushize twafatanyije I Gatsibo, ngaho ibaze ibigo by’imari byose biri mu Rwanda, buri kimwe cyafashe Akarere kamwe urumva byagenda bite? Turagira ngo dufatanye twubake u Rwanda rutoshye." Banki ya Kigali ntabwo yatanze ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka gusa ahubwo hari n’imbuto zirimo avoka, amapapayi ndetse n’imyembe. Ni mu gihe kandi gahunda ya leta ari uko nibura buri rugo rwo mu Rwanda rugira ibiti bitatu by’imbuto. Umwe mu baturage bo muri uyu Murenge wa Rweru witwa Tuyizere , yavuze ko bazakomeza gufatanya n’abaturage gukomeza kubungabunga ibi biti. Yagize ati "Ibi biti bitewe uyu munsi tuzabibungabunga kandi bitugirire akamaro ari ukutubyarira ifumbire n’imbuto ziribwa. Kuva aho dutangiye gutera ibiti bivamgwa n’imyaka by’umwihariko imbuto byagabanyije imirire mibi mu miryango yacu.” Ubuyobozi bwa Banki ya Kigali bwongeye kandi kwibutsa abaturage bo mu Karere ka Bugesera by’umwihariko abahinzi dore ko bagera ku bihumbi 32, kugana gahunda ya ‘Ikofi’ yashyiriweho abahinzi by’umwihariko. Ubu buryo buheruka kwiyongeraho serivisi y’imari ya IKOFI yatangijwe na Banki ya Kigali muri Gicurasi uyu mwaka, ifasha umuhinzi kubitsa amafaranga, kubikuza, kuyohereza ku buntu mu Rwanda, kwishyura imbuto n’inyongeramusaruro, ubwiteganyirize bwa ‘Ejo Heza’ n’ibindi.

title: TI-Rwanda igiye gukurikiranira hafi umushinga wa Gicumbi uzatwara miliyoni $ 32
content: Umushinga wo kwita ku bidukikije mu karere ka Gicumbi uzamara imyaka itandatu, ukazakorerwa mu Mirenge itandatu y’ako Karere; ariyo Rubaya, Cyumba, Kaniga, Mukarange, Rushaki na Shangasha. Imibare y’ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’umuryango urwanya ruswa n’akarengane mu 2017 yerekana ko imishinga yerekeye imihindagurikire y’ikirere yabayeho mu Rwanda yagiye irangwa n’ibura ry’uruhare rw’abaturage rimwe na rimwe n’abayobozi mu nzego z’ibanze ugasanga batayizi. Ibyo bigatuma abayishyira mu bikorwa bakoresha ingengo y’imari yayo mu buryo abagenerwabikorwa badasobanukiwe. Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa wa TI Rwanda, Mupiganyi Apolinaire asobanura ko imibare yerekana ko abaturage 55.5% batari bazi iby’iyo mishinga ndetse ngo hari n’abayobozi mu nzego z’ibanze bagera kuri 40.4% nabo ntibagishijwe inama ngo harebwe niba ariyo bakeneye cyangwa bamenye uruhare rwabo. Ati “Hari imbogamizi twabonye mu mishinga itandukanye nka za biogaz n’indi mishinga igerageza kugabanya kwangiza ibidukikije. Dushingiye kuri ibyo bibazo twabonye mu isesengura twakoze ku yindi mishinga yabanje, twafashe iya mberengo turebe uko twatera ingabo mu bitugu gahunda y’igihugu cyacu yo guha uruhare umuturage kugira ngo amenye ibimukorerwa”. Avuga ko ibi ari byo bizatuma bagira uruhare rukomeye bafatanyije n’indi miryango, inzego n’umuturage kugira ngo ibipimo by’abagenerwabikorwa bavugaga ko batazi ibikorerwa bigabanyuke. Ati "Turemera ko niba tuzamuye imyumvire y’umuturage, gukorera mu mucyo no kubaza utanga serivisi ibyo yakoze niba atabikurikiranye akabibazwa bizafasha kugira ngo uriya mushinga w’icyitegererezo muri Gicumbi uzagere ku ntego twifuza hanyuma bishobore no gukorerwa mu tundi turere.”  Yongeyeho ko bagendeye ku byo babonye mu bushakashatsi bakoze, uyu mushinga munini wa mbere FONERWA ikoze ugomba kurindwa ba rusahurira mu nduru. Umuyobozi mukuru wa FONERWA, Hubert Ruzibiza, yavuze ko binjiye mu bufatanye na TI Rwanda, kugira ngo uzabafashe mu ikurikiranabikorwa bityo ibyo abagenerwabikorwa, abafatanyabikorwa n’igihugu bawitezeho bizagerweho. Ati "Mu by’ukuri aya ni amafaranga menshi, kandi ibyitezwe biri hejuru cyane, yaba ari ku muturage yaba ari kuri twebwe, na leta cyangwa n’ikigega cyita ku bidukikije [cyateye inkunga uwo mushinga]”. Yongeyeho ko hari uburyo butandukanye burimo ubwo mu ikoranabuhanga buzatuma umuturage ashobora gutanga igitekerezo ku byo abona aho umushinga uri gukorerwa, ku buryo ayo makuru yagera no ku bafatanyabikorwa b’umushinga baba mu mahanga. Biteganyijwe ko mu myaka itandatu uyu mushinga uzafasha abaturage kugabanya imyuka ya gaz carbonique (CO2) ingana na toni 273,720. Uzagera ku baturage 150,000 ugirire akamaro abarenga 380,000 muri rusange.

title: Igifenesi, urubuto rushobora kuba imari ishyushye ku isoko ry’u Rwanda
content: Uru rwagwa aho aruranguza barugurisha amafaranga 500 ariko ngo ntarashobora guhaza isoko afite bitewe n’uko ari rinini cyane. Uyu mugore byamuteje imbere ku buryo yubatse uruganda rukora inzoga muri urwo rubuto, akaba afite gahunda yo guhinga ibifenesi byinshi no kubikangurira abandi. Igifenesi ni rumwe mu mbuto zo bwoko bw’inkeri bitewe n’uburyo kiremye, kikaba gikomoka mu Buhinde ariko gikunze kugaragara cyane no muri Thailand, Malaysia na Indonesia. Mu Rwanda urubuto rw’igifenesi ntirukunze kugaragara nk’izindi bitewe n’uko abanyarwanda bataratangira kwitabira kuruhinga, ariko ni urubuto rukize cyane ku ntungamubiri ndetse runafasha kugabanya umuvuduko w’amaraso, kugira uruhu rwiza n’isukari y’umwimerere. Mugabo Jean Pierre uyobora ishami ry’amashyamba mu Kigo gishinzwe guteza imbere amazi n’Amashyamba, RWFA, yavuze ko ari urubuto abantu benshi bakwiriye guhinga. Ati “Igifenesi ni urubuto rwifitemo isukari y’umwimerere, kigabanya umuvuduko w’amaraso, gifasha umuntu kugira uruhu rwiza, kikagira n’intungamubiri za magnesium zigira uruhare mu gukomeza amagufa.” Mugabo yongeraho ko igifenesi gifasha umuntu kubona neza cyane cyane kubageze mu zabukuru, kikagira ubutare buvura indwara yo kubura amaraso bukanatera amaraso kudatembera neza. Ikindi ni uko ibiti by’ibifenesi bishobora kwifashishwa mu kwirinda isuri, bikaba byakwifashishwa kandi mu gukora ibikoresho byo mu nzu, imirimo y’ubwubatsi, ibikoresho by’umuziki. Igifenesi kandi cyifashishwa mu gukora verini basiga imbaho, guhoma ubwato n’imyenge y’indobo. Mugabo yakanguriye abanyarwanda gutera igiti cy’igifenesi cyane ko ngo Ishami ry’amashyamba mu Kigo gishinzwe guteza imbere amazi n’Amashyamba, RWFA, rizabafasha kubona ingemwe, bakaba baniteguye gushyira igiti cy’igifenesi mu bizaterwa mu gikorwa ngarukamwaka cyo gutera ibiti. Ati “Abanyarwanda turabasaba kugitera ku buryo buhagije kugira ngo n’abagikeneye babashe kukibona cyane ko bashobora kubibona mu buhumbikiro butandukanye. Twebwe tuzakomeza kubafasha kubona ingemwe kugira ngo cyinjizwe no muri gahunda ngarukamwaka yo gutera ibiti, dufashe n’abikorera kucyongerera umusaruro.” Urubuto rw’igifenesi rweze rupima ibiro hagati ya 3-5, rukaba rumara amezi 16 mu buhumbikiro. Kugira ngo nyirarwo atangire kurusarura ni uko byibuze ruba rumaze imyaka itandatu rutewe. Igifenesi gisarurwa kabiri mu mwaka, igiti kimwe gifite ubushobozi bwo kwera imbuto 200. Ni igiti gikunze guhingwa mu duce dushyuha nko mu Bugesera, Kayonza, Huye, Gisagara, Nyanza, Ngoma na Rusizi. Mu 2018, Akarere ka Ngoma nka kamwe mu duce duhingwamo igifenesi cyasaruye toni 69. Ku isoko usanga uru rubuto ruri hagati ya 1000-1500 Frw. Inkuru bijyanye: Uko Kankwanzi yahaye agaciro igifenesi muri Kirehe agikoramo inzoga

title: Byinshi ku kayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba gakomeje guhangayikisha Isi
content: Abahanga bavuga ko aka kayunguruzo ari umwuka uboneka mu kirere ku bilometero hagati ya 15-30 uvuye ku butaka, ukaba utandukanye n’umwuka abantu bahumeka wa Oxygène. Abantu benshi bakunze kwibaza icyo ako kayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba kayungurura, imiterere yako n’ingano gafite. Umwarimu mu Ishami rya Kaminuza y’u Rwanda y’Ubumenyi n’Ikoranabuhanga mu ishami ry’ubutabire, Dr. Birame Sekomo Christian, avuga ko imirasire y’izuba ifite imbaraga n’ubukana butandukanye. Asobanura ko iyo imirasire y’izuba imanutse ivuye mu isanzure, umwuka wa Ozone uhita utangira kuyiyungurura ikagira iyo yemerera kugera ku isi (ari ryo zuba tubona), hakaba n’imirasire yitwa ‘Ultraviolet’ ifite ubukana bwangiza igera ku kayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba igahita isubira mu kirere kubera ko kaba katayemereye ko ihita. Gusa iyo akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba kangiritse, ya mirasire ifite ubukana ibasha kukanyuramo bikagira ingaruka ku bantu n’ibindi binyabuzima. Ku bavuga ko akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba wakabonesha amaso cyangwa ari ikintu gifatika, Dr. Birame avuga ko baba bibeshya cyane kuko ni umwuka ntabwo ari ikintu gifatika, nta nubwo wakabonesha amaso. Uko akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba kangirika Dr Birame avuga ko kwangirika kw’akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba bituruka ku kuba katewe n’ibindi binyabutabire bituruka ahanini mu byo dukora mu nganda zacu na gaz dukoresha mu byuma bikonjesha nka za firigo n’ibindi bitanga ubuhehere mu nzu z’abantu no mu modoka. Ibyo binyabutabire byangiza akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba birimo Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs), Hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs), Hydrobromofluorocarbons (HBFCs), Halons, Methyl bromide na Carbon tetrachloride. Imyuka kandi irimo ibinyabutabire nka chlorine, Bromine na Fluorine, iyo izamutse igahura n’umwuka wa Ozone ari ko kayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba iragasenya. Uyu mwarimu avuga ko kuva ibihugu bitandukanye ku isi byashyira umukono ku masezerano ya Montreal yari agamije kurebera hamwe uburyo bwo kubungabunga akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba mu 1987, hagiye habaho impinduka nziza. Ibi abishingira ko mu bipimo byafashwe mu 1990 byerekanye ko aka kayunguruzo karimo gusubirana. Dr Birame avuga ko amasezerano ya Montreal ari amwe mu yatanze umusaruro ugaragara ugereranyije n’andi agenda asinywa. Mu 2016 mu Rwanda hasinywe amasezerano ya Kigali agamije kurwanya iyoherezwa mu kirere ry’imyuka ituruka mu byuma bikonjesha. Amasezerano ya Kigali (Kigali Amendment) avugurura amasezerano ya Montreal yerekeye imyuka yangiza akayunguruzo k’izuba yasinywe mu 1987. Isano y’ubushyuhe bw’izuba na Ozone Dr. Birame avuga ko kuba izuba ryavuye ari ryinshi ku Isi ubushyuhe bukaba bwinshi nta sano bifitanye n’akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba ahubwo ubwiyongere bw’abantu ku isi, ibikorwa abantu bagenda bakora nko gutwika imodoka, ari byo bishobora gutera ubwiyongere bw’ubushyuhe ku isi. Ati “Ntaho bihurira, tugomba kumenya ko isi ari yayindi idahinduka ariko umubare w’abantu uriyongera n’ibikorwa by’abantu bikiyongera umunsi ku munsi. Ni ukuvuga ngo hari iyindi myanda twe tujugunya hanze igira ingaruka mbi ku bihe. Hari indi myuka twohereza mu kirere urugero nko gutwika imodoka na mazutu, ibyo bituma ubushyuhe bwiyongera ku isi.” Yongeraho ko gutwika amavuta y’indege, ibiti n’ibindi bintu byose byifitemo izindi ngufu, bizamura umwuka mubi wa CO2 ugira uruhare mu kongera ubushyuhe ku isi. Ati “Iyo utwitse ikintu gisanzwe gifite ingufu muri cyo, izo ngufu ntabwo zitakara ahubwo zirimuka zigahindura iyindi shusho. Iyo utwitse igiti hasigara ivu, ariko se bwa bunini bw’igiti bwagiye he? Bwahindutse umwuka bujya mu kirere.” Ingaruka zo kwangirika kw’akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba Ingaruka za mbere zo kwangirika kw’akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba ni uko urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima byangirika. Amafi mu nyanja aragabanuka kuko ibiribwa by’amafi byo bihita byangirika iyo bihuye n’imirasire ifite ubukana ya ultra violet [ifite ubukana]. Amababi ku bimera nayo arangirika iyo yahuye n’imirasire ifite ubukana agahinduka umukara. Ibyo bituma igikorwa cya photosynthèse gituma amababi yaba icyatsi nk’uko bisanzwe kitaba kubera iyo mirasire mibi. Dr. Birame akomeza avuga ko kwangirika kw’akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba bigira ingaruka no ku bantu nko kuzana ishaza mu jisho, no kurwara kanseri y’uruhu. Buri mwaka iyi myuka ifite ubukana yiyongera mu kirere ku kigero cya 10% na 15 %. Ikibi cyayo kandi iguma mu kirere imyaka igera kuri 29.

title: Inyoni zo muri Canada na Amerika zagabanyutseho hafi miliyari eshatu mu myaka 49
content: Ubwo bushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko inyoni zo muri ibyo bihugu zagabanyutseho 29 % mu myaka 49 ishize, kandi ko ari ikimenyetso kibi ku bijyanye no kubungabunga ibidukikije. Bwakozwe n’abashakashatsi bo muri Amerika na Canada, ikigo gishinzwe inyoni muri Amerika n’ibindi bigo byita ku rusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Ibyavuyemo byagaragaje ko 90 % by’inyoni zagabanyutse cyane ari izo mu moko 12 zirimo ibishwi, intashya n’ibindi. Inyonzi zibasiwe cyane kandi ni iziba mu mu kenke n’ahandi haba ibyatsi byinshi, aho zagabanyutseho izigera kuri miliyoni 720. Inyoni zo mu ku mazi no ku migezi nazo zagabanyuteho kimwe cya gatatu. Peter Marra, umwe mu bakoze ubushakashatsi yavuze ko hakwiriye gufatwa ingamba zikomeye kuri iri gabanyuka rikabije ry’inyoni, kuko zifite uruhare runini mu buzima bwa muntu. Abashakashatsi ntabwo bagaragaje impamvu yihariye inyoni zagabanyutse ariko bavuga ko ari ikibazo kiri hirya no hino ku isi. Nko muri Amerika y’Amajyaruguru, bavuga ko kugabanyuka bishobora kuba byaratewe n’ibibazo mu mibereho y’inyoni no kororoka kwazo. Ikindi bakeka kuba intandaro y’igabanyuka, harimo kwiyongera kw’ibikorwa bya muntu nk’ubuhinzi bukorerwa aho inyoni zabaga no kutitabwaho. Hari kandi ibikorwa by’imijyi n’ubwiyongere bw’abaturage, ikoreshwa ry’imiti yica udukoko twatungaga inyoni n’ibindi. Basabye ko hafatwa ingamba zikomeye mu kubungabunga inyoni, haba ku mpande za Guverinoma n’abaturage ubwabo.

title: Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko Isi iri mu kaga kubera ubushyuhe bukabije buri kwiyongera
content: Raporo y’ubwo bushakashatsi yatangarijwe mu nama ikomeye y’Umuryango w’Abibumbye yiga ku mihindagurikire y’ikirere ubwo Umunyamabanga mukuru, Antonio Guterres yahamagariraga ibihugu kongera ingamba zo kugabanya ibyuka bihumanya Ikirere. Raporo “Ishimangira ko hagomba gushyirwaho ingamba zihamye zo guhangana n’ikibazo cy’ubushyuye n’ingaruka zikomeye z’imihindagurikire y’Ikirere”. Impuzandengo y’ubushyuhe bwaranze Isi hagati ya 2015 na 2019 igaragaza ko kugeza ubu ariyo myaka itanu igiye kurangwa n’ubushyuhe bukabije mu mateka y’Umubumbe w’Isi, nkuko byagaragajwe n’iyo raporo. Igaragaza ko “Ubu ubushyuhe bwazamutseho 1.10C ugereranyije na mbere y’iterambere ry’inganda hagati y’imyaka ya 1850 na 1900 na 0.20C z’ubushyuhe ugereranyije no kuva 2011 kugeza 2015”. Umuyobozi mukuru w’Itsinda rirwanya umwuka wa Karubone (anti-carbon group E3G), Tom Burke, yabwiye Al Jazeera ko ikibazo kiri kwiyongera kurusha uko abantu babitekereza. Ati “Ndatekereza ko ibyago biri kwiyongera bivuze ko dufite igihe gito cyo gukemura icyo kibazo kurusha uko tubitekereza. Ni ukuvuga ngo niba dushaka kurandura imihindagurikire y’Ikirere tugomba guhagarika gutwika ibinyabutabire byohereza ibyuka bihumanya ikirere.” Mu cyumweru gishize, Guterres yavuze ko Isi iri gutatanya imbaraga ashingiye kuri iyo raporo igaragaza icyuho kiri hagati y’ibisabwa n’ibiri gukorwa. Mu 2018 umwuka uhumanya ikirere, CO2 wiyongeyeho 2% bihita bigeza ku mubare wo hejuru mu mateka ungana na Toni miliyari 37. Igiteye impungenge ni uko nta bimenyetso bigaragara byo kugera ku ntego yo gutangira kugabanyuka kw’ibyo byuka byoherezwa mu kirere. Amasezerano y’i Paris yo mu 2015 agaragaza ko ibihugu byiyemeje gushyiraho ingamba zo kugabanya izamuka ry’ubushyuhe kugeza nibura kuri 20C cyangwa 1.50C kuko aribyo bishobora guhagarika izamuka ry’ubushyuhe mu buryo buhamye. Gusa ubwo bushakashatsi bwatanze umuburo uvuga ko nubwo buri gihugu cyagera kuri iyo ntego, ubushyuhe buzazamuka kuva kuri 2.90C kugera kuri 3.40C. Kandi nabyo kugira ngo bishoboke ni uko Ibihugu byakuba gatatu umuvuduko biri kugenderaho ubu bishaka kugera kuri 1.50C.

title: Guverinoma iri kwiga ku buryo bwo kubungabunga ibirwa biri mu Rwanda
content: Umuyobozi ushinzwe iby’igenzura ry’amategeko ajyanye n’ibidukikije mu kigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Ibidukikije (REMA), Remy Duhuze yabwiye The New Times dukesha iyi nkuru ko iyo mbanzirizamushinga iri kuganirwaho n’inzego zitandukanye. Duhuze yavuze ko kugeza ubu mu Rwanda bamaze kumenya ko hari ibirwa 131 mu biyaga bitandukanye biri hirya no hino mu gihugu. Ati “Mu Rwanda hari ibiyaga 23. Muri byo hari ibirwa 131 tumaze kumenya, muri byo ibirwa 113 biri mu kiyaga cya Kivu ku ruhande rw’u Rwanda. Tugomba kubimenya neza no kubishyira mu byiciro kugira ngo turusheho kubibungabunga.” Inzobere mu bidukikije zivuga ko ibirwa ari iby’agaciro ku rusobe rw’ibinyabuzima kuko akenshi bibaho ubwoko bw’inyamaswa n’ibimera bidakunze kuboneka ahandi. Ibirwa bikunze kuba intaho ikomeye y’ibiguruka birimo inyoni, ndetse bivugwa ko ibirwa ku isi bituweho n’abantu basaga miliyoni 600, ni ukuvuga kimwe cya cumi cy’abatuye isi yose. Duhuze yavuze ko kubw’ako kamaro kose k’ibirwa, bafashe ingamba zo kubibungabunga. Ati “Bimwe mu biri kwigwaho ni ugushyira ibirwa mu byiciro bibiri. Icya mbere ni icy’ibirwa bishobora guturwaho bikaba byakoreshwa mu mirimo itandukanye nko mu buhinzi, ariko bikubahiriza amabwiriza. Ikindi cyiciro ni icy’ibirwa bizaba ibya Leta bikitabwaho mu buryo bwihariye nyuma yo kwimura no guha ingurane ababituyeho.” Duhuze yavuze ko hari n’abasaba ko habaho ibyiciro bitatu by’ibirwa. Ati “Harimo ibirwa bishobora guturwaho bikanakorerwaho ibikorwa bitandukanye. Icyiciro cya kabiri byaba ibirwa byahindurwamo ahantu h’ubukerarugendo hakaba hanubakwa amahoteli, naho icya gatatu ni icyiciro cy’ibirwa byabungabungwa ku buryo nta gikorwa kindi na kimwe kihakorerwa.” Yavuze ko bakiri kwiga kuri iryo tegeko kuko bigaragara ko hazazamo ibyo kwimura abaturage kubw’ingurane. Duhuze yavuze ko iryo tegeko rizanarushaho gutuma ibinyabuzima biri ku birwa no mu mazi abikikije birindwa kwangizwa, kuko byagaragaye ko hari abaturage batuye mu birwa batubahiriza amategeko agenga ibidukikije nko kutagira ibikorwa bikorerwa muri metero 50 uvuye ku mazi. Yavuze ko ibyo bituma hari ubwo nk’imiti bashyira mu bihingwa imanuka ikajya mu mazi, ikica ibinyabuzima biyarimo. Duhuze avuga ko batangiye igenzura ku bikorwa byangiza ibidukikije bikorerwa ku birwa, ababikora ndetse n’ikigero cy’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima bimaze kwangizwa. Kwangiza urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima biri mu mazi bishobora kugira ingaruka ku musaruro w’amafi nko mu kiyaga cya Kivu gikorerwamo uburobyi cyane. Bumwe mu bwoko bw’amafi buboneka mu kiyaga cya Kivu harimo nk’Isambaza, Indugu na tilapia. Ikiyaga cya Kivu mu mwaka wa 2018 cyarobwemo amafi angana na toni 18,879, ni ukuvuga 70 % by’umusaruro w’amafi yarobwe mu Rwanda hose.

title: U Rwanda rugiye kugira inyubako ya mbere muri Afurika itangiza ibidukikije
content: UDL iri mu nzira zo kubaka inyubako y’amagorofa 16 mu Mujyi wa Kigali, izaba yubakanywe ubuhanga n’uburyo butuma itangiza ibidukikije. Iyi nyubako izaba iri mu kibanza gifite ubuso bwa kilometero kare enye mu mujyi rwagati, ahateganye na Hotel des Mille Collines. Ubusanzwe inyubako itangiza ibidukikije ni inyubako haba mu gishushanyo mbonera cyayo, uburyo yubatswe n’imikorere yayo bikorwa mu buryo butagira ingaruka ku bidukikije. By’umwihariko iyo nyubako iba ifite uburyo butuma idakoresha ingufu nyinshi (amashanyarazi menshi), kudakoresha amazi menshi, itohereza mu kirere imyuka myinshi n’ibindi. Inyubako nk’izo kandi ziba zifite uburyo bwo gutunganya imyanda kandi ibikorwa byose bigakorwa mu buryo budahenze, bigaha abayituyemo n’abazayikoresha uburyo bwiza bw’imibereho. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’agateganyo wa UDL, Alice Ntamitondero, yabwiye The New Times dukesha iyi nkuru ko, inyubako zirengera ibidukikije ari zimwe mu zikunzwe na benshi muri iki gihe. Ati “Nk’abubaka inzu, tubona amahirwe menshi mu guhuza imyubakire igezweho n’uburyo burengera ibidukikije kuko byagaragaye ko abantu benshi babikunda.Turashaka kuba aba mbere bafite ubwo buziranenge.” Nubwo imirimo yo gutangira kubaka iyo nyubako ikiri mu ntangiriro, Ntamitondero yavuze ko bamaze gutanga isoko ryo gukora igishushanyo mbonera no kubaka iyo nyubako. Ati “Turacyari mu ntangiriro. Twamaze kwakira abahatanira isoko barimo abanyamahanga, turacyasuzuma amapiganwa yabo.” UDL ivuga ko iyo nyubako izaba yuzuye mu gihe cy’imyaka nibura itatu. Iyo nyubako izaba irimo ibiro, amacumbi, aho gukorera imyidagaduro n’amaduka. Iyo nyubako niramuka yuzuye, Ntamitondero avuga ko izaba ariyo nyubako ya mbere yo muri ubwo buryo ku mugabane wa Afurika ifite ibyangombwa byo kuba yubatse mu buryo burengera ibidukikije. Bavuga ko iyo nyubako niyuzura, bizamenyakanisha umujyi wa Kigali n’u Rwanda mu bijyanye n’ubuhanga gushushanya no kubaka inyubako zigezweho. Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku bidukikije, rivuga ko inyubako zitwara 30 % by’umuriro w’amashanyarazi ukoreshwa ku Isi, zikagira uruhare rwa 28% ku myuka mibi yoherezwa mu kirere. Loni ivuga ko muri Afurika, inyubako zikoresha 56% by’umuriro wose kuri uwo mugabane. Inyubako zitabangamira ibidukikije byagaragajwe ko ari kimwe mu bisubizo byafasha kugabanya iyo mibare.

title: Aho Papa yasomeye misa i Nyandungu hagiye kubakwa ubusitani buzajya bunasengerwamo
content: Mu minsi itatu yamaze mu Rwanda, uwavuga ko ari mike ku bakristu Gatolika ntiyaba abeshye kuko buri wese yifuzaga kumuhobera cyangwa nibura kumubona yageze muri Paruwasi ye. Gusa Papa yagerageje gusomera Misa mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu birimo; Mbare mu Karere ka Muhanga, ku Kamonyi mu Karere ka Kamonyi, na Nyandungu muri Kicukiro. Buri hantu, Papa yahasigaga ikimenyetso ndetse hubakwa ibikorwa remezo na Kiliziya Gatolika mu rwego rwo guha icyubahiro Umuyobozi wa Kiliziya Gatolika ku Isi. Urugero, i Mbare hubatswe ikigo cy’urubyiruko cyahawe izina rya Cité de Nazareth naho Kamonyi hashyirwa urwibutso rw’amasuka abiri yahashyize kuwa 8 Nzeri 1990, agaragaza ubuhinzi n’igitebo kibika umusaruro, hejuru hakaba inyuguti za IHS (Iesus Humanium Salvator) zishushanya amagambo y’ikilatini asonabura ko Yezu ari Umukiza w’abantu. Mu gishanga cya Nyandungu, Papa Yohani Pawulo II, yahasomye Misa kuwa 9 Nzeri 1990, yitabiriwe n’abantu benshi. Alitari n’igitereko Papa yasomeyeho misa kuri uwo munsi, byari biri ku musozi wa Kanombe, iruhande rw’ahari Kaminuza ya Kigali Institute of Management (KIM), ku muhanda uva Kigali werekeza i Rwamagana ahazwi nko kuri 12. Aho alitari yari iteretse, Papa yahashinzwe umusaraba munini nyuma Kiliziya Gatolika, yongeraho ikibumbano cy’igiti cyerekana Papa arimo gusoma Misa. Nyuma y’imyaka 28 Papa Yohani Pawulo II asuye u Rwanda, abakora ibijyanye no kubungabunga babonye ko hari ikindi cyakongerwa mu kwibutsa ibi bihe bidasanzwe by’uruzinduko rwe. Ikigo cy’Igihugu cyo kubungabunga ibidukikije (REMA), cyatangaje ko hagiye kubakwa ubusitani mu gishanga cya Nyandungu aho imbaga y’abantu yari ikoraniye yaje kumva ubutumwa bwa Papa mu gitambo cya misa yahasomeye. Umuhuzabikorwa w’umushinga NUWEP uzatunganya ubusitani bwa Nyandungu, yabwiye KT Press ko ubu busitani bw’urwibutso rwa Papa buzaba bungana na metero 10.5 kuri metero 17 cyangwa se bwose bukangana na metero kare 178.5. Ati “Ni ahantu ho kuvugira isengesho rito ry’umuntu ku giti cye. Bazajya basenga banabone amakuru ku mateka y’uruzinduko abakiri bato batazi”. Uretse gukora ubusitani n’ibyatsi n’indabo, ubu busitani buzaba burimo ikibumbano cya Mutagatifu Papa Yohani Pawulo II, n’icya Bikira Mariya Nyina wa Yezu.  Djangwani ati “Turacyavugana na Kiliziya Gatolika ku bindi byashyirwa muri ubu busitani”. Musenyeri wa Diyosezi ya Butare akaba na Perezida w’Inama y’Abepiskopi mu Rwanda, Musenyeri Philippe Rukamba, avuga ko Papa Yohani Pawulo II, ‘yigishije ubutumwa bw’amahoro ndetse asengera n’abarwayi. Twishimiye kugira ubwo busitani kuko abakristu bazahora bibuka ubutumwa bwe ubwo yabasuraga’. Mgr Rukamba avuga ko ubwo Mutagatifu Yohani Pawulo II yazaga mu Rwanda, yahaye ubupadiri abagera kuri 30 bo mu Rwanda na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Mu banyarwanda harimo na Mgr Antoine Kambanda wa Arkidiyosezi ya Kigali. Gukora ubusitani bwa Papa ni kimwe mu bindi bikorwa by’umushinga NUWEP, uzakorerwa kuri hegitari 130 mu gishanga cya Nyandungu. Ibi bikorwa byose bizaba byarangiye muri Nzeri 2020, aho bizatwara miliyari 5.2 FRW.

title: Ibyo wamenya ku ishyamba rihingwamo imiti mu Rwanda rigasarurirwa muri Congo
content: Ikigo gishinzwe amazi n’amashyamba (RWFA) kigaragaza ko mu mashyamba igihugu gifite ateye ku buso busaga 28% by’ubutaka bwose, 68% ari ay’abaturage, 27% ari aya Leta, amashyamba acungwa n’Uturere angana na 2% n’aya sosiyete sivile angana na 3%. Muri ayo y’abaturage habarurwamo ishyamba riherereye mu Karere ka Rusizi mu Ntara y’Uburengerazuba, mu nkengero z’ikiyaga cya Kivu, ryihariye guhingwamo ibiti bitunganywamo imiti ariko rigasarurirwa muri Repubulika iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (RDC). Umuyobozi wa koperative y’abakorera ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku burobyi mu kiyaga cya Kivu bo mu Murenge wa Gihundwe (Abagi), Nzeyimana Phenias, yabwiye IGIHE ko kuva cyera abona iryo shyamba risarurwamo ibitunganywamo imiti bigapakirwa ubwato bikajyanwa muri RDC. Ati “Bahaguze cyera bateramo ibinini, birera bagasarura bagatera n’ibindi kuko ni ubutaka bunini bujya kungana nk’Utugari nka tubiri. Bahingamo ibihingwa byitwa Quinquina bahonda bakabikuraho ibihu, bakabijyana mu ruganda kubikoramo imiti.” Nzeyimana yasobanuye bishoboka ko abazungu bene ryo baba baratangiye kurikoresha ku mwaduko w’abazungu mu Rwanda. Ati “Pharmakina [Sosiyete y’Abadage ihinga ikanatunganya quinquina] ifite ubutaka bunini ihingaho mu Rwanda, i Bukavu na Uvila muri RDC..Icyo bakora, bahinga bakanatunganya imiti irimo za quinine [wamamaye mu kuvura malaria]”. Uyu mugabo asobanura ko cyera hahoze ari ubutaka bw’abaturage abo bazungu babugurira n’abaturage babaha umunyu n’ibindi batangira kububyaza umusaruro. Ati “Baraguze, bafite n’ibyangombwa, bivuze ko banatanga imisoro ya buri kwezi. Uyu munsi abakozi barikoramo n’ababacunga ni abanyarwanda..Bimeze nk’ibihuru ariko winjiyemo ni ahantu heza usanga biteye ku murongo.” Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo gishinzwe amazi n’amashyamba (RWFA), Prime Ngabonziza, yabwiye IGIHE ko iryo shyamba ari umtungo w’Umudege witwa ‘Gebber Horst’ yahawe na Leta y’u Rwanda ku wa 1 Nzeri 1970. Uyu mugabo [Gebber] uri no mu bashinze Pharmakina, ngo ubwo hatangiraga gahunda yo kubarura ubutaka kuri bene bwo, ku wa 21 Gicurasi 2014 yongeye guhabwa ibyangombwa by’ubwo butaka busaga hegitari 180. Igice kimwe cy’iryo shyamba kiri mu Murenge wa Nkanka, Akagari ka Ngazi kikangana na hegitari 149, ikindi kiri mu Murenge wa Gihundwe, Akagari ka Gihaya rifite hegitari 28 naho irindi rifite hegitari 3.1 riherere mu Murenge wa Gihundwe, Akagari ka Kagara. Ngabonziza ati “Umwihariko w’aya mashyamba ni uko yatewe afitiwe gahunda yo kubyazwa umusaruro, bivugwa ko yaba avamo imiti. Yarabikoze ariko akanabikorera mu gihugu cya RDC duturanye.” Ngabonziza yasobanuye ko bizwi ko abibyaza uwo musaruro ariko adasarura amashyamba mu buryo bwo kuyatema ngo ayajyane muri RDC cyangwa ahandi. Ati “Afite uko asarura ariko ishyamba rihora rihari nta biti atema, ntabwo byangiza ibidukikije, ntibihungabanya ubuso buteyeho amashyamba. Ikindi ntekereza kandi nzi ni uko akomeza kugira akamaro gasanzwe ko kugabanya imyuka mibi yangiza ikirere, gutanga imvura.” Nubwo Pharmakina itagaragaza ingano ya Quinquina isarura kuri ubwo butaka bwo mu Rwnada, urubuga rwayo rugaragaza ko 60% by’umusaruro bikorwamo imiti ivura malaria ucuruzwa mu bihugu birimo n’u Rwanda. Urwego rw’amashyamba by’umwihariko aya Leta arimo kwegurirwa abikorera, mu 2017 rwinjije miliyari zisaga 67Frw, bikaba biteganyijwe ko nyuma yo kuyegurira abikorera azinjiza asaga miliyari 200Frw ku mwaka.

title: U Rwanda rwashimiwe kuba igihugu cya mbere cyatanze gahunda ivuguruye ijyanye n’amasezerano y’i Paris
content: Amasezerano ya Paris, yemeranyijweho mu Ukuboza 2015, agena uburyo bwo gushyira mu bikorwa ingamba zitandukanye kugira ngo igipimo cy’ubushyuhe bw’Isi kigume munsi ya dogere celcius ebyiri, ariko intego ari ukugera munsi ya dogere 1.5. Ingingo ya Kane n’iya 13 z’ayo masezerano zivuga ko buri gihugu mu byashyize umukono kuri ayo masezerano gitanga raporo ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo mbere y’imyaka itanu mu rwego rw’ikurikiranabikorwa. Umuryango w’Abibumbye wasabye ibihugu gutanga gahunda zabyo ivuguruye muri uyu mwaka. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa UNFCCC, Patricia Espinosa, yatangaje ko u Rwanda rwabaye igihugu cya mbere muri Afurika mu kubyubahiriza. Mu butumwa yanyujije kuri Twitter yagize ati “Turashimira u Rwanda rwatanze gahunda ivuguruye muri UNFCC ku bijyanye no guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere. Twishimiye ubwitange bwanyu mu guharura inzira y’ahazaza heza.” Espinosa yavuze ko Coronavirus itahagaritse ikibazo cy’imihindagurikire y’ikirere, bityo ko yizeye ko n’ibindi bihugu bizatanga gahunda bifite yo guhangana n’icyo kibazo mu myaka iri imbere. Inyandiko igaragaza ingamba u Rwanda rufite mu myaka itanu iri imbere, yerekena ko ahanini izashyira imbaraga mu zari zisanzwe zishingiye ku kubaka ubukungu butangiza ibidukikije, butanahungabanywa n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe “Green Growth and Climate Resilience Strategy.” Hakazanozwa ibijyanye n’ibarurishamibare no gushishikariza abafatanyabikorwa batandukanye kugira uruhare mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryazo. Mu ngamba zisanzwe, hashyizwe imbaraga mu guhangana n’ibinyabutabire byangiza akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba birimo Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs), Hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs), Hydrobromofluorocarbons (HBFCs), Halons, Methyl bromide na Carbon tetrachloride, bikaba biboneka mu byuma bikonjesha nka za frigo n’ibyuma bizana ubuhehere mu nzu no mu modoka. U Rwanda rwashyizeho gutera ibiti byinshi bitanga umwuka mwiza aho kuri ubu ari ku buso bungana na 30% bw’igihugu. Ibi bijyanye n’uko ubu ku isoko ry’u Rwanda hagejejwe imodoka na moto zikoresha amashanyarazi. Kimwe n’ibindi bihugu ariko u Rwanda rwagize imihindagurikire y’ibihe. Imvura yariyongereye ku kigero kiri hagati ya 5% na 10% naho ubushyuhe bwazamutse ku gipimo cya dogere celcius 1.4 kuva mu 1971 kugeza 2016 kandi mu gihe nta gikozwe, cyazamuka kugera kuri dogere celcius 2.5 mbere ya 2050. Ibyo byateje ihindagurika ry’ibihe byabaye intandaro y’ibiza by’inkangu, imyuzure, inkuba n’amapfa nabyo bifitanye isano n’iyangirika ry’ibikorwaremezo, iyangirika ry’umusaruro w’ubuhinzi, impfu z’abantu n’ibindi. Mu isesengura u Rwanda rwerekanye ko ubushyuhe buziyongeraho dogere celcius ziri hagati ya 0.1 na 0.3 mu bihe by’izuba, uretse mu Majyaruguru y’igihugu hazagabanyukaho dogere celcius 0.06 kugeza mu 2050. Muri rusange ngo biteganyijwe ko izuba riziyongera imvura ntihinduke muri icyo gihe. U Rwanda ruzakenera nibura miliyari 11 z’amadolari kugira ngo rugere kuri izi ntego zo kugabanya imyuka yangiza ikirere harimo miliyari 5.7 z’amadolari zo gushyira mu bikorwa ingamba zo kuyigabanya n’izindi miliyari 5.3 z’amadolari zo guhangana n’ingaruka z’izo ngamba. Iki kiguzi cyose harimo inkunga ingana na 60%. Ubushakashatsi buherutse gushyirwa ahagaragara na Kaminuza eshanu zirimo izo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, u Bushinwa no mu Burayi, bwamuritswe mu Kinyamakuru PNAS buvuga ko mu 2050, ubushyuhe bw’Isi buzaba bwariyongereyeho nibura dogere Celsius ziri hagati ya 2.5 na 2.7. Mu bihugu byo muri Afurika yo Munsi y’Ubutayu bwa Sahara, amasaha abantu bamara mu kazi nayo azagabanuka ku kigero cya 10 na 20%.

title: Hari kwigwa uko hakorwa amacupa ashobora kubora mu mwaka umwe
content: Iki gitekerezo gishyizwe mu bikorwa byaba ari inkuru nziza ku kurengera ibidukikije ku Isi, aho amacupa ya pulasitiki akomeje kwiyongera ari ko yangiza ibidukikije haba ubutaka, inyamaswa zo mu Nyanja n’ibindi. Avantium yatangaje ko hari ibigo bikora inzoga byatangiye gushyigikira uwo mushinga nk’Uruganda rwa Carlsberg. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Avantium, Tom van Aken, yavuze ko bizeye ko ibigo bikomeye mu gukora ibikoresho byo muri pulasitiki bizabiyungaho vuba bagateza imbere icyo gitekerezo. Ibigo bikomeye nka Coca-Cola na Danone nabyo byagaragaje ko bishyigikiye uwo mushinga mu rwego rwo kugabanya umubare w’amacupa ya pulasitiki akorwa mu bikomoka kuri peteroli. KuIisi hose buri mwaka hakorwa amacupa ya pulasitiki agera kuri miliyoni 300, agira uruhare mu iyangirika ry’ibidukikije. Aya macupa iyo ajugunywe mu nyanja ashobora kumara imyaka n’imyaka atarabora. Amacupa azajya akorwa na Avantium bivugwa ko azaba afite ubushobozi bwo kubika neza ibinyobwa birimo ikinyabutabire cya CO2. Igerageza ryakozwe rigaragaza ko ayo macupa akozwe mu bimera ashobora kubora mu mwaka umwe mu gihe ashyizwe mu kimoteri, naho yajugunywa imusozi akamara indi myaka mike. Biteganyijwe ko biramutse bigenze neza amacupa ya mbere yaba yagejejwe ku isoko bitarenze umwaka wa 2023.

title: Miliyari 10 Frw zigiye kwifashishwa mu kubungabunga icyogogo cya Sebeya
content: Kuzura kwa Sebeya bigira ingaruka ku bikorwa byinshi mu turere uwo mugezi inyuramo mu Ntara y’Iburengerazuba, aho usenya ibikorwa remezo, ugatwara ubuzima bw’abaturage no kwangiza ibikorwa by’abaturage bawuturiye. Umugezi wa Sebeya unyura mu turere twa Rubavu, Rutsiro, Nyabihu na Ngororero ku burebure bwa kilometero 336. Imirenge ya Rugerero, Nyundo na Kanama muri Rubavu ni imwe mu igerwaho cyane n’ingaruka z’iyuzura ry’umugezi wa Sebeya mu bihe by’imvura. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo gishinzwe Umutungo Kamere w’Amazi mu Rwanda, Ngabonziza Prime, yavuze ko guhera muri Nyakanga uyu mwaka hazatangira kubakwa ingomero, imiyoboro y’amazi no gutera ibiti hafi y’uwo mugezi, hagamijwe kuwubungabunga. Ngabonziza yavuze ko kuzura k’uwo mugezi ahanini guterwa n’ibikorwa by’ubuhinzi biwegereye bikorwa mu buryo butari ubwa kinyamwuga, kwangiza amashyamba, ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro bukorwa nabi n’ibindi. Ati “Iyo imvura iguye ubutaka buragenda hakaba n’imyuzure. Ibyateganyije muri uyu mushinga bigamije gukemura burundu ibibazo abaturage (baturiye Sebeya) bahura nabyo.” Ngabonziza yavuze ko abaturage baturiye uwo mugezi bazagira uruhare runini mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’uwo mushinga. Miliyari 10 Frw zigiye gushorwa mu kubungabunga Sebeya, ni amwe mu mafaranga angana na miliyari 22 yateganyijwe guhera muri Kamena 2019 agamije kubungabunga icyogogo cya Sebeya n’ibindi bice. Uyu mushinga w’imyaka ine uzashyirwa mu bikorwa n’ikigo gishinzwe Umutungo Kamere w’Amazi mu Rwanda , Umuryango urengera Ibidukikije (IUCN), Ikigo cy’Abaholandi gishinzwe Iterambere (SNV).

title: Ingaruka ubushyuhe bukabije buzagira ku Isi mu myaka 50 iri imbere
content: Ni ibigaragazwa n’ubushakashatsi bwakozwe na Kaminuza eshanu zirimo izo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, u Bushinwa no mu Burayi, bwamuritswe mu Kinyamakuru PNAS kivuga ku bushakashatsi. Abashakashatsi bakoze iyi nyigo, bagendeye ku bijyanye n’ubwiyongere bw’abaturage, uko ubutaka bukoreshwa ndetse n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere bizaba biriho mu myaka iri imbere. Barebye ibibazo ikiremwamuntu cyahuye nacyo biturutse ku mihindagurikire y’ikirere ndetse banagenzura ibishobora kuzahabo mu gihe kiri imbere. Nibura mu 2050, ubushyuhe bw’Isi buzaba bwariyongereyeho nibura dogere Celsius ziri hagati ya 2.5 na 2.7; ndetse abantu bari hagati ya miliyoni 160 na 200 baba mu Buhinde bazaba batuye mu bushyuhe bukomeye. Bizagira ingaruka ku bukungu bw’igihugu aho nibura umutungo mbumbe wabwo uzahungana ku kigero cya 2.5% na 4.5%. Mu bihugu byo muri Afurika yo munsi y’Ubutayu bwa Sahara, amasaha abantu bamara mu kazi nayo azagabanuka ku kigero cya 10 na 20%. Ibice byinshi by’Isi muri iki gihe bifite ubushyuhe bwa 13 °C, mu myaka 50 aho hantu hashobora kuzaba hashyushye ku kigero cya 20 °C, ubushyuhe bugaragara muri iki gihe mu bice byinshi bya Afurika y’Amajyaruguru nk’uburi hasi. Ubushakashatsi kandi bugaragaza ko abaturage batuye mu bice bishyushye muri iki gihe, baziyongera cyane mu myaka nibura 50 iri imbere. Miliyari 3.5 z’abatuye Isi nibura bazaba batuye ahantu hari ubushyuhe bwa 29.0 °C.

title: #GumaMuRugo: Imyuka ihumanya ikirere yagabanutseho 24% i Kigali
content: Ni inzira itoroshye cyane ko inyigo iheruka gukorwa n’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima, OMS, ku bijyanye n’ubuziranenge bw’umwuka yagaragaje ko abaturage bangana na 92% baba mu duce tubonekamo ihumana ry’ikirere ryo ku rwego rwo hejuru. Imibare igaragaza ko buri mwaka abantu miliyoni zirindwi bicwa n’indwara zituruka ku guhumana kw’ikirere. Ubwiyongere bw’abaturage n’abatura mu mijyi yo mu Rwanda biri mu byongera imirimo ituma habaho n’imyuka yoherezwa mu kirere irimo ishobora kuva imbere mu nzu no hanze yazo. Mu byangiza ikirere harimo impamvu kamere nk’iruka ry’ibirunga, ibikorwa bya muntu, ibinyabiziga bikoresha mazutu bisohora imyuka ihumanya ikirere. Muri make, ibyangiza ikirere bishobora kuba imyuka iboneshwa amaso n’itaboneshwa amaso. Muri iki gihe hafashwe ingamba zikomeye zigamije kwirinda icyorezo cya COVID-19 giterwa n’agakoko gashya ka Coronavirus, ibihugu byinshi byafashe ingamba zanatumye imyuka ihumanya ikirere igabanuka. Mu Rwanda, ku wa 21 Werurwe 2020, nibwo hafashwe icyemezo cyo guhagarika ibikorwa bitari iby’ingenzi ndetse abaturage bategekwa kuguma mu rugo. Ni icyemezo cyagize ingaruka ku bukungu bw’igihugu n’imibereho y’abagituye ariko kiba inyungu ku kirere cyongeye gusubirana umwimerere wacyo. Dr Kalisa Egide, Umwarimu muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda, Ishami ry’Ubumenyi n’Ikoranabuhanga akaba n’Umushakashatsi mu Kigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ibidukikije, REMA, ku bijyanye no kureba ibitera imyuka yanduza ikirere n’uburyo bwo kuyirinda, yabwiye IGIHE ko ihagarikwa ry’ingendo n’ibikorwa by’inganda byagize uruhare mu kugabanya imyuka ihumanya ikirere. Mu Rwanda, ibinyabiziga birimo imodoka na moto n’ibicanwa nk’inkwi n’amakara biza ku isonga mu guhumanya ikirere. Dr Kalisa Egide avuga ko “Usanga mu bihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere byugarijwe n’imyuka ihumanya ikirere iterwa cyane n’imyuka iva ku modoka, gutekesha inkwi n’imyotsi y’amakara ndetse n’ibindi.’’ Mu gihe cyo kubahiriza gahunda ya Guma mu rugo, bitewe nuko imwe mu mirimo n’ingendo byahagaze, byatumye imyuka ihumanya ikirere igabanuka. Mu Rwanda imyuka ihumanya ikirere iterwa na PM2.5 [utuvungukira duto cyane tungana n’umurambararo wa 2.5 dushobora kwinjira mu bihaha tugatera indwara] ari nayo ihangayikishije Isi, yaragabanutse. Ibipimo byafashwe mu minsi 35 y’ibihe bya Guma mu rugo byerekana ko igabanuka ry’imyuka ihumanya ikirere ryagaragaye mu Ruhango (-28%), Kigali (-24 %), Rubavu (-15 %), Rusizi (-14 %), Nyagatare (-13%), Nyabihu (-11%) na Kirehe (- 4%) mu gihe Kawangire [mu Burasirazuba] yo yazamutseho 19%. Dr Kalisa yavuze ko ubwiyongere bw’imyuka ihumanya ikirere muri Kawangire bushingiye ku kuba aka gace k’icyaro kabonekamo imyuka iva mu gucana no gutwika isanzwe ariyo yiganje mu ihumanya ikirere. Ati “Muri ako gace ibi bikorwa ntibiri mu byahagaze mu gihe cya COVID-19.’’ Asobanura impamvu mu Karere ka Ruhango habonetse igabanuka ryo hejuru, yagize ati “Ubusanzwe aho ibipimo byafatiwe ni mu Byimana ku muhanda wa Kigali-Huye. Ni umwe mu mihanda igendwa cyane mu Rwanda ariko muri iki gihe ingendo zikorwa mu ntara ni nke. Mu Rwanda umwuka waho ni mwiza ugendeye ku bipimo mpuzamahanga, intara zose zifite umwuka mwiza ugereranyije na Kigali.’’ Mu Mujyi wa Kigali aho igabanuka ry’imyuka mu kirere ryageze kuri 24% bijyanye no kuba hari ibikorwa byinshi byahagaze nk’ingendo z’ibinyabiziga, ubwubatsi, n’ibindi. Dr Kalisa akomeza avuga ko “U Rwanda ruri mu bihugu byashyizeho ingamba zikomeye mu kurwanya imyuka ihumanya ikirere REMA ifite sitasiyo zitandukanye zifata ibipimo by’imyuka ihumanya ikirere muri Kigali no mu turere dutandukanye tw’igihugu.” Igihugu kandi cyanatangije ikoreshwa rya moto n’imodoka zifashisha amashanyarazi zidasohora umwuka uhumanye no kunoza ubwikorezi rusange hagabanywa imodoka zishaje ziganje mu zohereza imyuka ihumanya cyane ikirere hifashishijwe igenzurwa ry’ibinyabiziga bisohora imyuka yangiza ikirere. Mu yindi mijyi ku Isi, ibipimo ku myuka ihumanya ikirere byerekana mu gihe cy’ibyumweru bitatu bya Guma mu rugo, Londres yagize igabanuka rya 9%, New York (-25%), Los Angeles (-32%), Madrid (-11%), Sao Paulo (-32%), Wuhan (-44%), Delhi (-60), Mumbai (-34%) na Rome yiyongereyeho 30% . Ubushakashatsi bwamuritswe na REMA mu 2017 bwagaragaje ko 95,2% y’imodoka ziri mu Rwanda zimaze imyaka irenga 10 zikozwe; 56,6 % ni iza mbere yo mu 1999 naho 77,2% zakozwe mbere ya 2000. Minisiteri y’Ubuzima igaragaza ko buri mwaka mu mavuriro hakirwa miliyoni eshatu z’abivuza indwara z’ubuhumekero barimo 13% bazitewe n’ihumana ry’ikirere.

title: Umwaka wa 2020 ushobora guca agahigo ko kugira ubushyuhe kurusha indi
content: Ibi byatuma 2020 ica agahigo kari karagiyeho mu myaka ine ishize katumaga 2016 ariwo mwaka waranzwe n’ubushyuhe bwinshi. Nubwo gufunga ibikorwa hirya no hino ku Isi byatumye ikirere gihumeka kubera ko byinshi mu bitera ubushyuhe byahagaze, abahanga bavuga ko ibi bitatumye Isi ikonja. Ubushyuhe bwinshi bwatangiye guturuka muri Antarctique kuva muri Mutarama. Abahanga bo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika bagaragaza ko ibi bituma nibura hari amahirwe angana na 75% ko Isi izashyuha cyane. Mutarama uyu mwaka yaciye agahigo mu kugira ubushyuhe buri hejuru bituma ibihugu bimwe byo mu Burayi bisigara nta rubura kandi ubusanzwe biruhorana. Bwa mbere mu majyepfo y’umugabane wa Antarctique, hagaragaye ubushyuhe bwinshi muri Gashyantare kuko bwarenze dogere celicius 20. Mu gihembwe cya mbere cy’uyu mwaka, ubushyuhe mu Burasirazuba bw’u Burayi no muri Aziya, bwarenze ikigero cyari gisanzwe kuko bwiyongereyeho dogere celicius eshatu. Ku wa Gatanu ushize, mu bice bitandukanye bya Los Angeles hagaragaye ubushyuhe buri hejuru y’ubwari busanzwe kuko bwageze kuri dogere celcius 34.

title: ‘Earth Day’, umunsi wahariwe kwiyemeza guhangana n’ibibazo byugarije ibidukikije ku Isi
content: Uyu munsi watangiye kwizihizwa mu 1970, ari cyo gihe Ihuriro ry’Abahirimbanira kurengera Ibidukikije batangiriye urugamba rweruye. Kuri iyi nshuro, uyu munsi wageze Isi yose ihanganye n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus, ariko abawutegura bagennye amasaha 72 yo kwiyemeza ibikorwa byo kurengera Isi binyuze mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga. Ibi bikaba byasimbuye kwizihiza uyu munsi mu nsanganyamatsiko yo kugira igikorwa mu kurwanya imihindagurikire y’ibihe. Uyu munsi usanze Loni yarasubitse inama mpuzamahanga yiga ku mihindagurikire y’ibihe (COP26). Amateka y’uyu munsi afite umuzi mu kuba mbere y’uko utangira kwizihizwa bwa mbere Abanyamerika benshi bari bugarijwe n’imyuka ihumanya yavaga mu binyabiziga n’inganda zasohoraga imyotsi, ibi byatumye bamwe mu baturage biyemeza kutabana nabyo bahagurukira kwerekana ingaruka bifite ku buzima bwa muntu. Senateri Gaylord Nelson wari uhagarariye Wisconsin, yari yarakunze kugaragaza cyane uko ibidukikije byangizwa cyane muri Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Muri Mutarama 1969, we n’abandi benshi batangije urugamba rwo kurengera ibidukikije. Umunsi wa mbere w’Isi ‘Earth Day’, witabiriwe n’Abanyamerika barenga miliyoni 20 icyo gihe bakaba bari 10% by’abaturage bose ba Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, bigabiza imihanda, ahategerwa imodoka n’ibyumba binini muri za Kaminuza bamagana ingaruka zikomeye ku buzima iterambere ry’inganda ryabasigiye mu myaka 150 zari zimaze. Icyo gihe ibihumbi bya za Koleji na za Kaminuza byateguye imyigaragambyo yamagana kwangiza ibidukikije ndetse hakaba hari n’abandi bahuriye mu mijyi no mu bindi bice. Bose bamaganaga inganda zihumanya ikirere, kumena peteroli n’ibiyikomokaho mu mazi no ku butaka, ahakusanyirizwa amazi yanduye hatitabwaho, imyanda ihumanya, imiti yica udukoko n’igabanuka ry’ibinyabuzima byo mu gasozi. Uyu munsi n’ibikorwa biwukorwaho byarashyigikiwe cyane n’inzego zose ku buryo mu mpera ya 1970 byatumye hashingwa Ikigo cyo kurengera Ibidukikije muri Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ndetse hashyirwaho n’amategeko abyerekeye. Aya mategeko yarinze miliyoni z’abagabo, abagore n’abana indwara n’impfu ndetse amagana y’ubwoko bw’inyamaswa ntizazimira. Uyu munsi wakunze kwifashishwa mu gutanga ubutumwa no kwiyemeza ibikorwa bigamije kurengera ibidukikije. Mu 1990, witaye cyane ku gushishikariza Isi kubyaza ibikoresho byashaje ibindi (Recycling) ndetse biharurira inzira inama yiga ku mubumbe w’Isi yo mu 1992, i Rio de Janeiro. Byanatumye Perezida Bill Clinton yambika Senateri Nelson umudali wo ku rwego rwo hejuru w’ubwisanzure, akaba ari wo ukomeye uhabwa abasivili muri Amerika kubera uruhare yagize mu guharanira ko uyu munsi ubaho. Uko iminsi yagiye ishira, uyu munsi wagiye waguka ukibanda no ku bundi bukangurambaga nko kurwanya ubushyuhe bw’Isi no gukoresha ingufu zitangiza ikirere. Mu 2000 internet yatangiye kwifashishwa mu guhuriza hamwe abantu benshi bahirimbanira kurengera ibidukikije, bakagirana ibiganiro ndetse hamwe na hamwe mu mijyi n’ibyaro bagakora ingendo bavuza ingoma biyemeza kurengera ibidukikije ari nako bamagana ibibyangiza. Kuri ubu, uyu munsi uhuza abarenga miliyari ugafatwa nk’umwanya wo kwiyemeza kugira igikorwa mu guhindura imyitwarire ya muntu no kugena impinduka ku rwego rw’Isi no mu bihugu n’uturere. Kurwanya imihindagurikire y’ikirere ni kimwe mu byitabwaho buri mwaka. Ugucumbagira cyane ku masezerano ya Paris ya 2015, ni imwe mu mpamvu ituma Isi yose igomba guhagurukira rimwe igasaba ko hagira igikorwa ku neza y’uyu mubumbe n’abawutuye. Kuri iyi nshuro imbuga nkoranyambaga zakoreshejwe cyane na za miliyoni zisaba ko hagira igikorwa cyihutirwa ku mihindagurikire y’ikirere, ni nyuma y’uko umwaka ushize mu Burayi habonetse igipimo cy’ubushyuhe kiri hejuru cyane kurenza ibindi kuva Isi yaremwa.

title: Meteo Rwanda yaburiye abaturarwanda ku mvura nyinshi izageza kuwa 20 Mata
content: Meteo Rwanda ivuga ko iyo mvura izaba irimo umuyaga mwinshi mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu. Ahateganyijwe kugira imvura nyinshi kurusha ahandi ni mu Ntara y’Iburengerazuba, Intara y’Amajyepfo, mu Mujyi wa Kigali no mu majyepfo y’Intara y’Iburasirazuba. Iyi mvura izagwa iri hagati ya milimetero 10 na 50 ku munsi. Uko babara amazi ya milimetero, urugero nk’amazi ya milimetero 10, ni litiro icumi zaguye mu butaka bwa meterokare 10. Meteo ivuga ko iyo mvura izaterwa n’isangano ry’umuyaga ndetse n’ubuhehere bw’umwuka bwiyongereye mu karere u Rwanda ruherereyemo. Umuyaga uteganyijwe uzaba ufite muvuduko uri hagati ya metero 5 na 10 ku isegonda. Meteo Rwanda yashishikarije Abaturarwanda bose kwitwararika bakurikiza amabwiriza bahabwa n’inzego zishinzwe gukumira ibiza.

title: U Rwanda rugeze he rukumira imyuka yangiza ikirere n’ibikoresho bikonjesha ikoreshwamo?
content: Aya masezerano agamije ko ibinyabutabire bya Hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs), akenshi bituruka mu byuma bikonjesha nka za frigo, ibitanga ubuhehere bizwi nka ‘Air Conditioner’ n’ibindi byacika burundu ku Isi, guhagarika ikora n’ikoreshwa ry’iyi myuka bikaba bishobora kugabanya dogere 0.5 ku gipimo mpuzandengo cy’izamuka ry’ubushyuhe bw’Isi mu myaka 100. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Ubuziranenge (RSB), Murenzi Raymond, aheruka kubwira IGIHE ko ikigo ayobora gifatanya n’igishinzwe kubungabunga ibidukikije (REMA) mu gukumira ko iyo myuka ikomeza kwinjira mu gihugu. Ati “Ubu rero iyo myuka iza muri ibyo byuma bikonjesha cyangwa se iza mu kubisana ntikinjira mu Rwanda kuko itemewe. Byumvikane ko ubu turimo kuyirwanya ndetse n’aho iri turimo kugenda dusobanurira abayifite ingaruka zayo kugira ngo aho ikoreshwa izagere igihe twihaye yarashize burundu.” Umuyobozi ushinzwe amabwiriza n’ubuziranenge muri REMA, Uwera Martine, yabwiye IGIHE ko hari imyuka imwe yamaze guhagarikwa burundu kwinjizwa ku butaka bw’u Rwanda. Ati “Ibyuma bikoresha umwuka [Gaz] witwa R22 birakumiriwe kwinjizwa ariko umwuka wo urinjizwa habanje gusaba uruhusa muri REMA. Hari ibindi byaciwe burundu byakoreshaga uwitwa R12 na R11. Ibyo yaba ibikoresho cyangwa umwuka bikoresha nta na kimwe cyemerewe kwinjira ku isoko ry’u Rwanda.” Yasobanuye ko impamvu uyu mwuka wa R22 ucyinjira mu gihugu mu gihe ibikoresho bikonjesha biwukenera byakumiriwe ari uko hari ibyinjijwe mbere kandi bigifite igihe cyo gukoreshwa. Ati “Tugomba kuba twabihagaritse burundu bitarenze 2030. Ubwo rero urumva, ntabwo umwuka bikoresha twahagarika kuwinjiza burundu. Tugomba kugera icyo gihe uwo mwuka tuwinjiza mu gihugu ku kigero cya 0%.” Uyu muyobozi yasobanuye ko hazashyirwaho gahunda yo guca burundu ibikoresho bikoresha uwo mwuka byinjijwe mbere mu gihugu ku buryo bizagera mu 2030, ababisanganywe nabo batakibikoresha. Ati “Ubu abantu bari kugura frigo n’ibindi byuma bitanga ubuhehere, turi kubashishikariza gukoresha izikoresha imyuka igezweho ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Ubu zamaze kugera ku isoko nta mpungenge n’imwe ihari, twe dufite n’icyizere ko tuzanagera icyo gihe abantu baramaze gutangira gukoresha izigezweho.” Kuba ubusanzwe ibyuma byinshi bikonjesha bimara igihe kitarenze imyaka 20, uyu muyobozi avuga ko bitanga icyizere ko bizagera mu 2030 nta muntu ugikoresha ibi byuma byahagaritswe kwinjira mu gihugu mu 2009. REMA ivuga ko hari inyigo igiye gukora izagaragaza ingano y’ibikoresho bikonjesha, bikoresha umwuka uhumanya biri ku butaka bw’u Rwanda.

title: Bimwe mu bikoresho bya pulasitiki bikoreshwa rimwe byakumiriwe mu Rwanda
content: Ibi bikoresho birimo imiheha ya pulasitiki, ibikoresho byifashishwa mu kuvanga, amakanya, ibiyiko, ibikombe n’amasahani bikoreshwa inshuro imwe, ibipurizo n’ububiko cyangwa ibitwarwamo impapuro bikoze muri pulasitiki. Izi ngamba zatangarijwe mu kiganiro n’itangazamakuru, iyi Minisiteri y’ibidukikije ifatanyije n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe kurengera ibidukikije (REMA) byagiranye n’abanyamakuru. Hasobanurwaga ku gutangiza ubukangurambaga ku icibwa ry’ibikoresho bya pulasitike bikoreshwa inshuro imwe bikajugunywa. Imibare igaragaza ko uyu munsi hakorwa toni hafi miliyoni 300 za pulasitiki buri mwaka, hakiyongeraho miliyari eshanu z’amasashi ya pulasitiki n’amacupa abarirwa muri za miliyari. Kimwe cya kabiri cya pulasitiki zikoreshwa rimwe zirajugunywa zigahinduka umwanda. Bivugwa ko bikomeje uku, pulasitiki zikorwa zizikuba inshuro eshatu mu 2050. Kuva mu 2008, u Rwanda rwabaye igihugu cyaciye ikoreshwa ry’amasashi hirya no hino mu gihugu. Naho kuva mu 2019, rushyiraho itegeko N°17/2019 ryo ku wa 10/08/2019, ryerekeye kubuza ikorwa, itumizwa mu mahanga, ikoreshwa n’icuruzwa ry’amasashi n’ibikoresho bikozwe muri pulasitiki bikoreshwa inshuro imwe. Iri tegeko ryavuguruye iryari risanzwe kugira ngo rigene ibyerekeye izi pulasitiki zindi zitari zararebwe n’itegeko rya 2008 kuko byagaragaye ko na zo zitera ihumana ry’ibidukikije. Ibi byatumye zimwe muri pulasitiki zibuzwa n’iri tegeko kongera gukoreshwa mu Rwanda. Minisiteri y’ibidukikije yabwiye abanyamakuru ko iri tegeko ribuza itumizwa mu mahanga, ikorwa, icuruzwa n’ikoreshwa ry’amasashi yose n’izindi pulasitiki zikoreshwa inshuro imwe nk’ibipfunyikwamo ibiribwa cyangwa ibindi bintu. Ibi birimo imiheha ya pulasitiki, ibikoresho byifashishwa mu kuvanga, amakanya, ibiyiko, ibikombe n’amasahani bikoreshwa inshuro imwe, ibipurizo n’ububiko cyangwa ibitwarwamo impapuro bikoze muri pulasitiki. Ivuga ko zimwe mu ngaruka ziterwa n’ikoresha rya Pulasitiki zikorerwa gukoreshwa inshuro imwe, harimo gutera umwanda ku nkengero z’imihanda no mu mazi, gufunga inzira z’amazi, kugabanya ubushobozi by’amazi bwo kwinjira mu butaka, bityo bigatuma habaho imyuzure. Inyinshi muri pulasitiki zikoreshwa inshuro imwe zikorwa mu mavuta ya peteroli zikaba zitabora burundu, ahubwo zikagaragara mu bidukikije nk’uduce duto duto tugira uruhare mu gutera umwanda, kwanduza ibiribwa n’ibindi. Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe mu 2017, bwemeje ko impfu nyinshi z’inyamaswa zo mu mazi n’inyoni ziterwa no kurya pulasitiki. Uduce twa pulasitiki zitashangutse twasanzwe muri izi nyamaswa. Minisitiri Dr Mujawamariya yagize ati “Guhera uyu munsi bimwe mu bikoresho bya pulasitiki birimo amasahane, imiheha n’izindi pulasitike zikoreshwa inshuro imwe nk’ibipfunyikwamo ibiribwa cyangwa ibindi bintu, bibujijwe kongera gukoreshwa mu Rwanda.” “Nta muntu tubujije kugura ibintu bipfunyitse muri pulasitiki, ishati zipfunyitse, amazi ari mu icupa n’ibindi, kubera ko izo nganda ntizirabona izisimbura ibi bikoresho kugeza igihe zizaba zabisimbuye, icyo tubujije ni ugupfunyika umugati muri pulasitiki, imbuto muri pulasitiki, inyama muri pulasitiki, isombe n’ibindi kuko ibyo bifite ibisimbura izo pulasitiki.” Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije ivuga ko pulasitiki zikoreshwa n’inganda mu gupfunyika zisonewe gupfunyikishwa gusa ibicuruzwa bikorerwa mu ruganda rwabiherewe uruhushya, ariko zigomba gushyirwaho ikimenyetso kigaragara n’uruganda ruzipfunyikisha ibicuruzwa byarwo. Ivuga ko ikorwa, itumizwa mu mahanga, ikoreshwa cyangwa icuruzwa ry’ibikoresho bikozwe muri pulasitiki ibora mu miterere isanzwe, bikorwa iyo byabanje gusabirwa uruhushya ku rwego rubifitiye ububasha (REMA), ariko hagaragajwe ko hari impamvu zihariye. Uruhushya rusabwa mu nyadiko. Bimwe mu bihano biteganyijwe Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije ivuga ko bimwe mu bihano bihabwa umuntu wese ukora amasashi n’ibikoresho bikozwe muri pulasitiki bikoreshwa inshuro imwe, ahanishwa gufungirwa ibikorwa, kwamburwa ayo masashi n’ibyo bikoresho no kwishyura ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi ingana na miliyoni 10 mu mafaranga y’u Rwanda. Harimo kandi kwishyura ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi ingana inshuro 10 z’agaciro k’ayo masashi n’ibyo bikoresho bikozwe muri pulasitiki bikoreshwa rimwe n’ibindi bihano. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa REMA, Eng Colette Ruhamya, yagize ati “Ibi bikoresho abantu bakwiye kujya babyitondera cyane kubishyiramo ibintu bishyushye, yego nta kintu kitagira ingaruka ku bidukikije ariko ushaka uko wagabanya za ngaruka.” Avuga ko mbere haciwe amasashi ariko ubu hatewe intambwe mu kureba n’ibindi bikoresho bikoreshwa inshuro imwe byacibwa.

title: Byinshi kuri Banki yihariye izatera inkunga imishinga irengera ibidukikije mu Rwanda
content: Iyi banki biteganywa ko izitwa ‘Rwanda Catalytic Green Investment Bank’, yitezweho kongera amafaranga yashorwaga mu mishinga igamije kurengera ibidukikije mu gihugu. Izaba ikora nk’izindi banki ariko yibanda gusa ku gutanga inguzanyo no gushora imari yayo mu mishinga igamije kurengera ibidukikije. Uru rwego rw’imari ruteganywa gushyirwaho, ruzafasha mu gukangurira ibigo byigenga gushyigikira ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’imishinga itangiza ibidukikije mu gihugu. Umukozi ushinzwe itumanaho mu kigega cya leta gisanzwe gitera inkunga imishinga irengera ibidukikije (Fonerwa), Doreen Nakure, yabwiye IGIHE ko Fonerwa ari yo ishinzwe gukurikirana by’umwihariko ishyirwaho ry’iyo banki, cyamaze gushyiraho itsinda ry’inzobere rizatanga ishusho nyayo y’imiterere n’imikorere y’iyo banki mu gihe cya vuba. Ati “Ubu twamaze guha akazi umuryango ‘Coalition for Green Capital’ kizadusesengurira ndetse kikaduha imiterere y’ishusho y’iyo banki ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Ibijyanye n’ingano y’amafaranga iyo banki izatangiza bizagaragazwa n’inyigo iri gukorwa n’icyo kigo gifatanyije n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa.” The Coalition for Green Capital ni umuryango udaharanira inyungu, wibanda cyane ku guteza imbere isoko ry’ingufu zidahumanya, binyuze mu gushyiraho banki ziteza imbere imishinga irengera ibidukikije. Kuva mu mwaka wa 2009, uyu muryango ufatanya n’ibihugu, ndetse n’imiryango itari iya Leta gushyiraho ibigo by’imari bishyigikira imishinga migari irengera ibidukikije, kigakora ubuvugizi, ndetse kigatanga ubujyanama n’ubugenzuzi mu mikorere y’ibyo bigo. Kugeza ubu ntibirasobanuka neza niba iyi banki izaba ari iya Leta cyangwa iy’abikorera; gusa Nakure avuga ko bizaterwa n’ibintu byinshi bikiri kuganirwaho ubu, ariko akagaragaza ko byagakwiye kuba igikorwa cy’abikorera. Iyi banki nitangira, izajya itera inkunga imishinga ya Leta n’abikorera igamije kurengera ibidukikije, habanje kurebwa niba yujuje ibisabwa. Nakure avuga ko iki gitekerezo cyo gushyiraho iyi banki kiri gushingira ku mahame yihariye ajyanye no kugena uburyo bwo kwifatira ibyemezo mu ishoramari, ubushobozi bwo kwiyongerera imari ivuye mu bigo by’imari ndetse no mu bikorera, hashingiwe cyane cyane ku bikorwa by’indashyikirwa bya banki mpuzamahanga zitera inkunga imishinga irengera ibidukikije, ubufasha bwa Fonerwa ndetse n’abandi bagira uruhare muri iri soko. Amakuru ajyanye n’itangizwa ry’iyi banki mu Rwanda yatangarijwe bwa mbere mu kiganiro cyatangiwe mu nama ya Cop 25 iherutse kubera muri Espagne mu mpera z’umwaka ushize yigaga ku ruhare rwa banki zigamije guteza imbere ibidukikije mu gutuma ibihugu bigera ku ntego zabyo. Igitekerezo cyo gushyiraho banki nyarwanda itera inkunga imishinga irengera ibidukikije, kije nyuma y’uko Afurika y’Epfo na yo yashyizeho iyo banki ifite imari shingiro ya miliyoni 100 z’amadorali ya Amerika. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ibijyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere muri Banki Nyafurika itsura Amajyambere (AfDB), Anthony Nyon, ubwo yari mu nama ya COP 25, yatangaje ko hakenewe ingamba zihamye mu guhanga ikoranabuhanga rishya rigamije guhangana n’ibibazo by’imihindagurikire y’ibihe. Ati “Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, Banki Nyafurika itsura Amajyambere, binyuze mu bufasha bw’ikigega kigamije kurengera ibidukikije, iri gukorana n’ihuriro rya banki zigamije kurengera ibidukikije mu kureba uburyo butandukanye bwo gushyira igishoro mu bikorwa bifasha kurengera ibidukikije ku rwego rwo hasi, ari na ko tuzamura uruhare rw’abikorera.” Leta yashyizeho ikigega Fonerwa cyahawe inshingano zo gufasha u Rwanda kugera ku bukungu butangiza ibidukikije binyuze mu gutera inkunga imishinga ya Leta n’abikorera iri muri uyu murongo. Kuva iki kigega cyashingwa muri 2013, hahanzwe imirimo 138 000 itangiza ibidukikije. Mu 2017, habarurwaga ko ubutaka bungana na hegitari 21 847 bwatunganyijwe hagamijwe kwirinda ko butwarwa n’isuri ndetse hegitari 12 998 z’inkombe n’imigezi n’ibiyaga zarasubiranyijwe, hegitari 41 116 ziterwaho amashyamba, ndetse imiryango 65,340 ifashwa kubona ingufu zikomoka ku mirasire y’izuba mu gihe toni miliyoni 65 z’imyuka ihumanya ikirere zakumiriwe. Icyo gihe Fonerwa yari imaze gutanga inkunga ya miliyoni 100 z’amadorali, iyi nkunga ikaba ihabwa imishinga yatsinze binyuze mu marushanwa. Umushinga w’uruganda rw’amashanyarazi rutanga megawati 8.5 ruri mu karere ka Rwamagana, ni urugero rwiza rw’ishoramari ryakozwe mu rwego rwo kurengera ibidukikije. U Rwanda rwihaye intego ko mu 2050, ruzaba rwagabanyije umwuka uhumanya ikirere ku rugero rwifuzwa.

title: Ingano y’umwuka wa CO2 Umunyarwanda yohereza mu kirere
content: Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe na Oxfam bwatangajwe kuri iki Cyumweru, bwagaragaje umuntu umwe mu Bwongereza bizamufata iminsi itanu kugira ngo agire uruhare mu bikorwa bituma haboneka CO2 mu gihe iyo ngano y’uyu mwuka ku muntu uri mu Rwanda bizamufata umwaka. Ku Cyumweru gitaha tariki ya 12 Mutarama, nibura Umwongereza azaba amaze kohereza mu kirere umwuka wa CO2 ungana n’uzoherezwa umwaka wose n’umuturage wo mu bihugu birimo Madagascar, Malawi, Ethiopia, Uganda, Guinea na Burkina Faso. Ubu bushakashatsi bwagaragaje ingano y’uyu mwuka woherezwa mu kirere ku batuye mu Rwanda ari toni 0.09, Malawi ni 0.19, Burkina Faso zigeze kuri toni 0.25 ku mwaka. Bwagaragaje ko umuturage wo muri Nigeria agira uruhare mu bikorwa byohereza mu kirere uyu mwuka uhumanya ungana na toni 0.49 buri mwaka naho uwo mu Buhinde akaba ari 1.68. Ikigereranyo rusange ku Isi kiri kuri toni 4.7 ku muntu buri mwaka. Mu Bwongereza honyine, umuturage abarirwa toni 8.3. Abongereza benshi bavuze ko hakwiye kugira byinshi bikorwa mu kurwanya ikibazo cy’imihindagurikire y’ikirere cyane mu kugabanya umwuka uhumanya woherezwa mu kirere. Ubwiyongere mu kirere bw’uyu mwuka wa CO2 bugira ingaruka ku bidukikije zirimo ubushyuhe bukabije ku Isi, imyuzure n’ibindi. Mu myaka 100 ishize, ibikorwa bya muntu byongereye ubushyuhe ku Isi ho dogere celcius 2.5. Uko kwiyongera k’ubushyuhe ku Isi kwagiye gutera ibibazo bitandukanye birimo ihindagurika ry’ibihe, imyuzure ya hato na hato, kuzimira kw’inyamaswa n’ibimera bitandukanye n’ibindi. Mu myaka myinshi ishize, ibikorwa bya muntu byakomeje kugira uruhare mu iyangirika ry’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima ndetse n’ihindagurika ry’imiterere y’Isi. Ahari ubutayu bwa Sahara hahoze ibyatsi, amazi ndetse n’amashyamba nkuko byatangajwe n’Umushakashatsi Dr Curt Stager wo muri Kaminuza ya Smith College, nyamara byaje guhindurwa n’imyuzure, agace gasigara kambaye ubusa. Kubera ubushyuhe, ibikorwa bya muntu n’ibindi, amoko 1000 y’inyamswa yarimutse ajya gushaka ahandi aba, andi menshi yo yarazimiye. Mu myaka 15 iri imbere, isunzu ry’umusozi wa Kilimanjaro rizwiho urubura rizaba ryambaye ubusa. Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko ubushyuhe bw’Isi buri gutuma urubura kuri uwo musozi rushonga bidasanzwe. Uyu mwuka wa CO2 ugira ingaruka nyinshi ku buzima bwa muntu. Zirimo kurwara umutwe, kugira umunaniro, kubura ibitotsi, kugira ibibazo by’ubuhumekero kimwe no gututubikana ndetse wongera uburyo umutima utera umuntu akaba yarwara indwara y’umuvuduko ukabije w’amaraso cyangwa se akaba yajya muri Coma mu buryo butunguranye kubera kubura umwuka mwiza. Ubushakashatsi buherutse kugaragaza ko ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe ku bukungu bw’u Rwanda zishobora kugera ku kigero cya 4.5% by’umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu mu mwaka wa 2030. Ubu bushakashatsi bwakozwe n’itsinda ry’ibihugu 19 bihuriye ku kuba bisangiye ingaruka bigirwaho n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere (V20), bwerekanye ko ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe ku buzima bw’abanyarwanda zishobora kurushaho gukomera harimo ukwiyongera kwa Malaria ndetse n’ibyorezo bituruka ku bukonje ndetse n’ubushyuhe bw’ikirere. Ubushakashatsi bw’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cyo kubungabunga Ibidukikije (REMA) bwo muri Gicurasi 2018, ku bitera ihumana ry’umwuka n’iyangirika ry’ikirere, bwagaragaje ko ibintu biza ku isonga mu guhumanya umwuka uhumekwa mu Rwanda harimo umwotsi w’imodoka, imyotsi y’amakara n’inkwi n’ibindi. Bwanerekanye ko uduce duto duto tutabonwa n’amaso twivanga n’umwuka uhumekwa, tubangamiye bikomeye ubuzima bw’abaturarwanda bishobora gutera indwara z’ubuhumekero n’umutima. Bwanagaragaje ko mu bice bituwe hari ubwo naho ikigero cy’utwo tuvungukira kirenga urugero rwemewe, ahanini kubera imyuka ikomoka ku gukoresha ibicanwa bikomoka ku biti no gutwika ibyatsi, ibiyorero n’amashyamba. Hari ibice bimwe na bimwe byagaragayemo ko mu mpeshyi muri metero kibe imwe y’umwuka usangamo hagati ya mikorogarama (microgram) 100 na 150 z’utwo tuvungukira mu gihe ikigero cyemewe kitagomba kurenga mikorogarama 35 kuri meterokibe y’umwuka. Mu guhangana n’ingaruka ziterwa n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe n’iyangirika ry’ikirere, u Rwanda rwashyizeho ingamba nyinshi zitandukanye zirimo gutera ibiti byinshi bitanga umwuka mwiza aho kuri ubu ari ku buso bungana na 30% bw’igihugu. Harimo kandi gukumira imodoka zisohora imyuka ihumanya ihumanya binyuze mu isuzuma zikorerwa no kwimakaza ikoreshwa ry’ingufu zidahumanya. Ibi bijyanye n’uko ubu ku isoko ry’u Rwanda hagejejwe imodoka na moto zikoresha amashanyarazi.

title: Mu Rwanda hagiye gutangizwa banki itera inkunga imishinga y’ibidukikije

title: Ubushakashatsi bwerekanye ko Umuryango w’ingagi zo mu Birunga uri kwaguka
content: Ubwo bushakashatsi bwerekana ko ingagi zo mu ishyamba rya Bwindi muri Uganda na Sarambwe muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (RDC) zavuye kuri 400 zikagera kuri 459. Mu Rwanda, imibare y’ingagi yariyongereye zigera kuri 604 zivuye kuri 480 zabarurwaga umwaka ushize. Ibyo byatumye ingagi zibarurwa mu gice cy’imisozi y’Ibirunga zigera ku 1,063. Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe bigizwemo uruhare n’Ikigega cyita ku ngagi muri Pariki y’Ibirunga (Dian Fossey Gorillas Fund) bushyirwa ahagaragara ku wa mbere tariki 16 Ukuboza 2019.
