Yasobanuye ko kwibuka ari ukwiyubaka, kurwanya ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside no kuyikumira binyuze ku masomo ava mu byo igihugu cyanyuzemo. Yagize ati “Kwibuka ni uguha agaciro abacitse ku icumu rya Jenoside no kubashimira uruhare rwabo mu bumwe n’ubwiyunge bw’Abanyarwanda no mu kubaka igihugu muri rusange. Ubuhamya batanga butuma Abanyarwanda bigira ku byabaye dore ko ijoro ribara uwariraye.’’ Ambasaderi Rwakazina yavuze ko umugambi wo gukora Jenoside wacuzwe mbere n’abategetsi babi bayoboye u Rwanda ariko ushyirwa mu bikorwa mu 1994. Nyuma y’imyaka 26, Ingabo zari iza RPA zihagaritse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi hari abakigaragara mu bikorwa byo kuyihakana no kuyipfobya mu bihugu bitandukanye ku Isi cyane mu bihugu by’Iburengerazuba. Yakomeje ati “Babeshya ko baharanira amahoro, uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu n’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge mu Rwanda ndetse bakifashisha inama, ibiganirompaka, inyandiko zo muri kaminuza, itangazamakuru n’imbuga nkoranyambaga. ” Ambasaderi Rwakazina yashimiye ibihugu byashyizeho amategeko ahana ihakana rya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, anahamagarira ibindi kubikurikiza. Abitabiriye uyu muhango banasangijwe ubutumwa bw’Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa Loni, Antonio Guterres, wavuze ko Kwibuka Jenoside bituma ‘twigira ku mateka y’abacitse ku icumu ku bijyanye n’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge no kongera kwiyubaka.’ Yanavuze ko nyuma ya Jenoside u Rwanda rwerekanye ko bishoboka ko ibihugu byongera kwiyubaka bihereye ku busa. U Rwanda rwanyuze mu nzira itoroshye kuva Jenoside ihagaritswe, igihugu cyasanwe guhera ku busa, cyubaka ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda ndetse kinateza imbere ubukungu budaheza n’igihugu kigendera ku mategeko. Ni intambwe igihugu cyagezeho kibikesha ubuyobozi bwiza burangajwe imbere na Perezida Paul Kagame, binyuze muri gahunda za Leta ziri mu cyerekezo cya 2020 n’icya 2050. Mu butumwa bw’abayobozi ba Loni bijeje gukomeza kurwanya imvugo zihembera urwango. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Loni i Genève, Tatiana Valovaya, yavuze ko n’ubwo hashize imyaka 26 ‘ntidushobora kwibagirwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.’’ Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Loni i Vienne, Ghada Fathi Waly, na we yashimiye abitangiye kurokora ubuzima bwa benshi n’umuhate w’Abanyarwanda baharaniye ubumwe n’ubwiyunge. Ati ‘‘Tugomba kunga ubumwe tukarwanya inzangano n’irondakoko.’’ Perezida wa Ibuka Suisse, Murangira César, mu butumwa bwe yahumurije abacitse ku icumu, ababwira ko atari bonyine. Yavuze ko imyaka 26 ishize ibafasha gusubiza amaso inyuma bakareba aho bavuye, urugendo bamaze gukora, aho bageze ndetse n’aho bagana. Yagize ati ‘‘N’ubwo urugendo rwo kwiyubaka rwari rugoye ariko nta cyatubujije kureba imbere tugana aho twifuza kugera.’’ Yashimye intambwe ikomeye yo kwiyubaka no kwiyomora ibikomere bigaragara n’ibitagaragara byasizwe na Jenoside. Imbuga nkoranyambaga zakoreshejwe mu gikorwa cyo kwibuka zifashishijwe mu gihe cyose cy’icyunamo zibanda ku buhamya bw’abacitse ku icumu n’ibiganiro bigamije kurwanya ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside.

title: Wari Inkotanyi cyane: Ababanye n’abamenye Bwitare bamuvuze ubupfura bwamuranze
content: Abazi neza Bwitare bavuga ko kumuvuga bitoroshye kuko yari umuntu udasanzwe, umugabo wabaniye neza ingeri zose z‘ababashije kumumenya no guhura nawe haba mu kazi no muri gahunda zose zihuza abantu mu mahanga. Bavuga ko mu ijambo rimwe yari ‘Imfura’ ku buryo mu byo iri jambo risobanura byimbitse nta gukabya ari we Nyirinkindi. Mu myaka igera kuri 25 yari amaze mu Bubiligi harimo 17 yarwayemo cyane, ariko uburwayi yagize yarabutsinze, agira ukwihangana kudasanzwe, aho wasangaga ari mu bafasha abandi mu bibazo, bigatuma bumva bakomeye kubera uko kwihangana kwe yagaragazaga. Bamwe mu babanye na we baramuvuga ibigwi Kananura Jean Marie, umwe mu bakiri bato yabereye umujyanama, inshuti, mukuru we, yagize ati “Bwitare yatwigishije mbere na mbere icyo igihugu ari cyo, tumenya inzira ducamo, tumenya icyo gukunda igihugu cyacu bivuze. Aho ari azashimishwa cyane n‘uko ibyo yatwigishije tubikurikiza, ibi ndabisubiramo ni byo bizamunezeza cyane”. Rukera Aubin yavuze ko “Kuvuga Bwitare biragoye yatubereye urumuri, imfura mbese, urugero rwiza, biragoye kumva ko ntazongera kumuvugisha, ariko ari mu mutima wanjye ubuziraherezo”. Ngabo Eric yavuze ibigwi Bwitare ati “Ruhukira mu mahoro Afande Bwitare Inkotanyi y’amarere. Watubereye umubyeyi, utubera inshuti, utubera urugero rwiza. Umurage udusigiye ntugira urugero. Ubwitange, ubunyangamugayo, ubuntu, kwihangana, guca bugufi ... no gukunda igihugu. Wari Inkotanyi itajenjeka”. Musare Faustin yakomeje avuga Bwitare ati “Yari umuhanga, yize ibya statistiques (ibarurishamibare); yari umuntu ushyikirana n’abandi ku buryo bworoshye kandi akagira urugwiro, akaganira cyane, akamenya ibintu binyuranye (yari cultivé - umuntu ufite ubumenyi bugari kandi uzi guhugura abandi!). Yabaye umu-cadre mwiza muri FPR Inkotanyi, Intore izi kwigisha. Tukiri ku rugamba yagiye kwigisha amatwara, impinduramatwara hirya no hino mu Banyarwanda babaga hanze. Yatubereye n’umukozi mwiza, mugenzi wacu, muri Ambasade, akagira n’igitsure kandi yari imfura, nta matiku, nta kujenjeka, avugisha ukuri, atanga inama. Yakundaga kandi urubyiruko”. Umuhanzi Rugamba Dorcy na we yunze mu ry’abandi avuga ubupfura bwa Bwitare. Ati “Ubupfura, ubuntu, urugwiro, ubwenge, urukundo, ishyaka n’ubutwari!. Iruhukire Eulade Bwitare, wari waracyebwe Imanzi nyinshi”. Umuryango we wagize uti “Tubabajwe no kubamenyesha urupfu rwa Bwitare wigendeye tariki ya 10 Mata 2020 rwabereye muri Woluwe Saint Lambert, turabashimira uko mukomeje gufata mu mugongo umugore we n‘umwana wabo. Kubera ibihe bitoroshye bya Covid-19, ntidushoboye guhurira hamwe. Ariko nk’uko yabyifuje azashyingurwa iwabo mu Rwanda, tuzagira umwanya wo kumuvuga no kumwibuka i Bruxelles dusohotse muri ibi bihe bya Covid-19, tuzakomeza kubagezaho uko gahunda zizagenda zikurukirana”.

title: Ambasaderi Ngarambe yasabye ibihugu bicumbikiye abakoze Jenoside gutanga ubutabera bukwiye
content: Kuva ku wa 7 Mata 2020, u Rwanda n’Isi byinjiye mu bikorwa by’iminsi 100 yo kwibuka Jenoside yahitanye ubuzima bw’Abatutsi b’inzirakarengane basaga miliyoni. Ni ibihe bidasanzwe kuko byahuriranye n’ingamba zafashwe mu kwirinda ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo cya COVID-19 giterwa n’agakoko gashya ka Coronavirus cyibasiye Isi. Ingamba zafashwe mu guhangana n’iki cyorezo zatumye abantu basabwa kuguma mu ngo zabo, binagira ingaruka ku bikorwa bihuza abantu benshi mu ruhame ngo batakwanduzanya. Mu butumwa bwa Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Bufaransa, Dr François-Xavier Ngarambe, ku Banyarwanda n’inshuti zabo muri icyo gihugu yavuze ko mu gihe cyo kwibuka bikwiye kugaragaza imbamutima ku bacitse ku icumu kuko ‘umubabaro wanyu ni wo wacu’. Yagize ati “Nubwo ibihe bya COVID-19 turimo bidutandukanyije, imitima yacu iri hamwe, turibuka. Nyuma y’imyaka 26 habaye Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, yahitanye abacu basaga miliyoni mu Rwanda, mu gihe cy’iminsi 100 mu 1994 […] turibuka. Turibuka kandi ntituzabibagirwa na rimwe. Umuhate wanyu no kudaheranwa n’agahinda bituma tububaha mwese.’’ Yavuze ko abantu Abatutsi bahigwaga nk’inyamaswa, bakorewe iyicarubozo, baranicwa mu bugome ndengakamere. Ati “Ubuzima bw’abasaga miliyoni bwarahagaritswe, inzozi za bo zirahonyorwa, icyizere bari bafite gihindurwa ubusa, ntituzabibagirwa na rimwe.’’ Ambasaderi Dr Ngarambe yavuze ko kugeza mu 2020, abagizweho ingaruka na Jenoside bagisaba ubutabera. Ati “Imyaka 26 nyuma y’icyaha kiruta ibindi, abagizweho ingaruka na cyo baracyasaba ubutabera kubera ko babufiteho uburenganzira. Ibihugu byose abakoze Jenoside bihishemo, turabisaba ko bitanga ubutabera, […] ubutabera bugatangwa ubu n’iteka ryose kugira ngo icyo cyaha kirandurwe burundu ndetse no kugikumira bigerweho neza.’’ Ubushinjacyaha bw’u Rwanda bumaze gutanga impapuro zirenga 1000 zo guta muri yombi abakekwaho uruhare muri Jenoside baba mu mahanga. Mu mpapuro u Rwanda rwatanze, 700 zoherejwe mu bihugu 13 bya Afurika. Abarokotse Jenoside bashima cyane ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi zagize uruhare mu kubarokora. Ambasaderi Dr Ngarambe yakomeje avuga ko “Mu gihe twibuka ubugome bukabije bw’abakoze Jenoside n’ubugambanyi bw’abari bafite inshingano n’ubushobozi bwo kuyihagarika, turibuka kandi tukanishimira umurava ntagereranywa n’ubwitange bw’abari ingabo za FPR bahagaritse ayo mahano.’’ “Ikuzo, icyubahiro no kuzirikana by’iteka ryose ni iby’izo ntwarane zaharaniye ubwigenge n’abayobozi bazo by’umwihariko Perezida wa Repubulika y’u Rwanda, Paul Kagame, wari Umugaba Mukuru w’Ingabo za FPR.’’ Nyuma y’imyaka 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ihagaritswe, u Rwanda rwafashe icyerekezo gishya cyo kubaka igihugu gishya kitarangwamo amacakubiri kandi kidaheza. Ni u Rwanda rw’amahoro, ubutabera n’uburinganire kuri bose, rutihanganira na gato ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside n’ivangura iryo ari ryo ryose. Ambasaderi Dr Ngarambe ati “Twese hamwe duhuriye mu kwibuka, twese hamwe turwanya ihakana n’ipfobya, twese hamwe turwanya abagoreka amateka […] kugira ngo twese duterurire mu ijwi rimwe n’umutima umwe tuti ‘Ntibizongera’.’’ Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yahitanye ubuzima bw’abasaga miliyoni. Mu 2004 yemewe ku rwego mpuzamahanga ndetse tariki 7 Mata buri mwaka yagizwe umunsi mpuzamahanga wo kuzirikana kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.

title: Abanyarwanda baba mu Bufaransa bamaganye ikiganiro cyatambutse kuri France Inter gipfobya Jenoside
content: France Inter ni imwe mu mashami ya radiyo ya Leta mu Bufaransa, Radio France. Kuwa Kabiri tariki 7 Mata 2020, yacishijeho ikiganiro gisetsa (Sketch) bise ‘Journée mondiale de réflexion sur le genocide au Rwanda’. Ni ikiganiro cyatambutse ku munsi u Rwanda n’Isi bibukaga ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri Mata 1994. Muri icyo kiganiro gito cyamaze iminota itatu, umunyarwenya wagikoze yavuzemo abantu ‘bahoze babana neza imyaka n’imyaka ariko nyuma bakaza gusubiranamo bagatemana.’ Yongeyeho ko ufashe ibyo byabaye wabigereranya nk’umukino wo gukirana ukunze gukinwa n’abana (Bataille de polochons). Iki kiganiro cyarakaje Abanyarwanda cyane cyane ababa mu Bufaransa, biyemeza kwandikira France Inter bayisaba gusaba imbabazi cyangwa hagafatwa izindi ngamba. Bimwe mu byo bamagana muri icyo kiganiro ni inyito y’ikiganiro ubwayo, aho bavuga ko ari Jenoside yo mu Rwanda kandi Umuryango w’Abibumbye waremeje ko ari Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ikindi ni ugufata Jenoside bakayigereranya no gukirana hagati y’abana, no kwerekana ko hari impande ebyiri zasubiranyemo, mu gihe bizwi ko abahigwaga ari Abatutsi. Umuyobozi wa Ibuka France, Etienne Nsanzimana yabwiye IGIHE ko mu gihe France Inter yaba idasabye imbabazi, byafata indi ntera. Yagize ati “Twakoze ibaruwa ibyiyama turindiriye ko bazasaba imbabazi ejo naho ubundi ntabwo tuzahagararira aho niba bakomeje kutagira icyo bakora. Si ubwa mbere babikoze kuko n’umwaka ushize habaye ikibazo turabahamagara, batwandikira ibaruwa isaba imbabazi ko batazongera.” Abanyarwanda batandukanye babinyujije ku mbuga nkoranyambaga nabo bagaragaje ko ibyakozwe na France Inter bidakwiriye. Umuyobozi wa Communauté Rwandaise de France, Angélique Ingabire yavuze ko ibyakozwe na France Inter ari igitutsi kuri miliyoni y’abatutsi bishwe muri Jenoside. Ati “France Inter, amagambo y’umunyarwenya wanyu ntabwo asekeje ahubwo ni igitutsi ku nzirakarengane zisaga miliyoni za Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.” Emile Rwamasirabo abinyujije kuri Twitter yanditse ati “Kubona radiyo ya Leta ikinira kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ni icyerekana ivangura riri mu nzego za Leta. Ntabwo bikwiriye kwemerwa na gato.” Ibinyamakuru byo mu Bufaransa bikunze kwandika inkuru zipfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ndetse zikihanangirizwa cyane n’Abanyarwanda. Tariki 12 Mata 2019, Ikinyamakuru Le Monde cyo mu Bufaransa cyasohoye igishushanyo (cartoon) gipfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Cyari igishushanyo hejuru cyanditseho ‘Rwanda’ kigaragaza abagabo babiri bafite imihoro ariko amajosi yabo nta mitwe iriho, ahubwo imitwe yatakaye hasi, umutwe umwe ubwira mugenzi wawo ngo ‘Twakwiyunze?’ Tariki 30 Werurwe 2016, ikinyamakuru gishushanyije Charlie Hebdo cyasohoye nimero yacyo ya 1236. Hifashishijwe inkuru y’umuhanzi w’umunyarwanda uba mu Bubiligi Stromae n’urupfu rwa Papa we Rutare Pierre wazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Igishushanyo cya Charlie Hebdo cyagaragazaga Stromae yibaza ngo “Papa où t’es?” (Papa uri he) hirya hari amaguru n’amaboko bicitse n’ijisho ryavuyemo bivuga ngo ‘Ndi hano, na hariya.” Ibyo byakozwe byashenguye Stromae dore ko n’ubu umubiri w’umubyeyi we utaraboneka ngo ushyingurwe mu cyubahiro. Ibuka France et la CRF exigent le respect de la dignité de celles et ceux, assasiné-es ou rescapé-es, que les bourreaux génocidaires croyaient pouvoir leur refuser. title: U Buholandi: Abanyarwanda bibutse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga (Amafoto)
content: Igikorwa cyo kwibuka muri uyu mwaka cyabaye mu buryo bwihariye bitewe n’ingamba zafashwe n’ibihugu bitandukanye ku Isi zigamije kurwanya ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo cya COVID-19 giterwa n’agakoko gashya ka Coronavirus. Umuhango wo kwibuka mu Buholandi wateguwe na Ibuka-Hollande, Ambasade y’u Rwanda n’inshuti zarwo zirimo abahagarariye ibihugu byabo n’imiryango mpuzamahanga itandukanye ikorera muri icyo gihugu. Wabaye buri wese ari mu rugo rwe cyangwa aho akorera akazi. Kuva ku bana kugera ku bakuru, bitabiriye iki gikorwa cyo gutangiza Icyumweru cy’Icyunamo cyabaye ku wa 7 Mata 2020. Mu kiganiro IGIHE yagiranye na Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Buholandi, Jean Pierre Karabaranga, yasobanuye ko mu gukomeza ibikorwa byo kwibuka hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga. Yagize ati “Tukimara guhabwa amabwiriza ajyanye na COVID-19 twahise dutekereza uburyo abacitse ku icumu rya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mbere na mbere bataba ari bonyine mu gihe kidasanzwe cyo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26. Twakoze ibishoboka ngo buri wese aho ari abigiremo uruhare, hateguwe uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga aho uwabishoboye wese yacanye urumuri nk’ikimenyetso gikomeye cyo kuba hamwe tugatangirana icyunamo.’’ Iki gikorwa cyatambukijwe kuri Chaîne ya Youtube ya Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Buholandi. Cyerekaniwemo filime mbarankuru yatangiye kurebwa ku wa 7 Mata saa 16h. Umuhango wo kwibuka mu Buholandi watangijwe n’Umunyamabanga wa mbere muri Ambasade, Herbert Ndahiro, watanze ikaze ku bawukurikiye bari mu bice bitandukanye. Abawukurikiye banasangijwe ubuhamya bwa Umulisa Cécile warokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, uko yarokowe akaza no kwiremamo icyizere cy’ubuzima abikesha ubuyobozi bwiza. Nyuma y’ubutumwa n’ubuhamya byatanzwe, hanacanwe urumuri rw’icyizere rugaragaza ahazaza hatekanye n’umunota wo kwibuka inzirakarengane zishwe muri Jenoside. Amb. Karabaranga yavuze ko ari ingenzi kwibuka abishwe bazira ubusa no kuba hafi abarokotse muri ibi bihe bitoroshye. Ati “Iki gikorwa muri ibi bihe ni ngombwa kuko dukomeza kuba hafi imiryango yiciwe ababo ngo idaheranwa n’agahinda no gukomeza gukora ibishoboka byose ngo ntihazongere kubaho Jenoside.’’ Yifashishije ijambo rya Perezida Kagame avuga ko ari ibihe byo guha umwanya Abatutsi bishwe muri Jenoside n’abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, bakabaho mu bihe bikomeye byatewe n’ayo mateka mabi. Ati “Dukomeze tubabe hafi. Kandi hamwe dukomeze tugire imbaraga zo kugira ubumwe no kwiyubakira igihugu.’’ Yakomeje ati ‘‘Iyo twibuka bidufasha gusubiza amaso inyuma tukibukiranya ko Jenoside isiga ibisigisigi bigomba guhandurwa burundu kugira ngo twubake u Rwanda rutubereye nkuko tumaze imyaka 26 tubirimo. Tugomba kubikora tunubaka Sosiyete Nyarwanda ijyanye n’ibihe bitarangwa n’amacakubiri, inzangano n’amatiku.’’ Yashimiye inshuti z’u Rwanda zikomeje kuba Abanyarwanda hafi mu bihe nk’ibi kuko ‘inshuti uyibona mu bihe bikomeye’. Mu gukomeza kwifatanya n’Abanyarwanda baba mu mahanga badashobora guhura ngo bahumurizanye mu bihe byo kwibuka, guhera ku wa 8 kugeza tariki ya 13 Mata 2020, hashyizweho gahunda yo kureba amafilime mbarankuru atandukanye guhera saa Kumi za buri munsi kuri Chaîne ya YouTube ya Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Buholandi. Biteganyijwe ko ibikorwa byo kwibuka bizakomeza kugeza muri Nyakanga, mu kuzirikana iminsi 100, Abatutsi bamaze bahigwa bukware, abasaga miliyoni bakicwa bazira uko bavutse. title: #Kwibuka26: Abanyarwanda n’inshuti z’u Rwanda muri Turikiya bibutse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi
content: Umuhango wo gutangiza Kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi wayobowe na Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Turikiya, Williams Nkurunziza witabirwa n’Abagize Umuryango w’Abanyarwanda baba muri icyo gihugu, Abakozi ba Ambasade, inshuti z’u Rwanda n’abandi banyacyubahiro batandukanye. Umuhango watangiranye no gukurikirana ibikorwa byo gutangiza iminsi 100 yo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, byaberaga ku rwibutso rwa Kigali ku Gisozi no kumva ijambo ry’umukuru w’igihugu. Aho muri Turikiya, umuhango waranzwe no kwenyegeza urumuri rw’icyizere hafatwa n’umunota wo kwibuka. Mu butumwa yatanze, Ambasaderi Williams Nkurunziza yavuze ko ibihe by’umwijima ku banyarwanda byarangiye, imyaka 26 ikaba ishize rugendera mu rumuri ry’imiyoborere myiza. Yavuze ko kwibuka muri ibi bihe bya Covid-19 bitoroshye ariko ko ari inshingano kandi ko ari uburyo bwo gutanga isomo ku buryo ayo mateka atasubira mu Rwanda n’ahandi ku Isi. Ati “Buri mwaka Abanyarwanda n’inshuti z’u Rwanda bafata umwanya wo kwifatanya mu kwibuka no kwiyubaka, nta kwibagirwa ibyabaye kuko byatuma amateka yisubiramo”. Yashimiye Inshuti z’u Rwanda zifatanyije muri uwo muhango wo kwibuka amateka akomeye y’u Rwanda, yihanganisha abarokotse Jenoside Yakorewe Abatutsi aho bari hose. Inshuti z’u Rwanda zifatanyije n’Abanyarwanda zatanze ubutumwa bwo kubihanganisha muri ibi bihe bitoroshye. Prof. Dr. Sedat Aybar, wigisha muri kaminuza ya Istanbul Aydin, yashimye ubutwari abanyarwanda bagize bwo kuva mu mateka ashaririye bakubaka igihugu gifite amahoro n’uburumbuke. Yavuze ko imyaka 26 ishize irimo isomo rikomeye ku kiremwamuntu kandi yifatanyije n’u Rwanda mu guha icyubahiro abazize Jenoside. Kuri we kandi ngo kwibuka ni ubutumwa bwo kwamagana ibivugwa n’abahakana Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Amb. Abdurrazaq M. Abdulqader, wahoze ari Ambasaderi wa Libye muri Turikiya, yavuze ko yunamiye abazize Jenoside kandi abahaye icyubahiro. Ibikorwa biri gukomeza mu buryo budasanzwe kubera icyorezo cya Covid-19. Inama hagati y’Abayobozi muri Ambasade na bamwe mu bagize umuryango w’abanyarwanda baba muri Turikiya n’inshuti z’u Rwanda zikorwa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga rya Skype. Abanyarwanda basangizwa raporo, ibiganiro n’ibyatangajwe na Komisiyo y’Igihugu yo kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG) buri munsi.

title: RDC: Amb. Karega yasabye Abanyarwanda Kwibuka baharanira gukosora amateka
content: Ni ubutumwa yatanze mu gihe kuri uyu wa Kabiri, u Rwanda rwifatanyije n’Isi mu kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ni umunsi kandi hatangiyeho icyumweru cy’icyunamo, ariko ntabwo kizabamo ibikorwa bituma abantu bahurira hamwe kubera ingamba zashyizweho zo gukumira ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo cya Coronavirus, gikomeje kwibasira benshi muri RDC, by’umwihariko mu Murwa Mukuru Kinshasa. Mu butumwa yageneye Abanyarwanda baba muri RDC mbere y’uko icyumweru cy’icyunamo gitangira, Amb Karega yabasabye ko mu gihe bibuka, bakwiye no kwibaza ngo “habaye iki ngo tugere kuri iryo shyano, amahano ndengakamere? Twakora iki bene ibyo bitazongera kubaho?" Yakomeje ati "Mu kwibuka twiyubaka tugomba guharanira ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda mu mvugo no mu bikorwa, no guteza imbere igihugu cyacu ku buryo bunogeye bose, kugira ngo tuzakosore amateka mabi dusige umurage mwiza." Mu gutangiza ibikorwa byo Kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, Perezida Paul Kagame na Madamu, baherekejwe n’abayobozi bakuru barimo Perezida wa Sena, Dr Augustin Iyamuremye; uw’Umutwe w’Abadepite, Donatille Mukabalisa; uw’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga Dr Faustin Ntezilyayo na Minisitiri w’Intebe, Dr Edouard Ngirente, benyegeje urumuri rw’icyizere, banashyira indabo ku mva ishyinguwemo abazize Jenoside, ku rwibutso rwa Kigali ku Gisozi. Perezida Kagame yavuze ko ibi bihe bibaye mu gihe Abanyarwanda batabasha guhurira hamwe kubera ingamba zashyizweho mu kwirinda Coronavirus, kandi bamenyereye kuba hamwe mu bihe nk’ibi bagafatanya. Yakomeje ati “Ariko ibi bihe turimo bidasanzwe ntibishobora kutubuza kuzuza inshingano yo kwibuka no guha icyubahiro abo twabuze no gukomeza abarokotse. Hahindutse uburyo bwo kwibuka gusa”. Bitewe n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus, kuri iyi nshuro abaturage bazibukira mu ngo zabo babifashijwemo n’ibiganiro bizahita mu itangazamakuru: Radiyo, Televiziyo n’imbuga nkoranyambaga kandi hazakorwa ibishoboka kugira ngo ibikorwa byo Kwibuka bigere no mu mahanga hakoreshejwe uburyo bw’iyakure.

title: #Kwibuka26: Abanyarwanda bo mu Bubiligi bibutse, basaba icyo gihugu gukomeza guhana abakoze Jenoside
content: Mu ijambo Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Bubiligi, Amandin Rugira, yagejeje ku Banyarwanda n’inshuti z’u Rwanda bari bamukurikiye mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga, yafashe mu mugongo abarokotse Jenoside muri ibi bihe bitoroshye. Ni ibihe bitoroshye kuko ari ibihe bibuka ababo basabwa kuguma mu ngo mu rwego rwo kwirinda icyorezo cya Coronavirus, bishobora kubasubiza mu bihe bibi babayemo muri Jenoside, ubwo babaga bihishe abicanyi. Ambasaderi Rugira yagize ati “Mwabayeho mwihishe mu 1994 ngo mubashe kurokoka, uyu munsi mwisanze mu bihe nk’ibyo bituma mwibuka ako kababaro. Ntabwo bishoboka ko tubaba hafi kubera ibibazo bihari, gusa muri mu bitekerezo n’amasengesho yacu. Mwizere ko imbaraga zababashishije kuva muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, zizabafasha no kurenga ibi bihe bishya.” Yavuze ko nubwo imyaka 26 ishize Jenoside ibaye, urugamba rwo gushaka ubutabera ku bayikorewe rukomeje, abayikoze bagezwa mu nkiko. U Bubiligi ni kimwe mu bihugu bikibarizwamo benshi bashakishwa n’ubutabera n’abakekwaho guhakana no gupfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Umwaka ushize, Umunyarwanda Fabien Neretse yakatiwe n’Urukiko rwo mu Bubiligi igihano cy’imyaka 25 kubera ibyaha bya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ni ubwa mbere mu mateka y’iki gihugu Umunyarwanda yari ahaniwe icyo cyaha. Ambasaderi Rugira yashimye ubwo bushake bw’u Bubiligi, asaba ko n’abandi bakekwaho ibyaha nk’ibyo bagezwa mu butabera. Muri Gicurasi umwaka ushize kandi u Bubiligi bwatoye itegeko rihana abantu bapfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ambasaderi Rugira yasabye ko iryo tegeko rikurikizwa, ku buryo u Bubiligi butaba ubwihisho bw’abahakana Jenoside. Ati “Ni umusanzu ukomeye mu rugamba rwo kurwanya ihakana, niyo mpamvu dushimira u Bubiligi kandi tubushishikariza gukomeza gukurikiza iryo tegeko ryatowe muri Gicurasi 2019 rihana abahakana Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi kugira ngo ubwo bwami bwiza bwoye kuba ubwihisho bw’abahakana Jenoside.” Rugira yasabye Abanyarwanda kuba hafi y’abarokotse Jenoside cyane cyane muri ibi bihe bitoroshye abantu bibuka bari mu ngo. Ati “Mu bihe bidasanzwe, haba hakenewe ingamba zidasanzwe, niyo mpamvu mbashishikariza kongera ingamba mu kwita ku bavandimwe barokotse Jenoside kuko gutekana kwabo mu mutwe, ni umutungo dukwiriye kurinda no kubungabunga.” Mu guha icyubahiro abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, Ubuyobozi bwa Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Bubiligi, ubwa Ibuka-Belgique n’ubw’Umuryango w’Abanyarwanda baba mu Bubiligi bashyize indabo ku nkingi ihagarariye imva y’abazize Jenoside.

title: Kwibuka26: Abanyarwanda baba mu Bushinwa basabwe gukomera ku bumwe, barwanya abahakana Jenoside
content: Babisabwe kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki 7 Mata 2020, ubwo Abanyarwanda baba mu Bushinwa bifatanyaga n’Isi kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Umuhango wo kwibuka wahurije hamwe abanyarwanda basaga 550 baba mu Bushinwa hakoreshejwe uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga mu rwego rwo kwirinda icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Bushinwa, James Kimonyo mu ijambo rye , yasabye abanyarwanda baba mu Bushinwa kurangwa n’indangagaciro z’ubwitange zaranze ingabo za RPA, ubwo zahagarikaga Jenoside ziyobowe na Perezida Paul Kagame. Ambasaderi Kimonyo yasabye abari bamukurikiye gukomeza kwimakaza ubumwe, barwanya ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside n’ihakana ryayo. Yasabye umuryango mpuzamahanga gufatanya n’u Rwanda mu kugeza imbere y’ubutabera abakidegembya bakekwaho uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Muri uyu muhango wo kwibuka, humviswe ubuhamya bwa Ntezimana Jean Népomucène warokotse Jenoside kuri ubu wiga mu Bushinwa, wavuze ku rugendo rwe mbere, muri Jenoside na nyuma yayo. Ntezimana uri kwiga ibijyanye n’ubuvuzi bw’imbere mu mubiri yashimiye ingabo za RPA zamurokoye na Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yagaruriye icyizere abarokotse Jenoside, ibafasha mu kubaka ejo hazaza heza.

title: Kwibuka26: Abanyarwanda baba mu Buyapani bibutse Jenoside, urubyiruko ruhabwa umukoro
content: Byatangajwe kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki 7 Mata ubwo Abanyarwanda batuye mu Buyapani bifatanyaga n’Isi mu kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ubusanzwe ibikorwa byo Kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Buyapani byahurizaga hamwe abanyarwanda, inshuti z’u Rwanda n’abayobozi muri Guverinoma y’u Buyapani. Uyu mwaka ibikorwa byo kwibuka biri gukorwa mu buryo bwihariye kubera ingamba zafashwe zo gukangurira abantu kuguma mu ngo zabo, hahashywa icyorezo cya coronavirus. Ambasade y’u Rwanda i Tokyo yahisemo gukora ibikorwa byo kwibuka mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga (video conference). Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Buyapani, Ernest Rwamucyo mu ijambo yagejeje ku banyarwanda n’inshuti zarwo mu Buyapani yagarutse ku mateka mabi yagejeje u Rwanda kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Yavuze ko kwibuka ari ngombwa “kuko biduha umwanya wo kwibuka abacu bambuwe ubuzima. Tuboneraho umwanya wo kwihanganisha abarokotse Jenoside n’ubu bagifite ibikomere byaba ibigaragara ku mubiri ndetse n’ibitagaragara.” Rwamucyo yavuze ko kwibuka ari umwanya wo gusubiza agaciro n’icyubahiro abazize Jenoside bambuwe ubwo bicwaga urw’agashinyaguro. Yavuze ko ari n’umwanya wo gukangurira abanyarwanda n’isi muri rusange kwirinda ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside n’ihakana n’ipfobya bya Jenoside. Ati “Biduha umwanya wo gukangurira abanyarwanda, abatuye isi ndetse n’imiryango mpuzamahanga kuzirikana ububi bw’ingengabitecyerezo ya Jenoside, ingaruka mbi zo guhakana no gupfobya Jenoside ndetse no kubashishikariza kwamagana ivangura iryo ari ryo ryose ryaba irishingiye ku turere, amoko, amadini, cyangwa ibindi byose bishobora gutandukanya abantu.” Mu myaka 26 ishize, u Rwanda rwagiye rwiyubaka haba mu mibereho y’abaturage n’iterambere muri rusange. Ambasaderi Rwamucyo yashimye umuhate w’ingabo zari iza RPA zahagaritse Jenoside, igihugu kikabona umusingi wo kubakiraho kigana imbere, ubu kikaba gikataje mu bumwe n’ubwiyunge bw’abanyarwanda, ukwisanzura kwa buri munyarwanda, umutekano n’imiyoborere myiza. Yashishikarije urubyiruko gutanga umusanzu warwo mu gukomeza kubaka igihugu. Ati “Mwebwe rubyiruko rwacu, mboneyeho umwanya wo kubakangurira gukunda igihugu cyababyaye. Kwitangira kubaka amateka meza mushyigikira umurongo wa politike nziza yubaka igihugu cyacu.” “By’umwihariko mwebwe muri hano nk’urubyiruko rufite ubumenyi bwihariye n’imyumvire igomba kuba ihanitse murasabwa byinshi.” Ambasaderi Rwamucyo yanasabye abanyarwanda n’inshuti z’u Rwanda gukomeza gufata mu mugongo abarokotse Jenoside muri ibi bihe bikomeye. Ibikorwa byo kwibuka Jenoside bizakomeza muri iki Cyumweru cyo kwibuka mu bihugu birimo Abanyarwanda barebererwa na Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Buyapani. Kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 8 Mata hazibuka Abanyarwanda baba muri Philippines naho kuwa Gatanu tariki 10 hibuke abanyarwanda baba muri Malaysia.

title: Rwandacash Africash yakoze impinduka muri serivisi zo kohererezanya amafaranga
content: Sosiyete itanga serivisi ku bohereza amafaranga mu Rwanda no mu mahanga ya Rwanda Cash LTD yagaragaje ko yakomeje gukora ariko yifashishije uburyo bugezweho kandi bwizewe bwo guhererekanya amafaranga bwa mobile money. Mu Bubiligi, ibiro byose bya Moneytrans-Africash zikorana na Rwandacash LTD byahawe uburenganzira bwo gufungura no kwakira abantu hakurikijwe ingamba zatanzwe n’inzego zibishinzwe. Naho mu Rwanda, Rwandacash LTD yabaye ifunze nkuko amabwiriza yatanzwe na Banki Nkuru y’Igihugu (BNR) abisaba kugeza ubwo hazatangwa andi avuga ku kongera gukora kw’ibigo byohererezanya amafaranga no kuvunja. Bitewe n’amasezerano iyi sosiyete isanzwe ifitanye na MTN Rwanda binyuze muri Mobile Money, abakiliya bose bakira amafaranga mu Rwanda bayashyirirwa kuri Mobile Money gusa. Itangazo ryayo yavuze ko “Hari n’ahongerewe imbaraga mu gukoresha ikoranabuhanga ku bohererezanya amafaranga kuri application ya https://www.moneytrans.eu/belgium/imoneytrans/.’’ Yanamenyesheje ko ishami rya Matonge i Kinshasa muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo rizafungura nihamara kugaruka agahenge nyuma y’icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Abashaka kohererezanya amafaranga bifashishije Rwanda Cash-Africash-Moneytrans bashyiriweho imirongo ya telefoni bashobora kubazaho andi makuru zirimo +32 2 227 18 20 ku bari mu Bubiligi na +250 788 35 87 87 ku bo mu Rwanda. Ikwirakwira cya Coronavirus mu mpande zose z’Isi ryahinduye imibereho ya muntu kugeza no ku ikoranabuhanga yifashisha mu buzima bwa buri munsi. Ubu imibereho y’Isi yubakiye ku bukungu bushingiye ku kudahererekanya amafaranga mu ntoki mu kwirinda ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus. Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima (OMS) ryemeje ku wa 11 Werurwe 2020 ko Coronavirus ari icyorezo cyugarije Isi bitewe n’uburyo umubare w’abayandura wiyongera kuva yaboneka mu Bushinwa mu Ukuboza 2019. Coronavirus imaze guhitana abantu 45 334, mu gihe abayanduye bagera ku 903 799, muri bo 190 675 barayikize.

title: Diaspora mu guhangana n’ingaruka za Coronavirus: Icyifuzo cy’Umunyarwanda uba muri Canada
content: Kugeza ubu mu Rwanda abagera kuri 19 ni bo bimaze kwemezwa ko banduye icyorezo cya COVID-19, giterwa na Coronavirus. Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yafashe ingamba nyinshi, aho kuri uyu wa Gatandatu yashyizeho izindi nshya. Ingamba nshya zo kurwanya ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus zatangajwe na Minisitiri w’Intebe, Dr Ngirente Edouard, zategetse ko abakozi ba leta bose n’abikorera basabwa gukorera akazi mu ngo zabo keretse abatanga serivisi z’ingenzi. Mu kiganiro na IGIHE, Kijuli yavuze ko izi ngamba ari ingenzi cyane kandi zizatanga umusaruro, akifuza ko Abanyarwanda baba muri diaspora bahabwa igisa nk’impuruza bakwishyira hamwe bakazagoboka abazagirwaho ingaruka n’izi ngamba cyane cyane abaryaga kuko bakoze uwo munsi ‘nyakabyizi’. Ati “Nkaba numva mfite igitekerezo cy’uko Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga yakorana vuba na za ambasade zacu aho ziri hose zigashishikariza Abanyarwanda twese dutuye muri bino bihugu [nubwo nabo icyorezo cyabagezeho], bisa n’aho bifite amikoro tukibumbira hamwe tugafasha abavandimwe bacu bazahura n’ikibazo cy’inzara.” Akomeza avuga ko abantu bagenda batanga nk’amadolari 100$, 50$, 10$ gukomeza ariko icyo kintu cyo ‘gutabara abavandimwe bacu kuko twese tuzi amikoro y’ibihugu byacu byo muri Afurika’. Kijuli wigeze kuba Perezida wa Diaspora muri Edmonton na Visi Perezida ku rwego rw’Intara ya Canada, ahumuriza Abanyarwanda agira ati “Tukaba tugira ngo tubakomeze ngo mushikame kandi nta kabuza iki cyorezo abanyarwanda tuzagitsinda.” Mu zindi ngamba Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yafashe zirimo ko ‘ubu imipaka yose irafunze, keretse ku Banyarwanda bataha n’abandi batuye mu Rwanda byemewe n’amategeko, abo bose bakaba bazashyirwa mu kato mu gihe cy’ibyumweru bibiri ahantu hateganyijwe’. ‘Ubwikorezi bw’ibicuruzwa byinjira cyangwa bisohoka mu Rwanda burakomeza mu gihe ingendo hagati y’imijyi n’uturere tw’igihugu zitemewe keretse ku bajya kwivuza cyangwa abafite impamvu zihutirwa’. Nyuma y’izi ngamba, Minisitiri w’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu, Prof. Shyaka Anastase, yagarutse ku bantu barya kuko bakoze uwo munsi, abasaba gutekereza icyaba baramutse bagiye gushaka ayo mafaranga ariko ntibazabashe kuyabona kubera uburwayi; ahubwo abasaba gusaranganya na bagenzi babo muri bike bafite. Minisitiri Prof Shyaka yatangaje ko Leta igiye kwishakamo ibisubizo bizafasha abantu barya ari uko bakoze ku munsi n’abandi bafite amikoro make kugira ngo mu gihe cyo kwirinda Coronavirus batazicwa n’inzara. Ati "Hari ibizasaba nk’igihugu ko abantu baba magirirane, niba hari urugo runaka rudafite icyo gusamura, tugomba kwishakamo ubushobozi ku buryo urwo rugo turwunganira kugira ngo abarurimo tutabarinda Coronavirus ariko bakicwa n’inzara.’’ Ibimenyetso bya Coronavirus birimo kugira umuriro, ibicurane, umunaniro n’inkorora ijyana no kubabara mu mihogo, guhumeka nabi bishobora no kugera aho itera umusonga no kubuza impyiko gukora bishobora gutera urupfu. Iyi ndwara ishobora kwandura binyuze mu gukora ku muntu uyirwaye, cyane cyane mu kuramukanya abantu bahana ibiganza.

title: Abanyarwanda baba muri Amerika batanze miliyoni zisaga 45 Frw zo gufasha abagizweho ingaruka na COVID-19
content: Mu gukumira ko iki cyorezo cyarushaho gukwirakwira mu gihugu, Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yafashe ingamba zirimo gufunga ibikorwa bitandukanye, ingendo zitari ngombwa zirahagarikwa, bigira ingaruka ku bantu benshi cyane cyane abaryaga ari uko uwo munsi bakoze. Guverinoma yahise itangira kugoboka bene abo bantu. Ubu imirimo myinshi imaze gusubukurwa, iheruka ni ingendo z’abamotari nubwo zigifunzwe mu turere twa Rusizi na Rubavu. Umuvugizi wa Diaspora nyarwanda muri Amerika akaba na Visi Perezida w’Umuryango w’Abanyarwanda baba muri uwo mugabane, Emmanuel Muvunyi, yavuze ko bashimira Perezida Paul Kagame ku mbaraga n’ibyiza akomeje kugeza ku gihugu, harimo n’ingamba zo kurinda ubuzima bw’abaturarwanda mu kurwanya ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo cya COVID-19. Yavuze ko bijyanye n’ingamba u Rwanda rwafashe, rwabaye icyitegererezo birenga na Afurika, mu gihe nko kuri Amerika, kubera uburangare no gutinda gushyiraho ingamba zo kwirinda ikwirakwiza rya Coronanavirus, iki cyorezo gikomeje guhitana imbaga y’abantu benshi. Yakomeje ati “Natwe nk’abanyarwanda batuye muri Amerika mu mpanuro nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika adahwema kutugezaho, abatuye muri diaspora ni uko aho duherereye twaje guhaha ubwenge, ubumenyi no gushaka imibereho, dusabwa gusubiza amaso inyuma tukibuka n’aho dukomoka n’imiryango twasize inyuma, kutibagirwa igihugu cyatubyaye, kuko ni cyo cyatugize abo turi bo.” Ni muri urwo rwego bishyize hamwe bakusanya inkunga yo gufasha abaturarwanda babikeneye, kubera ingaruka za Coronavirus. Yakomeje ati “Abanyarwanda batuye ku mugabane wa Amerika bazakomeza gushyigikira gahunda za Leta ziteza imbere imibereho yabaturarwanda ndetse n’igihugu muri rusange.” Mu ibaruwa bandikiwe n’Umunyamabaga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Imari n’Igenamigambi ushinzwe Imari ya Leta, Richard Tusabe, ku wa 29 Gicurasi 2020, Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yashimiye aba banyarwanda ku musanzu batanze. Yakomeje ati “Mu izina rya Guverinoma y’u Rwanda, ndifuza kubashimira nabamenyesha ko twakiriye umusanzu wanyu ungana na USD 47.918,04, mu guhangana n’ingaruka zirimo guterwa n’icyorezo cya COVID-19 binyuze mu bikorwa byo kwita ku mibereho y’abaturage.” Iki cyorezo cyageze mu Rwanda muri Werurwe, kugeza ubu abamaze kwandura ni 397, mu gihe abantu babiri bamaze guhitanwa n’iyi ndwara.

title: Kuki Col Ruhashya Epimaque yiswe Ruhashyinyenzi?
content: Mu kiganiro cyihariye na IGIHE, Ruhashya Egide, yagarutse ku buryo se yafashe icyemezo cyo kujya mu Gisirikare atari yishimiwemo kubera ko yari Umututsi uturuka mu Batsobe bavagamo Abiru b’Ibwami. Ruhashya avuga ko se akiri mu mashuri yisumbuye mu Ndatwa za Groupe Scolaire i Butare mu myaka ya za 1960, yumvise ko hari ibizamini byo kujya mu Ishuri rikuru rya Gisirikare ryaje kwitwa ESM (Ecole Supérieure Militaire). Yashakishije amakuru ajyanye n’ibyo umuntu akora nyuma yo kurisohokamo, arabikunda ajya kwiyandikisha. Mu buhamya bwe avuga ko umubyeyi we yari azi ko aziga ibijyanye na Agronomie. Col Ruhashya yinjiriye rimwe n’abandi basirikare muri promotion ya mbere y’iryo shuri barimo Habyarimana Juvénal wari ufite Matricule nr 01, Kanyarengwe Alexis M. 02, Nsekalije Aloys M.03, Benda Sabin M.04. We yari afite Matricule nr 05. Ruhashya Egide avuga ko akiri muto yakundaga kwegera no kuganira na se, akaba ari nawe wamuvunguriye kuri ayo mateka, anasoma izindi nyandiko. Ati ‘‘Data rero yasohotse muri ryo shuri ari Sous-Lieutenant. Yatangiye imirimo ya gisirikare ari Major. Yambwiye ko muri icyo gihe abasirikare benshi bakuru mu Rwanda bari Ababiligi abandi abato ari Abanye-Congo. Icyo gihe nibwo Abanyarwanda bari bagiye kuba mu basirikare ba mbere bakuru u Rwanda rugize.’’ Col Ruhashya mbere yo kwemererwa kwinjira mu Gisirikare uwari Minisitiri w’Ingabo icyo gihe witwa Sebazungu yabanje kumwangira ariko aza kubwirwa n’umutware Kayumba wari ufitanye ubucuti na Mbonyumutwa ko Umututsi umwe ntacyo atwaye. Mbonyumutwa ngo yavugaga ko ‘byanagaragara neza Umututsi umwe arimo’. Nibwo yinjiranye na bagenzi be barimo Habyarimana Juvénal n’abandi.  	Imibereho ya Col Ruhashya mu gisirikare cya Habyarimana Ruhashya Egide yagaragaje ko umubyeyi we nta bucuti bwihariye yagiranye na Habyarimana kuko binjiranye mu Gisirikare. Yagize “Buriya igisirikare ni ahantu ha mbere abakirimo bakurikiza amategeko, kuvuga ko yaba yarabaye umusirikare wa Habyalimana ndagira ngo mvuge ko atari byo, habaho umusirikare w’igihugu nta musirikare wa kanaka ubaho. Byumvikane neza.’’  	Byavuye he ngo Col Ruhashya yitwe Ruhashyinyenzi? Ruhashya Egide yavuze ko mu bitaga umubyeyi we ‘Ruhashyinyenzi’ barimo abakabyaga n’ababimwitiriye ngo berekane ko arimo kurwana na bene wabo kandi nk’umusirikare wese mu gihugu gitewe usabwa kujya ku rugamba. Urwo rugamba kuri Ruhashya wagira ngo ni we musirikare wenyine wari mu bice byose byatewe haba mu Bugesera, mu Bweyeye, Nshiri n’Umutara.  	Icyo Col Ruhashya yabwiye umuhungu we kuri Coup d‘Etat yo ku wa 5 Nyakanga 1973 Umuhungu wa Col Ruhashya avuga ko byabaye ngombwa ko umubyeyi we ‘ajya mu mubare w’abayikoze ariko byateguwe atabizi abimenya bitinze nibwo agaragaye mu mafoto ya komite yari iyigize byinjira mu mateka bityo.’ Egide Ruhashya yakomeje avuga ko bitari kumvikana ko yari kwitandukanya na bagenzi be biganye. Ati ‘‘Ntibyari kumvikana ukuntu aza gusigara mu bandi kandi ari muri promotion ya mbere n’iya kabiri kuko nizo zakoze Coup d’Etat; aha nibutse ko kandi yarayoboye ikigo gikomeye cyo mu Ruhengeri.’’ Mbere y’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’uwo mugambi, Col Ruhashya yigeze gusagarirwa n’umucamanza witwa Kanani Aminadabu, bigera naho akubitwa urushyi acirwa mu maso, kubera uburakari akuramo imbunda agiye kumurasa, yisubiraho arihangana, atsinda uwo mujinya. Nyuma yaje gukora mu mirimo itandukanye ya gisirikare irimo kuyobora ESO Butare, Ikigo cya Camp Kigali, Ikigo cy’Urubyiruko gishamikiye kuri Minisiteri y’Ingabo icyo gihe ari nacyo yakozemo igihe kinini. Ruhashya Egide avuga ko ‘‘Aho yabaraga amagi y’inkoko, areba imirima yahinzwe imbuto bakoresheje, ibintu bimupyinagaza ku rwego yariho.’’ Col Ruhashya ntiyigeze na rimwe arenga u Rwanda ajya mu yahoze ari Zaïre, Tanzania, u Burundi na Uganda ngo yoherejwe mu butumwa bw’amahoro kuko yakoreshwaga igihe bibaye ngombwa. Yifashishije urugero, umuhungu we yavuze ko mu 1990, mu gihe cy’Intambara yahawe umwanya ukomeye ku izina gusa aho yari ashinzwe kumenya ibintu byose byaba intwaro, ibikoresho byose bikenerwa n’abasirikare ku rugamba. Ati ‘‘Nta na rimwe yigeze akoresha uwo mwanya bagiraga ngo bimwitirirwe gusa berekane ko bari kumwe na we mu kazi. Ntacyo yakoraga mu nshingano zijyanye n’icyo uwo mwanya uvuze. Hari n’izindi ngero nyinshi zagaragaje ihohoterwa n’ishyirwa mu kato mu gihe yari umusirikare mukuru. Ibi byose byakorwaga kuko yari Umututsi, asuzugurwa n’abasirikare bato.’’ Umunsi umwe Col Ruhashya yigeze gusangira n’abandi basirikare bakuru nyuma y’Umunsi Mukuru wabaga ku wa 5 Nyakanga noneho abasirikare bakuru bajya muri Mess ya gisirikare baridagadura. Ruhashya Egide avuga ko ngo ‘‘Haje kujyamo indirimbo nuko Gen Major Habyarimana abwira Col Ruhashya ko bo babyinnye na we yakwidagadura mu ndirimbo ya ‘bene wanyu’ ndetse yayibyinnye wenyine, abandi bamushungereye baseka.’’  	Uko Ruhashya Egide yafashe icyemezo cyo kujya ku rugamba rw’Inkotanyi Ruhashya Egide yavuze ko “Nkurikije ibyo nabonaga nasanze ntaho ntaniye n’ibyatumye abandi bafata icyemezo cyo kujya ku rugamba rwo kubohora igihugu.’’ Ubwo yafataga icyo cyemezo yabanje kumenyesha umubyeyi we, amubwira aho agiye, na we nk’umuntu mukuru uzi ubwenge yaramwumvise amuhesha umugisha wa kibyeyi. Yamubwiye ati ‘‘Mwana wanjye uri umugabo ugende ntuzasibire inyuma.’’ Icyo gihe urugamba rurangiye yagize amahirwe yo kumusanga n’umuryango bongera kubana. Ubwo yageraga mu rugo avuye ku rugamba, yari yambaye impuzankano ya gisirikare. Avuga ko agikubitana amaso n’umubyeyi we, yamuhaye isaruti igaragaza ko amwubashye nkuko bigenda mu gisirikare, na we amuha uburenganzira bwo kumuramutsa barahoberana. Yakomeje avuga ati ‘‘Nongeye nshimishwa no kumubona akorera igihugu cye kuko Leta yari iyobowe na FPR yamugaruriye icyizere. Aho namubonye bikashimishwa ni ubwo yari mu mwambaro w’abasirikare bakuru ku rwego rwa Colonel igihe habaga umunsi mukuru wo kwibohora.’’ Urubyaro rwa Col Ruhashya, witabye Imana azize uburwayi, bishimira ko umubyeyi wabo yahesheje agaciro impuzankano ya Gisirikare, anagihagararira mu butumwa bw’amahoro, amahirwe yari yarimwe ku ngoma ya Habyarimana.  	Reba ibice bitatu by’ibiganiro birambuye IGIHE yagiranye na Ruhashya Egide, umwana wa nyakwigendera Col Ruhashya [email protected]

title: Abakinnyi ba PSG bifatanyije n’u Rwanda mu Kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi
content: Kuva ku wa 7 Mata 2020, Abanyarwanda n’inshuti z’u Rwanda bari mu minsi 100 yo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, yahitanye inzirakarengane zisaga miliyoni mu mezi atatu gusa. Ni muri urwo rwego, Ikipe ya Paris Saint-Germain ihagarariwe n’abakinnyi barindwi barimo Kylian Mbappé watsinze ibitego byinshi muri shampiyona y’uyu mwaka w’imikino wa 2019/20 mu Bufaransa, yatanze ubutumwa bwo kwifatanya n’u Rwanda muri ibi bihe. Ni ubutumwa bw’amashusho y’amasegonda 40, aho aba bakinnyi bose uko ari barindwi bagenda bakuranwa mu kuvuga amagambo yo kwifatanya n’u Rwanda mu kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Butangirwa n’amagambo y’Ikinyarwanda avugwa na Kylian Mbappé ati “Twibuke Twiyubaka”, agahita yakirwa n’Umunya-Sénégal, Idrissa Gana Gueye n’abandi bagakurikira mu gihe busozwa n’ubundi aba bakinnyi bavuga bati “Twibuke Twiyubaka” nk’amagambo agize insanganyamatsiko y’uyu mwaka. Bose bagize bati “Twibuke Twiyubaka. Rwanda, abakinnyi ba Paris Saint-Germain bagufitiye ubutumwa. Twifatanyije nawe mu kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Mu myaka 26 ishize kuva icyo gihe, wagaragaje ubumwe, kwihangana n’impinduka z’intangarugero Isi ishobora kukwigiraho, ikanakurikiza. No muri ibi bihe bikomeye, turi kumwe nawe dukomeza gushyigikira intambwe u Rwanda rukomeje gutera. Sitwe tuzarota dusura u Rwanda mu gihe cya vuba. Twibuke twiyubaka.” Guhera mu Ukuboza 2019, u Rwanda rwagiranye ubufatanye na Paris Saint-Germain, buzamara imyaka itatu bugamije kureshya abashoramari no gukomeza kuba icyerekezo kibereye ubukerarugendo. Muri ubu bufatanye, ikirango cya Visit Rwanda kigaragazwa kuri Stade ya Parc des Princes aho PSG yakirira imikino yayo ndetse no ku mugongo ku myenda iyi kipe ikoresha mu myitozo no mu gihe cyo kwishyushya mbere y’imikino, yaba iyo yambara yasuye indi kipe cyangwa iyo yambara iwayo muri Shampiyona y’u Bufaransa, Ligue 1. Mu biganiro byahuje abahagarariye Paris Saint-Germain na Minisiteri ya Siporo, hemejwe ko iyi kipe izubaka ishuri ry’umupira w’amaguru mu Karere ka Huye.

title: Ubujurire bwa Neretse Fabien wahamijwe ibyaha bya Jenoside bwatewe utwatsi
content: Tariki 20 Ukuboza 2019 nibwo Urukiko rwo mu Mujyi wa Bruxelles rwategetse ko Neretse afungwa imyaka 25 nyuma yo kumuhamya ibyaha bya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Neretse ku wa 29 Mata uyu mwaka yajuririye icyemezo cyo gufungwa imyaka 25 ariko urw’iremezo narwo rwanzuye ko iki gihano kigumishwaho. Ubushinjacyaha bwari bwasabiye Neretse gufungwa imyaka 30 ariko Urukiko rwo rutegeka ko afungwa imyaka 25 nyuma yo kumuhamya ibyaha yaregwaga. Ku wa Kane tariki 19 Ukuboza, Urukiko Mpanabyaha rwo mu Mujyi wa Bruxelles mu Bubiligi nibwo rwaburanishije Neretse, runamuhamya icyaha cya Jenoside n’ibyaha by’intambara. Mu Ugushyingo 2019 nibwo urubanza rwa Neretse rwatangiye kuburanishwa. Yashinjwaga ibyaha 13 by’intambara na bitatu byo kwica muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Neretse yari akurikiranyweho ibikorwa by’ubwicanyi mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi i Nyamirambo no mu Mataba mu yahoze ari Komini Ndusu muri Ruhengeri hagati ya 6 Mata 1994 na 14 Nyakanga 1994. Yarezwe gushishikariza abasirikare kwica Abatutsi, aho 13 biciwe i Nyamirambo. Yanashinze Umutwe w’Interahamwe mu Mataba, awuha intwaro mbere yo kugaba ibitero ku Batutsi, ariko anabaha ibihembo by’amafaranga. Icyemezo cy’Urukiko rwa Bruxelles cyo gukatira Neretse imyaka 25 cyari gifite umwihariko kuko ni ubwa mbere u Bubiligi bukurikiranye bukanahana icyaha cya Jenoside hashingiwe ku itegeko rihana. Mbere ya Neretse, hari Abanyarwanda baburanishijwe n’inkiko z’u Bubiligi hashingiwe ku itegeko rihana ibyaha byibasira inyokomuntu n’iby’intambara. Urubanza rwe rwaranzwe n’amagambo ahakana Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yavuzwe n’uwunganira Neretse, Me Jean Flamme, aho abari mu rubanza, harimo n’abacamanza basanze arengera avuga ko habaye Jenoside ebyiri. Kuva mu ntangiriro y’urubanza rwa Neretse, umwunganira, Me Flamme yagiye akoresha imvugo ihakana Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi avuga ko habaye Jenoside ebyiri. Uyu mugambi we kandi watumye atumira mu rubanza abantu basanzwe bazwiho kuyihakana nka Judi Rever, Joseph Matata, Johann Swinnen n’abandi. Intego ye kwari ukwerekana ko nta Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yabayeho, ko rero uwo yunganira nta ruhare abifitemo kuko icyaha akurikiranyweho kitabayeho. Iyi mvugo yatangaje benshi mu rukiko bituma umucamanza asaba uwunganira Neretse kuyirinda. Flamme azwiho kuba umuhakanyi nk’uko yabigaragaje mu rubanza rwa Tharcisse Renzaho yunganiraga. Neretse yanashyizeho itsinda ryagombaga gutanga ruswa kugira ngo abatangabuhamya bamushinjure, atanga imirima n’amafaranga. Urubanza rwa Fabien Neretse w’imyaka 72 rwatangiye mu Ugushyingo 2019 ubwo hatoranywaga itsinda ry’abaturage bagombaga gutanga ubuhamya bumushinja n’ubumushinjura. Nyuma y’iminsi itatu rutangira kuburanishwa mu mizi. Fabien Neretse ukomoka mu Ruhengeri yafatiwe mu Bufaransa mu 2011. Uyu mugabo wari ufite ijambo ku butegetsi bwa Habyarimana, ashinjwa kugira uruhare mu kwica Umubiligi Claire Beckers n’umugabo we Isaïe Bucyana n’umukobwa wabo Katia. Aba biciwe i Kigali ku wa 9 Mata 1994, nyuma y’iminsi mike Jenoside itangiye.

title: U Bwongereza: Abarokotse Jenoside bagaragaje imyirondoro y’abajenosideri bacyidegembya
content: Mu itangazo rigaragaza ibyishimo batewe n’ifatwa rya Kabuga Félicien, abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi baba mu Bwongereza bahuriye mu muryango witwa ‘Ishami Foundation’ bagaragaje urutonde n’aho abajenosideri batanu baherereye mu Bwongereza basaba ko bafatwa bakagezwa imbere y’ubutabera. Ku wa 16 Gicurasi 2020 nibwo inkuru yabaye kimomo ko nyuma y’imyaka 26 ashakishwa ngo aryozwe ibyaha ashinjwa bifitanye isano na Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, Kabuga Félicien ufatwa nk’umuterankunga wa Jenoside, yafatiwe mu Bufaransa ku myaka 84. Ni inkuru abarokotse Jenoside bari mu Rwanda no mu mahanga, bakiriye neza. Umuryango ‘Ishami Foundation’ na wo wagaragaje ko wishimiye ifatwa rye, uhamagarira u Bwongereza kubikuraho isomo bukagira icyo bukora ku bakekwaho uruhare muri Jenoside babubamo. Itangazo uwo muryango washyize hanze ku wa mbere tariki 18 Gicurasi 2020 rivuga ko ‘kimwe n’abandi Banyarwanda b’imbere mu gihugu n’ahandi ku Isi, abarokotse n’abanyeshuri baba mu Bwongerereza, bishimiye ifatwa rya Félicien Kabuga wafatiwe i Paris ku wa Gatandatu mu gitondo’. Ryibutsa u Bwongereza ko bugicumbikiye abajenosideri kandi ko abarokotse bakeneye ubutabera. Rigira riti “Ariko tuributsa Guverinoma y’u Bwongereza ko hakiri Abanyarwanda bashinjwa uruhare muri Jenoside bakiba hano mu Bwongereza.” Nyuma ya Jenoside abayigizemo uruhare bahungiye mu bihugu bitandukanye ndetse benshi bahindura imyirondoro batangira ubuzima bushya. Ishami Foundation yagaragaje urutonde rwa batanu baba mu Bwongereza, barimo abahinduye amazina, abandi biyitiriye ibindi bihugu. Urwo rutonde ruriho Vincent Bajinya, bahimba Brown. Uyu yari umwe mu bari bagize ‘Akazu’ ka Perezida Habyarimana kateguye Jenoside. Afatanyije n’Interahamwe ni umwe mu bapangaga za bariyeri muri Kigali. Ubu ngo aba mu gace ka Islington. Hari Mutabaruka Célestin wari Pasiteri mu Itorero ry’Abapantekote wagize uruhare mu iyicwa ry’Abatutsi barenga ibihumbi 20 bishwe urubozo. Hari n’abo abatangabuhamya bavuga ko babanje gukurwamo amaso. Ubu aba i Kent, agace karangwamo inyubako zidasanzwe kandi gafatwa nk’agakuze cyane mu Bwongereza. Kuri urwo rutonde hariho kandi Charles Munyaneza wari Burugumesitiri wa Komini Kinyamakara muri Perefegitura ya Gikongoro, ushinjwa kuyobora ibitero ku bihumbi by’Abatutsi bishwe bakajugunywa muri Mwogo. Ubu aba mu Mujyi wa Bedford. Uwari Burugumesitiri wa Komini ya Kigoma, mu yari perefegitura ya Gitarama, Ugirashebuja Célestin, wategetse Interahamwe kwica Abatutsi yari yategetswe ko babeshywa ko baje kurindirwa kuri komini na we ngo aba aho mu Bwongereza mu Mujyi muto wa Walton-on-the-Naze. Hari kandi Nteziryayo Emmanuel wari Burugumesitiri wa Komini, Mudasomwa muri Perefegitura ya Gikongoro. Uyu akaba we ubwe yarayoboye ibitero byishe Abatutsi muri komini ye. Nyuma yo kugera mu Bwongereza yahinduye amazina yiyita Emmanuel Ndikumana aho aba mu gace ka Wythenshawe mu Mujyi wa Manchester, nk’impunzi y’Umurundi. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Ishami Foundation, Eric Murangwa Eugène, avuga ko u Bwongereza butaraha abarokotse Jenoside ubutabera, mu gihe cyose abo bajenosideri batarafatwa ngo baryozwe ibyo bakoze. Ati “Guverinoma y’u Bwongereza yahakanye ubutabera ku barokotse, yanga kohereza cyangwa kuburanisha abajenosideri batanu b’Abanyarwanda. Kunanirwa gutanga ubutabera kw’inzego z’ubutabera z’u Bwongereza, byongera guhakana Jenoside kandi bigira ingaruka ku gukira ibikomere kw’abarokotse. ” Yavuze ko bahamagarira Leta y’u Bwongereza na Guverinoma z’ibihugu n’umuryango mpuzamahanga muri rusange guhagarara ku ruhande rw’abarokotse, bagafatanya gukura abajenosideri mu mihanda yo mu Bwongereza n’ahandi ku Isi yose bakagezwa imbere y’ubutabera byashoboka bakajyanwa ahakorewe icyaha. Ku ifatwa rya Kabuga, Murangwa n’abandi bagize Ishami Foundation bavuze ko bizeye ko ubutabera buzatangwa vuba, kuko bwatinze bihagije, ariko bose bagahiriza ku kuba u Bwongereza bukwiye gufatira urugero ku Bufaransa bugatanga abajenosideri baburimo. Bagaragaza ko n’ibindi bihugu bikwiye kubifatiraho isomo. Ishami Foundation ni umuryango w’abagiraneza uhuza Abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi hakoreshejwe umupira w’amaguru mu rwego rwo kubaka ubumwe n’amahoro. Ni umuryango urimo abanyarwanda n’abanyamahanga.

title: Uko Ibuka Europe yakiriye ifatwa rya Kabuga ukekwaho uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi
content: Ubutabera bw’u Bufaransa bwatangaje ko bwataye muri yombi Félicien Kabuga ku wa 16 Gicurasi 2020 ; uyu musaza yabaga mu nzu ya Asnières-sur-Seine i Paris aho yari yarahinduye imyirondoro. Félicien Kabuga w’imyaka 84 afatwa nk’uwabaye umuterankunga ukomeye wa Jenoside, aho mu Ugushyingo 1993, icyo gihe Sosiyete ye Kabuga yinjije mu gihugu toni 25 z’imihoro ivuye mu Bushinwa, nyuma muri Werurwe 1994 agura indi mihoro ibihumbi 50. Ni intwaro zakoreshejwe mu kwica Abatutsi muri Jenoside. Uretse ibyo ashinjwa ko ari n’umwe mu banyamigabane bashinze Radio RTLM, yagize uruhare rukomeye mu kubiba urwango mbere no mu gihe cya Jenoside. Nyuma y’imyaka 23 ashyiriweho impapuro mpuzamahanga zo kumuta muri yombi agakomeza gukoresha ubutunzi bwe yihishahisha, Ibuka Europe yakiriye neza ifatwa rye ryagizwemo uruhare n’inzego zitandukanye. Ibuka Europe mu izina ry’abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yashimye Urwego rwasigariyeho Inkiko Mpuzamahanga Mpanabyaha, IRMCT ndetse n’u Bufaransa mu ifatwa rya Kabuga. Itangazo uwo muryango wageneye itangazamakuru rivuga ko “iyi ntambwe irakuraho imigirire yagaragaraga mu bihugu byo mu Burengerazuba ndetse by’umwihariko mu Bufaransa kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.’’ Yibukije ko igikorwa cyo gufata Kabuga ‘kizagira agaciro mu gihe hazafatwa n’abandi.’ Ibuka Europe yasabye IRMCT guhagarika kurekura bidakurikije amategeko bamwe mu bahamijwe ibyaha ndetse bakatiwe n’urukiko kandi bagifite ibihano bagomba kurangiriza muri gereza. Ikomeza ivuga ko ‘‘Bibabaza abarokotse Jenoside, bigaha ababyungukiramo n’inshuti zabo icyuho cyo gutesha agaciro icyaha cya Jenoside no kuyihakana. Turayihamagarira kongera imbaraga mu gushaka abandi bihisha ubutabera.’’ Uyu muryango wasabye ibihugu byo mu Burengerazuba bw’isi kwihutisha iperereza ku birego byatanzwe mu nkiko no kunoza imikoranire y’u Rwanda na IRMCT. Uvuga ko ari “akaga kubona ibihugu nk’u Busuwisi, u Bubiligi n’u Bufaransa byaracumbikiye igihe kirekire umuntu ushinjwa icyaha gikomeye. U Burayi ntibugomba guhinduka indiri y’ubwihisho bw’abanyabyaha bahunga ubutabera.’’ Ibuka Europe yagaragaje ko umuco wo kudahana atari igitutsi ku barokotse gusa ahubwo ari ubutumwa bwo gushyigikira abicanyi b’ahazaza ndetse ni ‘ukugambanira ikiremwamuntu.’ Itangazo rya Ibuka Europe ryashyizweho umukono n’abayobozi bw’uwo muryango barimo Perezida wayo akaba n’uwa Ibuka France, Nsanzimana Etienne ; Félicité Lyamukuru uyobora Ibuka Belgique; Christine Safari wa Ibuka Hollande; Honorine Mujyambere wa Ibuka Italie; Jacqueline Mukandanga Blam wa Ibuka Allemagne na Murangira César wa Ibuka Suisse. Kabuga yashyiriweho na ICTR impapuro zo kumuta muri yombi mu 1997 ku byaha birindwi birimo icyaha cya Jenoside, ubufatanyacyaha mu cyaha cya Jenoside, gukangurira abantu gukora Jenoside, ubwinjiracyaha bwa Jenoside n’ibindi bifitanye isano na Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.

title: U Butaliyani: Insengero zemerewe gufungura ariko zishyirirwaho amabwiriza yo kwirinda Coronavirus
content: Muri iki gitondo abakirisitu basubiye mu nsengero, igihugu kikaba gikomeje koroshya ibikorwa bimwe na bimwe nyuma y’igihe bifunzwe. Umuyobozi w’Inama y’Abepisikopi mu Butaliyani, Gualtiero Bassetti, yavuze ko nubwo insengero zifunguye, abantu basabwa kubahiriza amabwiriza harimo kujya bambara udupfukamunwa kandi bakirinda kwegerana. Avuga ko mu rusengero abantu basabwa kujya batandukana, baba bicaye cyangwa bahagaze. Harimo kandi ko ahashyirwa amazi y’umugisha nta kintu kigomba kuba kirimo, nta guhana ikimenyetso cy’amahoro n’ibindi. Kuri uyu wa Mbere Kiziliya ya Basilica nayo yafunguye imiryango, nyuma y’umwanya muto Umushumba wa Kiliziya Gatolika, Papa Francis yishimiye ivuka rya Papa Yohani Pawulo wa Kabiri, wabonye izuba mu 1920. Papa Francis yavuze ku bigwi byaranze Yohani Pawulo wa Kabiri, harimo ko ngo yazengurutse Isi yigisha gushyira hamwe, urukundo n’ibindi. Kuva icyorezo cya Coronavirus cyaduka, Papa Francis ntiyongeye guhuza abantu benshi muri kiliziya ahubwo hakoreshwaga uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga. Kugeza ubu ntibiramenyekana uburyo uyu Mushumba wa Kiliziya Gatolika azatangamo isengesho. U Butaliyani ni kimwe mu bihugu byashegeshwe cyane na Coronavirus kuko abantu 225 435 baranduye, 31 908 barapfa mu gihe 125 176 aribo bakize.

title: Abanyarwanda baba mu Burusiya bibutse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi
content: Umuhango wo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi wabaye ku wa 16 Gicurasi 2020, hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga bijyanye n’ingamba zo kwirinda icyorezo cya COVID-19 giterwa n’agakoko ka Coronavirus. Witabiriwe n’Abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo ziba mu Burusiya n’intumwa zihagarariye ibihugu byazo bibutse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda. Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Burusiya, Lt General Frank Mushyo Kamanzi, mu ijambo rye yasobanuye uko umugambi wa Jenoside wacuzwe ukanashyirwa mu bikorwa. Yagize ati “Nk’uko mubizi mu 1994 mu gihugu cyacu cy’u Rwanda, guhera ku wa 7 Mata, mu gihe cy’iminsi 100, habayeho Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, y’indengakamere, yateguwe inashyirwa mu bikorwa n’ubutegetsi bwariho icyo gihe.” Yakomeje avuga ko “Uyu munsi mu Burusiya no hanze yabwo, Abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo baribuka inzirakarengane, zirenga miliyoni zishwe zizira ko ari Abatutsi.’’ Ambasaderi Lt General Frank Mushyo yahumurije abacitse ku icumu, anabashimira ubutwari bwabo, kwihangana no kubabarira, byagize uruhare mu kwiyunga no gukiza igihugu. Yashimiye ingabo za “Rwanda Patriotic Army” zari zirangajwe imbere na Perezida Paul Kagame mu kubohora no guhagarika Jenoside, mu gihe amahanga yareberaga. Mu 2014, Akanama k’Umuryango w’Abibumbye, gashinzwe Umutekano, kashyizeho Icyemezo 2150 (2014) cyerekeye gukumira no kurwanya Jenoside n’ibindi byaha bikomeye bikubiye mu mategeko mpuzamahanga, yemeza ko nta guhakana Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi kandi isaba ibihugu bigize uyu muryango guteza imbere uburezi bwabo, bashyiramo gahunda z’amasomo yigisha kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri 1994 mu rwego rwo gukumira ko nta handi Jenoside izongera kuba. Icyo cyemezo kandi gihamagarira ibihugu byose gukora iperereza, guta muri yombi, gukurikirana cyangwa kohereza mu Rwanda cyangwa mu nkiko mpuzamahanga abantu bose baregwa Jenoside baba ku butaka bwabo. Ibi ariko hari aho bitarashyirwa mu bikorwa kuko abantu benshi bakekwaho icyaha cyo gukora Jenoside bakorera mu bwisanzure mu bihugu bimwe na bimwe, ariko banakomeza gukwirakwiza ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi no kuyihakana. Ambasaderi Lt General Frank Mushyo yahamagariye ibihugu byaba bifite abanyabyaha kubashyikiriza ubutabera. Yashimiye Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga y’u Burusiya ku butumwa yoherereje Abanyarwanda, ashimira inshuti z’u Rwanda ku bufatanye bwabo muri iki gihe cyo kwibuka no kwigomwa umwanya bakitabira igikorwa cyo kwibuka mu gihe Isi ihanganye na COVID-19. Mu bashyitsi bakuru bitabiriye igikorwa cyo kwibuka barimo Ambasaderi wa Cameroun, Mahamat Paba Sale, ari nawe uhagarariye itsinda ry’Abambasaderi b’Abanyafurika mu Burusiya. Mu ijambo rye yihanganishije Abanyarwanda, anavuga ko ibyababayeho, ari ibyago ku Rwanda no kuri Afurika. Yashimiye iterambere ry’u Rwanda mu nzego zitandukanye, rukaba kuri ubu ari igihugu gifatwa nk’ishema rya Afurika. Mu ijambo rye Pasiteri Pavel yagejeje ku bakurikiranaga uyu muhango wo kwibuka, yavuze ko umwanya nk’uyu ari uwo kuzirikana ku byabaye ku Banyarwanda, kandi urubyiruko rwabonye ibyabaye, n’urutarabibonye rukigishwa ko rudakwiye kuzijandika mu bikorwa bya kinyamaswa. Yagize ati “Ntibizongere kubaho ukundi.” Umuyobozi wa Diaspora Nyarwanda i Moscow, Ruhinda Alexis, yibanze ku kubwira urubyiruko bagenzi be ko mu myaka 26 ishize hari isomo rikwiye gusiga. Ati “Turimo twibuka, hari urubyiruko rwagendeye ku nama mbi rukoreka igihugu.’’ Yasabye urubyiruko kumenya gushungura amakuru rubona cyane cyane akwirakwiza ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside, kuko ntaho yageza igihugu, ahubwo yagisubiza inyuma. Ibikorwa byo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi bizasozwa muri Nyakanga, igihe kingana n’iminsi 100 yamaze mbere yo guhagarikwa.

title: Abanyarwanda baba muri Malawi batanze miliyoni 12 Frw zo gufasha abagizweho ingaruka na Coronavirus
content: Mu gihe mu Rwanda abantu baherutse kumara iminsi igera kuri 43 bari mu ngo mu rwego rwo kwirinda ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus, muri Malawi imirimo yarakomeje. Ibi byatumye Abanyarwanda baba muri icyo gihugu giherereye mu Majyepfo ya Afurika, bakusanya inkunga yo gufasha abagizweho ingaruka n’icyo cyorezo mu Rwanda, aho hari abaryaga ari uko bakoze n’abandi bagizweho ingaruka n’ingamba zo kwirinda Coronavirus. Ngizwenayo Ephrem, Visi Perezida wa kabiri ushinzwe ubukungu muri Diaspora ya Malawi, yabwiye IGIHE ko bishatsemo ubushobozi kugira ngo bafashe bagenzi babo bo mu Rwanda nyuma yo kumenya ko imirimo yari itunze bamwe yahagaze. Ati “Tumaze kubona ko bagenzi bacu bo mu Rwanda bari bamaze iminsi bari mu ngo kubera icyorezo cya COVID-19, twaricaye nk’abantu bari hanze hano muri Malawi, tubanza guterana nk’abantu bo muri Komite, twiga ikintu twakora ngo dufashe bagenzi bacu.” “Twagiye inama ko dushishikariza Abanyarwada bose bari muri Malawi, tubasaba ko bakusanya inkunga kugira ngo dufashe bagenzi bacu bari mu ngo, batari ku kazi, tuzi ko benshi bari batunzwe no kujya ku kazi, batari kurya.” Inkunga ingana n’ibihumbi 13.43$ (12,590,625 Frw) ni yo yakusanyijwe binyuze mu kugera mu duce twose turimo Abanyarwanda muri Malawi. Ati “Twitoyemo abantu batandatu bajya muri buri Ntara yo muri Malawi, ahantu hose hari Umunyarwanda, tukamugezaho igitekerezo twagize, buri wese twagezeho yabyakiriye neza, akaduha inkunga. Mu gihe cy’icyumweru kimwe twabikoze, twakusanyije miliyoni 11 z’amafaranga ya hano. Ubwo ni ibihumbi 13.43$.” Nyuma yo gukusanya iyo nkunga, bifashishije Ambasade y’u Rwanda i Lusaka muri Zambia ari na yo ibareberera bohereza inkunga i Kigali mu cyumweru gishize. Ngizwenayo yakomeje avuga ko mu gihe bo bakomeje imirimo yabo isanzwe bahisemo kuzirikana bagenzi babo bo mu Rwanda nk’abantu bakunda igihugu cyababyaye. Ati “Turi abantu dushyira hamwe kandi dukunda igihugu, ikibazo cyose cyaba ku gihugu gisaba ubufasha cyangwa ikindi kintu, twagira icyo dukora ngo bigende neza, twese hano dufite umutima wo guteza imbere igihugu cyacu.” Aba Banyarwana baba muri Malawi bagera kuri 470 ubariyemo n’abana, basanzwe kandi bafashanya hagati yabo, bita ku batishoboye. Si ubwa mbere diaspora yo muri Malawi igize uruhare mu bikorwa byo gushyigikira Abanyarwanda b’imbere mu gihugu kuko yatanze miliyoni 5 Frw muri gahunda ya Bye Bye Nyakatsi n’ibihumbi 22$ mu kigega Agaciro Development Fund.

title: Abanyarwanda baba muri Canada batanze miliyoni 20 Frw zo gufasha abagizweho ingaruka na Coronavirus
content: Umuyobozi w’Umuryango w’Abanyarwanda baba muri Canada, Joachim Mutezintare, yabwiye IGIHE ko nubwo batuye muri Canada, umutima wabo uterera mu Rwanda ibyo bikabatera guhora bakurikiranira hafi ibihabera. Yavuze ko bafashe icyemezo cyo kwishakamo inkunga bagenera Abanyarwanda bari imbere mu gihugu, nyuma yo kubona ko hari abagizweho ingaruka no kubahiriza ingamba zo kwirinda ikwirakwira rya Covid-19. Ati “Kubera iki cyorezo cya Covid-19 n’ingaruka za Guma mu rugo, twatekereje Abanyarwanda ubusanzwe babonaga ikibatunga ari uko basohotse, nka ba nyakabyizi. Ni ho igitekerezo cyo kubashakira inkunga cyavuye, tukifatanya n’abandi banyarwanda, tugahuza imbaraga zo kurwanya ingaruka za Coronavirus ku batishoboye.” Nyuma yo kugira icyo gitekerezo, abanyarwanda baba muri icyo gihugu bakoresheje urubuga rwa "Gofundme", umuntu agatanga uko abishoboye, bakusanya $ 21.519 mu byumweru bibiri. Guverinoma y’u Rwanda iheruka gufata icyemezo ko ibikorwa bimwe na bimwe bifungurwa, gusa hari imirimo imwe n’imwe nk’abari basanzwe ari abamotari igifunzwe, hakiyongeraho abatakaje imirimo yabo ubu bakeneye gufashwa. Guverinoma yashimiye Abanyarwanda baba muri Canada ku bwo kuzirikana abanyarwanda bari imbere mu gihugu. Mu ibaruwa Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Imari n’Igenamigambi ushinzwe imari ya Leta, Tusabe Richard, yabandikiye ku wa 5 Gicurasi, yagize, ati “Mu izina rya Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ndabashimira nanabamenyesha ko twakiriye inkunga yanyu ingana na $21.519 igamije gufasha mu guhangana n’ingaruka za Covid-19 binyuze mu gufasha abatishoboye.” Mu buzima busanzwe, Mutezintare yavuze ko nta kibazo cyihariye Abanyarwanda baba muri Canada bafite, uretse ibyo basangiye n’abanya-Canada muri ibi bihe. Muri rusange abadashobora gukora kubera ibikorwa byahagaritswe, Leta ibaha Amafaranga yo kubatunga. Mu kwezi gushize banahuriye hamwe mu bikorwa byo Kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakrewe Abatutsi, ibikorwa byabaye hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga.

title: Kwibuka26: Abanyarwanda baba muri Ghana bibutse Jenoside, urubyiruko rusabwa kwigira ku mateka
content:
Ni igikorwa cyabaye kuri uyu wa 26 Mata 2020 muri Ghana, gikorwa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga kubera icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Ghana, Dr Aisa Kirabo Kacyira, yavuze ko mu gihe abanyarwanda bakomeje kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, ari umwanya wo guha icyubahiro Abatutsi barenga miliyoni bishwe mu 1994. Yavuze ko ari n’umwanya wo guha icyubahiro abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, uburyo bagize umutima wo kubabarira ari nayo moteri y’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge u Rwanda rwagezeho. Yagaragaje ko ibi byose byashobotse kubera imiyoborere myiza ya Perezida Paul Kagame. Dr Kacyira yagize ati “Ndashimira kandi ingabo zahoze ari iza FPR-Inkotanyi zari ziyobowe na Perezida Kagame zahagaritse Jenoside yakorerwaga Abatutsi mu gihe umuryango mpuzamahanga wareberaga, no ku bakiri bato batanze ubuzima bwabo ngo bahagarike Jenoside ntabwo tuzabibagirwa.” “Dukomeje kwibuka abo twakundaga ndetse twibuka ibihe by’umwijima twanyuzemo, ariko duharanira ejo heza kandi duharanira ko nta Jenoside izongera kuba ukundi, twarababaye ariko tugomba gukomeza kurwanya ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside n’ivangura kuko niyo ntandaro ya Jenoside.” Yahamagariye umuryango mpuzamahanga kurwanya ingengabitekerezo, gufata ndetse no kuburanisha abasize bakoze Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Yavuze ko abanyarwanda bafashe ingamba zikomeye zo gushyira ubumwe imbere aho gushyiraho imbere ivangura kuko ari byo shingiro ry’iterambere. Yasabye urubyiruko kwigira ku mateka, bubaka ejo hazaza heza.
Ati “Turaboba ejo heza ku bakiri bato, muri ibi bihe turabasaba kubyigiraho no kureba imiyoborere myiza ihari, kwibuka aho twavuye ariko ntibatwarwe n’aho twanyuze. Hejuru y’ibyo bashyire imbere ubumwe no kwihesha agaciro ka buri munyarwanda.” Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’amahanga n’ubutwererane bw’akarere muri Ghana, Shirley Ayorkor Botchway, yohereje ubutumwa bwihanganisha Abanyarwanda no kubizeza ko Jenoside itazongera ukundi. Ati “Icyubahiro gikomeye twaha inzirakarengane ni ugushyira hamwe tugaharanira ko ubunyamaswa nk’ubwo butazongera ukundi.” Lisa Princess Ikirezi wabuze bamwe mu bo mu muryango we muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, mu buhamya bwe yavuze ko yibuka abo bose bishwe muri Jenoside, n’ababuze abo bakundaga. Yashimiye abarokotse Jenoside uburyo bakomeje kwihangana nyuma yo guhura n’ayo makuba, asaba abavutse nyuma ya Jenoside kubigira inshingano guharanira ko ibyabaye bitazongera kuba. Ambasaderi wa Colombia muri Ghana, Claudia Turbay Quintero witabiriye uyu muhango mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga, yavuze ko igihugu cye cyifatanyije n’u Rwanda kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi. Yagize ati “Turaha icyubahiro abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi kandi dushimira ubuyobozi bwiza bwa perezida Paul Kagame, wahamagariye abaturage gushyira imbere ubumwe n’ubwiyunge nk’uburyo bwo kuvana igihugu mu kaga cyari kimaze guhura nako.” Yavuze ko isomo ryavuye mu Rwanda ryerekana ko buri gihugu gifite inshingano zo kubahiriza uburenganzira bwa muntu. Umuhango wo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi wakozwe mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kubera ingamba zafashwe n’icyo gihugu zo guhashya icyorezo cya coronavirus. Kugeza kuri uyu wa Mbere Ghana yari imaze kugira abanduye coronavirus basaga 1500, barimo 11 bapfuye.

title: Abanyarwanda batuye mu Majyaruguru y’u Burayi bibutse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi
content: Uyu muhango wateguwe na Ambasade y’u Rwanda iri Stockholm muri Suède. Wakozwe mu bice bibiri birimo icyabaye ku wa 22 Mata n’icyo ku wa 25 Mata 2020, mu buryo budasanzwe aho hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga kubera ibihe Isi irimo byo guhangana n’icyorezo cya COVID-19 giterwa n’agakoko ka Coronavirus. Ku wa 22 Mata 2020, umuhango wabaye wakozwe mu rurimi rw’Icyongereza, watumiwemo abayobozi mu nzego za Leta, abahagarariye ibihugu byabo mu bihugu by’Amajyaruguru y’Uburayi, Abanyarwanda n’inshuti z’u Rwanda. Watangiwemo ubuhamya na Umuhoza Frida wavuze ku nzira yo kurokoka Jenoside n’uko yiyubatse nyuma yayo, abikesha ubuyobozi bwiza. Mu batanze ikiganiro harimo Umuyobozi wa Diapora nyarwanda mu Mujyi wa Copenhagen muri Denmark, Teajen Misago na Nkulikiyinka Christine uhagarariye u Rwanda mu bihugu bya Scandinave ufite icyicaro i Stockholm muri Suède. Biyongeraho Christelle na Charisse Muhigana batanze ubutumwa bushimangira icyizere abakiri bato bafite nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Mu batanze ubutumwa barimo abayobozi bakuru nka Visi Perezida wa kabiri w’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ya Suède, Lotta Johnsson Fornarve; Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga muri Suède, Ann Linde; Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga wa Finlande, Pikka Haavisto n’Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga ya Norvège, Marianne Hagen bose bagarutse ku gushimira u Rwanda, intambwe rumaze gutera mu kwiyubaka nyuma y’ibihe by’akaga rwanyuzemo. Tariki ya 25 Mata 2020 nabwo habaye igikorwa cyo kwibuka cyakozwe mu rurimi rw’Ikinyarwanda, kitabirwa n’Abanyarwanda batuye muri Suède, Denmark, Finland na Denmark. Abacyitabiriye basangijwe ubuhamya na Lyse Umutoni, wavuze akababaro yagize igihe yari atwite inda y’amezi umunani muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, akaza kurokoka. Muri uyu muhango, Ambasaderi Nkulikiyinka ni we wawutangije yenyegeza urumuri rw’icyizere nk’ikimenyetso cy’ejo hazaza heza hazira umwijima wa Jenoside. Mu butumwa bwe yasangije Abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo igisobanuro cy’umuhango wo kwibuka n’impamvu uhabwa agaciro. Yagize ati “Kwibuka ni iki? Kwibuka ni ugufata mu mugongo mbere na mbere abarokotse, ni ukwibukiranya indangagaciro z’umuco w’ibanze Nyarwanda kuko uzikurikije ntiwakora ibyo abicanyi bakoze. Kwibuka kandi si uguheranwa n’agahinda gusa hagomba kubaho kwiyubaka, kuko tutabikoze niho ababikoze bakwishima. Kwibuka ni no gufatanya kurwanya abapfobya n’abahakana jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Amb. Nkulikiyinka yashimiye kandi urubyiruko rwitabiriye ibikorwa byo kwibuka arusaba gukomeza kubakira ku bumwe. Yarusabye kwitabira ibikorwa birebana n’igihugu no kumva ko ari icyabo, bakakirwanira ishyaka. Christelle Muhigana uhagarariye urubyiruko muri Norvège, yavuze ko hari igihango rukwiye kugirana n’igihugu. Yagize ati “Urubyiruko rurabizeza ko Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda rwiyemeje ko itazongera kubaho ukundi.’’ ‘‘Ubu u Rwanda rwariyubatse ni igihugu kiduteye ishema, tuzaharanira ko ruhora rwubashywe.’’ Abitabiriye uyu muhango baganirijwe ku mateka yimbitse ku itegurwa, ishyirwa mu bikorwa n’ipfobya rya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, mu kiganiro cyatanzwe n’Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa Komisiyo y’Igihugu Ishinzwe kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG), Dr Bizimana Jean Damascène, wabakanguriye kurwanya abahakana n’abapfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, ababwira ko aricyo cyiciro kigezeho kuko utegura Jenoside anategura uburyo azayihakana. Hanatanzwe ikiganiro ku ruhare rwa Diaspora mu kubungabunga amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi no kurwanya ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside cyatanzwe na Alain Ngirinshuti, wabaye muri diaspora mu Bufaransa, wagaragaje inzira abakwiza ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside, abapfobya n’abahakana banyuramo, asaba ko urugamba rwo kurwanya abapfobya rwaba urwa buri wese. Abitabiriye uyu muhango bahawe umwanya wo gutanga ibitekerezo no gusobanuza abatanze ibiganiro mu kurushaho kumenya byimbitse amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. [email protected]

title: Abanyarwanda baba muri Danmark bibutse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi
content: Abatuye muri Danmark ku wa 18 Mata 2020 nibwo bifatanyije n’inshuti zabo mu muhango wabaye hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga bitewe n’ibihe Isi irimo byo guhangana na Coronavirus. Ni umuhango watumiwemo Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Suède n’ibihugu yo muri Scandinavie, Nkulikiyinka Christine; Umuyobozi wa Paruwasi ya Remera mu Itorero Angilikani, Rev Past Dr Antoine Rutayisire n’umunyamakuru, Karirima Ngarambe Aimable uhagarariye IGIHE ku Mugabane w’u Burayi. Umuyobozi w’Umuryango Nyarwanda mu Karere ka Jylland na Fyn muri Denmark, Jackline Hansen, ni we wayoboye umuhango wo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Yashimiye abitabiriye uyu muhango, anashimangira ko wabaye hifashishijwe internet kubera ingamba zakajijwe mu kwirinda ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus. Ambasaderi Nkulikiyinka mu ijambo rye yashimye abateguye umuhango wo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi n’abifatanyije na bo. Yihanganishije Abanyarwanda mu bihe hibukwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi avuga ko ‘dukwiye kuzirikana kwibuka kugira ngo Jenoside ntizongere kubaho ukundi’. Ambasaderi Nkulikiyinka yasabye Abanyarwanda gukomeza gushyira hamwe no gushyigikira iterambere ry’igihugu cyabibarutse aricyo u Rwanda. Abawitabiriye basangijwe ku ruhare rw’amadini ndetse n’urw’itangazamakuru mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Pasiteri Rutayisire watanze ikiganiro ku ruhare rw’amadini, yahereye ku mateka ya kera y’u Rwanda asobanura inkomoko y’amoko n’ivangura ryagejeje kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Mu butumwa bwe yakomoje ku gihe cy’Abakoloni n’itangizwa ry’amadini mu Rwanda binyuze mu bitwaga abamisiyoneri. Amadini yafatwaga nk’ubuhungiro bwa benshi ari mu hiciwe Abatutsi benshi bahahungiye bakeka ko bahakirira ariko bahaburira ubuzima. Yasobanuye ko ivangura ryakozwe muri Repubulika ya Mbere rirakomeza no muri Repubulika ya Kabiri. Rev. Rutayisire yasobanuye ko nubwo amadini yagize uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ariko nyuma ya 1994 yatanze umusanzu mu komora imitima no gutanga icyizere cy’ahazaza kubera ubuyobozi bwiza u Rwanda rufite. Rutayisire yatanze icyo kiganiro nk’uwavukiye mu Rwanda, arukuriramo, anarwigiramo. Yagize ati ‘‘Jenoside iba nari mpari nza guhonoka. Ibyo mvuga si inkuru ahubwo ni ibyo nabayemo. Twese nk’Abanyarwanda dufite impamvu yo gushima Imana ko yaturinze, dufite inshingano yo kureba ko ibyabaye bidakwiye kuzaba ukundi.’’ Ikindi kiganiro cyatanzwe cyibanze ku ruhare rw’itangazamakuru n’uburyo ryakoreshejwe nk’intwaro y’icengezamatwara mu kubiba urwango rwagejeje kuri Jenoside. Umunyamakuru Karirima yavuze ko ibinyamakuru birimo icyitwa Kangura cyandikaga ubutumwa bubi butandukanya Abanyarwanda. Yasobanuye uko Radio RTLM yakoreshejwe mu gushishikariza Abahutu b’Interahamwe kwica Abatutsi. Yakomeje ati ‘‘Hari benshi mu rungano rwanjye twabanye mu mateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, tunayatangamo ubuhamya kugira ngo bitazavugwa ko atabaye. Si inkuru mbarirano, iyo Radio RTLM twumvaga ibyo yatangazaga, abakuriye kuri iyo radio rutwitsi twari tubazi. Bakoraga ibyo bazi benyegeza umuriro ngo bashakishe aho Abatutsi bose bihishe bicwe.’’ Yasabye urubyiruko gusigasira ibyagezweho kuko byatwaye imbaraga n’ubwitange bwinshi kugira ngo igihugu kibe kigeze aho kiri. Abitabiriye umuhango wo kwibuka banasangijwe ubuhamya na Eric Ilunga warokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Yasobanuye ko Jenoside yamugizeho ingaruka mbi hamwe n’umuryango we. Yashimye ubuyobozi bwa ambasade budahwema kubaba hafi. Mu butumwa bwe yasabye urubyiruko gushyira hamwe rugakomeza gufatanya n’Abanyarwanda kubaka igihugu. Mu gihe ibikorwa byo kwibuka bizamara iminsi 100, haracyatangwa ubutumwa bunyuze mu biganiro bijyanye no kwibuka binyuze ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Biteganyijwe ko ku wa 25 Mata 2020, Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa Komisiyo y’Igihugu Ishinzwe kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG), Dr Bizimana Jean Damascène azaganiriza abatuye mu bihugu bya Scandinavie atanga ikiganiro ku mateka ya Jenoside. Cyanatumiwemo Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Suède n’ibihugu yo muri Scandinavie, Nkulikiyinka Christine n’abandi batumirwa.

title: Abanyarwanda baba muri Norvège bibutse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi
content: Umuhango wo kwibuka kuri iyi nshuro wabaye mu buryo budasanzwe bitewe n’ingamba zafashwe n’ibihugu bitandukanye ku Isi zo kurwanya ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo cya COVID-19 giterwa n’agakoko ka Coronavirus. Muri Norvège, iki gikorwa cyateguwe n’Umuryango Urukundo w’Abanyarwanda baba muri Norvège usanzwe utegura igikorwa cyo kwibuka. Kuri iyi nshuro umuhango wo kwibuka wabaye hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga, wanyujijwe kuri Page ya Facebook ya “Urukundo Rwandisk Organisasjon – Norway’’ no kuri WhatsApp group “Kwibuka #26 Norway”. Wakurikiwe n’abantu 262. Uyu muhango watangijwe hatangwa ubutumwa bwo kwibuka no kwihanganishanya ndetse n’isengesho rya Pasiteri Aloys Munyeshyaka uba Norvège. Abawitabiriye banakurikiye ubutumwa bw’ijambo ry’umukuru w’igihugu rijyanye n’umunsi wo kwibuka, ryakurikiwe n’umuhango wo kwenyegeza urumuri rw’icyizere no gushyira indabo ku Rwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali ruri ku Gisozi ku wa 7 Mata 2020. Perezida w’Umuryango Urukundo, Muhigana Marie Chantal, ni we watangije igikorwa cyo kwibuka muri Norvège, ari iwe mu rugo bitewe n’ingamba zo kwirinda Coronavirus. Yashimiye abaharanira ko Jenoside itagira abayipfobya barebera kuko bitinza umurindi ingengabitekerezo yayo. Ati “Ndashimira mwese muzirikana ko Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ari icyaha ndengakamere, mwese muharanira iteka kurwanya no kuvuguruza abapfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, kuko gupfobya ari uburyo bwo kuyikomeza no gukomeretsa abayirokotse.’’ Yavuze ko urumuri rw’icyizere rushushanya urukundo, imbaraga n’ukwigira byaranze abarokotse Jenoside n’icyizere cyo gukomeza kubaho no kwirinda ko yakongeraho kubaho ukundi. Yagize ati “Dufite inshingano zo kwigisha abato amateka kugira ngo bajye bahora baharanira ko ibyabaye bitazasubira ukundi. Tugomba guharanira ko tutazazima.’’ Mu butumwa bwatanzwe n’abana bato na bo bashimangiye ko bidakwiye ko abantu bazira uko bavutse. Umwe yagize ati “Turibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, ni akaga. Abantu ntibakwiye gupfa kubera abo bari bo. Tuzaharanira ko bitazongera kubaho ukundi.’’ Perezida w’ Ihuriro ry’abanyarwanda baba muri Norvège (ARC-Norway), Mugisha Peter, yavuze ko uyu mwaka kwibuka byakozwe mu buryo budasanzwe ariko bihora ari ngombwa. Yagize ati “Turibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Twibuke twiyubaka. Uyu ni umunsi ukomeye, ubaye mu bihe bidasanzwe. Kwibuka biri mu nshingano za buri wese. Ni ngombwa kwibuka abatuvuyemo no kurwanya ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside kuko hari abashaka kuyihindura uko bishakiye.’’ Abitabiriye iki gikorwa banasangijwe ubuhamya na Muhire Veronique. Uyu Munyarwandakazi wagize amahirwe yo kuba akiriho, ahamya ko Jenoside y’Abatutsi yatangiye mu 1959, igasozwa mu 1994. Yatanze ubuhamya bw’uburyo inkuru y’ihanurwa ry’indege yabasanze bicaye mu nzu, bavuga ko bashize. Ati “Twahise tuzimya televiziyo, abakuru turarira.’’ Yaje guhungira kuri St Paul mu Mujyi wa Kigali aza no kuharokokera nyuma yo kwisanga mu maboko y’Inkotanyi mu ijoro ryo ku wa 16 rishyira 17 Kamena 1994. Hanatanzwe ubuhamya bwa Umugiraneza Léontine warokotse Jenoside. Bwakurikiwe n’ubutumwa bw’abana bwihanganisha ababyeyi babo bunizeza kuzaharanira u Rwanda rwiza ruzira Jenoside ukundi. Mu gihe ibikorwa byo kwibuka bizamara iminsi 100, haracyatangwa ubutumwa bunyuze mu biganiro bijyanye no kwibuka, ubutumwa bwihanganishanya cyane cyane ko nta gusurana, ku buryo usanga abantu bari hamwe. Umuhango wo kwibuka wasojwe n’igikorwa cyo gukusanya inkunga izafasha Intwaza n’abandi bacitse ku icumu rya Jenoside bafite n’ubumuga bunyuranye.

title: Singapore: Abanyarwanda bifatanyije mu Kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, biyemeza kurwanya abayihakana
content: Ni igikorwa cyabimburiwe no gufata umwanya wo Kwibuka no kwenyegeza urumuri rw’icyizere, mu guha icyubahiro abasaga miliyoni imwe bazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ni igikorwa cyitabiriwe n’Abanyarwanda basaga 200 bo mu bihugu bya Singapore, Australie, Nouvelle Zelande na Indonesia hamwe n’abari mu Rwanda n’ahandi. Mu buhamya yatanze, Umuhoza Frida warokotse Jenoside, ubu utuye mu Mujyi wa Melbourne muri Australie, yavuze urugendo yanyuzemo muri Jenoside nk’umwana w’umukobwa wari ufite imyaka 14 nyuma y’ibihe byabanjirije Jenoside byaranzwe no kubiba urwango, amacakubiri n’itotezwa byakorerwaga abatutsi, ibintu yabonye kuva afite imyaka itandatu agitangira amashuri. Yavuze ko nubwo umuryango we wishwe muri Jenoside, agasigarana ihungabana rikomeye ndetse yihebye, ibyo yabonye akibyibuka nk’ibyabaye ejo, ku buryo bibabaje kuba hari abagerageza guhakana Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Yavuze ko ari inshingano za buri wese mu kurwanya ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside kimwe n’abagerageza kuyihakana.
