Yasabye Abanyarwanda baba mu mahanga kugerageza gufasha abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu 1994 batorohewe muri ibi bihe bikomeye byo kurwanya Coronavirus, kuko igikorwa icyo ari cyo cyose nko kubahamagara kuri telefoni ubihanganisha unababaza uko babayeho, gisobanuye byinshi. Mu ijambo yagejeje kuri aba Banyarwanda, Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Singapore ari na we ushinzwe ibihugu bya Australia, New Zealand na Indonesia, Amb Jean de Dieu Uwihanganye, yavuze ko ubuzima Umuhoza yabayemo, abarokotse Jenoside benshi babunyuzemo, aboneraho umwanya wo kubihanganisha, anabizeza ko umuryango mugari w’Abanyarwanda ukomeza kubazirikana. Yasabye urubyiruko kurushaho kugira uruhare mu guhangana n’abagihakana bakanapfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Yakomeje agira ati “Bikwiye kutwibutsa uruhare tugomba kugira mu guhangana n’abagerageza kugoreka amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 bagamije izindi nyungu. Twifashishije ibimenyetso bihari, dukwiye kubirwanya binyuze mu kwamagana ku mugaragaro abagerageza kubiba urwango haba ku mbuga nkoranyambaga cyangwa mu muryango wacu.”  “Ndifuza gusaba by’umwihariko urubyiruko, abenshi turi kumwe hano. Uyu munsi ni mwe cyizere n’ahazaza h’u Rwanda. Mu myaka 26 ishize, ingabo zari iza RPA ziyobowe na Nyakubahwa Perezida Paul Kagame, zahagaritse Jenoside yari irimo gukorerwa Abatutsi, kandi turabibashimira. Bari bafite imyaka ingana n’iyanyu na twe.” Yavuze ko bagize uruhare mu guhagarika Jenoside no kubaka u Rwanda rushya. Yakomeje ati “Natwe nk’urubyiruko rw’Abanyarwanda baba mu mahanga, dukwiye kugira uruhare mu rugamba rwo kurwanya ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside kimwe n’abahakana Jenoside. Benshi mu benegihugu bagenzi bacu muri ibi bihugu by’umwihariko muri Australia, bakomeje kuyobywa ngo bajye mu guhakana Jenoside.” Abayobozi b’umuryango Nyarwanda mu bihugu bya Australia, Nouvelle Zelande na Indonesia nabo batanze ubutumwa buha icyubahiro abazize Jenoside no kwihanganisha abayirokotse. Banagaragaje uburyo hakenewe guhuza imbaraga mu gutsinda abakomeje gushaka kugoreka amateka y’u Rwanda, bagamije kuyobya abatazi ukuri kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Umuyobozi uhagarariye inyungu z’u Rwanda muri Australie, Michael Roux, yavuze ko nubwo Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yatangiye ku wa 7 Mata, byari nk’iherezo y’ibindi bikorwa byari bimaze imyaka myinshi byo kwibasira Abatutsi no gucura imigambi yo kubarimbura. Muri icyo gihe, Isi yatereranye u Rwanda kugeza ubwo mu minsi 100 gusa Abatutsi barenga miliyoni imwe bari bamaze kwicwa. Yavuze ko hari abantu benshi muri Australia na Nouvelle Zelande bahakana bakanapfobya Jenoside, bafite ibikorwa bitesha agaciro abazize Jenoside, abayirokotse n’Abanyarwanda muri rusange. Yasabye ko bene abo bantu bakwiye gushyirwa ahabona ndetse imvugo zabo zikamaganwa, ibinyoma byabo bigatsindishwa ibimenyetso by’ukuri ku mateka y’ibyabaye mu Rwanda. Lady Clare de Lore McKinnon uhagarariye inyungu z’u Rwanda muri Nouvelle Zelande yahaye icyubahiro abazize Jenoside, anifatanya n’abarokotse kimwe n’Abanyarwanda muri rusange. Yagarutse ku buryo mu 1994, nubwo habayeho intabaza ya ambasaderi w’icyo gihugu mu Umuryango w’Abibumbye, Amb Collin Keating, wasabaga uyu muryango kugira icyo ukora ku byabaga mu Rwanda, nta cyakozwe kandi byari gutabara ubuzima bw’ibihumbi bwari mu kaga. Yavuze ko muri iki gihe COVID-19 atari yo virusi yonyine muri Nouvelle Zelande, avuga ko hari abantu bahakana Jenoside bashaka gutesha agaciro abayirokotse hamwe n’imiryango yabo, binyuze mu guhakana ukuri kw’ibyabaye muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Muri uyu muhango kandi hanifashishijwe ubutumwa bwo Kwibuka bukubiye mu ndirimbo zitandukanye, hagamijwe guha icyubahiro abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, no kwifatanya n’abayirokotse.

title: U Rwanda rushobora kwisubiraho ku cyifuzo cyo kuva muri ICGLR
content: Muri Nzeri umwaka ushize Leta y’u Rwanda yatangaje ko iri gusuzuma niba ishobora kwivana muri ICGLR, nyuma y’uko uyu muryango unaniwe kurandura FDLR n’indi mitwe yitwaje intwaro ku butaka bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. ICGLR yashyizweho mu 2006 nyuma y’ubusabe bw’imiryango mpuzamahanga irimo n’Umuryango w’Abibumbye, ihabwa inshingano zo guhuza, kugenzura no korohereza ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’ibijyanye n’amahoro n’umutekano mu karere k’ibiyaga bigari. Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’amahanga, Amb. Olivier Nduhungirehe yabwiye IGIHE ko bakiri mu biganiro kuri icyo kibazo, gusa agaragaza ko hari ubushake bw’ibihugu bigize umuryango mu kugarura umutekano mu karere. Yagize ati “Iki kibazo kiracyari mu biganiro, cyane ukurikije ubushake bushya bwagaragajwe n’inama yahuje ibihugu bitatu i Kinshasa.” Iyo nama yabaye muri Gicurasi uyu mwaka, yahurije hamwe  Perezida  Felix Tshisekedi wa RDC, Perezida Paul Kagame w’u Rwanda na João Lourenço wa Angola. Muri iyo nama abakuru b’ibihugu bemeranyije ubufatanye mu kubaka umutekano mu karere, hibandwa ku kurandura imitwe yitwaje intwaro cyane cyane iboneka muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Nduhungirehe yavuze ko bagiye gukomeza gukorana mu gushakira amahoro n’umutekano akarere. Abajijwe niba bidasobanuye ko amahirwe menshi ari yo kuguma muri ICGLR, yagize ati “Yego, ICGLR yahawe inshingano n’itangazo ry’inama ya Kinshasa. Tugiye gukorera hamwe ku bibazo by’umutekano biri mu karere.” Ibikorwa bya ICGLR ku Rwanda bikunze kugaragara iyo habayeho kurengera ku ngabo ziri ku mupaka w’u Rwanda na Congo aho itsinda rya ICGLR rishinzwe ubugenzuzi, EJVM ariryo ryitabazwa ngo rigaragaze uwarengereye undi. ICGLR igizwe n’ibihugu 12 birimo Angola, Burundi, Centrafrique, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Kenya, Uganda, u Rwanda, Sudani y’Epfo, Sudani, Congo Brazzaville, Tanzania na Zambia. Icyicaro cyayo kiri i Bujumbura mu Burundi.

title: Sinzatuza umugabo wanjye adahawe ubutabera - Umupfakazi wa Hategikimana wishwe na CMI ya Uganda
content: Hategekimana yagejejwe mu Rwanda nyuma y’amezi atatu we na bagenzi be 19 batotezwa na CMI mu murwa mukuru Kampala, bashinjwa kuba intasi z’u Rwanda. Bahageze ku wa 12 Kamena bacishijwe ku mupaka wa Kagitumba. Nyirahabimana w’imyaka 45 yavuze ko umugabo we wapfuye nyuma y’iminsi mike ageze mu Rwanda, yishwe na CMI kuko raporo za muganga zagaragaje ko urupfu rwe ari ingaruka z’ibyo yakorewe. Yagize ati “CMI yishe umugabo wanjye, ntabwo nshobora kugoheka kugeza abonye ubutabera n’ubwo atakiri kumwe natwe.” Hategekimana yari umwe mu banyarwanda 20 bari bafunganywe bo mu itorero rya ADEPR muri Uganda. Umugore we yabwiye The New Times ko bagezwa ku mupaka wa Kagitumba, bari bafite ibikomere ku mutwe. Hategikimana ageze mu Rwanda yatangiye kubabara mu gituza, ajyanwa ku Bitaro bya Kacyiru. Babonye ko uburwayi bwe bukomeye, abaganga bemeje ko yoherezwa mu Bitaro bya gisirikare bya Kanombe kugira ngo akorerwe irindi suzuma. Umupfakazi wa Hategikimana yavuze ko umugabo we yari afite ikibazo cyo kubabara mu gituza, iburyo, "ibintu atari yarigeze agira mu buzima bwe mu myaka yose namumenye.” Ageze ku bitaro bya Kanombe, umuganga wamusuzumye yasabye ko anyuzwa mu cyuma ku ivuriro rya Legacy Clinics, gusa ku bw’amahirwe make yaje guhita apfa. Isuzuma rikorerwa uwitabye Imana ryagaragaje ko Hategikimana “Yari afite imvune y’urubavu yo ku rwego rwa gatanu n’ikibazo cy’amaraso yari yarikusanyirije hagati y’igituza n’ibihaha (hemothorax) hamwe no kwangirika ibihaha. Yari afite kandi ikibazo cy’impyiko y’ibumoso yangiritse n’ibikomere mu nda.” Raporo y’isuzuma yaasinyweho n’abaganga b’inzobere batanu, igaragaza ko urupfu rwa Hategekimana atari ‘urusanzwe’, ko rwatewe no gukubitwa cyane mu gituza no mu nda. Hategikimana yasize umugore n’abana batatu barimo abakobwa babiri n’umuhungu umwe. Bashakanye mu 1998 babanza gutura mu karere ka Musanze. Nyirahabimana  yatangaje ko umugabo we yari umuntu mwiza wita ku muryango we kandi usenga. Mu gahinda kenshi yagize ati “Yari yariyeguriye gukorera itorero no kwita ku bana be, ubu dufite ikibazo cy’uburyo tuzabaho kuko nta nzu twagiraga.” Yakomeje ati “Umugabo wanjye yashinjwe kuba intasi y’u Rwanda, iki ni ikinyoma gikomeye kuko icyo yakoraga Kampala byari ukwigisha ijambo ry’Imana no gukora ubumotari, ntabwo yigeze ajya mu bya politike, nta n’inyungu yari abifitemo.” Mbere y’uko apfa, Hategekimana na bagenzi be barindwi bari barajyanye Leta ya Uganda mu rukiko rw’Umuryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba basaba kurenganurwa ku iyicarubozo bakorewe. Yapfuye mbere y’uko ahabwa ubutabera. Mu 2009 nibwo umuryango wa Hategikimana wageze muri Uganda, ndetse Nyirahabimana avuga ko baje no kubona ubwenegihugu bwa Uganda. Yavuze ko ibintu byaje guhinduka muri Werurwe 2019 ubwo abantu bambaye imyenda ya gisirikare bashimutaga Hategikimana n’abandi bagenzi be bakoranaga muri ADEPR, bakorerwa iyicarubozo ryaje no kumuviramo urupfu.

title: KTN Rwanda yahaye amahirwe abifuza gutura mu bice bigezweho birimo Gacuriro
content: Mu mujyi wa Kigali iyi Sosiyete ifite ibibanza ahantu heza   hatandukanye harimo i Gacuriro, kuri Azam, ku Irebero n’handi kandi bihendutse. Mu Karere ka Gasabo, KTN Rwanda igaragaza ko ifite ibibanza 45 i Gacuriro munsi y’imidugudu y’icyerekezo aho kimwe kigura miliyoni 12.5Frw ikanagira ibindi 12 biherereye kuri Azam kimwe kigura miliyoni 13Frw gusa. Mu karere ka Kicukiro hafi ya Gare ya Nyanza mu cyerekezo cyiza kireba mu Mujyi wa Kigali, KTN Rwanda ihafite ibibanza bikase biri hamwe 6 kandi kimwe kigura miliyoni 15 Frw. Uretse mu Mmujyi wa Kigali KTN Rwanda yashyize hanze ibindi bibanza mu mujyi wa Nyamata hagati uyu ukaba ari umujyi urimo gutera imbere cyane ariko ikibanza kimwe kiri kugura 2.5 Frw Ibi bibanza byose biherereye ahantu hatunganyije, hari ibikorwa remezo birimo imihanda, amazi, amashanyarazi n’ibindi bya ngombwa buri wese ushaka gutura aba yifuza kwegera. Aya ni amahirwe akomeye banyarwanda baba mu gihugu n’ababa hanze badashoboye kugura inzu zuzuye bitewe n’impamvu zitandukanye zirimo ibiciro byazo bihanitse cyangwa kuba zubatse mu buryo umuntu atifuza. Ni n’amahirwe akomeye kugura na KTN Rwanda kuko ifite uburambe mu guhuza abaguzi n’abagurisha ibibanza, inzu zikodeshwa n’izigurishwa, ikabikora nta kiguzi. Uguze ikibanza KTN Rwanda imufasha gushaka ibyangombwa by’ubutaka akabibona mu gihe gito cyane bitamugoye. Ibi byose KTN Rwanda ifite icyicaro mu Mujyi wa Kigali mu nyubako ya Downtown, ibasha kubikora kubera abakozi b’inzobere bari hirya no hino mu gihugu n’urubuga www.ktnrwanda.com rubarizwaho amakuru yose arebana n’ubutaka buri ku isoko.

title: Icyo Perezida Kagame yaganiriye na Emmanuel Macron w’u Bufaransa muri G7
content: Ni inama yari yatumiwemo abandi bakuru b’ibihugu umunani bitari muri G7, barimo batanu bo ku mugabane wa Afurika. Muri iyo nama yabaye  guhera tariki 24 ikageza tariki 26 Kanama, byari biteganyijwe ko Perezida Kagame ahura na mugenzi we w’u Bufaransa Emmanuel Macron,  bakagirana  ibiganiro birambuye ku mubano w’ibihugu byombi. Ntabwo byakunze ko uwo muhuro wihariye w’abo bakuru b’ibihugu uba ariko babonye akanya gato ko kuganira mu gihe iyo nama yari iri kuba, nkuko Jeune Afrique yabitangaje. Macron yamenyesheje Perezida Kagame ko ambasaderi mushya u Rwanda ruherutse gushyiraho ngo aruhagararire mu Bufaransa, ari we François-Xavier Ngarambe yemejwe n’inama y’abaminisitiri b’u Bufaransa yateranye kuwa 21 Kanama 2019. Ngarambe  yasimbuye Jacques Kabale wari umazeyo imyaka icumi. Mu bindi abakuru  b’ibihugu byombi baganiriyeho, harimo gufungura i Kigali  Ikigo cy’Umuryango uhuza ibihugu bikoresha ururimi rw’Igifaransa (Institut de la francophonie) ndetse no kugarura mu Rwanda ibikorwa by’Ikigo cy’u Bufaransa gishinzwe Iterambere (AFD). Umubano  hagati y’u Rwanda n’u Bufaransa utangirira mu 1962 u Rwanda rukibona ubwigenge. Nubwo nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi wajemo agatotsi, bisa n’ibiri gufata umurongo mwiza guhera mu 2017 nyuma yo gutorwa kwa Perezida Emmanuel Macron. Muri Kamena,  Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigega Mpuzamahanga cy’Abafaransa gishinzwe Iterambere (Agence Française de Developpément , AFD), yaje mu Rwanda yizeza gukomeza gufatanya mu bikorwa by’iterambere. Umuyobozi w’icyo kigo yahaherukaga mu 1992.

title: Tito Rutaremara yavuze ku itegeko ryeguje abayobozi bakomeye barimo abaminisitiri barindwi (Video)
content:
Nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ni rumwe mu nzego zari zihanzwe amaso mu kunga abanyarwanda, aho yari inategerejweho gutanga umusanzu mu bikorwa bigamije iterambere ry’igihugu n’abagituye binyuze mu gushyiraho amategeko n’ibindi. Yari Inteko irimo abantu bo mu mashyaka atandukanye, aho byari bigoranye ngo bahuze ibitekerezo ku ngingo runaka byakomezwaga no kuba badahuje amateka. Yarimo bamwe mu bo imiryango yabo yari imaze gutsembwa, abari bamaze igihe mu buhunzi, abari mu buyobozi bwagize uruhare muri Jenoside ariko bo bakitandukanya nabwo gutyo gutyo. Mu kiganiro aherutse kugirana na IGIHE, Tito Rutaremara yagarutse ku bihe bikomeye Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ya mbere yanyuzemo, birimo kutumvikana ku mirongo imwe n’imwe ariko ubu akaba yishimira umusanzu wayo muri iki gihe mu iterambere ry’igihugu. Tito yavuze ko inteko ya mbere yagiyeho, yari ifite imyumvire itandukanye ku buryo byari n’imbogamizi ku ishyirwaho ry’amategeko amwe n’amwe. Yatanze urugero ku itegeko rishyiraho Ikigega gifasha abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, FARG, aho amashyaka amwe atari arishyigikiye. Ati “Abadepite benshi cyane nko muri PL n’abandi bati hakwiye gufasha abantu bose bangirijwe ibyabo. Ugasanga andi mashyaka ari kuvuga ati hakwiye gufashwa abakene bose, ni uko ibitekerezo byagendaga, bamwe bati kuki ari bariya kandi hari abandi bakennye.” Yakomeje avuga ko abadepite bamwe batumvaga ko “harimo abagizwe abakene kuko babitewe, bishwe, bakaba barakomeretse, bariciwe ababyeyi. Ubundi mu mategeko mpuzamahanga abakorewe Jenoside bakwiye kwishyurwa kuko barishwe, bagirirwa nabi. Ariko leta ntabwo yari ifite ibyo kwishyura”. Iyo myumvire yo kuba hari abadepite batabonaga ko hari ababyeyi b’incike za Jenoside biciwe imiryango yakabitayeho bagasigarana n’ubumuga ku buryo batabona n’uko bivuza, yari imbogamizi mu mikorere y’inteko. Ati “Izo mpaka zabaye igihe kirekire, abatabishaka na bo nka za MDR bati abakene bose bakwiye kwishyurirwa. Ariko ntibarebe ko hari abakene babitewe n’uko hari ababagiriye nabi. Ni nacyo gituma iryo tegeko rya FARG ryagiyeho bitinze kuko kwari ukugira ngo abantu baganire babyumve.” Atanga urugero kandi ku itegeko ryo gukuraho igihano cy’urupfu, aho bamwe bavugaga ko bidakwiye ko gikurwaho mu gihe abantu bamwe biciwe ari nabyo byatumye mu gihe inteko yakoreraga mu nzibacyuho kurikuraho byananiranye kuko abadepite bataryumvikanyeho. Ati “Bamwe bati kwica abantu si cyo gihano cyonyine, hari ibindi bihano. Ntabwo abantu baba barapfuye ngo wongere wice n’abandi. Ibyiza ni uko twashaka ibihano bindi aho gushaka iby’urupfu ariko ndibuka ko mu nzibacyuho byananiranye, abashakaga ko igihano cy’urupfu kivaho tubura ubwiganze.” Itegeko rigena imitunganyirize n’imikoreshereze y’amarimbi ryateye impaka
 Senateri Rutaremara yavuze ko nk’itegeko rigena imitunganyirize n’imikoreshereze y’amarimbi, ryamaze igihe kinini rigibwaho impaka kuko harimo abantu bari bagishenguwe no kuba batazi aho ababo bari n’abandi bari bakomeye ku muco wo gushyingura ku rugo. Ati “Ryamaze igihe ritanyuramo biturutse kuri ibyo, hari abantu batanabishakaga ibyo by’amarimbi bati ibyo mugiyemo ni ibiki? Ryarimo kureba uko ashyirwaho, uko atunganywa…hari bamwe bavugaga bati muravuga amarimbi tutazi n’aho abacu bari?” “Cyangwa ukumva ati ko abanjye nari narabashyize iwanjye hafi yanjye kuki bagira ngo bashyireho amarimbi? Iryo ryamaze igihe, ngira ngo ryatambutse ejo bundi aha.” Itegeko ryirukanishije abayobozi benshi Abazi neza politiki y’u Rwanda nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, bagaragaza ko kimwe mu bihe bikomeye igihugu cyanyuzemo, harimo itegeko ryo kugenzura Guverinoma kuko ryasize ba minisitiri barenga barindwi beguye na Perezida w’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko agasimburwa. Rutaremara avuga ko ryagombaga kujyaho kuko akazi k’abadepite ka mbere ari ugukora amategeko, kugenzura guverinoma no kwigisha abaturage. Muri icyo gihe, umurimo ukomeye w’inteko wari uwo gukora amategeko, kugenzura guverinoma ntibikorwe, aho atanga urugero rw’uburyo hatorwaga ingengo y’imari ariko ntihabeho kugenzura uko yakoreshwaga. Ati “Ibyo rero byagomberaga itegeko. Ntaryo twari dufite. Byari byanditse mu masezerano ya Arusha ko iyo Perezida wa Repubulika yanze kurisinya, Perezida w’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko mu gihe cy’iminsi icumi arisinya.” Itegeko ryaratowe, riva mu nteko rigezwa imbere ya Perezida wa Repubulika, Bizimungu Pasteur, kugira ngo arisinye hanyuma risohoke mu igazeti ya leta, undi ntiyarisinya biba ngombwa ko risubira mu nteko. Ati “Bizimungu yanze kurisinya, dukoze no kuri Perezida w’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko, [Nkusi] nawe aranga; bitewe n’uko Perezida wa Repubulika na bamwe mu bakuru nka ba Ntakirutinka bamubuzaga; biranga. Bimara umwaka umwe, ibiri, tubishaka biranga.” “Ariko tumaze kugira imyaka itatu turavuga tuti ibintu bizagenda bite ? Tuti twebwe inteko yacu ntabwo ikora umurimo wayo, dukora umurimo umwe w’amategeko, tugatora ingengo y’imari ariko ntitugenzura Guverinoma kandi Itegeko shingiro rirabidusaba kandi rukadutegeka kubikora. ” Yavuze ko nyuma y’imyaka itatu Abadepite bafashe umwanzuro wo kweguza Perezida w’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko, haza Sebarenzi Joseph wahise asinya rya tegeko ubundi imirimo yo kugenzura guverinoma iratangira. Nta mpamvu ifatika Senateri Rutaremara atanga y’impamvu iryo tegeko ritasinywaga, gusa ashimangira ko byose byari bikubiye mu kuba abantu batarumvaga ibintu kimwe. Nyuma yo gusinywa, abaminisitiri barindwi bahise bava mu myanya yabo nyuma yo kugaragaraho ruswa n’imikoreshereze mibi y’umutungo wa leta. Muri bo harimo nka Minisitiri Dr Anastase Gasana wari uw’Ububanyi n’Amahanga ; Minisitiri w’ingufu n’imirimo rusange, Charles Ntakirutinka ; Uwari Minisitiri w’Uburezi, Pierre-Célestin Rwigema n’abandi. Ati “ Urugero nka ba Ntakirutinka, byari ibibazo  byo gutanga amasoko n’abantu b’abacuruzi bafatanyije. Ugasanga bafatanyije gutwara amafaranga ya leta n’ibindi bitari byo. Nk’uw’uburezi, ugasanga yaravuze amashuri yubatswe kandi atarigeze yubakwa. Bagiye birukanwa. Hari n’abataribye ariko ugasanga imirimo bari bashinzwe ntibayikoze nka ba Patrick Mazimhaka, ni imirimo yari yarashinzwe ntiyakorwa kandi ingengo y’imari yaragiye, ntiyakurikira ngo arebe. ” Kimwe mu byafashije Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ya nyuma ya Jenoside, harimo gushyiraho abahwituzi bavaga muri buri shyaka, bafashaga bagenzi babo mu guhuza ibitekerezo n’ibindi. Tito asobanura ko wasangaga abantu bakomeye ku mashyaka kurusha gutekerereza igihugu, abahwituzi bakabafasha mu kugira imyumvire imwe.

title: Loni yashimye amasezerano yasinywe n’u Rwanda na Uganda
content: Loni yatangaje ko yiteguye gutanga ubufasha bwose bushoboka kugira ngo mu karere haboneke amahoro n’iterambere rirambye. Ku wa Gatatu tariki 21 Kanama nibwo Perezida Paul Kagame na mugenzi we wa Uganda, Yoweri Kaguta Museveni bashyize umukono ku masezerano y’ubufatanye n’umutekano ashobora no gushyira iherezo ku bibazo bimaze igihe hagati y’ibihugu byombi. Aya masezerano yashyiriweho umukono muri Angola yari ahagarariwe na Perezida wa Angola Perezida, João Lourenço; Félix Tshisekedi wa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo na Denis Sassou Nguesso wa Congo Brazzaville. Ni amasezerano yitezweho kubyutsa umubano w’u Rwanda na Uganda wari umaze imyaka igera kuri itatu utifashe neza kubera ibirego u Rwanda rwagiye rushinja Uganda birimo gutoteza abaturage barwo, gufasha imitwe ishaka guhungabanya umutekano n’ibindi. Kuri uyu wa Gatanu mu izina ry’Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa Loni, Stephane Dujarric, Umuvugizi w’Umunyamabanga Mukuru yasohoye itangazo rigaragaza ko Loni yashimye intambwe yatewe n’u Rwanda na Uganda. Itangazo rigira riti “Umunyamabanga Mukuru yahaye ikaze isinywa ryabaye ku wa 21 Kanama i Luanda muri Angola, ry’amasezerano hagati ya Perezida Yoweri Museveni wa Uganda na Paul Kagame w’u Rwanda hagamijwe kubyutsa umubano hagati y’ibyo bihugu bibiri.”’ Rikomeza rigira riti “Arasaba impande zombi gushyira mu bikorwa ayo masezerano bivuye ku mutima, ku ntego yo kubyutsa umubano n’ubufatanye hagati y’ibyo bihugu by’ibituranyi hagamijwe amahoro, umutekano n’iterambere rirambye mu Karere.” Loni yashimye kandi abakuru b’ibihugu barimo Perezida João Lourenço wa Angola Felix Tshisekedi Congo ku ruhare bagize mu gutuma habaho isinywa ry’ayo masezerano. Umuryango w’Abibumbye wagaragaje ko witeguye gutanga ubufasha bwose bushoboka kugira ngo amahoro no gukorera hamwe bisugire mu Karere. Itangazo rigira riti “Umunyamabanga Mukuru yiteguye gutanga ubufasha mu nzira yatangijwe no mu zindi gahunda zigamije guteza imbere amahoro, ubufatanye no kwishyira hamwe kw’akarere.” Amasezerano yasinywe hagati y’u Rwanda na Uganda asaba kurinda no kubaha uburenganzira n’ubwisanzure bw’abaturage b’urundi ruhande batuye cyangwa banyura ku butaka bw’icyo gihugu, mu buryo bwemewe n’amategeko yacyo. Asaba guhagarika ibikorwa bigamije guhungabanya urundi ruhande n’ibihugu by’ibituranyi ndetse n’ibyo gutera inkunga, guha imyitozo no kwinjiza abarwanyi mu mitwe igamije guhungabanya umutekano. Harimo kandi gusubukura bwangu ibikorwa byambukiranya imipaka hagati y’ibihugu byombi birimo urujya n’uruza rw’abantu n’ibintu, hagamijwe iterambere n’imibereho myiza y’abaturage babyo n’ibindi.

title: Ibidasanzwe byaranze bamwe mu bayoboye Kigali imaze imyaka 112 ishinzwe
content:
Ni umujyi ufite amateka maremare kuko niwo wabaye igicumbi cy’abakoloni b’abadage, aba mbere bakolonije u Rwanda bagakurwa n’ababiligi kugeza mu 1962 ubwo u Rwanda rwabonaga ubwigenge. Kigali izi byinshi kuko ibyiza n’ibibi u Rwanda rwanyuzemo imigambi yabyo yacurirwaga cyangwa ikanogerezwa muri Kigali, mu murwa mukuru. Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu abajyanama b’Umujyi wa Kigali baricaye batora umuyobozi mukuru mushya, amahirwe agwa kuri Pudence Rubingisa wahundagajweho amajwi ku bwiganze bwo hejuru, yegukana atyo uyu mwanya uba wifuzwa n’abatari bacye. Uyu mugabo ni inararibonye mu by’ubukungu, akaba yarakoze mu myanya itandukanye irimo kuba umuyobozi muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda kuva mu 2013 ushinzwe ishami ry’ubutegetsi n’imari, kuba umuyobozi Wungirije ushinzwe ubutegetsi n’imari muri ISAE-Busogo n’ibindi. Rubingisa wize ibijyanye n’imari n’itangwa ry’amasoko, abaye umuyobozi wa Kigali wa cumi nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi kuko awuyoboye nyuma ya Protais Musoni (1997-1999),Marc Kabandana(1999-2001),Theoneste Mutsindashyaka(2001-2006), Aissa Kirabo Kacyira (2006-2011), Fidèle Ndayisaba(2011-2016 ), Monique Mukaruliza (2016)  Pascal Nyamulinda  (2017-2018) na Marie Chantal Rwakazina (2018-2019). Hano turarebera hamwe bimwe mu by’ingenzi byagiye biranga imiyoborere y’Umujyi wa Kigali uhereye mu mwaka wa 2001 ubwo hatangiraga inkundura yo kuwuhindura icyitegererezo muri Afurika no ku isi mu birebana n’isuku, imiturire, kubungabunga ibidukikije n’ibindi. Uriya mwaka wa 2001 wakurikiranye n’impinduka nyinshi muri Kigali zaje nk’iya Gatera zatangiye hacibwa gukorera mu mazu atuzuye, za kontineri zari zuzuye umujyi zicururizwamo ziracibwa, imihanda itangira kuvugururwa, umujyi waburaga amashanyarazi bya hato na hato birakemurwa, kubaka mu bishinga bihinduka ikizira, mu mihanda hagati hashyirwa ubusitani binagirwa sakirirego kubukandagiramo mu gihe inkengero zayo hatangiye gushyirwa amatara aboneshereza bose mu ijoro [éclairage public/street lighting] Ibyemezo byafashwe ni byinshi kuko byageze no kukubuza abantu [cyane abagabo kuko Abanyarwandakazi ahanini ari ba mutakwasuku] kwihagarika ku mihanda hashyirwaho ubwiherero ku mihanda yo hirya no hino muri Kigali, uhereye muri rond point nini yo mu mujyi rwagati, hirya no hino mu mujyi hashyirwa udusanduku tugenewe kubika imyanda [poubelles/bins] birangira guta imyanda ahabonetse hose bibaye amateka. N’abamotari bategetswe kwambara ingofero zabugenewe [casques/helmets], tagisi minibisi zicibwa mu mujyi burundu, n’ibindi byinshi bigoye kurondora. Nyinshi mu mpinduka zakozwe mu Mujyi wa Kigali nubwo zikunze kwitirirwa ba meya bawuyoboye, kenshi na kenshi zagiye zituruka kuri Perezida Paul Kagame ubwe ku buryo abayobora Umujyi wa Kigali bose usanga bashyira mu bikorwa intumbero Umukuru w’Igihugu awufiteho. Mu minsi ishize Perezida Kagame yatangaje ko ari mu biganiro byo kunoza gahunda nshya yo gusimbuza moto zitwara abagenzi inshya zikoresha amashanyarazi. Ibyemezo byafashwe kugira ngo Kigali ise uko isa kuri ubu ni uruhuri ariko byose byari bikwiye kuko magingo aya byayihesheje kugera ku myanya yo hejuru mu mijyi iryoheye kuyituramo ku mugabane wa Afurika, umujyi abanyamahanga bageramo ugasanga benshi muri bo barabya indimi kuko imiterere ya Kigali y’ubu usanga ari imbonekarimwe kuri uyu mugabane.  Ibi byemezo ariko ntabwo byafatiwe rimwe ndetse ntabwo byashyizwe mu bikorwa icyarimwe, ku buryo tugiye kureba bimwe mu byaranze imiyoborere ya Kigali uhereye kuri Mutsindashyaka Theoneste bamwe bigeze guha izina ry’iritazirano rya "Mutsindamazu" kubera inkubiri yazanye mu kuvugurura imiturire muri uyu mujyi, hamwe na ba meya bawuyoboye nyuma ye. Mutsindashyaka utaravugirwagamo
 Umujyi wa Kigali wo zingiro ry’igihugu wikubiye 80 % by’ubukungu bwacyo, wagiye uyoborwa n’abayobozi batandukanye bafite imikorere itandukanye. Kubera kubaka inzego z’igihugu no kugisubiza umurongo, ibikorwa byihariye by’umujyi wa Kigali byatangiye kuvugwa cyane ahagana mu 2001 kubwa Mutsindashyaka Theoneste wawuyoboye imyaka itanu. Impamvu nuko aribwo hari hamaze gufatwa umurongo wo guteza imbere igihugu, dore ko ubuyobozi bwa Rose Kabuye, Protais Musoni na Marc Kabandana bwahuriranye n’ibibazo byo kugarura umutekano mu gihugu ku buryo ahanini byibandaga kuri iyo ngingo kurusha izindi. Mutsindashyaka  yaje mu mujyi wa Kigali urangwamo umutekano muke, ubujura buca ibintu mu duce duhurirwamo abantu benshi nka Nyabugogo n’ahandi, imitwe ya mayibobo yarihaye amazina kugeza ubwo biba ku manywa y’ihangu abantu bakabifata nk’ibisanzwe. Yewe na za banki ntabwo bene ngango bazireberaga izuba. Mutsindashyaka yaje umuriro w’amashanyarazi muri Kigali ari ingume uduce tw’umujyi  dusimburanwa mu mwijima.Nubwo yagiye bimwe bitarakemuka hari ibyagiye bikorwa nko guca ubujura muri Kigali. Ku buyobozi bwe  mu Mujyi wa Kigali, Mutsindashyaka yari azwiho gufata  ibyemezo bikarishye, cyane cyane mu bibazo by’amasambu n’imiturire. Yahanganye bikomeye na Umwamwezi Joséphine (Nyiri La Comete) uzwi ku izina rya Nyiragasazi ku bw’umuturirwa yashakaga kuzamura, Mutsindashaya akawita ‘ikiburazina’. Undi bahanganye ni nyakwigendera Mirimo yashatse gusenyera, urubanza rukarangira Umujyi wa Kigali utegetswe kwishyura miliyoni 150. Mutsindashyaka yamenyekanye kandi ubwo yitaga amazu y’abafite amikoro make bo mu Mujyi wa Kigali “utururi” cyangwa “ibyari by’inyoni” tugomba gusenywa. Ku buyobozi bwe niho hatanijwe gahunda yo guca abazunguzayi muri Kigali, gukuraho kiyosike na kontineri zitajyanye n’igihe, gusenya inzu zidafite ibyangombwa n’ibindi. Aissa Kirabo Kakira n’igishushanyo mbonera cy’Umujyi wa Kigali
 Dr Aissa Kirabo Kirabo ni we wasimbuye Mutsindashyaka ku buyobozi bw’umujyi wa Kigali, akaba umugore wa kabiri  wayoboye uyu mujyi mu myaka yose wari umaze ubayeho. Kirabo nk’uwari intumwa ya rubanda mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko yaje yitezweho gukora ibiteza imbere Umujyi wa Kigali wari uri hafi kuzuza imyaka ijana ubayeho ndetse n’ibibazo by’abaturage bashinjaga Mutsindashyaka kubayoboresha igitugu. Umujyi wa Kigali wari ukirimo ibibazo byo kwimura abaturage kubw’ingurane, bamwe bakishyurwa nabi cyangwa bigatinda nko mu Kiyovu cy’abakene n’ahandi. Ikibazo cy’umuvundo w’imodoka, ibikorwa remezo bike nk’amatara ku mihanda ya Kigali, akavuyo mu gutwara abantu n’ibintu  byari biganje muri uyu mujyi. Mu 2008 ubwo Kirabo yamurikaga bwa mbere igishushanyo mbonera cy’umujyi wa Kigali, yavuze ko intego ye ari ugusiga Kigali itekanye, isukuye  no guteza imbere ishoramari muri uwo mujyi wateraga imbere ku kigero cya 10.8 %. Dr Kirabo ubwo yari ayoboye Kigali mu 2008, umujyi wa Kigali watwaye igihembo mpuzamahanga kubwo kwita ku bidukikije, isuku n’umutekano ndetse na gahunda nziza yo gushakira ab’amikoro aciririrtse amazu aboneye kandi ahendutse nk’ayubatswe muri Batsinda. Nubwo hari ibikorwa byinshi byakozwe ubwo yari ayoboye bigashimwa, yavuzweho kutavugirwamo ndetse no gufatira ingamba zikakaye abayobozi bananiwe kuzuza ibyo bashinzwe. Mu Ugushyingo 2009, Kirabo yanyomoje abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze bari bamaze iminsi begura ku mpamvu zabo bwite, avuga ko beguzwa kuko bananiwe akazi. Icyakora na we yagiye ashinjwa kutubaha ibyemezo by’abamukuriye kugeza ubwo uwari Minisitiri w’Ubutegetsi bw’igihugu Christophe Bazivamo yanditse asaba ko Kirabo afatirwa ibyemezo kubera kwirengagiza ikibazo cy’abaturage bo muri Jabana bari babangamiwe n’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye bwakorwaga n’abashinwa. Icyo gihe njyanama y’umujyi yaramwihanangirije, ndetse imumenyesha ko niyongera azafatirwa ibihano. Dr Kirabo yanze kongera kwiyamamariza kuyobora Kigali mu 2011, nubwo amategeko yabimwemereraga kandi ahabwa n’amahirwe menshi. Ndayisaba Fidele  mu mpinduka zo gutwara abantu n’ibintu
 Ndayisaba yatangiye kuyobora Umujyi wa Kigali mu 2011. Ku isonga yavugaga ko ashaka Umujyi wa Kigali ufite uburyo bwo gutwara abantu bugezweho ku buryo n’abafite imodoka zabo bazajya bazisiga mu rugo bakagenda mu za rusange. Yemezaga  ko ibyo nibigerwaho na politiki yo gukora amasaha 24 kuri 24 mu mujyi izagerwaho kuko ntawe uzaba agitewe impungenge no  gukora amasaha yose kuko igihe ashakiye gutaha bizajya byoroha. Yaje ku buyobozi bw’umujyi wa Kigali ituwe n’abasaga miliyoni 1.3 , muri 54 % bakeneye amacumbi aciriritse ndetse yiyemeza gusiga icyo kibazo gikemutse nubwo gisa n’icyananiranye. Muri Nyakanga 2012 gutwara abantu muri Kigali byahinduye isura, imodoka zishyirwa muri Koperative aribwo havukaga RFTC, KBS na Royal zigabanywa imihanda muri Kigali ngo zitangire gutwara abagenzi kuri gahunda. Ubuyobozi bw’umujyi wa Kigali icyo gihe bwavugaga ko abashoferi kubera kwigenga bajyaga bataha amasaha bashakiye, bigatuma abagenzi babura imodoka. Mu 2013 kandi mu mujyi wa Kigali hatangijwe gahunda ya Smart City, hashyirwa Internet mu modoka n’ahantu hahurira abantu benshi. Ni gahunda yishimiwe igitangira ariko igenda icika intege kuko akenshi aho internet yavugwaga itahabonekaga. Mu gihe cye, nibwo haje imodoka zitwara abagenzi benshi ziswe ‘Shirumuteto’ zigabanya ikibazo cy’imodoka ariko zigashinjwa gupakira abantu benshi no gukererwa ku byapa. Kubwa Ndayisaba nibwo umujyi wa Kigali wujuje ibiro bigezweho byo gukoreramo nyuma y’igihe ukorera mu nyubako zidakwiriye. Nyuma yo gutaha iyo nzu hanibukwa amagambo yatangaje benshi Ndayisaba yavuze , agira ati “Kimwe mu binshimisha mu buzima, kuba mfite igihugu, nkagira ijambo mu gihugu cyanjye, nkaba na nayobora nkanicara aho Habyarimana watotezaga abantu yicaraga. tukaba twaranavanyeho na Nyakatsi yari yarahasize yarimo imizimu biciragamo abantu, ubu tukaba tuhafite ingoro ikwiriye ubuyobozi bw’ abanyamujyi”. Monique Mukaruliza na Car free Day
 Mukaruliza  yayoboye umujyi wa Kigali igihe kingana n’amasaha 8184 ahwanye n’iminsi 341 nyuma ya manda yari yaratorewe kuya 29 Gashyantare 2016. Mukaruliza Monique yabaye umugore wa gatatu uyoboye Umujyi wa Kigali kuva mu 1996. Kubera igihe gito yamaze ku buyobozi bw’umujyi, bimwe mu bikorwa yari yatangiye hari ibyo yagiye bitarangiye ariko ikintu gikomeye yibukirwaho ni siporo rusange izwi nka Car  Free Day yatangiye muri Gicurasi 2016. Iyi siporo imaze kuba ikimenyabose ndetse yakwirakwiriye no hirya no hino mu gihugu ku buryo isigaye yarongerewe iminsi, ikava ku munsi umwe mu kwezi ikaba kabiri mu kwezi. Mu zindi gahunda avuga ko zaranze igihe yari amaze mu Mujyi wa Kigali, harimo ibikorwa byari bimaze gutangira byo kwagura imihanda imwe n’imwe yo mu Mujyi wa Kigali aho byatangiriye k’uva mu Mujyi werekeza i Nyabugogo. Nyamulinda Pascal, yazonzwe n’ikibazo cy’abatuye Bannyahe
 Nyamulinda wari Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo gishinzwe Indangamuntu, NIDA, yatowe ku wa 17 Gashyantare 2017 agize amajwi 161 atsinda Umuhoza Aurore bari bahanganye. Uyu mugabo uvuga make yaje yitezweho byinshi cyane cyane hashingiwe ku mikorere myiza yarangaga ikigo NIDA yari avuyemo. Mu gihe cye hakomeje ibikorwa bisanzwe nko guteza imbere ibikorwa remezo hubakwa imihanda mishya, guteza imbere imibereho myiza y’abaturage n’ibindi ariko ikintu cyavuzwe cyane ku buyobozi bwe ni iyimurwa ry’abaturage bo mu mudugudu wa  Kangondo I, Akagali ka Nyarutarama mu murenge wa Remera, ahazwi nka Bannyahe . Abo baturage bashakaga amafaranga ariko umushoramari na Leta bakifuza ko bahabwa inzu, kugeza ubwo bamwe bajyanye Leta mu manza basaba guhabwa ingurane. Nyamulinda yarinze ava mu mujyi wa Kigali icyo kibazo kitarakemuka, n’uwamusimbuye yagiye kitarakemuka. Yeguye ku buyobozi bw’umujyi wa Kigali mu buryo butunguranye muri Mata 2018, ku mpamvu z’uko ngo ‘atari agishoboye kuyobora umujyi’. Rwakazina Marie Chantal yavuguruye igishushanyo mbonera
 Rwakazina yatorewe kuyobora umujyi wa Kigali muri Gicurasi 2019. Agitorwa yavuze ko azaharanira gushyira mu bikorwa ibiteganywa muri gahunda y’igihugu y’imyaka irindwi n’igishushanyo mbonera cy’Umujyi wa Kigali, mu buryo busubiza ibibazo by’abatuye Umujyi bafite ubushobozi butandukanye, ku buryo ntawe uzumva ko ari ku ruhande rw’ibibera mu mujyi. Hashize amezi make atowe, umushinga wo kuvugurura igishushanyo mbonera waratangiye ndetse haba inama zitandukanye zisaba abaturage gutanga ibitekerezo kubyo bumva byazibandwaho muri icyo gishushanyo mbonera. Yavuze ko icyo gishushanyo mbonera kitazagira umuturage cyirukana muri Kigali, yaba uwifite n’utishoboye. Mu byo Rwakazina yari yiyemeje agitangira kuyobora Kigali harimo gushyiraho uburyo butuma abanyamujyi baruhuka bakanidagadura. Nyuma y’icyumweru kimwe akuwe mu nshingano ze muri Nyakanga 2019, umujyi wa Kigali watangaje ko hagiye kujya haba ibitaramo by’ubuntu buri kwezi bifasha abatuye umujyi kwidagadura no kuruhuka. Rubingisa yitegweho iki?
 Akimara gutorwa, Pudence Rubingisa yavuze ko azubakira ku byakozwe n’abamubanjirije ariko agashyira imbaraga mu kunoza ibijyanye no gutwara abantu mu modoka rusange. Yavuze ko kandi azaharanira guteza imbere umujyi utabangamira ibidukikije, iterambere rigakomeza kwihuta. Biteganyijwe ko umujyi wa Kigali uzaba utuwe n’abaturage bagera kuri miliyoni enye mu 2050 ariyo mpamvu imbaraga nyinshi zashyizwe mu gutunganya ibikorwa remezo bizabasha guhaza abazaba bawurimo icyo gihe. Rubingisa aje kuyobora uwo  mujyi nyuma yo guhabwa imiyoborere mishya, dore ko ari wo  ugiye kujya ureberera uturere twose tuwugize ukanagira mu nshingano ibikorwa by’iterambere haba mu kubyubaka no kubiteza imbere.

title: Ni nde ukwiye kuryozwa iyicarubozo rikomeje gukorerwa Abanyarwanda muri Uganda?
content: Umubano wa Uganda n’u Rwanda uhera kera no ku ngoma z’Abami aho igihugu kimwe cyabaga gishaka kwigarurira akarere; ayo ni amateka si ibya none cyangwa se ibitekerezo bishingiye ku biba muri iki gihe. Mu myaka ya vuba, intango y’amahari ihera mu myaka ya za 1996. Mu mwaka wa 1998 nibwo ikimenyetso gikomeye gihamya umugambi mubisha wa Uganda ku Rwanda cyigaragaje ubwo Uganda yahaga ubufasha Seth Sendashonga wari warabaye muri Guverinoma y’Ubumwe nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, washakaga kurema umutwe w’inyeshyamba ndetse akagaba ibitero ku Rwanda. Uyu mugabo yagiranye inama n’abayobozi ba Uganda, bacurira muri Kenya umugambi wo gushaka gukuraho ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda aho umuvandimwe wa Museveni, Salim Saleh, ariwe wari ubirimo byose akora ibyo yasabwe na mukuru we. Kuva icyo gihe hakunze kuba ibindi bikorwa byo kugirira nabi u Rwanda aho iki gihugu cyabaye ubuhungiro bw’abagomereye u Rwanda, kugeza magingo aya bakifuza kurusubiza ahabi. Ibi bishimangirwa n’imikoranire ya Uganda  n’imitwe irimo RNC, FLDR, FNL n’indi igamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda, ndetse n’uburyo itangazamakuru ry’iki gihugu rivugira abahunze u Rwanda kubera amakosa n’ibyaha binyuranye. Ibintu byaje gufata indi ntera mu 2017, ubwo abanyarwanda batangiye gufatwa, bagafungwa, abandi bakameneshwa. Nta muntu watekerezaga ko byagira ubukana bifite uyu munsi aho abarenga igihumbi birukanwe muri Uganda nyuma yo kumara igihe kinini ku ngoyi muri gereza, bakorerwa iyicarubozo ryanaviriyemo bamwe ubumuga bukomeye. Icyo gihe abanyarwanda batangiye kwirukanwa muri Uganda bashinjwa kutagira ibyangombwa, uwigeze kubaho umusirikare mu ngabo z’u Rwanda ariko ukirukunda ahigwa bukware, abandi bazizwa ko hari abo baziranye nabo mu Rwanda, bikomeza bityo bigera no ku muhinzi wihitira. Ishimutwa n’iyicarubozo rikorerwa abanyarwanda ryatuma kandi abantu bibaza ibibazo byinshi. Ni ibintu biteye inkeke uburyo abarenga igihumbi birukanwe muri Uganda bagizwe intere, ariko Imiryango Mpuzamahanga ivuga ko irengera uburenganzira bwa muntu nka Human Right Watch na Amnesty International zikaba zararuciye ikarumira mu gihe idasiba gukora raporo zisiga icyasha u Rwanda ariko zikubiyemo kenshi ibinyoma. Uku kubogama cyangwa kutagira icyo ikora, nako kwakwibazwaho byinshi. Hari benshi bari bakwiye kubazwa ibi byose ndetse bakanabiryozwa binyuze mu nzira z’ubutabera ndetse n’izindi nzira zose zishoboka, kuko amakuru yagiye atangwa n’abanyarwanda bagizweho ingaruka n’ibyo bakora, abagarukaho neza. Gusa muri iyi nkuru, turaza kuvuga kuri bamwe, nubwo hari benshi bireba.  Perezida Yoweri Museveni Uyu musaza w’imyaka 74 abadakurikirana neza ibijyanye n’umubano w’u Rwanda na Uganda, ntibari bazi uwo ariwe. Bamubona mu isura y’umugabo mwiza waje i Kigali agakora umuganda, agasobanura uburyo abanyarwanda n’abaturage ba Uganda ari abavandimwe [ubwo yari muri Serena Hotel mu 2011] ndetse agahamagara n’umukobwa we kugira ngo aganirize abari bahari mu Kinyarwanda. Bene uyu muntu ntako aba asa, ariko ku rundi ruhande ni nka cya kirura kuko rimwe na rimwe ibikorwa bye byakwereka ko nta wagutera aturutse iwe. Ubuhamya bw’abanyarwanda batandukanye bwagiye bugaragaza uyu mugabo ko azi neza ibikorwa bibi bikorerwa abanyarwanda ndetse ko ari nawe utanga amabwiriza y’igikwiye gukorwa. Mu minsi ishize haherutse kujya hanze amakuru avuga ku nama Museveni yagiranye n’abayobozi bakuru b’ingabo, havamo ko hemejwe guhangana n’u Rwanda. Ikindi kandi ni uko yemeye ko yagiranye ibiganiro n’abantu babiri barimo Charlotte Mukankusi ushinzwe dipolomasi muri RNC na Eugene Gasana uheruka kwinjira muri uyu mutwe, aho amakuru ahamya ko yabemereye ubufasha mu bikorwa byabo byo guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda. Uyu mugabo yari akwiye kubazwa buri kimwe kijyanye n’uruhare rw’igihugu cye mu guhohotera abanyarwanda, kuko yabimenyeshejwe inshuro nyinshi n’u Rwanda, ariko akagenda biguru ntege ndetse inshuro nyinshi mu mbwirwaruhame ze yumvikanye agaragaza urwango afitiye u Rwanda mu marenga akavuga ko ari ‘guhandura amavunja’.  Gen Henry Tumukunde Uyu mugabo wasezerewe mu ngabo, kugeza mu 2018 yari Minisitiri w’umutekano. Kayumba Nyamwasa yatorotse u Rwanda mu gihe uyu mugabo yari ku ibere mu gisirikare cya Uganda ndetse ni mu mwaka yabonyemo Impamyabumenyi mu bijyanye n’amategeko. Gen. Tumukunde yubatse umubano ukomeye na Kayumba ku buryo baganiraga ku migambi yose ye. Byigeze kuvugwa ko inzego z’iperereza z’u Rwanda zabonye ibiganiro Gen.Tumukunde yagiranye na Kayumba Nyamwasa bigaraza ubushuti buhamye bafitanye. Mu rubanza rw’umunyarwanda Rutagungira; izina rya Gen. Tumukunde ryagarutsweho aho umwunganizi we Aaron Kizza, yagaragaje mu buryo bweruye uko umukiliya we yakorewe iyicarubozo n’uwari Minisitiri w’Umutekano, Lt. Gen. Henry Tumukunde kugira ngo yemere ko yafatanyije n’Uwari Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Polisi, Gen. Kale Kayihura, gushimuta no kunyereza Abanyarwanda baba muri Uganda. Icyo gihe Kizza yabwiye inteko iburanisha ati “Ni nde wababwiye ko hari amazina akomeye kuri njye ku buryo ntayavuga? Niba umukiliya wanjye ambwiye ko Brig. Kandiho na Gen.Tumukunde, bamukoreye iyicarubozo bakanamufunga amezi mu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko muri Gereza ya Gisirikare ya Mbuya, kugira ngo ashyire mu majwi IGP na Perezida Paul Kagame.”  Abel Kandiho Brig. Gen. Abel Kandiho akuriye Urwego rw’Ubutasi mu Gisirikare, nawe ni umwe mu bagiye bashyirwa mu majwi inshuro nyinshi ku gukorera iyicarubozo abanyarwanda. Nko mu rubanza rwa René Rutagungira, yagarutsweho aho uyu mugabo yamushinjaga kumutera ubumuga. Kandiho kandi yagiye agarukwaho cyane mu birebana n’Abanyarwanda bashaka guhungabanya ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda banyuze mu mitwe ya RNC, FDLR na FLN, ndetse n’abagiye bafatwa bari gutegura iyi migambi mibisha bagiye babyemera. Uheruka ni Nsabimana Callixte ‘Sankara’ ufunzwe ashinjwa ibyaha by’iterabwoba n’ubwicanyi. Uyu Kandiho yanashinjwe kuba ku ruhembe rw’iyicarubozo rikomeje gukorerwa Abanyarwanda muri Uganda binyuze muri CMI, urwego rushinjwa gukorana bya hafi n’umutwe wa RNC ya Kayumba Nyamwasa mu gushaka abayoboke muri Uganda, binyuze ku bantu batandukanye barimo Kayumba Rugema. Mu rubanda rwa Nsabimana Callixte ‘Sankara’ yahishuye ubufasha Brig General Abel Kandiho yari yaramwemereye, aho ngo abo bakoranaga mu mutwe wa FNL bagiye muri Uganda, basanga Kandiho yagize izindi gahunda, aboherereza Colonel ushinzwe iperereza ryo hanze. Bamusabye ibikoresho bya gisirikare n’ubufasha muri dipolomasi ndetse intumwa ze zavuyeyo zivuga ko ngo "ubufasha twasabaga babutwemereye”.  Ruhakana Rugunda Ruhakana Rugunda ni Minisitiri w’Intebe wa Uganda kuva muri Nzeri 2014, akaba umuntu wa hafi wa Perezida Museveni guhera mu ntambara yo kubohora Uganda, ndetse yanagize imyanya myinshi ikomeye muri Guverinoma ya Uganda. Ni umwe mu bantu bakabaye bumva neza ikibazo cy’umubano w’u Rwanda na Uganda ashingiye ku mateka azi yaranze ibihugu byombi, ndetse biragoye ko hakwemezwa umurongo wo gutoteza Abanyarwanda bikozwe n’inzego nkuru z’igihugu, uyu atabizi n’inshingano afite. Muri Gashyantare yigeze kubwira abaturage ba Uganda ko bakwiye gutuza, ko ikibazo cy’u Rwanda na Uganda kizakemuka mu minsi mike, nubwo nta gihe yatanze cyangwa ngo avuge ko igihugu cye kirimo kubikoraho. Icyiyongera kuri ibi, nta cyo Guverinoma yigeze ikora, nibura ngo ishyire igitutu ku nzego nkuru za leta kugira ngo zibazwe ibibazo biri mu mubano w’u Rwanda na Uganda, ahubwo abaminisitiri benshi bumvikanye baca ku ruhande ibintu, ku buryo nta n’umwe ujya uvuga ku iyicarubozo rikorerwa abanyarwanda. Ibi bishimangirwa n’uburyo abaminisitiri muri Guverinoma ye, bagiye bahura n’abashaka kugirira nabi u Rwanda, umwe ku wundi, bakabemerera ubufasha. Wakwibaza niba nka Minisitiri w’Intebe ntacyo abiziho ku buryo mu mvugo ze ayobya uburari agaragaza ko ikibazo kiri hagati y’u Rwanda na Uganda ari ikijyanye n’umupaka. Nko ku wa 14 na 15 Ukuboza 2018, abayobozi bakuru mu nzego z’umutekano muri Uganda ndetse n’abo hejuru mu mutwe wa RNC n’uwa FDLR bahuriye i Kampala muri Uganda ku butumire bwa Perezida Yoweri Kaguta Museveni. Umuhuzabikorwa w’iyo nama yari yatumijwe na Museveni yari Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga muri Uganda, Philemon Mateke. Mateke yarabakiriye, basangira ifunguro rya mu gitondo ndetse anababwira ku mikoranire na RNC, Uganda ibifuzaho.  	Maj Gen Kahinda Otafiire Maj Gen Kahinda Otafiire ni Minisitiri w’Ubutabera wa Uganda. Uyu mugabo ni umwe mu bakwiye kubazwa ibijyanye n’iyicarubozo rikorerwa abanyarwanda kuva mu 2017. Mu nshingano ze harimo kugenzura ko Itegeko Nshinga ry’Igihugu cye ryubahirizwa, kandi ryanditsemo ko ‘iyicarubozo rinyuranyije n’amategeko’. Ni umwe mu bantu bazi neza ingingo ku yindi mu zanditse mu Itegeko Nshinga, kuko ari umwe mu baryanditse mu 1995 bityo azi ibyo ribuza n’ibyo ryemera. Abanyarwanda baratatse, barahogora, bagaragaza ko bakorerwa iyicarubozo. Uyu mugabo nta na kimwe yavuze usibye gushimangira ko “nta munyarwanda wafashwe nabi”, by’agahomamunwa yanga no kugira uwo arema agatima nibura ngo atangize iperereza rireba ku bibazo bagaragaje. Ni umugabo watsimbaraye cyane ku kuvuga ko ibibazo biri hagati y’u Rwanda na Uganda, bishingiye ku mupaka wafunzwe [nubwo utigeze unafungwa nk’uko bivugwa], yirengagiza n’ubuhamya bw’abamugaye kubera iyicarubozo; kuri we bisa n’aho baguye nko mu mukoki bakavunika batembera.  	Martin Okoth Ochola Martin Okoth Ochola w’imyaka 60, ni Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Polisi ya Uganda kuva muri Werurwe 2018. Yagiye ku buyobozi n’ubundi ibibazo byo guta muri yombi abanyarwanda byaratangiye. We n’abapolisi ayoboye nta na kimwe bigeze bakora ngo bihoshe, ahubwo byakomeje uko byakabaye ndetse bikaza umurego. Kuva yafata ubuyobozi, hakwiriye amakuru y’uko Abanyarwanda bafatwa bagakorerwa iyicarubozo, ariko nta na kimwe yigeze abivugaho cyangwa ngo agaragaze ubushake bwo gukemura iki kibazo. Umuvugizi wa Polisi ya Uganda, Fred Enanga, ni umuntu ukunze kuvuga ku gikorwa cyose kireba Polisi, ariko nta na rimwe aravuga ku banyarwanda bafatwa n’inzego z’umutekano, bagakorerwa iyicarubozo ku buryo bagaruka mu gihugu baragizwe intere.  Kayumba Nyamwasa Kayumba Nyamwasa wabaye umusirikare mukuru mu ngabo z’u Rwanda, ubu ni umwe mu barwanya ubutegetsi ndetse inshuro nyinshi, yashinjwe kugira uruhare mu bikorwa byo guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda birimo ibitero byagabwe mu Rwanda binyuze muri gerenade zatewe mu bice bitandukanye mu Rwanda guhera mu 2010. Muri Gashyantare 2010 nibwo Uganda yohereje itsinda riyobowe na Gen. Salim Saleh na Gen. Kale Kayihura wari Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Polisi, kwakira Kayumba Nyamwasa wari uhungiye muri Uganda akaza gufashwa gukomereza muri Afurika y’Epfo. Mu Ukuboza 2018 raporo y’Itsinda ry’impuguke z’Umuryango w’Abibumbye yemeje ko Uganda ari icyanzu gihurizwamo ibikorwa bya “P5”, ihuriro ry’imitwe yitwaje intwaro rikorera muri RDC riyoborwa na Kayumba Nyamwasa rinabarizwamo RNC ye. Ni kenshi Abanyarwanda bagiye birukanwa nabi muri Uganda nyuma yo gufungwa bakanakorerwa iyicarubozo, batanze ubuhamya bw’uburyo ibyababayeho byose byakozwe bari muri kasho za CMI. Hari n’abasabiwemo kujya mu mitwe irimo uwa Kayumba Nyamwasa ngo boroherezwe, hakaba n’abahitaga burizwa imodoka nk’uko ubuhamya bubivuga. Nka Jean Claude Mucyo w’imyaka 28, ntazibagirwa ijoro ryo ku wa Kabiri tariki 29 Mutarama 2019. Uwo niwo munsi yashimuswe na CMI. Mu itotezwa no kubabazwa ku mubiri, yaje kumenya ko hari isano bifitanye na Kayumba Nyamwasa na RNC. Umwe mu bo bari bafunganywe witwa Rugengamanzi ngo yakomezaga kumubwira ngo yemere ko azajya mu ngabo za Kayumba niba ashaka kurokoka.  Salim Saleh Salim Saleh ni murumuna wa Perezida Museveni, akaba umwizerwa we guhera no mu gihe cy’intambara yo kubohora Uganda. Ni umuntu byagiye bigaragara ko aba ari mu migambi yose ya Perezida Museveni, utaretse n’igamije kugirira nabi u Rwanda. Uyu ari mu bakiriye abanyarwanda benshi bafite imigambi mibisha ku Rwanda bahungaga igihugu banyuze muri Uganda, bagahabwa n’uburinzi ngo badatahurwa n’ubwo ibyabo byagiye bijya hanze. Ni umwe mu bahungishije Kayumba Nyamwasa ndetse haheruka kujya hanze amakuru y’uburyo ari umwe mu bafatanyabikorwa ba Tribert Rujugiro mu bucuruzi muri Uganda, ari nabwo buvamo inkunga zishyigikira ibikorwa bigamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda nk’ibya RNC. Umwanditsi Gerard Prunier yanditse uburyo mu 1988, Seth Sendashoinga wari umaze kunaniranwa na guverinoma y’u Rwanda kuko atari ashobotse, yagiranye inama n’Abanya-Uganda yanitabiriwe na bamwe mu basirikare bakuru muri icyo gihugu barimo na murumuna wa Perezida Museveni, Gen Salim Saleh. Gen Salim Saleh yari ashyigikiye igitekerezo cyo gufasha undi mutwe wifuza kwinjira mu mukino wo guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda. Imigambi nk’iyo nubwo yagiye ipfuba, yerekana ko nta mutima wo kurengera Abanyarwanda yagira mu gihe bakomeje gutotezwa, ndetse n’uburyo ari uw’ibanze mu butegetsi, bituma nta kibi cyo ku rwego nk’uru cyaba atabizi.  Rujugiro Tribert Rujugiro Tribert ni umwe mu banyarwanda bahunze igihugu bafite ibyaha baregwa birimo kunyereza imisoro kugeza imitungo ye ifatiriwe ndetse igatezwa cyamunara, irimo inyubako yitwaga UTC. Nyuma yo guhunga yakoranye bya hafi n’abarwanya ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda ndetse mu minsi ishize yahawe rugari azamura ishoramari rye muri Uganda, ahabaye indiri y’abagamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda. Mu makuru aheruka kujya hanze ni uko yahaye imigabane mu bikorwa bye murumuna wa Museveni Gen Salim Saleh kugira ngo yidegembye ari nako atera inkunga ibikorwa bigamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda bikomeje gusuganyirizwa muri Uganda. Amafaranga y’uyu mugabo kandi akoreshwa mu bikorwa binyuranye by’ubukangurambaga bugamije guharabika u Rwanda binyuze mu itangazamakuru, aho abatavuga rumwe n’u Rwanda abishyurira amafaranga maze ibinyamakuru byo muri Uganda bikabaha ijambo. Mu gihugu kirimo abantu nk’aba, biragoye ko Umunyarwanda utumva ibintu kimwe nabo cyangwa udashaka kubiyungaho yagira amahoro, ari nayo mvano ya benshi batotezwa badashaka kujya muri iyo mitwe, abandi bakazizwa ubusa bitwa ko ari intasi z’u Rwanda kandi ari abasivili bagiye kwishakira ubuzima.

title: Uwayoboye The New Vision yahishuye ko Museveni atifuzaga urugamba rwo kubohora u Rwanda
content: Pike yatangiye kuyobora The New Vision kuva mu 1986 ubwo Perezida Museveni yajyaga ku butegetsi. Igitabo cye gishobora gusobanura impamvu Abanyarwanda bari muri Uganda bakomeje gushimutwa, gufungwa, gutotezwa no kwirukanwa mu buryo bunyuranije n’amategeko. Iki gitabo cyiswe: Combatants: A memoir of the Bush War and The Press in Uganda, kigaruka ku rwibutso rw’intambara yagejeje Perezida Museveni ku butegetsi mu myaka isaga 30 ishize, hamwe n’itangazamakuru ryo muri Uganda muri iyo myaka. Pike yasobanuye ko azi Perezida Museveni na mbere y’uko ajya ku butegetsi mu 1986, ndetse na mbere y’uko na we aba umuyobozi mukuru w’iki kinyamakuru. Asobanura ko yagiye akorana bya hafi na Perezida Museveni ndetse bakagirana ibiganiro, akaba kandi yarakoranye n’abayobozi bakomeye muri leta ye utaretse n’abayobozi bakuru mu gisirikare cya Uganda. Muri iki gitabo, Pike usanzwe ari Umwongereza ariko wavukiye muri Tanzania, yavuze ko “Mu bihe bitandukanye nagiye mbonana na Museveni tukagirana ikiganiro, nagiye kandi nganira na we kuri telefone igihe icyo aricyo cyose.” Yanditse ko ikibazo cy’u Rwanda kijya gutangira, byatangiye ubwo abayobozi bakuru mu gisirikare cya Uganda bari bafite inkomoko mu Rwanda bakaba ari nabo bafashije Museveni kuvanaho Milton Obote, mu buryo bw’ibanga bafashe umwanzuro wo gusubira mu gihugu cyabo. Pike ati “Museveni ubwe yambwiye ko byatunguranye kubona Gen Maj Fred Rwigema ashobora gukora ibi bintu atatubwiye, ati ariko nk’uko ubizi aba banyarwanda bafite ikibazo gikomeye cyo gushaka gusubira mu gihugu cyabo.” Pike yavuze ko ubwo yabazaga Museveni niba kuba ingabo za RPA zaratangije urugamba ku Rwanda we (Museveni) atabizi, bitaragagaje ko ubutasi bwe budakomeye cyangwa bikaba byaratewe n’uko izi ngabo ze zafunze amaso ku mugambi w’aba bajenerali b’abanyarwanda. Mu kumusubiza, Museveni yagize ati “Mu by’ukuri ibi byabaye bidutunguye, twari dufite amakuru twavanaga mu iperereza kandi twayasangiraga n’ubutegetsi bwa Juvenal Habyarimana, ariko ntabwo twabimenyeshejwe.” Ati“Twabonye amakuru amwe ko hari abantu benshi barimo kuva mu gisirikare cyacu ariko icyadutunguye ni uburyo umubare wari mwinshi kandi mu buryo bwihuse. Ubusanzwe hari amahitamo abiri, Rwigema we yambwiye gusa amahitamo abanza, nyamara mba naramufashije.” Gen Major Fred Rwigema yari umwe mu bari bafite ipeti rikomeye wari mu gisirikare cya Uganda akaba yaranafashije Museveni kugera ku butegetsi mu 1986. Yapfuye tariki 1 Ukwakira 1990 ubwo yatangizaga urugamba rwo kubohora u Rwanda. Nyuma yo kwitaba Imana, yahise asimburwa na Paul Kagame wari uvuye mu masomo ya gisirikare muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Ibikubiye muri iki gitabo cya Pike bigaragaza uburyo Museveni atigeze yifuza ko impunzi z’abanyarwanda zari muri Uganda zitahuka, nyamara we yakomeje kuvuga ko ariwe watumye urugamba rwo kubohora u Rwanda rugerwaho, hakanahagarikwa Jenoside yakorerwaga Abatutsi. Pike yagize ati “Museveni yavuze ko we yagombaga gufasha gusa inzira y’ibiganiro hagati ya Habyarimana n’abari impunzi, yavuze ko atagombaga gufasha mu buryo butaziguye byaba ingabo za RPF cyangwa leta y’u Rwanda yariho, yavugaga ko  ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda bwari ubw’igitugu naho ingabo za RPF zarimo ziva mu gisirikare cye zarimo zigambanira icyizere yari afitiwe.” Yakomeje agira ati “Ntabwo byatunguranye ko icyizere cya Museveni cyashegeshwe, icyo gihe Museveni yari Umuyobozi w’Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe, bisobanuye ko igitero ku Rwanda cyagaragaje isura mbi kuri we kuko ibihugu nka Zaire byatangiye kwikoma iki gihugu.” Pike yavuze ko Museveni yatangiye kubabazwa n’isura iki gitero cyamushyizeho nk’umunyapolitike, bimugabanyiriza icyizere ndetse bimusigira igikomere cyo kumva ko yagambaniwe. Ibikubiye mu nyandiko ya Pike bigaragaza uburyo ubutegetsi bwa Museveni bwatangiye kugira ibyiyumviro bibi ku butegetsi bw’u Rwanda, nk’uko ikinyamakuru The Observer kibivuga. Kivuga kandi ko kuba Museveni yarananiwe kuyobora u Rwanda nk’agace ke uko yishakiye mu myaka 25 ishize, aribyo bikomeje gutuma ikibazo kirushaho kuba kibi.

title: R. Kelly akurikiranyweho gukoresha uburaya umwana w’umukobwa
content: Umuvugizi w’ubushinjacyaha mu Karere ka Hennepin, Mike Freeman niwe watangaje ibyaha bishinjwa Robert Sylvester Kelly w’imyaka 50. Freeman yavuze ko ibyo R. Kelly ashinjwa byabaye muri Nyakanga 2001 nyuma y’aho umwana w’umukobwa wari ufite imyaka 17 yamusabye ko yamusigira isinya y’urwibutso [autograph]. R. Kelly ngo yasinyiye uyu mwana anamuha nomero ze za telefone. Ubwo yamuhamagaraga yamusabye kumusanga kuri hoteli yari arimo, yakirwa n’umugabo  yaketse ko bari uwo mu itsinda rye. Iki kirego kivuga ko R. Kelly ubwo yahuraga n’uyu mwana baganiriye umwanya muto, ubundi amwishyura $200 kugira ngo amubyinire. Bemeranyije kuri ayo mafaranga, maze amukuramo imyenda nyuma nawe akuramo iye, agenda amukorakora uko yamubyiniraga. Umubano wabo warakomeje R. Kelly amuha itike yo kujya mu nyanya y’icyubahiro mu gitaramo cyari kigenewe abarengeje imyaka 18, yinjirayo atishyuye cyangwa ngo yerekane n’indangamuntu ye. Uyu mukobwa yagannye inzego z’ubutabera muri Mutarama uyu mwaka, ubwo ibindi birego byari bikomeje kwisuka kuri R. Kelly. Umuvugizi w’ubushinjacyaha, Mike Freeman yavuze ko bibabaje kuba R Kelly yarakoresheje ubwamamare bwe mu kwangiza abana b’abakobwa. Ntabwo haramenyekana igihe R Kelly azagerezwa imbere y’urukiko rwo muri Leta ya Minnesota kuko hari izindi nkiko nazo zimukurikirana. Umwe mu bunganira R Kelly yahakanye ibyaha ashinjwa avuga ko ari abashaka gukomeza kurunda ibyaha ku mukiriya wabo. Yashidikanyije niba koko baranahuye nubwo mu bivugwa ngo atumva icyaha cy’ubusambanyi kirimo. Ikirego cyo muri Leta ya Minnesota kije nyuma y’ibindi byinshi uyu muhanzi yagiye ashinjwa muri Leta zitandukanye, aho akurikiranyweho ibyaha bijyanye no gusambanya abana bataruzuza imyaka y’ubukure. Ubushinjacyaha bwa Leta za Illinois na New York bwamushinjije gushaka abagore ajyana mu buraya, kwishyura abantu kugira ngo bamuhishire no gutanga amafaranga kugira ngo asubizwe amashusho yamugaragazaga asambana n’abana batarageza ku myaka y’ubukure. Muri Gashyantare yahakanye ibyaha 10 yashinjwaga n’ubushinjacyaha bwo muri Leta ya Illinois arafungwa aza kurekurwa atanze ingwate ya ibihumbi $100. Kuri ubu R. Kelly azitaba urukiko rwo muri Chicago tariki 4 Nzeri aho azaburana ku byaha byo gufata amashusho ari gusambana n’abakobwa bane bari bataruzuza imyaka y’ubukure mu 1998.

title: Imyaka ibiri irihiritse Umunyarwanda Rutagungira atoterezwa mu buroko bwa Uganda
content: Muri ayo magana, harimo umucuruzi Rutagungira René. Uyu mucuruzi w’Umunyarwanda wakoreraga i Kampala yafashwe tariki 7 Kanama 2017. Imyaka ibiri iruzuye afungiwe ubusa mu buryo bunyuranye n’amategeko mu Kigo cya Gisirikare cya Makindye nyamara ari umusivile. Rutagungira uheruka mu rukiko muri Gicurasi uyu mwaka, bivugwa ko agifunzwe n’igisirikare nta wemerewe kumugeraho, nta n’amakuru atangwa y’aho urubanza rwe rugeze. Umuryango we urahangayitse cyane. Yafunzwe ashinjwa kuba intasi nyamara nta bimenyetso na bimwe byigeze bitangwa bimuhamya icyaha. Abanyamategeko be  bakomeje gusaba ko yarekurwa, bavuga ko yahohotewe kandi afunzwe mu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko ariko Leta yavuniye ibiti mu matwi. Itotezwa yakorewe ryamaze kumwangiza ku mubiri, mu mutwe no mu mibereho muri rusange. Ubwo aheruka mu rukiko byarigaragazaga ko yananutse cyane ndetse adashobora guhagarara adafite icyo yishingikirijeho. Si ubwa mbere Abanyarwanda bajya cyangwa baba muri Uganda, baba inzirakarengane z’ukutubahiriza amategeko gukorwa n’inzego zishinzwe umutekano muri Uganda. Umwe mu basesenguzi mu by’umutekano i Kigali yagize ati “Imana niyo yonyine izi umubare w’inzirakarengane z’Abanyarwanda bashimutwa n’Urwego rushinzwe ubutasi mu Gisirikare (CMI) n’Urwego rushinzwe Umutekano w’Imbere (ISO).” Ikimenyetso cy’iyo mikorere idahwitse ya Guverinoma ya Uganda ni umunsi uwahoze ari Minisitiri w’Umutekano, Gen Henry Tumukunde yavaga mu biro bye, akajya mu Kigo cya Gisirikare cya Makindye gukubita no gutoteza Rutagungira. Ibyo ni ibigaragaza ko Rutagungira yashimuswe, akanafungwa ku mategeko yatanzwe na Tumukunde. Ibyabaye kuri Rutagungira ni kimwe n’ibyabaye kuri  Emmanuel Rwamuco, umucuruzi wakoreraga i Mbarara ndetse n’inshuti ye Augustin Rutayisire bafashwe muri Gicurasi umwaka ushize bakabanza gufungirwa i Mbarara,  bakahakubitirwa bikomeye mbere yo kujyanwa i Kampala. Aba bagabo bashimuswe ku mategeko yatanzwe na Mukama Moses Kandiho, umuvandimwe wa Brig Gen Abel Kandiho uyobora Urwego rushinzwe Ubutasi mu Gisirikare. Mukama Kandiho usanzwe ashinzwe umutekano muri Mbarara yahamagaye ushinzwe ibikorwa byo kurwanya umwanzi mu gace ka Mbarara, Maj Mushambo, akihagera amwereka abo Banyarwanda bari bafashwe ababeshyera ko bafatanywe intwaro. Ababibonye biba bavuga ko nta n’umwe muri abo bagabo wari ufite intwaro. Ahubwo bari bafite miliyoni 140 z’amashilingi ya Uganda bari bagiye kubitsa kuri Banki i Mbarara. Mukama Kandiho na Mushambo bafashe ayo mafaranga barayatwara, bafata imbunda baziha ku ngufu Rwamucyo na Rutayisire babajyana muri gereza. Aba bagabo ubu bari kuborera muri Gereza ya Luzira, nta cyizere na mba cy’uko bazahabwa ubutabera. Abanyarwanda nk’abo iyo bari mu buroko, bafatwa nabi bikabije, uburenganzira bwabo bugahonyorwa, bagatotezwa, bakicishwa inzara. Nka Rutagungira we, umwe mu bavandimwe be yavuze ko  nyuma yo gukubitishwa kenshi amashanyarazi no gushyirwa mu mazi y’urubura, ubu ibiganza bye nta kintu bishobora gufata kuko byagagaye. Amategeko ya Uganda avuga ko ukekwaho icyaha adakwiriye kumara amasaha arenga 48 ataragezwa imbere y’urukiko ngo yisobanure ku byo ashinjwa. Nyamara iyo bigeze ku Banyarwanda  bamara amezi ndetse n’imyaka bafunzwe bitubahirije amategeko, bafungiwe ahantu hatazwi cyangwa mu buroko bwa CMI. Ubuhamya bw’abagira amahirwe bakava muri ayo menyo ya rubamba bakajugunywa ku mupaka, bwuzuyemo ibindi bintu bibi byinshi bakorerwa. Kuri ubu ikigezweho, ni ukubakubita kugeza bataye ubwenge no kubapfuka amaso bakabajyana mu bihuru kubajugunyayo. Vuba aha, tariki 23 Kamena, Eric Rugorotsi yajugunywe mu mugezi witwa Umuyanja uherereye Ntungamo. Yahajugunywe n’abakozi b’Urwego rushinzwe Umutekano w’Imbere mu Gihugu (ISO), ategekwa koga agakiza ubuzima bwe cyangwa agahitamo kurohama. Yabwiwe ko naramuka ahuye na polisi cyangwa urundi rwego rushinzwe umutekano aza kuvuga ko yarekuwe n’abakozi ba ISO. Ikindi Rugorotsi yahishuye ni uko abamutotezaga ari abantu bavuga Ikinyarwanda neza cyane. Ibyo ni ibishimangira ibyo Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ihora ivuga by’uko ubutegetsi bwa Uganda bukorana cyane n’Umutwe w’Iterabwoba wa RNC.

title: Ikindi kimenyetso cy’umugambi wa Uganda mu gutera icyuhagiro RNC
content: Kimwe mu bikorwa bishya, ni ikinyamakuru Daily Monitor kuri uyu wa 2 Kanama cyateruye kivuganira abarwanashyaka ba RNC baba mu Bwongereza, ko bashaka gutaha iwabo nubwo bashinjwa ibyaha bikomeye by’iterabwoba, ariko iki kinyamakuru cyagaragaje ko uyu mutwe ugizwe n’impirimbanyi za demokarasi zishaka impinduka. Ni ibikorwa bidasiba kandi byiyongera ku kuba Perezida Yoweri Museveni aheruka kwiyemerera ko yahuye n’umwe mu barwanashyaka ba RNC, Charlotte Mukankusi ushinzwe dipolomasi muri uwo mutwe. Iyi mikoranire ya Uganda ishyigikiye abagamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda yagarutsweho kenshi, ko Uganda yahaye rugari umutwe wa RNC ari naho ukorera ibikorwa byo gushaka abayoboke mu banyarwanda baba muri icyo gihugu, ku bufatanye n’urwego rwa gisirikare rushinzwe ubutasi, CMI, abatemeranyije n’uwo mugambi bagakorerwa iyicarubozo rikomeye. Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Uganda, Maj Gen Frank Mugambage, yavuze ko RNC ari umutwe w’iterabwoba, ku buryo ibyo uvuga byose bidakwiye guhabwa agaciro. Ni mu gihe abawugize bakabaye bakurikiranwa ku bikorwa uyu mutwe wakoze n’indi migambi mibisha ufite ku Rwanda. Mu banenze iyi mikorere yo gukeza RNC kandi harimo Yolande Makolo, wibajije niba ubu ari uburyo bushya Uganda izanye nyuma y’imigambi iheruka kuyipfubana yo gushyigikira umutwe witwaje intwaro wagabaga ibitero unyuze mu ishyamba rya Nyungwe. pic.twitter.com/KWCfgoPN2V — Yolande Makolo 🇷🇼 (@YolandeMakolo) August 3, 2019 Uganda ikomeje ibikorwa bibangamiye abanyarwanda, byanatumye u Rwanda rubuza abaturage barwo kujya muri icyo gihugu kubera iyicarubozo bakorerwayo, kugeza igihe ikibazo cy’umutekano wabo kizakemukira. Ku wa 22 CMI yataye muri yombi abakirisitu ba ADEPR Kibuye bagera kuri 40 mu murwa mukuru Kampala, ubu bafunzwe mu buryo butemewe n’amategeko kuko bataragezwa imbere y’inkiko ngo bamenyeshe ibyo baregwa, banisobanure. Ni abanyarwanda biyongera ku bandi bafungiwe muri icyo gihugu, banangiwe gusurwa n’abahagarariye u Rwanda muri Uganda. Ni mu gihe Itegeko Nshinga rya Uganda riteganya ko nta muntu ugomba gufungwa igihe kirenze amasaha 48 uhereye igihe yafatiwe, ataragezwa imbere y’urukiko.

title: Harabura iki ngo u Bufaransa bugire ambasaderi mu Rwanda?
content: Kugeza ubu imirimo ya ambasade y’u Bufaransa i Kigali ikurikiranwa na Chargé d’Affaires. Flesch yagiye umubano w’ibihugu byombi utameze neza, ahanini hashingiwe ku mpamvu za politiki. Mbere y’uko Ambasaderi Flesch agenda, Leta y’u Bufaransa yari yarahaye u Rwanda izina rishya ry’uwo yifuza ko yayihagararira, Fred Constant, wari usanzwe ari Ambasaderi mu Birwa bya Antilles na Guyane. Ntiyaje koherezwa mu Rwanda kuko hashize igihe kirenga umwaka rutaramwemeza ajyanwa muri Guinée Équatoriale. Kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki 22 Nyakanga, Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga, Ubutwererane n’Ibikorwa by’Umuryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, Amb. Nduhungirehe  Olivier yakiriye mu biro bye Chargé d’Affaires mushya w’u Bufaransa i Kigali, Jérémie Blin baganira ku guteza imbere umubano hagati y’ibihugu byombi. Blin asimbuye Etienne de Souza wari umaze igihe akurikirana ibikorwa bya Ambasade y’u Bufaransa mu Rwanda. IGIHE yagiranye ikiganiro na Amb Nduhungirehe, imubaza  impamvu u Bufaransa bukomeje kohereza ba Chargé d’Affaires, aho kuzana ambasaderi mushya. Yagize ati “Igihe nikigera Abafaransa bazamushyiraho, natwe tukaba twiteguya kuzasuzuma ubwo busabe ariko ubu umubano umeze neza. Bivuze ko ibyabaye mu bihe byashize atari byo bizaba ubu.” Umubano w’u Rwanda n’u Bufaransa wagiye uba mubi nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, u Rwanda rushinja icyo gihugu uruhare mu gufasha Leta yakoze Jenoside, u Bufaransa nabwo bugashinja bamwe mu bayobozi bakuru b’u Rwanda guhanura indege yari itwaye Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana. Umubano watangiye kuba mwiza mu 2017 ubwo Emmanuel Macron yatorerwaga kuyobora u Bufaransa, akazana  impinduka mu bubanyi n’amahanga. Umwaka ushize, ubushinjacyaha bw’u Bufaransa bwahagaritse burundu iperereza ku ihanurwa ry’indege ya Habyarimana nyuma yo kubura ibimenyetso ku bo bashinjaga kubigiramo uruhare. Muri Mata uyu mwaka kandi Perezida Macron yashyizeho itsinda ry’inzobere rishinzwe gucukumbura uruhare rw’u Bufaransa muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. IGIHE yabajije Nduhungirehe niba u Rwanda atari rwo rwaba rwanga kwemeza ba ambasaderi  b’u Bufaransa, maze abihakana yivuye inyuma. Yavuze ko nta muntu n’umwe u Bufaransa bwigeze bwohereza vuba aha busaba ko u Rwanda rwamwemeza nka ambasaderi ngo rumwange. Ati “Oya ntawe twigeze twanga rwose. Ibyo ntabwo ari byo ntawe twigeze twanga. Ntawe bigeze bohereza. Na Perezida Macron yarabivuze umwaka ushize ko ubu turimo duteza imbere umubano kugira ngo ugaruke mu nzira nziza, ko igihe nikigera bazohereza ambasaderi.” Yakomeje agira ati “Ambasaderi ni u Bufaransa bumushyiraho si u Rwanda rumushyiraho. U Bufaransa igihe cyose buzamushyiraho tuziga kuri ubwo busabe.” Umubano ushingiye kuri za ambasade hagati y’u Rwanda n’u Bufaransa utangirira mu 1962 u Rwanda rukibona ubwigenge. Mu kwezi gushize Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigega Mpuzamahanga cy’Abafaransa gishinzwe Iterambere (Agence Française de Developpément , AFD), yaje mu Rwanda yizeza gukomeza gufatanya mu bikorwa by’iterambere. Umuyobozi w’icyo kigo yahaherukaga mu 1992. Guhera mu 1962, u Bufaransa bumaze kohereza mu Rwanda ba ambasaderi 16, kuva kuri Jean-Marc Barbey wabimburiye abandi kugeza kuri Michel Flesh  wagiye mu 2015.

title: Abarwanashyaka ba Parti Socialiste bakomeje gucikamo ibice bapfa uruhare rw’u Bufaransa muri Jenoside
content: Abo bari abaminisitiri bikomaga Raphaël Glucksmann wavuze ko Mitterand yagize uruhare muri Jenoside yabaye mu Rwanda mu 1994. Ni amagambo yavuze amaze kwiyamamaza muri Toulouse ku wa 6 Mata. Hubert Védrine wabaye Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Ibiro bya Mitterand, aba Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’amahanga w’u Bufaransa ndetse ubu uyobora Institut François Mitterrand, na we aheruka kwikoma abashinja Sebuja uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Nyuma y’imyaka 25 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ihagaritswe, umwuka mubi ugenda ugaruka mu ishyaka ry’aba-socialistes, ushingiye ku ruhare rutaremerwa u Bufaransa bwagize mu itegurwa ry’umugambi wa Jenoside n’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryawo. Icyo gihe iri shyaka rikomokamo Mitterand ni ryo ryari riyoboye igihugu. Nk’uko Jeune Afrique yabitangaje, uwahoze ari umunyamabanga wa PS ashinzwe ibibazo mpuzamahanga, Maurice Braud, aheruka kuvuga ko ibyabaye mu 1994 bitatinzweho cyane na PS, kubera ko ryari rifite ibindi birihangayikishije nk’ingaruka zo gutsindwa amatora y’abadepite mu 1993. Ibiro byari bishinzwe ububanyi n’amahanga muri PS bisa n’aho ari byo byonyine byemeye kuvuga ku kibazo cya Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi. Uwari ubibereye umunyamabanga mukuru, Pervenche Berès, yagaragaje ukutemeranya na gahunda za Elysée na Operation Turquoise yatangiye ku wa 22 Kamena 1994. Mu itangazo uru rwego rw’ishyaka PS rwasohoye ku wa 16 Kamena, rwavuze ko politiki y’amacakubiri yo mu Bufaransa [guhera mu 1990] yabwamburaga uburenganzira bwo kugira uruhare mu gikorwa cya gisirikare. Biragoye kuganira kuri iyi ngingo mu ba socialistes Ubwo hibukwaga ku nshuro ya 20 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ihagaritswe, iki kibazo cyazamuye umwuka mubi hagati y’abantu ba hafi ba François Mitterrand n’ishami ry’urubyiruko muri PS, Mouvement des jeunes socialistes (MJS). Mbere y’iminsi mike ngo ajye i Kigali, uwari kuba ahagarariye guverinoma y’u Bufaransa mu Rwanda, Minisitiri w’ubutabera Christiane Taubira, yasubitse urugendo nyuma y’amagambo Perezida Paul Kagame yavugiye mu kiganiro na Jeune Afrique. Yagarutse ku ruhare rutaziguye rw’u Bubiligi n’u Bufaransa muri politiki yagejeje kuri Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ndetse icyo gihugu kindi kiza kugira uruhare mu kuyishyira mu bikorwa. Ku wa 5 Mata MJS yasohoye itangazo yamagana uko kwisubiraho kwabaye ku munota wa nyuma. Riti “U Bufaransa bugomba kwemera uruhare rwose bwagize mu gushyigikira ubutegetsi bwateguye jenoside kuva mu 1990 kugeza mu 1994”. Ni ubutumwa ariko bwanenzwe n’abantu ba hafi na Mitterrand. Paul Quilès wayoboye komisiyo y’Inteko Ishinga amategeko y’u Bufaransa mu isesengura ryo mu 1998 ku ruhare rwabwo mu Rwanda, yavuze ko habayeho ibiganiro hamwe na MJS ku cyicaro cy’ishyaka, hasobanurwa izo ngingo. Uwari Perezida w’itsinda ry’ubucuti bw’u Rwanda n’u Bufaransa mu Nteko Ishinga amategeko y’icyo gihugu hagati ya 2007-2012, Marylise Lebranchu, ahamya ko atari ubwa mbere umubano w’u Rwanda n’u Bufaransa uteje umwiryane hagati y’abantu bakabaye bashyigikirana. Mu 2010 mu gihe umubano w’u Rwanda n’u Bufaransa wari uhagaze neza ku butegetsi bwa Nicolas Sarkozy wanagiriye uruzinduko i Kigali muri Gashyantare uwo mwaka, Marylise wari umudepite w’umu socialiste yagombaga kujya mu Rwanda ayoboye rya tsinda ry’ubucuti kuva ku wa 7 kugeza ku wa 10 Kamena. Ati "Mbere yo kugenda, nakiriye telefoni ya Hubert Védrine [wabaye Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa Elysée], wakuraga icyasha cyose ku Bufaransa, hamwe n’indi ya Paul Quilès. Twashyizweho igitutu,” Mu mvugo za MJS cyangwa Raphaël Glucksmann ndetse n’abahoze ari abantu ba hafi ba Mitterrand, bisa n’aho icyuho kirimo hagati aho bigoye kuzikiba. Jean-Christophe Cambadélis wigeze kuba umunyamabanga wa mbere muri iri shyaka (2014- 2017), aheruka kugira ati “Hari byinshi boshobora kuvugwa ku bikorwa by’u Bufaransa mu Rwanda, ariko ntabwo twabyita kugira uruhare muri Jenoside.” Olivier Faure uri muri uyu mwanya na we asa n’uwamaze kwerekana aho ahagaze. Muri Mata 2019 yanze gushyira umukono ku nyandiko yasinyweho n’andi mashyaka, yasabaga Perezida Emmanuel Macron kujya mu Rwanda “kuvugisha ukuri” kuri Jenoside. Mu ibaruwa yo ku wa 15 Werurwe Olivier Faure yandikiye Benjamin Abtan uyobora umuryango wo mu Burayi urwanya ivangura, EGAM, ari na wo watangije icyo gitekerezo, yitandukanyije n’icyo gikorwa avuga ko “cyaha agaciro gahunda z’ubutegetsi bw’igitugu, bwica bukanafunga abatavuga rumwe nabwo.’ Ku wa 20 Gicurasi, Olivier Faure yakiriye Hubert Védrine na Paul Quilès, aho abo batatu bemeranyije ku mwanzuro ko “nyuma y’amatora y’u Burayi, ishyaka PS rizatangiza ibiganiro ku bagize uruhare muri Jenoside mu Rwanda. Tuzasaba ifungurwa ry’ishyinguranyandiko z’ibihugu byose n’inzego zagize ruhare muri ayo makimbirane, kuva ku ntangiroro yayo kugeza ku iherezo.” Kugeza ubu ayo madosiye ntiyafunguwe. Muri Nyakanga hagati ariko Olivier yagize ati “Ntabwo uyu mushinga utatangira ariko nshyigikiye icyo gitekerezo.” Paul Quilès we yavuze ko yifuza biganiro, ariko binafite imirongo bigenderaho. Ati “Nifuza ibiganiro aho ibintu byose tuzabishyira ku meza, ariko byibanda mbere na mbere, ku mateka bigendana n’igihe. Bitari ibiganiro bishingiye kuri raporo ya Mucyo [yasohotse mu 2008 yakozwe na komisiyo yigenga yashyiriweho gushaka ibimenyetso ku ruhare rw’u Bufaransa mu gutegura no gushyira mu bikorwa umugambi wa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994], ivuga ko u Bufaransa hari amakosa bwakoze.”

title: Abagore n’abakobwa bihariye 95% by’Abanyarwanda bahuye n’icuruzwa ry’abantu
content: Ubushakashatsi ku kibazo cy’icuruzwa ry’abantu mu Rwanda bwamuritswe kuri uyu wa 19 Nyakanga 2019, bwakozwe n’ Umuryango Never Again Rwanda hagati ya 2017 na 2018. Imibare yatanzwe n’Urwego rw’abinjira n’abasohoka yagaragaje ko mu Rwanda ahanini abacuruzwa bahanyuzwa bajyanwe mu bindi bihugu, kuko abahakurwa ari bo bake. Mu bantu 515 bacurujwe higanjemo Abarundi, bagera kuri 323 bingana na 62.7%. Harimo kandi Abanye-Congo 77 (15%), Abanyarwanda 70 (13.6%) n’abantu 45 (8.7) bo mu bindi bihugu. Urebeye ku gitsina, abagore n’abakobwa bari 400 (77.67 %) naho ab’igitsina gabo ari 115 (22.33%). Ku ruhanda rw’u Rwanda, ubu bushakashatsi bwerekana ko mu bacurujwe, 95.24% ari ab’igitsina gore, 87.01% ni urubyiruko naho 18.8% bari munsi y’imyaka 18. Ubushakashatsi bwerekanye ko inzira Abanyarwanda banyuzwamo bajyanwa gucuruzwa ari izegereye imipaka nko mu Turere twa Rusizi, Burera, Nyagatare, Rubavu, Gicumbi na Kirehe. Ibihugu bakunze kujya gucururizwamo harimo Arabie Saoudite (38.55%), Uganda (37.35% na Kenya (7.23%), Mozambique, Tanzania, Malawi, Afurika y’Epfo, Zambia, Malaysia, Omar, Qatar, Kuwait Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Abarabu n’ahandi. Abakoze ubushakashatsi basobanuye ko abajya gucuruzwa akenshi babeshywa ko bagiye guhabwa akazi keza, kwiga n’ibindi, bagezwayo ntibabibone cyangwa bagashorwa mu bikorwa by’urukozasoni n’ibindi bigira ingaruka ku buzima bwabo. Zimwe mu mpamvu zituma ubucuruzi bw’abantu bwiyongera harimo imibereho mibi, ubukene, ubushomeri mu rubyiruko, igitutu cy’umuryango, ababeshywa ko bagiye kurihirwa amashuri n’ibindi. Umuyobozi wa Never Again, Dr Nkurunziza Ryarasa Joseph, yavuze ko hakenewe ubuvugizi kugira ngo abanyarwanda bamenye uko icuruzwa ry’abantu rikorwa, ingaruka rigira n’uko baryirinda. Ati “Icyo dusaba ni ukugira ngo habeho ihanahana ry’amakuru cyane cyane mu kigo gishinzwe abinjira n’abasohoka, Urwego rw’Ubugenzacyaha, Polisi n’urw’Ubutabera, kuko kugira ngo iki kibazo gikemuke ni uko abantu baba bafite amakuru yuzuye.” Yasabye ko hakwiye no kujyaho ikigo gifasha mu isanamitima ku bantu bahungabanyirijwe mu icuruzwa ry’abantu, abateshejwe ishuri bagafashwa kurisubiramo. Umuyobozi w’Ishami rishinzwe ubutabera mpuzamahanga muri Minisiteri y’Ubutabera, Umurungi Providence, yavuze ko icuruzwa ry’abantu atari ikibazo cy’u Rwanda gusa ahubwo cyugarije Isi yose. Ati “Ibivuye muri ubu bushakashatsi bizadufasha gushyira muri gahunda no guteganye icyakorwa mu rwego rwo kurwanya icuruzwa ry’abantu.” Umurungi yavuze ko imiryango ariyo ifite uruhare rukomeye kuko bigaragara ko abajya gucuruzwa bajyanwa n’abo bafitanye isano. Ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga ryita ku murimo (ILO) riheruka kugaragaza ko abantu barenga miliyoni 24.9 barimo abagabo, abagore n’abana bashowe mu bucuruzi bw’abantu mu 2017.

title: Icyo impuguke zivuga ku mahanga akomeje kwiyegereza Afurika
content: Iyi nama y’iminsi ibiri yabaye nyuma y’izindi zimaze kumenyererwa zirimo izihuza Umugabane wa Afurika n’Ubumwe bw’i Burayi, Afurika n’u Bufaransa, Afurika n’u Buhinde, Afurika n’u Bushinwa, Afurika n’ibindi bihugu by’ibihangange nka Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Umuntu yakwibaza icyo bivuze n’icyo bimaze kuba muri iyi myaka Umugabane wa Afurika uhanzwe amaso n’ibihugu by’ibihangange biharanira kuyobora Isi aho bidasiba guhamagaza abakuru b’ibihugu bya Afurika mu nama ziba zigamije kwiga ku mubano wihariye n’ubuhahirane hagati yabyo na Afurika. Uburyo ibihugu by’i Burayi na Amerika bikomeje gushaka kwiyegereza Afurika ni imwe mu ngingo zaganiriweho mu kiganiro Isi ya None cyo kuri Radio Rwanda cyari cyatumiwemo impuguke mu miterere y’Isi na politiki mpuzamahanga zirimo Senateri Dr Havugimana Emmanuel, Alex Nizeyimana na Emery Nzirabatinya. Senateri Dr Havugimana yavuze ko umutungo kamere hirya no hino ku Isi, uri kugenda ukendera aho usigaye ari muri Afurika ku buryo usanga hari ibihugu bimwe na bimwe nka Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo ifite amabuye y’agaciro, za Centrafrique, Guinée n’ahandi. Kuki u Burusiya? Kuva mu 2015, u Burusiya bwatangiye gusinyana amasezerano y’imikoranire n’ibihugu bya Afurika, aho bwasinye ajyanye n’ibya gisirikare n’ibihugu 21 ndetse mu myaka icumi ishize ubuhahirane hagati yabwo n’uyu mugabane bwavuye kuri miliyari 5.7 z’amadolari bugera kuri 20.4 z’amadolari mu 2018. Nzirabatinya Emery yavuze ko mu myaka 20 ishize Perezida w’u Burusiya, Perezida Vladimir Putin, yasuye Afurika yo munsi y’Ubutayu bwa Sahara inshuro eshatu gusa nabwo yageraga muri Afurika y’Epfo. Yakomeje agira ati “Muri izo nshuro eshatu aho yagiye ni mu gihugu kimwe gusa nabwo ku nyungu zigaragara, ahantu yibanze ahanini byari Afurika y’Amajyaruguru yari yaragiye muri Algeria na za Misiri. Aho umuntu yareba impamvu yabyo, ni ubukungu kamere.” Mu 2018, nibwo Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga w’u Burusiya, Sergey Lavrov, yatangiye kugendera ibihugu byo munsi y’Ubutayu bwa Sahara ndetse aza no kugera mu Rwanda muri Kamena. Nzirabatinya yavuze ko “bageze aho bikorera isuzuma basanga Abashinwa barabirangije kare, Abanyaburayi barabibonye kare, nk’ubu tuzi neza ko mu ntangiro za 2020, igihugu cy’u Bwongereza kizakorana inama na Afurika.” Afurika ni umugeni uri kureshywa Muri iki kinyejana cya 21, ibihugu bikomeye ku Isi, biri gushakira isoko muri Afurika. Nk’u Burusiya nicyo gihugu cya mbere gitanga ingano nyinshi ku Isi ariko nabwo hari ibyo budafite birimo n’ikawa n’ibindi biboneka muri Afurika gusa. Nzirabatinya yagize ati “Ibyo bituma mvuga iki rero? Afurika ni umugeni mwiza warezwe neza uri kureshywa n’abasore bafite ifaranga. Ni ukuvuga ngo aba bantu bari kuza bakoze ubushakashatsi bwimbitse bazi ibyo dufite twe tutabizi ariko nabo badafite iwabo.” Abahanga bavuga ko u Burusiya bushaka isoko muri Afurika ry’ibintu bitatu by’ingenzi aribyo ubuhanga bwa gisirikare n’ibikoresho kandi ibihugu byose byo ku Isi usanga bikeneye ubwirinzi. Ikindi ni uguhagarara ku cyo bashaka bakakinambaho kandi iki gihugu cyateye imbere mu rwego rw’ingufu zaba izikomoka ku mashanyarazi n’amazi, ibi ariko bikajyana n’inganda zateye imbere. Ubwo yatangizaga iyi nama ihuza Afurika n’u Burusiya, Perezida Vladimir Putin yabwiye abayobozi bitabiriye ko yifuza gukuba kabiri ubucuruzi u Burusiya bwakoreraga muri Afurika. Yavuze ko icyifuzo cye ari uko u Burusiya bugirana umubano mwiza na Afurika ushingiye ku bwubahane, bitandukanye n’ibihugu by’i Burayi ashinja gukoresha igitugu n’iterabwoba kuri Afurika. Kugeza ubu u Burusiya bufitanye umubano mu bya gisirikare n’ibihugu bisaga 30 bya Afurika.

title: Hong Kong yatangiye ibiganiro biganisha ku ishoramari ryayo mu Rwanda
content: Ubwo bucuruzi bwitezweho korohereza inganda zo mu Rwanda gukurayo ibicuruzwa. Umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe ibikorwa muri PSF, Faustin Karasira, yavuze ko ibiganiro na Hong Kong bigamije kureba imikoranire n’u Rwanda harebwa uburyo abanyarwanda bakorana ubucuruzi na Hong Kong mu buryo bworoshye. Hakazababo no gutumiza ibicuruzwa bizafasha inganda z’u Rwanda muri  gahunda ya ‘Made in Rwanda’. Ati “Mu mikoranire harimo kohereza ibintu hariya cyangwa mu gutumiza ibintu bikenewe hano cyane cyane bidufasha gutuma inganda zikora muri gahunda ya ‘Made in Rwanda’.” Karasira yavuze ko mu mwaka utaha hari abashoramari mu nzego zitandukanye bagera kuri 200 bo muri Hong Kong bazitabira ibikorwa bizategurwa na PSF i Kigali, bizabahuza n’Abanyarwanda mu nzego zitandukanye bazashoramo imari. Ati “Abo ngabo nibaza hano bizabafasha kureba ishoramari riri mu gihugu, ndetse n’ukuntu bakorana n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa hano mu Rwanda.” Ku ruhande rwa Hong Kong, ngo gukorera mu Rwanda bizabafasha kugera mu bindi bihugu byo mu Karere k’a Afurika y’Iburasirazuba mu buryo bworoshye. Hong kong isanzwe izwiho ubucuruzi bukomeye mu bijyanye n’ibiribwa ndetse n’ibinyobwa, ndetse igira imurikabikorwa mu bihugu bitandukanye. Mu biganiro irimo na PSF harimo no kuba imurikabikorwa nk’iryo ryazabera mu Rwanda. Inama y’iterambere ry’ubucuruzi muri Hong Kong yashinzwe mu 1996 igamije guteza imbere ubucuruzi bwa Hong Kong n’ibigo byaho mu mahanga. Daniel Lam ushinzwe ibikorwa bya Hong Kong mu burasirazuba bwo hagati no muri Afurika, yavuze ko u Rwanda ari isoko ryiza muri Afurika agendeye ku bukungu bwarwo mu myaka itanu ishize. Ati “U Rwanda ni isoko ry’ingenzi muri Afurika. Tubona ari ngombwa guteza imbere ubufatanye mu by’ubukungu na Hong Kong." Umujyanama mu by’ubukungu muri ambasade ya Repubulika y’abaturage y’u Bushinwa mu Rwanda, Wang Jiaxin, yatangaje ko Hong Kong ari agace ko mu Bushinwa gafite ubukungu buteye imbere bitewe n’aho gaherereye. Ati “Ndatekereza ko u Rwanda n’u Bushinwa bizaganira ukuntu imishinga mito n’icirirtse yaterwa inkunga kandi Hong Kong ni igihugu gifite ubunararibonye ku buryo bwo guteza imbere iyo mishinga, ni kimwe mu byo u Rwanda rwaganira na Hong Kong.” Hong Kong ni igice cy’igihugu cy’u Bushinwa gifite imiyoborere yihariye, ntabwo ari igihugu cyigenga nubwo mu buzima bwayo ikora ibikorwa bya buri munsi nk’igihugu cyigenga. Raporo y’umuryango w’ubukungu ku Isi yo mu 2018 yerekana ko Hong Kong ari iya kabiri mu kugira ibikorwa remezo. Ni iya karindwi mu bihugu bifite ubucuruzi bwagutse, ikaba ku mwanya wa munani mu bohereza ibicuruzwa byinshi mu mahanga. Hong kong niyo icururuza ibiryo na divayi nyinshi ku mugabane wa Aziya, ikagira ubwato bunini bwa kane ku isi butwara ibicuruzwa. Mu 2018 yabashije kwinjiza  miliyari $1000 zavuye mu bucuruzi.
