title: Bombori bombori irakomeje muri RNC, uwari Umuvugizi wayo yeguye
content: Ubwegure bwa Turayishimye bwatangajwe na Gervais Condo usanzwe ari Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa RNC mu nyandiko yashyize ahagaragara ku wa 24 Ukwakira 2019. Nta mpamvu n’imwe yigeze itangazwa y’icyaba cyatumye ava kuri iyi mirimo, byatumye benshi mu basesenguzi mu bya politiki bemeza ko "muri RNC bombori bombori ikomeje guca ibintu". Jean Paul Turayishimiye utuye i Boston muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika bivugwa ko ari we cyegera cya hafi cya Kayumba Nyamwasa, Umuyobozi Mukuru wa RNC utuye muri Afurika y’Epfo aho yahungiye ubutabera. Afite uruhushya rwa burundu rwo gutura muri Amerika, ni umwe mu bikomerezwa bya RNC akaba umucurabwenge w’uwo mutwe haba mu migambi yo gutegura ibitero, muri make azwi nk’umuyobozi ukuriye ubutasi. Ni umwe mu bacurabwenge w’ibitero bya grenade byibasiye Kigali mu 2010 Turayishimiye avugwaho kuba umwe mu bacurabwenge b’ibitero bya gerenade byahitanye inzirakarengane ndetse no kuba mu migambi mibisha igamije kwibasira u Rwanda. Byagaragaye neza ubwo Nshimiyimana Joseph uzwi nka Camarade yagezwaga mu rukiko akurikiranyweho uruhare mu bitero bya grenade byagabwe mu isoko rya Kicukiro tariki 13 Nzeri 2013. Icyo gitero cyahitanye abantu babiri, batandatu barakomereka. Nshimiyimana icyo gihe yivugiye ko yinjijwe muri ibyo bikorwa na Jean Paul Turayishimiye ndetse ko ari na we wamuhaye amabwiriza n’amafaranga yo kujya kugaba icyo gitero. Jean Paul Turayishimiye ni na we wakoreshaga Joel Mutabazi n’abo bari bafatanyije barimo Caporal Kalisa mu mugambi wabo wapfubye wo guhitana Umukuru w’Igihugu. Amakuru yemeza ko RNC yari yapanze kugaba igitero ku Mukuru w’Igihugu mu matora ya 2017 hagamijwe ‘guhungabanya abantu mu mutwe’. Icyo gikorwa ngo cyagombaga kujyana no kwangiza bimwe mu bikorwa remezo bikomeye ku buryo byari kugaragara ko Guverinoma itakibashije kugenzura igihugu. Bivugwa kandi ko Turayishimiye yari yategetse ibyitso bya RNC i Kigali kumukusanyiriza amakuru yose ku bikorwaremezo nk’ibiraro n’ahandi muri Kigali kugira ngo bizagabirweho igitero rimwe, bituritswe mu gihe cy’amatora ya 2017. Ngo imyitozo yo kugaba ibi bitero yagombaga kubera muri kimwe mu bihugu bituranyi by’u Rwanda. Mu myitozo hagomba kwigishwa uburyo bwo kugaba ibitero ukoresheje ibiturika. Zimwe mu nyandiko z’inkiko ku manza zaciriwe i Kigali zigaragaza ko akazi ko gushaka abazatera za grenade kari kashinzwe uwitwa Patrick Rukundo, wahoze anakorera umutwe wa FDLR na RNC i Kampala. Yifashishije kuba aba i Kampala hazwi nko mu ndiri y’abakozi ba RNC, Rukundo yahakoreraga yubaka agatsiko k’ibyitso bya RNC biri mu Rwanda. Bivugwa ko ibitero mu matora ya Perezida byagombaga kugabwa mu byiciro bibiri. Icya mbere kwari ugushwanyaguza ibikorwa remezo bigateza akavuyo. Ibyo byari guha urwaho icyiciro cya kabiri. Ubwo nibwo abandi bantu bari kujya gukwirakwiza inyandiko ziriho ibihuha “Tracts” kugira ngo bakomeze guteza imidugararo, ubuyobozi bugaragare ko bwananiwe. Turayishimye yagarutsweho mu rubanza rw’abo kwa Rwigara Turayishimye Jean Paul yavuzwe mu rubanza rw’abo kwa Rwigara, aho Perezida w’Urukiko Rukuru yanamuhamagaje we na Thabita Gwiza, Mukangarambe Xaverine, Mushayija Edmond bakunze kwita Sacyanwa. Yeguye mu gihe Ben Rutabana usanzwe ari komiseri muri RNC ushinzwe kongera ubushobozi amaze ukwezi aburiwe irengero ubwo yari mu rugendo yatangiye ku wa 5 Nzeri 2019 muri Uganda. Umuryango we uri mu rungabangabo rwo kubura uyu mugabo kuva mu kwezi gushize ubwo yajyaga mu bikorwa by’uwo mutwe muri Uganda, ugashinja Kayumba Nyamwasa n’abandi bayobozi bawo kuba inyuma y’ibura rye. Urugendo rwe muri Uganda rwavuzwe bwa mbere n’umuryango we mu ibaruwa yasakaye isaba ubuyobozi bwa RNC kumugarura mu muryango. Uruvunganzoka rw’ibibazo byugarije RNC rwiyongeraho uburyo ingabo zayo zari ziteguye kugaba ibitero-shuma ku Rwanda zanyukanyukiwe mu mashyamba ya Congo Kinshasa n’ingabo za FARDC, benshi muri bo bahasiga ubuzima, abandi barahambirwa, bazanwa mu Rwanda kwitaba ubutabera. Indi nkuru wasoma: Umwiryane, gucikamo ibice n’umuvumba w’amarira; ibyaranze imyaka 8 RNC imaze ishinzwe

title: Tariki 24 Ukwakira, intangiriro y’indunduro ya Mobutu Sese Seko wa Zaïre
content:
Ni intambara ikomeye kuko niyo  yashyize iherezo ku butegetsi bw’umunyagitugu Mobutu Sese Seko wari umaze imyaka 32 ayoboye Zaïre nk’urugo rwe, kugeza ubwo hari bamwe bari baramufashe nk’Imana cyangwa se umuntu utazapfa, nawe akabyuririraho akiyita Umwami wa Zaïre Imyaka 32 ku butegetsi bwa Mobutu yayimaze yishakira abanzi ari nabo bamurunduye, haba imbere mu gihugu no ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Mu myaka ya 1990, ubukungu bwa Zaïre bwari aharindimuka , aho umuturage yabonaga nibura amadolari atagera kuri magana atatu ku mwaka, ugize imyaka 49 akiriho akaba ari umurame. Muri iyo myaka kandi Mobutu yari ku gitutu mpuzamahanga, aho ibihugu bikomeye byifuzaga kandi bigashyigikira impinduka n’amaraso mashya mu buyobozi bw’ibihugu bya Afurika, byasaga n’ibiyobowe cyami nta jambo abaturage bafite. Ibihugu nka Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’u Bufaransa byashyigikiye Mobutu mu mizo ya mbere, byari bitangiye kumukuraho amaboko bimutegeka gukuraho ubutegetsi bw’ishyaka rimwe, akemera amashyaka menshi. Igisirikare cya Zaïre  (FAZ) nacyo cyari aharindimuka kuko imyitwarire mibi yari ikigeze kure ahanini kubera kudahembwa no kutagira ubuyobozi buhamye, byatumaga bahuka mu baturage gusahura, bikongera isura mbi ya Mobutu mu baturage. Binavugwa ko ngo hari ubwo Mobutu yigeze kubaza abasirikare be uburyo bataka kudahembwa kandi yarabahaye imbunda!. Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, imbarutso y’indunduro ya Mobutu
 Nyuma y’uko Ingabo zari iza FPR Inkotanyi zihagarikiye Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda, Interahamwe n’ingabo za Leta bayishyize mu bikorwa bahise bahungira mu burasirazuba bwa Zaïre, hafi y’imbibi z’u Rwanda. Ubusanzwe amategeko mpuzamahanga ntabwo yemera ko impunzi zishyirwa hafi y’umupaka w’igihugu zahunze, nyamara izavuye mu Rwanda zo zahawe rugari,  maze ingabo zahoze ari iza Leta y’u Rwanda yakoze Jenoside, abahoze mu butegetsi n’abandi batangira kwisuganyiriza ku butaka bwa Zaïre  ya Mobutu ngo bagaruke kugaba ibitero kuri Leta nshya yari imaze kujyaho mu Rwanda. Inkunga ikomeye yatangwaga ivuye muri Guverinoma ya Zaïre yari iyobowe na Mobutu Sese Seko. U Rwanda rwamenyesheje imiryango mpuzamahanga icyo kibazo ibyima amatwi, rufata umwanzuro wo kwambuka muri Zaïre  gusenya inkambi impunzi zisuganyirizagamo ngo zigabe ibitero mu Rwanda, banashishikariza impunzi zabyifuzaga gutaha kuza. Uko kwinjira k’u Rwanda muri Zaïre kwahaye ingufu indi mitwe itaravugaga rumwe na Leta ya Mobutu, nibwo umutwe wa Alliance des forces démocratiques pour la libération du Congo (AFDL) wari uyobowe na Laurent-Désiré Kabila watangije ibitero bihereye mu Burasirazuba bwa Zaïre maze ukomeza ujya gufata ubutegetsi i Kinshasa. Intambara yahise yanzika, AFDL ishyigikiwe n’u Rwanda na Uganda, Angola, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Zambia na Zimbabwe n’inyeshyamba nka SPLA yashakaga ubwigenge bwa Sudani y’Epfo. Kubera ubukene, ruswa n’ubwirasi muri Guverinoma ya Mobutu, abaturage benshi bagiye ku ruhande rw’inyeshyamba biba impinduramatwara kurusha uko byari intambara. Uruhande rwa Mobutu rwagerageje kwirwanaho rushyigikiwe na Sudani ndetse n’Inyeshyamba za UNITA zashakaga ubutegetsi muri Angola. Ni nabyo byatumye Angola ishyigikira uruhande rwashakaga gukuraho Mobutu dore ko yo yaninjiyemo nyuma. Mobutu wari no mu bihe bibi arembejwe na kanseri, yahaye ibiraka abacanshuro benshi bo kumufasha gusubiza inyuma  inyeshyamba n’abari bazishyigikiye ariko biba iby’ubusa kuko umunsi ku munsi barushagaho kwegera umurwa mukuru Kinshasa. Kwinjira kwa Angola mu ntambara noneho kongereye ingufu uruhande rwa Kabila rwarwanyaga Mobutu, ku buryo bugaragara barusha ingabo za Leta imbaraga. Mu mezi ya nyuma y’urugamba, ingabo za Mobutu ntizari zigiteye ikibazo inyeshyamba ahubwo ikibazo cyasigaye ari ibikorwa remezo bike nk’imihanda byorohereza inyeshyamba kugera i Kinshasa. Tariki 16 Gicurasi 1997, Mobutu wasaga n’uwabuze epfo na ruguru, yahunze igihugu, bucya Laurent Desire Kabila n’ingabo ze batangaza ko bafashe igihugu bashyiraho Guverinoma nshya. Mobutu yabanje guhungiro muri Togo, avayo ajya muri Maroc ari naho yaje kugwa nyuma y’amezi ane azize kanseri y’ubugabo bw’epfo (Prostate cancer) tariki 7 Nzeri 1997. Kabila amaze kujya ku butegetsi, yahindutse u Rwanda atangira gukorana n’abasize bakoze Jenoside na we atangira kubafasha ngo bazagaruke gutera u Rwanda. Nibyo byagejeje ku ntambara ya kabiri ya Congo.

title: Depite Munyangeyo Théogène yagizwe umuvugizi w’Ihuriro ry’Imitwe ya Politiki mu Rwanda
content: Aba bombi batowe kuri uyu wa 24 Ukwakira 2019, mu nama rusange y’iri huriro yabereye ku cyicaro cyaryo ku Kacyiru. Depite Munyangeyo ubarizwa mu ishyaka riharanira Ukwishyira ukizana kwa buri muntu(PL)  yamamajwe kuri uyu mwanya wenyine atorwa ku majwi 100%, asimbura Depite Mukabunani Christine wo mu ishyaka PS Imberakuri. Umuvugizi wungirije, Musanabaganwa Eugenie ubarizwa mu Ishyaka rya PSP wasimbuye Depite Mukama Abbas. We yatowe ku majwi 37 mu gihe Mukantagara bari bahanganye yagize amajwi atandatu. Nyuma yo gutorwa, Depite Munyangeyo yabashimiye icyizere bamugiriye. Ati “Gahunda y’ibikorwa mwarayigennye, igisigaye ni ugufatanya kugira ngo twuse ikivi  cy’uyu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari. Igisigaye ni ubufatanye kugira ngo dukomeze twubake igihugu cyacu.” Yakomeje agira ati “Ikirimo gikomeye ni ugukomeza kubaka ubumenyi bw’abagize imitwe ya Politiki yemewe mu Rwanda uko ar 11. Tuzanaguma kugirana ibiganiro na Minisiteri zitandukanye nk’ikijyanye n’uko igihugu cyacu gihagaze muri Politiki y’ububanyi  n’amahanga.” Depite Munyangeyo  asanzwe ayobora Komisiyo y’abadepite y’Ubukungu n‘Ubucuruzi. Umuvugizi ndetse n’umwungirije b’iri huriro batorerwa kuyobora manda y’amezi atandatu atongerwa.

title: U Rwanda rutegereje ubutumire bwa Uganda ku nama ya kabiri yiga ku masezerano ya Luanda
content: Ni amasezerano yasinyiwe i Luanda muri Angola ku wa 21 Kanama hagati y’u Rwanda na Uganda, agamije guhosha ubwumvikane buke bumaze iminsi hagati y’ibihugu byombi. Ku wa 16 Nzeri nibwo habaye inama ya mbere ya Komisiyo ihuriweho n’u Rwanda na Uganda, iteganywa n’amasezerano ya Luanda, yashyiriweho gucoca ibibazo bikomeje guteza umwuka mubi hagati y’ibi bihugu by’ibituranyi. Iyi nama yabereye muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga y’u Rwanda yiga ku bibazo birimo ko Uganda icumbikira imitwe igamije kuruhungabanyiriza umutekano, gukorera iyicarubozo Abanyarwanda no kubangamira ubucuruzi bwarwo. Itsinda ry’u Rwanda ryari riyobowe n’Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’amahanga, Nduhungirehe Olivier, Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Uganda Maj General Frank Mugambage; Minisitiri w’ubutabera akaba n’Intumwa nkuru ya Leta, Johnston Busingye, Minisitiri w’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu, Prof Shyaka Anastase, Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Urwego rw’igihugu rushinzwe Iperereza n’Umutekano, NISS, Major General Joseph Nzabamwita n’Umuyobozi Mukuru Ushinzwe Iperereza ryo hanze y’igihugu n’umutekano, Col Anaclet Kalibata. Ni mu gihe ku ruhande rwa Uganda hari Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’amahanga, Sam Kutesa, Minisitiri w’umutekano Gen. J.J Odongo Abu, Umuyobozi mu Biro bya Perezida Yoweri Museveni, Amb Joseph Ocwet, Intumwa nkuru ya Leta William Byaruhanga na Ambasaderi wa Uganda mu Rwanda Oliver Wonekha. Mu myanzuro yayo harimo ko inama ikurikiraho yo kureba aho ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’amasezerano rigeze, izaba nyuma y’iminsi 30 uhereye igihe inama ya mbere yabereye. Ubu iyo minsi imaze kurengaho ine, u Rwanda rutegereje ubutumire. Nduhungirehe kuri iki Cyumweru yabwiye IGIHE ati "Abanya-Uganda nibo bagomba gutanga ubutumire, twe ntabwo ari twe dutumira.” Bijyanye n’imyanzuro yafatiwe mu nama yabereye i Kigali, Nduhungirehe avuga "nta kintu gishya kirabaho". Mu nama ya mbere u Rwanda rwahaye Uganda urutonde rw’Abanyarwanda bafungiwe muri icyo gihugu, yemera kugenzura ayo makuru hagamijwe ko abari kuri urwo rutonde banyuzwa mu nzira zigenwa z’ubutabera, no kurekura abo bizagaragara ko nta bimenyetso bihari cyangwa ibyaha bakurikiranwaho. Ubwo buryo kandi ngo ni nabwo byari byemeranyijwe ko bugomba gukoreshwa ku baturage b’ibihugu byombi. Mu 2017 nibwo Abanyarwanda batangiye gufatwa bagakorerwa iyicarubozo, abandi bagafungwa mu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko, bashinjwa kuba intasi z’u Rwanda. Icyo kibazo cyanahuriranye n’uko ubucuruzi bw’Abanyarwanda muri Uganda bwari bukomeje kubangamirwa, ndetse Uganda igashinjwa gutera inkunga imitwe yitwaje intwaro igamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda. Ni impamvu zatumye u Rwanda rugira abaturage barwo inama yo "kutajya muri Uganda."

title: U Bwongereza bwasabye EU kongererwa igihe mbere ya Brexit
content: Icyatunguranye ni uburyo Minisitiri w’Intebe Johnson yanze gushyira umukono we kuri iyo baruwa, ahubwo iherekezwa n’ibaruwa ya kabiri noneho yasinyeho, bwo avuga ko ku ruhande rwe bwite, kongera igihe byaba ari ikosa, nk’uko BBC yabitangaje. Gusaba iki gihe Minisitiri w’Intebe Johnson yabikoreshejwe n’itegeko abadepite batoye muri Nzeri, ko agomba gusaba EU ko u Bwongereza bwagutse bwongererwa igihe cyo kwitegura kuva muri EU, igihe cyose itariki ya 19 Ukwakira yagera hataremezwa bizadusubirwaho amasezerano y’imikoranire yabwo na EU, cyangwa ngo habe hafashwe umwanzuro ko nta masezerano azabaho. Iyo baruwa hari aho igira iti “U Bwongereza bwagutse bwifuza ko icyo gihe cyarangira ku wa 21 Mutarama 2020 saa tanu z’ijoro GMT. Mu gihe impande bireba zaba zimaze kwemeranya ku masezerano mbere y’iyo tariki, Guverinoma yifuza ko icyo gihe cyarangizwa mbere y’iyo tariki.” Perezida wa Komisiyo ya EU, Donald Tusk yanditse kuri Twitter ko yakiriye ibaruwa y’ubwo busabe. Yavuze ko agiye kuvugisha abayobozi b’ibihugu bya EU, ku gisubizo gikwiye. Ibaruwa ya Johnson ivuga ko Guverinoma y’icyo gihugu igiye guhita ikurikirana ko ibigize amasezerano u Bwongereza buheruka kwemeranyaho na EU, byahita bihindurwa umushinga w’itegeko rikanatorwa, kandi ko bigomba gukorwa mbere y’itariki 31 Ukwakira, u Bwongereza bukava muri EU nyuma y’ubusabe abaturage banyujije muri Kamarampaka mu 2016. Johnson yaherukaga kuvuga ko azakora uko ashoboye kose u Bwongereza bukava muri EU bidasabye kongera kongererwa igihe, ku buryo ku bwe, yari yiteguye ko bwava muri uyu muryango nta n’amasezerano y’imikoranire yemejwe. Ni ibintu abadepite bakomeje kurwanya. Bimwe mu by’ibanze Johnson yemeranyijeho na EU mu masezerano yo gutandukana kw’impande zombi, bijya gusa n’ibyo Theresa May yasimbuye yagezeho mu mwaka ushize, uretse impinduka zigaragara ku ikoreshwa ry’umupaka wa Ireland ya Ruguru. Biteganywa ko u Bwongereza buzakomeza kugendera ku mategeko ya EU kugeza mu mpera za 2020 ndetse bishobora no kurengaho, kugira ngo ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi bihabwe umwanya uhagije wo kwitegura. U Bwongereza kandi buzishyura nibura miliyari £33 yo gutandukana na EU, ndetse uburenganzira bw’abaturage ba EU baba mu Bwongereza cyangwa ubw’Abongereza bari muri EU, buzakomeza kubahirizwa. Bimwe mu byahindutse ni ikoreshwa ry’umupaka Ireland ya Ruguru (iri mu Bwongereza bwagutse) ihuriraho na Repubulika ya Ireland (iri muri EU). Biteganywa ko nyuma ya Brexit, ari wo mupaka rukumbi uzaba uhuza u Bwongereza bwagutse na EU ukoresheje inzira y’ubutaka. Uwo mupaka uzakomeza kugendera ku mategeko agenga isoko rusange rya EU; mu gihe Ireland ya Ruguru izakomeza kugendera ku mategeko y’u Bwongereza bwagutse agenga za gasutamo, ikazagenda ininjizwa mu masezerano yose y’ubucuruzi u Bwongereza buzasinya nyuma ya Brexit. Biteganywa kandi ko komisiyo ihuriweho izemeza ibicuruzwa byemerewe kujya ku isoko rusange, u Bwongereza bukazajya bwakira imisoro yabyo mu izina rya EU.

title: Hahishuwe ko Ben Rutabana ari muri Uganda
content: Ben Rutabana usanzwe ari komiseri muri RNC ushinzwe kongera ubushobozi, ari muri Uganda aho yatangiye urugendo rwe ku wa 5 Nzeri 2019. Urugendo rwe muri Uganda rwavuzwe bwa mbere n’umuryango we mu ibaruwa yasakaye isaba ubuyobozi bwa RNC kumugarura mu muryango, ndetse umugore aza kujya kuri radio BBC yemeza ibiyikubiyemo. Nk’uko The New Times yabitangaje, amakuru avuga ko ubwo Rutabana yageraga muri Uganda yakiriwe na Dr. Sam Ruvuma, umunyamuryango ukomeye muri RNC, n’abofisiye bo mu rwego rw’iperereza rwa gisirikare muri Uganda, CMI. Gusa ku wa 8 Nzeri 2018, umuryango wa Rutabana uvuga ko utongeye kuvugana nawe. Mu kiganiro na BBC, Diane Rutabana yashimangiye ibyo we n’umuryango we banditse mu ibaruwa. Yavuze ko muramu wa Kayumba Nyamwasa, Frank Ntwari, usanzwe ari komiseri ushinzwe urubyiruko muri RNC, yari ateye inkeke umugabo we. Mu kiganiro cyo ku itariki 7 Ukwakira 2019, Diane yagize ati “Ben yambwiye ko afitanye ibibazo bikomeye na Ntwari, kandi ko yari amufitiye impungenge.” Ibaruwa yanditswe n’umuryango wa Rutabana igenewe “umuhuzabikorwa mukuru” wa RNC, Jerome Nayigiziki, igaragaza urugendo rwa Ben Rutabana guhera ava i Burayi. Ivuga ko yahagurutse ku wa Gatatu tariki 4 Nzeri 2019 n’indege ya Emirates, agana ku kibuga cy’indege cya Entebbe muri Uganda, ahagera ku wa 5 Nzeri 2019 nyuma yo guhagarara gato i Dubai. Ikomeza ivuga ko “mbere yo guhaguruka, Rutabana yabwiye umugore we, umuryango n’inshuti ze za hafi ku mpungenge afite ku mutekano we kubera ukutemeranya” na Kayumba Nyamwasa na muramu we Frank Ntwari, nk’uko ibaruwa yanditswe n’umuryango ibivuga. Byongeye, umuryango ushimangira ko urugendo rwa Rutabana “rwahuriranye” n’uko Ntwari yari muri Uganda. Amakuru ahamya koko ko Ntwali yari i Kampala hagati ya tariki 24 Kanama na 10 Nzeri. Umugore wa Rutabana avuga ko bakomeje kuvugana kuri telefoni ubwo yageraga Entebbe, kuva kuri iyo tariki (5 Nzeri) kugeza ku wa 8 Nzeri, ubwo itumanaho ryahagararaga. Uruzinduko rwa Rutabana muri Uganda ubwarwo si ikintu kidasanzwe. Ntabwo yari inshuro ya mbere Rutabana ushinzwe kongera ubushobozi muri RNC yari asuye Uganda, cyangwa ngo yakirwe n’abayobozi bagenzi be ba RNC n’ab’inzego z’iperereza rya gisirikare. Ubwo bavaga Entebbe, uwo munsi banagiye i Mbarara, amakuru akemeza ko bahuye n’abayobozi ba RNC barimo Pasiteri Deo Nyirigira n’umuhungu we Felix Mwizerwa, bari kumwe na Ruvuma n’abakozi ba CMI bajyanye kwakira Rutabana ku kibuga cy’indege, i Entebbe. Aho hari na Maj. Fred Kasimoni Mushambo, ukuriye CMI i Mbarara. Pasiteri Nyirigira n’umuhungu we Mwizerwa bakomeje kuba ku isonga mu bikorwa byo kwinjiza abarwanyi bashya muri RNC mu burengerazuba bwa Uganda, kandi bakorana bya hafi n’umuyobozi mukuru w’ibikorwa by’iterabwoba bya RNC, Kayumba Nyamwasa. The New Times ivuga ko mu icukumbura yakoze, yamenye ko ubwo Rutabana yavuganaga n’umugore we, icyo gihe yakoreshaga telefoni ya Sam Ruvuma, bari i Mbarara. Ni mbere gato y’uko Rutabana atongera kuvugisha umuryango we. Byateje igishyika mu muryango we ubwo ibyumweru byashiraga nta jwi rye barongera kumva. Amakuru ahuriza kukuba hashize igihe hari umwiryane muri RNC, hagashyirwa mu majwi agatsiko ka Nyamwasa kagizwe na we, umuvandimwe we Ntwari n’uwitwa Sande Mugisha, bahanganye na Rutabana. Amakuru ava ahantu hatandukanye agaragaza impamvu nyakuri zatumye Nyamwasa n’agatsiko ke muri RNC bijundika Rutabana. Icya mbere, Rutabana yakomeje kutumva impamvu Nyamwasa akomeje kugira ubuyobozi bwa RNC nk’akazu k’umuryango we, n’uburyo “yari akomeje kwikubira ifatwa ry’ibyemezo byose.” Rutabana kandi yakomeje kwibaza impamvu Nyamwasa akomeje gushyira Ntwari na Sande Mugisha “mu bikorwa byose bikomeye bya RNC”, mu gihe mu maso ya Rutabana, ari “abana”. Uwatanze amakuru yakomeje ati “Nyamwasa n’abahungu be banze cyane Rutabana, by’umwihariko kubera gukomeza kwibaza ku buryo Nyamwasa akoresha nabi umutungo ukwiye gufasha RNC nk’ishyaka.” Hashize igihe Nyamwasa ashinjwa n’amatsinda atandukanye ya RNC binyuze kuri internet, kunyereza umutungo w’ishyaka ryabo. Bivugwa ko amafaranga ya RNC yaba akomeje kuyashora mu bikorwa bye bwite muri Pretoria, na Maputo muri Mozambique. Ibintu byarushijeho kuba bibi hagati ya Rutabana n’agatsiko ka Nyamwasa. Uwo yaje gutera ubwoba Rutabana ko “azatabwa muri yombi umunsi yongeye gukandagiza ikirenge muri Uganda,” nk’uko ibaruwa y’umuryango we ibigaragaza. Umugore wa Rutabana agaruka ku bintu byihariye mu kiganiro na BBC, kimwe no mu ibaruwa. Ati “Ntabwo iterabwoba ryabo bakirigira ibanga! Babivuga ku mugaragaro ntacyo bahisha.” Nubwo hari izo mpungenge zose, Rutabana yabirenzeho ajya muri Uganda. Amakuru avuga ko yari akigendera ku cyizere cyo kuba yari amenyereye muri Uganda, kandi yafatwaga neza na Guverinoma y’icyo gihugu kimwe n’inzego z’umutekano zacyo, yibwira ko ibintu birakomeza kuba nk’ibisanzwe. Ntabwo ari ibanga ko Kampala itera inkunga ibikorwa bya RNC. Harimo ubufasha mu kwinjiza abanyamuryango bashya bigizwemo uruhare na CMI cyangwa ISO (Urwego rw’iperereza ry’imbere mu gihugu); ndetse abayobozi ba RNC bakirizwa yombi mu gihugu, nka Charlotte Mukankusi, Eugene Gasana na Tribert Rujugiro. Rutabana yari muri Uganda no muri Nzeri umwaka ushize nk”umushyitsi udasanzwe” w’umuyobozi wa ISO, Col. (Rtd) Kaka Bagyenda. Rutabana yahawe icyubahiro gihabwa umushyitsi w’icyubahiro w’igihugu, nk’uko amakuru abihamya. Su-Liyetona Jack Erasmus Nsangiranabo, umukozi wa ISO ni we wari ushinzwe kumwitaho. Amakuru ajyanye n’urugendo avuga ko Rutabana yari muri Uganda ngo yirebere ibikorwa byo kwinjiza abarwanyi bashya mu bikorwa by’iterabwoba. Nta wundi utari Maj. Fred Kasimoni Mushambo, umuyobozi ushinzwe ubutasi muri Diviziyo ya kabiri ya UPDF muri Mbarara, ubwe wamufashe akamujyana gusura ibyo bikorwa, ngo ahure n’abakimara kwinjizwa muri RNC, abatere imbaraga anabashishikarize gukomeza gushaka abandi. Mu bashinzwe iperereza muri Uganda RNC ifitemo ijambo rikomeye, nk’uko bigaragazwa n’urugero rwo mu Ukuboza 2017, ubwo polisi ya Uganda ahitwa Kikagati- ku mupaka wa Tanzania- yafataga abanyarwanda 46 bagenderaga ku mpapuro mpimbano. Inzego zishinzwe abinjira n’abasohoka zagize amakenga ubwo itsinda rigari, riri mu modoka imwe, ryerekanye ibyangombwa rivuga ko bagiye mu Burundi mu bijyanye n’iyobokamana. Mu gukomeza kubazwa, baje kwemera ko bagiye mu myitozo ya RNC mu nkambi za Minembwe muri Kivu y’amajyepfo, muri Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo. Polisi ya Uganda yari itarinjira mu bikorwa byo kubangamira umutekano w’u Rwanda, inzego z’umutekano zisesengura icyo kibazo. Polisi yanzuye ko bagomba gutabwa muri yombi. Nk’uko abakozi b’urwego rw’abinjira n’abasohoka babitangaje, polisi yavugaga ko bose bagomba gufatwa, ariko umuntu umwe byaje kumenyekana ko ari Captain Charles Byaruhanga ukorera CMI, aza kutabyumva kimwe n’abashinzwe umutekano. Yavugaga ko bakwiye kureka abo barwanyi bagakomeza. Yaje kuvugira hejuru ati “Amategeko aturutse hejuru ni uko aba bantu bagomba kwemererwa gukomeza urugendo!” Polisi yaratsimbaraye irabafata, kimwe na Dr Ruvuma wari wagerageje gucika. Byaje gutangazwa ko Ruvuma na Felix Mwizerwa aribo bashakishije abo bantu bafatanyije na CMI, babafasha kubona impapuro mpimbano z’inzira. Polisi yarabafunze ndetse ibakorera dosiye bashinjwa ibyaha by’iterabwoba. Ruvuma yaje gufungirwa muri gereza ya Nalufenya. Nyamara nubwo abapolisi bakoraga akazi kabo, abantu bamwe mu nzego zo hejuru bari bahugiye mu kugatesha agaciro. Umuyobozi wa CMI, Brig. Abel Kandiho ari nawe wakomeje gutanga “amategeko aturutse hejuru” yo kureka abo basore bagakomeza (hatitawe ku byangombwa by’ibihimbano), yari akomeje gukora ibishoboka ngo abafashwe bose barekurwe. Kubijyanye na Ruvuma, byaje kujya ahabona ko “itegeko riturutse hejuru” ryatumye ahita arekurwa. Nyuma gato, abari bafashwe bose bararekuwe, bakomeza urugendo bagana i Minembwe. Nta gushidikanya ko Rutabana ari muri Uganda: uburyo asanzwe ahasura, ubuhamya bw’umugore we n’uburyo bavuganye ari muri icyo gihugu n’uburyo yakiriwe n’abayobozi ba RNC barimo Sam Ruvuma n’abakozi ba CMI ku kibuga cy’indege n’i Mbarara. Ndetse no kugerageza kujijisha kw’abayobozi ba RNC nka Gervais Condo, “umunyamabanga mukuru w’iri tsinda”, ubwabyo bigaragaza ko Rutabana ari muri Uganda. Condo yagiye arya indimi, akavugira hejuru nta bisubizo afite ubwo radiyo BBC yamubazaga mu kiganiro bagiranye. Uwamubazaga ati “Uravuga ko utazi aho ari, ariko RNC yamwakiriye muri Uganda, hamwe n’abanya-Uganda?” Condo ntiyabihakanye. Ahubwo yakomezaga asubiramo ati “bamubonye mu karere.” Kuba Rutabana ari muri Uganda ni ikindi kimenyetso cy’uburyo icyo gihugu gikomeje kurenga ku masezerano yasinyiwe i Luanda muri Angola hagati y’u Rwanda na Uganda, ateganya ibirimo ko impande zombi zigomba “guhagarika ibikorwa byose bihungabanya ikindi gihugu,”

title: Amashyushyu ni yose! Intebe enye muri Guverinoma zitegereje abazicazwamo
content: Kuba hari imyanya ine yose muri guverinoma itegereje gushyirwamo abayobozi bashya, hanze aha amatsiko ni yose! Yaba ku baturage basanzwe, cyane bamwe baba bakurikiranira hafi politiki yo mu gihugu, byagera ku bakozi ba leta ndetse n’abandi biyumvamo ubushobozi bwo kuba babasha kwitwara neza muri iriya myanya ho bikaba akarusho. Buri gihe iyo hategerejwe impinduka muri Guverinoma, buri wese ushoboye aba ategereje n’amatsiko menshi kumva ko izina rye ryaba riri mubo Umukuru w’Igihugu yaba yagiriye icyizere. Bamwe muri aba usanga basanzwe mu myanya ya leta ariko bahora bashakisha uko babona amanota meza, bityo bakaba bazamurwa mu ntera. Abandi usanga ari bamwe baba bamaze igihe ku gatebe, mu bihe nk’ibi ugasanga barwaye ibicuro bikeka ko baba bari bugarurwe mu kazi, hari n’abandi baba batarigeze bakora muri leta ariko baba biyumvamo inyota yo gukorera igihugu mu myanya y’ubuyobozi nk’iriya, nabo ni benshi. Ku bemeramana bayobotse amadini y’abanyamwuka bo biba ari ibindi bindi muri ibi bihe. Abo Pasiteri yahanuriye ko bazaba ba Minisitiri, Umunyamabanga wa Leta cyangwa Umunyamabanga Uhoraho muri minisiteri runaka baba biteguye kuririmba ya makorasi ya ‘Yari yarabitubwiye, yari yarabivuze’, iyo bitabaye kuri iyi nshuro, bitabaza izivuga ngo ‘bitinde bitebuke’ cyangwa za ‘ntibeshya’ ntiziba ziva mu kanwa. Ubu ni ko bimeze rero kuko hari imyanya ine ikeneye abakozi muri Guverinoma. Abantu batekereza kuri aka kazi mu buryo bwinshi, yaba koko kujya gukorera igihugu muri iyi myanya yo hejuru cyangwa se kuryoherwa n’icyubahiro itanga n’ibijyana nacyo. Hari uhita atangira kubara muri ubu buryo, akareba ibigenerwa abanyapolitiki bari mu cyiciro cya D mu bijyanye n’amikoro. Ku batabizi, icyiciro cya D kibarizwamo ba Minisitiri, Abanyamabanga ba Leta, abandi bagize Guverinoma, Umuyobozi w’Umujyi wa Kigali na ba Guverineri. Abaminisitiri n’abandi bagize Guverinoma bashobora gushyirwaho na Perezida wa Repubulika bagenerwa buri wese umushahara mbumbe w’umurimo buri kwezi ungana na 2.534.861 Frw. Ubu wasanga hari abatangiye kuyatera imirwi, ibicuro byababanye byinshi mu biganza! Bagenerwa kandi amafaranga y’icumbi angana na 500 000 Frw buri kwezi, ayo kwakira abashyitsi 300 000 Frw, itumanaho ryo mu biro 100 000 Frw. Banagenerwa kandi internet ngendanwa ya 40 000 Frw buri kwezi, itumanaho rya telefoni ngendanwa 150 000 Frw n’amafaranga yo kugura ibikoresho byo mu nzu angana na 5 000 000 Frw atangwa rimwe, n’uburinzi. Kera bwo banagenerwaga imodoka zimwe dukunze kwita V8 ariko ubu siko bikimeze kuko bahabwa inguzanyo bakazazishyura. Ni nde uri bwinjizwe muri Minispoc, Minaloc, Mininfra na Migeprof? Guverinoma y’u Rwanda muri iyi minsi ifite imyanya ine yari isanzwemo abakozi harimo batatu bo ku rwego rwa Minisitiri ariko batakirimo kubera izindi nshingano. Aho harimo nka Minisitiri w’Umuco na Siporo aho Nyirasafari Espérance wari uri muri uyu mwanya yagizwe Umusenateri; Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu ushinzwe Imibereho Myiza y’Abaturage ugomba gusimbura Dr Alvera Mukabaramba nawe wagizwe Umusenateri. Hari kandi Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ibikorwaremezo ushinzwe Gutwara Abantu n’Ibintu ugomba gusimbura Uwihanganye Jean de Dieu wagizwe Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Singapore, n’Umunyamabanga Uhoraho muri Migeprof ugomba gusimbura Umutoni Gatsinzi Nadine watorewe kuba Umuyobozi wungirije w’Umujyi wa Kigali. Iyi yose ni imyanya idahatanirwa kuko Umukuru w’Igihugu abigiriwemo inama na Minisitiri w’Intebe, areba ubushobozi bw’abanyarwanda bose, agahitamo umwe aha inshingano mu mwanya runaka. Uretse ko nta n’uwakwirengagiza ko hari ubwo, bitewe n’icyerekezo igihugu gifite, hari igihe umwanya runaka udahita uhabwa umuyobozi, igihe bigaragara ko inshingano ze zishobora gukorwa n’izindi nzego kandi umuvuduko igihugu kiriho ntuhungabane. Hari benshi baba bishyize mu myanya rero n’ababa bavugira mu matamatama bibaza uzicazwa muri iyo ntebe mu gihe kitazwi, abandi nabo bari kuhanya ngo barebe ko baterwa iteka. Nubwo hatajya havugwa ibyagendeweho, icyerekezo cy’igihugu kirigaragaza. Perezida Kagame yavuze ko iyi manda izaba umwihariko ku rubyiruko, bikanakubitana n’uko u Rwanda rwimakaza ihame ry’uburinganire aho abagore badahezwa na mba; bisobanuye ko dushobora kubona iyi myanya yose ihawe nk’abagore tugakomeza kwesa imihigo. Kuri ubu muri Guverinoma y’u Rwanda, Abaminisitiri b’abagore bari ku kigero cya 58%, ni icyerekezo gishimwa n’Isi. Uburyo abayobozi bashyirwa mu myanya muri leta, akenshi biratungurana. Kugera ku munota wa nyuma usanga ari ibintu byakozwe mu bwiru ku buryo biba bizwi n’Umukuru w’Igihugu na Minisitiri w’Intebe, ibi ni nako bigenda mu gihe abayobozi bagiye gukurwa ku myanya. Guverinoma y’uyu munsi yuzuyemo amasura mashya Impinduka muri Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ni ibintu bimaze kumenyerwa, isaha iyo ariyo yose buri wese aba yiteze ko hashobora kumenyekana amakuru mashya amuvugaho ko yasimbuwe cyangwa se ko yahawe indi mirimo. Ni impinduka zitangazwa binyuze mu iteka rya Perezida wa Repubulika. Nka Guverinoma yariho mu mpera za manda ya kabiri ya Perezida wa Repubulika mu 2017, ubu urebye amasura yabo, abenshi twamaze kubibagirwa mu ruhando rwa politiki kuko ubu basigaye bakora ibindi, abandi bayobotse iy’ishuri kugira ngo bakarishye ubwenge. Batandatu, ni wo mubare w’abaminisitiri bari muri Guverinoma uyu munsi bari bayirimo mu mpera za manda ya Perezida Kagame mu 2017; naho 11 nibo ba Minisitiri batakiri muri Guverinoma Perezida Kagame yatangiranye iyi manda. Barindwi bari abanyamabanga ba leta [manda ya Perezida Kagame itangira mu 2017] nabo ntibakiri muri iyi myanya, gusa muri bo babiri bazamuwe mu ntera bagirwa abaminisitiri. Batatu niwo mubare w’abavuye muri Guverinoma yatangajwe na Perezida wa Repubulika mu Ukwakira 2018 biyongeraho Umunyamabanga Uhoraho umwe wahinduriwe inshingano. Nubwo ari imyanya ine itarimo abayobozi, nta kibujije ko n’abasanzwe bari muri Guverinoma harimo abashobora kuba basimburwa, yewe nta n’uzi isaha n’umunsi izi mpinduka zizabera, bizwi n’Umukuru w’Igihugu wenyine. Ku bafite ibicuro, amahirwe masa!

title: Rurageretse hagati y’umugore wa Ben Rutabana n’abayobozi ba RNC
content: Ni ubwa mbere Diane Rutabana yumvikanye ubwe asaba ubuyobozi bwa RNC kwerekwa aho umugabo we ari kuko abashinja kumenya aho aherereye, mu gihe abagize uwo mutwe banyuranya mu mashyi no mu mudiho ku irengero rye. Kubura kwa Rutabana kwaciye igikuba mu muryango we no mu batavuga rumwe na Leta baba hanze y’u Rwanda, nyamara RNC yo ukurikije uko yitwaye muri icyo kibazo isa n’itabyitayeho cyangwa se ifite andi makuru yihariye ku ishimutwa ry’umwambari wayo idashaka gutanga. Bamwe mu bazi neza imikorere ya RNC nka Noble Marara wakoranaga na Nsabimana Callixte uzwi nka Sankara, bavuze ko Rutabana yashimuswe na Kayumba Nyamwasa ndetse ko ari gukorerwa iyicarubozo n’abambari be. Kuwa 2 Ukwakira 2019 nibwo umuryango wa Ben Rutabana, umuririmbyi akaba na Komiseri ushinzwe amahugurwa muri RNC wandikiye Umuhuzabikorwa wa RNC, Jerome Nayigiziki bamusaba gusobanura izimira ry’umunyamuryango wabo. Mu ibaruwa, abo mu muryango wa Rutabana bavuze ko yahagurutse i Bruxelles ku wa Gatatu tariki 4 Nzeri 2019 saa 21:45 n’indege ya Emirates Airlines, agana Entebbe muri Uganda. Yabanje guhagarara i Dubai mbere yo kugera ku kibuga cy’indege cya Entebbe ku wa 5 Nzeri saa 13:50. Yakomeje kuvugana kuri telefoni n’umugore we Diane Rutabana hagati y’itariki 5-8 Nzeri, nyuma ntiyongera kumva ijwi rye. Rutabana ngo yagombaga gusubira mu Bubiligi ku wa 19 Nzeri nabwo akoresheje Emirates Airlines, ariko baramutegereje baraheba. Uwo muryango uvuga ko wakiriye amakuru ko Rutabana afunzwe mu buryo butemewe n’abarwanyi b’umutwe ukorere muri Repubulika Iharnira Demokarasi ya Congo witwa RUD Urunana, biturutse kuri Major Faustin Ntilikina; General Jean Michel Afurika bahoze mu buyobozi bw’uwo mutwe na Frank Ntwali muramu wa Kayumba Nyamwasa. Mu kiganiro Diane Rutabana yahaye BBC, yavuze ko aherutse guhamagarwa n’umuntu, akamumenyesha ko yatumwe na Kayumba Nyamwasa ngo amuhumurize. Uyu mugore yavuze ko yagiye ahabwa amakuru atandukanye, bamwe mu bagize RNC bakamubwira ko umugabo we ameze neza mu gihe abandi bamubwira ko batazi aho ari. Ati “Nyuma nabazaga bamwe bakambwira ngo ni ikibazo cy’umutekano ariko aho ari bazi ko ameze neza. Ayo ni amakuru nahawe n’abantu bane bo muri RNC. Bucyeye bwaho undi wo muri RNC arampamagara arambwira ngo yatumwe n’uwo muyobozi wabo ngo ’Kayumba yambwiye ngo nkuvugishe nguhumurize". Nyamara ibyo bihabanye n’ibyatangajwe n’umuhuzabikorwa wa RNC, Jerome Nayigiziki uherutse kwandika ibaruwa, agaragaza ko nabo batazi aho Ben Rutabana aherereye, ndetse bashishikariza umuryango we kwitabaza ibihugu Rutabana afitiye ubwenegihugu bikabafasha. Muri iyo baruwa, Nayigiziki yagize ati “Aho mugenzi wacu yaba yaragiye cyangwa ari, ntabwo yahagurutse agiye mu rugendo cyangwa mu butumwa yahawe n’ubuyobozi bw’Ihuriro nyarwanda nkuriye.” Diane Rutabana yumvikanishije ko RNC ishobora kuba iri inyuma y’izimira ry’umugabo we kuko na mbere yo guhaguruka mu Bubiligi ngo yari yarabwiwe ko nasubira muri Uganda azafungwa. Ibyo kandi Diane abishingira ku makimbirane umugabo we yari afitanye na muramu wa Kayumba Nyamwasa ushinzwe ubukangurambaga muri RNC witwa Frank Ntwali. Yagize ati “ Abo ni abantu bo muri RNC babivuze kandi ntabwo babivuze mu ibanga”. Uyu mugore yemeza neza ko RNC izi aho umugabo we ari, agasaba ko agaragazwa mu maguru mashya. Rutabana yari afitanye ubwumvikane buke na Kayumba Nyamwasa, bashinjanya ko Kayumba ashaka kwiyegereza abo bafitanye isano, ndetse ngo Rutabana yababajwe n’abantu bafatiwe muri Congo mu mutwe wa P5 uyoborwa na Kayumba, ubu bari mu nkiko mu Rwanda. Rutabana ngo yarakajwe n’uko inama ze zitubahirijwe kuko bajya gufatwa yari yababuriye. Ngo Kayumba yahaye itegeko Major Habib Mudathiru wari uyoboye izo ngabo kubavana muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo bakajya ku mupaka wa Uganda, aho bazahabwa inkunga zihagije kurusha izo bahabwaga hafi y’u Burundi. Uburakari bwa Rutabana agashaka kwaka ibisobanuro Kayumba wagushije ingabo zabo mu biganza by’uwo bahanganye, ngo byaba impamvu yatumye ashaka ‘kumwumvisha’ kuko umusirikare muto yari ashatse kubaza byinshi ‘Jenerali’, ndetse bikekwa ko ubwo Rutabana yajyaga muri Uganda yari agiye mu bikorwa bya gisirikare, arenze ku gushaka kwa Kayumba. Amakuru atandukanye ari kunyuzwa ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ariko adafitiwe gihamya, ari kuvuga ko Ben Rutabana yaba yariciwe muri Congo aciwe umutwe. Ngo yaba yicishijwe ku kagambane ka Kayumba ngo atazamena amabanga y’uwo mutwe na Uganda dore ko yari atangiye gushwana nabo. Noble Marara aherutse gutangaza ko Kayumba Nyamwasa afite uruhare runini mu ibura rya Rutabana. Marara yavuze ko Kayumba ari umwe mu babangamiye bikomeye abatavuga rumwe na Leta y’u Rwanda baba hanze kuko abahozamo umwiryane kubera icyenewabo, ku buryo asanga ntacyo bazageraho. Rutabana yakunze kugenda muri Uganda kimwe na bagenzi be bo muri RNC nta nkomyi, ari mu bikorwa bya RNC byo gushaka ubushobozi n’abayoboke, abifashijwemo n’inzego zirimo urushinzwe ubutasi bwa gisirikare, CMI n’urw’iperereza ry’imbere mu gihugu, ISO. Bivugwa ko ifatwa rye ryagizwemo uruhare na CMI atanzwe na Frank Ntwali, muramu wa Kayumba.

title: Murangwa Hadidja yatowe nk’umusenateri uhagararariye imitwe ya politiki
content: Murangwa asimbuye Uwamurera Salama wari watowe mu minsi ishize urukiko rw’ikirenga rukanga kumwemeza kubera ko ubunararibonye afite butamwemerera kujya muri uwo mwanya. Amatora yo gusimbura Uwamurera yabaye kuri uyu wa Kane ku cyicaro cy’Ihuriro ry’Imitwe ya Politiki yemewe mu Rwanda giherereye ku Kacyiru. Hiyamamaje abakandida batatu, hatorwa Murangwa Hadidja wo muri PDI ku majwi 32, Athanase Nahimana wa PS Imberakuri yagize amajwi ane  naho  Masozera Icyizanye Jacky wa Democratic Green Party of Rwanda agira  amajwi 7, n’impfabusa  imwe. Perezida wa PDI Harerimana Fazil yashimiye abahagarariye imitwe ya Politiki bagiriye icyizere ishyaka ayoboye. Ashingiye ku bunararibonye bwe, yavuze ko Hadidja  azafatanya n’abandi neza muri Sena. Ati “Twakiriye neza icyizere abahagarariye amashyaka baduhaye,  turabashimira kandi tubizeza ko tuzakomeza gushaka abakandida beza igihe cyose bizaba bikenewe”. Umuyobozi w’ihuriro ry’imitwe ya Politiki, Mukabunani yavuze ko bujuje inshingano zabo, ko we azamezwa n’urukiko rw’ikirenga. Kandi avuga ko kuba barasabwe gutora undi mukandida nta kibazo ahubwo byemeza ko buri rwego ruba rwakoze inshingano zarwo. Ati “Abanyarwanda bumve ko inzego zifite uko zikora, kuba twasubiyemo amatora ntabwo ari igitangaza ni uko gusa buri rwego ruba rwakoze inshingano zarwo.” Murangwa  Ndangiza Hadija ni inzobere mu bijyanye n’imisoro akaba n’umunyamategeko mu bijyanye n’imisoro. Ni umwe mu bagize inama y’ubutegetsi muri Banki Nkuru y’Igihugu, BNR. Ni umunyamuryango w’Ikigo Mpuzamahanga cy’Ubukemurampaka cya Kigali (KIAC). Yakoze mu mishinga itandukanye yiga ku misoro n’ubucuruzi yabaga ihuriweho n’imiryango mpuzamahanga ndetse na Guverinoma y’u Rwanda. Yakoze akazi k’ubujyanama mu bigo mpuzamahanga nka International Finance Corporation (IFC ), Umushinga wo guhuza imisoro muri EAC n’ibindi. Kuri ubu yakoraga nk’impuguke ishinzwe igenamigambi n’iterambere ry’ikigo mu kigo cy’ababaruramari b’umwuga mu Rwanda,  (ICPAR). Yagiye mu nama z’ubutegetsi z’ibigo bitandukanye mu Rwanda nko muri Banki Itsura Amajyambere (BRD),  Ishami rishinzwe ubuvuzi mu gisikare (MMI) no mu Kigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Ubuzima (RBC). Murangwa asanze Nkusi Juvenal w’ishyaka PSD, wamaze gutorerwa guhagararira Ihuriro ry’imitwe ya Politiki muri Sena.

title: Uko u Burundi na Uganda byafashije Kayumba Nyamwasa kurema umutwe wa gisirikare muri RDC
content:
Abo bantu biganjemo abanyarwanda, bayobowe na Rtd Maj Habib Mudathiru, bakurikiranyweho ubufatanyacyaha mu kwinjira mu mutwe w’ingabo utari ingabo zemewe n’igihugu; ubugambanyi mu cyaha cyo kugirira nabi ubutegetsi buriho, kugirana umubano n’izindi nzego za leta zo mu mahanga hagambiriwe gushoza intambara no kurema umutwe w’abagizi ba nabi. Ibyaha bashinjwa n’ubushinjacyaha, bigaragaza neza uruhare ibihugu by’u Burundi na Uganda byagize mu ishingwa ry’umutwe wa gisirikare ushamikiye ku ihuriro P5 rigizwe n’amashyaka atemewe mu Rwanda nka RNC, FDU Inkingi, PDP Imanzi, PS Imberakuri na Amahoro People’s Congress. Ibyo ubushinjacyaha bwagaragaje bihuye n’ibyatangajwe n’impuguke za Loni mu mpera z’umwaka ushize, ubwo zasohoraga raporo igaragaza ko muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo hari umutwe w’inyeshyamba wa Kayumba Nyamwasa ugamije guhungabanya umutekano mu Rwanda. Iyo raporo yavugaga ko Kayumba Nyamwasa afite umutwe w’inyeshyamba zikorera mu misozi ya Fizi na Uvira muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo. Uwo mutwe ugizwe n’abagera kuri 400, uyobowe na Shaka Nyamusaraba wahoze ayoboye inyeshyamba za Gomino, ukaba ukoresha  intwaro  ziturutse mu Burundi n’ubundi bufasha bavana muri Uganda. Kayumba yafashijwe gushinga umutwe w’inyeshyamba
 Umushinjacyaha yavuze ko Rtd Major Habib Mudathiru yahunze u Rwanda akajya muri Uganda, agezeyo ahurirayo  n’uwitwa Maj Robert Higiro wahoze mu ngabo z’u Rwanda akaba umwe mu bagize RNC, amugira inama yo gushaka ibyangombwa by’impunzi kugira ngo abone umutekano. Ngo ibyangombwa yarabishatse ku manyanga arabibona, ajyanwa kuba mu nkambi y’impunzi iri mu gace ka Arua. Higiro yaje kugaruka guhura na Mudathiru, amubwira ko yavuganye na Kayumba Nyamwasa uyobora RNC, akamubwira ko bagiye kubaka igisirikare ndetse bamaze kubona ibirindiro muri RDC. Higiro yafashe Mudathiru amuhuza na Capt Bagumya Apollo muramu wa Kayumba Nyamwasa. Yamuhuje kandi n’uwitwa Sunday Charles (uyu raporo ya Loni yagaragaje ko ari we washakiraga abarwanyi umutwe wa Kayumba ari i Bujumbura) yazanye na Sibo Charles wahoze ari Capt muri RDF. Bamaze kunoza umugambi, mu 2017 Sibo Charles na Mudathiru batorotse inkambi bagera i Mbarara, bahita bafashwa n’Urwego rw’Iperereza rwa Uganda ngo bagere i Burundi banyuze muri Tanzania, bafashijwe na Capt Johnson ukorera urwego rushinzwe ubutasi mu gisirikare cya Uganda (CMI) , wabashyize mu modoka afite n’imbunda, bagera ku mupaka wa Tanzania banyuze Kikagati. Berekeje i Bujumbura barindiwe umutekano, babagejeje i Bujumbura babaha icumbi muri Hotel Transit, ari naho hacumbikirwaga abantu benshi bajya muri RNC. Nyuma ngo Kayumba Nyamwasa yahamagaye Sibo Charles na Major Mudathiru kuri Skype, ababwira ko mu mwanya babonana n’abayobozi ba Gisirikare mu Burundi, ati  “Muvugane bikeya kuko ibyinshi twarabirangije." Ngo yababwiye ko bahabwa imbunda n’amasasu, bakerekwa inzira yo gucishamo abasirikare bato b’Abanyarwanda bari i Burundi, n’inzira yo kunyuzamo abarwayi igihe badashoboye kuvurirwa mu nkambi. Ni nako byagenze kuko mu kanya gato bahuye na  Colonel Ignace Sibomana na Major Bertin bari kumwe na Colonel Nyamusaraba, Umunyamulenge uyobora umutwe witwara gisirikare wa Ngomino ari na we wahawe kuyobora ingabo za Kayumba. Mu kiganiro bagiranye, ngo bemeranyije ko imyitozo ya P5 igizwe ahanini n’abanyarwanda, bazajya bakora imyitozo biyitiriye Ngomino ya Col Nyamusaraba, mu gihe bazaba babaye benshi bakazabona kujya mu nkambi yabo. Nyuma y’icyumweru kimwe iyo nama ibaye, ngo Colonel Sibomana na Maj Bertin, bahaye imodoka n’uburinzi igikundi cya Major Mudathiru n’abasirikare bato bari kumwe, babageza ku kiyaga cya Tanganyika, bambukira mu bwato bagera muri RDC. Bagezeyo baje kwakirwa n’abandi basanzweyo. Mbere yo kwinjira muri RDC,  ngo bahawe imbunda zo mu bwoko bwa SMG 13, LMG 3, MMG 1 n’ibikarito by’amasasu ya SMG 4, na sheni z’amasasu ya NMG 3. Umushinjacyaha yavuze ko nyuma yo gushinga P5, Kayumba yaje kugira Colonel Nyamusaraba umuyobozi w’ibikorwa byose, yungirizwa na Sibo Charles, Habib Mudathiru ashingwa ibikorwa n’imyitozo, Semahurunguru ashingwa iperereza na Politiki, uwitwa Richard ashingwa ubutegetsi n’ibikoresho, Olivier ashingwa imari. Nyuma ngo Kayumba yahamagaye Mudathiru  kuri telefoni ikoresha icyogajuru, amusaba ko batekereza uko bahindura aho bakorera, ashaka ko bava  muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo bakajya  ku mupaka wa Uganda, kuko babonaga u Burundi butabaha inkunga ihagije, ariko ngo muri Uganda babonaga ishobora kuba nyinshi. Muri uwo mugambi, mu mafaranga bakoresheje, amadolari  12000 yoherejwe na Ben Rutabana kuri Western Union i Bujumbura, Richard ajya kuyabikuza. Muri Gicurasi uyu mwaka niho ba barwanyi ba Kayumba bimutse, bageze Kalehe baza guhura n’umutwe wa MRCD iyoborwa na Gen Irategeka Wilson, bababwira ko ngo bo batangiye akazi muri Nyungwe. Bamaze kuruhuka ngo bakomeje urugendo "rutabahiriye na gatoya," kuko bageze muri Gatoyi i Masisi, bahuye n’ibico byinshi by’ingabo za Congo,  FARDC, bararaswa, aribwo bamwe bafatwaga abandi bishyikiriza  ingabo za Loni ziri mu Burasirazuba bwa Congo, Monusco. Umushinjacyaha yavuze ko abashoboye kurokoka bagiye bamanika amaboko ku matariki atandukanye, kugeza ubwo Leta ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo yabashyikirije u Rwanda. Ubuhamya ubushinjacyaha bwagaragaje, bushingiye ku iperereza bwakoze n’inyandiko mvugo z’abashinjwa ibyaha. Ibyagaragajwe bihura n’ibya raporo y’impuguke za Loni, kuko nayo ivuga ko intwaro, ibiryo, imiti n’imyambaro byose  uwo mutwe wakoreshaga  bituruka  i Burundi. Raporo ivuga ko uwo mutwe wari waragabanyijwemo batayo eshatu,  iyitwa Alpha, Bravo na  Delta, buri imwe ikaba igizwe n’abarwanyi basaga  120.

title: Urukiko rw’Ikirenga rwanze Uwamurera Salama wari uherutse gutorerwa kuba umusenateri
content: Urukiko rw’Ikirenga rwagaragaje ko Uwamurera nta bunararibonye afite bwo kuba umusenateri. Umuvugizi Ihuriro ry’Imitwe ya Politiki yemewe mu Rwanda, Depite Mukabunani Christine yabwiye IGIHE ko bandikiwe bamenyeshwa ko Uwamurera atemerewe kuba umusenateri. Yagize ati “Yego nibyo. [Bamwanze] kuko adafite ubunararibonye buhagije. Igikurikiraho ni ugutora undi, turi gutegura inama ejo bundi kuwa Kane.” Kuwa 19 Nzeri nibwo Ihuriro ry’Imitwe ya Politiki mu Rwanda  ryatoye Nkusi Juvénal wo mu Ishyaka riharanira Demokarasi n’Imibereho Myiza y’Abaturage (PSD) na Uwamurera Salama wo mu Ishyaka Ntangarugero muri Politiki (PDI) nk’abazarihagararira muri Sena. Uwamurera asanzwe ari Umunyamabanga wa PDI yakoze imirimo itandukanye mu Karere ka Rusizi mu gihe cy’imyaka icumi. IGIHE yabajije Mukabunani impamvu batoye Uwamurera batabanje kureba ko afite ubunararibonye buhagije, asubiza ati “Urukiko bo bafite ubushobozi burenze ubwacu, ni nayo mpamvu tuboherereza dosiye ngo bayisuzume. Twe  turatora dukurikije uko ishyaka ryamwamamaje, hanyuma urukiko tukarusaba ngo rumwemeze. Ubwo rero mu bushishozi bwabo nyine ni uko babibonye.” Yavuze ko nta gikuba cyacitse kuko urukiko rw’Ikirenga rwakoze akazi karwo. Mukabunani yavuze ko mu matora yo gushaka usimbura Uwamurera, amashyaka yose agize Ihuriro afite uburenganzira bwo gutanga umukandida, ko atari itegeko ko undi azava muri PDI. Ingingo ya 107 y’Itegeko Ngenga rigenga amatora ivuga ko kugira ngo umuntu atorerwe kuba cyangwa agirwe Umusenateri, agomba kuba ari Umunyarwanda w’indakemwa kandi w’inararibonye; kuba  afite nibura impamyabumenyi ihanitse cyangwa ihwanye na yo cyangwa yarakoze imirimo yo mu rwego rwo hejuru muri Leta cyangwa mu bikorera. Agomba kandi  kuba atarambuwe n’inkiko uburenganzira mbonezamubano n’ubwa politiki; kuba afite nibura imyaka mirongo ine  y’amavuko; kuba atarakatiwe ku buryo budasubirwaho igihano cy’iremezo kingana cyangwa kirenze amezi atandatu   kitahanaguweho n’imbabazi z’itegeko cyangwa ihanagurwabusembwa.

title: Umwiryane, gucikamo ibice n’umuvumba w’amarira; ibyaranze imyaka 8 RNC imaze ishinzwe
content: Imvo n’imvano y’Imiborogo no gucikamo ibice muri RNC.  Museveni, Papa mushya muri batisimu w’abarwanya u Rwanda.  RNC mu runana na Chieftency of Military Intelligence ya Uganda mu gukorera iyicarubozo Abanyarwanda.  Impamvu Rudasingwa yatutse Kayumba kuri nyina!  FARDC yasongeye RNC mu mashyamba ya Congo. RNC abayishinze bavugaga ko ari ihuriro ry’abanyarwanda rigamije impinduka mu Rwanda binyuze mu nzira z’amahoro. Ujya gushingwa, wari urangajwe imbere n’abagabo bane, bose bafite ikintu kimwe cyangwa bibiri bahuriyeho. Théogène Rudasingwa, Kayumba Nyamwasa, Gérald Gahima, na Patrick Karegeya nibo bari ku ruhembe rw’ishingwa rya RNC mu 2010, umugambi wabo bawunogereza muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, batangira ibikorwa ubwo. Mu bandi harimo kandi nka Jérôme Nayigiziki, Gervais Condo, Jonathan Musonera, Joseph Ngarambe, Dr. Emmanuel Hakizimana na Jean Paul Turayishimye. Iri huriro ryabo baritangirije mu Mujyi wa Bethesda muri Leta ya Maryland, aho bari bihaye intego yo “kuzana impinduka za politiki mu Rwanda” nk’uko bigaragara mu mahame remezo n’imirongo ngenderwaho bari biyemeje icyo gihe iganisha ku cyo bitaga “u Rwanda rushya”. Icyita rusange ku bashinze RNC Bane mu bari ku isonga ry’abashinze RNC bose babaye mu buyobozi bukuru bw’u Rwanda, babuvamo ku mpamvu zinyuranye, buri wese azinga utwangushye agana iy’ubuhunzi. Kayumba Nyamwasa yigeze kuba Umugaba Mukuru w’Ingabo, Théogène Rudasingwa yabaye Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’Umuyobozi mu Biro bya Perezida wa Repubulika; Gérald Gerald yabaye Umushinjacyaha Mukuru  ndetse n’Intumwa Nkuru ya Leta na Patrick Karegeya wigeze gushingwa ubutasi mu gisirikare. Bashinze uyu mutwe batanguranwa n’igihe kugira ngo bajijishe amahanga bikinze inyuma y’ishusho y’abatavuga rumwe na Leta, kuko u Rwanda rwari ruri kubakurikirana ku byaha bitandukanye. Mu 2011, Urukiko rwa Gisirikare rwakatiye Kayumba na Rudasingwa igifungo cy’imyaka 24 no kwamburwa impeta za gisirikare. Gahima na Patrick Karegeya bo bahanishwa igifungo cy’imyaka 20. Tumenyereye ko abashinga imitwe ya politiki baba baharanira demokarasi n’amahame y’uburenganzira bwa muntu, ariko usesenguye neza aba bane bo bari bahuriye ku kindi kintu gikomeye kuri bo, ariko kinasekeje ku rundi ruhande: Kwijundika Kagame. Impamvu bashingiraho zabonwa na buri wese, kuko akenshi hari ubwo abantu bakosa, ababakuriye bagerageza kubasubiza mu murongo, aho kurakara ku bwo gukosa, bakarakara ku bwo gukosorwa. Ni ko byagenze kuri aba bagabo bane. Bavuye i Kigali bakwepa! Kibuno mpa amaguru… Senateri Tito Rutaremara ni umwe mu bantu bazi neza iby’aba bagabo kuko bakuze ababona, baba abayobozi muri leta imwe ndetse banahura kenshi. Muri Nzeri 2010, yigeze kuva imuzi impamvu zagiye zituma bafungwa, icyo gihe we yari akiri Umuvunyi Mukuru mbere y’uko aba Umusenateri. Karegeya yafashe inzira y’ubuhinzi avuye muri Gereza, bivugwa ko icyo gihe yari amaze umwaka umwe afunguwe azira gusuzugura abamukuriye, niko guhita yerekeza iya Uganda ahari ababyeyi be, ararorongotana agera muri Afurika y’Epfo. Ibya Gahima Gérard byo ni birebire uhereye ku buryo uyu mugabo wize amategeko yinjiye mu myanya y’ubuyobozi bukuru mu rwego rw’ubutabera; ibyo byo ni ibindi bindi ntitwabigarukaho ngo tubirangize. Mbere y’uko nawe ava mu Rwanda, yari mu nkiko na BCR kubera gufata imyenda mu buryo bw’uburiganya, aho ngo hari umwenda yanditse ku mubyeyi we (nyina) kandi arengereje imyaka 70 y’amavuko, bikaba byari binyuranije n’amategeko. Rudasingwa nawe ntari kure aha, abazi ibye neza bamwibukira ku buriganya mu iyubakwa ry’ibikorwa remezo bikomeye birimo na Hotel Intercontinental (Serena tubona ubu), ifaranga ryaratikiriye karahava abigizemo uruhare. Yari ageze ku kigero cyo kwandika imitungo ku bantu batari bo, byigeze no gutuma afungwa, acitse umunyururu, nawe ayabangira ingata. Ni uko byagenze no kuri Kayumba Nyamwasa, nawe wakoze amakosa akomeye mu gisirikare, bikiyongeraho ibijyanye no kwigwizaho imitungo, ku buryo iyo badakomwa mu nkokora ugereranyije na apeti [appetit/appetite] bari bafite, aba bagabo magingo aya baba bihariye nka 3/10 cy’ubukungu bw’u Rwanda ahari! Icengezamatwara no guhuzagurika bitewe no kubura umurongo RNC ikimara kujyaho, yatangiye gushaka uko igaba amashami hirya no hino, ikora ku bantu bose bavuye mu Rwanda bahunga ubutabera n’abandi b’imburamukoro batuye iyo mu mahanga, basobanurirwa ko ariyo makiriro babonye, maze amashyushyu aba menshi, uwari ufitiye u Rwanda umutima mubi, awukuba kabiri. Uhereye muri Amerika ukagera muri Afurika, hose bagiye bahashyira abayobozi. Urugero nko muri Afurika y’Epfo, umuhuzabikorwa yari Abdallah Seif Bamporiki, Robert Mukombozi ari ushinzwe Australia, Rudasingwa Alexis areberera u Bubiligi, Jean Pierre Mushimiye ari mu Bwongereza, Patrick Uwalilaye muri Canada, Eugène Munyangoga muri Denmark n’ahandi gutyo. Byarakomeje maze bigera no mu kwiyegereza indi mitwe n’amashyaka atemewe mu Rwanda nayo agamije inabi ku gihugu maze bunga ubumwe ariko bwari bufite ikindi buhatse. Mu 2012 RNC yatangiye imikoranire na FDU-Inkingi ya Ingabire Victoire wari ufungiye mu Rwanda, icyo gihe igikorwa byose byagenzurwaga na Dr. Nkiko Nsengimana wari Umuhuzabikorwa wayo. Nyuma yaho yiyunze n’indi mitwe irimo Amahoro PC, PS-Imberakuri igice cya Ntaganda Bérnard, PDP-Imanzi n’indi nkuko byanagaragajwe na raporo ya Loni ya 2018 ko bafite umutwe bahuriyeho wa P5; bose intego yari uguteza umutekano n’imvururu mu gihugu, bahungabanya umutekano. Bashatse imbaraga ahantu hose, ndetse mu minsi ishize mu 2017 havuzwe imikoranire ya RNC ya Kayumba na Diane Rwigara bashaka kureba uko bateza umwuka mubi mu baturage bifashishije akarimi n’ikimero by’umukobwa. Kutumvikana, kuryana no gucikamo ibice Iri huriro nk’uko ryiyita, uko iminsi yagiye isimburana, ryatangiye kuzamo urunturuntu. Byatangiriye ku rupfu rwa Patrick Karegeya mu mpera za 2013, bisa n’aho abari bawugize babuze igice kimwe cy’umubiri kuko yari umuntu uzi gucengera dore ko ariwe wabafashije kugera kuri Jakaya Kikwete wayoboraga Tanzania. Nyuma y’aho gato, ku ya Mbere Nyakanga 2016 n’ibyo bikomere bitarakira, Kayumba na Rudasingwa barashwanye karahava. Bijya binavugwa ko Rudasingwa yigeze gutuka Kayumba ibitutsi bikomeye umuntu atatinyuka  kwandika binavamo ugicikamo kabiri k’uyu mutwe. Kayumba nk’uwabaye umusirikare ukomeye yari ashyigikiwe n’abandi babaye abasirikare, hanyuma Rudasingwa nawe afite abasivili bamuri inyuma. Uko niko bakoraga. Muri Nyakanga 2016, Rudasingwa yanditse avuga ko uyu mutwe wasubiye inyuma ku buryo budasanzwe mu myaka itanu yari ishize, ukagira “ubuyobozi bubi butigeze bubaho”. Inyandiko ye yo ku ya 1 Nyakanga 2016, yavugagamo ibintu biteye ubwoba bisa naho umuriro wakaga muri RNC, binagaragaza uburyo iri huriro ridafatika. Rudasingwa yashyize Kayumba mu majwi ko yashinze agatsiko k’Abatutsi bahoze mu gisirikare kahawe kuyobora RNC nubwo ubuyobozi bwari busanzweho bwageragezaga kugatesha agaciro, ku buryo bisa “nk’aho Kayumba yaremeye ishyaka mu rindi.” Kayumba nawe yashinjaga Rudasingwa ko hari agatsiko yashinze agamije kumuvana ku buyobozi bwa RNC ubwo yari akiyiyoboye cyane cyane mu myaka ibiri yari ishize, akamushinja kumusuzugura, kumutuka n’ibindi yavuze ko atari agishoboye kwihanganira. Muri make, icyari kiriho icyo gihe ni ukuvuga ngo ni inde uyoboye hano, umusirikare ati “Sio maombi ni Order”, umusivili nawe ati “ntukange”. Ubwo bakizwa na nde ? Iminsi! Gucikamo ibice kwa RNC n’ivuka rya New RNC Kayumba Nyamwasa tariki 26 Nyakanga 2016, yashyize hanze ibibazo bivugwa muri RNC, ubuhemu bwa Rudasingwa washakaga gusenya iryo shyaka biciye mu gukurura amacakubiri ashingiye ku moko no gushaka kuryigarurira biciye mu kwanga amatora n’ibyayavuyemo. Ubu bwumvikane buke bwatumye Rudasingwa amwiyomoraho, ashinga umutwe we yise New RNC, ajyana n’abari bamushyigikiye b’abasivili, abasirikare basigara mu rundi ruhande muri RNC ya Kayumba. Yahise ashyiraho Komite y’agateganyo yo kuyobora New RNC  mu gihe cy’iminsi 30 aho we yari Chairman, umwungirije ari Joseph Ngarambe naho Umunyamabanga ari Jonathan Musonera. Bahise biyemeza kandi kwitandukanya n’umuntu uwo ariwe wese ushyigikiye Kayumba ndetse wemera amatwara ye. Kayumba-Rudasingwa: Inkoni mu cyico Kayumba na Rudasingwa ntibakunze guhuza na busa, buri wese yabaga ahiga undi, ashaka uko yamubirindura, ubundi ibindi bikazaza nyuma. Kayumba yigeze gushinja Rudasingwa agasuzuguro, kutitabira inama kimwe no kwikanyiza. Kayumba mu 2016 yiyemereye ko RNC yugarijwe n’ibibazo, Rudasingwa we yavuze ko ari ishyaka ryasabitswe n’urwango rushingiye ku moko, kudashyira hamwe n’ibindi. Yavuze ko Rudasingwa yihutiye kubigaragaza mu itangazamakuru nyamara ngo we n’abo bafatanyije kwiyomora kuri Kayumba bagiye bakora ibikorwa bibi bakingirwa ikibaba. Kayumba ati “Hari ibikorwa bibi bagiye bakora, twabagiriye ibanga ariko bo ntibaritugirira, n’ubu hari ibyo tutavuga kandi si uko bidahari, si uko tutabizi.” Mu myaka yamaze muri RNC, Dr Rudasingwa ngo ntiyigeze ashyigikira demokarasi, atinya ko azasimburwa ku mwanya w’umuhuzabikorwa. Abateruzi b’ibibindi muri RNC Imvugo “Abateruzi b’ibibindi” yumvikanye igarukwaho kenshi na Twagiramungu Faustin, ashaka kuvuga abagaragu b’abandi. Muri RNC yakoreshwaga ku bantu badafite ijambo, Rudasingwa akabagereranya n’“abahutu” avuga ko bapfukiranywe n’agatsiko ka Kayumba. Mu 2016 ihangana ryari rikajije umurego, Kayumba yigaramye utwo dutsiko ashinja Dr Rudasingwa ingengabitekerezo y’amoko n’igitugu no kwifashisha imvugo zigamije gutera ubwoba ndetse no kubiba urwango. Ati “Igihe utangiye kuvuga ngo agatsiko k’Abatutsi bahoze ari abasirikare […] Ndetse umuntu umwise umwanzi w’abandi bantu, ugahindukira ngo agatsiko k’abateruzi b’abahutu. Izo mvugo zituma ibintu by’ubwoko bihabwa agaciro katari ko.” Yongeye ati “Guhaguruka ukavuga ko uriya ntacyo avuze, ngo ni umuteruzi w’ibibindi ni agatsiko [...] Niba turi abanyagatsiko ntacyo bitwaye abo twasigaranye nabo bazaduhabura, ubwo butsiko buhagarare.” Mu magambo ye yo ku wa 26 Nyakanga 2016, Kayumba yavuze ko “niba turi abateruzi b’ibindi ubwo bazatureka noneho dukore akazi, kuko bizeye ngo bamwe ni abaporofeseri, abandi ni abaganga, ariko kwita abantu abateruzi b’ibibindi mbona birimo gukabya. Hakwiye kubaho kubahana.” Umunyenga w’intebe y’ubuyobozi wakongeje urwango ku bwa ‘Parrain’ Kikwete Mbere y’uko Karegeya akurwamo umwuka, yari yaraceberegese agera kure, ahura na Perezida Zuma na Kikwete abagezaho igitekerezo cy’uyu mutwe wabo. Kuri we ntibyari bigoye nk’umuntu wigeze gushingwa ubutasi mu gisirikare kuba yagera kuri aba bakuru b’ibihugu akaba yababwira icyo ashaka. Bafashijwe na Kikwete wari ufite umugambi wo guhuza imitwe yose irwanya u Rwanda, ngo ikorere hamwe ariko icyakurikiyeho ni cyo gikomeye. Abo muri RNC bariye akara ba Twagiramungu Faustin, Rusesabagina [nubwo yaje kubakubita icya semuhanuka], BEM Habyarimana Emmanuel wari ufite inshuti nyinshi muri FDLR, n’abandi bashaka gukora ihuriro ry’iyo mitwe yose n’amashyaka. Ntibyatinze, kidobya ngo ba! Twagiramungu, Kayumba na buri wese wari ukomeye muri iryo huriro, yakoze ku isuti rye riteye agapasi, yitegura gusingira intebe y’ubuyobozi. Ubwinshi bw’abashakaga kuyobora bwari nka bimwe tujya tuvuga by’isoko n’amaduka ariko biza kurangira habuze n’umwe uyegukana kubera urupfu rwa Karegeya. Yari umwe mu bantu bazi gutera igipindi unakunda gushyenga cyane bituma umugambi wose wari uhari ukendera, buri wese asubira mu mwanya we ibyo kwihuza birangira bityo nyuma bagenda bavuga uburyo batandukanye. Kayumba yigeze kuvuga ko Rusesabagina yavuye muri uyu mugambi avuga ko burundu asezeye politiki, ubu amushinja kubeshya kuko yavuye muri RNC, agakomereza umurongo we muri FLN yarimo Nsabimana Callixte wamenyekanye nka Sankara. Umuvumba w’amarira muri RNC Mu myaka umunani RNC ishinzwe, amarira yatembye muri uyu mutwe inshuro nyinshi. Amarira ya mbere yatembye ubwo Patrick Karegeya yari amaze gukurwamo umwuka. Uyu yasaga nkaho ari we wahuzaga abasivili n’abasirikare, yumvirwaga na Kayumba ndetse na Rudasingwa. Urupfu rwe rwavuzweho byinshi, bashyira mu majwi u Rwanda ko arirwo rubiri inyuma ariko habuze ikimenyetso na kimwe kibigaragaza. Gusa abasesenguzi bakunze gusobanura uburyo Karegeya yari afite ibibazo impande n’impande. Andrew Mwenda nyuma y’urupfu rwa Karegeya yavuze uburyo uyu mugabo yashwanye n’umuhanzi w’ikirangirire Jean Christophe Matata amuziza kumuteretera ikizungerezi bari bacuditse, nyuma birangira Karegeya acuze umugambi wo kwivugana Christophe Matata binyuze mu gushyira ikinini mu kinyobwa cye. Urupfu rwa Matata bigizwemo uruhare na Karegeya ngo rushobora kuba rwarakongeje uburakari, maze abashaka guhorera uyu muhanzi nabo bapanga kwivugana Karegeya. Ikindi Afurika y’Epfo ni igihugu kibamo ubugizi bwa nabi ku rugero rwo hejuru. Iza mu bihugu bya mbere ku Isi biberamo ibikorwa by’ubugizi bwa nabi aho icyegeranyo cya Global Peace Index cyo mu 2018 kigaragaza ko ari  iya 125 ku Isi mu 165 bitekanye. Ku bijyanye n’impfu za hato na hato zitewe n’ibikorwa by’ubugizi bwa nabi, Afurika y’Epfo yashyizwe mu bihugu 10 ku Isi ziganjemo cyane. Polisi ya Afurika y’Epfo mu 2018 yagaragaje ko ubwicanyi bukomeje gufata indi ntera kuko nibura ku munsi hapfa abantu 57 biciwe mu bikorwa nk’ibi by’ubugizi bwa nabi. Ibikorwa by’ubugizi bwa nabi muri iki gihugu bishyira Afurika y’Epfo ku mwanya wa 15 ku Isi mu bihugu bihomba akayabo kubera ibi bikorwa aho nibura itakaza 24% by’umutungo mbumbe w’igihugu. Amakimbirane ashingiye ku bukungu ni yo aza ku isonga mu bituma ubugizi bwa nabi bukaza umurego muri Afurika y’Epfo. Mu minsi ishize kandi undi muntu wahoze muri RNC Nkurunziza Camille yishwe arashwe mu bushyamirane na Polisi ya Afurika y’Epfo. Kwisuganya kw’abarwanya Leta mu mutwe mushya w’iterabwoba P5 Nyuma yo gupfunda imitwe impande zose bagakama ikimasa, Kayumba n’andi mashyaka bihurije hamwe bashinga umutwe witwa P5 wari ushyigikiwe na Perezida Museveni na leta y’u Burundi kugira ngo barebe uko bagera ku mugambi wabo wo guhungabanya umtutekano w’u Rwanda. Tariki 18 Ukuboza 2018, Itsinda ry’inzobere za Loni zikora iperereza ku mutekano mu Burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, ryashyikirije Komite y’Akanama ka Loni gashinzwe umutekano raporo y’ibyo zabonye. Muri iyo raporo zise ‘Midterm report of the Group of Experts on the Democratic Republic of the Congo’, impuguke zivuga ko inyeshyamba za Kayumba Nyamwasa zikorera mu misozi ya Fizi na Uvira muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo. Izo zari zibumbiye mu mutwe wiswe P5 izwi nk’impuzamashyaka irwanya Leta y’u Rwanda, ibumbiye hamwe FDU Inkingi ya Ingabire Victoire, Amahoro PC; RNC, PDP-Imanzi na PS Imberakuri, igice cya Ntaganda Bérnard. Kugeza muri Nzeri 2018, uwo mutwe wari ugizwe n’abagera kuri 400, uyobowe na Shaka Nyamusaraba wahoze ayoboye inyeshyamba za Gomino, ukoresha intwaro n’ibindi byangombwa byose bituruka mu Burundi nubwo hatashyizwe hanze ababibaha. Abahoze muri uwo mutwe babwiye inzobere za Loni ko abawugize ari abanyamahanga benshi baturuka mu Rwanda ndetse n’abanye-Congo b’Abanyamulenge. Bavuze ko Kayumba Nyamwasa asura ako gace inshuro nyinshi. Mu kureshya abinjira muri uwo mutwe ngo hifashishwa kubahamagara kuri telefone, guhura nabo amaso ku maso ndetse no gukoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga. Nibura kwinjiza abarwanyi byabaga rimwe mu kwezi, mu mezi umunani ya mbere ya 2018. Raporo ivuga ko uwo mutwe wagabanyijwemo batayo eshatu, iyitwa Alpha, Bravo na Delta, buri imwe ikaba igizwe n’abarwanyi bagera kuri 120. Raporo ya Loni ishimangira ko ko intwaro, ibiryo, imiti n’imyambaro byose uwo mutwe ukoresha bituruka i Burundi, ndetse igenda igaragaza n’ingero z’intwaro zinjijwe mu nyeshyamba ziturutse i Bujumbura. Ishamaduko rya Museveni, Papa mushya muri batisimu w’abarwanya u Rwanda Ubwo Museveni yataga mu matwi ko hari abisuganyiriza kugirira nabi u Rwanda, iryo jambo yaryakiranye ubwuzu maze abaha karibu ati rwose ni muze mwisanga mu rukari. Uyu muyobozi guhera mu 2017 yatangiye gufasha mu buryo bweruye umutwe wa RNC n’abandi wafatanya nawo, abaha karibu muri Uganda ndetse agira n’uruhare mu bikorwa bigamije gutuma ubona abayoboke. Urwego rushinzwe Iperereza mu Gisirikare nirwo rwabaye ku isonga muri ibyo bikorwa byo gusohoza ubutumwa bw’Umukuru w’Igihugu, rutangira gushakira hasi hejuru uwo ariwe wese waba wifuza kujya mu myitozo ya RNC i Minembwe muri RDC kugira ngo azatere u Rwanda. Mu Ukuboza 2017, abasore 40 bafashwe bafite ibyangombwa by’inzira bya Uganda by’ibihimbano bagiye kwinjira muri RDC mu nkambi za RNC. Polisi ya Uganda itari izi umugambi wa sebuja ifatanyije n’iya Tanzania niyo yapfubije urugendo rwabo. Uko iminsi yagiye igenda kandi, ni ko Museveni yarushijeho kwerura, akagaragaza uruhande ahagaze mu bufatanye n’iyi mitwe. Ibaruwa ye yo muri Werurwe 2019 yakuye igihu kuri ibi byose kuko nawe yiyemereye uruhare rwe. Yandikiye Perezida Kagame amubwira ko yahuye na Mukankusi Charlotte ushinzwe dipolomasi muri RNC, agiye kubihuhura avuga ko byari nk’impanuka. Muri make ni nk’aho Museveni yari ari kugenda n’amaguru mu muhanda wa Jinja, agahura n’umugore witwa Mukankusi yihitira, bakaganira. Gusa ariko si ko byagenze, uyu mugore yakiriwe mu Biro by’Umukuru w’Igihugu, aganira umwanya munini na Museveni, ndetse bivugwa ko yamugejejeho umugambi wabo wo kugirira nabi ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda undi akamwizeza ubufasha amubwira ngo ‘turikumwe’.. Bivugwa ko uyu mugore yamugaragarije ubufasha bamukeneyeho by’umwihariko kuba Uganda yashimangira umubano ifiyanye na Loni i New York ku buryo yatesha agaciro raporo y’impuguke za Loni yo ku wa 31 Ukuboza 2018 igaragaza isano iri hagati ya Guverinoma ya Museveni na RNC. Si aba gusa, buri wese mu bavuye mu Rwanda ku mpamvu imwe cyangwa indi ariko utarwifuriza ineza, hamwe mu hantu yisanga ni muri Uganda. Ubu ba Rujugiro baratekanye baratimaje kuko ubucuruzi bwabo muri Uganda buhagarikiwe n’ingwe, Himbara David yahawe karibu mu itangazamakuru aho aba asebya u Rwanda nta rutangira n’abandi gutyo gutyo. Uyu mwanya Museveni yafashe wo kuba Papa mushya wa  Batisimu w’abarwanya u Rwanda, awusimbuyeho Jakaya Kikwete wari warahimbanishije ko ashaka kubona u Rwanda rugirana ibiganiro na FDLR. Umunsi inyeshyamba za P5 zakubitiwe muri Congo n’ikintu kitazwi Muri uko kwisuganya kwahereye mu 2017, abarwanyi muri RDC bagurirwa amatiliningi na bote, imyitozo iratangira igizwe n’insorensore zirenga 200 zirimo izaturutse muri Uganda zitazi n’ikipe ihanganye n’indi. P5 ihuriwemo n’amashyaka atanu agamije kurwanya u Rwanda, yari yakajije imyitozo muri Congo, Museveni nawe akomeje gutanga ubufasha bwose yaba ubwo gushaka abajya mu bikorwa nk’ibyo. Ku rundi ruhande, hari Congo nayo yari ifite umugambi wo gushaka uko yagarura amahoro mu gihugu cyayo cyabaye ikotaniro ry’imitwe yitwaje intwaro. Muri Kamena uyu mwaka, Ingabo za RDC zateguye ibitero bikomeye byiswe ‘Tempête de l’Ituri’, bigamije kwirukana imitwe yitwaje intwaro yigaruriye uduce dutandukanye mu mashyamba ya RDC. Amashusho yahise atangira gukwirakwira ku mbuga nkoranyambaga agaragaza ingabo za Leta ya Congo zisuka ibisasu biremereye ku birindiro by’imwe mu mitwe yitwaje intwaro ikorera muri aka gace ka Ituri. Izi ngabo zari zifite indege za gisirikare n’ibisasu biremereye, zatangaje ko impamvu y’ibi bitero ari uguhiga no kwirukana imitwe yitwaje intwaro yigaruriye ibice bitandukanye by’iki gihugu. Bishobora kuba aribyo byageze ku barwanyi ba P5 kuko bo ibyo bakorewe ntiwakeka ko ari ingabo za RDC zabikoze ahubwo wagira ngo ni ikiza cyangwa inkuba yabanyuzemo ikararika. Gukubitwa inshuro kw’abarwanya leta y’u Rwanda ntabwo byageze muri P5 gusa kuko hari n’abafashwe bazanwa mu Rwanda nk’imizigo. Muribuka Nsabimana Callixte wari wariyise Sankara, wigambaga ko yafashe Nyungwe mu biganza bye? Uyu wari wariyise umugaba mukuru w’ingabo za FNL ya Rusesabagina, yahizwe bukware, afatwa nta n’isasu ry’umuti rivuze, afatirwa muri za Comore, nyuma arahambirwa azanwa mu Rwanda nk’umuzigo. Ibyago ntibyarangiriye aho, mu minsi mike ishize, Mudacumura Sylvestre nawe wari uyoboye FDLR yakubiswe n’ingabo za RDC apfana ikiyiko, abari abarwanyi be barabohwa bajyanwa muri gereza. Birashoboka ko n’abandi aricyo kibategereje. Tubitege amaso!

title: Twagiramungu yibukijwe uko yarebaga FDLR icyoroshye none ikaba igeze aharindimuka
content: Ku wa 12 Kanama 2014, Twagiramungu yagiye ku rukuta rwe rwa Facebook maze yandikaho amagambo agaragaza ko azagwa inyuma y’umutwe wa FDLR. Icyo gihe yavugaga ko igihe cyose uyu mutwe uzaterwa, azazinga utwangushye nawe akajya ku rugamba kuwutabara. Icyo gihe yagize ati “FDLR niraswa, ntituzaba indorerezi, tuzayitabara”. Muri iyi minsi uyu mutwe wugarijwe n’ikibatsi cy’amasasu y’Ingabo za FARDC ku buryo ejo bundi aha uwari Umuyobozi wayo Lieutenant General Sylvestre Mudacumura yiciwe mu gace ka Bwito mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru. Yishwe n’umutwe w’abasirikare badasanzwe ba FARDC wari wakurikiranye neza umenya aho aherereye, ni ko kumusangayo ndetse ahita yicanwa n’abo bari kumwe. Amakuru ahamya ko ubwo FARDC yagwaga gitumo Gen Mudacumura, yicanwe n’abandi basirikare bari ibyegera bye barimo Col Serge, Col Soso Sixbert, uwari ushinzwe kumurinda akaba n’umunyamabanga we Maj Gaspard n’abandi. Hafashwe kandi abarwanyi 15. Iki gitero cyakomye mu nkokora uyu mutwe, cyatumye benshi bakubita agatima ku magambo yatangajwe na Twagiramungu ko nihagira ikiwuhungabanya cyose, azawugwa inyuma. Bakekaga ko yaba yamaze gufunga za bote [inkweto] gikomando nawe agiye kuwurwanirira. Ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ikiganiro cyabaye mu buryo busa no gutebya, abantu bereka Twagiramungu ko umutwe yiringiye udashinga, kandi ko uri mu marembera. Nka Tom Ndahiro, yanditse ati “Bwana Faustin Twagiramungu, hashize imyaka itanu uvuze ko #FDLR niraswa utazaba indorerezi ahubwo uzatabara, waba ugeze he ngo udasanga byacitse kwa Mudacumura usigaranye ikiyiko gusa nka Komanda urwanisha ikiyiko (TheSpoonCommander). Uce no ku bandi nka Victoire Umuhoza cyangwa abayoboke be! Amahirwe masa!” Bwana @FTwagiramungu, hashize imyaka itanu uvuze ko #FDLR niraswa utazaba indorerezi ahubwo uzatabara, waba ugeze he ngo udasanga byacitse kwa Mudacumura usigaranye ikiyiko gusa nka #TheSpoonCommander. Uce no ku bandi nka @VictoireUmuhoza cyangwa abayoboke be! Bon chance! pic.twitter.com/eBrTXLp2XR — Tom Ndahiro (@TomNdahiro) September 20, 2019 Uwitwa Julius K.Rw we yagize ati “Sigaho umusaza atazagwa kuri runonko mu ishyamba”, mu gihe Ingabire Egidie Bibio we yasetse amagambo ya Twagiramungu agira ati “ Muzehe se ngo agiye gutabara!? Arasangayo ikiyiko gusa kuko ubanza cyarasigaye ku cyicaro cya FDLR.” Kagabo Jacques ni undi watanze igitekerezo ku magambo ya Twagiramungu, aho yagize ati “Bwana Faustin Twagiramungu, a.k.a Rukokoma ko ingabo zigushizeho uracyakomeje urugamba? Nako ikomereze urwo kuvuga nirwo ushoboye naho abo washutse ngo uzabatabara ahubwo jya gukura ikiriyo.” Bagabe Nshayija Steven we yavuze ko “intambara ya Twagiramungu se ko ari iy’amagambo,  ubona ari iyihe yindi yarwana koko?  Azavuga aruhe.” Uwitwa Youssef na we yagaragaje ko Twagiramungu nta ntambara n’imwe yarwana itari iy’amagambo, ati “Twagiramungu se ko yitungiwe no kuvuga ahubwo sinzi niba nabyo azabishobora kuko iminsi ishobora kuba yaramaze gukona za ngwe.... none nabo yashutse nabo ubwabo ntibari bashoboye bamusigiye intebe iriho ikiyiko. Ni ukuvuga ko ariwe usigaye kurya kuri iriya mbehe!” Imvugo ya Twagiramungu yo mu 2014 yaturutse kuki? Twagiramungu ni umugabo wakunze gushyigikira abantu bose barwanya ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda, by’umwihariko umutwe wa FDLR, byanagize ubukana cyane ahagana mu 2013 ubwo uwari Perezida wa Tanzania, Jakaya Kikwete, yavugaga ko u Rwanda rukwiye kuganira n’uyu mutwe, mu gihe ushinjwa uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Amagambo y’uko FDLR niraswa azatabara yayavuze mu 2014 nyuma y’uko i Washington habereye inama ikemeza ko Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika izarasa FDLR ikorana na Twagiramungu nibaramuka badashyize intwaro hasi nta mananiza. Nyuma yayo Russ Feingold wari Intumwa idasanzwe ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu Karere k’Ibiyaga Bigari no muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo yatangaje ko nyuma y’amezi atandatu FDLR izaraswa niba idashyize intwaro hasi. Yanavuze ko uyu mutwe utemerewe gukorera politiki mu Rwanda ndetse no gukomeza gutekereza iby’ibiganiro na Leta y’u Rwanda. Feingold yavuze ko uruhande rw’ubuhuza rwiteguye korohereza abarwanyi ba FDLR bashaka gutaha mu Rwanda cyangwa se abashaka kurambika intwaro hasi bagatuzwa ahandi. Yakomeje avuga ko "Nta biganiro bikwiye kubaho by’uko FDLR yahabwa ijambo ikaganira na Leta y’u Rwanda, kubera uruhare ishinjwa muri Jenoside.” Twagiramungu wari uyoboye Ihuriro ry’Amashyaka atavuga rumwe na Leta y’u Rwanda (CPC), yahise avuga ko biteguye gutabara FDLR, mu gihe Amerika yaramuka ihirahiye kuyirasa aho yanavugaga ko mu mezi atandatu ikibazo kizaba cyakemutse hatabayeho kuraswa. Umwe mu bavugaga rumwe na Twagiramungu icyo gihe ni Laforge Fils Bazeye wari Umuvugizi wa FDLR, na we wavugaga ko nta muntu uzabakoraho, ubu ari i Mageragere. Undi ni Mudacumura uherutse kwicwa, na we ubu ashobora kuba ari kubazwa imirimo yakoze ku Isi. Tanzania ya Kikwete yari icyitso cya FDLR Igitabo cyasohokeye mu Budage mu 2016 gishingiye ku nyandiko z’urubanza rwabereye i Stuttgart muri icyo gihugu rw’abari abayobozi ba FDLR, cyagaragaje byinshi kuri uyu mutwe wokamwe n’ikibi ndetse n’ubugambanyi bwa bimwe mu bihugu ufata nka Se wo muri batisimu. Kigaragaza neza umubano wa FDLR n’umuyobozi wayo muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo, Col Hamada na Salama Kikwete, umugore w’uwahoze ari Perezida wa Tanzania. Igitabo kivuga ko Hamada ari umwe mu ihuriro rya Faustin Twagiramungu, Théogène Rudasingwa, wahoze muri RNC ndetse n’abayobozi bakuru muri FDLR ari bo; Mudamucura, Byiringiro na Pacifique Ntawunguka ‘Omega’. Ibiganiro by’iyi mitwe uko ari itatu byaberaga muri Tanzania kuko Hamada na Wilson Irategeka, uyobora CNRD yiyomoye kuri FDLR, bafite pasiporo z’iki gihugu, aba bakaba bahuje na Twagiramungu. Uku kuba icyitso kwa Tanzania, kwatumye uwayiyoboraga Kikwete asaba u Rwanda ko rushyikirana na FDLR kugira ngo mu Burasizuba bwa Congo-Kinshasa haboneke umutekano. Ibi byatewe utwatsi n’abayobozi bakuru b’u Rwanda bavuga ko ibiganiro na FDLR bidashoboka kandi bitazigera bibaho kuko ari inkoramaraso zasize zishe bunyamaswa inzirakarengane z’Abatutsi zisaga miliyoni imwe mu 1994.
