title: 2020, ihurizo ku ireme rya demokarasi ya Afurika y’Iburasizuba kubera amatora ateganyijwe
content: Tanzania Ni igihugu cyakunze kurangwa no guhererekanya ubutegetsi mu mahoro guhera igihe cyaboneye ubwigenge. Ishyaka riri ku butegetsi Chama Cha Mapinduzi riracyahabwa amahirwe yo kugumana ubutegetsi. Mu gihe hitegurwa amatora rusange azaba mu Ukwakira 2020, abatavuga rumwe na Leta n’imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta bafite impungenge ko Guverinoma ya Perezida John Pombe Magufuli ishobora kubangamira ubwisanzure bwo gutanga ibitekerezo. The East African yatangaje ko kuri ubu Guverinoma yakuyeho ibikorwa by’abatavuga rumwe na Leta, bivuze ko nta bikorwa byo gukoresha inama bishoboka mu mashyaka atavuga rumwe na Leta. Hari abantu bafunzwe, abanyamakuru bamwe baburirwa irengero abandi barafungwa nk’urugero rw’umunyamakuru Eric Kabendera cyangwa Paul Magotti wari impirimbanyi y’uburenganzira bwa muntu. Uko kubangamira abatavuga rumwe na Leta kwatumye amashyaka atavuga rumwe na Leta yanga kwitabira amatora y’inzego z’ibanze yabaye mu Ugushyingo umwaka ushize, bituma ishyaka CCM riyatsinda ku kigero cya 99%. Umunyapolitiki utavuga rumwe na Leta, Tundu Lissu aherutse kuvuga ko guhagarika ibikorwa y’abatavuga rumwe na Leta, ari ikimenyetso ko amatora ya 2020 atazaba mu mucyo. Perezida Magufuli yatowe mu 2015 afite intego yo kurwanya ruswa. Nubwo yatangije intambara ku baryi ba ruswa, ashinjwa kubangamira demokarasi mu gihugu, gupfukirana amajwi y’abamunenga no kubibasira. U Burundi Amatora atenganyijwe muri Gicurasi uyu mwaka, mu gihe hakiri urujijo niba Perezida Pierre Nkurunziza azongera kwiyamamaza nyuma ya manda ya gatatu yafashe mu 2015 igateza imvururu. Ikindi gihangayikishije ni ukumenya niba Guverinoma ye ifite ubushobozi bwo gutegura amatora anyuze mu mucyo, kuko imiryango n’ibihugu byinshi byateraga inkunga icyo gihugu, byarayihagaritse bishinja Nkurunziza guteza akaduruvayo mu gihugu. Nubwo Nkurunziza yatangaje ko atazongera kwiyamamaza, ababirebera hafi bavuga ko ashobora kwisubiraho cyangwa agashyiraho umuntu azajya atagekeramo. Nta kimenyetso cyerekana ko Nkurunziza agiye kuva muri politiki y’u Burundi mu gihe muri Gashyantare umwaka ushize, yimuye ibiro bya Perezida akabijyana mu Mujyi wa Gitega ari naho avuka. Raporo y’Umuryango w’Abibumbye yo muri Nzeri 2019, igaragaza ko nta cyizere cy’imigendekere myiza y’amatora mu Burundi mu 2020, mu gihe hakiri Perezida wigaragaza nk’igitangaza’. Loni ivuga ko ari Perezida wigwijeho ububasha bwose we n’ishyaka rye CNDD FDD,  n’ibyaha bishinjwa urubyiruko rw’ishyaka rye ruzwi nk’Imbonerakure rushinjwa guhutaza uburenganzira bw’abaturage n’abatavuga rumwe na Leta. Icyakora Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga w’u Burundi, Ezechiel Nibigira, aherutse kubwira Inteko rusange ya Loni, ko  mu gihugu hari umwuka mwiza uzatuma amatora agenda neza. Somalia Amatora yo  muri Somalia ni ingenzi cyane ku mutekano w’akarere. Iki ni igihugu kimaze igihe mu mvururu. Hashize imyaka 50 Perezida atorwa n’itsinda ry’abantu bake baba batoranyijwe, kubera ubwoba bw’uko hateguwe amatora rusange abaturage bakitabira, bishobora guteza imvururu n’umutekano muke. Mu matora ya 2009, aya 2012 na 2017 hose abagize Inteko Ishinga Amategeko na Perezida bagiye batorwa n’abantu 14 000 babaga batoranyijwe ngo bahagararire ubwoko buba muri icyo gihugu. N’uyu munsi haracyari impungenge niba amatora yo muri Somalia koko azaba dore ko aya Perezida aherutse yabereye muri parikingi y’ikibuga cy’indege. Ikibazo cy’umutwe w’iterabwoba wa al Shabaab ndetse no kuba abatavuga rumwe na Leta baherutse gushinja Perezida Mohamed Abdullahi Farmaajo gushaka kuguma ku butegetsi biteye impungenge ku mutekano w’amatora ateganyijwe. Guverinoma yatangaje ko yiteguye gukoresha amatora agaca mu mucyo kandi buri muturage wemerewe gutora agatora. Guverinoma yanavuze ko  vuba aha izageza ku Nteko Ishinga Amatora umushinga w’amatora kugira ngo wemezwe. Icyakora, iki gihugu cyiracyafite ikibazo cyo kuvugurura Itegeko Nshinga. Nubwo itsinda ryahawe kurivugurura ryagejeje ku Nteko umushinga w’itegeko, haracyari imbogamizi. Iya mbere ni uko nta matora ya kamarampaka ashobora kuba hatarakemuka ikibazo cy’agace ka Somaliland kifata nk’igihugu ukwacyo mu gihe Somalia igafata nk’agace kayo. Mu bindi kandi ivugurura ry’itegeko Nshinga rigomba kureba harimo aho umurwa mukuru ukwiriye kuba, uburyo ubuyobozi bwa za Leta zigize icyo gihugu bukorana na Leta nkuru n’ibindi. Mu gihe ivugurura ry’itegeko Nshinga ritaraba, n’tegeko rigenga amatora ntirizashoboka kuko abantu ntibashobora gutangira kwiyandikisha hataraboneka itegeko rigenga amatora kandi naryo rigomba kugenwa n’Itegeko Nshinga. Indi mbogamizi ni umutekano muke. Igice kinini cy’igihugu kiracyari mu maboko y’umutwe wa al Shabaab, bivuze ko aho hantu al shabaab ifite amatora atazashoboka. No mu murwa mukuru Mogadishu naho umutekano waho ntiwizewe. Ibyo bigaragazwa n’uko tariki 28 Ukuboza 2019, imodoka itezemo igisasu yaturikiye aho abantu basakirwa mu murwa mukuru kigahitana abantu 78. Perezida Farmaajo yavuze ko icyo gitero ari icy’iterabwoba kandi kitazihanganirwa, icyakora abatavuga rumwe na we bamushinja kubembekereza al shabaab kuko uduce Leta yigaruriye guhera mu 2017 ubwo Farmaajo yajyaga ku butegetsi ari duke. Ethiopia Amatora ateganyijwe muri Gicurasi 2020, ni aya mbere azaba abaye guhera Minisitiri w’Intebe wahawe n’igihembo cyitiriwe Nobel, Dr Abiy Ahmed agiye ku butegetsi. Umwanzuro aherutse gufata wo gusesa amashyaka yose yari agize Ihuriro EPRDF (Ethiopian People’s Revolutionary Democratic Front), agashinga ishyaka rya PP  watumye havuka impungenge n’umwuka mubi mu gihugu. Hari abadashyigikiye iryo shyaka PP kuko risa nk’irije guhanagura umuco n’umuhate bashyizeho bubaka amashyaka yabo mu myaka 30 ishize. Abatabyumva cyane ni abo mu mashyaka nka Tigray Peoples Liberation Front (TPLF), n’igice cy’ishyaka  Oromo Peoples Democratic Organisation (OPDO) ari naryo Abiy aturukamo, rishobora no kumurwanya agatsindwa. Amavugurura yakozwe na Dr Abiy yazanye umucyo muri Ethiopia yahoze ifatwa nk’igihugu  kibangamira uburenganzira bwa muntu ariko byanateje imvururu zishingiye ku turere zitewe n’abandi bantu bakomeye bafite inyota y’ubutegetsi. Guhera mu 1995, Ethiopia yagiye ikora amatora mu gihe cyagenwe. Icyakora, uretse mu 2005, nta na rimwe higeze habaho amatora arimo guhangana kugaragara nkuko The East African yabitangaje.

title: Perezida Kagame yavuze ku magambo ya Trump, manda ya gatatu n’uzamusimbura
content:
Icyo kiganiro kizatambuka muri nimero itaha ya Time Magazine ariko icyo kinyamakuru cyabaye gisohoye incamake mu byo cyaganiriye na Perezida Kagame. Time Magazine yaganiriye na Perezida Kagame mu kwezi gushize ubwo yari yitabiriye umuhango wo gutanga impamyabumenyi z’icyiciro cya gatatu cya Kaminuza ku banyeshuri bo muri Columbia University, barimo umukobwa we Ange Kagame. Hari igice cy’Isi cyigize abagenzuzi
 Perezida Kagame yabajijwe ku buryo abona impamvu umugabane wa Afurika u Rwanda rurimo ukunze gufatwa nk’uhoramo ibibazo, udatera imbere ukagira n’abayobozi babi. Yasubije ko ikibazo gikomeye atari Afurika nk’umugabane ahubwo ari abantu bamwe bigize abagenzuzi b’isi, bumva ko nta cyiza cyakorerwa ahandi hatari iwabo. Yagize ati “Hari igice cy’Isi gihora gishaka kugaragara nk’ahakorerwa ibintu byiza  gusa, hakaba n’ikindi gice kiberamo ibibi gusa. Icyo gice cya mbere cyumva ko ari cyo gishinzwe kugenzura ikindi. Bumva ko bafite inshingano zo gukomeza kugenzura. Mu yandi magambo, twe bo mu gice kibi, uko wagerageza gukora neza kose ntushobora kuva muri icyo gice ngo wenda ujye mu gice cy’abakora ibyiza.” Aho niho yahise asabwa gukomoza no ku magambo Perezida wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe, Donald Trump, wigeze gushinjwa kuvuga, ko ibihugu bya Afurika ari umwanda. Perezida Kagame asanga igikenewe atari ukujya guhangana n’abafata nabi Afurika ahubwo ko ingufu zikwiriye gushyirwa mu kurwanya ibituma uwo mugabane usuzugurwa. Ati “Uburyo bwiza ntabwo ari ukurwanya uwo muntu ubona ibihugu byacu mu buryo bubi, ahubwo icyiza ni ukurwanya ruswa, ubukene, n’ibindi bintu bibi byose abantu bashingiraho baducira imanza zitari zo. Dukwiriye kwibanda ku bintu bidushyira ku rundi rwego aho ntawibeshya ku cyo duharanira n’abo turi bo.” Manda ya gatatu: ‘Njye nashakaga kugenda’
 Mu mwaka wa 2015, Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika y’u Rwanda ryo mu 2003 ryaravuguruwe, ingingo zimwe ziravugururwa zirimo n’iyemerera Perezida Kagame kwiyamamariza manda ya gatatu. Ni igikorwa cyakozwe nyuma y’ubusabe bw’abaturage basaga miliyoni eshatu n’igice bari bandikiye Inteko Ishinga Amategeko bifuza ko ingingo ikumira Perezida kongera kwiyamamaza yavugururwa. Itegeko Nshinga ryaravuguruwe, mu 2017 haba amatora ya Perezida, Paul Kagame w’Umuryango FPR Inkotanyi ayatsinda ku majwi 98%. Perezida Kagame yabwiye Time Magazine ko we atifuzaga manda ya gatatu, ko yabikoze nyuma yo kubisabwa na benshi. Ati “ Njye nashakaga kugenda. Nanavuze impamvu ariko abantu bamwe barahagurutse  bati ‘Perezida waduhaye andi amahirwe, ukaduha undi mwanya? Ntabwo dushaka ko ba bantu batwikoreje imitwaro babona inzira yo kugaruka ku buyobozi bw’igihugu cyacu ngo bongere bangize ibintu.’  Haje ibitekerezo byinshi, nagombaga kubyumva nkanabyubahiriza.” Yabajijwe niba ishyaka FPR Inkotanyi ryaba riri gushaka uzamusimbura igihe manda ye izaba irangiye, Perezida Kagame avuga ko ibyo byaba atari byo. Kagame yagize ati  “Ibyo byaba ari nk’ubwami cyangwa ibimeze nkabyo.” ‘Sinagiye ku buyobozi nkoze amanyanga’
 Perezida Kagame yabajijwe ku bikunze gutangazwa n’imiryango mpuzamahanga iharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu, ivuga ko mu Rwanda nta bwisanzure buhari, ko abatavuga rumwe na Leta batotetezwa n’ibindi. Iki kinyamakuru cyitsaga cyane ku kuba bamwe mu batavuga rumwe na Leta barangiwe kwiyamamaza mu matora ya Perezida aherutse. Perezida Kagame yavuze ko rimwe na rimwe abayobozi n’abaturage bo muri Afurika bafatwa uko batari. Ati “Ntabwo nagiye ku buyobozi habayeho amanyanga, nta manyanga nakoze mu rugendo rwo kubohora igihugu cyanjye. Hari igishoro natanze kandi igishoro cyanjye ntabwo ari ukwibasira uburenganzira bw’abaturage. Siko nteye.” Yakomeje agira ati “ Abantu bajya batekereza ko abayobozi ba Afurika babereyeho kugirira nabi abaturage babo cyangwa ko abaturage bakiri inyuma batazi ikibabereye. Inshuro nyinshi abaturage bacu bagiye bafata umwanzuro, hakaza umuntu akavuga ngo ‘oya, oya  muri guhitamo nabi". "Ni ukuvuga ngo wa mugenzuzi nahoze mvuga ni we ufite ububasha bwo kuvuga uburyo bwiza ibintu bikwiriye gukorwamo, ngo uyu ni we muntu ukwiriye kuba umuyobozi wanyu. Abanyarwanda bazi icyo bashaka, bazi kwifatira umwanzuro kandi mu gihe babikoze ntekereza ko abantu bakwiriye kubyubaha.” Perezida Kagame yavuze ko nta munyamahanga waharaniye ubwigenge bw’abanyarwanda kumurusha ku buryo hagira umubwiriza ibyo akwiriye gukora. Ati “Nzi ibyo nkora, nzi ibimbereye. Ntabwo nkeneye kubibwirwa n’uwo ari we wese.” Ikiganiro kirambuye Perezida Kagame yagiranye na Time Magazine kizasohoka mu nimero yo kuwa 8 Nyakanga 2019.

title: Umuzimu wasaritse abarwanya u Rwanda uzorohera Twagiramungu na Rusesabagina bihuje?
content: Amasezerano hagati y’ishyaka RDI Rwanda Rwiza, rya Twagiramungu na MRCD, igizwe na RRM ya Nsabimana Callixte ‘Sankara’, ufungiwe mu Rwanda, PDR Ihumure na CNRD Ubwiyunge ya Gen. Irategeka Wilson wiyomoye kuri FDLR, yasinywe kuri uyu wa Kabiri i Bruxelles mu Bubiligi. MRCD niyo Nsabimana ‘Sankara’, yari abereye umuvugizi na Visi Perezida wa kabiri. Ifite ishami rya gisirikare ryitwa FLN, ikaba ari umutwe w’iterabwoba wagabye ibitero mu Majyepfo y’u Rwanda, bigahitana abaturage icyenda, 19 bagakomereka ndetse n’imitungo myinshi igasahurwa indi ikangizwa. Uwari umuvugizi w’uyu mutwe Nsabimana yumvikanye ku maradiyo ya BBC na VOA, n’imbuga nka YouTube yigamba ibyo bitero, avuga ko ari ibya FLN iyobowe na Habimana Hamada. Umusesenguzi mu bya politiki y’ibiyaga bigari, akaba impuguke mu itangazamakuru, Albert Rudatsimburwa, avuga ko kuba Twagiramungu yahisemo kwihuza ku mugaragaro n’umutwe w’iterabwoba, MRCD, bisobanura ko atakiri muri politiki gusa ahubwo yinjiye no mu iterabwoba. Avuga ko Twagiramungu yifuza guhirika ubuyobozi bw’u Rwanda ariko akaba yarabuze uko abigenza, bityo akaba yihuje n’abandi babimazemo iminsi, ariko ku bwe iri huriro ntacyo ryageraho. Ati “Ni amagambo gusa, ni ukuvugira kuri radiyo hirya no hino ariko ntacyo bivuze, nta n’ikintu gifatika gihari”. Inenge kuri Rusesabagina na Twagiramungu Rudatsimburwa avuga ko aba bagabo bose bafite inenge izingiye ku ‘bushobozi buke’ butuma ubufatanye bwabo ntacyo bwageraho. Mbere ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, Paul Rusesabagina yari umuntu usanzwe, yavukiye i Murama ya Gitarama ku wa 15 Kamena 1954, ariko nyuma yagiye gutura i Bruxelles mu Bubiligi na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Uburyo abantu bamuzi bwahinduwe cyane na filimi Hotel Rwanda yamukinweho nk’uwarokoye abantu 1268 muri Hôtel des Mille Collines, abayobejwe nayo batangira kumuhundagazaho ibihembo kugeza kuri ‘Presidential Medal Award of Freedom’, yahawe na Perezida George W. Bush wa Amerika mu Ugushyingo 2005. Rudatsimburwa agaruka ku mateka ya Rusesabagina akavuga ko atari umunyapolitiki, ahubwo yari umuntu wakoreraga hôtel akaza kugirwa igitangaza na filimi bityo agatangira kwibaza ko uwo muntu uri muri filime ari we kandi atari we. Ati “Ni ukwisumbukuruza gusa kandi nta bushobozi afite uretse ko yabonye abantu bamwumva kuko bibaza ko ari wawundi wo muri filime ariko mu banyarwanda nta kintu avuze, ntacyo bamuziho uretse ibyo ahwihwisa mu maradiyo gusa n’ahandi”. Akomereza kuri Twagiramungu, akavuga ko we yabaye umunyapolitiki kuva kera ariko ubu akaba ari ‘umunyapolitiki wasigajwe inyuma n’amateka’, kuko uko u Rwanda rwateye imbere ntacyo bimubwiye akiri mu bya kera yari yaramenyereye ku ngoma zindi. Mu nteruro imwe Rudatsimburwa ati “Nta hantu bishobora kubageza kuko nta ruhare bafite no ku banyarwanda”.  Umuzimu wasaritse abarwanya u Rwanda bazawukira? Si ubwa mbere abatavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda, bifatanyije bagashyiraho amahuriro ngo bahuze imbaraga bagere ku mugambi wabo ariko bikarangira bishwanyutse ntacyo bigezeho. Ingero ni nyinshi cyane. Ntawe utazi uko RNC ya Kayumba Nyamwasa yashwanyutse. Uguterana amagambo hagati ya Dr Théogène Rudasingwa na Kayumba Nyamwasa, bari bahuriye muri RNC, mbere y’uko bacikamo ibice, byatumye n’abo bizezaga ibitangaza bacika intege. Aha niho havutsemo amashyaka atemewe mu Rwanda arimo na RRM ya Nsabimana, nayo yacitsemo ibice mbere y’ifatwa rye kubera ubwumvikane buke, gusuzugurana no kutemera uburyo abayobozi bishyira mu myanya. Hari kandi n’amatiku hagati y’abasivili n’abahoze mu gisirikare. RRM igizwe n’abantu ahanini bavuye mu Rwanda bahunze ibyaha bakoze cyangwa andi makosa. Twagiramungu ubwe nawe yashinze ihuriro ry’amashyaka atavuga rumwe na Leta y’u Rwanda (CPC), ryari rigizwe na FDLR, UDR, RDI, CNR, na PS Imberakuri, igice cya gatatu. Abarigize baje kunaniranwa nawe bamushinja igitugu. Muri rusange iyo ugiye kwitegereza umuzimu wasaritse aya mashyaka, ni ugupingana no kuryana, buri wese arwanira kuba ku isonga no guhabwa ibyubahiro by’umukuru w’ishyaka cyangwa uzayobora igihugu igihe bageze ku butegetsi. Rudatsimburwa yongeraho izindi mpamvu abashinga aya mahuriro ntacyo bageraho ari uko ikibagenza ari inyungu zabo bwite, kwitwaza iturufu y’amoko n’intege nke basanganywe. Ati “Ubundi mu mvugo zabo usanga nka Rusesabagina afite akantu ko kuzana iby’amoko, RNC usanga ikibazo bafite ari umuyobozi mukuru. Ni uguhuza gusa ariko ubona ko bafite intege ziri hasi cyane, bakibaza ko guhuza imbaraga byatuma bazamura urwego rw’imbaraga zabo ariko akenshi ubona ko kuba ari abantu bifitiye gahunda zabo bwite, birangira akenshi bashwanye kuko hari aho batazahuza”. Rudatsimburwa akomeza agira ati “Ntibafite ingengabitekerezo ifatika yatuma babona n’imfashanyo, birangirira aho. Mu by’ukuri (Twagiramungu), aba ashaka kwihuza n’abandi kuko nta bushobozi na buke afite, niwe wenyine wibaza ko izina gusa rikurura ariko hashize imyaka 25 uriya muntu ntabwo azwi, ntawe yakurura, nta na benewabo yakurura.” Avuga ko FPR Inkotanyi yashobotse bitewe no guhuza mu bitekerezo byari bifitiye akamaro abanyarwanda bose yaba abari impunzi n’abandi bari mu gihugu babaho mu buzima bw’ingoma ya Habyarimana. Ati “Niyo mpamvu FPR yakuruye abantu n’ubushobozi bw’abo bantu. Ikindi harimo n’abantu bafite ubunararibonye bw’uko niba byanze muri politiki hari uko babikora bakurikije ubushobozi bwo gushoza intambara. Abandi ntabyo bafite, akenshi banafashwa n’abantu bashaka kugirira u Rwanda nabi ariko nabo kubera aho u Rwanda rugeze nta ngaruka yindi bifite uretse gukerereza iterambere ryabo”. U Budage ntibwakwicarana n’abahoze ari aba-Nazi Twagiramungu n’abandi bafatanyije kurwanya ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda, ntibasiba kumvikana bavuga ko bazagaruka mu Rwanda habaye ibiganiro. Rudatsimburwa asanga ntaho ibi biganiro byahera kuko u Rwanda rudaheza kandi ruhora rushishikariza impunzi n’abari mu mahanga gutaha, bityo n’abo bashaka ibiganiro bakwiye gutaha niba hari icyo bahindura ku cyerekezo cy’u Rwanda, bakagikora. Icyakora avuga ko harimo n’abantu kuganira na bo byagereranywa no kuvuga uti ‘u Budage bw’iki gihe bukwiye kwicarana n’abahoze ari aba-Nazi cya gihe cya Hitler’ kuko abuzukuru babo babisabye. Abo Twagiramungu yifatanyije nabo harimo abashyiriweho impapuro mpuzamahanga zibata muri yombi, Rudatsimburwa avuga ko nta kabuza uyu musaza agomba gufatwa nk’umuterabwoba kuko kuba yifatanyije nabo bivuze ko yemera ibyo bakora. Kugeza ubu ikibazwa ni ikidasanzwe ubufatanye bwa MRCD na RDI Rwanda Rwiza buzanye ku buryo bidatinze abantu batazumva iri huriro ryatewe n’umuzimu wasaritse abarwanya u Rwanda, nabo bagacikamo ibice.

title: Impaka z’urudaca kuri Coup d’état yakorewe Kayibanda,Twagiramungu avuga ko yateguriwe muri Zaïre
content:
Faustin Twagiramungu afite aho ahuriye bya hafi na Grégoire Kayibanda kuko ari umukwe we. Mu kiganiro Imvo n’Imvano yashinje André Sebatware wigeze kuba Minisitiri w’Ubutabera ku bwa Kayibanda uruhare rukomeye mu guhirika sebukwe ku butegetsi afatanyije na Habyarimana Juvenal n’abambari be biyise "les camarades du 5 Juillet". Iryo tsinda ryarimo Gen. Maj. Habyarimana wari Minisitiri w’Ingabo na Polisi akaba n’Umugaba Mukuru w’Ingabo, Lt. Col. Kanyarengwe Alexis wayoboraga iseminari nto yo ku Nyundo, Maj. Nsekalije Aloys, Maj. Benda Sabin wayoboraga ikigo cya Camp Kigali, Maj. Ruhashya Epimaque, Maj. Gahimano Fabien wayoboraga ishuri ry’abofisiye i Kigali, Maj. Jean Nepomuscène Munyandekwe, Maj. Serubuga Laurent, Maj. Buregeya Bonaventure, Maj. Ntibitura Bonaventure na Maj. Simba Aloys. Kayibanda yayoboye u Rwanda rukibona ubwigenge tariki 1 Nyakanga 1962 kugeza tariki ya 5 Nyakanga 1973 ubwo yahirikwaga ku butegetsi n’abasirikare bayobowe na Gen. Maj. Habyarimana Juvenal wari Minisitiri w’Ingabo. Ubwo Kayibanda yahirikwaga, Sebatware yari Minisitiri w’Umutekano mu gihugu na nyuma yaho yabaye Perefe w’Umujyi wa Kigali. Mu gitondo cyo ku wa 5 Nyakanga, abahiritse Kayibanda bagiye kuri Radiyo Rwanda babwira abaturage ko bamuhiritse kuko “abanzi b’amahoro badurumbanyije umutekano wa rubanda, bakabiba amacakubiri mu gihugu.” Kayibanda yahiritswe hashize iminsi mu gihugu hari imvururu, abakozi b’abatutsi mu nzego zitandukanye birukanwa, abanyeshuri b’abatutsi mu mashuri bicwa, bakubitwa cyangwa bakirukanwa. Twagiramungu avuga ko guhirika Kayibanda bitari ngombwa kuko nta n’igishya byazanye, ahubwo ngo abari bashinzwe guhosha ibyo bibazo nibo babyitarukije babimugerekaho. Kuba mu gihugu hari umutekano muke, Twagiramungu avuga ko byari inshingano za Sebatware wari Minisitiri w’Umutekano mu gihugu na Habyarimana wari ushinzwe ingabo. Yemeza ko Sebatware na Habyarimana bagize uruhare runini mu guhirika Kayibanda, akanabishingira ku kuba nyuma ya Coup d’état Sebatware yarahawe umwanya muri Leta nshya kandi abandi bakoranye na Kayibanda barafunzwe. Ati “Byari bihagije kugira ngo wowe [Sebatware] na Habyarimana mwumvikane izo mvururu muzihoshe muhe na Perezida raporo. Siko byagenze, byakomeje kuba mwigaramiye abana bakicana mureba, imvururu zikaba mu mashuri mureba, munazogeza.” Kayibanda yasuzuguriwe imbere y’imbaga i Nyamirambo, habura umukiza urubwa
 Kuwa 1 Nyakanga 1973, u Rwanda rwizihizaga imyaka 11 rumaze rubonye ubwigenge. Ubwo Perezida Kayibanda yari amaze akanya gato afashe ijambo, indangururamajwi ye yaracomowe, ijwi ntiryongera kumvikana. Kayibanda wasaga n’uwamaze kumenya ibiri kumutegurirwa, ngo yaravuze ati “Abashaka gukora coup d’état ngaho nimuyikore”. Sebatware avuga ko indangururamajwi imaze gucika, abatekinisiye barimo n’umuzungu bahise bajya kureba ibibaye, basanga ni ‘fusible’ yari igize ikibazo, barayisimbuza umuriro urongera uragaruka. Hashize akandi kanya gato, hari umusore waje wiruka ashaka kujya aho Kayibanda yavugiraga ijambo, abantu bamufata ataramugeraho. Sebatware agira ati “Nagiye kubona mbona agahungu karaje, ariko katarahagera hahagurutse abantu bagera kuri 200, baragafata ntabwo kigeze kagera kuri Kayibanda ngo kamwambure indangururamajwi. Ako gahungu kakoraga mu biro by’abinjira n’abasohoka, serivisi yo muri Minisiteri yanjye ku kibuga cy’indege.” Uwo musore waturukaga mu Ruhengeri, Sebatware avuga ko yari amaze iminsi asabye ko bamufunga kuko yari yaranyereje amafaranga ya Leta yakirwaga n’urwego rushinzwe abinjira n’abasohoka ku kibuga cy’indege ariko ntibyakorwa. Sebatware nka Minisitiri wari ushinzwe umutekano, ngo yongeye gusaba ko uwo musore atabwa muri yombi kuko yashatse kuvogera umutekano wa Perezida ariko abasirikare barabyanga. Ati “Bagiye kumufata abasirikare barabyanga. Iyo dosiye nyiheruka icyo gihe, ni uko byagenze.” Twagiramungu, umukwe wa Kayibanda yavuze ko biteye isoni, kuba Perezida asuzugurwa mu ruhame, Minisitiri w’umutekano n’uw’ingabo bakicecekera nk’aho nta cyabaye. Yemeza ko Sebatware na Habyarimana bari mu kagambane ko guhirika Kayibanda nyamara aribo ibibazo igihugu cyari gifite byarebaga. Ati “Tekereza Perezida arafata indangururamajwi, mukohereza umuntu ujya kuyimwambura , Perezida akumirwa ntihagire n’umwe uvuga ati umuntu wambuye micro Perezida agomba gufatwa agafungwa.” Mu gihe Kayibanda yashakaga kuva ku butegetsi, umugambi wo kumuhirika wanogerezwaga muri Zaïre
 Mu Ukwakira 1995, Twagiramungu wari umaze iminsi yeguye nka Minisitiri w’Intebe mu Rwanda avuga ko yagiye muri Zaïre, akabonana na Perezida Mobutu Sese Seko. Mu minsi itanu yamaze muri icyo gihugu, ngo yasobanukiwe itegurwa ry’umugambi wo guhirika sebukwe ku butegetsi. Ati “Mu Ukwakira 1995 nagiye i Kinshasa njya n’i Gbadolite. Nahamaze iminsi itanu nganira na Mobutu. I Kinshasa nabonye n’ishuri abantu bajyaga baza kwigiramo ukuntu bazakora Coup d’état.” Avuga ko Sebatware ari umwe mu bari mu gatsiko kahiritse Kayibanda kuko ngo hari n’abantu yingingiye kujya muri ako gatsiko kagombaga kuvana Perezida ku butegetsi. Umunsi Kayibanda yahiritsweho, niwo munsi hagombaga kuba kongere rusange y’ishyaka rye MDR Parmehutu, aho byari biteganyijwe ko gutora uzarihagararira mu matora ya Perezida yari kuba muri Nzeri. Byari bimaze iminsi bihwihwiswa ko Kayibanda ashaka kuguma ku butegetsi dore ko yari yamaze guhindura Itegeko Nshinga, akavanamo ingingo zimubuza kwiyamamaza inshuro ashaka. Nyuma yo gusuzugurirwa i Nyamirambo, Twagiramungu avuga ko Kayibanda yahise yivanamo ibyo kuguma ku butegetsi ku buryo yari yateguye kubwira kongere y’ishyaka ko agiye kwegura. Ati “Ntabwo Perezida Kayibanda yigeze ashaka kuguma ku buperezida bumaze kumutezaho amahane kuva kuri iyo tariki. Ntimwanatumye na kongere iba ngo yegure. N’amazina y’abantu bagombaga kumusimbura yari ayafite agomba kuyatanga muri kongere.” “Tariki 5 nibwo kongere yanyu y’ishyaka yagombaga guterana, wenda mwari kurangiza izo mvururu na Perezida Kayibanda mukamuvanaho bibaye ngombwa.” Twagiramungu asanga Sebatware na Habyarimana aribo nyirabayazana ba coup d’état yakorewe Kayibanda, kuko iyo babishaka ntiyari kuba. Yakomeje agira ati  “Perezida ni wowe washoboraga kumurengera, iyo ubwira Habyarimana uti nta Coup d’état mbona ikenewe, ntabyo yari gukora.  Iyo mushaka ko itaba ntiyari kuba ariko mwarabyifuje yarabaye kandi yatugejeje ku marorerwa.” Sebatware ahakana kugira uruhare mu ihirikwa rya Kayibanda, akavuga ko umugambi wo kumuvana ku butegetsi ntawo yamenye. Yemeza ko imvururu zibasiye abatutsi mu mashuri no mu kazi ka Leta yagiye aziganiraho n’abo bireba ndetse ngo hari nubwo yatumije inama y’abaperefe igamije kuzihosha ngo zitagera mu baturage. Kayibanda amaze guhirikwa ku butegetsi yatawe muri yombi, ajya gufungirwa i Rwerere mu Ruhengeri, acunzwe n’abasirikare 15. Nta burenganzira yari afite bwo gusurwa cyangwa gukora icyo ashatse. Yaje gupfa tariki 15 Ukuboza mu 1976 azize indwara itaramenyekana. Bivugwa ko ashobora kuba yararozwe cyangwa agahotorwa. Ikiganiro kirambuye na Maj. (Rtd) Gatarayiha Augustin ku ihirikwa ku butegetsi ryakorewe Kayibanda

title: Ingabo z’Abafaransa zavuze imyato Opération Turquoise yakingiye ikibaba abajenosideri
content: Ku wa 22 Kamena mu 1994, Loni ibisabwe n’u Bufaransa yafashe umwanzuro No 929 ubwemerera kohereza ingabo zabwo mu Rwanda mu cyiswe “Opération Turquoise”, yafatwaga nk’igamije ibikorwa by’ubutabazi ku bari mu kaga. Izi ngabo zagiye muri “Zone Turquoise” yari igice kigizwe n’ahahoze Perefegitura za Cyangugu, Gikongoro na Kibuye ari naho hiciwe Abatutsi benshi nyuma yo gutabwa n’ingabo z’Abafaransa mu maboko y’Interahamwe. Abafaransa baje mu Rwanda bitwaje intwaro za karahabutaka bisa naho biteguye kurwana inkundura. Bari bitwaje indege z’intambara zirenga 30 abasirikare 2500, kandi byari bizwi ko icyo gihugu cyari gifitanye umubano mwiza na leta yari iriho yaba iy’abatazi n’iyari yarayibanjirije zarimo zica Abatutsi uruhondogo. Ku wa 14 Kamena 2019, i Paris habereye umuhango wakoze mu buryo bwa rwihishwa wo gushimira abasirikare bari muri iki gikorwa mu Rwanda. Mu kiganiro cyahejwemo itangazamakuru, Minisitiri w’Ingabo w’u Bufaransa, Florence Parly, yavuze ijambo ashima abahoze muri Opération Turquoise. Jeune Afrique yatangaje ko inyandiko yashyizeho umukono kuri uwo munsi igaragaza amakuru yatanze. Igira iti “Ku wa 7 Mata, Perezida wa Repubulika yatangaje ko iyo tariki izaba umunsi wo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Bufaransa. Hari n’ubushake bwo guha ijambo abagabo n’abagore bari aho icyo kibi cyabereye.’’ Yananditse ko hakwiye gushimwa no guha icyubahiro abanyuze muri Opération Turquoise. Ni ubutumwa bwakiriwe neza n’abarimo abari ku rutonde rw’abasirikare 22, amateka agaragaza uruhare rwabo muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, haba mu kuyitegura, kuyikora cyangwa mu kugambana ariko babyihunza. Muri bo ni Général Erik de Stabenrath, wayoboye Opération Turquoise ku Gikongoro kuva tariki ya 16 Nyakanga kugeza 22 Kanama 1994. Yagize ati “Nishimiye cyane kuko bwa mbere numvise umunyapolitiki ashyigikira Opération Turquoise.’’ Bamwe mu basirikare bari muri Opération Turquoise bemeye kuvugisha ukuri, bagaragaza ko icyari cyabazanye mu Rwanda atari ibikorwa by’ubutabazi ndetse ko nta n’icyo bakoze ngo abatutsi badakomeza kwicwa. Rtd. Lieutenant Colonel Guillaume Ancel na we wari mu Rwanda mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, yakunze guhamya ko intego nyamukuru ya ‘Opération Turquoise’, atari ukurokora ubuzima bw’inzirakarengane zicwaga ahubwo yari ugushyigikira Guverinoma yakoze Jenoside. Ancel yanagaragaje ko ingabo z’u Bufaransa zahaye intwaro Leta yakoze Jenoside, ikaza no kuzihungana mu nkambi zo muri Zaïre, aho yisuganyirizaga ishaka kugaruka gutera igihugu cyari cyafashwe na FPR Inkotanyi. Ubuhamya bw’abarokokeye mu Bisesero aho Ingabo z’Abafaransa zari bugaragaza ko Abafaransa bari bafite umugambi wo gufasha Guverinoma yakoze Jenoside gutsemba Abatutsi no kuyiharurira inzira ngo ibashe guhunga ingabo za FPR-Inkotanyi zahagarikaga Jenoside. Bavuga ko batakambiye Ingabo z’u Bufaransa ngo zibakure mu maboko y’Interahamwe n’abasirikare bari bamaze kubicamo abarenga ibihumbi 40, ziterera agati mu ryinyo kugeza ubwo abandi barenga 4000 bishwe mu minsi itatu gusa. Ishimwe ryaturiwe ku ngabo zahoze muri ‘Opération Turquoise’ ryanakiriwe neza n’Umugaba Mukuru w’Ingabo, Général François Gérard Marie Lecointre. Uyu yari capitaine mu ngabo zirwanira mu mazi, akaba mu gihe cya Jenoside yari ashinzwe Segiteri ya Gisovu, imwe mu zari zigize iyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Kibuye. Yagize ati “Ni ubwa mbere umuyobozi mu gisirikare turi ku rwego rumwe, afashe ijambo mu kiganiro nk’iki.’’ Abasirikare bakuru bayoboye Turquoise i Cyangugu, Kibuye na Gikongoro bashinjwa ibyaha bikomeye byakozwe muri icyo gihe. Nka Jean-Claude Lafourcade yari Umuyobozi w’Ikirenga w’Ingabo z’Abafaransa zari muri Turquoise kuva tariki 22 Kamena kugeza 22 Kanama 1994. Inyandiko ya CNLG ku ruhare rw’Abasirikare b’u Bufaransa muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, igaragaza ko muri Turquoise, iyo hataba ubufatanye bw’abasirikare b’Abafaransa bari bayobowe na Gen. Lafourcade, ibyaha byakorewe ahahoze ari Cyangugu, Kibuye no ku Gikongoro bitari kuba. Ivuga ko ibyo byaha byashyigikiwe mu buryo bw’ibikoresho nk’intwaro, imodoka zitwara abantu n’ibintu ndetse n’amavuta (carburant) yazo byose bitangwa n’abasirikare b’Abafaransa. Nyamara, inshingano Loni yari yahaye Turquoise yashimangiraga ko “ari ubufasha buhabwa abantu kandi nta kurobanura”. Nko mu nkambi ya Murambi, abasirikare b’Abafaransa bayicungaga, babazaga ubwoko buri wese uyinjiyemo. Imbere mu nkambi, CNLG yavuze ko bashyiraga hamwe abarokotse jenoside, abasirikare ba FAR ndetse n’Interahamwe zari zimaze gukora jenoside. Ibi byahaye Interahamwe umwanya wo gukomeza ubwicanyi nyamara byaravugwaga ko ari ahantu hagenewe kugoboka abantu. Abanyamakuru b’abanyamahanga bahigereye kuva muri Nyakanga kugeza muri Kanama 1994 bavuze ukuntu abarokotse bageramiwe n’ubwicanyi bwakorwaga n’Interahamwe. Ubwicanyi, gusambanya ku ngufu byakorerwaga aho Lieutenant-Colonel Eric De Stabenrath wayoboraga aka gace yari atuye.

title: Perezida Kagame yishimiye ko mugenzi we Ali Bongo wa Gabon yorohewe (Amafoto)
content: Perezida Kagame yabigaragaje kuri uyu wa Mbere ku munsi wa mbere w’uruzinduko rwe rw’iminsi ibiri i Libreville muri Gabon. Mu kiganiro yagiranye n’itangazamakuru ryo muri Gabon, Perezida Kagame yavuze ko yaje gukomeza gutsura umubano mwiza uri hagati y’ibihugu byombi no gusura mugenzi we Ali Bongo uri koroherwa nyuma y’igihe arwaye. Mu Ukwakira umwaka ushize nibwo Perezida Bongo yajyanywe mu bitaro i Riyadh muri Arabie Saoudite nyuma yo gufatwa n’indwara yo kwangirika kw’imitsi y’ubwonko. Muri Mutarama yasubiye mu gihugu cye amaze koroherwa, akomeza gukurikiranirwa hafi n’abaganga. Perezida Kagame yavuze ko bishimishije kuba Bongo yarorohewe akanasubira mu nshingano ze. Yagize ati “Nishimiye kuza hano muri Gabon gukomeza inzira yo kwimakaza umubano uri hagati ya Gabon n’u Rwanda. Ni n’umwanya kuri njye wo gusura mugenzi wanjye wari umaze igihe arwaye. Nishimiye ko yorohewe akanakomeza inshingano ze.” Yakomeje agira ati “Mu muco w’abanyafurika, inshuti dusurana mu bihe byiza no mu bibi.” Perezida Kagame yavuze ko Gabon, by’umwihariko Perezida Bongo yagiye agira uruhare runini mu gushyigikira intego zigamije guteza imbere Afurika. Ati “Gabon yagiye iharanira inyungu za Afurika, icyerecyezo n’ingamba zigamije kugera kuri icyo cyerecyezo. Perezida Bongo yagize uruhare runini mu gukorana n’abandi bayobozi ku mugabane wacu, mu kuzamura urwego rw’iterambere ryacu”. Mu kwezi gutaha nibwo byitezwe ko muri Afurika hazatangizwa ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’amasezerano ashyiraho isoko rusange rya Afurika. Gabon iri mu bihugu 44 byashyize umukono ku masezerano ashyiraho isoko rusange ry’ibihugu bihurira mu Muryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe, AU, azwi nka AfCFTA. Ibihugu 22 bisabwa kuyemeza burundu ngo ashyirwe mu bikorwa byarabonetse ndetse biteganyijwe ko mu kwezi gutaha azatangizwa ku mugaragaro. Agaruka kuri ayo masezerano, Perezida Kagame yabwiye abanyamakuru ko ibihugu byose bya Afurika bizi akamaro kayo ku buryo n’ibitarayasinya bizabikora. Ati “N’ibihugu bitarayemeza burundu si uko bitabona inyungu cyangwa ngo bibone ko ari ngombwa ahubwo biracyafite ingorane mu bijyanye n’amategeko n’ibindi  bya tekiniki bagomba kubanza gukemura mbere yo kuyashyira mu bikorwa.” Yagarutse kandi ku muti watuma amakimbirane ahora agaragara hirya no hino muri Afurika acika, avuga ko bisaba ubufatanye bw’ibihugu bigize uwo mugabane. U Rwanda na Gabon bisanzwe bifitanye umubano mwiza. Byombi bihuriye mu Muryango w’Ubukungu bw’Ibihugu bya Afurika yo Hagati, CEEAC. U Rwanda na Gabon basinyanye amasezerano y’imikoranire mu 1976, aza kuvugururwa mu 2010. Bifitanye ubuhahirane buhagaze neza dore ko indege ya RwandAir ikorera ingendo mu Mujyi wa Libreville. Muri Kamena 2016 ibihugu byombi byakuyeho amafaranga yacibwaga umuntu ukoresheje umurongo wa telefoni mu guhamagara hagati yabyo.

title: Perezida Kagame yageze  muri Gabon mu ruzinduko rw’iminsi ibiri
content: Ibiro by’Umukuru w’Igihugu bibinyujije kuri Twitter, byatangaje ko Perezida Kagame yamaze kugera muri Gabon ndetse aragirana ibiganiro na mugenzi we Ali Bongo Ondimba mu biro bye. Mu itangazo Ibiro bya Perezidansi ya Gabon byageneye itangazamakuru byavuze ko abakuru b’ibihugu byombi baganira ku mubano uri hagati y’ibihugu bayoboye n’icyerekezo ukwiye kugira mu gihe kizaza. Mu biganiro byabo hitezwe ko bavuga ku bijyanye n’ubukungu bw’umugabane wa Afurika binyuze mu turere bayoboye. Perezida Ali Bongo ayoboye Umuryango w’Ubukungu bw’Ibihugu bya Afurika yo Hagati, CEEAC mu gihe Perezida Kagame afite inshingano zo kuyobora Umuryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, EAC, yahawe muri Gashyantare 2019. Gabon iri mu bihugu 44 byashyize umukono ku masezerano ashyiraho isoko rusange ry’ibihugu bihurira mu Muryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe, AU,  azwi nka AfCFTA. Aya masezerano yatangirijwe i Kigali muri Werurwe 2018, yamaze kwemezwa burundu; biteganyijwe ko azatangira gushyirwa mu bikorwa muri Nyakanga 2019, ubwo hazaba hateranye Inteko rusange y’Abakuru b’Ibihugu bya AU. Perezida Kagame abaye umukuru w’igihugu wa Gatandatu watumiwe muri Gabon nyuma y’amasaha 48, iki gihugu kivuye mu muhango wo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 10, Omar Bongo Ondimba, wabaye ku wa 8 Kamena 2019.  Perezida wa Gabon Ali Bongo Ondimba aheruka mu Rwanda tariki 13 Gashyantare 2018 mu ruzinduko rw’akazi rw’umunsi umwe. Abakuru b’ibihugu byombi bagiranye ibiganiro muri Village Urugwiro, byibanda ku buhahirane hagati y’ibihugu n’umutekano mu karere. Banaganiriye ku mavugurura y’Umuryango wa CEEAC, ibihugu byombi bihuriyemo. Gabon ikungahaye ku bucukuzi bwa peteroli, ubucuruzi bw’imbaho n’amabuye y’agaciro. U Rwanda na Gabon basinyanye amasezerano y’imikoranire mu 1976, aza kuvugururwa mu 2010.Bifitanye ubuhahirane buhagaze neza dore ko indege ya RwandAir ikorera ingendo mu Mujyi wa Libreville. Muri Kamena 2016, ibihugu byombi byakuyeho amafaranga yacibwaga umuntu ukoresheje umurongo wa telefoni mu guhamagara hagati yabyo.

title: Imyaka 19 iruzuye! Icyumweru u Rwanda rwahereyemo isomo Uganda bigacura inzigo itarasibangana
content: Hano itandukaniro ry’uko amateka y’u Rwanda ari ay’ejo bundi mu 2000, mu gihe aya Israel hari mu 1967. Mu cyumweru nk’iki mu 2000, by’umwihariko uhereye tariki ya 5 kugera tariki ya 10 Kamena, ingabo z’u Rwanda zasakiranye n’iza Uganda, UPDF ihahurira n’uruva gusenya. Amateka y’umubano w’u Rwanda na Uganda ushatse wayahera mu 1981-1986 ubwo Yoweri Museveni yari mu rugamba rwakuyeho ubutegetsi bwa Milton Obote. Igisirikare cyamufashije cyarimo ahanini impunzi z’Abanyarwanda barimo na Perezida Paul Kagame wayoboye ubutasi icyo gihe ndetse akanaza kuyobora urugamba rwo kubohora u Rwanda nyuma y’urupfu rwa Fred Rwigema wishwe rugikubita. Kuba abanyarwanda bafashije Yoweri Museveni kugera ku butegetsi baratangije urugamba rwo kubohora u Rwanda baturutse muri Uganda byatumye Museveni yishyiramo ko u Rwanda igihugu cye kirufiteho ijambo, mbese ko ba basirikare bari muri NRA bazakomeza guhabwa amategeko aturutse i Kampala n’igihe bageze mu gihugu cy’inkomoko. Nyuma yo kubohora u Rwanda no guhagarika Jenoside, Inkotanyi zamenesheje abayikoraga bahungira mu mashyamba ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo yitwaga Zaire, hakurikiraho urugamba rwo gucyura impunzi zari zarabaye ingwate yabo muri ayo mashyamba. Uganda yatumiwe muri urwo rugamba nk’inshuti ariko igahora ishaka ko ibikorwa by’indashyikirwa by’Ingabo z’u Rwanda biyitirirwa, mu gihe Abanyarwanda bagejeje Museveni ku butegetsi bo ayo mateka bari barayasize i Kampala. Imvano y’intambara ya Kisangani Nyuma haje urugamba rwo gukuraho Mobutu Sese Seko no kugeza Kabila ku butegetsi. U Rwanda rwafatanyije na Uganda ariko icyo gihugu kiza kwibanda cyane ku gusahura imitungo kamere, kandi mu mutwe kigahorana ko ahari Umunyarwanda n’umunya-Uganda, umuturanyi wo mu majyaruguru aza mbere. Mu Ntambara ya II ya Congo, Ingabo za Uganda zaritabiriye ariko RDF ifata bwangu imijyi itandukanye mu Burasirazuba n’Amajyepfo y’Iburasirazuba bwa RDC harimo Umujyi wa Kisangani n’ikibuga cy’indege cya Bangoka giherereye ku bilometero 12 mu nkengero zawo. UPDF ku rundi ruhande yo yibanze ku duce dukungahaye ku mabuye y’agaciro two mu Majyaruguru y’Iburasirazuba bwa RDC. Mu gihe imirwano yari ihagaritswe by’agateganyo, UPDF nta mujyi yari yagafashe wo kuba igumyemo. Abayobozi b’ingabo za Uganda basabye u Rwanda kubaha Kisangani kubera ko rwari rufite n’indi mijyi nka Goma, Bukavu, Kindu, Uvira n’indi. Abayobozi b’ingabo z’u Rwanda barabyanga. Icyo gisubizo ntabwo cyakiriwe neza n’abayobozi b’ingabo za Uganda. Mu nama yabereye i Goma yarimo uwari uhagarariye Mwalimu Julius Nyerere, Kahinda Otafiire wari ukuriye itsinda rya Uganda mu biganiro, yabwiye itsinda ry’u Rwanda ati “muraduha Kisangani cyangwa twembi tuyibure.” Nk’uko Colonel Akhram Hossein wo mu ngabo za Loni yabitangarije Ikinyamakuru Liberation, mu rukerera rwo ku wa 05 Kanama 2000 nibwo ingabo za Uganda zigera ku 7000 zitwaje ibitwaro biremereye, zatunguye iz’u Rwanda zizimishaho ibisasu. Kuva ubwo rurambikana, Igisirikare cy’u Rwanda gikora ku ntwaro zacyo kirasa kitababariye ingabo za Uganda, gitwika ibifaru bya UPDF karahava, ingabo za Uganda zihatakariza abasirikare babarwa ko bageraga mu 2000. Muri iyo mirwano, Ingabo za Uganda zaharaniraga kwambuka ikiraro kiri ku mugezi wa Tshopo gitandukanya Kisangani y’Amajyepfo yarimo Ingabo z’u Rwanda n’iy’Amajyaruguru yarimo iza Uganda, ariko ingabo z’u Rwanda zizibera ibamba. Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru, Col Karenzi Karake (ubu ni Rtd Lieutenant General) wari uyoboye Ingabo z’u Rwanda i Kisangani, yabwiye The Washington Post ku wa 12 Kanama 2000, ko ibyabaye hagati y’ingabo z’ibihugu byombi nta gishimishije kirimo. Yakomeje ati “Ariko ni bo baturasheho. Twatsinze urugamba kuko abasirikare bacu bazi icyo barwanira. Tugiye gusohoka muri Kisangani tutitaye ku byo Abanya-Uganda bashaka.” Icyo gihe yari amaze kwitegereza toni z’ibisasu, imbunda n’ibindi bikoresho ingabo za Uganda zari zimaze kuhasiga zihunga. Umunsi urugamba rwahagaze, Gen James Kazini wari uyoboye Ingabo za Uganda i Kisangani yabanje guhamagara Col Karenzi ku cyombo amusaba ko imirwano yahagarara, ndetse Ingabo za Uganda zisubira inyuma ibilometero bisaga icumi hanze ya Kisangani. Col Danilo Paiva wo mu ngabo za Loni i Kisangani, ni we watangaje bwa nyuma ko agahenge kabonetse, nyuma y’ubuhuza bwa Perezida wa Zambia, Frederic Chiluba wari ukubutse Kampala na Kigali kubonana na ba Perezida Museveni na Paul Kagame bakaganira ku buryo haboneka umuti urambye kuri aya makimbirane. Kuva iyo ntambara yarangira mu myaka 19 ishize, Museveni ahorana ikidodo ku bisobanuro yasabwa ku bana ba Uganda yashoye mu ntambara idafututse akanayitsindwa, abanya-Uganda bakahagwa ari benshi. Ibi byatumye arushaho kwijundika ibi bya cyane u Rwanda. Uganda yasabye u Bwongereza inkunga yo gutera u Rwanda Ku wa 28 Kanama 2000 nibwo Museveni yandikiye Umunyamabanga wa Leta w’u Bwongereza ushinzwe iterambere mpuzamahanga, Claire Short, ibaruwa amusaba ko Uganda yahabwa inkunga yisumbuye ikava kuri Miliyoni 113$ ikagera kuri Miliyoni 139 z’Amadolari, mu rwego rwo kwigaranzura igisirikare cy’u Rwanda. Muri urwo rwandiko, Uganda yavugaga ko u Rwanda rwamaze gutegura umutwe w’ingabo ugizwe n’abasirikare 100.000 wo guhirika ubutegetsi bwa Museveni. Ibi ariko uwari Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga w’u Rwanda, Ambasaderi André Bumaya yabiteye utwatsi, abwira PanaPress ikorera i Dakar muri Senegal ko ahubwo ari Uganda yari mu macenga yo gushaka gutera u Rwanda. Yagize ati “Ntituri mu myiteguro yo gutera Uganda na mba, u Rwanda rushishikajwe no gukemura ibibazo rwasigiwe na jenoside, bityo rero nta mwanya rufite wo kurwana intambara z’amafuti”. Uganda yakurikijeho guhimba ikinyoma cy’uko u Rwanda rwateraga inkunga umutwe wa PRA (People’s Redemption Army), byavugwaga ko wari uyobowe na Col Samson Mande na Antony Kyakabale ngo bashakaga guhirika ubutegetsi bwa Yoweri Kaguta Museveni. Museveni ntarakira ugutsindwa Mu kiganiro kirekire Perezida Kagame yagiranye n’ikinyamakuru Jeune Afrique cyasohotse ku wa 23 Werurwe 2019 ubwo yaganiraga n’Umunyamakuru François Soudan, yabajijwe niba bidashoboka ko Museveni yaba atarakira kuba Ingabo z’u Rwanda zaratsindiye ize i Kisangani mu myaka 20 ishize. Aha yashingiraga ku bushotoranyi budasiba bwa Uganda ku Rwanda, burimo n’iyicarubozo rikomeje gukorerwa abaturage barwo muri icyo gihugu cy’abaturanyi. Mu gusubiza yagize ati “ Twabatsinze ubugira gatatu, ni ukuri, ahari ushobora kuba ufite ukuri. Ariko nta gushidikanya hari ibindi bisobanuro. Ubushake bwo gushaka kugenzura u Rwanda, kuducisha bugufi? Birashoka. ” Perezida Kagame yavuze ko yubaha Museveni nka Perezida wa Uganda ariko ‘ntabwo ari Perezida w’u Rwanda nta nubwo azigera aba we. Bigomba gukemuka. Ntabwo dukunda abantu baduha amabwiriza, aho yaba aturutse hose, ibyo urabizi neza.” Umukuru w’Igihugu yakomeje agira ati “Mu ngano, u Rwanda ni igihugu gito, ariko mu ntekerezo no mu rwego rwa Politiki ni igihugu cya rutura.” Yanavuze ko nta muhuza ukenewe kugira ngo ibibazo by’u Rwanda na Uganda bikemuke ahubwo ko byose bishingiye kuri Museveni. Ati “Izingiro ry’ikibazo riri muri Uganda, riri mu biganza bya Museveni.”

title: Abanyamategeko basabye umuryango mpuzamahanga gukurikirana ihohoterwa ry’Abanyarwanda muri Uganda
content: Hashize imyaka igera kuri ibiri umubano w’ibihugu byombi udahagaze neza. Byakajije umurego mu mwaka ushize ubwo amagana y’Abanyarwanda bafatwaga umusubizo bagatoterezwa mu bigo by’inzego zishinzwe umutekano bashinjwa ubutasi, ariko ntibagezwe mu butabera. Umwuka warushijeho kuba mubi muri Werurwe uyu mwaka ubwo Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yagiraga inama abaturage bayo kudakomeza kujya muri Uganda kubw’umutekano wabo. Bamwe mu banyamategeko bunganira Abanyarwanda bafunzwe mu buryo budakurikije amategeko muri Uganda, bavuze ko abakiliya babo bakomeje gufatwa nabi n’icyo gihugu. Mu kiganiro baherutse kugirana n’abanyamakuru, Umunyamategeko Gawaya Tegulle na  Aboneka Michael bunganira abanyarwanda bafunzwe ndetse n’Umuyobozi w’Umuryango w’abanyamategeko muri Uganda, Francis Harimwomugasho bagaragaje ko ikibazo gikomeje gufata indi ntera. Bavuze ko amagana y’Abanyarwanda basanzwe bakomeje gufungirwa mu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko muri gereza z’Urwego rushinzwe ubutasi bwa gisirikare (CMI) ndetse n’iz’Urwego rushinzwe umutekano imbere mu gihugu (ISO), nyamara ntibagezwe mu butabera ngo bisobanure. Aba banyamategeko bavuze ko abo Banyarwanda bakorerwa iyicarubozo ku buryo hakenewe ko umuryango mpuzamahnga winjira muri icyo kibazo kugira ngo gihagarare kuko ‘kimaze kurenga igaruriro’. Tegulle yavuze ko nk’abanyamategeko bunganira abanyarwanda bafunzwe, bababajwe n’amagambo aherutse kuvugwa na Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga wa Uganda Sam Kutesa, aho yavuze ko Abanyarwanda bafatwa ari ababa bakoze ibinyuranyije n’amategeko. Yagize ati “Ibyatangajwe na Kutesa ni ibinyoma. Yagerageje guca hejuru y’ibibazo nyabyo birebana n’abantu bafunzwe n’imiryango yabo, abantu bangirijwe ubuzima n’inzego zishinzwe umutekano muri Uganda.” Yakomeje avuga ati “Hari abana batazi aho ababyeyi babo bari, abagore batazi aho abagabo babo baherereye n’ababyeyi batizeye niba bazongera guca iryera abana babo.” Tegulle yavuze ko Abanyarwanda bafunzwe batemerewe guhura n’imiryango yabo, abanyametegeko babo cyangwa ngo bahabwe serivisi z’ubuvuzi. Yavuze ko ahubwo bakorerwa iyicarubozo hagamijwe kubavanamo amakuru kugeza ubwo ugutakamba kw’ababunganira Leta ya Uganda yakwimye amatwi. Inkiko zimaze kwandika inyandiko 12 zisaba ko Abanyarwanda bafunzwe mu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko bagezwa imbere y’ubutabera, nyamara abagejejwe mu rukiko ni Claude Iyakaremye, Réne Rutagungira, Emmanuel Rwamucyo na  Augustine Rutayisire bose bagejejwe mu rukiko rwa gisirikare kandi ari abasivile nkuko ikinyamakuru The Observer cyabitangaje. Tegulle ati “Mu minsi sihize, Robert Tumwine yarekuwe yarakorewe iyicarubozo hafi yo gupfa, ajugunywa i Mbarara mu rugo rwa mushiki we ameze nk’uwapfuye. Nyuma gato yaje gupfa. Niba hari itegeko ryishwe, ryishwe n’inzego z’umutekano ntabwo ari imfungwa.” Umuyobozi w’Umuryango w’abanyamategeko muri Uganda, Harimwomugasho yavuze ko Guverinoma ya Uganda ikomeje kwirengagiza ibyemezo by’inkiko. Yagize ati “Mu gihe urukiko rubifitiye ububasha rufashe umwanzuro, uba ugomba  kubahwa. Twamaganye twivuye inyuma uwo ari we wese uhabwa amategeko ntayubahirize. Niba Guverinoma iba idashimishijwe n’ibyo byemezo byafashwe, ijye ijurira.” Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ivuga ko abanyarwanda basaga 900 bafungiye muri Uganda mu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko. U Rwanda kandi rushinja icyo gihugu gukorana n’abashaka kuruhungabanyiriza umutekano, ari nabo bivugwa ko bakorana bya hafi n’inzego z’umutekano muri icyo gihugu mu gufata no gutoteza Abanyarwanda badashaka gukorana nabo.

title: Ancel yasobanuye uko Ingabo z’u Bufaransa zasabwe gusenya ibirindiro bya FPR  mu 1994 ngo idafata Kigali
content: Ancel ni umwe mu basirikare 2500 boherejwe  mu Rwanda tariki 22 Kamena 1994, mu cyiswe Opération Turquoise bafite inshingano zo guhagarika Jenoside no gushyiraho igice kizwi nka Zone Turquoise mu Burengerazuba bw’u Rwanda kitagombaga kurangwamo imirwano. Tariki 29 Gicurasi uyu mwaka, mu Ishuri Rikuru ryo mu Bufaransa ryigisha ubumenyi rusange, EHESS, ishami ry’uburenganzira bwa muntu habereye ibiganiro bigamije kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri Mata 1994. Mu bari batumiwe muri ibyo biganiro, harimo Rtd Lieutenant Colonel Guillaume Ancel, ni umwanditsi w’ibitabo birimo icyitwa, Rwanda, la fin du silence. Yavuze ko ubwo boherezwaga mu Rwanda muri Opération Turquoise, ibyo bari bagiye gukora babisobanuriwe habura amasaha abiri gusa ngo bahaguruke. Mu byo yasobanuriwe, yaje kumenya ko u Bufaransa bufite uruhare mu ntambara yari imaze imyaka ine iri mu Rwanda, hagati y’Ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi n’iza Leta y’u Rwanda. Yavuze ko Ingabo z’u Bufaransa zari mu Rwanda zagiye zigira uruhare mu bitero bigamije gusenya ibirindiro bya FPR Inkotanyi, bukanafasha Leta mu bikorwa yari irimo byo kurimbura abatutsi. Guillaume Ancel w’imyaka 53, avuga ko ubwoko bw’intwaro bahagurukanye mu Bufaransa bazanye mu Rwanda, zabagaragazaga ko baje mu ntambara aho gutabara abaturage nkuko ubutumwa bari bajemo bwavugaga. Nk’Ingabo zirwanira ku butaka zarimo abakomando bo muri (RPIMa) Regiment Parachutistes d’Infanterie de Marine, bafite intwaro zirasa hafi ndetse na kure harimo n’izikoreshwa mu ijoro, abarwanisha ibifaru n’abandi benshi bafite indege z’intambara za kajugujugu 10 bita Gazelle n’izindi eshatu za Super-Puma. Ingabo zirwanira mu kirere zari zifite indege zirenga 30 harimo za C-130 Hercules, Falcon -20, C-160 TRANSALL na CASA-235. Ingabo zo mu kirere kandi zakodesheje indege imwe ya Airbus, Boing 747 imwe, Antonov-124 Condor cumi na ziriindwi (17) zo gutwara ibikoresho bya gisirikare. Yavuze ko ubwo bageraga i Goma muri Zaïre (Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo y’ubu), bari bahawe amabwiriza yo kurinda Umujyi wa Kigali ngo utava mu maboko ya Leta yakoraga Jenoside ukajya mu maboko ya FPR yari mu rugamba rwo kubohora igihugu. Mu buryo butunguranye, Ancel avuga ko amabwiriza yahindutse ku munota wa nyuma bagasabwa kurasa ku birindiro by’ingabo za FPR kugira ngo bayihagarike idakomeza gufata uduce dutandukanye tw’igihugu. Ubwo bageraga mu Bisesero, kamwe mu duce twari muri Zone Turquoise, Ancel avuga ko batunguwe no kubona Leta bashyigikiriye ariyo iri kwiyicira abaturage, aho ibihumbi bisaga 60 by’abatutsi byari bimaze kwicwa. Ngo aho niho bongeye guhererwa amabwiriza mashya, basabwa guhagarika imirwano ahubwo bakajya mu bikorwa by’ubutabazi. Ikinyamakuru Esprit cyatangaje ko mu buhamya bwe yakomeje avuga ko nubwo kari agace k’ubutabazi, kanabaye aka politiki kuko bahafashirije Ingabo za Leta yari imaze gukora Jenoside zigahunga nta nkomyi zigana muri Zaïre, ndetse bakabaherekeza bakabagezayo amahoro. Guillaume Ancel mu buhamya yatanze, yanavuze ko we ubwe ari umwe mu basirikare b’u Bufaransa batanze intwaro ku Ngabo za Leta yari imaze gukora Jenoside ubwo  yari mu buhungiro muri Zaïre. Ubusanzwe amategeko mpuzamahanga ntabwo yemera ko impunzi zijya mu kindi gihugu zifite intwaro cyangwa se ngo zihabwe intwaro. Iryo tegeko ryo gufasha Leta yakoze Jenoside mu buhungiro ngo ryatanzwe n’Ibiro bya Perezida François Mitterrand, nyuma yo kwemezwa n’ibiro by’umugaba mukuru w’ingabo. Ancel avuga ko ntaho u Bufaransa bushobora guhungira uruhare rwabwo muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, mu gihe bwashyigikiye ku mugaragaro, bugakingira bukanatanga intwaro kuri Leta yakoze Jenoside. Yavuze ko bibabaje kuba Ingabo z’u Bufaransa nta ruhare zihabwa mu biganiro bya politiki, nko kuba zakwemera gukora ikintu cyangwa zikacyanga bitewe n’uko  zisanzwe bimeze, nkuko bigenda ku ngabo zo mu Bwongereza. Yavuze ko kandi impamvu Leta y’u Bufaransa yakoze ibyo ishaka mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, ari uko nta batavuga rumwe na Leta bigenga bari bahari icyo gihe ngo babyamagane. Ashimangira ko gukomeza kuzinzika amateka ngo atajya ahagaragara, ari amakosa akomeye u Bufaransa bukora ashobora no gutuma ibyabaye byongera bikaba. Muri Mata  uyu mwaka, Perezida w’u Bufaransa, Emmanuel Macron, yatangaje ishyirwaho rya komisiyo igizwe n’abahanga mu mateka n’abashakashatsi, izasesengura inyandiko icyo gihugu kibitse zigaragaza ibikorwa byacyo mu Rwanda hagati ya 1990-1994, ngo hashyirwe ahabona ukuri ku ruhare rwacyo muri Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi. Guillaume Ancel yagaragaje ko icyo gitekerezo ari cyiza ariko gishobora kubangamirwa n’abahoze mu buyobozi bw’u Bufaransa nka Amiral Jacques  Lanxade wari umugaba Mukuru w’Ingabo z’u Bufaransa mu gihe cye Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Lanxade aherutse kuvuga ko abashakashatsi mu mateka nta gishya bazabona mu nyandiko z’umubano w’u Bufaransa n’u Rwanda mbere no mu gihe cya Jenoside. Nubwo ingabo za FPR zagiye zitambikwa n’Ingabo z’u Bufaransa zafashaga Leta yakoze Jenoside, ntabwo byabujije ko Umujyi wa Kigali ubohorwa tariki ya 4 Nyakanga 1994. Ingabo za FPR zakomeje urugamba mu tundi duce tutari twagafashwe, zirusoza tariki 18 Nyakanga uduce twose tw’igihugu tumaze kwamburwa Guverinoma yakoze Jenoside.

title: Afurika imeze nk’indogobe itwawe n’u Bushinwa- Ikiganiro n’intyoza mu kuvuga PLO Lumumba
content: Ni umugabo muto ariko utarya iminwa iyo bigeze ku mvano y’ubukene bwazahaje umugabane witirirwa kuba inkomoko ya muntu, uzwiho kugira ubukungu bwinshi, amakimbirane n’intambara zidashira. Umunyakenya PLO Lumumba ni Umuyobozi w’ishuri ry’amategeko muri Kenya, yigeze no kuyobora Komisiyo ishinzwe kurwanya ruswa muri icyo gihugu. Mu Cyumweru gishize yagiranye ikiganiro kirambuye n’Umunyamakuru wa IGIHE, Maniraguha Ferdinand ubwo yari yitabiriye isozwa ry’inama yiga ku mutekano mu ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare riherereye i Nyakinama mu Karere ka Musanze. IGIHE: Ni iki kigituma Afurika igaragara nk’iyasigajwe inyuma muri byinshi? Lumumba:  Afurika yagiye isigazwa inyuma n’ibintu byinshi ariko icya mbere muri byose ni imiyoborere. Mu bihugu byinshi bya Afurika hari abagore n’abagabo bagiye bahabwa amahirwe yo kuyobora ariko  ntabwo bagiye bakoresha ayo mahirwe mu gushakira abaturage ibyiza. Kubera iyo mpamvu ibibazo abaturage bashaka ko bikemurwa ntibikemuka. Nkeka ko Umunya-Nigeria Chinua Achebe mu gitabo cye ‘The Trouble with Nigeria” yavuze ko ikibazo Afurika ifite ari imiyoborere. Hari undi wigeze kuvuga ko impamvu Afurika ikennye ari ukubera ubushobozi buke bw’abayiyobora. Gukena ni amahitamo, abayobora Afurika bahisemo inzira yo gukenesha abaturage babo ariko abaturage babatora nabo bafite ikibazo. Usanga dutora abantu kuko duturuka mu bwoko bumwe cyangwa baduhaye ruswa. IGIHE: None hakorwa iki? Lumumba:  Tugomba gukanguka. Twarabibonye ko abaturage mu Barabu bakangutse. Batangiriye gukanguka muri Tunisia no mu Misiri. Muherutse kubibona muri Algeria n’i Khartoum muri Sudani. Amateka yagiye abigaragaza ko demokarasi izanwa n’abaturage. Iyo abaturage bazi icyo bashaka nibyo bashaka ku babayobora, ababayobora na bo bamenya  ko bari ku butegetsi ku nyungu z’abaturage. IGIHE: Muri iyi minsi hari umubano ukomeye wa Afurika n’u Bushinwa, bamwe bavuga ko bisa nk’ubundi bukoloni bw’ubundi bwoko, wowe ubibona ute? Lumumba: Nta kosa mbona ku Bashinwa. Bamaze kumenya icyo bashaka, bamaze kumenya ko Afurika ari umugabane ukize ku butunzi karemano, baraje rero, bari gukora ibiri mu nyungu z’Abashinwa. N’igihe natwe ngo tumenye icyo dushaka. Umubano uri hagati ya Afurika n’u Bushinwa ni nk’umubano uba hagati indogobe n’uyitwaye. Umutwazi ni u Bushinwa, indogobe ni Afurika. Umubano nukomeza gutyo Afurika izakomeza kubihomberamo. Icyakora biranshimisha iyo mbona Afurika yiha icyerecyezo 2063, bakavuga bati ubu tugiye gushyiraho isoko rusange. Nidukomeza muri icyo cyerekezo tugatangira guhahirana tuzamenya ko ibyo dukeneye ari twe birimo. Tugomba guteza imbere inganda. Ntabwo Afurika izahora yohereza imineke, yohereza ubutare budatunganyije, tugomba kubyongerera agaciro. Niba twarasigaye inyuma mu mpinduramatwara y’inganda, ntabwo dukwiye no gusigara inyuma mu mpinduramatwara ya kane y’ikoranabuhanga. IGIHE: Hashize iminsi tubona urubyiruko rwa Afurika rurohama mu Nyanja rujya i Burayi, byo ubona biterwa n’iki? Lumumba: Impamvu urubyiruko rwacu rwishyira mu byago rukajya i Burayi, ni uko nta mahirwe ari mu bihugu byabo. Nta cyizere bahabonera. Bareba aho bari, bakibaza icyo bazakora bakakibura. Iyo rero bumvise uko bavuga i Burayi, bumva ko nibahagera ubuzima buzahita buhinduka. Umunsi tuzashyiraho amahirwe atandukanye muri Afurika, tugashyira ho uburyo butagamije gusa guha urubyiruko akazi ahubwo bubafasha guhanga udushya, nta n’umwe uzifuza kujya mu Burayi. IGIHE: Muravuga ubuhahirane no gushakira amahirwe urubyiruko ariko duhereye aha muri EAC,  ayo mahirwe azitiwe n’amakimbirane ari hagati y’ibihugu, ibi bizashira bite? Lumumba:  Nemera ko amakimbirane udashobora kuyarandura burundu ahubwo ikibazo ni uburyo mukemura ayo makimbirane binyuze mu bwumvikane. Mu gihe hari ikibazo hagati y’ibihugu  muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, nakifuje ko tugira urubuga biganirirwamo mu buryo bufitiye inyungu buri gihugu. Ahubwo mbona n’uburyo twe twishyiriyeho budakoreshwa uko bikwiriye. Aho kuganira hamwe, twahisemo kuganira umwe yibasira undi  muri twe kandi ibyo ni bibi cyane. Biroroshye cyane ko ya makimbirane yagera ku rundi rwego mu gihe twaba tutabikemuriye igihe. Mbona ko inzego zacu zikwiriye kubyinjiramo vuba cyane kuko nkuko mbivuga, iyi mipaka idutanya ni ibintu byahimbwe bishyirwaho, niyo mpamvu usanga abaturage basanzwe batabyitaho. Bariyambukira bakajya kureba abavandimwe. Niwitwaza iyi mipaka yazanywe n’abakoloni ukabuza urujya n’uruza rw’abaturage, ni wowe uzaba uri guteza amakimbirane atoroshye. Ibihugu rero bigomba gukomeza kuganira kuko umunsi twarekeye aho kuganira ni cya gihe tuzisanga mu ntambara. IGIHE: None by’umwihariko ikibazo cy’u Rwanda na Uganda ubona kizarangira gite? Lumumba:  Amakuru mfite kuri icyo kibazo ntahagije ku buryo natanga igisubizo cyacyo neza ariko ndemeza ko ikibazo cyose cyaba kiri hagati y’u Rwanda na Uganda, gishobora gukemurirwa mu biganiro hagati y’ibihugu byombi cyangwa mu muryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. IGIHE: Uburezi abana b’abanyafurika bahabwa ubona buhuye n’ibyo umugabane wifuza kugeraho ejo hazaza? Lumumba:  Hari byinshi bigomba gukorwa mu burezi bwacu. Tugomba gusubiramo ibyo twigisha mu mashuri abanza, ayisumbuye no muri Kaminuza. Ubu burezi bwa gikoloni dufite ubundi bwari bwarakozwe hashingiwe ku nyungu z’abakoloni, nyuma rero yo kubona ubwigenge twakabaye duhindura uburezi bwacu tukabujyanisha n’icyerekezo dushaka nk’abanyafurika. Ibyo rero bijyana no kwigisha abana bacu ibizatuma tugera aho twifuza haba mu buhinzi, mu bucukuzi n’ibindi. Hari ibindi bihugu byabigezeho. Nka Koreya y’Epfo bafashe uburezi bw’abanyamerika babuhuza n’umuco wabo bitewe n’icyo bashakaga kugeraho. Abayapani nabo barabikoze, Abashinwa barabikoze […] natwe igihe kirageze ngo dutange uburezi bugamije gukemura ibibazo dufite. IGIHE: Mu bihugu nka Algeria na Sudani hashize iminsi hakorwa  imyigaragambyo yasize abayobozi bavuye ku butegetsi, biratanga irihe somo? Lumumba: Isomo bikwiriye gutanga ni uko uko waba wibwira ko ukomeye kose, iyo abaturage babihiwe, iyo bamaze kubona ko ari wowe kibazo gituma badatera imbere nta kabuza bazagukuraho. Intwaro zose waba ufite, imbaraga z’abaturage ntushobora kuzitsinda. Ibyo wabibaza Omar Bashir, wabibaza Bouteflika, genda ubaze Mugabe, ubaze Ben Ali muri Tunisia cyangwa Hosni Mubarak bazakubwira. Iyo abaturage bafashe umwanzuro wo kwimura imisozi, imisozi irimuka nta kabuza.

title: Uganda ihera he  ihakana ko ikorana n’abashaka guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda?
content: Yabivuze imbonankubone imbere y’abadipolomate b’abanyamahanga baba muri icyo gihugu, nyuma abisubiramo imbere ya kamera z’abanyamakuru baba ab’imbere mu gihugu na mpuzamahanga. Uwo mugabo yavuze ko nta kibazo igihugu cye gifitanye n’u Rwanda, ko ikibazo ari u Rwanda rwafunze imipaka, rukabuza abaturage kwambuka. Imvugo ya Kutesa yarakaje bamwe mu banyarwanda bakoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga zirimo na Twitter, maze bazifashisha bamugaragariza ibimenyetso simusiga byemeza ko igihugu cye kiri mu bikorwa bigamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda. Hashize imyaka isaga ibiri abanyarwanda bafatwa bagafungirwa mu bigo bya Gisirikare muri Uganda, bagatotezwa abagize amahirwe bakarekurwa ari intere bakajugunywa mu Rwanda. Nta cyumweru gishira batajugunywe ku mupaka, ubuhamya bwabo bwagaragaye kenshi mu binyamakuru bitandukanye bivugira iyicarubozo  bakorewe ubwo babaga bari mu buroko. Kuba Kutesa yemeza ko igihugu cye nta we gikorana na we ushaka guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda benshi babigaragaje nk’ikinyoma gikomeye no kwirengagiza ukuri no gukina ku mubyimba amagana y’abanyarwanda bafungiye ubusa muri icyo gihugu, bazizwa gusa ko banze kwifatanya n’umutwe w’iterabwoba wa Kayumba Nyamwasa, RNC, ufite intego zo guhungabanya umutekano mu Rwanda. Perezida Yoweri Museveni ni we wiyemereye ko aherutse guhura na Charlotte Mukankusi umwe mu bashinzwe dipolomasi muri RNC ndetse nyuma byamenyekanye ko uwo mugore yahawe Pasiporo ya Uganda azajya yifashisha mu bikorwa byo gushakisha inkunga no kwamamaza RNC hirya no hino ku isi. Abakoresha Twitter bibukije Minisitiri Kutesa ko Perezida Museveni adasiba guhura n’abayobora RNC ndetse by’ikimenyimenyi aherutse guhurira i Kampala na Kayumba Nyamwasa umuyobozi wa RNC, umutwe w’iterabwoba ubarizwa mu misozi ya Minembwe muri RDC no muri Uganda. Ubwo yari muri Uganda, Kayumba yagaragaye i Kampala muri hotel ihenze ari kumwe n’abakomando bakomeye b’umutwe udasanzwe mu gisirikare cya Uganda uzwi nka SFC. Mukankusi, Eugène Gasana, Tabaro,Ben Rutabana, Frank Ntwali n’abandi bayobozi muri RNC bahora i Kampala mu bikorwa byo gushakisha inkunga. Uganda yahaye ubutaka bwisanzuye inyeshyamba za RNC bwo gukoreraho ibikorwa byabo.  Ubwo butaka bukoreshwa nk’ibirindio byo kwinjirizamo  abarwanyi  bashya  ndetse  bugakoreshwa nk’ikibuga cy’imyitozo ya gisirikare. Uganda yashinze ibinyamakuru bisaga 30 byo kuri internet bigamije gukwirakwiza icengezamatwara rigaragaza nabi isura y’u Rwanda. Ibyo binyamakuru byibasira ubudasiba Perezida Kagame na Guverinoma ye. Ibyo bijyana no guha umwanya w’imbere abayobozi ba RNC mu binyamakuru bya Leta ya Uganda nka New Vision, maze bagaharabika abayobozi b’u Rwanda bigatinda. Igihamya gikomeye ko Uganda ikorana n’abashaka guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda cyagaragajwe na Raporo y’impuguke za Loni yasohotse mu Ukuboza umwaka ushize. Yerekanye ko Uganda n’u Burundi, ari indiri yo gushakiramo abajya mu mutwe wa gisirikare ukorera muri RDC, mu kizwi nka P5, irwanya u Rwanda, aho RNC na FDLR ari abayigize bo mu rwego rwo hejuru. Abari abayobozi ba FDLR barimo La Forge Bazeye wavugiraga uwo mutwe na Lt. Col. Abega wari ushinzwe iperereza mbere yo koherezwa mu Rwanda bari bafashwe n’ingabo za Congo bavuye muri Uganda mu biganiro byari bigamije ku bahuza na RNC ngo banoze umugambi wo guhungabanya u Rwanda. Hejuru y’ibi bihamya, benshi bibaza impamvu Minisitiri Kutesa atinyuka akavuga ko ntaho igihugu cye gihuriye n’ibikorwa byo gufasha abashaka guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda.

title: Museveni yahamagariye abacuruzi b’abanya-Uganda kwishora muri magendu
content: Ni mu ijambo yagejeje ku itsinda ry’abasirikare b’abanyamahanga, ubwo yahamagariraga abacuruzi b’abanya-Uganda n’abandi bacuruzi kuyoboka inzira y’ibyaha. Yagize ati “Nubwo umupaka wafunzwe, ubucuruzi buzakomeza, buzananyura mu nzira ya magendu. Ntushobora guhagarika ubucuruzi unyuze ku buyobozi bw’umupaka, abantu bahitamo magendu”. Isesengura ry’ijambo rya Museveni ryuzuyemo ibyo bamwe bise ‘ibinyoma byo kwiheba’, birimo no guhamagarira abanya-Uganda kujya mu byaha. Ubuyobozi bw’u Rwanda bwasobanuye neza ko nta mupaka bwafunze, uretse uwa Gatuna, habujijwe imodoka ziremereye zituruka muri Uganda kuhanyura. Ubwo iki cyemezo cyafatwaga kuwa 1 Werurwe, u Rwanda rwasobanuye ko kigamije kubaka neza umupaka kandi imirimo igiye kurangira. Ku mupaka wa Gatuna, abaturage b’ibihugu byose baragenda bakagaruka nk’ibisanzwe igihe cyose nta mananiza. Imodoka ziremereye zasabwe gukoresha umupaka wa Kagitumba. Gusa ku ruhande rwa Museveni ibi ntabyitayeho ahubwo arahamagarira abanya-Uganda kutanyura inzira zemewe ahubwo bakijandika muri magendu. Abasesenguzi bavuga ko ‘ubwirasi bw’ubuyobozi bwa Museveni bwo kumva ko bashobora gukoresha u Rwanda uko babyumva, nibyo bibagarukaho bikabarya bikabatera gushyigikira ikorwa ry’ibyaha’. Indorerezi zivuga ko icyemezo cy’u Rwanda nubwo kigamije kwihutisha serivisi zitangwa ku mupaka, cyatumye Museveni anengwa cyane n’abashoramari n’abacuruzi b’abanya-Uganda, barimo guhomba byinshi mu bucuruzi bwabo. Benshi barimo kwibaza kuri kamere ya Museveni y’ubushotoranyi ku Rwanda, harimo no kwakira no gufasha imitwe y’iterabwoba igamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda. Imibare y’ubucuruzi igaragaza ko Uganda yohereza mu Rwanda ibicuruzwa bifite agaciro ka miliyoni 178 z’amadolari ku mwaka, mu gihe u Rwanda rwoherejeyo ibya miliyoni 30 z’amadolari. Umwe mu basesenguzi akagira ati “Nk’uko mubibona, Uganda ikenera u Rwanda kuruta cyane uko ruyikenera”. U Rwanda kandi rwimuriye umuvuno w’ubucuruzi mu bindi bihugu bituranyi ndetse no ku masoko mpuzamahanga. Abacuruzi b’Abanyarwanda b’abanyarwanda barimo gushishikarizwa kugirana ubucuruzi n’abo mu bihugu bindi by’abaturanyi aho bajya ntibashimutwe, ntibafungwe binyuranyije n’amategeko, ntibashyirwe mu nzu z’ibanga cyangwa ngo bakorerwe iyicarubozo. Mu ntangiro za Werurwe, Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga w’u Rwanda, Dr Richard Sezibera, yanditse kuri Twitter ye asaba abanyarwanda kutajya muri Uganda kubera impamvu zirimo gutabwa muri yombi, gushyirwa ahantu hatazwi bitamenyeshejwe ambasade y’u Rwanda muri iki gihugu ndetse no gufungwa igihe kirekire ntibagezwe imbere y’inkiko. Ibikorwa nk’ibyo bikorerwa abanyarwanda, kugeza n’ubu ntabwo birahagarara. Mu ijambo rye, Museveni ntiyigeze agaruka kuri ibi bibazo. Umusesenguzi uri i Kampala wumvise ibyo Museveni yavuze, ashimangira ko kumva avuga ku ‘guhuza isoko kwa Afurika’, ari ibinyoma n’uburyarya. Museveni yagize ati “guhuza isoko kwa Afurika ndetse no guhuza politiki bizasembura uburumbuke bw’umugabane byihutishe impinduka mu bukungu bwa Afurika”. Umusesenguzi ati “Ariko se ni gute umuntu Guverinoma ye yishe amategeko agenga isoko rusange rya EAC, ku bijyanye n’urujya n’uruza rw’abantu n’ibicuruzwa, atinyuka kuvuga ku kwihuza kwa Afurika?”. Akomeza agira ati “Abanyarwanda barenga igihumbi bari muri gereza za Uganda, batawe muri yombi ku birego by’ibinyoma by’uko binjiye mu gihugu mu buryo butemewe n’amategeko”. Umunyamategeko w’umunya-Uganda, akaba n’umwe mu bagize Inteko Ishinga Amategeko (EALA), yagize ati “Itegeko ry’isoko rusange rya EAC rirasobanutse, abaturage b’igihugu kiri muri EAC, bemerewe kujya mu gihugu icyo ari cyo cyose nta bwoba bwo kujyanwa mu nkiko cyangwa guhohoterwa”. Nubwo abanyarwanda benshi berekana indangamuntu zabo bahamya ko ari abenegihugu cya EAC, ndetse n’abafite pasiporo ndetse n’impapuro z’inzira bazerekana, abenshi birangira batawe muri yombi, bagafatwa kinyamaswa mu nzu za polisi nka Kisoro, Kabale, Mbarara bagakorerwa iyicarubozo. Abenshi nyuma yo gukorerwa ayo marorerwa n’iyicarubozo bajugunywa ku mipaka n’ubuyobozi bwa Uganda. Abandi banyarwanda benshi batabwa muri yombi na CMI, bashinjwa kuba intasi, aho ababashinja baterekana ibimenyetso cyangwa ngo bajyanwe mu nkiko ngo biregure. Ubushotoranyi bwa Museveni ku Rwanda, bwageze no ku bicuruzwa byarwo binyura muri Uganda. Ubuyobozi bwa Uganda bwahagaritse imodoka z’u Rwanda zitwaye amata muri Kenya kugeza ubwo apfuye biteza igihombo abari bayajyanye. Abayobozi ba Uganda bwanahagaritse imodoka ebyiri zuzuyemo amabuye y’agaciro y’abanyarwanda yerekeza ku cyambu, ahamara amezi menshi. Umwe mu bayobozi b’u Rwanda yagize ati “Bahagaritse amabuye y’agaciro nubwo ibyangombwa byose byari bihari nta n’ikibazo yari afite”. Biratangaje cyane kubona Museveni aho gukemura ikibazo cy’ubucuruzi ashinjwa guteza, arimo gushishikariza abantu gukora ibyaha.

title: Imyaka ibiri iruzuye! Ijisho ku miyoborere ya Perezida Macron yahinduye byinshi mu mibanire n’u Rwanda
content: Mu mwaka we wa mbere muri Elysée, Macron yagaragaje ubushake bwo guhindura politiki y’u Bufaransa kuri Afurika, yo kubaka umubano w’abafatanyabikorwa bitandukanye n’iy’abamubanjirije bubatse uwagereranywa n’umwana imbere y’umubyeyi. Umubano w’u Rwanda n’u Bufaransa wakunze kuba mubi bishingiye ku ruhare bushinjwa muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, mbere na nyuma yayo, bwo bukagaragaza ibisa no kwihunza ibyo bwakoze birimo ibirego bwashyiriyeho abayobozi bahagaritse Jenoside. Ubutegetsi bwa Macron mu gukosora ibyagenze nabi Mu Ukuboza 2018 abacamanza b’Abafaransa bahagaritse iperereza ku ihanurwa ry’indege ya Habyarimana ryari rimaze imyaka 20, ryahoraga ku izingiro ry’umwuka mubi hagati y’ibihugu byombi. Ryahembereye umubano mubi hagati y’u Rwanda n’u Bufaransa. Mbere gato y’uko u Rwanda rwinjira mu bikorwa byo Kwibuka ku nshuro ya 25 Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu 1994, Perezida Emmanuel Macron yakiriye itsinda ry’ abayobozi b’Umuryango uharanira inyungu z’abarokotse Jenoside, Ibuka-France. Nyuma Perezida Macron yatangaje ishyirwaho rya komisiyo igizwe n’abahanga mu mateka n’abashakashatsi, izasesengura inyandiko icyo gihugu kibitse zigaragaza ibikorwa byacyo mu Rwanda hagati ya 1990-1994, ngo hashyirwe ahabona ukuri ku ruhare rwacyo muri Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi. Perezida Macron yanatangaje ko hagiye gushyirwaho uburyo bwo gusobanura amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi no gushishikariza abantu gukora ubushakashatsi kuri Jenoside. Yagaragaragaje kandi ko adashyigikiye umuco wo kudahana, avuga ko agiye kongerera ubushobozi urukiko rukurikirana ibyaha bifitanye isano na Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi no kongera umubare w’abagenzacyaha “kugira ngo abakekwaho uruhare muri Jenoside bakurikiranwe kandi bacirwe imanza mugihe gikwiye.” U Bufaransa bwashyigikiye Mushikiwabo muri OIF Kimwe mu bikorwa Macron yagaragaje mu mubano mushya, ni uko yashyigikiye byeruye kandidatire ya Louise Mushikiwabo wari umukandida w’u Rwanda n’Umuryango wa Afurika yunze Ubumwe, ku mwanya w’Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’ibihugu bikoresha Igifaransa, OIF. Mushikiwabo yaje kwemezwa n’abakuru b’ibihugu ku bwumvikane busesuye, asimbura Michaelle Jean wari usanzwe muri uwo mwanya ndetse wifuzaga manda ya kabiri. Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru muri Gicurasi 2018, ari kumwe na Perezida Kagame, Macron yavuze ko umutima wa Francophonie uherereye muri Afurika, ko buri wese wifuza kugeza aheza uyu muryango atabigeraho atishingikirije urubyiruko rwo ku mugabane wa Afurika. Ibyo ngo bituma ku bwa Macron "Kandidatire ku buyobozi bwa Francophonie yaba iturutse muri kimwe mu bihugu bya Afurika, niyo yaba ifite ishingiro cyane". Afurika ifite ibihugu 30 kuri 50 bifata ibyemezo muri OIF ndetse uyu muryango wanashingiwe kuri uyu mugabane. U Bufaransa bwahagarariwe mu bikorwa byo Kwibuka Perezida Macron yatumiwe inshuro nyinshi ngo azasure u Rwanda, ndetse bamwe bari biteze ko azarusura muri uyu mwaka. Mu kiganiro yagiriye muri Ethiopie muri Werurwe, yabajijwe n’abanyamakuru kuri ubu butumire bw’u Rwanda. Ati "U Rwanda nibyo rwadutumiye mu bikorwa byo Kwibuka, ubutumire twarabwakiriye kandi ndemeza ko u Bufaransa buzaba buhagarariwe muri ibyo bikorwa byo Kwibuka." Yahagarariwe na Depite Hervé Berville ufite inkomoko mu Rwanda wifatanyije n’Abanyarwanda mu mugoroba wo Kwibuka wabereye kuri Stade Amahoro. Kutiyizira ubwe byanenzwe n’abantu batandukanye ariko bigaragaza ubushake mu kunga ubumwe nyuma y’ibyabaye byose. Mu muhango wo Kwibuka wabereye i Paris naho Macron yohereje Minisitiri w’imari n’ubukungu, Bruno Le Maire, unitabirwa n’umuyobozi w’umujyi wa Paris, Anne Hidalgo. Hejuru y’ibyo byose Macron yagaragaje icyifuzo cy’uko itariki ya 7 Mata, mu Bufaransa yafatwa nk’umunsi wo Kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Kwinjiza uyu munsi mu yubahwa mu Bufaransa ni ikimenyetso gikomeye, harebwe ku mateka y’icyo gihugu mu Rwanda, mbere ya Jenoside ndetse n’igihe yakorwaga. U Rwanda rushima imiyoborere ya Macron Nyuma ya Jenoside, Perezida Nicolas Sarkozy ni we wa mbere uyoboye u Bufaransa wasuye u Rwanda, muri Gashyantare 2010. Icyo gihe yanasuye Urwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali, anemera ‘amakosa’ igihugu cye cyakoze. Perezida Kagame nawe yagiye i Paris muri Nzeri 2011, ashimangiraga ubushake hagati y’ibihugu byombi mu kuzahura umubano. Nyamara Sarkozy avuyeho mu 2012, ibyari bitangiye kujya mu murongo hagati y’u Rwanda n’u Bufaransa byongeye gukonja. Ubwo Macron yatorwaga, ubutegetsi bwe bwazanye icyizere n’itandukaniro ry’abayoboye u Bufaransa bose nyuma ya 1994. Ni nawe Perezida u Bufaransa bwagize nyuma ya 1994, utari mu buyobozi ubwo Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yabaga. Nyuma y’imyaka yose yari ishize, muri Gicurasi 2018 Perezida Kagame yasuye u Bufaransa aganira na Perezida Macron bemeza kunoza umubano. Perezida Kagame aheruka kuvuga ko muri iki gihe nta gushidikanya ko hagati y’u Rwanda n’u Bufaransa hari ubwumvikane ahanini bitewe n’imikorere ya Perezida Emmanuel Macron. Yavuze ko “Perezida Macron yazanye imitekerereze mishya muri politiki y’u Bufaransa” ndetse ko ari guhindura “Politiki y’u Bufaransa n’amateka yabwo”. Hategerejwe intambwe ikomeye mu mubano Mu kiganiro yagiranye na TV5 i Erevan muri Arménie umwaka ushize, Perezida Kagame yabajijwe niba nyuma y’igihe kinini u Bufaransa bushobora kongera kugira Ambasaderi mu Rwanda, asubiza ko usibye icyo hari n’ibindi bishoboka. Ati “Ndatekereza ko icyo kigiye kuba umusaruro w’iyi mitekerereze mishya n’uburyo bwo gukorera hamwe. Hari ibintu bigiye kuba birenze na Ambasade kuko ibi birajyana n’umubano mu buryo bwagutse aho ibintu byinshi biba harimo n’icyo.” “Icy’ingenzi ni uko tugomba gusa n’abavugurura uyu mubano tugatuma uba mwiza ukajyana n’imitekerereze mishya.” Aya magambo yasaga n’agiye guhindura amateka yari amaze imyaka itatu u Bufaransa butagira Ambasaderi mu Rwanda kuko uheruka ari Michel Flesch. Mbere y’uko agenda mu 2015, u Bufaransa bwahaye u Rwanda izina rishya ry’uwo yifuza ko yayihagararira, Fred Constant, wari usanzwe ari Ambasaderi mu Birwa bya Antilles na Guyane. Ntiyaje koherezwa mu Rwanda kuko hashize igihe kirenga umwaka rutaramwemeza, ajyanwa muri Guinée Équatoriale. Mu gihe u Bufaransa nta Ambasaderi bugira mu Rwanda, Chargé d’Affaires, Etienne de Souza, ni we ukurikirana ibikorwa bya Ambasade. Mu ntangiriro z’umwaka ushize yabwiye IGIHE ko hari icyizere ko hazaboneka ambasaderi mushya. Ati “Ntabwo nakubwira igihe bizabera, ariko urabizi biterwa n’ubushake bw’ibihugu byombi, tuzareba icyo ahazaza haduhishiye. Igikenewe ni ukureba mu buryo bw’igihe kirekire.” Macron i Paris Izina rya Macron rirubashywe ku rwego rw’Isi ariko iwe mu gihugu amaze amezi atandatu hanganye no kwigarurira icyizere afitiwe n’abaturage, nyuma y’imyigaragambyo irangajwe imbere n’abaturage bambaye akenda k’umuhondo buri muntu aba ategetswe kugendana mumodoka ye, ari naho hakomoka izina ‘Gilets Jaunes.’ Ubwo Macron yiyamamazaga ndetse akanatorwa mu 2017, yatangaga icyizere cyo kuzaba umuyobozi ukiri muto uzanye impinduka muri politiki y’u Bufaransa akazana n’impinduka mu bukungu zizatuma imibereyo myiza izamuka n’ubushobmeri bukagabanyuka. Ibintu byatangiye neza ariko nyuma abantu batangira kugenda bagaragaza icyuho, ku buryo hagendewe kuri politiki y’ubukungu mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari ya 2018/2019, abasesenguzi bavugaga ko abakennye n’ubundi bazarushaho gukena cyangwa ntibagire icyo biyungura. Imyigaragambyo ya Gilets Jaunes yatangiye mu Ukwakira 2018, ku ikubitiro iba iyo kwamagana imisoro yari yashyizwe ku bikomoka kuri peteroli. Agahinda k’abaturage kazamutse kuko igiciro cya lisansi cyiyongereye kuri 23 %, mu gihe  abenshi batuye kure y’imijyi bashakiramo ubuzima bityo bagakoresha imodoka cyane, ku buryo kuzamura uwo musoro byafashwe nk’ibizanye ubusumbane mu mibereho bijyanye n’amafaranga bakorera n’ibiciro by’ibindi nkenerwa byazamutse. Impamvu z’imyigaragabyo zaje kwaguka noneho zigera ku kiguzi cy’ubuzima cyatumbagiye  mu Bufaransa, bituma n’igihe leta yemereye kwisubiraho kuri wa musoro itabasha kuneza bose, maze gahunda z’ubukungu za Perezida Macron zitangira kwinubirwa. Mu kwezi gushize Perezida Macron yijeje ‘Gilets Jaunes’ amavugurura arimo kugabanya imisoro ku mishahara y’abakozi, kongera pansiyo hitawe ku guta agaciro k’ifaranga n’amavugurura mu mirimo ya leta, hakabaho gahunda zishishikariza abantu gukora bakarenza imyaka 62 yagenewe kujya mu kiruhuko cy’izabukuru. Hari kandi gukuraho ishuri rizwi nka ‘Ecole Nationale d’Administration, ENA’ rinyuramo abo mu miryango ikomeye ari nabo bavamo abayobozi bakuru muri Leta, na Macron ubwe akaba yararyizemo. Ibi ngo byakorwa hagamijwe gutanga amahirwe ku bantu bose. Yavuze ko yumva akababaro k’abaturage babona ko birengagijwe, ko azakora ku buryo ubutegetsi bwegerezwa abaturage, uturere tugahabwa ububasha bwisumbuye, kuko wasangaga “hari abantu benshi i Paris bafata ibyemezo batazi uko ibintu byifashe mu baturage”. Iyi myigaragambyo ikomeje kugenda icogora nyuma yo kuba ku minsi ya gatandatu 23 yikurikiranya ndetse ikaba yarakunze kurangwa n’ubugizi bwa nabi ku buryo hari benshi bayifatiwemo ubu bafunzwe ndetse abandi bagejejwe imbere y’inkiko.

title: Uko yandikiye Habyarimana amusaba kwemera amashyaka menshi, yanze kuba Padiri…ikiganiro na Antoine Mugesera
content:
Antoine Mugesera w’imyaka 77 y’amavuko, yavukiye mu Karere ka Nyaruguru. Ni umwe mu mpuguke n’inararibonye u Rwanda rufite. Amashuri abanza yayize iwabo muri Nyaruguru, ayisumbuye ayiga mu Iseminari Nto  i Kabgayi n’i Kansi, Kaminuza yayize i Burundi no muri Zaїre (Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo ubu). Ni umwe mu banyamuryango b’imena b’Umuryango FPR Inkotanyi, dore ko yanawubereye Komiseri. Yayoboye Uruganda rw’Ikawa rwa  Rwandex, yayoboye Ibuka, aba umusenateri imyaka umunani, ubu ari mu bagize Urwego rw’Igihugu ngishwanama. Muzehe Mugesera yagiranye ikiganiro kirambuye na IGIHE, atubwira byinshi ku rugendo rwe muri politike , uko yanze kuba padiri n’uko yahirimbaniye impinduka mu gihe cy’ubutegetsi bwa Habyarimana. IGIHE: Wize mu Iseminari, kuki utabaye Padiri? Mugesera: Nagiye mu iseminari gushaka Imana sinayibona ndahava. Nta wanyirukanye, nta wankoreye urugomo ku giti cyanjye ngo mvuge ngo arandenganyije. Abapadiri bera bari bameze nk’abaparimehutu nako bari bo. Bagiraga urugomo n’ivangura, ariko sinavuga ngo nibo batumye mvamo navuyemo ku giti cyanjye […] ibyo nashakaga sibyo nabonye nuko ndavuga nti  nzajya gushaka Imana ahandi. IGIHE: Uri umwe mu bandikiye Habyarimana musaba amashyaka menshi. Ni iki cyabateye gushira amanga? Mugesera: Hari igihe kigera hakabaho abantu bashaka impinduka. Twari turi abasore bize hirya no hino, tugasoma tukagakurikira ibibera hirya no hino tukabigereranya n’ibyo tubona mu gihugu. Muri za  1988-1989 twishyize hamwe turi abasore bajijutse, twari tuziranye kandi duhuje ibitekerezo twese twashakaga impinduka, ariko ntitwari dufite ishyirahamwe ryanditse. Twaragendaga tugakorera inama mu ngo zacu tukavuga ibyo tubona bikwiye guhinduka. Iby’izo nama twakoraga byageze aho biramenyekana umusore umwe muri twe baramufunga baramubabaza cyane, ariko ntitwacika intege twakomeje kujya dukora inama rwihishwa. Bukeye umwe muri twe witwa Karemera Gaspard (n’ubu aracyariho aba mu Bubiligi)  aduha igitekerezo ati ‘nimureke twandike ibaruwa tuyisinyeho twandikire Habyarimana ko hagomba kubaho amashyaka menshi’. Ibaruwa yanditswe n’uwitwaga Seruvumba Anastase nuko tukajya  dusinyisha inshuti zacu. Tumaze kugera ku bantu 33, hari umwe muri twe wari uziranye n’umuntu wo mu nzego z’iperereza, atubwira ko byamenyekanye. Ibyo gusinyisha abantu turabihagarika, abantu baratatana. IGIHE:Iby’iyo baruwa mwabihonotse mute?  Mugesera: Mu 1990, buri bucye ngo Inkotanyi zitere nari nagiye mu butumwa bw’akazi muri Togo, ariko njya kugenda hari abantu twari tuziranye mu Nkotanyi. Ndangije ubutumwa rero sinagarutse mu Rwanda ahubwo nagiye muri Zaїre. Nari narahize  mpafite inshuti nagezeyo banshakira akazi.  Bucyeye Inkotanyi zintumaho  nzisanga ku rugamba, nagumanye nazo kugeza urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu rurangiye. IGIHE: Uko niko wagiye mu Nkotanyi? Mugesera: Oya nari nsanzwe ndiyo mfite na bagenzi banjye tuziranye.  Bari kumenya bate se ntariyo? Nari nsanzwe ndiyo kandi ndi na hano. IGIHE: Hari igitabo wanditse uvuga ko Revolusiyo yo mu 1959 yapfubye, mwashakaga kuvuga iki ? Mugesera: Twashingiye kubyo yagezeho. Gupfuba se si byo? Umusaruro wawe, ibikorwa uzanye nibyo byerekana umusaruro wawe. Barebye ubwoko bumwe kandi nta revolusiyo  ivugira ubwoko, ivugira igihugu ikavugira abarengana. Baratsinzwe. Kubohoza umunyarwanda ntibabikoze, ahubwo batuziritse ku irondakoko n’irondakarere. IGIHE: Mubona mute uruhare amadini yagize mu gucamo ibice abanyarwanda? Mugesera:  Sintandukanya amadini yazanywe n’abakoloni n’ubukoloni ubwabwo. Ni bimwe . Ariya madini yazanwe n’abakoloni azana n’ibitekerezo by’ubukoloni.
Abamisiyoneri bashyiragaho umutware bashatse bakanyagisha uwo bashatse. Bariya ni kimwe na Leta ya gikoloni ntiwabitandukanya. Ni bamwe na Leta ya Parmehutu ndetse na Leta ya Habyarimana bari kimwe, ikimenyimenyi nuko Archevêque Vincent Nsengiyumva yari muri Komite Nkuru ya MRND. Bazanye inzangano mu banyarwanda biza no gukura bigera kuri Jenoside. Baratsinzwe buriya, icyo twari tubatezeho sicyo twababonyeho. No muri Jenoside nta musenyeri watinyutse ngo ahagarare mu Kiliziya ayamagane. Mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abayahudi, ahandi wumvaga musenyeri umwe, pasiteri umwe yandikira abakirisitu ati muzasome mu ikoraniro  ibi bintu tubyamaganye ariko hano bagiye ku isonga ry’abagizi ba nabi. IGIHE: Mubona umusanzu w’amadini mu kubiba amahoro n’ubwiyunge mu banyarwanda ari uwuhe? Mugesera:  Amadini y’ubu sindayareba neza, turacyayareba dutegereje ko ahindukira akaba mazima niba azashobora kuba mazima. Ntacyo ndayabonaho gishya. Hari abo wumva basomanye misa n’abakoze Jenoside, hari abo wumva basubiranyemo hagati yabo, hari abo wumva ngo bibye amaturo ari abapasiteri. Haracyari kare ab’ubu bihorere ntawe uvuma iritararenga.
