title: Inzego za gisirikare ‘CMI na ISO’ zasabwe kugaragaza abanyarwanda zashimutiye muri Uganda
content: Gawaya Tegulle na Michael Aboneka, bahuriye muri Thomas and Michael Advocates, bahagarariye imiryango y’abanyarwanda bashimuswe, bagaragaje ko hari abanyarwanda batanu bashimuswe n’Urwego rw’Ubutasi mu gisirikare cya Uganda, CMI n’ Urwego rushinzwe umutekano imbere mu gihugu (ISO), basaba ko bagaragazwa aho bari. Abanyarwanda benshi mu myaka ishize bakunze gushinja urwego rw’ubutasi kubakorera iyicarubozo, aho usanga Abanyarwanda barimo abagore bafite abana bato bakurwa mu modoka bakajya gufungwa bashinjwa kuba intasi. Itangazo rigenewe abanyamakuru ry’abo bunganizi mu mategeko, rivugamo Rugorotsi Eric, washimuswe kuwa 25 Ukwakira 2018 na Twahirwa David washimuswe kuwa 15 Ukuboza. Aba bombi ngo bajyanywe na ISO. Rugorotsi wari umucuruzi yafatiwe i Kampala yagiye kugura ibyuma by’ibinyabiziga kimwe na Twahirwa wari wagiye muri gahunda ze. Undi Munyarwanda witwa Ntakirutimana Theoneste, wayoboraga Itorero ADEPR muri Uganda yafashwe kuwa 28 Werurwe na Asiimwe Apollinaire wafashwe kuwa 7 Mata. Bombi byagaragaye ko bashimuswe na CMI. Nyuma yo gufatwa, nta mpapuro zibata muri yombi cyangwa indi nzira y’amategeko ikurikijwe, ibinyamakuru bimenyerewe mu gukwirakwiza icengezamatwara muri Uganda, byatangiye kwandika inkuru ko ‘bakorera u Rwanda’. Itangazo ry’aba banyamategeko rinagaruka kuri Gasana Deus, wavunjaga amafaranga wafashwe ku wa 3 Mata 2019 na ISO. Aba banyarwanda bose bashimuswe bashyizwe ahantu hatazwi aho badashobora kugerwaho n’imiryango yabo cyangwa abanyamategeko babo. Nk’uko abanyarwanda bagiye bahonoka gereza zo muri Uganda babivuga, Guverinoma ya Museveni ikomeje ubushotoranyi ku Rwanda ibinyujije no mu gufunga abanyarwanda b’abasivili. Bimaze kugaragara ko abakorera CMI bakorana bya hafi n’umutwe w’iterabwoba wa RNC, urwanya u Rwanda mu gushaka abarwanyi b’uyu mutwe mu nkambi cyangwa imijyi irimo abanyarwanda, kandi byose bakabikora ku mabwiriza n’uruhushya rw’abayobozi bo hejuru mu butegetsi bwa Uganda. Uku gushaka abarwanyi kandi binakorwa mu bundi buryo aho CMI ishimuta abanyarwanda ibashinja kuba intasi z’u Rwanda, ikabakorera iyicarubozo ndetse ikabafungira mu nzu zitazwi, kugeza bemeye kujya muri RNC. Abakorewe ubwo bunyamaswa ariko bakinangira kujya muri RNC bagakomeza gufungwa igihe runaka. Hari bamwe barekurwa bakajugunywa ku muhanda cyangwa ku mupaka runaka ndetse bamwe bakerekana ibimenyetso ku mubiri by’iyicarubozo bakorewe. Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ibarura abanyarwanda babarirwa mu 1000 bafungiye muri gereza zitandukanye cyangwa ahandi hantu ariko batemerewe kugira uwo bavugana cyangwa ubabona. Iri tangazo rinenga uburyo gushimuta abanyarwanda byagizwe akamenyero. Ibi bikaba bihamya ibyo u Rwanda rudahwema kunenga aho binyuze mu nyandiko ya Ambasade yarwo i Kampala, rwamaganye ibyo gufata abanyarwanda binyuranye n’amategeko, kubafunga bitemewe ndetse no gukorera iyicarubozo abasivili. Ibi byatumye u Rwanda rufata icyemezo mu kwezi gushize cyo kugira inama abaturage barwo yo kutajya muri Uganda. Abanyamategeko Tegulle na Aboneka berekanye uko CMI na ISO basuzugura amabwiriza y’urukiko. Izi nzego zimaze gusuzugura inyandiko eshatu zizisaba kugaragaza no kujyana mu nkiko abakekwaho ibyaha zafashe ndetse zikanga no kubarekura, hakibazwa niba amategeko muri Uganda agikurikizwa. Aba banyamategeko kandi basaba abaturage guhaguruka bakavuganira inzirakarengane z’ubutabera bucagase. Banahishuye kandi ko gutabwa muri yombi kuri bamwe gushobora kuba kwihishwe inyuma n’abantu runaka bahiga abanyarwanda. Basabye inzego z’umutekano n’ubushinjacyaha guha abakiliya babo umunsi wo kuburana niba hari ibimenyetso bafite. Bavuga ko gukomeza gufunga abakiliya babo ari uguhonyora amategeko mpuzamahanga n’aya Uganda.  Bati “Dushingiye ku biheruka kuba, hari ubwo abatawe muri yombi barekurwa barakorewe iyicarubozo rikaze, ku buryo biba bigoye no kongera kubamenya”. “Turahamagarira abagiraneza bose muri Uganda ndetse no mu miryango mpuzamahanga kwamagana ibi byaha byibasiye inyokomuntu”.

title: Manirakiza w’imyaka 19 arasaba ubufasha ngo ajye guhindurirwa impyiko irwaye mu Buhinde
content: Uyu mwana w’imyaka 19 utagira ababyeyi bombi ariko akaba afashwa na nyirasenge, Soeur Bangamwabo Catherine, yigaga mu mashuri yisumbuye. Ubwo burwayi bwamufatiye ku ishuri atangira kubyimba ibice bimwe by’umubiri ariko ntamenye indwara arwaye. Nyuma ageze mu biruhuko nibwo yamufashe yikubita hasi ajyanwa ku Bitaro bya Muhima mu Karere ka Nyarugenge mu Mujyi wa Kigali, nabyo bibonye ntacyo byakora ku burwayi bwe bimwohereza ku bya Gisirikare i Kanombe ari nabyo byaje gutahura ko impyiko ze zangiritse. Soeur Bangamwabo yitabaje Minisante kubera ko atari ashoboye kumuvuza nayo isaba ibitaro kumwitaho mu gihe agitegereje ko haboneka uburyo ngo ajyanwe guhindurirwa impyiko mu Buhinde. Kuva icyo gihe Ibitaro bya Kanombe byahise bitangira kumwitaho mu buryo butandukanye burimo kumwogereza impyiko aho nibura yakeneraga kozwa inshuro eshatu mu cyumweru. Soeur Bangamwabo yabwiye IGIHE ko nyuma yaje gukorerwa raporo ngo ajye kwivuriza mu Buhinde ndetse abona uzamuha impyiko Minisante yemeye kumwishyurira ibisabwa kugira ngo avurwe ariko umuryango we ugashaka amafaranga y’itike ye, iy’uzamuha impyiko n’uzamurwaza asaga miliyoni 10 Frw. Ati “Ibindi byose ni ukubyishakira ari impapuro z’inzira ze n’umurwaza, amacumbi n’ibindi bizakurikira. Umwana nta muryango afite ni njye na musaza we asigaranye kandi nawe yaramugaye ntitwabona ibikenewe ngo avurirwe iyo mu mahanga.” Uyu mwana wabaye imfubyi afite imyaka itanu yakomeje kwitabwaho na Soeur Bangamwabo uvuga ko atabona miliyoni 10 Frw asabwa. Soeur Bangamwabo avuga ko uwagira umutima ufasha yagira icyo akora kugira ngo uyu mwana avurwe kuko hasigaye amezi abiri gusa kugira ngo yoherezwe kwivuza mu Buhinde. Ufite umutima wo gufasha wakoresha Mobile Money kuri nimero 0788610658 ibaruye kuri Soeur Bangamwabo Catherine. Hari na nimero ya konti iri muri Banki ya Kigali; ariyo 002700655635318. title: Gutera akabariro inshuro nke bishobora gutuma umugore acura imburagihe
content: Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko abagore batera akabariro inshuro nke, amahirwe yo gucura kwabo aba ari hejuru ugereranyije n’abatera akabariro inshuro nyinshi. Mu gukora ubu bushakashatsi, abagore babajijwe inshuro bakoraho imibonano mpuzabitsina. Abagore bavuze ko batera akabariro byibuze buri cyumweru, byagaragaye ko amahirwe yabo yo gucura hakiri kare ari make ku gipimo cya 28% ugereranyije n’abatera akabariro rimwe mu kwezi bo bari kuri 19%. Ababwanditse bavuze ko kuba habaho guhuza ibitsina hagati y’umugore n’umugabo bishobora kumenyesha umubiri ko gutwita gushoboka. Ariko ku bagore badakora imibonano mpuzabitsina cyane, kuba bacura hakiri kare ngo bihita byisobanura ushingiye kuri iyi ngingo. Ubusanzwe igihe cyo gucura ku mugore kiba hagati y’imyaka 45 na 55. Bavuga ko umugore yacuze kare iyo acuze mbere y’imyaka 40 bakanavuga ko yacuze atinze iyo bibaye arengeje imyaka 55. N’ubwo ubushakashatsi butagaragaje aho ibi byombi bihurira, ababuyoboye bavuze ko bimwe mu bimenyetso by’umubiri bishobora kugaragaza ko hari amahirwe yo gusama, ariko ku bagore badatera akabariro inshuro nyinshi, gucura kwabo bishobora kugaragarira imbere mu mubiri gusa. Ubu bushakashatsi bushingiye ku isesengura ryatangiye gukorwa muri Amerika ku buzima bw’umugore guhera mu 1996 ryitwa “Women’s Health Across the Nation”. Bwashingiye ku makuru yatanzwe n’abagore 3000 bari bafite imyaka 45 mu gihe bwatangiraga, nibura buri wese afite abana babiri kandi afite umugabo. Abagore 45% bagaragaje ko bacuze bagize imyaka 52. Amakuru ajyanye n’imibereho y’ubuzima bwabo yakusanyijwe mu gihe cy’imyaka 10. Ku ikubitiro, nta mugore n’umwe muri aba bose wari wagacuze, ariko 46% bari batangiye kubona ibimenyetso byabyo birimo imihango ihindagurika no kumva mu mubiri bafite ubushyuhe bwinshi. 54% bo bari batarageza igihe cyo kujya gucura ndetse nta n’ibimenyetso byabyo babonaga kuko imihango yabo yazaga nk’ibisanzwe. Ibikorwa bifitanye isano n’igitsina ntabwo byigeze bisobanurwa nko gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina gusa ahubwo hanarebwe ku bijyanye no kwishimishanya ku gitsina abantu bakoresheje umunwa cyangwa ururimi, kwikinisha, kwagazanya n’ibindi nka byo. Ni bwo bushakashatsi bwa mbere bugaragaje isano iri hagati y’imibonano mpuzabitsina no gucura k’umugore. Ababukoze batangaje ko isesengura ryabo bagiye kurikorera ku kindi gice cy’abantu bakareba niba ibyo babona bizahura n’ibya mbere.

title: Ibitaro byitiriwe Umwami Faisal mu mavugurura azasiga bibasha kubaga imitima no gusimbuza impyiko
content: Ibitaro byitiriwe Umwami Faisal byatangiye amavugurura agamije kubishyira ku rwego mpuzamahanga arimo gutangiza serivisi nshya z’ubuvuzi zajyaga zitangirwa mu mahanga nko kubaga imitima, gusimbuza impyiko, kuvura ubwoko bumwe na bumwe bwa kanseri n’ibindi. Muri gahunda y’ibikorwa y’imyaka itanu ibi bitaro byihaye (2020-2025)  harimo kongera ibikorwa remezo, kongera ireme rya serivisi zihabwa abarwayi, kongera abaganga b’inzobere n’ibindi. Muri  Mata umwaka ushize nibwo Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yasheshe amasezerano yari ifitanye n’ikigo Oshen Healthcare Rwanda Limited gishamikiye kuri  Oshen Healthcare cyo muri Angola, nyuma y’uko ibyari byemeranyijwe byo gucunga no guteza imbere ibyo bitaro bitari biri kugerwaho uko bikwiriye. Ibi bitaro bifite intego yo kujya ku rwego mpuzamahanga, bigafasha Leta  kugabanya umubare w’abanyarwanda bajya kwivuriza  hanze bagiye kwivuza indwara zitavurirwa imbere mu gihugu. Umuyobozi w’Ibitaro byitiriwe Umwami Faisal, Dr Kalimba Edgar yabwiye IGIHE ko nyuma yo gusubizwa mu maboko ya Leta y’u Rwanda, bifuza guhindura amateka y’ibi bitaro. Kalimba yavuze ko mbere na mbere bazahera mu gutangiza ubuvuzi butari busanzwe nko kuba basimbuza impyiko yarwaye,  kongerera ubushobozi serivisi zo kubaga imitima n’ibindi. Yagize ati  “Tugiye kongera imbaraga mu bice  nk’ibijyanye no kubaga umutima. Icya kabiri ni indwara z’impyiko. Mushobora kuba muzi ko  ubu tubasha gutanga ubuvuzi mu gufasha impyiko kuyungurura amaraso, tubikora neza mu gihugu ariko ntabwo turabasha gutangira kujya dusimbuza impyiko. Umurwayi ukeneye impyiko ntabwo ashobora kuzibona mu Rwanda , bimusaba kujya hanze.” Benshi mu barwayi b’impyiko bageze ku rwego rw’uko zisimbuzwa, bakunze kujya kuzisimburizwa mu bihugu byateye imbere nk’u Buhinde. Ibyo bitwara amafaranga menshi haba agenda ku murwayi n’abamwitaho, iterambere ry’igihugu n’umurwayi bikahazaharira. Dr Kalimba yavuze ko nubwo biri muri gahunda y’imyaka itanu, nibatangiza iyo serivisi izaba ihendutse kurusha kujya mu mahanga. Yagize ati “Igiciro byanze bikunze ntabwo gishobora kungana n’umurwayi ugiye hanze kuko iyo ugiye hanze bisaba itike y’indege, umarayo igihe kirekire nk’ukwezi kugira ubagwe ukire ushobore kugaruka. Akenshi na kenshi iyo ufite n’umurwaza nabyo ni ubundi bushobozi bisaba. Nitumara gutangira izo serivisi bifite inyungu nini ku banyarwanda kuko bazabagirwa hano mu rugo kandi binahendutse.” Ibi bitaro bifite abaganga b’inzobere 40 mu basaga 80 bahari. Abafite ubumenyi mu buvuzi bw’impyiko ni bake mu gihe mu bijyanye no kubaga impyiko cyangwa kusizimbuza ntabo. Dr Kalimba avuga ko mu gihe bazaba batangiye gutanga ubwo buvuzi, bazitabaza abaganga b’abanyamahanga ariko n’abanyarwanda bakagenda babigiraho. Ibi bitaro kandi bifite ibibazo by’ubuke bw’abaganga mu zindi ngeri z’ubuvuzi nko kubaga imitima, indwara zo mu nda, indwara z’imitsi n’indwara z’amaraso. Muri uyu mwaka, byitezwe ko hazahabwa akazi abandi baganga b’inzobere bari hagati ya 10 na 15 cyane cyane ab’indwara zikirimo ibyuho. Miliyari 18 Frw zigiye gushorwa mu bikorwa birimo inyubako Mu myaka itanu y’ibikorwa,  ibi bitaro byiyemeje kubaka ibikorwa remezo bizafasha mu kugeza ubuvuzi bugezweho ku babigana. Igice cya mbere cyatangiye mu mpera za 2019, kizasozwa mu mwaka wa 2021 gitwaye miliyoni 20 z’amadolari, ni ukuvuga asaga miliyari 18 z’amanyarwanda. Leta y’u Rwanda nk’umunyamigabane mukuru w’ibi bitaro niyo izafasha mu kubona  ayo mafaranga. Bimwe mu bizubakwa mu cyiciro cya mbere harimo inyubako izaba irimo ibyumba 45  yo kuvuriramo abarwayi bataha,  hazubakwa inyubako izakorerwamo iby’uburezi n’ubushakashatsi, inyubako izaba irimo ivuriro ry’abifite n’ibindi. Muri gahunda kandi ibi bitaro bivuga ko bizateza imbere ibijyanye no kongerera ubumenyi abakozi no gufasha abanyeshuri biga ubuvuzi kwimenyereza. Ibyo bizajyana no kongerera ubushobozi ibijyanye n’ubushakashatsi bw’imbere mu gihugu ku bijyanye n’ubuvuzi. Dr Kalimba yagize ati “Muzi ko hari ibintu bigenda bihinduka cyane mu buvuzi, haba mu ikoranabuhanga, uburyo bw’imivurire n’imicungire y’ibitaro n’ibindi. Ni iby’inenzi kuri twe nk’ibitaro bikomeye mu gihugu gukora ubushakashatsi bwacu tugatanga amakuru yacu yihariye.” Ibitaro byitiriwe Umwami Faisal bimaze imyaka isaga 30 bitanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi mu Rwanda. Mu mwaka wa 2013 byashyizwe ku rwego rw’akarere, bikaba byitezwe ko muri Werurwe uyu mwaka hazakorwa irindi genzura, hakarebwa niba bikiri kuri urwo rwego.

title: Umugore yabyariye mu bitaro bya Faisal abana bane batagejeje igihe, bari kwitabwaho
content: Mu Cyumweru cya mbere cy’Ukuboza 2019 nibwo umugore uturuka i Goma muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo yaje kubyarira muri ibi bitaro, abyara abana bane bafite ibyumweru 28. Ubusanzwe umwana uvukiye igihe agomba kuba yujuje ibyumweru 40. Uvutse atabyujije akunze guhura n’ibibazo bitandukanye bishobora no gutuma abura ubuzima. Umwana uvutse atagejeje igihe abanza gushyirwamo mu byuma byabugenewe akitabwaho n’abaganga kugeza igihe bigaragaye ko nta kibazo ashobora kugira. Mu kiganiro na IGIHE, Umuyobozi w’Ibitaro byitiriwe Umwami Faisal Dr Kalimba Edgar yavuze ko abo bana bane  bameze neza. Yagize ati “Bavutse ari bane n’ubu baracyari mu bitaro ariko bo bavutse ku mezi atandatu. Ni bane ku muntu umwe kandi bameze neza. Ubuvuzi bujyanye n’abana b’impinja bavutse mbere, iby’ibanze birahari kandi turakomeza kubaka ubushobozi.” Nubwo IGIHE itabashije kugera aho abo  bana barwariye cyangwa kuvugana n’ababyeyi babo, si ubwa mbere ibi bitaro bivukiyemo abana batagejeje igihe bakabasha kwitabwaho kugeza bagejeje igihe nyacyo cyo kuvukira. Kuwa 24 Nyakanga 2019 nibwo Umutoni Peace na Ntaganira Felix, ababyeyi bo mu Murenge wa Kinyinya mu Karere ka Gasabo  bibarutse  umuhungu n’umukobwa, umwe umwe afite amagarama asaga 600 bitewe n’indwara y’umuvuduko w’amaraso, bahabwa ubufasha burimo kubashyira mu byuma byabugenwe mu bitaro byitiriwe Umwami Faisal. Mu Ugushyingo 2019, izi mpanga n’ababyeyi bazo basezerewe mu bitaro nyuma yo kubona ko zimerewe neza mu gihe ubusanzwe abana bavutse babura igihe kinini baba bafite ibyago byinshi byo gupfa. Umuhungu yujuje ibiro 2.90 naho umukobwa 1.5. Dr Kalimba yavuze ko kuba bakomeje kwita ku bana bavutse batagejeje igihe bakabaho, atari amahirwe ahubwo ari ubushobozi haba mu bumenyi n’ibikoresho ibyo bitaro bimaze kugira. Ati “Ntabwo nabyita amahirwe kuko ubuvuzi bumaze gutera imbere kandi nubwo bwose abana bavutse kare cyane nko ku mezi atanu aho wajya ku isi hose ni abana bagira ibibazo bitandukanye, twe usibye no kugira abaganga b’inzobere mu kuvura abana b’impinja bakivuka, dufite n’ibikoresho by’ibanze bituma abo bana babaho.” Abahanga mu by’ubuzima bwa muntu n’ubushakashatsi bemeza ko umuntu abyarira amezi icyenda ariko ko ashobora no kubyara atarayuzuza bitewe n’impamvu zitandukanye. Umuganga w’abana akaba n’inzobere mu kwita ku bana bavutse igihe kitageze ku bitaro bya Faisal, Dr Nkuranga John Baptiste, aherutse kubwira IGIHE  ko impamvu zikunze gutuma umubyeyi abyara umwana mbere y’amezi icyenda harimo imiterere y’umubiri we. Ati “Kubera imiterere y’umubiri, nk’abakunda kugira umuvuduko w’amaraso ukagira aho uhurira n’imiterere y’inda ahanini usanga uzanwa no gutwita, iyo uri ku kigero kidashobora kugenzurwa, bikaba ngombwa ko umwana avuka kugira ngo haramirwe ubuzima bw’uwo mwana n’umubyeyi.” Uretse umuvuduko w’amaraso hari kandi indwara zirimo nka Malaria, indwara zifata mu myanya y’imyororokere, imirire mibi, imiterere y’inda ibyara y’umubyeyi n’ibindi.

title: Abakora muri farumasi baburiwe ku guha abarwayi imiti nta cyemezo kibigaragaza
content: Mu Rwanda, ubucuruzi bw’imiti ivura indwara bukorerwa gusa ku mavuriro na farumasi, nabyo bibifitiye uburenganzira butangwa n’inzego zitandukanye zirimo izishinzwe ubuzima, ubucuruzi, ndetse n’izigenzura ubuziranenge. Inzira isa n’itoroshye yo guhabwa uburenganzira bwo gucuruza imiti, igenzurwa rya hato na hato ku bakora ubu bucuruzi, ndetse n’ingamba zashyizweho na Leta hagamijwe kwirinda ko ubucuruzi bw’imiti bwakorwa mu kavuyo; bigaragaza agaciro gahabwa uburyo bwo kurengera ubuzima bw’abagura imiti. Abakora ubucuruzi bw’imiti kandi bafatwa nka bamwe mu ntiti, ahanini hashingiwe ku myaka myinshi bamara bahabwa ubumenyi ku miti, ndetse n’amasomo baba barize akaba afatwa na benshi nk’agenewe abahanga cyane. Gusa nk’ubucuruzi bwose bugamije inyungu, hari ahashobora gukorwa amakosa aturutse ku gitutu cyo gushaka amafaranga cyane, hakirengagizwa amahame ngenderwaho agenga imikorere muri ubwo bucuruzi. Mu mahame agenga itangwa cyangwa icuruzwa ry’imiti ku bantu, harimo ko uhabwa umuti abanza kwerekana urupapuro rwanditswe na muganga ubifitiye ububasha nk’ikimenyetso cyemeza ko umurwayi yemerewe guhabwa umuti runaka by’umwihariko ku miti ifatwa igihe kirekire cyangwa ivura uburwayi bukomoka ku bwandu. Nubwo imiti yose idatangwa habanje kugaragaza urupapuro rwa muganga; hari ingero zitari nke zigaragaza imikorere ikwiye gukemangwa mu itangwa ry’imiti yari ikwiye gutangwa hashingiwe ku nyandiko ya muganga muri za farumasi. Mu kiganiro kihariye IGIHE yagiranye Prof Kayumba Pierre Claver, umuhanga mu by’imiti, wigisha muri kaminuza y’u Rwanda, akaba n’umwe mu bajyanama b’Ishyirahamwe ry’Abahanga mu by’Imiti mu Rwanda, yadutangarije ko iki kibazo gishingiye ku mikorere mibi igaragara mu rwego rw’ubucuruzi bw’imiti, kandi ko gikwiye guhagurukirwa n’inzego zitandukanye. Ati “Abantu bose bakwiye kumenya ko imiti ari uburozi kuko itaribwa cyangwa ngo inyobwe uko umuntu yishakiye. Imiti itangwa hashingiwe ku rupapuro rwa muganga irazwi, kandi n’umucuruzi w’imiti na we aba abizi; abaharanira inyungu z’amafaranga kuruta ubuzima bw’abantu baba barenze ku mabwiriza agenga umwuga.” Prof Kayumba akomeza avuga ko kuba hari umurwayi uza akimwa imiti muri farumasi runaka kubera nta ‘ordonance’ afite, yajya mu yindi bakayimuha bifatwa nk’imikorere mibi iri mu mafarumasi . Ni iki gitera iki kibazo? Politiki yo gufungurira amarembo abashora imari muri farumasi kandi badafite ubumenyi bwihariye ku miti, ivugwaho guha urwaho ikibazo cy’imitangire mibi y’imiti. Aha ngo umukozi wahawe akazi muri farumasi asabwa na shebuja gukoresha uburyo bwose bwo kwinjiza amafaranga, mu rwego rwo kurengera akazi ke n’iterambere rya nyiri farumasi. Bumwe muri ubwo buryo harimo gutanga imiti atiriwe asaba urupapuro rwanditswe na muganga, yirinda ko mu gihe yatse urwo rupapuro kandi ukeneye imiti ntarwo afite, yahitamo kwigira mu yindi farumasi. Aha hiyongeraho n’ikibazo cy’ubucucike bwa za farumasi mu duce tumwe nabyo bifatwa nk’intandaro y’ihangana rigamije kwinjiza amafaranga kuruta gutanga serivisi uko biteganywa n’amategeko. Umubare ukiri muto w’abahanga mu by’imiti mu gihugu nawo ni ikibazo kigaragazwa n’inzobere mu by’imiti, nk’intandaro y’imitangire idahwitse y’imiti muri za farumasi, kuko mubyo utanga imiti ashinzwe harimo no kugira inama uyihawe. Hari kandi n’abacuruza imiti bamwe na bamwe, baca mu rihumye igenzurwa rikorwa rigamije kureba imiti iri ku isoko kandi ibura igihe gito ngo irenze igihe yagenewe, bahitamo kuyitanga nta mpapuro za  muganga basabye kugira ngo birinde ko iyo miti yazarenza igihe bakiyifite mu bubiko bwabo. Amategeko mpuzamahanga ateganya ko umuti urengeje ½ cy’igihe wateganyirijwe kumara, ariko ukaba utaragezwa ku isoko ry’aho uzacururizwa; udakwiye kwemererwa kwinjizwa mu gihugu icyo aricyo cyose. Minisiteri y’Ubuzima nk’urwego rwa leta rukuriye ibikorwa by’ubuvuzi, Ikigo cy’Igihugu Kigenzura Imiti n’ibiribwa, Ishyirahamwe ry’Abahanga mu by’Imiti n’izindi nzego zifite aho zihuriye n’ikorwa ndetse n’icuruzwa ry’imiti bagirwa inama yo gukurikiranira hafi iki kibazo kitarafata indi ntera. Abakora ubucuruzi bw’imiti nabo bakwiye kwibutswa amahame shingiro agenga umwuga wabo, ndetse hagakazwa n’ibihano ku bantu bose bafatwa bari kunyuranya n’ayo mahame arimo gutanga imiti hadashingiwe ku rupapuro rwa muganga, bihuzwa no gushyiraho igenzura ritunguranye muri za farumasi, hagamijwe gukurikirana uko amahame agenga umwuga wo gucuruza imiti ashyirwa mu bikorwa.  Kugeza ubu mu Rwanda umuhanga mu by’imiti umwe yita ku bantu ibihumbi 14, hakifuzwa ko nibura yaba yita ku ibihumbi 10 mu 2025. Ntibyoroshye kumenya umubare w’abapfa bazize gufata imiti mu buryo butagenwe na muganga mu Rwanda kuko nta bushakashatsi bwakozwe kuri iyi ngingo; gusa hashingiwe ku bivugwa n’abahanga mu by’imiti, nta wahamya ko nta mubare w’abatakariza ubuzima mu kunywa imiti mu buryo butagenwe na muganga, biturutse ku kuba nta makuru ahagije bahawe n’umuhanga mu by’imiti cyangwa barayinyweye nta muganga wayibandikiye.

title: Minisante yashyizeho itsinda ryo kuvura Abanyarwanda icyenda batoterejwe muri Uganda
content: Mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa  Gatatu rishyira kuwa Kane  nibwo Abanyarwanda icyenda bari bamaze imyaka igera kuri itatu  bafungiye muri Uganda bageze ku mupaka wa Gatuna nyuma y’uko barekuwe n’Urukiko rwa Gisirikare rwa Makindye kuri uyu wa Kabiri. Abarekuwe ni Rene Rutagungira, Herman Nzeyimana, Nelson Mugabo, Etienne Nsanzabahizi, Emmanuel Rwamucyo, Augustin Rutayisire, Adrien Munyagabe, Gilbert Urayeneza na Claude Iyakaremye. Bose bahuriza ku buryo bari bafashwe nabi muri gereza, uko bakorerwaga iyicarubozo ku buryo ubuzima bwabo buri mu kaga nubwo barekuwe. Minisante ibinyujije kuri Twitter, yatangaje ko yashyizeho  itsinda ry’abaganga bakurikirana ubuzima bw’abarekuwe. Bagize bati “Minisiteri y’Ubuzima yashyizeho itsinda ry’Abaganga batangiye gusuzuma no kuvura Abanyarwanda icyenda barekuwe na Uganda.” Rutagungira uri mu banyarwanda ba mbere bashimutiwe i Kampala, yavuze ko yafashwe ku wa 05 Nyakanga 2017 afungwa amezi atatu muri Gereza z’Urwego rushinzwe iperereza mu gisirikare, CMI. Aho ngo yaje kuhava ajyanwa mu rukiko aregwa hamwe n’abandi. Ariko mu gihe cyose yamaze afunzwe, iminsi yose yakorewe iyicarubozo rikomeye. Ati “Baraje bansanga mu gisivili, mu gisivili rero ntibahuza neza kubera amakosa baba bakora. Bazanye abaganga b’abasivili n’abasirikare, baza kwemeza ko nakorewe iyicarubozo cyane.” Mugabo Nelson wo mu Karere ka Nyagatare mu Murenge wa Tabagwe yavuze ko yafatiwe muri Uganda tariki 18 Mutarama 2018. Mu gihe cyose yamaze afunzwe, yakorewe iyicarubozo kugeza ubwo hari igihe bagombaga kumuterura kuko atari akibasha kwigenza. Aganira na IGIHE yagize ati “Badukoreye byinshi, njye ndi umwe mu bakorewe byinshi. Mu 2019 guhera mu kwezi kwa mbere kugera mu kwa kane, ntabwo nagendaga, naraterurwaga nararemaye kubera ingaruka z’inkoni. Ubuzima ntabwo mbwizeye neza.” Bamwe mu bagiye batoterezwa muri Uganda bagiye basigarana ingaruka  z’iryo yicarubozo, bamwe bagapfa abandi bakamugara. Silas Hategekimana, umunyarwanda wamaze ibyumweru atoterezwa mu maboko y’urwego rushinzwe ubutasi mu gisirikare cya Uganda (CMI) yapfuye  muri Nzeri umwaka ushize azize iryo yicarubozo yakorewe ubwo yari afunzwe. Raporo zo kwa muganga zagaragaje ko nyakwigendera yari afite imvune y’urubavu yo ku rwego rwa gatanu ndetse n’ikibazo cy’amaraso yari yarikusanyirije hagati y’igituza n’ibihaha (hemothorax) hamwe no kwangirika ibihaha.Yari afite kandi ikibazo cy’impyiko y’ibumoso yangiritse n’ibikomere mu nda. Raporo y’isuzuma yakorewe igasinywano n’abaganga babiri, igaragaza ko urupfu rwe atari ‘urusanzwe’ ahubwo ko rwatewe no gukubitwa cyane mu gituza no mu nda.

title: Ibimenyetso byakwereka ko umuntu yasazwe n’agahinda gakabije gashobora kuvamo kwiyahura
content:
Kugira agahinda gakabije ni urwego ruri hejuru y’umubabaro kuko agahinda gakabije ko kamara igihe kinini ugereranyine n’umubabaro usanzwe abantu bagira. Kugira agahinda gakabije ariko bifitanye isano n’imiterera ya muntu n’uburyo yakira ibimubayeho bigoye. Si igitangaza ko hari umuntu uzirukanwa ku kazi kubera impamvu runaka akabirwara nk’ibyumweru bibiri afite agahinda, hakaba n’undi uzavuga ati “nta kundi n’i Nyagasambu rirarema” ubuzima bugakomeza. Agahinda gakabije ni iki? Agahinda gasaze ni indwara yo mu mutwe ituma imitekerereze ya muntu ihinduka ikarangwa n’umubabaro umara igihe kitari gito. Ibi bishobora guterwa n’imihindagurikire y’imibereho umuntu ashobora guhura nayo nko gupfusha, gutandukana n’umukunzi, ibibazo byo mu miryango n’ibindi bikora ku ndiba y’amarangamutima.
N’ubwo hari abagera muri iki gihe bakiyumanganya kuburyo utapfa kurabukwa ibyo bari guhura nabyo mu buzima, niwitegereza neza ukumva n’imvugo zabo uzasanga umuntu ufite agahinda gakabije arangwa n’ibimenyetso bikurukira: Gutakaza icyizere cyo kubaho ukanga ubuzima Prof. Sezibera Vincent, umwarimu muri kaminuza y’u Rwanda mu Ishami ry’Ubuzima n’Ubuvuzi, yabwiye IGIHE ko umuntu ufite agahinda gakabije arangwa no guhora avuga ko kubaho ntacyo bimaze birutwa no gupfa. Ati “Mu mvugo ushobora kumva iziganisha ku kwiheba no guta icyizere. Akenshi umuntu aba agaragaza ko ubuzima ntacyo bumaze, ko ejo hazaza nta cyizere hamuha. Ikindi ni ukumva ibitekerezo by’umuntu biganisha ku kuvuga ko gupfa bimurutira kubaho.” Prof. Sezibera akomeza avuga ko uko iminsi ishira ugenda wumva umuntu ashyiraho n’uburyo bwamufasha kubura ubuzima. Kumva nta kintu kikigushishikaza ukazinukwa Agahinda gakabije gashobora kuguhuza ibyo wakundaga biguha ibyishimo nko gukora siporo, gusohokana n’inshuti zawe no gusabana wagiraga kukagabanuka. Prof. Sezibera avuga ko ku mukobwa usanga uburyo yiyitagaho bihinduka, akaba yasohoka atisize amavuta nkuko yabikoraga, imyambarire n’uko agaragara mu bandi ugasanga ntacyo bikimubwiye. Umuhungu byabayeho nawe ngo usanga bimwe byo kuba yakwambara neza  bishira. Ku muntu ufite akazi atangira gukererwa, ndetse yaba yagiraga ibakwe rikagabanuka agatangira no kujya asiba akazi nta mpamvu. Ikindi kandi ni uko ubushake bwo gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina ku bashakanye bugabanuka kuburyo bishobora kuviramo umuntu kuba ikiremba. Umunaniro udashira no guhorana ibitotsi Imwe mu mpamvu ishobora gutera umuntu guhagarika ibyo yakoraga kandi yarabikunze ni ukuba  yumva ananiwe cyane. Agahinda gakabije gashobora kurangwa n’uko umuntu ahorana umunaniro ndetse akumva atentebutse, bikamutera guhorana ibitotsi bya buri gihe. Kugira ubwoba Umuntu wese ashobora kugira ubwoba nko mu gihe agiye gukora ikizami cy’akazi cyangwa agiye guhura n’uwo yihebeye. Rimwe na rimwe kandi hari igihe ubwoba bufasha umuntu kuba yakwitekerezaho bukamutera gufata n’ingamba z’umumaro. Iyo umuntu amaranye ubwoba igihe kirenze ibyumweru bibiri ntibiba bikiri ibisanzwe kuko biba byageze ku rundi rwego. Ibi bituma umuntu yahumeka insigane, akagira guhangayika gukomeye, gututubikana kwa hato na hato no guhora utekereza ko hari ikintu kidasanzwe kigiye kukubaho. Umujinya udasanzwe ku bagabo Agahinda gakabije kibasira abagabo n’abagore ariko ku buryo butandukanye. Ubushakashatsi bugaragaza ko abagabo bafite agahinda gakabije bakunze kugira umujinya udasanzwe, imyitwarire iteye inkeke, kunywa ibiyobyabwenge no kugira uburakari batabasha kugenzura. Imihindagurikire mu bushake bwo gufata amafunguro no kwiyongera cyangwa kugabanuka kw’ibiro Ingano y’ibiro n’ubushake bwo gufata amafunguro bishobora kukwereka ko umuntu afite agahinda gakabije n’ubwo bishobora kugaragara mu buryo butandukanye. Hari abantu ubushake bwo kurya buziyongera cyane bityo ibiro nabyo bikaba byinshi, mu gihe hari abazumva gufata amafunguro ntacyo bikibamariye ari nabyo bituma batakaza ibiro. Kugira amarangamutima utabasha kugenzura Iyo umuntu afite agahinda gakabije, ntaba akibasha kugenzura amarangamutima ye. Mu kanya gato ushobora kumubona afite umujinya mwinshi, ubundi ukamubona arimo kurira nyamara nta ruhare yabigizemo. Amarangamutima y’umuntu wahuye n’ikibazo cyo kugira agahinda gakabije ahora ahindagurika, uko umubonye mu minota mike ishize siko uza ku mubona mu masaha ari imbere. Kwifuza urupfu Kumva urupfu ruruta kubaho ni kimwe mu bimenyetso by’agahinda gakabije, ibi bikajyana no gushaka kwiyahura. Umuntu ajya kwiyahura ageze ku cyiciro cya kane nyuma y’ibindi bitatu aba yanyuzemo abantu ntibabibone cyangwa ntibabyiteho. Imibare y’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku buzima (OMS) igaragaza ko 60% y’abagerageza kwiyahura baba bafite agahinda gakabije, naho 90% baba bafite imwe mu ndwara zo mu mutwe. Prof. Sezibera avuga ko iyo umuntu yamenye icyamubabaje bimufasha kumenya uko yakwiyitaho. Akomeza avuga ko iyo waganiriye n’abantu bakakugaragariza ko bakumvishe kandi bafatanyije nawe mu byakubayeho hari icyo bigufasah mu marangamutima. Yongeraho ko iyo ubona agahinda kagusaze kandi kakurushije imbaraga usanga ababifitiye ubunararibonye babyigiye nk’abafasha mu by’imyumvire, kuko ngo uko wakwivuza malaria ari nako wakwivuza agahinda gakabije. At “ubuzima bwo mu mutwe hari ukuntu babutekereza, hari n’abumva ko umuntu ugiye gushaka ubufasha ari igisebo, abandi bakavuga ngo kujya gusaba ubufasha kubera agahinda ari ukwigira umwana n’ubutesi ngo ntawe agahinda kishe.” Polisi y’u Rwanda yatangaje ko abantu 121 bapfuye biyahuye mu mezi icyenda ya 2019, mu gihe ababigerageje bose hamwe ari 205. OMS ivuga ko abantu miliyoni imwe buri mwaka biyahura ku isi, bivuze ko buri masegonda 40 umuntu aba yiyahuye.

title: Inyungu mu kuba u Rwanda rwarabashije kwikorera umuti ugabanya uburibwe ku barwayi
content: Umuti usanzwe ukoreshwa mu buvuzi witwa Opioid, ukorerwa muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, uhenda inshuro esheshatu ku isoko ryo mu bihugu bikennye, ibituma miliyoni z’abaturage bo muri ibi bihugu batabasha kuwigurira. Ikigo cy’igihugu cy’ubuzima RBC kivuga ko gukora umuti ugabanya uburibwe ‘Morphine’ mu Rwanda byatangiye mu mwaka wa 2014, bikorerwa mu kigo cy’ubushakashatsi mu miti [LABOPHAR] giherereye mu karere ka Huye, mu ntara y’amajyepfo; bigakorwa hifashishijwe ifu ya ‘Morphine’ ibyazwamo umuti usukika. Mbere yo gukora uyu muti, ubushakashatsi bwari bwagaragaje ko abarwayi 7200 bapfaga bishwe na Kanseri cyangwa virusi itera Sida buri mwaka, bapfaga bababara cyane kuko nta miti igabanya ububabare babaga bahawe. Iyo uyu mubare uza kubona imiti igabanya ububabare, hari gukenerwa ibiro 44 bya ‘Morphine’; hatabariwemo abandi barwayi bakenera ubuvuzi bwo kugabanya ububabare nk’inkomere, abahiye, ababagwa, ababyara, n’abandi. Mu 2013, mu Rwanda hakoreshejwe ibiro 0.03 gusa ku baturage bose bari bakeneye imiti igabanya ububabare. Ibi bigaragaza ko igihugu cyari gikeneye gushyira imbaraga mu gushaka imiti igabanya ububabare ikagezwa ku bayikeneye bose kandi ku buryo buboroheye. RBC ivuga ko kuva uyu muti watangira gukorerwa mu Rwanda, hari impinduka zagaragaye mu buvuzi, zirimo kuba Minisiteri y’Ubuzima yarashyizeho politiki ngenderwaho mu kuvura abarwayi bakeneye ubufasha renzamunsi (Palliative Care), bityo ubukangurambaga mu kuvura no gutanga imiti igabanya ububabare ku barwayi bayikeneye bukaba bwariyongereye mu bigo byose by’ubuvuzi mu Rwanda. Iyi minisiteri yanatangije indi gahunda igamije gusuzuma no kuvura ububabare ku murwayi wese ukeneye umuti w’ububabare. Iyi gahunda ikaba ishishikariza cyane abaganga kugira umuco wo gusuzuma ububabare, kwandika imiti y’ububabare, kuzuza igipimo cy’ububabare n’ibyo bakoreye umurwayi mu ifishi ye. Abakora kwa muganga bahuguwe ku gusuzuma no kuvura ububabare, kandi ibitaro byose mu gihugu bibasha gusaba no guhabwa ‘Morphine’ ikorerwa mu Rwanda ku buntu. Bisa n’ibitoroshye kumenya imibare nyayo y’abarwayi bahabwa imiti yo kugabanya ububabare kuko ikusanyamibare rikiri ikibazo, nubwo ibitaro byose mu gihungu bifite iyi miti kandi igahabwa abarwayi bafite ububabare bwinshi. Kugera ubu RBC ivuga ko hakiri imbogamizi ku kugira ububiko buhagije bw’imiti igabanya ububabare kuko ifu ya ‘morphine’ igitangwa n’abaterankunga; bivuze ko hatabayeho gutangira kuyigura mu ngengo y’imari ya leta y’u Rwanda, hashobora kuzavuka ikibazo cy’ingano y’iyo miti mu gihe abaterankunga bahagarika inkunga yabo. Iki kigo kinongeraho ko nubwo ubukangurambaga bwakozwe, mu bigo nderabuzimana bitandukanye hagikenewe imbaraga nyinshi mu kongera ubumenyi n’ubushobozi bwo gusuzuma no gutanga imiti igabanya ububabare. Ikindi kandi bamwe mu baganga baracyatinya kwandikira abarwayi imiti ya ‘morphine’, bityo umurwayi uyikeneye ntahite ayibonera igihe. Umuti ugabanya ububabare ‘Morphine’ ukorerwa mu Rwanda wagiye wiyongera bitewe n’uko abawukeneye basigaye bawubona, ku buryo wavuye ku biro 0.03 muri 2013, ubu hakaba hateganywa gukorwa ibilo 12 bitarenze umwaka wa 2020. Kugera ubu iyi miti iracyatangirwa ubuntu, ariko guverinoma nitangira kuyigura bizasaba ko abarwayi bazajya bayishyura kuri mituweli. Abaharanira ko ubuvuzi bugera kuri bose bavuga ko igisubizo cy’u Rwanda cyo kwikorera imiti igabanya ububabare ku bafite amikoro make, igakwirakwiza mu ngo zo mu gihugu hose binyuze mu bajyanama b’ubuzima, ari ikimenyetso ko ubucuruzi bwa opioid butari bukwiye kureberwa mu mafaranga ashobora gukurwamo. Umuyobozi mukuru w’umuryango ufasha abababaye mu Rwanda, Diane Mukasahaha ati “Abantu bagomba guhabwa ubuvuzi nk’uko umunyamerika abuhabwa. Twese turi abantu, kandi umubiri ni umwe.” Umuryango udaharanira inyungu ‘Hospice Africa Uganda‘ uvuga ko ibihugu 22 muri 54 byo ku mugabane wa Afurika ari byo bifite umuti wizewe kandi uhendutse ugabanya uburibwe. Ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye rigenzura iyubahirizwa ry’amasezerano ku ikoreshwa ry’imiti [International Narcotics Control Board] rivuga ko 90% by’imiti ya opioid bikoreshwa n’ibihugu bikize, ahari 17% gusa y’abaturage bari ku isi. Mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere, igiciro kiri hejuru, amategeko akakaye n’umuco wo kwanga imiti igabanya uburibwe, ni bimwe mu bituma abayikenera benshi batayibona, niyo baba bageze mu minsi yabo ya nyuma. Kuba igiciro cy’imiti igabanya uburibwe kikuba inshuro esheshatu mu bihugu bikennye kuruta mu bihugu bikize; abahanga bavuga ko biterwa n’umubare ukiri muto w’abayikoresha muri ibyo bihugu, bituma guciririkanya ku buryo bwo kuyigura ku giciro gito binanirana. Meg O’Brien ufite ikigo gifasha ibihugu bikennye kwikorera imiti igabanya uburibwe, avuga ko iyi miti igabanya uburibwe ishobora kugira imbata uyikoresha. Gusa leta igenzura ikwirakwizwa ryayo mu rwego rwo kwirinda ibyabaye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho ibinini byoherezwaga mu mijyi mito ku rugero ruruta ingano ikenewe.

title: Inzitiramibu za mbere zakorewe mu Rwanda zigiye guhabwa abaturage
content: Ibi RBC yabitangaje mu gihe abaturage bakomeje kugaragaza ko badahabwa inzitiramibu ku gihe ndetse  n’abazifite zamaze gusaza. Leta y’u Rwanda yatumizaga hanze miliyoni zirindwi z’inzitiramibu zigakoresha amadolari ya Amerika ari hagati ya miliyoni 15 na 17, angana miliyari zigera kuri 17 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Nibura inzitiramibu imwe igura hagati y’amadolari atatu n’igice n’ane. RBC ivuga ko hashize imyaka ibiri abaturage bahawe inzitiramibu ndetse ikanashimangira ko muri Mutarama 2020 hagiye gutangwa izindi  nshya zigera kuri miliyoni  zirindwi. Radio Rwanda yatangaje ko mu nzitiramibu zizatangwa izigera kuri miliyoni eshatu n’igice zakorewe mu Rwanda mu ruganda ruherereye i Masoro mu Karere ka Gasabo. Ibihugu birimo Angola, Zambia na Nigeria bisanzwe byinjiza inzitiramibu zivuye mu bihugu by’i Burayi na Aziya, byiyemeje kuzazivana mu Rwanda. U Rwanda nibura rwakoreshaga miliyari 17 Frw mu gutumiza hanze inzitiramibu, zihabwa ku buntu abaturage bari mu cyiciro cya mbere n’icya kabiri cy’ubudehe. Raporo y’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima iheruka kwerekana ko u Rwanda rwagabanyije cyane indwara ya malaria ho hejuru ya 430, 000 ku bayirwaye mu 2017 ugereranyije na 2016.

title: Umurerwa w’imyaka 16  yasabye ubufasha ngo abashe kujya kwivuza impyiko mu Buhinde
content: Umurerwa  ufite imyaka 16 y’amavuko, ni umwana wa Gatatu mu bana bane bavukana, akaba ari nawe mukobwa mu muryango wa Nyandwi Charles na Umutoni Lyliane. Muri Nyakanga 2018 nibwo ibitaro bya Kaminuza bya Kigali CHUK, byemeje ko arwaye impyiko. Umuganga wamukurikiranye yakoze raporo ayohereza muri Minsiteri y’Ubuzima, leta yemera kumufasha kwivuza. Ibaruwa yasinyweho na Minisitiri, Diane Gashumba yerekana ko leta y’u Rwanda ibinyujije muri Minisiteri y’Ubuzima, yohereje Umurerwa Charlotte kwivuza impyiko mu Buhinde ikazamwishyurira ibijyanye no kwivuza byose. Umuryango we uzishyura amatike no kubayo, byose bizatwara miliyoni esheshatu z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda, mu gihe cy’amezi atatu ateganyijwe ko ubuvuzi buzamara, ashobora kwiyongera. Bikimara kwemezwa ko Umurerwa Charlotte arwaye impyiko, yandikiwe umuti uyungurura amaraso (imashini) ajya gukoresha gatatu mu cyumweru. Icyo gihe waguraga amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi 120 cyakora yaje kugabanyuka ubu ageze ku bihumbi 95 by’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Umubyeyi w’uyu mwana, Umutoni Lyliane yashimiye  leta y’u Rwanda yamuhaye ubuvuzi, agashimira n’abagiraneza bamufashije kugira ngo umwana we abe akiriho. Ati “Ndashimira leta y’u Rwanda, nkongera ngashimira n’ibitaro by’i Kanombe byatubaye hafi, nkongera ngashimira n’inshuti n’imiryango n’abanyarwanda bose ari abari mu Rwanda n’abari hanze baradufashije cyane kugira ngo Charlotte abe ahagaze.” Avuga ko afite icyizere ko bazabona ubufasha, umwana we akongera agasubira ku ishuri. Ati “ Nubundi baradufashije kandi twizeye ko bazadufasha kongera kubona Charlotte ari muzima yasubiye ku ishuri.” Umurerwa Charlotte afite gahunda ya muganga (Rendez-vous) mu Buhinde ku itariki 14 Mutarama 2020. Umutoni Lyliane yabwiye IGIHE ko ari we,  ari na se w’umwana nta kazi gahamye bafite ku buryo babona amafaranga yo kwishyura. Ibizamini byerekanye ko Nyandwi Charles, ariwe uzaha umwana we Umurerwa Charlotte impyiko. Uburwayi bwafashe Umurerwa ageze mu mwaka wa kabiri w’amashuri yisumbuye, ahita acikiriza amashuri, Icyakora afite icyizere ko umunsi umwe azavurwa agakira agasubira ku ishuri. Ufite umutima wo gufasha wakoresha Mobile Money kuri nimero; 0783142511 ibaruye ku Umutoni Lyliane cyangwa 0787387337 ibaruye ku Umurerwa Charlotte. Hari na Nimero ya Konti iri muri Equity Bank Rwanda; ariyo 4003111481123.

title: Ikibazo cy’ababyeyi batererana abana  batewe inda giteye inkeke
content: Minisiteri y’Ubuzima n’iy’Uburinganire n’Iterambere ry’Umuryango zigaragaza ko kuva mu 2016 kugeza muri Kanama 2019, abangavu basaga ibihumbi 70 basambanyijwe banaterwa inda. IGIHE iherutse kumenya amakuru y’umwana w’umukobwa watewe inda afite imyaka 15 ufite ababyeyi bombi ariko wakiriwe n’ikigo cyita ku bana b’abakobwa bari mu buzima bwo mu muhanda, abahohotewe n’abatagira kivurira kizwi nka Centre Marembo.  Umuyobozi w’icyo kigo, Nsabimana Nicolette, yaduhamirije ko uwo mwana twise Alice bamwakiriye ameze nabi atwite, atagira umwitaho kandi afite ababyeyi bombi. Yavuze ko yamwakiriye mu kigo muri Kamena 2019 abyara mu Ukuboza aza no  kujya mu bitaro kubera ikibazo  cy’uburwayi bw’umwana, ababyeyi be bataramugeraho na rimwe. Ibyo ngo byasaga n’aho byamuhungabanyije kuko yageze aho kumva atifuza ko bavuga ababyeyi be. Ati “Akatubwira ko afite Se, akatubwira ko afite nyina kandi kumuvuza byari bikomeye, nta mituweli. Wagira ngo uvuze kuri se cyangwa nyina ukabona agize ikibazo.” Ubwo IGIHE yasuraga Alice kwa muganga,  Nyirakuru wari umurwaje mu bitaro bya Kaminuza bya Kigali, CHUK yavuze ko se na nyina batandukanye ariko ko bamenye ko amakuru y’umwana wabo atwite. Nyina aba mu Ntara y’Iburasirazuba aho akora nk’umuforomokazi mu mushinga ukorera muri iyo Ntara naho se akaba i Kigali Kimironko aho akora mu kigo gicunga umutekano. Nyirakuru yavuze ko n’igihe bakekaga ko Alice atwite batumyeho  nyina ngo aze amurebe, abasaba ko bamwoherereza amafoto kuri Whatsapp ariko ntiyaza kumureba. Ikibazo cyo kutakirwa ku bana batewe inda gisa n’aho ari rusange mu muryango Nyarwanda. Mu nama ya 17 y’igihugu y’umushyikirano, uwitwa Umumararungu Immaculée wo mu Murenge wa Gatsata mu Karere ka Gasabo na we yavuze ko yatewe inda imiryango n’inshuti bakamucikaho. Ati “Jyewe nabyaye nkiri muto maze kubyara nahuye n’itotezwa umuryango uranyanga. Nk’abakobwa twabyariye mu rugo tukiri bato duhura n’ikibazo cyo kwangwa n’imiryango n’inshuti, cyo gutotezwa n’abaturera.” Uwo mukobwa yavuze ko amahirwe yagize ari ay’umushinga ufasha abakobwa bahuye n’icyo kibazo wamufashije, naho ubundi umuryango wari wamwanze bimutera ikibazo gikomeye. Umuhuzabikorwa w’imishinga mu mpuzamiryango iharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu Cladho, Murwanashyaka Evariste yabwiye IGIHE ko mu bukangurambaga bakora bahura n’icyo kibazo. Yavuze ko hari abirukana abana babo bagahungira mu miryango bafitanye isano, hakaba n’ababaha inkono zabo ngo bajye bitekera cyangwa ngo basange ababateye inda. Ati “hari n’abiyahuye.”  Yavuze ko mu Karere ka Kamonyi hari umwana bigeze gusanga yanditse ibaruwa ndende isobanura ko kwiyahura yabitewe no kutakirwa n’iwabo, no kumutoteza. Minisitiri w’uburinganire n’iterambere ry’umuryango Amb. Solina Nyirahabimana yasabye  habaho gufatanya gukumira no kurinda abana mu muryango Nyarwanda ariko akibutsa ko iyo umwana aramutse atewe inda bidakuraho inshingano z’umubyeyi. Ati “Ndagira ngo nibutse ababyeyi ko iyo umwana aramutse atewe inda bidakuraho inshingano z’umubyeyi. Ntabwo uwo mwana umucutsa ntabwo umureka,  ahubwo uba ufite inshingano zo kumureberera ndetse n’umwana abyaye.” Uko kutakirwa neza bishobora kuba imwe mu mpamvu ituma ahatanaboneka ubutabera kubera icyuho kigaragararira mu mibare y’abatewe inda n’abagejejwe imbere y’ubutabera. Imibare y’Ubushinjacyaha bw’u Rwanda igaragaza ko mu mwaka wa 2018/19, abagabo bakekwagaho ibyaha byo gusambanya abangavu bari 3320, mu 2017/18 bari 2926 naho mu wawubanjirije bari 2030.

title: Mu Rwanda havutse abana basaga 1700 kuri Noheli n’Ubunani
content: Umuvugizi wa Minisiteri y’Ubuzima, Kayumba Malick yabwiye IGIHE ko kuri Noheli imibare yabashije gukusanywa ari iy’abana bavukiye mu bitaro n’ibigo nderabuzima bya Leta gusa, bangana na 826. Ku wa 26 Ukuboza 2019, Umuyobozi w’ibitaro bya Muhima biherereye mu Karere ka Nyarugenge, Dr Nkubito Pascal, yabwiye IGIHE ko kuri ibyo bitaro n’ibigo Nderabuzima bikorana havukiye abana 31 barimo  19 bavukiye kuri ibyo bigo nderabuzima bose babasha kubaho. Impuzandengo ya Minisiteri y’Ubuzima igaragaza ko ku mwaka mu bigo nderabuzima n’ibitaro bya Leta n’amavuriro yigenga havukira abana 319 460, mu kwezi kumwe hakavuka 26 253, mu gihe ku munsi ari 875. Iyi mibare y’abana bavutse ku bunani Minisante iyitangaje mu gihe isesengura ry’imibare ryakozwe n’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Bana, Unicef, kuri buri gihugu, mu bisaga 190 ryerekenya ko ku Bunani mu Rwanda hari hitezwe kuvuka abana 933. Unicef igaragaza ko muri rusange umubare w’abana bagomba kuvuka ku wa 1 Mutarama 202o ku Isi bari 392,078, mu bihugu bigomba kuvukamo abana benshi harimo u Buhinde (67,385), u Bushinwa (46,299), Nigeria (26,039), Pakistan (16,787), Indonesia (13,020), Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika (10,452), Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (10,247) na Ethiopia (8,493). UNICEF ivuga ko imibare y’abana bapfa ikiri hejuru, abenshi bahitanwa n’impamvu ziba zishobora kwirindwa nko kubyara imburagihe n’ibindi bibazo. Abana miliyoni 2.5 bavuka bapfuye. U Rwanda rwashyize imbaraga mu kurwanya imfu z’abana, aho mu Ugushyingo 2019, Minisiteri y’Ubuzima yatangaje ko ibitaro birindwi mu Rwanda byasoje umwaka wa 2018/19 nta mubyeyi ubitakarijemo ubuzima abyara, kubera ubufatanye bw’inzego n’ubwitange bw’abakora mu rwego rw’ubuzima. Imibare yerekana ko umubare w’ababyaza mu Rwanda wazamutse aho wavuye ku mubyaza 1 ku baturage 66,749 ugera ku mubyaza umwe ku baturage 4064 muri 2017. Ikigo cy’ibarurishamibare mu Rwanda(NISR) kigaragaza k0 mu 2019 u Rwanda rwari rutuwe n’abaturage miliyoni zisaga 12(12,374,397).

title: Dr Nyirinkwaya yasobanuye byinshi ku kuzinga inda, kubyara igikoko no gusama ushaje
content: Ibi uyu muganga w’inzobere mu ndwara z’abagore yabigarutseho mu kiganiro yagiranye na Televiziyo y’u Rwanda cyibanze kugusobanura bimwe mu bibazo n’indwara zishobora kwibasira ubuzima bw’umugore utwite n’uwo atwite. Dr Nyirinkwaya abajijwe impamvu muri iyi minsi hasigaye hakunze kugaragara ibibazo by’abagore basama nyamara bari mu myaka yo gucura, yavuze ko nawe afite urugero rw’umugore w’imyaka 54 wigeze kugana ibitaro bye yumva ko yaba afite uburwayi bwo mu nda nyamara bamupima bagasanga aratwite. Ati “Mu 2009, hari umubyeyi waje kundeba avuye Musanze aje kwivuza ikibyimba kiri mu nda kigenda gikura, yari afite imyaka 54.  Nanjye numvaga agomba kuba afite ikibyimba ku gasabo k’intanga cyangwa kanseri ntazi iyo ari yo.” Yakomeje agira ati “Turagenda nshyizeho icyuma ngo mupime mbona akana kari kumpepera. Uwo mudamu kuva uwo munota ntabwo yongeye kuvuga,  yarumiwe, ndabyandika arangije aragenda ntacyo ambajije”. Nyirinkwaya yavuze ko gutwita umuntu akuze biterwa n’umubiri w’umuntu kimwe n’uko hari n’ushobora gucura akiri muto kuko  gucura ari ibintu bitagira gahunda bigenderaho. Gutwitira ikintu runaka nka kimwe mu byagarutwweho muri iki kiganiro, Dr Nyirinkwa yavuze ko bibaho.  Ati “Mu bwonko niho umuntu abanza gushaka ibintu, ubwo bushake bw’ibintu buva mu bwonko, ubwo bushake rero bushobora guterwa n’iyo misemburo mishyashya umubyeyi afite kubera ko atwite, hari abo nagiye mbona barya za buji, abandi barya urusenda, abandi bazinukwa ibintu byose.” Nyirinkwaya yongeye ko mu gihe ibyo uyu mugore atwitiye bishobora ku muteza ikibazo agomba kubireka nubwo yaba yumva abishaka bwose. Nyirinkwaya yabajijwe no ku bikunze kuvugwa ko umuntu runaka yaba yabyaye igikoko, inyamaswa cyangwa ikindi kidafite ishusho. Yavuze ko bishoboka ko umuntu ashobora kubyara umwana ufite ikibazo ko ariko ataba ari igikoko. Yagize Ati“Ntabwo ari igikoko, igihe umubyeyi yasamye aba ahuje intanga ngabo n’intanga ngore zigahura zikagira akanyangingo kamwe, kakagenda kigabanya bimwe bikazatanga ubwonko, ibindi bizatanga umutima, ibindi bizatanga umutwe. Hari igihe rero usanga muri uko kugenda byikora ugasanga umutwe uje mu buryo butangaje.” Yongeyeho ati “Usanga wenda afite imisatsi myinshi, ugasanga ijisho aho kuba imbere riri inyuma, ugasanga aho kugira amaso abiri afite rimwe, aho kugira umunwa akaba afite umwobo mu mwanya w’umunwa, rubanda izavuga ngo yabyaye igikoko, ntabwo ari igikoko ni umuntu ariko utuzuye.” Abajijwe icyo atekerezaa kucyo Abanyarwanda bakunze kwita ku kuzingwa bashaka kuvuga ko umugore yaba yararozwe, agatinda kubyara Dr Nyirinkwaya yavuze ko atabyemera Ati “Hari ababyeyi usanga rimwe na rimwe babura imihango, ejo bundi bakayibona nk’uku kwezi akabura imihango, ukwezi gutaha akayibona, rero nk’uwo mubyeyi, azamenya se yasamye ryari?” Dr Nyirinkwaya yatangiye ivuriro La Croix du Sud mu Rwanda mu  mwaka 1995. Yize amasomo y’ubuganga mu gihugu cya Sénégal muri Kamimuza ya Dakar akaba ari naho yakuye impamyabumenyi mu buvuzi bw’indwara z’abagore (Obstetric–Gynecology).

title: Minisitiri w’ubuzima yasabye abajyanama b’ubuzima b’i Rusizi gushaka umushinga ubinjiriza amafaranga
content: Ibi yabigarutseho kuri iki Cyumweru tariki ya 29 Ukuboza, mu ruzindiko yagiriye mu karere ka Rusizi, ubwo yagiranaga inama nabo ndetse anareba aho gahunda yo gukingira Ebola igeze muri aka karere. Dr Diane Gashumba yabibasabye yifashishije urugero rw’abajyanama b’ubuzima bo mu karere ka Karongi, maze asaba abajyanama b’ubuzima bo mu karere ka Rusizi ko nabo bakwiye kwishyira hamwe bakagira umushinga wabateza imbere. Ati “Karongi aho intara ifite icyicaro muzi ikizu cy’abajyanama b’ubuzima gihari, kiza cyane cy’ubucuruzi. Uriya ni umushinga mwiza, natwe abajyanama b’ubuzima ba hano muri Rusizi tugire umushinga udushyira hamwe, tugire udushinga n’iyo twaba duto ariko dufite akamaro.” Yasabye umuyobozi w’ibitaro bya Gihundwe kugaragaza umushinga w’abajyanama b’ubuzima kugira ngo uzabateze imbere. Dr Placide Nshizirungu, umuyobozi w’ibi bitaro yavuze ko hari ikigo cyiri kubigira umushinga wo kubaka inzu y’ubucuruzi, ku buryo vuba aha bazaba bamenye uko bihagaze. Ati “Icyo kigo cyiri gufatanya n’akarere na Minisiteri y’ubuzima kureba uburyo amakoperative y’abajyanama b’ubuzima bo mu karere ka Rusizi yakwiteza imbere. Hari umushinga mwiza uteganyijwe kandi nidufatanya tuzawugeraho wo kubaka inzu y’ubucuruzi muri gare ya Rusizi.” Ni inkuru abajyanama b’ubuzima bakiranye ibyishimo. Nyirabanguka Léonille yavuze ko bagize amahirwe iyo nzu ikubakwa, byanaha amahirwe bamwe mu bajyanama b’ubuzima badafite ikindi bakora. Ati “Hari umugabane shingiro buri munyamuryango yagiye atanga, yuzuye yadufasha kuko hari n’abajyanama badafite akazi, urumva yadufasha buri wese akabasha kwiteza imbere.”  Havugimana Ildephonse na we yagize ati “kiriya gitekerezo ni cyiza. Hariya hantu ni heza, ni ahantu hagendwa haba abantu benshi. Nituramuka tuyujuje tuzabona inyungu ifashe buri mujyanama kwiteza imbere.” Mu karere ka Rusizi habarurwa abajyanama b’ubuzima 2305 bari mu mirenge yose 18 igize akarere. Abajyanama b’ubuzima bo mu Karere ka Karongi bibumbiye muri koperative 22 mu 2017 bujuje inzu y’ubucuruzi yatwaye amafaranga miliyoni 350, bakuye mu kwizigama. Buri koperative yagiye itanga miliyoni 9 n’ibihumbi 100 Frw kugira iyo nzu yubakwe.

title: 2019: Umwaka usize ubudasa n’icyizere bitajegajega mu buvuzi bw’u Rwanda
content: Uyu mwaka usigaje iminsi ibarirwa ku ntoki ngo urangire, urwego rw’ubuzima mu Rwanda rwageze kuri byinshi bidasanzwe, byubaka ubudasa n’icyizere cy’ahazaza ku buzima bw’abenegihugu. Uretse kwakira inama zikomeye zigiwemo ingingo zitandukanye ku bibangamiye iterambere ry’urwego rw’ubuvuzi ku Rwanda n’Isi muri Rusange kandi zigafatirwa ingamba, hari ibindi bikorwa bitanga icyizere cy’ahazaza birimo gutangiza ubuvuzi butamenyerewe, ubuvumbuzi bw’udukoko tudasanzwe n’ibindi. Bimwe mu byagezweho bitanga icyizerere cy’ubuvuzi: Kubaga umurwayi adasatuwe igice kinini cy’umubiri Muri uyu mwaka nibwo Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yateye intambwe idasanzwe, itangiza ubuvuzi buhambaye bwifashisha ikoranabuhanaga mu kubaga umurwayi indwara z’imbere mu mubiri hatabayeho gusatura igice kinini cyawo, hagasaturwa igice gito kinyuzwamo ibikoresho byabugenewe mu kuvura igice kirwaye. Ubu buryo bwitwa ‘Minimally Invasive Surgery’ abaganga b’inzobere mu kubaga batobora agace gato k’umubiri, bakoherezamo ibikoresho byabugenewe, bakavura igice kirwaye barebera ku mashini, barangiza bagasubiranye ka gace kasatuwe ku buryo uwabazwe ashobora no gutaha mu rugo  bucyeye. Ni ubuvuzi bwatangijwe muri Nzeri. Ubu buryo bwaje busanga ubwifashishwaga buciriritse, bushobora kwifashishwa mu kubaga ibice bitandukanye birimo mu nda, kubaga ababyeyi, kanseri y’udusabo tw’intanga tw’abagabo n’ibindi. Abana bavutse bamaze igihe gito basamwe,  babaho Mu Ugushyingo nibwo ku nshuro ya mbere abaganga bo mu Rwanda babashije kwita ku mubyeyi wabyaye amaze igihe gito gishoboka asamye, abana be bakabaho. Aba bana b’impanga babyawe na Umutoni Peace na Ntaganira Felix, ababyeyi bo mu Murenge wa Kinyinya mu Karere ka Gasobo nyuma y’ibyumweru 24 basamwe, bitabwaho n’abaganga bo ku bitaro byitiriwe umwami Faisal. Umuyobozi w’agateganyo w’ibitaro byitiriwe umwami Faisal,  Dr Kalimba Edgar, yabwiye IGIHE ko “Atari bishya ko abana bavuka batujuje amezi icyenda bakitabwaho bakabaho ariko ni ku nshuro ya mbere abaganga n’ibitaro byo mu Rwanda babashije gufasha abana bavutse bamaze amezi macye.” Ubusanzwe abana barenga 70% bavutse bamaze hejuru y’ibyumweru 28 nibo babaho ariko ku bari munsi yabyo nk’aho bavukiye ibyumweru 24 bigoye ko babaho. Ni igikorwa kigaragaza ko hari intambwe ishimishije abaganga n’ibitaro byo mu Rwanda bitera mu kongera no kunoza serivisi z’ubuvuzi butangwa. Kwemeza ubushakashatsi ku bwoko bushya bw’agakoko gatera igituntu Muri uyu mwaka nibwo Itsinda ry’abakozi b’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ubuzima mu Rwanda (RBC), mu ishami rya Laboratwari, ryavumbuye ubwoko budasanzwe bw’agakoko gatera igituntu butigeze buvumburwa n’abandi bahanga ku Isi mu mateka y’iyi ndwara. Iri tsinda ryatangiye ubushakashatsi ku gikororwa cy’umurwayi w’umunyarwanda yatanze muri Gicurasi 2017, abarigize bamurika uburyo bavumbuye aka gakoko mu nama mpuzamahanga y’abashakashatsi ku dukoko dutera igituntu yabereye muri Espagne hagati ya 30 Kamena na 4 Nyakanga, buhita bwemezwa. Ni intambwe ishimishije igaragaza intambwe urwego rw’ubuvuzi mu Rwanda bugenda  butera, by’umwihariko mu gutera intambwe igana ku buvumbuzi bw’indwara n’imiti ihangana nazo.  Kurenza intego ya Loni mu kwita ku bafite virusi itera SIDA Umwaka wa 2019 wabaye uw’ubudasa ku Rwanda ku ruhando mpuzamahanga mu bijyanye no kurwanya no gukumira icyorezo cya virus itera SIDA. Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye rishinzwe kurwanye SIDA (UNAIDs) ryihaye intego ya  (90-90-90) ko mu 2020 abafite virusi itera Sida bazaba bazi uko bahagaze ari 90%, abafata imiti 90% naho kugabanuka kwa virusi itera Sida bikaba 90%. Raporo nshya yashyizwe abahona kuwa 25 Nzeri 2019 yagaragaje ko u Rwanda rwateye intambwe idasanzwe mu gukumira icyorezo cya Sida, by’umwihariko rukomeje kuza imbere mu gufasha abayirwaye kubona imiti no kubarinda ingaruka zayo. Mu Rwanda raporo igaragaza ko ikigero cyo kumenya uko abantu bahagaze ari 84%, abafata imiti ari 98% naho ikigero cyo kugabanuka kwa virusi itera SIDA  mu mubiri kiri kuri 90%. Umusanzu mu kurwanya indwara zihangayikishije Isi Muri mwaka benshi ntibazibagirwa ukuntu Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yemeye gutanga miliyoni $ 2.5 (asaga miliyari 2.3 Frw) mu Kigega Global Fund, azakoreshwa mu rugamba rwo kurwanya indwara eshatu zihangayikishije Isi, arizo Virusi itera Sida, igituntu na Malaria kugeza mu 2023. Niyo mafaranga menshi yari abashije gukusanywa n’umuryango uhuriwemo n’impande nyinshi, ari nayo menshi Global Fund yabashije gukusanya kuva yashingwa. Azashorwa mu bikorwa byitezweho kurokora ubuzima bw’abantu miliyoni 16, no gushyira iherezo ku ndwara za Sida, Igituntu na Malaria bitarenze umwaka wa 2030. Perezida Kagame yagenewe igihembo ku kugeza ubuvuzi kuri bose Muri Werurwe uyu mwaka nibwo umuryango Nyafurika ugamije kugeza ubuvuzi burambye kuri bose ‘Amref Health Africa’ wageneye igihembo Perezida Kagame, cy’umuyobozi w’igihugu wagize uruhare rukomeye mu gushyigikira gahunda n’ibikorwa bigamije kugeza ubuvuzi kuri bose muri Afurika (Universal Health Coverage Presidential Champion Award). Minisitiri w’Ubuzima Dr. Diane Gashumba washyikirijwe iki gihembo icyo gihe yavuze ko kigaragaza uguha agaciro ibikorwa Perezida Kagame akorera abo ayobora, bigiye kongerera imbaraga abakozi b’ibitaro, amavuriro, ibigo nderabuzima n’abandi zo gukora bivuye inyuma. U Rwanda rwungutse ikigo gikora insimburangingo n’inyunganirangingo Muri Mata uyu mwaka nibwo u Rwanda rwujuje ikigo kizajya cyita ku bafite ubumuga, kigakora insimburangingo n’inyunganirangingo, hagamijwe gukuraho imbogamizi ku iterambere ry’abafite ubumuga. Iki kigo giherereye i Gahini mu Karere ka Kayonza, cyubatswe n’umuryango ufasha abafite ubumuga, Christian Blind Mission (CBM), ku bufatanye n’itorero ry’Abangilikani, Diyosezi ya Gahini n’Inama y’Igihugu y’Abafite Ubumuga (NCPD). Cyuzuye gitwaye miliyari 1,5Frw utabariyemo ibikoresho bizagishirwamo’. Hatangijwe ikinyamakuru cy’ubuzima Muri uyu mwaka nibwo ku nshuro ya mbere u Rwanda rwatangije ikinyamakuru cyitezweho gufasha abanyaranwanda n’abanyamahanga kubona amakuru yizewe ku buntu no kwirinda ibihuha Iki kinyamakuru gifite ishusho nk’iy’igitabo, kitwa ‘Rwanda Public Health Bulletin’, cyafunguwe ku wa 30 Mata 2019, Kizajya gisohoka kabiri mu mwaka [Muri Werurwe na Nzeri] gikwirakwizwe ku bigo nderabuzima, ku bitaro no ku biro by’ubuyobozi, gitangwe ku buntu. Ni intambwe ishimishije kuko cyatangijwe ngo gisubize ikibazo cy’uko abantu batabonaga amakuru y’impamo kuri gahunda zitandukanye z’ubuzima mu Rwanda, bigatuma bajya kuyashakishiriza ahatizewe. Gutaha inyubako izajya ibikwamo inkingo  Muri Gicurasi uyu mwaka kandi Minisiteri y’Ubuzima yatashye ku mugaragaro inyubako izajya ibikwamo inkingo z’abana, imiti n’ibindi bikoresho byo kwa muganga, ifite agaciro ka miliyari na miliyoni 800 Frw. Iyi nyubako iherereye mu cyanya cyagenewe inganda i Masoro mu Karere ka Gasabo, niyo izajya ibikwamo inkingo zose zifashishwa mu gukingira abana, Ubusanzwe inkingo zikoreshwa mu gukingira abana mu Rwanda zabikwaga mu nzu yakodeshwaga miliyoni 4 Frw ku kwezi. Zimwe mu nama mpuzahanga zabereye mu Rwanda Muri uyu mwaka u Rwanda rwakiriye inama mpuzamahanga zitandukanye ziga kuri gahunda zo guteza imbere ubuvuzi muri rusange. Kuva tariki  1 kugeza tariki ya 7 Ukuboza 2019 u Rwanda rwakiriye inama idasanzwe yiga ku kurwanya virusi itera Sida ndetse n’izindi ndwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina (ICASA). Ni imwe mu nama zitabiriwe n’abantu benshi rwakiriye, bagera ku bihumbi 10 bari baturutse hirya no hino ku Isi, barimo abashakashatsi, abarimu muri za Kaminuza, abikorera, abayobozi mu nzego za leta, abafite ubwandu bwa Virusi itera Sida n’ababafasha. Muri iyo nama hagaragarijwemo intambwe ibihugu bigenda bitera mu kurwanya virusi itera SIDA, gufasha abayirwa n’ibindi bigamije gukumira ko iki cyorezo cyakomeza kwibasira imbaga y’agatuye Isi. Muri Gicurasi kandi u Rwanda rwakiriye inama Nyafurika yiga ku buzima bw’abana bakivuka, yahuje inzobere z’abaganga b’indwara z’abana, ababyaza n’abandi bakora mu nzego z’ubuzima mu Rwanda, u Burundi, Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda na Zambia  bagameje gushaka uko ubuvuzi bw’abana bwatezwa imbere. Muri Nzeri kandi u Rwanda rwakiriye inama nyafurika yiga ku gutanga ubufasha ku barwaye indwara zidakira kandi zitera uburibwe, igamije kongera imbaraga mu kwinjiza ubuvuzi bw’indwara zidakira muri serivisi z’ubuvuzi budaheza, kongera ibikoresho byifashishwa ku kuvura abazirwaye n’ibindi. Muri Werurwe naho rwakiriye inama Nyafurika igamije gusuzuma uko gahunda zo kugeza ubuvuzi kuri bose zarushaho kunozwa n’izindi.

title: U Bushinwa: Abanduye Coronavirus batangiye kwimurirwa mu bitaro byihariye byubatswe mu minsi 10
content: Kuri iki cyumweru nibwo ibyo bitaro byubatswe mu minsi 10 gusa, byashyikirijwe abaganga ba gisirikare ngo batangire kwita ku barwayi.  Byubatswe kuri metero kare 34.000. Magingo aya birimo gukorwamo n’abaganga 1400 b’abasirikare. Kugira ngo byuzure vuba, abubatsi bifashishije uburyo bwo kubakisha ibice biba byateranyijwe mbere ndetse bakora amanywa n’ijoro. Imibare itangazwa n’u Bushinwa igaragaza ko abantu bamaze kwandura coronavirus nshya ari 17.238 bo mu Bushinwa na 148 bo mu bindi bihugu. Mu bamaze gupfa harimo 361 bo mu Bushinwa n’umwe wo hanze yabwo, waguye muri Philippines ku wa Gatandatu. Hari na 480 bamaze gukira, basezerewe basubira mu miryango yabo. Iyi ndwara yagaragaye bwa mbere mu Bushinwa, uretse abenegihugu bayanduye, Minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga y’u Bushinwa yatangaje ko hari abanyamahanga 16 bamaze kwandura, nubwo ibihugu bakomokamo bitatangajwe.

title: U Rwanda rugiye gutaha ku mugararo ikigo kivura kanseri
content: Iki kigo cyubatswe mu Bitaro bya Gisirikare i Kanombe, kigiye gutahwa mu gihe kuri uyu wa 4 Gashyantare 2020, u Rwanda ruzaba rwifatanya n’Isi mu kwizihiza umunsi wahariwe kurwanya indwara ya kanseri. Iki kigo kizaba gikoresha uburyo bwo kuvura hakoreshejwe imirasire (Radiotherapy), aho hifashishijwe imashini zabigenewe, zerekeza imirasire (radiations) ahari uburwayi, iyo mirasire ikica uturemangingo twa kanseri. Kizajya cyakira abarwayi bo mu Rwanda no mu karere. Ubusanzwe mu kuvura kanseri hifashishwa uburyo butatu; kubaga no gukuraho ahafashwe na kanseri, gutanga imiti no gukoresha imirasire ugashiririza aharwaye. Ubwo hamurikwaga umushinga w’ikikigo, Umuyobozi wacyo, Lt Col. Pacifique Mugenzi, yavuze ko gifite ikoranabuhanga rihambaye mu kuvura kanseri kandi cyiteguye gutanga serivisi zo ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Yavuze ko kizaba gifite ubushobozi bwo kuvura abarwayi 80 ku munsi, bikagabanya umubare w’abajyaga kwivuza kanseri mu mahanga kuko kizajya gitanga serivisi zo ku rwego rwo hejuru. Yanagaragaje ko iki kigo gifite imashini ebyiri zagenewe kuvura kanseri zikoresheje imirasire zikaba zifite ikoranabuhanga rizifasha kudahusha kw’imirasire yapimiranijwe aharwaye nk’uko hari aho bijya biba. Serivisi zo kuvurisha kanseri imirasire zizahabwa umunyarwanda wese uzikeneye ukoresha ubwishingizi bwose bukoreshwa mu Rwanda, harimo na Mituweli. Iki kigo kandi kizanatanga serivisi ku baturage bo mu karere bose. Rwanda Cancer Center ije yiyongera kuri serivisi zo kuvura kanseri zibarizwa mu bitaro bya Butaro mu Karere ka Burera. Kugeza ubu kanseri iza ku mwanya wa kabiri mu ndwara zihitana abantu benshi ku Isi, aho mu mwaka wa 2018 abantu miliyoni 9.6 bayizize. Nibura ku Isi yose, umwe mu bantu batandatu bapfa aba azize kanseri. Iyi mibare kandi yerekana ko hafi 70% by’abantu ihitana, babarizwa mu bihugu bikennye n’ibiri mu nzira y’amajyambere.

title: U Rwanda rwashimiye u Bushinwa ku bufasha buri guha abanyarwanda 155 bari mu gace karimo Coronavirus
content: Kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 31 Mutamara nibwo Minisitiri Biruta yagiranye ibiganiro na Ambasaderi Hongwei aho yamushimiye uburyo u Bushinwa buri kurwanya icyorezo cya Coronavirus bwahuye nacyo anamufata mu mugongo kubera ingaruka cyateye. Itangazo ryashyizwe ahagaragara na Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga, rivuga ko u Rwanda rwashimiye u Bushinwa ku buryo buri gufata abanyamahanga babarizwa muri iki gihugu. Minisitiri Biruta yagize ati “Dushimiye u Bushinwa ku buryo buri kurwanya ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus ndetse n’ubufasha bwabwo ku banyamahanga barimo n’abanyarwanda baba mu Ntara ya Hubei.” Minisitiri Biruta yashimye Ambasaderi w’u Bushinwa ku bufasha burimo ibiribwa n’ibindi bikoresho nkenerwa byahawe abanyarwanda bari mu ntara ya Hubei bigizwemo uruhare n’ubuyobozi bwo muri aka gace hamwe na Ambasade y’u Rwanda i Beijing. Minisiteri y’Ubuzima yatangaje ko nta muntu n’umwe uragaragara mu Rwanda afite virusi ya Coronavirus, isaba abanyarwanda kwirinda kujya mu bihugu yagaragayemo n’ugiyeyo akitwararika akirinda akarinda n’abandi. Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru cyahuje Minisiteri y’Ubuzima n’iy’Ububanyi n’Amahanga; Umunyamabanga Uhoraho muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga, Urujeni Bakuramutsa, yavuze ko binyujijwe muri Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Bushinwa, abanyarwanda baba mu ntara ya Hubei barimo kugirwa inama kandi kugeza ubu nta munyarwanda urandura iki cyorezo. Hari ibihugu bitandukanye bikomeje kubwira abaturage babyo kuva mu Bushinwa ndetse bimwe bikajya kubacyura. Minisitiri Dr Gashumba, yavuze ko u Rwanda rutaragera aho gufata iki cyemezo. Ati “Twizeye urwego rw’ubuzima rw’u Bushinwa, kandi abantu bacu bariyo cyane abanyeshuri bariyo barakuze bazi uburyo bwo kwirinda ntabwo turagera ku rwego rwo kubagarura mu Rwanda kandi Ambasade y’u Rwanda iri hafi yabo. Ubu bimeze neza ntabwo turatekereza ku ngingo yo kubazana”. U Rwanda rukomeje gushyiraho ingamba zikomeye zigamije gukumira ko iki cyorezo cyakwinjira mu gihugu. Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ubuzima (RBC) cyashyizeho itsinda ry’abaganga bahoraho 10 n’abandi bashobora kuryunganira igihe bibaye ngomba, bapima ibimenyetso bya Virus ya Coronavirus kuri buri muntu wese uvuye hanze y’u Rwanda, cyane cyane mu Bushinwa cyangwa uwo bikekwa ko yahageze kandi bashobora no gutanga ubufasha ku muntu babisangana. Ku rundi ruhande, RwandAir yahagaritse ingendo hagati ya Kigali na Guangzhou guhera kuri uyu wa 31 Mutarama 2020, itangaza ko iki cyemezo kizongera gusuzumwa vuba muri Gashyantare 2020. Mu mpera z’umwaka ushize nibwo virus ya Coronavirus yagaragaye bwa mbere mu Mujyi wa Wuhan mu Bushinwa. Imibare mishya igaragaza ko abantu 9809 aribo bamaze kwandura iki cyorezo mu gihe 213 mu Bushinwa bahitanywe nayo. Ibimenyetso by’indwara ya Coronavirus birimo kugira umuriro, gukorora no guhumeka nabi ndetse ishobora no kugera aho itera umusonga no kubuza impyiko gukora bishobora gutera urupfu. Zimwe mu ngamba abantu bakwiye kwimakaza mu kuyirinda harimo gukaraba intoki n’amazi meza n’isabune, gukinga urushyi ku mazuru no ku munwa igihe umuntu bikekwa ko ayirwaye akorora cyangwa ahumeka, guteka inyama n’amagi bigashya neza. Hari kandi kwifashisha imiti yabugenewe yo gukaraba yica udukoko, kwirinda gukorakora amazuru, amaso n’umunwa igihe umuntu atakarabye, kwirinda kwegera umuntu ufite ibyago byo kuyandura hamwe no kuguma mu rugo igihe ufite ibimenyetso byayo.

title: U Rwanda ntirurateganya kuvana abaturage barwo mu Bushinwa kubera Coronavirus
content: Icyorezo cya Coronavirus kimaze guhitana abagera kuri 213, abarenga ibihumbi icyenda bamaze kucyandura naho ibihugu 23 bimaze kugeramo iki cyorezo. Mu kiganiro Minisiteri y’Ubuzima ifatanyije n’iy’Ububanyi n’Amahanga, bagiranye n’itangazamakuru ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa Gatanu, abanyarwanda basabwe kugira isuku kandi n’ugiye kwitsamura agakinga agatamburo ku mazuru. Minisitiri w’Ubuzima, Dr Diane Gashumba, yabwiye abanyarwanda ‘Gukomeza kwirinda cyane ingendo z’ahavuzwe icyorezo, baba bagiyeyo ari amaburakindi bakirinda, bakarinda n’abandi b’aho bazajya’. Minisitiri Biruta yashimiye u Bushinwa uburyo burimo guhangana n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus ndetse n’ubufasha burimo guha abanyamahanga babubamo barimo n’abanyarwanda baba mu ntara ya Hubei. Yanashimiye kandi ubufasha burimo ibiribwa n’ibindi nkenerwa by’ibanze byahawe abanyarwanda 155 baba mu ntara ya Hubei, ku bufatanye na Ambasade y’u Rwanda i Beijing. Umuyobozi w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ubuzima (RBC), Dr Sabin Nsanzimana, yavuze ko uretse kubaza ibibazo abageze ku kibuga cy’indege hari n’ibindi bipimwa nk’umuriro, gukorora n’ibicurane. Yashishikarije abanyarwanda kwirinda, kwivuza hakiri kare kandi uburyo bwashyizweho bwo kwirinda Ebola [gupima umuriro ku mipaka], burimo no gukoreshwa mu gupima iki cyorezo. Minisante kandi isaba abanyarwanda gukaraba intoki n’amazi meza n’isabune, gukinga urushyi ku mazuru no ku munwa igihe umuntu bikekwa ko ayirwaye akorora cyangwa ahumeka, guteka inyama n’amagi bigashya neza.
