title: Bwa mbere mu Bwongereza hagaragaye abanduye ‘coronavirus’
content: Aba bantu byemejwe ko bafite ubwo bwandu nyuma yo gukorerewa isuzuma, nta myirondoro yabo yashyizwe ahagaragara ndetse n’aho bari kuvurirwa ntihatangajwe. Amakuru avuga ko abagaragaweho n’icyorezo cya ‘coronavirus’ ari abo mu muryango umwe kandi ubu batangiye kwitabwaho n’abaganga. Umuyobozi w’inzego z’ubuvuzi mu Bwongereza, Prof Chris Whitty, yatangaje ko biteguye neza kandi bari guhangana n’ubwo bwandu kandi  bari gukora ibishoboka byose ngo bamenye niba hari abandi bantu bahuye n’abo barwayi mu rwego rwo kwirinda ko icyorezo cyakwirakwira. Ati “Twari twariteguye ko icyorezo cya ‘novel coronavirus’ gishobora kugera mu Bwongereza kandi twashyizeho uburyo n’ingamba bihambaye mu kugenzura ubwandu ako kanya.” Prof Whitty yongeyeho  ko kuva iki cyorezo cyakwaduka mu Bushinwa, igihugu cy’u Bwongereza cyakoranye bya hafi n’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima (OMS) hagamijwe kwitegura neza ikibazo cyose cyavuka. Kugeza ubu abantu basaga 213 bamaze kwitaba Imana mu Bushinwa, ari naho hakomotse iki cyorezo; umubare munini ukaba ari abo mu ntara ya Hubei, mu gihe imibare y’abamaze kwandura basaga ibihumbi 10 mu Bushinwa gusa. Usibye mu Bushinwa, ibihugu 18 hirya no hino ku isi bimaze kugerwamo n’iki cyorezo. Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku buzima, OMS, ryatangaje ko icyorezo gishya cya Coronavirus gikomeje gukwirakwira mu bihugu bitandukanye gihangayikishije Isi kitakiri ikibazo cy’u Bushinwa n’ibihugu cyagezemo. Umuyobozi wa OMS, Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, yavuze ko impamvu bakigize ikibazo cy’Isi yose atari impamvu z’u Bushinwa ahubwo ari ibiri kuba ku bindi bihugu. Mu kiganiro n’itangazamakuru i Genève, Dr Tedros, yavuze ko ari icyorezo kitigeze kibaho bityo ko nta n’umuti wacyo uhari magingo aya. BBC yatangaje ko ubu OMS igiye gufasha ibihugu bikennye n’ibifite ubukungu buciriritse, gukomeza ubwirinzi no kwitegura igihe hagira uwo Coronavirus igaragaraho. Amakuru avuga ko abashakashatsi bari gukora amanywa n’ijoro kugira ngo babone urukingo rw’iyo virus. Imwe muri Laboratwari zo muri California yatangaje igeragezwa rya mbere ryarwo rizakorwa hagati ya Kamena na Nyakanga nk’igerageza. Coronavirus ibaye icyorezo cya Kane OMS itangaje ko kidasanzwe kandi kireba Isi mu maguru mashya. Ni nyuma ya Swine flu ibicurane by’ingurube byateye mu 2009 biterwa na virus ya H1N1 byakwirakwiye ku Isi bigahitana abarenga ibihumbi 200, imbasa mu 2014 na Virus ya Zika mu 2016 isakazwa n’imibu yo mu bwoko bwa Aedesaegypti, ifite inkomoko mu ishyamba rya Zika muri Uganda.

title: Rusizi: Abatuye ku kirwa cya Nkombo batangiye gukingirwa Ebola
content: Ubusanzwe ahakingirirwa Ebola mu karere ka Rusizi hari mu ku kigo nderabuzima cya Gihundwe, ku mupaka wa Rusizi ya Mbere, ku kigo nderabuzima cya Islamique  Bugarama no ku mupaka uhuza u Rwanda na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo ku gice cya Bugarama, hakaba hiyongereyeho no ku kirwa cya Nkombo giherereye mu kiyaga cya Kivu. Minisitiri w’ubuzima Dr. Diane Gashumba ubwo yatangizaga iki gikorwa yabwiye abatuye ko urukingo rwa mbere ari ukigira isuku. Ati “Kuba mwaje muri benshi byerekana ko mwumvise agaciro k’uru rukingo. Ndabashimira imbaraga mwashyizemo kugira ngo  kugeza uyu munsi igihugu cyacu kibe cyidafite icyorezo cya Ebola. Ni imbaraga zanyu n’ubwo bushake bwanyu, ni gahunda y’isuku. Urukingo rwa mbere rw’indwara ni isuku, ibindi bikaza byunganira.” Dr Kasonde Mwinga, uhagarariye ishami ry’umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku buzima mu Rwanda,  yabwiye abatuye kuri iki kirwa ko bakwiye kugira isuku atari ukwirinda Ebola gusa ahubwo bagamije kwirinda indwara. Ati “Izi ngamba zo kugira isuku ni ingenzi cyane atari ukwirinda Ebola gusa ahubwo no kwirinda izindi indwara zinyuranye. Igihe muhawe urukingo rwa mbere ntimugacike integer,  mujye muza no gufata urwa kabiri.” Ikirwa cya Nkombo kigizwe n’ibirwa bibiri bituwe n’abaturage 18,700 abenshi muri bo bakora uburyobyi ndetse bagacuruza ibikomoka ku bworozi bw’amafi. Abahatuye bavuga ko bishimiye kuba bagiye gukingirwa Ebola bizafasha gukomeza gukora akazi kabo neza ko mu mazi ndetse n’ingendo bakora bajya gukorera muri Repubulika Iharanira Demukarasi ya Congo. Barabona Evariste yagize  ati “Urareba hano dutunzwe no kuroba ndetse hari na benshi bajya muri Congo, urumva dukunze guhura n’abanye Congo, uru rukingo rero ruzadufasha kwirinda Ebola.” Biyoga Lambert yunzemo ati “Ni igikorwa cyiza cyane kandi twishimiye, abayobozi bakoze kudutekerezaho nk’abantu batuye ku kirwa kuko akenshi duhura n’abanye-Congo cyane kandi tuzi ko ho hagaragaye Ebola.” Kuva gahunda yo gukingira Ebola yatangira, abantu 13323 bamaze gukingirwa harimo abagore bari ku kigero cya  45% n’abagabo 55%.

title: OMS yatangaje Coronavirus nk’icyorezo gihangayikishije Isi
content: Umuyobozi wa OMS, Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, yavuze ko impamvu bakigize ikibazo cy’Isi yose atari impamvu z’u Bushinwa ahubwo ari ibiri kuba ku bindi bihugu. Hari impungenge ko icyo cyorezo kimaze guhitana abantu 170 mu Bushinwa gishobora gukomeza gukwirakwira mu bihugu bifite inzego z’ubuzima zitubatse neza. OMS yatangaje ko Coronavirus imaze kugaragara ku bantu 98 mu bihugu 18 hanze y’u Bushinwa, ariko nta muntu kirahitana muri ibyo bihugu. Ibibazo byinshi ngo byaturutse ku bantu bakoze ingendo bavuye mu Mujyi wa Wuhan cyatangiriyemo. Cyakora mu Budage, u Buyapani, Vietnam na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika hamaze kugaragara abantu umunani bacyanduzanyije. Mu kiganiro n’itangazamakuru i Genève, Dr Tedros, yavuze ko ari icyorezo kitigeze kibaho bityo ko nta n’umuti wacyo uhari magingo aya. BBC yatangaje ko ubu OMS igiye gufasha ibihugu bikennye n’ibifite ubukungu buciriritse, gukomeza ubwirinzi no kwitegura igihe hagira uwo Coronavirus igaragaraho. Amakuru avuga ko abashakashatsi bari gukora amanywa n’ijoro kugira ngo babone urukingo rw’iyo virus. Imwe muri Laboratwari zo muri California yatangaje igeragezwa rya mbere ryarwo rizakorwa hagati ya Kamena na Nyakanga nk’igerageza. Coronavirus ibaye icyorezo cya Kane OMS itangaje ko kidasanzwe kandi kireba Isi mu maguru mashya. Ni nyuma ya Swine flu ibicurane by’ingurube byateye mu 2009 biterwa na virus ya H1N1 byakwirakwiye ku Isi bigahitana abarenga ibihumbi 200, imbasa mu 2014 na Virus ya Zika mu 2016 isakazwa n’imibu yo mu bwoko bwa Aedesaegypti, ifite inkomoko mu ishyamba rya Zika muri Uganda. Naho mu 2014 na 2019 yatangaje ko Ebola muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo ihangayikishije Isi. Ubwa mbere gahati ya Kanama 2014 na Werurwe 2016 yahitanye abantu ibihumbi 11 abagera ku bihumbi 30 bayanduye.

title: Abahanga bari gusiganwa amasigamana bashaka urukingo rwa Coronavirus
content: Ni virusi ya kane izengereje isi mu myaka itanu ishize nyuma ya Ebola, Zika na  Mers ijya gusa nka coronavirus kuko nayo ifata nk’indwara y’ubuhumekero. Abasaga ijana bamaze gupfa kubera Coronavirus, mu gihe ibihumbi n’ibihumbi byanduye. Igitandukanya coronavirus n’izindi ndwara zabanje ni uko zo byafataga igihe kinini ngo haboneke inkingo ariko kuri coronavirus abashakashatsi n’inzobere ntibari kugoheka, guhera umunsi wa mbere itangazwa nk’icyorezo bari kureba ko babona urukingo rwayo. Ibirango bishingiye ku tunyangingo by’iyo ndwara byahise bigaragazwa ubwo u Bushinwa bwavumburaga ko bwatewe n’icyorezo gishya. Ni ibirango bizwi nka genetic code bifasha abahanga kumenya aho iyo virusi yaturutse, uko yacibwa intege n’uburyo abantu bayirinda. Ubufasha bwa Guverinoma zitandukanye buri gutangwa ngo ubushakashatsi bugende neza, hanyuma umuti n’urukingo by’iyo ndwara biboneke vuba. Ikigo cyiswe Inovio kiri i San Diego muri California, abashakashatsi bacyo bari kwifashisha uburyo bushya mu gupima isanomuzi (DNA) mu kurema urukingo rw’iyo virusi. Urwo rukingo rwiswe ‘INO-4800’ biteganyijwe ko ruboneka mu mezi make ari imbere rugatangira kugeragezwa. Umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe ubushakashatsi muri Inovio, Kate Broderick, yabwiye BBC ko ubwo u Bushinwa bwatangazaga ibirango by’iyo virusi , bahise bakoresha ikoranabuhanga ryabo bagashaka uburyo bakora urukingo. Inovio yatangaje ko igerageza rya mbere ry’urwo rukingo nirishoboka, bazakurikizaho andi magerageza akomeye ku buryo mu mpera z’umwaka bazaba bafite urukingo rwuzuye rwabasha guhangana n’iyo ndwara. Mu 2000 ubwo virusi ijya gusa na Coronavirus yitwa Sars yadukaga mu Bushinwa, icyo gihugu cyabaye nk’ikibihisha Isi ntiyamenya uko bihagaze ku buryo abakora ubuvumbuzi bw’urukingo batangiye imirimo icyorezo cyarangiye. Ubushakashatsi bushya buri guterwa inkunga n’ihuriro ry’ibigo bikora ubushakashatsi ku byorezo, Cepi, rigizwe n’ibihugu byose n’imiryango mpuzamahanga. Ni ihuriro ryashinzwe nyuma y’icyorezo cya Ebola cyabonetse muri Afurika y’Iburengerazuba mu 2015, hagamijwe guhangana n’indwara nshya z’ibyorezo. Hari izindi gahunda ebyiri Cepi iri gutera inkunga nazo ziri gukora urukingo rwa coronavirus. Kaminuza ya Queensland iri gukora urukingo rwitezweho kwifashishwa mu guhangana n’uturemangingo tugize virusi ya coronavirus. Ni mu gihe ikindi kigo cyitwa Moderna Inc giherereye muri Massachusetts nacyo cyatangiye ubushakashatsi kuri iyo virusi gifatanyije n’ikigo cya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika gishinzwe kurwanya indwara zandura. Umuryango mpuzamahanga wita ku buzima, OMS wavuze ko uri gukora ibishoboka byose ngo haboneke urukingo rushya. Icyakora imbogamizi igihari ni uko ahari gukorwa ubushakashatsi kuri iyo ndwara hose bikiri ku rwego rwo hasi mu gihe indwara yo ikomeza gukaza umurego. Nta bushakashatsi na bumwe butanga icyizere ko buzarangira bugakoreshwa mu guhangana n’iki cyorezo ubu cyibasiye u Bushinwa. OMS ivuga ko ariyo izatangaza mu minsi ya vuba, urukingo ruzakoreshwa mu igerageza rigamije guhashya icyo cyorezo.

title: Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje icyuho mu buvuzi bw’abavukana indwara zisaba kubagwa mu Rwanda
content: Ubu bushakashatsi bwamuritswe kuri uyu wa 29 Mutarama 2020 bwakozwe n’Ikigo cy’Ubushakashatsi n’Isesengurangamba (IPAR) ku bufatanye n’Ibitaro bya Kaminuza bya Kigali (CHUK) na Kaminuza ya Aberdeen yo muri Écosse. Bwakozwe mu buryo bwo kuganira n’imwe mu miryango yabyaye abana bafite izi ndwara hagamije kureba imbogamizi bagira mu rugendo rwo kwivuza, mu mibereho n’ahandi n’uburyo zashakirwa umuti. Izi ndwara zikunze kwibasira ibice by’urwungano ngogozi, guhera mu kanwa aho ibiryo byinjirira kugera aho bisohokera [mu kibuno], imyanya myibarukiro, ubuhumekero n’ibindi bikabaho mu iremwa ry’ibice by’ingingo z’umubiri w’umuntu. Urugero ni nk’igihe umwana avutse adafite aho yitumira hasanzwe ku muntu udafite ikibazo, iki gihe bisaba ko umuganga w’inzobere amubaga, akamushakira uwo mwanya kugira ngo abashe kuba yabikora nk’abandi. Umuyobozi wa IPAR, Kayitesi Eugenia, yavuze mu Rwanda ababyeyi benshi izi ndwara bazifata nk’izidakira, ziterwa n’amadayimoni n’ibindi kandi zishobora kuvurwa. Ati “Ababyeyi baca mu bibazo byinshi iyo bafite aba bana. Abenshi barabihisha ntibabivuge, abandi bakumva ari indwara umwana agomba gupfana nayo. Ikindi kubavura biragorana. Ubushakashatsi icyo bwabonye ni uko 85% mu bihugu bikennye bavukana ubu burwayi bashobora kubagwa ariko twabonye ko ababyeyi badafite ubushobozi bwo kuvuza aba bana, dufite umuganga umwe ushobora kubaga izi ndwara.” Ibi bisobanuye ko umwana wukanye iki kibazo bisaba ko azanwa mu Bitaro bya CHUK, bikamusaba gutega imodoka, gucumbika, kurya n’ibindi. Ubu bushakashatsi bwerekanye ko nibura umwana umwe atangwaho amafaranga ari hagati y’ibihumbi 58 Frw n’ibihumbi 600 Frw bitewe n’inshuro yagiyeyo mu gihe ikiguzi cyo kuvura indwara imwe muri izo kikubye inshuro enyi z’ikiguzi cy’izisanzwe nka Malaria. Ababyeyi b’abagore babyara aba bana kandi ngo bakunze gutereranwa, rimwe na rimwe abagabo bakabata bashinjwa ko aribo ntandaro yo kubyara umwana utuzuye. Inzobere mu kubaga indwara z’abana zivukanwa ukorera muri CHUK, akaba ari na we gusa ubizobereyemo mu Rwanda, Dr Ntaganda Edmond, yavuze ko nibura 20% biba byoroshye ko babazwe bakiri impinja ikibazo cyakemuka, ingingo zabo zigakora nk’ibisanzwe. Ati “Hari n’abandi bifata bisaba kuzavurwa mu byiciro. Abo rero ni nabo ubu bushakashatsi bwakurikiranye, aho usanga bazakenera kuza kwa muganga inshuro nyinshi kubera ko bavurwa mu byiciro.” Inama zitangwa n’abakoze ubu bushakashatsi ni uko Leta yakora ibishoboka umubare w’abaganga b’inzobere mu kuvura izi ndwara ukiyongera, kuzamura umubare w’abafite ubwishingizi mu kwivuza kugira ngo byorohe kwivuza, abaganga bagakurikiranira hafi umwana uvuze agasuzumwa kare, gushishikariza ibigo by’abikorera kugoboka abarwaje igihe bagiye kwivuza n’ibindi. Ibitaro bya CHUK bizobereye mu kuvura izi ndwara bigaragaza ko ku mwaka byakira abazirwaye barenze 1000 ku mwaka, hagati ya 400-500 bakenera kubagwa. [email protected]

title: U Rwanda rwashyize abaganga bahoraho ku kibuga cy’indege mu gukumira Coronavirus ikomeje guhitana abantu
content: Mu mpera z’umwaka ushize nibwo virus ya Coronavirus yagaragaye bwa mbere mu Mujyi wa Wuhan mu Bushinwa. Imibare mishya imaze gukusanywa igaragaza ko mu bantu barenga 6000 iki cyorezo kimaze kugararaho mu bihugu hafi 20, abarenga 130 kimaze kubica. Ni icyorezo cyakangaranyije amahanga, cyane cyane mu bihugu cyagaragayemo hafatwa ingambi zidasanzwe zigamije kugabanya umuvuduko gifite mu gukwirakwira zirimo gutanga ubuvuzi bwihuse, gusuzuma abantu ku bibuga by’indege n’ibindi. Umuyobozi wa RBC, Dr Nsanzimana Sabin, yabwiye IGIHE ko iki cyorezo kitaragera mu Rwanda ariko kuva gitangiye kuvugwa rwahisemo gushyira itsinda ku Kibuga Mpuzamahanga cy’Indege cya Kanombe mu gukumura ko cyagera mu Rwanda. Ati “Itsinda rero rigenda ryongererwa ubushobozi bitewe n’uko iki cyorezo kiri kongera imbaraga. Icyo abarigize bakora, barasuzuma abantu binjiye mu gihugu bose, cyane cyane abaturutse mu Bushinwa cyangwa abahuye n’abaturutseyo.” Uretse gupima ibimenyetso by’iyi ndwara hari n’ibibazo bitandukanye umuntu abazwa biganisha ku kuba yashyirwa mu cyiciro cy’ukekwaho ibyago byo kwandura iyi Virus. Ati “Dufite n’ivuriro rihasanzwe ririmo abaganga n’ibikoresho ku buryo haramutse hari uhageze arwaye cyangwa akeneye ubufasha bwihuse yabuhabwa.” Iyi Virus ikomeje gukwirakwira mu bihugu bitandukanye, bikekwa ko yakomotse ku nyamaswa zo mu mazi. Imibare ikusanywa igaragaza ko abayirwaye baba bavuye mu Bushinwa cyangwa bahuye n’abavuyeyo. Dr Nsanzimana ati “Indege ziri kuva mu Bushinwa ziri kwitabwaho by’umwihariko ariko n’izituruka mu bindi bihugu zishobora kuba zizanye umugenzi wanyuzeyo.” Ku mipaka isanzwe amatsinda asanzwe apima ibimenyetso bya Ebola yahawe amabwiriza yo gupima n’iyo virusi ifite ibimenyetso bijya gusa, kimwe n’amavuriro atandukanye hirya no hino yahawe kwihutira kumenyekanisha uwagaragaza ibimenyetso. Ibimenyetso by’indwara ya Coronavirus birimo kugira umuriro, gukorora no guhumeka nabi ndetse ishobora no kugera aho itera umusonga no kubuza impyiko gukora bishobora gutera urupfu. Zimwe mu ngamba abantu bakwiye kwimakaza mu kuyirinda harimo gukaraba intoki n’amazi meza n’isabune, gukinga urushyi ku mazuru no ku munwa igihe umuntu bikekwa ko ayirwaye akorora cyangwa ahumeka, guteka inyama n’amagi bigashya neza. Hari kandi kwifashisha imiti yabugenewe yo gukaraba yica udukoko, kwirinda gukorakora amazuru, amaso n’umunwa igihe umuntu atakarabye, kwirinda kwegera umuntu ufite ibyago byo kuyandura hamwe no kuguma mu rugo igihe ufite ibimenyetso byayo.

title: Inzitaramibu zakorewe mu Rwanda zigiye gutangira gukwirakwizwa mu baturage
content: Gukorera inzitiramibu mu Rwanda bizagabanya amafaranga zagurwagamo hanze ku kigero cya 50 % Nyuma y’ishingwa ry’uruganda rukora inzitiramibu rwitwa LTC ltd rushamikiye ku ruganda Garment Vision Ltd, byitezwe ko mu nzitiramibu miliyoni 7.5 zizatangwa uyu mwaka, izisaga miliyoni 3.5 zizakorerwa mu Rwanda. Uru ruganda ruherereye mu cyanya cyahariwe inganda i Masoro, rufite ubushobozi bwo gukora inzitiramibu 16200 ku munsi, mu kwezi ni inzitiramibu 486 000 mu gihe intego ari ukujya rukora inzitiramibu miliyoni 1.7 mu kwezi. Umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe ubuvuzi bw’ibanze, Dr Patrick Ndimubanzi yavuze ko uyu mwaka inzitiramubu za mbere zakorewe mu Rwanda  zizagezwa mu baturage. Yagize ati “Turashaka gukoresha ubwoko butandukanye bw’inzitiramibu, kuzikwirakwiza bizatangira muri iki cyumweru. Uko ubushobozi bwo kuzikorera buzajya bwiyongera, tuzajya dutanga izakorewe mu Rwanda.” Umwaka ushize, u Rwanda rwatanze inzitiramibu miliyoni esheshatu zakuwe mu mahanga ku kiguzi cya miliyoni 17 z’amadolari, hafi miliyari 17 Frw. Mu gukwirakwiza inzitiramibu, u Rwanda rubarira abaturage miliyoni 12 barutuye, bakabara ko nibura buri nzitiramubu yifashishwa n’abantu babiri. Abahabwa inzitiramibu ku buntu harimo abari mu cyiciro cya mbere n’icya kabiri by’Ubudehe, abagore batwite n’abana. Imibare ya Minisiteri y’ubuzima igaragaza ko Malaria yagabanyutse mu Rwanda, aho abayirwaye mu mwaka wa 2018/2019 bari miliyoni 3.7 bavuye kuri miliyoni 4.8 mu 2015/2016. Abahitanwa na malaria bavuye kuri 663 mu 2015/2016 bagera kuri 224 mu 2018/2019.

title: Abanyarwanda bahumurijwe kuri Coronavirus ikomeje guhitana abantu
content: Iyi virusi yagaragaye bwa mbere mu Mujyi wa Wuhan mu Bushinwa ariko ikaba ikomeje kugaragara no mu bindi bihugu bitandukanye ku Isi ku muvuduko udasanzwe, imaze kwica abantu barenga 100 mu barenga 4000 bayanduye Umuyobozi wa RBC, Dr Nsanzimana Sabin yavuze ko nubwo iki cyorezo gifite umuvuduko uri hejuru, Abanyarwanda badakwiye guhangayika bitewe n’uko ahanini cyibasira abageze mu zabukuru, abo umubiri wabo udafite ubudahangarwa n’abana. Ati “N’abandi bashobora kwandura iyi Virus ariko ntabwo yabazahaza. Abantu ntabwo bakwiye guhangayika kuko iyi ndwara abayirwaye nibura 85% bashobora kuyivurwa. Mu bantu 100 bahuye n’iyi Virus, 25% nibo gusa bagaragaza ibimenyetso. Uyu ni umubare muto ugereranyije n’izindi Virus twagiye tubona mbere.” Kugeza ubu Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima (OMS) rigaragaza ko abantu barenga 4000 bo mu bihugu birenga 10, byiganjemo ibyo muri Aziya barimo kwitabwaho n’abaganga kandi riri gukora ibishoboka ngo ntikomeze gukwirakwizwa. Mu cyumweru gishize,  Minisiteri y’Ubuzima yasabye Abanyarwanda kwirinda kugirira ingendo mu Mujyi wa Wuhan wo mu Bushinwa, wakomotsemo iki cyorezo n’ahandi kigenda kigaragara. Uretse u Bushinwa,  ibindi bihugu birimo u Bufaransa, u Buyapani, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Australia, Vietnam, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Nepal, Koreya y’Epfo na Côte d’Ivoire iki cyorezo kimaze kuhagera. Dr Nsanzimana yavuze ko iyi Virus ari nshya mu zirenga 200 zimaze kugaragara mu bantu, aho nibura buri mwaka havumburwa izigera kuri ebyiri. Iyi Virus ikomeje gukwirakwira mu bihugu bitandukanye, bikekwa ko yakomotse ku nyamaswa zo mu mazi ikandukira mu bantu. Dr Nsanzimana yavuze ko ibyago byo gukwirakwira muri Afurika biri hejuru bitewe n’uko ingendo z’abantu bajya n’abava mu Bushinwa n’ibindi bihugu yagaragayemo zitahagaze. Yavuze ko abantu bakwiye kwihutira kumenyesha ubuyobozi cyangwa ivuriro ribegereye igihe bibonyeho kimwe mu bimenyetso biyiranga. Ibimenyetso by’indwara ya Coronavirus birimo kugira umuriro, gukorora no guhumeka nabi ndetse ishobora no kugera aho itera umusonga, kubuza impyiko gukora bishobora gutera urupfu. Zimwe mu ngamba abantu bakwiye kwimakaza mu kuyirinda harimo gukaraba intoki n’amazi meza n’isabune, gukinga urushyi ku mazuru no ku munwa igihe umuntu bikekwa ko ayirwaye akorora cyangwa ahumeka, guteka inyama n’amagi bigashya neza. Hari kandi kwifashisha imiti yabugenewe yo gukaraba yica udukoko, kwirinda gukorakora amazuru, amaso n’umunwa igihe umuntu atakarabye, kwirinda kwegera umuntu ufite ibyago byo kuyandura, kuguma mu rugo igihe ufite ibimenyetso byayo.

title: U Rwanda rugiye gutangira kwifashisha indege nto zitagira umupiloti mu guhashya Malaria
content: Inkuru yo gutangiza uyu mushinga yatangarijwe mu nama yabaye kuri uyu wa 27 Mutarama 2020 itegura inama yiga ku kurandura malariya n’indwara zititwabwaho uko bikwiye izabera i Kigali muri Kamena uyu mwaka. Uyu mushinga Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ifatanyije na Sosiyete y’abanyarwanda yitwa ’Charis Unmanned Aerial Solutions’ uratangirizwa mu Murenge wa Jabana mu Karere ka Gasabo kuri uyu wa 28 Mutarama 2020. Uyu mushinga uzunganira izindi ngamba Guverinoma y’u Rwanda isanzwe ifite zo guhashya indwara ya Malaria zirimo gukwirakwiza mu baturage inzitiramibu, gutera imiti mu bishanga, mu nzu n’ahandi hari indiri y’imibu itera iyi ndwara yugarije ibihugu bikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere n’ibikennye, kwegereza abaturage ubuvuzi, aho uyu munsi abajyanama b’ubuzima babasha kuyisuzuma no kuyivura n’izindi. Biteganyijwe ko Drones imwe mu zizakoreshwa muri uyu mushinga izaba ifite ubushobozi bwo gutwara icupa ririmo litiro 10 z’umuti yifashisha mu kuhera mu bice bikekwaho kuba indiri y’umubu utera Malaria nko mu bihuru, mu bishanga n’ahandi. Izi ndege ngo zifite ubushobozi bwo gukora urugendo nibura rw’iminota 15 zigafuhereye uwo muti ku buso bungana nibura na hegitari 40 ku munsi. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ishami ryo kurwanya Malaria mu kigo cy’ubuzima (RBC), Mbituyumuremyi Aimable, yavuze ko Drones zisanzwe zifashishwa mu bindi bihugu mu kurwanya indwara ya Malaria kandi ko bitanga umusaruro. Ati “Zizadufasha kugera mu bice bimwe by’indiri y’imibu byatugoraga kugeramo twifashishije amapombo dusanzwe duteresha umuti wica imibu harimo nko mu bishanga, mu mirima y’imiceri n’ahandi.” Iki ni kimwe mu bikorwa bitandukanye biteganyijwe gukorwa mu bukangurambaga bwo kurandura Malaria, buzamara amezi atandatu, kugeza iyi nama yo ku wa 25 Kamena 2020 ibaye. Imibare y’iyi minisiteri igaragaza ko umwaka ushize w’ingengo y’imari wa 2018/2019, Malaria yagaragaye ku barwayi basaga miliyoni 3.9. Mu mezi 12 ashize ya 2019, Malaria yagaragaye ku bantu miliyoni 3.7 bavuye kuri miliyoni 4.8 yagaragayeho mu mwaka wawubanjirije wa 2018, bisobanuye ko abo yagaragayeho bagabanutseho 21% hagati y’iyo myaka. Imibare kandi igaragaza ko iyi ndwara iri mu zihangayikishije ibihugu bikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere, abo yica bagabanutse cyane kuko bageze kuri 264 mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari ushize wa 2018/2019 mu gihe mu 2016/2017 yishe 663 bangana n’igabanuka rya 60%. Minisante igaragaza ko uyu mwaka izatanga inzitiramibu zisaga miliyoni 7.5 zirimo 3.5 zizakorerwa mu gihugu ndetse ko uturere 12 tuzaterwamo imiti yica imibu. [email protected]

title: Minisitiri Gashumba yagaragaje ko Malaria ari indwara yakwirindwa burundu
content: Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima(OMS) rigaragaz ko Malaria ari imwe mu ndwara zishobora kwirindwa no kuvurwa ariko ikiri ikibazo ku batuye Isi. OMS ivuga ko nibura buri minota ibiri Malaria yica umwana umwe. Nibura kimwe cya kabiri cy’abatuye Isi baba bafite ibyago byo kwibasirwaa n’iyi ndwara. Uyu muryango mu 2018 wasohoye raporo igaragaza ko abantu ibihumbi birenga 405 bishwe na Malaria mu gihe mu 2017 yari yishe abasaga ibihumbi 416. Mu 2018, abo yagaragayeho bari miliyoni 228 mu gihe mu mwaka wawubanjirije bari miliyoni 231. OMS igaragaza ko abantu barenga miliyari 1.5 ku Isi bafite ibyago byo kurwara indwara zititabwaho uko bikwiye zirimo iziterwa n’umwanda nka Bilharzia, inzoka zo mu nda, indwara y’ibitotsi n’izindi. Kuri uyu wa 27 Mutarama 2020 ubwo yafunguraga inama itegura inama yiga ku kurandura Malariya n’indwara zititwabwaho uko bikwiye izabera mu Rwanda muri Kamena uyu mwaka, Minisitiri Gashumba yagarutse ku bukana bw’izi ndwara. Ati “Umuntu umwe muri batanu agirwaho ingaruka n’indwara zititabwaho uko bikwiye. Buri mwaka Malaria yica abantu barenga ibihumbi 405, biganjemo abana, aho abarenga 90% ari abo ku mugabane wa Afurika. Malariya n’izi ndwara zititabwaho uko bikwiye zibasira cyane abana n’abagore, zigashegesha ubuzima, ubutunzi n’ubuzima bwacu.” Minisitiri Gashumba yavuze ko zigira ingaruka ku iterambere ry’ubukungu n’imibereho myiza by’abatuye Isi, anagaruka ku byakorwa ngo zikumirwe. Ati “Ni indwara zirindwa, zivurwa kandi tuzi ibikenewe kugira ngo tuzishyire ku iherezo. Kurwanya izi ndwara, tugomba gushyira imbaraga mu gushimangira ingamba zirambye, kubigira ibyacu mu giturage n’abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze mu kongera ingengo y’imari no guhanga udushya.” Muri iyi minsi mu bihugu byinshi, cyane cyane ibyo ku mugabane wa Afurika usanga urubyiruko rwihariye umubare munini w’abaturage bifite, nko mu Rwanda nibura rwihariye 70% by’abaturage bose. Bisobanuye ko ari imbaraga ntagereranywa mu kurwanya izi ndwara zugarije ibihugu bikennye n’ibikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere. Ati “Kugira ngo tugere kuri Afurika twifuza, nk’uko bikubiye mu cyerekezo 2063 tugomba kongera amafaranga tugenera urwego rw’ubuzima mu ngengo y’imari y’ibihugu byacu. Ubuzima n’iterambere biri mu nzego u Rwanda n’ibindi bighugu byinshi bya Afurika bishyize imbere.” Inama y’abakuru b’ibihugu na Guverinoma z’ibihugu bikoresha Icyongereza iheruka kuba mu 2018 yemerejwemo ingamba zihamye zo kugabanya malariya nibura kimwe cya kabiri bitarenze 2023 no gukusanya miliyari 1.5$ yo kurwanya indwara zititabwaho uko bikwiye. Mu masezerano ibihugu bya Afurika byashyiriyeho umukono Abuja muri Nigeria, yerekeye kurwanya Malaria, byiyemeje gukoresha nibura 15% by’ingengo y’imari mu guteza imbere urwego rw’ubuzima. Ati “Kurambiriza ku nkunga z’abanyamahanga zikoreshwa mu rwego rw’ubuvuzi n’iterambere byacu ntabwo ari uburyo burambye.” Minisitiri Gashumba yavuze ko u Rwanda gushora mu rwego rw’ubuzima kimwe cya gatanu cy’amafaranga rukoresha. Yavuze kandi ko rwakoze ibishoboka byose mu kurwanya indwara zifatwa nk’izititabwaho uko bikwiye na Malaria aho by’umwihariko rugiye gutangiza ubukangurambaga bugamije kuzikumira, buzamara amezi atandatu hibandwa ku guteza imbere ingamba zafashwe. Umuyobozi wa OMS mu Rwanda, Dr Kasonde Mwinga, yavuze ko Malaria n’indwara zititabwaho uko bikwiye ziri mu zisubiza inyuma iterambere ry’ibihugu kandi ko zitarandurwa igihe hadafashwe ingamba zitandukanye n’iziriho. Ati “Ntabwo bikwiye ko abantu muri Afurika bakomeza kwicwa n’indwara zivurwa zigakira.” Umuyobozi w’Ihuriro Mpuzamahanga ryo kurwanya malaria[RBM Partnership to End Malaria], Dr Abdourahmane Diallo, yavuze ko ibihugu bya Afurika bikwiye kongera ishoramari mu rwego rw’ubuzim no kunoza ingamba mu gukumira Malaria n’indwara zititabwaho uko bikwiye. Imibare ya Minisiteri y’Ubuzima mu Rwanda igaragaza ko mu 2019 Malaria yagaragaye ku bantu miliyoni 3.7 bavuye kuri miliyoni 4.8 yagaragayeho mu mwaka wawubanjirije wa 2018, bisobanuye ko abo yagaragayeho bagabanutseho 21% hagati y’iyo myaka. Abo Malariya yishe bageze kuri 264 mu mwaka w’ingengo y’Imari ushize wa 2018/2019 mu gihe wa 2016/2017 bari 663. Bisobanuye ko habayeho igabanuka rya 60%. Amafoto: Niyonzima Moise [email protected]

title: Malaria yishe abantu 264 muri miliyoni 3.9 bayirwaye mu Rwanda umwaka ushize
content: Imibare y’iyi Minisiteri igaragaza ko umwaka ushize w’ingengo y’imari wa 2018/2019, Malaria yagaragaye ku barwayi basaga miliyoni 3.9. Mu mezi 12 ashize ya 2019, Malaria yagaragaye ku bantu miliyoni 3.7 bavuye kuri miliyoni 4.8 yagaragayeho mu mwaka wawubanjirije wa 2018, bisobanuye ko abo yagaragayeho bagabanutseho 21% hagati y’iyo myaka. Imibare kandi igaragaza ko n’abantu iyi ndwara iri mu zihangayikishije ibihugu bikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere yica bagabanutse cyane kuko bageze kuri 264 mu mwaka w’ingengo y’Imari ushize wa 2018/2019 mu gihe mu 2016/2017 yishe 663 bangana n’igabanuka rya 60%. Iyi mibare yagarutsweho kuri uyu wa 27 Mutarama 2020 mu nama itegura inama mpuzamahanga yo kurwanya Malaria n’indwara zidahabwa agaciro iteganyijwe kubera i Kigali muri Kamena 2020. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ishyami ryo kurwanya Malaria mu kigo cy’ubuzima (RBC), Mbituyumuremyi Aimable, yavuze ko iryo gabanuka ryaturutse ku mpamvu zitandukanye zirimo kwegereza ubuvuzi abaturage. Ati "Byose byatewe n’uruhare rw’abajyanama b’ubuzima kuko ubu abantu 57% bavurwa n’abajyanama b’ubuzima. Tuba dushaka gukangurira abaturage kwivuza hakiri kare." Uretse iyi gahunda kandi hari no kuba guverinoma yarashyize imbaraga muri gahunda zo kurwanya Malaria zirimo gutanga inzitiramibu ku baturarwanda, gutera imiti yica imibu n’izindi. Minisante igaragaza ko uyu mwaka izatanga inzitiramibu zisaga miliyoni 7.5 zirimo 3.5 zizakorerwa mu gihugu ndetse ko uturere 12 tuzaterwamo imiti yica imibu. Amafoto: Niyonzima Moise

title: Imbuto Foundation yatangije umushinga ugamije gukumira  inda ziterwa abangavu muri Nyagatare na Burera
content: Uyu mushinga watangijwe ku mugaragaro kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 23 Mutarama mu Karere ka Nyagatare. Witezweho gufasha abana bari hagati y’imya icumi na 24 gusobanukirwa ibijyanye n’ubuzima bw’imyororokere hifashishijwe ababyeyi babo, abaganga ndetse n’abarimu. Insanganyamatsiko y’uyu mushinga iragira iti “ Rubyiruko, kugira ubumenyi ku buzima bw’imyororokere ni uburenganzira bwanyu.” Umukozi wa Imbuto Foundation, Eric Kayiranga, ushinzwe uyu mushinga mushya avuga ko uyu mushinga uzibanda ku byiciro bitatu birimo urubyiruko ruri hagati y’imyaka icumi kugeza kuri 24. Ati “ Muri abo bose harimo abari mu ishuri n’abataririmo, tuzakorana n’ibigo by’amashuri yisumbuye, ibigo Nderabuzima byose byo muri Nyagatare, amavuriro y’ibanze arimo 47, aho hose ni urubyiruko tureba. Ntabwo navuga ko iki kibazo tuje kugica burundu ariko tuzanye umusanzu kugira ngo kigabanuke, nirwo rugamba turiho rwo kugira ngo inda ziterwa abangavu zigabanuke.” Kayiranga yakomeje avuga ko bazafasha urubyiruko ruri mu matsinda ku buzima bw’imyororokere kubona ibiganiro na serivisi ku bigo Nderabuzima n’amavuriro y’ibanze, ngo bazakoresha imikino, ibiganiro muri rusange ndetse banapime abana kubushake indwara zitandukanye. Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Nyagatare wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage Murekatete Julliet yashimiye Imbuto Foundation ku gikorwa cyiza izanye mu Karere kabo, avuga ko ku kuba bafite imibare myinshi y’abana batwara inda imburagihe, ngo usanga ababyeyi n’abana badafite ubumenyi ku buzima bw’imyororokere bakaba bazahita bahera kuri ba babyeyi no mu Nteko z’abaturage kugira ngo babigishe. Yakomeje agira ati “ Amakimbirane mu miryango niyo ntandaro ya mbere aho abenshi baba batarahindura imyumvire ku buringanire bwo mu muryango.” Umuyobozi w’urwunge rw’amashuri rwa Rwempasha, yavuze ko hakenewe imikoranire ya mwarimu n’umubyeyi mu kuganiriza umwana w’umukobwa ku buzima bw’imyororokere. Ati “Umuntu mukuru wese akwiye kumva ko niba abonye umwana agiye gutatira igihango no kuva mu nshingano akwiye kongera kumukumira nk’umwana we cyangwa uw’igihugu kugira ngo twese dufatanye. Ikindi dukwiye gukomera ku ndangagaciro kuko abashuka bariya bana ni abantu bakuru.” Umuyobozi w’Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Ndama, Kayumba Samuel, we avuga ko akurikije ibyo basabwe bari basanzwe babikora ahubwo ngo bagiye kubishimangira. Yagize ati “ Buri kigo Nderabuzima gifite abantu babiri nibura bagiye bahugurwa ku bijyanye n’imyororokere y’urubyiruko, dufite naho turwigishiriza uko bakwirinda indwara n’ibindi.” Yavuze ko hari abantu bamwe na bamwe imyumvire yabo ariyo ituma abana baterwa inda gusa ngo uko bongera imbaraga mu bukangurambaga birushaho gucika. Mu mwaka wa 2010 uyu mushinga wakoreraga mu turere twa Nyarugenge na Gicumbi ukaba ugamije kwigisha, gutanga amakuru ahagije ku buzima bw’imyororokere mu rubyiruko bikorwa n’abakangurambaga b’urungano bakanimakaza ibiganiro hagati y’ababyeyi n’abana. Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe na Minisiteri y’Uburinganire n’Iterambere ry’Umuryango rigaragaza ko hagati y’umwaka wa 2016 na 2018 abangavu ibihumbi 70 batewe inda imburagihe, 36% bangana n’ibihumbi 19 na 800 ni abo mu Ntara y’Iburasirazuba. Akarere ka Nyagatare niko kaza imbere mu kugira abana benshi batewe inda aho byibuze mu mwaka ushize wa 2019 abangavu batewe inda imburagihe ari 1814 nkuko bitangazwa n’Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Nyagatare wungirije.

title: Abanyarwanda basabwe gusubika ingendo zigana i Wuhan mu Bushinwa kubera Virusi ya Coronavirus
content: Kuva ku wa 31 Ukuboza 2019 mu Bushinwa hateye Virusi yo mu bwoko bwa Coronavirus. Yaturutse mu isoko ryo mu Mujyi wa Wuhan ricuruza ibikomoka mu nyanja (Sea foods). Imibare yo ku wa 22 Mutarama 2019 yerekana ko abamaze kuyandura bagera kuri 296 kandi bakomeje kwiyongera, imaze guhitana abantu bane. Amakuru avuga ko uyanduye itangira kugaragara hagati y’ibyumweru bibiri na bitatu. Ni indwara nshya idasanzwe ku buryo idafite umuti cyangwa urukingo, cyakora Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima ryatangaje ko hari gukorwa ubushakashatsi. Urwaye iyo ndwara ntiyitabweho hakiri kare ngo abone imiti y’umuriro n’uburyo bwo kumukiza umwuma, bimuviramo kuziba imitsi ijya mu bihaha, bikurikirwa n’ibibazo byo guhumeka nabi bikavamo umusonga ariwo uhitana uwayirwaye. Iyi ndwara yandurira mu mwuka kuko ubusanzwe iyo umuntu ahumeka hari udutonyanga dusohoka nubwo umuntu atatubonesha amaso aritwo twanduza uwegereye uwayanduye. Ikanyura no gukora mu bimwira by’uwayanduye. Minisitiri w’Ubuzima, Dr Gashumba Diane, yavuze ko nkuko bamaze iminsi bakangurira Abanyarwanda kwirinda indwara n’ibyorezo bitandukanye birimo Ebola, ku ndwara ya 2019-nCov naho basabwa kuba maso. Nubwo hagikorwa ubushakashatsi abantu barasabwa kwitwararika isuku yo gukaraba intoki no gusukura ibiribwa. Mu rwego rwo kwirinda ko Umunyarwanda yagira aho ahurira n’icyo cyorezo, Minisitiri Dr Gashumba yasabye Abanyarwanda bateganya cyangwa bagirira ingendo mu Bushinwa kwirinda kwerekeza mu Mujyi wa Wuhan. Ati “Icyo dusaba Abanyarwanda nka Minisiteri cyangwa nka Leta y’u Rwanda ni ugukomeza kwirinda kujya ahari icyorezo.” Ibigo bitwara abantu mu ndege nabyo byasabwe kuburira abantu bashaka gutemberera mu Mujyi wa Wuhan gusubika ingendo zabo. Ati “Twagiranye inama n’ibigo byose bishinzwe gutwara abantu mu Rwanda cyane cyane ibikoresha inzira z’ikirere kugira ngo tubagire inama z’uko bigisha abashaka gutembera ko baba boroheje gutemberera ahari icyorezo.” Ibyo ngo bigomba kujyana no kureba niba hari abafite ibimenyetso birimo gukorora, ibicurane mu bagenzi batwaye. Kujya batanga utuntu two kwipfuka ku munwa no ku mazuru ndetse bakabyongera mu mabwiriza baha abo batwaye mu ndege no kugira ibikoresho byo gukaraba. U Bushinwa nabwo bwashyizeho ingamba zo kubuza abatuye Wuhan gusohoka muri uwo mujyi no kubuza abandi kuwinjiramo. Dr Kasonde Mwinga, uhagarariye Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima yavuze ko nta muti cyangwa urukingo ruhari ariko ko icyo bari gufasha u Rwanda kimwe n’ibindi bihugu ari ukwigisha ibimenyetso no gukangurira abaturage kutajya aho icyo cyorezo cyagaragaye. Yavuze ko uwagaragaza ibimenyetso yitabwaho ntibigere kuri wa musonga no kuziba kw’imiyoboro ituma ibihaha bikora. Ati “Icyo turi gukora ni ugufasha ibihugu kumenya uko bagaragaza abafite iyo Virusi no kubakangurira gukomeza gahunda z’isuku no kwirinda kujya aho icyorezo cyagaragaye ariko kugeza ubu nta muti cyangwa urukingo ruhari.” Urwego rw’abikorera rufatwa nk’urubarizwamo abacuruzi bakora ingendo nyinshi mu Bushinwa, biyemeje ubufatanye mu gusaba Abanyarwanda gusubika ingendo zabo i Wuhan. Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB) kireba cyane ku bukerarugendo cyatangaje ko cyita cyane ku mabwiriza ya Minisiteri y’Ubuzima kandi kikanamenyesha abayobora ba mukerarugendo ku buryo icyorezo kimenyekana mu mfuruka zose. Icyorezo cy’indwara 2019-nCov ntikiragaragara muri Afurika ariko abantu barasabwa guhora birinda kujya n’ahandi yagaragara.

title: Muri Amerika hagaragaye umuntu wa mbere wanduye ‘Coronavirus’
content: Kuri uyu wa Kabiri, Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo cyita ku Ndwara z’Ubuhumekero muri Leta Zunze  Ubumwe za Amerika, Nancy Messonnier, yabwiye itangazamakuru ko uwagaragayeho ubwo bwandu yageze ku kibuga cy’indege cya Seattle tariki ya 15 Mutarama, avuye mu Mujyi wa Wuhan wo mu Bushinwa, ahagaragaye iyi virus bwa mbere. Akigera ku kibuga cy’indege nta bimenyetso by’ubwandu bwa Coronavirus yagaragazaga, ariko ku Cyumweru yahise yihamagarira inzego z’ubuzima amaze kwibonaho ibimenyetso byayo. Imyirondoro y’uyu murwayi ubarirwa mu myaka 30 ntiyashyizwe ahagaragara, ariko inzego z’ubuzima muri Amerika zahise zitangira kumwitaho mu bitaro bya Everett. Leta Zunze  Ubumwe za Amerika ziyongereye ku bihugu byagezemo icyorezo cya ‘Coronavirus’, nyuma y’u Bbushinwa, u Buyapani, Koreya y’Epfo, Thaïlande na Taïwan, aho iki cyorezo kimaze guhitana abagera ku icyenda. Kugeza ubu abaganga batangaje ko ubuzima bw’uyu muntu wagaragaweho ubwandu bwa ‘Coronavirus’ bumeze neza. Kuva ku wa gatanu w’icyumweru gishize, Leta Zunze  Ubumwe za Amerika zashyizeho ubugenzuzi bukomeye ku bibuga by’indege bitatu bya mbere bikomeye muri iki gihugu bya New York JFK, San Francisco na Los Angeles. Muri iki Cyumweru biteganyijweko ubugenzuzi bwo gukumira iki cyorezo buzanashyirwa ku bibuga by’indege byo mu Mijyi ya Chicago na Atlanta. Abagenzi bose baturuka mu Mujyi wa Wuhan bategetswe kuzajya banyura kuri kimwe muri ibyo bibuga byashyizweho ubwo bugenzuzi. Ibimenyetso by’indwara ya Coronavirus birimo kugira umuriro, gukorora no guhumeka nabi. Abenshi mu bagaragayeho iyi ndwara ni abagiye mu isoko barangurizamo amafi n’amatungo muri Wuhan mu Ntara ya Hubei mu Bushinwa. Iryo soko ryatewe imiti yica udukoko ndetse rihita rifungwa guhera ku itariki ya 1 Mutarama 2020. Kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 20 Mutarama 2020 nibwo Leta y’u Bushinwa yemeje ko abantu bashobora kwanduzanya hagati yabo. Iyo ndwara yandura ite? Umuntu yanduzwa Coronavirus n’uwayanduye. Yandurira mu mwuka wahumetswe n’uwakoroye ayanduye. Yandura iyo umuntu akoze ku wayanduye cyangwa amusuhuje; iyo umuntu akoze ku kintu cyangwa ahantu hari iyo virusi noneho agakora ku munwa, ku izuru cyangwa ku maso mbere yo gukaraba intoki ndetse rimwe na rimwe ishobora kwandurira mu mwanda wo mu musarani. Nta muti wihariye uvura iyo ndwara. Igishoboka kugeza ubu kuyivura batanga imiti ifasha mu guhangana n’ibimenyetso byayo. Iyi virusi yafashwe nk’ikibazo kubera ko iki cyorezo kimaze kugaragara ku bantu bagera kuri 440 bamaze kuyandura, icyenda bo bakaba bamaze kwitaba Imana.

title: Abasaga 200 bamaze kwandura virusi itaramenyekana mu Bushinwa
content: Ubu imibare ihari iravuga ko abantu basaga 200 aribo bamaze kwandura abenshi bakaba batuye mu Mujyi wa Wuhan, gusa hamaze kugaragara abandi bantu bafite ibimenyetso nk’iby’abanduye iyo virusi mu yindi Mijyi nka Beijing, Shanghai na Shenzhen. Abantu batatu ni bo bimaze gutangazwa ko bapfuye bazize iyo virusi ifite ibimenyetso nk’iby’umusonga. Iyi ndwara bikekwa ko iri kwandura, itangiye gukwirakwira mu gihe habura iminsi mike Abashinwa bakajya mu birori by’umwaka wabo mushya. Abashinzwe ubuzima bavumbuye bwa mbere iyo virusi mu gace ka Wuhan mu Ukuboza umwaka ushize. Ni virusi igaragaramo uruhurirane rw’udukoko dushobora kwanduza abantu n’inyamaswa. Bavuga ko iyo virusi yateje icyorezo cy’umusonga ariko nta byinshi biramenyekana kuri yo. Iyi virusi yabaye yiswe 2019-nCoV, igizwe n’uruhurirane rwa virusi zibasira imyanya y’ubuhumekero ya muntu ariko inzobere zivuga ko ari ubwa mbere babonye ubwo bwoko bw’iyo virusi. Hari hasanzwe ubwoko butandatu bw’izo virusi buzwi, ubwo bwaje buramutse bwemejwe bwaba bubaye ubwa karindwi. Abashakashatsi bavuga ko ubusanzwe iyo virusi yakwirakwizwaga ahanini n’inyamaswa ziyanduza abantu, icyakora ngo bijya bibaho ko n’abantu bayanduzanya. Ibimenyetso byayo harimo umuriro, kugira ibibazo umuntu ahumeka, gukorora, guhumeka gahoro n’ibindi. Abaturage bagiriwe inama yo kwirinda gukora ku nyamaswa batikingiye haba mu guteka inyama, amagi no kwirinda guhura n’abafite ibimenyetso by’ibicurane. Abayobozi bo mu Mujyi wa Wuhan uri rwagati mu Bushinwa, ukaba utuwe n’abagera kuri miliyoni 11, kuri uyu wa Mbere bavuze ko abantu 136 aribo bagaragaweho iyo virusi mu mpera z’icyumweru gishize gusa. Kuri iki Cyumweru, abayobozi bavuze ko hari abantu 170 bari mu bitaro byo muri Wuhan bavurwa iyo virusi harimo icyenda barembye. Hari abandi bantu bane bagaragaweho ibimenyetso by’iyo virusi hanze y’u Bushinwa barimo babiri muri Thailand, umwe mu Buyapani n’umwe muri Koreya y’Epfo. Umuryango Mpuzamahanga wita ku Buzima (OMS) wavuze ko utaratanga amabwiriza ku ngendo cyangwa ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi, icyakora ngo uri gutanga inama ku bihugu ku buryo bwo guhangana n’iyo virusi.

title: Afurika ku isonga mu kugira umubare mwinshi w’abafite virusi itera SIDA
content: N’ubwo Leta zifatanyije n’abafatanyabikorwa batandukanye zagiye zikora byinshi hagamijwe kurwanya agakoko gatera Sida, kugeza ubu Imibare iheruka ya UNAIDS, igaragaza ko ku Isi yose abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 37.9 babana n’ubwandu bw’agakoko gatera Sida, muri bo abagera kuri Miliyoni 36.2 ni abantu bakuru mu gihe abangana na Miliyoni 1.7 bo ari abana bari munsi y’imyaka 15. Agakoko gatera Sida kagaragara mu bice byose by’Isi, gusa imibare ya UNAIDS igaragaza ko Umugabane wa Afurika ari wo wibasiwe cyane kuko wihariye 70% y’ababana n’ubwandu bwa Sida ku Isi hose. Mu 2018 muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba n’iy’Amajyepfo habarurwaga abantu babana n’agakakoko gatera Sida miliyoni 20.6  (57%) Muri  Afurika y’Iburengerazuba n’iyo hagati ho habarirwaga abantu miliyoni eshanu  (13%) naho muri Aziya na Pacifique  hakabarirwa abagera kuri miliyoni 5.9 (16%) na miliyoni 2.2 (6%) mu burengerazuba bw’u Burayi n’ubwo hagati na Amerika y’Amajyaruguru. Iyi mibare igaragaza ko mu 2018 ku Isi hose abantu miliyoni 1.7 banduye agakoko gatera Sida. Muri aba, abagera kuri 1.6 bari mu myaka 15 gusubiza hejuru, mu gihe abagera ku 160 000 bo bari bafite kuva kumezi kugera ku myaka 14. Kimwe mu bikibangamiye gahunda zo kurwanya icyorezo cya Sida ni ukutagerwaho na serivisi zo kwipimisha kuko abagera kuri 79 % by’abatuye Isi ari bo bonyine bazi uko bahagaze ku bijyanye n’agakoko gatera Sida mu gihe 21 % bo batagerwaho na Serivisi zo kwipimisha. Kubera ingamba zitandukanye zagiye zifatwa mu kwirinda no guhashya icyorezo cya Sida, imibare yerekana ko mu 2018 abagerwaho n’imiti igabanya ubukana bwa Sida biyongeyeho miliyoni 1.6,  bakagera kuri miliyoni 23.3 ugereranyije n’uko banganaga mu mwaka wari wabanje wa 2017, mu gihe kuva mu 2010 bazamutseho miliyoni 8. Ikindi cyagabanyutse ni umubare w’abana banduzwa na ba nyina kuko Mu 2018,  92% by’abagore batwite babana n’agakoko gatera Sida bahawe imiti ibafasha kutanduza abana mu gihe babonsa cyangwa se bababyara bivuye kuri 49% byariho mu 2010. Kubera ingamba zikarishye zagiye zifatwa na Leta zitandukanye ndetse n’abafatanyabikorwa bazo mu kurwanya Sida, imibare y’abo iki cyorezo gihitana yagabanutse ku kigero cya 55%, aho mu 2018 abicwa na Sida n’indwara z’ibyuririzi bari 770 000 bavuye kuri milioni 1.2 mu 2010. Uko u Rwanda ruhagaze Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe ku bufatanye bwa Guverinoma y’u Rwanda, Gahunda ya Perezida wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika (USA) yo kurwanya SIDA (PEPFAR), Ikigo gishinzwe kugenzura no gukumira indwara cyo muri USA (CDC) n’Umushinga wa Kaminuza ya Columbia ushinzwe kurwanya virusi itera Sida (ICAP), bugashyirwa hanze ku wa 22 Ukwakira 2019 bugaragaza ko umubare w’abandura Virusi itera Sida ku mwaka wagabanutseho 50%. Ubushakashatsi bwerekanye ko umubare w’abantu bashya bandura Virusi itera Sida mu Rwanda, ugenda ugabanuka uko imyaka ishira, by’umwihariko ukaba waravuye kuri 3/1000 (barenga ibihumbi 10) mu 2014 ukagera kuri 1/1000 (barenga 5400) mu 2019. Nubwo ubu bushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko u Rwanda rwateye intambwe idasanzwe mu gukumira icyorezo cya Sida by’umwihariko mu gufasha abayirwaye kubona imiti no kubarinda ingaruka zayo, bwagaragaje impungege ku bangavu. Imibare y’ubu bushakashatsi yerekana ko uko urubyiruko ruhagaze usanga biteye impungenge cyane cyane ku bangavu bari mu kigero cy’imyaka 20. Kuko Bugaragaza ko abangavu bari mu kigero cy’imyaka 20-24 bandura virusi itera Sida ari 1.8%,  bikubye inshuro zirenga eshatu bagenzi babo b’abahungu bo bari kuri 0.6%. Ubu bushakashatsi kandi bugaragaza ko ku rwego rw’Intara n’Umujyi wa Kigali, Ubwandu bushya bwayo bwiganje mu Mujyi wa Kigali ku gipimo cya 4.3%, Intara y’Uburengerazuba kuri 3%, Uburasirazuba n’Amajyepfo kuri 2.9% naho Amajyaruguru kuri 2.2%. muri rusange mu mijyi buri ku gipimo cya 4.8% naho mu byaro kuri 2.5%. N’ubwo mu myaka 10 ishize ibihugu bitandukanye byagiye bishyiraho ingamba zitandukanye mu kurwanya Sida ndetse zigatanga umusaruro mu bijyanye n’ubwiyongere bw’umubare w’abagerwaho n’imiti igabanya ubukana, kugabanuka kw’ababyeyi banduza abana ndetse n’imfu zituruka kuri Sida n’indwara z’ibyuririzi, y’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye rishinzwe kurwanya Sida, UNAIDS riraburira ko ibihugu kudatezuka  ku ntego yo guhashya icyo cyorezo. Intego isi yihaye ni ukuvanaho umubare w’abahitanwa na Sida bitarenze 2030. title: Sobanukirwa uko bapima ingano ya Alcohol mu maraso bitewe n’inzoga umuntu yanyoye
content: Iyo alcohol igira ingaruka ku mubiri w’umuntu inshuro nyinshi duhurira nayo mu binyobwa bisembuye nk’urwagwa, ikigage,   inzoga za kizungu nka Heineken, whisky n’izindi. Umuyobozi w’agashami gashinzwe gupima ibintu bihumanya n’ingano ya alcohol mu maraso, muri Laboratwari y’u Rwanda y’ibimenyetso bya gihanga byifashishwa mu butabera (Rwanda Forensic Laboratory), Samvura Jean Pierre, yabwiye IGIHE ko Alchool ikunze gusangwa mu nzoga yitwa Ethanol. Ati “Ni kariya kantu umuntu iyo anyoye inzoga wumva bitandukanye n’uko unyoye Soda [Fanta] kagize ikintu gahindura ku mubiri wawe niko bita Alcohol, kaboneka mu nzoga zisembuye.” Akenshi yirema mu ruvange rw’ibinyampeke birimo amasaka, umutobe w’imbuto cyangwa ibindi bintu byifitemo ikigero runaka cy’isukari. Samvura yasobanuye ko no mu mubiri naho habamo alcohol akenshi yiremamo ivuye mu biribwa umuntu aba yariye n’ibyo anywa. Iyo alcohol igaragara mu mubiri w’umuntu ntabwo abantu bose bayinganya. Urugero nk’umuntu unywa inzoga nka kimwe mu binyobwa bikungahayemo alcohol, isukari n’ibindi ntabwo iyo wasanga mu mubiri we ingana n’iyo wasanga mu mubiri w’utanywa inzoga cyangwa utarya isukari nyinshi. Samvura yavuze ko ibipimo bya Alchool ikigo akorera kibifata nk’igihe umuntu yapfuye ariko batazi icyo yazize ariko bakeka ko zaba ari inzoga. Ati “Dufata amaraso n’inkari mu gihe dusuzuma icyamwishe.” Ibyo bipimo byafashwe by’amaraso n’inkari nibyo bishyirwa mu mashini yabugenewe. Ati “Iyo mashini niyo ihita itwereka ingano ya Alchool iri mu maraso. Iyo dusanzemo niyo tugenderaho tuvuga niba ishobora kwangiza umubiri, ishobora kuba impamvu y’urupfu.” Iyo bamaze gupima ingano ya Alchool iri mu maraso hakurikiraho gupima iri mu nkari kugira ngo bamenye niba irimo ari iyamugiyemo mbere cyangwa nyuma y’uko apfa. Ati “Iyo umuntu yanyoye inzoga akihagarika, hari alcohol igaragara mu nkari. Iyo tuyibonye mu nkari no mu maraso, ni ukuvuga ko udashobora gutandukanya urwo rupfu rw’uwo muntu n’iyo Alchool.” Samvura yasobanuye ko Alcohol igenda igira ingaruka mu mubiri w’umuntu bitewe n’impamvu zitandukanye.  Hari nk’igihe umuntu anyoye inzoga zigatuma atabasha gukanura neza, amaguru acika intege, agatangira kugenda ategwa, igihe agenda yikoza hirya no hino, igihe atakaza ubwenge cyangwa akaba yanapfa. Abantu babiri banywa inzoga zingana ntibanganye alchol mu maraso bitewe n’impamvu zirimo ingano y’ibinure cyangwa ibindi bintu bishobora gukumira umuvuduko wayo mu kwinjira mu maraso. Ingano ya Alchool itagize icyo itwaye umubiri ngo ni itamugiraho ingaruka n’imwe muri izo zavuzwe cyangwa ngo imubuze gukora akazi ke ka buri munsi. Ati “Niba hari alcohol ishobora kukubuza gutwara imodoka, iyo ntiba yemewe. Alchool yemewe ni isanzwe mu mubiri ukoresha nyine. Iyo kugira ngo uyibone ntibisaba kunywa inzoga kuko abatazinywa ntibagira ikibazo cyo kuyibura.” Yatanze urugero niba muri litiro imwe y’inzoga harimo alcohol 5%, yose iramutse yinjiye mu maraso uko yakabaye haba hinjiyemo Ml 50 za Alchool, igasangamo isanzwe mu mubiri. Ubusanzwe umuntu muzima agira hagati ya litiro 4-5 z’amaraso. Bivuze ko iyo alcohol yahita yivanga n’ayo maraso. Gusinda ni iki? Ibisobanuro byo gusinda mu Kinyarwanda, ni ukugaragaza imyitwarire itandukanye n’iyo usanzwe ugaragaza bitewe n’inzoga wanyoye. Samvura ati “Ntabwo bipimirwa ku ngano y’inzoga wanyoye bireberwa mu bikorwa wakoze. Niba usanzwe witonda wamara kunywa inzoga ugatangira gusakuza, kurwana, kugenda wikoza hirya no hino, uko ni ugusinda.” Samvura yasobanuye ko uburyo ikigo akorera bwifashishwa mu gupima ingano ya Alchool mu maraso nta tandukaniro rinini n’ubwifashishwa na polisi ishami rishinzwe umutekano wo mu muhanda, umuntu ahuhamo igahita imwereka ingano y’iyo afite mu maraso. Ati  “Iyo umuntu anyoye inzoga, kumwe amaraso azenguruka mu mubiri aba ari kumwe na alcohol, akagera mu bihaha. Kumwe rero uhumeka, Alchool isohokana n’umwuka uhumekwa.” Bisobanuye ko ibikoresho bakoresha bikoranye ikoranabuhanga ritanga ibipimo bimwe n’ibyagaragara bayipimye mu maraso. Alchool iyo ibaye nyinshi mu mubiri iwugiraho ingaruka zirimo gusinda, kureba hafi, kwangiza zimwe mu nyama zo mu nda ku buryo byagira ingaruka ku kazi ka buri munsi karimo nko gutwara imodoka n’ibindi. Samvura avuga ko inama yagira abantu kandi nawe yakwigira ari uko igihe abantu bagiye nko mu kabari ari benshi hagomba kuvamo umwe ntazinywe kugira ngo niba bafite nk’imodoka bari butahemo abatware. Ati “Inama nagira abantu ni ukureka kunywa inzoga bazi ko hari akandi kazi bagiye gukora. Urugero niba utwaye imodoka wanyoye, ntabwo uzamenya ngo ibipimo ni kangahe, imashini niyo ibipima..Niyo waba udatwara imodoka, ushobora gusinda mu ruhame bakaguhana.” Itegeko riteganya ko umuntu afite alchool itamwemerera gutwara ikinyabiziga iyo igipimo kiyipima kigaragaza mu maraso harimo garama 0.8 muri litiro y’amaraso, ariko leta iteganya kumanura ikageza kuri 0.4. Imibare ya Polisi yo muri Mutarama kugera Nzeri uyu mwaka yerekana ko abantu 532 bishwe n’impanuka, 705 barakomereka bikomeye, 1007 bakomereka byoroheje naho imitungo irenga 1200 irangirika. Ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku buzima (OMS), riteganya ko umuntu wese atemerewe kurenza alcool ya 0.05 ngo atware ikinyabiziga. Hari kandi ibihugu birenza iki gipimo harimo n’u Rwanda rufite 0.8, n’ibindi biri munsi yacyo bitewe n’amahitamo yabyo. [email protected]

title: Ni ryari umwana ashobora kuganirizwa ku bijyanye n’ubuzima bw’imyororokere?
content: Guhera muri Mutarama 2019 kugera muri Kanama imibare y’abangavu batewe inda yari imaze kugera ku 15 596. Imwe mu mpamvu ikomeye ituma iki kibazo gikomeza kugira ubukana ni ukubura ubumenyi ku buzima bw’imyororokere, kudakurikiranirwa hafi n’ababyeyi cyangwa abarezi babo. Bamwe mu bakobwa batewe inda bagaragaza ko iyo baza kuba barabonye ababaganiriza ku buzima bw’imyororokere batari kwishora mu busambanyi kuko babikoze badasobanukiwe ingaruka babikuramo. Ku rundi ruhande ariko ababyeyi bavuga ko bigoye kuganiriza umwana ibijyanye n’imibonano mpuzabitsina n’ubuzima bw’imyororokere muri rusange, bitwaje ko mu muco nyarwanda bishobora kuba bitakirwa neza. Kuba bamwe mu babyeyi badasobanukiwe igihe baganiriza abana babo ku bijyanye n’imibonano mpuzabitsina n’ubuzima bw’imyororokere, byatumye IGIHE iganira n’abakurikiranira hafi iby’iyi ngingo kugira ngo imenya igihe umwana yayiganirizwaho. Umwana aganirizwa ibijyanye n’imibonano afite imyaka ingahe? Mu kiganiro IGIHE yagiranye n’ushinzwe itumanaho mu kigo cy’ubuzima n’uburenganzira (HDI), Uwamariya Diane, yasobanuye ko igihe icyo ari cyo cyose umwana ashobora kuganirizwa ku ngingo y’imibonano mpuzabitsina bitewe n’imyaka afite. Ati “Ni ukuvuga ngo nko mu myaka itatu cyangwa ine igihe umwana aba yatangiye gukura no gushaka gusobanukirwa byinshi ku mubiri we. Hari ibimenyetso agenda agaragaza agatangira gukina niba ari umukobwa agatangira gukina n’umuhungu ashaka kumenya ibyo umuhungu afite we adafite n’umuhungu agakina ashaka kumenya ibyo umukobwa afite we adafite”. Iyo umwana ageze muri ibyo bihe, umubyeyi we amusobanurira ibice bigize umubiri we ariko ntamubwire amazina y’igitsina kugira ngo ayo magambo atazajya amuhoramo ahubwo agakoresha andi magambo yo kuzimiza. Uwamariya atanga urugero rw’uko wabwira umwana uti “Nujya ukina n’umwana w’umuhungu ntukamukore ku ku myanya y’ibanga kuko uba wayimusobanuriye iyo ariyo.” Urugero nk’abana bari hagati y’imyaka irindwi na 10 umubyeyi yigisha abana b’abakobwa ko muri icyo gihe bashobora kujya mu mihango akabigisha ibijyanye n’isuku no kuyigira ku mubiri. Yongeyeho ko umwana iyo amaze kugira imyaka umunani kuzamura umubyeyi we aba akwiye kumubwira ibintu byose ntacyo amuhishe. Ati “Rero  iyo amaze kugera mu myaka umunani gutyo yatangiye kujya ku ishuri abonana n’abandi, nibwo atangira kumenya amakuru ku buzima bw’imyororokere atandukanye n’ayo umubyeyi amubwirara, aho hari abo usanga bakubaza ngo ese umwana ava he?  bigenda gute kugira ngo avuke? ibintu nk’ibyo.” Umwana wageze muri iki kigero umubyeyi we amubwira ibintu hafi ya byose bijyanye n’uko agenda akura niba ari umuhungu akamubwira ko hari igihe azaniga ijwi akaniroteraho, umukobwa akamubwira ko azamera amabere akanajya mu mihango n’ibindi. Uko umwana yakwitwara muri ibyo biganiro Uwamariya yemeza ko bitewe n’uko umwana aba afite amatsiko, iyo ari kuganirizwa ku bijyanye n’imibonano mpuzabitsina agahabwa umwanya agenda yirekura akavuga uko yumva ibyo abwirwa. Ati “Iyo wamuteze amatwi ukamwumva ukamuha umwanya, ni naho akubwira ibyo azi noneho ukabasha gusobanukirwa bya binyoma byose baba bamubwira n’ibintu byose bamubwira byamurangaza kuko atinyuka akakubwira”. Igihe umubyeyi yumvishe umwana amubajije ikibazo gikomeye kandi kimutunguye, ntakwiye kumukanga cyangwa kumureba igitsure ahubwo akwiye kumuha umwanya kugira ngo amuyobore mu nzira nziza yakuriramo. Uwamariya avuga ko umwana aganirizwa bitewe n’ikigero arimo kuko nk’umwana w’imyaka ine atahabwa inyigisho z’umwana ugeze mu bugimbi n’ubwangavu. Noneho hejuru y’imyaka 10 nibwo ababwira ibijyanye n’inda zitifuzwa ku bangavu no gukoresha agakingirizo. Icyo gihe akoresha imvugo zimeze nk’amarenga akavuga akanyoni cyangwa agatabi, agapipi n’ibindi mu gihe umaze kugira imyaka iri hejuru ya 11 akwiye kubwirwa amagambo yose yewe n’amazina y’igitsina ntacyo bitwaye. Mu 2017, Umuryango Imbuto Foundation wasohoye agatabo kitwa “Tuganire mwana wanjye” karimo inyigisho zose zifasha umubyeyi kuba yaganiriza umwana.

title: U Rwanda rwakajije ingamba zo kurwanya Ebola, abarenga 300 bayikingirwa buri munsi i Rubavu
content: Imibare yo ku wa 14 Mutarama 2020 yerekana ko abapfuye bazize Ebola muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo bageze ku 2236 bavuye ku 2000 babarurwaga muri Nzeri 2019 ni mu gihe abo imaze kugaragaraho muri rusange ari 3288 kuva mu 2018. Mu mwaka ushize amakuru yumvikanye ko Ebola yagaragaye mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru na Ituri no hafi y’imipaka ishyira Uburengerazuba bw’u Rwanda. Ibyo byatumye Minisiteri y’Ubuzima mu Rwanda ifata ingamba zitandukanye zo gukumira icyo cyorezo. Hubatswe ibyumba abakekwaho icyo cyorezo bashyirwamo hategerejwe ambulance ku mipaka ya Rubavu na Rusizi ndetse hatangizwa n’ubukangurambaga bwo gukangurira abanyarwanda kwirinda icyo cyorezo. Ibyumba byubatswe hafi ya Camera zishobora gutahura umurwayi wa Ebola hagendewe ku muriro afite. Camera zireba abashaka kwambuka umupaka bafite umuriro wa dogre Celsius 38 ni mu gihe ubushyuhe bw’umuntu udafite ikibazo buba hagati ya 36 na 37. Iyo zimubonye zitanga intabaza akajya kwitabwaho n’abaganga. Indi ngamba n’iy’ubukangurambaga bwiswe ‘Umurinzi’ bugamije gukingira abagera ku 200 000 biganjemo abakora ubucuruzi hagati y’u Rwanda na RDC. Ni urukingo rutemewe ku bana bari munsi y’imyaka ibiri n’abagore batwite. Ku ikubitiro rwahawe abagera ku 3 000 barimo abaganga n’abandi bakora mu rwego rw’ubuzima umwaka ushize naho abagera kuri 336 bakora ibikorwa byambukiranya umupaka w’u Rwanda na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo mu Karere ka Rubavu bakingirwa buri munsi. Umuyobozi w’Ibitaro by’icyitegererezo bya Rubavu, Dr William Kanyankore avuga gukingirwa ari ubushake kandi ko bibanda ku bakora ubucuruzi kuri uwo mupaka kubera ko ari bo bafite ibyago byinshi byo kwandura. Ati “Gukingirwa ni ubushake nta wubihatirwa abo tureba cyane ni abakora ubucuruzi bwambukiranya umupaka wa Congo kuko ari bo bafite ibyago byo kwandura iyo virusi.” Ni urukingo rwemejwe n’Ishami ry’umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku buzima, OMS. Umaze gufata urukingo ajyanwa mu cyumba amaramo iminota igera kuri 15 harebwa niba nta ngaruka rwamugizeho. Aho uwo Ebola yagaragaraho yafashirizwa Ibitaro by’icyitegererezo bya Rubavu biherereye mu Karere ka Rubavu, ni bimwe mu bifite ibyangombwa by’icyumba cyihariye cyo kwita ku murwayi wa Ebola igihe yaba agaragaye. Bifite icyumba cyitaruye kandi cyubatse ku buryo umurwayi wa Ebola atagira aho ahurira n’abandi hirindwa ko yabanduza. Umurwayi atwarwa mu modoka itwara abarwayi ’ambulance’ nta muganga bari kumwe kandi ntanaho yahurira n’umushoferi umutwaye. Iyo umurwayi ashobora kwigenza yakirwa n’abaganga babiri bambaye ku buryo bwagenwe yaba atabishoboye akakirwa na bane bambaye ku buryo batagira aho bahurira na we. Hakurikiraho kumujyana muri cya cyumba kitagerwamo n’undi muntu uretse umurwayi n’abaganga bipfutse ku buryo bushoboka. Umurwayi akimara gukurwa muri ambulance, ihita isukurwa hakoreshejwe umuti wica udukoko (0.5 Chlorine). Abaganga nabo iyo bavuye kureba umurwayi bakaraba uwo muti inshuro nyinshi bagakoresha n’indi miti mbere yo gukuramo imyambaro ibarinda. Ni imyenda iteganyijwe ko yambarwa mu minota 50 kubera ko iba ishyushye kandi ipfutse cyane ku buryo guhumeka bitorohera abayambaye. Ahavurirwa Ebola hafite icyumba kijyanwamo abari koroherwa bakitwabwaho. Iyo umurwayi apfuye hari aho umuryango we ushobora kumurebera ariko batamwegereye. Kubera ko umurambo w’uwazize Ebola wanduza cyane. Kugeza ubu u Rwanda rwubatse ahantu hatandukanye mu turere twa Rubavu na Rusizi no mu Mujyi wa Kigali, abagaragaraho Ebola bajyanwa bakitabwaho kandi n’abaganga bo kubitaho barahuguwe. Ambulance eshatu zihariye nazo zarateguwe. Miliyoni $17 zimaze gukoreshwa mu bikorwa byo kwirinda ko hagira umunyarwanda wandura Virusi ya Ebola no gutegura uburyo bwo kwita ku wo yagaragaraho. Nubwo ibyo byose byakozwe, Abanyarwanda basabwa kwirinda bakurikiza inama bahabwa zo kwirinda Ebola.

title: Inzobere mu kuvura indembe, Dr Nyirigira yagaragaje ko ububabare bukabije bushobora gutera kwiyahura
content: Yabigarutseho ubwo yatangaga ikiganiro mu Nama Mpuzamahanga y’iminsi ibiri yahuje abaganga bo mu bihugu 12 igamije kwigira hamwe uko hashyirwaho ubuvuzi bwihariye mu gukumira no kuganya ububabare (International Conference on Pain Management). Dr Nyirigira usanzwe avura mu Bitaro bya Kaminuza bya Butare (CHUB), mu mwaka wa 2018 yabaye Umunyafurika wa mbere wahawe igihembo cyo kuvura no kugabanya ububabare. Yagiherewe i Boston muri Leta ya Massashusette muri Amerika kubera ubushakashatsi yakoranye n’itsinda rya Kaminuza ya Queen’s University, bwanahinduye uburyo bw’imivurire mu bitaro bya CHUB na CHUK. Muri iyo nama mpuzamahanga yasojwe ku wa Gatanu tariki ya 17 Mutarama 2020, Dr Nyirigira yagaragaje ingaruka mbi zishobora guterwa n’ububabare asaba ko hafatwa ingamba zihariye mu kubukumira no kubuvura. Ati “Ingaruka zikomeye cyane harimo ubumuga bitewe n’uko umuntu  atavuwe neza ububabare. Ikindi ni uko uzahora ubihiwe kuko bizagera ku bwonko ku buryo wazagera n’igihe ukiyahura, hari abiyahura benshi cyane.” Yakomeje agaragaza ko hari ibikwiye guhinduka nk’aho usanga abantu barishyizemo ko igihe umuntu ababaye agomba gushinyiriza. Ati “Turakangurira abanyarwanda ndetse n’abandi bantu ko kubabara bishobora guturuka ku kintu kinini cyane, bisaba rero ko umuntu ufite ububabare agana ku ivuriro bakamurebera ikintu kibitera hakiri kare; ishobora kuba ari cancer ikaba yaguteza ibindi bibazo.” Abitabiriye iyo nama barimo abo mu Bitaro bya Kaminuza bya Butare, CHUB, abahagarariye Ibitaro by’Uturere byose byo mu Rwanda; abaturutse mu bihugu bo mu Karere k’Ibiyaga Bigari; muri Afurika; ku mugabane w’u Burayi no muri Amerika ndetse na Canada. Abayitabiriye bavuze ko basangiye ubunararibonye kandi bungukiyemo byinshi bizatuma bita ku barwayi by’umwihariko mu kubagabanyiriza ububabare. Niyonzima Emmanuel, yavuze ko agiye kurushaho  kuganiriza abarwayi by’umwihariko abamugana. Ati “Twuungukiyemo ko hari n’ibibazo byo mu mutwe bishobora gutera ububabare; ibibazo biterwa n’amateka umuntu yanyuzemo; umuntu ashobora kuza wamuganiriza ukumva ikibazo afite, ntabwo ari ukumuha imiti gusa ahubwo ukamwohereza no ku muntu umugira inama. Twungukiyemo ko no kuvugisha abarwayi neza nabyo bibavura.” Umubyaza mu Bitaro bya CHUB, Umurerwa Emerance we yavuze ko yungukiyemo uburyo bushya bwo kwita ku babyeyi batwite abarinda ububabare. Yavuze ko hari ababyeyi yakira baje  kubyara barimo kubabara cyane ndetse hari na benshi bashobora guhagarika kubyara kubera ko bafite amateka y’ukuntu bagiye bababara ku nda zatambutse. Ati “Akenshi twakundaga kubabwira ngo bagume hamwe baryamire uruhande rumwe ariko n’izindi mpande ziremewe kuko hari igihe akubwira ko yananiwe akababara cyane bikamubangamira. Uko ahindura uburyo ni ko uburibwe bugabanyuka gusa hari n’imiti myinshi ishobora kuboneka wenda tutashyiragamo ingufu mu kuyitanga. Guhera uyu munsi twemeye ko ari uguhinduka muri twebwe ni cyo kintu cyonyine gihagije kugira ngo abarwayi tubagabanyirize uburibwe.” Umuyobozi Mukuru wa CHUB, Dr Sendegeya Agustin, yavuze ko nyuma yo kubona ko ikibazo cy’ububabare ku barwayi gihagangikishije, biyemeje gutangiza serivise yihariye ibwitaho mu bitaro. Iyo nama Mpuzamahanga y’iminsi ibiri yabereye muri Galileo Stadium Hotel, yatumiwemo n’uhagariye abavuzi gakondo hamwe n’umupasiteri kugira ngo nabo batange umusanzu mu kuvura abantu ububabare. Yateguwe na CHUB ku bufatanye na Minisiteri y’Ubuzima mu Rwanda. [email protected]

title: Nyagatare: Ibitaro bya Gatunda bizatahwa muri uyu mwaka
content: Ibi bitaro byari bimaze imyaka ibiri byubakwa bigiye kuzura ku mafaranga miliyari enye. Nyagatare niko karere kanini mu gihugu. Kagizwe n’imirenge 14 n’abaturage bagera ku bihumbi 700 nyamara gafite ibitaro bimwe. Abaturage n’abayobozi babwiye itangazamakuru ko ibitaro bya Gatunda nibyuzura, bizateza imbere serivisi z’ubuzima mu ntara y’Iburasirazuba. Meya wa Nyagatare, Claudian Mushabe yagize ati “Ntabwo turamenya neza itariki yo kubitaha ariko turi mu mirimo ya nyuma yo kubaka.” Yakomeje agira ati “Nyuma yo kuzura hazajyaho ibyo kubona ibikoresho ariko icyo tuzi neza ni uko mu mpera z’uyu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari, ibitaro bizaba byaruzuye.” Ubuyobozi bw’akarere buvuga ko ibyo bitaro bizaha serivisi abaturage bagera ku bihumbi 400 bo mu mirenge ya Gatunda, Kiyombe, Karama, Mimuri, Mukama n’ibice bya Rukomo. Umuyobozi w’ishami ry’ubuzima muri Nyagatare, Elia Kamanzi, yavuze ko bafite icyizere ko muri Kamena uyu mwaka ibitaro bizaba byatangiye gukora. Ati “Inyungu za mbere z’ibi bitaro ni uko umubare w’abantu bajyaga mu mujyi wa Nyagatare uzagabanyuka. Nyagatare ni kamwe mu turere dutuwe cyane ariko gafite ibitaro bimwe, bikaba byagiraga ingaruka kuri serivisi zitangirwa mu bitaro.” Jean de Dieu Bavugirije, umuturage w’imyaka  54 wo mu murenge wa Karama, yavuze ko bishimishije kuba bagiye guhabwa ibitaro hafi. Ati “Hari abarwayi bajyaga boherezwa I Nyagatare, bamwe barimo ababyeyi batwite  bikagore imiryango yabo.” Mu 2017 ubwo Perezida Kagame yiyamamarizaga kuyobora u Rwanda, nibwo yemereye abaturage bo mu Murenge wa Gatunda, Akarere ka Nyagatare n’indi mirenge bihana imbibi kububakira ibitaro mu kubaruhura ingendo bakora bajya kwivuza.

title: Abaturage basaga ibihumbi ijana bicwa n’imiti y’imyiganano muri Afurika
content: Ahakomeje kugaragara cyane iki kibazo ni mu bihugu byo mu Burengerazuba bwa Afurika nko muri Sénégal, aho usanga abacuruzi bagurisha iyi miti bavuga ko ari myiza. Umuturage wo muri Sénégal wanyoye imiti yaguze ku isoko kubera ubushobozi buke, nyuma bikamuviramo kumva atabasha kugenda, kuruka cyane no gukuka amenyo, yahise yihutira kujya kwa muganga. Ati “Umuganga yarambwiye ngo nshobora kwitaba Imana, namubwije ukuri ko nta bushobozi nari mfite bwo kugurira imiti muri farumasi, nayiguriye ku muhanda.” Iyi miti usanga ahenshi ifunze neza, ku buryo abayigura baba batabasha kuyitandukanya n’imiti mizima ariko witegereje usanga imwe ntaho ihuriye n’isanzwe. Abasanzwe bacuruza imiti muri za farumasi bo basaba ubuyobozi gushyiraho zimwe mu ngamba zo gukumira ubucucruzi bw’imiti y’imyiganano kuko yica ubuzima bw’abaturage. OMS ivuga ko nibura umuti umwe mu miti icumi uba ari umwiganano ariko mu bihugu bimwe na bimwe usanga imiti irindwi ku icumi ari imyiganano cyane cyane muri Afurika. Mu Burengerazuba bwa Afurika, ubucuruzi bw’imiti y’imyiganano ituruka mu Bushinwa, mu Buhinde no muri Nigeria, butwara asaga miliyari 200 z’amadorali. Abakuru b’ibihugu byo mu Burengerazuba bwa Afurika bagiye guhurira mu murwa mukuru wa Togo, Lome, aho bazasinya amasezerano agamije guhagarika ubu bucuruzi bw’imiti y’imyiganano.

title: Abarwayi ba diabète bagiye guhabwa udukoresho miliyoni 12 bapimisha isukari mu mubiri
content: Utu dukoresho twifashishwa mu gupima isukari (Glucose meters) ni udukoresho twa ngombwa mu gufasha kugenzura ubuzima bw’abafite diabète. Ubu bufasha buri mu bufatanye bwa Team Type 1 Foundation, umuryango utari uwa leta ufite intego yo gufasha mu bijyanye n’uburezi, kongerera ubushobozi no gutuma buri wese ufite ikibazo cya diabète agerwaho n’ubuvuzi. Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ubuzima, ushinzwe ubuvuzi bw’ibanze, Dr. Ndimubanzi Patrick, yavuze ko Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yifatanyije n’amahanga mu guhangana n’ubwiyongere bwayo, ituma  kandi ubuvuzi bufite ireme butangwa mu nzego zose z’ubuzima harimo n’ubuvuzi bw’ibanze. Yavuze ko kurwanya diabète  n’izindi ndwara zitandura, biri mu byibanze  Minisiteri y’Ubuzima izakomeza gukoraho n’abafatanyabikorwa bayo,  mu guhangana nazo n’ingaruka zazo. Umuyobozi muri Abbott, Bernard Brisolier,  yagize ati “Twishimiye kuzana uyu mushinga mu buzima no gufasha umuryango nyarwanda w’abarwayi ba diabète, gukorana na minisiteri y’ubuzima na Team Type 1 Foundation, bizatuma dufasha umubare w’abantu batari bake bafite diabète mu Rwanda, mu kugenzura isukari aho ihagaze no guhangana nayo, ibi bizabafasha kubaho neza.” Uwashinze Team Type 1 Foundation, Phil Southerland, yagize ati  “Inzozi zibaye impamo mu kwakira izi nkunga zivuye muri Abbott, kuva mu 2010 Team Type 1 Foundation yakoreye mu Rwanda kugeza uyu munsi biciye muri Tour du Rwanda ndetse n’ishyirahamwe ry’abarwayi ba diabète” Abbott ifasha  mu by’ubuzima ku mugabane wa Afurika no mu Rwanda by’umwihariko. Kuva mu mu 2019, iki kigo cyakoranye na Minisiteri y’Ubuzima mu mushinga urimo uwo gutangiza amavuriro mato (Health posts)  umunani mu Karere ka Bugesera. Iyi gahunda igamije gutanga ubuvuzi bw’ibanze ku bantu ku buryo mu minota 30 baba byibuze bageze aho babonera ubuvuzi. Amavuriro mato azafasha abantu harimo abagore batwite n’abana bavukana indwara ndetse n’abafite indwara zitandura. Team Type 1 Foundation itanga ubufasha mu kuziba icyuho mu kugera ku buzima, uburezi biciye mu buryo bwo burambye. Ubushakashatsi bwo mu 2014, bugaragaza ko ikigero cya diabète mu Rwanda kiri kuri 3%, mu gihe abarwayi ibihumbi bibiri bafite diabète ya 1. Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yashyizeho ingamba mu guhangana na diabète  harimo ubukangurambaga ku kwisuzuma no gutanga ubumenyi bwo kuyimenya hakiri kare, kugera ku bikoresho by’ibanze bifasha guhangana n’iyi ndwara, gushyira ubu burwayi mu bivuzwa mu bwisungane mu kwivuza n’ibindi. Abbott ni ikigo mpuzamahanga gifasha abantu kubaho neza mu ngeri zose z’ubuzima, gifite abantu 103,000 batanga ubufasha mu bihugu birenga 160 ku Isi.

title: Manirakiza w’imyaka 19 arasaba ubufasha ngo ajye guhindurirwa impyiko irwaye mu Buhinde
content: Uyu mwana w’imyaka 19 utagira ababyeyi bombi ariko akaba afashwa na nyirasenge, Soeur Bangamwabo Catherine, yigaga mu mashuri yisumbuye. Ubwo burwayi bwamufatiye ku ishuri atangira kubyimba ibice bimwe by’umubiri ariko ntamenye indwara arwaye. Nyuma ageze mu biruhuko nibwo yamufashe yikubita hasi ajyanwa ku Bitaro bya Muhima mu Karere ka Nyarugenge mu Mujyi wa Kigali, nabyo bibonye ntacyo byakora ku burwayi bwe bimwohereza ku bya Gisirikare i Kanombe ari nabyo byaje gutahura ko impyiko ze zangiritse. Soeur Bangamwabo yitabaje Minisante kubera ko atari ashoboye kumuvuza nayo isaba ibitaro kumwitaho mu gihe agitegereje ko haboneka uburyo ngo ajyanwe guhindurirwa impyiko mu Buhinde. Kuva icyo gihe Ibitaro bya Kanombe byahise bitangira kumwitaho mu buryo butandukanye burimo kumwogereza impyiko aho nibura yakeneraga kozwa inshuro eshatu mu cyumweru. Soeur Bangamwabo yabwiye IGIHE ko nyuma yaje gukorerwa raporo ngo ajye kwivuriza mu Buhinde ndetse abona uzamuha impyiko Minisante yemeye kumwishyurira ibisabwa kugira ngo avurwe ariko umuryango we ugashaka amafaranga y’itike ye, iy’uzamuha impyiko n’uzamurwaza asaga miliyoni 10 Frw. Ati “Ibindi byose ni ukubyishakira ari impapuro z’inzira ze n’umurwaza, amacumbi n’ibindi bizakurikira. Umwana nta muryango afite ni njye na musaza we asigaranye kandi nawe yaramugaye ntitwabona ibikenewe ngo avurirwe iyo mu mahanga.” Uyu mwana wabaye imfubyi afite imyaka itanu yakomeje kwitabwaho na Soeur Bangamwabo uvuga ko atabona miliyoni 10 Frw asabwa. Soeur Bangamwabo avuga ko uwagira umutima ufasha yagira icyo akora kugira ngo uyu mwana avurwe kuko hasigaye amezi abiri gusa kugira ngo yoherezwe kwivuza mu Buhinde. Ufite umutima wo gufasha wakoresha Mobile Money kuri nimero 0788610658 ibaruye kuri Soeur Bangamwabo Catherine. Hari na nimero ya konti iri muri Banki ya Kigali; ariyo 002700655635318.
