title: Gutera akabariro inshuro nke bishobora gutuma umugore acura imburagihe
content: Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko abagore batera akabariro inshuro nke, amahirwe yo gucura kwabo aba ari hejuru ugereranyije n’abatera akabariro inshuro nyinshi. Mu gukora ubu bushakashatsi, abagore babajijwe inshuro bakoraho imibonano mpuzabitsina. Abagore bavuze ko batera akabariro byibuze buri cyumweru, byagaragaye ko amahirwe yabo yo gucura hakiri kare ari make ku gipimo cya 28% ugereranyije n’abatera akabariro rimwe mu kwezi bo bari kuri 19%. Ababwanditse bavuze ko kuba habaho guhuza ibitsina hagati y’umugore n’umugabo bishobora kumenyesha umubiri ko gutwita gushoboka. Ariko ku bagore badakora imibonano mpuzabitsina cyane, kuba bacura hakiri kare ngo bihita byisobanura ushingiye kuri iyi ngingo. Ubusanzwe igihe cyo gucura ku mugore kiba hagati y’imyaka 45 na 55. Bavuga ko umugore yacuze kare iyo acuze mbere y’imyaka 40 bakanavuga ko yacuze atinze iyo bibaye arengeje imyaka 55. N’ubwo ubushakashatsi butagaragaje aho ibi byombi bihurira, ababuyoboye bavuze ko bimwe mu bimenyetso by’umubiri bishobora kugaragaza ko hari amahirwe yo gusama, ariko ku bagore badatera akabariro inshuro nyinshi, gucura kwabo bishobora kugaragarira imbere mu mubiri gusa. Ubu bushakashatsi bushingiye ku isesengura ryatangiye gukorwa muri Amerika ku buzima bw’umugore guhera mu 1996 ryitwa “Women’s Health Across the Nation”. Bwashingiye ku makuru yatanzwe n’abagore 3000 bari bafite imyaka 45 mu gihe bwatangiraga, nibura buri wese afite abana babiri kandi afite umugabo. Abagore 45% bagaragaje ko bacuze bagize imyaka 52. Amakuru ajyanye n’imibereho y’ubuzima bwabo yakusanyijwe mu gihe cy’imyaka 10. Ku ikubitiro, nta mugore n’umwe muri aba bose wari wagacuze, ariko 46% bari batangiye kubona ibimenyetso byabyo birimo imihango ihindagurika no kumva mu mubiri bafite ubushyuhe bwinshi. 54% bo bari batarageza igihe cyo kujya gucura ndetse nta n’ibimenyetso byabyo babonaga kuko imihango yabo yazaga nk’ibisanzwe. Ibikorwa bifitanye isano n’igitsina ntabwo byigeze bisobanurwa nko gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina gusa ahubwo hanarebwe ku bijyanye no kwishimishanya ku gitsina abantu bakoresheje umunwa cyangwa ururimi, kwikinisha, kwagazanya n’ibindi nka byo. Ni bwo bushakashatsi bwa mbere bugaragaje isano iri hagati y’imibonano mpuzabitsina no gucura k’umugore. Ababukoze batangaje ko isesengura ryabo bagiye kurikorera ku kindi gice cy’abantu bakareba niba ibyo babona bizahura n’ibya mbere.

title: Ibitaro byitiriwe Umwami Faisal mu mavugurura azasiga bibasha kubaga imitima no gusimbuza impyiko
content: Ibitaro byitiriwe Umwami Faisal byatangiye amavugurura agamije kubishyira ku rwego mpuzamahanga arimo gutangiza serivisi nshya z’ubuvuzi zajyaga zitangirwa mu mahanga nko kubaga imitima, gusimbuza impyiko, kuvura ubwoko bumwe na bumwe bwa kanseri n’ibindi. Muri gahunda y’ibikorwa y’imyaka itanu ibi bitaro byihaye (2020-2025)  harimo kongera ibikorwa remezo, kongera ireme rya serivisi zihabwa abarwayi, kongera abaganga b’inzobere n’ibindi. Muri  Mata umwaka ushize nibwo Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yasheshe amasezerano yari ifitanye n’ikigo Oshen Healthcare Rwanda Limited gishamikiye kuri  Oshen Healthcare cyo muri Angola, nyuma y’uko ibyari byemeranyijwe byo gucunga no guteza imbere ibyo bitaro bitari biri kugerwaho uko bikwiriye. Ibi bitaro bifite intego yo kujya ku rwego mpuzamahanga, bigafasha Leta  kugabanya umubare w’abanyarwanda bajya kwivuriza  hanze bagiye kwivuza indwara zitavurirwa imbere mu gihugu. Umuyobozi w’Ibitaro byitiriwe Umwami Faisal, Dr Kalimba Edgar yabwiye IGIHE ko nyuma yo gusubizwa mu maboko ya Leta y’u Rwanda, bifuza guhindura amateka y’ibi bitaro. Kalimba yavuze ko mbere na mbere bazahera mu gutangiza ubuvuzi butari busanzwe nko kuba basimbuza impyiko yarwaye,  kongerera ubushobozi serivisi zo kubaga imitima n’ibindi. Yagize ati  “Tugiye kongera imbaraga mu bice  nk’ibijyanye no kubaga umutima. Icya kabiri ni indwara z’impyiko. Mushobora kuba muzi ko  ubu tubasha gutanga ubuvuzi mu gufasha impyiko kuyungurura amaraso, tubikora neza mu gihugu ariko ntabwo turabasha gutangira kujya dusimbuza impyiko. Umurwayi ukeneye impyiko ntabwo ashobora kuzibona mu Rwanda , bimusaba kujya hanze.” Benshi mu barwayi b’impyiko bageze ku rwego rw’uko zisimbuzwa, bakunze kujya kuzisimburizwa mu bihugu byateye imbere nk’u Buhinde. Ibyo bitwara amafaranga menshi haba agenda ku murwayi n’abamwitaho, iterambere ry’igihugu n’umurwayi bikahazaharira. Dr Kalimba yavuze ko nubwo biri muri gahunda y’imyaka itanu, nibatangiza iyo serivisi izaba ihendutse kurusha kujya mu mahanga. Yagize ati “Igiciro byanze bikunze ntabwo gishobora kungana n’umurwayi ugiye hanze kuko iyo ugiye hanze bisaba itike y’indege, umarayo igihe kirekire nk’ukwezi kugira ubagwe ukire ushobore kugaruka. Akenshi na kenshi iyo ufite n’umurwaza nabyo ni ubundi bushobozi bisaba. Nitumara gutangira izo serivisi bifite inyungu nini ku banyarwanda kuko bazabagirwa hano mu rugo kandi binahendutse.” Ibi bitaro bifite abaganga b’inzobere 40 mu basaga 80 bahari. Abafite ubumenyi mu buvuzi bw’impyiko ni bake mu gihe mu bijyanye no kubaga impyiko cyangwa kusizimbuza ntabo. Dr Kalimba avuga ko mu gihe bazaba batangiye gutanga ubwo buvuzi, bazitabaza abaganga b’abanyamahanga ariko n’abanyarwanda bakagenda babigiraho. Ibi bitaro kandi bifite ibibazo by’ubuke bw’abaganga mu zindi ngeri z’ubuvuzi nko kubaga imitima, indwara zo mu nda, indwara z’imitsi n’indwara z’amaraso. Muri uyu mwaka, byitezwe ko hazahabwa akazi abandi baganga b’inzobere bari hagati ya 10 na 15 cyane cyane ab’indwara zikirimo ibyuho. Miliyari 18 Frw zigiye gushorwa mu bikorwa birimo inyubako Mu myaka itanu y’ibikorwa,  ibi bitaro byiyemeje kubaka ibikorwa remezo bizafasha mu kugeza ubuvuzi bugezweho ku babigana. Igice cya mbere cyatangiye mu mpera za 2019, kizasozwa mu mwaka wa 2021 gitwaye miliyoni 20 z’amadolari, ni ukuvuga asaga miliyari 18 z’amanyarwanda. Leta y’u Rwanda nk’umunyamigabane mukuru w’ibi bitaro niyo izafasha mu kubona  ayo mafaranga. Bimwe mu bizubakwa mu cyiciro cya mbere harimo inyubako izaba irimo ibyumba 45  yo kuvuriramo abarwayi bataha,  hazubakwa inyubako izakorerwamo iby’uburezi n’ubushakashatsi, inyubako izaba irimo ivuriro ry’abifite n’ibindi. Muri gahunda kandi ibi bitaro bivuga ko bizateza imbere ibijyanye no kongerera ubumenyi abakozi no gufasha abanyeshuri biga ubuvuzi kwimenyereza. Ibyo bizajyana no kongerera ubushobozi ibijyanye n’ubushakashatsi bw’imbere mu gihugu ku bijyanye n’ubuvuzi. Dr Kalimba yagize ati “Muzi ko hari ibintu bigenda bihinduka cyane mu buvuzi, haba mu ikoranabuhanga, uburyo bw’imivurire n’imicungire y’ibitaro n’ibindi. Ni iby’inenzi kuri twe nk’ibitaro bikomeye mu gihugu gukora ubushakashatsi bwacu tugatanga amakuru yacu yihariye.” Ibitaro byitiriwe Umwami Faisal bimaze imyaka isaga 30 bitanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi mu Rwanda. Mu mwaka wa 2013 byashyizwe ku rwego rw’akarere, bikaba byitezwe ko muri Werurwe uyu mwaka hazakorwa irindi genzura, hakarebwa niba bikiri kuri urwo rwego.

title: Umujyi wa Kigali ugiye kwimura imiryango isaga 1100 kubera imvura ikomeye yitezwe
content: Iyi gahunda ije ikurikira indi yakozwe mu mpera z’umwaka ushize aho abaturage bari batuye mu bishanga bakuwemo bakimurirwa ahandi, hatazateza ikibazo ku buzima bwabo. Ishusho igaragazwa na Méteo-Rwanda yerekana ko Umujyi wa Kigali ari wo uzagwamo imvura nyinshi kandi mu gihe kirekire, ugereranyije n’ibindi bice by’u Rwanda. Mu kiganiro n’itangazamakuru kuri uyu wa Mbere, tariki ya 09 Werurwe, 2020, Umujyi wa Kigali wavuze ko hari uduce dusaga 10 two muri uyu mujyi twagaragaye ko abahatuye bakwiye kwimurwa mu buryo bwihuse kuko ibimenyetso bigaragaza ko imvura iteganywa, iramutse ibasanze aho batuye yakwangiza byinshi birimo no kubatwara ubuzima. Minisitiri w’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu, Prof Shyaka Anastase, yavuze ko iyi gahunda igamije gutabara abaturage bashobora kwibasirwa n’ibiza, ahera aho asaba abafite inzu zikodeshwa kutazamura ibiciro kubera umubare munini w’abakeneye kwimuka mu buryo butari bwateguwe. Ati “Ubu kwimura abaturage bigamije kubatabara bakavanwa aho batuye, hashobora kubashyira mu kaga kurushaho mu gihe ibiza byaba bihabasanze. Ntaho bihuriye no kuba bagiye kwimurwa ku bw’ibikorwa bigamije inyungu rusange. Ntihazagire ubyuririraho ngo ashake kubibyaza inyungu z’ikirenga kuko azaba ari guhungabanya umutekano w’igihugu n’abaturage.” Prof Shyaka akomeza avuga ko ubufatanye bw’inzego zitandukanye bukenewe muri uru rugamba mu rwego rwo kurinda abanyarwanda muri ibi bihe by’ibiza. Umujyi wa Kigali uvuga ko nta ngengo y’imari ihagije yateguwe muri iki gikorwa cyo kwimura abaturage bashobora kwibasirwa n’ibiza, usibye miliyoni 80 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda azifashishwa mu gukodeshereza abaturage bazaba bimuwe, bavanywe mu bice bya Kimisagara na Gitega bikikije ruhurura ya Mpazi, Gatsata, Gikondo, Kimihurura (Mu Myembe), Kangondo, Mulindi (ahazwi nko kuri 12), Rwampara, ibice bimwe bya Nyarutarama n’ahandi. Muri rusange abakeneye kwimurwa mu buryo bwihuse ni imiryango ibarirwa hagati ya 1000 na 1500. Umuyobozi w’Umujyi wa Kigali, Pudence Rubingisa, yavuze ko bari baratangije gahunda yo kubaka inzu 392 zigenewe abazimurwa mu bishanga no mu manegeka bitarenze muri Kamena uyu mwaka; gusa ngo ntihari hateganyijwe ko hari abandi baturage bazimurwa mu rwego rw’ubutabazi. Abazahabwa izi ni abatishoboye basanzwe bafashwa na Leta. Ikigo cy’Igihugu Gishinzwe Kurengera Ibidukikije (REMA) kivuga ko nyuma yo kwimura abaturage bose batuye mu bishanga, hazakurikiraho gahunda yo kubitunganya ndetse bikabyazwa umusaruro hakurikijwe icyo igishushanyo mbonera giteganya, kuko ibyinshi muri byo byangijwe n’ibikorwa byari byarubatswemo. Meteo Rwanda ivuga ko kugera mu mpera z’ukwezi kwa Gicurasi, mu gice cy’Uburasirazuba bw’Amajyepfo ari ho hazagwa imvura iringaniye; mu gihe Umujyi wa Kigali, ibice by’uburengerazuba ndetse n’uturere twa Nyaruguru na Nyamagabe hazagwa imvura ishobora guteza ibiza. Umujyi wa Kigali kandi ngo ni wo wagize imvura nyinshi mu kwezi kwa kabiri kuruta ahandi hose mu Rwanda. Mu mwaka ushize ni bwo hahagurukiwe ikibazo cy’abaturage bari batuye mu bishanga; bamwe barimuwe mu gihe imvura yari iri kugwa cyane, abandi bishakira aho gutura ndetse batanga umusanzu wo gukuraho ibikorwaremezo bari bafite mu bishanga. Hari abanyarwanda bafashije bagenzi babo kubona aho kwikinga mu gihe leta itari ifite ahantu hahagije ho kwimurira abaturage. Kuva icyo gihe hakozwe ibikorwa bitandukanye birimo kuzibura imiyoboro itwara amazi no guhanga imishya, gukuraho inzu n’ibindi bikorwa bigaragara ko biri mu bishanga n’ibindi. Mu mpera z’umwaka ushize kandi himuwe imiryango 5600 mu turere twose tugize umujyi. Bamwe baracyakodesherezwa mu gihe hakiri gutegurwa uburyo burambye bwo kubatuza. Umujyi wa Kigali uvuga ko watangiye gahunda izamara ibyumweru bibiri, ikorwa n’itsinda rigizwe na polisi n’abakozi b’Umujyi wa Kigali, bari kuzenguruka bareba abantu batuye ahantu hateje ikibazo (ahegereye ruhura, imikingo n’ibishanga), bose basabwa gushaka uburyo bimuka hakiri kare kuko ngo ubutaka bwanyweye amazi menshi, bukaba butagifite ubushobozi bwo kwirengera ibikorwaremezo byose biburiho. Hari inyigo iri gukorwa n’Umujyi wa Kigali ijyanye no gutunganya no gufata amazi akoreshwa mu ngo ndetse n’ay’imvura, inyigo igomba kumara igihe kitarenze umwaka. Umujyi wa Kigali wemera ko hakozwe ikosa ryo gutanga ibyangombwa byo kubaka mu bishanga, ariko ngo ibyo ntibikwiye kuba urwitwazo rw’abinangira bakanga kuva mu bishanga basaba ingurane, mu gihe nyamara ingurane itangwa iyo hari ibikorwa bigamije inyungu rusange bigiye kubakwa ahari hatuye abaturage. Ubusanzwe itegeko riteganya ko abaturage bagomba kubaka cyangwa kugira ikindi gikorwa bashyira hafi y’igishanga hasizwe metero 20 uvuye ku mbago zacyo, gusa ubuyobozi bw’Umujyi wa Kigali buvuga ko ibi bipimo bikwiye kongerwa bikagera kuri metero 30 kuko ubutaka bwagaragaje ko bubitse amazi menshi cyane ashobora kuba intandaro yo kuriduka, bikaba byateza impanuka. Kuva ikibazo cy’imvura nyinshi cyatangira kugaragara mu mpera z’umwaka ushize, mu gihugu hose hamaze kubarurwa abantu 60 bapfuye bazize ibiza, abandi 90 barakomereka, mu gihe inzu zisaga 900 yasenyutse ndetse na hegitari nyinshi z’ubutaka zigatwarwa n’isuri, hatabariwemo ibindi bikorwaremezo bitandukanye byangijwe n’amazi.

title: Minisante yashyizeho amabwiriza mashya ku binjira mu Rwanda mu guhangana na Coronavirus
content: Ayo mabwiriza ya Minisante aje akurikira izindi ngamba zitandukanye zafashwe na Guverinoma zo gukumira icyo cyorezo ku baturage b’imbere mu gihugu zirimo isuku haba ku baturage mu ngo zabo n’ahahurira abantu benshi, guhagarika ibitaramo bihuriramo abantu benshi, guhagarika ingendo zitari ngombwa mu mahanga n’ibindi. Itangazo ryashyizweho umukono na Minisitiri w’ubuzima, Dr Ngamije Daniel kuri iki Cyumweru tariki 8 Werurwe 2020, rivuga ko  abantu bose binjiye mu ku butaka bw’u Rwanda bagomba gusuzumwa COVID-19. Mu gihe hakozwe isuzuma, abantu bose bafite kimwe mu bimenyetso bya COVID 19 baturutse mu bihugu byagaragayemo icyo cyorezo, bazajya bafatwa nk’abakekwaho icyo cyorezo, bahite bajyanwa mu kato  ku bitaro biri hafi kugira ngo hakorwe ibizamini n’amasuzuma yisumbuyeho Mu gihe bigaragaye ko uwari waketsweho COVID-19 ayirwaye koko, azajya ahita yoherezwa mu kigo cyita ku barwayi bagaragaweho COVID-19. Ministeri y’ubuzima itangaza ko mu gihe uwaketsweho COVID 19 ibizamini bigaragaje ko ntayo afite, azajya asabwa kwishyira mu kato no gutanga umwirondoro wose kugira ngo akomeze gukurikiranirwa hafi mu gihe cy’iminsi 14 ibarwa uhereye umunsi yavuye mu gihugu cyagaragayemo COVID 19. Minisante ivuga ko abakozi bayo n’ab’Ikigo gishinzwe Ubuzima (RBC) bafite uburenganzira bwo kugera aho uwo muntu aherereye kugira ngo bakomeze kumukurikirana. Umuntu ukekwaho iyo virusi wasabwe kwishyira mu kato, agomba guhora yambaye akantu kamupfuka amazuru n’umunwa, (mask),  kutegera abo babana no kujya ahamagara ku 114 kugira ngo ahabwe andi mabwiriza. Abantu bose batagaragaza ibimenyetso bya COVID 19 ariko baturutse mu bihugu yagaragayemo, Minisante ivuga ko bazajya bafatwa nk’abafite ibyago byinshi. Imyirondoro yabo izajya ibikwa kugira ngo bakomeze gukurikiranwa mu gihe cy’iminsi 14 uhereye igihe  baviriye mu gihugu kirimo icyo cyorezo. Minisiteri y’Ubuzima igaragaza ko nubwo umuntu utagaragaza ibimenyetso adashyirirwaho akato kihariye, agomba gufata ingamba zikomeye zo kwirinda  kandi akihutira kumenyesha inzego z’ubuzima zimwegereye igihe hari ibimenyetso bidasanzwe yibonyeho mu gihe cy’iminsi 14 uhereye igihe yaviriye mu gihugu cyabonetsemo icyorezo. Mu Rwanda nta muntu urwaye  coronavirus urahagaragara, gusa Guverinoma yiyemeje gufata ingamba zikomeye zigamije kuyikumira no kuyihashya igihe haba hari ubonetse. Kugeza ubu ahantu hose hahurira abantu benshi hatanzwe amabwiriza yo gushyiraho aho abantu bakarabira mbere yo kwinjira cyangwa hakaboneka  imiti yica udukoko (alcohol) babanza gukaraba. Imibare igaragaza ko kugeza kuri uyu wa Mbere, abantu basaga ibihumbi 108 bamaze kugaragaraho coronavirus, abasaga 3800 imaze kubahitana. Icyakora, mu bihugu nk’u Bushinwa aho icyorezo cyagaragaye bwa mbere imibare y’abantu bashya bandura ikomeje kugabanyuka. Kuri iki Cyumweru, Komisiyo ishinzwe ubuzima mu Bushinwa yatangaje ko abantu bashya banduye ari 40, barimo 36 banduye mu ntara ya Wuhan ari naho icyorezo cyaturutse. Ibimenyetso by’indwara ya Coronavirus birimo kugira umuriro, gukorora no guhumeka nabi ndetse ishobora no kugera aho itera umusonga no kubuza impyiko gukora bishobora gutera urupfu. Zimwe mu ngamba abantu bakwiye kwimakaza mu kuyirinda harimo gukaraba intoki n’amazi meza n’isabune, gukoresha ihiniro ry’ukuboko igihe umuntu bikekwa ko ayirwaye akorora cyangwa ahumeka, guteka inyama n’amagi bigashya neza. Hari kandi kwifashisha imiti yabugenewe yo gukaraba yica udukoko, kwirinda gukorakora amazuru, amaso n’umunwa igihe umuntu atakarabye, kwirinda kwegera umuntu ufite ibyago byo kuyandura hamwe no kuguma mu rugo igihe ufite ibimenyetso byayo. Izindi nkuru wasoma: U Rwanda rwashyize abaganga bahoraho ku kibuga cy’indege mu gukumira Coronavirus ikomeje guhitana abantu Guverinoma yasabye Abanyarwanda guhagarika guhana ibiganza no guhoberana mu kwirinda Coronavirus Ibitaramo bya Misigaro, Kayirebwa n’ibindi bikorwa bihuza abantu benshi byahagaritswe mu kwirinda Coronavirus Kiliziya Gatolika mu Rwanda yahagaritse “guhana amahoro ya Kirisitu n’ibiganza mu misa”

title: Abamotari bashobora gusabwa kugendana Alcohol bahanaguza muri Casque mu gukumira Coronavirus mu Rwanda
content: Coronavirus yatangiriye mu Bushinwa mu mpera z’umwaka ushize, abantu barenga ibihumbi 100 bamaze kuyandura mu bihugu birenga 80 mu gihe abarenga 3500 ari bo imaze guhitana. Nubwo iyi virus itaragaragara mu Rwanda, rukomeje gufata ingamba zikomeye mu guhashya iki cyorezo, aho rusaba buri muturarwanda kubahiriza amabwiriza agamije kwirinda ko cyagera mu gihugu. Mu kiganiro cyatambutse kuri RBA kivuga ku cyorezo cya Coronavirus gikomeje guhitana abatuye Isi no gukwirakwira ku muvuduko udasanzwe n’ingamba zo kugikumira, hagarutswe ku buryo abamotari bashobora kwifashisha mu gukumira iki cyorezo. Umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe ubugenzuzi bw’inzego z’ibanze muri Minisiteri y’Ubutegetsi bw’igihugu, Semwaga Angello, yavuze ko ahantu henshi hahurira abantu yaba kuri hotel, ku maguriro, utubari n’ahandi hashyizwe ibikoresho abantu bifashisha bakaraba intoki ariko ikibazo gisigaye ku binyabiziga bitwara abagenzi nk’imodoka rusange na moto. Uyu muyobozi yavuze ko ku modoka rusange hari abatanze igitekerezo ko hashyirwa umuti wo gukaraba intoki bigakunda ariko kuri moto bikiri ikibazo. Ati “Hari nk’ikintu batubwiye gisaba kugira ngo twese tugiterekerezeho. Twumvaga muri bisi hari uburyo abantu babikora ariko kuri moto na casque bakatubwira bati umumotari atwaye umuntu, akuyemo casque undi araje arayimuhaye. Nabyo tugomba gutekereza uko tugomba kubigenza.” Ni imbogamizi ikomeye kuko iyi virusi bivugwa ko umuntu ashobora kuyanduza mugenzi we uri muri metero imwe binyuze mu matembabuzi kandi casque imwe ikaba yambarwa n’abagenzi benshi ku munsi umwe. Umuyobozi mukuru w’ikigo cy’Ubuzima, RBC, Dr Nsanzimana Sabin, yavuze ko ikibazo cy’abamotari koko giteye inkeke kandi by’umwihariko abanyamahanga bari mu batega moto cyane. Ati “Icyo kintu gihise kintera impungenge cyane ahubwo ntidukwiye no gutinda [Kugishakira igisubizo] ariko hari umuti woroshye.” “Nigeze kuvuga ngo kwica iyi virusi biroroshye kuko ushyiraho isabune isanzwe, Alcohol iyi badusiga twiyogoshyesha ipfa kuba ifite dogere nibura 70 [z’ubukana]..Ni ukureba ukuntu abamotari, bafite iyo Alcohol, gufata agatambaro bagacisha muri casque mbere yo kuyiha umugenzi ni ibintu byoroshye.” Dr Nsanzimana yavuze ko ibi bitaba igisubizo mu kwica no gukumira virusi ya Coronavirus gusa ahubwo byanakumira n’utundi dukoko dutera izindi ndwara nk’igituntu n’izindi. Mu Rwanda kandi hashyizweho itsinda rigamije gukurikirana ingamba zo kurwanya no gukumira icyorezo cya Coronavirus mu gihugu hose, aho riyobowe na Serivisi za Minisitiri w’Intebe zifatanyije na Minisiteri y’Ubuzima, Minisiteri y’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu n’Inzego z’umutekano. Iyi ndwara yandura mu buryo bwihuse, cyane cyane aho abantu benshi bateraniye binyuze mu matembabuzi aturuka mu guhumeka, gukoranaho no kwitsamura. Ishobora no kwandura binyuze mu gukora ku muntu uyirwaye, cyane cyane mu kuramukanya abantu bahana ibiganza. Ibaruwa Minisitiri w’Intebe Dr Edourd Ngirente yasohoye ku wa 6 Werurwe 2020 isaba abanyarwanda ‘kwirinda kuramukanya abantu bahana ibiganza cyangwa bahoberana, kugabanya ingendo zitari ngombwa mu bihugu byagaragayemo icyo cyorezo’. Hari kandi kwirinda gukorora cyangwa kwitsamura iruhande rw’abandi, gukaraba intoki hakoreshejwe amazi asukuye cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo gusukura intoki, kwirinda kwegera abandi igihe cyose warwaye ibicurane, inkorora cyangwa ufite umuriro mwinshi. Abanyarwanda kandi barasabwa kwitabaza inzego z’ubuzima zibegereye igihe bafite kimwe mu bimenyetso birimo ibicurane, umuriro, umunaniro n’inkorora ijyana no kubabara mu mihogo. [email protected]

title: Abaturage batangiye gushyira mu bikorwa ingamba zo guhashya Coronavirus mu mujyi wa Kigali (Video)
content: Izi ngamba zirimo ibikorwa by’isuku nko gukaraba intoki n’ubukangurambaga bugamije gusobanurira abaturage ububi bwa Coronavirus. Abantu basaga ibihumbi 90 bamaze kwandura coronavirus ku Isi mu gihe abasaga ibihumbi bitatu yabahitanye. Mu gihe Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ikomeje gusaba abaturage kuba maso bubahiriza ingamba zashyizweho mu kwirinda icyo cyorezo, IGIHE yatembereye mu bice bitandukanye mu mujyi wa Kigali, ireba ahashyizwe ibikoresho by’isuku mu guhangana n’iyo ndwara. Mu hatangiye gushyirwa ibyo bikoresho by’isuku byihariye  ni ahahurira abantu benshi nko ku mashuri, ibitaro, amasoko n’ahandi. Abaturage baganiriye na IGIHE, bagaragaje  ko bishimiye izi ngamba cyane ko babwiwe ko Coronavirus iterwa ahanini n’umwanda. Nyirandagijimana Marie Claire ufite umurwayi ku Bitaro byo ku Muhima yagize ati “ Ibi bintu byo gusanga Kandagira Ukarabe hano cyangwa se umuti wica udusimba duto, twabyishimiye cyane kuko biradufasha kwirinda kwanduza abandi no kuba natwe twakwanduzwa kuko batubwiye ko coronavirus ahanini ituruka ku mwanda.” Umunyeshuri wo muri GS. EPA mu Karere ka Nyarugenge, Mbarushimana Asouma, yavuze  ko kuba barabazaniye Kandagira Ukarabe ari bimwe mu bizabafasha kwirinda icyo cyorezo Ati “Kandagira Ukarabe ziri kudufasha kuko turi kuza buri wese akabanza gukaraba intoki kugira ngo umwanda umuveho mu rwego rwo kwirinda Coronavirus. Batubwiye ko yandurira mu guhumeka no mu gusuhuzanya kandi iterwa n’umwanda ku buryo natwe ubu tutari gusuhuzanya duhana intoki”. Umuyobozi  w’ivuriro Polyclinique de l’Etoile, Dr Birahira William, yatangaje ko bamaze gutegura ibyumba  byakwifashishwa igihe haba habonetse umuntu wanduye Coronavirus abagannye. Yavuze ko n’abaganga babo biteguye kwakira no kwita ku muntu waba agaragaweho coronavirus. Ati “ Twabanje duhugura abakozi bacu ku bijyanye na Coronavirus, tunashyiraho amatangazo y’uko yandura basoma buri munsi. Hari na Kandagira Ukarabe abantu batugannye bifashisha bari gukaraba.” Coronavirus ikomeje gusatira ibihugu birimo n’ibyo ku mugabane wa Afurika kuko abantu 27 bamaze kugaragara bayirwaye. Ikomeje no gusatira ibihugu byo muri Afurika yo munsi y’Ubutayu bwa Sahara u Rwanda rubarizwamo nyuma yo kugaragara muri Nigeria, Afurika y’Epfo na Sénégal.

title: Guverinoma yasabye Abanyarwanda guhagarika guhana ibiganza no guhoberana mu kwirinda Coronavirus
content: Icyorezo cya coronavirus cyadutse mu Bushinwa mu mpera za 2019 ubu kimaze kugera mu bihugu birenga 60 aho kimaze kwica abasaga 3000. Ibaruwa Minisitiri w’Intebe w’u Rwanda Dr Edouard Ngirente yashyizeho umukono kuri uyu wa 6 Werurwe 2020,  ivuga ko mu rwego rwo kwirinda no gukumira icyorezo cya coronavirus gikomeje gukwirakwira mu bihugu bitandukanye ku Isi,  Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yafashe ingamba zitandukanye. Muri izo harimo Camera zirimo kwifashishwa ku kibuga cy’indege cya Kigali i Kanombe mu gutahura uketsweho iki cyorezo. Kuri iki kibuga abagenzi bahanyura binjira mu Rwanda bakirwa n’abaganga bambaye mu buryo bubarinda kuba hagira ubanduza, hanyuma bagahita babaza buri wese aho aturutse. Nyuma yo kwandika igihugu buri wese aturutsemo amakuru ahita ajya muri mudasobwa, umugenzi akerekwa umuti akaraba wo kumurinda ko yakwandura cyangwa akanduza Coronavirus. Minisitiri w’Intebe yavuze ko hari itsinda  ryashyizeho rishinzwe gusesengura no gukurikirana uko igihugu cyiteguye gukumira no guhangana n’icyo cyorezo. Muri iyo baruwa, yavuze ko hashingiwe ku isesengura ryagaragajwe n’iryo tsinda, Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yamenyesheje ko ‘Kugeza uyu munsi nta cyorezo cya coronavirusi kiragaragara mu Rwanda’ kandi ko rwashyizeho ingamba zitandukanye zo kuyikumira no kuyirwanya. Iryo tangazo rikomeza rigira riti “Icyakora dukurikije ubukana bw’iki cyorezo n’uburyo gikomeje guhitana umubare munini w’abantu ku Isi, turasaba abanyarwanda kutirara no gukurikiza inama zo kwirinda icyo cyorezo zitangwa n’inzego zitandukanye.” Minisitiri w’Intebe  yakomeje yibutsa abanyarwanda ko iyi ndwara yandura mu buryo bwihuse, cyane cyane aho abantu benshi bateraniye binyuze mu matembabuzi aturuka mu guhumeka, gukoranaho no kwitsamura. Iyi ndwara ishobora no kwandura binyuze mu gukora ku muntu uyirwaye, cyane cyane mu kuramukanya abantu bahana ibiganza. Iyi baruwa ya Minisitiri w’Intebe ikomeza isaba abanyarwanda ‘kwirinda kuramukanya abantu bahana ibiganza cyangwa bahoberana, kugabanya ingendo zitari ngombwa mu bihugu byagaragayemo icyo cyorezo’. Hari kandi kwirinda gukorora cyangwa kwitsamura iruhande rw’abandi, gukaraba intoki hakoreshejwe amazi asukuye cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo gusukura intoki, kwirinda kwegera abandi igihe cyose warwaye ibicurane, inkorora cyangwa ufite umuriro mwinshi. Abanyarwanda kandi barasabwa kwitabaza inzego z’ubuzima zibegereye igihe bafite kimwe mu bimenyetso birimo ibicurane, umuriro, umunaniro n’inkorora ijyana no kubabara mu mihogo. Kugeza ubu hirya no hino mu gihugu ahahurira abantu benshi, hamwe na hamwe hamaze gushyirwa ibikoresho bitandukanye birimo amazi meza n’isabune byifashishwa mu gukaraba intoki. U Rwanda kandi rwamaze guteganya ahantu hane hashyirwa uwaketsweho iyo virusi kugira ngo yitabweho kandi ahamare igihe cyateganyijwe. Ahamaze gutegurwa ni ku bitaro bikuru bya Kanombe hateganyijwe ibyumba 25 bishobora kwifashishwa, ibitaro bya Kabgayi byateguye ibyumba 120 n’ikigo nderabuzima cya Kanyinya cyateganyije ibyumba 50. Ibindi bitaro byo mu gihugu bigera kuri 80 byose byagiye biteganya ibyumba bibiri. Mu gutegura abakwita ku murwayi igihe yagaragara, Minisiteri y’Ubuzima itangaza ko imaze guhugura abaganga 430.

title: Camera zirimo kwifashishwa ku kibuga cy’indege cya Kigali mu gutahura uketsweho Coronavirus
content: Ku kibuga mpuzamahanga cya Kigali abagenzi bahanyura binjira mu Rwanda bakirwa n’abaganga bambaye mu buryo bubarinda kuba hagira ubanduza, hanyuma bagahita babaza buri wese aho aturutse. Nyuma yo kwandika igihugu buri wese aturutsemo amakuru ahita ajya muri mudasobwa, umugenzi akerekwa umuti akaraba wo kumurinda ko yakwandura cyangwa akanduza Coronavirus. Uko binjira kandi ni ko camera ebyiri; imwe iburyo indi ibumoso zibafata igipimo cy’umuriro byagaragara hari ufite umuriro mwinshi abaforomo bakamushyira ku ruhande kugira ngo asuzumwe birenze. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ishami rigenzura rikanarwanya indwara z’ibyorezo mu kigo gishinzwe ubuzima (RBC), Dr Jose Nyamusore, avuga ko izi camera zoroheje akazi kajyanye no gupima umuriro, kimwe mu bimenyetso biranga ibyorezo birimo na Coronavirus. Ati “Camera iyo winjiye zifite ikoranabuhanga ryazo ‘sensor’, ziragufata zikamenya umuriro ufite zigahita zandika hariya kuri televiziyo, ukamenya ko kanaka yinjiye afite umuriro ungana gutya”. Akomeza agira ati “Ufite umuriro dukeka uri hejuru ya 38 uwonguwo avamo, dufite ukuntu bagukuramo bakagushyira ku ruhande hariya hari icyumba, bakakubarizamo ibibazo cyangwa uje bagasanga ufite uwo muriro cyangwa bimwe muri bya bimenyetso bya Coronavirus, ufite n’urugendo wagiriye mu gihugu kirangwamo Coronavirus bagushyira ku ruhande bakavuga ko ari umuntu twaketse ariko gukeka no kurwara biratandukanye cyane”. Dr Nyamusore avuga ko uwo waketswe atwarwa kwa muganga agafatwa ikizamini agategereza ikizamini, aho ntawurayigaragaraho mu bapimwe bose. Abagenzi bishimira iyi gahunda bakavuga ko ari uburyo bwiza bwo kugenzura ibimenyetso bya Coronavirus, bakavuga ko uyu muco wiganywe ku isi yose hagabanywa ikigero cy’ikwirakwizwa ry’iki cyorezo. Kugeza ubungubu nta muntu twari twabona ufite Coronavirus mu Rwanda. Si ubwa mbere mu Rwanda hakoreshwa ubu buryo bwa Camera mu kwirinda ibyorezo kuko zanifashishijwe mu 2014 ubwo rwatangiraga gukumira ko Ebola yinjira mu gihugu. Hirya no hino mu gihugu kandi ahahurira abantu benshi, hamwe na hamwe hamaze gushyirwa ibikoresho bitandukanye birimo amazi meza n’isabune byifashishwa mu gukaraba intoki. U Rwanda kandi rwamaze guteganya ahantu hane hashyirwa uwaketsweho iyo virusi kugira ngo yitabweho kandi ahamare igihe cyateganyijwe. Ahamaze gutegurwa ni ku bitaro bikuru bya Kanombe hateganyijwe ibyumba 25 bishobora kwifashishwa, ibitaro bya Kabgayi byateguye ibyumba 120 n’ikigo nderabuzima cya Kanyinya cyateganyije ibyumba 50 ndetse imirimo yo kubitegura irakomeje. Ibindi bitaro byo mu gihugu bigera kuri 80 byose byagiye biteganya ibyumba bibiri. Mu gutegura abakwita ku murwayi igihe yagaragara, Minisiteri y’Ubuzima itangaza ko imaze guhugura abaganga 430.

title: U Rwanda rwiteguye gute gufasha uwagaragaraho Coronavirus?
content: Hirya no hino mu gihugu ahahurira abantu benshi, hamwe na hamwe hamaze gushyirwa ibikoresho bitandukanye birimo amazi meza n’isabune byifashishwa mu gukaraba intoki mu rwego rwo kwirinda indwara ziterwa n’isuku nke harimo n’icyorezo gishya cya Coronavirus kiri kuyogoza ibihugu bitandukanye muri iyi minsi kuva mu mpera za 2019. Minsiteri y’ubuzima itangaza ko nubwo intambwe ya mbere mu kwirinda coronavirus ari ugukaraba intoki hakoreshejwe amazi meza n’isabune, hari ibindi abantu bagomba kwitwararika birimo; gusuhuzanya bakoresheje ibiganza, guhoberana no gusomana. Mu rwego rwo kwitegura, Minisiteri y’ubuzima itangaza ko yamaze guteganya ahantu hane hashyirwa uwaketsweho iyo virusi kugira ngo yitabweho kandi ahamare igihe cyateganyijwe. Ahamaze gutegurwa ni ku bitaro bikuru bya Kanombe hateganyijwe ibyumba 25 bishobora kwifashishwa, ibitaro bya Kabgayi byateguye ibyumba 120 n’ikigo nderabuzima cya Kanyinya cyateganyije ibyumba 50 ndetse imirimo yo kubitegura irakomeje. Ibindi bitaro byo mu gihugu bigera kuri 80 byose byagiye biteganya ibyumba bibiri. Mu gutegura abakwita ku murwayi igihe yagaragara, Minisiteri y’Ubuzima itangaza ko imaze guhugura abaganga 430. Umuyobozi mukuru w’Ibitaro bya Kibagabaga, Dr. Mutaganzwa Avite, avuga ko mu gihe coronavirus itaragaragara mu Rwanda, hari ingamba zidasaba ubushobozi buhambaye, abaturage basabwa kwifashisha. Ati “Ni ingamba zikomatanyije harimo guhugura abaturage tugatanga ubutumwa butandukanye, tubamenyesha iyo ndwara ko ihari n’uburyo bwo kuyirinda hakabaho n’uburyo bwo gushyiraho ibikoresho cyane cyane nka hano ku ivuriro, gukaraba intoki abantu baje kwivuza.” Dr. Muvunyi Zuber ushinzwe ubuvuzi rusange muri Minisiteri y’ubuzima, avuga ko amabwiriza ya Minisiteri y’ubuzima avuga ko ahantu hahurira abantu benshi hagomba kuba uburyo bwo gukaraba intoki bagasaba abayobozi gufasha abantu bose kubyubahiriza Ati “Amabwiriza yaratanzwe, ahantu hose hahurira abantu benshi haba ari ahahurira abagiye mu myidagaduro, abajya gufata amafunguro cyangwa ibinyobwa, noneho no ku nyubako zose za leta, amavuriro yose ni ukuvuga ngo bagomba gushyiraho uburyo bwo gukaraba intoki.” Aho hantu hagomba kugaragara n’imiti yica udukoko abantu bakaraba mu ntoki nk’abisiga amavuta (Hand sanitizer). Leta y’u Rwanda itangaza ko izakomeza gushyira imbaraga mu bijyanye n’ubwirinzi. Coronavirus yandura iyo umuntu yitsamuye cyangwa akoroye yegereye undi; iyo umuntu afite ibiganza byandujwe, gukora cyangwa gusuhuza muntu wayanduye no gukora ku kintu cyangwa ahantu hari iyo virusi. Minisiteri y’Ubuzima mu Rwanda yemeza ko nta Coronavirus irahagaragara ariko igashishikariza abantu bose kuyirinda binyuze mu ngamba zitandukanye zose zikubiye mu kugira isuku. Ingamba ya mbere; ‘karaba intoki buri gihe ukoresheje amazi meza n’isabune cyangwa alukoro yagenewe gukaraba intoki’. Igihe ukoroye cyangwa witsamuye pfuka ku munwa no ku mazuru ukoresheje agatambaro gasukuye uhite ukajugunya ahagenewe guta imyanda hanyuma uhite ukaraba intoki n’amazi meza n’isabune. Irinde gukora ku muntu uwo ari we wese ufite inkorora n’umuriro cyangwa kwegera abantu iyo warwaye kimwe muri ibyo. Ihutire ku ivuriro rigwereye igihe cyose ufite umuriro, inkorora cyangwa udahumeka neza. Irinde gukora urugendo niba ufite umuriro n’inkorora. Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB), giherutse gutegeka abatanga serivisi zo gucumbikira abantu, restaurants, utubari, utubyiniro, abatembereza ba mukerarugendo, ababayobora n’abategura ibikorwa bitandukanye, gushyiraho ahantu ho gukarabira intoki na alcohol yagenewe gusukura intoki. Ibi byashyizwe ku nyubako zose ndetse no mu modoka z’abakerarugendo cyangwa abashyitsi kugira ngo habungabungwe ubuzima n’umudendezo w’abashyitsi n’abakozi. Ibimenyetso by’indwara ya Coronavirus birimo kugira umuriro, gukorora no guhumeka nabi ndetse ishobora no kugera aho itera umusonga no kubuza impyiko gukora bishobora gutera urupfu. Coronavirus yatangiriye mu mujyi wa Wuhan wo mu Ntara ya Hubei mu Bushinwa mu mpera za 2019. Abagera ku bihumbi 90 bamaze kwandura coronavirus naho abarenga 3 000 yarabahitanye.

title: Turyoherwe n’ibigirira umubiri akamaro: Uburyo ukwiye gufata ifunguro ritagushyira mu kaga
content:
Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku buzima (OMS) rigaragaza ko mu 2018 abantu miliyari 1.9 bari bafite umubyibuho ukabije naho miliyoni 462 bafite ibiro bidahagije. Abana bari munsi y’imyaka itanu barenga miliyoni 155 bari baragwingiye naho miliyoni 41 bafite umubyibuho ukabije naho 48% by’impfu z’abari munsi y’imyaka itatu zari zifitanye isano no kutabona ifunguro rihagije. Inzobere mu by’imirire zigaragaraza ko imirire myiza no kuboneza imirire ari igihe umuntu abasha gufata amafunguro akungahaye ibyubaka umubiri, ibitera imbaraga n’ibirinda indwara kandi bitarimo ibyanduza bishobora gutera indwara, bikagendana n’imirimo akora, imyaka afite n’ibindi bijyanye n’ingano y’intungamubiri umubiri we ukenera. Zimwe mu ngero z’ibitera imbaraga harimo ibinyamafufu nk’ibijumba, imyumbati, umuceri, ibigori, amasaka ingano. Hari n’ibindi bifatwa nk’ibitera imbaraga ku kigero cyo hejuru nk’amavuta. Abahanga mu by’imirire bavuga ko garama imwe y’amavuta iha umubiri kilocalorie icyenda mu gihe garama imwe y’ibinyamafufu itanga kilocalorie enye. Mu byubaka umubiri harimo ibikomoka ku nyamaswa nk’inyama, amata, amagi n’amafi n’ibikomoka ku bimera nk’ibishyimbo, amashaza, soya, ifu ya moringa mu gihe ibirinda indwara harimo imboga n’imbuto. Mu kiganiro IGIHE yagiranye n’inzobere mu buvuzi Mbonezamire, Mukakayumba Anastasie, wanashinze ivuriro mbonezamirire ryitwa La Pervenche, yasobanuye ko kugira ngo umuntu yizere ko agiye kurya indyo nziza, ameza ye agomba kuba ateguyeho ibitera imbaraga, ibyubaka umubiri n’ibirinda indwara. Urugero nk’ibiribwa bikunze kuboneka bitaruhije umuntu, yategura ku meza ye akaba yizeye ko ariye neza ni ibijumba, ibishyimbo, imboga, igi, indagara.
Ati “Uyu muntu igaburo rye riba ryuzuye ariko twibuke ko rigomba kuba rifite isuku, ridafite udukoko [microbes] dushoboraa gutera indwara. Ikindi kandi riba ryitaye kuri uwo muntu mu bihe bidasanzwe, ku mirimo akora kandi rihagije.” Uko ifunguro rigomba kuba rigabanyije Mukakayumba avuga ko ubusanzwe abantu bategura amafunguro, ugasanga isahani bari kuriraho imeze nk’ikasemo ibice bitatu, ibitera imbaraga byihariye 50%, ibirinda indwara 25% n’ibyubaka umubiri na byo 25%. Ati “Muri rusange ni uko abantu barya ariko ntabwo ibitera imbaraga ari byo byagombye kuba bifite umwanya munini ku isahani yacu ahubwo ibirinda indwara ariho harimo imboga, byagombye kuba byihariye 50% by’isahani yacu, 25% ikajyaho ibyubaka umubiri naho ibitera imbaraga bigafata akandi 25%.” Kurya ibitera imbaraga byinshi kuruta ibirinda indwara n’ibyubaka umubiri bituma umuntu yinjiza imbaraga ziruta izo ari buze gukoresha. Ati “Aho niho hashobora kuvamo ko umuntu yagira ibilo birengeje ibyo akwiriye kugira.” Aya mafunguro ateguye gutya ni nayo yakabaye ategurwa n’abifite, bakagerekaho imbuto nibura igihe bashonje. Urugero wenda niba umuntu yafashe icyayi n’umugati mu gitondo, hagati ya saa yine na saa tanu z’amanywa niwo mwanya mwiza wo kuriraho imbuto kugira ngo igihe cyo gufata ifunguro rya saa sita, umubiri ube wamaze kuzikorera igogora. Amasaha yo kuriraho Umuntu kandi amafunguro afata kugira ngo amugirire akamaro aba agomba no kugira amasaha ayafatiraho, atari ukurya igihe cyose abiboneye. Mukakayumba ati “Ushobora gufata gahunda yo kurya ifunguro ryuzuye mu gitondo. Akenshi icyo gihe tuba tugiye mu kazi, gukoresha imbaraga z’umubiri ariko biratangaje ko ari ho akenshi usanga turya indyo ituzuye.” Inshuro nyinshi usanga umubare munini w’abantu bava mu rugo mu gitondo nta funguro bafashe n’abagerageje ugasanga ni icyayi cya mukaru, icy’amata cyangwa igikombe cy’igikoma n’irindazi cyangwa umugati bakajya mu kazi, bikaba ari byo biririrwa, ibyo bari gufata saa sita bakabifata nijoro. Ati “Aho naho ntabwo umuntu aba ari kurya uko bikwiye. Mu gitondo nibura twagombye kurya igaburo ryuzuye, hanyuma saa sita nabwo tukongera kurya igaburo ryuzuye, nijoro tukarya igaburo ryoroheje ritagombereye kuba ririho biriya byose kuko umuntu aba agiye kuruhuka, igifu nacyo kiba gikeneye gukora imirimo micye ishoboka kugira ngo nacyo gishobore kuruhuka n’ubwonko bwacu buruhuke.” Iyo bidakozwe uko ngo bigira ingaruka zitandukanye zirimo kunaniza ubwonko n’igifu bikaba byakongerera umuntu ibyago byo kugira ibiro by’umurengera. Imiterere y’ifunguro rya nijoro Muri rusange ifunguro rya nijoro ntirigomba kubamo ibiribwa birushya igogora nk’ifiriti cyangwa inyama, ibirimo amavuta menshi. Hari kandi na salade, mayonnaise bikungahaye intungamubiri zikangura ubwonko kuko igihe umuntu agiye kuryama nabwo buba bukeneye kuruhuka. Mukakayumba avuga ko iki gihe umuntu aba akwiye kwibanda ku mafunguro afite ibara ry’icyatsi kibisi cyangwa ryijimye nka potaje y’imboga rwatsi nka dodo, Sereri, ibirayi na karoti byorohera igogora. Imiterere y’ifunguro rya saa sita Iri ni ifunguro rigomba kuba rikungahaye ibyubaka umubiri, ibirinda indwara n’ibitera imbaraga. Mukakayumba ati “Dushobora kurya ibishyimbo n’igi ritogosheje, ahandi tugashyiraho umuceri, inyama. Iri gahuburo riba ryuzuye, kandi twibuke ko umuntu umaze kurya aza gukenera kunywa amazi nibura nyuma y’iminota 30 amaze kurya cyangwa mbere y’iminota 30 kugira ngo igogora rize kugenda neza.” Imiterere y’ifunguro rya mugitondo Iri funguro ntirihabanye cyane n’irya saa sita kuko rigomba kuba rikungahaye ibitera imbaraga, ibyubaka umubiri n’ibiwurinda indwara. Ati “Mu gitondo umuntu ashobora kurya ibirayi, ifi n’imboga. Hari abantu benshi bakunda kurya ubugari mu gitondo, bakabukoza isosi y’inyama cyangwa ifi, ubunyobwa cyangwa soya n’imboga, iryo naryo ni igaburo rya mugitondo.” Ibi Mukakayumba abigereranya n’uko mbere y’uko umushoferi ajya gutwara ikinyabiziga agomba kuba yizeye ko gifite lisansi igifasha kugenda. Ibimenyetso bigaragarira amaso ku wariye nabi Inzobere mu by’imirire zivuga ko umuntu urya nabi ari igihe arya amafunguro atamuha ibyo umubiri ukenera byose [ibyubaka umubiri, ibitera imbaraga n’ibirinda indwara] kimwe n’ufata arimo byose ariko adahagije. Ku wariye ibikungahaye ibyo umubiri ukeneye ariko bidahagije usanga afite ibiro bicye ugereranyije n’igihagararo cyangwa uburebure bwe. Ku bana bato, iyo bariye igaburo ritujuje intungamubiri bituma bashobora kurwara indwara z’imirire mibi nka bwaki, bagacurama imisatsi, bakabyimba ibikonjo n’ibirenge, bagahorana agahinda mu maso n’ibindi. Hari n’ubwo usanga umwana ahagararanye n’abandi bari mu kigero kimwe ukabona ntibangana, atari uko wenda abo akomokaho bakunda kuba bagufi. Umuntu wariye akarenza urugero rw’ibikenewe nawe abarwa mu bariye nabi, bikagaragarira mu bilo afite, aho usanga ari byinshi ugereranyije n’indeshyo cyangwa imyaka afite. Urugero ni nk’aho usanga umuntu ufite uburebure bwa metero 1.70, ugasanga afite ibiro birenga 100. Ubusanzwe ibipimo ngenderwaho by’umuryango w’Abibumbye mu gusuzuma niba uburebure bw’umuntu bujyanye n’ibiro, ni ugufata ibiro ukagabanya uburebure bwikubye kabiri [Kg/(cm)²]. Ibi kugira ngo ubusobanukirwe neza, bisaba ko wegera inzobere mu by’ubuvuzi mbonezamirire kugira ngo bagusobanurire, bakugira n’inama bitewe b’uko bagusanze. Imirire mibi kandi yongera ibyago byo kurwara indwara karande nka Kanseri, Diabetes, indwara z’umutima, umubyibuho ukabije n’izindi. Kurya neza ni ukurya inyama n’ifiriti? Mukakayumba asobanuro ko abantu benshi bibeshya ko kurya neza ari ukurya igaburo rihoraho inyama n’amafiriti n’ibindi bikungahaye amavuta nyamara atariko biri kuko nk’ifiriti itegurwa hifashishijwe amavuta usanga ubutabire bwayo bwangiritse itetswe. Ati “Ni amavuta ananiza umwijima n’igifu ku buryo ari ibiryo abantu bakwiye kumva ko atari byiza..Kuvuga ko umuntu ukize, ufite ubushobozi yariye neza ari igihe yashyize ifiriti ku isahani, inyama zikaranze, umureti, igikombe cy’amata, amakaroni, hari umuceri kandi ibyo bintu byose araza kubiryaho, mu buryo bumwe cyangwa ubundi, ntabwo ari byo nta no gucunga umutungo kurimo.” Mukakayumba avuga ko abantu bakwiye gushyira imbaraga mu gushaka amakuru y’uburyo barya neza kandi bakayashakira ku bantu babifiteho ubumenyi. Avuga kandi ko mu mashuri hakwiye kongerwa uburyo bwo gusobanura ibijyanye n’imirire kugira ngo abana bakure babifiteho ubumenyi. Igenzura  ryakozwe ku rwego rw’ubuzima bw’abaturage mu Rwanda (DHS) riheruka gushyirwa ahabona mu 2015 ryagaragaje ko ku rwego rw’igihugu abana bari munsi y’imyaka itanu bagwingiye bitewe n’ingaruka z’imirire mibi bari 38% . Intara y’uburengerazuba ifite ijanisha riri hejuru ringana na 45%, Amajyepfo 41%, Amajyaruguru 39% Uburasirazuba 39% naho Umujyi wa Kigali 23%. Iryo barura kandi ryagaragaje ko abantu 7.7% mu gihugu hose bafite umubyibuho ukabije aho umujyi wa Kigali uza imbere na 9.9%, ugakurikirwa n’Intara y’Amajyaruguru ifite 9.7%. ku rwego rw’Igihugu kandi abana bangana na 9% bafite ibiro bidahwanye n’imyaka bafite. title: Nyanza: Abarwara Malaria bavuye ku bihumbi 180 bagera ku bihumbi 50
content: Byatangajwe n’Ubuyobozi bw’Ibitaro by’Akarere ka Nyanza kuri uyu wa Mbere, tariki ya 2 Werurwe 2020, ubwo hatangizwaga ku mugaragaro igikorwa cyo gutera umuti wica imibu itera Malaria mu nzu z’abaturage. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ibitaro bya Nyanza, Dr Tuyishime Emille, yavuze ko ubukangurambaga bwakozwe mu baturage ku kwirinda Malaria no kuyivuza hakiri kare ku bayirwaye bwatanze umusaruro mwiza. Ati “Mu 2015 mu mavuriro twakiraga abantu barenga ibihumbi 180  barwaye Malaria ariko mu 2019 twakiriye abatarenga ibihumbi 50 mu karere kose.’’ Yakomeje avuga ko mu 2019 mu Karere ka Nyanza nta muntu wishwe na malaria ariko bihe byashize  hari ubwo hapfaga abagera kuri 44 mu mwaka umwe. Dr Tuyishime yagaragaje ko ibyatumye Malaria ihashywa birimo serivisi zo kuyivura zitangwa n’abajyanama b’ubuzima mu buryo bwihuse kandi bukorerwa hafi y’abaturage mu ngo; abaturage bivuza kare ntibanduze abandi; gutera imiti yica imibu mu nzu z’abaturage; kuvanaho ibinogo n’ibidendezi imibu ishobora kororokeramo; kuryama mu nzitiramibu iteye umuti n’ibindi. Bamwe mu baturage bo mu Karere ka Nyanza babwiye IGIHE ko bamaze imyaka irenga itatu batarwara Malaria kandi mbere hari n’abayirwaga buri kwezi. Ntihinyuzwa ati “Kuva natangira kurara mu nzitiramibu bakaduterera n’imiti mu nzu nta Malaria mperuka kurwara; hashize imyaka irenga ibiri. Ubundi buryo nkoresha mu kuyirinda ni ukuvanaho ibihuru byakorora imibu, nkakuraho ibiziba byarekamo amazi.” Nyirakamana Françoise wo mu Murenge wa Kigoma na we avuga ko adaheruka kurwara Malaria bitewe n’ingamba yafashe. Ati “Nubahiriza ingamba zose zo kuyirinda; umwana wanjye ni we uheruka kuyirwara ariko hashize nk’umwaka kandi naketse ko umubu wamuririye hanze kuko aryama mu nzitiramibu kandi inzu yacu bari bayiteyemo umuti. Nahise muvuza ahita akira ntabwo yamuzahaje.” Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Nyanza, Ntazinda Erasme, yavuze ko ingamba zo kurwanya Malaria no kuyikumira zikomeje gushyirwamo ingufu hagamijwe kuyirandura burundu. Yasabye abaturage gukomeza gukurikiza inama bagirwa zigamije kuyihashya. Mu Karere ka Nyanza igikorwa ngarukamwaka cyo gutera umuti wica imibu mu nzu z’abaturage kiri kuba ku nshuro ya kane; kizamara iminsi 20 aho hazaterwa inzu zirenga ibihumbi 80. Ibipimo byo mu 2019 by’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ubuzima, RBC, byerekanye ko Malaria iri mu Rwanda 80% iri mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo n’i Burasirazuba, kandi Nyanza, Gisagara na Huye ari two turere two mu Majyepfo twibasiwe kurusha utundi. title: Udukingirizo dusaga ibihumbi 170 tumaze gutangwa muri Tour du Rwanda 2020
content: Abasaga 70 % by’abafashe utwo dukingirizo ni urubyiruko ruri hagati y’imyaka 18 na 28. Tour du Rwanda 2020 yatangiye ku  Cyumweru tariki ya 23 Gashyantare 2020, ikaba isozwa kuri iki Cyumweru tariki 1 Werurwe 2020. Iri siganwa ryanyuze mu duce nka  Kigali, Rwamagana, Huye, Rusizi, Rubavu, Musanze na Muhanga. Kugeza kuri uyu wa Gatandatu ubwo isiganwa ryari rigeze i Nyamirambo, hagaragazwaga ko udukingirizo dusaga 171 000 tumaze gutangwa, hagamijwe gushishikariza abanyarwanda kwirinda ubwandu bushya bw’agakoko gatera SIDA. Udukingirizo twinshi twagiye dutangirwa aho Tour du Rwanda yagiye inyura ariko by’umwihariko ahabaga harasorezwa isiganwa n’ahabaga hateguwe ibitaramo bitandukanye. Umuyobozi ushinzwe kwirinda no kurwanya icyorezo cya Sida muri AHF Rwanda, Nteziryayo Narcisse, yavuze ko bishimishije kuba barabashije kugeza udukingirizo kuri benshi, mu gukomeza guhashya ubwandu bushya bwa virusi itera SIDA. Yagize ati “Twishimiye kuba twarageze ku bantu bangana gutya, tukabagezaho ubutumwa butandukanye bwo kwirinda SIDA.  Iri siganwa ni rimwe mu marushanwa afite abafana benshi muri Afurika, byatumye tugera kuri benshi kurusha abo twari twiteze. Twageze ku bantu barenga ibihumbi 700 mu turere twose twanyuzemo.” Nteziryayo yavuze ko igishimishije ari uko abanyarwanda batangiye kwikuramo isoni zo gufata udukingirizo, nyuma yo gucengerwa n’ubutumwa bwo kwirinda virusi itera SIDA. Ati “Bamwe bajyaga batinya kuza gufata udukingirizo mu ruhame, ariko kubw’ubukangurambaga dukora abantu bari guhindura imyumvire. Kugeza ubu aho dutangira udukingirizo urahasanga abakobwa bato n’abahungu baza gufata udukingirizo nta mpungenge.” Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe ku bufatanye bwa Guverinoma y’u Rwanda bugashyirwa hanze ku wa 22 Ukwakira 2019 bugaragaza ko umubare w’abandura Virusi itera Sida ku mwaka wagabanutseho 50%, mu gihugu hose abanduye ni 3 %. Ubushakashatsi bwerekanye ko umubare w’abantu bashya bandura Virusi itera Sida mu Rwanda ugenda ugabanuka, by’umwihariko ukaba waravuye kuri 3/1000 (barenga ibihumbi 10) mu 2014 ukagera kuri 1/1000 (barenga 5400) mu 2019. Nubwo ubu bushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko u Rwanda rwateye intambwe idasanzwe mu gukumira icyorezo cya Sida by’umwihariko mu gufasha abayirwaye kubona imiti no kubarinda ingaruka zayo, bwagaragaje impungege ku bangavu. Imibare y’ubu bushakashatsi yerekana ko uko urubyiruko ruhagaze usanga biteye impungenge cyane cyane ku bangavu bari mu kigero cy’imyaka 20. Kuko Bugaragaza ko abangavu bari mu kigero cy’imyaka 20-24 bandura virusi itera Sida ari 1.8%, bikubye inshuro zirenga eshatu bagenzi babo b’abahungu bo bari kuri 0.6%. Ubu bushakashatsi kandi bugaragaza ko ku rwego rw’Intara n’Umujyi wa Kigali, ubwandu bushya bwiganje mu Mujyi wa Kigali ku gipimo cya 4.3%, Intara y’Iburengerazuba ni 3%, Iburasirazuba n’Amajyepfo ni 2.9% naho Amajyaruguru ni 2.2%. Muri rusange mu mijyi buri ku gipimo cya 4.8% naho mu byaro buri kuri 2.5%.

title: Abashakashatsi bo muri Israel batanze icyizere ku rukingo rwa Coronavirus
content: Itsinda ry’aba bashakashatsi ryamaze gukora urukingo rushobora kurwanya virus ya Coronavirus yibasira inkoko, ndetse nirwo bari guheraho bakora urukingo rushobora kuba rwakwifashishwa ku muntu mu kuvura COVID-19, Coronavirus iteje ikibazo Isi muri iki gihe. Aba bashakashatsi bavuze ko hari isano ya hafi hagati ya virus ya Coronavirus yibasira inkoko n’imaze kugaragara mu bantu. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa MIGAL, David Zigdon, yabwiye abanyamakuru ko bitewe n’uburyo hakenewe igisubizo ku rukingo rwa Coronavirus, bari gukora ibishoboka byose kugira ngo rube rwaboneka. Ati “Intego yacu ni ugukora urukingo mu byumweru biri hagati y’umunani n’icumi biri imbere, no kubona ko rwemewe ko nta kibazo rwatera nibura mu minsi 90.” Kugeza ubu abantu barenga 2900 ku Isi bamaze guhitanwa n’iki cyorezo, umubare munini uri mu Bushinwa. Ku Isi hamaze kugaragara abantu 85000 bafite ibimenyetso byayo.

title: Gatsibo: Abasaga ibihumbi 90 bisuzumishije Hepatite C, 2544 basanga bayirwaye
content: Byagarutsweho n’umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Gatsibo, Gasana Richard, kuri uyu wa 29 Gashyantare 2020, ubwo hatangirizwaga ubuvuzi bw’indwara ya Hepatite C. Ati "Ni igikorwa gikomeje kandi kizagera kuri bose. Muri aba ibihumbi 90806 bisuzumishije byagaragaye ko harimo abafite indwara ya Hepatite C, 2544 ari na bo mwaje kudufasha kugira ngo dutangirizeho ubu buvuzi." Hepatitic C ni indwara ifata inyama y’umwijima ikabyimba bitewe n’impamvu zirimo imiti yo kwa muganga itakiriwe neza n’umubiri, irengeje urugero, iya gakondo n’ibindi. Ni imwe mu zihangayikishije u Rwanda n’Isi muri rusange bitewe n’uko yandura cyane, igoye kuvurwa kubera imiti ihenze kandi ikanica cyane. Yandurira mu maraso, mu mibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye, umwana ashobora kuyanduzwa na nyina igihe amubyara n’ibindi. Bamwe mu bafite ibyago byo kuyandura harimo abana bavuka ku babyeyi bayirwaye, ufite ubwandu bwa Virusi itera Sida, abakora umwuga w’uburaya, abakozi bo kwa muganga, abagabo bahuza ibitsina na bagenzi babo, abitera imiti bakoresheje inshinge n’abandi. Abantu benshi bacyandura Hepatite C ntibagaragaza ibimenyetso iyo bakimara kwandura ariko bacye bashobora kugira umuriro, gucika intege, kugira ikizibakanwa, kuribwa mu ngingo, kugira amaso y’umuhondo, inkari n’umusarani byahinduye ibara, kuribwa mu nda, kuruka n’ibindi. Iyo iyi ndwara yamaze kurenga umuntu ashobora kurwara kanseri, urushwima n’ibindi. Inzobere mu by’ubuzima zigira inama abantu ko bagomba kwisuzumisha no kwivuza iyi ndwara hakiri kare kuko byongera amahirwe yo gukira.

title: Uko wakwirinda Coronavirus ikomeje kwibasira Isi
content: Ibihugu byinshi bikomeje gufata ingamba zirimo guhagarika ingendo ziva n’izijya ahagaragaye iki cyorezo, gushyira mu kato no gukurikirana abagaragayeho iki cyorezo ndetse no gushyiraho ingamba zo kugikumira. Coronavirus yandura iyo umuntu yitsamuye cyangwa akoroye yegereye undi; iyo umuntu afite ibiganza byandujwe, gukora cyangwa gusuhuza muntu wayanduye no gukora ku kintu cyangwa ahantu hari iyo virusi. Minisiteri y’Ubuzima mu Rwanda yemeza ko nta Coronavirus irahagaragara ariko igashishikariza abantu bose kuyirinda binyuze mu ngamba zitandukanye zose zikubiye mu kugira isuku. Ingamba ya mbere; ‘karaba intoki buri gihe ukoresheje amazi meza n’isabune cyangwa alukoro yagenewe gukaraba intoki’. Igihe ukoroye cyangwa witsamuye pfuka ku munwa no ku mazuru ukoresheje agatambaro gasukuye uhite ukajugunya ahagenewe guta imyanda hanyuma uhite ukaraba intoki n’amazi meza n’isabune. Irinde gukora ku muntu uwo ari we wese ufite inkorora n’umuriro cyangwa kwegera abantu iyo warwaye kimwe muri ibyo. Ihutire ku ivuriro rigwereye igihe cyose ufite umuriro, inkorora cyangwa udahumeka neza. Irinde gukora urugendo niba ufite umuriro n’inkorora. Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB), giherutse gutegeka abatanga serivisi zo gucumbikira abantu, restaurants, utubari, utubyiniro, abatembereza ba mukerarugendo, ababayobora n’abategura ibikorwa bitandukanye, gushyiraho ahantu ho gukarabira intoki na alcohol yagenewe gusukura intoki. Ibi byashyizwe ku nyubako zose ndetse no mu modoka z’abakerarugendo cyangwa abashyitsi kugira ngo habungabungwe ubuzima n’umudendezo w’abashyitsi n’abakozi. Minisiteri y’Ubuzima kandi yashyize ku kibuga mpuzamahanga cy’indege cya Kigali, abaganga bahoraho bapima abinjira mu gihugu bakagira n’ibibazo babazwa. Ibimenyetso by’indwara ya Coronavirus birimo kugira umuriro, gukorora no guhumeka nabi ndetse ishobora no kugera aho itera umusonga no kubuza impyiko gukora bishobora gutera urupfu. Muri iki cyumweru OMS yaburiye ibihugu ko byakwitegura kurwanya Coronavirus, kuko irimo gukomanga imiryango ahantu hose. Komisiyo y’igihugu ishinzwe ubuzima mu Bushinwa, yatangaje ko abandi bantu 327 banduye Coronavirus, ndetse abandi 44 bakaba bahitanywe na yo. Muri iki gihugu abantu 78 824 banduye Coronavirus barimo 2788 imaze kwica.

title: Abakuramo inda mu buryo bwa magendu bahombya Leta arenga Miliyali buri mwaka
content: Byagarutsweho n’Umujyanama mu Kigo giharanira uburenganzira no guteza imbere ubuzima, Health Development Initiative (HDI), Mporanyi Theobald, ubwo yagiranaga ibiganiro n’abayobozi batandukanye bo mu Karere ka Huye bungurana ibitekerezo ku itegeko ryo gukuramo inda. Ibyo biganiro bibaye nyuma y’ibyabaye muri iki cyumweru aho HDI yaganiriye n’abangavu batewe inda imburagihe; ababyeyi babo; inzego z’urubyiruko n’iz’abagore; abajyanama b’ubuzima ndetse n’ishyirahamwe ry’abakora umwuga w’uburaya. Yagaragaje ko uwakuyemo inda mu buryo bwa magendu ashobora gukurizamo ubumuga n’uburwayi bukomeye ariko kandi ateza umuryango we igihombo ndetse na Leta ikabihomberamo. Ati “Nk’uko ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’ishuri rishinzwe ubuzima rusange muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda bwerekanye ko  inda z’abagore zivamo  buri mwaka zirenga ibihumbi 60; muri zo hari nyinshi zakuwemo mu buryo bwa magendu. Zimwe  na zimwe rero kugira ngo bavure benezo ku mwaka bitwara arenga Miliyoni imwe n’ibihumbi 200 by’amadolari [arenga Miliyari y’amanyarwanda].” Yasobanuye ko muri bo hari abajya kwa muganga bangiritse imyanya myibarukiro; abakurwamo nyababyeyi kuko yangiritse n’abahura n’ibindi bibazo bigatuma bihenda leta mu kubavuza kuko bahabwa ubuvuzi n’inzobere akenshi zituruka hanze y’igihugu. Mu mpera za 2019 mu Rwanda hatowe itegeko ryemerera abakobwa n’abagore kuba bajya kwa muganga gukuzamo inda mu buryo bwemewe kandi bukozwe neza igihe bujuje ibisabwa. Ababyemerewe bari mu byiciro bitanu; icya mbere  ni umwana watewe inda afite imyaka y’amavuko iri munsi ya 18; uwa kabiri ni umukobwa cyangwa umugore wafashwe ku ngufu; uwa gatatu ni uwatewe inda n’uwo bafitanye isano itarenze igisanira cya kabiri. Uwa kane ni uwabanishijwe ku ngufu n’umugabo bagashyingiranywa ku gahato; uwa gatanu ni umugore utwite ariko abaganga bakabona ko uwo atwite adashobora kuvuka kubera impamvu zijyanye n’ubuzima. Ni itegeko ryitezweho umusaruro Umukozi ushinzwe uburinganire n’iterambere ry’umuryango mu Karere ka Huye, Christine Dusabeyezu, yavuze ko iryo tegeko baryitezeho umusaruro mu buryo bugera kuri bune. Ubwa mbere ni uguteza imbere abakobwa kuko iyo batewe inda imburagihe bibadindiza mu kwiga no gukora ibibateza imbere; ubwa kabiri ni uguhosha amakimbirane mu miryango kuko ngo iyo abana babyaye biteza ibibazo mu ngo bigakurura ubwumvikane buke. Uburyo bwa gatatu yavuze ko ari ubukungu kuko iyo abangavu batewe inda imburagihe Leta itakaza amafaranga menshi mu kubitaho igihe babyaye kugira ngo basubire mu buzima busanzwe n’abataye ishuri barisubiremo. Yasobanuye ko icya kane ari ubuzima bwabo kuko iyo bakuyemo inda mu buryo bwa magendu bahatakariza ubuzima cyangwa bagakuramo ubumuga n’izindi ndwara zitandukanye. Umuganga witwa Kayitesi Francine yavuze ko ibiganiro bahawe kuri iryo tegeko bibakanguye bityo bakaba bagiye kujya bihutisha serivise ku muntu ubagannye aje gukuzamo inda igihe yujuje ibisabwa. Ingingo ya 123 iri mu gitabo cy’amategeko ahana ibyaha mu Rwanda ivuga ko gukuramo inda ari icyaha gihanwa n’amategeko Isobanura ko uwakuyemo inda cyangwa akayikurirwamo aba akoze icyaha kuko iyo ahamwe n’icyaha ahanishwa igifungo kiri hagati y’umwaka umwe n’imyaka itatu n’ihazabu iri hagati y’amafaranga ibihumbi 100 n’ibihumbi 200. Uwayimukuriyemo ahabwa igihano cy’igifungo kiri hagati y’imyaka itatu n’itanu n’ihazabu y’amafaranga ari hagati y’ibihumbi 300 n’ibihumbi 500 byavamo ubumuga bwemejwe na muganga ubifitiye ububasha agafungwa imyaka iri hagati ya 20 na 25 byavamo urupfu agafungwa burundu. Gusa ingingo ya 125 ivuga iyo uwujuje ibisabwa ashaka gukurwamo inda iyo abikoreye kwa muganga ubifitiye ububasha biba atari icyaha nk’uko bigaragazwa n’iteka rya Minisitiri w’ubuzima ryo muri 2019. Ku bufatanye bwa Minisiteri y’Ubuzima, Imbuto Foundation na HDI hari gukorwa ubukangurambaga hirya no hino mu gihugu bugamije gukangurira abantu kumenya no kubahiriza iryo tegeko rijyanye no gukuramo inda. Abitabiriye ibyo biganiro mu Karere ka Huye kuri uyu wa Gatanu barimo abashinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage, abayobora ibigo nderabuzima, inzego z’umutekano n’abashinzwe uburinganire n’iterambere ry’umuryango.
