title: Minisante igiye gukurikirana amakuru avuga ko hari abanyeshuri bafashwe n’indwara y’amashamba
content: Ibi bitangajwe nyuma y’uko umwe mu bakoresha urubuga rwa Twitter yanditseho atabaza Perezida Paul Kagame avuga ko hari abanyeshuri bafashwe n’indwara y’amashamba ndetse ikigo bigaho kigafungwa. Uwo muntu yanditse ati “Abana bacu bamerewe nabi, ibigo by’amashuri bimwe byamaze gufunga imiryango kubera icyorezo cy’amashamba, nta n’urukingo ruri ku bitaro. Dukeneye mu by’ukuri ubufasha bwawe.” Umuvugizi wa Minisiteri y’Ubuzima, Kayumba Malick, yabwiye IGIHE ko nta makuru minisiteri irahabwa ku bijyanye n’iyo ndwara ariko yatangiye gukurikirana ngo imenye niba aribyo koko kugira ngo itange ubutabazi. Ati “Ni amakuru twahawe ariko kugeza ubu ntaho baratubwira ko hari abagaragaweho iriya ndwara, natwe tugiye kubikurina, twamusabye kutumenyesha aho yabibonye.” Ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubuzima (RBC) cyahise gisubiza uwo muntu cyifashishije urukuta rwa Twitter, kimushimira ku makuru atanze, kimumenyesha ko icyo kibazo kigiye gukurikiranwa. Ubutumwa cyanditse bugira buti “Itsinda rishinzwe gukumira no kurwanya ibyorezo rirakurikirana ikibazo cy’ubwo burwayi buzwi nk’amashamba mu kinyarwanda, rinateganye ibikorwa bwo kuburwanya.” Urakoze @tmarcg ku makuru utanze. Itsinda rishinzwe gukumira no kurwanya ibyorezo rirakurikirana ikibazo cy'ubwo burwayi buzwi nk'amashamba mu kinyarwanda, rinateganye ibikorwa bwo kuburwanya. https://t.co/PZd7NAMptx — RBC-Rwanda (@RBCRwanda) February 28, 2020 Umwe mu bakoresha nimero ihamagarwa n’abashaka serivisi ku kigo cya ‘Discovery International School’ cyavugwagamo iyi ndwara, yabwiye IGIHE ko ayo makuru ntayo azi, cyane ko kugeza ubu abanyeshuri bari mu karuhuko kagufi. Ati “Ubu turi mu karuhuko ‘Mid Term Break’ wabaza uwo muntu aho yabikuye, njyewe ntabwo mbizi.” Indwara y’amashamba ni imwe mu zandura. Kuyirinda bisaba ko uwagaragaje ibimenyetso byayo yirinda ndetse arindwa kwegera abandi nibura mu gihe cy’iminsi itanu uhereye ku munsi wa mbere yagaragajeho ibimenyetso. Bimwe mu bimenyetso by’iyi ndwara birimo nko kugira umuriro, gutakaza ubushake bwo kurya, kubabara mu gihe umuntu ahekenya, kubyimba kw’ibice biherereyemo izo mvubura. Mu gihe hagize ugaragaza ibimenyetso by’amashamba, abantu bagirwa inama yo kwihutira kubimenyesha inzego z’ubuzima ku murongo wa telefone utishyuzwa ariwo ’114’ no kugana ikigo nderabuzima kibegereye kugira ngo bahabwe ubufasha. RBC ivuga ko iyi ndwara igira urukingo ariko rutari ku rutonde rw’inkingo zisanzwe zihabwa abana muri gahunda y’igihugu y’ikingira. Ivuga ko hari gahunda yo kwinjiza urukingo rw’indwara mu zisanzwe zihabwa abana muri gahunda y’igihugu y’ikingira. Urukingo rwayo rukazahuzwa n’urw’iseru na rubeole, abana bakazajya baruhabwa rukomatanyirijemo izo eshatu.

title: Rusizi: Hatangijwe ubukangurambaga bwo gukingira Ebola mu baturage
content: Icyo gikorwa cyatangijwe kuri uyu wa Gatatu  tariki 18 Ukuboza 2019. Iyi gahunda yiswe ‘Umurinzi’ yatangirijwe mu karere ka Rubavu, kuri ubu hakaba hakurikiyeho akarere ka Rusizi nka  kamwe mu turere duhana umupaka na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo yibasiwe na Ebola ku rwego rwo hejuru. Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ubuzima, ushinzwe ubuvuzi bw’ibanze, Dr. Ndimubanzi Patrick, yavuze ko abantu bakwiye kwikingiza Ebola mu rwego rwo kuyikumira. Yagize ati “Uru rugamba turimo rwo gukumira no kurwanya Ebola dushobora gutsinda twese dushyize hamwe, nicyo iki gikorwa kivuze. Ubu twabonye uburyo bushyashya, uburyo tugomba kwitabira, uburyo buzakoreshwa ku bantu bashobora guhura n’abantu bafite indwara ya Ebola.” Cosmos Kusimwa Bishisha, Minisitiri w’ubuzima mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo,  yashimye ubufatanye bw’ibihugu byombi mu guhangana na virus ya Ebola. Ati “Twakingiye abantu ibihumbi 30 birimo abantu bakora mu bijyanye n’ubuzima, twagiranye ibiganiro n’abayobozi mu by’ubuzima bo mu Rwanda dushyira hamwe ingamba zo kurwanya iyi ndwara, turashimira abayobozi bo mu ntara y’Iburengerazuba bashyize ingufu mu gusuzuma iyi ndwara ku mipaka.” Hari umubare munini w’Abanyarwanda bajya gukora imirimo itandukanye muri RDC, akaba ariyo mpamvu abakingiwe baganiriye na IGIHE bavuze ko uru rukingo ruzabafasha kwirinda Ebola. Mukamana Valence yagize  ati “Ikibazo twari dufite nuko twikangaga  ko dushobora kwandura kubera duturanye n’igihugu cyagize ibibazo no guhura ni icyorezo cya Ebola, tujya muri Congo gucuruza urumva ko twikingiye. Turashima abayobozi bacu batuzaniye uru rukingo.” Abantu basaga 2000 bishwe na Ebola muri  Congo. Muri abo harimo umwe wo mu ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo. Ubuyobozi bw’iyi ntara kuri ubu buravuga ko nta murwayi urongera kugaragara nyuma y’aho batangiriye gahunda yo gukingira. Uru rukingo rutangwa mu byiciro bibiri, urwa mbere rukurikirwa n’urwa kabiri nyuma y’amezi abiri uhereye igihe urwa mbere rwatangiwe. Mu Rwanda hazakingirwa abaturage ibihumbi 100 bo mu karere ka Rubavu n’ibihumbi 100 mu karere ka Rusizi.  Uru rukingo rukorwa n’ikigo cy’Abanyamerika ‘Johnson and Johnson’, rwageze bwa mbere muri Congo mu kwezi k’Ukwakira uyu mwaka aho biteganyijwe ko hazakingirwa ibihumbi 500.

title: Malaria ikomeje guhitana imbaga nubwo hashyizweho ingamba zinyuranye zo kuyihashya
content: Raporo igaragaza ko Nigeria yihariye umubare munini w’abarwaye  iyi ndwara aho ifite 25%, ikurikirwa na Repuburika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo ifite 12%, Uganda na 5%, mu gihe Cote d’Ivoire, Mozambique na Niger buri kimwe gifite 4%. Hari  ingamba zagiye zishyirwaho hirya no hino ku isi mu guhashya malaria zikaba zaranatanze umusaruro kuko imibare igaragaza ko abantu bavuye kuri miliyoni 177 mu 2010 bakagera kuri miliyoni 155 mu 2018. Abapfa bahitanywe na malaria bavuye ku bihumbi 400 mu 2010 bagera ku bihumbi 260 mu 2018. Uganda nka kimwe mu bihugu byazahajwe bikomeye na malaria yafashe iya mbere mu bihugu byo mu karere k’ibiyaga bigari aho yatangije ubukangurambaga bwari bugamije kugabanya malaria kugera ku kigero cya 40% bitarenze 2020, na 75% mu 2025. Nubwo hagiye hagaragara kugabanuka mu bijyanye n’abandura malaria ndetse n’abo yahitanaga, bigaraga ko igabanuka ryayo rigenda biguru ntege. Nko mu 2013 ubwandu bwa maralia bwavuye kuri 60% igera kuri 57%, kuva icyo gihe kugera mu 2018 imibare ntiyigeze itirimuka. The East African ivuga ko mu karere ka Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, Tanzania iyoboye ibindi bihugu mu kugira umubare munini w’abahitanywe na malaria mu 2018 aho ifite abagera 21,500, ikurikirwa na Uganda ifite ibihumbi 13, u Rwanda ruza ku mwanya wa gatatu n’abagera ku 3,200, Kenya ikagira ibihumbi bibiri. Itangazo Minisiteri y’ubuzima muri Uganda iheruka gusohora rigaragaza ko abarenga miliyoni barwaye malaria hagati y’ukwezi kwa Kamena na Nyakanga. Rikomeza rivuga ko imihindagurikire y’ikirere n’imvura ikabije biri mu byatumye iyi ndwara yibasira umubare munini muri iki gihugu. Ishami ry’Umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku buzima (OMS) rigaragaza ko kimwe mu bitera ubwiyongere bukabije bw’abandura malaria n’abo ihitana ari ubwitabire buke bukigaragara mu kubona imiti no kuyifatira ku gihe, ndetse n’ikibazo cy’amikoro adahagije. Muri Afurika y’iburasirazuba usanga ibihugu byinshi byitabaza inzitiramibu mu rwego rwo kurwanya malaria. Mu 2018 Uganda yatanze inzitiramibu zigera kuri miliyoni 11, Kenya itanga miliyoni 2.3, u Rwanda rutanga 974,800, mu gihe Tanzania itigeze itanga inzitiramibu mu 2018. Kenya yashoye miliyoni 200 z’amashiringi akoreshwa muri icyo gihugu mu gutera imiti irwanya ikwirakwizwa rya malaria.

title: Havumbuwe uburyo bushya bwo kuboneza urubyaro ku bagabo bumara imyaka 13
content: Ubu buryo bwo kuboneza urubyaro buzaba bufite ubushobozi bwo gukumira umugabo kuba yatera inda mu gihe cy’imyaka 13. Kugeza ubu, abagabo nta bundi buryo bari bafite bwo kuboneza urubyaro uretse agakingirizo no kwifungisha ibizwi nka ‘Vasectomie’. Ubu buryo bushya  buzaba buri ku isoko ry’imiti ry’u Buhinde mu mezi atandatu ari imbere bukazanaboneka ku isi hose mu gihe kizaza. Uru rushinge ruzajya ruterwa mu muyobora uri hafi y’udusabo tw’intanga tw’abagabo. Uru rushinge ntirubabaza kuko ruterwa hifashishijwe ikinya. Umuyobozi w’ishami ry’ubuvuzi bw’abagabo mu bitaro byitiriwe Cochin, akaba n’inzobere mu buvuzi bw’indwara z’abagabo, Dr Sylvain Mimoun, avuga ko u Buhinde nk’igihugu gifite abaturage benshi ku Isi, bumaze igihe bukora kuri uru rushinge ruzafasha abagabo kuboneza urubyaro, ari uburyo bwiza bwo kugabanya abaturage. Inzobere muri siyansi mu kigo cy’ubushakashatsi mu buvuzi cy’u Buhinde, Dr RS Sharma, yabwiye Hindustan Times ko uru rushinge rwarangije gukorwa rukaba rutegereje kwemezwa n’ikigo gishinzwe kugenzura imiti mu Buhinde. Uru rushinge ntabwo rwambura abagabo ubushobozi bwo gutera inda burundu nk’ubundi buryo bwari busanzwe bwo kwifungisha ‘Vasectomie’.

title: Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko ibinini byo kuboneza urubyaro bishobora kwangiza ubwonko
content: Bwakozwe n’Ikigo cy’Ubushakashatsi cyitwa “Magnetic Resonance Research Center” gishamikiye ku ishuri ryigisha ubuvuzi ryitiriwe  “Albert Einstein” muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Bwakorewe ku bagore 50, muri bo 21 bakoresha ibi binini. Bose bakorewe isuzuma rya ‘MRI’ harebwa imikorere y’ubwonko bwabo by’umwihariko hasuzumwa agace kitwa “Hypothalamus”. Iki gice cy’ubwonko ni ingenzi kuko gifasha mu kugenzura ingano y’imisemburo mu mubiri ndetse kigira uruhare ku buryo umuntu agira cyangwa abura ibitotsi n’uburyo umutima utera. Kinagira kandi uruhare mu kuba umuntu yakwiyongera cyangwa akagabanyuka ibiro n’ubushake bwo kurya. Abakoze ubu bushakashatsi bagaragaje ko abagore bafataga ibinini byo kuboneza urubyaro mu gihe bwakorwaga, bafite ‘hypothalamus’ nto ugereranyije n’abatarabikoreshaga. Umwarimu wigisha ibijyanye no gusuzuma indwara z’imbere mu mubiri hakoreshejwe imirasire mu kigo cy’ubushakashatsi ku buzima cyitiriwe Albert Einstein cy’i New York, Michael L. Lipton, uri mu babuyoboye; yagize ati “twabonye impinduka zigaragara mu ngano y’imiterere y’ubwonko hagati y’abagore bafataga ibi binini n’abatarabifataga.” Lipton yavuze ko ibyavuye muri ubu bushakashatsi bikwiye gutuma hakorwa igenzura rindi ryimbitse ku ngaruka z’ibi binini ku mubiri wa muntu by’umwihariko ku mikorere y’ubwonko. Gusa kimwe mu byo ubu bushakashatsi bwerekanye ni uko nta ngaruka n’imwe ibi binini bigira ku mitekerereze ya muntu. Si ubwa mbere ubushakashatsi bugaragaje ingaruka mbi z’ibi binini ku bwonko bw’ababikoresha kuko muri Gashyantare 2019, hari ubwasohotse  mu kinyamakuru ‘Frontiers in Neuroscience’ bwerekanye ko ibinini byo kuboneza urubyaro bituma ubwonko bwangirika ku buryo ubinywa aba adashobora kureba amarangamutima y’umuntu ku isura ye.

title: Abatuye mu Mujyi wa Kigali boroherejwe kwipimisha indwara zitandura
content: Zimwe mu ndwara zitandura zirimo; diyabete, umuvuduko w’amaraso (hypertension), kanseri, indwara z’umutima, umubyibuho ukabije n’izindi. Mu korohereza abatuye Umujyi wa Kigali kwipimisha izi ndwara zitandura, hashyizweho ahantu ho kuzipimira aho igikorwa cyatangiye kuwa 9 Ukuboza -15 Ukuboza 2019. Mu Karere ka Kicukiro birakorerwa ku isoko rya Ziniya, muri Gasabo ni ku isoko rya Kimironko naho muri Nyarugenge ni ahazwi nka Car Free Zone. Rwabukwaya Théogène, utuye mu karere ka Nyarugenge, Umurenge wa Muhima, wagendanaga umuvuduko w’amaraso ushobora kugera ku kigero cyo hejuru (Hypertension), avuga ko hari ibyo abashije kumenya bigiye kumufasha gukomeza kubungabunga ubuzima bwe anakangurira abandi kwipimisha hakiri kare. Yagize ati “Hari ibyo najyaga nibwira, kumwe umuntu agenda akumva nta ndwara afite cyangwa umubiri we nta kibazo ufite, ariko ubungubu hari ibyo mbashije kumva bamaze kunsobanurira ko hari ikibazo mfite. Babashije no kumpa ingamba z’uko ngomba kwitwara, bambwiye kugabanya inzoga, isukari, n’umunyu.” “Ubutumwa natanga ni uko buri muntu wese atakwirara ngo yumve ko umubiri we ntakintu kimurya ngo yumve ko ari muzima, na we akegera ibigo Nderabuzima cyangwa ahantu habereye igikorwa nk’iki akabasha na we kureba uko ubuzima bwe buhagaze.” Mukasekuru Julienne, wasanze afite umubyibuho ukabije avuga ko asanzwe akora ibishoboka ngo agabanye ibiro, anasaba ko bashyirirwaho na gahunda yo gupimwa kanseri kuko na yo iri mu ndwara zugarije abatuye mu mijyi. Yagize ati “Iki gikorwa nakijemo nishimye, bamfashe ibipimo byose basanga ndi muzima ariko basanze mfite ibiro byinshi bangira inama yo gukora siporo, nkagabanya amavuta, n’umunyu mwinshi. Ubusanzwe nageragezaga kugabanya ibiro ariko siporo ni yo numva izananira. “Iyi gahunda ndayishima ariko icyo nifuza ni uko badushyiriraho na gahunda yo gupima kanseri kuko hari abo usanga barayirwaye bataragize amahirwe yo kuyipimisha mbere kandi ni indwara iduhangayikishije cyane.” Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’ishami ry’umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku buzima (OMS) ndetse n’ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubuzima (RBC), bugaragaza ko umubare munini w’abibasirwa n’izi ndwara zitandura ari abo mu mijyi bitewe ahanini no kutita ku mirire. Indwara zitandura zishobora kwirindwa hitabwa cyane ku mirire, gukora siporo, kurya imbuto, kureka kunywa inzoga n’itabi. Indwara zitandura zica abantu miliyoni 38 ku isi buri mwaka. 3/4 byabo bangana na miliyoni 28 ni abo mu bihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere. Miliyoni 17 ngo baba bari munsi y’imyaka 70. Indwara zihitana benshi ni umutima bangana na miliyoni 17.5, kanseri yo ihitana miliyoni 8.2, indwara z’ubuhumekero miliyoni enye, naho diyabete yo ikaba ihitana miliyoni 1.5. Hatagize igikorwa mu mwaka wa 2030, muri Africa y’Uburasirazuba abaturage 42% bashobora kwicwa n’izi ndwara bavuye kuri 25%.

title: Umuvuduko w’amaraso na diabète mu ndwara zibasira Abanya-Kigali
content: Ibi byatangajwe kuri uyu wa Gatatu mu gikorwa cyo gutangiza ku mugaragaro ubukangurambaga bwo kurwanya indwara zitandura n’ubujyanama buhabwa abamaze kuzirwara. Imibare mishya igaragaza ko 7% by’abatuye Umujyi wa Kigali bafite ikibazo cy’umubyibuho ukabije, muri bo abana batarengeje imyaka 14 y’amavuko bagera ku 10%, mu gihe abagore ari 34%, bafite iki kibazo gifatwa nk’intandaro yo gufatwa n’izindi ndwara zitandura. Umuyobozi w’Ishami rishinzwe gukumira no kurwanya indwara zitandukanye muri RBC, Dr. Turate Innocent, avuga ko uburyo bw’ibanze bwo kwirinda indwara zitandura, abantu bakwiye kwirinda kunywa ibiyobyabwenge nk’inzoga n’itabi ndetse bakitabira kwisuzumisha. Yagize ati “Indwara zitandura ziri kwiyongera ku rwego rukabije ku buryo hadafashwe ingamba, bishobora kuzaba ikibazo gikomeye; gusa ikibazo dufite ubu ni uko abatugana ari bake ugereranyije n’abafite ibibazo.’’ Umuyobozi w’Umujyi wa Kigali wungirije ushinzwe Imibereho myiza n’Iterambere ry’Ubukungu, Umutoni Gatsinzi Nadine, yahamagariye abatuye umujyi kwitabira siporo no guharanira kugira imirire iboneye mu rwego rwo kwirinda indwara zitandura. Yagize ati “Indwara nka kanseri, diabète, umutima ni zimwe mu zikomeye zituma umuntu ashobora kumererwa nabi ndetse akaba yabura ubuzima ariko kuzirinda nabyo birashoboka twitabira gukora siporo kandi tugategura indyo iboneye.’’ Imibare yo kuva mu mwaka wa 2016 kugeza mu kwezi kwa Gicurasi 2019, igaragaza ko abamaze gusuzumwa indwara zitandura binyuze mu bukangurambaga rusange barenga gato 19 000; biyongera ku basaga 29 000 bisuzumishije muri siporo rusange izwi nka ‘‘CarFreeDay.’’ Bamwe mu bitabiriye iki gikorwa cyo gusuzumwa ku buntu indwara zitandukanye, bashimye iyi gahunda kuko yabafashije gufata ingamba z’uburyo bagomba kwitwara mu rwego rwo kwirinda indwara zandura. Bagaragaje icyifuzo cyo kuba mu ndwara zisuzumwa hakongerwamo na kanseri. Ibikorwa byo gusuzuma no gutanga inama ku ndwara zitandura byatangijwe uyu munsi, biri gukorerwa mu turere dutatu tugize umujyi wa Kigali. Mu karere ka Kicukiro biri kubera ku isoko rya Ziniya, mu ka Gasabo ni ku isoko rya kimironko, mu ka Nyarugenge ni muri Car Free Zone ndetse no ku Bigo Nderabuzima bya Gatenga, Kanyinya, Mageragere na Remera.

title: Hakozwe ibinini byo kuboneza urubyaro bizajya binyobwa rimwe mu kwezi
content: Ubushakashatsi bwerekenya ko abarenga 50% bakoresha ibinini byo kuboneza urubyaro banywa buri munsi, iyo bibagiwe kubinywa nibura inshuro imwe mu mezi atatu basama, mu gihe munsi ya 1/100 by’ababifashe uko bikwiye ariwe ushobora gusama. Ibi binini byitwa gelatine capsule byageragerejwe ku ngurube, bigaragara ko bifite ubushobozi bwo kumara nibura ibyumweru bitatu mu mubiri w’umugore cyangwa umukobwa, bigakora imisemburo imubuza gusama. Aba bashakashatsi bo muri Kaminuza ya Massachusetts Institute of Technology muri Amerika, babikoze bavuze ko bigiye kurinda abagore n’abakobwa batwaraga inda kandi bakoresha ibinini byo kuboneza urubyaro bitewe no kwibagirwa kubinywa mu gihe cyateganyijwe. Prof Robert Langer wayoboye ubwo bushakashatsi yavuze ko yizeye ko hazatinda hakavumburwa ibinini umuntu anywa bikamara igihe mu mubiri bikamurinda indwara zitandukanye zirimo izo mu mutwe n’izindi. Ibinini byifashishwa mu kuboneza urubyaro byamaraga igihe mu bisanzwe bikoreshwa, ni ibyafatwaga nibura inshuro ebyiri mu kwezi ariko ibikunze kwifashishwa cyane ni ibyo bafata buri munsi.

title: U Rwanda na RDC byatangije  gahunda yo gukingira Ebola  abaturiye umupaka
content:
Biteganyijwe  ko hazakingirwa abaturage ibihumbi 200 ku ruhande rw’u Rwanda n’ibihumbi 500 muri Congo. Ni gahunda yiswe’’Umurinzi’’ igamije kongerera ubudahangarwa bw’umubiri kuri virusi ya Ebola abaturage baturiye imipaka  y’u Rwanda na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Uru rukingo rutangwa mu byiciro bibiri, urwa mbere rukurikirwa n’urwa kabiri nyuma  y’amezi abiri uhereye igihe urwa mbere rwatangiriye. Biteganijwe ko mu Rwanda hazakingirwa abaturage ibihumbi 100 bo mu karere ka Rubavu n’ibihumbi 100 mu karere ka Rusizi. Uru rukingo rukorwa n’ikigo cy’Abanyamerika ‘Johnson and Johnson’, rwageze  bwa mbere muri Congo mu kwezi k’Ukwakira  uyu mwaka. Umuhuzabikorwa wa gahunda yo guhangana n’indwara ya Ebola muri Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo, Prof  Jean-Jacques Muyembe, yavuze ko gukingira abaturiye imipaka ari ingamba zafashwe kugira ngo bongerere abaturage ubudahangarwa no kwiteganyiriza mu myaka izaza.  Ati “icyorezo dufite ubu hari abaturage benshi bugarijwe  ntabwo twashobora kugera kuri buri rugo niyo mpamvu twashatse urukingo rushobora gukingira abaturage benshi. Twumvikanye n’u Rwanda kugira ngo twongerere ubudahangarwa abaturage baturiye umupaka kuburyo nubwo bafatwa byakoroha guhangana na virusi ya Ebola.”
Minisitiri  w’ubuzima mu Rwanda, Dr Diane Gashumba yavuze ko uru rukingo ruje kunganira izindi ngamba zari zisanzwe zirimo isuku. Ati “Icyo twiteze kuri uru rukingo ni ukuza kunganira izindi ngamba twari dufite nk’igihugu  nk’iz’isuku, ingamba zo kwirinda kujya ahari icyorezo ariko nanone no kunganira ibyo twakoze mu mezi ashize. Twakingiye abakozi bo kwa muganga ibihumbi bitatu  dukoresheje urukingo rwa mbere, uyu munsi dufite amahirwe y’uko tubonye urukingo rushobora gukoreshwa ku baturage muri rusange’’. Yakomeje avuga ko impamvu batangiriye gukingira abaturiye imipaka y’iburengerazuba ari uko bafitanye umubano, ubusabane n’ubuhahirane n’uburasirazuba bwa Congo. Ati “Twahereye hano mu karere ka Rubavu kuko abaturage bagendererana n’abaturage ba Goma, ni ukuvuga ko nidukingira abaturage ba Rubavu,Goma na Rusizi tuzagira amahoro kurushaho kuko turamutse tugize ibyago byo kugira icyorezo cya Ebola cyasanga abantu bafite ubudahangarwa’’ Mu itangazo OMS yasohoye, yavuze ko "uko imibare y’abanduye ikomeza kugabanuka, ari ikimenyetso gitanga icyizere mu kurandura iyi ndwara." Umubare w’abamaze gukingirwa iyi ndwara nawo ukomeje kuzamuka, ku buryo uhereye muri Kanama umwaka ushize hamaze gukingirwa abantu 252 835. Uretse abantu basaga 2100 Ebola yahitanye kuva ku wa 1 Kanama 2018, abandi 1.070 babashije kuyikira nkuko imibare ya Minisiteri y’ubuzima muri Congo ibigaragaza. Amafoto: Himbaza Pacis

title: Amb. Deborah Banks  yagiriye inama  ababyeyi  kumenya buri gihe ibyo  abakobwa babo bahugiyemo
content: Amb. Deborah Banks yabigarutseho mu kiganiro cyagarukaga ku kubwiza ukuri abakiri bato, by’umwihariko abangavu n’abagore, ko aribyo byaba igisubizo cya virusi itera Sida ku mugabane wa Afurika. Ni ikiganiro cyatanzwe muri gahunda z’Inama Mpuzamahanga yiga kuri SIDA n’izindi ndwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina (ICASA) iteraniye i Kigali guhera tariki ya 1 Ukuboza kugeza kuwa 7 Ukuboza 2019. Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Bana, UNICEF, rivuga ko kugeza ubu buri cyumweru abangavu bagera ku bihumbi bitandatu bandura ubwandu bwa Virusi Itera Sida ku isi, imibare minini ikaba iri munsi y’Ubutayu bwa Sahara. Amb. Banks avuga ko imbaraga z’abakiri bato iyo zihawe agaciro bitanga umusaruro, gushyira abangavu n’abagore  muri  izi gahunda bikaba ari ngombwa. Agira ari “Iyo tuganirije abana b’abakobwa tukamenya ibyo barimo gukora, bitanga umusaruro kuri bo ndetse bikazamura  imiryango yabo.” Dr. Paula Mandeli uhagarariye UNAIDS, we avuga ko uburyo bwiza bwashyirwaho ari ugushyiraho gahunda nziza zo kurwanya Sida mu bakobwa n’abagore kandi hakabaho kumva abagenerwabikorwa. Avuga ko abakobwa bakwiye kujya bungukira muri gahunda ziba zabashyiriweho mu guhangana n’iki kibazo cya virusi itera SIDA gikomeye guhitana benshi. Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ry’ubuzima (OMS),  rigaragaza ko abantu miliyoni 19.6 bafite ubwandu bwa virusi itera Sida mu gace ka Afurika y’u Burasirazuba n’Amajyepfo, muri aba, abarenga miliyoni imwe ni urubyiruko harimo abangavu barenga ibihumbi 600.

title: Abanyarwanda bavumbuye ubwoko bushya bw’agakoko gatera igituntu (Video)
content: Abahanga mu by’ubuzima bavuga ko igituntu ari indwara y’ibihaha iterwa n’agakoko kitwa ‘Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex’ cangwa ‘Bacille de Koch’ yandurira mu mwuka igihe uyirwaye akoroye cyangwa yitsamuye, utwo dukoko tujya mu kirere umuntu wese uhumetse uwo mwuka ku buryo ashobora kuyandura. Isuzuma ryakozwe mu 2014 ku bisigazwa by’umubiri w’umunya-Peru wari ukirwaye, ryerekanye ko igituntu gishobora kuba cyarabayeho mu myaka isaga 6000 ishize ariko ku wa 24 Werurwe 1882 nibwo Dr. Robert Koch yavumbuye agakoko gatera iyo ndwara, uhita unagirwa umunsi mpuzamahanga wo kukirwanya. Kuri ubu, itsinda ry’inzobere zo mu Rwanda ryavumbuye ubwoko bushya bw’aka gakoko. Umukozi wa RBC uyoboye ubu bushakashatsi bwagejeje u Rwanda ku gahigo ko kuvumbura ubwoko bushya bw’agakoko gatera igituntu, Ngabonziza Semuto Jean Claude, yabwiye IGIHE ko kuva indwara y’igituntu imenyekanye, abashakashatsi hirya no hino bakomeje gushakisha imiti yagahangara ndetse no kumenya byimbitse uburyo kashoboye gutera indwara no gukwirakwira mu bantu. Agakoko gatera igituntu kari mu bwoko bwa ‘Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex’. Utumaze kumenyekana dutera indwara abantu turi mu bwoko umunani, duhabwa amazina bitewe n’uruhererekane rwatwo. Ngabonziza yavuze ko muri Gicurasi 2017 aribwo itsinda ayoboye ryatangiye ubushakashatsi ku gituntu cy’igikatu mu Rwanda. Ni ubushakatsi bugamije kureba uburyo bwizewe kandi bwihuse bwo gupima muri Laboratwari no gukurikirana mu buryo bwimbitse indwara y’igintu by’umwihariko icy’igikatu (kitavurwa n’imiti isanzwe yo ku rwego rwa mbere). Ako gakoko byemejwe ko kadasanzwe mu Ukuboza 2017 hamaze gukorwa ibizamini byimbitse ku turemangingo twako (DNA). Kabonetse mu bizamini by’umurwayi ukomoka mu Karere ka Rulindo. N’ubwo uwo murwayi yaje kwitaba Imana mu gihe gito atangiye imiti, imirimo yo kumenya byimbitse ibidasanzwe kuri ako gakoko igeze hafi ku musozo. Ngabonziza yagize ati “Kimwe mu bidasanzwe kuri aka ka cyenda kavumbuwe mu Rwanda ni uko ariko kabanziriza uruhererekane rwatwo kakaba kagaragaza ishusho y’uburyo udukoko twagiye duhindagurika kugera k’udutera igituntu.” Ubusanzwe bishobora gutwara amezi agera kuri atatu kugira ngo hemezwe ko imiti iri gukora neza ku gituntu cy’igikatu, ariko ubu bushakashatsi buzatuma icyo gihe kigabanuka cyane kugera nibura ku cyumweru kimwe. Ngabonziza ati “Muri uko kureba uburyo bushya bwazasimbura ubusanzwe buhari bufata igihe kirekire nibwo twabonye ako gakoko kadasanzwe, haba mu bushakastsi bwakozwe hose cyera cyangwa uburi gukorwa ubu, nta hantu na hamwe karaboneka. Ni ukuvuga ngo umurwayi umwe wacu niwe wari ufite ako gakoko nako katumvaga imiti isanzwe.” Ubushakshatsi kuri utwo dukoko bukorwa hagendewe ku ruhererekane rwatwo ‘Lineage’, aho zitandukanira ku turemangingo tuzigize ‘DNA’. Kuva butangiye gukorwa agakoko kabanje kuvumburwa kahawe izina rya Lineage ya mbere (L1), akakurikiye kitwa L2 kugera ku ka munani gaheruka kiswe ‘L8’. Urwo ruhererekane rw’utu dukoko usanga tugenda tunatandukana mu buryo dukwirakwira hirya no hino cyangwa uko tubasha guhangana n’ubwoko bw’imiti. Uwo mwihariko w’ako bavumbuye ngo ugaragaza byihariye ko kitandukanyije n’utwo mu muryango w’utudatera indwara kagahinduka akazitera ariko kanafite ibyo gahuriyeho n’impande zose. Ibyo bitanga umukoro ku bashakashatsi wo kumenya uburyo kihinduye agatera indwara abantu kavuye mu muryango w’utudatera igituntu. Ubwo bwoko bushya bwavumbuwe n’abanyarwanda ntabwo burahabwa izina ariko birashoboka ko ryazaba ‘Lineage 9’ ukurikije uko utundi twagiye twitwa, gusa rizatangazwa igihe inyandiko ibuvugaho izaba igiye gushyirwa mu kinyamakuru cy’ubushakashatsi ku rwego mpuzamahanga ‘Medical Scientific Journal’, bizakorwa bitarenze amezi abiri ari imbere. Muri ubu bushakashatsi RBC ifatanyije n’ibindi bigo by’ubushakashatsi mpuzamahanga harimo Institute of Tropical Medicine yo mu Mujyi wa Antwerp mu Bubiligi, Centre national de la recherche scientifique (Lille, mu Bufaransa), GenoScreen (Lille, mu Bufaransa), Swiss Tropical and Public Health Institute (Basel, mu Busuwisi) ndetse na Laboratoire de Référence des Mycobactéries (Cotonou, Benin). Muri uyu mwaka nibwo abagize iri tsinda bamuritse uburyo bavumbuye aka gakoko mu nama mpuzamahanga y’abashakashatsi ku dukoko dutera igituntu yabereye muri Espagne hagati ya 30 Kamena na 4 Nyakanga, buhita bwemezwa. Kuvumbura ubu bwoko bivuze iki? Ngabonziza yagize ati “Tugiye kumenya neza uburyo ubu bwoko bushya bw’agakoko gatera igituntu kashoboye gutera uburwayi no gukwirakwira. Ni ikintu gikomeye kuko kugira ngo umuntu ashobore kuba yagira uburwayi umubiri we ugomba kuba wagize intege nke utabasha kurwanya udukoko.” Ibi ngo bizanafasha kumenya uburyo utu dukoko twarwanywa by’umwihariko ku bantu bafite Virus itera Sida. Injira muri Laboratwari zipima igituntu n’imiti ikivura Ubusanzwe kugira ngo bamenye umuti ushobora guhangara ubwoko runaka bw’igituntu bisaba kubanza gushyira agakoko kacyo muri Laboratwari, kagahabwa ibigatunga mu gihe cy’ibyumweru 4-6 kugira ngo kororoke. Iyo kamaze kororoka, kabyaye twinshi twimurirwa mu yindi laboratoire aho duhabwa imiti mu gihe cy’ibyumweru 3-6 ifasha kureba niba kabasha gukomeza kororoka kari muri iyo miti. Ngabonziza ati “Usanga umurwayi ashobora kumara amezi atatu tutaramenya imiti neza yamuvura, cyane cyane iyo afite agakoko katumva imiti. Hari iyo ku rwego rwa mbere n’urwa kabiri. Iyo ku rwa mbere, tubibona byoroshye ariko iyo ku rwego rwa kabiri bisaba inzira ndende.” Nyuma yo kugakura muri iyo Laboratwari, kajyanwa mu yindi bareberamo uturemangingo [DNA] tukagize n’andi makuru akerekewe ndetse n’imiti yakwifashishwa mu kukavura. Mu 2018, OMS yatangaje ko abanyarwanda 57 ku bihumbi 100, (hafi 6900) bari barwaye igituntu mu gihe umwaka wawubanjirije bari 64 ku bihumbi 100 (7 680). Bivuze ko bagabanutseho hafi 700. Mu myaka itanu ishize, abakirwaye bagabanutseho nibura 8% buri mwaka. Ibi bitanga icyizere gikomeye ko bikomeje uko, u Rwanda rwazesa umuhigo rwihaye mu ntego z’iterambere rirambye (2030) ko ruzaba rwagabanyije 80% by’abakirwaye. [email protected]

title: Ibihe by’ubushyuhe bishobora kongera ibyago byo kuba umugore yabyara umwana utagejeje igihe
content: Ni ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’abarimu babiri bo muri kaminuza zo muri leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika Alan Barreca na Jessamyn Schaller aho bakoze ubusesenguzi ku makuru y’abana miliyoni 56 bavutse muri Amerika hagati yo mu 1969 na 1988. Ubu bushakashatsi bwagiye hanze ku wa Mbere bugaragaza ko igihe muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ubushyuhe bwari kuri 32°C umubare w’abana bavuka wazamutse ku kigero cya 5%, ndetse bigakomeza kwiyongera no mu minsi yakurikiyeho, gusa ubushyuhe bumaze kugabanuka n’umubare w’abana bavuka nawo waramanutse. N’ubwo 5% bishobora kumvikana nk’umubare muto, ubu bushakashatsi bugaragaza ko mu gihe cy’imyaka 20, kubera ubushyuhe muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika buri mwaka havuka abana 25 000 batagejeje igihe. Muri ubu bushakashatsi abagore benshi bagiye babyara mbere y’iminsi itandatu ku gihe cyari giteganyijwe abandi babyara mbere ho ibyumweru bibiri. Umwe mu bakoze ubu bushakashatsi Alan Barreca,  avuga ko hari impungege z’uko iyi mibare izagenda yiyongera kuko ubushyuhe nabwo bukomeje kwiyongera. Ati “Tubona hari ibyago ko mu mpera z’ikinyejana umwana umwe  mu bana ijana muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika azajya avuga atagejeje igihe, iyi mibare ishobora kugaragara nk’aho ari mito ariko irenze ibyago umuntu aba afite byo kuba yakora impanuka mu modoka”. N’ubwo ubu bushakashatsi butagaragaza neza isano iri hagati yo kwiyongera k’ubushyuhe no kubyara igihe kitaragera, buvuga ko ubushyuhe bushyira igitutu ku mikorere y’umutima ndetse no kwiyongera ku musemburo wa Oxytocin, ibi byose bikaba byatuma umugore abyara igihe kitageze. Bivugwa ko umugore yabyaye igihe kitageze, igihe yabyaye ku cyumweru cya 37 cyangwa mbere yaho, ndetse umwana wavutse iyo abashije kubaho aba afite ibyago byinshi byo guhura n’ibibazo by’uburwayi birimo kwangirika kw’ibihaha, ibibazo by’umutima, ibibazo by’igogora ndetse n’ibibazo mu mikorere y’ubwonko ugereranyije n’umwana wavukiye igihe.

title: Ubuhamya buburira bwa Usanase wakize kanseri y’inkondo y’umura
content: Usanase mu 2017 nibwo yamenye ko yafashwe na kanseri y’inkondo y’umura, indwara ihangayikishije Isi n’u Rwanda by’umwihariko. Ikigo gishinzwe Ubuzima mu Rwanda (RBC) kigaragaza ko umwaka ushize habonetse abarwayi 362 bafite kanseri y’inkondo y’umura. Iyi kanseri iri ku mwanya wa mbere mu Rwanda mu zihitana abantu benshi, ariko iyo umugore ayibonye kare arivuza kandi agakira. Ibi bifite urufatiro no mu buhamya bwa Usanase. Usanase yasangije abitabiriye inama yahuje abafatanyabikorwa batandukanye harebwa ingamba n’ubufatanye byashyirwaho kugira ngo harandurwe iyi kanseri y’inkondo y’umura, yabereye muri Marriott Hotel kuri uyu wa Kabiri, tariki ya 3 Ukuboza 2019. Ni inama yitabiriwe na Madamu Jeannette Kagame, abafasha b’abakuru b’ibihugu barimo uwa Botswana, Niger, Tchad n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa. Iri muri gahunda z’Inama mpuzamahanga yiga kuri SIDA n’izindi ndwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina (ICASA) iri kubera i Kigali. Usanase yagarutse ku rugendo rwe rwo kumenya ko arwaye kanseri y’inkondo y’umura n’uko yakurikiye amabwiriza ya muganga. Yagize ati “Nafashwe mu Ugushyingo 2017, mu gufatwa ni uko nta mihango nari nkijyamo kuko murabona ko nkuze. Nabonye akenda k’imbere karanduye biranyobera, nahise nihitura kujya ku kigo nderabuzima banyohereza mu Bitaro bya CHUK.” Yakomeje ati “Ngezeyo baransuzumye bambwira ko ndwaye kanseri, nakubiswe n’inkuba mbabaza ukuntu nje ndi muzima bakaba bambwiye ko ndwaye kanseri.” Usanase avuga ko icyamutabaye ni uko hari umwana wari wamuherekeje, abaganga bahamagaye baba ariwe babwira ikibazo afite. Avuga ko CHUK nayo yamwohereje ku bitaro bivura indwara za kanseri biherereye  i Butaro. Ati “Nyuma y’ibyumweru bibiri bampaye igisubizo ko ndwaye kanseri ariko itaragera kure, bambwiye ko ndi muri kabiri bityo  ko nshobora gukira, ubwo nibwo ubwenge bwagarutse.” Usanase avuga ko buri kwezi yajyaga i Butaro agafata imiti ndetse agaterwa inshinge, bigeza aho kanseri ishiririzwa arakira.  	Inama ku babyeyi zo kwisuzumisha Usanase yavuze ko ababyeyi bakwiye kujya bipimisha kare, ntibavuge ngo ni amafumbi barwaye cyangwa ngo bararozwe. Yagize ati “Ibyo by’amafumbi ni ibiki? Abaganga barabyize kandi bafite ibyuma. Mu gihe tubonye akantu kadasanzwe tujye tujya kwa muganga tureke kuvuga ngo baraturoze, kanseri ntigomba kudutera ubwoba kuko irakira.” Imibare igaragaza ko mu Rwanda hamaze kubarurwa abarwaye kanseri y’inkondo y’umura 1304, n’abagore 921 yahitanye. Kugeza ubu kandi abakobwa 93% uhereye ku myaka 12 bamaze guhabwa urukingo rwa kanseri y’inkondo y’umura. Kanseri y’inkondo y’umura ishyirwa ku mwanya wa kabiri muri Afurika mu zikunze kwibasira abagore kandi zikica benshi, mu Rwanda ho iza ku mwanya wa mbere. Agakoko ka Human Papillomavirus (HPV) kihariye 99.7% mu gutera kanseri y’inkondo y’umura.

title: Udukingirizo dusaga miliyoni eshatu twiganjemo utw’abagore tuzakwirakwizwa mu Rwanda mu 2020
content: Ni itangazo ryatanzwe mu gihe u Rwanda rwakiriye Inama Mpuzamahanga yiga ku Cyorezo cya Sida n’Indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina muri Afurika, ICASA. Iyi nama iri kuba ku nshuro ya 20 yatangiye kuri uyu wa 2 Ukuboza, izasozwa ku wa 7 Ukuboza 2019. Buri mwaka, udukingirizo turenga miliyoni 20 dukwirakwizwa mu Rwanda bigizwemo uruhare na Guverinoma n’indi miryango y’ubuzima. Muri two miliyoni 15 zigurishwa mu maduka, miliyoni eshanu zigakoreshwa mu bajyanama b’ubuzima n’amavuriro, miliyoni imwe n’igice tugafatirwa mu tuzu twabugenewe aho dutangirwa ubuntu. AHF isanzwe itanga udukingirizo miliyoni eshatu buri mwaka yavuze ko izatwongera ndetse mu mwaka utaha izaha umwihariko utw’abagore. Umuyobozi wa AHF Rwanda, Dr Brenda Asiimwe Kateera, yabwiye KT Press ko “Muri uyu mwaka twarengeje intego yacu yo gutanga udukingirizo miliyoni eshatu. Twahisemo kongera umubare w’udukingirizo by’umwihariko twibanda ku tw’abagore kuko aritwo tubura mu gihugu.’’ AHF itangaza ko ubwitabire bw’abagabo bagura udukingirizo bugera kuri 80% mu gihe abagore bari kuri 20%. Ubushakashatsi bwo muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda mu 2012, bwasanze impamvu ya mbere ituma udukingirizo tw’abagore tudakoreshwa cyane iterwa n’uko tugira urusaku igihe cy’imibonano mpuzabitsina ndetse kugakoresha bisaba kugafata ku buryo ukarekuye gashobora no kumuhera mu gitsina. Icyemezo cyo kongera udukingirizo, AHF yagifashe nyuma yuko muri Nyakanga urubyiruko rwihariye umubare munini w’abafashe udukingirizo mu Imurikagurisha Mpuzamahanga ryabereye i Gikondo  ryitabiriwe n’abasaga 400 000. Mu byumweru bibiri ryamaze, urubyiruko rwafataga udukingirizo turenga 20,000 buri munsi mu gihe hari hateganyijwe udupaki 600,000. Mu kongera uburyo bw’ubwirinzi bwa SIDA, AHF yafunguye ahantu hatanu hatangirwa udukingirizo tw’ubuntu mu Mujyi wa Kigali harimo Nyamirambo, Remera-Migina, Gikondo na Nyabugogo Ubusanzwe udukingirizo tugurishwa 100 Frw na 300 Frw muri farumasi, utubyiniro na hoteli. Nubwo gukoresha agakingirizo ari bumwe mu bwirinzi kuri SIDA, imibare igaragaza ko ubwandu bushya bukiri hejuru, aho abantu 80, 000 biganjemo urubyiruko bandura. Raporo y’Ubushakashatsi bwa RPHIA (Rwanda Population HIV Impact Assessment) yo muri Nzeri 2019 yerekanye ko mu Rwanda abafite ubwandu bwa Virusi itera SIDA ari 3%; abari hagati y’imyaka 15 na 45 bageze kuri 2.6%. Iyo nyigo igaragaza ko abagore aribo banduye (3.7%) kurusha abagabo (2.2%). Abahanga mu by’ubuzima bagaragaje ko usibye kuba agakingirizo kifashishwa mu kurinda inda zitateguwe, kanarinda indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina kuri 98%.

title: Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ingaruka zo kuba telefone yarabaye nk’ikiyobyabwenge ku rubyiruko
content: Ubu bushakashatsi bwakorewe muri King’s College London, buvuga ko kubera uko kubatwa, urubyiruko ruta umutwe iyo hagize igituma bamburwa uburenganzira bwo kuba bafite telefone. Abakoze ubwo bushakashatsi bavuze ko bigeze aho urubyiruko rudashobora kumenya no kugenzura amasaha rumara ruri kuri telefone, nkuko BBC yabitangaje. Ubushakashatsi bwaburiye abantu ko iyo myitwarire ifite ingaruka zikomeye ku buzima bwo mu mutwe mu rubyiruko. Ubwo bushakashatsi bwatangajwe mu kinyamakuru BMC Psychiatry, bwakoze inyigo 42 zirimo urubyiruko 42 000, harebwa ibijyanye n’imikoreshereze ya telefone zigezweho. Mu bakoreweho ubushakashatsi, 23 % basanze bafite imyitwarire imeze nk’iy’abakoresha ibiyobyabwenge iyo habayeho kubima umwanya wo gukoresha telefone zabo. Basanze ko abo bantu batabasha kwihanganira kubaho badafite telefone zabo ku buryo bigira ingaruka no ku bindi bikorwa bakabaye bakora. Umwe mu bakoze ubushakashatsi, Nicola Kalk yavuze ko abantu bakwiriye kumenya ingaruka zo gukoresha telefone cyane. Yavuze ko kugeza ubu bataramenya niba telefone igezweho ubwayo ariyo ntandaro yo kuba imbata z’abayikoresha cyangwa niba ari porogaramu zibamo abantu bakoresha. Yagiriye inama ababyeyi n’urubyiruko by’umwihariko, kumenya neza uburyo abana bakoresha telefone, igihe gikwiriye bagombva kuba bari kumwe nazo n’ingaruka bishobora kubakururira. Samantha Sohn na we wagize uruhare mu bushakashatsi, yavuze ko gukoresha telefone zigezweho cyane bishobora guteza ikibazo cyo mu mutwe, bityo ko hakwiriye ubushakashatsi bwimbitse.

title: Kipharma yazanye amavuta azafasha abafite inkovu n’amaribori bibabangamiye
content: Bio-Oil ni amavuta akorwa n’uruganda Union Swiss rwo muri Afurika y’Epfo, akoreshwa n’umuntu ushaka kugabanya uburyo inkovu n’amaribori bigaragara, no gukuraho ibibara mu maso ndetse umuntu akaba ashobora kuyisiga bisanzwe. Uyasiga ahantu ukeneye ko habaho impinduka, ugasiga uhibanda [massage]  kabiri ku munsi ukabikora nibura mu mezi atatu. Ku mugore utwite ushaka ko amaribori atagaragara atangira kuyisiga mu gihembwe cya kabiri. Ubwo yasobanuriraga abakora muri za farumasi zitandukanye imikoreshereze y’ayo mavuta, kuri uyu wa Gatanu, inzobere mu byo kubaga (Plastic Surgery) Dr. Michael G Rebeiro, yibukije ko nubwo ayo mavuta afasha cyane adasibanganya inkovu burundu. Ati “Inkovu waba ufite yose icyo Bio-Oil ikora ni ukuyigabanya kugeza ku kigero gito gishoboka cy’uko igaragara, ntabwo asibanganya inkovu.” Impinduka zishobora kugaragara ku bantu mu bihe bitandukanye bitewe n’imiterere y’imibiri yabo. Regine Uwitonze ushinzwe iyamamazabikorwa yavuze ko Kipharma ariyo ihagarariye Union Swiss mu Rwanda. Ati “Ntabwo tuyacuruza hano mu Rwanda gusa ahubwo Kipharma niyo yemerewe kuyaranguza (distributeur). Iyo ufashe ririya cupa ugasoma ubona ko amavuta akorwa na Union Swiss naho uyakwirakwiza mu Rwanda ari Kipharma. ” Aya mavuta ari mu mapaki atandukanye arimo irya Mililitiro 25 (ml 25) irya Mililitiro 60 (ml 60) na Mililitiro 125 (ml 125). Igerageza ku ikoreshwa ry’ayo mavuta ryakozwe mu 2010 ryerekanye ko 92% bagaragaje impinduka z’uburyo inkovu zigaragara mu byumweru umunani. Amaribori mu byumweru umunani yari amaze guhinduka 100% naho 93% bari bafite amabara ku ruhu bagaragaje impinduka mu byumweru bitandatu.

title: Cameroun yagaragayemo umurwayi wa Coronavirus, Amavubi ashobora kutitabira CHAN 2020
content: CHAN 2020 izabera muri Cameroun guhera tariki ya 4 kugeza ku ya 25 Mata, izitabirwa n’ibihugu 16 birimo u Rwanda ruzaba ruri mu itsinda C hamwe na Maroc, Uganda na Togo. Itangazo ryashyizwe hanze na Minisiteri y’Ubuzima muri Cameroun kuri uyu wa Gatanu, rivuga ko muri icyo gihugu hagaragayemo umurwayi wanduye coronavirus. Rigira riti “Minisiteri y’Ubuzima iremeza  ko hari umurwayi wa COVID-19 ku butaka bwa Cameroun. Ni umuturage w’Umufaransa w’imyaka 58 wageze i Yaoundé tariki ya 24 Gashyantare 2020.” Iri tangazo rikomeza rivuga ko hashyizweho ingamba zikomeye zo gukurikirana ibijyanye n’iki cyorezo, akaba ari nayo mpamvu havumbuwe ko hari uyu murwayi washyizwe mu kato mu bitaro bikuru bya Yaoundé kugira ngo yitabweho. Minisiteri y’Ubuzima muri Cameroun yasabye abatuye icyo gihugu, kurushaho gukurikiza amabwiriza ajyanye n’isuku mu rwego rwo kwirinda iki cyorezo gihangayikishije abatari bake ku Isi. Amavubi ashobora kutitabira CHAN 2020 Ikipe y’Igihugu ‘Amavubi’ y’abakina imbere mu gihugu, ishobora kutitabira CHAN 2020 izabera muri Cameroun kubera iki cyorezo cya COVID-19 cyatangiye kuhavugwa. Umwe mu myanzuro yafatiwe mu nama yahuje Minisiteri ya Siporo, ingaga za siporo n’amashyirahamwe y’imikino mu Rwanda kuri uyu wa Kane,  uvuga ko mu rwego rwo kwirinda iki cyorezo, abakinnyi n’amakipe yagombaga guhagararira igihugu mu mikino mpuzamahanga, agomba kwirinda kujya mu bihugu bivugwamo COVID-19. Hemejwe ko kandi ku mikino n’ibindi bikorwa bihurirwaho n’abantu benshi, hashyirwaho uburyo bufasha abantu kugira isuku ndetse hakanatangwa ubutumwa bubakangurira kwirinda iki cyorezo. Ahandi byifashe gute? Muri Maroc, imikino yaho ya Shampiyona isigaye ibera mu muhezo mu rwego rwo kwirinda iki cyorezo gikomeje guhitana abantu. Mu Bushinwa, aho cyahereye, ibikorwa byose by’imikino byarahagaritswe mu gihe mu Butaliyani, imikino imwe yagiye isubikwa kubera iki cyorezo. Mu Bwongereza, bafashe icyemezo cyo gukuraho ibyo gusuhuzanya kw’abakinnyi mbere y’uko umukino utangira.

title: Uko Abakinnyi b’Abanyarwanda bigabanyije hafi miliyoni 7 Frw basaruye muri Tour du Rwanda 2020
content: Tour du Rwanda 2020 yabaye hagati ya tariki ya 23 Gashyantare n’iya 1 Werurwe, ni yo abakinnyi b’Abanyarwanda bitwayemo neza kuva iri siganwa mpuzamahanga  ry’amagare rigiye ku rwego rwa 2.1 mu mwaka ushize. Mugisha Moïse ni we Munyarwanda waje hafi, aho yabaye uwa kabiri, akurikira Umunya-Erythrée Natnael Tesfatsion. Ibihembo byose byatanzwe mu isiganwa ry’uyu mwaka, byari bifite ingengo y’imari ingana n’ibihumbi 45€, ni ukuvuga asaga gato miliyoni 48 Frw. Aya yavuyemo ayahembwe abakinnyi 20 ba mbere kuri buri gace mu duce umunani twakinwe, aho uwa mbere yahabwaga 1250€ (asaga gato miliyoni 1.3 Frw), mu gihe uwa 20 yahabwaga 20€ angana n’ibihumbi 20 Frw. Uwegukanye isiganwa (Natnael Tesfatsion) yahawe kandi ibihumbi 3250€, Mugisha Moïse wa kabiri ahabwa ibihumbi 2200€ kugeza k’uwabaye uwa 20 ku rutonde rusange, we wahawe 50€. Ibyiciro birimo umukinnyi uzi kuzamuka imisozi kurusha abandi, uzi kuvuduka kurusha abandi, ukiri muto witwaye neza, uwahatanye kurusha abandi, Umunyafurika n’Umunyarwanda bitwaye neza, byahembwe hagati ya 350€ na 100€ kuva ku wa mbere kugeza ku wa gatatu hashingiwe ku rutonde rusange, mu gihe ikipe ya mbere yahawe 1000€ naho iya gatanu igahabwa 100€. Restrepo Jhonatan ni we watahanye menshi Umunya-Colombia Jhonathan Restrepo wanaciye agahigo ko kwegukana uduce twinshi muri Tour du Rwanda imwe, ni we wakoreye amafaranga menshi mu isiganwa ry’uyu mwaka. Kwegukana uduce tune byinjirije Restrepo ibihumbi 5000€ ndetse kuba yaraje ku mwanya wa karindwi ku rutonde rusange byatumye ahabwa andi 550€. Aya yiyongeraho 720€ yakuye mu tundi duce dutatu atatwaye, ariko akaza mu myanya ihemberwa. Iyi mibare imushyira ku mwanya wa mbere n’ibihumbi 6260€ (miliyoni 6.714 Frw), aho arusha Umunya-Erythrée Natnael Tesfazion wegukanye isiganwa, ariko we akaba yaratahanye ibihumbi 6230€ (miliyoni 6.671) birimo 3250€ byo kuyobora urutonde rusange, 1250€ cy’uko yatwaye agace ka Rusizi-Rubavu, 700€ yo kwambara umwenda w’umukinnyi ukiri muto witwaye neza no kuba Umunyafurika mwiza. Amafaranga Abanyarwanda binjije muri Tour du Rwanda Mugisha Moïse ukinira SKOL Adrien Cycling Academy ni we Munyarwanda wasaruye menshi muri Tour du Rwanda 2020 n’ibihumbi 4070€, ni ukuvuga hafi miliyoni 4,3 Frw. Mugisha w’imyaka 22 yatsindiye 2200€ kuko yasoje ku mwanya wa kabiri ku rutonde rusange, 1070€ ku myanya yagiye asoreza ho mu duce twose uko ari umunani na 800€ mu myanya yasorejeho ku yindi myambaro ihatanirwa irimo uw’Umunyarwanda mwiza (yegukanye), Umunyafurika mwiza, umukinnyi ukiri muto n’umukinnyi ushoboye kuzamuka imisozi. Akurikiwe na Manizabayo Eric ‘Karadiyo’ wa Benediction Ignite, we watsindiye 700€ (hafi ibihumbi 750 Frw), Areruya Joseph (Team Rwanda) watsindiye 670€ na Munyaneza Didier ‘Mbappé’ (Benediction Ignite) wabaye umukinnyi wahatanye kurusha abandi, we yatsindiye 570€. Abandi Banyarwanda bahembwe kubera imyanya basorejeho mu duce twa Tour du Rwanda 2020 ni Mugisha Samuel wa Team Rwanda wahawe 240€, Byukusenge Patrick wa Benediction Ignite wahawe 190€, Hakizimana Seth wa Skol Adrien Cycling Academy watahanye 40€ na Gahemba Barnabé wa Team Rwanda watahanye 30€. Ni mu gihe ikipe y’igihugu y’u Rwanda (Team Rwanda) yahawe 100€ nk’iya gatanu mu makipe 16 yakinnye irushanwa uyu mwaka. Igiteranyo cy’amafaranga yose yatsindiwe n’Abanyarwanda mu isiganwa ry’uyu mwaka ni 6510€, ni ukuvuga miliyoni 6,9 Frw. Ibihembo abakinnyi n’amakipe atsindira mu masiganwa mpuzamahanga nk’aya, bishyirwa kuri konti y’Ishyirahamwe ry’Umukino w’Amagare ku Isi (UCI), rikaba ari ryo ribigeza ku babitsindiye. title: Police FC yandikiye FERWAFA ivuga ko yibwe mu mukino wayihuje na APR FC
content: Uyu mukino w’umunsi wa 21 wa Shampiyona wabereye kuri Stade ya Kigali, warangiye APR FC itsinze igitego 1-0. Mbere y’uko uwo munsi wa Shampiyona ukinwa, Komisiyo y’imisifurire muri FERWAFA, yari yatangaje ko uyu mukino uzayoborwa na Uwikunda Samuel, ariko mu buryo butunguranye, wayobowe na Twagirumukiza Abdul Karim. Kimwe mu byagarutsweho cyane kuri uyu mukino, ni umupira wakozwe n’ukuboko na myugariro wa APR FC, Buregeya Prince , wari uhinduwe na rutahizamu wa Police FC, Iyabivuze Osée mu rubuga rw’amahina. Bamwe mu bakurikiranye uyu mukino, babonaga ko ibi byabaye ku munota wa 20 byari kuvamo penaliti, abandi bakavuga ko umupira ari wo wakoze Buregeya Prince kuko bawumuteye mu  gihe umusifuzi Twagirumukiza Abdul Karim wari hafi y’aba bakinnyi bombi ntacyo yabikozeho, umukino urakomeza. Ubuyobozi bwa Police FC bwandikiye FERWAFA buvuga ko butishimiye imisifurire yaranze uyu mukino bwatsinzwemo na APR FC by’umwihariko n’umusifuzi akaba yarahinduwe ku munota wa nyuma. Bwagize buti “Tubandikiye kugira ngo tubagaragarize akarengane kabayeho mu mukino wabaye tariki ya 4 Werurwe 2020 ku munsi wa 21 wa Shampiyona, wahuje APR FC na Police FC kuri Stade ya Kigali. “Muri uyu mukino wavuzwe haruguru, hagaragaye amakosa y’abasifuzi barimo Abdul Twagirumukiza  wahindutse ku rutonde rw’abasifuzi bari bateganyijwe ku munota wa nyuma, aho abakinnyi batandukanye bagiye bakora amakosa akomeye, bakihanangirizwa inshuro zirenze enye, ariko ntibahabwe amakarita.” Bwakomeje bugira buti “Nk’uko bigaragara ku mashusho y’uwo mukino, aho umukinnyi Iyabivuze Osée wambara nimero 22, yateye umupira ukagaruzwa n’ukuboko na myugariro wa APR FC witwa Buregeya Prince, aho Police FC yagombaga kuhabonera penaliti ariko ntitwayihabwa.” “Turabasaba gusuzumana ubushishozi iri kosa ryakozwe n’abasifuzi bakaba bafatirwa ibihano kuko imisifurire imeze kuriya idafatiwe ibyemezo yadindiza iterambere ry’umupira w’amaguru.” Gutsindwa na APR FC byatumye Police FC itakaza umwanya wa kabiri, aho kuri ubu iri ku wa gatatu n’amanota 43, irushwa amanota umunani n’ikipe y’ingabo. Ikipe y’abashinzwe umutekano izagaruka mu kibuga ku Cyumweru, yakira AS Kigali mu mukino w’umunsi wa 22 wa Shampiyona. Police FC yaherukaga kwandikira FERWAFA ivuga ko yibwe, ku mukino yatsinzwemo na Rayon  Sports mu irushanwa ry’Agaciro 2019, aho umusifuzi Hakizimana Louis yahagaritswe ibyumweru bine mbere y’uko uyu mwaka w’imikino wa 2019/20 utangira. Reba ibihe by’ingenzi byaranze uyu mukino

title: APR FC yatsinze Police FC ikomeza kuyobora shampiyona y’u Rwanda (Amafoto)
content: Uyu mukino wahuje amakipe yombi y’abashinzwe umutekano, wari watezwe ikipe y’Ingabo yari idafite ba myugariro babiri igenderaho, Mutsinzi Ange wavunitse na Omborenga Fitina wari ufite amakarita atatu y’umuhondo. Amakipe yombi yakiniraga mu kibuga hagati mu minota ya mbere kugeza ubwo Usengimana Danny yafunguraga amazamu ku munota wa 13 ku mupira yaherejwe na Niyomugabo Claude. APR FC yatangiye gukinira inyuma mu gihe Police FC  yasatiraga cyane ndetse yashoboraga kubona igitego cyo kwishyura, uburyo bwabonywe na Iyabivuze Osée ntibwamuhira, atera umupira hejuru y’izamu. Mu gice cya kabiri abatoza bombi bakoze impinduka zinyuranye, aho ku ruhande rwa APR FC, Bukuru Christophe yasimbuwe na Butera Andrew mu gihe Byiringiro Lague wananiwe kubyaza umusaruro uburyo bubiri yabonye, yasimbuwe na Mugunga Yves. Ku ruhande rwa Police FC, Kubwimana Cédric yasimbuwe na Issa Bigirimana, Ntirushwa Aimé asimbura Ngendahimana Eric mu gihe Harerimana Obed yasimbuye Mico Justin. Mu minota ya nyuma, Police FC yashoboraga kwishyura igitego yatsinzwe, ariko Issa Bigirimana wari usigaranye n’umunyezamu Rwabugiri Umar, atereshwa umupira nabi na Buregeya Prince, ujya hejuru y’izamu. Gutsinda uyu mukino byafashije APR FC kugira amanota 51 ku mwanya wa mbere, irusha amanota arindwi Rayon Sports ya kabiri, yo yatsindiye Etincelles FC i Rubavu ibitego 2-1.  Police FC yagumanye amanota 43 ku mwanya wa gatatu. APR FC  izagaruka mu kibuga ku wa Gatandatu, yakirwa na Mukura Victory Sports mu gihe Police FC izakira AS Kigali mu mukino w’umunsi wa 22 wa Shampiyona. Uko amakipe yatsindanye ku munsi wa 21 wa Shampiyona Ku wa Kabiri tariki ya 3 Werurwe 2020 Ku wa Gatatu tariki ya 4 Werurwe 2020 Amafoto: Umurerwa Delphin

title: Sugira Ernest yafashije Rayon Sports kwikura i Rubavu
content: Umukino watangiye ikipe ya Etincelles igaragara ko yafunze inyuma, gusa ikajya igerageza kuzamuka gahoro mu gihe Rayon Sports yo yahanahanaga umupira hagati ariko kubasha kugera ku izamu rya Etincelles bikagorana kubera urukuta rw’ab’inyuma. Umukino waje guhinduka ku munota wa 16 ubwo Itangishaka Ibrahim, murumuna wa Nizeyimana Mirafa ukinira Rayon Sports, yatsindaga igitego  ku mupira mwiza wari utanzwe na Akayezu Jean Bosco. Ni igitego cyaturutse ahanini ku burangare bw’abinyuma ba Rayon Sports baketse ko habayeho kurarira. Ku  munota wa 31 w’umukino nibwo umutoza Cassa Mbungo André utoza Rayon Sports, yavanyemo Nizeyimana Mirafa amusimbuza Bizimana Yanick na we wahise avunika ku munota wa 36, asimburwa na Mugisha Gilbert. Igice cya mbere cyarangiye nta gihindute, Etincelles ikomeje kuyobora umukino n’igitego kimwe. Igice cya kabiri cyatangiye ikipe ya Etincelles yafunze inyuma idashaka gusatira, ibintu byatanze umwanya ku ikipe ya Rayon Sports, iyotsa igitutu nubwo  rutahizamu Sugira Erneste atabashije kubyaza umusaruro amahirwe yagiye abona. Uku gusatira kwa Rayon Sports kwavuyemo igitego cyatsinzwe na Sekamana Maximwe ku munota wa  72 w’umukino. Rayon Sports yakomeje kotsa igitutu ikipe ya Etincelles ni uko ku munota wa 81 Sugira Ernest atsinda igitego cy’intsinzi biturutse ku burangare bw’abinyuma ba Etincelles. Gutsinda uyu mukino byafashije Rayon Sports gufata umwanya wa kabiri n’amanota 44, ikomeza kurushwa amanota arindwi na APR FC ya mbere, yo yatsinze Police FC igitego 1-0. Rayon Sports izagaruka mu kibuga ku wa Gatandatu ihura na Musanze FC mu gihe Etincelles FC izakirwa na Marines FC zisangiye Stade Umuganda. Uko amakipe yatsindanye ku munsi wa 21 wa Shampiyona Ku wa Kabiri tariki ya 3 Werurwe 2020 Ku wa Gatatu tariki ya 4 Werurwe 2020

title: Umwe mu bakinnyi ba PSG ategerejwe i Kigali mu minsi iri imbere
content: Kaliza yabivuze mu kiganiro yagiranye n’itangazamakuru ubwo hasozwaga uruzinduko rw’umunyabigwi wa Paris Saint-Germain, Youri Raffi Djorkaeff wari umaze iminsi ine mu Rwanda. Djoerkaeff yageze i Kigali ku wa Gatandatu mu ruzinduko rw’iminsi ine nyuma y’aho u Rwanda rugiranye ubufatanye n’ikipe ya Paris Saint-Germain yo mu Bufaransa mu bijyanye n’Ubukerarugendo n’Iterambere.  Umuyobozi Mukuru muri RDB Ushinzwe ubukerarugendo na Pariki z’igihugu, Belise Kaliza, yavuze ko nyuma ya Djorkaeff u Rwanda rwitegura kwakira umwe mu bakinnyi b’ikipe ya mbere ya Paris Saint-Germain mu mezi abiri ari imbere. Abajijwe niba abantu bakwitega amwe mu mazina akomeye abarizwa muri iyi kipe yo mu Bufaransa, nka Neymar cyangwa Kylian Mbappé, abakinnyi babiri bahenze kurusha abandi ku Isi, Belise Kaliza yavuze ko ari bo batekerezwaho bwa mbere ariko hari byinshi bigenderwaho mu kwemeza umukinnyi uzaza. Ati “Iyo tuvuze ngo umukinnyi wo mu ikipe ya mbere muri PSG, bose tubafata kimwe. Wenda harimo abo abafana bakunda cyane, nibo tugerageza kuzana bwa mbere, ariko nk’uko mubizi hari ibintu byinshi bigenderwaho kugira ngo haboneke uza, bitewe n’uhari, uko ahagaze n’ibindi. Mutwihanganire, tuzababwira uzaza, turacyabinoza ariko nk’uko nabivuze ni muri uyu mwaka vuba cyane, mu kwezi kumwe cyangwa abiri araba yageze mu Rwanda.” RDB ivuga ko kumenyekanisha u Rwanda binyuze mu bantu bazwi ku Isi, ari igikorwa cyiza cyo kwerekana isura nziza y’u Rwanda. Mu bufatanye bw’u Rwanda na PSG bwatangiye mu Ukuboza umwaka ushize, ikirango cya Visit Rwanda kigaragazwa kuri Stade ya Parc des Princes aho PSG yakirira imikino yayo ndetse no ku mugongo ku myenda iyi kipe ikoresha mu myitozo no mu gihe cyo kwishyushya mbere y’imikino, yaba iyo yambara yasuye indi kipe cyangwa iyo yambara iwayo muri Shampiyona y’u Bufaransa, Ligue 1. Binyuze muri ubu bufatanye, ikipe ya Paris Saint-Germain izubaka ishuri ry’umupira w’amaguru mu Rwanda mu Karere ka Huye. Intumwa z’iyi kipe zari mu Rwanda mu mpera za Mutarama uyu mwaka muri gahunda zirebana n’uyu mushinga. Inkuru bifitanye isano: Icyo u Rwanda ruzungukira mu bufatanye na PSG n’impamvu rwaguye imbibi zikarenga ubukerarugendo.

title: Imikino ya Basketball Africa League yagombaga kubera i Dakar yasubitswe
content: BAL ni irushanwa ryatekerejwe ku bufatanye bwa Shampiyona ya Basketball ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika (NBA) n’Ishyirahamwe ry’uyu mukino ku Isi (FIBA). Perezida wa BAL, Amadou Gallo Fall yatangaje ko ‘nyuma y’inama zatanzwe na Guverinoma ya Sénégal, zigendeye ku mpungenge mu rwego rw’ubuzima kubera Coronavirus, gutangiza umwaka usanzwe wa BAL byasubitswe’. Amadou yakomeje avuga ko ababajwe no kuba umwaka usanzwe w’irushanwa rya BAL udatangiriye igihe wari uteganyirijwe ariko avuga ko hari icyizere ko uzatangizwa ku yindi tariki idatinze. Amakipe 12 meza y’ahatandukanye muri Afurika arimo Patriots BBC, yo mu Rwanda ni yo azakina iri rushanwa. Iyi mikino izahuza amakipe 12 izabera mu mijyi irimo Cairo (Misiri), Dakar (Sénégal), Lagos (Nigeria), Luanda (Angola), Rabat (Maroc) na Monastir (Tunisia). U Rwanda ni rwo ruzakira BAL Final 4 (izahuza amakipe ane mu cyiciro gisoza) n’Umukino wa nyuma byombi bizakinirwa i Kigali mu mpera za 2020. Imyambaro n’inkweto za NIKE na Jordan ni zo zizaba zemewe gukoreshwa muri iri rushanwa. NBA na FIBA kandi byanashyigikiye iri rushanwa binyuze mu gutanga ubufasha bukubiyemo amafaranga, gutoza abakinnyi, guhugura abatoza n’abasifuzi no kubaka ibikorwa remezo bizifashishwa muri BAL.

title: Youri Djorkaeff yasangije abana urugendo rwe muri ruhago n’uburyo yishimiye u Rwanda
content: Youri Djorkaeff watwaranye n’Ikipe y’u Bufaransa Igikombe cy’Isi mu 1998, ari mu Rwanda guhera ku wa Gatandatu, aho yaje mu rwego rw’ubufatanye u Rwanda rwagiranye na Paris Saint-Germain binyuze muri Visit Rwanda. Uyu mugabo w’imyaka 51, mu minsi amaze mu Rwanda, yatembereye ibice binyuranye by’igihugu birimo Pariki y’Igihugu y’Akagera n’iy’Ibirunga, areba imisozi n’ibindi byiza bitatse u Rwanda birimo n’ibiyaga. Yasuye kandi Ikigo Nyafurika kigamije guteza imbere umukino w’Amagare cyubatse mu Murenge wa Nyange mu Karere ka Musanze. Ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kabiri, Djorkaeff yabonanye n’abana muri Kigali Convention Centre, abasangiza urugendo rwe mu mupira w’amaguru n’icyamufashije kuvamo umukinnyi ukomeye. Youri Djorkaeff yavuze ko yakuze se akinira Paris Saint-Germain (akaba ari na we wabaye kapiteni wayo wa mbere), aho yamujyanaga ku kibuga afite imyaka itandatu bituma na we atangira gukunda iyi kipe. Yasabye abana b’Abanyarwanda kugira umuhate mu byo bakora no kumvira ababyeyi babo kuko ari byo bizabafasha kugera ku byo bifuza. Ati “Twatembereye igihugu cyose kugira ngo kuri uyu mugoroba tube turi kumwe namwe. Ni ibyishimo kuri njye kubera ko ndebye ku maso yanyu, mbona ko mukiri bato kandi ndakeka ko icy’ingenzi cyakabashishikaje atari njye, ahubwo iyi kipe iri hano, Paris Sanit-Germain. Nishimiye kubona Abanyarwanda kandi nasanze abenshi ari urubyiruko.” “Iyo ufite inzozi n’umuhate wo gukora ikintu nubwo hari abakubwira ko bidasoboka, wowe jya wumva ko bishoboka. Niba wizeye ko bishoboka nta muntu wakakubwiye ko bitakunda. Icy’ingenzi ni ukwigirira icyizere, kubaha no kumvira ababyeyi, abatoza cyangwa abarimu kuko baba bakwifuriza icyiza.” Mu Ukuboza umwaka ushize, RDB yatangiye ubufatanye n’Ikipe ya Paris St Germain buzamara imyaka itatu bugamije kureshya abashoramari no gukomeza kuba icyerekezo kibereye ubukerarugendo. RDB yatangaje ko ubu bufatanye buzafasha abakurikira PSG n’Isi muri rusange kumenya ubwiza bw’u Rwanda, umuco n’udushya twaruhangwamo kimwe n’ibicuruzwa bigezweho birukorerwamo bya ’Made in Rwanda’. Ubu bufatanye kandi bwitezweho kurushaho gufungurira amarembo abashoramari bo mu Bufaransa no mu bindi bice by’Isi ku buryo babyaza umusaruro amahirwe aboneka mu Rwanda. Ibinyujije ku rubuga rwayo rwa Twitter, Paris Saint-Germain yashyize hanze amashusho yaranze urugendo rwa Djorkaeff mu Rwanda, ishimira u Rwanda uburyo yakiriye uyu munyabigwi wayo. 🎦🇷🇼 @visitrwanda_now Merci au Rwanda pour cet accueil chaleureux et cette expérience inoubliable pour notre #PSGLegend @youridjorkaeff ! ❤️💙 🌄 #VisitRwanda pic.twitter.com/vNfxGJmKCs — Paris Saint-Germain (@PSG_inside) March 3, 2020 Binyuze muri ubu bufatanye, Paris Saint-Germain izubaka ishuri ry’umupira w’amaguru mu Karere ka Huye.

title: SACA yitabiriye Tour du Rwanda bwa mbere ikitwara neza yashimiye Skol
content: SACA ni ikipe nshya iri ku rwego rwo gukina amarushanwa yo ku mugabane “continental “ yashinzwe mu rwego rwo guteza imbere impano z’Abanyarwanda bakina umukino w’amagare. Iyi kipe iri mu byishimo bikomeye nyuma y’uko umukinnyi wayo  Mugisha Moïse yasoje ku mwanya wa kabiri ku rutonde rusange ku nshuro ya mbere iyi kipe yitabiriye Tour du Rwanda ndetse akaba ari naryo siganwa rya mbere yari ikinnye. Mugisha Moïse (SACA) yasoje ku mwanya wa kabiri inyuma ya Natnael Tesfatsion wegukanye Tour du Rwanda 2020 aho mu bilometero 889.2 yakoresheje 23h13’01”amurusha 54” mu gihe ku mwanya wa gatatu hasoje Umusuwisi Schelling Patrick ukinira Israel Start-up Nation wakoresheje 23h14’33’’. Umutoza wa SACA, Adrien Niyonshuti, yabwiye IGIHE ko nyuma ya Tour du Rwanda bagiye gukaza imyitozo ku buryo bakwitwara neza mu yandi marushanwa bazitabira mu myaka iri mbere bakazaba bari ku rwego rukomeye cyane. Agaruka ku ntsinzi babonye muri Tour du Rwanda, Niyonshuti, yashimiye cyane umuyobozi wa Skol, Ivan Wulffaert, n’uruganda muri rusange. Yagize ati “Turateganya kuzitabira Tour du Rwanda ya 2025 dufite abakinnyi bafite ubumenyi buhagije, by’umwihariko umuyobozi wa Skol, Ivan, yakoze byinshi bishoboka. Muri Tour du Rwanda twari dufite amagare afite umuvuduko wa 12.  Dufite ibikoresho by’umwihariko,  urumva rero kugira umufatanyabikorwa nka Skol ni ibintu by’agaciro.” Uruganda rwa Skol narwo rwishimiye umusaruro ikipe yabonye, runizeza kurushaho guteza imbere abanyempano mu mukino wo gusiganwa ku magare. Benurugo Emilienne ushinzwe Iyamamazabikorwa muri Skol, yavuze ko bafatanyije n’abafatanyabikorwa babo, bakora ku buryo abakinnyi babona ibyangombwa nkenerwa byatumye batekereza ku ntsinzi gusa. Ati “Twiyegereje abantu bafite ubushobozi bwo kwigisha abana, tuba hafi yabo ubundi tubahereza n’ubushobozi kuko burya iyo umuntu ubumuhaye biramufasha cyane kuko nta kindi aba atekereza kitari ugukina agatsinda.” Yanashimangiye ko kugira umuntu umenyereye amagare nka Adrien Niyonshuti no guhabwa ubufasha biri mu byafashije ikipe ya SACA kwitwara neza. Ati “Kuba umutoza wabo Adrien yarabanye nabo n’ikipe yose imufasha noneho natwe Skol tukamuhereza ubwo bufasha; ari amagare, ari ibikoresho bindi bitandukanye, nicyo cyatumye babasha kwitwara neza nubwo bamaze igihe gitoya batangiye.” Muri Tour du Rwanda, SACA yaserukiwe n’abakinnyi batanu barimo Mugisha Moïse wari na Kapiteni wayo, Nsengiyumva Shemu, Hakizimana Seth, Dukuzumurenyi Fidel na Habimana Jean Eric. Mu makipe 13, SACA yasoje ku mwanya wa cyenda. Skol Adrien Cycling Academy (SACA) ikomoka kuri Adrien Niyonshuti Cycling Team yavutse mu 2007 hamwe n’umuterankunga ukomeye Skol ni ikipe ifite icyerekezo kandi itanga icyizere. Nyuma ya Tour du Rwanda 2020, SACA iteganya kwitabira andi masiganwa arimo Tour de l’Egypte, Tour de Limpopo, Tour du Cameroun, Tour du Sénégal n’ayandi atandukanye. SACA igizwe n’abakinnyi 12, yabaye ikipe ya kabiri yo mu Rwanda iri ku rwego rwo gukina amasiganwa yo ku mugabane nyuma ya Benediction Ignite y’i Rubavu, yashyizwe muri iki cyiciro mu mwaka ushize. title: AS Kigali yatsinze AS Muhanga, Gasogi United itsindira Kiyovu Sports ku Mumena (Amafoto)
content: AS Muhanga imaze iminsi ivugwamo amikoro make, yatsinzwe imikino yose yakinnye kuva mu ntangiriro z’umwaka wa 2020. AS Kigali yatsinze imikino itatu iheruka gukina muri Shampiyona, yari ihagaze neza muri uyu mukino ariko ibura amahirwe y’igitego mu minota 45 ibanza. Igitego kimwe cyabonetse muri uyu mukino, cyatsinzwe na Ishimwe Christian ku mupira w’umuterekano, ku munota wa 70, ubwo yahanaga ikosa ryakorewe kuri Nsabimana Eric ‘Zidane’ winjiye asimbura. Gutsinda uyu mukino, byafashije AS Kigali gufata umwanya wa gatandatu n’amanota 29 mu gihe AS Muhanga yasubiye inyuma, ikajya ku mwanya wa 11 n’amanota 22. Mu yindi mikino yabaye uyu munsi, Mukura Victory Sports yari yakiriye Heroes FC i Huye, iyitsinda igitego 1-0 cya Iradukunda Bertrand, cyatumye igira amanota 37 ku mwanya wa kane. Gicumbi FC yavuye ku mwanya wa nyuma, inganya amanota 15 na Heroes FC ya 16, ni nyuma yo gutsindira Espoir FC iwayo igitego 1-0. Gasogi United yatsindiwe na Kaneza Augustin, yafashe umwanya wa cyenda n’amanota 25 nyuma yo gutsindira Kiyovu Sports ku Mumena igitego 1-0. Shampiyona y’u Rwanda izakomeza ku wa Gatatu, ahateganyijwe imikino ine, aho APR FC izakira Police FC kuri Stade ya Kigali; Sunrise FC igacakirana na Musanze FC i Nyagatare; Etincelles FC yakire Rayon Sports i Rubavu mu gihe Bugesera FC izakira Marines FC. title: Yarebye Tour du Rwanda asesa urumeza! Urugendo rwa Amina rwongereye icyizere cyo kwakira Shampiyona y’Isi
content: Niko byagenze ku Muyobozi Mukuru w’Ishyirahamwe ry’Umukino w’Amagare ku Isi (UCI), Amina Lanaya. Yatunguwe n’ubwitabire bw’abafana bihebeye umukino w’amagare. Ku mihanda yose kuva i Kigali kugera i Rusizi uhasanga abakunzi b’uyu mukino biteguye kuyareba. Yageze kwa Mutwe ahazwi nka Mur de Kigali ho avuga ko ibyo yahaboneye aho kuva ku bana bato kugera ku basaza bakuru byatumye asesa urumeza. Mu magambo ye ntiyajijinganyije kugaragaza ko imitegurire ya Tour du Rwanda ihambaye ndetse irebwa cyane [n’abari ku mihanda] kurusha amarushanwa akomeye yitabiriye arimo ayo mu Bubiligi no mu Bufaransa. Amina Lanaya yasutse amarangamutima ye ku buryo Tour du Rwanda 2020 yagenze, aca amarenga ko ibyo yiboneye ubwe bitanga icyizere ko igihugu cyakwakira Shampiyona y’Isi y’Amagare mu 2025 Amina Lanaya wageze mu Rwanda ku wa 28 Gashyantare 2020, yarebye iminsi ibiri ya nyuma y’isiganwa mpuzamahanga rizenguruka u Rwanda ku magare, ryegukanywe n’Umunya-Erythrée Natnael Tesfatsion. Amina Lanaya ukomoka muri Maroc yabaye Umuyobozi wa UCI muri Gashyantare 2018 asimbuye Martin Gibbs. Uruzinduko rwe rwari rugamije kureba aho u Rwanda rugeze rwitegura kwakira Shampiyona y’Isi y’umukino w’amagare izaba mu 2025. Muri Nzeri 2019 nibwo u Rwanda rwatanze ibisabwa byose, rusaba ko rwazakira Shampiyona y’Isi y’Amagare izabera muri Afurika, rukaba ruhanganye na Maroc. Biteganyijwe ko igihugu kizemererwa kuyakira kizatangazwa muri Nzeri 2020. Ku bijyanye n’aho yasanze u Rwanda ruhagaze rwitegura, Amina Lanaya, yashimye aho bigeze, ashimangira ko rufite imihanda myiza kandi ko n’Abanyarwanda bihebeye umukino w’amagare. Amina Lanaya wakiriwe na Guverineri w’Intara y’Amajyaruguru Gatabazi Jean Marie Vianney, yasuye Ikigo gitorezwamo abakinnyi b’umukino w’amagare mu Rwanda (Africa Rising Cycling Center) giherereye mu Murenge wa Nyange mu Karere ka Musanze, bagirana ibiganiro byatuma ARCC iba mpuzamahanga. Yanasuye Centre Culturel Ibyiwacu iherereye mu Kinigi, aho yasobanuriwe ibijyanye n’umuco Nyarwanda wo hambere. Mu butumwa bwa mbere yanyujije kuri Twitter ye, Amina yavuze ko “Nishimiye kuba mu Rwanda kuganira ku iterambere ry’umukino w’amagare bijyanye na kandidatire yarwo yo kwakira Shampiyona y’Isi y’amagare mu 2025.’’ Very pleased to be in Rwanda to discuss cycling development in line with @cyclingrwanda candidature for the 2025 UCI Road World Championships! Great first meeting @arccRwanda with President of @cyclingrwanda @AbdallahMurenz2 and Governor of the Northern Province @gatjmv pic.twitter.com/oyXVnLnczy — Amina Lanaya (@Amina_Lanaya) February 29, 2020 Amina nyuma yo kwitabira Agace ka Karindwi ka Tour du Rwanda kakiniwe i Nyamirambo ku wa 29 Gashyantare 2020, yagaragaje ko yanyuzwe n’ubwitabire bw’Abanyarwanda. Ati "Tour du Rwanda yagenze neza mu mihanda ya Kigali aho abantu bakinaga basiganwa n’ibihe (Individual Time Trial). Ni isiganwa ririmo umurava udasanzwe.’’ Incredible success of the @tour_du_rwanda in the streets of Kigali for the individual time trial. So much enthusiasm and fervor along the course! pic.twitter.com/M636BXVMLb — Amina Lanaya (@Amina_Lanaya) February 29, 2020 Nyuma ya Tour du Rwanda, Amina yanditse amagambo agaragaza kunyurwa n’uburyo isiganwa ryagenze. Ati “Warakoze cyane Perezida [Murenzi] ku butumire wampaye. Hakozwe akazi keza mu mitegurire ya Tour du Rwanda. Ndanashimira Minisitiri wa Siporo, Munyangaju Aurore Mimosa n’Umuyobozi w’Umujyi wa Kigali, Rubingisa Pudence ku rugwiro rwabo.Tuzasubira umwaka utaha, kandi amahirwe masa mu birori bya Shampiyona y’Isi y’amagare.’’ Thank you very much Mr President for your invitation! Amazing job achieved in the delivery of the @tour_du_rwanda.Thanks also to Min. of Sports @auroremimosa & Mayor @PudenceR for their hospitality. See you next year, and 🤞 for the 2025 UCI Road World Championships awarding! https://t.co/0Jx5BBEpYb pic.twitter.com/yQrUuIMdR5 — Amina Lanaya (@Amina_Lanaya) March 1, 2020 Uruzinduko rwa Amina mu Rwanda n’ibikorwa yahakoreye biratanga icyizere ntayegayezwa cyo kwemerera urwa Gasabo kwakira Shampiyona y’Isi mu mukino w’amagare umaze kwigarurira imitima ya benshi. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na RFI, Amina yashimangiye ko UCI yafashe icyemezo cyo guha igihugu cya Afurika kwakira ku nshuro ya mbere Shampiyona y’Isi mu mukino w’amagare mu 2025. Ati “Naje nk’intumwa ngo ndebe uko ibihangange mu mukino w’amagare ku Isi byakwakirwa hano mu Rwanda. Nahuye n’abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze, by’umwihariko Minisitiri wa Siporo, Munyangaju Aurore Mimosa, tuganira ku iterambere ry’amagare. Igitekerezo cyacu ni ugushyigikira abakinnyi b’Abanyafurika kugira ngo na bo bazitabire Shampiyona y’Isi izabera ku mugabane wabo, banahatanire imidali.’’ Amina yageze mu Busuwisi ahari icyicaro cya UCI, icyo gihe yatangiye gukorana n’Ikigo gifasha abanyamategeko i Lausanne. Nyuma y’imyaka ibiri muri Mutarama 2006, yinjiye muri UCI akora nk’umujyanama mu by’amategeko. Mu 2013 nibwo yahawe inshingano nk’Umuyobozi Wungirije wa UCI, umwanya yavuyeho aba umuyobozi mukuru. Ku nshuro ye ya mbere mu Rwanda yanarebye isiganwa rizenguruka igihugu, anyurwa n’uburyo ritegurwa. Ati “Mu by’ukuri, nanyuzwe n’ibyo nabonye. Nakunze kubibwirwa, nabwiwe kenshi ko ‘uzabibona, Tour du Rwanda ni nziza’, ariko ugomba kwihera ijisho ngo ubyizere. Ubwo nari mu modoka ngeze kuri Muri de Kigali [Kwa Mutwe], nabonye ibihumbi by’abafana, abana, imiryango numva nsheshe urumeza. Sinigeze ntekereza ku kintu gikomeye nk’icyo mu irushanwa nubwo narebye uduce tumwe tw’amasiganwa yo mu Bubiligi [Tour des Flandres] na Tour de France.’’ Yavuze ko Tour du Rwanda yayibonye nk’igikorwa gishyigikirwa n’abaturage bose na Guverinoma. Ati “Tour du Rwanda ni icyitegererezo ku iterambere rya siporo yacu ndetse ni kuri iyo mpamvu dushobora kuvuga kuri kandidatire iri mu nzira nziza zo gutegura Shampiyona y’Isi mu 2025.’’ Amina agaragaza ko amahirwe Afurika yahawe yo kwakira Shampiyona y’Amagare ku Isi mu 2025, akwiye kubyazwa umusaruro. Abakinnyi b’Abanyafurika bitabiriye amarushanwa akomeye mu mukino w’amagare ariko ntibatanga umusaruro ushamaje. Muri bo harimo Areruya Joseph wanditse amateka akaba Umunyafurika wa mbere wo Munsi y’Ubutayu bwa Sahara wasiganwe mu irushanwa ry’amagare rya Paris-Roubaix, rimwe mu akomeye. Areruya yasoje isiganwa n’ubwo yaje mu bakinnyi 10 bageze ku murongo igihe cyigenwa n’amategeko y’uyu mukino cyarangiye. Avuga ku musaruro w’Abanyafurika mu marushanwa mpuzamahanga, Amina yavuze ko hakwiye kubaho uburyo bwo guteza imbere amagare muri Afurika mu buryo buhuriweho. Ati “Dufashe urugero, usanga abakinnyi bo muri Erythrée bitwara neza, ndetse bakisanga i Burayi kuko siporo y’amagare bayigize umuco mu gihugu cyabo. Biragoye ku bandi nko ku Banyarwanda.’’ Yatanze inama ko ubufasha buhabwa abakinnyi burenga kubafasha kubona amakipe ahubwo bakitabwaho birushijeho. Ati “Abo bakinnyi bagomba kugera i Burayi, ni ngombwa kubaka imikoranire n’amashyirahamwe y’ibihugu n’amakipe yabigize umwuga. Nzi ko Jean-René Bernaudeau (Umutoza wa Total Direct-Energie) yita ku iterambere ry’umukino w’amagare muri Afurika, aniteguye kuwushyigikira. UCI izaganira n’andi makipe ku buryo hashyirwaho igenamigambi na gahunda irambye.’’ UCI na yo yihaye intego yo gushaka abanyempano b’ahazaza ndetse yanashyizeho ikigo kigisha umukino w’amagare kibarizwa muri Afurika y’Epfo. Ati “Abakinnyi bahabwa imyitozo ariko ntihirengagizwa abakanishi, abatoza,…Ni umurimo ugomba gutangira vuba mu gutoza abakiri bato gukurana amahame y’umukino wo gusiganwa ku magare. Ni umukino ukomeye, ugoye kuwumva. Izo gahunda zose z’imyitozo zarateguwe kuva mu gihe gishize ariko turi kuzinononsora.’’ Mu gukomeza guteza imbere umukino w’amagare muri Afurika, UCI irateganya kwagura ibigo atorezwamo bikagirwa icyitegererezo. Amina yavuze ko Ikigo gitorezwamo abakinnyi b’umukino w’amagare kiri i Musanze yasuye agasanga kimeze neza, nacyo gishobora kuba muri bimwe mu bizazamurirwa urwego, kigashorwamo imari igishyira ku rwego rwisumbuye mu bijyanye n’ibikoresho n’ibikorwaremezo. UCI yiyemeje ko izatanga ubufasha mu gukomeza kuzamura umukino w’amagare; biteganyijwe ko muri Nzeri aribwo hazatangazwa byeruye iyagurwa ry’icyo kigo mu Rwanda. title: Inkwenene z’Icyongereza n’uko yatekereje guhunga atinya gufungwa: Ikiganiro na Myasiro (Video)
content:
Myasiro Jean Marie Vianney, ni umusore w’imyaka 23 ufite amateka akomeye mu Rwanda akomora ku kuba ubwo yari muri shampiyona y’Isi y’abatarengeje imyaka 20 muri Pologne “2016 IAAF World Junior (U20) Championships”, yarakuyeho agahigo k’uwitwa Valens Bivahagumye wari warirutse metero ibihumbi 10 mu iminota 29, amasegonda 35 n’ibice 41 muri 2004. Uyu Myasiro we yayirutse mu iminota 29 amasegonda 26 n’ibice 26, icyo gihe akaba yari afite imyaka 19. Myasiro Jean Marie Vianney yavukiye mu karere ka Nyaruguru, Umurenge wa Busanze mu Majyepfo y’u Rwanda. Avuka mu mu muryango w’abana barindwi akaba ari na we bucura, abandi batandatu bose ni abakobwa. Uyu musore afite nyina gusa kuko se yitabye Imana mu 2017. Mu kiganiro cyihariye na IGIHE, Myasiro, yavuze byinshi byerekeranye n’uburyo yahuye n’akaga akimara kuvuga Icyongereza gipfuye, ku buryo hari n’abamubwiye ko nagera mu Rwanda agomba gufungwa kuko yasebeje igihugu n’ibindi. IGIHE: Mu buzima bwawe wumvaga uzaba umukinnyi ngororamubiri wabigize umwuga? Myasiro: Nkiri muto ntabwo numvaga nzirukanka kuko bitewe n’ahantu navukiye,  nari ntarabona umuntu wiruka, twari tuzi ko umuntu yiruka agiye gufata uruakwavu cyangwa akaba ari umusazi. Numvaga nzaba umuganga kuko nakundaga abaganga cyangwa nkakora muri banki, gusa uko iminsi yagendaga nashyize ingufu mu mupira w’amaguru, nkumva nzaba nk’umukinnyi Jimmy Gatete, niwe mukinnyi nakundaga. Ngiye mu mwaka wa mbere i Butare, nibwo najyaga mbona abantu biruka ku maguru. Nahise mva mu mupira kuko abantu bancaga intege bambwira ko  ntavukiye mu muryango ukomeye, narabiretse  njya mu kwiruka. Byaje kumpira kuko nakomeje nza no mu rwego w’igihugu mu by’amashuri yisumbuye, aha nibwo nabonye ko bishoboka. Naje kubonwamo impano n’abantu barimo, Kajuga Robert na Disi Dieudonné, bakomeje kujya bamvuganira ku ishuri nigagaho ry’Abapadiri, kugira ngo njye mbona umwanya wo gukina. Mu 2013 byaje gutuma njya mu ikipe yitwa Mountain Classic, bituma nitabira amarushanwa akomeye harimo n’irya All African Games ryabereye muri Botswana, nyuma njya no muri Uganda. Ndibuka ko ngiye muri Uganda twagarutse mu Rwanda natsindiye amadorali 500, numvise bindeze kuko nibwo bwa mbere nari mfashe ku mafaranga, nyagejeje mu rugo nabo byarabatunguye ndetse babanza kuvuga ko nayibye, ariko ku ishuri bababwira ko nayatsindiye, Papa yahise anguriramo ishyamba, ubwo nibwo nabonye ko noneho uyu ari umukino ugiye kuntunga. IGIHE: Mu 2016 witabiriye irushanwa muri Pologne uhavugira icyongereza abenshi banenze, byagenze gute? Myasiro: Iri rushanwa abantu benshi bararyibuka n’umuntu wese udakurikirana ibya siporo nzi ko anzi neza,  iri ni irushanwa nakoreyemo ibintu bibiri, ku bazi siporo nakoze icyo bita amateka (record), kuko ninjye ufite ibihe byiza mu bakiri bato mu Rwanda, mu batarengeje imyaka 20. Ikindi ni uko navuze Icyongereza ari nacyo cyakwiriye ku Isi yose, ndakeka n’abatari abanyarwanda bose nabonye babinyereka, abanyarwanda bamwe baranshimye abandi baranseka, buri muntu aba afite uko abifata ariko kuri njye byarabaye. Nkimara kuvuga biriya bintu, hari umusore witwa Sugira James twari kumwe uwo munsi, twageze mu cyumba twararagamo kuko njye nari naniwe cyane, nkajya mbona arareba kuri Youtube agaseka, kuri njye ntabwo nanibukaga ko hari interview (Ikiganiro) natanze ku munyamakuru. Nakomeje kubona aseka (Sugira), ahita anambwira ati ubu uzi ko wagera i Kigali bakagufunga? Nahise mubaza nti nakoze iki? Ati Perezida arahita agufunga, akibimbwira umutima warankutse kuko urumva iyo uvuze umukuru w’igihugu uba wumva ko hari ikintu gikomeye wakoze. We yakomeje guseka ni nabwo yanyeretse ya Video, ndamubwira nti ese ibi nibyo Perezida amfungira? ariko nanjye nsubiyemo ya video kuyireba nahise niseka. Iyo urebye kuri iyi video ahantu hahera, hari aho ubona ko nasetse kuko nahakoze amafuti, hari aho navuze ngo, ‘Me I’m not Minimum Olympic” aho nakavuze ngo, ‘I don’t have Minimum Olympic’, Urumva ko navuze ngo ndi ‘Minimum ya Olympic. Ako kanya koko nahise numva ko bari bumfunge kuko numvaga nsebeje igihugu, numvise ngiye kureka uyu mukino ntangira no kumva ngiye guhunga igihugu, ndabyibuka ako kanya nagiye ahantu twari ducumbitse,  ndababaza nti ese nta hantu umuntu yabona byibuze muri Kaminuza yajya akajya akoropa? Ntabwo numvikanye nabo mu rurimi, mbese twananiwe kumvikana. Mbonye byanze naravuze nti iki gihugu nkitorokeyemo napfa, nahisemo kuvuga nti reka nsubire mu Rwanda, byibuze nibamfunga bazamfungura. Ngeze mu gihugu nta muntu nabibwiye gusa naravuze nti uzaza kumbaza nzahita ntorokera mu Burundi kuko ni bugufi yo mu rugo. Nshimira ko itangazamakuru ari ryo ryansubijemo icyizere bambwira ko ari ibisanzwe kuvuga icyongereza nka kiriya, ndetse nabonye n’abayobozi batandukanye bagiye banshimira ibihe byiza nakoze, bakambwira ko nta kosa nakoze. IGIHE: Kuba hari abanyarwanda bagusetse wabyakiriye gute? Myasiro: Kugeza uyu munsi nakongera nkabivuga, hari abanyarwanda bamwe usanga badakunda ibifite umumaro ahubwo bareba ahabaye ikosa gusa, uyu munsi usanga abantu benshi bazi ko navuze Icyongereza nta kindi baba bazi, hari n’uwo ubona yirirwa akwirakwiza ibyo navuze, wamubaza uti yabivugiye he ugasanga ntabyo azi. Icyo nabwira abantu ni uko ibyo babona bajya babanza gusesengura, simbabuza guseka kuko umuntu niho ahera anikosora ariko bajye banaseka ibyo bazi, si byiza kubona ibihurura nawe ngo uhurure, burya iyo unenze ikintu uzi, uba uzi n’inama uri bugire wa wundi wakoze ikosa. IGIHE: Umaze gusekwa washatse uko wihugura? Myasiro: Nkiva muri Pologne nabonye abantu  bamfasha kwiga icyongereza mu Rwanda, nahamaze ibyumweru bibiri ariko nyuma nabonye gahunda yo kujya gukina mu Butaliyani, nk’uko nakubwiye mu buzima bwanjye, ni uko namaze kubona ko nzatungwa n’amaguru yanjye, kuba narakinaga  mu Rwanda nkaba nari  mbonye amahirwe yo kujya ku mugabne w’i Burayi nagombaga kugenda. Naragiye ndakina nkajya mvuga ko ningaruka nziga cyangwa nkaba nakimenyera n’aho nkina, ngeze mu Butaliyani nasanze batavuga cyane icyongereza ariko hari akiyongerereho nubwo bitari uko nabishakaga. IGIHE: Mu buryo bufatika, uyu mukino umaze ku kugeza kuki? Myasiro: Nk’abantu duturanye bo bazi neza uko nateye imbere, icya mbere uyu mukino watumye mvana umukecuru wanjye muri Nyaruguru  mutuza mu Karere ka Nyanza, namuguriye imirima n’inzu ubu ntakodesha, ntabwo ihenze cyane ariko yantwaye miliyoni 4.8 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Hari n’ibindi nagezeho ariko ntavuga, sinavuga ko nageze ku cyo nkeneye cyose ariko uyu munsi siporo ifite byinshi yampaye, amafamu y’inka n’ibindi, mfite imirima y’ibyayi muri Nyaruguru n’ibindi, ntabwo nicuza ubuzima nagiyemo nk’uko nk’ubu abo twiganye 90%, nzi ko benshi bifuza kubaho nkanjye. IGIHE: Myasiro w’imyaka 23 yaba afite umukunzi? Myasiro: Njye ibi narabirangije, ubu mfite uwo nkunda, vuba nzababwira itariki y’ubukwe. Myasiro avuga ko amaze amezi atandatu afite imvune, gusa ngo akaba akomeje ibiganiro bitandukanye n’amakipe y’i Burayi kugira ngo abe yayakinira.
Avuga ko anateganya gutangira kwiga mu mwaka wa mbere muri Kaminuza yigenga ya Kigali (ULK).

title: Etincelles yahize gutsinda Rayon Sports, yazamuriye abakinnyi agahimbazamusyi
content: Etincelles FC izakira Rayon Sports mu mukino w’umunsi wa 21 wa Shampiyona uzabera kuri Stade Umuganda ejo ku wa Gatatu, saa cyenda (15:00). Umunyamabanga mukuru wa Etincelles, Kabanda Innocent, avuga ko imbaraga bakoresheje kuri APR FC, bazikubye kabiri ku mukino bazahuramo na Rayon Sports. Ati “Ubushize twari twahize gutsinda ikipe ya APR FC ariko iraducika turanganya.  Ubu imbaraga twari twakoresheje twazikubye kabiri Rayon Sports ntituva mu nzara. Yananiwe kudutsindira i Kigali hano iwacu siho yabishoborera.” Yakomeje avuga ko umutekano ku bakinnyi wakajijwe bakaba banabemereye agahimbazamusyi k’amafaranga menshi. Ati “Abakinnyi barimo gukora imyitozo stade ifunze, mukanya barajya mu mwiherero. Nta tumanaho na rimwe bafite kandi twanabageneye agahimbazamusyi gafatika ntatangaza, nabo ubwabo bahize gutsinda Rayon Sports bakira umutoza wabo mushya bishimiye cyane.” Ubwo amakipe yombi yahuraga mu mikino ibanza ya Shampiyona, kuri Stade ya Kigali, yanganyije ubusa ku busa. Etincelles FC iri ku mwanya wa 12 n’amanota 22 mu gihe Rayon Sports iri ku mwanya wa gatatu n’amanota 41 mu mikino itatu imaze gukinwa.
