title: Uko Abanyarwanda bitwaye muri Tour du Rwanda 2020 biratanga icyizere- Komiseri Ntiyamira
content: Isiganwa ry’amagare rizenguruka u Rwanda, ryabaye mpuzamahanga kuva mu 2009, aho ryari ku rwego rwa 2.2 kugeza mu 2018. Muri iyo myaka uko ari 10, Abanyarwanda baritwayemo inshuro eshanu (hagati ya 2014 na 2018) mu gihe kuva rigiye ku rwego rwa 2.1 mu mwaka ushize, nta Munyarwanda urongera kuryegukana cyangwa ngo atware agace karyo. Umunyarwanda aheruka kwegukana agace ka Tour du Rwanda tariki ya 6 Kanama 2018. Ni Mugisha Samuel  watwaye agace ka Kigali- Huye ndetse akaba icyo gihe yaratwaye Tour du Rwanda 2018. Kuva iri siganwa rizamuriwe urwego mu mwaka ushize, ryatangiye kwitabirwa n’amakipe akomeye arimo n’akina amarushanwa yo ku rwego rw’Isi. Umwanya mwiza Umunyarwanda yabonye muri iyi myaka ibiri, ni uwa kabiri ku rutonde rusange, watwawe na Mugisha Moïse ukinira Skol Adrien Cycling Academy (SACA) mu gihe mu 2019, Areruya Joseph yari yabaye uwa cyenda. Kubwa Ntiyamira Jean Sauveur, komiseri w’umukino w’amagare, asanga Abanyarwanda bagenda bazamura urwego kuko byibuze kuri iyi nshuro hari uwabashije kuza muri batatu ba mbere. Ati “Umwaka ushize ubwo irushanwa ryabaga bwa mbere riri kuri 2.1 umukinnyi w’Umunyarwanda waje hafi yabaye uwa cyenda, Areruya Joseph, ariko ubu twuriye podium [mu myanya itatu ya mbere].” “Biraturuka ukuntu twashyizemo imbaraga, twungutse indi kipe ya SACA ari nayo ifite umukinnnyi wabaye uwa kabiri ku rutonde rusange, ikaba yariyongereye kuri Benediction n’ikipe y’Igihugu. Ni ibigaragaza ko umukino w’amagare ugenda uzamuka.” Muri iki kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE, Ntiyamira yavuze ko mu myaka itatu iri imbere Abanyarwanda bazaba bafite ubushobozi bwo kwegukana iri siganwa riri ku rwego rwa 2.1. Ati “Ukurikije ibyabaye nubwo tutabashije gutwara etape [agace k’isiganwa], ariko ndaguha imyaka ibiri, uwa gatatu tuzatwara  Tour du Rwanda ya 2.1.” “Kuba dufite amakipe abiri ashobora gusohokera igihugu birashimishije, aho tugeze harashimishije, twabonye n’umushyitsi [Umuyobozi mukuru wa UCI] mwabibonye, aba-Minisitiri baje gutanga ibihembo.  Nituramuka twemerewe gutegura Shampiyona y’Isi ya 2025 tuzahagera twaratwaye Tour du Rwanda ya 2.1, ariko ibyiza biri imbere. Nkurikije uko twitwaye, umwaka utaha bizahindura isura.” Abajijwe ku migendekere y’irushanwa ry’uyu mwaka ryarimo imihanda myinshi igoranye ku basiganwa, Ntiyamira yavuze ko ryari irushanwa riteguye neza kuko nta mpanuka nyinshi zabaye mu muhanda. Ati “Nashimira Tour du Rwanda ko umutekano wagenze neza, nta mpanuka nyinshi zabaye nubwo imihanda yari mibi cyane kandi inagoye, Biriya ni ibikwereka ko iba iteguye neza.” “Urebye iyi Tour du Rwanda iraduha icyizere, uretse gutsinda ku bakinnyi b’Abanyarwanda ndetse no mu mitegurire, u Rwanda rumaze kwigaragaza ko rushoboye gutegura umukino w’Amagare ku rwego rw’Isi.” Ntiyamira yasabye abafite aho bahurira n’itegurwa ry’abakinnyi kujya babakurikirana cyane kugira ngo barusheho kugira imyiteguro myiza ibafasha kwitwara neza mu marushanwa. Ati “Ubutumwa natanga ni uko ababishinzwe bakurikirana uko abakinnyi bitoza, uko bitwara, bagashyiramo imbaraga uko bakurikiranwa kandi bakagira imyitozo ihanitse. Ahantu igare rikomerera si imbaraga gusa ahubwo n’uburyo umukinnyi yitwara nabyo bigiramo uruhare. “ Mu marushanwa yose Abanyarwanda bamaze kwitabira ku rwego rwa Afurika, Areruya Joseph ni we wegukanye La Tropicale Amissa Bongo yari ku rwego rwa 2.1 mu 2018. title: Niyigena na Umulisa begukanye irushanwa ry’Ubutwari 2020 muri Tennis
content: Irushanwa ry’Ubutwari muri Tennis ryari rimaze imyaka itatu ridakinwa kubera ko nta muterankunga ryari rifite, ariko uyu mwaka ryateguwe ku bufatanye n’Isoko ry’Imari n’Imigabane (Rwanda Stock Exchange). Umukino wa nyuma mu bagabo babigize umwuga, wahuje Niyigena Etienne na Gatete Hamisi. Niyigena yegukanye irushanwa atsinze 6-2 na 6-2. Mu bagore, Umulisa Joselyne yaryegukanye nyuma yo gutsinda Tuyisenge Olive 7-6 na 6-2. Uwamutsali Marie w’imyaka 77, yatwaye igikombe mu bashehe akanguhe mu cyiciro cy’abagore mu gihe mu bagabo hitabiriye abarimo Ngabonziza Damien w’imyaka 78. Uwamutsali yavuze ko amaze imyaka igera igera hafi kuri 40 akina Tennis kuko imufasha gukora siporo mu buzima bwe bwa buri munsi. Ati “Ni ukubikunda gusa nta kindi. Natangiye gukina Tennis mu 1980 ariko nta ngufu nyinshi nabishyizemo. Siporo ni ikintu cyiza cyane kandi nta hadakora siporo hawe iyo ukina Tennis.” Niyigena wegukanye igikombe mu bagabo babigize umwuga, yavuze ko ibanga ryamufashije gutsinda ari uko yirinze gukora amakosa ndetse akaba yari azi neza uwo bari bahanganye. Asoza iri rushanwa, Umuyobozi w’Ishyirahamwe rya Tennis mu Rwanda, Karenzi Théoneste, yashimiye abaryitabiriye mu byiciro byose, avuga ko bagiye gushyiramo imbaraga mu mitegurire yaryo rikajya riba buri mwaka.

title: Europa League: Arsenal na Ajax zasezerewe, Manchester United ikomeza inyagiye Club Brugge (Amafoto)
content: Arsenal yatsindiwe ku mukino wa nyuma wa Europa League mu mwaka ushize, na Ajax yageze kure muri UEFA Champions League y’umwaka ushize, yari amwe mu makipe yasigaye mu irushanwa ry’uyu mwaka afite amazina akomeye. Mu mukino wo kwishyura wabaye ejo kuwa Kane kuri Emirates Stadium mu Bwongereza, Arsenal yari yatsinze igitego 1-0, yatunguriwe iwayo na Olympiacos, yayisezereye hitabajwe itegeko ry’igitego cyo hanze. Nta buryo bwinshi bugana mu izamu bwabonetse ku mpande zombi kugeza ku munota wa 38 ubwo Bukayo Saka yahinduraga umupira mu rubuga rw’amahina, ushyizwe mu izamu na Alexandre Lacazette, umusifuzi wo ku ruhande avuga ko habayeho kurarira. Nyuma y’iminota irindwi amakipe yombi avuye kuruhuka, Pape Abou Cissé yatsinze igitego cyagaruriye Olympiacos icyizere ku mupira wari uvuye muri koruneri yatewe na Mathieu Valbuena. Iyi kipe yo mu Bugereki yashoboraga kandi gutsinda igitego cya kabiri ku munota wa 56, ishoti rikomeye ryatewe na Konstantinos Tsimikas rishyirwa muri koruneri n’umunyezamu Bernd Leno. Nicolas Pépé yateye ishoti rikomeye rikurwamo n’umunyezamu José Sa wa Olympiacos mbere y’uko Lacazette atera umupira w’umutwe wanyuze ku ruhande. Byasabye Arsenal gutegereza umunota wa 23 muri 30 yongereweho kuko amakipe yombi yanganyaga igitego 1-1 mu mikino yombi, itsindirwa igitego cyayihesheje icyizere cyo gukomeza  na Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang ku mupira yigaramye uvuye kuri Gabriel Martinelli. Ibyari ibyishimo ku bakunzi ba Arsenal, byahindutse amarira n’agahinda ku munota wa 118 ubwo Youcef El Arabi yatsindaga igitego cya kabiri cya Olympiacos ku mupira wahinduwe na Giorgos Masouras. Aubameyang yahushije uburyo bwa nyuma bwabonetse mu mukino, umupira wari utakajwe na myugariro wa Olympiacos awuteye mu izamu uca ku ruhande, Arsenal irasezererwa. Mu yindi mikino yabaye, Manchester United yakomeje muri 1/8 nyuma yo kunyagira Club Brugge yo mu Bubiligi ibitego 5-0 mu mukino wo kwishyura wabereye mu Bwongereza. Igice cya mbere cyarangiye ari ibitego 3-0 byatsinzwe na Bruno Fernandes kuri penaliti, Odion Ighalo watsinze igitego cye cya mbere mu mashitani atukura na Scott McTominay wakinnye umukino we wa mbere nyuma yo gukira imvune mu gihe Fred yatsinze ibitego bibiri byabonetse mu minota 10 ya nyuma. Club Brugge yakinnye iminota isaga 75 ari abakinnyi 10 mu kibuga, ni nyuma y’uko Simon Deli yahawe ikarita itukura nyuma yo kugarura umupira waganaga mu izamu akoresheje ukuboko, hatangwa penaliti yavuyemo igitego cya mbere ku munota wa 24. Ajax yo mu Buholandi, na yo yari mu makipe yitezwe uyu mwaka, yasezerewe na Getafe yo muri Espagne nubwo yatsinze ibitego 2-1 mu mukino wo kwishyura. Umukino ubanza wari warangiye Getafe itsinze 2-0. Amakipe 15 yakomeje muri 1/8 cya Europa League ni: Rangers, AS Roma, Wolfsburg, LASK, Basel, Bayer Leverkusen, Istanbul Basaksehir, Wolves, Shakhtar Donetsk, Inter Milan, Manchester United, Olympiacos, Seville, Getafe na FC Copenhagen. title: Tour du Rwanda 2020: Abahagarariye u Rwanda batuye Minisitiri Munyangaju ikibazo cy’amagare atagezweho bakinisha
content: Icyizere cyo kuba Umunyarwanda yakwegukana Tour du Rwanda 2020 cyangwa kamwe mu duce twayo, cyagabanutse kuri uyu wa Kane nyuma y’agace ka gatanu kegukanwe n’Umunya-Colombia, Restrepo Jhonatan Valencia. Minisitiri wa Siporo Munyangaju Aurore Mimosa watangije aka gace ka gatanu i Rubavu, yasuye abakinnyi b’Abanyarwanda ubwo isiganwa ryari rirangiye, aho bacumbitse mu kigo cy’amagare cya Africa Rising Cycling Center kiri mu Murenge wa Nyange mu Karere ka Musanze, akaba ari naho ikipe y’igihugu “Team Rwanda” ikorera umwiherero. Umutoza wa Benediction Ignite, Sempoma Félix, akaba ari na we watoje Team Rwanda muri La Tropicale Amissa Bongo yabaye mu kwezi gushize muri Gabon, yabwiye Minisitiri Munyangaju ko kimwe mu bituma kugeza ubu Abanyarwanda nta musaruro mwiza bafite muri Tour du Rwanda 2020 ari uko amagare bakoresha atajyanye n’urwego iri siganwa rigezeho. Ati “Amagare dufite ni ikibazo kuko ntabwo amagare dufite ari aya 2.1, amagare dufite ni aya 2.2. Ndumva rero kuba Leta y’u Rwanda ishyigikiye umukino bizagenda neza hakaboneka amagare ajyanye n’icyiciro turimo.” Tour du Rwanda yabaye mpuzamahanga kuva mu 2009, mu 2019 nibwo yashyizwe ku rwego rwa 2.1 ivuye kuri 2.2 ndetse ni ku nshuro ya kabiri ikinwe iri ku rwego rwo hejuru, aho guhera mu mwaka ushize yitabirwa n’amakipe akomeye arimo n’akina amarushanwa yo ku rwego rw’Isi. Nubwo kugeza ubu nta Munyarwanda uregukana agace ka Tour du Rwanda kuva igiye ku rwego rwa 2.1 mu mwaka ushize, Minisitiri Munyangaju, yashimiye abakinnyi bahagarariye u Rwanda uko bakomeje kwitwara, aho kugeza ubu Mugisha Moïse wa SACA, ari uwa kabiri ku rutonde rusange, asigwa iminota ibiri n’amasegonda 11 na Natnael Tesfazion uyoboye isiganwa nyuma y’uduce dutanu. Ati “Twishimiye urwego umukino w’amagare uriho kandi no muri iyi Tour du Rwanda ndahamya ko duhagaze neza kuko ubu dufite umwanya wa kabiri.” Yongeye kwibutsa abakinnyi ko bagomba guharanira ishema ry’igihugu bafatanyije, bakarinda ibyagezweho birimo n’uyu mwanya wa kabiri ufitwe n’Umunyarwanda. Ati  “Umwanya wa kabiri dufite tuwufite nk’u Rwanda ntabwo tuwufite nk’ikipe runaka. Icyo dushaka ni ugukomeza kwitwara neza mu nzira zisigaye biranshoboka ko twaratwara irushanwa.” Umuyobozi w’Ishyirahamwe Nyarwanda ry’umukino w’amagare, Murenzi Abdallah, yasabye abakinnyi gukomeza guhatana bakagira umusaruro mwiza, anabizeza ko nibitwara neza nta kabuza ikibazo cy’amagare bafite kizakemuka. Ati “Ku bufatanye bwacu na Minisiteri ntabwo bizananirana. Aya magare tujya kuyabona ni uko twari twagaragaje umusaruro, n’ubu dutwaye umwenda byahamagara ibindi kdi byiza.” Uretse bamwe mu bakinnyi ba Team Rwanda bakoresha amagare yatanzwe na Perezida Kagame nyuma y’uko ikipe y’igihugu yari yatwaye Tour du Rwanda ya 2015, abandi bakoresha amagare amakipe yabo yiguriye. Kapiteni wa Team Rwanda, Mugisha Samuel, wavuze mu izina ry’abakinnyi, yijeje Minisitiri Munyangaju n’abayobozi ba FERWACY, ko bagiye gukora iyo bwabaga bakagira agace begukana muri dutatu dusigaye. Ati “Tour du Rwanda 2020 turimo sinavuga ngo hari icyo twabuze wenda gituma tutaratwara agace kayo. Nta kibazo kinini dufite ahubwo mu mukino bibaho. Gusa tugiye gukora ibishoboka kugira ngo turebe ko byagenda neza.” Abakinnyi 15 nibo bahagariye u Rwanda muri Tour du Rwanda 2020, bakaba bagabanyije mu makipe atatu: Team Rwanda, Benediction Ignite na Skol Adrien Cycling Academy (SACA). Tour du Rwanda 2020 izakomeza ejo ku wa Gatanu mu gace ka gatandatu k’iri siganwa riri ku rwego rwa 2.1. Abasiganwa bazakora intera y’ibilometero 127.3, bazahaguruka i Musanze saa tatu (09:00) berekeza i Muhanga, aho byitezwe ko bazahasesekara saa 12:30 zibura iminota mike.

title: Abanyarwanda babuze amahirwe yo kwegukana agace ka gatanu ka Tour du Rwanda 2020 (Amafoto)
content: Abasiganwa bahagurutse mu Mujyi wa Rubavu saa tanu (11:00) babanza kuzenguruka uyu mujyi inshuro eshatu mbere yo gufata umuhanda wa Musanze. Munyaneza Didier ukinira Benediction Ignite, yacitse bagenzi be ubwo bari bageze mu bilometero 25, asiga abandi  amasegonda 10. Bageze mu bilometero 37 Byukusenge Patrick ni we wayoboye isiganwa, asize igikundi cyarimo abakinnyi benshi amasegonda 39 mu gihe Areruya Joseph yashatse kumukurikira, agarurwa n’igikundi. Byukusenge Patrick wahawe amanota yo kuzamuka yatangiwe ku gasozi ka  Sashwara, aho yasigaga igikundi hafi iminota ibiri. Yari akurikiwe n’umunya-Ethiopia, Buru Tesmegen we yasigaga umunota n’amasegonda 30. Byukusenge yakomeje kuyobora isiganwa ariko ibihe bagenda babigabanya kugeza mu bilometero umunani bya nyuma ubwo hari hasigayemo amasegonda 16. Habura ibilometero bitatu gusa, nibwo Byukusenge Patrick yafashwe n’igikundi abakinnyi binjira mu Mujyi wa Musanze bari mu gikundi kugeza ubwo Umunya-Colombia Restrepo Jhonatan yatsindaga bagenzi be abatanze gukoza ipine ku murongo. Restrepo yakoresheje amasaha abiri, iminota umunani n’amasegonda 19, aho yari mu gikundi kimwe na Tesfazion Natnael wakomeje kwambara umwenda w’umuhondo. Umunyarwanda waje hafi ni Mugisha Moïse wa SACA wabaye uwa 16, asizwe amasegonda ane mu gihe ku mwanya wa 18 haje Hakizimana Seth bakinana. Ntiyamira Jean Sauveur umwe mu bakomiseri b’umukino w’amagare mu Rwanda, yabwiye IGIHE ko kuba Abanyarwanda batabashije kwegukana agace k’uyu munsi, amahirwe yabo asa n’ayarangiye. Ati "Iyi Tour du Rwanda irakomeye, turacyafite étape ebyiri ziri imbere zikomeye, ariko Eritrea ifite ikipe nziza, ifite abahungu bazi kuzamuka. Nabonaga ko Abanyarwanda bashobora gutsinda étape y’uyu munsi, kuba binaniranye nta yandi mahirwe njye mbona tuzabona yo gutwara indi étape.” “Abanyarwanda hari uri ku mwanya wa kabiri ku rutonde rusange n’uri ku wa gatanu. Bakwiye kwiga uburyo bagumana iyo myanya kuko hari n’andi makipe ayishaka.” Tour du Rwanda 2020 izakomeza ejo ku wa Gatanu mu gace ka gatandatu k’iri siganwa riri ku rwego rwa 2.1. Abasiganwa bazakora intera y’ibilometero 127.3, bazahaguruka i Musanze saa tatu (09:00) berekeza i Muhanga, aho byitezwe ko bazahasesekara saa 12:30 zibura iminota mike. title: Ikipe ya Congo yakoreye imyitozo kuri Stade Amahoro mbere yo gucakirana n’Amavubi (Amafoto)
content: Kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 28 Gashyantare 2020 nibwo Amavubi azacakirana na Diables Rouges ya Repubulika ya Congo, umukino uzabera kuri Stade Amahoro. Amavubi agiye gukina uyu mukino mu gihe ku wa Mbere yakinnye n’ikipe ya Cameroun izakira iri rushanwa, umukino warangiye ari 0-0. Biteganyijwe ko irushanwa rya CHAN 2020 rizaba ku matariki ya 4-25 Mata 2020 muri Cameroun. Ikipe y’u Rwanda iri mu itsinda C hamwe na Maroc ifite irushanwa riheruka, Uganda na Togo igiye kurikina ku nshuro ya mbere. Kwinjira muri uyu mukino i Remera, muri VVIP bizaba ari 20.000 Frw, muri VIP ni 10.000 Frw, ku mpande ni 3000 Frw, ahatwikiriye mu ntebe z’umuhondo ni 2000 Frw mu gihe ahasigaye hose ari 1000 Frw. title: Rutahizamu Michael Sarpong ategerejwe muri Rayon Sports uyu munsi
content: Mu minsi ishize nibwo byatangiye kuvugwa ko Michael Sarpong wari waragiye mu igeragezwa mu Bushinwa, agiye kugaruka gukinira Rayon Sports mu mikino yo kwishyura ya Shampiyona y’u Rwanda. Sarpong wagiriye ibihe byiza muri Rayon Sports, ayigarutsemo bitewe n’uko ibikorwa byose by’imikino mu Bushinwa byahagaritswe kubera Coronavirus nshya yibasiye iki gihugu, ndetse ikomeje  gukwirakwira hirya no hino mu mahanga. Mu butumwa Rayon Sports yanyujije kuri Twitter, yagize iti "Rutahizamu wacu ukomoka muri Ghana @msarpong45 yagarutse … Arahagera bitarenze uyu munsi… Mwitegure kumubona atsinda ibitego atozwa na Casa Mbungo Andre...” Our Ghanian bull striker @msarpong45 is back... He is landing by today... You can't be ready enough to see him scoring under Casa Mbungo Andre...#Gikundiro pic.twitter.com/urHMhm8Ddh — Official Rayon Sports (@rayon_sports) February 27, 2020 Rayon Sports yemeje igaruka ry’uyu rutahizamu nyuma y’uko kuri uyu wa Gatatu yasinyishije umutoza Casa Mbungo, ku masezerano y’amezi ane ashobora kongerwa. Bagomba gufasha Rayon Sports kureba ko yakwegukana igikombe cya shampiyona, ibintu bisa n’ibigoye kuko iri ku mwanya wa gatatu, inyuma ya Police FC ya kabiri na APR FC iri ku mwanya wa mbere. title: SKOL yashimye umusaruro wa Mugisha, isobanura impamvu ihemba uwegukanye agace muri Tour du Rwanda
content: Mugisha Moïse w’imyaka 21 ukinira Skol Adrien Cycling Academy (SACA) ni uwa kabiri ku rutonde rusange rwa Tour du Rwanda 2020 imaze gukinwamo uduce tune, nyuma yo kuba uwa gatatu mu gace ka kane kavuye i Rusizi kagasorezwa i Rubavu. Benurugo Emilienne ushinzwe kwamamaza ibikorwa bya SKOL, yavuze ko bishimira uko Tour du Rwanda 2020 ikomeje kugenda by’umwihariko umusaruro wa Mugisha uri ku mwanya wa kabiri ku rutonde rusange rw’abakinnyi 71 basigaye mu isiganwa. Ati "Abantu bakurikiye Tour du Rwanda uyu munsi bumvise cyangwa babonye ko umukinnyi Mugisha Moïse wa Skol Adrien Cycling Academy akomeje kongera amanota ye yegera imbere ku buryo kuri twe kujya imbere tudasubira inyuma ni ikintu cyiza." Skol ni yo ihemba umukinnyi wa mbere muri buri gace ka Tour du Rwanda 2020. Benurugo yakomeje avuga ko impamvu SKOL yahisemo kujya ihemba uwo mukinnyi ari uko intego aba yihaye uwo munsi zijyana n’iz’uru ruganda zo guharanira kugera ku byo yiyemeje byose. Yagize ati "Uruganda rwa SKOL rwahisemo gutanga igihembo cy’umukinnyi wegukanye agace ko muri Tour du Rwanda buri munsi kuko uwo umuntu aba yitanze akagera ku byo yiyemeje 100% bigahuza n’intego yacu y’uko ibikorwa byose uruganda rwacu dukora, duharanira kubigeraho 100%." "Rero intsinzi 100% ijyanye no guhemba uwo muntu uba watsinze agace ka Tour du Rwanda aho dusoreza buri munsi." Benurugo  yasabye abakunzi b’amagare n’Abanyarwanda muri rusange, kwifatanya n’uru ruganda mu gushyikira abenegihugu bari gukina Tour du Rwanda kugira ngo bazaheshe igihugu ishema. Ati "Abakunzi b’amagare n’Abanyarwanda muri rusange nabashishikariza kwitabira Tour du Rwanda bakifatanya na SKOL nk’uruganda hamwe n’ikinyobwa cya Skol Malt, tuba tubafitiye ibitaramo mu isiganwa. Baze dushyigikire abakinnyi bacu kuko dufite amakipe atatu kandi Umunyarwanda atsinze ni igihugu kiba gitsinze.” Kuva Tour du Rwanda 2020 itangiye ku Cyumweru tariki ya 23 Gashyantare, abakinnyi bane bamaze guhembwa na SKOL nk’abegukanye agace k’iri siganwa ni Yevgeniy Fedorov wa Vino- Astana Motors watwaye aka Kigali-Rwamagana-Kigali, Mulu Kinfe Hailemichael wa Nippo Delko wegukanye aka Kigali-Huye, Restrepo Jhonatan wa Androni watwaye aka Huye-Rusizi na Natnael Tesfatsion wa Erythrée wabaye uwa mbere mu ka Rusizi-Rubavu. title: Champions League: Real Madrid yatsinzwe na Manchester City, Lyon itungura Juventus (Amafoto)
content: Mbere y’uyu mukino, Real Madrid ni yo yahabwaga amahirwe, aho iyi kipe imaze kwegukana ibikombe by’i Burayi bya UEFA Champions League inshuro 13, yanatsinze imikino ibiri yayihuje na Manchester City kuri iki kibuga cya Santiago Bernabéu. Manchester City itari izi uko gutsinda Real Madrid bisa muri iri rushanwa, yashoboraga gufungura amazamu ku munota wa 20, umupira Gabriel Jesus yahawe na Kevin De Bruyne, awuteye mu izamu ushyirwa muri koruneri na Thibaut Courtois. Nyuma y’iminota mike, Real Madrid na yo yabonye uburyo bwiza bwo gufungura amazamu ku mupira w’umutwe watewe na Karim Benzema, ukuwemo n’umunyezamu Ederson usanga Vinícius Júnior washatse kuwusubiza mu izamu arawuhusha. Manchester City yahushije kandi uburyo bwiza mu minota y’inyongera y’igice cya mbere, umupira wa koruneri watewe na De Bruyne, ukurwaho na Courtois n’ikiganza, ugeze kuri Gabriel Jesus awutera mu izamu, Sergio Ramos washoboraga kwitsinda kimwe na Casemiro, batabarwa na Federico Valverde. Real Madrid yafunguye amazamu ahagana ku munota wa 60, ku mupira Vinícius Júnior yatwaye ba myugariro ba Manchester City, awucomekera Isco wahise aroba umunyezamu Ederson Santana de Moraes. Ikipe yo mu Bwongereza, yabonye igitego cyo kwishyura ku munota wa 77, ku mupira wari uhinduwe na Kevin De Bruyne ahagana muri koruneri, ari mu rubuga rw’amahina, usanga Gabriel Jesus wari inyuma gato ya Ramos utawugezeho, atsindisha umutwe. Nyuma y’iminota itatu, Dani Carvajal yagushije Raheem Staerling mu rubuga rw’amahina, umusifuzi yemeza ko ari penaliti, yatsinzwe na Kevin De Bruyne, ihesha Manchester City gutsinda umukino ubanza ku bitego 2-1. Habura iminota itanu ngo umukino urangire, kapiteni wa Real Madrid, Sergio Ramos, yahawe ikarita itukura nyuma yo kugusha Gabriel Jesus inyuma gato y’urubuga rw’amahina. Undi mukino wabaye ejo ku wa Gatatu, warangiye Lyon itsindiye Juventus mu Bufaransa, igitego 1-0 cyatsinzwe na Lucas Tousart ku munota wa 31. Imikino yo kwishyura izaba tariki ya 17 Werurwe mu Bwongereza no mu Butaliyani.

title: Tour du Rwanda: Agace ka Rusizi- Rubavu kagaruye Abanyarwanda mu isiganwa (Amafoto)
content: Aka gace karekare mu isiganwa ry’uyu mwaka, kari gafite intera y’ibilometero 206.3, kegukanywe n’Umunya-Erythrée Tesfazion Natnael wahise wambara umwenda w’umuhondo. Abakinnyi 74 nibo bahagurikiye i Rusizi mu gitondo. Babanje kugendera mu gikundi mbere y’uko Abakinnyi batanu barimo kapiteni wa Benediction Ignite, Byukusenge Patrick, bacitse abandi ubwo basohokaga mu Mujyi wa Rusizi, ariko amasegonda 24 bari bashyizemo akurwamo n’igikundi. Mbere y’uko isiganwa rigera muri Nyamasheke, abakinnyi 19  barimo Areruya Joseph, Mugisha Moise na Manizabayo Eric bahise batoroka banikira abandi. Aba bayoboye isiganwa ibilometero byinshi, ndetse bagera n’aho basiga abandi iminota 10 n’amasegonda 45. Bakimara kurenga i Mushubati muri Rutsiro ubwo batangiraga kuzamuka Congo Nil, bamwe muri bo basigaye, imbere hasigara abarimo Carlos Oyarzun, Areruya Joseph, Mugisha Moise, Main Kent, Debesay Mekseb, Tesfazion Natnael na Kipkemboi. Mbere gato yo kurangiza Congo Nil, Manizabayo Eric yahise abatoroka agenda wenyine, abasiga amasegonda 40, gusa nyuma gato ab’imbere bahise bongera baramushyikira. Manizabayo yongeye kugerageza gucika ariko abanya-Erythrée; Tesfazion na Debesay baramugarura, ari na ko byagenze kuri Mugisha Moïse na we wabigerageje bagahita bamugarura mbere yo kugera ku ishyamba rya Gishwati. Mugisha Moïse yakomeje aragenda, aza gukurikirwa na Tesfazion, bayobora isiganwa ari babiri imbere, bagera muri Gishwati basize abandi umunota n’amasegonda 40. Mu bilometero 20 bya nyuma niho Main Kent wa Pro- Touch yabasatiriye mbere y’uko binjiya mu Mujyi wa Rubavu. Ubwo basozaga, batatu bari imbere baje banyongera ku muvuduko wo hejuru(Sprint) ubwo bari bagiye kugera ku murongo, ariko umunya-Erythrée Tesfazion Natnael abatanga ku murongo, asize Main Kent isegonda rimwe ndetse ahita yambara umwenda w’umuhondo awambuye mugenzi we, Ghirmay Biniam ukinira Nippo Delko. Umunyarwanda Mugisha Moïse ukinira SACA, yafashe umwanya wa kabiri ku rutonde rusange, arushwa iminota ibiri n’amasegonda 11 mu gihe Areruya Joseph ari ku mwanya wa kane. Tour du Rwanda 2020 izakomeza ejo ku wa Kane, aho abakinnyi bazahaguruka i Rubavu berekeza i Musanze ku ntera y’ibilometero 84.7 mu gace ka gatanu k’isiganwa kazatangira saa 11:00. title: Maria Sharapova yahagaritse gukina Tennis ku myaka 32
content: Maria Sharapova afite ibigwi bihambaye muri Tennis ku Isi, kuko uretse ibikombe bitanu bya Grand Slam, n’umudali wa Feza mu mikino Olympique, hari n’ibindi yatwaye byagiye bimushyira ku mwanya wa mbere mu bategarugori bakina bonyine. Mu 2004 Sharapova yegukanye Wimbledon ku myaka 17. Umwaka w’imikino ushize ntiwamuhiriye, dore ko waranzwe n’imvune zatumye anakina amarushanwa make bikamuviramo no gusubira inyuma ku rutonde rw’uko abakinnyi bahaze mu mukino wa Tennis ku isi. Kuri uyu wa Gatatu yatangarije Vanity Fair ko arimo gusezera ku mukino wa Tennis nubwo ari ibintu bitamworoheye. Ati “Ni gute wasezera ubuzima rukumbi wamenyekanyemo?,  ni gute se wajya kure y’ibibuga witorejemo kuva ukiri umukobwa muto, kure y’umukino wakunze, wakurijije amarira atagira ingano ukaguha n’ibyishimo bitavugwa, siporo wakuyemo umuryango, abafana bakubaye inyuma imyaka irenze 28?”. Sharapova yakomeje avuga azakumbura imyitozo n’akamenyero n’ibyo yamenyereye buri gihe, agakumbura abo bakinanaga n’abatoza. Ati “Tennis, ndimo kugusezeraho...Nyuma y’imyaka 28 n’ibikombe bya Grand Slam bitanu, niteguye kuzamuka undi musozi no guhangana mu bindi”. Mu 2016 Sharapova yarasuzumwe bisangwa yarakoresheje ibiyobyabwenge mu mikino myinshi yagiye akina. Yahagaritswe imyaka ibiri adakina ariko iki gihano kiza kugabanywa kigezwa ku mezi 15 nyuma yo kujurira, yongera gukina muri Mata 2017. Nyuma y’ibi bihano aho yabashije kugera ni muri kimwe cya kane cya Grand Slam, ndetse umwanya mwiza yagezeho ni uwa 21 ku Isi.

Rutanga umusanzu mu kubaka umusingi uhamye mu mukino w’amagare. Ni umuterankunga wa Tour du Rwanda aho ihemba umukinnyi watwaye agace k’isiganwa. Kuva muri Nyakanga 2018, Skol ifasha ingimbi zo mu makipe yo mu Rwanda kwitoreza mu Bubiligi. Muri Tour du Rwanda 2020 ifitemo ikipe yayo ifatanyije n’Ikigo cya Adrien Niyonshuti kigamije kuzamura impano mu mukino w’amagare (ANCA). Iyi kipe yitwa Skol Adrien Cycling Academy (SACA) ni nshya, iri ku rwego rwo gukina amarushanwa yo ku mugabane “continental’’, yashinzwe mu rwego rwo guteza imbere impano z’Abanyarwanda bakina umukino w’amagare. Skol iri ku rwego rwo kwenga ibinyobwa bifite ingano ya hegitolitiro ibihumbi 500 ku mwaka. Isanzwe ikora ibinyobwa bitandukanye birimo Skol Lager, Skol Malt, Skol 5, Virunga Mist, virunga Gold, Panache Lemon byose biboneka hirya no hino mu gihugu ku giciro cyiza. 08:13: Mu bilometero bibiri bya mbere, abakinnyi bageze mu Nyagatare bakiri mu gikundi. Mu bilometero bitatu Tesfay ukomoka muri Ethiopie ni we uri imbere basatira agasozi ka mbere ko mu Gisuma hafi y’Uruganda rw’icyayi cya Shagasha.  	Rwanda Tea, icyayi kizimanirwa abakinnyi muri Tour du Rwanda 2020 Rwanda Tea ni umufatanyabikorwa wa Tour Du Rwanda 2020. Ni yo ihemba umukinnyi wa mbere ku rutonde rusange ikamuha umwambaro w’umuhondo. Icyayi cy’u Rwanda ni ryo zimano rya mu gitondo ku bakinnyi mbere yo gutangira urugendo rurerure rw’imisozi n’amataba banyonga igare. Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe kohereza mu mahanga Ibikomoka ku Buhinzi n’Ubworozi mu Rwanda (NAEB) kibinyujije muri Rwanda Tea cyahisemo gutera inkunga iri siganwa kubera agaciro giha imikino by’umwihariko amagare. Mu gace ka Kane, abakinnyi baranyura mu misozi ihinzeho icyayi n’ahari inganda zacyo i Shagasha muri Rusizi, mu Ngororero (Rubaya tea estate), Rubavu (Pfunda) na Nyabihu Tea Factory mu Karere ka Nyabihu. Kimwe mu biryoshya Tour du Rwanda harimo no kwirebera ibyiza bitatse u Rwanda, nk’imisozi, ibibaya, imirima y’icyayi, ibiyaga n’ibindi. 08:06: Abakinnyi bageze mu Nyagatare batangiye kubarirwa ibihe. Aka gace kanyuze mu bice byiganjemo imirima n’inganda z’icyayi. Rwanda Tea ni umuterankunga w’imena wa Tour du Rwanda. 08:00: Abakinnyi bahagurutse i Kamembe. Bakoze ibilometero 2.6 basohotse mu mujyi binjiye mu Nyagatare batangira kubarirwa ibihe. 07:57: Abakinnyi bagiye guhaguruka mu Mujyi wa Kamembe berekeza mu wa Rubavu ku ntera y’ibilometero 206, ari nako gace karekare muri Tour du Rwanda 2020. 07:40: Abasiganwa bari kwishyushya mu mihanda yegereye isoko rya Kamembe ahagiye guhagurukira isiganwa mu minota mike iri imbere. 07:15: Imyirondo y’abakinnyi yatangiye gusuzumwa mbere y’uko bahaguruka muri aka gace ka kane. Tour du Rwanda iri ku rwego rwa 2.1 guhera mu mwaka ushize mu gihe hagati ya 2009 na 2018 yari kuri 2.2. Agace ka Rusizi-Rubavu ni agace ka kabiri karekare kabayeho mu mateka ya Tour du Rwanda kuva ibaye mpuzamahanga mu 2009. Aka mbere ni akavuye i Huye kerekeza i Rubavu mu mwaka ushize, kareshyaga n’ibilometero 213. Umujyi wa Rusizi n’uwa Rubavu ivuze iki mu mateka ya Tour du Rwanda? Ni ku nshuro ya kabiri Umujyi wa Kamembe (Rusizi) uhagurukiyemo agace ka Tour du Rwanda. Ubwa mbere ni mu 2016, aho isiganwa ryahagurutse ryerekeza i Huye. Ni ku nshuro ya karindwi Umujyi wa Rubavu ugiye gusorezwamo agace ka Tour du Rwanda: Imiterere y’agace ka kane: Rusizi- Rubavu Aka niko gace karekare mu isiganwa ry’uyu mwaka (ibilometero 206.3). Abasiganwa bahagurikiye imbere y’isoko rya Kamembe mu gihe nibagera ku kilometero cya 4.7 hari umusozi wa Gisuma utangirwaho amanota. Ku kilometero cya 52.4 hari umusozi wa Kadehero, ku cya 66.8 hari uwa Jarama mu gihe ku cya 85.8 hari uwa Mugonero. Nyamuhebe, Congo Nil Center, Gisika no mu ishyamba rya Gishwati ni ahandi hatangirwa amanota yo kuzamuka mu gihe ayo kubaduka atangirwa mu Rugabano n’i Rubengera. Ibyaranze agace ka gatatu: Ghirmay Biniam wambaye umwenda w’umuhondo ni umukinnyi wa 22 uwambaye mu mateka ya Tour du Rwanda. Ni Umunya-Erythrée wa gatatu uwambaye nyuma ya Merhawi Kudus watwaye isiganwa mu mwaka ushize ndetse na Daniel Teklehamainot. Ni umukinnyi wa kabiri wa Nippo Delko wambaye umwenda w’umuhondo wa Tour du Rwanda nyuma ya Fideli wawambaye mu mwaka ushize. title: Runanira Amza yirukanywe muri Rayon Sports kubera ubusinzi
content: Mu kwezi gushize nibwo Runanira Amza yahagaritswe na Rayon Sports mu gihe cy’ukwezi kubera ubusinzi, ahabwa ibihano byo kujya akorera imyitozo mu ikipe y’abato itozwa na Kayiranga Baptiste. Nk’uko byemezwa n’Ubuyobozi bwa Rayon Sports, ibihano uyu mukinnyi yahawe ntiyigeze abishyira mu bikorwa nk’uko yari yabisabwe, ahubwo yagiye asiba imyitozo kenshi  yanga gukorera imyitozo mu ikipe y’abato. Nyuma yo kwihanangirizwa, ariko Runanira Amza akanga  kumvira ubuyobozi, iyi kipe yamaze gutangaza ko yatandukanye n’uyu mukinnyi ukiri muto. Mu itangazo iyi kipe yashyize ku rubuga rwa Twitter, yagize iti “Rayon Sports yatandukanye mu buryo bwemewe na myugariro Runanira Amza kubera amakosa yo kutitabira akazi.” Runanira Amza yari amaze hafi amezi umunani muri Rayon Sports, ni nyuma y’uko yayisinyiye muri Kamena umwaka ushize ku masezerano y’imyaka ine. Runanira yakiniye La Jeunnesse, ayivamo mu 2015 ubwo yerekezaga muri Musanze FC, na yo ayikinira umwaka umwe mbere yo kwerekeza muri Marines FC yakiniye imyaka ibiri mbere yo kugurwa na Rayon Sports.

title: Champions League: Chelsea yanyagiriwe iwayo na Bayern Munich, Napoli ihagama FC Barcelone (Amafoto)
content: Mu cyumweru gishize nibwo hatangiye gukinwa imikino ibanza ya 1/8 cy’iri rushanwa mu gihe iyo kwishyura izaba mu kwezi gutaha. Mu mukino wabaye ejo ku wa Gatatu i Stamford Bridge mu Bwongereza, Chelsea yari imbere y’abafana bayo, yagowe cyane na Bayern Munich yayisatiriye kuva ku munota wa mbere kugeza ku wa nyuma. Iyi kipe yo mu Budage ni yo ya yabonye uburyo bwa mbere bugana mu izamu, umupira watewe na Thomas Müller ufatwa na Willy Caballero mbere y’uko na Kingsley Coman atera ishoti ryanyuze ku ruhande gato. Uburyo bwa mbere bwabonetse ku ruhande rwa Chelsea, bwabonywe na Ross Barkley ku munota wa 23, ishoti yateye rica ku ruhande rw’izamu ryarimo Manuel Neuer. Bayern Munich yakomeje gusatira ndetse ihusha uburyo bubiri bwiza bwabonywe na Robert Lewandowski. Umupira wa mbere yawutanzwe na Caballero mu gihe irindi shoti yateye, ryashyizwe muri koruneri n’uyu munyezamu naho Thomas Müller na we yongera gutera undi mupira ukomeye wanyuze ku ruhande. Habura iminota mike ngo igice cya mbere kirangire, Chelsea yashoboraga gufungura amazamu ku mupira Olivier Giroud yacomekewe na Mateo Kovačić mu rubuga rw’amahina, ariko uyu rutahizamu w’Umufaransa ananirwa kuwugeraho aserebetse, urarenga. Ibitego bibiri bya mbere bya Bayern Munich byabonetse mu minota ya mbere y’igice cya kabiri. Icya mbere cyaturutse ku guhanahana kwa Serge Gnabry na Robert Lewandowski wasubije umupira uyu mugenzi we, ahita awushyira mu izamu. Nyuma y’iminota ibiri n’ubundi Lewandowski yatanze umupira kuri Serge Gnabry watsinze ikindi gitego ku ruhande rw’iyi kipe yo mu Budage. Gnabry yahise ageza ibitego bitandatu muri Champions League y’uyu mwaka, byose yatsindiye mu Mujyi wa Londres, birimo bine yatsinze Tottenham. Habura iminota 15 ngo umukino urangire, Alphonso Davis yacenze abakinnyi b’inyuma ba Chelsea yihuta, ahindura umupira mu rubuga rw’amahina, ushyirwa mu izamu na Lewandowski watsinze igitego cya gatatu. Chelsea yasoje umukino ari abakinnyi 10 mu kibuga, ni nyuma y’uko Marcos Alonso yahawe ikarita itukura akubise inkokora Robert Lewandowski ku munota wa 80. Undi mukino ubanza wa 1/8 wabaye ejo, warangiye Napoli yo mu Butaliyani, inganyije FC Barcelone yo muri Espagne igitego 1-1. Dries Mertens yatsindiye Napoli ku munota wa 30 mu gihe igitego cya FC Barcelone cyishyuwe na Antoine Griezmann ku munota wa 57. Imikino yo kwishyura izaba tariki ya 18 z’ukwezi gutaha mu Budage no muri Espagne. Kuri uyu wa Gatatu hateganyijwe indi mikino ibiri ya 1/8 ibanza ari nayo isigaye. Lyon yo mu Bufaransa irakira Juventus yo mu Butaliyani  saa yine z’ijoro (22:00) mu gihe Real Madrid yo muri Espagne yakira Manchester City yo mu Bwongereza.

title: Ghirmay w’imyaka 19 yambaye umwambaro w’umuhondo nyuma y’agace ka Huye- Rusizi (Amafoto)
content: Aka gace ka gatatu, kegukanywe n’Umunya-Colombia Restrepo Jhonatan Valencia, wakoresheje  amasaha atatu, iminota 47 n’amasegonda 39. Isiganwa ryo kuri uyu wa Kabiri, ryatangiwe n’abakinnyi 75 batarimo kabuhariwe Eyob Metkel wagize uburwayi bw’ibicurane. Abasiganwa bahagurukiye imbere ya sitasiyo SP mu Mujyi wa Huye, ariko ibihe bitangira kubarwa bamaze kugenda ibilometero 2.5 muri santere ya Gahenerezo. Umunya-Ethiopia Bulu yacomotse hakiri kare asiga abandi amasegonda 50 mu gihe bageze ku kirometero cya cyenda, Tewelde wa Erythrée na Uhiriwe Byiza Renus wa Benediction Ignite,  nabo baramusatira. Abakinnyi bafashwe n’igikundi ubwo bari bageze mu kirometero cya 13 mu gihe mu cya 18, hahise hagenda abandi umunani barimo  Areruya Joseph, Mugisha Samuel, Munyaneza Didier na Yemane Dawit. Bakomeje kuyobora isiganwa ndetse Munyaneza Didier atwara amanota y’akazamuko ka mbere muri Nyamagabe kugeza ubwo binjiraga mu ishyamba rya Nyangwe. Mugisha Samuel na Yemane Dawit bakomeje kuba ku isonga mu gihe Areruya Joseph yasigaye bageze mu bilometero 100  naho Fedorov wari wambaye umwambaro w’umuhondo yari mu gikundi cyasizwe amasegonda 50, ariko cyaje kuyagabanya asigara ari 27 mu birometero 20 bya nyuma. Muri izi nzira zisohoka muri Nyungwe, ahamanukaga cyane, niho Abanyarwanda basigariye, abarimo Rein Taaramae, Mulu Kinfe wegukanye agace k’ejo hashize, Mulueberhan na Valencia Restrepo batangira gusatira cyane. Abakinnyi 10 nibo bari bayoboye isiganwa mu bilometero 15 bya nyuma, ariko mu gihe haburaga ikilometero kimwe, Restrepo Valencia wa Androni na Biniam Hailu Girmay bacika bagenzi babo ubwo bazamukaga berekeza imbere y’isoko rya Kamembe, ahasorejwe isiganwa. Restrepo yageze  ku murongo ari uwa mbere, akurikiwe na Hailu Biniam yarushaga isegonda rimwe. Uyu mwanya wa kabiri wafashije uyu Munya-Erythrée w’imyaka 19 gufata umwambaro w’umuhondo. Umunya-Kazakhstan Fedorov, wari uwumaranye iminsi ibiri, yabaye uwa 26 asizwe iminota itatu n’amasegonda 58, ibi byatumye yisanga ku mwanya wa cyenda ku rutonde rusange, arushwa hafi iminota ine. Tour du Rwanda 2020, izakomeza ejo ku wa Gatatu, aho abasiganwa bazakora intera y’ibilometero 206.3 berekeza i Rubavu mu gace karekare k’isiganwa ry’uyu mwaka, akaba ari aka kabiri karekare mu mateka ya Tour du Rwanda imaze imyaka 12 ibaye mpuzamahanga. title: Champions League: Umukino wa PSG na Dortmund uzabera mu muhezo
content: Paris Sant-Germain yo mu Bufaransa, izakira Borussia Dortmund yo mu Budage yayitsinze ibitego 2-1 mu mukino ubanza wabaye mu kwezi gushize. Polisi yo mu Mujyi wa Paris, kuri uyu wa Mbere yafashe icyemezo cyo kubuza abafana b’iyi kipe kwitabira umukino mu rwego rwo kwirinda ikwirakwiza ry’indwara iterwa na coronavirus. Ubuyobozi bwa Paris Saint-Germain bwari bwatangaje ko ko bwakoze ubukangurambaga buhagije kugira ngo umukino uzabe mu buryo bwiza bushoboka. Stade ya Parc des Princes yakira abantu ibihumbi 48, yatewemo imiti ifasha kwirinda coronavirus. Umukino wa Shampiyona wagombaga guhuza Paris Saint-Germain na Strasbourg mu mpera z’icyumweru gishize, ntiwabaye kubera ubwoba bw’iki cyorezo. Kugeza ubu, u Bufaransa bumaze kugaragaramo abamaze kwandura coronavirus 1,116 nk’uko bigaragazwa n’Umuryango Mpuzamahanga wita ku buzima (OMS), aho u Bushinwa, Korea y’Epfo, u Butaliyani na Iran ari byo bihugu bifite benshi kuburusha. Undi mukino wa UEFA Champions League uteganyijwe ku wa Gatatu, uzahuza Liverpool yo mu Bwongereza na Atlético Madrid. Umukino ubanza warangiye iyi kipe yo muri Espagne itsinze igitego 1-0.

title: Umucamanza yemeje ko Ronaldinho akomeza gufungirwa muri Paraguay
content: Ronaldinho wabaye umukinnyi ukomeye na murumuna we, Roberto Assis, bafatiwe muri Paraguay ku wa Gatanu bafite pasiporo z’impimbano zo muri icyo gihugu. Bombi basabye ko barekurwa, aho Assis yavuze ko asanzwe agira uburwayi bw’umutima, ariko umucamanza yanze iki cyifuzo kuko nta bimenyetso yagaragaje. Umucamanza Clara Ruiz Diaz yavuze ko “icyaha aba bagabo bombi bashinjwa gikomeye ndetse gihabanye n’amategeko leta ya Paraguay igenderaho.” Umunyamategeko we Tarek Tuma yabwiye abanyamakuru ko “Ronaldinho atumva ibiri kuba.” Umwe mu bayobozi ba Polisi yabwiye itangazamakuru ryo muri Paraguay ko bashyizwe muri gereza imwe n’izindi mfungwa, bahabwa isabune, umusego n’inzitarumubu. Nubwo bamwe mu bakozi ba gereza bafashe amafoto hamwe n’uyu munyabigwi ukomoka muri Brésil, nta kwitabwaho kwihariye yigeze akorerwa. Televiziyo ya Paraguay yerekanye Ronaldinho na mukuru we, bagera mu rukiko bambaye amapingu ahagana saa sita zo ku wa Gatandatu, muri icyo gihugu. Aba bavandimwe bombi bari batumiwe muri Paraguay n’umwe mu bagabo bafite inzu y’urusimbi, bahagera ku wa Gatatu, aho bagombaga kwitabira ibikorwa by’umupira w’amaguru w’abana no kumurika igitabo. Nubwo nk’uwabigize umwuga yakinnye kugeza mu 2015, Ronaldinho wakiniye amakipe yo muri Brésil arimo Atlético Mineiro, Flamengo na  Fluminense, yari yihariye ubuhanga mu kibuga ku buryo yakundwaga n’abatari bake ku Isi. Uyu mugabo w’imyaka 39 watowe nk’umukinnyi w’umwaka ku Isi mu 2004 na 2005, yatwaranye na Brésil igikombe cy’Isi mu 2002 ndetse na UEFA Champions League na FC Barcelone mu 2006.

title: GS Kimisange yegukanye umwanya wa mbere mu marushanwa ya Esheke (Chess) ahuza ibigo by’amashuri
content: Iri rushanwa ribaye ku nshuro yaryo ya gatatu, ryateguwe n’Ishyirahamwe ry’umukino wa esheke (FERWADE) ku bufatanye na Ambasade y’Abafaransa mu Rwanda ndetse na Institut Français du Rwanda (IFR), ryitabiriwe n’amakipe 17 aturuka mu bigo by’amashuri icyenda. Ishuri riba ryemerewe kwandikisha ikipe irenze imwe kandi buri kipe iba igizwe n’abakinnyi batanu. Abakinnyi bose hamwe, habariwemo n’abasimbura, bari 89 barimo abakobwa 36. Imikino itatu ya mbere yakinwe ku wa Gatandatu indi itatu isigaye ikinwa ku Cyumweru. GS Kimisange yari yazanye amakipe abiri, ikipe yayo ya mbere niyo yegukanye umwanya wa mbere, nyuma yo gutsinda Petit Seminaire ya Ndera, Ecole Belge de Kigali, Kigali International Community School, Kagarama Secondary School ndetse na Lycée Notre Dame de Citeaux. Iyi kipe ya mbere ya Kimisange yatsinzwe gusa na Green Hills Academy mu mukino wa gatatu wakinwe ku wa Gatandatu. Umwanya wa kabiri wegukanywe n’ikipe imwe rukumbi muri iri rushanwa ya Kagarama Secondary School naho ku mwanya wa gatatu wegukanwa n’ikipe imwe rukumbi ya Green Hills Academy. Ku mwanya wa gatatu amakipe ane yanganyije amanota. Ayo ni ikipe ya Green Hills Academy, ikipe ya kabiri GS Kimisange, ikipe ya kabiri ya Lycée Notre Dame de Citeaux (yari ifitemo amakipe atatu) hamwe n’ikipe ya kabiri ya Petit Seminaire ya Ndera, nayo yari ifite amakipe atatu. Green Hills Academy niyo yahembwe ku mwanya wa gatatu hakurikijwe ibindi bigenderwaho (tie break) iyo amakipe yanganyije mu manota. Nk’uko buri kipe yakinishaga abakinnyi batanu, mu myanya (board) itanu, hahembwe abakinnyi bitwaye neza kuri buri mwanya. Ku mwanya wa mbere, umukinnyi witwaye neza yabaye Dheer Chawla wa Green Hills Academy, ku mwanya wa kabiri hahembwa Friend Fabrice wa Kagarama Secondary School, ku mwanya wa gatatu hahembwa Ishimwe Blaise na we wa Kagarama, ku mwanya wa kane hahembwa Niyonzima Hassan wa GS ADB Nyarutarama naho ku mwanya wa gatanu hahembwa Mugisha Josué wa GS Kimisange. Umuyobozi wa FERWADE, Ganza Kevin, yavuze ko irushanwa ryagenze neza cyane, hashingiwe ku mubare w’amakipe yaryitabiriye, ubushake n’ishyaka rigaragara mu bakinnyi. Ikindi kikaba ari umubare w’abakobwa baryitabiriye ukomeje kwiyongera. Yavuze ko kandi ikindi gishimishije ari ukuba Gashora Girls Academy yaritabiriye amarushanwa ku nshuro yayo ya mbere kandi ikazanamo amakipe atatu. Mu irushanwa ry’umwaka ushize wa 2019, GS Kimisange niyo yegukanye umwanya wa mbere, ikurikirwa na Green Hills Academy naho ku mwanya wa gatatu haza Lycée Notre Dame de Citeaux.

title: Ifoto y’umunsi: Haruna na Sibomana Patrick basangiye ibyishimo by’intsinzi ya Yanga SC kuri Simba SC
content: Igitego kimwe rukumbi cyabonetse muri uyu mukino, cyatsinzwe na Bernard Morrison ku munota wa 44, ku mupira wari uteretse inyuma gato y’urubuga rw’amahina. Ku ruhande rwa Yanga SC, kapiteni w’ikipe y’Igihugu ‘Amavubi’, Niyonzima Haruna yari mu bakinnyi 11 batangiye umukino, Sibomana Patrick abanza ku ntebe y’abasimbura mu gihe Meddie Kagere yabanjemo ku ruhande rwa Simba SC, asimburwa na Hassan Dilunga ku munota wa 70. Sibomana Patrick yinjiye mu kibuga ku munota wa 56 asimbuye Bernard Morrison, afasha bagenzi be gukomeza guhagarara ku gitego bari babonye mu gice cya mbere cy’uyu mukino warebwe n’abarimo Perezida w’Impuzamashyirahamwe y’Umupira w’Amaguru muri Afurika (CAF), Ahmad Ahmad ndetse na Perezida wa Tanzania, John Pombe Mugufuli. Nubwo yatsinzwe, Simba SC yakomeje kuyobora Shampiyona ya Tanzania n’amanota 68 mu mikino 27 mu gihe Yanga SC ifite ibirarane, yahise ifata umwanya wa gatatu n’amanota 50 mu mikino 25 imaze gukina. Yanga SC yari imaze imyaka ine idatsinda Simba SC muri Shampiyona.

title: Police FC yatsinzwe na AS Kigali amahirwe yayo ku gikombe cya Shampiyona aragabanuka (Amafoto)
content: Uyu mukino wasoje iyabaye mu mpera z’iki cyumweru, waranzwe n’amakosa menshi, aho hatanzwe amakarita umunani y’umuhondo arimo atanu ku ruhande rwa AS Kigali. Ikipe y’Abanyamujyi yihariye uburyo bwabonetse mu gice cya mbere, yashoboraga gufungura amazamu ku munota wa karindwi, umupira Rick Martel  yahawe na Nsabimana Eric, awuteye mu izamu ushyirwa muri koruneri na Habarurema Gahungu. Umunya-Nigeria Orotomal Alexis wagoye abakinnyi b’inyuma ba Police FC, yahushije kandi uburyo bwiza ku mupira yaherejwe na Rick Martel ku munota wa 14, awuteye uca hejuru y’izamu. Habura iminota umunani ngo igice cya mbere kirangire, Nsabimana Eric ‘Zidane’ yafunguye amazamu nyuma yo gucika ba myugariro ba Police FC, atsinda umunyezamu Habarurema Gahungu. Mu minota ya mbere y’igice cya kabiri, Police FC yabonye uburyo bwashoboraga gutangwaho penaliti ku mupira wakozwe na Rusheshangoga Michel mu rubuga rw’amahina, umusifuzi avuga ko ari koruneri. Ku munota wa 70, Police FC yatsindiwe igitego na Mico Justin ku mupira yahawe na Nshuti Dominique Savio, umusifuzi avuga ko habayeho kurarira. Kayitaba Jean Bosco wasimbuye Orotamal Alexis, ni we watsinze igitego cya kabiri ku mupira yahawe na Ndekwe Felix, aroba umunyezamu Habarurema Gahungu mu minota y’inyongera. Gutsinda uyu mukino byafashije AS Kigali gufata umwanya wa gatandatu n’amanota 32 mu gihe Police FC yaherukaga gutsindwa na APR FC, yigabanyirije amahirwe y’igikombe, aho irushwa amanota 11 na APR FC mu gihe hasigaye imikino umunani. Police FC izagaruka mu kibuga ku wa Gatatu yakirwa na Bugesera FC naho AS Kigali izakira Mukura Victory Sports ku wa Kabiri. Uko amakipe yatsindanye ku munsi wa 22 wa Shampiyona Ku wa Gatanu tariki ya 6 Werurwe Ku wa Gatandatu tariki ya 7 Werurwe 2020 Ku Cyumweru tariki ya 8 Werurwe 2020 Amafoto: Uwihanganye Hardi

title: Ishyirahamwe rya Cricket mu Rwanda ryahembye ababaye indashyikirwa mu 2019
content: Ibirori byo gutanga ibi bihembo byabereye muri Serena Hotel i Kigali ku wa Gatanu w’iki cyumweru. Umwaka w’imikino wa 2019 muri Cricket, wasojwe mu Ugushyingo, aho  Challengers CC yegukanye Igikombe cy’Icyiciro cya Mbere mu Bagabo, Spartans CC itwara iyo mu cyiciro cya kabiri. Mu bagore, Shampiyona y’icyiciro cya mbere yatwawe na Charity Cricket Club mu gihe Queens of Victory Cricket Club ari yo yabaye iya mbere mu cyiciro cya kabiri. Igikorwa cyo guhemba ababaye indashyikirwa muri uwo mwaka w’imikino, cyasize hashimiwe abakinnyi bitwaye neza, abatoza beza n’abandi bagize uruhare mu iterambere ry’uyu mukino. Mu cyiciro cy’umukinnyi mwiza w’umwaka mu bagabo, mu Cyiciro cya Mbere “Player of the year Division 1”  hahembwe Pankaj Vekaria ukinira Kutchi Tigers CC naho Mihir Bhat ukinira Indorwa CC aba umukinnyi mwiza mu Cyiciro cya Kabiri. Mu bagore, umukinnyi witwaye neza mu Cyiciro cya Mbere yabaye Ishimwe Henriette ukinira Indatwa Hampshire CC, mu Cyiciro cya Kabiri aba Tuyizere Cynthia ukinira Ikipe ya Ndera Girls CC. Umukinnyi ukizamuka mu bahungu yabaye Hakizimana Jean Baptitse wa Zonic Tigers CC mu gihe mu bakobwa, iki gihembo cyegukanywe na Ishimwe Gisèle ukinira Indatwa Hampshire CC. Ikipe yitwaye neza mu bagabo mu Cyiciro cya Mbere yabaye Challengers CC, mu bagore iba Charity CC. Mu cyiciro cy’ikipe yitwaye neza mu Cyiciro cya Kabiri mu bagabo yabaye Spartans CC naho mu bagore iba Queens of Victory. Izi akaba ari nazo zatwaye ibikombe bya shampiyona iterwa inkunga na Unimoni. Umutoza w’umwaka yabaye Tuyizere Bosco wa Zonic Tigers CC, umusifuzi w’umwaka “Umpire of the year” yabaye Dusabemungu Hirwa Eric, umukorerabushake “Volunteer of the year” yabaye Gilies Opie naho Umunyamamakuru w’umwaka yabaye Bugingo Fidèle ukorera Imvaho Nshya. Umuyobozi w’Ishyirahamwe rya Cricket mu Rwanda, Mugarura Eddy Baraba, yavuze ko iki gikorwa cyo gushimira abitwaye neza cyagenze neza ndetse baboneyeho gusangiza abanyamuryango b’iri shyirahamwe gahunda bafite muri uyu mwaka wa 2020. Ati “Twashimiye abitwaye neza mu mwaka wa 2019 tunabasangiza gahunda dufite muri uyu mwaka wa 2020, kuko ni umwaka w’ingenzi muri Cricket y’u Rwanda, ni umwaka wa 20 uyu mukino ugeze mu gihugu.” Ubuyobozi bw’Ishyirahamwe ry’Umukino wa Cricket mu Rwanda bwishimira ko ukomeje kugera ku Banyarwanda benshi, aho kuri ubu mu Ntara zose hari abawukina. Kuri ubu, Cricket ikinwa mu mashuri agera kuri 106 mu turere twose two mu Rwanda mu gihe umwaka ushize w’imikino witabiriwe n’amakipe 24 haba mu cyiciro cya mbere n’icya kabiri mu bagabo n’abagore. title: Shampiyona y’abagore muri Handball yatangiye ES Kiziguro inyagira UR Remera
content: Iyi shampiyona yatangijwe kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 7 Werurwe 2020, itsinda rya mbere ryakiniye i Gatsibo, irindi rikinira mu Karere ka Nyamasheke mu gihe hari n’iryakiniye mu Karere ka Gicumbi. Mu mukino wabereye mu Karere ka Gatsibo watangirijwemo iyi shampiyona ku mugaragaro, igice cya mbere cy’umukino cyarangiye UR Remera ifite ibitego bitandatu mu gihe ES Kiziguro yari ifite ibitego 15. Mu gice cya kabiri, ES Kiziguro yarushije cyane UR Remera aho yabonye ibitego 15 mu gice cya kabiri, mu gihe UR Remera yabonyemo ibitego bitatu. Nyuma y’umukino, umutoza wa UR Remera, Hakizimana Célestin, yabwiye itangazamakuru ko ikipe ye yazize kudakora imyitozo ihagije, aho abanyeshuri benshi bari mu biruhuko bakoze umwitozo umwe, ariko bizeye kwitwara neza mu mikino izakurikiraho. Ati “Muri Kaminuza ntabwo byoroshye kubona abakinnyi benshi. Dufite abakinnyi bake ari nayo mpamvu ubona dukina igice cya mbere neza igice cya kabiri abana bakaruha tukabura ababasimbura gusa tugiye gukaza imyitozo ubutaha tuzitwara neza.” Umutoza wa ES Kiziguro, we yavuze ko  bagize intangiriro nziza ariko ngo n’intego yabo muri uyu mwaka ni ugutwara igikombe cya shampiyona. Yavuze ko ibyangombwa byose babifite birimo ikibuga cyiza, abakinnyi beza ndetse n’ubundi bufasha burimo ubw’akarere n’ikigo cy’ishuri. Umuyobozi w’Ishyirahamwe rya Handball mu Rwanda, Utabarutse Théogène, yavuze ko muri uyu mwaka bifuza kugira amakipe arenga 30 muri shampiyona aho azajya akinira mu matsinda atatu. Yavuze ko icyo bishimira ari uko amenshi mu makipe bafite ari ayo mu mashuri yisumbuye na za kaminuza. Ati “Uyu munsi turishimira ko amakipe yo muri kaminuza yagarutse, nibura umwana azajya arangiza amashuri yisumbuye akomeze gukina no muri kaminuza, ubu nibura nibazajya bakina amarushanwa mpuzamahanga bazajya baba bafite imyitozo myiza.” Utabarutse yavuze ko shampiyona y’uyu mwaka bayishyizemo imbaraga nyinshi kugira ngo abagore bitabire cyane kandi banakine ku rwego ruri hejuru. Mu yindi mikino yabaye hirya no hino mu gihugu, ISF Nyamasheke yatsinze ES Mudasomwa 30-3, inatsinda IPRC Karongi ibitego 17-8; UR Rukara yatsinze IPRC Karongi ibitego 8-6 naho TTC de la Salle itsinda Falcons ibitego 23-27.

title: Rurangirwa  yavuze ku misifurire yo mu Rwanda na penaliti Police FC ivuga ko yibwe kuri APR FC
content: Ngo uhiriye mu nzu ntaho adapfunda imitwe. Iyi ni imvugo Abanyarwanda bakoresha, umuntu ashobora kwifashisha uvuga ku magambo y’abatoza batandukanye. Aha ariko ushobora guhuza iyi ntero n’indi igira iti "nta nduru ivugira ubusa" dore ko hari abasifuzi bigaragara ko koko baba bakoze amakosa mu kazi kabo, bakabihanirwa. Icyumweru turi gusoza cyavuzwemo imisufirire mibi mu mikino itandukanye irimo uwahuje Rayon Sports na Etincelles FC, aho umutoza mushya w’ikipe y’i Rubavu, yavuze ko mu myaka 20 amaze mu mupira ari ubwa mbere abonye imisifurire itari myiza. Abanya-Rusizi ntibishimiye kubona Espoir FC yabo itsindirwa mu rugo na Gicumbi FC, bahitamo kwandikira FERWAFA bagaragaza ko bibwe ndetse bashinja abasifuzi gufata ruswa ya Gicumbi FC. Umukino wahuje APR FC na Police FC ku wa Gatatu, na wo wavuzweho byinshi nyuma y’uko umusifuzi Twagirumukiza Abdul Karim adatanze penaliti ku mupira wakozwe n’ukuboko kwa myugariro wa APR FC, Buregeya Prince nyuma yo guhindurwa na Iyabivuze Osée. Police FC yandikiye FERWAFA bukeye bwaho, isaba ko abayoboye uyu mukino wayihuje na APR FC bahanwa  mu gihe byagaragara ko banze gutanga iyi penaliti. Imisifurire yo mu Rwanda ni mibi cyangwa ni amakipe akabya?  Rurangirwa Louis ni Umuyobozi wa Rugende WFC ndetse yabaye umusifuzi mpuzamahanga kugeza mu 2011. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE, yavuze ko umwuga w’ubusifuzi ugoranye bitewe n’igihe gito abawukora baba bafite mbere yo gufata ibyemezo. Yakomeje avuga ko atari mu Rwanda gusa imisifurire inengwa, ariko asanga bigoye ko bizarangira bitewe n’imiterere y’uyu mwuga. Ati “Imisifurire abantu bagomba kumenya ko ari umwuga mubi, ni umwuga usaba gushishoza, ni umwuga usaba gufata icyemezo ako kanya, rimwe na rimwe rero hari igihe nk’abafana cyangwa abakunzi b’amakipe batabivugaho rumwe n’ibyemezo yagiye afata.” “Imisifurire ntiyakunze kuvugwa rumwe haba mu Rwanda, muri Afurika no ku Isi hose kandi ntibizahinduka kuko ni ibintu umuntu afata ako kanya kandi akoresheje ubwenge, mu gihe kitarenze amasegonda atatu.” Rurangirwa yakomeje avuga ko kuba umunsi ku munsi hari ikoranabuhanga rigenda ryongerwa mu misifurire, ari ukugira ngo rifashe abasifuzi, aho kuri ubu biba ngombwa ko umukino uhagarara hagafatwa umwanzuro hifashishijwe amashusho (Video Assistant Referee “VAR”). Ati “Umusifuzi ni umuntu ashobora kwibeshya, n’i Burayi bibaho, turabibona no mu mashampiyona akomeye bibaho. Icya kabiri, tumenye ko n’amategeko yagiye ahinduka kuko umupira w’amaguru ugenda utera imbere.” Rurangirwa: Penaliti Police FC ivuga ntabwo yariyo IGIHE yabajije uyu mugabo icyo avuga ko ikosa ryashoboraga kuvamo penaliti, ikipe ya Police FC yavuze ko yibwe. Rurangirwa yavuze ko ku ruhande rwe itari penaliti kuko uburyo myugariro wa APR FC yakozemo umupira atabishakaga ku buryo ukuboko ariko yari gukoresha  ahagarika umupira. Ati “Ibyo bisaba ubushishozi bwinshi, cyane cyane iyo ukuboko kutavuye mu mwanya wako, ku bwanjye numva nta penaliti yakagombye kubaho. Simbizi niba mwarabonye amashusho, akaboko birasa naho gahinnye, ntibivuze ko ukuboko kose iyo kwazamutse ako kanya biba ari penaliti.” Rurangirwa wabaye umusufizi wo hagati mu kibuga, asanga umusifuzi Twagirumukiza Abdul Karim yari ahagaze neza ubwo iri kosa ryabaga, aho yemeje ko bimwemerera kuba yahagarara ku cyemezo yafashe. Ati “Kuba narabaye umusifuzi wo hagati biranyorohera guhita mibona ko ikosa ari ikosa cyangwa atari ryo. Sinzi niba mwarabibonye, uriya musifuzi arihuta, ni ukuvuga ngo ikosa ryabaye arireba. Hari igihe umuntu adasifura ikintu kubera ko ari kure. “ “Na we ni umusifuzi mpuzamahanga erega, iyo akoze ikosa baramuhana kandi iyo ugeze ku rwego rwo guhamagarwa mu Gikombe cya Afurika, hari udukosa utakora. Njye icyo mushimira ni uko yari hafi y’aho byabereye.” Uyu mugabo wigeze kugaragaza ubushake bwo kuyobora Ishyirahamwe ry’Umupira w’Amaguru mu Rwanda (FERWAFA) yatanze ingero z’ahandi hagiye habaho amakosa y’abakinnyi bakina inyuma bakoze imipira mu rubuga rw’amahina, ariko ntihatangwe penaliti. Ati “Bikimara kuba nahise mfata telefoni ndareba, nsanga bimeze neza nk’ibyabaye ku mukino wa Manchester City na Liverpool ejo bundi rwose, muze kureba. Noneho bo bafite VAR kandi ntibateye penaliti.” Ese yaba ari amakipe cyangwa abafana bakabya? Rurangirwa avuga ko akenshi igitutu abatoza baba bariho cyangwa intego amakipe aba yariyemeje, atuma ntaho badapfunda imitwe, akavuga ko yibwe. Yakomeje avuga ko umufana w’ikipe ajya ku kibuga yifuza ko ikipe ye itsinda ku buryo mu gihe idatsinze bigoye ko yakwishima cyangwa ngo anyurwe n’ibyabaye mu mukino. Yasabye Ishyirahamwe ry’Umupira w’Amaguru mu Rwanda guhugura amakipe, rihereye ku batoza n’abakinnyi kuko umutoza aramutse amenye amategeko y’imisifurire byajya byoroha ko n’abakunzi b’umukino bakira ibyawuvuyemo. Ati” Njyewe inama nagira Komisiyo y’imisifurire mu Rwanda, aho bigeze bahugure abantu. Harageze ko n’abatoza bahugurwa bakanakora ibizamini. Bajye mu makipe bereke abakinnyi amategeko mashya, naho ubundi bizahora ari akaduruvayo. Umuntu nahugurwa, ntazasagarira umusifuzi. “ “Namusagarira bizaba ari cya gitutu cy’abakinnyi, cy’amakipe agiye kumanuka  cyangwa ashaka igikombe. Namwe abanyamakuru kuko mushobora kuvuga uko mubibona kandi amategeko yarahindutse cyane.” Mu mezi atanu Shampiyona y’u Rwanda ya 2019/20 imaze itangiye, hamaze guhagarikwa abasifuzi batatu. Ngabonziza Dieudonné yahaniwe kwanga igitego Heroes FC yatsinze mu mukino wayihuje na Bugesera FC, Rulisa Patience yahaniwe kudatanga penaliti ku mukino Kiyovu Sports yanganyijemo na Gasogi United mu gihe Umutoni Aline yahagaritswe kubera kudatanga penaliti ku mukino wa Gasogi United na Gicumbi FC.

title: APR FC yanyagiye Mukura VS y’abakinnyi 10, ikomeza kuyobora Shampiyona
content: Imbere y’abafana buzuye Stade ya Huye, APR FC  yinjiye neza mu mukino ndetse mu minota itanu ibanza, yabonye uburyo bubiri  bwiza,  Mukura Victory Sports itabarwa n’abakinnyi bayo bakina inyuma. Ikipe y’ingabo yakomeje gushyira igitutu kuri iyi kipe y’i Huye, bitanga umusaruro ku munota wa 17 ubwo Nshuti Innocent warebanaga neza n’umunyezamu Iratugenera Edouard, umupira awushyira mu rushundura. Igice cya mbere nticyahiriye Mukura yakiniraga imbere y’abafana bayo, aho ku munota wa 31, Umunya-Ghana Munir Abdul Raman, yacenze ba myugariro ba APR FC, ariko umupira awutera hejuru. Igice cya kabiri cyatangiranye ishyaka rikomeye ku makipe yombi, Mukura Victory Sports ishaka kwishyura, umupira w’umutwe watewe na Iradukunda Bertrand usanga umuzamu Omar Rwabugiri ahagaze nabi, awukozaho imitwe y’intoki werekeza muri koruneri. Umukino wahinduye isura ku munota wa 54 ubwo Byiringiro Lague yasigaga ba myugariro ba Mukura Victory Sports, abatsindana igitego cya kabiri n’umutwe nyuma yo gusigarana na myugariro, Uwihoreye Jean Paul n’umunyezamu gusa. APR FC yakomeje gusatira izamu rya Mukura, ibona uburyo bwa Niyonzima Olivier ‘Sefu’ wateye ishoti rikomeye ku munota wa 59, ku bw’amahirwe make ye umupira ufata umutambiko w’izamu. Nyuma y’igitutu gikomeye APR FC yashyize kuri Mukura, abakinnyi bo hagati b’iyi kipe y’i Huye batangiye gukora amakosa cyane, kapiteni wayo Niyonkuru Ramadhan ahabwa ikarita itukura ku munota wa 60. APR FC yungukiye ku buke bw’abakinnyi ba Mukura Victory Sports, irushaho kuyisatira ndetse yashoboraga kubona igitego cya gatatu ku mupira watewe na Niyonzima Olivier, uca ku ruhande gato rw’izamu. Habura iminota 10 ngo umukino urangire, Ishimwe Kevin yateye ishoti rikomeye, umunyezamu Iratugenera Edouard ananirwa kugarura uyu mupira wavuyemo igitego cya gatatu. Ku munota wa kabiri muri itanu y’inyongera nibwo myugariro Fitina Ombolenga yirukankanye abakinnyi ba Mukura Victory Sports, abatsinda igitego cya kane cya APR FC. Gutsinda uyu mukino byafashije APR FC gukomeza kuyobora Shampiyona n’amanota 54, irusha amanota arindwi Rayon Sports ya kabiri na 47. Abakinnyi 11 babanjemo ku mpande zombi: Mukura VS: Iratugenera Edouard, Uwihoreye Jean Paul, Manzi Aimable,Rugirayabo Hassan, Hitimana Janvier, Niyonkuru Ramadhan (C), Mutabazi Hachim, Biraboneye Aphrodis, Ntwari Evode, Iradukunda Bertrand na Muniru Abdul Rahman. APR FC: Rwabugiri Omar, Manzi Thierry (C), Buregeya Prince, Manishimwe Emmanuel, Ombolenga Fitina, Niyonzima Olivier, Bukuru Christophe, Manishimwe Djabel, Ishimwe Kevin, Nshuti Innocent na Byiringiro Lague.

title: REG BBC ya mbere yatsinze Espoir, APR BBC ikomereza kuri IPRC Kigali
content: REG BBC yaherukaga gutsindwa na APR BBC, n’ubundi yagowe n’intangiriro z’umukino wayihuje na Espoir BBC, aho iminota itandatu ibanza yarangiye ifite amanota 6-8. Beleck Bell na Nshobozwabyosenumukiza bagerageje kuyigarura mu mukino, bayitsindira amanota yatumye ijya imbere (12-8) habura iminota ine, ariko abakinnyi ba Espoir BBC barimo Kasongo, Irumva na Mugiraneza basubizamo ikinyuranyo cy’amanota atanu (12-17). Utundi duce uko ari dutatu twatsinzwe na REG BBC, aka kabiri igatsinda ku manota 20-12, aka gatatu kuri 18-6 mu gihe aka nyuma karangiye kuri 20-13. Kami Kabange ni we watsinze amanota menshi muri uyu mukino, aho yatsinze 15 mu gihe Shyaka Olivier bakinana muri REG BBC yatsinze amanota 13. Gutsinda uyu mukino byafashije REG BBC gukomeza kuyobora Shampiyona n’amanota 19 mu mikino 10, irusha amanota atatu Patriots BBC ikina na UR Huye BBC kuri uyu wa Gatandatu. Undi mukino wari witezwe na benshi ni uwa APR BBC na IPRC Kigali, benshi bari bategereje kureba niba nyuma yo gutsinda REG ikomereza no kuri IPRC Kigali, byaje no kuyihira,  iwutsinda ku manota 79-70. Agace ka mbere katsinzwe na IPRC Kigali ku manota 23-20, APR BBC itsinda aka kabiri ku manota 16-15 n’aka gatatu kuri 25-10 mu gihe aka nyuma katsinzwe na IPRC Kigali ku manota 20-18, umukino urangira ari 79 ya APR BBC kuri 70 ya IPRC Kigali. Sangwe Armel wa APR BBC na Isezerano Enock wa IPRC Kigali ni bo batsinze amanota menshi aho buri umwe yatsinze 15, Niyonkuru Pascal ‘Kaceka’ na Iyakaremye Emmanuel ‘Zulu’ ba APR BBC, buri umwe atsinda amanota 13. APR BBC yahise ifata umwanya wa kane n’amanota 13, isimbura IPRC Kigali BBC yari iwuriho nyuma yo kunganya amanota, ariko ikayisumbya ayo zizigamye.

title: Isiganwa ry’imodoka “Nyirangarama Rally” rigiye kuba ku nshuro ya kabiri
content: Mu mwaka ushize ubwo iyi Rally yabaga ku nshuro ya mbere, yegukanywe na Giancarlo Davite mu gihe mu 2018 habaye igisa n’igeragezwa ry’iri siganwa ribanziriza ayandi mu mwaka wa Shampiyona yo gusiganwa mu modoka. Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru cyabaye kuri uyu wa Gatanu kuri Pilipili i Nyarutarama, Nzamwita Eric, uyobora isiganwa ry’uyu mwaka, yavuze ko imyiteguro bayigeze kure, aho bamaze kuvugana n’abapilote bashobora kuzaza gukina n’imihanda ikaba yaramaze kwemezwa. Ati “Twatumiye abapilote 10 bo mu Rwanda n’abo hanze bagera ku munani bo mu Burundi. Kugeza ubu ntabwo navuga abamaze kwemeza ko bazaza kuko baracyafite igihe cyo kwemeza ko bazakina, umunsi wa nyuma ni tariki ya 13 z’uku kwezi.“ Nzamwita yakomeje avuga ko isiganwa ry’uyu mwaka rizakinirwa ku ntera y’ibilometero 295.5 (birimo 151.8 byo gusiganwa), mu mihanda ya Kinini, Cyinzuzi, Tumba no ku musozi wa Tare, hose inshuro ebyiri. Kalisa Thierry, umwe mu bari bahagarariye Entreprise Urwibutso Nyirangarama ya Sina Gérard, yavuze ko bishimira gutera inkunga iri siganwa ry’amamodoka kuko rifasha akarere ka Rulindo kumenyekana cyane umusozi wa Tare. Ati “Siporo tuyishyigikira kuko ifasha Abanyarwanda. Hamwe n’akarere ka Rulindo, duhora twifuza ko ibyo dukora bitagarukira ku byo kurya gusa cyangwa ubumenyi duha abanyeshuri. Sina Gérard yiyemeje gutera inkunga iyi Rally. Ni ubwa gatatu tugiye kuyitera inkunga.” “Gushyigikira uyu mukino byatumye agasozi kacu kamenyekana n’ishuri ryacu riramenyekana. Umubare w’abanyeshuri wariyongereye kuva dutangiye gukorana nabo.” Nyirangarama Rally ni ryo siganwa rya mbere rizakinwa uyu mwaka riri ku ngengabihe ya Shampiyona y’umukino wo gusiganwa mu modoka mu Rwanda, rikaba rizabanziriza Rwanda Mountain Gorilla Rally izaba muri Gicurasi (ikaba inabarwa mri Shampiyona Nyafurika) mu gihe hazakurikiraho Huye Rally  na Rallye des Milles Collines. title: Gasogi United yatsinze imikino ibiri yikurikiranya mu cyiciro cya mbere (Amafoto)
content: Gasogi United yaherukaga gutsindira Kiyovu Sports ku Mumena, n’uyu munsi yatangiye umukino iri hejuru, ishaka kwihorera kuri Espoir FC yayitsindiye hakurya y’ishyamba mu mikino ibanza. Uburyo bwa mbere bukomeye, bwabonetse hakiri kare, Umugande Kikoyu Hassan ananirwa gutsindira Gasogi United ku munota wa kabiri, ku mupira wari uhinduwe na Dusabe Jean Claude mu gihe kandi na Habimana Yves yahushije uburyo bwabazwe ku mupira yashoreye yasize abakinnyi ba Espoir FC, ukamubana muremure. Gasogi United yakomeje gushyira igitutu ku bwugarizi bwa Espoir FC, iyi kipe y’i Rusizi itabarwa n’umunyezamu Bihoyiki Kagabo wakuyemo imipira ibiri ikomeye n’undi umwe wagaruriwe ku murongo na Wilondja Jacques. Iminota ibanza y’igice cya kabiri, yaranzwe no gusatira kwa Espoir FC, ariko Gasogi United ibaca mu rihumye, itsinda igitego ku munota wa 52, umusifuzi wo ku ruhande yerekana ko Habimana Yves yari yaraririye. Igitego kimwe rukumbi cyabonetse muri uyu mukino, cyatsinzwe na Hassan Kikoyu kuri penaliti, nyuma y’uko yari amaze kugushwa mu rubuga na Uwineza Jean de Dieu ku munota wa 78. Gutsinda uyu mukino byafashije Gasogi United kugira amanota 28 ku mwanya wa karindwi mu gihe hari andi makipe azakina umunsi wa 22 wa Shampiyona ku wa Gatandatu no ku Cyumweru. Ni ku nshuro ya mbere Gasogi United yazamutse mu cyiciro cya mbere uyu mwaka, itsinze imikino ibiri yikurikiranya ya Shampiyona. Espoir FC yakomeje kuba mu myanya itatu ya nyuma, aho ifite amanota 16 gusa ku mwanya wa 14, inota rimwe hejuru y’umurongo utukura. Gahunda y’umunsi wa 22 wa Shampiyona Ku wa Gatanu tariki ya 6 Werurwe 2020 Ku wa Gatandatu tariki ya 7 Werurwe 2020 Ku Cyumweru tariki ya 8 Werurwe 2020 Amafoto: Umurerwa Delphin

title: Cameroun yagaragayemo umurwayi wa Coronavirus, Amavubi ashobora kutitabira CHAN 2020
content: CHAN 2020 izabera muri Cameroun guhera tariki ya 4 kugeza ku ya 25 Mata, izitabirwa n’ibihugu 16 birimo u Rwanda ruzaba ruri mu itsinda C hamwe na Maroc, Uganda na Togo. Itangazo ryashyizwe hanze na Minisiteri y’Ubuzima muri Cameroun kuri uyu wa Gatanu, rivuga ko muri icyo gihugu hagaragayemo umurwayi wanduye coronavirus. Rigira riti “Minisiteri y’Ubuzima iremeza  ko hari umurwayi wa COVID-19 ku butaka bwa Cameroun. Ni umuturage w’Umufaransa w’imyaka 58 wageze i Yaoundé tariki ya 24 Gashyantare 2020.” Iri tangazo rikomeza rivuga ko hashyizweho ingamba zikomeye zo gukurikirana ibijyanye n’iki cyorezo, akaba ari nayo mpamvu havumbuwe ko hari uyu murwayi washyizwe mu kato mu bitaro bikuru bya Yaoundé kugira ngo yitabweho. Minisiteri y’Ubuzima muri Cameroun yasabye abatuye icyo gihugu, kurushaho gukurikiza amabwiriza ajyanye n’isuku mu rwego rwo kwirinda iki cyorezo gihangayikishije abatari bake ku Isi. Amavubi ashobora kutitabira CHAN 2020 Ikipe y’Igihugu ‘Amavubi’ y’abakina imbere mu gihugu, ishobora kutitabira CHAN 2020 izabera muri Cameroun kubera iki cyorezo cya COVID-19 cyatangiye kuhavugwa. Umwe mu myanzuro yafatiwe mu nama yahuje Minisiteri ya Siporo, ingaga za siporo n’amashyirahamwe y’imikino mu Rwanda kuri uyu wa Kane,  uvuga ko mu rwego rwo kwirinda iki cyorezo, abakinnyi n’amakipe yagombaga guhagararira igihugu mu mikino mpuzamahanga, agomba kwirinda kujya mu bihugu bivugwamo COVID-19. Hemejwe ko kandi ku mikino n’ibindi bikorwa bihurirwaho n’abantu benshi, hashyirwaho uburyo bufasha abantu kugira isuku ndetse hakanatangwa ubutumwa bubakangurira kwirinda iki cyorezo. Ahandi byifashe gute? Muri Maroc, imikino yaho ya Shampiyona isigaye ibera mu muhezo mu rwego rwo kwirinda iki cyorezo gikomeje guhitana abantu. Mu Bushinwa, aho cyahereye, ibikorwa byose by’imikino byarahagaritswe mu gihe mu Butaliyani, imikino imwe yagiye isubikwa kubera iki cyorezo. Mu Bwongereza, bafashe icyemezo cyo gukuraho ibyo gusuhuzanya kw’abakinnyi mbere y’uko umukino utangira.

title: Natnael Tesfazion ashobora kwegukana Tour du Rwanda 2020 nubwo agace ka nyuma kagoye
content: Tour du Rwanda 2020 irasozwa kuri iki Cyumweru hakinwa agace ka munani kazenguruka mu Mujyi wa Kigali ku ntera y’ibilometero 89.3. Nyuma yo gusoza agace ka karindwi kakiniwe i Nyamirambo ejo hashize, ku wa Gatandatu, Komiseri Ntiyamira Jean Sauveur, yabwiye IGIHE ko Natnael Tesfazion asa n’uwamaze kwegukana Tour du Rwanda 2020, keretse habayeho izindi mpamvu zituma adasoza isiganwa. Ati “Kuyoyoka [kw’amahirwe y’Abanyarwanda] ntabwo umuntu yapfa kubivuga, ariko uko isiganwa riteye abakinnyi bose bagera ku munsi wa nyuma bananiwe. Ikigaragara ni uko uriya Munya-Erythrée atatakaje ibihe muri ITT ahubwo Moïse [Mugisha] niwe watakaje mu bahabwaga amahirwe." “Ejo [uyu munsi] ni etape ya nyuma izamuka, biragoye ko njye nakwemeza ko uriya munya-Erythrée [Tesfazion] yatakaza umwambaro w’umuhondo keretse agize ibindi byago nko kugwa akavamo cyangwa akagira izindi mpamvu nk’uburwayi. Nkurikije uko bimeze njye ndemeza ko umwambaro w’umuhondo yawutwaye.” Kuri iki Cyumweru ubwo iri siganwa riza kuba risozwa, abakinnyi barahaguruka i Gikondo ahasanzwe habera imurikagurisha (Expo Ground), berekeze i Rebero, aho bazanyura Norvège no kwa Mutwe, ku ntera y’ibilometero 89.3 . title: Watford yanyagiye Liverpool yari imaze imikino 44 idatsindwa
content: Ismaila Sarr yatsinze ibitego bibiri muri uyu mukino mbere y’uko Troy Deeney ashyiramo icya gatatu mu mukino wagarutsweho kurusha iyindi muri uyu mwaka. Watford yari imbere y’abafana bayo, yabonye uburyo butandukanye mu gice cya mbere, Liverpool itabarwa n’umunyezamu Alisson Becker wakuyemo umupira wa Troy Deeney. Igitego cya mbere cyo muri uyu mukino w’umunsi wa 28 wa Premier League, cyabonetse ku munota wa 54 gitsinzwe na Ismaila Sarr ku mupira wari uhinduwe na Abdoulaye Doucoule. Liverpool yaherukaga kugorwa cyane na West Ham, yarushijwe bigaragara no muri uyu mukino ndetse nyuma y’iminota itandatu itsindwa ikindi gitego cya Ismaila Sarr waherejwe na Troy Deeney. Kapiteni wa Watford, yashimangiye intsinzi ku munota wa 72, ubwo yaherezwaga na Ismaila Sarr, umupira yaterereye ku murongo w’urubuga rw’amahina ukaruhukira mu nshundura. Gutsindwa uyu mukino ntacyo bihindura ku mahirwe ya Liverpool ku gikombe cya Shampiyona cy’uyu mwaka, aho iyoboye n’amanota 79, ikaba irusha 22 Manchester City ya kabiri mu gihe hasigaye imikino 10. Liverpool yari imaze imikino 44 ya Shampiyona idatsindwa, kuva muri Mutarama 2019 ubwo yatsindwaga na Manchester City. Arsenal niyo kipe yamaze imikino myinshi ya Shampiyona idatsinzwe (49) mu mateka ya Premier League. Ni ubwa mbere kandi Liverpool yananiwe gutsinda igitego mu mukino wa Premier League guhera muri Werurwe 2019 ubwo yanganyaga ubusa ku busa na Everton, ikaba yari imaze imikino 36.

title: Youri Djorkaeff yagarutse mu Rwanda, yiyemeza gukundisha Abanyarwanda PSG (Amafoto)
content: Ni ku nshuro ya kabiri uyu mugabo wanakiniye Ikipe y’Igihugu y’u Bufaransa, ageze mu Rwanda nyuma yo kuhagera mu mwaka ushize. Uruzinduko rwe mu Rwanda ruri muri gahunda y’ubufatanye Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB) giherutse kugirana na PSG yo mu cyiciro cya mbere mu Bufaransa, binyuze muri Visit Rwanda. Youri Djorkaeff n’itsinda ry’abagera kuri barindwi bari bamuherekeje, basohotse mu Kibuga Mpuzamahanga cy’Indege cya Kigali saa mbiri n’iminota 21. Uyu mugabo wishimiye kugaruka mu Rwanda, yavuze ko muri iki gihe azahamara, azasaba Abanyarwanda gukunda Ikipe ya Paris Saint-Germain. Ati “Ni igihugu cyiza gifite abaturage beza. Ni inshuro yanjye ya kabiri hano kuko nahageze bwa mbere mu Ukwakira mbonana na Perezida wanyu. Ubu nishimye ko nzabona umwanya wo gutembera hose nkabonana n’Abanyarwanda kandi ndizera ko bazakunda Paris Saint-Germain.” Agaruka ku bufatanye bw’u Rwanda na PSG, Youri Djorkaeff yavuze ko u Rwanda rwahisemo neza ndetse impande zombi zizabwungukiramo. Ati “Buri gihe biba ari ubufatanye bwiza mu gihe igihugu kibona ko umupira wacu ari mwiza kandi u Rwanda ni igihugu kigaragarira Isi yose, bahisemo ikipe nziza kuko PSG ifite ishusho ishobora kuzamura igihugu mu buryo bwose.” Kuri gahunda za Djorkaeff mu minsi ine azamara mu Rwanda, harimo ko ejo ku Cyumweru azabonana n’abana bakina umupira w’amaguru mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Azasura kandi Pariki y’Ibirunga ndetse anahure n’abafana ba Paris Saint-Germain. Youri Raffi Djorkaeff w’imyaka 51, yakiniye amakipe yo mu Bufaransa, u Butaliyani, u Budage, u Bwongereza na Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Yakiniye amakipe arimo Grenoble, Strasbourg, Monaco, Paris Saint Germain, Inter Milan, Kaiserslauten, Bolton Wanderers, Blackburn Rovers na New York Red Bulls. Yakiniye kandi Ikipe y’Igihugu y’u Bufaransa (Les Bleus) hagati ya 1993 na 2002, aho yari mu ikipe yatwaye Igikombe cy’Isi mu 1998, icy’u Burayi (Euro) mu 2000 n’icy’ibihugu kibanziriza icy’Isi, FIFA Confederations Cup mu 2001. title: Restrepo Jhonatan yegukanye Agace ka Karindwi, yandika amateka muri Tour du Rwanda 2020 (Amafoto na Video)
content:
Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 29 Gashyantare 2020, isiganwa mpuzamahanga ry’amagare rizenguruka igihugu “Tour du Rwanda” ryakomereje i Nyamirambo mu Mujyi wa Kigali, mu gace kabanziriza aka nyuma, kagizwe n’intera y’ibilometero 4.5. Restrepo Jhonatan yakoresheje iminota itandatu n’amasegonda 32, yakurikiwe na Ghirmay Hailu Biniam wa Nippo Delko Provence wakoresheje 6’34’’. Umunyarwanda wakoresheje ibihe bito ni Areruya Joseph wasoje ku mwanya wa 11 akoresheje 6’55’’. Uyu mukinnyi w’imyaka 25, akinira Androni Giocattoli – Sidermec yo mu Butaliyani, agace yegukanye ni aka kane muri turindwi tumaze gukinwa muri Tour du Rwanda. Kiyongereye ku ka Gatatu ka Tour du Rwanda 2020 kavuye i Huye kagana i Rusizi aho yakoresheje amasaha atatu, iminota 47 n’amasegonda 39 ku ntera y’ibilometero 142; aka Gatanu ka Rubavu-Musanze n’aka Gatandatu ka Musanze-Muhanga kakinwe ku wa 28 Gashyantare 2020. Agace kakiniwe muri Nyamirambo abasiganwa banyuze mu muhanda wo kwa Mutwe ahazwi nka Mur de Kigali kegukanywe na Restrepo Jhonatan ahita yinjira mu bitabo by’amateka muri Tour du Rwanda. Ni uwa mbere utwaye uduce tune kuva Tour du Rwanda yashyirwa ku rwego rwa 2.1 mu 2019 ndetse ni uwa kabiri kuva mu 2009 iri siganwa rigizwe mpuzamahanga rivuye kuri 2.2. Agahigo ko kwegukana uduce tune mu irushanwa kari gafitwe n’Umunyamerika Kiel Reijnen wabigezeho mu 2011, akanegukana Tour du Rwanda y’uwo mwaka. Bitandukanye n’uduce dutandatu twabanje cyangwa aka nyuma kazakinwa ku Cyumweru, aho abakinnyi bakinira mu makipe, uyu munsi buri wese yakinnye ku giti cye, asiganwa n’ibihe [Individual Time Trial]. Tour du Rwanda izasozwa ku wa 1 Werurwe 2020 hakinwa Agace ka Munani kazagurukira kuri Expo Ground i Gikondo kagasorezwa ku i Rebero ku ntera y’ibilometero 89.3. Mu bahabwa amahirwe yo kuyegukana ni Natnael Tesfatsion umaze gukoresha 20h38’58’’ mu duce turindwi akaba arusha Mugisha Moïse wa SACA wa kabiri umunota n’amasegonda 30. AMAFOTO MENSHI Y’ABAKINNYI BASIGANWA MU MIHANDA Y’I NYAMIRAMBO Adrien Misigaro na Gentil Misigaro baraye bageze mu Rwanda bavuye muri Amerika barebye agace kakiniwe i Nyamirambo Abahanzi bamaze kubaka izina mu muziki wo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana, Adrien Misigaro na Gentil Misigaro bageze mu Rwanda ku wa 28 Gashyantare 2020 aho bitabiriye ibitaramo bazahuriramo na Israel Mbonyi. Ibi bitaramo byiswe “Each one reach one” byateguwe mu rwego rwo gukangurira buri wese mu Banyarwanda kuba bafasha byibuza umuntu umwe wabaswe n’ibiyobyabwenge kubivamo bityo bigafasha kwihutisha ubukangurambaga bwa “Melody of New Hope”. Mu gihe azamara mu Rwanda, Adrien Misigaro n’ikipe bazaba bari kumwe bazasura ibigo bitandukanye bifasha ababaswe n’ibiyobyabwenge. Igitaramo cy’i Kigali kizaba tariki 8 Werurwe 2020 muri Intare Arena mu gihe tariki 15 Werurwe 2020 bazakomereza muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda, Ishami rya Huye muri Auditorium. Restrepo yakuyeho agahigo kari kamaze imyaka isaga icyenda Umunya-Colombia Restrepo Jhonatan yegukanye uduce tune muri Tour du Rwanda y’uyu mwaka. Yageze ku gahigo kari gafitwe n’Umunyamerika Kiel Reijnen wabikoze mu 2011, akanaryegukana.  Ibyo wamenya kuri Restrepo wegukanye agace ka kane muri turindwi tumaze gukinwa muri Tour du Rwanda 2020 Jhonatan Restrepo Valencia ukinira Androni Giocattoli – Sidermec yo mu Butaliyani yavutse ku wa 28 Ugushyingo 1994.
