Kugeza ubu abayoboye isiganwa ni: Umunyarwanda Mugisha Moïse avuga ko iyi minsi ibiri isigaye ngo Tour du Rwanda 2020 isozwe, itandukanye n’iyindi yabanje, ariko agiye gukora ibishoboka kugeza ku munsi wa nyuma. Ati “Iminsi ibiri ya nyuma itandukanye n’iyindi. Sinzi niba ejo [uyu munsi] nasiga abandi bose muri buriya bilometero 4.5. Nzakora ibyo nshoboye kugira ngo nkabanye ibihe noneho ku munsi wa nyuma ndebe ko nabikuramo byose.” 13:10: Abasiganwa batangiye kugera i Nyamirambo. Abakinnyi barimo aba Novo Nordisk bamaze kugera ahatangirira isiganwa ku Ishuri ry’Intwari. Abantu ni benshi baje kwirebera uko abakinnyi bitwara kuri uyu munsi ubanziriza uwa nyuma. Agasozi ko kwa Mutwe karaza kugora benshi Ku bwa Ntiyamira Jean Sauveur, Komiseri urambye muri Tour du Rwanda, asanga abakinnyi bataza koroherwa n’agace k’uyu munsi bitewe n’agasozi karimo ko kuzamuka kwa Mutwe. Ati “Ariko mwitonde cyane, kuko aka gace karimo umusozi umaze kwamamara ku isi hose Mur de Kigali. Twe abanyarwanda tuhazi nko kwa Mutwe i Nyamirambo. Aha ni ukwitonda cyane kuko birashoboka ko umukinnyi ushoboye kwitwara igice kinini, ashobora gukora amateka agahindura ibintu bitewe n’uyu musozi wo kwa Mutwe uri kuri Cat ya 1 ugoye cyane kuzamuka.” Umujyi wa Kigali mu mateka ya Tour du Rwanda Ni ku nshuro ya 39 Umujyi wa Kigali utangiriyemo agace ka Tour du Rwanda mu gihe ari ku nshuro ya mbere Mur de Kigali (Kwa Mutwe) hagiye gusorezwa agace k’iri siganwa rizenguruka igihugu. Imiterere y’Agace ka Karindwi ka Tour du Rwanda 2020 Abakinnyi bahagurukiye ku ishuri “Intwari i Nyamirambo”, berekeza Tapis Rouge, bamanuka mu Nyakabanda. Bazamuka kwa Mutwe, basoreza kuri 40 ku ntera y’ibilometero 4.5. Uko abakinnyi bigabanyije imyambaro itangwa kugeza ubu:  	Cogebanque yaherekeje Tour du Rwanda 2020, yegereza Abanyarwanda serivisi z’imari Cogebanque iri gusobanurira abitabiriye Tour du Rwanda serivisi zitandukanye z’imari nuko bazikoresha mu guhindura ubuzima bwabo. Muri gahunda za Cogebanque Plc zo gufasha Abanyarwanda kuzamura ubukungu bwabo no gukemura ibibazo bitandukanye, iyi banki yakomeje gushyira abakiliya igorora ibaha inguzanyo ku mushahara izwi nka ‘Gisubizo Loan Express’, itangwa nta ngwate. Gisubizo Loan Express ni inguzanyo Cogebanque itanga ku bakiliya bayo babona umushahara wa buri kwezi. Ni inguzanyo ikubye inshuro zigera kuri 15 z’umushahara umuntu ahembwa ku kwezi, na we akagenda yishyura agera kuri 50% by’umushahara we buri kwezi. Usabye iyi nguzanyo, ayibona mu gihe kitarenze iminsi mike iyo yujuje ibisabwa. Gisubizo Loan Express iri gutangwa mu buryo buvuguruye ishobora kwishyurwa mu myaka itanu mu gihe kuyibona bifata iminsi mike ku wujuje ibisabwa. Iyo umukiliya ashaka kwishyura inguzanyo mbere y’igihe, nta bundi bwishyu bw’inyongera asabwa yaba yishyura yose cyangwa igice. Umukiliya ashobora gukurikirana imiterere y’uburyo bwo kwishyura kandi akoresheje porogaramu ya CogemBank.  	Rwanda Foam yegereje Abanyarwanda ibicuruzwa bishya  Rwanda Foam imaze imyaka 37 ifasha Abanyarwanda koroherwa no kubona aho kurambika umusaya, itanga ibicuruzwa birimo matela n’imisego biramba kandi bihendutse. Rwanda Foam yatangiranye na Tour du Rwanda 2016, itera inkunga iri siganwa kuri iyi nshuro yaherekejwe na Mbabazi Shadia wamamaye ku mbuga nkoranyambaga nka Shaddy Boo n’umuraperi Tuyishime Joshua [Jay Polly] basusurukije abakiliya b’amagare mu gihugu hose.  	Menya Nyamirambo ahabereye Agace ka Karindwi ka Tour du Rwanda 2020 Nyamirambo ni agace gaherereye mu Karere ka Nyarugenge mu Mujyi wa Kigali; gakunda kuvugwa cyane bitewe n’uko abagaturiye baba bafite umwihariko w’imibereho itandukanye cyane n’iy’abatuye mu tundi duce. Benshi mu banyamujyi bemeza ko bazi aka gace kubera ko ari ko ka mbere k’Umujyi wa Kigali kagaragaramo ibintu bihendutse cyane yaba ibyo kurya, kwambara cyangwa inzu zo gukodesha. Nyamirambo ni hamwe mu misozi yapfiriyemo Abanyoro batagira ingano, cyane cyane mu bice bikikije umusozi wa Kigali kuri Stade ya Nyamirambo no ku Musigiti w’Abayisiramu no mu gace bakunze kwita Kuryanyuma. Bitewe n’Abanyoro benshi bahaguye, babuze gishyingura maze Abashumba baragiye inka bakagira batya bakabona umurambo w’umuntu, abahinzi bajya gutema ibihuru ngo bahinge, bagasangamo umurambo w’Umunyoro washangutse. Abahigi batamitse umuheto, impigi zabo zikabazanira imirambo y’Abanyoro. Ibyo byatumye ababibonye batangarira ibyo barimo kubona ni ko kugira bati “Aha si ahantu ho kubabwa n’abantu, ni ah’imirambo’’. Uko ni ko bakurijeho kuhita Nyamirambo, hacibwa iteka ryo kuzajya hashyingurwa hagahinduka irimbi, ko nta muntu uzongera kuhatura. Amateka y’ibyahabaye yatumye hagirwa n’umwihariko wo gushyingurwamo n’imisozi ihegereye nk’ahari irimbi rya Rugarama na bugingo n’ubu. Nyamirambo: Bivuga ahatuwe n’imirambo, ahahariwe gushyingurwa, Inturo y’Abazimu (abantu bapfuye). Amafoto: Niyonzima Moïse na Umurerwa Delphin Video: Mugwiza Olivier

title: Minisitiri Munyangaju yashimiye Mugisha Moïse wiyongereye amahirwe yo kwegukana Tour du Rwanda 2020
content: Mbere y’agace ka gatandatu ka Tour du Rwanda 2020 kakinwe kuri uyu wa Gatanu, Mugisha Moïse yarushwaga iminota ibiri n’amasegonda 11 ku rutonde rusange. Mu ntera y’ibilometero 127.3  byakozwe uyu munsi kuva i Musanze kugera i Muhanga, Mugisha Moise yabaye uwa munani asiga Umunya-Erythrée Tesfazion Natnael wabaye uwa 15. Amasaha atatu, iminota 11 n’amasegonda 15 Mugisha Moïse yakoresheje, agasiga Tesfazion umunota umwe n’amasegonda atatu, byatumye hasigaramo ikinyuranyo cy’umunota umwe n’amasegonda umunani gusa ku rutonde rusange mu gihe hasigaye uduce tubiri kugira ngo Tour du Rwanda 2020 igere ku musozo. Abinyujije ku rubuga rwa Twitter, Minisitiri wa Siporo, Munyangaju Aurore Mimosa, yashimiye Mugisha Moïse uko akomeje kwitwara muri iri siganwa rizenguruka igihugu, riri kuba ku nshuro ya 12. Yagize ati “Uko urutonde rwa Tour du Rwanda ruhagaze uyu munsi, wakoze neza Mugisha Moïse. Komeza utsinde! Umuntu utsinda ntajya arekera kugerageza… Jya mbere Rwanda. Dutewe ishema nawe.” Thank you @AuroreMimosa https://t.co/HaCf9VrpkC — Adrien Niyonshuti Cycling Academy (@acyclingacademy) February 28, 2020 Uretse ubu butumwa, Minisitiri Munyangaju yashyizeho kandi ubundi buriho ifoto ya Mugisha Moïse n’iya Areruya Joseph bombi bari mu myanya umunani ya mbere ku rutonde rusange, avuga ko nibakomeza gukorera hamwe nk’ikipe bizabafasha kugera kure. General classification @tour_du_Rwanda 2ème place, Mugisha Moise à 1.08 minutes du maillot jaune 8ème place, Areruya Joseph à 3.52 minutes du maillot jaune. Travail d’equipe, ensemble on va + loin. Well done @cyclingrwanda @AbdallahMurenz2 @Rwanda_Sports pic.twitter.com/w4iCMhliIR — Aurore Mimosa Munyan (@AuroreMimosa) February 28, 2020 Ubwo yaganiraga n’abakinnyi bahagarariye u Rwanda muri iri siganwa, ejo hashize, Munyangaju yabasabye gukorera hamwe nk’ikipe kugira ngo bakomeze kurinda umwanya wa kabiri. Abakinnyi 15 nibo bahagariye u Rwanda muri Tour du Rwanda 2020, bakaba bagabanyije mu makipe atatu: Team Rwanda, Benediction Ignite na Skol Adrien Cycling Academy (SACA). Tour du Rwanda 2020 irakomeza kuri uyu wa Gatandatu mu gace ka karindwi k’iri siganwa riri ku rwego rwa 2.1. Abasiganwa bazakora intera y’ibilometero 4.5 i Nyamirambo buri mukinnyi asiganwa n’ibihe ku giti cye. Ku Cyumweru, umunsi wa nyuma w’isiganwa, abakinnyi bazakora intera y’ibilometero 89.3  bahagurukiye kuri Expo Ground mu isiganwa rizaca mu bice by’Umujyi wa Kigali birimo umusozi wa Rebera na Mont Kigali. title: Umuyobozi Mukuru wa UCI yasuye Ikigo cy’Amagare i Musanze (Amafoto)
content: Lanaya yageze mu Rwanda kuri uyu wa Gatanu, mu ruzinduko rugamije kureba aho u Rwanda rugeze rwitegura kwakira Shampiyona y’Isi y’umukino w’amagare izaba mu 2025. Muri Nzeri umwaka ushize nibwo u Rwanda rwatanze ibisabwa byose, rusaba ko rwazakira Shampiyona y’Isi y’Amagare izabera muri Afurika, rukaba ruhanganye na Maroc. Uretse kureba aho u Rwanda rugeze imyiteguro mu rugendo rwo kwakira Shampiyona y’Isi, uyu Muyobozi Mukuru wa UCI, Amina Lanaya, yavuze ko yaje no guhagararira Ishyirahamwe ry’Umukino w’Amagare ku Isi muri Tour du Rwanda 2020, aho biteganyijwe ko azareba agace ka nyuma k’iri siganwa ryo ku rwego rwa 2.1, rizasozwa ku Cyumweru tariki ya 1 Werurwe. Ku bijyanye n’aho yasanze u Rwanda rugeze imyiteguro, Amina Lanaya, yashimye aho bigeze, ashimangira ko u Rwanda ari igihugu gifite imihanda myiza kandi ko n’Abanyarwanda bakunda cyane umukino w’amagare. Nyuma yo kwakirwa na Guverineri Gatabazi, Amina Lanaya yasuye kandi Ikigo gitorezwamo abakinnyi b’umukino w’amagare mu Rwanda  (Africa Rising Cycling Center) giherereye mu Murenge wa Nyange mu Karere ka Musanze. Guverineri Gatabazi yabwiye IGIHE ko ibiganiro bagiranye byagarutse no ku kuba Ikigo cy’Amagare cya Musanze cyaba mpuzamahanga. Ati “Twaganiriye ku bijyanye n’uko Musanze yaba ikigo cy’icyitegererezo mu karere  nk’uko nari narabiganiriye na President wa UCI ubwo yadusuraga na we. Yambwiye ko nubwo icyemezo kitarafatwa ariko u Rwanda arirwo ruzagira ikigo cya EAC.” Amina Lanaya yasuye u Rwanda nyuma y’imyaka ibiri, Perezida wa UCI David Lappartient na we ahageze muri Kanama 2018. Lanaya yasuye kandi Centre Culturel Ibyiwacu iherereye mu Kinigi, aho yasobanuriwe ibijyanye n’umuco Nyarwanda wo hambere.

title: Amavubi yanganyije na Congo Brazzaville mu mukino wa gicuti
content: Ni umukino wa kabiri wa gicuti Amavubi yakinnye muri iki Cyumweru nyuma yo kunganya na Cameroun ubusa ku busa ku wa Mbere, mu rwego rwo kwitegura CHAN 2020 izaba muri Mata. Amavubi yatangiye umukino asatira, abona uburyo bw’ishoti ryatewe na Usengimana Danny mu minota ya mbere, ariko ntacyo bwatanze. Uyu mukinnyi yongeye kubona uburyo bwiza ku ruhande rw’u Rwanda, ishoti yateye rikurwamo n’umunyezamu wa Congo Brazzaville, umupira usubijwemo na Ngendahimana Eric, umunyezamu Ndila Pavelh awushyira muri koruneri. Habura iminota itanu ngo igice cya mbere kirangire, Congo Brazzaville yabonye uburyo bwashoboraga kuyihesha igitego, umupira watewe na Obossi Bersyl ukurwamo na Kimenyi Yves. Mu gice cya kabiri, Congo Brazzaville yakomereje ku rwego yasorejeho icya mbere, nyuma y’iminota itandatu ihusha uburyo bwabonywe na Ninguila wari uherejwe na Hardy Prince. Ku munota wa 55, Usengimana Danny yananiwe gutsindira Amavubi ku buryo bwabazwe, aho yari asigaranye n’umunyezamu, agiye gutera umupira arawuhusha. Ndekwe Félix, Nshuti Dominique Savio, Iyabuvuze Osée na Manishimwe Djabel binjiye basimbuye, bafatanyije na bagenzi babo gushaka igitego ariko nta buryo bukomeye bugana mu izamu bigeze babona. Muri CHAN 2020 izaba guhera tariki ya 4 kugeza ku ya 25 Mata, u Rwanda ruzaba ruri mu itsinda C hamwe na Maroc ifite irushanwa riheruka, Uganda na Togo igiye kurikina ku nshuro ya mbere. title: Youri Djorkaeff wakiniye PSG n’u Bufaransa ategerejwe mu Rwanda
content: Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Iterambere, RDB, kibinyujije kuri Twitter cyatangaje ko “Ejo u Rwanda ruzakira uwahoze akinira PSG ndetse agatwarana igikombe cy’Isi n’ikipe y’Igihugu y’u Bufaransa, Youri Djorkaeff, mu ruzinduko rw’iminsi ine. Uru ruzinduko ruri muri gahunda y’ubufatanye bwa Visit Rwanda na Paris Saint Germain bwasinywe mu Ukuboza umwaka ushize”. Youri Raffi Djorkaeff yavutse kuwa 9 Werurwe 1968. Yakiniye amakipe yo mu Bufaransa, u Butaliyani, u Budage, u Bwongereza na Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Djorkaeff yatsinze ibitego 28 mu mikino 82 yakinnye mu ikipe y’igihugu y’u Bufaransa hagati ya 1993 na 2002. Yatwaye igikombe cy’Isi mu 1998, atwara igikombe cy’u Burayi (Euro) mu 2000, umwaka ukurikiyeho (2001) atwara igikombe cy’ibihugu kibanziriza icy’Isi, FIFA Confederations Cup. Yakiniye amakipe arimo; Grenoble, Strasbourg, Monaco, Paris Saint Germain, Inter Milan, Kaiserslauten, Bolton Wanderers, Blackburn Rovers na New York Red Bulls. Mu Ukuboza umwaka ushize, RDB yatangiye ubufatanye n’ikipe ya Paris St Germain buzamara imyaka itatu bugamije kureshya abashoramari no gukomeza kuba icyerekezo kibereye ubukerarugendo. RDB yatangaje ko ubu bufatanye buzafasha abakurikira PSG n’isi muri rusange kumenya ubwiza bw’u Rwanda, umuco ndetse n’udushya twaruhangwamo kimwe n’ibicuruzwa bigezweho birukorerwamo, bya ’Made in Rwanda.’ Ubu bufatanye kandi bwitezweho kurushaho gufungurira amarembo abashoramari bo mu Bufaransa no mu bindi bice by’Isi ku buryo babyaza umusaruro amahirwe aboneka mu Rwanda. U Rwanda rwiteze ko binyuze muri ubu bufatanye, abakinnyi b’ikipe ya PSG n’ibindi byamamare mpuzamahanga, bizabafasha gusura u Rwanda, bakabona ibyiza bitatse igihugu cy’imisozi igihumbi uhereye ku bijyanye n’ubugeni, umuco, siporo, muzika, ubukerarugendo, amafunguro n’ubwiza bw’igihugu muri rusange. Ibi bihe ntagereranywa bizajya bisangizwa abakurikira PSG ku mbuga nkoranyambaga zayo barenga miliyoni 70 bari hirya no hino ku Isi. Muri ubu bufatanye, ikirango cya Visit Rwanda kizajya kigaragazwa kuri Stade ya Parc des Princes aho PSG yakirira imikino yayo ndetse no ku mugongo ku myenda iyi kipe ikoresha mu myitozo no mu gihe cyo kwishyushya mbere y’imikino, yaba iyo yambara yasuye indi kipe cyangwa iyo yambara iwayo muri Shampiyona y’u Bufaransa, Ligue 1. Guhera umwaka utaha w’imikino, ubu bufatanye buteganya ko icyayi cy’u Rwanda n’ikawa aribyo byonyine bizajya bitangwa kuri Parc des Princes. Hazabaho kandi icyumweru cy’imishinga y’abanyempano b’abanyarwanda n’Abafaransa. Icyo cyumweru cyiswe “Semaine du Rwanda à Paris” kizajya gitegurwa na PSG mu kumenyekanisha ibintu byose bikorerwa mu Rwanda. Mu bijyanye no kuzamura impano z’u Rwanda, PSG izagira uruhare mu kuzamura abakiri bato binyuze mu gushinga ishuri ry’umupira w’amaguru i Kigali, aho iyi kipe izajya itegura imyitozo y’abatoza n’abakiri bato mu kubafasha kugira ubunararibonye bw’iyi kipe ikomeye mu Burayi, by’umwihariko yanditse amateka mu Bufaransa.

title: Etincelles FC yerekanye umutoza mushya w’Umwongereza, iburira Rayon Sports bigiye guhura
content: Calum Shaun Salby yakiniye Barnsley FC  yo mu cyiciro cya kabiri mu Bwongereza. Yabaye kandi Umuyobozi wa tekiniki muri Villa SC yo muri Uganda, yegukanye  igikombe cya Shampiyona mu 2017. Uyu mugabo abaye umutoza wa gatatu ugiye gutoza Etincelles FC muri uyu mwaka w’imikino nyuma ya Seninga Innocent na Bekeni bagiye begura. Aganira n’itangazamakuru nyuma yo kwerekwa abakinnyi n’abafana, Calum Salby  yavuze ko agiye gufatanya n’abakinnyi kuzamura iyi kipe kandi ko bitazamugora kuko yakoreye muri Uganda. Ati "Nsanzwe nkurikirana umupira w’u Rwanda cyane cyane ikipe ya Rayon Sports ubwo yari mu matsinda. Ubu maze kuvugana n’abakinnyi kandi twumvikanye kuzakora byiza cyane kuko nshaka ko twubaka ikipe ihangana. Nabaye muri Uganda,  ni kimwe na hano bakoresha ingufu na tekinike, tuzareba ko ibyo byose byangana.’’ Umuyobozi wa Etincelles FC, Ruboneka Gédéon, yavuze ko uyu mutoza basanze ari we wujuje ibyo bashakaga avuga ko bumvikanye gutangirana na Rayon Sports. Ati “Tumaze iminsi dushaka umutoza none twamubonye kandi twasanze ari we twifuzaga ko yadutoza mu mikino 10 isigaye kandi twumvikanye ko intego ari ukuzamura ikipe. Aratangirana na Rayon Sports kandi ntabwo iduteye ubwoba. Twumvikanye ko tugiye kuyitegura, abakinnyi yasabye ko bajya bakora imyitozo kabiri ku munsi.” Kapiteni wa Etincelles, Gikamba Ismael, yavuze ko biteguye gutsinda Rayon Sports kuko ari ikipe itajya ibatera ubwoba. Ati “Rayon Sports turayiteguye ni ibisanzwe kuko ni ikipe itajya ikanga Etincelles. Turimo kuyitegura nk’ibisanzwe kandi turabizi ko tuzayitsinda imana nibidufashamo.” Umukino wa Etincelles FC na Rayon Sports uzaba ku wa Gatatu tariki ya 4 Werurwe 2020 kuri Stade Umuganda i Rubavu. Etincelles FC iri ku mwanya wa 12 n’amanota 22 mu gihe Rayon Sports iri ku mwanya wa gatatu n’amanota 41 mu mikino itatu imaze gukinwa.

title: Ruremesha utoza Kiyovu Sports yahawe uburenganzira bwo gutoza mu cyiciro cya mbere
content: Nyuma y’imyaka isaga itatu hakozwe amahugurwa y’abatoza bo mu cyiciro cya mbere mu Rwanda, bamwe mu batoza barimo na Ruremesha Emmanuel bari batarabona ibyemezo  batsindiye. Ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru muri Afurika (CAF)  ryagaragazaga  ko uyu mutoza yatsindiye  iyo mpamyabushobozi  ariko itaroherezwa kugira ngo  yemererwe kwitwa umutoza mukuru mu cyiciro cya mbere. Kuri uyu wa Kane  nibwo Ferwafa yashyikirijwe impamyabushobozi (Licences) z’uyu mutoza zombi uko yazitsindiye (A,B), bikaba bisobanuye ko ubu yemerewe kuba umutoza mukuru mu cyiciro cya mbere bitari iby’agateganyo nkuko byari bimeze muri Kiyovu Sports. Ruremesha  yiyongereye ku bandi batoza batandukanye, batsindiye Licence A mu myaka itatu ishize. Amabwiririza mashya ya Ferwafa  avuga ko udafite iyi mpamyabushobozi atemerewe gutoza mu cyiciro cya mbere nk’umutoza mukuru. Ruremesha yaciye mu makipe atandukanye, arimo Mukura VS, Musanze FC aherukamo, Etincelles FC, Gicumbi FC, Atraco FC n’izindi.

title: Restrepo Jhonatan yegukanye agace ka Gatandatu ka Tour du Rwanda 2020 kakinwe imvura ijojoba (Amafoto na Video)
content:
Agace ka Gatandatu k’Isiganwa Mpuzamahanga ry’Amagare rizenguruka igihugu “Tour du Rwanda” kakinwe kuri uyu wa 28 Gashyantare 2020, kahagurukiye i Musanze gasorezwa i Muhanga ku ntera y’ibilometero 127.3. Abakinnyi banyuze mu mihanda ya Musanze bafata Nyabihu, Ngororero basoreza i Muhanga, bahuriye n’imvura nyinshi mu mihanda ndetse yanatumye abakinnyi bakora impanuka ariko yoroheje itababujije gukomeza no gusoza isiganwa. Restrepo Jhonatan yasesekaye i Muhanga akurikiwe na Schelling Patrick wa Israel Start-up Nation na Quintero Norena Carlos Juan wa Terengganu bakoresheje ibihe bimwe. Uyu mukinnyi w’imyaka 25, akinira Androni Giocattoli – Sidermec yo mu Butaliyani, agace yegukanye ni aka gatatu muri dutandatu tumaze gukinwa muri Tour du Rwanda. Kiyongereye ku ka Gatatu ka Tour du Rwanda 2020 kavuye i Huye kagana i Rusizi aho yakoresheje amasaha atatu, iminota 47 n’amasegonda 39 ku ntera y’ibilometero 142 n’aka Gatanu ka Rubavu-Musanzekakinwe ku wa 27 Gashyantare 2020. Umunyarwanda wasoje hafi ni Mugisha Moïse wa munani, wasizwe umunota umwe n’amasegonda 43 mu gihe Manizabayo Eric, Gahemba Beranabe uvukana na Areruya Joseph baje ku mwanya wa 11 n’uwa 12 basizwe iminota ibiri n’amasegonda 43. Umunya-Erythrée Tesfatsion Natnael yakomeje kwambara umwenda w’umuhondo nyuma yo kuba uwa 15, asizwe iminota ibiri n’amasegonda 46. Ku rutonde rusange Mugisha Moïse ari ku mwanya wa kabiri ndetse yagabanyije ikinyuranyo n’umuri imbere. Tour du Rwanda 2020 igeze aharyoshye biteganyijwe ko izakomeza ku wa Gatandatu, abakinnyi bakina basiganwa buri wese abarirwa ibihe yakoresheje [Individual Time Trial]. Ni Agace ka Karindwi kazakinirwa i Nyamirambo ku ntera y’ibilometero 4.5. Izindi nshuro ni mu: Ni ku nshuro ya gatatu isiganwa rya Tour du Rwanda rivuye i Musanze ryerekeza i Muhanga ndetse ni ku nshuro ya kane uyu Mujyi ugiye gusorezwamo agace ka Tour du Rwanda. Izindi nshuro ni mu: Imiterere y’agace ka gatandatu: Musanze- Muhanga (ibilometero 127.3 ) Abasiganwa barahagurukira imbere y’isoko rya Musanze batangire kubarirwa ibihe bamaze gufata umuhanda wa Nyakinama. Amanota ya mbere yo kuzamuka, yatangiwe ku kilometero cya 8.3 ku gasozi ka Busogo mu gihe aya kabiri yatangiwe ku kilometero cya 28 ku gasozi ka Busoro. Aya gatatu yatangiwe ku kilometero cya 51.5 ku gasozi ka Kukinyanda mu gihe aya nyuma yatangiwe ku gasozi ka Ryakarimira abasiganwa bageze ku kilometero cya 112.9. Amanota ya mbere yo kuvuduka (sprint) yatangiwe ku kilometero cya 22.4 ku Mukamira mu gihe aya nyuma yatangiwe i Ngororero ku kilometero cya 76. Uko kugeza ubu abakinnyi bigabanyije imyambaro itangwa: Agace ka Gatandatu katangiriye i Musanze mu Majyaruguru Agace ka Gatanu ka Tour du Rwanda kasorejwe mu Mujyi rwagati wa Musanze mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru, ikungahaye cyane ku bijyanye n’ubukerarugendo. Intara y’Amajyaruguru ni igicumbi cy’ahantu nyaburanga. Iza ku ruhembe rw’izisurwa cyane na ba mukerarugendo ikabafasha kwishimira ibihe bagirira mu Rwanda. Amajyaruguru ari ku buso bwa 3293.3 km2, ahana imbibi na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo na Uganda. Ni intara igizwe n’uturere dutanu, imirenge 89, utugari 414 n’imidugudu 2744. Iyi ntara ikungahaye ku buhinzi n’ubworozi, uburobyi, ubukerarugendo n’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro arimo Zahabu iboneka muri Gicumbi na Burera, Coltan (Rulindo na Gakenke), Wolfram (Rulindo na Burera) na Gasegereti. Ikundirwa ibirimo Pariki y’Ibirunga icumbikiye ingagi zo mu misozi miremire, Buhanga Eco– park ndetse n’Ibirunga bya Muhabura, Gahinga na Sabyinyo. Intara y’Amajyaruguru ni ikigega cy’igihugu mu buhinzi aho abaturage bakora mu nganda z’icyayi cya Kinihira n’icya Mulindi muri Gicumbi buri kwezi basarura miliyoni 500 Frw. title: Europa League: Arsenal na Ajax zasezerewe, Manchester United ikomeza inyagiye Club Brugge (Amafoto)
content: Arsenal yatsindiwe ku mukino wa nyuma wa Europa League mu mwaka ushize, na Ajax yageze kure muri UEFA Champions League y’umwaka ushize, yari amwe mu makipe yasigaye mu irushanwa ry’uyu mwaka afite amazina akomeye. Mu mukino wo kwishyura wabaye ejo kuwa Kane kuri Emirates Stadium mu Bwongereza, Arsenal yari yatsinze igitego 1-0, yatunguriwe iwayo na Olympiacos, yayisezereye hitabajwe itegeko ry’igitego cyo hanze. Nta buryo bwinshi bugana mu izamu bwabonetse ku mpande zombi kugeza ku munota wa 38 ubwo Bukayo Saka yahinduraga umupira mu rubuga rw’amahina, ushyizwe mu izamu na Alexandre Lacazette, umusifuzi wo ku ruhande avuga ko habayeho kurarira. Nyuma y’iminota irindwi amakipe yombi avuye kuruhuka, Pape Abou Cissé yatsinze igitego cyagaruriye Olympiacos icyizere ku mupira wari uvuye muri koruneri yatewe na Mathieu Valbuena. Iyi kipe yo mu Bugereki yashoboraga kandi gutsinda igitego cya kabiri ku munota wa 56, ishoti rikomeye ryatewe na Konstantinos Tsimikas rishyirwa muri koruneri n’umunyezamu Bernd Leno. Nicolas Pépé yateye ishoti rikomeye rikurwamo n’umunyezamu José Sa wa Olympiacos mbere y’uko Lacazette atera umupira w’umutwe wanyuze ku ruhande. Byasabye Arsenal gutegereza umunota wa 23 muri 30 yongereweho kuko amakipe yombi yanganyaga igitego 1-1 mu mikino yombi, itsindirwa igitego cyayihesheje icyizere cyo gukomeza  na Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang ku mupira yigaramye uvuye kuri Gabriel Martinelli. Ibyari ibyishimo ku bakunzi ba Arsenal, byahindutse amarira n’agahinda ku munota wa 118 ubwo Youcef El Arabi yatsindaga igitego cya kabiri cya Olympiacos ku mupira wahinduwe na Giorgos Masouras. Aubameyang yahushije uburyo bwa nyuma bwabonetse mu mukino, umupira wari utakajwe na myugariro wa Olympiacos awuteye mu izamu uca ku ruhande, Arsenal irasezererwa. Mu yindi mikino yabaye, Manchester United yakomeje muri 1/8 nyuma yo kunyagira Club Brugge yo mu Bubiligi ibitego 5-0 mu mukino wo kwishyura wabereye mu Bwongereza. Igice cya mbere cyarangiye ari ibitego 3-0 byatsinzwe na Bruno Fernandes kuri penaliti, Odion Ighalo watsinze igitego cye cya mbere mu mashitani atukura na Scott McTominay wakinnye umukino we wa mbere nyuma yo gukira imvune mu gihe Fred yatsinze ibitego bibiri byabonetse mu minota 10 ya nyuma. Club Brugge yakinnye iminota isaga 75 ari abakinnyi 10 mu kibuga, ni nyuma y’uko Simon Deli yahawe ikarita itukura nyuma yo kugarura umupira waganaga mu izamu akoresheje ukuboko, hatangwa penaliti yavuyemo igitego cya mbere ku munota wa 24. Ajax yo mu Buholandi, na yo yari mu makipe yitezwe uyu mwaka, yasezerewe na Getafe yo muri Espagne nubwo yatsinze ibitego 2-1 mu mukino wo kwishyura. Umukino ubanza wari warangiye Getafe itsinze 2-0. Amakipe 15 yakomeje muri 1/8 cya Europa League ni: Rangers, AS Roma, Wolfsburg, LASK, Basel, Bayer Leverkusen, Istanbul Basaksehir, Wolves, Shakhtar Donetsk, Inter Milan, Manchester United, Olympiacos, Seville, Getafe na FC Copenhagen. Uyu munsi nibwo hamenyekana ikipe ya 16 iva hagati ya Salzburg na Eintracht Frankfurt. Amafoto y’umukino wa Manchester United na Club Brugge

title: Tour du Rwanda 2020: Abahagarariye u Rwanda batuye Minisitiri Munyangaju ikibazo cy’amagare atagezweho bakinisha
content: Icyizere cyo kuba Umunyarwanda yakwegukana Tour du Rwanda 2020 cyangwa kamwe mu duce twayo, cyagabanutse kuri uyu wa Kane nyuma y’agace ka gatanu kegukanwe n’Umunya-Colombia, Restrepo Jhonatan Valencia. Minisitiri wa Siporo Munyangaju Aurore Mimosa watangije aka gace ka gatanu i Rubavu, yasuye abakinnyi b’Abanyarwanda ubwo isiganwa ryari rirangiye, aho bacumbitse mu kigo cy’amagare cya Africa Rising Cycling Center kiri mu Murenge wa Nyange mu Karere ka Musanze, akaba ari naho ikipe y’igihugu “Team Rwanda” ikorera umwiherero. Umutoza wa Benediction Ignite, Sempoma Félix, akaba ari na we watoje Team Rwanda muri La Tropicale Amissa Bongo yabaye mu kwezi gushize muri Gabon, yabwiye Minisitiri Munyangaju ko kimwe mu bituma kugeza ubu Abanyarwanda nta musaruro mwiza bafite muri Tour du Rwanda 2020 ari uko amagare bakoresha atajyanye n’urwego iri siganwa rigezeho. Ati “Amagare dufite ni ikibazo kuko ntabwo amagare dufite ari aya 2.1, amagare dufite ni aya 2.2. Ndumva rero kuba Leta y’u Rwanda ishyigikiye umukino bizagenda neza hakaboneka amagare ajyanye n’icyiciro turimo.” Tour du Rwanda yabaye mpuzamahanga kuva mu 2009, mu 2019 nibwo yashyizwe ku rwego rwa 2.1 ivuye kuri 2.2 ndetse ni ku nshuro ya kabiri ikinwe iri ku rwego rwo hejuru, aho guhera mu mwaka ushize yitabirwa n’amakipe akomeye arimo n’akina amarushanwa yo ku rwego rw’Isi. Nubwo kugeza ubu nta Munyarwanda uregukana agace ka Tour du Rwanda kuva igiye ku rwego rwa 2.1 mu mwaka ushize, Minisitiri Munyangaju, yashimiye abakinnyi bahagarariye u Rwanda uko bakomeje kwitwara, aho kugeza ubu Mugisha Moïse wa SACA, ari uwa kabiri ku rutonde rusange, asigwa iminota ibiri n’amasegonda 11 na Natnael Tesfazion uyoboye isiganwa nyuma y’uduce dutanu. Ati “Twishimiye urwego umukino w’amagare uriho kandi no muri iyi Tour du Rwanda ndahamya ko duhagaze neza kuko ubu dufite umwanya wa kabiri.” Yongeye kwibutsa abakinnyi ko bagomba guharanira ishema ry’igihugu bafatanyije, bakarinda ibyagezweho birimo n’uyu mwanya wa kabiri ufitwe n’Umunyarwanda. Ati  “Umwanya wa kabiri dufite tuwufite nk’u Rwanda ntabwo tuwufite nk’ikipe runaka. Icyo dushaka ni ugukomeza kwitwara neza mu nzira zisigaye biranshoboka ko twaratwara irushanwa.” Umuyobozi w’Ishyirahamwe Nyarwanda ry’umukino w’amagare, Murenzi Abdallah, yasabye abakinnyi gukomeza guhatana bakagira umusaruro mwiza, anabizeza ko nibitwara neza nta kabuza ikibazo cy’amagare bafite kizakemuka. Ati “Ku bufatanye bwacu na Minisiteri ntabwo bizananirana. Aya magare tujya kuyabona ni uko twari twagaragaje umusaruro, n’ubu dutwaye umwenda byahamagara ibindi kdi byiza.” Uretse bamwe mu bakinnyi ba Team Rwanda bakoresha amagare yatanzwe na Perezida Kagame nyuma y’uko ikipe y’igihugu yari yatwaye Tour du Rwanda ya 2015, abandi bakoresha amagare amakipe yabo yiguriye. Kapiteni wa Team Rwanda, Mugisha Samuel, wavuze mu izina ry’abakinnyi, yijeje Minisitiri Munyangaju n’abayobozi ba FERWACY, ko bagiye gukora iyo bwabaga bakagira agace begukana muri dutatu dusigaye. Ati “Tour du Rwanda 2020 turimo sinavuga ngo hari icyo twabuze wenda gituma tutaratwara agace kayo. Nta kibazo kinini dufite ahubwo mu mukino bibaho. Gusa tugiye gukora ibishoboka kugira ngo turebe ko byagenda neza.” Abakinnyi 15 nibo bahagariye u Rwanda muri Tour du Rwanda 2020, bakaba bagabanyije mu makipe atatu: Team Rwanda, Benediction Ignite na Skol Adrien Cycling Academy (SACA). Tour du Rwanda 2020 izakomeza ejo ku wa Gatanu mu gace ka gatandatu k’iri siganwa riri ku rwego rwa 2.1. Abasiganwa bazakora intera y’ibilometero 127.3, bazahaguruka i Musanze saa tatu (09:00) berekeza i Muhanga, aho byitezwe ko bazahasesekara saa 12:30 zibura iminota mike.

title: Abanyarwanda babuze amahirwe yo kwegukana agace ka gatanu ka Tour du Rwanda 2020 (Amafoto)
content: Abasiganwa bahagurutse mu Mujyi wa Rubavu saa tanu (11:00) babanza kuzenguruka uyu mujyi inshuro eshatu mbere yo gufata umuhanda wa Musanze. Munyaneza Didier ukinira Benediction Ignite, yacitse bagenzi be ubwo bari bageze mu bilometero 25, asiga abandi  amasegonda 10. Bageze mu bilometero 37 Byukusenge Patrick ni we wayoboye isiganwa, asize igikundi cyarimo abakinnyi benshi amasegonda 39 mu gihe Areruya Joseph yashatse kumukurikira, agarurwa n’igikundi. Byukusenge Patrick wahawe amanota yo kuzamuka yatangiwe ku gasozi ka  Sashwara, aho yasigaga igikundi hafi iminota ibiri. Yari akurikiwe n’umunya-Ethiopia, Buru Tesmegen we yasigaga umunota n’amasegonda 30. Byukusenge yakomeje kuyobora isiganwa ariko ibihe bagenda babigabanya kugeza mu bilometero umunani bya nyuma ubwo hari hasigayemo amasegonda 16. Habura ibilometero bitatu gusa, nibwo Byukusenge Patrick yafashwe n’igikundi abakinnyi binjira mu Mujyi wa Musanze bari mu gikundi kugeza ubwo Umunya-Colombia Restrepo Jhonatan yatsindaga bagenzi be abatanze gukoza ipine ku murongo. Restrepo yakoresheje amasaha abiri, iminota umunani n’amasegonda 19, aho yari mu gikundi kimwe na Tesfazion Natnael wakomeje kwambara umwenda w’umuhondo. Umunyarwanda waje hafi ni Mugisha Moïse wa SACA wabaye uwa 16, asizwe amasegonda ane mu gihe ku mwanya wa 18 haje Hakizimana Seth bakinana. Ntiyamira Jean Sauveur umwe mu bakomiseri b’umukino w’amagare mu Rwanda, yabwiye IGIHE ko kuba Abanyarwanda batabashije kwegukana agace k’uyu munsi, amahirwe yabo asa n’ayarangiye. Ati "Iyi Tour du Rwanda irakomeye, turacyafite étape ebyiri ziri imbere zikomeye, ariko Eritrea ifite ikipe nziza, ifite abahungu bazi kuzamuka. Nabonaga ko Abanyarwanda bashobora gutsinda étape y’uyu munsi, kuba binaniranye nta yandi mahirwe njye mbona tuzabona yo gutwara indi étape.” “Abanyarwanda hari uri ku mwanya wa kabiri ku rutonde rusange n’uri ku wa gatanu. Bakwiye kwiga uburyo bagumana iyo myanya kuko hari n’andi makipe ayishaka.” Tour du Rwanda 2020 izakomeza ejo ku wa Gatanu mu gace ka gatandatu k’iri siganwa riri ku rwego rwa 2.1. Abasiganwa bazakora intera y’ibilometero 127.3, bazahaguruka i Musanze saa tatu (09:00) berekeza i Muhanga, aho byitezwe ko bazahasesekara saa 12:30 zibura iminota mike. title: Europa League: Arsenal yatsindiye Olympiacos iwayo, Manchester United inganyiriza mu Bubiligi (Amafoto)
content: Amakipe yombi yaranzwe no gusatirana mu minota ya mbere, ariko nta kipe yabonye uburyo bukomeye bugana mu izamu mu minota 15 ibanza. Arsenal yashoboraga gufungura amazamu ku buryo bwabonywe na Alexandre Lacazette ku munota wa 20, umupira yatereye mu rubuga rw’amahina  aherejwe na Gabrieli Martinelli, uca iruhande rw’izamu rya Olympiacos ryari ririnzwe na Jose Sa. Olympiacos yakomeje kwihagararaho mu bwugarizi bwayo, ariko nta mbaraga yagaragazaga mu gusatira ku buryo yabona uburyo bugana mu izamu. Igice cya kabiri cyaranzwe n’amakosa menshi hagati y’amakipe yombi, byatumye Olympiacos ibona imipira ibiri y’imiterekano yose yakuwemo n’umunyezamu wa Arsenal , Bernd Leno . Igitego kimwe rukumbi cyabonetse mu mukino cyatsinzwe na Alexandre Lacazette wacitse ba myugariro ba Olympiacos akoza ikirenge ku mupira wahinduwe na Bukayo Saka mu izamu. Gutsinda uyu mukino ubanza, byongereye Arsenal amahirwe yo gukomeza muri 1/8 mbere y’umukino wo kwishyura uzabera Emirates Stadium mu cyumweru gitaha, tariki ya 27 Gashyantare. Mu yindi mikino yabaye, Manchester United na yo yo mu Bwongereza, yari yakiriwe na Club Brugge yo mu Bubiligi, amakipe yombi anganya igitego 1-1. Club Brugge yafunguye amazamu ku munota wa 15 ku gitego cyatsinzwe na Emmanuel Dennis warobye umunyezamu Sergio Romero wari wasohotse hanze y’urubuga rwe ubwo hari hagiye guterwa koruneri y’ikipe ye. Anthony Martial yishyuriye Manchester United habura iminota 10 ngo igice cya mbere kirangire nyuma yo kungukira ku makosa ya ba myugariro ba Club Brugge, akabatwara umupira. Wolves yatsinze Espagnol Barcelone ibitego 4-0, Getafe itsinda Ajax 2-0 mu gihe Ludogorets Razgard yatsinzwe na Inter Milan ibitego 2-0 naho AS Roma itsinda Gent 1-0.

title: Pep Guardiola ntateganya kuva muri Manchester City yafatiwe ibihano na UEFA
content: Mu cyumweru gishize nibwo Manchester City yahagaritswe imyaka ibiri muri aya marushanwa nyuma yo gusanga yararenze ku mategeko agenga imibererho n’umutungo by’amakipe “Financial Fair Play”. Kuva icyo gihe byagiye bivugwa ko Umunya-Espagne, Guardiola, umwe mu batoza beza ku Isi, ashobora kuva muri iyi kipe nyuma y’uko itazongera gukina irushanwa rikomeye i Burayi. Ku ruhande rwe ariko, Pep Guardiola, avuga ko nta mpamvu yatuma ava muri Manchester City mbere y’uko amasezerano ye arangira mu 2021. Nyuma y’umukino iyi kipe ye yatsinzemo West Ham kuri uyu wa Gatatu, Guardiola yabwiye Sky Sports ko mu gihe atakwirukanwa na Manchester City azakomeza kuyitoza. Ati “Niba banyirukanye, ibyo bishobora kuba, ariko nibaramuka batanyirukanye nzaguma hano. Ndashaka kuguma hano, ndashaka kandi gufasha iyi kipe niba bishoboka, ikaguma ku rwego rwiza rushoboka.” “Kuki nagenda? Nabivuze mbere, nkunda iyi kipe.” Manchester City ihakana ko yabeshye mu kumenyakanisha uburyo yinjijemo amafaranga mu iperereza ryakozwe na UEFA ndetse ubuyobozi bwayo bwatangaje ko buzajurira mu Rukiko rwa Siporo (CAS). Guardiola avuga ko “ukuri kuzatsinda” ndetse yijeje abafana ko abakinnyi bazakomeza guhatana kugeza ku mpera z’umwaka w’imikino. Ati “Ndizera 100% ibyo ikipe yanjye yakoze kuko bansobanuriye impamvu yabyo. Tugiye guhatana nk’uko twabikoze kuri buri mukino na buri munsi kugeza ku mpera z’umwaka w’imikino.” “Dufite icyizere ko bizarangira ukuri kubigaragaje noneho umwaka utaha, nituramuka tubonye itike ya UEFA Champions League, tuzayikina.” Manchester City ya kabiri muri Premier League, aho irushwa amanota 22 na Liverpool, kuri ubu iri muri 1/8 cya Champions League y’uyu mwaka, aho izahura na Real Madrid mu cyumweru gitaha ndetse ni ryo rushanwa isigaranyemo amahirwe menshi yo kwegukana muri uyu mwaka wa kane itozwamo na Pep Guardiola.

title: Perezida Kagame na Masai Ujiri bamuritse iserukiramuco rya Giants of Africa rizahuza ibihugu 11 (Amafoto)
content: Giants of Africa (GOA) ni gahunda yatangijwe na Masai Ujiri uvuka muri Nigeria, aho afasha abakiri bato bo ku Mugabane wa Afurika gukura bakunda umukino wa Basketball. Iri serukiramuco rizahuza abahungu n’abakobwa 200 bo mu bihugu 11 bya Afurika, guhera tariki ya 16 kugeza ku wa 22 Kanama 2020. Mu kumurika ibikorwa by’iri serukiramuco, Perezida Kagame yashimiye Masai Ujiri wazanye Umushinga Giants of Africa, avuga ko iri huriro ari ingenzi ku buryo ryabyazwa umusaruro mu kuzamura abana ba Afurika. Ati “Ndashaka guha ikaze buri wese kandi muzabona ko kugeza muri Kanama iki gihugu ari igihugu gitanga ikaze. Ni igihugu giharanira ishema kandi kikanabikorera Afurika.” “Tugomba kwiyitaho ubwacu, tugakora ibikenewe gukorwa by’umwihariko tukabyaza umusaruro amahirwe dufite nk’iri huriro rizahuza abana bato ba Afurika ari nabo benshi ku mugabane wacu. Twizeye ko tuzabibyaza umusaruro nk’uko Masai yabivuze kare, Abanyafurika turatsinda muri gahunda zose twikoreye. Tujye imbere rero.” Masai Ujiri na we yashimiye Perezida Kagame ku ruhare agaragaza mu iterambere rya Afurika, avuga uburyo ari umugabo ushyira mu bikorwa ibyo yiyemeje byose nko kuba yaramubwiye ko agiye kubaka Kigali Arena none ubu akaba ari yo yabereyemo iki gikorwa. Ati “Ndashimira kandi Perezida Kagame ku ruhare rwe rushimishije cyane no kuba yaremereye ko iri huriro ryabera hano. Afurika igomba gutsinda kuko turi abatsinzi.” Myrah Naomi Nantume umwe mu banyuze muri gahunda ya Giants of Africa, yavuze uburyo ifasha abana mu kububakira ubuzima atari mu mukino wa Basketball gusa, ahubwo muri siporo zitandukanye no mu buzima bwa buri munsi, asaba abantu bose kubyaza umusaruro amahirwe babonye. Umushinga wa GOA wa Masai Ujiri, watangiye mu 2003 ukorera muri Nigeria gusa kugera mu 2014 ubwo uyu mugabo yafunguraga imipaka atangira kubikora no mu bindi bihugu bitandukanye bya Afurika birimo n’u Rwanda. Kimwe mu bikorwa byashibutse muri uyu mushinga ni isanwa ry’ikibuga cy’umukino w’intoki wa Basketball cyo kuri Club Rafiki i Nyamirambo. Cyatashywe na Perezida Paul Kagame na Masai Ujiri ku wa 8 Kanama 2017. Gusana iki kibuga ni isezerano ryatanzwe mu 2015 ubwo abatangije Giants of Africa bazaga mu Rwanda, bakagira umwanya wo kujya guhura n’abana bakinira Basketball kuri Club Rafiki. Hari kandi n’ingando z’abana zikorwa kuva mu 2015. Ibihugu 11 bizitabira ihuriro rizabera i Kigali ni Sénégal, Mali, Nigeria, Cameroun, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Sudani y’Epfo, Uganda, Rwanda, Tanzania, Kenya na Somalia. title: U Rwanda rwagumye ku mwanya wa 131 ku rutonde rwa FIFA
content: U Rwanda ruri kuri uyu mwanya n’amanota 1089 ari nayo rwari rufite mu kwezi gushize. Ku mugabane wa Afurika ruri ku mwanya wa 36. Muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, Uganda niyo iri mbere ku mwanya wa 77 ku Isi n’amanota 1321, Kenya iri ku mwanya wa 107, Tanzania iri ku mwanya wa 134, irarushwa n’u Rwanda amanota atatu, u Burundi buri ku mwanya wa 149. U Bubiligi, u Bufaransa na Brésil byagumye ku myanya itatu ya mbere, u Bwongereza buri ku mwanya wa Kane, Uruguay ku mwanya wa Gatanu, Portugal ku wa karindwi, Espagne ku wa munani, Argentine ku wa cyenda naho Colombia iri ku wa 10. title: Abanyarwanda bahize kwegukana Tour du Rwanda, Ferwacy na Rwanda Tea babizeza ishimwe (Amafoto)
content: Ni isiganwa rya kabiri rya Tour du Rwanda rigiye kuba riri ku rwego rwa 2.1 bitandukanye n’irya 2.2 mu myaka 10 yabanje. Birumvikana ko hari itandukaniro kuko kuri ubu haba harimo abakinnyi bakomeye, ndetse itandukaniro ryagaragaye ku ikubitiro ubwo umwaka ushize ryegukanwaga n’Umunya-Erythree Merhawi Kudus wa Astana, mu gihe Umunyarwanda waje hafi yari Areruya Joseph wabaye uwa cyenda. Nyuma y’umwaka umwe hari ibyahindutse ndetse intego n’imihigo ku bakinnyi b’Abanyarwanda bazakina iri rushanwa birakomeje nubwo bemezo ko ari urugamba rutoroshye. Muri iri rushanwa rizitabirwa n’amakipe 16, u Rwanda ruzaba rufitemo Abanyarwanda 15 babarizwa mu makipe atatu; Ikipe y’Igihugu (Team Rwanda), Benediction Ignite y’i Rubavu na SKOL Adrien Cycling Academy (SACA), aya makipe abiri ya nyuma akaba akina amarushanwa yo ku mugabane. Abakinnyi bose hamwe bari mu mwiherero mu Kigo cy’Amagare i Musanze (Africa Rising Cycling Center) ushatse wahita iwabo wa Team Rwanda nubwo atari bo bahari gusa kuko hari n’abandi bakinnyi bakomeye bazakina Tour du Rwanda y’uyu mwaka bari kuhitoreza nk’Umunya-Estonia, Rein Taaramäe ukinira Direct Energie. Uyu yabaye uwa kabiri muri Tour du Rwanda iheruka ndetse byarashoboka ko yayegukana. Amaze gukina amasiganwa akomeye arimo Giro d’Italia, Tour de France na Vuelta ya Espagne. Ari mu bahabwa amahirwe kuri iyi nshuro! Ibi ariko ntibikanga abakinnyi b’Abanyarwanda uhereye kuri Mugisha Samuel na Areruya Joseph ba Team Rwanda, Byukusenge Patrick uyoboye Benediction Ignite cyangwa Mugisha Moïse wa SACA. Kuri uyu wa  Gatatu tariki ya 19 Gashyantare, abakinnyi basuwe na Rwanda Tea izajya yambika umwenda w’umuhondo umukinnyi uyoboye isiganwa. Nyuma yo kubashyikiriza icyayi nka kimwe mu bihingwa byera mu Rwanda bikunzwe n’abatari bake haba mu Rwanda no mu mahanga, Uwacu Cynthia wari uhagarariye Rwanda Tea, yasabye aba bakinnyi kuzitwara neza umwenda w’umuhondo ukaguma mu Rwanda, abasezeranya ko nibabigeraho hari ishimwe bahishiwe bazahabwa. Ati “Twishimiye kuza kubareba hano mu gihe mwitegura gukina Tour du Rwanda. Nitwe tuzatanga umwambaro w’umuhondo, bizadushimisha nituyiha Umunyarwanda aho kugira ngo tuyihe abandi. Twabazaniye impano ntoya, ariko hari ibyo muzabona nimutwara Maillot Jaune.” Kapiteni w’ikipe y’Igihugu y’u Rwanda, Mugisha Samuel, yavuze ko “bazakora ibishoboka byose umwambaro w’umuhondo ugume mu Rwanda” ndetse bizeye ko Imana izabibafashamo. Byukusenge Patrick uzaba ayoboye abakinnyi ba Benediction Ignite, yijeje ko muri Tour du Rwanda, umwambaro w’umuhondo ari uwabo. Abakinnyi basuwe kandi n’Ubuyobozi bw’Ishyirahamwe ry’Umukino w’Amagare mu Rwanda (FERWACY) burangajwe imbere na Perezida waryo, Murenzi Abdallah, wari kumwe na Nkuranga Alphonse, Visi Perezida wa kabiri ushinzwe amarushanwa n’Umunyamabanga Mukuru, Sekanyange Jean Léonard. Murenzi Abdallah yasabye abakinnyi b’Abanyarwanda uko bari mu makipe atatu kuzakorera hamwe baharanira ishema ry’Igihugu, umwambaro w’umuhondo ukazaguma mu Rwanda. Niyonshuti Adrien utoza SACA, watwaye Tour du Rwanda mu 2008, akaba n’umwe mu bafite izina rikomeye mu mukino w’amagare mu gihugu, na we yabwiye aba bakinnyi ko bagomba gufatanyiriza hamwe kuko nibakorera hamwe nta kipe izabatsinda. Abakinnyi basabye FERWACY ko mu gihe bakorera hamwe nk’Abanyarwanda bazashimirwa bingana aho kureba gusa ku ikipe y’Igihugu nubwo aya makipe yandi na yo aba aharanira amanota azayafasha mu yandi marushanwa. Abakinnyi babayeho gute mu mwiherero? Africa Rising Cycling Center (ARCC) ni ikigo kibamo ikipe y’u Rwanda, kikifashishwa kandi n’abakinnyi bavuye mu yandi makipe haba muri Afurika no ku yindi migabane baje kwitoreza mu Rwanda. Ubuyobozi bwacyo buvuga ko gifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira abakinnyi bagera kuri 60 icya rimwe, aho bane babana mu nzu imwe irimo ibitanda bine. Abakinnyi b’Abanyarwanda kuri ubu bari kwitegura Tour du Rwanda, babyuka mu gitondo, saa moya (07:00) bagafata amafunguro ya mu gitondo ashobora kubamo igikoma, icyayi cyangwa ikawa. Imyitozo bayitangira saa yine (10:00) bigaterwa n’iyateguwe n’abatoza n’aho bakorera mu gihe kingana n’amasaha abiri, amafunguro ya saa Sita bakayafata saa sita n’igice  mu gihe saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba (18:00) bakora imyitozo yoroheje yo kunanura imitsi naho amafunguro ya nijoro bakayafata saa moya (19:00). Salade, umureti, ibirayi, inkoko, ibijumba, imboga, capati, imbuto, imigati n’inyama z’inka ni bimwe mu bishyirwa mu mafunguro ahabwa aba bakinnyi kuri ubu babura iminsi mike ngo bakore ibilometero 882.9 mu gihe cy’iminsi umunani banyoga igare. title: Champions League: Tottenham ya Mourinho yatsindiwe mu rugo, Atalanta yihererana Valence CF (Amafoto)
content: Tottenham itozwa na José Mourinho, yakiriye uyu mukino ubanza ibura bamwe mu bakinnyi bayo bakomeye nka Harry Kane umaze iminsi yaravunitse, ukongeraho Son Heung-min wavunitse ikiganza. Iyi kipe yari imbere y’abafana bayo, yarushijwe bigaragara kuva ku munota wa mbere, aho RB Leipzig yakabaye yafunguye amazamu ku buryo bwinshi bwabonetse, Tottenham itabarwa n’umunyezamu Hugo Lloris. Mu gihe cy’amasegonda 60 ya mbere gusa, Lloris yakuyemo imipira ibiri, aho uwa mbere watewe na Angelino yawukuyemo ugafata igiti cy’izamu mbere y’uko akuramo n’irindi shoti rya Timo Werner watereye mu rubuga rw’amahina. Igitego kimwe rukumbi cyabonetse muri uyu mukino cyatsinzwe na Timo Werner kuri penaliti nyuma y’uko umusifuzi yemeje ko umupira uterekwa mu rubuga rw’amahina ubwo Ben Davies yari amaze kugusha Konrad Laimer ku munota wa 57. Tottenham na yo yagiye inyuzamo igasatira ishaka igitego, ariko uburyo burimo umupira w’umuterekano watewe na Giovani Lo Celso bukurwamo n’umunyezamu Peter Gulacsi mu gihe umupira w’umutwe watewe na Lucas Moura wagiye hejuru y’izamu. Undi mukino wa 1/8 wabaye ku wa Gatatu, Atalanta yo mu Butaliyani yakiriye Valence C.F yo muri Espagne, iyinyagira ibitego 4-1. Igice cya mbere cy’umukino  cyarangiye ari ibitego 2-0 byatsinzwe na Hans Hateboer ku munota wa 16 ndetse na Josip Ilicić ku wa 42. Ku wa 57, Remo Freuler yatsinze icya gatatu, Hans Hateboer yongeramo icya kane ku wa 62, mu gihe icy’impozamarira cyabonetse ku ruhande rwa Valence C.F, cyatsinzwe na Denis Cheryshev ku munota wa 79. Imikino yo kwishyura iteganyijwe ku wa Kabiri tariki ya 10 Werurwe mu gihe mu cyumweru gitaha, ku wa Kabiri no ku wa Gatatu, hazakinwa indi mikino ine ibanza ya 1/8 ku yandi makipe asigaye.

title: Rayon Sports na Kiyovu SC mu makipe yahawe igihe ntarengwa cyo gushaka abandi batoza
content: Mbere y’uko uyu mwaka w’imikino wa 2019/20 utangira, FERWAFA yasobanuriye amakipe gahunda ya “Club Licensing” iyafasha kubaho kinyamwuga, akaba ari na yo yagendeweho hatangwa uruhushya rwo kwitabira amarushanwa. Iyi gahunda ikubiyemo no gutozwa n’abatoza babifitiye ubushobozi, aho amakipe yo mu cyiciro cya mbere agomba gutozwa n’abafite ibyangombwa by’ubutoza bya CAF, Licence A cyangwa B. Shampiyona yatangiye mu Ukwakira buri kipe ifite umutoza wujuje ibisabwa, ariko nyuma y’ukwezi kumwe, amakipe atandukanye yahise atangira kwirukana abatoza bakuru kuva kuri Mukura Victory Sports kugera kuri Etincelles, yagiye atandukana n’abatoza bakuru, asigarana abungirije badafite ibyangombwa bisabwa. Kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 19 Gashyantare 2019, FERWAFA yongeye kwibutsa amakipe ko agomba gutozwa n’ababifitiye ubushobozi. Yagize iti “Komite Nyobozi ya FERWAFA yemeje ko igihe ntarengwa umutoza utujuje ibisabwa azajya amara atoza ikipe yatandukanye n’umutoza wari ubyujuje kubera impamvu zinyuranye ari ukwezi kumwe (iminsi 30) kubarwa uhereye igihe ikipe yatandukaniye n’uwo mutoza.” FERWAFA ivuga ko amakipe atazashyira mu bikorwa ibi yasabwe uhereye igihe yabimenyesherejwe, ahabwa ibihano birimo no kwamburwa uruhushya yahawe rwo kwitabira amarushanwa. Kugeza ubu amakipe atozwa n’abatoza batabifitiye ibyangombwa bisabwa ni:  Rayon Sports, Kiyovu Sports, Etincelles FC, Espoir FC (bivugwa ko yirukanye Rukundo Jean De Dieu mu ibanga) na Gicumbi FC.

title: Stade ya Gicumbi yemerewe  kongera kwakira imikino ya shampiyona (Amafoto)
content: Mbere y’uko Shampiyona y’Umupira w’Amaguru mu Rwanda mu mwaka w’imikino wa 2019/20 itangira mu Ukwakira 2019, FERWAFA yasuye ibibuga byose amakipe yatanze azakiriraho imikino yayo. Stade ya Gicumbi FC iri mu bibuga byasanzwe bitujuje ibisabwa. Kuva icyo gihe, Gicumbi FC yakiriraga imikino yayo kuri Stade Mumena i Nyamirambo mu Mujyi wa Kigali, ariko ikaba yari yasabwe na FERWAFA  kugira ibyo itunganya ku kibuga cyayo maze ikongera kuhakirira. Mu minsi ishize, IGIHE yanditse ko imirimo yo kuvugurura iki kibuga igeze kure ndetse hari amahirwe menshi yo kongera kwemererwa kwakira imikino. Bimwe mu byahinduwe kuri iki kibuga harimo kongeramo ubwatsi mu gice kinini cyari kimeze nk’imbuga ndetse hanashyirwamo umucanga. Hubatswe uruzitiro rutandukanya ikibuga n’igice cy’abafana mu gihe ahari igice gitwikiriye ariko kigatwarwa n’umuyaga, hashyizwe urukuta rushya ku buryo hazajya hubakwa amahema yicarwamo n’abaje kureba umukino. Kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 19 Gashyantare 2020, FERWAFA yatangaje ko iki kibuga cyamaze gukomorerwa ndetse Gicumbi FC igiye kujya ihakinira imikino yo mu rugo. Iki cyemezo cyafashwe nyuma y’uko hari Akanama ka FERWAFA kasuye iki kibuga mu ntangiriro z’iki cyumweru. Gicumbi FC ya nyuma, ku mwanya wa 16 n’amanota 12, izagaruka mu kibuga mu ntangiriro z’ukwezi gutaha, yakirwa na Espoir FC. Umukino izakiramo Sunrise FC tariki ya 7 Werurwe 2020, ku munsi wa 22 wa Shampiyona, ushobora kuba uwa mbere izongera gukinira ku kibuga cyayo. Inkuru bifitanye isano: Ishusho ya Stade ya Gicumbi mbere yo kongera kwakira imikino ya Shampiyona

title: Kigali ku isonga ry’imijyi itanu ihataniye kwakira umukino wa nyuma wa CAF Champions League
content: Bwa mbere mu mateka y’amarushanwa abiri akomeye ahuza amakipe yo ku mugabane wa Afurika (CAF Champions League na CAF Champions League), hazakinwa umukino wa nyuma umwe, aho kuba ibiri (ubanza n’uwo kwishyura) nk’uko byari bimaze kumenyerwa. Tariki ya 11 z’uku kwezi nibwo Impuzamashyirahamwe y’Umupira w’Amaguru muri Afurika, CAF, yashyize hanze itangazo risaba Imijyi yifuza kwakira iyi mikino ya nyuma kwandika isaba. Ikinyamakuru cyo muri Maroc gisohoka buri munsi, Asabbah, kuri uyu wa Gatatu cyanditse ko Umujyi wa Kigali n’u wa Casablanca muri Maroc, ubarizwamo Stade Mohamed V, ari yo iri ku isonga mu zihabwa amahirwe yo kwakira umukino wa nyuma uzaba tariki ya 28 Gicurasi. Assabah ikomeza ivuga ko CAF kuri ubu ifite ibibuga bitanu bizavamo kimwe cyakira uyu mukino. Uretse Stade Amahoro na Mohamed V, hari kandi Stade Perle Bleue y’I Khartoum muri Sudani, Stade ya Cairo mu Misiri n’iya Rades muri Tunisia. Iki kinyamakuru gikomeza kivuga ko ibiganirobyabaye hagati ya Perezida wa CAF, Ahmad Ahmad na Perezida w’u Rwanda Paul Kagame mu cyumweru gishize, byasize Impuzamashyirahamwe y’Umupira w’Amaguru muri Afurika, yemeye ko Umujyi wa Kigali ufite ubushobozi bwo kwakira uyu mukino. Kivuga ko kandi, CAF yaba yaramenyesheje Ishyirahamwe ry’Umupira w’Amaguru mu Bwami bwa Maroc (FRMF) impinduka ishobora kuzakora mu guhitamo Stade izakira umukino wa nyuma. Icyemezo kizafatwa nyuma y’itora rizaba mbere y’uko haba imikino ibiri ya ½ aho kuba icyemezo cya Komite Nyobozi ya CAF nk’uko byari byatangajwe mbere. Hazashyirwaho komisiyo igamije gusura ibibuga byose byavuzwe, ikore raporo izashingirwaho n’abazahitamo ikibuga. Ibi ni nako bizakorwa mu guhitamo Stade izakira umukino wa nyuma wa CAF Confederation Cup uzaba tariki ya 24 Gicurasi. Stade Amahoro yakira abafana benshi [25 000] yari yarakuwe mu bibuga byemewe na CAF. Guverinoma yatangaje ko hari gahunda yo kuvugurura iki kibuga gifite ubwatsi bwiza, muri uyu mwaka. Kugeza ubu iri rushanwa rya CAF Champions League rigeze muri ¼, risigayemo amakipe ya Al Ahly (Misiri), Zamalek SC (Misiri), TP Mazembe (RDC), ES Tunis (Tunisie), Raja Casablanca (Maroc), Wyadad Casablanca (Maroc), Étoile du Sahel (Tunisie) na Mamelodi Sundwons (Afurika y’Epfo). Ku wa 28 Gashyantare 2020 nibwo hazakinwa imikino ibanza muri ¼ mu gihe umukino wa nyuma uteganyijwe ku wa 28 Gicurasi 2020.

title: StarTimes yashyize igorora abakunzi ba Europa League
content: Arsenal yatsindiwe ku mukino wa nyuma wa Europa League mu mwaka ushize, izakirwa na Olympiacos nyuma yo kwisengera Newcastle ikayitsinda ibitego 4-0 ku Cyumweru muri Shampiyona, ubwo Mesut Özil yatsindaga igitego cye cya mbere muri uyu mwaka w’imikino. Iyi kipe yo mu Bugereki imaze iminsi ihagaze neza mu rugo muri Europa League, yatsinze Burnley mu gushaka itike yo gukina iri rushanwa iranayisezerera. Umunyezamu wa Arsenal, Bernd Leno, yizeye ko we na bagenzi be bazitwara neza imbere ya Olympiacos nyuma yo kugorwa n’imikino y’amatsinda. Ati “ Dufite imikino ikomeye cyane muri Europa League, ni imikino myinshi ikomeye kuko mu mwaka ushize w’imikino twabonye ko muri ¼ cya Europa League no muri ½ uhura n’amakipe aba avuye muri Champions League.” “Bose baba bahataniye gutwara igikombe kandi umukino wa nyuma [wa Europa League] wari ukomeye cyane. Turashaka kongera kugera ku mukino wa nyuma. Dufite icyizere ko dushobora kwegukana igikombe uyu mwaka.” Amakipe abiri ya mbere muri buri tsinda rya Europa League, yiyongereyeho amakipe umunani yabaye aya gatatu muri Champions League, bituma iri rushanwa ribonekamo amazina akomeye nka Ajax, Porto na Inter Milan. Manchester United, yatwaye Europa League mu 2017, izaba yerekeje mu Bubiligi mu mukino izakirwamo na Club Brugge guhera saa Moya n’iminota 55 (19:55). Amashitani atukura yakinnye na Chelsea ku wa Mbere atsinda ibitego 2-0, bivuze ko azaba afite iminsi itatu gusa yo kuruhuka. Umutoza wayo, Ole Gunnar Solsjkær yajyaga aha umwanya abakinnyi badasanzwe bakina muri Europa League mu gihe kuri ubu iyi kipe ikomeje gushaka uko yabona umwanya mwiza muri Premier League. Ikipe ya gatatu yo mu Bwongereza isigaye mu irushanwa ni Wolverhampton Wanderers, izaba iri mu rugo kuri Stade Molineux , ikazakira Espagnol Barcelone yo muri Espagne. Wolves yongeye gukina amarushanwa y’Uburayi bwa mbere kuva mu mwaka w’imikino wa 1980/01 ubwo yasezererwaga na PSV Eindhoven muri UEFA Cup,  ikomeje gushaka uko yagera kure. Kuri ubu, Wolves iri mu makipe ahagaze neza muri Premier League, aho ikurikye Manchester United ya karindwi, ikaza imbere ya Arsenal ku rutonde rwa Shampiyona. Mu 1972, Wolves yakoze amateka yo kugera ku mukino wa nyuma wa UEFA Cup, ihatsindwa na Tottenham Hotspur. Kenny Hibbitt wari muri iyo kipe yageze kuri uyu mukino wa nyuma, avuga ko nta mukino woroha muri iyi yo gukuranamo. Ati “Kugera muri iyi mikino yo gukuranamo ni kimwe mu bintu byiza uba ugezeho, atari gusa ku mutoza ahubwo ku ikipe yose muri rusange. Espagnol ni ikipe nziza. Nta mukino wa 1/16 woroha.” Abakunzi b’Umupira w’Amaguru muri Afurika bafite amahirwe yo kureba iyi mikino yose iri kuba mu mashusho meza ya HD ku mashene ya ruhago ya StarTimes ifite uburengazira busesuye bwo kwerekana iri rushanwa.

title: BBC yirukanye umwe mu basesenguzi bayo wibasiye abakinnyi b’abirabura
content: Craig Ramage wakiniye Derby hagati y’imyaka ya 1980 na 90, yari mu kiganiro Sportscene cya BBC ku wa Gatatu ubwo yavugaga amagambo atarishimiwe n’abatari bake. Ramage yanenze myugariro w’imyaka 22 wa Derby, Max Lowe, na we wavuze ko “yatunguwe” n’ibyavuzwe n’uyu mugabo nyuma y’umukino ikipe ye yanganyijemo na Huddersfield igitego 1-1. Ati “Gufata abantu mu buryo budakwiye hashingiwe ku ruhu rwabo no kubagiraho imyumvire itariyo byangiza isura y’umukinnyi uba ufite ahazaza ndetse bigatandukanya abantu muri sosiyete.” Muri ubu butumwa yanditse ku rubuga nkoranya mbaga rwa Instagram, Lowe ngo wavugiraga abakinnyi b’abirabura bakinana muri Derby County, yakomeje avuga ko yababajwe cyane n’ibyavuzwe na Craig Ramage. Ati “Nababajwe kandi n’uburyo igitangazamakuru gikorera abaturage kitigeze gisaba umusesenguzi gusobanura ibyo yavugaga, cyangwa ngo cyitandukanye n’iyo mitekerereze ishaje.” Lowe yatangaje ko Ramage yavuze ko kuri we asanga ibyo abakinnyi b’abirabura bageraho batabikwiye, ahubwo boroherezwa kandi barangiza bakumva ko bagezeyo ku buryo atemeranya n’imyitwarire yabo. Umuvugizi wa BBC yemeje ko bamaze gutandukana na Ramage n’ubundi wari umusesenguzi wigenga. Yagize ati “Craid Ramage yavuze amagambo adakwiye mu kiganiro cyabaye ejo hashize ariko cyamaze gukurwa kuri interineti. Ntabwo tuzongera gukorana na Craig.” Ubwo yari umukinnyi, Ramage yakiniye amakipe yo mu Bwongereza arimo Watford na Notts County. Yakiniye kandi Derby imikino isaga 40, asezera gukina mu 2001. Abinyujije ku rubuga rwa Twitter, Ramage yasabye imbabazi, avuga ko “yicuza kubera amagambo yavuze nyuma y’umukino wabaye ku wa Gatandatu kandi akaba atari abigambiriye.” Ku Cyumweru, Ubuyobozi bwa Derby bwasohoye itangazo rivuga ko bwagiranye ibihaniro na BBC bukayibwira ko budashyigikiye ivangura iryo ari ryo ryose. Derby County iri ku mwanya wa 13 muri Championship, icyiciro cya kabiri mu Bwongereza, ni mu gihe mu mwaka ushize yatsindiwe ku mukino wa Playoff washoboraga gutuma izamuka muri Premier League.

title: Champions League: Liverpool yatsinzwe na Atlético Madrid, PSG itsindirwa mu Budage (Amafoto)
content: Atlético Madrid yari imbere y’abafana bayo, yatangiye umukino iri hejuru ndetse yashoboraga gufungura amazamu ku munota wa gatatu, umupira Diego Costa yahinduye imbere y’izamu ntiwagera kuri Álvaro Morata. Liverpool ifite igikombe giheruka, yatsinzwe igitego hakiri kare, cyabonetse ku munota wa kane gusa gitsinzwe na Saul Niguez ku mupira wari uvuye muri koruneri, Fabinho wari Liverpool ananirwa kuwukura imbere y’izamu. Ángel Correa na Álvaro Morata babonye kandi uburyo bwiza ku ruhande rw’iyi kipe yo muri Espagne, Liverpool itabarwa n’umunyezamu Alisson Becker. Iyi kipe yo mu Bwongereza yabonye uburyo bubiri bukomeye muri uyu mukino, bwashobora kuyihesha kwishyura, ariko imipira ntiyagana mu izamu. Igitego Liverpool yatsindiwe na Mohamed Salah ku munota wa 27, cyanzwe nyuma yo gusanga mugenzi we Roberto Firmino yari yaraririye. Mohamed Salah yabonye uburyo bukomeye ku munota wa 53, umupira yateresheje umutwe ujya hanze mu gihe ishoti rikomeye ryatewe na Jordan Henderson na ryo ryanyuze ku ruhande rw’izamu rya Jan Oblak. Umutoza Jürgen Klopp yakuyemo Sadio Mané igice cya mbere kirangiye na Mohamed Salah ku munota wa 72, bombi basimbuwe na Divock Origi na Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain, ariko ntacyo bahinduye ku mukino. Undi mukino wabaye kuri uyu wa Kabiri, wasize Paris Saint-Germain itsindiwe mu Budage na Borussia Dortmund ibitego 2-1. Dortmund ni yo yabanje gufungura amazamu ku gitego cyatsinzwe na Erling Braut Haaland ku munota wa 69 mbere y’uko Neymar yishyurira PSG ku wa 75 ku mupira yaherejwe na Kylian Mbappé. Nyuma y’iminota ibiri, Haaland w’imyaka 19 ukomoka muri Norvège, yatsinze igitego cyahesheje Dortmund intsinzi mu mukino ubanza, ku ishoti yatereye ahagana ku murongo w’urubuga rw’amahina. Imikino yo kwishyura izaba mu kwezi gutaha, ku wa Gatatu tariki ya 11 Werurwe 2020. Uyu munsi ku wa Gatatu, hateganyijwe indi mikino ibiri ibanza ya 1/8, aho Atalanta yo mu Butaliyani yakira Valence C.F yo muri Espagne mu gihe Tottenham yo mu Bwongereza, yakira RB Leipzig yo mu Budage.

title: Emery Mvuyekure yahishuye uburyo yanze ruswa ya miliyoni 1.8 Frw ngo yitsindishe igitego
content: Mvuyekure yabitangaje mu kiganiro yagiranye n’ikinyamakuru PD Online cyo muri Kenya, aho yavuze ko hari umuntu (atashatse gutangaza) wamusabye kwitsinda igitego mu minota ya nyuma akamwemerera ibihumbi 200 by’amashilingi ya Kenya, ni ukuvuga agera kuri miliyoni 1 n’ibihumbi 880 Frw. Ubutumwa uwiyise “Fixer” yandikiye Emery Mvuyekure ku mukino wa Tusker na Chemilil Sugar bwagiraga buti “Aha hari akantu gato tugusaba, uze kureka umupira ujye mu izamu ku munota wa nyuma w’umukino, turaza kukwishyura neza." Uyu munyezamu umaze amezi 14 muri Kenya, yavuze ko yanze gufata aya mafaranga kuko umutima we wari kuzakomeza kumucira urubanza kandi na none bikaba byari kwangiza ubunyamwuga bwe. Ati “Ni iki cyari gukurikiraho? Mfashe ayo mafaranga, ubunyamwuga bwanjye bwari kuba ubuhe? Ku bwanjye ntabwo nashobora kubana n’icyo cyasha.” Uyu mukino wabaye mu ntangiriro z’ukwezi gushize, warangiye Tusker FC inyagiye Chemelil Sugar ibitego 7-0. Aya magambo ya Mvuyekure Emery yaje nyuma y’iminsi mike FIFA ihannye abakinnyi bane bo muri Kenya bagaragayeho kugira uruhare mu kugena uko imikino irangira. Mvuyekure uvuga ko yirinda gukoresha telefoni amasaha ane mbere y’umukino, yanenze abakinnyi bagenzi be bemera kurya aya mafaranga, asaba ababishinzwe kujya babikoraho iperereza. Emery Mvuyekure w’imyaka 30, yakiniye amakipe atandukanye mu Rwanda arimo APR FC na Police FC.

title: Johnny McKinstry yiteze guhangana gukomeye k’u Rwanda na Uganda muri CHAN 2020
content: McKinstry wigeze kuba umutoza w’Amavubi hagati ya 2015 na 2016, yabitangaje mu kiganiro yagiranye na Shene ya Televiziyo y’Ishyirahamwe ry’Umupira w’Amaguru muri Uganda, FUFA, aho yabazwaga kuri tombora ya CHAN 2020 yaraye ibereye muri Cameroun. Uyu mugabo  w’imyaka 33, watandukanye n’u Rwanda nabi ndetse akarucisha amande ya miliyoni hafi 200 Frw nyuma yo kururega muri FIFA, avuga ko nta kipe azi kurusha izindi nk’Amavubi. Ati “Muri Afurika nta kipe nzi neza kurusha u Rwanda. Abakinnyi benshi (baba abo mu ikipe nkuru cyangwa iya CHAN) ntabwo bankiniye ariko ninjye wabahamagaye bwa mbere. Hari umubano dufitanye, ariko iminota 90 y’umukino izarangwa no guhangana. Ndizera ko dufite icyo bisaba cyose kugira ngo tubone amanota yose, atari k’u Rwanda gusa ahubwo no kuri Maroc.” Johnny McKinstry ni we mutoza wagejeje Amavubi kure muri CHAN mu nshuro eshatu amaze kuyikina, aho ubwo iri rushanwa ryari ryakiriwe n’u Rwanda mu 2016, bageranye muri ¼, basezererwa na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo yatsinze Amavubi ibitego 2-1. Yavuze ko itsinda C ikipe ye izaba ihuriyemo n’u Rwanda, Maroc na Togo ari itsinda ryiza kuko ririmo amakipe yo mu bice byose bya Afurika kandi amakipe yose akaba afite umukino wayo wihariye. CHAN 2020 izatangira tariki ya 4 kugeza ku ya 25 Mata 2020. Umukino wa mbere w’u Rwanda muri iri rushanwa uzaruhuza na Uganda mu Mujyi wa Douala.

title: Uruhare rwa SKOL mu mikoranire yayo na Rayon Sports
content: Mbere y’uko impande zombi zitangira gukorana, Rayon Sports yarimo ibibazo bitandukanye by’amikoro ndetse hari nyuma y’uko iyi kipe yari yaravuye mu Mujyi wa Kigali ikajya kuba i Nyanza. Rayon Sports yamamaza SKOL binyuze ku myambaro yambara no mu bindi bikorwa byayo mu gihe uru ruganda rufasha iyi kipe mu bikorwa bitandukanye. Umuvugizi w’iyi kipe, Nkurunziza Jean Paul yabwiye IGIHE ko bishimira uko bakorana n’uyu mufatanyabikorwa wabo mukuru ndetse bizeye ko bazakomeza gukorana nubwo hari ibishobora kuvugurwa mu masezerano. Ati "SKOL ni umufatanyabikorwa wacu mukuru tumaranye igihe. Kugeza kuri uyu munota twebwe ibyo iduha ibikora neza. Amasezerano yacu avuga ko dushobora kuyavugurura kandi twizera ko ibiganiro bizagenda neza tugakomeza gukorana." Ku ruhande rwa SKOL, Ubuyobozi bwayo buvuga ko bwishimira gukorana na Rayon Sports, aho kuva batangiye ubufatanye n’iyi kipe umubare w’abagura ibinyobwa byayo wiyongereye ndetse akaba ari na byo binyobwa gusa mu bikorwa bihuza abafana ba Rayon Sports. Imiterere y’amasezerano ya Rayon Sports na SKOL  Tariki ya 15 Gicurasi 2014 nibwo Rayon Sports yasinyanye amasezerano y’imyaka itatu na SKOL yemeye kujya itanga miliyoni 47 Frw  buri mwaka muri iyi kipe. Mu 2017, nibwo hasinywe amasezerano mashya ya miliyoni 66 Frw buri mwaka mu gihe cy’imyaka itanu. SKOL itanga miliyoni 1 Frw ku kwezi y’ikirango cyayo kiri ku modoka ya Rayon Sports ndetse n’ibikoresho Rayon Sports yifashisha ku kibuga haba ku mikino cyangwa mu myitozo. Rayon Sports ishobora kandi kuguza amafaranga muri SKOL mu gihe iyakeneye mu bikorwa bitandukanye byihutirwa, ikagira uburyo iyishyuramo binyuze mu masezerano ifitanye n’uyu muterankunga wayo. Uru ruganda rwemereye Rayon Sports miliyoni 6 Frw mu gihe cyose yegukanye Igikombe cy’Amahoro, rutanga kandi miliyoni 20 Frw zo kugura imyambaro y’ikipe buri mwaka w’imikino. Amafaranga uru ruganda rw’ibinyobwa rwatanze kuva mu 2014 kugeza mu 2017 ubwo havugurwaga amasezerano asaga miliyoni 141 Frw. Mu myaka ibiri yakurikiyeho, hari ibyiyongereyemo bitandukanye birimo kuba Rayon Sports yaratwaye Igikombe cy’Amahoro mu 2016, igahabwa miliyoni 6 Frw no kuba yaraguze imodoka igendamo guhera mu mwaka ushize ikaba ihabwa miliyoni 1 Frw buri kwezi, aho kuri ubu imaze guhabwa asaga miliyoni 12 Frw. Ugereranyije ayatanzwe muri iyi myaka ibiri iheruka, agera muri miliyoni 145 Frw mu gihe hari n’agera kuri miliyoni hafi 100 Frw yatanzwe mu kwambika Rayon Sports kuva itangiye gukorana na SKOL, ukongeraho n’ayo uru ruganda rwagurije ikipe mu mwaka ushize, ariko ataratangajwe. Ufashe aya mafaranga akubiye mu masezerano y’impande zombi, usanga kuva mu 2014, SKOL yarahaye Rayon Sports asaga miliyoni 390 Frw kugeza mu mwaka ushize mu gihe imibare yemewe yatangajwe na SKOL, igaragaza ko imaze guha Rayon Sports asaga miliyoni 500 Frw kongeraho n’ubundi bufasha butabarirwa mu mafaranga burimo ikibuga n’amacumbi by’abakinnyi. SKOL yubakiye Rayon Sports ikibuga, amacumbi n’akabari Tariki ya 29 Nzeri 2017, nibwo SKOL yatashye ikibuga y’ubwatsi bwiza bw’ubuterano cyubatse mu Nzove kuri uru ruganda, cyuzuye gitwaye hafi miliyoni 100 Frw ndetse igishyikiriza Rayon Sports. Iyi kipe yari imaze iminsi nta kibuga cyihariye igira cyo gukoreraho imyitozo ndetse yakodeshaga kenshi ibibuga byo gukoreraho, aho nka Stade Mumena yakodeshwaga ibihumbi 200 Frw ku kwezi. Kuri iki kibuga, SKOL yahubatse kandi akabari ka “Rayon SKOL BAR”, aho amafaranga gacuruza binyuze mu bafana bitabira imyitozo y’ikipe muri aka gace cyangwa abahaturiye, yose ajya muri iyi kipe. Tariki ya 14 Nyakanga mu mwaka ushize, SKOL yashyikirije kandi Rayon Sports amacumbi afite ubushobozi bwo kwakira abakinnyi 40. Aya macumbi ari mu nzu ebyiri zigerekeranye yubatse mu Nzove hafi y’ikibuga. Inzu yo hasi ifite imiryango itatu, aho harimo umuryango wa mbere ugizwe n’igitanda kimwe gishobora kuryamamo abantu babiri, cyagenewe umutoza, undi muryango urimo ibitanda by’abakinnyi ndetse n’umuryango ukorerwamo inama y’ikipe iri kwitegura umukino. Hari kandi aho abakinnyi bogera bavuye mu myitozo mbere y’uko bahindura imyenda, ivuriro rito ndetse n’igikoni gitunganyirizwamo ibyo abakinnyi barya mu gihe bari mu Nzove. Hejuru y’ibi, Skol igira kandi uruhare no mu bikorwa by’abafana ba Rayon Sports birimo igihembo cy’umukinnyi w’ukwezi wa Rayon Sports, cyatangijwe n’itsinda ry’abafana “March’ Generation”. Ubwo Rayon Sports yasohokeraga u Rwanda muri CAF Champions League muri Kanama 2019, muri Sudani, SKOL yashyizeho itike y’indege ku mufana wahize abandi mu mwaka ushize w’imikino. Hari kandi abafana 29 baguriwe amatike yo kurebera imikino Rayon Sports yakiriye mu manya y’icyubahiro muri uyu mwaka w’imikino wa 2019/20 bitewe n’uko mu mwaka ushize w’imikino barebye imikino yose iyi kipe yakinnye muri Shampiyona.

title: Abari baguze amatike  y’igitaramo cya Cécile Kayirebwa cyahagaritswe basabwe kuyagumana
content: Iki gitaramo cyagombaga kuba ku wa 8 Werurwe 2020 muri Camp Kigali aho kwinjira byari 5 000 Frw mu myanya isanzwe, 10 000 Frw mu myanya y’icyubahiro na 200 00 Frw mu myanya y’ikirenga. Uretse Kayirebwa wari gushimirwa hari harimo abandi bahanzi nka Clarisse Karasira, Mariya Yohana, Muyango, Jules Sentore, Mani Martin n’Itorero Ibihame nibo bari gususurutsa abari kwitabira. Kuri iki cyumweru habura amasaha make ngo iki gitaramo kibe,  cyaje guhagarikwa n’Umujyi wa Kigali kubera Coronavirus yugarije Isi muri iki gihe, gihagarikirwa rimwe n’ikindi  cyari cyateguwe na Adrien Misigaro cyiswe ‘Each one reach one’ bigenda gutyo. Kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki 9 Werurwe 2020, Ubuyobozi bwa Bwiza Media Ltd, Karibu ASBL, Umushanana Media n’Abacukumbuzi b’ireme ry’amateka n’umuco bateguye igitaramo  bwashyize hanze itangazo bwihanganisha abari baguze amatike babasaba kuyagumana. Bagize bati “Turamenyesha abantu bose ko nyuma y’ihagarikwa ry’iki gitaramo ku mabwiriza y’ubuyobozi bw’Umujyi wa Kigali ku munsi nyir’izina byongeye ku munota wa nyuma , twihanganishije abo byagizeho ingaruka bose. Tuboneyeho gusaba abari baraguze amatike bose kuyagumana mu gihe tukiganira n’inzego zitandukanye bireba kugirango hashakwe umuti ukwiye”. Iri tangazo rinavuga ko ubu buyobozi bw’izi sosiyete zari zateguye iki gitaramo bwitandukanyije n’undi muntu wese ushobora gusanisha ihagarikwa ry’iki gitaramo n’izindi nyungu izo arizo zose. Umujyi wa Kigali wasabye  abantu bategura ibitaramo kuba baretse kugeza igihe bazabonera irindi tangazo ribibemerera.

title: Igor Mabano yahinduye umuvuno, yatangiye kuririmba no mu njyana ya Dancehall
content: Uyu muhanzi watangiye aririmba indirimbo ziganjemo izo muri RnB, iyi ndirimbo ye nshya yayise ‘Easy’ yasohotse ikoze mu buryo bw’amajwi gusa aherekejwe n’amashusho y’amagambo ayigize. Amajwi yayo yakorewe muri Kina Music na Ishimwe Karake Clement. Igor Mabano yabwiye IGIHE ko yatekereje gukora indirimbo muri Dancehall kuko asanzwe ari injyana akunda. Ati “Gukora iyi ndirimbo muri ubu buryo nabitewe n’uko nyikunda kandi injyana ya dancehall ari nziza. Iri kuri album yanjye nshya ‘Urakunzwe’ n’izindi zimeze nkayo zizaza.” Iyi ndirimbo irimo ubutumwa bw’urukundo bw’umusore w’umu-rasta  ugira amakenga y’uko umukobwa akunda iwabo bashobora kuzamumubuza kuko ngo baba bakeka ko anywa amatabi. Ngo kuyihimba ‘Ni ubuzima busanzwe mbona,  bibaho abantu bafite dread muri sosiyete bafatwa uko bashatse.’ Uyu muhanzi ntabwo amaze igihe kinini kuko yatangiye gukora umuziki byeruye mu 2016 akimara gusoza amasomo ye ya muzika mu ishuri ry’umuziki ryo ku Nyundo. Yahise anatangira kwigisha ibijyanye no kuvuza ingoma za kizungu muri iryo shuri, no gukora ibihangano byatumye yinjira mu ruhando rw’abahanzi mu Rwanda. Ni umwe mu bafite ubuhanga buhambaye mu gucuranga no gutunganya umuziki, ndetse yifashishwa cyane mu itunganywa ry’indirimbo zo muri Kina Music aho akorera ibikorwa bye bya muzika umunsi ku munsi. Igor Mabano yarimo guteganya kumurikira abakunzi be album ye ya mbere yise ‘Urakunzwe’ ariko iki gikorwa gishobora gukomwa mu nkokora na Coronavirus yugarije isi muri iki gihe, yanatumye ibitaramo byari biteganyijwe kuri iki Cyumweru Umujyi wa Kigali ubihagarika. Iyi album y’uyu muhanzi, umuririmbyi akaba n’umucuranzi, izaba iriho indirimbo 13. Iyi album yateganyaga kuzayimurikira abakunzi be ku wa 21 Werurwe 2020 muri Kigali Serena Hotel. Kwinjira mu myanya isanzwe  ari 10 000 Frw, ku wajyanye n’umukunzi we ari 15 000 Frw.

title: Diamond Platnumz yifurije abakobwa  bose bakundanye umunsi mwiza w’abagore
content: Uyu muhanzi yashyize ubutumwa ku rukuta rwe rwa Instagram ku wa 8 Werurwe 2020, ubwo hizihizwaga uyu munsi wahariwe abagore ku Isi yose. Ubu butumwa bwari buherekejwe n’amafoto y’abo yakundanye bose barimo Zari Hassan, Hamisa Mobetto, Tanasha Donna na Wema Sepetu. Abandi bari bari muri iyi foto yabahurijemo ni umubyeyi we Sandra Kassim na bashiki be Esma Platnumz na Queen Darleen ndetse n’umukobwa we na Zari bise Tiffah Dangote. Arangije ashyiraho ubutumwa ati “Umunsi mwiza w’abagore. Nywutuye aba abagore banjye bakomeye. Abagore batanze umusanzu ku buzima bwanjye. Batumye nkora cyane, nditanga, nkora amakosa, ndishima, ndarira ndetse bakabona ndi mwiza cyangwa mubi ariko ku iherezo byari urugendo rwanjye Uwiteka yari yaranyandikiye kugira ngo ngere ku  wo ndi we kuri iyi si.” Yongeyeho ko buri muntu unyura mu buzima bw’undi aba afite ibyiza n’ibibi ariko avuga ko tuba dukwiriye kubyemera tukabiha agaciro kuko biba byarabayeho ku mugambi w’Imana ngo bigire icyo bifasha ubuzima bwawe. Ati “Buri muntu afite ibyiza bye n’ibibi kandi dukwiriye kwiga kubyemera kandi ugaha agaciro buri wese wakoze ku buzima bwawe nk’uko byari byateganyijwe n’Imana kuri bo ku kugeza aho uri uyu munsi. Umusanzu wabo ni munini niyo mpamvu urukundo rwabo n’agaciro bizahoraho iteka mu mutima wanjye. Aba ni abagore  b’ikirenga kuri njye.” Mu minsi yashize Diamond Platnumz yatandukanye na Tanasha Donna bari bamaze igihe bakundana ndetse banafitanye umwana w’umuhungu. Tanasha yahise azinga utwe asubira iwabo muri Kenya we n’umwana we ndetse anasiba amafoto yose yari ari ku rubuga rwa Instagram yari ahuriyemo na Diamond Platnumz. Uyu mukobwa yananditse ubutumwa agaragaza ko yababajwe na Diamond Platnumz yari yarahaye umutima we nyamara undi amuryarya atamukunda.

title: Umuraperi w’Umunyamerika yahawe inkwenene nyuma yo gukubita umugore witabiriye igitaramo cye
content: DaBaby yakubise uyu mugore mu ijoro ryo ku wa Gatandatu ubwo yerekezaga ku rubyiniro, abari bitabiriye iki gitaramo baramurakarira ndetse baramunenga mu buryo bukomeye. Ni mu gitaramo kiri mu by’uruhererekane DaBaby yise ‘Up Close N Personal’ cyabereye ahitwa Whiskey North, ubwo umwe mu bafana bari muri iki gitaramo yafataga telefoni ye n’ibiganza akayifatira aho uyu muhanzi yagombaga guca ashaka gufata amafoto. TMZ yatangaje ko nyuma uyu muhanzi yamuhutaje amukubita mu isura bituma abafana barakara cyane batangira kumuha inkwenene ari ku rubyiniro, we n’itsinda bari bajyanyeho bakavaho bataririmbye. DaBaby yari amaze iminsi mu bindi bibazo ndetse mu minsi yashize yashinjwaga gukubita umusore no kumwiba muri Miami. DaBaby afite imyaka 28, yamamaye mu ndirimbo zirimo iyo yise ‘‘Suge’’ na  ‘‘Bop’’.

title: Young Grace yanenze umusore wamuteye inda akitarutsa inshingano za kibyeyi
content: Kuri uyu wa 8 Werurwe 2020, ni Umunsi Mpuzamahanga wahariwe Abagore ku Isi yose. Ni umunsi bazirikanwaho nka bamwe mu bagira uruhare rukomeye mu mibereho ya buri munsi y’ikiremwamuntu.
