title: Ibyamamare muri Sinema byashimiwe muri Rwanda International Movie Awards 2020 (Amafoto na Video)
content: Ibi bihembo byatanzwe ku mugoroba wo ku wa Gatandatu tariki 7 Werurwe 2020, mu birori byabereye muri Kigali Convention Centre. Buri wese mu bakinnyi ba filime baserutse mu birori bya Rwanda International Movie Awards 2020, yagerageje kwikoraho yitaye cyane ku bijyanye no kurimba. Ubwo bahingukaga mu cyumba cyabereyemo ibirori, abakinnyi ba filime banyujijwe ku itapi itukura bafata amashusho n’amafoto y’urwibutso. Buri wese witabiriye ibi birori mbere yo kwinjira mu cyumba cyari cyateguwe yabanzaga gusuzumwa indwara ya Coronavirus ubundi agahabwa umuti wo gukaraba mu kwirinda iki cyorezo. Virusi nshya ya Corona  ikomeje koreka imbaga, yahereye mu Bushinwa mu mwaka ushize. Ikomeje kwigabiza n’ibindi bice by’Isi cyane ko nta rukingo irabonerwa. Ni virusi ya kane izengereje Isi mu myaka itanu ishize nyuma ya Ebola, Zika na Mers ijya gusa nka Coronavirus kuko nayo ifata nk’indwara y’ubuhumekero. Kuva tariki 15 Mutarama 2020 kugeza ku wa 15 Gashyantare 2020 nibwo Ishusho Art Organisation itegura Rwanda International Movie Awards bakiriye filime zizahatana zo mu Rwanda n’izo mu Karere ka Afurika y’Uburasirazuba. Kuva ibi bihembo byatangira gutangwa bwa mbere kugeza ku nshuro ya gatandatu byitwaga Rwanda Movie Awards; byaje guhindurirwa izina byitwa Rwanda International Movie Awards. Tariki 26 Gashyantare 2020 nibwo ubuyobozi bwa Rwanda International Movie Awards bwatangaje abahatanira ibihembo, muri bo abatsinze babishyikirijwe mu birori byabaye ku mugoroba wo ku wa 7 Werurwe 2020. Ibi birori byayobowe n’umwe mu banyamakuru bakurikiranira hafi ibya sinema Julius Chita, byakererewe amasaha arenga abiri cyane ko byagombaga gutangira saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba bigatangira saa mbili zirenga.  	Urutonde rw’abahawe ibihembo muri Rwanda International Movie Awards 2020: Ibyamamare muri Sinema byegukanye ibihembo muri Rwanda International Movie Awards 2020 Digidigi, Papa Sava, Bamenya, Mama Nicky n’abandi bahawe ibihembo muri Rwanda Movie Awards2020 Ibyamamare muri filime byari byabukereye muri Rwanda International Filime Awards Amafoto: Muhizi Serge

title: Ibitaramo bya Misigaro, Kayirebwa n’ibindi bikorwa bihuza abantu benshi byahagaritswe mu kwirinda Coronavirus
content: Iki cyemezo cyafashwe n’Umujyi wa Kigali nyuma y’uko Inama y’abaminisitiri yateranye ku wa 6 Werurwe iyobowe na Perezida Paul Kagame, yagarutse ku cyorezo cya Coronavirus gikomeje gukwirakwira mu bihugu bitandukanye ku Isi. Imyanzuro yayo irimo "gukomeza gukangurira abaturage gukurikiza inama zo kukirinda, kwitabaza inzego z’ubuzima mu gihe hari ugaragayemo kimwe mu bimenyetso biranga icyo cyorezo no kugabanya ingendo n’inama zitari ngombwa hanze n’imbere mu Gihugu.” Umujyi wa Kigali watangaje ko ushingiye ku butumwa bwa Minisitiri w’Intebe bwasohotse tariki ya 6 Werurwe 2020, bugamije gukangurira buri wese gukumira Coronavirus, wahagaritse ibikorwa bihuza abantu benshi. Itangazo ryashyizwe ahagaragara rigira riti "Umujyi wa Kigali uramenyesha abantu bose ko ibitaramo by’imyidagaduro n’ibindi birori bihuza abantu benshi (imyidagaduro, imurikagurisha, imurikabikorwa, umutambagiro n’ibindi), ko bisubitswe guhera tariki ya 8 Werurwe kugeza igihe irindi tangazo rizasohokera ryo kubisubukura." "Abari barahawe impushya n’Umujyi wa Kigali nabo basabwe kubahiriza ibiri muri iri tangazo mu rwego rwo gukumira icyo cyorerezo. Mu kurengera ubuzima bw’abaturage, tuributsa abafite ibikorwa bihuza abantu benshi nk’insengero, ubukwe, utubari, hoteli, restaurant, utubyiniro, ahakorerwa siporo (gym) n’ahandi, gukaza ingamba z’isuku bashyiraho uburyo bwo gukaraba cyangwa se umuti wabugenewe wica mikorobe.” Ubuyobozi bw’Umujyi wa Kigali bwasabye abantu kwitwararika no gukurikiza amabwiriza mu rwego rwo kwirinda ko iki cyorezo cyagera mu Rwanda. Ku gicamunsi cyo kuri iki Cyumweru nibwo Adrien Misigaro yamenyesheje abakunzi b’umuziki we ko igitaramo yagombaga gukorera i Kigali cyasubitswe. Yagize ati "Ku bakunzi bacu bari bategereje igitaramo cyari bubere ku Intare Arena kuri uyu wa 8 Werurwe 2020 saa kumi gihuje Adrien Misigaro, Gentil Misigaro, Israel Mbonyi, ndetse n’abandi batumirwa, mube muhagaritse ingendo zigana aho igitaramo cyari Kubera! Havutse ikibazo gitunguranye!" Uyu muhanzi yakomeje avuga ko gahunda zikurikiye ziri butangazwe mu masaha make ari imbere, icyakora basabye abaguze amatike kuyagumana. Ihagarikwa ry’iki gitaramo ryatangiye gututumba ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, aho byavugwaga ko aba bahanzi bamenyeshejwe ko igitaramo kitakibaye. Mu gitondo cyo kuri iki Cyumweru, Misigaro yagiye kubaza ku biro by’Umujyi wa Kigali, icyakora birangira ibiganiro ntacyo bitanze kuko ahagana saa sita z’amanywa icyemezo cya nyuma cyavugaga ko igitaramo cyasubitswe. Ikindi gitaramo cyari gitegerejwe na benshi ni icyiswe ‘Ikirenga mu Bahanzi’, cyagombaga gushimirwamo umuhanzi Cecile Kayirebwa nk’uwateje imbere umuco abinyijuje mu buhanzi. Kayiranga Melchior wateguye iki gitaramo, yabwiye IGIHE ko abapolisi bakorera ahagombaga kubera icyo gitaramo muri Camp Kigali, bamubwiye ko kitakibaye. Kugeza icyo gihe yari ataramenyeshwa ko igitaramo cyasubitswe. Coronavirus nshya ni icyorezo gihangayikishije Isi, cyatangiriye mu Bushinwa mu mpera z’Ukuboza 2019. Muri icyo gihugu abamaze kucyandura ni 80.859, mu gihe abapfuye ari 3.100. Hanze y’u Bushinwa hamaze kwandura abantu 25.208 ndetse abagera kuri 500 bamaze gupfa. Igiteye inkeke ni uburyo iyi ndwara irimo gukwirakwira cyane hanze y’u Bushinwa, ku buryo hari ubwoba ko ishobora gukwira Isi yose. Magingo aya yamaze kugaragara mu bihugu byinshi muri Afurika nka Misiri, Afurika y’Epfo, Senegal, Togo, Cameroon n’ahandi. Iyi ndwara yandurira mu matembabuzi, igafata imyanya y’ubuhumekero ku buryo yica umuntu imuteye umusonga. Uburyo bw’ibanze mu kuyirinda ni ukugira isuku binyuze mu gukaraba intoki n’amazi meza n’isabune, cyangwa gukoresha alcool yica udukoko. Hirya no hino mu gihugu hakomeje gushyirwaho uburyo bw’isuku nko ku nyubako z’amaguriro rusange, hoteli n’ahandi, ku buryo abantu bakaraba intoki inshuro nyinshi kandi bakoresheje isabune. Nta muti wa Coronavirus cyangwa urukingo bizwi, igikomeje kwifashishwa ni ukuvura ibimenyetso byayo gusa. Icyizere ariko kigenda kizamuka kuko mu Bashinwa bari baranduye iyi coronavirus, abagera ku 57.143 bamaze kuyikira. Mu mujyi wa Wuhan watangiriyemo iki cyorezo, kuri iki Cyumweru guverinoma yatangaje ko yafunze ibitaro 11 muri 14 byari byashyiriweho kwakira abarwayi ba Coronavirus, kubera ko abenshi bakize, ndetse ubwandu bushya bumaze gucogora. ½ Bugamije gukangurira buri wese gukumira icyo cyorezo, ku ngingo ivuga ko Inzego z’Ubuzima n’zindi nzego za Leta zizakomeza kubagezaho ingamba zijyanye no gukomeza gukumira no guhangana n’iki cyorezo, — City of Kigali (@CityofKigali) March 8, 2020 ¼ Abari barahawe impushya n’Umujyi wa Kigali nabo basabwe kubahiriza ibiri muri iri tangazo mu rwego rwo gukumira icyo cyorerezo. — City of Kigali (@CityofKigali) March 8, 2020 1/6 Tubasabye kwitwararika no gukurikiza amabwiriza mu rwego rwo kwirinda ko iki cyorezo cyagera mu Rwanda. — City of Kigali (@CityofKigali) March 8, 2020 Inkuru wasoma: Guverinoma yasabye Abanyarwanda guhagarika guhana ibiganza no guhoberana mu kwirinda Coronavirus

title: Hagiye gutangizwa irushanwa ry’abaririmbyi rizahemba uwa mbere miliyoni 1 Frw
content: Ni irushanwa rifite intego yo kuzamura no guha urubuga abafite impano yo kuririmba bakamenyekana mu Rwanda no hanze yarwo. Nsengiyumva Alphonse uhagarariye 1000 Group Ltd yabwiye IGIHE ko batekereje iri rushanwa bamaze gusanga ishuri ryigisha umuziki riherereye mu Karere ka Muhanga, hari abasoza amasoza yabo ntibabashe kumenyekana cyangwa se n’abandi batabashije kuwiga bikagenda bityo. Ati “Twasanze n’ubwo mu Rwanda hatangiye kuboneka amashuri yigisha umuziki, abarangije cyangwa se abatarabashije kujyayo kumenyekana bibagora. Twemera ko muzika ari impano ishobora gutunga nyirayo kandi ikinjiriza n’igihugu muri rusange. Duhitamo gutangiza amarushanwa yaba urubuga rwo kuzamukiramo.” Yavuze ko hazabaho kwiyandikisha binyuze ku rubuga rwa WhatsApp 0783014482 ndetse no kuri Instagram y’irushanwa Supra_voice1035. Iki gikorwa kikazakorwa mu gihe cy’ukwezi kwa Werurwe 2020 kose. Abashaka bazajya bohereza amajwi cyangwa amashusho bari kuririmba indirimbo iyo ariyo yose ariko mu ijwi ry’umwimerere bitanyuze mu cyuma gitunganya umuziki na kimwe. Bashobora kandi gushyira amashusho yabo bari kuririmba kuri Instagram yabo barangiza bagashyiraho (tag) urukuta rw’iri rushanwa. Nyuma abashinzwe gutoranya bazarebamo abafite impano, babahamagare, babakorere amashusho ya mbere azashyirwa ku mbuga nkoranyambaga no kuri televziyo kugira ngo abantu babamenye kandi babatore. Abazaba batowe neza kandi bagaragaza ubuhanga bazajya mu cyiciro gikurikiyeho. Irushanwa rizabera kuri murandasi mu gice cya mbere, hanyuma habeho guhangana mu cyiciro kibanziriza icya nyuma n’icya nyuma aho abahatana bose bazaba bari kumwe. Uzaba uwa mbere irushanwa ryose rirangiye, azahabwa ibihembo birimo miliyoni imwe y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda.

title: Uko ibyamamare  byaserutse muri Rwanda International Movie Awards 2020 (Amafoto)
content: Ubwo bahinguka mu cyumba cyabereyemo ibirori, abakinnyi ba Filime banyuzwaga ku itapi y’umutuku ari nako abafata amashusho n’amafoto nabo banyuranagamo buri wese yifuza gufata inziza kurusha undi. Buri wese mu bakinnyi ba Filime wari waserutse mu birori bya Rwanda International Movie Awards 2020, yari yagerageje kwikoraho ubona ko bitaye cyane ku bijyanye no kurimba. Abo barimo nka Papa Sava, Ndimbati, Kecapu, Mimi Nadege, Nyaxo, Mutoni Assia n’abandi baserutse bigaragara ko baje biteguye ibirori. Kuva tariki 15 Mutarama 2020 kugeza ku wa 15 Gashyantare 2020 nibwo Ishusho Art Organisation itegura Rwanda International Movie Awards bakiriye filime zizahatana yaba mu Rwanda ndetse n’izo mu karere ka Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Kuva ibi bihembo byatangira gutangwa bwa mbere kugeza ku nshuro ya gatandatu  byitwaga Rwanda Movie Awards, muri uyu mwaka wa 2020 bihindurirwa izina byitwa Rwanda International Movie Awards. Tariki 26 Gashyantare 2020 nibwo ubuyobozi bwa Rwanda International Movie Awards bwatangaje abahatanira ibihembo. Kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 7 Werurwe 2020 nibwo abatsinze bashyikirijwe ibihembo byabo mu birori byabereye muri Kigali Convention Center. Uko ibyamamare muri Filime baserutse muri Rwanda International Movie Awards 2020 mu mafoto Amafoto:Muhizi Serge

title: Ingamba zo kwirinda Coronavirus zakajijwe mu gitaramo cyo gushimira Cécile Kayirebwa
content: Mu buryo bwo gukumira Coronavirus mu bazitabira igitaramo “Ikirenga mu bahanzi” abari kugitegura babwiye IGIHE ko hateguwe uburyo abantu bazasuzumwa ndetse bakazanahabwa aho gukarabira mbere yo kwinjira mu gitaramo nyiri izina. Ibi byagize ingaruka zikomeye ku isaha igitaramo cyagombaga gutangirira cyane ko kigijwe imbere mu masaha. Kayiranga Merchiore uri mu bari gutegura igitaramo, yavuze ko abantu bifuza kuzareba igitaramo neza bizabasaba kuzinduka kuko saa kumi bazaba batangiye gukingura imiryango. Yagize ati”Abantu bitabira igitaramo baratangira kwinjira saa kumi z’amanywa, bazabanza gukaraba (kwisukura) n’isuzuma rya Coronavirus hanyuma igitaramo gitangire saa kumi n’ebyiri.” Virus nshya ya Coronavirus ikomeje koreka imbaga, yahereye mu Bushinwa ariko ikomeje kwigabiza n’ibindi bice by’Isi, nta rukingo. Ni virusi ya kane izengereje isi mu myaka itanu ishize nyuma ya Ebola, Zika na Mers. Uyu mwaka, Cécile Kayirebwa azashimirwa mu gitaramo “Ikirenga mu bahanzi“ giteganyijwe tariki ya 8 Werurwe 2020, mu birori bizabera muri Kigali Conference and Exhibition Village (KCEV) hahoze hitwa Camp Kigali. Amatike ari kugura 20000 frw,10000 frw na 5000 frw ku batabashije kuyagura bifashishije Airtel. Ari gucururizwa ahantu hatandukanye harimo ahakorera Serivise za Airtel muri Kigali nka Remera ku cyicaro gikuru , Nyabugogo na Nyamirambo. Aya matike kandi agurirwa muri Camellia ku Gisimenti, UTC, CHIC na KBC, Simba Supermarket, no muri T2000 ahakorera Monaco, I Nyarutarama kuri Tenis Club, Simba yo mu Mujyi na Blues Coffee ndetse no muri gare yo mu Mujyi. Ku bantu bari kugura amatike bakoresheje Airtel Money, itike igura ibihumbi 20 000Frw yashyizwe kuri 18000 Frw mu gihe iya 10 000 Frw iri kugura 9000 Frw. Naho iya 5000Frw ikagura ibihumbi 4000Frw. Uzagura tike ku munsi w’igitaramo Kwinjira mu myanya y’icyubahiro ni ukwishyura tike ya 25000 Frw (VVIP), mu gihe ahasanzwe azaba ari 15000 Frw (VIP) ndetse na 10000 Frw ahasigaye hose. Ni ku nshuro ya mbere hagiye gutangwa ishimwe ku muhanzi watoranyijwe nk’Ikirenga mu Bahanzi abikesha mu kwimakaza no guteza imbere ‘umuco nyarwanda abinyujije mu buhanzi. Iki gitaramo kiritabirwa n’abahanzi barimo Muyango, Mariya Yohani, Mani Martin, Sentore Jules, Karasira Clarisse, Itorero Ibihame by’Imana, Mushabizi n’Ababeramuco.

title: Shekinah Worship Team Masoro yamuritse album mu gitaramo cyamaze amasaha 12
content: Abakunda kuramya no guhimbaza bari bategerezanyije amatsiko iki gitaramo gikomeye cyabereye muri Evangelical Restoration Church Masoro iyoborwa na Apôtre Ndagijimana Yoshua Masasu. Cyabaye kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 6 Werurwe 2020 iri tsinda ryo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana rihuriramo n’abandi bahanzi bakomeye muri uyu muziki barimo Rene Patrick, Yvan Ngenzi, Papi Clever, Shining Stars, Alarm Ministries na Coeur d’Adoration de Goma. Coeur d’Adoration de Goma yaririmbye indirimbo zitandukanye zirimo ‘Fanda nayo’, Alarm Ministries baririmba iyitwa ‘Yasatuye ijuru’, Yvan Ngenzi aririmba iyitwa ‘Yambwiye ko atazampemukira’, Papi Clever yaririmbye nyinshi zo mu gitabo zirimo ‘Ndi amahoro’. Shekinah Worship Team bari bamuritse album, baririmbye izirimo ‘Dwelling place’, ‘Ndakwihaye’ bitiriye album, ‘Uri indirimbo yanjye’, ‘Mpawe ikaze’, ‘Ni wowe mpisemo’, ‘Shimwa Yesu’, ‘Ndakuramya’ n’izindi. Kwinjira byari ubuntu muri iki gitaramo cyahembuye benshi bakunda kuramya no guhimbaza Imana. Gentil Misigaro usanzwe uba muri Canada ariko mu Rwanda muri iyi minsi ari mu bahanzi batunguranye muri iki gitaramo aho yaje ku rubyiniro gihumuje kuko yageze ku rubyiniro saa tanu n’iminota 35. Uyu muhanzi yaririmbye indirimbo ye yise ‘Biratungana’ hashize akanya Adrien Misigaro amusanga ku rubyiniro batangaza ko bafite igitaramo ku Cyumweru tariki 8 Werurwe 2020. Saa sita n’iminota irindwi Apôtre Ndagijimana Yoshua Masasu nibwo yageze imbere y’iteraniro yigisha umumaro wo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana. Yifashishije umurongo uri mu Baheburayo 13: 15 ugira uti “Imana ishaka ko dutanga igitambo cy’iminwa yacu duhimbaza Imana tuvuga gukomera kwayo.” Yavuze ko akenshi ibivugwa ku munwa ari nabyo abantu baba bafite mu mitima yabo, abwira abari bateraniye aho ko ‘Imana idutegeka kuyitambira igitambo cy’ishimwe iteka ari yo mbuto y’iminwa yacu’. Masasu ari kwigisha yanasengeye abayobozi ba Shekinah Worship Team abaturiraho imigisha no gukomezwa n’Imana mu murimo bakora w’ivugabutumwa mu ndirimbo, anasengera album bamuritse. Perezida wa Shekinah Worship Team Masoro, Tuyishime Olivier, yabwiye IGIHE ko iki gitaramo cyabanyuze kubera ukuntu abantu bacyitabiriye. Yagize ati “Igitaramo cyari cyiza, icya mbere turashima Imana kuko yadutangaje. Hari igihe umuntu ategura ibintu akibaza uko bizagenda bikamucanga ariko ibyo yadukoreye birenze ibyo twateganya abantu bitabiriye. Ntabwo namenya neza umubare neza w’abitabiriye ariko bari mu bihumbi bitatu.” Muri iki gitaramo abantu batandukanye bitanze amafaranga arenga miliyoni arimo nayo Masasu yabemereye ibihumbi 500 Frw. Album Shekinah Worship Team Masoro yamuritse igizwe n’indirimbo 10 z’amajwi ariko bari ku rubyiniro bari gufata amashusho y’izi ndirimbo. Shekinah ni itsinda ryatangiye mu 2003 ubwo hafungurwaga paruwasi yitwa Remera Casabonita, yaje kwimukira i Masoro. Apôtre Masasu yahishuye icyo apfa n’abantu bo muri iyi minsi mu butumwa bwihariye Imbaga y’abantu yuzuye Umwuka Wera bahimbaza Imana mu gitaramo cya Shekinah Worship Team Gentil Misigaro yahishuye indirimbo ye nshya mu gitaramo cya Shekinah Worship Team

title: Producer Holybeat wo muri The Mane yatawe muri yombi kubera ibiyobyabwenge
content: Amakuru agera kuri IGIHE ava mu nshuti za hafi z’uyu musore avuga ko yafatiwe mu karere ka Kicukiro ari kumwe n’inshuti ze, bakaba bakurikiranyweho gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge. Uyu musore acumbikiwe kuri sitasiyo ya Polisi ya Kicukiro nk’uko byanahamijwe n’Umuvugizi wa RIB, Marie Michelle Umuhoza wemereye IGIHE ko uyu musore yatawe muri yombi akurikiranyweho icyaha cyo gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge. HolyBeat izina rye ryazamutse cyane ubwo yakoreraga ibijyanye n’umuziki muri Urban Record aho yavuye yerekeza muri The Mane muri 2019. HolyBeat yinjiye muri Studio ya Urban Record mu mwaka wa 2018 ubwo bayifunguraga ku mugaragaro. Yakoranye n’iyi studio imishinga itandukanye y’indirimbo ariko by’umwihariko indirimbo yamamaye cyane mu zo yakoze ni “Nta Kibazo” yari ihuriyemo abahanzi benshi ariko mu by’ukuri ari iya Urban Boys. HolyBeat yinjiye muri The Mane abisikana na Li John wari usezerewe muri iyi sosiyete ifasha abahanzi ibarizwamo Marina, Queen Cha na Kelvin Mbanda.

title: Mukadaff wari umaze igihe atagaragara mu muziki yashyize hanze Album ye ya mbere
content: Iyi Album ya mbere ya Mukadaff igizwe n’indirimbo 14 muri 35 yakoze kuva yatangira umuziki mu 2016, kuri iyi album nshya y’uyu muraperi hariho indirimbo yakoranye n’abandi bahanzi nka; Karimunda yakoranye na B- Threy, Bundi bushya yakoranye na Puff G, Bihemu yakoranye na Fireman, Ailosa yakoranye na Bulldogg. Album “Igikoni” yakozweho n’abatunganya indirimbo babiri ari bo Trackslayer na Sean Brizz, yasohotse indirimbo zose zikoze mu buryo bw’amajwi mu gihe amashusho yayo azagenda afatwa gake gake. Mukadaff avuga uko yiteguye kumenyekanisha Album ye nshya “Igikoni”, binyuze mu gukora gukora ibitaramo bizazenguruka uturere turimo imijyi ikomeye mu Rwanda kugira ngo yegere abakunzi ba muzika ye badatuye mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Mukadaff aganira na IGIHE yagize ati” Nari maze igihe ntuje ntagaragara mu muziki, ariko ni ibi nari ndimo, nari ndi kureba uko nakora album yanjye ya mbere nkayirangiza ubu igikurikiyeho ni ugushaka uko nayimenyekanisha.” Uyu muraperi wavukiye i Kigali mu karere ka Nyarugenge yinjiye mu muziki ubwo yari ari kurangiza amasomo ye ya kaminuza cyane ko yize itangazamakuru muri ICK, (Institut Catholique de Kabgayi, aho yagiye arangije amashuri yisumbuye muri LDK (Lycée de Kigali), aho yize indimi. Ailosa ya Mukadaff Ft Bulldogg Bihemu ya Mukadaff na Fireman Karimunda ya Mukadaff na B-Threy

title: Amarangamutima ya Queen Cha wakorewe indirimbo na Junior Multisystem nyuma yo gucibwa ukuboko
content: Uyu muhanzikazi yinjiye mu muziki mu 2012, benshi mu bakurikiraniraga hafi umuziki icyo gihe bamenye indirimbo ye yise “Windekura”, iyi yari iya mbere kuri we yayikorewe na Junior Multisystem. Nyuma y’uko uyu mugabo akoze impanuka mu 2019 ikamuviramo gucibwa ukuboko, icyakora nyuma yo koroherwa akagaruka mu muziki, Queen Cha yifuje ko bakorana indi ndirimbo nshya. Aganira na IGIHE yagize ati ”Iyo ndi gukorana na Junior mba nzi neza ko dukorana indirimbo nziza, niwe wantangije umuziki. Ntihagire unyumva nabi kuko n’abandi turakorana kandi ibyo dukorana kenshi biba ari byiza.” Yunzemo ati ”Kuva yakora impanuka yatumye acibwa ukuboko twari tutarongera gukorana indirimbo, ni umwe mu bakora indirimbo banzi, iyo turi gukorana buri wese muri twe aba ameze neza kuko turaziranye, niwe wanyinjije mu muziki mu 2012 ubwo yankoreraga Windekura.” Iyi ndirimbo nshya ya Queen Cha ikubiyemo ubutumwa bw’urukundo, anarimo kwibandaho bikomeye muri iyi minsi byatumye abazwa n’umunyamakuru wa IGIHE niba ari uko ari mu munyenga w’urukundo. Asubiza iki kibazo Queen Cha yagize ati” Mu minsi ishize nakoraga izijyanye n’ibibazo biba mu rukundo abantu baravuga ngo nkunda kuganya, none nahinduye ndi kuvuga amagambo y’urukundo nabyo bibaye ikibazo? Ni indirimbo isanzwe ahubwo sinzi impamvu iyo ndirimbye ikintu runaka bifatwa mu ndororerwamo y’uko ndi kuririmba ubuzima bwanjye.” Romantic, indirimbo nshya ya Queen Cha yakorewe muri The Mane Music cyane ko Junior Multisystem amaze iminsi atandukanye na Ladies Empire yakoreragamo ubu akaba ataravuga ahandi ari gukorera. Umva indirimbo “Romantic” ya Queen Cha

title: Nina wagaragaye aririmba wenyine, yahishuye ibyari bihugije itsinda ryabo mu minsi ishize
content: Asobanura impamvu yaririmbye wenyine, mu kiganiro na IGIHE, Nina yagize ati”Mugenzi wanjye ntabwo yashoboye kuboneka hari utubazo tuba twabaye, igitaramo kiba cyatangajwe kandi umukiriya aba agomba guhabwa ibyo yasabye rero nagombaga kugerageza kubimuha.” Nina yavuze ko yabonye abantu bari bishimye nubwo nyine katabura ako kuba yari wenyine ariko ngo yakoze uko ashoboye ngo ashimishe abakunzi b’iri tsinda. Abajijwe ibyo bari bahugiyemo mu gihe bamaze badakora umuziki, Nina yagize ati”Twari turi kubategurira ibyo tuzabaha, tujya dufata igihe tugategura neza, byabaye ngombwa ko tubaha iriya yitwa ‘Ibirenze ibi’ izindi zizasohoka nyuma.” Uyu muhanzikazi yavuze ko bahisemo gusohora iyi ndirimbo mu buryo bw’amajwi mu gihe bari gushaka uko yafatirwa amashusho cyane ko ayo bari bafite basanze atameze neza. Abajijwe niba kumara igihe badakora bitabadindiza, Nina yagize ati ”Biba byabayeho kubera impamvu zinyuranye, haba hari ibintu bitagenze neza haba hari ibibazo n’impamvu bitaduturutseho ariko twe tuba dushaka gusohora indirimbo.” Uyu muhanzikazi yahishuye ko nubwo mu 2019 nta gitaramo cyabo bakoze ariko byanze bikunze bari gutekereza uko mu 2020 bagikora. Ibi byose uyu muhanzikazi yabitangaje mu gihe yari avuye ku rubyiniro mu yahoze aro KIE, aho yaririmbye wenyine bitewe n’uko Charly atabashije kuboneka nubwo impamvu zo kutaboneka kwe atifuje kuzigarukaho. Itsinda rya Charly na Nina ryari ryatumiwe gususurutsa abitabiriye ubukangurambaga bwa “EAC iDeserve” aho abanyeshuri bo muri za kaminuza baganirizwaga kuri gahunda z’uyu muryango. Nina wagaragaye aririmba wenyine yahishuye ibyari bihugije itsinda ryabo mu minsi ishize

title: Ibitwenge byari byose! Miss Naomie ari mu bateweho urwenya muri Seka Live (Amafoto)
content: Bimaze kumenyerwa ku bakunda urwenya ko buri Cyumweru cya nyuma cy’ukwezi habaho ibitaramo bya Seka Live bitumirwamo ibyamamare bitandukanye. Muri uku kwezi ntabwo abakunzi  b’urwenya batanzwe kuko nabwo abanyarwenya batandukanye bakomeye bashimishije benshi mu gitaramo cyabaye kuri uyu wa 29 Gashyantare 2020. Iki gitaramo cyabaye mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa 29 Gashyantare 2020, muri Kigali Marriott Hotel. Saa mbili ziburaho iminota mike nibwo Arthur Nkusi yageze ku rubyiniro ahita ahamagara Captain Father wateye urwenya avuga uburyo byari kuba bimeze iyo Yesu/Yezu aza kuza ku Isi ari umusirikare,  n’uko yari kujya ahamagara intumwa ze nk’uko abasirikare babigenza. Arthur Nkusi wari uyoboye iki gitaramo cy’urwenya yanyuzagamo agasetsa abantu bagatembagara dore ko ari umwe mu basanzwe bafite izina rikomeye kandi bafite ubunararibonye mu gusetsa. Ubwo yateraga urwenya ku bigezweho cyangwa amakuru amaze iminsi avugwa yagarutse kuri Nishimwe Naomie uherutse kwambikwa ikamba rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda mu 2020. Arthur yavuze ko mu byavuzwe cyane ari amanota ye,  ashimangira ko na we ubwe mu mashuri abanza yatsinzwe ari nayo mpamvu ataseka Miss Nishimwe Naomie. Ati  “Muri iyi minsi amanota ya Miss [….] Ntabwo nabivuga nanjye naratsinzwe mu mashuri abanza, ugiye ku Karere n’ubu wayasangayo. Niba uri inshuti na Naomie umubwire ko bizarangira.” Bitewe n’uburyo yabivugagamo byatembagaje benshi bari bitabiriye iki gitaramo. Yahise yanzika ahamagara abanyarwenya bakizamuka mu Rwanda bagerageza gushimisha abantu cyane ko bari bakiri bake muri aya masaha. Uretse Captain Father, mu bandi banyarwenya bigaragaje harimo Nimu Roger, Milly, Fally Merci ndetse na Patrick. Mu bari bitabiriye harimo n’umuhanzi mu ndirimbo zo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana, Israel Mbonyi wanateweho urwenya na Arthur. Mu rwenya rwatembagaje  benshi, Arthur yabanje gushimira abitabiriye ahita avuga ko mu byamamare byaje kumushyigikira harimo na Israel Mbonyi . Ati  “Ndagira ngo mbikubwire wenda hari igihe utabizi,  ufite indirimbo wakoze ariko ntabwo uzi uburyo iri kurokora ubuzima bw’abantu benshi hano hanze.” Yakomeje avuga ko indirimbo nyinshi zikunze kuba zivuga ku bagabo bakunda abagore ariko indirimbo ya Mbonyi aririmbamo ngo “Uko bimeze kose nziko hari umugabo unkunda, ambwira ko ndi uwe….”ibi nabyo byatembagaje abatari bake bitewe n’uburyo yabivuzemo. Nyuma y’umwanya w’abanyarwenya bo mu Rwanda, ahagana saa tatu  n’igice nibwo Arthur Nkusi wari uyoboye ibi birori yahamagaye ku rubyiniro Ndumiso Lindi yavuze ko ari inshuti ye ya hafi kandi yishimira. Uyu mugabo wo muri Afurika y’Epfo afite ibigwi dore ko yakoze ibitaramo byinshi haba mu gihugu cye, mu Bwongereza, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’ahandi henshi. Ndumiso yateye urwenya yibanda kubo mu muryango we by’umwihariko avuga uburyo Mama we yari umukiristo akunda kuririmba indirimbo zose zo mu rusengero nk’aho azizi ariko muby’ukuri ari ukujyana n’injyana ariko ukaba utamubaza amagambo ari kuririmba ngo ayakubwire. Umunyarwenya wasoje iki gitaramo ni Umunya- Nigeria,  Otolorin Kehinde Peter, [Kenny Blaq], wasekeje abari bitabiriye iki gitaramo kuva ubwo yageraga ku rubyiniro kurinda asoje. Yateye urwenya rwagarutse ku bibuga by’indege na serivisi zihatangirwaho avuga ko muri Nigeria iwabo bafite ikibuga cy’indege cyiza ariko batarusha i Kigali bitewe n’uburyo yasanze hameze neza. Uyu musore nawe ntiyibagiwe gutera urwenya agaragaza ubwiza bw’abakobwa yasanze i Kigali bakunze gutangarirwa na benshi ndetse n’imyitwarire yabo yavuze ko itandukanye n’iy’ab’iwabo muri Nigeria Yatanze nk’urugero rw’iyo ubajije umukobwa wo muri Nigeria izina uburyo agusubiza bitandukanye n’uko uw’i Kigali agusubiza,  ahereye ku bari bitabiriye igitaramo yabazaga. Ati  “Iwacu muri Nigeria abakobwa baho iyo umubajije izina avuga mu ijwi riranguruye ukaba wanagira ubwoba naho hano abakobwa baho bavuga mu tujwi tworoheje.” Bitewe n’uburyo yabivugagamo byatumye benshi batembagara kuko yabijyanishaga n’intambuko benshi bagakwekwenuka. Ibitaramo bya Seka Live bimaze kuba ubukombe mu Rwanda no hanze , byanyuzemo abanyarwenya b’ibyamamare nka Eric Omondi, Klint da Drunk n’abandi  bakomeye muri Afurika.

title: Abahanzi barimo King James na Knowless  basendereje ibyishimo abanya-Kigali muri Tour du Rwanda (Amafoto)
content:
Iki gitaramo cyabaye kuri uyu wa 29 Gashyantare 2020, gihuriramo abahanzi batandukanye bakomeye mu Rwanda barimo ababarizwa muri Kina Music nka Butera Knowless, Igor Mabano, Nel Ngabo, P,  Bulldogg, Bruce Melodie, Davis D na King James. Ni nyuma y’agace ka karindwi kasorejwe  i Nyamirambo  aho Umunya-Colombia Restrepo Jhonatan wa Androni Giocattoli - Sidermec yegukanye aka gace,  yandika amateka mashya yo kuba umukinnyi wa kabiri wegukanye uduce tune twikurikiranya mu irushanwa rimwe. Mu gitaramo cyakurikiyeho, ku rubyiniro habanjeho Rob Drabkin washimishije benshi mu ndirimbo ze zitandukanye biba akarusho ubwo yaririmbaga indirimbo izwi cyane mu Rwanda y’abana yitwa ‘Mbe Kanyamanza keza’. Yakurikiwe n’umuraperi S-Wrap nawe washimishije benshi mu muziki wiganjemo uwo mu njyana ya Trap. Nel Ngabo ubarizwa muri Kina Music niwe wakurikiye uyu muhanzi ashimisha benshi mu ndirimbo zirimo ‘Byakoroha’  asoreza kuri ‘Ya Motema’ yahuriyemo na P wahoze muri Dream Boyz. Davis D ugezweho mu ndirimbo ‘Dede’ niwe wakurikiyeho yishimirwa mu ndirimbo zitandukanye. Uyu muhanzi yahereye ku yitwa ‘Biryogo’, ‘Soso’, ‘Sexy’, ‘Like you’ yahuriyemo na Seyn na Kevin Kade asoreza kuri ‘Dede’. Nyuma, Igor Mabano yahise ajya ku rubyiniro yishimirwa mu bihangano bye bitandukanye birimo indirimbo yise ‘Ni ukuri’, ‘Go Back’,  ‘Dear Mashuka’ yafashijwe ku rubyiniro na Rob Drabkin, ‘Gake’ asoreza kuri  ‘Iyo Utegereza’. Yahise aha umwanya Platini wahoze muri Dream Boyz usigaye yitwa P, uyu muhanzi aririmba indirimbo ze zirimo ‘Fata amano’ yakoranye na Safi Madiba ndetse na ‘Romeo & Juliet’ ya Dream Boyz yahozemo. Bruce Melodie niwe wari utahiwe! Uyu muhanzi yishimiwe mu ndirimbo yinjiriyeho yitwa ‘Ndumiwe’, ‘Katerina’, ‘Kalibu nyumbani’ asoreza kuri ‘Kungola’ yahuriyemo na Sunnny yahagurukije n’iyonka muri iki gitaramo. Aba bahanzi bakurikiwe na Bulldogg wahise yanzika n’indirimbo ze zirimo ‘Nk’umusaza’, ‘Cinema’ na ‘Zana’ na ‘Mpe Enkoni’. Uyu muhanzi ari mu bishimiwe bikomeye muri iki gitaramo. Butera Knowless yaje akorera mu ngata uyu muhanzi mu ndirimbo yise ‘Yuda’, ‘Nkoraho’, ‘Sweet Mutima’, ‘Blessed’, ‘Day to day’. Uyu muhanzikazi yishimiwe kuva atangiye kugeza asoje kuririmba. Abakunzi be bari bahimbawe ku buryo baririmbanaga nawe kuri buri ndirimbo yose yaririmbaga. King James niwe washyize akadomo kuri iki gitaramo ahereye ku ndirimbo yise ‘Icyangombwa’ akajya anyuzamo akaganiriza abafana ababwira ati ‘muriteguye kubyina?’ bose bakiriza icyarimwe bamwereka ko banyotewe no gutaramana nawe. Yakomereje kuri ‘Ayo arya ni ayanjye’, ‘Ibare’, ‘Buhoro buhoro’, ‘Umuriro watse’, ‘Ganyobwe’ asoreza kuri ‘Ndagutegereje’. Uyu muhanzi ari muri bake babashije guhagurutsa buri wese wari uri muri iki gitaramo ndetse yeretswe urukundo mu buryo bukomeye. Muri iki gitaramo habayemo n’umwanya wo gupima ku buntu virusi itera sida n’izindi ndwara, hakanatangwa inyigisho zitandukanye zifasha abaturage kubungabunga ubuzima bwabo. Amafoto: Umurerwa Delphin

title: Urwibutso rwa Miss Rwanda Nishimwe Naomie mu rugendo rwo kuba nyampinga,  n’uburyo yatunguwe no gutorwa (Video)
content: Miss Nishimwe ni umukobwa w’imyaka 21 wavukiye i Kigali aba ari naho akurira, aha ni naho yize dore ko yarangije ayisumbuye mu mwaka wa 2019 aho yize MEG muri Glory Secondary School. Nyuma y’uko arangije amashuri ye uyu mukobwa yaje kwitabira irushanwa rya Miss Rwanda yanegukanye tariki 22 Gashyantare 2020 mu Intare Arena. Nishimwe wakuranye indoto zo kuba Nyampinga yatangiye kubyiyumvamo mu 2015 ubwo yitabiraga amarushanwa anyuranye y’ubwiza mu mashuri yisumbuye. Yamenyekanye cyane mu irushanwa rya Miss High School aho yanaje kwegukana ikamba ry’umukobwa uzi kwifotoza neza. Tariki 18 Mutarama 2020 nibwo benshi bamenye uyu mukobwa wari umaze kwinjira muri Miss Rwanda ahagarariye Umujyi wa Kigali. Ubwo bahamagaraga abakobwa bagomba guhagararira uyu mujyi 19 barangiye ataragerwaho, uyu akaba ariwe bahamagaye bwa nyuma bityo buzura 20. Akinjira mu bakobwa bagomba guhagararira Umujyi wa Kigali yabwiye abanyamakuru ko ataganira nabo kubera ibyishimo yari afite, aha yirindaga kuba yavuga amagambo atateguye. Yagize ati”Kiriya gihe nari mfite ubwoba, nibazaga ukuntu nsigaye nkumva birakomeye. Gusa narasenze cyane kandi ndashimira Imana ko yabikoze.” Abakobwa 20 bari bagiye basanga abandi 34 batoranyijwe mu zindi ntara, tariki 1 Gashyantare mu ihema ry’ahasanzwe habera imurikagurisha i Gikondo niho habereye ibirori byo gutoranya abakobwa 20 bagombaga kujya mu mwiherero muri 54 bahatanaga icyo gihe. Nishimwe Naomie yabaye umwe muri abo 20 bagombaga kujya mu mwiherero bityo we kimwe na bagenzi be 19 bamara ibyumweru bibiri muri Hotel La Palisse i Nyandungu mbere y’uko umunsi nyiri izina wo gutanga ikamba ugera. Uyu mukobwa winjiranye mu irushanwa umushinga wo kurwanya indwara y’agahinda gakomeye mu banyarwanda yanawugeranye ku munsi wa nyuma w’irushanwa kuko ari nawo yabwiye abagize akanama nkemurampaka mbere yuko kamuha amanota yatumye yegukana ikamba. Tariki 22 Gashyantare 2020, ku Intare Arena, Nishimwe Naomie yambitswe ikamba rya Miss Rwanda nyuma y’irushanwa rikomeye ry’abakobwa beza bose bahatanaga. Mu bakobwa 54 bagombaga gushakwamo 20 bajya mu mwiherero Nishimwe Naomie avuga ko byari urugamba rukomeye ariko Imana yonyine ariyo yarumufashije. Ati” Byari bikomeye, Imana yaramfashije. Abakobwa 54 bose beza bakwiye kuba ba Nyampinga si ibintu byari byoroshye.” Ageze mu mwiherero Nishimwe Naomie yari azwi nk’umukobwa ukunda gusetsa cyane ariko bagenzi be bari baranamaze guha akazina ka “Manyinya” kubera Inyinya afite. Miss Nishimwe mu mwiherero ubwo bajyaga kwerekana impano we yavuze ko ari umuhanga mu gutunganya imisatsi, iki gihe yafashe Akaliza Hope amutunganyiriza mu mutwe. Ku munsi nyiri izina w’irushanwa avuga ko nta cyizere yari afite kuko ikamba yari yamaze kuriha Akaliza Hope bari bahanganye. Ati” Nta cyizere nari mfite, nabonaga ikamba ari irya Akaliza Hope, kenshi nawe narabimubwiraga ko ariwe Miss Rwanda 2020.” Abajijwe impamvu yarihaga uwo mukobwa Miss Nishimwe yagize ati” Nta mpamvu, nyine ni uko ariko nabibonaga, buri wese muri twe yari afite uwo abona ukwiye ikamba, njye rero nabonaga ari we.” Muri uyu mwiherero ngo ntazibagirwa uburyo yabanaga na bagenzi be ndetse n’abayobozi banyuranye babasuraga bakabaha ibiganiro byiza. Nishimwe Naomie yayoboye abandi bakobwa mu majwi kuva mu ijonjora ry’ibanze kugeza ku munsi wa nyuma w’irushanwa. Yarushaga abandi bakobwa amajwi yaba kuri Internet no mu buryo bwa SMS. Ku munsi nyiri izina wo gutanga amakamba Uyu ngo wari umunsi w’ubwoba ku bakobwa bose bahatanaga, Nishimwe Naomie yagize ati “Twarabyutse tujya gufata amafunguro bisanzwe, badukorera mu mutwe baradusiga ubundi dutegereza amasaha ngo tujye ahagombaga kubera irushanwa.” “Buri wese yari afite ubwoba ubona ntawe uvugisha mugenzi we” . Miss Nishimwe avuga ko bakimuha ikamba rya Miss Photogenic yahise yumva ko byose birangiye. Ati” Numvaga byarangiye, bavuze nimero yanjye ko ariyo yatsinze nagize ngo baribeshye bagiye kubanza kureba neza. Nari natangiye kubara intambwe ngiye gutera nsubira inyuma ariko Imana yarahabaye nsanga ni njyewe.” Ikamba  Nishimwe Naomie yegukanye ryamuhesheje kwegukana ibihembo binyuranye. Nka Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2020 yagenewe imodoka nshya yo mu bwoko bwa Suzuki Swift 2019 yatanzwe na Suzuki binyuze muri Rwanda Motor ifite agaciro ka miliyoni 18 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Yemerewe kandi umushahara w’ibihumbi 800 Frw ku kwezi mu gihe cy’umwaka, aya akazatangwa na Africa Improved Foods. Nyampinga w’u Rwanda yemerewe kwivuza ku buntu ku ivuriro ryitwa Ubuzima Polyclinique no gusohokera muri Camellia agafata icyo ashaka mu gihe kingana n’umwaka azamarana ikamba. Yemerewe itike y’indege izamujyana i Dubai n’ibindi byose bijyanye n’urugendo azakora mu rwego rw’ikiruhuko, iyi ikazatangwa na kompanyi yitwa Multi Design Group. Keza Salon yemeyeko izamukorera ibijyanye n’imisatsi ndetse no kwita ku bwiza bwe mu gihe cy’umwaka wose. Yemerewe gucapirwa inyandiko zose ku buntu ku bintu byose azaba ashaka muri Smart Design, mu gihe True Connect yo yamwemereye internet y’umwaka ku buntu. Mu gihe agiye mu birori, uyu mukobwa azajya yambikwa na Ian Boutique ku buntu ahabwe n’imyenda ya Siporo y’ubuntu muri Magasin Sport Class. Umukobwa wegukanye ikamba rya Miss Rwanda buri mwaka ahita anatsindira itike yo guhagararira igihugu muri Miss World. Ishimwe Naomie wegukanye ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2020 ni umwana w’imyaka 21 upima metero 1.70 akaba yari yambaye nimero 31 mu irushanwa rya Miss Rwanda 2020.

title: Filime zisaga 230 ziri guhatanira kwitabira iserukiramuco rya Mashariki African Film Festival
content: Iri serukiramuco ry’uyu mwaka rifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti “Kagire inkuru (tell the tale)”. Iyi nsanganyamatsiko yatekerejwe mu rwego rwo gushishikariza kubara inkuru zigisha kandi zubaka umuryango uzira umuze. Mashariki African Film Festival ni iserukiramuco ngarukamwaka rigamije kumenyekanisha filime zikorerwa muri Afurika ndetse n’izo mu Rwanda no kuzikundisha abanyafurika n’isi yose muri rusange. Uyu mwaka iri serukiramuco rizaba guhera tariki 21 kugeza kuri 27 Werurwe 2020. Kugeza ubu filime zigera mu 218 zamaze kwiyandikisha zisaba kuzitabira iri serukiramuco, nyuma ya tariki 25 Gashyantare 2020 nibwo hazamenyakana filime zabashije kwemererwa kuzitabira Mashariki African Film Festival. Filime zizerekanwa muri iri serukiramuco ni izakozwe n’abanyafurika kandi zivuga inkuru zerekeranye na Afurika, zikaba zarakozwe nibura guhera muri 2018-2019. Uretse kwerekana filime, hazaba hari gahunda yo gutanga amasomo ajyanye na sinema, guhemba filime n’abakora filime mu byiciro bitandukanye. Filime zizerekanwa ndetse nyuma yo kwerekanwa hazajya haba umwanya w’ibibazo n’ibisubizo mu gihe uwakoze iyo filime ahari. ‘Girls in Cinema’ ni kimwe mu bizaba bigize Mashariki African Film Festival muri uyu mwaka, iyi ikaba ari gahunda yo gushishikariza umubare munini w’abakobwa kwitabira kujya muri sinema. Hateganyijwe gahunda zo kwigisha abakobwa gukora filime bifashishije telefoni zigezweho (smartphones), nka kimwe mu bikoresha bihendutse ugereranyije n’ibindi bikoresho nkenerwa mu gukora filime. Mashariki African Film Festival igamije guteza imbere sinema ya Afurika n’inkuru z’Abanyafurika ubwabo ari nazo zerekanwa cyane kurusha izo mu bindi bihugu. Izakorewe hanze ya Afurika zerekanwa muri iri serukiramuco ni izikubiyemo inkuru zivuga kuri Afurika gusa.

title: Trezzo Mahoro akomeje kwandika izina muri filime iri mu zigezweho kuri Netflix
content: Trezzo Mahoro yavukiye mu Rwanda gusa aba muri Vancouver, muri Canada. Yatangiye kwiyumvamo ibyo gukina filime ari mu mwaka wa nyuma w’amashuri yisumbuye. Yamamaye muri filime zitandukanye zirimo "The Magicians" yakinnyemo yitwa Ralphie,  “The X-Files” yakinnyemo yitwa Crewman ya Fox, "iZombie" yakinnyemo yitwa Darius, ubu agezweho muri filime Nyamerika yitwa ‘To All the Boys: P.S. I Still Love You’ ica kuri Netflix akinamo yitwa Lucas. Iyi filime ni igice gishya kuko yabanjirijwe n’ikindi cyitwaga ‘To All the Boys I’ve Loved Before’ yagiye hanze muri 2018. Yanditse ikomowe ku gitabo cy’umwanditsi w’Umunyamerika witwa Jenny Han, yayobowe na  Michael Fimognari yandikwa na  Sofia Alvarez na J. Mills Goodloe. Ivuga ku nkuru y’umukobwa wagiye akunda abahungu bagiye bahura mu bihe bitandukanye, akajya abandikira amabaruwa noneho rimwe murumuna we aza kuyafata ayoherereza ba bahungu batanu baba barakundanye na we. Umwe muri bo akaza kumubwira ngo bakundane ariko ari ukubeshya bagira ngo batere ishyari umukobwa baba basanzwe bakundana uba wamwanze, agace ka mbere karangira aba bombi baratangiye gukundana bya nyabyo. Mu gace ka kabiri barakomeza bagakundana ariko hakaza undi muhungu bari baroherereje ibaruwa akanamusubiza nyuma bakaza guhurira ahantu bakagerageza gukundana ariko umukobwa akaza gusanga bitakunda. Trezzo Mahoro[Lucas] aba ari umwe mu nshuti z’uyu mukobwa ubusanzwe witwa Lana Condor uba akinamo yitwa Lara Jean, aba ari mu bo yigeze gukunda ndetse akanamwandikira ariko Lucas akamwanga kuko aba ari umutinganyi. Trezzo Mahoro afite imyaka 23. Icyo ahuriyeho na Ncuti Gatwa nawe uherutse kwamamara cyane muri Sex Education ndetse ukurikirwa n’abasaga miliyoni ebyiri kuri Instagram, n’uko muri izi filime zatumye bamenyekana cyane bose bazikinamo ari abakundana bahuje ibitsina [abatinganyi]. Reba agace gato ka ‘To All the Boys: P.S. I Still Love You’, filime iri ku bica bigacika kuri Netflix yakinnyemo umunyarwanda

title: Buravan, Michaël Sengazi na Hervé Kimenyi bazifashishwa mu kwezi ko kwizihiza imyaka 50 OIF imaze
content: Ni igikorwa cyatangiye mu 1988, nk’uburyo abari muri uyu Muryango wa OIF uhurije hamwe abaturage bavuga Igifaransa basaga miliyoni 300 ku Isi, bakwishimira ururimi rw’Igifaransa rukoreshwa na byinshi muri byo. Kuri iyi nshuro muri uyu mwaka wa 2020, birihariye cyane cyane kuri Ambasade y’u Bufaransa mu Rwanda. Ku rwego mpuzamahanga ho hazaba hizihizwa imyaka 50 uyu muryango wa OIF umaze utangijwe. Iki gikorwa kizabera mu Rwanda ku bufatanye n’Ibigo bya Leta bitandukanye birimo Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga ndetse n’iy’uburezi, abadipolomate bahagarariye ibihugu bigize uyu muryango n’abandi bayobora OIF. Muri Werurwe hateganyijwe ibikorwa bitandukanye mu Mujyi wa Kigali by’umwihariko hazabanza icyo gutangiza ku mugaragaro uku kwezi nk’uko kwizihiza isabukuru y’imyaka 50 uyu muryango umaze. Chargé d’Affaires muri Ambasade y’u Bufaransa i Kigali, Jérémie Blin na Juliette Bigo uyobora  Ikigo Ndangamuco cy’Abafaransa mu Rwanda bazagirana ikiganiro n’itangazamakuru ku wa 04 Werurwe 2020 saa tanu za mu gitondo kuri Onomo Hotel. Ibindi bikorwa biteganyijwe harimo igitaramo cy’umuhanzi Yvan Buravan wegukanye Prix découverte RFI mu 2018 kizabera muri Serena Hotel ku wa 20 Werurwe 2020, guhera saa mbili z’umugoroba aho kwinjira bizaba ari ubuntu. Ikigo Ndangamuco cy’Abafaransa mu Rwanda cyateguwe n’igikorwa cy’amarushanwa kizahuza abanyempano mu kuvuga imivugo by’umwihariko yo mu rurimi rw’Igifaransa. Kizabera ku nzu y’imyidagaduro ya Kimisagara ku wa 14 Werurwe 2020 hagamijwe kuzamura impano nshya. Uzaba uwa mbere umuvugo we uzatunganywa werekanwe mu gitaramo cya Buravan. Hateganyijwe amarushanwa ya bandes dessinées [inkuru zishushanyije] yateguwe ku bufatanye na éditions Bakamé, abahize abandi bazatangazwa ku wa 21 Werurwe 2020 ibikorwa byabo bigaragazwe mu gihe cy’icyumweru mu isomero  rusange ry’Umujyi wa Kigali mu gihe cy’icyumweru. Uku kwezi kuzasozwa na Wallonie-Bruxelles, Michaël Sengazi  watwaye Prix RFI Talents du rire 2019 na  Hervé Kimenyi bazataramira abazitabira umugoroba wiswe  Francofourires , mu gitaramo cy’urwenya kizabera muri Kigali Cultural Village ku wa 28 Werurwe. Uyu muryango washingiwe i Niamey muri Niger tariki 20 Werurwe 1970, utangizwa n’ibihugu 21 byiganjemo ibyahoze bikolonijwe n’u Bufaransa. Kuri ubu ugizwe n’ibihugu 84 birimo ibinyamuryango byuzuye 54, ibihugu bine byiyunze n’ibihugu 26 by’indorerezi. Louise Mushikiwabo niwe muyobozi wawo, yatangiye kuwuyobora muri Mutarama 2019.

title: Paris: Abantu 30 bafashwe bashinjwa guteza imvururu hafi y’aho Fally Ipupa yakoreye igitaramo
content: Mbere y’iki gitaramo, ahagana saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba hafi y’aho bategera ’Gare de Lyon’, i Paris, hagaragaye inkongi yatewe n’abigaragambya bagamije kubuza abantu kwitabira igitaramo cya Fally Ipupa, cyaberaga hafi aho. Aba biganjemo abarwanya ubuyobozi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, batwitse ibishyirwamo imyanda ndetse n’utumoto duto twari aho. Icyakora bakomwe mu nkokora na Polisi y’u Bufaransa n’abazimya umuriro bahise bawucyaha. Umunyamakuru wa BBC wari uri aho byabereye yagize ati” Hari umwotsi mwinshi cyane, abantu biruka batwika ibintu. Byagaragaraga ko barakaye. Urujya n’uruza rwari rwakumiriwe mu byerekezo byose. Byari akaga”. “Abigaragambya bajugunyaga buri kimwe bashoboye kuri polisi ndetse n’abazimya inkongi bageragezaga gukora akazi kabo. Batwikaga buri kimwe bashoboye kandi bakakirwanisha.” Igitaramo cya Fally Ipupa cyabereye ahitwa Accor Hotels Arena. Polisi yabashije gukumira ko aba bigaragambyaga irabatatanya ndetse ntibabangamira igitaramo cya Fally Ipupa, kuko byarangiye kibaye cyitabirwa n’abarenga 20 000. Abigaragambyaga bari bagamije gukumira abantu kwitabira igitaramo cya Fally Ipupa ushinjwa kuba inshuti ya hafi ya Perezida Felix Tshisekedi umaze umwaka ayobora Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Polisi yavuze ko yataye muri yombi abantu 30 mu gihe abarenga 54 bo baciwe amande bashinjwa kugira uruhare muri iyi myigaragambyo. Nyuma y’igitaramo cyagenze neza, Fally Ipupa abinyujije ku mbuga nkoranyambaga yashimiye buri umwe wakitabiriye ndetse anihanganisha abatabashije kwinjira kubera ko amatike yari yarashize cyera. Ndihanganisha abatabashije kwinjira imbere, tuzasubira. title: U Budage: Filime ‘Notre-Dame du Nil’ yegukanye igihembo mu iserukiramuco rikomeye “Berlinale 2020”
content: Berlinale [Berlin International Film Festival] ni iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime rikomeye mu gihugu cy’u Budage no ku mugabane w’u Burayi yabaga ku nshuro ya 70. Berlinale muri uyu mwaka yatangiye tariki Tariki 20 Gashyantare izageza ku itariki ya 1 Werurwe 2020. Aha Filime ‘Notre-Dame du Nil’ yakomotse ku gitabo cya Mukasonga Scholastique ikaba yegukanye igihembo cya filimi nziza “Best Film “. Iyi filime yashibutse ku gitabo cyanditswe na Mukasonga, Umunyarwandakazi uba mu Bufaransa cyasohotse mu 2012, kigahabwa ibihembo mpuzamahanga bibiri ari byo Prix Renaudot na Prix Ahmadou Kourouma. Muri iki gitabo Mukasonga agaragaza itotezwa ryakorerwaga abakobwa b’abanyeshuri bakomokaga mu bwoko bw’Abatutsi mbere ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Umwanditsi avuga ibyabereye mu Kigo cy’amashuri yisumbuye cyitwaga Notre Dame du Nil cyari icy’abakobwa gusa. Nyuma y’imyaka umunani iki gitabo gisohotse, ikigo gikora filime cyitwa Les Films du Tambour kiyobowe na Marie Legrand na Rani Massalha, bari kumwe n’umuhanga mu gutunganya filime Atiq Rahimi, baje mu Rwanda gukora filime ishingiye kuri iki gitabo. Iyi filime yakiniwe mu Karere ka Musanze no muri Rutsiro ku Ishuri rya Murunda, igaragarano abakobwa b’Abanyarwandakazi bagera kuri 20 barimo Amanda Mugabekazi, Malaika Uwamahoro, Albina Sydney Kirenga, Rubango Belinda na Clariella Bizimana.

title: Adrien Misigaro na Gentil Misigaro bageze mu Rwanda aho bagiye gukorera ibitaramo bikomeye (Video)
content: Aba bahanzi bageze ku kibuga cy’indege cya Kanombe ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 28 Gashyantare bari kumwe n’irindi tsinda ry’abaririmbyi bazafatanya nabo. Adrien Misigaro yabwiye itangazamakuru ko yababajwe cyane no gufungwa kwa Fireman nubwo ntacyo yari kubikoraho kuko gahunda zagombaga gukomeza mu gihe umuntu yaguye mu makosa. Ati “Nk’umukozi w’Imana ndamusengera nta kindi kintu nabivugaho, gahunda za leta zigomba gukomeza kuko umuntu iyo ari mu makosa aba agomba gufungwa yaba arengana akarenganurwa. Hari gahunda tuzakorana, hari n’indirimbo ze twakoze.” Gentil Misigaro we yavuze ko yari akumbuye mu Rwanda ndetse anagaragaza ko ari ahantu ahoza ku mutima cyane ko yanaje yambaye imyambaro yahakorewe. Mu mwaka wa 2019 nibwo Adrien Misigaro yagiye gusura urubyiruko ruri kugororerwa i Iwawa, iki gihe uyu muhanzi yavuyeyo atangije Ubukangurambaga yise “Melody of New Hope” bugamije gukangurira urubyiruko rutandukanye kwirinda no kwitandukanya n’ibiyobyabwenge. Asubiye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho asanzwe atuye, uyu muhanzi uri mu bagezweho muri Diaspora mu bakora indirimbo zo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana yasobanuriye ubuyobozi bw’itorero asengeramo ibyo avuyemo mu Rwanda. Nyuma yo kwishimira iki gikorwa yatangije, ubuyobozi bw’Itorero asanzwe asengeramo muri Amerika bwiyemeje kumutera ingabo mu bitugu bukamushyigikira ndetse kugeza ubu uhereye ku muyobozi w’iri torero n’abandi bakozi b’Imana bafatanya umurimo bazamuherekeza mu bitaramo ateganya gukorera mu Rwanda muri Werurwe 2020. Ibi bitaramo byiswe “Each one reach one” byateguwe mu rwego rwo gukangurira buri wese mu banyarwanda kuba bafasha byibuza umuntu umwe wabaswe n’ibiyobyabwenge kubivamo bityo bigafasha kwihutisha ubukangurambaga bwa “Melody of New Hope”. Mu gihe azamara mu Rwanda, Adrien Misigaro n’ikipe bazaba bari kumwe bazasura ibigo bitandukanye bifasha ababaswe n’ibiyobyabwenge. Igitaramo cy’i Kigali kizaba tariki 8 Werurwe 2020 muri Intare Arena mu gihe tariki 15 Werurwe 2020 bazakomereza muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda, Ishami rya Huye muri Auditorium.

title: Joeboy yashimishije abitabiriye igitaramo cya Kigali Jazz Junction (Amafoto)
content: Kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 28 Gashyantare 2020, nabwo abakunzi b’umuziki bari babukereye bambariye kureba abahanzi bakomeye barimo Davis D ugezweho mu ndirimbo yitwa ‘Dede’ na Niyo Bosco uri mu bahanzi bari kuzamuka neza mu ndirimbo zitanga ubutumwa ku buzima bwa buri munsi. Umunya-Nigeria Joseph Akinfenwa Donus umaze kwamamara nka Joeboy nawe yari ari mu bafitiwe amatsiko cyane ko afite ibihangano bigezweho mu Rwanda no muri Afurika muri rusange. Abakobwa b’ibizengerezi bakibyiruka bari biganje muri iki gitaramo bakamejeje, isegonda ku rindi babyinana imbaduko idasanzwe ndetse byarimba bagasanga abahanzi ku rubyiniro bakabafasha kubyina indirimbo zabo. Niyo Bosco niwe wabimburiye abandi aririmba indirimbo zitandukanye z’abandi bahanzi ndetse anasusurutsa abantu mu zindi ze zirimo ‘Ibanga’ na ‘Ubigenza Ute’ zazamuye amarangamutima ya buri wese wamurebaga. Uyu muhanzi ubusanzwe witwa Niyokwizerwa Bosco, afite ubumuga bwo kutabona ariko atangaza benshi kubera uburyo akirigita imirya ya guitar. Davis D nawe yaje amukorera mu ngata mu ndirimbo ze nka ‘Dede’, ‘Biryogo’, ‘Sexy’, ‘Soso’ n’izindi zitandukanye. Ubusanzwe yitwa Icyishaka David ni umwe mu bahanzi baririmba Afrobeat bafite uburyo butandukanye n’abandi baririmbamo bigashimisha benshi. Uyu musore yageze kuri ‘Dede’ ikunzwe mu bice byose by’igihugu abantu bose n’uwari wicaye bahagurukira icyari mwe bacinya akadiho karahava cyane ko iyi iri mu ndirimbo zikunzwe cyane. Yaririmbye mu buryo bwa Semi Live ariko kuva ku ndirimbo ye ya mbere kugeza ku yo yasorejeho abantu hafi ya bose wabonaga akanyamuneza ari kose bishimiye ibihangano bye kandi bacinya akadiho nta nkomyi. Joeboy niwe wari utegerejwe! Abantu babwiwe ko agiye gusesekara ku rubyiniro bose nk’abitsamuye basakuriza icyarimwe berekana ko bamwishimiye ku nshuro ye ya mbere aje mu Rwanda. Yaririmbye indirimbo ze zitandukanye guhera ku ya mbere kugeza ku ya nyuma abantu ubona akanyamuneza ari kose bafatanya nawe kuririmba. Yaririmbye mu buryo bwa Playback. Uyu musore w’imyaka 22, yavutse ku wa 21 Gicurasi 1997 mu Mujyi wa Lagos muri Nigeria, akaba ari umwanditsi n’umuririmbyi. Abarizwa mu nzu ifasha abahanzi ya emPawa Africa. Yize muri Kaminuza ya Lagos izwi nka UNILAG aho yakuye impamyabumenyi mu bijyanye n’imicungire y’abakozi. Joeboy yatangiye kuririmba ubwo yari afite imyaka 16. Ku myaka 17 akora indirimbo ye ya mbere yise ‘Gbeseyin’. Yasubiyemo ‘Shape of You’ ya Ed Sheeran yakirwa neza ndetse inatumbagiza izina rye ku rwego ruhambaye. Uyu muhanzi akimara kuririmba iyi ndirimbo ya Sheeran yahise yemererwa na Mr Eazi ubufasha ndetse anamusinyisha mu nzu ye ifasha abahanzi ya Eazi’s "Banku" Music. Mu ndirimbo yakoze zamenyekanye harimo ‘Baby’, ‘Beginning’, ‘All of You’ n’izindi nyinshi zatumye muri iki gihe abarirwa mu bahanzi bahagaze neza muri Nigeria. Amaze gukora album imwe yise ‘Love & Light’. Joeboy aherutse gusohoka ku rutonde rwa BBC rw’abahanzi bo kwitega mu 2020. Joeboy yaje mu Rwanda abisikana n’Umuraperi Jidenna Theodore Mobisson [Jidenna] nawe wo muri Nigeria waherukaga gutaramira mu Rwanda tariki 29 Ugushyingo 2019 mu gitaramo cyitabiriwe mu buryo bukomeye cyabereye muri Kigali Conference and Exhibition Village hazwi nka Camp Kigali. Amafoto: Uwihanganye Hardy

title: Miss World yahaye ikaze Miss Nishimwe Naomie uzitabira iri rushanwa uyu mwaka
content: Babinyujije ku rukuta rwabo rwa Twitter, Ubuyobozi bwa Miss World bwagize buti” Mudufashe duhe ikaze Nishimwe Naomie mu muryango wa Miss World.” Miss Nishimwe watsindiye ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2020 yahise ahabwa itike yo guhagararira u Rwanda mu irushanwa rya Miss World rizaba riba ku nshuro ya 70. Uyu mukobwa afite umushinga wo kurwanya Kwiheba mu rubyiruko, cyane ko yasanze ari ikibazo gikomeye kandi akenshi abantu badaha agaciro. Miss Nishimwe muri Miss World azaba abaye umunyarwandakazi wa gatanu witabiriye iri rushanwa u Rwanda ruzaba rwujuje imyaka itanu rwitabira. Mutesi Jolly niwe mukobwa wa mbere witabiriye Miss World mu 2016, kuva icyo gihe u Rwanda ntirugisiba mu irushanwa. Nimwiza Meghan niwe Munyarwandakazi uherutse muri iri rushanwa ryabereye mu mujyi wa Londres mu Bwongereza mu mpera za 2019. Nta mukobwa n’umwe wari wahagararira u Rwanda ngo acyure ikamba iryo ariryo ryose nubwo bagerageza kwitwara neza.

title: Musanze: The Ben yasusurukije abitabiriye Tour du Rwanda mu gitaramo gikomeye (Video)
content: Uyu muhanzi yifashishijwe n’uruganda rwenga ibinyobwa bisembuye n’ibidasembuye rwa Skol Brewery Ltd. Mu gitaramo yakoreye i Musanze, yanyuze abakunzi be bari bamaze imyaka 10 batamuca iryera abataramira. Abanyamusanze bitabiriye iki gitaramo banyuzwe n’uburyohe bw’umuziki w’uyu muhanzi, usanzwe ukundwa cyane n’abiganjemo abakobwa kubera ibihangano bibashima ku ndiba z’imitima. Yaririmbye ibihangano bye bitandukanye byakunzwe, ageze ku yitwa ‘Imfubyi’ afatanya na Bulldogg bayikoranye, nabyo binyura benshi mu buryo bukomeye. Yaririmbye izindi zirimo ‘Soma Skol’, ‘Zoubeda’ yakoranye na Kamichi, ‘Thank You’ yakoranye na Tom Close, ‘Habibi’ n’izindi zitandukanye. The Ben ari kwifashishwa na Skol mu bitaramo bitandukanye, icya mbere yagikoreye Kimironko ku wa 23 Gashyantare, i Musanze ku wa 27 Gashyantare ndetse ategerejwe mu kindi kizabera i Kigali ku wa 29 Gashyantare 2020. Reba igitaramo cy’i Musanze uko cyari cyifashe

title: Uwase wahagarariye u Rwanda muri Miss Supranational 2018 yitabiriye irindi rushanwa rikomeye
content: Uyu mukobwa ahatanye na bagenzi 16 baturutse mu bindi bihugu bitandukanye bitabira iri rushanwa riri kubera muri Pologne ari naho Uwase yiga muri kaminuza ya Wyższa Szkoła Bankowa yigisha ibyerekeye ubukungu. Uwase yabwiye IGIHE ko umukobwa uzahiga abandi azahabwa amajwi hakurikijwe uko yitwaye imbere y’akanama nkemurampaka, intambuko, ubwiza n’ukuntu ashyigikiwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga z’irushanwa. Azahembwa amafaranga ataratangajwe umubare ndetse afotorwe bya kinyamwuga mu gihe cy’icyumweru ari mu butembere ku mucanga wa  Miami muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Aba bakobwa bageze mu cyiciro cya nyuma bari 20, batatu barasezererwa kubera kutubahiriza igihe n’imyitozo. Uwase yavuze ko yiha amahirwe n’ubwo abona bitoroshye. Yagize ati “Birakomeye ariko amahirwe  ndayiha,  n’ubwo ntakubwira umubare njanishije kuko irushanwa aba ari irushanwa.” Umunsi ny’irizina wo gutora Miss Elite 2020, ni kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki 29 Gashyantare 2020. Hazatorwa Miss Elite n’ibisonga bye bibiri. Uwase ubusanzwe ni umunyamideli ndetse yegukanye ibihembo bitandukanye birimo icya Top Model Africa cyabereye muri Zimbabwe mu 2016 anitabira World Next Top Model 2017 ryabereye mu Mujyi wa Beirut muri Liban, aza mu bakobwa bageze mu cyiciro cya nyuma. Yitabiriye amarushanwa y’ubwiza nka Miss Supranational 2018 naho ntiyahirwa kuko atigeze aza mu myanya y’imbere.

title: Senderi yahawe igihembo n’akarere ka Kirehe
content: Yabwiye IGIHE ko yahawe iki gihembo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 27 Gashyantare 2020 muri aka karere akomokamo. Ati “Naraye mpawe igihembo cy’indashyikirwa n’akarere ka Kirehe nk’umuhanzi uhavuka ugerageza gushimisha abaturage baho n’utundi turere muri gahunda z’iterambere ry’igihugu, mu kurinda ibyagezweho no kubyongera  biciye mu bihangano by’uburere mboneragihugu.” Yavuze ko indirimbo zatumye ahabwa iki gihembo zirimo iyitwa ‘Ibidakwiriye nzabivuga’, ‘Nta mpamvu n’imwe’, ‘Iyo twicaranye’, ‘Abanyarwanda twaribohoye’, ‘Tuzarinda igihugu’ na ‘Twambariye gutsinda’. Uyu muhanzi yahawe iki gihembo ku munsi wo gusoza ibyitwa ‘Open Day’ bikorwa n’abatuye muri aka karere, uyu akaba ari munsi abantu n’ibigo byigenga bakorera mu karere bose bahurira mu imurikabikorwa bakerekana ibyo bamaze kugeza ku baturage hanarebwa gahunda z’ibihe biri imbere. Senderi aherutse gushyira hanze  indirimbo zirimo iyo yise ‘Imitako ya Migongo’  na ‘Ikirashi’ yakoranye na Intore Tuyisenge . Uyu muhanzi yatangiye kuririmba mbere gato ya 1994. Umuziki we wiganjemo indirimbo zivuga kuri politiki y’iterambere ry’igihugu, isuku, kwirinda ibyorezo nka Sida na Malariya, ubukungu, urukundo, umutekano n’ibindi. Senderi kandi akunda no kwibanda ku ndirimbo zihumuriza abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 n’izamagana abahembera amacakubiri. Reba indirimbo Senderi aheruka gushyira hanze yise ‘Ikirashi’

title: Musanze: Bizihiwe n’umuziki w’abahanzi bakomeye mu gitaramo cya Tour du Rwanda (Amafoto)
content: Ni mu gitaramo cyabaye nyuma y’agace k’iri rushanwa rimaze kuba ubukombe mu magare ribera mu Rwanda, kabaye kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 27 Gashyantare 2020 aho Umunya-Colombia Restrepo Jhonatan yegukanye aka gace ka Gatanu ka Tour du Rwanda 2020 ka Rubavu-Musanze, akoresheje 2h 08’19”. Mujyi wa Musanze hari hashyushye bose biteguye kwirebera aba banyonzi, banabukereye kwirebera abahanzi batandukanye bakomeye bagombaga kubataramira kakahava muri stade Ubworoherane yo muri aka karere. Guhera saa kumi,abantu banyuranagamo basiganwa buri wese ashaka umwanya w’imbere ngo aze kwirebera umuhanzi yihebeye nta nkomyi. Iki gitaramo cyabaye nyuma y’ikindi cyabereye mu karere ka Rubavu mu Ntara y’Uburengerazuba kuri Kivu Beach iruhande rwa Serena Hotel kuwa Gatatu tariki 27 Gashyantare 2020. Cyari cyitabiriwe n’umubare munini w’abakunzi b’umuziki biganjemo  cyane urubyiruko. Abatandukanye bakomeye mu Rwanda biganjemo ababarizwa mu nzu ifasha abahanzi ya Kina Music hamwe na King James, Bulldogg, Davis D na Bruce Melodie ndetse na Rob Drabkin na S-Wrap bari baturutse muri Amerika nibo basusurukije abari bitabiriye. Saa kumi n’ebyiri zishyira saa moya ku rubyiniro habanjeho Rob Drabkin washimishije benshi mu ndirimbo ze zitandukanye biba akarusho ubwo yaririmbaga indirimbo izwi cyane mu Rwanda y’abana yitwa ‘Mbe Kanyamanza keza’. Yakurikiwe n’umuraperi S-Wrap nawe washimishije benshi mu muziki wiganjemo uwo mu njyana ya Trap. Davis D ugezweho mu ndirimbo ‘Dede’ niwe wakurikiyeho yishimirwa mu ndirimbo zitandukanye. Uyu muhanzi yahereye ku yitwa ‘Biryogo’, ‘Soso’, ‘Sexy’ asoreza kuri ‘Dede’. Nel Ngabo ubarizwa muri Kina Music niwe wakurikiye uyu muhanzi ashimisha benshi mu ndirimbo zirimo ‘Why’ iri mu zo yahereyeho, ‘Nzahinduka’, ‘Byakoroha asoreza kuri ‘Ya Motema’ yahuriyemo na P wahoze muri Dream Boyz. Bakiri ku rubyiniro P yahise asangwayo na Polisi y’u Rwanda, bakora ubukangurambaga iherutse gutangiza n’abafatanyabikorwa bayo bw’ibyumweru 52 bugamije kurwanya no gukumira impanuka buzwi nka  “Gerayo Amahoro”. Nyuma, Igor Mabano yahise ajya ku rubyiniro yishimirwa mu bihangano bye bitandukanye birimo indirimbo yise ‘Urakunzwe’ yahereyeho, ‘Back’, ‘Dear Mashuka’ yafashijwe ku rubyiniro na Rob Drabkin, ‘Iyo Utegereza’ asoreza kuri ‘Gake’ yahuriyemo na Nel Ngabo banaririmbanye muri iki gitaramo. Aba bahanzi bakurikiwe na Bulldogg wahise yanzika n’indirimbo ze zirimo ‘Nk’umusaza’, ‘Cinema’ na ‘Zana’ yahuriyemo na Deejay Lenzo banajyanye ku rubyiniro muri iki gitaramo. Bruce Melodie niwe wari utahiwe! Uyu muhanzi yishimiwe mu ndirimbo yinjiriyeho yitwa ‘Ndumiwe’, ‘Ikinya’, ‘Fresh’ asoreza kuri ‘Kungola’ yahuriyemo na Sunnny yahagurukije n’iyonka muri iki gitaramo. Butera Knowless yaje akorera mu ngata uyu muhanzi mu ndirimbo yise ‘Baramushaka’, ‘Nkoraho’, ‘Sweet Mutima’, ‘Urugero’, ‘Blessed’, ‘Ko nashize’ asoreza ku yo yise ‘Ujya unkumbura’. King James niwe washyize akadomo kuri iki gitaramo gusa atenguhwa n’umuriro kuko yatangiye kuririmba ahereye ku ndirimbo yise ‘Rasta’ yajya kuririmba izindi zirimo ‘Ganyobwe’ umuriro ukagenda ucika.. Muri iki gitaramo habayemo n’umwanya wo gupima ku buntu virusi itera sida n’izindi ndwara, hakanatangwa inyigisho zitandukanye zifasha abaturage kubungabunga ubuzima bwabo. Biteganyijwe igitaramo nk’iki kizabera mu Mujyi wa Kigali kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 29 Gashyantare 2020 muri Car Free Zone ku bufatanye n’Umujyi wa Kigali muri gahunda y’ibitaramo bisoza ukwezi usanzwe ukora. Amafoto: Niyonzima Moïse

title: Trezzo Mahoro akomeje kwandika izina muri filime iri mu zigezweho kuri Netflix
content: Trezzo Mahoro yavukiye mu Rwanda gusa aba muri Vancouver, muri Canada. Yatangiye kwiyumvamo ibyo gukina filime ari mu mwaka wa nyuma w’amashuri yisumbuye. Yamamaye muri filime zitandukanye zirimo "The Magicians" yakinnyemo yitwa Ralphie,  “The X-Files” yakinnyemo yitwa Crewman ya Fox, "iZombie" yakinnyemo yitwa Darius, ubu agezweho muri filime Nyamerika yitwa ‘To All the Boys: P.S. I Still Love You’ ica kuri Netflix akinamo yitwa Lucas. Iyi filime ni igice gishya kuko yabanjirijwe n’ikindi cyitwaga ‘To All the Boys I’ve Loved Before’ yagiye hanze muri 2018. Yanditse ikomowe ku gitabo cy’umwanditsi w’Umunyamerika witwa Jenny Han, yayobowe na  Michael Fimognari yandikwa na  Sofia Alvarez na J. Mills Goodloe. Ivuga ku nkuru y’umukobwa wagiye akunda abahungu bagiye bahura mu bihe bitandukanye, akajya abandikira amabaruwa noneho rimwe murumuna we aza kuyafata ayoherereza ba bahungu batanu baba barakundanye na we. Umwe muri bo akaza kumubwira ngo bakundane ariko ari ukubeshya bagira ngo batere ishyari umukobwa baba basanzwe bakundana uba wamwanze, agace ka mbere karangira aba bombi baratangiye gukundana bya nyabyo. Mu gace ka kabiri barakomeza bagakundana ariko hakaza undi muhungu bari baroherereje ibaruwa akanamusubiza nyuma bakaza guhurira ahantu bakagerageza gukundana ariko umukobwa akaza gusanga bitakunda. Trezzo Mahoro[Lucas] aba ari umwe mu nshuti z’uyu mukobwa ubusanzwe witwa Lana Condor uba akinamo yitwa Lara Jean, aba ari mu bo yigeze gukunda ndetse akanamwandikira ariko Lucas akamwanga kuko aba ari umutinganyi. Trezzo Mahoro afite imyaka 23. Icyo ahuriyeho na Ncuti Gatwa nawe uherutse kwamamara cyane muri Sex Education ndetse ukurikirwa n’abasaga miliyoni ebyiri kuri Instagram, n’uko muri izi filime zatumye bamenyekana cyane bose bazikinamo ari abakundana bahuje ibitsina [abatinganyi]. Reba agace gato ka ‘To All the Boys: P.S. I Still Love You’, filime iri ku bica bigacika kuri Netflix yakinnyemo umunyarwanda

title: Buravan, Michaël Sengazi na Hervé Kimenyi bazifashishwa mu kwezi ko kwizihiza imyaka 50 OIF imaze
content: Ni igikorwa cyatangiye mu 1988, nk’uburyo abari muri uyu Muryango wa OIF uhurije hamwe abaturage bavuga Igifaransa basaga miliyoni 300 ku Isi, bakwishimira ururimi rw’Igifaransa rukoreshwa na byinshi muri byo. Kuri iyi nshuro muri uyu mwaka wa 2020, birihariye cyane cyane kuri Ambasade y’u Bufaransa mu Rwanda. Ku rwego mpuzamahanga ho hazaba hizihizwa imyaka 50 uyu muryango wa OIF umaze utangijwe. Iki gikorwa kizabera mu Rwanda ku bufatanye n’Ibigo bya Leta bitandukanye birimo Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga ndetse n’iy’uburezi, abadipolomate bahagarariye ibihugu bigize uyu muryango n’abandi bayobora OIF. Muri Werurwe hateganyijwe ibikorwa bitandukanye mu Mujyi wa Kigali by’umwihariko hazabanza icyo gutangiza ku mugaragaro uku kwezi nk’uko kwizihiza isabukuru y’imyaka 50 uyu muryango umaze. Chargé d’Affaires muri Ambasade y’u Bufaransa i Kigali, Jérémie Blin na Juliette Bigo uyobora  Ikigo Ndangamuco cy’Abafaransa mu Rwanda bazagirana ikiganiro n’itangazamakuru ku wa 04 Werurwe 2020 saa tanu za mu gitondo kuri Onomo Hotel. Ibindi bikorwa biteganyijwe harimo igitaramo cy’umuhanzi Yvan Buravan wegukanye Prix découverte RFI mu 2018 kizabera muri Serena Hotel ku wa 20 Werurwe 2020, guhera saa mbili z’umugoroba aho kwinjira bizaba ari ubuntu. Ikigo Ndangamuco cy’Abafaransa mu Rwanda cyateguwe n’igikorwa cy’amarushanwa kizahuza abanyempano mu kuvuga imivugo by’umwihariko yo mu rurimi rw’Igifaransa. Kizabera ku nzu y’imyidagaduro ya Kimisagara ku wa 14 Werurwe 2020 hagamijwe kuzamura impano nshya. Uzaba uwa mbere umuvugo we uzatunganywa werekanwe mu gitaramo cya Buravan. Hateganyijwe amarushanwa ya bandes dessinées [inkuru zishushanyije] yateguwe ku bufatanye na éditions Bakamé, abahize abandi bazatangazwa ku wa 21 Werurwe 2020 ibikorwa byabo bigaragazwe mu gihe cy’icyumweru mu isomero  rusange ry’Umujyi wa Kigali mu gihe cy’icyumweru. Uku kwezi kuzasozwa na Wallonie-Bruxelles, Michaël Sengazi  watwaye Prix RFI Talents du rire 2019 na  Hervé Kimenyi bazataramira abazitabira umugoroba wiswe  Francofourires , mu gitaramo cy’urwenya kizabera muri Kigali Cultural Village ku wa 28 Werurwe. Uyu muryango washingiwe i Niamey muri Niger tariki 20 Werurwe 1970, utangizwa n’ibihugu 21 byiganjemo ibyahoze bikolonijwe n’u Bufaransa. Kuri ubu ugizwe n’ibihugu 84 birimo ibinyamuryango byuzuye 54, ibihugu bine byiyunze n’ibihugu 26 by’indorerezi. Louise Mushikiwabo niwe muyobozi wawo, yatangiye kuwuyobora muri Mutarama 2019.

title: Paris: Abantu 30 bafashwe bashinjwa guteza imvururu hafi y’aho Fally Ipupa yakoreye igitaramo
content: Mbere y’iki gitaramo, ahagana saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba hafi y’aho bategera ’Gare de Lyon’, i Paris, hagaragaye inkongi yatewe n’abigaragambya bagamije kubuza abantu kwitabira igitaramo cya Fally Ipupa, cyaberaga hafi aho. Aba biganjemo abarwanya ubuyobozi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, batwitse ibishyirwamo imyanda ndetse n’utumoto duto twari aho. Icyakora bakomwe mu nkokora na Polisi y’u Bufaransa n’abazimya umuriro bahise bawucyaha. Umunyamakuru wa BBC wari uri aho byabereye yagize ati” Hari umwotsi mwinshi cyane, abantu biruka batwika ibintu. Byagaragaraga ko barakaye. Urujya n’uruza rwari rwakumiriwe mu byerekezo byose. Byari akaga”. “Abigaragambya bajugunyaga buri kimwe bashoboye kuri polisi ndetse n’abazimya inkongi bageragezaga gukora akazi kabo. Batwikaga buri kimwe bashoboye kandi bakakirwanisha.” Igitaramo cya Fally Ipupa cyabereye ahitwa Accor Hotels Arena. Polisi yabashije gukumira ko aba bigaragambyaga irabatatanya ndetse ntibabangamira igitaramo cya Fally Ipupa, kuko byarangiye kibaye cyitabirwa n’abarenga 20 000. Abigaragambyaga bari bagamije gukumira abantu kwitabira igitaramo cya Fally Ipupa ushinjwa kuba inshuti ya hafi ya Perezida Felix Tshisekedi umaze umwaka ayobora Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Polisi yavuze ko yataye muri yombi abantu 30 mu gihe abarenga 54 bo baciwe amande bashinjwa kugira uruhare muri iyi myigaragambyo. Nyuma y’igitaramo cyagenze neza, Fally Ipupa abinyujije ku mbuga nkoranyambaga yashimiye buri umwe wakitabiriye ndetse anihanganisha abatabashije kwinjira kubera ko amatike yari yarashize cyera. Yagize ati” Ndashimira abantu 20000 bitabiriye igitaramo cyanjye kitazibagirana cyo ku wa 28 Gashyantare 2020, urukundo rwanyu rwatumye twongera kwandika amateka mashya. Ndihanganisha abatabashije kwinjira imbere, tuzasubira. Ndabakunda cyane.” Nubwo habanje akaduruvayo, Fally Ipupa yishimiye uko igitaramo cyagenze  👑🦅 Merci aux 20.000 personnes qui hier soir ont rendu cette soirée du 28.02.2020 inoubliable.Votre détermination,votre courage mais surtout votre amour ont permis de réécrire une nouvelle histoire .🙏🏾 Mes regrets les plus sincères à tous ceux et celles qui n’ont pas pu accéder à l’intérieur de la salle, ce n’est que partie remise je vous aime ❤️...
