title: U Budage: Filime ‘Notre-Dame du Nil’ yegukanye igihembo mu iserukiramuco rikomeye “Berlinale 2020”
content: Berlinale [Berlin International Film Festival] ni iserukiramuco mpuzamahanga rya Filime rikomeye mu gihugu cy’u Budage no ku mugabane w’u Burayi yabaga ku nshuro ya 70. Berlinale muri uyu mwaka yatangiye tariki Tariki 20 Gashyantare izageza ku itariki ya 1 Werurwe 2020. Aha Filime ‘Notre-Dame du Nil’ yakomotse ku gitabo cya Mukasonga Scholastique ikaba yegukanye igihembo cya filimi nziza “Best Film “. Iyi filime yashibutse ku gitabo cyanditswe na Mukasonga, Umunyarwandakazi uba mu Bufaransa cyasohotse mu 2012, kigahabwa ibihembo mpuzamahanga bibiri ari byo Prix Renaudot na Prix Ahmadou Kourouma. Muri iki gitabo Mukasonga agaragaza itotezwa ryakorerwaga abakobwa b’abanyeshuri bakomokaga mu bwoko bw’Abatutsi mbere ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Umwanditsi avuga ibyabereye mu Kigo cy’amashuri yisumbuye cyitwaga Notre Dame du Nil cyari icy’abakobwa gusa. Nyuma y’imyaka umunani iki gitabo gisohotse, ikigo gikora filime cyitwa Les Films du Tambour kiyobowe na Marie Legrand na Rani Massalha, bari kumwe n’umuhanga mu gutunganya filime Atiq Rahimi, baje mu Rwanda gukora filime ishingiye kuri iki gitabo. Iyi filime yakiniwe mu Karere ka Musanze no muri Rutsiro ku Ishuri rya Murunda, igaragarano abakobwa b’Abanyarwandakazi bagera kuri 20 barimo Amanda Mugabekazi, Malaika Uwamahoro, Albina Sydney Kirenga, Rubango Belinda na Clariella Bizimana.

title: Adrien Misigaro na Gentil Misigaro bageze mu Rwanda aho bagiye gukorera ibitaramo bikomeye (Video)
content: Aba bahanzi bageze ku kibuga cy’indege cya Kanombe ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 28 Gashyantare bari kumwe n’irindi tsinda ry’abaririmbyi bazafatanya nabo. Adrien Misigaro yabwiye itangazamakuru ko yababajwe cyane no gufungwa kwa Fireman nubwo ntacyo yari kubikoraho kuko gahunda zagombaga gukomeza mu gihe umuntu yaguye mu makosa. Ati “Nk’umukozi w’Imana ndamusengera nta kindi kintu nabivugaho, gahunda za leta zigomba gukomeza kuko umuntu iyo ari mu makosa aba agomba gufungwa yaba arengana akarenganurwa. Hari gahunda tuzakorana, hari n’indirimbo ze twakoze.” Gentil Misigaro we yavuze ko yari akumbuye mu Rwanda ndetse anagaragaza ko ari ahantu ahoza ku mutima cyane ko yanaje yambaye imyambaro yahakorewe. Mu mwaka wa 2019 nibwo Adrien Misigaro yagiye gusura urubyiruko ruri kugororerwa i Iwawa, iki gihe uyu muhanzi yavuyeyo atangije Ubukangurambaga yise “Melody of New Hope” bugamije gukangurira urubyiruko rutandukanye kwirinda no kwitandukanya n’ibiyobyabwenge. Asubiye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho asanzwe atuye, uyu muhanzi uri mu bagezweho muri Diaspora mu bakora indirimbo zo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana yasobanuriye ubuyobozi bw’itorero asengeramo ibyo avuyemo mu Rwanda. Nyuma yo kwishimira iki gikorwa yatangije, ubuyobozi bw’Itorero asanzwe asengeramo muri Amerika bwiyemeje kumutera ingabo mu bitugu bukamushyigikira ndetse kugeza ubu uhereye ku muyobozi w’iri torero n’abandi bakozi b’Imana bafatanya umurimo bazamuherekeza mu bitaramo ateganya gukorera mu Rwanda muri Werurwe 2020. Ibi bitaramo byiswe “Each one reach one” byateguwe mu rwego rwo gukangurira buri wese mu banyarwanda kuba bafasha byibuza umuntu umwe wabaswe n’ibiyobyabwenge kubivamo bityo bigafasha kwihutisha ubukangurambaga bwa “Melody of New Hope”. Mu gihe azamara mu Rwanda, Adrien Misigaro n’ikipe bazaba bari kumwe bazasura ibigo bitandukanye bifasha ababaswe n’ibiyobyabwenge. Igitaramo cy’i Kigali kizaba tariki 8 Werurwe 2020 muri Intare Arena mu gihe tariki 15 Werurwe 2020 bazakomereza muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda, Ishami rya Huye muri Auditorium.

title: Joeboy yashimishije abitabiriye igitaramo cya Kigali Jazz Junction (Amafoto)
content: Kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 28 Gashyantare 2020, nabwo abakunzi b’umuziki bari babukereye bambariye kureba abahanzi bakomeye barimo Davis D ugezweho mu ndirimbo yitwa ‘Dede’ na Niyo Bosco uri mu bahanzi bari kuzamuka neza mu ndirimbo zitanga ubutumwa ku buzima bwa buri munsi. Umunya-Nigeria Joseph Akinfenwa Donus umaze kwamamara nka Joeboy nawe yari ari mu bafitiwe amatsiko cyane ko afite ibihangano bigezweho mu Rwanda no muri Afurika muri rusange. Abakobwa b’ibizengerezi bakibyiruka bari biganje muri iki gitaramo bakamejeje, isegonda ku rindi babyinana imbaduko idasanzwe ndetse byarimba bagasanga abahanzi ku rubyiniro bakabafasha kubyina indirimbo zabo. Niyo Bosco niwe wabimburiye abandi aririmba indirimbo zitandukanye z’abandi bahanzi ndetse anasusurutsa abantu mu zindi ze zirimo ‘Ibanga’ na ‘Ubigenza Ute’ zazamuye amarangamutima ya buri wese wamurebaga. Uyu muhanzi ubusanzwe witwa Niyokwizerwa Bosco, afite ubumuga bwo kutabona ariko atangaza benshi kubera uburyo akirigita imirya ya guitar. Davis D nawe yaje amukorera mu ngata mu ndirimbo ze nka ‘Dede’, ‘Biryogo’, ‘Sexy’, ‘Soso’ n’izindi zitandukanye. Ubusanzwe yitwa Icyishaka David ni umwe mu bahanzi baririmba Afrobeat bafite uburyo butandukanye n’abandi baririmbamo bigashimisha benshi. Uyu musore yageze kuri ‘Dede’ ikunzwe mu bice byose by’igihugu abantu bose n’uwari wicaye bahagurukira icyari mwe bacinya akadiho karahava cyane ko iyi iri mu ndirimbo zikunzwe cyane. Yaririmbye mu buryo bwa Semi Live ariko kuva ku ndirimbo ye ya mbere kugeza ku yo yasorejeho abantu hafi ya bose wabonaga akanyamuneza ari kose bishimiye ibihangano bye kandi bacinya akadiho nta nkomyi. Joeboy niwe wari utegerejwe! Abantu babwiwe ko agiye gusesekara ku rubyiniro bose nk’abitsamuye basakuriza icyarimwe berekana ko bamwishimiye ku nshuro ye ya mbere aje mu Rwanda. Yaririmbye indirimbo ze zitandukanye guhera ku ya mbere kugeza ku ya nyuma abantu ubona akanyamuneza ari kose bafatanya nawe kuririmba. Yaririmbye mu buryo bwa Playback. Uyu musore w’imyaka 22, yavutse ku wa 21 Gicurasi 1997 mu Mujyi wa Lagos muri Nigeria, akaba ari umwanditsi n’umuririmbyi. Abarizwa mu nzu ifasha abahanzi ya emPawa Africa. Yize muri Kaminuza ya Lagos izwi nka UNILAG aho yakuye impamyabumenyi mu bijyanye n’imicungire y’abakozi. Joeboy yatangiye kuririmba ubwo yari afite imyaka 16. Ku myaka 17 akora indirimbo ye ya mbere yise ‘Gbeseyin’. Yasubiyemo ‘Shape of You’ ya Ed Sheeran yakirwa neza ndetse inatumbagiza izina rye ku rwego ruhambaye. Uyu muhanzi akimara kuririmba iyi ndirimbo ya Sheeran yahise yemererwa na Mr Eazi ubufasha ndetse anamusinyisha mu nzu ye ifasha abahanzi ya Eazi’s "Banku" Music. Mu ndirimbo yakoze zamenyekanye harimo ‘Baby’, ‘Beginning’, ‘All of You’ n’izindi nyinshi zatumye muri iki gihe abarirwa mu bahanzi bahagaze neza muri Nigeria. Amaze gukora album imwe yise ‘Love & Light’. Joeboy aherutse gusohoka ku rutonde rwa BBC rw’abahanzi bo kwitega mu 2020. Joeboy yaje mu Rwanda abisikana n’Umuraperi Jidenna Theodore Mobisson [Jidenna] nawe wo muri Nigeria waherukaga gutaramira mu Rwanda tariki 29 Ugushyingo 2019 mu gitaramo cyitabiriwe mu buryo bukomeye cyabereye muri Kigali Conference and Exhibition Village hazwi nka Camp Kigali. Amafoto: Uwihanganye Hardy

title: Miss World yahaye ikaze Miss Nishimwe Naomie uzitabira iri rushanwa uyu mwaka
content: Babinyujije ku rukuta rwabo rwa Twitter, Ubuyobozi bwa Miss World bwagize buti” Mudufashe duhe ikaze Nishimwe Naomie mu muryango wa Miss World.” Miss Nishimwe watsindiye ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2020 yahise ahabwa itike yo guhagararira u Rwanda mu irushanwa rya Miss World rizaba riba ku nshuro ya 70. Uyu mukobwa afite umushinga wo kurwanya Kwiheba mu rubyiruko, cyane ko yasanze ari ikibazo gikomeye kandi akenshi abantu badaha agaciro. Miss Nishimwe muri Miss World azaba abaye umunyarwandakazi wa gatanu witabiriye iri rushanwa u Rwanda ruzaba rwujuje imyaka itanu rwitabira. Mutesi Jolly niwe mukobwa wa mbere witabiriye Miss World mu 2016, kuva icyo gihe u Rwanda ntirugisiba mu irushanwa. Nimwiza Meghan niwe Munyarwandakazi uherutse muri iri rushanwa ryabereye mu mujyi wa Londres mu Bwongereza mu mpera za 2019. Nta mukobwa n’umwe wari wahagararira u Rwanda ngo acyure ikamba iryo ariryo ryose nubwo bagerageza kwitwara neza.

title: Musanze: The Ben yasusurukije abitabiriye Tour du Rwanda mu gitaramo gikomeye (Video)
content: Uyu muhanzi yifashishijwe n’uruganda rwenga ibinyobwa bisembuye n’ibidasembuye rwa Skol Brewery Ltd. Mu gitaramo yakoreye i Musanze, yanyuze abakunzi be bari bamaze imyaka 10 batamuca iryera abataramira. Abanyamusanze bitabiriye iki gitaramo banyuzwe n’uburyohe bw’umuziki w’uyu muhanzi, usanzwe ukundwa cyane n’abiganjemo abakobwa kubera ibihangano bibashima ku ndiba z’imitima. Yaririmbye ibihangano bye bitandukanye byakunzwe, ageze ku yitwa ‘Imfubyi’ afatanya na Bulldogg bayikoranye, nabyo binyura benshi mu buryo bukomeye. Yaririmbye izindi zirimo ‘Soma Skol’, ‘Zoubeda’ yakoranye na Kamichi, ‘Thank You’ yakoranye na Tom Close, ‘Habibi’ n’izindi zitandukanye. The Ben ari kwifashishwa na Skol mu bitaramo bitandukanye, icya mbere yagikoreye Kimironko ku wa 23 Gashyantare, i Musanze ku wa 27 Gashyantare ndetse ategerejwe mu kindi kizabera i Kigali ku wa 29 Gashyantare 2020. Reba igitaramo cy’i Musanze uko cyari cyifashe

title: Uwase wahagarariye u Rwanda muri Miss Supranational 2018 yitabiriye irindi rushanwa rikomeye
content: Uyu mukobwa ahatanye na bagenzi 16 baturutse mu bindi bihugu bitandukanye bitabira iri rushanwa riri kubera muri Pologne ari naho Uwase yiga muri kaminuza ya Wyższa Szkoła Bankowa yigisha ibyerekeye ubukungu. Uwase yabwiye IGIHE ko umukobwa uzahiga abandi azahabwa amajwi hakurikijwe uko yitwaye imbere y’akanama nkemurampaka, intambuko, ubwiza n’ukuntu ashyigikiwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga z’irushanwa. Azahembwa amafaranga ataratangajwe umubare ndetse afotorwe bya kinyamwuga mu gihe cy’icyumweru ari mu butembere ku mucanga wa  Miami muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Aba bakobwa bageze mu cyiciro cya nyuma bari 20, batatu barasezererwa kubera kutubahiriza igihe n’imyitozo. Uwase yavuze ko yiha amahirwe n’ubwo abona bitoroshye. Yagize ati “Birakomeye ariko amahirwe  ndayiha,  n’ubwo ntakubwira umubare njanishije kuko irushanwa aba ari irushanwa.” Umunsi ny’irizina wo gutora Miss Elite 2020, ni kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki 29 Gashyantare 2020. Hazatorwa Miss Elite n’ibisonga bye bibiri. Uwase ubusanzwe ni umunyamideli ndetse yegukanye ibihembo bitandukanye birimo icya Top Model Africa cyabereye muri Zimbabwe mu 2016 anitabira World Next Top Model 2017 ryabereye mu Mujyi wa Beirut muri Liban, aza mu bakobwa bageze mu cyiciro cya nyuma. Yitabiriye amarushanwa y’ubwiza nka Miss Supranational 2018 naho ntiyahirwa kuko atigeze aza mu myanya y’imbere.

title: Senderi yahawe igihembo n’akarere ka Kirehe
content: Yabwiye IGIHE ko yahawe iki gihembo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 27 Gashyantare 2020 muri aka karere akomokamo. Ati “Naraye mpawe igihembo cy’indashyikirwa n’akarere ka Kirehe nk’umuhanzi uhavuka ugerageza gushimisha abaturage baho n’utundi turere muri gahunda z’iterambere ry’igihugu, mu kurinda ibyagezweho no kubyongera  biciye mu bihangano by’uburere mboneragihugu.” Yavuze ko indirimbo zatumye ahabwa iki gihembo zirimo iyitwa ‘Ibidakwiriye nzabivuga’, ‘Nta mpamvu n’imwe’, ‘Iyo twicaranye’, ‘Abanyarwanda twaribohoye’, ‘Tuzarinda igihugu’ na ‘Twambariye gutsinda’. Uyu muhanzi yahawe iki gihembo ku munsi wo gusoza ibyitwa ‘Open Day’ bikorwa n’abatuye muri aka karere, uyu akaba ari munsi abantu n’ibigo byigenga bakorera mu karere bose bahurira mu imurikabikorwa bakerekana ibyo bamaze kugeza ku baturage hanarebwa gahunda z’ibihe biri imbere. Senderi aherutse gushyira hanze  indirimbo zirimo iyo yise ‘Imitako ya Migongo’  na ‘Ikirashi’ yakoranye na Intore Tuyisenge . Uyu muhanzi yatangiye kuririmba mbere gato ya 1994. Umuziki we wiganjemo indirimbo zivuga kuri politiki y’iterambere ry’igihugu, isuku, kwirinda ibyorezo nka Sida na Malariya, ubukungu, urukundo, umutekano n’ibindi. Senderi kandi akunda no kwibanda ku ndirimbo zihumuriza abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 n’izamagana abahembera amacakubiri. Reba indirimbo Senderi aheruka gushyira hanze yise ‘Ikirashi’

title: Musanze: Bizihiwe n’umuziki w’abahanzi bakomeye mu gitaramo cya Tour du Rwanda (Amafoto)
content: Ni mu gitaramo cyabaye nyuma y’agace k’iri rushanwa rimaze kuba ubukombe mu magare ribera mu Rwanda, kabaye kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 27 Gashyantare 2020 aho Umunya-Colombia Restrepo Jhonatan yegukanye aka gace ka Gatanu ka Tour du Rwanda 2020 ka Rubavu-Musanze, akoresheje 2h 08’19”. Mujyi wa Musanze hari hashyushye bose biteguye kwirebera aba banyonzi, banabukereye kwirebera abahanzi batandukanye bakomeye bagombaga kubataramira kakahava muri stade Ubworoherane yo muri aka karere. Guhera saa kumi,abantu banyuranagamo basiganwa buri wese ashaka umwanya w’imbere ngo aze kwirebera umuhanzi yihebeye nta nkomyi. Iki gitaramo cyabaye nyuma y’ikindi cyabereye mu karere ka Rubavu mu Ntara y’Uburengerazuba kuri Kivu Beach iruhande rwa Serena Hotel kuwa Gatatu tariki 27 Gashyantare 2020. Cyari cyitabiriwe n’umubare munini w’abakunzi b’umuziki biganjemo  cyane urubyiruko. Abatandukanye bakomeye mu Rwanda biganjemo ababarizwa mu nzu ifasha abahanzi ya Kina Music hamwe na King James, Bulldogg, Davis D na Bruce Melodie ndetse na Rob Drabkin na S-Wrap bari baturutse muri Amerika nibo basusurukije abari bitabiriye. Saa kumi n’ebyiri zishyira saa moya ku rubyiniro habanjeho Rob Drabkin washimishije benshi mu ndirimbo ze zitandukanye biba akarusho ubwo yaririmbaga indirimbo izwi cyane mu Rwanda y’abana yitwa ‘Mbe Kanyamanza keza’. Yakurikiwe n’umuraperi S-Wrap nawe washimishije benshi mu muziki wiganjemo uwo mu njyana ya Trap. Davis D ugezweho mu ndirimbo ‘Dede’ niwe wakurikiyeho yishimirwa mu ndirimbo zitandukanye. Uyu muhanzi yahereye ku yitwa ‘Biryogo’, ‘Soso’, ‘Sexy’ asoreza kuri ‘Dede’. Nel Ngabo ubarizwa muri Kina Music niwe wakurikiye uyu muhanzi ashimisha benshi mu ndirimbo zirimo ‘Why’ iri mu zo yahereyeho, ‘Nzahinduka’, ‘Byakoroha asoreza kuri ‘Ya Motema’ yahuriyemo na P wahoze muri Dream Boyz. Bakiri ku rubyiniro P yahise asangwayo na Polisi y’u Rwanda, bakora ubukangurambaga iherutse gutangiza n’abafatanyabikorwa bayo bw’ibyumweru 52 bugamije kurwanya no gukumira impanuka buzwi nka  “Gerayo Amahoro”. Nyuma, Igor Mabano yahise ajya ku rubyiniro yishimirwa mu bihangano bye bitandukanye birimo indirimbo yise ‘Urakunzwe’ yahereyeho, ‘Back’, ‘Dear Mashuka’ yafashijwe ku rubyiniro na Rob Drabkin, ‘Iyo Utegereza’ asoreza kuri ‘Gake’ yahuriyemo na Nel Ngabo banaririmbanye muri iki gitaramo. Aba bahanzi bakurikiwe na Bulldogg wahise yanzika n’indirimbo ze zirimo ‘Nk’umusaza’, ‘Cinema’ na ‘Zana’ yahuriyemo na Deejay Lenzo banajyanye ku rubyiniro muri iki gitaramo. Bruce Melodie niwe wari utahiwe! Uyu muhanzi yishimiwe mu ndirimbo yinjiriyeho yitwa ‘Ndumiwe’, ‘Ikinya’, ‘Fresh’ asoreza kuri ‘Kungola’ yahuriyemo na Sunnny yahagurukije n’iyonka muri iki gitaramo. King James niwe washyize akadomo kuri iki gitaramo gusa atenguhwa n’umuriro kuko yatangiye kuririmba ahereye ku ndirimbo yise ‘Rasta’ yajya kuririmba izindi zirimo ‘Ganyobwe’ umuriro ukagenda ucika.. title: Umunyarwenya Kenny BlaQ witabiriye Seka Live yageze i Kigali
content: Guhera mu ntangiriro z’umwaka wa 2020 Arthur Nation isanzwe itegura ibirori bya Seka Live batangaje ko bigeye kujya biba buri kwezi. title: Tonzi yashyize hanze indirimbo nshya yise “Hejuru ya byose”
content: Iyi ndirimbo nshya ya Tonzi yumvikanamo ubutumwa bwibutsa abantu ko hejuru y’ibiba byose ku Isi haba hari Imana iba iri hejuru. Igitero cya mbere cy’iyi ndirimbo Tonzi agira ati“Hejuru y’ibyo twibaza tudafitiye ibisubizo, aho ubwenge ubuhangange n’imbaraga birangirira, ibyo twibwira ko twashoboye turasanga twarabishobojwe n’Imana umugenga wa byose uri hejuru y’ibituvuna, hejuru y’ibihe bihinduka”. Iyi ndirimbo mu buryo bw’amajwi yakozwe inatunganywa na Camarade mu gihe amashusho yayo yo yafashwe akanatunganywa na Eliel Sando. Tonzi ni umuhanzikazi ukunze guhamya ko yakuranye impano yo kuririmba aho yatangiye kuririmba akiri umwana muto cyane bagomba  kuhagarika ku meza kugira ngo abantu bamubone. Impano yaje kwaguka ajya mu makorali atandukanye, mu mwaka wa 2004 atangira umuziki ku giti cye. Ni umwe mu bahanzi b’igitsinagore baririmba indirimbo zihimbaza Imana umaze kwagura umwuga we mu buryo bukomeye.

title: Uko Mr Eazi yabereye ikiraro Joeboy ugiye gutaramira mu Rwanda
content: Uyu musore yabitangaje mu kiganiro n’itangazamakuru gitegura igitaramo cya Kigali Jazz Junction kizaba kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 28 Gashyantare 2020, aho azahuriramo na Davis D ndetse na Niyo Bosco uri mu bahanzi bagezweho muri iki gihe. Joeboy yabajijwe uko yahuye n’umuhanzi Oluwatosin Ajibade [Mr Eazi] usanzwe afite inzu ifasha abahanzi ya emPawa Africa, ari nayo yazamuye Joeboy ugezweho muri iki gihe. Mu gusubiza Joeboy yavuze ko yahuye na Mr Eazi mu buryo butangaje, ati “Nigaga muri kaminuza ya Lagos [UNILAG], nakoraga umuziki wo kwishimisha. Igihe kimwe nashyize amashusho ndi kuririmba ku rubuga rwa Instagram arayibona tuza kumenyana kubera impano yari yambonanye atangira kumfasha atyo.” Yavuze ko afata Mr Eazi nk’umuntu washyize itafari ku muziki we ndetse by’umwihariko akishimira kuba aba muri iyi nzu ye ifasha abahanzi. Iki gitaramo ategerejwemo giteganyijwe ku wa 28 Gashyantare 2020. Joeboy yatowe n’abakurikira urubuga rwa Twitter rw’abakunzi ba Kigali Jazz Junction ku majwi 66.2% ahigitse Innos B wo muri RDC wakoranye indirimbo na Diamond Platnumz ndetse n’Umunya-Kenya Stella Mwangi. Joeboy ni umwe mu bahanzi bagezweho cyane muri Afurika muri iki gihe ndetse mu banyabirori bo muri Kigali baramuzi cyane kuko indirimbo ze zidasiba gucurangwa mu tubyiniro dutandukanye yaba muri Kigali no hanze yayo. Indirimbo ze zamamaye cyane mu 2019. Aririmba cyane Afro Pop na R&B. Uyu musore w’imyaka 22, yavutse ku wa 21 Gicurasi 1997 mu Mujyi wa Lagos muri Nigeria, akaba ari umwanditsi n’umuririmbyi. Abarizwa mu nzu ifasha abahanzi ya emPawa Africa. Yize muri Kaminuza ya Lagos izwi nka UNILAG aho yakuye impamyabumenyi mu bijyanye n’imicungire y’abakozi. Joeboy yatangiye kuririmba ubwo yari afite imyaka 16. Ku myaka 17 akora indirimbo ye ya mbere yise ‘Gbeseyin’. Yasubiyemo ‘Shape of You’ ya Ed Sheeran yakirwa neza ndetse inatumbagiza izina rye ku rwego ruhambaye. Uyu muhanzi akimara kuririmba iyi ndirimbo ya Sheeran yahise yemererwa na Mr Eazi ubufasha ndetse anamusinyisha mu nzu ye ifasha abahanzi. Mu ndirimbo yakoze zamenyekanye harimo ‘Baby’, ‘Beginning’, ‘All of You’ n’izindi nyinshi zatumye muri iki gihe abarirwa mu bahanzi bahagaze neza muri Nigeria. Amaze gukora album imwe yise ‘Love & Light’. Joeboy aherutse gusohoka ku rutonde rwa BBC rw’abahanzi bo kwitega mu 2020. Nadege Gaju ushinzwe iyamamazabikorwa muri Volkswagen yavuze ko muri iki gitaramo buri muntu uzakitabira akoresheje Move Ride azagabanyirizwa 10% y’amafaranga y’urugendo. Kugira ngo ubashe gukora ingendo mu modoka zitandukanye za Volkswagen zirimo Polo, Passat na Teramont bigusaba kubanza gushyira muri telefoni yawe yaba ikoresha Android cyangwa iOS, ‘application’ ya ‘Move’. Usabwa kubanza gufungura konti ukoresheje e-mail cyangwa nimero yawe ya telefoni (Sign up), ubundi gahita winjiramo (Log in). Mbere y’iki gitaramo uyu muhanzi arahura n’abantu banasangire mu mugoba bise "Meet and Greet" kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 27 Gashyantare 2020 kuri Marriott Hotel ahaba hacurangira itsinda rya Nep Djs kwinjira bikaza kuba ari ubuntu kuri buri wese ubyifuza. Ni umugoroba wahura n’uyu muhanzi mukifotozanya mukanasangira mbere yuko igitaramo nyiri izina kiba.

title: Itorero New Life Bible Church ryateguye igiterane cyizitabirwa n’abashumba bakomeye muri Afurika
content: Ni igiterane kiba gikubiyemo inyigisho zo guhemburwa k’umugabane wa Afurika ndetse no kuramya Imana kugira ngo habeho ubutumwa bw’impemburo. Muri 2020, iki giterane giteganyijwe kubera kuri New Life Bible church guhera tariki ya 8 kugeza ku itariki ya 15 Gashyantare 2020. Mu kiganiro yagiranye n’itangazamakuru kuri uyu wa Kabiri, Rev Dr Charles Mugisha Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Africa New Life Ministries na New Life Bible Church yavuze ko igiterane cy’uyu mwaka gifite umwihariko w’uko abantu bazahabwa inyigisho z’impemburo hagamijwe kugira umutwaro wo guhembura Afurika. Yavuze ko hazabaho ibihe byihariye byo kuramya Imana byimbitse hifashishijwe  abaramyi biteguye kandi bagiye kujya mu mwiherero ari nako barushaho gusenga kugira ngo hazabeho guhembuka byuzuye binyuze mu kuramya Imana. Uyu mushumba kandi yavuze ko hatumiwe abakozi b’Imana batandukanye barimo Pasiteri  Lincoln Serwaga ukorera ivugabutumwa mu Bwongereza uyu akaba ari mu bashumba bakomeye ndetse bajyanye ivugabutumwa ku byanyafurika bari muri diaspora. Hari kandi abandi bavugabutumwa barimo Pasiteri James Kato,Pasiteri Chris Rue,Pasiteri Jide Laore,Pasiteri Ryan Holladay,ndetse na Pasiteri Charles Mugisha ari na we uzakira aba bakozi b’Imana. Refresh Africa Conference ni igiterane kimaze imyaka itanu kiba, nkuko bitangazwa n’ubuyobozi bukaba buvuga ko cyahembuye imitimba ya benshi muri iyo myaka yose yewe ngo hari n’ubuhamya butandukanye bugaragaza ko hari n’abakize indwara.

title: James na Daniella n’abo bazafatanya bahishuye aho bageze imyiteguro y’igitaramo “Mpa Amavuta Live Concert”
content: Kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 26 Gashyantare 2020 ahazabera iki gitaramo habereye ikiganiro n’abanyamakuru bari kumwe na bamwe mu bahanzi bazabafasha barimo; Kavutse Olivier, Maya Fabrice, Papi Clever, Ben Serugo na Nkomezi Prosper. Aba bahanzi bose bijeje abanyamakuru kuzakorera abakunzi babo igitaramo cy’amateka. James asubiza umunyamakuru wari umubajije niba atari igitaramo cy’abashakanye gusa yagize ati ”Kuba abakundana ari bo bazacyitabira ni agace gato, ni igitaramo cyo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana, nutarubatse agomba kuzaza kwiga kuko kizanamurikirwamo album ibyo byose bireba n’abatubatse.” James yavuze ko iki gitaramo kizatangira saa cyenda z’amanywa aho imiryango izaba ifunguye saa munani z’amanywa, saa munani n’igice kugeza saa cyenda bazaba bari gusenga, saa cyenda umuhanzi wa mbere azaba ageze ku rubyiniro kuko igitaramo kizarangira saa moya z’umugoroba. Maya Fabrice mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru yashimiye Imana ko igitaramo cya mbere cya James na Daniella kigiye kubera muri Kigali Arena. Ari James na Daniella cyangwa abahanzi bazafatanya bavuze ko imyiteguro y’iki gitaramo bayigeze ku musozo ku buryo biteguye kuzashimisha abazitabira iki gitaramo. James na Daniella bafite igikundiro cyo ku gasongero mu bihebeye ibihangano byo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana, bateguye igitaramo gikomeye bahurijemo couple z’abaramyi zikunzwe mu gihugu. Iki gitaramo cyiswe “Mpa Amavuta Live Concert” gitegerejwe kubera muri Kigali Arena ku wa 1 Werurwe 2020. James na Daniella bagiteguye bagamije kumurika album yabo ya mbere bise “Mpa Amavuta’’ izaba iriho indirimbo umunani. Cyatumiwemo abahanzi bakomeye barimo andi ma-couple azwi cyane mu muziki wo kuramya Imana arimo iya Ben na Chance; Tuyizere Papi Clever na Ingabire Dorcas; Maya na Fabrice na Amanda Fung na Kavutse Olivier babarizwa muri Beauty for Ashes. Abazacyitabira kandi bazataramirwa n’abahanzi barimo Prosper Nkomezi uri mu bafite igikundiro, René Patrick, Ndayisenga Esron wamamaye muri True Promises na Gaby Kamanzi. Couple ya James Rugarama na Daniella Mukiza ifitanye abana babiri. Ni imwe mu zakoze umuziki ukabasha kugera ku kigero nk’icyo uyu munsi bariho. Bavuga ko kuba indirimbo zabo ziri kwamamara cyane mu buryo bwihuse ari ubushake bw’Imana n’amasengesho yabo adasiba. Mu minsi ishize babwiye IGIHE ko babanye igihe kinini babitsanya amabanga, nyuma bafata umwanzuro wo kugirana umubano w’urukundo no kuririmbana nka Couple. Ni ku nshuro ya mbere James na Daniella bagiye gukorera igitaramo mu Rwanda, gusa si cyo cya mbere bakoze kuva batangiye umuziki kuko hari icyo bakoreye muri Uganda mu mpera za 2017. Kwinjira muri “Mpa Amavuta Live Concert” ku bazagura amatike mbere ni 3 000 Frw, 15 000 Frw na 30 000 Frw ku bazagura amatike mbere mu gihe abazayagurira ku muryango bizaba ari 5 000 Frw, 10 000 Frw na 20 000 Frw.

title: Yvan Buravan yasabye RIB gukurikirana umutekamutwe wamwiyitiriye uri kwiba abantu

title: TMC yerekeje muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika
content: Kuva mu minsi ishize umwuka wagiye uba mubi mu itsinda rya Dream Boys, abakurikiranira hafi iby’umuziki bagahamya ko iri tsinda riri mu marembera. Uyu mwuka wazamutse ubwo TMC yari amaze kumurika igitabo cy’ubushakashatsi yari yarakoze arangiza icyiciro cya gatatu cya Kaminuza. Iki gihe mu kiganiro na IGIHE yavuze ko yifuza gukomeza amasomo ye ariko byaba byiza akiga hanze y’u Rwanda. Nyuma y’aya magambo abantu banyuranye batangiye kubona ko abagize Dream Boys badahuje intego ndetse bitizwa umurindi nuko nyuma buri wese muri iri tsinda yatangiye kwikorana umuziki ku giti cye. Platini yahinduye izina yitwa P uyu akaba yarasohoye indirimbo zinyuranye wenyine atari kumwe na TMC mu gihe n’undi nawe hari izo yakoze wenyine. Muri iyi minsi Platini ari kugaragara wenyine mu kazi ka Tour du Rwanda aho ari gukorana na CANAL+ benshi bari batangiye kwibaza igihatse ibi byose.  Kugeza ubu TMC  yamaze kwerekeza muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, hakaba hari n’amakuru ahamya ko uyu muhanzi atazagaruka mu Rwanda ukundi ahubwo agiye gushaka uko yakomerezayo amasomo ye. Icyakora ubwo yahagurukaga i Kanombe TMC yagiranye ikiganiro kigufi na IGIHE ashimangira ko agiye muri Amerika ariko atagiye burundu. Uyu muhanzi yagize ati” Ngiye muri Amerika muri gahunda zanjye, mugenzi wanjye Platini arabizi yewe ntanikibazo na kimwe gihari.” Yakomeje agira ati” Gahunda zanjye nizirangira nzagaruka kandi si cyera, wenda bizanafata icyumweru kimwe.” Gusa nubwo TMC avuga ko atagiye guhera muri Amerika ku mbuga nkoranyambaga benshi siko babifata bitewe nuko umwuka wari uhagaze mu itsinda. Dream Boys ni itsinda ry’umuziki rigizwe n’abasore babiri aribo Mujyanama Claude uzwi nka TMC ndetse na Nemeye Platini wamenyekanye nka Platini. Aba basore bamaze imyaka irenga icumi bakorana umuziki bakunzwe mu ndirimbo zinyuranye cyane ko bafite album zirenga esheshatu zose zamaze gusohoka ndetse bamurikiye abakunzi babo. title: Niyo Bosco yashimiye Adrien Misigaro wamufashije gukora indirimbo “Ibanga”
content: Uyu muhanzi ukomeje kwigarurira imitima ya benshi mu kiganiro na IGIHE yagize ati” Ndashimira Adrien Misigaro, ku bufasha yampaye mu ikorwa ry’iyi ndirimbo yaramfashije ndamushimira cyane.” Uyu muhanzi ntabwo nyigeze atangaza ubwoko bw’impano Misigaro yamuhaye. Ati” Ndabasaba ko bakumva ibihangano byanjye bagakunda impano yanjye ntibankundire ibindi cyangwa ngo bumve ko bankunze kubera impuhwe z’ikibazo mfite.” Adrien Misigaro washimiwe cyane na Niyo Bosco ni umuhanzi w’indirimbo zo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana utuye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Indirimbo “Ibanga” ya Niyo Bosco ikubiyemo ubutumwa bukangurira abantu kugira ibanga, agaragazamo ingaruka zikunze kuba ku bantu batarigira. Mu nyikirizo y’iyi ndirimbo uyu muhanzi agira ati”Ibanga ni igihamya cyemeza ko uri umwizerwa, kugira ibanga nibyo bishimangira ubupfura bwawe. Uko waba uri kose utagira ibanga amagambo uvugwa niyo menshi kurusha ayo avuga! Jya uvuga uziga […].” Niyokwizerwa Bosco wamenyekanye nka Niyo Bosco ni umusore w’imyaka 20 y’amavuko ukora umuziki ariko afite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Iyi ndirimbo ye nshya mu buryo w’amajwi yakorewe muri Uno Record ikorwa na Producer witwa Santana mu gihe amashusho yayo yafashwe akanatunganywa na Bagenzi Bernard uri mu bagezweho muri iyi minsi. Ikiganiro na Niyo Bosco washimiye bikomeye Adrien Misigaro wamufashije mu ndirimbo "Ibanga" Indirimbo "Ibanga" Niyo Bosco aherutse gushyira hanze

title: Miss Nishimwe Naomie yasubije abamwibasiye kubera amanota yagize mu kizamini cya Leta
content: Uyu mukobwa yatorewe kuba Nyampinga w’u Rwanda mu mpera z’icyumweru gishize yambikwa ikamba mu birori byabereye mu Intare Conference Arena, asimbura Nimwiza Meghan. Impamvu yo kwibasira uyu mukobwa ni uko ubusanzwe byari bimaze kumenyerwa ko benshi muri ba Nyampinga b’u Rwanda batsindaga ibizamini bya leta ku manota yo hejuru, ariko we yagize 13 mu Mibare, Ubukungu n’Ubumenyi bw’Isi. Mu kiganiro Amahumbezi kuri Radiyo Rwanda, Nishimwe Naomie yabajijwe icyo avuga ku bantu bamunenze ko yagize amanota make mu kizamini cya leta. Ati “Ntabwo ushobora kubuza abantu kuvuga, hari n’igihe wakora ibyiza n’ubundi bakavuga. Njye rero ubu ndi kureba ibikorwa byanjye nta kindi nitayeho […] biriya ni ahahise hanjye ubu ndi kubaho by’aka kanya, ndi kureba ubuzima ndi kubaho aka kanya.” Abajijwe uko yakiriye amanota yagize, Nishimwe yavuze ko nawe atashimishijwe n’uko yitwaye mu bizamini bya leta gusa ko yabikoze nyuma y’igihe ahuye n’uburwayi bukomeye ku buryo ashimira Imana kuba akiriho.  Ati “Uko mwabibonye nanjye niko nabibonye, sinishimiye amanota nagize, si impamvu ngiye gutanga ariko ubuyobozi bw’ikigo cyanjye burabizi. Umwaka nakozemo ikizamini ni umwaka narwayemo cyane nubwo ariko na none ntabigira impamvu. Byibuza ndashima Imana ko nkiriho.” Nishimwe Naomie yigaga muri Glory Secondary School, yarangije mu mwaka wa 2019 mu ishami rya MEG. Uyu mukobwa wegukanye ikamba rya Miss Rwanda mu 2020 muri uyu mwaka wa 2020 yari yiyamamarije mu Mujyi wa Kigali agaragaza umushinga wo kurwanya ukwigunga mu banyarwanda. Ubuzima bwa Miss Nishimwe Naomie ku ishuri aho yigaga

title: Senderi Hit na Intore Tuyisenge basohoye indirimbo bakoze mu rurimi rw’Ikirashi
content: Iyi ndirimbo bayisohoye kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 21Gashyantare 2020 ubwo hizihizwaga umunsi mpuzamahanga w’ururimi kavukire. Uyu munsi ukaba warizihirijwe mu Karere ka Kirehe ahahawe umwanya ururimi shami rw’ikinyarwanda rukoreshwa na bamwe mu baturage bo mu Karere ka Kirehe ruzwi nk’Ikirashi. Abaturage bakoresha uru rurimi bahawe umwanya baganira banabyina imbyino zitandukanye ziririmbwe muri uru rurimi rw’ururashi. Abaturage bahimbawe cyane nyuma yo kumva ko abahanzi babiri bakomoka muri aka Karere babakoreye indirimbo bise Ikirashi aho bafatanyije nabo mu kuyibyina. Senderi yavuze ko iyi ndirimbo bayikoze bagira ngo bashimire leta ku iterambere imaze kugeza ku baturage bavuga ikirashi. Yagize ati “Mbere 1994 abaturage bavuga Ikirashi bari babayeho nabi bamwe barwaye imvunja ibirenge bikitambika none ubu batujwe mu midugudu bahabwa agaciro ntabwo bakibayeho nka mbere.” Yongeyeho ati “Ikindi twayikoze kubera uyu munsi mpuzamahanga w’ururimi kavukire kugira ngo abantu bareke kwibagirwa indimi zacu gakondo.” Yavuze ko gufata amafaranga yabo bakayasohoramo indirimbo ari ukugira ngo bakomeze guteza imbere uru rurimi kugira ngo rwoye kuzima ahubwo abantu bakomeze baruvuge. Intore Tuyisenge we yavuze ko bakimara kumenya ko uyu munsi mpuzamahanga uzizihirizwa mu Karere ka Kirehe barebye umusanzu batanga bagasanga bakwiye gukora indirimbo ishishikariza abantu gukomeza kwibuka ururimi rw’Ikirashi. Ati “Iyo ururimi rutabungabunzwe rurazimira, njye na Senderi twahisemo rero gukora iyi ndirimbo kugira ngo turusigasire. Iyo tuvuze Ikirashi bimfasha kwibuka abakurambere bacu muri aka Karere tuvukamo kuko nirwo bavugaga nubwo twe tutagize amahirwe yo kurumenya neza.” Tuyisenge yavuze ko bagiye kongera imbaraga mu kurusakaza kugira ngo rumenyekane cyane. Yavuze ko kuri ubu inyinshi mu ndirimbo ze azajya agerageza agashyiramo amagambo make y’ururimi rw’Ikirashi. Abakuze bakoresha ururimi rw’Ikirashi bafite agahinda baterwa nuko abato batagishaka kurumenya ngo kuko ku ishuri batarukoresha bakibaza uburyo nibasaza ruzakendera bikabababaza. IGIHE yaganiriye na bamwe mu barukoresha batubwira amagambo amwe namwe n’ibisobanuro byayo mu Kinyarwanda. Gusuhuzanya mu Kirashi iyo ari mu gitondo bakoresha ‘Murayire ge, haba hacyeye bagakoresha ‘Aganda’ cyangwa ‘Musibire ge’ kubwira umuntu uti “Amakuru ki uvuga Agandi shi, Mwiriwe mute bavuga Mwasiba kurungi. Iyo ushaka kubwira umuntu uti uvuye he bakoresha Waruga hi, muryoherwe ni Munuriwe. Ibice by’umubiri nk’izuru ryitwa Enyindo, ukutwi ni ugutwi, irisho ni ijisho, urutoki rw’insina ni Engemu, amasaka yitwa umugusha, amashaza akitwa ubushaza, ibishyimbo byitwa ibiharage, ibitoki ni ibitiki ihene ni Embuzi, inka ni Ente.

title: Young Grace yavuze impamvu yabatirishije umwana we muri Kiliziya Gatolika kandi asengera mu rindi dini
content: Ku Cyumweru tariki 23 Gashyantare 2020 nibwo Young Grace yabatirishije umwana we Amata Anca Ae’eedah Ai ‘Diamante’ muri Kiliziya Gatolika mu Karere ka Rubavu. Uku kubatirisha uyu mwana muri Kiliziya Gatolika kwa Young Grace kwateye urujijo abasanzwe bakurikirana uyu muhanzikazi cyane ko asanzwe ari umukirisitu usengera mu itorero riyoborwa n’umushumba Sultan Eric. Ibi bigaragazwa n’uko mu Ukwakira 2019 uyu muhanzikazi yari yagiye guhesha umugisha umwana we mu itorero asengeramo. Mu kiganiro na Young Grace yabwiye IGIHE ko we yahisemo kubatirisha umwana we muri Kiliziya Gatolika  kuko nawe ariho yaherewe amasakaramentu. Ati "Namubatirishije muri Kiliziya Gatolika kuko mu rugo bose ni abakirisitu bo muri kiliziya kandi nanjye ndi umugatolika, muri “River of Joy and Hope Ministries” nsengerayo kuko ahantu hose bavuga Imana bemera Yezu nahasengera ariko ndi umugatolika wemewe.” Mu Ukwakira 2012 Young Grace yari yinjiye muri Islam, ahita ahabwa izina rya Housna. Icyo gihe yatangaje ko yinjiye muri Islam nyuma y’inyigisho yahawe na bamwe mu nshuti ze bo muri iri dini akumva ziramunyuze akemera guhinduka. Guhera mu 2016 uyu muraperikazi yaje kuva muri Islam ajya muri “River of Joy and Hope Ministries”.

title: Miss Akacu Lynca yambitswe impeta n’umusore bamaze igihe bakundana
content: Mu mpera z’icyumweru cyashize nibwo umusore witwa Guy Alain uririmba indirimbo zo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana yafashe icyemezo cyo kwambika impeta Miss Akacu Lynca amusaba ko yazamubera umugore. Abinyujije kuri Instagram ye Guy Alain yagize ati ”Byabaye, nateye ivi musaba ko twakomezanya urugendo arabyemera! Niba muzi Lynca muzi uburyo ndi umusore w’umunyamugisha, niba munzi muzi ukuntu ndi umunyamugisha kugira Lynca, niba mutuzi twese, muzi uburyo ndi umunyamugisha kubana na Lynca muri ubu buzima. Ndagukunda Lynca.” Guy Alain ni umwe mu bagize itsinda rya muzika riririmba indirimbo zo kuramya no guhimbaza “Alive and Freed”, amaze imyaka hafi ine bimenyekanye ko akundana na Miss Akacu Lynca. Miss Akacu Lynca ufite imyaka 23, yabaye igisonga cya kabiri cya Miss Rwanda akurikiye Uwase Vanessa Raïssa wabaye igisonga cya mbere. Bombi bari bagaragiye Kundwa Doriane watowe nka Nyampinga w’u Rwanda mu 2015.

title: USA: Harvey Weinstein wamamaye mu gutunganya filimi yahamijwe ibyaha byo gufata ku ngufu
content: Urukiko rukuru rwo muri Leta ya New York rwamuhamije icyaha cyo mu rwego rwa mbere cyo guhatira imibonano yo mu kanwa, Miriam Harey wari  umwungirije mu bijyanye no gutunganya filimi mu 2006. Ni icyaha gihanishwa igihano kuva ku myaka itanu kugeza kuri 25 y’igifungo. Hari ikindi cyaha yahamijwe cy’umugore yafatiye muri Hotel y’i New York mu 2013 gihanishwa igihano kitari munsi y’imyaka ine. Icyakora Weinstein w’imyaka 67 y’amavuko yahanaguweho ibindi byaha bitatu birimo bibiri bikomeye byo mu rwego rwa mbere byashoboraga gutuma afungwa burundu. Nyuma y’urubanza uwo mugabo yasubijwe mu buroko gufungwa by’agateganyo mu gihe ategereje isomwa ry’urubanza ku Itariki 11 Werurwe 2020. Aracyakurikiranyweho ibyaha by’abagore babiri bo muri leta ya  Los Angeles yafashe ku ngufu mu 2013. Abagore barenga 80 barimo ibyamamare mu gukina filimi n’abana bamusabaga ubufasha ngo abagire ibyamamare bashinja uyu mugabo kubakorera ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina. Gukurikiranwa k’uyu mugabo byatijwe umurindi n’ubukangurambaga bwiswe MeToo bukangurira abagore kujyana mu butabera abagabo bakomeye bitwaza icyo bari cyo bagahohotera abagore. Weinstein yamenyakanye cyane muri filimi yiswe Pulp Fiction yo mu 1994 ivuga ku byaha by’ubujura, iyitwa The English Patient yo mu 1996 na Shakespeare in Love 1998 zombi zivuga ku rukundo. Haleyi, wakoraga kuri imwe mu mateleviziyo Weinstein yavuze ko yamuhohoteye ubwo yamutumiraga mu nzu ye iri Manhattan. Yatanze ubuhamya avuga ko yamujyanye ku buriri akamwikubaho. Ni mu gihe Mann yavuze ko yamusuzuguraga cyane mu mubano wabo utarimo imibonano mpuzabitsina kugeza ubwo amufashe ku ngufu mu 2013. Michelle Simpson Tuegel uhagarariye abahohotewe, mu rukiko yavuze ko yizeye ko n’abandi bagore barakomeza kuzana abakora ihohotera rishingiye ku gitsina mu nkiko. Ati "Imbaraga umuntu yaba afite zose turi mu bihe bishya. igihe cya #MeToo kije gutamaza abakoresha imbaraga bafite mu guhohotera abagore." Miriam Haley ubu ufite imyaka 42 y’amavuko avuga ko yahohotewe na Harvey ytwaje  kumufasha kuguma mu kazi ke ko kumwungiriza. Yamufashe ku ngufu ku itariki 10 Nyakanga 2006.

title: Riderman, Social Mula na Marina basusurukije abitabiriye igitaramo bakoreye mu Bubiligi (Amafoto)
content: Aba bahanzi bacurangirwaga na DJ Princess Flor wavanze indirimbo mu buhanga asanzwe azwiho, afatanyije na Dj Toxxyk wari waturutse i Kigali. Social Mula niwe wabanje ku rubyiniro, akurikirwa na Marina hasoza Riderman basusurukije abantu bakabakaba igihumbi bari bitabiriye iki gitaramo biganjemo urubyiruko rwari rwaturutse mu gihugu cy’Ububiligi n’ibindi bituranye. Iki gitaramo cyatewe inkunga na RwandAir, inafite ibiro i Bruxelles mu Bubiligi aho ikorera ingendo eshatu mu cyumweru, Kigali-Bruxelles, Bruxelles-Kigali, kuwa Kabiri, kuwa Kane no kuwa Gatandatu. RwandAir yakoresheje tombola y’itike y’indege yo gutembera mu bice 29 iyi kompanyi ikoreramo ingendo, yegukanywe na Teta Armella. Gutera inkunga iki gitaramo kwa RwandAir, ni imwe mu nzira yo kwereka Abanyarwanda batuye i Burayi ibyiza by’iterambere ry’u Rwanda by’umwihariko iyi sosiyete ikora ubwikorezi bwo mu kirere. Iki gitaramo cyateguwe na Team Production imenyereye gutegura ibitaramo no guha umwanya abahanzi b’Abanyarwanda n’abandi banyafurika baturuka hirya no hino, ngo bagaragaze injyana y’iwabo, itewe inkunga na RwandAir. Iki gitaramo cyabereye ahitwa Birmingham Place, 112 Rue de Birmingham Straat, 1070 Anderlecht ku wa 22 Gashyantare 2020, cyatangiye guhera saa mbiri z’umugoroba kigeza mu gitondo. Amafoto: Jessica Rutayisire

title: U Butaliyani: Umuntu wa karindwi yishwe na Coronavirus
content: Ubuyobozi bw’u Butaliyani bwatangaje kuri uyu wa Mbere ko bwahagaritse amashuri, za kaminuza, inzu ndangamurage n’ibindi bikorwa bihuriza abantu hamwe nk’imikino y’umupira w’amaguru n’ibikorwa ndangamuco. Ibiro ntaramakuru by’u Butaliyani, Ansa byatangaje ko umuntu wa karindwi yazize iyi ndwara, ikomeje kwibasira u Butaliyani bw’amajyaruguru. Byatangajwe ko umuntu witabye Imana ari umugabo w’imyaka 80, wajyanwe mu bitaro mu cyumweru gishize mu mujyi wa Lodi, kubera indwara y’umutima nk’uko Reuters yabitangaje. Abaganga bavuga ko ashobora kuba yarandujwe Coronavirus n’undi murwayi. Umubare w’abarimo guhitanwa n’iyi ndwara ukomeje kwiyongera, mu gihe umuntu wa mbere wahitanwe na Cornavirus mu Butaliyani yapfuye ku wa Gatanu. Abayobozi bavuga ko mu Bushinwa abantu bamaze kwandura ari 77 269 naho abanduye hanze yabwo ni 2 271. Abamaze guhitanbwa nayo ni 2 596, barimo 33 bamaze kugwa mu mahanga. Kugeza ubu abantu bamaze gukira ni 24 854.

title: Itorero ry’igihugu Urukerereza ryakiriye abanyempano 100 bashya
content: Ijonjora ry’abanyempano ijana bazajya mu mwiherero w’Itorero Urukerereza ryabaye kuri iki Cyumweru i Kabuga aho bari bamaze iminsi mu mwiherero. Bitunguranye umusaza w’imyaka 51 witwa Ntahontuye Jean Marie wo mu Murenge wa Cyumba mu karere ka Gicumbi ucuranga umuduri, yagaragaye mu bahataniraga kwinjira mu itorero ry’igihugu Urukerereza ndetse birangira anatsinze. Mu itorero ry’Igihugu Urukerereza bashakaga abanyempano mu byiciro bitanu aribyo abakaraza, intore, abaririmbyi, abacurangisha ibikoresho gakondo n’imbyino z’abakobwa. Aba banyempano 100 binjiye mu itorero ry’igihugu Urukerereza bari mu mwiherero w’iminsi itanu ugamije kubafasha gusobanukirwa icyerekezo cy’Itorero binjiyemo n’icy’Igihugu muri rusange, ukazasozwa ku wa Gatatu tariki 26 Gashyantare 2020. Kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki 24 Gashyantare 2020 bari kumwe na Mutangana Steven uyobora ishami ry’Umuco muri Minisiteri y’Urubyiruko n’Umuco, basuye Urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ku Gisozi, banasura Ingoro y’amateka y’urugamba rwo guhagarika Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.

title: Ibidasanzwe byaranze Miss Nishimwe Naomie ubwo yigaga mu mashuri yisumbuye
content: Nyuma yuko hamenyekanye Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2020, twifuje kumenya uyu mukobwa guhera mu bwana maze biba ngombwa ko tujya ku ishuri aho yarangirije amashuri yisumbuye tugirana ikiganiro n’ubuyobozi bw’ikigo ndetse n’abanyeshuri babanye nawe. Sibomana Alphonse, umuyobozi w’ishuri rya Glory Secondary School aho Nishimwe Naomie yize kuva mu wa kabiri w’amashuri yisumbuye kugeza arangije muri MEG (Maths-Economics-Geography)  mu mwaka wa 2019, yabwiye IGIHE ko batatunguwe nuko uyu mukobwa yegukanye ikamba rya Miss Rwanda cyane ko ari umukobwa mwiza, uzi ubwenge kandi w’intangarugero mu myitwarire. Yavuze ko Nishimwe ari umukobwa uzi kuvugira mu ruhame, bikaba imwe mu ndangagaciro zigishwa abanyeshuri babo kugira ngo bazagire icyo bigezaho mu buzima. Yagize ati”Twe tugira Ministeri zitandukanye, harimo iy’umuco na siporo kenshi rero bakunda kugira amarushanwa y’abanyempano atuma abana bitinyuka bakagaragaza impano zabo, ishinzwe gutegura abanyeshuri kuzavamo abayobozi beza b’ejo hazaza iyi ikaba urebye ifasha abanyeshuri gutinyuka kuvugira mu ruhame,  n’izindi. ” Uyu muyobozi yavuze ko ubumenyi Nishimwe Naomie yakuye muri iri shuri aribwo bwamufashije no mu rugendo rwe rwo kuba  Nyampinga w’u Rwanda. Sibomana yabwiye IGIHE ko uyu mukobwa ubusanzwe imico ye yari nta makemwa ku ishuri cyane ko nta kosa yari yagafatiwemo iryo ariryo ryose ryari gutuma yatumwa nk’umubyeyi cyangwa akirukanwa. Ati “Naomie yize hano kuva mu wa kabiri w’amashuri yisumbuye kugeza arangije, yari umukobwa uzwiho gusetsa cyane,  nta makosa yakunze kumuranga mu buzima bwe bwo ku ishuri.” Yavuze ko uyu mukobwa yari afite imyitwarire myiza ku buryo abarezi n’abanyeshuri bagenzi be babimukundiraga ndetse byatumye banamuba hafi mu rugendo rwe rwo kwiyamamariza kuba Nyampinga w’u Rwanda. Mu bijyanye n’amasomo,  umuyobozi w’iri shuri yavuze ko uyu mukobwa yatsindaga neza, ati” Dufite amanota tugenderaho twimura abanyeshuri, Naomie ntiyigeze asibira n’umunsi wa rimwe, urumva ko yatsindaga.” Umuyobozi w’ikigo Nishimwe Naomie yizeho yavuze ko bakimenya ko uyu mwana ari muri Miss Rwanda bakanguriye abanyeshuri kumushyigikira yaba mu buryo bwo kumutora ndetse n’ubundi bwose bushoboka. Isheja Ricky Junior uhagarariye abandi banyeshuri muri Glory Secondary School yabwiye IGIHE ko uyu mukobwa yari umuntu usetsa kandi uzi kubana n’abantu ku buryo ari umwe mu bari bishimiwe cyane mu kigo. Ati “Nishimwe Naomie yari umukobwa ukunda gusetsa cyane, nimwiza cyane twamufataga nk’uwa mbere mu burang. Nibyadutunguye kuba yabaye Miss Rwanda.” Umukundwa Keilla bucura bwo kwa Nishimwe Naomie na we wiga muri iki kigo mukuru we yanyuzemo,  yabwiye IGIHE ko bishimiye cyane iyi ntsinzi. Umukundwa wiga mu wa kane HEG (History-Economics -Geography)  yavuze ko yaba mu rugo ndetse no ku ishuri bishimiye gutsinda kwa mukuru we wegukanye ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2020. Ku ishuri yigagaho Nishimwe Naomie azwi nk’umukobwa w’uburanga ariko usetsa cyane ku buryo abanyeshuri hafi ya bose bari bamuzi. Nishimwe Naomie si we wa mbere wegukanye ikamba rya Miss Rwanda avuye muri iki kigo cya Glory Secondary School cyane ko mu 2015 havuye na Kundwa Doriane. Usibye aba bakobwa begukanye ikamba rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda ariko iki kigo kibitse andi Makamba nk’irya Lynca Akacu wabaye igisonga cya kabiri cya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda mu mwaka wa 2015. Aha hize kandi Marie d’Amour Uwase Rangira wabaye igisonga cya gatatu cya Miss Rwanda 2016, Ndahiro Liliane wabaye Miss Congeneniality 2018 na Gaju Anitha witabiriye Miss Rwanda 2019.

title: Miss Uwimana w’i Burundi yatunguwe n’ibirori bya Miss Rwanda abigereranya na Miss Universe
content: Ku wa Gatandatu tariki 22 Gashyantare 2020 nibwo habaye ibirori byo gutora Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2020 ikamba ryambitswe Nishimwe Naomie imbere y’abafana benshi. Ibi birori byari byitabiriwe n’abakobwa bafite amakamba y’ubwiza mu bihugu bitandukanye bifuje kwitabira Miss Rwanda ndetse banayikurikiranye imbonankubone. Uwimana Dative Miss University Africa 2019 wari waturutse i Burundi mu kiganiro na IGIHE yagize ati ”Ibirori byari bimeze neza, urwego abategura irushanwa bagezeho ni ibintu byiza cyane, ni ikintu cyantangaje wagira ngo ni Miss Universe.” Uyu mukobwa icyakora nubwo yashimye urwego rw’imitegurire n’uburyo iri rushanwa ryagenze yavuze ko ikintu cyazitonderwa ubutaha ari ikijyanye n’umwanya kuko byakererewe. I Burundi aho uyu mukobwa aturuka baheruka gutora Nyampinga mu  2017 guhera 2018 kugeza ubu ntawo barongera gutora umukobwa uhiga abanda uburanga ku rwego rw’Igihugu. Ibi birori byitabiriwe na ba nyampinga baturutse mu bindi bihugu baje kwihera ijisho umukobwa wegukana ikamba. Usibye Uwimana hari  na Nyampinga wa Tanzania, Sylivia Sebastian, watowe mu  2019; Oweditse Phirinyane wo muri Botswana; Rebecca Nana Adwoa Kwabi wo muri Ghana n’igisonga cye cya kabiri Princess Owusua Gyamfi; Miss Mariah Nyayeina wo muri Sudani y’Epfo na Oliver Nakakande wo muri Uganda. Ikiganiro na Uwimana Dative wari waturutse i Burundi

title: Tour du Rwanda 2020: Skol yifashishije The Ben mu gusangira ibyishimo n’abakunzi b’amagare (Amafoto)
content: Tour du Rwanda iri kuba ku nshuro ya 12 yatangiye kuri uyu wa 23 Gashyantare 2020, mu gace kegukanywe na Yevgeniy Fedorov ukinira Vino- Astana Motors yo muri Kazakhstan. Uyu mukinnyi w’imyaka 20 yakoresheje amasaha abiri, iminota 44 n’amasegonda 59 ku ntera y’ibilometero 114.4. Ni we wa mbere wo muri Kazakhstan wegukanye agace muri Tour du Rwanda. Usibye kuryoherwa n’igare, abitabiriye itangizwa rya Tour du Rwanda banataramanye n’abahanzi bahoza ku mutima. Uruganda rwenga ibinyobwa bisembuye n’ibidasembuye rwa SKOL Brewery Limited Rwanda ruzaherekeza Tour du Rwanda, rwazirikanye abakunzi b’umuziki butegura igitaramo cyaririmbwemo na The Ben. Mugisha Benjamin wamamaye mu muziki nka The Ben yataramiye ku Kimironko aho isiganwa ryasorejwe kuri iki Cyumweru. Yifashishije indirimbo ze zikunzwe cyane yashimishije abakunzi b’umuziki Nyarwanda n’abihebeye ibihangano bye by’umwihariko. The Ben afatanyije n’ibihumbi by’abafana baririmbanye “Ndaje”,  “Naremeye”, “Vazi (Vas-y)’’, “Fine girl” n’izindi bagaragaza ibyishimo. Uyu muhanzi yanaririmbye indirimbo yahimbiye Skol, ishimagiza ibinyobwa by’uru ruganda. The Ben azongera gutaramira abakunzi b’umukino w’amagare i Musanze ku wa 27 Gashyantare 2020, asoze ibitaramo bye ataramana n’abanyamujyi b’i Nyamirambo ku wa 29 Gashyantare 2020. Skol ni umuterankunga wa Tour du Rwanda ndetse mu 2018 yasinye amasezerano yo gukomeza kuyitera ingabo mu bitugu mu myaka itatu. Niyo ihemba umukinnyi watwaye agace k’isiganwa ndetse aho gasorezwa hatangirwa ibinyobwa ku biciro bigabanyije ndetse abanyamahirwe bagatsindira ibihembo bitandukanye. Kuva muri Nyakanga 2018, Skol ifasha ingimbi zo mu makipe yo mu Rwanda kwitoreza mu Bubiligi. Muri Tour du Rwanda 2020 ifitemo ikipe yayo ifatanyije n’Ikigo cya Adrien Niyonshuti kigamije kuzamura impano mu mukino w’amagare (ANCA). Iyi kipe yitwa Skol Adrien Cycling Academy (SACA) ni nshya, iri ku rwego rwo gukina amarushanwa yo ku mugabane “continental’’, yashinzwe mu rwego rwo guteza imbere impano z’Abanyarwanda bakina umukino w’amagare. Abakinnyi batanu bayihagarariye barimo Mugisha Moïse (Kapiteni), Habimana Jean Eric, Dukuzumuremyi, Hakizimana Seth na Nsengiyumva Shemu. Uretse Tour du Rwanda 2020, SACA iteganya kwitabira andi masiganwa arimo Tour de l’Egypte, Tour de Limpopo, Tour du Cameroun, Tour du Sénégal n’ayandi atandukanye. Mu Ukuboza 2019 nibwo Skol yatangaje ko iri ku rwego rwo kwenga ibinyobwa bifite ingano ya hegitolitiro ibihumbi 500 ku mwaka. Isanzwe ikora ibinyobwa bitandukanye birimo Skol Lager, Skol Malt, Skol 5, Virunga Mist, virunga Gold, Panache Lemon byose biboneka hirya no hino mu gihugu ku giciro cyiza. AMAFOTO: NIYONZIMA Moses

title: Ikanzu ya Meghan, Shaddyboo, ikamba rishya: Udushya mu birori byo gutoranya Miss Rwanda 2020
content: IGIHE yakusanyije tumwe mu dushya twagaragaye muri uyu muhango wabareye kuri Intare Arena i Rusororo mu karere ka Gasabo. Ubwitabire bw’abafana muri Miss Rwanda 2020 Ibirori byo gutanga ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2020 byabereye kuri Intare Arena, nubwo atari hafi cyane yo mu mujyi rwagati ariko ntibyaciye intege abantu babyitabiriye kuko bari buzuye mu cyumba cyatangiwemo ikamba. Imyanya yose yari irimo abantu kandi abafana mu mpande zose ariko bagaragaza umuriri wo gushyigikira abakobwa batandukanye bari bashyigikiye. Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Urubyiruko n’umuco, Edouard Bamporiki  yatashye adasoje ibirori Ibirori bya Miss Rwanda 2020 byitabiriwe n’abayobozi batandukanye barimo Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’amahanga Olivier Nduhungirehe ndetse n’Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Urubyiruko n’Umuco Bamporiki Edouard. Mu buryo butunguranye saa sita z’ijoro zibura iminota mike  Bamporiki Edouard yahagurutse asezera kubo bari bicaranye aritahira. Bamwe mu babonye uyu muyobozi agiye batekereje ko arambiwe n’ibi birori byatinze kurangira cyane ko byashyizweho akadomo saa saba n’igice z’igicuku. Impaka zikomeye mu bagize akanama nkemurampaka mbere yo gutangaza Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2020 Nyuma y’uko abakobwa icyenda  bari bamaze gusezererwa, abakobwa 10 bari basigaye bakamurikira akanama nkemurampaka imishinga yabo abari bashinzwe kubaha amanota basabwe gufata akanya bakajya guteranya amanota bityo bagatangaza uwahize abanda ari na we wegukana ikamba. Umwiherero w’abagize akanama nkemurampaka watinze ku rwego rwo hejuru kuko barengeje isaha mu mpaka zikomeye. Nyuma yo kugaruka bazanye amanota ateranyije nabwo impaka zari zose nubundi ubona batarumvikana ku manota batanze. Nyuma y’izo mpaka hemejwe ko Nishimwe Naomie ari we wegukanye ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2020. Ikanzu ya Nimwiza Meghan mu birori bya Miss Rwanda ni kimwe mu bitazava mu mitwe y’abakurikiye iri rushanwa Nimwiza Meghan wari usanganywe ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2019 yari yitabiriye ibirori byo kuritanga, uyu mukobwa yaje yambaye ikanzu ndende kandi yagutse yatunguye benshi. Usibye abatangajwe n’iyi kanzu na nyirayo kuyigenderamo byamutonze cyane ko byamusabaga kugenda ayifashe cyangwa afite itsinda ry’abamukikije bamufasha gutambuka itamuteze. Kwicara yambaye iyi kanzu ni kimwe mu byagoye cyane uyu mukobwa umaranye umwaka ikamba rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2019. Kutubahiriza igihe byatumye ibirori biba iminsi ibiri  Byari byitezwe ko ikamba rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2020 ritangwa tariki 22 Gashyantare 2020, icyakora bitunguranye iri kamba ryatanzwe nyuma y’amasaha hafi abiri ku wundi munsi. Nta mpamvu n’imwe yateye ubu bukerererwe yigeze itangazwa icyakora imwe mu zagaragariye buri wese witabiriye ibi birori ni ugutinda kwemeza uwegukanye ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2020 byafashe isaha irenga. Amasura mashya mu bagize akanama nkemurampaka Batanu bari bagize akanama nkemurampaka ni Munyaneza James umunyamakuru wa The New Times ubifitemo uburambe, Ntarindwa Diogene Atome umunyarwenya w’icyamamare mu Rwanda, Umubyinnyi w’ikirangirire ku Isi Sherri Silver, Evelyne Umurerwa umaze igihe ari umunyamakuru mu kigo cy’igihugu cy’itangazamakuru ndetse na Mutesi Jolly wegukanye ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2016. Muri aba tumaze kuvuga hejuru, Ntarindwa Diogene uzwi nka Atome ndetse na Sherri Silver yari amasura mashya mu kanama nkemurampaka ka Miss Rwanda. Ibirori byitabiriwe na ba Nyampinga bo mu bindi bihugu Ibi birori kandi byitabiriwe na ba nyampinga baturutse mu bindi bihugu baje kwihera ijisho umukobwa wegukana ikamba. Muri bo harimo Dative Uwimana waserukiye u Burundi muri Miss Africa University mu 2019; Nyampinga wa Tanzania, Sylivia Sebastian, watowe mu mwaka wa 2019; Oweditse Phirinyane wo muri Botswana; Rebecca Nana Adwoa Kwabi wo muri Ghana n’igisonga cye cya kabiri Princess Owusua Gyamfi; Miss Mariah Nyayeina wo muri Sudani y’Epfo na Oliver Nakakande wo muri Uganda. Ni ubwa mbere abakobwa bo mu bindi bihugu batwaye amakamba bitabira kuri urwo rwego. Bwa mbere abakobwa bari bambaye amakanzu yadodewe mu Rwanda Abakobwa bahatanaga mu irushanwa rya Miss Rwanda mu birori byo gutanga ikamba bari bambitswe n’abanyamideri babiri aribo Tanga Design na Ian Boutique. Eric Birasa uhagarariye Ian Boutique yabwiye IGIHE ko amakanzu abakobwa bose baserukanye ari imyambaro yadodewe mu Rwanda bikaba ari ubwa mbere bibaye mu gihe cy’imyaka itandatu amaze akora iki gikorwa cyo kwambika abakobwa bo muri Miss Rwanda. Urubyiniro rwari ruteguye neza cyane kimwe n’icyumba cyabereyemo ibi birori Buri wese winjiraga ahari hagiye kubera ibirori bya Miss Rwanda 2020 yatungurwaga n’uburyo hari hatatse neza cyane, byagaragaraga ko ari ibirori byiteguwe ku rwego rwo hejuru. Usibye imitako,  urubyiniro abakobwa bagombaga gutambukaho kimwe n’ibyuma byasohoraga amajwi byari ibintu biteguye neza kandi bivuga neza. Shaddyboo yasize inkuru mu birori bya Miss Rwanda Shaddyboo uzwi cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga yasize umugani ahabereye ibirori byo gutanga ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2020. Uyu mugore wafanaga Nishimwe Naomie yabanje kukanyurizaho abitabiriye ibi birori ubwo akanama nkemurampaka kari kari guteranya amanota. Ubwo akanama nkemurampaka kari kagiye guteranya amanota, Dj Ira wavangaga imiziki yaryohereje abitabiriye ibirori bya Miss Rwanda nubwo bari bananiwe bose bicaye. Muri iki gihe Shaddyboo yatunguranye abantu bose bicaye arahaguruka acinya akadiho abantu bose bamuhanze amaso. Ubwo bari bamaze  gutangaza uwatsinze, Shaddyboo yongeye kwigaragaza cyane ko yarenzwe n’ibyishimo akavuza induru mu cyumba cyatorewemo Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2020. Ibirori byaranzwe n’imbyino n’umuziki gakondo kimwe n’imbyino za Kinyarwanda Mu birori byo gutora Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2020 hari hatumiwe itorero Inganzo Ngari ndetse n’itsinda ry’abacuranzi gakondo basusurukije abitabiriye iki gitaramo. Usibye Itorero Inganzo Ngari, na ba Nyampinga mu myireko bakoze harimo aho biyerekanye babyina Kinyarwanda cyane ko bari bamaze igihe batozwa. Nyuma y’imyaka itanu ikamba rya Miss Rwanda ryahinduwe Ikamba ryambitswe Miss Nishimwe Naomie ryakozwe n’Inzu y’Ingoro Ndangamurage z’u Rwanda nyuma y’imyaka itanu iryari risanzwe rikozwe rikaba ryasimbujwe ku busabe bw’abategura iri rushanwa. Ubwo Nimwiza Meghan yajyaga gutanga ikamba yari amaranye umwaka wose byamusabye kubanza gukuramo iryo yari asanganywe afata irishya aba ariryo yambika Nishimwe Naomie.

title: Incamake y’urugendo rwa Nishimwe Naomie mu irushanwa rya Miss Rwanda rwamuhesheje kwambara ikamba
content: Uyu mukobwa mu kiganiro yahaye abanyamakuru nyuma yo gutorwa,  yavuze ko hari igihe cyageze agacika intege ku buryo yumvaga n’irushanwa nyirizina yaryihorera akivanamo. Nishimwe Naomie wambitswe ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2020 yaryinjiyemo yiyamamarije mu mujyi wa Kigali. Akimara gutsindira guhagararira Umujyi wa Kigali,  yahise atangira kwibasirwa ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ashinjwa kuba akorana bya hafi na MTN Rwanda bityo hakaba hari abagaragazaga impungenge z’uko iyi sosiyete yeteye inkunga Miss Rwanda 2020 yazagira uruhare mu itsinda rye. Ari abategura iri rushanwa cyangwa ubuyobozi bwa Miss Rwanda bose bavuze ko uyu mukobwa kwinjira mu irushanwa nta tegeko yishe ndetse arimo mu buryo bwubahirije amategeko. Bose bahumurije abakurikirana iri rushanwa bababwira ko kuba uyu mukobwa hari uburyo yakoranye na MTN Rwanda ntacyo byamwongereraho. Nyuma yo guhagararira Umujyi wa Kigali, Nishimwe Naomie mu ijonjora ry’ibanze yaserukanye umushinga  wo kurwanya indwara y’agahinda gakabije (Depression). Uyu mushinga waherekeje Nishimwe Naomie kugeza umuhesheje ikamba rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda w’umwaka wa 2020 yambitswe mu birori byabaye mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki 22 Gashyantare 2020. Usibye ikamba rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda Nishimwe Naomie yegukanye ikamba ry’umukobwa uberwa n’amafoto wahembwe na Bella Flowers yamugeneye 1 200 000frw. Nishimwe Naomie yayoboye abandi bakobwa mu majwi kuva mu ijonjora ry’ibanze kugeza  ku munsi wa nyuma w’irushanwa yarushaga abandi bakobwa amajwi yaba kuri Internet no mu buryo bwa SMS. Ikamba rya Miss Rwanda Nishimwe Naomie yegukanye ryamuhesheje kwegukana ibihembo binyuranye. Nka Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2020 yagenewe imodoka nshya yo mu bwoko bwa Suzuki Swift 2019 yatanzwe na Suzuki binyuze muri Rwanda Motor ifite agaciro ka miliyoni 18 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Yemerewe kandi umushahara w’ibihumbi 800 Frw ku kwezi mu gihe cy’umwaka, aya akazatangwa na Africa Improved Foods. Nyampinga w’u Rwanda yemerewe kwivuza ku buntu ku ivuriro ryitwa Ubuzima Polyclinique no gusohokera muri Camellia agafata icyo ashaka mu gihe kingana n’umwaka azamarana ikamba. Yemerewe itike y’indege izamujyana i Dubai n’ibindi byose bijyanye n’urugendo azakora mu rwego rw’ikiruhuko, iyi ikazatangwa na kompanyi yitwa Multi Design Group. Keza Salon yemeyeko  izamukorera ibijyanye n’imisatsi ndetse no kwita ku bwiza bwe mu gihe cy’umwaka wose. Yemerewe gucapirwa inyandiko zose  ku buntu ku bintu byose azaba ashaka muri Smart Design, mu gihe True Connect yo yamwemereye internet y’umwaka ku buntu. Mu gihe agiye mu birori, uyu mukobwa azajya yambikwa na Ian Boutique ku buntu ahabwe n’imyenda ya Siporo y’ubuntu muri Magasin Sport Class. Umukobwa wegukanye ikamba rya Miss Rwanda buri mwaka ahita anatsindira itike yo guhagararira igihugu muri Miss World. Ishimwe Naomie wegukanye ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2020 ni umwana w’imyaka 21 upima metero 1.70 akaba yari yambaye nimero 31 mu irushanwa rya Miss Rwanda 2020.

title: Nishimwe Naomie yegukanye ikamba rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2020 (Amafoto na Video)
content: Nishimwe Naomie yegukanye ikamba rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda w’umwaka wa 2020, asimbura Nimwiza Meghan wari ufite iriheruka yambitswe muri Gashyantare 2019. Uyu mukobwa w’imyaka 20  yatowe mu birori byabereye mu Intare Conference Arena i Rusororo ku mugoroba wo ku wa 22 ushyira mu rukerera rwo ku wa 23 Gashyantare 2020. Nishimwe yabaye Nyampinga wa munani utowe mu mateka y’u Rwanda. Urugendo rwo guhitamo Nyampinga w’u Rwanda rwari rumaze iminsi 64 kuva ku ijonjora ry’ibanze ryabereye mu Karere ka Rubavu ku wa 21 Ukuboza 2019. Nishimwe yagizwe Nyampinga hagendewe ku kimero n’ubwiza, kugira ubumenyi kurusha abandi ndetse n’umuco nk’imwe mu nkingi z’ubuzima bw’igihugu. Uyu mukobwa yahiriwe cyane kuko yanagizwe Nyampinga uberwa n’amafoto (Miss Photogenic). Abakobwa 20 [baje kuvamo umwe] b’ikimero bageze mu cyiciro cya nyuma cy’irushanwa batoranyijwe muri 54 batsinze amajonjora yabereye mu ntara zose z’igihugu aho abagera kuri 400 bari biyandikishije. Mu byashingiweho batoranya Nyampinga harebwe uburanga (amanota 30%), ubuhanga mu kuvuga (amanota 40%) n’uko umukobwa yiyerekanye (amanota 30%) byose bikagira igiteranyo cy’amanota ijana. Mu ijambo rye yagize ati “Ndishimye cyane. Ndashimira Abanyarwanda bangiriye icyizere.’’ Nishimwe yasazwe n’ibyishimo nyuma yo gutangazwa ko ariwe wegukanye ikamba rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2020. Ababyeyi n’abavandimwe be bamusanze ku rubyiniro barishimana. Uyu mukobwa yahise anashyikirizwa urufunguzo rw’imodoka yo mu bwoko bwa Suzuki Swift yagenewe. Iyi modoka nshya (Zero Kilometre) yatanzwe na Suzuki binyuze muri Rwanda Motor. Nishimwe yize ibijyanye n’Imibare, Ubukungu n’Ubumenyi bw’Isi (MEG). Ubwo yiyamamarizaga i Kigali ku wa 18 Mutarama 2020, Nishimwe yavuze ko nahabwa ikamba azita ku mushinga wo kugabanya agahinda gakabije mu rubyiruko (depression). Uyu mukobwa asanzwe akurikirwa cyane [afite abantu ibihumbi 66.1 kuri Instagram] ndetse byagaragajwe cyane n’uburyo yahamagawe [ariwe wa nyuma] abantu bari bari mu cyumba cyabereyemo igikorwa cyo kujonjora bakiyamira. Uretse ibyo, muri Kamena umwaka ushize muri Sénégal ubwiza bw’Abanyarwandakazi bwakuye benshi mu byimbo butuma bamwe bavugishwa, havuka iteranamagambo hibazwa igihugu gifite abakobwa beza hagati y’u Rwanda na Sénégal. Icyo gihe ifoto ya Nishimwe Naomie yavugishije benshi bari batangariye ubwiza bwe. Ku mbuga zitandukanye muri Sénégal hakwirakwiye ifoto y’uyu mukobwa wari uhagarariye Abanyarwandakazi muri rusange hagereranywa ubwiza bwe n’ubw’abakobwa bo muri icyo gihugu. Izi mpaka zakwirakwiriye ku mbuga za internet zitandukanye muri Sénégal, zatangiriye mu itsinda [Group] rya Facebook rikunzwe muri iki gihugu ryitwa ‘T’es De Dakar Si’ hibazwaga hagati y’u Rwanda n’iki gihugu ahari abakobwa b’uburanga. Kuva ubwo havutse ibice bibiri muri iri tsinda, icya mbere cy’abagabo bo muri Sénégal bemeza ko ‘Abanyarwandakazi bafite uburanga burangaza benshi kurusha ubw’abakobwa bo muri iki gihugu’ mu gihe hari n’abakobwa batabyishimiye maze nabo bishyira hamwe bamagana ibyo basaza babo bavuze. title: Alpha Blondy yasezeranye imbere y’Imana n’umunyamakuru ukora kuri radiyo ye
content: Muri Mata 2019 nibwo urukundo rwa Alpha Blondy na Aelysa Darragi rwashinze imizi ubwo bakoraga ubukwe bwa mbere gakondo. Muri Nyakanga 2019 aba babyaranye umwana w’umuhungu. Ku wa Kane tariki 20 Gashyantare 2020 bakaba barasezeranye imbere y’Imana mu musigiti wa Riviera Golf. Alpha Blondy yari asanzwe afite umuryango ndetse ibinyamakuru by’iwabo bihamya ko afite abana 11 harimo babiri bakorana mu buzima bwa buri munsi na batatu bihebeye umuziki nka we. Alpha Blondy yabonye izuba ku wa 01 Mutarama 1953, avukira i Dombokro. Ni umuhanzi wiyeguriye injyana ya Reggae w’umuririmbyi n’umwanditsi w’indirimbo, yubatse izina mu gihe amaze mu muziki. Indirimbo ze yazubakiye kuri Politiki n’ubuzima busanzwe, aziririmba mu ndimi zitandukanye zirimo; Dioula, Igifaransa n’Icyongereza rimwe na rimwe akanakoresha Icyarabu. Alpha Brondy yakunzwe mu ndirimbo zitandukanye nka "Guerre Civile", "Jerusalem”, “Brigadier Sabari”, "Journalistes en danger" n’izindi. Mu bihe bitandukanye yagiye agera mu Rwanda mu bitaramo n’ibirori yabaga yatumiwemo nka Kigali Up Music Festival n’ibindi. Amaze gushyira hanze album nka: Jah Glory! (1982), Cocody Rock!!! (1984), Apartheid Is Nazism (1985), Jérusalem (1986), Revolution (1987), The Prophets (1989), S.O.S Guerre Tribale (1991) n’izindi.

content: Mu myaka yatambutse abagiye bakurikiranira hafi ibya muzika bamenye uwari umwana witwa Babou wamenyekanye cyane mu njyana ya Hip Hop. Avuga uko yinjiye mu muziki yagize ati” Nigeze kujya mu gitaramo cyarimo marume, ndeba uburyo baririmbye abantu bakishima dutashye mubwira ko mbishaka ansaba ko ngomba gutsinda neza mu mashuri abanza kugira ngo anyemerere kubijyamo. Mbaye uwa mbere icyo gihe nibwo yanyandikiye indirimbo aranayinkoreshereza.” Babou avuga ko icyo gihe yafashijwe cyane na nyirarume ndetse n’itsinda ry’abo bakoranaga muri TFP. Uyu musore yavuze ko ubwo yari agiye mu mwaka wa kane w’amashuri yisumbuye aribwo yahisemo kuba aretse iby’umuziki kugira ngo ahe umwanya amasomo ye. Nyuma yo gusoza ibyo kwiga amashuri yisumbuye, Babou yabwiye IGIHE ko agiye gusubukura iby’umuziki ndetse mu gihe cya vuba azashyira hanze indirimbo ye nshya. Kugeza ubu uyu musore aracyakorana bya hafi na nyirarume Peterson n’ubundi wamwinjije mu muziki. Babou avuga ko umuziki w’u Rwanda kugeza ubu uhagaze neza, wateye imbere ndetse harimo amahirwe menshi yaba mu buryo abahanzi binjiza amafaranga ndetse n’ibikorwa remezo bituma abahanzi bakora neza mu buryo bworoshye. Uyu muraperi wamenyekanye akiri umwana yashimiye buri wese wamubaye hafi akinjira mu muziki yaba abahanzi, abanyamakuru ndetse n’abakunzi b’umuziki bamuhaye icyizere cyabo, anabasaba kuzongera kumwakirana yombi mu gihe azaba agarutse. Babou yamenyekanye cyane mu bwana bwe aho yafatwaga nk’umuraperi ukiri muto, aha akaba yari afite indirimbo zinyuranye zirimo iyitwa; Rimwe kabiri, Do it, Njye na Muzika yakoranye na Tuff Gang n’izindi nyinshi yaririmbye zirimo Arambona agaseka yaririmbye. Babou yavuze ko agiye gusubukura umuziki Njye na muzika Babou yakoranye na Tuff Gangs

title: Nyampinga wa Botswana, Sudani y’Epfo na Ghana bitabiriye ibirori bya Miss Rwanda 2020
content: Usibye Oweditse Phirinyane Nyampinga wa Botswana yageze i Kigali ku mugoroba wo ku wa Kane tariki 20 Gashyantare 2020, aba bakobwa bandi bageze i Kigali mu bihe bitandukanye byo kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 21 Gashyantare 2020 aho bitabiriye umuhango wo gutanga ikamba muri Miss Rwanda 2020. Ku mugoroba w’uyu munsi nibwo Mariah Nyayeina, Nyampinga wa Sudani y’Epfo na we yageze mu Rwanda. Uwanyuma wageze mu Rwanda ni Nyampinga wa Ghana, Rebecca Nana Adwoa Kwabi wabaye uwa gatanu witabiriye Miss Rwanda 2020. Aba bose bahasanze Oliver Nakakande wo muri Uganda ndetse na Sylivia Sebastian wo muri Tanzania bahageze mbere y’abandi. Miss Rwanda 2020 niyo ya mbere yitabiriwe n’abakobwa bo mu bindi bihugu. Irushanwa rya Miss Rwanda 2020 riri kugana ku musozo, abakobwa bahatanira ikamba bari mu mwiherero mbere y’iminsi mike ngo hamenyekane uzegukana ikamba. Ubu basigaye ari 19, nyuma y’uko Ingabire Jolie Ange yasezeye mu irushanwa kubera uburwayi. Amatike yo kwinjira mu birori bizatangarizwamo Miss Rwanda 2020 yamaze gushyirwa ku isoko, abayashaka bashobora kuyagura bifashishije Mobile Money (*182*8*1*333111#), Ecobank cyangwa bakayasanga kuri Camellia muri KBC, Keza Saloon no kuri Smart Design.

title: Abakobwa bari muri Miss Rwanda bahishuye agahinda batewe na Ingabire wavuyemo kubera uburwayi
content: Tariki 17 Gashyantare 2020 nibwo ubuyobozi bwa Miss Rwanda bwatangaje ko Ingabire yavuye mu irushanwa kubera uburwayi. Nyuma y’iminsi avuye mu irushanwa abakobwa bahataniraga ikamba rya Miss Rwanda babwiye IGIHE ko bababajwe n’uyu mugenzi wabo utarabashije gukomeza guhatana kubera impamvu z’uburwayi. Benshi muri aba bakobwa bahishuye ko ryari ijoro ribi cyane igihe basezeraga kuri Ingabire. Bahamya ko bababajwe nuko ibyamubayeho ari impamvu zatunguranye kandi nta yandi mahitamo bari bafite. Ikindi aba bakobwa uko ari 19 bahurizaho ni uburyo Ingabire yababaniye neza mu mwiherero ku buryo kuvamo kwe byabaye agahinda gakomeye. Kirezi Rutaremara Brune umwe mu bahatanira ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2020 yagize ati ”Jolie Ange sinzi uko namuvuga; aritonda, mu bantu nabonaga bashoboraga gutwara n’ikamba na we yari arimo. Kumva ko avuye mu irushanwa atari iyindi mpamvu ari uburwayi, njye ku giti cyanjye byarambabaje.” Uyu mukobwa avuga ko bose byabababaje cyane ku buryo iyo baganira muri rusange basanga iyaba hari ikindi cyashobokaga bari kugikora ariko byarenze ubushobozi bwabo. Teta Ndenga Nicole wiganye na Ingabire mu mashuri yisumbuye we yavuze ko yababajwe bikomeye nuko uyu mukobwa w’inshuti ye yavuye mu irushanwa. Akaliza Hope yavuze ko Ingabire ari umukobwa wakundaga kubatera imbaraga kenshi kabone n’iyo babaga bari gukora ibintu bigoye akababwira ko we yumva ntacyo bimutwaye. Aba bakobwa bose bababajwe no kuva mu irushanwa kwa mugenzi wabo bamusabira gukira akamera neza ariko kandi akanihanganira ibyabaye bamwibutsa ko atari ryo herezo ry’ubuzima. Ingabire Jolie Ange yasezeye mu irushanwa nyuma yuko yari yaryinjiyemo atsindiye guhagararira Intara y’Amajyepfo. Itike yakuye mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo niyo yamwinjije muri Pre-Selection, aha naho yahanyuranye umucyo bituma yinjira muri 20 berekeje mu mwiherero. Uyu mukobwa yasezeye muri Miss Rwanda nyuma y’icyumweru yari amaze mu mwiherero uri kubera La Palisse Hotel i Nyamata. Kuri ubu abakobwa basigaye bahatanira ikamba bakaba ari 19. Umukobwa uzambikwa ikamba rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2020 uzasimbura Nimwiza Meghan ufite irya 2019, azamenyekana mu birori biteganyijwe kubera muri Intare Conference Arena i Rusororo mu ijoro ryo ku wa 22 Gashyantare 2020.

title: The Ben yasinye amasezerano y’imikoranire na Onomo Hotel yiyemeje kumushyigikira mu muziki we
content: Aya masezerano yasinyiwe kuri Onomo Hotel iherereye mu Mujyi wa Kigali, ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 21 Gashyantare 2020. Umuyobozi wa Onomo Hotel i Kigali, Emile Nizey, yabwiye itangazamakuru ko bishimiye guha ikaze The Ben mu mikoranire bagiye kugirana. Yavuze ko amasezerano bagiranye ashingiye mu gushyigikira uyu muhanzi mu bikorwa bye bya muzika yaba mu Rwanda no ku rwego mpuzamahanga cyane cyane mu bihugu 18 iyi hoteli ifitemo amashami. Yavuze ko bazashyigikira bishoboka umuziki wa The Ben mu rwego rwo guteza imbere uyu musore nk’umuhanzi w’Umunyarwanda bifuza gushyiramo imbaraga kugira ngo arusheho gutera imbere. Ku ruhande rwa The Ben we avuga ko azaba yamamaza anamenyekanisha ibikorwa bya Onomo Hotel. The Ben yavuze ko yanyuzwe n’imikoranire yemeranyijeho na Onomo Hotel ndetse anayishimira gahunda nziza bafitanye. Amasezerano ahuriweho n’impande zombi nta gihe cyashyizweho agomba kurangiriraho, ahubwo naba atagitanga inyungu zihuriweho azashyirwaho iherezo. The Ben abajijwe niba hari amafaranga yahawe n’umubare wayo, yagize ati ”Amafaranga nibyo arahari ariko twahisemo kuyagira ibanga.” Ku kijyanye no gukorana na hoteli iri mu Rwanda nyamara ubusanzwe yibera muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, The Ben yavuze ko ntaho bizahurira kuko uburyo azakorana nayo ari ibintu ashobora gukorera ahantu hose azaba ari. Nizey yifashishije urugero mu gushimangira iyo mikorere yavuze ko ” Wenda hari igihe yajya muri Tanzania, Afurika y’Epfo n’ahandi dufite amashami. Iki gihe aba yizeye ko nta kibazo agira cy’aho kuba n’uburyo bwo kubaho kimwe n’ikipe ye. Tuzamufasha muri buri kimwe dushoboye.” Mbere yo gusinyana amasezerano na Onomo Hotel, The Ben yijeje abanyamakuru ko abona ubu bufatanye buzamufasha mu iterambere rya muzika ye cyane ko bizanamufasha ku rwego mpuzamahanga bikagabanya ingorane yahuraga nazo. The Ben yavukiye i Kampala muri Uganda ku wa 9 Mutarama 1988. Ni mwene Jean Mbonimpa na Esther Mbabazi. Ni uwa kabiri mu muryango w’abana batandatu barimo nka Danny Scott (na we wabaye umuhanzi, ananyura mu itsinda rya B Gun), Green P (umuraperi wamamariye muri Tuff Gangz) n’abandi. Uyu muhanzi Nyarwanda uririmba injyana ya RnB/Pop. Yatangiye impano y’ubuhanzi abihereye mu muryango aho yakuze akundishwa n’ababyeyi be gusenga cyane. Byatumye ajya muri korali aho yari ari kumwe n’abandi bahanzi bamenyekanye nka Meddy, Lick Lick na Nicolas. Indirimbo yazamuye izina rye ni ‘‘Amaso ku Maso’’ yasohoye mu 2008. Izindi ndirimbo zizwi ni ‘‘Si beza’’ na ‘‘Mbwira’’ yahuriyemo na Tom Close; ‘‘Uzaba Uza’’ yaririmbanye na Roger, ‘‘Wirira’’, ‘‘Imfubyi’’ yahuriyemo na Bull Dogg, ‘‘Wigenda’’, ‘‘Uri he’’, ‘‘Sinzibagirwa’’, ‘‘Amahirwe ya nyuma’’ na ‘‘Zubeda’’. Nyuma yaho yaje no gusohora indirimbo nka ‘‘Ese nibyo’’ mbere yo kwerekeza muri Amerika aho yakomereje ubuhanzi bwe. Ubu akunzwe mu ndirimbo z’urukundo zirimo nka ‘‘Ko Nahindutse’’, ‘‘Urabaruta’’, "Ndaje’’, ‘‘Habibi’’, ‘‘Ntacyadutanya’’, ‘‘Only You’’, ‘‘I’m In Love’’, ‘‘Can’t get enough’’ yakoranye na Otile Brown wo muri Kenya n’izindi. Ni umwe mu bahanzi bake b’Abanyarwanda babashije kwagura umuziki wabo ukamenyekana no mu bindi bihugu.

title: Miss Rwanda 2020: Ibyo abakobwa bazakumbura mu mwiherero n’umushinga wa buri wese (Video)
content: Aba bakobwa babaye 19 nyuma y’uko mugenzi wabo Ingabire Jolie Ange atabashije gukomeza cyane ko yasezeye kubera uburwayi bwamutunguye bugatuma atabasha gukomeza irushanwa. Aba bakobwa uko ari 19 bose twabasuye mu mwiherero tuganira ku bintu binyuranye birimo uko bari babayeho mu mwiherero,  ibyo bazawukumburamo n’incamake ku mishinga yabo. Mu biganiro n’aba bakobwa bose bahuriza ku kuba bazakumbura umwiherero wa Miss Rwanda kuko bari babanye neza, babayeho nk’umuryango. Akaliza Hope yagize ati “Nzakumbura abakobwa tubana muri rusange, uko twasangiraga, uko twagendanaga mbega ni byinshi.” Musana Teta Hense nawe uri mu bahatana muri Miss Rwanda 2020 yavuze ko azakumbura bagenzi be, ibiganiro bahabwaga n’ibindi. Ati “Nzakumbura aba bakobwa twabanye, buri wese afite umwihariko we. Nzakumbura ibiganiro byari byiza. Kubona amahirwe yo kubona abayobozi batuganiriza nzabikumbura.” Nishimwe Naomie na we yagize ati “Ikintu nzakumbura ni ugusangira nijoro n’abandi bakobwa ubundi tukaza kumva gahunda z’undi munsi turi kuririmba nzabikumbura cyane.” Imishinga yabo Ikirezi Rutaremara Brune yavuze ko afite umushinga wo gufasha abanyarwanda bafite ubumuga bwo mu mutwe. Ingabire Rehma we afite umushinga wo guteza imbere imibereho ya mwarimu. Teta Ndenga Nicole yavuze ko afite umushinga wo gukangurira abanyarwanda n’urubyiruko guhinga ibiti by’imbuto. Akaliza Hope we yavuze ko umushinga we ushingiye ku gukangurira abana b’abakobwa kwitabira kwiga ubukerarugendo. Mutesi Denise afite umushinga wo kugabanya umubare w’abantu badafite akazi mu gihugu cy’u Rwanda. Umutesi Denise umushinga we ni uguteza imbere uburenganzira bw’abaguzi. Mutegwantebe Chanice afite umushinga wo guhuriza hamwe abantu batishoboye basabiriza ku mihanda mu rwego rwo kubafasha kwiteza imbere. Nishimwe Naomie afite umushinga wo kurwanya ubwigunge mu rubyiruko. Musana Teta Hense we umushinga we ni ukurwanya kanseri mu Rwanda. Umuratwa Anitha umushinga we ni ugufasha abana kubyaza impano zabo umusaruro cyane cyane siporo. Marebe Benitha umushinga afite umushinga wo kubaka ubushobozi bw’urubyiruko rufite ubumuga. Irasubiza Alliance umushinga we ni ukurwanya inda z’imburagihe mu bana bakiri bato bari munsi y’imyaka 18. Ingabire Diane afite umushinga wo kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge cyane cyane mu rubyiruko. Uwase Aisha we afite umushinga wo gukangurira abahuye n’ihohoterwa kutariceceka. Mukangwije Rosine afite umushinga wo gushishikariza urubyiruko kwiteza imbere binyuze mu kwikorera. Nyinawumuntu Delice we afite umushinga wo gushishikariza abana b’abakobwa kwiga siyansi n’ikoranabuhanga. Ingabire Gaudance afite umushinga wo gushishikariza urubyiriko kwitabira ubukerarugendo bw’imbere mu gihugu mu gihe Umwiza Phionah afite umusinga wo kurwanya ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina rikorerwa abana bari munsi y’imyaka 18. Kamikazi Rurangirwa Nadege we afite umushinga wo kwita kubana bafite indwara izwi nka  “Down Syndrome” no guhugura imiryango yabo uburyo babitaho. Ni indwara ifata umwana ukiri mu nda ya nyina. Ishobora gutuma umwana avuka hari uduce tw’umubiri tumwe na tumwe abuze cyangwa se mu mutwe he hadakora nk’ibisanzwe. Kugeza ubu irushanwa rya Miss Rwanda 2020 riri kugana ku musozo abakobwa bahatanira ikamba bari mu mwiherero mbere y’amasaha make ngo hamenyekane uzegukana ikamba. Aba bakobwa bari mu mwiherero bamaze kuvamo umwe cyane ko ubu basigaye ari 19 nyuma y’uko Ingabire Jolie Ange asezeye mu irushanwa kubera uburwayi. Umukobwa uzambikwa ikamba rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2020 uzasimbura Nimwiza Meghan ufite irya 2019, azamenyekana mu birori biteganyijwe kubera muri Intare Conference Arena i Rusororo mu ijoro ryo ku wa 22 Gashyantare 2020. Kugeza ubu amatike yo kwinjira mu irushanwa rya Miss Rwanda 2020 yashyizwe ku isoko; abayashaka bashobora kuyagura bifashishije Mobile Money (*182*8*1*333111#), Ecobank cyangwa bakayasanga kuri Camellia KBC, Keza Saloon no kuri Smart Design.

title: Abakobwa batabashije gukomeza muri Miss Rwanda 2020 bakomereje ibikorwa by’urukundo mu Karere ka Gisagara
content: Abo bakobwa bibumbiye mu itsinda “We for the Nation” kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 20 Gashyantare 2020 bakomereje ibyo bikorwa mu Karere ka Gisagara aho baganirije urubyiruko rw’abanyeshuri ku gukumira gusambanya abana ndetse no kurwanya inda z’imburagihe ziterwa abangavu. Ni nyuma y’uko ku wa 13 Gashyantare 2020 basuye ikigo kirererwamo abana bafite ubumuga cya HVP Gatagara i Gikondo ho mu mujyi wa Kigali; aho baganiriye n’ubuyobozi bwabasobanuriye ibikorwa bihakorerwa buri munsi ndetse banagira umwanya wo kwifatanya n’abana baharererwa yaba mu gusangira ndetse no kwidagadurana. Gaju Evelyne uhagarariye iryo tsinda yavuze ko bahisemo kuganiriza urubyiruko ku ngingo yo gusambanya abana no gukumira inda ziterwa abangavu kuko ari ikibazo gihangayikishije muri iki gihe. Ati “Buri mukobwa muri twe yari afite umushinga we; uyu wo gukumira inda zitateganyijwe ni imwe muri iyo mishinga. Gusa ikibazo cy’abana basabanywa ndetse n’icy’abangavu baterwa inda kirahangayikishije ni yo mpamvu twiyemeje gutanga umusanzu mu kuzikumira tuganiriza urubyiruko.” Kuri ubu itsinda “We for the Nation” rigizwe n’abakobwa 34 ariko abaje kuganiriza urubyiruko mu Karere ka Gisagara ni 10 kuko bagenzi babo bari mu bindi bikorwa birimo kwiga n’ibindi. Mu Karere ka Gisagara baganirije urubyiruko rw’abanyeshuri biga kuri GS Saint Philippe Neri hamwe n’abiga kuri Saint Eugenie Smet aho bari bahuriye ku kibuga cy’umupira w’amaguru kuko ayo mashuri yombi yari yakinnye. Igihozo Dianne watanze ikiganiro yagarutse ku ngaruka zo gusambanya abana no gutwara inda imburagihe,  asaba urubyiruko kwirinda ibishuko bishobora kubashora mu busambanyi. Yagize ati “Cyane cyane nkamwe b’abanyeshuri na twe twese akenshi hari igihe badushukishaga amandazi, bombo, amafaranga n’ibindi. Icya mbere ni uko abana b’abakobwa tugomba kumenya ko dufite agaciro tukirinda abadushuka.” Yabibukije ko umukobwa usambanyijwe agaterwa inda bimugiraho ingaruka mbi zitandukanye bikamwicira ejo hazaza. Ati “Muri mwe harimo abazaba Abadepite; Abaminisitiri cyangwa mukazayobora mu bundi buryo. Mureke twirinde ibishuko bitwicira ejo hazaza.” Nyuma y’ibiganiro byatanzwe urubyiruko rwahawe umwanya wo kubaza ibibazo bitandukanye byibanze ku buzima bw’imyororokere. Umukozi ushinzwe uburinganire n’iterambere ry’umuryango mu Karere ka Gisagara, Sewabo Vincent, ni we wabakiriye ashima ibikorwa byabo abizeza ubufatanye. Ati “Ni byiza kuko biraza gutuma hari icyo twunguka mu kugabanya imibare y’abana bakomeje gusabanywa mu karere.” Sewabo yavuze ko mu mezi 11 ashize mu Karere ka Gisagara hagaragaye  abangavu bagera kuri 214 bari munsi y’imyaka 17 batewe inda imburagihe. Urubyiruko rwagiriwe inama yo kudahishira abasore n’abagabo basambanya abangavu kuko babicira ubuzima bityo bakwiye guhanwa by’intangarugero kugira ngo abandi babonereho hatazagira utekereza kongera guhirahira asambanya umwangavu. Gaju Evelyne uhagarariye “We for the Nation” yavuze ko bishimiye uko igikorwa bateguye mu Karere ka Gisagara cyagenze bityo byabongereye imbaraga zo gukomeza ibyo biyemeje. Yavuze ko bashinze uwo muryango bagamije gukora ibikorwa by’urukundo nk’uko bari babyiyemeje ubwo bitabiraga irushanwa rya Miss Rwanda 2020 bityo biteguye no kwakira umufatanyabikorwa wese waza kubashyigikira.

title: Niyo Bosco yasohoye indirimbo nshya yise “Ibanga”
content: Indirimbo “Ibanga” ya Niyo Bosco ikubiyemo ubutumwa bukangurira abantu kugira ibanga, agaragazamo ingaruka zikunze kuba ku bantu batarigira. Mu nyikirizo y’iyi ndirimbo uyu muhanzi agira ati ”Ibanga ni igihamya cyemeza ko uri umwizerwa, kugira ibanga nibyo bishimangira ubupfura bwawe. Uko waba uri kose utagira ibanga amagambo uvugwa niyo menshi kurusha ayo avuga! Jya uvuga uziga […].” Uyu muhanzi yakanguriye abantu kuvuga baziga, bakavuga ibyo babajijwe cyane ko n’umunyarwanda yaciye umugani ko akarimi kabi gasemera agasaya. Niyokwizerwa Bosco wamenyekanye nka Niyo Bosco ni umusore w’imyaka 20 y’amavuko ukora umuziki ariko afite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Mu kiganiro aherutse kugirana na IGIHE, Niyo Bosco yasabye abantu kutumva ko yaba akunzwe kubera impuhwe agirirwa ku bw’ikibazo afite ahubwo bakita ku mpano ye mu muziki. Uyu wahereye cyera aririmba ariko atarabona ubushobozi, yaje kurabukwa n’umunyamakuru Irene Mulindahabi wamufashije kumenyekanisha impano ye mu 2019. Nyuma yuko Isi yose ibonye impano iri muri uyu musore, abantu banyuranye biyemeje kumufasha, kuri ubu Niyo Bosco afite ikipe imufasha mu bijyanye na muzika ndetse no mu buzima bwa buri munsi. Iyi ndirimbo ye nshya mu buryo w’amajwi yakorewe muri Uno Record ikorwa na Producer witwa Santana mu gihe amashusho yayo yafashwe akanatunganywa na Bagenzi Bernard uri mu bagezweho muri iyi minsi.
