title: Abakobwa bahatana muri Miss Rwanda basuye Ecobank, Bella Flowers na Africa Improved Food (Amafoto)
content: Kuva aba bakobwa bakwinjira mu mwiherero ku wa 9 Gashyantare 2020 bagiye basura ahantu hatandukanye ndetse bakira abashyitsi banyuranye mu rwego rwo kwiyungura ubumenyi. Mu ngendo za nyuma aba bakobwa bakoze mbere y’uko irushanwa rya Miss Rwanda rirangira basuye ibigo bikomeye nka Ecobank (Umuterankunga mukuru wa Miss Rwanda 2020), Bella Flowers izahemba Nyampinga uberwa n’amafoto na Africa Improved Food izahemba Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2020. Ku wa Kabiri tariki 18 Gashyantare 2020 nibwo aba bakobwa basuye Ecobank basobanurirwa birambuye imikorere y’iyi banki ndetse banaganirizwa kuri serivisi zitandukanye itanga. Abakobwa bashishikarijwe kuzirikana gahunda ya Leta yo kutagendana amafaranga mu ntoki [cashless], banasabwa gukangurira abo mu miryango yabo inshuti n’abavandimwe iyi gahunda ifite uruhare rukomeye ku iterambere ry’igihugu no gucunga umutekano wa buri wese. Kuri uwo munsi banasuye Bella Flowers, aho berekewe uburyo bahinga indabo ndetse bakazitunganya kugeza zigeze ku isoko. Bibukijwe ko ubuhinzi bw’indabo ari kimwe mu bishobora kwinjiriza Abanyarwanda amafaranga mu gihe babukangukira ariko nanone bigakorwa kinyamwuga kuko buri mu butanga umusaruro ushimishije. Aba bakobwa bishimiye ubumenyi bungukiye muri iki kigo cyane ko hafi ya bose mu buzima busanzwe bakunze kugura indabo zo guha abantu banyuranye ku minsi mikuru yabo cyangwa igihe bagiye gutabara umuntu witabye Imana. Buri mukobwa yavuye muri iki kigo ahawe impano y’ururabo. Abakobwa bahataniye ikamba rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda ku wa Gatatu tariki 19 Gashyantare 2020 basuye African Improved Food, ikigo gitunganya ifu zo mu bwoko bunyuranye zitegurwamo igikoma gikundwa na benshi. Nyuma yo gutemberezwa mu ruganda basobanurirwa uburyo ifu z’ibikoma zitegurwa, abakobwa bagize umwanya wo kugisangira n’abayobozi ba AIF bishimira akamaro k’ifu z’igikoma zikorerwa muri uru ruganda. Aba bakobwa bashimiye uru ruganda uburyo rukomeje kunganira Leta mu kurwanya imirire mibi mu bana n’abantu bakuru rubagezaho ifu zifite intungamubiri kandi ku giciro cyiza. Ubuyobozi bwa Africa Improved Food bwasabye aba bakobwa kubabera aba ambasaderi beza bakamenyekanisha akamaro k’ifu zirimo intungamubiri zikorerwa muri uru ruganda bityo imiririre mibi igahashywa mu Banyarwanda. Ibi bigo aba bakobwa basuye byashyize akadomo ku ngendo bakoreye ahantu hatandukanye cyane ko hasigaye amasaha make bakajya mu irushanwa rizatangarizwamo uwegukanye ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2020. Kugeza ubu irushanwa rya Miss Rwanda 2020 riri kugana ku musozo abakobwa bahatanira ikamba bari mu mwiherero mbere y’amasaha make ngo hamenyekane uzegukana ikamba. Aba bakobwa bari mu mwiherero bamaze kuvamo umwe cyane ko ubu basigaye ari 19 nyuma y’uko Ingabire Jolie Ange asezeye mu irushanwa kubera uburwayi. Umukobwa uzambikwa ikamba rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2020 uzasimbura Nimwiza Meghan ufite irya 2019, azamenyekana mu birori biteganyijwe kubera muri Intare Conference Arena i Rusororo mu ijoro ryo ku wa 22 Gashyantare 2020. Kugeza ubu amatike yo kwinjira mu irushanwa rya Miss Rwanda 2020 yashyizwe ku isoko; abayashaka bashobora kuyagura bifashishije Mobile Money (*182*8*1*333111#), Ecobank cyangwa bakayasanga kuri Camellia KBC, Keza Saloon no kuri Smart Design.

title: RICTA n’abafatanyabikorwa basuzumye uko Internet n’ikoranabuhanga rigezweho byitabirwa mu Rwanda
content: Iyi nama ngarukamwaka itegurwa na RICTA, n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa bafite aho bahuriye n’ikwirakwizwa rya internet. Ibiganiro by’uyu mwaka bikaba byibanze ahanini ku kwimakazwa ikoranabuhanga rigezweho mu guhindura ubuzima bw’abanyarwanda bukaba bwiza kurushaho. Ikindi ni uko barebeye hamwe uko abanyarwanda bumva ibijyanye na internet, uko bayikoresha n’uko bayigeraho. Umunyamabanga uhoraho muri Minisiteri y’Ikoranabuhanga mu Itumanaho na Inovasiyo, Irere Claudette, yasabye abitabiriye iyi nama kuzajya babanza kureba niba ingamba zifatwa mu ikoranabuhanga ziri mu nyungu z’abaturage. Ati “Dukwiriye kureba neza niba ingamba, amahame n’amabwiriza dushyiraho biba birengera kandi byungura abaturage. Abaturage bacu nibashyirwa imbere, bazagira uruhare mu ikorwa ry’ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga bityo babe abaturage bakungahaye mu ikoranabuhanga rigezweho.” Ku bijjyanye n’uko umubare munini w’abanyarwanda badafite ubumenyi ku ikoranabuhanga rigezweho, Umuyobozi wa RICTA, Ingabire Grace, yavuze ko umwaka utaha bafite gahunda yo kwigisha ubumenyi bw’ibanze kuri internet mu bigo by’amashuri na za kaminuza. Yagize ati “Umwaka utaha dufite ibikorwa bitandukanye, aho tuzajya muri za kaminuza, mu mashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye, tukazatangira kwigisha ubumenyi bw’ibanze kuri murandasi ku buryo abantu bose guhera ku rwego rwo hasi baziyumvamo murandasi icyo ari cyo.” Ingabire yongeyeho ko kwegereza abaturage ikoranabuhanga rigezweho bitari ukubakwirakwizamo imashini gusa cyangwa kubigisha uko bazifungura, ahubwo ari ukubigisha uburyo bazikoresha mu guhindura ubukungu n’iterambere ry’ubuzima bwabo. Kugeza ubu abanyarwanda bafite ubumenyi ku ikoranabuhanga rigezweho bari munsi 10%, mu gihe imibare igaragazwa n’Ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe Ikoranabuhanga mu Itumanaho n’Isakazabumenyi (RISA) ivuga ko 52% aribo bakoresha Internet mu Rwanda.

title: Uburyo indege zo mu bwoko bwa Pod zizahindura ibijyanye n’ingendo n’ubwikorezi
content: Izi ndege za Pod zizaba zikoze mu buryo igice kijyamo abagenzi cyangwa imizigo gishobora komorwa ku kindi cy’ibanze kirimo abapilote, nk’uko bigenda ku makamyo manini ashobora gukurwaho icy’inyuma kizwi nka kontineri. Gusa ku ndege iki gice cyijyamo abantu n’ibintu cyo kizaba cyitwa ‘capsules’ ndetse ‘pod’ ikazaba ifite ubushobozi bwo gutwara ibigera kuri bitatu. Iri koranabuhanga biteganyijwe ko rizagabanya ingendo abantu bakoraga bagana ku bibuga by’indege, ndetse n’imirongo batondaga bategereje kwinjira mu ndege kuko umugenzi azaba afite ubushobozi bwo kwinjira muri iki gice cya ‘Capsules’ aho yaba ari hose mbere y’uko cyomekwa ku ndege. Nk’uko bigenda kuri kontineri, hari aho bizajya biba ngombwa ko iki gice kirimo abagenzi kizajya gishyirwa ku modoka cyangwa se ku bwato igihe aho abantu bagiye atari hafi y’ikibuga indege. Biteganyijwe ko ubu buryo bwo gutwara abantu n’ibintu nibutangira gukoreshwa, kompanyi zimwe zizita ku gucunga iki gice cy’indege gisanzwe izindi zite kugucunga ikijyamo abagenzi ku buryo umugenzi azaba afite ubushobozi bwo kugenda muri Capsules ya Etihad cyangwa iya Qatar Airways ariko byose biri ku ndege imwe. Umuyobozi wa Airinsight, ikigo gitanga inama zijyanye n’ubucuruzi ku bigo by’indege Addison Schonland, yavuze  ko nubwo mu buryo buri tekiniki bigaragara ko bizakunda hakiri imbogamizi ku buryo bw’ubucuruzi. Yagize ati “Nubwo bishobora kuba bisobanutse urebeye ku ruhande ruri tekiniki, bizagorana kugira ngo bishyirwe mu buryo bw’ubucuruzi kandi mu kuri birashidikanywa ko isoko rizaba ryiteguye ubu buryo bushya yewe no mu gihe kirekire, gusa biramutse bikunze ndabona bizahera ku bijyanye n’imizigo”. Abashakashatsi bari gukora ku mushinga w’izi ndege bavuze  ko batazi neza igihe zizagira hanze kuko hagomba gukorwa amagerageza menshi.

title: Uko wagura itike ya Tap&Go wifashishije ikoranabuhanga
content: AC Group yazanye ubu buryo bwo kwishyura hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga bigendanye na gahunda ya Leta y’u Rwanda, yo kwishyura ibicuruzwa na serivisi utitwaje amafaranga mu ntoki. Kuri ubu AC Group imenyerewe cyane mu Mujyi wa Kigali, irimo gutanga serivisi ku bajya mu ntara ihereye ku bakora ingendo Kigali-Musanze-Rubavu. Mu korohereza abakiriya bayo, yatangije uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga ribafasha kubona serivisi. Ubu buryo ni Tap&Go App, yashyiriweho gufasha umukiriya kubasha kuzigama itike, gushyira amafaranga ku ikarita atarindiriye kugana abakozi ba AC Group mu Mujyi wa Kigali, ndetse akabasha no kureba amafaranga asigaranye ku ikarita n’ibindi byinshi. Icya mbere usabwa ni ukuba ufite application ya Tap&Go App muri telefoni yawe, aho wayikurura kuri App store ku bakoresha ios na Play Store ku bakoresha Android. Hakurikiraho kwiyandikisha ugatunga konti, ukabikora ushyiramo izina, nimero ya telefoni na email. Uko ushobora kugura itike ya Tap&Go ukoresheje telefoni Fungura application ya Tap&Go muri telefoni yawe, shyiramo aho ushaka guhagurukira, shyiramo aho ushaka kwerekeza n’isaha yo guhaguruka n’uburyo ukoresha mu kwishyura niba ari Mobile Money cyangwa banki runaka. Iyo umaze kuzuza ibyo byose, uhita ubona imibare werekana iyo ugiye guhaguruka. Kugura ikarita ya Tap&Go unyuze ku rubuga Iyo umaze gufungura mudasobwa yawe cyangwa telefoni, uhita wandikamo www.tapandgo.rw, ukuzuzamo imyirondoro yawe (amazina, nimero ya telefoni na email), aho ugiye guhagurukira, aho werekeza n’igihe wifuza gutangira urugendo, ukishyura, nyuma ukaza guhabwa imibare uza kwerekana mu gihe ugiye guhaguruka. Kwishyura itike wifashishije umukozi wa Tap&Go Iyo umaze kugera ku mukozi wa Tap&Go ukwegereye, umuha imyirondoro yawe, aho ushaka guhagurukira, aho ushaka kwerekeza n’igihe cyo guhaguruka. Iyo birangiye wishyura mu buryo bukunogeye yaba kwishyura mu ntoki, Mobile Money cyangwa Banki ukorana nayo, ubundi ugahita uhabwa agatike imashini ihita isohora. Bitewe n’uburyo byoroshya ubuzima, AC Group ishishikariza abanyarwanda bafite telefoni zigezweho ‘Smartphone’ kwihutira gushyira ‘application’ ya Tap&Go muri telefoni zabo kugira ngo bajye babasha kwigurira itike bitabasabye kujya ku mukozi wa Tap&Go. Ikindi ni uko kugura itike wifashishije ‘application’ ya Tap&Go cyangwa uyiguriye ku rubuga bigufasha no kuba wareba uburyo wagiye ugura amatike mu bihe bitandukanye byatambutse.

title: Snapchat igiye kujya igenzura amatangazo yamamaza abanyapolitiki
content: Bitangajwe nyuma y’iminsi ibindi bigo bikomeye by’ikoranabuhanga binenzwe kudafata ingamba zikakaye mu gihe habura iminsi mike muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika hakaba amatora ya Perezida. Facebook yamaze gutangaza ko itazagenzura byihariye amatangazo yamamaza abanyapolitiki mu gihe Twitter yo yayahagaritse. Spiegel yatangaje ko Snapchat iri kugerageza gushyirahao uburyo bwo kwamamaza ibikorwa bya politiki kugira ngo bashishikarize abakiri bato kwisanga muri politiki. Icyakora, yijeje ko ayo matangazo yose azajya agenzura n’itsinda bagiye gushyiraho nkuko yabitangarije Televiziyo CNBC. Snapchat isanzwe itangaza urutonde rw’amatangazo yamamaza abanyapolitiki yayishyizweho. Imibare yo mu 2019, igaragaza ko amatangazo yamamaza ibikorwa bikomeye  byo kwiyamamaza by’abashaka kuba abakuru b’ibihugu byayinyujijweho birimo icyo kwamamaza Joe Biden ushaka kuba Perezida wa Amerika cyatwaye amadolari 1,175, kikarebwa n’abantu 281,894, igikorwa cyo kwamamaza Pete Buttigieg nacyo cyatwaye amadolari 35,618  kikarebwa n’abantu 8,079,020.

title: Hagaragajwe ko udushya mu ikusanyamakuru twafasha Afurika kugera ku iterambere rirambye
content: Mu nama iteraniye i Kigali yiga ku guhanga udushya mu ikoranabuhanga ry’ikusanyamakuru hagamijwe gushyira mu bikorwa intego 17 z’iterambere rirambye, hagaragajwe ko igenamigambi ry’igihugu rishingira kumenya amakuru y’ibikorwa, aho bigiye gukorerwa n’abagenerwabikorwa ku buryo bikwiye gushyira imbaraga mu kumenya ayo makuru yose. Ibyo ngo byafasha ibihugu kumenya amakuru no kuyasesengura ku buryo bworoshya kandi mu gihe gito ku buryo byafasha gushyira mu bikorwa intego z’iterambere rirambye. Igihugu ngo gishobora kumenya amakuru ku gace runaka gishaka gukoreramo igikorwa kikabasha kwihuta nk’uko u Rwanda rwabashije kubarura kandi rugatanga ibyemezo by’ubutaka. Kimwe n’urwo rugero ngo ahagiye  kubakwa ishuri bituma igihugu kimenya umubare w’abanyeshuri bahari n’amashuri akenewe, bikamera bityo no mu zindi nzego zirimo ubumenyi bw’ikirere, amakarita y’uduce tw’ahantu, imigezi igihugu gifite n’ingano yayo, umubare w’abaturage n’andi makuru igihugu gikenera mu igenamigambi. Umuyobozi w’umuryango Nyafurika uteza imbere ikusanyamakuru(EIS Africa), Sives Govender, yavuze ko nibura 99% y’ibyemezo abayobozi bafata bisaba ko babanza kwibaza ibyo bagiye gukora aho bagiye kubikorera, abo bizagirira inyungu ndatse niba n’aho hantu hakwiye, ariryo kusanyamakuru bakenera mu byemezo byabo bya buri munsi. Ati “Wakwibaza ngo ni gute igihugu giteganyiriza ubureri mu mashuri abanza. Ikibazo cya mbere kizaba ngo abaturage banjye bari he, amashuri ari he? Aho ugiye gukorera igikorwa ni ingenzi. Mu buzima, ni he hari icyorezo, ni he gikomeye? Ni ukuvuga ngo kwibaza ngo ni he ni ikibazo gikomeye ushaka gukemura ikibazo runaka, iryo ni ryo kusanyamakuru.” Icyakora avuga ko ubushakashatsi buheruka bwerekanye 1/3 cy’ibuhugu bya Afurika aribyo bifite Politiki isobanutse yo gukusanya no gusesengura amakuru yafasha kugera ku ntego z’iterambere rirambye, ati “urugendo ruracyari rurerure”. Minisitiri muri Minisiteri y’Ikoranabuhanga na Inovasiyo, Paula Ingabire yavuze ko ibijyanye no kugira amakuru n’imibare byafashije u Rwanda kugera ku ntego z’icyerekezo 2020. Bimwe mu bikorwa byakozwe birimo kubarura ubutaka no gutanga ibyemezo byabwo ku baturage, ngo byashobotse kubera u Rwanda ruri kwimakaza ikoranabuhanga. Ati “Ikigo cy’Ibarurishamibare, gikoresha imibare mu bushakashatsi butandukanye harimo kugaragaza ubwiyongere bw’abaturage, bigaragaza ibikenewe ahantu runaka.” Umuyobozi mukuru wungirije wa Kaminuza y’u Rwanda ibarizwamo ikigo cy’ikusanyamakuru (GIS center) Philippe cotton, avuga ko aho u Rwanda rugeze ari nk’aho rwabwiye umusozi ngo imuka. Yavuze ko amasomo bigisha yerekeye uburyo abanyeshuri bashobora kugira icyo bahindura arebana n’imijyi yunganira Kigali, ubuzima, uburezi n’izindi nzego z’ubuzima kugira ngo bazabashe gutanga umusanzu wabo basoje amasomo. Abagera kuri 500 bo mu bihugu bya Afurika, bateraniye i Kigali mu nama ya 16 y’ibyerekeye ubumenyi bw’isi n’isanzure bunguranamo ibitekerezo ku guhanga udushya mu gukusanya no gukoresha amakuru, hagamijwe kugera ku ntego 17 z’iterambere rirambye. title: Ibyishimo bya Ambasaderi wa EU ku munsi wa mbere akoresheje telefoni ikorerwa mu Rwanda
content: Ni nyuma y’uko Umuryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi mu Rwanda usuye uruganda rukorera telefoni i Masoro mu Karere ka Gasabo rwa ‘Mara Phone’. Yabitangaje yifashishije ubutumwa yanditse ku rubuga rwe rwa Twitter buherekejwe n’ifoto afite telefoni ku gutwi agaragaza akanyamuneza. Yabuherekesheje amagambo agira ati “Abagize Umuryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi baba mu Rwanda basuye Mara Phone, uruganda rwa mbere rukora telefoni ku mugabane [wa Afurika].” Yakomeje agira ati “Kuvuga ni ugutaruka nishimiye kuba natangiye gukoresha telefoni yakorewe mu Rwanda.” Uru ruganda rukora ubwoko bubiri bwa Mara Phones aribwo Mara Z na Mara X, zombi zijyamo SIM Card ebyiri. Mara Z igura 175 750 Frw naho Mara X igura 120 250 Frw. Mara Z ikoresha internet nke kandi yihuta ugereranyije na telefoni zisanzwe, ku buryo niba ari ibintu ushaka gushyira kuri internet (upload) byihuta kuri megabits 150 ku isegonda naho kubikuraho (download) bikaba megabits 300 ku isegonda, bitewe n’uko iyi telefoni ikoresha umuyoboro wa internet wa 4.5 G. Inakoranye Android One. Ifite camera y’imbere n’iy’inyuma buri imwe ifite megapixels 13, batiri ifite ubushobozi bwa 3075 mAh; ubushobozi bwo kumenya igikumwe cya nyirayo n’ikirahuri gikomeye kandi kibona neza cyo mu bwoko bwa Gorilla Glass gikorwa n’uruganda rwa Corning Inc rwo muri Amerika. Mara X nayo ifite batiri irambana umuriro ya 3500 mAh, camera y’imbere ifite megapixels eshanu n’iy’inyuma ya megapixels 13; ububiko bwa 16 GB na RAM ya 1GB. Yo niba ushaka gushyira ibintu kuri internet bishobora kwihuta kuri megabits 50 ku isegonda, naho kubikuraho bikihuta kuri megabits 150 ku isegonda. Ifite nayo ikirahuri cya Corning Gorilla Glass n’ubushobozi bwo gukoresha igikumwe mu kuyifunga cyangwa kuyifungura. Yo ikoresha Android Go ituma yorohera abayikoresha mu bijyanye n’ibyo itwara. Nicola Bellomo uhagarariye Umuryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi (EU) mu Rwanda ni umwe muri ba Ambasaderi 10 bakiriwe na Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame muri Mutarama 2018. Nyuma yo gushyikiriza Umukuru w’Igihugu impapuro zimwemerera guhagararira EU mu Rwanda, yabwiye itangazamakuru ko ikimuzanye ari ugukomeza umubano mwiza usanzwe hagati y’u Rwanda na EU, bikanakomereza ku mugabane wa Afurika. Ubwo yizihizaga umunsi wahariwe Ubumwe bw’u Burayi (Europe Day), muri Gicurasi 2018 nabwo yijeje u Rwanda ubufatanye mu kwiteza imbere no kwishakamo ibisubizo hagamijwe ko narwo rugira ubushobozi rugahagarika kubeshwaho n’inkunga z’amahanga. Uruganda rwa Mara Phone ni urwa mbere muri Afurika rukora telefoni zigezweho za smartphones rwafunguwe ku mugaragaro na Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame mu Ukwakira 2019. Nyuma rwaguriye ibikorwa mu bindi bihugu birimo Afurika y’Epfo.

title: Intumbero za Goffin ushaka gutangiza mu Rwanda ikoranabuhanga rikora robot
content: Uyu mugabo ni umwe mu batse ijambo maze ageza ku Mukuru w’Igihugu icyifuzo cye cyo gutangiza mu Rwanda ibikorwa bya Sosiyete ye ikora ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga nyuma y’uko akoreye mu bindi bice by’Isi birimo u Buyapani, u  Bushinwa n’ibindi by’i Burayi. Icyo gihe yananyujijemo mu mvugo isa no gutebya asaba Umukuru w’Igihugu itike y’indege nyuma y’uko yari amaze kuyiha umukobwa wamubwiye ko arangije amasomo y’ubuganga mu Bufaransa akaba ashaka gutaha agakorera mu gihugu cye cy’amavuko. Mu cyumweru gishize, Fabrice Goffin yageze mu Rwanda atiriwe ategereza itike y’Umukuru w’Igihugu. Uyu mugabo yaganiriye na IGIHE asobanura byimbitse uburyo yagize inyota yo gukorera mu Rwanda akahatangiza ibikorwa bya sosiyete ye yitwa Zora Bots ikora ibijyanye na robot. Goffin yavuze ko hari inshuti ye yigeze kumutumira mu muhango wo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, ahageze aganira na Ambasaderi Amandin Rugira, wamutumiye muri Rwanda Day kugira ngo amenye byinshi ku Rwanda. Ni umuntu utari ufite amakuru menshi kuri Afurika kuko igihugu yari yaragezemo cyari “ Afurika y’Epfo gusa nagiye mu biruhuko“. Kuri we kwitabira Rwanda Day byamufunguye amaso, bimwereka ko hari amahirwe menshi yabyaza umusaruro niko gufata iya mbere agana i Kigali. Mu 2011, Goffin wari ufite indoto zo gushaka gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo abona muri filimi za Star Wars, we na mugenzi we bashinze ikompanyi ikora ibijyanye na robots. Ati “Ntabwo nigeze niga iby’ikoranabuhanga, nize ibijyanye n’ubukungu. Uwo dufatanyije ikompanyi yahagaritse kwiga afite imyaka 18.” Bakoze Zora, robots imaze guca agahigo ku Isi Mu 2013 nibwo ibikorwa bya Goffin byatangiye nyuma y’imyaka ibiri yo kugerageza. Icyo gihe yabonye umukiliya wa mbere wamubwiye ko ashaka robot ifasha abana. Ati “Twarayikoze mu buryo butatekerezwaga kuko twashakaga kujya mu mahoteli kubereka uburyo robot zabafasha ariko bakatubwira bati ntituzikeneye.” Muri iki gihe Goffin na mugenzi we ntibakora robot uko yakabaye ahubwo bagura icyo umuntu yakwita nk’umubiri wazo, barangiza bo bagashyiramo ikoranabuhanga bakoze ku buryo zikora ibyo rizitegetse. Ubu bamaze gukora ubwoko burindwi bwa robot. Imwe muri izi yamenyekanye cyane ni Zora, robot ishobora kuvuga, kugenda, kubyina n’ibindi. Ati “Ibyo ugomba kwitega muri iyi minsi kuri robot, ni uko itaje ngo ikore akazi kawe kose ka buri munsi, ugomba kugira inshingano zawe waba uri mu rugo cyangwa se niba ari ikompanyi. Ugomba kubona robot nk’igikoresho cyo kugufasha aho kuba icyo kugusimbura. Ibyo Zora ishobora gukora, ni ugutanga amakuru ya nyayo kuko aba yarashyizwe muri robot.” “Ni amakuru ajyanye n’ikibazo icyo aricyo cyose waba ufite. Urugero winjiye nko mu isoko, kandi ufite ikibazo ku gikoresho runaka. Biragoye ku muntu ko ibintu byose yaba abifite mu mutwe. Kuri robot biratandukanye, icyo bisaba ni ukubishyira mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga.” Kugira ngo Zora ikore, umuntu agomba kuba afite ‘tablet’ akaba ariyo yifashisha mu kuyibwira ibyo ikora, yaba guhagarara, kugenda, cyangwa se ikindi. Mu bihugu by’u Burayi, aho ikoreshwa hari nk’aho abaganga bayishyiramo ikoranabuhanga ku buryo iganira n’abarwayi baba bamaze igihe kinini mu bitaro ku buryo baba baramaze kwinubira kuganira n’abaganga. Icyo gihe umuganga aganira n’umurwayi yifashishije robot, niba ari nk’umurwayi utagishaka kunywa imiti ariko yarabihishe umuganga, ugasanga yisanzuye kuri robot arayibibwiye, muganga akabimenya atyo. Ibi bikora cyane mu bitaro biba byita ku bantu bageze mu za bukuru. Ati “Hari umugore wari ufite uburwayi bw’umutima, ntabwo yari agifata imiti ye ariko ntiyabibwiraga umuganga. Yaje kubibwira robot arangije arayibwira ati ntubibwire muganga.” Gahunda y’imikorere mu Rwanda Goffin asobanura ko ataje mu Rwanda kugira ngo acuruze robot ze kuko aho igihugu kigeza magingo aya, zitari zakenerwa ku bwinshi. Kuri we, arashaka kugirana imikoranire n’inzego z’uburezi ku buryo zakwifashisha ikoranabuhanga rikoresha robot mu kwigisha abakiri bato uko zikora ku buryo bazakura bafite ubushobozi bwo kwikorera robot ubwabo. Ati “Ndashaka kuganira na Minisitiri w’Uburezi n’uw’Ikoranabuhanga, tukareba uburyo twafasha mu bigo by’amashuri mu gutegura abanyeshuri by’ahazaza. Ntabwo ndi hano kugira ngo ngurishe robot, ntabwo numva ko zikenewe mu Rwanda mu kazi ka buri munsi. Icyo nshaka ni ugufasha abanyeshuri mbaha ikoranabuhanga [software] mu kubategura mu mpinduramatwara iri kuza.” Atanga urugero kuri mudasobwa, ubwo zatangiraga gukorwa, Microsoft yatanze mu bigo bitandukanye ku Isi ‘windows’ kugira ngo abanyeshuri batangire kugira ubumenyi bwo kuba bazikoresha, yaba mu gukoresha porogaramu zirimo Word, Excel n’izindi. Ati “Ni twe twenyine ku Isi dufite software ishobora gukora muri robot zose. Mu myaka iri imbere robot nyinshi zizajya ku isoko, niba ufite porogaramu ishobora gukora kuri izi robot zose, ni amahirwe ku rubyiruko, ku bayikoresha no kuba abantu bamenyera gukoresha robot.” Zora mu bihugu ikoreshwamo yishyurwa bitewe n’impamvu zitandukanye zirimo igihugu n’icyo igenewe. Mu bihugu bimwe by’u Burayi, habaho kuyikodesha ku kwezi abayishaka bakajya bishyura. Gusa hari n’abashobora kuyigura ariko igiciro cyayo gishobora kugera no ku ma-euro ibihumbi 20 cyangwa 30 bitewe n’imiterere yayo. Mu Bufaransa hari ibitaro yagurishijwemo ibihumbi 18 by’ama-euro. title: Uburyo bushya bwo kwerekana amashusho bwa Disney plus na Netflix bushobora gohombya televiziyo nyinshi
content: Ibi bigo sibyo byonyine kuko hari n’ibindi biteganya gutangira ubu buryo bushya bwo kwerekana amashusho harimo nka HBO Max na Peacock. Uku kuvuka umusubirizo kw’ibigo byerekana amashusho binyuze kuri internet, gukomeje guhangayikisha abatari bake kuko bitera kugabanuka kw’imibare y’abakoresha televiziyo, kuko ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’ikinyamakuru Bralin  buvuga ko hagati y’umwaka wa 2014 na 2015 abakoreshaga televiziyo bagabanutseho 8% kandi ko bagenda barushaho kugabanuka uko imyaka iza. Umuyobozi wa Netflix, Reed Hastings we yabwiye Business Insider ko ikoreshwa rya televiziyo rishobora kutazarenza mu 2030 . Bimwe mu bishingirwaho n’abasesenguzi, bavuga ko ubu buryo bushya bwo kwerekana amashusho binyuze kuri internet bushobora kuzahombya amateleviziyo harimo kuba ibiciro biri hasi ugereranyije n’ifatabuguzi ry’amateleviziyo kuko nka Apple TV plus ifatabuguzi ry’ukwezi ari $4.99 naho irya HBO Max rikaba $15. Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’ikigo cyAbanyamerika,  SurveyMonkey hagamijwe kureba uko ikoreshwa rya televiziyo rihaze ugereranyije no kureba Video kuri internet, bwerekanye ko mu bantu 500 bakoreweho ubushakashatsi, 250 bavuze ko bagikoresha uburyo bwo kureba televiziyo  ari abari  hejuru y’imyaka 60, mu gihe abakoresha uburyo bwombi ari 22%  naho 27% biganjemo urubyiruko (imyaka 18-29) bo bavuze ko bakoresha uburyo bwa internet gusa. Igiteye impungege muri ubu bushakashatsi ndetse kikarushaho gushyira mu kaga ikoreshwa rya Televiziyo ni uko abagera kuri  58.5 %  bavuze ko uburyo bwo kureba amashusho hifashishijwe internet ari bwo buhendutse, ndetse 60% by’abakoresha televiziyo bakavuga ko bateganya kubireka nabo bagatangira gukoresha uburyo bwo kureba amashusho hifashishijwe internet. Ibiciro biri hasi, kuba umuntu yakwihitiramo icyo ashaka kureba aho yaba ari hose, kutavangirwa n’amashusho yamamaza ndetse n’ubushobozi bwo gusubiza inyuma cyangwa guhagarika gato amashusho, nibyo bikomeje gutera abatari bake kuyoboka ubu buryo bushya bwo kureba filimi n’ibiganiro bitandukanye. Imibare yashyizwe hanze mu 2019 na Netflix yerekana ko yo yonyine ubu imaze kugira abayikurikira miliyoni 151 ku Isi hose.

title: Urubyiruko rwamuritse imishinga mishya irimo uwo kororera amafi imusozi, gusudiza umunyu n’indi
content:
Iyi mishinga bayimuritse kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 15 Ugushyingo ubwo hizihizwaga umunsi Mpuzamahanga wa siyansi wizihirijwe mu Karere ka Rwamagana mu ishuri rikuru ry’imyuga n’ubumenyingiro rya IPRC Gishari. Umunsi Mpuzamahanga wahariwe Siyansi umaze imyaka 20 wemejwe n’ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye rigamije guteza imbere ubumenyi n’umuco UNESCO, watangiye kwizihizwa mu mwaka wa 2002, naho mu Rwanda watangiye kwizihizwa mu mwaka wa 2009. Leta y’u Rwanda ifite intego ko mu 2024 abanyeshuri biga amashuri y’imyuga n’ubumenyi ngiro bazagera kuri 60% nyuma yo kubona ko ariho hashobora kuboneka guhanga no gutanga imirimo mu buryo bworoshye. Umushinga wa Safari wo gusudira yifashishije umunyu n’amazi witezweho gufasha abasudira
 Safari Ben ni umunyeshuri wiga mu ishuri rikuru ry’imyuga n’ubumenyingiro rya Gishari. Yifatanyije na bagenzi be batangiza umushinga wo gusudira bifashishije umunyu n’amazi. Bavuga ko babikoze bagamije gufasha abashaka gukora uyu mwuga bategereye amashanyarazi, ikindi ngo  bagira ngo bagabanye ingano y’amashanyarazi akoreshwa muri uyu mwuga. Yagize ati “ Twahisemo gukoresha ubu buryo bwo gufata indobo tugashyiramo amazi ndetse n’umunyu bifite ibipimo kugira ngo dufashe abantu bashaka gusudira badakoresheje amashanyarazi, nko muri litiro 20 z’amazi dushyiramo umunyu ungana na garama 500, ibyo byasudira nk’urugi rumwe hamwe n’idirishya.” Safari avuga ko kugira ngo ubu buryo babugurishe umuturage usanzwe bimusaba ibihumbi 32 by’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ngo biteze ko buzakundwa n’abantu benshi. Hirwa yakoze Porogaramu ya telefone izajya yifashishwa mu kurinda imodoka
 Hirwa Aime Patrick wigisha mu ishuri rikuru rya IPRC Gishari  we yakoze software izajya yifashishwa muri telefone mu kurinda imodoka hifashishijwe gufunga moteri n’ibindi bintu bitandukanye bituma imodoka yaka. Yagize ati “ Software yacu iyo uyifite ntabwo umuntu ashobora gufungura imodoka yawe utamuhaye uburenganzira nubwo yaba yakwibye urufunguzo ntibyakunda, byemera iyo umuhaye uburenganzira wifashishije telefone yawe.” Hirwa avuga ko ubu buryo babugurisha ibihumbi 300 Frw ngo yabugerageje kuri moteri z’imodoka zitandukanye asanga burakora neza ngo mu minsi iri imbere arashaka kuyimurikira abanyarwanda. Musabyimana yakoze uburyo butuma amafi yororerwa imusozi
 Musabyimana Chantal, umukobwa w’imyaka 23 wiga mu ishuri rikuru ry’imyuga n’ubumenyingiro rya IPRC Kitabi, yakoze uburyo butuma hororerwa amafi i Musozi. Ubu buryo yabukoze kugira ngo afashe abantu batuye i Musozi korora amafi nabo bakayaryaho. Musabyimana avuga ko kuri ubu afite ibyuzi yororeramo amafi imusozi kandi ngo biri gutanga umusaruro mwinshi. Ati “ Ibisabwa nuko ugira ubushake ubundi ukagira ubutaka bwo kororeraho ayo mafi, ubundi ukajya usukamo amazi y’isoko, ishwagara n’andi mafumbire ya Kinyarwanda, ibyo iyo umaze kubikora uba washyiramo amafi bigakunda kuko ishwagara rituma ya mafi yisanga kuri bwa butaka ntagire ikibazo.” Tuyizere yakoze ikoranabuhanga rigenzura imyotsi ibinyabiziga bisohora
 Tuyizere Emmanuel wiga mu ishuri rikuru ry’imyuga n’ubumenyingiro i Karongi yakoze ikoranabuhanga rizajya rigenzura imyotsi ibinyabiziga bisohora ryabona riri guhumanya ikirere rikaburira umushoferi kujya gukoresha imodoka. Ubu buryo ngo buzatuma imibare y’imodoka zihumanya ikirere igabanuka ive kuri 80% kuri ubu iriho. Ati “ Ibipimo byagenwe iyo  birenze rya koranabuhanga ryacu rihita rihagarika shoferi akabanza kujya gukoresha imodoka aho gukomeza kugenda ahumanya ikirere, nituyishyira ku isoko izaba igura ibihumbi 140 Frw kandi turateganya kuyishyira ku isoko mu minsi ya vuba cyane.” Tuyizere avuga ko kuri ubu akigorwa no kubona ibikoresho byo kwifashisha mu kuyikora bitewe nuko amafaranga abiguze ari menshi agasaba leta kumufasha mu kubona ibikoresho no kuyimenyekanisha mu bantu bafite imodoka. Umunyamabanga wa leta muri minisiteri y’uburezi Dr Isaac Munyakazi yavuze ko bishimiye cyane uburyo abanyeshuri bari kubyaza umusaruro amasomo bahabwa bavumbura bimwe mu bintu bitanga ibisubizo ku muryango nyarwanda. Yabijeje ko ibyo bari kuvumbura bitazigera bizimira ahubwo bazabafasha mu kubimenyekanisha. Yongeyeho ati “Uburezi turiho dutanga uyu munsi, ni ubufasha abana tubaha kutajya ku isoko ngo batangire gushaka akazi ahubwo turifuza ko abenshi bazajya bajya ku isoko barateguye neza icyo bagiye kwikorera.” Insanganyamatsiko y’umunsi Mpuzamahanga wa siyansi uyu mwaka igira iti “ Ubumenyi, umusemburo w’amahoro n’iterambere rirambye kandi ubumenyi bufunguriye bose nta n’umwe usigaye inyuma.”

title: Facebook imaze gufunga konti miliyari 5.4 muri uyu mwaka
content: Ni umubare wazamutse cyane ugereranyije na miliyari 3.3 za konti za baringa zasibwe mu mwaka ushize wose, mu gihe uyu utaranarangira. Bibarwa ko nibura mu bagera kuri miliyari 2.5 bakoresha Facebook, buri kwezi haba harimo 5% bakoresha konti za baringa, nubwo iki kigo cyatangiye gukoresha ikoranabuhanga rifasha mu gutahura bene izo konti zigifungurwa. Ni igikorwa kigaragaza imbogamizi urwo rubuga rufite nko muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika hateganyijwe amatora ya perezida mu mwaka utaha. Ni ibintu abahanga bahamya ko bishobora kuzaha urwaho ikwirakwizwa ry’impuha zishobora kuyobya cyangwa zikagira uruhare mu kugena ibiva mu matora, nk’uko byagenze mu 2016. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Facebook, Mark Zuckerberg, yabwiye abanyamakuru kuri uyu wa Gatatu ko umubare munini wa konti zasibwe ugaragaza uburyo iki kigo cyahaye umwihariko icyo kibazo. Ati "Kubera ko umubare ari munini ntabwo bivuze ko hari ya makuru abangamye ku bwinshi. Ahubwo bivuze ko turimo gukora ibishoboka byose ngo dutahure ayo makuru, niyo mpamvu umubare [wa konti zasibwe] wabaye munini.” Iyi niyo raporo ishyira ibintu mu mucyo igiye hanze irimo n’amakuru avuga kuri Instagram. Ivuga ko hagati ya Mata na Nzeri, Facebook yasibye ubutumwa miliyoni eshatu bwarenze ku mabwiriza abuza ubutumwa bujyanye no gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge. Hari kandi ubutumwa 95000 bwajyanaga n’icuruzwa ry’imbunda. Kuri Facebook hasibwe ubutumwa miliyoni zirindwi bwabibaga urwango hagati ya Nyakanga na Nzeri, aho bwiyongereye kuri 60% ugereranyije n’ubwatahuwe hagati ya Mata na Kamena.

title: Imare amatsiko ku mibereho y’ahazaza mu Isi y’imashini zikora nk’abantu
content: Uyu munsi kugira ngo akazi kawe kagende neza bisaba ko wowe n’abagufasha mu bigiramo uruhare 100%, niba ushaka kurya bisaba ko icyo biri bugusabe cyose ukikorera niba udafite undi muntu ugufasha, niba uri umuhinzi nabyo ni uko. Ubu buzima mu myaka mike iri imbere bushobora kuzasigara ari inkuru ubarira abuzukuru n’abazukuruza bawe ndetse bo bakayifata nk’umugani kuko icyo gihe bazaba babona byose bikorwa n’imashini. Mu bihugu byateye imbere izi mashini zigeze ku rwego zishobora gukora kazi vuba ndetse neza kurusha umuntu. Lego Robot mu mwaka wa 2015 yaciye agahigo ko gukina neza kandi vuba umukino uzwi nka ‘Rubik’s Cube’ mu gihe kitageze ku isegonda mu gihe umuntu ufite agahigo ko kuwukina vuba akoresha amasegonda ane. Ibi byerekana ubushobozi izi mashini zifite mu gukora ibintu neza kandi vuba, ibi bikaba byitezweho kuzahindura ubuzima bw’abatuye Isi Bimwe mu bihugu byatangiye kwifashisha izi mashini zikora nk’abantu mu mirimo itandukanye irimo iyo mu nganda, ubuhinzi, ubuvuzi ndetse no mu bya gisirakare ndetse hakaba hari kugeragezwa izindi zifite n’imikorere n’ubwenge bujya gusatira ubwa muntu neza. Iri koranabuhanga ry’imashini zifite imikorere nk’iy’abantu no buhinzi ntiryahejwe kuko izi mashini zizajya zikora imirimo abantu bari basazwe bakora muri uru rwego irimo iyo gutera, gusarura ndetse no gupakira imyaka. Ikigo cy’Abanyamerika gishinzwe iby’ubumenyi bw’isanzure, (NASA)  kuri ubu cyatangiye kwifashisha imashini zirimo izitwa Mars rovers, Curiosity na Spirit Opportunity kivuga ko gukoresha izi imashini mu buvumbuzi bigabanya ibyago abantu bari guhura nabyo kubera ko bitewe n’uko umuntu aremye hari aho bigoranye ko yagera, niyo mpamvu mu mirimo yacyo y’ubuvumbuzi irimo iyo mu isanzure no mu ndiba z’inyanja cyatangiye kwifashisha izi mashini. Imashini zikora nk’abantu kandi zirimo izitwa Cyber cockroach swarms, Walk-Man, The shape-shifter mu minsi iri imbere zishobora kuzarinda abantu gutikirira mu bikorwa by’ubutabazi igihe habaye inkangu, umwuzure, inkongi kubera ko icyo gihe nizo zizakora akazi kose k’ubutabazi. igisirikare cya Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika nacyo cyatangiye kugerageza ikoreshwa rya robo mu bikorwa byo gutega no gutegura ibisasu ndetse kuri ubu ikigo gikora za robo cyitwa ‘Boston Dynamics’ cyakoze igerageza ry’imwe mu mashini ishobora kujya ku rugamba ikarwana ndetse ikaba ifite akarusho ko kudahusha intego, ibi nibikunda bishobora kuzagabanya umubare w’abasirikare ibihugu bikoresha. Sosiyete zitandukanye z’ubucuruzi zamaze gushima imikorere y’izi mashini ndetse bakaba babibona nk’ibintu bizatanga inyungu kuko bishimiye uburyo zikora ibintu neza kandi vuba, zikagira n’akarusho ko kutananirwa nk’uko bigenda iyo ukoresha umuntu. Nubwo  abenshi bishimira ikoreshwa ry’izi mashini,  hari abandi benshi bahangayikishijwe na zimwe mu ngaruka zishobora gutera nk’ibura ry’akazi ndetse no kuba zakwigaranzura ikiremwa muntu igihe zaba zimenye ubwenge bwa nyabwo.

title: AC Group yazanye ikoranabuhanga rya Tap&Go ku bagenzi bajya mu ntara
content: Iri koranabuhanga ryari rimaze kumenyererwa mu Mujyi wa Kigali rigiye kugezwa mu ntara ariko mu buryo bugezweho kuko umuntu atazajya agura ikarita kandi bizajya bikorerwa kuri telefone by’umwihariko abafite smartphones. Ubuyobozi bwa AC Group bwasobanuye ko niba umuntu ashaka kujya nk’i Rubavu azajya afata  telefone ye agashaka Porogaramu ya Tap&Go ukinjiramo hanyuma ugafungura konti yawe ukoresheje amazina na nimero za telefone hanyuma ukabona aho kugurira itike bitewe n’aho ugiye. Ni ukuvuga ngo ubutaha niba ugiye kugura itike ntabwo uzongera gufungura konti ahubwo winjiramo ukagaragaza aho ugiye n’isaha ushaka kugendera hanyuma niba wenda uri muri Kigali bakakwereka imodoka ziri muri gare ziri ku murongo iyo saha ugendera hanyuma ugahitamo iyo mujyana ukishyura amafaranga ukoresheje Mobile Money. Umaze kwishyura bahita baguha kode izwi nka QR ari nayo ujyana ugakoza ku cyuma mu modoka zijya mu ntara kizwi nka BV. Ku badafite telefone zigezweho nabo bazajya bafashwa na bakozi b’iki kigo batanga amatike y’urugendo. Umuyobozi ushinzwe imibanire n’itumanaho muri AC Group, Allen Kendunga yabwiye IGIHE, ko ubu buryo buzafasha cyane abagenzi bajya mu ntara kubungabunga amafaranga yabo ndetse bukanaborohereza kugura itike aho baba bari hose. Yakomeje agira ati “Ubu buryo bushya buzafasha abantu benshi mu buryo bwo kubungabunga amafaranga yabo kuko batazayagendana mu ntoki ariko kandi bizafasha kudahererekanya amafaranga ndetse ni uburyo bwiza bwo kurengera ibidukikije twirinda gukoresha no guta impapuro hirya no hino.” Yakomeje agira ati “Abatarabona telefone zigezweho bazajya babona itike kuko tuzashyiraho abaduhagarariye ahantu hose abantu bari basanzwe bakatishiriza tike.” Ubuyobozi bwa AC Group butangaza ko ubu buryo buzatangizwa ku mugaragaro kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 13 Ugushyingo 2019.

title: WhatsApp yazanye uburyo bushya butuma ntawe ushyirwa muri ‘Group’ atabishaka
content: Uburyo bushya bwongewe kuri WhatsApp buzajya bukorana n’ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga bikoresha Android na  iOS, aho umuntu ari we uzajya atanga uburenganzira mbere yo gushyirwa mu itsinda runaka. Kugira ngo bikunde, ukoresha WhatsApp  ajya ahanditse Settings, agakanda ahanditse Account > Privacy > Groups hanyuma  akabona  ahanditse utuntu dutatu aritwo  “Everyone,” “My Contacts,” cyangwa  “My Contacts Except…” Mu gihe uhisemo ahanditse “My Contacts” uzaba wemeje ko umwe mu bantu bari muri telefone yawe afite uburenganzira bwo kugushyira mu rindi tsinda (group) rya WhatsApp . Nuhitamo ahanditse “My Contacts Except” uhita ujya ahandi haguha uburyo bwo kuba waha undi muntu utari mu bari muri telefone yawe, uburenganzira bwo kuba yagushyira mu rindi tsinda rya WhatsApp. Mu gihe umuntu ashatse kugushyira mu itsinda runaka bikanga, hazajya haza uburyo akoherereza ubutumwa bugusaba kwemera akagushyira muri iryo tsinda. Mu gihe bakwandikitye bagusaba gutanga uburenganzira ukinjizwa mu itsinda rishya, uzajya uba ufite iminsi itatu yo gusubiza. WhatsApp yatangaje ko ubu buryo bwatangiye gukoreshwa guhera kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 7 Ugushyingo mu bice bimwe na bimwe ku isi, aho bitaragera bikazahagera mu minsi iri imbere. Uru rubuga nkoranyambaga rw’umuherwe, Mark Zuckerberg rukoreshwa n’abasaga miliyari 1.5 ku isi hose.

title: U Bushinwa bwatangije ku mugaragaro ikoreshwa rya  internet ya 5G
content: Ibi bigo ni China Mobile (CHL), China Telecom (CHA) na  China Unicom (CHU). Ikinyamakuru CNN cyatangaje ko biteganyijwe ko uzajya akoresha iyi internet, azajya yishyura ama yuan 128 akoreshwa mu Bushinwa,  ni ukuvuga amadorali 18 , ahwanye n’amanyarwanda ibihumbi 16. Aya azajya agura GB 30 buri kwezi. Internet ya 5G yihuta inshuro 100 kurenza iya 4G, ikaba ishobora gukoreshwa n’ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga byinshi icyarimwe. Kugeza ubu iyi internet ya 5G iragaragara mu Mijyi 50 harimo uwa Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou na Shenzhen, nk’uko  Ibiro Ntaramakuru byAbashinwa, Xinhua byabitangaje. Mu Mujyi wa Shanghai, ahantu harenga ibihumbi 12 hamaze gushyirwaho mu gufasha mu itangwa ry’iyi internet. Kugeza ubu mu bihugu birimo Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika na Korea y’Epfo nabyo byamaze gutangiza iyi internet ariko mu Mijyi imwe yatoranijwe. Kugeza ubu ariko  igihugu cy’u Bushinwa nicyo kigaragaza ubwiganze bukomeye mu bijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga ku rwego rw’isi. u Bushinwa nicyo  gihugu gifite abakoresha internet benshi kuko bagera kuri miliyoni 850. Abasesenguzi bavuga ko u Bushinwa buzaba bufite abakoresha 5G bangana na miliyoni 110 mu 2020. Koreya y’Epfo yo yatangije ikoranabuhanga ryayo rya 5G muri Mata uyu mwaka, kugeza ubu abangana na 3% by’abatuye iki gihugu nibo bayikoresha. Ikigo gikomeye mu by’ikoranabuhanga cya Huawei, nicyo kiyoboye mu gukora iri koranabuhanga. Huawei iri ku gitutu muri Amerika aho iki gihugu cyamaganye iri koranabuhanga ryayo. Amerika yanasabye ibihugu bitandukanye ku Isi guhagarika ibikoreshyo by’iki kigo bitanga iyo internet, kuko ngo bikoreshwa n’u Bushinwa mu buryo bwo kuneka. Nubwo Huawei yahuye n’izi mbogamizi, yo ivuga ko ikomeje kubona abakiriya batari bake. Ivuga ko muri uku kwezi imaze gusinyana amasezerano n’ibigo 60 bikoresha 5G hirya no hino ku Isi.

title: iPhone 5 muri telefoni zishobora gutakaza ubushobozi bumwe kuri iki Cyumweru
content: Ubutumwa bwa Apple buvuga ko guhera kuri iki Cyumweru saa sita z’ijoro, iPhone na  iPad  zageze ku isoko mu 2012 na mbere yaho, niziba zitarashyirwamo iOS 10.3.4 zizatakaza ubushobozi bwo gukoresha App Store, iCloud, email no gusura imbuga za internet, kubera ko bisaba ko igikoresho kiba gifite amasaha n’amatariki byizewe, bitangwa na GPS. Gusa ibikoresho bishya byo nta kibazo bifite, mu gihe nk’ibimaze igihe ku isoko bya iPhone5, iPhone 4S, iPad mini, iPad 2, bizasaba ko ababitunze babanza kujyanisha n’igihe iOS bikoresha. Apple yakomeje iti “Niba kujyanisha n’igihe iPhone 5 bidakozwe mbere ya tariki 3 Ugushyingo 2019, kubikora bizasaba ko wifashisha mudasobwa kuko uburyo umuntu aba ashobora kubyikorera na telefoni cyangwa iCloud Backup bitazakora.” Mu kujyanisha n’igihe iOS y’ibi bikoresho, abakoresha ibicuruzwa bya Apple basabwa kujya aho bagenera imikorere ya telefoni zabo (settings), akaba ariho babikorera. Nyuma ngo ibyo bikoresho bizaba bifite iOS 10.3.4 cyangwa 9.3.6 bitewe n’igikoresho, bitabaye ibyo, serivisi zimwe zizahagaragara guhera kuri iki Cyumweru.

title: U Burusiya mu mugambi uzabufasha gushwanyuza ibibuye bishobora kugonga Isi
content: Mu bihe bitandukanye ibigo bikora ubushakashatsi mu isanzure byagiye bigaragaza ko hari ibibuye (Asteroids) bishobora kuzagonga Isi, harimo n’icyitwa 2019 XO1, ikigo cya Nasa giherutse gutangaza ko ku bw’amahirwe cyahushije Isi ku wa 13 Ugushyingo 2019. Umukozi wa Roscosmos yabwiye ibiro ntaramakuru by’Abarusiya ko impamvu y’iki kigo kigiye kujyaho ari ukugira ngo kigenzure by’umwihariko ibijyanye n’ibibuye bishobora kugonga Isi. Umukozi muri Roscosmos, Igor Bakaras, yavuze ko inshingano z’iki kigo kigiye gutangizwa azaba ari ukugenzura ikintu cyose gishobora kugonga Isi. Yagize Ati “Mu rwego rwo gushyiraho uburyo bwo kugenzura imikorere n’amakuru hagamijwe umutekano w’imirimo ikorerwa mu isanzure hafi y’Isi, turateganya kumurika ku mugaragaro ikigo (Russina Center for Small Celestial Bodies), kizaba gifite inshingano zo kugenzura ibiri mu isanzure bisatira Isi”. Bakaras yongeyeho ko kugira ngo uyu mugambi ugerweho hagikenewe gukora ubushakashatsi. Ati “Mbere y’uko u Burusiya bwashwanyaguza ibibuye biteye impungege, buzakenera gukora ubushakashatsi bwinshi”. Kuri ubu mu Burusiya hari gukorwa ubushakashatsi ku buryo bwose bwakwifashishwa ngo ibi bibuye bituritswe cyangwa biyobywe, burimo gukoresha icyogajuru, gukoresha imirasire y’izuba cyangwa uburyo bwo guturitsa buzwi nka ‘Rocket engine’. Ubushakashtsi butandukanye bwagiye bugaragaza ko hari ibibuye bine bishobora kuzagonga Isi mu bihe bitandukanye birimo 2014 Jo25 gishobora kugonga Isi mu 2027, hakaba 2014 AG5 gishobora kuzagonga Isi mu 2040, 99942 Apophis gishobora kuzagonga Isi mu 2068 na 101955 Bennu gishobora kuzagonga Isi mu 2182.

title: Ikigo ESSOKA  cyashyizeho uburyo ibigo bishobora guhangana n’abajura babyinjirira bakoresheje ikoranabuhanga
content: Nubwo bimeze gutya, ni nako abajura bakora ibyaha by’ikoranabuhanga nabo baboneyeho gushaka uburyo bagera ku makuru y’ibyo bigo nk’amakonti yo muri banki, gukora ibikorwa by’iterabwoba n’ibindi. Ibi bigaragara cyane muri Afurika aho uburyo bwo kwirinda ibi byaha by’ikoranabuhanga bukiri hasi. Ni muri urwo rwego, ikigo ESSOKA Corporation, cyashyizeho ishami rizobereye mu by’ikoranabuhanga ryiswe ESSOKA CyberSecurity Division (ECSD), rifite intego yo guteza imbere uburyo abantu bahangana n’ibi byaha bikoresha ikoranabuhanga, hakoreshejwe uburyo bwo kwigisha no gutanga serivisi hatangwa amahugurwa yo guhangana n’ibi byaha. ECSD, mu mushinga wayo wa Cyber4Africa (C4A), rifite intego yo gutanga ubushobozi ku banyafurika ngo bahangane n’abajura bakoresha ikoranabuhanga, biciye muri iyi gahunda yayo yahawe ibyangombwa mpuzamahanga birenga 29 bijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga no guhangana n’ibyaha bikoresheje ikoranabuhanga (cybersecurity). Umuyobozi ushinzwe ibikorwa byo guhangana n’ibyaha by’ikoranabuhanga muri ECSD, Dr. Coach Achu Gustave, avuga ko bashaka guhangana n’iki kibazo nubwo hakiri icyuho cyo guhangana nabyo muri Afurika. Ati "Uburezi butangwa ku mugabane wa Afurika buracyari ikibazo, uburyo uburezi butangwamo uyu munsi muri Afurika sibwo uyu mugabane ukeneye, ntabwo bwasubiza mu buryo bwihuse ikibazo cy’ikoranabuhanga." Dr. Coach Achu Gustave kandi asobanura ko impamvu nyamukuru y’umushinga Cyber4Africa, ari uko Afurika ishobora guhugura abantu bayo bashobora guhangana n’ibi bibazo by’ubujura bukoresheje ikoranabuhanga. Ati ’Twashyizeho gahunda yo guhugura abantu mu buryo bwo guhangana n’iki kibazo, izi gahunda zizibanda mu gutanga amahugurwa bikazatuma tugira inzobere kuri uyu mugabane zishobora kugira ubushobozi burwanya ibi byaha, zikabikora hadakenewe ubundi bufasha buvuye mu Bushinwa cyangwa mu bindi bihugu by’Abarabu." "Muri ECSD, dutanga uburyo buboneye bwo guhangana n’iki kibazo byaba muri Afurika n’ahandi ku isi dukoresheje amahugurwa mpuzahamaganga, serivisi, ubufatanye, na gahunda zikemura ibibazo bikoresheje ikoranabuhanga, bikaba bikeneye ubufatanye n’ibigo nka EC-Council, Microsoft, Cisco, CompTIA n’abandi." Dr. Coach Achu yahamagariye buri wese ufite inyungu muri gahunda z’ikoranabuhanga no gushaka guhangana n’ibi byaha bikoresha ikoranabuhanga, kugana izi gahunda na serivisi zabo, kugira ngo Afurika ibe umugabane utarimo ibi bibazo. Yavuze ko intego zabo ari ukugira uburyo bwo guhangana n’ibi byaha mu Rwanda kandi bugatangwa n’abanyarwanda.

title: RISA yahembye imishinga y’ikoranabuhanga ritanga icyizere mu koroshya ubuzima bw’abafite ubumuga
content: Imishinga itanu yahembwe yatoranyijwe muri 60 yakiriwe mu irushanwa ryateguwe hagamijwe guhanga udushya mu ikoranabuhanga ryatuma abafite ubumuga babona ibikoresho bakwifashisha bikaborohereza kujyana n’abandi mu iterambere byiswe “Innovative4DisabilityInclusion.” Ni irushanwa riri mu murongo w’intego z’iterambere rirambye na Gahunda y’Igihugu yo kwihutisha Iterambere yo gutera imbere nta Munyarwanda usigaye inyuma. Ryateguwe na RISA ifatanyije na Minisiteri y’Urubyiruko n’Umuco n’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye rishinzwe gutsura amajyambere (UNDP). Umuyobozi wa RISA, Muhizi Innocent, yavuze ko umushinga wo gushyiraho ayo marushanwa bawutekereje bamaze kubona ko abafite ubumuga batari kujyana n’abandi mu iterambere. Ati “Twasanze uko igihugu kigenda gitera imbere hari igice kimwe cy’Abanyarwanda bashobora kuzasigara inyuma na bo ntibakomeze gutera imbere nk’abandi, abo ni abafite ubumuga.” Mu mishinga yahembwe harimo ufasha abafite ubumuga kumvikana n’abatabufite batanazi ururimi rw’amarenga, aho ufite ubumuga akora amarenga akiyandika mu magambo binyuze muri Application ishyirwa muri telefoni. Uwabaye uwa kabiri ni uw’igare rya moteri ritwara abafite ubumuga ridakeneye urisunika. Ubwo yagaragazaga uwo mushinga, Byukusenge Viateur yavuze ko utwaye iryo gare azajya yitwara akoresheje telefoni cyangwa yiyobora nk’uko batwara imodoka. Ati “Ukuntu iyo ntebe ikoze ifite moteri y’ibyerekezo bine, iyo ushatse kujya imbere ukanda kujya imbere, dushyiraho ibyerekezo bitewe n’ururimi uwo muntu yumva, kujya imbere, ibumoso n’iburyo no gusubira inyuma no guhagarara. Ntabwo akenera umuntu umusunika ni we ubyikorera yashaka agakoresha na telefoni cyangwa akayobora nk’imodoka.” Umushinga wabaye uwa mbere ni uwerekeye uburyo abafite ubumuga bazajya bagaragza ibibazo byabo bikagera ku nzego zose zibishinzwe hakoreshejwe ubutumwa bugufi. Mutuyimana Célestin wakiriye miliyoni 4 Frw y’igihembo cy’uwo mushinga wahize indi yabwiye IGIHE ko watangiye gukoreshwa mu Karere ka Kamonyi. Yavuze ko ufite ubumuga ubishoboye azajya yiyandikira ubutumwa utabishoboye akandikirwa n’undi ubundi akohereza ku murongo inzego zose zibishinze zihuriye kuri uwo murongo. Ati “Ajya ahandikirwa ubutumwa bugufi akandika ikibazo afite, akohereza ikibazo cye kikaba cyabonywe na za nzego zose zishinzwe abafite ubumuga kuva ku rwego rw’umudugudu kugeza ku rw’igihugu bagatangira kugishakira igisubizo.” Cyakora abo bose bagaragaje imishinga bagarukaga ku kuvuga ko nibabona amafaranga bazakomeza, ibyumvikanisha ko badafashijwe yaba imishinga irangiriye mu marushanwa igiye ayo bahembwe atabageza aho bifuza. Muhizi yabwiye IGIHE ko bazabafasha kugeza ibyo bikoresho bitangiye gukoreshwa. Ati “Ikizakurikiraho ni ukureba ukuntu tubakurikirana tukabafasha ku buryo bafata ibihangano byabo bakabinononsora bakabinoza ku buryo bitangira kuba ibikoresho biri hanze abantu bafite ubumuga batangira kwifashisha mu buzima bwabo bwa buri munsi.” Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Inama y’Igihugu y’abafite Ubumuga, Ndayisaba Emmanuel, yavuze ko ikoranabuhabuhanga ryagaragajwe rigejejwe ku ndunduro byafasha kugabanya igiciro cy’ibikoresho bitumizwa mu mahanga. Ati “Byagaragaje ko mu minsi mike dushobora kwikorera amagare, ubwayo tuyakura hanze agahenda bitandukanye, ni ukuvuga ngo bariya bana babashije kunoza ririya gare rigakorerwa hano mu gihugu, urumva inyungu zaba zirimo ariya madevize dukoresha dutumiza amagare hanze, ari ukuyabona bitugoye, ari ukuyabona aduhenze ibyo byose byavaho.” Yakomeje agira ati “Niba umuntu ashobora kugira inkoni y’abatabona, imubwira ko agiye guhura n’imbogamizi n’ikintu cyamubangamira ikabimubwira mbere ni ukuvuga ngo ba bantu tujya tugira bagwa mu mifuregi inyuranye y’imihanda ntabwo baba bakivunikiyemo.” Muri rusange abitabiriye iryo rushanwa biganjemo  urubyriruko. Harimo abagore 10 n’abafite ubumuga ubwabo bagera kuri barindwi. Minisitiri w’Urubyiruko n’Umuco, Mbabazi Rosemary, yabwiye abafite ubumuga ejo ari heza. Yibukije ko Politiki y’igihugu idaheza abafite ubumuga mu bikorwa byose kandi ko biri gukomeza gushyirwamo imbaraga. Ati “Ejo harashoboka kugira ubumuga si ukudashobora, dukeneye gufatanya ubufatanye ni cyo kintu cya ngombwa.” Yanashimye ko abagaragaje imishinga biganjemo abize mu mashuri y’Ikoranabuhanga n’Ubumenyingiro (IPRCs) bigaragaza ubushobozi bw’abana b’Abanyarwanda n’uruhare rw’uburezi bw’u Rwanda. Amagare akoresha moteri agurwa hanze y’u Rwanda, ashobora kurenza miliyoni ziri hagati y’eshanu na zirindwi zishobora kugera mu icumi bitewe n’imiterere yayo. Kugeza ubu mu Rwanda hari abafite ubumuga bagera ku bihumbi 446 mu byiciro byose, biganjemo abafite ubw’ingingo. Amafoto: Munyarugerero Gift

title: Uko Blackberry yasigaye inyuma mu rugamba rw’ikoranabuhanga rya telefone zigezweho
content: Amateka n’ibigwi bya Blackberry n’imibare irabigaragaza kuko mu 2011 yari yihariye isoko rya telefone zigezweho ku kigero cya 50% muri Amerika na 20% ku Isi hose, aho yagurishije izirenga miliyoni 50. Abenshi mu bakoresheje telefone za Blackberry bazikundiraga umutekano usesuye mu kubika amakuru yabo. Gusa ibi bihe byiza siko byakomeje kuko kuri ubu imibare igaragaza ko Blackberry isigaranye isoko riri munsi ya 3%. Bamwe mu bahanga bamenyereye amasoko ya telefone bavuga ko Blackberry yizize mu makosa agera kuri atatu yose aganisha ku kuba batarahaye agaciro icyo abakiliya bashaka. Amwe mu makosa Blackberry yakoze Gutinda kuzana impinduka zigamije ihangana mu bucuruzi. Abayobozi ba Blackberry ntibigeze baha agaciro uburyo bwa telefone zikoresha ibirahure binini kandi bikorwamo (touch screen) nk’uko iPhone yabigenje, ahubwo bakomeza gutsimbarara ku buryo bwabo bwa telefone zikoresha amatushi (clavier) bavuga ko ari bwo abakiliya babo bakunda. Nyamara nyuma yo kubona ko telefone zakorwaga na Apple zitangiye kwigarurira isoko na bo bahisemo gukora telefone ikoresha ubu bwoko bw’ikirahure bayita ‘BlackBerry Storm’ n’ubwo itakunzwe cyane. Nyuma y’iyi telefone izindi bashyize hanze zakomatanyaga uburyo bw’ikirahure gikorwamo ndetse n’amatushi. Ibi byatumye ku isoko Blackberry igaragara nk’aho itazi icyo ishaka kuko isoko ryaririmo ririgarurirwa na telefone za iPhone ndetse n’izikoresha porogaramu ya Android. Blackberry ntiyamenye ko isoko rizahinduka. Blackberry ntiyigeze iha agaciro icyo abantu benshi bifuzaga birimo uko igaragara ndetse na porogaramu zigezweho, ahubwo yakomeje guha agaciro icyo amwe mu makompanyi yari abakiliya babo b’imena yifuzaga. Nyuma y’uko izi kompanyi zifashe ingamba z’uko abakozi babo bazajya bizanira telefone bashaka abenshi bahagaritse gukoresha telefone za Blackberry, kuko zitahazaga ibyifuzo byabo bayoboka iPhone na Samsung. BlackBerry ntiyumvise neza akamaro ka telefone zigezweho (smartphones). Uruganda rwa Blackberry rwahaye agaciro cyane ibijyanye n’umutekano wa telefone bakora birengagiza gutanga ibyo abantu benshi bakeneye. Kuba Blackberry nta porogaramu nyinshi yagiraga byatumye abazitunze batihanganira gucikwa na byinshi byiganjemo imyidagaduro  byabaga muri porogaramu za iPhone na Samsung. Kubera ibi bibazo bitandukanye byatumye abakiliya bayo bayishiraho nayo mu 2013 itangaza ko itazongera gukora telefone ahubwo ubu burenganzira bwo gukora telefone mu izina ryayo ibuha kompanyi yo mu Bushinwa yitwa TCL, yo ubu yibanda mu gukora porogaramu za telefone.

title: Imiterere ya ‘Tesla Cybertruck’, imodoka y’akataraboneka igiye guhindura ibintu ku isoko
content: Ni imodoka yakozwe n’uruganda rwa Tesla rw’umuherwe, Elon Musk, wanditse izina mu gukora ibijyanye na za satellites ariko ubu akaba yarashyize imbaraga nyinshi mu modoka zikoreshwa n’amashanyarazi. Mu mpera z’uyu mwaka nibwo hamuritswe uko ‘Cybertruck’ izaba imeze aho igomba kujya ku isoko mu 2020. Kugira ngo wumve ubudahangarwa bwayo, reka duhere ku buryo ikoze. Icyo benshi bita ibati ry’imodoka kuri iyi itandukanye na nyinshi uzi. Rikozwe mu byuma bikomeye bizwi nka ‘inox’ ku buryo mu gihe cy’impanuka idashobora guhongama nk’uko izindi bibaho. Yo urayigonga ntihagire icyo iba ahubwo iyawe igashanyagurika. Iki cyuma ikozemo usibye kuba kidahongama biranagoye kugisana iyo cyangiritse ndetse ntibinashoboka ko cyasigwa irangi. Umuyobozi wa Tesla, Elon Musk, yatangaje ko umubiri w’iyi modoka uyibashisha kuba itangizwa n’inyundo nini za kinubi ndetse ndetse ntishobora gutoborwa n’amasasu y’imbunda nto zimwe na zimwe. Ireshya n’imodoka zindi nyinshi twita ‘double-cabine’ nka Ford F-150 cyangwa Silverado 1500 ya Chevrolet. Uburebure bwayo ni metero 5.8; ubugari ni metero ebyiri ndetse ifite metero 1.9 kuva hasi ujya hejuru. Ifite imyanya ishobora kwicarwamo n’abantu batandatu bakuru. Ifite aho batwara imizigo hashobora gufungwa ku buryo ibirimo biba bifite umutekano, atari nka kwa kundi umuntu aba akeka ko hari abari busimbukiremo bakabitwara. Iyi modoka izajya hanze idakoresha lisansi cyangwa mazutu nk’izisanzwe ahubwo izaba ikoresha amashanyarazi, ariko izaba ikoranye uburyo bwakira ingufu z’izuba ku buryo igenda yiyongeramo umuriro. Ubwo buryo buzaba bufite ubushobozi bwo kwakira ingufi zatuma imodoka igenda ibilometero biri hagati ya 24 na 64, gusa birashoboka ko ubu buryo butazana n’imodoka ahubwo bukajya buhabwa abantu babishaka. Cybertruck izasohoka mu moko atatu, buri bumwe bufite ubushobozi bw’ingufu bwihariye. Ubwibanze buzaba bufite icyo umuntu yakwita batiri ishobora gutuma igenda nibura ibilometero 402; iyi izaba ishobora kwikorera cyangwa gukurura ikintu gipima toni 3.4. Tesla ivuga ko iyi modoka izajya hanze igura nibura $39,900. Ikindi cyiciro kizaba kigura $49,900 aho yo izaba ifite ubushobozi bwo kugira bimwe twise batiri, ebyiri ndetse yo ingufu ziyihutisha zituruka mu mapine yose uko ari ane bimwe twita 4WD. Yo izaba ifite ubushobozi bwo kugenda nibura ibilometero 482 ihetse toni 4.5 Icyiciro cya nyuma yo izaba ifite za batiri eshatu akaba ari nayo irusha ubushobozi izindi zose. Igitangaje ni uko izaba igura $69,900, amafaranga make ugereranyije n’arenga ibihumbi 80 by’amadolari agura za V8. Kuri ariya mafaranga, umuntu azaba abasha kugira imodoka igenda ibilometero 804 nta muriro wongewemo kandi ihetse toni 6.3. Umwaka utaha nibwo Tesla izatangira gukora izi modoka ku bwinshi, hanyuma mu 2020 iza mbere zijye ku isoko, gusa ku muntu uyisha yatangira kuyabika hakiri kare. Nibura ifite batiri ebyiri ifite ubushobozi bwo gufata umuvuduko w’ibilometero 100 mu isaha mu gihe cy’amasegonda 2.9. Icyo bisobanuye ni uko uyicayemo, ugakandagira ku muriro, mu masegonda 2.9, urushinge ruba rugeze ku 100 naho iya batiri eshatu yo ni mu masegonda 4.5 naho imwe bikaba mu masegonda 6.5. Reba amashusho agaragaza igerageza ryakozwe ubwo yamurikwaga

title: Mu Rwanda hatangiye kugeragezwa ikoranabuhanga rizifashishwa mu gutanga amakuru ajyanye  n’ubuhinzi
content: Uyu muhango wabaye kuri uyu wa kabiri tariki ya 3 Ugushyingo 2019 mu karere ka Rulindo, mu Ishuri rikuru ry’Imyuga n’Ubumenyi ngiro rya Tumba (IPRC Tumba). Iri koranabuhanga rizibanda ahanini ku gufasha abahinzi kumenya amakuru ajyanye n’iteganyagihe n’ingengabihe mu buhinzi, ibirebana na serivisi y’ubuzima n’imirire y’amatungo, kumenya amakuru y’ibiciro biri ku isoko, ubujyanama ku mirire no kurwanya indwara ya nkongwa. Ku muhinzi wamaze kuzuza imyirondoro ye akaba anafite telefoni igezweho ya ‘Smart phone’ aba asabwa kumanura porogaramu igaragaraho serivisi zijyanye n’ubuhinzi, akajya ku rubuga rwa https://digital.apps.fao.org akabona amakuru, mu gihe abafite telefoni zidakoresha murandasi babona amakuru binyuze ku butumwa bugufi. Umunyamabanga uhoraho muri Minisiteri y’Ubuhinzi n’Ubworozi, Musabyimana Jean Claude, yavuze  ko iri koranabuhanga rizafasha abahinzi kubona amakuru ku buryo bwo gufata neza umusaruro no gutegura neza igihembwe. Ati “Nk’abahinzi iyi serivisi izabafasha kubona amakuru ku buryo bwo gufata neza umusaruro, guhunika no kuwutwara neza kugera ugeze k’uwukoresha utangiritse. Iri koranabuhanga rizabafasha kugendana n’iteganyagihe mu mikorere yabo haba mu gutegura igihembwe cy’ihinga, hagati mu gihembwe ndetse n’igihe cy’isarura.” Umuyobozi  wungirije ushinzwe iterambere ry’ubukungu mu karere ka Rulindo, Murindwa Prosper, yavuze  ko iri koranabuhanga rizanafasha gukemura ikibazo cyo kutamenya ibiciro biri ku isoko. Ati “Twahuraga n’ikibazo cy’ibiciro aho abahinzi bahingaga cyane ariko kubera kutamenya ibiciro hakaba igihe bibashyira mu gihombo. Ikindi ni uko bashoboraga guhinga mu gihe kitari cyo kuko badafite amakuru. Aborozi kandi bapfaga gufata ibyatsi babonye bakabiha inka uko bagaburira inka y’ikimasa n’ikamwa bikaba ari bimwe, ariko muri iyi porogaramu harimo amakuru yose.” Twagiramungu Léodomir usanzwe ari umuhinzi, yabwiye IGIHE ko iyi porogaramu ayitezeho kuzajya imumenyesha amakuru y’uko ibihe by’ikirere bihagaze bityo agategura neza igihe agomba gutangirira guhinga. Yagize ati “icyo niteze kuri iyi porogaramu ni uko izajya imbwira ngo imvura ihari ingana itya bityo ntegure ubuhinzi bwanjye mu buryo burambye. Ntabwo namenyaga igihe imvura izamara igwa bigatuma ntategura ubuhinzi bwanjye mu buryo burambye, ariko iri koranabuhanga rizamfasha.” FAO ivuga ko iri koranabuhanga ryo gutanga serivisi mu buhinzi biteganyijwe ko rizageragerezwa mu bihugu birimo Misiri, Tanzania, Niger na Senegal. U Rwanda nirwo rwabaye urwa mbere mu gutangira kugerageza iri koranabuhanga bigendanye n’umuvuduko igihugu kiriho mu ikoranabuhanga. Ku bahinzi bo mu Rwanda kandi ni uko bazajya bahitamo ururimi rubanogeye, hagati y’Ikinyarwanda, Igifaransa n’Icyongereza.

title: Imikorere y’utwuma twambikwa abagororwa tugasimbura gereza
content:
Mu Rwanda naho ni uko, kuko mu mezi atatu ashize gusa, abagororwa biyongereyeho abarenga 1300 muri gereza zo hirya no hino mu gihugu ndetse ingengo y’imari Urwego rw’Igihugu rw’amagereza rukoresha imaze kugera kuri miliyari 17 Frw, amenshi ni akoreshwa mu biribwa. Bisobanuye ko mu gihe abagororwa baba ari bake, aya mafaranga ashobora kwifashishwa mu zindi nzego z’iterambere rusange ry’abaturage. Kimwe mu byitezweho kugabanya ubucucike muri gereza, ni ugukoresha inzogera zambikwa abahamwe n’ibyaha  bagahabwa ahantu runaka badakwiye kurenga. Aka kuma kazwi nka ‘ankle monitor/Surveillance électronique’ gakoreshwa n’inzego z’ubutabera iyo hari umuntu ukekwaho icyaha cyangwa cyaramuhamye, bashaka ko atarenga ahantu runaka kuko kaba gafite ikoranabuhanga rigahuza n’izo nzego, iyo uwakambitswe arenze aho bamubujije karasakuza kagatanga amakuru ku nzego zibishinzwe zikabimenya zikamufata. Muri Nyakanga uyu mwaka, Minisitiri w’Ubutabera akaba n’Intumwa Nkuru ya Leta, Busingye Johnston, yabwiye Abadepite ko ako kuma gashobora kwambarwa mbere cyangwa nyuma y’uko umuntu ahamwa n’ibyaha kazafasha mu kugabanya abafungwa. Ati “Itegeko riri gukorwa rizanagena uburyo bwo gukoresha akuma kifashisha ikoranabuhanga kagenzura abanyabyaha ku bahamijwe igifungo cyangwa abafunguwe batarangije igihano ariko bakigenzurwa. Gashobora kwambarwa mbere cyangwa nyuma y’uko ahamwa n’ibyaha.” Yavuze ko ubwo buryo buzatuma hongerwa imbaraga mu bikorwa byo kugorora no gutegura abagororwa gusubizwa mu muryango. Nonese ubu buryo bwitezwe gutangira gukoreshwa mu Rwanda mu minsi iri imbere, bukora bute, n’iki bushimwa cyangwa bunengwa? Imibare yerekana ko mu 2005 abantu babarirwa mu 53 000 bari barambitswe aka kuma. Mu 2015 uyu mubare warenze abantu ibihumbi 125. Ni ukuvuga inyongera ya 136% mu myaka 10 gusa. Benshi basanga aka kuma ari keza kuko uretse kugabanya ubucucike mu magereza gatuma umuntu aguma muri sosiyete, agakomeza kubana n’umuryango we. Gusa ku rundi ruhande ngo ikoranabuhanga ryako ntabwo rikora neza ku buryo gashobora kugira ingaruka ku wakambitswe. Amateka yerekana ko igitekerezo cyo gukora aka kuma cyazanywe n’itsinda ry’abashakashatsi bo muri kaminuza ya Harvard mu 1960. Gashyirwa aho ukuguru guhurira n’ikirenge. Sarah Faye Hanna w’imyaka 34 wo muri Leta ya Texas, yambitswe aka kuma mu gihano cy’agateganyo cy’imyaka itatu yakatiwe nyuma yo guhamwa n’icyaha cyo gutunga ibiyobyabwenge mu 2018. Avuga ko akuma ke gafite ingano nk’iy’ipaki y’isigara. Kaka icyatsi igihe amerekezo yako ahari n’umutuku mu gihe kabuze amerekezo, bikabaho kenshi nta bushake yabigizemo. Aka kuma gafite ikoranabuhanga rya ‘GPS’ ryemerera abakurikiranyweho ibyaha runaka kubonwa aho bari hose n’ababishinzwe. Uwambiswe aka kuma ahabwa ahantu runaka atagomba kurenga, yabirengaho kagatangira kuvuga cyangwa kakaba yanajwigira mu rwego rwo kwibutsa ukambaye ko yarenze aho yabwiwe. Imbibi z’aho umugororwa wambitswe akuma atagomba kurenga zishobora kongerwa bitewe n’ibyo yumvikanye n’inzego z’ubutabera. Gakoresha umurongo wa radio ufasha gutanga amakuru ku bagenzuzi. Iyo aka kuma gakuwemo cyangwa kagakubaganywa, ubuyobozi buhita bubibona ukambaye agatabwa muri yombi. Hanna avuga ko iyo aka kuma kabuze ikoranabuhanga rya GPS, bimusaba kuzenguruka hafi aho arishakisha kugeza rigarutse. Yishyura amadolari 300 yo kugatunga. Aka kuma kandi bisaba ko ukambaye agashyira ku muriro byibuze amasaha abiri buri munsi kugira ngo kabashe gukora. Iyo bitagenze gutyo, byereka abakurikirana umugororwa ko yavuye ku murongo akaba yatangira no gukurikiranwa. Gakozwe ku buryo ntacyo amazi agatwara, bisobanuye ko uwakambitswe yakogana. Aka kuma gashobora gukora nabi. Mu gihe bibayeho uhamagara abayobozi ukabamenyesha kugira ngo utagwa mu bibazo byo gushinjwa kugakuraho. Tumwe kandi tugira uburyo bwo kumviriza, aho abantu bo mu bugenzuzi bwatwo bashobora kumviriza ibiganiro ukambaye agirana n’abandi. Hari n’utugira uburyo bwo kugenzura ko ukambaye yanyoye inzoga, kakaba kahita kabyerekana mu gihe unyoye alcohol kandi umucamanza yarabikubujije. Hirya no hino ku isi ibihugu byinshi byatangiye gukoresha ubu buryo kuko bigabanya umubare munini w’abafungiye muri za gereza. Ikindi ni uko ubu buryo bufasha ibihugu gusigasira ingengo y’imari igenda ku bagororwa. Nko muri Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika bakoresha aka kuma kugira ngo abakambitswe bakoreshwe imirimo ifitiye igihugu akamaro.
Hari aho gukuraho aka kuma cyangwa kugakubaganya bituma ubikoze afungwa imyaka itanu cyangwa akishyura amande ya 5000$, cyangwa byombi. Shubha Bala, umuyobozi w’ikigo cya Amerika gishinzwe iby’ikoranabuhanga na inovasiyo mu butabera, avuga ko utu twuma nubwo turuta kuba umuntu yafungwa dufite imbogamizi. Bala avuga ko uwakambitswe abona ubutumwa bwinshi buri kanya bugamije kumenya aho aherereye, bityo bikaba byamubangamira. Imwe mu mpamvu utu twuma tugenda dukwirakwira cyane hirya no hino ku isi, Bala avuga ko ari ukubera imbaraga z’ikigo kidukora kuko ngo dufite ubunararibonye buhagije mu bijyanye no gucunga imfungwa n’abagororwa.

title: Sobanukirwa impamvu usabwa kuzimya telefone yawe igihe indege igiye guhaguruka no kururuka
content: Abenshi bibaza impamvu bahabwa aya mabwiriza mu gihe indege igiye guhaguruka cyangwa se kururuka, cyangwa se niba baramutse batayubahirije byayibuza kugenda. Hari umwe wabwiwe kuzimya telefoni ye mu gihe yari ategereje ubutumwa bw’ingirakamaro bujyanye n’akazi, maze aho kuyizimya ahitamo kuyishyira mu mufuka atayizimije kuko yumvaga ibyo ari byo byose telefone ye nto itatuma indege igwa. Ku mpamvu ahuje n’abandi benshi babikora, uwo yabikoze kuko atumvaga ingaruka gukoresha telefone ye nto bishobora kugira ku ndege. Mu bushakashatsi buherutse gukorwa, Abanyamerika bane mu 10 bemeye ko buri gihe iyo bagiye mu ndege atari ko bazimya telefone n’ibindi bikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga. Amabwiriza mpuzamahanga mu bijyanye n’indege avuga umuntu ashobora gukoresha ibikoresho nka mudasobwa igihe indege iri ku butumburuke bwa kilometero eshatu. Impamvu y’ibi ni ukugira ngo ikoranabuhanga rya telefone ritabangamira iry’indege binyuze mu mbaraga rukuruzi, nk’uko iyo telefone isonnye iri uruhande rwa radiyo bigenda. N’ubwo nta bushakashatsi buragaragaza urugero ibi bishobora kugira ingaruka ku ndege, Raporo y’Ikigo cy’Abanyamerika gishinzwe ibijyanye n’umutekano w’indege yagiye hanze mu ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka yagaragaje ko hari aho abapilote bagiye bagira ibibazo bya tekinike babwira abagenzi kuzimya telefone bigakemuka. Muri iyi raporo hari aho igira iti “Uburyo ndangamerekezo bw’indege bwagize ikibazo igihe indege yari irimo irahaguruka, igihe abagenzi bababwiraga kureba neza niba telefone zabo zijimije, nyuma yo kuzizimya uburyo ndangacyerekezo bwarongeye bukora neza”. Iyi raporo kandi igaragaza ibindi bibazo nk’ibi 125 byagiye bibaho biturutse ku bikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga byakije bigatuma hari aho indege idakora neza ndetse n’ubushakashatsi bw’Ishyirahamwe Mpuzamahanga ry’ubwikorezi bw’Indege ku Isi (IATA) bwagaragaje ko hagati y’umwaka wa 2003 na 2009 habayeho ibibazo 75 mu mikorere y’indege bitewe na telefone. Gusa hari benshi batemeranya n’ibi bitekerezo barimo Umuyobozi w’Ikigo Aeromobile gitanga uburyo bw’itumanaho bugezweho mu ndege, Kevin Rogers, wavuze ko biramutse bigaragara ko telefone hari ikibazo gikomeye ishobora gutera ku ndege batazajya bemerera abagenzi kuzijyanamo Ati “Burya telefone nyinshi ntizizimywa, iyo haza kuba hari ingaruka ikomeye telefone zigira ku mikorere y’indege, abantu ntibakwemererwa kuzinjirana na gato.” Uko ikoranabuhanga rigenda ritera imbere niko havumburwa ibisubizo bishya. Ubu bimwe mu bigo bikora ingendo zo mu kirere byazanye uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga burimo ‘OnAir’ na ‘AeroMobile’ aho umuntu ashobora gukoresha internet ari mu ndege ariko ntibibe byatera ikibazo ku mikorere yayo.

title: Hagiye gushorwa miliyoni $18 mu ikoranabuhanga rizaca uburiganya mu bamotari
content: Ni amasezerano yasinywe n’impande zombi kuri uyu wa mbere agamije gushyira ikoranabuhangaririmo mubazi na GPS kuri moto ndetse na porogaramu izajya ishyirwa muri telephone ku buryo abashinzwe umutekano babasha kugenzura moto aho yaba iri hose. Muri uyu muhango wo gusinya amasezerano, Minisiteri y’ibikorwa remezo yatangaje ko umunsi iri koranabuhanga rizaba ryatangiye gukoreshwa, rizafasha guca imwe mu myitwarire idahwitse n’amakosa byagaragaraga mu mwuga wo gutwara abantu kuri moto. Umukozi ushinzwe Ubwikorezi rusange n’umutekano wo mu muhanda mu Minisiteri y’ibikorwa remezo, Zirikana François, yagize ati “Kugeza ubu iyo urebye mu bamotari benshi bakora impanuka usanga nta bwishingizi bafite ariko muri iri koranabuhanga umumotari udafite ubwishingizi tuzajya tumureba tumenya ko bwarangiye.” “Icya kabiri ni uko umumotari udafite ibyangombwa ntabwo azashobora kongera gutwara moto kuko iryo koranabuhanga rizajya rihabwa umuntu ufite icyangombwa”. Zirikana yavuze ko kandi iri koranabuhanga rizaba ririmo akuma kazafasha gukurikirana umumotari igihe yakoze amakosa. Mininfra yavuze ko iri koranabuhanga ritagamije guca abamotari mu muhanda ahubwo ko rije mu buryo bwo kurushaho gushimangira imikorere myiza. Umuyobozi wa Pascal Technology (PTY) Limited, Pascal Ndizeye, yavuze ko iri koranabuhanga rizatangira gushyirwa muri moto uhereye mu cyumweru gitaha kuko icyabakerezaga ari amikoro. Ati “Kuva dusinyanye amasezerano y’imikoranire ni iyi kompanyi nini muri Afurika kandi ibikoresho byinshi by’ibanze byamaze kuhagera, turatangira mu cyumweru gitaha duhereye ku bamotari barenga ibihumbi birindwi bamaze kwiyandikisha.” Ndizeye yongeyeho ko kugera muri Mutarama abamotari 10 000 bazaba bamaze kugezwaho iri koranabuhanga. Iri koranabuhanga rizajyana na porogaramu ya telefoni aho umuntu ashobora kuzuzamo nimero ziranga moto agahita abona aho iherereye, igihe yakoze amakosa. Kuri ubu umumotari wifuza iri koranabuhanga ashobora kwishyura ibihumbi 200 n’amafaranga 200 mu byiciro cyangwa akayishyurira rimwe. Uretse ibijyanye n’umutekano iri koranabuhanga ryitezweho kuzafasha mu bijyanye n’igenamigambi kuko izi mashini zizerekana umubare w’abantu bakoresha moto mu Rwanda ndetse n’uw’abari muri uyu mwuga wo gutwara abantu kuri moto.

title: Minisitiri w’Intebe Dr Ngirente yashimangiye ko kwemerera abanyeshuri telefone byaba ari ukubarangaza
content: Yabitangaje kuri uyu wa Mbere ubwo yagezaga ku Nteko Ishinga Amategeko imitwe yombi ibikorwa bya Guverinoma bijyanye n’Ikoranabuhanga mu bukungu bushingiye ku bumenyi. Bimwe mu byo yatangaje u Rwanda rwishimira kuba rwaragezeho mu iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga, harimo kugeza ibikorwa remezo by’ikoranabuhanga henshi nk’umuyoboro mugari wa Internet wagejejwe mu gihugu hose, gutangiza uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga mu myigishirize n’ibindi. Dr Ngirente yavuze ko kugeza ubu, Internet mu mashuri yisumbuye ikoreshwa ku kigero cya 52.9 % naho muri kaminuza bikaba 100%. Abagize Inteko Ishinga Amategeko bagize impungenge kuri iyo mibare mu mashuri yisumbuye, bavuga ko ari icyuho gikomeye ku iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga ugereranyije n’abiga muri kaminuza. Depite  Uwanyirigira  Gloriose  yibajije uburyo imyigire ihagaze mu gihe internet itagera hose, ndetse anagaragaza impungenge ko  nta gikozwe bishobora gukoma mu nkokora  gahunda yo koherereza ibigo by’amashuri ibizamini hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga. Depite John Ruku Rwabyoma we, yavuze ko ukurikije aho iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga rigeze, umunyeshuri atakabaye yamburwa telefone ku ishuri. Yagize ati “Abana bacu rwose hari ubwo mvuga nti tubabuza amahirwe. Ibihe tugezemo twigishe abana ubwiza bw’ikoranabuhanga aho kugira ngo dushyireho imyugariro hirya no hino. Mbona amashuri hirya no hino bavuga ngo umwana bamufatanye telefone bakamwirukana, telefone ni igikoresho umwana akwirirye kuba akoresha ntabwo ari ikintu kibi.” Minisitiri w’Intebe, Dr Ngirente yavuze ko kubuza abanyeshuri gutunga no gukoresha telefone uko bishakiye ku mashuri byakozwe mu nyungu zabo no gushyigikira imyigire myiza. Yavuze ko ubushakashatsi bwagiye bukorwa bukagaragaza ko kwemerera abana kwiga bafite telefone n’ibindi bikoresho by’ikoramabuhanga mu buryo butagenzuwe, bibarangaza kurusha uko bibafasha. Ati “Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko iyo atabikeneye cyangwa  atabitumwe na mwarimu bimurangaza. Niba umwana wiga mu mashuri abanza ageze ku isomo ry’ikoranabuhanga  icyo gihe mwarimu atanga uburenganzira ati mushobora gufata telefone zanyu nkaberekeraho ibintu ibi n’ibi, ariko niba agiye kwiga isomo ry’ibidukikije cyangwa imibare hataribuzemo rya koranabuhanga tumusaba ko telefone ayibika kure ye ntanayigeze mu ishuri.” Yavuze ko binajyanye n’uburere busanzwe kuko n’umwana mu rugo hari uburyo ababyeyi be bamufasha gukoresha ibyuma by’ikoranabuhanga ariko akagira n’umwanya wo gusubira mu masomo. Ati “Abana bamwe avana umukoro ku ishuri yagera mu rugo ntawukore kubera ko ari kureba televiziyo, umubyeyi akayimukuriraho kugira ngo abanze yite ku mukoro yahawe na mwarimu. Ni ugushakisha nk’ababyeyi kuko igihugu kigizwe natwe twese, ni ukureba igituma umwana wacu akura neza.” Icyakora, Dr Ngirente yavuze ko haramutse habonetse ubundi bushakashatsi bugaragaza ibyiza byo gukoresha telefone mu mashuri, byakwigwaho. Muri Kamena umwaka ushize, nibwo Minisiteri y’Uburezi yatangaje ko nta munyeshuri wo mu mashuri y’incuke, abanza n’ayisumbuye wemerewe gukoresha telefoni ku ishuri kuko zigira uruhare rukomeye mu kurangaza abanyeshuri ntibige neza uko bikwiye. U Rwanda rufite intego yo guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga n’ubumenyi ku buryo bigira uruhare mu bukungu bw’igihugu. Umwaka ushize hatangijwe ikigega cy’Igihugu kizatera inkunga imishinga y’ikoranabuhanga, National Reasearch and Innovation Fund. Minisitiri w’Intebe yavuze ko guhera mu mwaka wa 2000 kugeza mu 2019, kubera guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda, urwo rwego rwatanze imirimo 123 670.

title: KtRN yashoye miliyoni 10 z’amadorali mu kuvugurura umuyoboro wa 4G
content: Mu gihe ibyifuzo by’abakiliya byiyongera, abakoresha internet ya 4G bahuye n’ibibazo bitandukanye by’uburyo igendamo byatumye biba ngombwa ko harebwa uko yahabwa ingufu ku bayikoresha. KtRN ko yashoye izo mbaraga mu kuvugurura uyu muyoboro mu Mujyi wa Kigali n’indi mijyi itandatu yunganira uwa Kigali irimo Musanze, Huye, Muhanga, Nyagatare, Rusizi na Rubavu. Iki kigo kivuga ko “Muri iyi minsi, ibyifuzo by’abakiliya byariyongereye, abakoresha internet ya 4G bagenda bagaragaza ikibazo cy’uyu muyoboro, ibi bituma hatekerezwa uko wahabwa ingufu hagamijwe kuzuza ibyifuzo by’abayikoresha mu gihugu.” Iyi gahunda yateguwe mu byiciro bibiri, birimo icyo kuvugurura uburyo bw’itumanaho n’icyo guha ingufu umuyoboro ya LTE+ muri Kigali n’imijyi iyunganira. Biteganyijwe ko izatangira ku wa 15 Ukuboza 2019 igasozwa muri Werurwe 2020. Muri Mutarama uyu mwaka, KtRN ku bufatanye n’abafatanyabikorwa bayo,  yashyizeho amapaki adasanzwe ya 4G  agenewe abakoresha telefoni zigezweho za  ‘smartphones’ mu gihugu, intego ikaba yari ukuyibagezaho mu buryo buhendutse. Iki kigo kivuga ko abagenerwabikorwa mu minsi mike batangira kugerwaho na internet ya 4G yihuta kandi  ihendutsemu ntego yayo yo kugeza umuyoboro mugari wa internet kuri bose. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa KtRN, Daeheak AN, yagize ati “Dukomeje guharanira kunoza ubwiza bwa internet ya (4G LTE+) kandi ku giciro gihendutse. Ibi ni byo bizatuma iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga ryiyongera mu buzima bw’abaturage b’igihugu cyacu, hanaboneke amahirwe mu bucuruzi buto bugitangira, bijyanye n’icyerekezo cyacu.” Internet yihuta (Broadband) muri smartphones yagaragaje ko iri mu mwanya mwiza wo kwihutisha guhanga udushya mu ikoranabuhanga  no gufasha abatangira imishinga mu Rwanda. Mu Rwanda 4G yatangijwe mu 2014, ubu 95% by’igihugu bigerwaho n’umuyoboro wa murandasi yihuta mu gihe mu gihugu hose hagera 4G.

title: Ibyogajuru by’ikoranabuhanga rihambaye byoherejwe mu isanzure muri iki cyumweru
content: Kuva ku wa 23 Ugushyingo, u Bushinwa bwohereje mu kirere ibyogajuru bibiri byaturutse mu gace ka Xichang birimo kimwe cyangije ibikorwa remezo byo mu gace ko hafi aho kuko inzu zasenyutse, bigateza n’umwotsi bivugwa ko ushobora kugira ingaruka ku buzima bwa muntu. This is the aftermath downrange following a Chinese Long March 3B launch from Xichang early Saturday. And that yellow smoke is very toxic hypergolic propellant. Source: https://t.co/VEh5X8Ors0 pic.twitter.com/22IVIpyJOk — Andrew Jones (@AJ_FI) November 23, 2019 U Burusiya nabwo bwakurikiyeho bwohereza mu isanzure icyogajuru cy’ibanga rikomeye ry’igisirikare. Iki cyo cyagiye ku wa 25 Ugushyingo kirasiwe mu gace ka Plesetsk. Nyuma y’iminsi ine gitinze kubera ibibazo  by’amashanyarazi byatewe n’ikirere kitari kimeze neza, u Burayi nabwo bwohereje mu isanzure icyogajuru cyabwo cya ‘Ariane 5’. Cyoherejwe giturutse mu gace ka Kourou muri French Guiana. Ku wa 26 Ugushyingo, Misiri yohereje mu isanzure icyogajuru cyayo cya mbere cya gisirikare kiswe Tiba-1. Ni icyogajuru cya toni 5.6 cyakozwe na Airbus hamwe na Thales Alenia Space, kizamara mu isanzure imyaka 15. Cyitezweho gufasha Misiri gukemura ibibazo bya internet n’itumanaho. Mu gusoza icyumweru, ku wa 27 Ugushyingo u Buhinde nabwo bwohereje icyogajuru mu isanzure cyiswe Cartosat-3, kiri kumwe n’ibindi 13 bya Amerika ariko byo bito byo mu bwoko bwa Cubesat, bimeze kimwe nk’icyo u Rwanda ruherutse kohereza. Cartosat-3 ni ubwoko bw’ibyogajuru bya gisivile bifite ubushobozi bwo gufata amashusho nibura agaragaza santimetero ebyiri za buri gace byafashe, hanyuma akifashishwa mu gukemura ibibazo bitandukanye; nk’uko u Rwanda ruzajya rubigenza rugamije iterambere ry’ubuhinzi. Amafoto agaragaza uburyo icyogajuru cya Ariane 5 cyoherejwe mu kirere

title: Abanyarwanda batandatu ba mbere bahuguwe ku mikorere y’ubwenge bw’ubukorano bahawe impamyabushobozi
content: Ni amahugurwa yatangiye ku wa 6 Kanama 2019, akaba yari agenewe bamwe mu banyeshuri biga amasomo ajyanye n’Ikoranabuhanga mu Cyiciro cya Gatatu [Master’s Degree] muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda. Umunyamabanga Uhoraho muri Minisiteri y’Ikoranabuhanga mu Itumanaho na Inovasiyo, Irere Claudette, yavuze ko u Rwanda rukeneye iri koranabuhanga ry’ubwenge bw’ubukorano mu nzego zose z’ubukungu. Yagize ati “Ndibaza ko buri wese akeneye iri koranabuhanga ry’ubwenge bw’ubukorano urebye mu nzego z’ingenzi mu bukungu bwacu, urwa mbere ni ubuhinzi, ubuzima, uburezi, ubucuruzi, ubwikorezi; navuga ko ryakoreshwa aho ariho hose.” Irere yongeyeho ko hagiye kurebwa uburyo hakongerwa ubushobozi hakazajya hahugurwa abantu benshi. Ati “Mfite icyizere ko twareba uburyo twakongera inkunga tukagura iyi gahunda ku buryo itaba ari iy’abanyeshuri batandatu gusa ahubwo ikagera ku mubare munini.” Abanyeshuri batandatu bahuguwe na bagenzi babo b’Abanyarwanda biga ibijyanye n’iri koranabuhanga mu Buyapani ku bufatanye n’Ikigo gikora iri koranabuhanga ry’Ubwenge bw’Ubukorano cya Future Corporation. Ubwenge bw’ubukorano ni uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga bwo gukora porogaramu zishyirwa muri mudasobwa ku buryo igira ubushobozi bwo gutekereza ndetse ikaba yanasesengura amakuru hadakenewe uruhare rwa muntu. Umwe mu banyeshuri bahuguwe muri iri koranabuhanga, Rutayisire Olivia, yavuze ko ubumenyi yahawe buzamufasha kugira bimwe mu bisubizo atanga ku bibazo u Rwanda ruhura nabyo. Ati “Bizadufasha kugira ngo tubashe kurebera hamwe ibisubizo twazanira igihugu cyacu ndetse akaba ari n’uburyo bwiza bwo kugira ngo Abanyarwanda babashe guhana ubumenyi tudategereje abanyamahanga ahubwo twe tukiga tukigisha n’abandi.” Umuyobozi wa JICA mu Rwanda, Shin Maruo, cyanagize uruhare mu gutanga aya mahugurwa yavuze ko iki gikorwa cyo guhugura Abanyarwanda kiri mu murongo w’ubufatanye bw’u Rwanda n’u Buyapani mu bijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga. Yakomeje agira ati “Nk’uko mushobora kuba mubizi urwego rw’ikoranabuhanga ni rumwe mu nzego z’ingenzi ku Rwanda kandi u Buyapani na JICA, ikoranabuhanga ni rumwe mu zishyizwe imbere mu bufatanye bwacu.” Ikigo JICA gitera inkunga ibikorwa by’iterambere mu Rwanda aho nibura kuva mu 2008, kugeza mu 2017, cyahaye u Rwanda agera kuri miliyoni $350, yashyizwe ahanini mu nzego zirimo iterambere ry’ibikorwa remezo bifasha mu bukungu, ubuhinzi, ikoranabuhanga, kongera ubushobozi bw’abakozi n’ibindi. Igitekerezo cyo gutangiza aya masomo cyazanywe na Prof. Moustapha Cissé usanzwe ari Umuyobozi w’Ikigo cya Google gikora ubushakashatsi ku bwenge bw’ubukorano muri Ghana.
