title: Hakozwe ikoranabuhanga rikora incamake y’inyandiko ndende zanditse mu ndimi icyenda
content: Iri koranabuhanga rifite ubushobozi bwo guhina inyandiko ndende zanditse mu ndimi zirimo Igishinwa, Icyongereza, Igiheburayo, Icyarabu, Ikinya-Persi [Persian] kivugwa muri Iran, Ikidage, Ikinya-Espagne [Spanish] kivugwa muri Espagne n’Igifaransa. Bisobanuye ko ushobora kurishyiramo inyandiko ndende yanditse muri rumwe muri izo ndimi icyenda rigahita riguha incamake yayo mu kanya gato cyane. Gusa igerageza ryagaragaje ko enye muri izo ndimi ari zo rikorera ibintu bizira amakemwa nk’uko umuntu akora incamake y’inyandiko ndende arizo; icyongereza, igiheburayo, icyarabu n’ikinya-Persi. Aba bashakashatsi batangaje icyiciro cya mbere cy’iri koranabuhanga mu 2010 ariko bakomeza kuryongerera ubushobozi. Bavuga ko mu gihe cya vuba rigiye gushyirwa ku isoko abantu bagatangira kurikoresha. Umwe mu bagize uruhare mu kuvumbura iri koranabuhanga ryitwa MUSE mu magambo ahinnye cyangwa ‘Multilingual Sentence Extractor’, Prof. Mark Last, yabwiye Jerusalem Post ko rizafasha abantu kugabanya umwanya bamara basoma inyandiko ndende. Ati “Abantu bakeneye kumenya amakuru menshi. Iri koranabuhanga rizabikira igihe abasomyi. Ntabwo bazakenera kumara igihe kirekire basoma inyandiko ndende.” Prof.Mark yavuze ko nk’ibinyamakuru bishobora kuzajya byifashisha iri koranabuhanga mu gukora incamake y’inkuru ndende byanditse mu rwego rwo korohereza abantu badafite umwanya wo kuyisoma yose, mu gihe ubusanzwe byasabaga ko bayikorera incamake ubwabo.

title: Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Twitter arateganya kuzaza muri Afurika akahamara amezi atatu
content: Dorsey mu minsi yari amaze muri Afurika yasuye ibihugu nka Nigeria, Ghana, Ethiopia na Afurika y’Epfo, aho yagiye aganira n’abafite ubucuruzi bujyanye no kubyaza umusaruro ikoranabuhanga. Abinyujije kuri Twitter, Dorsey w’imyaka 43  yavuze ko bibabaje kuba asoje uruzinduko rwe, gusa ashimangira ko Afurika ari umugabane mwiza ugaragaza ahazaza h’isi. Yagize ati “Birababaje kuba mvuye kuri uyu mugabane. Afurika niyo izagena ahazaza. Sindamenya neza ariko nzahagaruka mpamare amezi kuva kuri atatu kugeza kuri atandatu mu 2020. Nishimiye ko nibura nabashije kwirebera igice gito (cya Afurika).” Dorsey yavuze ko ukugena ejo hazaza ha Afurika bizaturuka mu bucuruzi bw’amafaranga y’ikoranabuhanga ya Bitcoin, nubwo atasobanuye impamvu ariko abibona, nkuko BBC yabitangaje. Bitcoin ni ifaranga ryakozwe bwa mbere mu 2009 n’umuhanga mu bya mudasobwa wamenyekanye ku izina rya Satoshi Nakamoto. Muri ubu buryo abantu cyangwa ibigo bibiri bishobora kohererezanya amafaranga ntayo biciwe nk’ubwishyu. Dorsey asanzwe azwi mu ngendo zitandukanye agirira hirya no hino. Muri Nzeri yavuze ko yagiye muri Melbourne na Australia mu gihe umwaka ushize mu Ukuboza yari muri Myanmar ari naho yizihirije isabukuru yamaze iminsi icumi ahantu hatuje yitekerezaho. Kuza kumara amezi atatu muri Afurika kwa Dorsey, ni ikimenyetso cy’uko sosiyete z’ikoranabuhanga zikomeye zitangira kubona uwo mugabane nk’ahantu heza ho gushora imari mu by’ikoranabuhanga mu gihe kiri imbere. Dorsey abengutswe Afurika nyuma ya Mark Zuckerberg wa Facebook wavuze ko mu mwaka wa 2020 ateganya kuhaza mu biganiro bigamije guteza imbere uruhare rw’ikoranabuhanga mu iterambere ry’abaturage. Ni imyumvire mishya kuri sosiyete z’ikoranabuhanga zo mu bihugu byateye imbere kuko ubundi Afurika yajyaga iza nk’amahitamo ya nyuma. Dorsey avuye muri Afurika kandi mu gihe Jack Ma washize urubuga rucururizwaho kuri Internet rwa Alibaba Group yari aherutse muri Ethiopia aho yasinyiye amasezerano yo gutangiza urubuga rushya rucururizwaho kuri Internet.

title: Twitter igiye gushyiraho uburyo bwo guhitamo abemerewe kuvuga ku byo umuntu yanditse
content: Ubusanzwe ibyo umuntu yanditse kuri uru rubuga biba bishobora kuvugwaho cyangwa gusubizwa ‘Reply’ n’umuntu wese ubisomye, yaba asanzwe amukurikira cyangwa atamukurikira ‘Following’. Umuyobozi ushinzwe kugenzura ibinyuzwa kuri Twitter, Suzanne Xie, yatangaje kuri uyu wa gatatu ko harimo kuvugururwa imiterere yayo ku buryo abayikoresha bazajya bahitamo uwemerewe kugira uruhare mu kiganiro cyangwa igitekerezo batanzeho. Iyo miterere mishya izaba igenera umuntu wandika ikintu kuri twitter amahitamo ane arimo kureka buri wese akakivugaho, guhitamo abasanzwe bamukurikira gusa kandi yahisemo gusangiza icyo yanditse, guhitamo abo yifuza kugisangiza gusa cyangwa guhitamo ko ntawemerewe kukivugaho. Uru rubuga rwaherukaga gushyiraho uburyo bwemerera abarukoresha guhisha bimwe mu bitekerezo byatanzwe ku nyandiko barushyizeho ruvuga ko ari mu rwego rwo guhindura uburyo imikorere y’ibiganiro birutangwaho no guha amahirwe abarukoresha amahirwe yo kugenzura ibitekerezo bitangwa ku nyandiko banyuzaho. Bamwe mu basanzwe bakoresha uru rubuga bagargaje ko iyi miterere mishya izaba ari igisubizo ku bantu bibasiraga abandi ku nyandiko babaga barunyujijeho, rimwe na rimwe batari mu bo bifuzaga kuzandikira. Iyi miterere Twitter irimo ishaka kuzana biteganyijwe ko izatangira gukoreshwa mu gihe cya vuba muri uyu mwaka nubwo itavuze neza ukwezi.

title: Umunara wa StarTimes wakubiswe n’inkuba bibuza bamwe muri Kigali kureba Televiziyo
content: Itangazo iki kigo kirimo koherereza rigira riti  “Ikigo StarTimes kiramenyesha Abafatabuguzi bacyo ko Inkuba yakubise umunara wayo, uri ku musozi wa Jali i Kigali. Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, amashusho ntabasha kugaragara. Turasaba abafatabuguzi bacu kwihangana mu gihe turimo gukemura ikibazo cyabayeho.” Umuyobozi ushinzwe itumanaho n’imenyekanishabikorwa muri Star Times, Vlady Terimbere, yabwiye IGIHE ko abakiliya bagizweho ingaruka n’iyo mpanuka ari abakoresha antenes nto mu mujyi wa Kigali gusa. Bisobanuye ko ahandi hose nta kibazo bakomeje kureba amashusho neza ariko no muri Kigali abakoresha Antenes  z’ibisahani bakomeje kuyareba nta kibazo. Ati “Twageze ku kazi harimo kugwa ya mvura nyinshi cyane, noneho hari inkuba yakubise umunara wa hariya kuri Jali, niyo mpamvu amashusho atabasha kugararagara ariko abatekinisiye bacu bose bagiyeyo barimo kubikoraho, turasaba abafatabuguzi kwihangana, ni igihe gito.” Terimbere yavuze ko  hari icyizere ko mu gihe gito biza kuba byakemutse abantu bagakomeza kuryoherwa n’ibyiza bya Star Times. Star Times ni ikigo kiyoboye mu ikoranabuhango ryo gusakaza amashusho ya Televiziyo muri Afurika, aho abagera kuri miliyoni 30 bakoresha ifatabuguzi ryayo. Ikorera  mu bihugu bisaga 30, ifite amasheni agera kuri 480 arimo ay’amakuru, filime, filime z’uruhererekane, imikino, imyidagaduro, gahunda zigenewe abana n’ibindi.

title: Havumbuwe batiri ishobora kubika umuriro wakoresha smartphone iminsi itanu
content: Ni batiri ikoze mu binyabutabire bya Lithium na Sulfur byitezwe ko mu gihe yaba itangiye gukoreshwa na benshi yafasha mu kugabanya ihumana ry’ikirere ndetse igakoresha ingufu neza. Itsinda ryo muri Kaminuza ya Monash iherereye mu Mujyi wa Melbourne ryakoze iyi batiri rivuga ko ariyo ya mbere ku Isi ikoresha ingufu neza ndetse ikaba yakora ku kigero gikubye kane izindi zisanzwe zikora. Umwe mu bagize iri tsinda, Matthew Hill, yavuze ko uretse kuba iyi batiri ikora neza izanafasha mu kugabanya iyangirika ry’ibidukikije. Yagize Ati “Ubu buryo ntibuzafasha gusa mu bijyanye no kurambya umuriro ahubwo n’igiciro bitwara umuntu abukora kiri hasi, imikorere yayo ishingiye ku mazi ishobora kugabanya bigaragara imyanda yangiza ibidukikije.” Aba bashakashatsi bavuze ko iyi batiri izafasha mu kurwanya imihindagurikire y’ibihe. Izi batiri zikoze muri Lithium na Sulfur zari zisanzwe zikoreshwa ku ndege n’imodoka zimwe na zimwe ubu akaba ari ubwa mbere zaba zigiye gukoreshwa kuri telefoni. CNN yanditse ko hari abagaragaza ko nubwo izi batiri zibika umuriro igihe kirekire hari abazinenga ko zitaramba. Mu gukora iyi batiri ifite ubushobozi budasanzwe mu kubika umuriro, abashakashatsi bavuguruye imiterere y’igice cy’iyari isanzwe kizwi nka ‘Cathode’ kugira ngo ibashe gukoresha umuriro muke kandi nta kigabanutse mu mbaraga itanga. Uyu mushinga wamaze guterwa inkunga na Leta ya Australia bitaganyijwe ko uzakorerwa irindi gerageza mu mpera z’uyu mwaka rigamije gusuzuma byisumbuyeho imikorere y’izi bateri.

title: Hakozwe ikoranabuhanga rishobora gutahura kanseri y’ibere kurusha abaganga
content: Ubushakashatsi bwakoze kuri iri koranabuhanga, bwamuritswe kuwa Gatatu w’iki cyumweru. Iyi porogramu yahawe ubumenyi bwo gutahura kanseri ikoresheje amashusho amagana iba yafashe mu bagore, yakoreshejwe mu Bwongereza na Amerika. Ubushakshatsi kuri iri koranabuhanga bugaragaza ko rishobora gutanga amakuru kurenza uburyo busanzwe. Ugereranyije n’abahanga basanzwe bapima kanseri, iyi porogaramu yagabanyije amakuru atariyo ku kigero cya 5.7% ku banyamerika na 1.2% ku Bongereza. CNN ivuga ko iyi porogramu yizewe cyane mu gutanga amakuru y’ukuri, gusa ikaba ifite inenge yo gukorana no guhana amakuru n’abahanga muri iyi ndwara, urugero nk’amakuru yerekeye umurwayi. Prof. Ara Darzi, uyobora ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi cyitwa UK Imperial Centre cyo mu Bwongereza, avuga ko atari yiteze kubona ubu buhanga bw’iri koranabuhanga. Ati “Ubu ni bumwe mu buryo bwavumbuye, bushobora kuzarogoya uko dusanzwe dukora ibipimo mu buryo bwo gutanga amakuru y’ukuri kandi atanga umusaruro.” Ikigo American Cancer Society kivuga ko uburyo busanzwe bukoreshwa mu gupima kanseri, bukunze kwibeshya ku gutahura kanseri, ibi bikaba ku muntu umwe kuri batanu. Kimwe cya kabiri cy’abagore kandi ngo bahabwa amakuru atari yo kuri iyi ndwara bituma bahabwa ubuvuzi butari bwo. Dominic King, ukora muri Google Health avuga ko ibyavuye muri ubu bushakashatsi bishimishije, bikaba kandi bigaragaza uko iri koranabuhanga rishobora gufasha mu gutahura iyi kanseri itaragera mu rwego rwo hejuru. Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku buzima, OMS, rivuga ko mu 2018 abagore 627,000 ari bo bishwe na kanseri y’ibere. Muri rusange OMS ivuga ko mu 2018 kanseri zishe abarenga miliyoni 9.6 muri miliyoni 18.1 by’abari bazirwaye. Mu Rwanda habarurwa abanyarwanda ibihumbi 10 barwaye kanseri zitandukaye muri miliyoni zisaga 12 z’abaturage bose, aho iy’ibere iza ku mwanya wa kabiri nyuma y’ifata inkondo y’umura. Ikigo cy’ubuzima (RBC) kigaragaza ko mu 2017 abarwayi barenga 500 bivurije kanseri y’ibere hirya no hino ku bitaro.

title: Mu 2019 Samsung yagurishije telefoni zikoresha 5G  zisaga miliyoni esheshatu
content: Uru ruganda ruyoboye izindi mu gukora telefone zigezweho  rwabitangaje kuri uyu wa Kane, aho rwavuze ko kugurisha telefoni zisaga miliyoni 6 birenze ibyo bari biteze, dore ko umwaka wa 2019 utangira uruganda rwari rwihaye intego yo kugurisha nibura telefone zikoresha 5G miliyoni enye. Samsung yatsinze igitego izindi sosiyete bihanganye mu 2019 ubwo yashyiraga ku isoko telefoni zirimo Samsung Galaxy S10 5G, Note 10 5G, Note 10+ 5G, A90 5G na Galaxy Fold 5G ifite ubushobozi bwo gukunjwa.  Biteganyijwe ko muri uyu mwaka uru ruganda ruzashyira ku isoko ‘tablet’ ikoresha umuyoboro wa internet ya 5G. Apple nka rumwe mu nganda zihanganye na Samsung ku isoko ivuga ko mu 2020 nta gahunda ifite yo gusohora telefoni ikoresha internet ya 5G. Samsung kandi yungukiye mu bibazo uruganda rwa Huawei rwahuye nabyo mu mwaka wa 2019 byo gukomanyirizwa  ku isoko rya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika dore ko ubusanzwe ruri mu zigurisha telefone nyinshi ku isi.

title: Tesla yashyize ku isoko imodoka za mbere yakoreye mu Bushinwa
content: Mu ntangiriro z’iki Cyumweru nibwo imodoka 15 za mbere zo mu bwoko bwa  Model 3 zamurikiwe mu ruganda rwa Tesla rwitwa Gigafactory ruri hafi y’umujyi wa Shanghai. Ibi bije mu gihe urwo ruganda rufite icyicaro i California rufite intego yo kwigarurira isoko ry’imodoka ku Isi. Icyakora uku kwagura ibikorwa bya Tesla mu Bushinwa, abasesenguzi basanga bishobora gukomwa mu nkokora n’intambara y’ubucuruzi iri hagati ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’u Bushinwa. Nyuma y’imodoka 15 za Tesla zamurikiye mu Bushinwa, bisobanuye ko n’abandi bashaka ubwo bwoko bw’imodoka zakozwe na Gigafactory batangira kuzigura. Tesla yari yatangaje ko ishaka gutangira kugurisha imodoka zayo zakorewe mu Bushinwa bitarenze tariki 25 Mutarama 2020. Imodoka za Tesla zo mu bwoko bwa Model 3 zashyizwe ku giciro cy’amadolari 50 000 ariko ashobora kugabanyuka kuko hari izindi nganda z’imbere mu Bushinwa zikora imodoka zifuza gukorana na Tesla. Tesla iri mu bigo bike byo muri Amerika bikomeje kwagura ibikorwa byabyo mu Bushinwa mu gihe intambara y’ubucuruzi hagati y’ibihugu byombi ikomeje. Byinshi mu bigo byo muri Amerika bitinya ko ibicuruzwa byakozwe n’amashami yabyo mu Bushinwa  byakwa imisoro myinshi mu gihe byinjiye ku butaka bwa Amerika. Ni mu gihe kandi muri Kanama umwaka ushize, Perezida Trump yasabye ibigo byo mu gihugu cye bifite amashami mu Bushinwa kuyavanayo. BBC yatangaje ko Tesla nta gahunda ifite yo kugurisha muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika imodoka zakorewe mu Bushinwa. Kuri iyo sosiyete bishobora kuyibera inyungu kuko imodoka zose zayo zoherezwaga mu Bushinwa zabaga zivuye ku ruganda rwo muri Amerika, bivuze ko zagongwaga n’imisoro ihanitse yashyizweho. Uretse mu Bushinwa, Tesla iherutse gutangaza  ko ishaka kubaka urundi ruganda ruzaba rukomeye mu Burayi bwose, rugashyirwa i Berlin mu Budage.

title: Impamvu abavutse ku wa 29 Gashyantare bizihiza isabukuru y’amavuko rimwe mu myaka ine
content:
Nubwo imibare y’abavuka kuri uyu munsi iri hasi kuko mu mpinja 1500 zitwitwe rumwe nirwo ruba rufite amahirwe yo kuvuka kuri uyu munsi, ntibibuza ko ku Isi habarurwa abantu miliyoni enye bavutse kuri uyu munsi. Ibi biterwa n’uko ku Isi kugira ngo babare ko umwaka wuzuye Isi iba irangije urugendo rumara iminsi 365 rwo kuzenguruka izuba. Nubwo bikunze kuvugwa ko iyi minsi ari 365 si yo gusa kuko ahubwo imara iminsi 365 n’amasaha atandatu, gusa mu buryo bwo kwirinda ko kubibara bigorana havugwa iminsi gusa. Aya masaha niyo agenda yongeranywa akazabyara amasaha 24 nyuma y’imyaka ine, hanyuma aya masaha 24 angana n’umunsi akongerwa ku kwezi kwa kabiri uwo mwaka ku kagira iminsi 29, abavutse kuri iyi tariki bakizihiza isabukuru y’amavuko nyuma y’imyaka ine. title: Abanyarwandakazi bakoze ikoranabuhanga  rizajya rimenyesha abantu aho bakorera siporo habegereye
content: Uru rubuga rwitwa WePlay bakoze nyuma y’amezi atandatu bahabwa amahugurwa mu bijyanye no gukora porogramu za mudasobwa na telefone muri gahunda ya WeCode ifasha abakobwa gukora ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga. Imanishimwe Aime Clemence uri mu bakoze uru rubuga, yabwiye IGIHE ko barukoze bagamije gufasha abantu baburaga aho bakorera siporo kandi ari kimwe mu bikumira indwara zitandura zugarije Isi. Ati “Twaje gusanga abantu benshi badakora Siporo ngororamubiri rimwe na rimwe kubera ko batazi aho kuzikorera cyangwa bahuze mu kazi no mu mpera z’icyumweru ugasanga babunza imitima bibaza aho bazikorera. Twategereje gukora urubuga rwabafasha kumenya aho bakorera siporo aho batuye mu buryo bworoshye.” Urwo rubuga n’iyo porogaramu ishyirwa muri telefone, umuntu azajya yinjizamo izina ry’umurenge atuyemo ihite imwereka ahamwegereye ashobora kubona ubwoko bwa siporo akunda. Ati “Iyo ukijyaho bwa mbere ubona siporo zitandukanye ushobora gukora, ukandikamo Umurenge utuyemo, igahita ikwereka ubwoko bwa siporo ushobora kubona muri uwo Murenge cyangwa hafi yawo.” Uko ari bane bayikoze igihe cy’ibyumweru bine, batatu bakora urubuga rusanzwe mu gihe undi umwe yakoze Porogaramu ya mudasobwa. Ugirimpuhwe Yvonne bafatanyije yavuze ko mbere yo kuyikora babanje kubaza abantu batandukanye niba bakeneye kwifashisha ikoranabuhanga mu gushakisha aho gukorera siporo. Ati “78.9% by’abo twabajije batweretse ko iri koranabuhanga rikenewe. Kuyikoresha ni ubuntu, ujyaho ukaba wafungura aho uzajya winjiza umwirondoro wawe. Hariho n’uburyo wahitamo kwifatanya n’itsinda runaka risanzwe rikorera siporo ahantu runaka.” Siporo ni kimwe mu bigabanya ibyago byo kurwara indwara zitandura.  Indwara zitandura harimo diabète, umuvuduko w’amaraso, Kanseri n’izindi. Mu nama abahanga mu by’ubuzima bagira abantu mu rwego rwo kuzirinda harimo gukora siporo ngororamubiri, kutanywa inzoga n’itabi byinshi. Mu Rwanda, Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ubuzima ku ndwara zitandura mu 2013 bwagaragaje ko 2.8% bafite umubyibuho ukabije, 14.3% bafite ibiro byinshi bitajyanye n’uko bareshya naho 7.8% bafite ibiro biri munsi y’ibyo bakabaye bafite. Bwagaragaje kandi ko ibibazo by’umubyibuko ukabije byiganje ku bantu bari hagati y’imyaka 35-54, muri bo abagore bakaba bagize 4.7%. Ikindi ni uko ibibazo by’umubyibuho ukabije biri cyane mu mijyi ku kigero cya 10.2%. Ubwo bushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko 15% basanganywe umuvuduko ukabije w’amaraso, kandi ku bantu bari hagati y’imyaka 55 na 64 byiyongera ku kigero cya 40%.

title: Arsenal yemeye kwitabira ubukangurambaga bwa #ConnectRwanda
content: Ubukangurambaga bwiswe #ConnectRwanda buri gukorwa  umuntu cyangwa ikigo bishyiriraho intego ku bushake yo guha smartphones abatazifite mu Rwanda. Iki gikorwa ahanini gikorerwa kuri internet aho abantu batandukanye bashyiraho intego y’izo bazatanga bagasaba n’abandi kubigenza gutyo. #ConnectRwanda yibanze ku kuzamura no kwihutisha gahunda y’ikoreshwa ry’ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda hongerwa umubare w’abantu batunze smartphone ndetse bakagerwaho na internet. Mu Rwanda hari ingo miliyoni 2.8 intego ni uko buri rugo nibura rwagira smartphone, nyuma y’igihe, intego ikaba yaba ko buri wese yayigira. Umuyobozi w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere, RDB, Clare Akamanzi, yanditse ku rukuta rwe rwa Twitter asaba Ikipe ya Arsenal nayo kwitabira asobanura ko “hazatangwa telefoni zikorerwa mu Rwanda za Mara Phone hagamijwe gufasha abo mu cyaro kugera kuri serivisi z’ingenzi”. Nyuma yo gusobanura ikigamijwe, yahise abaza iyi kipe ati “ese muritabira?” I would to invite @Arsenal to join the #ConnectRwanda challenge. We will provide #MadeInRwanda @MaraPhones smart phones to increase rural access to key services. title: MTN Rwanda yinjiye mu bukangurambaga ‘ConnectRwanda’ bugamije kugeza telefoni zigezweho kuri bose
content: ConnectRwanda ni ubukangurambaga bwa Minisiteri y’Ikoranabuhanga na Inovasiyo bugamije ko buri rugo rwatunga telefoni igezweho nibura imwe. Mu kiganiro kivuga ku ntambwe ya FPR Inkotanyi mu myaka 25 ishize nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, cyatangiwe mu Nama Nkuru ya 14 y’uwo Muryango, Minisitiri w’Ikoranabuhanga na Inovasiyo, Ingabire Paula, yavuze ko ari gahunda yatekerejweho na Minisiteri ayobora n’ibigo by’itumanaho, harebwa uko umuturage yarushaho koroherezwa kubona telefoni igendanwa igezweho. Mu ntego yayo yo guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga mu Banyarwanda, MTN Rwanda, ku wa 20 Ukuboza 2019 nibwo yatangaje ko itangije ubukangurambaga bugamije guteza imbere no kwihutisha ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda. Ubwo yatangizaga ubwo bukangurambaga, Umuyobozi wa MTN Rwanda, Mitwa Ng’ambi, yavuze ko buri mu ntego y’icyo kigo yo guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda. Ati “Intego yacu ni ukuba imbere mu ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda. Twibona nk’abafatanyabikorwa mu ikoranabuhanga u Rwanda rukatajemo. Dushaka kubona u Rwanda aho buri Munyarwanda yisanga mu Isi y’ikoranabuhanga.” Yavuze ko kugira ngo ibyo bishoboke mu minsi mike batangira gahunda nyinshi zizatuma buri Munyarwanda atunga smartphone. Ati “Kugira ngo ibyo bishoboke, mu mezi make ari imbere turatangira gahunda zitandukanye kugira ngo twongere smartphones mu baturage no kongera ikoreshwa rya internet.” Umuyobozi ushinzwe Iyamamazabikorwa muri MTN, Richard Acheampong, yasobanuye ko ari ubukangurambaga bugizwe n’ibikorwa by’uruhererekane. Igice cya mbere cyabwo kigizwe no kwitanga telefoni zigezweho ku bantu batandukanye, kigamije kugira ngo abantu bose muri rusange bagire uruhare rwabo muri ubwo bukangurambaga. Bizatuma abatari bake badatunze smartphones zibageraho bivuye kuri icyo gikorwa cy’ubugiraneza. Yavuze ko abantu bashobora gukurikira ibijyanye n’icyo gikorwa cyo kwitanga banyuze kuri Twitter ya MTN Rwanda, bakemera telefoni bazatanga. Abantu bashobora gutanga telefoni zigezweho bazijyanye ku biro bya Serivisi za MTN hirya no hino mu gihugu, bashobora kujyana amafaranga mu ntoki (cash) cyangwa bakazishyura kuri Mobile Money. Acheampong yagize ati “Hamwe na  ConnectRwanda, dushobora gufasha abadafite smartphones  kuzitunga, buri muntu ashobora gutuma nibura umuntu umwe ayitunga.” MTN itangaza ko igice cya kabiri cy’ubwo bukangurambaga kizaba kigizwe no gutanga ubwisanzure ku gukoresha internet hakurwaho kurangira kw’amwe mu mapaki yayo ya internet. Iyitwa ‘MTN Tuuuza’ ni bumwe mu bwoko bw’ayo mapaki ya internet izatangizwa ku ikubitiro. Ayo mapaki (bundles) abakiliya bazajya bayageraho bakanda *345#. Ni ubukangurambaga buzaba kandi burimo kugurisha smartphones zo mu bwoko bwa “Taci” na internet ya 4G. ‘ConnectRwanda’ ni ubukangurambaga, abantu batandukanye barangajwe imbere na Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame bamaze kugaragaza ko bashyigikiye  cyane. Imibare y’Urwego Ngenzuramikorere (RURA) yo mu Ugushyingo uyu mwaka igaragaza ko Abanyarwanda batunze telefoni ngendanwa ari 9,527,829. Gusa iyo babara aba, haba hagendewe ku mubare wa sim card zikora, ku buryo ushobora gusanga hari umwe ufite izirenga ebyiri. Ibi bisobanuye ko ugiye kubarura, utasanga telefoni miliyoni icyenda n’imisago, ahubwo wabona sim card zingana n’uwo mubare zishobora kuba zikoreshwa muri telefoni zitanageze no kuri miliyoni eshanu. Muri miliyoni icyenda n’imisago zibarurwa, MTN Rwanda yihariye umubare munini na 5,245,426. Ni mu gihe Abanyarwanda bangana na 52.1% ari bo bakoresha internet bavuye kuri 7.9% babarwaga mu 2010.

title: Icyogajuru cya Boeing kigiye kugaruka ku butaka kitarangije ubutumwa cyoherejwemo
content: Aya makuru yo kugaruka kw’icyo cyogajuru yemejwe n’ikigo cy’Abanyamerika gishinzwe iby’ubumenyi bw’isanzure(NASA) na Boing, bivuga ko kigera ku butaka bwo mu mujyi wa New Mexico kuri iki cyumweru saa kumi n’imwe na 47,  ni ukuvuga saa sita n’iminota 57 ku isaha mpuzahanga. Iki cyogejuru kuri ubu kiri mu birometero 250. Abenjeniyeri ba Boeing bari gukora ibishoboka byose ngo cyoherezwe mu isanzure kinyuze hejuru y’inyanja ya Pacifique. Iki cyogajuru kigiye kugaruka ku butaka ubutumwa cyoherejwemo budakozwe. Ni amakuru mabi kuri Boeing nyuma y’impanuka ebyiri indege z’indege za Boeing zo mu bwoko bwa 737 MAX  zahitanye ubuzima bw’abantu 346. Iki cyogajuru cyoherejwe mu isanzure ku wa Gatanu w’icyumweru gishize muri Leta ya Florida ariko nyuma yo gutandukana n’igikoresho kicyohereza nticyabasha gukora nk’uko byateganyijwe, bituma kitagera mu nzira yacyo ituma kibasha guhana amakuru na sitasiyo zishinzwe ingendo  zo mu kirere. Nyuma y’urwo rugendo byagaragaye ko cyamaze umwanya gikoresha ibigiha imbaraga zikigurutsa mu buryo butandukanye n’uko cyagombaga kubikoresha. Visi Perezida wa Boeing, unashinzwe ishami rijyanye n’ibyo kohereza mu kirere, Jim Chilton, yabwiye abanyamakuru ko habayeho amakosa bagikora, ‘Bashyira isaha ku gihe kitari cyo’. Umuyobozi wa NASA, Jim Bridenstine, yavuze ko kuba kitarabashije gukora ubutumwa cyohererejwemo mu isanzure bidasobanuye ko bwananiranye ahubwo ko ‘Itsinda ry’abakozi ba NASA na Boeing bazakomeza gukorana bya hafi kugira ngo icyo gikorwa kirangire’. Iki cyogajuru cyoherejwe mu isanzure gifite umuvuduko wikubye inshuro 25 umuvuduko w’ijwi. Biteganyijwe ko NASA izafata umwanzuro wo kongera kucyoherezayo cyangwa ikizera niba hari ibindi bishobora kwifashishwa mu kujyana mu isanzure abahanga mu by’ubumenyi bw’ikirere. Icyogajuru cyagombaga kuzajya mu isanzure kijyanye n’abantu byari biteganyijwe ko kizoherezwayo mu 2020 ariko nta gihe nyamukuru kiratangazwa. Ikindi cyogajuru kitwa Crew Dragon kirimo gukorwa na SpaceX ifatanyije na NASA nacyo biteganyijwe ko kizoherezwa mu isanzure mu gihe cya vuba. NASA yemereye miliyari 8$ Boeing na SpaceX igihe bizaba bigejeje abakora ingendo mu kirere nibura batandatu uhereye ubu kugera mu 2024.

title: Facebook niyo ifite porogaramu nyinshi zimaze kumanurwa kuri internet
content:
Kuwa Mbere tariki ya 16 Ukuboza, Facebook, Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp na Instragram nizo porogaramu zasohotse ku rutonde rwa App Annie’s nk’iziri ku isonga mu zikunzwe cyane . Hagati y’umwaka wa 2010-2019, porogaramu ya Facebook ni yo yamanurwaga cyane kuri internet, ikurikirwa na Facebook Messenger. Whatsapp yaje mwanya wa gatatu na ho Instagram iza ku mwanya wa kane. Facebook yaguze Instagram asaga miliyari y’amadorali mu mwaka wa 2012, igura WhatsApp asaga miliyari 19 z’amadorali mu mwaka wa 2014. Porogaramu enye zihagarariwe n’umuyobozi wa Facebook, Mark Zuckerburg, buri imwe ikoreshwa n’abasaga miliyari. Inzobere mu bushakashatsi mu bijyanye na mudasobwa mu kigo cy’Abongereza cyitwa Oxford Internet Institute, Taha Yasseri, agereranya kuba ikigo kimwe gifite imbuga nkoranyambaga na porogaramu z’itumanaho zikoreshwa cyane, nko kwiharira abakoresha internet kandi ko ibiri kuri izi mbuga nkoranyambaga zitandukanye bishobora kuba imbarutso yo guhindura umuco n’imyitwarire y’abazikoresha. Snapchat na Skype byaje ku mwanya wa 5 na 6, bikurikiwe na Tik Tok ndetse na UC Browser bya sosiyete y’Abashinwa Alibaba. You Tube yaje ku mwanya wa 9 naho Twitter iza ku mwanya wa 10. Porogaramu 8 mu 10 ziza ku isonga ni izo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, mu gihe izindi ebyiri  ari iza sosiyete y’Abashinwa. Umukino ukunze kumanurwa cyane kuri internet muri iki kinyejana, ni Subway Surfers, wakozwe n’ikigo gikora imikino cyitwa Denmark firm Kiloo. Umukino Candy Crush wahigitse Temple Run 2, uza ku mwanya wa kabiri , mu gihe Clash of Clans yaje ku mwanya wa gatanu. Porogaramu yo kurebera amashusho kuri internet (video streaming), na porogaramu z’imiziki, ni zo zitwara amafaranga cyane abazikoresha bakoresheje porogaramu ya Netflix, Pandora Music na Tencent video zose ziza muri eshanu ziri ku isonga. Urutonde rwa porogaramu zimanurwa cyane kuri internet.

title: Ibiganiro ku mushinga uzongerera ubushobozi abiga ibya porogaramu z’ikoranabuhanga bigeze kure
content:
Ni umushinga uzatangira mu 2020 ukaba witezweho kurushaho kongerera ubumenyi abana biga muri iri shuri mu bijyanye no gukora porogaramu za mudasobwa, umutekano mu by’ikoranabuhanga no kubigisha ibijyanye n’uruhurirane rw’ibice bya mudasobwa. Umuyobozi wungirije wa KOICA  mu Rwanda, Choi Myung, yavuze  ko mu gihe uyu mushinga uzaba umaze kwemezwa n’icyicaro gikuru cy’iki kigo uzatangira gushyirwa mu bikorwa. Yagize ati “Mu gihe uyu mushinga uzaba wemejwe n’icyicaro gikuru cya KOICA, hamwe na MINEDUC n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa, tuzarebera hamwe uburyo burambuye uyu mushinga washyirwa mu bikorwa”. Muri uyu mushinga KOICA izashoramo amadorali agera ku miliyoni 5.8 azafasha mu kugura ibikoresho no kubaka iri shuri rikajya ku rwego mpuzamahanga.
Umunyamabanga uhoraho muri Ministeri y’uburezi, Mulindwa Samuel, yavuze  ko mu gihe uyu mushinga uzaba utangiye gushyirwa mu bikorwa bizafasha igihugu kugera ku cyerekezo cyo kugira inzobere mu ikoranabuhanga. Ati “Ndizera ko icyo twifuza kuzageraho tuzakigeraho nk’igihugu. Aho tuzaba dufite inzobere mu by’ Ikoranabuhanga, aho twifuza ko igihugu kiza ku isonga mu by’ikoranabuhanga.” Korea y’Epfo nk’igihugu gisanzwe giteye imbere mu ikoranabuhanga byitezwe ko binyuze muri uyu mushinga abana b’Abanyarwanda na bo bazafashwa kongera ubumenyi muri uru rwego. Ku ruhande rwa Minisiteri y’ikoranabuhanga bo basanga uyu mushinga uzafasha mu kongera umubare w’abana biga ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga ndetse bakagira n’aho bigira heza. Kuri ubu iri shuri ryatangijwe mu rwego rwo kugabanya umubare w’abahanga mu ikoranabuhanga igihugu gikura hanze ryigamo abagera kuri 60 batsinze neza imibare n’ubugenge (Physics), bakazahabwa impamyabumenyi y’amashuri yisumbuye nyuma y’imyaka itatu bigishwa.

title: Umuburo ku bakoresha WhatsApp kubera abatekamutwe bakomeje kubibasira
content: N’iyo bitaba kukwambura amafaranga, ushobora kwibwa amakuru runaka cyangwa konti yawe ikaba yakoreshwa mu gukwirakwiza amakuru atariyo. Nta n’uwo bitabaho, kuko uheruka guhura n’iri sanganya ari Minisitiri w’Ubutabera akaba n’Intumwa Nkuru ya Leta, Johnston Busingye. Birasanzwe ko iyo ugiye gukoresha WhatsApp bwa mbere muri telefoni, iyo umaze gushyiramo nomero ya telefoni hari imibare itandatu (verification code) wohererezwa kuri ya nimero uzajya ukoresha kuri WhatsApp. Iyo nimero ushaka gukoresha ari yo iri muri iyo telefoni, uwo mubare uhita wiyuzuza ahabigenewe nta kindi bigusabye. Iyo iri mu yindi telefoni, wa mubare niho ujya bityo bikagusaba kuwurebamo, ukawuzuza ahagenwe. Ni nako bigenda iyo umutekamutwe ashatse kwigarurira WhatsApp yawe, ashyira iyi porogaramu nko muri telefoni ye, akuzuzamo nimero yawe ya telefoni, ugahita wohererezwa ya code utabizi. Akenshi hari ubwo abo bantu bazakubwira ko hari ubutumwa bugufi bwakuyobeyeho bakagusaba kububoherereza. Ucyoherereza wa muntu iyo mibare, WhatsApp yo muri telefoni ye itangira gukora, iyawe ikavaho maze akigarurira ubutumwa bwose, agatangira kuvugana n’abantu bawe ari naho ahera abasaba amafaranga mu izina ryawe, uwemeye kuyohereza akamusaba kuyanyuza ku yindi nimero amuha. Mu butumwa Urwego rw’Ubugenzacyaha, RIB, rukomeje gutanga, rusaba abantu “kudaha agaciro abakoherereza ubutumwa bugufi biyitirira abantu musanzwe muziranye, bagusaba kubasubiza ubutumwa bavuga ko buyobeye kuri telefoni yawe.” Harimo kandi kwirinda gutanga imibare y’ibanga (verification code) ya WhatsApp ku bakubwira ko yayobeye kuri telefoni yawe n’iyo mwaba muziranye no gushishoza neza mbere yo kohereza amafaranga ku bantu bakubwira ko bayakeneye cyane byihuse ariko bahuze, bari buyagusubize, n’iyo mwaba muziranye. Nibiba ngombwa ubanze umuhamagare. RIB ikomeza iti “Mu gihe uhuye n’iki kibazo wakwihutira gutanga ikirego cyawe kuri Sitasiyo ya RIB ikwegereye cyangwa ugahamagara kuri nimero ya RIB itishyurwa 166. Ni ngombwa kubigeza kuri RIB bikiba kugira ngo usubizwe WhatsApp yawe kuko iyo bidakozwe vuba uwibye WhatsApp akomeza kuyikoresha yiba abandi.” Ni ibintu byeze ku buryo hari ubwo iyi code izana n’ahantu ukanda (link), wabikora utaranamenya n’ibyo ari byo bikaba bisobanuye ko wa mubare ari wowe uwemeje, ukaba ushyize WhatsApp yawe mu maboko y’abagizi ba nabi.

title: Ikoranabuhanga rishya rishobora gutuma tugera kuri Mars vuba
content: Impamvu y’ubu buvumbuzi bushya buri gukorwa irumvikana. Ni uko inzira ziganisha ku mpera y’Isi na Mars zose zisaba kuzenguruka ukwezi, harimo intera ndende iri hagati y’ibilometero miliyoni 54.6 na 401. Ubutumwa bwo kujya kuri Mars bukorwa mu gihe iyi mibumbe yombi isa n’iyegeranye. Bifata amezi nibura icyenda kugira ngo umuntu agere kuri Mars hifashishijwe ‘rocket’ zigenda ziyongera umuvuduko uko zikora urugendo. Icyo gihe bisaba ngo umuntu agere kuri Mars ni kirekire ku buryo bigoye ngo akimare ari mu rugendo. Abahanga barimo abo mu Kigo cya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika gikora Ubushakashatsi mu isanzure, Nasa, bari mu bushakashatsi kugira ngo bakore ikintu gishobora kwihuta mu kugera kuri Mars. Mu ikoranabuhanga riri kwigwaho, harimo iryifashisha ingufu z’izuba. Abahanga mu by’isanzure bari gukora ku mushinga wo gukora icyo umuntu yagereranya n’icyogajuru ariko cyifashisha ingufu z’izuba mu mushinga wiswe Solar Electric Propulsion, SEP. Iri koranabuhanga ryitezweho ko rishobora kwifashishwa mu kohereza imizigo kuri Mars mbere y’uko habaho urugendo rw’umuntu. Ibyo byafasha ko abahanga mu bumenyi bw’ikirere bagerayo bagasanga hariyo ibikoresho byose bakeneye, gusa bo bagenda bakoresheje ‘rocket’ zisanzwe. Uko uyu mushinga uteye ni uko icyo bazohereza kuri Mars kizaba gifite ubushobozi bwo gufata ingufu z’izuba kikazibyaza amashanyarazi asanzwe. Ubusanzwe iyo icyogajuru cyoherejwe mu kirere kiba gikoresha ingufu zingana na kilowatt ziri hagati ya 10 na 15, ariko abahanga bari gushaka kuzongera nibura ku buryo zagera kuri Kw 50. Ikibazo kiriho ubu ni ubushobozi bw’imizigo icyogajuru gikoresha imirasire y’izuba cyakoherezwa cyaba gifite kuko ubusanzwe ibintu bikoresha imirasi bikora neza iyo bitwaye ibintu bitaremereye cyane. Ikindi gitekerezo ni ukwifashisha ibyogajuru bikoresha ingufu za nucléaire ku buryo bihaguruka ku Isi bigafungira amaferi kuri Mars.

title: Toyota na Honda zakuye ku isoko imodoka zirenga miliyoni esheshatu kubera ibibazo bya tekiniki
content: Toyota yatangaje ko igiye gukura ku isoko imodoka miliyoni 3.4, muri zo miliyoni 2.9 ni imodoka ziri muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika zifite ibibazo biterwa n’ibikoresho birinda abagenzi mu gihe cy’impanuka, Airbag. Imodoka zifite ibibazo ni iziri muri Amerika ya Ruguru, iyo hagati n’Amajyepfo zirimo izo mu bwoko bwa Corolla, Corolla Matrix, Avalon, na Avalon HV zakozwe hagati y’umwaka wa 2010 na 2019. Ku rundi ruhande, Honda nayo yatangaje ko igiye gukura ku isoko imodoka miliyoni 2.7 zirimo 2.4 ziri muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’izindi 300,000 ziri muri Canada. Ubwoko bufite ikibazo ni izitwa Acuras zakozwe hagati y’umwaka wa 1996 na 2003 zifite ibibazo bya “airbag” zifite inenge mu buryo zakozwe. Imodoka za Toyota ziri gukurwa ku isoko kuko zagakwiye kuba zikoranye ikoranabuhanga rigenzura rikamenyesha umuntu niba hari impanuka igiye kubaho ku buryo icyo gihe airbag ihita yifungura hanyuma n’imikandara y’intebe ikifunga ikikomeza ku buryo umuntu atagira imvune ikabije. Toyota yatangaje ko ikoranabuhanga riri muri ziriya modoka rishobora kudakora neza mu gihe cy’impanuka bitewe na kirogoya zishobora kubaho ku buryo Airbag zitafunguka n’imikandara ntiyifunge cyane. Honda yo yavuze ko imodoka yakuye ku isoko zifite ikibazo cya Airbag zakozwe n’uruganda rwa Takata zikoranye amakosa ku buryo aho kugira ngo zikize ubuzima bw’umuntu zishobora guturika.

title: Instagram igiye kujya igenzura amafoto ayishyirwaho yanyujijwe muri Photoshop
content: Uru rubuga rugenzurwa na Facebook ruri gukora amavugurura atandukanye by’umwihariko agamije kurwanya amakuru y’ibihuha atambutswaho. Kuri ubu amavugururwa agiye gutangazwa mu minsi iri imbere azaba agenzura amafoto yakorewe muri Photoshop. Hazajya hifashishwa uburyo bubiri. Ubwa mbere ni ubushingiye ku bitekerezo by’abantu, aho bazajya bavuga uko babona iyo foto, hanyuma ubundi bwo bushingiye ku igenzura rizajya rikorwa mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga. Mu gihe ifoto bigaragaye ko iri gutanga amakuru atari yo kubera ko yahinduwe, izajya ibanza kugenzurwa mbere y’uko yongera kugaragara kandi ubutumwa buvuga ko iri gutanga amakuru atari yo buyigaragazweho. Umuvugizi wa Facebook yatangaje ko amafoto atazajya ahishwa kuko yakorewe Photoshop, ahubwo ko azajya ashyirwaho ikirango mu gihe ari kugenzurwa. Mu gihe iryo genzura rirangiye, kizajya gikurwaho mu gihe  bigaragaye ko atari amafoto agamije gukwirakwiza amakuru y’ibihuha.

title: Verizon yatangije ishakiro rya OneSearch riha umwihariko umutekano w’abakoresha internet
content: Niyo mpamvu uzabona hamwe unyura ushakisha niba ukoresha nka telefoni, iyo ugifungura urubuga rwa Google usanga imbuga wasuye kenshi ziyanditse hasi, ku buryo bitagusaba kongera kuzandikamo igihe wifuza kuzisura. Hari uburyo bukoreshwa mu gushakisha ibintu runaka kuri internet, amayira wanyuze ntabikwe na porogaramu wakoresheje (browser). Uburyo bwari busanzwe ku isoko ni DuckDuckGo, ariko ku wa 14 Mutarama 2020 hari ubundi bwinjiye ku isoko. OneSearch. Ni uburyo bwakozwe n’ikigo Verizon Media, bushobora kwifashishwa mu gushakisha ibintu binyuranye kuri internet, haba kuri telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa. Itandukaniro ry’iri shakiro rishya (search engine) ugereranyije n’uburyo busanzwe, ni uko OneSearch ifata amakuru y’uyikoresha mu buryo bwihariye. OneSearch yo ntabwo ikusanya amakuru y’umuntu unyuze muri iri shakiro ngo ibe yayagaragariza uwo ari we wese, cyangwa ngo igumane ibyo ukunda gushakisha, ku buryo ibigo bidashobora kwifashisha amakuru yawe ngo bikwamamazeho ibintu runaka bitewe n’ibyo babonye ukunda gushakisha. Mu gushakisha ibyo umuntu akeneye, OneSearch ivuga ko izajya itanga “ibisubizo bidafite ikindi cyagize uruhare mu kubigena.” Iki kigo kinavuga ko ibintu byose umuntu ashakisha bizajya birindwa, ku buryo niba ukoresha OneSearch umuntu adashobora kugukurikirana ngo amenye ngo ukunda kureba ibi cyangwa ukunda gusura imbuga runaka. Iri shakiro rinatanga uburyo bwisumbuye bw’umutekano buzwi nka “Advanced Privacy Mode”, aho imbuga wasuye, nyuma y’isaha imwe zisiba mu ishakiro ryawe. Nk’uko Verizon yabitangaje, ubu buryo buzafasha cyane mu kurinda amakuru y’umuntu wifashisha nka telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa agashakisha ikintu runaka kuri internet, nyuma undi muntu akaza kuyifashisha cyangwa icyo washakishaga ukagisangiza abandi. Iri shakiro rya OneSearch naryo rizaba ryemera amatangazo yohererezwa abantu bari kuri internet, ariko azajya atangwa hashingiwe ku kintu runaka ushakishije, aho gushingira ku bintu ukunze gushakisha cyangwa imbuga ukunda gusura. OneSearch ni kimwe mu bishya bihanzwe na Verizon Media, aho ije isanga ibindi bikorwa birimo ibinyamakuru HuffPost, TechCrunch na Yahoo. Ni imbuga Verison ivuga ko zisurwa n’abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 900 buri kwezi. Umutekano w’abakoresha internet ni ikintu cyakunze gutindwaho cyane, bitewe ahanini n’uburyo ibigo bikomeye nka Facebook, Google na Amazon birimo gushinjwa gukoresha nabi amakuru y’ababikoresha. Ni mu gihe ayo makuru usanga abyazwa umusaruro mu buryo bw’ubucuruzi, ibintu bikomeje gutuma nka Facebook ihora mu nkiko.

title: Windows 7 mu marembera
content: Guhera kuri uyu wa 14 Mutarama 2020, uruganda rwa Microsoft rwahagaritse uburyo rwatangaga ubufasha mu kugeza ibintu bishya (updates) ku bakoresha Windows 7 cyangwa mu bijyanye n’umutekano. Ku rubuga rwa Microsoft bagaragaza ko porogaramu ituma mudasobwa zikora (operating system) ya Window 10 Home igurwa $139, ariko ntibiraba ngombwa gutanga ayo mafaranga yose: Microsoft yatanze amahirwe yo kuyijyanisha n’igihe (upgrade) ku buntu bwagombaga kurangira mu 2016, ariko n’ubu biracyakora. Mu mpinduka nshya ariko, Microsoft yatangaje ko izakomeza gufasha mu by’umutekano abantu bakoresha Windows 7 mu buryo bw’ubucuruzi ndetse banabyishyurira, bitandukanye no kuba byakorwaga ku bantu ku giti cyabo. Windows 7 yagiye ku isoko mu 2009, ni imwe muri porogaramu zifashishwa cyane mu gukoresha za mudasobwa. Gusa mu mpera z’umwaka ushize Windows 10 yayiciyeho mu kuba ikoreshwa n’abantu benshi nk’uko ZDNet yabitangaje. Igenzura ryakozwe na NetMarketShare mu Ukuboza 2018 ryerekanye ko mu mashini zarebweho, 39.2% zakoreshaga Windows 10 naho 36.9% zakoreshaga Windows 7. Ubwo Windows 10 yasohokaga bwa mbere muri Nyakanga 2015, Microsoft yatanze amahirwe yo kuyisimbuza ku buntu ku bakoresha Windows 7, 8 na 8.1, kugeza muri Nyakanga 2016. Gusa ubwo buryo bwakomeje gukora ku buntu, kuko ababigerageza bavuga ko bigikunda kugeza magingo aya. Icyo ukwiye kuzirikana ni uko iyo Windows 7 uyisimbuje Windows 10 bihindura igenamikorere (settings) rya mudasobwa yawe, kimwe na zimwe muri porogaramu ufitemo zishobora guhinduka mu buryo zakoraga cyangwa zigasibama. Hari uburyo bwo kugumana ibintu wabitse muri mudasobwa yawe ndetse n’amakuru yawe bwite, ariko bitewe n’itandukaniro riri hagati ya Windows 10 na Windows 7, ntabwo bikunda ko porogaramu zose wari ufite muri mudasobwa uzigumana uko zakabaye. Windows 8.1 nayo ishobora kujyanishwa n’igihe igasimburwa na Windows 10, ariko yo ntabwo ari ngombwa ko isiba porogaramu wari ufite cyangwa ngo ihindure igenamikorere rya mudasobwa yawe. Uko watangira gukoresha Windows 10 ku buntu Niba ukoresha Windows 7, Windows 8 cyangwa Windows 8.1 Home cyangwa Pro: 1. Banza ubike mu buryo bwihariye (back up) inyandiko zawe, porogaramu cyangwa amakuru yawe bwite. 2. Jya aho ushobora kumanurira (download) Windows 10 ku rubuga rwa Microsoft. 2. Kanda ahanditse ‘Download’ ukurikizeho ahanditse ‘Run’. 3. Nimara gufunguka, hitamo ‘Upgrade this PC’ niba iyi Windows 10 ushaka kuyishyira muri mudasobwa urimo gukoresha, cyangwa ukande kuri ‘create installation media’, niba ushaka kuyibika nko kuri flash disc cyangwa ahandi, ngo uze kuyishyira mu yindi mudasobwa. Ibyo nibiba birangiye, mudasobwa izakubaza niba ukeneye kugumana amadosiye yawe cyangwa niba ushaka gutangira bundi bushya. Nuhitamo gutangira bundi bushya bizaba bivuze ko amadosiye yose wari ufite agiye gusibwa, ugatangira bundi bushya gushyiramo Windows 10. Nimara kujyamo, uzahabwa uburyo bwo gutangiza Windows 10, aho ushobora kubona unyuze muri Settings > Update & Security > Activation. Aha ariko niba usanzwe ukoresha Windows 7 cyangwa 8 Home, ushobora kujyanisha n’igihe Windows yawe igahinduka Windows 10 Home, mu gihe Windows 7 cyangwa 8 Pro ishobora kujyanishwa n’igihe ikaba Windows 10 Pro.

title: Uko wagaruza telefoni yawe ya Android yibwe
content: Guta cyangwa kwibwa telefoni si ibintu buri wese ahita yakira bitwe n’uburyo tuzifashisha mu buzima bwa buri munsi, ariko hari n’uburyo wakomeza kuyikurikirana, ukamenya aho iherereye ikaba yagaruzwa! Hari uburyo telefoni yawe ya Android yabuze ushobora kuyikurikirana, ukaba wayifunga uwayitwaye ntayikoreshe ndetse ugakurikirana aho iherereye mu buryo bworoshye. Hari intambwe z’ingenzi ugomba gutera igihe telefoni yawe ukiyifite mu maboko. Yifunge mu buryo bwizewe Ni ngombwa ko telefoni yawe uyifungisha uburyo bwizewe, butuma nta muntu wapfa kuyinjiramo. Ni ukuvuga gukoresha umubare w’ibanga kandi utapfa gufindurwa na buri wese nk’urimo imibare, ibimenyetso n’inyuguti nkuru, ugakoresha n’igikumwe kuri telefoni bishoboka. Ikindi, ni byiza kwirinda gufunguza telefoni yawe isura kuri telefoni za Android, ibizwi nka Facial Recognition. Impamvu ni uko iyo isura y’umuntu ariyo ikoreshwa mu gufungura telefoni, iri koranabuhanga kuri telefoni zimwe rishobora kujijishwa n’umuntu uwo ari we wese, akoresheje nk’ifoto ya nyirayo. Umwihariko uba kuri telefoni nshya za Google arizo Pixel 4 na Pixel 4 XL, kuko zo zikoresha ubuhanga bwihariye nk’ubwa Apple mu gukoresha isura y’umuntu, ku buryo bwakwizerwa kurusha izindi telefoni. Uburyo bwa ‘Find My Device’ bwa Google Iteka iyo winjiye muri telefoni yawe nshya ya Android, ugashyiramo konti ya Google (Gmail), uburyo bugufasha gutahura telefoni yawe bwa ‘Find My Device’ buhita bufunguka. Nibwo uzifashisha telefoni yawe yibwe cyangwa itakaye, ku buryo ushobora kuyifunga cyangwa ugasiba ibintu byose biyiriho kandi utayifite mu ntoki. Ni ngombwa kwinjira muri telefoni yawe ukareba niba ‘Find My Device’ ifunguye, ukanyura mu igenamikorere rya telefoni (settings), ukajya mu bijyanye n’umutekano n’ibiranga ahantu (Security & Location), ukagera muri Find My Device. Ushobora no kunyura muri Google > Security > Find My Device. Find My Device igomba kuba ifunguye, niba atari ko bimeze, yinjiremo maze urebe akarongo gatambitse kaguha icyerekezo kigana iburyo, ugakozeho urutoki ukajyane iburyo gaheze inguni, ku buryo hiyandikamoko “on” cyangwa kagahindura ibara. Find My Mobile kuri Samsung Niba utunze telefoni ya Samsung, uretse uburyo bwa ‘Find My Device’ butangwa na Google, uzabonamo ubundi bwihariye bwagenwe na Samsung, buzwi nka ‘Find My Mobile’. Ntabwo buguha amahirwe yo gukurikirana telefoni yawe yabuze gusa, bunaguha amahitamo yagutse kurusha uburyo bwa Google. Muri iyo serivisi ya Samsung, wibereye aho uri ushobora gukurura ibintu biri muri telefoni wabuze (backup) cyangwa ukabona niba umuntu yavanyemo sim card yawe. Aho bigusaba kuba warafunguye konti ya Samsung kugira ngo ukoreshe ubwo buryo bwa ‘Find My Mobile.’ Kubwinjiramo uca muri ‘settings’ ukinjira muri Biometrics and security > Find My Mobile. Niba ugitangira kuyikoresha warahise ufungura konti ya Samsung muri ya masaha ya mbere, Find My Mobile iba irimo gukora. Niba atari ko byagenze, fata umwanya muto ufungure konti ya Samsung, ufungure na Find My Mobile. Koresha Find My Device Gukoresha ubu buryo bwa Google, bizagusaba gusura urubuga rumwe. Android.com/find. Ni rwo rubuga uzajyaho mu bihe nk’ibyo uzaba wabuzemo telefoni yawe. Ni ngombwa ko uzabanza kuzuzamo konti yawe ya Google ihura neza n’iri muri telefoni yawe ya Android. Utari hafi ya mudasobwa, ushobora gukoresha indi telefoni ya Android, ugashyiramo application ya Find My Device uyikuye muri Play Store. Ukimara gushyira konti yawe muri urwo rubuga cyangwa iyo application, Google izahita itangira gushakira irengero rya telefoni yawe. Ako kanya izahita ibwira umuntu uyifite ko nyirayo arimo kuyishakisha, ubundi ukoreshe amahitamo ari ku ruhande rw’ibumoso muri Find My Device kugira ngo utume itera hejuru, bityo niba iri hafi aho mu rugo ube wayibona, ubashe kuyifunga cyangwa usibe ibintu byose biriho niba yibwe. Nuhitamo ahanditse ‘Secure Device”, uzaba uyifunze, kandi uzaba ushobora gukomeza kubona aho iherereye nubwo uzaba wayifunze. Niba ukoresha uburyo nka Google Pay mu kwishyurana kuri telefoni, kuyifunga bizatuma nta muntu ukoresha telefoni yawe ngo agire ikintu na kimwe agura. Nuhitamo ahanditse ‘Erase Device’, ntabwo uzabasha kongera gukurikirana iyo telefoni kubera ko n’ibikuranga bizasibwa. Ubu ni uburyo bushobora gukoreshwa iyo ubundi bwose bwananiranye, ukavanamo ibyawe ubundi ukayiheba. Igihe umujura yaba yazimije telefoni yawe, ntabwo wabasha kuyikurikirana kereka igihe yaba ayicanye kandi akaba arimo gukoresha internet. Google ihita ikoherereza email iyo ibone amerekezo ya telefoni yawe. Iyo uyibonye, bigusaba kongera gushyiramo PIN cyangwa undi mubare w’ibanga kugira ngo ubashe kongera kuyikoresha, rimwe na rimwe bakanagusaba kongera gushyira umubare w’ibanga muri konti ya Google, kugira ngo bamenye neza ko ari nyir’ubwite urimo kuyikoresha. Telefoni za Samsung Nk’abakoresha Samsung Galaxy, bafite amahirwe yo gukoresha serivisi za Google cyangwa Samsung mu gushakisha telefoni yabuze. Ariko uburyo bwa Samsung hano nibwo bwizewe kurushaho kubera amahirwe y’inyongera butanga. Ukeneye gukurikirana telefoni yibwe bimusaba gusura urubuga findmymobile.samsung.com. Aha ho nta application y’inyunganizi batanga nko kuri Google, ni ukuvuga ko ukoresha indi telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa, unyuze ahagenewe gusura imbuga zinyuranye. Injiza konti yawe ya Samsung ahabigenewe, uhitemo telefoni yawe yatakaye ku ruhande rw’ibumoso. Ikarita igaragaza aho telefoni yawe iherereye izahita yigaragaza, unahabwe amahitamo anyuranye, ku ruhande rw’iburyo kuri telefoni yawe. Hera ku gushyira imfunguzo muri telefoni yawe, ibintu bizahita buyoherezaho ubutumwa ushaka, bigahagarika amakariya yawe ya Samsung Pay ndetse uwayibye ntabashe kuba yayizimya. Nyuma uhabwa amahirwe yo kurema ububiko bwihariye bw’ibintu biri muri telefoni yawe, ku buryo uramutse uyibuze burundu, uzaba ufite bwa bubiko bw’ibintu byose (backup). Niba telefoni igenda yimuka aho iri, unahitamo uburyo bukwereka izo nzira zose. Ubwo buryo buzajya bukwereka aho telefoni yawe iri buri minota 15. Ushobora kandi kwemeza uburyo butuma umuriro umara igihe muri batiri ya telefoni yawe, ubwo buryo bukaba buhagarika ibintu byose, igasigarana gusa ubushobozi butuma ikugaragariza aho iri. Kimwe na Find My Device yakozwe na Google, serivisi ya Samsung igusaba PIN yawe iyo umaze kubona telefoni yawe. Ntabwo igusaba gusubira kuri rwa rubuga waciyeho ngo uvanemo uburyo bwo gukomeza kuyikurikirana. Ni ngombwa ko niba wibwe telefoni gutya, ukagira amahirwe ukamenya aho iherereye, utishora ubwawe ngo ujye kuyibohoza, cyane ko bishobora gutuma ugirirwa nabi n’umujura. Ni ngombwa kwitabaza inzego zishinzwe umutekano zikabigufashamo, ukazishyikiriza ibipimo byose urimo kubona by’aho telefoni yawe iherereye.

title: Umunyarwanda yavumbuye ikoranabuhanga rikoreshwa muri Gari ya moshi zo mu Bushinwa
content: Mu 2002 u Bushinwa bwatangiye gukoresha bwa mbere gari ya moshi izwi nka Maglev (magnetic levitation) zigira umuvuduko wa Kilometero 431 mu isaha ziri mu zihuta cyane ku Isi. Ni gari ya moshi ikoresha ikoranabuhanga rya rukuruzi, aho igice cyayo gitwara abagenzi kigenda gikururuka ku nzira ikozwe muri rukuruzi, bikayiha imbaraga zidasanzwe zo kwihuta. Ni gari ya moshi idakoresha amashanyarazi cyangwa ibikomoka kuri peteroli, nta moteri igira muri make. Guhera iki gihe ibindi bihugu bike nk’u Buyapani na Koreya y’Epfo n’ibyo byabashije gukoresha ubu bwoko bwa Gari ya Moshi nshya zihuta cyane. Gusa n’ubwo izi Gari ya Moshi zagendaga zikundwa n’abatari bake kubera umuvuduko wazo wihutishaga urugendo, hari hakiri ikibazo cy’uko nta koranabuhanga rihari rishobora kuburira abazitwara n’abazigenzura igihe mu nzira yazo harimo imbogamizi ishobora kuziteza impanuka. Aha niho Umunyarwanda witwa Katabarwa Gilbert Murenzi wari waragiye mu Bushinwa mu 2015 gukomeza amashuri y’icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza muri Kaminuza ya Tongji iri mu Mujyi wa Shanghai, yahereye akora  ubushakashatsi avumbura uburyo bushobora kwerekana ko hari imbogamizi iri mu nzira y’iyi Gari ya Moshi ya Maglev. Mu 2016 nibwo Katabarwa wigaga amasomo y’ubugenzuzi (Surveying and geometrics)  yahawe gukora ubushakashatsi ku cyuma gishobora kuvumbura inzitizi ziri mu nzira ya Maglev Katabarwa avuga ko mu ntangiriro we na mwarimu we batumvaga neza uburyo ibi bizakorwa.  Ati “Sinari nzi icyo Maglev ari cyo, ndetse na mwarimu wanjye yagaragaraga nk’utumva ibizava mu bushakashatsi." Katabarwa yahisemo gukora ubushakashatsi kuko yumvaga ntawe uzamushyiraho igitutu cyo kuburangiza vuba, bityo akabubonamo amahirwe y’uko buzamuha umwanya wo kwikorera indi mirimo yafatanyaga  no kwiga. Yagize ati “Imyumvire yanjye yari uko niba mwarimu adafite ubumenyi buhagije kuri ubu bushakashatsi, bizampa umwanya uhagije wo kwita ku biraka byanjye byo hanze ndetse mu gihe nabaga mbajijwe aho bugeze nababwiraga ko nkiri kubukoraho” Ibi si ko byagenze kuko mu 2018 Katabarwa yaje guhabwa iminsi 15 ngo yerekane aho ubushakashatsi yari amazemo imyaka ibiri bugeze, bitagenda gutyo akabura amahirwe yo kwishyurirwa ishuri yari yarabonye agasubira mu Rwanda. Yagize ati “Naravuze nti nta buryo nasubira mu rugo. Nari narakoze uburyo busobanura iryo koranabuhanga nari ndimo nkoraho ubushakashatsi. Mu gihe nari ndimo mbubamurikira bashimishijwe cyane  n’ibimaze gukorwa ndetse bansaba ko nakwitegura kubishyira mu bikorwa” Katabarwa avuga ko mu gihe yakoraga ubu bushakashatsi yagowe cyane no kugira ubundi yareberaho kuko nta bandi benshi bari barabikozeho ndetse ko na bake babigerageje bitagenze neza. Mu 2018 mu Ukuboza nibwo ku nkunga ya miliyoni 1 y’amadorali ya Leta y’u Bushinwa, Katabarwa Gilbert yatangiye gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo yari yarakuye mu bushakashatsi. Iri koranabuhanga ryavumbuwe na Katabarwa rishobora kwerekana ibiti, abantu ndetse n’ibindi bintu bishobora kujya mu nzira ya Gari ya Moshi bigateza impanuka. Gari ya Moshi imenya ko hari ikiri mu nzira yayo itarakigeraho. Katabarwa aganira na The New Times yavuze ko inzozi afite ari ukugaruka mu Rwanda agafasha mu mishinga iteza imbere imijyi igezweho n’uburyo bwo gutwara abantu n’ibintu.  Ati “ Hamwe no kwiyongera kw’abaturage no kwaguka kw’imijyi, ikoranabuhanga rigezweho rirakenewe mu kugenzura imijyi. Ndashaka kugaruka mu rugo ngo ngire uruhare ku iterambere ry’imijyi yacu muri Afurika”. Hagendewe kuri iri Koranabuhanga rya Katabarwa, umwaka ushize muri Gicurasi u Bushinwa bwatangiye igerageza ry’indi gari ya Moshi ishobora kugenda kilometero 600 mu isaha, ikazaba ifite ubushobozi bwo gukoresha amasaha atatu n’iminota 50, ahantu indege yakoresha amasaha 5 n’iminota 50.

title: Ikoreshwa rya ‘smartphones’ zirimo gutangwa muri Connect Rwanda rizakurikiranwa rite?
content: Muri iyi gahunda igamije kuzamura no kwihutisha ikoreshwa ry’ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda, abantu batangiye gutanga izi telefoni ndetse umuntu agasaba undi ahisemo kugira icyo yiyemeza, bigakorerwa kuri internet cyane cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Icyiciro cya mbere cy’ubu bukangurambaga ni ukwiyemeza gutanga telefone zigezweho, aho intego yacyo ari ukugira ngo uruhare rwa buri muntu rugaragare mu kugeza ikoranabuhanga ku batarifite hatangwa smartphones. MTN Rwanda igaragaza ko by’umwihariko hagati ya Werurwe na Ukuboza 2019 yari imaze gucuruza Smartphone zizwi nk’Ikosora zirenga ibihumbi 50 ariko hakigaragara icyuho mu gufasha Abanyarwanda gutunga telefone zigezweho, aho bakiri munsi ya 20% kuko mu baturage basaga miliyoni 12, abafite smartphone basaga miliyoni 1.7. Umuyobozi wa MTN Rwanda, Mitwa Kaemba Ng’ambi, yabwiye CNBC Africa ko ubukangurambaga bwa Connect Rwanda ari igitekerezo cyaje mu kureba uburyo inzego zitandukanye zagira uruhare mu kongera umubare w’abafite telefone zigezweho, kugira ngo boroherwe no kuzifashisha muri gahunda z’ishoramari. Kuva ubu bukangurambaga butangijwe, abantu n’ibigo bitandukanye bamaze kwiyemeza gutanga Smartphones zisaga ibihumbi 50. Ng’ambi yavuze ko MTN Rwanda yahisemo gufatanya na Minisiteri y’ikoranabuhanga na Inovasiyo muri ubu bukangurambaga kugira ngo zizagezwe ku bo zigenewe kandi babikwiriye. Ati “Ku bufatanye na Minisiteri y’ikoranabuhanga na Inovasiyo hashyizeho uburyo bugaragaza neza uburyo bizakorwa, abantu bose badafite smartphones, bazi neza abafite n’abadafite smartphones.” Yasobanuye ko na Minisiteri y’Ubutegetsi bw’igihugu isanzwe ifite imibare y’ingo zifite n’izitafite telefone zigezweho, ikazaba ariyo igenderwaho hatoranywa abazahabwa izigera ku bihumbi 50 zamaze kwiyemezwa n’abantu n’ibigo bitandukanye. Ati “Impamvu turimo gukora ibyo ni ukugira ngo twizere ko smartphones izahabwa umuntu koko utayitunze uyu munsi kugira ngo twizere ko bijyanye n’intego muri rusange ariko nanone no kureba abantu batabasha kubona serivisi z’ikoranabuhanga.” Icyiciro cya mbere cy’ubu bukangurambaga cyatangiye mu Ukuboza 2019 hagati biteganyijwe ko kizashyirwaho akadomo mu byumweru bitatu bya mbere bya Werurwe 2020. Uretse gukusanya smartphones zizatangwa muri iyo gahunda no kuzishyikiriza abagenerwabikorwa, MTN Rwanda izanafatanya na Minisiteri y’Ikoranabuhanga na Innovasiyo mu gushyiraho integanyanyigisho y’uburyo abaturage bazajya bakoresha porogaramu zizashyirwamo no kubakangurira kuri serivisi zitandukanye z’ikoranabuhanga zakwifashishwamo. Ng’ambi yakomeje ati “Tuzakomeza no gukurikirana kugira ngo twizere ko umuntu wayikoresheje ejo hashize azanayikoresha ejo hazaza, tunarebe niba hari icyuho mu kuzikoresha, tubabaze niba bibanogeye cyangwa niba hari ubundi bufasha twabaha.” Yavuze ko inyigo zitandukanye zagaragaje ko mu gihe umubare w’abakoresha telefone wiyongereye, bigira uruhare mu kongera umubare w’abakoresha ikoranabuhanga ndetse n’umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu ukiyongera. Ati “Ku ruhande rwanjye icyo niteze ni uko bazakomeza kuzikoresha bagakomeza kugerwaho na serivisi zitandukanye batabonaga mbere. Nk’uko nabivuze, serivisi nyinshi za Guverinoma zirimo gutangwa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga ariko abantu bazibona baracyari bacye kubera ko badakoresha ibikoresho bizitangirwaho.” “Ikindi mbona nk’amahirwe ni ubucuruzi buciriritse kuko mbere yo gutangiza ubu bukangurambaga, twaganiriye n’abantu benshi mu byaro tubabaza ‘Ese uwaguha smartphone ni iki wayikoresha?’ nk’abahinzi batubwiye ko hari amasoko ya kure y’aho batuye batabasha gucuruzamo ariko ko ‘bafite smartphone bashobora gufotora ibicuruzwa bakabishyira kuri internet bakaba babigura, bakabishyura nko kuri MTN Mobile Money n’ibindi.” Yavuze ko hari n’abantu bakora n’abacuruza porogaramu za telefone batandukanye usanga batabasha kubona isoko ryazo rihagije kubera umubare muto w’abakoresha smartphone bazikenera, bityo uko bazagenda biyongera ari nako isoko rizaguka. MTN Rwanda iteganya ko abantu bose bazahabwa izi telefone muri ubu bukangurambaga bazahabwa na Sim Card iriho na 1GB ya Internet mu gihe cy’amezi atatu ya mbere, mu rwego rwo kugabanya imbogamizi ku bantu bazitirwa no kubura internet. Si ibyo gusa kuko inateganya uburyo na nyuma yazabagabanyiriza igiciro cya internet ku buryo batazajya bagorwa no kubona serivisi z’ikoranabuhanga no gukomeza gushaka smartphone zidahenze, ku buryo abantu bashobora no kuzigurira. Biteganyijwe ko porogaramu 12 zizabanza gushyirwa muri izi telefoni zizatangwa muri #ConnectChallenge, zizaba ziri mu ndimi eshatu ari zo Ikinyarwanda, Icyongereza n’Igifaransa, bisobanuye ko abaturage bazihitiramo ururimi bakoresha. Izo porogaramu zirimo Irembo, Serivisi za banki, iz’ubuzima, uburezi, kwishyura ifumbire bakoresheje Smart Nkunganire, amakuru ajyanye n’iteganyagihe n’ibindi.

title: Hagiye gukorwa impinduka mu mikorere ya Bluetooth bwa mbere mu myaka 20
content: Impinduka za mbere zizagaragazwa n’uburyo amajwi asohorwa n’ibikoresho byifashisha Bluetooth [écouteur] azajya aba ayunguruye kurusha mbere, bikajyana n’ikoranabuhanga rishya mu twumvisho [écouteur] dukoresha ubu buryo. Bizanajyana n’uburryo umuriro uzajya ugenda ari muke ugereranyije n’ibisanzwe. Iri koranabuhanga ryiswe Bluetooth LE (LE isobanura Low Energy ni ukuvuga Bluetooth idatwara umuriro mwinshi) rizatuma abantu bashobora no gusangizanya ibyo bari kumva bakoresheje igikoresho kimwe. Ni ukuvuga ngo niba uri kumva umuziki kuri écouteur zawe, ukaba ushobora gusangiza undi muntu nawe agafatira ku yawe akumva. Ibyo bizafasha abantu benshi kumva nk’indirimbo imwe cyangwa ikindi kintu kimwe. Nko mu gitaramo cyangwa ahandi hateraniye abantu benshi, ubu buryo buzafasha ko abantu benshi bumva ibintu bimwe buri muntu ari ukwe, ariko aho amajwi ari kuva ari ku gikoresho kimwe bafatiyeho. Abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutumva nabo iri koranabuhanga rishya rya Bluetooth mu gihe gito rizashyirwa mu twumvisho tubafasha kumva. LE Audio ikora kuri écouteur zikoresha Bluetooth kandi ku muntu wari uzisanganywe ntabwo ashobora kurishyiramo, ahubwo bimusaba kugura inshya zizashyirwa mu isoko mu minsi mike.

title: Havumbuwe ikoranabuhanga ririnda uburyo bwo guhumeka kw’abana bavutse batagejeje igihe
content: Ikigo cy’ikoranabuhanga cyo muri Israel (Technion), kuri uyu wa Kane cyatangaje ko iri koranabuhanga rigamije gukemura ikibazo cy’ubuhumekero bw’abana bavutse igihe kitaragera kuko usanga ibice bitandukanye by’umubiri wabo biba bitarakura neza. Abana bavutse igihe kitaragera, usanga barangwa no kuba bafite ibibazo by’ubuhumekero bikaba ngombwa ko bahabwa ubufasha mu guhumeka hakoreshejwe icyuma gikoreshwa mu buvuzi mu gutanga umwuka. Gusa ubu buryo bugira ingaruka zirimo kwangirika kw’ibihaha. Muri ubu buryo kandi buri mwana akenera gupimirwa impuzandengo y’ingano y’umwuka, uburemere bwawo, umuvuduko n’ibindi. Abashakashatsi ba Technion, bakoze uburyo bwongera gutanga umwuka bigendanye n’ikigero cy’uko umwana ahumeka. Ubu buryo bushobora kurinda iyangirika ry’urwungano rw’ubuhumekero bw’abana kandi bukamufasha guhumeka neza. Abashakashatsi kandi banavumbuye ikindi kintu gishobora kuba ku mwana kitari kizwi, aho umwuka usohokera mu gakoresho kaba kashyizwe mu munwa w’umwana (tube) ushobora kugira ingaruka ku mwana.

title: Twitter igiye gushyiraho uburyo bwo guhitamo abemerewe kuvuga ku byo umuntu yanditse
content: Ubusanzwe ibyo umuntu yanditse kuri uru rubuga biba bishobora kuvugwaho cyangwa gusubizwa ‘Reply’ n’umuntu wese ubisomye, yaba asanzwe amukurikira cyangwa atamukurikira ‘Following’. Umuyobozi ushinzwe kugenzura ibinyuzwa kuri Twitter, Suzanne Xie, yatangaje kuri uyu wa gatatu ko harimo kuvugururwa imiterere yayo ku buryo abayikoresha bazajya bahitamo uwemerewe kugira uruhare mu kiganiro cyangwa igitekerezo batanzeho. Iyo miterere mishya izaba igenera umuntu wandika ikintu kuri twitter amahitamo ane arimo kureka buri wese akakivugaho, guhitamo abasanzwe bamukurikira gusa kandi yahisemo gusangiza icyo yanditse, guhitamo abo yifuza kugisangiza gusa cyangwa guhitamo ko ntawemerewe kukivugaho. Uru rubuga rwaherukaga gushyiraho uburyo bwemerera abarukoresha guhisha bimwe mu bitekerezo byatanzwe ku nyandiko barushyizeho ruvuga ko ari mu rwego rwo guhindura uburyo imikorere y’ibiganiro birutangwaho no guha amahirwe abarukoresha amahirwe yo kugenzura ibitekerezo bitangwa ku nyandiko banyuzaho. Bamwe mu basanzwe bakoresha uru rubuga bagargaje ko iyi miterere mishya izaba ari igisubizo ku bantu bibasiraga abandi ku nyandiko babaga barunyujijeho, rimwe na rimwe batari mu bo bifuzaga kuzandikira. Iyi miterere Twitter irimo ishaka kuzana biteganyijwe ko izatangira gukoreshwa mu gihe cya vuba muri uyu mwaka nubwo itavuze neza ukwezi.

title: Umunara wa StarTimes wakubiswe n’inkuba bibuza bamwe muri Kigali kureba Televiziyo
content: Itangazo iki kigo kirimo koherereza rigira riti  “Ikigo StarTimes kiramenyesha Abafatabuguzi bacyo ko Inkuba yakubise umunara wayo, uri ku musozi wa Jali i Kigali. Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, amashusho ntabasha kugaragara. Turasaba abafatabuguzi bacu kwihangana mu gihe turimo gukemura ikibazo cyabayeho.” Umuyobozi ushinzwe itumanaho n’imenyekanishabikorwa muri Star Times, Vlady Terimbere, yabwiye IGIHE ko abakiliya bagizweho ingaruka n’iyo mpanuka ari abakoresha antenes nto mu mujyi wa Kigali gusa. Bisobanuye ko ahandi hose nta kibazo bakomeje kureba amashusho neza ariko no muri Kigali abakoresha Antenes  z’ibisahani bakomeje kuyareba nta kibazo. Ati “Twageze ku kazi harimo kugwa ya mvura nyinshi cyane, noneho hari inkuba yakubise umunara wa hariya kuri Jali, niyo mpamvu amashusho atabasha kugararagara ariko abatekinisiye bacu bose bagiyeyo barimo kubikoraho, turasaba abafatabuguzi kwihangana, ni igihe gito.” Terimbere yavuze ko  hari icyizere ko mu gihe gito biza kuba byakemutse abantu bagakomeza kuryoherwa n’ibyiza bya Star Times. Star Times ni ikigo kiyoboye mu ikoranabuhango ryo gusakaza amashusho ya Televiziyo muri Afurika, aho abagera kuri miliyoni 30 bakoresha ifatabuguzi ryayo. Ikorera  mu bihugu bisaga 30, ifite amasheni agera kuri 480 arimo ay’amakuru, filime, filime z’uruhererekane, imikino, imyidagaduro, gahunda zigenewe abana n’ibindi.

title: Havumbuwe batiri ishobora kubika umuriro wakoresha smartphone iminsi itanu
content: Ni batiri ikoze mu binyabutabire bya Lithium na Sulfur byitezwe ko mu gihe yaba itangiye gukoreshwa na benshi yafasha mu kugabanya ihumana ry’ikirere ndetse igakoresha ingufu neza. Itsinda ryo muri Kaminuza ya Monash iherereye mu Mujyi wa Melbourne ryakoze iyi batiri rivuga ko ariyo ya mbere ku Isi ikoresha ingufu neza ndetse ikaba yakora ku kigero gikubye kane izindi zisanzwe zikora. Umwe mu bagize iri tsinda, Matthew Hill, yavuze ko uretse kuba iyi batiri ikora neza izanafasha mu kugabanya iyangirika ry’ibidukikije. Yagize Ati “Ubu buryo ntibuzafasha gusa mu bijyanye no kurambya umuriro ahubwo n’igiciro bitwara umuntu abukora kiri hasi, imikorere yayo ishingiye ku mazi ishobora kugabanya bigaragara imyanda yangiza ibidukikije.” Aba bashakashatsi bavuze ko iyi batiri izafasha mu kurwanya imihindagurikire y’ibihe. Izi batiri zikoze muri Lithium na Sulfur zari zisanzwe zikoreshwa ku ndege n’imodoka zimwe na zimwe ubu akaba ari ubwa mbere zaba zigiye gukoreshwa kuri telefoni. CNN yanditse ko hari abagaragaza ko nubwo izi batiri zibika umuriro igihe kirekire hari abazinenga ko zitaramba. Mu gukora iyi batiri ifite ubushobozi budasanzwe mu kubika umuriro, abashakashatsi bavuguruye imiterere y’igice cy’iyari isanzwe kizwi nka ‘Cathode’ kugira ngo ibashe gukoresha umuriro muke kandi nta kigabanutse mu mbaraga itanga. Uyu mushinga wamaze guterwa inkunga na Leta ya Australia bitaganyijwe ko uzakorerwa irindi gerageza mu mpera z’uyu mwaka rigamije gusuzuma byisumbuyeho imikorere y’izi bateri.

title: Hakozwe ikoranabuhanga rishobora gutahura kanseri y’ibere kurusha abaganga
content: Ubushakashatsi bwakoze kuri iri koranabuhanga, bwamuritswe kuwa Gatatu w’iki cyumweru. Iyi porogramu yahawe ubumenyi bwo gutahura kanseri ikoresheje amashusho amagana iba yafashe mu bagore, yakoreshejwe mu Bwongereza na Amerika. Ubushakshatsi kuri iri koranabuhanga bugaragaza ko rishobora gutanga amakuru kurenza uburyo busanzwe. Ugereranyije n’abahanga basanzwe bapima kanseri, iyi porogaramu yagabanyije amakuru atariyo ku kigero cya 5.7% ku banyamerika na 1.2% ku Bongereza. CNN ivuga ko iyi porogramu yizewe cyane mu gutanga amakuru y’ukuri, gusa ikaba ifite inenge yo gukorana no guhana amakuru n’abahanga muri iyi ndwara, urugero nk’amakuru yerekeye umurwayi. Prof. Ara Darzi, uyobora ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi cyitwa UK Imperial Centre cyo mu Bwongereza, avuga ko atari yiteze kubona ubu buhanga bw’iri koranabuhanga. Ati “Ubu ni bumwe mu buryo bwavumbuye, bushobora kuzarogoya uko dusanzwe dukora ibipimo mu buryo bwo gutanga amakuru y’ukuri kandi atanga umusaruro.” Ikigo American Cancer Society kivuga ko uburyo busanzwe bukoreshwa mu gupima kanseri, bukunze kwibeshya ku gutahura kanseri, ibi bikaba ku muntu umwe kuri batanu. Kimwe cya kabiri cy’abagore kandi ngo bahabwa amakuru atari yo kuri iyi ndwara bituma bahabwa ubuvuzi butari bwo. Dominic King, ukora muri Google Health avuga ko ibyavuye muri ubu bushakashatsi bishimishije, bikaba kandi bigaragaza uko iri koranabuhanga rishobora gufasha mu gutahura iyi kanseri itaragera mu rwego rwo hejuru. Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku buzima, OMS, rivuga ko mu 2018 abagore 627,000 ari bo bishwe na kanseri y’ibere. Muri rusange OMS ivuga ko mu 2018 kanseri zishe abarenga miliyoni 9.6 muri miliyoni 18.1 by’abari bazirwaye. Mu Rwanda habarurwa abanyarwanda ibihumbi 10 barwaye kanseri zitandukaye muri miliyoni zisaga 12 z’abaturage bose, aho iy’ibere iza ku mwanya wa kabiri nyuma y’ifata inkondo y’umura. Ikigo cy’ubuzima (RBC) kigaragaza ko mu 2017 abarwayi barenga 500 bivurije kanseri y’ibere hirya no hino ku bitaro.

title: Twitter yatangiye kugerageza ‘Fleets’, uburyo bwo gusangiza inkuru zisiba nyuma y’amasaha 24
content: Iri gerageza ryatangiriye muri Brésil kuri uyu wa gatatu, rikora mu buryo busa neza nka “Stories” ku zindi mbuga nkoranyambaga nka Snapchat cyangwa “Status” kuri WhatsApp. Abinyujije ku rukuta rwe rwa Twitter, Umuyobozi ushinzwe ibicuruzwa muri Twitter, Kayvon Beykpour, yavuze ko bizera ko izo mpinduka zizafasha abantu gutambutsa ibitekerezo byabo mu gihe gito, bitabasabye kwandika kuri twitter mu buryo busanzwe bumenyerewe. Ati "Izi ni impinduka zikomeye, twishimiye igitekerezo cyo gukora iri gerageza, tukareba uburyo abakiliya bacu  babikoresha natwe tugakuramo isomo." Iri gerageza rya ‘Fleets’ ryatangiriye muri Brésil gusa, risa cyane n’inkuru cyangwa amashusho mato mato ubusanzwe aba agizwe n’inyandiko, ifoto cyangwa video bigaragara mu masaha 24 gusa. Ibi bisanzwe byarakozwe na Snapchat mu 2013, hanyuma bishyirwa ku mbuga zitandukanye nka Facebook, Instagram ndetse vuba aha byashyizwe kuri LinkedIn. Ubu buryo bushya buzajya bugaragara gusa mu gihe umuntu akanze ahabugenewe (avatar), abandi bantu babe bagira icyo babuvugaho banyuze ku butumwa bwihariye bujya kuri nyirabwo gusa.

title: Uruganda rwa BMW rwavuguruye ikirango cyarwo
content: Impinduka zakozwe ku kirango cyari gisanzwe ni ugusimbuza uruziga ruri mu ibara ry’umukara rwagaragara mu kirango cyari gisanzwe, hagashyirwamo ibara ribonerana. Ibindi bisanzwe mu kirango cyari gisanzwe byarushijeho kugaragazwa neza mu kirango gishya, ariko amabara y’ubururu n’umweru aba ari imbere mu ruziga, amenyerewe n’abazi ikirango cy’uru ruganda ntiyahinduwe. Visi-Perezida w’ishami rishinzwe abakiliya n’iyamamazabirango muri BMW, Jans Thiemer, abinyujije ku rubuga rwa internet rw’iyi sosiyete, yavuze ko ikirango gishya kizakoreshwa mu bikorwa by’itumanaho rya BMW, harimo imbuga nkoranyambaga ndetse n’urubuga rwa internet, hagamijwe kurushaho kukimenyekanisha no kugaragaza umucyo wacyo. Yongeyeho ko isura nshya, igaragaza igisobanuro n’akamaro ka BMW mu gukora ingendo n’umunezero wo gutwara ibinyabiziga mu bihe biri imbere. Umuvugizi w’uru ruganda yavuze ko nta gahunda ijyanye no gushyira iki kirango gishya ku modoka bari gukora, nubwo BMW yagishyize ku modoka ikoresha amashanyarazi igenewe uruganda rwa Tesla yatangiye gukoreshwa kuva kuri uyu wa kabiri. Uru ruganda rwavuze ko ibara ribonerana ryashyizwe mu kirango gishya, riha ibara ryiza ry’inyuma imodoka ndetse rigatuma imenyekana cyane. Ikirango cyari gisanzwe cyatangiye gukoreshwa mu 1997. Uru ruganda rumaze guhinduranya ibirango byarwo inshuro esheshatu mu myaka 103 rumaze rushinzwe kandi byose bijya gusa. Abakunzi b’uru ruganda bamaze igihe kinini bavuga ko imbere mu kirango cyari gisanzwe, hagaragaza ishusho y’icyuma gikoreshwa mu kurema ingufu zitwara ubwato cyangwa indege (propeller), ariko BMW yo yasobanuye ko amabara y’umweru n’ubururu mu by’ukuri agaragaza umujyi wa Bavaria ufatwa nk’igicumbi cy’uru ruganda. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami rishinzwe guhanga udushya mu kigo gikora ibishushanyo cya Siegel+Gale, Doug Sellers, yatangarije CNN ko ikirango gishya ari iterambere kandi ko gituma uruganda rwumva rwuguruye amarembo rukanorohereza abakiliya bakiri bato bafite ubumenyi bw’ikoranabuhanga. BMW ni rwo ruganda rwa kabiri rukora imodoka mu Budage, rumaze guhindura ibirango byarwo mu mezi atandatu ashize. Volkswagen nayo iherutse kugaragaza ikirango gishya mu imurikagurisha ry’imodoka ryabereye mu Mujyi wa Frankfurt, ruvuga ko ari cyo gihe cyo kwereka Isi imiterere mishya y’ikirango cyarwo.

title: Apple igiye gutanga impozamarira za miliyoni $500 kubera kugabanya ubushobozi bwa iPhone
content: Ni amafaranga uru ruganda rwasabye ko rwazishyura kugira ngo ruhagarike iki kirego, ibintu bizemezwa bwa nyuma n’umucamanza Edward Davila kuwa 3 Mata Biteganyijwe ko Apple izagenda yishyura $25 kuri buri telefone yagezweho n’uku gucibwa intege, gusa itangazo ry’urukiko rw’i San Jose muri leta ya California rikavuga ko aya mafaranga ashobora kwiyongera cyangwa akagabanuka bitewe n’umubare w’abazasaba izi mpozamarira. Aya mafaranga azakoreshwa mu kwishyura abakiliya bagezweho n’ingaruka andi akoreshwe mu kwishyura abanyamategeko, ibintu byose hamwe bizatwara atari munsi ya miliyoni $300 ariko atazanarenga miliyoni $500. CNN ivuga ko Abazahabwa impozamarira ari abantu batuye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika batunze iphone 6, 6 Plus, 6S, 6S Plus, 7 cyangwa 7 Plus zaguzwe mbere ya taliki 21 Ukuboza mu 2017 kandi bazagaragaza ko ziri mu zagabanyirijwe ubushobozi. Ibirego bishinja Apple kugabanya ubushobozi bwa iphone zimaze igihe byatangiye mu 2017, ubwo yemeraga ko yakoresheje uburyo bwo kujyanisha n’igihe (update) porogaramu, mu kugabanya ubushobozi bwa iPhone zimaze igihe. Gusa ibi uru ruganda rukavuga ko rwabikoraga mu gukemura ikibazo cya bateri za lithium-ion zatumaga izi telefone zimaze igihe zizimya bitandukanye n’ibyo abakiliya baketse ko ari umugambi wo kubahatira kugura iphone nshya ku isoko. Abakiliya babwiye urukiko  ko Apple yatumye bagura telefone shya kuko itabamenyesheje ko ikibazo nyirizina ari batiri, nkuko CNN yabitangaje.

title: Ibitanda mu ndege: Air New Zealand igiye gutangiza ingendo z’indege zizajya zifasha abashaka kuryama
content: Iyo sosiyete yavuze ko nubwo ari agashya, bizatwara igihe kirenga umwaka ngo ibyo bitanda bibe byamaze kugezwa mu ndege zayo. Kuri uyu wa Gatatu, Air New Zealand yatangaje ko yamaze kwandika ishinganisha ibitanda byayo mbere yo gutangira kubikoresha mu ndege. Ubu buryo bwiswe Economy Skynest, buzaba bufite ibitanda bitandatu muri buri ndege bya santimetero 200 z’uburebure na santimetero 58 z’ubugari. Kuri buri gitanda hazajya haba hariho umusego, amashuka, utwuma dutuma utumva urusaku, ndetse n’umwenda ukingira uburiri (rideaux). Air New Zealand yatangaje ko igitekereza niba izongeraho n’ibindi bikoresho nk’aho gucomeka telefone, n’itara ritanga urumuri ruhagije ku buryo umuntu yabasha gusoma. Ushinzwe ibikorwa byo kwamamaza muri Air New Zealand, Mike Tod yavuze ko ubwo buryo bw’ibitanda buzaba bugenewe cyane cyane abakiliya bajya mu byerekezo birebire aho bibasaba amasaha menshi mu ndege, nk’urugendo rwa Auckland –New York izatangiza umwaka utaha ruzajya rufata amasaha 17 n’iminota 40. Ikiguzi cya Skynet ntikiramenyekana ariko ubuyobozi bwa Air New Zealand bwatangaje ko kizajya kiba kiri ukwacyo, ntaho gihuriye n’itike y’indege isanzwe nk’uko The Guardian yabitangaje. Hari n’ubundi buryo buzajya bukoreshwa, aho uri mu ndege ashaka kuryama ashobora kubisaba akishyura, akagenda akaryama amasaha cyangwa iminota mike.  Air New Zealand yatangaje ko abakozi bo mu ndege bazajya baba bari hafi ku buryo mu gihe umuntu umwe abyutse, bahita bategura uburiri ku buryo undi ushaka kuryama abukoresha. Haracyategerejwe uburenganzira kugira ibyo bitanda bitangire gushyirwa mu ndege za Air New Zealand. Mu gihe ubu buryo buzaba bwemejwe, iyo sosiyete ivuga ko izahita itangira kubugurisha no ku zindi sosiyete z’indege. Air New Zealand siyo ya mbere itangiye kuzana udushya tugamihe gushimisha abakiliya bayo mu ngendo kuko nk’umwaka ushize, sosiyete Collins Aerospace ikora iby’indege yatangije uburyo bw’uko mu gihe indege ihagurutse, hafi y’amadirishya n’inzugi zayo hazajya hihindura nk’akabari , abakiliya bakagenda baganira bafata n’icyo kunywa.

title: Ikinyarwanda mu ndimi eshanu nshya zatangiye gukoreshwa muri Google Translate
content: Ubu buryo bushya buzorohereza Abanyarwanda cyangwa abanyamahanga bakeneye kubona ibintu mu Kinyarwanda, cyangwa kuvana amagambo mu Kinyarwanda bayashyira mu rurimi runaka ruboneka muri Google Translate. Nyuma yo kongeraho izi ndimi nshya, izishobora gukoreshwa muri serivisi ya Google Translate zageze ku ndimi 108. Ni inshuro ya mbere mu myaka ine ishize indimi zongerewe muri iyi serivisi yifashisha ubwenge bw’ubukorano (articial intelligence) mu gusemura, nk’uko Google yabitangaje. Indimi ziyongereyemo ni Ikinyarwanda, Odia (ruvugwa mu Buhinde), Tatar (ruvugwa mu bice bimwe by’u Burusiya, Ukraine na Uzbekistan), Turkmen (muri Turkmenistan) na Uyghur (ruvugwa muri Aziya yo hagati no mu Bushinwa). Google yatangaje ko iyi ari inyongera ikomeye ku ikoranabuhanga ryayo, kuko nibura igiteranyo cy’abantu bakoresha izo ndimi uko ari eshanu bagera kuri miliyoni 75 hirya no hino ku Isi. Google Translate ni uburyo bwifashishwa n’abantu benshi, gusa ntabwo ibisubizo itanga mu isemura biba byizewe 100%. Google ivuga ko impamvu byafashe igihe ngo yongere izi ndimi, ari uko hari byinshi byari bikeneye kunozwa mu ikoranabuhanga ryayo, kuko “indimi zidafite ibintu byazanditswemo byinshi kuri internet, usanga iteka kuzisemura bigorana.” Byongeye, Google yatangaje ko mu minsi mike hazaba haboneka inyuguti umuntu akoresha yandika muri ’keyboard’ ye, ziri mu ndimi z’Ikinyarwanda, Tatar na Uyghur.

title: Liquid Telecom yagabanyije ibiciro bya internet inakuraho ingano ntarengwa y’iyo ukoresha
content: Kuri uyu wa Gatatu nibwo iki kigo cyatangije uburyo cyise ‘Liquid Home’, buzafasha abantu kubyaza umusaruro internet imaze iminsi yegerezwa ingo z’abaturage hiryo no hino mu gihugu, kandi ku giciro gito. Mu mpinduka nshya, ku muntu ukoresha internet itanga megabits eshanu ku isegonda ari nayo iri hasi, guhera kuri ubu asabwa kwishyura 27 999 Frw, mu gihe ubusanzwe yishyuraga 49 999 Frw. Ku bindi byiciro ho hazamuwe umuvuduko wayo, ibiciro biguma ari bya bindi. Hejuru y’ibyo, mbere yo guhabwa internet umuntu yasabwaga kwishyura 50 000 Frw yo kuyimugezaho mu nzu iwe, ubu ayo mafaranga yavanweho. Ni ukuvuga ko uwasabwaga hafi hafi 100 000 Frw ngo agezweho internet, ubu ni 27 999 Frw. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Liquid Telecom muri Afurika yo hagati n’Iburasirazuba, Sam Nkusi, avuga ko bamaze igihe begereza internet ingo n’izindi nyubako binyuze mu miyoboro ya fibres optiques yagiye yagiye inyuzwa mu butaka hirya no hino. Uretse nk’imidugudu imaze igihe ituwe, iyubakwa ubu, uko hashyirwamo ibikorwa remezo nk’imiyoboro y’amazi n’amashanyarazi, ni nako hashyirwamo iya internet. Nkusi yakomeje ati “Twageze ku ngo, aho abantu batuye dushyiraho insinga za fibres optique. Nureba ku muhanda iwawe uzabona urutsinga rutukura rutunguka hejuru. Twabitangaga mbere twishyuza n’abantu, ubu nta mafaranga kugira ngo tugushyireho ube umukiliya wacu, tugusaba ubwishyu bwa internet ukeneye gusa.” Avuga ko bitewe n’uko mu Rwanda igice kinini ari urubyiruko, rukeneye internet ihendutse bijyanye n’amikoro ya buri wese, kandi idacika. Umuyobozi wa Liquid Telecom mu Rwanda, Alexis Kabeja, avuga ko uretse kugabanya ibiciro ku cyiciro cyo hasi, ku bindi ho hazamuwe umuvuduko wa internet. Ati "Abakiliya basanzwe twabongereye umuvuduko wa internet, ni ukuvuga ngo uwakoreshaga iya Mbps 15 ku 69 999 Frw, twazamuye umuvuduko tuwugeza kuri Mbps 25, naho uwari ku ya Mbps 30 twamugejeje kuri Mbps 80. Abakiliya bari basanzwe twabazamuriye umuvuduko kugira ngo babashe gukora byinshi bishoboka.” "Ni ukuvuga ngo twabahaye kuyikoresha nta ngano ntarengwa itanzwe, kubera ko kuba ufite Mbps 80 mu rugo ushobora gukora byinshi, kuri telefoni, televiziyo zikoresha internet, camera z’umutekano, gukurikirana ibibera mu rugo, kwerekana ibintu kuri internet, ariko icy’ingenzi ni internet idafite umupaka, ikaza yihuta kandi ku giciro cyoroheye abantu benshi." Kugeza ubu imiyoboro ya fibres optiques imaze kugezwa mu midugudu myinshi cyane cyane mu mujyi wa Kigali nka Gacuriro, Gisozi, Kacyiru, Kagugu, Kibagabaga, Kimihurura, Kinyinya, Kiyovu, Nyarutarama, Rebero, Rugando, Remera, Vision 2020 na Vision City, ndetse n’ahandi irimo kubakwa. Liquid Telecom imaze kubaka ibikorwa hirya no hino muri Afurika, aho yamaze gukora imiyoboro ikwirakwiza internet ihuza Cape Town muri Afurika y’Epfo na Cairo mu Misiri, no kuva kuri Port Sudan ukagera muri Cameroon. Iteganya gukwirakwiza internet n’ahantu hahurira abantu benshi nko muri Kigali Arena, mu busitani imbere y’Umujyi wa Kigali n’ahandi, kandi bigakorwa ku buntu. Liquid Telecom ivuga ko internet ihabwa abantu mu ngo inajyana no kuyishyirirwa mu nyubako ku buntu, igikoresho gisakaza internet nziramugozi na telefoni ikoresha umugozi ishobora guhamagaragana n’izindi zatanzwe n’iki kigo, ku buntu. Abakeneye izi serivisi basabwa kureba niba aho batuye hagera fibres optiques, ubundi bagahitamo bitewe na internet bakeneye, kandi gusaba kuyihabwa babikorera kuri internet, ndetse no kwishyura bishobora gukorwa hifashishijwe ikarita cyangwa mobile money. Mu byiciro bya internet itangwa na Liquid Telecom habanza icyiciro gihendutse kurusha ibindi (Basic essential), aho internet itanga Megabits eshanu ku isegonda igurwa 27 999 Frw ku kwezi, igenewe umuryango (Family Entertainment) itanga Megabits 25 ku isegonda igurwa 69 999 Frw ku kwezi, hakaza iyisumbuye kurushaho (Modern Family) itanga Megabits 80 ku isegonda igurwa 113 999 Frw ku kwezi, n’ihanitse (Power Pack) itanga Megabits 150 ku isegonda igurwa 199 999 Frw.
