title: Google irashinjwa ubutasi ku banyeshuri b’Abanyamerika
content: Intumwa Nkuru ya Leta ya New Mexico yavuze ko Google yagiye ikusanya amakuru agaragaza imbuga za internet abanyeshuri  bagiye basura, imibare y’ibanga bakoresha, amashusho bagiye bareba, abantu bahanahana amakuru n’ibindi. Ibyo byagiye bikorwa ku banyeshuri bakoresha mudasobwa za Chromebook na porogaramu za Google. Google yo ihakana ayo makuru, ikavuga ko ari ikinyoma cyambaye ubusa. Abatanze ikirego bavuze ko mudasobwa za Google Chromebooks na porogaramu za Google zizwi nga G Suite zirimo Gmail, kalendari n’ibindi, ngo bikoreshwa n’abasaga 60 % by’abanyeshuri bo muri New Mexico. Intumwa nkuru ya Leta, Hector Balderas yavuze ko Google yinjiye mu mabanga y’abanyeshuri nta burenganzira yasabye ababarera cyane cyane ku bana bari munsi y’imyaka 13,  amakuru yabo agakusanywa ku nyungu z’ubucuruzi. Ikirego kandi kivuga ko abanyeshuri n’abarimu basaga miliyoni 80 muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika bakoresha porogaramu za Google mu mashuri, ko ingaruka z’ibyakozwe na Google zishobora kuba nyinshi. Umuvugizi wa Google, Jose Castaneda yavuze ko amashuri ariyo afite uburenganzira bwo kumenya ibyo abana bareba kuri internet igihe bari ku ishuri kandi ko aho bikenewe basaba uburenganzira bw’ababyeyi. Yavuze ko amakuru y’abanyeshuri bo mu mashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye batajya bayakoresha mu bikorwa by’ubucuruzi. Intumwa nkuru ya Leta ya New Mexico yabwiye itangazamakuru ko yasabye amashuri yose muri Leta yabo, kureba niba nta kibazo gukomeza gukoresha  serivisi za Google bishobora guteza. Umwaka ushize, Komisiyo ishinzwe ubucuruzi muri Amerika yaciye Googke amande ya miliyoni 170 z’amadolari kubwo gukoresha amakuru y’abana bato mu bikorwa by’ubucuruzi kuri YouTube.

title: Urugendo rwa Ashish Thakkar winjiye mu bucuruzi ku myaka 15, ubu ageze ku ruganda rwa Mara Phones
content: Idi Amin yabyutse atanga iminsi 90 bose bakaba bamuviriye mu gihugu. Hafi ibihumbi 50 by’abaturage bafite inkomoko muri Aziya barirukanwe. Abenshi bafashe inzira igana mu Bwongereza. Mu bahungiyeyo icyo gihe harimo Jagdish na Sarla ababyeyi b’umunyemari Ashish Thakkar washinze Mara Phones, uruganda rwa mbere rukora telefone muri Afurika, arushinga mu Rwanda. Igisekuru cya Thakkar cyavuye mu Burengerazuba bw’u Buhinde muri Leta ya Gujarat mu myaka ya 1890, kiza gutura muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Nyuma yo kwirukanwa muri Uganda, ababyeyi ba Thakkar bagiye mu Bwongereza ari naho uwo munyemari yavukiye  mu mujyi wa Leicester mu 1981. Mu kiganiro yagiranye n’ikinyamakuru Le Point cyo mu Bufaransa, Ashish Thakkar yagize ati “Ndi igisekuru cya kane mu muryango wanjye guhera ugeze muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Twubatse sosiyete ya Mara Group duhereye ku busa none ubu ni sosiyete y’icyitegererezo muri Afurika.” Umuryango wa Thakkar waje kuva  mu Bwongereza ugaruka muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, kuri iyi nshuro baza mu Rwanda. Muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, byinshi mu byo uwo muryango wari umaze kugeraho byarasenywe basubira hasi cyane. Yavuye mu ishuri atangira ubushabitsi Ku myaka 15, nibwo Thakkar yatangiye ubucuruzi nyuma yo kugira amahirwe akabona inguzanyo y’amadolari 5000. Yagize ati “Ubwo ababyeyi banjye banyuraga mu byabaye muri Uganda, nari ntaravuka. Icyakora nyuma y’ibyo babayemo mu Rwanda nkumva n’ibyo babayemo mbere, byampaye imbaraga zo kugira icyo nkora.” Yahise ahagarika ishuri, atangira ubucuruzi hagati ya Dubai na Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Ubucuruzi bwe nta bundi, kwari ukuzana ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga byakoreshejwe akabicuruza mu mujyi wa Kampala muri Uganda mu iduka rito ababyeyi be bari barashinze, dore ko baje gusubira muri Uganda bakahaba nk’impunzi. Mu byo yacuruzaga habaga harimo mudasobwa n’ibikoresho byose bijyana nazo, telefone n’ibindi. Ni ubucuruzi bwamuhiriye dore ko icyo gihe benshi batari bakamenye neza iby’ubucuruzi bw’ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga. Mu mwaka wa 2013, Thakkar yahuye n’umuherwe w’umunyamerika ufite inkomoko mu Bwongereza, Bob Diamond, akaba yarahoze ari mukuru wa banki ya Barclays. Bamaze kuganira bafatanyije gushinga Atlas Mara, sosiyete y’ishoramari mu mabanki ku mugabane wa Afurika. Mu gihe gito, abo banyemari babashije kubona miliyoni 325 z’amadolari, bahita bandikisha sosiyete yabo ku isoko ry’imari n’imigabane ry’i Londres. Ibintu byaje kugenda nabi, basanga ubyuryo binjiye mu kibuga cyo muri Afurika butaratekerejweho neza, maze batangira guhomba. Thakkar avuga ko kubera gufungura amashami mu bihugu badasobanukiwe neza imikorere, byabahombeje cyane kugeza ubwo ibikorwa bya sosiyete Atlas Mara biguye ku kigero cya 84 %. Ubu Atlas Mara iri mu biganiro byo kuguranisha imigabane yayo muri Equity Group yo muri Kenya. Icyo gihombo cyagarutsweho mu gitabo cya Ashish Thakkar yise ‘The Lion Awakes : Adventures in Africa’s Economic Miracle’. Muri icyo gitabo agira ati “Uko twafataga Afurika turi hanze yayo bitandukanye n’ibihabera. Kuhakorera ubucuruzi ni ibintu bigoye rwose.” Yakomeje agira ati “Sosiyete zo hanze y’umugabane zakomeje guhabwa ikaze muri Afurika, twe nka sosiyete nyafurika bikaturakaza. Ntabwo twitaga ku kuba tugiye gushinga ubucuruzi busa nk’ubw’uwo uvuye hanze y’umugabane nyamara ari we ufite amahirwe menshi.” “Nk’umugabane, ibikorwa byacu n’ubwinshi bihagaze neza. Dufite miliyari y’abaturage ariko turacyagabanyijemo ibihugu 54. Ni abantu mugomba gukorana ariko b’imico n’imyumvire bitandukanye.” Uyu mugabo avuga ko ibintu byarushijeho kuba bibi mu 2013 ubwo yatandukanaga n’uwahoze ari umugore we Meera Manek bikagera mu rukiko baburana imitungo. Uko yatangije uruganda rwa telefone zigezweho mu Rwanda Mu myaka mike, Ashish Thakkar yafashe umwanzuro wo gutangiza uruganda rwa mbere rukora telefone zigezweho ku mugabane wa Afurika. Abajijwe uko byaje, yagize ati “Icya mbere ni ukureba uko guhererekanya amafaranga binyuze kuri telefone bihagaze muri Afurika , no gutekereza amahirwe ari kuri uwo mugabane kubera ikoreshwa ry’ikoranabuhanga. Kuri ubu abanyafurika bagomba guhitamo hagati ya telefone ihendutse cyangwa telefone yujuje ubuziranenge. Hashingiwe ku kuboneka kwa internet ya telefone na porogaramu z’ingirakamaro, telefone igezweho ishobora gufasha mu guhanga imirimo kandi igateza imbere guhanga udushya.” Yongeyeho ati “Muri iryo hanga ry’umurimo no gukoresha ibyahanzwe, niko umugabane wa Afurika uba uri gutera imbere.” Uruganda rwa Mara Phones ruherereye mu cyanya cyahariwe inganda i Masoro mu karere ka Gasabo. Byafashe imyaka itanu kugira ngo Ashish Thakkar we na Bob Diamond babashe gutangiza imirimo yo kubaka urwo ruganda mu Rwanda, bafashijwe na Leta y’u Rwanda. Ni umushinga wa miliyoni 22 z’amayero. Urwo ruganda rufite ubushobozi bwo gukora telefone igihumbi buri munsi, nkuko byatangajwe na Eddy Sebera umuyobozi Mukuru w’urwo ruganda. Kugeza ubu urwo ruganda rusohora ubwoko bubiri bwa telefone, aribwo Mara X na Mara Z, bukoresha Android. Ni telefone zifite batiri zirambana umuriro n’ububiko bunini. Buri telefone iba ikozwe n’udukoresho tw’ikoranabuhanga dusaga igihumbi twose dukorerwa muri urwo ruganda. Ashish Thakkar avuga ko Mara Phones ari rwo ruganda rwa mbere muri Afurika rukora telefone ibiyigize byose byakorewe kuri uwo mugabane, mu gihe izindi nganda zisanzwe zo ziteranya ibyakorewe ahandi. Thakkar ati “U Burayi ntibukora telefone zigezweho, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ntizikora telefone ndetse no mu Burasirazuba bwo hagati ntazo bakora. Dufate nka Apple ikorerwa mu Bushinwa, Samsung ni iyo muri Korea, Huawei ni iyo mu Bushinwa.” Yongeyeho ati “Mara Phones ni inyafurika , ibyo bigaha amahirwe menshi abanyaburayi cyangwa abanyamerika bagira impungenge ku bijyanye n’ubutasi n’umutekano wabo. Nibura telefone zacu zifite uwo mwihariko.” Thakkar avuga ko bishimishije uburyo Guverinoma zo muri Afurika zagiye zihindura imyumvire muri iyi myaka ishize, zigaha rugari ivuka ry’ishoramari by’umwihariko muri Afurika yo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara, aho Banki y’Isi igaragaza ko buri mwaka havuga sosiyete ziciriritse ibihumbi 500. Kugeza ubu muri Afurika hari izindi sosiyete ziteranya telefone zigezweho nka Elikia muri Congo, Kunfabo ya Fadima Diawara muri Guinée na Nile X zikorwa na sosiyete yo mu Misiri ya Sico. Icyakora ibigize izo telefone zose bikorerwa mu Bushinwa ku nkunga y’icyo gihugu. Abajijwe uko bazahangana n’izo telefone nshya zihendutse muri Afurika, Thakkar yagize ati “Biroroshye kubizana muri Afurika ariko dutekereje gutyo nta na kimwe twazikorera ubwacu. Afurika igomba gutekereza guhanga ibyayo kuko mu gihe uri kwigana iby’abandi, muba mukiri inyuma cyane.” Kuba barahisemo u Rwanda, Ashish Thakkar yavuze ko ari igihugu gikataje mu guteza imbere ibyakorewe muri Afurika kandi gifite amarembo akinguye ku  bashoramari. Ati “U Rwanda ubu rurajwe ishinga no guteza imbere ibyakorewe mu Rwanda. Ni igihugu giha ikaze ubucuruzi, gifunguriye amarembo umugabane wose hamwe na Guverinoma isobanukiwe ibiba hirya no hino ku isi n’ubuyobozi bwiza. Ni igihugu gishaka kuba igicumbi cy’ikoranabuhanga, birigaragaza hose.” Uyu munyemari yagaragaje ko telefone za Mara Phones zoherezwa mu bihugu 53. Muri byo, inyinshi zigurishwa mu Budage, u Butaliyani, muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika no mu Bufaransa. Thakkar avuga ko bashaka  ko telefone za Mara Phones zigaragara mu maduka menshi acuruza telefone. Mara Group yafunguye urundi ruganda rumeze nk’urw’i Kigali i Durban muri Afurika y’Epfo. Inzozi za Ashish Thakkar ni ugukomeza guteza imbere ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga, akagira uruhare muri Afurika n’isi muri rusange.

title: Uburyo waryoherwa n’ubuzima ukoresha umurongo wa Airtel
content: Ni uburyo bwifashishwa mu buzima bwa buri munsi nko mu bucuruzi, mu kuganira n’inshuti, mu miyoborere, mu bihinzi, mu burezi mu buvuzi, mu serivisi z’ishoramari, guhererekanya amafaranga n’ibindi, akenshi hifashishijwe umuyoboro w’ibigo by’itumanaho nka Airtel. Nyuma yo gusobanurikirwa akamaro k’ikoranabuhanga biba uburyohe kurushaho iyo wahisemo kandi ugakoresha umuyoboro ugufasha kugera ku ndunduro y’ibyifuzo cyangwa serivisi ushaka kubona uryifashishije, utabunza imitima wibaza icyo wakora ngo byihute, dore ko kimwe mu mpamvu rikunze kwigarurira imitima ya benshi ari uburyo ryihutisha ibintu. Nta gushidikanya ko mu gihe wahisemo gukoresha umuyoboro wa Sosiyete y’Itumanaho wa Airtel uzarushaho kuryoherwa n’ubuzima mu ruhurirane rw’ibyiza bitangirwa ubuhamya n’abamaze kubiganuraho, ibyinshi bikubiye muri serivisi zifashisha ikoranabuhanga nko guhamagara, internet, guhererekanya amafaranga n’ibindi. Bimwe mu byagufasha kuryoherwa n’ubuzima ukoresha umuyoboro wa Airtel Internet ya Airtel Ntushobora kuryoherwa n’ubuzima mu gihe ugikoresha internet igenda nk’akanyamasyo, ukenera nko kohereza cyangwa kwakira ubutumwa wifashishije imbuga nkoranyambaga, kumanura(Download) cyangwa kuzamura(Upload) ikintu kuri internet ugategereza amasaha n’amasaha. Ubuhamya bw’abamenye amahitamo nyayo bushimangira ko Airtel Rwanda ariyo sosiyete ifite internet yihuta cyane  kandi igaragara aho ariho hose mu Rwanda ku kigero cya 98%. Abakiliya benshi bahitamo kugura ipaki za internet bitewe n’uko buguha amahirwe yo kuryoherwa bwikubye inshuro eshatu kuri internet itangwa n’ibindi bigo by’itumanaho. Iyi sosiyete by’u mwihariko igira Internet igenera abakiliya izwi nka Isanzure, igurwa ukanze *255*5#  ugahitamo kabiri(2) maze ukabasha kuryoherwa na internet ihendutse aho ku mafaranga 50Frw aho ubona megabit  (Mgb) 60, ku 100Frw akabona Mgb 250 zimara amasaha 24, kuri 500Frw akabona Gigabit (GB) imwe imara icyumweru n’izindi. Ni umwihariko ku bari munsi y’imyaka 25 kuko bash0bora kugura ipaki ya internet yiswe ‘Jama Packs’ igurwa akanze *154# agahitamo internet kuri 2. Ni uburyo uretse gutanga internet yihuta iba ari na nyinshi kuko nk’iy’amafaranga 100 Frw ari Mgb 200 n’inyongera  ya 1GB n’iminota 60 byo gukoresha mu masaha y’ijoro.  Hari n’ipaki ya internet igenewe abakiliya bose babona bakanze *255*2#, bagahitamo iyo bashobora gukoresha mu gihe cy’umunsi umwe, icyumweru cyangwa ku kwezi. Nk’iy’amafaranga 100 Frw ikoreshwa amasaha 24 iba ari Mgb 50, iy’amafaranga 1000 Frw imara icyumweru ni 1GB naho GB 30 zimara Ukwezi zikagurwa ibihumbi 10Frw. Guhamagara byarorohejwe  ‘Tera Stori’ ni ipaki ikoreshwa mu guhamagara imirongo yose ku giciro gito mu rwego rwo koroherereza abakiriya bayo, umukiliya agura akanze *255*4#. Imuha amahitamo atatu arimo bumwe bumara amasaha 48, icyumweru n’ukwezi. Ku mafaranga 300FRW gusa ibaha iminota 200 yo guhamagara Airtel ku yindi n’indi ijana  yo guhamagara indi mirongo ikoreshwa mu Rwanda, ikamara amasaha 48. Iy’amafaranga 1000Frw itanga iminota 700 yo guhamagara Airtel ku yindi n’indi 40 yo guhamagara indi mirongo ikoreshwa mu Rwanda mu gihe cy’iminsi irindwi yose. Iy’amafaranga 3500 Frw itanga iminota 3000 yo guhamagara Airtel kuri Airtel n’indi 200 yo guhamagara indi mirongo ikoreshwa mu Rwanda, imarama iminsi 30. Si ibyo gusa kuko no mu gihe ipaki umukiliya yaguze ishize akomeza kuryoherwa no guhamagara ku giciro gito cyane aho Airtel ku yindi aba yishyura gusa 3 Frw ku munota mu gihe indi mirongo ikoreshwa mu Rwanda yishyura 10 Frw ku munota gusa. Uyu muyoboro ushora kwishimira ibyiza byo kuwukoresha ndetse ukabisangiza inshuti zawe aho Tera Stori iguha uburyo ushobora kuyihaho impano inshuti zawo y’iminota ukanze *255*4# ugahitamo 2. Guhererekanya amafaranga Airtel Money ni uburyo iyi sositeye yashyizeho bufasha abakiliya kuryoherwa no kohereza amafaranga nta kiguzi bakaswe. Icyo basabwa gusa ni ugukanda *500*1*1# maze bagakurikiza amabwiriza ari nako bakomeza kuryoherwa n’ubuzima. Ubu buryo buguha n’amahitamo yo kwishyura ifatabuguzi ry’amazi nta kindi kiguzi ukaswe, icyo usabwa ni ugukanda *500*4*2#. Hari no kwishyura umuriro w’amashanyarazi nta kiguzi ukaswe, gushyira amafaranga y’urugendo ku ikarita n’ibindi ukanze *500*4#. Iyo umukiliya aguze ipaki akoresheje Airtel Money bimuhesha kuryoherwa n’inyongera yo guhera kuri 30%. Ni uburyo umukiliya ashobora kunyura mu nzira isanzwe yo gukanda *255# agahitamo kugura yifashishije Airtel Money cyangwa akagenera impano y’ama unite cyangwa iya internet inshuti ye akanze *500*4*2# Umukiliya ashobora no kwishyura serivisi z’ikigo cy’imisoro n’amahoro cyangwa ifatabuguzi rya Televiziyo yifashishije Airtel Money, unyuze kuri porogaramu ya eStep.App igaragara kuri play store. Ushobora kuryoherwa n’ubuzima nanone utumiza ibiribwa muri resitora zikunzwe, ukishyura ukoresheje Airtel Money kuri porogaramu ya Vuba Vuba iboneka kuri play store. Ntabwo ushobora guhangayika igihe wibagiye umubare w’ibanga wa konti yawe ya Airtel money kuko ushobora kongera gusaba undi ukanze *500*5*3*1*1#, ariko igihe ufiteho amafaranga arenze 5000 Frw bikagusaba kwegera ishami ryayo rikwegereye. Umuyoboro wa Airtel ni uburyo bworoshye bushobora kugufasha kohereza amafaranga mu bihugu birimo Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania, Zambia na Malawi(Airtel to Airtel) ukanze gusa *500*1*3#. Ushobora no kubitsa cyangwa ukabikuza amafaranga ufite kuri konti yo muri Banki runaka ukanze *500*6*1# mu gihe nimero yawe wayihuje na konti. Airtel ikorera mu bihugu birimo Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Congo Brazaville, Nigeria, Gabon, Madagascar, Niger, Tchad, Malawi, Zambia, Ghana na Seychelles byo ku Mugabane wa Afurika.

title: Smartphones 1000 za mbere zashyikirijwe abatishoboye muri #Connect Rwanda
content: Iyi gahunda ya Connect Rwanda yatangijwe na MTN Rwanda, aho buri muntu yagendaga yitanga uko yifite, maze nawe agasaba mugenzi we cyangwa undi muntu ashaka, gutera inkunga ubu bukangurambaga. Kuri uyu wa Kane nibwo telefoni za mbere zashyikirijwe abadafite ubushobozi bwo kuzigura, mu muhango wabereye mu Karere ka Rutsiro. Minisitiri w’Ikoranabuhanga na Inovasiyo, Ingabire Paula, yasabye abazihawe kubibyaza umusaruro. Yagize ati “Izi telefoni mwahawe ni impano zatanzwe mu bufatanye bw’abanyarwanda muri rusange harimo ibigo bitandukanye ndetse n’abantu ku giti cyabo. Muzihawe kugira ngo muzikoreshe mu bintu byazabagirira umumaro.” Umwe mu bahawe izi telefoni, Munyagisenyi Augustin, usanzwe ari n’umujyanama w’ubuzima, yavuze ko telefoni yahawe izamufasha cyane. Ati “Nk’umujyanama w’ubuzima, najyaga ntanga raporo mu magambo gusa, ariko ubu ndajya nongeraho n’amafoto!” Sebitoki Jean Damascène wo mu Murenge wa Munanira yavuze ko izi smartphone zizabafasha guhanahana amakuru no kubungabunga umutekano. Ati “Itumanaho ryatugoraga kuba umuturage aha undi amakuru na mugenzi we bikaba ikibazo ariko ubu nzajya mpamagara abari kure no hanze y’igihugu. Ubu umutekano na wo bizadufasha gutanga amakuru vuba uri Nyabirasi abwire uri Manihira.’’ Ayinkamiye Divine yavuze ko telefoni izamufasha kubona serivisi zajyaga zimugora zirimo no gushaka amafaranga ya internet. Ati “Ndishimye cyane. Njye  mu buzima bwa buri munsi nahuraga n’ibibazo kuko nta telefoni nagiraga no gutanga mituweli nakoreshaga iy’abandi ariko ubu nzajya mbyikorera ntagiye gutira; nzajya nishakamo aya internet.’’ Ku wa 20 Ukuboza 2019 nibwo MTN Rwanda yatangije ubukangurambaga bwa Connect Rwanda Challenge, maze ibigo n’abantu ku giti cyabo batangira kwiyemeza umubare wa telefoni zigezweho bazatanga zigahabwa abadafite ubushobozi bwo kuzigurira hirya no hino mu gihugu. Umuyobozi wa MTN Rwanda, Mitwa Kaemba Ng’ambi, yasabye abahawe telefoni kuzifashisha bahindura ubuzima. Ati “Ndabasaba kuzubahiriza impanuro za Perezida Kagame yaduhaye ubwo yatangizaga iyi gahunda. Izi telefoni ntabwo ari iz’amafiyeri zigomba kubafasha kuzamura ubuzima kuko hari serivisi zabagoraga bitewe nuko nta koranabuhanga mwari mufite; nimuzibyaze umusaruro.’’ Uretse gushyikirizwa izi telefoni, abazihawe banahuguwe ku buryo bwo kuzikoresha, kugira ngo bazabashe kuzibyaza umusaruro. Aba baturage banahawe internet izamara amezi atatu kugira ngo bimenyereze kuzikoresha. Minisiteri y’Ikoranabuhanga na Inovasiyo igaragaza ko mu Rwanda habarirwa abantu miliyoni ebyiri n’ibihumbi 600 zidafite smartphone. Akarere ka Rutsiro kaza ku mwanya wa nyuma aho ari umuturage 1% ufite telefoni akaba ari nayo mpamvu ariho kuzitanga byatangiriye. Kuri ubu hamaze gukusanywa telefoni ibihumbi 43 zatanzwe zivuye mu bantu batandukanye binyuze mu bukangurambaga bwa Connect Rwanda.

title: Umubare w’abakoresha WhatsApp wageze kuri miliyari ebyiri
content: Sosiyete ya Facebook yatangaje ko umubare w’abantu bakoresha WhatsApp hirya no hino ku Isi wazamutse uva ku bantu miliyari 1.5 bayikoreshaga mu 2018 ugera kuri miliyari ebyiri. Uyu mubare kandi nabwo wari uherutse kuzamuka uva kuri miliyari 1 wariho mu 2016 ugera kuri miliyari 1.5 mu 2018. Facebook ari nayo ifite WhatsApp mu itangazo yashyize hanze yagaragaje ko nta gahunda ihari yo guhagarika uburyo butanga umutekano ku butumwa bw’abayikoresha buzwi nka ‘End-to-end encryption’ Abashyiraho amategeko na Guverinoma z’ibihugu bitandukanye zakunze kugaragaza ko ubu buryo bwa End to End encryption bubangamira iperereza ku byaha birimo iterabwoba, ikoreshwa ry’abana n’ibindi. Umuyobozi wa WhatsApp, Will Cathcart, yagize ati “Mu mateka yose y’ikiremwamuntu, abantu bagiye babasha kuvugana hagati yabo mu buryo bw’ibanga kandi ntidutekereza ko ibyo bigomba kuvaho muri sosiyete igezweho.” Cathcart yongeyeho ko WhatsApp izajya itanga amakuru yifuzwa igihe bizaba byagaragajwe ko ari ingenzi mu iperereza. Imibare yo mu 2018 igaragaza ko n’umubare w’abakoresha izindi mbuga nkoranyambaga za Sosiyete ya Facebook wazamutse nk’aho ubwayo ikoreshwa n’abagera kuri miliyari 2.5 mu gihe Instagram yo ikoreshwa na miliyari imwe.

title: Samsung yashyize ku isoko telefoni nshya ya Galaxy Z Flip ishobora gukunjwa
content: Ni telefoni yabanje kumurikwa ubwo hatangwaga ibihembo bya Oscars mu mashusho yamaze amasegonda 30, ariko itangazwa ku mugaragaro ku wa Kabiri mu gikorwa cyabereye mu mujyi wa San Francisco, muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Iyi telefoni ishobora gukoreshwa mu buryo bunyuranye, ikunjwa ikanaramburwa igatanga ikirahuri kigari, ukaba wayikunja ukayitereka ahantu kumwe mudasobwa iba imeze niba wifuza kuyikoresha uganira n’undi muntu hifashishijwe amashusho, n’ibindi. Iyi Galaxy Z Flip ni imwe muri telefoni zigezweho, nto kandi zishobora gukunjwa, nyuma y’uko uru ruganda rwo muri Korea ruheruka guhura n’imbogamizi mu gusohora Galaxy Fold, telefoni ishobora kuramburwa ikavamo tablet. Samsung Galaxy Z Flip ikoresha Android 10, camera y’inyuma ifite megapixel 12 naho iyi mbere ifite megapixel 10. Ifite ubushobozi bwo gufata amashusho yo mu bwoko bwa 4K (HDR 10 Plus), ni ukuvuga ko aba asa neza cyane kandi ashobora kwerekanwa ku birahuri bya rutura, umwimerere w’amashusho ntuhinduke. Ifite processor ya 64-bit octa-core, ububiko bwa GB 256 n’ububiko ikoresha by’akanya gato (RAM) bwa 8GB. Ubushobozi bwa batiri ni 3,300 mAh. Muri uyu mwaka kandi hagiye ku isoko indi telefoni ishobora gukunjwa, Motorola Razr igura $1500. Yasohotse muri uku kwezi ndetse yakirwa neza ku isoko bitewe n’ubyiza byayo birimo kuba igira batiri nto n’ikirahuri cya pulasitiki. Galaxy Z Flip izajya ku isoko ku wa 14 Gashyantare 2020, aho izaba igura $1,380 muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.

title: Cadillac yashyize hanze ubwoko bw’imodoka ishobora kwitwara
content: Cadillac Escalade yashyizwe hanze nyuma ya Cadillac CT6 yashyizwe hanze mu 2017 nayo ifite ikoranabuhanga rishobora gutuma yitwara. Iri koranabuhanga rituma umuntu akura amaboko ye ahabugenewe mu kuyobora imodoka ubundi yaba iri mu muhanda mugari ikitwara. Ntabwo bisaba ko umuntu yongeza umuriro cyangwa ngo awugabanye cyangwa se ngo afunge amaferi, kuko byose imodoka ibyikorera bitewe n’aho igeze. Si yo modoka ya mbere yitwara kuko n’uruganda rwa Tesla rumaze kwandika izina mu gukora izikoresha amashanyarazi rwakoze “Autopilot” ariko yo ntabwo yagenda ahantu harehare nk’uko kuri Escalade bimeze. Iyi modoka ishobora kuva mu gisate kimwe cy’umuhanda ikijyana mu kindi ariko bibaho gusa iyo umushoferi akanze ku kinyoteri cy’icyerekezo ashaka kujyamo. Iyi modoka izajya hanze umwaka utaha igura ibihumbi 75 by’amadolari, asaga gato miliyoni 70 Frw.

title: Drones zirimo iy’Abanyafurika zagurukijwe mu mwitozo utegura irushanwa ryazo mu Rwanda (Amafoto na Video)
content: Iri rushanwa ryiswe Lake Kivu Challenge rigamije kwerekana ikoranabuhanga rigezweho mu iterambere  ryo gutwara drones. U Rwanda rwabaye igihugu cya mbere muri Afurika kizaryakira kuva ku wa 8 Gashyantare 2020. Amarushanwa yo kugurutsa indege za drones azamenyekanisha serivisi nshya, amakuru agezweho mu kohereza no kwakira ibintu bitandukanye, guhanga imirimo n’amahirwe yo kwihutisha iterambere, no kubaka ubumenyi bujyanye n’imirimo yo mu kinyejana cya 21. Ibigo 11 nibyo bizaryitabira ndetse kuri uyu wa Kabiri, tariki ya 4 Gashyantare 2020, bimwe muri byo byakoze umwitozo wo kugurutsa drones. Umuyobozi wa Banki y’Isi ushinzwe Ibijyanye n’Ubwikorezi muri Afurika y’Uburasirazuba, Ben Eijbergen, yashimiye abagize uruhare mu gutegura irushanwa. Ati “Intego nkuru ni ukureba ikoranabuhanga rigezweho. Ntituri hano kureba drone ishobora kugenda yihuse ahubwo ni ukureba ikoranabuhanga rikenewe mu kunoza ibyo zikora.’’ Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Ishyirahamwe ry’Indege za Gisivili mu Muryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe (AFCAC), Tefera Mekonnen, yavuze ko amahirwe ari mu ikoreshwa rya drone akwiye kubyazwa umusaruro. Ati “Tugomba kureba uko ikoranabuhanga rya drones rikoreshwa, kungukira byinshi mu byo zikora ku buzima bw’abaturage.’’ U Rwanda rwashimwe uko rukomeje kwimakaza iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga. Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Karongi, Mukarutesi Vestine, yavuze ko hari byinshi irushanwa rya Lake Kivu Challenge rizasigira igihugu. Yagize ati “Turishimye cyane ko mwemeye kuza mu gihugu cyacu. Bizadusigira ubumenyi bwinshi, ku buryo twakora ubushakashatsi bwimbitse mu gukoresha drones.’’ Mbere yo kugurutsa drones, abitabiriye iki gikorwa bahawe amabwiriza y’ibyo kwirinda birimo kutanywa itabi, kuzimya telefoni kugira ngo bidateza ikibazo izo ndege. Muri drones zagurukijwe harimo iya Germany Drone yo mu Budage, Hojung solutions – Remo-M yo muri Koreya y’Epfo; Avy; Phoenix Wings yo mu Budage na Wingcopter. Buri tsinda ryahabwaga umwanya wo kugurutsa indege nyuma yo gusuzuma ikirere no kureba ko nta kibazo gifite. Urugendo rwa drone rwagenzurwaga n’inzobere mu by’ingendo zo mu kirere harebwa ko zubahiriza amabwiriza. Abapilote bahabwaga umwanya wo kubanza gutegura urugendo no gusuzuma ko ikirere kimeze neza mbere y’uko indege ihaguruka; zagurukijwe hakurikijwe amategeko mpuzamahanga.  	Drone y’Abanyafurika ikoze mu migano mu zagurukijwe Indege idakenera umupilote yakozwe n’abanyeshuri bo muri Tanzania, Bornlove Nkitha na Digna Gasper, iri mu zamuritswe muri iki gikorwa. Ni drone ifite ibice biyigize bikoze mu migano. Yavuye mu mushinga abanyeshuri bakoze basoza amasomo ya kaminuza mu mwaka ushize. Digna yabwiye IGIHE ko bitabiriye uyu mwitozo ku nshuro ya kabiri kuko no mu mwaka ushize, bari ku Kiyaga cya Victoria muri Tanzania. Ati "Intego dufite ni iyo kwagura ikoranabuhanga dukoresha kugira ngo rikomeze kugirira benshi umumaro.’’ Iyi drone yakozwe ku bufatanye bw’aba banyeshuri na OpenMap Development Tanzania (OMDTZ), yagurutse hejuru y’Ikiyaga cya Kivu nkuko izindi zabigenzaga, igera muri metero 100 zo mu kirere igaruka ku butaka [ahari ikibuga cyabugenewe] mu minota ibiri. Mu Ukwakira 2016, Perezida Paul Kagame yatangije ikoreshwa rya drones nk’uburyo bushya u Rwanda rukoresha mu kugeza amaraso ku bitaro binyuranye byo mu gihugu, mu gufasha abayakeneye ku buryo bwihuse kandi vuba. Uyu ni umushinga wa Minisiteri y’ubuzima mu Rwanda na sosiyete ya Zipline, watangiye ushyirirwa mu bikorwa mu Murenge wa Shyogwe mu karere ka Muhanga, mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo. U Rwanda kandi rwatangiye gukoresha drones mu bindi bitari ubuvuzi, nko mu buhinzi. Lake Kivu challenge biteganyijwe ko uzayegukana azahabwa ibihumbi £40, agera kuri miliyoni 50 Frw. Irushanwa rizibanda mu byiciro bitatu bigaragaza uko ikoranabuhanga rya drones ryakwifashishwa mu kugeza serivisi z’ibanze nk’ubuvuzi ku baturage. Aya marushanwa azakurikira Inama Nyafurika kuri drones, izahuriza hamwe abayobozi mu ikoranabuhanga rya drones kuri uyu wa 5 Gashyantare 2020. Izigirwamo imikoreshereze yazo muri Afurika mu bihe biri imbere. Zipline izasangiza abazitabira “Africa Drone Forum’’ urugendo rwayo rw’imyaka itatu itanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi mu Rwanda na Ghana. title: WhatsApp igiye guhagarikwa muri telefoni nyinshi ku Isi
content: Ibikoresho bya Android na iPhone bifite porogaramu y’ikoranabuhanga ’Operating System’ ishaje cyangwa itakigezweho ni byo bitazongera gukoresha WhatsApp. WhatsApp yatangaje ko iki cyemezo yagifashe kuko cyari gikenewe ndetse kigamije kurinda umutekano w’amakuru y’abayikoresha akaba yizewe. Telefoni zigezweho zizwi nka Smartphones zikoresha Android 2.3.7 na iPhone iOS 8 ni zo zizagerwaho n’izi mpinduka zo kutongera gukoresha WhatsApp. BBC yanditse ko abantu benshi bashobora gukorera amavugurura [update]  operating systems zabo kugira ngo bakomeze gukoresha WhatsApp. Ibi ariko mu bikoresho bimwe na bimwe nka iPhone 4, yakira gusa porogaramu ya iOS 7, ntizongera kwakira application ya WhatsApp. WhatsApp yari muri application zamanuwe (download) mu myaka 10 ishize, ku nshuro ya mbere yari yatanze umuburo ko izi mpinduka zizaba mu 2017. Ni icyemezo Umuvugizi wa WhatsApp avuga ko kigoye ariko cyari gikwiye gufatwa mu gufasha abantu kuganira n’inshuti, imiryango mu buryo bwizewe. Mu 2016 nibwo WhatsApp yaherukaga gukura application yayo muri telefoni zitandukanye n’iza Windows ku wa 31 Ukuboza 2019.

title: U Bufaransa: Uwambaje Béatrice yanditse igitabo yise ’Le silence des Collines’
content: Ni igitabo kivuga ku nkuru y’umugore witwa Mutesi wabaga mu muryango we atuje mbere ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, yahitanye umugabo we na nyina. Ayo mateka n’uburemere bwayo byatumye ahungira mu mahanga, anyura mu bihugu bitandukanye bya Afurika n’u Burayi mbere yo guhingukira mu Bufaransa. Umwanditsi agaragaza ko yaje gusubira mu Rwanda nyuma y’imyaka 23 Jenoside ihagaritswe yibwira ko ibikomere byashize, kuko yabaga mu buzima butuje mu Burayi muri iyo myaka yose. Agikandagiza ikirenge ku ivuko yahise yibuka bya bihe byo mu 1994 nk’ubihagazemo bushya. Icyo gihe yatangiye kwibaza impamvu abantu babanye mu buto ari inshuti zisangira akabisi n’agahiye n’abo mu muryango we bwite, bageze aho bakora amahano. Mu kuzimiza mu nyandiko, Uwambaje amateka ayaganisha ku giti cy’Umuko kizwi cyane mu mateka y’u Rwanda rwo hambere. Icyo giti kikaba cyari kiri mu rugo iwabo, aho avuga asa n’ukibaza impamvu ibyo byose byabaye kireba kandi cyarafatwaga nk’umurinzi mu mateka ya kera. Ati ‘‘Kuki u Rwanda rwageze aha, kuki ari twe byabayeho?’’ Nyuma y’ibyumweru bine yamaze mu Rwanda yaje gusubira mu Bufaransa aho atuye ahita atangira kwandika igitabo yise ’Le silence de Collines’.’ Uwambaje yabwiye IGIHE ko yanditse icyo gitabo nk’uburyo bwo guha agaciro amateka yanyuzemo no kuyasigasira. Yagize ati ‘‘Nifuzaga kongera kwibona muri ayo mateka, nageze aho numva ntanashaka kuba mu Banyarwanda cyangwa ngo mvuge Ikinyarwanda.’’ ‘‘Ikintu gikomeye muri iki gitabo ni ukuba impunzi mu mutima, kugira imbogamizi zo kuvuga ubuhamya bw’ibyo nabayemo, ibyo benshi twabayemo mu 1994, kubibonera amagambo, inyito n’intangiriro.’’ Uwambaje yanditse asa n’uwitirira undi inkuru ariko ashushanya ubuzima bwe bwite yanyuzemo. Ni umushinga yakoze agamije gufasha abana be n’abandi kumenya amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi batabikuye ahandi cyangwa ngo babibwirwe uko bitari kandi afite ubushobozi n’ubumenyi bwo kubikora. ‘‘Le silence de Collines’’ ni igitabo cyereka abakiri bato ko ibyabaye byakozwe n’abantu bari abaturanyi bari mu miryango imwe, biganaga n’abandi ba hafi. Yagize ati ‘‘Mube maso kuko ni ibintu bishoboka kandi byakongera kubaho mu gihe cyose mutabibwiwe mubyirinde.’’ Yakomeje avuga ko ‘‘Amagambo iyo atitondewe akavugwa uko abonye ashobora kugeza ku bwicanyi kuko twarabibonye kuri RTLM, aho bitaga umututsi Inyenzi, Inzoka n’ibindi bikaza kuvamo kwicwa. Ibi byose urubyiruko rugomba kubimenya ni kimwe mu mpamvu nanditse igitabo.’’ Uyu mwanditsi yerekanye ko amagambo meza ashobora gukiza, kubaka, nkuko biri kugerwaho mu Rwanda rw’uyu munsi rukataje mu iterambere. Ibi abishimangira mu gutangira igitabo cye aho avuga ko “Kuba narabonye n’amaso ibyabaga ntibingira umuntu w’igitangaza ariko bimpa kwerekana uko mbyumva. Ni ishusho y’ibyabaye mu gihe runaka (1994) mu buzima bw’umugore  w’Umunyarwanda n’umwana we w’umuhungu babagaho bisanzwe ariko bikaba byaramuteye ikimwaro. Ni umuntu ushaka kuva mu kintu kimeze nko kuba imfungwa y’amateka yanga kuvuga ngo idakomeretsa abandi. Iri ni ijwi ryanjye riranguruye numva ari inshingano zanjye zo gusiga no kwandika aya mateka.’’ Uwambaje Béatrice ni umugore uri mu kigero cy’imyaka 50, aba mu Bufaransa hamwe n’umuryango we ugizwe n’umugabo n’abana batatu. title: Imyemerere ihejeje abantu mu rujijo: Imana y’i Rwanda, Imana ya Israel ( Igice cya mbere)
content: Nk’uko tubikesha igitabo “Imana mu Banyarwanda, Abanyarwanda mu Mana’’, cyanditswe n’Umusizi NSANZABERA Jean de Dieu, inzobere mu muco, amateka n’ubuvanganzo, tugiye kubasesengurira iby’iyo myumvire ihejeje abantu mu rujijo, bikaba n’imvano y’amakimbirane mu miryango migari y’Abanyarwanda. Mu busesenguzi bw’amateka y’impitabihe ku myemerere y’Abanyarwanda n’abatuye isi muri rusange, uwo mwanditsi yagize ati “‘Kuva isi yaremwa n’ijuru rigahanikwa , Imana ni imwe mu bihe byose, ari iyo amahanga yiyitirira, ari iyo Abanyamadini bigisha nta tandukaniro rihari. Imana y’Abasekuruza b’Abisirayeli n’Imana y’Abakurambere b’Abanyarwanda n’andi mahanga, ni Imana imwe. Ahubwo Imana bemera cyangwa se bigisha bakayiringira muri byose, itandukanira mu myumvire n’uburyo bayifata. Ibyo bikagaragazwa n’uburyo amahanga yagiye ayifatiraho igenamigambi ryayo n’imico bagiye bayiha itandukanye, bituma Imana yo mu burayi itandukana n’iyo mu Rwanda no muri Afurika muri rusange. Imana ni imwe ku isi yose, aho itandukanira mu muco no mu mu myigishirije abantu bayiha bitewe n’icyo bagamije kugeraho.” Imana yafatiweho ibintu byinshi, ariko byose bigamije kwimakaza kuganza kw’igihugu iki n’iki n’umuco wacyo mu batuye ibindi bihugu                                (Nationalisme). Kugira ngo amahanga ahatire ibihugu byinshi kugendera ku mahame y’umuco wabo, ibitekerezo byabo biyobore isi, yagiye yifashisha Imana, kugira ngo abantu barusheho gutinya no kuyoboka bwangu. Mbere y’uko Imana yiharirwa n’Abanyamadini ikaza no kuba umwihariko w’ibihugu bimwe na bimwe, yari amaraso y’umuryango mugari w’abatuye isi, bakaba muri yo nayo ikaba muri bo, buri muturage wa buri gihugu, akiyumvamo ari umwana w’Imana, na mugenzi bikaba uko. Noneho igihe kiza kugera, ibihugu bitangira kuyigira umwihariko wabyo, bikayiyitirira bikayigiraho ubuzare buruta ubw’abandi. Muri ibyo bihe, nibwo imiryango iyi n’iyi y’abatuye isi na Leta z’ibihugu by’ibihangange ku isi, zagiye zishyira Imana mu igenamigambi ryayo, bitewe n’intego bimirije imbere. Mu bihe by’ibisekuruza bya mbere mu birari by’amateka ya bene Yakobo nibo bihinduye umuryango mutagatifu Imana yemera kandi igomba gucishamo ibyiza byose igenera ibiremwa byayo bigandagaje ku isi. Iyo myato bakayivuga aho bageze hose, bakayikandagiza n’amahanga abazengurutse, ko ariyo ibaha ubuhangange. Aho niho bagiraga bati “ Uwiteka ni we Mana ya Israel’’, Abanyarwanda nabo bakagira bati “ Imana y’i Rwanda yirirwa ahandi igataha i Rwanda’’. Ahasaga mu wa 325 mu bihe by’ubwami bwa Kositantine, ubutegetsi bw’Abanyaroma bwayifatiyeho bushimangira amahame y’idini ryabo.Imana iba urufatiro ntayegayezwa rw’idini ry’Abanyeroma ryitwa Gatolika, utari muri iryo dini, ahinduka umwanzi w’Imana. Mu nkundura yatangijwe n’Umupadiri w’Umudage Dr Martin Luther impirimbanyi y’uburenganzira bwa Muntu, yabaye intango y’andi madini yose yo ku isi, yo guhangwa afatiye ku Mana, kugira ngo uwo muhora wari umaze kuremwa n’Abagatolika b’i Roma uyitandukanya n’abantu yaremye, ukurweho, bose bibumbira mu miryango n’amadini yitirirwa Imana. Ku ngoma y’umwami w’Abongereza James watwaye ubwo bwami kuva mu wa 1603-1625, ni we waciye iteka ko Politiki y’abongereza igomba gufatira ku Mana, ari nawe wacapishije Bibiliya yamwitiriwe mu wa 1612( King James Bible). Ni  we washyizeho gahunda yo kurahirira kuri Bibiliya igihe cyose umuyobozi arahirira kuzubahiriza inshingano ze. Ihame yashyizeho ryo gushyiraho Politiki yitirirwa Imana, ryogoga isi yose, cyane cyane mu bihugu u Bwongereza bwakoronije. Kugeza ubwo aya mateka yandikwaga, ibihugu byinshi byo ku isi, bimaze gutora umuco wo kurahirira kuri Bibiliya nk’ikimenyetso kigaragariramo Ijwi ry’Imana cyimakajwe n’amadini. Muri yo nkundura yo kurema gahunda z’isi zifatiye ku Mana, Abanyamerika n’Abanyaziya, bahisemo kuyubakiraho intambara zose barwana n’andi mahanga. Intambara zose n’ibitero bagiye kugaba mu mahanga adacana uwaka nayo, bakazitirira Imana. Aho ni naho havuye imvugo ikunze gukoreshwa cyane cyane mu bihugu bya Aziya yo kurwana intambara ntagatifu. Bigeze muri Afurika, byo byahinduye umuvuno, abogezamana b’abanyamadini, baje kuyikangurira Abanyafurika nk’aho bayibarusha, bitwaje ikindi cyerekezo kitari icyo Abongereza,Abanyamerika n’Abanyaziya bari barahisemo. Imana Abanyamadini baje gusakaza muri Afurika, ni Imana bafatiyeho ubucuruzi, no gusahura imitungo kamere y’Abanyafurika, dore ko bahasanze imitungo kamere itagira ingano kandi bene yo bayikomeyeho. Niko kwiga umuvuno baca kugira ngo babasahure, niko kwitwaza Imana nk’ikitegererezo cyo kudakunda iby’isi no kuyigaragaza nk’igihangange kitagaragara, kirimbura ukigomeye. Inyigisho zabo ziza ari izo gucuruza Imana muri Afurika no mu Rwanda,  cyahawe inyito ya kimwe mu icumi n’amaturo yo gushima, inyiturano, ibirundo n’ayandi. Aha niho benshi mu batekereza b’isi, bagiye bakura ibitekerezo by’imishinga ifatiye ku Mana, kugira ngo abaturage bayo barusheho kuyoboka byihuse. Ibihugu by’ibinyantege nke, bihura n’uruva gusenya kuko imigirire, imibereho n’imyumvire-Mana bavomaga mu muco wabo yatangiye guhanagurika. Babura icyo bafata n’icyo bareka. Inyigisho zuje iterabwoba ry’Imana irimbura, ryazengereje Abanyafurika by’umwihariko u Rwanda, bigatuma bemera ibyo batazi, bakareka ibibubatse, bakarushaho guhunga no kureba igitsure icyabahatse imyaka myinshi! Igihamya cy’ubu busenguzi, nuko uzasanga uko ku mugabane w’IiBurayi bafata Imana, bitadukanye n’uko Abanyaziya bayifata, imigirire n’imyumvire y’Imana muri Afurika, ugasanga ihabanye n’iy’Abanyamerika. Kuki ibyo byose biba, kandi Imana ari imwe? Byose biterwa n’inyungu baba bifuza ku ishyanga iri n’iri cyangwa isi muri rusange, bagahitamo kuyitegekesha imico runaka bahisemo kwitirira Imana ngo ibageze ku nyungu zabo,kuko ariyo itinywa kandi ibyayo bikubahwa na bose, ari naho usanga bayitirira imico idahwitse, na muntu waremwe nayo atagira mu mibereho ye. Mu gice gikurikiraho, tuzarushaho kubagaragariza uburyo Imana y’i Rwanda n’Imana ya Israel, ari Imana imwe, usibye abayitandukanya bagamije inyungu zabo, bimakaza umuco w’ubusambo  no kuba ba rusahuriramunduru.

title: Inkomoko y’Insigamugani: Yaraye i Ragwe!
content: Icyo gihe, hari ku ngoma ya Cyilima Rujugira; mu Mayaga ya Mututu hakaba ibuga ryitwa  i Ragwe. (Ubu ryarasibanganye; aho ryabaga hasigaye harangwa n’umugunguzi). Bukeye rero, Abanyarwanda barishoraho inka zabo nyinshi cyane. Ubwo bajya gushora. Abatasi b’i Burundi bamenya ko bazashora nk’ejo; bararika inkiko zegeranye na Mututu, bati “Nimubona inka z’Abanyarwanda zishotse i Ragwe muzazinyage”.  Abanyarwanda ntibamenya iyo migambi y’Abarundi; bucya bishorera uko bisanzwe. Inka zigeze kuri iryo buga, abarundi bazisakiza bangana n’inzige batunguye Abanyarwanda. Bararwana rubura gica, ariko Abanyarwanda baba bake ntibabasha kubatsimbura. Gusa birwanaho n’ubwo bari bake bwose barwana no ku nka zabo ntizanyagwa; barara barwana bageza mu gitondo. Uko barwana uko ni na ko n’induru zivuga. Aba hafi aho baritabira; Abanyarwanda bamaze kwiyongera banesha Abarundi babamurura haciyeho iminsi ibiri. Ubwo rero inka zari zaraburanye n’izazo, kuko zari zashotse uko bisanzwe nta we urota ayo makozere. Abanyarwanda bamaze kunesha bashorera inka barakura. Ziza zararariranye amabere zabirira izazo inzira yose. Abasigaye imuhira bazisanganira ari igisaga; abagore n’abakobwa bavuza impundu, abagabo n’abahungu bataraka baziririmba, bati “Amacebe yazo yaraye i Ragwe nimuzisanganize izazo’.  Bazirekurira izazo barinikiza barakama. Nuko kuva ubwo baba hagize umugabo urara ukubiri n’umugore we, cyangwa umubyeyi urara kubiri n’abana be ariko kubera amakozere bakabigereranya n’iby’izo nka zaraye ukubiri n’izazo ku iriba rya Ragwe, bati “Yaraye i Ragwe”. Ndetse byanavuyemo igitutsi batukana bagira ngo “Naka arakarara i Ragwe” iyo bamwifuriza kurara nabi.

title: Inkomoko y’Insigamugani ’Ntibigira rutangira!’
content:
Wakomotse ku Mushambo Rutangira w’i Nduba mu Butare mu Bwanacyambwe (Kigali), ahagana mu mwaka wa 1700. Ubwo hari ku Ngoma ya Cyilima Rujugira, asimbuye Karemera Rwaka ku ngoma kuko imurashe. (Yamuteye ubumuga bwo guhuma kuko yayihawe itari iye by’irage). Karemera yari afite umugaragu witwa Rutangira agatura i Nduba mu Bwanacyambwe. Yari yaramugize umutware we wo mu batoni. Haciyeho iminsi rero Rwaka arahuma ndetse na nyina Rukoni arasara. Rubanda bavuga ko ari ingoma yabarashe. Abiru na rubanda babonye Rwaka ahumye na nyina asaze, batumira Rujugira ngo aze kwima ingoma y’u Rwanda. Yari yarahungiye se mu Gisaka, amaze kumwicira impfizi yitwaga Ruhashya. Rujugira amaze kugera mu Rwanda baramwimika yitwa Cyilima. Amaze kwima, se Mazimpaka aratanga, Rutangira ariwe utegeka urugo rw’ibwami n’umuryango we w’Abashambo, barakize baradendeza. Rujugira na we amurekera ubwo butware. Nuko bibaho, kugeza ubwo abanzi ba Rutangira bamuteranyije n’ibwami, nyuma y’igitero cy’Abarundi, Mutaga ubwe yari yatabayemo by’ihururu. Ubundi abapfumu be bamuraguriye ko azatera u Rwanda ku ruhira; we abonye ingabo ze ziteye agira ubwuzu bwazo, yiyemeza kuzitabaramo. 
Atwikisha inzu n’ivu rihowe imaze kuzima abyita uruhira, yambara inkindi ajya ku itabaro. Ageze ku rugamba arukomerekeramo; akomeretswa n’Umunyarwanda wari wiguze kuzamwica. Uwo Munyarwanda ni Rugira  rwa Shaza w’i Ntora mu Bwanacyambwe, yari yibwe mu kiraro baramufata bamuzanira Cyilima ngo amuhane. Baramuboha ingoyi imaze kumurembya, ati “Nimureke nigure.’’ Bati “Urigura iki ngo tukubohore?’’ Abwira Cyilima ati “Mpa umuheto n’imyambi ine nzakwicira Mutaga!’’ Cyilima aramwemerera, baramubohora, bamuha umuheto n’imyambi aratabara. Koko rero urugamba rw’Abarundi n’Abanyarwanda rwabaye rucyambikana, Rugira aba amaze kuhagera ahubirana n’abandi bari bagiye gucurangisha. Arahagarara araruhuka, abaza abandi, ati “Mutaga ari aha?’’ Mutaga aramwumva asohoka mu rugamba mu rugamba afite ingabo ye Rwamu rw’Abahizi n’amacumu; ingabo ayishinga hagati y’ingamba zombi, ati “Ndahari Sembyariyimana Bibero bikingira abarwanyi.’’ Rugira aba yashyizemo umwambi ararekera, ingabo ya Mutaga arayibarura, amurasa mu gatuza. Mutaga, ati “Yifungurire yaraye kandi irataha kure ni Rwamu rw’abahizi.’’ Rugira amurasa umwambi mu kibero  utunguka mu kindi aramujisha. Mutaga baramuraha, baramuheka aratabaruka. Ubwo aba araneshejwe, ingabo z’u Rwanda zohereza abavuzi b’amacumu. Abagiye kuvuga amacumu, abanzi ba Rutangira babagambanaho, bati “Nimugera ibwami muzavuga ko Abanyarwanda bose babaye abagabo uretse Rutangira wenyine wabaye ikigwari bitavugwa.’’ Abavuzi b’amacumu, koko baragenda babivuga gutyo. Cyilima abyumvise akubitiyeho n’ibindi birego basanzwe bamumuregaho, biramurakaza araritsira. Ingabo ziratabaruka barara inkera barahiga. Rutangira agiye guhiga baramuseka bati “Uyu aragira ibiki!’’ Inkwenene bayivaho bose bamuha inkwekwe bavuga ko icyo gitero yakigizemo ubwoba akaba ikigwari. Cyilima ati “Uretse no kugira ubwoba, ntazi n’imirimo y’ibwami yashinzwe’’. Amunyagira aho, ibye bigabanywa rubanda. Nuko Rutangira amaze kunyagwa ahinduka umukene karahava, bene wabo b’Abashambo na bo bose ibyabo bibura kirengera bigenda nka Nyomberi, baratindahara. Rubanda rw’i Nduba bakajya babazanya byo kubannyegura ngo iyo anyazwe n’umuryango wose uhinduka imbwa?! Ibyo mu Bashambo rero bimaze kuba umwaku, rubanda babifatiraho; babona abantu bari mu makuba y’amaburantsinzi, bati “Ibyabo bigiye nka Nyomberi, ntibigira rutangira!’’. Kubura rutangira = kubura kirengera n’intsinzi

title: Ibyihariye ku itongo ry’Umwami Kigeri IV Rwabugiri ry’i Karongi,ahateguriwe ibitero bikomeye
content: Kuwa 7-10 Kanama 2019, Umunyamakuru wa IGIHE kimwe n’abafite ibigo bifasha ba mukerarugendo mu Rwanda, basuye ahahoze urugo rwa Kigeri IV Rwabugiri, mu rugendo rugamije gutangiza inzira nshya y’ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku muco n’amateka. Uru rugendo rwateguwe n’ ikigo gishinzwe Ingoro z’Umurage w’u Rwanda n’Umushinga w’Abadage wita ku iterambere (GIZ), rwabimburiwe no gusura inkima zo mu birunga Umuvumbuzi w’umudage Dr Richard Kandt yakozeho ubushakashatsi. Rwakomereje i Shangi aho Kandt yabanje gutura, muri Pariki ya Nyungwe aho yavumbuye isôoko y’uruzi rwa Nil no gusura Abanyamuryango ba koperative zirimo Abagi ikorera uburobyi n’ubwato mu Kiyaga cya Kivu mu masaha y’ijoro na Tugarure Umuco yo muri Karongi. Iri tsinda ryasobanuriwe ko uyu mwami yari afite ingo nyinshi mu gihugu akoreramo ibikorwa bitandukanye byo kuyobora igihugu no gusigasira ubusugire bwacyo. Kigeri IV Rwabugiri wabaye ikirangirire n’igihangange, atsinda  amahanga mu bitero byose bigera kuri 16 yagiye agaba,  yubatse urugo mu cyahoze ari Kibuye mu 1874, ubu ni mu Karere ka Karongi, Umurenge wa Rubengera, ari naho yateguriragamo ibitero. Ni urugo  rwari ruguru gato y’ikiyaga cya Kivu. Uru rugo yarwubatse ubwo yari atabarutse[Avuye ku rugamba] i Butembo muri Repubulika iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Nirwo yakoreyemo umuhango w’umuganura inshuro nyinshi[Zirindwi] ugereranyije n’ahandi yagiye awukorera. Ibitero byinshi Kigeri IV Rwabugiri yagabye ku Ijwi n’i Bunyabungo, yabiteguriraga muri urwo rugo, ingabo zatabaruka zikahavugiriza amacumu zizanye n’iminyango zakuye ku rugamba nawe akazishimira, azambika  impeta z’ubutwari. Kuva i Rubengera ku kibuye ugera aho uru rugo rwari rwubatse, mu modoka ugenda iminota itarenga 10, ugahita ubona icyapa kizamuka mu gahanda gato kabanza ku kugeza ahahoze iriba i Bwami bavomagaho amazi. Uvuye kuri iryo riba uyu munsi ryubakiwe kijyambere, ugenda metero nka 30 ugahita ubona inzira y’abanyamaguru igera aho urugo rwe rwari ruri, uyu munsi hagaragazwa n’ikigabiro cy’igihondohondo n’ibindi byarangaga urugo rw’umwami nk’inzu ya kinyarwanda. Umuyobozi w’Ingoro z’Umurage w’u Rwanda, Amb Robert Masozera, yavuze ko ‘Ubushakatsi bwakozwe bwerekanye ko mu Rwanda hari ahantu nyaburanga 500 hari amateka akomeye hashobora gusurwa n’abakerarugendo harimo n’aho hahoze urugo rwa Kigeri IV Rwabugiri’. Ati “Mu bushakashatsi dukora burimo no gucukura dushaka ibisigaratongo, hano twahabonye ibimenyetso by’icyo gihe biranga ubutwari bw’Umwami Rwabugiri birimo intango z’imitsindo yakoreshaga.” Yavuze ko habitse amateka menshi kandi hafitiwe gahunda yo kuyabungabunga muri gahunda yo kwagura ubukerarugendo bukarenga gushingira ku Ngagi na Pariki. Amb Masozera yijeje ubufasha abanyamuryango ba Koperative  Tugarure Umuco biyemeje gutegura ibikorwa bitandukanye byo kwakira abakerarugendo bazajya basura ahohoze urugo rwa Kigeri IV Rwabugiri n’utundi duce nyaburanga dukikije umukandara wa Kivu.

title: Rutangarwamaboko yakoze umuhango gakondo wo gutura Umuganura abakuru (Amafoto)
content: Umuganura  ni Umuhango ukomeye mu mateka y’u Rwanda rwo hambere  ari nacyo cyatumye Leta y’Ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda iwugarura ndetse ikawushyiriraho itegeko riwuha imbaraga ku buryo ku munsi wo kuwizihiza mu gihugu hose haba hari ikiruhuko. Uyu munsi mukuru udasanzwe ushushanya ubumwe bw’Abanyarwanda. Ni umuhango wizihizwa buri wa gatanu wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa Kanama buri mwaka. Mu 1925 ubwo ubukoloni bwazaga mu Rwanda nibwo umuganura wacitse, leta zikurikiyeho ntizabiha imbaraga, leta y’ubumwe bw’abanyarwanda irangajwe imbere na Paul Kagame niyo yongeye kuwugarura. Rutangarwamaboko yakoze ibidasanzwe  mu  Bibungo bya Mukinga, mu Murenge wa Nyamiyaga, mu Karere ka Kamonyi ho mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo aho avuka ahakorera ibirori byo gutura umuganura ababyeyi bitungura benshi ku gasozi kose k’iwabo. Rutangarwamaboko yabwiye IGIHE ko ibi yakoze ari ukugarura umuco wabagaho kera mu muganura abana bagatura ababyeyi babo. Ati “Ni ukugarura umuco wa kera mu muganura aho abana baturaga umuganura ababyeyi babo nk’ikimenyetso cyo gushima imbuto n’imigisha babahaye, noneho ababyeyi bakawubasangiza.” Agaya benshi mu rubyiruko bamara gukura bakajya kwiga mu mahanga cyangwa se kuba i Kigali ababyeyi babo ntibongere kubaca n’irihumye bakazapfa bikubye kandi barabyaye. Mu byo uyu muryango mugari wa Rutangarwamaboko waganuye harimo umusaruro mwiza w’umwe mu bana bavuka muri uyu muryango wari wasoje icyiciro cya kabiri cya kaminuza witwa Uwase Niyonigenera Clenie wanakoze ubushakashatsi bwashimwe na benshi kuko yatangije uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga buzajya butuma abantu badatonda umurongo ku bitaro bishyura nk’uko byagendaga ahubwo bigakorwa mu kanya gato kuri telefoni. Umuganura wo hambere Mu muco nyarwanda ukiri umwimerere utarinjirirwa n’ibyateye, ababyeyi iyo babyaraga abana barabareraga bakabakuza, bakazanabubakira nabo bakaba abantu bakuru. Mu kububakira rero babahaga imbuto nkuru z’u Rwanda mu gihe babatekeshaga zirimo; uburo, Amasaka, Isogi n’Inzuzi.” Bababatongeraga babatuka imigisha bati “Bana bacu dore imbuto tubahaye muzabibe mweze, muzatunge mutunganirwe, muzabyare muheke, muzagire ubugiri n’ubugwiza maze namwe muzabone ibyo mutanga nk’uko namwe mubihawe”. Abana rero iyo bamaraga kubaka bakaremya, bakabyara bagaheka, bagahinga bakeza, bagahaha bakaronka, ntabwo barekeraga aho gusa ahubwo mu mpera za buri mwaka w’Umuganura wa Kinyarwanda, bazirikanaga ikintu gikomeye bakorewe gitumye bariho. Bakazirikana  isoko baturukamo, bakibuka abakuru maze bakegeranya imitwa n’abana n’inshuti n’abandi b’umuryango buri wese aho atuye bagahurira ku mubyeyi wabo mukuru bamutuye amature y’ishimwe ko imigisha yabatutse yinononsoye, ko baje gushimira kubaho kwabo n’uburere buruta ubuvuke bahawe, ko baje kuzirikana ko bafite aho bakomoka ndetse ko Abakuru batariho nabo batabaho. Bagatura  ababyeyi ayo mature agizwe na za mbuto nkuru, bagatura amata n’inzoga z’uburyo butandukanye cyane ikigage nk’amazi y’amasaka, bagatura amafu y’amasaka n’uburo maze bagasusurutsa ababyeyi batyo urugo ntirwigunge ngo n’uko abana barushizemo kuko bakuze bakubakirwa ingo zabo ahubwo bagahora iteka bashishira ababahaye kubaho, ibyo rero bikaba ariwo mugenzo witwaga ‘Gutura Umuganura’ mu muhango w’Umuganura. Iyo  abana bamaraga gutura ababyeyi ayo mature, ababyeyi nabo bafataga kuri ya fu bakavugira umutsima abana bakabazimanira n’ibyo kunywa cyane amata n’ikigage bikaba ari byo byitwa Gutanga Umuganura. Abana baturaga umuganura abakuru, abakuru nabo bakawutanga bakawusangiza abana n’inshuti n’abaturanyi b’umuryango bikaba ari ikimenyetso cyiza cyasigasiraga ubumwe bw’umuryango ntutatane, ntugire amakimbirane kandi yanaza bakayacoca kuko abasangiye batarasana. Ubwo kandi ababyeyi bakongera kubaha imbuto bazabiba ubutaha no kongera kubahesha imigisha y’Imana y’i Rwanda ngo bazahorane ishya n’ihirwe nabwo bazongere babone ibibatungisha n’ibyo batura nabo bagatanga bagatungisha abandi no gutura abakuru babatungishije kuko ngo indinda ari ebyiri mu muco nyarwanda: Ndinda Dawe na Ndinda mwana. Rubanda narwo rwaturaga umuganura abatware nabo bakawutura Umwami nawe akabona akaganuza rubanda, ko ari nako abana batura umuganura ababyeyi nabo bakabona bakabaganuza. Ibi bikaba ikimenyetso gikomeye ko Igihugu cyawe kiguha ibyo wagihaye. Rutangarwamaboko asanzwe ari umushakashatsi, umwigisha w’ubuzima bushingiye ku muco akaba n’inzobere mu by’umuco, amateka, imbonezabitekerezo (Filosofiya) n’ubuzima bwa muntu bushingiye ku myizerere, imyumvire, imitekerereze, imyitwarire ndetse n’imigirire. Ni nawe  watangije kandi akaba n’Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo Nyarwanda cy’Ubuzima Bushingiye Ku Muco, Kigamije Iterambere ry’Igihugu rishingiye ku muco biturutse mu bushakashatsi yakoze ku muco n’ubuzima ubwo yasozaga kaminuza. Umwaka ushize nabwo yakoze  ibirori bimeze nk’uko byagendaga hambere mu gusohora umwana no kumwita amazina. Ubwo yitaga izina umwana we  w’umukobwa bamwita w’imfura ye yise ‘Rutangarwamaboko Umugiramana’ mu gushimangira ko afite amahirwe n’imigisha ikomeye ku bwo kuba yaravukiye mu Rwanda.

title: Umuhango wo guca inzigo mu butabera bwo mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere
content: Mu iyi nkuru, tukaba tugiye kubatekerereza amateka y’umuhango wo guca inzigo, wakorwaga mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere, nk’umwe mu mihango yifashishwaga mu kweza igihugu no kukirinda kumenekamo amaraso ya buri buri ku mpamvu zidasobanutse. Nk’uko tubikesha igitabo “Intwari z’imbanza , Zubatse u Rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro’’ cyanditswe na Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, inzobere mu muco, ubusizi, ubuvanganzo n’amateka y’impitabihe ku gihugu cy’u Rwanda, tugiye kubavomeramo intango zisubira, musome ubundi mucururure, dutekererezwe amateka y’umuhango wo guca inzigo mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere. Amateka y’u Rwanda agaragaza ko u Rwanda kimwe n’ibindi bihugu byinshi byo ku isi hakunze kugaragara umuco wo guhora. Uwiciwe umuntu agakora iyo bwabaga kugira ngo na we azihorere. Kwihorera byabaga ari ukwica uwo muntu wamwiciye cyangwa se akica umwe wo mu muryango we, igihe yabaga abuze uwabaga yakoze icyo cyaha.  Iyo batamwicaga bwangu  cyangwa se bakabura n’undi bica wo mu muryango we, babanaga izo nzika kugeza ku gisekuruza cya kure, kugeza igihe uwo muryango wihoreye k’ukomokamo uwabiciye. N’iyo uwabaga yarishe yabaga atakiriho, umuryango we wabaga ubaye inzigo k’uwo biciye, kugeza igihe bazihorera bishe umwe wo mu babo, ubundi amahoro agahinda. Iryo rya ri ihame ry’ikirenga mu mibanire y’abenegihugu mu mizo ya mbere y’iturwa ry’isi no mu Rwanda. Mu kwimakaza ubutabera nyakuri no gushimangira ubworoherane n’ituze muri rubanda, umwami Cyilima Rugwe yaciye umuco wo guhora no kugira inzigo zokamwe n’inzika z’igihe kirekire z’ababaga hagati y’abiciwe n’abishe. Cyilima Rugwe, yashyizeho umuhango yise “Guca inzigo”  Bishatse kuvuga gukuraho inzika zo kuzihorera ku muryango uyu n’uyu wabaga wiciwe. Guca inzigo byakorwaga iyo uwishe yafataga umwanzuro wo kujya kwirega ibwami, ko yishe umuntu akajya gusaba gucishirizwa inzigo we n’umuryango we. Iyo yajyaga gusaba gucishirizwa inzigo, yajyanaga n’umuryango we wose, ku buryo ntawe usigara inyuma ngo adatanga urwaho rwo kwihorera ku muryango biciye umuntu. Guca inzigo byakorwaga mu buryo bwo gufata ingoma y’imihango,  bakayitereka hagati y’imiryango yagiranye ibibazo [Abishe n’abiciwe] ubundi bagakubitaho umurishyo umwe, bakarahira ko nta n’umwe uzihorera. Urenze kuri uwo muhango akihorera,  yafatwaga nk’undi munyacyaha wese, ariko iyo wihoreraga, umuryango w’uwishe utaragera ibwami ngo usabe gukorerwa umuhango wo guca inzigo, nta cyaha cyakubarwagaho. Ni ukuvuga ko guhora inzigo, byasabwaga n’umuryango w’uwishe, ukajya kwihakirwa ibwami mu buryo bwihuse, abiciwe batarihorera. Iyo inzigo yamaraga gukurwaho igacibwa burundu,  hakurikiragaho kugenza icyaha mu mutuzo bakamenya impamvu icyo cyaha cyakozwe cyahama nyira cyo akagihanirwa. Muri ibyo bihe ahasaga mu wa 1345, nibwo Cyilima Rugwe yaciye iteka ko: ‘’Icyaha ari gatozi, ntawe ukwiye kuzira icyaha cya mwene wabo, ko umuntu ari umunyacyaha ku giti cye, kitaryozwa umuryango we’’. Kuva ubwo  ndavuga ku ngoma y’umwami Cyilima Rugwe, umugenzo wo kwihorera ugenza amaguru make, ndetse ugenda ucika gahoro gahoro no ku bami bamukurikiye.  Iteka yaciye ry’uko icyaha gihanirwa uwagikoze, kitareba umuryango we, ritangira kubahirizwa, na magingo aya.

title: Inkomoko y’Insigamugani:Yatanze Rwantorero
content: Rwantorero uwo yabayeho ku ngoma ya Ruganzu Bwimba, igihe Abasinga batinyiriye ingoma; nyirarume wa Ruganzu Nkurukumbi amaze kwihadika intugunguru avuga ko yazanye amagara atashobora gutabara. Ubwo Robwa mushiki wa Ruganzu yari amaze kurongorwa na Kimenyi Musaya umwami w’i Gisaka. Mu irongorwa rye akaba yarajyanye n’umugabo Mukubu wa Mushyoma, (Urukubanzoka mugabo wiciwe mu mariba ya Rwishwima), amuhaweho indongoranyo. Bamaze kugera i Gisaka, Kimenyi atonesha Mukubu cyane. Mukubu na we mu bo asanze i Gisaka abana cyane n’umuhungu witwaga Rwantorero, bituma Robwa na we akunda uwo muhungu cyane. Haciyeho iminsi Robwa yoherereza nyina na musaza we amaturo ashorejwe na Mukubu na mugenzi we Rwantorero. Bagejeje amaturo mu Rwanda bavuga ubutumwa, barangije bakomeza ibiganiro. Rwantorero akaba ingenzi mu magambo; araganira cyane bimukundisha Ruganzu. Bukeye bamaze gusezera ngo batahe, Ruganzu atuma Mukubu ati “Ugende umbwirire Robwa uti yarabashimye cyane, kandi arabasaba ko nimugira icyo mushaka kumutumaho muzajya mutuma Rwantorero”. Intumwa zirasezera zirataha. Zigeze i Gisaka zivuga ubutumwa zashohoje n’ubwo zigarukanye. Baburangije Mukubu ati “Andi magambo natumwe na Ruganzu ni ay’uko ngo muramutse mugize icyo mumutumaho mwazajya mutuma Rwantorero”. Hacaho iminsi, Ruganzu yoherereza mushiki we amaturo; ajyanwa na Mugarura Sekabote w’Umutsobe, wari utuye i Kinyambi cya Runda na Gihara ho mu Rukoma. Kinyambi iyo ni ya yindi bavugaho ngo “Umugabo ntari kure ari i Kinyambi!” Nuko Mugarura aragenda atanga amaturo aragaruka. Haciyeho indi minsi, na none Robwa yohereza amaturo; noneho ashorerwa na Rwantorero nk’uko Ruganzu yabisabye. Ayagejeje ibwami arayerekana; ayerekana neza muri bwa bugeni bwe.  Ruganzu yumvise amagambo avuga biramushimisha kurusha ubw’amambere; abaza Rwantorero, ati  “Uwakwisabira Kimenyi akaguhaka wabikunda?” Rwantorero ati “sinabyanga”.  Ruganzu, ati  “Na Kimenyi aramutse atanadukundiye ndagusaba ko nzaguhaka kandi nzagukiza”. Umugambi bombi barawunoza. Bamaze kuwuzuza, Rwantorero arasezera arataha. Ngo haceho iminsi, Ruganzu yoherereza Kimenyi inka ebyiri z’imbyeyi zo gusaba Rwantorero ngo amuhake. Intumwa igeze i Gisaka yerekana inka. Kimenyi n’Abanyagisaka barazishima cyane.  Intumwa ya Ruganzu iba iboneyeho ijambo; iraterura, iti  “Ruganzu yampaye izi nka nkuzaniye kugira ngo agusabe Rwantorero amuhake: ngo aramukunda mugirire ubuntu umumuhe”.  Kimenyi amaze kumva ayo magambo asubiza iyo ntumwa, ati “Ugende umbwirire Ruganzu uti  Rwantorero ni umugaragu we akunda cyane ntabwo yamuguha. Uti ahubwo urebe ikindi umusaba naho we sinamutanga”. Ibyo byose babivugaga Robwa mushiki wa Ruganzu abyumva. Amaze kubyumva arababara, kuko Kimenyi yimye musaze we icyo akunda. Yihererana umugabo we aramubwira, ati “Uhemukiye umwami mugenzi wawe, kuko umwimye icyo agusabye.”  Bavuga ko Ruganzu na mushiki we babigiriraga imigambi y’ubucengeri, kuko bombi bari abacengeri.  Kimenyi yumvise amagambo umugore amubwiye bimutera akantu biturutse ku bukundwakazi.  Yemera guha Ruganzu Rwantorero. Azana n’iyo ntumwa. Ruganzu abakubise amaso biramushimisha, kuko abonye uwo yifuzaga. Intumwa yerekana Rwantorero ivuga n’uko Kimenyi yamumuhaye. Ruganzu ahita agabira Rwantorero Rukoma yose. Yubaka Gishyeshye ku ka Rubare. Nuko amaze kugabana Rukoma, aba umutoni wa Ruganzu asigiye na Rugina w’umusinga wari mubyara wa Ruganzu. Bukeye Rwantorero amaze kumutambutsa ubutoni, amugirira ishyari amusabana ibye avuga ko ari umugome wanga Ruganzu. Igihe Ruganzu atarabimuha, nyirarume Nkurukumbi yihadika intugunguru avuga ko yazanye amagara adashobora gutabara; naho kwari ukwanga gutabarira ingoma nyiginya kandi we ari umusinga! Ruganzu amaze kumva ko nyirarume atinyiriye ingoma yiyemeza kuyitabarira we ubwe. Ariko agenda rubanda batabizi, bazi ko ari ugutambagira u Rwanda rwe gusa. Byari bizwi n’abiru na Rwantorero bonyine. Ruganzu akiri mu nzira ataragera i Gisaka, Rwantorero aramwegera, ati “Ese mugiye mugenje mute kuri bya bintu bya Rugina nabasabaga?”  Ruganzu aramwihorera. Noneho Rwantorero abonye ko undi amunaniye, ararika inshuti ze; arazibwira ati “Buriya Ruganzu atabaye bucengeri (ubutazagaruka) kandi nari naramusabye ibintu bya Rugina, none agiye gutanga atabimpaye. None nimuce hasi dufatanye turege Rugina asige amutanze.” Rwantorero amaze kumena ibanga atyo, noneho rubanda bose bamenya ko Ruganzu atabaye bucengeri. Ibwami n’abiru bagumya kubaririza icyabibamenyesheje. Hagati aho Rugina amenya ko ari Rwantorero; aba abonye urwaho rwo kwihimura aca hasi n’inshuti ze babibwira abiru; bati “Ibi byose mwumva byaciye igihugu umugongo byaturutse kuri Rwantorero wasabaga ibya Rugina, akaba ashaka ko Ruganzu asiga amaze kubimuha kandi anamutanze”. Nuko abiru n’ibwami barabyemera; babyemezwa n’uko bazi ko Rwantorero ari we wari ubizi kuko yari umutoni w’akadasohoka wicara mu bitaramo by’abiru. Bemeza ko atangwa Ruganzu ataratabara. Ruganzu yemera kumutanga kandi yamukundaga, ahamagara rubanda n’abakuru, bamaze guterana aramutanga amujijije amazimwe ye. Rwantorero arapfa apfana n’umuryango we wose. Uwaba ngo yararokotse ni umukobwa we witwaga Nyirakamagaza, wari warashyingiwe mu Basengo b’i Gishyeshye; akaba nyirakururuza w’Abasengo b’aho bakivugwa na magingo aya. Kuva ubwo rero abantu bagwa mu kantu barumirwa; bakajya bavuga ngo:”Ruganzu yatanze Rwantorero ku bw’ubwitarange bwe”. Kuva ubwo rero rubanda batangira kubikwiririkanya mu mvugo, bivamo umugani baneguza uwitaranga wese bati “Naka yatanze Rwantorero” (Yitaranze ubwe).

title: Uko Umunsi w’Umuganura wizihijwe mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu (Amafoto)
content: Wari umunsi usobetse imihango n’imigenzo ikubiyemo byinshi bifite icyo bivuze gikomeye mu buzima bw’igihugu n’abagituye. Umuganura watangiye kwizihizwa mu Rwanda ku Ngoma ya Gihanga Ngomijana mu kinyejana cya 11, uza kongera guhabwa imbaraga na Ruganzu II Ndoli (1510-1543) ubwo yabohoraga u Rwanda nyuma y’imyaka irenga 11 ruri mu maboko y’abanyamahanga (Abanyoro, Abanyabyinshi n’Abanyabungo). Uyu munsi wizihizwa buri mwaka kuri uyu wa 2 Kanama 2019 wizihirijwe mu Karere ka Nyanza ku rwego rw’igihugu. Mu butumwa bwa Minisitiri w’Intebe, Dr Ngirente Edouard, wari umushyitsi mukuru muri uwo muhango, yagaragaje ko Umuganura ari umwanya wo kwishima, gusubiza amaso inyuma no kwisuzuma, hagafatwa ingamba zo kunoza ibitaragenze neza kugira ngo tuzarusheho gutera imbere ejo hazaza. Yagize ati “Mu kwizihiza Umuganura, turasabana, tugasangira ibyo twejeje ariko kandi tukanafata ingamba zo gukomeza gukora neza, kugira ngo tugere ku majyambere arambye duharanira kwishakamo ibisubizo no kwigira.” Umunsi w’Umuganura kandi wizihijwe n’Abanyarwanda b’ingeri zose mu mfuruka enye z’igihugu n’Umujyi wa Kigali. Abanyamakuru ba IGIHE bakorera mu ntara zitandukanye z’igihugu bakusanyije iby’ingenzi byaranze uyu munsi ufite amateka akomeye mu mibereho y’Abanyarwanda. Ni umunsi waranzw no gusangira amafunguro n’ibyo kunywa bitandukanye byavuye mu byo abaturage bejeje.  	I Rubavu bizihije Umuganura bibutswa gukomeza kwirinda Ebola Mu Karere ka Rubavu mu Ntara y’Iburengerazuba, Umuganura wizihirijwe mu Kagari ka Buringo mu Murenge wa Bugeshi. Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Rubavu, Habyarimana Gilbert, yasabye abaturage kwirinda Ebola kuko ibyo bagezeho ihageze byaba impfabusa. Yagize ati “Ndabasaba kujya musuhuzanya mudakoranyeho mu kwirinda Ebola  kuko ni ibintu by’ibanze. Nubwo twizihiza umuganura twishimira ko ibirayi cyangwa ibigori byeze; turimo kwishimira ko umusaruro wagenze neza. Ebola iramutse igeze hano ibintu byose byaba impfabusa imihigo duhiga n’icyerecyezo dufite byose ntibyakunda n’iyo mpamvu buri muturage gukumira agomba kubifata nk’ibye.’’  	Abaturage ba Burera baguze ibitanda bizagoboka abarwayi kwa muganga Abaturage basaga 1500 bo mu Karere ka Burera n’abaturutse mu bindi bice by’Intara y’Amajyaruguru, Umunsi mukuru w’Umuganura bawizihije mu Murenge wa Kinyababa. Mu kwishimira uyu munsi, abaturage bishatsemo ibisubizo bagura ibitanda 10 na matelas 10 bizifashishwa ku Kigo Nderabuzima cya Kinyababa. Mu rwego rwo kwigira bishatsemo ibisubizo bakusanya miliyoni imwe n’ibihumbi 800 Frw yakoreshejwe mu kugoboka abarwariraga muri icyo kigo  nderabuzima bakaryama hasi kuri matela zishaje. Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Burera, Uwambajemariya Florence, yasabye abaturage kwimakaza umuco wo guhigurira ku gihe. Yagize ati “Umusi nk’uyu w’umuganura udufasha kuzirikana ibigwi mva rugamba ku byo twagezeho ariko ukaba n’umwanya w’imihigo njyarugamba. Muharanire ko umuco wo guhiga mugahigura uba muri mwe ariko mwibuke ko iterambere ryihuta ari uko dukoreye hamwe. Natwe tuzababa hafi aho muzadukenera.’’  	Iburasirazuba basabwe gusigasira umuco nyarwanda Umunsi w’Umuganura ku rwego rw’Intara y’Iburasirazuba wizihirijwe mu Karere ka Nyagatare mu Murenge wa Matimba. Witabiriwe na Guverineri Mufulukye Fred; Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Nyagatare, Mushabe David Claudien n’Umuyobozi w’Ingabo mu turere twa Nyagatare, Gatsibo, Kayonza na Rwamagana, Col Rugambwa Albert. Guverineri Mufulukye yashimiye abaturage bitabiriye uyu munsi abasaba gukomeza kugira umuco wo kwishimira ibyiza bagezeho kandi bakanakomera ku muco nyarwanda. Yagize ati “Iyo turi aha ngaha tuba twasubiye ku isoko y’umuco wacu, byerekana ko tugihagaze ku muco w’igihugu ndetse tukigikunda, ikindi bitwereka ubumwe bwacu nk’Abanyarwanda.’’ Yavuze ko uyu munsi ukwiye gusigira Abanyarwanda gukunda iby’iwabo bakareka kwizirika ku gukunda umuco w’ahandi. Mufulukye yanakomoje ku baturage bamwe batejeje imyaka ariko avuga ko hari bagenzi babo bagiye babagoboka bakabaha ibiribwa. Ati “Hari nk’uturere tumwe, imirenge n’utugari byagiye bigira ibibazo by’izuba ariko tukagira imirenge imwe n’imwe yagiye ifasha ba baturage batejeje neza bakabaha ibyo kurya, turasaba abaturage gukomeza kugira uwo muco wo gusangira n’abandi batagize umusaruro mwiza kuko aribyo biranga umunyarwanda.” Muhaya Simon utuye mu Kagari ka Matimba yavuze ko kuganura byari bikwiye bitewe nuko muri iki gihembwe babonye imvura imyaka yabo igakura neza. Ati “Uyu mwaka imvura yagwiriye ku gihe itinda no guhita bituma ibishyimbo byacu byera neza, ikindi ntabwo izuba ryavuye cyane ku buryo umusaruro w’amata ugabanuka cyane, tumeze neza nubwo tutavuga ngo ni 100% ariko ntabwo dushonje.” Mu mujyi wa Kigali, Umunsi w’Umuganura wabereye mu turere twose tuwugize aho abaturage bahuriye aho batuye basangira, baranasabana. Ku rwego rw’Akarere ka Nyarugenge wabereye mu Murenge wa Mageragere, mu gikorwa cyitabiriwe n’Umuyobozi w’agateganyo w’Umujyi wa Kigali, Busabizwa Parfait. Abitabiriye ibi birori muri uyu murenge kandi batashye ibiro by’Akagari ka Runzenze abaturage biyubakiye. Umuganura wa 2019 wizihijwe mu nsanganyamatsiko ivuga ngo “Umuganura, isôoko y’ubumwe n’ishingiro ryo kwigira”. Biteganyijwe ko uzanizihirizwa mu mashuri yose yo mu Rwanda mu rwego rwo gutoza abana Umuco Nyarwanda bakiri bato.  	Indi nkuru wasoma: Minisitiri w’Intebe Dr Ngirente yagaragaje ibyo Abanyarwanda bakwiye kwishimira ku munsi w’Umuganura (Amafoto na Video)

title: Ibyaranze igitaramo ndangamuco I Nyanza Twataramye (Amafoto)
content: “I Nyanza Twataramye” ni igitaramo ngarukamwaka kiba mu ijoro ribanziriza Umunsi mukuru w’Umuganura, kikabera mu Rukari mu Karere ka Nyanza. Icy’uyu mwaka cyabaye ku nshuro ya gatandatu cyatangijwe n’umutambagiro w’abahanzi batandukanye n’abanyabufindo wahereye ahazwi nko ku Bigega ugana mu Rukari. Iki gitaramo cyari cyitabiriwe n’abayobozi batandukanye ku rwego rw’Intara y’Amajyepfo na Minisitiri wa Siporo n’Umuco, Nyirasafari Espérance. Mu byaranze “I Nyanza Twataramye” harimo imbyino, indirimbo gakondo n’indi mikino yitsa ku muco Nyarwanda by’umwihariko ibihe byarangaga Umuganura. Abagize Urugaga rw’Ikinamico berekanye umukino witwa “Ibyiza by’u Rwanda” ukubiyemo ubutumwa butoza Abanyarwanda gukunda umuco wabo birinda gufata ibituruka mu mico mvamahanga bidahwitse nk’imyambarire, imvugo zidahwitse n’ibindi. Itorero Urugangazi ryo mu Rukari ni ryo ryasusurukije abari aho mu mbyino ziryoheye ijisho. Ababeramuco barangajwe imbere na Mushabizi Jean Marie Vianney na bo bakoze mu mirya y’inanga bavuza icyembe n’ibindi bicurangisho gakondo. Mu bandi bitabiriye iyi nkera barimo Ihuriro ry’abakora indirimbo gakondo, “Ishakwe” rihuriyemo Mavenge Soudi, Intore Tuyisenge, Jaba Star, Sofia Nzayisenga baririmbye indirimbo bakoreye umunsi w’umuganura. Hari kandi Danny Vumbi ukunzwe mu ndirimbo ye yise “Abana babi” aho yasusurukije abari aho mu ndirimbo ze zo mu njyana Nyafurika zirimo “Ni Danger” yatumye benshi babyina, bongerwa kwizihirwa.  Usibye abahanzi b’indirimbo hanatumiwe abanyarwenya bari bahagarariwe na Japhet na 5K Etienne bo mu Itsinda rya Daymakers Entertainment. Aba basore bamamaye kubera imvugo yabaye ikimenyabose yiswe ‘Bigomba Guhinduka’ inganzo yabo yo gusetsa yanyuze benshi. Mu butumwa bwabo bikije cyane ku gutanga ubutumwa bukangurira urubyiruko gusigasira umuco gakondo w’abakurambere. “I Nyanza Twataramye” ni igitaramo ngarukamwaka kibera mu Rwanda, kimaze kuba ubukombe kandi gifite umwihariko wo kugaragaza no gusigasira umuco Nyarwanda.

title: Umunsi mukuru w’Umuganura mu muco no mu mateka y’u Rwanda
content: Nk’uko tubikesha igitabo “Umuco mu Buvanganzo’’ n’icyitwa “Intwari z’imbanza, zubatse u Rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro’’ byombi bya Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, inzobere mu muco, amateka n’ubuvanganzo, tugiye kubatekerereza amateka y’umunsi mukuru w’umuganura n’ibyo wasobanuraga mu muco n’amateka y’u Rwanda. Umuganura watangiye kwizihizwa mu Rwanda ku Ngoma ya Gihanga Ngomijana mu kinyejana cumi na kimwe, uza kongera guhabwa imbaraga na Ruganzu II Ndoli (1510-1543) ubwo yabohoraga u Rwanda nyuma y’imyaka irenga 11 ruri mu maboko y’abanyamahanga (Abanyoro, Abanyabyinshi n’Abanyabungo). Umuganura wabaye imwe mu nzira z’ubwiru, kenshi na kenshi dufata nk’itegeko nshinga ryo mu Rwanda rwo hambere. Ni umwe mu byafatirwagaho ibitaramo nyarwanda, kuko nawo wari ufite umwanya mu bitaramo bitanu byari bikomeye mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere. Mu munsi mukuru w’umuganura, ibwami hazaga imyaka y’amoko menshi yabaga yeze muri ibyo bihe, ariko mu kuwutegura no kuwizihiza, hakifashishwa imbuto nkuru y’amasaka, ari nayo bengagamo amarwa n’inturire, ubundi bagasangira bishimira ibyiza byagezweho. Mbere y’uko habaho umuganura nyirizina wo muri Kamena kugeza muri Nzeri, hari undi munsi Mukuru wabaga muri Gashyantare witwaga “Umurorano’’ benshi bakunze kwita “Umuganura w’uburo’’. Uwo munsi mukuru icyo wasobanura nk’uko izina ryawo riri, wavugaga, “Gusogongera umuganura’’ ari nabwo abashinzwe umuganura batangiraga kuwuhinga. Mu gukora uwo muhango w’Umurorano uvuze gusogongera umuganura uzaba muri Kamena kugeza muri Nzeri, kenshi na kenshi bifashishaga imbuto nkuru ya Gihanga, ariyo y’uburo, dore ko aho buhingwa muri ibyo bihe bwabaga bweze, kandi nabwo bugomba guhabwa ikuzo nka bumwe mu mbuto za mbere z’ibanze z’Abanyarwanda (uburo, inzuzi, isogi, ibikoro n’amasaka), zahanganywe n’u Rwanda. Ku rwego rw’Igihugu, Umuganura wayoborwaga n’Umwami afashijwe n’abanyamihango b’umuganura bakomoka kuri Rutsobe rwa Gihanga naho ku rwego rw’umuryango, umukuru w’umuryango n’abagize uwo muryango we nabo barahuraga bakizihiza umuganura kugera hasi ku miryango mito. Ibirori by’Umuganura mu gihe cya kera byizihizwaga ku mwero w’amasaka, Umunsi Mukuru w’umuganura watangiraga muri Kamena, ugasoza muri Nzeri. Umunsi Mukuru waheraga ibwami, ukabona gusesekara muri rubanda. Baganuzaga Umwami amata, amasaka n’izindi mbuto nkuru ari zo uburo, inzuzi n’isogi ariko bakongeraho n’ibindi byose byabaga byeze muri icyo gihe. Umwami yafataga umwuko agatangiza umuhango wo kuvugira umutsima rubanda baje kuganuza, akawuvuga apfukamye yerekana icyubahiro aha abo ayobora ndetse n’Igihugu. Nyuma y’umuhango wo kuganura hakurikiragaho ibirori by’Umuganura byasozwaga n’igitaramo cy’imihigo. Muri ibyo birori, Umwami yamurikirwaga umusaruro unyuranye w’Abanyarwanda bavuye impande zose z’Igihugu, hakaba amarushanwa y’ indashyikirwa. Kuri uwo munsi kandi, imiryango nayo yarateranaga maze umutware w’umuryango akayobora imihango n’ibirori byayikurikiraga. Umuganura rero ni kimwe mu byatumye u Rwanda ruba Igihugu gikomeye kitavogerwa kuko watumye Abanyarwanda bunga ubumwe. Umuganura wasobanuraga byinshi mu buzima bw’igihugu. Bimwe muri byo nibyo dusanga mu mateka n’umuco by’Abanyarwanda, byatumaga uwo munsi mukuru ubaho. Iby’ingenzi byagendeweho kugira ngo hagenwe umunsi mukuru w’umuganura, bigatuma ushyirwa mu itegeko nshinga ryo mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere, ni ibi bikurikira: •	Umuganura cyari igikoresho cy’ibarabihe mu mateka y’u Rwanda, kuko iyo babaraga imyaka y’ubukure y’umunyarwanda, bagiraga bati “kanaka yariye imiganura iyi n’iyi.” •	Umunsi w’umuganura wizihizwaga kubera impamvu zo gushimira Imana y’i Rwanda yabahaye amagara mazima, imyaka ikaba yihiritse •	Umuganura wari umunsi wo kwishimira uburumbuke bw’imyaka, abantu n’amatungo Abanyarwanda babaga barungutse mu mwaka wose, •	Umuganura niwo wari umunsi w’ubunani mu bihe byo ha mbere, kuko umwaka w’Abanyarwanda watangiraga ku wa 15 Nzeri ukarangira n’ubundi ku wa 15 Nzeri w’umwaka ukurikiyeho, •	Umuganura rwari urubuga Abanyarwanda bahuriragamo bategura igenamigambi ry’umwaka ukurikiyeho, cyane cyane igihembwe cya mbere cy’ihinga aricyo cy’Umuhindo, gitangirana na Nzeri kigasozanya n’Ukuboza. Mu ihururu ry’umwaduko w’Abakoroni, Umunsi mukuru w’umuganura uri mu byashegeshwe n’Abakoroni b’Ababirigi. Mu mavugurura yakozwe yo kwangiza umuco w’Abanyarwanda, harimo n’umuganura. Mu wa 1925 Adiminisitarateri wa Nyanza yafashe icyemezo cyo "Guca" Gashamura ka Rukangirashyamba umutware w’Abiru (Umwiru w’ijambo) amucira i Gitega (Burundi). Bamuzizaga ko yari afite uruhare mu mitegekere no mu mibanire y’ibwami n’Abazungu. Muri ibyo bihe nibwo banakuyeho umuganura n’abahinzi bawo. Musenyeri Léon Paul Classe na we uwo mugambi wo kwigizayo Gashamura yari awurimo. Baciye umuganura bitwaje ko ariwo Abanyarwanda bahuriramo bagasangira imihango yabo itsindira igihugu. Rwampungu, umuhungu wa Gashamura, bahise bamushyira mu ishuri riyoborwa n’Umubiligi, bityo "Ubwiru" burazima kuko bari babuciye umutwe. Umuganura nka kimwe mu mihango y’ubwiru yabashaga kugira byinshi isobanura ubwami n’abaturage basangiye, uzima utyo. Kwizihiza umuganura muri iki gihe byarenze imbibi zo kwita ku musaruro w’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi gusa, ahubwo bigera no mu zindi nzego zireba ubuzima n’iterambere by’Abanyarwanda. Kwizihiza Umuganura ni ugusubira ku isoko y’umuco wacu tukavomamo bimwe bishobora kudufasha gukemura ibibazo duhura na byo uko Igihugu kigenda gitera imbere. Umuganura ni isoko y’ubuhuza n’umuco wo kwigira kw’Abanyarwanda.

title: Inkomoko y’insigamugani  “Yigize nyiranzakaha”
content: Wakomotse ku muja wa Rugaju witwaga Mupfasoni, wo mu Bibungo bya Mukinga (Gitarama); ahasaga umwaka wa 1800. Izina rya Nyiranzakaha si irya se, ahubwo ni irihimbano. Ubundi yitwaga Mupfasoni, akaba umuja wa Rugaju rwa Mutimbo; wa mutoni w’akadasohoka wa Yuhi Gahindiro. Se wa Mupfasoni yari umugaragu wa Mutimbo. Uwo mukobwa abana na Rugaju bakiri abana; barareranwa baragirana inyana barakurana. Bukeye Rugaju ahakwa n’ibwami ariko ahijyanye; nta wamushohoje! Aratona aba umutware w’akadasohoka. Nuko amaze kuba umutware birambuye yibuka wa mukobwa Mupfasoni. Aramutumiza aramushyingira. Umuhungu umurongoye agabana ubutware ku mpamvu ya Mupfasoni w’inshuti ya Rugaju. Mupfasoni amaze kubyara kabiri umugabo we arapfa. Rugaju amushyira iwe, ariko amurekera n’iby’umugabo we; urugo n’inka n’abagaragu. Aramutonesha cyane; umuntu wese ushaka ubuhake kuri Rugaju akabanza guca kuri Mupfasoni; n’ugize ubuhake buke yegera Mupfasoni ngo amuhakirwe bikamuhira. Arahongerwa karahava; ndetse no mu batware ba Gahindiro, uwagiraga amakuba yihutiraga kujya kwa Mupfasoni ngo amubwirire Rugaju amumuhakirweho. Umuntu yamubaza uko Rugaju amumereye, Mupfasoni, ati “Ndabizi humura nzabikumarira’’. Ni bwo abahungu bamuhinduye Nyiranzakaha. Ariko bakabivuga rwihishwa kugira ngo atabimenya bikabagwa nabi. Bukeye aho Rugaju agiriye amakuba, ariko bigihwihwiswa mu rwihisho ibwami bareshya Mupfasoni baramujyana ngo ababwire neza ibya Rugaju. Ageze ibwami akajya abamenyesha uko ameze kugeza igihe bamutangiye. Amaze gupfa, ibwami bahindukirana Nyiranzakaha; bati “Na we ntakwiye gusigara’’. Baramutanga. Rubanda rubyumvise bariyamirira, bati “Nyiranzakaha apfanye nashebuja Rugaju!’’. Nuko bisakara igihugu cyose, biturutse kuri Mupfasoni wari warihaye kumenyera Rugaju ibihwihwiswa aha na hariya. Kuva ubwo rero, ushatse kumenya ibintu byose by’aha na hariya, na we bakamugereranya na Mupfasoni, bati  “Naka uriya cyangwa nyiranaka yigize Nyiranzakaha!’’  -Kuba nyiranzakaha ( = nyira-nzi-akaha) = Kwigira bamenya w’ibintu byose.

title: Umwanditsi Pierre Péan wakunze kunengwa ku gupfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, yapfuye
content: Pierre Péan yakunzwe gushinjwa gupfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi abinyujije mu gitabo cye cyasohotse mu 2005 yise ‘Noires fureurs, blancs menteurs’ ugenekereje mu kinyarwanda ni ‘abirabura bagira umujinya w’umuranduranzuzi, abera bakaba ababeshyi’ . Yagaragazagamo ko mu Rwanda habaye Jenoside ebyiri. Yakoreye ibinyamakuru bitandukanye birimo Libération, Le Canard Enchaîné, Actuel n’ibindi. Yigeze kandi gutanga umutangabuhamya ku bijyanye n’ihanurwa ry’indege ya Habyarimana mu iperereza ryakorwaga n’abacamanza b’Abafaransa, Marc Trévidic na Nathalie Poux. Mu 2015, Perezida wa Gabon,  Ali Bongo Ondimba, yamujyanye mu nkiko amushinja ko yamwanditseho amakuru yuzuye ibinyoma. Icyo gihe yari akurikiranywe kubera inyandiko yasohoye kuri Perezida Bongo mu gitabo cyitwa «Nouvelles Affaires Africaines». Guverinema ya Gabon yatanze ikirego ku wa 10 Ugushyingo 2014 mu rukiko rwo mu Bufaransa, irega Pean wasohoye inyandiko yanditse zisebya Perezida Ali Bongo. Hamwe yari yavuze ko Perezida Bongo akoresha ibyangombwa mpimbano ku bwenegihugu bwe n’umwaka yavukiyemo. Agaragaza kandi ko Ali Bongo abyarwa n’umuturage wo muri Nigéria, akaba yararezwe n’umuryango wa Omar Bongo nk’umwana watoraguwe mu ntambara yabaye mu mpera 1960 mu gihe muri Nigéria hari intambara ikomeye yo mu karere ka Biafra. Ahereye kuri ibyo, Péan yanditseko asanga Ali Bongo ataragombaga kuba Umukuru w’igihugu cya Gabon kuko Itegeko Nshinga ry’icyo gihugu ritemera ko umuntu aba akiyobora atarakivukiyemo.

title: Ubuhanzi nyarwanda bwahawe umwihariko udasanzwe mu muganura w’uyu mwaka
content: Guhera tariki ya 29 Nyakanga kugeza tariki ya 4 Kanama, mu Rwanda hazizihizwa Icyumweru cy’Umuganura 2019, kizarangwa n’ibikorwa bitandukanye. Minisiteri ya Siporo n’Umuco (MINISPOC) ku bufatanye n’Inteko Nyarwanda y’Ururimi n’Umuco (RALC), batangaje ko uyu mwaka umwihariko uzaba guteza imbere inganda ndangamuco, hamurikwa ibihangano nyarwanda mu ngeri zitandukanye. Mu kiganiro IGIHE yagiranye n’ Umuyobozi w’Ishami ry’Umuco muri RALC, Dr Nzabonimpa Jacques, yavuze ko uyu mwaka bahisemo kwibanda ku buhanzi kuko ari icyiciro cyafasha igihugu gutera imbere ariko cyasigaye inyuma. Ati "Impamvu ni uko ari icyiciro kimwe mu bigize ubukungu bw’u Rwanda cyagiye gisigara inyuma. Abahanzi bakomeje gufatwa nka ba Sagihobe, nk’abantu baza bakaririmba cyangwa bagashimisha abantu bagahabwa ikinyobwa barangiza bakigendera. Ntibyahawe agaciro kandi iyo urebye neza usanga ari icyiciro gifite kuba cyazamura ubukungu bw’igihugu mu buryo bwihuse kandi buhamye. Mu gutanga akazi, ni icyiciro gifite guha abantu benshi akazi.” "Nitwibanda ku buhanzi bukaduhangira imyambaro, za nganda ndangamuco zizatera imbere. Nk’icyiciro cya sinema giteye imbere, ntabwo cyazamuka cyonyine ahubwo cyazamura icya muzika, kikazamura icy’ubwiza n’imideri.” Guhera tariki ya 29 Nyakanga kugeza tariki ya 31 Nyakanga, mu Mujyi wa Kigali ahazwi nka “Car Free Zone” buri munsi guhera saa kumi n’imwe hazajya habera imurikabikorwa ry’urwego rw’ubuhanzi nyarwanda, mu ngeri zitandukanye zirimo kuririmba, imideri, sinema, urwenya, imbyino n’ibindi. Hari n’Uturere twemeye ko muri icyo gihe tuzategura aho gukorera imurikabikorwa ry’abahanzi batwo mu rwego rwo kubateza imbere. Tariki ya 1 Kanama nibwo hazaba igitaramo cy’Umuganura kimaze kumenyerwa ku izina rya “I Nyanza Twataramye” kizatangira saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba mu Rukari i Nyanza. Ku wa Gatanu tariki ya 2 Kanama, hazizihizwa Umuganura 2019 ku rwego rw’Igihugu, ibirori byawo bizabera kuri Sitade ya Nyanza; ariko bikazanizihizwa ku rwego rw’Uturere n’Umudugudu. Dr Nzabonimpa yatangaje ko uyu mwaka hari undi mwihariko w’uko tariki ya 3 n’iya 4 Kanama, Umuganura 2019 uzizihizwa ku rwego rw’umuryango, hagamijwe gushishikariza imiryango y’Abanyarwanda kuba umwe no gufashanya. Ati “Bigumye ku rwego rw’Igihugu ntibibe mu muryango ntabwo Umuganura 2019 waba wabaye. Umuganura ni cya gihe ngewe manuka nkajya iwacu ku isȏoko, nkifatanya n’abandi banyamuryango tugasabana nk’umuryango. Abana bato baba i Kigali bagahura na babyara babo, bakamenya ibibaranga nk’umuryango. Umuryango ukarebera hamwe uko umeze, abarimo bakennye batabonye mituweri bagafata ingamba nk’umuryango.” Umuganura 2019 mu Banyarwanda baba mu mahanga uzizihizwa ku munsi bazahitamo ariko bitarenze tariki ya 31 Kanama uyu mwaka. Dr Nzabonimpa yashishikarije abakozi ba Leta badafite impuzankano yihariye, ko mu Cyumweru cy’Umuganura 2019 bakwiriye kuza bambaye kinyarwanda cyangwa bakambara imyenda yakorewe mu Rwanda. Mu mateka y’ u Rwanda, Umuganura wari umunsi mukuru ngarukamwaka wubahwaga kandi ugahabwa agaciro ibwami no mu muryango w’Abanyarwanda. Uwo munsi wizihizwaga ku mwero w’amasaka, maze Abanyarwanda bagashimira Imana uburumbuke bw’umuryango, imyaka n’amatungo yabahaye. Bivugwa ko Umuganura watangiye kwizihizwa ku ngoma ya Gihanga Ngomijana mu kinyejana cya cyenda. Kwizihiza uwo munsi byaciwe n’abakoroni mu wa 1925 ubwo umutware Gashamura ka Rukangirashyamba wari umwiru ushinzwe Umuganura, yacibwaga mu Gihugu. Abanyarwanda bakomeje kwizihiza umuganura mu miryango yabo, uwo munsi wongera guhabwa imbaraga na Leta y’Ubumwe yanashyizeho ikiruhuko buri wa Gatanu wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa munani (Kanama).
