content: Muri iki gice tugiye kubavunguriraho gato ku bigwi n’ibirindiro by’amateka  y’ibigwi by’inka mu Rwanda, dore ko utabikuyeho akamanyu nibura gato gato, utashobora kubiva imuzi ngo ubigere imuzingo. Nk’uko tubikesha igitabo “Intwari z’imbanza, zubatse u Rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro’’ cyanditswe n’Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, inzobere ku Muco, ubusizi n’amateka,  tubimburiye ku iyinjira ry’inka  mu Rwanda n’uko zatejwe imbere zikaba urufatiro rukomeye rw’ibintu byinshi mu mateka. Inka ifite ibisekuruza byinshi mu mateka y’Afurika, aho bisaga imyaka 3000. Inka  zahanganywe n’u Rwanda, aho zadukanywe n’Abasangwabutaka b’Abasinga n’Abazigaba ahasaga mu wa 300. Abanyiginya bahasesekaye, bateje imbere cyane ubworozi bw’inka bituma inka zose zo mu gihugu bazitirirwa, aho mu mateka bagira bati “Gihanga niwe wahanze inka n’ingoma’’ . Bikomoye ku kuba Abanyiginya aribo bahaye intera ndende n’urwego rw’ikirenga ubworozi bw’inka, ziba nyinshi mu gihugu. Inka yahawe intera iyingayinga iy’umuntu. Aho mu Bucurabwenge bw’inka, bagiraga bati “Inka ni imfura, kuko upfa ikakurerera, wabumbira ( wabura amashereka) ikakugoboka, ikakurwanyiriza indwara z’ibyorezo n’ubujyahabi”. Inka niyo yarangaga ubukire, Inka niyo yari ipfundo ry’ubuhake nk’akazi ko hambere, Intwari yo ku rugamba yagororerwaga inka, Inka yungaga inshuti, Inka yahuzaga inshuti  (abahanaga inka, babaga babaye inshuti ), Inka bayikwaga umugeni nk’ikimenyetso cy’uburere bwiza. Mu Kinyejana cya Munani nyuma ya Yezu, ni ukuvuga ahasaga mu wa 700, nibwo hadutse  ishyanga rishya mu Rwanda, ari ryo ryaje kuvamo umuryango mugari w’Abanyiginya, baza n’ubundi, bagowe n’iyimukayimuka ryabo n’umutungo wabo urangajwe imbere n’inka bagendaga bashakira inzuri zitoshye kandi ngari. Mu gusesekara mu Rwanda,  binjiriye bwa mbere mu Gihugu cy’u Rweya rw’u Mubali ( mu mirenge ya Murundi na Mwili yo mu Karere ka Kayonza na Rwimbogo yo mu Karere ka Gatsibo).  Kuko ubutaka bubereye ubworozi bw’inka zabo bari babugezeho, bishimiye umukenke w’Iburasirazuba bw’u Rwanda, ugaragiwe n’ubutohe bw’umurambi w’ubutaka bwiganjemo icyogogo cy’uruzi rw’Akagera, ibiyaga bya Rwanyakiziga, Nasho, Ihema n’ibindi. Imyaka isaga 300(700-1091), umuryango mugari w’Abanyiginya wamaze mu busembere mu ngoma y’u Rweya rw’Abazigaba, nta kindi cyera cyangwa se cyirabura bakoze, usibye guteza imbere ubworozi bw’inka, bakora ubugenge n’ubuhanga bwo kuzibangurira kugira ngo zirusheho kororoka, maze nazo zirabakundira ziroroka karahava!! Aha akaba ari naho, bakuye umwihariko w’inka zitirirwa u Rwanda z’Inyambo  aribyo bivuga “Itungo ry’intoranywa’’. Imisozi yose bacumbikiwemo, yari yiganjemo inzuri z’inka, aho gutura ari hato, ku buryo aribo ba mbere bateje imbere gutura mu nsisiro mu rwego rwo kurinda akajagari mu miturire byari kugabanya ingano y’inzuri z’inka zabo. Mu misozi batuyemo myinshi kuri ubu  ibarizwa mu Karere ka Gatsibo ¾ byayo  byari inzuri z’inka. Muri yo twavuga Imisozi ya Nyagihanga, Rugarama, Ngarama, Kabarore, Gitoki, Gatsibo na Kageyo Imisozi batuyemo muri ibyo bihe, ari nayo baremyemo insisiro, ni mu mu Murenge wa Remera na Muhura yo mu Karere ka Gatsibo. Uko imyaka yashiraga indi igataha, niko Abanyiginya barushagaho guteza imbere ubworozi bw’inka, ari nako butuma bagira ijambo ry’icyizerabuhake mu Rweya, kugeza ubwo byabahesheje ijambo mu nzu y’ubwami bwabo, banashakamo abagore b’ibikomangoma. Muri bo twavuga nka Nyirarukangaga rwa Nyamigezi ya Kabeja, washatswe na Kazi ka Kizira, bakabyarana Gihanga. Abanyiginya bakomeje kugwiza ubutunzi bw’inka, amashyo n’amagana, bibaha imbaraga n’icyubahiro cy’ikirenga, kugeza ubwo ibwami batangiye kubakeka amababa ko bashobora kuzabambura ingoma, ari nabwo Gihanga yabimenyaga agashyira nzira akabahunga ajya guhanga igihugu cye mu bisigara by’ubutaka Abasangwabutaka banennye, akabuhangaho igihugu cy’i Gasabo. Gihanga, akimara guhanga Gasabo, Umuryango mugari w’Abanyiginya akomokamo akawukura mu busembere mu ngoma y’u Rweya, yashyizeho igenamigambi  ryeruye rishingiye ku nka mu kubaka igihugu cye. Inka ihabwa umwanya ukomeye mu buzima bwose bw’igihugu, aho yifashishwaga muri Politiki z’igihugu zitandukanye nko mu Bubanyi n’amahanga, mu kubaka ubukungu bw’igihugu, mu mutekano no mu ntambara zo kwigarurira amahanga, mu mibereho myiza y’abaturage, mu mibanire n’ubumwe bw’abenegihugu n’ibindi. Inka yayishyize mu igamigambi ry’ ububanyi n’amahanga n’ubutwererane n’abami b’ibindi bihugu bituranyi by’u Rwanda ku buryo yagombaga guhuza u Rwanda n’ibihugu by’inshuti kandi ikagabirwa abami b’ ibihugu byanga u Rwanda, bityo bikagabanya urwango, ubundi rukabasha gukora ibikorwa by’iterambere rwifuza. Inka yabaye inkingi ya mwamba yo kurwanya umwanzi w’imbere mu gihugu. Umwanzi w’imbere mu gihugu, burya ni ubukene. Iyo umunyarwanda atakennye, nta nabi agira, kandi umwanzi wo hanze y’igihugu ntiyabona aho yinjirira, kuko uwakamubereye icyitso wo mu gihugu hagati, baba baramugushije ruhabo. Nuko Gihanga, agena gahunda zo kugabira abaturage inka ku buntu, kugira ngo biteze imbere, ubundi amahoro ahinde mu miryango yabo. Inka yashyizwe mu rwego rwo gufasha igihugu mu kugera ku mutekano n’intwaro yo guhashya amahanga adakunda u Rwanda. Niho Gihanga, yahereyeho ashyiraho gahunda yo kugabira inka Ingabo zose z’igihugu, kugira ngo zirusheho kwitabira intambara zo kwivuna abanzi, no kugira imbaduko ku rugamba rwo kwagura igihugu. Inka yafatiweho umurongo mugari wo kwigarurira imitima y’abaturage b’ibindi bihugu u Rwanda rwashakaga kwigarurira. Aho buri muturage u Rwanda rwabaga rwanyaze mu bitero byo kurwagura, yahabwaga inka nyinshi zo korora zikamufasha kwikura mu bukene, bityo akinjira muri Paradizo nshya y’igihugu cy’u Rwanda, irimo amata n’ubuki, umutima akawukura kuri gakondo y’iwabo, akaganza  i Rwanda. Gahunda yo kugabira abaturage b’ibindi bihugu banyazwe n’u Rwanda, yatumye benshi mu baturage batoroka ibihugu byabo, biyizira mu Rwanda, bahabwa inka zo korora, ubundi batangira gutanga amakuru y’imbamutima y’uburyo u Rwanda ruzigarurira ibihugu bakomokamo. Ubukungu bw’ibihugu mu bihe byo hambere, bwari abaturage ku isonga, ubundi butunzi bugakurikiraho, ari nayo mpamvu u Rwanda, rwihatiye kwigarurira abaturage b’ibindi bihugu, rwifashishije inka.

title: Padiri Amerika agiye kumurika igitabo gitanga umucyo ku mpaka z’urudaca zishingiye  kuri Bibiliya
content:
Muri iki gitabo, Padiri Amerika yashyizemo ibice bitandukanye bishingiye ku bushakashatsi na Bibiliya, bigaragaza ukuri kw’imyererere abantu bajya bibazaho. Avugamo inzira ikwiriye abanyamadini kuri ubu basa n’abarajwe ishinga no kurwana intambara zishingiye ku myemerere, ugasanga barwanira abayoboke kurusha uko bwaranira kwigisha ukuri kw’ijambo ry’Imana. Agaruka no ku bibazo bigaragara mu muryango ariko bitavugwaho rumwe, nk’ibijyanye no kwihorera, gusenda abagore, kuboneza urubyaro n’ibindi. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE, Padiri Amerika yavuze ko yagize igitekerezo cyo kwandika iki gitabo nyuma yo kwegerwa na bamwe mu bakiristu ayoboye akumva ibibazo bakunze kumubaza bigaragaza ko hari ibyo badasobanukiwe. Yabihereye kandi mu gace paruwasi ayobora iherereyemo kabonekamo amadini menshi ariko ugasanga ashishikajwe no gushaka abayoboke asebya andi aho kwigisha ukuri kw’ijambo ry’Imana kuboneka muri Bibiliya. Ati “Muri iki gihe abantu benshi baremera, dufite amadini atandukanye dusengeramo ugasanga umuntu yabaye uw’idini kuruta kuba uw’ukuri, agatsimbarara kuri bya bindi bemera ariko atanabisobanukiwe.” Yakomeje agira ati “Igitabo cyanjye ntabwo ari igitabo cy’idini, ni igitabo nanditse nk’umuntu uri mu buzima bw’iyobokamana ariko cyakwifashishwa n’abantu bose.” Padiri Amerika nko ku kijyanye no kuboneza urubyaro, agaragaza ko hari abagendera ku mugambo aboneka muri Bibiliya avuga ngo “Mubyare mwororoke mungane n’umusenyi wo ku Nyanja”. Yavuze ko nubwo Bibiliya ivuga ityo, Aburahamu ufatwa nka sekuruza w’abemera bose yabyaye abana umunani gusa mu gihe cye bishingiye ku bushobozi n’inshingano yari afite. Ibyo bijyanye n’andi magambo yo muri  Bibiliya, mu ibaruwa ya kabiri Pawulo intumwa yandikiye abanyakolenti, 12:14 handitse ngo “ si abana bateganyiriza ababyeyi ahubwo ni ababyeyi bateganyiriza abana babo.” Padiri Amerika agaragaza ko  iyo ngingo  yereka umubyeyi ko kubyara ari uburenganzira n’inshingano. Ati “Byara uwo ushoboye kurera, utazaba interagahinda akurushye, arushye n’igihugu.” Muri iki gitabo kandi umwanditsi agaruka ku buhanuzi bweze muri iki gihe cyane cyane ubujyanye n’igihe isi izarangirira. Yabwiye IGIHE ko ntawe ukwiriye guhanura iby’irangira ry’isi atarayishyizeho, ko  bikwiriye guharirwa Imana ari nayo yaremye. Yifuza ko uzasoma iki gitabo asobanukirwa n’imyemerere ye ndetse n’itandukaniro n’iy’abandi ariko byose bikaba ibiganisha ku kubana neza n’abandi aho gushwana. Ati “Tureke kuba abantu b’idini, ntabwo idini ari ishyaka. Ishyaka rya mbere ni ukurwanirira kubana neza n’abandi , kugira ngo mugenzi wawe akugirireho umugisha nawe umugirireho umugisha.” Musenyeri wa Diyosezi ya Kabgayi, Smaragde Mbonyintege ni we wanditse ijambo ry’ikaze ry’iki gitabo. Mbonyintege mu ijambo ry’ikaze, yavuze ko iki gitabo kije gukemura impaka z’urudaca ku myumvire ya Bibiliya mu matorerro atandukanye. Ati “Impaka z’urudaca ku myumvire ya Bibiliya duhuriyeho
n’andi matorero ndetse no ku Masakramentu bamwe mu
banyamatorero bakunze kugoreka imyumvire, umwanditsi
yabiboneye ibisubizo ku buryo bwumvikana.” Yongeyeho  ati “ Iki gitabo ndagishimira ko kitagamije kwinjira mu mpaka n’abagoreka ibyo twigisha, ahubwo gufasha mbere na mbere abakristu bacu gusobanukirwa mu mpaka z’ababarundaho ibisobanuro biyobya.” Iki gitabo kizamurikwa kuri uyu wa Gatanu i Kigali kuri Hotel St Famille, guhera saa kumi n’igice z’umugoroba.

title: Ububiko bw’amateka: Umudugudu wa Nyirabwana wahoze ari igicumbi cy’ingoma y’u Bwanacyambwe
content: Muri iki gice, tugiye kubatekerereza bimwe mu bimenyetso ndangamateka, bigaragaza imiterere y’imwe mu misozi y’u Rwanda rwo hambere, rutaraturwa ngo rube insinsiro zisakayemo abantu. Nkuko tubikesha igitabo “Imizi y’u Rwanda’’ n’igitabo “Intwari z’imbanza, zubatse u Rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro’’, byombi dukesha umwanditsi n’umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, tugiye gutekerereza hamwe amateka y’umudugudu wa Nyirabwana wo mu Kagali ka Kibagabaga mu Murenge wa Kimironko ho mu Karere ka Gasabo ahahoze ari ingoma ngabe y’igihugu cy’u Bwanacyambwe mu bihe byo hambere. Hariho nka kimwe mu bimenyetso bibitse amateka akomeye agaragaza imiterere y’igihugu cy’u Bwanacyambwe mbere y’uko gihangwamo igihugu, n’ikimenyetso kigaragaza bene cyo uburyo bakuturanyije bakagitunganya kikaba igihugu kiganje. Ubu butaka butaraba igihugu cy’u Bwanacyambwe bwari ubutaka bw’imigina n’ibishanga by’imifunzo by’amasanzure y’umugezi wa Nyabugogo n’Akagera, n’ikiyaga cya Mugesera. Mu bihe byo hambere, igihugu cy’u Bwanacyambwe cyari gikikijwe n’ingoma y’i Gisaka cy’Abagesera b’Abazirankende mu Burasirazuba, Gasabo y’Abanyiginya  mu Majyaruguru, Nduga y’Ababanda mu Burengerazuba bw’Amajyepfo, u Buliza bw’Abongera mu Majyaruguru y’u Burengerazuba n’ingoma y’u Bugesera bw’Abahondogo yari mu Majyepfo. Igihugu cy’u Bwanacyambwe kimwe n’icy’u Buliza, byagengwaga n’Ibikomangoma by’Abongera, bakomoka kuri Mwongera wa Rurenge Sekuruza wabo. Aho cyari giherereye kugeza ubwo aya mateka yandikwaga, ni mu Karere ka Nyarugenge, Akarere ka Kicukiro, Akarere ka Gasabo y’Amajyepfo (Mu Mirenge ya Gisozi, Kinyinya, Kimihurura, Remera na Kimironko) hamwe n’Akarere ka Rwamagana y’Iburengerazuba (Mu mirenge ya Karenge, Nyakariro, Nzige, Muyumbu na Gahengeri). Amacishirizo y’ihangwa ry’icyo gihugu, akaba agaragaza ko cyahanzwe mu mizo ya mbere y’iyaguka ry’ibihugu byagengwaga n’Abasinga b’Abasangwabutaka, aho cyahanzwe ahasaga mu wa 450, nyuma ya Yezu Kirisitu. Mu ihangwa ry’igihugu cy’u Bwanacyambwe, ryanzuwe n’umuhungu wa Rurenge witwaga Mwongera n’umugore we w’inkundwakazi Nyirabwanacyambwe, ari na we wakurijweho kwitirirwa icyo gihugu kikitwa’’ u Bwanacyambwe’. Agasozi gakuru ari nako kabarwa nk’ubutaka gakondo bw’Abongera, kitwaga  Nyirabwanacyambwe, niko ubu kabumbye imidugudu ya Nyirabwana, Ramiro, Rindiro na Kageyo yo mu Kagali ka Kibagabaga, mu Murenge wa Kimironko wo mu Karere ka Gasabo. Ingoma ngabe y’Abongera ikaba yari itetse mu Mudugudu wa Nyirabwana ( Nyirabwanacyambwe) wiswe izina ry’impine, aho kuryuzuza ngo witwe ’’Nyirabwanacyambwe". Nyuma y’imyaka amagana, ingoma ngabe yaje  kwimurirwa mu Mudugudu wa Amahoro mu Kagali ka Rukiri II mu Murenge wa Remera wo mu Karere ka Gasabo ko mu Mujyi wa Kigali, ari naho hashyiriweho iherezo ryayo ubwo u Bwanacyambwe bwatsindwaga n’u Rwanda mu gitero cyagabwe na Kigeli Mukobanya ahasaga mu wa 1378, akivugana Nkuba ya Nyabakonjo watwaraga u Bwanacyambwe muri ibyo bihe. Ubutaka bw’Umudugudu wa Nyirabwana, ni kimwe mu bimenyetso karundura, kigaragaza ko ingoma y’u Bwanacyambwe yabayeho, kandi ikagaragaza n’inkomoko y’iryo zina, n’aho yatangiriye mu bwaguke bwayo.

title: Umusozi wa Kigali wasabirwagaho kugira Umutima w’u Rwanda
content:
Umusozi wa Kigali n’Igenamigambi ry’ingoma inye (Ubu twagereranya na Vision 2020 cyangwa 2050).
 Kumenya icyerekezo cy’u Rwanda mu myaka ijana  ni byo bitwereka  neza icyo ubusugire n’ubwigenge by’u Rwanda gakondo  byari  bisobanuye, bityo  na none tukabasha  no  gusobanukirwa neza  n’icyari ku mutima (Philosophie) w’abakurambere baremye u Rwanda bakarwubaka, bakarurwanira ndetse  benshi  bakanarupfira. Aha tugiye kubona ko ubusugire n’imibereho myiza y’Abanyawanda ku ngoma eshatu bwategurwaga n’Abami bitwa Mutara na Cyilima mbereho nk’ imyaka ijana. Nk’uko musanzwe mubizi, mu mazina y’Abami atanu yasimburanaga mu bihe bine yakurikiranaga atya: Mutara, Kigeli, Mibambwe, Yuhi na Cyilima. Aha biragaragara neza ko hagati ya Mutara na Cyilima hacagamo Ingoma eshatu mbere y’uko Cyilima atangiza ikindi cyiciro cy’Abami. Inshingano z’abami Kigeli na Mibambwe zabaga ari ukwagura u Rwanda kuko ku ngoma eshatu zabaga zarabanje Inka n’Abantu byabaga byaragwiriye bityo hakaba haragombaga kuboneka uruhumekero habayeho kwagura ubutaka bw’igihugu. Yuhi  yari ashinzwe imihango y’i Bwami cyane cyane Umuriro waho utarazimaga ukaba wararangaga ubusugire bw’igihugu. Aha murumva ko Yuhi yari ashinzwe gutunganya ibijyanye n’ubusugire bw’igihugu n’ibijyanye n’imiyoborere myiza kimwe n’Iyobokamana kugira ngo abandi bami bane babone urufatiro rukomeye bazubakiraho. Ubwo hari aho bitaniye cyane n’ibikorwa ubu mu igenamigambi rirerire? Yaba Yuhi, Kigeli na Mibambwe uko ari batatu babanzirizwaga kandi bagaherukwa na Mutara cyangwa na Cyilima. Musenyeri Kagame yaragaragaje ko mu Rwanda Ingoma eshatu zamaraga imyaka 100 kuko buri yose yari imyaka yegereye 33. Mbese ni ukuvugako kuva Mutara cyangwa Cyilima batanze kugera hongera kwima undi Mutara cyangwa undi Cyilima; muri rusange habaga hashize imyaka 100.  Umuhango wo kwaka Umutima w’Ingoma 
 Mutara na Cyilima bari Abami b’Inka kandi bagombaga kugira umuhango ukomeye wo mu Bwiru bakoraga ujyanye n’icyerekezo cy’u Rwanda mu ngoma eshatu zigiye gukurikiraho. Niwo  mu Bwiru bita “Inzira y’Ishora”. Hari umuhango baheragaho wo kuvugurura Ingoma z’ibwami nka Kalinga, Cyimumugizi, Kiragutse na Mpatsibihugu.  Barebaga niba mu myaka hafi ijana ishize nta kibazo izo ngoma zagize kugira ngo bibaye ngombwa babe basisazura cyangwa se ngo bazisimbuze izindi. Iyo basangaga izo ngoma zikiri nzima cyangwa bagasanga zigomba gusimbuzwa; byanze bikunze bagombaga kuziha icyo bitaga “kuziha imitima mishya”. Iyo mihango yo kubonera Ingoma z’ingabe  imitima, imwe bayikoreraga ahitwa i Karama ku murwa wa Kigali hariya ku musozi  wa Mont Kigali aho bavuga ko mu mirwa yose y’Abami  umurwa wa Kigali  ari wo wari Imfura y’imirwa yose y’Abami. Aho i Karama bahajyaga baje kuhatora imitima y’Ingoma z’ingabe arizo Cyiragutse, Cyimumugizi, Mpatsibihugu na Kalinga. Mu gihe ingoma Kalinga yari Ingabe y’ubwami bw’u Rwanda, ziriya zindi uko ari eshatu zo bigaragara ko zari ingabe za buri mwami muri bariya Bami batatu bari hagati ya Mutara na Cyilima.  Bishoboka ko Cyiragutse ari ingabe ya Mibambwe maze Mpatsibihugu ikaba iya Kigeli bitewe n’uko bose bari bashinzwe kwagura u Rwanda nk’uko amazina y’izo ngoma abigaragaza. Cyimumugizi ikaba ingabe ya Yuhi kuko ariwe wari ushinzwe imihango y’ubwami bw’u Rwanda nk’uko na none izina ryayo ribigaragaza. Ibi rero ubona bimeze nka bya bindi by’Umwami Salomo wo muri Bibiliya igihe yajyaga gutambira ku musozi wa Gabaon nk’uko tubisoma mu 2 Abami 3:1-14. Ubwo Salomo yariho atamba Imana yaramubonekeye imubwira kuyisaba icyo ashaka maze Salomo ayisaba ubwenge kugira ngo agire ubushishozi bwo kuyobora ishyanga rya Israel. Uriya muhango wa Salomo wo gusaba Imana ubwenge (Umutima) bari ku musozi muremure nk’uwa Kigali urasa cyane n’ibyo Abiru b’i Rwanda bakoraga bafatanije n’Umwami nk’uko tugiye kubibona. Iyo rero Abiru n’abandi banyamihango bageraga ku murwa wa Kigali babaga bazanye:  Umutsobe w’isugi, Umukobwa w’isugi n’Umwenenyabirungu w’isugi, bakazana amata, inzoga n’imbuto bagatereka aho. Hanyuma rero bendaga ya mata na za nzoga bagakozamo icyuhagiro icyarimwe bakuhagira igiti cy’umurama (ngo gitere uburame) babaga bazanye maze Umutsobe mukuru agapfukama agasenga avuga aya magambo:   Gahorane Imana Kigali.
           Tuje kwenda imitima y’ingoma
           Ngo Umwami mu Rwanda agire umutima
           Ingoma mu Rwanda zigire umutima
          Abagabo mu Rwanda bagire umutima
          Abagore  mu Rwanda bagire umutima
          Inka mu Rwanda zigire umutima
         U Rwanda rwose rugire umutima. Aha murabona ko niba Ingoma y’Ingabe y’u Rwanda ari yo Kalinga iyo ibonye Umutima ugereranya Ubwenge n’Ubushishozi, Umwami wayimye nawe aba abonye umutima. Na none Ingoma z’Abami ari zo Cyimumugizi, Kiragutse na Mpatsibihugu iyo zibonye umutima, ni ubutegetsi bw’imyaka ijana bw’Abami Kigeli, Mibambwe na Yuhi burangwa n’umutima. Uwo mutima rero ni wo ugera mu baturage no mu nka. Ibyo birangira ari u Rwanda rwose rubonye umutima kugira ngo rubone kuba umurame. Ibyo bimeze nk’uko Umwami Salomo yasabye ubwenge Imana ikamushima ikamubwira ko izamuha n’ibyo atasabye nko kurama, ubukire, amahoro no kunesha abanzi bitewe n’uko yahisemo neza. Ibyo Imana yamusezeranyije byose bimeze nk’ibyo Abanyarwanda bizeraga kubona bamaze kubona Umutima w’Ingoma. Dore uko uduce tw’ubwiru dukurikira tubivuga:  Uri umurame umwami abe umurame
       Ingoma mu Rwanda zibe umurame 
       Abagabo b’i Rwanda babe umurame
       Abagore b’iRwanda babe umurame
      Inka mu Rwanda zibe umurame
       U Rwanda rwose  rube umurame Nyuma rero yo kubona umutima no kubona uburame; ibyo ntabwo byari  bihagije  kuko  u Rwanda rwose rwagombaga  kuzira ubusembwa, kuvogerwa  no guhumana  ari byo bishushanywa na ba bantu b’amasugi bazanye. Ubusanzwe umuntu w’isugi ni umuntu ugifite ababyeyi bombi cyangwa umukobwa utarasambanyijwe. Muri ya masengesho y’Umutsobe mukuru yakomezaga agira ati:  Aya ni amasugi umwami abe isugi
      Ingoma i Rwanda zibe amasugi
     Abagabo i Rwanda babe amasugi
     Abagore mu Rwanda babe amasugi
     Inka i Rwanda zibe amasugi
    U Rwanda rwose ruhorane amasugi
 Usibye imihango yo mu bwiru yo gusabira u Rwanda rwose umutima, uburame n’ubusugire, mu magambo amwe n’ayo tubonye hejuru, na none icyerekezo cyari ukugira ubuhoro (amahoro) mu Rwanda rw’Umwami.   Umwami w’i Rwanda agira ubuhoro
  Ingoma z’i Rwanda zigira ubuhoro,
  Abagabo b’i Rwanda bagira ubuhoro
  Abagore b’i Rwanda bagira ubuhoro
  Inka z’i Rwanda zigira ubuhoro
  U Rwanda rwose rugira ubuhoro Nyuma y’ibyo byose u Rwanda rukagira uburumbuke bw’amata, ubuki n’inturire.  Ibyo nabyo babivugaga mu mugambo ahwanye n’ayo hejuru bati  Ng’aya amata n’ubuki
Kugira ngo Umwami agire amata n’ubuki
Ingoma mu Rwanda zigire amata nubuki 
Abagabo bagire amata n’ubuki 
Abagore bagire amata n’ubuki 
Inka mu Rwanda zigire amata n’ubuki. Nyuma y’ibi, hazaga amasengesho yo gucyamura (gukebura) amahanga yose adatura umwami w’u Rwanda. Dore amagambo bavugaga muri ubwo Bwiru:   Twacyamura u Burundi ku ngoma
    Twacyamura u Bushubi ku ngoma
   Twacyamura u Bunyabungo ku ngoma
   Amahanga yose adatura umwami w’u Rwanda
   Twayacyamura Ibi twabigereranya na diporomasi y’ubu iba igamije  gutuma amahanga yandi ayoboka iby’igihugu cyawe. Amahame remezo y’u Rwanda gakondo
 Iyi  mihango yakorwaga n’Abami bitwa Mutara na Cyilima hari ibintu idusobanurira neza bigatuma tumenya  Ihame-ngengabitekerezo ryubatse u Rwanda rikaruha Indangagaciro. Ihame-ngengabitekerezo ni ryo soko y’ibikorwa n’imyitwarire by’umuntu cyangwa by’ikigo biturukamo. Ni yo mpamvu nta muntu, nta kigo, nta shyaka nta n’ishyanga byabaho bidafite Ihame-ngenga-bitekerezo ababigize bagenderaho.  Ku gihugu Ihame-ngengabitekerezo ni ryo rigena kandi rikagenga Indangagaciro na Kirazira by’igihugu! None abakurambere baturaze u Rwanda barwubatse babikuye ku rihe hame-ngengabitekerezo ukurikije ibyo tumaze kubona? Ihame-ngengabitekerezo rya mbere ryagenaga kandi rikagenga ibyo mu Rwanda byose; ni iritumenyesha icyo u “Rwanda rwose” ari cyo: “u Rwanda rwose” ntabwo ari ubutaka bwose bw’aho twita mu Rwanda gusa; ahubwo ni ahantu hari: Ingoma-Umwami -Abagabo -Abagore-Inka. Ibi rero ni nabyo byerekana ibyo twabonye by’Ibanga ry’Umwami n’Ingoma, n’Ibanga ry’Inka n’Ingabo. Aha icya mbere kigomba kumvikana mu Ihame ngenga-bitekerezo ry’abahanze u Rwanda,  ni uko ahantu hose ku isi hari kuba haboneka Umwami wimye Ingoma-ngabe yahawe umutima, hakaboneka Abagabo n’Abagore ndetse n’Inka, habashaga  kuboneka  u “Rwanda rwose.”Kimwe n’uko ibyo byose uwari kubivana ku butaka bw’u Rwanda haba hatakaje kuba “u Rwanda rwose.” Impamvu ni ko ikihagira u Rwanda rwose ari izi ndangagaciro z’Abanyarwanda zihari tuzi ko izo ndangagaciro zari zubakiye ku Mana, Inka n’Ingoma. Nk’uko Umwami   yabaga ahatswe n’Ingoma maze Ingabo (Abaturage) nazo zikaba zihatswe n’Umwami; ni nako u Rwanda rwose rwabaga ruhatswe n’Imana bitewe n’uko Ingoma yimye u Rwanda ari Imana yayihaye umutima. Nk’uko Inka ihaka isabwa kubyara icyo ihatse; ni nako Imana ihatse u Rwanda na yo isabwa guhora irubyara (irugoboka). Burya mu Kinyarwanda ijambo“gusenga” risobanuye gukesha byose uguhatse! Ni yo mpamvu usanga n’isengesho gakondo ryo gusabira u Rwanda na ryo ari ibyo ryabaga ryerekejeho. Nimwongere murebe amagambo arigize: Seka seka gasani k’i Rwanda 
Rusekere rugubwe neza
Rusenderezemo amahoro n’amahe
Rutsindire ubukenya n’ubugingo buke
Rutsindire ubusame n’ubusharire
Rutsindire icyago n’icyagane
Rutsindire nyamunsi n’intumwa yayo 
Rutsindire umwanzi wo mu kirambi
N’umurozi uvuka ishyanga
Garika ibiganza utugabire 
Rugaba, Rugabo, Rwagisha
Maze twishyuke mu Rwanda umu.  Ihame-ngengabitekerezo ry’abahanze u Rwanda ni ukugira Ishyanga aho Umwami yima Ingoma-ngabe yahawe umutima (ubushishozi) n’Imana, maze ingoma (reigns) zikagira umutima (ubushishozi) bigatuma Ingabo z’Umwami (Abagabo n’Abagore) nabo bagira umutima  uzagera no ku nka na zo zikagira umutima (wo gukamwa no konsa izazo). Murabona neza ko uru ari uruhererekane rw’Umutima uva ku MANA ukagera mu Mwami unyuze mu NGOMA-NGABE maze ukarangiriza mu NKA unyuze mu ngabo (Abagabo n’Abagore). Uru ruhererekane kandi ni rwo rwahoze rukoze “umutima w’u Rwanda rwose”. Byongeye kandi u Rwanda rwose iyo rwabaga rubonye umutima; ni byo na none byateraga igihugu kugira uburame, ubusugire, ubuhoro n’uburumbuke ndetse no kugarura amahanga adatura u Rwanda. Ibi rero abakurambere bacu bakoraga kera ngo bahorane Umutima w’u Rwanda (w’Ubunyarwanda) n’ubu mpamya ko bikenewe. Kubura uwo umutima w’u Rwanda, w’ubunyarwanda ni byo byatumye abanyarwanda bishora mu mahano ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ngo na Ruganzu Ndoli amaze kubohora u Rwanda amacakubiri yatumye rugirwa ingaruzwamuheto imyaka irenga icumi, yatangiye yigisha umutima w’u Rwanda. Arwanya ba mutima-nda, mutima-rwana, mutima-muke, agakunda cyane mitimi-igwanye (ihuje). Ese ubu abo ba mutima-nda sibo batumye u Rwanda rutabohoka burundu?  Imana tugira ni uko “imiyaga isubiza inyuma indege itwaye abanyarwanda itayibuza kugera iyo ijya” nk’uko Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika aherutse kubyibutsa Abanyarwanda bo mu Rwanda rutugendamo! Naho ibidindiza Ndi Umunyarwanda byo ubanza dukwiye kubirebera mu mizi yabyo mikuru twitabaje amahame-remezo yagengaga ishyaka ry’u Rwanda n’Abanyarwanda. Ibitekerezo bya Gérard Nyirimanzi na Nyirishema Célestin, Abacukumbuzi b’Ireme ry’Umuco n’Amateka by’u Rwanda. Babikuye mu Ubwiru, Inzira y’Ishora, vers 279-310.

title: Village Urugwiro, inyubako y’amateka akomeye mu Rwanda
content: Ni inyubako y’amateka kuko abagera kuri 50 % by’Abanyarwanda bariho bavutse iriho, iganje ku Kacyiru, mu Karere ka Gasabo mu Mujyi wa Kigali aho imaze imyaka 44. Yubatswe mu 1975 n’Umuryango wahuzaga Ibihugu bya Afurika cyane cyane ibyakolonijwe n’u Bufaransa n’ibikoresha Igifaransa, Organization Commune Africaine et Malgache (OCAM). Uwo muryango kuri ubu wazimye, u Rwanda rwawinjiyemo mu 1965. Mu 1975, nibwo rwari kwakira inama yawo yagombaga kwitabirwa n’abakuru b’ibihugu bagera kuri 15. Byari ihurizo rikomeye ku gihugu nk’u Rwanda cyari gifite hoteli nke zitwa ko zikomeye  nka Mille Collines na Diplomate zari zigezweho icyo gihe ariko zifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira abashyitsi baringaniye. Muri icyo gihe u Rwanda rwiteguraga kwakira inama, inyubako za mbere za Village Urugwiro zubatswe ku mafaranga ya OCAM nkuko Rucagu Boniface, umwe mu bagize Urwego Ngishwanama rw’Inararibonye yabibwiye IGIHE. Inama ya OCAM irangiye, inyubako za Village Urugwiro  zeguriwe Leta y’u Rwanda nayo izihinduramo hoteli yakiraga abifite muri ibyo bihe. Nubwo Village Urugwiro yabaye hoteli, mu gihe u Rwanda rwabaga rwakiriye inama zikomeye yakomezaga kwifashishwa mu kwakira abashyitsi ba Leta. Urugero ni tariki 21 na 22 Gicurasi 1979 ubwo u Rwanda rwakiraga inama ya Gatandatu ihuza u Bufaransa na Afurika yanitabiriwe na Perezida wari uyoboye u Bufaransa icyo gihe, Valéry Marie René Georges Giscard d’Estaing. Mbere y’uko iyo nama iba, u Bufaransa bwari bwatanze amafaranga yo kwagura Village Urugwiro no kuyivugurura kugira ngo ijye ku rwego rwo kwakira inama ikomeye nk’iyo, nkuko biri mu nyandiko z’ibanga za Ambasade ya Amerika mu Rwanda muri icyo gihe, zashyizwe hanze na WikiLeaks. Uwo mwaka ni nabwo hubatswe hoteli Novotel Umubano (Marasa Umubano Hotel kuri ubu) nabwo ku mafaranga yatanzwe n’u Bufaransa. Rucagu avuga ko nyuma yo kwagura Village Urugwiro, yasigaye igizwe n’inyubako (appartments)  zisaga 20 zirimo amacumbi agezweho, ibyumba by’inama n’ibindi. Amacumbi y’abadepite, ibiro bidahoraho bya Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana amaze gufata ubutegetsi mu 1973, yahise asesa Inteko Ishinga Amategeko. Yongeye kuyisubizaho mu 1981, abadepite ba mbere 70 b’inzibacyuho batangira imirimo mu 1982. Kubera ubuke bw’amacumbi muri Kigali, Leta yemereye buri mudepite icumbi muri Village Urugwiro dore ko abenshi babaga baturuka mu bice bya kure badashobora gukora bataha iwabo. Mu 1983 habaye amatora y’abadepite, Rucagu Boniface aba umwe muri bo ubwo yatangiraga imirimo mu 1984 na we ahabwa icumbi muri Village Urugwiro. Umudepite yahabwaga icumbi gusa, ibyo kurya akimenya. Rucagu avuga ko mu badepite 70, abasaga 40 babaga muri Village Urugwiro kuko babaga baturuka mu bice bya kure. Uwabaga yifitiye inzu i Kigali, yayibagamo Leta ikamugenera amafaranga y’icumbi. Rucagu ati “Uwabaga yifitiye inzu ye bamuhaga amafaranga ariko babanje kubyanga bavuga bati kuki mushaka kurara mu nzu zanyu kandi twarabageneye iza Leta, baraburana ariko byaje gukemuka nyuma.” Icyo gihe abadepite babamo, inzu zasagukaga zakomezaga kuba ibyumba bya hoteli bisanzwe, abashaka kubiraramo bakaza kwishyura. Nubwo hari hoteli n’amacumbi y’abadepite, Perezida Habyarimana na we yahashyize ibiro ariko akajya abizamo rimwe na rimwe kuko ibiro nyamukuru byari mu mujyi rwagati, ahubatse Ibiro by’Umujyi wa Kigali ubu. Rucagu ati “Iruhande rw’izo nzu haruguru y’ahahoze reception niho hari Ibiro by’Umukuru w’Igihugu. Muri izo nzu zose ahagana ku rwinjiriro yari yarafashemo inzu y’ibiro bye, izindi zose zikomeza kuba hoteli. Yari ibiro bya kabiri yazagamo nka rimwe cyangwa kabiri mu kwezi.” Buri nyubako (apartment) muri izo zari zigize Hotel Village Urugwiro yabaga ifite icyiciro runaka ibarizwamo. Rucagu wahabaye mu gihe cy’imyaka 10 ari umudepite, avuga ko buri nyubako yabaga ifite ibyumba bitatu, ni ukuvuga A, B na C. Icyumba A, cyabaga gifite ibyangombwa nkenerwa byose birimo uruganiriro, uburiri, ubwiherero, igikoni,  harimo  frigo n’ibindi, kikaba kigenewe Umukuru w’Igihugu mu gihe habaye inama cyangwa undi muntu wo ku rwego rwo hejuru wakirayemo. Hafi y’icyo cyumba nyamukuru, habaga ikindi bise B, kikararamo umuganga w’umuntu mukuru waraye muri A. Ni ukuvuga ko niba haraye Perezida, muri B hararaga umuganga we naho muri C hakarara abarinzi be. Mu  gihe habaga habaye inama zikomeye, abadepite bari barahawe amacumbi muri Village Urugwiro basabwaga kuvamo bakazagaruka inama yarangiye. Rucagu ati “Batumenyeshaga mbere y’ukwezi, tukavamo bakahakoropa, bakahasukura bakavanamo umwanda wose, tukazagaruka baragiye. Ubwo mu mirimo y’Inteko twariyeranjaga.” Village Urugwiro yakomeje kuba hoteli kugeza mu 1994 muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.  Jenoside imaze guhagarikwa, muri Nyakanga uwo mwaka Leta y’Ubumwe imaze kurahira Village Urugwiro aho kuba ibiro bidahoraho by’Umukuru w’Igihugu, yahindutse Ibiro byuzuye by’iminsi yose by’Umukuru w’Igihugu kugeza ubu.

title: Ikinyarwanda cyahawe intebe muri Miss Rwanda 2020, urundi rurimi ruzakoreshwa ku bushake bw’uhatana
content: Abifuza guhatanira ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2020 bashyiriweho ibyo bagomba kuba bujuje nkuko byatangajwe na Rwanda Inspiration Back Up isanzwe itegura iri rushanwa. Amabwiriza cyangwa ibisabwa kugira ngo umukobwa abashe kwiyandikisha muri Miss Rwanda ni;  Kuba ari Umunyarwandakazi  Kuba afite imyaka hagati ya 18 na 24  Kuba yararangije amashuri yisumbuye  Kuba avuga neza Ikinyarwanda. (Kuba azi urundi rurimi rwiyongera ku rurimi kavukire mu zemewe n’amategeko mu Rwanda nabyo biremewe)  Kuba afite uburebure guhera kuri 1,70 m  Kuba afite BMI iri hagati ya 18.5 na 24.9  Kuba atarigeze abyara  Kuba yiteguye kuguma mu Rwanda byibuze mu gihe cy’umwaka nyuma yo gutorwa nka Nyampinga  Ntagomba gushyingirwa cyangwa gushinga urugo mu gihe akiri Nyampinga  Kuba yiteguye guhagararira u Rwanda ahantu hose n’igihe cyose abisabwe cyangwa biri ngombwa  Kuba yiteguye gukurikiza no kubahiriza amahame yose n’amabwiriza agenga ba Nyampinga Nyuma yo kunyuza amaso muri ibi bisabwa umukobwa ugiye kwiyandikisha muri Miss Rwanda 2020, twasanze umukobwa asabwa kuba azi Ikinyarwanda mu gihe kumenya urundi rurimi byaba akarusho. Bitandukanye n’ibyakorwaga mbere. Ubusanzwe mu mategeko y’irushanwa bavugaga ko umukobwa agomba kuba azi Ikinyarwanda n’urundi rurimi muri eshatu z’amahanga zemewe mu Rwanda. Umuyobozi wa Rwanda Inspiration Back Up, Ishimwe Dieudonne, yabwiye IGIHE ko aribyo koko iryo bwiriza ryahinduwe. Ati ”Ni mu rwego rwo guha agaciro ururimi rwacu ariko nanone no gufasha umukobwa kwisobanura uko ashaka mu gihe umushinga we waba uri mu rurimi kavukire.” Yakomeje agira ati ”Indimi z’amahanga ntabwo tuzikuyeho ariko noneho ntabwo tubujije n’utazizi, abakobwa bose bahawe amahirwe. Ikinyarwanda ni cyo cy’ingenzi, izindi ndimi zizakoreshwa ku mahitamo y’uhatana.” Prince Kid yavuze ko mu gutanga amanota hazitabwa cyane kubyo umukobwa avuga, ubwiza ndetse n’umuco. Ubusanzwe umukobwa yasabwaga kuba azi Ikinyarwanda n’urundi rurimi rumwe rw’amahanga, uburyo abahatana bitwaraga mu ndimi z’amahanga byatumye benshi bibaza impamvu abategura Miss Rwanda bazibandaho nyamara hashobora gukoreshwa ururimi kavukire, aha bagaraazaga ko icyingenzi ari ikiri mu muntu atari ururimi akivugamo. Umwe mu bagize icyo bavuga ku ikoreshwa ry’indimi z’amahanga ni Ange Kagame,ubwo hasozwaga Miss Rwanda 2019 yagaragaje ko gukoresha Ikinyarwanda gusa muri iri rushanwa byaba bihagije. Icyo gihe yagize ati ”Kuvuga mu Kinyarwanda byaba bihagije. Mu irushanwa rya Miss Universe baba bafite abasemuzi, basobanurira abatavuga Icyongereza, wakongeraho ibibazo ubwabyo bibajijwe mu Cyongereza cya ntacyo”. Igitekerezo cya Ange Kagame cyakiriwe neza n’abamukurikira kuri Twitter, urebye uburyo abategura irushanwa babihinduye basa n’abemeranya neza n’ibitekerezo bya benshi bifuzaga ko Miss Rwanda yajya ikorwa mu Kinyarwanda gusa. Reba hano igitekerezo cyari cyatanzwe na Ange Kagame ku irushanwa rya Miss Rwanda Speaking Kinyarwanda should suffice. Miss Universe pageants have translators for the contestants that don’t speak English. PLUS, the questions themselves are poorly worded in poor english. 😞 — Ange.I. Kagame (@AngeKagame) January 26, 2019

title: Imiryango yahamije ibigwi mu mateka y’u Rwanda: Igicumbi cy’umuryango w’umwami Ndoba
content: Ni imiryango yagiye igira amaboko akomeye kubera kugira imiryango migari igizwe n’abantu benshi kandi bagwije ubugabo igitinyiro n’ubuhangange. Muri iki gice tukaba tugiye kubatekerereza amateka y’igicumbi cy’umuryango mugari ufite inkomoko ku mwami Ndoba, iki kikaba ari igice gikurikiraho mu bindi bizakurikiraho mu kubatekerereza imbumbe y’imiryango migari yabayemo ibihangange ikanagira n’inzu zikomeye mu mateka y’u Rwanda. Nk’uko tubikesha igitabo “Iyororoka ry’Abanyarwanda, inkomoko y’imiryango migari ’’ dukesha Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, inzobere mu Busizi, umuco n’amateka y’u Rwanda, tugiye kwinjira mu muryango mugari w’abakomoka kwa Ndoba, mu mavu n’amavuko yawo n’inzu z’ibihangange zawukomotseho. Ndoba ni mwene Ndahiro Ruyange rwa Yuhi Musindi, umwami wo mu mu muryango mugari w’Abanyiginya na Monde ya Gahutu, ukomoka mu muryango mugari w’Abega, yategetse ahasaga  mu wa 1213 kugeza mu wa 1246. Ni umwami wa 5 mu bami 28 bategetse u Rwanda, akaba n’umwami wa 5 mu Berekeza 34 b’umushinga wo kubaka u Rwanda. Umwami Ndoba ni umwe mu Bami b’u Rwanda bagize inzu z’imiryango nyinshi ugereranyije n’abandi bami, akaba ari na we wagize inzu z’imiryango ntabarika mu bami bose bamubanjirije n’abamuherutse. Ndoba, yakomotsweho n’inzu z’imiryango zigera kuri  13 zabaye ibihangange mu mu muryango mugari w’Abanyiginya kugeza ubwo aya mateka yandikwaga na n’ubu akivugwa. Yagize n’imimaro myinshi mu bigaragara mu gushyira mu bikorwa umushinga wo kubaka u Rwanda. Amateka atugaragariza ko Umwami Ndoba ya Ndahiro, yabyaye abana benshi, biganjemo Abahungu 11 aribi Mujiji, Mugunga, Mukobwa, Muturagara, Munyiga, Nyamuhanzi, Mupfumfu, Cyambwe, Biharage, Cyoba na  Neza. Aba bagabo b’Intarumikwa, nibo babaye inkomoko y’inzu z’imiryango zo kwa  Ndoba zikomoka mu muryango mugari w’Abanyiginya. Inzu z’imiryango zikomoka kwa Ndoba ni: Abanyiginya b’ABAJIJI bakomoka kuri MUJIJI wa NDOBA ; Abanyiginya b’ABENEMUGUNGA bakomoka kuri MUGUNGA wa NDOBA; Abanyiginya b’ABAKOBWA bakomoka kuri MUKOBWA wa  NDOBA; Abanyiginya b’ABATURAGARA bakomoka kuri MUTURAGARA wa NDOBA; Abanyiginya b’ABENEMUNYIGA bakomoka kuri MUNYIGA wa NDOBA; Abanyiginya b’ABENENYAMUHANZI bakomoka kuri  NYAMUHANZI ya NDOBA; Abanyiginya b’ABENEMUPFUMFU bakomoka kuri  MUPFUMFU wa NDOBA Abanyiginya b’ABENECYAMBWE bakomoka kuri  CYAMBWE cya  NDOBA Abanyiginya b’ABENEBIHARAGE bakomoka kuri  BIHARAGE bya NDOBA Abanyiginya b’ABENECYOBA bakomoka kuri  CYOBA cya NDOBA Abanyiginya b’ABENENEZA bakomoka kuri  NEZA ya NDOBA Abanyiginya b’ABENEGAHAYA bakomoka kuri GAHAYA ka RWASA rwa TURAGARA , Abanyiginya b’ABATARE bakomoka kuri KAREMERA NTARE RUSATSI  rwa SINZI wa NYAMUHANZI wa NDOBA. Abakomoka muri iyi miryango bararumbutse cyane muri uru Rwanda, ku buryo babumbye hafi kimwe cya kabiri cy’abakomoka mu muryango mugari w’Abanyiginya. Ngaho iyo mwama mukuru wa Ndoba mu mizi yanyu mikuru ( Urabe wumva muntu w’i Rwanda, ibyo nibyo bisekuruza by’iwanyu mu muryango wo kwa Ndoba).

title: Hagiye kuba amarushanwa y’igisoro, umwe mu mikino nyarwanda imaze igihe
content: Igisoro ni umwe mu mikino gakondo yatangiye kumenyekana mu Rwanda mu mwaka wa 1510 ku ngoma y’Umwami Ruganzu II  Ndoli. Ni umukino ukinanwa ubuhanga bwinshi hifashishijwe insoro (zimeze nk’utubumbe duto) bagenda betereka mu twobo twabugenewe. Ni umukino amateka agaragaza ko na Ruganzu Ndoli yawukinnye kuko hirya no hino mu gihugu hari ibimenyetso byamwitiriwe nko ku  bitare bya Mpushi muri Kamonyi ahari igisoro, ikibumbiro, amajanja y’imbwa ze n’intebe yicaragaho. Umuyobozi wa sosiyete Umutsakura yateguye ayo marushanwa, Nshimyumuremyi Justin yabwiye IGIHE ko amarushanwa yatangiye mu Ukwakira uyu mwaka, umukino wa nyuma ukazaba kuwa Gatanu tariki 22 Ugushyingo muri Olympique Hotel ku Kimironko. Ababugu (abakina igisoro) babiri nibo bazaba bahatanira umwanya wa mbere. Nshimyumuremyi  yavuze ko igisoro ari umwe mu mikino y’umwihariko w’abanyarwanda, nyamara udahabwa agaciro kuko ufatwa nk’usuzuguritse. Ati “impamvu yo gukora aya marushanwa ni ukuwusigasira. Usanga indi mikino yarahawe agaciro ariko igisoro basa nk’aho bagisize inyuma kandi ari umwihariko wacu abanyarwanda. Aya marushanwa ni uburyo bwo kugira ngo igisoro cyongere kimenyekane , cyongere gikinwe ndetse mu bihe bizaza nkuko abakina Football ibagirira umumaro n’abakina igisoro boye kujya bitwa inkorabusa cyangwa se abanebwe.” Yongeyeho ko “Hambere igisoro cyari gifatiye abanyarwanda runini. Bagikoreshaga mu mibare . Kubera ko bari bataragira irindi terambere rihambaye, iyo bakinaga barabaraga bati ndazana butatu nkurase burindwi , nongere nzane bune murase 12 […] kumenya iyo mibare rero bigaragaza ubuhanga bari bafite.” Uretse kumenyekanisha uwo mukino, Nshimyumuremyi yavuze ko bashaka no kugikundisha abakiri bato kugira ngo bazagisigasire. Kwinjira muri uyu mukino wa nyuma bizaba ari ubuntu. Uzaba uwa mbere azahembwa ibihumbi 75 Frw, uwa kabiri ahembwe ibihumbi 50 naho  uwa gatatu ahembwe ibihumbi 30 Frw. Biteganyijwe ko hazanakorwa ibindi bikorwa by’umuco birimo indirimbo gakondo, imivugo n’ibisigo, ibyivugo n’ibindi. Abategura aya marushanwa bavuze ko icyifuzo ari uko aya marushanwa yajya ategurwa nibura gatatu mu mwaka ubushobozi buramutse bubonetse.

title: Ibigwi n’ibirindiro by’umwami Kigeli Rwabugili, mu gitero cy’Imigogo (Igice cya mbere)
content: Muri iki gice cy’uruhererekane rw’inkuru twise  “Ibigwi n’ibirindiro’’ Aho tuzajya tubakusanyiriza amateka y’ibihangange byabaye  mu rwa Gasabo bifite ibikorwa bikomeye, tugiye kubavunguriraho gato ku bigwi n’ibirindiro by’umwami Kigeli Rwabugili, dore ko utabikuyeho akamanyu nibura gato gato, utashobora kubiva imuzi ngo ubigere imuzingo. Nk’uko tubikesha igitabo “Intwari z’imbanza, zubatse u Rwanda rugahaya igitinyiro’’ cyanditswe n’Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, inzobere ku Muco, ubusizi n’amateka, tugiye kubatekerereza bimwe mu bigwi n’ibirindiro by’umwami Kigeli Rwabugili, aho tubimburiye ku bigwi bye mu gitero cy’imigogo, na n’ubu kikirahirwa n’amahanga, by’umwihariko abakigabweho b’Abanyankore b’Abahinda. Mu gitero cyiswe icy’Imigogo Rwabugili yagabye muri Nkore, cyabaye mu gihe Abanyaburayi bari batangiye gusesekara muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba ngo bayikoronize, icyo gihe agace k’igihugu cya Uganda Nkore yabarizwagamo kari karatangiye kugendagendwamo n’Abongereza barimo kwiga inzira bazanyuramo batangira kuhakoroniza no kuhasakaza ibikorwa byabo. Mu Rwanda ho bari bakihasunasuna byo kuhatinya kubera amateka yaho y’abayobozi n’abaturage b’indwanyi. Impano za mbere Abongereza bahaye Abanyankore ni imbunda n’amasasu yo kwirwanaho bahashya umwanzi ubashotoye. Zimwe mu mbunda Abanyankore bari bafite ni izo bitaga ‘Makoba’. Izo  mbunda babahaye zigera ku 300 nizo zabashutse batangira kwigerezaho ngo bagiye gutera u Rwanda rwabazengereje imyaka myinshi, dore ko hari ikindi gitero  Rwabugili yari aherutse kubagabaho mu myaka ibiri yari ishize, ni ukuvuga mu wa 1892. Bitewe nuko ibice  byo mu Burasirazuba bw’u Rwanda byari byaramaze  kwigarurirwa burundu n’u Rwanda, icyari kiraje ishinga Rwabugili,  ni ibihugu byo mu Burengerazuba bw’u Rwanda byari bitarigarurirwa ibindi byigaruriwe n’ababanjirije Rwabugili, byaratangiye kwigomeka. Abanyankore bari batangiye kwiga uburyo bagaba ibitero by’ubushotoranyi ku Rwanda, bikaba n’uburyo bwo kubihimuraho kuko bari barabumvishije mu gitero cyaherukaga. Ubushotoranyi bwakozwe na Ntare IV Rugingiza rwa Migereka umwami wa Nkore watwaraga icyo gihe, aho yambutse umupaka aza kunyaga Inyambo z’i Rwanda, agatwika ingoro ya Rwabugili yari i Rutaraka muri Nyagatare. Icyo gihe Rwabugili yari yaragabye ibitero mu Burengerazuba bw’u Rwanda ku Ijwi ryari ryarigometse, arabimenya ko  umwami wa Nkore Ntare Rugingiza rwa Migereka yamuteye akanyaga Inka ze zari Rutaraka muri Nyagatare. Umugenga wazo Kinyamakara cya Ndezi ari na we wayoboraga ingoro ya Rwabugili yari i Rutaraka mu Ndorwa, yari mu ruzinduko, nuko banyaga inka za Rwabugili n’umwe mu baja be barimo Nyiranziza muka Mpore ya Semandira. Umutasi wabanje gutatira Ntare yari  umuhungu we Muhanika wa Ntare. Amakuru y’icyo gitero cy’Abanyankore, Rwabugili yayabariwe n’ umuhima Bukomangando wabaciye mu rihumye akabonera akito kuri ibyo bitero ko kwihakirwa kuri Rwabugili, kuko yari amuziho ubuhangange n’ubudatsindwa. Rwabugili uburakari buramusaba yibaza uko ari bubigenze abifatira ingamba, kuko ntabwo yagombaga kugaruka igitero cyo ku Ijwi atagisoje. Yaje gutegura igitero cyagabwe ku Banyankore muri Gashyantare umwaka wa 1894, cyiswe “Igitero cy’Imigogo” kuko cyitabiriwe n’Imitwe ibiri y’Ingabo z’Abanyankore zitwa: ”Ingogo n’imigogo”. Umwami Kigeli Rwabugili wari i Bunyabungo n’Ingabo ze, yabanje kohereza yo Nyamuhenda wa Kajeje, n’umutwe yari  ayoboye witwaga “ Ibisumizi” . Mu gushyika aho urugerero rw’Abanyankore rwari rukambitse i Kagitumba, Nyamuhenda wa Kajeje yasanze atari ukunyaga Inka gusa, ahubwo biteguye no kurwana. Nyamuhenda n’Ibisumizi, bakabona Abanyankore barimo bohereza mu kirere ibintu biturika byaka umuriro bikabayobera kuko batari bagasobanukirwa n’imikorere y’imbunda zari zadutse vuba muri Afurika. Bitewe nuko gusubira inyuma ku rugamba no kuruhunga bitari mu ndangagaciro z’Abanyarwanda, biyemeje kururwana, nubwo babonaga harimo udushya twinshi turimo n’imbunda zitari zimenyerewe muri aka karere. Icyo gitero  Abanyankore bagabye mu Rwanda, nicyo kiswe mu mateka y’u Rwanda na Nkore “Ehururu ya Rwanda”. Urugamba rwaremeye mu Kibande cya  Ruhumba rwa Kiyojo. Nyamuhenda n’Ibisumizi yari ayoboye, Abanyankore bahabarasira kubamara kuko bo bari bakirwanisha imiheto n’imyambi, abandi bafite imyuko iruka umuriro! Nyamuhenda abonye ko Ingabo zigiye kumushirana, aravunura ahagarika urugamba ajya guhamagaza indi mitwe y’ingabo. Nuko atanga ubutumwa ibukuru aho Rwabugili yari, amutangariza amacumu y’urugamba. Rwabugili yazibiranyijwe n’uburakari butagira ingano, bitewe n’agasuzuguro kangana gutyo Abanyankore basuzuguye u Rwanda none bakaba bagiye no gutsindwa urugamba rwo kubarwanya, bitarigeze bibaho mu mateka y’abami b’u Rwanda. Rwabugili yafashe imitwe y’Ingabo yose yari ku Ijwi n’i Bunyabungo yageraga kuri 30, ahamagaza n’indi yari inyanyangiye ku ngerero zitandukanye hirya no hino mu gihugu yose igera kuri 50, baravunura batera Nkore. Bageze i Rutaraka ku ngoro ya Rwabugili, basanga harabaye amatongo, bahicara umwanya munini biga imigendekere y’urugamba bagiyemo. Abanyankore babonye Ingabo z’uruvunganzoka z’Abanyarwanda, zitangiye kubanyanyagiramo, batangira gushya ubwoba, ariko birema agatima ku bwo kwiringira imbunda bari bafite kandi bibwiraga ko Abanyarwanda bari bataragera ku ikoranabuhanga nk’iryo. Abanyankore batangira  kurasa mu kirere no gukanga kwinshi, ariko Abanyarwanda barimo kubiga no kwitegereza ibyo barimo. Rwabugili akitegereza iyo myuko yohereza imiriro mu kirere, niko kubaza Nyamuhenda wa Kajeje, ati  “Ko ndeba bariya Banyankore bohereza imiriro mu kirere, kandi nkaba mbona igera ku butaka yazimye, babicishije iki ?” Nyamuhenda wa Kajeje, amutekerereza uburyo bagiye bakabahagarara imbere bahanganye nk’abagiye kurasana nk’uko bisanzwe mu mirwanire ya gakondo, noneho batangira kubarasa mu mutwe no mu gituza abantu batangira kwikubita hasi n’intwaro zabo, ari nako urushunzi rw’amaraso rwisuka ku butaka, bapfa umusubizo. Mu gice gikurikira, tuzabaramburira imigendekere y’urwo rugamba rwongereye ibigwi bya Rwabugili n’igitinyiro cy’u Rwanda kirushaho kwiyongera…..

title: Inkomoko gakondo y’ibicumbi by’imiryango migari y’Abanyarwanda ( Igice cya  mbere)
content:
Nk’uko tubikesha igitabo “Iyororoka ry’Abanyarwanda, Inkomoko y’imiryango migari’’ dukesha Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, inzobere mu muco, ubusizi n’amateka y’u Rwanda, tugiye kubatekerere za gakondo nkuru z’ibicumbi  bikuru by’imiryango  migari y’Abanyarwanda. Abanyarwanda bibumbiye mu Bicumbi bikuru by’imiryango, imiryango migari ndetse n’inzu z’imiryango. Ibicumbi bikuru by’imiryango, nibyo byabyaye imiryango migari,  naho imiryango migari ibyara inzu z’imiryango. Muri aya mateka tukaba tugiye kwanzikira kuri gakondo z’ibicumbi bikuru by’imiryango y’Abanyarwanda aribyo: Abasinga, Abazigaba n’Abanyiginya. Gakondo z’ igicumbi gikuru cy’imiryango y’Abasinga
 Abatekereza b’amateka y’u Rwanda, bagaragaza neza ko Abasinga batuye bwa mbere ku butaka bw’u Rwanda, bafite inkomoko ku Bahima babarizwa ku butaka bw’igihugu cya Uganda, aribo bakunze kwita “Abahima b’Abanyankole”. Mu iyaduka ryabo, baje bafite intego yo guhamya ubuhangange bwo gutura ku butaka bwari butwikiriwe n’amashyamba ya kimeza, babuhangaho ibihugu, bituma bakura izina ryabo mu rurimi rw’igisekuruza cyabo rw’urunyankore, bakurijeho kwitwa “Abasinga” aribyo mu Kinyarwanda bisobanuye: ‘’ Abatsinze’’. Mu gutura kuri ubu butaka bw’u Rwanda, Abasinga binjiriye  bwa mbere mu Majyaruguru y’u Rwanda bakomereza mu Burengerazuba bagana mu Majyepfo, bakurikiranye  ubutohe bw’umwegega w’Ikiyaga cya Kivu n’amashyamba y’Ibirunga n’aya kimeza nka Gishwati, Nyungwe,  Mukura na Cyamudongo. Ayo mashyamba bayahereyeho bahiga, kugeza ubwo bayatutira, bayahangaho ibihugu. Kubera ko ntawe bacuranwaga ngo abakome imbere kuri ubu butaka, barisanzuye baratura kugeza n’ubwo basakaje ingoma zabo mu Rwanda rw’ u Burengerazuba, mu Rwanda rw’Amajyepfo no mu Rwanda rwo Hagati ndetse bambuka na Nyabarongo basatira u Rwanda rw’i Burasirazuba. Gakondo yabo ari nayo gicumbi gikuru batuyemo, kuri ubu ni mu Mirenge ya : Kigeyo,  Mushonyi,  Musasa,  Ruhango, Gihango, Kivumu na Boneza yo mu Karere ka Rutsiro n’Umurenge wa Nyamyumba  wo mu Karere ka Rubavu Gakondo z’ igicumbi gikuru cy’imiryango y’Abazigaba
 Abatekereza b’amateka y’u Rwanda, bagaragaza neza  ko Abazigaba batuye mu ba mbere kuri ubu butaka bw’u Rwanda bakurikiye bene wabo b’Abasinga, bafite ikomoko ku Bahima babarizwa ku butaka bw’igihugu cya Uganda, aribo bakunze kwita “Abahima b’Abanyankole”. Mu iyaduka ryabo, badukiriye igice cy’i Burasirazuba bw’u Rwanda bogoze ibiyaga bigari bihabarizwa, aba ariho batema amashyamba ya Cyimeza barayakonda, barayatutira bayahangamo ibihugu bishyira kera. Batuye ako gace babungira ubutohe gakomora ku ruzi rw’Akagera n’ibiyaga bihaboneka nka Nasho, Hago, Ihema  n’ibindi. Nuko batangira kwagura  ibihugu byabo bagana mu Rwanda rwo hagati no mu Majyepfo y’Iburasirazuba. Gakondo y’imbanza y’igicumbi gikuru cy’imiryango y’Abazigaba ni mu mirenge ya: Mwili na Murundi yo mu Karere ka Kayonza, ukongeraho Umurenge wa Rwimbogo yo muri Gatsibo. Gakondo  z’ igicumbi gikuru cy’imiryango y’Abanyiginya
 Abatekereze b’amateka y’Igicumbi cy’imiryango migari cy’Abanyiginya, bavuga ko cyaba gikomoka mu Majyaruguru y’Iburasirazuba bwa Afurika mu gihugu cya Ethiopia. Inkomoko yabo ikaba ari iyo mu muryango w’Abagala  bakunze kwita n’Abaromo,wari ukomeye muri icyo gihugu kandi wari nawo mugabwangoma mu myaka ya 300 nyuma ya Yezu Kirisitu. Abanyiginya basesekaye mu Karere ka Afurika y’Iburasirazuba no mu Rwanda, ahasaga muwa 700, ubwo bari mu iyimukayimuka  nk’abandi bose ry’abatuye muri Afurika, bashaka ubwinyagamburiro bw’imiryango yabo n’amatungo yabo. Nyuma y’igihe kitari gito, bafashe urugendo rwo mu muhora uhuza Afurika y’Amajyaruguru y’Iburasirazuba n’iy’Amajyepfo, bagaca mu bihugu bya Somaliya, Kenya na Uganda,  niko gusesekara kuri ubu butaka bw’u Rwanda. Barasukiye mu Burasirazuba bw’u Rwanda mu  Murenge wa Gatsibo wo mu Karere ka Gatsibo, basanga Abazigaba barahakabye barema ingoma y’u Rweya rw’u Mubali, yari ikomatanyije  Imirenge y’Akarere ka Gatsibo, n’imirenge imwe n’imwe iri mu Majyaruguru y’Akarere ka Kayonza. Abahasesekaye muri ibyo bihe, nibo bavuyemo Abasekuruza b’Imbanza ba Kazi wabyaye Gihanga cyahanze ingoma y’u Rwanda. Mu gusesekara mu Rweya rw’Abazigaba, bahaserukanye, ibigwi n’imihigo y’ibyo bazanye muri aka karere, nk’uko babivuze mu izina ryabo ubwo Abazigaba babazaga izina ryabo. Nk’aho bakavuze iry’igisekuruza cyabo cy’Abagala cyangwa se Abaromo, badukana izina rishya ryibigwi n’ibirindiro  by’ahazaza habo, ry’Abanyiginya rishatse kuvuga “Abantu barambye ku butunzi n’ubupfura”.  Nyuma y’imyaka isaga 300, Abanyiginya bamaze mu busembere bacumbikiwe n’Abazigaba, nibwo umucyo w’ubuhangange wabamurikiye bahanga igihugu cyabo kitwaga Gasabo, cyinjira mu ruhando rw’ibindi bihugu bigera kuri 24 byari bisanganyije ubu butaka bw’u Rwanda, baba babaye igihugu cya 25, gihangwa na Gihanga Ngomijana, umukurambere w’Abangiyinya bahanze ingoma y’u Rwanda. I Gasabo niho Abanyiginya n’imiryango ibakomokaho baguriye ubutaka bwabo bahanga ibindi bihugu  ku bisigara by’ubutaka Abasinga n’Abazigaba bari baranennye. Ibihugu byahanzwe na bene Gihanga, muri byo dusangamo Ndorwa y’Abashambo, Kibali y’Abega, u Bugara bw’Abacyaba n’u Bugesera bw’Abahondogo. Amateka y’impitabie ku gihugu cy’u Rwanda, adutekerereza ko gakondo nkuru y’igicumbi gikuru cy’Abanyiginya n’imiryango migari ibakomokaho, ari mu Mirenge ya Nduba, Bumbogo, Rutunga, Gikomero, Ndera na Rusororo yo mu Karere ka Gasabo, ukongeraho n’Umurenge wa Fumbwe wo mu Karere ka Rwamagana. Nyuma yo kubagezaho Gakondo nkuru z’ibicumbi by’imiryango y’Abanyarwanda, mu bice bikurikiraho, tuzabagezaho za Gakondo nkuru z’imiryango migari y’Abanyarwanda, uko ari 24.

title: Uruzinduko rw’amasaha arindwi Bush yakoreye mu Rwanda, rugasiga ishusho nshya y’umubano mu ishoramari
content: Yaje mu Rwanda asoza uruzinduko rw’iminsi yari amaze muri Afurika mu bihugu birimo Bénin, Tanzania, Ghana na Liberia. Bush yaje mu Rwanda ibibazo byasizwe na Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi bikiri byinshi, abapfakazi ba Jenoside, impfubyi, ibikorwa remezo bidahagije na gahunda z’imibereho myiza y’abaturage bikiri hasi. Icyakora yaje u Rwanda rutangiye kwigaragaza, aho 95 % by’abana bagejeje igihe cyo kujya kwiga mu mashuri abanza bajyagayo na hejuru ya 90 % y’abana bavuka bahabwa inkingo. Yageze ku Kibuga Mpuzamahanga cy’Indege cya Kigali mu gitondo, impande nyinshi z’umujyi umutekano wakajijwe. Bush yazanye n’umufasha we Laura Bush,  bahitira ku rwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Kigali kunamira inzirakarengane zazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi no gusobanurirwa byimbitse itegurwa n’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’iyo Jenoside ikomeye yakozwe mu kinyejana cya 20. Amaze gusura urwibutso no gushyira indabyo ku mva ziruhukiyemo imibiri isaga ibihumbi 250, Bush yavuze ko ibyabaye mu Rwanda bidakwiriye kugira ahandi biba. Yagize ati “Aha ni ahantu hatitiza ibyiyumviro byawe. Byanyibukije ko tudakwiriye gutuma ibintu nk’ibi biba kandi ko abaturage b’u Rwanda bakeneye ubufasha ngo biyunge, batere imbere nyuma y’ibi bihe by’ubwicanyi.Turasabira umugisha uva ku Mana abagifite ibikomere n’abamaze igihe bakeneye ubufasha ndetse n’abana ubuzima bwabo bwashegeshwe n’ibihe banyuzemo.” Yongeyeho ati “Turashimira ubuyobozi kuba bwarashyizeho ahantu nk’aha hibutsa abantu ko ikibi ntaho cyagiye mu Isi kandi ko kigomba kurwanywa.” Avuye ku rwibutso rwa Jenoside, Bush yakomereje muri Village Urugwiro kuganira na Perezida Kagame no gusinya amasezerano y’ishoramari hagati y’ibihugu byombi. Mu 2007, u Rwanda rwohereje muri Amerika ibicuruzwa bifite agaciro ka miliyoni 13 z’amadolari ya Amerika, ruvanayo ibicuruzwa bifite agaciro ka miliyoni $16. Amasezerano amaze gusinywa, abakuru b’ibihugu byombi bagiranye ikiganiro n’abanyamakuru, Perezida Kagame avuga ko ayo masezerano ari ubutumire ku bashoramari bo muri Amerika kuza mu Rwanda. Ati “Ni ubutumire ku bashoramari kandi tubabwira ko nibaramuka baje hano ishoramari ryabo rizarindwa neza ku buryo bazabona umusaruro w’ibyo batanze.” Yongeye kubisubiramo nyuma ubwo batahaga Ibiro bishya bya Ambasade ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, avuga ko gutaha inyubako nshya za ambasade bikwiriye kuba nka rukuruzi ikururira abashoramari bo muri Amerika kuza gushora mu Rwanda. Ibirori byakomereje ku Kacyiru ku Biro bishya bya Ambasade ya Amerika mu Rwanda, bishimira imyaka ibiri yari ishize byubakwa. Ni ibiro Perezida Bush yitiriye Martin Luther King waharaniye ubwigenge bw’abirabura muri Amerika. Muri ibyo birori byitabiriwe n’abantu babarirwa mu magana, Michael Arieti wari Ambasaderi wa Amerika mu Rwanda yavuze ko uwo munsi ari uw’amateka mu mubano w’u Rwanda na Amerika. Yatangiye yibutsa ko mu 2004 aribwo Leta y’u Rwanda yemeye kugurisha ikibanza ngo kigurwe na Amerika cyubakweho ambasade. Yavuze ko imirimo yo kubaka iyo ambasade yakozwe n’abakozi 750, barimo abasaga 650 b’Abanyarwanda. Bush wari umaze amasaha make mu Rwanda, yahawe umwanya avuga ko bitumvikana uburyo igihugu cyanyuze mu bibazo nk’ibyo yari amaze kubona ku rwibutso, cyabashije kwiyubaka kikaba gitanga icyizere. Yavuze ko ejo heza h’u Rwanda hashoboka cyane ashingiye ku muhate n’urukundo yabonanye Perezida Kagame. Ati “Ntabwo byumvikana uburyo icyizere cyagaruka nyuma yo guca mu bihe nka biriya. Abanyamerika turi kumwe namwe mu rugamba rwo guharanira ejo heza. Nishimira kuganira n’abayobozi bakomeye  bita ku baturage babo. Nkunda umuhate n’urukundo ari nabyo Perezida wanyu afite. Yita bikomeye ku bibazo by’abaturage be.” Yavuze ko kuba hatashywe inyubako nshya za ambasade, ari umukoro ku Banyamerika wo gukomeza umutima wo gufasha no gushyigikira iterambere ry’u Rwanda. Ahagana saa cyenda, Bush na Laura bagiye muri Lycée de Kigali kuganira n’abanyeshuri baho ibijyanye no kwirinda SIDA, ahava ahawe inkoni ya Kinyarwanda nk’impano. Ubwo yageraga ku kibuga cy’indege atashye, yaganiriye gato n’abasirikare bari baravuye mu butumwa bw’amahoro mu Ntara ya Darfur muri Sudani, dore ko igihugu cye cyari kimaze iminsi gitanga amahugurwa ku ngabo zigiye kujya mu butumwa bw’amahoro. Bivugwa ko mu ruzinduko rwa Bush, we na Perezida Kagame baganiriye ku mutekano wo mu Karere cyane cyane muri Kenya aho imvururu zakurikiye amatora yo mu Ukuboza 2007 zari zimaze guhitana abantu basaga igihumbi. No mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru, Bush yabikomojeho, avuga ko hatagizwe igikorwa ibiri kuba muri Kenya biganisha ku byabaye mu Rwanda mu 1994. Bush ni we Perezida wa Amerika uheruka gusura u Rwanda, akaba uwa kabiri nyuma ya Bill Clinton wahaje mu 1998 Jenoside imaze imyaka ine ihagaritswe. Uruzinduko rwe rwongereye ishoramari n’ubucuruzi hagati y’ibihugu byombi kuko mu 2018, ibyo u Rwanda rwohereza muri Amerika byari bigeze kuri miliyoni $67.4, bivuye kuri miliyoni $13 mu 2007 ibyo ruvanayo biba miliyoni 425.3 bivuye kuri  miliyoni $16 mu 2007.

title: ‘Sinzatesha agaciro uwakansubije’, igitabo kivuga amateka y’Abanyarwandakazi  n’uburyo basubiranye ijambo
content: Gikubiyemo amateka y’abagore mu Rwanda  rwa mbere y’ubukoloni, guteshwa agaciro mu bukoloni na nyuma y’aho ndetse n’uburyo bongeye gusubizwa agaciro nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Iki gitabo cy’amapaji asaga 250 kizamurikwa ku mugaragaro  kuwa Gatanu tariki 15 Ugushyingo 2019 muri Kigali Convention Centre. Hetegekimana usanzwe yandika ibitabo bitandukanye, yavuze ko iki gitabo kigaragaza neza uburyo mbere y’umwaduko w’abazungu abanyarwandakazi bagiraga ijambo mu miyoborere n’ubuzima bw’igihugu, bikavaho mu gihe cy’ubukooloni, muri Repubulika ya mbere n’iya kabiri, bakongera kwisanga mu buzima bw’igihugu  ubwo Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yahagarikwaga n’Ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi zari ziyobowe na Perezida Paul Kagame. Muri iki gitabo atangamo ingero z’uburyo abagore bagize uruhare mu rugamba rwo kubohora igihugu n’umusanzu bakomeje gutanga nyuma ya Jenoside ngo u Rwanda rwongere kuba igihugu cyubashywe. Aganira na IGIHE, Hategekimana yavuze ko yanditse icyo gitabo, kugira ngo yibutse abagore ko ubwisanzure n’ijambo bafite hari aho byaturutse, bityo ko bakwiriye kurinda icyo gihango bafitanye na Perezida Paul Kagame. Ati “Mbere y’ubukoloni, Abanyarwandakazi bari bafite agaciro, bagagaragara mu buzima bw’igihugu ariko kuva mu bukoloni kugeza mu 1994 agaciro kabo barakambuwe. Imiyoborere myiza ya Perezda Paul Kagame n’umuryango FPR Inkotanyi yasubije agaciro Abanyarwandakazi, bafata iya mbere mu kugirana igihango na Perezida wa Repubulika, biyemeza ko agaciro yabahaye batazigera bakamutesha.” Yakomeje agira ati “Ni igitabo kigaragaza amateka y’umugore, kikamwereka aho ari, aho ava n’aho yerekeza kikanamwibutsa igihango afitanye na Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame.” Muri iki gitabo, ijambo ry’ibanze ryasinywe na Madamu Ingabire Marie Immaculée uyobora Umuryango Transparency International Rwanda. Hategekimana avuga ko yabikoze kugira ngo igitabo cye koko kigire umwihariko no kugaragaza uruhare rw’abagore mu iterambere. Igitabo ‘Sinzatesha Agaciro Uwakansubije’ kibaye icya gatatu cya Hategekimana Richard, cyabanzirijwe  n’ibirimo “Intwari Mpinduramatwara Paul Kagame” n’ikindi cyitwa “Urubyiruko dufitanye igihango”.

title: Kurasaga, imyotso, kurumika, kugombora: Uburyo gakondo bwamamaye mu kuvura indwara z’amayobera
content:
Gusa kuri ubu Abanyarwanda benshi ntibabyemera, ndetse bavuga ko ari imihango ya gipagani, n’ubwo hari abaganga bemeza ko iyo migenzo yabaga ari ingirakamaro. Nk’uko tubikesha igitabo “Umuco mu Buvanganzo’’ cyanditswe n’Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, Inzobere ku muco, amateka n’ubuvanganzo nyarwanda, tugiye kubataturira imwe mu mihango  n’imigenzo yakorwaga mu kuvura no kurinda indwara mu muco w’Abanyarwanda. Kurasaga (Guca indasago, gukeba gahoro gahoro ku mubiri) umuntu byaterwaga n’uko bashaka nko kumushyiramo imiti yo kumuvura ikintu arwaye, cyangwa kumutsirika bavuga ngo batazamuroga, bakarasaga rero bagashyiramo iyo miti. Hari n’aho bikengeraga ko umwana wavutse azahura n’akaga, nako bakagatsirika bakoresheje kumuca indasago, ukazasanga koko bibaye impamo, ibyago baketse, akabicika. Hari kandi n’indasago bacaga ku mugore ugiye gushaka cyangwa umugabo, bagashyiramo imiti ituma bahamya umubano uzira kidobya. Niyo mpamvu uzasanga abantu bakuru benshi bafite indasago ku mubiri, ku gikanu, mu gatuza, ku bibero ku gahanga, mu biganza n’ahandi. Umumaro w’indasago ahanini, wari uwo gutsirika ushyiramo umuti aho barasaze, bakungikanya n’imitongero runaka yo kuvura, imitongero igakurwa n’indi maze umuntu akaba mutaraga. Kurumika ho bacaga indasago nko mu gikanu cyangwa mu mugongo , bagashyiraho ikintu bita ingunga. Ingunga kari agacuma bakebye katagira ijosi. Kurumika babikoraga bashaka gusohora amaraso mabi ari mu mubiri. Hari nk’ubwo imitsi yipfundikaga ikabuza umuntu kuba yagenda, ugasanga aho yipfunditse habaye nk’umukara, uwo byabayeho agakunda kugira ibinya bimufata bya hato na hato. Barasagaga ya maraso agasohoka, nyuma bagasigamo imiti yo kugira ngo homoke hasubirane, ariko na none igakiza ubwo burwayi ntibuzagaruke. Hari n’aho barumikaga bakoresheje ihembe rikiyomeka ku mubiri rikajya rikurura amaraso, ryamara kuzura bakarikuraho bakayamena bakongera bagasubizaho. Kurasaga no kurumika, bifite itandukaniro benshi badakunze kumenya. Kurasaga byakorerwaga ku ruhu inyuma , basharuragaho gato, hakava amaraso makeya. Naho kurumika, byakorwaga binjiye mu mubiri imbere ku buryo bashyikira umutsi ujyana amaraso mu mubiri, akaba ariwo bakomeretsa amaraso bashaka kumena akava. Ubuvuzi gakondo bwo kotsa ( imyotso) amateka atugaragariza ko bwaba bukomoka mu Gisaka, aho bwadutse ku ngoma y’umwami waho  Kimenyi II Shumbusho, watway I Gisaka ahasaga mu wa 1312. Muri icyo kibariro, mu Gisaka hadutse indwara y’amaso yafataga abana bakiri bato bakundaga kuvukana bitewe n’uburwayi bwafataga Ababyeyi batwite, urukingo rukaba gufata abo bana bakabotsa ku gahanga no mu misaya, bagahita bakira. Noneho biba nk’umugenzo wo muri ako gace, abantu babona ari byiza, uvutse wese kabone n’ubwo yaba atarwaye amaso bakamwotsa. Gushyira imyotso ku gahanga no mu misaya, nibwo buvuzi gakondo bw’Abanyarwanda bifashishaga bavura icyorezo cy’uburwayi bw’amaso, haba ku bana no ku bantu bakuru Uwo mugenzo wo guca imyotso ku bana b’Abanyagisaka, wageze aho uba ikirango mwihariko wabo, uhinduka umugenzo wo guca imanzi z’ubwiza ku mwana uwo ariwe wese uvukiye mu Gisaka, ku buryo byabaye n’ikimenyetso cyakoreshwaga mu ntambara y’I Gisaka n’u Rwanda kugira ngo Abanyagisaka babashe gutandukanya abaturage babo n’Abanyarwanda. Ubuvuzi gakondo bw’Abanyarwanda bugombora uwakomwe ( uwarumwe) n’inzoka, akabasha kuyirokoka, ni bumwe mu buvuzi gakondo bumaze igihe kirekire mu Rwanda, kuko bwahanganywe n’u Rwanda rukiri amashyamba y’inzitane adapfa kwisukirwa. Kugombora, hakoreshwaga uburyo bwo gushyira umuti witwa : ‘’Umukubayoka’’ ahakomwe ( aharumwe) n’inzoka, cyangwa se bagashyira ifu y’inzoka y’inkazi babaga baraseye ( nk’impiri, uruziramire n’izindi) mu gikomere cy’aharumwe n’inzoka. Kugombora byaherekezwaga n’imitongero ivugwa muri ubu buryo : Ndakugombora impiri , ndakugombora idubi,
Ndakugombora insana n’inkomyi,
Habyimbirwa imbwa, habyimbirwa impyisi,
Ubwo  bugomboro nabugomboje Ruganzu,
Bwagomboye Rwabugili na Rudahigwa.
Ndakugombora byunga na barihuta,
N’inyenzi na buhoma !
Murahura , ntikurya ! urajye kuvoma ,
Ntikurya ! urajya ku ryama!ntikurya !
Murahura , ikaraba , ikarabirana , ikabura ubwenge,
Ikabura ubwinyo , ikaba imbwa biseseme ! Ubuvuzi gakondo bw’Abanyarwanda bushingiye ku kurumika, kotsa, guca indasago no kugombora, bwari bwuje igenantekerezo zisobetse rwose, ku buryo ritabashaga kugerurwa n’abahisi. Ku buryo na n’ubu hari aho bugikoreshwa mu kuvura indwara zimwe na zimwe.

title: Nzaharanira kutaruta ubutumwa kuko buruta intumwa! Isezerano rya Bamporiki nyuma yo kugirwa Minisitiri
content: Nyuma yo guhabwa uyu mwanya Bamporiki Edouard yashimiye Perezida Kagame amwizeza ko atazamutenguha ndetse azasohoza ubutumwa amutumye. Abinyujije ku rukuta rwe rwa Twitter, Bamporiki yagize ati “Witaba kare ugatumwa kure, Watumwa n’Umukuru ugashima ushingura ugana iyo utumwe. Ubutumwa mumpaye Nyakubahwa Mutoza w’Ikirenga Paul Kagame nzabusohoza bwemye, nzaharanira kutaruta ubutumwa kuko buruta intumwa. Nzaba Mudahusha ku ruhembe muntumye kurasaniraho. U Rwanda nirweme.” Ubu butumwa buri mu Kinyarwanda cyiza, bwumvikanisha uburyo uyu mugabo wari usanzwe ari umukuru w’Itorero ry’Igihugu yishimiye inshingano nshya yahawe. Usibye kuzishimira, ikindi Bamporiki yavuzemo ni uko atazigera ashaka kuruta ubutumwa ahawe kuko buruta intumwa. Aha akaba yumvikanishaga ko atazitwaza umwanya abonye ngo akomere kuruta inshingano ze. Bamporiki yamenyekanye nk’umukinnyi wa filime, ikinamico akaba n’umwanditsi w’ibitabo, imivugo n’ibisigo, azwi cyane mu ikinamico urunana aho akina yitwa Tadeyo cyangwa se Kideyo, aho akina ari se wa Budensiyana na Solina, inshuti ya Bushombe na Sitefano b’i Nyarurembo. Yavutse tariki 24 Ukuboza 1983, i Nyamasheke mu Ntara y’Iburengerazuba, ari naho yaje kwiga amashuri abanza ndetse n’ayisumbuye, nyuma yiga amategeko mpuzamahanga muri Kaminuza yigenga ya Kigali ULK. Yakuze akunda cyane kwandika imivugo, bituma yitabira amarushanwa atandukanye mu bigo by’amashuri. Afite imyaka 11 gusa y’amavuko, yakoze umuvugo witwa “Iyo badatsembwa tuba dutwenga” ari nawo watumye amenyekana nk’umusizi akiri umwana. Amaze kuba umusore yagiye abona umwanya wo kuvuga imivugo mu birori bitandukanye byo ku rwego rw’igihugu, nko ku munsi mukuru w’Intwari n’indi minsi mikuru itandukanye. Bamporiki wari usanzwe yumva ikinamico “Urunana” akiri muto, akifuza kuba umwe mu bakinnyi bayo, mu 2003 yashakishije aho umushinga uyitegura ukorera, arahamenya maze agezeyo arabinginga ngo bareke ajye akinamo. Aza kubyemererwa maze ahabwa umwanya yitwa Tadeyo. N’ubwo abantu bagiye bumva Tadeyo akina ari umusaza ndetse ufite abana bakuru n’abuzukuru, yari muto kuko icyo gihe yari afite imyaka 20 y’amavuko, bamwe mu bakinaga byumvikana ko ababereye umubyeyi baramurutaga. Mu bindi bijyanye n’ubuhanzi, Bamporiki yakunze kugaragara muri filime zitandukanye ndetse ahabwa ibikombe n’ibihembo muri sinema, haba mu z’abandi yagiye akinamo ndetse no mu zo yagiye yandika akanazikinamo. Muri z’abandi yagaragayemo harimo iyitwa ’Munyurangabo’ y’uwitwa Isaac  Chung ukomoka muri Amerika, iyitwa ’Rwanda take two’ ya Pia nawe wo muri Amerika, n’iyitwa ’Imitoma’ ya Kwezi John. Mu mafilime yanditse ku giti cye akanakinamo harimo iyitwa ‘Ukuri kuri he’ ndetse na ‘Long Coat’ (Ikote rirerire). Mu 2006 yitabiriye Iserukiramuco ry’amafilime rya Cannes mu Bufaransa, mu 2010 yitabira iryabereye i Rotterdam mu Buholandi, mu 2011 yitabira iryabereye muri Turikiya ryitwa “Crimes and punishment”. Mu 2008 yabonye igihembo yakuye i New York muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, akaba yarahembewe kwandika filime nziza (Best Script) abikesheje filime “Long Coat”,  yagaragayemo abahanzi b’Abanyarwanda nka Nirere Shanel, Mani Martin n’umukinnyi Jimmy Gatete. Mu 2011 yabonye igihembo cy’umukinnyi mwiza (Best Actor) mu iserukiramuco rya Heart Land. Nyuma y’ubuhanzi mu byiciro bitandukanye, Bamporiki mu 2013 yatorewe kuba intumwa ya rubanda, aba Umudepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko y’u Rwanda. Ku itariki ya 30 Kanama 2017, Bamporiki yahawe imirimo mishya agirwa Umuyobozi w’Itorero ry’Igihugu. Bamporiki ni umugabo wubatse, wambikanye impeta y’urudashira na Uwingabire Claudine tariki ya 18 Ukuboza 2010. Bamporiki yize  amasomo atandukanye, arimo ajyanye na sinema yize i Burayi ahitwa Plague, aza no kwiga muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ibijyanye no kubaka amahoro no kurwanya amakimbirane. Mu masomo asanzwe  yize muri Kaminuza yigenga ya Kigali ULK aho yakuye impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya gatatu mu mategeko mpuzamahanga..
