Ubutumwa mumpaye Nyakubahwa Mutoza w'Ikirenga @PaulKagame nzabusohoza bwemye, nzaharanira kutaruta ubutumwa kuko buruta intumwa. Nzaba Mudahusha kuruhembe muntumye kurasaniraho. URwanda nirweme. — Bamporiki Edouard (@Bamporikie) November 4, 2019

title: Imiryango yahamije ubuhangange mu mateka: Igicumbi cy’Umuryango w’Umwami Yuhi Mazimpaka
content:
Muri iki gice tukaba tugiye kubimburira ku mateka y’igicumbi cy’umuryango mugari ufite inkomoko ku Mwami Yuhi Mazimpaka twifashishije  igitabo “Iyororoka ry’Abanyarwanda, inkomoko y’imiryango migari ’’ dukesha Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, inzobere mu Busizi, Umuco n’Amateka y’u Rwanda. Yuhi III Mazimpaka ni mwene Sekarongoro Gisanura cya Kigeli Nyamuheshera, Umunyiginya wo mu nzu y’Abaganzu na Nyamarembo ya Majinya, ukomoka mu muryango mugari w’Abakono, wategetse ahasaga mu wa 1642 kugeza mu wa 1675. Ni umwami wa 18 muri 28 bategetse u Rwanda, akaba n’umwami wa 18 mu Berekeza 34 b’umushinga wo kubaka u Rwanda, kugeza ubwo aya mateka yandikwaga. Izina rye ry’ubutwari ryari “Insarikanamakuza.’’ Umwami Yuhi Mazimpaka ni umwe mu Bami b’u Rwanda bagize inzu z’imiryango nyinshi ugereranyije n’abandi bami, akaba akurikira Ndoba na we wagize inzu z’imiryango ntabarika. Amateka atugaragariza ko Umwami Yuhi Mazimpaka ya Gisanura, yabyaye abana benshi, biganjemo abahungu 10 barimo Rwaka, Rujugira, Nyarwaya, Gakomba, Mureganshuro, Gapfizi, Mukungu, Mukuku, Rushara na Bukombe. Umuryango w’Umwami Yuhi Mazimpaka wabayemo ingabo z’ibikongote ku ngoma ye n’iy’umuhungu we Cyilima Rujugira wamuzunguye ku ngoma. Banabaye abagaba b’ingabo b’intahusha mu gihe cye. Imitwe y’Ingabo yatwarwaga n’abahungu be, irimo Indara zatwarwagwa na Mukungu wa Yuhi Mzimpaka, Inkoramaraso: Zatwarwaga na Mukungu wa Yuhi Mazimpaka Abashahuzi: Batwarwaga na Nyarwaya Karuretwa wa Yuhi Mazimpaka Ababaga: Batwarwaga na Nyarwaya Karuretwa wa Yuhi Mazimpaka Ababanda: Batwarwaga na Nyarwaya Karuretwa wa Yuhi Mazimpaka Inkuba: Zatwarwaga na Mureganshuro ya Yuhi Mazimpaka Abakungu: Batwarwaga na Mureganshuro ya Yuhi Mazimpaka Abatabaga: Batwarwaga na Yuhi Mazimpaka za Gisanura Intaremba: Zatwarwaga na Yuhi Mazimpaka ya Gisanura Hari n’ababaye abagaba b’ingabo ku ngoma y’umuhungu we akaba n’umuvandimwe wabo Cyilima  Rujugira, aribo aba bakurikira: Abakemba: Batwarwaga na Sharangabo ya Cyilima Rujugira, Imvejuru: Zatwarwaga na Sharangabo ya Cyilima Rujugira, Indirira (Rugamba): Zatwarwaga na Muciye ya Serutaro rwa Mukuku wa Mazimpaka, Abarima: Batwarwaga na Mitunga ya Cyilima Rujugira n’umugabo we Seruhuga, Abatanyagwa: Batwarwaga na Gihana cya Cyilima Rujugira, Intarindwa: Zatwarwaga na Ndabarasa ba Cyilima Rujugira, Ababito: Batwarwaga na Ndabarasa ba Cyilima Rujugira, Indara: Zatwarwaga na Cyilima Rujugira rwa Yuhi Mazimpaka, Ababanda: Batwarwaga na Cyilima Rujugira rwa Yuhi Mazimpaka Aba bagabo b’Intarumikwa, ni bo babaye inkomoko y’inzu z’imiryango zo kwa 
Mazimpaka zikomoka mu muryango mugari w’Abanyiginya. Inzu z’imiryango zikomoka kwa Yuhi Mazimpaka ni izi zikurikira: Abanyiginya b’ABAKA bakomoka kuri Karemera Rwaka rwa Yuhi Mazimpaka Abanyiginya b’ABAYA bakomoka kuri Nyarwaya rwa Yuhi Mazimpaka; Abanyiginya b’ABASIGAYE bakomoka kuri Nsigaye ya Gakombe ka Yuhi Mazimpaka; Abanyiginya b’Abahwege bakomoka kuri Segahwege ka Nsigaye ya Gakombe ka Yuhi mazimpaka; Abanyiginya b’ABAPFIZI bakomoka kuri Gapfizi ka Yuhi Mazimpaka; Abanyiginya b’ABAREGANSHURO bakomoka kuri Mureganshuro ya Yuhi Mazimpaka; Abanyiginya b’Abashamakokera bakomoka kuri Shamakokera ya Ndabaramiye wa Bukombe bwa Yuhi  Mazimpaka; Abanyiginya b’ABASAMANZI bakomoka kuri Rwasamanzi rwa Mukungu ya Yuhi Mazimpaka; Abanyiginya b’Abakuku bakomoka kuri Mukuku wa Yuhi  Mazimpaka; Abanyiginya b’Abashara bakomoka kuri Rushara rwa Yuhi Mazimpaka; Izindi nzu zihamye mu mateka y’u Rwanda zikomoka kwa Yuhi Mazimpaka, harimo n’izo kwa Cyilima Rujugira umuhungu we w’ubuheta  wabaye umwami wa Rubanda akamuzungura ku ngoma. Inzu zimukomokaho zirimo Abanyiginya b’Abadenge bakomoka kuri Mudenge wa Cyilima Rujugira; Abanyiginya b’Abakore bakomoka kuri Kanyankore ka Kanyoni ka Baziga ba Cyilima     Rujugira; Abanyiginya b’Abahabanyi bakomoka kuri Bihabanyi bya Gashikazi ka Cyilima Rujugira; Abanyiginya b’Abamo bakomoka kuri Rwamo rwa Gihana cya Cyilima Rujugira; Abanyiginya b’Abanana bakomoka kuri Munana wa Gihana cya Cyilima Rujugira; Abanyigiya b’Abasharangabo bakomoka kuri Sharangabo ya Cyilima Rujugira.

title: Inkomoko y’Insigamugani “Barapfa iz’imibaya”
content: Muri iyo mpugu, higeze gutera inzara, umwe mu batwa b’aho asuhukana na nyina n’umugore we n’abana babo, bagenda berekeje iyo mu Kabagari. Bahamaze iminsi umwe mu bana babo arwara amacinya. Babwira se ko amacinya avurwa n’amata. Umutwa ajya kuyasaba mu batunzi,  barayamuha ayazanira umwana aranywa, ariko biba iby’ubusa yanga gufuma. Umutwa ashira ubute akomeza kuyasaba, kugeza igihe bamwinubiye barayamwima, aho agiye kuyasaba bakamwaka ikibindi. Bamaze kumushwishuriza yemera guteba ibibindi, kugira ngo bakunde bayamuhe. Akomeza kubiteba, ariko biba iby’ubusa umwana yanga gukira arirenga arapfa.  Amaze gupfa, nyirakuru w’uwo mwana abwira umuhungu we ati “Ino hatuguye nabi, none uko ndora ikiruta n’uko twasubira iwacu i Gihogwe tugasanga bene wacu”. Umuhungu aremera basubirayo. Bahageze basanga harakize inzara. Basubira mu byari ibyabo. Babumba inkono bagura ibishyimbo; n’ibijumba n’amasaka. Bamaze kugira amasaka menshi barinika, amamera; amaze kuma barasya benga amarwa. Amaze gushya umugore ayamurikira umugabo we. Bemeranya kuyanywa nimugoroba bihereye, byo gukumira abavumbyi. Nuko bugorobye bose bateranira ku marwa yabo baranywa baraganira. Ibiganiro bimaze kurimbanya, bibuka ibyago bagiriye mu Kabagari. Nyina, ati “Muribuka uko ya mata twaseheye nyakwigendera yaduhaze urukuru” Umuhungu we ati “Hora wibinyibutsa!” Abwira umugore we  ati “Mbega urabizi ! Kuva ubu ngiye kujya njya mu ibumba nditunde ndikwegereze ujye ubumba ibibindi tubigure ibishyimbo, na njye hagati aho njye njya guca umubaya nkeneke umunyu w’ingasire na wo tuwugure ibishyimbo, maze nibimara kugwira, tubigure amasuka, nagwira tuzayagure ihene tuzorore, nizigwira tuzigure ikimasa tukirere, nikimara kuba igisore tukigwatirize inyana tuyiragire neza, abana banjye bayikuranwe ye gukena, nimara kuba indinzi tuyibangurire imfizi nziza, maze nijya kubyara, mama azajye ayikama kane na we uyikame kabiri abana banywe amata, maze tuzarebane n’abatunzi twatebeye ibibindi byacu ku busa”. Umugore abyumvise atyo ati “ashwi ! Ndakambura data ntabwo nyoko yayikama kane ngo nyikame kabiri kandi ari jye wayiruhiye mbumba inkono abana banjye birirwa ku nkuba y’izuba nyiragiye’. Umugabo ati  “Ubwo wanze ibyo ngutegetse noneho umukecuru azayiharire”. Ubwo baratangira batera hejuru bararwana. Abaturanyi barahurura baza kubakiza. Bababajije icyo bapfuye babibasubiriramo. Bumvise intandaro y’uwo murwano barabaseka, bati “Ntimuraca n’umubaya, ntimurasumba inkono, none inka ni yo ibatanze kugera mu rugo? Barikubura baragenda. Abo bahuye na bo bitabiriye iyo nduru bakababaza bati “Induru twumvise ni bwoko ki ?”  Abandi bati “Ni kwa wa mutwa bapfa iz’imibaya!”.  Kuva ubwo  abantu babigira urwenya mu biganiro, babona abahayurana bose bapfa ubusa bakabagereranya n’abo batwa, bati ‘Barapfa iz’imibaya (inka)”.

title: Igitaramo ‘Twinikize Inkera’ cyasubije abanyarwanda ku isoko y’amazina y’inka
content: Ku mugoroba wo ku wa 31 Gicurasi 2019, Ihuriro ‘Iriba ry’Umuco nyarwanda’ rihurije hamwe abahanzi batandukanye cyane cyane mu buvanganzo nyabirori nk’Abasizi, Abisi b’Amazina y’inka, Abashingwabirori, Abakirigitananga, Ababugu ( Ababuguza igisoro) n’abandi ryagerageje gusubiza ku kirari cy’amazina y’inka, Abanyarwanda bazikunda bongera kumva ku cyanga cyayo cyatangijwe n’igihangange mu Bisi bazo Nkibiki, ahasaga mu wa 1746, ku ngoma y’umwami Yuhi Gahindiro. Mu gitaramo cyabereye muri Hotel Hill Top i Remera mu Mujyi wa Kigali, cyari cyitabiriwe n’abantu bake ariko gihuje abahanga mu buvanganzo bw’Amazina y’inka, amahamba, imyoma n’ibindi. Itorero Intayoberana ryari ryahaserukanye isheja mu mudiho uhamye, ikinyemera, umushagiriro, urusharaza n’urw’intwari nk’imwe mu byinire gakondo bifashisha mu gushimisha abatagira ingano. Intore z’Intayoberana, nazo zavunnye Sambwe, ubundi zikandagira isi yiyasa imitutu. Ni igitaramo cyari cyitabiriwe n’Abakirigitananga nka Munyakazi Deo na Nkwakuzi Emmanuel bamenyereye gusasanura imirya y’inanga. Ahasaga saa moya n’igice z’umugoroba nibwo igitaramo kiswe “Twinikize inkera” cyari cyinikijwe, habimbura Umuyobozi w’ihuriro “Iriba ry’umuco nyarwanda”  Nshimyumuremyi Justin wahaga ikaze abitabiriye icyo gitaramo, hataho Itorero Intayoberana ricinya umudiho, wabisikanaga n’urw’intwari n’urusharaza, nuko haza gukurikiraho amazina y’inka yabimbuwe na Rugemintwaza ndetse na Nkurunziza bakunze kwita Mag-Mag, ubundi bazivuga mu myoma, basoreza ku mazina, y’inka, baza gukorerwa mu ngata na Gatete wataramiye abari aho mu buhanga buhanitse mu mahamba. Mu murya w’inanga niho Munyakazi Déo yibukije Abataramyi amajwi y’urwunge abanyarwanda bahoranye. Mu kiganiro cyatanzwe n’Inzobere mu Muco, Ubusizi n’Amateka Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, yagiteruye atekerereza abataramyi ibintu bitagatifu mu muco n’amateka y’u Rwanda. Aho yagize ati “Mu Rwanda hariho ibintu bitagatifu mu mateka y’u Rwanda byahanzwe na Gihanga bigera kuri bitanu. Ni ibintu bihanitse by’ikirenga, byubahwa, biziririzwa, bitinywa, u Rwanda rwafatiyeho ngo rwiyubake mu myaka amagana n’amagana ishize. Muri ibyo harimo n’inka yagize akamaro kenshi mu kubaka u Rwanda, kurunywanisha n’amahanga no kurwubakira ubukungu butajegajega. Ibindi byari mu byiciro bimwe n’inka, harimo: Ingoma-Ngabe, Umwami, Umugore n’Umugabo. Bikaba ibintu bizira kandi byera i Rwanda, bigomba gusigasirwa nk’amateka atazibagirana, kandi bigafatirwaho mu kubaka ubukungu, ubumwe bw’abenegihugu ndetse bikadusabanisha n’amahanga”. Mu bandi batanze ibiganiro harimo Perezida w’Itorero ry’igihugu Bamporiki Edouard, aho yagaragaje ko iki gitaramo kije cyari gikenewe kandi gikwiye gukomeza gushyikirwa. Ati “ Iki gitaramo cyakozwe, ni amateka, kandi kuba mwari kubitekereza ntimubikore, amateka yari kuzabibabaza ariko kuko mwabikoze ni ishimwe kuri mwe no ku gihugu. Ntimubabazwe nuko kititabiriwe nk’uko mwabyifuzaga, kuko kuba mwebwe bagiteguye mwaje, byonyine bigaragaza koko ko gikwiye kubaho kandi kigakomera. Nubwo  byabagoye, umugabo imbaraga zimusanga mu nzira, iyo yahagurukanye ize”. Senateri Uyisenga Charles, na we wari witabiriye ibyo birori  yavuze ko gutarama ari umuco nyarwanda ukwiriye gutozwa abato ngo utazacika. Ati “Gutarama, ni umuco mwiza ukwiye gutozwa no mu mashuri, yaba Abanza, Ayisumbuye Amakuru na za Kaminuza. Byigishijwe bigatozwa abakiri bato, umuco ntabwo wacika kuko n’ubundi watorezwaga mu bitaramo by’abanyarwanda. Iki gitaramo gikwiye gushyigikirwa kikaba kenshi gashoboka”. Amazina y’inka ni ibisingizo by’inka ku bw’akamaro zari fitite mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere. Ahasaga mu wa 1746, ku ngoma y’umwami Yuhi Gahindiro, nibwo abahanga n’abafite ubushobozi bwo guhanga, batangiye kuzisingiza. Niho hagiye haba inkomoko y’abandi bagiye bakora mu nganzo, bagahanga: Amajuri, Amahamba, Ibihamagaro, Imyoma, Ibyisigo n’ibindi. Byose biganisha kun ka, ku bw’akamro zifitiye igihugu n’abaturage bacyo.

title: Uko Nyanza yabaye umurwa mukuru w’ubwami bw’u Rwanda (Igice cya gatatu)
content: Nyamara ukurikije ibirari by’amateka y’u Rwanda, igihugu cyagiye kigira imirwa mikuru myinshi itandukanye, yagiye ishyirwaho n’abami bagera kuri 28 batwaye u Rwanda mu gihe cy’imyaka 870 (1091-1961) rwamaze ruyobowe n’ingoma ya cyami. Nk’uko tubikeshasha ibitabo “Imizi y’u Rwanda” n’igitabo  “Intwari z’imbanza, zubatse u Rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro” byombi byanditswe n’Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, inzobere mu Muco, amateka n’ubuvanganzo by’impitabihe k’u Rwanda, bitugaragaziza ko mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere, buri mwami yagiye agira umurwa mukuru we, kenshi na kenshi ukazarangirana n’ingoma ye. Nk’uko twabibasezeraniye mu gice kibanza, tugiye gukomeza kubatekerereza imirwa y’ingoma y’u Rwanda mu bihe by’abami kugeza ku murwa wa nyuma ariwo Mwima ya Rwesero rwa Nyanza mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo y’u Rwanda. Imirwa mikuru yose y’u Rwanda, yagiye ishyirwaho kandi ikomeza kwimurwa hakurikijwe uko igihugu cyatanyaga kijya mbere mu kwagura igihugu higarurirwa ibindi bihugu byari kuri ubu butaka bwitwa u Rwanda butaraba igihugu kimwe. Ruganzu Ndoli amaze gutanga ingoma akayigabira umuhungu we Mutara Semugeshi, yahise yihatira kwigarurira ingoma y’u Bungwe yari muri zimwe ngari mu bihe byo ha mbere. Mbere y’uko yigarurira ingoma y’u Bungwe, yabanje gushyira umurwa we i Giseke na Nyagisenyi ( Rusatira ya Huye) aba ariho agaba ibitero aturutse, kugeza ahigaruriye. Mutara Semugeshi amaze gutanga, umuhungu we Kigeli Nyamuheshera yakomeje ingando ya se akomeza umurwa wa Giseke, ari naho yagiye aturuka agaba ibitero byibasiye ingoma zo mu Burengerazuba no mu Majyaruguru y’u Rwanda. Kigeli Nyamuheshera, yatanze ingoma ayisigira umuhungu we wafashe izina ry’ubwami rya Mibambwe Gisanura. Umurwa w’u Rwanda yahise awimura awuzana mu Murenge wa Ruhango ho mu Karere ka Ruhango, ari na we wabaye inkomoko y’iryo zina bwa mbere mu mateka y’u Rwanda. Umuhungu we Yuhi Mazimpaka na we yakomeje kwimura umurwa w’u Rwanda awuganisha mu Rwanda rwo hagati aherekera mu Burasirazuba aho yawushyize mu Ijuru rya Kamonyi ho mu Mudugudu wa Juru mu Kagali ka Nkingo mu Murenge wa Gacurabwenge ho mu Karere ka Kamonyi. Cyilima Rujugira wazunguye se Mazimpaka ku ngoma, nawe yahanze umurwa we, aho yawushyize i Ntora ya Bwanacyambwe, ahaje guhinduka Gisozi ku ndunduro y’ingoma ye. Ahari umurwa wa Rujugira kuri ubu ni mu Mudugudu wa Ntora wo mu Kagali ka Ruhango mu Murenge wa Gisozi wo mu Karere ka Gasabo. Kigeli Ndabarasa wafashije se Rujugira kwanamiza ibitero by’ibihugu bine byari byishyize hamwe ngo byagirize u Rwanda, we yatembye asubira kuri Gakondo ya ba sekuruza i Gasabo aba ariho ashinga umurwa we. Impamvu yashinze umurwa we i Gasabo, kwari ukugira ngo ahindure amateka y’abamubanjirije mu kwagura u Rwanda aho berekezaga mu Burengerazuba, we ahugukira kwagura u Rwanda yomekaho ubutaka bwo mu bihugu by’Iburasirazuba. Akimara gushinga umurwa we i Gasabo, yihatiye gushimangira ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda mu ngoma ya Ndorwa yari yigaruriwe vuba, anashyira imbaraga mu kwigarurira ingoma y’u Rweya rw’Abazigaba, ashirwa abigezeho.  Umuhungu we Mibambwe Sentabyo na we ntiyigeze yimura umurwa we, yawuhamishije i Gasabo, dore ko yanimikiwe hafi y’Ikiyaga cya Muhanzi mu Murenge wa Gasange wo muri Gatsibo hateganye n’I Gasabo. N’ubwo ingoma ye itateye kabiri kubera abavandimwe be barimo Gasenyi na Gatarabuhura bamurwanyije agatanga amaze ku ngoma imyaka itarenga ine, ariko yakomeje ubutegetsi bwe ari mu Murwa Mukuru w’I Gasabo mu gicumbi cy’Abakurambere bahanze u Rwanda. Mu bice bikurikiyeho tuzarushaho kubatekerereza indi mirwa y’abami b’u Rwanda, kugeza ku ndunduro y’ingoma ya cyami, ubwo yabererekeraga Repubulika.

title: Inkomoko y’Insigamugani ‘Nzarya ikindi nsibe inyama y’ibusinga’
content:
Wakomotse ku iteka Yuhi Gahindiro yaciriye mu Ruhango rwa Mutakara na Nyamagana, akurije ku rupfu rw’umugabo Kibugenza wiciye umusinga iwabo mu Ndorwa (Byumba), nyuma inzigo ye igahorwa n’undi musinga w’i Nduga, ahagana mu mwaka w’i 1800. Uwo mugabo Kibugenza yapfuye amazi y’inka n’umusinga wo mu Ndorwa bari ku ibuga; barayarwanira Kibugenza amutera icumu aramurambika. Abasinga bene wabo b’uwo wapfuye bakora ku muheto bashaka guhora. Kibugenza aca mu nkindi, ajya ibwami mu Ruhango rwa Mutakara na Nyamagana gusisha inzigo. Agezeyo asaba icyanzu aragihabwa; atekerereza Gahindiro uko yishe uwo muntu, avuga ko nta nzika bari basanzwe bagirana. Gahindiro n’abari aho, bumvise ko nta cyo bari basanzwe bapfa, bemeza guca inzigo. Gahindiro agena abatware bazatangaza ko yaciye inzigo ya Kibugenza n’abasinga. Kibugenza aranezerwa, arahaguruka arivuga akura ubwatsi kuko akize inzigo. Abari aho nabo bamukurira ubwatsi. Ubwo ariko muri bo hari harimo umusinga waje mu gitaramo, asaba umwami ijambo bisa n’aho ari ibiganiro ati “Nyagasani se ko uciye inzigo ngo ntihazagire umusinga uhora Kibugenza mu gihugu, nk’umusinga wava  hasi cyangwa hejuru se ngo aje agahora iyo nzigo byagenda bite?” Abari aho baramuseka, bati  “Vuga uvuye aho! Umusinga uzava ikuzimu cyangwa hejuru se ngo aje guhora ni musinga nyabaki?”  Kibugenza ati “Uwo we ntateye inkeke, niba anariho azaze ampore”.  Gahindiro ati “Nshiye inzigo mu gihugu naho iby’ikuzimu ni iby’ikuzimu, ibyo hejuru na byo ni ibyo hejuru”.
Nuko ajya kwibikira ishengero rirashenguruka, ariko wa musinga we yanga gutaha agumana n’abararirizi kugira ngo azabe indakekwa. Naho hagati aho yari yohereje undi musinga rwihishwa ngo ajye kurarika bene wabo bihishe mu myobo ku nzira, maze Kibugenza nahanyura bamaze gutangaza ko inzigo iciwe, hagire umurasira mu mwobo. Uwo we ni we wa musinga wo hasi. Nuko bukeye ku gasusuruko ingoma ijya ku nama, abatware babigenewe batangaza ko inzigo ya Kibugenza mu basinga iciwe, Kibugenza n’abe baranezerwa, bagenda amaterekamfizi bizihijwe n’uko bakize inzigo. Hafi y’inzira banyuzemo, hakaba umusinga umwe mu bararitswe wihishe mu mwobo. Kibugenza amugeze iruhande, undi arafora amukubita igisongo cy’umugano mu mpyiko irasohoka, amutsinda aho. Induru ziravuga bene wabo barumirwa bayoberwa aho ikimwishe giturutse. Barasakabaka bigera ibwami bati “Kibugenza arapfuye” Gahindiro ati “Yishwe n’iki?”  Kirayoberana biba urujijo. Gahindiro ni ko kubwira imbaga yumiwe iteraniye aho, ati “Noneho nimujye guhamba murekere iyo! Kandi nimujya kurya mujye murya inka, murye ihene, murye  ikindi ariko musibe inyama y’ibusinga”. Ubwo yavugaga ko Abasinga ari inkurubanwa nta wiba akabo ngo agaheze!. Umugani rero waduka ubwo, umuntu yajya kuvuga ahakana kutazakora icyamukoraho, ati “Nzarya ikindi nsibe inyama y’ibusinga”.  Ni ukuvuga ngo nzakina ku bindi nirinde akantu ka ba mudasigwa bakurikiranira utwabo hasi no kubura hejuru, ejo katangwaho nkakaryozwa.

title: RALC irashishikariza Abanyarwanda kugira umuco wo Kuremera
content: Mu kiganiro kirambuye, Umuyobozi w’Ishami ry’Umuco mu Nteko Nyarwanda y’Ururimi n’Umuco, Dr. Nzabonimpa Jacques yagaragaje ko “kuremera” ari igikorwa gisanzwe mu muco w’Abanyarwanda aho barebaga umuntu ukennye mu muryango, maze inshuti n’abavandimwe bakagira igikorwa bamukorera bamushakira ubushbozi kugira ngo agire icyo akora cyamufasha gutera imbere.  Ibyo byakundaga gukorwa nko mu gihe k’imihango yahuzaga inshuti n’abavandimwe nko mu gihe cyo kwizihiza umuganura, mu mihango y’ubukwe, mu gihe cyokwera, kubandwa n’ibindi. Bagiraga uburyo bafashanya bakareba umuntu umwe muri bo udatunze cyane bakamufasha bakamuzamura bakamuvana mu bukene bakamufasha kugira aho yigeza. Mu by’ukuri umuco wo kuremera ntawamenya igihe watangiriye mu Rwanda, Dr. Nzabonimpa we yemeza ko ari umuco watangiye kubaho kuva kera u Rwanda rwakwitwa u Rwanda akaba ari umuco dukomora kuri Gihanga Ngomijana wahanze u Rwanda. Ni kimwe mu byatumye Abanyarwanda baba abo baribo: “Abanyarwanda.” Dr. Nzabonimpa Jacques yagaragaje ko “kuremera”byakorwaga mu buryo bwinshi bitewe n’icyo uremewe akeneye kurusha ibindi kugira ngo abashe kwiteza imbere. Bashoboraga kumuha isambu, itungo, inganzo, umubyizi n’ibindi byinshi nyiri kuremerwa yashoboraga guheraho agakora maze akiteza imbere. “Kuremera” bitandukanye no “Guha umuntu iyabo” kuko byo byabaga ari uguha umuntu ibimuramira mu gihe gito bijyanye n’ibifungurwa. Naho uwo baremeraga we yabaga ahawe icyo aheraho kugira ngo atangire ubuzima bushya. Mu rurimi rw’iki gihe wavuga ko babaga bamuhaye “Umutahe cyangwa Igishoro.” Kuremera ni indangagaciro yisanisha n’indangagaciro remezo zose uko ari enye; Gukunda Igihugu, Ubumwe, Ubupfura no Gukunda Umurimo. Kuremera bisanishwa n’indangagaciro y’Ubumwe kuko kuremera byagaragazaga ubusabane hagati mu miryango, bigatsimbataza imibanire nyayo, ubufatanye, kubaha ikiremwamuntu, ubufatanye n’umuco w’amahoro no kubaha ubuzima. Kuremera birongera bikisanisha n’indangagaciro yo Gukunda Igihugu kubera ko iyo uremeye umuntu uba ugabanyije umutwaro ku gihugu, uba ugaragaje ubwitange, ubutwari bwo gufashanya n’abandi, ndetse no kugira ishyaka ryo gufasha abandi guhindura imibereho. Kuremera byisanisha nanone n’indangagaciro yo gukunda umurimo kubera ko kuremera byatumaga uwaremewe abasha kubona ubushobozi bwo gutangira gukora kuko yabaga abonye igishoro na we agakura amaboko mu mifuka akiteza imbere. Umuhango wo kuremera  wimakaza indangagaciro y’ubupfura kuko ni igikorwa cy’abantu bafite umutima ari ko kurangwa n’ubumuntu nk’uko Abanyarwanda bavugaga bati “Imfura ni zo bantu”, ubwitange, kuzirikana no kugira ubushishozi bwo gutuma abandi babaho neza. Dr. Nzabonimpa Jacques yasabye Abanyarwanda muri rusange gukomeza kugira umutima. Umunyarwanda akareba mugenzi we ufite ikibazo na we bikamutera ikibazo bigatuma atekereza kumufasha kuva mu bibazo nk’uko Abanyarwanda bavugaga bati “Ntamugabo umwe, nta muntu umwe, ntawigira n’izindi.” Biracyari mu muco, biracyari mu bumwe n’ubupfura bw’Abanyarwanda. Yasabye Abanyarwanda kuva mu kwikubira no kwihugiraho, asaba Abanyarwanda kuba Abanyarwanda barangwa n’umutima. “Umuco dusangiye uraturanga, ururimi rwacu rukaduhuza”

title: Inkomoko y’inyito y’umugezi wa Nyabugogo( Igice cya Kabiri)
content: Tugiye gukomeza kubatekerereza imvano y’inyito y’umugezi wa Nyabugogo wisuka mu ruzi rwa Nyabarongo, wabaye imvano y’inyito y’Utugali n’imidugudu myinshi mu Rwanda. Umutekereza w’amateka y’u Rwanda akaba n’umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, yagize icyo adutekerereza ku nkomoko y’izina ry’umugezi wa Nyabugogo, mu gitabo cye yise “ Intwari z’Imbanza, zubatse u Rwanda ruhagamya igitinyiro” n’ikindi kitwa “Ibirari by’amateka, inkomoko y’inyito y’ahantu”.  Aho agaragaza ko iyo nyito ikomoka ku misezero y’abami b’u Rwanda, bambukaga uwo mugezi  ukuka mu Kiyaga cya Muhazi, bakajya kubatabariza mu Murenge wa Rutare mu tugali twa Bikumba, Kigabiro,Gatwaro, Munanira, Gasharu na Nkoto Amateka y’inyito y’uwo mugezi, agaragaza ko mu ntango y’iyitwa ryawo, witwaga “Nyamigogo”  nyuma uza kwitwa “Nyabugogo” Bikuye ku mvugo yo gushyoma, agasuzuguro no gupfobya yagiye ikomoka ku mahari ibihugu by’ibituranyi by’u Rwanda rugali rwa Gasabo, byagiye bigira mu bihe byo kubyigarurira. Umugezi wa Nyamigogo,  wakorerwagaho imihango irebana n’ubuzima bw’igihugu cyane ku bijyanye n’ibiza byakururwa n’imigezi nk’uhagarariye imigezi yose yo mu Rwanda yisuka mu nzuzi zitandukanye. Ikiyaga cya Muhazi ari nacyo gihumekera mu mugezi wa Nyabugogo, cyahawe icyubahiro cyo guhagararira ibindi biyaga nk’amazi magari yari  mu Rwanda, mu gukorerwaho imihango nk’iyo yo kurinda igihugu ibiza bikomoka ku mvura no ku mazi adendeje cyangwa se atemba. Nk’umugezi wari ufite icyubahiro cyo kwambukirizwaho imigogo y’abami b’u Rwanda bashyinguwe mu misezero y’I Rutare, uwo mugezi wahawe izina rifatiye ku migogo y’abami bahambukirizwaga, niko kuwita ‘Nyamigogo’ nk’irifite igisobanuro cy’ukubiri kigenekereje kivuga “Umuzimanyi w’imigogo y’abami”  cyangwa se “inturo y’imigogo (imirambo) y’abami”  bikuye ku kuba barabanzaga kuvoma amazi y’uwo mugezi bakayeresha icyuhagiro imigogo y’abami b’u Rwanda mbere y’uko ijya gutabarizwa mu misezero y’i Rutare. Uko kuvoma amazi muri uwo mugezi bayuhagiza umugogo w’umwami, ababaga bahetse uwo mugogo babifataga nko kuzimanira umwami wabo, bakamumara inyota, dore ko kenshi babaga baturutse kure bitewe n’aho ingoro y’umwami yatangiyemo iherereye. Nyuma y’aho ku ngoma ya Cyilima Rujugira ahasaga mu wa 1795, u Rwanda rutangiye guhangana n’ibihugu byo mu Burasirazuba bw’u Rwanda cyane cyane mu Ndorwa n’u Rweya rw’u Mubali, nibwo hadutse izina “Nyabugogo”  ryahanzwe n’ingabo z’Abanyandorwa zari ku nkiko z’u Rwanda na Ndorwa       ( hariya ku Gaseke na Cyamutara) byo gupfobya no gusondeka abami b’u Rwanda bakabatesha agaciro no kubashyiraho igisuzuguriro uhereye no ku bakurambere babo batanze. Ikindi babikoreye, kwari ugukomeza ibikorwa by’ubushotoranyi bukora mu jisho umwami Cyilima Rujugira wari wahagurukiye kurwanya ibitero by’ibihugu bine byishyize hamwe (Ndorwa, Gisaka, Bugesera n’u Burundi, ngo bihanagureho u Rwanda. Kuva ku ngoma ya Cyilima Rujugira, iryo zina ry’umugezi wa Nyamigogo ryarahinduwe rikitwa Nyabugogo, riramamara kugeza magingo aya bitewe nuko nta washyize imbaraga mu gukuraho igisuzuguriro cyo guhindura iryo zina cyazanywe n’Abanyandorwa, abana b’u Rwanda ntibanakomeze kwibutswa amateka y’uwo mugezi ngo bayasigasire.  Iryo zina ryakomeje kwamamara rityo cyane cyane mu misozi y’ Iburasirazuba hari mu ngoma y’I Gisaka, banaryita imisozi myinshi yaho kugeza ubwo ryimukanwa n’igihe u Rwanda rwigaruriraga i Gisaka ku ngoma y’umwami Mutara Rwogera ahasaga mu wa 1850. Imwe mu misozi yo mu Gisaka yiswe Nyabugogo twavuga nka Nyabugogo ya Rugarama mu Murenge wa Nzige wo mu Karere ka Rwamagana, Nyabugogo ya Juru mu Murenge wa Gahini mu Karere ka Kayonza, na Nyabugogo ya Ruyumba mu Murenge wa Kabare mu Karere ka Kayonza. Uwo mwera waturutse mu Ndorwa ugakwira mu Gisaka bawusamiye hejuru kuko batacananaga uwaka n’u Rwanda, wageze aho ukwira no mu Bwanacyambwe bwa Kigali, bawusamira hejuru batabanje gusesengura. Izina rya Nyabugogo  nabo baryita imisozi yabo, karahava.  Muri yo misozi dusangamo nka Nyabugogo ya Kigali mu Karere ka Nyarugenge, Nyabugogo ya Kimisagara mu Murenge  wa Kimisagara, mu Karere ka Nyarugenge na Nyabugogo ya Muhima mu Karere ka Nyarugenge. Ngayo ng’uko, reka twoye ayo! Naho amateka aratuba iyo uyabariwe utayisomeye! Ng’iyo inkomoko y’inyito y’umugezi wa Nyabugogo waryiswe mu rwego rwo gupfobya u Rwanda n’abami barwo.

title: Imitako ya Kinyarwanda yatanzweho impano mu isangira ry’abayobozi ba Rotary (Amafoto)
content: Itsinda ry’aba bayobozi 50 ku wa 17-18 Gicurasi 2019 bateraniye mu Mujyi wa Kigali mu mahugurwa yagarutse ku iterambere rya Rotary muri Afurika. Bayasoje bakirwa mu nkera y’igitaramo cya Kinyarwanda aho basangijwe umuco Nyarwanda binyuze mu mbyino n’indirimbo zo hambere; cyabereye muri Marriott Hotel ku mugoroba wo ku wa 18 Gicurasi 2019. Rotary yo mu Rwanda yari ihagarariwe n’abayobozi b’ama-clubs yayo atandatu n’abandi banyamuryango, banashimiwe umuhate mu migendekere myiza y’icyo gikorwa. Barimo Perezida wa Rotary Club Kigali Doyen, Eddy Kimenyi Sebera; uwa Kigali Mont Jali, Kabandana Aimé; uwa Kigali Virunga, Saudah Nalule n’uwa Kigali Gasabo, Stella Kalisa. Biyongeraho Ndoba Mugunga na Birungi Paul Masterjerb babaye abayobozi bungirije Guverineri wa Rotary District 9150 ibarizwamo ibihugu 10 birimo n’u Rwanda. Abitabiriye igitaramo bizihiwe no gutaramana n’Itorero Inyamibwa ryaserutse mu mbyino gakondo n’umudiho w’intore ugaragaza umuco gakondo. Ababyinnyi bagisesekara imbere y’abayobozi muri Rotary, abenshi bahise bazamura telefoni, batangira gutafa amafoto n’amashusho y’urwibutso rw’imbyino zaherekeje ibihe byiza bagiriye i Kigali. Buri ndirimbo yasozwaga, bayiherekesha amashyi agaragaza kunyurwa, ndetse ab’inkwakuzi bafatanyije n’ababyinnyi kubyina, banisunga intore barataraka. Umuyobozi wungirije Guverineri wa Rotary Club mu Karere ka 9150 kagizwe n’ibihugu 10 birimo n’u Rwanda, Rugera Jeannette, yavuze ko bishimiye kwakira aba bayobozi. Yagize ati “Badufashije kumenya byimbitse imikorere ya Rotary kuko bafite ubunararibonye. Ni abantu bayimazemo imyaka myinshi kandi bakoze  amahugurwa kenshi.’’ Yakomeje avuga ko “Hari ibyo twasogongeye, byatugiriye akamaro, batweretse uko twashaka abanyamuryango bashya, batwigishije uko twashaka inkunga zidufasha gukora imishinga n’ibindi.’’ Muri uyu muhango kandi aba bayobozi bahawe imitako n’ibihangano byakozwe n’abanyabugeni b’Abanyarwanda birimo inigi, imigongo n’ibindi bikoresho byifashishwaga hambere. Rugera yabwiye IGIHE ko “Impano zatanzwe nk’uburyo bwo guteza imbere ibikorerwa mu Rwanda. Inkunga yakusanyijwe izatangwa muri Rotary Foundation, ifasha ama-clubs yose ku Isi gukora imishinga itandukanye.” Mu bihangano byatangiwe muri ibi birori kimwe kizoherezwa mu biro Afurika ihuriraho n’u Burayi. Igihangano cyakorewe mu Rwanda kizaba icya mbere kigaragaza umuco wa Afurika kihagejejwe. Rugera yavuze ko “Ni ishema ku Rwanda kuba ari igihangano cya mbere kigiye kujya mu biro bya Rotary International. Bizatuma barushaho kumenya u Rwanda. Bizabatera amatsiko bavuge bati ‘iki gihangano cyavuye he?’” Rotary International ifite icyicaro muri Amerika ariko agace gahuriyemo Afurika n’ibihugu byo mu Majyepfo y’u Burayi gafite ibiro i Zurich mu Busuwisi. Visi Perezida wa Rotary International, Yinka Babalola, yavuze ko igihangano cyavuye mu Rwanda kizoherezwa muri ibyo biro guhagararira umuco wa Afurika. Yagize ati “Nk’Umuyobozi wa Afurika nifuza ko ibiro byacu bigira ibiranga umugabane. Buri gihe niyemeje kuzajya mpa umuyobozi ubikoreramo igihangano giturutse muri Afurika.’’ Yashimye urugwiro beretswe n’abanyamuryango ba Rotary muri Kigali. Ati “Bagenzi banjye twaganiriye biyumvisemo ikaze hano i Kigali. Mwatumye twumva turi mu rugo, Kigali yaduhaye byose twifuzaga.” Yavuze ko bahisemo gukorera amahugurwa mu Rwanda kuko kurugeramo byoroshye. Ati “Twaturutse mu bihugu 15 bya Afurika, twashakaga ahantu hadahenze kandi horoshye kuhagera. Ikindi ni uko ari ahantu hashobora kuboneka abantu bavuga Igifaransa n’Icyongereza ku buryo abanyamuryango ba Rotary bahisanga.” Rotary ishaka umuti w’ibibazo birimo kurwanya ubujiji n’ubukene, kwegereza ubuvuzi kuri bose, kunoza imitangire y’amazi meza, kurwanya ibyorezo, guhashya indwara y’imbasa no gufasha abababaye. Masterjerb Paul Birungi wabaye Guverineri wungirije muri District 9150 ibarizwamo u Rwanda, yavuze ko Rotary ifata inkingi zose z’iterambere. Yagize ati “Turateganya gukorana na Minisante, mu gushinga club y’abaganga gusa, kuko batabona umwanya uhagije ariko tuzafatanya ku buryo ibitekerezo byabo tubyohereze mu bindi bihugu.” Yavuze ko Rotary atari umuryango w’abakire mu mufuka ahubwo ni ‘abakire mu bitekerezo no mu mitima.’ Rotary Clubs y’u Rwanda igizwe n’ama-clubs atandatu abarizwamo abanyamuryango 102. Buri wese ahabwa inshingano zo kwinjiza nibura umunyamuryango umwe mu mwaka. Rotary International ibarizwamo abanyamuryango miliyoni 1.22 mu ma Rotary Clubs 35, 000 mu bihugu n’uduce birenga 220.
