title: Inkomoko y’inyito  Nyabugogo( Igice cya Mbere)
content: Tugiye kubatekerereza imvano y’inyito y’umugezi wa Nyabugogo wisuka mu ruzi rwa Nyabarongo, wabaye imvano y’inyito y’Utugali n’imidugudu myinshi mu Rwanda. Umutekereza w’amateka y’u Rwanda akaba n’umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, yagize icyo adutekerereza ku nkomoko y’izina ry’umugezi wa Nyabugogo, mu gitabo cye yise “ Intwari z’Imbanza, zubatse u Rwanda ruhagamya igitinyiro”n’ikindi kitwa “Ibirari by’amateka, inkomoko y’inyito y’ahantu”. Izina Nyabugogo  rikomoka ku misezero y’abami b’u Rwanda, bambukaga uwo mugezi  ukuka mu Kiyaga cya Muhazi, bakajya kubatabariza mu Murenge wa Rutare mu Karere ka Gicumbi kuri ubu. Abasiganuzi b’amateka bagaragaza ko mu ntango umugezi wa Nyabugogo witwaga “ Nyamigogo”. Nyabugogo byavuye ku mvugo yo gushyoma, agasuzuguro no gupfobya yagiye ikomoka ku mahari ibihugu by’ibituranyi by’u Rwanda rugari rwa Gasabo, byagiye bigira mu bihe byo kubyigarurira. Nk’uko tubimenyereye mu Ikeshamvugo ry’Ikinyarwanda, umugogo bivuga “Umurambo w’umwami”  bikaba bigaragaza ko uwo mugezi witiriwe Imigogo y’abami b’u Rwanda yahambutswaga bagiye kuyitabariza i Rutare mu Buganza bwa Ruguru.  Mbere y’uko bambuka uwo mugezi, babanzaga kuhakorera imihango ibanzizira kuwambuka bajya gutabariza umwami. Imwe mu mihango bahakoreraga irimo no kuvoma amazi muri uwo mugezi, bakayavanga n’ingwa y’inono n’amazi y’ubuhoro, bagakozamo icyuhagiro, barangiza bakayatera ku mugogo w’umwami watanze, ayandi bakayiyuhagira, bakabona kwambuka bajya kuwutabariza mu misezero yagenewe abami b’u Rwanda aho i Rutare. Impamvu nyamukuru yatumaga bakora uwo muhango wo gutera icyuhagiro umugogo w’umwami watanze, yari ugukumira ibiza n’imyuzure bikomoka ku migezi n’ibiyaga biri mu Rwanda.  Uwo  muhango kandi wahamyaga  imitsindo ku banyarwanda, ko umuntu wese uzagwa mu ruzi cyangwa se mu mugezi atazarohama cyangwa se ngo yicwe nayo. Icyatumaga abagiye gutabariza umwami biyuhagirira muri uwo mugezi, ni uko nabo bashakaga kwambuka binjira mu misezero y’abami b’u Rwanda bera, basa neza, nta mwanda bafite. Umwami Kigeli Mukobanya, watwaye u Rwanda ahasaga mu wa 1378 kugeza mu wa 1411, ni we wabaye umwami wa mbere uzwi watabarijwe i Rutare ukurikije uruhererekane ry’abami batwaye u Rwanda, niwe waciye iteka rishyiraho ahantu mwihariko hagenewe imisezero y’abami b’u Rwanda. Yabitewe n’uko abami bamubanjirije, bari bafite imisezero inyanyagiye hirya no hino mu gihugu, ku buryo wabonaga bibangamye . Icyatumye Mukobanya asaba ubutaka bwo gushyinguramo abami b’u Rwanda mu Burasirazuba bwarwo, nabwo bwari uburyo bwo kubungabunga amateka y’u Rwanda agaragaza aho baturutse baza guhanga ingoma y’i Gasabo. Twibuke ko banyuze mu bihugu by’i Burasirazuba, barabyambuka baza guhanga ibihugu byabo hakuno ya Muhazi. Amazi magari bambutse baza guhanga igihugu, bagombaga no kuyambuka bagisezeramo. Niko kurambagiza ubutaka bwegeranye neza n’i Gasabo, ahitamo mu Murenge wa Rutare mu ngoma y’u Buganza. Muri ibyo bihe, Mukobanya yaciye iteka ko ubutaka bwose buri hakurya y’uwo mugezi, bugomba kuba indeka y’ingoma y’u Rwanda, ikaba umwihariko w’imisezero y’abami bayo. Yongeyeho ko niba hari abaturage bahatuye batarimurwa, cyangwa abahaturiye n’abashobora kuhanyura bagiye mu miryango yabo ariko bambutse uwo mugezi, bagomba kubanza kuwiyuhagiriramo cyangwa se bakiraba ku gahanga bakoresheje icyuhagiro, bakabona kuwambuka. Ibyo byaterwaga n’igenantekerezo ry’Abanyarwanda, ko ahari imisezero y’abami hagomba kurindwa ubwandure. Uhanyuze wese agomba kwizirura akabwinjiramo yeze. Kuva iryo teka ryacibwa, mu kwezi kwa Kamena kwa buri mwaka, Abiru b’ibanga ry’ingoma bafataga amazi y’ubuhoro yavomwaga mu mariba ya Rwezangoro mu Bwanacyambwe, bagafata n’ingwa y’inono (Ifu y’ingwa yera de) bakaza kuhakorera imihango yo kuzirura uwo mugezi n’ igihugu, kugira ngo umwaka ukurikiyeho abaturage bazahanyura bakahakarabira, bazabe baziruwe nk’uko ayo mazi aziruwe. Mu gice gikurikiraho, tuzakomerezaho tubatekerereza iby’amateka y’umugezi wa Nyamigogo waje guhindurirwa izina ukitwa Nyabugogo, kugeza magingo aya ubwo aya mateka yandikwaga.

title: Menya Bushayija Pascal, nyir’ibihangano bimanitse mu nzu z’abanyacyubahiro
content:
Ni we wakoze igishushanyo kiriho ifoto ya Perezida Kagame na Museveni cyagurishijwe agera kuri miliyoni 34 Frw ubwo hashakwaga inkunga yo kubaka ishuri rya Ntare aba bakuru b’ibihugu bavomyeho ubumenyi. Yakoze ibindi birimo impano Perezida Kagame yahaye mugenzi we wa Tanzania John Pombe Magafuli ubwo yasuraga Tanzaniya muri Mutarama 2018. Ni we wakoze igihangano Perezida Kagame yahawe n’Intore z’Indatabigwi zigizwe n’abahanzi n’abanyabugeni, Imparirwakubarusha zigizwe n’abakora siporo zitandukanye ndetse n’Impamyabigwi zigizwe n’abanyamakuru. Ni byinshi yakoze byamuhesheje amafaranga abarirwa muri miliyoni amagana mu myaka irenga 35 amaze ari umunyabugeni. Yihariye ku gukora ibihangano bigaragaza umuco nyarwanda akanakoresha ibarizo ry’ibiti bitandukanye mu kongera ubwiza bw’ibyo akora. Yagiranye ikiganiro kirambuye na IGIHE atubwira byinshi ku buhanzi bwe. IGIHE: Watangiye ibijyanye n’ubugeni ryari?
 Bushayija:  Ibi bintu mu by’ukuri navuga ko mbimazemo imyaka irenga 35 ariko ntabwo ari ibintu biba byarapfuye kwizana gusa ahubwo ni ibintu biba biri mu maraso umuntu aba yaravukanye. Ndabyibuka neza nkiri mu mashuri abanza, ukuntu nashushanyaga amanota ya mbere nabaga nziko ari ayanjye  mu ishuri. Noneho nza kujya kubyika ku Nyundo muri Ecole d’Arts, nkiva mu mashuri abanza niho nahise nkomereza, niho naje kugiramo ubunararibonye buhagije n’ibyo ntashoroga guhishura muri njyewe nagize amahirwe yo kubimenyera aho. IGIHE: Nyuma yo kuva Muri Ecole D’Arts wakomereje he?
 Bushayija:  Nyuma yo kuva muri Ecole D’Arts ni ibintu byari bindimo, numvaga no mu buzima bwanjye ari ibintu ngomba kuzakora mu buzima bwanjye bwose. Naragiye njya gukora mu ruganda rwa Pfunda nk’imyaka itatu, nabwo byari ibintu bijyanye no kwandika ibyapa byo gushyira mu mirima y’icyayi. Amasezerano y’imyaka itatu nari mpafite arangiye, nteganya kuzaza i Kigali kuko mu murwa mukuru niho numvaga abantu bashobora kuba babizi. Muri icyo gihe naje kugira amahirwe muri Ecole D’Arts baza kumpa akazi kuko bari bakeneye abarimu. Narahigishije kuva muri 1984 kugeza mu 1994. Mu 1994 nibwo habaye Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, noneho ibikorwa byose bisa nk’ibihagarara. Ndeba igihe ishuri rizongera gufungurira mbona bitanshobokera nza inaha i Kigali mba ariho mbikomereza. Icyo gihe byararuhanyije cyane kuko abanyarwanda babyiyumvagamo bari bake cyane. Bumvaga ko ibi bintu bitabareba ari iby’abanyamahanga. Twakoze agashyirahamwe k’abantu batarenze bane, kugira ngo nitujya dukora amamurika tujye dutumiramo abanyarwanda. Twumvikana ko ibihangano tuzajya dukora bizajya biba byiganjemo umuco nyarwanda. IGIHE: Ko abakobwa bakunze gukururwa cyane n’udushushanyo, wigeze ubikoresha mu kurambagiza? Bushayija: Narabikoreshaga icyo gihe ahubwo n’akarusho narushaga abandi nabikoraga neza. Hari n’abandi banyeshuri bagenzi banjye bashakaga nko kwandika utubaruwa bakaza bakanshushanyishaho uturabo kugira ngo gashimishe uwakandikiwe. IGIHE: Nta gihangano wibuka wahaye umukunzi wawe?
 Bushayija:  [Aseka] Ntabwo mbyibuka kuko nagiye nkora byinshi ariko nk’uwo twakundanaga birumvikana ikintu cya mbere nagombaga kumuha kugira ngo kimushimishe ni ukubanza kumushushanyiriza nk’agashushanyo keza.
Buriya abakobwa bakunda ibintu by’indabo. Byatumaga urukundo rwiyongera kuko wabaga uzi uruhande rwe rw’intege nke rwatuma agukunda kurushaho. IGIHE: Ni ikihe gihangano wakoze wumva utazibagirwa?
 Bushayija: Igihangano cya mbere na mbere nakoze kugeza kuri uyu munota ntekereza nkumva kingenze ahantu, nanjye ubwanjye hari igihe ntekereza ngo uwakimpa nkongera nkakireba. Ni igihangano nakoze ndangiza kwiga.
Igihangano cyansabye gutekereza, kikansaba n’imbaraga nyinshi mu mutwe, izina ryacyo ntabwo ari njye waryihitiyemo, abatwigishaga nibo baduhitiragamo insanganyamatsiko. Ni igishushanyo kitwa “La Fin du Monde” [umunsi w’imperuka]. Barambazaga bati ‘urumva umunsi w’imperuka uzaba umeze ute, nta kwibanda ku byo wasomye muri Bibiliya cyangwa ibyo wumvise ahantu’? Bigushyira mu bihe ugeramo ukumva ubaye nk’umusazi. Naragikoze kigira n’amanota ya mbere noneho bahita bakijyana mu Bubiligi, bashobora kuba barakijyanye mu nzu ndangamurage y’i Liège kandi icyo gihe hari mu 1978. IGIHE: Ubwo icyo gihangano cyari kimeze gute?
 Bushayija:   Hari harimo ibintu byinshi harimo bimwe nibuka n’ibindi ntibuka. Ibintu byadogereye, ubona ikirere cyahindutse cyabaye kibi cyane. Hari ibintu by’ibirunga biri gutomboka, abantu bari kwiruka batazi iyi bagana, abagore bahetse abana bari kujugunya, batazi iyo bagana bari kubona ibyo bintu bidasanzwe. IGIHE: Hari amamurika waba waritabiriye hanze y’u Rwanda?
 Bushayija: Naje kugira amahirwe yo kujya hanze mpura n’abandi banyabugeni mpuzamahanga nkajya njya aho bakorera nkahakura ubunararibonye butandukanye. Bwa mbere nagiye mu Bufaransa ahantu hitwa Mâcon mpakorera imurika ndanahakorera, ndahava njya Montignac hari iserukiramuco ryamaze ibyumweru bibiri, hanyuma njya Saint Malo naho mpamara ibyumweru bibiri mbona kugaruka.
Nyuma yaho nagiye muri Afurika y’Epfo, mvuyeyo nsubira mu Bufaransa, aho mperuka kumurika ibihangano hanze ni Busuwisi mu mujyi wa Fribourg nahakoreye ibyumweru bibiri. IGIHE: Nta bihembo ku rwego mpuzamahanga wigeze wegukana?
 Bushayija: Ntabwo nabikoraga mu rwego rw’amarushanwa, nabikoraga gusa mu buryo bwo guhagararira igihugu kugira ngo babone ko u Rwanda rutasigaye mu bintu bijyanye n’ubugeni. IGIHE: Ni ibihe bihangano byawe uziko abantu benshi bashobora kuba bazi?
 Bushayija: Urebye izina rya Bushayija rirazwi. Urebye mu mahoteli menshi ya hano i Kigali birahari. Nko kuri Grand Legacy ibishushanyo byose bihari ni ibyanjye. Hari igishushanyo nakoze ntazibagirwa. Kimwe kiri iburyo ikindi ibumuso aho bakirira abantu. Kimwe gifite nka metero 12 iva nko itaje ya mbere igafata nko ku ya gatandatu. Byantwaye umwanya kubitekerezaho kuko ni nk’ikizamini bari bampaye. Bayinyishuye miliyoni 20. Ni cyo gihangano nakoze cyantwaye igihe kandi ngishyiraho no gutekereza bihagije. IGIHE: Ni bihe bihangano bindi wagurishije amafaranga menshi
 Bushayija:  Ibihangano nshobora kuba naragurishije amafaranga menshi ni impano bahaye perezida wa Repubulika bizihiza imyaka 100 y’umujyi wa Kigali. Yaguzwe nk’amayero ibihumbi 4. Hari indi nakoze bayishyize mu cyamunara nubwo ayo mafaranga atagiye mu mufuka wanjye ariko byanteye ishema, yaguzwe amafaranga agera kuri miliyoni 34. Hari ikindi gihangano nakoreye Profemme Twese Hamwe, nacyo bagishyize mu cyamunara nayo kigeza muri miliyoni 18. IGIHE: Igishushanyo abahanzi, abakinnyi n’abanyamakuru bahaye Perezida Kagame wagikoreye angahe?
 Bushayija: Kiriya cyo kirasanzwe n’amafaranga nagikoreye nayo ni amafaranga asanzwe ariko ku giti cyanjye numvise binshimishije. Kubona igihangano nka kiriya baguha amafaranga nka miliyoni bibi ari ibyo. IGIHE: Ku kwezi winjiza amafaranga angana iki?
 Bushayija: [Aseka] Byaba ari ibanga. IGIHE: Ni ikihe gihangano udashobora gukora?
 Bushayija: Igihangano ntakora ni nko kunzanira nk’ifoto y’igihangano cyakozwe n’undi munyabugeni, ukambwira ngo ninkigane, ntabwo nshobora kukikwemerera. Icyo gihe mba ngiye mu nganzo y’undi kandi nawe ubwe aramutse amenye ko namwiganiye igihangano cye afite uburenganzira bwo kujya kubiregera. Ibindi ntashobora kukwemerera nk’urugero ukaba wabambwira uti nkore igihangano gisebya umuntu runaka cyangwa gisebya igihugu. Icyo gihe nakubwira nti ‘shaka ahandi ibyo ntabwo nabikwemerera’. IGIHE: Hari umuntu wari gusaba ko umukorera igihangano ukabyanga?
 Bushayija: Barahari nka 50 bagiye banzanira ibihango bakambwira nko mbyigane. IGIHE: Wari warota igihangano bugacya ugikora?
 Bushayija: Bijya bimbaho cyane. Akenshi na kenshi ibi bintu twirirwamo ni nabyo turaramo mu nzozi. Burya biba byiza iyo uraje iruhande rwawe ikaramu n’ikayi wakwicura agahita wandika ku buryo igihe kizaza bizagufura ku buryo ubona uko uhanga. IGIHE: Mu bagukomokaho hari abagukurikije.
 Bushayija: Ngira abakobwa babiri umuto ni we nabonye ubikunda cyane ariko navuga ko ari nk’ibintu twakuranye iwacu. Mfite mukuru wanjye nakurikiraga nibyo yize n’uwankurikiraga nibyo yize. IGIHE: Mu myaka 35 umaze uri umunyabugeni bwakugejeje kuki?
 Bushayija: Mu mikurire yacu ntabwo byari byoroshye n’ababyeyi bacu ntabwo babyiyumvagamo na gato. Tekereza ko mu buzima bwanjye nta kindi kintu nigeze nkora. Navuga ko byangejeje ku bintu byinshi nk’aha ndi ni mu gipangu cyanjye niyubakiye ntabwo nkodesha kandi nta handi nakuye amafaranga. Byagiye bituma menyana n’abandi banyabugeni bakomeye, byibura nkashobora kuva mu Rwanda nkanjya hanze nabwo ni ubundi bukungu abandi ntibabibona ariko ni njye ubibona. IGIHE: Ujya uteganya guhagarika uyu mwuga ? Bushayija: Njyewe uko mbitekereza numva ntazi igihe ibi bintu nzabihagarikira. Numva igihe ngifite ubuzima nzakomeza kubikora. Nta gihe ibitekerezo bitaza, ntabwo ari kimwe n’akandi kazi umuntu ajya mu kiruhuko cy’izabukuru. Dore nk’ubu mfite imyaka 62 ariko ubu nibwo numva mfite ubushake bwo kujya nkora cyane.

title: Nyakarundi yasohoye igitabo gikebura abafite inzozi zo kuba i Burayi na Amerika
content:
Ubuzima bw’urugendo bwa Nyakarundi muri Amerika butangirra ubwo yavaga i Bujumbura mu 1996 aje i Kigali gufata indege yamwerekeje i Washington DC. Washington DC yahavuye ajya muri Leta ya Georgia aho yari asanze mama we na mushiki we, atangira ubuzima bw’amahanga atari amenyereye mu gihugu atagiragamo inshuti  atazi n’ururimi rwaho. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE, Nyakarundi avuga ko nk’umwana muto wari wisanze mu mahanga, ubuzima bwamugoye cyane kuko ibyo yari yaramenyereye yasanze atari ko bigenda mu mahanga. Ati “Muri Afurika tugira umugisha ko abantu bo mu mijyi baba bafite abakozi mu rugo babafasha guteka no gukora isuku. Muri Amerika ibyo ntibibayo. Ugomba kwikorera buri cyose. Byansabye guhindura imikorere. Twari dutuye kure y’umujyi, bikadusaba isaha mu modoka ngo tugere mu mujyi buri munsi, nta nshuti nari mpafite nirirwaga  nigunze.”
Muri Mutarama 1997, Nyakarundi yatangiye ishuri ingorane zirakomeza kuko mu mezi ane gusa atari yakamenye Icyongereza cyangwa ngo agire inshuti. Nibura byamufashe imyaka ibiri ngo abashe kumenyera ubuzima bwo muri Amerika. Muri Amerika yamazeyo imyaka 17, nyuma  aza gufata umwanzuro wo kugaruka muri Afurika aba rwiyemezamirimo, ari nako ahugura urubyiruko rugitangira ubucuruzi. Uko yagendaga ahura n’urubyiruko rutandukanye, yarusanganye imyumvire y’uko Amerika n’i Burayi bumva ari ahantu heza hataba ibibazo, ahitamo kwandika igitabo kivuga kubyo yaciyemo kugira ngo abashaka kujya muri ibyo bihugu bagenda basobanukiwe neza uko hateye. Ati “Nahisemo  gusangiza abandi ubunararibonye bwanjye kugira ngo nerekane ko uko twumva i Burayi na Amerika buri gihe atari ko abari ukuri, kandi tugomba guhindura uburyo dufata Afurika.” Mu gitabo My African Dream, Nyakarunda asobanura uburyo yavuye muri Afurika yumva ari ahantu habi, nyuma akaza gusanga ariho hari amahirwe menshi kuri we. Yagize ati “Ibyo nagezeho mu myaka itandatu maze muri Afurika birenze ibyo nagezeho mu myaka 17 namaze muri Amerika.” Nyakarundi yavuze ko ahantu hose ahaba ibyiza n’ibibi kuko no muri Amerika yafataga nk’ahantu heza yahasanze abakene ba nyuma. Ati “Ubwo nageraga muri Amerika nahabonye abantu baba ku mihanda birantangaza. Ntabwo numvaga ko naho haba abantu baba ku muhanda bajya gushakisha ibiryo aho bamennye imyanda. Ahantu hose haba ibyiza n’ibibi.” Ku muntu ushaka gutera imbere, Nyakarundi avuga ko Afurika ariho hantu heza ho gukorera kuko hari byinshi byabyazwa umusaruro. Yasobanuye ko nko muri Amerika aho yabaga, haba guhangana no gukoresha ingufu nyinshi kuko icyo uvumbuye uyu munsi, ejo haba havumbuwe ikindi kirusha icyawe ubushobozi. Amerika kandi Nyakarundi avuga ko ari igihugu cya  ba nyamwigendaho, aho nta wundi uba akwitayeho. Ati “ Niho hantu hakomeye nabayemo mu buzima. Buri gihe uba urwana no kwishyura amadeni , ntabwo ubona uko wishimira ubuzima. Nta mwanya wo guhura n’umuryango ubona  ariko muri Afurika biratandukanye.Afurika niho hantu heza ho kugirira umuryango, ntihahenda.” Nyakarundi yavuze ko igitabo My African Dream kitagamije kwangisha cyangwa gukundisha abagisoma amahanga, ahubwo ko ari uburyo bwo kumenya neza ubuzima bwo hanze ku buryo n’ugiyeyo agenda yiteguye. Iki gitabo My African Dream  kiboneka mu nzu y’ibitabo Charisma Bookstore iri mu nyubako ya Kigali Heights mu mujyi wa Kigali. Ushobora kandi kugisanga kuri Amazon.

title: Inkomoko y’Insigamugani “Ni mu rya Bilindi”
content: Aba agereranyije iryo joro  n’iry’umutasi wa Cyilima Rugwe witwaga Bilindi yagenzemo  ajya i Bugesera gutata ubukwe bwa Nyanguge ya Sagashya, ahagana mu mwaka w’i 1400. Icyo gihe Cyirima Rugwe Umwami w’u Rwanda na Nsoro Bihembe, umwami w’u Bugesera bagiganiraga umukobwa w’umukonokazi witwaga Nyanguge ya Sagashya; umwe ashaka  kuba ari we umurongora ku mugaragaro, naho Cyilima Rugwe atanga Nsoro kumurongora rwihishwa, mu ijoro rimwe n’iryo yarongoweho na Nsoro ku mugaragaro. Niho hakomotse imihango y’ubukundwakare Nyanguge yahize bakeba be, agira ati “Ndabaruta jye warongowe n’abami babiri ijoro rimwe” bimuviramo  impamvu yamutanije na Nsoro agacyurwa  na Cyilima Rugwe, bakabyarana Kigeli Mukobanya. Uwo mugabo Bilindi wakomotsweho n’iyi nsigamugani, nyina yari umuhondogokazi, ukomoka mu bikomangoma by’i Bugesera. Ni we wari umutasi wa Cyilima Rugwe wahoraga atata igihe ubukwe bwa Nsoro na Nyanguge buzabera, kugira ngo amutange kumurongora, nk’uko indagu zari zabyemeje, ko azabyara umwami w’u Rwanda, n’ubwo yasabwe na Nsoro akanamukwa, na Cyilima agasubirayo nawe agasaba agakwa. Mu gihe umunsi w’ubukwe wari umaze kumenyekana, Bilindi yaherekeje Cyilima bajya mu Bugesera gutaha ubukwe nk’abandi bose ariko umugambi ari uko nibamara gukora ibirori by’ubukwe, Cyilima akora uko ashoboye akarongora Nyangunge mbere ya Nsoro. Nuko Cyilima amaze kurongora uwo mukobwa Nyanguge, ku mpamvu z’imitsindo bari baziranyeho dore  bombi bari bazi ko azavukaho igihangange, Cyilima yigarukira i Rwanda ijoro ryose atinya ko hagira impamvu ituma bamenya ko yarongoye Nyanguge rwihishwa; agarukana na Bilindi Baje byo kwihamba batazi ko bari bugere mu Rwanda, bikubitiyeho ko no kuva i Bugesera ukagera i Kigali aho Cyilima Rugwe yari atuye hari ishyamba ry’umutamenwa; gusa Bilindi yari azi inzira neza kuko yayicagamo kenshi ajya kwa ba nyirarume b’Abahondogo mu Bugesera. Nuko bihereza  iryo shyamba, bararyogoga bagera i Kigali mu gicuku cya nyuma gishyira urukerera. Abararirizi bari kwa Cyilima babakubise amaso baratangara, bati “Iri joro rya Bilindi na Cyilima bariturutse he?” Abandi baricecekera, ku bwa ya mabanga bari bafitanye kuko  mu Rwanda nta muntu wari uzi ko Cyilima yarongoye Nyanguge rwihishwa na Nsoro wamusabye atabizi. Cyilima Rugwe amaze kugaruka i Rwanda, Nsoro asigarana Nyanguge kuko ari we wamurongoye ku mugaragaro ; kurongora kwa Cyilima ko nta wundi wari ukuzi, uretse gusa ko bari bazi ko Nyanguge yasabwe n’abo bami kandi bombi bagakwa ; ni na byo byatangazaga rubanda bagira, bati “Uriya mugabo Sagashya wakiriye inkwano z’abami babiri azabigenza ate?". Ubwo Cyilima Rugwe amaze kugaruka, akajya atuma Bilindi kuri Nyanguge akamwoherereza intashyo. Bilindi akagenda rwihishwa ijoro ryose kugeza igihe Nyanguge yanganye na Nsoro bapfuye ya mihigo yo guhiga na bakeba be ngo “ arabaruta yarongowe n’abami babiri mu ijoro rimwe”. Cyilima amaze kumenya ko Nyanguge yatanye na Nsoro, ahera ko yohereza Bilindi ku basare b’i Bugesera kuko ari we bari baziranye,  amuha n’amakoro y’amagumba y’ibimasa ngo bazambutse Nyanguge bitagoranye. Bilindi amaze gushyikiriza abasare, ajyana amaturo kwa Sagashya. Amaze kugerayo avuga ubutumwa bwa Cyilima, barabwemera biba gutebutsa kuko yari yarakoye. Bamaze gucutsa imisango, agarukana na Nyanguge ijoro ryose. Ageze mu Rwanda, ahita abyarira Mukobanya mu Nyakabanda ka Kigali. Cyilima yita umwana izina, acyura nyina atyo. Nuko urwo rugendo rwa Bilindi mu majoro y’umwijima ajyana ubutumwa bwa Cyilima Rugwe, ruhinduka iciro ry’imigani; ijoro ritashyemo umwijima mubi ryose, urisohotsemo agana hanze, yabura aho ava n’aho agana akiyamirira abwira abo asize mu nzu, ati “Yemwe! Hanze hano, hari ijoro ni rya Bilindi”.

title: RALC yasabye abanyarwanda guha agaciro ‘Indimishami z’Ikinyarwanda’
content: Muri iyi minsi biragoye kuganira n’umuntu cyane cyane mu bari mu cyiciro cy’abize cyangwa uwabaye mu mahanga mukarangiza atavanzemo ijambo ryo mu rundi rurimi rw’amahanga. Turabyumva kenshi mu mbwirwaruhame z’abayobozi, inyigisho z’abanyamadini, indirimbo z’abahanzi, mu biganiro ku maradiyo n’ahandi hatandukanye. Nubwo Abanyarwanda bose bahuriye ku rurimi rumwe ‘Ikinyarwanda’ hari n’izindi ndimi shami zivugwa mu duce dutandukanye nk’Ikigoyi dusanga muri Rubavu n’Ikirera cyo mu bice bya Musanze na Burera. Hari kandi izindi nk’Igishobyo kivugwa mu gace ka Nyundo muri Rubavu, Uruyaka n’Igisozo n’ubwo Inteko Nyarwanda y’Ururimi n’Umuco itangaza ko zigenda zikendera ku buryo mu myaka mike iri imbere zizaba zitakivugwa. Ku rundi ruhande Umuyobozi Ushinzwe Ishami ry’Indimi mu Nteko Nyarwanda y’Ururirimi n’Umuco, Nsanzabaganwa Modeste, yabwiye IGIHE ko bafite intego yo kubungabunga indimi shami mu rwego rwo kurengera umurage no gucunga umutungo by’u Rwanda. Nsanzabaganwa yagize ati “Iyo urebye muri rusange inzira twahisemo ni iyo gukoresha indimi nyinshi. Ikinyarwanda, Igiswahili, Igifaransa n’Icyongereza, n’izindi zishobora kuzaza cyangwa se zimwe muri izi zikarekwa.” “Ni inzira nziza yagura amarembo y’Igihugu, iha amahirwe Abanyarwanda yo gusabana n’abandi bo hanze no kuvoma ubwenge ariko ni inzira y’amahwa bityo ni ngombwa ko tumeya uko tuyicamo.” Yakomeje avuga ko magingo aya hari Abanyarwanda batakimenya Ikinyarwanda cy’umwimerere bavuga indimi bazivanga ndetse bamwe bagakeka ko ari ubusirimu. Ati “Benshi baba bavuga ko babuze amagambo y’Ikinyarwanda. Umwe mu miti yadufasha guhangana n’iryo bura ry’amagambo ni ukuyashaka mu mvugo z’Ikinyarwanda zihariye: iza kera n’iz’Uturere cyangwa kuyahanga.” Nsanzabaganwa avuga ko aho gutira ijambo mu ndimi z’amahanga, twatira mu ndimi shami zacu. Ati “ Twaba tugize neza kuvoma ijambo “indiga” mu Kirera; ubundi ni icyuma aho gutira ‘knife’ mu Cyongereza cyangwa ‘couteau’ mu Gifaransa. Tuba dukungahaza ikinyarwanda kandi ari amagambo y’uririmi rwacu ibyo bikaturinda kumiragura indimi z’ahandi mu buryo bworoshye.” Inteko Nyarwanda ishishikariza Abanyarwanda bose bazi indimi shami nk’Ikigoyi n’Ikirera kuzivuga bashize amanga ariko batibagiwe Ikinyarwanda mbonera duhuriyeho twese. Nsanzabaganwa ati “Ku mpamvu zijyanye na poritiki mu mateka yacu abantu bagiye batinya cyangwa se bagatinyuka gukoresha indimi shami. Niba umuyobozi akomoka iwanyu ubwo ni umwanya wo gukoresha imvugo cyane igasagamba. Hariya atava imvugo yaho igakendera. Icyo kintu ni ukugikura burundu mu bantu.” Ibi bijyana no gukangurira abazi izi ndimi shami kuzandikamo inyandiko zitandukanye, kuzihangamo n’ibindi mu rwego rwo gukomeza kuzibungabunga. Nsanzabaganwa yabwiye IGIHE ko kugeza ubu Inteko Nyarwanda y’Ururimi n’Umuco ifite ikigega cy’amagambo ibihumbi 97 akoreshwa mu myuga inyuranye aho kigenda gikurwamo amagambo ashyirwa mu nkoranyamagambo. Yongeyeho ko kugeza ubu hamaze kwandikwa inkoranyamagambo zivuga ku binyabuzima: umuntu n’ibimera, ivuga ku magambo akoreshwa mu bucamanza n’iy’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi izasohoka mu mwaka utaha. Ati “Umuco dusangiye uraturanga, ururimi rwacu rukaduhuza.”

title: Ababyeyi barasabwa guteganya amafaranga yo kugurira abana babo ibitabo
content:
“Ushaka guhisha Umunyafurika arandika”, iyi ni imvugo ikunze gukoreshwa n’abantu benshi bagaragaza ko gusoma inyandiko zitandukanye bitari mu muco w’abatuye uyu mugabane. Leta y’u Rwanda yashyizeho gahunda zitandukanye zigamije gukangurira Abanyarwanda kugira umuco wo gusoma no kwandika. Imwe muri izo ni imurikabitabo ry’Igihugu rihuza abantu bose bahuriye mu ruganda rw’igitabo, abanditsi, amazu asohora ibitabo, ababigurisha n’abibugura. Iri murika bitabo ngarukamwaka ryatangiye kuva mu wa 2017, rizatangira tariki 20 rirangire tariki 22 Gicurasi 2019 aho rizajya ribera muri parikingi ya stade Amahoro. Umuyobozi w’agateganyo w’Inkoranyabitabo y’Igihugu, Nyirabahizi Beata, yabwiye IGIHE ko mu gusoza iri murika, hazaba inama igamije kwigira hamwe uburyo abanditsi b’ibitabo byababyarira inyungu. Ati “Tuzaganira ku buryo igitabo gishobora kugurishwa, kubyara imirimo mu gihugu cyacu. Kuko turashaka ko uyu mutungo w’ubwenge mu by’ukuri na wo winjiza amafaranga, uteza imbere igihugu, ugira uruhare mu iterambere ry’Igihugu cyacu.”
Nyirabahizi yasabye ababyeyi kugira uruhare mu gukundisha abana babo gusoma no kwandika, babagurira ibitabo bitandukanye nk’uko babagurira ibindi bakenera. Ati “Tukaba tunabasaba ko bagira uruhare mu guteza imbere uru ruganda rw’igitabo, batoza abana babo kwandika ku buryo aba bakuru bandika bazagira abasimbura. Batoze abana kujya mu masomero nibagera mu rugo babasomere ibitabo bapange muri gahunda zabo kubagurira ibitabo nk’uko babagurira ibindi. Kugira ngo bagaburire ubwonko bwabo.” Ibitabo bizamurikwa harimo ibyanyuze mu nzu zisohora ibitabo [publishing houses], ibitabo banditse mu Kinyarwanda bivuga ku muco no ku mateka y’u Rwanda byemejwe n’Inteko Nyarwanda y’Ururimi n’Umuco n’ibindi byemejwe na CNLG mu gihe byaba bivuga kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi cyangwa se ibyemejwe na CHENO mu gihe byaba bivuga ku ntwari. Nta mubare uzwi w’abanditsi b’ibitabo bari mu Rwanda ariko abari mu rugaga rwabo bagera kuri 40.

title: Ururimi rw’Igifaransa rwungutse amagambo mashya 109
content:
Umushinga wo gutangaza inkoranyamagambo ya Le Petit Robert izagaragaramo amagambo mashya wamuritswe ku wa Mbere, tariki ya 13 Gicurasi 2019. Umuyobozi ushinzwe kunoza Imyandikire ya Petit Robert, Marie-Hélène Drivaud, yatangaje ko “Muri uyu mwaka amagambo 109 niyo yafashwe.’’ Iyo nkoranyamagambo igaragaraho umunyendimi w’Umufaransa, Alain Rey ku gifuniko cyahanzwe n’umunyabugeni akaba n’umwanditsi Riad Sattouf. Le Parisien yatangaje ko ayo magambo azagaragara mu nkoranyamagambo ya Robert Illustré n’iya Petit Robert. Le Petit Robert ifite amagambo mashya ari mu ngeri zitandukanye z’ubuzima kuva ku ikoranabuhanga, umuco, siporo n’ibindi bijyanye n’icyerekezo cy’Isi. Le Petit Robert igizwe n’amagambo yose hamwe 300 000, aho amagambo yakuwe (citations) 35 000, impuzanyito n’imbusane 150 000, inkomoko  y’amagambo (etymologies) 75 000. Iyi nkoranyamagambo y’amapaji 2 880, ipima ibilo 2,24, izasohoka ku wa 16 Gicurasi 2019. Izaba icuruzwa 62,50 €. Le Petit Robert Edition 2020, irimo imvugo zikoreshwa mu Isi ya none, mu kazi n’ahandi, uko zisomwa n’ibisobanuro byazo. Amwe mu magambo mashya yinjijwe mu nkoranyamagambo n’ibisobanuro byayo:
 Jober: Gukora akazi cyangwa ikiraka cy’umunsi  Millénial: Umuntu wakuze ahagana mu myaka ya 2000  Coworking: Gukorana akazi n’abanyamwuga bigenga  Infox: Amakuru y’impuha cyanga yifitemo kubogama agamije kuyobya abayahabwa  Cyberharcèlement: Ihohoterwa rikozwe hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga by’umwihariko ku mbuga nkoranyambaga  Agrobusiness: Ibikorwa bigamije kuzamura ubukungu, bifitanye isano n’ubuhinzi no kwihaza mu biribwa Amagambo akoreshwa mu Gifaransa akunda guhindurwa bitewe n’iterambere n’imibereho myiza y’abaturage. Mu Ukwakira 2018, Komisiyo ishinzwe Iterambere ry’Igifaransa yemeje ko ijambo “Infox” rizajya ryifashishwa mu kugaragaza amakuru y’impuha. Ijambo ‘‘Fake News’’ rikomoka mu Cyongereza ariko ryanakoreshwaga n’abavuga Igifaransa. Rikoreshwa hagaragazwa amakuru y’impuha yatangajwe cyangwa abogamye.

title: Amwe mu magambo akomeye yavuzwe na Bob Marley umaze imyaka 38 apfuye
content:
Kugeza n’ubu imvugo ze zifashishwa n’abantu batandukanye mu mbwirwaruhame zitandukanye, ibintu bishimangira ubuhanga n’ubwenge bw’uyu mugabo ufatwa nk’umukurambere w’abarasta. Robert Nesta Marley yavutse tariki ya 6 Gashyantare mu 1945 muri Jamaica. Nyina witwa Cedella Marley Booker yamubyaye afite imyaka 18 naho se w’umuzungu witwa Norval Marley yari afite imyaka 50. Bob Marley yaririmbaga injyana ya Reggae akitsa cyane ku butumwa bwo bwo kurwanya ivangura, ubutabera, urukundo, amahoro n’ibindi. Ntiyigeze atinya kunenga ibitagenda neza haba mu ndirimbo ze no mu magambo yagiye avugira ahantu hatandukanye kandi byagiye bizana impinduka. Ibi byatumaga hari abatamwishimira dore ko yagiye arokoka ibitero byabaga bigamije kumwica. Nka tariki 3 ukuboza mu 1976, Bob Marley yararusimbutse ubwo yari i Kingston mbere y’igitaramo yari agiye gukora. Abantu batandatu bafite intwaro bamutegeye iwe, bamurasa isasu ryamufashe ukuboko, irindi mu gituza no mu itako, irindi rikomeretsa umugore we Ritha mu mutwe ariko ntiryamuhitana.
Ni we muhanzi wa mbere ku Isi mu bakora injyana ya Raggae wabashije kugurisha ibihangano byinshi dore ko yagurishije ama-CD agera kuri miliyoni 200. Bob Marley yatabarutse yariki 11 Gicurasi 1981 aguye mu Mujyi wa Miami muri Leta ya Florida muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Yasize abana 11 yabyaranye n’abagore batandukanye. Hari amagambo atandukanye yagiye avuga kugeza n’ubu akigenderwaho na benshi bitewe n’ubuhanga yayavuganye. Amwe muri yo ni aya:  	Ubuzima ni umuhanda munini wuzuyemo ibimenyetso, rero iyo uri kugenda unyura mu mikoki ntukagore ubwonko bwawe. Hunga urwango, ikibi n’ishyari. Wihamba ibitekerezo byawe shyira icyerekezo cyawe ku kuri. Haguruka kandi ubeho.  	Itandukanye na sebiki ukoresheje urukundo.  	Ubuhangange bw’umuntu ntiburi mu mitungo afite ahubwo ni mu bunyangamugayo bwe n’uburyo ashobora guhindura abamuri impande mu buryo bwiza.  	Amafaranga ni imibarwa kandi ntijya irangira. Niba ibyishimo bitangwa n’amafaranga ntuzigera urekera gushaka ibyishimo.  	Kubera ko wishimye ntabwo bivuze ko uwo munsi ari mwiza cyane ahubwo ni uko warebye kure y’ibibi byawo.  	Muvuga ko mukunda imvura nyamara yagwa mugakoresha imitaka muyigendamo. Muvuga ko mukunda izuba ariko mugashaka ubwugamo iyo rivuye. Muvuga ko mukunda umuyaga ariko iyo uje mufunga amadirishya yanyu. Ni yo mpamvu ngira ubwoba iyo mumbwiye ko munkunda.  	Umukobwa ashobora kuba atari icyamamare cyangwa ari ihoho ariko niba agukunda agatuma umwenyura ni iki kindi gikenewe?  	Ntawe umenya ko ari umunyembaraga kugeza igihe kuba umenyembaraga ari yo mahitamo yonyine afite.  	Umunsi urekera gusiganwa niwo munsi utsinda irushanwa.  	Umugabo wa mbere w’ikigwari ni uzamura urukundo rw’umukobwa nta ntego yo kumukunda afite.  	Kunda ubuzima ubayemo, ubeho mu buzima ukunze.  	Wapfa urwanira ubwingenge aho kuba imbohe ubuzima bwawe bwose.  	Ntukizere abantu bafite ibyiyumviro bihindukana n’ibihe. Izere umuntu uhorana ibyumviro bimwe kabone n’ubwo ibihe byahinduka.  	Umuntu ntashobora gukora adafite Imana. Nk’uko ukenera amazi iyo ufite inyota, ntushobora kugenda udafite Imana.  	Umuziki wanjye uzahoraho iteka. Birashoboka ko ari ubucucu kubivuga ariko iyi ufite ibimenyetso urabivuga. Umuziki wanjye uzahoraho.  	Ntukwiye gushyirwa hasi n’ibikubaho ahubwo ukwiye gukoresha ibikubaho nk’ibikuzamura aho kugushyira hasi.  	Ntugace urubanza utaraca urwawe.  	Sindi mu ruhande rw’abirabura cyangwa abazungu. Ndi mu ruhande rw’Imana.  	Ntuzategereze ko Imana igukorera ibyo udakorera abandi.  	Urumogi ni umuti w’igihugu, inzoga ni izigisenya.  	Iyo unyweye urumogi rutuma wisobanukirwa. Umwa zimwe mu ndirimbo za Bob Marley zanditse amateka akomeye

title: Imvano y’igitutu cy’u Burayi na Amerika ku Rwanda ubwo Habyarimana yacudikaga na Koreya ya Ruguru
content: Iyo Koreya isa n’iyitajwe n’ibihugu kuri ubu,  yabaye inshuti ikomeye y’u Rwanda ku butegetsi bwa Perezida Habyarimana Juvénal mu gihe cy’intambara y’ubutita kugeza ubwo Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’u Burayi zari zimurabye ivu, bikamusaba amayeri ngo atabizira. Habyarimana yashatse gukina amayeri Amerika n’u Burayi, bamuha gasopo Ikibazo cyo kutavuga rumwe kwa  Koreya ya Ruguru n’iy’Epfo cyo mu 1948  ubwo zacikagamo kabiri, cyakomeje gukururuka kigeza mu 1973 ubwo Habyarimana yafataga ubutegetsi mu Rwanda. Nk’umuntu wari ugiye ku butegetsi vuba, yagombaga gushaka ibihugu by’inshuti ariko agahera ku bitari bisanzwe bifitanye ubushuti bwa hafi n’u Rwanda, kugira ngo inkunga iva hanze yiyongere. Koreya ya  Ruguru yari ishyigikiwe n’ibihugu by’u Bushinwa na Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Abasoviyeti, iy’Epfo ishyigikiwe n’u Burayi Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Ibihugu byinshi muri Afurika byari byarahisemo guca umubano n’ibindi bikoresha Communisme ari nacyo gice Koreya ya Ruguru yabarizwagamo kugira ngo ba shebuja b’i Burayi na Amerika babirebe neza, hato badakoma rutenderi ingoma zabo zigahirima. Leta ya Habyarimana yashakaga ubufasha no kwimenyekanisha mu mahanga, yatangiye kugenda rwihishwa ikorana n’ibihugu bikoresha Communisme, dore ko muri ibyo bihe byatangaga inkunga itubutse kandi itariho amananiza menshi nk’ayo Amerika n’u Burayi bashyiragaho. U Rwanda rwatangiye kwiyegereza Koreya ya Ruguru, nayo irarukundira  umubano uratangira. Tariki 15 Mata 1974 mu Rwanda haje itsinda ryo muri Koreya ya Ruguru riyobowe n’uwari  Minisitiri wungirije w’ububanyi n’amahanga, Chun Nyung Soo, ryakirwa na Perezida Habyarimana. Icyo gihe Radio Rwanda yatangaje ko Koreya ya Ruguru yemeye gufasha u Rwanda mu bijyanye n’amahugurwa y’urubyiruko, kubaka inzu mberabyombi y’urubyiruko n’ibindi. Radio Rwanda kandi yavuze ko iryo tsinda ryashyikirije Habyarimana ubutumwa buvuye kuri Perezida, Kim il Song wa Koreya ya Ruguru. Inyandiko z’ibanga za Ambasade ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu Rwanda zo muri ibyo bihe zashyizwe hanze n’urubuga Wikileaks, zigaragaza ko Koreya ya Ruguru nyuma yaje no kwemera guha imyitozo urubyiruko rw’ishyaka MRND ryari ku butegetsi, gutoza abasirikare ibijyanye n’akarasisi n’ibindi. Uruzinduko rw’intumwa za Koreya ya Ruguru mu Rwanda rwaje mu gihe Koreya zombi zari mu biganiro byo kwiyunga ariko bigatambamirwa n’ibindi bihugu bikomeye. Abasesenguzi icyo gihe bavugaga ko Koreya ya Ruguru nta gihambaye yashakaga ku Rwanda kitari ijwi ryarwo mu Muryango w’Abibumbye. Habyarimana icyo gihe yabwiye itsinda rya Koreya ya Ruguru ko u Rwanda rufata ikibazo kiri hagati ya Koreya zombi nk’icy’imbere mu gihugu gikwiriye gukemurwa hatajemo ukuboka kw’amahanga. Umubano w’ibihugu byombi warakuze, ndetse Koreya ya Ruguru ifungura Ambasade yayo i Kigali. Mu Ukwakira 1976, inyandiko z’ibanga za Ambasade ya Amerika zigaragaza ko Habyarimana afatanyije na Ambasade ya Koreya ya Ruguru, bashyizeho Komite yiga ku kongera kwiyunga kwa Koreya  zombi. Inama yabereye mu nyubako z’uwari uhagarariye Koreya ya Ruguru mu Rwanda. Iyo  komite yari  igizwe n’abajyanama muri MRND, Umuyobozi Mukuru ushinzwe Ububanyi n’Amahanga muri Perezidansi, abo muri Minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga n’abandi. Iyo  nama yabaye buri buke ngo Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa MRND wafatwaga nk’umuntu wa kabiri ukomeye  mu butegetsi, ajye mu ruzinduko i Pyongyang. Iyo komite yashimwe cyane na Djeun Yeung Oun wari ushinzwe ibikorwa muri Ambasade ya Koreya ya Ruguru i Kigali, aho yavuze ko gushyiraho iyo komite bizongera ubushuti n’umubano mu by’ubukungu w’ibihugu byombi. Nubwo u Rwanda rwakoraga ibishoboka byose ngo rushimishe Koreya ya Ruguru, byakorwaga mu ibanga rikomeye ngo ibihugu bya Amerika n’u Burayi bitabimenya. Ibanga ryaje kumenyekana! Mu 1976 intambara y’ubutita yari irimbanyije. Gufatwa  n’abanyaburayi cyangwa abanyamerika ucuditse n’ibihugu by’Uburusiya, u Bushinwa n’abakorana nabyo, byari icyaha kitababarirwa. Ibihugu bya Amerika n’u Burayi biciye  muri Ambasade zabyo i Kigali,  byaje kuvumbura ko u Rwanda ruri mu bushuti bwihariye na Koreya ya Ruguru. Ubwo hari hashize iminsi Komite ishyizweho ndetse n’Umunyamabanga wa MRND avuye muri Koreya ya Ruguru, Ambasaderi w’u Bubiligi yahamgaje Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga w’u Rwanda, amusaba ibisobanuro ku mubano wihariye uhari na Koreya ya Ruguru. Ambasaderi yamubwiye ko  ababajwe no kuba u Rwanda ruri kugendera ku icengezamatwara rya Koreya ya Ruguru no guhengamira ku ruhande rumwe, avuga ko u Rwanda rukwiye kumenya neza inshuti z’u Burayi n’umwanzi wabwo. Wikileaks igaragaza ko Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga w’u Rwanda yatunguwe, aryoshyaryoshya u Bubiligi, avuga ko umubano uri hagati y’u Rwanda na Koreya udakanganye. Yavuze  ko u Rwanda rushyigikiye kongera kwihuza kwa Koreya zombi, gusa yemera ko kuba barashinze komite yiga kuri icyo kibazo ntibazanemo Koreya y’Epfo kandi nayo biyireba, ari amakosa asabira imbabazi. Yijeje u Bubiligi ko umubano w’u Rwanda n’icyo gihugu ndetse n’ibindi bihugu by’i Burayi na Amerika utazangizwa n’iryo shyirwaho rya Komite kuko icyerecyezo cy’ububanyi n’amahanga bw’u Rwanda bakizi neza. Ambasaderi w’u Bubiligi yavuze ko yifuza kubona inyandiko z’ibyo Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa MRND yavugiye muri Koreya ya Ruguru, kugira ngo bemeze koko niba nta kindi cyihishe inyuma y’uwo mubano udasanzwe. Habyarimana yasuye Koreya ya Ruguru ahasiga amacumu, ahabwa umudari Ibihugu by’u Burayi na Amerika bimaze kwihanangiriza u Rwanda, rwagabanyije amarere ariko rukomeza kubana na Koreya ya Ruguru kuko yarufashaga muri byinshi. Tariki  7 Kamena 1978, Habyarimana yahagurutse i Kigali agiye mu ruzinduko rw’iminsi icumi muri Koreya ya Ruguru no mu Bushinwa. Yahagurutse ku kibuga cy’indege i Kanombe aherekejwe n’abantu 70, bagenda mu ndege yatanzwe n’u Bushinwa ya Boeing 107. Uretse kuba uruzinduko rw’iminsi icumi rudasanzwe ku mukuru w’igihugu, bwari n’ubwa mbere Habyarimana agiye hanze aherekejwe n’abantu bangana gutyo, nkuko inyandiko za Ambasade ya Amerika zibigaragaza. Habyarimana yakiriwe neza muri Koreya ya Ruguru no mu Bushinwa. I Pyongyang yakiriwe n’indirimbo za MRND zaririmbwe mu Kinyarwanda n’abana bo muri Koreya ya Ruguru. Bivugwa ko Habyarimana yasigiye Perezida Kim Il-Sung amacumu nk’ikimenyetso cy’umubano mwiza, na we agororerwa umudari uzwi nka Order of the National Flag. Amacumu Habyarimana yatanze ari mu nzu ndangamurage yiswe International Friendship Exhibition, irimo impano Kim Il-Sung na Kim Jong-il  bagiye bahabwa n’abanyamahanga. Nyuma y’iminsi icumi, tariki 17 Kamena 1978, Habyarimana n’abo bari bajyanye bagarutse mu Rwanda. Ageze ku kibuga cy’indege, yavuze ukuntu yashimishijwe n’umuhate w’Abashinwa n’Abanya-Koreya n’uburyo bamwijeje inkunga itubutse bazaha u Rwanda. Icyo gihe Koreya ya Ruguru yavuze ko igiye kwihutisha umushinga wo kubaka ingoro y’urubyiruko no guhinga umuceri kuri hegitari 200 mu Rwanda. Banatanze inkunga ijyanye n’imodoka zirekura amajwi n’amashusho zigenewe urubyiruko ndetse n’iz’Ikigo cy’amatangazo ya Leta,  Orinfor. Mu 1979, Koreya ya Ruguru yahaye u Rwanda ibijyanye n’intwaro za gisirikare imbunda zo  mu bwoko bwa Howitzers, n’imbunda nini zishobora guhangana n’ibitero byo mu kirere. Uwo mwaka kandi Koreya yemeye gufasha u Rwanda mu mishinga  irimo uwo kubaka ikigo cy’amashuri cyakira abanyeshuri 400, kubaka ibitaro n’uruganda rw’ibireti. Umubano w’u Rwanda na Koreya ya Ruguru warakomeje kugeza mu 1994 muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Nyuma yo guhagarika Jenoside, umubano w’u Rwanda na Koreya ya Ruguru wabaye nk’ukonje uretse ko n’ijambo rya Koreya ya Ruguru mu ruhando mpuzamahanga ryasaga nk’aho ntaryo, kandi intambara y’ubutita yatumaga ibihugu byiremamo udutsiko nayo yari yarahosheje. Tariki 18 Kanama 2010, Kim Jong Il    wayoboraga Koreya yoherereje ubutumwa bw’ishimwe Perezida Paul Kagame amushimira kuba yongeye gutorerwa  manda ya kabiri ku majwi 93 %. Ibiro Ntaramakuru bya Koreya, Korea News Services  (KNS) byatangaje ko Kim yifurije ishya n’ihirwe Perezida Kagame ndetse ko yizeye iterambere ry’umubano w’ibihugu byombi. Guhera mu 1994,  nta mubano ushingiye kuri za ambasade ibihugu byombi bifite.

title: Bamurangirwa agiye gusohora ibitabo bibiri birimo igikebura abanyafurika abategereje amakiriro  mu mahanga
content: Bamurangirwa w’imyaka 69, amaze kwandika ibitabo bitanu. Bibiri ateganya gusohora  birimo icyo yise “Africanism” na “New Rwanda From Hell to Heaven” akazabimurika ku itariki 16 Mutarama uyu mwaka. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE, Bamurangirwa yavuze ko igitabo yise “Africanism” cyangwa “uburwanashyaka muri rusange ku mugabane wa Afurika” yacyanditse kugira ngo akangurire urubyiruko kwikunda no gukunda iby’iwabo. Yagize ati “Ni igitabo nanditse ari ugukangurira urubyiruko muri rusange, bigirire icyizere, bakunde iwabo, ndetse kandi na bo ubwabo bibuke kwiyubaha, bikunde ko ari beza ku mubiri, bamenye ko ubwenge babufite, ntibagire icyo bakeka cyangwa uwo bakeka wabaruta ku buryo ubwa ari bwo bwose kubera ko ari bo; kandi bamenye ko muri Afurika iwabo ntacyo babuze, bareke kurarikira ahandi hanze y’umugabane wacu.” Bamurangirwa yavuze kandi ko iki gitabo yacyanditse kugira ngo kiburire urubyiruko rufite imyumvire yo kujya mu bihugu by’abazungu bizeye kuhakirira. Ati “kubera umubare munini w’urubyiruko muri Afurika bafite iyo myumvire, ari abo nahasanze n’abahansanze, nasanze ntabona ukundi mbwira abana bacu kugira ngo bigarure, biyemere, bakunde aho bari, bamenye ko ari heza kandi ntacyo habuze.” Indi mpamvu yateye imbaraga Bamurangirwa kwandika iki gitabo ni uko hari abandi bafite imyumvire nk’iyo yarafite mbere y’uko agera bihugu byo hanze y’umugabane wa Afurika, ngo abone ko ibyo yatekerezaga atari byo. Yavuze ko ibyo benshi bakeka ko mu bihugu by’i Burayi na Amerika haba ubuzima bwiza, baba bibeshya kuko akenshi bajyayo bagakora akazi gasuzuguritse gahari, bahembwa amafaranga y’intica ntikize. Bamurangirwa avuga ko ubwe azi benshi bagiye bagenda bazi ko bagiye gukira, bikarangira babayeho ubuzima bubi, bakagira isoni zo kugaruka iwabo. Yavuze  ko hari icyizere cy’uko imyumvire ibihugu bya Afurika byasigiwe n’ubukoroni yo kumva ko bikennye kandi ntacyo byakwishoboza, yahinduka ariko mu gihe urubyiruko rubigizemo uruhare.  Ati “Twebwe nk’abirabura batwumvishije ko iwacu turi abakene natwe turabyakira. Kugira ngo tuzabyigobotore, ni byo bizakunda ariko ni urugendo rurerure ruzatangirwa n’aba bana bacu, abana babyiruka badukundiye n’ubwo bitoroshye twabigeraho.”  “Inama yanjye ni uko bankundira nkabuhagira ubwo bukoroni bubarimo nkashyiramo ubundi, kuko urugendo ruracyari rurerure. Ntabwo byahita bishoboka ariko intangiriro yo irahari ntabwo twahita tuvuga ngo nta cyizere.” New Rwanda From Hell to Heaven” cyo yagikomoye ku iterambere yasanze mu Rwanda ubwo yahagarukaga mu mwaka wa 2016, ubwo yari amaze imyaka isaga icumi atahakandagira. Yavuze ko  iterambere ry’u Rwanda ari igihamya ko Afurika yatera imbere ishyize hamwe. Kumurika ibyo bitabo ku mugaragaro bizaba tariki 16 Mutarama 2020 mu isomero rikuru ry’igihugu ku Kacyiru guhera saa kumi n’imwe. Nubwo adafite amashuri menshi, ngo ntibimuza kwandika ibitabo kubera ko yegera inzobere muri uyu mwuga zikagenda zimugira inama. Iduka ’Waterstones’ niryo mu Bwongereza rimufasha gusohora ibitabo rikanabishyira ku isoko. Mu Rwanda ibitabo bye biboneka mu maduka y’ibitabo, Ikirezi na Caritas, ndetse n’ababishaka bashobora kubisanga kuri interineti. Ibi bitabo bibiri yasohoye bizajya biboneka mu isomero ry’igihugu. Bamurangirwa amaze kwandika ibitabo bitanu byose biri mu rurimi rw’Icyongereza. Harimo icyo yise “Rwanda Yesterday” avugamo amateka y’u Rwanda, ‘‘Patriotism” kigizwe n’ibisigo biri mu Kinyarwanda no mu Cyogereza yahimbiye Perezida Kagame, icyo yahimbiye Umwami Mutara wa III Rudahigwa, ndetse n’icyo yahimbiye Inkotanyi zambuka, “My Mother’s Dreams” agaragazamo uburyo yapfushije nyina akiri muto agacikiriza amashuri ye kandi inzozi ze zari ukwiga, “New Rwanda From Hell to Heaven” avugamo uburyo u Rwanda rwahindutse nyuma ya Jenoside. Igitabo cya gatanu ni icyo yise “Africanism” twabavwiyeho byinshi. Amafoto: Munyarugerero Gift

title: Umuco ube ubuzima bw’Abanyarwanda mu gihugu no mu mahanga
content:
Kuzigenderaho niko kugira umuco ubuzima, guhera mu muryango, ku banyarwanda baba mu gihugu n’ababa mu mahanga. Twifashishije ubutumwa Perezida wa Repubulika yatanze mu bihe bitandukanye, ubutumwa buri kuri Twitter y’Ibiro bya Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika, kuri Youtube no mu bitabo. Nk’uko bigaragara mu ijambo ry’ibanze ry’igitabo “Rwanda: Umurage ndangamuco kuva kera kugeza magingo aya”, Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika y’u Rwanda, Paul Kagame, asaba ko umuco ukomera ku busugire bwawo. Iki gitabo yashyizemo ijambo ry’ibanze, cyanditswe na Prof Kanimba Misago Célestin (wayoboraga Ingoro z’Umurage z’u Rwanda) na Lode Van Pee, cyasohotse mu 2008. Muri iri jambo ry’ibanze, Umukuru w’Igihugu yasabye kwirinda ibyangiza umuco w’u Rwanda, ati “Ni ngombwa rwose kwirinda ko uruvange rw’imico y’u Rwanda n’iy’amahanga rutuma abantu bitwara nk’ibihindugembe. Umuco wose aho uva ukagera ugomba gukomera ku busugire bwawo.” Mu ijambo yagejeje ku bitabiriye Inama y’Igihugu y’Umushyikirano mu 2007, Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika yavuze ko umuco uduhuza ukanadufasha gukemura ibibazo ubu n’igihe kizaza. Ati  “Hari imbaraga twavana mu muco wacu, uduhuza, ukatugira umwe, ukaduha byinshi dusangiye. Uyu muco kandi uba ukwiye kutuyobora, ukatwereka uko dukwiye kwifata n’uko dukwiye guhangana n’ibibazo biriho n’ibizaza.” Ubwo yagezaga ijambo ku banyarwanda baba mu Bwongereza kuwa 7 Werurwe 2017, Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika yababwiye ko u Rwanda rwiyubaka rushingiye ku muco. Yagize ati “Aho muri hano mu burayi cyangwa mu Bwongereza, muhari nk’Abanyarwanda (…) Turubaka igihugu gifite umuco, kigendera ku muco, …” Ibi bikagaragarira mu mibereho n’imibanire ndetse n’iterambere ry’ubukungu. “Igihugu kitagira indangagaciro ntikigira ejo hazaza”, Perezida Paul Kagame  Nk’uko Umukuru w’Igihugu abyemeza, Igihugu kitagira indangagaciro, ntikigira ejo hazaza. Ibi yabivuze mu nama y’Igihugu y’Umushyikirano mu 2015. Nk’uko tubisoma ku rubuga rwa Twitter rw’Ibiro by’Umukuru w’Igihugu, ubutumwa bugira buti “Umuntu utagira igihugu, ntagira agaciro. Igihugu kitagira indangagaciro, ntikigira ejo hazaza”. Avuga ku bigomba kuranga Abanyarwanda, Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame, mu Nama y’Igihugu y’Umushyikirano mu 2018, yasobanuye ko tugomba kugira umuco ushingiye ku bumwe. Ati  “Abanyarwanda tubane neza, tugire umuco ushingiye ku bumwe, dukorere hamwe, dusenyere umugozi umwe, dushakishe icyagera kuri buri wese kandi kikagirira igihugu cyose akamaro. Buri wese akiyumvamo undi, tugakorana”. Indangagaciro y’ubumwe, ni imwe muri enye zatoranyijwe zikemezwa ku rwego r’Igihugu mu 2018. Izo ndangagaciro remezo ni Ubumwe, Gukunda Igihugu, Umurimo, Ubupfura, nk’uko tuzisanga mu gitabo cyashyizwe ahagaragara na Minisiteri ifite umuco mu nshingano (Minisiteri ya Siporo n’Umuco, Indangagaciro z’umuco w’u Rwanda, igitabo nyobozi, 2018). Ubwo bari mu mwiherero mu 2018, Abayobozi mu nzego zitandukanye z’Igihugu bagejejweho ubutumwa bubafasha kumva agaciro k’umuco mu kubaka iterambere ry’Igihugu no kwimakaza indangagaciro. Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika yagize ati “Ikintu gifasha cyane mu kugera ku mpinduka ni umuco. Iyo urebye ibihugu byateye imbere usanga ibyinshi byarabigezeho kubera umuco wo kwicisha bugufi, kwiyoroshya, no gukora cyane.” Umuco uba ubuzima bihereye mu muryango. Muri iki gihe, ababyeyi bashishikarizwa guharira umwanya uhagije abana, bakabaganiriza mu muryango, kuko ariho uburere bwiza buhera. Bamwe mu babyeyi ariko bavuga ko batabona umwanya kuko bafite imirimo myinshi. Nyamara ntawavuga ko agira imirimo iruta iy’Umukuru w’Igihugu. We arawubona.  Mu 2018, yavuze ko aganiriza abana ku muco n’indangagaciro yagize ati “Hamwe na Madamu duhora tubaganiriza ku ndangagaciro, umuco na politiki. Mu mikurire yabo, ibyo tubigisha bigamije kubashyiramo uwo muco wo gusobanukirwa ibyo babona bikorwa. Ariko ibi ntibigomba kubangamira ko bakura nk’abandi bana”. Ababyeyi bakwiye rero kugendera kuri uru rugero rwiza aduha, bakagira umwanya wo kuganiriza abana ku muco w’u Rwanda n’indangagaciro zawo. Niko umuco uzahinduka ubuzima bw’Abanyarwanda mu gihugu no mu mahanga. Ubwo yagezaga ijambo ku rubyiruko rw’Abanyarwanda biga mu mahanga, mu itorero ry’Indangamirwa, mu 2015, Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika yabasabye gukomera ku muco w’u Rwanda. Ati “Iyo utaye umuco ndetse n’indangagaciro zo kumenya ikibi n’icyiza, uba ubuze byose. Mukomere ku muco wacu.” N’ubwo hari abibwira ko kujyana n’ibyitwa “ibigezweho” bivuze guta iby’iwayu ugasanga iby’iw’abandi, impanuro yahaye urubyiruko mu ihuriro rya YouthConnekt mu 2017, zigaragaza ko tugomba kwimakaza indangagaciro z’umuco w’u Rwanda mu byo dukora byose. Icyo gihe yagize ati“Indangagaciro zo mu muco wacu ntabwo zihinduka. Zigomba kuranga ibyo mukora byose. Inzira zacu zishobora gutandukana ariko intego yacu ni imwe n’indangagaciro zacu ntizihinduka.” Ibi bigashimangirwa n’ubutumwa dusanga kuri Twitter y’Ibiro bya Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika, bugaragaza ko Abanyarwanda bagerageje kujyana n’igihe ariko bataretse gushingira ku muco wabo. Ubu butumwa bwatanzwe ubwo twizihizaga isabukuru y’imyaka 20 yo kwibohora.  Umuco dusangiye uraturanga
  Mutangana Steven
Umusomyi wa IGIHE.COM

title: Imiryango yahamije ubuhangange mu Mateka: Igicumbi cy’umuryango wa Rurenge
content:
Ni imiryango yagiye igira amaboko akomeye kubera kugira imiryango migari igizwe n’abantu benshi kandi bagwije ubugabo, igitinyiro n’ubuhangange. Nk’uko tubikesha igitabo “Iyororoka ry’Abanyarwanda, inkomoko y’imiryango migari ’’ ndetse n’igitabo  “Intwari z’imbanza, zubatse u Rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro’’ byombi dukesha Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, inzobere mu Busizi, umuco n’amateka y’u Rwanda, tugiye kwinjira mu muryango mugari w’abakomoka kwa Rurenge, mu mavu n’amavuko yawo n’inzu z’ibihangange zawukomotseho. Rurenge ni umugabo wahamije imyato mu gihugu cy’u Rwanda, akaba atazwi neza igisekuruza cye, gusa amateka y’iturwa ry’u Rwanda, atugaragariza ko ari umwe mu Basinga b’Abasangwabutaka ba mbere bakomeye babayeho muri ikigihugu cy’u Rwanda, kgitangira kumenyekana.  Ni umwe mu babaye ibimburiro ry’amateka y’Abasinga b’Abasangwabutaka bageze kuri ubu butaka bwa mbere. Rurenge niwe wakomotsweho n’imiryango migari y’Abasinga myinshi ikurije ku bahungu be. Umuryango mugari w’Abarenge, ni izina bihaye risobanura mu Kinyarwanda “ABADASUMBWA”. Ni Abasinga bafite inkomoko kuri Jeni rya Rurenge, bitandukanyije n’ abandi bavandimwe babo bakomoka kuri Rurenge n’abandi Basinga barema igisekuruza cyabo bakomora kuri Rurenge “RUDASUMBWA”. Abasinga b’Abarenge, ni nabo basigaranye izina ry’igisekuruza cyabo gikuru cy’Abasinga b’Abasangwabutaka. Imisozi yari itetseho gakondo nkuru yo kwa Rurenge n’abamukomokaho, ari naho zingiro ry’ibanze ry’igisekuruza cy’Abasinga b’Abasangwabutaka n’imiryango migari  igishamikiyeho (Abarenge, Ababanda, Abongera, Abahunde, Abungura, Abasita) cyororokeye, kuko umukurambere wabo Rurenge yari ahatuye. Kuri ubu ni mu Mirenge ya Kigeyo,  Mushonyi,  Musasa,  Ruhango, Gihango, Kivumu na Boneza yo mu Karere ka Rutsiro n’umurenge wa Nyamyumba  wo mu Karere ka Rubavu. Rurenge yabyaye abana b’abahungu bagera kuri barindwi barimo: Jeni, Mwongera, Kimari, Kimezamiryango, Gihunde,  Kibanda na Mateke. Abo bose nibo babaye inkomoko y’imiryango migari tubona mu mateka y’u Rwanda, ariyo abasinga b’abarenge, bakomoka kwa Jeni ya Rurenge, abasinga b’abateke, bakomoka kwa Mateke ya Rurenge, abasinga b’abamari, bakomoka kwa Mimari cya Rurenge. Hari kandi abasinga b’abongera, bakomoka kwa Mwongera wa Rurenge, abasinga b’ababanda,  bakomoka kuri Kibanda cya Rurenge, abasinga b’abahunde bakomoka kuri Gihunde cya Rurenge, abasinga b’abungura  bakomoka kwa Byungura bya Mateke ya Rurenge, abasinga b’abasita  bakomoka kwa Gasita ka Mateke ya  Rurenge, abasinga b’abashingwe bakomoka kuri Rushingo rwa Byungura bya Mateke ya Rurenge. Hari  abungura b’abannyori bakomoka kwa Mannyori ya Byungura bya Mateke ya Rurenge, abungura b’abarembe bakomoka kwa Mirembe  ya Byungura bya Mateke ya Rurenge, ababanda b’abasindi, bakomoka kuri Basindi ba Kibanda cya Rurenge, ababanda b’abalindi bakomoka kwa Bulindi  bwa Kibanda cya Rurenge, ababanda b’abaguyane bakomoka kuri Muguyane wa Kibanda cya Rurenge, ababanda b’abakoma bakomoka kuri Nkoma ya Nkondongoro, ababanda b’abahuge bakomoka kwa Bihuge bya Kibanda cya Rurenge, ababanda b’ababarake bakomoka kwa Kibarake cya Kibanda cya Rurenge n’abandi Mu muryango w’igicumbi gikuru cyo kwa Rurenge, habayemo ibihangange byinshi byagengaga ibihugu byabo, ndetse banasagurira n’ibindi bihugu, aho mu mizo ya mbere y’ihangwa ry’ingoma y’I Gasabo, bari bafite abagabekazi b’Abasinga cyane cyane abo mu muryango mugari w’Abarenge. Ibihangange byabayeho mu miryango y’Abasinga bo kwa Rurenge ( Abasangwabutaka) bakomoka kuri Rurenge twavugamo: Abami b’ingoma z’abakomoka kuri Rurenge nk’uko ibihugu bagengaga byari biri. Umwiru Mukuru Rubunga n’abahungu be Shango na Nyamuhindura,  bagize uruhare rukomeye cyane mu guhanga ingoma y’i Gasabo no gutanga ibitekerezo bikomeye byayubatse igihe kirekire. Harimo Nyamususa wa Jeni wabaye umugore wa Gihanga, akaba  n’umwe mu Bagabekazi ba mbere b’ingoma y’i Gasabo, kuko yabyaye Kanyarwanda Gahima wazunguye Gihanga  ku ngoma y’i Rwanda, na Nyirampigiye wabaye umugore ba Gihanga, bakabyarana Rutsobe.  Harimo n’abandi Barengekazi babaye Abagabekazi b’ingoma y’u Rwanda, muri bo twavuga nk’Umugabekazi Nyamata ya Gahuriro wari nyina wa Yuhi Musindi, Umugabekazi Kizigira wari nyina wa Ndahiro Ruyange, Umugabekazi Nyakanga ya Nyebunga wari nyina wa Ruganzu Bwimba n’Umugabekazi Nyirarumaga wabaye umugabekazi w’ingoboka ku ngoma ya Ruganzu Ndoli, kuko nyina  Nyabacuzi yari yaraguye i Rubi rw’i Nyundo. Harimo kandi Nyambibi ya Rubanguka  w’Umusita wari nyina wa Ntwaza wabaye umugore wa Sharangabo umuhungu wa Kigeli Rwabugili.
Harimo  n’abami bari abagenga b’ibihugu bya bene Rurenge n’ibindi bihangange bibashamikiyeho. Muri bo twavuga nka Mugina  w’Umwongera watwaraga u Buliza wivuganywe na Cyirima Rugwe umwami w’u Rwanda, na Nkuba ya Nyabakonjo w’Umwongera wagengaga u Bwanacyambwe wivuganywe  n‘umwami w’u Rwanda Kigeli Mukobanya. Hari  na Rubingo Umuhinza wazengereje Ruganzu Ndoli, ubwo yigaruriraga u Buliza, mu bihe by’amage y’u Rwanda yakuruwe n’Ibikomangoma byo kwa Gahima byarwaniye ingoma. Ruganzu Ndoli, yashyize umutima hamwe ari uko amaze kumwivugana, abunduye u Buliza bwari bwarigaruriwe na Cyilima Rugwe, bugasubiranwa na Rubingo. Hari kandi  na Nyaruzi rwa Haramanga umwe mu Batware bo mu ngoma y’u Bungwe watwaraga i Burwi mu Ndara agatura mu Mukindo wa Makwaza ( Mu Murenge wa Mukindo mu Karere ka Gisagara)  wivuganywe na Ruganzu Ndoli. Mu bakomoka ku gihangange Rurenge, harimo kandi n’abo mu muryango mugari w’Ababanda bagengaga ibihugu byabo n’ibihangange bibashamikiyeho.  Muri bo twavuga Kimezamiryango cya Rurenge wahanze ingoma ya Nduga, akaza kuyamburwa na Murumuna we Kibanda cya Rurenge wabaye inkomoko y’umuryango mugari w’Ababanda bagengaga ingoma ya Nduga wazunguwe na Sabugabo, Nkuba na Mashira, nk’abami ba nyuma b’ingoma-Mbanda.  Muguyane wa Kibanda yahanze ingoma ya Rwankeri y’Abaguyane, Barindi ba Kibanda wahanze ingoma ya Rwankeri y’Abarindi n’abandi. Ntitwabura kuvuga kandi, Nkoma ya Nkondogoro ( Sekirasanyi, ikirozi cyo mu Marangara) wari umupfumu w’icyatwa, wanazengereje Ruganzu Ndoli mu iyima rye na Senteteri wari Umutunzi w’inka. Ababanda bo kwa Kibanda cya Rurenge nibo umukurambere BGAYI witiriwe KABGAYI akomokamo (Kabgayi=Agasozi ka BGAYI), bakaba barahitaga Inteko ya Bene –Impinga. Imiryango migari ikomoka ku bahungu ba Rurenge, imwe muri yo niyo yari yihariye ubugenga bw’ibihugu bigera kuri 15  by’abasinga byari mu Rwanda. Bagiye  bagabana ubutaka babuhangamo ibihugu mu buryo bukurikira: Ibihugu bya bene Jeni rya Rurenge: Budaha n’u Bwisahaza, u Bukunzi, u Busozo,  n’u Bunyambilili. Ibihugu bya Kibanda cya Rurenge: Nduga, Buhoma, u Bukonya, u Burera, U Bugoyi, Rwankeri y’Abarindi, Rwankeri y’Abaguyane n’u Bwanamwali.
Ibihugu bya Mwongera wa Rurenge:  U Buliza n’u Bwanacyambwe Igihugu bya Gihunde cya Rurenge:  U Buhunde Ngaho iyo mwama mukuru wa Rurenge mu mizi yanyu mikuru ( Ngaho mwana w’i Rwanda, ibyo nibyo bisekuruza by’iwanyu mu muryango wo kwa Rurenge).

title: Imyemerere itangaje y’Abanyarwanda bo hambere: Kuzinga inzoka no kohera imvura
content: Icyakora kuri  ubu Abanyarwanda benshi ntibabyemera, ndetse bavuga ko ari imihango ya gipagani, n’ubwo hari abaganga bemeza ko iyo migenzo yabaga ari ingirakamaro. Nk’uko tubikesha igitabo “Umuco mu Buvanganzo’’ cyanditswe n’Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, Inzobere ku muco, amateka n’ubuvanganzo nyarwanda, tugiye kubataturira imwe mu mihango ishyigikiwe n’imigenzo yakorwaga mu kuvura no kurinda indwara mu muco w’Abanyarwanda. Kuzinga inzoka byaterwaga n’uko bashaka kwica iyo nzoka kugira ngo itagira uwo iza kuruma. Hari kandi no kohera imvura ntigwe cyangwa se kuyica iyo yabaga yaciye ibintu . Niyo mpamvu uzasanga abantu bakuru benshi bafite imigenzo bakora mu rwego rwo gutsirika imvura ntigwe no kubuza inzoka kuva aho iri, mu gihe hakivuzwa intabaza yo kuyica itaragira uwo iruma cyangwa ngo icike ariko isize abantu mu bwoba. Umumaro wo kuzinga inzoka ahanini  wari uwo gutuma itava aho iri ngo yiruke, ahubwo bayihasange bayice, kuzinga inzoka, byakorwaga mu buryo bw’ibimenyetso byungaiwe n’imitongero ituma iyo nzoka itava aho iri. Naho kohera imvura, byagendanaga no gukora imigenzo yo kuyibuza kugwa no kuyohera iyo yabaga yaciye ibintu. Umumaro wabyo, nuko iyo batayishakaga itagwaga, haba hari ibyo yangije bakayibuza kongera kugwa cyangwa se yaba irimo amahindu bakayicecekesha nayo igahwama. Ari umugenzo wo kuzinga inzoka, ari umugenzo wo kohera imvura no kuyica, yose yagiraga uko ishyirwa mu bikorwa mu bihe byo ha mbere. Umwuga-buvuzi wo kohera imvura wakorwaga n’Abavubyi mu bihe byo mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere. Abavubyi babaga ari abantu babashaga kugusha imvura iyo yabaga yahagamye, no kuyica iyo yabaga yaciye ibintu, rubanda bagahonga amasororo kugira ngo abavubyi bakunde bamanure imvura cyangwa se kugira ngo batume yohoka. Umuvubyi yavubaga imvura ahuhera mu museke ukavuga  nk’inkokera,  ngo ubwo arahamagara imvura cyangwa ngo arayica. Naho umugenzo wo kohera aribyo bakunze kwita kuyihenera yadutse vuba, ariko ifitanye amasano n’ibyakorwaga mu bihe byo ha mbere mu kuvuba imvura no kuyohera mu bihe yabaga yaciye ibintu. Guhenera imvura ni mvugo  ngiro yadutse vuba aho abana b’abaharerezi mu muryango ngo bahenera imvura ntibe ikiguye. Hari n’indi migenzo yakorwaga mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere yo gutsirika imvura y’amahindu ubwo yabaga irimo kugwa. Aho bafataga isuka y’ifuni, bakayihingisha imbere y’umuryango inshuro ebyiri, ubundi bakayitongera muri iyi mvugo: Oherwa utagira uwo uhitana n’ibyo wangiza, cururuka ucurike icumu u Rwanda ruguhaye indaro, n’ibindi. Ubundi buryo bwa hafi bukoreshwa n’abahanga mu gutsirika urubura, bafata icupa ry’icyuma, bakarufata aho rwaguye bakarushyiramo, ubundi bakarijungunya aho mu mbuga urubura ruri kugwamo. Ako kanya ruhita rucururuka, rukagenda nka nyomberi. Umwuga-buvuzi wo kuzinga inzoka wabaga wihariwe n’Abahoryo. Mu mateka y’u Rwanda rwo ha mbere. Abahoryo nibo bavumaga ibyonnyi byangiza imyaka yo mu butaka bagatanga n’imiti ivura imyaka, bakazinga kandi bakanagombora inzoka. Uburyo-mugenzo bwo kuzinga inzoka bwakorwaga mu buryo bukurikira butandukanye. Hari buryo bwakorwaga n’igitsina gore: Ubu buryo bwakoreshwaga n’abagore bakuze, cyane cyane bamaze gucura ( batakibyara). Iyo yabaga abonye inzoka akabona nta buryo bwo kuyica ako kanya afite, yafataga ibere ry’ibumoso akarihuza n’iry’iburyo mu buryo byo kuyagerekeranya, ubundi inzoka igahagarara igategereza abaza kuyikanira uruyikwiye. Impamvu ubu buryo bwakoreshwaga n’abagore bacuze, nuko babaga nta mihango bagifite, kuko mu igenantekerezo ry’Abanyarwanda bari bazi ko ibikuruka byose bizirana n’umukobwa cyangwa se umugore uri mu mihango. Ikindi cyatumaga uwo mugenzo uharirwa abagore bacuze, ni uko aribo babasha kugira amabere maremare kandi ashobora kwirambura akagera ahakenewe hose, ku buryo ushobora kuyagerekeranya. Ubundi buryo bwashoboraga gukorwa n’uwari we wese hatitawe ku gitsina icyo aricyo cyose, ni ubwo gufata ukuguru kw’iburyo, ukakugereka hejuru y’ukwibumoso, ariko kudakoze hasi, ubundi nzoka igahagarara. Imigenzo gakondo y’Abanyarwanda ishingiye ku kuzinga inzoka no kohera imvura, yari yuje igenantekerezo risobetse rwose, ku buryo ritabashaga kugerurwa n’abahisi. Ubwo aya mateka yandikwaga hari aho iyo migenzo igikoreshwa mu rwego rwo guhangana n’inzoka z’inkazi nko mu bice bituriye amashyamba magari kandi ya  kimeza n’imisozi yiganjemo umukenke, ndetse hari n’ahagikorwa imihango yo kohera imvura no kuyohera iyo yabaga yaciye ibintu, nko mu turere tw’u Rwanda twari twiganjemo Abavubyi n’amavubiro agera kuri atandatu  yabagaho mu Rwanda rwo ha mbere.

title: Imiryango yahamije ubuhangange mu mateka y’u Rwanda: Igicumbi cy’uwa Rwakagara (Igice cya kabiri)
content: Iki ni igice cya kabiri gikurikira icyo twabatekerereje ku mateka y’igicumbi cy’umuryango mugari ufite inkomoko kuri Rwakagara rwa Gaga. Iki ni igice gikurikiraho mu bindi bizibanda mu kubatekerereza imbumbe y’imiryango migari yabayemo ibihangange ikanagira n’inzu zikomeye mu mateka y’u Rwanda. Nk’uko tubikesha ibitabo “Iyororoka ry’Abanyarwanda, inkomoko y’imiryango migari ’’ n’icyitwa  “Intwari z’imbanza zubatse u Rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro’’ by’Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, inzobere mu Busizi, umuco n’amateka y’u Rwanda, tugiye kwinjira mu muryango mugari w’abakomoka kwa Rwakagara, mu mavu n’amavuko yawo n’inzu z’ibihangange zawukomotseho. Tugiye gusubukurira aho twagereje ubushize, tubabwira ibigwi n’ibirindiro by’igicumbi cy’umuryango wa Rwakagara, wahamije ibigwi n’ibirindiro mu mateka y’u Rwanda. Mu bandi bibukwa mu bihe bya vuba bo mu muryango wa Rwakagara, ntitwabura kuvugamo Rwubusisi rwa Cyigenza cya Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuru wa Rwakagara, wari ingabo ihamye ku Ngoma y’Umwami Yuhi Musinga, akamufasha guhamya ubutware bwe mu Rwanda ubwo yafataga Basebya ba Nyirantwari wari warigometse ku ngoma ya Musinga. Mu muryango mugari w’Abega bo mu nzu ya Rwakagara, hanavuyemo abatware benshi batwaye imisozi itandukanye yo mu Rwanda. Muri bo twavuga: 1.	Nyarwaya ya Rwesa rwa Ruterambuku rwa Gaga, wari umwuzukuru wa Rwakagara kwa se wabo watwaraga Susheferi ya Nduba  muri Sheferi ya Bwanacyambwe muri Teritwari ya Kigali. 2.	Rwabutogo rwa Kabare ka Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuru wa Rwakagara, watwaraga muri Sheferi y’u Buganza  bw’Iburasirazuba muri Teritwari ya Kibungo,  mu bihe by’Ingoma ya Musinga mu 1926. 3.	Rutaremara rwa Kayondo ka Mbanzabigwi bya Rwakagara, wari Umwuzukuruza wa Rwakagara watwaraga muri Susheferi ya Gikongoro muri Sheferi ya Bufundu muri Teritwari ya Astrida. 4.	Rwakayiru kwa Nyirinkwaya ya Giharamagara cya Rwakagara wari Umwuzukuruza wa Rwakagara watwaraga muri Susheferi ya Zivu muri Sheferi ya Mvejuru muri Teritwari ya Astrida. 5.	Ngarambe ya Sengati ya Rwabanda rwa Nyamushanja wa Rwakagara, wari Umwuzukuruza wa Rwakagara, watwaraga Susheferi ya Rubavu  muri Sheferi ya Bugoyi  muri Teritwari ya Gisenyi. 6.	Rwigema rwa Sengati ya Rwabanda rwa Nyamushanja wa Rwakagara, wari Umwuzukuruza wa Rwakagara, watwaraga Susheferi ya Cyanyanza  muri Sheferi ya Budaha  muri Teritwari ya Gisenyi. 7.	Rwabuyonza rwa Nkubamiheto ya Giharamagara cya Rwakagara wari Umwuzukuruza wa Rwakagara, watwaraga Susheferi ya Ngobagoba  muri Sheferi ya Budaha  muri Teritwari ya Gisenyi. 8.	Nyirakabuga ka Cyigenza cya Rwakagara wari umwuzukuru wa Rwakagara, watwaraga Susheferi ya Vumwe muri Sheferi y’i Gihunya  muri Teritwari ya Kibungo. 9.	Gakirage ka Nyakayiru ka Cyigenza  wari umwuzukuru wa Rwakagara, watwaraga Susheferi ya Gasetsa  muri Sheferi y’i Gihunya  muri Teritwari ya Kibungo. 10.	 Rwubusisi rwa Cyigenza cya Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuru wa Rwakagara,  watwaraga Susheferi ya Murambi  muri Sheferi y’u Buliza muri Teritwari ya Kigali. 11.	Rwabuyonza rwa Nkubamiheto ya Giharamagara cya Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuruza wa Rwakagara, watwaraga Susheferi ya Ngobagoba  muri Sheferi ya Budaha  muri Teritwari ya Gisenyi. 12.	Gisagara cya Munyakigeli cya Mbanzabigwi bya Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuru wa Rwakagara, watwaraga Susheferi ya Kinyinya  muri Sheferi ya Bwanacyambwe muri Teritwari ya Kigali. 13.	Kanobana ka Rwubusisi rwa Cyigenza cya Rwakagara, wari uwuzukuru wa Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuruza wa Rwakagara watwaraga Susheferi ya Muhororo  muri Sheferi y’u Buliza muri Teritwari ya Kigali. 14.	Hitiyise ya Rwabutogo rwa Kabare ka Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuruza wa Rwakagara, watwaraga Susheferi ya Rwamagana muri Sheferi y’u Buganza bw’Amajyepfo muri Teritwari ya Kibungo. 15.	Ngoga ya Kanimba ka Karubambana  rwa Giharamagara cya Rwakagara, wari ubuvivi bwa Rakagara, watwaraga muri Susheferi ya Nyanza-Juge  muri Sheferi ya Amarangara muri Teritwari ya Nyanza. 16.	Karinganire ka Karushoza ka Giharamagara cya Rwakagara  wari umwuzukuruza wa Rwakagara, watwaraga muri Susheferi ya Shaki muri Sheferi ya Ndiza muri Teritwari ya Nyanza. 17.	Bangambiki cya Nyantabana ya Kabare ka Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuruza wa Rwakagara, watwaraga muri Susheferi ya Mbuye  muri Sheferi ya Nduga  muri Teritwari ya Nyanza. 18.	Nkubito ya Mwikarago ya Rwabanda rwa Nyamushanja wa Rwakagara, wari Ubuvivi bwa Rwakagara watwaraga muri Susheferi ya Rwesero  muri Sheferi y’u Busanza bwa Ruguru muri Teritwari ya Nyanza. 19.	 Karuretwa ka Mwikarago ya Rwabanda rwa Nyamushanja wa Rwakagara, wari Ubuvivi bwa Rwakagara, watwaraga muri Susheferi ya Mushishiro  muri Sheferi ya Amarangara muri Teritwari ya Nyanza. 20.	 Gashagaza ka Sekaryongo rya Rwibishenga bya Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuruza wa Rwakagara, watwaraga muri Susheferi ya Sogwe muri Sheferi y’u Busanza bwa Ruguru  muri Teritwari ya Nyanza. 21.	Naho ya Sebwayi bwa Nyamushanja ya Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuruza wa Rwakagara watwaraga muri Susheferi ya Kanyarira  muri Sheferi ya Amarangara  muri Teritwari ya Nyanza. 22.	Mbaraga za Mwikarago ya Rwabanda rwa Nyamushanja wa Rwakagara, wari Ubuvivi bwa Rwakagara watwaraga Susheferi ya Kinunu muri Sheferi ya Kanage  muri Teritwari ya Gisenyi. 23.	 Rutemesha rwa  Rugemera rwa Nyamushanja ya Rwabugili, wari umwuzukuruza wa Rwakagara watwaraga Susheferi ya Kiruli muri Sheferi y’Akabagali  muri Teritwari ya Nyanza. 24.	 Ntunda ya Nyirinkwaya ya Giharamagara cya Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuruza wa Rwakagara watwaraga Susheferi ya Mutakara muri Sheferi y’u Bunyambilili muri Teritwari ya Nyanza. 25.	 Fundi ya Rwagataraka rwa Rwidegembya rwa Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuruza wa Rwakagara, watwaraga Susheferi ya Gishyita muri Sheferi ya Rusenyi- Itabire muri Teritwari ya Cyangugu. Kubera ubuhangange, ibigwi n’ibirindiro bahamije mu mateka y’u Rwanda, abakomoka mu muryango wa Rwakagara, bubatse inzu ikomeye cyane ikomoka mu muryango mugari w’Abega. Abahungu be bose uko ari 15, biyomoye ku nzu se Rwakagara akomokamo y’Abega b’Abagaga, barema inzu yabo y’igikonyozi, yitwa “Abega b’Abakagara’’ imwe mu nzu ikomeye yo mu Bega mu zabayeho mu mateka y’u Rwanda igizwe n’abantu benshi bakomeje kororoka no kugwiza ubuhangange, kugaragaza ubushobozi bwo kubaka igihugu no kukirinda. Kugeza ubwo aya mateka yandikwaga mu 2019, benshi mu bakomoka mu nzu yo kwa Rwakagara, bari biganje mu buyobozi bw’ingabo z’igihugu no mu yindi mirimo y’ikirenga y’igihugu. Ubwo aya mateka yandikwaga kandi, u Rwanda rwari ruyobowe n’umwe wo mu nzu y’Abakagara, ariwe : Kagame ka Rutagambwa rwa Kampayana ya Cyigenza cya Rwakagara, akaba ari ubuvivi bwa Rwakagara, umukurambere w’Abega b’Abakagara. Urabe wumva mwana w’i Rwanda, ibyo ni byo bisekuruza byo mu muryango wo kwa Rwakagara.  	Soma: Imiryango yahamije ubuhangange mu mateka y’u Rwanda: Igicumbi cyo kwa Rwakagara (Igice cya mbere)

title: Imiryango yahamije ubuhangange mu mateka y’u Rwanda: Igicumbi cyo kwa Rwakagara (Igice cya mbere)
content: Muri iki gice tugiye kubatekerereza amateka y’igicumbi cy’umuryango mugari ufite inkomoko Kuri Rwakagara rwa Gaga, iki kikaba ari igice gikurikiraho mu bindi bizibanda mu kubatekerereza imbumbe y’imiryango migari yabayemo ibihangange ikanagira n’inzu zikomeye mu mateka y’u Rwanda. Twifashishije ibitabo “Iyororoka ry’Abanyarwanda, inkomoko y’imiryango migari’’ n’icyitwa “Intwari z’imbanza, zubatse u Rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro’’ by’Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, inzobere mu Busizi, umuco n’amateka y’u Rwanda, tugiye kwinjira mu muryango mugari w’abakomoka kwa Rwakagara, mu mavu n’amavuko yawo n’inzu z’ibihangange zawukomotseho. Rwakagara ni umugabo wahamije imyato mu Rwanda, akaba mwene Gaga rya Mutazintare, akaba ari uwo mu muryango mugari w’Abega bo mu nzu y’Abagaga. Ni umwe mu Bega babayeho neza, bagira n’ibikorwa bikomeye mu Rwanda, maze agira n’amavugwa y’ikirenga, akomora ku kuba yarabyaye abana benshi kandi bakaba ibihangange ku ngoma z’abami b’u Rwanda nka Rwabugiri, Rutalindwa, Musinga, Rudahigwa na Ndahindurwa. Rwakagara yabayeho ku ngoma ya Gahindiro, iya Rwogera n’iya Rwabugiri, amateka akaba agaragaza ko ibisigisigi by’abo mu muryango we bikiri no mu buyobozi bwo mu Rwanda rwa vuba aha ubwo aya mateka yandikwaga. Umuryango we wagize ibigwi byinshi no mu mateka ya vuba aha, cyane mu guhangana n’Abakoloni b’Ababiligi no mu ibohorwa ry’u Rwanda. Rwakagara yabaye Umugaba w’Ingabo z’imitwe ibiri y’Uruyange n’Ingeyo, yombi yo ku ngoma ya Yuhi Gahindiro. Yanabaye Umugaba w’Ingabo w’imitwe y’Ingeyo, Abasoni n’Inkotanyi ku ngoma ya Kigeli Rwabugiri. Burya nta mugayo n’ubundi “Amavugwa agira aho avuka n’aho avomwa.’’ Rwakagara yari musaza wa Nyiramavugo Nyiramongi wari umugore wa Gahindiro, aza no kuba Umugabekazi w’umuhungu we Mutara Rwogera. Ni ukuvuga ko yari muramu w’Umwami Yuhi Gahindiro, akaba nyirarume w’Umwami Mutara Rwogera. Rwakagara yakunzwe na mushiki we Nyiramongi, ku buryo yamwinjije mu muryango w’ibwami buhoro buhoro, aza no kureshywa umwe mu bakobwa ba Gahindiro yabyaranye n’undi mugore utari Nyiramavugo aramumushyingira. Urujeni rwa Gahindiro, ni we mugore wa mbere Rwakagara yashatse. Nyuma y’Urujeni, Rwakagara yashatse Nyiramashyongoshyo ya Mukotanyi wo mu muryango mugari w’Abanyiginya mu nzu y’Abaka. Nyiramashyongoshyo yatashye busumbakazi (Gusumbakaza=kurongora umugore umukuye ku mugabo we) kwa Rwakagara kuko yamucyuye amuvanye mu yindi nzu ya Runihangabo biturutse ku Mugabekazi Nyiramavugo Nyiramongi nyina wa Rwogera. Umunsi umwe ngo Nyiramashyongoshyo yarebye Rwakagara maze ngo aravuga ati “Rwakagara ni umutware ubereye ingabo ariko hari icyo abuze ngo abonere rwose”.  Ibi ngo yashakaga kuvuga ko uyu mutware abura imirire myiza dore ko ngo yari ananutse byabuze akagero kandi ari umwana w’ingoma. Nyiramavugo rero ngo yararebye abona nta wundi wamwitaho keretse Nyiramashyongoshyo wari warabashije kubibona, maze ategeka musaza we Rwakagara kumucyura maze babyarana abandi bana biyongera kuri Bicunda yari yarabyaranye na Runihangabo. Urujeni rwa Gahindiro w’Umunyiginya wo mu nzu y’Abaganzu na Nyiramashyongoshyo w’Umunyiginya wo mu nzu y’Abaka, nibo bagore rukumbi amateka agaragaza ko Rwakagara yashatse. Rwakagara n’abagore be Urujeni na Nyiramashyongoshyo n’abandi bagore batandukanye babyaranye abana b’abahungu n’abakobwa. Harimo abahungu bagera kuri 15 n’abakobwa umunani, bose bakaba 23. Abana b’abahungu Rwakagara yabyaranye na Urujeni rwa Gahindiro mushiki wa Rwogera barimo Kabare, Ruhinankiko, Ruhinajoro, Rwibishenga, Cyigenza na Mbanzabigwi. Abahungu yabyaranye na Nyiramashyongoshyo ni Nyamushanja, Giharamagara, Sagatwa, Sebajura, Ryahama, Rwabigwi, Rwandoha, Ntizimira na Birara. Hakaza n’abandi Rwakagara  yabyaranye n’abandi bagore batandukanye. Abana b’abakobwa Rwakagara yabyaye ni Rubera,  Nsekarubera, Shegenya, Shalibabaza, Ilibagiza, Nyirandirikiye, Ikinani, Kanjogera na Nyamashaza. Abana ba Rwakagara bakuze basa nk’aho nabo ari Ibikomangoma by’ibunyiginya  kuko n’ubundi barerewe ibwami, bari ciraha nikubite kubera ko nyirasenge akaba na nyirakuru Nyiramavugo Nyiramongi wari nyiringoma. Mu gukomeza kwinjira cyane mu ngoma y’u Rwanda, abana ba Rwakagara babaye bamwe mu bahangiweho Umutwe w’Ingabo z’Ingangurarugo za Rwabugiri zanabaye umutwe w’umurangangoma we, wari wiganjemo abana b’abatware n’ibihangange byo mu gihugu. Abana ba Rwakagara bari mu Ngabo z’Ingangurarugo muri bo twavuga Birara, Kabare, Ntizimira, Ruhinankiko na Sebajura. Mu bihe by’ingoma ya Kigeli Rwabugiri, benshi mu bahungu ba Rwakagara, bari abagaba b’imitwe y’ingabo itandukanye yafashije Rwabugiri koromya amahanga no kuyagusha ruhabo. Bamwe muri bo twavuga nka: 1.	Nyamushanja watwaraga Umutwe w’Ingabo z’Uruyange 2.	Kabare watwaraga Umutwe w’Ingabo z’Indinda 3.	Ruhinankiko watwaraga Umutwe w’Ingabo z’Abadaraza 4.	Giharamagara watwaraga Umutwe w’Ingabo z’Abasozi n’ Inkotanyi afatanyije na se Rwakagara 5.	Cyigenza watwaraga Umutwe w’Ingabo z’i Nyantango Umuryango wa kwa Rwakagara, ni wo waciye agahigo mu mateka y’u Rwanda, ko guturukwamo n’abagabekazi benshi n’abagore b’ibwami benshi. Mu muryango wa Rwakagara habonetsemo abagabekazi bane n’abagore b’ibwami batatu. Ku ikubitiro, hari abo amateka atugaragariza bakomoka mu muryango wo kwa Rwakagara, babaye abagabekazi n’abamikazi b’ingoma y’u Rwanda. Muri bo twavuga; 1.	Nyiramavugo Nyiramongi wari Mushiki wa Rwakagara, wabaye umugabekazi w’umuhungu we Mutara Rwogera. 2.	Nyirayuhi Kanjogera, umukobwa wa Rwakagara na Nyiramashyongoshyo wabaye Umugabekazi w’abami babiri, Rutalindwa n’umuhungu we Musinga. 3.	Nyiramavugo Kankazi ka Mbanzabigwi bya Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuru wa Rwakagara, wabaye umugabekazi w’umuhungu we Mutara Rudahigwa. 4.	Nyirakigeli Mukashema rya Cyigenza cya Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuru wa Rwakagara, wabaye umugabekazi w’umuhungu we Kigeli Ndahindurwa. 5.	Kagisha ka Cyigenza cya Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuru wa Rwakagara, wabaye umwe mu bagore b’Umwami Yuhi Musinga. 6.	Nyirakabuga ka Cyigenza cya Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuru wa Rwakagara, wabaye umwe mu bagore b’umwami Yuhi Musinga. 7.	Mukaruhinda rwa Rukemanganizi za Ruhinajoro rya Rwakagara, wari umwuzukuruza wa Rwakagara, wabaye umwe mu bagore b’umwami Yuhi Musinga. Ibi nibyo bisekuruza byo mu muryango wo kwa Rwakagara. Reka tube duhiniye aha, mu gice cya kabiri tuzasubukura byimazeyo, tunasesengura birunduye, ubuhangange bw’igicumbi cy’umuryango wa Rwakagara rwa Gaga.

title: Padiri Amerika yasohoye igitabo ‘Nzi Uwo Nemeye’, gihanura abasoma Bibiliya ‘bunyuguti’
content: Iki gitabo yari amaze imyaka itatu yandika, avuga ko kirimo ibisobanuro bishingiye cyane cyane kuri Bibiliya, aho avuga ku myemerere abantu bakunze kutavugaho rumwe, hakaba abayisobanura uko bishakiye kubera ibikomere bahuye na byo. Imwe mu myemerere ikubiye mu bice birindwi bigize icyo gitabo harimo nk’ibijyanye n’umubatizo, irangira ry’isi, kuboneza urubyaro, umubare 666 ukunze  gufatwa nk’uwa shitani n’ibindi. Padiri Amerika Victor ubwo yamurikaga iki gitabo muri Hotel Sainte Famille kuri uyu wa Gatanu, yavuze ko inganzo ya mbere yayikuye muri Paruwasi ayobora ya Nyabinyenga iherereye muri Diyosezi ya Kabgayi. Yavuze ko hari abakiristu bajyaga baza kumubaza ibibazo bitandukanye bishingiye ku myemerere, yongera kuyikomora ku bwinshi bw’amadini ari muri ako gace aho usanga amenshi ashishikajwe no gushaka abayoboke aho kwigisha ijambo ry’Imana uko riri. Padiri Amerika yavuze ko abantu benshi basigaye bagwa mu mutego wo kwigisha ijambo ry’Imana nabi, bagasoma Bibiliya igice cyangwa bakayisobanura bagendeye ku marangamutima n’ibikomere basebya imyemerere y’abandi. Yagize ati “Muri iki gihe hari amatorero y’inzaduka aho abantu bigisha aho kugira ngo bashingire ku kuri , bagashingira ku marangamutima n’ibikomere byabo, agafata Bibiliya agafata akajambo kamwe bagasoma bunyuguti, agasoma akajambo kamwe ntabashe gusoma ibikurikiraho.” Yongeyeho ati “Iki ni igitabo numva cyafasha abakiristu Gatolika n’abo mu yandi matorero bifuza kumenya by’ukuri kuko nanditse nshingiye ku kuri aho gushimira ku idini.” Musenyeri uri mu kiruhuko cy’izabukuru, André Havugimana yashimiye Padiri Amerika kuba yarashiritse ubute akandika muri iki gihe benshi bashishikajwe no gusoma ibiri kuri internet gusa. Yavuze ko ari ikimenyetso kigaragaza ko azirikana intama yahawe kuragira no gukomeza kwamamaza ubutumwa bwiza bushingiye ku myerere ye. Yagize ati “Ubu ni uburyo bwo gushimira Imana no guhamya impano. Ntabwo abantu bose bandika cyane cyane muri iki gihe mu bapadiri kubera ko basigaye boroherwa no gusoma ibiri kuri Internet bakagira ngo birahagije. Igihe tugezemo kubona umwanya wo kwicara ukandika bikwiye gushimwa kuko abantu bahora mu bigezweho gusa kandi hirya abantu bicaranye ibibazo bitandukanye.” Umwe mu bakristu ba Paruwasi ya Nyabinyenga, Rutaganda Henry yashimiye Padiri Amerika kuba yashyize hanze igitabo gisobamura imyerere ikunze gutera benshi urujijo. Yavuze ko kigiye gufasha benshi cyane cyane abakiristu bajyaga bagira impungenge kubyo bemera cyangwa bakabura ibisobanuro bihagije mu gihe hari ubabajije ibyo bemera. Iki gitabo cyatangiye kugurishwa mu nzu zitandukanye zigurisha ibitabo hirya no hino mu gihugu nko kuri St Famille mu mujyi wa Kigali, kuri diyosezi ya Kabgayi n’ahandi.
