title: U Bubiligi bwahaye u Rwanda urutonde rw’ibikoresho ndangamurage bubitse birimo igisingo cy’umwami Rwabugili
content:
Urutonde rw’ibyo bimenyetso byashyikirijwe umuyobozi w’ingoro z’umurage w’u Rwanda, Amb Masozera Robert  kuri uyu wa Kane, ubwo hafungurwaga ku mugaragaro imurika ry’uruhare rw’abanyarwanda, abarundi n’abanye-Congo mu Ntambara ya Mbere y’isi yose. Umuyobozi w’Ingoro y’umurage nyafurika mu Bubiligi ibitse byinshi muri ibyo bikoresho, Guido Gryseels yashyikirije Masozera ’flash disk’ iriho urutonde rw’ibikoresho ndangamateka bisaga ibihumbi bibiri, by’u Rwanda, biri hirya no hino mu nzu ndangamurage z’u Bubiligi. Ni nyuma y’ubusabe u Rwanda rwagejeje kuri icyo gihugu, ngo rumenye neza  umurage warwo uri mu Bubuligi nyuma ruzabone kujya mu biganiro by’uburyo byagarurwa. Nubwo umwanzuro wo kugarura ibyo bikoresho utarafatwa, Guido Gryseels yashimangiye ko umurage w’abanyafurika ubitswe i Burayi ugomba kugarurwa. Yagize ati “Ni ibisannzwe ko uwo murage nyafurika uri mu Burayi ugaruka. Ibindi bihugu byinshi byo muri Afurika byashyizeho za komisiyo ngo bamenye umurage ndangametka w’ibihugu byabo byajyanywe mu Burayi. Umwaka ushize Robert yansabye ko namufasha kumenya ibintu ndangamurage by’u Rwanda biri mu Burayi, none intambwe ya mbere ni uko nishimiye kumuhereza urutonde rwa 2069 rw’ibintu ndangamurage biri mu nzu ndangamurage zacu, hariho amafoto y’igihe byajyaniwe, uko byajyanywe, icyo byakoreshwaga.” Guido yavuze ko hari n’imyiteguro igeze kure yo gushyikiriza u Rwanda inyandiko n’amakarita byafashwe mu gihe cy’ubukoloni, bigaragaza ibiri munsi y’ubutaka bw’u Rwanda nk’umutungo kamere, amabuye y’agaciro n’ibindi. Yavuze ko bigenze neza, muri Mutarama cyangwa Gashyantare umwaka utaha ibyo bimenyetso ndangamurage bigaragaza munsi y’ubutaka byaba byashyikirijwe u Rwanda. Ati “Hari na gahunda yo gushyira mu ikoranabuhanga ishyinguranyandiko zose z’u Rwanda ziri mu Bubiligi. Ni intambwe ikomeye, ntekereza ko turi igihugu cya mbere mu Burayi mu kubikorera gutyo igihugu cya Afurika kandi ndabizeza umucyo mu gusangira ibimenyetso ndangamurage, inyandiko, amafoto, amajwi n’amashusho dufite.” Amb Masozera yabwiye IGIHE ko bishimiye kwakira urwo rutonde kuko bizagaragaza neza umutungo gakondo w’abanyarwanda uri mu Bubiligi kugira ngo u Rwanda rubone uko rutangira ibiganiro ngo ugarurwe. Yavuze ko mu Ngoro ibitse amateka ya Afurika iherereye i Tervuren mu  Bubiligi, hari ibikoresho byinshi by’umurage w’abanyarwanda birimo ibikoresho byakoreshwaga kera, ingoma zirimo n’iz’ibwami, inyamaswa zabaga mu Rwanda nk’inyambo yumishijwe, igisingo cy’umwami Kigeli IV Rwabugili, indirimbo, amashusho n’amafoto bigaragaza abanyarwanda bo hambere n’ibindi. Bivugwa ko mu Bubiligi ari naho hari umugogo w’umwami Yuhi V Musinga, icyakora Masozera yavuze ko byo bitarasobanuka neza kuko nta gihamya ko wajyanyweyo. Yavuze ko kuba u Rwanda ruhawe urwo rutonde, ari intangiriro y’ibiganiro biganisha ku kugarura uwo murage w’amateka mu Rwanda. Yagize ati “Bafite inyandiko nyinshi ku buryo bazibara mu burebure zikaba zishobora kurenga ikirometero. Ni inyandiko zaba izakoreshwaga mu butegetsi, izo mu bucukuzi… Bazaduha ibijyanye n’ibiri munsi y’ubutaka bw’u Rwanda, ubukungu buri mu butaka bw’u Rwanda barabuzi. Bafite amakarita ku buryo abantu bashobora kumenya ahari zahabu, diyama n’ibindi”. Byinshi mu bihugu bya Afurika byakolonijwe kuri ubu biri mu rugamba rwo kugarurirwa umurage w’amateka yabyo watwawe n’abanyaburayi mu gihe cy’ubukoloni. Mu minsi ishize u Bufaransa bwasubije Sénégal inkota yibwe indwanyi yayo Omar Saidou Tall mu kinyejana cya 19. Uretse u Bubiligi, u Rwanda runafite ibindi bikoresho, inyandiko n’ibirango ndangamurage byajyanywe mu Budage kuko nacyo ari igihugu cyarukolonije. 
Masozera yavuze ko naho ibiganiro byatangiye ngo ibyo icyo gihugu kibitse kibigarure. Igihugu cy’u Butaliyani nubwo kitakolonije u Rwanda ariko kibitse inyandiko zarwo kubera Kiliziya Gatolika yarugezemo kera. U Bubiligi bwakolonije u Rwanda nk’indagizo rwahawe na Loni nyuma y’Intambara ya Mbere y’Isi yose mu 1919, rwambuwe u Budage.

title: Mu Rwanda hatangijwe imurika ry’amateka y’abanyarwanda mu ntambara ya mbere y’isi yose
content: Intambara ya mbere y’isi yose yatangiye u Rwanda ruri mu maboko y’Abadage, isoza rwarageze mu maboko y’Ababiligi. Nubwo akenshi yumvikana nk’intambara yarwanywe n’ibihugu bikomeye cyane cyane iby’i Burayi, ntiyasize n’umugabane wa Afurika byinshi muri ibyo bihugu byari byarigaruriye. Uwatsinze cyangwa ukomeye niwe uvuga amateka uko abishaka, ni nayo mpamvu utazapfa kubona intwari z’abanyafurika zarwanye iyo ntambara mu bitabo by’amateka ahubwo ingabo z’abakoloni babaga bayibashoyemo nizo uzasanga zivugwa ibigwi. Iri murika ryatangiye rigamije gusubiza agaciro izo ngabo z’abanyafurika n’abaturage bayo batikiriye mu ntambara ya mbere y’isi by’umwihariko Abanyarwanda, Abarundi n’Abanye-Congo. Ryateguwe n’Ingoro y’umurage w’u Rwanda ku bufatanye n’Ingoro y’umurage nyafurika iri mu Bubiligi, izwi nka Musée Royal de l’Afrique centrale, ari nayo yari ibitse ayo makuru yose y’uburyo abanyafurika mu bice bari bakolonije bitwaye mu ntambara ya mbere y’isi yose. Muri iri murika harimo amafoto y’icyo gihe n’ibisobanuro by’uburyo izo ngabo z’abanyafurika zitwaye ku rugamba, akaga zahuye nako n’ingaruka iyo ntambara yagize ku baturage. Umuyobozi w’Ingoro y’umurage nyafurika mu Bubiligi, Guido Gryseels, yavuze ko iryo murika ari intambwe ya mbere mu gushyira hanze amateka nyafurika abitse mu Bubiligi n’imikoranire myiza hagati y’ibihugu byombi. Yagize ati “Umwaka ushize twaganiriye uburyo twavugurura imikoranire , iri murika ni intambwe ya mbere. Ubwo hakorwaga imurika rya mbere rikozwe n’ingoro ndangamurage kuri Afurika, yavugaga ku ruhare rw’abanyarwanda mu ntambara ya mbere y’isi yose. Twarizanye hano, ndizera ko mwishimiye iri murika kuko hazaza n’andi.” Ambasaderi w’u Bubiligi mu Rwanda, Benoît Ryelandt, yavuze ko iryo murika rigamije gusubiza agaciro abanyarwanda n’abandi banyafurika barwanye intambara ya mbere y’isi ariko bibagiranye. Ati “Intambara yarwaniwe hano mu myaka ijana ishize isa nk’itavugwa mu Burayi ndetse ibyabaye akenshi bivugwa uko bitari. Uko byagenze icyo gihe byirengagiza ukuri, ikerekanwa nk’intambara yarwanywe n’ibihugu byari bikolonije ku nyungu zabyo nta kwita ku buzima bw’ingabo z’abanyafurika , ababatwazaga n’ubuzima bw’abaturage basanzwe.” Yakomeje agira ati “Iri murika rifite intego yo kuvuga ukuri k’uburyo ibintu byagenze nta guca ku ruhande. Ibyo bizaba ri uguha ubutabera ku bihugu byahoze bikolonijwe no ku bihumbi by’abagabo n’abagore ba Afurika babuze ubuzima bwabo muri ayo makimbirane.” Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ingoro z’umurage w’u Rwanda, Amb Robert Masozera, yavuze ko nyuma yo guhabwa ibigize iryo murika, bigiye kuba inzira yo kugira ngo n’undi mutungo ndangamurage w’u Rwanda uri mu Bubiligi ugarurwe. Yasabye abanyarwanda kwitabira iryo murika bakamenya amateka batari bazi ndetse bagatanga n’ibitekerezo kubyo bazi kuko bitakwizerwa ijana ku ijana ko ibyatangajwe ariko byagenze, gusa avuga ko bizazamura ibiganiro mpaka mu banyamateka. Ati “Turashaka ko abantu barisura ariko bakanabijyaho impaka kuko nta wahamya ko ibyavuzwemo hano byose ari ukuri. Dukeka ko bituzuye ijana ku ijana, hashobora kuba hari ibindi biburamo ku buryo twabifata nk’imvumburamatsiko. Ni n’ubury bwo kunamira abantu bacu bibagiranye mu mateka.” Iri murika rizamara ukwezi ribera  mu ngoro yo kwa Kandt gusa Masozera yavuze ko rizanazengurutswa hirya no hino mu gihugu mu zindi ngoro kugira abantu benshi  babashe kumenya amateka y’u Rwanda mu gihe cy’ubukoloni.

title: Ibigwi n’ibirindiro: Amateka n’ibigwi by’inka mu Rwanda ( Igice cya mbere)
content: Muri iki gice tugiye kubavunguriraho gato ku bigwi n’ibirindiro by’amateka  y’ibigwi by’inka mu Rwanda, dore ko utabikuyeho akamanyu nibura gato gato, utashobora kubiva imuzi ngo ubigere imuzingo. Nk’uko tubikesha igitabo “Intwari z’imbanza, zubatse u Rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro’’ cyanditswe n’Umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, inzobere ku Muco, ubusizi n’amateka,  tubimburiye ku iyinjira ry’inka  mu Rwanda n’uko zatejwe imbere zikaba urufatiro rukomeye rw’ibintu byinshi mu mateka. Inka ifite ibisekuruza byinshi mu mateka y’Afurika, aho bisaga imyaka 3000. Inka  zahanganywe n’u Rwanda, aho zadukanywe n’Abasangwabutaka b’Abasinga n’Abazigaba ahasaga mu wa 300. Abanyiginya bahasesekaye, bateje imbere cyane ubworozi bw’inka bituma inka zose zo mu gihugu bazitirirwa, aho mu mateka bagira bati “Gihanga niwe wahanze inka n’ingoma’’ . Bikomoye ku kuba Abanyiginya aribo bahaye intera ndende n’urwego rw’ikirenga ubworozi bw’inka, ziba nyinshi mu gihugu. Inka yahawe intera iyingayinga iy’umuntu. Aho mu Bucurabwenge bw’inka, bagiraga bati “Inka ni imfura, kuko upfa ikakurerera, wabumbira ( wabura amashereka) ikakugoboka, ikakurwanyiriza indwara z’ibyorezo n’ubujyahabi”. Inka niyo yarangaga ubukire, Inka niyo yari ipfundo ry’ubuhake nk’akazi ko hambere, Intwari yo ku rugamba yagororerwaga inka, Inka yungaga inshuti, Inka yahuzaga inshuti  (abahanaga inka, babaga babaye inshuti ), Inka bayikwaga umugeni nk’ikimenyetso cy’uburere bwiza. Mu Kinyejana cya Munani nyuma ya Yezu, ni ukuvuga ahasaga mu wa 700, nibwo hadutse  ishyanga rishya mu Rwanda, ari ryo ryaje kuvamo umuryango mugari w’Abanyiginya, baza n’ubundi, bagowe n’iyimukayimuka ryabo n’umutungo wabo urangajwe imbere n’inka bagendaga bashakira inzuri zitoshye kandi ngari. Mu gusesekara mu Rwanda,  binjiriye bwa mbere mu Gihugu cy’u Rweya rw’u Mubali ( mu mirenge ya Murundi na Mwili yo mu Karere ka Kayonza na Rwimbogo yo mu Karere ka Gatsibo).  Kuko ubutaka bubereye ubworozi bw’inka zabo bari babugezeho, bishimiye umukenke w’Iburasirazuba bw’u Rwanda, ugaragiwe n’ubutohe bw’umurambi w’ubutaka bwiganjemo icyogogo cy’uruzi rw’Akagera, ibiyaga bya Rwanyakiziga, Nasho, Ihema n’ibindi. Imyaka isaga 300(700-1091), umuryango mugari w’Abanyiginya wamaze mu busembere mu ngoma y’u Rweya rw’Abazigaba, nta kindi cyera cyangwa se cyirabura bakoze, usibye guteza imbere ubworozi bw’inka, bakora ubugenge n’ubuhanga bwo kuzibangurira kugira ngo zirusheho kororoka, maze nazo zirabakundira ziroroka karahava!! Aha akaba ari naho, bakuye umwihariko w’inka zitirirwa u Rwanda z’Inyambo  aribyo bivuga “Itungo ry’intoranywa’’. Imisozi yose bacumbikiwemo, yari yiganjemo inzuri z’inka, aho gutura ari hato, ku buryo aribo ba mbere bateje imbere gutura mu nsisiro mu rwego rwo kurinda akajagari mu miturire byari kugabanya ingano y’inzuri z’inka zabo. Mu misozi batuyemo myinshi kuri ubu  ibarizwa mu Karere ka Gatsibo ¾ byayo  byari inzuri z’inka. Muri yo twavuga Imisozi ya Nyagihanga, Rugarama, Ngarama, Kabarore, Gitoki, Gatsibo na Kageyo Imisozi batuyemo muri ibyo bihe, ari nayo baremyemo insisiro, ni mu mu Murenge wa Remera na Muhura yo mu Karere ka Gatsibo. Uko imyaka yashiraga indi igataha, niko Abanyiginya barushagaho guteza imbere ubworozi bw’inka, ari nako butuma bagira ijambo ry’icyizerabuhake mu Rweya, kugeza ubwo byabahesheje ijambo mu nzu y’ubwami bwabo, banashakamo abagore b’ibikomangoma. Muri bo twavuga nka Nyirarukangaga rwa Nyamigezi ya Kabeja, washatswe na Kazi ka Kizira, bakabyarana Gihanga. Abanyiginya bakomeje kugwiza ubutunzi bw’inka, amashyo n’amagana, bibaha imbaraga n’icyubahiro cy’ikirenga, kugeza ubwo ibwami batangiye kubakeka amababa ko bashobora kuzabambura ingoma, ari nabwo Gihanga yabimenyaga agashyira nzira akabahunga ajya guhanga igihugu cye mu bisigara by’ubutaka Abasangwabutaka banennye, akabuhangaho igihugu cy’i Gasabo. Gihanga, akimara guhanga Gasabo, Umuryango mugari w’Abanyiginya akomokamo akawukura mu busembere mu ngoma y’u Rweya, yashyizeho igenamigambi  ryeruye rishingiye ku nka mu kubaka igihugu cye. Inka ihabwa umwanya ukomeye mu buzima bwose bw’igihugu, aho yifashishwaga muri Politiki z’igihugu zitandukanye nko mu Bubanyi n’amahanga, mu kubaka ubukungu bw’igihugu, mu mutekano no mu ntambara zo kwigarurira amahanga, mu mibereho myiza y’abaturage, mu mibanire n’ubumwe bw’abenegihugu n’ibindi. Inka yayishyize mu igamigambi ry’ ububanyi n’amahanga n’ubutwererane n’abami b’ibindi bihugu bituranyi by’u Rwanda ku buryo yagombaga guhuza u Rwanda n’ibihugu by’inshuti kandi ikagabirwa abami b’ ibihugu byanga u Rwanda, bityo bikagabanya urwango, ubundi rukabasha gukora ibikorwa by’iterambere rwifuza. Inka yabaye inkingi ya mwamba yo kurwanya umwanzi w’imbere mu gihugu. Umwanzi w’imbere mu gihugu, burya ni ubukene. Iyo umunyarwanda atakennye, nta nabi agira, kandi umwanzi wo hanze y’igihugu ntiyabona aho yinjirira, kuko uwakamubereye icyitso wo mu gihugu hagati, baba baramugushije ruhabo. Nuko Gihanga, agena gahunda zo kugabira abaturage inka ku buntu, kugira ngo biteze imbere, ubundi amahoro ahinde mu miryango yabo. Inka yashyizwe mu rwego rwo gufasha igihugu mu kugera ku mutekano n’intwaro yo guhashya amahanga adakunda u Rwanda. Niho Gihanga, yahereyeho ashyiraho gahunda yo kugabira inka Ingabo zose z’igihugu, kugira ngo zirusheho kwitabira intambara zo kwivuna abanzi, no kugira imbaduko ku rugamba rwo kwagura igihugu. Inka yafatiweho umurongo mugari wo kwigarurira imitima y’abaturage b’ibindi bihugu u Rwanda rwashakaga kwigarurira. Aho buri muturage u Rwanda rwabaga rwanyaze mu bitero byo kurwagura, yahabwaga inka nyinshi zo korora zikamufasha kwikura mu bukene, bityo akinjira muri Paradizo nshya y’igihugu cy’u Rwanda, irimo amata n’ubuki, umutima akawukura kuri gakondo y’iwabo, akaganza  i Rwanda. Gahunda yo kugabira abaturage b’ibindi bihugu banyazwe n’u Rwanda, yatumye benshi mu baturage batoroka ibihugu byabo, biyizira mu Rwanda, bahabwa inka zo korora, ubundi batangira gutanga amakuru y’imbamutima y’uburyo u Rwanda ruzigarurira ibihugu bakomokamo. Ubukungu bw’ibihugu mu bihe byo hambere, bwari abaturage ku isonga, ubundi butunzi bugakurikiraho, ari nayo mpamvu u Rwanda, rwihatiye kwigarurira abaturage b’ibindi bihugu, rwifashishije inka.

title: Padiri Amerika agiye kumurika igitabo gitanga umucyo ku mpaka z’urudaca zishingiye  kuri Bibiliya
content:
Muri iki gitabo, Padiri Amerika yashyizemo ibice bitandukanye bishingiye ku bushakashatsi na Bibiliya, bigaragaza ukuri kw’imyererere abantu bajya bibazaho. Avugamo inzira ikwiriye abanyamadini kuri ubu basa n’abarajwe ishinga no kurwana intambara zishingiye ku myemerere, ugasanga barwanira abayoboke kurusha uko bwaranira kwigisha ukuri kw’ijambo ry’Imana. Agaruka no ku bibazo bigaragara mu muryango ariko bitavugwaho rumwe, nk’ibijyanye no kwihorera, gusenda abagore, kuboneza urubyaro n’ibindi. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE, Padiri Amerika yavuze ko yagize igitekerezo cyo kwandika iki gitabo nyuma yo kwegerwa na bamwe mu bakiristu ayoboye akumva ibibazo bakunze kumubaza bigaragaza ko hari ibyo badasobanukiwe. Yabihereye kandi mu gace paruwasi ayobora iherereyemo kabonekamo amadini menshi ariko ugasanga ashishikajwe no gushaka abayoboke asebya andi aho kwigisha ukuri kw’ijambo ry’Imana kuboneka muri Bibiliya. Ati “Muri iki gihe abantu benshi baremera, dufite amadini atandukanye dusengeramo ugasanga umuntu yabaye uw’idini kuruta kuba uw’ukuri, agatsimbarara kuri bya bindi bemera ariko atanabisobanukiwe.” Yakomeje agira ati “Igitabo cyanjye ntabwo ari igitabo cy’idini, ni igitabo nanditse nk’umuntu uri mu buzima bw’iyobokamana ariko cyakwifashishwa n’abantu bose.” Padiri Amerika nko ku kijyanye no kuboneza urubyaro, agaragaza ko hari abagendera ku mugambo aboneka muri Bibiliya avuga ngo “Mubyare mwororoke mungane n’umusenyi wo ku Nyanja”. Yavuze ko nubwo Bibiliya ivuga ityo, Aburahamu ufatwa nka sekuruza w’abemera bose yabyaye abana umunani gusa mu gihe cye bishingiye ku bushobozi n’inshingano yari afite. Ibyo bijyanye n’andi magambo yo muri  Bibiliya, mu ibaruwa ya kabiri Pawulo intumwa yandikiye abanyakolenti, 12:14 handitse ngo “ si abana bateganyiriza ababyeyi ahubwo ni ababyeyi bateganyiriza abana babo.” Padiri Amerika agaragaza ko  iyo ngingo  yereka umubyeyi ko kubyara ari uburenganzira n’inshingano. Ati “Byara uwo ushoboye kurera, utazaba interagahinda akurushye, arushye n’igihugu.” Muri iki gitabo kandi umwanditsi agaruka ku buhanuzi bweze muri iki gihe cyane cyane ubujyanye n’igihe isi izarangirira. Yabwiye IGIHE ko ntawe ukwiriye guhanura iby’irangira ry’isi atarayishyizeho, ko  bikwiriye guharirwa Imana ari nayo yaremye. Yifuza ko uzasoma iki gitabo asobanukirwa n’imyemerere ye ndetse n’itandukaniro n’iy’abandi ariko byose bikaba ibiganisha ku kubana neza n’abandi aho gushwana. Ati “Tureke kuba abantu b’idini, ntabwo idini ari ishyaka. Ishyaka rya mbere ni ukurwanirira kubana neza n’abandi , kugira ngo mugenzi wawe akugirireho umugisha nawe umugirireho umugisha.” Musenyeri wa Diyosezi ya Kabgayi, Smaragde Mbonyintege ni we wanditse ijambo ry’ikaze ry’iki gitabo. Mbonyintege mu ijambo ry’ikaze, yavuze ko iki gitabo kije gukemura impaka z’urudaca ku myumvire ya Bibiliya mu matorerro atandukanye. Ati “Impaka z’urudaca ku myumvire ya Bibiliya duhuriyeho
n’andi matorero ndetse no ku Masakramentu bamwe mu
banyamatorero bakunze kugoreka imyumvire, umwanditsi
yabiboneye ibisubizo ku buryo bwumvikana.” Yongeyeho  ati “ Iki gitabo ndagishimira ko kitagamije kwinjira mu mpaka n’abagoreka ibyo twigisha, ahubwo gufasha mbere na mbere abakristu bacu gusobanukirwa mu mpaka z’ababarundaho ibisobanuro biyobya.” Iki gitabo kizamurikwa kuri uyu wa Gatanu i Kigali kuri Hotel St Famille, guhera saa kumi n’igice z’umugoroba.

title: Ububiko bw’amateka: Umudugudu wa Nyirabwana wahoze ari igicumbi cy’ingoma y’u Bwanacyambwe
content: Muri iki gice, tugiye kubatekerereza bimwe mu bimenyetso ndangamateka, bigaragaza imiterere y’imwe mu misozi y’u Rwanda rwo hambere, rutaraturwa ngo rube insinsiro zisakayemo abantu. Nkuko tubikesha igitabo “Imizi y’u Rwanda’’ n’igitabo “Intwari z’imbanza, zubatse u Rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro’’, byombi dukesha umwanditsi n’umusizi Nsanzabera Jean de Dieu, tugiye gutekerereza hamwe amateka y’umudugudu wa Nyirabwana wo mu Kagali ka Kibagabaga mu Murenge wa Kimironko ho mu Karere ka Gasabo ahahoze ari ingoma ngabe y’igihugu cy’u Bwanacyambwe mu bihe byo hambere. Hariho nka kimwe mu bimenyetso bibitse amateka akomeye agaragaza imiterere y’igihugu cy’u Bwanacyambwe mbere y’uko gihangwamo igihugu, n’ikimenyetso kigaragaza bene cyo uburyo bakuturanyije bakagitunganya kikaba igihugu kiganje. Ubu butaka butaraba igihugu cy’u Bwanacyambwe bwari ubutaka bw’imigina n’ibishanga by’imifunzo by’amasanzure y’umugezi wa Nyabugogo n’Akagera, n’ikiyaga cya Mugesera. Mu bihe byo hambere, igihugu cy’u Bwanacyambwe cyari gikikijwe n’ingoma y’i Gisaka cy’Abagesera b’Abazirankende mu Burasirazuba, Gasabo y’Abanyiginya  mu Majyaruguru, Nduga y’Ababanda mu Burengerazuba bw’Amajyepfo, u Buliza bw’Abongera mu Majyaruguru y’u Burengerazuba n’ingoma y’u Bugesera bw’Abahondogo yari mu Majyepfo. Igihugu cy’u Bwanacyambwe kimwe n’icy’u Buliza, byagengwaga n’Ibikomangoma by’Abongera, bakomoka kuri Mwongera wa Rurenge Sekuruza wabo. Aho cyari giherereye kugeza ubwo aya mateka yandikwaga, ni mu Karere ka Nyarugenge, Akarere ka Kicukiro, Akarere ka Gasabo y’Amajyepfo (Mu Mirenge ya Gisozi, Kinyinya, Kimihurura, Remera na Kimironko) hamwe n’Akarere ka Rwamagana y’Iburengerazuba (Mu mirenge ya Karenge, Nyakariro, Nzige, Muyumbu na Gahengeri). Amacishirizo y’ihangwa ry’icyo gihugu, akaba agaragaza ko cyahanzwe mu mizo ya mbere y’iyaguka ry’ibihugu byagengwaga n’Abasinga b’Abasangwabutaka, aho cyahanzwe ahasaga mu wa 450, nyuma ya Yezu Kirisitu. Mu ihangwa ry’igihugu cy’u Bwanacyambwe, ryanzuwe n’umuhungu wa Rurenge witwaga Mwongera n’umugore we w’inkundwakazi Nyirabwanacyambwe, ari na we wakurijweho kwitirirwa icyo gihugu kikitwa’’ u Bwanacyambwe’. Agasozi gakuru ari nako kabarwa nk’ubutaka gakondo bw’Abongera, kitwaga  Nyirabwanacyambwe, niko ubu kabumbye imidugudu ya Nyirabwana, Ramiro, Rindiro na Kageyo yo mu Kagali ka Kibagabaga, mu Murenge wa Kimironko wo mu Karere ka Gasabo. Ingoma ngabe y’Abongera ikaba yari itetse mu Mudugudu wa Nyirabwana ( Nyirabwanacyambwe) wiswe izina ry’impine, aho kuryuzuza ngo witwe ’’Nyirabwanacyambwe". Nyuma y’imyaka amagana, ingoma ngabe yaje  kwimurirwa mu Mudugudu wa Amahoro mu Kagali ka Rukiri II mu Murenge wa Remera wo mu Karere ka Gasabo ko mu Mujyi wa Kigali, ari naho hashyiriweho iherezo ryayo ubwo u Bwanacyambwe bwatsindwaga n’u Rwanda mu gitero cyagabwe na Kigeli Mukobanya ahasaga mu wa 1378, akivugana Nkuba ya Nyabakonjo watwaraga u Bwanacyambwe muri ibyo bihe. Ubutaka bw’Umudugudu wa Nyirabwana, ni kimwe mu bimenyetso karundura, kigaragaza ko ingoma y’u Bwanacyambwe yabayeho, kandi ikagaragaza n’inkomoko y’iryo zina, n’aho yatangiriye mu bwaguke bwayo.

title: Umusozi wa Kigali wasabirwagaho kugira Umutima w’u Rwanda
content:
Umusozi wa Kigali n’Igenamigambi ry’ingoma inye (Ubu twagereranya na Vision 2020 cyangwa 2050).
 Kumenya icyerekezo cy’u Rwanda mu myaka ijana  ni byo bitwereka  neza icyo ubusugire n’ubwigenge by’u Rwanda gakondo  byari  bisobanuye, bityo  na none tukabasha  no  gusobanukirwa neza  n’icyari ku mutima (Philosophie) w’abakurambere baremye u Rwanda bakarwubaka, bakarurwanira ndetse  benshi  bakanarupfira. Aha tugiye kubona ko ubusugire n’imibereho myiza y’Abanyawanda ku ngoma eshatu bwategurwaga n’Abami bitwa Mutara na Cyilima mbereho nk’ imyaka ijana. Nk’uko musanzwe mubizi, mu mazina y’Abami atanu yasimburanaga mu bihe bine yakurikiranaga atya: Mutara, Kigeli, Mibambwe, Yuhi na Cyilima. Aha biragaragara neza ko hagati ya Mutara na Cyilima hacagamo Ingoma eshatu mbere y’uko Cyilima atangiza ikindi cyiciro cy’Abami. Inshingano z’abami Kigeli na Mibambwe zabaga ari ukwagura u Rwanda kuko ku ngoma eshatu zabaga zarabanje Inka n’Abantu byabaga byaragwiriye bityo hakaba haragombaga kuboneka uruhumekero habayeho kwagura ubutaka bw’igihugu. Yuhi  yari ashinzwe imihango y’i Bwami cyane cyane Umuriro waho utarazimaga ukaba wararangaga ubusugire bw’igihugu. Aha murumva ko Yuhi yari ashinzwe gutunganya ibijyanye n’ubusugire bw’igihugu n’ibijyanye n’imiyoborere myiza kimwe n’Iyobokamana kugira ngo abandi bami bane babone urufatiro rukomeye bazubakiraho. Ubwo hari aho bitaniye cyane n’ibikorwa ubu mu igenamigambi rirerire? Yaba Yuhi, Kigeli na Mibambwe uko ari batatu babanzirizwaga kandi bagaherukwa na Mutara cyangwa na Cyilima. Musenyeri Kagame yaragaragaje ko mu Rwanda Ingoma eshatu zamaraga imyaka 100 kuko buri yose yari imyaka yegereye 33. Mbese ni ukuvugako kuva Mutara cyangwa Cyilima batanze kugera hongera kwima undi Mutara cyangwa undi Cyilima; muri rusange habaga hashize imyaka 100.  Umuhango wo kwaka Umutima w’Ingoma 
 Mutara na Cyilima bari Abami b’Inka kandi bagombaga kugira umuhango ukomeye wo mu Bwiru bakoraga ujyanye n’icyerekezo cy’u Rwanda mu ngoma eshatu zigiye gukurikiraho. Niwo  mu Bwiru bita “Inzira y’Ishora”. Hari umuhango baheragaho wo kuvugurura Ingoma z’ibwami nka Kalinga, Cyimumugizi, Kiragutse na Mpatsibihugu.  Barebaga niba mu myaka hafi ijana ishize nta kibazo izo ngoma zagize kugira ngo bibaye ngombwa babe basisazura cyangwa se ngo bazisimbuze izindi. Iyo basangaga izo ngoma zikiri nzima cyangwa bagasanga zigomba gusimbuzwa; byanze bikunze bagombaga kuziha icyo bitaga “kuziha imitima mishya”. Iyo mihango yo kubonera Ingoma z’ingabe  imitima, imwe bayikoreraga ahitwa i Karama ku murwa wa Kigali hariya ku musozi  wa Mont Kigali aho bavuga ko mu mirwa yose y’Abami  umurwa wa Kigali  ari wo wari Imfura y’imirwa yose y’Abami. Aho i Karama bahajyaga baje kuhatora imitima y’Ingoma z’ingabe arizo Cyiragutse, Cyimumugizi, Mpatsibihugu na Kalinga. Mu gihe ingoma Kalinga yari Ingabe y’ubwami bw’u Rwanda, ziriya zindi uko ari eshatu zo bigaragara ko zari ingabe za buri mwami muri bariya Bami batatu bari hagati ya Mutara na Cyilima.  Bishoboka ko Cyiragutse ari ingabe ya Mibambwe maze Mpatsibihugu ikaba iya Kigeli bitewe n’uko bose bari bashinzwe kwagura u Rwanda nk’uko amazina y’izo ngoma abigaragaza. Cyimumugizi ikaba ingabe ya Yuhi kuko ariwe wari ushinzwe imihango y’ubwami bw’u Rwanda nk’uko na none izina ryayo ribigaragaza. Ibi rero ubona bimeze nka bya bindi by’Umwami Salomo wo muri Bibiliya igihe yajyaga gutambira ku musozi wa Gabaon nk’uko tubisoma mu 2 Abami 3:1-14. Ubwo Salomo yariho atamba Imana yaramubonekeye imubwira kuyisaba icyo ashaka maze Salomo ayisaba ubwenge kugira ngo agire ubushishozi bwo kuyobora ishyanga rya Israel. Uriya muhango wa Salomo wo gusaba Imana ubwenge (Umutima) bari ku musozi muremure nk’uwa Kigali urasa cyane n’ibyo Abiru b’i Rwanda bakoraga bafatanije n’Umwami nk’uko tugiye kubibona. Iyo rero Abiru n’abandi banyamihango bageraga ku murwa wa Kigali babaga bazanye:  Umutsobe w’isugi, Umukobwa w’isugi n’Umwenenyabirungu w’isugi, bakazana amata, inzoga n’imbuto bagatereka aho. Hanyuma rero bendaga ya mata na za nzoga bagakozamo icyuhagiro icyarimwe bakuhagira igiti cy’umurama (ngo gitere uburame) babaga bazanye maze Umutsobe mukuru agapfukama agasenga avuga aya magambo:   Gahorane Imana Kigali.
           Tuje kwenda imitima y’ingoma
           Ngo Umwami mu Rwanda agire umutima
           Ingoma mu Rwanda zigire umutima
          Abagabo mu Rwanda bagire umutima
          Abagore  mu Rwanda bagire umutima
          Inka mu Rwanda zigire umutima
         U Rwanda rwose rugire umutima. Aha murabona ko niba Ingoma y’Ingabe y’u Rwanda ari yo Kalinga iyo ibonye Umutima ugereranya Ubwenge n’Ubushishozi, Umwami wayimye nawe aba abonye umutima. Na none Ingoma z’Abami ari zo Cyimumugizi, Kiragutse na Mpatsibihugu iyo zibonye umutima, ni ubutegetsi bw’imyaka ijana bw’Abami Kigeli, Mibambwe na Yuhi burangwa n’umutima. Uwo mutima rero ni wo ugera mu baturage no mu nka. Ibyo birangira ari u Rwanda rwose rubonye umutima kugira ngo rubone kuba umurame. Ibyo bimeze nk’uko Umwami Salomo yasabye ubwenge Imana ikamushima ikamubwira ko izamuha n’ibyo atasabye nko kurama, ubukire, amahoro no kunesha abanzi bitewe n’uko yahisemo neza. Ibyo Imana yamusezeranyije byose bimeze nk’ibyo Abanyarwanda bizeraga kubona bamaze kubona Umutima w’Ingoma. Dore uko uduce tw’ubwiru dukurikira tubivuga:  Uri umurame umwami abe umurame
       Ingoma mu Rwanda zibe umurame 
       Abagabo b’i Rwanda babe umurame
       Abagore b’iRwanda babe umurame
      Inka mu Rwanda zibe umurame
       U Rwanda rwose  rube umurame Nyuma rero yo kubona umutima no kubona uburame; ibyo ntabwo byari  bihagije  kuko  u Rwanda rwose rwagombaga  kuzira ubusembwa, kuvogerwa  no guhumana  ari byo bishushanywa na ba bantu b’amasugi bazanye. Ubusanzwe umuntu w’isugi ni umuntu ugifite ababyeyi bombi cyangwa umukobwa utarasambanyijwe. Muri ya masengesho y’Umutsobe mukuru yakomezaga agira ati:  Aya ni amasugi umwami abe isugi
      Ingoma i Rwanda zibe amasugi
     Abagabo i Rwanda babe amasugi
     Abagore mu Rwanda babe amasugi
     Inka i Rwanda zibe amasugi
    U Rwanda rwose ruhorane amasugi
 Usibye imihango yo mu bwiru yo gusabira u Rwanda rwose umutima, uburame n’ubusugire, mu magambo amwe n’ayo tubonye hejuru, na none icyerekezo cyari ukugira ubuhoro (amahoro) mu Rwanda rw’Umwami.   Umwami w’i Rwanda agira ubuhoro
  Ingoma z’i Rwanda zigira ubuhoro,
  Abagabo b’i Rwanda bagira ubuhoro
  Abagore b’i Rwanda bagira ubuhoro
  Inka z’i Rwanda zigira ubuhoro
  U Rwanda rwose rugira ubuhoro Nyuma y’ibyo byose u Rwanda rukagira uburumbuke bw’amata, ubuki n’inturire.  Ibyo nabyo babivugaga mu mugambo ahwanye n’ayo hejuru bati  Ng’aya amata n’ubuki
Kugira ngo Umwami agire amata n’ubuki
Ingoma mu Rwanda zigire amata nubuki 
Abagabo bagire amata n’ubuki 
Abagore bagire amata n’ubuki 
Inka mu Rwanda zigire amata n’ubuki. Nyuma y’ibi, hazaga amasengesho yo gucyamura (gukebura) amahanga yose adatura umwami w’u Rwanda. Dore amagambo bavugaga muri ubwo Bwiru:   Twacyamura u Burundi ku ngoma
    Twacyamura u Bushubi ku ngoma
   Twacyamura u Bunyabungo ku ngoma
   Amahanga yose adatura umwami w’u Rwanda
   Twayacyamura Ibi twabigereranya na diporomasi y’ubu iba igamije  gutuma amahanga yandi ayoboka iby’igihugu cyawe. Amahame remezo y’u Rwanda gakondo
 Iyi  mihango yakorwaga n’Abami bitwa Mutara na Cyilima hari ibintu idusobanurira neza bigatuma tumenya  Ihame-ngengabitekerezo ryubatse u Rwanda rikaruha Indangagaciro. Ihame-ngengabitekerezo ni ryo soko y’ibikorwa n’imyitwarire by’umuntu cyangwa by’ikigo biturukamo. Ni yo mpamvu nta muntu, nta kigo, nta shyaka nta n’ishyanga byabaho bidafite Ihame-ngenga-bitekerezo ababigize bagenderaho.  Ku gihugu Ihame-ngengabitekerezo ni ryo rigena kandi rikagenga Indangagaciro na Kirazira by’igihugu! None abakurambere baturaze u Rwanda barwubatse babikuye ku rihe hame-ngengabitekerezo ukurikije ibyo tumaze kubona? Ihame-ngengabitekerezo rya mbere ryagenaga kandi rikagenga ibyo mu Rwanda byose; ni iritumenyesha icyo u “Rwanda rwose” ari cyo: “u Rwanda rwose” ntabwo ari ubutaka bwose bw’aho twita mu Rwanda gusa; ahubwo ni ahantu hari: Ingoma-Umwami -Abagabo -Abagore-Inka. Ibi rero ni nabyo byerekana ibyo twabonye by’Ibanga ry’Umwami n’Ingoma, n’Ibanga ry’Inka n’Ingabo. Aha icya mbere kigomba kumvikana mu Ihame ngenga-bitekerezo ry’abahanze u Rwanda,  ni uko ahantu hose ku isi hari kuba haboneka Umwami wimye Ingoma-ngabe yahawe umutima, hakaboneka Abagabo n’Abagore ndetse n’Inka, habashaga  kuboneka  u “Rwanda rwose.”Kimwe n’uko ibyo byose uwari kubivana ku butaka bw’u Rwanda haba hatakaje kuba “u Rwanda rwose.” Impamvu ni ko ikihagira u Rwanda rwose ari izi ndangagaciro z’Abanyarwanda zihari tuzi ko izo ndangagaciro zari zubakiye ku Mana, Inka n’Ingoma. Nk’uko Umwami   yabaga ahatswe n’Ingoma maze Ingabo (Abaturage) nazo zikaba zihatswe n’Umwami; ni nako u Rwanda rwose rwabaga ruhatswe n’Imana bitewe n’uko Ingoma yimye u Rwanda ari Imana yayihaye umutima. Nk’uko Inka ihaka isabwa kubyara icyo ihatse; ni nako Imana ihatse u Rwanda na yo isabwa guhora irubyara (irugoboka). Burya mu Kinyarwanda ijambo“gusenga” risobanuye gukesha byose uguhatse! Ni yo mpamvu usanga n’isengesho gakondo ryo gusabira u Rwanda na ryo ari ibyo ryabaga ryerekejeho. Nimwongere murebe amagambo arigize: Seka seka gasani k’i Rwanda 
Rusekere rugubwe neza
Rusenderezemo amahoro n’amahe
Rutsindire ubukenya n’ubugingo buke
Rutsindire ubusame n’ubusharire
Rutsindire icyago n’icyagane
Rutsindire nyamunsi n’intumwa yayo 
Rutsindire umwanzi wo mu kirambi
N’umurozi uvuka ishyanga
Garika ibiganza utugabire 
Rugaba, Rugabo, Rwagisha
Maze twishyuke mu Rwanda umu.  Ihame-ngengabitekerezo ry’abahanze u Rwanda ni ukugira Ishyanga aho Umwami yima Ingoma-ngabe yahawe umutima (ubushishozi) n’Imana, maze ingoma (reigns) zikagira umutima (ubushishozi) bigatuma Ingabo z’Umwami (Abagabo n’Abagore) nabo bagira umutima  uzagera no ku nka na zo zikagira umutima (wo gukamwa no konsa izazo). Murabona neza ko uru ari uruhererekane rw’Umutima uva ku MANA ukagera mu Mwami unyuze mu NGOMA-NGABE maze ukarangiriza mu NKA unyuze mu ngabo (Abagabo n’Abagore). Uru ruhererekane kandi ni rwo rwahoze rukoze “umutima w’u Rwanda rwose”. Byongeye kandi u Rwanda rwose iyo rwabaga rubonye umutima; ni byo na none byateraga igihugu kugira uburame, ubusugire, ubuhoro n’uburumbuke ndetse no kugarura amahanga adatura u Rwanda. Ibi rero abakurambere bacu bakoraga kera ngo bahorane Umutima w’u Rwanda (w’Ubunyarwanda) n’ubu mpamya ko bikenewe. Kubura uwo umutima w’u Rwanda, w’ubunyarwanda ni byo byatumye abanyarwanda bishora mu mahano ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ngo na Ruganzu Ndoli amaze kubohora u Rwanda amacakubiri yatumye rugirwa ingaruzwamuheto imyaka irenga icumi, yatangiye yigisha umutima w’u Rwanda. Arwanya ba mutima-nda, mutima-rwana, mutima-muke, agakunda cyane mitimi-igwanye (ihuje). Ese ubu abo ba mutima-nda sibo batumye u Rwanda rutabohoka burundu?  Imana tugira ni uko “imiyaga isubiza inyuma indege itwaye abanyarwanda itayibuza kugera iyo ijya” nk’uko Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika aherutse kubyibutsa Abanyarwanda bo mu Rwanda rutugendamo! Naho ibidindiza Ndi Umunyarwanda byo ubanza dukwiye kubirebera mu mizi yabyo mikuru twitabaje amahame-remezo yagengaga ishyaka ry’u Rwanda n’Abanyarwanda. Ibitekerezo bya Gérard Nyirimanzi na Nyirishema Célestin, Abacukumbuzi b’Ireme ry’Umuco n’Amateka by’u Rwanda. Babikuye mu Ubwiru, Inzira y’Ishora, vers 279-310.

title: Village Urugwiro, inyubako y’amateka akomeye mu Rwanda
content: Ni inyubako y’amateka kuko abagera kuri 50 % by’Abanyarwanda bariho bavutse iriho, iganje ku Kacyiru, mu Karere ka Gasabo mu Mujyi wa Kigali aho imaze imyaka 44. Yubatswe mu 1975 n’Umuryango wahuzaga Ibihugu bya Afurika cyane cyane ibyakolonijwe n’u Bufaransa n’ibikoresha Igifaransa, Organization Commune Africaine et Malgache (OCAM). Uwo muryango kuri ubu wazimye, u Rwanda rwawinjiyemo mu 1965. Mu 1975, nibwo rwari kwakira inama yawo yagombaga kwitabirwa n’abakuru b’ibihugu bagera kuri 15. Byari ihurizo rikomeye ku gihugu nk’u Rwanda cyari gifite hoteli nke zitwa ko zikomeye  nka Mille Collines na Diplomate zari zigezweho icyo gihe ariko zifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira abashyitsi baringaniye. Muri icyo gihe u Rwanda rwiteguraga kwakira inama, inyubako za mbere za Village Urugwiro zubatswe ku mafaranga ya OCAM nkuko Rucagu Boniface, umwe mu bagize Urwego Ngishwanama rw’Inararibonye yabibwiye IGIHE. Inama ya OCAM irangiye, inyubako za Village Urugwiro  zeguriwe Leta y’u Rwanda nayo izihinduramo hoteli yakiraga abifite muri ibyo bihe. Nubwo Village Urugwiro yabaye hoteli, mu gihe u Rwanda rwabaga rwakiriye inama zikomeye yakomezaga kwifashishwa mu kwakira abashyitsi ba Leta. Urugero ni tariki 21 na 22 Gicurasi 1979 ubwo u Rwanda rwakiraga inama ya Gatandatu ihuza u Bufaransa na Afurika yanitabiriwe na Perezida wari uyoboye u Bufaransa icyo gihe, Valéry Marie René Georges Giscard d’Estaing. Mbere y’uko iyo nama iba, u Bufaransa bwari bwatanze amafaranga yo kwagura Village Urugwiro no kuyivugurura kugira ngo ijye ku rwego rwo kwakira inama ikomeye nk’iyo, nkuko biri mu nyandiko z’ibanga za Ambasade ya Amerika mu Rwanda muri icyo gihe, zashyizwe hanze na WikiLeaks. Uwo mwaka ni nabwo hubatswe hoteli Novotel Umubano (Marasa Umubano Hotel kuri ubu) nabwo ku mafaranga yatanzwe n’u Bufaransa. Rucagu avuga ko nyuma yo kwagura Village Urugwiro, yasigaye igizwe n’inyubako (appartments)  zisaga 20 zirimo amacumbi agezweho, ibyumba by’inama n’ibindi. Amacumbi y’abadepite, ibiro bidahoraho bya Perezida Juvénal Habyarimana amaze gufata ubutegetsi mu 1973, yahise asesa Inteko Ishinga Amategeko. Yongeye kuyisubizaho mu 1981, abadepite ba mbere 70 b’inzibacyuho batangira imirimo mu 1982. Kubera ubuke bw’amacumbi muri Kigali, Leta yemereye buri mudepite icumbi muri Village Urugwiro dore ko abenshi babaga baturuka mu bice bya kure badashobora gukora bataha iwabo. Mu 1983 habaye amatora y’abadepite, Rucagu Boniface aba umwe muri bo ubwo yatangiraga imirimo mu 1984 na we ahabwa icumbi muri Village Urugwiro. Umudepite yahabwaga icumbi gusa, ibyo kurya akimenya. Rucagu avuga ko mu badepite 70, abasaga 40 babaga muri Village Urugwiro kuko babaga baturuka mu bice bya kure. Uwabaga yifitiye inzu i Kigali, yayibagamo Leta ikamugenera amafaranga y’icumbi. Rucagu ati “Uwabaga yifitiye inzu ye bamuhaga amafaranga ariko babanje kubyanga bavuga bati kuki mushaka kurara mu nzu zanyu kandi twarabageneye iza Leta, baraburana ariko byaje gukemuka nyuma.” Icyo gihe abadepite babamo, inzu zasagukaga zakomezaga kuba ibyumba bya hoteli bisanzwe, abashaka kubiraramo bakaza kwishyura. Nubwo hari hoteli n’amacumbi y’abadepite, Perezida Habyarimana na we yahashyize ibiro ariko akajya abizamo rimwe na rimwe kuko ibiro nyamukuru byari mu mujyi rwagati, ahubatse Ibiro by’Umujyi wa Kigali ubu. Rucagu ati “Iruhande rw’izo nzu haruguru y’ahahoze reception niho hari Ibiro by’Umukuru w’Igihugu. Muri izo nzu zose ahagana ku rwinjiriro yari yarafashemo inzu y’ibiro bye, izindi zose zikomeza kuba hoteli. Yari ibiro bya kabiri yazagamo nka rimwe cyangwa kabiri mu kwezi.” Buri nyubako (apartment) muri izo zari zigize Hotel Village Urugwiro yabaga ifite icyiciro runaka ibarizwamo. Rucagu wahabaye mu gihe cy’imyaka 10 ari umudepite, avuga ko buri nyubako yabaga ifite ibyumba bitatu, ni ukuvuga A, B na C. Icyumba A, cyabaga gifite ibyangombwa nkenerwa byose birimo uruganiriro, uburiri, ubwiherero, igikoni,  harimo  frigo n’ibindi, kikaba kigenewe Umukuru w’Igihugu mu gihe habaye inama cyangwa undi muntu wo ku rwego rwo hejuru wakirayemo. Hafi y’icyo cyumba nyamukuru, habaga ikindi bise B, kikararamo umuganga w’umuntu mukuru waraye muri A. Ni ukuvuga ko niba haraye Perezida, muri B hararaga umuganga we naho muri C hakarara abarinzi be. Mu  gihe habaga habaye inama zikomeye, abadepite bari barahawe amacumbi muri Village Urugwiro basabwaga kuvamo bakazagaruka inama yarangiye. Rucagu ati “Batumenyeshaga mbere y’ukwezi, tukavamo bakahakoropa, bakahasukura bakavanamo umwanda wose, tukazagaruka baragiye. Ubwo mu mirimo y’Inteko twariyeranjaga.” Village Urugwiro yakomeje kuba hoteli kugeza mu 1994 muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.  Jenoside imaze guhagarikwa, muri Nyakanga uwo mwaka Leta y’Ubumwe imaze kurahira Village Urugwiro aho kuba ibiro bidahoraho by’Umukuru w’Igihugu, yahindutse Ibiro byuzuye by’iminsi yose by’Umukuru w’Igihugu kugeza ubu.

title: Ubwiza bwa One&Only Gorilla’s Nest, hoteli y’i Musanze yishyurwa 3600 $ ku ijoro (Amafoto)
content: Ifite ibyumba 21 biri mu byiciro bine, icyiciro cya mbere gifite ibyumba 10, igikurikiraho gifite ibyumba bine, ikindi bitanu naho icya nyuma kikagira ibyumba bibiri. Uko bikurikirana, ni nako bitandukanye mu biciro, mu bunini no mu bwiza. Zitatse mu buryo bwa Kinyarwanda hakoreshejwe imigongo, hakabamo n’ibindi bikoresho by’ubugeni. Ibyumba icumi biri mu cyiciro cya mbere, byishyurwa 3600 by’amadolari ku ijoro rimwe naho icyumba cya menshi ni ibihumbi 10500 by’amadolari gishobora kwakira nk’abakuru b’ibihugu. Mu mafaranga umuntu yishyura, haba harimo ibyo kurya n’ibyo kunywa. Ibintu byose byubatse ibyumba by’iyi hoteli bikozwe mu mbaho nubwo bifashwe n’ibyumba. Iyi hoteli yubatse ku buso bungana na hegitari 35, aho yubatse hahoze hari hoteli yitwa Gorilla’s Nest. Imirimo yo kuyubaka yamaze imyaka igera kuri ibiri, yuzura itwaye miliyoni 65 z’amadolari ya Amerika. Imaze gutanga akazi ku bantu 120 bahoraho barimo abanyarwanda 100. Mu Ukwakira 2019 nibwo iyi hoteli yatangiye gukora ariko ntabwo yari yagafunguwe ku mugaragaro. Kuva mu kwa gatanu kugera mu kwa cyenda, nibwo iba ifite abashyitsi benshi. Imboga zose zitekerwa abashyitsi muri iyi hoteli, zihinze mu bice byayo. Amoko y’ibyatsi ibihumbi 36 niyo yatewe mu ishyamba ririmo iyi hoteli. One and Only Gorilla’s Nest yiyongereye ku zindi nyubako ebyiri zikomeye zakira ba mukerarugendo bo ku rwego rwo hejuru mu bice by’ibirunga, zirimo Bisate lodge kuri uyu wa Gatanu yahawe inyenyeri eshanu na Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House, yatangije ibikorwa mu Rwanda ku wa 1 Kanama 2019. Ije nyuma ya hoteli igezweho imaze igihe muri Pariki y’Igihugu ya Nyungwe, International One & Only Resorts, iyi ikaba ari ishami ryayo. Amafoto agaragaza uko mu byumba hameze Amafoto: Himbaza Pacifique

title: Nyamasheke: Bubakiwe ibyumba 11 by’amashuri nk’inyungu ku mafaranga ava mu bukerarugendo
content: Ibi babigarutseho ubwo batahaga ku mugaragaro ibyumba by’amashuri 11 byubatswe n’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere RDB. Ibyumba bitatu byubatswe ku ishuri ribanza rya Mutagatifu Paul rya Rugabe mu Murenge wa Karambi n’ ibyumba umunani byubatswe ku ishuri ribanza rya Nyarusiza riherereye mu Murenge wa Mahembe mu karere ka Nyamasheke. Aya mashuri yose ari munsi ya Pariki ya Nyungwe. Ababyeyi barerera muri ibi bigo by’amashuri bavuga ko ibikorwa bakorerwa bibagaragariza ko pariki ari iyabo bigatuma barushaho kuyirinda abashaka kuyangiza. Mukeshimana Zacharie ati “Byatunejeje cyane, twahise tubona akamaro ka Nyungwe twumva tugomba kuyibungabunga kuko abana bacu bigiraraga mu mashuri mabi.” Nyirambarushimana Cecile  ati“Badukoreye ibintu byiza kuko batumye abana bacu bigira ahantu heza, urumva ko tugomba kurinda pariki yacu kugira ngo amafaranga avamo akomeze yiyongere, bizatuma dukomeza kubona ibikorwa byinshi.” Bamwe mu banyeshuri biga muri ibi bigo by’amashuri bavuga ko bigiraga mu byumba bishaje ndetse bakicara ari benshi ku ntebe ariko kuri ubu bakaba biga neza, akaba ariyo mpamvu biyemeje gukomeza kurwanya ba rushimusi. Mugabo Aime wiga mu mwaka wa Gatandatu w’amashuri abanza yagize  ati “Turishimye cyane twabaga turi abana benshi bigatuma tudatsinda kubera hari aho twicaraga turi batanu, ubu twicara turi batatu kubera amashuri mashyashya. Tumaze kandi gusobanukirwa no kubungabunga ibinyabuzima biba muri parike ya Nyungwe kuburyo tubonye ushaka kubyangiza twamushyikiriza abayobozi.” Ngoga Thelesphore, ushinzwe imicungire ya pariki z’igihugu mu kigo cy’igihugu Iterambere RDB avuga ko bashora mu mishinga y’uburezi mu rwego rwo kugira ngo abaturiye za pariki barusheho gusobanurirwa kuyibungabunga ariko kandi ngo hari n’indi mishinga itandukanye batera inkunga. Ati “Ntabwo ari imishinga y’Uburezi gusa ariko n’ibindi bikorwa bishobora kuzamura abaturage kugira ngo banabone ko parike baturiye bagomba kugira uruhare mu kuyibungabunga. Abaturage nibiga bakamenya  nibwo tuzabasha kubasobanurira akamaro ka parike bakakumva. Umwana aziga narangiza ajye gushaka akazi aho kujya gushimuta muri pariki. ” Ibi byumba by’amashuri 11 byatwaye miliyoni zisaga 64, ni mu gihe amafaranga yagenewe gukora imishinga mu mirenge 7 ikora kuri Nyungwe muri Nyamasheke ari miliyoni 423.

title: Akarere ka Bugesera karifuza kubyaza umusaruro ibiyaga gafite mu bukerarugendo
content: Ubusanzwe akarere ka Bugesera gafite ibiyaga icyenda birimo bibiri binini nka Rweru na Cyohoha. Nubwo ari kamwe mu turere dufite ibiyaga byinshi, nta musaruro ugaragra bitanga haba mu bijyanye n’ubukerarugendo cyangwa kuba byakwifashishwa mu buhinzi buteye imbere bwifashisha kuhira muri ako karere kakunze kurangwamo amapfa cyane. Meya w’akarere ka Bugesera, Mutabazi Richard aherutse kubwira IGIHE  ko bifuza kubyaza umusaruro ibyo biyaga, bagahamagarira abashoramari kuhubaka amahoteli n’ibindi bigezweho bikurura ba mukerarugendo. Yagize ati “Turi gukangurira abashoramari gukora muri icyo cyiciro. Dufite ibiyaga icyenda ariko nta na kimwe kiriho inkombe zigezweho ikindi ugendeye ku miterere yacu ntabwo ari bya biyaga bifite umucanga, ni bigufi ariko uko byaba bimeze kose hakenewe abashoramo imari mu bijyanye n’imyidagaduro.” Mu Bugesera ni hamwe mu bice by’igihugu biri gutera imbere cyane, by’umwihariko umujyi wa Nyamata uri hafi y’ahari kubakwa ikibuga cy’indege gishya kizaba ari icya mbere kinini mu Rwanda. Ni agace kari kuzamurwamo inzu nyinshi kandi zigezweho zo guturamo. Meya Mutabazi avuga ko ikibura ari uburyo bw’imyidagaduro ku buryo abantu benshi bifuza kuza gutura muri ako karere, bakajya gukora ahandi ariho baturutse. Ati “Akarere kacu gakwiriye kuba akarere gasurwa, abantu bakaza kuharuhukira bakava mu murwa mukuru bakaza hano, bakabona ibikorwa byinshi by’imyidagadauro bakaruhuka , abashaka kuhatura bakaza bakajya gukora baturutse hano.” Mu guhamagaririra abashoramari kuza muri ako karere, Meya Mutabazi avuga ko bakeneye abantu bahubaka ibikorwa by’imyidagaduro nk’utubyiniro n’ibindi bituma urubyiruko ruhuga, aho gushidukira kujya mu mujyi wa Kigali. Ati “Inaha usanga nta kabyiniro gahari, ugasanga urubyiruko ruri inaha rushaka gusohokera i Kigali. Kwambuka amazi ugiye kubyina twumva bidasobanutse mu karere kacu, twagombye kuba dufite ibyo bikorwa byose. Turakorana n’abashoramari batandukanye, turebe ko harimo ababyumva vuba.” Aka karere gaherutse kuzurizwa stade nshya igezweho, nka kimwe mu bikorwa remezo by’imyidagaduro. Mutabazi avuga ko ibiyaga bihari biramutse bibyajwe umusaruro, bigashyirwaho ibikurura ba mukerarugendo byakwinjiriza akarere, n’abagatuye bakabona  imirimo. Ibiyaga icyenda biboneka mu karere ka Bugesera bifite ubuso bwa hegitari 10,635 byose hamwe.

title: Maria Sharapova n’umukunzi we bahishuye ibihe bidasanzwe bagize ubwo basuraga u Rwanda na Botswana
content: Mu nyandiko yasohotse mu kinyamakuru Vogue cyo mu Bwongereza, Sharapova na Alexander bagaruka ku bihe bidasanzwe bagiriye mu Rwanda na Botswana umwaka ushize, aho babonye inyamaswa zinyuranye bagahura n’abantu batandukanye. Maria atangirira kuri Botswana, aho bageze n’indege bakahagirira igice cya mbere cy’urugendo rwabo rw’iminsi ine bamaze basura ibyiza nyaburanga binyuranye. Muri Botswana baraye muri Wilderness Vumbura Plains amajoro abiri. Ku munsi wa mbere basuye inyamaswa zitandukanye zirimo intare mbere yo kwerekeza mu Rwanda kureba ingagi zitaba ahandi ku Isi. Alexander avuga ko muri icyo gihugu babonye inyamaswa zitandukanye zirimo intare, imvubu, ingona, imparage, udusumbashyamba n’izindi. Maria yongeraho ko banabonye ingwe n’imwe mu nyamaswa ibarizwa mu muryango w’ibisimba bitanu bikaze cyangwa ‘Big Five. Yakomeje ati “Ingwe zo zari zitangaje cyane; twaricaye twitegereza zirimo gushaka amafunguro y’umugoroba, zikikinga ku mashami y’ibiti ziteze Impala zicaracara. Mu ijoro ryakeye, nakangutse mbona Inzovu irimo kunywa amazi muri piscine yacu.”  “Nabanje gukeka ko mbonye Intare irimo kugenda inyuma y’inzu yacu, ariko Alexander arambwira ngo nimpumure ni ingwe – nk’aho ari byo biroroshya ikibazo!” Nyuma yo gusura ibyo byiza nyaburanga, Alexander yavuze uburyo berekeje muri Bisate Lodge mu Ruhengeli, hoteli igizwe n’inzu esheshatu ziteye mu buryo bwihariye, aho uba witegeye Ikirunga cya Bisoke n’indi misozi itatse u Rwanda. Ati “Ni mu gihe cy’imvura, turagerageza kota ku muriro ku mugoroba, ari nako tureba uko ibihe bigenda bihinduka buri minota 30. Batubwiye ko inkende ndetse rimwe na rimwe ingagi zishobora kuza hafi y’inzu.” Maria Sharapova ahita avuga uburyo babonye inkende mbere y’ingagi, ariko aho baziboneye, bifuje kuba baramaranye nazo igihe cyose bamaze basura ibyiza by’aka karere. Yakomeje “Uburyo uhura n’ibi bisamuntu wiyoroheje ntabwo nzabyibagirwa. Ni umunsi wacu wa nyuma, ariko ntabwo nshaka kuhava.” Alexander avuga uburyo mu ijoro ryabo rya nyuma mbere yo gusura Johannesburg muri Afurika y’Epfo, batewe ishema no guhura na Perezida Paul Kagame. Ati “Birashimishije iyo urebye ibyo yabashije kugeraho mu myaka 25 nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, akunga abantu kandi ni abaturage beza cyane. Uyu munsi buri kwezi u Rwanda rugira umunsi wo gukora isuku rusange, Guverinoma igizwe n’abagabo n’abagore 50/50, ubukungu bukomeje gutera imbere. Sitwe tuzabona tugarutse.” Maria Sharapova yabaye nimero ya mbere ku Isi guhera mu 2005, ariko kuri ubu ari kubarizwa ku mwanya wa 369 nyuma yo kwitabira amarushanwa 12 gusa mu mwaka ushize.

title: Rusizi: Ni iki cyadindije umushinga wa hoteli imeze nk’ubwato yagombaga kubakwa ku kirwa?
content: Gihaya Island Resort  yagombaga kuba ifite ishusho nk’iy’ubwato bwa Titanic ndetse igizwe n’amagorofa atatu, ikubakwa mu Kagari ka Gihaya mu murenge wa Gihundwe, ku buso buri hagati ya hegitari 20 na 40. Ugeze kuri iki kirwa usanga abahatuye bari mu mirimo yabo nk’ibisanzwe ndetse nta n’igikorwa kigaragaza iyubakwa ry’iyi hoteli. Nyabyenda Faustin, umwe mu bahatuye ati “Urebye imirimo y’abaturage irakomeje ariko hoteli yo ntituzi ibyayo kuko tubona nta cyahindutse uretse ko hari abaturage bacye baguriye.” Muneza Nira, nyiri uyu mushinga avuga ko bahuye n’imbogamizi nyinshi zituma badatangira ibikorwa ariko ko ubu ziri kugenda zicyemuka kuburyo imirimo yo kubaka izatangira muri Nyakanga cyangwa Kanama uyu mwaka. Ati “Twagize ikibazo cy’ibyangombwa, ibyangombwa byaho byangombaga guhuzwa bikaba icyangombwa kimwe kuko hari ubutaka bw’abaturage benshi, hagiye haza n’ibindi bibazo byinshi byo kugurira abantu aho hari abaturage wasangaga ubutaka butabanditseho.” Yakomeje agira ati “ Twahuye n’ikindi kibazo kuko hatari  haragenewe amahotei cyangwa ubuhinzi, ubu turi mu ndunduro twabonye inyandiko ko aho hantu hashobora guhuzwa, hakaba ubutaka bumwe. Tuzatangira ibikorwa by’ibanze kuburyo bitakagombye kurenza muri 2022.” Muneza yavuze  mu gice cya mbere himuwe imiryango igera muri 50 ariko ko hoteli ifite ibice bitatu kuburyo bizarangira abaturage bose bimuwe hakubakwa ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo. Gihaya Island Resort  biteganyijwe ko izuzura itwaye akayabo ka miliyoni 56 z’amadolari ya Amerika.

title: RDB yahuguye abayobora ba mukerarugendo ku mateka y’urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu
content: Liberation History Tourism Trail ni gahunda nshya yinjijwe mu rwego rw’ubukerarugendo, igamije gusobanurira ba mukerarugendo b’abanyarwanda n’abanyamahanga, amateka y’urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu n’impamvu rwabayeho. Igizwe n’urugendo runyura ahantu (sites) 29 mu turere dutandatu tw’u Rwanda, hafite icyo hasobanuye gikomeye ku rugamba rwo kubohora igihugu rwatangiye ku itariki 1 Ukwakira 1990 rukarangira ku itariki 4 Nyakanga 1994. Kuri uyu wa mbere tariki 3 Gashyantare 2020, Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere na Minisiteri y’Ingabo, batangiye guhugura abayobora ba mukerarugendo n’abafatanyabikorwa b’urwego rw’ubukerarugendo hagamijwe kubongerera ubushobozi n’ubumenyi bwo gusobanurira abo bayobora iby’amateka y’aho hantu. Umuyobozi w’ishami ry’amabwiriza agenga ubukerarugendo muri RDB, Emmanuel Nsabimana yavuze ko muri ayo mahugurwa bazasobanurirwa byinshi ku hantu habumbatiye amateka y’urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu ndetse bakanahasura. Ati “Amateka y’urugamba rwo kubobohra igihugu mu bukerarugendo ni igice gikomeye mu mateka n’umurage mu guteza imbere ubukerarugendo. Twateguye amahugurwa ku bayobora ba mukerarugendo ngo tubongerere ubumenyi kuri urwo ruhererekane. Hari ibyo bigira hano ariko bazajye no kuhasura kugira ngo bazafashe ba mukerarugendo mu buryo bwuzuye.” Umugaba w’Ingabo zirwanira mu kirere, Maj Gen Emmanuel Bayingana; yavuze ko kumenya amateka y’urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu bizatuma abo basobanurira by’umwihariko abakiri bato bamenya impamvu rwabayeho. Ati “Twishimiye gukorana n’abayobora ba mukerarrugendo, tubongerera ubumenyi ku mateka y’urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu no kubafasha kwigisha abakiri bato kumenya impamvu y’urwo rugamba.” Ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku mateka y’urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu, bwatangijwe ku mugaragaro muri Kanama 2019. title: Mbatembereze i Strasbourg, Umujyi ubumbatiye amateka y’Abafaransa n’Abadage (Amafoto)
content: Ni umujyi uhana imbibi n’u Budage ndetse ubitse amateka menshi hagati y’ibi bihugu byombi, uherereye mu gace ka Alsace.  Ntabwo ari umujyi utuwe cyane kuko uri ku buso bwa kilometero kare 7826, ibarura ryo mu 2017 rigaragaza  ko wari utuwe n’abaturage 280966. Ufatwa nk’Umurwa Mukuru w’u Burayi kubera ko ariwo ubarizwamo ibikorwa by’inama y’ubujyanama bw’u Burayi, Urukiko rw’u Burayi rw’uburenganzira bwa muntu, Inteko Ishinga Amategeko y’u Burayi n’ibindi. Ni umujyi kandi ubarizwamo ibikorwa byinshi bibungabungwa na UNESCO nk’umutungo kamere w’Isi. Muri ibyo harimo nka Cathédrale Notre-Dame de Strasbourg n’agace gakundwa na ba mukerarugendo kazwi kitwa Petite France. Ni agace karimo imigezi myinshi ndetse mu myaka yo hambere kakundaga kubamo abarobyi cyane, magingo aya ni ko gace gasurwa cyane muri Strasbourg yose. Imiterere yako igaragaza imyubakire yo mu Bufaransa kera mu kinyejana cya 17 ari nayo mpamvu UNESCO yahisemo kugashyira mu duce tubungabunzwe kubera amateka yako. Naho Cathédrale Notre-Dame de Strasbourg igizwe n’inyubako zigaragaza amateka ya kera y’Abaromani, ndetse igaragazwa nk’urugero rwiza rwo kwerekana amateka yo hambere dore ko mu myaka ya 1647 na 1874 yabaye inzu ya mbere ndende ku Isi, ireshya na metero 142. Uyu munsi ni kiliziya iri mu nsengero esheshatu ndende mu mateka y’Isi ndetse yihariye agahigo ko kuba ariyo ya mbere ndende mu mateka y’Isi  yubatswe hagati y’ikinyejana cya Gatanu n’icya 15. Umusizi Victor Hugo n’umudage Goethe nawe wari umwanditsi, bakunze kuyigereranya n’igiti cy’Imana bashaka kuvuga uburebure bwayo. Bitewe n’uko iteye, ahantu hose hari umusozi muri uyu mujyi, iyo uwugiyeho bituma umuntu abasha kuyibona neza Ku bantu bakunda gutembera bihera amaso ibyiza bitatse Isi, ni umujyi mwiza cyane. Mu 2009 ubwo habaga inama ya NATO, Barack Obama na Chancelier w’u Budage, Angela Merkel, bakoze urugendo rw’amateka n’amaguru, bava Strasbourg bagera mu Kehl banyuze ku kiraro cya Passerelle des Deux Rives cyubatswe mu 2004 nk’ikimenyetso cy’ubumwe mu Burayi. Nta passport bisaba ku muntu ushaka gukora uru rugendo nk’urwabo, ugera mu Budage mu gace ka Rhine. Alsace agace ka Strasbourg kazwi ho kugira umuvinyo uryoheye ijigo ndetse n’inzoga nyinshi zituruka mu baturanyi b’Abadage. Mu masaha y’ijoro usanga hafi ya Notre-Dame hari abantu benshi bari ku gacupa bungurana ibitekerezo, Umujyi wa Strasbourg guhera mu 2008 uyoborwa na Roland Ries nyuma yo kuba Umwarimu muri Kaminuza ya Strasbourg n’Umusenateri muri aka Karere imyaka icyenda. Amafoto: Karirima A. Ngarambe

title: Twitege Visit Rwanda muri Formula 1 na NBA?
content: Muri ubu bufatanye, ikirango cya Visit Rwanda kigaragazwa kuri Stade ya Parc des Princes aho PSG yakirira imikino yayo ndetse no ku mugongo ku myenda iyi kipe ikoresha mu myitozo no mu gihe cyo kwishyushya mbere y’imikino, yaba iyo yambara yasuye indi kipe cyangwa iyo yambara iwayo muri Shampiyona y’u Bufaransa, Ligue 1 mu gihe kandi aya magambo agaragara ku myambaro y’ikipe y’abagore. Mu masezerano harimo kandi icyumweru cy’imishinga y’abanyempano b’abanyarwanda n’Abafaransa. Icyo cyumweru cyiswe “Semaine du Rwanda à Paris” kizajya gitegurwa na PSG mu kumenyekanisha ibintu byose bikorerwa mu Rwanda. Ubu bufatanye bwatangajwe nyuma y’umwaka umwe n’igice, RDB itangiye gukorana n’ikipe ya Arsenal yo mu Bwongereza, aho binyuze muri Visit Rwanda, iyi kipe yo mu Mujyi wa Londres yamamaza ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda. Kuva icyo gihe, hari abanyabigwi benshi bakomeye ba Arsenal baje mu Rwanda barimo Tony Adams wabaye kapiteni wayo igihe kirekire, Lauren Etame Mayer, Alex Scott wabaye kapiteni w’ikipe y’abagore na David Luiz kuri ubu ukinira iyi kipe, bose baje mu Rwanda. Muri ubu bufatanye kandi, abatoza babiri b’Ingimbi za Arsenal FC, Simon McManus usanzwe ari Umutoza Mukuru w’Amashuri yigisha umupira w’amaguru ya Arsenal na Kerry Green, bahugura ab’Abanyarwanda mu kubafasha kubatoza umupira ugezweho nk’uwo iyi kipe ikina. RDB ivuga ko kuva u Rwanda rutangiye gukorana na Arsenal binyuze muri Visit Rwanda mu 2018, ba mukerarungo baza mu Rwanda bamaze kugera kuri miliyoni imwe na 700 (byatangajwe mu Ukuboza 2019) ndetse yizeye ko bazakomeza kwiyongera mu myaka iri imbere. Ese birashoboka ko tuzabona Visit Rwanda mu marushanwa nka Tour de France, Formula 1 cyangwa NBA? Imwe mu mpamvu ituma habaho ubu bufatanye bw’u Rwanda n’amakipe akomeye i Burayi, ni ugutekereza kure kugira ngo u Rwanda ruzabe igihugu gikize mu myaka iri imbere ndetse n’Abanyarwanda bagire ubushobozi buhagije bwo gukora ibyishimirwa n’abanyamahanga. Tour de France niryo siganwa rya mbere ry’amagare rikomeye ku Isi, Formula 1 naryo ni isiganwa rya mbere rikomeye mu mukino wo gusiganwa mu modoka mu gihe NBA yo muri Amerika ari yo Shampiyona ya Basketball ikunzwe na benshi ku Isi. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami ry’Ubukerarugendo no kubungabunga za Pariki muri RDB, Ariella Kageruka, yavuze ko bishoboka ko u Rwanda rwagirana ubufatanye n’imwe mu makipe agaragara muri aya marushanwa kuko byose bisaba kwiha intego ndetse bikagira uko bikorwa. Ati “Sinavuga ko hari igihe runaka bizabera, ariko nta kintu kidashoboka kuko iyo urebye ikintu gisabwa ni ukureba niba ibikorwaremezo dufite bihuye n’ibyo. Nko kuri Formula 1, icya mbere ni imihanda kandi nkeka imbaraga Leta yashyize mu kubaka imihanda dushobora kuyibyaza umusaruro.” “Ku kwerekana Visit Rwanda muri NBA, BAL (Basketball Africa League yashyizweho na NBA) yo ubwo yaje aha, mwabonye ko ikipe yacu (Patriots BBC) yari ihagarariye u Rwanda yari yambaye Visit Rwanda. Ni ukuvuga ngo ni ukugenda intambwe ku ntambwe kandi byose birashoboka. Icya mbere ni ukugira ngo tubyaze umusaruro ubufatanye dufite uyu munsi kuko ni ukubanza kureba icyo dukuramo, tukaba twava mu mupira w’amaguru tukajya muri Basketball.” Kageruka avuga ko nubwo kuri ubu ubufatanye bw’u Rwanda mu bukerarugendo bushingiye ku mugabane w’u Burayi, bitabuza ko n’Abanyamerika barumenya kuko nka Arsenal ikunda gukorerayo imyiteguro ya Shampiyona ijyanye n’itangazamakuru ryayo rigari ndetse ubwo David Luiz yazaga mu Rwanda, byavuzwe cyane muri Brésil. Ni iki cyakorwa ngo Siporo y’u Rwanda itange umusaruro mu bukungu bw’igihugu?  Siporo ni umwe mu nkingi z’iterambere u Rwanda rushaka kubakiraho ndetse igihugu kiri gushora cyane mu mikino kuko bitanga icyerekezo cyiza cy’igihugu ndetse bigafasha n’Abanyarwanda gutera imbere. Mu kiganiro yatanze ubwo yari yatumiwe mu mahugurwa yahuje abagize ingaga za Siporo, yateguwe n’Umuryango FPR Inkotanyi, Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami ry’Ubukerarugendo no kubungabunga za Pariki muri RDB, Ariella Kageruka, yavuze ko muri Siporo hari amahirwe menshi arimo ashobora kwinjiriza igihugu nko gukora imyenda n’inkweto bya Siporo. Kageruka yakomeje avuga ko itangazamakuru rishobora kwifashishwa mu kumenyakanisha Siporo y’u Rwanda, abakinnyi n’abatoza b’Abanyarwanda bagahabawa amahugurwa abafasha kugira ubumenyi buri ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Ati “Hari uburyo bwinshi bwo kubyaza umusaruro muri siporo, nko gushyiraho inganda zikora ibikoresho bya Siporo mu gihugu. Mu bijyanye n’ubukerarungo bushingiye kuri siporo, ubufatanye twagiranye n’abatwamamaza bwarengeje ibyo twari twiteze. Twari twiteze ko binyuze muri uku kwamamaza tuzabona miliyoni 28£, ariko mu mwaka umwe twabonye miliyoni 36£.” Indi nzira yafasha u Rwanda kwinjiza binyuze muri Siporo hari ugutegura amarushanwa akomeye abera mu gihugu hakanategurwa ibikorwa byishimirwa n’Abanyamahanga baje muri iyi mikino, nko gusura ingagi n’izindi Pariki, gutembera mu Kivu no kuzamuka imisozi. RDB ivuga ko kuva u Rwanda rutangiye gukorana na Arsenal mu myaka ibiri ishize, hamaze gutozwa abana n’abatoza basaga 120 ndetse no mu bufatanye na Paris Saint-Germain hazakorwa gahunda nk’iyi. Inzu y’imikino ya Kigali Arena, ikibuga cya Cricket kiri i Gahanga, ikibuga cya Kigali Golf Club kiri kuvugurwa biri mu byitezweho kuzazamura ubukeragendo bunyuze muri siporo. Mu 2017 ubukerarugendo bwinjirije u Rwanda miliyoni 401 z’Amadolari, ariko intego ya Guverinoma ni ukuzamura ayo madolari akaba miliyoni 800 mu 2024. Amafoto: Umurerwa Delphin

title: RDB yitabiriye imurika rikomeye ry’ubukerarugendo muri Amerika
content: Iri murika ry’ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo riri mu ya mbere akomeye muri Amerika y’Amajyaruguru. Riri kubera mu Mujyi wa Manhattan ahazwi nka Jacob K.Javits. Ryatangaiye taraiki 24 Mutarama, rirasozwa kuri iki Cyumweru tariki 26 Mutarama 2020. Nyuma y’imurika, itsinda rihagarariye u Rwanda rizakomereza ibikorwa byo kumenyekanisha ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda hirya no hino mu bice bya Leta ya California nka San Diego, Orange County na Los Angeles mbere yo kugaruka mu Rwanda. Ibigo byigenga bikora iby’ubukerarugendo bihagarariye u Rwanda birimo Mantis Rwanda, Akagera Aviation, New Dawn Associates, Heritage Safaris, Far Trek Africa Safaris, Silverback Africa na  FCM Charleston. Mu byo  bari kwerekana harimo umuco w’u Rwanda, urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima ruboneka mu Rwanda, ubwiza bw’u Rwanda n’ibijyanye no kwakira abakerarugendo. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ubukerarugendo muri RDB, Belise Kariza, yavuze ko muri Amerika y’Amajyaruguru ari hamwe mu haturuka ba mukerarugendo benshi basura u Rwanda, ko ari iby’ingenzi gukomeza kuhamenyekanisha ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda. Ati “Kuba twitabiriye iri murika rizwi rya New York Times Travel Show, tukagaragara mu bandi bamurika basaga 700 baturutse hirya no hino ku isi biratuma abitabiriye bamenya ko  u Rwanda ari ahantu heza ho gusura ku isi. Twiteguye guha ikaze abakerarugendo bashaka gusura igihugu cyacu cyiza.” New York Times Travel Show ni imurika ry’ubukerarugendo riri mu akomeye ku Isi. Ryitabirwa n’abantu basaga 35 000, barimo abamurika basaga 700 bavuye mu bihugu bigera ku 175.

title: Abaholandi barimo Van Gaal bagaragaje urwibutso basigaranye mu rugendo bagiriye mu Rwanda
content: Louis Van Gaal yabigarutseho ku wa 20 Mutarama 2020 mu gikorwa cyiswe B2B cyahuje abaserukiye ibigo bitwara abakerarugendo mu Rwanda n’ibigo binini byo mu Buholandi bicuruza ubukerarugendo. Iki gikorwa cyateguwe na Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Buholandi cyabereye i LaHaye, u Rwanda rwari ruhagarariwe n’ibigo birimo Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB), Sosiyete Nyarwanda y’Ubwikorezi bwo mu Kirere, RwandAir, Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Buholandi n’ibigo by’ubukerarugendo birimo Amahoro Tours, Palast Tours and Travel na Wildlife Tours-Rwanda. Ibi bigo byari byitabiriye Imurikagurisha Mpuzamahanga ry’Ubukerarugendo rya Vakantiebeurs mu Mujyi wa Utrecht mu Buholandi. Byarimurikiyemo amahirwe y’ubukerarugendo ari mu gihugu binyuze muri gahunda ya ‘Visit Rwanda’. Abayobozi babyo ku mugoroba wo ku wa Mbere bahuye n’Abaholandi basuye u Rwanda hagamijwe kungurana ibitekerezo, kugaragaza uko bakiriwe no gutanga inama ku byanozwa kugira ngo bakomeze bishimire serivisi bahabwa nk’abakerarugendo. Muri Nzeri 2019, Van Gaal ni  umwe mu banyacyubahiro 25 bise amazina abana b’ingagi mu Rwanda, ni umuhango wabereye mu karere ka Musanze witabirwa kandi na Perezida Paul Kagame. Aloysius Paulus Maria van Gaal OON w’imyaka 68 yavuze ko ibyo yishimiye mu Rwanda harimo kuba yarise izina umwana w’ingagi, igikorwa yavuze ko ari iby’agaciro. Yagize ati “Ikindi nahabonye ni abantu badasanzwe kubera ko mu Rwanda mu myaka 25 ishize ibintu byari bimeze nabi, ariko iyo urebye uko bimeze bakemuye ibyo bibazo, ibi kandi ni ukubera umukuru w’igihugu, njye nk’umutoza ndabizi ko bitoroshye guhindura imyumvire mu buryo bworoshye,  bitwara igihe ariko we yarabikoze.” “Abantu baho baratandukanye, ni abantu ubona ko bitonze kandi bazi kwakira abashyitsi, mu Rwanda ni abantu bazi kureba kure kandi ikirere cyaho ni cyiza, twagiye mu modoka nini, byari bishimishije.” Yavuze ko amahoteli yo mu Rwanda ari meza, agaragaza ko abantu bashobora gukeka ko wenda yagiye muri hoteli y’inyenyeri eshanu ariko ko atari byo. Yavuze ko aho wajya hose uhasanga ibintu byiza, ibiryo ndetse hakaba hari n’isuku iri hejuru. Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Buholandi, Karabaranga Jean Pierre, yavuze ko hari byinshi ibihugu byombi bisangiye, harimo ko haba mu Rwanda no muri iki gihugu abantu usanga bafite inzozi zo kugera kure mu kubaho neza. Yagize ati “Iyo urebye mu myaka 25 ishize ukareba aho twavuye n’aho turi uyu munsi, ni ukubera ko Abanyarwanda twavuze tuti tugomba kugira imibereho myiza kandi turabiharanira.” Ku birebana no gusura u Rwanda, Amb. Karabaranga yagize ati “Dufite iterambere, dufite ahantu hafite ikirere cyiza, imisozi myiza  kandi nzi neza ko abenshi muri mwe usanga bagenda ahantu harambitse ariko twe byose turabyishimira.” Umuyobozi muri RDB Ushinzwe kumenyekanisha Ubukerarugendo, Mutesi Linda, yavuze ko u Rwanda ari igihugu gitekanye, benshi bishimira gusura. Ati “U Rwanda ni igihugu gishimishije, ni igihugu cyiza kandi kigira ibihe byiza, iki ni kimwe mu bihugu byiza mu kugira umutekano mu kubitemberamo. Dufite ahantu heza ho gusura harimo mu Burasirazuba bw’u Rwanda, mu Majyepfo,  mu Majyaruguru y’u Rwanda dufite ingagi z’Ibirunga zisangwa gusa mu bihugu bitatu ku Isi.” “Mu Burengerazuba bw’u Rwanda tuhafite Ikiyaga cya Kivu ukaba wahafatira amafoto meza, dufite kandi uburyo bwiza bwo kugera muri izo parike kuko dufite kajugujugu zishobora kuva ku Kibuga cy’indege i Kanombe zijyayo, uramutse ushaka kujyayo hari RwandAir iva Brussels mu Bubiligi inshuro enye mu cyumweru ukagera i Kigali.” Yababwiye kandi ko kugira ngo ubone VISA bidasaba ko uyakira mu gihugu urimo, ahubwo iyo ugeze ku kibuga cy’indege mu Rwanda uhita uyibahwa. Kuri ubu isoko ryo mu Buholandi riza mu myanya umunani ya mbere, mu kugira abakerarugendo benshi bakorana n’u Rwanda. Abarusura biyongereyeho 11.9 %, bavuye ku 4918 mu 2017 bagera kuri 5501 mu 2018. Guverinoma yihaye intego ko mu 2024 inyungu u Rwanda ruvana mu bukerarugendo izagera kuri miliyoni $800 zivuye kuri miliyoni $404 yinjiye mu 2017.

title: Mu basuye Pariki y’Akagera umwaka ushize, 48 % ni Abanyarwanda
content: Ugereranyije abasuye iyo pariki umwaka ushize n’abayisuye mu 2018, habayeho ubwiyongere bwa 12 %. Parike #Akagera yakiriye abakerurgendo basaga 49,000 muri 2019. Habayeho ubwiyongere bwa 12% ugereranyije na 2018. 48% by'abasuye parike uyu mwaka ni ABANYARWANDA. #Ibyaranze2019#VisitRwanda — Akagera (@AkageraPark) January 21, 2020 Iyi pariki  kuva mu 2010 icungwa n’umuryango wita ku rusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, African Parks. Mu myaka itanu ishize hagiye haba amavugurura agamije guteza imbere urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima muri iyo pariki no kurushaho gukurura ba mukerarugendo bayisura. Nubwo umubare w’amafaranga yinjijwe umwaka ushize utatangajwe, ashobora kuba yariyongereye ugendeye ku bwiyongere bw’abayisuye. African Parks icunga iyi pariki igaragaza ko amafaranga yinjiza yavuye ku madolari 200 000 mu 2010, akagera ku madolari miliyoni ebyiri mu 2018. Ibyo byatumye iyo pariki ibasha kwihaza ku ngengo y’imari ikoresha ku kigero cya 75 %. Iyi pariki irimo amoko atandukanye y’inyamaswa, ikaba imwe mu zikomeye muri Afurika nyuma yo kuzanwamo intare n’inkura. Pariki y’Akagera irimo n’izindi nyamaswa zitandukanye nk’impala n’imparage, impongo, inzovu, imvubu, ingwe, inyoni z’amoko asaga 500  n’ibindi. Mu 2015, Pariki y’Akagera yazanywemo intare zaherukagamo mu myaka ya 1990. Mu mwaka wa mbere zigaruwemo, umubare w’intare wikubye kabiri kuko zahise zibyara ibyana 11. Mu 2017, hazanywemo izindi ntare ebyiri z’ingabo zivuye muri Afurika y’Epfo. Mu 2017 kandi, muri iyo pariki hazanywemo inkura z’umukara 18, nyuma y’imyaka icumi ubwo bwoko bw’inyamaswa bwarazimiye. Umwaka ushize, Pariki y’Akagera yari yasuwe n’abakerarugendo 44000, kimwe cya kabiri ari Abanyarwanda.

title: Ibigo  nyarwanda byacanye umucyo mu imurikagurisha ry’ubukerarugendo mu Buholandi  (Amafoto)
content:
Ni imurikagurisha riri kuba ku nshuro ya 13, ryabereyemwo gahunda zitandukanye mu bijyanye no kumenyekanisha u Rwanda, aho ryitabiriwe n’ibigo byo mu Rwanda bitandukanye bikora ibijyanye n’ubukerarugendo n’izindi serivisi zijyana nabwo. Ryitabiriwe uyu mwaka n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere, RDB,  Sosiyete Nyarwanda y’Ubwikorezi bwo mu Kirere, RwandAir, Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Buholandi n’ibigo by’ubukerarugendo birimo Amahoro Tours, Palast Tours and Travel, Heritage  Safaris na Wildlife Tours-Rwanda.  Umuyobozi w’Ishami ry’Ubukerarugendo mu rugaga rw’abikorera (PSF), Rutagarama Aimable, yabwiye IGIHE ko kwitabira iryo murikagurisha  ari ubundi uburyo bwiza bwo kongera abakerarugendo basura u Rwanda. Yagize ati “ Turashimira  rwose Leta y’u Rwanda uburyo idahwema kudufasha no gushyiramwo imbaraga ngo ubukerarugendo bukomeze butere imbere kandi natwe tubukora tukagiramo inyungu.” Yakomeje agira ati “ Iyo urebye muri iyi myaka ishize biragaragara cyane ko ubukerarugendo bwateye intamwe igaragara. Natwe umuntu ku giti cye muri twe tubukora nk’umwuga ni ugushyiraho  akacu ntitubiharire gusa Leta, twongera ingufu n’umubare w’ibigo bikora ubukerarugendo, dukomeza kubaka amahoteli n’ibindi bijyanye no kwakira abantu.” Muri gahunda yo kumenyekanisha u Rwanda izwi nka  ‘Visit Rwanda’, abahagarariye ibigo byo mu Rwanda beretse bagenzi babo bo mu Buholandi amahirwe ari mu bukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda n’uko yabyazwa umusaruro. Abayobozi baryitabiriye barimo Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Buholandi, Karabaranga Jean Pierre; Umuyobozi muri RDB Ushinzwe kumenyekanisha ubukerarugendo, Mutesi Linda na Ildephonse Kambogo ushinzwe ibijyanye n’Ubusesenguzi mu by’Ubukerarugendo. Vakantiebeurs ni imurika rifatwa nk’amahirwe ku bukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda yo  gukorana n’ubw’u Buholandi n’andi masoko akomeye yabufasha gutera imbere.
Umuyobozi uhagarariye Visit Rwanda mu Buholandi, Harry Betist, yagize ati  “Ni umwanya mwiza wo guhura n’abafatanyabikorwa bacu no kwishimira intambwe ubukerarugendo bumaze gutera no kureba uko itasubira inyuma.’’ Kuri ubu isoko ryo mu Buholandi riza mu myanya umunani ya mbere, mu kugira abakerarugendo benshi bakorana n’u Rwanda. Abarusura biyongereyeho 11.9 %, bavuye ku 4918 mu 2017 bagera kuri 5501 mu 2018. Ibi bikorwa by’imurikagurisha rigamije kumenyekanisha ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda byiyongera ku bikorwa bikomeye mu kubumenyekanisha birimo amasezerano rwasinye n’amakipe ya Arsenal na Paris St Germain ndetse na Filime ya Rwanda: The Royal Tour. title: Umunyamakuru w’icyamamare mu Buholandi yaryohewe n’ibyiza by’u Rwanda
content: Humberto ni umunyamakuru w’icyamamare kuri Televiziyo ya RTL mu Buholandi, ayobora ibiganiro kuri iyi televiziyo ya mbere mu gutambutsa ibiganiro by’ubucuruzi. Uretse kuba umunyamakuru w’umwuga, Humberto ni umufotozi utarabigize umwuga, akurikirwa n’abasaga 378,000 kuri Instagram. Ishingiye ku kuba ari umunyamakuru w’icyamamare kandi akurikirwa n’abantu benshi ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Buholandi ifatanyije n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB), yamutumiye ngo asure u Rwanda mu rwego rwo kumenyekanisha ibyiza by’igihugu, muri gahunda ya Visit Rwanda. Humberto Tan yakiriye ubwo butumire neza, asura u Rwanda tariki 15 uku kwezi, yishimira uburyo Abanyarwanda bamwakiriye, umuco n’ahantu nyaburanga yasuye harimo Pariki z’Akagera n’Ibirunga, ikiyaga cya Kivu n’Umujyi wa Kigali. Urugendo rwo gusura Ingagi ni rumwe mu byo avuga yabonye mu Rwanda atazibagirwa. Yagize ati “Icyantangaje cyane ni ukuntu Ingagi zicisha bugufi kandi bigaragara ko zifite imbaraga, Ingagi y’ingabo ya Silverback ifite ubudahangarwa, iguma yitegereza buri kimwe cyose kandi ihora yiteguye kuba yatabara hagize icyinjirira umuryango wayo. Twakoze urugendo rw’amasaha abiri n’igice yo kujya guhura n’Ingagi kandi guhura nazo ni iby’agaciro cyane”. Abamukurikira ku mbuga nkoranyambaga nabo batangariye urugendo rwe mu Rwanda. Umwe yagize ati “Byiza cyane, uri umunyamahirwe kuba warabashije gukora uru rugendo, ubu noneho warukura ku rutonde rw’ibyo wari wariyemeje kuzageraho mu buzima bwawe”. Undi nawe ati “Nibyo se koko warazibonye amaso ku maso ku manywa y’ihangu? Amafoto wahafatiye ni meza cyane”. Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Buholandi, Jean Pierre Karabaranga, mu gusobanura iby’uru rugendo yagize ati  “Gahunda ya Visit Rwanda imaze kwamamara mu gihugu cy’u Buholandi, kuva aho itangiriye twahafunguje ibiro bishinzwe kuyamamaza ndetse mu mwaka wa 2019, twatunganije ingendo zitandukanye z’abanyamakuru na ba rwiyemezamirimo mu by’ubukerarugendo bw’Abaholandi batandukanye baje gusura u Rwanda.” Yakomeje agira ati “Uretse ibyo Humberto Tan yatangaje ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, hari n’indi nkuru yasohotse ku wa Gatandatu w’icyumweru gishize ku rupapuro rwa mbere rw’ikinyamakuru cya mbere mu binyamakuru bisohora inkuru zanditse cyitwa, TELEGRAAF.” Yavuze ko “Kuva tariki ya 15 kugera 19 Mutarama uyu mwaka, gahunda ya  Visit Rwanda irimo  kwitabira imurikabikorwa ry’ubukererarugendo rya mbere mu Buholandi, ryitwa ‘Vakantiebeurs’, riri kubera mu mujyi wa Utrecht.” Yavuze ko bakiriye  intumwa z’u Rwanda zirimo abahagarariye RDB ndetse na ba rwiyemezamirimo batandukanye barimo abavuye muri Sosiyete y’ubwokerezi bwo mu kirere, RwandAir, Amahoro Tours, Heritage Travel, Palast Tours & Travel na Wildlife Tours Rwanda. Yagaragaje ko mu gutangiza iri murikabikorwa ku munsi wa mbere, bafatanyije n’ikigo cyitwa Untamed Travellers mu kwakira kuri stand yabo ya Visit Rwanda,  ba rwiyemezamirimo n’abanyamakuru mu bukerarugendo basaga 200. title: Singita Kwitonda Lodge yashyizwe ku mwanya wa gatatu muri hoteli nziza ku Isi
content: Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House igizwe n’inyubako zigezweho zubatse mu Murenge wa Nyange mu Karere ka Musanze, ku birenge by’Ikirunga cya Sabyinyo, aho uba unitegeye ibirunga bya Gahinga na Muhabura. Yafunguwe ku mugaragararo na Perezida Paul Kagame muri Kanama 2019. LTI yashyize ahagaragara urutonde rwa hoteli 15 nziza kurusha izindi mu 2019, Singita Kwitonda Lodge iza ku mwanya wa gatatu. Hoteli ya mbere ni iyitwa The Nautilus yo muri Maldives, ifite umwihariko w’inzu 26 zihariye ku bakiliya (Private Homes) n’ibindi bintu bitandukanye igenera abakiliya, igakurikirwa na Grantly Hall yo mu Ntara ya Yorkshire yo mu Bwongereza. Singita yo mu Rwanda iza ku mwanya wa gatatu, ni inyubako nshya iherereye hafi ya Pariki y’Igihugu y’Ibirunga, ahantu hakururiye LTI cyane mu myaka ishize. Kuri urwo rutonde hoteli 12 za mbere zashyizwe ku rutonde hagendewe ku buryo zakira abakiliya n’agaciro ziha abazigana. Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House yubatswe ahantu hahoze igishanga cyari urwuri, ariko ubu hashibutse umushinga ukomeye w’ubukerarugendo ugizwe n’inzu umunani zubatswe mu buryo zirengera ibidukikije. Zirimo zirindwi zagenewe umuntu umwe cyangwa uherekejwe kuko buri imwe ifite uburiri bumwe, uruganiriro rwagutse n’ibindi byangombwa nkenerwa, hakaba indi imwe yiswe Kataza House yo igizwe n’ibyumba bine byo kuraramo. Yubatswe n’ibikoresho byinshi byakorewe mu Rwanda, ibyinshi ni ibiboneka i Musanze birimo amakoro n’imigano. Singita Kwitonda Lodge yashoweho miliyoni $25. Yahawe izina rya Kwitonda, yitiriwe ingagi y’ingabo yari izwiho ubwitonzi, yapfuye mu 2012 ifite imyaka 40, icyo gihe yabonetse itagihumeka nyuma y’iminsi yari ishize itakigaragara mu muryango wayo. Uyu mushinga wa Singita ni umwe mu izatuma u Rwanda rwesa umuhigo wo kwinjiza miliyoni $800 avuye mu bukerarugendo mu 2024, avuye kuri miliyoni $438 rwasaruye mu 2017. Singita ni izina risobanura ’ahantu h’ibitangaza’ mu rurimi rwa Shangaan rwo muri Afurika y’Epfo, ari naho iki kigo gikomoka. Cyatangiye ishoramari mu bukerarugendo mu 1993, gisanganwe izindi hotel zo mu bwoko bwa Lodge muri Tanzania (muri Grumeti Game Reserve na Lamai), muri Zimbabwe (Singita Pamushana Lodge) no muri Afurika y’Epfo (Singita Sweni Lodge na Singita Sabi Sand.)  	Urutonde rwa hoteli 15 za mbere ku Isi mu 2019  1. title: Wild Connector Safaris yatanze umwihariko mu gutembereza abantu Pariki y’Akagera mu minsi mikuru
content: Uruzinduko ruzaba kuwa Gatandatu tariki 21 Ukuboza 2019, muri Pariki y’Akagera icumbikiye inyamaswa nyinshi. Abazitabira bazabasha kubona amoko atandukanye y’inyamaswa  ziba muri iyo pariki, imwe mu zikomeye muri Afurika nyuma yo kuzanwamo intare n’inkura. Pariki y’akagera irimo n’izindi nyamaswa zitanduknaye nk’impala n’imparage, impongo, inzovu, imvubu, ingwe, inyoni z’amoko asaga 500  n’ibindi. Ushinzwe iyamamazabikorwa muri  Wild Connector Safaris , Rugamba Alexis  yakanguriye cyane cyane ababyeyi kuzana abana bari mu biruhuko, babafasha gusobanukirwa neza ibitatse igihugu cyabo. Ni n’umwanya kandi ku muryango n’abakundana gusoza umwaka bishimye batembera ibyiza bitatse u Rwanda. Ati “Iki gihe abana benshi baba bari mu biruhuko. Ni umwanya mwiza kuri bo wo gutembera no kumenya byinshi ku gihugu cyabo. N’abakuru ni uko, muze dusure pariki yacu y’Akagera tunezezwe no kureba inyamaswa za mbere zikomeye ku isi.” Kujyana na Wild Connector Safaris muri Pariki y’Akagera, umuntu umwe  arasabwa kwishyura amafaranga 30 000 Frw mu gihe abanyamahanga badaturuka mu muryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba bazishyura amadolari 110. Muri ayo mafaranga  harimo itike, uburenganzira bwo kwinjira muri pariki, ifunguro rya ku manywa, abakuyobora n’ibindi. Abantu bakundana baziye rimwe ndetse n’abana bazagabanyirizwaho 10 %. Undi mwihariko w’uru rugendo ni uko hazaba hari umufotozi wabigize umwuga uzafata amafoto kandi buri wese akazahabwa umwanya wo kubaza ibibazo byose ku bijyanye n’ibyiza bitatse u Rwanda. Ku bindi bisobanuro kandi aha: Www.Wildconnectorsafaris.com

title: U Rwanda rumaze kungukira miliyari 36 Frw mu bufatanye na Arsenal
content: Byatangajwe kuri uyu wa Kabiri mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru mu gihe hitegurwa umunsi wo Kwita Izina abana b’ingagi 25. Umwaka ushize binyuze mu kigo gishinzwe guteza imbere ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku nama, Rwanda Convention Bureau, u Rwanda rwinjiye mu bufatanye bw’imyaka itatu n’ikipe ya Arsenal FC, ikazajya yambara imyenda yanditseho ‘Visit Rwanda’ ndetse ikarumenyekanisha mu bundi buryo butandukanye. Ku cyumweru tariki 12 Kanama 2018, nibwo ubufatanye bw’u Rwanda n’ikipe ya Arsenal FC  bwatangiye ku mukino iyi kipe yakinagamo na Manchester City. RDB ntiyatangaje amafaranga yishyuye iyo kipe iri mu zikunzwe ku Isi, gusa ivuga ko ari ayari ateganyirijwe kumenyekanisha u Rwanda no kureshya abashoramari na ba mukerarugendo. Umuyobozi Mukuru mu Kigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere RDB, ushinzwe ubukerarugendo, Belise Kaliza yabwiye abanyamakuru ko ubufatanye bw’u Rwanda na Arsenal bumaze kubyara umusaruro nyuma y’umwaka umwe butangiye. Yavuze ko bifashishije imibare yakusanyijwe n’ibigo mpuzamahanga, inyungu u Rwanda rumaze kuvana muri ubwo bufatanye ibarirwa muri miliyari 36 Frw. Ati “Mbere yo gusinya ayo masezerano 71 % by’amamiliyoni y’abafana ba Arsenal ntibabonaga u Rwanda nk’ahantu ho gusura ariko  mu mpera z’umwaka wa mbere w’ubufatanye , kimwe cya kabiri cyabo babona u Rwanda  nk’ahantu ho gusura.” Kaliza yavuze ko mu mwaka wa 2018 ba bakerarugendo bavuye mu Bwongereza baza mu Rwanda  biyongereyeho 5 % . Yakomeje avuga ko uburyo bwamamaza ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda bwakozwe na Arsenal, bwageze ku bantu miliyoni 4.3 , akaba asanga ari umusaruro ufatika. Ati “Bivuze ko ishusho yacu iri kubonwa n’abantu basaga miliyoni enye ku Isi. N’iyo wakoresha kwamamaza kuri Televiziyo ntiwabasha kubona abantu nk’aba. Ni igihamya ko bifite akamaro.” Inyungu kandi y’ubwo bufatanye RDB igaragaza ko ibonekera mu mubare w’abatangiye gukurikira ibikorwa byo gusura u Rwanda (Visit Rwanda) aho ku mbuga nkoranyambaga nka Youtube ababikurikira biyongereye ku kigero cya cya 100 % , kuri Instagram biyongeye ku kigero cya 507 %, kuri Twitter biyongera ku kigero cya 72 %  naho kuri Facebook biyongeyere ku kigero cya 44 %. Naivasha Oakes ushinzwe ubufatanye bw’u Rwanda n’ikipe ya Arsenal, yavuze ko iyo mibare y’agaciro k’inyungu u Rwanda rumaze kuvana muri ubwo bufatanye, hifashishijwe uburyo butandukanye bwabazwe n’ibigo bizobereye. Ati “Aha mbere harebwaga  agaciro ko kwamamaza kuri za Televiziyo, ibiganiro n’ibijyanye no kwamamaza u Rwanda bitangazwa buri gihe iyo Arsenal iri gukina , ako gaciro kabarwa n’ibigo mpuzamahanga mu kubarura iby’itangazamakuru , bakanareba uburyo uko kwamamaza u Rwanda birebwa , bakareba bati  ese uko kwamamaza iyo u Rwanda ruba rubyishyura rwari kwishyura angahe.” Umuyobozi w’Ishyirahamwe ry’Abatwara n’abatembereza ba mukerarugendo mu Rwanda (RTTA) Mutoni Bonita, yavuze ko bishimishije kubona ubufatanye nk’ubwo bumaze gutuma u Rwanda rumenyekana hirya no hino ku Isi. Yavuze ko nk’abakurikiranira hafi iby’ubukerarugendo, ba mukerarugendo bavuye mu Bwongereza bagiye bagabanyuka mu bindi bihugu mu minsi ishize kubera ibibazo by’icyo gihugu cyivanye mu Muryango w’Ubumwe bw’Uburayi (Brexit) na Ebola ivugwa mu karere u Rwanda ruherereyemo. Mutoni yavuze ko kuba mu Rwanda bariyongereye bigaragaza agaciro k’ubufatanye na Arsenal. Ati “Dukwiriye gushimira RDB ku bw’imbaraga mu kongera abakerarugendo b’abongereza mu Rwanda. Ahanini haba mu Karere n’ahandi umubare wabo wagiye hasi kubera nka Brexit na Ebola ariko siko byagenze mu Rwanda.” Umwaka ushize wa 2018, mu Rwanda haje abakerarugendo bangana na miliyoni 1.7.
