title: Mu itongo kwa Richard Kandt! Igicumbi cy’ubushakashatsi, icumbi ry’abamisiyoneri ryasinyiwemo amasezerano akomeye (Amafoto)
content: Nyuma yo kuzenguruka u Rwanda umwaka wose, yaje kwiyemeza kubaka inzu y’ibyatsi yo kubamo i Shangi, aho yakorega ubushakashatsi, akayakiriramo n’abashyitsi barimo umumisiyoneri wa mbere wanahasomeye misa yabaye iya mbere y’abazungu. Uru rugo rwasinyiwemo n’amasezerano akomeye aho Ababiligi bifuzaga ko umupaka wa Congo unyuzwa mu ishyamba rya Nyungwe, icyari Cyangugu cyose kibaka umutungo wa RDC. Uru rugo ruherereye mu Karere ka Nyamasheke mu Murenge wa Shangi, Kandt, yaje kuruvamo ajya kuba i Kigali mu 1907, ubwo yagirwaga Rezida w’u Rwanda. Kuwa 7-10 Kanama 2019, Umunyamakuru wa IGIHE kimwe n’abafite ibigo bifasha ba mukerarugendo mu Rwanda, basuye ahahoze urugo rwa Kandt, mu rugendo rugamije gutangiza inzira nshya y’ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku muco n’amateka. Uru rugendo ikigo gishinzwe Ingoro z’Umurage w’u Rwanda n’Umushinga w’Abadage wita ku iterambere (GIZ) byabageneye, rwabumburiwe no gusura inkima zo mu birunga Kandt yakozeho ubushakashatsi, rukomereza i Shangi aho yabanje gutura. Uretse ibyo bikorwa bishushanya urugendo rwa Kandt, banasuye ibindi bice nyaburanga byabyazwa umusaruro n’abafasha abakerarugendo birimo ahahoze urugo rw’Umwami Kigeli IV Rwabugiri, ingoro y’ibidukikije i Karongi, ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku burobyi n’ibindi. Aho i Shangi  uyu munsi wahagereranya n’itongo rya Richard Kandt kuko uretse kuba kwinjiramo bigoranye, n’iyo nzu bivugwa ko yahubatse utayihabona uretse ibisigazwa by’amateka yayo birimo ibiti by’imbuto, ikawa n’ibindi by’imitako byahatewe mu gihe cy’Abakoloni. Kugera kuri uru rugo uturutse ku muhanda wa Kaburimbo mu Murenge wa Ruharambuga mu gasanteri ka Shangazi, uhabona icyapa kikuyoborayo kikugargariza ko kuhagera ugenda kilometero 10.3. Winjirira mu muhanda w’igitaka ubona ukoze neza ariko uko ugenda usatira aho iyi nzu yari yubatse niko ugera ku bice bidakoze neza. Ku marembo hari icyapa cyashyizweho n’Ikigo gishinzwe ingoro z’igihugu, kigaragaza ko ari kamwe mu duce tubitse amateka dushobora gusurwa n’abakerarugendo. Ukihagera ubona hameze nko mu ishyamba ritarimo ibiti byinshi ariko ibirimo bikuze cyane, bikikijwe n’urugo rufite amarembo yubakishije imbaho ariko rufite akaryango gato gahora gafunze, bigaragara ko hinjirwa na nyiraho cyangwa undi wabanje kubisabira uburenganzira. Ntabwo imodoka wabona uko uyigezamo. Urakomanga ugategereza ko abasore bahakora baza kukubaza ikikugenza bakaguha uburenganzira bwo kujyamo, bivuze ko hari n’ubwo bashobora kubukwima bitewe n’impamvu runaka. Ukinjira, imbere harimo agahanda gafite nka metero ebyiri gakikijwe n’ibiti by’imikindo bivugwa ko byatewe ku ngoma y’Abakoloni. Ugenda nka metero 50 ukagera ku nzu zimaze igihe zubatswe mu 1930, mu gihe u Rwanda rwagenzurwaga n’Ababiligi ariko bigaragara ko mu gihe cyazo zari mu zigezweho. Haruguru yazo aho bivugwa ko Kandt yari yarubatse iyo nzu y’ibyatsi harisanzuye nta kintu giteyemo uretse ibyatsi cyimeza. Gusa hari uruhande ubonamo ikawa bigaragara ko zatewe cyera ariko zidakoreye. Hepfo y’izo nzu ziteye irangi ry’umweru ridaheruka kuvugurwa n’amabati y’ubururu ashaje zirimo na sima, hari umwanya mugari ukikijwe n’ibiti by’inganzamarumbo. Kubera ibimera birimo n’indabo zizikikije bihari, hahora hahereye. Hirya gato, ka gahanda kinjiramo gakikijwe n’imikindo karakomeza kugera ku mazi y’ikiyaga cya Kivu, harimo urugendo nk’urwa metero 800, bivuga ko yari inzira Kandt n’abandi bahabaye banyuragamo bagiye cyangwa bavuye mu bwato. Izo nzu iriho imitako itandukanya ifoto ya Richard Kandt, ay’umwami Yuhi V. Musinga ari kumwe n’umwe mu Badage bari mu Rwanda icyo gihe n’andi asobanura bimwe mu bikorwa byahabere. Ubwo butaka bubarizwamo iryo tongo uyu munsi ntabwo burajya mu maboko ya Leta, ni ah’umuzungu witwa Sett Manfred, Umudage wo mu muryango wa Dr Richard wamuzunguye, ndetse aza kuhagura na Leta mu 1989. Mu itongo ry’aho Kandt yabaga uyu munsi ntabwo inzu y’ibyatsi yabagamo wayihabona. Ni isambu nini bivugwa ho yarengaga hegitari 10 izitije ibiti by’ubwoko butandukanye birimo ibimaze imyaka isaga 100. Dr Kandt yubatse iyi nzu y’ibyatsi iherereye i Shangi, ruguru gato y’ikiyaga cya Kivu ku wa 24 Werurwe 1899, nyuma yo kuvumbura isoko y’uruzi rwa Nile, mu ishyamba rya Nyungwe. Igicumbi cy’ubushakashatsi Umushakashatsi mu kigo cy’igihugu cy’ingoro z’Umurage, Mugabowagahunde Maurice, yavuze ko muri uru rugo ariho Kandt yakoreraga ubushakashatsi butandukanye. Yasobanuye ko ariho yicaraga agakubira mu nyandiko ibintu bitandukanye yabonye bishya birimo ibijyanye n’isoko y’uruzi rwa Nil yabonye mu ishyamba rya Nyungwe, ishusho y’ikiyaga cya Kivu yashushanyije nyuma yo kukizenguruka n’amaguru n’ibindi. Mugabowagahunde  ati “Ubushashatsi bwose yabukoraga ataha hano kugera igihe bamugiriye umuyobozi w’umujyi wa Kigali mu 1907, ajya kubayo.” Yahakiriye abamisiyoneri bahasomera misa ya mbere Mugabowagahunde yavuze ko Abamisiyoneri binjiye bwa mbere mu Rwanda baturutse i Bujumbura mu Burundi, bakagirwa inama yo kubanza kwiyegereza Richard Kandt wari uhamenyereye. Ati “Abamisiyoneri ba mbere baza baturutse i Bujumbura mu Burundi, bayobowe na Musenyeri Joseph Hirth bamubwiye ko kugira ngo ahite ajya kureba umwami agomba kubanza kuvugana na Kandt wari uhamenyereye, akamubwira uko yabyitwaramo.” Muri icyo gihe Musenyeri Joseph Hirth yari ategereje kugirwa inama na Kandt, we na bagenzi be b’abamisiyoneri basomeye misa ya mbere i Shangi mu rugo rwa Kandt, yitabiriwe n’abaturage bacye. Nyuma Kandt yaje kubagira inama yo kujya gutura i Save muri Butare, hafi y’umwami. Imishyikirano yo kwambura ubutaka u Rwanda Ubwo u Bubiligi bwakolonizaga Congo, u Rwanda rugakolonizwa n’u Budage, mu myaka ya 1900 impande zombi zagiraga igihe zihura zikaganira ku buryo bwo kwigabanya ubutaka. Mugabowagahunde ati “Habereye imishyikirano ikomeye yamaze igihe hagati y’Abadage n’Ababiligi bari muri Congo. Nyuma yaho Ababiligi baje kongera gushaka ko umupaka wimuka, ukava aho u Rwanda rugabanira na Congo, ugaca muri Nyungwe iki gice [Cya Cyangugu] kikajya muri Congo, Richard Kandt arabyanga.” Mugabowagahunde yavuze ko mu nyandiko zitandukanye Kandt yanditse, zisobanura ko yanze ko umupaka wimuka kuko yari agifite impungenge z’uko azabwira Umwami Musinga, ukuntu ibindi bice nko ku Idjwi byagiye ku ruhande rwa Congo. Umuyobozi w’Ingoro z’Umurage w’u Rwanda, Amb Robert Masozera, yavuze ko kumenyekanisha ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku rugendo rwa Kandt ‘atari ugushyigikira ibyo yakoze kuko atari byiza ahubwo aho yageze ari ahantu heza habyazwa umusaruro no kwagura ubukerarugendo bukarenga gushingira ku ngagi na Pariki’.

title: Shira amatsiko ku mibereho y’Inkima zo mu Birunga zisangiye amateka na Richard Kandt (Amafoto)
content: Ni inyamaswa zishimishije zifite imico ijya gusa n’iya muntu, zifitanye amateka na Dr Richard Kandt, umuvumbuzi uzwi cyane mu mateka y’u Rwanda no mu Karere ka Afurika y’Uburasirazuba. Dr Kandt yageze mu Rwanda ari gukora ubushakashatsi burimo gushakisha isoko y’uruzi rwa Nil mu myaka ya 1897 na 1906, ni nabwo yaje kubona mu Birunga Inkima zifite ibara rya zahabu, azandikaho inyandiko nyinshi ndetse zihabwa izina ry’ubushakashatsi rya ‘Cercopithecus kandti’. Ubu bwoko bw’inkima bugaragara cyane mu Karere ka Afurika y’Iburasirazuba mu misozi y’Ibirunga ihuriweho na Pariki enye zirimo iy’Ibirunga yo mu Rwanda, iya Mgahinga muri Uganda, iya Virunga na Kahuzi-Biéga zo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Kuwa 7-10 Kanama 2019, umunyamakuru wa IGIHE kimwe n’abafite n’abakorera ibigo bifasha ba mukerarugendo mu Rwanda, basuye Inkima zo mu Birunga, mu rugendo rugamije gutangiza inzira nshya y’ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku muco n’amateka. Uru rugendo ikigo gishinzwe Ingoro z’Umurage w’u Rwanda n’Umushinga w’Abadage wita ku iterambere (GIZ) byabageneye, rwibanze ku mateka y’Ubukoloni bw’Abadege mu Rwanda by’umwihariko urugendo rwa Dr Richard Kandt wari ubahagarariye. Ni urugendo rwahereye muri Priki y’Ibirunga icumbikiye inyamaswa nyinshi zirimo Inkima zifite ibara rya zahabu igice kimwe n’ajya gusa n’ikigina n’umukara, bakomereza n’izindi nzira Richard Kandt yanyuzemo mu Rwanda. Umukozi uhagarariye abafasha ba mukerarugendo muri Pariki y’Ibirunga, Irakoze Emmanuel, wari uyoboye itsinda guturuka ku biro byayo biherereye mu Kinigi mu Karere ka Musanze, yagize ati “Urugendo tugiye gukora rugera muri umwe mu miryango y’Inkima zisurwa n’abakerarugendo, rutwara iminota 30”. Urugendo rujya gutangira yadusobanuriye ko mu Birunga harimo imiryango myinshi y’Inkima ariko isurwa ari itatu irimo uwa Kinege, Kageri na Kabatwa, zihabwa amazina bitewe y’uduce zikunze gusangwamo. Uwo twasuye wa Kageri, ugizwe n’inkima ziri hagati ya 60-100. Kugera kuri uyu muryango bisaba iminota nibura 30 uvuye ku cyicaro cya Pariki y’Ibirunga, gusa Irakoze asobanura ko we cyangwa abashinzwe kuzicunga bataba bazi aho ziherereye kuko zihora zimuka. Ni inyamaswa zisurwa cyane, buri gitondo abashinzwe kuzishakisha barazinduka mu ishyamba ry’imigano n’ibindi byatsi n’ibiti cyimeza usanga muri pariki y’Ibirunga, bashakisha aho ziherereye, bagahana amakuru n’ushinzwe kuyobora abakerarugendo. Nk’ibisanzwe mbere yo kwinjira muri iyi pariki, Irakoze yabanje gutanga amabwiriza abasura bagomba gukurikiza mu kubungabunga umutekano wabo n’uw’imyamaswa zibarizwamo. Mu nama zitangwa harimo kutavugira hejuru, ahubwo ‘ushobora gutangara ariko bikamara amasegonda gusa’ no kutagira icyo ukura muri pariki cyangwa ngo usigemo icyo winjiranye, kutiherera aho ubonye, wabishaka ukamumenyesha. Ukigera aho umuryango wa Kageri uhera, biba bishoboka ko Inkima wazibona hafi cyangwa kure bitewe n’aho zaraye cyangwa aho zagiye gushakira ibizitunga. Tumaze kugenda nk’iminota 20 mu ishyamba, twageze ku bashinzwe kuzishakisha mu ishyamba, batubwira ko tugize amahirwe ko ziri hafi aho. Irakoze wari utuyoboye yadusabye gusiga ibikapu n’ibindi bikoresho dufite kugira ngo bitaza kubangamira ubwisanzure hagati yacu n’izi nyamaswa. Bimwe mu bifasha abazishakisha kumenya aho ziherere harimo kuba bazi agace barimo umunsi wabanje. Kubera kumarana igihe kinini nazo, bashobora kumenya icyerekezo zizaganamo umunsi ukurikiye. Aba baba bafite n’ubuhanga bwo kwitegereza ibyatsi zariyeho bakamenya umwanya ushize zihanyuze ku buryo bibafasha gutahura agace ziherereyemo. Inkima usanga zisimbagurika hejuru mu biti ari nabyo ziberamo. Ntizigera mu bushorishori ariko nanone biragoye ko wazisanga hasi ku butaka, zigerageza kujya hagati na hagati. Ni imyamaswa zidatinya, usanga zishaka kwegera abantu zibyishakiye ariko n’ubwayo uyegereye ihita ihunga, rimwe na rimwe ikaba yahagaraya hafi yawe. Inkima igira uburebure buri hagati ya sentimetero 48 na 67 n’umurizo ushobora kugera kuri santimetero 72. Irakoze yavuze ko Inkima ishobora kubyara impanga ariko bigoye ko izikuza zose kuko byayigora kuzitaho icyarimwe kuko akenshi iyo bikiri ibyana biyisaba kubigendana ibiteruye. Imara amezi atanu mu nda ya nyana, ikavuka ifite amagarama 300-500. Abakurikiranira hafi imibereho y’inkima bavuga ko bigoye gushyingura umurambo wayo kuko iy’imbyeyi igize ibyago byo gupfusha umwana, imuterura ikabana na we kugeza ashangutse [Mu Rwanda ntabwo birabaho ni ku bundi bwoko bw’inkima]. Imushyira hasi iyo igiye kurisha, yabona umuntu cyangwa hakagira ikiyikanga, ihita iwuterura ikawurirana mu giti. Umushakashatsi mu Kigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ingoro z’Umurage, Mugabowagahunde Maurice, yavuze ko kumenyekanisha ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku muco ari igikorwa cyunganira ubundi busanzwe. Yavuze ko na mbere y’uko Dr Richard Kandt aza mu Rwanda Inkima zabaga mu Birunga, ahubwo icyo yakoze ari ukuzandikaho no kuzimenyekanisha ku ruhando mpuzamahanga, dore ko zigaragara hacye ku Isi. Ati “Inkima ziteye amatsiko, icyo dusaba abantu ni uko bazisura kuko ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda si ukuvuga ingagi gusa ahubwo hari n’ibindi biteye amatsiko mu gihugu bashobora gusura.” Umuyobozi wa guhunda yo guteza imbere ubukungu n’umurirmo muri GIZ, Kubwimana Jean Bosco, yavuze ko muri gahunda yo kumenyekanisha ubukerarugendo bufitanye isano na Dr Kandt ‘Twifuza ko ibigo bikora ubukerarugendo birimo ibikorera aho yagiye anyura, ibice ndangamateka, ingoro z’umurage byagura ubukerarugendo bikanagira uruhare mu iterambere ry’igihugu’. Si ugushyigikira ibyakozwe n’Abakoloni Umuyobozi w’Ingoro z’Umurage w’u Rwanda, Amb Robert Masozera, yavuze ko ‘Atari ugushyigikira ibyo Kandt yakoze kuko atari byiza ahubwo aho yageze ari ahantu heza habyazwa umusaruro no kwagura ubukerarugendo bukarenga gushingira ku ngagi na Pariki’. Yasobanuye ko hari porogaramu yitwa ‘Richard Kandt Trail’ igaragara kuri Play Store yakozwe, umuntu yamanuraho akayishyira muri telefone zigezweho, ikamufasha kumva no gusobanukirwa amateka n’urugendo rwa Dr Richard Kandt no gusura uduce yagiye anyuramo. Ikigo cy’igihugu ndangamurage kigaragaza ko kimaze gukora ubushakashatsi bugamije kugaragaza ibice nyaburanga by’u Rwanda abakerarugendo basura, bwagaragaje ibisaga 500 birimo 10 bifitanye isano n’urugendo rwa Dr Richard Kandt. title: Mu mafoto: Imiterere ya ’beach’ 10 za mbere nziza ku Isi mu 2019
content:
Kujya ku mucanga wo ku mazi (beach) ni kimwe mubyo abantu bakunda gukora baruhuka cyangwa bishimisha. Urubuga rwa Big 7 Travel rwashyize ahagaragara beaches 10 za mbere zikunzwe mu 2019, rwifashishije ibitekerezo by’abakozi barwo n’abasomyi barwo 6,105 babajijwe. 10. Pig beach
 Iyi beach iherereye mu karere ka Exuma mu gihugu cya Bahamas. Bivugwa ko ingurube cyari kimwe mu by’ingenzi mu bucuruzi bwo muri Bahamas, bikaba bugingo n’ubu kuri uwo mucanga hakirangwa ingurube. 9. Kanuhura
 Kanuhura n’imwe muri beach 10 za mbere ku isi nziza ikaba iherereye mu gihugu cya Maldives, muri Asia y’amajyepfo. 8. Playa Ruinas
  Playa Ruinas ni beach iherereye mu gihugu cya Mexique ikaba izwiho kugira umucanga mwiza w’umweru n’amazi ateye amabengeza. Ni n’ahantu habumbatiye amateka y’ingenzi. Abatuye Amerika y’Amajyepfo no ku yindi migabane usanga basura iyo beach ku bwinshi. 7. Source d’Argent
 Source d’Argent ni beach iherereye ku Nyanja y’Abahinde mu gihugu cya Seychelles. Ikikijwe n’ibitare binini bitangaje. 6. Reynisfjara Beach
 Iyi ni beach izwi cyane kubera umwihariko wayo wo kugira umucanga w’umukara, ikaba iherereye mu gihugu cya Iceland. Impamvu zatumye umucanga wo kuri iyi beach uba umukara n’iruka ry’ikirunga,  gusa ibi ntibiyibuza kuza mu icumi  za mbere nziza mu 2019. 5. Secret Lagoon
 Iyi beach ya  gatanu  ku rutonde rw’inziza mu 2019 iherereye mu gace ka El Nino ku kirwa cya Palawan mu gihugu cya Philippines. Kugira ngo uyigereho bigusaba kubanza koga ukanyura mu bitare biyikikije. Kujya kuri uwo mucanga ugahabwa n’ifunguro byagutwara agera ku Frw 29, 250. 4. Grace Bay
 Iyi ni beach iherereye mu birwa bya Turks na Caicos hagati y’igihugu cya Bahamas na Repubulika y’Abadominikani. Ifite umucanga w’umweru ukundwa cyane n’abakerarugendo. 3. Fig Tree Bay
 Iyi ni beach ya gatatu  mu nziza ku isi mu 2019  iherereye mu gihugu cya Chypre. Kwicara ku mucanga waho ni ubuntu kuri bose ariko kujya ku dutanda n’imitaka byo birishyuzwa. Mu 2011, iyi beach yaje ku mwanya wa 3 mu nziza ku mugabane w’Iburayi. 2. Whitehaven Beach
 Whitehaven iri ku mwanya wa kabiri  mu nziza ku isi mu 2019, ikaba iherereye mu gihugu cya Australie ku kirwa cya Whitsunday. Ifite uburebure bwa kilimetero zirindwi ikaba ifite n’umucanga w’umweru. 1. Zlatni Rat
 Nkuko bitangazwa na Big 7 travel, Zlatni Rat niyo beach ya mbere nziza ku isi mu 2019. Iherereye mu gihugu cya Croatia bakaba bakunda kuyita ihembe rya zahabu kubera imisusire yayo. Iyi beach kandi ifite umwihariko wo kugenda yihinduranya amabara nyuma ya buri metero 10 na 20. Izenguruswe n’imikindo itanga umuyaga mwiza ku bayigana.

title: Abana 25 b’Ingagi bagiye kwitwa amazina mu muhango wateguwe ku nshuro ya 15
content: Kwita Izina ni umuhango witabirwa n’abashyitsi baba abo ku rwego rw’igihugu na mpuzamahanga, aho ingagi ziba zavutse buri mwaka zihabwa izina, mu mugenzo umaze kumenyerwa kandi ufite uruhare mu kumurikira amahanga ibyiza u Rwanda rufite mu bukerarugendo. Iki gikorwa kiri mu rwego rwo kubungabunga ibidukikije, giteganyijwe ku wa 6 Nzeri mu Kinigi mu Karere ka Musanze. Ibarura ryakozwe mu 2016 ryerekanye ko umubare w’ingagi ukomeje kwiyongera mu gice cy’ibirunga, aho habarurwaga ingagi 604 ziba mu miryango 41, bingana n’izamuka rya 26% kuko zavuye kuri 480 zabarurwaga mu mwaka wa 2010. Iki ni ikimenyetso cy’intambwe ikomeye yatewe mu kubungabunga ingagi, ku buryo ziheruka kuvanwa mu mubare w’inyamaswa zugarijwe n’ibyago byo gukendera. Imbaraga u Rwanda rukoresha mu kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima zikomeje no gutanga umusaruro kubera ko n’inyungu ituruka mu bukerarugendo igenda izamuka, hamwe n’abasura ingagi by’umwihariko. Mu 2017 Pariki y’Igihugu y’Ibirunga yasuwe n’abantu 35 567, ibyara inyungu ya miliyoni $16.75. Guverinoma yashyizeho uburyo bwo gusangiza abaturage baturiye pariki ku nyungu ituruka mu bukerarugendo, aho kuva mu 2005 bahabwaga 5% k’umusaruro wabwo, mu 2017 aza kongerwa agera ku 10%. Byatumye haterwa inkunga imishinga 730 y’abaturage ibarirwa agaciro kari muri miliyoni $6.1, birimo amashuri, amavuriro, ibigega by’amazi n’ibindi bikorwa mu mirenge 12 yo mu Turere tune dukora kuri Pariki y’Igihugu y’Ibirunga. Ni ibikorwa bimaze guhanga imirimo igera ku 1,500.

title: Uruhare rw’abaturage ku isonga mu byatumye Gishwati - Mukura izuka igahinduka Pariki y’Igihugu
content: Abaturage bari ku ruhembe ku izuka rya Gishwati  Abaturiye pariki bafashijwe kwiteza imbera binyuze mu mishinga ibyara inyungu  Imizi Ecotourism Development Ltd igiye gutangira kubaka inzu z’ubukerarugendo  Umushinga LAFREC ukorera muri REMA uri kubaka ibikorwa remezo bizifashishwa pariki itangiye kwakira ba mukerarugendo  Urugendo rwo kongera ibyiza bya Gishwati-Mukura rurakomeje Iyo pariki iherereye mu Turere twa Rutsiro na Ngororero mu Ntara y’i Burengerazuba bw’igihugu, ingana na hegitari 3 558, harimo icyanya cya Gishwati gifite ubuso bungana na Hegitari 1 570, n’icya Mukura kingana na Hegitari 1 988. Ni pariki yabashije kubaho kubera uruhare rwa leta n’abaturage, kuko nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi iyi pariki yari yakendereye, ituzwamo abaturage ndetse ibindi bikorwa byabo birushaho kuyangiza. Kayihura Jean uturiye Pariki y’Igihugu ya Gishwati-Mukura, avuga ko bakimara gutuzwa muri Gishwati bayihinzemo ibishyimbo ku gice kinini ndetse bayiragiramo amatungo, utaretse n’igice kinini cyatuwe. Ingaruka zibikomokaho ntizatinze kuko habanje kuva izuba ridasanzwe, nyuma hagwa imvura idasanzwe. Ati “Nyuma yo gutema ishyamba habaye ikibazo, ikirere kirahinduka hano haba izuba rikomeye, haza ingomero ebyiri twari dufite rumwe rwa Nkore rutangira gusenyuka, tubona ingaruka ziteye ubwoba zibonetse kubw’ishyamba ryari ryangiritse. Niho twatangiye gufata ingamba zo kujya inama tuti iri shyamba nirisenyuka, n’ubuzima twibwiraga ko tuzabamo ntibuzashoboka, hafatwa icyemezo dufatanyije n’izindi nzego, zo guhagarika kurituramo.” Ruzindana Alexis warindaga iyi pariki, yavuze ko babitangira mu 2009 yari yugarijwe n’ibikorwa byatumaga inyamaswa ndetse n’ibimera biyigize bihutazwa bikomeye kubera ibikorwa bya muntu. Ati “Abantu bakimara kuhatuzwa, ishyamba bahise batangira kuritema, nk’impundu zarimo zatangiye guhura n’ikibazo ugasanga zigiye konera abaturage bari kuzirukaho, ikindi ni ukuriragira cyangwa n’ubucukuzi by’amabuye y’agaciro, ugasanga n’ibiti umushinga wa mbere wateye batangiye kubicukura.” Abaturage ku ruhembe rwo kubungabunga Gishwati Mu gutunganywa iri shyamba, habanje umushinga Gishwati Area Conservation Program (GACP) wateraga ibiti muri iri shyamba hagamijwe ko ryongera kugira isura, ribungwabunga kuva mu 2008-2011. Umaze guhagarara nibwo hibajijwe niba intambwe yatewe itazasubira inyuma, abaturage bagerageza kwishyira hamwe ngo barebe icyo bakora. Baje kwishyira hamwe bashinga Forest of Hope Association (FHA) muri Mutarama 2012, ngo yubakire ku bikorwa byari bimaze kugerwaho n’umushinga wa mbere kandi bakabikora nta gihembo bategereje. Nyuma hiyongereyeho ibikorwa by’Umushinga LAFREC ( Landscape approach to forest restoration and conservation) w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cyo kubungabunga ibidukikije, REMA, wafashije mu gukomeza gusubiranya no gusana ibice by’ishyamba byangiritse, kubaka ibikorwa by’ibanze bya pariki ndetse no gufasha abaturiye pariki kwiteza imbere binyuze mishinga ibyara inyungu. Binyuze muri muri uyu mushinga, amashaymba ya Gishwati na Mukura n’ibice biyakikije byakomeje gusubiranywa, cyane ahitwa Kinyenkanda ku gice cy’ishyamba rya Gishwati, ahatewe ibiti gakondo kuri hegitari 439. Ibi biti byatewe hamaze kwimurwa abaturage bahatujwe, ariko leta iza kubona ko ari ngombwa ko bimurwa mu rwego rwo gukomeza kongera ubuso bw’ishyamba no kurinda iyangirika ryaryo. Naho ku gice cy’ishyamba rya Mukura, Umushinga LAFREC wafashije gusubiranya ibice byacukurwagamo amabuye y’agaciro mu buryo butemewe n’amategeko, aho byatezaga isuri ndetse n’iyangirika ry’ibidukikije mu buryo bukabije. Kuri ubu hakomeje gushyirwaho ibikorwa remezo by’ibanze by’ubukerarugendo bizifashishwa igihe pariki izaba yatangiye gukora. Muri byo harimo inzu pariki izakoreramo, aho ba mukerarugendo bahererwa amakuru igihe basuye pariki (visitor centers), inzu z’abacunga pariki (ranger posts) ndetse n’aho ba mukerarugendo baruhukira igihe bari mu nzira basura pariki. Umushinga LAFREC wa REMA kandi wafashije ababaturage kwiteza imbere binyuze mu mishanga ibyara inyungu ifite agaciro ka miliyari ebyiri na miliyoni 600 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda, ndetse bubakirwa aho bazajya bamukirikira bakanagurishiriza ibyavuye mu musaruro wabo. Hubatswe kandi ibikorwa byo kwirinda ibiza aho kuri ubu hamaze kubakwa ibiraro bine by’abanyamaguru ku migezi ya Sebeya na Satinsyi, aho kenshi abaturage batabashaga kwambuka bitewe n’amazi yateraga kuzura kwi’iyo migezi mu gihe cy’imvura nyinshi. Hateganyijwe kandi ko hazubakwa ibindi biraro bitatu mu turere twa Rutsiro na Ngororero. Hakozwe kandi inyigo n’ubushakashatsi bugaragaza urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima biri muri iyi pariki ndetse n’inyandko igaragaza uko ubukerarugendo buzakomeza gutezwa imbere. Nyiratuza Madeleine wakoranye n’umushinga wa mbere ndetse akaza gushinga FHA, avuga ko mu bikorwa byo kubungabunga Gishwati, abaturage babigizemo uruhare rukomeye kandi bagaragaza umuhate udasanzwe kubera ko bari bazi akamaro kayo ku buzima barimo. Ati “Mbere twari tuzi ko tuhasanga hegitari 800 gusa ariko abaturage batwereka ahantu hose bakoreshaga leta yari yarageneye gusubira mu mbago z’ishyamba, riza kwiyongeraho ubundi buso bwa hegitari 700.” Bashinga Forest of Hope Association ngo bumvaga bagiye kubungabunga ishyamba amezi make kubera ko bari abakorerabushake, kandi bumvaga atari ibintu bakora igihe kirekire. Nyamara haje kuboneka inkunga ku buryo uyu muryango waje gukomera ndetse ugira abakozi bahoraho. Hashyizweho itsinda ry’abantu batatu bavuye muri buri Kagali gakora kuri Gishwati, kakanagira komite y’abantu batandatu bagomba gushyigikira abarinda ishyamba, bakaba n’abahuza babo na leta. Kabenga Edson wari umukorerabushake muri Pariki ya Gishwati, avuga ko bitangira bari abantu 18 baturiye ishyamba rya Gishwati. Agaruka ku kazi kabo yagize ati “Tugenda tuzunguruka ku ishyamba tureba ahantu hashobora kuba hangiritse, aho tubonye tugahamagara abarinda ishyamba tukahabereka, twaba dufashe umuntu ari kuryangiza tukamwigisha, twamara kumwigisha tugahamagara abarinda ishyamba, tukamwandikisha, tukamurekura.” “Byaba bibaye nk’inshuro ya kabiri twongeye kumufata asubiye mu ishyamba, tugahamagara abarinda ishyamba, nabo bagahamagara abantu bo mu nzego z’ibanze kugira ngo bamuhane.” Ni umurimo abaturage bakora bawishimiye, kuko umusaruro waryo ubageraho binyuze mu bikorwa bijyana n’iyi pariki. Mu bice biyikikije hubatswe ibikorwa nk’amakaragiro n’uruganda rw’ubuki rwa Gishwati, bijyana n’imihanda yunganira abaturage mu bikorwa binyuranye. Pariki y’Igihugu ya Gishwati-Mukura igiye gutangira gusurwa Umuyobozi wa Pariki y’Igihugu ya Gishwati-Mukura, Abel Musana, avuga ko kuba RDB igiye gutangira imicungire ya pariki mu buryo buhoraho aho gukorwa n’abaturage nk’uko bisanzwe, ari inyungu ikomeye ku gihugu ndetse n’abayituriye. Imirimo yo kuhubaka ibiro bya RDB igeze kure. Yagize ati “Iyi pariki iri ahantu twavuga ko hari ibikorwa remezo, umuhanda (wa kaburimbo) ubasha gutuma abantu bayigeramo, igihe ubukerarugendo buzaba butangiye bizoroha. Ariko by’ubwihariko, muri iyi pariki ni naho dusanga amasoko y’imigezi nka Sebeya, hari amoko y’inyoni ataboneka ahandi, ikanagira umwihariko wo kuba ari nshya ku buryo abantu bazaba bishimiye kureba ahantu abantu bakoze ibishoboka byose ngo bagarure ishyamba ryari rigiye kuzimira ndetse barigire pariki.” Kugeza ubu urugendo rurimo gukorwa ni urwo kongera inyamaswa zirimo ndetse n’ibimera, ku buryo abantu bazishimira gusura iyi pariki ya Gishwati-Mukura. Nyuma y’urwo rugendo rwose, Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere kigiye gutangira gucunga Pariki y’Igihugu y’Igihugu ya Gishwati, ndetse giheruka gusinyana amasezerano na y’imyaka 25 n’ikigo Imizi Ecotourism Development Ltd, yo gutunganya no gucunga Pariki y’igihugu ya Gishwati-Mukura, ku buryo ihinduka igice gikorerwamo ubukerarugendo mu gihugu. Ikigo Imizi gishamikiye kuri Wilderness Safari imaze kubaka izina mu bijyanye n’ubukerarugendo bugezweho kuri uyu mugabane. Ayo masezerano azatuma ikigo Imizi gitunganya ndetse gicunge Pariki y’igihugu ya Gishwati Mukura ku buryo ba mukerarugendo bazoroherwa no gusura inguge n’ibisamuntu bihaboneka, RDB isigarane inshingano zo kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima n’ibikorwa byo kurengera ibidukikije. Musana yakomeje ati “Hari ibyatangiye gukorwa kugira ngo gihe gito kiri imbere iyi pariki y’igihugu ya Gishwati Mukura izatangire kwakira ba mukerarugendo, muri ibyo navuga amasezerano RDB yagiranye na Wilderness Safari, mu minsi iri imbere bakazaza kubaka ‘eco-lodge’ iri ku rwego rwo hejuru hano iruhande rwa pariki, ariko mu mizo ya mbere hazabanza kubakwa aho ba mukerarugendo barara mu buryo bwo gukambika, iyo hoteli ya eco-lodge ikazaza mu cyiciro cya nyuma. N’ubutaka bwo kubakaho bwarabonetse.” “Bikaba ari bimwe bizabanza kugira ngo ubukerarugendo nyirizina bwo gusura pariki, gusura za nyamaswa zirimo, gusura bya biti birimo, bitangire. Ibyo bikaba ari bimwe mu bikorwa abatiriye pariki bazagenda babonamo inyungu kuo iyo mirimo yose izajya ikorwa akenshi, ari bo babigiramo uruhare. Uretse ibikenera ubushobozi buhambaye, hari imirimo ya buri munsi kandi izajya ikenera abaturage bakikije iyi pariki.” Mu rugendo rwo kwishimira intambwe u Rwanda rumaze gutera mu kwita kubidukikije, Madeleine Nyiratuza watangije Forest of Hope Association ubu ukora muri UNDP Rwanda, ni umwe mu bise ingagi Izina ku wa Gatanu. Yise ingagi izina ‘Isanzure’.

title: Radisson Blu yabaye iya mbere mu Rwanda yahawe igihembo cya hoteli itekanye
content: Ku wa 5 Kanama 2019 ni bwo byatangajwe ko Radisson Blu Hotel and Convention Centre yegukanye iki gihembo gitangwa n’Ikigo Mpuzamahanga gihemba hoteli zifite ituze n’umutekano cyitwa Safehotels Alliance AB. Iki gihembo gihabwa hoteli zateye intambwe ishimishije mu gushyira mu bikorwa politiki n’ingamba zo kubungabunga ituze n’umutekano kandi zikubahiriza amabwiriza y’ubuziranenge. Iki kigo gitanga iki gihembo cyemewe kandi gikorana n’Ishyirahamwe ry’ibigo bya ba mukerarugendo birimo Ihuriro Mpuzamahanga rishinzwe ibyo gutegura inama zikomeye (ICCA) n’Ibiro by’Umuryango w’Abibumbye bishinzwe gukumira Ibiza (UNISDR). Umuyobozi wa Radisson Blu Hotel and Convention Centre, Denis J. Dernault, yavuze ko bishimiye kuba hoteli yakiriye icyo gihembo gikomeye. Yakomeje agira ati “Ituze n’umutekano by’abakiliya bacu ni ikintu duha agaciro gakomeye kandi tuzirikana ko ingamba nk’izo zishyirwa mu bikorwa.  Abakozi bacu bazakomeza gutozwa kubahiriza amabwiriza mu nama zidasanzwe, dukomeze kubigira iby’ibanze.” Yasobanuye ko Radisson Blu Hotel and Convention Centre izi neza ko icy’ibanze abagenzi bishimira aho batemberera ari ituze n’umutekano bahasanga, bityo kuba yabiherewe igihembo bizatuma abayigana barushaho kuyigirira icyizere. Radisson Blu Hotel yahawe igihembo cya hoteli itekanye kandi yiyubashye nyuma y’igenzura yakorewe ku ngingo zisaga 220 zishingirwaho kugira ngo hoteli runaka ishyirwe mu zitekanye. Harebwa ibyiciro bitandatu bitandukanye birimo umutekano w’inyubako, imiterere ya hoteli n’uburyo ihugura abakozi, ibikoresho bikumira inkongi, ibikoresho byifashishwa mu gucunga umutekano n’uburyo ikemura ibibazo ihuye nabyo. Radisson Blu Hotel and Convention Centre, yagiye ihabwa ibindi bihembo birimo icyo yegukanye mu cyiciro cya hoteli zifite igishushanyo cyiza n’izikomeje gutera imbere muri Afurika, icya Hotel ibereye gukorerwamo Inama (Best Conference); Ubukerarugendo (Best Mice Hotel) n’Ishoramari mu Rwanda n’ibindi. Radisson Blu Hotel and Convention Centre iherereye ku Kimihurura mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Ifite ibyumba 291, birimo n’icyagenewe abo ku rwego rwo hejuru (Royal Suite) kiri ku buso bwa metero kare 700. Igice cyayo gishushe nk’Inzu y’Umwami igaragara i Nyanza, cyakira abantu 2600. Iyi nyubako yafunguye imiryango mu 2016, ifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira inama y’abantu 5000 icyarimwe n’umwanya uhagije ushobora kuberamo ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi, imyidagaduro n’ibindi birori. title: RDB yavuze ku mpinduka zimaze kugaragara nyuma y’imyaka ibiri ibiciro byo gusura ingagi bikubwe kabiri
content: Yabigarutseho kuri uyu wa Kane mu kiganiro n’itangazamakuru, nyuma y’itahwa rya Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House, imwe mu nyubako yitezweho kuzajya yakira ba mukerarugendo bo ku rwego rwo hejuru, yubatse munsi y’Ikirunga cya Sabyinyo. Ni imwe mu nyubako izajya yakira abasura u Rwanda bashaka no gusura ingagi. Muri Gicurasi 2017 nibwo RDB yatangaje ko u Rwanda rwakubye kabiri igiciro cy’abajya gusura ingagi, kiva ku madolari 750 kigera ku 1500$ ku bantu bose kandi kigahita gitangira gukurikizwa. Hanashyizweho ko icyiciro gishya aho umuntu uzajya asura umuryango wose w’ingagi azajya yishyura 15 000$. Nyuma y’itangazwa ry’ibyo biciro, abantu bavuze byinshi ko Abanyarwanda batazajya babasha kwishyura ayo mafaranga, ariko baza gushyirirwaho gahunda zihariye zibafasha kwitegereza ibyiza igihugu cyabo gifite. Nyuma y’imyaka ibiri, Akamanzi avuga ko imibare y’abasura ingagi yagabanyutse, nubwo mu bijyanye n’amafaranga avamo, yo yazamutse. Yagize ati “Impamvu ni uko tuzi ko dufite ingagi, kandi ntabwo ari inyamaswa zihora zibyara buri gihe, bivuga ko tugomba kuzibungabunga neza cyane. Bivuze ko kugira ngo umuntu ashobore kubona ingagi, bigomba gusaba amafaranga menshi, kubera ko amafaranga naba make abantu benshi bazajya kuzireba kandi ntabwo ari byiza mu kuzibungabunga.” “Niyo mpamvu kugira ngo turebe ko abantu bake bashoboka ariko bashobora kwishyura, kugira ngo dushobore kubona ya mafaranga nubwo ari abantu bake bajyayo. Bivuze ko kuva igihe twongereye ibiciro by’ingagi, amafaranga tubona ubu ngubu aruta amafaranga twabonaga mbere yuko twongera igiciro no mu bihe ba mukerarugendo baba ari bake.” Akamanzi yavuze ko mu mwaka wa mbere ibiciro bimaze kuzamurwa, abantu basura ingagi bagabanyutse cyane ariko ubu batangiye kwiyongera ndetse n’amafaranga ubu aboneka mu basura ingagi yabaye menshi nubwo umubare w’abantu wagabanyutse, ariko ntiyatangaje umubare. Yakomeje ati “Umubare w’abantu bagura impushya ntabwo ari munini cyane nka kwa kundi ariko bigenda byiyongera, ariko nubwo amafaranga ari menshi kuko twakubye kabiri (ibiciro), ubu turashaka ko twakira ba mukerarugendo benshi bashoboka kuko nubwo bagenda biyongera, nitugurisha impushya zose tukarenza n’izo twagurishaga mbere, tuzabona amafaranga menshi kurusha ayo tubona ubu.” “Nubwo tutagurisha impushya zose twagurishaga mbere, amafaranga yariyongereye ariko n’umubare w’impushya tugurisha ugenda wiyongera. Bivuze ko nitugurisha impushya zose, amafaranga azaba menshi kurusha ayo tubona ubu ngubu. Icyo navuga ni uko icyemezo cyafashwe ngo twongere ibiciro cyari icyemezo cyiza nubwo abantu benshi bibazaga ibibazo byinshi ariko turareba ku mibare ko byabaye ibintu byiza.” Akamanzi yavuze ko u Rwanda rukeneye abantu 96 bashobora kureba ingagi ku munsi kuko rufite imiryango 12 y’ingagi zisurwa. Buri muryango uba ukeneye gusurwa n’abantu umunani ku munsi. Ingagi zo mu birunga ni nke ku Isi, hasigaye izigera kuri 880 gusa, u Rwanda rukagiramo 62% yazo. Muri Kamena 2016 zari 604 zivuye kuri 480 zabaruwe mu 2010. Guverinoma y’u Rwanda igenera abaturiye hafi ya za pariki 10% by’inyungu iva mu bukerarugendo. U Rwanda rufite intego yo kwinjiza miliyoni $800 avuye mu bukerarugendo mu 2024, mu gihe mu wa 2017 bwinjije miliyoni $438. Inkuru wasoma: U Rwanda rwazamuye ibiciro byo gusura ingagi mu birunga

title: Perezida Kagame yafunguye ku mugaragaro Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House (Amafoto)
content: Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House igizwe n’inyubako zigezweho zubatse mu Karere ka Musanze mu Murenge wa Nyange, ku birenge by’Ikirunga cya Sabyinyo, aho uba unitegeye ibirunga bya Gahinga na Muhabura. Perezida Kagame yavuze ko ari ibyishimo mu kwifatanya n’abandi muri iki gikorwa, ashimira Luke Bailes washinze Singita Group, ku murimo ukomeye amaze gukora kugeza ubwo ikigo cye gifunguye ibikorwa mu Rwanda. Ati “Iki ni igikorwa gikomeye ku kurengera ibidukikije muri Afurika n’iterambere ry’urwego rwo kwakira abantu kuri uyu mugabane.” Yavuze ko Singita ifite izina rikomeye mu bijyanye n’amahoteli, ku buryo u Rwanda rwishimiye kwakira iri zina mu yandi asanzwe mu gihugu. Yanashimye amahitamo y’ibikoresho byifashishijwe mu kuyubaka byavuye mu Rwanda, uburyo bwifashisha ingufu z’izuba bwahubatswe n’imbaraga zashyizwe mu kwita ku gace iyi nyubako iherereyemo. Yashimangiye ko kimwe na Singita, u Rwanda rushaka kwakira neza abarugana, aho gutanga serivisi nziza bigomba kuba ku isonga. Yakomeje ati “Ndanasaba abantu batuye hano gukora cyane kugira ngo bahuze n’ibikenewe n’iyi Lodge, kugira ngo bizajye bigurishwa hano.” Uwashinze Singita, Luke Bailes, yashimiye Perezida Kagame n’abandi bose batumye Singita ibasha gufungura inyubako mu Rwanda, bityo inzozi zayo zigahinduka impamo nyuma y’imyaka itanu y’imirimo inyuranye muri iki gihugu. Yakomeje ati “Dushimishijwe no kugira uruhare mu kurengera ibidukikije ndetse no gutanga umusanzu mu rwego rwo kwakira abantu mu Rwanda.” Umuyobozi w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere, RDB, Clare Akamanzi, yavuze ko u Rwanda rukomeje kwakira ba mukerarugendo batandukanye kandi bakeneye n’ibintu binyuranye, bityo Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House ari inyongera nziza ku byiza u Rwanda rufite bifasha ba mukerarugendo barusura. Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House yubatswe ahantu hahoze igishanga cyari urwuri, ariko ubu hashibutse umushinga ukomeye w’ubukerarugendo ugizwe n’inzu umunani zubatswe mu buryo zirengera ibidukikije. Zirimo zirindwi zagenewe umuntu umwe cyangwa uherekejwe kuko buri imwe ifite uburiri bumwe, uruganiriro rwagutse n’ibindi byangombwa nkenerwa, hakaba indi imwe yiswe Kataza House yo igizwe n’ibyumba bine byo kuraramo. Yubatswe n’ibikoresho byinshi byakorewe mu Rwanda, ibyinshi ni ibiboneka i Musanze birimo amakoro n’imigano. Ibiciro byaho byihagazeho nubwo bihindagurika bitewe n’ibihe, nk’uyu munsi uwakwifuza kuharara ari wenyine yakwishyura $1750 ku ijoro rimwe, uyavunje mu mafaranga y’u Rwanda nibura ni miliyoni 1.6 Frw, mu gihe abantu babiri bishyura $3500. Kurara muri Kataza House byo bishobora kugera ku 8000$ ku ijoro rimwe ku bantu babiri, barengaho bikaba $15 000 ku ijoro. Muri Singita Kwitonda kandi biteganywa ko iminsi mike umuntu ashobora kwemererwa kuhamara ari itatu. Muri icyo giciro haba hakubiyemo n’ibintu byose umuntu akenera mu ijoro, birimo ibyo kurya no kunywa byose bihaboneka. Singita Kwitonda Lodge yashoweho miliyoni $25. Nyuma yo gufungurwa kuri uyu wa Kane, biteganyijwe ko umuntu wa mbere muri benshi bamaze gusaba kuharara, azahagera ku wa 5 Kanama 2019, ni mu minsi itatu iri imbere. Inyubako ya Singita Lodge yahawe izina rya Kwitonda, yitiriwe ingagi y’ingabo yari izwiho ubwitonzi, yapfuye mu 2012 ifite imyaka 40, icyo gihe yabonetse itagihumeka nyuma y’iminsi yari ishize itakigaragara mu muryango wayo. Uyu mushinga wa Singita ni umwe mu izatuma u Rwanda rubasha kwesa umuhigo wo kwinjiza miliyoni $800 avuye mu bukerarugendo mu 2024, mu gihe mu wa 2017 bwinjije miliyoni $438. Singita ni izina risobanura ’ahantu h’ibitangaza’ mu rurimi rwa Shangaan rwo muri Afurika y’Epfo, ari naho iki kigo gikomoka. Cyatangiye ishoramari mu bukerarugendo mu 1993, gisanganwe izindi hotel zo mu bwoko bwa Lodge muri Tanzania (muri Grumeti Game Reserve na Lamai), muri Zimbabwe (Singita Pamushana Lodge) no muri Afurika y’Epfo (Singita Sweni Lodge na Singita Sabi Sand.) title: Icyerekezo cya Onomo, hoteli imaze umwaka ku isoko ry’u Rwanda- Ikiganiro na Nizey Emile uyiyobora
content: Onomo Hotel yubakishijwe imirimbo ijyanye na gakondo y’u Rwanda mu mitako y’imigongo, ibiseke n’ibishushanyo by’ubugeni bikoreshejwe amase avanze n’ibyondo biri mu mabara abereye guhangwa ijisho. Iyi hotel igenzurwa na ONOMO Hotels imaze kubaka izina muri Afurika, ishami ryayo rya Kigali riri muri 16 ifite kuri uyu mugabane. Onomo hotel ifite ibyumba 109 birimo 10 byigiye hejuru, iby’inama byakira abantu hagati ya 200-250, aho abantu bogera, parking n’ibindi. Mu gihe imaze ku isoko ry’u Rwanda, yakira ibikorwa bitandukanye n’inama zibera mu Mujyi wa Kigali nk’uburyo bwo gutanga umusanzu wayo mu iterambere rishingiye ku bukerarugendo. Kuva muri Nyakanga 2019, Onomo hotel yabonye umuyobozi mushya, Nizey Emile, ufite ubunararibonye mu by’amahoteli akesha ubumenyi yavanye mu Bwongereza no muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Nizey w’imyaka 37 yavukiye mu Rwanda ariko aba cyane mu bihugu by’i Burayi no muri Amerika. Ibijyanye n’amahoteli yabitangiye mu 2003 ari mu Bwongereza. Mu buhamya bwe yatangiye akora akazi gaciriritse muri hoteli. Mu 2008 yaje kwimukira muri Amerika ahakomereza ibijyanye n’amahoteli, ubu afite Impamyabushobozi y’Icyiciro cya Gatatu cya Kaminuza mu by’amahoteli yavanye muri Kaminuza ya Florida mu Mujyi wa Miami, yanahakuye iy’Icyiciro cya Kabiri cya Kaminuza mu  bijyanye n’Imari. Nizey yagiranye ikiganiro na IGIHE cyibanze ku cyerekezo cya Onomo Hotel n’imishinga ifite mu isoko ry’amahoteli mu Rwanda. IGIHE: Onomo Hotel ihagaze ite ku isoko rya serivisi zo kwakira abantu mu Rwanda? Nizey: Mu mahoteli tungana urebye n’igihe tumaze ku isoko, ubona ko tugeze ku rwego rwiza kandi  turimo guhatana mu byo dutanga, mu myaka ibiri cyangwa itatu  iri imbere tuzaba tugeze ku rwego rukomeye. IGIHE: Ni iki Onomo Hotel yihariye kiyitandukanya n’andi mahoteli? Nizey: Turi hoteli yibanda mu gukorana n’abanyabugeni n’abahanzi b’imbere mu gihugu. Ibi ni ibintu twashyizemo imbaraga, nureba muri hoteli uzasangamo ibintu by’ubugeni kandi byakorewe mu Rwanda, abanyamideli  na bo ni abantu tugomba gukorana na bo. Gahunda dufite ni uguteza imbere ibintu bikorerwa mu Rwanda ariko cyane cyane dushyira imbaraga ku banyabugeni. Ikindi navuga ni uko turi hoteli y’Abanyafurika, turi mpuzamahanga ariko muri twe dufite Afurika imbere, ni hoteli ifite icyicaro muri Maroc ariko ikorera n’ahandi muri Afurika. Izina Onomo ubwaryo rifite inkomoko muri Mali, andi mahoteli hano ubona ko ari ayo muri Amerika n’i Burayi ariko twe twazanye iryo tandukaniro. IGIHE: Murateganya kuzajya mukorana n’abahanzi mu buhe buryo? Nizey: Tuzajya tugira imurikabikorwa ry’abahanzi, noneho ONOMO ibe aho  abahanzi bose bumva ko bagomba gukorana nayo. Iyi ni gahunda nshya mfite nk’umuyobozi, tugomba kwegera abahanzi yaba amastudio, abakora iby’ubugeni bose bakerekana ibihangano byabo hano. Turashaka ko Onomo Hotel iba igicumbi cy’ubuhanzi Nyarwanda, turanashaka kuzahashyiraho ahantu bacururiza ibintu byabo kuko twabonye ko abanyamahanga benshi baba babishaka. IGIHE: Nk’umuyobozi mushya ni uruhe ruhare uzatanga mu guteza imbere serivisi za hoteli ? Nizey: Mfite ubumenyi buhagije mu by’amahoteli, iyo urebye iby’amahoteli mu Rwanda ubona ko byibanzwemo cyane n’abanyamahanga, gusa ni ibintu byumvikana kuko ni bishya mu gihugu kandi urebye ingufu u Rwanda rwashyize mu cyerekezo cyo kwakira abantu, hagombaga amahoteli mpuzamahanga kandi koko akeneye ubwo bumenyi. Nta Munyarwanda wakoze mu mahoteli mpuzamahanga igihe kirekire, njye rero nagize ayo amahirwe yo kuba narakoranye n’amahoteli nka Radisson, Hilton, Marriott n’andi. IGIHE: Muri Kamena 2020, u Rwanda ruzakira Inama ihuza Abakuru b’ibihugu na za Guverinonma bigize Umuryango w’Ibihugu bikoresha Icyongereza (CHOGM). Onomo Hotel yiteguye ite kwakira abayobozi? Nizey:  Nk’andi mahoteli yose hari ibirimo gukorwa kugira ngo twitegure, hari inama tuzagirana n’abafatanyabikorwa kandi twamaze kubona ubutumwa buva muri RDB na Rwanda Convention Bureau butubwira  iyo gahunda. Hari ibyo turimo guhindura bijyanye n’iyo nama ariko bigomba kuba ari ibintu bizamara igihe kirekire. IGIHE: Onomo Hotel ihagaze he mu bijyanye no guteza imbere ibikorerwa mu Rwanda? Nizey:  Twe dukoresha iby’iwacu kandi dufite n’akarusho kuko dufite akarima k’igikoni, Made in Rwanda itangirira iwacu. Ibyo dukoresha byinshi tubikura mu Rwanda, yego hari ibikiva hanze wenda tutaragira ubushobozi bwo gukorera mu Rwanda ariko ibyinshi dukoresha ibiva hano mu Rwanda. IGIHE: Mubona Abanyarwanda bitabira kujya mu mahoteli? Nizey: Icyo ni ikibazo kikidukomereye kuko Abanyarwanda benshi bumva ko aya mahoteli ari  ibintu by’ibitangaza, ariko biterwa n’umuco wacu wo kudakunda gusura ibintu nyaburanga byo mu Rwanda. Iyo hajemo amahoteli byo usanga ari ibindi, nzi abantu babona nka Marriott Hotel ariko ntibajyeyo kandi babishoboye. Simvuze ngo ibiciro byose abantu babishobora ariko reka dufate ikintu twese ducuruza mu Rwanda (Fanta), igiciro cyayo muri Onomo Hotel ni 1000 Frw; ibyo bituma abantu badakwiye kumva ko ari ahantu hatabagenewe. Ibyo nk’abanyamahoteli nitwe tugomba kubihindura. IGIHE: Ni ikihe cyerekezo cya Onomo Hotel? Nizey: Dufite abakozi kandi bafite ubumenyi buhagije, abo dufite bakoze mu  mahoteli akomeye barimo n’abafite ubumenyi burengeje imyaka itandatu mu kazi k’amahoteli. Intego yacu ni ugukomeza gutanga serivisi nziza ariko byaba na ngombwa tugafungura irindi shami rya Onomo Hotel mu Rwanda, icyo gihe bizagaragaza ko yateye imbere, turashaka ko aha haba ahantu Abanyarwanda biyumvamo. title: Intare zimaze kwikuba gatatu muri Pariki y’Igihugu y’Akagera kuva mu 2015
content: Imibare mishya y’ikigo African Parks gicunga iyi pariki, igaragaza ko mu mwaka ushize yasuwe n’abantu basaga 44,000, aho abasaga kimwe cya kabiri muri bo ari Abanyarwanda. Ibyo byanatumye yinjiza amafaranga agera kuri miliyoni $2, ari nabwo bwa mbere ageze kuri icyo gipimo mu mateka y’iyi pariki. Inyungu y’iyi pariki imaze kwiyongera hejuru ya 900 kuko yavuye ku $200,000 mu 2010, ku buryo iyi pariki igeze ku rwego nibura yihaza mu ngengo y’imari ku gipimo cya 75%. African Parks ikomeza iti “Nyuma y’imyaka y’imyiteguro, binyuze mu miyoborere myiza n’uburyo bwo kubahiriza amategeko, umwaka wa 2017 wasize amateka y’igarurwa ry’inkura 18 z’umukara nyuma y’imyaka 10 zihacitse, bigizwemo uruhare na Howard G. Buffett Foundation.” “Izindi Ntare ebyiri z’ingabo zongerewe muri Pariki y’Akagera mu 2017 kugira ngo zigire uruhare mu kororoka kwazo, ku buryo zimaze kwikuba gatatu kuva zagarurwamo mu 2015. Mu gihe ubu gushimuta inyamaswa byakumiriwe, inyamaswa z’ingenzi muri pariki zikomeje kororoka.” Pariki y’Igihugu y’Akagera ni yo ikuze kuruta izindi mu Rwanda, kuko yashinzwe ahagana mu 1934. Gusa mu myaka 25 ishize yendaga kuzimira kubera ibibazo birimo na Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, ariko aho amahoro yongeye gusagambira mu gihugu, hashyizwe imbaraga mu gusana iyi pariki, ihabwa ubwinyagamburiro bwa pariki n’inyamaswa zari zarashizemo zongera gushyirwamo. Mu 2010 nibwo ikigo African Parks kizobereye mu gucunga pariki zitandukanye cyeguriwe imicungire ya Pariki y’igihugu y’Akagera, ku bufatanye n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere, RDB. Mu 2015 nibwo iyi pariki yongeye gusubizwamo Intare, nyuma y’uko zaje guhigwa ndetse zikicwa ahagana mu 1990, ndetse mu mwaka wa mbere izi ntare zari zimaze kwikuba kabiri ubwo havukaga ibyana 11. Mu mwaka wa 2017 haje kongerwamo intare ebyiri z’ingabo zivuye muri Afurika y’Epfo, zirushaho kwiyongera. Ibyo byagiye bigendana no kuvugurura amategeko akumira abashimuta inyamaswa, hashyirwaho itsinda rishinzwe kubashakisha ryifashishije imbwa zatojwe, hanashyirwaho uruzitiro rwa kilometero 120 rurimo amashanyarazi akomoka ku zuba rutandukanya Pariki n’ubutaka bwagenwe nk’ubuhumekero bwayo. Hagamijwe kugabanya uguhura kw’abantu n’inyamaswa. Mu gushishikariza Abanyarwanda kurushaho gukunda ubukerarugendo, abanyeshuri bagera ku 1800 nibura basura iyi pariki buri mwaka hamwe n’abarimu babo. Ubu iyi pariki ni imwe mu zikomeye muri Afurika kuko ifite inyamazwa eshanu zifatwa nk’izikaze kurusha izindi kuri uyu mugabane, ari zo Inkura, Intare, Imbogo, Inzovu n’Ingwe.

title: Ramada, sosiyete ikomeye mu by’amahoteli ishobora kwinjira ku isoko ry’u Rwanda
content: Ramada ni yo sosiyete ikomeye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Abarabu mu bijyanye n’imicungire y’amahoteli, ariko igenzurwa n’indi yitwa Wyndham Hotels and Resorts. Kugeza mu Ukuboza 2018, yari ifite amahoteli 811 afite ibyumba 114,614 mu bihugu 63 zikora mu izina rya Ramada. Mu 2018 nibwo byatangiye kuvugwa ko Ramada iteganya gutangira ibikorwa mu Rwanda, igafungura hotel ifite ibyumba 154. Amakuru agera kuri IGIHE, ni uko hari ibiganiro byabayeho hagati y’abashinzwe ishoramari ry’amahoteli mu Rwanda n’iyi sosiyete harebwa uburyo yatangira gukorera mu Rwanda, gusa igihe izatangirira ntikiratangazwa. Kuva mu 2013, mu Rwanda hatangiye kwinjira amazina akomeye mu by’amahoteli bijyanye n’uko igihugu cyari gishyize imbere gushaka kuba igicumbi cy’inama. Abashoramari bakomeye mu by’amahoteli babengutse u Rwanda nk’icyerekezo cyiza cy’ubukerarugendo ntibazuyaza kuhagaba amashami. Aha twavuga Rezidor Hotel Group ifite Raddison blue, Hotel y’inyenyeri eshanu ifite ibyumba 292, ibyumba by’inama birimo icyakira abantu basaga 2500, ibiro byo gukoreramo n’ibindi. Ikigo Marriot Hotels International gifite Kigali Marriot Hotel iri ku rwego rw’inyenyeri eshanu, ari na yo Marriot ya mbere yubatswe mu bihugu byo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara. Ifite amagorofa atanu, ibyumba 254 byo kuraramo, ikaba ishobora gucumbikira abantu bagera kuri 320, ibyumba 10 byo gukoreramo inama kuva ku byakira abantu 50 kugera kuri 650, na parikingi y’imyanya 120. Hari kandi Park Inn by Radisson nayo ya Rezidor Hotel Group, hoteli y’inyenyeri enye iherereye mu Kiyovu ahahoze Hotel Kiyovu, ifite ibyumba 161, birimo iby’inama, uburiro n’ibindi; ikagira akabyiniro, ubwogero, ahaparikwa imodoka, aho gukorera imyitozo ngororamubiri, sauna n’ibindi bigezweho. Hari n’ikigo gikomeye Hilton Hotels and Resorts cyitegura kugura Hoteli Ubumwe Grande iherereye hagati mu Mujyi wa Kigali, ikazahita ihindura izina ikitwa DoubleTree by Hilton Kigali City Centre, ndetse n’umubare w’ibyumba byayo ukazamuka bikarenga 153. Ikigo gikomeye mu by’amahoteli muri Afurika, Protea Hotels Group, gifite umushinga wo kubaka hoteli ikomeye mu Karere ka Rusizi ‘Protea Kivu Marina Resort Hotel’. Andi mazina akomeye y’amahoteli ari mu Rwanda ni nka Golden Tulip, Onomo Hotel, Serena Group of Hotels, Marasa, One&Only na Swiss International Hotels & Resort imenyerewe i Burayi, Aziya na Amerika.

title: Ibikorwa byo gusura ikiraro cyo mu bushorishori bwa Nyungwe byasubukuwe
content: Muri Gicurasi uyu mwaka nibwo  Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere, RDB, cyatangaje ko ikiraro kinyura hejuru y’ishyamba muri Pariki y’Igihugu ya Nyungwe kizwi nka ‘Canopy walkway’ kigiye kumara iminsi kidakoreshwa na ba mukerarugendo bayisura kubera imirimo yo kugisana. Kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki 9 Nyakanga 2019, Pariki ya Nyungwe ibinyujije kuri Twitter yatangaje ko imirimo yo gusura icyo kiraro yasubukuwe. Bagize bati “Tunejejwe no kubamenyesha ko imirimo yo gusana yarangiye, kuri ubu ikiraro kirafunguye kuri bamukerarugendo.” Canopy Walkway ni ikiraro cyubatse mu kirere muri Nyungwe gifasha ba mukerarugendo kwitegereza no kureba ibyiza nyaburanga birimo ibiti, inyoni, inyamaswa, ibimera n’ibindi binyabuzima biri muri iyo pariki. Iki kiraro cyubatswe mu 2010 mu gihe cy’amezi umunani. Cyubatswe n’abubatsi baturuka muri Canada bafatanyije n’abo muri Brésil. Ni ikiraro kireshya na metero 70 z’ubutumburuke (kuva hasi kugera hejuru) na metero 150 z’uburebure. Cyubatswe mu byuma n’imigozi y’imirunga ikomeye. Ni icya mbere mu Karere ka Afurika y’Uburasirazuba, kikaba icya gatatu muri Afurika nyuma y’icyo muri Ghana na Nigeria. Abagisura bagenda ari ikipe y’abantu batarenze umunani mu itsinda bagera aho kirangirira abandi bakaza gutyo gutyo bagakomeza kugisura mu matsinda mu rwego rwo kugifata neza. Pariki ya Nyungwe ni ishyamba cyimeza ry’inzitane rimaze igihe kirekire muri Afurika nzima, amoko 13 y’inyamaswa zo mu bwoko bw’inguge n’amoko asaga 300 y’inyoni agaragaramo, bikurura ba mukerarugendo. Iyi pariki ifite umwihariko wo kuba ariho hari amasoko y’inzuzi nini muri Afurika. Harimo isoko y’uruzi rwa Nil mu burasirazuba n’iy’uruzi rwa Congo mu Burengerazuba. Imibare ya RDB igaragaza ko Pariki ya Nyungwe yinjije amadolari 534,821 mu mwaka wa 2017 nyuma yo gusurwa na ba mukerarugendo 13,941.

title: Abanyarwanda 100 bafite imyaka 25 bahawe amahirwe yo gusura ingagi ku buntu
content: RDB yatanze aya mahirwe mu gihe hizihizwa imyaka 25 ishize igihugu kibohowe ubutegetsi bwaryanishije abaturage, bikageza kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, yahitanye ubuzima bw’inzirakarengane zirenga miliyoni. Ni igikorwa kijyanye na gahunda ngarukamwaka ya “Tembera u Rwanda”, igamije gushishikariza Abanyarwanda by’umwihariko gukangukira gusura ibyiza nyaburanga bigize igihugu cyabo. Pariki y’Ibirunga ibamo ingagi zo mu misozi ni imwe mu zikurura ba mukerarugendo benshi bagana u Rwanda. Mu gufasha Abanyarwanda gukomeza kwizihirwa n’ibirori byo Kwibohora, RDB yatanze amahirwe ku bantu 100 bafite imyaka 25 azatuma basura ibirunga. Mu butumwa yanyujije ku rukuta rwayo rwa Twitter, RDB yanditse ko “Waba ufite imyaka 25 cyangwa ukaba uzayuzuza muri uyu mwaka?  Mu gihe twishimira imyaka 25 ishize twibohoye, twageneye Abanyarwanda 100 bujuje imyaka 25, amahirwe adasanzwe yo gusura ingagi zo mu Birunga.’’ Ni amahirwe akomeye kubera ko ubusanzwe kugira ngo umuntu asure ingagi bimusaba kwishyura $1500 ku muntu umwe, ni ukuvuga asaga miliyoni 1,3 Frw. Ukwibohora k’u Rwanda ntikwaruzaniye gusa iterambere n’amahoro ahubwo byanagize uruhare mu kubungabunga umutungo kamere w’igihugu. Ibi byatumye ubukerarugendo bwaguka cyane mu Rwanda ndetse Guverinoma yiyemeje ko izabusaruramo miliyoni $ 800 mu 2024, zivuye kuri miliyoni $ 438 mu 2017. Igikorwa cya Tembera u Rwanda kigamije gushishikariza Abanyarwanda by’umwihariko gukangukira gusura ibyiza nyaburanga bigize igihugu no kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Ni gute waba umunyamahirwe? Buri wese wujuje imyaka 25 mu 2019 ashobora gusura ishami rya RDB rimwegereye, agahabwa inyandiko yo kuzuza. Abanyamahirwe 50 ni bo bazatoranywa mu gihe abandi bazagenwa hifashishijwe imbuga nkoranyambaga za Twitter na Facebook. Ku bakoresha Twitter, basabwa kuvuga umuntu wujuje imyaka 25 bakandika ubutumwa bwihariye, bakabuherekesha ifoto n’izina rye; bakanongeraho hashtag #TemberaURwanda25 #Kwibohora25 bakongeraho @visitrwanda_now. Abazatsinda bazahabwa amahirwe yo guherekezwa n’umuntu umwe bazahitamo. Irushanwa rizasozwa ku wa 20 Nyakanga 2019. RDB ni yo izishyura urugendo rwerekeza muri Pariki y’Igihugu y’Ibirunga ruteganyijwe mu Ukuboza 2019. Ibarura ryakozwe mu 2010 ryagaragaje ko mu Birunga hari ingagi 480 zivuye kuri 285 zari zihari mu 1978. Muri izo ngagi, 65 % ziba mu Rwanda. Kuva mu 2003 kugeza mu 2010, ingagi zo mu birunga ziyongereye ku kigero cya 26.3 %. Are you 25 or turning 25 this year? title: Amafoto y’Inkura eshanu u Rwanda rwahawe ubwo zagezwaga muri Pariki y’Akagera
content: Izi nkura zagejejwe ku Kibuga Mpuzamahanga cya Kigali i Kanombe mu rukerera rwo ku wa 24 Kamena 2019, zahavanwe zerekezwa muri Pariki y’Igihugu y’Akagera aho zashyizwe mu biraro ngo zimenyerezwe ikirere cyaho. Zoherejwe mu Rwanda ku bufatanye bw’Ishyirahamwe ry’u Burayi rishinzwe ibijyanye n’ahororerwa inyamaswa, EAZA; Guverinoma y’u Rwanda n’Umuryango Nyafurika urengera urusobe rw’Ibinyabuzima, African Parks. Izi nkura zirimo ebyiri z’ingabo n’eshatu z’ingore, zitezweho kongera umubare w’izi nyamaswa zimaze gukendera muri Afurika. Ziri hagati y’imyaka ibiri n’icyenda. Harimo izavukiye muri Safari Park Dvůr Králové muri Tchèque zitwa Jasiri, Jasmina na Manny. Iyitwa Olmoti yaturutse muri Flamingo Land mu Bwongereza naho iyitwa Mandela ituruka muri Ree Park Safari muri Denmark. Izi nkura zoherejwe mu Rwanda nk’impano yahawe Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB). Nyuma y’urugendo rw’amasaha 30 mu kirere kuva muri Tchèque kugera i Kigali, izo nkura zashyizwe mu modoka zijyanwa muri Pariki y’Akagera, aho zageze zigashyirwa mu biraro byazo ndetse zigahita zitangira kugaburirwa. Mu muhango wo kuzakira, Umuyobozi Mukuru wa RDB, Clare Akamanzi, yavuze ko biteze kubona inyungu iziturutseho. Yagize ati “Ubuzima n’imibereho myiza y’inkura ni ingenzi mu kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, haba mu Rwanda no muri Afurika.’’ Yongeyeho ko bituma Pariki y’Akagera iba imwe mu zikomeye mu Karere zifite inyamaswa eshanu nini zikunze gukurura ba mukerarugendo, yizeza ko izi nkura zizamera neza muri iyo pariki. Ati “Ba mukerarugendo basura Pariki y’Igihugu y’Akagera bazanogerwa no kwihera ijisho inkura zizaba ziri mu kiraro cyazo.’’ Umuyobozi w’Ishyirahamwe ry’u Burayi rishinzwe ibijyanye n’ahororerwa Inyamaswa, EAZA, Dr. Thomas Kauffels, na we yashimangiye ko “Ibiraro bigezweho ni ingenzi mu kubungabunga ubutaka ndetse imikoranire yacu na Pariki y’Igihugu y’Akagera igaragaza uko byagira uruhare mu kubungabunga no kugarura inyamaswa zakendereye mu byanya birinzwe.’’ Mu myaka ishize Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ifatanyije n’Ikigo gishinzwe Imicungire ya Pariki y’Akagera yashyize imbaraga mu kubungabunga iyi pariki n’ibinyabuzima biyirimo. Intambwe ya mbere yatewe mu 2015, yari iyo kugarura Intare zirindwi zavanywe muri Afurika y’Epfo nyuma yo kumara imyaka 20 nta n’imwe irangwa mu Rwanda. Muri Gicurasi 2017, kandi nibwo Inkura z’Umukara 18 zagejejwe muri Pariki y’Igihugu y’Akagera zivanywe muri Afurika y’Epfo [binyuze mu mushinga uterwa inkunga na Howard G. Buffett Foundation] nyuma y’uko zahaherukaga mu myaka 10. Izi nkura zimaze kuba 20 zimeze neza. Inkura z’Umukara ziri gusubizwa muri Pariki y’Akagera aho izari zirimo zose zishwe mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ku Isi hasigaye Inkura z’Umukara zigera ku 1000. Pariki y’Akagera iherereye mu Ntara y’Iburasirazuba, ifite ubuso bungana na kilometero kare 1 122, irimo inyamaswa zizwi nka ‘Big Five’ ari zo Intare, Inkura, Inzovu, Ingwe n’Imbogo. Mu 2018 yasuwe na ba mukerarugendo 44,000, muri bo 50% ni Abanyarwanda. Muri uwo mwaka kandi iyi pariki yinjije miliyoni $2, ni ukuvuga amafaranga y’u Rwanda arenga miliyari imwe na miliyoni 800.
