title: Nyanza: Inzira z’Ubukerarugendo gakondo zahawe icyangombwa cyo mu rwego rwa mbere (Amafoto)
content:
Ni igikorwa cyabaye kuri uyu wa Gatatu ubwo izo nzira zafungurwaga ku mugaragaro zihabwa n’amanota bitewe n’imiterere yazo igaragaza ibyiza ndangamateka na nyaburanga. Cyitabiriwe n’abayobozi barimo Minisitiri w’Urubyiruko n’Umuco, Mbabazi Rosemary; Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ingoro z’Igihugu z’Umurage w’u Rwanda, Amb. Masozera Robert; Guverineri w’Intara y’Amajyepfo, Gasana Emmanuel na Perezida w’ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku kugenda n’amaguru mu gihugu cy’u Budage, Klaus Eber, n’abandi. Amanota yatanzwe  n’abarimo inzobere mu bukerarugendo akaba na Perezida w’ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku kugenda n’amaguru mu gihugu cy’u Budage, Klaus Eber. Izo nzira zitwa Nyanza Cultural Trials ni  eshatu zitandukanye ariko zuzuzanya. Iya mbere yitwa ‘Royal Trail’ ifite kilometero 10 izenguruka Umujyi wa Nyanza igakikiza Ingoro z’Umurage ebyiri zihari ari zo Ingoro y’Abami mu Rukari n’Ingoro y’Umurage wo kwigira iherereye ku Rwesero ahahoze hatuye Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa. Iyo nzira kandi inyura ahari ibindi byiza biranga amateka y’u Rwanda mu Karere ka Nyanza nk’Umusezero w’Abami i Mwima hatabarijwe Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa tariki ya 28 Nyakanga 1959; Umwami Kigeli V watabarijwe ku ya 15 Mutarama 2017 ndetse n’Umwamikazi Gicanda Rosalie wahatabarijwe tariki ya 20 Mata 1995. Inzira ya kabiri yitwa ‘Big View’ y’ibirometero umunani ituruka mu Mujyi wa Nyanza ikagera ku musozi wa Remera. Iyo uri kuri uwo musozi wa Remera uba ushobora kureba ku ntera y’umurambararo wa kilometero 50. Ubasha kureba imisozi itandukanye ikikije Nyanza ndetse waterera amaso kure ukaba wabona ibindi bice by’u Rwanda birimo n’ibirunga biri mu Majyaruguru y’igihugu. Inzira ya gatatu yitwa ‘Gatagara Trail’ y’ibiromtero 12 ituruka mu Mujyi wa Nyanza ikagenda ikikiza ibishanga ikagera i Gatagara ahari ibikorwa by’ububumbyi biteye imbere ndetse n’ikigo cyita ku bafite ubumuga. Klaus Eber yavuze ko bamaze iminsi basura izo nzira baziha n’amanota ariko basanze zifite umwihariko ugeranyije n’izo mu bihugu by’i Burayi. Ati “Abantu benshi bakora ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku kugenda n’amaguru bakunda inzira zirimo ibyerekezo bishushanyije birimo n’amakuru  atandukanye. Rero nishimiye kubamenyesha ko izi nzira zo mu Karere ka Nyanza zujuje ibyo byose.” Yasobanuye ko mu gutanga icyangombwa hari byinshi bishingirwaho birimo ibyerekezo n’ibindi byiza nyaburanga n’ibiranga amateka bikabafasha kugenda bishimye batarambirwa. Yavuze ko kimwe mu byahesheje amanota menshi inzira zo mu Karere ka Nyanza ari amateka y’Ubwami ahaboneka. Yasobanuye ko ubusanzwe batanga amanota bakurikije ukuntu ahantu hagenda hahinduka kuko abagira amanota menshi baba bafite byibura  ahantu hagera kuri 50 muri izo nzira hatandukanye. Ati “Ni ukuvuga ngo ukagenda  ukava mu ishyamba ukagera mu mirima ihinzemo imyaka, ukagera mu mibaya, mu misozi, mu bisiza, muri kaburimbo, ahatuye abantu, ahadatuwe n’ahandi. Uko guhindagurika kw’ahantu ni ko gutuma inzira zigira amanota meza.” Yakomeje avuga ko inzira zo mu Karere ka Nyanza bazisuzumye basanga zifite ahantu hagera kuri 75 hatandukanye kandi hari ibyiza byinshi bishimisha abazinyuramo. Ati “Twe twaje gusanga inzira za hano zifite ahantu 75; ni igipimo kirenze ibindi byose. Ntewe ishema n’uko u Rwanda rugeze kuri icyo gipimo cyo hejuru; mwabonye amanota 75.” Klaus Eber yavuze ko ku mugabane w’u Burayi aho izo nzira zimaze igihe;  izo mu rwego rwa mbere ziba zifite amanota 60 ariko hari iyo mu Budage ifite amanota 80. Yavuze ko ari igikorwa gikomeye gikwiriye kubyazwa umusaruro kigafasha igihugu mu iterambere. Asobanura inzego zitandukanye izo nzira ziba zirimo yavuze ko hari urwa mbere rwo hejuru ruba rwitwa ‘Premium’ ari narwo izo mu Karere ka Nyanza bazishyizemo. Ati “Ubu ku Isi hose cyane cyane mu Burayi hari izigera kuri 600 zo muri urwo rwego rwa premium.” Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ingoro z’Igihugu z’Umurage w’u Rwanda, Amb. Masozera Robert, yavuze ko  bishimiye amanota babonye bityo nyuma yo gutangiza izo nzira ku mugaragaro hagiye gukurikira ibikorwa byo kuzimenyekanisha no kuzibyaza umusaruro. Ati “Izi nzira eshatu zimaze gutangizwa zagiye ku rwego mpuzamahanga; ubu hagiye gukurikiraho kuzimenyekanisha kugira ngo zimenyerwe; abantu bakora mu bukerarugendo batangire bazicuruze bazimenyakanishe.” Amb. Masozera yavuze ko usibye izo nzira eshatu hari izindi enye zizatangira gukorwa guhera umwaka utaha. Bamwe mu baturage bitabiriye igikorwa cyo gutaha izo nzira banifatanya n’abayobozi gukora urugendo rwa kilometero 10 mu nzira yitwa ‘Royal Trail’ bavuze ko bazishimiye cyane. Dusabimana Francine waturutse mu Mujyi wa Kigali ati “Icyanshimishije ni ibintu nabonye bitandukanye birimo utuyira twiza tuzamuka n’utumanuka imisozi; mbese ntabwo umuntu ashobora gucika intege ngo ananirwe.  Nabonye Ingoro  z’Abami ni ubwa mbere nari mpageze byanshimishije kuhabona.” Hari bamwe batangiye kubibyaza umusaruro
 Bamwe mu baturage batangiye ibikorwa byo kubyaza umusaruro ubwo bukerarugendo bushingiye ku kugenda n’amaguru aho bakora ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi kuri izo nzira. Umusore witwa Nsanzintwari Augustin wo mu Murenge wa Busasamana yatangiye gucuruza inkoni abantu bashobora kwicumba bazamuka imisozi ndetse n’ingofero zishobora kubakingira izuba. Ati “Hari ba mukerarugendo bahora baza hano mu Rukari gusura bagakenera inkoni zo kwicumba cyangwa ingofero zo kwambara.” Minisitiri w’Urubyiruko n’Umuco, Mbabazi Rosemary, yasabye abaturage bo mu Karere ka Nyanza kubyaza umusaruro ubwo bukerarugendo. Yavuze ko ubukerarugendo ari ikintu u Rwanda rwiyemeje gushyiramo imbaraga ruganisha ku murage n’umuco w’Abanyarwanda. Ati “Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika yifuza ko Intara y’Amajyepfo iba igicumbi cy’umuco n’umurage wacu. Iyi nzira yose ugakomeza ukagera muri Nyungwe hari byinshi cyane bigize amateka yacu  n’umurage wacu dushobora kubyaza umusaruro kandi n’abato bakabimenya bagakura babizi” Yasabye ubufatanye bw’Akarere ka Nyanza, abari mu bukerarugendo n’abikorera gukora ibikorwa bihabyaza umusaruro mwiza. Ati “Mumenyekanishe hano hantu ibikorwa bihari baze babisure bahamare umwanya munini bahasige amadevize n’abaturage bacu batere imbere kurushaho.” Yagiriye inama abaturage yo gucuruza inkoni, ibyo kwitwikira, ibyo umuntu yakwihanaguza icyuya, amazi, imitako n’ibindi bishobora gukenerwa na ba mukerarugendo banyura muri izo nzira. Yasabye abasanzwe batanga serivise z’amafunguro kwagura ibikorwa no kunoza ibyo bakora ku buryo nta mukerarugendo uzasohoka i Nyanza  ngo ajye gushaka icyo kurya cyangwa icyo kunywa ahandi. Ati “Abanyabugeni, abanyabukorikori n’abatanga serivise mwumve ko ari amahirwe tugomba kubyaza umusaruro.” Abitabiriye urugendo rwo gutangiza izo nzira ku mugaragaro kuri uyu wa gatatu babarirwa mu bantu 400 barimo n’abanyamahanga. Icyangombwa inzira z’i Nyanza zahawe kimara imyaka itatu, nyuma yayo nibwo hongera gutangwa ikindi.

title: Uko byagenze ngo amasezerano y’u Rwanda na PSG agerweho
content: Bamwe babanje gukeka ko ari ’Fake News’, abandi babanza kujijinganya kuko batiyumvishaga ko byashoboka cyangwa se koko ko byari byabaye, muri macye u Rwanda rwongeye gutungurana rusinyana amasezerano y’imikoranire na Paris Saint Germain, ikipe rurangiza muri ruhago yo mu Bufaransa, imwe ikinamo Neymar na Mbappe. Gutungurana k’u Rwanda ko kumaze kuba akarande kuko rimwe bucya hatangijwe uruganda ruteranya imodoka, ejo ukumva ngo hatangijwe uruteranya izikoreshwa n’amashanyarazi, ubundi ngo hatangijwe urwa telefone, cyangwa se ngo amaraso n’imiti bisigaye bigemurwa ku mavuriro hifashishijwe drones. Buri munsi ucyana ayawo. Kuri ubu inkuru yamaze kuba kimomo ni uko PSG igiye kujya yamamaza urwa Gasabo binyuze mu gikorwa cyo kureshya ba mukerarugendo kizwi nka ’Visit Rwanda" ku buryo guhera kuri uyu wa Gatatu ku mukino PSG iri buze kwakiraho Nantes, hari butangire ubufatanye bw’u Rwanda n’iyi kipe, aho ’Visit Rwanda’ iza kugaragara bwa mbere ku myenda abakinnyi bari buze kuba bambaye bishyushya. Kugira ngo ubu bufatanye bugerweho, byanyuze mu nzira ndende ariko itagoye na busa, kubera amakarita yakinwaga. Nta bwana na seti zasakiranaga. Ni ngombwa ko ubanza ugasobanukirwa ba nyir’iyi PSG n’uko mu myaka itarenze icumi imaze kuba ubukombe mu Burayi. Iyi kipe si iya kera cyane kuko yashinzwe mu 1970 ariko igira amahirwe yo kuba ba  nyirayo Guy Crescent, Pierre-Étienne Guyot na Henri Patrelle bari abagwizatunga bakomeye. Ubuhangange bwayo bwakajije umurego ubwo yagurwaga n’abanyemari bo muri Qatar, Qatar Sports Investments, mu 2011. Iyi Sosiyete yashinzwe mu 2005 ifite icyicaro gikuru i Doha muri Qatar, ishora imari mu bikorwa by’imyidagaduro na siporo. Perezida wa QSi ni nawe wa PSG, Nasser Ghanim Al-Khelaifi. Nubwo ari Sosiyete y’ishoramari ikora mu buryo bwigenga, ishingiye kuri leta ya Qatar, bituma iyi kipe ari imwe muri ebyiri zonyine ku Isi zifite ba nyirazo bashingiye kuri leta; yo na Manchester City. Aba baherwe bayishoyemo imari ifatika, ihera mu gihugu imbere yigarurira ibikombe byose byari bimaze imyaka n’imyaniko bitwarwa na Lyon. Mu gushaka kwigarurira u Burayi, Al-Khelaifi, yashyize ingufu mu gutuma iyi kipe iba ikirangirire, igura buri mukinnyi wese ukomeye ku Isi ariko w’icyamamare ku buryo byayifunguriye imiryango henshi. Uhereye kuri David Beckham, Zlatan Ibrahimovich, Kylian Mbappé, kugera kuri Neymar Jr uhenze ku Isi kugeza ubu. Amakuru yizewe agera kuri IGIHE, ni uko kugira ngo ubufatanye bwa PSG n’u Rwanda bubeho mu bijyanye no kuba iyi kipe yakwamamaza ibikorerwa mu Rwanda n’ubukerarugendo bwarwo, byaturutse ndetse byoroshywa n’umubano usanzwe hagati y’u Rwanda na Qatar. Uyu mubano umaze igihe kinini ni wo watumye Emir wa Qatar, Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, aza mu Rwanda muri Mata uyu mwaka ndetse anasura Pariki y’Akagera ari kumwe na Perezida Kagame mu mvura yagwaga icyo gihe. Icyo gihe kandi hasinywe amasezerano mu ngeri enye arimo ajyanye n’imikoranire mu rwego rw’umuco, muri siporo, mu bukerarugendo n’ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi ndetse n’ibijyanye n’ingendo zo mu kirere. Bivugwa ko ibiganiro na PSG byoroshye biturutse kuri uyu mubano ndetse bikomezanya umuvuduko nyuma y’uko uyu muyobozi yari avuye mu Rwanda. Igikomeye muri byose ni uko nubwo QSi iyoborwa na Al-Khelaifi ari nawe Perezida wa PSG, iyi sosiyete yashinzwe na Emir wa Qatar;  byumvikanisha uburyo u Rwanda rwisanze mu biganiro mu buryo bworoshye. Ikindi ni uko umwe mu bantu batumye QSi igura PSG, ni Nicolas Sarkozy wayoboye u Bufaransa, ubu akaba ari inshuti ikomeye y’u Rwanda ndetse afasha abashoramari bashaka kurugana. Ubu bufatanye bw’u Rwanda na PSG butandukanye n’ubwo u Rwanda rusanzwe rufitanye na Arsenal, ariko bufite akamaro kanini urebye mu cyerekezo cy’igihugu. Kuba u Rwanda rushaka kugaragariza amahanga ibyiza byarwo, hamwe mu hantu rwari ruhanze amaso ni ku isoko ry’u Bufaransa, by’umwihariko mu Mujyi wa Paris, ufatwa nk’Umurwa Mukuru w’Isi mu by’umuco. Ibyamamare hafi ya byose by’Isi bifata Paris nk’Umujyi w’ubukerarugendo, imideli n’ibindi; inkengero za Paris nko mu Mujyi wa Cannes ni ahantu handitse amateka mu bya Sinema. Ibi byose byanatumye mu mikoranire na PSG hitswa cyane ku kugaragaza u Rwanda mu isura yindi y’umuco, hakanatezwa imbere ibikorerwa mu gihugu nk’imideli, icyayi, ikawa n’ibindi. Ikindi kigaragaza isura yihariye y’iyi mikoranire na PSG ni ishoramari riri gushyirwa mu ngeri zibanzweho muri aya masezerano cyane cyane umuco n’imyidagaduro. Uru rwego cyane rujyanye n’imyidagaduro n’ubundi Abafaransa bari batangiye kuruyoboka mu Rwanda bigaragazwa n’ishoramari rya miliyoni $40Vivendi ibarizwamo Canal+ yiyemeje gushyira muri Kigali Cultural Village ku musozi wa Rebero. Gusa igitangaje kandi cyiza muri byose ni uburyo guhera umwaka utaha, icyayi cy’u Rwanda n’ikawa aribyo byonyine bizajya bicuruzwa kuri Parc de Princes, stade ya PSG, biha amahirwe abahinzi n’inganda gutera imbere kurushaho no kubona isoko rishya. Kuki u Rwanda rwamamaje ku myenda yo mu myitozo n’iyo mu kwishyushya mbere y’umukino? Amakuru avuga ko u Rwanda rwifuzaga kuba rwagirana amasezerano n’iyi kipe ku buryo Visit Rwanda yamamazwa ku myenda ikipe ikinana, ariko ntibyakunda kubera abandi baterankunga kandi bakomeye PSG ifite. PSG magingo aya ifite abaterankunga bagera kuri 30. Ab’imena ni babiri aribo Nike iyambika na Sosiyete y’amahoteli ya Accor. Zombi zamamazwa ku mupira imbere aho agaciro k’amasezerano n’izi sosiyete kabarirwa muri miliyoni 165 z’amadolari. Byonyine amasezerano iyi kipe yagiranye na Accor bivugwa ko ari “mu  masezerano ane meza mu Burayi” aho ku mwaka agaciro kayo kagera muri miliyoni 50 z’amadolari. Arsenal ubusanzwe yamamaza u Rwanda binyuze ku gushyira ijambo Visit Rwanda ku kuboko kw’ibumoso kw’imyenda iyi kipe ikinana muri shampiyona. Aha hantu ku mwenda wa PSG hafitwe na Banki y’Igihugu muri Qatar (Qatar National Bank) nayo itanga amafaranga menshi, ikanarenzaho guha amasezerano abakinnyi barimo nka Neymar ngo bayamamaze ku giti cyabo. Iyi banki niyo yahaye PSG inguzanyo y’amafaranga yifashishijwe mu kugura Neymar, aho ayamutanzweho abarirwa muri miliyoni 222 z’amadolari ya Amerika. Mu mugongo naho hafitwe n’abanya-Qatar, Ooredoo, sosiyete ikora ibijyanye n’itumanaho. Ibi nibyo byatumye u Rwanda rwashakaga kugaragara muri Paris rushaka ubundi buryo hakorwa amasezerano y’imikoranire ndetse hanashyirwamo ingingo nyinshi zirugaragaza mu buryo budasanzwe ndetse ubirebye neza bwihariye kurusha ubwa Arsenal. Itandukaniro ni uko amasezerano ya Arsenal agaragaza u Rwanda ku rwego rw’Isi yose ariko inyungu yayo ntihite igera ku muturage wo hasi ako kanya, mu gihe aya PSG akora ku buzima bw’umuhinzi wo mu Kitabi uri mu murima w’icyayi. Umwe mu basesenguye aya masezerano waganiriye na IGIHE yagize ati “Aya Arsenal yagejeje u Rwanda ku rwego ruhambaye bidasanzwe, atandukanye n’aya, gusa icyiza kuri aya ni uko inyungu igera ku muntu ako kanya.” Ibi bishingirwa ku kuba guhera umwaka utaha w’imikino, ubu bufatanye bw’u Rwanda na PSG, buteganya ko icyayi cy’u Rwanda n’ikawa aribyo byonyine bizajya bitangwa kuri Parc des Princes. Ushinzwe itangazamakuru n’itumanaho mu Kigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe guteza imbere ibyoherezwa mu mahanga bikomoka ku buhinzi n’ubworozi, NAEB, Pie Ntwari, yabwiye IGIHE ko aha abahinzi indi mpamvu yo kongera umusaruro. Ati “Iyo tubonye isoko ryiyongera ku yo dufite biba ari byiza. Igishimishije ubu ni uko ari twe twenyine tuzaba twemerewe gucuruzamo [muri stade] icyayi n’ikawa. Twiteze ko amadevize yinjiraga aziyongera. Ikindi abahinzi babonye indi mpamvu yo kongera umusaruro n’ubwiza ku bwinshi. Twiteze isoko ridahungabana mu gihe cy’imyaka itatu.” Hazabaho kandi icyumweru cy’imishinga y’abanyempano b’abanyarwanda n’Abafaransa. Icyo cyumweru cyiswe “Semaine du Rwanda à Paris” kizajya gitegurwa na PSG mu kumenyekanisha ibintu byose bikorerwa mu Rwanda. Ibi byiyongera ku mikoranire hagati y’abakora mu ruganda rw’imideli izatangizwa mu mezi ari imbere. Mu bijyanye no kuzamura impano z’u Rwanda, PSG izagira uruhare mu kuzamura abakiri bato binyuze mu gushinga ishuri ry’umupira w’amaguru i Kigali, aho iyi kipe izajya itegura imyitozo y’abatoza n’abakiri bato mu kubafasha kugira ubunararibonye bw’iyi kipe ikomeye ku mugabane w’u Burayi, by’umwihariko yanditse amateka mu Bufaransa. 🆕✍🌄 @visitrwanda_now#ThisIsRwanda #VisitRwanda #MadeInRwanda pic.twitter.com/ojsRJsZOWN — Paris Saint-Germain (@PSG_inside) December 4, 2019 Inkuru bifitanye isano: Paris Saint Germain yiyongereye kuri Arsenal mu kwamamaza Visit Rwanda

title: Paris Saint Germain yiyongereye kuri Arsenal mu kwamamaza Visit Rwanda
content: RDB yatangaje ko ubu bufatanye buzafasha abakurikiran PSG n’isi muri rusange kumenya ubwiza bw’u Rwanda, umuco ndetse n’udushya twaruhangwamo kimwe n’ibicuruzwa bigezweho birukorerwamo, bya ’Made in Rwanda.’ Ubu bufatanye kandi bwitezweho kurushaho gufungurira amarembo abashoramari bo mu Bufaransa no mu bindi bice by’Isi ku buryo babyaza umusaruro amahirwe aboneka mu Rwanda. U Rwanda rwiteze ko binyuze muri ubu bufatanye, abakinnyi b’ikipe ya PSG n’ibindi byamamare mpuzamahanga, bizabafasha gusura u Rwanda, bakabona ibyiza bitatse igihugu cy’imisozi igihumbi uhereye ku bijyanye n’ubugeni, umuco, siporo, muzika, ubukerarugendo, amafunguro n’ubwiza bw’igihugu muri rusange. Ibi bihe ntagereranywa bizajya bisangizwa abakurikira PSG ku mbuga nkoranyambaga zayo barenga miliyoni 70 bari hirya no hino ku Isi. Muri ubu bufatanye, ikirango cya Visit Rwanda kizajya kigaragazwa kuri Stade ya Parc des Princes aho PSG yakirira imikino yayo ndetse no ku mugongo ku myenda iyi kipe ikoresha mu myitozo no mu gihe cyo kwishyushya mbere y’imikino, yaba iyo yambara yasuye indi kipe cyangwa iyo yambara iwayo muri Shampiyona y’u Bufaransa, Ligue 1. Guhera umwaka utaha w’imikino, ubu bufatanye buteganya ko icyayi cy’u Rwanda n’ikawa aribyo byonyine bizajya bitangwa kuri Parc des Princes. Hazabaho kandi icyumweru cy’imishinga y’abanyempano b’abanyarwanda n’Abafaransa. Icyo cyumweru cyiswe “Semaine du Rwanda à Paris”  kizajya gitegurwa na PSG mu kumenyekanisha ibintu byose bikorerwa mu Rwanda. Ibi byiyongera ku mikoranire hagati y’abakora mu ruganda rw’imideli izatangizwa mu mezi ari imbere. Mu bijyanye no kuzamura impano z’u Rwanda, PSG izagira uruhare mu kuzamura abakiri bato binyuze mu gushinga ishuri ry’umupira w’amaguru i Kigali, aho iyi kipe izajya itegura imyitozo y’abatoza n’abakiri bato mu kubafasha kugira ubunararibonye bw’iyi kipe ikomeye ku mugabane w’u Burayi, by’umwihariko yanditse amateka mu Bufaransa. U Rwanda rwiteze ko binyuze muri ubu bufatanye na PSG, urugendo rw’iterambere rumazemo imyaka irenze 20 ruzarushaho gufata indi ntera kandi rukihuta kurushaho. Nk’igihugu kiri gutera imbere muri Afurika mu bijyanye n’ubukungu, aho bwiyongera ku kigero 8.5%, rwiteze ko ruzabasha kuba igihugu cya kabiri muri Afurika mu koroshya ubucuruzi. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa RDB, Clare Akamanzi, yatangaje ko amafaranga yashowe muri ubu bufatanye ari igice gito cy’inyungu n’ubusanzwe iva mu bukerarugendo. Ati “Dushora ku nyungu iva mu bukerarugendo bwacu mu bufaranye nk’ubu bwa Paris Saint-Germain kuko twumva neza ibyiza bizana ku isura rusange y’igihugu ku Isi hose.” “Ibi bisobanuye ko kureshya abashoramari, kongera ingufu mu bijyanye n’ibyoherezwa mu mahanga muri gahunda ya Made in Rwanda, kurema amahirwe mashya y’ubukungu ku baturage bacu no kongera imirimo mu bijyanye n’ubukerarugendo. Uyu munsi abanyarwanda 142000 bafite akazi mu bukerarugendo, bageze kuri uwo mubare bavuye ku 90000 bariho mu 2017.” Yakomeje avuga ko umwaka ushize u Rwanda rwakiriye ba mukerarugendo bagera kuri miliyoni 1,7 ndetse rwiteze ko uyu mubare wiyongera kurushaho muri uyu mwaka. Ikindi cyiyongera kuri ibyo ni uko rwanditse ishoramari rya miliyari ebyiri z’amadolari aho byitezwe ko ubu bufatanye buzazamura ishoramari kurushaho. Bivugwa ko aya masezerano y’u Rwanda na PSG yaba afite agaciro kari hagati ya miliyoni umunani n’icumi z’ama-euro gusa nta muntu n’umwe wo muri RDB wigeze wemeza ko ari ukuri. 🆕✍🌄 @visitrwanda_now#ThisIsRwanda #VisitRwanda #MadeInRwanda pic.twitter.com/ojsRJsZOWN — Paris Saint-Germain (@PSG_inside) December 4, 2019

title: Inzira z’Ubukerarugendo gakondo zitezweho gukuba kabiri umubare w’abasura i Nyanza
content: Byatangajwe kuri uyu wa Gatandatu mu muganda rusange aho hakozwe ibikorwa by’isuku muri imwe muri izo nzira iherereye mu Murenge wa Busasamana. Hasobanuwe ko izo nzira ziswe ‘The Nyanza Cultural Trials’ ari eshatu zitandukanye ariko zuzuzanya. Iya mbere yitwa ‘Royal Trail’ ifite kilometero 10 izenguruka Umujyi wa Nyanza igakikiza Ingoro z’Umurage ebyiri zihari ari zo Ingoro y’Abami mu Rukari n’Ingoro y’Umurage wo kwigira iherereye ku Rwesero ahahoze hatuye Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa. Iyo nzira kandi izanyura ahari ibindi byiza biranga amateka y’u Rwanda mu Karere ka Nyanza nk’Umusezero w’Abami i Mwima hatabarijwe Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa tariki ya 28 Nyakanga 1959; Umwami Kigeli V watabarijwe ku ya 15 Mutarama 2017 ndetse n’Umwamikazi Gicanda Rosalie wahatabarijwe tariki ya 20 Mata 1995. Inzira ya kabiri yitwa ‘Big View’ y’ibirometero umunani ituruka mu Mujyi wa Nyanza ikagera ku musozi wa Remera. Iyo uri kuri uwo musozi wa Remera uba ushobora kureba ku ntera y’umurambararo wa kilometero 50. Ubasha kureba imisozi itandukanye ikikije Nyanza ndetse waterera amaso kure ukaba wabona ibindi bice by’u Rwanda birimo n’ibirunga biri mu Majyaruguru y’igihugu. Inzira ya gatatu yitwa ‘Gatagara Trail’ y’ibiromtero  12 ituruka mu Mujyi wa Nyanza ikagenda ikikiza ibishanga ikagera  i Gatagara ahari ibikorwa by’ububumbyi biteye imbere ndetse n’ikigo cyita ku bafite ubumuga. Izo nzira zose uko ari eshatu zifite umwihariko w’uko ari utuyira twa Kinyarwanda tunyura mu misozi, ibibaya aho abantu batunyuramo bagenda bareba ahantu hateye indabyo, ahahinze imyaka  itandukanye, ahatuwe, urutoki n’ibindi byiza bitandukanye bihaboneka. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ingoro z’Igihugu z’Umurage w’u Rwanda, Amb. Masozera Robert, yavuze ko izo nzira ziyongera ku bindi byiza biranga amateka mu Karere ka Nyanza bigatuma ba mukerarugendo bahasura biyongera. Ati “Twazanye ubundi bwoko bw’ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku kugenda n’amaguru baciye muri izi nzira gakondo za Kinyarwanda. Ni ukuvuga ngo abo bantu nibajya baza aho kugira ngo bamare amasaha abiri nibura bazajya bamara iminsi itatu cyangwa barenzeho kandi uko batinda ni ko bituzanira inyungu yo kudusigira amafaranga.” Amb. Masozera yashimiye abaturage bitabiriye umuganda rusange wo gukora isuku muri izo nzira, abararikira kuzaza  kuzitaha ku mugaragaro tariki ya 4 Ukuboza 2019. Ati “Ni igikorwa gikomeye cyane kizatuma hano i Nyanza cya cyifuzo mwari mufite cy’uko haba igicumbi cy’umuco kiba impamo. Dutekereza ko izo nzira zizatuma abantu basura Nyanza bava ku bihumbi 70 nibura bakagera ku bihumbi 150 ku mwaka.” Amb. Masozera yasobanuye ko inzobere mu bijyanye n’ubwo bukerarugendo zimaze iminsi zisura izo nzira ari nako zitanga amanota hakaba hari icyizere ko zizaza mu za mbere nziza 1 000 ziri ku Isi. Muri izo nzira bagiye bashyiraho ibyapa byerekana ibyerekezo ariko abazajya bazinyuramo hari ubwo bazajya bakenera ababasobanurira amateka y’uduce dutandukanye duhari. Umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe iterambere ry’ubukungu mu Karere ka Nyanza, Kajyambere Patrick, yasabye abaturage kwirinda kongera kumena imyanda hafi y’izo nzira. Yabibukije ko bagomba kugira isuku muri byose, buri rugo rukagira aho  kujugunya imyanda habugenewe ntibongere kuyishyira aho babonye. Ati “Nahoze mbona umwanda wari uri hano muri iyi nzira; umuntu arava mu rugo akaza kumena ibishingwe hano cyangwa akagajugunya ibishishwa by’ibitoki kubera ko atumvaga agaciro k’iyi nzira.” Bamwe mu baturage bo mu Karere ka Nyanza bawiye IGIHE ko nyuma yo kumenya agaciro k’izo nzira bagiye kuzitaho ku buryo hatazongera kugaragara umwanda. Mukankunzi Jeannette ati “Twishimiye ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo bikomeje kwiyongera hano iwacu; izo nzira ntabwo zizongera kugaragaramo umwanda kuko buri wese agiye kuba ijisho rya mugenzi we ku buryo nta muntu uzongera kuza kuhamena imyanda.” Kalisa JMV nawe yavuze ko bishimiye ubusobanuro bahawe ku bijyanye n’izo nzira kandi yumvise  bizagirira akamaro Akarere kabo ka Nyanza. Akarere ka Nyanza kabumbatiye amateka menshi yiganjemo ayo hambere kuko Nyanza yabaye Umurwa Mukuru w’Ubwami kuva mu 1899 kugeza mu mu 1962 I Nyanza hahoze ari Umurwa w’Ubwami kuko hatuwe n’Abami bane ari bo Kigeli IV Rwabugiri wari utuye ku misozi ya Mwima na Mushirarungu; Yuhi IV Musinga watuye i Mwima na Gakenyeri; Mutara III Rudahigwa watuye mu Rukali ndetse n’Umwami Kigeli V Ndahindurwa watuye i Busasamana. Muri nyanza kandi haboneka Amariba ya Mutende yafukuwe ku ngoma y’Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa, aho Inyambo ze ndetse n’inka z’abaturage ziturutse imihanda yose zashokaga. Hari kandi Icyuzi cya Nyamagana cyafukujwe n’Umwami Mutara III Rudahigwa afatanyije n’agoronome w’Umubiligi witwaga Dubois. I Nyanza kandi hafatwa nk’igicumbi cy’ubutabera kuko hahoze urukiko umwami yaciragamo imanza. [email protected]

title: Burera: Inkomoko y’izina ry’agasantere kiswe  Kidaho
content: Inkomoko y’iri zina nk’uko abasaza n’abakecuru bahatuye babisobanura ngo ryaturutse ku kuba harabaga ibigega byinshi bahunikagamo imyaka itandukanye babaga bejeje,  uwabaga yifuza kudahamo imyaka ngo ntibyamusabaga kunama ahubwo yayidahaga ahagaze kubera ko byahoraga byuzuye. Mu myaka ya 1975  na 1992 abahinzi bo muri aka gace ngo bakundaga kweza cyane  ibinyampeke birimo amasaka, ingano, uburo, babisarura bakabihunika mu bigega binini babaga bafite, aho wasangaga urujya n’uruza rw’abadahamo, ari naho hakomotse izina “ Kidaho” Gakwandi Jonas w’imyaka 68 ni umwe mu basaza basobanura iby’iri zina, aho yemeza ko ryakomotse ku bigega byinshi bahunikagamo imyaka. Ati “ Aha uko uhabona mu myaka ya mbere ya Jenoside muri  za 75 kuzamura, twezaga imyaka myinshi cyane, tukagira ibigega binini cyane twayihunikagamo, iyo umuntu yifuzaga kujya kudahamo imyaka ntibyamusabaga kunama kuko byahoraga byuzuye, ari naho havuye Kidaho, ariko aho iterambere ryaziye dusigaye duhinga kijyambere tukagurisha ubundi tugahunika amafaranga mu ma Banki” Nyirabirahure Donatille w’imyaka 58 na we yagize  ati “ Twagiraga ibigega binini n’ibindi bitaga imitiba twahunikagamo imyaka twabaga twejeje. Uwabaga yahinze amasaka akajya kuguranisha ku wahinze ingano gutyo, ari naho Kidaho yavuye, ubu ntibikibaho tureza tukagurisha ubundi tukazigama kuri Konti”. Abatuye muri ako gasantere bakomeza bavuga ko n’ubwo bezaga cyane bagahunika bahuraga n’ibihombo by’uko imyaka yabo hari ubwo yangirikaga bitewe no kumara igihe kinini mu bigega, ariko aho iterambere ryahagereye, bigishijwe guhinga kijyambere bakeza byinshi nyuma ubwizigame bwabo aho kujya mu bigega bakizigamira ku bigo by’imari n’ubucuruzi. Umukozi w’Umurenge wa Kagogo ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage,  Nsengamungu Sabin, yavuze  ko aka gasantere kamaze kugeramo ibikorwa byinshi by’amajyambere ugereranyije n’igihe cyashize. Ati “Aka gasantere cyera nta terambere ryari rihari, nta muriro, nta bikorwa by’ubucuruzi, hari inyubako za nyakatsi, ariko ubu byose byarahageze, ntibacyeza imyaka ngo bahunike mu bigega  nk’uko cyera byari, ahubwo bayijyana ku masoko kuko arahari ubundi bakamenya kwizigamira mu mabanki.” Kuri ubu aka gasantere ka Kidaho kazwi nanone nka  Cyanika, hari ibikorwa byinshi by’amajyambere ubucuruzi, amashuri, n’ibindi, aho abaturage baho bakora ahanini ubuhinzi, bibanda ku buhinzi bw’ibirayi, ibigori n’ibishyimbo.

title: Inyubako za mbere mu Rwanda zakira ba mukerarugendo zihenze kurusha izindi (Amafoto)
content: Ubwo Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yarangiraga, u Rwanda rwari igihugu cyangiritse, abanyamahanga baragitereranye ndetse nta bikorwa bifatika rufite, kugeza ubwo filime yiswe Hotel Rwanda yajyaga gukinwa, hagafatwa icyemezo ko ikinirwa muri Afurika y’Epfo ku mpamvu zirimo ko mu Rwanda hatari hari hoteli zakwakira ibyamamare nka Don Cheadle uyigaragaramo. Burya si buno! Ibintu byarahindutse, ubu muri hoteli eshanu z’inyenyeri eshanu zibarirwa mu rwa Gasabo, ebyiri ziri hanze y’Umurwa Mukuru Kigali. Izo ni One & Only Nyungwe House yo muri Pariki y’Igihugu ya Nyungwe na Bisate Eco Lodge yo mu Karere ka Musanze yashyizwe kuri urwo rwego ku wa 1 Ugushyingo 2019. Kugeza ubu hoteli z’inyenyereri eshanu ziyongera kuri izo ni Radisson Blu Hotel & Convention Centre, Kigali Serena Hotel na Kigali Marriott Hotel. Ni intambwe zikomeye zizatuma u Rwanda rubasha kugera ku rwego rwo kwinjiza nibura miliyoni 800 z’amadolari ya Amerika mu 2024, ahwanye na miliyari 760 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Twagerageje kwegeranya hoteli za mbere mu Rwanda zihenze, nubwo ibiciro byazo bihindagurika bitewe n’ibihe, ni ukuvuga niba ari mu mezi ajyanye n’ubukeraryugendo cyangwa mu gihe abasura igihugu baba ari bake. Haniyongeraho ko mu kugena igiciro hitabwa ku gihe umuntu azamara muri hoteli runaka. Ntabwo bivuze ko uburyo zikurikirana hano ari bwo buryo ntakuka. Kugira ngo wumve neza iyi nkuru, birasaba ko wifashisha Calculatrice, hanyuma idolari rimwe riri kuri 925 Frw ugendeye ku ivunjisha rya Banki Nkuru y’Igihugu. 1. Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House Singita yatashywe ku wa 1 Kanama 2019 na Perezida Paul Kagame aherekejwe na Madamu Jeannette Kagame. Ni inyubako yo ku rwego rwo hejuru yakira ba mukerarugendo nabo bo ku rwego nk’urwo, yubatswe mu Karere ka Musanze ku birenge by’Ikirunga cya Sabyinyo, aho uba unitegeye ibirunga bya Gahinga na Muhabura. Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House yubatswe mu gishanga cyari urwuri, ariko ubu hashibutse umushinga ukomeye w’ubukerarugendo ugizwe n’inzu umunani zubatswe mu buryo zirengera ibidukikije. Zirimo zirindwi zagenewe umuntu umwe cyangwa uherekejwe kuko buri imwe ifite uburiri bumwe, uruganiriro rwagutse n’ibindi byangombwa nkenerwa, hakaba indi imwe yiswe Kataza House yo igizwe n’ibyumba bine byo kuraramo. Yubatswe n’ibikoresho byinshi byakorewe mu Rwanda, ibyinshi ni ibiboneka i Musanze birimo amakoro n’imigano, itwara miliyoni $25. Ibiciro byaho byihagazeho nubwo bihindagurika bitewe n’ibihe by’ubukerarugendo nk’uko twabivuze. Nk’ubu kuva ku wa 1 Ugushyingo kugeza ku wa 19 Ukuboza, icyumba gishobora kuraramo abantu babiri cyishyurwa $1495 ku muntu ku ijoro, mu gihe mu mpeshyi aba ari $1750. Muri iyi minsi kandi icyumba kibamo ibitanda bibiri kirimo kwishyurwa $4 485, mu gihe ubusanzwe aba ari $5250 hagati y’umuntu umwe na batatu, hakwiyongeraho undi umwe bikajyana n’inyongera ya $1495 mu minsi nk’iyi cyangwa $1750 mu bihe by’ubukerarugendo. Kurara muri Kataza House yo ishobora kwakira abantu umunani ubu ni $6877 mu gihe ubusanzwe aba ari $8050 ku ijoro rimwe ku bantu hagati y’umwe na bane, hagira uwiyongeraho bikajyana n’izamuka rya $1495 cyangwa $1750 bitewe n’ibihe. Muri icyo giciro haba hakubiyemo n’ibintu byose umuntu akenera mu ijoro, birimo ibyo kurya no kunywa byose bihaboneka. 2.	One&Only Gorilla’s Nest Mu kwezi gushize nibwo inkuru yabaye kimomo ko nyuma ya hoteli igezweho imaze igihe muri Pariki y’Igihugu ya Nyungwe, One & Only Resorts yibarutse irindi shami mu karere ka Musanze, ryitezweho kuzajya ryakira ba mukerarugendo basura ingagi. One&Only Gorilla’s Nest yubatswe mu Kinigi mu ishyamba ry’inturusu, ahantu hitegeye ibyiza by’ibirunga by’u Rwanda. Yubatswe mu biti mo hagati ku buryo buri nzu iteretse ku byuma bishinze, aho nibura bibarwa ko inzu imwe yagiye itwara miliyoni imwe y’amadolari ngo yubakwe. Kugeza ubu kuharara byihagazeho kuko nka Forest lodge irimo ibitanda bibiri, kuyiraramo ijoro rimwe ari $3,825 ni ukuvuga nibura miliyoni 3.5 Frw; Forest Lodge King ni $3,060 ni ukuvuga asaga miliyoni 2,8 Frw; Virunga Suite ni $4,760 ni ukuvuga miliyoni 4,3 Frw naho Ingagi suite ni $5,900, nibura ni miliyoni 5,4 Frw. 3.	Radisson Blu Hotel Muri Nyakanga 2016 nibwo Perezida Paul Kagame yafunguye ku mugaragaro inyubako ya Radisson Blu and Kigali Convention Centre, ahamya ko ari intsinzi y’Abanyarwanda kuko bananiwe kenshi kuyuzuza kubera ubushobozi buke, ariko ntibacike intege bikarangira bayujuje. Iyi nyubako yubatse mu birometero bitanu uvuye ku kibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga cya Kigali, mu Murenge wa Kimihurura ku buso bungana na hegitari 12,6. Kigali Convention Centre igizwe na Hotel y’inyenyeri eshanu ifite ibyumba 292, icyumba cy’inama cyakira abantu basaga 2500, ibiro byo gukoreramo n’ibindi. Inyubako zirimo zifite agaciro ka miliyoni 300 z’amadolari abarirwa muri miliyari 223 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Iyo ukigera ku rubuga rwayo wakirizwa ubutumwa ko ushobora kurara muri iyi nyubako itagira uko isa guhera ku $265.50 Ayo madolari agenda azamuka ukagera kuri Junior Suite ifite ibaraza, ikakwemera kugira aho wakirira abashyitsi ugahabwa n’ifunguro rya mu gitondo ku madolari $690.00 kugeza kuri Suite yo iguha ibyo ukeneye byose (Terrace & Lounge Access-Breakfast) yishyurwa $ 3,540. 4.	Kigali Marriott Hotel Mu 2016 nibwo u Rwanda rwahaye ikaze Marriott Hotel, hoteli y’inyenyeri eshanu igizwe n’ibyumba 254 birimo n’icyo ku rwego rw’abaperezida. Niyo hoteli yayo ya kabiri yari ifunguwe ku mugabane wa Afurika nyuma y’iri mu Misiri. Kuharara byihagazeho, kuko uwagiyemo nko ku wa Mbere agasohokamo kuri uyu wa Kabiri ku mafaranga make byamusabye kwishyura $210, yakenera kujya mu cyumba cyo ku rwego rwo hejuru akishyura $3,500 kandi ku ijoro rimwe gusa. Muri rusange iyi hoteli igizwe n’inyubako umunani zigerekeranye, ikagira ibyumba  229 n’icyo twagereranya n’inzu mu yindi cyangwa suite 25, ziri mu rwego rwo hejuru ku buryo umuntu aba yisanzuye, afite ibyangombwa nkenerwa byose imbere ye. Ifite kandi ahantu 14 hatandukanye hashobora kubera inama. 5.	Bisate Lodge Iyi ni indi nyubako ya Wilderness Safari yubatswe muri Pariki y’Igihugu y’Ibirunga. Bisate ifite ibyumba bitandatu buri kimwe kiri ukwacyo, bishobora kwakira abantu byaba mu buryo bw’umuntu ukeneye kurara wenyine, kurarana n’undi cyangwa guhabwa ibitanda bibiri. Kuharara umuntu yishyura bitewe n’ibihe ndetse no kuba aherekejwe cyangwa ari wenyine. Nk’urugero uwajya kurara muri Bisate Logde muri aya mezi hagati ya tariki 16 Ukuboza 2019 na tariki 29 Gashyantare 2020, byamusaba kwitwaza US$1654. Gusa ashobora no kugabanuka ku mpamvu zitandukanye. 6.	Kigali Serena Hotel Kigali Serena Hotel ni imwe muri hotel zigezweho kandi zifite amazina amaze igihe mu Rwanda, ndetse ho ibiciro byayo iyo ufunguye urubuga rwayo ubisoma mu mafaranga y’u Rwanda. Nibura icyumba gihera ku 215 855 Frw ; hakwiyongeramo ifunguro rya mu gitondo bikaba 246 784 Frw. Ni amadolari ya Amerika asaga $230. Bigenda bizamuka mu biciro bitewe n’imiterere y’icyumba n’ibijyana nacyo, wagera ku byumba byo mu rwego rw hejuru (Junior suite & Suite) ukishyura hagati ya 895 891 Frw na 1.087.018 Frw, ni ukuvuga agera mu madolari ya Amerika $1170. 7.	One and Only Nyungwe House  One & Only Nyungwe House ni hotel iteye amabengeza yubatswe mu nkengero za Pariki y’Igihugu ya Nyungwe. Iyi hoteli iri rwagati mu mirima y’icyayi ya Gisakura yongeye gufungurira bose amarembo tariki ya 1 Ukwakira 2018, nyuma yo kuvugururwa no kwagurwa. Yubatswe mu 2010 ku bufatanye na Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ihabwa izina rya Nyungwe Forest Lodge, rihinduka mu 2017 nyuma y’uko yeguriwe One & Only Nature Resorts. Hotel za One & Only Nature Resorts zifite umwihariko wo kuba mu gihe zubakwa, hazirikanwa ku kurengera ibidukikije n’urundi rusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Ibyumba byayo uko ari 22 bigaragaza ubwiza bw’imitako igaragaza umuco nyarwanda, bituma uwabirayemo abasha kwisobanurira no kurushaho kwegerana n’u Rwanda atabanje kugira uwo asobanuza. Serivisi zo ku rwego rwo hejuru One&Only itanga kandi zinihagazeho kuko ibyumba byabo byishyurwa guhera ku madolari 595 mu ijoro rimwe. Hari kandi n’ikindi cyumba cyagutse (Two-Bedroom Forest Suite), gifite uruganiriro n’aho gufatira amafunguro, kandi kiri ahantu uba witegeye ibyiza bitatse ishyamba rya Nyungwe. Iki cyumba gishobora kwakira abantu bane, kiri mu byumba by’amahoteli bihenze cyane mu Rwanda, kuko cyishyurwa 2 288$. 8.	Amakoro Songa Lodge Amakoro Songa Lodge ni indi nyubako yiyubashye yakira ba mukerarugendo, iherereye mu Kinigi mu Karere ka Musanze. Ni inyubako ziri ahantu hatuje, ku buryo igihe wasuye ingagi mu birunga cyangwa wagiyeyo kuruhuka, hagufasha gusubiza ubwenge ku gihe ukunga ubumwe n’ibvidukikije. Kurara muri izi nyubako nabyo byihagazeho, kuko bisaba kwishyura nibura $1200 ku ijoro rimwe, ndetse hari n’aho wishyura $1500 ku ijoro. Ni inyubako y’akataraboneka ibereye buri wese uri mu kwezi kwa buki. Amakoro Songa Lodge kandi yahawe ubushobozi butuma nk’ababyeyi bafite abana, babona ikibuga gihagije cyo kwidagaduriraho. 9.	The Bishop’s House  The Bishop’s House ni inyubako itazwi na benshi ariko yihagazeho, yubatswe mu Karere ka Musanze gafatwa nk’irembo ry’ubukeraugendo bwo ku rwego rwo hejuru mu Rwanda, kuko ari iwabo w’Ingagi ziba mu birunga. Uyirebeye inyuma si inyubako y’igitangaza kuko yubatswe mu buryo bwakoreshwaga mu gihe cy’ubukoloni, ariko itanga serivisi zikomeye ndetse n’ibikorwa biyigize birihariye. Ifite ibyumba icyenda byakira ba mukerarugendo. Ibyo bituma nk’icyumba cyayo kinini kuruta ibindi  (executive suite), kukiraramo bisaba umuntu kwishyura $1200 ku ijoro, Deluxe room ikishyurwa $800 ku ijoro naho ibyumba binini bishobora no kujyamo ibitanda bibiri bikishyurwa $700. 10.	Magashi Camp  Iyi ni indi nyubako igezweho yubatswe mu Majyaruguru ya Pariki y’Igihugu y’Akagera, aho uba witegeye ikiyaga cya Rwanyakazinga. Ni hamwe mu hakundwa na ba mukerarugendo banyuranye, baba bajyanwe no gusura inyamaswa ziboneka muri Pariki y’Igihugu y’Akagera cyangwa kureba inyoni z’amoko arenga 520. Magashi yifashishije amahema atandatu, yubatswe n’ikigo Wilderness Safaris itahwa muri Gicurasi 2019. Ibiciro byayo byihagazeho kuko kuharara ijoro rimwe, nko mu ihema abantu bashobora gusangira, muri aya mezi akunze gukorerwamo ubukerarugendo kuva ku wa 16 Ukuboza 2019 kugeza ku wa 29 Gashyantare, ni amadolari US$650 ku ijoro. 11. Ruzizi Tented Lodge Ni inyubo igezweho ikoreshwa cyane n’abashaka gukambika muri Pariki y’Igihugu y’Akagera, aho umuntu aba yitegeye neza ikiyaga cya Ihema. Igizwe n’amahema icyenda ateye neza mu biti bituma hahora umuyaga utagira uko usa. Ishobora kwakira abashyitsi 20 kandi buri hema rikagira ubushobozi bwo gutanga amazi ashyushye n’akonje ku muntu uyakeneye, ikagira umwihariko wo kuba ikoresha ingufu zikomoka ku mirasire y’izuba. Mu mezi atarimo ubukerarugendo ku rwego rwo hejuru nko kuva ku wa 1 Werurwe kugeza ku wa 30 Gicurasi ndetse no kuva ku wa 1 Ukwakira kugeza ku wa 14 Ugushyingo, umunyamahanga ushaka kuharara, ku ihema rigari abantu bashobora kuraranamo bishyura $195 ku ijoro, umuntu umwe akishyura $265, ihema abana bashobora kuraranamo bakishyura $95 mu gihe ihema ryiyubashye ryishyurwa $280. Naho mu bihe bibereye ubukerarugendo, umunyamahanga muri Ruzizi yishyura $235 ku ihema ryagutse (Double tent) abantu bashobora kuraranamo, umuntu umwe akishyura $325, aho abana bashobora kurarana bakishyura $115 naho icyumba cyisumbuyeho kikishyurwa $335. Ibi biciro biragabanuka iyo ari ku banyarwanda cyangwa abanyamahanga bafite ibyemezo byo gutura no gukorera mu Rwanda. title: Impamvu u Rwanda rwatoranyijwe kwakira isozwa ry’imurika ry’Ingoro Ndangamurage muri Afurika
content: FAVT ni imurika rizasorezwa mu Rwanda nyuma yo kuzenguruka ibindi bihugu bya Afurika n’ibyo ku yindi migabane bibarizwamo Abanyafurika benshi. Ryashyizwemo ibihangano bitandukanye by’abahanzi n’abanyabugeni bazwi muri Afurika no mu Rwanda birimo bishushanya urugendo rw’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge no gukira ibikomere nka zimwe mu nsanganyamatsiko zatanzwe ku banyabugeni bashushanyije. Imurika ryanyuze mu bihugu birimo Kenya, Afurika y’Epfo, Brazil, Zimbabwe, Namibia, Burkina Faso, Cuba, Uganda mbere yo kugera mu Rwanda. Umuyobozi w’Ingoro y’Umurage yitiriwe Richard Kandt, Rusaro Utamuriza Carine, yavuze ko mu gukusanya ibyamuritswe habajijwe abantu batandukanye barimo abahanzi, abashakashatsi n’abandi icyo batekereza ku hazaza. Iri murika riri mu Ngoro yo kwa Richard Kandt, ririmo ibihangano by’ubwoko butandukanye, amajwi y’abantu babajijwe yumvikana mu cyumba cyabugenewe ndetse hari n’ahantu ushobora kwicara ukitekerezaho, ukibaza ku hazaza hawe. Yakomeje ati “Iri murika ridahoraho ni ryiza cyane ku bashyitsi badusura, mu buzima hari ibyo udatekereza ariko aha ufata umwanya ugatekereza ku byo wakora. Rizafasha abantu kumenya umuco w’u Rwanda.” Ni imurika ryitezweho kongera umubare w’amafaranga yinjizwa n’Ingoro Ndangamurage yitiwe Kandt avuye kuri miliyoni 3-4 Frw ya buri kwezi no kuzamura abasura bakarenga 1500. Umuyobozi wa Goethe Institute Kigali, Katharina Hey, yavuze ko iri murika rizasorezwa mu Rwanda kuko ari igihugu gihagaze neza. Ati “Kigali ni icyitegererezo kuri Afurika, iterambere ry’igihugu riha u Rwanda umwanya wihariye utuma rwibandwaho ku Isi yose n’i Burayi. Twatekereje ko hano mu mutima wa Afurika ari ahantu habereye gusorezwa imurika ririmo Abanyafurika.’’ Yakomeje ati “Uburyo iri murika rikorwa byerekana ko abantu bashobora kugaragaza ibitekerezo byabo mu buryo butandukanye bufasha ababireba kugerwaho n’ubutumwa.’’ Mu Rwanda imurika ryahaye umwihariko kwibuka no gukira ibikomere nk’ingingo y’ingenzi ku muryango Nyarwanda.  Yakomeje ati “Ni uburyo bwo gutekereza ku hahise hagoye urema ahazaza heza. Hari ibindi bihugu twanyuzemo aho twavuze ku bijyanye n’ubukoloni n’ibindi’’ Umunyabugeni Uwase Christa ufite ibihangano bitatu muri iri murika yavuze ko kuba byaratoranyijwe ari ishema kuri we. Ati “Nibanze ku nsanganyamatsiko ivuga ku kwibuka no gukira ibikomere. Nahisemo gukira kuko ari ikintu tudakunze kuvuga, mu Rwanda hari Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, kuri njye numva ari icya ngombwa cyo kuganirwaho ngo twitegure kutajyana bya bikomere mu gihe kiri imbere. Uyu munyabugeni ubimazemo imyaka itanu avuga ko kuganira ku byabaye mu Rwanda bituma abantu bakira ibikomere bityo bigafasha ko habaho kwiyubaka no gutera imbere. Abahanzi bafite ibihangano muri FAVT barimo Mizero Cedric,  Chris Schwagga, Crista Uwase, Uwayo  Ingrid, Lilian Magodi,  Moses Serubibi, John Kamicha, Sam Hopkins, Rui Assubuj, Sylowia Kyambi n’abandi. FAVT ni imurika ryatangiye mu 2015, mu Rwanda ryateguwe ku bufatanye bw’Ikigo cy’Ingoro z’Igihugu z’Umurage w’u Rwanda (INMR), Goethe Institute na Kaminuza yo mu Budage ya Bayreuth. title: Inyamaswa ziri muri Pariki y’Akagera zageze ku bihumbi 13
content: Kubarura inyamaswa ziri muri iyi pariki byatangiye gukorwa mu 2010 mu ibarura rikorwa buri myaka ibiri. Uyu mwaka ryakozwe hifashijwe indege ya kajugujugu yo mu bwoko bwa AS350 B3 yagenzuye ibice byose bya Pariki. Imibare itangazwa na Pariki y’Akagera igaragaza ko raporo y’ibarura yerekanye inyamaswa zose ziri muri iyi pariki ari 13500 aho bigaragara ko ziyongereye zikava ku 12000 zabarurwaga mu 2017. Iyi pariki ni imwe mu zisurwa cyane mu Rwanda aho umubare munini wa ba mukerarugendo bayigana  ari  abanyarwanda bihariye 50% by’abayisura bose. Mu mwaka ushize yasuwe n’abantu 44000. Aba bayisuye bayinjirije amadorali miliyoni ebyiri ni ukuvuga amafaranga y’u Rwanda arenga miliyari imwe na miliyoni 800. Parike y’Igihugu y’Akagera iherereye mu Ntara y’Iburasirazuba yashinzwe mu 1934. Uretse kuba ari ahantu hagizwe n’uduce tw’imirambi habereye abahasura, harimo n’inyamanswa zikundwa na ba mukerarugendo nk’Imparage, Udusumbashyamba, Inzovu, Intare, Ingona n’Imvubu biri mu Kiyaga cya Ihema n’andi moko y’inyoni. Iyi pariki ifite ubuso bungana na kilometero kare 1122, irimo inyamaswa zizwi nka ‘Big Five’ ari zo; Intare, Inkuru, Inzovu, Ingwe n’Imbogo.

title: Maria Sharapova yashimagije Bisate Eco Lodge yacumbitsemo ari mu Rwanda
content: Uyu Murusiyakazi yaje mu biruhuko bisanzwe nyuma y’umwaka w’imikino utaramuhiriye, dore ko waranzwe n’imvune zatumye anakina amarushanwa make bikamuviramo no gusubira inyuma ku rutonde rw’uko abakinnyi bahaze mu mukino wa Tennis ku isi. Yashyize amashusho ku rukuta rwe rwa Instagram yerekana ko yishimiye gucumbikirwa muri Bisate Eco Lodge iri muri hoteli zihenze mu Rwanda. Aya mashusho yabanjirijwe n’amagambo agira ati “Mu gace ko mu ishyamba muri Bisate Lodge, Rwanda. Gutembera icyumba kose gutangizwa n’ikimenyetso cy’inkende cyihaniza abashobora gushaka kunkomangira kuraba kwiza […] Rwanda turagukumbuye.” Mu mashusho yagaragaraga ari gutembera mu cyumba cya Bisate Eco Lodge ari kumwe n’ufata amashusho agenda yerekana uko mu cyumba cy’iyi hoteli haba hameze arangije avuga ko ari ahantu heza hateye amabengeza yishimiye kuba. Bisate Eco Lodge Sharapova yacumbikiwemo, yatashywe na Perezida Paul Kagame tariki ya 1 Nzeri 2017. Yubatse muri Pariki y’Ibirunga aho uba witegeye neza udusongero tw’ibirunga bya Bisoke, Kalisimbi na Mikeno. Iyi hoteli iza mu za mbere zakira ba mukerarugendo bo ku rwego rwo hejuru mu Rwanda, yubatswe n’ikigo Wilderness Safaris. Impumeko yayo yavuye ku miterere y’Ingoro y’Umwami iherereye i Nyanza mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo. Bisate Lodge ifite ibyumba bitandatu bigiye biteretse mu ishyamba hagati, bisakaje ibyatsi hejuru, ndetse byihagazeho kuko kuharara ijoro rimwe wishyura amadolari ya Amerika ari hagati ya 1100–1400. Sharapova wigeze kuba nimero ya mbere ku isi mu bagore, n’umwe mu bafite amafaranga menshi dore ko yigeze kuba umugore wa mbere mu bakina imikino itandukanye winjiza amafaranga menshi, abikora inshuro 11 zikurikiranya. Maria Sharapova yabaye nimero ya mbere ku Isi guhera mu 2005, ariko kuri ubu ari kubarizwa ku mwanya wa 132 nyuma yo kwitabira amarushanwa 12 gusa uyu mwaka. title: Maria Sharapova yasuye ingagi muri Pariki y’Ibirunga (Amafoto)
content: Uyu Murusiyakazi amaze iminsi itatu mu Rwanda aho yaje mu biruhuko bisanzwe nyuma y’umwaka w’imikino utaramuhiriye, dore ko waranzwe n’imvune zatumye anakina amarushanwa make bikamuviramo no gusubira inyuma ku rutonde rw’uko abakinnyi bahaze mu mukino wa Tennis ku isi. Amakuru agera ku IGIHE avuga ko Sharapova w’imyaka 32 azamara mu Rwanda icyumweru. Amafoto Sharapova yasangije abamukurikira ku mbuga nkoranyambaga yagaragaje ko yasuye ingagi muri Pariki y’Ibirunga. Sharapova wigeze kuba nimero ya mbere ku isi mu bagore, n’umwe mu bafite amafaranga menshi dore ko yigeze kuba umugore wa mbere mu bakina imikino itandukanye winjiza amafaranga menshi, abikora inshuro 11 zikurikiranya. Uretse gusura ingagi mu Rwanda, Sharapova yanasuye zimwe muri Pariki zo muri Boswana nk’uko yagiye abisangiza abamukurikira ku mbuga ze nkoranyambaga.
