title: Maria Sharapova yasuye ingagi muri Pariki y’Ibirunga (Amafoto)
content: Uyu Murusiyakazi amaze iminsi itatu mu Rwanda aho yaje mu biruhuko bisanzwe nyuma y’umwaka w’imikino utaramuhiriye, dore ko waranzwe n’imvune zatumye anakina amarushanwa make bikamuviramo no gusubira inyuma ku rutonde rw’uko abakinnyi bahaze mu mukino wa Tennis ku isi. Amakuru agera ku IGIHE avuga ko Sharapova w’imyaka 32 azamara mu Rwanda icyumweru. Amafoto Sharapova yasangije abamukurikira ku mbuga nkoranyambaga yagaragaje ko yasuye ingagi muri Pariki y’Ibirunga. Sharapova wigeze kuba nimero ya mbere ku isi mu bagore, n’umwe mu bafite amafaranga menshi dore ko yigeze kuba umugore wa mbere mu bakina imikino itandukanye winjiza amafaranga menshi, abikora inshuro 11 zikurikiranya. Maria Sharapova yabaye nimero ya mbere ku Isi guhera mu 2005, ariko kuri ubu ari kubarizwa ku mwanya wa 132 nyuma yo kwitabira amarushanwa 12 gusa uyu mwaka. Uretse gusura ingagi mu Rwanda, Sharapova yanasuye zimwe muri Pariki zo muri Boswana nk’uko yagiye abisangiza abamukurikira ku mbuga ze nkoranyambaga. Sharapova aje akurikira myugariro wa Arsenal, David Luiz, nawe uheruka mu Rwanda agasura ahantu hatandukanye harimo na Pariki y’ibirunga.

title: Imbeho y’ubutita, imvura ku bitugu, kubabwa n’isusa… Twasuye Ingagi mu Birunga (Amafoto)
content: Biba birenze ibyo tubona kuri televiziyo cyangwa se ibyo dusoma mu binyamakuru. Kubona amahirwe yo gusura ingagi ni nk’imbonekarimwe cyane ko atari buri wese wabasha kwigondera $1500, ni ukuvuga asaga miliyoni 1,3 Frw asabwa abashaka kuzisura. Kuri iki Cyumweru nibwo urubyiruko rw’abahungu n’abakobwa bujuje imyaka 25 uyu mwaka wa 2019 n’ababaherekeje bajyanywe ku buntu gutembera muri Pariki y’Igihugu y’Ibirunga no kwirebera ingagi ziyibarizwamo, bikozwe n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB) gifatanyije na Shalom Safaris. Iya rubika mbere yo kwerekeza mu Birunga, twabanje gufata amafunguro ya mu gitondo nyuma dufata imyambaro yabugenewe irimo ikote rirerire ryo kwirinda imvura, uturindantoki na bote zo kwambara mu cyondo. Ukigera mu Kinigi ahari ibiro bya RDB, uba uzi ko urugendo rucogoye nyamara nibwo ruba rutangiye! Nyuma yo guhaguruka mu Kinigi muri Musanze werekeza mu Murenge wa Jenda muri Nyabihu n’imodoka, ni ahantu nibura naho hasaba amasaha abiri ubundi imodoka ikabasiga ku muhanda, mugafata iy’agasozi mukerekeza ahari ingagi, aho mushobora kugenda mu ishyamba nibura iminota 40, isaha imwe cyangwa hejuru yayo, bitewe n’aho ingagi mugiye gusura ziherereye. Mbere yo guhaguruka mu Kinigi ariko mubanza gushyirwa mu matsinda y’abantu umunani, mugahabwa amabwiriza bitewe n’umuryango mushaka gusura, kuko umuryango w’Ingagi usurwa n’abantu batarenze umunani kandi bakamarana n’ingagi igihe kitarenze isaha imwe. Icyo gihe kibarwa nk’aho ziba zitangiye guhararukwa abantu, zigahabwa n’umwanya ngo zikomereze ubuzima. Kuva mu Mujyi wa Musanze ikibunda cyari cyose, ikirere kiremereye ndetse hari aho twageze imvura iri ku mugongo, ubukonje ari bwinshi reka sinakubwira. Mu rugendo rwo mu ishyamba muba muherekejwe n’umurinzi ufite imbunda, ngo hato mudasakirana n’inzovu cyangwa imbogo byo mu birunga, dore ko bigira amahane kubi. Hagize inyamaswa ibakanga, uwo murinzi icyo akora ni ukuyikanga igahunga. Muba muri kumwe kandi n’umugabo ubashakira inzira, akagenda atema ibyatsi byagandaye, ibisura byaguca urwaho ntibikurebere izuba. Ni inzira iba igoye ku buryo ugera aho ujya nta nkuru, ariko wakubita amaso Ingagi ugasabwa n’ibyishimo. Twasuye Ingagi zo mu muryango wa Igisha ariko amafoto ari muri iyi nkuru yo yafashwe n’umufotozi wacu ni ayo mu muryango wa Isimbi aho yajyanye  n’irindi tsinda cyane ko yari amatsinda arindwi. Muri iyi pariki harimo imiryango 20 harimo 10 ikorerwaho ubushakashatsi ndetse n’indi 10 isurwa na ba mukerarugendo. Muri iyi icumi isurwa harimo Amahoro, Umubano, Hirwa, Igisha, Isimbi, Muhoza, Kwitonda, Sabyinyo, Susa, Pablo, Kuryama, Mafunzo, Kureba, Musirikali na Ntambara. Ingagi zatanze amasomo akomeye ku bazisuye Uwihirwe Yasipi Casmir wabaye Igisonga cya mbere cya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda, nyuma y’uru rugendo yavuze ko ikintu cya mbere yavuga ari ugishimira RDB ku bw’iki gikorwa. Ati “Byarenze ibyo twatekerezaga, twumvaga ko nyine ari ukureba Ingagi bikarangira ariko twabonye ibindi byinshi byiza. Nkanjye ku giti cyanjye twari twasuye Isimbi, twabonye ingamba zafashwe kugira ngo habungabungwe ibidukikije, uko Ingagi zibayeho, uko zibayeho mu miryango n’uko hagati yazo ziganira.” Ikintu gikomeye uyu mukobwa yize mu gihe cy’isaha yamaranye n’ingagi, yavuze ko icya mbere ari ukuntu ziyoborana kandi zikubahana mu buryo bukomeye. Ati “Ikintu nazigiyeho zifite uburyo ziyoborana, ziba zizi ugomba kuba mukuru wazo (Silver-back) ikindi kuba ziba zizi ko ziri mu bwami bwazo uba ugomba kubizubahira. Icyo nabonye nazigiraho mu buzima busanzwe, zumva cyane ibijyanye n’amasano kandi zikubahana, hanyuma rero natwe nk’umuryango twakabaye tubana hamwe kandi tugatekereza kure, tukubaha n’abaturuta." "Ikintu natekerezaga cya mbere ni uko zimeze nk’abantu kandi ni nako twabisanze biri." Batashye bakubita agatoki ku kandi bavuga ko bazagaruka Mushimimana Olivier ukora muri Shalom Safaris yafatanyije na RDB gutembereza abantu, isanzwe itembereza ba mukerarugendo mu mapariki atandukanye ku giciro kiri hasi mu rwego rwo kugira ngo bafatanye na leta guteza imbere ubukerarugendo bw’imbere mu gihugu. Yabwiye IGIHE ko atari ubwa mbere yari agiye mu Birunga ariko umuntu wese uhaza aba yifuza kugaruka. Ati "Uko imyaka igenda ishira hagenda hazamo udushya. Ni ubwa kane nzisuye ariko n’ubu byagenze neza nta kibazo, ntabwo ingagi wasura rimwe ngo unyurwe ahubwo uba wumva wahora ugaruka buri munsi.” Iki cyo kuba umuntu wese usuye ingagi ahora yifuza kugaruka agihuriyeho n’abandi benshi bari bagiye muri uru rugendo. Ingagi ziri mu biza ku isonga mu gukurura ba mukerarugendo mu Rwanda ndetse buri Munyarwanda wese aba yifuza kuzisura akihera ijisho uko zibayeho akanasobanukirwa byinshi birenze. Muri Nyakanga 2019 RDB nibwo yatanze amahirwe mu gihe hizihizwaga imyaka 25 ishize igihugu kibohowe ubutegetsi bwaryanishije abaturage, bikageza kuri Jenoside yahitanye ubuzima bw’inzirakarengane zirenga miliyoni. Aya mahirwe yo gusura ingagi yari agenewe abantu bujuje imyaka 25 uyu mwaka n’abandi bayifite. Ni igikorwa kijyanye na gahunda ngarukamwaka ya “Tembera u Rwanda”, igamije gushishikariza Abanyarwanda by’umwihariko gukangukira gusura ibyiza nyaburanga bigize igihugu cyabo. Tembera u Rwanda yabaga ku nshuro ya karindwi. Amafoto: Muhizi Serge

title: U Rwanda rwamuritse ibyiza byarwo i Londres,  rutumira abatuye Isi muri CHOGM 2020
content: ‘The Lord Mayor’s Show’ ni ibirori bimaze imyaka 804 biba ndetse bikaba bimwe mu bikomeye ku Isi mu bihuza abantu barenga 6000  baturutse ku Isi yose, aho baza  bakiyerekana mu buryo bw’imbyino, umuco,  amatsinda acuranga n’ibindi. Itsinda ryaserukiye u Rwanda ubwo ryiyerekanaga  ryasabye abitabiriye ibi birori gusura u Rwanda mu nama ya CHOGM 2020. Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Bwongereza , Yamina Karitanyi  yavuze ko ari ibyishimo ku Rwanda kuko kwitabira ibi birori bivuze byinshi ndetse bikaba byabaye inzira yo kumurika umuco Nyarwanda. Yagize ati “Ubu ni ubwa mbere u Rwanda rwitabira the Lord Mayor’s Show, twatewe ishema no kuba muri iki gikorwa, dusangiza abandi umuco wacu ndetse dutumira n’abatuye Londres  kwitabira inama ya CHOGM.” Yongeyeho ko kuba u Rwanda rwitabiriye byerekana umubano mwiza rufitanye n’umujyi wa Londres . Ati “Kuhaba k’u Rwanda byerekana umubano mwiza n’umujyi wa Londres  ndetse n’ukwiyemeza dufite mu muryango wa Commonwealth”. Karitanyi yavuze ko uko CHOGM 2020 igenda yegera bazarushaho gusangiza abantu amakuru y’uko u Rwanda rugenda rutera imbere n’aho imyiteguro igeze kugira ngo igikorwa cyo kwakira iyi nama kizagende neza. Abari bahagarariye u Rwanda muri ibi birori barimo itsinda ry’intore n’abakaraza biyerekanye mu myambaro n’imbyino by’umuco gakondo, byose hagamijwe guteza imbere ubukerarugendo n’ishoramari mu Rwanda. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ubukerarugendo mu Kigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB), Belise AKaliza yavuze ko inama ya CHOGM 2020 izaba amahirwe k’u Rwanda yo gusangiza Isi bimwe mu byiza nyaburanga rufite. Yagize ati “Twishimiye kwakira abarenga 5000 baturutse ku Isi yose bazaza mu Rwanda kubera inama ya CHOGM 2020. Iyi nama izaba ari imwe mu zihuza abantu benshi kandi batandukanye mu mateka y’u Rwanda ndetse twishimiye gusangiza Isi umwihariko w’igihugu mu byiza nyaburanga bikurura ba mukerarugendo uhereye ku gusura Ingagi, kwibonera ishyamba rya Nyungwe riri mu akuze, gusura inyambo, kubona ubuzima bwo muri Kigali ndetse no kujya mu Kagera gusura inyamaswa eshanu zikomeye”. Uretse ibijyanye n’ubukerarugendo n’umuco,  itsinda ryari rihagarariye u Rwanda ryerekanye ubushake bw’u Rwanda mu kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibidukikije, aho biyerekanye bari mu mwambaro ubasanisha n’ingagi bagenda iruhande rwa moto idasohora umwuka wangiza ikirere. Muri ibi birori kandi Abanyarwanda biyerekanye mu mwambaro wa Arsenal nk’uburyo bwo kwishimira ubufatanye bw’u Rwanda n’iyi kipe ndetse sosiyete Nyarwanda itwara abantu mu ndege Rwandair, isanzwe ijya muri uyu mujyi gatatu mu cyumweru nayo yiyerekanye iboneraho no kubwira abazitabira CHOGM  ko izabafasha kugera i Kigali.

title: U Rwanda ku mwanya wa mbere mu bihugu bizasurwa cyane muri Afurika mu 2020
content: Uru rutonde rwatangajwe ku wa 7 Ugushyingo 2019 rugaragaza ibihugu 30 bifite ibintu bikurura abakerarugendo, bitanga icyizere ko bizasurwa cyane kurusha ibindi mu 2020. Ibihugu byatoranyijwe muri uyu mwaka byatangajwe muri iki cyumweru ku rubuga TravelLemming.com rusanzwe ruteza imbere urwego rw’ubukerarugendo, mu muhango wabereye mu Bwongereza. Ku mwanya wa mbere hatoranyijwe Georgia, igihugu kiri hagati y’u Burayi na Aziya nk’igitanga icyizere cyo kuzasurwa cyane mu 2020 kubera urunyurane rw’imisozi iri mu gace ka Caucasus kandi kikagira imijyi ihendutse kuyibamo. Iki gihugu ngo gikunda gusurwa cyane hagati ya Mata n’Ukwakira. Iki gihugu gikurikirwa na Nova Scotia, Intara yo muri Canada ifite ibice bikunze gusurwa cyane birimo Pariki y’Igihugu ya Cape Breton n’ibindi. Ni igace k’ikirwa kihariye ku bwiza gakondo n’inyubako zitangaje gakunda gusurwa cyane muri Kamena n’Ukwakira. U Rwanda ruza ku mwanya wa kane inyuma Cook Islands iherereye mu Majyepfo y’Inyanja ya Pacifique. Ibirwa byihariye ku kugira umucanga wo kwidagaduriraho, ukundwa n’abakerarugendo cyane. U Rwanda rwihariye ku ngagi zo mu Birunga, Pariki ya Nyungwe n’izindi ngoro ndangamurage, Urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi n’ibindi bikunzwe n’abakerarugendo, rukurikirwa na Kyrgyzstan, Equateur, Suède, n’ibindi. U Rwanda rukunze gusurwa cyane guhera mu Ukuboza hagati kugera mu ntangiriro za Gashyantare no muri Kamena na Nzeri. Umuyobozi w’Ishami ry’Ubukerarugendo mu Kig0 cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB), Belise Kariza, yavuze ko “Twishimiye kwakira iki gihembo no kuba mu bihugu bya mbere bizasurwa n’abakerarugendo mu 2020 nk’uko byagaragajwe na travel bloggers.” Yakomeje agira ati “Iki gihembo tugisangiye n’abanyamuryango bose ba gahunda yo kumenyekanisha u Rwanda (Visit Rwanda), abashinzwe kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibidukikije n’ibinyabuzima, abakora mu bukerarugendo, amahoteli bagira uruhare buri munsi mu gutuma u Rwanda ruba ahantu hadasanzwe ho gusurwa.” Kariza yavuze ko ku batarasura u Rwanda bahawe ikaze kugira ngo baryoherwe n’ubwiza karemano, umuco n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima birurimo.  Mu mpamvu u Rwanda rwatoranyijwe mu bihugu byahawe iki gihembo harimo kuba World Economic Forum iheruka kurushyira ku rutonde rw’ibihugu bifite umutekano muri Afurika kandi RwandAir ikaba iteganya mu 2020 gufungura icyerekezo gishya cya Kigali- JFK muri New York, ku kibuga mpuzamahanga cyitiriwe John F. Kennedy. Umwe mu bagize akanama nkemurampaka ka Travel Blogger katoranyije u Rwanda, Amarachi Ekekwe, yavuze ko rukomeje kugira impinduka zikomeye mu rwego rw’ingendo z’indege muri Afurika mu byiciro bitandukanye. Ati “Bizaba bishimishije gusura Kigali ukareba impinduka zitangaje n’imbaragaga ishyira mu kwita kuri Pariki z’igihugu.” Undi mu bagize akanama nkemurampaka Amanda Mouttaki, yavuze ko ‘U Rwanda ruri ku mwanya wa mbere w’ibihugu nzasura muri Afurika nkibonera byinshi mu mico itandukanye, ubwiza karemano bwarwo n’ubw’ingagi zikurura benshi, hari n’ibindi byinshi birimo ingoro z’umuco gakondo abantu bahasanga.’ Igihugu cya Afurika kiza hafi ni Namibia iri ku wa 13 mu gihe Ethiopia yo iri ku mwanya wa 30.

title: Umujyi wa Kigali ugiye gutaha ubusitani bugezweho imbere y’ibiro byawo (Amafoto)
content: Ni ubusitani bugezweho bwubatswe ku muhanda imbere y’ibiro by’Umujyi wa Kigali, ahateganye n’icyicaro gikuru cya I&M Bank. Bwubatswe ku nyubako yo hejuru, kuko munsi yabwo harimo inzu yagenewe ishyinguranyandiko ry’umujyi wa Kigali. Ubu busitani bugeze mu cyiciro cya nyuma cyo kubakwa, bufunguriwe abaturage muri rusange. Bufite intebe zihariye umuntu ashobora kwicaraho akahasomera igitabo, yumva akayaga aganira n’inshuti n’ibindi. Mu buryo aha hantu hubatswe, biteganyijwe ko hazashyirwa internet nziramugozi y’ubuntu, ku buryo abantu bashobora kuhicara bakarahura ubwenge. Umujyi wa Kigali utangaza ko kuhatemberera bizaba ari ubuntu, ariko ku bantu bifuza kuhakorera ibikorwa by’izindi nyungu nko kuhafatira amashusho y’ubukwe cyangwa y’indirimbo, urateganya kureba uko byazakorwa kugira ngo haboneke uburyo bwatuma hazajya habungabungwa neza. Ubu busitani bwatangiye kubakwa muri Mutarama uyu mwaka, buzatahwa ku mugaragaro mu minsi iri imbere. Bwubatswe ku buso bwa metero kare 1072, butwara miliyoni 226,1 Frw. Umujyi wa Kigali uvuga ko nibura 6% by’ubuso bwawo, mu gishushanyo mbonera bwageneye ahantu ho kuruhukira. Mu bindi bice bikomeje gutunganywa ngo bigenerwe bene ibi bikorwa harimo igishanga cya Nyandungu, ahazwi nka Nyandungu Urban Wetland Eco-Tourism Park. Ni ibikorwa ubuyobozi bwashyizemo imbaraga, aho buteganya ko mu gihe mu mwaka wa 2050 abatuye uyu mujyi bazaba bageze kuri miliyoni 3.8 bavuye kuri miliyoni 1.3 babarurwa kuri ubu, uyu mujyi ugomba kuba ufite ibidukikije bihagije kandi abaturage bafite ahantu hakwiye ho kuruhukira. Amafoto: Niyonzima Moïse

title: One&Only Gorilla’s Nest yiyongereye ku nyubako zigezweho zakira ba mukerarugendo mu Rwanda (Amafoto)
content: Nyuma ya hoteli igezweho imaze igihe muri Pariki y’Igihugu ya Nyungwe, International One & Only Resorts yibarutse irindi shami mu karere ka Musanze, yitezweho kuzajya yakira ba mukerarugendo basura ingagi. One&Only Gorilla’s Nest ifite ibyumba 14 bigezweho n’inzu zirindwi buri imwe iri ukwayo. Zitatse mu buryo bwa Kinyarwanda hakoreshejwe imigongo, hakabamo n’ibindi bikoresho by’ubugeni. Izi nyubako kandi zigizwe n’igice kinini cy’ibirahuri ku buryo umuntu abasha kwitegereza ibyiza bitatse amajyaruguru y’u Rwanda. Yubatswe mu biti mo hagati ku buryo buri nzu iteretse ku byuma bishinze, aho nibura bibarwa ko inzu imwe yagiye itwara miliyoni imwe y’amadolari ngo yubakwe. Kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 1 Ugushyingo nibwo One&Only Resorts yatangaje ko One &Only Gorilla’s Nest yafunguye imiryango mu Rwanda. Witegereje ku ndangaminsi igaragaza igihe umuntu ashobora kurara muri iyi nyubako, usanga kugeza ku wa 15 Ugushyingo yaramaze gufatwa. Izi nyubako zikozwe mu buryo bifasha abantu kunga ubumwe n’ibidukikije, kuko zubatse mu mahumbezi aboneka ku birenge by’ibirunga. Kugeza ubu kuharara byihagazeho kuko nka Forest lodge irimo ibitanda bibiri, kuyiraramo ijoro rimwe ari $3,825 ni ukuvuga nibura miliyoni 3.5 Frw; Forest Lodge King ni $3,060 ni ukuvuga asaga miliyoni 2,8 Frw; Virunga Suite ni $4,760 ni ukuvuga miliyoni 4,3 Frw naho Ingagi suite ni $5,900, nibura ni miliyoni 5,4 Frw. One and Only Gorilla’s Nest yiyongereye ku zindi nyubako ebyiri zikomeye zakira ba mukerarugendo bo ku rwego rwo hejuru mu bice by’ibirunga, zirimo Bisate lodge kuri uyu wa Gatanu yahawe inyenyeri eshanu na Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House, yatangije ibikorwa mu Rwanda ku wa 1 Kanama 2019.

title: Bisate Lodge yabaye hoteli ya kabiri mu ntara yahawe inyenyeri eshanu (Amafoto na Video)
content: Inyenyeri za hoteli zitangazwa n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Iterambere (RDB) gishingiye ku bipimo bizigenga muri Afurika y’Uburasirazuba (EAC). Ku nshuro ya gatatu mu Rwanda hatangajwe uko hoteli, appartements n’izindi nzu zakira abakerarugendo zihagaze bijyanye n’inyenyeri zazo kuva kuri imwe kugeza kuri eshanu mu birori byabereye muri Kigali Convention Center ku wa 1 Ugushyingo 2019. Muri 40 zagenzuwe, Bisate Lodge ni yo yahawe inyenyeri eshanu mu gihe izahawe enye ari ebyiri zirimo Residence Prima 2000 na The Retreat & Heaven Boutique Hotel. Hoteli zahawe inyenyeri eshatu zigera ku 10 zirimo Executive Suites Kigali na Landmark Suites iherereye i Kinyinya. Izisaga 10 zashyizwe ku rwego rw’inyenyeri ebyiri zirimo The Court Boutique Hotel na Barthos Hotel mu gihe 10 zahawe imwe. Gutanga inyenyeri hashingirwa ku birimo serivisi zitanga, aho ziherereye, imyubakire yazo, ubushobozi bwo kwakira abantu, amasaha zikora n’ibindi hagendewe ku mabwiriza ahuriweho na EAC agenga hotel, restaurants, n’izindi nyubako zakira ba mukerarugendo. Bisate Lodge yubatswe hagendewe ku miterere y’Ingoro y’Umwami y’i Nyanza mu Majyepfo, yahawe inyenyeri eshanu nyuma yuko mu 2018 yaje no ku rutonde rwa hoteli 56 nshya nziza ku Isi. Iri mu za mbere zakira ba mukerarugendo bo ku rwego rwo hejuru mu Rwanda, yubatswe n’ikigo Wilderness Safaris. Umuyobozi wa Thousand Hills ikorana na Bisate Lodge, Sebageni Jacqui, yagaragaje ko inyenyeri bahawe ari ishema rizatuma bakora cyane. Ati “Biratanga ishusho y’abo turibo kandi byereka abakiliya ko bakora amahitamo mazima yo kutugana. Guhabwa inyenyeri bifasha buri wese mu rwego rw’ubukerarugendo kuko bituma dukora cyane.’’ Imiterere ya Bisate Lodge ituma ba mukerarugendo bizihirwa no kuharara kuko kugeza ubu ibyumba byayo byamaze gufatwa (booked) kugeza mu 2020. Mu bituma hakundwa harimo ubwiza bwaho, ingagi,  ibirunga na serivisi nziza zihabarizwa. Umuyobozi wa Landmark Suites Hotel ikorera mu Murenge wa Kinyinya muri Gasabo, Kirenga Sarah, yabwiye IGIHE ko guhabwa inyenyeri ari indi nyunganizi mu ishoramari rimaze imyaka itanu. Ati “Twishimiye intambwe twateye yo guhabwa inyenyeri eshatu kandi ntitugiye kwicara kuko tuzi neza ko tuzakomeza gutera imbere. Inyenyeri ivuze ko abatugana baba bazi neza serivisi tugomba kubaha kandi bizadufasha kumenyekanisha ibikorwa byacu mu gihugu no hanze.’’ Igikorwa cyo guha hoteli inyenyeri cyagaragajwe nk’inzira yo gukomeza guteza imbere ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda. Umuyobozi Wungirije wa RDB, Niyonkuru Zephanie, yavuze ko Guverinoma y’u Rwanda izakomeza gutanga inkunga mu iterambere ry’ubukerarugendo. Mu myaka itanu ishize u Rwanda rwari rufite hoteli imwe y’inyenyeri eshanu, ubu zigeze kuri eshanu zirimo Bisate Lodge, One & Only Nyungwe House, Radisson Blu Hotel, Kigali Serena Hotel na Kigali Marriot Hotel. Yakomeje agira ati “Ibi byatumye inyungu iva mu Bukerarugendo bwibanda ku kwakira ibiganiro, inama mpuzamahanga n’ibikorwa bitandukanye, byiswe MICE izamuka iva kuri miliyoni $33 mu 2014 igera kuri miliyoni $55 mu 2018.’’ Umuyobozi w’Umujyi wa Kigali, Rubingisa Pudence, yavuze ko kubaka ubukerarugendo buhamye bitagerwaho hatangwa serivisi mbi. Yagize ati “Igihugu cyacu gifata serivisi nziza nk’umusingi w’iterambere ry’ubukungu ndetse biri muri Gahunda yo kwihutisha Iterambere (NST1), igamije gukuba inyungu iva mu bukerarugendo ikarenga miliyoni $800 mu 2024.’’ “Ni ngombwa kwita kuri serivisi duha abakiliya bacu, kuko ni ingenzi cyane. Ni ngombwa kumva ibyo dukeneye. Bigomba kuba inshingano za buri mushoramari na buri Munyarwanda wese.’’ Rubingisa yavuze ko ibyinjizwa n’igihugu biba bigamije guhindura ubuzima bw’abaturage. Ati “Ntibikiri muri Kigali gusa ahubwo byanageze mu ntara. Hoteli yahawe inyenyeri eshanu ni iyo mu Karere ka Musanze. Ni ingenzi kugaragaza ko ishoramari ritangijwe, abantu bashobora kungukira mu bikorwa remezo ndetse bakanabona imirimo.’’ U Rwanda rwihaye intego yo kwinjiza amadolari asaga miliyoni 150 buri mwaka muri gahunda ya MICE. Kuva itegeko ry’ubukerarugendo ryo mu 2014 ryatangira gushyirwa mu bikorwa hamaze gutangwa inyenyeri ku nyubako 156 mu gihugu hose. Amafoto: Niyonzima Moses Video: Mugwiza Olivier

title: U Rwanda mu bihugu bikomeje gutera imbere cyane mu bukerarugendo
content: Raporo y’ikigo gishinzwe iby’ubukerarugendo ku Isi, 2019, yavuze ko Ethiopia aricyo gihugu kirimo gutera imbere mu buryo budasanzwe ku hantu hasurwa na ba mukerarugendo, u Rwanda rukaza ku mwanya wa gatandatu naho Uganda ku wa 12. Ikinyamakuru The East African cyavuze ko urwego rw’ubukerarugendo muri Ethiopia rwateye imbere ku kigero cya 48.6% mu 2018, rukaba rugize 9.4% by’ubukungu bw’iki guhugu rukanatanga imirimo miliyoni 2.2. Kugeza ubu abangana na 8% by’abatuye iki gihugu bakora mu rwego rw’ubukerarugendo. U Rwanda narwo rukomeje gutera imbere mu bukerarugendo, iyi raporo yagaragaje ko ari ku kigero cya 13.8% naho Uganda ikaba kuri 11.3%. Mu 2018 Kenya nayo yari  kuri 5.6%, uru rwego rutangayo imirimo miliyoni 1.46, naho 8.8% by’ubukungu bw’iki gihugu biva mu bukerarugendo. Mu bihugu 185 byakoreweho ubu bushakashatsi no mu duce 25, byagaragaye ko urwego rw’ubukerarugendo rugize 10.4% by’ubukungu bw’Isi, imirimo ingana na miliyoni 319 niyo yahanzwe. Iki cyegeranyo kivuga ko urwego rw’ubukerarugendo ruzakomeza gutera imbere mu 2019, nubwo ubukungu bw’Isi bukomeza kugenda ku kigero kiri hasi. Muri rusange iyi raporo yagaragaje ko mu myaka itanu ishize urwego rw’ubukerarugendo rwagiye rutanga akazi byibuze ku muntu umwe muri batanu. Mu Ukuboza 2018, u Rwanda rwaje ku rutonde rwakozwe n’ikinyamakuru Forbes, rugaragaza ahantu heza buri wese akwiye gusura mu mwaka wa 2019, akaba yizeye kugira ibihe atazigera yibagirwa. Ni urutonde rwakozwe nyuma yo kugenzura ibirebana n’ibishya biri aho hantu, umutekano, ibikwiye gusurwa bitarakendera, ibizagusigira urwibutso n’impinduka zikomeye mu buzima bwawe. Mu gukora uru rutonde umunyamakuru wa Forbes ufite ubunararibonye mu birebana n’inkuru zivuga ku bukerarugendo yanifashishije inararibonye zikora mu bigo bitegura ingendo, dore ko ari nabo baba bazi aho bahanze amaso bifuza ko ababagana berekeza. U Rwanda kandi rwiyemeje gukora ibishoboka ngo mu 2024 inyungu ruvana mu bukerarugendo izabashe kwikuba kabiri igere kuri miliyoni $800 zivuye ku zigera kuri miliyoni $440 nk’intego rwari rufite mu 2017.

title: Umunyamerikakazi n’umukozi uyobora ba mukerarugendo bashimutiwe muri pariki muri Uganda
content: Polisi ivuga ko byabaye kuri uyu wa Kabiri hagati ya saa kumi n’ebyiri na saa moya z’ijoro, muri iyi pariki ikora ku mupaka wa Repubulila ya Demokarasi ya Congo, RDC. Iti “Abo bitwaje intwaro bafatiye imbunda kuri aba ba mukerarugendo, bafata babiri muri bane barabajyana. Barimo umugore Kimbley Sue Endecott w’imyaka 35 n’umushoferi Jean Paul.” Ngo bagendaga mu modoka zitwara ba mukerarugendo, ariko nyuma yo gushimuta babiri, ababikoze basize imodoka aho ariko batwara imfunguzo zayo. Abasigaye bahise bitabaza ubuyobozi bwa pariki burabafasha, ndetse ngo bameze neza. Polisi ivuga ko ambasade ya Amerika i Kampala yahise imenyeshwa ibibaye, isaba ko hakorwa ibishoboka byose bakarekurwa. Yakomeje iti “Ababashimuse, bifashishije telefoni yabo basabye guhabwa 500 000$. Turakeka ko gushaka aya mafaranga ari byo byatumye bakora ibi.” Inzego z’umutekano zahise zigota inzira zose zisohoka muri Uganda zinjira muri RDC. Polisi yavuze ko iki gikorwa kidasanzwe kuko iyi pariki imaze igihe itekanye, ku buryo abateganya kuyisura mu minsi ya vuba badakwiye gucika intege. Mu mwaka ushize ubukerarugendo muri pariki zihana imbibi na RDC bwahagaritswe nyuma y’uko ba mukerarugendo babiri b’Abongereza n’umushoferi bashimuswe, bakarekurwa nyuma y’iminsi ibiri.

title: Singita Kwitonda Lodge yubatse mu ntango y’Ibirunga izafungurwa muri Kanama
content: Singita Kwitonda Lodge izuzura itwaye miliyoni $20, yatangiye kubakwa ku wa 31 Kanama 2017, ni yo nzu ya mbere Singita igize ifasha abantu kureba ingagi, mu bihugu byose ifitemo ibikorwa. Iyi nyubako yubatse ku buso bwa hegitari 72 aho ibirunga bitangirira; uyirimo aba yitegeye ibirunga bya Sabyinyo, Gahinga na Muhabura. Ku ikubitiro izaha akazi abantu 70. Singita Kwitonda Lodge itatswe n’ibikoresho gakondo byakorewe mu Rwanda, izafungurwa ku mugaragaro ku wa 5 Kanama 2019. Igizwe n’inzu zirindwi buri imwe ifite icyumba kimwe cyo kuraramo, imwe ifite ibyumba bibiri n’indi yo ku ruhande ifite ibyumba bine. Umuyobozi wa Singita, Luke Bailles, yavuze ko ifungurwa ry’iyi nyubako ba mukerarugendo bazaryungukiramo kuko rizorohereza abasura ingagi. Yavuze ko Singita iri gukorana n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere n’abatuye hafi y’Ibirunga ngo hafatwe ingamba zihamye zo kubungabunga urusobe rw’Ibinyabuzima muri Pariki y’Igihugu y’Ibirunga mu gihe kirambye nk’icyerekezo cy’imyaka 100 iki kigo cyihaye mu gushyigikira ibinyabuzima muri Afurika. Yagize ati “Mu ntangiriro tuzashyiraho ishuri ry’incuke, tunatere ibiti 60 000 imbere no mu nkengero z’inyubako. Singita yizeye ko izashobora gufasha Guverinoma y’u Rwanda mu gushaka uburyo bwo kuzamura aho ingagi ziba ariko ikita no ku gushyigikira abaturiye ibirunga kubaka ubushobozi bw’ubukungu buzahindura ubuzima bwabo.’’ Yakomeje avuga ko icyemezo cyo gushora imari mu Rwanda gishingiye ku cyerekezo cyarwo mu bukerarugendo n’imbaraga igihugu cyabushyizemo. Ati “Zahoze ari inzozi zacu kugira uruhare mu bukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda.’’ Mu 2017, ubukerarugendo bwinjirije u Rwanda miliyoni $438, mu gihe intego ya 2024 ni uko ruzabusaruramo miliyoni $ 800. Inyubako ya Singita Lodge yahawe izina rya Kwitonda, yitiriwe ingagi y’ingabo yapfuye mu 2012 ifite imyaka 40, icyo gihe ikaba yarabonetse itagihumeka nyuma y’iminsi yari imaze itagaragara mu muryango wayo. Singita ishora imari mu bukerarugendo guhera mu 1993; isanganwe izindi nzu zo mu bwoko bwa Lodge muri Tanzania (Singita Lamai na Singita Grumeti), muri Zimbabwe (Singita Pamushana Lodge) no muri Afurika y’Epfo (Singita Kruger National Park na Singita Sabi.

title: Twatembereye Nyungwe n’Inkengero zayo! Iby’umutekano muke babifata nk’ibihuha
content: IGIHE yatembereye muri ibyo bice, abakerarugendo n’abaturage bagaragaza ko nta kibazo cy’umutekano gihari, ndetse  bashimangira ko abavuga ibyo ari abanyabihuha. Iby’umutekano muke  akenshi ababivuga babishingiraga ku bitero byagabwe muri ako gace guhera muri Nyakanga umwaka ushize, Ingabo z’u Rwanda zikabihashya ndetse zigatangaza ko byakozwe n’abagizi ba nabi bagamije guhungabanya umutekano w’igihugu. Muri Nyakanga umwaka ushize mu Karere ka Nyaruguru abagizi  ba nabi bateye mu Murenge wa Nyabimata baranasahura ariko ingabo z’u Rwanda zirabahashya. Muri Ukuboza uwo mwaka abandi bagizi ba nabi bagabye igitero mu mu Murenge wa Kitabi mu Karere ka Nyamagabe, imodoka z’abagenzi ziratwikwa, babiri barapfa abandi umunani barakomereka. Ingabo z’u Rwanda zaje gutangaza ko zishe batatu mu bagabye icyo gitero, abasigaye bahungira mu Burundi. Tariki 18 Werurwe abandi bantu bitwaje intwaro bahitanye umuturage mu Murenge wa Karambi mu Karere ka Nyamasheke, Ingabo z’u Rwanda zirahagoboka  ku makuru zahawe n’abaturage, zihangana n’abagizi ba nabi zirabashya. Abakerarugendo muri Nyungwe baratekanye Ahagana saa tatu n’igice z’igitondo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu abanyamakuru ba IGIHE bari bageze kuri Hotel One &Only Nyungwe House mu Murenge wa Bushekeri muri Nyamasheke. Iyo Hoteli icumbikira benshi muri ba mukerarugendo basura pariki ya Nyungwe. Twahasanze abakerarugendo batandukanye, bamwe babyutse bari kwitegura kujya  kureba ibyiza bitatse Nyungwe. Umunyafilipine Victor Dizon  n’umugore we twasanze  bavuye muri Pariki kureba ubwoko bw’inkende zizwi nka Colubus. Dizon yabwiye IGIHE ko amaze iminsi mu Rwanda ariko ngo mu bihugu 15 amaze kugeramo nta handi muri Afurika yabonye umutekano nk’uwo mu Rwanda. Yagize ati “Navuga ko u Rwanda ari icyo gihugu cya mbere gitekanye mu byo nagezemo muri Afurika kuko turi nk’i Kigali twasigaga ibikapu byacu mu modoka , yego ugakinga umuryango ariko ibyo ntiwabikora muri Afurika y’Epfo cyangwa Kenya.  Na hano numva mfite umutekano. Guverinoma yanyu yakoze akazi gakomeye mu kuzana umutekano.” Yashimangiye ko kuba hari bamwe mu bashinzwe umutekano yabonye muri Pariki aho kumuca intege bimuha icyizere ko arinzwe. Ati “Twagiye hirya no hino muri Pariki, twasuye imirima ariko ndumva mfite umutekano hano . Ndabizi ko turi hafi y’umupaka n’u Burundi , nabonye abasirikare hano ariko nta kibazo byanteye ahubwo bituma ndushaho gutekana.” Ahagana saa kumi z’umugoroba, IGIHE yanyuze mu ishyamba rya Nyungwe mu muhanda uva Nyamasheke uhinguka i Nyamagabe, isanga ahazwi nko Kuwinka hakirirwa abakerarugendo baje muri Pariki ya Nyungwe haparitse imodoka zigera kuri enye zizanye abakerarugendo. Abaturage ntibumva ishingiro ry’abavuga umutekano muke Mu rugendo rw’isaha irenga abanyamakuru ba IGIHE bakoze bava muri Nyamasheke bagana muri Nyamagabe banyuze mu ishyamba rya Nyungwe, nta muntu wigeze abahagarika ngo agire icyo ababaza. Hari aho wageraga ukabona abashinzwe umutekano ku nkengero z’umuhanda, imodoka zitwara abagenzi zibisikana n’izitwara ibicuruzwa n’imyaka ariko nta n’imwe bigeze bahagarika. Mu Murenge wa  Bushekeri ahazwi nka Gisakura saa tatu za mu gitondo abaturage bari bari mu mirima y’icyayi bacyitaho abandi basarura. Mu gasantere ka Mushabarara, Umurenge wa Kitabi mu Karere ka Nyamagabe, IGIHE yahageze ku gicamunsi ariko ubucuruzi bwakorwaga nk’ibisanzwe, bamwe bari mu tubari bica inyota, abandi botsa inyama, ibigori, ibirayi n’abakiliya babyo ku ruhande aho. Ako gasantere kari hafi neza y’ishyamba rya Nyungwe. Abaturage baho bavuze ko nta kibazo cy’umutekano bafite, ngo nabo babyumva mu binyamakuru. Umugore wita ku bwiherero rusange muri ako gasantere ariko utashatse gutangazwa amazina, yavuze ko abahakeka umutekano muke atari ko bimeze. Ati “Amakuru bafite wavuga ko atari yo kuko nta gifatika bifite.” Icyakora yavuze  ko amakuru y’ibihuha yagiye avugwa kuri ako gace yabagizeho ingaruka, urujya n’uruza rusa n’urugabanyutse. Ati “Mbere twabonaga abakiliya ariko ubu ntabwo bakigenda neza nkuko bagendaga mbere. Hashize nk’amezi nk’abiri abantu batakiza nkuko byari bimeze mbere. N’abagenzi iyo bageze hano baba bikanga bakatubaza bati ese ishyamba turaryambuka, tuti mugende murambuka nta kibazo kandi koko bakagenda bakagerayo.” Nzeyimana Edouard ni umugabo ukora umwuga w’ubuvumvu hafi y’ishyamba rya Nyungwe mu Mudugudu wa Subukiniro, akagali ka Rugogwe umurenge wa Uwinkingi. Yavuze ko aheruka kumva isasu mu 1993, anyomoza abavuga ko  ibice byegereye Nyungwe birimo intambara. Ati “Nk’umuntu uhahora unahatuye, abaturage bacu nta kibazo dufite turatekanye. Turarya , tugahinga tugakora imirimo yacu isanzwe. N’umuntu ubivuga tukamwumva tumubwira ko abeshya. Nta muturage wacu uragira ikibazo , ntawe urajya gutashya inkwi ngo ahereyo, ntawe urajya kwahira ubwatsi ngo ahereyo. Aho dutuye twegereye pariki tuba tuyireba nta kibazo.” Komanda wa Polisi  mu Murenge wa Karengera ukora kuri pariki ya Nyungwe muri Nyamasheke, CIP Fidèle Mbonimana na we yabwiye IGIHE ko nta kibazo cy’umutekano muke gihari. Ati  “Ayo makuru nyumva mu itangazamakuru. Ugasanga umuntu arahurudutse avuze ijambo ngo mu Rwanda nta mutekano, ngo hari ikibazo ariko nkanjye nkurikije igihe maze aha  nta kibazo cy’umutekano muke kiri muri aka gace. Nta hantu ndumva isasu na rimwe, iyo nta sasu wumva rero umutekano uba uhari.” Pariki ya Nyungwe ikora ku turere turimo Rusizi, Nyamasheke na Karongi mu ntara y’iburengerazuba na Nyaruguru na Nyamagabe mu ntara y’Amajyepfo. Umwaka ushize yasuwe n’abakerarugendo basaga gato ibihumbi 14. Kanda hano urebe andi mafoto menshi Amafoto: Niyonzima Moise na Rwanda Gov Video: Kazungu Armand

title: Abagore bari mu bukerarugendo bakangukiye kubyaza umusaruro amahirwe aburimo (Amafoto)
content: U Rwanda rufite abagore mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko (61.25%) mu gihe 50% bari muri guverinoma na 40% mu nama njyanama z’inzego z’ibanze. Ntirwirengagijwe uruhare rw’umugore mu kwagura ubukerarugendo. Mu bufatanye bw’u Rwanda na Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Abarabu (UAE), abagore 100 bakora muri serivisi zo kwakira neza ababagana, abo muri hoteli, abayobora ba mukerarugendo n’abandi bahawe ubumenyi buzabafasha kugendana n’ibipimo mpuzamahanga muri uru rwego. Aya mahugurwa yakozwe mu “Guha abagore 100 ubushobozi buzabaremamo abayobozi b’ahazaza mu rwego rw’ubukerarugendo.’’ Umwiza Joana utwara imodoka zitembereza abakerarugendo yavuze ko ubumenyi yungutse bwatumye we na bagenzi be biyemeza gukora cyane ngo batarebwa nk’abadashoboye. Yagize ati ‘‘Hari ibyo batubwiye dusanga hari impinduka n’inyongera ikenewe. Twungutse ko dukwiye kwakira neza abatugana binyuze mu gutegura neza igihe cyo guhura n’umukiliya, serivisi umuha n’akarusho karengaho ku birenze  ibyo yari yiteze. Batubwiye kumenya icyo umuntu yakongera ngo serivisi iryohere uwamugannye. Hari abakobwa bitinyutse ndetse bikanabakura mu bibasubiza inyuma.’’ Umuyobozi wungirije muri Palast Rock Hotel i Nyamata, Kamikazi Aurore, na we wahuguwe yavuze ko mu bukerarugendo hari amahirwe menshi. Ati “Aya mahugurwa n’amahirwe ahari tuyakoreshe, twerekane ko dushoboye. Turi gushaka ibisubizo byo gukuraho imbogamizi zo kwitinya no kumva ko udashoboye. Twize kwihutisha serivisi no kubikora tubikunze.’’ Abahuguwe bemeza ko mu gihe serivisi zizanozwa abakiliya bazahora babagana banakangurire bagenzi babo kuza ku bwinshi. Ambasaderi wa UAE mu Rwanda, Hazza Mohammed Falah Kharsan Al Qahtani, yavuze ko amahugurwa yatanzwe ashushanya uruhare rw’ubukerugendo mu bukungu. Ati “Imikoranire ya UAE n’u Rwanda yatangiye kera aho bikorana mu mishinga itandukanye. Ibihugu byacu byizera ko ubukungu buhamye buzagerwaho binyuze mu mikoranire hagati y’umugore n’umugabo.’’ U Rwanda rwizeye kwinjiza miliyoni 800$ mu 2024 avuye mu bukerarugendo. Minisitiri w’Uburezi, Dr Mutimura Eugène, yavuze ko urwego rw’ubukerarugendo rwakuze aho mu myaka ibiri ishize, umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu wazamutse ugera kuri miliyoni 438$. Ati “U Rwanda rwiyemeje guteza imbere ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku nama. Ibyo bizabaho mu gihe ababakira, bafatwa nk’urumuri bafite ubushobozi bwo ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Dushimishijwe n’ubumenyi abagore bahawe buzabafasha guteza imbere ubukerarugendo. Turabashishikariza kugira intego no gukora cyane. Ndizera ko imbuto zavuye hano zizagira akamaro.’’ Mu mitangire ya serivisi muri rusange, u Rwanda ruhagaze ku gipimo cya 74% mu gihe rwifuza kugera kuri 90% mu 2024. Umuyobozi ushinzwe Ubukerarugendo mu Kigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB), Belise Kariza, yavuze ko amahugurwa yateguwe mu guha umwihariko ab’ingeri zitandukanye mu kugaragaza amahirwe ari mu bukerarugendo. Yagize ati “Urwego rw’ubukerarugendo ni rumwe mu zizana amadevise menshi. Ni ugutangira gutekereza uko abari n’abategarugori babyaza umusaruro amahirwe aburimo. Iyo ureze umugore biba ari iby’agaciro gakomeye. Tuzakomeza ubukangurambaga kandi tugomba gutanga serivisi zihanitse.’’ Aya mahugurwa y’iminsi itatu yabereye muri La Palisse Hotel Nyamata ku wa 18- 20 Werurwe 2019.  Yateguwe na Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ifatanyije na UAE nyuma y’amasezerano y’ubufatanye yashyizweho umukono ku wa 8 Werurwe 2019, ubwo hizihizwaga Umunsi Mpuzamahanga w’Abagore. Yanatewe inkunga na UAE Aid, Emirates Academy of Hospitality Management, Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga y’u Rwanda n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB). Amafoto: Muhizi Serge

title: Ubukerarugendo mu isura nshya i Kigali kubera imodoka zoroshya kuyizenguruka (Amafoto)
content:
Bitewe n’imiterere n’uburyo bukoreshwa mu ngendo ariko ntibyari byoroshye gusura ibi byiza, ari nayo mpamvu hazanywe imodoka nini izajya ifasha ba mukerarugendo baturutse mu mahanga ndetse n’Abanyarwanda bifuza kumenya byinshi ku mujyi wabo. Kuri uyu wa Kane nibwo izi modoka zifite imyanya igerekeranye (Double Decker), yatangiye gukora ingendo zizenguruka umujyi wa Kigali, mu gikorwa cyatangijwe n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu Gishinzwe Iterambere, RDB ku bufatanye na Sosiyete Kigali City Tour ari nayo nyiri uyu mushinga. Umuyobozi Mukuru muri RDB ushinzwe ubukerarugendo, Belise Kariza, yagaragaje ko kimwe mu bintu byaburaga mu bukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda ari imodoka zitembereza abantu mu mujyi, by’umwihariko igihe hari itsinda ry’abashyitsi bari ku rwego rwo hejuru bifuza kumenya byimbitse Kigali. Ati “Izi modoka zizatanga umusanzu mu byiciro byinshi, kimwe ni uguteza imbere ubukerarugendo mu mujyi wa Kigali, ikindi ni ukwigisha by’umwihariko urubyiruko. Kubera amateka yacu, benshi muri twe ntitwavukiye mu Rwanda, iyi modoka izaha urubyiruko urubuga rwo kwiga no gutembera umujyi”. Ibi kandi yabihurijeho n’Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Nyarugenge, Kayisime Nzaramba, wavuze ko ubukerarugendo ari kimwe mu bintu umujyi wa Kigali ushyizemo imbaraga kandi nubwo u Rwanda rwakira ba mukerarugendo b’abanyamahanga bagera kuri miliyoni 1.6 ku mwaka, umubare ukiri muto ugereranyije n’ibindi bihugu. Yakomeje avuga ko iyi ariyo mpamvu u Rwanda rugikeneye gushyira imbaraga nyinshi mu kongera umubare w’abakora ubukerarugengo baba abanyamahanga n’Abanyarwanda, izi modoka zikaba zije kurushaho gushyira ku rundi rwego ibirebana uburyo bukoreshwa mu kubatembereza. Umuyobozi wa Kigali City Tour, Munyandamutsa Augustin, yavuze ko iyi modoka yahawe izina rya ‘Sightseeing Bus’ ifite imyanya 64, bakaba baratekereje kuzizana mu Rwanda nk’uburyo bwo kongera ibikorwa ba mukerarugendo bashobora gukora igihe basuye Kigali. Uwayo Honorine ushinzwe kuyobora ba mukerarugendo muri Kigali City Tour, yabwiye IGIHE ko izi modoka zizatuma ibikorwa byo gutembereza abantu mu mujyi byoroha, aho bazajya bajyana abantu ku nyubako, inzu ndangamurage ndetse n’ibindi byiza biwutatse. Ati “Imodoka twari dusanzwe dufite ntizari zigerekeranye. Tuzajya dutwara abantu benshi, abicaye hejuru by’umwihariko bazajya babasha kureba umujyi wa Kigali mu buryo bwagutse, no gufata amafoto igihe babyifuza”. Gutembereza abantu mu mujyi wa Kigali hakoreshejwe iyi modoka bizajya bikorwa mu byiciro bitatu, buri cyiciro kikazajya kimara amasaha atatu. Icyiciro cya mbere kizajya gitangira saa tatu za mu gitondo kugeza saa sita, abantu batemberezwe mu duce twa kera tw’umujyi nka Nyamirambo, Kimisagara, Nyabugogo n’ahandi. Guhera saa munani kugeza saa kumi n’imwe, abantu bazajya batemberezwa mu duce dushya tw’umujyi wa Kigali turimo Nyarutarama, Kibagabaga, Kacyiru n’ahandi. Kuva saa moya z’umugoroba kugeza saa tanu z’ijoro, bazajya bajyanwa mu bice bya Kicukiro na Rebero kugira ngo bitegereze neza Umujyi wa Kigali mu masaha y’ijoro.
Bazajya banatemberezwa ahantu hatandukanye hagaragaza ubuzima bw’umujyi mu masaha y’ijoro. Uretse kuba ifite imyanya igerekeranye, iyi modoka ifite ibyuma bitanga umuyaga, ahashobora gucomeka telefoni n’ibindi bikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga, televiziyo ndetse na Internet itagira umugozi. Kugenda muri izi modoka, abanyarwanda n’abaturage ba EAC bazajya bishyura 25000 Frw naho abanyamahanga bishyure $50 (hafi 45000 Frw). Amafoto: Rwanda Gov.

title: Gahunda yo kugaburira abana ku mashuri ihagaze ite mu myaka itanu imaze?
content: Iyi gahunda itaratangira, hari abana bigaga amasomo ya nyuma ya saa Sita basinzira abandi bayura kubera inzara, mu gihe abandi batahaga bakagaruka ku ishuri bakerewe kubera ko basanze ibiryo bitarashya cyangwa se kubera urugendo rurerure. Kuva iyo gahunda yatangira, ababyeyi bayigize iyabo ndetse abashinzwe uburezi bahamya ko yazanye impinduka mu mitsindire y’abanyeshuri. Hari ibikoma mu nkokora iyi gahunda Ababyeyi bo mu bice bitandukanye baganiriye na IGIHE, bavuga ko batanga hagati ya 10.000 Frw na 12.000 Frw buri kwezi, ariko ngo abana babo hari aho barya nabi cyangwa se ntibahabwe ifunguro ribahagije kubera impamvu zitandukanye. Mukasekuri Marie Rose ufite umwana wiga ku Rwunge rw’amashuri rwa Nduba mu Karere ka Gasabo, yagize ati “Abana bagaburirwa akawunga n’ibishyimbo kuva ku wa Mbere kugeza ku wa Gatanu. Hari n’igihe bataha bavuga ko batahaze.” Kirenga Damien wo mu Karere ka Gicumbi we yagize ati “Ubundi iriya gahunda yari nziza ariko ikibazo gihari ni uko dutanga amafaranga noneho ugasanga babandi barihirwa na Leta batinze kuyatanga bigatuma abana bacu barya nabi kandi ntibahage.” Abayobozi b’ibigo by’amashuri bitandukanye baganiriye na IGIHE, bose bashima iyi gahunda kuko ngo yatumye abana bakurikira amasomo neza kandi bagatsinda. Ku rundi ruhande bagaragaza ko hakiri ikibazo kuri Minisiteri y’Uburezi yemeye kujya itangira buri mwana 57 Frw, akenshi agatangwa bitinze. Umuyobozi w’Urwunge rw’Amashuri rwa Busanza mu Karere ka Kicukiro, Sewase Jean Claude, avuga ko abana afite bagaburirwa ifunguro rya saa sita ari 931, ababyeyi bakaba basabwa gutanga 12.000Frw mu gihembwe, ubwo ni 4000 Frw mu cyumweru. Leta ibaha 56 Frw ku mwana ahwanye na 3.993.990 Frw ku gihembwe, ariko ngo bayabona impitagihe. Ati “Gahunda ni nziza cyane kuko yakemuye ibibazo byinshi birimo iby’abana bakererwa, abiga basinzira cyangwa bayura kubera inzara n’ibindi. Ariko kandi irimo ibindi bibazo by’ingutu. Nk’ubu mu bana barenga 900 dufite abamaze kwishyura ni 400 gusa kandi urabona ko igihembwe kibura iminsi mike ngo kirangire. Ayo Leta igomba kuduha nayo ntirayatanga.” “Usanga ikigo gihora gifitiye amadeni ba rwiyemezamirimo kubera ariya mafaranga Leta idatangira igihe. Ayo mafaranga agiye azira igihe nta kibazo twagira. Nko mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari wa 2017-2018, ay’igihembwe cya mbere twayabonye muri Kamena, igihembwe cya kabiri cyo ntayo baduhaye kandi abana barariye. Ibi rero bitugiraho ingaruka zikomeye cyane niho usanga n’ababyeyi bavuga ko abana babo badahaga nawe urumva aho biba byapfiriye.’’ Umuyobozi w’Urwunge rw’Amashuri rwa Gihinga mu Karere ka Bugesera, Munyantwari Vedaste, yabwiye IGIHE ko bagerageza kwishakamo ibisubizo bafatanyije n’ababyeyi, ariko hakiri imbogamizi. Ati “Iyi gahunda ababyeyi bayigize iyabo kandi barayishyimiye cyane. Mu bana 592, abagera kuri 500 barishyuye, naho 65 ni abo mu cyiciro cya mbere cy’ubudehe, abandi basigaye ni abana b’abakene batuye hafi y’ishuri, ababyeyi badusabye ko bajya kurya mu rugo.’’ Uyu muyobozi avuga ko umubyeyi asabwa gutanga 10.000 Frw mu gihembwe, utayaboneye rimwe akayatanga mu byiciro bibiri kandi ko bikorwa neza. Ati ‘‘Ikibazo gikomeye dufite ni ariya mafaranga agomba gutangwa na Leta ntajya azira igihe, ni iyanga pe ! Hari igihe tuyategereza nk’amezi atandatu kandi abana baba bagomba kurya. Usanga rero tugondoza ba rwiyemezamirimo ngo bakomeze baduhe ibiryo ugasanga ikigo gihora mu madeni.’’ Icyifuzo cy’abayobozi b’ibigo batandukanye ni uko Minisiteri y’Uburezi yajya ibagezaho amafaranga ku gihe, kuko ngo bayaboneye igihe nta kabuza abana barya neza kandi bagafata ifunguro rihagije hatabayeho gusaranganya ibihari. 2019-2020 : Mineduc izakoresha miliyari 7 FRW mu kugaburira abana ku ishuri Umuvugizi wa Minisiteri y’Uburezi, Serafina Flavia, avuga ko gutinda kw’amafaranga biterwa n’impamvu zitandukanye. Ati ‘‘Twebwe ibyo dusabwa tuba twabikoze, ariko ugasanga hari nk’ibibazo by’amalisiti ataratunganywa bitewe n’uko iyo umwaka ugitangira imibare y’abana iba yarahindutse.’’ Umuyobozi ushinzwe Igenamigambi na Politiki y’Uburezi muri Mineduc, Rose Baguma, yabwiye IGIHE ko 56 FRW ari yo yagenewe gahunda yo kugaburira abana ku ishuri. Ati ‘‘Kugaburira abana ku ishuri ni inshingano z’ababyeyi mbere na mbere. Amafaranga 56 niyo nkunga ya leta ku mwana. Bitewe n’ubushobozi buzaboneka, Leta irateganya kuyongera. Ingengo y’imari yagenewe iyi gahunda mu myaka itanu ishize yari miliyari 5.5 Frw mu mwaka, ariko mu ngengo y’imari ya 2019/2020 yariyongereye, hateganyijwe miliyari 7 Frw.’’ Yakomeje avuga ko kugeza ubu abanyeshuri  biga mu burezi bw’ibanze bw’imyaka 9 na 12 barya ku ishuri ari  97.3%, Umujyi wa Kigali ukaza ku isonga n’ubwitabire bugera ku 100%, Amajyaruguru 99.4%, Intara y’Uburengerazuba 95.2%, Amajyepfo 97.3%, Intara y’Uburazirazuba nayo ikagira ubwitabire bwa 97.3%. Umwanzuro wa 7 w’Umwiherero w’Abayobozi Bakuru wa 16, ugira uti “Kuvugurura gahunda yo kugaburira abana ku mashuri ku bufatanye n’inzego zose zibifitemo uruhare.’’ Baguma avuga ko mu gushyira mu bikorwa uyu mwanzuro, hateganyijwe ko ku ifunguro ry’abanyeshuri hongerwamo n’amata, mu biribwa bihabwa abanyeshuri hagomba kwibanda ku byera mu karere ishuri riherereyemo no kuvugurura ibigize ifunguro. Mu rwego rwo kurushaho kubungabunga ubuzima bw’abana b’u Rwanda, Leta yatangije gahunda ya ‘Inkongoro y’umwana’ ireba abana bo mu mashuri y’incuke kugera mu wa Gatatu w’amashuri abanza, ikaba izashyirwa mu bikorwa na Gahunda y’Igihugu mbonezamikurire. Minisiteri y’Uburezi yibutsa ababyeyi ko gahunda yo kugaburira abana ku ishuri bagomba kuyigira iyabo, bagatanga imisanzu yagenwe mu nama rusange y’ababyeyi (amafaranga, ibiribwa, umusanzu mu kazi) ku ishuri ku gihe. title: Kenya: Umwongereza yafotoye inzovu idasanzwe iri mu zakendereye muri Afurika
content: Iyi nzovu yiswe ‘Elephant Queen’, ifite umubyimba udasanzwe, amahembe yayo ni maremire ku buryo agenda ikora hasi. Abahanga mu by’imibereho y’inyamaswa zo mu gasozi bavuga ko muri Afurika habarizwa izitarenze 30. Will Burrard-Lucas yayifotoreye muri Pariki y’Igihugu ya Tsavo muri Kenya; yafatanyije n’Umuryango udaharanira Inyungu wa Tsavo Trust nk’uburyo bwo gukomeza ubukangurambaga bwo kubungabunga izi nyamaswa. Uyu Mwongereza w’imyaka 36 yabwiye CNN ko “Byari ibihe bidasanzwe. By’umwihariko muri iyi myaka aho inzovu zifite imitonzi miremire zagabanutse.’’ Burrard-Lucas wabaye muri Tanzania mu buto bwe, igihugu gifite pariki nyinshi, bituma yihebera gufotora inyamaswa zo mu gasozi. Amafoto y’inzovu yayafashe yifashishije camera ikoranye ikoranabuhanga rimwemerera gufata inyamaswa iri mu ndiri yayo. Ati “Mu myaka yashize nayikoresheje ku mishinga itandukanye, no kuri uyu nabikoze nk’uburyo bwo kugaragaza ingano y’izi nyamaswa.’’ “Ndizera ko abantu bagira ishyaka ryo kwita ku rusobe rw’ibinyabuzima kandi bashobora gushyigikira imiryango nka Tsavo Trust itanga umusanzu mu kurinda izi nyamaswa.’’ Tsavo Trust ikorana n’Ikigo gishinzwe Inyamaswa zo mu Gasozi cya Kenya Wildlife Service mu gutera inkunga ibikorwa byo kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima birimo no guhangana na ba rushimusi. Will Burrard ni we wafotoye igisamagwe cy’umukara agifatiye muri ‘Laikipia Wilderness Camp’ mu Majyaruguru y’Umujyi wa Nairobi muri Kenya nyuma y’imyaka isaga 100, ubwoko bw’iyi nyamaswa busa n’ubwacitse muri Afurika. Aya mafoto yagarutsweho cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga yasohowe ku wa 11 Gashyantare 2019. Uyu Mwongereza yashimangiye ko inzovu zifite amahembe maremire zigaragara hake cyane kurusha Igisamagwe cy’umukara.

title: Abantu 35 bari guhugurirwa kuyobora abashaka kureba amoko y’inyoni mu Rwanda
content: Aya mahugurwa yatangiye ku wa Gatanu, tariki ya 15 Werurwe 2019, ari gukorerwa mu bice bigaragaramo inyoni nyinshi mu Karere ka Bugesera, Pariki y’Igihugu y’Akagera n’iya Nyungwe. Umwongereza w’inzobere mu bukerarugendo bwo gusura inyoni, Malcolm Wilson, ni we uri kwigisha abari guhugurwa ibijyanye na tekiniki zikoreshwa, uburyo bwo gufata amafoto, kumva no gutandukanya amajwi y’inyoni, imiterere y’uburumbuke bwazo, ubukerarugendo n’ibindi. Mu gutangira aya mahugurwa, Abanyarwanda bayobora ba mukerarugendo kureba inyoni bahawe ibitabo byihariye muri ubu bukerarugendo n’indebakure (binoculars) bazifashisha. Aya mahugurwa y’iminsi 19 yateguwe n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB) ku bufatanye n’Umushinga w’Abadage wita ku Iterambere (GIZ) n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa mu bukerarugendo; azasozwa ku wa 4 Mata 2019. Umuyobozi muri RDB ushinzwe Ubukerarugendo no kubungabunga Urusobe rw’Ibinyabuzima, Mutangana Eugène, yavuze ko u Rwanda rukungahaye cyane ku hantu habereye ba mukerarugendo harimo n’ahari inyoni. Yagize ati “Dufite ahantu harindwi hari ku rwego mpuzamahanga habarizwa ubwoko bw’inyoni burenga 703. Abanyamahanga bakorera mu Rwanda ingendo miliyoni eshatu buri mwaka baje kureba inyoni. Binyuze muri aya mahugurwa, turashaka kuzamura agaciro k’abareba inyoni no kungukira mu bukerarugendo bwazo.’’ Umujyanama mu bijyanye n’Ubukungu muri GIZ, Ellen Kallinowsky, yavuze ko bizeye ko ubukerarugendo bwo kureba inyoni mu Rwanda bushobora kugira agaciro nk’ak’ingagi. Ati “Inyoni ntizifite umubare w’abantu ntarengwa bazisura cyangwa ahantu hihariye mu gihugu. Ku rundi ruhande, ubuturo bw’inyoni buba ahari ibyatsi, mu bishanga n’udushyamba dutoshye, bituma habaho itandukaniro mu bwoko bwazo rigira igihugu ahifuzwa n’abihebeye ubukerarugendo bw’inyoni.’’ Yakomeje avuga ko abayobora ba mukerarugendo, urwego rw’ubukerarugendo n’Abanyarwanda muri rusange bashobora kubyungukiramo. Ku wa 14 Kamena 2018, Ishyirahamwe Nyarwanda ry’Abayobora ba Mukerarugendo (Rwanda Safari Guides Association-RSGA) ryatanze impamyabushobozi kuri 45 batsinze ikizamini cyo kuyobora abantu basura u Rwanda mu rwego rw’ubukerarugendo. Abayobora ba mukerarugendo batanga ibyishimo by’ikirenga mu rugendo rwose kuva bakigera ku kibuga cy’indege binyuze mu bisobanuro byimbitse batanga bikanogera amatwi n’amaso. U Rwanda rwiyemeje gukora ibishoboka ngo mu 2024 inyungu ruvana mu bukerarugendo izabashe kwikuba kabiri igere kuri miliyoni $800 zivuye ku zigera kuri miliyoni $440 nk’intego yo mu 2017.

title: Imodoka zihariye zigiye kujya zifashishwa mu kwereka ba mukerarugendo ubwiza bwa Kigali
content: Munyandamutsa Augustin watangije uwo mushinga yabwiye The NewTimes ko bamaze kuzana imodoka imwe ifite ibyicaro hasi no hejuru, bakaba biteze ko mu kwezi gutaha  hazaba habonetse indi. Tariki 21 Werurwe nibwo uwo mushinga uzamurikwa ku mugaragaro, umunsi ukurikiyeho akazi ko gutembereza abantu Umujyi wa Kigali gatangire. Munyandamutsa yavuze ko intego yabo ari ugutembereza abasura Kigali ndetse n’abayisanzwemo ibice byayo biteye amatsiko, yaba uduce tw’umujyi twatuwe kuva kera ndetse n’utwubatswe vuba aha. Ati “Twamaze kubona ko umujyi wacu wakira inama nyinshi,  rero ubu buryo bw’ubukerarugendo ni amahirwe kuri ba mukerarugendo yo kumenya byinshi kuri uyu mujyi mu gihe gito.” Yakomeje avuga ko bazajya batembereza abantu mu byiciro bitatu, buri cyiciro kikamara amasaha atatu. Icyiciro cya mbere kizajya gitangira saa tatu za mu gitondo kugeza saa sita, abantu batemberezwe mu duce twa kera tw’umujyi nka Nyamirambo, Kimisagara, Nyabugogo n’ahandi. Guhera saa munani kugeza saa kumi n’imwe, abantu bazajya batemberezwa mu duce dushya tw’umujyi wa Kigali nka Nyarutarama, Kibagabaga, Kacyiru n’ahandi. Kuva saa moya z’umugoroba kugeza saa tanu z’ijoro, bazajya bajyanwa mu bice bya Kicukiro na Rebero kugira ngo bitegereze neza Umujyi wa Kigali mu masaha y’ijoro. Bazajya banatemberezwa ahantu hatandukanye hagaragaza ubuzima bw’umujyi mu masaha y’ijoro. Munyandamutsa yashishikarije Abanya-Kigali n’abanyarwanda muri rusange kwitabira ubu bukerarugendo bushya bwo kumenya neza Umujyi wa Kigali. Umunyamahanga azajya yishyura amadolari 50 kuri buri cyiciro muri bitatu naho umunyarwanda cyangwa uwo muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba yishyure 25 000 Frw. Meya w’Umujyi wa Kigali,Marie Chantal Rwakazina, yashimye uwo mushinga,yemeza ko ugamije gufasha abantu gusobanukirwa Kigali. Ati “Kigali ifite ahantu hatandukanye hateye amatsiko kuhasura nk’urwibutso rwa Jenoside n’ ahandi hagaragaza amateka ya kera. Hari imihanda mishya turi gukora izafasha ba mukerarugendo gusobanukirwa  ayo mateka y’u Rwanda. Iyo mihanda izajya inifashishwa n’izo modoka.” Kuva umwaka w’ingengo y’imari 2018/2019 watangira,  ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku nama bumaze kwinjiriza igihugu miliyoni 52 z’amadolari nkuko byatangajwe n’Ikigo gishinzwe kumenyekanisha ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku nama, RCB. Umwaka wa 2019/2020, u Rwanda rurashaka kwinjiza miliyoni 88 z’amadolari zivuye mu bukerarugendo bushingiye ku nama.

title: Ibibuga by’indege 20 byakoreshejwe n’abantu benshi mu 2018
content:
Atlanta International Airport umwaka ushize cyagize abagenzi barenga miliyoni 107, bituma kiba icya mbere kigendwa n’urujya n’uruza ry’abantu benshi mu kinyejana cya 21. Raporo ya 2018 y’Inama Mpuzamahanga y’ibibuga by’indege igaragaza urujya n’uruza ku bibuga by’indege, iheruka gutangazwa ku wa 13 Werurwe, igaragaza ko abagenzi ku kibuga cy’indege cya Atlanta biyongereye ku kigero cya 3.3%. Umwaka ushize Ku Isi abagenzi biyongereyeho miliyoni 8.8, bingana na 6% naho imizigo yiyongera ku kigero cya 3.2%. Raporo igaragaza ko umubare w’abagenzi ku bibuga by’indege 20 bigendwa cyane wiyongereye ku kigero cya  4.7% mu 2018, aho byagize abagenzi basaga miliyari  1.5 ariko nta kibuga na kimwe cyo ku mugane wa Afurika kirimo. Atlanta International Airport gikurikirwa n’icyo mu Bushinwa ‘Beijing Capital International’  cyagize abagenzi bagera kuri miliyoni 101 n’ubwiyongere bwa 4.5% naho icya Dubai muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Abarabu kiza ku mwanya wa gatatu, cyakiriye abagenzi miliyoni 89 n’ubwiyongere bwa 1%. Bimwe mu bituma ikibuga cya Atlanta gikomeza guca agahigo harimo kuba kiri ahantu heza hegeranye n’ibyambu byinjira muri Amerika ya ruguru, aho mu masaha abiri, abanya Amerika barenga 80% (basaga miliyoni 300) bakora ingendo mu ndege. Gusa ikibuga cy’indege cya Chicago ‘O’Hare International’ kiza imbere ya Atlanta mu byagize ingendo nyinshi z’indege aho cyagize hafi ibihumbi 904,  Atlanta ikagira ibihumbi 895 naho icya Los Angeles International kikagira ibihumbi 708. Ikibuga cy’indege cya Hong Kong nicyo kiza imbere mu byatwaye imizigo myinshi ingana na Metero Cube zirenga miliyoni 5.1 kigakurikirwa na Memphis International Airport naho Shanghai Pudong International Airport ikaza ku mwanya wa gatatu. Umuyobozi w’inama mpuzahanga y’ibibuga by’indege, Angela Gittens, yavuze ko bishimishije kubona umubare w’abagenzi wiyongera umunsi ku wundi n’igiciro cy’urugendo kikagabanuka hamwe na hamwe nk’uko CNN yabyanditse. title: U Rwanda rwanyuranye umucyo mu imurika mpuzamahanga ry’ubukerarugendo i Berlin (Amafoto)
content: U Rwanda rwari ruhagarariwe n’ibigo bitandukanye bitanga serivisi z’ubukerarugendo, birangajwe imbere n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB) n’Ishami ry’Ubukerarugendo mu Rugaga rw’Abikorera mu Rwanda, PSF. Mu muhango ukomeye wo kurisoza, ITB Grand Finale 2019, u Rwanda rwabaye umutumirwa w’Icyubahiro. Ubusanzwe iyi gahunda itumirwamo abahabwa ibihembo n’abaterankunga ba ITB, Abakuru b’ibihugu, ba Ambasaderi cyangwa abahagarariye imiryango n’ibindi bigo byagize uruhare mu mitegurire ya ITB. Umujyanama wa mbere wa Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Budage,  Nshimiyimana Benedicto, wari uhagarariye Ambasaderi Igor César, yabwiye IGIHE ko kwitabira ITB 2019 byabaye akarusho ku Rwanda. Ati “Ikindi cyabaye kidasanzweho ni uko bwari ubwa mbere Ishami rishinzwe ubukerarugendo muri PSF ryitabira ITB kandi riza rifite akarusho kuko bafatanyije na GTZ bateguye inama ihuza abikorera mu bukerarugendo baturutse mu Rwanda, bagirana inama n’abo mu Budage no mu bindi bihugu.” “Iki gikorwa cyateguriwe hanze y’ibikorwa bya ITB kuko cyarebaga u Rwanda n’abandi bishyize hamwe ngo bazakorane n’u Rwanda kuko ibiganiro byibanze mu guhana amakuru no gukanira byimbitse ku mikoranire.” Yanagarutse ku Itorero Irebero ryongeye kugaragaza zimwe mu ndanga gaciro z’umuco nyarwanda binyuze mu mbyino, kuvuza ingoma, imyambarire n’ibindi, aho wasangaga bikurura benshi bagasura ibyo u Rwanda rumurika. Nshimiyimana akomeza avuga ko bashimishijwe no kubona mu gusoza iri murika, abahanzi b’u Rwanda ari bo batoranyijwe muri Afurika bagasusurutsa abitabiriye uwo muhango. Umuyobozi Muri RDB Ushinzwe kumenyekanisha ubukerarugendo, Linda Mutesi, yavuze ko bishimishije kuba ITB y’uyu mwaka yaritabiriwe n’abanyarwanda benshi. Yakomeje ati “Ikindi ni umwanya twahawe nk’u Rwanda tukagira ijambo imbere y’abantu, ubundi kubageraho byabaga bigoye, barimo abaterankunga ba ITB, abahagarariye ibihugu byabo, abashoramari batumiwe, twagerageje kubabwira u Rwanda n’ibyiza byo kurusura, tubereka na filime mbarankuru yerekana ubukerarugendo, ubwo itorero Irebero ryabyinaga nabyo byabaye akarusho kuko nyuma yaho benshi bifuje ko twamenyana.” Birori Joseph uyobora ikigo ‘Primate safaris’ cyitabiriye  iri murika, yabwiye IGIHE ko yaherukaga muri ITB mu 2012, bityo yishimiye kurisubiramo agenzwa n’impamvu zitandukanye. Ati “Ni uguhagararira u Rwanda mu ruhando rw’amahanga, gukomeza kuvugana n’abo dukorana tukongera tugahura tukaganira kuko mu bucuruzi  ni uguhozaho, icya gatatu ni ukureba aho isi igeze mu bukerarugendo ngo natwe tudasigara inyuma, abadusanga ntibagire icyo babura haba mu bikoresho bigezweho n’ibindi.” Gasore Francois Xavier uyobora ‘Jambo Tours Rwanda’ we yavuze ko atashye abonye abo bazakorana guhera mu 2020 bo muri Pologne, bazasura u Rwanda nawe akazerekeza mu gihugu cyabo mu guhe cya vuba. Emmanuel Mvuyekure uyobora ‘Shami Tours’ we yavuze ko ari ubwa mbere agiye mu Burayi mu imurika mpuzamahanga nk’iri kuko yakoreraga ku rwego rw’u Rwanda gusa, ariko ngo ibyo yabonye byamufunguye amaso. Iri murika rya ’ITB’ ryatangiye mu 1966 i Berlin mu Budage nk’uruganda ruhoraho rwo gufasha no guhuza abakora umwuga wo gutanga serivisi z’ubukerarugendo Isi. title: U Rwanda rwitabiriye ku nshuro ya 13 imurika mpuzamahanga ry’ubukerarugendo i Berlin (Amafoto)
content: Ni ku nshuro ya 13 u Rwanda rwitabira iri murikagurisha ngarukamwaka rya ‘ITB’, aho buri gihugu kiba giharanira kureshya ba mukerarugendo baturuka mu mpande zose z’Isi, rihuriramo benshi bakora ibijyanye n’ubukerarugendo. Ryitabirwa kandi n’Ibitangazamakuru bikomeye byo ku Isi kubera inyungu ibihugu biba bifite mu kwerekana ibyiza bifite bishobora gusurwa, no kumenyesha abaturage aho bakorera ubukerarugendo cyangwa bashora imari. U Rwanda nk’igihugu kirimo gutera imbere mu bikorwa by’ubukerarugendo ku rwego mpuzamahanga, ruhagira umwanya ugaragara. Uyu mwaka muri ‘ITB 2019’ u Rwanda rwaserukiwe n’ibigo bitandukanye bizwi mu kwakira abantu bikanataga serivisi z’ubukerarugendo, biherekejwe n’ Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB) n’Ishami ry’Ubukerarugendo mu Rugaga rw’Abikorera mu Rwanda. Umuyobozi muri RDB Ushinzwe kumenyekanisha ubukerarugendo, Mutesi Linda, yatangarije IGIHE ko "Itsinda rigizwe n’abanyarwanda nk’uko bisanzwe bishimiye kongera kwitabira iri murika.” Yakomeje ati "Umunsi wo kurifungura wakozwe nk’uko bisanzwe kuko ni inshuro ya 13 turyitabira nk’u Rwanda, habayeho igikorwa kidasanzwe ku mugoroba w’umunsi wa mbere aho abikorera mu bijyanye n’ubukerarugendo bitabiriye ITB 2019 bahuye na bagenzi babo ba hano mu Budage bakagirana ibiganiro byimbitse.” Umuyobozi w’Ishami ry’ubukerarugendo mu Rugaga rw’abikorera mu Rwanda, PSF, Ariella Kageruka, yavuze ko abikorera mu by’ubukerarugendo baganiriye na bagenzi babo bo mu bindi bihugu, hagarukwa kuri serivisi abasura u Rwanda babona zirenze gusura Ingagi gusa. Ati “Mbere y’uko iyi gahunda ibaho twari twakoze ubushakashatsi dushaka amakuru yimbitse mu bo twazanye ngo bazaganire koko bumvikane uko bakorana mu kubereka ishusho y’u Rwanda, bikaba byabaye mu buryo butuje, bari hamwe, basangira ikirahuri n’amafunguro, bareba filime mbarankuru yerekana ubukerarugendo mu Rwanda, bahuza urugwiro bahana amakuru koko.” “Twabazaniye n’Ikawa yacu barayisogongera muri ibyo biganiro, ku buryo buri wese yatashye amaze kugira abo bazakorana bahanye amakuru nyabyo, kuko burya iyo wicaranye n’umuntu ku meza mugasangira, mugaseka, mugera kuri byinshi kuruta guhurira mu biro cyangwa mu imurika bisanzwe.” Yavuze ko bamwe mu bakora mu bukerarugendo bahuye n’abo mu Rwanda, bafite ibikorwa mu bindi bihugu ariko bakibaza uko bakorera no mu Rwanda kuko amakuru yabageragaho ari uko mu Rwanda ari aho gukorera hizewe. Umujyanama wa mbere muri Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Budage, Nshimiyimana Benedicto, wari uhagarariye Ambassaderi Igor César, yavuze ko bishimishije kubona abanyarwanda bahuye n’abanyamahanga bakora ibintu bisa. Ati “Buri wese aba akeneye serivisi z’undi kuko abakerarugendo baba bifuza guhabwa amakuru n’ababifitiye ubunararibonye, abari aha bose rero ni abantu koko b’abanyamwuga mu kazi.” Yakomeje avuga ko igisigaye ari ukureba uko ibyaganiriweho byashyirwa mu bikorwa, abizeza ubufasha buzakenerwa ku rwego rwa ambasade. Mu bigo byaturutse mu Rwanda harimo  RwandAir, Charleston Tours, Thousand hills Africa; Primate safaris, Charleston Travel, Wildlife tours-Rwanda, Jambo Tours Rwanda,  Amahoro Tours, International Tours & Travel, Thousand Hills Africa, Shami Tours n’ibindi. Iri murika rya ’ITB’ ryatangiye mu 1966 i Berlin mu Budage nk’uruganda ruhoraho rwo gufasha no guhuza abakerarugendo b’umwuga n’abagenzi n’abandi bose bakora ibijyanye n’ubukerarugendo ku Isi.

title: U Rwanda na Tanzania mu bufatanye bwihariye bugamije kwagura ubukerarugendo muri Afurika
content: Babyemeranyije kuri uyu wa Gatatu ubwo ababukoramo bo muri Tanzania basuraga bagenzi babo bo mu Rwanda, bakaganira uburyo barushaho kunoza ubufatanye. Ni ibiganiro byaranzwe no kugaragaza amahirwe buri gihugu kihariyemo mu bukerarugendo nk’ibishingiye ku muco, umutungo kamere n’ibindi. Umuyobozi wungirije w’Ishyirahamwe ry’Abatwara n’abatembereza ba mukerarugendo mu Rwanda, RTTA, Namatovu Caroline, yavuze ko ibihugu byombi bifite ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo bitandukanye, bityo kwishyira hamwe ari amahirwe. Ati “Ba mukerarugendo iyo baje muri Afurika akenshi ntabwo baza gusura igihugu kimwe. Basura n’ibindi bihugu bihegereye kandi Tanzania nicyo gihugu kidafite ibintu by’ubukerarugendo bisa n’ibyo mu Rwanda. Iyo baje mu Rwanda baba bashaka gukomereza Tanzania.” Yavuze ko ubufatanye bw’abakora mu bukerarugendo mu bihugu byombi busanzwe ariko butari ku rwego rwifuzwa rushobora gufasha ibihugu byombi kubwungukiramo uko bikwiye. Namatovu yavuze ko gufasha no gushishikariza ba mukerarugendo bagannye igihugu kimwe kugera no mu kindi kugira ngo barebe ibyiza bihari, bizafasha ibihugu byombi kandi babisigire amadovize mu buryo bwagutse. Yavuze ko uburyo bwo kubahererekanya bworoshye, kuko nk’ikigo gitwara abantu n’ibintu mu ndege, RwandAir, gisanzwe gikora ingendo mu bihugu byinshi birimo na Tanzania. Umuyobozi w’Ishyirahamwe ry’Abatwara n’abatembereza ba mukerarugendo muri Tanzania, TATO, Sirili Akko, yavuze ko ubukerarugendo ari rumwe mu nzego zishobora gufasha Afurika kwikura mu bukene. Ati “Ntabwo ari muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba gusa, ubukerarugendo ni amarembo mashya yafasha umugabane wa Afurika kwikura mu bukene kuko ni kimwe mu bihanga akazi, bugira uruhare rukomeye mu kongerera agaciro ibikorwa.” Akko yavuze ko u Rwanda na Tanzania bidahuje ibikorwa bikurura ba mukerarugendo ku buryo kimwe cyakumva ko gihanganye n’ikindi ahubwo bigomba gukorana byagutse, bikajya bihererekanya ababigana. Umuyobozi  w’ishami ry’ubukerarugendo mu rugaga rw’abikorera, Kageruka Ariella, yavuze ko bikwiye ko ‘Ibihugu byo muri EAC bikangurira ba mukerarugendo babigannye kugera no mu bindi bihugu bituranyi kandi bikaborohereza mu ngendo n’ibindi bibafasha kuhagera. Abikorera bakora mu bukerarugendo muri Tanzania nibo babimburiye gusura bagenzi babo bo mu Rwanda, bakaba bemeranyije ko nabo bazabasura mu gihe cya vuba. [email protected]

title: U Rwanda rwahawe igihembo cy’igihugu kibereye ubukerarugendo
content: Iri murikabikorwa ngarukamwaka ryabaye ku wa 21-23 Gashyantare 2019, u Rwanda rwahagarariwe na Ambasade yarwo mu Bushinwa  ibifashijwemo n’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere, RDB, nk’Uko The New Times yabyanditse. Guangzhou International Travel Fair yatangijwe mu 1993, ihuza abamurika bo mu Bushinwa n’abanyamahanga, igamije kugaragaza no kumenyekanisha ibikorwa byabo. Iry’uyu mwaka ryahuje ibigo birenga 100 byo mu bihugu 55, Ambasade y’u Rwanda yamurikiyemo ibikorwa birimo iby’ubukerarugendo, ibikorerwa mu Rwanda na serivisi za RwandAir. By’umwihariko RwandAir iri mu myiteguro yo gutangiriza ingendo mu mujyi wa Guangzhou, Umurwa mukuru w’Intara ya Guangdong iherereye mu majyepfo y’u Bushinwa. Ibikorwa by’u Rwanda byamuritswe hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga rya ‘live streaming’ rikorerwa ku mbuga nkoranyambaga bikurikiranwa n’ababarirwa muri za miliyoni. U Rwanda rwahawe igihembo cy’ahantu heza ho gukorerwa ubukerarugendo kubera ibikorwa bibushingiyeho byamuritswe birimo imbyino gakondo zakunzwe na benshi. Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Bushinwa, Charles Kayonga, yabwiye itangazamakuru ko ‘Abakerarugendo b’Abashinwa bishimira gukorera ingendo mu Rwanda, ndetse ko ubu bashobora kugura ibibukomokaho bifashishije ikoranabuhanga’ kuri porogaramu y’urubuga rwa Alibaba banyuze ahari ‘VisitRwanda’. Yavuze ko kuba RwandAir igiye gutangiza ingendo zijya zikanava Guangzhou, bizorohereza ibihugu byombi gukora ubucuruzi, kongera ubukerarugendo n’ishoramari ry’u Bushinwa muri Afurika. Umwaka ushize u Rwanda rwasuwe n’abakerarugendo bo mu Bushinwa barenga 800 ariko biteganyijwe ko uyu mubare uzazamuka mu 2019. Umuyobozi w’umujyi wa Tuanjie, Li Chenggang, yavuze ko nyuma yo gusura u Rwanda mu 2017 ‘Yifuza kongera kurusura mu gihe cya vuba kuko ari rwiza kandi rufite umuco utangaje’. Muri uyu mwaka Rwanda ruritegura kwitabira imurikabikorwa ry’ubuhinzi bw’indabo rizabera mu Mujyi wa Beijing n’imurikagurisha rihuza abacuruzi bo muri Afurika no mu Bushinwa rizabera ahitwa Changsha.

title: U Rwanda nicyo gihugu rukumbi cyo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara ubukungu buzazamuka ku 8%
content: Iyi raporo yasohotse ku wa Gatatu igaragaza ko muri rusange ubukungu bw’aka karere buzakomeza kuzamuka kubera uburyo abashoramari bakomeje kukagirira icyizere. Muri rusange Banki y’Isi itangaza ko muri uyu mwaka, ubukungu bw’u Rwanda  aribwo buzazamuka kurenza ibindi bihugu byiganjemo ibyo mu karere kuko buzagera ku 8.1%, mu gihe nk’u Burundi bwo buzaba buri kuri 2% gusa. Uko ibihugu by’akarere bihagaze Banki y’Isi igaragaza ko mu bihugu byo mu karere, uretse u Rwanda ruzaba ruri ku 8.1%, Tanzania izazamuka kuri 5.8%, Uganda kuri 6.5%, u Burundi kuri 2%, Kenya kuri  6%, Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo 3.9%  naho Ethiopia ni 6.3%. Banki y’Isi ivuga ko u Rwanda ruzakomeza kuzamuka mu bukungu kubera impinduka zikomeye mu bijyanye n’imiyoborere myiza, kongera ibikorwa remezo, uburezi kuri bose, gufasha abashoramari n’ibindi. Itanga urugero uburyo u Rwanda rwabaye urwa mbere mu bihugu mu bihugu biri munsi y’Ubutayu bwa Sahara mu 2018 mu bijyanye no koroshya ishoramari, rukaba n’urwa 29 ku rwego rw’Isi. Muri raporo yasohotse umwaka ushize, u Rwanda rwagumye ku mwanya wa kabiri muri Afurika nk’ahantu byoroshye gukorera ubucuruzi, ruba n’urwa 38 ku Isi. Iyi raporo nshya kandi igaragaza ko u Rwanda rwashyize ingufu mu bijyanye no kwigisha kwihangirira imirimo mu mashuri yisumbuye, intego ari ugufasha no gutegura abakiri bato kuzaba ba rwiyemezamirimo no kubaha ubushobozi bwo guhangana ku isoko ry’umurimo. Raporo kandi igaragaza ko mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere, imirimo ibyara inyungu izakomeza kwihagararaho ku buryo izakomeza gutera imbere hejuru ya 6%. Mu bihugu birimo u Rwanda na Benin, uku gutera imbere kuzafashwa n’ishoramari za leta zikomeje gushyira mu bikorwa remezo, ubuhinzi n’uburyo abikorera bakomeje kwiyongera. U Rwanda, Ethiopia, Mali, Nigeria na Guinea, raporo igaragaza ko byashoboye guhangana n’ihindagurika ry’ibiciro ku bijyanye n’ibikomoka kuri peteroli. Iyi raporo kandi igaragaza u Rwanda nk’igihugu cyagabanyije ikibazo cy’ingufu z’amashanyarazi. Banki y’Isi yagaragaje ko mu bindi bizatuma ubukungu bw’u Rwanda bukomeza gutera imbere, harimo uburyo rwashyizeho gahunda ihamye ifasha mu guhangana n’ihindagurika ry’ibiciro bya hato na hato mu bijyanye no gutwara abagenzi. Mu bindi bihugu, iyi raporo igaragaza ko nko muri Afurika y’Epfo buzazamuka kuri 0.9%, Angola kuri 1.5%, Nigeria 2.1%. Muri rusange ku rwego rw’Isi, iyi raporo ya Banki y’Isi igaragaza ko ubukungu buzazamuka kuri 2.5% mu 2020, mu gihe umwaka ushize byari  kuri 2.4%. Banki y’Isi iteganya ko mu 2021 ubukungu bw’Isi buzazamuka kuri 2.6%, mu gihe mu 2022 buzaba buri kuri 2.7%. Mu Ukuboza umwaka ushize, Ikigo cy’Igihugu y’Ibarurishamibare, NISR, cyatangaje ko mu gihembwe cya gatatu cya 2019, umusaruro mbumbe w’u Rwanda ubariye ku biciro ku isoko, wazamutseho 11.9 ku ijana ukagera kuri miliyari 2 358 Frw uvuye kuri miliyari 2 065 Frw, zabarurwaga mu gihembwe cya gatatu cya 2018. Muri icyo gihembwe urwego rw’ubuhinzi rwazamutseho 8%, urw’inganda rwazamutseho 14%, urwa serivisi ruzamuka 13% ndetse ibikenerwa mu gihugu bizamukaho 17%. Bimwe mu byazamuye cyane urwego rw’inganda harimo ibikorwa by’ubwubatsi byiyongereyeho 29% ndetse n’ibikorerwa mu nganda byazamutseho 13 ku ijana. Gusa ibijyanye n’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro byo byagabanutseho 16%. Urwego rwa serivisi rwazamutseho 13 ku ijana ahanini bitewe n’ubucuruzi bw’ibikorerwa mu Rwanda byazamutseho 25%, ibijyanye n’ubwikorezi byazamutse 18%, serivisi z’imari zizamuka 9%, serivisi za hoteli na resitora zizamukaho 15%. Mu buhinzi, izamuka rya 8% ahanini ryatewe n’izamuka ry’ibihingwa ngandurarugo byazamutse 5% n’ibihingwa byoherezwa mu mahanga byazamutseho 22% nk’ikawa cyazamutse 22% mu gihe icyayi cyazamutse 29%.

title: Ibiciro by’ibiribwa byiyongereyeho 6.7% mu Ukuboza 2019
content: Igipimo ngenderwaho cyifashishwa mu bukungu bw’u Rwanda kiboneka hifashishijwe gusa ibiciro byakusanyijwe mu mijyi. Iki kigo kivuga ko ihinduka ry’ibiciro mu Ugushyingo 2019 ryari ku kigereranyo kingana na 6.9%. Muri raporo cyashyize ahagaragara ivuga ku gipimo cy’ihindagurika ry’ibiciro mu Ukuboza, cyatangaje ko bimwe mu byatumye ibiciro byiyongeraho 6.7% muri uko kwezi, byatewe n’ibiciro by’ibiribwa n’ibinyobwa bidasembuye byazamutseho 14.9% n’ibiciro by’ibinyobwa bisembuye n’itabi byazamutseho 20.6%. Kivuga ko iyo ugereranyije Ukuboza kwa 2019 n’Ukuboza kwa  2018, usanga ibiciro by’ibintu bitarimo ibiribwa n’ibikomoka ku ngufu byarazamutseho 3.6%, wagereranya Ukuboza 2019 n’Ugushyingo 2019 ho ibiciro byagabanutseho 0.3%. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa NISR, Yusuf Murangwa, aherutse kuvugira  mu Nama y’Igihugu y’Umushyikirano yabaye mu Ukuboza 2019 ko  hari impamvu ebyiri zishobora gusobanura isano iri hagati y’izamuka ry’ubukungu mu Rwanda buri ku kigero cya 8% ku mwaka n’ibiciro byazamutse ku isoko muri iki gihe. Yavuze ko byatewe n’uko mu mezi ya Ugushyingo na Ukuboza akenshi umusaruro uba waragabanutse, kandi ko haguye imvura nyinshi ikangiza ibihingwa. Indi mpamvu ikomeye ni uko usanga abantu bose bahanze amaso umusaruro w’ubuhinzi, bitaretse n’ubwiyongere bw’abaturage bubigiramo uruhare. Ati “Uko ubukungu buzamuka, abakenera umusaruro w’ubuhinzi, baba benshi, buri mwaka umubare w’abaturage uriyongera iyo ubukungu bwazamutse bagira n’ubushobozi bwo gushaka gukoresha wa musaruro w’ubuhinzi.” Yasobanuye ko uretse abashaka kurya, usanga inganda n’abacuruzi na bo bakeneye wa musaruro ibyo byose bigatuma uhari uhenda. Indi nkuru wasoma:Ishusho y’izamuka ry’ibiciro by’ibiribwa byikubye kabiri ku masoko yo mu Rwanda

title: Ubukungu bw’isi bwitezweho kuzamuka ku kigero cya 2.5 % muri 2020
content: Muri iyi raporo izwi nka Global Economic Prospects yashyizwe hanze kuri uyu wa Gatatu, Banki y’Isi ivuga ko  izamuka ry’ubukungu mu bihugu byateye imbere rizaganyukaho 1.4 %  kubera kugabanyuka kw’ibikorerwa mu nganda mu gihe mu bihugu biri gutera imbere n’ibiri mu nzira y’amajyambere ubukungu buzazamukaho 4.1%. Visi Perezida ushinzwe izamuka ry’ubukungu n’imari muri Banki y’Isi, Ceyla Pazarbasioglu yahamagariye abakora igenamigambi mu bihugu bitandukanye gukora amavugurura hakiri kare, azahangana na zimwe mu mbogamizi zishobora kuzitira izamuka ry’ubukungu. Yagize ati “Mu gihe izamuka ry’ubukungu mu bihugu biri gutera imbere n’ibiri mu nzira y’amayambere rizakomeza kuba rito, abafata ibyemezo bakwiriye gufatirana ayo mahirwe bagakora amavugurura azatuma habaho kuzamuka k’ubukungu ari nabyo bizagira uruhare mu kugabanyuka k’ubukene.” Ceyla Pazarbasioglu yavuze ko hakenewe uburyo bworohereza ubucuruzi mu bihugu, iyubahirizwa ry’amategeko, uburyo bwo gucunga amadeni ibihugu bifite n’uburyo bwo kongera ibikorerwa mu bihugu imbere. Ibihugu bikomeye nka Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ubukungu bwabyo biteganyijwe ko buzagabanyukaho 1.8% ahanini bitewe n’ingaruka z’ibyemezo byo kongeza imisoro ku bicuruzwa biva mu Bushinwa no kuba hakiri urwikekwe kuko ntawe uzi iyo bigana. Mu bihugu bikoresha amayero ubukungu buzazamukaho 1 % kubera ibibazo biri mu mikorere y’inganda. Hashingiwe ku turere, Afurika yo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara ubukungu bwayo byitezwe ko buzazamukaho 2.9 % muri uyu mwaka kubera icyizere abashoramari bafitiye bimwe mu bihugu bikomeye muri ako karere. Izamuka ry’ibiciro bya peteroli naryo biteganyijwe rizabigiramo uruhare kuko ibihugu biyicukura bizinjiza menshi, n’umusaruro w’ubuhinzi ukaba witezweho kugenda neza. Mu bihugu nka Afurika y’Epfo biteganyijwe ko ubukungu buzazamukaho 0.9 %, muri Nigeria buzazamukaho 2.1 % naho muri Angola buzamukeho 1.5 %. Muri Kenya biteganyijwe ko ubukungu buzazamukaho 6 %. Muri Aziya na Pacifique, ubukungu bwitezweho kuzamuka ku kigero cya 5.7 %, mu Burayi na Aziya yo hagati buzaguma kuri 2.6 %, muri Amerika y’Amajyepfo buzazamuka kuri 1.8 % mu gihe mu Burasirazuba bwo hagati na Afurika y’Amajyaruguru ubukungu buzazamukaho 2.4 %. Raporo ya Banki y’isi igaragaza ko muri Aziya y’Amajyepfo ubukungu buzazamuka ku kigero cya 5.5 %.

title: Muhanga: BDF yafashije urubyiruko gutangiza umushinga wunguka ibihumbi 30 ku munsi
content: Urwo rubyiruko rugizwe n’abahungu batanu n’abakobwa batanu rwishyize hamwe nyuma yo kumara umwaka wose rwiga umwuga wo gutunganya imisatsi mu Ishuri ry’Imyuga rya Gahogo TVT School. Rwashinze Sosiyete yitwa Beauty in the Sky Ltd ari nayo rukoreramo ibyo bikorwa byarwo. Umuyobozi wa Beauty in the Sky Ltd, Habihirwe Habis, avuga ko bakirangiza kwiga biyemeje kujyana umushinga wabo muri BDF, ibafasha kuwunoza no kubona inguzanyo mu Murenge Sacco. Ati “BDF yadufashije kubona miliyoni eshanu z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ariko harimo ibikoresho byo muri salon bya miliyoni enye na miliyoni imwe baduhaye ku ruhande tuyikoresha mu gukodesha inzu n’ibindi.” Bimwe mu bikoresho baguze bigezweho harimo intebe, indorerwamo, amatara, casques, imashini zogosha n’ibindi bitandukanye bifashisha mu kogosha no gutunganya umusatsi. Bakorera mu nzu nziza bakodesha ibihumbi 200 Frw ku kwezi iri rwagati mu Mujyi wa Muhanga. Muri ayo mafaranga miliyoni eshanu bahawe bazishyuramo 50% kandi bazatangirana n’uku kwezi kwa Mutarama 2020 kuko umushinga wabo watangiye kunguka. Habihirwe avuga ko mu mezi atatu bamaze batangiye uwo mushinga, batangiye kubona inyungu ifatika kandi batanze akazi gahoraho ku bantu batanu. Ati “Iyo umunsi wagenze neza dushobora kubona inyungu y’amafaranga ibihumbi 30 Frw twamaze guhemba abakozi bose; urumva ko ari umushinga mwiza.” Umwe mu bagize iyo  sosiyete, Umutesi Agnes, avuga ko bishimira ko umushinga wabo babashije kuwushyira mu bikorwa kandi ukomeje gutera imbere. Ati “Intego twihaye mbona igenda igerwaho kuko turakora inyungu ikaboneka.” Umutesi agira inama urubyiruko by’umwihariko abakobwa gutinyuka bagakora kuko nabo bashoboye. Umukozi wa BDF mu Karere ka Muhanga, Murigande Félix, yavuze ko urubyiruko rwo muri Beauty in the Sky Ltd rufite umushinga mwiza kandi ruwushyira mu bikorwa uko bikwiye. Murigande yavuze ko mu 2019 honyine bafashije abantu bagera ku 150 kubona ibikoresho byo gutangiza imishinga yabo. Bazishyura 50% by’ayo bahawe. Naho abo bishingiye mu 2019 mu bigo by’imari kugira ngo bahabwe inguzanyo ni abantu 126. Yasabye n’abandi bafite imishinga bifuza gushyira mu bikorwa kugana BDF ikabagira inama ikabafasha no kubona inguzanyo. Ikigega BDF cyashinzwe mu 2011 na Banki y’u Rwanda Itsura Amajyambere, BRD. By’umwihariko BDF iha amahirwe abagore n’urubyiruko kurusha abandi, kuko ni bo bahabwa ubufasha bwo kubemerera kubishingira nk’ingwate ku kigero cya 75%, mu gihe abagabo bo bemererwa kwishingirwa ku kigero cya 50%.
