title: Amafaranga y’abikorera akomeje kuba iyanga ngo hubakwe isoko rya Rwamagana
content: Ni isoko rizaba rifite inyubako enye zigerekeraye rikabamo ibyangombwa byose nkenerwa, kuryubaka rizatwara miliyari eshatu z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Ni amafaranga azaturuka mu bikorera bo muri aka Karere ndetse n’abandi babyifuza biciye mu kugura imigabane. Kuri ubu abantu 67 nibo bamaze kwemera ko bazagura imigabane muri iri soko,  ni ukuvuga ko abemeye kugura imigabane ayo bazatanga ahwanye na miliyoni 149 n’ibihumbi 500. Muri bo abamaze kwishyura ni mbarwa kuko amafaranga angana na miliyoni 32 ari yo amaze kwishyurwa. Umuyobozi w’Urugaga rw’Abikorera mu Karere ka Rwamagana Munyaneza Célestin, yabwiye IGIHE ko idindira ryatewe n’umuco utari mwiza wo kudafatanya, kudahabwa ikibanza bemerewe n’Akarere n’ibindi. Yagize ati “ Nubwo twavugaga kuryubaka, byari ukubanza guhuza abikorera kugira ngo bafatanye bashyire hamwe imbaraga baryubake, ariko urabizi umuco wacu w’ubufatanye ntabwo uradukwiramo n’ubu turimo turabikora. Tumaze kuzenguruka imirenge yose ndetse n’ubu turateganya gukomeza kubegera, hari abamaze kugira ibyo bemera ndetse baranabitanga ariko ntabwo turagera ku gipimo twifuza.” Yakomeje avuga ko inyigo yaryo yagaragazaga ko kuryubaka bizabatwara miliyari eshatu ariko ngo kugeza ubu hamaze kwemerwa miliyoni 149 n’ibihumbi 500, ababashije kwishyura ngo ni miliyoni 32 akaba ari yo mafaranga bafite kuri konti. Ati “ Ntabwo turacika intege, turacyasaba abikorera kongeramo imbaraga, turifuza gushaka abakorera Kigali kugira ngo tubakangurire gufasha iwabo, ku bufatanye n’Akarere katwemereye ikibanza nubwo katarakiduha no kudukorera inyigo nabyo ntibirarangira ariko batubwira ko bari kubikora.” Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Rwamagana Mbonyumuvunyi Radjab, we yabwiye IGIHE ko mu gihe aba bikorera baba berekanye ko biteguye kubaka ngo Akarere kiteguye kubaha ikibanza cyaba gito bakanacyongera. Ati “ Ikibanza twarakibemereye n’ubu batubwiye ko bakeneye kubaka twakibaha, Nibo bazatwandikira batubwira ngo dukeneye kubaka mu kwezi gutaha, dukeneye ubutaka muduhe ibyangombwa byabwo ubundi tukakibashyikiriza, ntabwo twabubashyikiriza bataratwereka ko bafite gahunda ifatika kuko bwubatseho isoko ntabwo twapfa kurifunga bataratangira.” Kutabona ibisabwa biracyari inzitizi yo gutangira kubaka Munyaneza avuga ko nibura bakeneye 30% y’ibisabwa byose kugira ngo batangire kubaka, ngo nibamara kuyibona bazahita begera banki zitandukanye zibahe amafaranga. Yakomeje avuga  ko kuba Akarere karabemereye ikibanza ariko ntikabahe ibyangombwa by’icyo kibanza nabyo bikibabereye inzitizi. Ati “ Ubundi twifuzaga kubona 30% kuko ni nacyo n’amabanki ageneraho atanga inguzanyo. Twayabonye bashobora kuduha asigaye, Akarere nako kakaduha ikibanza atari ukukitwemerera gusa.” Benshi mu bikorerea bo muri aka Karere baganiriye na IGIHE bavuga ko ikibazo gihari gituruka ku kutarekura amafaranga no kutumva neza kugura imigabane icyo byabamarira. Niyivuga Manisula yagize ati “ Imyumvire yacu iracyari hasi nta kindi kintu kibitera, si ukuvuga ko abacuruzi b’i Rwamagana babuze amafaranga kandi gutanga umugabane ni ukwigomwa ariko kugira ngo yumve ngo yishyuye amafaranga aguze umugabane uzamugirira akamaro mu myaka icumi nicyo kibazo, hari n’abakubwira ngo sinzaba nkiriho.” Munyaneza yavuze ko  bitarenze uyu mwaka bazaba batangiye kubaka. Isoko rihari bazarisenya kuko nicyo kibanza bahawe n’Akarere.

title: Byinshi ku mikorere ya moto zikoresha amashanyarazi n’uko zakiriwe ku isoko ry’u Rwanda
content: Ni umushinga mugari, aho biteganyijwe ko izi moto zikoresha amashanyarazi zizasimbura izikoresha lisansi. Kugira ngo izi moto zigende zikoresha batiri ikoreshwa hagati y’ibilometero 65 na 70 ubundi ukajya guhinduza kuri sitasiyo zabugenewe ubu zimaze kuba eshatu mu Mujyi wa Kigali ari zo; iya Rwandex, Nyabugogo na Kimironko. Umubare w’abamotari bazikoresha mu Rwanda ubu ni 20, aba bapatana n’Ikigo cyitwa Ampersand, kizobereye mu bijyanye n’ibinyabiziga bikoresha uburyo bw’amashanyarazi, bagatanga 37 500 Frw buri cyumweru ku yo bakoreye. Umuyobozi wa Ampersand mu Rwanda akaba n’umwe mu bayishinze, Hakizimana Emmanuel, yabwiye IGIHE ko ubu abamotari bagera ku 7000 bamaze gusaba gukorana nabo, ariko iki kigo gifite intego y’uko byibuze umubare w’abatwara abagenzi kuri moto z’amashanyarazi uzagera kuri 500 uyu mwaka wa 2020. Umwihariko wa moto zikoresha amashanyarazi Hakizimana avuga ko uretse kuba zifite imbaraga mu guterera, zinorohera buri wese kuba yazitwara. Ati “Moto zacu ni ‘automatique’, umuntu wese yayitwara kandi nta mavuta zigira kubera ko nta moteri, ni ukuvuga ko ya mavuta bamenaga buri cyumweru iwacu urayazigama. Ikindi zifite imbaraga mu guterera kandi ku mutekano zifite feri zikomeye cyane.” Ibijyanye no kutangiza ikirere, Hakizimana yemeza ko izi moto ari igisubizo. Ibi bijyana n’ubushakashatsi bwamuritswe n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cyo Kubungabunga Ibidukikije (REMA) mu 2017 bwagaragaje ko ibiza ku isonga mu guhumanya umwuka uhumekwa mu Rwanda harimo umwotsi w’imodoka, moto, imyotsi y’amakara n’inkwi n’ibindi. Gasago Venuste umaze amezi atanu atwara moto ikoresha amashanyarazi, avuga ko amafaranga yunguka aruta ayo yabonaga agikoresha moto inywa lisansi. Ati “Litiro ya lisansi igura 1070Frw ikagenda ibilometero 45 ariko izi iyo ugiye guhinduza batiri igenda ibilometero 60 cyangwa 70 kandi wishyuye 940Frw. Kuri batiri nkorera 5000Frw kandi urebye ziriya zisanzwe litiro ntiwarenza 3500Frw.” Mugenzi we witwa Turatsinze Emmanuel avuga ko atarota asubira kuri moto zinywa lisansi. Ati “Iriya isanzwe iyo itobotse uhagarara aho ariko iyi (iy’amashanyarazi) wayigenderaho n’iminsi ibiri. Niyo banyirukana najya ndoba ntabwo nasubira ku ya lisansi, kuyisubiraho naba mvuye mu wa kabiri ngiye muwa mbere.” Iradukunda Robert, umugenzi wakoresheje moto z’amashanyarazi yazishimiye rasoro zifite zituma iyo ugeze mu mukuku utapfa kubyumva, umuvuduko wazo no kuba uzigenderaho nta rusaku aba yumva. Izi moto hari icyo zinengwa Iyo witegereje ingano y’iyi moto n’izisanzwe ubona ko yo ari nini ndetse iraremereye, motari ntibimusaba kuyihata imigeri ngo ihaguruke kuko yo ari ‘automatique’. Uretse kubona ko urimo uva ahantu hamwe werekeza ahandi, ntushobora kumva ijwi rihinda rituruka muri moteri cyangwa mugasohora mwotsi. Abamotari batwara izi moto z’amashanyarazi icyifuzo bahuriraho ni uko hakongerwa ibilometero amabatiri yazo agenda mbere yo guhindurwa, na sitasiyo umuntu ashobora gusangaho batiri zikiyongera hirya no hino mu gihugu. Ntawukirasongwa Jean Marie Vianney utwara moto za lisansi avuga ko adatashobora kujya ku z’amashanyarazi kuko bitamworohera kujya abona batiri aho ashatse hose. Ibi abihuza na Maniriho Gerard wagize ati “Iriya moto nta ‘chargeur’ igira ku buryo no mu rugo wayishyiramo umuriro, urebye nabi yakuzimiraho uri mu nzira.” Ku bijyanye no kongera ubushobozi bw’ibilometero batiri zifite mbere yo guhindurwa, Hakizimana, yemeza ko ari ikintu bari kwitaho. Ati “Ni byo ikipe yacu turi gutekerezaho, ariko mu by’ukuri navuga ko ikoranabuhnga rya batiri ku isi ritaratwemerera, tuzajya dukora ibishoboka. Turacyatekereza kongera za sitasiyo, gusa uko abamotari bacu bangana izihari zirabahaza”. Ubushakashatsi bugaragaza ko buri mwaka hapfa abantu miliyoni zirindwi bazize umwuka uhumanye. Minisiteri y’Ubuzima mu Rwanda igaragaza ko buri mwaka mu mavuriro hakirwa miliyoni eshatu z’abivuza indwara z’ubuhumekero barimo 13% bazitewe n’ihumana ry’ikirere.

title: Abanyarwanda bagiye kwerekeza mu Bufaransa kunoza ubucuruzi bw’ikawa n’icyayi na Paris St Germain
content: Tariki 5 Ukuboza 2019, Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ubukerarugendo, RDB, nibwo cyatangiye ubufatanye na PSG buzamara imyaka itatu bugamije kureshya abashoramari no gukomeza kuba icyerekezo kibereye ubukerarugendo. Muri ubu bufatanye, ikirango cya Visit Rwanda kigaragazwa kuri Stade ya Parc des Princes aho PSG yakirira imikino yayo no ku mugongo ku myenda iyi kipe ikoresha mu myitozo no mu gihe cyo kwishyushya mbere y’imikino, yaba iyo yambara yasuye indi kipe cyangwa iyo yambara iwayo muri Shampiyona y’u Bufaransa, Ligue 1. Muri ubu bufatanye kandi, u Rwanda na PSG byasinyanye amasezerano  yo guzacuruza icyayi cy’u Rwanda  muri Parc des Princes n’ikawa ikamenyekanishwa mu Bufaransa. Minisitiri w’Ubuhinzi n’Ubworozi, Mukeshimana Géraldine, yabwiye itangazamakuru ko kuba amasezerano yaragezweho ari ikintu cyiza cyane ko igiciro cy’icyayi n’ikawa bidahagaze neza ku isoko mpuzamahanga. Yagize ati “Icyayi cyacu cyagiye kigira amahirwe ariko buriya mu cyayi habamo ibyiciro byinshi, hari aho usanga nk’icyiciro  cya mbere cy’icyayi, igiciro kiri hejuru ku buryo kigurwa   nka $7. Ibi ntibivuze ko toni ibihumbi 32 twejeje zose zaguzwe ayo amadorali, hari aho muri rusange nk’icyiciro cy’icyayi cyacu cyaguze $2.20.” Yongeyeho ko  n’ikawa yageze aho igira igiciro kitari cyiza, usanga kiri no munsi y’igishoro umuhinzi yakoresheje. Ati “Ibi byatumye abahinzi batangira kubona ko nta nyungu irimo, bisaba ko leta yinjiramo ku buryo  amafaranga abahinzi batangaga bagura ifumbire ijya muri kawa, byasabye ko  leta itangamo miliyari 5 Frw muri uyu mwaka kugira ngo abahinzi batazagira amafaranga batanga.” Dr Mukeshimana avuga ko ibiciro  byakomeje kugenda bigorana, ku buryo  uburyo bwari busigaye byari ugushaka amasoko yandi. Ati “Ubu isoko rya Alibaba ni rimwe mu  masoko adufasha, iri rya PSG aho iyi kipe yakinnye abantu bakanywa icyayi cy’u Rwanda n’ikawa naho ni uko. Ubu turi mu biganiro by’uburyo bizagenda bikorwa, ku buryo hagati ya tariki 20-26 Mutarama 2020, abantu bacu bazajya i Paris gukorana n’abantu ba Paris St Germain, kugira ngo twige neza uko iki gikorwa kizagenda.” Ubu bufatanye bwitezweho kurushaho gufungurira amarembo abashoramari bo mu Bufaransa no mu bindi bice by’Isi ku buryo babyaza umusaruro amahirwe aboneka mu Rwanda. U Rwanda rwiteze ko binyuze muri ubu bufatanye, abakinnyi ba PSG n’ibindi byamamare mpuzamahanga, bizabafasha gusura u Rwanda, bakabona ibyiza bitatse igihugu cy’imisozi 1000 uhereye ku bijyanye n’ubugeni, umuco, siporo, muzika, ubukerarugendo, amafunguro n’ubwiza bw’igihugu muri rusange. Ubu bufatanye buteganya ko icyayi cy’u Rwanda n’ikawa aribyo byonyine bizajya bitangwa kuri Parc des Princes. Hazabaho kandi icyumweru cy’imishinga y’abanyempano b’Abanyarwanda n’Abafaransa. Icyo cyumweru cyiswe “Semaine du Rwanda à Paris” kizajya gitegurwa na PSG mu kumenyekanisha ibintu byose bikorerwa mu Rwanda. Mu bijyanye no kuzamura impano z’u Rwanda, PSG izagira uruhare mu kuzamura abakiri bato binyuze mu gushinga ishuri ry’umupira w’amaguru i Kigali, aho iyi kipe izajya itegura imyitozo y’abatoza n’abakiri bato. Mu 2018, binyuze mu Kigo gishinzwe guteza imbere Ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku Nama, RCB, u Rwanda rwinjiye mu bufatanye bw’imyaka itatu n’ikipe ya Arsenal FC, aho ubu yambara imyenda yanditseho ‘Visit Rwanda’ ndetse ikarumenyekanisha mu bundi buryo butandukanye. RDB iheruka kuvuga ko ubufatanye bw’u Rwanda na Arsenal FC, bumaze kugira inyungu ibarirwa muri miliyoni 36 z’amapawundi, ni ukuvuga asaga miliyari 36 Frw. Ikawa ni kimwe mu bihingwa bifatiye runini ubukungu bw’u Rwanda. Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe kohereza mu Mahanga ibikomoka ku Buhinzi n’Ubworozi (NAEB) cyatangaje ko mu 2018 hoherejwe toni ibihumbi 24 za kawa mu mahanga, havamo amafaranga agera kuri miliyoni $67. Mu 2019 hari intego yo kugeza kuri miliyoni 75 z’amadorali avuye muri kawa. Umwaka wa 2018 wasize u Rwanda rusuwe n’abakerarugendo miliyoni 1.7.

title: Ikigo Alphabet kibarizwamo Google cyinjiye mu bifite agaciro ka tiriyari 1$
content: Apple nicyo kigo gifite agaciro kanini muri Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho ku isoko ifite agaciro ka tiriyari 1.4$. Microsoft ifite agaciro ka tiriyari $1.3. Ni ku nshuro ya mbere ibigo bitatu byo muri Amerika bigize icyarimwe agaciro nibura ka tiriyari y’amadolari. Ikigo gifite agaciro kanini ku Isi ni igitunganya ibikomoka kuri peteroli na Gas cya Saudi Aramco, giherereye Dhahran muri Arabie Saoudite. Mu kwezi gushize byatangajwe ko iki kigo gifite agaciro ka tiriyari 2$ kuri ubu kikaba gifite agaciro kabarirwa muri tiriyari 1.8$. Amazon ubungubu ibarirwa agaciro ka miliyari 930$ yabaye ikigo cya kabiri cyo muri Amerika cyageze ku gaciro ka tiriyari 1$, mu 2018. Muri icyo gihe, Apple nicyo kigo kindi cyari gifite agaciro karenga tiriyari 1$. Imigabane ya Alphabet yageze kuri tiriyari 1$ mbere y’uko isoko ry’imigabane rifungwa kuwa Kane, aho yacuruje umugabane umwe ku $1,451.70 ukaba warazamutseho 0.87%. Ikindi kigo cyo muri Amerika byitezwe ko kizagera ku gaciro ka tiriyari 1$ mu gihe cya vuba ni Facebook, aho isoko ryafunzwe kuwa Kane kibarirwa muri miliyari 620$. Mu kwezi gushize Alphabet yahinduye ubuyobozi aho Larry Page na Sergey Brin bavuye ku nshingano zo gukurikirana ibikorwa by’iki kigo. Sundar Pichai wari umaze igihe kirekire ayobora Google, niwe wahise agirwa Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Alphabet Inc ibumbiye hamwe ibigo nka Google, Calico, DeepMind, Google Fiber, Jigsaw, Sidewalk Labs, Verily, Waymo n’ibindi.

title: U Rwanda rwungutse inzobere 32 zizarufasha gukumira ko umusaruro w’inganda ubengwa n’abanyamahanga
content: Aya mahugurwa yasojwe kuri uyu wa 16 Mutarama 2020 bayahawe na RSB ku bufatanye n’Umuryango w’Ubumwe bw’Ibihugu by’u Burayi mu mushinga ukorerwa mu bihugu bitanu byo mu Karere ka Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Bimwe mu byo bigishijwe harimo kugenzura iyubahirizwa ry’ubuziranenge bw’ibiribwa, gukora ibintu mu buryo buhendutse, kubahiriza ibisabwa ku isoko mpuzamahanga kandi bibifasha guhangana kuri urwo rwego. Ni amahugurwa aba bakozi barimo abo muri RSB no mu bindi bigo bitandukanye byiganjemo inganda bahawe n’impuguke zitandukanye zo mu Karere n’ahandi. Umuyobozi ushinzwe gahunda y’Uruganda Iwacu muri Minisiteri y’Ubucuruzi n’Inganda, Dr Nshimyumukiza Ossiniel, uri mu bahuguwe yavuze ko akenshi usanga inganda zimwe zikora ibintu bifite ubuziranenge buke bitewe n’uko nta bakozi b’inzobere bazikurikirana cyangwa ngo bazigire inama mu rugendo rwo gutunganya ibyo zikora. Hari kandi urwego rw’ikoranabuhanga ruciriritse, abakozi bashoboye n’ibindi. Ati “Akazi kacu kari mu gufasha inganda nto n’iziciriritse mu bigendanye n’aho bafite intege nke. Tugiye gusuzuma ibitagenda muri bya bigo, turebe aho ibintu bipfira tubafashe kandi tubagire inama z’icyo bakora.” Umuyobozi wa RSB, Murenzi Raymond, yagize ati “Babonye aya mahugurwa kugira ngo dukore itsinda ry’abantu bashobora gufasha inganda kumenya ibisabwa no kuzishyira ku murongo ku buryo buzuza ubuziranenge busabwa kuri ayo masoko mpuzamahanga.” Yavuze ko nubwo muri iyi minsi nta gicuruzwa cyo mu Rwanda gishorwa mu mahanga ngo kinengwe, mbere y’uko uru rwego rushyirwa byabagaho. Bisobanuye ko guhugura aba bakozi bigamije kwagura isoko ry’ibikorerwa mu Rwanda no kubifasha guhangana ku isoko mpuzamahanga. Ambasaderi wa EU mu Rwanda, Nicola Bellomo, yavuze ko umuryango ahagarariye ugira uruhare mu kongera umusaruro w’inganda, ubuhinzi n’izindi nzego. Ati “Intego yacu si ukongera gusa ubwinshi bw’umusaruro ahubwo ni no kongera ubwiza bwawo kugira ngo ubashe gucuruzwa ku masoko y’imbere mu gihugu, mu Karere no ku rwego mpuzamahanga arimo n’ayo mu Muryango w’Ubumwe bw’Ibihugu by’u Burayi.” RSB igaragaza ko mu Rwanda hari ibicuruzwa bimaze guhabwa ibyemezo by’ubuziranenge birenga 542 biri ku masoko yo mu Rwanda, mu Karere n’ahandi hose ku Isi mu gihe mu myaka 10 ishize nta na kimwe cyari gifite icyangombwa cy’ubuziranenge. title: Ibiciro bishya by’imisoro ku bibanza byashyizwe ahagaragara
content:
Uyu musoro washyizweho mu rwego rwo kuvugurura imiturire hemezwa ko uzajya utangwa hashingiwe ku cyiciro cy’umujyi ubutaka busoreshwa buherereyemo; urwego rw’iterambere ubutaka busoreshwa buherereyemo; icyo ubutaka busoreshwa bwagenewe n’ikigero ubutaka bwateguweho ngo bukoreshwe icyo bwagenewe. Iteka rya Minisitiri ryo ku wa 10 Mutarama 2020 rigena ibipimo fatizo n’ibindi bikurikizwa mu kugena umusoro wishyurwa ku bibanza, rivuga ko ibibanza biri mu turere dukorerwamo ibikorwa by’iterambere mu Mujyi wa Kigali n’indi mijyi y’uturere igaragaza iterambere by’umwihariko ahagenewe ibikorwa bibyara inyungu, bigomba gutanga umusoro uruta uw’ibibanza biri ahagenewe guturwa. Iri teka rivuga kandi ko ibibanza biri mu mijyi bigomba kuzajya bisoreshwa amafaranga aruta ay’ibibanza biri mu duce tw’icyaro, nabwo hagashingirwa ku cyateganyijwe gukorerwa aho hantu ndetse n’ibikorwa remezo byahashyizwe. Ibibanza biri mu Mujyi wa Kigali, ahagenewe ubucuruzi n’ inganda, kandi ubutaka bwaho bukaba bwarateguwe, bufite ibikorwaremezo by’ibanze, bizajya bisoreshwa amafaranga y’u Rwanda 250 kugeza kuri 300 kuri metero kare imwe y’ubutaka mu gihe cy’umwaka. Ibibanza biri mu Mujyi wa Kigali ahagenewe ubucuruzi n’ inganda, ubutaka bwaho bwarateguwe ariko budafite ibikorwaremezo by’ibanze, bizajya bisoreshwa amafaranga y’u Rwanda 125 kugeza ku 150 kuri metero kare imwe y’ubutaka buri umwaka ; mu gihe ahari ubutaka butateguwe nta musoro uzajya uhakwa. Ibibanza biri mu Mujyi wa Kigali ahagenewe guturwa, ubukerarugendo n’imyidagaduro, hateguwe kandi hafite ibikorwaremezo by’ibanze bizajya bisoreshwa amafaranga 200 kugeza kuri 250 kuri metero kare. Abafite ibibanza mu masanteri aciriritse y’umujyi, hagenewe guturwa kandi ubutaka bwaho buteguwe bunafite ibikorwaremezo by’ibanze, bazajya basora amafaranga 100 kugeza ku 150; mu gihe ahagenewe ubucuruzi bazajya basora amafara 150 kugeza kuri 200. Iri teka rivuga ko uturere tubarizwamo imijyi yunganira Kigali ndetse na tumwe mu duhana imbibi n’Umujyi wa Kigali dushyirwa mu cyiciro cya kabiri mu gusoresha ibibanza, bikubarizwa hashingiwe ku ngingo ziteganywa n’iri teka. Utwo turere ni Muhanga, Rubavu, Musanze, Huye, Nyagatare, Karongi, Rusizi, Bugesera, Kamonyi na Rwamagana Abafite ibibanza muri utu turere, bibarizwa ahagenewe ubucuruzi cyangwa inganda, bazajya basora amafaranga y’u Rwanda kuva ku 100 kugeza ku 140, mu gihe ikibanza kiri ku butaka bwateguwe kandi bufite ibikorwaremezo by’ibanze ariko kiri ahagenewe guturwa, ubukerarugendo n’imyidagaduro cyo gisoreshwa amafaranga y’u Rwanda 50 kugeza ku 100 kuri metero kare imwe ku mwaka. Ikindi cyiciro cyakwitwa icya gatatu kibarizwamo uturere twa Nyabihu, Gicumbi, Rulindo, Kayonza, Ngoma, Kirehe, Gatsibo, Ruhango, Nyanza, Burera, Ngororero, Gakenke, Nyaruguru, Gisagara, Nyamagabe, Rutsiro na Nyamasheke. Muri utu turere, umusoro ku bibanza biri mu masanteri y’ubucuruzi, santeri y’inkengero z’umujyi na santeri yo mu gace kandi hagenewe guturwa, bizajya bisoreshwa amafaranga y’u Rwanda 8 kugeza kuri 15 kuri metero kare imwe ku mwaka, mu gihe ubutaka bwateguwe kandi bufite ibikorwaremezo by’ibanze; naho ibibanza biri ahagenewe ubuhinzi n’ubworozi bisoreshwe amafaranga 2 kugeza ku 10 kuri metero kare imwe y’ubutaka. Ahantu hafatwa nk’icyaro muri utu turere, ibibanza byaho biri ahagenewe guturwa kandi ubutaka bwaho bwarateguwe, bufite ibikorwaremezo by’ibanze bizajya bisoreshwa amafaranga 4 kugeza ku 8 y’u Rwanda kuri metero kare imwe y’ubutaka ku mwaka. Kanda hano usome iri teka ingingo ku yindi
Izindi nkuru wasoma:  Umusoro ku butaka wongerewe, hashyirwaho umwihariko ku bafite ibibanza bidakoreshwa  Umusoro w’ubutaka utangwa ute?  Itegeko rishya ry’ubutaka riri mu nyungu za nde?

title: Ibyihariye kuri ‘Rapid Transfer’ uburyo bwa Ecobank Rwanda bufasha guhererekanya amafaranga muri Afurika
content: Si ibyo gusa kuko n’imibereho ya muntu muri iki gihe imuhatira gushabikira hirya no hino, rimwe na rimwe agasabwa gukorera mu bihugu birenze kimwe. Nta kabuza ko icyo gihe azakenera guhererekanya amafaranga n’abandi bakorana, inshuti n’abavandimwe atabasha kugeraho ako kanya kandi bitamutwaye umwanya cyangwa ngo bihungabanye ubushabitsi bwe. Mu rwego rwo gusubiza ibyifuzo n’ibibazo by’abantu batandukanye, Banki y’Ubucuruzi ya Ecobank yashyizeho uburyo bwihariye bufasha abakiliya bayo n’abayigana guhererekanya amafaranga mu bihugu 33 ikoreramo muri Afurika. Ubu buryo buzwi nka Rapid Transfer bufasha umuntu koherereza, kwakira cyangwa gusaba amafaranga mugenzi we uri muri kimwe mu bihugu Ecobank ikoreramo bitamuhenze kandi mu buryo bwihuse. Umuyobozi w’Ishami rishinzwe Serivisi zo guhererekanya Amafaranga na Mobile Money muri Ecobank Rwanda, Murenzi Patrick, yabwiye IGIHE ko Rapid Transfer ari serivisi y’umwihariko iki kigo cy’imari kimaze kubaka izina cyatangije igamije koroherereza abakiliya bayo n’abandi bayigana. Ati “Muri Afurika tugira benewacu baba baragiye gushaka imibereho hanze basize imiryango yabo, iyo bagezeyo bakenera kugira icyo bagenera benewabo basize mu gihugu baturutsemo, bagakenera kuboherereza amafaranga batarinze kugaruka.” Si ibyo gusa kuko nk’abakora ubucuruzi mpuzamahanga bashobora gukenera amafaranga yo kunganira ubucuruzi bwabo igihe bagiye mu mahanga bakaba basaba abo bakorana kuboherereza kugira ngo bukomeze. Ati “Rapid Transfer uko ikora harimo kwakira, kohereza no kubasha gukura amafaranga kuri konti yawe igihe utari mu gihugu waturutsemo wenda tuvuge ushobora kuba ukorera muri Nigeria ariko ufite konti muri Ecobank yo mu Rwanda, ukaba wakura amafaranga kuri konti ya Ecobank Rwanda ukabasha kuyakira uri Nigeria.” Iyi serivisi iboneka ku mashami yose ya Ecobank ari mu bihugu 33 muri Afurika aho uyishaka ahasanga abakozi babizobereyemo bakamufasha kubikora. Si aho gusa kuko iki kigo cy’imari kimaze kwigarurira benshi by’umwihariko muri serivisi zifashisha ikoranabuhanga kuko cyanashyizeho uburyo abafite telefoni zigezweho bashobora kubyikorera bifashishije porogaramu yitwa ‘Ecobank Mobile App’ igaragara kuri Play Store na App store. Rapid Transfer kandi ishobora gukoreshwa n’abafite mudasobwa cyangwa telefoni zigezweho batarinze gukoresha iyo APP ariko bafite internet, uburyo buzwi nka ‘Ecobank Online’. Ati “Ushobora koherereza amafaranga umuntu ufite konti muri Ecobank cyangwa n’utayifitemo, akayafata muri Ecobank cyangwa mu yindi banki kimwe n’uko yanayafata ku mu-agent mu gihugu Ecobank iherereyemo.” Ecobank ikorera mu bihugu birimo Cape Vert, Sénégal, Guinea, Mali, Gambia, Guinea-Bissau, Sierra Leone, Liberia,Côte d’Ivoire, Burkina Faso, Ghana, Togo, Benin, Niger, Nigeria, Cameroun, Chad, Equatorial Guinea, Sao Tomé-et-Principe, Gabon, Congo Brazzaville, République Centrafricaine, Sudani y’Epfo, RDC, u Rwanda, Uganda, u Burundi, Kenya, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zimbabwe na Mozambique. Rapid Transfer ifasha umuntu uyikoresha kwakira amafaranga yoherejwe mu gaciro k’ifaranga ry’igihugu arimo. Urugero niba umuntu ari mu Rwanda akohererezwa amafaranga n’umuntu uri muri Kenya wayohereje mu mashilingi, ayafata mu manyarwanda bitamusabye kujya kuvunjisha. Murenzi ati “Ni uburyo buhendutse ugereranyije n’ibiguzi by’izindi serivisi zo kohererezanya amafaranga. Harimo igabanuka rigera kuri 10% ugereranyije n’izindi serivisi.” Raporo ya BNR y’umwaka wa 2018/2019 igaragaza ko kwishyurana mu ikoranabuhanga, muri Kamena 2019 byageze kuri 34.63% by’umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu bivuye kuri 30% muri Kamena 2018. title: KFC Rwanda yatangije ibikorwa byayo ku mugaragaro
content: Ibi bije nyuma y’aho mu Ukuboza umwaka ushize, yari yatangije ko 2020 izatangira gukorera mu Rwanda. Mu butumwa iki kigo cyacishije kuri Twitter cyavuze  ko “Ubutumwa bwari bumaze igihe butegerejwe bwaje, ubu twamaze gufungura ku mugaragaro, kubona amafunguro meza byatangiye.” KFC  yatangiye ibikorwa byayo mu Rwanda, nyuma yo gusinyana amasezerano y’imikoranire n’ikigo gicuruza ibikomoka kuri peteroli, Vivo Energy. Aya masezerano agena ko buri ruhande ruzaba rufite 50% mu bikorwa bya restaurant za KFC, aho zizaba zikora mu izina rya Kuku Foods, isanzwe ari ishami rya KFC muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Icyicaro cy’iyi sosiyete giherereye i Remera mu Mujyi wa Kigali, kuri sitasiyo ya Essence ya SP ku muhanda uva Remera ujya Kicukiro ahazwi nko kuri Prince House. Urubuga rwa KFC ruvuga ko ifite restaurant 17 000 muri Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’ahandi ku Isi. Nibura abarenga miliyoni 185 babona ibicuruzwa bya KFC mu cyumweru, bakaba barenga kimwe cya kabiri cy’abaturage ba Amerika. KFC ifite abakiliya mu bihugu 115 ikoreramo ku Isi yose birimo 22 byo ku mugabane wa Afurika nka Kenya, Uganda na Tanzania.

title: BNR yagumishije kuri 5% inyungu fatizo itangiraho inguzanyo ku mabanki
content: Yabitangaje kuri uyu wa Gatanu nyuma y’inama ngarukagihembwe y’akanama gashinzwe politiki y’ifaranga, MPC. Guverineri wa Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda, John Rwangombwa, yavuze ko kudahindura inyungu fatizo batangiraho inguzanyo ku mabanki, byatewe n’umusaruro wagaragaye kuva bagabanya iyo nyungu ikava kuri 5.5% umwaka ushize. Ati “Tubona ko gufata icyemezo cyo kugumishaho 5% y’urwunguko rwa BNR byatanze umusaruro ku myenda yatanzwe ku bikorera, tubona imyenda mishya yatanzwe n’amabanki yarazamutseho 20% mu 2019”. “Turifuza ko ibyo byakomeza kugira ngo dukomeze gushyigikira iterambere ry’igihugu cyacu”. BNR yatangaje kandi ko ubukungu bw’u Rwanda bwagenze neza umwaka ushize, aho mu bihembwe bitatu bya mbere bwazamutseho 10.8%. Guverineri Rwangombwa avuga ko nubwo bategereje imibare y’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ibarurishamibare (NISR), iyo barebye iyabo bakurikirana basanga mu gihembwe cya kane byaragenze neza byiyongereyeho 9.9% ugereranyije uko byari byagenze mu gihembwe cyabanje. Ati “Ibi rero biduha icyizere ko n’ubundi ubukungu mu gihembwe cya kane bwazamutse neza bitanga icyizere ko umwaka wose ubukungu buzaba buhagaze neza”. “Iyo turebye icyerekezo uyu mwaka dukurikije imibare twakoranye na Minisiteri y’imari n’igenamigambi, muri uyu mwaka ushira, ni uko tubona ukuzamuka k’ubukungu kuzakomeza kuba hejuru ya 8% muri uyu mwaka wa 2020”. Mu 2019 kandi ibyo u Rwanda rutumiza mu mahanga byarazamutse, ku kigero cya 10.6% bitewe n’ibikoresho by’ubwubatsi, ibyo mu nganda. Ibyoherejwe mu mahanga byazamutseho 3.8%. Ikinyuranyo cyabyo ni 16.3%. Inguzanyo zitishyurwa neza zaragabanutse BNR itangaza ko inguzanyo zitishyurwa neza zagabanyutse kuri 7.6% mu 2017, zigera kuri 6.4% mu 2018 na 4.9% mu 2019. Bikaba ari ubwa mbere iki gipimo kigiye munsi ya 5% BNR iteganya. Rwangombwa avuga ko byatewe n’uko ‘ubukungu bwagenze neza bituma bongera inguzanyo batanga ariko n’abiguriza mu mabanki barushaho kugira ubushobozi bwo kwishyura neza inguzanyo bafashe mu mabanki’. Akomeza agira ati “Ikindi ni uko iyo hashize imyaka ibiri hari imyenda itishyurwa neza batashobora kwishyuza bayihanagura mu bitabo byabo, ibyo nabyo bigabanya umubare w’imyenda itishyurwa neza”. BNR ivuga ko amabanki n’ibigo by’imari umwaka ushize byateye imbere, bifite imari shingiro yerekana ko nta cyabihungabanya, kandi bifite amafaranga yakenerwa mu bindi bintu. Amafoto: Dushimimana Ami Pacifique

title: 250STARTUPS yatanze impamyabushobozi kuri ba rwiyemezamirimo bato bahuguwe mu kubyaza inyungu imishinga
content: Uyu muhango wabereye muri Kigali Convention Center ku wa 4 Gashyantare 2020, wahuje abayobozi ba 250STARTUPS n’abafatanyabikorwa bawo, abahagarariye n’abayobozi mu bigo bya leta na barwiyemezamirimo bakuru n’abato. Umwe mu basoje aya mahugurwa akaba n’Umuyobozi w’Urubuga Gocook rufasha abantu kubona abatetsi kabuhariwe babafasha, Nyinawumuntu Yvonne, yavuze ko 250STARTUPS yamufashije gushyira igitekerezo cye mu bikorwa. Yagize ati “Gocook cyari igitekerezo twari dufite mbere yo kuza muri 250STARTUPS ariko kidakora, twari dufite umushinga gusa tuhageze twabonye amahugurwa mbona abamfasha mu bijyanye n’imari n’amategeko ku buryo noneho byanyoroheye kumenya nti ese dushaka iki, tuzagera ku ki? Nyuma twabonye n’umuntu wadufashije gukora urubuga biva mu bitekerezo biba ikintu gifatika.” Nyinawumuntu yavuze ko ubu amahugurwa arangiye afite umushinga ufatika. Ati “Navuga ko ibintu twari dufite mbere yo kuza muri 250STARTUPS ntaho bihuriye n’ibyo dufite ubu, mbere yo kuza twari dufite ibitekerezo gusa ariko ubu dufite igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi cyunguka.” Imishinga yari imaze amezi atandatu inozwa harimo uwitwa GoCook, Safe Sana, Dev Plug, Nyereka Tech, Aqua Safi, Imenye, Izi park, Ikizamini, Farmpal na Codeck. Umuyobozi w’umushinga 250STARTUPS, Shyaka Charles, yavuze ko bizeye ubumenyi bahaye aba barwiyemezamirimo mu gihe cy’amezi atandatu. Yagize ati “Twabahaye ubumenyi iyo bije mu bijyanye n’amategeko, ubu bazi uburyo bashobora guciririkanya mu buryo bw’amategeko, twabahaye ubumenyi bwo kugira imbanziriza mushinga yanditse mu buryo bwiza kandi bazi kubikora icyo ni ikintu cy’ingenzi. Yabasabye kubakira kuri ubu bumenyi bahawe ubundi bakamenyekanisha imishinga yabo ari nako bayibyaza amafaranga. Yagize ati “Icyo tubategerejeho ni ukugenda bakagurisha ibyo bakora ku bakiliya, ikindi ni ukubona ubufatanyabikorwa burushijeho bushobora kwagura kompanyi yabo ndetse bakagenda bakiga byagutse akarere kose kugira ngo batangire kwaguka, twabateye imbaraga, twabahaye ibyo bari bakeneye kugira ngo bagira igikorwa gihamye, ubu Isi ni iyabo ngo bayigarurire.” Abahawe impamyabushobozi ni abahuguwe mu cyiciro cya gatatu, mu bijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga, amategeko n’imari. Umuyobozi w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Ikoranabuhanga mu Itumanaho n’Isakazabumenyi (RISA), Muhizi Innocent, yasabye abasoje amahugurwa kuzirikana ko aribwo urugendo rugitangira. Ati “Nk’uko babivuga urugendo rwa kilometero 100 ruhera ku ntambwe imwe, ntucibwe intege n’uko utabonye umuntu ushyira ibihumbi 5 Frw mu mushinga wawe,…., hari abandi bashoramari benshi hanze aha,….., ibi bigomba kuba intangiriro, ibiri mu nzira nibyo byinshi , ntimuhagararire aha mukomeze guhanga udushya no gutekereza byagutse.” Muri uyu muhango ba rwiyemezamirimo bagize umwanya wo kumurikira abashoramari imishinga yabo ndetse banabasaba kuyishoramo. Kuva mu 2018 imishinga 40 irimo n’iri kunozwa ubu imaze kunyura mu biganza bya 250STARTUPS, 12 muri 30 iri hanze yatangiye kwinjiza amafaranga mu gihe 70% y’abahuguwe mu bijyanye n’amateko n’icungamari babonye akazi mu bigo bitandukanye byo mu Rwanda. title: RDB igiye gufatanya na FAO mu guteza imbere umusaruro w’ubuhinzi
content: Umuhango wo gushyira umukono kuri ayo masezerano y’ubufatanye wabereye ku cyicaro cya RDB ku Gishushu ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa 5 Gashyantare 2020. Ibigo byombi bizafatanya gushyira mu bikorwa ry’umushinga w’imyaka itatu, uzafasha abahinzi, ibigo n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa mu rwego rw’ubuhinzi kongera inyungu n’umusaruro (Support local suppliers’ capacity development and promote e-commerce in Rwanda). Mu bikorwa by’uwo mushinga harimo amahugurwa ku bucuruzi bukoresha ikoranabuhanga n’uburyo ababukoresha bishyurana, imicungire myiza y’ibikorwa n’ibijyanye no kuhira. Bikazareba ubuhinzi bw’indabo, ubworozi n’inganda zikora ibishingiye ku buhinzi n’ubworozi. Uyu mushinga witezweho guhuza abahinzi n’abakenera umusaruro wabo, kongera inyungu abahinzi babona, kugabanya ibyo u Rwanda rutumiza mu mahanga no gufasha inganda zitunganya ibikomoka ku buhinzi n’ubworozi guhangana ku isoko ry’imbere no hanze y’igihugu. Umuyobozi mukuru wa RDB, Clare Akamanzi yavuze ko muri uwo mushinga bazibanda kuzamura ubwiza bw’umusaruro nkuko bikubiye muri Politiki y’iterambere ry’igihugu. Ati “Guteza imbere umusaruro ukomoka ku buhinzi binyuze mu kuzamura ubwiza bwawo ni imwe mu nkingi z’igihugu mu iterambere ubuhinzi, FAO ni umufatanyabikorwa ukomeye mu kubigeraho. Tuzakora ku buryo tugera kuri byinshi mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’uyu mushinga.” Umuyobozi uhagarariye FAO mu Rwanda, Gaulbert Gbehounou, yavuze ko uwo mushinga ari intangiriro y’ubufatanye buzakomeza yibutsa ko mu ntego zabo nka FAO bazirikana ko umuhinzi agomba guhinga akeza kandi agakuramo inyungu imuteza imbere. Ati "Igihe umuhinzi yejeje, agomba kugurisha kugira ngo umusaruro umubesheho neza. Iyo yungutse ahindura ubuzima agahanga n’indi mirimo." RDB izakorana na Minisiteri y’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi, iy’ubucuruzi n’inganda n’iy’Ikoranabuhanga no guhanga udushya mu gushyira mu bikorwa uwo mushinga.

title: Qatar igiye gushora imari mu mahoteli mu Rwanda: Kuki yahisemo u Rwanda?
content:
Mu 2012 nibwo ishoramari rikomeye ry’abanya-Qatar ryatangiraga mu Rwanda, hatangizwa ingendo za Qatar Airways. Nyuma yaho, ibindi bikorwa byarakurikiye binyuze mu mubano mwiza uri hagati y’ibihugu, ni ukuvuga Perezida Kagame na Emir wa Qatar. Hari kandi amasezerano atandukanye hagati y’u Rwanda na Qatar yibanda kuri serivisi z’ubwikorezi bwo mu kirere, guteza imbere no kurengera ishoramari bihuriweho n’ay’imikoranire mu by’Ubukungu, Ubucuruzi na Tekiniki. Mu myaka itatu ishize, umubano w’ibihugu byombi wafashe indi ntera binyuze mu ngendo z’abakuru b’ibihugu, hasinywa amasezerano atandukanye. Azwi cyane ni ajyanye no kubaka ikibuga cy’indege cya Bugesera ndetse hitezwe n’andi yo kugura imigabane muri RwandAir. Hari impamvu nyinshi Qatar yahisemo gushora imari mu Rwanda, zimwe zirimo imiyoborere y’igihugu n’amahirwe y’ishoramari aruboneka bikajyana n’uko ari igihugu kiri mu mutima wa Afurika aho byoroshye kugera mu zindi mpamvu. IGIHE yahuye n’Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Qatar Airways, Akbar Al Baker, i Doha, avuga ko kimwe mu byabakuruye mu gushora imari mu Rwanda ari aho igihugu giherereye, umutekano “n’amahirwe y’ishoramari ari muri kiriya gihugu”. Qatar igiye gushora imari mu mahoteli mu Rwanda
 Akbar yatangaje ko mu gihe cy’imyaka itatu, abanyarwanda bazatangira kubona umusaruro ugaragara w’amasezerano amaze iminsi asinywa hagati y’u Rwanda na Qatar dore ko icyo gihe ikibuga cy’indege cya Bugesera kizaba cyatangiye gukora. Ati “Mu myaka itatu iri imbere muzatangira kubona umusaruro, uwo ni umusaruro mu guhanga imirimo, mu guhanga amahirwe y’ubukungu ku baturage, kuzamura imibereho y’abaturage, kuko ibijyanye n’indege ni umuyoboro mwiza wo guhanga imirimo. Abajijwe ibijyanye n’ingano y’amafaranga bazashora mu Rwanda, Akbar yasubije ati “ntabwo njya mbwira umuntu uwo ariwe wese ibijyanye n’imibare”. Magingo aya, usibye Ikibuga cy’Indege cya Bugesera n’imigabane Qatar Airways igiye kugura muri RwandAir, hari gahunda yo gushora imari mu bindi bikorwa cyane ibijyanye n’amahoteli. Umuyobozi wa Qatar Airways, yabwiye IGIHE ati “Qatar Airways irashaka gushora imari mu bijyanye n’amahoteli. Urabizi iyo ukura mu bijyanye n’indege, ukenera ibyumba byo kuraramo by’abakozi, ukenera kuzana abantu b’inzobere, uzakenera kandi ibyumba by’abakozi bo mu ndege biri hafi n’ikibuga cy’indege. Rero hazabaho amahirwe y’irindi shoramari riturutse mu zindi nzego za Guverinoma zikora ibijyanye n’ibikorwa remezo.” Kuki Qatar ikomeje ishoramari hanze y’igihugu? Qatar ni kimwe mu bihugu byo mu Burengerazuba bw’Isi gifite buri kimwe cyose umuntu yakenera, kiri ku buso buto cyane bungana n’Intara y’Uburengerazuba hamwe n’Umujyi wa Kigali ubiteranyije, kuko kiri kuri kilometero kare 11,581. Qatar ntabwo ituwe cyane, magingo aya ibarirwa abaturage bagera kuri miliyoni 2.7 gusa, igitangaje ni uko muri abo, abanyagihugu kavukire barenga gato 10%, ni ibihumbi 330 gusa, abandi bose ni abanyamahanga binjira mu gihugu bashaka akazi. Mu 2017 habarwaga ko umuturage muri Qatar yinjizaga nibura ibihumbi 63 by’amadolari (asaga miliyoni 60 Frw) ku mwaka. Gusa ariko ayo mafaranga aturuka ku kintu kimwe, ubukungu bushingiye ku mutungo kamere, Qatar ifite gaz nyinshi bihambaye ndetse ni iya gatatu ku Isi nyuma y’u Burusiya na Iran. Intego ya Qatar ntabwo ari ugukomeza gushingira ubukungu mu mutungo kamere gusa, ikora n’ibishoboka byose igashora imari ariko hanze y’igihugu. Mu gihe ubukungu bwari bwifashe nabi mu Burayi na Amerika, Qatar yarahagurutse ibibyaza amahirwe, igura imiturirwa myinshi mu Burayi, by’umwihariko i Londres, 30% z’inyubako zaguzwe na Qatar cyangwa se izifitemo imigabane. Mu 2017 habarurwaga ko ishoramari rya Qatar mu Bwongereza ringana na miliyari 35 z’ama-pound ndetse ko mu myaka itanu hazaba hamaze gushorwa andi miliyari eshanu z’ama-pound. Agace kabonekamo inganda nyinshi mu Bwongereza, Canary Wharf, ni aka Qatar; umuturirwa witwa The Shard, Olympic village n’izindi ndetse Qatar ifite imigabane ingana na 6.67% muri Barclays Bank. Aha ni hamwe muri henshi Qatar yashoye imari kandi ubu birayihira. Ni uburyo bumwe Qatar yahisemo bwo kutarambiriza ku mutungo kamere gusa ahubwo igashaka n’uko ikorera andi mafaranga ariko binyuze mu ishoramari ryo hanze.

title: MTN Rwanda yijeje abakiliya ibishya byinshi nyuma yo kwegukana igihembo muri Business Excellence Awards
content: Kuwa 31 Mutarama 2020, nibwo Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB), ku nshuro ya karindwi cyahembye abashoramari babaye indashyikirwa mu mwaka 2019, mu bihembo bizwi nka Business Excellence Awards bya 2019. Mu bihembo icyenda byatanzwe mu byiciro bitandukanye, MTN Rwanda yahawe icy’ikigo cyagaragaje udushya mu byo gikora mu 2019. Umuyobozi Ushinzwe Ubucuruzi n’ibindi bikorwa muri MTN Rwanda, Kagame Chantal, yabwiye IGIHE ko icyo gihembo bagikesha ikoranabuhanga bazanye ryafashije abantu kugura amatike, guhaha no kwishyura ibyo baguze mu imurikagurisha rya Made in Rwanda 2019. Yagize ati “Mbere abantu bakoreshaga udupapuro nyuma yaho haza kwifashishwa amakarita. Twaje kuzana igisubizo mu imurikagurisha ryabaye mu 2019, umukiliya ashobora kugura itike ye yicaye mu rugo akayibona ku butumwa bugufi akishyura na Mobile Money bitamugoye akaba ari nayo anakoresha kwinjira mu imurikagurisha.” Icyo gihe kandi abamurika bose bari bafashijwe kugira Konti ya Mobile Money bishyurirwaho izwi nka MoMo Pay aho umukiliya yishyura bitamusabye amafaranga mu ntoki kandi nta yo kubikuza aciwe. Ni ikoranabuhanga ryafashije abitabiriye Made in Rwanda Expo ya 2019, abayiteguye ndetse n’umudendezo yabayemo. Iryo tumanaho ryoroheje ibintu ku buryo byari byoroshye kumenya abaguze amatike, abitabiriye imurikagurisha n’abatabashije kuza umunsi runaka, ku buryo byoroheraga n’abategura guteganya ko bazagira abantu benshi undi munsi bakurikije abaguze amatike. Chantal Kagame yavuze ko mu mwaka wa 2020, MTN Rwanda itazibanda gusa ku gutanga serivisi zo kwitaba no guhamagara cyangwa gukoresha internet gusa nkuko imaze iminsi ibitangiye, ahubwo ko izakomeza gutanga ibisubizo birambyemu mibereho ya buri munsi y’Abanyarwanda ikoresheje ikoranabuhanga. Ati “Twabitangiye umwaka ushize mu imurikagurisha, turashaka kubitwara mu bwikorezi, ahantu hose abantu bakenera kwinjira, mu bitaramo n’ahandi hose.” Muri uyu mwaka avuga ko bazegera abantu b’ingeri zitandukanye hagamijwe kumenya aho bafatanya mu iterambere. Harimo ibigo by’amashuri, abagitangira ubucuruzi buciriritse bataragira ubushobozi bwo kwaka inguzanyo muri banki n’abandi. Muri rusange MTN Rwanda ikomeje mu cyerekezo cyayo cy’uko Umunyarwanda abonera serivisi zose kuri telefoni ye ngendanwa. Kimwe n’iryakoreshejwe mu imurikagurisha, ni ikoranabuhanga rikora kuri telefoni ngendanwa iyo ariyo yose bidasabye ko umuntu aba afite smartphone. Sosiyete MTN Rwanda ifite ubunararibonye bw’imyaka igera kuri 22 imaze itanga serivisi z’itumanaho mu Rwanda. Izwi muri serivisi zo guhamagara, internet, kwishyurana hifashishijwe uburyo bwa Mobile Money n’ibindi byagize uruhare rukomeye mu iterambere ry’ubukungu bw’u Rwanda. MTN Rwanda ni yo yatangije gahunda ya Connect Rwanda igamije kugeza telefoni mu gihugu hose. Kuwa 20 Ukuboza 2019 nibwo MTN Rwanda yatangije ubukangurambaga bwa Connect Rwanda Challenge, maze ibigo n’abantu ku giti cyabo batangira kwiyemeza umubare wa telefoni zigezweho bazatanga zigahabwa abadafite ubushobozi bwo kuzigurira hirya no hino mu gihugu kugira ngo babashe kugendana n’ibigezweho.

title: Master Steel yabaye umushoramari w’umwaka mu bihembo bya RDB Business Excellence Awards 2019
content:
Ibi bihembo bizwi nka 2019 RDB Business Excellence Awards, byatanzwe mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa 31 Mutarama 2020 mu gikorwa cyabereye muri Kigali Convention Centre. Muri rusange hatanzwe ibihembo icyenda. Igihembo cy’umushoramari w’umwaka cyahawe Master Steel Ltd, yahembwe kuzatembereza abakozi batanu b’iki kigo bakajya gusura Ingagi zo mu Birunga. Rwiyemezamirimo w’umugore wahize abandi mu 2019 yabaye  Bufcoffee Ltd, Ikigo cyagaragaje agashya mu byo gikora mu  2019, cyabaye sosiyete y’itumanaho ya MTN Rwanda, rwiyemezamirimo ukiri muto wa 2019 yabaye Awesomity Lab, wahawe miliyoni ebyiri z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Rwiyemezamirimo ukora ubucuruzi buto n’ubuciritse yabaye EasyHatch Ltd,  rwiyemezamirimo wasangije abandi ubumenyi agatanga n’amahugurwa ndetse n’akazi yabaye Banki ya KCB. Rwiyemezamirimo wateje imbere ibyakorewe mu Rwanda hahembwe babiri, barimo Moshions na Agropy Ltd, rwiyemezamirimo wohereza ibicuruzwa mu mahanga bivuye mu Rwanda naho hahembwe babiri, harimo Multi-Sector Investment Group na Africa improved Foods, naho umushoramari mushya washoye imari mu Rwanda yabaye uruganda rwa Volkswagen rukora imodoka. Minisitiri w’Intebe Dr Ngirente Edouard, witabiriye uyu muhango, yashimiye Urugaga rw’abikorera mu Rwanda rwafatanyije na Guverinoma y’u Rwanda binyuze mu rwego rushinzwe Iterambere mu Rwanda (RDB), mu gutegura ibi birori by’uyu munsi. Yavuze ko abashoramari n’abacuruzi ari abafatanyabikorwa b’ingenzi mu cyerekezo u Rwanda rufite cyo kugera ku iterambere rirambye, kandi rihuriweho na bose mu 2024. Yagize ati “Guverinoma y’u Rwanda irabashimira ko kugeza ubu ari mwe mutanga imirimo myinshi ku mubare munini w’Abanyarwanda, ibi kandi ni nabyo byagize uruhare mu kuzamuka ubukungu bw’u Rwanda nk’uko byagaragaye mu myaka ishize”. Minisitiri w’Intebe yakomeje avuga ko guverinoma y’u Rwanda ishimira uruhare rwa ba rwiyemezamirimo n’abashoramari mu kongera ingano y’ibyo u Rwanda rwohereza mu mahanga. Ati “Muri urwo rwego, ndashishikariza kandi ba rwiyemezamirimo n’ibigo by’ubucuruzi mu Rwanda kwitabira ishoramari rihuriweho”.
Mu 2019 ishoramari rihuriweho n’Abanyarwanda n’abanyamahanga ryihariye 44% y’ishoramari ryose, by’umwihariko ibigo bito n’ibiciriritse (SMEs). Minisitiri w’Intebe ati “Ndabizeza ko Guverinoma y’u Rwanda izakomeza kunoza no korohereza ishoramari kugira ngo abashora imari imbere mu gihugu barusheho kwiyongera, guverinoma y’u Rwanda yiyemeje gushyigikira no kongerera ubushobozi urubyiruko hagamijwe kurufasha kwihangira imirimo. “ Yashishikarije kandi ba rwiyemezamirimo b’urubyiruko kubyaza umusaruro amahirwe atandukanye igihugu cyabahaye, kugira ngo barusheho guteza imbere ibikorwa n’imishinga yabo. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa RDB, Claire Akamanzi, yashimiye buri wese wagiye yitabira aya marushanwa kuva mu myaka yose irindwi ishize, avuga ko ari iby’agaciro. Yagaragaje uburyo ishoramari ry’igihugu cyarazamutse riva kuri  miliyari ebyiri z’amadorali ryariho mu 2018, rigera kuri miliyari 2.4 mu 2019. Yavuze ko ibi byose byagiye bigirwamo uruhare na guverinoma iyobowe na Perezida wa Repubulika, Paul Kagame, byatumye hashyirwaho uburyo bufasha ishoramari gukora neza. Yagize ati “Ni muri ubwo buryo hari impinduka zatumye u Rwanda ruza mu bihugu by’imbere muri Afurika mu gufasha ishoramari kuko turi ku maywa wa kabiri, no ku mwanya wa 38 ku Isi, u Rwanda kandi nicyo gihugu cyonyine mu bihugu bikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere kigaragara mu bihugu 50.” Akamanzi yavuze ko nka leta izakomeza gufasha abagitangira ubucuruzi n’ibigo binini kugira ngo bikomeze gutera imbere. Uyu munsi bitwara gusa amasaha atandatu kugira ngo umuntu yandikishe ikigo, kandi abashoramari bashobora no gusura RDB buri wa gatanu hagati ya saa tatu kugeza saa sita, bakaba bafashwa gukemurirwa ahari ikibazo.
