title: U Rwanda rwahawe miliyari 10 Frw azakoreshwa mu kubaka umujyi utangiza ibidukikije i Kigali
content: Amasezerano atanga iyi nkunga yashyiriweho umukono mu Mujyi wa Kigali kuri uyu wa Gatanu, tariki ya 31 Mutarama 2020; yari ahagarariwe na Minisitiri w’Imari n’Igenamigambi, Dr Ndagijimana Uzziel na Ambasaderi w’u Budage mu Rwanda, Dr Thomas Kurz. Umujyi utangiza ibidukikije muri Kigali uzubakwa ku buso bwa hegitari 600 mu Murenge wa Kinyinya mu Karere ka Gasabo. Uzaba ufite ibikorwa remezo bifasha mu kurinda iyangirika ry’ibidukikije n’imyuka ihumanya ikirere. U Rwanda niruwuzuza ruzaba igihugu cya mbere gifite uwo mwihariko muri Afurika. Iyi nkunga yatanzwe n’u Budage yanyujijwe muri Banki y’Iterambere y’iki gihugu, KfW. Yiyongereye kuri miliyoni €20 cyiyemeje gutanga mu Ukuboza 2019. Umushinga wo kubaka umujyi utangiza ibidukikije muri Kinyinya biteganyijwe ko uzatwara miliyari $1.5 mu itangira. Icyiciro cya mbere kizamara imyaka itanu kizasiga hubatswe inzu 1,749 kuri hegitari 18 mu gihe hazakoreshwa miliyoni $ 103.8. Minisitiri w’Imari n’Igenamigambi, Dr Ndagijimana Uzziel, yavuze ko uyu mushinga ari intangiriro izagaragaza imiterere y’iyubakwa y’u Rwanda mu kubungabunga ibidukikije. Yagize ati “Ni umushinga wujuje ibyangombwa byo kubungabunga ibidukikije. Ni uwa mbere tugiye gukora ariko twifuza ko uzaguka ukaba mugari, ugakomereza no mu mijyi yunganira uwa Kigali uko ari itandatu.’’ Uyu mushinga uzifashisha ibikoresho by’imbere mu gihugu, nta ngaruka uzagira ku baturage bafite ubushobozi buke kuko watekerejweho mu buryo buzababyarira inyungu birimo no kuborohereza kubona inguzanyo. Yakomeje ati ‘‘Abaturage bazabona akazi, ariko nanone abatanga serivisi z’ibikoresho by’ubwubatsi bazunguka. Inzu na zo abaturage barazikeneye cyane ko zizaba ziciriritse zishobora guturwamo cyangwa gukodeshwa, bizakemura ikibazo cy’imiturire.’’ Kuri ubu hamaze gukorwa inyigo, hanashyizweho itsinda riri gukora igishushanyo mbonera kizarangira muri Kamena 2020. Biteganyijwe ko hazubakwa imihanda, imiyoboro y’amashanyarazi, amazi n’ibijyanye n’isukura no gushishikariza urwego rw’abikorera gushoramo imari. Ambasaderi w’u Budage mu Rwanda, Dr Thomas Kurz, yashimangiye ko igihugu cye kizakomeza gushyigikira imishinga y’iterambere. Ati “Twishimiye kuba muri uyu mushinga ugamije kubungabunga ibidukikije. Ni mwiza, cyane ko uzatanga inyubako ziciriritse. Birashimishije kuko uzagera mu yindi mijyi yunganira Kigali.’’ Biteganyijwe ko uyu mushinga uzafasha abagera ku 14.000 kubona inzu ziciriritse. Umushinga wo kubaka umujyi w’icyitegererezo muri Kigali urashimangira icyerekezo cy’u Rwanda mu kwimakaza ikoranabuhanga ritangiza ibidukikije n’ubukungu budahungabanywa n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe mu mijyi yunganira Kigali, ubwikorezi bw’abantu n’ibindi. Uwo mujyi uzaba ufite ikoranabuhanga rigezweho, imodoka zikoresha amashanyarazi, imihanda yagenewe amagare na moto, ingufu zisubira, uburyo burambye bwo gutunganya imyanda, inganda za biogas n’ibindi. Imyaka icyenda irashize u Rwanda rushyizeho ingamba zo kubaka ubukungu butangiza ibidukikije, butanahungabanywa n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe “Green Growth and Climate Resilience Strategy.” Ni icyerekezo cyazamuye ubukungu burambye hibandwa ku mutungo kamere, ujyanye no gutera amashyamba, gutunganya amazi, kunoza ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro n’ibindi bitangiza ibidukikije.

title: RRA yongereye ukwezi ku gihe cyo kwishyura imisoro
content: Mu itangazo iki kigo cyashyize hanze, cyavuze ko  “abantu bose barebwa n’umusoro ku mutungo utimukanwa, umusoro w’ipatante wa 2020 n’umusoro ku nyungu z’ubukode wa 2020, itariki ntarengwa yo kumenyekanisha no kwishyura uwo musoro yari iteganyijwe kuwa 31 Mutarama 2020 yimuriwe tariki 29 Gashyantare 2020.” Ubuyobozi bwa RRA bwasabye abasora gukora imenyekanisha ry’iyi misoro kandi bakishyura bifashishije ikoranabuhanga. Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Imisoro n’Amahoro (RRA) giherutse gutangaza ko mu mwaka wa 2018/19 cyinjije miliyari Frw 1,422.9 ku ntego ya miliyari Frw 1,392.1 cyari gifite bituma kirenzaho miliyari Frw 30.8 angana na 102%. Mu myaka 20 ishize, imisoro y’imbere mu gihugu yakusanyijwe na RRA yiyongereye inshuro 20 mu gihe ingengo y’imari y’igihugu yiyongereye inshuro 14. Itegeko riherutse gusohoka mu igazeti ya Leta rigena ibihano ku bukererwe bwo kwishyura imisoro byaragabanyijwe. Uwakererewe kwishyura yishyura ibihano bya 20% by’umusoro yari kwishyura igihe atararengeje iminsi 30 y’ubukererwe. Urengeje iminsi 30 ariko iri munsi ya 60 yishyura 40% naho uyirengeje yishyura 60% y’ibihano. Kugeza ubu imisoro ifite uruhare rwa 54.1% mu ngengo y’imari y’igihugu, mu gihe nko mu 1998 yari 36.3%.

title: I&M Bank yazamuye inguzanyo ku mushahara, umukiliya ashobora gukubirwa inshuro 17.5 agahabwa miliyoni 30 Frw
content: Impinduka muri serivisi y’inguzanyo zakozwe ku nguzanyo ku mushahara, iyo kugura inzu n’inguzanyo y’igihe gito; hagamijwe korohereza abakiliya no kubafasha kugera ku nzozi zabo. Binyuze muri Eclair loan ivuguruye, ubu umukiliya wa I&M Bank Rwanda yahawe amahirwe yo kuba yabona amafaranga y’inguzanyo akubiwe inshuro 17.5 umushahara we mu gihe ubusanzwe bitarenzaga 12. Ibi bivuze ko umukiriya ashobora kugurizwa agera kuri miliyoni 30 Frw ku mushahara we. Uretse kwiyongera kw’amafaranga umuntu ashobora kubona nk’inguzanyo ku mushahara, I&M Bank kandi yongereye igihe umuntu yashoboraga kuyishyuramo kiva ku mezi 50 kigera ku mezi 60. Naho ku nguzanyo yo kugura inzu, igihe umuntu ashobora kwishyuramo cyavuye hagati y’imyaka 15 na 20 kigera ku myaka 25. Izi mpinduka kandi zakuyeho miliyoni 150 nk’amafaranga ntarengwa umuntu ashobora guhabwa nk’inguzanyo yo kugura inzu, biha umukiliya ubushobozi bwo kuba yakwaka ayo ashaka yose. Mu kwihutisha ibyifuzo by’abakiliya ubu kuri izi nguzanyo zose I&M Bank yagabanyije iminsi umuntu amara ategereje igisubizo kuri dosiye ye. Umuyobozi Mukuru ushinzwe kuzamura ubucuruzi muri I&M Bank Rwanda Plc, Faustin Byishimo, yavuze ko izi mpinduka zije kugira ngo Abanyarwanda barusheho gukabya inzozi zabo. Ati  “Turifuza ko umuntu wese utekereje kwaka inguzanyo azajya atakereza I&M Bank kuko dufite serivisi zinogeye abatugana kandi mu buryo bwihuse, aho twita ku byifuzo byabo byose.” I&MBank yatangiye gukorera mu Rwanda mu 1963 yitwa BCR. Umwaka wa 2018 warangiye ifite umutungo mbumbe ungana na miliyari 294 Frw, wiyongereye ku kigero cya 13% kuko mu 2017 wari miliyari 260 Frw. Byari nyuma y’uko muri uwo mwaka urwunguko rwayo rugeze kuri miliyari 7.5 Frw, nyuma yo kwishyura imisoro bingana n’izamuka rya 15% ugereranyije n’umwaka wari wabanje kuko mu 2017 inyungu yari miliyari 6.5 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda.

title: Vuba Vuba mu mikorere mishya izorohereza abatumiza amafunguro n’ibinyobwa bakoresheje ikoranabuhanga
content: Albert Munyabugingo wahoze ari Umuyobozi Mukuru muri Jumia Food, yavuze ko ubwo bari bagikorera iki kigo cyafunze imiryango mu Rwanda, bagize amahirwe yo kwiga uburyo ubucuruzi bw’amafunguro  bwifashisha ikoranabuhanga bukorwa ndetse n’uburyo bwo kugeza ibicuruzwa ku bakiriya babisabye. Ati “Nyuma yo gufunga kwa Jumia Food, bamwe mu bakozi bayikoreraga twagiye hamwe tureba ubumenyi tumaze kwigiramo n’ibindi bitandukanye, dusanga hari abagikeneye serivisi icyo kigo cyatangaga, duheraho dutangiza Vuba Vuba.” Munyabugingo yavuze ko kimwe mu bintu bari gushyiramo imbaraga kuruta uko byari bimeze, ari ugukoresha ibikenerwa byose bikorewe mu Rwanda kugira ngo serivise batanga zirusheho kwihuta kandi zinogere abazigezwaho. Abanyarwanda batandukanye cyane cyane abatuye mu mijyi bazwiho kujyana n’iterambere, bagaragaraje ubushake bukomeye mu kwitabira serivise zikoresha ikoranabuhanga, zirimo n’iyi yo kubagezaho amafunguro batiriwe bava aho bari. Ibi ngo biha icyizere ubuyobozi bwa Vuba Vuba bwo kuzagera ku ntego bafite yo kwagura serivisi zabo zikagera no mu zindi ntara ziri hanze y’Umujyi wa Kigali. Ubuyobozi bwa Vuba Vuba kandi bushimangira ko gahunda ya leta yo guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga binyuze mu kwagura imiyoboro ya murandasi bizababera uburyo bwiza bwo kugera kuri benshi bifuza serivisi yo kugezwaho amafunguro n’ibinyobwa, kandi mu buryo bunogeye buri wese. Munyabugingo yavuze ko ikibaraje ishinga ari ukugabanya umwanya wo kugeza ku mukiliya ibyo yasabye, ukava ku minota 46 bariho ubu, ukagera ku minota 40 cyangwa munsi yayo. Uyu muyobozi yongeraho ko bari gukoresha uko bashoboye bakaba bakorana na ‘restaurants’ zifite ibiciro bito kurushaho mu rwego rwo korohereza umubare munini w’abatumiza amafunguro bifashishije ikoranabuhanga. Kuki umuntu akwiriye gutumiza amafunguro yifashishije Vuba Vuba Albert Munyabugingo uyobora Vuba Vuba avuga ko amasezerano bagirana na za ‘restaurants’ zitandukanye, harimo ko amafunguro yatumijwe hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga ryabo ahabwa umwanya w’imbere mu rwego  rwo kwihutisha serivise yabo. Ati “Hirya y’ibyo kandi tuba dufashije restaurants kuzigama umwanya mu gihe umukiriya yari kuba ahagaze ategereje umwakira, tunarengeye ibindi bishobora kwangirika muri uwo mwanya.” Kugeza ubu Vuba Vuba ikorana n’ama-restaurent 50 mu Mujyi wa Kigali hose;  binahesha amahirwe abatumiza amafunguro bayifashishije guhitamo ibyo bakeneye byose mu gihe icyo aricyo cyose ku buryo buboroheye. Mu kurushaho kudabagiza abakiriya bayo kandi, Vuba Vuba yashyizeho ubwasisi bwa buri wa kabiri w’icyumweru kuri restaurents zimwe na zimwe,  bwiswe "Buy One, Get One Free", aho umuntu utumije ikintu kimwe yongezwa ikindi nkacyo bitewe n’ahari ubwasisi buri muri uwo mwanya. Usibye gutumiza amafunguro n’ibinyobwa hifashishjwe ikoranabuhanga rya Vuba Vuba, hari n’uburyo bwo gutumiza ibicuruzwa biboneka mu maguriro (Super Markets) atandukanye, kandi hakaba hateganywa kongerwamo n’ibindi biboneka ku masoko asanzwe. Muri iri koranabuhanga kandi, abakoresha uburyo bwaryo bwiswe “Vuba Party” bahabwa amahirwe yo kugura ibinyobwa bitandukanye ku giciro gito ugereranyije n’ikiri ku isoko. Ubuyobozi bwa Vuba Vuba ariko buvuga ko bugifite imbogamizi y’abakifuza gutumiza ibinyobwa n’amafunguro badakoresheje ‘Application’ ya Vuba Vuba kandi kuyikoresha bihesha amahirwe umukiriya yo kubona  restaurents zitandukanye zamufasha guhitamo ibyo ashaka. Indi mbogamizi ikigaragara iri mu kwagura imiyoboro ya internet itaragera  ku rugero rwifuzwa kuko hari ahagaragara umubare  munini w’abifuza serivise zitangwa na Vuba Vuba ariko batagerwaho na Internet. Mu Rwanda ubucuruzi bwo kuri internet bumaze imyaka hafi irindwi; ubu bucuruzi buracyagaragaramo icyuho kuko butaritabirwa na benshi ndetse n’ibikorwaremezo bijyanye nabwo bikaba bitaratera imbere ku rwego ruhambaye. Vuba Vuba ivuga ko ubu imaze kugira abantu basaga ibihumbi 5 biyandikishije ku rubuga rw’ikoranabuhanga rwabo basaba serivise zo kugezwaho ibintu bitandukanye mu gihe kitarenze ukwezi iki kigo kimaze gitangiye. Ubuyobozi bw’iki kigo bushishikariza abatarakoresha uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga cyashyizeho ko bakwiye kubyaza umusaruro aya mahirwe cyabazaniye kuko bubagezaho amafunguro ku buryo bwihuse kandi bwizewe. Mu Ukuboza umwaka ushize nibwo Jumia Food yatangaje ko izahagarika ibikorwa byayo mu Rwanda kuwa 09 Mutarama 2020. Iyi yari inkuru mbi ku bari abakozi bayo ndetse n’abayifashishaga mu gutumiza amafunguro mu Rwanda ariko akaba amahirwe akomeye ku bazi kubyaza umusaruro amahirwe yo gucururiza kuri Internet. Munyabugingo avuga ko mu bakozi bakoresha, abagera kuri 80% bakoranaga na Jumia Food.

title: Banki y’Isi yagaragaje icyizere mu bukungu bw’u Rwanda n’icyuho mu gukoresha ikoranabuhanga
content: Banki y’Isi ivuga ko ubukungu bw’u Rwanda bwazamutse ku kigera kiri ku  10.9% mu mezi icyenda ya 2019, ugereranyije 8.2% by’ayo mezi ya 2018. Ivuga ko ibi byatewe n’ishoramari ritari irya leta harimo iry’abikorera, iterambere mu by’ikoranabuhanga n’ibindi. Iyi banki ivuga ko ibikorwa by’ubwubatsi mu 2019 byazamutse kuri 31% mu bihembwe bitatu by’uwo mwaka, serivisi zizamuka 10.7% mu gihe inganda ari 12.3%. Igaragaza kandi ko mu buhinzi ho byari 5.8%. Mu 2020, ubukungu ngo buzakomeza guhagarara neza kuko buzakomeza kugera ku 10%, ifaranga ry’igihugu na ryo rigakomeza guhagarara neza. Nubwo bimeze gutyo, Banki y’Isi igira inama u Rwanda ko rugomba kwitondera gukomeza gushingira ku mishinga y’ishoramari rushyiramo amafaranga. Ivuga ko leta gushora amafaranga mu bikorwa kugira ngo igere ku ntego iba yarihaye harimo ibikorwa remezo, bizamura imyenda bigatera icyuho, bikaba byanabangamira ibindi bikorwa by’iterambere rirambye. Ku bijyanye n’iterambere rishingiye ku ikoranabuhanga, banki y’Isi ivuga ko leta yakoresheje ingufu kugira ngo igihugu kibe mu bihugu bimaze gutera imbere mu karere no ku Isi, ariko hakiri ikibazo cy’uburyo abantu barikoresha. Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho n’isakazabumenyi (RISA), kigaragaza ko igipimo cy’abanyarwanda bafite ubumenyi mu gukoresha ikoranabuhanga ari 8%, bisobanuye ko hari icyuho cya 92% badafite ubumenyi ku ikoreshwa ry’ikoranabuhanga. Impuguke mu by’ubukungu n’iterambere muri banki y’Isi, Isabella Hayward, avuga ko iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda, ryazamutse mu buryo  bwihuse mu myaka itanu ishize, ku kigero cya 12.7%. Banki y’Isi ivuga ko ikwirakwizwa rya internet ya 3G mu gihugu  riri ku kigero cya 93.5%, mu gihe muri aka karere ho bakiri kuri 76% gusa. Ivuga ko ku bufatanye n’ikigo, Korean Telecom Rwanda Networks (KTRN) cyo muri Koreya, ikwirakwizwa rya interneti ya 4G riri kuri 96.6%. Isabella yagize ati “Nubwo u Rwanda rukomeje gukwirakwiza ubu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga mu buryo bwiza, haracyari icyuho mu buryo bwo kurikoresha”. Isabella avuga ko hakiri ikibazo cy’abaturage bataragerwaho na telefone zigezweho n’abatagerwaho na interneti ya 2G na 3G, ku buryo ngo 74.3% by’abakoresha telefoni uzasanga bakomeza gukoresha 2G mu gihe igenda gake. Avuga ko aba bahitamo guhamagara cyangwa gukoresha ubutumwa bugufi (SMS). Mu bindi bibazo Banki y’Isi isanga bikibangamye, ni uko usanga abikorera na bo batarajya mu murongo w’ikoranabuhanga, ku buryo usanga ikoranabuhanga rikoreshwa n’ibigo bya leta cyane. Umunyamabanga uhoraho muri Minisiteri y’ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho no guhanga udushya, Claudette Irere, avuga ko guverinoma y’u Rwanda imaze gukora byinshi kugira ngo abanyarwanda bagerweho n’ikoranabuhanga, gusa agaragaza ko hakiri icyuho kirimo no kuba abenshi badashobora kugerwaho na telefoni zigezweho (Smartphone). Aha niho agaragaza ko kugira ngo abantu bigishwe ikoreshwa ry’ikoranabuhanga, binasaba ko baba bafite icyo uri bubigishirizeho. Irere yavuze ko iyi ari yo mpamvu  hatangirijwe ubukangurambaga bwiswe Connect Rwanda, bugamije kureba ko imiryango idafite telefone zigezweho izibona. Yagize ati “Kwigisha abantu badafite telefoni zigezweho nabyo ni ikibazo, aha niho haje gahunda yishwe Connect Rwanda, aho abantu bitanga icyo bashoboye kugira ngo izi telefone zigere ku banyarwanda benshi, uyu munsi 14% by’abanyarwanda nibo bafite gusa smartphones,  ubu dufite ingo zirenga miliyoni ebyiri zidafite telefone, iyi gahunda igamije ko mu mezi atatu twaba twageze kuri miliyoni imwe.” Yavuze ko icyo bivuze ari uko kwigisha abantu bizoroha kuko nibura bazaba bafite ibyo barimo kwigishirizwaho.

title: Banki y’Isi yizeye ko izamuka ry’ubukungu bw’u Rwanda rizagera ku 10% uyu mwaka
content: Ni ku nshuro ya kabiri Banki y’Isi yongereye igipimo cy’izamuka ry’ubukungu bw’u Rwanda. Ushinzwe ubukungu muri Banki y’Isi, Aghassi Mkrtchyan, yavuze ko izamuka ry’ubukungu umwaka ushize rizagera ku 8.5% rivuye kuri 7.8% ryari ryateganyijwe mbere. Ati “Izamuka ry’ubukungu byitezwe ko rizagera ku 10% kuzamura mu gihe imirimo yo kubaka ikibuga cy’indege cya Bugesera yaba itangiye muri uyu mwaka cyangwa utaha, gusa mu gihe giciriritse izamuka ry’ubukungu riracyari hejuru, riteganyijwe ku 8%”. Mu Ukuboza umwaka ushize Guverinoma y’u Rwanda na Qatar Airways basinye amasezerano y’ubufatanye mu ishoramari ryo kubaka Ikibuga cy’Indege gishya cya Bugesera, biteganyijwe ko kizatwara miliyari 1.3 z’amadolari. Muri ubu bufatanye, Qatar izaba ifite 60% naho Guverinoma y’u Rwanda igire 40%. Icyiciro cya mbere kizajya cyakira abagenzi miliyoni zirindwi ku mwaka, kizuzura gitangire no gukoreshwa mu 2022. Banki y’Isi ivuga ko icyuho mu ngengo y’imari kizakomeza kuzamuka ariko kijye ku gipimo kidasanzwe cya 8% na 8.2%. Bitewe n’uko izamuka ry’ibiciro ku masoko riri hasi, politiki y’ifaranga yitezweho gukomeza gushyigikira kugaruza imyenda amabanki yatanze, mu gihe isoko ry’ivunjisha rihagaze neza rizakomeza gufasha mu kugira umutungo uhagije. Muri rusange, ubukungu bw’isi mu mwaka wa 2020 buzazamuka ku kigero cya 2.5 % kubera ko hari izamuka ry’ubucuruzi n’ishoramari mu bice bitandukanye by’isi, bitandukanye n’umwaka ushize aho bwazamutse ku kigero cya 2.4 %. Ikigo cy’Igihugu y’Ibarurishamibare, NISR, giherutse gutangaza ko mu gihembwe cya gatatu cya 2019, umusaruro mbumbe w’u Rwanda ubariye ku biciro ku isoko, wazamutseho 11.9 ku ijana ukagera kuri miliyari 2 358 Frw uvuye kuri miliyari 2 065 Frw, zabarurwaga mu gihembwe cya gatatu cya 2018. Urwego rwa serivisi rwari rugize 49 ku ijana by’umusaruro mbumbe, urwego rw’ubuhinzi rwari rugize 27%, urwego rw’inganda rwari rugize 17 ku ijana. Muri icyo gihembwe kandi urwego rw’ubuhinzi rwazamutseho 8%, urw’inganda rwazamutseho 14%, urwa serivisi ruzamuka 13% ndetse ibikenerwa mu gihugu bizamukaho 17%.

title: Uganda imaze guhomba miliyoni 454 z’amadolari kubera umubano mubi n’abaturanyi
content: Muri rusange, ibibazo bijyanye n’ubucuruzi Uganda imazemo iminsi n’ibihugu byo muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, umwaka ushize byayihombeje miliyoni z’amadolari 454.7 kubyo yohereza hanze nkuko biri mu mibare ya Banki Nkuru ya Uganda, Ikigo cya Uganda gishinzwe imisoro n’amahoro n’Ikigo gishinzwe iterambere ry’ubucuruzi bw’ikawa muri icyo gihugu. Imibare igaragaza ko Uganda yahombeye cyane kubyo yoherezaga muri Kenya n’u Rwanda ugereranyije n’ibindi bihugu byo mu Muryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, nkuko Daily Monitor yabitangaje. By’umwihariko, miliyoni z’amadolari 75.6 Uganda yahombye byatewe no kugabanyuka kwa sima y’uruganda rwa Hima Cement yoherezwaga mu Rwanda, kugabanyuka kw’ibicuruzwa by’uruganda rwa Movit, amabati n’ibindi. Ibyoherezwa muri Kenya nabyo byaragabanyutse kuko byavuye kuri miliyoni z’amadolari 825 yabonetse mu 2018, zikaba miliyoni 535 mu 2019. Bivuze ko nibura hari ibicuruzwa bya miliyoni z’amadolari 290 byahombye cyane cyane bivuye ku makenga abanyakenya bagize ku bigori biva muri Uganda, isukari, inyama n’ibikomoka ku bworozi bw’inkoko. Nubwo Kenya ifite ikibazo cyo kubura ibigori, yatanze umuburo ku bigori byaturukaga muri Uganda, ivuga ko birimo uburozi bwa Aflatoxins bushobora gutera indwara buturuka ku ruhumbu. Kenya kandi ntiravanaho burundu akato yashyizemo ibikomoka ku nkoko zo muri Uganda guhera mu 2018. Uganda na Kenya kandi bimaze iminsi mu ntambara y’ubucuruzi bw’amata, ku buryo no mu minsi ishize amata ya Uganda afite agaciro ka miliyari y’amashilingi ya Uganda yangiwe kwinjira ku isoko rya Kenya nkuko bitangazwa n’urugaga rw’abikorera muri Uganda. Uganda kandi ibyo yohereza muri Tanzania byaragabanyutse, cyane ko Tanzania itarakuraho akato yashyize ku isukari iva muri Uganda. Ibyo Uganda yohereza muri Tanzania byavuye kuri miliyoni 91 z’amadolari mu 2018, bigera kuri miliyoni 83 mu 2019. Icyakora, imibare y’ikigo gishinzwe ibyoherezwa hanze muri Uganda igaragaza ko amafaranga ava mubyo icyo gihugu cyohereza hanze muri rusange yiyongereye akava kuri miliyari 13.4 z’amashilingi yabonetse mu 2018 akaba miliyari 13.8 mu 2019. Ibi bavuga ko byavuye mu kongera ubucuruzi icyo gihugu gikorana n’ibihugu nka Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Aziya no mu Burasirazuba bwo hagati. Umubano wa Uganda n’u Rwanda wajemo agatotsi kubera ibirego icyo gihugu gishinjwa birimo gutoteza abanyarwanda bajyayo, gukorana n’imitwe ishaka guhungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda no kubangamira ubucuruzi bw’u Rwanda. Muri Werurwe umwaka ushize, u Rwanda rwagiriye inama abaturage barwo kutajya muri Uganda, mu gihe icyo gihugu kidahagaritse kubatoteza.

title: Igishushanyo mbonera gishya cy’ubutaka: Ubuso bw’imijyi buzongerwa, Intara ebyiri ziharirwe ubuhinzi
content: Mu 2050, u Rwanda rwiyemeje kuba mu bihugu biteye imbere ku Isi aho umunyarwanda azaba yinjiza amadolari 12476 ku mwaka. Ni inzira igoye ariko ishoboka kandi uburyo bwose bwakoreshwa, imikoreshereze y’ubutaka igomba kubigiramo uruhare. Ubutaka ni umwe mu mitungo igihugu gifite itarakunze kuvugwaho rumwe mu buryo ikoreshwa cyane cyane mu bijyanye n’ubwubatsi ndetse n’ubuhinzi. Igishushanyo mbonera cy’ubutaka cyemejwe mu 2011, cyagombaga kubahirizwa kikageza u Rwanda mu 2020 ariko nticyubahirijwe uko bikwiriye. Kuva mu Ugushyingo 2019, Ministeri y’Ibidukikije ibinyujije mu kigo gishinzwe imicungire n’imikoreshereze y’ubutaka mu Rwanda (RLMUA) batangije ku mugaragaro kuvugurura igishushanyo mbonera cy’imikoreshereze y’ubutaka cyo ku rwego rw’igihugu gisimbura icyo mu 2011. RLMUA itangaza ko icyo gishushanyo mbonera kirimo gutegurwa kigeze ku rwego rwa nyuma rwo kwemezwa. Ikigo gishinzwe imicungire n’imikoreshereze y’ubutaka mu Rwanda cyatangaje ko igishushanyo mbonera gishya  kizagaragaramo impinduka zijyanye n’icyerecyezo gishya cya 2050 kimwe n’ibisubizo ku mpungenge z’inzego zitandukanye haba mu miturire, ubuhinzi n’ibindi. Ubuso bw’imijyi buzongerwa Mu bijyanye n’imiturire, igishushanyo  mbonera gishya kizagaragaza  ibyiciro by’imijyi bigera kuri bitanu hashingiwe ku mubare w’abaturage na servise zizaba zikenewe mu guteza imbere imibereho y’abatuye imijyi bazaba bageze ku kigero cya 70 %  y’abanyarwanda bose muri 2050, bavuye kuri hafi 20 % bayituye ubu. Hateganyijwe ko Umujyi wa Kigali uzakomeza kuba umujyi mukuru kandi munini. Mu rwego rwo kwirinda ko wakomeza kuba ari wo mujyi ukomeye gusa , igishushanyo mbonera cyagaragaje  indi mijyi ifite ubushobozi bwinshi bwo gutera imbere. Aho harimo imijyi ya  Muhanga, Nyamata na Rwamagana. Hari kandi imijyi umunani yegereye imipaka izarushaho kuzamuka ariyo Nyagatare, Musanze, Rubavu, Karongi, Rusizi, Huye, Kirehe na Kayonza. Hagaragaramo n’uburyo indi mijyi mito hirya no hino mu gihugu izakomeza gutezwa imbere  bivuye  ku bucuruzi ahanini bushingiye ku buhinzi. Ikindi kintu gishya kiri mu gishushanyo mbonera, ni uko ubuso imijyi iriho ubu bungana na 12% by’ubuso bw’igihugu bugomba kongerwa bukagera kuri 16%. Ibyo bizajyana kandi n’uko 30 % by’abaturage bazaba basigaye mu cyaro bazatura kuri site nke, zikava kuri site z’imidugudu 13 000 zigasigara zitarenga ibihumbi bine. Buri mujyi uzaba ufite ubwoko bw’inzu zigomba kubakwamo hashingiwe ku bawutuye n’ubucucike. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ishami ry’imikoreshereze y’ubutaka, mu kigo cy’ubutaka, Alexis Rutagengwa, yabwiye IGIHE  ko ibyo bizafasha  buri wese kumenya  urwego rw’umujyi n’ibisabwa mu mibereho y’uwo mujyi bikamufasha guhitamo umujyi yabamo cyangwa yahuza n’ubushobozi bwe. Ati “Igishushanyo kiraduha ngo, igihugu giteye imbere kigomba kuba ifite imijyi imeze ite? Kigomba kuba gifite ubuhinzi bumeze gute, inganda […] ibyo byose cyamara kubireba kikanatanga ubutaka. Ese ubwo butaka buri he? Turabufite se? Niba tutabufite turabigenza gute ngo ubuhari bukoreshwe neza?” Mu Mujyi wa Kigali niho hazibanda inzu ndende zituwemo n’abantu mu buryo rusange kimwe no mu yindi mijyi minini, naho mu cyaro hazaba higanje inzu zifatanye zishobora guturamo abantu benshi. Mu gihe mu cyaro wasangaga urugo rumwe ruri ukwarwo, mu gishushanyo mbonera si ko bizaba bimeze. Abantu bazaba batuye hamwe, ahasigaye hahingwe hashingiwe ku bihingwa byagenewe ako gace. Igishushanyo  mbonera kandi cyagennye ubutaka n’inzira zizakoreshwa mu gutwara abantu n’ibintu harimo imihanda, inzira za gari ya moshi, imihanda yihuta n’ibindi. Intara ebyiri zagenewe ubuhinzi by’umwihariko Abanyarwanda basaga 60 % bakora ubuhinzi nyamara uruhare rwabwo ku musaruro mbumbe ni 30 %. Guverinoma ishaka ko umubare w’abakora uwo mwuga ugabanyuka ariko umusaruro ukiyongera kugira ngo uzabashe guhaza miliyoni 22 zizaba zituye igihugu mu 2050. Kugeza ubu ubutaka buhingwa mu Rwanda bungana na 48% by’ubuso bw’igihugu. Kugira ngo bigerweho, igishushanyo mbonera cyateganyije ko ubutaka bwinshi bwo guhinga bwibanda cyane mu Ntara y’Iburasirazuba no mu Majyepfo ashyira Iburasirazuba. Impamvu ni uko ariho  haba ubutaka bwera kandi byoroshye kugeza uburyo bwo kuhira ku buryo hahingwa mu bihe byose. Rutagengwa yagize ati “Ubutaka bwacu nabwo usanga ari utuntu tudatatanye. Usanga byibura buri muturage afite ubutaka butageze no ku gice cya hegitali. Ntabwo twakomeza gutyo ngo tuzagere ku cyerekezo cya 2050. Biradusaba kongera ikoranabuhanga no kuvanaho ibyabangamiraga ubuhinzi. Ka karima gato, gahuzwe n’utundi.” Mu rwego rw’ibidukijkije n’umutungo kamere, ubutaka  buteyeho amashyamba bugize 30.4% by’ubuso bw’igihugu. Biteganyijwe ko buzakomeza kubungabungwa. Igishushanyo mbonera cy’igenamigambi ry’imikoreshereze y’ubutaka mu Rwanda kirimo gukorwa ku bufatanye n’inzobere zo muri sosiyete ebyiri zirimo Tzamir Architects and Planners Ltd yo muri  Israel  na Horwath Htl  Intercosult Ltd  yo  mu Rwanda. Byitezwe ko kizasohoka mu minsi ya vuba.

title: Ibyishimo by’abakiliya bahamagara n’abakoresha internet ku muyoboro wa Airtel
content: Airtel-Tigo ni imwe mu masosiyete y’Itumanaho ashimwa n’abakiliya muri serivisi ibaha zo guhamagaraga, kohereza ubutumwa bugufi, gukoresha internet, kohererezanya amafaranga n’izindi. Ni umuyoboro utanga ipaki za internet zikubye inshuro eshatu kuri internet itangwa n’ibindi bigo by’itumanaho, ukagira n’amapaki yo guhamagara ashyira igorora abakiliya bawo arimo ‘Tera Stori’ iri gukoreshwa na benshi muri iyi minsi. Abakiliya ba Airtel-Tigo hirya no hino mu  gihugu babwiye IGIHE ko ari umuyoboro utarigeze ubatenguha. Akimana Joselyne wiga mu ishuri ry’Imyuga n’Ubumenyingiro rya Musanze (IPRC Musanze), avuga ko  serivisi za Airtel-Tigo zo guhamagara, gukoresha internet no kohererezanya amafaranga zitagorana haba mu mujyi no mu cyaro. Uretse kuba iyo afite amafaranga 100 agura ipaki ituma avuga yisanzuye, Akimana avuga ko nk’Umunyeshuri muri rusange Airtel-Tigo iborohereza kuko ibaha uburyo bwo guhora kuri internet badakoresheje amafaranga menshi. Ati “Internet yayo irihuta aho waba uri hose irakora, niyo yaba mu cyaro cya kure. Usanga ihendutse byagera ku banyeshuri nkatwe bwo bikaba amahirwe yihariye, nko gukoresha internet ihendutse kandi yihuta, cyane ko nta mafaranga ahagije ku ishuri tuba dufite.” Mu mahame ya Airtel-Tigo yita cyane ku ikoranabuhanga u Rwanda rukatajemo, yemera ko umuntu adashobora kuryoherwa n’ubuzima mu gihe agikoresha internet igenda nk’akanyamasyo. Kwishyura make agahabwa megabit nyinshi ni kimwe mu bituma Mfitumukiza Jean Lambert utuye mu Murenge wa Kigabiro mu Karere ka Rwamagana  adakoresha amafaranga menshi agura internet. Ati “Nyikoresha cyane kuri internet, irihuta cyane, nta bibazo igira ntabwo iranteguha na rimwe. Bituma nizigamira kuko amafaranga nkoresha kuri internet ni make baduha nyinshi [megabit], bikadufasha kudahora dusohora amafaranga.” Munyensanga Gervais, ukomoka mu Murenge wa  Kinazi mu Kagali ka Gitovu mu Karere ka Ruhango we avuga ko iminota ahabwa iyo aguze ipaki yo guhamagara aricyo gituma ahitamo Airtel-Tigo. Ati “Ibiciro bya Airtel-Tigo biba bihendutse kubera ko iminota bampa ahandi bampa mikeya cyane kurenza iyo muri Airtel-Tigo. Iyo nkoresha cyane ni Airtel-Tigo  kuko niyo ihendutse.” Mugenzi we Amizero Jeanne, avuga ko na we yahisemo gukoresha Airtel-Tigo mu guhamagara kubera n’umwihariko wo guhamagara ku yindi mirongo adahenzwe. Ati “Airtel na Tigo nizo zoroshye kuzikoresha kubera ko batanga ama-inite menshi ugereranyije n’abandi. Nko ku 100 Frw baguhereza iminota 40. Kohereza amafaranga ntabwo urenzaho ayo gukata. Nkunda gukoresha Airtel money.” Airtel-Tigo ifite serivisi ya Airtel Money uburyo yashyizeho bufasha abakiliya kuryoherwa no kohereza amafaranga nta kiguzi bakaswe. Ndagijimana Jules  utuye mu Murenge wa Muhazi mu Karere ka Rwamagana avuga ko ari imwe muri serivisi zimunyura. Ati “Nk’ubu iyo ntekereje koherereza amafaranga ababyeyi banjye bari mu cyaro n’abandi bavandimwe banjye ntabwo bankata, ikindi nibura muri buri gasantere uhasanga umu-agent wabo bigatuma adakora urugendo rurerure ajya kubikuza.” Airtel-Tigo Rwanda niyo sosiyete ifite internet yihuta cyane kandi igaragara aho ariho hose mu Rwanda ku kigero cya 98%. Sosiyete y’Itumanaho ya Airtel ikorera mu bihugu birimo Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Congo Brazaville, Nigeria, Gabon, Madagascar, Niger, Tchad, Malawi, Zambia, Ghana na Seychelles byo ku Mugabane wa Afurika. Inkuru bifitanye isano: Uburyo waryoherwa n’ubuzima ukoresha umurongo wa Airtel-Tigo

title: Tour du Rwanda 2020: Cogebanque izasangiza abakunzi b’amagare ibyihariye kuri serivisi z’imari
content: Tour du Rwanda igiye kuba ku nshuro ya kabiri kuva izamuriwe urwego igashyirwa kuri 2.1 mu 2019; iteganyijwe ku wa 23 Gashyantare kugeza ku wa 1 Werurwe 2020. Amakipe 16 arimo atatu ahagarariye u Rwanda ni yo azitabira iri rushanwa rizanyura mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu ku ntera y’ibilometero 889.0 mu minsi umunani. Mu bafatanyabikorwa bazaherekeza iri rushanwa harimo na Banki Nyarwanda y’Ubucuruzi ya Cogebanque, imaze imyaka irenga 20 itanga serivisi z’imari. Cogebanque imaze imyaka umunani yinjiye mu gutera inkunga umukino w’amagare uri mu ikunzwe mu Rwanda. Tour du Rwanda ni kimwe mu bikorwa bya siporo iyi banki itera inkunga muri  gahunda zayo zo guhindura ubuzima bw’abaturage. Mu bakinnyi bafite izina mu mukino w’amagare harimo n’abarerewe muri Les Amis Sportifs y’i Rwamagana iterwa inkunga na Cogebanque. Barimo Niyonshuti Adrien [washinze ikipe ye], Uwizeyimana Jean Claude, Areruya Joseph na Ndayisenga Valens [wahagaritse gukina] bazamuye ibendera ry’u Rwanda. Mu Banyarwanda bane batwaye Tour du Rwanda, iyi kipe ifitemo babiri barimo Ndayisenga Valens wayegukanye inshuro ebyiri (2014 & 2016) na Areruya Joseph mu 2017. Usibye kureba ubuhanga bw’abakinnyi bazarushanwa muri Tour du Rwanda, uko baterera imisozi bakaminuka amataba, abakunzi b’amagare banegerejwe uburyo buzabafasha kugerwaho na serivisi z’imari. Muri Tour du Rwanda, Cogebanque ishyiriraho Abanyarwanda uburyo bworoshye butuma babasha gutegura ejo heza binyuze mu gufunguza konti no kubatoza umuco wo kwizigamira. Umuyobozi ushinzwe Iyamamazabikorwa muri Cogebanque, Iyamuremye Antoine, yabwiye IGIHE ko kuri iyi nshuro bazakomeza gufasha Abanyarwanda kugerwaho na serivisi z’imari zihindura ubuzima bwabo aho Tour du Rwanda izanyura hose, mu bukangurambaga bwiswe “AGUKA NA COGEBANQUE”. Yagize ati ‘‘Umukino wo gusiganwa ku magare uri mu yakuze byihuse kuva mu myaka yashize, twahisemo neza gukomeza gutera inkunga Tour du Rwanda no kwegereza Abanyarwanda serivisi zitandukanye za banki zatuma barushaho kugira umutekano w’ahazaza habo binyuze mu kwizigamira, guhererekanya amafaranga bifashishije ikoranabuhanga no guhabwa inguzanyo bakiteza imbere.’’ Cogebanque inatera inkunga ibindi bikorwa, izasangiza abakunzi b’amagare amahirwe ari mu gukoresha serivisi z’imari no kugendera mu cyerekezo cy’igihugu cyo kubaka ubukungu bushingiye ku guhererekanya amafaranga bifashishije ikoranabuhanga. Iyamuremye yavuze ko muri Tour du Rwanda 2020 bazakomeza gusangiza Abanyarwanda serivisi z’imari zihariye zitangwa na Cogebanque. Ati “Tuzaba dufite ibikorwa by’imyidagaduro ahazajya hasorezwa isiganwa ndetse no mu nzira aho amagare azaca hose (Caravan). Abazagera ahazaba hari ibikorwa bya Cogebanque muri buri gace isiganwa rizasorezwamo baziyongerera amahirwe yo kuba mu bashobora gutsindira ibihembo bishimishije.’’ Mu gushyigikira gahunda yo guherekanya amafaranga hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga, abazitabira Tour du Rwanda bazoroherwa no kubona serivisi za Cogebanque banyuze ku ba ‘Agents’ cyangwa bakoresheje Mobile Banking, Internet Banking n’amakarita (MasterCard na smart cash). Muri Tour du Rwanda 2020, Cogebanque niyo izaha umwenda umukinnyi uzaba uwa mbere mu guterera imisozi mu duce (etape) twose umunani. Ni  igihembo cyerekana ubwiza bw’u Rwanda nk’igihugu cy’imisozi igihumbi na Cogebanque akaba ari Banki Nyarwanda itanga serivisi mpuzamahanga.

title: Abahembwe muri gahunda ya BK Urumuri Initiative bishimiye iterambere bamaze kugeraho
content: Iyi gahunda yiswe “BK Urumuri Initiative” yatangijwe tariki ya 7 Werurwe 2017, yari muri gahunda yo kwizihiza imyaka 50 iyi banki  yari imaze itangiye gukora. Ubwo yatangizaga iyi gahunda, Umuyobozi Mukuru wa BK, Dr Diane Karusisi, yavuze ko ikigamijwe ari ukureba abafite ibitekerezo bizima, bishobora kuvamo ubucuruzi bukomeye mu bihe biri imbere. Ati “Iyo turebye imyaka 50 iri imbere, twibazaga uko twafasha abakiri bato, kugira ngo ejo hazaza bagire ubucuruzi bukomeye kandi bakoresha ikoranabuhanga. Twabonaga ko natwe tugomba kubigiramo uruhare kuko natwe bizatugiraho ingaruka.” Muri iyi gahunda, abatoranywa bahabwa amahugurwa ku bufatanye n’Ikigo INKOMOKO,  gisanzwe gihugura ba rwiyemezamirimo. Abahembwa bavuga imyato BK Umuyobozi akaba ari nawe washinze Zima  Entreprise ikora ibintu bitandukanye mu nzuzi z’ibihaza, Mukagahima Marie Ange, avuga ko ‘Urumuri Initiative’ yamugiriye akamaro uhereye ku mahugurwa bahawe n’inguzanyo bahawe, ku buryo ibikorwa bye byagutse. Yabwiye IGIHE ati “Ikigo cyacu cyongerera agaciro ibihaza, dukora amavuta yo mu nzuzi y’ibihaza n’ibisuguti  byabyo kuva mu 2017, iki gihembo icyo cyadufashije ni uko mbere y’uko tukibona hari ibyo tutari dufite nk’iyo fu y’ibihaza, muri make  byaratugoraga cyane kuyibona,  aho tuboneye iyi nkunga  twashoboye kugura utumashini dutoya tudufasha kuyumisha tukabasha no gukora ibisuguti neza.” Yakomeje agira ati “Icyerekezo  dufite ni ukwagura amasoko tukagera mu gihugu cyose nubwo n’ubu tugera henshi, muri make BK yatubereye ikiraro cy’aho turi uyu munsi.” Uwizeye Josue uyobora Ikigo Josh Innovation gikora ibicanwa bitangiza ibidukikije, nawe yashimangiye ko inguzanyo yahawe na BK yatumye ashobora kwagura ibikorwa bye ndetse birushaho kumenyekana. Uwizeye avuga ko  ubu batangiye gukora drones, ariko bakaba bibanda cyane ku bushakashatsi. Yagize ati “Mu minsi ya vuba leta yavuze ko igiye gushyiraho ikigo kiteranya drones no kuzigurutsa, twe turi ikigo cya mbere kigurutsa drones, ubu turimo gukorana n’abafatanyabikorwa, ku mafaranga ya BK yatumye nshobora kugira umufatanyabikorwa,  ku buryo ubu ndakeka biri ahantu heza.” Agaragaza ko nubwo habaye ikibazo cy’amafaranga yari yaratumyeho ibikoresho mu Bushinwa ntibize kubera icyorezo kiriyo cya coronavirus, akeka ko bizasubira ku murongo. Ati “Nta muntu n’umwe utashimira BK kuba yarabikoze, ubu dufite abakozi 12 nubwo tutari benshi cyane ariko uko biri birimo kujya ahantu heza, ibyo turimo kugeraho byose ni ukubera bumwe mu bufasha twahawe na BK, nubwo uyu munsi bitameze neza ariko ejo bizaba bimeze neza.” Mu 2017, Banki ya Kigali yagurije miliyoni hafi 60 Frw imishinga umunani ya ba rwiyemezamirimo bakiri bato. Mu mishinga yatoranyijwe icyo gihe harimo Safe Motos yahawe miliyoni 11.7 Frw; umushinga DSIS&T wo kuhira uhabwa miliyoni 4 Frw; Kalisimbi Wines ihabwa miliyoni 9 Frw; WiredIn Ltd ibona miliyoni 8 Frw; Pure Pro ihabwa miliyoni 9.3 Frw; Mudacumura Publishing ihabwa miliyoni 8 Frw; Yummy & Fresh ihabwa miliyoni 3.5 Frw naho Murukali Online ihabwa miliyoni 6 Frw. Mu 2018, izi nguzanyo zahawe, Sonia Mugabo Showroom wahawe miliyoni 4 Frw, Sanit Wing ihabwa miliyoni 5Frw, Imagine We Publishers ihabwa miliyoni 5Frw, House of Tayo ihabwa miliyoni 5Frw, Josh Innovation ihabwa miliyoni 4Frw naho Zima Enterprise ihabwa miliyoni 2 Frw. Mu 2019, abatsinze ni Amazon Nutrition Cabinet yatsindiye inguzanyo ya 4 000 000 FRW, Avo Health Business Enterprise yegukanye 4 500 000 FRW, Greenleaves Business Enterprise yatsindiye 4 000 0000 FRW, Ishyo foods business enterprise yatsindiye 4 000 000 FRW, Nziza igisura itsindira 4 250 000 FRW, naho Kipepeo Kids itsindira 4 250 000 FRW.

title: Inyungu ya Radisson Blu Kigali yazamutse ku gipimo cya 18% mu myaka itatu
content: Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Radisson Blu Kigali, Denis Dernault, avuga ko uku gutera imbere kwazamuye ibijyanye n’imenyekanishabikorwa ndetse n’ubushobozi bwo gukora ubucuruzi burambye kandi bubyara umusaruro, bikaba bitanga icyizere ku hazaza. Ati “Ni iterambere ryiza aho umufatanyabikorwa adakeneye kongera gushyiramo amafaranga ukundi. Ubu turimo kugaruza ishoramari ryatanzwe”. Nubwo hari inyubako zo kwakira abashyitsi ndetse n’ibyumba by’inama byiyongereye ku isoko mu myaka itatu ishize, Kigali Convention Centre, yakomeje kuba ku isonga mu kwakira inama n’ibikorwa aho kuva muri Nyakanga 2016, imaze kwakira ibigera ku 1100. Mu 2019, iterambere ryayobowe ahanini n’ibintu byinshi cyane cyane inama n’ibikorwa birenga 300 byabereye muri Kigali Convention Centre. Ubuyobozi bwa Radisson Blu Kigali buvuga ko iterambere rigaragara ari umusaruro w’imbaraga zikoreshwa n’ikigo Radisson Hotel Group, zituma idasubira inyuma ndetse n’imenyekanishabikorwa rihamye. Dernault avuga ko imbaraga zikoreshwa mu kumenyekanisha ibikorwa no gucuruza, twavuga nko kwitabira amamurika mpuzamahanga y’ubucuruzi bisigasira isura ya hoteli n’aho gukorera inama kandi abakiriya bashya bakerekwa ahantu hadasanzwe bakeneye kugana binyuze mu kwamamaza. Radisson Blu Kigali kandi ifitanye imikoranire na Rwanda Convention Bureau, mu gutanga inama za kinyamwuga zijyanye n’imiterere y’ibikorwa bizabera muri Kigali Convention Centre, bigafasha mu migendekere myiza yabyo. Iterambere rya Radisson Blu Kigali, kandi ryanagize uruhare mu zindi nzego z’ubukungu bw’igihugu, aho nk’abatwara abantu, abakora mu myidagaduro, restaurants, utubari n’ibindi bikenerwa n’abashyitsi babyungukiyemo. Muri uyu mwaka wa 2020, Radisson Blu Kigali izakirana inama zikomeye zirimo iy’Abakuru b’Ibihugu na za Guverinoma bo mu Muryango w’ibihugu bikoresha Icyongereza, Commonwealth n’ibindi. U Rwanda ruri ku mwanya wa kabiri nk’ahantu hakunzwe n’abategura inama n’ibikorwa nyuma ya Cape Town muri Afurika y’Epfo.

title: Burera: Gutura kure y’imiyoboro ntibakibibona nk’imbogamizi ku kubona amashanyarazi
content: Kuri uyu wa 18 Gashyantare 2020, ubwo Sosiyete y’u Rwanda Ishinzwe Ingufu (REG) yari mu bukangurambaga bushishikariza abatuye kure y’imiyoboro gufata amashanyarazi akomoka ku zuba, abatangiye kuyafata bavuze ko abafitiye akamaro kanini. Mu ngamba Leta y’u Rwanda yashyizeho zizafasha kugera ku ntego yo kugeza amashanyarazi ku ngo zose bitarenze umwaka wa 2024, harimo no gukoresha amashanyarazi adafatiye ku muyoboro munini, aya arimo n’akomoka ku mirasire y’izuba. Mu gihe kugeza imiyoboro y’amashanyarazi mu duce twose mu gihugu bishobora gufata igihe, hari uduce twagenewe kuzahabwa amashanyarazi adafatiye ku muyoboro munini ibi bikazaba igisubizo kizafasha kugera ku ntego igihugu kiyemeje. REG igenda ikora ubukangurambaga bwo gushishikariza abaturage batuye mu bice byagenewe guhabwa amashanyarazi adafatiye ku muyoboro mugari kwitabira kugura no gukoresha amashanyarazi akomoka ku mirasire y’izuba na bo bakiteza imbere. Aya mashanyarazi kuyabona no kuyashyira mu ngo iwabo birihuta kandi ntibigoye, igisabwa ni ukumva ko ari amashanyarazi meza, kandi hari ibyo yakora nk’ayo ku muyoboro rusange. Munyaneza Jean de la Paix atuye mu Mudugudu wa Kabukoko yavuze  ko aya mashanyarazi yamukijije kurira mu kizima nijoro. Yagize ati  “Mbere nariraga mu kizima cyangwa nkagenda nijoro ngonga intebe n’ibindi biri mu nzu, ariko ubu ndacana hakabona, abana bakareba mu makayi bakiga.”  Hakizimana Emmanuel na we yunze mu rya Munyaneza, avuga ko ubuzima bwabaye bwiza kurushaho. Yagize ati “Uretse gutandukana n’ikizima, ncaginga na telefoni ntagombye gukora urugendo njya ku Mucaca nkatanga inoti y’ijana, nanayijyanayo sindare nyibonye. Ariko ubu isaha n’isaha ndacaginga ku muriro wanjye.  Uyu murasire rwose umfitiye akamaro, amatara aba ari kwaka bimeze nko ku manywa”. Kabagema Anastasia we ageze mu zabukuru nawe atuye mu Mudugudu wa Kabukoko. Yavuze ko imirasire yatumye baca ukubiri  n’ibishirira. Yagize ati “Kera bwariraga nkagenda nzunguza ibishirira ngo mbone urumuri cyangwa nkacana akatadowa. Ubu rero aya mashanyarazi icyo yamariye, ubu ngenda habona, nkaryama aho ndeba, mbese ubu akatadowa n’itoroshi narabiretse.” Anastasia avuga ko kera yajyaga abona amafaranga agatinya kugura telefoni, ariko ko ubwo yabonye umurasire, atazatinya kuyigura umunsi yongeye kubona amafaranga. REG ivuga ko mu Rwanda ingo zisaga 52.8% zifite amashanyarazi. Izisaga 14.3% muri zo zifite amashanyarazi adafatiye ku muyoboro rusange yiganjemo akomoka ku mirasire y’izuba.

title: Uruhare rwa  Airtel Rwanda mu guhererekanya amafaranga mu  ikoranabuhanga
content: Uko iterambere ryagiye ryaduka, abantu bisanze guhererekanya amafaranga mu ntoki bigabanya umutekano wayo ndetse bikadindiza ubukungu bifuza kugeraho mu gihe gito. Banki Nkuru y’Igihugu (BNR) itangaza ko buri mwaka itakaza miliyari ebyiri zo gukoresha inoti nshya n’ibiceri kubera ko biba byashaje kuko abantu babihererekanya mu ntoki. Guhitamo kwa mbere kwabaye kwisunga ikoranabuhanga, ryatumye umuntu ashobora koherereza undi amafaranga batari kumwe, bigakorwa mu gihe gito kandi ku buryo bwizewe bigizwemo uruhare n’ibigo bisobanukiwe no koroshya imbogamizi mu bukungu nka ‘Airtel-Rwanda’. Iki Kigo cy’Itumanaho kimaze imyaka umunani gikorera mu Rwanda, kivuga ko cyizahora giteza imbere gahunda zorohereza abakiriya bayo guhererekanya amafaranga hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga (cashless) kuko ari icyerekezo kizatuma barushaho kujyana n’umuvuduko w’ikoranabuhanga ku isi. Bumwe mu buryo iki kigo cyashyizeho burimo guhererekanya amafaranga hakoreshejwe ‘Airtel Money’ bufasha abakiliya kuryoherwa no kohereza amafaranga nta kiguzi batswe. Ubu buryo kandi buha amahirwe abakiriya ba ‘Airtel’ yo kwishyura ifatabuguzi ry’amazi, kwishyura umuriro w’amashanyarazi, gushyira amafaranga y’urugendo ku ikarita yitwa Kozaho cyangwa iya Tap&Go, kwishyura ifatabuguzi rya televiziyo, serivise za leta zitangirwa ku rubuga Irembo, kwishyura serivisi z’ikigo cy’imisoro n’amahoro, no kwishyura ibicuruzwa mu masoko atandukanye,  byose bikorwa nta kindi kiguzi umukiriya yatswe. Guteza imbere gahunda ya ‘Cashless’ kandi byatumye Airtel ishyiraho uburyo bwo guhemba abakozi imishahara yabo bidasabye guterura ibandari ry’amafaranga cyangwa ngo ujye muri za banki. Hari kandi n’uburyo bwo kugura serivise za Airtel nka interineti cyangwa ukagenera impano inshuti yawe hakoreshejwe Airtel Money bihesha umukiriya guhabwa inyongera ihera kuri 30% y’ibyo yaguze. Umukiliya kandi ashobora no gutumiza ibiribwa muri resitora zikunzwe, akishyura akoresheje Airtel Money. Umuyoboro wa Airtel ufatwa n’abatari bake nk’uburyo bworoshye bushobora gufasha umuntu kohereza amafaranga mu bihugu birimo Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania, Zambia na Malawi ku mirongo ya Airtel gusa. Ushobora no kubitsa cyangwa ukabikuza amafaranga ufite kuri konti yo muri banki runaka mu gihe nimero yawe wayihuje na konti. Ubuyobozi bwa Airtel Rwanda  buvuga ko gushyiraho gahunda zitandukanye nk’izi zifasha abaturage ari indi ntamwe bateye mu kunoza gahunda zo kudahererekanya amafaranga mu ntoki yatangijwe na Leta y’u Rwanda. U Rwanda rufite intego ko mu mwaka wa 2024, amafaranga abarirwa ku kigero cya 80 % y’umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu azajya ahererekanywa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga, avuye kuri 34.6%  mu 2019. Airtel Rwanda yanatangiye gahunda yo kujya yishyura inyungu abakiliya babikije amafaranga kuri Airtel Money mu rwego rwo gushishikariza abakiliya bayo kwitabira ibikorwa by’imari binyuze kuri telefoni zigendanwa ndetse no gufasha leta kongera umubare w’abitabira ibikorwa by’imari muri rusange. Airtel Rwanda ikaba yabaye sosiyete  ya mbere y’itumanaho mu Rwanda isangiza abakiliya bayo inyungu y’amafaranga baba barabikije, nyuma y’uko byemewe  na BNR. Kugeza ubu Airtel Rwanda ni iya mbere mu kugira abakiliya benshi mu Rwanda kuko babarirwa hejuru ya miliyoni eshanu, muri bo hafi miliyoni ebyiri bakoresha Airtel Money. Airtel kandi ikorera mu bindi bihugu birimo Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Congo Brazaville, Nigeria, Gabon, Madagascar, Niger, Tchad, Malawi, Zambia, Ghana na Seychelles byo ku Mugabane wa Afurika.

title: Abishyura bakoresheje EcobankPay muri Simba Super Market bagabanyirijwe 5% ku bicuruzwa byose
content: Hashize iminsi Ecobank Rwanda Plc itangije ikoranabuhanga rya EcobankPay rifasha abakiliya igihe bishyura ibicuruzwa na serivisi zitandukanye mu maguriro ayo ariyo yose hifashishije ikoranabuhanga mu kugabanya ingano y’amafaranga ahererekanywa mu ntoki n’asanzwe acibwa abacuruzi iyo bishyurishije amakarita. Ni gahunda yakurikiwe na Poromosiyo ya Ryoherwa na EcobankPay yamaze amezi atatu aho buri kwezi abahize abandi mu kwishyura ibicuruzwa na serivisi bayikoresheje bahembwe telefoni zigezweho, frigo na televiziyo. Si ibyo gusa kuko buri wa gatanu Ecobank Rwanda yageneraga impano zitunguranye abakiliya bishyuye bakoresheje EcobankPay ndetse ikaba yitegura guha itike y’indege ijya i Dubai muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Abarabu umunyamahirwe umwe n’inshuti ye, bakishyurirwa buri kimwe cyose mu gihe cy’iminsi ine. Ubuyobozi bwa Ecobank Rwanda bwabwiye IGIHE ko nyuma ya poromosiyo ya Ryoherwa na EcobankPay bwashyizeho gahunda yihariye yo kwishyurira 5% abakiliya bishyura ibicuruzwa muri Simba Super Market bakoresheje EcobankPay. Bisobanuye ko iyi banki imaze kwamamara mu gutanga serivisi z’imari ziganjemo iz’ikoranabuhanga mu bihugu 33 muri Afurika, yahaye iri guriro amafaranga azajya yunganira ayo umukiliya yatanze (95%) kugira ngo ahabwe icyo yaguze. Ni uburyo bwashyizweho hanazirikanwa umunsi wa Saint Valentin, uwo abakundana hirya no hino ku Isi bongera kuzirikana no kwizihiza urukundo rwabo bahana impano, umuntu akaba yayigura yifashishije EcobankPay, akaryoherwa n’ibyiza byayo.  	Uko wakoresha Ecobank Pay Kwishyura ibicuruzwa na serivisi ukoresheje EcobankPay, usabwa kumanura application isanzwe ifasha abakiliya bayo kubona serivisi z’imari bifashishije application izwi nka ‘Ecobank Mobile App’ kuri Play Store, ijya muri telefoni zigezweho.  Nyuma yo kuzuza ibisabwa birimo umwirondoro w’umukiliya muri iyo application na nimero ya konti, ahitamo ahanditse ‘Pay Marchants’ cyangwa se kwishyura ibicuruzwa, agahita abona aho ashyira kode iranga umucuruzi wiyandikishije mu kwishyurwa hakoreshejewe ubu buryo. Uretse kuba yakoresha iyo kode kandi hari n’uburyo yahitamo gutunga telefoni ku kimenyetso cy’ikoranabuhanga (QR Code) kikayisoma [Scan] maze agakurikiza amabwiriza kugeza yishyuye ibicuruzwa na serivisi ashaka hatabayeho guhererekanya amafaranga mu ntoki. title: ‘Gisubizo’, inguzanyo ku mushahara itagira ingwate ikomeje gufasha benshi mu bakiliya ba Cogebanque
content: Gisubizo Loan Express ni inguzanyo Cogebanque itanga ku bakiliya bayo babona umushahara wa buri kwezi. Ni inguzanyo ikubye inshuro zigera kuri 15 z’umushahara umuntu ahembwa ku kwezi, na we akagenda yishyura agera kuri 50% by’umushahara we buri kwezi. Usabye iyi nguzanyo, ayibona mu gihe kitarenze iminsi mike iyo yujuje ibisabwa. Nka banki Nyarwanda yiyemeje gufatanya n’Abanyarwanda mu rugendo rw’ubukungu, Cogebanque itangaza ko muri ‘Gisubizo Loan Express’, ufashe miliyoni eshanu nta ngwate atanga naho ufashe arenze ayo akayitanga ariko byose bigakorwa mu buryo bumworoheye. Umuyobozi ushinzwe Amashami, Pierre Seruhungo Nsengiyumva, yavuze ko ari serivisi bongeye mu zo batanga nyuma yo kubona ko ikenewe ku bakiliya bayo. Ati “Intego y’iyi gahunda ni ukwereka abakiliya bacu ko tubaha agaciro kandi tubafasha gukemura ibibazo byabo byihutirwa cyangwa bitunguranye.” Yavuze ko ari gahunda yakiriwe neza kuva abakiliya bayimenyeshwa kandi ko bari kwitabira gusaba iyo nguzanyo. Hari n’abamaze kuyibona bari kuyikoresha. Usaba iyo nguzanyo asabwa gusa kuba ari umukozi ufite amasezerano y’akazi, umushahara we awuhemberwa muri Cogebanque. Cogebanque itangaza ko iyo nguzanyo, itangwa mu gihe gito bijyanye n’impamvu yayishyizeho yo gukemura ibibazo byihutirwa cyangwa bitunguranye umuntu ashobora kugira. Iteganya ko inguzanyo nk’iyo iba ije gufasha umuntu utunguwe n’ikibazo kidasanzwe nk’urugendo rwa kure, gukenera kugura ibikoresho byo mu nzu, kwishyura amafaranga y’ishuri, gukoresha imodoka, fagitire zo kwa muganga n’ibindi. Nsengiyumva ati “Ni serivisi nziza kubera ko kuyisaba bitwara igihe gito kitarambira abakiliya iyo bigeze ku kwita ku gukemura ibibazo byabo.” Gisubizo Loan Express iri gutangwa mu buryo buvuguruye ishobora kwishyurwa mu myaka itanu mu gihe kuyibona bifata iminsi mike ku wujuje ibisabwa. Iyo umukiliya ashaka kwishyura inguzanyo mbere y’igihe, nta bundi bwishyu bw’inyongera asabwa yaba yishyura yose cyangwa igice. Umukiliya ashobora gukurikirana imiterere y’uburyo bwo kwishyura kandi akoresheje porogaramu ya CogemBank. Mu gufatanya n’Abanyarwanda mu rugendo rw’ubukungu no kubegereza serivisi zayo, Cogebanque iherutse gufungura amashami mashya mu turere twa Ngoma, Kirehe, Bugesera na Rubavu (Mahoko). Kubegereza sirivisi hose mu gihugu bijyana no gutanga inguzanyo zitandukanye mu buryo bworoheye abakiliya. Cogebanque Plc yemewe nka Banki y’Ubucuruzi na Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda (BNR) mu 1999, itangira gukora ku wa 17 Nyakanga muri uwo mwaka. Ifite amashami 28 mu gihugu hose aho ifite ibyuma bya ATM 34, aba-agents barenga 600 bayifasha gutanga serivisi zo gufunguza konti, kubitsa no kubikuza zirimo n’izifashisha ikoranabuhanga binyuze muri Internet Banking, Mobile Banking, smart cash card n’amakarita ya MasterCard (Debit, Credit na Prepaid) afasha abayakoresha kwishyura no kubikuza ahantu harenga miliyoni 36 ku Isi yose.

title: Nyamasheke: Abajyanama b’ubuzima bagiye kubaka inzu y’ubucuruzi ya miliyoni zisaga 330 Frw
content: Gahunda y’abajyanama b’ubuzima yashyizweho mu 1995 ubwo igihugu cyashakaga uburyo bwo gukemura ibibazo by’ingenzi byari mu rwego rw’ubuzima. Muri ibyo harimo abantu batabashaga kugera kuri serivisi z’ubuzima no kuba hari ubuke bw’abantu bashobora gutanga ubufasha mu by’ubuzima. Yatangiranye n’abanyamuryango 12,000 ariko baza kongerwa bagera ku 58,445 bitewe n’umusaruro batangaga. Nubwo inshingano zabo z’ibanze ari ukwita ku buzima bw’abaturage, banatanga umusanzu mu kubaka igihugu binyuze mu bikorwa by’iterambere. Muri Nzeri 2017, abajyanama b’ubuzima bo mu Karere ka Karongi bibumbiye muri koperative 22 bujuje inzu y’ubucuruzi [Agaciro Legacy Mall] yatwaye miliyoni 350 Frw, bakuye mu kwizigama. Ni umushinga wakanguye andi makoperative, atangira na yo gutekereza ku bikorwa byagutse byayabyarira inyungu kandi bikabateza imbere n’igihugu muri rusange. Mu mpera z’Ukuboza 2019, Minisitiri w’Ubuzima, Dr Gashumba Diane, yasabye abatuye i Rusizi na bo kwiyubakira inzu izabafasha kwiyubaka. Ni ubutumwa bwumviswe n’abajyanama b’ubuzima muri Nyamasheke biyemeje kwiyubakira inzu y’ubucuruzi. Abajyanama b’ubuzima 2352 bo mu mirenge 15 igize Akarere ka Nyamasheke, bavuga ko iyi nzu izabafasha kwiteza imbere bakabasha kugira ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi na bo bakora byunganira agahimbazamusyi bahabwa na Minisiteri y’Ubuzima. Mukantaganzwa Consolée yagize ati “Iyo nzu izatujyana mu cyerecyezo ku buryo izajya ibyara inyungu maze igere no ku mujyanama w’ubuzima. Hazabamo ahari ubucuruzi, parikingi n’ibilo bizinjiza amafaranga kandi natwe atugereho.” Habimana Gaston yavuze ko usibye abajyanama b’ubuzima, iyo nyubako izagirira akamaro abaturage muri rusange. Yagize ati “Inzu niyuzura itangiye gukora amafaranga azavamo azajya muri twe natwe twiteze imbere.’’ Inzu y’abajyanama b’ubuzima izubakwa imbere y’Ibilo by’Akarere ka Nyamasheke. Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Nyamasheke wungirije ushinzwe Imibereho myiza y’Abaturage, Mukamana Claudette, yavuze ko akarere kamaze kugura ikibanza inzu izubakwamo. Ati “Ni igitekerezo cyaturutse mu bajyanama b’ubuzima ubwabo kandi nka twe abayobozi twumva ko tugomba kugishyigikira kuko gifite iterambere ry’akarere. Twabafishije kubona ikibanza cyo kuyubakamo.” Inzu igiye kubakwa n’abajyanama b’ubuzima mu Karere ka Nyamasheke izatwara miliyoni 335 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda yatanzwe n’abajyanama b’ubuzima. Izatangira kubakwa muri Mata uyu mwaka mu gihe biteganyijwe ko izuzura mu mpera z’Ukuboza 2020. Imibare ya Minisiteri y’Ubuzima yo mu 2019 igaragaza ko abajyanama b’ubuzima babinyujije muri koperative zabo bamaze kugira umutungo utimukanwa ufite agaciro ka miliyari 11.2 Frw, wiyongera kuri miliyari 3.5 Frw abitse mu bigo by’imari bitandukanye.

title: U Rwanda rwashyizwe ku mwanya wa Gatanu mu bihugu byiza byo gushoramo imari mu 2020
content: Urutonde rw’Ibihugu 54 bya Afurika ruyobowe na Misiri  yisubije uwo mwanya yariho umwaka ushize.  Raporo y’ubushakashatsi yerekana ko urwego rw’imideli rwazamutse cyane muri icyo gihugu, ubukungu ndetse n’ishoramari binyuze mu bikorera na gahunda zorohereza abashoramari kugikoreramo nabyo biriyongera. Ikurikirwa na Maroc yazamutseho umwanya umwe igasunikira Afurika y’Epfo ku mwanya wa Gatatu. Maroc ngo kuba yarinjiye mu Muryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe n’Umuryango w’ubukungu bw’ibihugu bya Afurika y’Iburengerazuba (ECOWAS) byatumye ishoramari rizamuka. Kenya yaje ku mwanya wa Kane, imbere y’u Rwanda.  Ibihugu byombi byazamutseho umwanya umwe. Kenya ifite ubukungu bwitezweho kuzamukaho hejuru ya 5%  kandi ifite ikirere cyiza no kuba umwuka wa politiki umeze neza nyuma y’imvururu zakurikiye amatora ya 2017. U Rwanda ubusanzwe ruza ku mwanya wa kabiri ku rutonde rwa Banki y’Isi, raporo ya Rand Merchant Bank ivuga ko rwikubye kabiri mu kuzamura icyizere cyo kuba igihugu cyo gushoramo imari. Ivuga ko u Rwanda rwashyize imbaraga mu gushora imari mu nganda z’imbere mu gihugu byakubitiraho no kuba kimwe mu bihugu bifite ubukungu buzamuka cyane ku mugabane wa Afurka bigatanga icyizere cyuzuye. Ghana yaje ku mwanya wa Gatandatu ikaba yazamutseho imyanya itatu kuko mu 2019 yari iya cyenda. Ku mwanya wa karindwi hari Côte d’Ivoire nayo yazamutseho imyanya itatu nubwo hatangajwe amatora y’umukuru w’igihugu bishobora gutuma hashidikanywaho kuko amatora ari kimwe mu bikunze kurangwa n’imvururu bikadindiza ishoramari mu bihugu bya Afurika. Nigeria yagumye ku mwanya wa munani naho Ethiopie iza ku mwanya wa cyenda ikaba yamanutseho imyanya itanu, mu gihe Tunisie yinjiye mu 10 bya mbere nyuma yo kuzamukaho umwanya umwe. Hashize imyaka icyenda iyi banki ikora urutonde nk’uru mu rwego rwo kwereka abashoramari ahantu hari amahirwe yo gushora imari yabo mu bihugu bya Afurika.
