title: U Rwanda rwaje imbere muri Afurika mu gushyira mu bikorwa gahunda ziteza imbere ubuhinzi
content: Iyi raporo yamurikiwe mu nama rusange y’Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe yabaye ku wa 10 Gashyantare 2o20 yagaragaje ko amanota y’u Rwanda yiyongereye akava kuri 6.1 rwari rufite mu 2017 akagera kuri 7.2 mu mwaka wa 2019 mu gihe inota fatizo ryari 6.6/10. Iyi gahunda yo guteza imbere ubuhinzi muri Afurika yatangijwe mu 2003 igamije kugabanya ubukene, kongera ibiribwa no kugabanya ikigero cy’imirire mibi kuri uwo mugabane. Mu 2014 nibwo abakuru b’ibihugu na Guverinoma z’ibihugu by’Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe bashyize umukono ku masezerano ateganya amahame ngenderwaho kugira ngo mu 2025 uyu mugabane uzabe wamaze kurandura inzara, kuvugurura ubucuruzi hagati y’ibihugu bigize uwo mugabane n’ibindi bigamije kuzamura uruhare rw’urwego rw’ubuhinzi mu kugabanya ubukene. Igenzura ryakozwe bwa mbere mu 2017 naryo ryagaragaje nabwo ko u Rwanda rukomeje kwanikira ibindi bihugu binyamuryango mu gushyira mu bikorwa ibikubiye muri ayo masezerano. Minisitiri w’Ubuhinzi n’Ubworozi, Dr. Gerardine Mukeshimana yavuze ko ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’iyi gahunda riri mu murongo umwe n’icyerekezo cy’iterambere u Rwanda rwihaye. Ati “Twakiriye neza uburyo u Rwanda rwitwaye nk’ikimenyetso cy’imbaraga Guverinoma ishyira mu kubahiriza ibyo umugabane wa Afurika wiyemeje no guteza imbere imibereho myiza y’Abanyarwanda binyuze mu gushyira mu bikorwa politiki zo guteza imbere ubuhinzi.” Iki gihembo u Rwanda rugihwe ku nshuro ya kabiri nyuma y’umwaka umwe rutangije gahunda ya Kane y’impinduramatwara mu buhinzi (PSTA4) iteganyijwemo kongera umusaruro w’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi no kongerera agaciro ibibukomokaho, guhanga imirimo mishya no kongera ibibukomokaho byoherezwa mu mahanga. Imibare yo mu Ugushyingo 2019 igaragaza ko u Rwanda rukomeje gutera intambwe ishimishije muri gahunda zo kwihaza mu biribwa kuko mu 2018 abanyarwanda bari bihagije mu biribwa bari 81.3% naho 18.7% bangana n’ibihumbi 467 aribo bafite ikibazi cy’ibiribwa bidahagije.

title: U Rwanda rwagumishijwe ku inota rya B+ mu kugira ubukungu buhagaze neza
content: Mu itangazo ry’iki kigo ryo kuwa 7 Gashyantare 2020, cyerekanye ko inota ry’u Rwanda ryagumishijweho n’izamuka ry’ubukungu riri hejuru ugereranyije n’ibindi bihugu biri mu cyiciro kimwe. Izamuka ry’ubukungu rikomoka ku ngufu guverinoma yashyize mu kugira ubukungu buri wese yibonamo binyuze muri gahunda nyinshi zizamura ubukungu. Ikigo S&P cyizewe ku rwego mpuzamahanga, mu bushobozi n’ubunararibonye mu kugaragaza uko ibihugu bifite ubushobozi bwo kwishyura imyenda biba byaragurijwe, kikanatanga ubusesenguzi mu rwego rwa politiki. Iki kigo giteganya ko umusaruro mbumbe w’u Rwanda uzakomeza kuzamuka bishingiye ku ishoramari rya leta, ariko ikerekana ko bishobora kuzagira ingaruka z’icyuho mu byo igihugu gishora ugereranyije n’ibyo cyinjiza ndetse bikazamura imyenda yacyo. S&P igira iti “Twavuguruye igipimo cyacu cy’izamuka ry’ubukungu kigera ku 9.5% kivuye kuri 7.5% twari dufite, ikibiri inyuma ni umusaruro wabonetse mu bihembwe bitatu bya mbere bya 2019”. Izamuka ry’umusaruro mbumbe rishingiye ahanini ku mishinga y’ubwubatsi ndetse n’urwego rw’inganda na serivisi bihagaze neza byose bisembuwe na sosiyete y’ubwikorezi bwo mu kirere, RwandAir n’ubucuruzi. S&P yerekana kandi ko umusaruro mbumbe w’u Rwanda uzazamuka ku gipimo cya 7.7% buri mwaka kuva mu 2020 kugeza mu 2023, bitewe n’imishinga y’ubwubatsi bw’imihanda, imishinga y’ingufu, stade, amashuri, ibigo nderabuzima n’inyubako zo kubamo zubakwa n’abikorera. Hari kandi inyubako z’ubucuruzi n’inganda byose bizashyigikira iterambere ry’ubukungu bw’u Rwanda. Imishinga y’ubwubatsi kandi izateza imbere imikorere y’inganda by’umwihariko ibikoresho by’ubwubatsi n’ibyuma. Hitezwe kandi iterambere mu buhinzi n’inganda zibushingiyeho bitewe n’ishoramari rizatuma uru rwego ruhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe ndetse no kongerera agaciro ibirukomokaho. S&P ivuga kandi ko imbaraga guverinoma yashyize mu kuvugurura urwego rw’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro zizongera umusaruro ndetse n’agaciro k’amabuye. Abasesenguzi mu by’ubukungu bavuga ko kuba u Rwanda rwarashyizwe mu cyiciro cy’inota rya B+ bituma rugaragara neza, rukabona inguzanyo ku giciro kiri hasi kandi bikagaragara ku bashoramari ko ari igihugu gifite aho kigana kandi kitajegajega. Bavuga ko bishingirwaho cyane n’abashoramari n’abafatanyabikorwa mu iterambere ry’ibihugu mu bijyanye no gufata ibyemezo binyuranye. Abasesenguzi bavuga kandi ko kuba u Rwanda rumaze igihe rushyirwa mu byiciro bya B, B+ no hejuru yaho bigaragaza icyizere rufitiwe mu bukungu n’uko rushimwa umurongo rugenderaho.

title: Karongi: Akanyamuneza k’abaganuye ku mushinga w’amashanyarazi uzacanira ingo 5800 bitarenze uku Kwezi
content: Umuyobozi w’Ishami rya Sosiyete y’u Rwanda ishinzwe ingufu(REG) mu Karere ka Karongi, Dusengimana Damien, yabwiye IGIHE ko uyu mushinga wo kugeza amashanyarazi kuri izo ngo watangijwe muri Nyakanga 2019. Ati “REG yatangiye kugeza amashanyarazi ku batuye muri iyo Mirenge muri Nyakanga 2019, turateganya ko tuzarangiza mu mpera z’ukwa Kabiri [Gashyantare 2020]. Umushinga uteganya gucanira ingo 5811 muri iyo Mirenge, ariko izimaze gucanirwa ni 600 ariko turimo gushyiramo imbaraga kugira ngo kuzarangire bose bayagejejweho.” Ubwo IGIHE yasuraga bamwe mu bamaze kuganura kuri aya mashanyarazi bo mu bice bitandukanye muri iyi Mirenge, bavuze ko bishimira intambwe bateye kuko bayitezeho byinshi nyuma y’imyaka myinshi bamaze mu icuraburindi. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa  w’Umurenge wa Mubuga, Ntakirutimana Gaspard, yavuze ko muri rusange umuriro w’amashanyarazi ari igikorwa remezo cyari gikenewe cyane kuko wageraga mu kagari kamwe gusa muri Tune tugize uwo Murenge. Ati “Umuriro w’amashanyarazi  urimo kudufasha mu bikorwa bitandukanye by’amashuri, hoteli, ibigo nderabuzima, insengero no mu duce tw’ubucuruzi dutandukanye twahoraga mu bwigunge. Hagenda hagaragara impinduka kuko ugerayo ugasanga batangiye kuhashyira inzu zo kogosheramo n’ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi bikiyongera kandi amasaha yo gukora ukabona ko yiyongereye.” Akazi gashya Aya mashanyarazi yafunguye amarembo ku bashoramari batangiza inganda ndetse zinafasha abaturage kubona akazi n’amafaranga abafasha kwivana mu bukene. Umuyobozi w’uruganda ruconga amabuye ruheruka gushyirwa mu Murenge wa  Mubuga, Bizimungu Jean Bosco, yagize ati “Hatari amashanyarazi ntabwo byari gukunda kuko imashini ziconga amabuye nta zindi ngufu zazikoresha, ariko ubu urabona ko dukora neza nta kibazo, n’abaturage badukorera bakabasha kubona amafaranga abafasha gukemura ibibazo by’umuryango.” Yasobanuye ko uyu munsi rufite abakozi batandatu bahoraho, aho uhembwa macye ari 2500 Frw ku munsi ariko intego ikaba ari iyo kwagura ibikorwa byarwo rukabasha guha akazi abaturage benshi nabo bakabasha kwivana mu bukene. Iyi Mirenge ni imwe mu bice by’icyaro bigize aka Karere ku buryo kubona amashanyarazi usanga babyishimiye bitewe n’imyaka bamaze batarabona. Umuyobozi w’Umudugudu wa Gisunzu, Akagari ka Murangara mu Murenge wa Mubuga,  Musenkora Jean, yagize ati “Uyu muriro uje tuwukeneye mu by’ukuri kuko dufite ibikorwa byinshi bikenera umuriro w’amashanyarazi birimo nk’inganda zitunganya ikawa zikoreshwa n’umuriro w’amashanyarazi.” Yavuze ko mbere y’uko uyu muriro w’amashanyarazi uhagera wasangaga igihe cyo gusudira cyangwa kubaza bisaba kujya gukodesha moteri cyangwa bakabijyana aho umuriro wageze mbere. Ati “Urumva ko abantu bahavunikiraga cyane. None rero ubwo dusubijwe hano izo mashini zisudira n’izibaza zigiye kugera iwacu tujye tubyikorera.” Ngezahayo Etiènne Sadoc utuye muri ako Kagari, yavuze ko yatandukanye no kuba mu kizima. Ati “Hari abo wasangaga bakoresha moteri n’izindi ngufu ariko nabyo birahenze. Iyo ubaze ikiguzi cy’amashanyarazi, ukabara n’ibyo ubasha gukora usanga mu by’ukuri ari ibintu bitandukanye kandi ntekereza ko impinduka zizaboneka.” Yakomeje agira ati “Aka gace twari dufite ikibazo cy’ubwigunge, aho kugira ngo umuntu ashobore kuba yakwiyogoshesha byasabaga ko umuntu ajya ku Mubuga, agakora urugendo rw’ibirometero bitanu ariko aho umuriro uziye ku dusanteri abantu biteguye kuhashyira inzu zo kogosheramo bagafasha abaturage bagorwaga no gukora urugendo rurerure.” Ngezahayo yavuze ko yari afite inzu icapa impapuro ikanazifotorera ku Mubuga ariko ko agiye kuyimurira aho atuye kugira ngo abashe gufasha abaturage batuye mu gace aherereyemo. Ati “Imashini zisya twazisangaga aho ku Mubuga ariko kugeza ubu tugiye kugura izo tuzajya twifashisha hano dutuye, nkaba numva ndi umwe mu biteguye kuyigura kuko abantu benshi hano bakenera gusesha.” Amatorero arabyinira ku rukoma Iyi Mirenge iheruka guhabwa amashanyarazi ni imwe mu ifite abakiristu batari bacye ariko mbere y’uko bayahabwa barushywaga n’uburyo bwo guhimbaza Imana kubera kubura uko bacuranga. Umushumba w’Itorero ry’Abadivantiste b’Umunsi wa karindwi, Intara ya Murangara, rikorera mu Murenge wa Mubuga, Pasteri Hakizimana Evariste, yagize ati “Ibwirizabutumwa ry’iki gihe ryari rifite ikibazo gikomeye kubera kubura amashanyarazi. Mu matorero umunani dufite mu Mirenge ya Mubuga na Gishyita, abiri gusa niyo yari afite amashanyarazi, akabasha gukora ibwirizabutumwa biyoroheye, abantu bakaririmba, bakarangurura amajwi, bakabasha gukorera amavuna[amasengesho] hanze biboroheye.” Uyu mushumba yahishuye ko andi matorero atarahabwa amasharazi yagorwaga no guhimbaza Imana bituma akoresha moteri zikenera gukoreshwa na mazutu usanga zihenze, zikangiza n’ikirere. Ati “By’umwihariko kuri iri torero uyu ni umwaka wa gatatu ntangiye ariko muri iyi nzu mbamo ntihabuze nka moteri umunani zihabitse zitagikora kubera kwangirika, byumvikane ko uyu muriro uje mu gihe wari ukenewe.” Si ibyo gusa kuko nk’umuyobozi w’Itorero ngo hari byinshi akora bisaba kwifashisha ikoranabuhanga nko gukoresha ibyuma bisakaza amashusho n’ibindi bifasha umurimo w’iyogezabutumwa cyangwa ugasanga bagenzi be bamubuze kubera nta muriro afite. Ati “Ubu ibintu bigiye kugenda neza nyuma y’uko duhawe amashanyarazi.” Ku munsi w’amateraniro rishobora gukoresha mazutu ya 6000Frw mu gihe umuriro w’amashanyarazu utarenga 1000 Frw. Iri torero ubu rifite n’inyubako nshya ririmo kubaka  ariko kubera kubura uburyo bwo guteranya[gusudira] ibyuma kubera nta mashanyarazi byatumye igice kimwe cyayo gisenywa n’imvura. Gusa ngo mu gihe gito bamaze bahawe amashanyarazi hari icyizere ko imirimo igiye kwihuta rukubakwa mu gihe gito cyane. Ibyishimo kwa muganga Umuyobozi wungirije w’Ikigo Nderabuzima cya Karora cyo mu Murenge wa Mubuga, Habumugisha Edson, yavuze ko kuba nta mashanyarazi icyo kigo cyagiraga byatumaga hari imirimo imwe n’imwe idindira ariko bikaba bigiye kuba amateka. Ati “Mu bihe byashize twakoraga mu buryo bugoye kuko wasangaga bitugora kubera gukoresha moteri nibura mu kwezi inywa nibura litiro 300 za mazutu. Ubwo urumva ko yari amafaranga menshi ku buryo nta gushidikanya ko ibyo twatanga tutarabona amashanyarazi bigiye kugabanuka.” Hoteli zaciye ukubiri no gukoresha mazutu Aka Karere ni kamwe mu dukunze gusurwa n’abakerarugendo batandukanye. Ibyo bituma kanaza mu dufite hoteli zikomeye, zinafite ibikorwa bitandukanye bikenera umuriro w’amashanyarazi kugira ngo zikomeze gufata neza abazigana. Umuyobozi wa Hoteli Kivu Lodge iherereye mu nkengero z’ikiyaga cya Kivu mu Murenge wa Gishyita, Murebwayire Venie, yagize ati “Mbere y’uko amashanyarazi aza mu bigaragara twari dufite ubuzima butari bwiza kuko twakoreshaga moteri, ugasanga hari ibintu bishobora kwangirikira muri Firigo kubera ko itari gukomeza gukora igihe cyose kubera mazutu ihenze ariko ubu turimo gukora neza kubera ko umuriro w’amashanyarazi waje.” Iyi hoteli igaragaza ko mu ijoro rimwe yashoboraga gukoresha mazutu y’ibihumbi birenga 200 Frw ariko aho amashanyarazi ahagereye ikaba ikoresha umuriro w’amashanyarazi w’ibihumbi bitatu. Ishami rya REG mu Karere ka Karongi rigaragaza ko abaturage bafite amashanyarazi muri rusange ari 35% barimo 25% bakoresha afatiye ku muyoboro mugari naho 10% akaba atangwa n’izindi ngufu.

title: Rubavu: Abasora biyemeje guhwitura bagenzi babo baseta ibirenge mu kwishyura umusoro
content: Ubu ni ubutumwa RRA imaze iminsi itanga aho yahuye n’Abasora bo mu turere tugize Intara y’Iburengerazuba, baba mu byiciro by’Ikoranabuhanga, Amahoteli, utubari na  Restaurants.  Ni mu gikorwa cyiswe RRA Tax Compliance Improvement Plan 2019-2020 cyahereye mu karere ka Rusizi  tariki 4 Gashyantare gikomereza i Karongi, gisoreza mu Karere ka Rubavu. Kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 6 Gashayantare 2020, nibwo Abasora bari muri ibyo byiciro by’imirimo, bigaragara nk’ibigifite intege nke mu kunoza neza uburyo bw’imisorere, bahuye n’abahagarariye RRA mu biganiro nyunguranabitekerezo, mu karere ka Rubavu. Abitabiriye bageraga ku 120 baje baturutse mu turere twa Nyabihu, Ngororero na Rubavu. Abasora ahanini bitabira ibiganiro usanga bumva neza akamaro k’imisoro ku iterambere ry’igihugu ariko hakaba bamwe mu bari mu cyiciro kimwe cy’imikorere baba bacyibera mu bikorwa by’akajagari  cyangwa  n’abagaragara ko bakora bakaba bakoresha amayeri atuma umusoro bakwiye gutanga bawukwepa. Umukozi wa RRA, Sam Kabera,  watanze ikiganiro yibukije abasora ko iyo bakoze ibinyuranije n’ibyo itegeko rigema imisoro bagwa mu bihano. Avuga ko ikigo cy’Imisoro kiba kitagambiriye guhana. Ati “Abasora baramutse bitwararitse bagatanga umusoro nyawo kandi bakawutangira igihe ntabwo bagirwaho n’ibihano”. Aba basora basabwe kunoza ibirimo kwandikisha ibikorwa bakora mu buyobozi bw’imisoro ku bagikorera mu kajagari. Ikindi basabwe kwitaho ni ugukora imenyekanisha rinoze bagaragaza uko ubucuruzi bakora bwagenze, gukoresha uburyo bugezweho bw’ikoranabuhanga mu gusora ndetse n’ubufasha mu gutanga inyemezabuguzi yemewe ya EBM. Ikindi ni uko bibukijwe ko mu gihe abakozi ba Hoteli, utubari na restaurants bagaburirwa iyo bari mu kazi, ikiguzi cy’ibyo bahawe kitagomba kurenga 1.5% cy’ibyacurujwe na Restaurant. Basabwe kandi kujya batangira umusoro ku bihembo/PAYE abakozi bakoresha. Urwego rw’abakora ibikorwa byo kwakira ababagana rurimo Hotel, utubari na restaurents  wongeyeho urw’ikoranabuhanga ni zimwe zagaragayemo abasora bagikwepa cyane imisoro mu myaka itatu ishize, ariyo mpamvu RRA yiyemeje kujya ihura n’iki cyiciro kugira ngo habeho gufatira hamwe ingamba zituma abagiseta ibirenge bazamura urugero rw’imyumvire bariho mu gutanga umusoro. Abari muri ibi byiciro bahuriye mu Karere ka Karongi kuwa Gatatu tariki 5 Gashyantare, mu gihe abasaga 100 bo mu turere twa Rusizi na Nyamasheke bo bari bahuriye i Rusizi ku itariki ya 4 Gashyantare 2020. Aba basora bose biyemeje gusenyera umugozi umwe mu bufatanye na RRA bayigezaho amakuru kuri bagenzi babo bitwara nabi badatanga umusoro ngo bafatanye kubaka igihugu. Ahanini bagaragazaga impungenge mu kumenyekanisha ikiguzi cyagiye ku biribwa akenshi bakura mu baturage kandi batanditse mu buyobozi. RRA yabasabye ko bajya bahahira ku baturage bishyize hamwe bakaba banafite TIN, nk’uko byemeranijweho n’ishyirahamwe amahoteli na Restaurants bibarizwamo.

title: Abahinzi ba kawa bakorana na sosiyete IMPEXCOR bongerewe amafaranga ku kilo kuri kawa bari baragemuye
content: Abo bahinzi ni abo mu turere twa Nyamasheke, Rusizi, Huye,Nyaruguru na Muhanga bakaba bagemura kawa ku nganda icyenda zo muri utwo turere Shangi,Kinunga,Nyakabuye, Muhari, Shyogwe, Nyakabuye,Muhari,Kiyumba, Gatare na Busanza. Bari baguriwe ku kilo cya kawa amafaranga ari hagati ya 190 na 195 ariko sosiyete ibagurira kawa yo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika ariyo San Francisco Bay coffee LTD isaba ko bakongerwa amafaranga yuzuza akaba 300 Frw ku kilo.  Oreste Baragahorana,umuyobozi wungirije sosiyete IMPEXCOR LTD yagize ati  “Mbere bari bagiye babona amafaranga atandukanye agendanye n’ayo ikigo gishinzwe iby’amakawa cyari cyagennye yo guha umuturage ari hagatati ya 190 na 200 Frw  ariko bitewe nuko umuguzi yashimye kawa, twabongeye amafaranga ari hagati y’ijana n’ijana cumi.” Akomeza agira ati “Ni umuguzi wo muri Amerika asanzwe atugurira kawa kuva muri 2014 akaba akoze igikorwa cyiza. Ni ukuvuga ko twayabongeye akagera kuri Magana atatu ku kilo. Ikawa yashimye ni izo mu nganda ebyiri zo muri Rusizi, enye zo muri Nyamasheke, rumwe rwo muri Nyaruguru n’inganda ebyiri zo muri Muhanga.” Abahinzi baganiriye na IGIHE bo mu mirenge ya Shangi, Bushenge na Nyabitekeri mu karere ka Nyamasheke bavuga ko aya mafaranga agiye kubafasha mu mibereho yabo ndetse no kwita kuri kawa yabo kugira ngo ikomeze gukundwa ku ruhando mpuzamahanga. Muramira Pheneas ati “Nahinze kawa kuva muri 19 71, ubu bampaye ibihumbi 300 ubwo nazanye toni eshatu kandi ndajya no gufata ayandi ku rundi ruganda rw’i Shangi naho mpafite izindi kawa, ubu tugiye gukomeza kwita kuri kawa cyane.” Uzamushaka Theresia ati “ Bampaye ibihumbi 52, mfite ibiti bya kawa birenga 500. Ibi bintu turabyishimiye, abana bari babirukanye ubu ndahita njya kwishyura, ubundi nite no kuri kawa nyishakire isaso.” Oreste Baragahorana,Umuyobozi wungirije wa sosiyete IMPEXCOR LTD asaba abahinzi kwita kuri kawa yabo kugira ngo bakomeze kubona amafaranga menshi. Abahinzi 8096 nibo bagomba guhabwa aya mafaranga agera kuri  202 286 745 Frw, bakaba baragemuye kawa y’igitumbwe ingana n’ibilo 2 056 441. Sosiyete IMPEXCOR LTD, ni sosiyete nyarwanda itunganya ikanacuruza kawa, ikaba yarashinzwe muri 2008 n’abantu bafite ubunararibonye mu gihingwa cya kawa, ikaba ifite inganda 20 mu ntara eshatu z’igihugu, ikorana n’abahinzi ba kawa barenga ibihumbi 20.

title: Abahoze ari abakozi ba Jumia bashinze sosiyete igeza  amafunguro ku bayifuza
content:
Mu Ukuboza umwaka ushize nibwo Jumia Food  yatangaje ko ko izahagarika ibikorwa byayo mu Rwanda ku wa 09 Mutarama 2020. Yari amakuru mabi ku bari abakozi bayo mu Rwanda ariko akaba amahirwe akomeye ku bazi kubyaza umusaruro amahirwe. Bamwe mu bahoze ari abakozi b’iyo sosiyete  ubu bashinze iyitwa Vuba Vuba Africa izakomeza ibikorwa byo kugeza ku baturarwanda amafunguro aho bari mu gihe  bayasabye bifashishije ikoranabuhanga. Iyo sosiyete nshya iyobowe na Albert Munyabugingo wahoze ari Umuyobozi Mukuru muri Jumia Food , akaba afatanyije n’abandi bari bamaranye imyaka igera kuri itanu bakora muri Jumia Food. Munyabugingo yatangaje ko mu bakozi bagiye gukoresha harimo 80 % bakoranaga na Jumia Food.
Mu gihe sosiyete zikomeye nka Jumia ziri gufunga imiryango, Munyabugingo  yatangaje ko bo bizeye kunguka kuko bazakoresha porogaramu ya telefone yoroshye gukoresha izajya isabirwaho amafunguro n’abayakeneye. Avuga ko ibyo abishingira ku kuba iyo porogaramu yarakorewe mu Rwanda kandi ikaba ikoze ku buryo bubereye abanyarwanda. Mu byo bazajya bakora harimo  gukwirakwiza amafunguro aturutse muri resitora zitandukanye mu mujyi wa Kigali bakayageza ku bakiliya aho babyifuza, kugeza ku bakiliya ibicuruzwa byo mu maguriro manini (supermarkets) n’ibinyobwa ku babyifuza. Iyi sosiyete yatangije ko Porogaramu yayo, Vuba Vuba iboneka kuri Google Play store  no kuri Apple App Store. Munyabugingo yabwiye itangazamakuru ko bakurikije ubunararibonye bafite mu by’ubucuruzi bw’amafunguro hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga, bibaha icyizere. Ati “Twashatse ibintu bibereye u Rwanda. Mu myaka itandatu ishize twagerageje ibintu byinshi, twagiye tubona impinduka ku bantu bakoresha Internet kandi byaduhaye ubundi buryo bwo kurushaho gufasha abakiliya bacu.” Vuba Vuba Africa yatangiye ibikorwa byayo  guhera tariki ya 1 Mutarama  2020. Jumia yafunze ishami ryayo mu Rwanda nyuma y’imyaka itandatu yinjiye ku isoko ry’imbere mu gihugu. U Rwanda ni igihugu cya 11 Jumia ihagaritsemo ibikorwa byayo, nyuma y’aho itangiranye imbaraga nyinshi ndetse abantu bayigereranya na Amazon ya Afurika. Muri Kanama uyu mwaka, Jumia yahuye n’ibibazo bitandukanye ku Isi hose aho yakoreraga ndetse iregwa no mu nkiko ku buryo ibihombo byayo byageze kuri miliyoni 70 z’amadolari ndetse n’imigabane yayo ku isoko ikagabanukaho 14%.

title: Radiant yahaye umwaka mushya abakiliya bayo inatangaza ikarita idasanzwe ifasha mu kwishyura ubwishingizi
content: Mu 2013 nibwo Radiant Insurance Company yatangijwe na Marc Rugenera, itangirana intego zo gufasha abashaka ubwishingizi kububona mu buryo butabagoye ugereranyije n’uko byari bimeze ku bindi bigo. Kuva uwo mwaka Radiant itanga ubwishingizi burimo ubw’inzu, imodoka ubuzima n’ubundi. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Radiant, Marc Rugenera, yavuze ko ubwo batangiraga mu 2013 bakusanyije imisanzu ya miliyari 3.6 Frw, mu gihe uyu mwaka urangiye bakusanyije miliyari 13 Frw kubera uburyo abantu bakomeje kubagirira icyizere. Ati “Murumva ko Radiant yazamutse mu buryo bugaragara kubera icyizere abanyarwanda bayigiriye kandi duhora tuvuga ko isezerano ari isezerano. Agashya twazanye ni ukuba hafi y’abakiriya bacu, ibyo abakiliya batwifuzaho dukora ibishoboka ngo tubikemure, ndasaba abatugana ngo bakomeze kuza kandi bakomeze batugirire icyizere.” Hagati aho Radiant yibarutse ikindi kigo cy’ubwishingizi cyitwa ‘Radiant Yacu’ cyo kigamije kwegera ba banyarwanda badafite ubushobozi buremereye, ni ukuvuga nka wa wundi wavuga ati simfite amafaranga arenga 1000 ku kwezi ariko ndashaka kubona ubwishingizi. Rugenera yakomeje ati "Twagiye no mu bwishingizi bw’Abanyarwanda bakora ubuhinzi n’ubworozi, urugero niba ufite inka ifite agaciro k’ibihumbi 500 ikaza kugira ibibazo igapfa, ariko uwo muntu akaba yaratanze amafaranga atarenga ibihumbi 25 ku mwaka, iyo nka iyo ipfuye ahabwa amafaranga akagura indi.” Rugenera avuga ko kugeza ubu Radiant ifite abakiliya barenga ibihumbi 150 kandi bakomeje kwiyongera, ku buryo bashaka  kugera muri miliyoni ebyiri. Ati “Turashimira abantu bacu baduherekeje mu myaka itandatu ishize kandi tubasaba gukomeza kutuba inyuma, nibaze muri Radiant kandi natwe tuzakora ibikwiriye byose.” Umuyobozi mukuru w’ikigo cy’ubwishingizi buciriritse, Radiant Yacu Ltd, Ambasaderi Joseph Habineza, yavuze ko iki kigo kigamije kugera kuri buri muntu wese ku buryo umunyarwanda wese agira ubwishingizi. Ati “Icyo dutandukaniraho n’abandi ni uko tworohereza abantu kuriha ubwishingizi no kubafasha vuba kuri babandi bagize ikibazo, kandi tukaba twakoresha na mobile money. Niba uvuze uti njye ndashaka ubwishingizi bw’ubuzima bwanjye, ukavuga uti nzajya ntanga igihumbi ku kwezi, uramutse ugize ikibazo dufata ya mafaranga tukakwishyura miliyoni, iyo usanzwe utanga ibihumbi bibiri ni miliyoni ebyiri, gutyo, uramutse ugize urupfu rw’ikirago rwo dukuba inshuro 200.” “Ikindi cyiza ni uko dutekereza na nyakabyizi, usanga umuntu afite ubwishingizi yarwara bakamuvuza, ariko iyo uri mu bitaro barakuvuza gusa, twe yayandi watangaga buri kwezi tuyaguha buri munsi, niba watangaga ibihumbi bitanu turayaguha, urumva ko ari byiza.” Hashyizweho ikarita idasanzwe Amb. Habineza yavuze ko ubu bashyizeho ikarita yiswe ‘Turi Kumwe’, nyuma yo gutekereza bagasanga hari abantu badafata umwanya ngo bajye kugura ubwishingizi kuko wenda babyibagiwe. Ati “Ariko hari ibintu usanga umuntu akora buri munsi nk’aho ajya kurira, guhahira, kugura lisansi n’ahandi, ubu twatangiriye kuri sitasiyo za lisansi za Merez, niba ufite ikinyabiziga ukajya ahantu hari Radiant, uravuga uti mumpe iyi karita, nufata ikarita ugashyiraho bya byuma bikayisoma ukishyura lisansi bisanzwe, iyo wishyuye hahita havamo ubwishingizi bw’ubuzima nta yandi mafaranga utanze." “Niba unyoye lisansi ya litiro 20 ku kwezi, urahita ubona bwa bwishingizi, ikintu ukora urajya kuri Radiant uvuge uti nsanzwe nywa ibihumbi 100 ku kwezi, noneho kuri ya karita ayo mafaranga ajye agenda avaho ari nako n’ubwishingizi burimo kumutangirwa. Abanyarwanda bose turashaka ko bagira ubwishingizi muri Radiant Yacu.” Ovia Tuhirwe Kamanzi ushinzwe ubucuruzi muri Radiant, avuga ko kugeza ubu bafite amashami 70 mu gihugu, bakaba barakoze uko bashoboye ku buryo umukiliya atamara umwanya ajya gushakisha aho baherereye. Mutoni Diogene umaze imyaka 11 atwara moto, avuga ko yahisemo Radiant kubera ko ari sosiyete itaruhanya mu kwishyura uwagize ikibazo. Yagize ati “ Kuva mu 2015 mba muri Radiant, nagiyemo mu 2015 kuko ikora neza mu bwishingizi kandi igoboka abantu, ndasaba abamotari bose kujya muri Radiant kuko iyo kuko umuntu agize ikibazo iramufasha mu buryo bwihuse.”  Amafoto: Muhizi Serge

title: Imishinga 12 y’ishoramari yashinze imizi mu Rwanda mu 2019
content: Ibi byose bifite inkomoko mu bushake bwa politiki ihamye y’u Rwanda yo korohereza ishoramari yatumye ubu ruri ku mwanya wa 38 ku Isi n’uwa kabiri muri Afurika. Mu 2018, u Rwanda rwanditse ibikorwa by’ishoramari rishya 173 ringana na miliyari 2.006 z’amadolari ya Amerika, mu gihe rwari rwihaye intego ya miliyari $2. Iri shoramari ryiyongereyeho miliyoni $ 331 (20%) ugereranyije n’iryanditswe mu 2017 ryanganaga na miliyari $1.675. Mu 2007 ishoramari u Rwanda rwanditse ryari miliyoni 800$ ariko 2017 yarangiye rigeze kuri miliyari 1.675 $, ku buryo ryikubye kabiri muri iyo myaka 10. Iri shoramari rishingiye mu mishinga y’ibitunganyirizwa mu nganda, ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro n’ibikomoka ku buhinzi n’ubworozi. Hari kandi ubukerarugendo, ubuzima, serivisi z’ishoramari n’ikoranabuhanga. Kuva muri Mutarama kugeza mu Ukuboza 2019, habayemo imishinga myinshi y’ishoramari mu bijyanye n’amahoteli, moto zikoresha amashanyarazi zitangira gutwara abantu i Kigali, imodoka zikoresha amashanyarazi z’uruganda Volkswagen, zitangirira mu mihanda y’u Rwanda. Ni umwaka kandi u Rwanda rwungutsemo ibyicaro by’amashuri atatu harimo abiri y’ubuvuzi, ibyogajuru bibiri byoherejwe mu isanzure ndetse inyubako iteye amabengeza ya Kigali Arena, irafungurwa itangira kwakira imikino, ibitaramo n’ibindi bikorwa bikomeye. Mu gihe habura iminsi ibarirwa ku ntoki ngo uyu mwaka urangire, ni ngombwa gusubiza amaso inyuma tukareba imwe mu mishinga itandukanye yawushinzemo imizi. -Kigali Arena yubatse amateka Stade y’imikino y’amaboko n’ibitaramo, Kigali Arena, yatashywe nyuma y’amezi atandatu yari imaze yubakwa na Sosiyete yo muri Turikiya, Summa. Iyi nyubako yubatswe n’abanyarwanda 70% n’abanyamahanga 30%. Ubwo yayifunguraga ku mugaragaro, Perezida Kagame, yavuze ko kuba u  rushobora kubaka ibikorwaremezo nka Kigali Arena, ari uko ari igihugu cy’igihangange, bityo ko urubyiruko narwo rugomba kubikoresha rukazavamo ibihangange. Ati “Kwitwara nk’ibihangange bituruka mu bikorwa, ntabwo ari uko ungana gusa cyangwa uko ukora, iyo ugaragara nk’igihangange, ugakora nk’igihangange ubacyo, ubu n’u Rwanda ni igihangange, tugomba kubishingira ku bikorwa.” “Ntabwo iyi nyubako twayikoreye ko isa neza, ko tuzaza tuza kuyireba tukishima. Twayikoreye kugira ngo ibihangange by’u Rwanda, bya Afurika, bishobore kuhitoreza no kuhatsindira.” Kigali Arena ni inyubako ya mbere nini y’imikino mu Karere ka Afurika y’Uburasirazuba ndetse iri mu icumi za mbere muri Afurika yose. Yubatswe mu buryo bumeze kimwe na Dakar Arena iherereye i Diamniadio nayo yubatswe na Summa ariko aho bitandukaniye ni uko iyi yo muri Sénégal yakira abantu ibihumbi 15. Ifite uburebure bwa metero 18,6 uvuye ku gisenge. Izajya yakira imikino ya Basketball, Volleyball, Tennis na Football ikinirwa mu nzu. Ishobora kwakira ibitaramo, inama mpuzamahanga, ibiterane n’ibindi bikorwa bitandukanye. -Ishoramari rya Qatar mu kibuga cy’indege cya Bugesera Ukuboza kwatangiranye inkuru nziza y’uko Qatar Airways yaguze imigabane ingana na 60% mu mushinga w’ikibuga cy’indege cya Bugesera, mu gihe u Rwanda rwasigaranye imigabane ingana na 40%. Icyiciro cya mbere cy’iki kibuga kizajya cyakira abagenzi miliyoni zirindwi ku mwaka, kizuzura gitangire no gukoreshwa mu 2022. Ni mu gihe uyu mushinga wose uzuzura utwaye ingengo y’imari ingana na miliyari 1.3$. Iki kibuga kizaba cyujuje ibipimo mpuzamahanga by’ibibuga byo ku rwego rwa mbere kandi cyubatse mu buryo burambye. -Amasezerano y’u Rwanda na PSG Umwaka wa 2019, ni umwaka udasanzwe mu bijyanye n’ubukerarugendo, nibwo u Rwanda rwinjiye ubufatanye n’ikipe ya Paris St Germain buzamara imyaka itatu bugamije kureshya abashoramari no gukomeza kuba icyerekezo kibereye ubukerarugendo. Ubu bufatanye buzafasha abakurikiran PSG n’isi muri rusange kumenya ubwiza bw’u Rwanda, umuco ndetse n’udushya twaruhangwamo kimwe n’ibicuruzwa bigezweho birukorerwamo, bya ’Made in Rwanda.’ Ubu bufatanye kandi bwitezweho kurushaho gufungurira amarembo abashoramari bo mu Bufaransa no mu bindi bice by’Isi ku buryo babyaza umusaruro amahirwe aboneka mu Rwanda. U Rwanda rwiteze ko binyuze muri ubu bufatanye, abakinnyi b’ikipe ya PSG n’ibindi byamamare mpuzamahanga, bizabafasha gusura u Rwanda, bakabona ibyiza bitatse igihugu cy’imisozi igihumbi uhereye ku bijyanye n’ubugeni, umuco, siporo, muzika, ubukerarugendo, amafunguro n’ubwiza bw’igihugu muri rusange. Ibi bihe ntagereranywa bizajya bisangizwa abakurikira PSG ku mbuga nkoranyambaga zayo barenga miliyoni 70 bari hirya no hino ku Isi. Muri ubu bufatanye, ikirango cya Visit Rwanda kizajya kigaragazwa kuri Stade ya Parc des Princes aho PSG yakirira imikino yayo ndetse no ku mugongo ku myenda iyi kipe ikoresha mu myitozo no mu gihe cyo kwishyushya mbere y’imikino, yaba iyo yambara yasuye indi kipe cyangwa iyo yambara iwayo muri Shampiyona y’u Bufaransa, Ligue 1. Guhera umwaka utaha w’imikino, ubu bufatanye buteganya ko icyayi cy’u Rwanda n’ikawa aribyo byonyine bizajya bitangwa kuri Parc des Princes. Hazabaho kandi icyumweru cy’imishinga y’abanyempano b’abanyarwanda n’Abafaransa. Icyo cyumweru cyiswe “Semaine du Rwanda à Paris” kizajya gitegurwa na PSG mu kumenyekanisha ibintu byose bikorerwa mu Rwanda. Ibi byiyongera ku mikoranire hagati y’abakora mu ruganda rw’imideli izatangizwa mu mezi ari imbere. Mu bijyanye no kuzamura impano z’u Rwanda, PSG izagira uruhare mu kuzamura abakiri bato binyuze mu gushinga ishuri ry’umupira w’amaguru i Kigali, aho iyi kipe izajya itegura imyitozo y’abatoza n’abakiri bato mu kubafasha kugira ubunararibonye bw’iyi kipe ikomeye ku mugabane w’u Burayi, by’umwihariko yanditse amateka mu Bufaransa. Ubu bufatanye busanze ubwo u Rwanda rufitanye na Arsenal FC, aho muri Kanama uyu mwaka bwari bumaze kugira inyungu ibarirwa muri miliyoni 36 z’amapawundi, ni ukuvuga asaga miliyari 36 Frw. Kuva ubu bufatanye bwatangizwa, umwaka wa 2018 ba bakerarugendo bavuye mu Bwongereza baza mu Rwanda biyongereyeho 5%. Uburyo bwamamaza ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda bwakozwe na Arsenal, bwageze ku bantu miliyoni 4.3. Umubare w’abatangiye gukurikira ibikorwa byo gusura u Rwanda (Visit Rwanda) ku mbuga nkoranyambaga nka Youtube biyongereye ku kigero cya cya 100 %, kuri Instagram biyongeye ku kigero cya 507 %, kuri Twitter biyongera ku kigero cya 72 % naho kuri Facebook biyongeyere ku kigero cya 44 %. -Uruganda rwa Mara Phones Uruganda rwa mbere muri Afurika rukora telefoni zigezweho za smartphones, ‘Mara Phones’, rwafunguwe mu Rwanda muri uyu mwaka. Rufite icyicaro mu cyanya cy’inganda cya Kigali mu Karere ka Gasabo. Rukora ubwoko bubiri bwa Mara Phones aribwo Mara Z na Mara X, zombi zijyamo SIM Card ebyiri. Mara Z igura 175 750 Frw naho Mara X igura 120 250 Frw. Mara Z ikoresha internet nke kandi yihuta ugereranyije na telefoni zisanzwe, ku buryo niba ari ibintu ushaka gushyira kuri internet (upload) byihuta kuri megabits 150 ku isegonda naho kubikuraho (download) bikaba megabits 300 ku isegonda, bitewe n’uko iyi telefoni ikoresha umuyoboro wa internet wa 4.5 G. Inakoranye Android One. Ifite camera y’imbere n’iy’inyuma buri imwe ifite megapixels 13, batiri ifite ubushobozi bwa 3075 mAh; ubushobozi bwo kumenya igikumwe cya nyirayo n’ikirahuri gikomeye kandi kibona neza cyo mu bwoko bwa Gorilla Glass gikorwa n’uruganda rwa Corning Inc rwo muri Amerika. Ku bufatanye na Google, telefoni za Mara Phones, zifite ububiko butagira umupaka bwaba ubw’amafoto cyangwa amashusho kandi agaragara ku rwego rwo hejuru, ku buryo udakenera kongera ububiko bwayo. Uretse ububiko bwisanzuye ihabwa na Google, Mara Z inakoranye ubwa 32 GB na RAM ya 3 GB. Mara X nayo ifite batiri irambana umuriro ya 3500 mAh, camera y’imbere ifite megapixels eshanu n’iy’inyuma ya megapixels 13; ububiko bwa 16 GB na RAM ya 1GB. Yo niba ushaka gushyira ibintu kuri internet bishobora kwihuta kuri megabits 50 ku isegonda, naho kubikuraho bikihuta kuri megabits 150 ku isegonda. Ifite nayo ikirahuri cya Corning Gorilla Glass n’ubushobozi bwo gukoresha igikumwe mu kuyifunga cyangwa kuyifungura. Yo ikoresha Android Go ituma yorohera abayikoresha mu bijyanye n’ibyo itwara. Ubusanzwe ngo iyo umuntu akanze mu mashusho kuri internet ahita atangira gukinika, ariko kuri Mara X banaguha amahitamo, bakakubaza niba ushaka kuyareba mu bwiza bwo hejuru, uburinganiye cyangwa ubuciriritse. Ni ukuvuga ngo nk’amashusho wagakoreshejeho 1 GB, ushobora gukoresha MB 150 cyangwa MB 200 kuri Mara X. Kubaka uru ruganda bimaze gutwara miliyoni zisaga $50. Rwatashywe rukoresha abakozi bagera kuri 200 b’Abanyarwanda mu mashami atandukanye, bakuriwe n’abanyamahanga bazobereye mu bijyanye no gukora telefoni. Mara Phone ifite ubushobozi bwo gukora telefoni 1000 ku munsi. Telefoni z’uru ruganda ubu zamaze kugezwa mu bihugu 41 byo hirya no hino ku isi. -Imodoka zikoresha amashanyarazi ‘E-Golf’ Uyu mwaka watangijwemo ikoreshwa ry’imodoka za mbere zikoresha amashanyarazi z’uruganda Volkswagen, zifashishwa mu gutwara abantu mu mushinga wa Move, aho umuntu akoresha porogaramu ya telefoni mu gusaba gutizwa imodoka mu gihe runaka. U Rwanda nicyo gihugu cya mbere muri Afurika cyatangirijwemo izi modoka ziswe e-Golf. Ni ku bufatanye bwa Volkswagen n’ikigo cyo mu Budage, Siemens, kizajya gitanga uburyo bwo kongera umuriro w’amashanyarazi mu modoka. Ku ikubitiro imodoka enye nizo zatangiye gukoreshwa ariko hari gahunda yo kwagura zikagera kuri 50, ndetse na sitasiyo zazo zikava kuri imwe zikagera kuri 15 mu gihugu hose. Volkswagen ifite intego y’uko uyu mwaka urangira gahunda ya Move ikoreshwamo imodoka zirenga 200 zirimo izo mu bwoko bwa Polo, Amarok, Teramont na Passat. Uburyo bwo gukoresha porogaramu ya telefoni mu gusaba imodoka za Volkswagen bumaze kwitabirwa cyane kuko abamaze gutunga iyi porogaramu barenga 60 000 naho abayikoresha barenga 30 000. Ingendo zikorwa muri ubu buryo n’imodoka za Volkswagen ni 13000 ku kwezi. Batiri y’imodoka ya E-Golf, igura ibihumbi $8 bivuze ko igiciro cyayo kingana n’icy’imodoka isanzwe bimeze kimwe ariko hakiyongeraho ibyo bihumbi $8 bya batiri ku giciro cyayo. Gusa izi modoka ntabwo zigurishwa ahubwo mbere na mbere zirakoreshwa mu buryo bwo kuzisangira, aho ukoresha telefoni yawe ukayisaba ikagutwara. Iyi modoka itagira imyotsi ishobora kugenda kilometero 230, itarongerwamo umuriro. Iyo kuyishyiramo umuriro bikorewe mu rugo bitwara hagati y’amasaha 10 na 11, naho kuyishyiramo umuriro ku buryo bwihuse [kuri sitasiyo] ni iminota 45. Izi modoka za e-Golf ntabwo zateranyirijwe mu Rwanda ahubwo zakorewe mu Budage zizanwa mu gihugu. Ubusanzwe iyo wakije imodoka wumva ijwi ryayo ko yatse ariko izi zo bisaba kubirebera muri ‘tableau’. Igenda kilometero 160/h. Volkswagen Group iteganya gushora miliyari €30 mu gukora imodoka zikoresha mashanyarazi, aho iteganya kongera ubwoko bw’imodoka zikoresha amashanyarazi gusa, zikava ku bwoko butandatu bukagera kuri 50 bitarenze umwaka wa 2025. -Moto zikoresha amashanyarazi Muri Gicurasi 2019 nibwo moto 20 za Sosiyete ya Ampersand zatangiye gukorera muri Kigali, zitwara abagenzi n’imizigo mu kugerageza umusaruro wazo ku isoko ry’u Rwanda. Muri izi ngendo abamotari bafataga batiri ku masitasiyo zashyizweho muri Kigali aho bazihindurirwaga mu minota itarenze ibiri. Mu Ukuboza uyu mwaka, moto za Ampersand iri ku isonga muri Afurika mu zicuruza moto zikoresha amashanyarazi, zari zimaze kugenda ibilometero 250 000 ku butaka bw’u Rwanda. Ampersand iﬁte icyicaro i Kigali, iteranya kandi igaha abamotari moto (e-moto) zihendutse, ziﬁte isuku kandi zigenda neza kurusha moto zigera kuri miliyoni eshanu ziri hirya no hino mu Karere ka Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Muri Kigali iyi sosiyete imaze kubaka ahantu hatatu ho kuzicagingira igihe zishizemo umuriro ariko izakomeza kubaka ahandi mu gihugu. Batiri imwe kuyicaginga bishyura 920 Frw ariko ntibisaba kuyitegereza, uhagera baguhereza irimo umuriro ugasiga iyo washizemo. Moto za Ampersand zirihariye kuko zisohora umwuka muke uhumanya ikirere ugereranyije n’izikoresha mazutu na lisansi. Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko gukorera mu Rwanda kw’izi moto bizagabanya 75% by’umwuka uhumanya ikirere. Izi moto zifite ahantu habugenewe uyitwaye agenda arebera umuriro urimo uko ungana ku buryo abonye ugiye gishiramo yakwihutira guhindura batiri yayo. Igerageza ry’ibanze ryerekanye ko moto itwara abagenzi ishobora gushyirwamo umuriro ikagenda ibilometero 65, inafite umuvuduko wo hejuru y’ibilometero 80 mu isaha. Izi moto zizagabanya amafaranga umuntu akoresha ho 30%, ugereranyije no gukoresha moto inywa mazutu cyangwa lisansi. Icyifuzo ni uko ukoresha moto icagingwa ashobora kuzajya acungura amadolari 900$ (ibihumbi hafi 900 Frw) ku mwaka yakabaye agura Lisansi. Iyi moto igura miliyoni 2.7 Frw agenda yishyurwa buhoro buhoro mu mezi 18; iki giciro gikubiyemo n’izindi serivisi uwayiguze ahabwa zirimo ibijyanye gukemura ibibazo bya tekiniki, kwiyandikisha n’izindi. -Ububiko bw’ibicuruzwa Ububiko bw’ibicuruzwa bivuye mu mahanga, ni umushinga ukomeye wa 2019, witezweho gufasha abakura ibicuruzwa mu mahanga haba mu gihe byatwaraga ngo ibicuruzwa byabo bigere mu Rwanda ndetse no guteza imbere ubucuruzi n’ubukungu bw’u Rwanda. Ubu bubiko bwiswe Kigali Logistics Platform buherereye i Masaka mu karere ka Kicukiro, bukaba bwarubatswe na sosiyete Dubai Ports World izobereye mu gucunga no kubaka ububiko bw’imizigo iva cyangwa ijya mu mahanga. Ni ububiko bwitezweho gufasha abacuruzi bo mu Rwanda bajyaga bagorwa no kuvana ibicuruzwa byabo mu mahanga, bigatinda mu nzira biva ku byambu nka Mombasa cyangwa Dar es Salaam. Ubu bubiko buzafasha mu kuba umucuruzi yatumiza ibicuruzwa bye nka Dubai, mu Bushinwa n’ahandi, bakabimukurikiranira bakanabishakira ibyangombwa byose aho bizaca kugeza bigeze mu Rwanda mu bubiko i Masaka. Bizagabanya kandi igihe byatwaraga mu nzira, bive ku minsi 14 bivuye ku cyambu kugera mu Rwanda, bibe iminsi itatu. Ubu bubiko nibukoreshwa neza uko bikwiriye bwitezweho gufasha u Rwanda kuzigama miliyoni 50 z’amadolari ku mwaka y’igiciro cyagendaga ku kuzana ibicuruzwa bivuye mu mahanga. Uyu ni umushinga wa miliyoni 35 z’amadolari wubatswe ku buso bwa metero kare 130 000 i Masaka. Hari ibikorwa remezo bigezweho kandi bijyanye n’igihe, umwanya uhagije ushobora guparikamo amakamyo agera kuri 200, n’umwanya wakwakira kontineri 50 000 ku mwaka. Hazajya hatangirwa n’izindi serivisi zikenerwa n’abacuruzi nk’iz’amabanki, Ikigo cy’imisoro n’amahoro, Ikigo cy’ubuziranenge, polisi n’izindi. Mu bakozi bakora muri Kigali Logistics 98 % ni abanyarwanda. Ubu bubiko buzacungwa na Dubai Ports World mu gihe cy’imyaka 25, Leta y’u Rwanda ibone kubwegukana. -Ishoramari rya Vivendi Group Ikigo gikomeye mu Bufaransa, Vivendi Group kibarizwamo Canal+, ni ikindi kigo cy’ishoramari u Rwanda rwungutse muri uyu mwaka, aho kizashora imari muri Kigali Cultural Village ingana na miliyoni $40 Uyu mushinga uzubakwa ku musozi wa Rebero mu Mujyi wa Kigali, ni umudugudu uzaba ugizwe n’inyubako zakira ba mukerarugendo, uberamo ubucuruzi bugaragaza ibikorwa by’umuco nyarwanda, ibibuga by’imyidagaduro, ubusitani bwiza burimo ibihangano bya kinyarwanda, amateka n’ibindi. Ni umushinga wose hamwe uzubakwa ku butaka bwa hegitari 30.1 Vivendi Group ni ikigo gishamikiye kuri Bolloré Holdings. Gikora ibijyanye n’imyidagaduro, gifite televiziyo n’inzu itunganya filime ya Canal+ Group, inzu itunganya umuziki ya Universal Music Group, inzu y’ibitabo ya Editis, ikigo cy’itumanaho cya Havas, ikigo cy’imikino cya Gameloft n’urubuga rushyirwaho amashusho rwa Dailymotion. Mu masezerano y’imyaka 20 yahawe, mu cyiciro cya mbere Vivendi Group yo izashoramo hagati ya miliyoni 3-4 z’amadolari ya Amerika, aho biteganyijwe ko kizuzura mu mezi atandatu ari imbere. Iki cyiciro kizasiga hari inzu igezweho yo kwerekaniramo sinema ifite imyanya 300, ahantu hashobora kubera ibitaramo hanze hakwakira abantu 15,000, ahantu ho gufatira amafunguro n’ahagenewe imikino y’abana. Hazaba hashobora kwerekanirwa sinema inshuro 19 mu cyumweru, ibitaramo, amaserukiramuco, imyiherero n’inama. Icyiciro cya kabiri kizakomereza ku mirimo y’icyiciro cya mbere. Kizubakwamo studio ya Universal, icyumba cy’imikino (Escape games) n’ahantu haba imikino ya Gameloft mu ikoranabuhanga, ibibuga by’abana, utubari, restaurant na Canal Factory. Canal Factory ni inzu ikomeye izaba itunganya umuziki n’amashusho arimo sinema n’ibiganiro bya televiziyo, ibikorwa byitezweho kuzamura impano z’abanyarwanda cyangwa abanyeshuri bifuza gukarishya ubumenyi mu gutunganya filime. -Kaminuza ya Carnegie Mellon Icyicaro gishya cya Carnegie Mellon University, cyuzuye mu cyanya cyahariwe inganda i Masoro, na cyo cyafunguwe muri uyu mwaka. Iyi kaminuza yakoreraga i Kigali mu nyubako ya Telecom House ku Kacyiru, imaze kurangizamo abanyeshuri 196 bakomoka mu bihugu 19. Bari bavuye ku banyeshuri 20 batangiranye nayo mu 2012. Amasomo atangirwa muri iyi kaminuza ni ajyanye n’ikoranabuhanga, mu cyiciro cya gatatu cya Kaminuza (Masters’ Degree) mu mashami arimo Electrical and Computer Engineering na Information Technology. Iki cyicaro gifite amashuri menshi kurushaho, byose bigamije gutuma nk’abanyeshuri bari mu Rwanda babasha kubona amasomo atangirwa mu mujyi wa Pittsburgh muri Leta ya Pennsylvania aho Carnegie Mellon University ifite icyicaro gikuru, ndetse n’abanyeshuri bari Pittsburgh bagafata amasomo yigishirizwa mu Rwanda. Umunyeshuri wiga muri CMU ari muri Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika yishyura ibihumbi $48, ariko abigira i Kigali bishyuzwa ibihumbi $16. Umunyarwanda yishyuzwa ibihumbi $8 nayo akayishyurirwa n’inkunga ya leta. Kugira ngo Umunyarwanda yemererwe kwiga muri iyi kaminuza asabwa kuba yaratsinze ku rwego rwo hejuru muri kaminuza, ariko na CMU ikamukoresha ibizamini byayo birimo n’icy’Icyongereza. -Singita Kwitonda Lodge Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House, ni inyubako yo ku rwego rwo hejuru yakira ba mukerarugendo, yuzuye mu Karere ka Musanze, munsi y’ibirunga. Singita Kwitonda Lodge and Kataza House yafunguwe muri uyu mwaka, igizwe n’inyubako zigezweho zubatse mu Karere ka Musanze mu Murenge wa Nyange, ku birenge by’Ikirunga cya Sabyinyo, aho uba unitegeye ibirunga bya Gahinga na Muhabura. Uyu mushinga ugizwe n’inzu umunani zubatswe mu buryo zirengera ibidukikije. Zirimo zirindwi zagenewe umuntu umwe cyangwa uherekejwe kuko buri imwe ifite uburiri bumwe, uruganiriro rwagutse n’ibindi byangombwa nkenerwa, hakaba indi imwe yiswe Kataza House yo igizwe n’ibyumba bine byo kuraramo. Yubatswe n’ibikoresho byinshi byakorewe mu Rwanda, ibyinshi ni ibiboneka i Musanze birimo amakoro n’imigano. Ibiciro byaho byihagazeho nubwo bihindagurika bitewe n’ibihe, nk’uyu munsi uwakwifuza kuharara ari wenyine yakwishyura $1750 ku ijoro rimwe, uyavunje mu mafaranga y’u Rwanda nibura ni miliyoni 1.6 Frw, mu gihe abantu babiri bishyura $3500. Kurara muri Kataza House byo bishobora kugera ku 8000$ ku ijoro rimwe ku bantu babiri, barengaho bikaba $15 000 ku ijoro. Muri Singita Kwitonda kandi biteganywa ko iminsi mike umuntu ashobora kwemererwa kuhamara ari itatu. Muri icyo giciro haba hakubiyemo n’ibintu byose umuntu akenera mu ijoro, birimo ibyo kurya no kunywa byose bihaboneka. Singita Kwitonda Lodge yashoweho miliyoni $25. -Kaminuza ya UGHE Uyu mwaka usigiye u Rwanda icyicaro cya Kaminuza mpuzamahanga y’ubuvuzi, University of Global Health Equity (UGHE), iherere i Butaro mu Karere ka Burera. Iyi Kaminuza igizwe n’inyubako zitandukanye zirimo ibyumba by’amashuri, aho kurara, laboratwari, inzu z’imyidagaduro n’ibindi bigezweho, ikaba hafi y’ibitaro bya Butaro bizobereye mu kuvura Kanseri, mu bilometero 80 uvuye i Kigali. Abanyeshuri bemerererwa kwiga muri iyi kaminuza ni abarangije icyiciro cya kabiri cya Kaminuza mu mashami y’ubuganga (Medicine), Kubaga (surgery) cyangwa abafite icyiciro cya gatatu mu mitangire y’ubuvuzi rusange. Iyi Kaminuza yari isanzwe ifite agashami i Kigali katangiye mu 2015 kigisha amasomo y’icyiciro cya gatatu mu mitangire y’ubuvuzi rusange (Global Health delivery). Mu 2018, abanyeshuri 300 banditse basaba kwiga muri iryo shuri ariko haherutse gutangira abagera kuri 24 gusa baturutse mu bihugu 12 bitandukanye byo muri Afurika. -Ibyogajuru bibiri byoherejwe mu isanzure Ku bufatanye bwa Leta y’u Rwanda n’ikigo mpuzamahanga mu by’itumanaho, OneWeb, mu 2019, hoherejwe mu isanzure icyogajuru cyiswe ‘Icyerekezo’. Ni umushinga w’ikigo OneWeb gifite gahunda yo kohereza mu isanzure ibyogajuru 650 mu myaka ibiri, bizakwirakwiza internet icika gake cyane ugereranyije n’isanzwe. Ibi byogajuru byakozwe ku bufatanye n’ikigo Airbus Defence and Space. Icyogajuru cy’u Rwanda cyohererejwe rimwe n’ibindi bitanu, mu gikorwa cyabereye mu gace ka Guyane muri Amerika y’Amajyepfo ariko kagenzurwa n’u Bufaransa. Ibi byogajuru byahagurutse bifashijwe na ’rocket’ ya Soyouz yakozwe n’Abarusiya. Hoherejwe kandi icyogajuru, RWASAT-1, ku wa 25 Nzeri 2019, gihagurukira muri Tanegashima Space Center mu majyepfo y’u Buyapani. Icyogajuru RWASAT-1 cyakozwe na Kaminuza ya Tokyo ifatanyije n’itsinda ry’Abanyarwanda 15, abo byitezwe ko kizatanga umusanzu mu iterambere ry’ubuhinzi mu Rwanda. Gikoranye akuma gato gafite ubushobozi buhambaye bwatuma kibasha gupima ingano y’amazi mu butaka, ubushyuhe, ubuhehere n’ibindi bipimo bijyanye n’imiterere y’ibihe. Kireshya na Sentimetero 30 z’uburebure na 10 z’ubugari, gipima kilogarama 3.8. Amafoto: Niyonzima Moise&Muhizi Serge

title: Imisanzu y’abanyamuryango b’ikigega Ejo Heza yageze kuri Miliyari mu mwaka umwe
content: ‘Ejo heza’ yatangijwe mu isozwa ry’Inama y’Igihugu y’Umushyikirano yo ku wa 14 Ukuboza 2018 nk’uburyo buzafasha igihugu kwihutisha iterambere, aho buri umwe azaba abasha kwiteganyiriza. Ubwo yatangizaga ubu bwizigame Minisitiri w’Imari n’Igenamigambi, Dr Ndagijimana Uzziel, yavuze ko buzafasha abantu basanzwe binjiza ariko bitari mu buryo bw’umushahara kubona pansiyo, amacumbi ndetse n’ubwishingizi bw’ubuzima. Yagize ati “Inyungu za ‘Ejo Heza’ harimo kubona pansiyo ihoraho ya buri kwezi nk’ihabwa abakozi bakorera imishahara, kuba uwizigamiye ashobora kugera ku bindi by’ ingenzi nko kubona icumbi, ubwishingizi bw’ubuzima, kuriha amashuri no gukoresha igice cy’ubwizigame nk’ ingwate ku nguzanyo.” Umuyobozi ushinzwe imirimo rusange muri RSSB, Nyirishema Innocent yavuze ko nyuma y’umwaka ubu bwizigame butangijwe, ubwitabire buhagaze neza. Ati “Ubwitabire muri Ejo Heza bumeze neza ubungubu imibare igaragaza ko nyuma y’umwaka itangiye abamaze kwinjiramo ndetse bagatangira no kwizigamira bamaze kurenga ibihumbi 200, uyu munsi bakaba bamaze kwizigamira amafaranga arenga miliyari y’amanyarwanda.” Nyirishema yongeyeho ko Ejo Heza izafasha umuntu winjiza amafaranga ayo ari yo yose kuba yakwizigamira amafaranga azamufasha mu gihe azaba atagishoboye gukora, anakangurira abatariyandikishamo kuyigana. Ati “Umunyarwanda wese uyu munsi ushoboye gukora no kugira icyo yinjiza, igihe azaba atakibishoboye azabe afite igisimbura wa mubyizi yacyuraga. Ejo Heza rero ni cyo gisubizo yaje ituzaniye, nicyo gituma dukangurira Abanyarwanda ko bayinjiramo.” Uwizigamye muri Ejo Heza mu gihe azaba agize imyaka 55, ubwizigame bwe azatangira kubuhabwa nka pansiyo ya buri kwezi. Icyakora mu gihe yaba amaze kurenza umusanzu wa miliyoni 4FRW, akagaragaza umushinga nk’uwo kubaka icumbi cyangwa kwishyura amashuri, ashobora guhabwa ikigero runaka cyarenga kuri miliyoni enye. Mu gihe cy’imyaka itatu uhereye igihe Ejo Heza yatangirijwe, umunyamuryango uri mu cyiciro cya mbere cyangwa icya kabiri cy’ubudehe mu gihe yizigamiye muri Ejo Heza, nibura amafaranga 15 000 ku mwaka, leta izamwongereraho uruhare rwayo rungana 100% ariko ku buryo rutarenga 18000 FRW. Ubwishingizi bw’ubuzima n’ubwo gushyingura Abanyamuryango bari mu cyiciro cya mbere n’icya kabiri cy’ubudehe bizigamiye nibura 15 000 FRW muri Ejo Heza ku mwaka. Bazahabwa ubwishingizi bw’ubuzima n’ubwo gushyingura mu mwaka ukurikiraho. Ubwizigame fatizo muri ‘Ejo heza’ ku bari mu cyiciro cya mbere n’icya kabiri ni ibihumbi 15 Frw ku mwaka, abo mu cya gatatu ni ibihumbi 18 Frw ku mwaka ariko n’utayagezeho ntabuzwa kuzigama, abo mu cya kane ni ibihumbi 72 Frw, kandi umuntu yihitiramo uburyo bumworoheye azajya ayatangamo. Gufungura konti muri ‘Ejo Heza’ bikorerwa kuri telefoni. Umuntu akanda *506# ku mirongo ya MTN na Airtel &Tigo. Kwiteganyiriza ni kimwe mu bizafasha u Rwanda kugera ku ntego yo kuzamura ubukungu bwarwo bukava ku rwego rw’ibihugu bikennye rukagera mu biyingayinga ibikize mu 2035 no kugera mu bikize mu cyerekezo cya 2050.

title: Umwalimu SACCO yatangije uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga rya banki rizateza imbere serivisi zayo
content: Iri koranabuhanga ryifashisha telefoni ngendanwa, rizaha ubushobozi umunyamuryango wa koperative kugenzura ibikorwa byose bibera kuri konti ye ndetse no kuba hari serivisi yakwikorera bitamusabye kujya kuri banki. Iki gikorwa cyamuritswe kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 27 Ukuboza 2019, mu Nteko rusange idasanzwe yahurije hamwe ubuyobozi bwa koperative n’abanyamuryango bahagarariye abandi bo mu mirenge yose y’igihugu. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Koperative ‘Umwalimu SACCO’, Uwambaje Laurence, yavuze ko ubu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga bwiswe ‘UMWALIMU SACCO Mobile Banking’, buzajya bufasha umunyamuryango kubitsa no kubikuza amafaranga kuri konti ye, yishyure ibyo akeneye byose, agenzure ibikorerwa kuri konti ye, yake inguzanyo, n’ibindi, byose bikorwe yifashishije telefoni ye bwite. Ati “Ubu buri munyamuryango agendana konti ye muri telefoni; bose babasha kwifatira inguzanyo nto bifashishije telefoni zabo, ikibaye cyose kuri konti zabo barakimenya.” Iyi koperative ivuga ko igifite intambwe zo gutera mu rugendo rw’ikoranabuhanga muri serivisi za banki, aho iteganya gutangiza uburyo bw’ikarita yo kubikurizaho no kubitsa ya (ATM) mu 2020. Bamwe mu banyamuryango bari bitabiriye iyi nama bavuga ko ubu buryo bushya bw’ikoranabuhanga ryifashisha telephone buzabafasha kugabanya igihe bakoreshaga bajya kuri banki, kandi ko bizatanga umusaruro mwinshi urimo no kuzamura ireme ry’uburezi. Niyonkuru Sylvestre, umwarimu wo ku Ishuri rya Kigembe TVET School, mu karere ka Gisagara, Umurenge wa Kigembe yavuze ko ubu ibijyanye no guhererekanya amafaranga byoroshye. Ati “Ubu nshobora koherereza umuntu amafaranga nkuye kuri konti yanjye bitansabye kuva aho ndi; muri make Mobile Banking muri koperative yacu ije ari igisubizo kandi turyohewe nayo. Ikindi bizakuraho na wa mwanya najyaga nyaruka ngiye gushaka amafaranga kuri banki, nyamara nari kuba ndi gutegura amasomo cyangwa ndi kumwe n’abanyeshuri nigisha.” Mukahigiro Venantie wigisha ku Ishuri ribanza rya Kibirizi, riherereye mu Murenge wa Kibirizi, mu Karere ka Nyamagabe na we yashimangiye ko ikoranabuhanga rishya rizoroshya imikorere ya koperative. Ati “Mbere y’uko ubu buryo butangizwa, byaratugoraga cyane kuko benshi muri twe ntiduturiye amashami ya koperative. Twakoraga urugendo rutari ruto, bigatuma hari amafaranga dutakaza, ariko ubu ayo natakazaga ku giti cyanjye nzajya nyakoresha ibindi uko yaba angana kose.” Usibye uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga ryifashisha telefoni bwamuritswe muri iyi nama; Koperative ‘Umwalimu SACCO’ yanagaragaje amabara mashya y’ibirango byayo byemewe n’amategeko; inatangiza ku mugaragaro inguzanyo yiswe [Home Solar Energy Loan] izajya ihabwa abanyamuryango bayo mu rwego rwo gutunga amashanyarazi ku batayafite cyangwa kugabanya ikiguzi cyayo ku bayasanganywe. Hanamuritswe ikoranabuhanga ryiswe [Urubuto Education System] rizajya rifasha ababyeyi kwishyura amafaranga y’ishuri bitabagoye n’abayobozi b’ishuri bagakurikirana neza uko amafaranga yishyurwa kuri konti z’ishuri. Hanatangijwe kandi uburyo bwo kuzigama bwitwa ‘Nzigamira Nige’ buzafasha abanyamuryango kuzigama amafaranga y’ishuri y’abana babo. Iyi gahunda imaze gushyirwaho ubwizigame bungana na miliyoni 159 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Mu 2019, Umwalimu SACCO’ wabonye inyungu ya miliyari esheshatu na miliyoni 119 Frw); inyungu koperative ivuga ko yaturutse ku micungire myiza y’inguzanyo n’ingufu nyinshi zongerewe mu kugaruza inguzanyo zari zaracyererewe. Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda (BNR) ivuga ko ‘Umwalimu SACCO’ ari kimwe mu bigo by’imari iciriritse bigari mu Rwanda kuko yihariye hafi kimwe cya kane cy’umutungo rusange w’ibigo by’imari iciriritse mu gihugu. Kugeza uyu munsi mu gihugu hose harabarurwa amashami 30 ya koperative Umwalimu Sacco n’abakozi basaga 200, bita ku banyamuryango basaga ibihumbi 73. Mu mwaka ushize nibwo Leta y’u Rwanda yavuze ko mu 2022 izahagarika inkunga ya miliyari 30 Frw, yatangiye guha Koperative Umwalimu SACCO kuva mu 2008 ubwo yashingwaga. Ubuyobozi bw’iyi koperative buvuga ko igihe cyo guhagarika iyi nkunga kizagera imaze kugeza umwarimu ku rwego rushimishije kandi nta mpungenge zihari kuko koperative izakomeza gutanga inguzanyo uko bisanzwe kuko izaba iri ku rwego rwo kwigira.

title: Abacuruzi n’abafite inzozi zo kwinjira mu bushabitsi bagiye kuganirizwa ku kunoza ibikorwa byabo
content: Iki gikorwa cyateguwe n’Ihuriro rya Gikirisitu rihuza abacuruzi n’abandi bafite izo nzozi, Authentic Business Club. Giteganyijwemo ibiganiro bizahabwa abacuruzi harebwa uburyo abafite inzozi zabwo bazishyira mu bikorwa n’uburyo abamaze gutangiza ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi babiyobora mu murongo w’ijambo ry’Imana bikarushaho gutera imbere. Umuyobozi wa Authentic Business Club, Pasiteri Manirakiza Divin, yavuze ko iki gikorwa kigamije gufasha abantu gutangira ubucuruzi no kubuyobora bikwiye. Yagize ati “Tugamije gufasha umuntu gutangira ubucuruzi bwe, icya kabiri ni ugufasha wa wundi wakoraga ubucuruzi kubukosora akabuyobora mu murongo w’ijambo ry’Imana. Mu bucuruzi ni hamwe mu hantu usanga ibyaha byinshi ku buryo bamwe usanga babikora batabizi abandi na bo bagatekereza ko gucuruza ari ko bimera.” Yavuze ko hari ukuri ijambo ry’Imana rivuga ku bucuruzi harimo kwishyura imisoro neza n’ibindi bikorwa bigendanye n’ukuri ku ijambo ry’Imana. Aha atanga urugero ku mugani w’itaranto aho abagaragu bahawe amataranto bamwe bakayabyaza andi ndetse shebuja akabashimira mu gihe abandi ntacyo bayabyaje bigatuma babaka n’ayo bari bafite. Pasiteri Manirakiza yagaragaje ko uru ari urugero ko Imana ishyigikiye ubucuruzi ariko bukozwe mu nzira ziboneye butarimo ubujura cyangwa ibindi bintu bibi. Iki gikorwa cyahawe insanganyamatsiko igira iti “Imbogamizi duhura nazo, andi mahirwe mu bucuruzi.” Abazitabira ibi biganiro bazasobanurirwa amahirwe y’ubucuruzi abazengurutse n’amabanga yo guteza imbere ishoramari ryabo. Ni inyigisho zishingiye ku mahame y’ijambo ry’Imana zigisha uburyo umuntu yateza imbere ibikorwa bye by’ubucuruzi ashingiye ku ijambo ry’Imana. Pasiteri Manirakiza yashimangiye ko bi biganiro byereka abantu bafite intumbero mu bucuruzi cyangwa n’ababugezemo ko bashobora gukoresha amahame ya Bibiliya kandi bagatera imbere. Yongeraho ko “bikangura abantu bikabereka ko batagomba kujya mu mwuka gusa ahubwo bagomba kubijyanisha byombi bakubaka umwuka ariko bakubaka n’ibifatika kuko turi mu Isi, ntituragera mu ijuru.” Ibi biganiro bishamikiye ku Ishuri ryitwa Focus Business School. Ni ishuri rifite inkomoko muri Suède rifite icyicaro cyaryo mu Rwanda aho rifatanya n’Itorero Zion Temple Celebration Centre. Pasiteri Manirakiza yavuze ko iri shuri mu byo rifasha abaryigamo harimo kwiteza imbere uhereye hasi. Yongeraho ko ushobora kuba umugenzi ujya mu ijuru ariko bitakubuza kubaho neza ku Isi. Ibi biganiro ni umwanya wo gusobanukirwa amahirwe y’ubucuruzi ahari n’amabanga yo guteza imbere ishoramari. Byatumiwemo bamwe mu bacuruzi bateye imbere aho bazaganiriza bazasangiza abandi amabanga bakoresheje. Abazabyitabira bazaganirizwa n’abarimo Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Hôtel des Mille Collines, Consolata Ruboneka; Kamugisha Amos na Sengiyumva Richard. Bizanitabirwa n’Umushumba w’Itorero Zion Temple Celebration Center ku Isi, Apôtre Dr. Paul Gitwaza. Biteganijwe kubera muri Kigali Convention Centre ku wa Gatandatu tariki ya 28 Ukuboza 2019 guhera saa Munani z’amanywa.

title: Abishyura ibicuruzwa bakoresheje EcobankPay bahishiwe impano nyinshi mu minsi mikuru isoza umwaka
content: Mu Ugushyingo uyu mwaka nibwo Ecobank Rwanda Plc yatangije poromosiyo ya Ryoherwa na EcobankPay, ifasha abakiliya bakoresha EcobankPay kwishyura ibicuruzwa na serivisi zitandukanye mu maguriro ayo ariyo yose, hatabayeho guhererekanya amafaranga mu ntoki. Iri koranabuhanga rigamije gushimira abakiliya bahisemo kugendana n’ibigezweho, bagaca ukubiri no kugendana ibifurumba by’amafaranga mu mufuka no mu ntoki. Uretse kubarinda kuyibwa, kuyata cyangwa kuyatagaguza, urikoresheje abona n’amahirwe yo kwegukana ibihembo bishimishije, byamufasha kwizihiza iyi minsi mikuru isoza umwaka. Ubwo iri koranabuhanga ryatangizwaga, Ubuyobozi bwa Ecobank bwahishuye ko buzanafasha abakiliya n’abacuruzi bakoresha ubwo buryo gutsindira ibihembo birimo televiziyo za rutura [Flat Tv], telefone zigezweho, frigo n’itike z’indege zijya mu Bushinwa na Dubai muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Abarabu, bakanishyurirwa ibizabafasha igihe bazaba bariyo. Nubwo ibyo ari ibihembo bya buri kwezi, hari n’ibya buri wa Gatanu bitangirwa mu maguriro atandukanye, umukiliya uhashye yifashishije ubu buryo agahembwa. Ntibyahereye mu magambo gusa kuko ab’inkwakuzi bamaze kuganura kuri ibi bihembo bya buri kwezi naho ibya buri wa Gatanu byo bimaze kuba akamenyero ko uhahiye mu iguriro ritahiwe akoresheje EcobankPay, atahana impano zirusha agaciro ibyo yaguze. Ku wa 20 Ukuboza mbere gato ya Noheli nibwo abanyamahirwe batatu batsindiye ibihembo by’Ugushyingo babishyikirijwe. Umwe yatsindiye televiziyo ya rutura ifite pousse 32, undi atsindira frigo naho undi atsindira telefone igezweho. Umulisa Diana wo mu Murenge wa Jali mu Karere ka Gasabo watsindiye frigo, yavuze ko akimenya ko Ecobank Rwanda yatangije iri koranabuhanga yahise arikoresha, ahantu agiye guhahira akabanza kubabaza niba bakoresha EcobankPay. Ati “Uko najyaga kwishyura aho mpahiye, icya mbere nabanzaga kubabaza niba bafite EcobankPay. Icyo nabwira abantu, ni ukubashishikariza kubukoresha kuko buroroshye kandi burizewe kuko utagendana amafaranga mu mufuka, byose ubikora na telefone yawe.” Umuyobozi ushinzwe kumenyekanisha ibikorwa bya Ecobank Rwanda, Mana Desire yavuze ko hasigaye ibihembo by’amezi abiri n’ibihembo nyamukuru bizatangwa irishanwa risojwe. Nta gushidikanya ko nawe niba wishyura ukoresheje ubu buryo budatuma ukatwa amafaranga na make, ushobora kuba umunyamahirwe utsindira ibyo bihembo by’ukwezi bisigaye, ugasoza umwaka uryoherwa n’ibyiza bya Ecobank. Ibi bihembo byiyongera ku byo wakwegukana buri wa Gatanu kugeza iyi poromosiyo isojwe, aho abamenyereye kubihabwa bashimishwa n’uburyo bahabwa impano ziruta ibyo bahashye bakoresheje EcobankPay. Hakizimana Jackson wo mu Karere ka Kicukiro uheruka guhabwa impano yahahiye muri Sharma Super Market, yagize ati “Nashimira Ecobank kuko kugura ibintu barangiza bakaguha impano irenze ibyo wahashye nta handi wabisanga uretse muri Ecobank.” Munyentwari Sebagabo Emma wahawe impano nyuma yo kwishyura ibicuruzwa yari aguze muri Ndoli Super Market akoresheje EcobankPay, we yabwiye IGIHE ko yatunguwe kuko yagiye guhaha atiteguye ko ashobora kubihemberwa. Ati “Sinari mbyiteguye nyine nishyuye nkoresheje EcobankPay ngura ibintu bitandukanye bifite agaciro ka 2200Frw, bahita bampa ibihembo bishimishije harimo umupira n’ibindi banguriye muri iri guriro ndibuze kureba.” Uko wakoresha Ecobank Pay Ubuyobozi bwa Ecobank Rwanda Plc buvuga ko kwishyura ibicuruzwa na serivisi ukoresheje EcobankPay, usabwa kumanura application isanzwe ifasha abakiliya bayo kubona serivisi z’imari ya ‘Ecobank Mobile App’ kuri Play Store, ijya muri telefone zigezweho. Nyuma yo kuzuza ibisabwa birimo umwirondoro w’umukiliya muri iyo application na nimero ya konti, ahitamo ahanditse ‘Pay Marchants’ cyangwa se kwishyura ibicuruzwa, agahita abona aho ashyira kode iranga umucuruzi wiyandikishije mu kwishyurwa hakoreshejewe ubu buryo. Uretse kuba yakoresha iyo kode kandi hari n’uburyo yahitamo gutunga telefoni ku kimenyetso cy’ikoranabuhanga (QR Code) kikayisoma [Scan] maze agakurikiza amabwiriza kugeza yishyuye ibicuruzwa na serivisi ashaka hatabayeho guhererekanya amafaranga mu ntoki. title: BNR yasabye abaturarwanda kwigengesera ku  mutekano w’amafaranga ahererekanywa mu ikoranabuhanga mu minsi mikuru
content: Kwishyurana no guhererekanya amafaranga hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga ni bumwe mu buryo Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ishyize imbere nk’ubuzatuma ubukungu bwiyongera byihuse. Ubu buryo bwavuye kuri kuri 0.3% by’umutungo w’igihugu mu 2011, uyu munsi bigeze kuri 34.6% by’umutungo w’igihugu.Intego  ni uko mu 2024 byaba bigeze  kuri 80%. Icyakora, mu gihe cy’iminsi mikuru, ba rusahuriramunduru baba barekereje, bene ngago bakorakora hirya no hino, abatekamutwe barushaho kuyishyushya ngo bayitekere abataramenya amayeri y’ubwirinzi. Banki Nkuru y’Igihugu (BNR) yongeye kuburira abantu gukaza ubwirinzi bw’amafaranga yabo abitse, ahererekanywa cyangwa yishyurwa mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga hatabayeho kuyahererekanya mu ntoki (kashilesi). Mu gihe nk’iki cy’iminsi mikuru nibwo abatekamutwe batangira guhamagara abantu bababeshya ko batsindiye amafaranga runaka, bagasaba imibare y’ibanga ukoresha cyangwa kuboherereza amafaranga ngo babone kuguha igihembo watsindiye, BNR iraburira abaturage kudaha agaciro abantu nk’abo.  BNR ivuga ko buri muntu akwiriye kurinda umubare w’ibanga akoresha mu kwishyurana, yirinda kuwerekana cyangwa kuwubika muri telefone; n’ahandi abandi bantu bashobora kuwubona. Ni ngombwa kandi kwirinda  gukoresha itariki y’amavuko nk’umubare w’ibanga cyangwa undi mubare woroshye gutahura. Urugero ni nk’imibare ikurikirana (1234,…). Si byiza kandi gukoresha umubare w’ibanga umwe usa ahantu hose ukenewe (ngo usange umubare w’ibanga  ukoresha kuri telefone ni nawo ukoresha  ku ikarita ya banki). Uko ikoranabuhanga rirushaho gukwira kandi, ni nako abatekamutwe barushaho kumenya amayeri mashya, bakaba bakoherereza ubutumwa bugufi cyangwa bakaguhamagara n’akarimi karoshye bagusaba uwo mubare, BNR itanga inama zo kudahishurira umuntu n’umwe umubare w’ibanga. Mu kurinda umutekano w’ikarita ikoreshwa mu kwishyurana ( Mastercard, Visa Card, Smartcash card, n’ayandi), si byiza kuyibitsa undi muntu cyangwa ngo hagire undi umenya umubare wayo w’ibanga. BNR ivuga ko  umukiliya akwiriye kureba neza niba amafaranga agomba kwishyura ahuye neza n’ari ku nyemezabwishyu yahawe. Mu gihe habayeho kubura  ikarita yawe ya Banki ihutire kubimenyesha Banki mukorana. Uko ikoranabuhanga rirushaho gutera imbere kandi ni nako kwishyura ibicuruzwa bikakugeraho utavuye aho uri, ukoresheje murandasi (internet) byoroshye. Ni ibintu byiza kuko byagabanyije umwanya abantu bamaraga bajya ku masoko n’ahandi ariko naho bisaba kwitonda kuko abatekamutwe batahasize. BNR ivuga ko mu gihe wishyura ukoresheje murandasi ukwiriye kureba neza niba urubuga wishyuriraho ari rwo kandi rutekanye rufite ikirango cyizewe ‘’https’’. Si byiza kubika  ijambo ry’ibanga ukoresha winjira ku rubuga (website) muri telefone, si na byiza gusubiza ubutumwa bugusaba gutanga iryo jambo ry’ibanga.

title: RwandAir yinjiye mu bufatanye buzatuma abayikoresha bazigamira ingendo bakora
content:
Ubu bufatanye buzatuma abakiriya bashobora kwizigamira biciye mu itike y’urugendo baguze. Ubu buryo bushya buzafasha abakiriya kugira amahirwe yo kugura itike ya RwandAir mbere ku giciro cyiza kandi bakaba bahitamo igihe bifuza kuba bagenderaho. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa RwandAir, Yvonne Manzi Makolo, yagize ati “Ubu bufatanye na Optiontown, buzatanga ukwizigamira ku bakiriya bacu, nyuma yo gushyiraho uburyo bwo kwishyura mbere ingendo za RwandAir. Abakiriya bacu bazaba bashobora kwishimira ingendo bakora ku isi baguze itike ihendutse, turashimira iki gikorwa twakoze ku bufatanye na Optiontown.” Abakiriya baguze itike y’urugendo rwa RwandAir, bashobora guhitamo hagati y’ingendo enye na 500 zitandukanye, uru rugendo rukaba rwamara imyaka ibiri guhera uwo munsi, uko umukiriya aguze ingendo nyinshi ni nako aba arushaho kwizigamira. Kuri abo baguze urugendo rwa RwandAir, bashobora kandi guhitamo igihe itike igomba kumara guhera ku minsi 180 kugeza ku masaha ane mbere yo guhaguruka.
Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Optiontown, yagize ati “Optiontown yishimiye gufatanya na RwandAir mu  gutangiza ubu bufatanye bw’ingendo, bizafasha abagenzi kuzigama ku mafaranga y’urugendo no gutuma biteganyiriza, gufata urugendo ku buryo bworoshye kandi bwiza, dufite icyizere ko gutangiza iyi gahunda bizongerera icyizere abakiriya ba RwandAir ndetse byongere uburyo bwo gufata umwanya mwiza mu kigo cya mbere mu gutwara abantu mu kirere muri Afurika.” Abagenzi bahitamo gukoresha RwandAir bashobora kwishimira umuziki ubarizwamo, ibinyobwa bigezweho n’ibiribwa, interinet ya Wi-Fi n’imyanya myiza y’icyubahiro. Abagenzi kandi kugira amahirwe yo gutwara imizigo igera ku biro 23 ku gikapu mu myanya ihendutse ahazwi nko muri ’Economy Class’, ndetse n’ibikapu bibiri buri kimwe gifite ibiro 32 mu myanya ya Premium Economy Class, n’ibikapu bitatu buri kimwe gifite ibiro 23 mu myanya y’icyubahiro ’Business Class’.

title: 2020 iratangizwamo ibikorwa bya KFC mu Rwanda
content: KFC igiye gutangira ibikorwa byayo mu Rwanda, nyuma yo gusinyana amasezerano n’imikoranire n’ikigo gicuruza ibikomoka kuri peteroli, Vivo Energy. Aya masezerano agena ko buri ruhande ruzaba rufite 50% mu bikorwa bya restaurant za KFC, aho zizaba zikora mu izina rya Kuku Foods, isanzwe ari ishami rya KFC muri Afurika y’Uburasirazuba. Nyuma y’igihe gito hasinywe aya masezerano, KFC mu butumwa yashyize hanze ibinyujije ku rubuga rwa Instagram, yatangaje ko mu minsi ya vuba igiye gutangira ibikorwa byayo mu Rwanda. Ati “Birashoboka ko waba utarabaye umwaka w’agahebuzo ariko ntugire ikibazo, aha hari ikintu ugomba kwishimira mu 2020, KFC Rwanda igiye gufungura vuba”. N’ubwo hataratangazwa neza italiki iyi restaurant izatangira gukora, amafoto yacicikanye ku mbuga nkoranyambaga yerekana ko imirimo yo kubaka imwe mu nzu izakorerwamo n’iyi iri ku musozo. Amafoto akomeje gucicikana ku mbuga nkoranyambaga yerekana ko icyicaro cy’iyi sosiyete kizaba giherereye i Remera gisa n’icyuzuye. Iki cyicaro kizaba giherereye kuri sitasiyo ya Essence ya SP ku muhanda uva Remera ujya Kicukiro ahazwi nko kuri Prince House. Urubuga rwa KFC rwerekana ko ifite restaurant 17 000 muri Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’ahandi ku Isi. Nibura abarenga miliyoni 185 babona ibicuruzwa bya KFC mu cyumweru, bakaba barenga kimwe cya kabiri cy’abaturage ba Amerika. KFC ifite abakiliya basaga miliyoni 12 baturuka mu bihugu 115 ikoreramo ku Isi yose birimo 22 byo ku mugabane wa Afurika nka Kenya, Uganda na Tanzania. title: Bruxelles: Ibigo byo mu Rwanda n’iby’i Burayi bizahurizwa mu cyumweru cy’imurikagurisha n’ishoramari
content: Rwanda-Europe Business Week 2020 izabera mu Mujyi wa Bruxelles kuva ku wa 20-22 Gashyantare 2020. Ni igikorwa cy’amateka kuko u Rwanda ruzaba rubaye igihugu cya mbere mu bibarizwa muri Afurika gihurije hamwe abashoramari n’ibigo by’i Burayi. Cyateguwe na BEREXINVEST, Ikigo gifasha muri serivisi z’Ishoramari n’Ubucuruzi bwo hanze mu bihugu byo muri Afrika n’i Burayi gikorera mu Bubiligi, cyashinzwe n’Umunyarwanda Ntasinzira Dieudonné. Icyo gikorwa cyahurijweho amaboko na Minisiteri y’Ubucuruzi n’Inganda; Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB); Urugaga rw’Abikorera (PSF); Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe kohereza mu mahanga ibikomoka ku Buhinzi n’Ubworozi mu Rwanda (NAEB) na Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga. Rwanda-Europe Business Week 2020 izahuza abashoramari bo mu Rwanda n’abagize ibihugu bibarizwa mu Muryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi (EU) aho bazasangira ubunararibonye n’amakuru ashobora kubyara amahirwe y’ishoramari. Inzego zizahabwa intebe mu zizibandwaho zirimo ingufu, ikoranabuhanga, ishoramari, ubukerarugendo, ubwubatsi, ubuhinzi n’ubworozi n’ibindi. Biteganyijwe ko ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda buzerekanwa, amahirwe aburimo ndetse n’umuco w’igihugu ugaragazwe i mahanga. Umuyobozi wa BEREXINVEST, Ntasinzira Dieudonné, yabwiye IGIHE ko ambasade umunani z’u Rwanda zatangiye kurambagiza ibigo bizitabira iki gikorwa. Ati “Harimo ibigo bya ba mukerarugendo, abashoramari, Abanyarwanda baba mu Burayi n’abafata ibyemezo mu nzego za leta bafasha mu kunoza imikoranire hagati y’u Rwanda n’u Burayi.’’ Yavuze ko iki gikorwa cyitezwemo inyungu nyinshi zirimo no gukomeza guteza imbere Made in Rwanda no kuyimenyakanisha ku Mugabane w’i Burayi. Ati “Rwanda – Europe Business Week 2020 ni ubwa mbere iteguwe mu buryo buzahuza ibigo by’igenga n’ibya leta bifite uruhare mu bukungu bw’u Rwanda ngo tubihuze n’iby’i Burayi. Icya mbere bizatanga ubufatanye mu kuzamura ubucuruzi hagati y’impande zombi. “Ikindi ni ukugira ngo ibikorerwa mu Rwanda birusheho kumenyekana i Burayi no gukurura abasura igihugu binyuze muri gahunda ya Visit Rwanda. Icya gatatu ni ukwegereza Abanyarwanda b’i mahanga serivisi bakenera ntibazibone kuko si ko bose bagira amahirwe yo kuza mu Rwanda buri kwezi. Urugero nka serivisi za Banki, ubwishingizi, iz’ubutaka, iz’imisoro n’amahôro (RRA) n’izindi.’’ Muri iri murikagurisha ry’iminsi itatu, abazaryitabira bazasobanurirwa ibyiza biri mu gushora imari mu Rwanda. Raporo ya Banki y’Isi ku buryo ibihugu byorohereza ishoramari ya 2020, yashyize u Rwanda ku mwanya wa kabiri muri Afurika nk’ahantu byoroshye gukorera ubucuruzi n’urwa 38 ku Isi. Ibigo byo mu Rwanda kandi bizahuzwa n’ibyo hanze harebwa aho bishobora gukorana ndetse binasinye amasezerano. Ibi bizafungura amarembo y’isoko ku b’i Burayi no gutinyura abacuruzi kuriganaho kuko bafite ibicuruzwa rikeneye. Ntazinzira yavuze ko kuba RwandAir igerayo bizihutisha ubucuruzi hagati y’u Rwanda n’ibihugu by’i Burayi. Ati “Turacyashaka guha imbaraga ibyoherezwa hanze, uburyo duha ingufu cyane ibintu bikorerwa cyangwa bihingwa mu Rwanda nk’ikawa n’icyayi, imbuto, imboga n’imiteja ibyo byagezeyo ariko turifuza ko hashyirwamo ingufu cyane kugira ngo bigende ari byinshi.’’ Muri iyi mikoranire hahanzwe amaso amaguriro akomeye mu Burayi ashobora gukoresha ibicuruzwa biva mu Rwanda ku buryo amenya ko urwa Gasabo rufite isoko rifite ibicuruzwa byujuje ubuziranenge. Ibigo byo mu Rwanda bizitabira iri murikagurisha usibye amahirwe y’imikoranire, bizanahaha ubumenyi bwisumbuyeho bwabifasha mu mikorere ya buri munsi. Muri iri murikagurisha kandi hateganyijwe ubucuruzi, ihuriro rya ba rwiyemezamirimo, gusura inganda, ingendoshuri n’umugoroba wo gutarama. Kuri ubu Abanyarwanda baba i Burayi basaga 52 200, muri bo 35 000 baba mu Bubiligi. Ikigo gishaka kwiyandikisha mu bizitabira Rwanda - Europe Business Week 2020 cyegera BEREXINVEST muri Minisiteri y’Ubucuruzi n’Inganda.

title: Telefoni za Mara Phone zikorerwa mu Rwanda zagejejwe ku isoko ryo muri Ethiopia
content: Uruganda rwa Mara Phone rufite icyicaro mu cyanya cy’inganda cya Kigali mu Karere ka Gasabo, rwafunguwe na Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame ku wa 7 Ukwakira 2019. Rukora ubwoko bubiri bwa Mara Phone aribwo Mara Z na Mara X, zombi zijyamo SIM Card ebyiri. Mara Z igura 175 750 Frw naho Mara X ni 120 250 Frw. Ni uruganda rumaze kwamamara kuri telefoni rukorera mu Rwanda aho zimaze kugezwa mu bihugu birenga 41 kandi bikomeje kwiyongera. Umunya-Ethiopia, Eng. Mengistu Berhanu, uyobora Monaco Automotive Engineering abinyujije kuri Twitter yatangaje ko izo telefoni zanagejejwe no ku isoko ryo muri Ethiopia. Yagize ati “Telefoni ya Mara Phone ikorerwa mu Rwanda ubu wayibona muri Ethiopia. Irahendutse, ikorwa n’Abanyafurika, igakorerwa muri Afurika, iraboneka. Iyo uguze telefoni ya Mara Phone uba wubatse Afurika.” Ubu butumwa yabuhererekesheje amashusho agira ati “Yakozwe n’abenjeniyeri b’Abanyafurika, ikorewe Abanyafurika. Mara Phone iraboneka ku Banya-Ethiopia muri Ethiopia.” Abari muri Ethiopia bashyiriweho uburyo bwo gutumiza telefoni kuri internet banyuze  kuri http://maraphone.com cyangwa bagahamagara 0911932709. Iyaguka rya Mara Phone kugera ku isoko rya bimwe mu bihugu bya Afurika ryishimiwe n’abakoresha urubuga nkoranyambaga rwa Twitter, bagaragaje ko ari iby’agaciro gukoresha telefoni zakorewe muri Afurika n’Abanyafurika. Ni umwe mu mishinga itangiye kubyara inyungu binyuze mu masezerano ashyiraho Isoko rusange rya Afurika rizahuriza hamwe abaturage bagera kuri miliyari 1.2 batuye Afurika n’ibihugu 55 bifite umusaruro mbumbe tiliyari 2.5 z’amadolari ya Amerika. Aya masezerano yasinyiwe i Kigali muri Werurwe 2018, azazamura ubucuruzi bukorwa hagati y’ibihugu bya Afurika busanzwe kuri 16%, igipimo kiri hasi cyane ugereranyije na 60% ibyo bihugu bikorana n’u Burayi na 50% bikorana Aziya. Seth Bisimwa yagize ati “Iyi ni yo Afurika dukeneye, abantu bafashanya, mureke dukoreshe Mara phone.’’ Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Uruganda rwa Mara Phone mu Rwanda, Eddy Sebera, yunzemo ati ‘‘Murakoze ku bufasha bwanyu. Iyi ni yo Afurika twifuza.’’ Telefoni za mbere za Mara Phone zakorewe mu Rwanda zamuritswe bwa mbere muri Kamena 2019. Mara Phone nirwo ruganda rwa mbere muri Afurika rukora telefoni zigezweho za smartphones, rwitezweho kujya rukora nibura smartphones 1,200 ku munsi zo kugurisha mu Rwanda no hanze. Mara Phone ifite ubushobozi bwo gukora telefoni 1000 ku munsi. Yatangiranye  amaduka atatu acururizwamo telefoni zayo, KBC, KIC (ahitwaga UTC) n’iririmo gufungurwa mu isoko rya Nyarugenge. Biteganywa ko mu mezi abiri ari imbere amaduka azaba amaze kuba umunani, ari naho hashobora gukorerwa telefoni zagize ikibazo. Rawandian made Mara phone is now in Ethiopia. Affordable, African designed, manufactured and distributed. Let the African free Trade agreements kick in ASAP.
