title: Uko ubukungu bw’u Rwanda buzaba buhagaze mu 2050
content: Yabigarutseho ku wa Kane ubwo yatangaga ikiganiro cyagarutse ku kwihutisha iterambere ry’ubukungu, cyatangiwe mu Nama y’Igihugu y’Umushyikirano 2019 yahurije hamwe abasaga 2,000 muri Kigali Convention Centre. Ni inama yasojwe tariki 20 Ukuboza uyu mwaka. Dr Ndagijimana yavuze ko intego igihugu cyihaye ni uko  mu myaka 15 u Rwanda rwaba rugeze ku bukungu buri hagati y’ibihugu bigeze ku rwego ruciriritse, ndetse ruri mu nzira zo kugera mu nzira y’ibihugu bikungahaye ku isi. Yagize ati “Mu 2035 tuzaba dufite nibura umusaruro mbumbe ubariye ku muturage usaga gato ibihumbi bine by’amadorali ni ukuvuga miliyoni enye z’amanyarwanda, mu 2050 ho tukaba tugeze ku rwego rw’ibihugu byateye imbere nk’uko tubizi uyu munsi,  nibura ibihumbi 12 by’amadorali ku muturage.” Dr Ndagijimana avuga ko kugira ngo ibi bigerweho bisaba byinshi. Ati “Ni ukubakira ku bushobozi tumaze kubaka, ni urugendo turi hafi gusoza ariko  birasaba ko tugira umuvuduko w’iterambere urenze 10% buri mwaka  kandi bigaragara ko bishoboka, 12% mu myaka ishize   twagezeho bigaragaza  ko twakora n’ibirenze.” Yavuze ko “Kugira ngo dukomeze uwo muvuduko hari byinshi bidusaba, nubwo uyu muvuduko uri hejuru birasaba ko twongera ubwinshi by’ibyo dukora uyu munsi byaba mu nganda mu buhinzi, muri za serivisi n’ahandi ariko tugahanga n’ibicuruzwa bishya, serivisi zikaguka kugira ngo ubukungu bwacu bube bushingiye ku bicuruzwa bitandukanye,  bityo haramutse havutse ikibazo ku gicuruzwa runaka bireke guhungabanya ubukungu muri rusange.” Yavuze ko ikindi abona bazibandaho ni ukongera imbaraga mu bushobozi bwo gupiganwa ku masoko haba mu karere no ku isi, ibi bikaba bisaba gukomeza kuvugurura ubuhinzi n’umusaruro kuko umusaruro ukiri muke.  Yavuze ko nubwo inganda zivuka cyane  muri gahunda ya Made in Rwanda,  bisaba ko zikora byinshi kuko iyo zibikoze nibwo igiciro kigabanuka zikaba zahangana n’amasoko yo mu karere,  muri Afurika no ku Isi. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo cy’Ibarurishamibare mu Rwanda, NISR, Yusuf Murangwa, we avuga ko  mu myaka 18 ishize ubukungu bw’u Rwanda  bwazamutse  ku kigero cya 8% buri mwaka, avuga ko ari byiza kuko u Rwanda ruri ku mwanya wa kabiri muri Afurika inyuma ya Ethiopia. Ati “Dukurikije uko ibintu bihagaze uyu munsi, turumva uyu mwaka u Rwanda ruzaba ari urwa mbere muri Afurika.” Agaragaza ko iyo ubukungu buzamutse haboneka uburyo bityo bigakemura ibibazo mu buhinzi n’ahandi. Yagize ati “Iyo turebye mu buhinzi umusaruro wariyongereye cyane, wareba mu nganda turazizi mu myaka 10, hari nyinshi tutari dufite ubu zihari, serivisi z’amahoteli turazibona, ubuvuzi, amashuri, ibigo by’imari byariyongere ku buryo n’utazi kubara iyo mibare arabibona.” Murangwa yavuze ko iyo ubukungu buzamutse buri mwaka haboneka imirimo ibihumbi 160 idashingiye ku buhinzi gusa agaragaza ko hakiri icyuho. Yagize ati “Buri mwaka hari urubyiruko rugera ku bihumbi 200 bageza imyaka yo gukora bakajya ku isoko, iyo habonetse akazi ibihumbi 160 gusa ni ukuvuga ko ibihumbi 40 nta kazi babona, ni ukuvuga ko igipimo turiho kidahagije, ibi ni nako bimeze mu bindi byose aho dufite ibibazo.” Ati “Birasaba ko ubukungu buzamuka hejuru 10% kugira ngo ibibazo bikemuke tugere kuri gahunda twifuza mu 2050, turasabwa ko mu buhinzi buzamuka hejuru 8%, mu nganda 15% kuko  hari inganda zinshi zigomba gushyirwaho zigafasha  mu buhinzi n’ibijya hanze, muri serivizi turifuza 12%.” Kugeza ubu u Rwanda ni igihugu kiri guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga aho ubu kwandikisha ubucuruzi bitwara amasaha atandatu, naho kwandikisha ubutaka u Rwanda ruri ku mwanya wa gatatu ku Isi mu buryo rwashyizeho bwo kwandikisha no guhindura ibyo byemezo.

title: Abatunganya ibikomoka ku bigori bahangayikishijwe n’umusaruro muke n’ibiciro bikomeje kwiyongera
content: Izi nganda zivuga ko zigiye kugana amasoko yagutse nko muri Brésil na Ukraine kuko ho hakiri umusaruro uhagije kandi ku giciro gito. Aba batunganya ibikomoka ku bigori bo mu Rwanda bavuga ko Tanzania ariyo yari isigaye itanga umusaruro mwinshi muri aka karere u Rwanda ruherereyemo, ariko naho ibiciro byaho biri kuzamuka umunsi ku wundi. Moses Ndayisenga ukora mu ruganda Minimex aganira na Rwanda Today yagize  ati “Muri Tanzania naho ibigori byaragabanutse ndetse birushaho guhenda; nubwo kujya kubivana hakurya y’inyanja tutari twabitangira, hari gahunda kuri benshi ko twajya kubikura mu bihugu nka Ukraine, Argentine, Méxique na Brésil.” Magingo aya toni imwe muri Tanzania iri kugurwa hafi 280 000 by’amafaranga y’u Rwanda, bikagera ku isoko ryo mu Rwanda bigura 400 000 by’amafaranga y’u Rwanda, ubariyemo n’imisoro no kubitwara; mu gihe ibyaturutse imbere mu gihugu biri kugurishwa 500 000 by’amafaranga y’u Rwanda kuri toni imwe. Mu gihe umusaruro w’ibigori ku isoko ry’imbere mu gihugu ugeze kuri toni 424 204, ibigera ku isoko ngo byongererwe agaciro birangana na toni 290 000 kuko 30% y’umusaruro wose uba wasigaye mu baturage. Usibye igiciro cyiyongereye ku isoko ryo mu karere, igihe cyo gukura ibigori mu bice bya kure muri Tanzania nacyo cyariyongereye kiva ku minsi itanu, kigera ku byumweru bibiri, ibituma igiciro nacyo kiyongera muri rusange. Abatunganya ibigori  mu Rwanda bavuga ko kubikura hakurya y’inyanja bishobora kugabanya ikiguzi kandi bikaziba icyuho cy’umusaruro ukiri muke. Ndayisenga ati “Ntidufite kompanyi  ifite ubushobozi bwo gutumiza byibura toni 10 000 icyarimwe nkuko byifujwe n’abo muri Ukraine n’ahandi. Ubushobozi bwacu buke ntibutwemerera kugura ibiro 3 000 000 icyarimwe. Gusa nk’abikorera turacyari kureba uburyo twakwihuza tukaba nk’ikigo kimwe.” Nkuko byemezwa n’ikigo gihuriza hamwe amakuru arebana n’ubucuruzi bw’ibihingwa mu karere [Regional Agricultural Trade Information Network-RATIN], ari nacyo kigenzura ubucuruzi bw’ibigori mu karere; kivuga ko kutabona umusaruro uhagije byatewe n’ubuhinzi butagenze neza mu karere ka Afurika y’Iburasirazuba muri rusange, ibyashyize igitutu ku hari hakiri ubuhunikiro bwabyo nko muri Tanzania na Uganda. Iki kigo gikomeza kivuga ko igiciro cy’ibigori kizazamuka muri Kenya, u Rwanda, na Sudan y’Epfo byari bisanzwe bitumiza ibigori mu bihugu byo mu karere. Imibare y’iki kigo igaragaza ko ingano y’ibigori u Rwanda rutumiza muri Tanzania yazamutse ku rugero rwa 279 ku ijana, hagati ya Nyakanga na Nzeri uyu mwaka. Ku rundi ruhande, abongerera agaciro ibigori baravuga ko mu gihe igiciro gikomeje kuzamuka, kandi nta n’ahandi ho kubikura hafatika hahari, ubucuruzi bwabo buri kuhazaharira. Diane Ndagijimana, umuyobozi mukuru w’uruganda SOSOMA , yagize ati “Ubusanzwe  twaguraga ibigori bizamara amezi atandatu, ariko ubwo ububiko bwacu bwagabanukaga mu kwezi gushize k’Ukwakira, twasanze ibiciro byarazamutse cyane, bituma tugura bike muri Tanzania.” Ubu ku isoko ryo mu Rwanda, igiciro cy’umufuka w’ibiro 25 by’akawunga ka Minimex cyazamutse ku rugero rwa 52%, kiva ku 12 500 by’amafaranga y’u Rwanda, kigera ku 19 000 by’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Ku rundi ruhande, Minimex iha ibigori uruganda rwa Bralirwa rukora ibinyobwa bitandukanye, igaragaza ko kuva ibigori byagabanuka ku isoko, ibyo bahaga Bralirwa babigabanyije inshuro ebyiri. Mu gihe Bralirwa yakeneraga impeke z’ibigori hafi toni 400, Minimex igaragaza ko ubu iri gutanga munsi ya toni 200.

title: Icyerekezo 2050 mu ishusho y’ihangwa ry’imirimo izagira abanyarwanda abamiliyoneri
content: Clare Akamanzi yabigarutseho kuri uyu wa Kane, ubwo yatangaga ikiganiro cyagarutse ku kwihutisha iterambere ry’ubukungu, cyatangiwe mu Nama y’Igihugu y’Umushyikirano 2019 yahurije hamwe abasaga 2,000 muri Kigali Convention Centre. Yavuze ko kugeza ubu hari abihangira imirimo ibinjiriza miliyari imwe y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ariko ko mu 2050 hakenewe abahanga imishinga yinjiza nibura miliyari imwe y’amadorari bagatanga akazi ku bihumbi 50. Ni icyerekezo yagaragaje yifashishije urugero ry’umwana w’umukobwa wavukiye mu ibitaro bya Kaminuza bya Kigali (CHUK) uyu munsi, uzakurira mu gihugu cy’u Rwanda gifite ubukungu bushingiye ku bumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga. Ati “Buri kwezi mu bitaro bya CHUK [ibitaro bya Kaminuza bya Kigali] nibura buri munsi havuka abana 10. Uyu munsi wa mbere w’umushyikirano haravuka byibura abana 10 muri abo bana hashobora kuvuka umwana witwa Keza Nyiramajyambere, uyu mwana w’umukobwa azaba afiye imyaka 30 mu 2050”. Yavuzeko uwo mwana uzaba yarakuriye mu gihugu cyihuta mu iterambere, azaba akora ndetse aba mu gihugu n’ubukungu bushingiye ku bumenyi. Clare Akamanzi yavuze ko hari icyizere ko imirimo bazajya bahanga izabagira abamiliyoneri kandi batange akazi ku bantu benshi hagendewe ku ntego zijyanye n’icyerekezo cy’icyo gihe. Ati “Ariko aba bana bazavuka mu gihugu gifite ubukungu bushingiye ku bumenyi. Bazaba afite ibyifuzo bijyanye n’icyo gihe. Umwana w’umukobwa Keza Nyiramajyambere, ashobora guhitamo gutangira ubucuruzi bushingiye ku ikoranabuhanga nkuko icyo gihe bizaba bimeze azaba afite sosiyete byibura yinjiza miliyari imwe y’amadorari. Yavuze ko ubu miliyari imwe y’amadorari hari abayinjiza. Ati “Ubu ngubu hari abo tubona binjiza miliyari imwe y’amanyarwanda, ariko icyo gihe tuzaba dukeneye kandi dufite sosiyete za ba Keza n’abandi bazana byibura miliyari imwe y’amadorari kuko nta gihugu gikize kidafite ba miliyoneri.” Imirimo izahangwa nayo ngo izaba ari myinshi kuburyo izaba yunganira cyane izajya ihangwa n’inganda n’izindi nzego. Ati “Uyu mwana azabikora kuko azaba afite sosiyete ifite aya mafaranga kandi itanga akazi ku  bana b’abanyarwanda bagera ku 50,000.” Kubera ikoranabuhanga imishinga y’icyo gihe izajya imenyakana cyane kandi igire abakiliya mu mpande zose z’Isi, ibyo yagereranyije n’urubuga nkoranyambaga rwa Facebook rushobora kugera ku muntu aho ari hose. Ati “Iyo sosiyete izamera nka Facebook, izagira abakiliya bagera kuri miliyoni 50 byibura bivuze ko hazabamo abakiliya b’abanyarwanda b’abanyafurika ndetse no ku isi hose nkuko facebook imeze.” Byitezwe ko akazi kazatanga kazajya kinjiriza abagahawe nibura ibihumbi $ 10 ku kwezi. Kugira ngo izo nzozi zishoboke, Akamanzi yavuze ko hari ibyamaze gukorwa mu rwego rwo kubiharurira amayira. Ati “Hari ibintu bitatu tumaze gushyiraho, byerekana ko ibi bishoboka. Birimo  korohereza ibikorwa by’ishoramari n’ubucuruzi, kwagura amasoko y’u Rwanda, kubaka ubushobozi bushingiye ku bumenyi.” U Rwanda rufite ubukungu buzamuka ku gipimo cy’umunani ku ijana kuva mu myaka 18 ishize. Igihe u Rwanda ruzaba rufite ba rwiyemezamirimo bari ku rwego Akamanzi yavuze, ngo bishobora kuzazamura igipimo ubukungu bw’u Rwanda. Minisitiri w’imari n’igenamigambi, Dr Uzziel Ndagijimana yavuze ko izamuka ry’ubukungu ryubakiye ku nkingi zitandukanye zirimo uruhare rw’abikorera, ubushobozi n’ubumenyi bw’abanyarwanda. Ati “Intambwe twagezeho irava ku gukomatanya Politiki zitandukanye, […] hakabamo uruhare rw’abikorera ndetse n’abanyarwanda muri rusange kuko bafite uruhare mu bukungu bw’igihugu bugera kuri 85%. Habaye na none kubaka inzego zaba iza leta zaba iz’abikorera, ndetse n’ubushobozi n’ubumenyi muri rusange by’abanyarwanda.” Umuyobozi w’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’Ibarurishamibare, Yusuf Murangwa yavuze ko aho ubukungu bugeze, butuma haboneka imirimo ibihumbi 160 itari iy’ubuhinzi. Icyakora yavuze ko iyo mirimo  idahagije ku rubyiruko rungana n’ibihumbi 200 rujya ku isoko ry’umurimo buri mwaka. Yusuf Murangwa yavuze ko  bisaba ko nibura ubukungu bwazamuka ku kigero cy’icumi ku ijana kugira ngo bose bayibone. Igihe wa Rwiyemezamirimo (Keza Nyiramajyambere) yazahanga umurimo winjiza miliyari imwe y’amadorari ku mwaka akanatanga akazi ku bihumbi 50,  byitezweho kuzaba musanzu kuri icyo kibazo. Guverinoma ifite gahunda yo guhanga imirimo miliyoni 1.5 idashingiye ku buhinzi mu gihe cy’imyaka irindwi uhereye mu 2017.

title: Gaella, izina ry’umukobwa ukunda ubugeni no kumva umuziki
content: Nubwo ritamamaye cyane, riri mu mazina 1000 agezweho mu 2019 ku buryo usanga n’abana benshi bavuka muri iki gihe b’abakobwa barihabwa.  	Ibiranga ba Gaella Ba Gaella bakunda ibyiza nyaburanga no kuryoherwa n’ubuzima. Ibitekerezo byabo byiza bakunda kubigaragaza babinyujije mu mivugo, ibirimo inyandiko n’ibindi bintu bifite aho bihuriye n’ubugeni. Ni abantu bakunda kumva imiziki, bakanga ingeso zigaragaza umuntu nk’umunyamusozi cyangwa utagira ikinyabupfura. Ba Gaella kandi bakunda gutinda ku tuntu duto duto badutekerezaho, dore ko baba batekereza niba koko bari kuzuza inshingano baba bafite. Ntibyoroshye kumenya neza uburyo ba Gaella bateye kuko bakunda guhisha amarangamutima yabo, ariko usanga byoroshye kubabara kuko bagira umutima woroshye cyane. Ba Gaella bakunze kuvuga ko biyemera bakaba na ba nyamwigendaho bitewe nuko badakunda ko umuntu apfa kubamenya wese, ibi bikanajyanirana nuko rimwe na rimwe usanga ngo nta cyizere bigirira iyo bari kuganira n’abandi batinya ko bajora ibitekerezo byabo. Ba Gaella bicisha bugufi kandi bakitonda, gusa bakunda kuba bari bonyine kabone n’iyo baba bari mu bantu benshi. Ibi bituma akenshi bagaragara nka ba nyamwigendaho bigatuma bahugira mu gusoma inyandiko cyane dore ko ari n’ibintu bakunda.

title: Amategeko avuga iki ku musore wakwizeza umukobwa urukundo agamije kumusambanya
content: Hari isezerano rikunze kuba hagati y’umuhungu n’umukobwa, akenshi umuhungu akamubwira amagambo asize umunyu n’isukari, amusezeranya urukundo cyangwa kuzamugira umugore, bagacudika  hari izindi nyungu amutezeho nta rukundo na mba amufitiye. Nubwo abo byabayeho badakunda kubyatura, hari abasore bavugwaho kuba baba bashaka kurya imitungo y’abakobwa cyangwa kugira ngo baryamane [basambane], bamara kubigeraho, ya magambo aryohereye nk’isukari agahinduka asharira kurusha igikakarubamba. Abakurikirama umuziki nyarwanda muribuka indirimbo ya Soso Mado yaririmbyemo akaga kabaye ku nkumi yo kwa mwene Rubaduka, wanze kumva impanuro za nyina, umusore w’i Kigali akamuriraho utwe amusezeranya kuzamurongora ntabikore. Uwo mukobwa wa Rubaduka yaje kujya mu mahanga ariko asezeranyijwe n’uwo musore kuzabana akaramata, ndetse udufaranga akoreye akatumwoherereza ngo aguremo imitungo yunguke, izafashe urugo rwabo gutera imbere ariko bikarangira umusore abiriye byose ntamurongore. Gasore [izina ryahinduwe] atuye mu Mujyi wa Kigali, yabwiye IGIHE ati “benshi turababeshya ko tubakunda kubera ko twishakira gushimisha imibiri gusa ariko tutabakunda. Wenda nkanjye ntawe ndabeshya ko namugira umugore, iryo kosa sinanarikora ariko kumubwira ko mukunda byo ndabikora twamara kuryamara bikarangira.” Gakumi, [izina twahinduye] ni inkumi yo mu Karere ka Gisagara yabwiye IGIHE ko hari umusore wamubeshye bagakundana, bagasangira akabisi n’agahiye amusezeranya kuzabana ariko birangira amwihindutse. Ati “Twari inshuti abantu benshi babizi, bamwe iyo bashakaga kumumbaza ntibatinyaga no kumbaza ngo ‘umugabo wawe ari he?’ kubera ukuntu twisanzuranagaho. Twasangiraga byose ntacyo yari kunyaka ngo nkimwime ngifite kubera ukuntu namukundaga mufata nk’umugabo wanjye w’ahazaza kuko nawe yabinsezeranyaga ariko birangira antetereje.” Uku kubeshyana uretse kuba bibiba urwango hagati y’umuhungu n’umukobwa n’imiryango yabo, hari n’igihe bibyara amakimbirane akomeye, ugasanga bivuyemo n’urupfu cyangwa izindi ngaruka bitewe n’uko umwe ashakisha uko yakwihimura kuri mugenzi we, hari n’abavuga ko babonye uko bamurogesha babikora. Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ubutabera, ushinzwe Itegeko Nshinga n’andi mategeko, Uwizeyimana Evode, yabwiye IGIHE ko kugeza uyu munsi mu mategeko y’u Rwanda ibyo bifatwa nk’ububeshyi n’ubusambabyi busanzwe ariko iyo uwabeshywe bimuteje igihombo, ashobora kubiregera agasubizwa ibyo yahombye. Ati “Kugeza ubu mu mategeko yacu, ibintu byo kuvuga ko umuntu yagusezeranyije ko azakurongora ntakurongore mu Rwanda ni ububeshyi busanzwe keretse iyo uko kugusezeranya bigaragaye ko hari ibintu watakaje mu buryo bumwe cyangwa ubundi.” Icyo gihe ngo hashobora gukurikizwa amategeko umuntu agafashwa gusubizwa ibyo yatakaje. Ariko igihe uwasezeranyijwe kurongorwa ntabikorerwe kandi jujuje imyaka y’ubukure n’uwabimusezeranyije ari mukuru hakabaho ugusambana, iyo nta gufata ku ngufu byabayeho bifatwa nk’ubusambanyi busanzwe. Ati “Ibyo ni ubusambanyi busanzwe, abo bantu bafitanye ikibazo na Bibiliya ariko ntibagifitanye n’amategeko ya Leta kuko gusambana utafashe ku ngufu, usambanye n’umuntu mukuru mwabyumvikanyeho cyangwa wamubeshye, sinakubwira ngo mu buryo bw’amategeko hari icyo twabikoraho, abakobwa nabo ntabwo ari injiji bagomba kuba maso.” Mu Buhinde, iyo umugabo cyangwa umuhungu asezeranyije umugore cyangwa umukobwa kuzamurongora agamije kumusambya ntabikore, ahanwa nk’uwamufashe ku ngufu. Muri mata uyu mwaka, Urukiko rw’Ikirenga rwo muri iki gihugu hari umugabo rwakatiye igifungo cy’imyaka 10 nyuma yo guhamywa icyaha cyo gusambanya umugore amusezeranya ko bazabana yarangiza akishakira undi. Gusa yaje kujurira, kiragabanywa akatirwa gufungwa imyaka irindwi. [email protected]

title: Ikiganiro na Amb. Igor César, umudipolomate w’u Rwanda ufite inkuru y’ubuzima itangaje (Video)
content: Twahuye ku cyumweru, nyuma y’amasaha make iki gikorwa kirangiye, twicarana mu isomero rya Motel One, hotel iri mu Mujyi rwagati i Bonn hafi gato y’ahabereye Rwanda Day. Twaganiriye birambuye kuri Rwanda Day, mubaza uko abona yagenze, ariko mu Kinyarwanda gitomoye kigenda buhoro, akitsa ku kuvuga ko we adashobora kwiha amanota. Ati “Ntabwo wakora ikintu ukirimo ngo ube n’umusifuzi, njye ndi umukinnyi ntabwo ndi umusifuzi. Ahubwo abaje muri Rwanda Day nibo bagira uruhare mu kuvuga ukuntu Rwanda Day yari imeze.” Igor wakundishijwe u Rwanda na sekuru, yavugaga ko “agashya nabonye, ni uko mu biganiro bya Rwanda Day u Rwanda rusigaye ari u Rwanda nk’uko rwakagombye kuba ruri. Wumvise izina u Rwanda, ni u Rwanda rutari ahantu hamwe gusa ahubwo rugenda rukarenga imbibi.” Mu Budage, kimwe mu bihugu areberera hari  abanyarwanda bagera ku 1295, muri bo abarenga 800 bitabiriye Rwanda Day ndetse banayigiramo uruhare rukomeye. Uyu mugabo, ni umwe mu badipolomate b’u Rwanda bibazwaho byinshi, ndetse hari n’abazi ko atazi Ikinyarwanda cyangwa se ko ari Umudage wasabye ubwenegihugu n’ibindi nk’ibi. Twaricaye, mubaza buri kimwe cyose kijyanye n’ubuzima bwe, inkomoko ye, uko yabaye umudipolomate, intumbero ye n’ibindi bitandukanye. Gusa, imitekerereze ye itandukanye n’uko abantu bamufata, ni umugabo ukunda u Rwanda bya nyabyo, ni umunyarwanda byuzuye utewe ishema n’igihugu cye kandi uvuga ashize amanga ko azagikorera mu gihe cyose akigifite. Yavutse tariki ya 13 Mutarama 1968, se ni umunyarwanda hanyuma mama we akaba Umudagekazi. Se yavuye mu Rwanda ahagana mu 1960 ajya kwiga mu Bubiligi. U Rwanda rwabonye ubwigenge ari mu mahanga, nyuma ajya gutura mu Budage aho yigaga muri Kaminuza ya the Bauhaus University Weimar. Igor César yavukiye mu Mujyi wa Weimar mu  Budage, ahamara imyaka ine y’ubwana bwe, nyuma mu 1971 azana n’ababyeyi muri Afurika aho babaye mu bihugu bitandukanye birimo mu Burundi, Ethiopia. Uko yagiye akura, niko sekuru yamukundishije u Rwanda kugeza ubwo yumvaga ari igihugu cy’agatangaza azageramo akanyagirwa n’imvura y’amata n’ubuki, gusa ibyo yabonye arugezemo, byashimangiye urukundo rwe ku gihugu cye. Ikiganiro na Amb. Igor César uhagarariye u Rwanda mu Budage IGIHE:   Abantu benshi ntibazi ko uri umunyarwanda mu maraso, wabasobanurira ute uwo uriwe? Amb. Igor: Njye ndi umunyarwanda wuzuye, ufite inzobe. Icyo nzi ni uko yaba mu mateka y’abanyarwanda n’Abadage, ubwoko bwabaga ari ubwa so. Navutse ku munyarwanda, ndi umunyarwanda, nakuze nzi ko ndi umunyarwanda, nagize n’amahirwe yo kuvuka ku Mudagekazi bimpa kuba ndi Umunyarwanda kandi nshoboye no kuba Umudage no kumenya andi mateka y’ibindi bihugu twagiye tubamo. IGIHE: Wigeze umara igihe kinini mu Rwanda? Amb. Igor: Oya! Abantu benshi iyo bumvise ikinyarwanda baba bibaza ko navukiye mu Rwanda. Navukiye mu Budage, nakuriye mu mahanga kubera amateka y’u Rwanda. Ariko ntabwo byambujije kugira amahirwe yo kubana na Sogokuru ari nawe wankundishije u Rwanda n’ikinyarwanda. Mu biganiro bye nagiye niga Ikinyarwanda, ni nayo mpamvu iki Kinyarwanda mwumva gisa n’icy’abasaza, ni uko ari umusaza wakinyigishije. IGIHE: Ufite abana bangahe? Amb. Igor: Mfite abana bane, babiri nabyaye, n’abandi babiri ndera. IGIHE:  Nabo bazi Ikinyarwanda? Amb. Igor: Barakiga, twatangiye n’amashuri y’ikinyarwanda kuri Ambasade bamaze imyaka ibiri biga Ikinyarwanda. Umwe mu bahungu banjye mwaramubonye muri Rwanda Day yari mu bantu bavuze ikivugo, aracyakarishya ururimi rwe, aracyacyubakiraho. IGIHE: Mwinjiye mute muri dipolomasi? Amb. Igor:  Njye ntabwo nigeze nkora akazi ka dipolomasi mbere yo kuba Ambasaderi. Kandi si twe dufata uwo mwanzuro ahubwo ni ababa baduhaye ayo mahirwe n’inshingano byo kuba aba ambasaderi. Ntabwo navuga inzira iganisha umuntu ku kuba ambasaderi ndebye urugendo njye nakoze, icyo nzi ni uko nize gukunda u Rwanda, natojwe kuri urwo rukundo ndubamo, nkorera u Rwanda nk’umunyarwanda, nkunda kubakira u Rwanda aho nari ndi hose, bigera ahantu ngira n’amahirwe barampamagara bansaba ko nahagararira u Rwanda mu Budage. IGIHE: Mu mashuri wize ibijyanye n’iki? Amb. Igor:  Nize mu bihugu bitandukanye. Nize i Burundi, niga Kaminuza muri Canada ibijyanye na politiki, niga gato no mu Budage. Nakoreye umuryango w’abanyarwanda nkiri muto, nabaye uwubakisha inzu, nakoze mu bijyanye n’ibikorwa remezo, mu Rwanda nakoze ibikorwa bitandukanye. IGIHE: Ni iki cyatumye wiga ibijyanye na politiki? Amb. Igor:  Amateka y’u Rwanda. Njya nshishikariza urubyiruko rw’uyu munsi ngo ntibazakunde u Rwanda ari uko barubuze. Njye nakunze u Rwanda kuko ntari ndufite, gukunda u Rwanda utarufite bituma ukorana n’abanyarwanda kugira ngo urwo Rwanda urugire aho uri hose. Ubwo rero kureba uburyo twakubaka umuryango ushobora kugira n’igihugu aho witirirwa twabitangiye tukiri bato. Narangije amashuri abanza ngiye gutangira ayisumbuye ntibatwemerera gukomeza bitewe n’uko tutari abenegihugu. Icyo nicyo cyatumye ntagira ubunyarwanda bwanjye, nabumenye kubera ko ntari mfite igihugu bituma mparanira kugira igihugu, mparanira kubana n’abandi banyarwanda, kwiyubaka, kubaka umuryango w’abanyarwanda aho uri hose kugeza aho mbaye ambasaderi ntabwo nigeze ndohoka gukora kugira ngo u Rwanda n’abanyarwanda batere imbere. IGIHE: Twirengagije amateka, ni iki cyatumye ukunda u Rwanda bene aka kageni? Amb. Igor:  Nganira na sogokuru nabonaga uburyo umunyarwanda atekereza n’uburyo yibona, nsanga ari byo byatumye nshaka ko ubunyarwanda bwanjye bugira uburemere. Nakuze mbona yaba papa cyangwa sogokuru, ikintu cyose cyiza babonaga bacyitiriraga u Rwanda. Urugero iyo babonaga ikintu cyiza wumvaga uti “iki ni cyiza cyenda gusa n’u Rwanda”, “Uyu rwose afite umuco wenda gusa n’uw’u Rwanda”, ugasanga u Rwanda ni ikigereranyo cy’ibyiza. Ndibuka ubwa mbere ntaha mu Rwanda nkareba ukuntu hasa, ukuntu hameze, hari umukungugu, hari ibibazo, abantu bari barishwe, ntabwo hari hameze nk’uko hameze ubu. Hari ibintu byinshi bitajyanye n’uko umusaza, ababyeyi bagendaga bavuga u Rwanda. Ndibuka rimwe nagiye kureba papa ndamubwira nti warakoze kuba waratubeshye kuko iyo utubwira ukuri ntabwo u Rwanda nari kuruharanira. Ariko iyo ndebye u Rwanda turimo ubu, mpita mbona ibyo yashakaga kutubwira. IGIHE: Wageze mu Rwanda bwa mbere ryari? Amb. Igor:  Nageze mu Rwanda bwa mbere mu 1984. Ntabwo nabashije gutembera u Rwanda kuko ntari mbifitiye uburenganzira. Naciye mu Rwanda mva i Burundi njya i Bukavu, wagendaga ahubwo wifata utazi niba unagera aho ugana. IGIHE: Ubu wabashije gusura ibice byose by’u Rwanda? Amb. Igor: Ndibaza nta gice cy’u Rwanda ntarasura. Nageze mu Majyarugu, Amajyepfo, Uburasirazuba, Iburengerazuba n’i Kigali. Natashye mu Rwanda mfite amatsiko yo kureba ibyo bice umusaza yajyaga avuga, imihanda, imisozi, kugendera mu mazi, nasuye u Rwanda mu nzira nyinshi. IGIHE: Uyu munsi nihe wumva watura mu Rwanda? Amb. Igor: Burya u Rwanda urarukunda nk’u Rwanda ariko aho ukomoka hari akantu uhakundira kuko burya kuvuga ngo aha hantu niho imizi yanjye iva, ‘ngo ntawanga nyina ngo arwaye ibiheri.’ Iburengerazuba kubera i Kivu, kubera uburyo hameze niho nkunda mu Rwanda kandi n’abakerarugendo basa naho bahakunda. IGIHE:  Ni iki cyagushimishije mu buzima bwawe? Amb. Igor: Kuva nkiri muto twize kwakira buri kintu cyose uko kije ukacyakira cyuzuye, ntabwo wakira ikintu igice. Rero njye sinzi kurobanura ngo mvuge ngo iki ikintu nicyo cyari cyiza kuko ibintu byose nabayemo nabibayemo byuzuye. Twabaye mu buzima bwiza, twabaye mu buzima buciriritse, twabaye mu bibazo ariko muri ibyo byose hari icyiza uvanamo kuko ni isomo ry’ubuzima. Isomo ry’ubuzima uryakira n’urukundo n’ubushishozi, icyo ndimo cyose mba mfite amatsiko nshaka kumenya kurusha. Kumbwira rero icyo nakunze kurusha ibindi bigabanya n’ibyiza mba nakuye mu isomo. Mpora nshaka icyo cyiza ntabwo ndobanura, nize kwemera ikintu cyose kikujeho ukacyakira ariko ukacyakira ukivanamo isomo. IGIHE: Ujya uganira n’abana bawe mugaca imigani? Amb. Igor:  Cyane! Nta kintu nzi mu Kinyarwanda gikomeye kurusha imigani. Byerekana y’uko abanyarwanda kuva kera hari uburyo bahaga abana amasomo kugira ngo babyigireho banabyubakirero. IGIHE: Ni ikihe gitabo wasomye kikagushimisha kurusha ibindi? Amb. Igor: Nsoma byinshi ariko hari ibitabo mbona ku muco nyarwanda umuntu yanditse amateka akajya no mu mizi yayo n’uburyo bwo gutekereza inkomoko y’ibitekerezo by’abanyarwanda, Alex Kagame ari mu bantu wasoma ukamenya amateka y’abanyarwanda n’uburyo batekerezaga. Nsoma byinshi mfite amatsiko menshi. Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Budage ihagarariye u Rwanda muri Romania, Tchèque, Slovaquie, Pologne, Ukraine na Liechtenstein.

title: Rutanga wa Rayon Sports yasezeranye n’umugore we imbere y’amategeko (Amafoto)
content: Abayobozi ba Rayon Sports barangajwe imbere na Perezida w’iyi kipe, Munyakazi Sadate, abatoza barimo Umukuru Javier Martinez Espinoza n’umwungirije Kirasa Alain ndetse n’abandi bakoze b’iyi kipe bari mu bitabiriye ibi birori. Hari kandi abakinnyi bagenzi be barimo Nshimiyimana Amran, Rugwiro Hervé, Irambona Eric, Nizeyimana Mirafa, Habimana Hussein, Sekamana Maxime na Habineza Olivier. Rutanga yabwiye urubuga rw’iyi kipe ko yishimiye gusezerana n’umukunzi we bamaranye imyaka ine, aho yizeye ko bizamufasha kugira ahazaza heza. Ati “Umunyana tumaze imyaka ine dukundana. Ni umugore ukunda imana kandi ungira inama zubaka iteka. Bijyanye n’uko nyoboye bagenzi banjye dukinana mu ikipe ikomeye ngomba no kuba ntuje mu mutwe ntafite byinshi bimvangira. Kugira umufasha ni kimwe mu bifasha umukinnyi gutuza, nizeye ko ahazaza hagiye kuba heza.” Muri Kamena umwaka ushize, nibwo Rutanga Eric na Umunyana Shemsa bibarutse imfura y’umukobwa. Rutanga byitezwe ko azagaragara mu mukino Ikipe ye ya Rayon Sports izakirwamo na Sunrise FC ku wa Gatandatu ubwo hazaba hakinwa Umunsi wa Gatanu wa Shampiyona. Amafoto: Rayon Sports

title: Théodore, izina ry’umuhungu wifitemo impano y’ubugeni
content: Izina Théodore ryakunze gukoreshwa cyane n’abanyamibare, abahanga mu by’imitekerereze n’abayobozi bo mu Bugiriki cyane mbere ya Yesu Kirisitu. Ni izina ryamamaye cyane muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika no ku Mugabane w’u Burayi mu bihugu birimo u Burusiya n’u Bufaransa. Bamwe mu byamamare bazwi bahawe iri izina rya Théodore barimo Theodore Roosevelt Jr. wabaye Perezida wa 26 wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika hagati ya 1901-1909.  	Bimwe mu biranga ba Théodore Ba Théodore bumva bahora baharanira kugira Isi nziza, bakaba abanyembaraga kandi ntacyo batinya. Banga urunuka akarengane kandi bumva abandi. Ni abantu baha agaciro gakomeye urukundo no kwinezeza muri rwo. Ubucuti n’abandi n’ubuzima babamo butuma bahorana ibitekerezo bigamije kumenya no kuvumbura urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Ba Théodore kandi bigiramo impano y’ubugeni ndetse bashobora kugira inama abandi no kubabera icyitegerezo. Muri kamere yabo, ba Théodore ni abanyempuhwe, imico yabo n’imiterere yabo ibakururira ku bantu kandi bumva umwuga uwo ariwo wose bakora waba ufite aho uhuriye n’inyungu za muntu. Abantu bitwa ba Théodore akenshi usanga bajya mu rukundo vuba ariko usanga bababara vuba rimwe na rimwe bigaragara nkaho ari abanyamujinya.

title: Stella, izina ry’umukobwa ugira igikundiro mu rungano
content: Iri zina ryatangiye gukoreshwa mu Bwongereza mu 1374 maze mu kinyejana cya 16, umusizi w’Umwongereza witwa Sir Phillip Sydney arikoresha mu muvugo wamenyekanye cyane witwa ‘Astrophel to Stella’. Stella Ni izina rikunzwe cyane ku Mugabane w’u Burayi mu bihugu nk’u Bufaransa, Suède na Norvège ndetse no muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Canada na Australie.  	Ibiranga ba Stella Ba Stella barangwa nuko bakunda guhirwa no kugira amafaranga. Ibi binagaragarira ku miterere yabo yuko bakunda kubona ibintu bihenze hafi yabo. Gusa, imibanire myiza n’abandi iza ku isonga mu byo bashyira imbere. Ukuri n’ubutabera ni bimwe ba Stella bubaha. Bakunda gukurikiza amategeko n’amabwiriza kuko ngo aribyo bibazanira amahoro no kunyurwa. Bagira ibitekerezo byiza ku buryo iyo babikoresheje bizamura ubukungu bwabo. Bagira imiterere ituma abantu babakunda cyane ku buryo kugira inshuti biborohera cyane. Ba Stella bakunda gukora ibintu byabo bituma baba babohotse ku buryo baba biteguye ingaruka z’ibyo bakoze. Izina rya Stella rifitwe n’ibyamamare bitandukanye birimo Abanyamerika Stella Stevens na Stella Hudgens bamamaye mu gukina filimi n’umunyamideli ubifatanya n’ubuhanzi Stella Ruiz White ukomoka muri Philippines.

title: Isaac, izina ry’umuhungu ugira urugwiro
content: Isaac rikomoka ku ijambo ry’Igiheburayo, Yitzchak, bisobanura ngo “Azaseka”.  	Bimwe mu biranga ba Isaac Abantu bitwa ba Isaac akenshi usanga bihariye cyane ku gukundwakaza. Mu miterere yabo barakunda cyane kandi bakita ku bantu. Ba Isaac imiterere yabo ni nka rukuruzi kuko usanga akenshi ibafasha kwigarurira imitima y’abantu mu buryo bworoshye. Ni izina rihabwa abantu bakunda kubana n’abandi amahoro mu buzima bwabo kandi bakunda gukora akazi kabo. Imiterere yabo ituma bakunda kugira amafaranga n’ibintu bihenze ariko kubana neza n’abantu n’icyo bashyira imbere cyane. Ba Isaac ntibagira ubugugu kuko badashyira indamu zabo imbere, ahubwo baratanga cyane kuko ngo aribyo bibafasha kugera ku bintu bikomeye. Mu miterere ya ba Isaac, usanga bakunda kwigisha bagenzi babo bagamije kubaha inama zabagirira umumaro mu buzima. Hari abantu bamenyekanye cyane ku Isi bitwa iri zina barimo Isaac Sears wamenyekanye cyane muri politiki ya Amerika, Isaac Newton Evan wamamaye cyane mu bijyanye n’ubugenge aho yagiye ashyiraho amahame atandukanye agikoreshwa na magingo aya.

title: Uburyo umubyeyi yafasha umwana kwitwara neza mu ishuri
content: Umubyeyi wese yishimira kubona umwana yibarutse yitwara neza mu rungano, bikaba akarusho iyo abantu bose bamufata nk’icyitegererezo mu byo akora, mu ishuri no mu buzima busanzwe. Mu gihe ababyeyi baba bashaka ko abana babo bitwara nk’abantu bakuru, ubushakashatsi mu by’imitekerereze y’umuntu bwagaragaje ko nubwo nta mahame yashyizweho agenderwaho mu gutanga uburere bwiza hari ingingo zigaragaza uko ushobora kugera ku ntsinzi. Abahanga mu by’imitekerereze bagaragaza ko hari uburyo butandukanye ababyeyi bakwifashisha mu gutoza abana babo kwitwara neza ku ishuri. Ababyeyi ni bo banze y’uburezi buhabwa abakiri bato kuko bazi agaciro bufite ku buzima bwabo bw’ahazaza. Rimwe na rimwe usanga abana batitaye ku hazaza habo ahubwo bakaba birebera YouTube, bakina imikino itandukanye cyangwa bari kuganira n’inshuti zabo aho gukora imikoro itandukanye. Ese kuki abana bamwe bdashishikarira kwitara neza mu ishuri nyamara biri mu nyungu zabo? Kuki badaharanira gushaka intsinzi nkuko ababyeyi babo baba babibifuriza? Empoweringparents.com yakusanyije ingingo z’ingenzi zafasha umubyeyi gushyira umwana we mu mwanya wamufasha gukorana ibakwe no gutsinda mu ishuri.  	Kubaka ubucuti n’umwana Umubyeyi akwiye guhora ari inshuti n’umwana we, akamwubaha kandi akamushyigikira. Ni byiza kuzirikana ko aba bombi bari mu ikipe imwe, aho umubyeyi aba afite inshingano zo kwita ku we. Guhana, kubwiriza no gukoresha iterabwoba ntaho bizakugeza ahubwo bizonona ubucuti bwanyu n’umuhate w’abana. Amarangamutima y’umubyeyi yo kwiheba, kurakara no kugira ubwoba arasanzwe ariko kuyagaragariza abana ntibikwiye kuko bishobora kugira ibyo bizambya. Umubyeyi akwiye kwibuka ko imyitwarire y’umwana akenshi itaba igamije kumubabaza. Ni ingenzi kuzirikana ko inshingano zawe nk’umubyeyi ari ukwigisha umwana uko akwiye kuba uwifatira ibyemezo aho kuba wa wundi ukwishingikirizaho buri munsi.  	Gukundisha umwana gukora cyane Mu buzima, rimwe mu masomo y’ingenzi harimo no guhemberwa akazi wakoze. Ni byiza ko umubyeyi atangira kubwira umwana we amagambo amwereka inyungu ziri mu gusoza amasomo neza. Ushobora kumubwira ko “Nusoza kwiga, nzaguha uruhushya rwo kujya gusura inshuti zawe’’ cyangwa “Nusoza umukoro, turaganira kuri ya film washakaga kureba kuri televiziyo.’’ Iri hame ni byiza kurizirikana kuko iyo umwana wawe adafite imyitwarire ihwitse, ubu buryo bushobora kumufasha. Ibi bimufasha kumenya gukora ibyo ubwonko bwe butashoboraga gukora aribyo byo kwita ku by’ibanze, ibyo kwishimisha bikazaza nyuma.  	Gushyiraho  uburyo bwo gufasha umwana wawe Mu gihe umwana wawe atari kwiga, asubira inyuma mu bijyanye n’amanota yabonaga; aha rero ntiwareberera iki kibazo uko byagenda kose. Umubyeyi si byiza gukorera umwana ahubwo amufasha kubaka uburyo atashobora kwigezaho bumworohereza mu byo akora. Ubu buryo bushobora kuba ingengabihe yo gusubiramo amasomo, kumuhuza mudasobwa mu rugo, ukamukumira ku mikino ya video mbere yo gusoza umukoro yahawe. Ushobora gushyiraho uburyo butuma yiga nta kimuhuza ndetse ibikoresho byose by’ikoranabuhanga byashyizwe ku ruhande. Hari abana bakunda kumva umuziki bari kwiga, nta kibazo kibirimo. Gusa umubyeyi akwiye kumenya ko hari imiziki iba iri muri telefoni, ashobora gukura kuri YouTube, Twitter, Reddit n’izindi mbuga zicuruza muzika. Iyo umubyeyi adashobora kugenzura uko umwana we akoresha izo porogaramu biba byiza kutemerera umwana kumva umuziki mbere yo gusoza akazi ke.  	Gutegura gahunda yo guhura na mwarimu Iyo amanota n’imyitwarire by’umwana byasubiye inyuma biba byiza ko umubyeyi ategura inama, akamuganiriza ari kumwe n’abarimu be. Ugomba kubaka ubucuti bwagufasha unyuze kuri mwarimu ukamenya ko umwana wawe yahawe umukoro. Buri gitondo ni byiza kubaza umwana niba yibutse gutwara umukoro ku ishuri kuko hari ababikora ariko bakabyibagirwa. Iyo umwana amaze kumenya gukoresha igihe, gusoza umukoro we no gukorera kuri gahunda, ni cyo gihe cyo kumureka akikoresha, ukaba wamufasha aho bikenewe.  	Gushaka ahantu haboneye ho kwigira  Umwana wawe ashobora kuba ashaka kwigira ahantu hatuje, yitaruye abavandimwe be cyangwa akanyurwa no kwiga ari hamwe n’abandi. Ni byiza ko umubyeyi afasha umwana we muri urwo rugendo ku buryo abona ahantu hamunyura akahamugumisha. Mu gufasha umwana wawe kutarangara, ni byiza kwicarana na we akora umukoro. Ushobora kuba wisomera igitabo cyangwa ikinyamakuru ariko unaga akajisho ku byo akora kuko bimufasha kudatandukira.  	Kugabanya akazi mu byiciro Ni byiza gufatanya n’umwana mu gihe akeneye kugabanya akazi afite mu byiciro bitandukanye. Ibi bizafasha mu kumenya ibyo umwana ashobora gukora kuri gahunda ya buri munsi.  	Kubahiriza amabwiriza yemejwe Umubyeyi akwiye kugendera ku mahame yafashe atayatandukiriye, kugira ngo afashe umwana we. Ni byiza guha umwana ubutumwa bumufasha kwitwara neza kandi bumuremamo icyizere. Ingamba mwafashe mu myigire zikwiye kubahirizwa byanze bikunze.  	Kwita ku myitwarire y’umwana Ni byiza ko umubyeyi amenya ko kuba umwana we adashishikarira kwiga bishobora kuba biterwa n’isoni agira mu ishuri. Abana bashobora kudasobanura ibi byose kuko batari kuri urwo rwego. Ababyeyi rero bakwiye guhora bagenzura neza bakamenya imyitwarire y’abana babo n’ingaruka ishobora kubagiraho. Ibimubaho ushobora gusanga bitandukanye mu gihe azaba amaze kuba mukuru. Umwana ni umutware, akwiye gutegurwa kare kugira ngo azavemo uw’umumaro ku muryango n’igihugu cye.

title: Nyuma y’imyaka 10 bakundana, Usengimana Faustin na Bayingana Daniella bagiye kurushinga
content: Usengimana w’imyaka 25 yatangiye gukundana na Daniella mu 2009, bivuze ko aba bombi bamaranye imyaka 10 bari mu rukundo ibidakunze kugaragara mu byamamare yaba hano mu Rwanda n’imahanga. Abakurikirana imbuga nkoranyambaga za Usengimana n’umukunzi we, ntibahwema kubona iby’urukundo rwabo cyane ko usanga buri umwe adahisha kwerekana ko yanyuzwe n’ubuzima babanyemo. Babigaragazaga bifashishije amafoto berekanaga aherekejwe n’amagabo aryohereye cyane aranga abari mu rukundo. Aba bombi kandi bahuriye ku mpakanizi igira iti #TEAM15FORLife, ijambo bakunda gukoresha bombi ku mbuga nkoranyamabaga zabo. Magingo aya, biyemeje kubana akaramata nk’umugabo n’umugore mu birori biteganyijwe mu Ugushyingo uyu mwaka. Impapuro z’integuza y’ubukwe bwabo zigaragaza ko tariki 9 Ugushyingo 2019 aribwo hazaba imihango yo gusaba no gukwa, ikabera mu busitani bwa Kaminuza ya UTB ishami rya Rubavu ari naho Bayingana Daniella avuka. Tariki ya 11 Ugushyingo 2019, Usengimana n’umukunzi we bazasezerana imbere y’Imana kuri Parkland Remera ruguru y’ahazwi nko ku Mushumba mwiza. Usengimana Faustin yakiniye amakipe atandukanye mu Rwanda arimo Rayon Sports yanazamukiyemo na APR FC, aha hose akaba yaragiye atwara ibikombe. Ari mu itsinda ry’abakinnyi Rayon Sports yifashishije ikora amateka yo kugera mu matsinda mu irushanwa rya CAF Confederations Cup mu 2018. Usengimana Faustin kandi yanakiniye ikipe y’igihugu mu byiciro byose yaba icy’abatarengeje imyaka 17, 20, 23 n’ikipe y’igihugu nkuru. Nyuma y’uko atandukanye na Khaitan Sporting Club yo muri Kuwait, ubu arabarizwa muri Zambia muri Buildcon FC, akaba ari no mu mu bakinnyi b’inkingi za mwamba muri iyi kipe.

title: Verbena, izina ry’umukobwa wifitemo impano yo kuyobora ibirori
content: Verbena ni izina rihabwa umwana w’intyoza mu gushyushya urugamba no kuyobora ibirori. Bagira amagambo meza ku bantu baba bari kumwe n’ababakikije.  	Ibiranga ba Verbena Ni abantu bakunda kwihagararaho kabone niyo byabashyira mu kaga birengera ingaruka. Bagira amakenga menshi iyo barimo guhitamo inshuti zabo. Bakunda kwigirira icyizere cyane. Ba Verbena ntibacibwa intege nibyo abantu bababwira cyangwa babatekerezaho. Ntibakangwa n’ikintu icyo aricyo cyose kibabayeho. Verbena ashobora kurakara cyangwa akaba yishimye ariko ntubitahure kuko bigoye kumenya amarangamutima ye. Gufata ibyemezo kuri ba Verbena biba bigoye ku buryo no guhitamo icyo barya bitizana ako kanya. Bagira gushidikanya cyane mbere yo kugira icyo bakora. Bagira impano yo kumenya ibintu cyangwa kubikeka mbere yuko biba. Akenshi usanga abakobwa bitwa ba Verbena bagorwa cyane no kwakira impinduka. Urwego rw’imitekerereze rwa ba Verbena ruri hejuru cyane ku buryo na bagenzi babo babana umunsi ku munsi baba babibaziho. Ba Verbena bakunda guhagarara ku nshingano biyemeje ku buryo bashobora no kuzitangira ariko zikajya mu buryo bitewe n’umuhate bashyizemo.

title: Elliana, izina ry’umukobwa wanga akarengane
content: Iri zina rikunze gukoreshwa kenshi mu bihugu bivuga ururimi rw’Icyesipanyolo n’Ikinyaporutigali. Elliana ni izina rikunzwe cyane muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ku buryo mu 2018 ryaje ku mwanya wa 83 mu mazina akunzwe cyane kurusha andi.  	Dore ibiranga ba Elliana Ba Elliana usanga barangwa no kugira umwete mu kazi kabo kandi ngo bakunda kugera ku ntego zabo iza muntu ndetse n’iz’umwuka. Ni abantu badatinya kandi baba biteguye iteka kuba barwanira ukuri. Ibi bituma bazira urunuka akarengane ku buryo batajya bashobora no kukihanganira. Bakunda gufasha abandi bakanishyira mu cyimbo cyabo. Baha agaciro gakomeye ibijyanye n’urukundo no kurwinezezamo. Bashobora kwigisha abandi bakabaha inama zabafasha mu buzima, kandi bifitemo n’impano y’ubugeni. Mu byo bakora, usanga baba babifitemo impano ku buryobitabagora. Ikindi nuko ba Elliana bafatwa nk’icyitegererezo bitewe n’imiterere yabo.

title: Eliza, izina ry’abakobwa bifitemo impano y’ubuyobobozi
content: Izina Eliza ni ijambo riri mu rurimi rw’Igiheburayo risobanura ngo “Imana ni isezerano ryanjye.” Mu kinyejana cya 18 n’icya 19 hakoreshwaga izina rya Elzabthe ariko Eliza riba ariryo ryamamara cyane mu Bafaransa. Iri zina rifitwe n’ibihangange bitandukanye ku Isi birimo Umunyamerika w’umunyarwenya Eliza Kate Coupe; Umunya-Australia Eliza Szonert ukina filime n’umuhanzi Eliza Carthy ukomoka mu Bwongereza.  	Ibiranga ba Eliza Ba Eliza barangwa no kugira ubwira n’imbaraga mu byo bakora ndetse bakunze no kuba abatunzi. Bifitemo ubuyobozi muri bo kandi bakunda gukemura ibibazo by’abandi. Ni abantu bifitemo impano yo kuba abayobozi kandi bagira umwete ku kazi kabo. Igifite agaciro kuri bo ni uko babona akazi bagombaga gukora kagenze neza. Ba Eliza ikintu gito bakibonamo ikinini kandi bahorana ingamba zo kugera ku ntsinzi y’ibyo biyemeje.  Bashoboye kuyobora amatsinda bakayageza ku ntego yiyemeje, kandi bazi kumenya ubushobozi bw’abo bari kumwe mu matsinda ku buryo bababyazamo umusaruro. Ba Eliza bakunda guhirwa n’ubucuruzi ku buryo akenshi bituma bahirwa bakaba abakire mu buzima bwabo.

title: Phoebe, izina ry’umukobwa wifitemo impano yo gusetsa
content: Usanga abana b’abakobwa muri iyi minsi babita Phoebe bitewe nuko byoroheye buri wese kurihamagara kandi ryumvikana neza mu matwi. Hari ibyamamare byabayeho bifite izina rya Phoebe nk’umukinnyi wa filimi w’Umunyamerika Phoebe Brand, umuririmbyi rurangiranwa w’Umwongereza, Phoebe Brown na Phoebe Cary wamamaye mu busizi.  	Ibiranga ba Phoebe Ba Phoebe bagaragara nk’abakunda kwivugira kandi icyitwa ubwoba ntikibarangwaho. Ntushobora kugira irungu mu gihe muri kumwe bitewe n’impano yo gusetsa baba bifitemo. Kubera imyitwarire ya ba Phoebe, abasore bose baba bifuza kubana na bo. Niba uri inshuti na ba Phoebe uri umunyamahirwe kuko abafite imyitwarire myiza nk’iyabo bitoroshye kubabona. Niba uri umusore ba Phoebe bakaba aribo baba urukundo rwawe rwa mbere ntuzabibagirwa. Ni abakobwa b’abanyaburanga, biyitaho kandi bakunze kuba abanyempano. Ibyo bituma abantu benshi bifuza kuba bamera nkaho. Bakunda gushyira inyungu z’abandi imbere kurusha uko bakwiyitaho bo ubwabo. Ba Phoebe kandi usanga ari intyoza mu kuba abarimu n’abajyanama b’abandi.

title: Assiel, izina ry’umuhungu w’umunyamahoro
content: Izina Assiel rigaragara no mu Giheburayo “Asiel” aho risomwa “AH-Z-iy-eh-L” bikaba bisobanura ngo “Icyaremwe n’Imana.” Assiel mu zindi ndimi ryandikwa nka Asiel, Cassiel,  Chasiel, Hasiel, Hassiel, Jaasiel na Jansiel.  	Ibiranga ba Assiel Ba Assiel ni abanyembaraga kandi bakunda gukora ubushakashatsi ku bintu bitandukanye. Bafite  ubuhanga mu gutegura ibintu kandi bikagenda neza. Ni abantu bumva batuzuye iyo nta muntu basangira urukundo, ibyo bungutse n’imikorere. Ni abanyamahoro muri kamere yabo, bakunda ukuri n’ubutabera. Ba Assiel bagaragara nk’abagira isoni mu bandi kandi barihangana. Bita ku kumenya impamvu y’ibyo bashaka n’impamvu ibatera kubirarikira. Bakunda gutembera, ubwisanzure, kwinezeza no gusabana n’abandi. Ni abanyabwenge ndetse bashobora guhanga udushya ariko bagorwa no gukoresha neza amafaranga. Hari ibihangange ku Isi bikoresha izina rya Assiel harimo umukinnyi wa filime Asiel Rodriguez Perez; Asiel Kneeland wamamaye mu kwambika abakinnyi ba filime na Asiel Norton wandika filime akaba yaragiye atsindira n’ibihembo bitandukanye.

title: Willa, izina ry’umukobwa w’umunyamahirwe
content: Iri zina rimaze imyaka irenga 100 rimenyekanye, usanga muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika riri mu akunzwe cyane. Ibiranga ba Willa Ni abantu bakunda guca bugufi bakanakunda cyane inshuti n’umuryango wabo. Bakunda ko ibintu byabo biba mu mucyo kandi ingeso zabo nziza zituma abenshi bumva bagumana nabo mu buzima bwa buri munsi. Ba Willa bakunze kuba abanyamahirwe mu buzima bwabo, imirimo berekejeho amaboko irabahira cyane. Imyitwarire yabo ituma bafatwa nk’abana bato bitewe n’uko bahorana ibyishimo. Akenshi usanga bifitemo impano zitandukanye ku buryo akenshi usanga aho bari baba bashagawe n’abashaka ko babasusurutsa. Willa riri mu mazina 100 akunzwe mu mwaka wa 2019 mu yatangajwe mu igenzura ryakozwe n’Urubuga rwitwa Nameberry rusanzwe rutanga ubujyanama bujyanye n’amazina ababyeyi bakwita abana babo.

title: Elsa, izina ry’umukobwa ukunda gukorana n’abandi
content: Elsa ni izina ryakunze gukoreshwa cyane mu bihugu birimo u Budage, u Bwongereza na Suède. Hari abarifata nk’impine ya Elisabeth. Iri zina ryaje kwamamara cyane mu 2013 nyuma ya filimi yitwa “Frozen”. Hari ibihangange byinshi bifite izina rya Elsa birimo Umutaliyani witwa Elsa Morante wamamaye mu kwandika ibitabo; umunyamuziki Elsa Garcia; Umunyamerika ukina filimi, Elsa Lanchester na Elsa Peretti utunganya imikufi.  	Ibiranga ba Elsa Ba Elsa bakunda ko abantu babashima cyane. Ibi bituma bagira ishyaka mu mirimo yabo kandi bakishimira gukorana n’abandi. Bakunda umuryango wabo cyane n’abantu muri rusange. Ni abantu bakunda gutegura ibirori, bakunda ubuyobozi ku buryo kuyoborwa atari ibintu bashyikira biboroheye. Bagira amahame ntakuka rimwe na rimwe bakaba bagira n’amahane. Bakunda kugendera ku ntego kandi bakora ibishoboka byose ngo bayigereho. Ba Elsa usanga ari abantu bihariye mu miterere yabo, barakubagana, bakunda guhanga udushya, bifitemo kwigirira icyizere.

title: Elton, izina ry’umuhungu w’umunyamurava
content: Mu bihugu bivuga ururimi rw’Icyongereza nka Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Canada n’u Bwongereza usanga iri zina ariho rikunze kugaragara cyane.  	Ibiranga ba Elton Ni abantu barangwa no guhora bashaka aho bamenera kugira ngo berekane ubushobozi bifitemo. Bacisha make kandi bakunda ko abantu babashima cyane. Elton iyo mumeranye neza nta kibazo mufitanye aba ari umuntu mwiza cyane gusa iyo hari impinduka zibaye mu mibanire yanyu ahinduka uwundi kuko imyitwarire n’indangagaciro ze nziza abitereka ku ruhande. Ba Elton bahora bashakisha umutuzo n’ubwisanzure bituma badakunze kunyurwa n’ibyo bafite. Bo bahora bashakisha udushya kugera ku bintu bishya, ibi bikabatera guhora bafite ubwoba bw’ibihe biri imbere. Ni abantu bumva ko bagera ku ntego nyinshi icyarimwe. Bahora bashaka impinduka nshya, amasura amashya no kuba bari ahantu hashya. Izina rya Elton ryakoreshejwe n’abafite amazina azwi barimo Elton John wamamaye cyane mu kuririmba injyana ya Rock, Elton Brand wakanyujijeho mu mukino wa Basketball na Elton Flatley, Umunya-Australie wigeze kwamamara cyane mu mukino wa Rugby.

title: Firdaus, izina ry’umukobwa wigengesera mbere yo gukora
content: Ni izina rikunze gukoreshwa mu bihugu bitandukanye ku Isi ariko cyane ibivuga ururimi rw’Icyarabu n’Igihinde.  	Ibiranga ba Firdaus Ba Firdaus ntibakunda guhita bemera impinduka zibayeho ahubwo barabanza bakagenzura icyaziteye bakagenzura niba ari na ngombwa ko zibaho. Ibi bijyanirana n’uko muri kamere yabo iyo hari ikintu runaka bashaka gukora babanza gufata umwanya munini bagitegura. Ni abantu bakunda kubahiriza inshingano zabo cyane ku buryo usanga akenshi  bahangayika iyo zitarashyirwa mu bikorwa bitewe n’agaciro baba bazihaye. Ni abanyempano cyane cyane ku bintu bijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga rigezweho. Mu rukundo usanga ba Firdaus ari abantu bakunze kuzana ibitekerezo by’inyamibwa cyane ariko ntibakunze kugaragaza amarangamutima yabo bihambaye ku buryo bisaba abo bakundana kubanza kwakira uko bateye hato bataba babakeka ibindi. Ba Firdaus bakunda kubaho mu buzima busazwe butuma babana n’abandi amahoro kandi bakemera ibintu bifite uburanga. Kuri bo ibikorwa bihabwa agaciro kanini kuruta amagambo.

title: Umukobwa wa Apôtre Masasu yasabwe anakobwa n’umusore bitegura kurushinga
content: Uyu muhango wari ubereye ijisho wabereye mu busitani buherereye hafi y’Ikibuga cya Golf kuri SOS Kacyiru mu Mujyi wa Kigali, ku wa Gatandatu, tariki ya 31 Kanama 2019. Ni ibirori byitabiriwe n’abantu batandukanye barimo abagize imiryango ya Musafiri na Masasu barimo abo basenganye n’abo bakorana. Ubukwe bwa Deborah Masasu bwitabiriwe kandi n’abiganjemo abo bakorana umurimo w’ivugabutumwa mu itorero rya se Evangelical Restoration. Mu bazwi babutashye barimo abahanzi Gabby Kamanzi na Patient Bizimana; uyu byanigeze guhwihwiswa ko bagiranye ibihe byiza by’urukundo. Musafiri usanzwe akora akazi k’Ubuvuzi bw’amenyo yasabiwe n’Umwepiskopi w’Itorero ry’Abangilikani mu Rwanda, Diyosezi ya Butare, Musenyeri Gasatura Nathan mu gihe umuryango wa Apôtre Masasu wari uhagarariwe n’abasaza barimo Rudahunga Gedeon [usanzwe ari Visi Perezida wa Rwanda Leaders Fellowship] n’Umuvugabutumwa Sandral Sebakara. Umuhango wo gusaba Deborah Masasu watangiye ahagana saa munani z’amanywa ariko utinda gusozwa bitewe n’imvura yarindimutse mu masaha y’umugoroba. Iyi mvura ntiyarogoye ubukwe kuko aho bwabereye hari hateguye neza ku buryo itabuhungabanya. Deborah Masasu yasabwe anakobwa nyuma yuko ku wa 25 Kanama 2019, urungano rwamukoreye ibirori byo kumusezeraho bizwi nka “Bridal Shower” byanitabiriwe na nyina, Pasiteri Lydia Masasu. Urukundo rwe na Musafiri rwagizwe ubwiru, ntirwakunze kuvugwa cyane mu itangazamakuru kugeza ubwo muri Kamena Musafiri Thacien yateraga ivi akambika impeta Deborah Masasu amusaba ko bazabana akaramata undi nawe akabimwemerera atazuyaje. Hari nyuma y’aho uyu mugabo yerekanwa mu itorero tariki ya 19 Gicurasi 2019. Uyu mukobwa uba muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika yamenyekanye cyane nk’uwatangije itsinda riramya rikanahimbaza Imana mu mbyino rya Shining Stars. Deborah Masasu na Musafiri bazaserana imbere y’Imana ku wa 7 Nzeri 2019 mu rusengero rwa Evangelical Restoration Church i Masoro mbere yuko abatumi bajya kwiyakirira kuri Intare Conference Arena i Rusororo.

title: Amagambo akomeye ya Miss Aurore kuri se witabye Imana
content: Uyu mubyeyi washyinguwe yasigiye benshi agahinda, yasezeweho bwa nyuma mu muhango wabereye mu Mujyi wa Portaland kuri uyu wa 28 Kanama 2019 witabirwa n’abanyarwanda batuyeyo n’inshuti zabo. Ladislas Kayibanda yitabye Imana tariki 18 Kanama 2019 azize uburwayi yari amaranye igihe. Ni umubyeyi wa Kayibanda Mutesi Aurore wabaye Nyampinga w’u Rwanda mu 2012 na Hirwa Henry wari umuririmbyi mu itsinda rya KGB nawe witabye Imana. Aurore n’abavandimwe be basigaranye n’umubyeyi wabo umwe nawe babana muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Mu butumwa buhekejwe n’amashusho yo gushyingura umubyeyi we Miss Aurore yagize ati “Nabuze data, umurinzi, umujyanama, inshuti magara, uwo nareberagaho n’intwari nyayo; ariko ijuru ribonye umumalayika uzajya andeberera.” Kayibanda Ladislas yatabarutse nyuma y’uko umukobwa we Mutesi Aurore yari amaze igihe gito asezeranye imbere y’amategeko na Mbabazi Egide muri Nyakanga 2018. Mutesi Kayibanda Aurore, mwene Ladislas Kayibanda na Olive Mukazera; yavukiye i Burundi (Bujumbura) mu 1992, akaba umuhererezi mu bana bane. Amashuri y’incuke yayigiye kuri Petit Prince (mu Mujyi wa Kigali), aho yanakomereje amashuri abanza kugeza mu mwaka wa kane, akaba yarahavuye akomereza ku ishuri rya Kimisange ari naryo yashorejemo amashuri abanza. Icyiciro cya mbere cy’amashuri yisumbuye yacyigiye kuri Saint Joseph i Nyamirambo, ayakomereza muri ETO Muhima aho yavanye impamyabumenyi y’amashuri yisumbuye mu bijyanye n’ubwubatsi.  I lost a father, a protector, a guiding hand, a mentor, a best friend,a role model and a superhero, but heaven gained an angel who will always look out for me.  ️ A post shared by  Hirwa ️ (@aurorekayibanda) on Aug 29, 2019 at 10:38am PDT

title: Ibimenyetso byakwereka ko umusore wihebeye atakigukunda
content:
Birumvikana ko bishengura kubona bimwe mu bimenyetso bikwereka ko umuhungu wihebeye ashobora kuba atakigukunda cyane igihe wowe wumvaga ko urushaho kumukunda, gusa igihe ubashije kubibona ni amahirwe kuri wowe kuko bikurinda gutakaza umwanya ndetse ukaba wamenya imyanzuro ukwiriye gufata hakiri kare. Ibi ni bimwe mu bimenyetso bishobora kukwereka ko umuhungu wihebeye atakigukunda. Arakurakarira n’aho bitari ngombwa Umuhungu mukundana iyo atagishaka ko mukundana, ibyo wakoraga bikamushimisha hari igihe ubikora bikamurakaza cyangwa wagira icyo umubaza niyo cyaba cyoroshye gusubiza akagusubizanya umushiha. Uyu mushiha n’uburakari iyo nta yindi mpamvu uzi ibimutera nk’umunaniro yakuye ku kazi cyangwa ibibazo afite bye ku giti cye, biba ari ikimenyetso cy’uko atakigushaka ndetse yifuza ko urukundo rwanyu ruhagarara. Aratinda cyangwa ntasubize ubutumwa bwawe Iyo urukundo rugitangira, abakundana baba bashaka kubonana kenshi gashoboka, igihe bitakunze bakohererezanya ubutumwa bwinshi kandi ntibatinde gusubizanya. Mu gihe umuhungu mukundana usigaye umwandikira ubutumwa bugufi ntagusubize cyangwa akagusubiza haciyemo igihe, wabimubaza bikamurakaza ndetse ntagire impamvu aguha yumvikana yatumye abikora, biba ari ikindi kimenyetso ko yifuza ko urukundo rwanyu ruhagarara. Ahagarika kukubwira ko agukunda Iyo umusore ari mu rukundo, arabigaragaza ndetse agashaka ko umenya uburyo yiyumva, akubwira ko agukunda kenshi bishoboka, mu gihe iyo atakikubwira ko agukunda kandi yarajyaga abikora ndetse wamubaza niba akigukunda akakubaza impamvu ubimubajije , ni ikimenyetso cyerekana ko ashobora kuba atakigukunda. Ntaguha umwanya Igihe ubona umuhungu mukundana atakiguha umwanya ngo uze imbere mu buzima bwe, ni ikimenyetso cy’uko ashaka ko urukundo rwanyu ruhagarara. Umuhungu ugukunda n’ubwo yaba ahuze cyane agerageza gushaka umwanya mukabonana cyangwa mukavugana, igihe akubwiye ko ahuze akabigira impamvu yo kuba mutabonana, ni uburyo bwo kukwigizayo ariko akaba adafite imbaraga zo kukubwira ko atakigukunda nka mbere. Ntaguhumuriza mu bibazo
Kimwe mu byiza byo kuba mu rukundo ni ukumva ko ufite umuntu ukuri hafi ndetse ushobora kugufasha mu bibazo byose wahura nabyo akabana nawe. Mu gihe ubona umuhungu mukundana atakikuba hafi ahubwo ibibazo byaza ukabona ararushaho kuguhunga, bishobora kuba ari ikimenyetso cy’uko atakigukunda. Akunda kugaragara nk’utishimye Birasanzwe ko mu rukundo umuntu wese agira igihe aba yumva atameze neza ndetse atishimye. Ariko igihe ubibona mu buryo buhoraho ku musore mukundana ariko utazi impamvu ibimutera wenda ituruka hanze y’urukundo rwanyu, bishobora ko ari ikimenyetso cy’uko ashaka ko muhagarika umubano wanyu.

title: Ibidasanzwe kuri Nyirakaragire, umuganga wa mbere w’ingagi ukomoka mu Rwanda (Amafoto & Video)
content: Ni umuganga muri Pariki y’Igihugu y’Ibirunga guhera mu 1987, ubu amaze imyaka 32 akorana n’ingagi umunsi ku munsi; kubera umuhate no gukunda akazi ke, ku myaka ye aterera ibirunga haba mu mvura n’imbeho, intego ari ukuramira ubuzima bw’ingagi ngo hato izi nyamaswa ziri mu zigeramiwe ku Isi zidacika, kandi bimaze kugaragara ko ari isoko ihamye ivubura amadevize mu Rwanda. Yagize ati “Ubu mfite imyaka 56 ariko ndacyafite imbaraga kandi nkunda akazi kanjye ko gukora mu bidukikije.” Nyirakaragire wavukiye mu gace k’ibirunga, yibuka ko mbere yo gutangira aka kazi, ubwo yari afite imyaka 12 yagiye gusura bene wabo babituriye, abona ingagi isa n’umusaza ubasuye, yihutira kubibwira sekuru wamusobanuriye ko icyo abonye ari ingagi. Ati “Ikintu cya mbere cyanjemo naravuze nti ‘ninkura nzaba umwe mu itsinda ribungabunga ingagi. Icyifuzo cyanjye ubwo nari ndangije amashuri yisumbuye mu buvuzi bw’amatungo, nibuka ko hari mu 1987, kubera ko twari duturiye ibiro bya ORTPN (Office Rwandais de Tourisme et des Parcs Nationaux, kimwe mu bigo birindwi byabyaye RDB mu 2008), hari umwanya w’umuganga w’inyamaswa, nasabye akazi muri Gashyantare, guhera ku wa 15 Werurwe 1987 ntangira kuvura ingagi.” Ni we wa mbere ukomoka mu Rwanda watangiye kuvura ingagi, yunganiraga umuganga wa mbere wakoze uyu murimo mu Rwanda, Dr. James Foster. Ntabwo kari akazi koroshye, kuko yibuka ko ku munsi wa mbere yinjira muri Pariki yari kumwe n’abakozi bagenda baranga aho ingagi ziri, bazwi nka trackers. Ati “Ntabwo byari byoroshye ku mukobwa muto kwinjira muri pariki, ndibuka ko ubwa mbere ndi imbere y’ingagi, zari izo muri ‘13 Group’ ubu uyu umuryango wahinduye izina witwa Agashya. Kubona ingagi ku munsi wa mbere, Haah, nari mfite ubwoba, ndibuka ko dusubiye ku biro nahise njya ku muyobozi wanjye ndamubwira nti ‘ntabwo nshoboye gukorana n’ingagi.’ “Nubwo ari akazi kagoye, kwinjira mu ishyamba, ubusanzwe kuva hagati ya Werurwe kugeza muri Gicurasi aba ari igihe cy’imvura nyinshi, ntabwo byari byoroshye, ndavuga nti ‘ntabwo nzasubirayo, nzajya mvura inyamaswa zisanzwe nk’inka n’amatungo yo mu rugo, ntabwo nabasha akazi gakomeye nka kariya.” Icyo gihe ariko umuyobozi wa pariki yaramuhumurije, amwumvisha ko afite imbaraga n’ubushobozi bwo gukora ako kazi, bityo adakwiye gucika intege kuko ku zindi nshuro azamenyera kuvura ingagi. Ni nako byagenze kuko yamenyereye akazi, ubu nyuma y’imyaka 32 avura ingagi, Nyirakaragire ni umugore wishimye kubera akazi ke n’uruhare kagira mu gutuma umubare w’ingagi wiyongera. Iyo bagiye kuvura ingagi ni ukubanza kuyirasa ikinya bakayisinziriza kugira ngo idatera amahane, bakayivura mu buryo bwose bitewe n’ikibazo ifite. Iyo iri kumwe n’izindi na zo bisaba kuzisinziriza, kuko mu muco wazo zigira uburyo bwo gutabarana. Nyirakaragire yagize ati “Nishimira kubona nk’urugero twaravuye ingagi nto y’ingabo, nyuma y’igihe nkabona ikomeje gukura, igize umuryango, nshimishwa cyane no kubona umubare w’ingagi ukomeje kwiyongera, ariko bikaba akarusho nk’iyo uvuye ingagi ukabona irakize neza.” “Nibuka ingagi nto y’ingore twavuye, yari ifite ibimenyetso by’indwara z’ubuhumekero, ubu imaze kubyara abana batatu. Iyo mbonye abana b’iyo ngagi biranshimisha cyane nkavuga nti ‘uyu ni umusaruro w’akazi kanjye’, ni umusaruro w’uruhare rw’abaganga. Niteguye kandi nishimiye gukomeza gutanga umusanzu wanjye mu itsinda ririmo kubungabunga ingagi n’ibidukikije muri rusange.” Iyo asura ingagi, Nyirakaragire kimwe n’abandi baganga agenda afotora, yitegereza ko nta ngagi yaba ifite ikibazo, hagira ikigaragaza ikavurwa. Yitegereza uko ingagi ikora ibintu binyuranye nko kurya, gukina n’izindi, imbaraga ifite n’ibindi, akagenda yandika. Ubwo ku Cyumweru yasuraga umuryango w’ingagi w’Umubano, ugizwe n’ingagi 15, yabonyemo ingagi ifite igikomere kiri kuma, icyo gihe ngo nta mpungenge ziba zihari nubwo bitabuza ko abitangira raporo kuri buri muryango yasuye. Avuga ko kugeza ubu ingagi nta bibazo bikomeye zikigira, kuko mu gihe kera habaga ibibazo byinshi bizibasira bituruka ku mitego ya ba rushimusi, ubu byakemutse ku buryo izi nyamaswa zifite umutekano uhagije. Ati "Uko ndimo kugenda nkura, bigaragara ko ntagifite imbaraga nko mu ntangiriro, ariko ubwo natangiraga kuzamuka ibirunga, kubera igihe gishize namaze kubimenyera. Ngomba gukoresha imbaraga zanjye, ndabimenyereye, nkunda ingagi, mu mutwe byangiyemo ko ngomba kugera aho ingagi ziri, kuko nkunda gukorana nazo, ntabwo njya ninubira aho ingagi ziri uko haba kure hose, intego yanjye ni uko mba ngomba kuhagera.” “Kandi kugeza ubu ku myaka 56 ndacyashobora kuzamuka mu gitondo, ubu urabona uko ndimo kugenda. Iyo ukunda ikintu, ufite umuhate, ugomba kugera ku ntego wiyemeje.” Nubwo bisanzwe ko mu mategeko ko umuntu ajya mu kiruhuko cy’izabukuru ku myaka 65, Nyirakaragire avuga ko azakijyamo ku myaka 60. Umurimo wa Nyirakaragire na bagenzi be watanze umusaruro, kuko ubushakashatsi bwashyizwe ahagaragara mu mwaka ushize bwerekanye ko imibare y’ingagi ziri mu birunga kugeza muri Kamena 2016 zari 604 zivuye kuri 480 zabaruwe mu 2010. Imibare yashyizwe ahagaragara kandi ntirimo ingagi ziri mu ishyamba rya Bwindi muri Uganda kuko ho ubushakashatsi bugikorwa. Ibarura ryaho mu 2011 ryari ryerekanye ko harimo ingagi zigera kuri 400, bivuze ko ubu ingagi zibarurwa muri iki gice zirenga 1000. Ubu bwiyongere ngo bushingiye ku mbaraga zashyizwe mu kubungabunga ingagi binyuze mu Kigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB) n’uruhare rw’abaturage bamaze gusobanukirwa akamaro k’ibidukikije.
