title: Bya bihe muri kaminuza, iminsi ya mbere muri Guverinoma n’ibindi: Urugendo rwa Amb. Uwihanganye
content: Ku wa 15 Nyakanga 2019 nibwo Perezida Paul yashyizeho abahagarariye u Rwanda mu bihugu 15 by’amahanga, barimo na Uwihanganye woherejwe muri Singapore nka ambasaderi. Ni nyuma y’uko yari Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ibikorwa remezo kuva ubwo Perezida Kagame yashyiragaho abagize Guverinoma iyobowe na Minisitiri w’Intebe Dr. Edouard Ngirente, tariki ya 30 Kanama 2017. Hari nyuma y’imyaka mike ari umuyobozi mu kigo gikora iby’ubwubatsi, NPD-COTRACO, ashinzwe gutegura imishinga n’iterambere ryayo. Afite impamyabushobozi y’icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza mu bijyanye no gucunga imishinga minini y’ubwubatsi yakuye muri Kaminuza ya Manchester mu Bwongereza, yabonye mu 2013. Amb.Uwihanganye Jean de Dieu yakoreye igihe kinini Radio Salus na Radio 10. Agitangira gukora ibijyanye n’ubwubatsi, yabibangikanyaga no kwigisha muri Kaminuza ya INILAK. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na Radio Rwanda yahishuye byinshi bimwerekeye haba kubuzima bwe bwite, nk’umwe mu bagize guverinoma ndetse no ku nshingano nshya za ambasaderi. Urugendo rw’imyaka ibiri muri Guverinoma Amb. Uwihanganye yavuze ko urugendo muri guverinoma rwari rukomeye cyane kuko atari yaragize ahandi ayobora ku rwego nk’urwo, kuko yabaga mu mirimo yo gukora imihanda n’ibindi. Ati “Urumva urugendo ntabwo rwahise rworoha gukora akazi ko kuyobora ntabwo wavuga ko nari mbifitemo uburambe. Ubundi njye nari umufundi, ndi enjeniyeri, nubakaga imihanda, nayoboraga abandi bisanzwe kuko nari nshinzwe imishinga irimo iy’umuriro, imihanda, amashanyarazi, za stade n’ibindi, ni akazi ko kuyobora nakoraga.” “Ntabwo nari nakageze ahantu n’iyo wanaba umunyamabanga uhoraho kugira utangire no kumenya uko bikora. Kugira ngo njye mbonane na Minisitiri yaje gusura umushinga byabaga gake kuko abamubonaga ni abayobozi bari banyoboye, gusa nigeze kugira amahirwe yo guhura n’uwo nasimbuye yaje gusura umushinga w’umuhanda, aho niho nabonye amahirwe yo kumenya uko Minisitiri yitwara, avuga … bibanza kugutonda ukavuga uti ‘iyi mirimo ko ikomeye kuri iyi myaka mfite!’ Ubanza kwitinya uti ko ubanza ndi muto ntazabishobora.” Avuga ko byatangiye bitoroshye ariko aho byari bigeze byari byiza, kuko no mu kazi ari gukora ubu nka amabasaderi yamaze kukamenyera. Ati “Icyo gihe noneho uba utangiye kubimenyera, mukorera hamwe ni igihugu mukorera, ubona ubufasha. Ukoresha ingufu n’ubwenge n’ubumenyi bwawe kugira ngo ibyo usabwa bigerweho. Ni igihe cyanshimishije cyane n’ubu kikinshimisha kuko ni cyo gihe ubyuka buri munsi uzi ko ikintu cyose uri bukore, ingamba zose ufata, biragira akamaro n’ingaruka ku mubare munini w’abantu.” Nta nzozi zo kujya muri Politiki yabyirukanye Amb. Uwihanganye avuga ko kuva akiri muto atigeze arota kuzajya muri politiki, kuko n’ikimenyimenyi yize ibijyanye n’ubwubatsi, yumva aribyo azakora. Ati “Mvuze ko ndi umwana nashakaga kuzajya muri politiki naba mbeshye. Iyo uri umwana ugiye guhitamo kwiga ibintu by’igifundi, nkanjye nize Civil Engineering no gutunganya imishinga y’ubwubatsi, ubwo nyine uba ushaka kubaka amazu, imihanda n’ibindi.” Amara impungenge urubyiruko rutinya kujya muri politiki, akavuga buri kintu cyose ibamo kandi ariyo ituma amahoro ahinda muri iki gihe mu Rwanda. Ati “Nta mpungenge. Twe twakuriye mu gihugu cyiza, abari urubyiruko mu gihe cyatubanjirije, urugero nka perezida Kagame yayoboye urugamba afite imyaka 33 icyo ni igihe ngezemo ubu. Abantu bari abayobozi bafashije mu rugamba rwo kwibohora bari mu myaka 28 na 30, nibo bafashe iki gihugu […] urumva kuyobora urugamba ni ibintu bikomeye cyane.” Yemeza  ko buri kintu cyose kibaho kigenwa na politiki, abantu bakaba nta hantu bayihungira kubera ko utayikurikiranye ikugiraho ingaruka. Gusa Amb. Uwihanganye avuga hari igihe nawe abantu bajyaga bamubwira ibya politiki akabanza gusa nk’ubyirengagiza. Ati “Umuntu wese arabitinya aba avuga ati ntabwo nshaka kujya muri politiki. N’ubu ndi Ambasaderi cyangwa nkiri n’Umunyamabanga akambwira ngo mwebwe abanyapolitiki nkahita mubwira nti njye sindi we, ariko nkigarura kubera gutinya iryo jambo.”  “Nabyo byarantunguye ariko byanyongereyemo imbaraga kuko bigaragaza icyizere. Kuko iyo uri Ambasaderi uba uhagarariye umukuru w’igihugu muri icyo gihugu ugiyemo, ni ibintu bikomeye cyane. Bigaragaza cya cyizere umukuru w’igihugu akomeje kugirira urubyiruko.” Ifoto ye akiga muri kaminuza ari imbere ya Perezida Kagame Mu 2012 ubwo Perezida Kagame yatahaga inyubako ya KOICA muri Kaminuza Nkuru y’u Rwanda, Uwihanganye ni umwe mu banyeshuri bahagarariye abandi bamurika imishinga yabo, akavuga ko ari ikintu gikomeye cyamubayeho mu buzima bwe. Ati “Guhagarara imbere ya Perezida Kagame si ibintu bisanzwe kuko bisaba kubikorera. Icyo gihe bari bagiye gutaha iriya nzu yitwa KOICA, noneho umukuru w’igihugu ari buze kuyitaha ariko agasura n’abanyeshuri, noneho bafata abanyeshuri bamwe bigaga nk’ibyo nigaga ko dutekereza ibintu dushobora kwereka umukuru w’igihugu bijyanye naho kaminuza igeze.” “Dutegura umushinga w’uko wategura umujyi, turabikora mu ishuri ariko bavuga ko hagomba kubaho umuntu ubisobanura, baza guhitamo njye kuko nari nsanzwe nkora kuri radio nyobora n’ibirori. Tuzi ibintu bikomeye umukuru w’igihugu yakoze, guhagarara imbere ye umusobanurira uba wumva ari ikintu gikomeye ugezeho mu buzima. Iriya foto ndayibuka nkishima.” Ikintu cya mbere yigiye kuri Perezida Kagame ngo  ‘ni umuntu ukunda abaturage, kureba kure no gutekereza cyane no gukora vuba.’ Inama ye ku rubyiruko ni ukubaho mu buzima bufite intego kuko iyo ufite intego wirinda kurangara, ukagira ikinyabupfura, gukunda igihugu no kumenya ko kikureba, gukora neza kandi uhanga udushya no kumenya kwiyakira no kumenya uko witwara mu gihe hari icyo wagezeho. Amb. Uwihanganye yavukiye mu karere ka Gatsibo ahitwa Ngarama mu 1987, mu muryango w’abahinzi. Yize amashuri abanza ku ishuri rya Ngarama, ayisumbuye ayiga mu iseminari nto yo ku Rwesero, akomereza muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda ndetse yiga icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza mu Bwongereza.

title: Karahanyuze! Urukundo rwagurumanye mu byamamare rukaza gukendera
content:
Bajya bavuga ko urukundo ari nk’ibisazi kuko akenshi umuntu ashobora gukora ibyo atatekerejeho kubera gutwarwa narwo ntiyite ku maso y’imbaga imureba. Muri make rukoresha byinshi! Rurihangana rukagira neza, ntirugira ishyari, ntirwirarira, ntirwihimbaza, ntirukora ibiteye isoni, ntirushaka ibyarwo, ntiruhutiraho, ntirutekereza ikibi ku bantu, ntirwishimira gukiranirwa kw’abandi ahubwo rwishimira ukuri, rubabarira byose, rwizera byose, rwiringira byose, rwihanganira byose. Aya ni amwe mu magambo ari mu rwandiko Intumwa y’Imana Pawulo yandikiye Abanyekorinto igaragaza ko ku Isi nta kiruta urukundo. Ku byamamare cyane abahanzi usanga iyo akundana n’umuntu amukomoraho inganzo akisanga ibihangano bimwe bitangiye kuva mu marangamutima afitiye umukunzi we. Kubera kugira agatubutse ibyamamare urukundo rurabiryohera kuko impano, gusohokana uwo bakundana, kumuryoshyaryoshya mu buryo bwose bidasiba iyo urukundo rugishyushye. Mu Isi y’urukundo rwabo usanga umunyenga n’uburyohe bwarwo bitamara kabiri! Abari bararohamye mu nyanja y’urukundo bateranaga imitoma umunsi ku wundi ugasanga batandukanye nabi.
IGIHE yakusanyije urutonde rw’ibyamamare bitandukanye byo mu Rwanda byubatse izina, ariko byagiye bitandukanye nabo bakundana urukundo rwabo ntirurambe. Active Love Mu 2016 abasore bagize  itsinda rya  Active bahiriwe n’urukundo rwa ba Nyampinga, kuva kuri Derek wababimburiye akundana na Miss Sandra Teta, Olivis akurikiraho ari kumwe Miss Uwase Vanessa na Mugiraneza Thierry [Tizzo] aza kwijajara akundana na  Hitayezu Belyse witabiriye  Miss Rwanda 2014 na Miss Rwanda 2015. Nyamara ibyishimo by’aba basore bose ntibyarambye kuko Vanessa yabenze Olivis akamwita umwana, Derek agakurikiraho nawe agatandukana na Miss Sandra Teta naho urukundo rwa Tizzo narwo rukagenda nyomberi. Safi Madiba na Parfine mu munezero utararambye Urukundo rwa Safi na Parfine rwatangiye kuvugwa muri Gashyantare 2015, bombi babanje kubyamaganira kure bakavuga ko ‘ari inshuti zisanzwe’. Ahari umuriro haboneka umwotsi nk’uko Safi yabiririmbye, nyuma babitangaza byeruye. Umutesi Parfine yakundanye na Safi akiri umugore w’Umusuwisi Blaise Pistoletti bafitanye abana babiri b’abakobwa. Muri Kanama 2017 Safi Madiba yatandukanye na Parfine, icyo gihe yabwiye IGIHE ko mu byatumye batandukana ku isonga haza intera ndende yabaga hagati yabo bigatuma urukundo rusinzira. Yagize ati “Ntabwo ari ikintu kimwe cyadutandukanyije ariko ibyanjye na Parfine byararangiye, ntabwo byashobotse ko dukomezanya. Ndumva hashize amezi abiri dutandukanye, ndi njye nyine. Icyadutandukanyije rero si kimwe, icya mbere ni uko twabaga mu bihugu bitandukanye aba mu Busuwisi nkaba mu Rwanda, kubonana byaratugoraga, kuba kure ye ntibyanyoroheraga na we ni uko.” Mu mezi yabanjirije gutandukana kwa Safi na Parfine, uyu muhanzi yari yavuze ko bateganya kurushingana bidatinze, ubukwe ntibwatashye ahubwo hahise hasohoka inkuru yo gutandukana kwabo. Ubu Safi ni umugabo wa Niyonizera bakoze ubukwe ku wa 1 Ukwakira 2017. Urukundo rwa Riderman na Asinah Asinah yakundanye na Riderman imyaka umunani batandukana bitunguranye mu ntangiriro za 2015 ndetse uyu muraperi ahita ashinga urugo n’undi mukobwa witwa Miss Agasaro Nadia. Kuva mu Ugushyingo 2008 Riderman na Asinah ntibarekuranaga, bagendaga bafatanye agatoki ku kandi. Amafoto yabo n’inkuru zabo byacicikanaga ubutitsa mu itangazamakuru bigashengura Nazil wo muri Family Squad wahoze akundana na Asinah. Mu  2012, Nadia wigaga mu mashuri yisumbuye i Rubavu we n’umuryango we bari bagituye i Musanze ari naho yamenyaniye na M Izzo [wari inshuti magara ya Riderman]. Ubumwe bwa M Izzo na Nadia bwagiye bukura kugeza ubwo bimutse bakaza gutura i Kigali. Bageze mu Murwa wa Kigali, Nadia yatangiye gusurana na M Izzo uyu musore aza no kumuhuza na Riderman. Ahagana mu mpera za 2014 ngo Asinah yatangiye gushyira igitutu ku musore amubwira ko bagomba kurushinga undi akabyima amatwi akikomereza imishinga ye y’umuziki no kwita kuri Nadia we. Mu ntangiriro za 2015, Nadia Agasaro yasamye inda ya Riderman ihita ihinduka ipfundo ryababoshye bombi umusore abura amahitamo yiyemeza kumurongora. Mu nkuru z’urukundo mu byamamare iya Riderman na Asinah n’ubu ijya ivugwa kubera uburyo aba bombi bakundanaga benshi bazi bazanarushinga. Nyuma yo gutandukandana na Riderman, Asinah yavuzweho gukundana n’abasore barimo uw’umuzungu bacuditse umwaka ushize bagatandukana bamaranye igihe gito ndetse na Michael Sarpong ukinira Rayon Sports. Nizzo na Yvette Nshimiyimana Muhamed uzwi nka Nizzo mu itsinda rya Urban Boyz, ni umwe mu byamamare byagiye bikundana n’abakobwa benshi abazwi harimo Sacha Kate, Anita Pendo, Jessica Mwiza, Bonne na Yvette Umulisa. Uyu Umulisa Yvette niwe mukobwa uzwi uheruka mu rukundo na Nizzo, bakundanye mu gihe cy’imyaka itanu urukundo rwabo rugera ku iherezo mu 2017. Kuri Instagram Nizzo yakundaga kwandikaho amagambo y’urukundo aherekejwe n’udufoto tw’uyu wari umukunzi we amwereka ko amukumbuye mu buryo bukomeye ndetse yanakundaga kuvuga ko azamurongora nyagasani nakomeza urukundo rwabo. Nubwo hari intera nini hagati y’u Rwanda n’u Bushinwa, Nizzo we yagaragaza ko ‘kure y’amaso atari kure y’umutima’. Nizzo yahamyaga ko Umulisa ari we mukunzi we w’ibihe byose ndetse agashimangira ko ‘yamwihebeye’ kugeza umunsi bazatandukanywa n’urupfu. Muri Mutarama 2017, Umulisa yaje mu Rwanda mu biruhuko ndetse yagiye agaragara kenshi ari mu byishimo na Nizzo. Mu mezi abiri yahamaze bagiye basohokana kenshi gusa mu minsi isatira umusozo w’ibiruhuko ibyabo byajemo gishegesha, umukobwa amaze kurira indege imusubiza mu Bushinwa Nizzo yahise ahanagura amafoto ye yose nk’ikimenyetso cy’uko ishyamba atari ryeru. Nizzo n’uyu mukobwa ngo bamaranye imyaka itanu bakundana. Bivuze ko binjiye mu rukundo nyuma ya  2011 uyu musore agitandukana na Anita Pendo bakundanaga muri icyo gihe. Nyuma ya Anita, nta wundi mukobwa Nizzo yigeze agaragaza ko bari kumwe usibye uyu. Anita Pendo na Ndanda Anita Pendo na Ndanda Alphonse byatangiye guhwihwiswa ko bakundana mu mpera za 2016 gusa baza kubihamya mu 2017. Icyo gihe hari n’amakuru avuga ko Anita yagiye kwerekana umugabo iwabo bakaba bari baranatangiye kunoza gahunda y’ubukwe. Mu Ukwakira 2018, Nzeyimana Ndanda Alphonse wari umunyezamu wa AS Kigali, yahishuye ko iby’urukundo rwe na Anita Pendo bimaze igihe byarahagaze. Aba bombi bafitanye abana babiri b’abahungu, umukuru yitwa Tiran uwo baheruka kwibaruka akitwa Ryan. Bajya kwibaruka umwana wa mbere babanaga mu nzu imwe ku Gisozi, gusa mu ntangiro za 2018  baratandukanye ariko babigira ubwiru kuko iyo babibazwaga babyamaganiraga kure. Anita yacaga amarenga y’uko batandukanye kuko amagambo yari yaranditse kuri Instagram agaragaza ko ari umugore wa Ndanda yaje kuyasiba yandikaho ko ari ‘Single Mum’ bishatse kuvuga ko yari asigaye yiyumva nk’umugore utabana n’umugabo. Batandukana, Ndanda  yanditse amagambo ashimangira ko yaciye ukubiri na Anita Pendo, gusa bakaba baririnze kubishyira mu itangazamakuru kuko byari guhungabanya ubuzima bw’uyu mugore wendaga kwibaruka ubuheta. Mu mafoto abiri y’urukurikirane yashyize ku rubuga rwa Instagram, Ndanda yabanje kwandika avuga ngo ‘Ceceka ntukibeshye’, ahandi ati ‘Reka guta igihe cyawe’. Arangije akurikizaho amagambo asobanura ko ibye na Anita Pendo bimaze igihe byarahwekereye. Ati “Amaso yanjye ari kuri Tiran na Ryan, ibindi abantu bibwira nibyo bibeshyera si byo. Abambaza murekere aho ndabinginze, abanyandikira babimbaza ukuri kwabyo ni uko ntabana nawe [Anita Pendo] ntuye Kacyiru agatura Remera”. Kimenyi na Diddy D’or Urukundo rw’aba bombi rwatangiye gusakara cyane mu 2018 ahantu hose bagendana bafatanye agatoki ku kandi ndetse banaterana imitoma ku mbuga nkoranyambaga mu buryo bukomeye. Amagambo ahehereye n’imitoma byarangiye muri Kamena uyu mwaka nyuma yaho muri Mata ku mbuga nkoranyambaga hasakaye amashusho y’Umunyezamu wa mbere w’Ikipe y’Igihugu ‘Amavubi’ n’ikipe ya Rayon Sports , Kimenyi Yves, amugaragaza ari mu bwogero yambaye ubusa bigaragara ko ari nk’umuntu baganiraga bifashishije uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga ry’amashusho. Icyo gihe Didy D’Or, yatangiye kugenda asiba amafoto ya Kimenyi Yves yari ari ku rukuta rwe rwa Instagram biza kurangira yose ayamazeho. Ubu Kimenyi Yves bivugwa ko akundanye uruzira imbereka na Muyango Uwase Claudine wabaye nyampinga uberwa n’amafoto muri Miss Rwanda 2019. DJ Pius na Ange Umulisa Mu 2018 nibwo hasakaye amakuru avuga ko Ange Umulisa wahoze ari umugore w’umuhanzi Rickie Pius Rukabuza uzwi nka Deejay Pius yahukanye nyuma y’uko urugo rwabo rwari rumaze iminsi rurimo umwuka mubi. Aba bombi bakundanye bahuriye mu kabari aho DJ Pius yakoraga akazi ko kuvanga imiziki naho Ange ari ‘MC’. Urukundo rwabo rwagiye rukura kugeza bakoze ubukwe, basezeranye  kubana akaramata muri Werurwe 2014. Banafitanye umwana w’umuhungu witwa Yuhi Abriel Rukabuza. Ubu asigaye abana na nyina. Amakuru y’indunduro y’urugo rwa DJ  Pius na Ange Umulisa yatangiye gucaracara mu ntangiro za 2018, ubwo uyu mugabo yifataga agasiba amafoto hafi ya yose ahuriramo na Ange yari ku rubuga rwe rwa Instagram ndetse n’umugore bikaba uko. Hari hashize iminsi bumvikanye mu itangazamakuru  bavuga ko umubano wabo udashobora gucikamo igikuba kuko bakundana bitari iby’agahararo, mu 2016 Dj Pius yigeze gutangaza ko ajya ashwana n’umugore we bapfuye umuziki ariko bakabihosha nk’abantu bakuru. Batandukana, Ange yataye umugabo  mu nzu babagamo i Kanombe ajya kubana n’umwana we mu Karere ka Kicukiro. Uncle Austin Mu 2018 nibwo umuhanzi akaba n’Umunyamakuru Tosh Luwano [Uncle Austin] yatandukanye  na Mwiza Joannah bari bamaze igihe gito babana, nyuma yo gutandukana na Ingabire  Liliane bari barasezeranye mu 2006 banafitanye umwana mukuru ufite imyaka 13 bagatandukana mu 2015. Uncle Austin na  Mwiza Joannah yari yarashatse bwa kabiri umubano warahagaze ndetse buri umwe ahita yihutira gusiba amafoto bari bahuriyeho ku rubuga rwa Instagram. Uyu mugabo yanajyaga yifuriza umugore we isabukuru nziza yizihiza kuwa 5  Ugushyingo akamutaka akavuga ko amukunda bitari agahararo ariko bagitandukana , Uncle Austin yararuciye ararumira ntiyongera kujya abikora. Muyoboke na Muhimpundu Mu 2015 nibwo Muyoboke Alex na Muhayimpundu Ornella batandukanye. Aba bombi babanye ahagana mu mpera za 2010 basezerana mu 2012. Batandukanye bamaranye imyaka ibiri gusa, umugore amusigira umwana w’umuhungu bafitanye witwa Mwene-Muyoboke Aston undi asubira iwabo i Burundi. Gahongayire na Gahima Aline Gahongayire na Gahima Gabriel bahanye isezerano ryo kubana akaramata ku wa 20 Ukuboza 2013, mu bukwe butazasibangana mu mitwe ya benshi. Nyuma y’amezi atatu hatangiye gukwira inkuru zavugaga ko batandukanye ariko bo baza kubyamaganira kure. Mu 2014 baje kwibaruka imfura yabo bise Ineza ku bw’amahirwe make ahita yitaba Imana. Nyuma y’amezi make hongeye gukwira inkuru zivuga ko batandukanye, icyo gihe umugabo yavugaga ko iby’urukundo rwabo abona bitagishobotse. Muri Mutarama 2015 Gahima yashimangiye ko yamaze gutandukana na Gahongayire ubwo yari muri Tanzania. Icyo gihe Gahongayire yaryumyeho avuga ko ‘yabivuze bimucitse’. Muri Nzeri 2016 Aline Gahongayire yagiriye urugendo muri Amerika aza kuvugira kuri Radiyo Ijwi ry’Amerika ko arambiwe kubaho aremerewe. Ati “Impamvu natandukanye na we, ni uko byanze burundu, byaranze ntabwo twumvikanye, ntabwo turi abanzi ariko ntabwo twumvikanye.” Yongeyeho ko ibyo gushaka umugabo kuri we ubu atari ikintu cyihutirwa. Ati “Ntabwo ndi mubi Imana izampa undi, nzabona undi mugabo ntabwo nzakomeza kubaho gutya. Undi mugabo nzamushaka, ko nkiri muto se! […] Nkeneye kubyara, nkeneye kuba nyina w’amahanga, humura undi mugabo nzamushaka, nako ntabwo nzamushaka azanshaka." Ku wa Kabiri tariki ya 28 Ugushyingo umwaka ushize Gahongayire na Gahima bahawe gatanya isesuye n’Urukiko rw’ibanze rwa Kacyiru. Uwera Dalila na Dirk Mu 2017 nibwo Uwera Dalila wabaye Nyampinga w’u Rwanda mu 1994 yahamije ko agiye gukora ubukwe ku nshuro ya kabiri nyuma y’igihe gito cyari gishize bimenyekanye ko yatandukanye n’uwari umugabo we witwa Dirk. Kuwa 27 Ukuboza 2013 nibwo Umubiligi Dirk yatanze inkwano mu muryango wa Miss Uwera baranasezerana, ibirori byabereye i Nyarutarama muri The Manor. Bafitenye umwana w’umukobwa. Uwera Dalila na Dirk batandukanye nyuma y’imyaka umunani yari ishize bari mu rukundo gusa bari bamaze itatu barushinze. Yavuze ko afite undi mukunzi mushya na we w’Umubiligi ndetse ngo baritegura gukora ubukwe. Frank Joe na Melanie Gale Mu 2015 nibwo hasakaye inkuru ivuga ko Frankie Joe yatandukanye na Melanie Gale wari umugore we ku mpamvu itarigeze imenyekana. Frankie Joe na Melanie Gale barushinze mu 2009. Ku wa 13 Gashyantare 2011, bibarutse umuhungu wamwita Taye Rukundo. Aba bombi buri wese yaciye inzira ze, bahuzwa n’umwana babyaranye. Kuri ubu Frank Joe atuye ahitwa Calgary muri Canada. Shaddy  Boo na Meddy Saleh Mu 2016 nibwo Producer Meddy Saleh uri  mu bakora amashusho y’indirimbo mu Rwanda, hasakaye amakuru y’uko yatandukanye  n’umugore we bari bamaze kubyarana abana babiri.  Yari yarashakanye Shaddy Boo ubu uri mu b’igitsinagore barangamiwe cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Mu ntangiriro za 2016 byatangiye kunugwanugwa ko Meddy Saleh n’umugore we bari gushaka gatanya nk’umuti w’ibyo batumvanyeho nyuma yo kurushinga. Bivugwa ko muri Gashyantare 2016, Shaddy Boo  ngo yasize Meddy mu nzu babanagamo i Nyamirambo ajya gutura ku Kacyiru hafi y’Akarere ka Gasabo n’abana be. Icyo gihe Meddy Saleh yahakaniye kure iby’iyi nkuru yavugaga ko yatandukanye n’umugore we ndetse avuga ko nta muntu ukwiye kubyinjiramo kuko ari ubuzima bwe bwite, gusa aza kwemeza ko batakibana. Ama G The Black na Rosine Muri Gicurasi 2017, nibwo Hakizimana Amani wiyise AmaG The Black yatangaje ko yamaze gutandukana n’umugore we nyuma y’imyaka ibiri yari ishize babana mu nzu nk’umugabo n’umugore. Uyu muraperi wakunzwe mu ndirimbo ‘Care’, ‘Uruhinja’ n’izindi yabwiye IGIHE ko umubano yari amaze igihe afitanye n’umugore we witwa Rosine wamaze gusenyuka burundu.
Yagize ati “Ibyo byamaze kurangira, njye na we ntabwo tukiri kumwe. Ndi mu buzima bwanjye na we ari mu buzima bwe, bibaho ntabwo twabashije gukomezanya.” Ama G The Black icyo gihe yahamirije IGIHE ko hari hashize amezi ane atandukanye na Rosine gusa yirinda kuvuga mu buryo bweruye icyabaye intandaro yo gutandukana kwabo. Nyuma yo gutandukana n’umugore we, Ama G The Black yahise akora ubukwe  n’undi witwa  Uwase Liliane, bwabaye ku itariki ya 24 Ukuboza 2017. Ama-G na Rosine bari bafitanye umwana w’umuhungu bise Shami [uyu yajyanye na nyina]. Ibyo kubana kwabo mu nzu byatangiye kuvugwa muri Mutarama 2015, nyuma batangaje ko bagombaga gukora ubukwe mu ntangiriro za Gashyantare 2015, mu 2017 urukundo rwabo rugera ku iherezo. Jay Polly na Nirere Afsa (Fify) Jay Polly ni umwe mu baraperi bakunzwe cyane mu myaka myinshi  ishize. Mu 2013 yabanye n’umukobwa wari uzwi nka Fify ndetse banabyarana umwana w’umuhungu. Ariko urukundo rwabo rwaje gushonga Jay Polly yishumbusha Sharifa wari uzwi mu mashusho y’indirimbo ya Urban Boys yitwa ‘Ancilla’. Jay Polly na Sharifa bafitanye umwana w’umukobwa. Platini na Diane Mu 2017 nibwo Nemeye Platini, uri mu bagize itsinda rya Dream Boys yatandukanye na Ingabire Diane bari bamaze imyaka ine bakundana ndetse binavugwa ko bitegura kurushinga. Platini na Diane bari bamaze imyaka isaga ine bakundana, mu bitaramo bitandukanye umusore yitabiraga babaga bafatanye agatoki ku kandi, bari kumwe no mu bukwe bwa Knowless na Clement. Urwari rwaratumye Ingabire Diane yongera izina rya Platini mu yo yakoreshaga ku mbuga nkoranyambaga akiyita Nemeye Diane, rwatangiye gushonga mu Ugushyingo 2016, umukobwa asiba amafoto yose y’umusore yari yarashyize kuri Instagram. Ku wa 5 Mutarama 2017, Ingabire Diane ni bwo yerekanye undi musore witwa Rutayisire uba muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika yasimbuje Platini, yashyizeho ifoto y’uyu musore ayiherekeza ikimenyetso cy’umutima. Yongeye gushyira kuri Instagram indi foto y’uyu musore basigaye bakundana anavuga ko ari we ’byishimo bye’. Mu butumwa uyu musore yanditse kuri ayo mafoto yunganira Diane, yavuze ko amukunda birenze ibindi bintu byose n’andi magambo aryohereye agaragaza urukundo hagati ya bombi, n’ubwo nabo urwabo rwashonze rutamaze igihe. Iby’urukundo hagati ya Platini na Diane byatangiye kunugwanugwa no kuvugwa cyane mu itangazamakuru mu 2013, bakomeje kubigira ubwiru no kuterura ngo bavuge ku bijyanye n’umubano wabo. Itangazamakuru ryakomeje kuboga runono kugeza mu 2014 ubwo Platini yemeje ko afite umukunzi mushya yasimbuje umuhanzi Rozy bakundanye bakiga mu yahoze ari Kaminuza Nkuru y’u Rwanda. Young Grace na Piqué Umuraperikazi Abayizera Marie Grace [Young Grace] yatangiye kugaragaza ibimenyetso by’urukundo rwe na Rwabuhihi Hubert [Piqué]; ubwo yari mu irushanwa rya Primus Guma Guma Super Star 2018. Nyuma uyu musore aza kumwambika impeta y’urukundo amusaba ko bazarushinga bakabana nk’umugabo n’umugore, ndetse aherutse kwibaruka umwana bivugwa ko babyaranye. Ariko, urukundo rwabo ntabwo rwarambye kuko muri uyu mwaka bahisemo gutandukana buri wese agaca inzira ye.

title: Menya Graça Machel, wabaye umudamu w’abakuru b’ibihugu bibiri bitandukanye
content: Graça ni umunyapolitiki umaze kubaka izina mu gihugu cye no ku mugabane wa Afurika dore ko yamaze igihe kirenga imyaka 10 ari Minisitiri w’uburezi n’umuco muri Mozambique, akaba yaranakoze nk’impuguke ku bibazo by’abana mu Muryango w’Abibumbye. Ubusanzwe amazina yiswe n’ababyeyi ni Graça Simbine, nyuma yo kuvuka ku wa 17 Ukwakira 1945, Se amaze iminsi 17 yitabye Imana akaba ari umuhererezi mu bana batandatu. Uyu mugore wari usanzwe yitwa Simbine yaje gufata izina rya Machel nyuma yo gushakana n’uwahoze ari umukuru w’igihugu cya Mozambique Samora Machel, ku wa 19 ukwakira 1975 nyuma y’amezi atatu uyu mugabo agejeje iki gihugu ku bwigenge. Nyuma y’imyaka 11 bari bamaze babana nk’umugore n’umugabo, ku wa 19 Ukwakira mu 1986 Samora Machel yaje kwitaba Imana azize impanuka y’indege yabereye mu misozi ya Lebombo ku mupaka wa Mozambique na Afurika y’Epfo bituma Graça ahabwa akazina ka Jackie Kennedy wa Afurika. Ibi byatewe n’uko Jackie Kennedy yari umugore w’uwahoze ari umukuru w’igihugu wa Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika, bakaba bari bahuje ibyago byo gupfusha abagabo bakiri ku butegetsi. Samola Machel yasigiye Graça abana babiri ari bo Josina na Malengane Nyuma y’urupfu rwa Samora Machel, Graça yamaze imyaka itanu yambara imyenda yirabura nk’uburyo bwo kunamira umugabo we. Mu 1998, mu birori by’ibanga Graça yashyingiranywe na Nelson Mandela wayoboye Afurika y’Epfo akaza kwitaba Imana mu 2013, bimugira umugore wa gatatu w’uyu mukambwe nyuma ya Evelyn Wase na Winnie Mandela anafata izina ‘Mandela’ guhera ubwo yitwa ‘Graca Machel Mandela’. Ibitangazamakuru byagarutse cyane ku rukundo rwa Mandela na Graca Machel, kubera ikinyuranyo cy’imyaka cyarimo hagati yabo dore ko Mandela icyo gihe yari afite imyaka 80, Graça akagira 52. Graça aganira n’ikinyamakuru The Guardian yavuze ko iki kinyuranyo ntacyo cyari kimutwaye. Yagize ati “Ntago byari ikibazo. Nari nishimiye gushyingiranwa nawe, twari dukuze, dutuje kandi tuzi agaciro k’urushako n’umufasha”. Ku wa 5 Ukuboza mu 2013 nibwo Nelson Mandela yitabye Imana, Graça apfakara kabiri. Yasangije ikinyamakuru The Guardian iby’agahinda yatewe no gupfakara kabiri. Yagize ati “Niba ushobora kwiyumvisha uburyo miliyoni z’abantu bafashe iki gihombo, ubwo ushobora kumva icyo bivuze kuri njye, kuhaba kwe, kuzuza buri gice cy’ubuzima bwanjye, buri gace k’ubuzima bwanjye arimo none ubu ni uburibwe, ubu icyo gice kirimo ubusa kandi kiri gushakisha, kugeza n’aho wishaka ubwawe. Wiyumva nk’aho nawe muri wowe hari icyahindutse kuko ibi ntibyakubaho ngo ugume uko wari umeze”. Graça yabaye hafi ya Mandela no mu burwayi bwe kugeza yitabye Imana. Graça yagiye ahabwa ibihembo bitandukanye ku rwego rwa Afurika n’Isi muri rusange birimo nk’icyitwa World’s Children’s Prize yahawe muri 2005.

title: Zimwe mu nama zagufasha kubana neza n’umukoresha wawe uramutse uzikurikije
content: Abahanga mu by’imibanire y’abantu hari inama batanga ku cyo wakora ngo ubane neza n’umukoresha wawe. Umukoresha wawe uyu munsi ashobora kuba umuntu w’ingenzi mu buzima bwawe bwose kabone niyo wamukorera icyumweru kimwe cyangwa ukaba umaze imyaka 10 utakimukorera, kuko ni henshi ushobora gukenera ko akwandikira ibaruwa ihamya ko wamukoreye, kandi wakoraga neza. Urumva ko mu gihe umubano wanyu waba wararanzwe no kutumvikana mu gihe wamukoreraga, byagorana ko aguha iki cyangombwa kandi wenda cyari iki ngenzi kuri wowe. Hifashishijwe ibitekerezo by’abahanga mu by’imibanire y’abantu, IGIHE yaguteguriye inama zikubiye mu ngingo esheshatu zagufasha kurushaho kubana neza n’umukoresha wawe ntawe ubangamiye undi. Ntuzategereze gushimwa Gukora ugamije gushimwa bituma umukoresha akubona nk’umuntu udakuze cyangwa utazi icyo ashaka kuko ntiyumva impamvu umuntu akwiye kugushimira gukora neza akazi kawe. Gukora utegerejwe gushimwa bituma uhangayika igihe ntawagushimye ukumva ko wenda ushobora kuba utakoze neza nk’uko bisanzwe nyamara wenda ntacyahindutse. Mutange kugera mu kazi Abakoresha benshi bavuga ko bishimisha kugera mu kazi buri munsi usanga umukozi wawe yahagutanze. Uku kugera mu kazi bituma umukoresha akubona nk’ukuboko kwe kw’iburyo ndetse kubera imirimo myinshi agira akaba yakwizera akakubona nk’umuntu ushobora kumufasha imwe muri yo kuko akubona nk’umuntu ugira gahunda. Si ngombwa ko uba inshuti magara n’umukoresha wawe Umukoresha ntakeneye kumenya byinshi mu buzima bwawe bwite nk’ibyo inshuti zawe zizi, ndetse ntuzigere umusaba ubucuti ku mbuga nkoranyambaga nka Facebook kereka ari we ubikoze. Kuko biba byiza iyo umubano wawe n’umukoresha wawe ugumye mu mbibi z’akazi kwirinda ko agira byinshi amenya mu buzima bwawe bwite bizagufasha gukora akazi kawe neza kuko baravunga ngo ‘abagira ibyo bapfana nibo bagira ibyo bapfa’. Emera ko umukoresha wawe agukuriye Umwanditsi w’ibitabo akaba n’umunyamakuru McIntyre, yagize icyo avuga ku cyubahiro umukozi agomba umukoresha we. Ati “Ibi ntibivuze ko ugomba kumwubaha we nk’umuntu ariko ni ngombwa ko umwubahira urwego arimo”. Ushobora kubona umukoresha wawe yitwara mu buryo butakunyuze ndetse bushobora gutuma utamwubaha rimwe na rimwe gusa ibuka ko ari umukoresha wawe kandi iby’imyitwarire ye atari wowe bireba, ibi bizakurinda kurenga imbibi. Mwereke ko uri uwo kwizerwa Umukoresha wawe ntashobora kuba ahantu hose icyarimwe, ugomba kumubera ijisho waba hari amakuru y’ingenzi ufite ku bijyanye n’akazi ukayamubwira kabone n’ubwo yaba atari meza, kandi wirinde amanyanga ayo ari yo yose mu kazi yatuma atakugirira icyizere. Wikwijujutira amategeko atanga Kimwe mu bintu bizatuma umukoresha wawe agutakariza icyizere ni ukumenya ko wijujutira uburyo ayobora, biba bibi iyo utabimwibwirira ahubwo ukabivuga hanze mu bandi bakozi, ni byiza ko niba ubona hari ibitagenda ubimubwira amaso ku maso kuruta uko ujya kubibwira abandi.

title: Amagambo ashize ivuga! Indirimbo ziririmbirwa umugeni w’i Gicumbi (Amafoto na Video)
content: Ibirori by’isezerano ryo gushyingirwa akenshi bifatwa nk’imboneka rimwe ku miryango y’abashyingiwe n’abashyingiye dore ko ahenshi aribwo umusore n’umukobwa bemererwa kwitwa umugore n’umugabo ndetse kuva ubwo bakemererwa kubana mu nzu. Ku munsi w’ibirori abafite amikoro bifashisha imodoka zihenze n’izoroheje mu gutwara abageni n’abitabiriye ibirori gusa mu bice by’icyaro ho usanga biba bitoroshye ari nayo mpamvu usanga bahitamo kugenda n’amaguru ndetse ahenshi ugasanga bagira uburyo bagenda baririmba indirimbo zitandukanye iyo bari ku rugendo. Uburyo bwo kwizihiza ibirori butandukana akenshi bitewe n’agace cyangwa akarere ba nyiri ukubikora bavukamo cyangwa babarizwamo. Urugero nko mu bice bitandukanye by’Akarere ka Gicumbi by’umwihariko mu cyaro, usanga ku munsi w’ubukwe umusore abyuka agaherekezwa n’imiryango akajya iwabo w’umukobwa gusaba no gukwa nyuma bakamuha umugeni agahita amufata ukuboko bakerekeza ku rusengero gusezerana imbere y’Imana. Aha ibijyanye no gusezerana mu mategeko, ibyitwa gutera igikumwe biba byarabaye mbere. Ahagana saa saba n’igice z’igicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 22 Kanama 2019, mu muhanda unyura mu Murenge wa Nyankenke werekeza ku rusengero rwa EAR Paruwasi Rugambwa, byari ibirori n’ibyishimo bidasanzwe ku bari baherekeje Iyamuremye Théophile na Ukobukeye bagiye guhamya isezerano ryabo imbere y’Imana n’abantu. Iyamuremye na Ukobukeye bari basanzwe babana dore ko banafitanye abana batatu gusa nk’uko abo basengana babibwiye IGIHE ngo iyo bagiye gusezerana bitwa ‘Abagarukiramana’. Ubwo bari mu muhanda bajya gusezerana bagendaga baririmba indirimbo itangaje aho bagendaga bavuga ngo “Birabaye, birabaye weee... Amagambo ashize ivuga we, birabaye...! Bamwe mu batashye ubu bukwe babwiye IGIHE ko ari ibisanzwe mu muco wabo ko iyo baherekeje umugeni agiye gushyingirwa cyangwa bagiye guhamya isezerano bagenda bamuririmbira. Bizimana Aimable utuye mu Mudugudu wa Nturo, Akagari ka Yaramba mu Murenge wa Nyankenke yavuze ko “kuririmba kuriya ni ibyishimo by’ubukwe, kandi ni ibisanzwe mu muco wacu.” Amafoto: Himbaza Pacifique Video: Kazungu Armand

title: Bimwe mu bimenyetso byakwereka ko umugabo wawe aryamana na bagenzi be
content: Susan ni umugore w’imyaka 51 wo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, yasangije ikinyamakuru Huffington Post uko yamenye ko umugabo bari bamaze imyaka 10 babana yaje gusanga ari umutinganyi. Ati “Mu gihe kigera kumyaka 10 tubana, naketse ko haba hari umubano wihariye afitanye n’undi mugore kuko namwumvise avugira kuri telefoni ibijyanye no kubyina mu kabari, gusa nza kumva ijwi ni iry’umugabo. Ijoro rimwe twagiye mu karuhuko turi kunywa mbimubazaho, yansubije ko buri gihe abona abagabo bamukurura.” Ugendeye ku buhamya bwa Susan bigaragara ko muri iyi minsi bisigaye bigoranye kumenya uwo umugabo wawe ashobora kuba agirana na we umubano werekeye ku mibonano mpuzabitsina, kuko ushobora gukeka umugore ugasanga ni umugabo. Ibi ni bimwe mu bimenyetso bishobora kukwereka ko umugabo wawe cyangwa umuhungu mukundana ashobora kuba akunda abagabo bagenzi be. Ntashamadukira abandi bakobwa Kubona umuhungu mukundana cyangwa umugabo wawe adashamadukira kureba abandi bakobwa cyangwa abagore, ushobora kumva ko ari byiza, aguhesha ishema, gusa ibi iyo bikabije ntibiba bisanzwe. Abagabo benshi birasanzwe ko baragarira umuntu w’igitsina gore cyane iyo ari mwiza cyangwa yambaye imyenda igaragaza uko ateye. Nubona umuhungu mukundana, umukobwa nk’uyu amunyuzeho bigasa nk’aho atanamubonye, uzamenye ko bidasanzwe. Arangarira abagabo Umuhanga mu by’imitekerereze Joe Kort yavuze ko uburyo bwiza bwo gupima ibi ari igihe muri ku mucanga (beach). Uyu muhanga yavuze ko abagabo batari abatinganyi, igihe muri ku mazi barangarira abagore ndetse ukagira ngo ntibabona ko hari abagabo bahari, mu gihe abatinganyi bo bahanga amaso abagabo bahari gusa, bakabikora mu buryo bagerageza kubihisha? Yanga abatinganyi Nubona umuhungu mukundana cyangwa umugabo wawe agirira urwango abatinganyi cyangwa akakubwira ko atabishimira, bishobora kuba ikimenyetso cy’uko na we ari we, urwango abagiririra akaba ari nk’uburyo bwo kwirwanaho ngo hatagira ucyeka ko ari we.

title: Ibyo wagenderaho uhitamo umuntu mwiza uzagusigaranira abana umaze gupfa
content: Ibyiyumviro ko umunsi umwe ushobora kwitaba Imana ugasiga utareze abana bawe nk’uko wabishakaga, cyane mu gihe waba ubasize bakiri bato birababaza, gusa n’iby’ingenzi ko wakora inyandiko yemeza umuntu wifuza ko yazarera abana bawe mu gihe wowe n’uwo mwashakanye mutakiriho kuruta ko urukiko ari rwo rwazagena ubarera. Hifashishijwe ibitekerezo by’abanyamategeko batandukanye bagejeje ku kinyamakuru Huffpost, ibi ni bimwe mu bibazo ukwiye kwibaza mu gihe urimo gufata umwanzuro ku uzarera abana bawe udahari. Ese abana bazimurwa? Ushobora kuba ufite inshuti n’abavandimwe hafi mu gihugu hose ndetse no ku Isi muri rusange, ibi bishobora kukubera ikibazo mu gihe uri guhitamo uzabana n’abana bawe mu gihe udahari. Umunyamategeko witwa Ann Margaret Carozza yavuze ko biba byiza igihe uhisemo umuntu uzakomeza kurerera abana bawe aho babaga. Ati “Nagira inama ababyeyi b’abana bakiri mu mashuri guhitamo umuntu  utazahindura  aho abana babaga, sosiyete babagamo ndetse n’amashuli bigagamo”. Ibi bizatuma bakomeza kubana n’inshuti bamenyereye n’ahantu bamenyereye bityo bibafashe. Bafite imyaka ingahe? Ni byiza ko utekereza ku myaka y’uwo uhisemo gusigira abana bawe ugendeye kuyo nabo bafite. Umunyamategeko Laurie Giles avuga ko imyaka ari ingenzi mu guhitamo uzarera abana bawe. Ati “Hitamo uzaba umubyeyi mwiza ku mwana wawe, niba ubu afite imyaka 65 akaba ari umubyeyi ushoboye mu gihe umwana wawe akiri muto, ibaze niba igihe azaba afite imyaka 78 azaba akiri umubyeyi ushoboye kurera ingimbi cyangwa umwangavu”. Ese duhuje indangagaciro? Ikintu gihangayikisha ababyeyi benshi ni ukumenya niba abo bazasigira abana babo bazakomeza kubarera mu murongo w’indangagaciro babatoje. Carozza avuga ko ari ingenzi guhitamo umuntu ubona mujya guhuza indangagaciro ngo azabe ari we usigarana abana bawe. Ati “Ushobora kumva utanejejwe n’uko uzasigarana abana bawe mudahuje imyemerere n’indangagaciro niyo mpamvu ukwiye kureba niba muhuje uburyo bwo kurera”. Ese bazi gucunga amafaranga? Ni byiza kureba niba umuntu wemeje ko azasigarana abana bawe afite ubushobozi bwo gucunga amafaranga neza, cyane cyane mu gihe waba hari ayo ubasigiye ngo azabafashe. Umunyamategeko Carrozza ati “Urugero umuvandimwe wanjye ni umuntu wujuje ibindi byose ariko iyo bije ku mafaranga biba ikibazo, nshobora ku mugira uzasigarana abana banjye ariko ngahitamo undi uzagena uko amafaranga yabo akoreshwa”. Ese babanye gute n’abana ? Ni byiza ko uhitamo umuntu usanzwe afite uburyo bwiza abanyemo n’abana bawe ndetse bamwishyikiraho. Iyi ngingo yemezwa n’amagambo yavuzwe n’umunyamategeko Katie De Leon wagize ati “Ababyeyi b’umugabo wanjye ntibakunze gushyikirana n’umuhungu wacu, niyo mpamvu ababyeyi banjye ari bo bazamusigarana kuko bo babanye neza nawe”. Ese ni ngombwa ko aba uwo mu muryango? Ababyeyi benshi bumva ko ari ngombwa ko abana bazasigaranwa n’umuntu wa hafi mu muryango gusa ibi si ngombwa cyane buri gihe. Ashley Robinett yemeza ko buri gihe umuryango atari abo muhuje amaraso cyane ko we yahisemo ko inshuti y’umugabo we n’umugore we ari bo bamurera abana igihe yaba atagihari kubera ubushobozi ababonamo mu kurera, urukundo ndetse n’ubushobozi bafite mu gukoresha amafaranga. Ese arabishaka? Iyi n’ingingo y’ingenzi kuko n’ingombwa ko uwo ushaka gusigira izo nshingano nawe aba abishaka nk’uko Giles yabivuze. Ati“Si ngombwa ko uhitamo mushiki wawe kuko ari umubyeyi mwiza ku bana be bamaze gukura, kuko ushobora gusanga atagishaka kurera akeneye umwanya wo kujya kwibera ku mucanga”.

title: Imbamutima za Miss Yassipi wayoboye urugamba rw’intore imbere ya Perezida Kagame (Video)
content: Ni imyiyereko igaragaza imyiteguro, amayeri n’ibindi ingabo zifashisha ziri ku rugamba kugira ngo zibashe gutsinsura umwanzi. Urugamba ni kimwe mu bigize imyiyereko izo ntore zeretse Perezida Paul Kagame n’abandi banyacyubahiro bari bitabiriye umuhango wo gusoza ibyumweru bitandatu urwo rubyiruko rwari rumaze rutorezwa mu kigo cy’imyitozo ya gisirikare cya Gabiro mu Karere ka Gatsibo. Yassipi ni umwe mu bakobwa bitabiriye amarushanwa yo gushaka Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2019. Yabaye igisonga cya mbere cya Nyampinga. Mu gihe cy’iminota 13 imyiyereko y’urugamba yamaze, Uwihirwe ni we wari uyoboye urwo rugamba, ayoboye abasirikare b’igihugu cyari cyiswe Rugari, ababwira uburyo bagomba gukoresha ngo batsinde umwanzi bari bahanganye, ni ukuvuga ingabo ziswe ‘Inyangabirama’. Mbere yo gutangira urugamba nyir’izina, Uwihirwe yabanje gusobanurira Perezida Kagame n’abandi banyacyubahiro uko urugamba ruteguye, akomeza abwira abayobozi b’imitwe y’ingabo uko bari bwitware kugeza ubwo urugamba nyir’izina rwatangiraga. Ni ibintu yavugaga adategwa, ku buryo hari abaketse ko asanzwe azi ibijyanye n’igisirikare dore ko byanarangiye ingabo yari ayoboye zitsinze umwanzi. Mu kiganiro uyu mukobwa w’imyaka 19 yahaye IGIHE, yavuze ko ibijyanye n’igisirikare yabimenyeye mu itorero. Kuba yabashije kuyobora neza, Uwihirwe avuga ko ari uko yatojwe neza kandi agashyiraho umuhate. Ati “Navuga ko ari amasomo twigishijwe muri rusange aho tuba dusobanurirwa uburyo urugamba rutegurwa ndetse n’uburyo rushyirwa mu bikorwa. Nyuma yo kubyiga tugenda dukora imyitozo itandukanye bikagera ku munsi nyamukuru wo kuba twabyerekana.” Yakomeje agira ati “Ni ibintu bifata hafi iminota 13 uvuga ibintu ufite mu mutwe, ni akazi navuga ko katoroshye. Bisaba umuhate no kubikora wumva ko ubikunze atari ibintu ukora ngo imyiyerekano irangire.” Uyu mukobwa asanzwe ari umusizi ukomeye mu bijyanye n’imivugo kandi abahimba imivugo bakunze kuba bafite ubushobozi bwo gufata mu mutwe. Abajijwe niba kuba asanzwe ari umusizi hari aho bihuriye no kuba yafashe neza imiyoborere y’urugamba mu mutwe, Yassipi yavuze ko bifitanye isano. Ati “Isano rirahari kuko twari dufite igihe gito ariko ibyo gukora ari byinshi. Bisaba ko hari ukundi kwiyemeza uba ufite haba kubifata mu mutwe, kuba wabivuga imbere y’abantu ntutinye kuvugira mu ruhame.” Kuba ari we watoranyijwe mu bantu bagera kuri 700 ngo azayobore imyiyereko y’urugamba kimwe mu bice bikomeye, Yassipi yavuze ko ari amahirwe akomeye yahawe. Mu mpanuro Perezida Kagame yahaye intore zisoje itorero, yazisabye gukoresha uburere zahawe bugaherekeza ubumenyi zakuye mu ishuri ubundi bagateza igihugu imbere. Ati “Ushobora kujya mu ishuri ukiga ukagira ubumenyi buhanitse byarangiza bigapfa ubusa bigapfira n’igihugu ubusa. Ukiga ukaba umuhanga, ukamenya warangiza kubera ko nta muco, nta burere buhagije, nta kwibaza wowe ubwawe bishingiye kuri ibyo, bya bindi byose ukabihindura ubusa, ukajya mu biyobyabwenge.” Yassipi yavuze ko uburere no gukunda igihugu ari byo azashyira imbere mu buzima asubiyemo. Ati “Hari indangagaciro nyinshi byanyigishije ariko by’umwihariko indangagaciro yo gukunda igihugu no kugikorera tutizigamye. Nzabasha gusobanurira abenshi batazi icyo gukunda igihugu bivuze cyangwa batabiha agaciro nkuko bisabwa.” Uyu mukobwa wazanye n’abandi mu itorero ku wa 24 Kamena 2019, yavuze ko icyabanje kumugora mu byumweru bitandatu yahamaze ari uburyo gahunda zari zipanze, nta mwanya wo gupfa ubusa ariko ngo yaje kubimenyera. Yavuze ko ikintu gitangaje cyamubayeho ari uko buri gihe yikangaga ifirimbi ya mu gitondo ibabyutsa, akenshi agashiduka yikanze ko bayivugije kandi batarayivuza. Yassipi ngo azakumbura morale yo mu itorero dore ko abenshi bari bamaze kumenyerana. Intore zasoje itorero Indangamirwa icyiciro cya 12 ni 698 harimo abakobwa 214 n’abahungu 484. Muri bo 78 baturutse mu bihugu 23 by’amahanga.

title: Mathilda, izina ry’umukobwa uharanira gukemura ibibazo by’abandi
content: Ubusanzwe Mathilda igizwe n’amagambo abiri y’Ikidage ariyo “math’’ na ‘‘hild’’ iyo bihuye bisobanura imbaraga n’ubushobozi. Ni izina ryamamaye cyane muri Denmark mu 2009, riza no muri 20 ya mbere akunzwe muri icyo gihugu. Mathilda ni izina ryakunzwe cyane mu bihugu by’u Burayi birimo Norvège, Finland, na Suède, rikomeza no kugenda ryigarurira imitima y’Abongereza n’Abafaransa. Mu 2017, abana 113 b’abakobwa mu Bufaransa bahawe izina rya Mathilda.  	Ibiranga ba Mathilda Abakobwa bitwa ba Mathilda barangwa no kwita ku baturanyi babo n’abantu muri rusange. Iyi myitwarire ituma bakundwa cyane n’abantu. Bifitemo ubuyobozi kandi bazi gushyira gahunda ku murongo no kuyobora amatsinda. Bakunda gufasha bakanatanga iby’agaciro ku bakene. Ibi bituma bakunda kumara umwanya utari muto bakora ibikorwa bigirira akamaro abantu benshi. Ba Mathilda bakunda gukora cyane bakanimariramo ibyo barimo, ibi bigatuma iyo hari ikitagenze neza biheba cyane bakiyanga. Kubera gukunda gukora cyane kwabo usanga baba bashaka ko n’abandi bakora ku buryo babashyiraho igitutu. Amazina afitanye isano n’iri ya hafi arimo Mathylda, Mathylde, Matilda, Mathita, Milda, Milada, Matylda na Milouda. Abantu bazwi cyane bakoresha iri zina barimo umukinnyi wa film ukomoka mu Bufaransa Mathilda May n’Umwongereza Katherine Mathilda Swinton.

title: Umunyamideli Kate Bashabe afungiwe i Gikondo
content: Kate Bashabe washinze inzu y’imideli yitwa ‘Kabash Fashion House’, afungiwe kuri Station ya Polisi i Gikondo mu Karere ka Kicukiro kuva mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 4 Nyakanga 2016. Umuvugizi wa Polisi y’u Rwanda mu Mujyi wa Kigali, SP Emmanuel Hitayezu yahamirije IGIHE ko uyu mukobwa afunzwe ndetse ko batangiye gukora iperereza ryimbitse ku cyaha akurikiranyweho. Yagize ati “Kuri station ya Polisi i Gikondo, ducumbikiye umukobwa witwa Catherine Bashabe. Yafashwe ku mugoroba, icyaha akurikiranyweho ni gukubita no gukomeretsa bagenzi be, turi gukora iperereza nyuma dosiye tuzashyikiriza izindi nzego.” Bashabe Catherine [Kate] w’imyaka 25, yabaye Miss MTN mu mwaka wa 2010 ndetse no muri 2012 aba Nyampinga wa Nyarugenge. Ubuhamya IGIHE yahawe n’umwe mu bakobwa Kate akurikiranyweho gukomeretsa, buvuga ko intandaro ya byose ‘ari konti ya Instagram yafunguwe n’umuntu utaramenyekana, ikwirakwiza amafoto y’uyu mukobwa ikanavuga amazina y’abagabo yaryamanye na bo, abo mu Rwanda no mu mahanga’. Kate ngo yabanje gukeka umwe mu nshuti ze [tudatangaje izina ku bw’umutekano we] amuhamagara kuri telefone amwihaniza ko nadafunga iyo konti ashobora kuzabura ubuzima bwe. Uwo mukobwa ngo yahakaniye Kate yivuye inyuma ko atari we wafunguye iyo konti imusebya birangira bumvikanye ko bagiye gufatanya gukora iperereza mu gushakisha uwayihimbye. Yagize ati “Namuhakaniye ko atari njye wafungiye iyo konti birangira ansabye imbabazi ambwira ko mwihanganira ku magambo mabi yambwiye. Ejo nibwo yanyandikiye message ambwira ko akeneye ubufasha bwanjye, yansabye ko musanga iwe mu rugo nkamuzanira Heinken enye zikonje .” “Nahageze turaganira bisanzwe, hashize akanya mbona azanye icyuma aramfata andyamisha ku buriri bwe amaboko ayazirikira inyuma ambwira ko nintemera ko ari njye wakoze ya konti ari bunyice. Nabanje kubihakana ariko mbona akomeje gukaza umurego akankoza icyuma mu maso anyereka ko umunota ku wundi yakintera ngapfa kuko yari arakaye cyane.” Yongeyeho ati “Nagize ubwoba mwemerera ko ari njye wabikoze arangije amfata amajwi ndi kubivuga. Yantegekaga ibyo mvuga, yantegekaga abo mpamagara tukabivugana.” Kate ngo yaketse undi mukobwa w’inshuti yabo bombi ko na we yaba ari inyuma y’umugambi wo gushinga iyo konti imusebya kuri Instagram. Ngo yaje gutegeka uyu mukobwa amusaba guhamagara uwo mugenzi wabo ngo abasange mu rugo kuko bafite ikibazo, undi yaje bwangu ahageze na we ahita azirikwa amaboko ahatwa imigeri n’inshyi. Ati “Yadukubise twembi aturyamishije hasi, yaduteraga ubwoba cyane ko tugiye gupfa. Nyuma nigiriye inama yo kumwemerera, mwinginga musaba ko yaduha amasaha 24 tukaba twasibye iyo konti, ariko nashakaga ko tumucika tukajya kuri polisi. Yaraturekuye, yatubwiye ko yiteguye kujya muri 1930 ngo nitutabikora azatwica yijyane kuri polisi.” Aba bakobwa bombi bakimara kuva mu rugo rwa Kate batabaje Polisi y’u Rwanda ihita ibatabara ndetse ita muri yombi uwabakubise ubu afungiwe i Gikondo.

title: Video: Imyiyereko y’abanyamideli mu gusoza Kigali Fashion Week
content: Ibirori byo gusoza Kigali Fashion Week byitabiriwe n’abahanzi b’imideli n’abanyamideli babigize umwuga babarirwa muri 60 baturutse mu bihugu 12 byo ku Mugabane wa Afurika n’u Burayi. Kigali Fashion Week yatangiye tariki ya 18 Kamena isozwa mu muhango ukomeye wabereye i Nyarutarama kuri Century Park Hotel kuwa 24 Kamena 2016.

title: Imyambarire idasanzwe yaranze ibirori bya Kigali Fashion Week (Amafoto)
content: Ni ku nshuro ya Gatandatu ibirori bya Kigali Fashion Week bibaye nyuma y’ibyabaye mu myaka itanu ishize bikagaragaza intera ikomeye abanyamideli bo mu Rwanda bamaze kugeraho ugereranyije n’abo mu bindi bihugu. Ibirori byo gusoza Kigali Fashion Week byitabiriwe n’abanyamideli babarirwa muri 60 baturutse mu bihugu 12 byo ku Mugabane wa Afurika n’u Burayi. I Kigali hari hateraniye abahanzi b’imideli bamaze kubaka izina muri uyu mwuga barimo Sheena Frida C wo muri Kenya, Winnie Godi wo muri Sudani y’Epfo, Jamil Walji wo muri Kenya, An Buermans wo mu Bubiligi, Charity na Irene Businge bo muri Uganda n’abandi. Mu bihugu byari bihagarariwe muri ibi birori harimo Uganda, Kenya, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Sudani y’Epfo, u Bushinwa, u Buyapani, Afurika y’Epfo, Rwanda, Ghana,u Burundi, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo n’u Buhinde. Abahanzi b’imideli berekanye ibihangano byabo muri iri joro, buri wese yari yakoze iyo bwabaga ngo yiyerekane ko ageze ku rwego rufatika. Imideli yose yerekanwe yarimo ubuhanga n’udushya ndetse benshi mu biyerekanye bavuze ko byazamuye urwego rwabo. Umunyakenyakazi werekana imideli akanayihanga, Sheena Frida C yabwiye IGIHE ko ku nshuro ya kabiri aje mu Rwanda yanyuzwe n’uko abitabiriye Kigali Fashion Week banyuzwe n’ibihangano bye akora muri Fashion Development Consortium ikorera i Nairobi. Yavuze ko yahisemo kugaruka kugira ngo yongere inyungu n’umusaruro yavanye i Kigali mu mwaka ushize. Yagize ati “Ni ubwa kabiri ngarutse hano, ubushize nari mpari, nkiva hano nagiye mbona amahirwe menshi nkesha kuba naritabiriye Kigali Fashion Week. Iyo ntagaruka byari kumbera igihombo.” Winnie Godi wo muri Sudani y’Epfo yerekanye imideli ahanga mu nzu y’imideli yise ‘Winnie G Fashion’. Yavuze ko urugendo rwe i Kigali rwamufashije kwagura amarembo y’ibyo akora bizwi cyane cyane n’abatuye mu Mujyi wa Juba. Umunyamideli Judith Hard Kantengwa wo muri Uganda, ari mu berekanye imideli yahanzwe na Turahirwa Moise washinze ‘Moshions House’. Uyu ni umwe mu bishimiwe cyane ndetse na we yigaragaje nk’umuhanga mu byo kwerekana imideli. Amafoto: Mahoro Luqman

title: I Kigali hateguwe ibirori byo kwerekana imideli yo mu Bubiligi
content: Umuhanzi w’imideli ukomeye mu Bubiligi, An Buermans yaje i Kigali mu ntangiriro z’iki cyumweru aho agomba gukorera ibikorwa bitandukanye byo kwamamaza no kumenyekanisha imideli ahanga mu nzu yitwa ‘A.N Buermans Fashion House’. Mu Kiganiro na IGIHE, An Buermans yavuze ko aje mu Rwanda ku nshuro ya kabiri, yahaherukaga muri 2015 ubwo yari aje kuherekanira imideli muri Kigali Fashion Week. Ni umwe mu bagomba kwerekana imideli mu cyumweru cyahariwe imideli i Kigali, gusa ngo yifuje kuhava na we akoze igikorwa cyagutse cyerekana ubuhanzi bwe akora nk’akazi gahoraho. Yagize ati “Ni inshuro ya kabiri nje hano, mu by’ukuri navuga ko nahageze umwaka ushize ngahita nkunda uburyo abashyitsi bakirwa. Uhereye ku kibuga cy’indege kugeza ugeze muri hoteli wakiranwa urugwiro [...] Narabikunze cyane, nshaka kubibyaza umusaruro.” An Buermans afatanyije na mugenzi we bavanye mu Bubiligi, bateguye igikorwa cyo kwerekana imideli cyitwa ‘The Show Room’, kizaba kuwa Gatandatu tariki ya 25 Kamena 2016. Ati “Mu mwaka ushize nerekanye ibyo nkora ariko abo twahuriraga muri Kigali Fashion Weeek bambazaga uko bagura ibintu byanjye nkabura igisubizo mbaha. Muri The Show Room bazabibona n’amaso, hazaba hari n’amahirwe yo kubigura ku bakunda imideli.” Buermans yavuze ko mu migambi yagutse afite yifuza kuzashinga iduka ry’imideli mu Mujyi wa Kigali ndetse ngo yifuza kugirana ubufatanye burambye n’abari mu mwuga w’imideli mu Rwanda. Ati “Ndabyifuza, ndumva nazakorera hano, ndifuza kubikora nibigenda neza.” Avuga ko iki gikorwa yagitewemo inkunga na Ambasaderi w’u Bubiligi mu Rwanda ukunda gutera inkunga ibirori by’imideli. Iki gikorwa bise ‘The Show Room’ kizabera mu Mujyi wa Kigali kuri Impact Hub mu Kiyovu guhera saa cyenda z’amanywa kugeza saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba. Imideli bakora muri A.N Buermans....

title: Abasore n’inkumi 60 baziyerekana mu mideli muri Kigali Fashion Week
content: Ni ku nshuro ya Gatandatu ibirori bya Kigali Fashion Week bigiye kongera kuba nyuma y’ibyabaye mu myaka itanu ishize bikagaragaza intera ikomeye abanyamideli bo mu Rwanda bamaze kugeraho ugereranyije n’abo mu bindi bihugu. Kigali Fashion Week izabera kuri Century Park Hotel i Nyarutarama ahazaba hateraniye abahanzi b’imideli bagera kuri 22 bazaba baturutse mu bihugu cumi na bibiri. Umuyobozi wa Kigali Fashion Week, John Bunyeshuri yavuze ko uyu mwaka bakiriye abanyamideli n’abahanzi b’imideli [fashion designers] bo mu bihugu bitandukanye haba ibyo ku Mugabane wa Afurika, Aziya n’u Burayi. Yagize ati “Kigali Fashion Week igitangira yari iy’Abanyarwanda gusa, bwa mbere bari abanyamideli b’u Rwanda. Muri uyu mwaka hari impinduka zikomeye, abitabira bariyongereye, ibihugu nabyo ni byinshi […] Mu birori byo gusoza tuzaba dufite abanyamideli bo mu bihugu birenga icumi, urumva abanyamideli 60 ni igikorwa cyerekana ko twakuze.” Ibihugu byitabiriye imurikamideli rikomeye rya Kigali Fashion Week, baturutse mu bihugu birimo Uganda, Kenya, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Sudani y’Epfo, u Bushinwa, u Buyapani, Afurika y’Epfo, Rwanda, Ghana,u Burundi, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo n’u Buhinde. Kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 21 Kamena 2016 mu kiganiro cyahuje abanyamakuru n’abanyamideli bazitabira ibirori byo gusoza Kigali Fashion Week, benshi bavuze ko ari amahirwe akomeye kwibona mu bamurika imideli muri iki gikorwa kuko bifungura imiryango itabarika. Umunyakenyakazi werekana imideli akanayihanga, Sheena Frida C yabwiye IGIHE ko aje mu Rwanda ku nshuro ya kabiri, yahaherukaga mu mwaka wa 2015 ari nabwo yerekanye imideli ahanga muri Fashion Development Consortium ikorera i Nairobi, avuga ko yahisemo kugaruka kugira ngo yongere inyungu n’umusaruro yavanye i Kigali mu mwaka ushize. Yagize ati “Ni ubwa kabiri ngarutse hano, ubushize nari mpari, nkiva hano nagiye mbona amahirwe menshi nkesha kuba naritabiriye Kigali Fashion Week. Iyo ntagaruka byari kumbera igihombo […] Nzagira amahirwe yo guhura n’abakunda iby’imideli bo mu bihugu bitandukanye nanjye barusheho kumenya.” Winnie Godi wo muri Sudani y’Epfo na we yavuze ko yaje kwerekana imideli ahanga mu nzu y’imideli yise ‘Winnie G Fashion’ mu kwagura amarembo y’ibyo akora bizwi mu Mujyi wa Juba ari naho atuye. Ati “Iwacu muri Sudani ibikorwa byanjye bigenda bimenyekana buhoro buhoro, navuga ko n’urwego rw’imideli rutangiye kuzamuka hariya iwacu. Kuza hano rero bizamfasha byinshi, nzabona umubare munini w’abamenya ibyo nkora mu bindi bihugu.” Uyu mukobwa w’imyaka 24, nava i Kigali azitabira irindi serukiramuco rikomeye rizabera muri Australia ndetse naho azahamurikira imideli ahanga. Uyu mwaka Kigali Fashion Week yatewe inkunga na Bralirwa ibinyujije mu kinyobwa cya Mützig, Ambasade y’u Bubiligi mu Rwanda n’ibindi bigo bitandukanye. Amafoto: Mahoro Luqman

title: Turahirwa azahagararira u Rwanda mu iserukiramuco ry’imideli muri Ghana
content: Ku myaka 24 y’amavuko, Turahirwa Moise [uyobora Moshions House] ni umwe mu bahanzi b’imideli bakomeye mu Karere bazitabira iserukiramuco ry’imideli rya Mercedes Benz African Fashion Festival rizamara iminsi itatu kuva ku itariki ya 1 Nyakanga kugeza kuwa 3 Nyakanga 2016. Azahura n’abanyamideli baturutse mu bihugu birenga mirongo itanu birimo ibyo muri Afurika, Amerika n’u Burayi. Ati “Ni hafi ibihugu byose bya Afurika, mu bo nabashije kumenyamo nabonye abazaturua muri Amerika, u Bwongereza, Ghana, abo muri Kenya, Afurika y’Epfo n’abandi.” Turahirwa yabwiye IGIHE ko ari gutegura imbumbe y’imideli [collection] azerekana mu Mujyi wa Accra ndetse ngo ari kubyitegura neza kugira ngo azaheshe ishema igihugu. Ati “Mfite collection nshyashya nzerekana, ntabwo nzongera gusubiramo ibyo nerekanye muri Tanzania mu minsi ishize. Ndi kubyitegura neza, batoranyije abanyamideli b’abahanga mu bihugu byose, urumva rero biransaba kubyitondera.” Mercedes Benz African Fashion Festival 2016, yihaye intego yo kwifashisha abanyamideli bakumvikanisha akamaro ko kwiga mu bakiri bato no kurandura burundu indwara ya Glaucoma muri Afurika. Muri Mutarama 2016, Turahirwa yagiye muri Nigeria mu irushanwa rya Mister Africa International, icyo gihe yabaye igisonga cya Gatatu mu gihe umusore wo muri Uganda witwa Keith Karuhuura yaje ku mwanya wa mbere agirwa Rudasumbwa w’Umugabane wa Afurika.

title: Mupende Alexia yaserukiye u Rwanda mu birori by’imideli mu Busuwisi
content: Ku nshuro ya kane, i Geneva mu Busuwisi hagiye kubera ibirori bikomeye by’imideli byiswe Africa Fashion Show Geneva(AFSG). Bizabera muri Grand Hotel Kempinski in Geneva. Alexia Uwera Mupende ni na we waserukiye u Rwanda mu mwaka ushize, yabonye aya mahirwe yo kwitabira ibi birori by’imideli bigizwe uruhare rukomeye n’umuryango UN Women usanzwe ufasha abari n’abategarugori by’umwihariko ba rwiyemezamirimo kwiteza imbere. Crucible Events itegura Africa Fashion Show Geneva itangaza ko impamvu nyamukuru n’icyerekezo ifite mu gutegura iki gikorwa, ngo ni uguteza imbere imideli y’Abanyafurika, kubagaragaza ku rwego rw’Isi. Muri uyu mwaka wa 2016, Africa Fashion Show Geneva izitabirwa n’abanyamideli bo mu bihugu birimo u, Rwanda, Tanzania, Mali, Nigeria, Ghana, u Burusiya, Brazil n’abandi. Ku rubuga rwa Crucible Events hari itangazo rivuga ko Africa Fashion Show Geneva itangira kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 28 Gicurasi 2016, izanakomeza mu birori byo kuyisoza bizaba ku Cyumweru ahategerejwe abanyamideli b’abatumirwa bazaturuka mu Bufaransa, u Bwongereza na Costa Rica. Alexia Uwera Mupende, yatangiye kumenyekana mu by’imideli mu mwaka wa 2012 ubwo yatsindaga irushanwa rya Rwanda Premier Model Competition. Yagiye yitabira ibikorwa by’imideli bikomeye ku Isi nka Dubai Runway Season II. Yakoranye n’abahanzi b’imideli bakomeye barimo Modupe Omonze, Shaleen Cheah, Helen Couture, Si Fashion Galerie na Khalid Al Ayoub

title: Umunyamideli Rupari Cynthia yahawe igihembo gikomeye i Conakry
content: Rupari Cnynthia ni umwe mu bahanzi b’imideli [Fashion designers] bakomeye mu Rwanda, ni we washinze inzu y’imideli ya Rupari Design. Yaserukiye u Rwanda mu birori byahuje abanyamideli bakomeye muri Afurika byitwa Guèssè Fashion Show biherutse kubera mu Murwa Mukuru wa Conakry. Guèssè Fashion Show, ni imurikamideli ngarukamwaka ribaye ku nshuro ya kane i Conackry. Ritegurwa n’ihuriro ry’abahanzi b’imideli muri Guinée ryitwa G.S.M.CG [Groupement des Stylistes Modélistes et Créateurs de Guinée]. Yabwiye IGIHE ko  ari we muhanzi w’imideli w’umugore witabiriye Guèssè Fashion Show mu barenga mirongo itatu bari baturutse mu bihugu bitandukanye ndetse abasha kwegukana igihembo nk’uwahize abandi mu kwerekana imbumbe y’imideli [collection] ifite umwihariko. Yagize ati “Navuye i Kigali mu ijoro ryo kuwa Kane [w’icyumweru gishize] ngerayo kuwa Gatanu nijoro, bantumiye bantunguye gusa nkora uko nshoboye njyayo kuko bitegurwa n’ihuriro ry’abanyamideli bakomeye muri Afurika ku buryo ntari kwirenza ayo mahirwe. Nanagize umugisha ntahana igikombe, urumva ko ari ibintu bikomeye gutsinda mu bantu bangana kuriya kandi b’abahanga.” Cynthia Rupari yerekanye imideli yabumbiye muri Glamour Collection, yari yiganjemo imyenda yo gusohokana idoze kinyafurika ari nacyo cyamuhesheje amahirwe yo guhabwa igikombe. Ati “Uretse igikombe nahawe, nyuma wasangaga bose bambaza uko babona iriya myenda nerekanye. Urumva najyanye imyenda cumi n’ibiri gusa, ariko nabonye ko bishoboka kuba nageza ibihangano byanjye hariya.” Muri Guèssè Fashion Show, Rupari yahuriyemo n’abanyamideli bakomeye barimo abo mu bihugu bya Nigeria, Côte d’Ivoire n’abandi 27 bo muri Guinée. By’umwihariko ngo yagize amahirwe yo guhuza imishinga n’umunyamideli wambika Umugore wa Perezida wa Côte d’Ivoire, uyu bigeze guhurira iwabo mu 2012 ubwo yari yaserukiye u Rwanda. Rupari Cynthia ni umwe mu banyamideli babigize umwuga wagiye ahagararira u Rwanda mu imurika ry’imideli mu bihugu bitandukanye. Yanahagarariye u Rwanda mu marushanwa arimo Miss Grand Lacs, East African Model Search n’ahandi.

title: Irungu n’ibitotsi mu birori by’imideli ya Mama Africa (Amafoto)
content: Ibirori byo kwerekana imideli yiswe Mama Africa Design Season 1 byateguwe na Niragire Nince uyobora Mama Africa izina benshi bamwitiriye. Ni ku nshuro ya mbere bibereye i Kigali herekanwa imyenda yiganjemo iy’Abanyafurika idoze mu bitenge. Ibirori byabereye kuri Top Tower Hotel[mu igorofa rya munani]  ku Kacyiru, mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa 15 Gicurasi 2016. Byagombaga gutangira saa moya zuzuye, kwinjira byasabaga kwishyura amafaranga ibihumbi bitanu ariko icyagaragaye ni uko abacuruzaga amatike basa n’abatashye badakoze ku ifaranga kuko na bake binjiye berekanaga impapuro z’ubutumire (invitation) abandi bari biganjemo abanyamakuru n’abanyamideli ubwabo. Ucyinjira muri Top Tower Hotel umusekirite yahitaga akubwira ko ascenceur yagize ikibazo bityo ko ugomba kuzamuka mu igorofa rya munani n’amaguru, ibintu bitamenyerewe na benshi. Abazamukaga bageragayo bahagira abandi ukumva bitotomba bavuga ko batabyishimiye. Ahagana saa tatu n’igice z’ijoro nibwo ibirori byatangiye, habanje kuririmba abahanzi bafite amazina ataramenyekana i Kigali nyuma abasore n’inkumi batangira kwiyerekana. Muri ibi birori hari irungu rikomeye cyane ahanini kubera uburyo byatwaye amasaha menshi hakiyongeraho ko abantu bari bake, bicaye batatanye ku buryo bitari byoroshye kubona abantu baganira. Kwiyerekana nabyo byagiye bitinda cyane ku buryo hagati y’icyiciro n’ikindi habagamo icyuho kugeza ubwo uwari uyoboye ibirori na we w’umuhanzi mushya yashyizemo CD ye akababyinira ashaka kubamara irungu. Byabaye iby’ubusa kuko ahagana saa tanu benshi [muri bake baje] bikubuye barataha salle isigaramo abantu batarenze 15 nabwo biganjemo abanyamakuru. Mu gihe cyose ibi birori byatindaga, abafana wasangaga baryamye mu ntebe, abafite za smartphone bakimarira irungu kuri WhatsApp na Facebook. Ibirori byasojwe ahagana saa tanu n’igice z’ijoro, Niragire Nince yavuze ko yishimiye uko byagenze ndetse ngo yizeye ko icyiciro cya kabiri ateganya gukora vuba kizagenda neza. Yagize ati « Ndabashimiye mwese, byagenze neza kurusha uko nabitekerezaga […] Nizeye ko ubutaha bizaba byiza kurushaho. »

title: Abanyamideli 17 bivumbuye mu birori bya Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show (Amafoto)
content:
Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show, ni ibirori ngarukamwaka byo kurimba bihuza abanyamideli bo mu Rwanda n’abo mu bihugu bitandukanye bakerekana imideli yiganjemo imyambaro gakondo. Muri uyu mwaka byabaye mu bice bibiri, icya mbere cyari umusogongero wo kwitegura ibizakorwa muri Nzeri 2016. Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show y’umusogongero yabaye mu mpera z’icyumweru dusoje kuri Goethe-Institut mu Kiyovu. Mbere y’uko ibi birori biba, hari haratoranyijwe abanyamideli 25 bagombaga kwiyerekana mu byiciro bibiri kuwa 13 Gicurasi no muri Nzeri 2016 gusa bivumbuye habura iminota mike ngo igikorwa gitangire ku bwo kutumvikana amafaranga n’uwateguye ibirori. Muri 25 bagombaga kwerekana imideli, 17 bivumbuye bageze kuri Goethe-Institut ahabereye igikorwa, bifuzaga ko bahabwa amadolari ijana nk’igihembo cyo kwiyerekana hanyuma uwabatumiye akavuga ko ayo mafaranga ari umurengera ko atabasha kuyabona bityo abasaba gufata umwanzuro ubanogeye.
Abasore n’inkumi 17 bahise bikubura barataha, imideli yerekanwa na bake babashije kwihanganira gukorera amadolari 20 n’abandi bake bitabajwe by’igitunguro. Umuyobozi wa Rwanda Cultural Fashion, Celestin Ntawirema ati «Ikibazo cyabaye ni uko bageze hano banga gukora akazi kuko amafaranga twavuganye bifuzaga ko twayazamura akagera ku madolari ijana, ibyo badasubaga ni ukurengera, ntabwo nari kubona ayo mafaranga yose kandi nta bushobozi buhari.» Yongeyeho ati « Nababwiye ko bakora icyo bashaka, bamwe bivumbuye baragenda abandi barasigara kandi igikorwa cyabaye, cyagenze neza. Bagaragaje imyitwarire itari myiza ariko nababwira ko ibyo bakoze ntacyo byatanze. » Nubwo abanyamideli bagombaga kwiyerekana bivumbuye bakanga gukora akazi, igikorwa cyarabaye ndetse abantu babyitabiriye wabonaga banyuzwe n’ibyo beretswe, abiyerekanye. Imyambarire yamuritswe muri Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show yari yiganjemo ifite aho ihuriye n’umuco nko kwambara impu, ishabure, imyiyereko y’abasore bari bogoshe amasunzu n’ibindi. Ibirori byasojwe ubona bose ku maso bakinyotewe gukomeza kureba iyi mideli yamuritswe n’abahanga muri uyu mwuga haba abo mu mahanga ndetse n’abasanzwe bazwi i Kigali. Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show yitabiriwe n’abanyamideli bo mu bihugu birimo Tanzaniya, u Burundi, Kenya ndetse hari n’umugore witwa Esther wari waturutse muri Nigeria. Makeke Jocktan, Umunyatanzaniya wari wazanye itsinda ryerekanye imideli ya Makeke Design yabwiye IGIHE ko yungukiye byinshi mu gikorwa cya Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show ndetse ngo yifuza ko ibyo ahanga muri Tanzania yabishakira isoko i Kigali. Yagize ati « Nari nagiye muri East African Fashion Week nibwo namenye ko hano hari igikorwa kimeze gutya. Nungutse byinshi hano, nabonye uburyo Umujyi wa Kigali utandukanye n’indi mijyi nagezemo, abanyamideli baho baracyari bato ariko ni abahanga, ubona ko mu byo bakora harimo umwimerere » Yongeraho ati «  Navuga ko nungutse byinshi. Namenyanye n’abantu benshi hano, bizamfasha ninsubira iwacu […] Ndashaka gukoresha aya mahirwe nagura ibikorwa byanjye hano, bishobotse nashaka abo dukorana inaha. » Ibirori nyamukuru bya Rwanda Cultural Fashion bizaba muri Nzeri 2016, Ntawirema Celestin yavuze ko bizitabirwa n’abazaturuka mu bihugu birindwi.

title: Imyambarire idasanzwe yaranze ibirori bya Met Gala (Amafoto)
content: Ibirori bya Met Gala byari biyobowe na Taylor Swift, Anna Wintour, umwe mu bakosora[editor] ikinyamakuru Vogue, umukinnyi wa filime Idris Elba ndetse n’umwe mu bahanga bakora mu sosiyete ya Apple witwa Jonathan Ive. Ibi birori bya Met Gala benshi bita Costume Institute Gala, byabereye ahitwa Metropolitan Museum of Art ari nayo itegura iri serukiramuco ngarukamwaka ry’imideli mu Mujyi wa New York . Muri uyu mwaka ibyamamare byitabiriye ibirori byari byaserukanye imideli ishushanya ibivugwa mu nsanganyamatsiko yakanguriraga abanyamideli gukora uyu mwuga bagendana n’umuvuduko ikoranabuhanga rigezeho ku Isi. Abahanzi bakomeye ku Isi, abakinnyi ba filime, abanyamideli, abanyarwenya, abanyamakuru, abanyabugeni n’izindi ngeri z’ibyamamare, bari babukereye mu myambarire yiganjemo ifitanye isano n’icyuma. Taylor Swift yari yambaye ikanzu ngufi yavuzweho byinshi yakozwe n’inzu y’imideli y’Umufaransa Louis Vuitton, byari bitandukanye n’uko mu myaka yashize uyu muhanzi yazaga yambaye imyenda ibonerana cyane cyangwa igaragaza amabere. Muri 2014 Jay-Z yahuye n’ibibazo bikomeye kuko yakubiswe na muramu we ,Solange Knowles murumuna wa Beyonce bari bazanye mu birori icyo gihe. Kuri iyi nshuro Beyonce yaje wenyine ndetse umugabo we ntiyahakandagije ikirenge. Kim Kardashian wari wambaye ikanzu ndende yakozwe n’inzu y’imideli ya Pierre Balmain yari aherekejwe n’umugabo we Kanye West. Umunyamideli Gigi Hadid na we yazanye n’umukunzi we Zayn Malik cyo kimwe na Bella [uvukana na Gigi] na we yari yaherekejwe n’umukunzi we The Weeknd. Nyina wa Kim Kardashian na we yatunguranye muri ibi birori kuko yaje aherekejwe n’umukunzi we Corey Gamble. Ntibakunze kugaragara kenshi mu birori bari kumwe gusa muri iri joro bari bishimanye. Ibi birori bya Met Gala byatangiye kuba mu mwaka wa 1971, byitabirwa n’ibyamamare bitandukanye haba mu muziki, ubugeni, sinema, abanyarwenya n’abandi batandukanye.

title: Kabagema, Umunyarwandakazi watangiye kwerekana imideli mu 1980 (Amafoto)
content: Azwi cyane mu bikorwa byo guteza imbere imideli, gufasha abatishoboye, gukora ubukangurambaga mu bikorwa biteza imbere u Rwanda ndetse yabaye mu kanama nkemurampaka k’irushanwa rya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2016. Mu 1994, Kabagema yashinze umuryango udaharanira inyungu witwa ‘Alliance Pour Le Rwanda’. Yari awuhuriyemo na Christine Kabagema, Zoeka Gacha, Michelle Mabondzo, Florence Souchel n’abandi. Mu by’ingenzi bakoze harimo gusukura amazi no kwakira imfubyi zitagira kivurira. Igice kinini cy’ubuzima bwe, Kabagema Josée yakimaze mu bihugu by’amahanga. Yagiye muri Uganda ajyanye n’umuryango we wameneshejwe mu 1959, niho yatangiriye kwiga amashuri abanza gusa nyuma y’igihe gito bagiye gutura mu Bufaransa. Ni umwe mu bakoze amateka akomeye mu mideli mu gihugu cy’u Bufaransa kuva mu 1980. Icyo gihe yabyinjiyemo nk’impano yiyumvagamo gusa ababyeyi bamwemereye kubikora nk’umwuga nyuma yo kurangiza kaminuza. Ati “Nabitangiye mu 1980 icyo gihe twari dutuye mu Bufaransa, nabyinjiyemo nk’impano niyumvagamo. Abafotozi barambonaga aho twari dutuye bakambwira ko mberewe no kwerekana imideli ariko ababyeyi ntibabyumvaga, babanje kubyanga.” Yongeraho ati “Ababyeyi bansabye kubanza nkiga nkarangiza amashuri hanyuma nkazabikora nyuma mbifatanyije n’undi mwuga atari ibyo gusa.” Amaze kubitangira, ababyeyi batunguwe n’uko yabivanagamo amafaranga afatika gusa bamugiriye inama ko byaba byiza abifatanyije n’undi mwuga utandukanye n’imideli kuko batumvaga uburemere bwabyo. Yagize ati “Byatangiye ari ukwifotoza kuko byari bimbereye ntabwo natangiye ndi umunyamideli gusa narangije kaminuza mbyinjiramo nk’umwuga. Mubyara wanjye yadusanze aho twari dutuye i Lille ni hafi y’umupaka w’u Bubiligi, yambwiye ko yavuye i Paris kandi yabonye ahantu najya kwerekana imideli, nagiyeyo gutyo ntungurwa n’uko banyambitse birambera bahita bamfata.” Amaze imyaka irenga 36 mu mideli Yerekanye imideli kuva mu 1980 abihagarika ahagana mu mpera z’umwaka wa 2009 ku mpamvu ze bwite. Ubu atoza abanyamideli no kubereka inzira zabafasha kwiteza imbere. Kabagema Josée yerekanye imideli mu bihugu birenga icumi ndetse hose yahavanaga amanota meza. Yagiye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ahagana mu 1990 muri New York Fashion Week, yanerekanye imideli mu Buyapani[kwerekana iby’imisatsi], u Bubiligi, u Bushinwa, mu Budage, mu Bufaransa, u Butaliyani n’ahandi. Yakoranye n’banyamideli bakomeye ku Isi barimo Umutaliyani Pierre Cardin, Dior, Hubert de Givenchy, Umufaransa Thierry Mugler, Patrovitch&Robinson, Grey n’abandi. Ati “Ntabwo abantu bari bazi ko ndi Umunyarwandakazi, bakeka ko ndi Umunyamerikakazi cyangwa muri biriya bihugu. Muri Mata 1994 Jenoside yabaye nkorana na Givenchy na Cardin, nababwiye ko mvuka mu Rwanda kandi mbasobanurira ko igihugu cyacu kiri mu bibazo bikomeye hanyuma mbasaba ko bamfasha tugakoresha izina nari mfite mu gutabariza igihugu. Icyo gihe natumiwe kuri Televiziyo, muri za Radio no mu binyamakuru bikomeye.” Ashimira Bihozagara na Papa Wemba Ashimira benshi mu byamamare byafashije umuryango Alliance pour le Rwanda mu bikorwa byawo. Mu b’ibanze ashimira harimo Jacques Bihozagara, Papa Wemba, Hubert de Givenchy, Umunya-Senegal Youssou N’Dour, itsinda rya Touré Kunda, Ismaël Lô, Myriam Makeba n’abandi. Ati “Baradufashije cyane, hari n’ibikorwa by’ubukangurambaga twakoze mu kumenyesha amahanga ibyaberaga iwacu, twababwiraga ko mu Rwanda aho mvuka hari kubera ubwicanyi. Banafashije uriya muryango[Alliance pour le Rwanda] cyane, ndabashimira.” Kabagema wize Indimi n’Ubuvanganzo muri Kaminuza ya Université Catholique de Lille, ntiyigeze ashaka umugabo ngo kuko atabonye uwo bahuza ku buryo barushinga.

title: Hatowe 25 bazerekana imyambarire yo mu Rwanda rwo hambere
content: Ni ku nshuro ya Kane ibi birori bigiye kuba, bizitabirwa n’Abanyamideli bo mu Buhinde no bihugu bigize Afurika y’Uburasirazuba. Ibirori byo kurimba bya ‘Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show’ biheruka kubera i Kigali kuwa 26 Nzeri kuri Hôtel Des Mille Collines by Kempinski. Kuri uyu wa 24 Mata 2016 kuri Great Seasons Hotel i Gacuriro mu Mujyi wa Kigali habereye igikorwa cyo gutoranya abanyamideli 25 bahize abandi. Ni nabo bazifashishwa mu kwerekana imideli yateguwe n’abahanga mu byo kurimba basanzwe bategura Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show. Hari hiyandikishije abanyamideli basaga ijana gusa ku munsi w’ijonjora haje 75 bo mu bihugu birimo Uganda, Kenya, u Buhinde, Tanzania, u Burundi n’u Rwanda. José Kabagema wari uhagarariye akanama nkemurampaka, yabwiye IGIHE ko mu byakurikijwe harimo kureba uko umunyamideli avuga, intambuko ye n’uburyo aberwa n’imideli mu mafoto. Yagize ati “Ubundi mu banyamideli ntabwo tureba cyane isura, uko umuntu asa cyangwa ubwiza ntabwo tubyitaho. Buriya icyo twashingiyeho cyane ni uko umunyamideli aberwa n’amafoto, uko atambuka hanyuma tukanareba uko avuga. Ntabwo twatora abanyamideli batazi kwisobanura kuko tuba tubatoza kuzamenya kuvugana n’abazabakoresha mu bikorwa byo kwamamaza.” Ibirori byo kurimba bya ‘Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show’ biheruka kubera i Kigali kuwa 26 Nzeri kuri Hôtel Des Mille Collines by Kempinski. Umuyobozi wa Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show, Ntawirema Celestin yavuze ko abatowe uko ari 25 ari bo baziyerekana muri uyu mwaka. Ibirori bizaba inshuro ebyiri muri kuwa 13 Gicurasi kuri Goethe-Institut no muri Nzeri 2016 kuri hoteli nshya yitwa Mariot Hotel. Yagize ati “Muri uyu mwaka twashyizemo umwihariko, tuzakora imurika mu byiciro bibiri muri Gicurasi 2016 hanyuma mu kwezi kwa cyenda[Nzeri] habe noneho Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show nyir’izina.” Yavuze ko kuwa 13 Gicurasi hazaba ibirori byo kumurika imideli yiganjemo ifite aho ihuriye n’umuco nyarwanda, by’umwihariko ngo hazerekanwa uko umwami n’ingabo ze bambaraga.

title: Kanye West yamuritse igice cya gatatu cy’imideli yahanze (Amafoto)
content: Ibirori byo kumurika iyi mideli byabaye ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 11 Gashyantare 2016. Yanamurikiyemo album ya karindwi amaze iminsi ategura yise ‘The Life of Pablo’ iriho indirimbo yakoranye n’abahanzi barimo Rihanna, Kirk Franklin n’abandi. Yari ashyigikiwe n’abo mu muryango we no kwa sebukwe barimo umugore we Kim Kardashian na North West; baramukazi be hafi ya bose ndetse na Caitlyn yari yaje kwihera ijisho. Mu buryo bwatunguye benshi, umukinnyi wamamaye muri NBA Lamar Odom wari umaze iminsi yaraheze mu buriri kubera ikibazo yagize cyakomotse ku bisindisha byinshi na we yaje muri ibi birori. Hari n’abahanzi b’ibyamamare nka Jaden Smith, Anna Wintour, Jay Z, Tyga, 50 Cent, Young Thug, 2 Chainz, Kid Cudi, Jonathan Cheban, Austin Mahone, Anna Wintour n’abandi. Hari kandi abanyamideli bakomeye ku Isi nka Naomi, Alek Wek na Veronica Webb. Imwe mu ndirimbo zigize album nshya ya Kanye West, uyu muraperi yayirimbyemo amagambo yumvikanisha ko ashobora kuba akorana imibonano mpuzabitsina na Taylor Swift. Abantu ibihumbi n’ibihumbi bari muri Madison Square Garden batangaye bikomeye bumvise amagambo Kanye yaririmbye. Muri Gashyantare 2015 nibwo Kanye West yamuritse bwa mbere imideli ku bufatanye na Adidas. Muri Nzeri umwaka ushize yamuritse igice cya kabiri cyari cyiganjemo imyambaro y’abagore mu birori byabereye ahitwa Skylight Modern muri Chelsea.

title: Kutishimira kwambara imyenda imenyekanisha amahanga byatumye bakora ifite ikirango cya ‘KGL’
content: Nyuma y’igihe babyitegereza bakabona bidakwiye guhora abantu bagenda bamenyekanisha imijyi y’amahanga, urubyiruko rwibumbiye mu nzu y’imideli yitwa DCIB (Dawn Central Investiment Bureau), rwahisemo gukora imyambaro ifite ikirango cya KGL, bifatwa nk’impine ya Kigali, Umurwa Mukuru w’u Rwanda umaze kumenyekana ku Isi yose kubera isuku n’iterambere rikomeje kwihuta. Mu kiganiro na IGIHE, Tuyishimire Desiré, umwe mu basore babiri bashinze iyi nzu y’imideli yavuze ko intego yabo ari ukumenyekanisha Umujyi wa Kigali, babinyujije mu gutanga umusanzu muri gahunda ya leta yo guca caguwa, hatezwa imbere imyenda ikorerwa mu Rwanda. Ati “Nyuma yo kumva no gusobanukirwa gahunda ya Leta y’u Rwanda twabonye ko ari ngombwa ko dutanga umusanzu wacu nk’urubyiruko, tugashishikariza abantu gukunda imyenda ikorerwa mu gihugu cyacu.” Yakomeje avuga ko nyuma yo kwitegereza baje gusanga abantu benshi bahitamo kwambara umwambaro runaka kubera ikirango cyawo, bituma batekereza gukora ifite icya ‘KGL’ kuko bazi neza ko Abanyarwanda bakunda umujyi wabo kandi ubateye ushema. Ati “Twabonye ko igihe mu Rwanda hazaba hari ikirango abantu bakunze, ntabwo bazajya bajya gushaka icyo mu mahanga. Murabizi umwana ntabwo akura ngo ahite yuzura ingobyi, niyo mpamvu twahereye ku ngofero, uko ubushobozi buzagenda buza, tuzakora amakoti, imipira n’ibindi.” Tuyishimire yavuze ko kugeza ubu byinshi ku ngofero zabo bikorerwa mu Bushinwa, kuko batarabasha kugira ubushobozi bwo kugura imashini zidoda n’izishyiraho ikirango bitewe n’uburyo zihenda. Bateganya ko mu myaka itanu iri imbere byose bazaba baratangiye kubikorera mu Rwanda, ibi bikazagerwaho bitewe n’uburyo ikirango cyabo kizakundwa n’ubushobozi bw’inganda zikora imyenda mu Rwanda. Ati “Mu myaka itanu iri imbere turabona uretse Abanyarwanda aho bari hose ku Isi n’abanyamahanga turabona bazaba bambara imyenda yacu ifite ikirango cya KGL. Turashaka gushimangira iterambere ry’umujyi wacu wa Kigali binyuze mu myambaro.” Uru rubyiruko ruvuga ko uretse kuba rwifuza kurushaho kumenyekanisha Kigali, rufite n’intego yo gutanga akazi kenshi ku rungano rwabo, rugasaba Abanyarwanda kubanza kwikunda mbere yo gukunda iby’abandi kugira ngo inzozi zabo ari nazo z’igihugu zo guteza imbere ‘Made in Rwanda’ zigerweho. title: Kigali International Fashion Week igiye kubera mu bihugu bitatu i Burayi
content: Ibi birori byaherukaga kubera i Kigali muri Gicurasi uyu mwaka, aho byamaze iminsi itatu biba, hakerekanwa imodoka, imyambaro isanzwe n’itamenyerewe ndetse n’ibindi bikorwa bitandukanye bigaragaza umwihariko n’intera ibijyanye no kumurika imideli bimaze kugeraho mu Rwanda. Mu kiganiro n’itangazamakuru, Umuyobozi wa Kigali Fashion Week, John Bunyeshuri, yatangaje ko umwaka wa 2018 uzasiga isura nshya n’iterambere ridasanzwe ku bakora n’abamurika imideli b’Abanyarwanda biturutse ku mushinga udasanzwe bafite wo gutangira kubafasha kumenyekanisha ibikorwa mu mahanga. Yagize ati "Nk’uko twambara Gucci, Nike n’indi myenda tukumva turabyishimiye cyane, kuki abanyamahanga nabo batakwambara amashati n’imyenda byanditseho ’Made in Rwanda?’" Yongeyeho ati "Ibirori bya Kigali Fashion Week tugiye kubigeza ahashimishije kurushaho, turifuza ko n’Abanyarwanda bakora imideli bamenyekana ku Isi n’ibyo bakora bikarenga imbibi." Yavuze ko byibuze abakora imideli bagera ku icumi mu Rwanda bazahabwa amahirwe yo kumurika ibikorwa byabo mu birori bya Kigali International Fashion Week bizabera mu bihugu bitatu i Burayi ndetse n’abamurika imideli bagera kuri 16 akaba ari bo bamaze kwemererwa guhabwa amahirwe yo kugaragaza impano zabo. Ku ikubitiro, ibirori bya Kigali International Fashion Week bizabera i Berlin mu Budage kuva ku itariki 12 kugeza kuri 14 Mutarama 2017, bizerekeza i Amsterdam mu Buholandi kuva ku wa 26 kugeza ku wa 28 Mutarama, hanyuma mu i Bruxelles mu Bubiligi habere ibisoza urugendo muri uwo mwaka i Burayi kuva ku itariki 19 kugeza kuri 25 Werurwe 2017. Dieudonne Ntasinzira, Umuyobozi wa BerexInvest Corporation ikorera mu Bubiligi, yasinye amasezerano y’ubufatanyabikorwa na Kigali International Fashion Week, yavuze ko amarembo afunguye ku banyarwanda bifuza kugira ibyo bamenyekanisha yizeza umusanzu ukomeye mu guteza imbere abakora ibijyanye n’imideli mu Rwanda. Abateguye Kigali International Fashion Week batangaje ko iki gikorwa batangije cyo kugeza hanze y’u Rwanda ibi birori, nibigenda neza i Burayi, hazarebwa uko byagezwa no ku yindi migabane nka Amerika, Aziya n’ahandi hatandukanye ku Isi.

title: Imideli yakorewe mu Rwanda yamuritswe bwa mbere muri Ghana
content: Tanga Designs ihanga imideli kuva mu 2014, yatangijwe n’umusore witwa Olivier Niyitanga ufite impano y’imideli, umaze kumenyekana cyane ukaba witwa ‘Tanga’. Iyi nzu yibanda ku myambaro izwi nka ‘Haute Couture’ yambarwa mu birori. Nyuma y’imyaka ibiri, Tanga Designs itangijwe ku mugaragaro yerekanye imyambaro mishya yise ‘I Am Mercedes Bae’ mu iserukiramuco ry’imideli rizwi nka Mercedes Benz Fashion Festival ribera mu Mujyi wa Accra muri Ghana. Niyitanga yabwiye IGIHE ko iryo serukiramuco yitabiriye ryamusigiye byinshi mu buryo bw’ubumenyi no kubishyira mu ngiro. Ati “Nigiye byinshi ku bahanzi b’imideli bo muri Ghana kandi niteguye kubishyira mu ngiro.” Yongeyeho ati “Ntabwo ari amahirwe gusa nagize yo kwitabira Mercedes Benz African Fashion Festival 2017 i Accra muri Ghana ahubwo narabikoreye.” Yakomeje agira ati “Mu minsi itanu namaze, nungutse byinshi byiza ku bijyanye n’uburyo abantu baho bategura ibirori by’imideli biri ku yindi ntera yo hejuru, nanahaboneye n’amahirwe yo guhura n’abashoramari bakomeye mu by’imideli nubwo igihe cyo kubitangaza byose kigihari.” Niyitanga avuga ko yavuye muri ibi birori abashije kwereka ababyitaniriye imideli yakoze ku buryo byabasigiye ishusho y’iterambere uwo mwuga ugezeho mu Rwanda. Uyu musore amaze gukorana n’abanyamideli bakomeye n’abahanzi bazwi barimo Yvan Buravan na Mr. Eazi yambitse ubwo aheruka gukorera igitaramo i Kigali. Imideli ya Tanga Designs yamuritswe muri Ghana

title: Uwase ari mu banyamideli bo mu bihugu 50 bazitabira World Next Top Model
content: World Next Top Model ni rushanwa ngarukamwaka rihuza abanyamideli bo mu bihugu bitandukanye byo ku Isi, bahatanira ikamba riruta ayandi mu berekana imideli maze uryegukanye akaba ari we uhangwa amaso nk’umunyamideli uzaba ukomeye ku Isi mu gihe kizaza. Irushanwa ry’uyu mwaka rizaba kuva ku itariki ya 14 Nyakanga kugeza kuwa 5 Kanama 2017, rizabera mu Mujyi wa Beirut muri Liban. Kuri iyi nshuro ya 18 hatumiwe abanyamideli bagera kuri 44 bo mu bihugu birenga 50 byo ku migabane itandukanye. Muri aba banyamideli batoranyijwe uyu mwaka harimo umunyarwandakazi umwe Uwase Clementine [Tina] umaze imyaka ine yinjiye mu byo kumurika imideli nk’umwuga uhoraho. Uwase yabwiye IGIHE ko yishimiye kuba azaba ateye intambwe ikomeye mu kazi ke ko kwerekana imideli akaba asaba Abanyarwanda kuzamushyigikira muri iri rushanwa rizasozwa ku itariki ya 5 Kanama 2017. Uwase Clementine w’imyaka 21 yitabiriye ibikorwa bitandukanye by’imieli birimo Red Carpet Fashion Awards, Kigali Fashion Week 2017 na  Top Model Africa yabereye muri Zimbabwe agira n’amahirwe yo kubonana n’abategura World Next Top Model bahise bamuha ubutumire bwo kuzahangana n’abandi uyu mwaka.

title: Umwihariko udasanzwe mu birori by’imideli ya ‘Made in Rwanda’ (Amafoto)
content: Ibi birori by’imideli CollectiveRW Fashion Week byabereye mu ihema rya Kigali Conference and Exhibition Village[KCEV],  byateguwe n’ikompanyi Collective Rw.
