Iyi yashinzwe mu 2015, ihuriwemo n’abanyamideli bo mu Rwanda bagamije guteza imbere imideli yahangiwe mu Rwanda ndetse no kuzamura ireme ry’abakora uyu mwuga bakamenyekana ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Ibirori bya Collective Rw byitabiriwe n’abahanzi b’imideli batangije iki gikorwa Sonia Mugabo, Teta Isibo, Mathew Rugamba, Linda Mukangoga na Candy Basomingera. Muri uyu mwaka hiyongereyemo abashya barimo inzu z’imideli za Amizero,  Moshions na Uzi Collections. Imideli yerekanywe irimo amakanzu, amashati, amapantaro, inkweto, ibikapu byo mu moko yose, ingofero n’imirimbo inyuranye byose bikorerwa mu Rwanda. Iyi mideli yerekanwe muri ibi birori harimo iyakorewe mu Rwanda n’iyahanzwe n’abanyamideli mpuzamahanga. Ibirori byatangiye saa kumi n’imwe n’igice, abantu babanje gusangira, kungurana ibitekerezo no kwishima babifashijwemo n’umuziki uyunguruye wacurangwaga mu busitani bwa KCEV. Ku isaha ya saa tatu z’ijoro nibwo MC Regis Isheja na Kemiyondo Coutinho bari bayoboye ibirori batangije igikorwa ari nabwo abahanzi b’imideli icumi batangiye kwerekana ibyo bahanze. Mu ihema rya Akagera hari umuteguro ubereye ijisho ku buryo buri mutumirwa wese yarebaga ibirori nta kimukoma imbere. Abanyamideli biyerekanaga banyuranamo mu nzira zari zateguwe hagati mu bakunzi b’imideli ku buryo wabonaga ko batojwe kandi biteguye neza. Saa yine z’ijoro icyiciro cya mbere cy’imideli cyari gisojwe habaho undi mwanya wo gusangira, kungurana ibitekerezo  no gukata umuziki. Saa tanu z’ijoro ikindi cyiciro cy’imideli cyahise kimurikwa herekanwa ibyakozwe n’abahanzi bo muri Inzuki Designs, Haute Baso, House of Tayo na Sonia Mugabo. Umuhanzi w’imideli ukomeye muri Afurika y’Epfo Laduma Ngxokolo na we yerekanye imideli yahanze yiganjemo iyerekana akarango k’imyambaro yo mu muco w’iwabo. Yabaye n’umwe mu bahanzi berekanye imideli yishimiwe ku rwego rukomeye muri ibi birori. Icyumweru cyahariwe imideli cya CollectiveRW Fashion Week cyatangiye kuwa 6 Kamena 2017 kuri Repub Lounge iherereye ku Kimihurura. Mu ntangiriro abanyamideli bahawe amasomo arimo kubigisha kuba abanyamwuga no kumenya gukoresha iyi mpano. Umuhanga mu mideli witwa Rachel Young ni we wabahaye aya masomo. Ku munsi wa kabiri habaye imyiteguro nyir’izina y’ibirori, kuri uwo munsi Mizero Cedric ari muberekanye ubuhanga budasanzwe mu mideli aho yadoze ikanzu mu gihe kitarenze amasaha abiri ahita ayimurika. Nyuma habaye ikiganiro nyunguranabitekerezo cyahuje abafite ubumenyi mu by’imideli mu ngeri zitandukanye haba abo mu Rwanda n’abo mu mahanga barimo Laduma Ngxokolo wo muri South Africa, Lamic Kirabo wo muri Uganda, Paul Peter Siniga wo muri Tanzania, Sunny Dolat wo muri Kenya, Kemiyondo Coutinho waturutse muri Uganda na Lauren Rwema wo mu Rwanda. Mu byibanzweho muri iki cyumweru, abahanzi b’imideli bahurije hamwe imbaraga mu kuzamura no guteza imbere iby’imideli mu Rwanda ndetse bihaye umugambi umwe wo kugira umwimerere mu byo bakora haba abo mu gihugu n’abo mu bindi bihugu bya Afurika. Imideli yahanzwe na Haute Baso Imideli ya House of Tayo Sonia Mugabo amaze kwigaragaza nk’umuhanga mu guhanga Laduma Ngxokolo  yerekanye imideli y’iwabo muri Afurika y’Epfo Inzuki designs... Imideli yahanzwe na Mizero Imideli ya Moshions Amafoto: Mahoro Luqman

title: Laduma, umuhanzi w’imideli ukomeye agiye kuyimurikira i Kigali
content: Laduma Ngxokolo ukomoka muri Afurika y’Epfo mu gace ka Port Elizabeth, ni umwe mu bahanzi b’imideli bakomeye muri Afurika umaze no kumenyekana hirya no hino ku Isi bitewe n’umwimerere agaragaza mu myambaro akora ndetse no kwambika abantu b’ibyamamare batandukanye. Laduma yamenyekanye cyane biturutse ku nzu ya "Maxhosa" yashinze muri 2010, ikora imideli y’ubudodo igaragaramo uruvangitirane rw’amabara atandukanye agaragaza ubwiza n’umwimerere w’ibyo ahanga. Igikorwa cya “Collective Rw Week of Fashion” uyu muhanzi w’imideli yatumiwemo kizamara icyumweru, kizabera Camp Kigali, ku wa 10 Kamena 2017. Hazerekanwa imideli itandukanye yiganjemo ikorerwa mu Rwanda ndetse n’iyakozwe na Laduma. Umuyobozi w’itsinda ritegura iki gikorwa, Manzi Munana Derick, yabwiye IGIHE ko imyiteguro ikomeye y’iki gikorwa bayirangije igisigaye akaba ari ukwakira uyu muhanzi w’imideli ufite ibigwi akambika n’Abanyarwanda bakora umwuga wo kumurika imideli. Ati “Kuzana umuhanzi w’imideli uzwi ku isi ku rwego nk’urwe, ni byiza cyane kuko bituma uruganda rw’imideli rutera imbere kandi rukavugwa hose, tutiyibagije ko azambika abana b’Abanyarwanda bakora akazi ko kwerekana imideli.” Iki gikorwa cya “Collective Rw Week of Fashion” kizerekanirwamo imideli y’inzu icumi zikomeye mu Rwanda ari zo Haute-Baso, Inzuki Designs, House Of Tayo, Sonia Mugabo, UZI Collections, Moshions, Amizero, Ikwiize, Maxhosa ya Laduma na AFRIEK yo mu Buholandi. Ibikorwa bya Laduma byagiye bishimwa n’abantu bakomeye ku rwego mpuzamahanga barimo n’umuririmbyi Beyonce. Imyambaro ikorwa n’uyu mugabo inambarwa na Jidenna waririmbye ’Classic Man’. Yagiye yegukana ibihembo bitandukanye birimo icya Design Indaba cyitwa "Most Beautiful Object in South Africa", "Nelson Mandela Metropolitan University Rising Star Award", "Best Emerging Designer Award", "Marie Claire Prix D’Excellence" n’icya "ASFA" yatwaye mu mwaka ushize nk’umuhanzi mwiza w’imideli w’umwaka mu bakorera mu bihugu byo muri Afurika y’Amajyepfo. Nyuma yo kwerekana imideli akora mu nzu ya “Maxhosa” mu mijyi itandukanye ku Isi irimo Milan, Toyko, New York, Paris na London, ubu Laduma Ngxokolo amaso ayahanze i Kigali.

title: Umunya-Ireland yaguye ubucuruzi bw’imyambaro ikorerwa mu Rwanda kuri internet
content: Mu kwagura ubu bucuruzi, Lorcan Cathain ukomoka muri Ireland yatangije urubuga Ronkos.rw rugiye guhuza inzu zikora imyenda mu Rwanda n’abakiriya bazo bagahahirana nta nkomyi. Ronkos.rw igamije kwita ku igurisha n’igura ry’imyambaro izatuma uyikora akomeza akazi ke gasanzwe, bikamworohereza kubona isoko n’uyifuza akabona aho ayigura;   Uru rubuga rushyiraho imyambaro yose rwerekana n’inzu ziyikora. Mu mezi atandatu ashize uru rubuga rwegereye inzu zikora imyenda zirenga icumi ruri mu igeragezwa, muri zo  hari izakunze imikorere yarwo n’uburyo rucuruza. Ronkos.rw yafunguye ku mugaragaro ku ya 5 Gicurasi 2017. Kuva icyo gihe nyuma y’iminsi itatu gusa ibikorwa byarwo byageze ku bantu barenga ibihumbi mirongo ine, rwakira ubusabe bufite agaciro k’amafaranga miliyoni imwe n’igice. Igitekerezo cyo gutangiza uru rubuga Lorcan Cathain yakigize ubwo yari agiye guhahira mu isoko rya Kimironko akabona uburyo ryuzuye abantu benshi bifuza imyambaro ikorerwa mu Rwanda, bamwe ntibayibone. Cathain ukomoka muri Ireland yatangarije IGIHE ko yahise atekereza ku gutangiza isoko rimwe ryahuza inzu zose zikora imyambaro mu Rwanda bikazorohereza kwerekana imyambaro yazo n’umuguzi akagira amahitamo. Lorcan Cathain ateganya kwagura ibikorwa by’uru rubuga hanze y’u Rwanda mu kurushaho kwamamaza imyenda ikorerwa mu gihugu. Ronkos.rw yita ku igurisha n’igura, kwamamaza, guhuza abadozi n’abaguzi, kuganira n’abaguzi, gufotora imyambaro, kwakira amafaranga no kugeza imyambaro kuri nyirayo. Ku rubuga rwa Ronkos.rw  hari imyambaro myinshi aho umukiliya ahitamo uwo ahaka akawugura hanyuma bakawumushyira aho aherereye. Umukiriya ni we wihitiramo ingano y’umwenda yifuza ndetse ashobora no gutanga uko awifuza, bakamwoherereza abadozi bo gufata ibipimo, bakamudodera ibimukwiriye. Intego nyamukuru ya Ronkos.rw ni ugushyiraho ahantu hahurira ibikorwa byinshi byo kugura no kugurisha imyambaro ikorerwa mu Rwanda bityo bikorohereza ababibamo binateza imbere uruganda rw’imideli.

title: Amafoto y’ibirori bya Kigali Fashion Week byaranzwe n’imyambarire ihebuje
content: Ni ku nshuro ya karindwi Kigali Fashion Week ibaye nyuma y’izabaye mu myaka itandatu ishize. Ibirori by’uyu mwaka byabaye mu minsi itatu, byerekaniwemo imodoka, imyambaro isanzwe n’itamenyerewe ndetse n’ibindi bikorwa bitandukanye bigaragaza umwihariko n’intera ibijyanye no kumurika imideli bimaze kugeraho mu Rwanda. Ibirori bisoza byabaye mu ijoro ryo ku wa Gatandatu, tariki 27 Gicurasi 2017, byitabiriwe n’abantu b’ingeri zitandukanye barimo abanyamahanga n’abayobozi  mu nzengo nkuru z’igihugu na Minisitiri w’Imicungire y’Ibiza n’Impunzi, Seraphine Mukantabana wari waje gushyigikira iki gikorwa. Imyiyereko y’abanyamideli n’imyambarire yagaragaye muri Kigali Fashion Week byanyuze benshi mu bitabiriye, hashimwa cyane uburyo u Rwanda rugeze ku ntera yo kugirana imikoranire n’abatunganya imideli bakomeye baturuka mu bihugu byo hanze. Uwitwa Gatesi Yvette uri mu bitabiriye ibi birori waganiriye na IGIHE, yagize ati "Ibirori nabikunze cyane njye nabonye imyambaro ihebuje ku buryo nanjye nifuza kuyambara. Ikindi nishimiye kubona ni abakora imideli bo hanze baza bakambika abamurika imideli bo mu Rwanda. Ibi birori byari biyobowe n’umushyushyarugamba Makeda Mahedeo byagaragayemo imyiyereko y’abamurika imideli bagera kuri 60 bambitswe n’abayikora 15 barimo n’abaturutse hanze y’u Rwanda barindwi. Kigali Fashion Week y’uyu mwaka yitabiriwe n’abakora imyuga ijyanye n’imideli bo mu bihugu nka Cameroun, Sudani, Kenya, Uganda, u Buhinde, Nigeria, u Bwongereza, u Bubiligi, Afurika y’Epfo, Ethiopia, u Buyapani, u Burundi n’ahandi. Inzu z’imideli zirimo ’Delphine House of Fashion’, ’Tanga Designs’, ’Christa Bella’, ’Hakym Reagan’, ’Lupita Collection’, ’Cynthia Rupari’, ’Patrick Inkanda’, ’Fathia’ ni zimwe mu zerekanye imyambaro zikora muri ibi birori byatangijwe bwa mbere mu Rwanda mu 2011 bifite intego yo kuzamura abanyamideli.

title: Seraphina, inzu ikora imideli ibereye Abanyarwandakazi
content: Mu nkubiri y’ivuka ry’inzu z’imideli no muri Nzeri 2016 hashinzwe iyitwa ‘Seraphina’ yatangijwe na Ines Claudia Hirwa na mugenzi we Diane Umugwaneza, yazanye umwihariko wo gukora imyenda igaragaza umuco gakondo idakunze kugaragara ku isoko. Igitekerezo cyo gukora inzu y’imyenda, Ines Hirwa yagikuye mu Bubiligi, igihugu yagezemo afite imyaka ine y’amavuko akanagikuriramo. Agarutse mu Rwanda yashatse imyenda yari asanzwe abona hanze abantu bakunda kwambara no kugura arayibura; abibwiye inshuti ze zimushishikariza gutangiza inzu y’imyenda nibwo yahisemo kuyishinga  ayita Seraphina, izina rya Nyirakuru nawe wahoze ari umudozi. Ines Hirwa na mugenzi we batangije iyi nzu ya Seraphina nyuma y’imyaka ibiri bari mu myiteguro yo kuyitangiza. Yatangiranye n’umudozi umwe gusa n’igishoro cya miliyoni eshatu z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Nyuma y’amezi asaga umunani ishinze imizi ubu igenda ikura cyane ndetse n’imyambaro ihakorerwa iri gutumizwa buri munsi bitewe no kwishimirwa na buri wese n’umwihariko wo kugaragaza umuco w’Abanyarwanda. Ines Hirwa yagize ati “Twifuza gukora imyambaro izabera Abanyarwandakazi ariko n’abandi bo hanze bakayifuza, tuzi ko iyo dukoresheje umudozi w’Umunyarwanda, tugakorera mu Rwanda ndetse tugacuruza imyambaro ihavuye biteza imbere ubukungu bw’igihugu kandi natwe bikadushimisha kuko abantu bamenya ibivuye iwacu”. Intego ya Seraphina akaba ari ugukomeza kuba igisubizo mu gukora imyambaro yihariye itagaragara ku masoko haba ay’imbere mu gihugu no hanze yacyo. Seraphina iherereye mu iduka rya Bold Kigali riherereye mu nyubako ya Kigali Heights. Hirwa uri mu batangije Seraphina ari mu bitabiriye inama mpuzamahanga ‘Accelerate Summit 2016’ ndetse atoranywa muri ba rwiyemezamirimo 26 batanga icyizere.

title: Abanyamideli 60 bazitabira Kigali Fashion Week bamenyekanye (Amafoto)
content: Amajonjora y’ibanze yahuje abanyamideli bagera kuri 300 baturutse mu bihugu  birimo Kenya, u Bwongereza, Uganda, u Buhinde na Congo mu muhango wabaye ku Cyumweru tariki ya 14 Gicurasi 2017. Iki gikorwa cyamaze amasaha arenga atandatu cyabereye One Love ahazwi nko kwa Rasta ku Kimihurura. Ndayishimiye Daniel uri gutegura iki gikorwa yatangarije IGIHE ko Kigali Fashion Week izitabirwa n’abakora imideli baturuka ku migabane yose. Yagize ati “Kigali Fashion Week ni kimwe mu bikorwa bihuriza hamwe abantu bo mu ngeri zose bava mu bihugu bitandukanye bakaza kureba intera ikomeye abanyamideli bo mu Rwanda bamaze kugeraho ugereranyije n’abo mu bindi bihugu.  Muri uyu mwaka abakora imideli barimo n’Abanyarwanda bari kuzamuka bazagaragaza ibikorwa byabo.” Abanyamahanga bazabyitabira bazerekana ibikorwa byabo mu gihugu bambika abanyamideli b’Abanyarwanda. Ibirori bya Kigali Fashion Week biteganyijwe kuva kuya 25 kugeza ku ya 27 Gicurasi 2017, bizabera muri Serena Hotel.

title: Umuhanzi Nkurunziza yamuritse ubugeni bwerekanwa hakoreshejwe imideli (Amafoto)
content: Ku wa Kane tariki 4 Gicurasi 2017 abantu benshi biganjemo abanyamahanga n’abahanzi basanzwe basura Inema Art Center, bahuriye .....mu gikorwa cyari kigamije kwerekana ibikorwa by’ubugeni bitandukanye hakoreshejwe abanyamideli biyerekanaga babyambaye, ibimenyerewe nka ‘Fashion Show’ mu ndimi z’amahanga. Mu gice cya mbere cy’iki gikorwa abanyamideli 10 barimo abazwi cyane nka Jay Rwanda, Kalisa Winnie, Neza Rachel, biyerekanye bambaye ibihangano bisanzwe bimanikwa ku nkuta, banambaye inkweto zikozwe mu ibihingwa n’ibimera bisanzwe (Vegan) zakozwe n’uruganda rwa Native Shoes. Nkurunziza yatangarije IGIHE ko icyo yifuza ari uko ubugeni butera imbere cyane kuko azi ko buba ahantu hose no mu ruganda rw’imideli. Yagize ati “Iki gikorwa si icy’ubugeni gusa cyangwa imideli gusa ahubwo byose birajyana kuko byose bisaba ko umuntu aba umuhanzi kugira ngo abikore.” Yakomeje avuga ko iyi ari intangiriro kuko yifuza kuzageza no hanze y’u Rwanda ubu buryo budasanzwe bwo kwerekana ubugeni hakoreshejwe imideli. Ashishikariza abantu kwerekana impano zabo kandi bakazirikana gukoresha ibintu bisanzwe bafite mu buzima bwabo bwa buri munsi batagendeye ku bituruka mu Isi y’ikoranabuhanga. Iki gikorwa cyitabiriwe na bamwe mu bahanzi barimo, Jolie Claudine Murenzi uzwi cyane mu ruhando rwa sinema, washimye cyane ibikorwa bya Nkurunziza. Yagize ati “Nkurunziza ni umuhanzi mu birebana n’imideli wuzuye [fashion designer], ntabwo ari umutayeri [tailleur] nka benshi mu bo tubona hano hanze bakunze kwiyita ko bahanga imideli.” Asobanura ko impamvu amwemera nk’umuhanzi ari uko ibihangano bye ubisangana umwihariko udashobora kubona ahandi. Inema Art Center ni itsinda ry’abahanzi 10 b’ubugeni b’abanyarwanda bishyize hamwe bagamije guhuza impano yabo yo gushushanya no kuyibyazamo umurimo wabatunga, cyane cyane ibijyanye n’ubugeni Nyafurika, ubukorikori, umuziki n’imbyino. Abahanzi bo mu nzu Inema bakora ubugeni bwo gushushanya [Painting], gukora ibibumbano [Sculpture], n’ibihangano bimanikwa ku nkuta. Inema Art Center itanga n’amahugurwa n’ubumenyingiro mu bijyanye n’ubugeni.

title: Abasore n’inkumi barindwi bazaserukira u Rwanda mu iserukiramuco ry’imideli muri Guinée
content: Iserukiramuco ‘Festival International de la Mode Guinéenne’ rimaze kumenyekana muri Afurika, ni ku nshuro ya gatatu rigiye kuba. Iry’uyu mwaka rizamara icyumweru guhera kuwa 8 Gicurasi kugeza ku itariki ya 13 Gicurasi 2017. Abahanzi b’imideli n’aberekana imideli bazahagararira u Rwanda barimo Franco Kabano ihuriro ry’abamurika imideli mu gihugu [Rwanda Fashion Models Union], Shema Ryabasinga , Cissy Ngamije, Mucyo Sandrine, Ntabanganyimana Jean de Dieu [Jay Rwanda], Ganza Irihose Jean Fidèle [Ganza Gabey] ndetse na Sekamana Eric Louis . Iri serukiramuco risanzwe ritegurwa na Bah Alpha Oumar Ly abicishije mu nzu y’imideli yitwa Alphao Fashion ku bufatanye na Minisiteri ya Siporo, Umuco, umurage n’amateka muri  Guinée. Mu kiganiro Bah Alpha Oumar Ly yagiranye n’ikinyamakuru Guinée Matin, yavuze ko icyerekezo iri serukiramuco rifite ari ugufasha urubyiruko rwa Afurika n’urwa Guinée by’umwihariko kwiteza imbere binyuze mu guhanga umurimo no kubyaza inyungu ubuhanzi n’impano ya buri wese. Yagize ati “Icyerekezo nyamukuru dufite ni ukuzamura impano z’urubyiruko no guteza imbere gahunda yo gutungwa n’impano, waba uri umunyamideli cyangwa wambika abantu. Twahereye mu gihugu imbere tunareba no mu bindi bihugu aho imideli igenda izamuka…” Alpha yavuze ko uyu mwaka hatumiwe abanyamideli bo mu bihugu 14 hakiyongeraho na Guinée izaba ihagarariwe n’abasore n’inkumi 15 bazatoranywa mu gihugu hose. Ibi bihugu byatumiwe bizerekana imideli buri wese mu cyiciro cye mu kugaragaza umwihariko wa buri gace ka Afurika mu birori bizaba kuwa 12 Gicurasi 2017.

title: Ibikwiye kuranga abitabira urugendo rwo kwibuka
content: Bamwe mu bitabira uru rugendo ruzwi nka Walk to remember biganjemo urubyiruko, bakunze kuvugwaho kutaruha uburemere n’agaciro rukwiye, aho abenshi bivugwa ko bambara imyambaro idakwiriye, abandi bakagenda baganira, abandi  bashyize mu matwi ’ecouteur’ bagenda biyumvira imiziki, ibyo abenshi babona nk’ibidakwiye. Urubyiruko rutandukanye rwiganjemo abanyeshuri bari mu biruhuko, batanze ibitekerezo by’imyitwarire ikwiye kuranga umuntu uba witabiriye urugendo rwo kwibuka, mu rwego rwo kuruha agaciro rukwiye. Kayisire Kevin utuye i Nyarutarama yagize ati “ Walk to Remember ni urugendo rwo kwibuka ariko abenshi bajyayo basa n’abagiye guhura n’inshuti zabo. Ibyo ntibikabe ahubwo mbona ibyiza ari uko bazirikana kwambara amabara asanzwe akoreshwa mu igihe cyo kwibuka nk’umukara, Ibara risa nk’ivu cyangwa umweru naho hasi bakambara imyenda itabafashe cyane ku buryo biteza ikibazo.” Elie Gashagaza utuye i Gikondo we yatubwiye ko imyambarire idafite icyo ivuze cyane ahubwo ko abantu bitabira uru rugendo bakwiriye kwita ku myitwarire yabo mu gihe barukora birinda kuganira cyangwa ngo basakuze ku buryo byateza umutekano muke. Isimbi Ines utuye Kicukiro na mugenzi we Kevin Mujiji utuye Kimironko bombi  bagarutse ku ihame ry’uko buri wese ugiye mu rugendo rwo kwibuka, akwiye kumva uburemere bw’icyo gikorwa n’ubusobanuro bwacyo bityo akambara ku buryo atanengwa n’abo bari kumwe. Umutoni Fiona, umwe mu bakurikiranira hafi itegurwa ry’urwo rugendo akaba anafite inshingano zo kwandika urubyiruko rwitabira yabwiye IGIHE ko hari imyambaro idakwiriye gukoreshwa n’abitabira urugendo rwo kwibuka nk’ipantaro icitse (Dechirée), imyambaro ifite ibara ry’umutuku, imyenda iriho ibishushanyo bitera ubwoba nk’uduhanga, amaraso, intwaro n’ibindi. Uwitabira uru rugendo kandi ngo ntabwo akwiriye kwambara ingofero cyangwa se utwuma bashyira mu matwi bumva indirimbo. Abari n’abategarugori kandi ngo ntibakwiriye no kwishyiraho ibyongera ubwiza byinshi. Uyu mwaka, urugendo rwo kwibuka ruratangira saa kumi n’imwe n’igice z’umugoroba aho abarwitabira bahagurukira ku ngoro y’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko berekeza kuri Stade Amahoro ahari bukomereze ijoro ryo kwibuka.

title: Hatangijwe irushanwa ry’abafite impano zo kumurika imideli mu bakiri bato i Kigali (Amafoto)
content: CCAP yatangije iki gikorwa ku mugaragaro kuwa 2 Mata 2017 mu birori byabereye ku nyubako y’Umurenge wa Remera binyuze mu irushanwa ryiswe “CCA Style Awards” rigamije guteza imbere urubyiruko rufite impano yo gukora imideli (Fashion Designing) no kuyerekana mu ruhame (Modelling). Rutamu Omar ukuriye CCAP yatangaje ko ibi bikorwa bigamije gutinyura urubyiruko rufite impano. Ati “Twe tugamije guteza imbere urubyiruko kugira ngo rureke kwitinya kandi rugire uruhare mu kubaka igihugu no kugera ku nzozi zabo, muri CCAP twakira impano zose maze duharanira kuziteza imbere.” Irushanwa rya CCA Style Awards ryahuje amatsinda umunani ahatanira gutwara icyo gihembo, yiyerekana imbere y’akanama nkemurampaka; agera kuri atatu niyo  yatoranyijwe  ahabwa amahirwe yo gukomeza mu irushanwa. Abakomeje mu kindi cyiciro barimo Planet Fashion Agency, Young Generation Models Agency na 1000 Hills Agency. Ku nshuro ya mbere, ibi bikorwa byatewe inkunga n’Umurenge wa Remera ndetse na Goshen Finance. Abitabiriye ibi birori basusurukijwe n’umuhanzikazi ukunzwe by’umwihariko mu njyana gakondo Mariya Yohana wari waje gushyigikira urubyiruko.

title: Menya ihame rikomeye cyane ryagufasha kwambara neza ukaberwa
content: Icyo buri wese akwiye kumenya ni abantu duteye mu buryo butandukanye, ndahamya neza ko icyo ikintu wari ukizi ariko ushobora kuba wibaza aho bihuriye n’imyambarire ariko igisubizo si ikindi ahubwo ni uko buri wese akwiye kwambara imyenda ijyanye n’uwo ariwe aho kwambara ijyanye n’ibigezweho. Abantu benshi bakunze gukora amakosa atababarirwa mu myambarire aho babona umwenda mushya wambawe n’ikirangirire mu ndirimbo runaka cyangwa umuhanzi bakunda yashyize hanze urukweto runaka bakajya kurugura bakiyibagiza ko ibibereye abo bantu bo hari igihe bitababera. Urugero rw’imiterere y’umugabo Umusore w’imyaka 24 ukora imyitozo ngororamubiri buri umunsi, ujya mu mbyumba byabugenewe agaterura ibiremereye (Gym) ntazagira umubiri umwe nk’umugabo ufite imyaka 62 uhora wicaye mu biro aho amara amasaha arenze umunani buri umunsi. Bitewe n’uko imibiri yabo idateye kimwe nta nubwo bakwiye kwambara kimwe ahubwo buri wese akwiriye kureba imyambaro ijyanye n’imiterere ye mbere y’uko areba igezweho cyangwa se ifite amabara akunda. Irindi banga ni uko buri wese akwiriye kumenya umubiri we neza ndetse akamenya icyamubera n’ikitamubera bityo mu ihitamo ry’umwambaro ari bwambare akagendera ku mwenda umwerekana uko yifuza kugaragara. Mu inkuru zacu zitaha tuzakomeza kwiyungura ubumenyi mu byerekeye imyambarire n’ibigendanye nayo ku buryo tubikurikije twazajya dutambukana umucyo aho tunyuze hose ariko mwibuke kandi muzirikane ihame twarebeye hamwe kandi ntimukibagirwe ko tugomba kwambara ibijyanye n’imiterere yacu aho kwambara ibigezweho.

title: Haute Baso, inzu imaze kuba ubukombe mu by’imideli mu Rwanda
content: Iyi nzu y’imideli yatangijwe n’abagore babiri, bari basanzwe buri wese ku giti cye ahanga imideli, nyuma yo kuganira bahitamo gukorera hamwe kuko basanze guhuza imbaraga byatuma barushaho kubona umusaruro. Umwe muri bo yari asanzwe afite inzu y’imideli yitwaga ‘Haute Rwanda’, yakoraga ibijyanye n’imitako n’amasakoshi, undi akorera muri ‘Baso Designs’ yakoraga imyenda, ari nabyo byaje guhuzwa havuka “Haute Baso”. Mu kiganiro IGIHE yagiranye n’umwe mu bashinze iyi nzu y’imideli yasobanuye ko batangiriye ku gishoro cy’ibihumbi bibiri by’amadolari gusa ndetse ngo babanje kumenyekanisha imyambaro bahanga no kuyikwirakwiza binyuza ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Ati “Twatangiye ducururiza ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, ntabwo twari dufite iduka. Twashyize imbaraga mu kugira urubuga rwa internet na Facebook. Abantu baratwandikiraga bakatubwira ngo turashaka iki, tukakibashyira.” Mu Ukwakira 2014 nibwo Haute Baso yashinze iduka ryayo rya mbere, bikaba byaragezweho nyuma yo kwizigama amafaranga bakuraga mu gucururiza ku mbugankoranyambaga. Ubu bafite ababahagarariye muri Kenya no muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Kuva batangira, bagiye bagira amahirwe menshi yo kumurika imideli bahanga ahantu hatandukanye ndetse bakaba bashima ubufasha leta y’u Rwanda n’Urugaga rw’abikorera, PSF bidahwema guha ba rwiyemezamirimo bakiri bato. Mu mpera za 2014, bagize amahirwe yo guhabwa inkunga ya $80000 n’Umuryango Spring usanzwe ufasha imishinga ishobora kuzana impinduka mu bihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere by’umwihariko ku bakobwa. Aya mafaranga yatumye bagura ibikoresho byinshi bakenera mu guhanga imideli yabo, kuko ubusanzwe bakorana n’amakoperative abadodera, ariko ibikenewe byose babyizaniye. Bamuritse ibyo bakora mu bihugu birimo na Afurika y’Epfo Umwe muri aba yatangiye ibijyanye n’imideli ubwo yigaga kaminuza hanze y’u Rwanda yaza mu biruhuko abantu bakamutuma impano akuye mu Rwanda. Ati “Hari nko mu 2007, mama wanjye yabaga inaha nkaza kumusura.  Nta bindi bintu byiza byahabaga washyira abantu nk’impano. Natangiye gukora utuntu duke nkabijyana, abantu bakampa amafaranga. Hari umugore nari nzi ubizi nahitagamo ibyo ankorera.” Nyuma yo gufata umwanzuro wo kubikora nk’umuyoboro wo kugaragaza ibitekerezo bye, yaje guhura na mugenzi we batangira gufatanya urugendo binyuze muri Haute Baso. Ati “Kiriya gihe ibijyanye n’imideli ntabwo byafatwaga nk’akazi, byari bigoye kubwira umuntu ngo aguhe inguzanyo utangira inzu y’imideli, ubu bwo birashoboka. Twebwe twakoresheje ayo twari dufite, buri wese yazanye uruhare rwe tuyashora mu kugura ibikoresho.” Yagaragaje ko bigoye kugaragaza amafaranga bamaze kunguka mu bikorwa byabo, kuko inyungu yose babonye bongera bagashora mu bikorwa byabo kugira ngo bikomeze kwaguka. Ati ”Kuri njye ntabwo mbibara mu mafaranga, ni umubare w’abantu dufite ubushobozi bwo gukoresha. Twatangiranye n’abantu bane, mu gihe kitageze ku myaka ibiri tugeze kuri 27. Umubare w’abanyabukorikori dushobora gukorana na bo bitari umunsi umwe ahubwo igihe cyose, iryo ni ryo terambere rya Haute Baso.” Aba bahanzi b’imideli kandi bamaze kwitabira ibikorwa byo kumurika imideli bitandukanye by’imideli Kampala Fashion Week (Uganda), Origin Africa Trade Show (Madagascar), Collective Rw na  Mercedes Benz Fashion Week (Afurika y’Epfo), iza mu bikomeye cyane muri Afurika. Banambitse kandi ibyamamare bitandukanye birimo n’abagize Itsinda rya Saut Sol ryo muri Kenya.  Gutumiza ibikoresho hanze biracyari inzitizi Kuba ibikoresho byinshi bakenera babitumiza mu mahanga, bituma bahendwa cyane, ari nabyo bituma igiciro cy’imyenda ikorerwa mu Rwanda kijya hejuru ugereranyije n’ibindi biva hanze. Hari icyizere ko bizahinduka ariko, kuko u Rwanda ruherutse gufata umwanzuro wo kudasoreha ibikoresho byifashishwa mu budozi. Kuba bakiri bato kandi ngo bituma hari bamwe badaha agaciro gakwiye ibyo bakora, ariko na none bakishimira ko u Rwanda rushyigikira ba rwiyemezamirimo by’umwihariko abagore. ‘Made in Rwanda’ yaje ari igisubizo Gahunda ya ‘Made in Rwanda’ igamije gushishikariza abanyarwanda gukoresha ibikorerwa mu gihugu, bayibona nk’uburyo bwo gutuma ibyo bakora bitera imbere kurushaho. Ati “Urabizi ubu bari guca imyenda ya caguwa, ibi bizateza imbere ubucuruzi nk’ubwacu. Ni byiza ko turi kugira uruhare mu gushyiraho uburyo buzatuma ubucuruzi bwacu butera imbere […] Mu gihe caguwa idahari abantu benshi bazakenera kwambara.” Amafoto ya bimwe mu bikorwa bya Haute Baso

title: Mimi Mirage wamamaje imyenda ya Beyonce agiye gutangiza ibikorwa bye mu Rwanda
content: Uyu mukobwa uzwi cyane nka Mimi Mirage yabwiye IGIHE ko mu myaka ibiri amaze atangiye ibikorwa byo kwerekana imideli amaze kugera ku rwego rukomeye ari nayo mpamvu yifuza kuza gusangiza Abanyarwanda ubumenyi yungutse no gutangiza uburyo bushya bwatuma abanyamideli bo mu Rwanda bamenyekana byisumbuyeho. Mimi Mirage ngo yamamarije ibikorwa by’imideli ikorerwa muri House of Deréon yashinzwe na Beyonce afatanyije na nyina Tina Knowles mu mwaka wa 2006, aba bombi bayitangije mu guha icyubahiro Agnèz Deréon [nyirakuru wa Beyonce]. Yavuze ko yanakoze nk’umunyamideli wamamaza imyenda y’abagore ya Apple Bottoms, iyi yatangijwe n’umuraperi Nelly afatanyije na Yomi Martin ndetse na Ian Kelly. Yagize ati “Nakoze ibikorwa byo kwamamaza bitandukanye, namamije Deréon ya Beyonce hari n’igikorwa cyo kwamamaza Apple Bottoms y’umuraperi Nelly nakoze, mu myaka ibiri maze nkora uyu mwuga wo kwerekana imideli nakoranye n’inzu zitandukanye z’imideli mu Bubiligi, hari n’ibindi bikorwa binini natumiwemo.” Yavuze ko ari umwuga yakoze nk’impano yiyumvamo, ahamya ko ntaho yabikomoye kuko ‘nta muntu umwe wihariye mu byo kwerekana imideli afatiraho urugero’. Ati “Nta muntu umwe wihariye mfata nk’icyitegererezo kuri njyewe, mbona benshi ariko ku giti cyanjye ndabikunda.” Karuranga Mimi Mirage yemeza ko afite inzu zikomeye z’imideli akorana na zo zirimo Maza Boetiek , Class Roberto Cavalli, Vcj Versace n’izindi. Mu kwerekana imideli ngo yibanda cyane mu Bufaransa no mu Bubiligi aho atuye ariko ngo arifuza ko mu mwaka wa 2017 yatangira kwigaragaza nk’umunyamwuga wifuza kubikorera iwabo mu Rwanda. Mugisha Frank uyobora Kigaliwood Photo yavuze ko bafitanye imikoranire na Mimi Mirage ndetse ngo hari umushinga ukomeye bazatangira gukorana na we bitarenze muri Mata 2017. Yagize ati “Yitegura kuza mu Rwanda aho azakorana na Kigaliwood mu bijyanye no kumufata amafoto yo kwamamaza mu buryo butandukanye, hari n’indi mishinga dufitanye, ibi yashatse kubikora nyuma y’igihe kinini ataba mu Rwanda kugirango naho ahagaragaze ibikorwa bye bimaze kumenyekana hanze.”

title: I Kigali hateguwe ibirori bizitabirwa n’abambaye ibitenge gusa
content: Byari bimenyerewe ko habaho ibirori bihuriza hamwe abambaye ibyererana, umutuku n’andi mabara atandukanye, kuri iyi nshuro hateguwe ibizitabirwa n’abambaye imyenda ikozwe mu gitenge yakorewe mu Rwanda. Ibi birori ngarukamwaka byiswe ‘Kitenge Dress Code Dinner’ bigiye kubera i Kigali biri mu murongo wo guteza imbere ibyakorewe mu Rwanda. Umuyobozi wa The Business Mag yateguye iki gikorwa, Aimable Ngendahayo yabwiye IGIHE ko intego nyamukuru bafite ari ugushishikariza abantu kugira umutima wo gukunda ibikorerwa mu Rwanda kugira ngo ababikora babashe gutera imbere. Ati “Intego yacu n’icyo tugamije ni ukugira ngo duteze imbere ‘Made in Rwanda’ kuko iyo witegereje abantu benshi muri iyi minsi binjiye mu gukora iby’iwacu badasize inyuma n’ibyo kwambara.” Yakomeje avuga ko iki ari igikorwa kizajya kibaho buri mwaka hagamijwe gukangurira abanyarwanda kugura ibikorerwa mu gihugu kugira ngo bateze imbere ababikora. Yanavuze ku mpamvu usanga imyambaro ikorerwa mu Rwanda igifite ibiciro bihanitse n’uburyo icyo kibazo cyakemuka. Ati “Mu by’ukuri impamvu bihenda, ni uko uba usanga abanyarwanda batarakangukira kubigura, ariko babaye babigura igiciro cyagabanuka, usanga n’ubikora akora bicye kubera aba avuga ngo ‘ndakora byinshi bizagurwa na nde?’, noneho ako yakoze kamwe cyangwa tubiri akagahenda, ariko haramutse habonetse abakiriya babigura byahenduka.” “Iyo rero abaguzi batabagana ari benshi bituma n’ibyo bakora bihenda, ariko iyo bakoze byinshi bakabona abaguzi bituma n’igiciro kijya hasi, niyo mpamvu rero twahisemo gutegura iki gikorwa kugira ngo tumeyekanishe ibikorerwa iwacu ariko nanone tunashyigikira ba bantu binjiye muri Fashion Design kugira ngo babone abaguzi. Ntanze nk’urugero, abantu bazitabira ibi birori bagomba kuba bambaye igitenge, nta handi bazagikura rero bazagikura muri ba bandi babidoda bitume na bo batera imbera.” Abakora ibikorwa bitandukanye birimo guhanga imyambaro ikozwe mu gitenge bazahabwa umwanya muri ibi birori kuko hazerekanwa imideli (fashion show) itandukanye y’amoko menshi ishobora gukorwa mu gitenge. Abanyamideli batandukanye baziyerekana mu myenda ikozwe mu gitenge, habeho gufata ifunguro ku bitabiriye bizaherekezwa n’umuziki. Ibi birori bizitabirwa n’abambaye imyenda ikozwe mu gitenge biteganyijwe kubera i Kigali muri Car Free Zone ku wa 18 Gashyantare 2017 guhera ku saa kumi n’imwe z’umugoroba kugeza mu masaha akuze, kwinjira muri iyi Dinner ni amafaranga y’u Rwanda 10,000 Frw azaba arimo icyo kurya n’icyo kunywa.

title: Kanye West agiye kumurika ikindi cyiciro cy’imideli yahanze
content: Uyu muraperi uri mu bavugwaho cyane muri USA, mu cyiciro cya gatatu cy’imideli ye yaherukaga kumurika indi myambaro yahanze yifashishije ifoto yafatiwe mu Rwanda mu nkambi ya Kibeho mu Karere ka Nyaruguru mu 1995. Ifoto yagendeyeho ategura iyo ishusho y’uburyo abanyamideli bagombaga kugaragara, yafashwe n’Umwongereza witwa Paul Lowe mu 1995 i Kibeho mu Majyepfo y’u Rwanda. US Magazine ivuga ko uyu muraperi agiye kumurika ubwoko butandukanye bw’imideli yahanze yo mu cyiciro cya gatanu mu yo yise ’Yeezy’. Biteganyijwe ko azerekana iyi myambaro mu cyumweru cyahariwe imideli cya ’New York Fashion Week’ yaherukaga kumurikiramo icyiciro cya kane. Umwe mu bantu ba hafi b’umuryango w’aba-Kardashians yabwiye iki kinyamakuru ko guhera kuri Kim Kardashian kugeza no ku bana babo bari mu myiteguro yo gutera ingabo mu bitugu Kanye West. Imideli mishya Kanye West yahanze azayimurikira ahitwa Pier 59 Studios muri Manhattan nyuma y’uko muri Nzeri 2016, yari yakoreye icyo gikorwa Franklin D. Roosevelt Four Freedoms Park hakagora abanyamideli bitewe n’ubushyuhe bwinshi bwari buhari. Mbere y’uko agera ku cyiciro cya tatu cy’imideli yahanze yari yabanje gukora ikindi cyiciro mu ntangiriro za 2016, icyo gihe yatunguye abitabiriye ibirori bitewe n’uburyo yari yambitsemo abanyamideli be.

title: Ubwoko bw’amavuta n’ibirungo umugore wa Trump yari yisize mu muhango w’irahira ry’umugabo we
content: Mu mihango itandukanye yaranze uyu munsi, Melania Trump wahoze ari umunyamideli yari yabukereye aho mu maso yari yasizwe n’uwitwa Nicole Bryl n’aho imisatsi ye itunganywa na Mordechai Alvow. Aba bombi babwiye US Weekly ko kuri uriya munsi, ibyakoreshejwe mu maso no mu musatsi we byatwaye amadorali 901 (asaga ibihumbi 700 by’amafaranga y’u Rwanda). Bryl yavuze ko amazi yifashishwa mu gutuma uruhu ruba rutoto (Face Lifting Water) yakoreshejwe yaguzwe amadorali 450 n’aho umuti utuma uruhu rurushaho gusa neza (Face Perfecting Serum) ugurwa amadorali 225, kubitegura bikaba byaratwaye amasaha 46. Andi mafaranga asigaye yakoreshejwe mu bindi birungo byakoreshejwe mu gusiga ibice bitandukanye birimo mu maso. Alvow wamusokoje yavuze ko bahisemo gusa n’abafungira imisatsi inyuma, mike akaba ariyo iza mu maso, kugira ngo itaza kubangamira ikanzu yari yambaye yahanzwe ku bufatanye n’umuhanzi w’imideli witwa Ralph Lauren. Insokozo, ibirungo n’imyenda yari yambaye kandi biri mu byagize uruhare mu gutuma imiterere ye yifuzwa n’abatari bake irushaho kugaragara.

title: Abantu 10 bahamijwe icyaha cyo kwiba Kim Kardashian i Paris
content: Mu masaha ashyira igitondo cyo ku wa 3 Ukwakira 2016 nibwo Kim Kardashian yacucuwe n’abajura babiri bambaye imyenda nk’iya Polisi, bamufatiyeho imbunda ubwo bari bamusanze mu cyumba cya hoteli yitwa “No Adress” yari acumbitsemo mu Mujyi wa Paris. AFP yatangaje ko ku wa Kane w’iki Cyumweru umucamanza wo mu Bufaransa ukurikirana ikirego cy’abibye uyu munyamideli uzwi cyane ku Isi aribwo yanzuye ko abantu bane muri 17 bahamwa n’ibyaha bari bakurikiranyweho. Abandi batandatu nabo ku wa Gatanu w’iki Cyumweru urukiko rw’i Paris rwemeje ko bakomeza kuba bafunzwe kuko hari ibimenyetso simusiga byatanzwe n’ubushinjacyaha bigaragaza uruhare bagize muri ubwo bujura. Umwe mu bafashwe wahawe izina rya “Omar the Old” ni we bivugwa ko yateguye umugambi wo kwiba Kim Kardashian, uyu ngo banasanze DNA ye ihura neza n’ibimenyetso byavuye mu perereza rya Polisi, byemezwa ko ari mu waziritse Kim Kardashian ubwo yibwaga. Abahamijwe kugira uruhare mu bujura bwakorewe Kim Kardashian ni abagabo icyenda ndetse n’umugore umwe. Mu bafashwe harimo abafite imyaka 27 kugeza kuri 74. Ntiharatangazwa ibijyanye n’ibihano aba bahamijwe kwiba Kim Kardashian bazahabwa, gusa amakuru atangazwa n’ikinyamakuru The Mirror cyo mu Bwongereza avuga ko bazakatirwa igihano cy’igifungo muri gereza. Umushoferi watwaraga Kim Kardashian mu Bufaransa aho yibiwe we yararekuwe, murumuna we aba ari we ufatwa. Bivugwa ko abahamijwe kwiba Kim Kardashian basanzwe ari abajura ruharwa mu gatsiko k’abayogoje u Bufaransa n’u Bubiligi biba imitako y’agaciro. Muri iki gihe Kim Kardashian ari mu Mujyi wa Dubai mu ruzinduko rwe rwa mbere kuva yafatirwaho imbunda mu Bufaransa. Mu Ukwakira akimara kwibwa yahise ava mu Bufaransa igitaraganya, yohererejwe indege ye bwite imusubiza muri Amerika aho asanzwe atuye n’umuryango we. Yongeye kubivugaho haciyeho igihe. Mu cyumba yari afitemo amafaranga yo kwifashisha n’imirimbo y’agaciro ifite agaciro ka miliyoni esheshatu z’amadolari, ibi byose abajura barabikukumbye barabyandurukana ntibamenyekana. Kim Kardashian kandi bamwibye impeta ihenze yambitswe n’umugabo we Kanye West, iyi ifite agaciro ka miliyoni enye z’amadolari ya Amerika. Mu byo bamwibye harimo telefone ebyiri zihenze, ngo hari imwe yari irimo amabanga menshi ye.

title: Umwihariko mu birori by’imideli ya ‘Made in Rwanda’ (Amafoto)
content: Ibi birori by’imideli byari byiswe ‘Made in Rwanda Fashion Night Out’ byateguwe n’abahanzi b’imideli bitabiriye imurikagurisha ry’ibyakorewe mu Rwanda. Aba bahanzi bagamije guteza imbere imideli yahangiwe mu Rwanda ndetse no kuzamura ireme ry’abakora uyu mwuga bakamenyekana ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Imideli yerekanywe irimo amakanzu, amashati, amapantaro, inkweto, ibikapu byo mu moko yose, ingofero n’imirimbo inyuranye byose bikorerwa mu Rwanda. Iyi mideli yakorewe mu Rwanda muri Sonia Mugabo,Uzi Collections, Inzuki Designs, Inkanda,Moshions,Haute Baso,Made in Kigali, Rwanda Clothing ndetse na Rupari Designs. Ibi birori byabereye ahasanzwe habera imurikagurisha i Gikondo gusa kuri iyi nshuro abamurikabikorwa baryitabiriye ni abacuruza ibyakorewe mu Rwanda gusa[Made in Rwanda]. Byari umwihariko ugereranyije n’ibindi birori byo kumurika imideli bisanzwe bimenyerewe mu Rwanda kuko abanyamideli bambaraga imideli mu mok anyuranye hanyuma bagahagarara mu matsinda hanyuma abaje kureba ibirori bakabazengurukamo bareba imideli baje kumurika ubishoboye agahita agura. Aba bahanzi b’imideli kandi bari bazanye imyenda, imitako n’ibindi basanzwe bakora ku buryo ibirori byabaye bibangikanye n’igikorwa cyo gusobanurira abari baje kwihera ijisho umwihariko wa buri nzu y’imideli. Sonia Mugabo umwe mu bahanzi b’imideli bitabiriye iki gikorwa yabwiye IGIHE ko ‘byamusigiye isomo ryiza no kurushaho kugira umuhate mu byo akora’. Ati “Ibikorwa nk’ibi byerekana ko Abanyarwanda baturi inyuma kandi ko bashaka kwambara ibintu byakorewe mu Rwanda, natwe biradusunika cyane ngo turusheho gukora cyane kandi byiza.” Yongeraho ati “Ibi byerekana ko nshyigikiye gahunda ya leta yo guteza imbere Made in Rwanda, kandi bishimangira ko turi muri gahunda nziza yo kwishakira imirimo. Nkanjye natangiye ndi umwe ariko ubu tumaze kuba abantu icumi.” Yavuze ko nyuma y’iri murikagurisha agiye gufungura iduka rinini muri Marriot Hotel mu kurushaho kwagura ibikorwa bye. Ati “Nyuma ya hano ngiye guhita mfungura iduka rindi muri Marriot Hotel, ni ugushyiramo ingufu tugakora cyane…” Ibi birori bibaye nyuma y’igihe gito habaye ikindi gikorwa kinini cyahurije hamwe abahanzi b’imideli bibanda cyane ku yakorewe mu Rwanda bibumbiye muri ikompanyi Collective Rw ari nayo benshi muri aba bamuritse ibikorwa byabo babarizwamo. Iri murikagurisha ry’ibikorerwa mu Rwanda ribaye ku nshuro ya kabiri, ryitabiriwe n’abanshoramari bari mu byiciro bitandukanye birimo, abakora ibijyanye n’u bwubatsi, ubuhinzi n’ubworozi, imyenda, ibikoresho by’isuku, ubukorikori, abatanga servise mu ikoranabuhanga n’ibindi. Imurikagurisha ry’uyu mwaka ku bikorerwa mu Rwanda rifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti “Duharanire kwigira duhaha iby’iwacu.” Amafoto: Mahoro Luqman

title: I Kigali hateguwe ibirori by’imideli bizakusanyirizwamo inkunga yo gufasha impunzi
content: Ni ibirori byiswe ‘Refugees Matter Show’ cyateguwe n’ikigo cyitwa Abigaelle Closet gisanzwe gikorera i Portland muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Iki kigo cyashinzwe n’urubyiruko rukomoka mu Rwanda no mu Burundi gikora kikanagurisha imyenda y’amoko atandukanye. Mu kiganiro n’umuyobozi wa Abigaelle Closet, Abigaelle Judicaelle Irakoze yabwiye IGIHE ko yagize iki gitekerezo cyo gukora ibi birori nyuma y’iminsi yari amaze i Kigali, yiyambaza abandi bantu batandukanye bakora umwuga nk’uwe ngo bafatanye gutegura iki gikorwa kizakusanyiriza hamwe amafaranga azajya gufasha impunzi mu nkambi ya Mahama mu Karere ka Kirehe. Yagize ati “Twifuje kubera ijwi abatarifite, kuba icyizere ku batagifite, ni muri urwo rwego twatekereje gukoresha kumurika imideli nka kimwe mu bikorwa byagira akamaro mu gufasha abatishoboye.” “Twateguye iki gikorwa mu rwego rwo gufasha impunzi z’Abarundi ziri mu nkambi ya Mahama, amafaranga azavamo yose azakoreshwa mu bikorwa by’ubufasha birimo kubagezaho ibikoresho nkenerwa, imyambaro n’ibindi tuzasanga ari ngombwa kuri bo.” Yongeyeho ko usibye amafaranga azakusanyirizwa muri iki gitaramo, abazitabira bashobora no kwitwaza imyambaro mizima itagikoreshwa mu rwego rwo kongera ingano y’imfashanyo izatangwa ku mpunzi ziri mu nkambi ya Mahama bifuje gufasha. Ibi birori by’imideli biteganyijwe kuba ku wa Gatanu tariki 16 Ukuboza 2016 muri Hotel des Milles Collines i Kigali guhera saa kumi n’ebyiri kugeza saa yine z’ijoro. Kizasusurutswa n’abahanzi batandukanye barimo Eric 1Key n’abanyarwenya barimo na Michael Sengazi uzaba n’umushyushyarugamba w’iki gitaramo. Abigaelle Closet yateguye iki gikorwa, izifatanya n’abandi bahanzi b’imideli barimo abo muri Uzuri K&Y ikora inkweto, abo muri ByAlpha Couture bakora ibijyanye n’imisatsi, Dokmai Rwanda n’abandi benshi. Imwe mu mideli ihangwa na Abigaelle Closet

title: ‘KGL’ umudeli mushya uje guhangana n’imyambaro ituruka mu mahanga
content: Inzu y’imideli ya DCIB[Dawn Central Investiment Bureau] icuruza imyenda ifite ibirango bya ‘KG’L[impine y’izina Kigali], ubuyobozi bwayo buvuga ko bazanye iyi myambaro mu rwego rwo gufasha leta mu rugendo rwo kugabanya ibiva mu mahanga bimika ibyakorewe mu Rwanda[Made in Rwanda]. Umuyobozi w’iyi nzu y’imideli, Habimana Felix yabwiye IGIHE ko iyi myenda iva mu mahanga itarangiye neza hanyuma yagezwa i Kigali bakayishyiraho ibirango bigaragaza ko yakozwe n’Abanyarwanda gusa ngo mu myaka iri imbere bizeye ko bazaba barabonye ubushobozi bagatangira kuyidoda kugeza isohotse yuzuye. Yagize ati “Navuga ko ibari yarakozweho imirimo imwe n’abantu bo mu mahanga kuko ibyo tuyikoramo tubitumiza mu Bushinwa hanyuma yagera inaha tugakoraho utuntu duke no kwandikaho aya magambo ubundi ikajya ku isoko.” Yongeyeho ko mu mpamvu nyamukuru zatumye bahitamo gusakaza imyenda yanditseho ‘KGL’ ngo ni uko babona abantu benshi mu Rwanda bambaye ibyanditseho amazina y’imijyi nka New York, Chicago n’ayandi. Ati “Gahunda yacu ni ukwambika Abanyarwanda imyenda bibonamo, biracyatubabaza kubona abantu bambaye imyenda yanditseho amazina y’ibindi bihugu n’indi mijyi izwi nyamara kubona uwambaye Kigali ntibipfa gukunda, icyo nicyo tuje gukemura.” Arongera ati “Ikituzanye ni ukwambika Abanyarwanda ibintu byiza, gahunda ya leta ihari ni uguteza imbere ibikorewe mu gihugu icyizere kirahari ko abakiriya bazaboneka kandi tuzakora ibishoboka bizanogere abazabyambara.” Habimana afatanyije na mugenzi we witwa Tuyishimire Desire, aba bombi bavuga ko imideli yabo izakundwa ku isoko kubera umwihariko ifite ndetse ngo itandukanye cyane n’indi yagiye icaracara  nayo ifite amagambo ajya gusa n’aya. Ati “Ubu turi mu biganiro na bamwe mu bahanzi ndetse n’abanyamideli bazadufasha kwamamaza no kumenyekanisha imyenda yacu. Intego twihaye ni uko mu gihe kitarenze umwaka umwe imyenda dukora igomba kuzaba yamaze kumenyekana kandi ari icyitegererezo mu gihugu.” Imideli batangiye gusakaza kugeza ubu harimo ingofero ndetse n’imipira yanditseho ‘KGL’. Ingofero bayigurisha amafaranga ibihumbi icumi[10,000frw] naho umupira ukagurishwa ibihumbi 30.

title: Iserukiramuco ry’imideli yo mu bukwe rigiye kubera i Kigali
content: Ibirori by’imideli yo mu bukwe [Wedding Fashion Show] bizabera i Kigali mu gihe cy’iminsi ibiri guhera ku itariki ya 9 Ukuboza kugeza kuwa 10 Ukuboza 2016. Mu kiganiro na IGIHE, Rusanganwa Laurent uyobora ikompanyi The Wedding Plus Ltd ari  nayo iri gutegura iki gikorwa yatangaje ko nyuma yo gutembera muri Uganda ,Kenya ndetse na Australia bakabona uburyo iserukiramuco ry’imideli yambarwa mu bukwe ihuruza abantu batagira ingano byabahaye imbaraga gufata bafata umwanzuro wo kubitegura mu Rwanda. Ati” Twasanze twarasigaye inyuma ntabwo ibi bintu byo kumurika imideli yambarwa mu bukwe abantu babizi. Nyamara ni igikorwa gituma ibikorerwa mu Rwanda bimenyekana ndetse n’abanyamahanga baba mu gihugu cyacu bakabizamo dore ko abo dutumira mu bukwe bwacu baba ari bake.” Rusanganwa yakomeje avuga ko iryo serukiramuco ry’imideli rizitabirwa n’inzu enye zikora imideli mu Rwanda ariko hakazibandwa ku yambarwa mu bukwe n’ibindi birori bisaba kurimba Ati” Kugira ngo duteze imbere gahunda ya Leta yo kumenyekanisha ibikorerwa mu Rwanda ,twatumiye Amazing Fashion Shop, ALTA Fashion and Decoration,Rupari Designs,Yozata, Monial Glamoor, abo bose bazamurika imideli bikorera mu guteza imbere Made in Rwanda” Iri serukiramuco ritamenyerewe mu Rwanda ni igikorwa kimwe mu bizaba bigize imurikagurisha ry’iminsi ibiri ryiswe Rwanda Wedding Expo rizahuriramo abafite ibikorwa bifite aho bihuriye no gutegura ubukwe. Abazamurika ibikorwa byabo muri Rwanda Wedding Expo ni abambika abageni, abatanga serivisi za decoration, abasokoza abageni, abakora cakes, sonorisation, abafotora abageni, abakora impeta, abacuruza amavuta yo kwisiga, abacuruza indabo, abakodesha imodoka zifashisha mu bukwe n’ibindi bitandukanye. Ibyo ngo bizafasha abafite ibirori bya vuba n’ababiteganya mu gihe kizaza kugira amakuru ahagije n’amahitamo menshi y’uwo bagomba guha akazi kabo. Rusanganwa Laurent ati” Usanga nkiyo uzi umuntu umwe gusa ufotora ukamuhamagara afite akazi kenshi hari ubwo yanga kukwitaba cyangwa akakurangira adakora neza ariko ubaye uzi abantu benshi byari kugufasha.” Iri serukiramuco rizamara iminsi ibiri, rizaba ku wa gatanu tariki ya 9 no ku wa gatandatu tariki ya 10 Ukuboza 2016, kwinjira bizaba ari ubuntu mu gusura abarimo kumurika ibikorwa byabo. Naho ku  mugoroba wo ku itariki ya 10 Ukuboza habe ibirori byo gusoza ari nabwo hazabaho igikorwa cy’iserukiramuco ry’imideli yambarwa mu bukwe kizatangira saa kumi n’imwe kugeza saa yine z’ijoro. Muri ibyo birori byo kwerekana imideli abazabyitabira bazasusurutswa n’abahanzi Charly na Nina ndetse na DJ Pius. Iryo serukiramuco riteganyijwe ko rizitabirwa n’abantu bagera ku gihumbi buri munsi ,rizabera mu Mujyi wa Kigali rwagati mu nyubako ya Kigali City Tower ahasanzwe habera ibitaramo. Ni igikorwa kigiye kujya kiba buri mwaka mu rwego rwo gufasha Abanyarwanda kudasigara inyuma mu kumenyekanisha ibyo bakora bijyanye n’imideli. [email protected]

title: Imyambarire idasanzwe yaranze ibirori by’imideli bya ‘Victoria’s Secret’ i Paris (Amafoto)
content: Ni ibirori bikomeye byabaye mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 30 Ugushyingo 2016 ahitwa Grand Palais mu Mujyi wa Paris mu Bufaransa. Victoria’s Secret Show’ yitabiriwe n’abanyamideli 51 bakomeye ku Isi barimo Alessandra Ambrosio, Adriana Lima, Taylor Hill, Jasmine Tookes, Kendall Jenner, abavandimwe Gigi na Bella Hadid, Lily Aldridge n’abandi banyuranye. Ku nshuro ya mbere kabiri, abanyamideli basanzwe ari inshuti Kendall Jenner na Gigi Hadid berekanye imideli muri ibi birori byahuruje imbaga mu Mujyi wa Paris. Abahanzi batandukanye barimo Lady Gaga, The Weeknd na Bruno Mars basusurukije ibi birori. Icyatunguranye ndetse kigashimisha benshi ni uburyo umunyamideli Bella Hadid yiyerekanye muri ibi birori ahura n’umuhanzi bahoze bakundana The Weeknd byongera ibyishimo mu bakurikiranye ibirori. Ibirori birangiye, muri Grand Palais hakwirakwijwe inkuru ihamya ko umunyamideli Irina Shayk wahoze akundana na Cristiano Ronaldo atwite inda ya Bradley Cooper gusa ababivuze nta gihamya batanze na nyir’ubwite kugeza ubu ntacyo yabivuzeho. Abitabiriye ibi birori baganiriye na ABC News bahamije ko ari byo bya mbere biruta ibindi byose byerekeranye n’imideli byabereye muri Grand Palais. Abategura iri murika ry’imideli rigamije no kwamamaza ibikorwa na Victoria’s Secret  bamaze kugera ku rwego rwo hejuru mu kwinjira amafaranga mu mideli, mu mwaka wa 2014/2015 ubukungu bwabo bwarazamutse bugera kuri miliyari 7.2 z’amadolari.

title: Jay D na Turahirwa bazaserukira u Rwanda mu mideli muri Tanzania na Nigeria
content: Ntabanganyimana Jean de Dieu [uzwi nka Jay D] na mugenzi we Turahirwa Moise [uyobora Moshions House] bari mu banyamideli bakomeye mu Karere bazitabira iserukiramuco ry’imideli rya Nigeria Men’s Fashion rizamara iminsi itatu ribera mu Mujyi wa Lagos. Aba bombi bazerekeza muri Nigeria kuwa 1 Ukuboza 2016, bazaba bitabiriye icyumweru cyahariwe imideli kizabera mu Mujyi wa Lagos. Jay D yabwiye IGIHE ko mbere yo kujya muri Nigeria hari ibindi bihembo batumiwemo bya Swahili Fashion Week Awards bizatangwa hasozwa iki cyumweru cy’imideli muri Tanzania. Yagize ati “Ni ibintu byanshimishije cyane kwibona mu batumiwe muri ibi bihugu byombi, ibyo bikorwa byombi ni binini, bizahuza abanyamideli bakomeye muri Afurika, kubijyamo ni iby’agaciro gakomeye cyane, nzungukiramo byinshi.” Yongeraho ati “Muri Nigeria nzajyana na Moise, badutumiye mu gikorwa cyitwa Nigeria Men’s Fashion, mbere y’aho hari ibindi bantumiyemo bizabera muri Tanzania, byo ni ibya Swahili Fashion Week, bazanatangamo ibihembo, ndi no mu bahatana mu cyiciro cya ‘East African Model of the Year’, gusa kubera uburyo byegeranye cyane sinzi niba nzabasha kujyayo.” Muri Swahili Fashion Week Awards, Turahirwa na we ari mu bahataniye ibihembo mu cyiciro cya East African Designer of the Year. Ahanganye n’abanyamideli bakomeye muri Afurika y’Uburasirazuba. Muri Nigeria, aba banyamideli bazahura n’abandi baturutse mu bihugu birenga mirongo itanu birimo ibyo muri Afurika, Amerika n’u Burayi. Jay D na Turahirwa Moise kandi bari mu banyamideli batoranyijwe guhatanira ibihembo bya Abryanz Style&Fashion Awards bizatangirwa mu Mujyi wa Kampala kuwa 9 Ukuboza 2016 muri Kampala Serena Hotel. Turahirwa ahatanye mu cyiciro kimwe muri ibi bihembo cya ‘Fashion Designer of the Year naho Ntabanganyimana Jean de Dieu [Jay D] akaba mu banyamideli bari kuzamuka neza mu Rwanda yatoranyijwe mu cyiciro ‘East African mising Model of the year’.

title: Sonia Mugabo yagiye kumurika imideli yahanze muri Madagascar
content: Sonia Mugabo washinze inzu y’imideli ya SM[Sonia Mugabo] mu mwaka wa 2013 yagiye muri Madagascar kwerekana no gucuruza imideli bwite ahangira mu Rwanda. Yajyanye n’irindi tsinda ry’abahanzi b’imideli bagize Haute Baso [yashinzwe na Candy Basomingera na Linda Mukangoga ]. Ibirori by’imideli bya Origin Africa Trade Show biri kubera i Antananarivo ku nshuro ya karindwi, byatangiye kuwa 3 Ugushyingo 2016 bizasozwa kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 5 Ugushyingo. Mu kiganiro na TNT, Sonia Mugabo yavuze ko afite icyizere gikomeye ko iki gikorwa cyatumiwemo Abanyarwanda kizabahesha amahirwe yo kwigaragaza ku rwego rwa Afurika nk’abamaze gutera intambwe ikomeye mu buhanzi bw’imideli. Yanavuze ko muri Antananarivo we na bagenzi be bazabonerayo amahirwe mashya mu mideli bahanga ndetse ngo bazabona isoko ryagutse ku rwego mpuzamahanga mu bikorwa bakora. Sonia Mugabo n’abagize Haute Baso berekeje muri Madagascar nyuma y’ibyumweru bibiri bakoze ikindi gikorwa gikomeye cyahuje abahanzi b’imideli bibumbiye muri Collective Rw bamuritse imyambaro n’imirimbo bahanze yiganjemo iyo mu Rwanda mu birori bikomeye byabereye muri Kigali Serena Hotel mu ijoro ryo kuwa 14 Ukwakira 2016. Iyi Collective Rw yashinzwe n’abahanzi b’imideli barimo Sonia Mugabo, Teta Isibo, Mathew Rugamba, Linda Mukangoga na Candy Basomingera. Igikorwa cya Origin Africa Trade kibereye muri Madagascar nyuma y’uko mu mwaka ushize wa 2015 cyabereye mu Mujyi wa Addis Ababa muri Ethiopia.

title: Abanyamideli batanu bahagarariye u Rwanda muri Abryanz Style&Fashion Awards
content: Abatoranyijwe guserukira u Rwanda uyu mwaka harimo Ntabanganyimana Jean de Dieu [Jay D], Bashabe Kate, Georgie Ndirangu na Moise Turahirwa ndetse na Judith Heard ubikorera cyane muri Uganda. Umwaka ushize u Rwanda rwari rufitemo abanyamideli babiri, Judith Heard na Moise Turahirwa. Judith Heard yabashije kubona igihembo ariko mugenzi Moise Turahirwa ntiyabasha gutsinda. Uyu mwaka hatoranyijwe abantu b’ibyamamare mu byiciro bitandukanye barimo abavuga rikijyana mu cyiciro cy’abakora imideli, abahanzi b’imideli, abazi guhitamo neza imyambaro, abahanzi, abakora make-up, abanyamakuru mu ngeri zinyuranye n’abandi. Uretse kumurika imideli, Turahirwa afite inzu y’imideli yise ‘Moshions [Moses Fashions]’. Ahatanye mu cyiciro kimwe muri ibi bihembo cya ‘Fashion Designer  of the Year., ari kumwe n’abahanzi b’imideli bakomeye mu karere. Judith Heard wabonye igihembo umwaka ushize, asanzwe ari umwe mu banyamideli bahagaze neza muri Uganda ari na ho abana n’umuryango we. Ari mu cyiciro kimwe cya ‘Best Dressed Celebrity’ ari nacyo ahuriyemo na Kate Bashabe washinze Kabash Fashion House. George Ndirangu wo muri Kenya akaba n’umunyamakuru wa CNBC  uba mu Rwanda, bamushyize mu cyiciro cy’abahagarariye iki gihugu mu banyamakuru bambara neza[Best Dressed Media Personality]. Ntabanganyimana Jean de Dieu [Jay D] uri mu banyamideli bari kuzamuka neza mu Rwanda yatoranyijwe mu cyiciro ‘East African mising Model of the year’. Uyu amaze kwiyerekana cyane mu bikorwa byo kumurika imideli no gutanga amanota mu marushanwa ya Nyampinga anyuranye abera mu Rwanda. Ibirori byo gutangaza abatsinze bizaba kuwa 9 Ukuboza 2016 muri Kampala Serena Hotel.

title: Eric Birasa agiye gutangiza uruganda nyuma y’imyaka umunani mu mideli
content: Ni we washinze inzu y’imideli yitwa Ian Boutique mu mwaka wa 2008. Icyo gihe yari ifite intego yo kuzana mu Rwanda imideli mishya kandi igezweho mu bihugu bizwiho kurimba ku Isi. Eric Birasa yambitse ibyamamare bitabarika mu Rwanda no hanze. Azwi cyane kandi nk’umwe mu bafite ubumenyi mu gutoza no kwigisha abanyamideli ndetse mu minsi yashize yagizwe Umuyobozi w’Ihuriro ry’Abanyamideli b’umwuga Premier Model Agency [PMA]. Mu myaka amaze mu by’imideli yatoje benshi mu banyamideli bakomeye mu Rwanda ndetse inzu yashinze ya Ian Boutique yamufashije kwambika ibyamamare birimo abaririmbyi bo mu Rwanda, abakobwa bitabiriye irushanwa rya Miss Rwanda mu myaka itatu ishize muri 2014, 2015 ndetse na 2016. Ati “Mu myaka umunani maze muri uyu mwuga nambitse abantu benshi bazwi, nahereye hasi cyane nza kuzamuka ku buryo nko kwambika Ally Soudy mu bukwe bwe numvaga bikomeye cyane.” Eric Birasa yavuze ko gukunda akazi ko guhanga no guhitiramo abantu imideli ibabereye byamuzamuye ku rwego rukomeye ndetse yambika benshi mu byamamare nyuma ya Ally Soudy. Ati “Nambitse Urban Boyz mu bitaramo bitandukanye, Riderman mu bukwe bwe, abahanzi muri Salax Awards zitandukanye. Ikindi gikomeye cyanamfashije kurushaho kumenyekana ni uko nagiye nambika abakobwa mu itorwa rya Nyampinga kuva muri 2014 ndetse n’abanyamideli bakomeye mu birori bagiye bitabira.” Imizi yo gushinga iduka ry’imideli… Eric Birasa yavuze ko atigeze ahabwa ubumenyi mu by’imideli gusa yakoze ijoro n’amanywa ashakisha ibigezweho mu bindi bihugu kugira ngo abo yambika banyurwe ari nacyo avuga ko yubakiyeho mu iterambere rye. Igitekerezo cyo gushinga inzu y’imideli yakigize nk’umuntu wakundaga kurimba ariko akifuza no kubikorera abandi. Mu mwaka wa 2008 nibwo yatangiye kubikora agamije kuvanamo inyungu ndetse biranamuhira ubu abikora nk’akazi gahoraho. Ati “Mu buzima busanzwe njyewe nakundaga kwambara neza, igihe kigeze ntekereza uburyo nabikora nkambika abantu ariko nkabibonamo n’amafaranga hanyuma mu mwaka wa 2008 nibwo natangiye gukora aka kazi ndetse mbikore nk’ubucuruzi ari nabwo nagize ubushobozi bwo gushinga Ian Boutique.” “Icyatumye ngira imbaraga cyane ndetse nkamenyekana ni uko nakoranye n’itangazamakuru, nagiye nambika abantu b’ibyamamare, uwo nambikaga azwi yampuzaga n’abandi ngira n’umugisha abanyamakuru baranyoboka menyekana gutyo.” Imideli ye imyinshi ayivana mu mahanga mu bihugu bizwimo abantu barimba cyane. Avuga ko ari akazi kagoye guhitiramo abantu imideli ndetse biba ingorabahizi kurushaho iyo azanye imyambaro imuhenze cyane yagera mu gihugu akabangamirwa n’isoko rito n’ubushobozi budahagije bw’abakiriya be. Ati “Icya mbere bisaba gusoma cyane no gukurikirana uko mu bindi bihugu bigenda no kumenya ibigezweho. Nkurikirana inzu zikomeye zambika abantu ku Isi nkamenya ibigezweho haba mu myambaro y’abagabo ndetse n’iy’abagore, ntabwo bingora kubimenya ahubwo ikigorana ni uko akenshi biba bihenze.” Yongeyeho ati “Iyo utangiye business ntabwo uhita utangira kubara inyungu, natangiye bingoye cyane ndihangana nkomeza kubikora kuko nabikundaga, navuga ko mu myaka umunani maze nkora ibi bintu byo kwambika abantu ari bwo ntangiye kubona inyungu. Imbogamizi ikomeye cyane ni uko isoko ari rito, amafaranga ni make ku isoko mu gihe ibyo mvana hanze biba bihenze.” Yerekeje amaso ku gushinga uruganda Birasa yavuze ko inzu ye y’imideli yihaye icyerekezo gishya cyo gushinga uruganda ruto ruzajya rumufasha gukora imideli irimo ubuhanga bwerekana inkomoko y’ibyo bakora hagendewe ku kwihesha agaciro no guteza imbere gahunda ya ‘Made in Rwanda’. Yagize ati “Politiki y’igihugu ubu iradushishikariza gukunda iby’iwacu binyuze muri gahunda ya ‘Made in Rwanda’, ubu icyerekezo mfite ni ugutangiza uruganda rukora imyenda y’iwacu. Nagenze mu bihugu byinshi ndeba uko bakora, ubu ndifuza kuzashaka ubushobozi ngatangiza uburyo buzajya butuma Abanyarwanda bambara imyenda yakorewe iwacu, byose ni ukwihangana no kugira intego nizeye ko bizashoboka.” Mbere yo gutangiza uruganda ngo agiye gushakisha ubushobozi bwisumbuyeho ajye agura imideli igezweho ayigurishe bya burundu bitandukanye n’uko mu myaka yari amaze yabikoraga atiza abantu bakamuha amafaranga ubundi bakayimusubiza. Ati “Ubusanzwe ngitangira nambikaga ibyamamare, abanyamideli, ba Nyampinga, abageni mu bukwe n’abandi bantu bafite ibirori. Ntabwo mbere nagurishaga imyenda, uraza tukakwambika ukishyura ubukode ukazadusubiza imyenda yacu, ubu rero ndashaka ko nazajya njya mu mahanga nkagura imyambaro igezweho, umudeli wose ugezweho mu mahanga nkawuzana i Kigali abafite ubushobozi bakaba babigura bikaba ibyabo burundu, hari abantu baba bifuza gutunga iyo myenda, ni bake ariko barahari.” Abantu bazwi Eric Birasa amaze kwambika...

title: Haute Baso, inzu imaze kuba ubukombe mu by’imideli mu Rwanda
content: Iyi nzu y’imideli yatangijwe n’abagore babiri, bari basanzwe buri wese ku giti cye ahanga imideli, nyuma yo kuganira bahitamo gukorera hamwe kuko basanze guhuza imbaraga byatuma barushaho kubona umusaruro. Umwe muri bo yari asanzwe afite inzu y’imideli yitwaga ‘Haute Rwanda’, yakoraga ibijyanye n’imitako n’amasakoshi, undi akorera muri ‘Baso Designs’ yakoraga imyenda, ari nabyo byaje guhuzwa havuka “Haute Baso”. Mu kiganiro IGIHE yagiranye n’umwe mu bashinze iyi nzu y’imideli yasobanuye ko batangiriye ku gishoro cy’ibihumbi bibiri by’amadolari gusa ndetse ngo babanje kumenyekanisha imyambaro bahanga no kuyikwirakwiza binyuza ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Ati “Twatangiye ducururiza ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, ntabwo twari dufite iduka. Twashyize imbaraga mu kugira urubuga rwa internet na Facebook. Abantu baratwandikiraga bakatubwira ngo turashaka iki, tukakibashyira.” Mu Ukwakira 2014 nibwo Haute Baso yashinze iduka ryayo rya mbere, bikaba byaragezweho nyuma yo kwizigama amafaranga bakuraga mu gucururiza ku mbugankoranyambaga. Ubu bafite ababahagarariye muri Kenya no muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Kuva batangira, bagiye bagira amahirwe menshi yo kumurika imideli bahanga ahantu hatandukanye ndetse bakaba bashima ubufasha leta y’u Rwanda n’Urugaga rw’abikorera, PSF bidahwema guha ba rwiyemezamirimo bakiri bato. Mu mpera za 2014, bagize amahirwe yo guhabwa inkunga ya $80000 n’Umuryango Spring usanzwe ufasha imishinga ishobora kuzana impinduka mu bihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere by’umwihariko ku bakobwa. Aya mafaranga yatumye bagura ibikoresho byinshi bakenera mu guhanga imideli yabo, kuko ubusanzwe bakorana n’amakoperative abadodera, ariko ibikenewe byose babyizaniye. Bamuritse ibyo bakora mu bihugu birimo na Afurika y’Epfo Umwe muri aba yatangiye ibijyanye n’imideli ubwo yigaga kaminuza hanze y’u Rwanda yaza mu biruhuko abantu bakamutuma impano akuye mu Rwanda. Ati “Hari nko mu 2007, mama wanjye yabaga inaha nkaza kumusura.  Nta bindi bintu byiza byahabaga washyira abantu nk’impano. Natangiye gukora utuntu duke nkabijyana, abantu bakampa amafaranga. Hari umugore nari nzi ubizi nahitagamo ibyo ankorera.” Nyuma yo gufata umwanzuro wo kubikora nk’umuyoboro wo kugaragaza ibitekerezo bye, yaje guhura na mugenzi we batangira gufatanya urugendo binyuze muri Haute Baso. Ati “Kiriya gihe ibijyanye n’imideli ntabwo byafatwaga nk’akazi, byari bigoye kubwira umuntu ngo aguhe inguzanyo utangira inzu y’imideli, ubu bwo birashoboka. Twebwe twakoresheje ayo twari dufite, buri wese yazanye uruhare rwe tuyashora mu kugura ibikoresho.” Yagaragaje ko bigoye kugaragaza amafaranga bamaze kunguka mu bikorwa byabo, kuko inyungu yose babonye bongera bagashora mu bikorwa byabo kugira ngo bikomeze kwaguka. Ati ”Kuri njye ntabwo mbibara mu mafaranga, ni umubare w’abantu dufite ubushobozi bwo gukoresha. Twatangiranye n’abantu bane, mu gihe kitageze ku myaka ibiri tugeze kuri 27. Umubare w’abanyabukorikori dushobora gukorana na bo bitari umunsi umwe ahubwo igihe cyose, iryo ni ryo terambere rya Haute Baso.” Aba bahanzi b’imideli kandi bamaze kwitabira ibikorwa byo kumurika imideli bitandukanye by’imideli Kampala Fashion Week (Uganda), Origin Africa Trade Show (Madagascar), Collective Rw na  Mercedes Benz Fashion Week (Afurika y’Epfo), iza mu bikomeye cyane muri Afurika. Banambitse kandi ibyamamare bitandukanye birimo n’abagize Itsinda rya Saut Sol ryo muri Kenya.  Gutumiza ibikoresho hanze biracyari inzitizi Kuba ibikoresho byinshi bakenera babitumiza mu mahanga, bituma bahendwa cyane, ari nabyo bituma igiciro cy’imyenda ikorerwa mu Rwanda kijya hejuru ugereranyije n’ibindi biva hanze. Hari icyizere ko bizahinduka ariko, kuko u Rwanda ruherutse gufata umwanzuro wo kudasoreha ibikoresho byifashishwa mu budozi. Kuba bakiri bato kandi ngo bituma hari bamwe badaha agaciro gakwiye ibyo bakora, ariko na none bakishimira ko u Rwanda rushyigikira ba rwiyemezamirimo by’umwihariko abagore. ‘Made in Rwanda’ yaje ari igisubizo Gahunda ya ‘Made in Rwanda’ igamije gushishikariza abanyarwanda gukoresha ibikorerwa mu gihugu, bayibona nk’uburyo bwo gutuma ibyo bakora bitera imbere kurushaho. Ati “Urabizi ubu bari guca imyenda ya caguwa, ibi bizateza imbere ubucuruzi nk’ubwacu. Ni byiza ko turi kugira uruhare mu gushyiraho uburyo buzatuma ubucuruzi bwacu butera imbere […] Mu gihe caguwa idahari abantu benshi bazakenera kwambara.” Amafoto ya bimwe mu bikorwa bya Haute Baso

title: Mimi Mirage wamamaje imyenda ya Beyonce agiye gutangiza ibikorwa bye mu Rwanda
content: Uyu mukobwa uzwi cyane nka Mimi Mirage yabwiye IGIHE ko mu myaka ibiri amaze atangiye ibikorwa byo kwerekana imideli amaze kugera ku rwego rukomeye ari nayo mpamvu yifuza kuza gusangiza Abanyarwanda ubumenyi yungutse no gutangiza uburyo bushya bwatuma abanyamideli bo mu Rwanda bamenyekana byisumbuyeho. Mimi Mirage ngo yamamarije ibikorwa by’imideli ikorerwa muri House of Deréon yashinzwe na Beyonce afatanyije na nyina Tina Knowles mu mwaka wa 2006, aba bombi bayitangije mu guha icyubahiro Agnèz Deréon [nyirakuru wa Beyonce]. Yavuze ko yanakoze nk’umunyamideli wamamaza imyenda y’abagore ya Apple Bottoms, iyi yatangijwe n’umuraperi Nelly afatanyije na Yomi Martin ndetse na Ian Kelly. Yagize ati “Nakoze ibikorwa byo kwamamaza bitandukanye, namamije Deréon ya Beyonce hari n’igikorwa cyo kwamamaza Apple Bottoms y’umuraperi Nelly nakoze, mu myaka ibiri maze nkora uyu mwuga wo kwerekana imideli nakoranye n’inzu zitandukanye z’imideli mu Bubiligi, hari n’ibindi bikorwa binini natumiwemo.” Yavuze ko ari umwuga yakoze nk’impano yiyumvamo, ahamya ko ntaho yabikomoye kuko ‘nta muntu umwe wihariye mu byo kwerekana imideli afatiraho urugero’. Ati “Nta muntu umwe wihariye mfata nk’icyitegererezo kuri njyewe, mbona benshi ariko ku giti cyanjye ndabikunda.” Karuranga Mimi Mirage yemeza ko afite inzu zikomeye z’imideli akorana na zo zirimo Maza Boetiek , Class Roberto Cavalli, Vcj Versace n’izindi. Mu kwerekana imideli ngo yibanda cyane mu Bufaransa no mu Bubiligi aho atuye ariko ngo arifuza ko mu mwaka wa 2017 yatangira kwigaragaza nk’umunyamwuga wifuza kubikorera iwabo mu Rwanda. Mugisha Frank uyobora Kigaliwood Photo yavuze ko bafitanye imikoranire na Mimi Mirage ndetse ngo hari umushinga ukomeye bazatangira gukorana na we bitarenze muri Mata 2017. Yagize ati “Yitegura kuza mu Rwanda aho azakorana na Kigaliwood mu bijyanye no kumufata amafoto yo kwamamaza mu buryo butandukanye, hari n’indi mishinga dufitanye, ibi yashatse kubikora nyuma y’igihe kinini ataba mu Rwanda kugirango naho ahagaragaze ibikorwa bye bimaze kumenyekana hanze.”

title: I Kigali hateguwe ibirori bizitabirwa n’abambaye ibitenge gusa
content: Byari bimenyerewe ko habaho ibirori bihuriza hamwe abambaye ibyererana, umutuku n’andi mabara atandukanye, kuri iyi nshuro hateguwe ibizitabirwa n’abambaye imyenda ikozwe mu gitenge yakorewe mu Rwanda. Ibi birori ngarukamwaka byiswe ‘Kitenge Dress Code Dinner’ bigiye kubera i Kigali biri mu murongo wo guteza imbere ibyakorewe mu Rwanda. Umuyobozi wa The Business Mag yateguye iki gikorwa, Aimable Ngendahayo yabwiye IGIHE ko intego nyamukuru bafite ari ugushishikariza abantu kugira umutima wo gukunda ibikorerwa mu Rwanda kugira ngo ababikora babashe gutera imbere. Ati “Intego yacu n’icyo tugamije ni ukugira ngo duteze imbere ‘Made in Rwanda’ kuko iyo witegereje abantu benshi muri iyi minsi binjiye mu gukora iby’iwacu badasize inyuma n’ibyo kwambara.” Yakomeje avuga ko iki ari igikorwa kizajya kibaho buri mwaka hagamijwe gukangurira abanyarwanda kugura ibikorerwa mu gihugu kugira ngo bateze imbere ababikora. Yanavuze ku mpamvu usanga imyambaro ikorerwa mu Rwanda igifite ibiciro bihanitse n’uburyo icyo kibazo cyakemuka. Ati “Mu by’ukuri impamvu bihenda, ni uko uba usanga abanyarwanda batarakangukira kubigura, ariko babaye babigura igiciro cyagabanuka, usanga n’ubikora akora bicye kubera aba avuga ngo ‘ndakora byinshi bizagurwa na nde?’, noneho ako yakoze kamwe cyangwa tubiri akagahenda, ariko haramutse habonetse abakiriya babigura byahenduka.” “Iyo rero abaguzi batabagana ari benshi bituma n’ibyo bakora bihenda, ariko iyo bakoze byinshi bakabona abaguzi bituma n’igiciro kijya hasi, niyo mpamvu rero twahisemo gutegura iki gikorwa kugira ngo tumeyekanishe ibikorerwa iwacu ariko nanone tunashyigikira ba bantu binjiye muri Fashion Design kugira ngo babone abaguzi. Ntanze nk’urugero, abantu bazitabira ibi birori bagomba kuba bambaye igitenge, nta handi bazagikura rero bazagikura muri ba bandi babidoda bitume na bo batera imbera.” Abakora ibikorwa bitandukanye birimo guhanga imyambaro ikozwe mu gitenge bazahabwa umwanya muri ibi birori kuko hazerekanwa imideli (fashion show) itandukanye y’amoko menshi ishobora gukorwa mu gitenge. Abanyamideli batandukanye baziyerekana mu myenda ikozwe mu gitenge, habeho gufata ifunguro ku bitabiriye bizaherekezwa n’umuziki. Ibi birori bizitabirwa n’abambaye imyenda ikozwe mu gitenge biteganyijwe kubera i Kigali muri Car Free Zone ku wa 18 Gashyantare 2017 guhera ku saa kumi n’imwe z’umugoroba kugeza mu masaha akuze, kwinjira muri iyi Dinner ni amafaranga y’u Rwanda 10,000 Frw azaba arimo icyo kurya n’icyo kunywa.

title: Kanye West agiye kumurika ikindi cyiciro cy’imideli yahanze
content: Uyu muraperi uri mu bavugwaho cyane muri USA, mu cyiciro cya gatatu cy’imideli ye yaherukaga kumurika indi myambaro yahanze yifashishije ifoto yafatiwe mu Rwanda mu nkambi ya Kibeho mu Karere ka Nyaruguru mu 1995. Ifoto yagendeyeho ategura iyo ishusho y’uburyo abanyamideli bagombaga kugaragara, yafashwe n’Umwongereza witwa Paul Lowe mu 1995 i Kibeho mu Majyepfo y’u Rwanda. US Magazine ivuga ko uyu muraperi agiye kumurika ubwoko butandukanye bw’imideli yahanze yo mu cyiciro cya gatanu mu yo yise ’Yeezy’. Biteganyijwe ko azerekana iyi myambaro mu cyumweru cyahariwe imideli cya ’New York Fashion Week’ yaherukaga kumurikiramo icyiciro cya kane. Umwe mu bantu ba hafi b’umuryango w’aba-Kardashians yabwiye iki kinyamakuru ko guhera kuri Kim Kardashian kugeza no ku bana babo bari mu myiteguro yo gutera ingabo mu bitugu Kanye West. Imideli mishya Kanye West yahanze azayimurikira ahitwa Pier 59 Studios muri Manhattan nyuma y’uko muri Nzeri 2016, yari yakoreye icyo gikorwa Franklin D. Roosevelt Four Freedoms Park hakagora abanyamideli bitewe n’ubushyuhe bwinshi bwari buhari. Mbere y’uko agera ku cyiciro cya tatu cy’imideli yahanze yari yabanje gukora ikindi cyiciro mu ntangiriro za 2016, icyo gihe yatunguye abitabiriye ibirori bitewe n’uburyo yari yambitsemo abanyamideli be.

title: Ubwoko bw’amavuta n’ibirungo umugore wa Trump yari yisize mu muhango w’irahira ry’umugabo we
content: Mu mihango itandukanye yaranze uyu munsi, Melania Trump wahoze ari umunyamideli yari yabukereye aho mu maso yari yasizwe n’uwitwa Nicole Bryl n’aho imisatsi ye itunganywa na Mordechai Alvow. Aba bombi babwiye US Weekly ko kuri uriya munsi, ibyakoreshejwe mu maso no mu musatsi we byatwaye amadorali 901 (asaga ibihumbi 700 by’amafaranga y’u Rwanda). Bryl yavuze ko amazi yifashishwa mu gutuma uruhu ruba rutoto (Face Lifting Water) yakoreshejwe yaguzwe amadorali 450 n’aho umuti utuma uruhu rurushaho gusa neza (Face Perfecting Serum) ugurwa amadorali 225, kubitegura bikaba byaratwaye amasaha 46. Andi mafaranga asigaye yakoreshejwe mu bindi birungo byakoreshejwe mu gusiga ibice bitandukanye birimo mu maso. Alvow wamusokoje yavuze ko bahisemo gusa n’abafungira imisatsi inyuma, mike akaba ariyo iza mu maso, kugira ngo itaza kubangamira ikanzu yari yambaye yahanzwe ku bufatanye n’umuhanzi w’imideli witwa Ralph Lauren. Insokozo, ibirungo n’imyenda yari yambaye kandi biri mu byagize uruhare mu gutuma imiterere ye yifuzwa n’abatari bake irushaho kugaragara.

title: Abantu 10 bahamijwe icyaha cyo kwiba Kim Kardashian i Paris
content: Mu masaha ashyira igitondo cyo ku wa 3 Ukwakira 2016 nibwo Kim Kardashian yacucuwe n’abajura babiri bambaye imyenda nk’iya Polisi, bamufatiyeho imbunda ubwo bari bamusanze mu cyumba cya hoteli yitwa “No Adress” yari acumbitsemo mu Mujyi wa Paris. AFP yatangaje ko ku wa Kane w’iki Cyumweru umucamanza wo mu Bufaransa ukurikirana ikirego cy’abibye uyu munyamideli uzwi cyane ku Isi aribwo yanzuye ko abantu bane muri 17 bahamwa n’ibyaha bari bakurikiranyweho. Abandi batandatu nabo ku wa Gatanu w’iki Cyumweru urukiko rw’i Paris rwemeje ko bakomeza kuba bafunzwe kuko hari ibimenyetso simusiga byatanzwe n’ubushinjacyaha bigaragaza uruhare bagize muri ubwo bujura. Umwe mu bafashwe wahawe izina rya “Omar the Old” ni we bivugwa ko yateguye umugambi wo kwiba Kim Kardashian, uyu ngo banasanze DNA ye ihura neza n’ibimenyetso byavuye mu perereza rya Polisi, byemezwa ko ari mu waziritse Kim Kardashian ubwo yibwaga. Abahamijwe kugira uruhare mu bujura bwakorewe Kim Kardashian ni abagabo icyenda ndetse n’umugore umwe. Mu bafashwe harimo abafite imyaka 27 kugeza kuri 74. Ntiharatangazwa ibijyanye n’ibihano aba bahamijwe kwiba Kim Kardashian bazahabwa, gusa amakuru atangazwa n’ikinyamakuru The Mirror cyo mu Bwongereza avuga ko bazakatirwa igihano cy’igifungo muri gereza. Umushoferi watwaraga Kim Kardashian mu Bufaransa aho yibiwe we yararekuwe, murumuna we aba ari we ufatwa. Bivugwa ko abahamijwe kwiba Kim Kardashian basanzwe ari abajura ruharwa mu gatsiko k’abayogoje u Bufaransa n’u Bubiligi biba imitako y’agaciro. Muri iki gihe Kim Kardashian ari mu Mujyi wa Dubai mu ruzinduko rwe rwa mbere kuva yafatirwaho imbunda mu Bufaransa. Mu Ukwakira akimara kwibwa yahise ava mu Bufaransa igitaraganya, yohererejwe indege ye bwite imusubiza muri Amerika aho asanzwe atuye n’umuryango we. Yongeye kubivugaho haciyeho igihe. Mu cyumba yari afitemo amafaranga yo kwifashisha n’imirimbo y’agaciro ifite agaciro ka miliyoni esheshatu z’amadolari, ibi byose abajura barabikukumbye barabyandurukana ntibamenyekana. Kim Kardashian kandi bamwibye impeta ihenze yambitswe n’umugabo we Kanye West, iyi ifite agaciro ka miliyoni enye z’amadolari ya Amerika. Mu byo bamwibye harimo telefone ebyiri zihenze, ngo hari imwe yari irimo amabanga menshi ye.

title: Umwihariko mu birori by’imideli ya ‘Made in Rwanda’ (Amafoto)
content: Ibi birori by’imideli byari byiswe ‘Made in Rwanda Fashion Night Out’ byateguwe n’abahanzi b’imideli bitabiriye imurikagurisha ry’ibyakorewe mu Rwanda. Aba bahanzi bagamije guteza imbere imideli yahangiwe mu Rwanda ndetse no kuzamura ireme ry’abakora uyu mwuga bakamenyekana ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Imideli yerekanywe irimo amakanzu, amashati, amapantaro, inkweto, ibikapu byo mu moko yose, ingofero n’imirimbo inyuranye byose bikorerwa mu Rwanda. Iyi mideli yakorewe mu Rwanda muri Sonia Mugabo,Uzi Collections, Inzuki Designs, Inkanda,Moshions,Haute Baso,Made in Kigali, Rwanda Clothing ndetse na Rupari Designs. Ibi birori byabereye ahasanzwe habera imurikagurisha i Gikondo gusa kuri iyi nshuro abamurikabikorwa baryitabiriye ni abacuruza ibyakorewe mu Rwanda gusa[Made in Rwanda]. Byari umwihariko ugereranyije n’ibindi birori byo kumurika imideli bisanzwe bimenyerewe mu Rwanda kuko abanyamideli bambaraga imideli mu mok anyuranye hanyuma bagahagarara mu matsinda hanyuma abaje kureba ibirori bakabazengurukamo bareba imideli baje kumurika ubishoboye agahita agura. Aba bahanzi b’imideli kandi bari bazanye imyenda, imitako n’ibindi basanzwe bakora ku buryo ibirori byabaye bibangikanye n’igikorwa cyo gusobanurira abari baje kwihera ijisho umwihariko wa buri nzu y’imideli. Sonia Mugabo umwe mu bahanzi b’imideli bitabiriye iki gikorwa yabwiye IGIHE ko ‘byamusigiye isomo ryiza no kurushaho kugira umuhate mu byo akora’. Ati “Ibikorwa nk’ibi byerekana ko Abanyarwanda baturi inyuma kandi ko bashaka kwambara ibintu byakorewe mu Rwanda, natwe biradusunika cyane ngo turusheho gukora cyane kandi byiza.” Yongeraho ati “Ibi byerekana ko nshyigikiye gahunda ya leta yo guteza imbere Made in Rwanda, kandi bishimangira ko turi muri gahunda nziza yo kwishakira imirimo. Nkanjye natangiye ndi umwe ariko ubu tumaze kuba abantu icumi.” Yavuze ko nyuma y’iri murikagurisha agiye gufungura iduka rinini muri Marriot Hotel mu kurushaho kwagura ibikorwa bye. Ati “Nyuma ya hano ngiye guhita mfungura iduka rindi muri Marriot Hotel, ni ugushyiramo ingufu tugakora cyane…” Ibi birori bibaye nyuma y’igihe gito habaye ikindi gikorwa kinini cyahurije hamwe abahanzi b’imideli bibanda cyane ku yakorewe mu Rwanda bibumbiye muri ikompanyi Collective Rw ari nayo benshi muri aba bamuritse ibikorwa byabo babarizwamo. Iri murikagurisha ry’ibikorerwa mu Rwanda ribaye ku nshuro ya kabiri, ryitabiriwe n’abanshoramari bari mu byiciro bitandukanye birimo, abakora ibijyanye n’u bwubatsi, ubuhinzi n’ubworozi, imyenda, ibikoresho by’isuku, ubukorikori, abatanga servise mu ikoranabuhanga n’ibindi. Imurikagurisha ry’uyu mwaka ku bikorerwa mu Rwanda rifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti “Duharanire kwigira duhaha iby’iwacu.” Amafoto: Mahoro Luqman

title: I Kigali hateguwe ibirori by’imideli bizakusanyirizwamo inkunga yo gufasha impunzi
content: Ni ibirori byiswe ‘Refugees Matter Show’ cyateguwe n’ikigo cyitwa Abigaelle Closet gisanzwe gikorera i Portland muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Iki kigo cyashinzwe n’urubyiruko rukomoka mu Rwanda no mu Burundi gikora kikanagurisha imyenda y’amoko atandukanye. Mu kiganiro n’umuyobozi wa Abigaelle Closet, Abigaelle Judicaelle Irakoze yabwiye IGIHE ko yagize iki gitekerezo cyo gukora ibi birori nyuma y’iminsi yari amaze i Kigali, yiyambaza abandi bantu batandukanye bakora umwuga nk’uwe ngo bafatanye gutegura iki gikorwa kizakusanyiriza hamwe amafaranga azajya gufasha impunzi mu nkambi ya Mahama mu Karere ka Kirehe. Yagize ati “Twifuje kubera ijwi abatarifite, kuba icyizere ku batagifite, ni muri urwo rwego twatekereje gukoresha kumurika imideli nka kimwe mu bikorwa byagira akamaro mu gufasha abatishoboye.” “Twateguye iki gikorwa mu rwego rwo gufasha impunzi z’Abarundi ziri mu nkambi ya Mahama, amafaranga azavamo yose azakoreshwa mu bikorwa by’ubufasha birimo kubagezaho ibikoresho nkenerwa, imyambaro n’ibindi tuzasanga ari ngombwa kuri bo.” Yongeyeho ko usibye amafaranga azakusanyirizwa muri iki gitaramo, abazitabira bashobora no kwitwaza imyambaro mizima itagikoreshwa mu rwego rwo kongera ingano y’imfashanyo izatangwa ku mpunzi ziri mu nkambi ya Mahama bifuje gufasha. Ibi birori by’imideli biteganyijwe kuba ku wa Gatanu tariki 16 Ukuboza 2016 muri Hotel des Milles Collines i Kigali guhera saa kumi n’ebyiri kugeza saa yine z’ijoro. Kizasusurutswa n’abahanzi batandukanye barimo Eric 1Key n’abanyarwenya barimo na Michael Sengazi uzaba n’umushyushyarugamba w’iki gitaramo. Abigaelle Closet yateguye iki gikorwa, izifatanya n’abandi bahanzi b’imideli barimo abo muri Uzuri K&Y ikora inkweto, abo muri ByAlpha Couture bakora ibijyanye n’imisatsi, Dokmai Rwanda n’abandi benshi. Imwe mu mideli ihangwa na Abigaelle Closet

title: ‘KGL’ umudeli mushya uje guhangana n’imyambaro ituruka mu mahanga
content: Inzu y’imideli ya DCIB[Dawn Central Investiment Bureau] icuruza imyenda ifite ibirango bya ‘KG’L[impine y’izina Kigali], ubuyobozi bwayo buvuga ko bazanye iyi myambaro mu rwego rwo gufasha leta mu rugendo rwo kugabanya ibiva mu mahanga bimika ibyakorewe mu Rwanda[Made in Rwanda]. Umuyobozi w’iyi nzu y’imideli, Habimana Felix yabwiye IGIHE ko iyi myenda iva mu mahanga itarangiye neza hanyuma yagezwa i Kigali bakayishyiraho ibirango bigaragaza ko yakozwe n’Abanyarwanda gusa ngo mu myaka iri imbere bizeye ko bazaba barabonye ubushobozi bagatangira kuyidoda kugeza isohotse yuzuye. Yagize ati “Navuga ko ibari yarakozweho imirimo imwe n’abantu bo mu mahanga kuko ibyo tuyikoramo tubitumiza mu Bushinwa hanyuma yagera inaha tugakoraho utuntu duke no kwandikaho aya magambo ubundi ikajya ku isoko.” Yongeyeho ko mu mpamvu nyamukuru zatumye bahitamo gusakaza imyenda yanditseho ‘KGL’ ngo ni uko babona abantu benshi mu Rwanda bambaye ibyanditseho amazina y’imijyi nka New York, Chicago n’ayandi. Ati “Gahunda yacu ni ukwambika Abanyarwanda imyenda bibonamo, biracyatubabaza kubona abantu bambaye imyenda yanditseho amazina y’ibindi bihugu n’indi mijyi izwi nyamara kubona uwambaye Kigali ntibipfa gukunda, icyo nicyo tuje gukemura.” Arongera ati “Ikituzanye ni ukwambika Abanyarwanda ibintu byiza, gahunda ya leta ihari ni uguteza imbere ibikorewe mu gihugu icyizere kirahari ko abakiriya bazaboneka kandi tuzakora ibishoboka bizanogere abazabyambara.” Habimana afatanyije na mugenzi we witwa Tuyishimire Desire, aba bombi bavuga ko imideli yabo izakundwa ku isoko kubera umwihariko ifite ndetse ngo itandukanye cyane n’indi yagiye icaracara  nayo ifite amagambo ajya gusa n’aya. Ati “Ubu turi mu biganiro na bamwe mu bahanzi ndetse n’abanyamideli bazadufasha kwamamaza no kumenyekanisha imyenda yacu. Intego twihaye ni uko mu gihe kitarenze umwaka umwe imyenda dukora igomba kuzaba yamaze kumenyekana kandi ari icyitegererezo mu gihugu.” Imideli batangiye gusakaza kugeza ubu harimo ingofero ndetse n’imipira yanditseho ‘KGL’. Ingofero bayigurisha amafaranga ibihumbi icumi[10,000frw] naho umupira ukagurishwa ibihumbi 30.

title: Iserukiramuco ry’imideli yo mu bukwe rigiye kubera i Kigali
content: Ibirori by’imideli yo mu bukwe [Wedding Fashion Show] bizabera i Kigali mu gihe cy’iminsi ibiri guhera ku itariki ya 9 Ukuboza kugeza kuwa 10 Ukuboza 2016. Mu kiganiro na IGIHE, Rusanganwa Laurent uyobora ikompanyi The Wedding Plus Ltd ari  nayo iri gutegura iki gikorwa yatangaje ko nyuma yo gutembera muri Uganda ,Kenya ndetse na Australia bakabona uburyo iserukiramuco ry’imideli yambarwa mu bukwe ihuruza abantu batagira ingano byabahaye imbaraga gufata bafata umwanzuro wo kubitegura mu Rwanda. Ati” Twasanze twarasigaye inyuma ntabwo ibi bintu byo kumurika imideli yambarwa mu bukwe abantu babizi. Nyamara ni igikorwa gituma ibikorerwa mu Rwanda bimenyekana ndetse n’abanyamahanga baba mu gihugu cyacu bakabizamo dore ko abo dutumira mu bukwe bwacu baba ari bake.” Rusanganwa yakomeje avuga ko iryo serukiramuco ry’imideli rizitabirwa n’inzu enye zikora imideli mu Rwanda ariko hakazibandwa ku yambarwa mu bukwe n’ibindi birori bisaba kurimba Ati” Kugira ngo duteze imbere gahunda ya Leta yo kumenyekanisha ibikorerwa mu Rwanda ,twatumiye Amazing Fashion Shop, ALTA Fashion and Decoration,Rupari Designs,Yozata, Monial Glamoor, abo bose bazamurika imideli bikorera mu guteza imbere Made in Rwanda” Iri serukiramuco ritamenyerewe mu Rwanda ni igikorwa kimwe mu bizaba bigize imurikagurisha ry’iminsi ibiri ryiswe Rwanda Wedding Expo rizahuriramo abafite ibikorwa bifite aho bihuriye no gutegura ubukwe. Abazamurika ibikorwa byabo muri Rwanda Wedding Expo ni abambika abageni, abatanga serivisi za decoration, abasokoza abageni, abakora cakes, sonorisation, abafotora abageni, abakora impeta, abacuruza amavuta yo kwisiga, abacuruza indabo, abakodesha imodoka zifashisha mu bukwe n’ibindi bitandukanye. Ibyo ngo bizafasha abafite ibirori bya vuba n’ababiteganya mu gihe kizaza kugira amakuru ahagije n’amahitamo menshi y’uwo bagomba guha akazi kabo.
