Rusanganwa Laurent ati” Usanga nkiyo uzi umuntu umwe gusa ufotora ukamuhamagara afite akazi kenshi hari ubwo yanga kukwitaba cyangwa akakurangira adakora neza ariko ubaye uzi abantu benshi byari kugufasha.” Iri serukiramuco rizamara iminsi ibiri, rizaba ku wa gatanu tariki ya 9 no ku wa gatandatu tariki ya 10 Ukuboza 2016, kwinjira bizaba ari ubuntu mu gusura abarimo kumurika ibikorwa byabo. Naho ku  mugoroba wo ku itariki ya 10 Ukuboza habe ibirori byo gusoza ari nabwo hazabaho igikorwa cy’iserukiramuco ry’imideli yambarwa mu bukwe kizatangira saa kumi n’imwe kugeza saa yine z’ijoro. Muri ibyo birori byo kwerekana imideli abazabyitabira bazasusurutswa n’abahanzi Charly na Nina ndetse na DJ Pius. Iryo serukiramuco riteganyijwe ko rizitabirwa n’abantu bagera ku gihumbi buri munsi ,rizabera mu Mujyi wa Kigali rwagati mu nyubako ya Kigali City Tower ahasanzwe habera ibitaramo. Ni igikorwa kigiye kujya kiba buri mwaka mu rwego rwo gufasha Abanyarwanda kudasigara inyuma mu kumenyekanisha ibyo bakora bijyanye n’imideli. [email protected]

title: Imyambarire idasanzwe yaranze ibirori by’imideli bya ‘Victoria’s Secret’ i Paris (Amafoto)
content: Ni ibirori bikomeye byabaye mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 30 Ugushyingo 2016 ahitwa Grand Palais mu Mujyi wa Paris mu Bufaransa. Victoria’s Secret Show’ yitabiriwe n’abanyamideli 51 bakomeye ku Isi barimo Alessandra Ambrosio, Adriana Lima, Taylor Hill, Jasmine Tookes, Kendall Jenner, abavandimwe Gigi na Bella Hadid, Lily Aldridge n’abandi banyuranye. Ku nshuro ya mbere kabiri, abanyamideli basanzwe ari inshuti Kendall Jenner na Gigi Hadid berekanye imideli muri ibi birori byahuruje imbaga mu Mujyi wa Paris. Abahanzi batandukanye barimo Lady Gaga, The Weeknd na Bruno Mars basusurukije ibi birori. Icyatunguranye ndetse kigashimisha benshi ni uburyo umunyamideli Bella Hadid yiyerekanye muri ibi birori ahura n’umuhanzi bahoze bakundana The Weeknd byongera ibyishimo mu bakurikiranye ibirori. Ibirori birangiye, muri Grand Palais hakwirakwijwe inkuru ihamya ko umunyamideli Irina Shayk wahoze akundana na Cristiano Ronaldo atwite inda ya Bradley Cooper gusa ababivuze nta gihamya batanze na nyir’ubwite kugeza ubu ntacyo yabivuzeho. Abitabiriye ibi birori baganiriye na ABC News bahamije ko ari byo bya mbere biruta ibindi byose byerekeranye n’imideli byabereye muri Grand Palais. Abategura iri murika ry’imideli rigamije no kwamamaza ibikorwa na Victoria’s Secret  bamaze kugera ku rwego rwo hejuru mu kwinjira amafaranga mu mideli, mu mwaka wa 2014/2015 ubukungu bwabo bwarazamutse bugera kuri miliyari 7.2 z’amadolari.

title: Jay D na Turahirwa bazaserukira u Rwanda mu mideli muri Tanzania na Nigeria
content: Ntabanganyimana Jean de Dieu [uzwi nka Jay D] na mugenzi we Turahirwa Moise [uyobora Moshions House] bari mu banyamideli bakomeye mu Karere bazitabira iserukiramuco ry’imideli rya Nigeria Men’s Fashion rizamara iminsi itatu ribera mu Mujyi wa Lagos. Aba bombi bazerekeza muri Nigeria kuwa 1 Ukuboza 2016, bazaba bitabiriye icyumweru cyahariwe imideli kizabera mu Mujyi wa Lagos. Jay D yabwiye IGIHE ko mbere yo kujya muri Nigeria hari ibindi bihembo batumiwemo bya Swahili Fashion Week Awards bizatangwa hasozwa iki cyumweru cy’imideli muri Tanzania. Yagize ati “Ni ibintu byanshimishije cyane kwibona mu batumiwe muri ibi bihugu byombi, ibyo bikorwa byombi ni binini, bizahuza abanyamideli bakomeye muri Afurika, kubijyamo ni iby’agaciro gakomeye cyane, nzungukiramo byinshi.” Yongeraho ati “Muri Nigeria nzajyana na Moise, badutumiye mu gikorwa cyitwa Nigeria Men’s Fashion, mbere y’aho hari ibindi bantumiyemo bizabera muri Tanzania, byo ni ibya Swahili Fashion Week, bazanatangamo ibihembo, ndi no mu bahatana mu cyiciro cya ‘East African Model of the Year’, gusa kubera uburyo byegeranye cyane sinzi niba nzabasha kujyayo.” Muri Swahili Fashion Week Awards, Turahirwa na we ari mu bahataniye ibihembo mu cyiciro cya East African Designer of the Year. Ahanganye n’abanyamideli bakomeye muri Afurika y’Uburasirazuba. Muri Nigeria, aba banyamideli bazahura n’abandi baturutse mu bihugu birenga mirongo itanu birimo ibyo muri Afurika, Amerika n’u Burayi. Jay D na Turahirwa Moise kandi bari mu banyamideli batoranyijwe guhatanira ibihembo bya Abryanz Style&Fashion Awards bizatangirwa mu Mujyi wa Kampala kuwa 9 Ukuboza 2016 muri Kampala Serena Hotel. Turahirwa ahatanye mu cyiciro kimwe muri ibi bihembo cya ‘Fashion Designer of the Year naho Ntabanganyimana Jean de Dieu [Jay D] akaba mu banyamideli bari kuzamuka neza mu Rwanda yatoranyijwe mu cyiciro ‘East African mising Model of the year’.

title: Sonia Mugabo yagiye kumurika imideli yahanze muri Madagascar
content: Sonia Mugabo washinze inzu y’imideli ya SM[Sonia Mugabo] mu mwaka wa 2013 yagiye muri Madagascar kwerekana no gucuruza imideli bwite ahangira mu Rwanda. Yajyanye n’irindi tsinda ry’abahanzi b’imideli bagize Haute Baso [yashinzwe na Candy Basomingera na Linda Mukangoga ]. Ibirori by’imideli bya Origin Africa Trade Show biri kubera i Antananarivo ku nshuro ya karindwi, byatangiye kuwa 3 Ugushyingo 2016 bizasozwa kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki ya 5 Ugushyingo. Mu kiganiro na TNT, Sonia Mugabo yavuze ko afite icyizere gikomeye ko iki gikorwa cyatumiwemo Abanyarwanda kizabahesha amahirwe yo kwigaragaza ku rwego rwa Afurika nk’abamaze gutera intambwe ikomeye mu buhanzi bw’imideli. Yanavuze ko muri Antananarivo we na bagenzi be bazabonerayo amahirwe mashya mu mideli bahanga ndetse ngo bazabona isoko ryagutse ku rwego mpuzamahanga mu bikorwa bakora. Sonia Mugabo n’abagize Haute Baso berekeje muri Madagascar nyuma y’ibyumweru bibiri bakoze ikindi gikorwa gikomeye cyahuje abahanzi b’imideli bibumbiye muri Collective Rw bamuritse imyambaro n’imirimbo bahanze yiganjemo iyo mu Rwanda mu birori bikomeye byabereye muri Kigali Serena Hotel mu ijoro ryo kuwa 14 Ukwakira 2016. Iyi Collective Rw yashinzwe n’abahanzi b’imideli barimo Sonia Mugabo, Teta Isibo, Mathew Rugamba, Linda Mukangoga na Candy Basomingera. Igikorwa cya Origin Africa Trade kibereye muri Madagascar nyuma y’uko mu mwaka ushize wa 2015 cyabereye mu Mujyi wa Addis Ababa muri Ethiopia.

title: Abanyamideli batanu bahagarariye u Rwanda muri Abryanz Style&Fashion Awards
content: Abatoranyijwe guserukira u Rwanda uyu mwaka harimo Ntabanganyimana Jean de Dieu [Jay D], Bashabe Kate, Georgie Ndirangu na Moise Turahirwa ndetse na Judith Heard ubikorera cyane muri Uganda. Umwaka ushize u Rwanda rwari rufitemo abanyamideli babiri, Judith Heard na Moise Turahirwa. Judith Heard yabashije kubona igihembo ariko mugenzi Moise Turahirwa ntiyabasha gutsinda. Uyu mwaka hatoranyijwe abantu b’ibyamamare mu byiciro bitandukanye barimo abavuga rikijyana mu cyiciro cy’abakora imideli, abahanzi b’imideli, abazi guhitamo neza imyambaro, abahanzi, abakora make-up, abanyamakuru mu ngeri zinyuranye n’abandi. Uretse kumurika imideli, Turahirwa afite inzu y’imideli yise ‘Moshions [Moses Fashions]’. Ahatanye mu cyiciro kimwe muri ibi bihembo cya ‘Fashion Designer  of the Year., ari kumwe n’abahanzi b’imideli bakomeye mu karere. Judith Heard wabonye igihembo umwaka ushize, asanzwe ari umwe mu banyamideli bahagaze neza muri Uganda ari na ho abana n’umuryango we. Ari mu cyiciro kimwe cya ‘Best Dressed Celebrity’ ari nacyo ahuriyemo na Kate Bashabe washinze Kabash Fashion House. George Ndirangu wo muri Kenya akaba n’umunyamakuru wa CNBC  uba mu Rwanda, bamushyize mu cyiciro cy’abahagarariye iki gihugu mu banyamakuru bambara neza[Best Dressed Media Personality]. Ntabanganyimana Jean de Dieu [Jay D] uri mu banyamideli bari kuzamuka neza mu Rwanda yatoranyijwe mu cyiciro ‘East African mising Model of the year’. Uyu amaze kwiyerekana cyane mu bikorwa byo kumurika imideli no gutanga amanota mu marushanwa ya Nyampinga anyuranye abera mu Rwanda. Ibirori byo gutangaza abatsinze bizaba kuwa 9 Ukuboza 2016 muri Kampala Serena Hotel.

title: Eric Birasa agiye gutangiza uruganda nyuma y’imyaka umunani mu mideli
content: Ni we washinze inzu y’imideli yitwa Ian Boutique mu mwaka wa 2008. Icyo gihe yari ifite intego yo kuzana mu Rwanda imideli mishya kandi igezweho mu bihugu bizwiho kurimba ku Isi. Eric Birasa yambitse ibyamamare bitabarika mu Rwanda no hanze. Azwi cyane kandi nk’umwe mu bafite ubumenyi mu gutoza no kwigisha abanyamideli ndetse mu minsi yashize yagizwe Umuyobozi w’Ihuriro ry’Abanyamideli b’umwuga Premier Model Agency [PMA]. Mu myaka amaze mu by’imideli yatoje benshi mu banyamideli bakomeye mu Rwanda ndetse inzu yashinze ya Ian Boutique yamufashije kwambika ibyamamare birimo abaririmbyi bo mu Rwanda, abakobwa bitabiriye irushanwa rya Miss Rwanda mu myaka itatu ishize muri 2014, 2015 ndetse na 2016. Ati “Mu myaka umunani maze muri uyu mwuga nambitse abantu benshi bazwi, nahereye hasi cyane nza kuzamuka ku buryo nko kwambika Ally Soudy mu bukwe bwe numvaga bikomeye cyane.” Eric Birasa yavuze ko gukunda akazi ko guhanga no guhitiramo abantu imideli ibabereye byamuzamuye ku rwego rukomeye ndetse yambika benshi mu byamamare nyuma ya Ally Soudy. Ati “Nambitse Urban Boyz mu bitaramo bitandukanye, Riderman mu bukwe bwe, abahanzi muri Salax Awards zitandukanye. Ikindi gikomeye cyanamfashije kurushaho kumenyekana ni uko nagiye nambika abakobwa mu itorwa rya Nyampinga kuva muri 2014 ndetse n’abanyamideli bakomeye mu birori bagiye bitabira.” Imizi yo gushinga iduka ry’imideli… Eric Birasa yavuze ko atigeze ahabwa ubumenyi mu by’imideli gusa yakoze ijoro n’amanywa ashakisha ibigezweho mu bindi bihugu kugira ngo abo yambika banyurwe ari nacyo avuga ko yubakiyeho mu iterambere rye. Igitekerezo cyo gushinga inzu y’imideli yakigize nk’umuntu wakundaga kurimba ariko akifuza no kubikorera abandi. Mu mwaka wa 2008 nibwo yatangiye kubikora agamije kuvanamo inyungu ndetse biranamuhira ubu abikora nk’akazi gahoraho. Ati “Mu buzima busanzwe njyewe nakundaga kwambara neza, igihe kigeze ntekereza uburyo nabikora nkambika abantu ariko nkabibonamo n’amafaranga hanyuma mu mwaka wa 2008 nibwo natangiye gukora aka kazi ndetse mbikore nk’ubucuruzi ari nabwo nagize ubushobozi bwo gushinga Ian Boutique.” “Icyatumye ngira imbaraga cyane ndetse nkamenyekana ni uko nakoranye n’itangazamakuru, nagiye nambika abantu b’ibyamamare, uwo nambikaga azwi yampuzaga n’abandi ngira n’umugisha abanyamakuru baranyoboka menyekana gutyo.” Imideli ye imyinshi ayivana mu mahanga mu bihugu bizwimo abantu barimba cyane. Avuga ko ari akazi kagoye guhitiramo abantu imideli ndetse biba ingorabahizi kurushaho iyo azanye imyambaro imuhenze cyane yagera mu gihugu akabangamirwa n’isoko rito n’ubushobozi budahagije bw’abakiriya be. Ati “Icya mbere bisaba gusoma cyane no gukurikirana uko mu bindi bihugu bigenda no kumenya ibigezweho. Nkurikirana inzu zikomeye zambika abantu ku Isi nkamenya ibigezweho haba mu myambaro y’abagabo ndetse n’iy’abagore, ntabwo bingora kubimenya ahubwo ikigorana ni uko akenshi biba bihenze.” Yongeyeho ati “Iyo utangiye business ntabwo uhita utangira kubara inyungu, natangiye bingoye cyane ndihangana nkomeza kubikora kuko nabikundaga, navuga ko mu myaka umunani maze nkora ibi bintu byo kwambika abantu ari bwo ntangiye kubona inyungu. Imbogamizi ikomeye cyane ni uko isoko ari rito, amafaranga ni make ku isoko mu gihe ibyo mvana hanze biba bihenze.” Yerekeje amaso ku gushinga uruganda Birasa yavuze ko inzu ye y’imideli yihaye icyerekezo gishya cyo gushinga uruganda ruto ruzajya rumufasha gukora imideli irimo ubuhanga bwerekana inkomoko y’ibyo bakora hagendewe ku kwihesha agaciro no guteza imbere gahunda ya ‘Made in Rwanda’. Yagize ati “Politiki y’igihugu ubu iradushishikariza gukunda iby’iwacu binyuze muri gahunda ya ‘Made in Rwanda’, ubu icyerekezo mfite ni ugutangiza uruganda rukora imyenda y’iwacu. Nagenze mu bihugu byinshi ndeba uko bakora, ubu ndifuza kuzashaka ubushobozi ngatangiza uburyo buzajya butuma Abanyarwanda bambara imyenda yakorewe iwacu, byose ni ukwihangana no kugira intego nizeye ko bizashoboka.” Mbere yo gutangiza uruganda ngo agiye gushakisha ubushobozi bwisumbuyeho ajye agura imideli igezweho ayigurishe bya burundu bitandukanye n’uko mu myaka yari amaze yabikoraga atiza abantu bakamuha amafaranga ubundi bakayimusubiza. Ati “Ubusanzwe ngitangira nambikaga ibyamamare, abanyamideli, ba Nyampinga, abageni mu bukwe n’abandi bantu bafite ibirori. Ntabwo mbere nagurishaga imyenda, uraza tukakwambika ukishyura ubukode ukazadusubiza imyenda yacu, ubu rero ndashaka ko nazajya njya mu mahanga nkagura imyambaro igezweho, umudeli wose ugezweho mu mahanga nkawuzana i Kigali abafite ubushobozi bakaba babigura bikaba ibyabo burundu, hari abantu baba bifuza gutunga iyo myenda, ni bake ariko barahari.” Abantu bazwi Eric Birasa amaze kwambika...

title: Amafoto aryoheye ijisho mu birori by’imideli ya ‘Made in Rwanda’
content: Ibi birori by’imideli byari byiswe ‘Week of Fashion’ byateguwe n’ikompanyi Collective Rw ihuriwemo n’abanyamideli bo mu Rwanda bagamije guteza imbere imideli yahangiwe mu Rwanda ndetse no kuzamura ireme ry’abakora uyu mwuga bakamenyekana ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Collective Rw yashinzwe n’abahanzi b’imideli barimo Sonia Mugabo, Teta Isibo, Mathew Rugamba, Linda Mukangoga na Candy Basomingera. Ibirori byo kwerekana imideli baherutse gutegura ngo bizajya biba buri mwaka. Ibyo bateguye ku nshuro ya mbere byiyerekanyemo abanyamideli basaga mirongo itatu biganjemo abasore n’inkumi zimaze kugira ubuhanga mu kwerekana imideli. Imideli yerekanywe irimo amakanzu, amashati, amapantaro, inkweto, ibikapu byo mu moko yose, ingofero n’imirimbo inyuranye byose bikorerwa mu Rwanda.  Iyi mideli yakorewe mu Rwanda muri  Amizero, Inco Icyusa, Uzi collections, House of Tayo, Inzuki designs, Haute Baso, Sonia Mugabo ndetse na Naked Ape yo muri Afurika y’Epfo. Imideli yishimiwe cyane n’abantu bagera ku gihumbi bari baje kureba ibirori. Mu yanyuze benshi harimo imbumbe y’imideli yitwa ‘Stella’ yahanzwe na Sonia Mugabo ndetse n’iya Teta Isibo muri Inzuki Designs. Ibirori byitabiriwe n’abayobozi bakomeye ku rwego rw’igihugu barimo Madamu Jeannette Kagame n’umukobwa we Ange Kagame, Minisitiri w’Ubucuruzi n’ Inganda, Kanimba Francois, Minisitiri w’Umuco na Siporo Uwacu Julienne n’abandi bayobozi mu nzego zitandukanye. Umunyamakuru wa CNBC George Ndirangu na Rita Umulisa ni bo bayoboye ibi birori byamaze igihe kigera ku isaha n’iminota 45. Ibirori byarangiye ubona ku maso abantu bakinyotewe no gukomeza kureba imideli yamuritswe gusa ababiteguye bavuze ko hari ibindi bitaramo bizagenda biba mu minsi iza. Imideli yahanzwe na Mizero Cedric Uzi collections Inco Icyusa Naked Ape  Imideli ya Sonia Mugabo Inzuki designs House of Tayo iyobowe na Matthew Tayo Rugamba Haute Baso Amafoto: Mahoro Luqman

title: Umugore wa Stromae yasohoye icyiciro cya gatatu cy’imideli yakoze
content: Ni nyuma y’igihe gito atangaje ko ubugeni n’imideli akora yifuza ko byakwamamara ku Isi. Yanavuze ko yifuza kwambika ibyamamare birimo Beyonce na Rihanna. Paul Van Haver [Stromae] na Coralie Barbier bari bamaze igihe mu kiruhuko, ntibakoraga cyane iby’ubuhanzi bw’indirimbo basanzwe bafatanyamo gusa uyu mugore yakoranaga bya hafi n’abadozi bamufasha mu by’imideli asigaye yibandaho cyane. Aba bombi basezeranye mu ibanga rikomeye kuwa Gatandatu tariki ya 12 Ukuboza 2015 mu muhango wabereye i Malines mu Ntara ya Antwerp mu Bubiligi. Barbier ni we umwambika imyambaro yose ajyana mu ruhame, akaba yaranamuhimbiye ubwoko bw’imyambaro akunda kugararagarana yise ‘Collection Mosaert’. Imideli bashyize hanze ni mike ugereranyije n’iyo bamaze amezi atandatu basohoye, imishya irimo inkweto imiguru 18[umuguru umwe ucuruzwa ku ma- euros24] ndetse n’imipira n’amakabutura 20 ya Polo[bicuruzwa ku ma- euros 125]. Muri Mata 2016 Barbier  yashyize hanze igice cya kabiri cya ‘Collection Mosaert’. Icyo gihe Stromae yatangarije ikinyamakuru Le temps ko yizeye kuzabona inyungu itubutse mu mideli umugore we ahanga ndetse ko bitazabangamira iterambere ry’umuziki we. Yagize ati “Twizeye ko byombi bizagenda neza kuko biratandukanye. Stromae ni umushinga w’ibanze ariko na none iyi myambaro nayo ifite agaciro, iri ku ruhande, ibaho yonyine kandi bizanshimisha nayo nimenyekana cyane.” Coralie Barbier yunzemo agira ati “Ni uburyo bubiri bwo kwigaragaza […] Umushinga w’umuziki uhagaze ntabwo byatubuza gukomeza mu yindi nzira. Ni urugero, nk’ubu turifuza gushaka isoko ry’imyenda mu Buyapani kuko umushinga w’umuziki ntitwawerekanyeyo.” Stromae yavuze ko yifuza kuzabona imyambaro umugore we akora yamamaye ku Isi. Imyenda badoda ikorerwa mu Bubiligi ni naho hari amaduka menshi ayicuruza kurusha abandi. Bacuruza idoze mu bitenge bya wagisi [wax] bizwi muri Afurika ariko hari n’indi ya polo icuruzwa ku giciro gihanitse cyane. Stromae afata Barbier nk’umuntu ukomeye mu kugaragara neza kwe mu myambarire, kuko hari benshi bayimukundira. Avuga ko kera, ataramenyana na Barbier, byamugoraga guhitamo imyambaro ahanini bitewe n’indeshyo ye.

title: Amafoto y’ibirori byo kwerekana imideli gakondo i Kigali
content: Ni ibirori ngarukamwaka byo kurimba byabaye mu ijoro ryo kuwa Gatandatu tariki ya 24 Nzeri kuri Sports View Hotel i Remera. Muri uyu mwaka, ibirori byo kurimba bya ‘Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show’ byabaye mu bice bitatu, icya mbere cyabaye ku itariki ya 13 Gicurasi 2016 cyari umusogongero no kwerekana uko ibirori nyamukuru byo kuwa 24 Nzeri; ndetse n’ikindi gikorwa gikomeye cyabaye kuwa 1 Nzeri 2016 mu cyaro mu Karere ka Musanze mu birori by’imideli igaragaza ishusho nyakuri y’ubuzima bw’Abanyarwanda hambere igihugu kigitwarwa n’abami. Abantu babyitabiriye wabonaga buri wese yakoze ibishoboka ngo aze yambaye umudeli umubereye kandi ujyanye n’ibirori byari byateguwe. Abahanzi b’imideli bamuritse imyambaro harimo Augustin Hakizima werekanye uko mu Rwanda rwo hambere bambaraga, Umurerwa Jossete werekanye imbumbe y’imideli[collection] yise ‘Umunyu’ , Nadege Umutoni yerekanye imideli yahanze ku myambarire yo muri Botswana mu myaka ya mbere ya 1900. title: Umunyamideli  Iraguha Francis ajyanye akandi gashya muri Rwanda Day i San Francisco
content: Mu kiganiro cyihariye Iraguha yagiranye n’umunyamakuru wa IGIHE uri muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, yatangaje ko muri uyu mwaka ajyanye ibintu byinshi azamurikira akanagurisha abazitabira Rwanda Cultural Day ndetse bitandukanye n’ibyabaye umwaka  wa 2014. Kuri iyi nshuro abazashaka kugura bifashishize amakarita mvunjafaranga (Credit/debit card), nabo bazabasha kugura nta  mbogamizi. Mu byo ajyanye harimo imyambaro y’ubwoko butandukanye yahanze. Yavuze ko hari n’imyambaro yahanze nyuma yo gusinyanya amasezerano y’ubufatanye n’abahanzi bibumbiye muri “Press One barimo” Meddy na The Ben byose bihaka biri no muri gahunda yo guteza imbere ibikorerwa mu Rwanda ya “Made in Rwanda”. Uretse kuba azerekana ibyo akora akanabigurisha, uyu munyamideli wabigize umwuga, unafite  sosiyeti  yitwa Francis Zahabu ari no mu biganiro byo kureba uburyo yakora ubucuruzi by’ibyo akora abinyujije muri gahunda ihuza abacuruzi b’Abanyarwanda bari muri gahunda y’ubucuruzi ihuza bimwe mu bihugu bya Afurika na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika “African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA),  akaba ateganya ko mu minsi yavuba bishoboka ko yazajya yohereza ibyo akora muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu buryo buhoraho. Rwanda Day y’uyu mwaka izaba kuwa 24 Nzeri ibere mu Mujyi wa San Francisco muri Leta ya California, imwe muri 50 zigize Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Uyu mwaka yahawe izina ryihariye ‘Rwanda Cultural Day’ hagamijwe kurushaho kwita ku muco Nyarwanda no kuwukundisha abatawuzi.

title: Ibirori by’imideli gakondo bizahuza abo mu bihugu birindwi
content: Muri uyu mwaka, ibirori byo kurimba bya ‘Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show’ byabaye mu bice bibiri, icya mbere cyabaye ku itariki ya 13 Gicurasi 2016 cyari umusogongero no kwerekana uko ibirori nyamukuru byo kuwa 24 Nzeri 2016 bizaba biteguwe. Ibirori nyir’izina bizabera kuri Sports View Hotel i Remera kuwa 24 Nzeri 2016, bizahuriza hamwe abahanzi b’imideli [fashion designers] bazava mu bihugu birindwi birimo Rwanda, Kenya, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo,Tanzania, Nigeria na Uganda. Abahanzi b’imideli 12 bazerekana ubwoko bw’imideli bugera kuri cumi na bubiri mu byiciro byose haba mu myambaro y’abagore n’iy’abagabo. Muri aba bahanzi b’imideli bitezwe muri Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show harimo batandatu bo mu Rwanda gusa abandi bazaturuka hanze y’igihugu. Abo mu Rwanda barimo Augustin Hakizima (azerekana uko mu Rwanda rwo hambere bambaraga), Umurerwa Jossete, Inzovu Village: african print & Batik, Odette SCH ltd  na Mutuyeyezu Marie Paule, N&S creations[ni abahanzi bakizamuka bibumbiye hamwe]. Kenya izaba ihagarariwe na  Vinn Clizz uzerekana imyenda abagabo barimbana, ndetse na Tanzania izaba ifitemo umwe witwa Hameed Abdul ugiye kuza mu Rwanda ku nshuro ya kabiri. Igihugu cya Uganda kizaba gihagarariwe na  Robinah U5, bo bazerekana ibyiganjemo imirimbo igezweho n’imyambaro y’abana. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika hazaza uwitwa Nancy Zeller, Anne Dickson wo muri Nigeria na Patricia Kinga wo muri RDC uzerekana imyenda ikunze kwifashishwa mu birori by’ubukwe. Mu gutegura Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show izaba kuwa 24 Nzeri 2016, Ntawirema Celestin umuyobozi w’igikorwa avuga ko yabanje gukora ingendoshuri mu bindi bihugu yigira ku bandi uko bategura ibikorwa nk’ibi. Ati “Igikorwa kirihariye kuko nakoze ingendoshuri mu bindi bihugu nigira ku bandi. Nagiye muri Dubai Fashion Week, Singapore, Hong Kong, aho hose narebye ukuntu bakora. Mu gikorwa twateguye nagerageje gufata abahanga imideli [Fashion Designers] b’abahanga bazerekana ibintu bizima, ikindi ni uko tuzakora ibintu biri ku murongo.” Yongeraho ati “Muri rusange icyo abantu bakwitega ni uko bizaba ari byiza cyane kuko bazabasha kubona imyenda myinshi kandi myiza. Uburyo bwo kwicara buzaba bumeze neza kuko buri tike izaba irimo icyo kunywa. Ikindi ni uko n’umuntu uzazana n’umuryango twabateganyirije uburyo abantu bane bazicarana ahantu hamwe kandi bakabona icyo kunywa." Abanyamideli 30 baziyerekana muri ibi birori, harimo bane bazaturuka muri Kenya n’abandi babiri bazava muri Tanzania, abasigaye bose ni abasanzwe bakora uyu mwuga barimo n’abashya bo mu Rwanda. Mu myaka ine ishize atangije Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show amaze kuzamura abanyamideli barenga ijana ndetse ubu avuga ko ashakisha uburyo yabageza ku rwego mpuzamahanga. title: Umwihariko udasanzwe mu birori by’imideli y’ibwami mu Rwanda rwo hambere (Amafoto)
content: Igikorwa cya Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show cyabereye bwa mbere mu gice cy’icyaro i Nyakinama, cyahuriranye n’ibirori bikomeye byo gusoza icyumweru cyahariwe ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku muco ‘Cultural Tourism Week’ kuri uyu wa 1 Nzeri 2016. Igikorwa cyo kwerekana imideli n’ubuzima gakondo Abanyarwanda babagamo ku ngoma ya cyami, cyateguwe na Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show[isanzwe itegura ibirori by’imideli gakondo] ifatanyije na ‘Red Rocks’. Muri uyu mwaka, ibirori byo kurimba bya ‘Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show’ byabaye mu bice bibiri, icya mbere cyabereye ahitwa i Nyakinama mu Karere ka Musanze mu gihe igice cya kabiri kizabera mu Mujyi wa Kigali kuwa 24 Nzeri 2016. Byari ibirori binogeye ijisho kandi bitanga ishusho nyakuri y’ubuzima umwami yabanagamo n’abaturage be umunsi ku wundi. Akarusho gakomeye muri ibi birori [byari byitabiriwe n’abiganjemo abanyamahanga n’abaturage bo muri aka gace] ni umukino wigishije benshi uko ibwami bishimiraga umusaruro w’igihugu bagasangira n’indi migenzo yabiherekezaga. Umushengero wanyuze benshi… Ni ibirori byari byihariye ugereranyije n’ibindi by’imideli bisanzwe bibera mu Rwanda. By’umwihariko ababiteguye berekanye ubudasa ‘mu mukino w’umushengero abanyamideli bashushanya uko Abanyarwanda bo hambere biyerekaga umwami ko bafite amaboko mahire’. Urebye ishusho mbumbe y’umukino wabonaga ko byasabye imbaraga mu guhuza imyambarire gakondo n’ubutumwa bwatanzwe. Carlos Gerolf, Umudage witabiriye ibi birori yabwiye IGIHE ati “…ni umwihariko, nabikunze, nakunze kuriya abasore basokoje n’indirimbo zabo wumvaga zihariye.” Abanyamideli 90 bahuje imbaraga muri ibi birori berekanya uko imihango yo kuraguza, guterekera, gutera icyuhagiro n’ubuvuzi bwa Kinyarwanda bwakorwaga hambere. Muri ibi birori kandi hasobanuwe akamaro k’ingoma mu gihe cyo hambere, amagambo akwiye yakoreshwaga ibwami n’ibindi. Muri Red Rocks ahabereye ibi birori hanatangiwemo amasomo [ku babishaka] ku buryo kwenga inzoga ya Kinyarwanda byakorwaga, gusya, kubumba, kwivuga, kuraguza [n’ibikoresho byabaga mu ndaro], kumasha n’ibindi byihariwe n’u Rwanda. Umuyobozi wa Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show, Ntawirema Celestin yavuze ko bateguye iki gikorwa mu gace k’icyaro mu rwego rwo kugaragaza byeruye ubuzima gakondo bw’Abanyarwanda mu myaka yo hambere bitandukanye n’igikorwa gisanzwe kibera i Kigali. Ati “Iki gikorwa twashatse ko kiba umwihariko, i Kigali byari bigoye cyane kubona ibikoresho birimo nk’uruho, umuheto, umuvure, urusyo n’ingasire, urutara n’ibindi byerekana akarango k’umuco nyarwanda.” Yongeraho ati “Ntabwo byadukundiraga ko mu gikorwa dutegura i Kigali twerekana uko gukama ibitoki bikorwa, uko urwagwa rutegurwa, imibereho y’umwami, kwigisha abantu gusya n’ibindi […] Urebye ibyo twakoze urabonamo umwihariko n’itandukaniro.” Abanyamideli biyerekanye bambaye impu Imideli yose biyerekanyemo yari yiganjemo iyambarwaga hambere by’umwihariko impu n’ishabure ndetse no kogosha amasunzu ari nabyo bishushanya imimerere y’umunyarwanda wo hambere. Mu gukina uko umwami yabagaho hambere, abanyamideli berekanye ko yari umuyobozi mukuru wabaga wubashywe n’abaturage be, ibi babigaragaje mu kumuheka berekana imihango yose yamukorerwaga mu kumuha ikuzo. Ibi birori byahujwe no gusoza icyumweru cyahariwe ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku muco cyabaye kuva kuwa 26 Kanama kugeza kuwa 1 Nzeri 2016. Yavuze ko mu myaka itaha we n’itsinda rimufasha bazashyiramo ingufu kugira ngo bijye byitabirwa n’abandi bo mu bice by’igihugu. Ati “Nk’icyanshimishije cyane ni uko twakoresheje abanyamideli ba hano muri Musanze, hari abana biga mu mashuri yisumbuye twahuje n’abagore bo mu cyaro n’bagabo ba hano kugira babigishe ibyo batazi, murabona nko kwerekana uko umwami yabagaho abenshi mu biyerekanye bari bataranavuka ku buryo kugira ngo babikore neza byadusabye abakecuru babizi, babahaye amasomo, natwe ntabwo twari tubizi byose.” Ibindi bikorwa byerekanwe harimo kwigisha abantu kuraguza, kwenga urwagwa, uko umusaruro watunganywaga mbere yo guhunikwa, gucunda amata, guhamiriza, guhiga mu ishyamba, ubusabane ku ntango, ubuvuzi gakondo, kubumba inkono n’ibibindi. Ntawirema ati “Abanyamideli babitojwe igihe kinini, uriya mukino wadutwaye imbaraga, ntibyari byoroshye kwigisha abana bakiri bato uko umwami yabagaho mu rugo rwe, uko yasabanaga n’abaturage, uko abaja bakoraga akazi, uko abakobwa bakuburaga ndetse ukabasaba ko babikora kandi bakabikina neza.” By’umwihariko abanyamideli benshi biyerekanye muri ibi birori ni abavuka muri Musanze hakiyongeramo bake baturutse i Kigali. Ntawirema yijeje abazitabira Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show izabera i Kigali kuwa 24 Nzeri 2016 ko bazabona ibirori birusha iby’imyaka yatambutse.

title: Urutonde rw’abanyamideli 10 bakize kurusha abandi ku Isi
content:
Ntacyiyerekana mu byo kwerekana imideli no gukora ibitaramo byo kurimba ariko Gisele Bündchen aracyayoboye abo basangiye umwuga mu kwinjiza amafaranga. Uyu mwaka yinjije miliyoni 30.5 z’amadolari, yicaye ku mwanya wa mbere kuva mu mwaka wa 2002. Forbes magazine yakoze uru rutonde yatangaje ko uyu mugore wamamaye muri filime ‘Taxi, The Devil Wears Prada’ amafaranga menshi yayavanye mu bikorwa byo kwamamaza n’ubufatanye agirana n’ibigo bikomeye by’ubucuruzi. Gisele Bündchen akorana na Chanel , Carolina Herrera na Pantene, ibi byiyongeraho ibikorwa byo kwamamaza inkweto zikorwa na Arezzo ndetse na SkyTV y’iwabo muri Brazil. Afite kandi ibikorwa bye bwite by’ubucuruzi bibyara inyungu. Uyu mugore ureshya na 1.8 m amaze kwinjiza miliyoni 430 z’amadolari mu myaka amaze akora iby’imideli.  Ku mwanya wa kabiri haje Adriana Lima na we wo muri Brazil, yinjije miliyoni 10.5 z’amadolari. Kendall Jenner yaje ku mwanya wa gatatu na miliyoni 10 z’amadolari, amafaranga yinjiza yarazamutse ku gipimo cya 150% mu mwaka wa 2016 kubera gukoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga mu buryo bubyara inyungu. Jenner ayoboye abanyamideli bose bari kuri uru rutonde mu gukurikirwa cyane kuri Instagram. Akurikiwe na miliyoni 64.4 ari nazo zamufashije kwinjiza menshi mu mafaranga kubera ibikorwa yamamaza bya Estée Lauder na Calvin Klein. 1.Gisele Bündchen: $30.5 million (£22 million)  Ni Umunya-Brazil w’imyaka 36, mu 1998 yagaragaye ku gifuniko cy’inyamakuru gikomeye mu Bwongereza ‘Vogue’. Kuva mu mwaka wa 2004 kugeza ubu ayoboye abanyamideli babona amafaranga menshi ku Isi. Ni umugore wa Tom Brady, ubu bafitanye abana babiri. 2. Adriana Lima: $10.5 million (£8 million)  Adriana Lima na we akomoka muri Brazil, amafaranga menshi abona ayavana mu kwamamariza Maybelline, Vogue Eyewear na IWC watches. Kimwe na Gisele, Adriana afite abana babiri. yarushinganye n’umukinnyi wa NBA,Marko Jarić gusa baje gutandukana mu mwaka wa 2014. 3. Kendall Jenner: $10 million (£7.6 million)  Ni murumuna wa Kim Kardashian, afite imyaka 20 y’amavuko akareshya na 1.79. Kendall Jenner yinjije amadolari miliyoni10 kuva muri Kamena 2015. Muri uyu mwaka amafaranga yinjiza yazamutse ku kigero cya 150%, ni na we wa mbere mu gukurikirwa cyane kuri Instagram mu banyamideli bari kuri uru rutonde. 3. Karlie Kloss: $10 million (£7.6 million)  Karlie Elizabeth Kloss akomoka i Chicago, yujuje imyaka 24 y’amavuko. Yahuriye ku mwanya wa Gatatu na Jenner aho na we yinjije miliyoni 10 z’amadolari. 5. Gigi Hadid: $9 million (£6.8 million)  Kimwe na Jenner, Gigi na we yatangiye ibyo kumurika imideli afite imyaka ibiri. Yamamariza Maybelline , Tommy, Evian, BMW n’andi maduka akomeye muri Amerika. Yamamaye cyane ubwo umuryango we wagaragaraga mu kiganiro mpamo cyitwa The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills. 5. Rosie Huntington-Whiteley: $9 million (£6.8 million)  Uyu Mwongerezakazi na we w’imyaka 29 yaje ku mwanya wa gatanu na miliyoni 9 z’amadolari. Amafaranga menshi yayakuye mu mibavu ye bwite acuruza, amavuta y’abagore n’ibindi bikorwa byo kwamamaza. 7.Cara Delevingne: $8.5 million (£6.4 million)  
Amafaranga menshi yayakuye mu bufatanye mu kwamamaza agirana na YSL Beauty, Burberry na Tag Heur . Ku myaka 24 amaze no gukina muri filime eshatu uyu mwaka harimo “Suicide Squad” n’izindi ebyiri zigiye gusohoka. 8. Candice Swanepoel $7 million (£5.3 million)  Uyu munyamideli w’imyaka  27 yinjije miliyoni zirindwi. Yaje kuri uru rutonde bwa mbere muri 2012, ubu aritegura kubyara umwana wa mbere. 8. Liu Wen: $7 million (£5.3 million)  Liu Wen yabaye umunyamideli wa mbere muri Aziya uje kuri uru rutonde rukorwa na Forbes hari mu mwaka wa 2013, kuva icyo gihe kugeza ubu aza mu banyamideli 10 ba mbere bafite amafaranga. Yavukiye mu majyepfo y’uburasirazuba bw’u Bushinwa. Ubu afite imyaka 28, atuye mu Mujyi wa New York. Akorana na Estee Lauder na La Perla. 10. Miranda Kerr: $6 million (£4.5 million)  Ni umunyamideli wo muri Australia. Miranda Kerr yamamaye cyane mu by’imideli muri  2012. Mu 1997 ni bwo yinjiye mu mideli icyo gihe yari afite imyaka 13. Kerr afite umwana w’umuhungu yabyaranye n’umukinnyi wa filime Orlando Bloom. Aherutse gutangaza ko yambitswe impeta y’urukundo n’umwe mu bashinze Snapchat Evan Spiegel.

title: Inkumi yagaye Messi ‘witwaye nk’umurambo’ bakora imibonano mpuzabitsina
content: Inkuru igezweho kuri Messi ni iy’umunyamideli wo muri Argentine witwa Xoana Gonzalez  wandagaje uyu mugabo, yamwise umunebwe bwimbi mu buriri ahereye ku mibonano mpuzabitsina bakoze muri 2011. Umunyamideli Xoana Gonzalez yavuze ko atazibagirwa ibihe bibi yagiranye na Lionel Messi wamusabye ko bakorana imibonano mpuzabitsina ariko bagera mu gitanda akitwara nabi ku kigero cyo hejuru. Uyu rurangiranwa mu gutaha izamu mu mupira w’amaguru asanzwe azwiho ubuhanga mu gutsinda ibitego muri FC Barcelona. Gonzalez ariko ‘yagaye cyane imyitwarire ya Messi wananiwe gutaha izamu ubwo bari hagati y’amashuka’. Mu kiganiro ’the value of truth’ gica kuri Televiziyo yo muri Peru, Gonzalez yavuze byimbitse iby’umubano we na Lionel Messi umaze kwegukana  Balon d’Or inshuro eshanu. Yahamije ko yakundanye by’igihe gito na Messi ndetse bakorana imibonano mpuzabitsina itaramuhaye uburyohe ku bw’umusore wananiwe gukora akazi. Yagize ati “Ni mu myaka ishize. Mu by’ukuri yari [Messi] akiri muto ariko yari azi ibyo akora kuko ntiyari munsi y’imyaka y’ubukure, nicyo cyari ingenzi.” Yongeraho ati ‘Abashinzwe umutekano we  barambwiye ngo ‘babonye umuntu ushaka ko tumenyana’. Nagize amatsiko yo kumubona, nibazaga uwo ari we, naratitiye nkibona ari Messi nakundaga, naratitiye.” Umukobwa ngo yatahuye Messi ko ari umunyabwoba ku nkumi rugikubita kuko yatinye kumwiteretera ahubwo amutumaho abamurinda. Ati “Navuga ko afite intinyi, kuko yohereje abashinzwe umutekano we baza kumfata. Nahise mvumbura ko ari umunyabwoba cyane.” “Twavuganye iby’umuziki, sinibuka niba naramubajije niba afite umukunzi cyangwa niba bitarabayeho. Hashize umwanya twagiye mu nzu yari acumbitsemo muri Puerto Madero.” Gonzalez na Messi bageze mu buriri, umusore yitwaye nabi ku buryo ngo inkumi yakekaga ko uwo baryamanye ari umurambo. Yavuze ko atiyumvisha uburyo Messi yananirwa kwirwanaho imbere y’inkumi kandi ari we wamusabye ko bajyana mu gitanda. Ati “Nashakaga ko ankorera ibirenze biriya, ku ruhande rumwe numvaga nsa n’uryamanye n’umurambo!” Lionel Messi w’imyaka 29 ntaragira icyo atangaza kuri aya makuru yavuzwe na Gonzalez. Messi afite ibihembo bitanu by’umukinnyi mwiza ku Isi, yatwaye ibikombe bikomeye birenga 30 ari kumwe n’ikipe ya FC Barcelona akinira kuva afite imyaka 17. Yasezeye mu ikipe y’igihugu nyuma y’uko yari amaze imyaka 11 ayikinira.

title: Inkomoko y’iterambere umunyamideli Kate Bashabe yagezeho
content:
Uretse ubuhanga n’umurava mu gukora ubushabitsi, Kate Bashabe ni umwe mu bakobwa bafite uburanga n’ikimero ndetse byashimangiwe mu mwaka wa 2010 agirwa Nyampinga wa MTN, muri 2012 yabishyizeho akadomo yambikwa ikamba rya Nyampinga wa Nyarugenge igicumbi cy’abakobwa b’indobanure mu bwiza. Ntiyabaye nka ya hene babwiye ko ari nziza guhera ubwo ntiyongere gushokora ibyatsi ngo irishe ndetse ishishe kurushaho. Guhera muri 2011, Kate Bashabe ntiyongeye kuryama ngo ahezeyo, yahoranaga umutima uhagaze ashakisha inzira zamuvana mu cyiciro cy’abakora bakarindira umushahara w’ukwezi. Kate Bashabe yatangiye urugendo rukomeye mu mwaka wa 2012, yahereye ku mafaranga yizigamiraga ku mushahara yakoreraga icyo gihe. Ati “Icyo gihe nahoraga mfite inyota yo kwikorera business yanjye, nakundaga ibintu by’imideli bityo ngira igitekerezo cyo gukora ibintu byo gucuruza imyenda. Nari mfite amafaranga nazigamye ku mushahara ndavuga reka nyoherereze umushuti wanjye uba hanze andangurire imyenda.” Iby’ubwiza no kwitwa Nyampinga yabishyize ku ruhande. Yatangiye acuruza imyenda iciriritse ariko myiza, nta duka yagiraga ahubwo yakoraga urugendo rw’amaguru ashakisha abakiriya, yategaga moto ari uko yabonye inyungu y’umurengera muri duke yacuruzaga. Yizigamiye ahereye ku bikoroto Ibi byose yabikoraga muri ubu buryo ashakisha uko yarundarunda udufaranga ngo azagwize ayo gushinga iduka. Inshuti ze n’abari bamuzi icyo gihe, hari abamubonaga bakamuha urw’amenyo, abandi bakamuca intege ‘ko atazabishobora’. Ati “Ntabwo yari imyenda myinshi cyane ariko yari myiza. Icyo gihe natangiye kubwira abantu bose ko natangiye gucuruza imyenda, bamwe baransekaga ariko bakagura, abandi bakantera ingufu.” Yongeraho ati “Namaze umwaka hafi ibiri nkora ubwo bucuruzi bwo gusanga abantu ahantu bari mbashyiriye imyenda. Nacibwaga intege, n’abo mu muryango batangira kumbwira ko ntazabishobora ariko nkomeza urugendo.” Ku bwo kwihangana no gushyira umutima ku nzozi ze, mu mwaka wa 2013 yagwije amafaranga yamufashije gushinga inzu y’imideli yitwa ‘Kabash Fashion House’. Yaje no gushinga indi nzu yise ‘Kabash House’ ikoreramo ibintu by’ubukorikori, kudoda imyenda, gukora utubati, ibitanda n’ibindi bikoresho bigezweho byo mu nzu. Ati “Icyamfashije ni uko nabikaga inyungu cyane kuko nifuzaga kuzashinga iduka kandi sinari kubigeraho ntizigamira. Ndibuka muri 2012 irangira hafi muri 2013 nibwo nafunguye iduka rya Kabash Fashion House, mbere y’uko ndifungura nari nararanguye, nari mfite imyenda myinshi.” “Maze nk’umwaka ndifunguye, nashinze irindi duka rya Kabash House, dukora ibijyanye n’imitako, utubati, ibitanda […] Nageze igihe ntangira gutegura no gushyira imitako mu nzu z’abandi(interior design), nahereye ku nzu yanjye mbona bibaye byiza. Nasanze mfite impano yo kubikora, nakoreye benshi mu ngo zabo no mu biro, nzamuka gutyo.” Kate yatangiye kwera imbuto... Bashabe w’imyaka 25 amaze kugera ku ntera ikomeye mu byo guhanga imideli no gukora imitako yifashishwa mu nzu ndetse ubucuruzi bwe bw’imyenda bwaragutse ku buryo na we ubwe atangiye kwemera ko igishoro gito yatangije kimaze kubyara byinshi. Yatanze imirimo ku bakozi akorana na bo haba muri Kabash Fashion House, Kabash House n’abo mu makoperative akorana nayo barimo abadoda n’abamufasha mu guha ubwiza inzu n’ibiro by’abakiriya be. Amafaranga yashoye mu mwaka wa 2011 yatangiye kumugeza ku musaruro ufatika ndetse kugeza ubu abarirwa mu rubyiruko rwibeshejeho akaba anabasha gukemura ibibazo by’amafaranga bisaba ubushobozi ku bamugana, umuryango we na wo watangiye kwizihirwa n’igishoro umwana wabo agezeho. Ati “Nyuma y’imyaka itanu nkora ibi bintu maze kugera ku ntambwe ishimishije kuko uyu munsi mfite abakozi bahora ku maduka, bita ku bintu byanjye nubwo naba ntahari. Mfite n’andi makoperative arimo abantu benshi nkoresha, mfite abakiriya banjye bahoraho, mbona inyungu binyoroheye.” Akura umugisha mu gusangira n’abatishoboye Bashabe yize Kaminuza arayirangiza adateze amaboko ubufasha bwa leta, yakoresheje amafaranga yavuye mu mitsi ye. Yarangije kwiga ndetse ubu yatangiye gufasha abana batishoboye abashyira mu ishuri, afite babiri arera akanakurikirana ubuzima bwabo umunsi ku wundi. Ati “Nageze ku bintu byinshi, nabashije kwiyishyurira kaminuza. Ngira impano yo gufasha, mfasha abantu benshi. Mfite abana babiri ndera, mbishyurira ishuri no kumenya ubuzima bwabo bwa buri munsi…”  [N’ibinezaneza ku maso] yongeraho ati “ Mbayeho neza, singitega moto nka mbere ngitangira, mbasha kwiyitaho, nkigurira imyenda ngasa neza.” Umurebye ku maso ubona ko ubuzima abayemo bufite intego kandi ko yatangiye kuyobokwa n’umusaruro w’amafaranga yakoreye. Atuye mu rugo rwiza, afite imodoka ye bwite agendamo. Ubucuruzi bwe butangiye kwaguka ku buryo asigaye akorera ingendo mu mahanga ashakisha ibintu bihenze mu kurushaho kureshya abakiriya. Yahuye n’ibigusha abirusha imbaraga Mu rugendo rw’iterambere, Kate Bashabe yanyuze muri byinshi byamucaga intege ariko akabyima amatwi. Ni imwe mu nkingi yubakiyeho ndetse kugeza uyu munsi ikibi cyose kimwitambika agitsindisha kudacika intege yerekeza ku nzozi ze.
Ati “Nanyuze mu bintu byinshi bikomeye, abantu banciye intege […] kuko nari nzi icyo nshaka, nari mfite intego byose nabyimye amatwi ndakomeza ndabikora. Ntabwo byari byoroshye, naraye amajoro, nararaga nirukanka ku bakiriya ariko uyu munsi navuga ko nageze aho nshaka.” Nka rwiyemezamirimo ukiri muto, yatangiranye intego zijegajega bityo bikamugusha mu gihombo. Ati “Ikosa nakoze ngitangira habayeho kwizera abantu, akenshi barantenguhaga ntibanyishyure bikabamo imvururu. Maze kwigirira icyizere namenye uko mbitwara iryo kosa rivaho.” ‘Abanzi batangiye kumwitambika’ Intambwe amaze kugeraho avuga ko abatayishimiye batangiye kumwitambika mu kugerageza kumuca intege bya burundu gusa aracyahagaze bwuma kandi yizeye kuzabarusha imbaraga. Ati “Iyo umuntu hari aho amaze kugera heza ahura n’abantu bamwe bidashimisha, sinzi niba nabita aba-haters[abanzi]. Mu gihe gishize navuzwe mu itangazamakuru ko nakubise abantu, ni byinshi ntasubiramo…” “Abatangaje ibyo bintu, ni nk’umuntu wafashe filime y’i Hollywood nayo y’imirwano ayivangamo urwenya n’ibindi bibabaje. Ntabwo ndi indwanyi, ku banzi uko narezwe ntabwo ngira amagambo mabi.” Abakobwa bashyize Kate mu itangazamakuru bamushinja kubashimuta no kubakorera iyicarubozo, ngo ni bagenzi be babikoze bafite umugambi mubisha. Ati “Icyabayeho ni ukutumvikana n’abo bagenzi banjye ariko byari ibintu by’amafuti ariko bo babigira ibintu birebire. Abakiriya banjye ndabiseguraho, ibyamvuzweho mu by’ukuri nta kuri kurimo, ntabwo ndi umuntu umeze gutyo. Mungarurire icyizere n’abari bakinkuyeho.” Uyu mukobwa w’uburanga washinjwe kunigira mu nzu inkumi ebyiri, yiseguye ku babyumvise bakamufata nk’umugome agira ati “Ntabwo nkina filime, ntabwo nkina karate ntabwo n’ubwo nize igisirikare.” Kate agiye gufungura amaduka hanze y’u Rwanda Ati “Inama nagira urubyiruko cyane cyane abakobwa ni ukwigirira icyizere bakumva ko bashoboye. Iyo wihangiye umurimo ugishyiramo imbaraga zose ugashakisha ibitekerezo ahantu hose, niryo banga nakoresheje.” Itarambere amaze kugeraho avuga ko ritamuhagije ndetse ko agihihibikana ashakisha uko yakorera ubucuruzi mu bindi bihugu, Kabash Fashion House n’ibindi akora bikamamara mu mahanga. Ati “Nubwo hari byinshi maze kugeraho ndacyafite urugendo runini. Ni ibintu byinshi nshaka kugeraho, ndashaka gufungura amaduka hanze y’u Rwanda no kwagura ibikorwa byanjye.”

title: Abanyamideli 70 bagiye kwerekana ubuzima gakondo mu Rwanda rwo hambere
content: Igikorwa cyo kwerekana imideli n’ubuzima gakondo Abanyarwanda babagamo ku ngoma ya cyami, cyateguwe na Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show[isanzwe itegura ibirori by’imideli gakondo] ifatanyije na kompanyi yitwa ‘Red Rocks’. Muri uyu mwaka, ibirori byo kurimba bya ‘Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show’ byabaye mu bice bibiri, icya mbere kigomba kubera mu Mujyi wa Kigali mu gihe hari n’ibindi birori byateguwe ahitwa i Nyakinama mu Karere ka Musanze. Umuyobozi wa Rwanda Cultural Fashion Show, Ntawirema Celestin yavuze ko bateguye iki gikorwa mu gace k’icyaro mu rwego rwo kugaragaza byeruye ubuzima gakondo bw’Abanyarwanda mu myaka yo hambere bitandukanye n’igikorwa gisanzwe kibera i Kigali aho biba bigoranye kubona ibikoresho birimo nk’uruho, umuheto, umuvure, urusyo n’ingasire, urutara n’ibindi byerekana akarango k’umuco nyarwanda. Yagize ati “Ni igikorwa twateguye dufatanyije na kompanyi ya Red Rocks, iyi isanzwe itegura icyumweru cyahariwe ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku muco. Ubu bari kwitegura gukora iki gikorwa kizamara icyumweru nk’uko bisanzwe gusa nk’abategura Cultural Fashion Show twifatanyije na bo aho twateguye umunsi w’ibirori byo kwerekana ubuzima nyabwo bw’Abanyarwanda mu gihe cyo hambere.” Yongeraho ati “Ntabwo byadukundiraga ko mu gikorwa dutegura i Kigali twerekana uko gukama ibitoki bikorwa, uko urwagwa rutegurwa, imibereho y’umwami, kumasha, kwigisha abantu gusya n’ibindi.” Icyumweru cyahariwe ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku muco kizaba kuva kuwa 26 Kanama kugeza kuwa 2 Nzeri 2016. Igikorwa cyo kwerekana ubuzima gakondo bw’Abanyarwanda kizaba umunsi umwe, kuwa 1 Nzeri 2016 mu gihe hazaba habura iminsi mike hakaba umuhango wo Kwita Izina. Ibikorwa biteganyijwe kuzerekanwa harimo kwigisha abantu uko kumasha byakorwaga hambere,kuraguza, kwenga urwagwa, guhunika imyaka mu kigega, gusya no gusekura, gukama, gucunda amata, kotsa runonko, gukina igisoro no gusimbuka urukiramende, guhiga mu ishyamba, ubusabane hateguwe intango, ubuvuzi gakondo, kubumba inkono n’ibibindi. Ntawirema ati “Abanyamideli batojwe n’ibijyanye n’uko umwami yabagaho mu rugo rwe, uko yasabanaga n’abaturage, uko abaja bakoraga akazi, uko abakobwa bakuburaga. Ni igikorwa kizereka umuntu ishusho y’uko byabaga bimeze hambere.” By’umwihariko abanyamideli 70 bateguwe, biganjemo abo mu cyaro i Nyakinama hafi ya Red Rocks ahazabera igikorwa, abo mu Karere ka Musanze basanzwe berekana imideli ndetse na bake bazaturuka i Kigali baje gutoza abandi.

title: Mu mafoto: Ibirori byo kwerekana imideli ikorerwa mu Rwanda
content: Ibirori byo kumurika imideli yakorewe mu Rwanda [Made in Rwanda] byabaye mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 14 Nyakanga 2016, kuri Hotel Umubano iherereye ku Kacyiru. Ni ibirori byitabiriwe n’umubare munini wiganjemo abakunda imideli bo mu bihugu binyuranye byitabiriye inama ya AU iri kubera i Kigali kuva kuwa 10 kugeza kuir 18 Nyakanga 2016. Ubuyobozi bw’Urugaga rw’abikorera mu Rwanda[PSF] ari nabo bagize uruhare rukomeye mu gutegura ibi birori, bwatangaje ko byakozwe nko gushaka umwanya mwiza wo kwereka amahanga ibyiza by’umuco nyarwanda cyane cyane herekanwa ibihakorerwa. Mu birori by’imideli byiswe “Fashion Dusk”, herekanywe ibikorwa n’inganda zo mu Rwanda mu kwerekana ko ‘hari inganda n’abahanga mu by’imyambarire bakora imyenda igezweho no gushishikariza Abanyarwanda kuyoboka ibikorerwa mu gihugu.’ Turahirwa Moses, umuhanzi w’imideli wanashinze inzu yitwa ’Moshions’, yavuze ko byamubereye umwanya mwiza wo kwereka abanyamahanga ibihangano bye ndetse ko yabibonyemo amahirwe yo kwagura ibikorwa bye. Ibyamuritswe muri ibi birori, harimo ibikapu, T-shirts, inkweto, amakanzu, imipira y’imbeho n’indi mideli inyuranye yose yakorewe mu Rwanda.

title: Abanyamideli bagiye kwiyerekana mu birori bikomeye bizabera ku mazi
content: Ibi birori by’imideli byiswe Fiesta de Verano [Summer Party] bigiye kubera mu Mujyi wa Kigali ku nshuro ya mbere kuwa Gatandatu tariki ya 16 Nyakanga  2016, bizabera i Nyarutarama kuri Hotel Villa Portofino  Kigali. Itsinda ryateguye ibi birori, ryatangaje ko hateguwe abahanzi b’imideli bamaze kumenyakana mu gihugu barimo Moshions, Cedric, Tanga Design n’abandi batandukanye. Aba bahanzi b’imideli [fashion designers] buri wese azaba afite abanyamideli b’umwuga bazerekana iyi myambaro igezweho yambarwa ku mazi. Umunyamideli Ntabanganyimana Jean de Dieu uri mu bateguye ibi birori ati “Iki gikorwa twagiteguye mu bihe nk’ibi by’izuba, abantu baba bakeneye aho barihungira ndetse bakaruhura umubiri bidagadura.” Yongeyeho ko imyambaro izerekanwa mu birori bya Fiesta de Verano yiganjemo iyambarwa mu bihe by’ubushyuhe by’umwihariko igezweho yitabazwa mu kurimba ku mazi. Ati “Ni ibirori by’akataraboneka aho abasore n’inkumi bazaba berekana imyambaro igezweho yo ku mazi, hanateguwe imikino inyuranye isanzwe ikinwa n’abantu bidagadurira ku mazi mu buryo bwo kubafasha kurushaho kuroherwa.” Ibi birori bizatangira saa tanu z’amanywa kugeza saa tanu z’ijoro. Mu gufata neza abazabyitabira hateguwe ingeri zinyuranye z’imyidagaduro zirimo imikino yo ku mazi n’umuziki w’imbaturamugabo uzavangwa n’aba Dj bamaze kumenyerwa mu birori bikomeye mu Rwanda, DJ Miller  na Toxxyk. Ati “Nk’umwe mu bateguye Fiesta de Verano ndahamya ko  ntawe uzayizamo ngo yifuze gutaha cyane ko iteguye mu buryo butandukanye cyane n’ibindi birori by’imideli bisanzwe bibera mu Rwanda. Kunywa no kurya ni zimwe mu ngingo zitaweho cyane muri iki gikorwa.” Kwinjira muri Hotel Villa Portofino ahazabera ibi birori, ni amafaranga ibihumbi bitanu[5,000frw] mu myanya isanzwe ndetse n’ibihumbi icumi [10,000frw] mu cyubahiro.

title: Abanyamideri bagiye kwifashishwa mu kwereka umuco nyarwanda abitabiriye inama ya AU
content: Kuri PSF (Urugaga rw’abikorera mu Rwanda) kwakira inama ni ibuye rimwe ryatewe ariko ishaka ko ryica inyoni ebyiri. Uretse kuba ari amahirwe ku bukungu bw’u Rwanda kwakira inama nk’iyo, PSF itangaza ko ari n’umwanya mwiza wo kwereka amahanga ibyiza by’umuco nyarwanda cyane cyane herekanwa ibihakorerwa. Niyo mpamvu yateguye igitaramo cyo kumurika imideri, herekanwa Umuco nyarwanda, ndeste no kuratira ibikorerwa mu Rwanda abantu basaga 3500 bitabiriye iyo nama. Yosam Kiiza, Umuyobozi ushinzwe Umutungo muri PSF yatangarije IGIHE ko bazifashisha abamurika imideri by’umwuga kugirango bereke amahanga ibikorerwa mu Rwanda, banabamurikira Umuco Nyarwanda hagamijwe guteza imbere inganda nyarwanda ndetse n’izo muri Afurika muri rusange. Kiiza yakomeje avuga ko muri iki gihe cy’inama, PSF ifite inshingano eshatu nk’umufatanyabikorwa wa Leta, aho imwe muri zo ari iyo kwerekana ibikorwa n’inganda z’imyenda, ibyo bikazakorwa hifashishijwe igitaramo cyiswe “Fashion Dusk”, cyo kumurika imideri. Yagize ati “Dufite abamurika imideri by’umwuga haba mu Rwanda, muri Afurika ndetse n’ahandi, kandi dufite inganda zikora imyenda ndetse n’abahanga mu by’imyambarire (Fashion). Bazamurika imideri hagamijwe gushishikariza Abanyarwanda n’Abanyafurika kuyoboka ibikorerwa imbere mu gihugu ndetse no kuri uyu mugabane.” Iki gitaramo kizaba mu gihe u Rwanda n’ibihugu bya Afurika y’Iburasirazuba biri mu nkubiri yo kwigaranzura guhora bisohora amafaranga menshi hanze hajya kugurwa imyenda n’ibindi bikoresho byakoreshejwe mu mahanga, kandi no muri ibyo bihugu imbere hari ubushobozi bwo kubyikorera kandi bikaza ari umwimerere, aho kujya kugura hanze ahubwo nabyo bikagurishayo. Icyo gitaramo cyo kumurika imideli giteganyijwe kuwa Kane tariki ya 14 Nyakanga 2016, kizabera  muri Hotel Umubano guhera saa kumi n’ebyiri. Uretse kumurika imideri, PSF inamurika ibikorerwa mu Rwanda ndetse no muri Afurika, aho abari mu nama iyo basohotse babasha gusura bakihera ijisho ibikorwa bitandukanye bimurikirwa kuri Kigali Convention Center. Indi nshingano y’Urugaga rw’abikorera mu gihe cy’inama y’Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe ni ukuyobora abanyamahanga n’abandi bose bayitabiriye, aho hanakozwe agatabo kiswe ‘Experience Kigali’, kerekana imiterere y’imihanda mu Mujyi wa Kigali, amahoteli, utubari inzu zo kwidagaduriramo ninjoro (Night Clubs), inzu zo gufatiramo amafunguro n’ibindi bitatse Umurwa mukuru w’u Rwanda.
