title: Rizinde yahanze imideli agamije kurata ubutwari bw’Inkotanyi
content: “Inkotanyi cyane” ni imwe mu mipira iri mu cyiciro cy’imyenda aherutse gushyira hanze yise “Impeshyi16”, binyuze mu nzu ye ikora imyenda yitwa Khalilu Rahman Clothing. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE, Rizinde usanzwe uhanga imideli yanditseho amagambo agamije kurata u Rwanda, yavuze ko yahismo “Inkotanyi cyane” mu rwego rwo kurata ubwitange n’ubutwari zagaragaje mu kubohora u Rwanda no guhagarika Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ati” Collection mperutse gushyira hanze igizwe n’imipira yanditse amagambo atandukanye. Harimo iyanditseho ‘Inkotanyi Cyane’. Iyi nayikoze by’umwihariko nk’ikimenyetso cy’uko twe nk’urubyiruko dushima ibyo badukoreye n’ibyo bakomeje gukora.” Ahamya ko u Rwanda ruha amahirwe angana abantu bose, nta wundi babikesha uretse Inkotanyi zarwanye urugamba rutoroshye biturutse ku kutihanganira akarengane kakorerwaga bamwe mu banyarwanda bari mu gihugu n’abari barameneshejwe. Iyi ‘collection’ kandi irimo n’indi mipira yanditseho “Umwamikazi” yakoze akuye inganzo kuri Gicanda Rosalie wishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ati “Nashatse gushyiraho ifoto ye ariko ndavuga nti abakobwa benshi ntibamuzi, mpera ku ijambo ‘Umwamikazi’, ubutaha nzagerageza gushyiraho n’ifoto ye.” Uretse iyi kandi hari n’indi yanditse 250 [umubare uranga u Rwanda], ‘Go KGL’ na ‘Nta mutima mubi’. Rizinde w’imyaka 21 avuga ko iyi atari yo myenda ya mbere atangiriyeho gukora kuko yabitangiye mu 2013 ariko imyenda ya mbere ifite ikirango cya Khalilu Rahman Clothing ikaba yaragiye hanze muri Gushyingo 2015. Mu buhanzi bwe bw’imideli yibanda ku myenda ikundwa n’abanyamujyi (Urban Street Wear) irimo imipira, amakoti n’ingofero. Yiyimye byinshi ashakisha igishoro Rizinde wyiga ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga mu ishami rya Computer Engeneering muri Kaminuza ya Mevlana mu Mujyi wa Konya kuva  mu 2014. Kugira ngo abashe kugera ku nzozi ze, yahisemo kwizigama amafaranga yakoreye akirangiza amashuri yisumbuye mu 2013, ndetse akajya agerageza no kwigomwa bimwe ashakisha igishoro. Nubwo kugeza ubu nta nyungu aratangira kubona, afite icyizere ko azabona umusaruro ufatika bidatinze ahereye ku mubare w’abamugurira  ugenda wiyongera aho amaze kugurisha imyenda irenga 500 mu gihe gito amaze atangiye. Ati” Intego yanjye ni ugukora ikintu wambara umuntu wese ukubonye akagira icyo asigarana mu mutwe. Niyo mpamvu imyenda nkora iba ifite ijambo ryanditse kandi rifite igisobanuro.” Nyuma yo kurangiza amasomo azatwara imyaka itari munsi y’itanu avuga ko yiteguye kugaruka mu Rwanda gufatanya n’abandi muri gahunda yo guteza imbere ibikorerwa mu gihugu ‘Made in Rwanda’ binyuze mu guha Abanyarwanda imyenda myiza, ikoze neza uko babyifuza. Mu gihe atarataha afite gahunda yo gushinga iduka mu Rwanda ndetse akanakorana n’abacuruzi bo mu gihugu kugira ngo abashe kugeza imyenda ye ku bantu benshi, kugeza ubu ayicuruza kuri internet gusa. Afite inzozi zo kuzambika Minisitiri Louise Mushikiwabo Ati” Nkunda uburyo ari umugore w’umunyembaraga, ukunda igihugu ndetse akaba n’urugero rw’uburyo buri munyarwandakazi yagakwiye kuba ameze.” Akomeza avuga ko kandi yifuza kwambika Albert Rudatsimburwa, Umuyobozi wa Contact FM na Contact TV kuko ari umwe mu bantu afata nk’icyitegererezo haba mu kwihangira imirimo, ubuhanzi ndetse no gukunda igihugu. Imyenda ikorwa na Rizinde muri Khalilu Rahman Clothing iboneka ku rubuga http://www.kigalicious.com/#!shop/aeyi1, kandi uwo uguze bawukugereza aho uri hose. Mu kwishyura hifashishwa uburyo butandukanye burimo Mobile Money, kwishyura ukugezeho na Paypal. [email protected]

title: Umunyamideli Kate Bashabe yavuye mu gihome
content: Kate Bashabe washinze inzu y’imideli yitwa ‘Kabash Fashion House’, yatawe muri yombi na Polisi y’u Rwanda mu Karere ka Kicukiro mu ijoro ryo kuwa 4 Nyakanga 2016. Yafunzwe nyuma y’uko abakobwa babiri batabaje Polisi bamurega ‘ko yabashimuse akabafungirana mu nzu ye ubundi akabahata inkoni’. Uyu mukobwa w’imyaka 25 y’amavuko, yarekuwe ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 6 Nyakanga 2016, aho yahise ashyira ifoto ye nshya kuri Instagram yifuriza Abayisilamu umunsi mwiza wa Eid al-Fitr. Benshi bagaragaje ko bishimiye kuba yarekuwe mu gihe hari abandi bamubwiraga ko ‘yagize neza gukubita abo bakobwa’. Kakoza Nkuriza Charles [KNC], ari mu batanze ibitekerezo ku irekurwa rya Kate aho yanditse amubwira ati “Navuze ko ukeneye inshuti kugira ngo wishime, ariko kandi ukeneye abanzi kugira ngo urusheho gukomera cyane.” Umwe mu bari muri dosiye y’ikirego cya Kate Bashabe yabwiye IGIHE ko Polisi yamurekuye by’agateganyo ndetse ko agiye gukomeza gukurikiranwa ari hanze kugeza igihe ikibazo cyavutse kizabonerwa umuti. Abakobwa Kate ashinjwa gukubita akanabakomeretsa bavuga ko intambara hagati yabo yavutse biturutse kuri konti ya Instagram imusebya, yashinzwe n’umuntu utaramenyekana. Uwayishinze ngo yandikagaho amagambo asebya uyu mukobwa ko atunzwe n’akazi ‘ko kuryamana n’abanyamafaranga bakomeye mu Rwanda na Nigeria’, ibintu byamubabaje cyane kugeza ubwo atana mu mitwe n’abakobwa b’inshuti be babiri bamurega kubashimuta akanagerekaho kubatera ubwoba ko azabica akijyana muri Gereza ya 1930. IGIHE yagerageje kuvugana na Kate Bashabe ngo asobanure byimbitse ibibazo byatumye atabwa muri yombi, ntibyadukundira kuko umurongo wa telefone ye ufunze kugeza ubu. Mu nkuru yacu itaha tuzabagezaho birambuye, icyo Kate Bashabe avuga ku birego abakobwa b’inshuti ze bamushinja. Inkuru irambuye ku ifungwa rya Kate Bashabe

title: Ubugenzuzi bwagaragaje gusesagura, kunyereza no gucunga nabi umutungo muri ADEPR
content: Iri genzura ryitaye ku bikorwa byo ku cyicaro gikuru cya ADEPR ndetse no mu isomero ryayo. Ryitaye kureba niba ibikoresho biramba bibyazwa umusaruro uko bikwiye cyangwa niba bifatwa neza, kureba niba ibikorwa byatwaye amafaranga yaratanzwe mu buryo bwemewe n’ibindi. Iri genzura ryakozwe n’abagenzuzi b’umutungo b’imbere muri ADEPR, ari bo Matabaro Evariste, Mukumburwa Joyeuse na Mukamurenzi Angelique. Bimwe mu byagaragaye mu igenzura ni ibibazo n’amayobera ku cyuma gisya amabuye akavamo umucanga kiri mu Karere ka Bugesera (Crusher), aho cyari kimaze amezi 11 gikora ariko nta faranga na rimwe ryinjira mu isanduku y’itorero kandi cyaragombaga kwishyurwa miliyoni 9 Frw buri kwezi. Muri iyi nyandiko y’ubugenzuzi IGIHE ifitiye kopi, abagenzuzi bavuga ko ‘bageze aho iki cyuma gikorera ntibahasange ugikoresha ndetse yari yabujije n’abakozi be kugira icyo bavuga yikanga ko hari amakuru baha abagenzuzi’. Bati “Ibyo twari twaganiriye na bo ndetse n’ibyo twabonye kuri chantier biduhamiriza ko kuvuga ko crusher [icyuma gisya amabuye] itigeze ikora ari ibinyoma byambaye ubusa”. Abagenzuzi bavuga ko mu mezi 11 nta musaruro iki cyuma cyatanze muri ADEPR kuko byavugwaga ko kidakora nyamara ariko bagikoraho barababwiye ko hari amasaha gikora ku munsi. Bati “Ikimenyetso simusiga kigaragaza ko crusher ikora ni ikirundo cy’umucanga ukomoka ku mabuye yasewe cyakuzura nk’amakamyo abiri. Twabwiwe ko chemise ya moteur yamenetse mu Ukwakira 2019, bikaba bitumvikana uko yamenetse kandi crusher idakora”. Muri iyi raporo y’agateganyo abagenzuzi bagaragaza amafaranga miliyoni 80 Frw, yaguze ikibanza cyanditse kuri Mukamuganga Judith kiri haruguru ya Dove Hotel, bakavuga ko ‘ni menshi cyane ugereranyije n’uko ibibanza nk’icyo bigurwa’. Bakomeza bavuga ko ikindi giteye impungenge ari uko uhagarariye icungamutungo ugomba gusinya impapuro zose zemeza ko amafaranga akwiriye gusohoka yanze kubisinya nk’uwabigenzuye ko bikwiye. Bati “Kugura ikibanza ku gaciro gahanitse cyane kuko ibibanza ku Gisozi bigurishwa hagati ya miliyoni 20 Frw na 30 Frw.” Ubugenzuzi bugaragaza ko abayobozi ba ADEPR bafite abarinzi bishyurwa n’itorero kandi batabagenewe n’amategeko yaryo, ibi bigafatwa nko gusesagura umutungo. Abagenzuzi bati “Kurihira abayobozi abo kubararira (abacunga umutekano bane ba EASCO), bakishyurwa binyuze muri EASCO ariko icyemezo kibibemerera ntacyometse aho bishyuriye...hakwiye kugaragazwa inyandiko isinye ibahesha izo avantage zo kurarirwa”. Ubugenzuzi bugaragaza kandi abayobozi bahabwa amafaranga yo mu butumwa ariko ntihagaragare inyandiko y’ubutumwa [ordre de mission], na raporo y’ubwo butumwa, ibi bituma bifatwa nko gusesagura umutungo no kuwunyereza. Kuri iyi ngingo hari urugero rwa 2 237 000 Frw yahawe Rev. Ntaganda Jean Paul yo kujya mu rugendo rw’iminsi icyenda muri Uganda ariko nta nyandiko y’ubutumwa ihari igaragaza ko uru rugendo rwakozwe nta na raporo y’urugendo ihari. Hari kandi 185 000 Frw yahawe Karangwa John adafite inyandiko y’ubutumwa yatangiweho, ibi bigatuma abagenzuzi bavuga ko ashobora kuba atarakoze icyo yasabiwe kubera ko nta kigaragaza ko cyakozwe kandi cyagombye kuba gihari. Ku micungire mibi y’umutungo, hari imodoka zaheze mu gishanga ubu zikaba ziri hanze aho basenye i Gikondo. Abakoze ubugenzuzi barirukanywe Abakoze ubugenzuzi mu gusoza bavuze ko ‘kubera ko gukora ubugenzuzi ku cyicaro cya ADEPR bisa nk’aho bibangamira ubuyobozi bwa ADEPR, turifuza ko bwajya bukorana n’abo hanze ariko batahawe isoko n’abo baje kugenzura.’ Bagaragaje kandi ko mu bugenzuzi bwabo bahuye n’ukunanizwa n’Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa ADEPR, Rev. Gatemberezi Paul, aho basabwaga gukora ubugenzuzi bw’ibintu bimaze imyaka ibiri bagahabwa umunsi umwe. Mu bagenzuzi batatu bakoze ubugenzuzi, babiri bahagaritswe mu kazi ndetse bahabwa n’inyandiko z’integuza yo gusesa amasezerano yabo. Amakuru agera kuri IGIHE ni uko ibi byakozwe nyuma yo kubasaba kuvuguruza ibyavuye mu bugenzuzi bakoze abandi bakabyanga. Inenge mu bugenzuzi Umuvugizi wa ADEPR, Rev. Past Karuranga Ephrem, yabwiye IGIHE ko ubu bugenzuzi batabwemera kubera inenge bufite. Ati “Inenge ya mbere, basohoye ibintu ariko abo bagombaga kubaza ntabwo bababajije, ikindi cya kabiri bahuje ibibazo bari bafitanye n’umuntu ku giti cye cyangwa se mu kazi, babihuza n’uko na byo ari igenzura (audit)”. “Icya gatatu ni uko ari njye bagombaga kubiha no kumbaza uko bimeze, nanjye nagiye kubona mbona byarasohotse ntazi uko bimeze. Ntabwo bigeze bambwira ikibazo na kimwe bahuye na cyo”. Ku kuba babiri muri batatu bakoze ubugenzuzi barahawe integuza yo gusesa amasezerano yabo, Rev. Past Karuranga avuga ko ‘Ntaho bihuriye kuko ibyo bagaragaje nta n’ikibazo gihari ahubwo ni uko nyuma y’aho bakomeje kugira imyitwarire mibi no kubagira inama ntibazumve, hanyuma duhitamo gusesa amasezerano ariko ibyo gusesa amasezerano dukurikije ubugenzuzi ntabwo ari byo’.

title: Papa Francis yasubitse umwiherero kubera ibicurane
content: Uyu mukambwe w’imyaka 83 yabwiye abakiristu bari bateraniye i Vatican mu rubuga rwitiriwe Mutagatifu Petero, ko uwo mwiherero w’iminsi itandatu yateganyaga atakiwugiyemo. Yagize ati “Kubw’amahirwe make, ibicurane byambujije kuzawujyamo uyu mwaka.” Gusubika uyu mwiherero Papa yagombaga gutangira kuri iki Cyumweru, bije mu gihe u Butaliyani buhanganye n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus gikomeje guhitana benshi ku Isi. Kugeza kuri iki Cyumweru, abantu basaga igihumbi bari bamaze kugaragaraho ibimenyetso by’iyo ndwara mu Butaliyani. Papa nawe byari byatangiye guhwihwiswa ko yanduye coronavirus nyuma yo kugaragara abira ibyunzwe mu ruhame,  ariko ubuyobozi bwa Vatican bwabinyomoje. Umuvugizi wa Papa yabwiye Ibiro Ntaramakuru by’Abafaransa, AFP ko nta kibazo gikanganye Papa afite, ko ari uburwayi busanzwe. AFP ivuga ko Papa yagaragaye i Vatican akomeye nubwo yakoroye inshuro ebyiri ubwo yari imbere y’imbaga y’abakirisitu. Abantu 29 bamaze gupfa mu Butaliyani mu gihe abandi 105 bari kwitabwaho n’abaganga mu buryo bwihariye.

title: Kigali: Yibye  igikoresho gitagatifu ‘Ostensoir’ muri Kiliziya azi ko ari zahabu
content: Mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 26 Gashyantare 2020, nibwo uwo musore yahengereye umukirisitu wa nyuma wari muri iyi Paruwasi ya Gikondo asohotse, na we ahita yinjira yiba Ostensoir. Padiri wa Paruwasi ya Gikondo, Rwasa Chrysante, yabwiye IGIHE ko uwo musore yibye iki gitereko cy’isakaramentu azi ko abonye zahabu. Yagize ati “Umusore yaje ejo mu gitondo mbere ya misa aterura isakaramentu aragenda. Nta bantu bari barimo, yacunze uwa nyuma  asohotse  muri ako kanya  aragenda arayitwara.” Rwasa yavuze ko bahise bamenyesha inzego z’umutekano kandi ngo hari amakuru y’ibanze ashobora gutuma uwibye  icyo gikoresho afatwa. Yavuze ko abajura bakunze kwiba za Ostensoirs  bakeka ko  ari zahabu y’umwimerere, nyamara ziba zikozwe muri  zahabu y’umwomekano. Ostensoir  yibwe ifite agaciro  kari hagati y’ibihumbi 600 na miliyoni 1 y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda.

title: Abahoze bayobora ADEPR bihannye umucamanza kubera gusubika urubanza kenshi
content: Abaregwa ni Sibomana Jean, Tom Rwagasana, Mutuyemariya Christine, Sebagabo Leonard, Sindayigaya Theophile, Gasana Valens, Niyitanga Straton, Beninka Bertin, Mukabera Lynea, Twizerimana Emmanuel, Nzabarinda Tharcisse na Mukakamari Mediatrice. Ubushinjacyaba bubarega kunyereza 2 366 708 946Frw nk’uko byagaragajwe muri raporo y’umugenzuzi yakozwe nyuma y’ifatwa ry’abo bayobozi mu 2017. Ku wa 14 Ukuboza 2018 nibwo Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo, Urugereko ruburanisha ibyaha bimunga ubukungu bw’igihugu, rwagize abere Bishop Sibomana Jean na Bishop Tom Rwagasana bari abayobozi ba ADEPR n’abandi 10 kuko batahamwe n’ibyaha bari bakurikiranyweho. Ubuyobozi bwa ADEPR n’ubushinjacyaha bwajuririye iki cyemezo mu Urukiko Rukuru, ari naho urubanza rugeze kuri ubu. Urubanza rukimara kujuririrwa abaregwa bagiye bitaba urukiko urubanza rugasubikwa kugeza ubwo rwongeye gusubukurwa  tariki ya 21/2/201/20 saa mbili za mugitondo ku Rukiko Rukuru, aho ababurana bose bari bitabiriye ndetse bafite n’ababunganira mu mategeko. Ubushinjacyaha bwabwiye urukiko ko bwasabye Urwego rw’Imiyoborere (RGB) gukora ubugenzuzi (Audit) kandi ko irimo kubikora nk’uko biri mu ibaruwa umushinjacyaha yasomeye urukiko yanditswe na RGB, akomeza asaba ko urubanza rwashyirwa tariki ya 8/7/2020. Uku kongera gusubika urubanza byatumye uwari umuvugizi wa ADEPR, Bishop Sibomana Jean, avuga ko urubanza rumaze gusubikwa inshuro zirindwi zose  hashakwa ibimenyetso, agaragaza ko izo nshuro nta na rimwe atitabye urukiko bityo ko atumva impamvu akomeza kubura ubutabera. Yakomeje avuga ko imitungo ye yose kimwe n’iy’abandi batandatu [Tom Rwagasana, Sebagabo Leonard, Mutuyemariya Christine, Niyitanga Salton, Sindayigaya Theophile na Gasana Valens] yafatiriwe bikabagiraho ingaruka zikomeye mu gihe ku bandi batanu bareganwa itafatiriwe ndetse bari mu kazi ka ADEPR. Bishop Sibomana yavuze ko urubanza rumaze gusubikwa kuva tariki ya 10/6/2019, 18/6/2019, 17/7/2019, 6/9/2019, 13/9/2019, 03/10/2019, 8/11/2019, 21/2/2020; atigeze abura mu rukiko, akabishingiraho asaba ko umucamanza uyoboye iburanisha witwa Nzabonimana Cassien ava mu rubanza kuko uko gutinda akubona nko kubogama ku ruhande rumwe rurega kuko ari rwo ruhora rusaba ko urubanza rusubikwa hagishakishwa ibimenyetso. Abaregwa bavuga ko ubugenzuzi bwasabwe n’ubucamanza batemeranya na bwo kuko mu 2017 hari ubwakoreshejwe n’ubushinjacyaha bukaburanirwaho mu rukiko rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo.  Kuba rero harasabwe ubundi bugenzuzi nyuma y’imyaka itatu batari mu kazi babibona nko kubaheza mu gihirahiro. Ubwihane bw’umucamanza bukaba bwaratanzwe kuri uyu wa Mbere kugira ngo busuzumwe n’urukiko. Urubanza rukaba ruzasubukurwa nyuma yuko urukiko rufashe icyemezo kuri ubwo bwihane. Ni ryari umuburanyi yihana umucamanza? Kwihana umucamanza ni igihe umuburanyi yanze ko amuburanisha iyo; Ubwe cyangwa uwo bashakanye n’abana babo, bafite inyungu bwite mu rubanza; Ubwe, cyangwa uwo bashakanye afitanye isano y’amaraso cyangwa yo gushyingiranwa ku buryo butaziguye cyangwa afitanye isano ku buryo buziguye kugeza ku gisanira cya kane n’umwe mu bagize inteko y’urukiko, n’umwe mu baburanyi, n’umwunganira cyangwa umuhagarariye; Umwe mu baburanyi agaragaje ishingiro ry’urwango afitanye n’umucamanza; Umwe mu baburanyi agaragaje ko umucamanza afitanye ubucuti bwihariye n’undi mu baburanyi cyangwa kuva aho urubanza rutangiriye, yarigeze kwakirwa mu buryo bwihariye n’umwe mu baburanyi ku mafaranga ye, cyangwa yaremeye impano ahawe n’umuburanyi; Iyo yigeze kugira icyo avuga cyangwa agatanga inama kuri urwo rubanza mbere y’uko ruburanishwa; Iyo yigeze kuba mu rubanza ari umucamanza, umwunzi, umushinjacyaha, umugenzacyaha, umuburanyi, umutangabuhamya, , umusemuzi, inzobere cyangwa umukozi wo mu butegetsi bwa Leta; Yiyamwa kandi iyo habayeho urubanza rw’ishinjabyaha cyangwa rw’imbonezamubano, hagati y’umucamanza cyangwa uwo bashakanye, abafitanye n’umucamanza isano ishingiye ku maraso cyangwa ku gushyingirwa ku buryo butaziguye cyangwa ku buryo buziguye kugeza ku gisanira cya kane n’umwe mu baburana, uwo bashakanye cyangwa abo bafitanye isano ishingiye ku maraso cyangwa ku gushyingirwa ku buryo butaziguye cyangwa ku buryo buziguye kugeza ku gisanira cya kane.

title: Itorero Angilikani ry’ u Rwanda riri gushaka miliyoni 115 zo gushyigikira  diyosezi nshya ya Karongi
content: Iri torero ryagaragaje ko rikeneye nibura miliyoni 115 Frw zo gushyigikira imirimo y’iyo diyosezi nshya mu gihe cy’imyaka itatu, kugira ngo nayo itangire kwibeshaho. Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, iryo torero ryatangije ubukangurambaga bwiswe ‘25 Km walking Challenge  in Suppot of Karongi Missionary Diocese’  mu rugendo rw’ibirometero 25. Abarwitabiriye bagiye n’amaguru guhera  i Nyanza mu Karere ka Kicukiro kugera i Nyamata mu karere ka Bugesera. Intego y’urwo rugendo kwari ugukusanya ubushobozi bwo gushyigikira Diyosezi nshya  ya Karongi izatangizwa tariki ya 31 Gicurasi uyu mwaka. Ni urugendo  rw’amasaha atanu  rwatangijwe n’Umwepisikopi Mukuru w’itorero Angilikani ry’u Rwanda  Dr.Laurent Mbanda , rukitabirwa  n’abakristo b’itorero  Angilikani. Iri torero rigaragaza ko mu mwaka wa mbere wa Diyosezi ya Karongi hakenewe byibura  86,000,000 Frw. Buri Diyosezi ya Angilikani  mu zisanzweho yiyemeje gutanga 3. 500.000 Frw. Ayo mafaranga azafasha mu gushaka imodoka y’Umwepiskopi, Umushahara we, gukodesha inzu mu gihe Diyoseze itaragira inyubako zayo, ibikoresho by’ibanze byo mu biro, gufasha za paruwasi  n’amakanisa,  gusana no kubaka insengero zitujuje ibisabwa, kwigisha no guhugura abapasitoro. Rev.Prof .Ndikumana Viateur, umwe  mu bitabiriye urugendo rwo gushakira amikoro Diyosezi ya Karongi yagize ati " Uru rugendo rwatunejeje, ni urugendo rw’amateka rugaragaza ubumwe mu gukora umurimo w’Imana. Biratwereka ko tuzagera kure nidufashanya  kandi tugatahiriza umugozi umwe mu kubaka ubwami  bw’Imana.” Rev.Rukundo Jean Pierre Methode watowe n’inama y’Abepisikopi kuzayobora Diyosezi nshya ya Karongi , yavuze ko Diyosezi ya Karongi niboneka izafasha gukomeza iyogezabutumwa rikagera kuri benshi. Yagize ati “Iyo Diyosezi  izunganira abandi bari basanzwe bakora muri kariya gace mu kwamamaza Inkuru nziza y’ Agakiza ka Yesu no kuzana Iterambere ryuzuye, dore ko kariya gace ka Nyamasheke, na Rutsiro turi mu duce tubarizwamo abaturage bakennye kurusha abandi mu Rwanda.” Umwepisikopi Mukuru w’itorero Angilikani ry’u Rwanda  Dr.Laurent Mbanda, yavuze ko bakeneye inkunga yo gushyigikira Diyosezi nshya ya Karongi, no gutegura umunsi nyirizina wo kuyitaha. Yavuze  ko kuri uyu wa Gatandatu hakusanyijwe miliyoni zirenga enye, bakaba bagiye no gukomereza mu zindi Diyosezi kugira ngo amafaranga akenewe aboneke. Diyosezi  nshya ya Karongi  izaba ifite imbibi z’icyahoze ari perefegitura ya Kibuye, ubu ikaba igizwe na Paruwase 9 zabarizwaga muri Diyosezi  ya Kivu.

title: Gitwaza yaguze urusengero rwa miliyoni 8 $ muri Amerika
content: Uru rusengero rwari rusanzwe ari urw’umuvugabutumwa ukomeye wo muri Amerika witwa Mike Murdock. Yari asanzwe yararushyize ku isoko mu cyamunara nk’uko bigaragara ku mbuga za internet. Amakuru avuga Umushumba w’Itorero Zion Temple, Apôtre Dr Paul Gitwaza yaje kumenya ko Murdock ari kugurisha uru rusengero, yuririra ku bushuti bari bafitanye, amusaba ko yarugura kugira ngo Zion Temple ariho izajya isengera dore ko hari amakuru avuga ko ari narwo rushobora kuba icyicaro gikuru cy’iri torero. Bivugwa ko ngo Gitwaza yasabye Murdock kumudohorera akarumuhera ku mafaranga make, undi yemera gukura agaciro karwo kuri miliyoni 13 z’amadolari yemera ko arwegukana ku nguzanyo ya miliyoni umunani z’amadolari izishyurwa mu gihe cy’imyaka itanu. Mu materaniro yabaye kuri iki Cyumweru muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Gitwaza yashimiye abakirisitu b’itorero rye muri Amerika mu gihe cy’umwaka rimaze rihakorera. Yavuze ko muri icyo gihe, ryari rimaze kwimuka inshuro ebyiri ariko “ubwa gatatu tuzabayo burundu’. Aha niho yahereye ahishura iby’igurwa ry’urwo rusengero ati “Kandi uwabigizemo uruhare ni umubyeyi Dr Murdock”. Yavuze ko uyu Murdock yabwiwe n’Imana ko urwo rusengero akwiye kurureka ariko ko akaruha umuntu Imana izamushyira ku mutima. Ati “Bamuhaye amafaranga miliyoni 13 z’amadolari, njye yarabimbwiye ngira ngo ni inkuba zikubise mu matwi, nagize ukwizera guke ariko nabisabiye imbabazi. Arambwira ati wowe ndumva iyi nzu Imana yambwiye ngo nyiguhe, anshyira mu mutego arambwira ngo urampa angahe ndananirwa, natashye ntavuze.” “Namubwiye ayo nshobora kumuha bwa mbere ariko sinayavuga hano kuko ateye isoni, ariko nyuma […] ndabaza, ngisha inama, nandikira n’inshuti yanjye nti nakoze ishyano. Irambwira iti ntutinye Murdock ni umubyeyi.” Ngo yabajije iyo nshuti ye niba ashobora kuba yakongera kuvuga ayo yakwishyura, imubwira ko yabikora nta kibazo. Ati “Turandika, musaba ko yahaduhera kuri miliyoni umunani. Umubyeyi ntiyanze. Abandi bamuhaye miliyoni 13, akuraho miliyoni eshanu! Mwibaze.” Gitwaza yavuze ko yabwiye Murdock ko nta mafaranga afite, ko ashobora kuba yakwishyura mu myaka itanu, undi nawe amubwira ko nta kibazo. Ati “Ndamubwira nti nanjye ngiye gukora, imyaka itanu ntizagera.” Yavuze ko abakirisitu ba Zion Temple n’Imana aribo bazatuma bigerwaho bityo kuko bari bamaze igihe basembera mu bukode. Murdock wari witabiriye ayo materaniro ngo yemereye Gitwaza ko azamufasha mu bikorwa byo gukusanya amafaranga agamije kwishyura iri deni. Muri ayo masengesho, abakirisitu bitanze ibihumbi 250 by’amadolari. Urwo rusengero rufite buri kimwe cyose nkenerwa ku itorero, nk’icyumba cyo gusengeramo, ibiro, ibyumba bito byo kwigiramo n’iby’inama, icyumba cya televiziyo n’ibindi. Zion Temple yatangiye mu 1999, ku itariki 11 Nyakanga bigizwemo uruhare n’abantu 120. Inkuru wasoma: Apôtre Gitwaza yahishuye byinshi: Ubuhanuzi, amadini, ikiganiro gikomeye n’intumwa ya Papa n’ibindi (Video) Amafoto agaragaza uru rusengero ruherereye Denton muri Leta ya Dallas

title: Abanyarwanda babaye aba mbere mu irushanwa ryo gusoma Korowani
content: Ryari ryitabiriwe n’ibihugu icyenda ari byo; Kenya, Tanzania, Djibouti, Ethiopia, Burundi, Sudani y’Epfo, Uganda, Somalia n’u Rwanda. Nshimiyimana Saidi wabaye uwa mbere mu cyiciro cy’abazi korowani yose mu mutwe yahembwe ibihumbi 7$ mu gihe Zigabe Muhamadi, warushanyijwe amajuzu 20 yahawe 5000$. Aba bana babwiye IGIHE ko bishimye cyane ndetse amafaranga bahawe azabafasha mu buzima bwabo cyane. Nshimiyimana Saidi yagize ati “Nabyakiriye neza kandi nishimye cyane kuko aya mafaranga natsindiye agiye kumfasha mu myigire yanjye no muri gahunda z’iterambere ryanjye.” Yakomeje avuga ko yizeye ko nawe agiye guteza imbere ubuzima bwe bugahinduka bitewe n’ibihumbi 7$  yahawe. Zigabe na we yemeza ko amafaranga yahawe azayifashisha mu kwiyishyurira ishuri. Ati “Aya mafaranga agiye kumfasha mu myigire kuko amafaranga iyo atagufashije mu ishuri ntabwo aba yarakugiriye akamaro.” Yakomeje avuga ko nta kintu cyamushimishije nk’uburyo batsinze abantu baturuka mu bihugu byitwa ibya kiyisilamu. Mufti w’u Rwanda, Hitimana Salim, yashimiye aba bana anashimangira ko intsinzi yabo ari iy’abanyarwanda bose kuko bari bahagarariye igihugu. Ati “Ni gikorwa gikomeye cyane by’umwihariko ku bayisilamu no ku gihugu muri rusange kuko bagiye bagihagarariye n’ubwo basomaga korowani, ni ishema mu gihugu cyose kandi nibaza ko ari igikorwa gikwiye gushimwa na buri wese.” Mufti Hitimana yongeyeho ko ibihembo nk’ibi bifasha imiryango ya kiyislamu gutera imbere kuko nk’umwaka ushize mu miryango y’abayisilamu hinjiyemo miliyoni zirenga 100 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda zagiye zegukanwa n’abana bitabiriye amarushanwa yo gusoma korowani mu bihugu bitandukanye.

title: Patient Bizimana yatumiwe mu gitaramo gikomeye mu Buholandi
content: Iki gitaramo cyiswe “Thanksgiving Celebration Live Concert” giteganyijwe kubera Kerkplein1 mu Buholandi ku wa 4-5 Mata 2020. Cyateguwe na Family Fellowship Ministries. Patient Bizimana azagihuriramo n’umuramyi Fortran Bigirimana ukomoka mu Burundi, akaba afite ibingano binyura benshi mu bakunda umuziki uhimbaza Imana. Bigirimana yakunzwe mu Rwanda binyuze mu ndirimbo zirimo “Ntaco Nzoba”, ‘‘Ni amahoro” n’izindi. Amakuru agera kuri IGIHE ni uko Patient Bizimana azahaguruka mu Rwanda mu mpera za Werurwe yerekeza mu Buholandi. Agiye gusubira gutaramira i Burayi nyuma y’amezi asaga abiri ahavuye. Ubwo aherukayo mu mwaka ushize, urugendo rwe yarusoje mu gitaramo yahuriyemo na Gentil Misigaro cyabereye mu Mujyi wa Bruxelles mu Bubiligi ku wa 31 Ukuboza 2019. Uyu muramyi yabwiye IGIHE ko yiteguye neza kuzataramana n’abakunzi b’ibihangano bye ku Mugabane w’u Burayi. Yagize ati “Ni ubwa mbere nzaba ndirimbye muri iki gihugu; ikindi kandi guhurirayo na Fortrand uzaba uvuye mu Bufaransa nabyo bizatuma igitaramo kirushaho kuba cyiza.” Bizimana Patient yizeye ko igitaramo kizaba cyiza cyane ko amaze kumenyera ikirere cyaho n’uburyo abatuye muri ibi bihugu baba bafite inyota yo kuramya Imana. Uyu muhanzi usengera muri Evangelical Restoration Church yakoreye ibitaramo mu bihugu hafi ya byose bya Afurika y’Uburasirazuba, yaririmbiye mu Burayi n’ahandi henshi. Ni we muhanzi rukumbi mu bakora umuziki uhimbaza Imana mu Rwanda umaze gukora ibitaramo bikomeye ndetse bikagaragaramo abahanzi bubatse izina. Ategura ibitaramo ngarukamwaka bya ‘East Celebration’ byitabirwa n’ibihumbi by’abakunda umuziki we. Mu 2016 yatumiye Solly Mahlangu, umunyempano ukomeye wo muri Afurika y’Epfo, Umunya-Nigeria Osinachi Joseph [Sinach] (2018) na Alka Mbumba wiyita ’Umusazi wa Yesu’ (2019) n’abandi. Umuziki yawutangiye akiri muto, agitangira kwiyumvamo impano yatangiye kwihatira kwiga gucuranga piano mu rusengero hanyuma bigeze mu 2007 asohora indirimbo ye bwite yitwa ‘Andyohera’ ari nabwo benshi batangiye kumubwira ko afite ijwi ryiza. Yakunzwe bihambaye mu ndirimbo nka ‘Iyo neza’, ‘Amagambo yanjye’, ‘Menye neza’, ‘Andyohera’ n’izindi.  	Reba indirimbo “Ijambo rya nyuma” ya Patient Bizimana

title: Itorero Angilikani mu Rwanda ryemeje ishyirwaho rya Diyoseze nshya n’Umwepisikopi wayo wa mbere
content: Byemejwe n’inama y’Inama y’Abepisikopi (House of Bishops ) yateraniye mu Karere ka Musanze muri Diyoseze ya Shyira ku wa Gatanu tariki 15 Gashyantare 2020. Itangazo ryashyizweho umukono n’Umwepisikopi Mukuru w’Itorero Angilikani mu Rwanda, Dr.Laurent Mbanda  ryerekana ko byo iyo nama yemeje harimo gushyiraho Diyoseze ya Karongi izaba igizwe n’iyahoze ari Intara ya Kibuye. Iyo nama yanatoye uzaba Umwepisikopi wa mbere w’iyo Diyoseze nshya Rev. Jean Pierre Methode Rukundo uzimikwa ubwo izaba itahwa ku mugaragaro ku itariki ya 31 Gicurasi 2020. Itorero rya Angilikani rifite abayoboke barenga miliyoni imwe kuva ritangiye mu Rwanda mu 1992 ryari rigizwe na Diyosezi 11, ubu zikaba zibaye 12. Rev. Jean Pierre Methode Rukundo afite impamyabumenyi ihanitse muri Tewologiya n’Iterambere (Theology and Development) yayikuye i Nairobi muri Kenya. Yakoze imirimo itandukanye harimo kuba Pasitoro muri za Paruwasi, kuyobora ishami ry’iterambere muri Diyosezi ya Shyogwe. Ubu ni Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Itorero Anglikani ry’u Rwanda. Kubera ubuzima bubi yakuriyemo nyuma y’uko ababyeyi be batandukanye afite imyaka ine bigatuma amara umwaka mu buzima bwo ku muhanda ariko akaza kugira amahirwe ya kabiri yamufashije kwiga, Rev. Jean Pierre Methode Rukundo yashinze umuryango yise amahirwe ya kabiri “Second Chance Rukundo Ministry” ufasha abagize ibibazo bitandukanye kongera kugaruka mu buzima.

title: James na Daniella bahurije couple z’abaramyi mu gitaramo cy’amateka gitegerejwe i Kigali
content: James na Daniella bafite igikundiro cyo ku gasongero mu bihebeye ibihangano byo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana bateguye igitaramo gikomeye bahurijemo couple z’abaramyi zikunzwe mu gihugu. Iki gitaramo cyiswe “Mpa Amavuta Live Concert” gitegerejwe kubera  muri Kigali Arena ku wa 1 Werurwe 2020. James na Daniella bagiteguye bagamije kumurika album yabo ya mbere bise “Mpa Amavuta’’ izaba iriho indirimbo umunani. Cyatumiwemo abahanzi bakomeye barimo andi ma-couple azwi cyane mu muziki wo kuramya Imana arimo iya Ben na Chance; Tuyizere Papi Clever na Ingabire Dorcas; Maya na Fabrice na Amanda Fung na Kavutse Olivier babarizwa muri Beauty for Ashes. Abazacyitabira kandi bazataramirwa n’abahanzi barimo Prosper Nkomezi uri mu bafite igikundiro, René Patrick, Ndayisenga  Esron wamamaye muri True Promises na Gaby Kamanzi. Couple ya James Rugarama na Daniella Mukiza ifitanye abana babiri.  Ni imwe mu zakoze umuziki ukabasha kugera ku kigero nk’icyo uyu munsi bariho. Bavuga ko kuba indirimbo zabo ziri kwamamara cyane mu buryo bwihuse ari ubushake bw’Imana n’amasengesho yabo adasiba. Mu minsi ishize babwiye IGIHE ko babanye igihe kinini babitsanya amabanga, nyuma bafata umwanzuro wo kugirana umubano w’urukundo no kuririmbana nka Couple. Aba bombi iyo bavuga amateka yabo bavuga ko batangiye baririmbana ariko mu 2019 bakaza gufata umwanzuro wo gutangira kuririmba nyuma y’uko baririmbiraga mu rugo bakumva ni byiza cyane. James ati “Twararirimbaga tutarabana ubundi tugahurira mu matsinda atandukanye. Tumaze kubana dutangira kujya turirimbana ariko bitari mu buryo bweruye. Uyu mwaka nibwo nk’itsinda ryacu nibwo twagiye muri studio dukora indirimbo ya mbere twise ‘Mpa Amavuta’.” Daniella avuga ko urukundo rwabo rwatangiye gututumba mu 2008 cyangwa 2009, mu 2012 bajya kwiga muri Uganda, umugabo yiga iby’Ububanyi n’Amahanga mu gihe umugore icyo gihe yigaga Ibaruramari. Ati “Twamenyanye kera kuko twari abaturanyi Kimironko nyuma tugiye kwiga muri Uganda nibwo twaje kubana. Mu 2008 cyangwa 2009 nibwo twamenyanye noneho mu 2012 tujya kwiga kaminuza, tuyirangiza mu 2015 aba ari nabwo tuba umuryango.” Ubu bamaze gushyira hanze indirimbo zirimo  ‘Mpa Amavuta’ bahereyeho imaze no kurebwa n’abasaga miliyoni ku rubuga rwa Youtube, “Nkoresha”, “Ububyutse” na “Narakijijwe”. Kuba ari couple ikora umurimo w’Imana wo kuririmba, bavuga ko ari ikintu kibafasha kuko kuba bafite icyerekezo kimwe ari ikintu gihambaye ama-couple yose yakabaye yitaho cyane. Ni ku nshuro ya mbere James na Daniella  bagiye gukorera igitaramo mu Rwanda, gusa si cyo cya mbere bakoze kuva batangiye umuziki kuko hari icyo bakoreye muri Uganda mu mpera za 2017. Kwinjira muri “Mpa Amavuta Live Concert” ku bazagura amatike mbere ni 3 000 Frw, 15 000 Frw na 30 000 Frw ku bazagura amatike mbere mu gihe abazayagurira ku muryango bizaba ari 5 000 Frw, 10 000 Frw na 20 000 Frw.  	Reba ‘Mpa Amavuta’ ya James&Daniella

title: Papa Francis yanze icyifuzo cyo kuba abapadiri ku bagabo bafite abagore muri Amazon
content: Abasenyeri bo muri ako gace bari bashyigikiye uwo mwanzuro umwaka ushize, ariko byagombaga  kwemezwa na Papa. Ubusanzwe abapadiri ba Kiliziya Gatolika basabwa gukomeza kuba  imanzi igihe cyose bahamagariwe uwo murimo. Ubwo abagabo muri Amazon basabirwaga kwemererwa kuba abapadiri bafite abagore, byararwanyijwe cyane mu bice by’Uburayi na Amerika, bavuga ko byaba biganisha ku kwemerera abapadiri bose ku isi gushaka abagore ari umwe mu  myihariko Kiliziya yari ifite. Itangazo ryavuye i Vatikani rigira riti “Amazon yaduhaye umukoro, Papa arandika, agamije ko tuva mu kibazo gihari bya nyabyo aho kwinezeza mu bisubizo bitanga umuti w’ikibazo igice.” Papa yavuze ko hakenewe abapadiri bumva neza ikibazo kiri muri Amazon n’umuco wo muri ako gace. Yasabye abashumba gusengera abantu ngo bagire umuhamagaro w’ubupadiri ku bwinshi. Umwaka ushize abasenyeri 184 bahuriye i Vatikani biga ku hazaza ha Kiliziya mu gace ka Amazon. Hanaganiriwe niba abagabo bakuze n’abashatse abagore bakwemererwa kuba abapadiri. Bivugwa ko nibura 85 % by’uduce two muri Amazon batabasha guhimbaza misa buri cyumweru kubera ko nta bapadiri bahagije bahari. Hari abavuga ko babona padiri rimwe mu mwaka.

title: Pasiteri Antoine Rutayisire agiye kujya mu kiruhuko cy’izabukuru
content: Itorero Angilikani riteganya ko Pasiteri cyangwa Musenyeri  wujuje imyaka 65 ku munsi yizihirijeho isabukuru y’imyaka 65 ahita ajya mu kiruhuko cy’izabukuru. Hashize  iminsi ku mbuga nkoranyamabaga hacicikana amakuru y’uko Rev. Past. Dr. Antoine Rutayisire agiye kujya mu kirihuko cy’izabukuru ariko ugasanga abantu batabivugaho rumwe benshi bavuga ko agikenewe mu murimo w’Imana. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE, Rutayisire  yavuze ko ayo makuru ari ukuri kandi ko agenda abyibutsa abantu iyo avuga ubutumwa mu materaniro atandukanye. Ati “Ibyo ni ukuri nta kinyoma kirimo kubera ko twebwe buriya mu Itorero Angilikani iyo wujuje imyaka 65 ujya mu kiruhuko cy’izabukuru. Nta muntu wabimpimbiye ni  njye wabivuze. Nkunze no kubivuga muri iyi minsi.” Kugeza ubu Rev. Past. Dr. Antoine Rutayisire afite imyaka 62.  Yavuze ko ku itariki 29 Gicurasi 2023 azaba asoje imirimo ahabwa n’itorero, gusa avuga ko atazahagarika ivugabutumwa. Ati “Ku itariki 29 z’ukwezi kwa Gatanu nzabyuka ntakiri umukozi wa Diyoseze. Ntabwo nzaba nahagaritse ubutumwa ariko nzaba nahagaritse kuyobora Paruwasi n’indi mirimo yose.” Uyu mugabo wize imiyoborere avuga ko iyo umuntu asigaje imyaka itanu ngo ajye mu kiruhuko cy’iza bukuru aba agomba gutegura ubuzima bwe buri imbere kandi ngo we yarabirangije. Yavuze  ko iyo ari kwigisha ijambo ry’Imana bimunezeza ariko ko hari n’undi munezero yumva ategereje kandi ngo ntibizamubuza  gutanga umusanzu mu itorero atari mu buyobozi. Ati "Mfite undi munezero numva ntegereje imbere Imana nintiza ubuzima burenga imyaka 65. Namaze gukora gahunda y’akazi k’ubuzima bwanjye, uko nzasaza ntabwo nzasaza nsaziye mu biro, ntabwo mbyifuza.” Akomoza ku byo azibandaho mu kiruhuko cy’izabukuru, yavuze ko azakomeza kwandika ibitabo akarushaho no kwishimana n’umuryango we cyane abuzukuru be. Ati “Maze kugira abuzukuru, byanezeza nicaye hamwe nkajya njyana abuzukuru ku ishuri ba nyina na ba se bagiye mu kazi nkajya kubabafatira bakaza nkabagaburira nkicarana nabo nkasekana nabo nkagira igihe cyo kunezerwa.” Rev. Past. Dr. Antoine Rutayisire yatangiye ivugabutumwa 1983 akimara gukizwa. Mu 1990 yaretse akazi ko kuba mwalimu igihe cye agiharira kwigisha ijambo ry’Imana. Icyo gihe yahise ajya kuyobora Umuryango w’ivugabutumwa rishingiye kuri Bibiliya w’abanyeshuri ba Kaminuza, akaba ariwe wabaye Umunyamabanga mukuru wawo wa mbere kugeza mu 1994. Nyuma Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, yayoboye umuryango w’ivugabutumwa wa AEE. Mu 2008 ayobora paruwasi ya Saint Etienne mu Biryogo  ahava ajya kuyobora Paruwasi  ya Remera arimo kugeza ubu.

title: Korali Iriba y’i Huye igiye kwizihiza isabukuru y’imyaka 25 imaze mu ivugabutumwa
content: Iyi korali yashinzwe ku wa 15 Gashyantare 1995, yatangijwe n’abantu 18. Izina ryayo ryamenyekanye cyane mu ndirimbo zirimo ‘‘Nta kibasha’’, ‘‘Witinya’’, ‘‘Turiho ku bw’ubuntu’’, ‘‘Urakomeye’’ na ‘‘Icyampa’’. Mu kwizihiza isabukuru y’imyaka 25 imaze ishinzwe, Korali Iriba yatangije ibikorwa byagutse byiswe “IribaWeek” bibanziriza ibyo birori biteganyijwe ku wa 16 Gashyantare 2020. Korali Iriba yinjiye mu cyumweru cy’ibikorwa bibimburira isabukuru y’imyaka 25 biteganyijwe ku 3-9 Gashyantare 2020. Ni icyumweru cyateguwemo ibikorwa byo kubakira ubwiherero imiryango itanu  itishoboye n’ibindi bikorwa by’urukundo. Abajijwe impamvu bahisemo kubakira abatishoboye, Umuyobozi wa Korali Iriba, Mukasine Jeanne D’arc, yavuze ko bifuje kuvuga ubutumwa mu bikorwa. Yagize ati “Twahisemo noneho kuvuga ubutumwa mu bikorwa kuko binazamura imibereho y’abantu, iki gikorwa kizakomeza n’ibindi twateguye.’’ Biteganyijwe ko ku wa 15 Gashyantare, Korali Iriba izagira umwiherero wo gushima Imana, naho ku wa 16 Gashyantare 2020 kuva saa Munani, ikore igitaramo cy’amashimwe akubiye muri Zaburi ya 107, kizabera ku rusengero rwa ADEPR Taba mu Karere ka Huye. Abazacyitabira bazataramirwa na Korali Iriba ifatanyije na Korali Itabaza. Umuvugabutumwa uzakibwirizamo ni Umuvugizi wa ADEPR, Karuranga Ephrem. Mu myaka 25, Korali Iriba ishima buri wese wagize uruhare mu kugira ngo umurimo ukomeze gutera imbere. Korali Iriba igizwe n’abarenga 130 bari mu byiciro bitandukanye biganjemo abatuye mu duce two mu Mujyi wa Huye turimo Matyazo no ku Itaba n’abakorera mu bindi bice by’igihugu. Mu myaka 25 imaze mu ivugabutumwa, Korali Iriba yashyize hanze album enye z’amajwi n’eshatu z’amashusho.

title: Abashakanye n’abitegura kurushinga bateguriwe igiterane kiziga ku kibazo cy’ingo zisenyuka
content: Iki giterane gifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti ‘‘Ukuri n’amahoro mu bashakanye’’ cyateguwe n’Umuyobozi wa River Ministry, Mukabaramba Jacky afatanyije n’umugabo we. Giteganyijwe kubera kuri Kigali Convention Centre ku wa 14 Gashyantare 2020, aho kizatangira saa kumi n’imwe n’igice z’umugoroba. Abazacyitabira bazaganirizwa n’Umuyobozi wa Evangelical Restoration Church ku Isi, Apôtre Joshua Ndagijimana Masasu n’umufasha we Pasiteri Lydia Masasu. Aba bombi baheruka kwizihiza isabukuru y’imyaka 30 bamaze babana nk’umugabo n’umugore mu birori byabaye mu Ukuboza 2019. Iki giterane cyahuriranye n’Umunsi w’Abakundana, cyanatumiwemo abahanzi bagezweho barimo James na Daniella bakunzwe cyane mu ndirimbo “Mpa  amavuta”, “Nkoresha” n’izindi n’abandi barimo Arsene Tuyi waririmbye “Naranyuzwe”, “Icyaremwe gishya” ndetse na Irimbere Christian ugezweho mu yitwa “Obligado” na “Ndi hano”. Umuyobozi wa The River Ministry, Mukabaramba akaba n’umwanditsi w’ibitabo yabwiye IGIHE ko yahisemo gutegura iki gikorwa bitewe n’izamuka ry’ingo zisenyuka. Uyu mubyeyi wanditse igitabo “Izahabu ihishe mu muryango” ni na we uyobora  abagore kuri Restoration Church Masoro. Yagize iyerekwa ashaka kongera guhuriza hamwe abashakanye n’abandi bari mu nzira yo kurwubaka kugira ngo baganire uko bakubaka ingo zihamye zubakiye ku rufatiro rutanyeganyezwa. Imibare y’inkiko igaragaza ko gatanya zizamuka ubutitsa kuko kugeza mu Ugushyingo 2018, hari hamaze gucibwa imanza za gatanya 1311, ni ubwikubwe bw’inshuro 19 ugereranyije n’umwaka wa 2017. Imibare igaragaza ko mu 2016 ingo zatandukanye zari 21, mu 2017 ziba 69; yerekana ko gatanya zikubye inshuro 62 bingana na 6,200% mu myaka itatu ishize. ERC ni itorero rishingiye ku musingi wo kubaka umuryango uhamye, aho imfubyi ibonera umubyeyi, umupfakazi akagira umwitaho. Ihishurirwa ryo kuritangiza Apôtre Masasu yarihawe mu 1984, aza kurishinga mu 1994. Amafaranga yo kwinjira muri iki giterane ku bashakanye ni 30 000 Frw ku bagura amatike mbere naho abazayagura uwo munsi ni 35 000 Frw; itike ku muntu umwe ni 15 000 Frw ariko izazamurwa ku 20 000 Frw.

title: Tanzania: Abantu 20 baguye mu mubyigano wabereye mu rusengero
content: Nyuma y’igiterane cyabaye kuri iki Cyumweru, Umuyobozi w’umujyi wa Moshi uherereye mu Majyaruguru ya Tanzania ibyo byabereyemo, Kippi Warioba, yavuze ko atewe impungenge n’uko umubare w’abapfuye ushobora gukomeza kwiyongera biturutse kuri uwo mubyigano. Ati “Kugeza ubu abantu 20 bapfuye ariko imibare ishobora kwiyongera kuko hari abakomeretse.”  Abakomeretse habarurwa 16. Ibyo byago byabaye ubwo abantu benshi bari bitabiriye igiterane cyayobowe n’umupasiteri ukunzwe  cyane muri icyo gihugu, Boniface Mwamposa, uyoboye itorero Arise and Shine Ministry ryo muri Tanzania. Jennifer Temu wari muri ayo materaniro yabwiye Ibiro Ntaramakuru by’Abafaransa, AFP, ko ikibazo cyaje kuvuka ubwo Mwamposa wiyita intumwa y’Imana, "Apôtre",  yasukaga ibyo yise amavuta yera hasi abantu bakabyiganira kuyakoramo. Mwamposa yahise ahunga. Umuyobozi wa Polisi muri icyo gihugu Simon Sirro wemeje ko hapfuye abantu 20 mu kiganiro kuri Televisiyo y’igihugu muri Tanzania, TBC1, yasabye Mwamposa kwishyikiriza Polisi kuko ari umuntu uzwi, ntaho yacikira. Yavuze ko Polisi igiye kureba uburyo amadini n’amatorero ategura amateraniro arimo abantu benshi. Perezida John Magufuli na we yavuze ko ababajwe n’abantu 20 baguye i Moshi ndetse n’abandi 20 bahitanywe n’imyuzure mu Majyepfo ya Tanzania, mu Karere ka Lindi mu cyumweru gishize.

title: Korali Yesu Araje yo mu Badiventisiti igiye kumurika album ya kane y’amashusho
content: Iki gitaramo gitegerejwe ku wa 29 Ukuboza 2019 ni impurirane y’ibyishimo kuko Korali Yesu Araje izaba yizihiza isabukuru y’imyaka itandatu imaze ivuga ubutumwa bunyuze mu ndirimbo. Umuyobozi wa Korali Yesu Araje, Muhayimana Elisa Claude [Elsa Cruz], yabwiye IGIHE ko ari umwanya mwiza wo gushima Imana ku burinzi bwayo mu rugendo rwo gukoramo ivugabutumwa. Ati “Mu myaka itandatu, twahuye na byinshi byari kuducogoza ariko Imana iracyadukomeje ku buryo tudafite gahunda yo gusubira inyuma. Imitima yacu iranezerewe cyane kuko Imana yabanye natwe muri iyo myaka yose; yadukoresheje umurimo wayo ku buryo nta karere ko mu Rwanda tutarakandagiramo tuvuga ubutumwa bwiza.’’ Igitaramo cyiswe “Ugirira ibanga” cyatumiwemo Korali Ababimbuzi na Abahamya ba Yesu zo ku Muhima, Inkuru nziza yo mu Bibare, Kugana Yesu y’i Muhanga ndetse n’abasore bibumbiye muri New Zion iririmba accapella n’umuhanzi Jonathan Jay bo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Korali Yesu Araje ifite gahunda yagutse yo kugura ibikoresho bizajya biyifasha mu ivugabutumwa ikorera mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu. Elsa Cruz ati “Mu by’ukuri dufite umugambi wo kugura ibyuma kuko kubera ingendo nyinshi tugira hari igihe tujya ahantu ugasanga nta na microphones bagira bikatugora kandi twakabaye tubyijyanira ariko kugeza ubu nta kintu na kimwe tugira uretse imihogo yacu.’’ Iki gikorwa nikigerwaho hazanategurwa ibiterane by’ibyumweru bibiri [amavuna] bizabera ahantu hatandukanye, mu kurushaho kwamamaza ubwami bw’Imana no mu bataramenya ubutumwa bwiza. Korali Yesu Araje yatangijwe n’abasore batatu gusa kugeza ubu umwe ni we uyisigayemo. Yatangiye ari itsinda (group) ribarizwa ku Gisozi. Nyuma yo  gucika intege kw’amatsinda mu Badiventisiti, abayigize bayihinduye Korali, kuri ubu ibarizwa ku Itorero rya LMS Kamukina (Kacyiru Merdien). Iyi Korali kuri ubu igizwe n’umusore umwe witwa Sekanyana Samuel n’abagabo batatu barimo Elisa Claude Muhayimana [Elsa Cluz], Nsengimana Amiel na Mudagani Pilote. Korali Yesu Araje ifite indirimbo zirenga 150 zirimo n’izandikwa zigenewe ibikorwa bitandukanye zigahita zirangira ntizongere gukoreshwa. title: Korali Shiloh yahurije Upendo y’i Huye na Dusabe Alexis mu gitaramo gisoza 2019
content: Igitaramo cyiswe ‘‘Haguruka Live Concert’’ kizasoza igiterane cy’iminsi ine cyatangiye ku wa 26 Ukuboza 2019, kiba buri mugoroba. Haguruka Live Concert izasozwa ku Cyumweru, tariki ya 29 Ukuboza 2019 mu gitaramo kizatangira saa munani z’amanywa. Cyatumiwemo Dusabe Alexis wamamaye mu ndirimbo zirimo "Umuyoboro", "Ninde Wamvuguruza", "Njyana i Gologota", "Tuzazamurwa" na "Igitambo Cyanjye" na Korali Upendo yo muri ADEPR Matyazo izwi mu ndirimbo “Bimenyekane” n’andi makorali y’i Musanze. Pasiteri Habyarimana Désiré na Evangeliste Jean Paul Nzaramba ni bo bazabwiriza ijambo ry’Imana. Iki gitaramo cyahawe intego iboneka mu Gitabo cya Yesaya 55:6 hagira hati “Nimushake Uwiteka bigishoboka ko abonwa, nimumwambaze akiri bugufi.’’ Perezida wa Korali Shiloh, Umutoni Aliane, yabwiye IGIHE ko iki gitaramo kigamije gutanga ubutumwa ku bari mu rugendo rugana Siyoni. Ati “Twiteguye kuramya Imana dufatanyije n’abazitabira igitaramo. Ubutumwa bw’ingenzi dushaka gutanga ni ubuganisha ku gushakana Uwiteka imbaraga zose no kumusenga ubudasiba.’’ Korali Shiloh ni iy’urubyiruko rubarizwa ku Mudugudu wa Muhoza mu Karere ka Musanze. Yashibutse ku y’abana b’irerero ry’icyumweru. Mu 2010 abenshi mu bari bayigize ubwo bari bageze mu cyiciro cy’ubugimbi n’ubwangavu bari bagiye kwimurirwa mu yindi Korali yitwa ‘Urufatiro’ yareraga urubyiruko rutegurirwa kujya mu yandi makorali makuru. Mu 2017, ubuyobozi bw’itorero bwanzuye ko abagize iyo korali baguma hamwe. Ku wa 3 Nzeri 2017, iyo korali nshya yaravutse ihabwa izina rya “Shiloh’’, ryakuwe muri Bibiliya Yera mu gitabo cya 1 Samweli 1:24; ahavugwa ijambo "Shiloh" nk’umusozi wera, aho ubwoko bw’Abisiraheli bwabonaniraga n’Imana. Korali Shiloh yakoze ivugabutumwa mu duce dutandukanye tw’igihugu mu turere twa Musanze, Burera, Ngororero, Gasabo, Kicukiro n’ahandi. Kugeza ubu ifite indirimbo umunani zirimo n’iyitwa "Umutima" iheruka kujya hanze. Usibye ivugabutumwa ry’indirimbo inakora ibindi bikorwa byo gufasha abatishoboye nko guha abanyeshuri ibikoresho by’ishuri no gukora imiganda itandukanye. Mu mpera za 2018, Korali Shiloh yakoze igitaramo “Uri Mwiza Mana Live Concert”, aho yafatanyije na Korali Goshen n’umuramyi Danny Mutabazi mu gitaramo cyasize benshi bakiriye agakiza.  	Umva indirimbo “Umutima” ya Korali Shiloh yo muri ADEPR Musanze

title: Uko abakristu bizihije Noheli mu nsengero zitandukanye mu Rwanda (Amafoto)
content: Ijambo Noheli rikomoka ku ijambo ry’Igifaransa “Noël”, naryo ryakomotse mu Kilatini “Natalis” bivuze “umunsi w’amavuko/isabukuru y’amavuko”. Mu Cyongereza Noheli yitwa “Christmas”. Imyiteguro y’uyu munsi iba ari myinshi mu ngeri zitandukanye, aho usanga mu bigo bya leta n’ibyigenga, amahoteli n’izindi nyubako bateguye ikirugu nk’ikimenyetso cy’uyu munsi wa Noheli. Guhera ku mugoroba wa Tariki 24 Ukuboza, abemera uyu munsi bawinjiramo bajya mu bitaramo byawo biba byateguwe hirya no hino mu madini atandukanye, bikaba akarusho bucyeye bwaho ku munsi nyirizina, aho bizwi ko n’utaherukaga mu rusengero yikubita agashyi akahaboneka. IGIHE yatembereye mu nsengero zitandukanye kureba uko abakristu bizihije Noheli, yaba abo muri Kiliziya Gatolika, ADEPR, Angilikani n’ahandi, tubakusanyiriza amafoto y’uko byari byifashe. title: Mgr. Antoine Kambanda yasabye abakristu gutsinda ukwikunda no kwita ku baciye bugufi
content: Mu nyigisho yatanze y’umunsi wa Noheli ya 2019, Mgr Kambanda, yavuze ko uko umuntu yaba ari kose n’akazi kenshi yaba afite atabura umwanya wo gukora icyiza kigirira mugenzi we akamaro. Yakomoje ku ibaruwa Papa yandikiye abakirisitu yise ’Ibyishimo by’Ivanjiri’ avuga ko “iyo umuntu yireba cyangwa yiyuzuyemo  nta mwanya agirira Imana” mu buzima bwe. Yavuze ko kwikunda ari byo bigaragara mu ngo zimwe na zimwe zibura gukundana no kwakirana hagati y’abashakanye bigatuma zisenyuka. Ati “Ibyo tubona kenshi abantu barikunda, yajya no kubaka urugo gushaka umugore cyangwa gushaka umugabo kubera kwireba, kwikunda no kuba yiyuzuyemo, ntashobore kwakira mugenzi we mu mutima we no mu buzima bwe, bakabana nk’amashyiga bakabana nabi urugo rugasenyuka.” Mgr Kambanda yavuze ko kwitanaho ku bashakanye, bikwiye kujyana na none no kwita ku bakene n’abandi bafite ibibazo bitandukanye, yibutsa abakirisitu ko ari cyo gisobanuro cya Noheli. Ati “Bavandimwe mukingurire umukiza imitima yanyu, ubuzima bwanyu. Mukingurire abavandimwe imitima yanyu n’ubuzima bwanyu cyane cyane abakene n’abababaye, abihebye n’abigunze.  Noheli ni ukwakira Imana mu bantu. Imana yigize umuntu kugira ngo tuyakire, kandi tuyikunde tuyiture ineza itugirira, tubigirira abandi, tugirira abandi akamaro.” Aho niho yahereye asaba abantu kwita ku baciye bugufi. Yavuze ko akazi umuntu yaba afite ako ariko kose, atabura uburyo n’umwanya wo gukora icyagirira mugenzi we akamaro. Ati “Mu rwego rwose umuntu arimo, mu bushobozi bwe no mu nshingano ze, buri muntu afite uburyo bwo kuba yagirira mugenzi we akamaro...Nta muntu udafite uburyo n’igihe, cyo kuba yakora icyiza. Icy’ingenzi ni ugutsinda ukwikunda, gutsinda ukwireba tugaharanira icyagirira abandi akamaro. ” Yavuze ko ‘ibyo ari byo bihesha Imana ikuzo bikaba n’uburyo bwo kuyitura urukundo n’ineza igirira abantu kandi bakayibera amaboko n’amaguru.’ Yabwiye abakristu ko ari maboko Yezu akoresha mu kuramira no gufasha abababaye, bakaba amaguru ye akoresha abageza ku bamwifuza bose. Ati “Ni twebwe maso ye abonesha kugira ngo abone abamukeneye, ni twebwe matwi ye akoresha kugira ngo yumve  abamutakambira. Turi ingingo zigize umubiri wa Kiristu, kuba yarigize Imana akavuka kuri Noheli akaba umwe muri twe, yatugize umuryango umwe natwe turi umubiri we n’ingingo akoresha kugira ngo akomeze gukiza abantu”. Musenyeri Kambanda yavuze ko kubaho abantu bikunda no kwirengagiza abafite ibibazo bituma babaho bigometse ku Mana bakabaho mu mwijima ntawe umenya undi kandi bamwe bahemukira abandi na bo batiretse.

title: Ben na Chance, Gahongayire mu batumiwe mu itangizwa ry’Umuryango Heart of Worship in Action
content: Igikorwa cyo gutangiza Heart of Worship in Action Foundation kizabera mu Ubumwe Grande Hotel ku wa 27 Ukuboza 2019 kuva saa Kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba. Gakunzi yatumiye abaramyi bakomeye mu Rwanda barimo Aline Gahongayire, Simon Kabera na Ben & Chance bamaze iminsi bakunzwe mu ndirimbo bise ‘Amarira ya Yohana’ n’abandi. Umuryango wa Heart of Worship in Action Foundation ufite intego yo gushyigikira ibikorwa bitandukanye bigamije guhindura ubuzima bwa benshi binyuze mu kubaka no kongerera ubushobozi bw’abari muri sosiyete runaka. Washinzwe  na Willy Gakunzi n’umugore we Estelle. Aba bombi bahuriye mu Buholandi mu 2004, barakundana ndetse bahuza inzozi zo gusakaza ibikorwa by’urukundo. Nyuma y’imyaka itanu bashyingiwe bakomeje umuhamagaro wo kuramya Imana no kwitangira ibikorwa byo gukunda abantu. Mu buzima bwabo bashyize imbaraga mu bikorwa bigamije kongerera ubushobozi urubyiruko, impunzi, abahohotewe n’abagore batishoboye. Mu bihugu byose babayemo birimo u Buholandi, u Bubiligi na Canada, ibyo bakora byarashyigikiwe bituma na bo bakomeza inzira biyemeje. Ku wa 8 Ugushyingo 2018 nibwo Estelle yitabye Imana, Gakunzi asigarana n’abana be babiri Kayla na Shayna. Kuva uwo munsi, Imana yahaye Gakunzi iyerekwa ryo gutangiza Umuryango Heart of Worship in Action nk’uburyo bwo kumuzirikana. Gakunzi yavuze ko mu kumuha icyubahiro azakomeza ibikorwa bye by’ubugiraneza. Yagize ati “Nta buryo bwiza bwo kwishimira no guha icyubahiro Estelle nko gukomeza gushyira mu bikorwa umutima we wo kuramya. Duhamya tudashidikanya ko binyuze muri uyu muryango ubuzima bwa benshi buzakorwaho kandi buhinduke bwiza.’’ Willy M. Gakunzi amaze igihe kirekire yitangira gukorana n’urubyiruko n’abantu bamukikije mu bikorwa bigamije guhindura imibereho yabo. Gakunzi afite Impamyabumenyi y’Icyiciro cya Gatatu cya Kaminuza mu bijyanye n’Ubukungu, International Economics and Business, yakuye muri Kaminuza ya Utrecht mu Buholandi. Anafite icyemezo nk’umuhanga mu gutegura igenamigambi (Functional Business Architect) yakuye mu Ishuri rya CEVORA na Kaminuza ya Antwerp mu Bubiligi. Gakunzi afite ubunararibonye mu gukorana n’ibigo by’imari mu bice bitandukanye ku Isi. Mu nshingano ze abifasha gushaka no gushyiraho uburyo bwo guhangana n’ibyago byatuma bigwa mu gihombo. Uyu mugabo afatanya izi nshingano no kwandika indirimbo akaba n’umuramyi. Yashinze amatsinda yo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana ku Isi. Gakunzi avuga ko ashishikazwa no kubaka ubushobozi bw’abantu by’umwihariko urubyiruko n’abadafite ubushobozi bagahindurirwa imibereho. Ati “Nizera ko hatitawe ku ho umuntu aba n’ubuzima arimo, iyo ufite uburyo bwo kubona igishoro n’ubumenyi bukwiye, ushobora gukora umushinga wahindura ubuzima bwawe.’’ Heart of Worship in Action Foundation ni umuryango udaharanira inyungu watangirijwe muri Canada mu 2019.

title: Masasu n’umugore bahujwe n’abaramyi bazwi mu gitaramo Christmas Eve Shout of Joy
content: Iki gitaramo cyiswe “Christmas Eve Shout of Joy” giteganyijwe kubera kuri ERC Masoro ku wa 24 Ukuboza 2019, kizinjiza neza abazacyitabira muri Noheli, umunsi abizera bafata nk’uwo Umwami woherejwe gucungura Isi yavutseho. Christmas Eve Shout of Joy yateguwe n’abaramyi barimo Serge Iyamuremye, Christian Irimbere, Tuyiringire Arsène [Tuyi], Milca na Gaelle. Ni umugoroba udasanzwe kuko abakirisitu bose bawutumiwemo ngo bazifatanye n’abaramyi kwizihiza umunsi wo kuvuka k’Umwami  wabacunguje amaraso y’igiciro cyinshi. Wahawe insanganyamatsiko iboneka muri Matayo2:10 havuga ngo “Babonye iyo nyenyeri baranezerwa cyane.” Abazitabira iki gitaramo kandi bazataramirwa n’abahanzi barimo Patient Bizimana, Shekinah Worship Team, Shining Stars, Shekinah Junior n’abarimo abaramyi Muhumure Confiance uririmba mu matsinda yo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana ya Alarm Ministries na Heman Worshipers; Umuhanzi Bigira Elysée uririmba muri Gisubizo Ministries na Nkomezi Prosper . Aba baramyi baziyongeraho Umuyobozi wa ERC mu Rwanda, Apôtre Ndagijimana Yoshua Masasu n’umugore we Pasiteri Lydia Masasu. Apôtre Masasu ni we uzabwiriza ijambo ry’Imana. Iyamuremye Serge uri mu bateguye iki gitaramo yabwiye IGIHE ko yavuze ko biteze kuzagirana ibihe byiza n’abazacyitabira. Ati “Ikintu gishya kizabahera ni uko abazitabira igitaramo bazabona ubufatanye no gushyira hamwe kw’abaramyi. Uzahagera wese azahagirira ibihe bidasanzwe byo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana ku bwa Yesu.’’ Christmas Eve Shout of Joy izabera i Masoro ku mugoroba wo ku wa Kabiri kuva saa Kumi n’Ebyiri kugeza saa Tanu z’ijoro.

title: Nyuma ya Kaminuza, Abangilikani barashaka kubaka ibitaro na Stade mu Rwanda
content: Byangajwe kuri iki  Cyumweru mu gikorwa cyateguwe n’itorero Angilikani ry’u Rwanda  ryamurikiraga  abakiristo ku mugaragaro ibikorwa ryakoze mu mezi 18 ribonye umwepisikopi Mukuru mushya Dr Laurent Mbanda, igikorwa cyabereye kuri Katederali ya Diyosezi ya Gasabo. Umwepisikopi Mukuru  w’Itorero Angilikani ry’u Rwanda Dr.Laurent Mbanda yavuze ko ubwo yarahiriraga  inshingano nshya   tariki  ya 10 Kamena 2018 yemeye  ibikorwa azakora mu gihe cy’imyaka itanu bikubiye mu nkingi eshanu zirimo  ivugabutumwa,kwigisha abakozi b’itorero banatangiza Kaminuza y’abangilikani , gushyira imbaraga mu burezi bahereye mu marerero n’ibindi. Dr Laurent Mbanda yavuze ko  mu gihe cy’amezi 18  itorero rimaze gukora  byinshi birimo kubaka Kaminuza y’Abangilikani i Kabuga izatangira muri  Mutarama 2020, kubaka icumbi ry’Umwepisikopi Mukuru i Kibagabaga  no kubaka amashuri y’amarerero   mu gihugu hose asaga 400. Mu bindi bikorwa Angilikani imaze gukora harimo kuba   ryujuje Katederali  y’igihugu i Kibagaba  ,ubu bakaba  bari no kubaka inzu z’ubucuruzi zizaba zuzuye  mu ntangiriro ya 2020 . Musenyeri Dr.Laurent Mbanda yatangarije abakristo ko usibye ibyo bimaze gukorwa ubu bagiye gutangiza imishinga mishya  irimo  kubaka  ibitaro muri Gasabo  i Bumbogo  n’ibindi  bibiri    hanze ya Kigali ,gutangiza ikigo cy’imari ( Anglican Church Sacco),kubaka ikigo cy’ubukerarugendo  cyizajya kigisha amateka y’ububyutse i Gahini, gutangiza ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi  ku bibazo abaturage bahura nabyo i Kabuga no kubaka Stade Mpuzamahanga  i Kabuga  izajya yakira imikino yose ,ibi byose  bikazatangira gushyirwa mu bikorwa  umwaka utaha Minisitiri w’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu,  Prof. Shyaka Anastase  yashimiye itorero ry’Abangilikani ku bikorwa bari gukora bijyanye n’icyerekezo cy’igihugu mu iterambere,  avuga ko nka Leta bashimishijwe n’umushinga  wo kubaka kaminuza izajya itegura abapasiteri. Yanashimye by’umwihariko imbaraga itorero ryagaragaje mu kubaka amashuri y’inshuke  arera abana mu gihugu hose, avuga ko bari gusubiza umuhigo igihugu cyihaye wo  kubaka uburezi bahereye hasi. Yagize ati “Ibi biragaragaza ko mufite abayobozi beza  kuko ibyo yadusezeranyije dutangiye kubibona mu gihe gito.” Minisitiri  Shyaka  yashimye  umuco mwiza wo kumurikira abakiristu ibikorerwa mu itorero  nk’ikimenyetso cyo gukora neza no  gukorera mu mucyo ,abizeza  ubufatanye. Itorero Angilikani ubu rifite diyosezi  11, mu gihe cyavuba bakaba bagiye gutangiza izindi ebyiri  arizo Kibuye na Nyaruguru.
