content: Iki gitaramo cyiswe “Urugamba ni Yesu Uruyoboye” kizabera muri Stade ya ULK guhera saa Munani z’amanywa. Korali Jehovah Jireh izafatanya na Korali Siloam yo muri ADEPR Paruwase Gasave, Umudugudu wa Kumukenke na Ntora Worship Team iyoborwa n’umuramyi Tuyizere Papi Clever. Perezida wa Korali Jehovah Jireh, Muvunyi Hyppolite, ni we uzayobora iki gitaramo mu gihe umwigisha wagitumiwemo ari Pasiteri Rudasingwa Jean Claude. Album ya kane igiye kujya hanze ikurikira iyo Korali Jehovah Jireh yamuritse muri Nyakanga 2017 yitwa ‘Umukwe araje’ igizwe n’indirimbo 13. Iyi korali yamamaye cyane mu ndirimbo zirimo ‘Umukwe araje’, ‘Tugufitiye icyizere Mana’, ‘Izahanagura amarira’, ‘Imana yaraduhamagaye’, ‘Kugira ifeza’, ‘Guma muri Yesu’, ‘Ingoma yawe’, ‘Turakwemera’, ‘Intsinzi’, ‘Akira ishimwe’ n’izindi. Korali Jehovah Jireh yashinzwe mu 1998, ikorera umurimo w’Imana mu Itorero rya Pentekote ADEPR by’umwihariko muri CEP ULK. Usibye ivugabutumwa ikora yifashishije indirimbo, Korali Jehovah Jireh ikora n’ibindi bikorwa by’urukundo birimo gufasha abatishoboye. Korali Jehovah Jireh yatangijwe n’abanyeshuri batandatu biga nimugoroba babarizwaga mu itsinda rikorera mu muryango w’abanyeshuri b’abapantekote bo muri kaminuza, icyo gihe ikaba yaritwaga Groupe de Prière des étudiants Pentecotistes Universitaires (GPEPU) nyuma nayo yaje guhindura izina ikaba CEP (Communautés des étudiants Pentecotistes) mu 2000. Kwinjira mu gitaramo  “Urugamba ni Yesu Uruyoboye” ni ubuntu. Abazacyitabira bashobora kuzatahana DVD iriho indirimbo za Korali Jehovah Jireh zose cyangwa bakanahabwa Flash disk iriho album zayo zose.

title: Apôtre Gitwaza yimikiye rwiyemezamirimo Byiringiro F. Régis i Yerusalemu
content: Byiringiro yasutsweho amavuta yo kuba umuvugabutumwa ku wa Kane, tariki ya 19 Ukuboza 2019. Ni umuhango wahuriranye n’urugendo rwa gihanuzi yarimo muri Israel rwo kureba ikirari Umwami Yesu yanyuzemo mu buzima bwo ku Isi. Uyu rwiyemezamirimo yinjiye ku rutonde rw’abavugabutumwa bemewe muri Zion Temple, aho asengera mu Gatenga. Mu kiganiro cyihariye na IGIHE, Byiringiro w’imyaka 33 yavuze ko kwimikwa byamwongereyemo imbaraga cyane ko byanabereye ku butaka bwanyuzeho abo afata nk’ibyitegererezo mu byo yizera. Yagize ati “Abantu banyitegure nk’umuntu ugiye gutanga umusanzu ariko noneho binyuze mu kuvuga ubutumwa bwiza. Nari nsanzwe nywutanga ku gihugu binyuze mu bucuruzi nkora ariko nifuje no kongeraho ivugabutumwa.’’ Yavuze ko yiteguye gutanga imbaraga mu iterambere ry’igihugu kirangwamo abaturage bakize banakijijwe. Ati “Nizeye ko bizagira ingaruka nziza ku muryango Nyarwanda kuko nzanifashisha ubunararibonye bw’imyaka 12 mfite mu bucuruzi nkongeraho ijambo ry’Imana. Ubutumwa Imana izanshyira ku mutima ni bwo nzajya ntanga ariko nifuza gushyira imbaraga mu kwerekana urukundo rw’Imana mu bigaragara.’’ Yashimangiye ko inshingano zo kwagura ubwami bw’Imana yahawe zitazamubuza gukomeza ishoramari asanzwemo ahubwo ari inyuganizi ku gukorera igihugu. Byiringiro yimitswe avuye mu cyumba cyo hejuru aho intumwa zuzuriye Umwuka Wera ku Munsi wa Pantekote, ibintu azahora azirikana nk’ikimenyetso cyo gushira amanga mu rugendo rwe rwo kubwiriza ubutumwa. Byiringiro yavuye muri Israel asuye ibice bitandukanye bifite amateka yihariye muri Bibiliya nka Tabora, Shilo, Urukuta rw’inzu ya Salomo yubakiye Imana, Umusozi wa Kalumeri, Inyanja itukura n’ahandi. Byiringiro ni umugabo wubatse, yashakanye na Uwera Christine, wanamwakiriye ubwo yageraga ku Kibuga Mpuzamahanga cy’Indege cya Kigali i Kanombe kuri uyu wa 20 Ukuboza 2019, avuye muri Israel. Byiringiro asanzwe ari Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Saltel Foundation ikomoka kuri Saltel, Ikigo gitanga serivisi z’ikoranabuhanga. Saltel Foundation ikora ibikorwa byo gufasha abantu batishoboye mu bijyanye n’uburezi aho ibafasha kubona amikoro yo kwiga. Muri Mutarama 2019, Saltel Foundation yafashije abanyeshuri 30 bo mu Kagari ka Runga mu Murenge wa Rwabicuma mu Karere ka Nyanza, bakomoka mu miryango itishoboye bahawe ibikoresho by’ishuri batangirwa n’amafaranga y’ifunguro rya saa sita kugira bige neza nta mbogamizi.

title: Korali Bethlehem na Siloam zanyuze abitabiriye isozwa rya Bethlehem Evangelical Week 2019
content: Iki giterane cyamaze icyumweru cyahurijwemo abahanzi n’amakorali akunzwe mu Rwanda ndetse kinaberamo ibikorwa by’urukundo byo gufasha abatishoboye no gusangira na bo. Muri uyu mwaka iki cyumweru cyahariwe ivugabutumwa cyahawe intego ivuga ngo “Naho twebweho iwacu ni mu ijuru’’ iri mu Abafilipi 3.20. Nyuma yo gutaramirwa n’abahanzi barimo Alexis Dusabe, Danny Mutabazi na Innocent Tuyisenge uririmba muri Korali Shalom yo muri ADEPR Nyarugenge mu minsi y’imibyizi, iki giterane cyasojwe ku wa 15 Ukuboza 2019 hakorwa igitaramo cyagutse. Korali zagitumiwemo zirimo Bethlehem na Siloam n’izindi zibarizwa ku Mudugudu wa ADEPR Gisenyi. Abacyitabiriye banyuzwe n’ubutumwa bwatanzwe bunyuze mu ndirimbo z’ayo makorali zakunzwe cyane mu nsengero zitandukanye. Hacuranzwe umuziki w’umwimerere, wizihiye buri wese. ‘Bethlehem Evangelical Week’ ni igitekerezo cyatangiye gushyirwa mu bikorwa ubwo iyi korali yizihizaga Yubile y’imyaka 50 mu 2016. Ibikorwa byitabwaho muri iki gihe birimo kwifatanya n’abababaye no kubaremera, gusura abarwayi n’imfungwa n’ibindi. Mu gikorwa cy’uyu mwaka, cyasojwe abaterankunga bahabwa ibyemezo by’ishimwe ndetse Rukundo Darius ahembwa nk’umuterankunga w’umwaka mu gihe Perezida wa Korali Bethlehem, Muhire Muparasi Innocent, yashimiwe nk’umaze igihe ku buyobozi. Yabwiye IGIHE ko yishimiye igihembo yahawe. Ati “Byari byiza cyane guhabwa igihembo nk’umuyobozi wa korali kuva mu 2005. Byanshimishije cyane, numvise nongewemo imbaraga.’’ Muri iki gitaramo kandi abaririmbyi ba Korali Bethlehem basangiye n’abapasiteri, amakorali, abakirisitu batishoboye Noheli n’Ubunani. Nyuma y’iki gikorwa cya 2019, Bethlehem Evangelical Week ishobora kwagurwa ikazajya itangira muri Mutarama mu kurushaho kunoza ibikorwa biyiberamo ndetse kikaba cyanagezwa mu zindi ntara. Mu bindi bikorwa Korali Bethlehem ishyize imbere harimo gusoza umwaka wa 2020 yarasoje umushinga wo kugura ibyuma n’urubyiniro izifashisha mu gukora ivugabutumwa ryagutse. Kuri ubu imaze kugura iby’asaga miliyoni 30 Frw. Korali Bethlehem yatangiye umurimo w’Imana mu 1965, igizwe n’abaririmbyi bane, yari iy’Urubyiruko. Nyuma y’imyaka ibiri yahawe izina rya Bethlehem. Ni korali ya kabiri yashinzwe muri ADEPR nyuma ya Bethania y’i Gihundwe aho iri torero ryatangirijwe mu 1940. Korali Bethlehem ubu ibarizwamo abarenga 80. Yibarutse abashumba benshi bagiye bahabwa imirimo itandukanye mu nzego zo hejuru muri ADEPR. Iyi korali imaze kubaka ibigwi mu bakunda umuziki uramya Imana, ifite album esheshatu z’indirimbo z’amajwi n’izindi z’amashusho. Yakoze ivugabutumwa mu nsengero n’ibiterane byagutse, muri za gereza mu Rwanda, yanatumiwe mu bitaramo mu bihugu birimo u Burundi, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Tanzania, Uganda na Kenya.

title: Calvary Ministries yateguye igiterane cy’amashimwe mu gusoza 2019
content: Iki giterane cyahawe insanganyamatsiko igira iti ‘Garukana amashimwe’; yatoranyijwe hagamijwe gufasha abakirisitu gusoza 2019 bari mu mashimwe. Giteganyijwe gutangira ku wa 26 no ku wa 27 Ukuboza 2019 aho kizabera kuri Nazareen Church Remera; kizasozwa mu gitaramo cyagutse cy’ijoro ry’ubusabane giteganyijwe ku wa 31 Ukuboza 2019 kuri Dove Hotel ku Gisozi. Iri joro ryo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana ryatumiwemo abahanzi n’amakorali afite ibigwi mu muziki uhimbaza Imana mu Rwanda arimo Healing Worship Team, Alarm Ministries, True Promises, Kingdom of God Ministries ndetse n’abahanzi Prosper Nkomezi na Bea na Ndutira. Abazacyitabira bazafata umwanya wo gushima Imana ku byo yakoze ku buzima bwabo, ubw’itorero n’igihugu muri rusange ariko banayiragiza umwaka utaha wa 2020. Iki giterane cyaherukaga kuba mu mpera za 2018 aho cyahurije hamwe amatsinda akunzwe mu Mujyi wa Kigali n’abahanzi baririmba ku giti cyabo.

title: Korali Siloam ya ADEPR Bibare yatumiye Shalom y’i Nyarugenge mu gitaramo gikomeye
content: Iki gitaramo cy’ivugabutumwa cyiswe “Amashimwe Live Concert” giteganyijwe kubera kuri ADEPR Bibare iherereye muri Kimironko ku wa 22 Ukuboza 2019. Gifite intego iboneka muri Zaburi 150, hagira hati “Haleluya. Mushimire Imana ahera hayo, Muyishimire mu isanzure ry’imbaraga zayo.’’ Korali Siloam imaze kugira izina mu muziki uhimbaza Imana ndetse bimwe mu bihangano byayo byifashishwa ahantu hatandukanye. Birimo “Niwo wera”, “Umunyamaboko’’, “Numvise Ijwi” n’iyitwa “Amashimwe’’ iheruka kujya hanze akaba ari nayo yitiriwe album nshya. Umuyobozi wa Korali Siloam ADEPR Bibare, Ntabana Dieudonné, yabwiye IGIHE ko imyiteguro igeze kure y’iki gitaramo cy’amashimwe y’ibyo Imana yabakoreye nk’abaririmbyi na korali. Yagize ati “Twariteguye mu buryo bw’imiririmbire ndetse twasenze Imana twizeye ko igitaramo kizagenda neza. Turarika abantu bazaze twifatanye gushima Imana.’’ Muri iki gitaramo hazamurikirwamo album y’amajwi  ndetse  bazanaboneraho  gufata amashusho y’izo ndirimbo zizashyirwa ku mugaragaro umwaka utaha 2020. Korali Siloam izifatanya na Korali Shalom yo muri ADEPR Nyarugenge ikunzwe cyane mu ndirimbo zirimo “Nzirata’’, “Abami n’abategetsi’’,  “Moyo Safi”, “Nzamamaza”, ‘‘Nyabihanga’’ n’izindi. Ijambo ry’Imana rizabwirizwa na Pasiteri Munezero. “Amashimwe Live Concert” ni igitaramo kizatangira saa Saba n’igice ndetse kucyinjiramo  ni ubuntu. Korali Siloam yatangiye umurimo w’ivugabutumwa bwiza ku wa 24 Ugushyingo 1998, yatangijwe n’abantu bake ariko Imana ikababwira ko izabagura. Iyi korali ubu ibarizwamo abaririmbyi 75. Ifite album eshatu z’indirimbo z’amajwi n’imwe y’iz’amashusho.

title: Korali Galeedi yatumiye Dominic Ashimwe na Deo Munyakazi mu gitaramo cy’amashimwe
content: Iki gitaramo giteganyijwe ku Cyumweru tariki ya 22 Ukuboza 2019, saa munani zuzuye. Kizabera aho Korali Galeedi ibarizwa, ku rusengero rwa ADEPR mu Nyakabanda, munsi y’ahahoze hoteli ya Alpha Palace, i Remera, ku muhanda KK263 St. Galeed Choir Live Concert yatumiwe abahanzi bafite izina barimo umuririmbyi Dominic Ashimwe n’umukirigitananga Deo Munyakazi, ukora umuziki gakondo avanga n’uwo mu rusengero. Ashimwe ari mu bahanzi babarizwa mu itorero rya ADEPR ufite izina mu muziki uhimbaza Imana, kuva mu myaka isaga icumi ishize. Yamamaye mu bihangano birimo “Nemerewe kwinjira’’, “Ashimwe”, “Ndishimye”, “Azanyibuka’’, “Wambereye imfura’’ n’izindi. Uyu muhanzi azanafatanya na Korali Sion ibarizwa ku Mudugudu wa Nyakabanda ndetse n’itsinda ryo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana ryo muri ADEPR Nyarugenge. Abazacyitabira bazabwirizwa ubutumwa bwiza n’umuvugabutumwa Singirankabo Boniface wo muri ADEPR. Mu kiganiro yagiranye n’abanyamakuru, Umuyobozi wa Korali Galeedi, Erick Shaba, yatumiye abakunzi b’ibihangano bihimbaza Imana kuzitaba ubutumire bwo gusangira ubutumwa bwiza bunyuze mu ndirimbo n’ijambo ry’Imana rihembura imitima. Ati ‘‘Twiteguye gutaramana n’abakunzi b’indirimbo zihimbaza Imana kugira ngo turusheho gushima Imana.’’ Kwinjira muri iki gitaramo kizatangirwamo amashimwe y’uburinzi bw’Imana mu gihe gitambutse ni ubuntu ku bantu bose. Korali Galeedi yatangiye umurimo w’Imana mu 1997 yitwa iya Nyakabanda. Icyo gihe yari igizwe n’abaririmbyi batanu basengera muri shitingi ; izina yakuweho ihabwa irya Ebenezer. Nyuma y’imyaka isaga itatu yahinduye  izina yitwa Korali Galeedi, bisobanura igishyinga gihamya (Itangiriro 31 :46-48). Iyi korali yakunze kugira umwihariko wo kuvuga ubutumwa hanze ya Kigali, mu bice by’ibyaro hirya no hino mu Rwanda ndetse iza kubihererwa igihembo cya Sifa Rewards cyatangwaga na Isange Corporation.

title: Patient Bizimana agiye gutaramira mu Bufaransa
content: Uyu muhanzi yahamirije IGIHE ko afite urugendo muri iyi minsi aho agiye gukorera igitaramo mu Bufaransa. Amaze imyaka irenga icumi akora umuziki ndetse indirimbo ze zihembura abatari bake mu ngeri zose. Igitaramo Patient Bizimana azaririmbamo kizaba tariki 28 Ukuboza 2019 muri Eglise Evangelique Lumiere Des Nations muri Reims. Bizimana yakoreye ibitaramo mu bihugu hafi ya byose bya Afurika y’Uburasirazuba, yaririmbiye mu Burayi n’ahandi henshi. Ni we muhanzi rukumbi mu bakora umuziki uhimbaza Imana mu Rwanda umaze gukora ibitaramo bikomeye ndetse bikagaragaramo abahanzi bubatse izina. Azwiho gutegura ibitaramo ngarukamwaka bya ‘East Celebration’ byitabirwa n’ibihumbi by’abakunda umuziki we. Mu 2016 yatumiye Solly Mahlangu, umunyempano ukomeye muri Afurika y’Epfo n’abandi batandukanye bagiye bamufasha mu myaka yatambutse. Umuziki yawutangiye akiri muto, agitangira kwiyumvamo impano yatangiye kwihatira kwiga gucuranga piano mu rusengero hanyuma bigeze mu 2007 asohora indirimbo ye bwite yitwa ‘Andyohera’ ari nabwo benshi batangiye kumubwira ko afite ijwi ryiza. Yakunzwe bidasanzwe mu ndirimbo ze nka ‘Iyo neza’, ‘Amagambo yanjye’, ‘Menye neza’ n’izindi; ahamya ko Imana yamugiriye ubuntu butangaje mu buzima bwe kuba yaramuhaye impano ikomeye yo kubwiriza ubutumwa bwayo binyuze mu ndirimbo ndetse zikaba umusemburo mu mitima y’ababa bacitse intege. Mbere yo kujya mu muziki, Patient Bizimana yakinnye umupira w’amaguru igihe kirekire gusa byageze mu mwaka wa 2000 amaze kuva muri Kiliziya Gatolika yakira agakiza, ibya ruhago abivamo atangira kwita cyane ku gukorera Imana no gukora umuziki. Ibitaramo ngarukamwaka yabiteguye ahereye ku byo yitaga ‘Poetic Evening of worship’ nyuma bibyara Easter Celebration iba buri mwaka mu kwizihiza Pasika.

title: Bamporiki yagaragarije urubyiruko ingaruka zo kuba abakolonije  u Rwanda barivanze n’abaruzaniye ivanjiri
content: Yabigarutseho kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki 14 Ukuboza 2019, mu ijambo yagajeje ku bitabiriye ibirori byo kwizihiza isabukuru y’imyaka 25, Umuryango Youth for Christ umaze ukorera mu Rwanda. Ibirori byo kwizihiza isabukuru y’imyaka 25, Umuryango Youth for Christ Rwanda, byaje bisoza igiterane cyateguwe n’uyu muryango cyabaye kuva tariki 8 kugeza tariki 14 Ukuboza 2019, i Kibagabaga ahakorera Ishuri rya Kigali Christian School. Kitabiriwe n’urubyiruko rugera ku 1150, ruri hagati y’imyaka 14 na 21, abakorana n’urubyiruko, abakozi b’uyu muryango, abakorerabushake, abashumba n’abandi bantu batandukanye. Cyari gifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti “Gukurira muri Kristo Yesu ugasenderera muri we”, igamije gufasha urubyiruko kumenya Kristo rugakurira muri we hanyuma rukajya no kubwiriza abandi iyo nkuru nziza y’agakiza. Minisitiri Bamporiki wari umushyitsi mukuru muri ibi birori yibukije urubyiruko ko rukwiye kumenya ko arirwo mbaraga z’igihugu bityo rudakwiye kwirarara. Ati “Nzi neza ko muri urubyiruko ruzima kandi muzi ko  iki gihugu cyakuwe kure n’amaboko y’abangana natwe mu myaka. Byaba ari agahomamunwa tugaragaye nk’abashaka gusinda kandi tudafite ibigega bihunitsemo imyaka myinshi.” Yavuze ko ibihugu birimo n’u Rwanda byagize ingorane za politiki mbi aho abazanye ivanjiri bivanze n’abaje kubikoroniza bituma intego y’Imana nyamukuru ntibayigeraho aho kwigisha urukundo bigisha imigenzo n’imihango. Yagize ati “Batangira kutwigisha cyane ibijyanye n’uko twambara, uko tunywa n’uko turya n’uko tunywa kurusha kutubwira mu by’ukuri imiterere n’imigirire ya Yesu Kristo bari batuzaniye.” “Iki ni igihe cyiza cyo guhuza indangagaciro z’abanyarwanda, amahame remezo ari mu Itegeko Nshinga n’Amategeko y’Imana yanditse neza kandi afite igisobanuro cyayo, tukava mu mihango n’imigenzo tukajya dutinda mu kureba ngo uyu kuki arya gutya, anywa gutya, yasokoje gutya kandi hari umurimo udutegereje.”  Umuryango Youth for Christ Rwanda wizihiza isabukuru y’imyaka 25, watangiye gukorera mu Rwanda mu buryo bwemewe n’amategeko mu 1995, ufasha ukora imirimo yerekeranye no kugeza ubutumwa bwiza mu rubyiruko no kubafasha gukurira mu matorero ya Gikristo kugira ngo babe abigishwa ba Kristo bageze ku kigero gishyitse. Imibare y’uyu muryango igaragaza ko urubyiruko rugera kuri miliyoni imwe rumaze kugezwaho ubutumwa binyuze mu matorero, amashuri, ibiterane na siporo. Youth for Christ Rwanda kandi abenshi mubo yafashije kuri ubu bari mu matorero bakuriyemo harimo n’ababaye abashumba, abapasiteri, abandi babaye abayobozi muri uyu muryango.

title: Groove Awards Rwanda 2019 yinjijwemo ibyiciro bishya birimo n’icy’umwana ufite impano ihambaye
content: Ibyiciro bishya byinjijwe mu irushanwa ry’uyu mwaka birimo umunyamakuru mwiza w’umwaka (hano ntibazagendera ku kuba akora kuri radio cyangwa kuri televiziyo) umuntu wese ukora itangazamakuru ryerekeranye no gutangaza ubutumwa bwiza niyo yaba akorera kuri Youtube azahembwa. Ikindi ni icy’Umwana muto w’umunyempano, muri iki cyiciro hazahembwa umwana ufite impano kurusha abandi bazaba bahatanye. Aba bana bahawe amahirwe ni abafite hagati y’imyaka itatu na 15. Ntabwo azaba ari umuririmbyi gusa ushobora guhatana ahubwo hanashyizwemo n’abandi bafite impano zirimo kubyina, kwigisha ijambo ry’Imana no gucuranga ibicurangisho bitandukanye bya muzika. Muri iki cyiciro amatsinda y’abana akora ibikorwa bitandukanye mu ruganda rw’umuziki wo guhimbaza Imaba yemerewe guhatana. Harimo kandi ikindi cyiciro cy’Umuyobozi w’Itsinda riramya Imana wahize abandi. Aha ho hazahembwa umwe mu bayobozi b’itsinda rikora umuziki wo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana uhiga abandi. Icyiciro cya nyuma mu bishya bongewemo ni icya MC mwiza, hano hazahembwa abayobozi b’ibikorwa bitandukanye mu ruganda rw’umuziki wo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana; birimo ibitaramo, inama n’ibindi. Kwiyandikisha byatangiye  ku wa 5 Ukuboza 2019, ku bahanzi b’abaririmbyi, ababyinnyi, amakorali, amatsinda n’abandi. Kuva ubwo abakurikiranira hafi ibikorwa by’umuziki uhimbaza Imana bafunguriwe amarembo yo kuzuza ‘forms’ zo kwiyandikisha no gutanga amahirwe muri iri rushanwa. Ubwo batangizaga kwiyandikisha muri ibi bihembo uyu mwaka ni nabwo hatanzwe ibihembo by’umwaka ushize, byatindijwe no kuba barabikoresheje hanze bigatinda kugera muri Kenya kandi ariho byari kuva bizanwa mu Rwanda. Nyuma yo kwiyandikisha hazabaho kwicarana n’inararibonye mu muziki wo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana  (abanyamakuru, abahanzi, producers n’abandi) batoranye abazahatanira ibihembo, urutonde rwa nyuma rwemezwe n’abagize akanama nkemurampaka. Nta matora azabaho, ahubwo abagize akanama nkemurampaka ni bo bazicara bahitemo mu bunararibonye bwabo abahize abandi.  ‘Forms’ zo kwiyandikisha ziri hanze kugeza tariki 19 Ukuboza 2019. Ziri ahantu hatatu: Mu mujyi kuri Radio Umucyo, i Nyamirambo ku biro  bya Impinga.com no ku Kisimenti kuri RAAH Supermarket no kuri internet ziriho ku rubuga rwa Groove: www.grooveawards.co.rw. Irushanwa rya Groove Awards mu 2019 rifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti ‘Better together’ yakuwe muri Zaburi 133:1. Abatsindiye ibihembo bya Groove Awards bazatangazwa mu mugoroba w’akataraboneka uteganyijwe ku wa 19 Mutarama 2020.

title: Abaramyi Gentil na Adrien Misigaro basesekaye muri Kenya aho bategerejwe mu gitaramo gikomeye
content: Gentil Misigaro na mubyara we Adrien Misigaro bageze mu Mujyi wa Nairobi muri Kenya ahagana saa tanu z’ijoro ryo ku wa 10 Ukuboza 2019. Igitaramo bateguye muri iki gihugu cyiswe “Buri Munsi Live Concert in Kenya-Nairobi” cyitiriwe indirimbo aba bombi bahuriyemo yitwa “Buri Munsi’’, yagize igikundiro mu Rwanda no mu mahanga ya kure. Biteganyijwe ko kizabera muri Calvary Convenant Centre iherereye ahitwa Komarock Section One kuva saa Cyenda z’amanywa yo ku wa 15 Ukuboza 2019. Gentil Misigaro na Adrien Misigaro bazafatanya n’abandi bahanzi bakunzwe muri Kenya. Kwinjira muri “Buri Munsi Live Concert in Kenya-Nairobi” ni amashilingi 200 mu myanya isanzwe mu gihe iy’icyubahiro ari amashilingi 500 akoreshwa muri Kenya. Gentil Misigaro yabwiye IGIHE ko biteguye neza gutaramana n’abo muri Kenya. Ati “Imyiteguro y’igitaramo iri kugenda neza, mu gitondo twakoze umwitozo wa mbere wo gusubiramo indirimbo.’’ Yakomeje ashima urukundo beretswe n’abatuye muri Kenya avuga ko bishimira kuzabana na bo mu gitaramo. Gentil Misigaro agiye gutaramira muri Kenya nyuma y’uruherekane rw’ibitaramo ’Biratungana Tour’ amazemo iminsi yakoreye muri Canada, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, u Bubiligi, u Bufaransa, u Bwongereza, u Buholandi, Australia n’ahandi. Aba basore bamaze kwamamara mu muziki wo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana baheruka gusangira urubyiniro mu Mujyi wa Kigali mu gitaramo cyiswe‘Hari Imbaraga Rwanda Tour’ cyabaye ku wa 10 Werurwe 2019. Iki gitaramo cyateguwe na Gentil Misigaro cyabereye muri Kigali Conference & Exhibition Village [Camp Kigali]. We na mubyara we Adrien Misigaro bafatanyije kuririmba indirimbo zirimo  ‘Yesu ndiye Dereva’, ‘Hano ku Isi’, ‘Buri munsi’,  ‘Biratungana’, ‘Iyo mbimenya’ na ‘Hari Imbaraga’ banakoranye.  	Reba hano indirimbo “Buri Munsi” ya Gentil Misigaro na Adrien Misigaro

title: Choeur International yateguye igitaramo izifashishamo indirimbo ya M’bilia Bel (Video)
content: Ni igitaramo kizaba ku Cyumweru tariki 15 Ukuboza 2019 muri Lemigo Hotel, aho kizatangira saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba. Umuyobozi wa Choeur International de Kigali, Shimagizwa Alain Richard, yabwiye IGIHE ko gitaramo kigiye kuba ku nshuro ya 13, batangiye kugikora kuva iri tsinda ryashingwa. Ati “Buri mwaka dukora igitaramo kiba kivuga kuri Noheli tukaririmba indirimbo zitandukanye ariko na none si ibyo gusa tureba n’indirimbo zisanzwe zizwi. Urugero nk’uyu mwaka mu gaseke kacu harimo indirimbo ya M’bilia Bel abantu bamenye nkaba nshishikariza abantu kuzaza. Ni igitaramo dutegura kuva Choeur International yashingwa.” Yavuze ko by’umwihariko uyu mwaka by’umwihariko bazacurangisha ibicurangisho byinshi bitandukanye kandi mu yindi bitarajyaga bibaho. Abaririmbyi b’iri tsinda biteguye iki gitaramo mu buryo bukomeye cyane ko badasiba gukora imyitozo kugira bazataramane n’ababakunda neza. Iki gitaramo kizaba gikubiyemo indirimbo zigiye zitandukanye zirimo izamenyekanye cyane mu Isi ya muzika ziririmbwe mu buryo bw’umwimerere kandi zatunganyijwe na bamwe mu bagize Choeur International. Mu ndirimbo zizaririmbwa higanjemo indirimbo zitandukanye nka Classique, pop, na R&B. Kwinjira muri iki gitaramo ni 5 000 Frw mu myanya isanzwe na 10 000 Frw mu y’icyubahiro. Amatike yacyo ari kuboneka kuri Lemigo Hotel, Librairie ya St Michel ashobora no kuboneka umuntu anyuze kuri umwe mu bagize Komite ya Choeur International de Kigali.  	Indi nkuru wasoma: Agaseke! Choeur International yateguye igitaramo kizakora mu nguni zose z’ibyishimo

title: Video: Yaririmbiye umugore we yifashishije indirimbo ya Westlife! Ibyaranze ubukwe bwa Papi Clever
content: Papi Clever na Ingabire bahamije isezerano ryo kubana akaramata imbere y’Imana ku wa 7 Ukuboza 2019 muri Dove Hotel ku Gisozi. Uyu muhanzi akimara kwambika umugore we impeta igaragaza ikimenyetso cyo kunga ubumwe mu buzima asigaje ku Isi, yahise amuririmbira agace gato k’indirimbo ya Whitney Houston “I Will Always Love You”. Yamwongoreye amagambo y’urukundo ati “Ndagukunda, nezezwa nuko wakwishima kandi nzahora mparanira ko wishima. Bakeka ko ngukunda ariko ntibabizi kukurusha. Guhera uyu munsi nzahora mparanira ibyiza kuri wowe. Yesu azabimfashemo.’’ Abatumiwe muri ubu bukwe bakiriwe muri Gigi’s Garden ku Gisozi, ahahuriye inshuti, abavandimwe n’abo mu miryango yombi. Nyuma yo kwakirwa, Papi Clever afashijwe na band ye, yateye umugore we umutoma yifashishije indirimbo “Beautiful In White” ya Westlife. Ubwo yaririmbaga yahabwaga amashyi y’urufaya ndetse yayisoje ahita agwa mu byano by’umukunzi we barishimana. Usibye uyu muhanzi wakoze mu nganzo, ibirori bye byasusurukijwe n’abarimo Worship Team ya Ntora ayobora [yaririmbye izirimo ‘Jehovah has the final say’, ‘Tambira Jehovah’, ‘My God is good’ n’izindi]. Iri tsinda ryiyongereyeho Korali Goshen y’i Musanze, Ingabire yaririmbyemo mbere yo kwimukira mu Mujyi wa Kigali, abayigize bifashishije indirimbo ya Niyomugabo Philemon yitwa “Ubukwe bwiza” mu kwifuriza ihirwe umuryango mushya. Abahanzi bazwi batashye ubukwe bwa Papi Clever barimo Nkomezi Prosper waririmbye indirimbo ze zirimo “Ibasha gukora” na “Nzayivuga.’’ Yamubwiye ati “Turashima Imana ku ntambwe nziza wateye. Turagukunda cyane.’’ Abatashye ubukwe banataramiwe n’itsinda ry’abahanzi b’abahanga barimo Kenneth na René Patrick, bifashishije indirimbo zitandukanye zirimo “Mwami icyo wavuze” ya Healing Worship Team n’izindi zabyinwe n’abageni ndetse n’abasore n’inkumi babaherekeje. Umubyeyi wa Papi Clever yakiriye umukazana we amubwira ko mu rugo habamo ibibazo byinshi ariko ibisubizo byabyo bizava mu masengesho no kwegera Imana. Ubukwe bwa Papi Clever bwayobowe na Nsengeyukuri Jean Damascène [Mc Philos] uri mu bamaze kwandika izina mu kuyobora imisango y’ubukwe, akoresheje ikeshamvugo n’ubuvanganzo binyura amatwi. Yayoboye ubukwe bw’abanyamakuru Karangwa Mike, Eric Shaba n’ubw’abahanzi barimo Albert Niyonsaba, Gikundiro Rehema [waririmbaga muri Korali Shalom y’i Nyarugenge mbere yo kwerekeza muri Amerika] na Elsa Cruz wo muri Korali Yesu Araje y’Abadiventisiti. Papi Clever yabengutse Ingabire bahuje umuhamagaro we na we ari umuramyi. Uyu mukobwa ufite ijwi ryiza yanyuze muri Korali Goshen ikorera ivugabutumwa muri ADEPR Musanze.  	Inkuru wasoma:  Umuramyi Papi Clever yarushinze na Ingabire Dorcas (Amafoto) Ibyaranze ubukwe bwa Papi Clever mu mashusho Amafoto: Niyonzima Moïse Video: Salomo George

title: Mahirwe uririmba muri Korali Shalom yasohoye indirimbo “Asifiwe sana” yubakiye ku buzima yanyuzemo
content: Mahirwe yamenyekanye cyane muri Korali Shalom kubera ijwi rye rifite umwihariko ryumvikana mu ndirimbo zayo zitandukanye atera. Mu ntangiriro za 2019 nibwo yinjiye mu muziki nk’umuhanzi wigenga; yatangiriye ku ndirimbo yise ‘‘Ikorera igihe’’, “Icyomoro” mbere yo gusohora “Usifiwe sana” iri mu Rurimi rw’Igiswahili. “Usifiwe sana” igizwe n’iminota 4 n’amasegonda 14 yasohokanye n’amashusho yayo, irimo ubutumwa, Mahirwe agaragaza ko Imana idakoza isoni abayiringira. Mahirwe yahisemo kuyiririmba nka Lumba, injyana ikoreshwa cyane muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, igihugu yabayemo. Uyu muhanzikazi yabwiye IGIHE ko indirimbo ye nsha yubakiye ku byo yanyuzemo, akanahitamo kuririmba ashima Uwiteka. Ati “Indirimbo ifite ubutumwa bushimangira ko Imana yagendanye nanjye. Naritegereje nsanga mu byo Imana yakoze ikwiriye ishimwe kuko ntiyigeze inkoza isoni.’’ Yakomeje ati “Nararebye mbona Imana ikwiye gushimwa kuko hari aho twageze tubaho mu buzima bukakaye ariko Imana ntiyadutereranye.’’ Mahirwe yavuze ko intego y’iyi ndirimbo ari ukubwira abantu ko nta kinanira Imana kandi ko isohoza mu gihe cyagenwe. Yagize ati “Ni ukubumvisha ko Imana ishobora byose kandi ko ariyo mugenga wa byose. Nimba Uwiteka ari mu ruhande rwacu nta muntu n’umwe uzaduhangara.’’ Indirimbo “Usifiwe Sana” ya Mahirwe mu buryo bw’amajwi yakozwe na Producer Arnaud mu gihe amashusho yatunganyijwe na Producer Eliel Sando. Mahirwe yatangiye kugaragaza impano yo kuririmba abarizwa mu ishuri ryo ku Cyumweru muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo i Goma aho yarerewe. Kuva mu 2007, uyu muhanzikazi yanyuze muri Korali zirimo Elayono, Tumaini, Integuza na Siyoni zo muri ADEPR Rubavu.

title: Umuvugabutumwa Reinhard Bonnke yitabye Imana
content: Ku rukuta rwe rwa Facebook  niho umugore  we yacishije ubutumwa bugaragaza ko bafite intimba batewe no kuba yitabye Imana. Mu butumwa bagize bati “N’agahinda kenshi umuryango wa Bonnke urifuza kubamenyesha urupfu rw’umugabo wacu twakundaga, data akaba na sogokuru; umuvugabutumwa Reinhard Bonnke. Yatabarutse mu mahoro akikijwe n’umuryango we kuri uyu wa 7 Ukuboza 2019.” “Mu myaka 60 yashize yabwirije inkuru nziza y’agakiza gatangwa na Yesu Kirisito  ku Isi yose. Dushaka gushimira mu izina rye n’iry’umuryango ku bw’urukundo mwamweretse no kuba mutarahwemye kumushyigikira[…]” Bonnke yitabye Imana nyuma yaho yari amaze igihe afite ikibazo cy’igufa ryo mu kuguru, ndetse yarabazwe ku buryo atabashaga gutambuka. Reinhard Bonnke yavutse ku wa 19 Mata 1940 i Konogsberg mu Budage. Yakijijwe afite imyaka icyenda, aza kwiga amashurii ya Bibiliya muri ishuri The Bible College of Wales mu Mujyi wa Swansea.  Yasoje amashuri aba umuvugabutumwa mu Budage imyaka irindwi nyuma y’aho aza gukomereza umuhamagaro we muri Afurika. Mu 1967 yagiye muri Lesotho agenda agira ibiterane  byinshi by’ivugabutumwa ku Isi yose byahinduriwe ubuzima benshi bakava mu byaha. BBC yatangaje  ko nibura abantu miliyoni 79 bakiriye agakiza bimuturutseho.

title: ‘Bethlehem Evangelical Week 2019’ yahurijwemo abaramyi bakunzwe, izaberamo ibikorwa by’urukundo
content: Icyumweru cyahariwe ivugabutumwa gitegurwa na Korali Bethlehem, kuri iyi nshuro cyahawe intego ivuga ngo “Naho twebweho iwacu ni mu ijuru’’ iboneka mu Abafilipi 3.20. Biteganyijwe ko iri vugabutumwa rizatangira ku wa Mbere, tariki ya 9 Ukuboza risozwe ku wa 15 Ukuboza 2019, aho rizabera kuri ADEPR Paruwasi ya Gisenyi. Abazitabira iki giterane bazifatanya n’abahanzi barimo Alexis Dusabe, Danny Mutabazi na Innocent Tuyisenge uri mu bari kuzamuka mu muziki uhimbaza Imana akaba asanzwe aririmba muri Korali Shalom yo muri ADEPR Nyarugenge. Aba baziyongeraho korali zirimo Siloam ya ADEPR Kumukenke mu Mujyi wa Kigali n’izindi z’i Rubavu nka Bethel, Impuhwe, Rehoboth, Siyoni, La Source, Bethfage na Penuel. Ijambo ry’Imana rizabwiriza n’abavugabutumwa babisigiwe barimo Ev. Singirankabo Boniface, Pasiteri Habyarimana Désiré na Rev. Past Butera Célestin. Umuyobozi wa Korali Bethlehem, Muhire Innocent, yatangarije IGIHE ko iki cyumweru cyateguwemo ibikorwa byinshi by’ivugabutumwa rinyuze mu ndirimbo no kuremera abatishoboye. Yagize ati “Hari ibikorwa tuzakora byo gufasha abantu mu bitaro, muri gereza n’ahandi nkuko dusanzwe tubigenza.’’ Yavuze ko kuri iyi nshuro bazanita ku bo mu rusengero bahereye ku bo bakorana umurimo w’ivugabutumwa rinyuze mu ndirimbo. Ati “Turifuza kuzaremera n’abantu bo muri twe batishoboye. Mu myaka ibiri ishize, ivugabutumwa ryacu ryibanze cyane mu byaro tugera ku bantu batagiraga amahirwe yo gutaramana natwe. Turashaka gukomeza kwagura ivugabutumwa mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu.’’ Ibiterane bizaba muri iki cyumweru biteganyijwe ko kuva ku wa Mbere kugera ku wa Gatanu bizajya biba saa 16:00-20:00. Ku wa Gatandatu ni saa 14:00-20:00 mu gihe kizasozwa ku wa 15 Ukuboza 2019 mu gitaramo gikomeye giteganyijwe kuva saa 9:00-18:30. Mu mwaka ushize ibikorwa byakozwe muri Bethlehem Evangelical Week byari bifite agaciro k’arenga miliyoni enye n’igice z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Korali Bethlehem yatangiye umurimo w’Imana mu 1965, igizwe n’abaririmbyi bane, yari iy’Urubyiruko. Nyuma y’imyaka ibiri yahawe izina rya Bethlehem. Ni korali ya kabiri yashinzwe muri ADEPR nyuma ya Bethania y’i Gihundwe aho iri torero ryatangirijwe mu 1940. Korali Bethlehem ubu ibarizwamo abarenga 80. Yibarutse abashumba benshi bagiye bahabwa imirimo itandukanye mu nzego zo hejuru muri ADEPR. Iyi korali imaze kubaka ibigwi mu bakunda umuziki uramya Imana, ifite album esheshatu z’indirimbo z’amajwi n’izindi z’amashusho. Yakoze ivugabutumwa mu nsengero n’ibiterane byagutse, muri za gereza mu Rwanda, yanatumiwe mu bitaramo mu bihugu birimo u Burundi, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Tanzania, Uganda na Kenya.

title: Umuhanzikazi Tuyishime Sabrina yatumiye abanyempano mu gitaramo azamurikiramo album
content: Iki gitaramo cyiswe “Ndabihamya Live Concert” kizabera kuri ADEPR Kibagabaga, ku wa 8 Ukuboza 2019 kuva saa munani. Tuyishime yabwiye IGIHE ko iki gitaramo yashatse kucyitirira indirimbo ye ya mbere yise “Ndabihamya” kuko yizera ko yakoze ku mitima ya benshi. Yagize ati “Igitaramo nacyitiriye indirimbo yanjye ya mbere nashyize hanze. Ntekereza ko yakoze ku mitima ya benshi.’’ Uyu muhanzikazi mu gitaramo cye yatumiyemo abarimo Bosco Nshuti ufite igikundiro mu muziki uhimbaza Imana ndetse yegukanye Groove Awards 2018; Tuyisenge Innocent uririmba muri Korali Shalom yo muri ADEPR Nyarugenge; Umukirigitananga, Niyifasha Esther n’amakorali arimo Abarinzi na Goshen. Abazacyitabira bazasangizwa ijambo ry’Imana n’umuvugabutumwa, Kalisa Fred wo mu Itorero rya ADEPR. Tuyishime yavuze ko yakoze imyiteguro y’ibanze ategereje umunsi w’igitaramo kandi yizeye ko kizagenda neza. Yakomeje ati “Icyo abakunzi banjye banyitezeho nta kindi uretse gukorera Imana binyuze mu kuyihimbaza nayiramya binyuze mu ndirimbo. Mu bihe biri imbere ateganya  gukomeza ibikorwa by’ivugabutumwa birimo no gusura abantu bababaye n’abarwayi mu bitaro bitandukanye. Tuyishime Sabrina ni umukobwa ubarizwa mu Itorero rya ADEPR Kibagabaga. Amaze imyaka ibiri atangiye umuziki ariko indirimbo ya mbere yayishyize hanze mu 2018. Uyu muhanzikazi amaze gukora indirimbo zirindwi ariko anafite izindi agitunganya muri studio. Indirimbo ze zamamaye zirimo “Ndabihamya” yanitiriye album, “Uri uwo kubahwa” n’izindi. Kwinjira mu gitaramo cyitiriwe “Ndabihamya”, indirimbo ya mbere ya Tuyishime yasangije abakunzi be ni ubuntu.  	Reba hano “Ndabihamya” ya Tuyishime Sabrina

title: Umwihariko muri Groove Awards 2019 igiye kubera mu Rwanda ku nshuro ya karindwi
content: Mu itangazo rigenewe abanyamakuru ryagiye hanze, rigaragaza ko ibi bihembo bizatangwa ndetse muri uyu mwaka bikazazana umwihariko utandukanye n’iyabanje. Abazahatanira ibihembo biteganyijwe ko bazatangazwa mu mpera z’uku kwezi. Hazaba harimo ibyiciro bishya bitari bisanzwe n’izindi mpinduka zigamije gukomeza guteza imbere uruganda rw’umuziki uhimbaza Imana mu Rwanda. Kwiyandikisha bizatangira ku wa 5 Ukuboza 2019, ku bahanzi b’abaririmbyi, ababyinnyi, amakorali, amatsinda n’abandi. Ni igikorwa kizabera muri Ubumwe Grande Hotel saa kumi n’imwe z’umugoroba. Kuva kuri uyu munsi, abakurikiranira hafi ibikorwa by’umuziki uhimbaza Imana bazafungurirwa amarembo yo kuzuza ‘forms’ zo kwiyandikisha no gutanga amahirwe muri iri rushanwa. Uyu mugoroba ni nawo uzatangirwamo ibihembo by’ababyegukanye Groove Awards mu mwaka ushize ariko bari bamaze umwaka babitegereje. Irushanwa rya Groove Awards mu 2019 rifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti ‘Better together’ yakuwe muri Zaburi 133:1. Abatsindiye ibihembo bya Groove Awards bazatangazwa mu mugoroba w’akataraboneka uteganyijwe mu ntangiriro za Mutarama 2020. Ibirori nk’ibi bya Groove Awards biheruka mu Ukuboza umwaka ushize muri Kigali Marriott Hotel, ababyitabiriye basusurukijwe n’abahanzi barimo Gahongayire, The Pink, Eddie Mico, Ashimwe Dorcas n’abandi. Abatwaye ibihembo mu byiciro bine bikuru muri Groove Awards Rwanda bari barimo Umuhanzi n’Umuhanzikazi b’umwaka, Korali y’umwaka na Minisiteri y’umwaka, icyo gihe bemerewe guterwa inkunga y’ibikoresho bazifashisha nibategura igitaramo. Ibi bihembo byahawe Nshuti Bosco, Gahongayire Aline, Ambassadors of Christ Choir na Healing worship Team iri mu matsinda aramya Imana agezweho cyane muri iki gihe.
