title: Mgr Rukamba yavuze ku biganiro bishobora kugeza ku kwemerera abafite abagore kuba abapadiri
content: Mu byumweru bitatu biri imbere uhereye kuri uyu wa 6 Ukwakira 2019, abasenyeri bagera kuri 260 bo muri Amerika y’Epfo bazigira hamwe ibibazo bijyanye n’ihindagurika ry’ikirere, abimukira n’ivugabutumwa. Inyandiko igaragaza ibizaganirwaho izwi nka Instrumentum Laboris, iriho n’igitekerezo gikomeje kugibwaho impaka, hibazwa niba muri Amazonie bishobora kwemerwa ko abagabo bakuze kandi bafite abagore, bakwemererwa guhabwa isakaramentu ry’ubusaserdoti. Ni igice cyugarijwe n’ubuke bw’abapadiri, kugeza ubwo abaturage 85 % badahabwa misa uko bikwiye. Umushumba wa Diyosezi Gatolika ya Butare akaba na Perezida w’Inama y’Abepiskopi mu Rwanda, Mgr Philippe Rukamba, yavuze ko nubwo ari ibiganiro bigikomeza, ari uburyo bushoboka ahamaze kugaragara ikibazo cy’ubuke bw’abapadiri. Ati “Ni ibintu abantu batekerezaho cyane muri iki gihe kubera ko u Burayi, Amerika y’Epfo batangiye kugira ikibazo gikomeye cy’abapadiri bato. Ubundi kuba umupadiri ni ubutumwa umuntu agira, akoherezwa kwigisha ijambo ry’Imana, gutagatifuza abantu, kuyobora Kiliziya, buriya hari n’aho abapadiri bahari barashatse cyane nko mu mico yo muri Aziya, hari abapadiri bafite abagore, gusa babyemera kare, bagashyingirwa.” “Ni ibintu bivugwa cyane kubera icyo kibazo, abantu bamwe bakavuga bati ‘ariko turabura abapadiri kandi hari abantu wenda bashaka kuba abapadiri ari abantu bakuru’. Noneho rero ntabwo biremezwa, ni ibintu abantu batekerezaho kuko kudashaka, umuntu ashobora kuba padiri yaranashatse nk’uko mu mico imwe n’imwe muri za Liban n’ahandi mu bagatolika ihari. Ariko ubu nta kintu cyari cyagerwaho, ni ibitekerezo gusa.” Musenyeri Rukamba yavuze ko hari kenshi biba nk’abapasiteri b’abaporoso bahinduka abagatolika, ngo hari ubwo mu bihugu bimwe bemererwa kugumana abagore babo kandi bakaba abapadiri aho byemewe, cyangwa bagashakirwa izindi nshingano muri Kiliziya. Gusa muri iki gice cya Kiliziya Gatolika u Rwanda ruherereyemo, umuco uhari ni uw’uko abapadiri badashaka abagore. Mgr Rukamba yakomeje ati “Nko mu minsi ishize habaye ikibazo gikomeye mu Bangilikani, [kiliziya] ibemerera kuza, bari bafite n’abakirisitu babo bazanye, barakomeza bababera abashumba, barashatse.” Gusa ingingo yo kwemerera abantu bafite abagore kuba abapadiri ngo ntaho iragera yemezwa, ni uko yumvikana nk’ishishikaje abantu cyane, ariko ngo n’iyo abasenyeri muri Amazonie babyemeza, bizasaba ko Papa abiha umugisha abanje gutumiza sinode yagutse, igizwe n’abasenyeri bahagarariye abandi mu bihugu byose ku Isi. Mgr Rukamba ati “Bishobora no kuba bibera mu gice kimwe runaka, ariko Isi yose igomba kubimenya, bigomba kwemezwa. Papa ni wo murimo we wo guhuza abantu bose, gutuma [habaho] ubumwe hagati y’abakristu, kandi bigenze bityo urabona ko baba bavuye mu buryo bumwe bwo kubaho bajya mu bundi, ni ikintu rero cyasaba ko abantu bicara bakaganira.” Umuhanga mu bijanye n’amadini, Prof. Linda Woodhead MBE, yabwiye BBC ko nubwo iyo ngingo hari abatayivugaho rumwe, bidakwiye ko bibagirwa ko Kiliziya Gatolika ari umuryango ugenda uhinduka, bijyanye n’uko imyaka igenda ishira. Ati "Igenda ihinduka buri gihe, ariko bikaba mu bwitonzi, ibanje kwitegereza neza amateka n’imyemerere yayo.” Bitekerezwa ko mu gihe abarongoye bakwemererwa guhabwa ubusaserdoti muri Amazonie, no mu tundi duce dukennye abapadiri bishobora kuba gutyo. Gusa ngo hari n’ubwo ahandi babona ibisubizo byihariye ku kibazo cy’ubuke bw’abapadiri. Gusa ngo hari n’impungenge ko abubatse bemerewe isakaramentu ry’ubusaseredoti, bishobora no gutuma n’ahatari ikibazo cy’abapadiri babyifuza, cyane ko ingingo yo kwemerera abapadiri gushaka abagore yakomeje gutindwaho cyane.

title: Umufaransa Gianadda na Christus Regnat bishimiwe mu gitaramo bahuriyemo i Kigali (Amafoto)
content: Iki gitaramo cyabereye muri Kigali Conference and Exhibition Village [Camp Kigali]mu ijoro ryo ku wa Gatandatu, tariki ya 5 Ukwkaira 2019. Cyitabiriwe ku rwego rwo hejuru n’ab’ingeri zitandukanye barimo abana, urubyiruko, abakuru, abakecuru n’abasaza, abanyamahanga bose bashimishijwe no kwihera ijisho umuziki wa kera wanyuraga amatwi n’imitima ya benshi. Ngoboka Cyriaque wari uyoboye iki gitaramo, niwe wabanje kujya ku rubyiniro ashyira abantu mu mwuka w’umuziki w’umwimerere. Uyu mugabo ntabwo yamaze igihe kinini ku rubyiniro wenyine kuko yahise ahamagara abacuranzi ndetse n’abandi baririmbyi ba Korali Christus Regnat batambuka gake gake baza mu byicaro byabo imbere. Iyi korali imaze kuririmba indirimbo imwe yahamagaye umukobwa we witwa Samantha, amufasha kubwira abantu ibigwi bya Christus Regnat n’ibindi byerekeye igitaramo. Abaririmbyi bahise bakomeza baririmba indirimbo eshanu, bahereye ku yitwa ‘Kumbaya’ y’itsinda rya Peter, Paul na Mary; yitwa ‘Christus Regnat’ ivuga ibyiza byayo n’izindi zivanzemo iz’Ikinyarwanda. Jean Claude Gianadda ni we wakurikiyeho yishimirwa mu ndirimbo ze zitandukanye zirimo ‘Trouver dans ma vie ta présence’, ‘Qu’il est formidable d’aimer’, ‘Marie tendresse dans nos vies’, ‘Magnificat’  n’izindi nyinshi. Uyu muhanzi wari uri gufashwa na Korali ya Christus Regnat, uko yasozaga kuririmba indirimbo yakomerwaga amashyi y’urufaya ubona abitabiriye iki gitaramo banyuzwe n’umuziki we. Yageze aho afata gitari ye yari yanditseho amazina ye, maze ayongera mu birungo by’umuziki wa Christus Regnat wari uryoheye amatwi mu buryo buhambaye. Iki gitaramo cya Christus Regnat cyari kigamije gukusanya inkunga yo gufasha ikigo cyita ku bana bafite ubumuga babarizwa muri ‘Centre Inshuti zacu i Gahanga’ mu Murenge wa Gahanga mu Karere ka Kicukiro. Mu bitanze harimo na Jean Claude Gianadda watanze sheki y’amayero 1500 yo gufasha Centre Inshuti Zacu ngo kuko ukwemera gukwiye guherekezwa n’ibikorwa. Igitaramo gihumuje Musenyeri Antoine Kambanda, yahawe ijambo ashimira Jean Claude Gianadda ndetse anibutsa abantu iby’ukwezi kudasanzwe kw’iyogezabutumwa. Ati “Wakoze Jean Claude Gianadda kuba waje muri iki gitaramo n’abandi ndabashimira cyane kuba mwaje. Ni umugisha n’ibyishimo bikomeye, sinzi niba mubizi ko turi mu kwezi kudasanzwe kw’iyogezabutumwa ku Isi yose […]  ni uburyo bwo kwizihiza imyaka 100 y’ibaruwa ikomeye yanditswe na Papa Benedigito wa 15 atangaza kandi atuma intumwa kujya ku Isi.” Yanavuze ku gikorwa cyiza cyo gufasha cyari mu byatumye iki gitaramo gitekerezwa cyane, kuko iyo umuntu abana n’ubumuga aba akwiriye gushyigikirwa. Ati “Muzi ko iki gitaramo kigamije igikorwa cy’urukundo cya bariya bana bafite ubumuga. Iyo  umuntu adafite amaguru abayafite tuba dufite inshingano zo kumugeza aho ashaka kujya, iyo adafite amaboko abayafite tuba dufite inshingano zo kuyamubera. Na bariya bana badafite amahirwe yo kubona ibyangombwa by’ubuzima ni twebwe bireba.” Jean Claude Gianadda nk’umushyitsi mukuru muri iki gitaramo niwe wihariye igihe kinini ari kuririmba. Uyu musaza wanyuze benshi yavutse mu 1944 mu Bufaransa [ubu afite imyaka 75]. Yabaye umwarimu wa Siyansi n’Umuyobozi w’Ishuri rya Koleji Saint Bruno i Marseille mu Bufaransa kuva 1970 kugeza 1994. Uyu muhanzi w’umunyabigwi yashyize hanze album ya mbere mu 1974 aho yafatanyaga kuririmba no kwigisha. Ku myaka 50 y’amavuko yasezeye umwuga w’ubwarimu afata inzira yo kuririmba nk’ubutumwa bwe bw’ibanze muri Kiliziya Gatolika. Jean Claude Gianadda nk’umuririmbyi, yakoze indirimbo nyinshi cyane zikubiye muri za album zirenga 100. Ni abahanzi bake ku Isi bafite aka gahigo. Yaririmbye indirimbo zirimo ‘Tiens Ma Lampe Allumée’, Jésus me voici devant toi’, ‘Trouver dans ma vie Ta présence’ n’izindi. Yashyize hanze album nka ‘Qu’il est formidable d’aimer’, ‘Près de Toi Marie’ n’izindi. Yashinze umuryango witwa ‘Association Jeunesse et Culture Saint-Bruno’. Intego nyamukuru zawo zigabanyije mu bice bibiri birimo icyo kwibanda ku guteza imbere indirimbo zisingiza Imana. Mu buzima busanzwe afasha abababaye haba mu gihugu cye kavukire n’ahandi ku Isi yose. Korali Christus Regnat yamutumiye yashinzwe mu 2006, ivukira kuri Centre Christus i Remera mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Kuva mu 2008, ibarizwa kuri Paruwasi yitiriwe Umwamikazi w’Amahoro Regina Pacis i Remera. Ubu ifite imizingo itandatu y’indirimbo zabo mu buryo bw’amajwi, mu gihe imaze gukora ibitaramo bikomeye bine. Amafoto: Niyonzima Moïse

title: Abahanzi bakomeye mu muziki uramya Imana bahurijwe mu giterane cyo kubatura urubyiruko
content: Iki giterane kizaba kiba ku nshuro ya gatanu cyatumiwemo abahanzi b’ibyamamare nka Gahongayire Aline, Bizimana Patient, Sam Rwibasira, Bosco Nshuti, Healing Worship Team n’andi matsinda y’abanyeshuri. Youth Convention 2019 izabera muri Kigali Conference and Exhibition Village hazwi nka Camp Kigali ku Cyumweru, tariki ya 6 ukwakira 2019, guhera saa Saba. Iki giterane cyateguwe na Teens For Christ ku bufatanye n’ibigo by’amashuri yisumbuye uyu muryango wigishamo ijambo ry’imana; gisanzwe kiba buri mwaka ariko kikabera ku Kigo cy’amashuri cya Gihogwe. Umuyobozi w’Umuryango wa TFC ku rwego w’igihugu, Pasiteri Mbanzabugabo Aminadab, yatangaje ko muri uyu mwaka habayeho impinduka ku ho igitaramo gisanzwe kibera. Yagize ati “Igiterane cyari gisanzwe kibera i Gihogwe  ariko twabonye ari hato dukurikije umubare w’abantu bacyitabira n’ubutumwa butangirwamo.’’ Umunyamakuru akaba n’Umuvugabutumwa Issa Noël Kalinijabo uri gutegura iki giterane cya “Youth Convention 2019’’ yavuze ko akenshi umuryango wa Teens For Christ ukorera mu bigo by’amashuri aho babwiriza ijambo ry’Imana. Aha kandi hanatangwa ubutumwa bwo kwirinda ibiyobyabwenge mu rubyiruko aho benshi babivaho burundu binyuze mu ijambo ry’Imana. Ati “Ijambo ry’Imana rigira imbaraga. Tujya  twakira ubuhamya bw’abana b’abanyeshuri bareka urumogi n’ibindi biyobyabwenge, bamwe bakatuganiriza. Dufite ingero nyinshi z’uburyo Imana igirira neza urubyiruko binyuze mu kumva ijambo ry’Imana.’’ Abazitabira Youth Convention 2019 bazagaburirwa ijambo ry’Imana n’abavugabutumwa barimo Felix Mushinzimana, Aminadab Mbanzabugabo n’Umunyamerika Pasiteri David Anderson. Kucyinjiramo byarorohejwe kuko ni ubuntu.

title: Gianadda watumiwe na Christus y’i Remera yageze mu Rwanda afite amashyushyu yo gusura i Kibeho(Amafoto)
content: Uyu muhanzi yageze i Kigali ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kane, mu masaha ya saa mbili ashyira saa tatu. Yavuze ko urugendo rwe kuva mu Bufaransa rwari rwiza. Yakiriwe n’itangazamakuru ndetse n’abagize iyi korali yamutumiye. Aganira n’itangazamakuru yavuze ko  asabwa kuza gutamira mu Rwanda yabyishimiye cyane, kuko yari amaze iminsi ataramira no mu bindi bihugu bya Afurika nka Sénégal, Madagascar , Togo na Bénin. Ati “Narabyemeye kuko nari mfite amatsiko yo kumenya byinshi byihariye  ku banyarwanda.” Yavuze ko yiteguye kuba yakorana indirimbo n’iyi korali yamutumiye mu Rwanda kuko ifite umuziki mwiza, kuko yagiye yumva indirimbo zayo mbere yo kuza. Ati “Mfite inzozi zo kugera i Kibeho ntabwo mpazi ariko ni ahantu h’umubyeyi Bikira Mariya. Nifuza ko umunsi umwe nazajya i Kibeho. Numvise abakobwa batatu bahaboneye ibonekerwa, nanjye ndifuza kugerayo.” Jean Claude Gianadda yavutse  mu 1944 mu Bufaransa[ubu afite imyaka 75]. Yabaye umwarimu wa Siyansi n’umuyobozi w’ ishuri rya Koreji Saint Bruno i Marseille mu Bufaransa kuva 1970 kugeza 1994.  Uyu muhanzi w’umunyabigwi yashyize hanze album ya mbere mu 1974 aho yafatanyaga kuririmba no kwigisha muri iyi koreji. Ku myaka 50 y’amavuko yaje gusezera ku mwuga  w’ubwarimu afata inzira yo  kuririmba nk’ubutumwa bwe bw’ibanze muri Kiriziya Gatolika. Jean Claude Gianadda nk’umuririmbyi, yakoze indirimbo nyinshi cyane zikubiye muri za Album zirenga 100. Ni abahanzi bacye ku Isi afite aka gahigo. Yaririmbye indirimbo zirimo  ‘Tiens Ma Lampe Allumée’, Jésus me voici devant toi’, ‘Trouver dans ma vie Ta présence’ n’izindi. Yashyize hanze album nka  ‘Qu’il est formidable d’aimer’, ‘Près de Toi Marie’ n’izindi. Yashinze umuryango witwa ‘Association Jeunesse et Culture Saint-Bruno’. Intego nyamukuru y’uwo muryango zigabanyije mu bice bibiri birimo icyo kwibanda ku guteza imbere indirimbo zisingiza Imana. Mu buzima busanzwe afasha abababaye haba mu gihugu cye kavukire ndetse n’ahandi ku isi yose. Iki gitaramo uyu musaza yatumiwemo kizabera muri Kigali Conference and Exhibition Village [Camp Kigali], tariki 5 Ukwakira 2019, kuva saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba. Kwinjira   bizaba ari 10 000 Frw mu myanya y’imbere ndetse na 5 000 Frw ahasigaye. Hari n’ikindi kizaba ku wa 06 Ukwakira 2019 mu gitambo cya Misa, kizabera kuri Paruwasi Regina Pacis i Remera kuva saa yine za mu gitondo. Korali Christus Regnat yashinzwe mu 2006, ivukira kuri Centre Christus i Remera mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Kuva mu 2008, ibarizwa kuri Paruwasi Regina Pacis i Remera. Ubu ifite imizingo itandatu y’indirimbo zabo mu buryo bw’amajwi, imaze gukora ibitaramo bikomeye bitatu. Amafoto: Muhizi Serge

title: Umuvugabutumwa Gakumba ufite ubumuga bwo kutabona yasezeranye n’umukunzi we mu mategeko (Amafoto na Video)
content: Isezerano rya Timoni n’umukunzi we ryahamirijwe mu buryo bwemewe n’amategeko mu Murenge wa Remera kuri uyu wa Kane, tariki ya 3 Ukwakira 2019. Ni ibirori byitabiriwe n’inshuti n’abavandimwe b’imiryango yombi n’abiganjemo abakirisitu bo ku Mudugudu wa ADEPR Remera abereye umuyobozi. Mwarimu Timoni umaranye ubumuga bwo kutabona imyaka isaga 64 akorera umurimo w’ivugabutumwa muri ADEPR. Izina rye ryamamaye cyane kubera ubuhanga afite mu kuvuga no gusobanura Bibiliya azi imirongo yayo myinshi mu mutwe ndetse n’indirimbo zo mu gitabo. Gakumba mu buhamya bwe avuga ko kumenya Bibiliya ari impano yahawe n’Imana kuko we yavutse afite ubumuga bwo kutabona. Gakumba yasezeranye na Zereyukuri nyuma yuko umugore we wa mbere yitabye Imana. Mu magambo y’aba bombi babwiye itangazamakuru ko bashimira Imana yabateje intambwe yo gushinga umuryango mushya. Gakumba yatangiye kubenguka Zereyukuri mu mwaka ushize ariko we amufungurira umutima we, anamwemerera kumubera urugingo mu ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka. Uyu muvugabutumwa yavuze ko Imana yamuhishuriye ko azabana na Zereyukuri basezeranye ndetse iby’urukundo rwabo ikabiha umugisha. Ati “Turashima Imana ko turi gusatira umunsi mwiza wo gukora ubukwe. Umunsi wa mbere twavuganye kuri telefoni, ndamusuhuza ndamubwira. Hari byinshi byagiye biba binyemeza ko dukwiye kubana kandi mugejejeho icyifuzo arabyemera.’’ Zereyukuri we yavuze ko “Imana yanshyizemo urukundo rwo kumukunda ndamwemera. Ni Imana yabikoze. Kuvuga yego ni ikintu kiba gikomeye guhita ubyakira. Yabimbwiye muri Gicurasi 2018 mbana nabyo nsenga ariko ku wa 23 Werurwe 2019 nibwo nikirije iryo jambo yambwiye, mwemerera ko tuzabana.’’ Gakumba na Zereyukuri bazasezerana imbere y’Imana ku wa Gatandatu, tariki ya 5 Ukwakira 2019. Uyu mugabo yagiriye icyizere Pasiteri Habyarimana Vedaste ngo azabe amugaragiye (Parrain). Yanateguriwe ibirori n’itorero rya ADEPR nkuko bikorerwa abandi bakozi b’Imana. Mu bukwe bwe hazaririmbamo korali zirimo Amahoro, Besalel na Elayono z’i Remera. Abanyetorero bagaragaje ibyishimo batewe n’intambwe Mwarimu Timoni yateye, akabona umukunzi nyuma y’ibibazo yanyuzemo. Timoni yavukiye mu yahoze ari Kibuye, i Gishyita mu 1955, avukana ubumuga bwo kutabona. Yakiriye agakiza mu 1979, aza gutangira kubwiriza muri Kigali mu 1981, ahawe ubutumwa n’Imana. Mu 1985 nibwo yatangiye umurimo w’ivugabutumwa i Remera akajya muri buri rugo kuvuga ubutumwa. Gakumba wakoze ubukwe mu 1993, yabyaranye n’umugore we wa mbere abana barindwi ariko umwe muri bo yitabye Imana. Amafoto: Niyonzima Moïse Video: Salomo George na Hakizimana Souke

title: Korali z’ubukombe i Kigali zahurijwe mu itangizwa ry’Iserukiramuco ‘Choir Fest’
content: Choir Fest Season 1 izahuza amatsinda n’amakorali atandatu, iteganyijwe kubera muri Serena Hotel, ku wa 6 Ukwakira 2019, kuva saa Cyenda z’amanywa. Iri serukiramuco rizajya riba buri mwaka ryateguwe na Sensitive Limited iyoborwa na Mugwema N Wilson afatanyije n’abandi bantu banyuranye. “Choir Fest” yatumiwemo Korali Ijwi ry’Impanda na Maranatha n’amatsinda amaze kwandika izina mu muziki uhimbaza Imana ya True Promises, Gisubizo Ministries, Healing Worship Team na Alarm Ministries. Abazacyitabira bazabwirizwa ijambo ry’Imana n’Umushumba Mukuru wa Foursquare Gospel Church, Bishop Dr Fidèle Masengo. Mu kiganiro IGIHE yagiranye na Mugwema Wilson yavuze ko ku nshuro ya mbere y’iri serukiramuco bifuje gukorana na korali zumvise icyerekezo cyabo ariko ko zizongerwa. Yagize ati “Twifuzaga kubona korali nyinshi ariko kubera ko ari ugutangira ntabwo byatworoheye. Mu yandi madini nka Kiliziya Gatolika twifuzaga kubona korali zabo ariko ntibyadukundiye ariko ubutaha zizaba zihari.” Amatsinda na korali zizitabira iri serukiramuco zizaririmba indirimbo zo mu gitabo, izayo za kera n’inshya ariko zakunzwe cyane. Mugwema  yavuze ko bifuza ko abantu benshi bakunda kandi bumvise izo ndirimbo bazongera kuzicurangirwa kandi bakanyurwa. Yagize ati “Abantu bazaze biteguye gufashwa no gukizwa. Bazanezerwa  ndetse banabone korali zabo bataramane.’’ Choir Fest biteganyijwe ko izajya iba buri mwaka mu Ukwakira ndetse izagezwa no mu bindi bice by’u Rwanda hanze y’Umujyi wa Kigali. Kwinjira muri iri serukiramuco ni ukwishyura 5 000 Frw mu myanya isanzwe, 10 000 Frw mu y’icyubahiro (VIP) na 20 000Frw mu myanya y’icyubahiro cy’ikirenga (VVIP).

title: Umudugudu wa ADEPR Mayange ugeze aharindimuka! Mutangana uwuyobora yashyizwe mu majwi
content: Muri ayo mashusho bamwe bagaragara bari hanze y’urusengero bategereje ko Pasiteri asohoka ngo bamubaze impamvu yashingiweho mu guhagarika bamwe mu badiyakoni [aba bakora imirimo itandukanye mu rusengero]. Umushumba wa Paruwasi ADEPR Mayange, Banganineza Emile ni we watangaje icyemezo cyo guhagarika abo badiyakoni, bari baranditse bagaragaza ko bafitanye ikibazo na Mwarimu w’Umudugudu Mutangana Emmanuel. Nyuma y’ayo makuru, umunyamakuru wa IGIHE yacukumbuye imvano y’ikibazo nyirizina kiri hagati ya Mutangana Emmanuel n’abayoboke bo muri ADEPR abereye umuyobozi.  	Imvano y’intungunda ku Mudugudu wa ADEPR muri Paruwasi Mayange Mutangana yahawe inshingano zo kuyobora Umudugudu wa ADEPR Mayange muri Mata 2017. Uyu mukozi w’Imana akigera ku buyobozi ngo yashatse gukora impinduka mu nzego zose ashyiraho ize bwite kuva ku bashinzwe inyubako, abadiyakoni,  abayobozi ba korali, ab’urubyiruko,  abahagarariye abagore n’abagabo n’abandi. Muri izo mpinduramatwara nibwo yatangiye gushyamirana n’abanyetorero batanejejwe n’iyo myanzuro n’uburyo yafashwemo. Muri Kamena 2019, abajyanama b’Inama Nyobozi y’Umudugudu banditse ibaruwa bamenyesha Paruwasi ya Mayange n’Itorero ry’Akarere ka Bugesera ibibazo bafite, banasaba ko Mutangana yimurwa. Ibaruwa bayishyikirije Pasiteri Bangananeza Emile uyobora Paruwasi ya Mayange. Nyuma y’amezi atatu yanditswe, Mutangana yatumije inama y’Umudugudu, yatangarijwemo ko abadiyakoni batandatu banditse ibaruwa imurega bahagaritswe ku murimo. Ibibazo bya Mutangana n’ab’i Mayange byarashibutse bigera no kuri Korali yitwa Alliance ikorera ivugabutumwa kuri uwo mudugudu ngo yabwiye ko itazagira amahoro akihabarizwa. Kuva mu myaka isaga ibiri, hari ibibazo byinshi byavutse ndetse bamwe mu bakirisitu bamushinje no kwitambika mu mibanire ya bamwe mu baririmbyi ashaka kubateranya. Muri bo hari n’abo ibihano byarangiye ariko ntibagarurwa mu murimo kugeza ubwo bandikiye ubuyobozi wa Paruwasi ya ADEPR Mayange ariko ntibigire icyo bitanga. Mu ibaruwa IGIHE ifitiye kopi hari aho uwari Umushumba w’Itorero ry’Akarere ka Bugesera, Rwigema Donatien asaba Umushumba wa Paruwasi ya Mayange gukemura ikibazo cy’umudiyakoni wahagaritswe, ibihano bye bigasozwa ntagarurwe mu nshingano. Hari amabaruwa menshi yagejejwe mu nzego za ADEPR ndetse abayanditse bahabwa icyemeza ko yakiriwe (copie de réception) ariko ntibasubizwa. Mu majwi yafatiwe mu nama y’abakirisitu ku wa 14 Nzeri 2019, hari abumvikana bavuga ko kuva Mutangana yagera i Mayange babuze amahwemo. Amakuru IGIHE ifite ni uko ubwo Mutangana yatangizaga inama, Umushumba wa Paruwasi Banganineza Emile yinjiye mu rusengero atanga itangazo ry’abahagaritswe. Umwe muri bo agira ati ‘‘Twinjiye mu itorero dusize hanze intambara n’ibibazo byari bihari, tuza tuzi ko duhungiye mu rusengero kuko tuhasanga amahoro ariko turugezemo dusanga nta mahoro ahari ahubwo hari intambara ziruta izo twasize hanze.’’ Mu ijambo rye, humvikanamo amajwi y’abakirisitu bamuvugiramo, akabasaba gutuza. Ati ‘‘Muduhaye amatangazo ariko adafite isura, adafite abantu muhagaritse imbere ngo abantu bababone. Narakubwiye nti ‘hejuru y’ibi mudukorera hari Imana izaca urubanza.’ Icya mbere uyu mudugudu ukimara kuwugeramo nta mahoro twagize. Ninjye wa mbere waciye, nasanze ntafite umwanya wo guhangana na we.’’ ‘‘Waje usanga ndi Perezida w’inyubako, narazamuye urusengero rugera hafi ya ‘Lenton’, unca umbwira ko ntari umudiyakoni ngo ndi umulayiki. Icya kabiri umusaza wampaye raporo na we waramuhagaritse nyamara raporo ihabwa perezida w’inyubako akayigushyikiriza. Icyo ni cyo mwapfuye, nta kindi.’’ Yakomeje avuga ko iyo abakirisitu bageze mu itorero riba ryungutse abantu ariko ubuyobozi bwa Mutangana bushimishwa no kubaca. Inama yabereyemo ibi biganiro yabaye mu mibyizi mu gihe abakirisitu basabye ko Inama Nyobozi yajya iba ku Cyumweru ku buryo n’abakozi ba leta bayitabira. Ati ‘‘Inama wayishyize mu mibyizi ngo ibitekerezo byawe ubivuge nta muntu wakuvuguruza.’’ Ubusanzwe mu Itorero rya ADEPR, umukirisitu waguye mu cyaha, ahanirwa mu ruhame imbere y’iteraniro ndetse abayoboke bakamenyeshwa ibyo yakoze nk’impamvu yo guhagarikwa kwe. Mu buhamya bwa bamwe bagaragaza ko hari abafatirwa mu byaha n’ubusambanyi  ntibahanwe, ahubwo ababivuze akaba aribo bakanirwa urubakwiye. Umwe mu baciwe muri ADEPR ku Mudugudu wa Mayange avuga ko ‘‘Abantu mwaciye ntimugaragaze icyo bakoze, abakirisitu baragenda bavuga ngo iki? Agahinda dufite Imana izakatumara. Hari igihe kizagera ukagenda, hakaza abandi mutavuga kimwe, mudakora kimwe. Ntuzatura aha nk’umusozi.’’ Yavuze ko icyifuzo abakirisitu bafite ari ukugira amahoro mu nzu y’Imana kuko baje bifuza kuhakirira. Mutangana yakunze kwiyegereza abantu bamubwira amagambo yamuvuzweho ku buryo uwo badahuje ngo ashakirwa impamvu zo kumuhagarika mu itorero. Umwe mu batifuje ko amazina ye atangazwa yagaragaje ko yashatse kumuteranya n’umugore we ariko agasanga urugo rwe rudadiye. Ati ‘‘Uburyo yakoresheje ngo agere kuri ibyo ni iterabwoba. Yatangiye atubwira ko yatumwe aho rukomeye. Avuga ko i Mayange ari iwe nta wavuguruza icyo avuze n’icyo akoze. Yigambaga ko yaje guhangana n’abakirisitu b’i Mayange bigize abanyabwenge.’’ Mutangana kandi hari abamushinja gufata bimwe mu byemezo akabyitirira Inama nyobozi. Abayobozi bose bayoboye Paruwasi ya Mayange, Itorero ry’Akarere ka Bugesera kugeza ku Rurembo rw’Iburasirazuba  nta wakemuye icyo kibazo.  	Ubuyobozi bw’itorero buvuga iki kuri iki kibazo? IGIHE yagerageje kuvugana na Mwarimu  Mutangana Emmanuel ariko avuga ko hari inzego zishinzwe gutanga amakuru. Yagize ati “Ntacyo nabivugaho. Hari abashinzwe kuvugana n’itangazamakuru bagira icyo batangaza.’’ Umushumba w’Itorero ry’Akarere ka Bugesera, Masumbuko Josué, umaze ukwezi ahawe inshingano zo kuhayobora yavuze ko icyo kibazo nakimenya azagikurikirana. Yagize ati “Ndi mushya mu Bugesera ku buryo hari paruwasi ntarageramo ndetse hari abashumba tutarahura. I Mayange narahateraniye ariko nabonye nta kibazo kidasanzwe gihari. Iyo dusanze hari ibibazo nk’ibyo hari uburyo tubikemura. Nabwiwe ko hari ibaruwa abadiyakoni banditse ariko ntabwo ndayibona. Ninyibona tuzakurikiza uburyo busanzwe bw’itorero bwo gukemura ikibazo.’’ Umudugudu wa Paruwasi ya ADEPR Mayange ubarizwaho abakirisitu basaga 700. Abemeramana bahateranira bavuga ko ibibazo bihari byagize ingaruka ku bwitabire bw’abinjira mu rusengero kuko bamwe bagiye bigendera ahandi.

title: Munyakazi Deo yatunguriwe mu gitaramo cya Pasiteri Gaudin yifurizwa isabukuru (Amafoto)
content: Iki gitaramo cy’ijoro ryo kwegerana n’Imana cyiswe “Night of Worship” cyateguwe na Pasiteri Mutagoma afatanyije n’Umuryango w’Ivugabutumwa wa New Seed. Cyabereye kuri Eglise Vivante Kanogo ku wa Gatanu, tariki 27 Nzeri 2019. Abacyitabiriye kuva saa mbiri kugeza saa Saba z’ijoro banyuzwe n’ubutumwa bwagitangiwemo bunyuze mu bihangano by’abahanzi barimo René Patrick, Deo Munyakazi, New Life Worship Team na Korali El Shaddai. Ijambo ry’Imana ryagabuwe na Pasiteri Désiré Habyarimana watanze ubutumwa buvuga ku bikwiye kubaho mu buzima buramya Imana. Pasiteri Mutagoma ubarizwa mu Itorero rya New Jerusalem yanyuze benshi mu bihangano bye byakunzwe birimo “Akanyabugabo”, “Ntundeka”, “Baratungurwa” na “Mfite ishimwe.” Ahagana saa tanu z’ijoro nibwo Umukirigitananga Munyakazi Deo yageze ku rubyiniro. Yari aherekejwe na mushiki Niyifasha Esther. Aba bombi bashimishije benshi mu bitabiriye igitaramo binyuze mu murya w’inanga wakirigitwaga na Munyakazi n’ijwi rye yahuzaga n’iry’umuvandimwe we rigatanga uburyohe mu matwi y’abaryumva. Yageze ku ndirimbo “Urakwiriye Mwami’’, abari mu rusengero batera hejuru baririmba iyo kumwifuriza isabukuru nziza y’amavuko. Uyu musore utaganjwe n’amarangamutima yahise ababwira ati “Murakoze cyane’’, akomeza kuririmba. Munyakazi wujuje imyaka 28 abonye izuba yabwiye IGIHE ko yishimiye urukundo yeretswe ku isabukuru ye y’amavuko. Yagize ati “Nakiriye ubutumwa buturutse ku ncuti zanjye ziri mu Rwanda no hanze. Nongeye kwishimira umugisha w’abantu Imana yampaye mu buzima. Ni iby’igiciro gikomeye kuri njye kuba hari umuntu wafata umwanya we akanzirikana akanyifuriza ibyiza.’’ Yakomeje ati “Kuririmbirwa n’itorero ryose ririmo abashumba n’abakirisitu mu gitaramo nabyo byankoze ku mutima.’’ Deo Munyakazi uheruka gusohora indirimbo ikangurira Abanyarwanda kwitabira Umuganda, ari gutegura ibindi bihangano bitandukanye. Uyu muhanzi ari gusoza Icyiciro cya Gatatu cya Kaminuza mu Ishami ry’Ibijyanye n’Imiyoborere mu by’Ubukungu ‘Business Administration’ muri Kaminuza ya Kigali. Munyakazi ni umwe mu bahanga mu gukirigita umurya w’inanga gakondo y’Abanyarwanda mu bakibyiruka, abikora nk’umunyempano wabyize akiri muto. Yacuranze mu bitaramo bikomeye yishimirwa na benshi, ni umwe mu bigishijwe n’umusaza Mushabizi wamenyekanye mu nanga yitwa “Zaninka”. Uyu musore iyo yivuga agira ati “Ndi mwene Habihirwe wa Mukorukarabe wa Kidende cya Mutarataza wa Zirimwabagabo wa Kagirimpa ka Mpanga.’’ Yakoranye indirimbo n’abahanzi bakomeye barimo Umwongereza, Joscelyn Eve Stoker [Joss Stone]. Azwi mu zirimo “Emirembe”, “Italanto”, “Urakwiriye Mwami’’ na “Isoko dusangiye” yumvikanamo inanga ye na saxophone yashyizwemo n’Umwongereza Scott Woods ubizobereyemo. Mu rugendo rwe rwa muzika, yitabiriye amaserukiramuco atandukanye arimo iry’i Paris aho yatumiwe mu gitaramo ‘Le Printemps des Poètes’; mu Budage yatoranyijwe mu bahanzi 10 bafite umwihariko kandi batanga icyizere muri muzika ku Isi.  	Munyakazi Deo aheruka gusohora indirimbo yise "Twitabire umuganda”  	Reba hano igitaramo Deo Munyakazi yatunguriwemo

title: Yayeli, ishyiga ry’inyuma muri Kingdom of God Ministries yasezeranye mu mategeko
content: Umuhango wo gusezerana imbere y’amategeko wabereye mu murenge wa Kagarama mu Karere ka Kicukiro mu Mujyi wa Kigali, baherekejwe n’inshuti n’imiryango yabo; bose bafite akanyamuneza. Yayeli agaragara atera mu ndirimbo nyinshi zirimo na “Nzamuhimbaza” iri no mu zamenyekanye cyane mu z’iri tsinda. Muri “Victorious Live Concert”, igitaramo cyateguwe na Kingdom of God Ministries cyabereye kuri Christian Life Assembly (CLA) i Nyarutarama ku wa 16 Nzeri 2018, Rukundo yamwambitse impeta amusaba kuzamubera umugore. Icyo gihe igitaramo kigana ku musozo, Rukundo yasatiriye aho abaririmbyi bari bahagaze imbere y’imbaga, apfukama imbere y’umukunzi we amusaba kubana akaramata. Na we ntiyazuyaje yahise amubwira “Yego.” Bamwe mu bari ahabereye igitaramo barabyishimiye, abandi bavugira mu matamatama ko bitari bikwiye kubera mu nzu y’Imana. Rukundo yatangarije IGIHE ko gutungurira umukunzi we mu rusengero ari uko bose bavuka mu miryango ikikijwe. Yagize ati “Yayeli ni umukozi w’Imana, si umunyonzi, si n’umukinnyi w’umupira! Ni umukozi w’Imana uririmba. Nanjye mvuka mu muryango w’abapasiteri. Twakuriye mu rusengero. Ni Imana yaduhuje.” Urukundo  rwa Producer Rukundo w’imyaka 30 na Yayeli rwatangiye kuvugwa mu 2017. Mu Ugushyingo Yayeli yifurije umukunzi we isabukuru y’amavuko ashimangira ko ari amahitamo mu buzima bwe bwose. Niyitegeka w’imyaka 24 asengera muri Eglise Vivante i Kabuga. Yatangiye kuririmba akiri muto. Yakuriye muri korali ndetse yanyuze mu itsinda “The Queens” ry’abakobwa bihariye mu kuririmba ryashinzwe na Aline Gahongayire. Reba indirimbo yitwa Nzamuhimbaza, yatewe na Yayeli

title: Holy Recall Worship Ministry yo muri EAR yatangije umushinga wa album nshya
content: Holy Recall Worship Ministry ikorera umurimo w’ivugabutumwa rinyuze mu ndirimbo muri Paruwasi ya Kacyiru muri Angilikani aho ryatangiriye muri Kanama 2018. Ni itsinda ryashinzwe n’abaririmbyi b’ingeri zitandukanye bahurije ku ntego yo kongera guhuriza ku muhamagaro wo gukorera Imana ariko hibandwa ku butumwa bunyuze mu ndirimbo. Indirimbo ya mbere y’amashusho iri tsinda ryageneye abakunzi b’ibihangano bihimbaza Imana yitwa “Azakuraho’’. Ubutumwa buri muri iyi ndirimbo y’iminota ine n’amasegonda 22 bugaruka ku kugaragaza ko Imana ariyo ifite ubushobozi bwo gukuraho ibivuna abantu. Hari agace kayo kavuga kati “Azakuraho ibituvuna ndamwizeye azabikora.’’ Umuyobozi wa Holy Recall Worship Ministry, Irihose Martin, yabwiye IGIHE ko iyi ndirimbo iryoheye amatwi yabimburiye izindi ziri gutunganywa. Yagize ati “Ni umushinga mugari dutangije wo kwamamaza ubutumwa bwiza binyuze mu kuramya no guhimbaza Imana.’’ Indirimbo nshya ya Holy Recall Worship Ministry ni iya mbere mu zizaba zikubiye kuri album iri tsinda ritegura kumurikira abakunzi baryo mu gitaramo gikomeye giteganyijwe ku wa 3 Ugushyingo 2019. Iki gitaramo cyatumiwemo amatsinda azwi mu ruhando rw’indirimbo zihimbaza Imana arimo True Promises, Tabernacle, Abacunguwe na APKF ihuriyemo abana bavuka ku bapasiteri bo mu Itorero ry’Abangilikani. Holy Recall Worship Ministry itozwa n’umuhanzi Ezra Joas uri mu bakunzwe cyane mu muziki uhimbaza Imana by’umwihariko mu njyana ya Lumba na Blues. Uyu yamamaye akorera umuziki mu Karere ka Musanze. Yakoze indirimbo zakunzwe zirimo iyitwa ‘Niyo’ yafatanyije na Aline Gahongayire. Reba hano indirimbo nshya ya Holy Recall Worship Ministry yitwa "Azahoraho"

title: Paruwasi ya Rwamagana yizihije Yubile y’imyaka 100
content: Byabaye kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki 21 Nzeri, mu birori byabanjirijwe n’umutambagiro mutagatifu n’igitambo cya Misa byitabiriwe n’abayobozi batandukanye haba mu nzego za leta no mu buyobozi bukuru bwa Kiliziya. Byabereye  imbere y’iyi Kiliziya iherereye mu mujyi wa Rwamagana,  byitabirwa n’abasenyeri barimo Arikiyepisikopi wa Kigali Musenyeri Antoine Kambanda, Musenyeri Filipo  Rukamba wa Butare, Musenyeri Anaclet Mwumvaneza wa Nyundo, Musenyeri Kizito Bahujimihogo. Hari kandi Guverineri Mufulukye Fred, Senateri Mukabaramba Alvera n’abandi bayobozi bakuru bo mu nzego za leta. Kiliziya ya Rwamagana yaragijwe umwamikazi w’imitsindo, iherereye muri Diyosezi ya Kibungo, ikaba ari iya 12 mu zashinzwe bwa mbere mu Rwanda nyuma ya Save yashinzwe mu 1900, Zaza, Nyundo, Rwaza, Mibirizi, Kabgayi, Runda, Rulindo, Kansi, Kigali na Rambura. Yihariye amateka arimo kubyara izindi paruwasi  zikomeye cyane zirimo nka Kiziguro, Musha, Mukarange, Rukara n’izindi. Yihariye kandi amateka yo kubakwa mu butaka bwari ubw’umutware wategekaga igice cy’ubuganza witwaga Rwabutogo Francisco akaba yaranayitundiye amatafari mu gihe yubakwagwa. Mu ijambo yagejeje ku bakristu bitabiriye uyu muhango, Arikiyepisikopi wa Kigali akanaba n’umuyobozi wa Diyosezi ya Kibungo Antoine Kambanda, yashimiye abakristu bitabiriye uyu muhango abasaba gukomeza kwita ku muryango ngo kuko ariwo Kiliziya ya mbere y’umuntu. Yakomeje avuga ko ijambo ry’Imana ryabibwe muri iyi Paruwasi ryagize imbuto nyinshi, abakristu benshi bakomeje kwamamaza ubutumwa bwiza abahabwa amasakaramentu bariyongera. Ahereye kuri ibyo, yasabye abakristu gukomeza kwerera imbuto nziza abandi ari nako bakomeza  iyogezabutumwa. Yashimiye Umukuru w’Igihugu ku nkunga yahaye iyi Kiliziya yo kubakorera neza imbuga yayo mu mwaka wa 2009 ubwo yahasengeraga kuri Noheri, anashimira abakristu ku bwitange bwakomeje kubaranga ubwo bateguraga uyu munsi mukuru. Guverineri w’intara y’iburasirazuba, Mufulukye Fred yashimiye ubufatanye buranga amadini n’amatorero atandukanye akorera muri iyi ntara, ashimira ubuyobozi bwa Kiliziya ku kuba bafatanya mu kuzamura imibereho y’abaturage biciye mu buvuzi aho bubatse ibitaro bikuru bya Rwamagana, mu mashuri  bafite ibigo umunani bitanga uburezi ndetse no mu bindi bikorwa. Mufulukye yasabye abakristu  gukomeza gufatanya n’ubuyobozi gukuraho ibibazo bibangamiye imibereho myiza y’abaturage. Ati “ Ndabasaba ngo dufatanye gufasha abaturage tugifite bafite ibibazo bibangamiye imibereho myiza yabo birimo amacumbi ashaje, abadafite ubwiherero, imirire mibi n’ibindi.” Kuri ubu Paruwasi ya Rwamagana ifite abakiristo babarirwa bagera ku 15 901 bayibarizwamo. Kuvugurura iyi kiliziya byakozwe n’abakiristo nyuma y’imyaka 100 yubatswe,  ngo byabatwaye arenga miliyoni 72 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Kiliziya ya Rwamagana ni imwe  mu zakomotsemo abapadiri benshi aho kugeza ubu ababarirwa muri 22 bayivukamo barimo na Musenyeri Kizito Bahujimihigo wigeze kuyobora diyosezi ya Kibungo.
