title: Kolari Urumuri yakoze igitaramo cyomoye imitima ya benshi i Rwamagana
content: Ni igiterane cyabohoye imitima ya benshi bafata umwanzuro wo kwakira no Kwemera Yesu Kristo nk’Umwami n’umucunguzi  w’ubugingo bwabo. Iki giterane cyatumiwemo izindi Kolari  zirimo Jehovanisi na korari Elayo zo muri Paruwasi ya Muyumbu. Higishijwe ijambo ry’Imana  riri mu Byakozwe n’intumwa ibice 10:34-35,” aho Petero aterura  amagambo agira  ati “Ni ukuri menye y’uko Imana itarobanura ku butoni,ahubwo mu mahanga yose uyubaha agakora ibyogukiranuka iramwemera.” Abigisha b’ijambo ry’Imana Rev.Nkundimana Hobes uyobora Umudugudu wa Rukurazo na Ev.Bagabo Jean Bosco, bagarutse kuri iri  jambo, babwira Abakristo n’abashyitsi bari bitabiriye  ko Imana igira neza kandi itarobanura abantu ku butoni. Rev.Nkundimana yagize ati “Imana iyo ijya gukora ntigendera ku bukire cyangwa ubukene, ntiyita ku muntu bitewe n’aho aturuka  ku mugabane runaka. Ntiyita ku burebure cyangwa ubufufi ahubwo  yita ku muntu uyubaha akanakora  imirimo myiza yo gukiraka.” Muri iki giterane benshi bakiriye Yesu nk’umwami n’umukiza, hanabaho kwitanga ngo hagurwe ibyuma by’umuziki bizifashishwa na Kolari Simuruna yo muri Muyumbu ari nayo yagize uruhare mu gutegura igiterane. Kolari Urumuri izwi mu ndirimbi nka Nzahimbaza,Abafite ubwoba nibushire, Narikure,Imirimo n’ibindi.

title: Umuhanzi Papi Clever yatangije umushinga wo gushyingirwa (Amafoto)
content: Papi Clever n’umukunzi we berekanywe bwa mbere imbere y’abakirisitu kuri iki Cyumweru, tariki ya 15 Nzeri 2019, mu muhango wabereye muri ADEPR Paruwasi ya Muhoza aho umukobwa akomoka. Aba bombi bari bagaragiwe n’inshuti n’abavandimwe baniganjemo abenshi baturutse mu Mujyi wa Kigali bishimiye intambwe y’ibanze bateye mu rugendo rwo kurushinga.  Papi Clever yabengutse Ingabire bahuje umuhamagaro we na we ari umuramyi. Uyu mukobwa ufite ijwi ryiza yanyuze muri Korali Goshen ikorera ivugabutumwa muri ADEPR Musanze. Nyuma yo kwimukira i Kigali, Ingabire ari gukora igeragezwa muri Korali Hoziana yo muri ADEPR Nyarugenge iri mu zifite ibigwi kuko iri mu zatangijwe mbere muri iryo torero. Biteganyijwe ko ku Cyumweru gitaha [ku wa 22 Nzeri 2019] aribwo Papi Clever na Ingabire aribwo bazerekanwa imbere y’abakirisitu b’aho uyu musore asengera muri ADEPR Ntora muri serivisi y’abakoresha indimi z’amahanga. Umuryango wa Papi Clever wavuye mu Karere ka Musanze umufatiye irembo. Azasaba anakwe Ingabire mu birori bizaba ku wa 30 Ugushyingo mu gihe azasezerana imbere y’Imana ku wa 7 Ukuboza 2019. Izina rya Papi Clever uyobora Ntora Worship Team ibarizwa muri ADEPR rimaze igihe ryumvikana mu bakunzi b’ibihangano byahimbiwe Imana. Yakoze indirimbo nyinshi zirimo “Ugendane Nanjye”, ‘‘Narakwiboneye’’, ‘‘Uburyohe’’, ‘‘Ahari Kurira’’, “Utwumvire”, "Uvuze Yego", "Uri uwo Kwizerwa" na “Impamvu z’Ibifatika’’ aheruka gushyira hanze. Muri iyi minsi akunzwe cyane kubera umushinga w’indirimbo zo mu Gitabo yatangiye gusubiramo akazazisoza uko ari 547. Album ya mbere z’izi ndirimbo yayise “Amakuru y’Umurwa” ikubiyeho indirimbo 12 zo mu gitabo.  	Incamake ku mateka ya Papi Clever Papi Clever yavukiye i Rusizi ku wa 18 Nzeri 1992; avuka kuri Nzeyimana Elie na Mushonganono Jeanne. Se yaje gupfa muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ubwo yari afite imyaka ibiri gusa. Yasigaranye na nyina, amurerana n’abandi bavandimwe babiri; mukuru we na murumuna we. Uyu musore nubwo yakuriye mu buzima bugoye n’umuryango we yakuze akunda gusenga Imana cyane, byaje kuvamo kuririmba muri korali zitandukanye zo mu itorero rya ADEPR. Yatangiye kuririmba yiga mu wa Gatanu w’amashuri abanza muri korali y’abakuze baramurera akuriramo atyo. Papi Clever amashuri abanza yayize ahantu henshi ku bigo bigera kuri birindwi bitewe n’uko umuryango we wakundaga kwimuka. Mu Cyiciro Rusange yize mu Rutobwe mu Karere ka Kamonyi, asoreza ayisumbuye muri Aparude Ruhango aho yakurikiye Ishami rya Computer & Electronics. Kaminuza yayize mu Ishuri rikuru ry’Imyuga n’Ubumenyingiro rya Kigali (IPRC). Yarangije amashuri yisumbuye ajya kwiga umuziki muri Kigali Music School mu 2012 ariho yanatangiriye umuziki nk’umwuga mu 2014. Yagiye yandika indirimbo nyinshi zirimo n’iza Hyssop Choir yo muri ADEPR Kiruhura aho yazamukiye, nyuma aza no gutangira kwandika ize bwite.  	Reba hano indirimbo Papi Clever yitiriye album y’indirimbo zo mu Gitabo yitwa “Amakuru y’Umurwa”  	Impamvu z’Ibifatika ni yo ndirimbo Papi Clever aheruka gusohora

title: Rubavu: Abayobozi b’umudugudu na se w’umwana bakurikiranyweho guhishira uwamusambanyije akamutera inda
content: RIB yatangaje ko abatawe muri yombi ari Abayobozi b’Umudugudu wa Kiruhura mu Murenge wa Cyanzarwe mu Karere ka Rubavu ari bo Niyigaba François wari Umuyobozi w’Umudugudu, Niyonzima Pierre Célestin ushinzwe Ubuhinzi, Ntizihabose Gilbert ushinzwe Iterambere na Hakizimana David ushinzwe Umutekano. Abo bafatanywe na Ndimukaga Jean Baptiste, se w’umwana wasambanyijwe akanaterwa inda. Mu butumwa yanyujije kuri Twitter, RIB yakomeje iti “Aba bakekwaho kunga umuryango w’uwasambanyije umwana n’umuryango w’umwana mu rwego rwo guhishira icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana.” “RIB irongera kwibutsa Abanyarwanda cyane cyane abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze ndetse n’ababyeyi, ko guhishira icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana bunga umuryango w’uwakoze icyaha n’uw’uwagikorewe ari icyaha gihanwa n’amategeko.” RIB yashishikarije buri muturarwanda kwihutira gutanga amakuru igihe cyose amenye ko icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana cyakozwe kugira ngo gicike burundu mu gihugu cyacu. Ingingo ya 36 y’itegeko rikumira kandi rihana ihohoterwa iryo ari ryo ryose rishingiye ku gitsina ivuga ko uwanga gutabara uwahohotewe cyangwa uwanga gutanga ubuhamya ku ihohoterwa iteganya ko uhamijwe icyo cyaha, ahanishwa igifungo kuva ku mezi atandatu kugeza ku myaka ibiri n’ihazabu y’amafaranga kuva ku bihumbi mirongo itanu kugeza ku bihumbi magana abiri cyangwa kimwe muri ibyo bihano.

title: Abakerarugendo bahawe imyaka ibiri yo guhindura amatariki yo gusura pariki kubera Coronavirus
content: Iri tangazo ryashyizwe hanze kuri uyu wa Mbere nyuma y’uko inzego zitandukanye zikomeje gufata ingamba zo guhashya Coronavirus iri guhitana imbaga hirya no hino ku Isi. Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima (WHO) ryatangaje ko COVID-19 ari icyorezo gihangayikishije Isi ndetse mu kwirinda ko cyagera mu Rwanda hafashwe ingamba zifatika. Inama y’Abaminisitiri yo ku wa 6 Werurwe “yemeje gushyira ingufu mu kugikumira no guhangana nacyo harimo gukomeza gukangurira abaturage gukurikiza inama zo kucyirinda, kwitabaza inzego z’ubuzima mu gihe hari ugaragayeho kimwe mu bimenyetso biranga icyo cyorezo no kugabanya ingendo n’inama zitari ngombwa hanze n’imbere mu gihugu.” Iki gikorwa kiyobowe na Serivisi za Minisitiri w’Intebe, Minisiteri y’Ubuzima, iy’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu n’Inzego z’umutekano. Itangazo Minisitiri w’Intebe Dr Edouard Ngirente yashyizeho umukono ku wa 6 Werurwe 2020, rivuga ko mu rwego rwo kwirinda no gukumira Coronavirus, u Rwanda rwifashisha camera ku Kibuga Mpuzamahanga cy’Indege cya Kigali i Kanombe mu gutahura uyiketsweho. Coronavirus ni icyorezo cyatangiriye mu Bushinwa mu mpera z’Ukuboza 2019. Muri icyo gihugu abamaze kucyandura ni 80 859, mu gihe abapfuye ari 3 100. Hanze y’u Bushinwa hamaze kwandura abantu 25 208 ndetse abagera kuri 500 bamaze gupfa. Kugeza ubu mu Rwanda nta murwayi wa Coronavirus urahagaragara. Mu itangazo rya RDB ryashyizweho umukono n’Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere kuri uyu wa 9 Werurwe 2020, rivuga ko na “Serivisi z’ubukerarugendo zikomeje gutangwa nk’ibisanzwe mu gihugu hose.’’ RDB yashyize hanze amabwiriza azagenderwaho mu gihe hari abakerarugendo bashaka gusubika cyangwa kwimura ingendo zabo. Iryo tangazo rivuga ko “Hakuweho uburyo umuntu yamenyeshaga mbere y’iminsi irindwi kugira ngo asure pariki; hakuweho iminsi 30 yagenwaga ngo ikigo gitembereza ba mukerarugendo kibe cyamenyekanishije ko bishyuye.’’ Rikomeza riti “Abakerarugendo bifuza gusubika uruhushya baguze rwo gusura pariki kubera ihagarikwa ry’ingendo z’indege cyangwa bakumiriwe gukora ingendo ahantu runaka bitewe na Coronavirus bafite igihe cy’imyaka ibiri yo kwimura itariki bari bafashe bidasabye ikindi kiguzi; abaguze impushya zo gusura pariki mu mezi atabamo ba mukerarugendo benshi bashobora guhindura igihe bagombaga gusurira ingagi, bagahitamo ikindi gihe nk’icyo bitarenze imyaka ibiri. Abakerarugendo bagombaga kwitabira inama baguze impushya ku giciro kigabanyijwe na bo bemerewe kwigiza inyuma impushya baguze bakaba bazikoresha mu kindi gihe bahitamo mu myaka ibiri.’’ Iri tangazo rigaragaza ko uburenganzira bwatanzwe mu gihe butarahindurwa bwemerewe gukoreshwa mu gihe cy’amezi atandatu uhereye igihe ryashyiriweho umukono kandi urwo ruhushya rugakoreshwa mu myaka ibiri. Public notice for tourism and travel stakeholders on COVID-19 (Corona Virus) 👇🏽. #VisitRwanda pic.twitter.com/JIAsyziVI6 — Rwanda Development Board (@RDBrwanda) March 9, 2020 Mu ngamba u Rwanda rwafashe mu gukumira Coronavirus harimo gushishikariza Abanyarwanda kwirinda kuramukanya abantu bahana ibiganza no guhoberana, kugabanya ingendo zitari ngombwa mu bihugu byagaragayemo icyo cyorezo. Hari kandi kwirinda gukorora cyangwa kwitsamura iruhande rw’abandi, gukaraba intoki hakoreshejwe amazi asukuye cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo gusukura intoki, kwirinda kwegera abandi igihe cyose warwaye ibicurane, inkorora cyangwa ufite umuriro mwinshi. Umujyi wa Kigali na wo kuva ku wa 8 Werurwe wasubitse ibikorwa byose bihuriza abantu benshi ahantu hamwe birimo ibitaramo by’imyidagaduro n’ibindi birori bihuza abantu benshi nk’imurikagurisha, imurikabikorwa, umutambagiro n’ibindi. Coronavirus yandurira mu matembabuzi, igafata imyanya y’ubuhumekero ku buryo yica umuntu imuteye umusonga. Uburyo bw’ibanze mu kuyirinda ni ukugira isuku binyuze mu gukaraba intoki n’amazi meza n’isabune, cyangwa gukoresha alcool yica udukoko. Nta muti wa Coronavirus cyangwa urukingo bizwi, igikomeje kwifashishwa ni ukuvura ibimenyetso byayo gusa. Icyizere ariko kigenda kizamuka kuko mu Bashinwa bari baranduye iyi coronavirus, abagera ku 57 143 barayikize.

title: Umugore wa mbere yagizwe Brigadier Général mu gisirikare cya Guinée ku munsi wabahariwe
content: Sylla yahawe iryo peti kuri iki Cyumweru tariki 8 Werurwe ku munsi Mpuzamahanga wahariwe abagore. Mu muhango kwizihiza uwo munsi, Perezida Alpha Condé yavuze ko agiye gushyira imbaraga mu kuzamura uruhare rw’umugore mu iterambere ry’icyo gihugu. Brig Gen Sylla yize mu ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare mu Bushinwa, aho yakuye impamyabushobozi mu mwaka wa 2014. Mu mwaka wa 2017, yagizwe umuyobozi wungirije w’inama y’igihugu ishinzwe umutekano. Yanagiye mu bikorwa bya Loni byo kugarura amahoro muri Côte d’Ivoire (UNOCI). Igisirikare cya Guinée cyatangaje ko Sylla yazamuwe mu ntera hashingiwe ku busabe bwa Minisiteri y’Ingabo.

title: Uganda: Abapolisikazi bakuriweho gusaba uburenganzira bwo gushyingiranwa n’umusivile
content: Muri aya mavugurura kandi abapolisikazi bo mu rwego rwo hejuru ntibazongera gusuhuzwa hakoreshejwe ijambo ‘Sir’. Mu bindi byemejwe ni uko impuzankano za Polisi ya Uganda zigiye gusubirwamo nyuma y’aho bigaragariye ko abagore bambaraga amapantalo adoze nk’ay’abagabo. Kuba umupolisikazi wo muri Uganda washakaga gushyingiranwa n’umusivile yabanzaga gusaba uruhushya, biteganywa n’amabwiriza yo 1984. Umuyobozi Wungirije wa Polisi ya Uganda, Asan Kasingye, yabwiye Daily Monitor ko barangije kuvugurura aya mategeko wasanganga ahanini atsikamira abagore. Ati “Mu mategeko ariho agenga polisi aheruka kuvugururwa mu 1984, umupolisikazi yagombaga gusaba uruhushya umuyobozi mukuru wa polisi kugira ngo ashyingiranwe n’umusivile, umupolisikazi yafatwaga nka ‘Sir’, izi ngingo zose zivangura zakuwe mu mategeko avuguruye azashyirwa ku mugaragaro mu kwezi gutaha.” Izi mpinduka kandi zizaha abapolisikazi amahirwe yo kujya mu myanya yo hejuru, kuko n’ubwo ijanisha ryabo muri polisi ringana na 20%, abenshi ni abapolisi bato. Batandatu bonyine nibo bafite ipeti rya komiseri gusubiza hejuru.

title: Perezida wa Portugal yashyizwe mu kato kubera Coronavirus
content: Ibiro ntaramakuru by’u Bushinwa, Xinhua, bivuga ko itangazo ryashyizwe hanze kuri iki Cyumweru rigaragaza ko Perezida Rebelo yasuwe n’itsinda ry’abanyeshuri baturutse mu majyaruguru ya Portugal, ku wa Kabiri w’icyumweru gishize. Umwe muri abo banyeshuri byaje kwemezwa n’abaganga ko afite Coronavirus, ndetse n’ishuri yigamo rirafungwa. Perezida Rebelo yemeye igitekerezo cy’inzego z’ubuzima cyo kuba ashyizwe mu kato mu rugo rwe mu gihe cy’ibyumweru bibiri, nk’uko byanditse muri iri tangazo. Abaganga bemeza ko muri icyo gihe aribwo umuntu aba amaze kugaragaza ibimenyetso iyo yanduye. Itangazo rigira riti "Perezida wa Repubulika yumvise inzego z’ubuzima nubwo nta kimenyetso na kimwe afite, afata umwanzuro wo guhagarika gahunda z’akazi mu gihe cy’ibyumweru bibiri biri imbere… muri iki gihe aho Abanyaportugal bagaragaza ubumwe bwo hejuru mu maso ya Coronavirus, Perezida wa Repubulika arabizi ko agomba gutanga urugero rukomeye mu kwirinda." Ku wa 8 Werurwe muri iki gihugu hari hamaze kugaragara abantu bashya icyenda  banduye Coronavirus, biyongera kuri 21 bari baramaze kwandura.

title: Minisitiri w’Intebe wa Sudani yarokotse igitero mu murwa mukuru Khartoum
content: Televiziyo y’igihugu ya Sudani yatangaje ko uku guturika kwabaye ahagana saa tatu za mu gitondo, mu majyaruguru ya Khartoum. Mu itangazo ryatanzwe n’ibiro bya Minisitiri w’Intebe, hemejwe ko nta muntu n’umwe wari mu bamuherekeje wakomerekeye muri icyo gitero. Umuyobozi w’ibi biro Ali Bakhit yagize ati "Uku guturika kwabayeho ubwo imodoka ya Minisitiri w’Intebe Abdalla Hamdok yari mu nzira, ariko turashima Imana ko nta muntu n’umwe wakomeretse." Minisitiri w’Intebe yahise ajyanwa ahantu hatekanye, aho acungiwe umutekano. Nta rwego cyangwa agatsiko karigamba kugaba icyo gitero. Dr Hamdok aheruka gushingwa kuyobora Guverinoma ya Sudani nyuma y’amasezerano yagezweho hagati y’abasivili - bari bamaze igihe mu myigaragambyo - n’inama nkuru ya gisirikare yari ifite ubutegetsi, nyuma yo gukuraho Omar al-Bashir utari wishimiwe n’abaturage. Guverinoma ayoboye ikubiye mu masezerano y’imyaka itatu y’inzibacyuho, ndetse uyu mugabo w’imyaka 66 yitezweho byinshi cyane mu kuzahura ubukungu bwa Sudani, imwe mu ngingo yagejeje ubutegetsi bwa Bashir ku iherezo.

title: Ibyo wamenya ku muhanda w’urupfu wigeze kujya upfiramo abasaga 300 buri mwaka
content: Ni umuhanda ufite uburebure bwa kirometero 60, ukaba uherereye mu gace kitwa Yungas, mu gihugu cya Bolivia giherereye mu Burengerazuba bwo hagati bw’umugabane wa Amerika y’Epfo. Niwo muhanda uhuza La Paz cyangwa Nuestra Señora de La Paz, agace kabarizwamo icyicaro cya guverinoma ya Bolivia na Yungas iherereyemo ishyamba rikora ku misozi ya Andes ikikije Peru, Bolivia na Argentina, ukaba usurwa n’abantu barenga 25000 buri mwaka. Uyu muhanda uri ku musozi uhanamye, ku butumburuke bwa metero 3500 uhereye aho umusozi uhera, wahanzwe n’imfungwa z’intambara zo muri Paraguay mu 1930, uza kuvugururwa mu 1986. Witiriwe umuhanda w’urupfu kubera ubuhaname bw’uwo musozi, ibihu bikunze kuba muri ko gace byatumye uberaho impanuka zahitanye ubuzima bw’abatari bacye, zaje no gutuma ufungwa mu 2006. Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe bwerekanye ko mbere y’uko uyu muhanda ufungwa nibura buri mwaka abantu barenga 300 bawupfiragamo bazize impanuka. Mu 1983 habereye impanuka ikomeye y’imodoka nini yari itwaye abagenzi, abagera mu 100 bahasiga ubuzima. Gusa nubwo uyu muhanda wafunzwe n’ubu abantu baracyawupfiramo kuko umaze gupfiramo abakerarugendo 22 kuva aho bawufungiye. Kugira ngo ukorere ubutembere muri uyu muhanda ubu usabwa kwishyura amafaranga akoreshwa muri icyo gihugu ‘bolivianos’ agera kuri 50 angana n’amadolari 7.31$. Ni hafi 6000Frw, yifashyishwa mu guhemba abaturage bahatuye,  bakora ibikorwa byo kuwubungabunga.

title: Coronavirus yatumye Abaperezida bamwe muri Afurika babuza abaminisitiri gukora ingendo no guhererekanya ibiganza
content: Abaperezida b’ibyo bihugu bavuze ko abaminisitiri babyo bazongera kugira aho bajya ari uko bahawe andi mabwiriza. Iki cyorezo cyadutse mu Bushinwa mu mpera za 2019 kugeza ubu kimaze kwica abarenga 3800 ku Isi naho abarenga ibihumbi 108 mu bihugu birenga 90 bamaze kucyandura. Ku wa 4 Werurwe 2020, mbere gato y’inama y’abaminisitiri muri Côte d’Ivoire, Perezida Alassane Ouattara, yabahaye amabwiriza ko batemerewe kuramukanya bahererekanyije ibiganza nk’uko byari bisanzwe. Minisitiri w’Ubuzima muri Benin, Benjamin Hounkpatin aheruka gusabwa kuguma mu biro bye amasaha 24/24, icyo akeneye bakakimusangishaho nk’uko inkuru ya Jeunne Afrique ibivuga. Ibindi bihugu birimo Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Gabon, Mauritanie, Burkina Faso, Guinée, Togo na Cameroun iheruka guhabwa ibikoresho byo gukumira iki cyorezo na Koreya y’Epfo, byakajije ingamba ku bibuga by’indege byabyo. Si byo gusa kuko n’ibindi bihugu muri Afurika biryamiye amajanja mu gukumira ko iki cyorezo kiri gukwirakwira ku muvuduko udasanzwe ko cyagerayo. Minisitiri w’Intebe w’u Rwanda, Dr Edouard Ngirente aheruka gusaba abanyarwanda kudateshuka ku mabwiriza bahawe yo kwirinda no gukukira iki cyorezo arimo kutongera guhererekanya ibiganza baramukanya, kudakorera ingendo zitari ngombwa mu bihugu iki cyorezo cyagaragayemo, gukaraba intoki n’amazi meza n’isabune n’ibindi. U Rwanda rwanashyizeho itsinda rishinzwe gusesengura no gukurikirana uko igihugu cyiteguye gukumira no guhangana n’icyo cyorezo aho kugeza ubu rivuga ko nta muntu uragaragaraho iki cyorezo.

title: Musanze: Abagore bafunzwe bibukijwe ko batatsinda urugamba rw’iterambere bakijandika mu byaha
content: Ni ubutumwa bahawe kuri uyu wa 8 Werurwe 2020, ubwo hizihizwaga ku nshuro ya 45 umunsi mpuzamahanga wahariwe umugore, wabereye muri Gereza nkuru ya Musanze. Umubare munini w’abagore bafungiwe muri iyi Gereza, bashinjwa ibyaha bifite aho bihuriye n’ubukungu, birimo ubujura, ikoreshwa ry’ibiyobyabwenge, inyandiko mpimbano n’ibindi, ariyo mpamvu mu butumwa bwagarutsweho bibukijwe ko bagomba kubanza kwitandukanya n’icyaha bakabona kugera ku nzira y’ubukire. Bamwe muri aba bagore nabo bavuga ko n’ubwo batatiriye igihango cya mutima w’urugo bakijandika mu byaha byabagonganishije n’amategeko, kuri ubu nabo biyemeje kwitandukanya n’ibyaha ubundi bagahanga ijisho inzira y’ubukungu ku miryango yabo n’Igihugu, binyuze mu myuga itandukanye bigiye muri Gereza. Niyonsenga Francine w’imyaka 43 y’amavuko, ukomoka mu Karere ka Ngororero, kuri ubu ushigaje ukwezi kumwe ngo arangize igihano cye yagize ati " Ubu namaze kugororoka mu bwenge ku buryo kuba narize imwuga wo kudoda, kuboha ibishora n’ibindi, niteguye ko ningera mu muryango nziteza imbere, nzajya nidodera umwenda, ndodere n’abandi, ku buryo umugabo n’abana nasize bazambonamo umugore ushoboye, witandukanyije n’icyaha." Mutungirehe Margarite wo mu Karere ka Gasabo nawe ati "Nubwo twatatiriye igihango cya mutima w’urugo tukagongana n’amategeko, ariko turashimira Leta yacu ko itatumye twigunga, ubu nize guhinga ibihumyo mu buryo bwa kinyamwuga, ku buryo ninsoza igihano cyanjye nzakomeza mbikore, mbyigishe n’ abo nzasanga dufatanye kurwanya imirire mibi kandi n’ifaranga riboneke, ariko mparanira ko ntazasubira mu cyaha." Umuyobozi mukuru wungirije w’urwego rw’Igihugu rw’imfungwa n’abagororwa, DCG Ujeneza Chantal, yibukije aba bagore ko batabasha kurasanira ku ruhembe rw’iterambere bagikora ibyaha, abasaba kubanza kwitandukanya na byo bagahinduka. Yagize ati "Ubu insanganyamatsiko yacu ni umugore ku ruhembe rw’iterambere, ntabwo warujyaho rero ukijandika mu byaha, bisaba gufunguka mu mutwe, isuku mu bitekerezo, ubundi ugahagarara wemye”. “Ntabwo wajya ufungwa ufungurwa ngo ugere ku iterambere, iyi myuga mwize niyo izabafasha kwiteza imbere n’imiryango yanyu, mbifurije rero kugira umunsi mwiza wa mutima w’urugo utari muri Gereza, muharanire kuvamo ubutagarukamo." Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Musanze wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage, Kamanzi Axelle nawe yasabye aba bagore gusigasira imyuga bigiye muri Gereza, kugira ngo nibasoza ibihano bahawe izababere umusemburo w’iterambere, ndetse bazigishe n’abo bazaba basanze mu muryango, bafatanye mu bikorwa by’iterambere rirambye Kugeza ubu mu magereza yo mu Rwanda, hafungiwe abagore basaga 4900, aho mu byaha biri ku isonga bafungiwe birimo ibyaha bya Jenoside, ibiyobyabwenge n’ibindi bifite aho bihurira n’ubukungu.

title: U Bufaransa: Bamwe mu bari kuyobora ikiganiro gipfobya kikanahakana Jenoside bisubiyeho
content: Dr. Denis Mukwege yanze kwitabira iyi nama ku munota wa nyuma, avuga ko ibyo yifuzaga ko bivugirwa muri iyi nama bitashyizwe kuri gahunda, nyamara ari we wari watangije igitekerezo cyayo abinyujije muri senateri Gérard Longuet. Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Ikigo cy’Ubumenyi ku masomo yibanda ku bihugu bigitegekwa n’u Bufaransa (Académie des Sciences d’Outre-Mer), Pierre Gény, na we wateganyaga kuba mu bagombaga gutangiza iyi nama, yavuze ko atazayitabira kuko uwo bashyigikiye kandi basanzwe bakorana, Dr Denis Mukwege, atazayibonekamo. Umunyamakuru Vincent Hervouët wari kuba umuyobozi w’iyi gahunda kuva itangiye, kugera ku musozo wayo nawe yaraye atangaje ko atakibashije kuyitabira kubera impamvu z’umwanya muke. Iyi nama ifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti "Afurika yo mu biyaga bigari, imyaka 60 y’ihungabana ry’umutekano rikomeye". Iyi nama yitezweho gutangirwamo ibiganiro bibiri by’ingenzi birimo ikiba gifite insangamatsiko igira iti "Amateka, raporo, imyaka 60 y’ubwicanyi, ihohoterwa ryakorewe imbaga, ibyaha byibasiye inyokomuntu na Jenoside"; mu gihe ikiganiro cya kabiri kiba gifite insanganyamatsiko ivuga ku bagize uruhare muri ibyo bikorwa, baba abo mu karere ndetse n’abo ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Iyi nama yateguwe hifashishijwe abasenateri babiri bo mu Bufaransa, barimo uwahoze ari Minisitiri, Alain Richard, ugomba kuyitangiza ku mugaragaro ndetse Gérard Longuet, na we wahoze ari Minisitiri, ugomba kuyisoza. Abantu batandukanye barimo Ihuriro ry’Abanyarwanda batuye mu Bufaransa (Communauté Rwandaise de France, CRF), ndetse na Ibuka France, basabye Sena y’iki gihugu kwitandukanya n’inama igamije guha urubuga abahakana bakanapfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Ku ruhembe hari Judi Rever, wamenyekanye cyane kubera ibitekerezo n’inyandiko ze zisebya ubuyobozi bw’u Rwanda ndetse agahakana na Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Igitabo cyanditswe n’uyu mugore ukomoka muri Canada, ‘In Praise of blood, the crimes of the Rwandan Patriotic Front’, cyamaganiwe kure n’abahanga mu mateka ya Jenoside ndetse n’inzu isohora ibitabo yari yahawe akazi ko kugisemura mu gifaransa yanga kubikora. Hari kandi Jean-Marie Vianney Ndagijimana, wahoze ahagarariye u Rwanda mu Bufaransa, na we uzwiho guharabika abayobozi b’u Rwanda ndetse akavuga ko habayeho Jenoside ebyiri abinyujije mu mbwirwaruhame ze n’inyandiko zitandukanye. Muri iyi nama kandi haraba hari Charles Onana, uzwi nk’umunyamakuru ndetse n’impuguke mu mateka, na we uvuga ko hagati ya 1990 na 1994 nta Jenoside yigeze ikorerwa umuntu uwo ari we wese mu Rwanda, ariko we akaba anakurikiranywe n’inkiko ku cyaha cyo guhakana ko nta byaha byibasiye inyokomuntu byabayeho. Undi ugaragara ku rutonde rw’abazatanga ibiganiro muri iyi nama ni Hubert Védrine, wari umunyabanga mukuru mu biro bya Perezida François Mitterrand ubwo Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yabaga mu Rwanda. Uyu azwiho guhirimbana no guhagaragara ku bitekerezo byari bifitwe na Leta y’Abafaransa muri icyo gihe ndetse agashimangira ko igitabo cyanditswe na Judi River ari cyo gikwiye kureberwaho. Gutumizwa kw’iyi nama ngo byasabwe ku ikubitiro na Dr Denis Mukwege, uherutse guhabwa igikombe cyitiriwe Nobel mu 2018. Uyu ngo yifuzaga ko ku murongo w’ibizaganirwaho, havugwa kuri raporo yakozwe n’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ku bikorwa by’intambara byakorewe muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo hagati ya 1993 na 2003 (Mapping Report), yashyinguwe na ONU; mu gihe we yashakaga gukoresha iyi nama nk’uburyo bwo kongera guhakana ibyavuye muri iyo raporo kuko atabyemera ku giti cye. Nyuma yo gusanga ibyifuzo bye bitari kuri gahunda izaganirwaho muri iyi nama, Dr Denis Mukwege yahisemo kutazayitabira nk’uko byatangajwe n’umwunganizi we ubwo yaganiraga n’ikinyamakuru La Croix. Amakuru avuga ko senateri Gérard Longuet ari we wazanye umushinga w’iyi nama muri sena y’u Bufaransa, gusa we na mugenzi we Alain Richard, banze kugira icyo bavugana n’itangazamakuru ku bijyanye n’iyi nama iteganyijwe kuri uyu wa mbere. Nk’abandi basenateri bose mu Bufaransa, Gérard Longuet, yemerewe gutegura inama nyunguranabitekerezo muri sena y’iki gihugu rimwe mu mwaka, mu gihe cyose yujuje ibisabwa kandi Perezida wa sena, Gérard Larcher, ntiyemerewe kumubangamira. Amakuru avuga ko abateguye iyi nama basabwe kwirinda ko hazamo ibitekerezo n’amagambo ahakana akanapfobya Jenoside kandi ko ikibazo cyagejejwe mu biro bya perezida w’u Bufaransa ndetse no muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga, na bo basa n’abahangayikishijwe n’iyi nama. Mu gihe abazayobora ibiganiro muri iyi nama bose bigaragaje ku ruhando mpuzamahanga nk’abahakana bakanapfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda, benshi baribaza ukuntu igikorwa nk’iki kigiye kubera ku butaka bw’u Bufaransa kandi iki gihugu giherutse gushyiraho itariki ya 7 Mata nk’umunsi wo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ibi bibaye kandi mu gihe muri Mata 2019, Perezida Emmanuel Macron w’u Bufaransa, yatangaje ishyirwaho rya komisiyo igizwe n’abahanga mu mateka n’abashakashatsi, izasesengura inyandiko icyo gihugu kibitse zigaragaza ibikorwa byacyo mu Rwanda hagati ya 1990-1994, ngo hashyirwe ahabona ukuri ku ruhare rw’icyo gihugu muri Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi. Biteganyijwe ko iryo tsinda rizatanga raporo mu myaka ibiri uhereye igihe ryashyiriweho, rikazafasha mu gutegura neza imfashanyigisho zakwifashishwa no kwigisha mu Bufaransa amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ni itsinda riyobowe na Prof. Vincent Duclert. Hagati aho Komisiyo y’Igihugu yo kurwanya Jenoside, CNLG, iheruka kuvuga ko yakiriye abahagarariye iri tsinda, rikaba ryari mu Rwanda mu ntangiro za Gashyantare 2020, barigaragariza uko bifuza ko rikora ibitandukanye n’abaribanjirije.

title: Ibinyoma bya Leta ya Habyarimana ku bwicanyi yakoreraga Abatutsi n’itegurwa ryeruye rya Jenoside
content: Iyi nyandiko isohoka buri cyumweru y’Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa CNLG, Dr Bizimana Jean-Damascène, ishimangira ko Leta ya Habyarimana yateguye Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, ikoresha ubugome bwose bushoboka, kugira ngo uwo mugambi utamenyekana. Yerekana kandi ko Habyarimana yatesheje agaciro amasezerano y’amahoro y’Arusha, akomeza gukwirakwiza intwaro mu baturage, no gukoresha iterabwoba hose mu gihugu. MRND yashinze agatsiko k’abicanyi mu Mujyi wa Butare  Amashyaka ya MDR na PL yasohoye itangazo ridasanzwe yise special ku wa 14 Werurwe 1992 rigaragaza ko MRND yashinze mu mujyi wa Butare umutwe w’abagizi ba nabi witwaga “Front commun contre les Inkotanyi” (FCCI) wari ugizwe cyane cyane na bamwe mu banyeshuri bo muri Kaminuza nkuru y’u Rwanda. Uwo mutwe wari ufite inshingano zo gutoteza abanyeshuri batari muri MRND, by’umwihariko Abatutsi. Umutwe washinzwe na Dr Jean Berchmans Nshimyumuremyi wari umuyobozi wungirije wa Kaminuza. Izo nterahamwe zahabwaga kandi inkunga n’ubuyobozi bwazo ku rwego rw’igihugu ndetse abakuru bazo barimo Kajuga Robert, Mbonabaryi Leoni, Mudahinyuka Jean Marie Vianney, Akingeneye Eugene na Rutaganda Georges bazaga kenshi gukorana inama n’abagize uwo mutwe i Butare. Imwe muri izo nama yabaye ku itariki 12 Werurwe 1992, irangiye bamwe mu banyeshuri b’Abatutsi n’abo mu mashyaka ya politiki yarwanyaga Leta baratewe barakubitwa. Ibi byabanjirijwe n’inama yabaye ku wa 08 werurwe 1992, ikoreshejwe n’abadepite babiri ba MRND bakomoka muri Butare, Laurent Baravuga ukomoka muri Kigembe na Bernadette Mukarurangwa ukomoka muri Ndora. Baravuga yakoresheje inama muri komine Kigembe, segiteri Kigali, asaba abari aho bose “gufata imipanga, imiheto n’amacumu bagatangira bagahiga abatari muri MRND bose badakangwa n’amaduka n’amamodoka.” Muri Jenoside abo badepite bombi bagize uruhare runini mu gukangurira kwicisha Abatutsi. Irindi tangazo rya MDR ryo ku wa 10 Werurwe 1992 rigaragaza ko abayobozi ba MRND muri Butare bateje imvururu muri za komine bafitemo ingufu, aho ishyaka rya MRND ryakoresheje mitingi muri Komini nyinshi zo mu gihugu bagasiga bateje imvururu mu baturage. Itangazo rivuga ko ibikorwa nk’ibyo byatangiriye muri Komine Muganza (Butare) biyobowe na Perezida w’iryo shyaka muri Butare, Amandin Rugira, ngo wavugaga ko “MDR yibanguriye kuri PL bizabyara ibirambu, cyangwa ngo Ujya gutwika imbagara arazirundanya. Ubwo aba ashaka guteranya Abahutu n’Abatutsi ngo basubiranemo”. Iryo tangazo ryasobanuraga ko “Ikibabaje cyane nuko abategetsi bamwe ba perefegitura n’aba komini barimo perefe Temahagari bakomeje kubogamira uruhande rumwe, bagatera ubwoba abayoboke b’andi mashyaka.” Itangazo rigasoza riburira Temahagari ngo “amenye ko Butare yo muri 1992 atari Gikongoro yo muri 1963”. Impamvu y’iyi mvugo ni uko muri 1963, Yusitini Temahagari ariwe wasimbuye Andreya Nkeramugaba ku mwanya wa perefe w’iyo perefegitura mu gihe cya Jenoside yabereye ku Gikongoro mu Ukuboza 1963. Ibinyoma bya Leta ya Habyarimana ku bwicanyi yakoreraga Abatutsi muri Ruhengeri na Gisenyi Igihe Leta ya Habyarimana yicaga Abatutsi muri perefegitura ya Ruhengeri na Gisenyi, abantu ntibari bemerewe kuhagera keretse abakozi ba perefegitura, abasirikari n’abakozi bo mu nzego z’umutekano. Abanyamakuru nabo babujijwe kugera ahaberaga ubwicanyi, keretse abanyamakuru ba Radio Rwanda n’ab’ikinyamukuru Kangura. Ibi birasobanura impamvu ubwicanyi bwakorwaga na Leta ya Habyarimana bwatinze kumenyekana. Mu kiganiro cyahise kuri Radio Rwanda, tariki ya 12/3/1991, abategetsi ba perefegitura ya Ruhengeri ari nabo bakoraga ubwo bwicanyi bavuze ko nta kibazo cy’amoko kiri muri iyo perefegitura. Umuyobozi w’amashuri abanza muri iyo perefegitura yavuze ko abarimu be bose bari mu kazi, ko nta n’umwe ubura. Nyamara, abarimu b’Abatutsi bose barafunzwe mu byitso, nyuma baricwa. Kubera ko ikinyoma cyari kimaze kumenyekana, abari ku isonga ry’ubwicanyi, bemeye ko hari Abatutsi bapfuye, babeshya ko bapfuye barwanira Inkotanyi, abandi ngo bajyanye na zo. Iki kinyoma nicyo Habyarimana nawe yakomeje kubwira amahanga, nk’uko yabigaragaje mu ibaruwa yandikiye Komisiyo y’Uburenganzira bwa Muntu y’Umuryango w’Abibumbye. Nyamara n’ubwo Habyarimana yahakanaga ubwo bwicanyi, Minisitiri w’Ubutabera yemeje ko buriho, asaba ko hatangira iperereza. Nta perereza ryigeze rikorwa kuko perefe wa Perefegitura Ruhengeri, Nzabagerageza Charles yatumije inama y’umutekano ya perefegitura, avuga ko nta perereza rigomba gukorwa, ko nta mpamvu yo “kuzikura ibintu byibagiranye, bishobora gushoza imvururu mu baturage”. Amashyirahamwe aharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu yagaragaje ko hishwe abatutsi basaga 300 mu Bugesera Nyuma y’ubwicanyi bwakorewe Abatutsi mu Bugesera mu ijoro ryo ku itariki ya 4 rishyira iry’iya 5 Werurwe 1992, amashyirahamwe atanu yigenga aharanira Uburenganzira bwa Muntu: ADL, Lichredor, ARDHO, Kanyarwanda na AVP yakoze ubucukumbuzi bubiri bwimbitse kuri ubu bwicanyi bavumbura ibintu byinshi biteye agahinda. Raporo ya mbere yashyizwe ahagaragara ku itariki 10 Werurwe 1992 igaragaza urupfu rw’Abatutsi basaga 300. Bamwe muri bo bari bararoshywe mu migezi abandi baratwikiwe mu nzu. Iyi raporo kandi yanavugaga ko Abatutsi bavuye mu byabo bageraga ku 15 000 kandi ko bari babayeho mu buzima buteye agahinda, cyane cyane abari barahungiye kuri Paruwasi no ku mashuri i Nyamata, Maranyundo, Ruhuha na Rilima. Iyi raporo kandi yamaganaga uruhare rw’abayobozi muri ubwo bwicanyi cyane Fidèle Rwambuka, Burugumesitiri wa Kanzenze, Faustin Sekagina, Superefe wa Kanzenze, Déogratias Ndimubanzi wari umwungiriza wa mbere w’umushinjacyaha muri Parike ya Kanzenze na Dominique Muhawenimana wari ushinzwe iperereza muri Superefegitura ya Kanazi. Ku itariki ya 30 Werurwe 1993, aya mashyirahamwe yongeye gukora ubucukumbuzi mu Bugesera agamije kureba uko umutekano uhagaze nyuma y’umwaka umwe habaye ubwicanyi bwo mu 1992. Muri raporo yabo basohoye ku itariki 5 Werurwe 1994, aya mashyirahamwe yagaragaje ko Abatutsi benshi bari baravuye mu byabo batari barigeze babisubiramo kandi ko iteka bahoraga bahohoterwa n’abarwanashyaka ba CDR. Iyi raporo yagaragazaga ko abangavu bari baragiye bafatwa ku ngufu n’abasirikare bo mu kigo cya Gako. Abantu bakomeje kwicwa hitwajwe ko bakekwagaho gushaka kujya muri FPR. Bamwe muri abo bishwe babashije kumenyekana ni nka Nyabyenda n’undi witwa Anastase bakoreraga uwari umukozi ukomeye muri MINECOFIN witwaga Mbarute. Uwitwa Butera yiciwe n’abasirikare i Nyarurama (Komini Ngenda) ku itariki ya 6 Werurwe 1993. Abantu benshi barakubiswe baramugazwa barimo umusaza witwaga Mutabazi wakubiswe n’abajandarume n’abapolisi ku Biro bya Komini Kanzenze ku itariki ya 21 Gashyantare 1993. Lieutenant-Colonel Claudien Singirankabo, Komanda w’Ikigo cya Gisirikare cya Gako, yasobanuye ko ubwo bwicanyi bwabaye inkurikizi z’intambara bari barashowemo na FPR kandi ko na nyina yari yariciwe na FPR mu Ruhengeri. Imiryango mpuzamahanga irengera ikiremwamuntu yamaganye ubwicanyi bwakorwaga na Leta ya Habyarimana Tariki ya 15 Werurwe 1994, Komisiyo Mpuzamahanga ihuje imiryango irengera ikiremwa muntu, ari yo « Human Rights Watch, Fédération Internationale des Ligues des Droits de l’Homme, Centre International des Droits de la Personne et du Développement démocratique, Union interafricaine des Droits de l’Homme et des Peuples », ifatanije n’umuryango « Amnesty International » basohoye itangazo bagaragaza  ko ubwicanyi bwiyongereye mu Rwanda, kandi ko intwaro zahabwaga abaturage ku mugaragaro. Iryo tangazo ryanagaragaje ko MRND ifite uruhare mu gukereza gushyiraho inzego z’inzibacyuho, aho yashakishaga impamvu zose ayo masezerano yaburiramo, inasaba ko abagize uruhare mu bwicanyi batakurikiranwa. Leta ya Habyarimana yishe n’abanyamahanga barwanyaga umugambi we wo kurimbura Abatutsi Gutegura Jenoside byajyanaga no gucecekesha abashoboraga gutuma umugambi wa jenoside utagerwaho. Abenshi barishwe, abandi barafungwa cyane cyane abanyamakuru bavugishaga ukuri nka Kameya Andre umuyobozi w’ikinyamakuru Rwanda Rushya. Ni muri urwo rwego, umutaliyanikazi witwa Antonia Locatelli yishwe. Antonia Locatelli yakomokaga mu Butaliyani, yari Umuyobozi w’Ikigo cyigisha imyuga iciriritse (CERAI) cya Nyamata. Yishwe mu ijoro ryo ku itariki 9 rishyira itariki ya 10 Werurwe 1992  arashwe n’umujandarume Epimaque Ulimubenshi. Uyu Mutaliyanikazi wari umurezi i Nyamata yari yarakiriye impunzi z’Abatutsi zahungaga abicanyi, abimenyesha inzego zitandukanye zaba iza Leta cyangwa izigenga zirimo Arikidiyosezi ya Kigali, CERAI ya Nyamata yabarizwagamo. Mu rwego rwo kumvikanisha uburemere bw’ubwicanyi bwari burimo gukorerwa Abatutsi, Antonia Locateli yari yaratanze amakuru kuri Radio Mpuzamahanga y’Abafaransa (RFI). Yahise yicwa ikiganiro cye (interview) kikimara gutangazwa mu makuru ya nimugoroba kuri RFI. Uwamwishe ntibyigeze bimutera ikibazo na gato, ibi bikaba bigaragaza ko ari ubwicanyi bwari bwateguwe kandi bushyigikiwe na Leta. Uretse Anatonia Locatelli, hari n’undi munyamahanga Furere Fransisko CARDINAL wakomokaga mu gihugu cya Canada wayoboraga ikigo cy’imyuga cya Butamwa “Centre de formation rurale de la jeunesse de Butamwa” kigishaga urubyiruko imyuga itandukanye, nawe wishwe muri ubwo buryo. Yabanaga muri icyo kigo n’abandi bafurere batatu barimo undi munya-Canada witwa Paul Latraverse n’abandi banyarwanda babiri aribo Furere Karake Evariste na Furere Rwibandira Pierre Servillien. Nk’uko bigaragara mu ibaruwa yo ku wa 2 Ukuboza 1992 igenewe Minisitiri w’Intebe yanditswe na Dr Iyamuremye Augustin wari Umukuru w’ibiro by’iperereza imbere mu gihugu, byabarizwaga kwa Minisitiri w’Intebe, mu ijoro ryo ku itariki 29 rishyira 30 Ugushyingo 1992, Furere CARDINAL wari ufite imyaka 50 y’amavuko yarashwe n’igitero cy’abantu bagera kuri batandatu bambaye imyenda ya gisilikare. Yarasiwe mu kigo cy’abafurere agwa imbere y’icyumba yararagamo. Bamaze kumwica binjiye mu nzu batwara amafaranga abarirwa hagati y’ibihumbi magana abiri na Magana ane. Muri iyo baruwa, umuyobozi mukuru w’ibiro by’iperereza asoza avuga ko abaturage bo muri ako karere binubira imikorere mibi y’inzego zishinzwe umutekano n’iz’ubugenzacyaha, bakavuga ko zifatanyije n’abicanyi ndetse n’amabandi. Iyicwa rya Furere CARDINAL risa nkaho ritatunguye bamwe mu bari bamuzi cyane cyane abahagarariye ibihugu byabo mu Rwanda. Ku itariki ya 30 Ugushyingo 1992 yaraye arashwe, Kinyamateka yaganiriye n’abadipolomate b’abanyamahanga bari bagiye Butamwa aho Furere yari yaraye yiciwe. Kinyamateka itangaza ko umwe muri bo yayitangarije ko iryo yicwa ryasaga nk’aho ryari ryitezwe kuko yari yarahawe kenshi ubutumwa kuri telefoni ko azicwa, kandi uwo mugambi wari uyobowe na Colonel Elie Sagatwa, muramu wa Perezida Habyarimana, akaba yari n’umujyanama we wihariye. Jenoside yarinze iba muri 1994 abishe Furere CARDINAL batarahanwa, bikaba byerekana ukuri kw’inyandiko ya KINYAMATEKA igaragaza ko abategetsi bakomeye bari bafite uruhare rw’ibanze mu iyicwa rye. Leta ya Habyarimana yakomeje gutegura intambara na Jenoside Tariki ya 10 werurwe 1994, MINUAR yaguye ku rutonde rw’intwaro nini zari zigenewe ingabo za Habyarimana. Kuri iyo tariki inzego z’ubutasi z’u Bubiligi zavuze ko intwaro zakomezaga kwiyongera, umubare w’abasirikari nawo ari ko wiyongera. Dallaire wayoboraga ingabo za Loni yasabye uburenganzira bwo gufata izo ntwaro mu mujyi wa Kigali, umunyamabanga mukuru wa Loni aramwangira. Ibyo byemejwe na Minisitiri w’Ingabo w’u Bubirigi ubwo yari avuye mu Rwanda, yavuze ko Kigali yuzuyemo intwaro, bikaba byari binyuranije n’amasezerano y’amahoro y’Arusha. MINUAR yagerageje gufatira intwaro zari zigenewe abasirikari b’u Rwanda zari zoherejwe na sosiyete y’Abongereza Mil-Tec n’iy’Abafaransa yitwa Dyl-Invest. Nta gushidikanya ko Habyarimana atari ashishikajwe n’amasezerano y’amahoro y’Arusha, kuko ukwiyongera kw’intwaro mu gihugu no mu baturage nta kindi byari bigamije uretse gutsemba Abatutsi n’abageragezaga kuburizamo uwo mugambi. U Bufaransa bwo bwakomeje gushyigikira Leta ya Habyarimana buyisabira kongererwa intwaro n’abasirikari bo kuyirwanirira. Tariki 11 Werurwe 1992, umuyobozi ushinzwe Afurika na Madagascar muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga y’Abafaransa, Paul Dijoud, yagiriye inama Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga w’u Bufaransa, Roland Dumas, kongera inkunga u Bufaransa bwageneraga u Rwanda mu bya gisirikare no kohereza umujyanama mu bya gisirikare wo ku rwego rwo hejuru muri “Etat-major” y’ingabo z’u Rwanda. Umusozo Nk’uko ibikorwa byinshi bibyerekana, Leta ya Habyarimana yateguye Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, ikoresha ubugome bwose bushoboka, kugira ngo uwo mugambi utamenyekana. Habyarimana yatesheje agaciro amasezerano y’amahoro y’Arusha, akomeza gukwirakwiza intwaro mu baturage, no gukoresha iterabwoba hose mu gihugu.

title: USA: Umwana w’umunyamerika watawe inshuro ebyiri, ari kurerwa n’umunyarwanda
content: Inkuru y’ubuzima bwa Anthony ikimenyekana yakoze ku mitima y’Abanyamerika benshi nyuma yo gusanga yarahuye n’ibibazo bikomeye kuva akiri muto. Daily Mail dukesha iyi nkuru yanditse ko umunyarwanda, Peter Mutabazi, ukora akazi ko kuranga no kugurisha amazu muri Leta Zunze  Ubumwe za Amerika yagize umutima w’impuhwe yemera kwakira uwo mwana wari umaze gutabwa inshuri ebyiri zose. Umunsi umwe ubwo yari yemeye kwakira Anthony ngo amwiteho by’igihe gito (muri weekend gusa), yaje kuganira n’uwo mwana, amubwira inkuru y’ubuzima bwe bwose bituma yiyemeza gusaba kumurera mu buryo bwemewe n’amategeko muri Mutarama 2018. Kugeza ubu ngo umubano n’ubuzima byabo bombi bimaze guhinduka mu gihe gito bamaranye. Mutabazi ati "Nta muntu n’umwe washakaga kumwakira, kandi koko biragoye kubona inzu cyangwa imiryango yakira umuhungu w’imyaka 11." Mutabazi uvuga ko na we yanyuze mu buzima butoroshye akiri muto, yemerewe kurera uyu mwana mu buryo bwemewe n’amategeko ku wa 12 Ugushyingo umwaka ushize. Uyu munyarwanda avuga ko nubwo byatwaye igihe kirekire, yari yizeye ko uyu mwana azageraho akaba umuhungu we. Peter Mutabazi utuye mu mujyi wa Charlotte, muri Leta ya Caroline y’Amajyaruguru, mu myaka itatu ishize yari yariyemeje kujya yakira abana bo kurera mu gihe cya weekend gusa, aho bari bamaze kuba 12. Abana yari amaze kwakira bari bafite imyaka iri hagati y’ibiri na 11 baje kumubana benshi, umuryango wigenga wita ku bana badafite imiryango bakoranaga wiyemeza kubajyana mu yindi miryango ibarera. Mutabazi yavuze ko gutandukana n’abo bana icyo gihe byamugoye kubyakira. Umuryango w’Abibumbye uvuga ko kugeza ubu abana miliyoni 60 batawe n’imiryango yabo bakiri bato, bakajya kwibeshaho mu mihanda cyangwa bakakirwa mu bigo birera imfubyi hirya no hino ku isi. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, abana basaga 7000 batabwa n’imiryango yabo buri mwaka.

title: Uko yibwe amafaranga kuri telefoni n’uwo yahaye icumbi akamutwara umubare w’ibanga
content: Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu Mujyi wa Kigali Chief Inspector of Police (CIP) Marie Gorette Umutesi yavuze ko kugira ngo Umurerwa abashe kwiba ariya mafaranga yabanje kwicarana n’uwo mucuruzi akamenya umubare w’ibanga akoresha akawufata mu mutwe. Yagize ati “Ubwo uyu mukozi w’imwe muri sosiyete z’itumanaho yari mu kazi ke i Remera mu Giporoso, yahamagawe na Umurerwa Zakili bari basanzwe baziranye amusaba icumbi, igihe bari batarataha yamwicaye iruhande akomeza gucunga umubare w’ibanga akoresha aha serivisi abakiriya. Batashye bageze mu rugo Umurerwa aza kumutira telefoni ngo ahamagare niko guhita yiyoherereza amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi 68 azinduka amusezeraho.” CIP Umutesi yakomeje avuga ko uwibwe akimara kubura amafaranga ye kuri telefoni yitabaje sosiyete yakoreraga basanga amafaranga yibwe na wawundi yacumbikiye ndetse basanga ako kanya amaze kuyabikuza ari nabwo yahise yitabaza Polisi ngo imukurikiranire umwibye ari we Umurerwa. Polisi yatangiye kumushakisha  kugeza ubwo ku mugoroba wo kuwa Gatandatu yaje gufatirwa ahitwa mu Giporoso ashyikirizwa urwego rw’igihugu rw’ubugenzacyaha rukorera kuri Sitasiyo ya Polisi ya Kanombe kugira ngo hakomeze iperereza. CIP Umutesi yasoje agira inama abakora imirimo nk’iyi kwirinda ko umubare wabo w’ibanga umenyekana, anasaba abishora mu bujura nk’ubu kubireka. Yagize ati "Turasaba buri wese yaba abakora uyu murimo wo kubitsa, kubikuriza no koherereza abantu amafaranga hifashishijwe telefoni ndetse n’abaturarwanda muri rusange kwirinda ko umubare w’ibanga wabo ujya hanze ukamenyekana. Ni uwawe wenyine nta wundi ugomba kuwumenya.  Abagira umugambi wo kwiba muri ubu buryo nabo icyo bagomba kumenya ni uko ari icyaha gihanwa n’amategeko kandi uburyo bwo kubafata ni bwinshi." Ingingo ya 174 y’itegeko nº68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange iteganya ko umuntu wese wihesha umutungo w’undi, imari ye yose cyangwa igice cyayo mu buryo bw’uburiganya yiyitiriye izina ritari ryo cyangwa umurimo adafitiye ububasha cyangwa akizeza icyiza cyangwa agatinyisha ko hari ikibi kizaba, aba akoze icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko, ahanishwa igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka ibiri ariko kitarenze imyaka itatu n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda atari munsi ya miliyoni eshatu (3.000.000 FRW) ariko atarenze miliyoni eshanu (5.000.000 FRW).

title: Tariki 9 Werurwe
content: Tariki 9 Werurwe ni umunsi wa 67 w’uyu mwaka usigaje indi 299 ngo ugere ku musozo. Bimwe mu byabaye kuri iyi tariki mu mateka 632: Nibwo Intumwa Muhammad yavuze isengesho rya nyuma (Khutbatul Wada). 1276: Augsburg yahindutse Umujyi w’i Bwami wigenga. 1566: David Rizzio, Umunyamabanga wihariye w’umwamikazi Mary wo muri Scotland, yiciwe I Bwami (Holyroodhouse) muri Scotland. 1796:  Napoléon Bonaparte yarwubakanye na Joséphine de Beauharnais. 1990:  Dr Antonia Novella niwe wabaye umugore wa mbere wahawe umwanya w’ushinzwe ubuzima unafite inkomoko yo muri Espagne. 2010: Habaye ubukwe bwa mbere bw’abahuje igitsina i Washington. Bamwe mu bavutse kuri iyi tariki 1285: Go-Nijō,Umwami w’abami wo mu Buyapani. 1929: Zillur Rahman, Perezida wa Bangladesh. 1975: Juan Sebastián Verón,umukinnyi w’umupira w’amaguru w’umunyargentine. Bamwe mu batabarutse kuri iyi tariki 1992: Menachem Begin, Minisitiri w’Intebe wa Isirayeli akaba yaranabonye igikombe cy’amahoro cya Prix nobel. 1926: Usui Mikao, uwashinze Reiki. 2007: Brad Delp, Umuririmbyi w’umunyamerika.

title: U Butaliyani: Berlusconi w’imyaka 83 yatandukanye n’umugore w’imyaka 34, yishumbusha ukiri muto
content: Ishyaka Berlusconi abarizwamo, Forza Italia ryatangaje ko uwo mugabo w’imyaka 83 yatandukanye n’uwari umugore we, Francesca Pascale. Berlusconi na Pascale batangaje ko nubwo batandukanye bazakomeza kuba inshuti zisanzwe. Pascale yavuze ko  yatunguwe n’icyemezo cy’uwahoze ari umugabo we, gusa amwifuriza ibyiza mu buzima. Yagize ati “Nzakomeza kumufata nk’inshuti igihe cyose. Ndamwifuriza ibyishimo mu Isi kandi nizeye ko azabona undi muntu uzamwitaho nkuko namwitayeho.” Amafoto yakwirakwijwe agaragaza ko Berlusconi yishumbushije umudepite muto w’imyaka 30 banabarizwa mu ishyaka rimwe, witwa Marta Fascina. Hari ifoto iherutse gushyirwa hanze igaragaza Berlusconi na Fascina basohoka muri hoteli yo mu Busuwisi, Fascina afite imbwa ya Pascale. Bivugwa ko Fascina yamenyanye na Berlusconi ubwo uwo mugore yari ashinzwe Itangazamakuru mu Ikipe ya AC Milan Berlusconi atarayigurisha. Ibinyamakuru bitandukanye byatangaje ko Fascina yari yaranishushanyijeho amafoto ya Berlusconi. Fascina yize Ubuvanganzo muri Kaminuza ya Sapienza iherereye i Roma. Akirangiza kwiga yahise akora muri AC Milan ashinzwe Itangazamakuru. Berlusconi yagiye avugwaho inkundo no gushurashura mu bagore mu myaka 20 ishize. Mu 2013 yakatiwe igihano cy’imyaka irindwi ashinjwa kwishyura umukobwa w’imyaka 17 ngo bakorane imibonano mpuzabitsina, gusa uwo mwanzuro w’urukiko waje guteshwa agaciro mu 2014. Uyu mugabo ni umwe mu baherwe bakomeye dore ko ikinyamakuru Forbes Magazine mu mwaka wa 2018 cyamushyize ku mwanya wa 190 mu baherwe Isi ifite, n’umutungo wa miliyari 8 z’amadolari ya Amerika. Yabaye Minisitiri w’Intebe w’u Butaliyani muri Guverinoma enye ku buryo uteranyije imyaka yose yayoboye Guverinoma ari imyaka icyenda. Guhera muri Nyakanga 2019, Berlusconi ni Umudepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko y’Umuryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi.

title: RURA igiye gushyiraho uburyo bwo kwirinda Coronavirus mu modoka zitwara abagenzi
content: Byatangajwe kuri iki Cyumweru nyuma y’uko inzego zitandukanye zikomeje gufata ingamba zigamije guhashya Coronavirus ikomeje guhitana imbaga hirya no hino ku Isi. Nyuma y’uko Umujyi wa Kigali usohoye itangazo rihagarika ibitaramo n’ibindi bikorwa bihuza abantu benshi hirindwa coronavirus, bamwe batangiye kugaragaza ko hakwiriye n’ingamba mu modoka zitwara abagenzi kuko ari hamwe mu hahurira abantu benshi kandi byoroshye kuba uwarwaye yakwanduza abandi. RURA ibinyujije kuri Twitter yatangaje ko iri guteganya gushyiraho uburyo abinjira mu modoka rusange babanza gukaraba umuti wica udukoko. Igira iti “Mu rwego rwo gukomeza kwimakaza isuku no kwirinda iki cyorezo, mu minsi ya vuba, turateganya gushyiraho uburyo bufasha abagenzi gukaraba alcool mu ntoki, mbere yo kwinjira mu modoka.” Nubwo RURA itatangaje igihe bizatangirira, yagaragaje ko bakiri kunoza iyo gahunda ku buryo izatangira mu minsi ya vuba. Coronavirus nshya ni icyorezo gihangayikishije Isi, cyatangiriye mu Bushinwa mu mpera z’Ukuboza 2019. Muri icyo gihugu abamaze kucyandura ni 80 859, mu gihe abapfuye ari 3 100. Hanze y’u Bushinwa hamaze kwandura abantu 25 208 ndetse abagera kuri 500 bamaze gupfa. Mu ngamba Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yafashe mu gukumira Coronavirus harimo gupima abagenzi banyura ku Kibuga Mpuzamahanga cy’Indege cya Kigali i Kanombe, gushishikariza Abanyarwanda kwirinda kuramukanya abantu bahana ibiganza cyangwa bahoberana, kugabanya ingendo zitari ngombwa mu bihugu byagaragayemo icyo cyorezo. Hari kandi kwirinda gukorora cyangwa kwitsamura iruhande rw’abandi, gukaraba intoki hakoreshejwe amazi asukuye cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo gusukura intoki, kwirinda kwegera abandi igihe cyose warwaye ibicurane, inkorora cyangwa ufite umuriro mwinshi. Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, Kiliziya Gatolika mu Rwanda nayo yashyizeho amabwiriza mashya agomba kubahirizwa n’abayoboke bayo mu gihe bagiye gusenga. Mu mabwiriza mashya yashyizweho, harimo “guhana amahoro ya Kirisitu ku mutima gusa nta guhana ibiganza cyangwa guhoberana”. Ubusanzwe mu misa mu gihe cyo gutura igitambo cya Ukarisitiya, iyo kigana ku musozo, umusaseridoti asaba abakirisitu guhana amahoro ya Kirisitu, agasuhuza ababa bamwegereye, abandi nabo bagasuhuza abo begeranye. Byakorwaga umuntu aha mugenzi we ikiganza cyangwa ahobera uwo begeranye, amubwira ati “akira amahoro ya kirisitu”. Ubu icyo gikorwa cyo gusuhuzanya no guhoberana, ntikizongera gukorwa mu rwego rwo kwirinda iki cyorezo. Irindi bwiriza rijyanye n’igihe cyo guhazwa, aho Inama Nkuru y’Abepisikopi yemeje ko “mu gihe cyo guhazwa, ni ugutega ibiganza, nta guhazwa ku rurimi”. Kuri Kiliziya zitandukanye, mu rwego rwo kwirinda iki cyorezo, mbere y’uko umuntu yinjira, azajya abanza gutega ibibanza ku ducupa turi ku miryango turimo umuti wica udukoko ubundi akarabe.

title: Perezida Kagame yashimye uruhare rw’abagore mu iterambere ry’igihugu
content: Uyu munsi wizihizwa buri wa 8 Werurwe, aho muri uyu mwaka mu Rwanda wizihijwe ku nsanganyamatsiko igira iti “Umugore ku ruhembe mu iterambere.” Mu butumwa yanyujije kuri Twitter yagize ati “Iyo umugore yungutse, twese twunguka nk’igihugu. Nta terambere nyaryo rishoboka hatabayeho uburinganire. Mwarakoze ku ruhare rukwiye mugira mu iterambere ry’u Rwanda. Umunsi mpuzamahanga mwiza w’abagore kuri bashiki bacu, ababyeyi n’abakobwa bacu mu Rwanda no hirya no hino ku Isi.” Whenever women gain,we all gain as a country. There can be no true progress without equality. Thank you for playing your rightful and equal role in Rwanda’s transformation. Happy International Women’s Day to our sisters,mothers & daughters in Rwanda and across the world. #IWD2020 — Paul Kagame (@PaulKagame) March 8, 2020 Perezida Kagame ashimwa kuba mu miyoborere yarahaye umwanya abagore mu nzego zose, ku buryo magingo aya muri Guverinoma y’u Rwanda igizwe n’abantu 32, harimo abagore 17 bingana na 53%. Abagore mu Nteko Ishinga amategeko ni 61%, kandi bafite ubwiganze mu zindi nzego. Mu mwaka wa 2016 nibwo Perezida Kagame yashimiwe uruhare rwe mu guteza imbere abagore mu Rwanda bakagera no mu nzego zifata ibyemezo kandi bashoboye no kwibeshaho bitandukanye n’uko mbere byari bimeze aho bahezwaga mu bikorwa bimwe. Ni igihembo yahawe n’Ihuriro Nyafurika riharanira Iterambere ry’Abagore, African Women Movements, mu gikorwa ‘Gender Champions Award’ cyo guhemba abagize uruhare mu kwimakaza ihame ry’uburinganire muri Afurika. U Rwanda rumaze kuba indashyikirwa ku Isi mu guteza imbere uburinganire. Raporo Mpuzamahanga ku buringanire ‘The Global Gender Gap Index’ y’umwaka wa 2020, igaragaza ko u Rwanda ruza ku mwanya wa mbere muri Afurika n’uwa cyenda ku Isi, rukagira amajwi 79.1%. Ibihugu biza imbere mu kuziba icyuho mu buringanire ni Iceland, umwanya yajeho ku nshuro ya 11 yikurikiranya. Hakurikiraho Norvège (84.2%), Finlande (83.2%) Suède (82.0%), Nicaragua (80.4%), Nouvelle Zélande (79.9%), Irlande (79.8%), Espagne (79.5%), u Rwanda (79.1%) n’u Budage (78.7%).

title: Iran: Umudepite wa kabiri yahitanywe na coronavirus
content: Umudepite witwa Fatemeh Rahbar yapfuye nyuma y’iminsi atorewe guhagararira Umujyi wa Tehran mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko ya Iran. Guhera tariki 19 Gashyantare, Iran yibasiwe bikomeye na Coronavirus  kugeza ubwo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu yari imaze guhitana abantu 145, mu gihe abayanduye bose hamwe basaga 5800, abayikize bakaba ari 1663. Rahbar w’imyaka 55 yabaye umudepite wa kabiri wishwe na Coronavirus muri Iran. Ni umwe kandi mu banyapolitiki barindwi imaze guhitana guhera muri Gashyantare 2020. Coronavirus yibasiye Iran yamaze no kugera mu bindi bihugu bituranye nayo  nka Misiri, Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Abarabu, Iraq, Liban na Palestine. Ibyo bihugu n’ibindi bibarizwa mu Burasirazuba bwo Hagati byafashe ingamba zikomeye zitandukanye zigamije kugabanya ikwirakwizwa ry’iyo virusi. Nka Koweït yahise ihagarika ingendo zose ziva cyangwa zijya mu bihugu birindwi mu gihe cy’icyumweru. Mu bihugu byahagaritswemo ingendo harimo Bangladesh, Philippines, u Buhinde, Sri Lanka, Syria, Liban na Misiri.

title: Kicukiro: Umwe yarashwe undi aratoroka, ubwo bageragezaga gucukura inzu bashaka kwiba
content: Ahagana mu rukerera rwo ku wa Gatandatu, tariki ya 7 Werurwe 2020, nibwo abajura babiri bashatse kwinjira mu nzu y’umuturage. Amakuru IGIHE ifite ni uko umwe muri bo yarashwe ashatse kurwanya abapolisi bari babasanze bari gucukura inzu; umwe yashatse kubakubita umutarimba yari arimo gucukuza, mu gihe mugenzi we bari bari kumwe we yahise yiruka akibona abapolisi bahingutse. Kugeza ubu nta myirondoro y’uwarashwe yari yamenyekana kuko nta cyangombwa na kimwe yari afite, ariko abaturage bageze aho byabereye bagaragaje ko ashobora kuba ari mu kigero cy’imyaka 23. Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu Mujyi wa Kigali, CIP Marie Goretti Umutesi, yavuze ko uwarashwe yahise ajyanwa ku Bitaro bya Kacyiru. Ati "Abapolisi basanze abo bajura bari gucukura inzu y’umuturage bakoresheje imitarimba n’imihoro. Umwe yahise yiruka aburirwa irengero, undi arwanya polisi iramurasa.’’ CIP Umutesi yakomeje avuga ko abantu bashaka kurwanya inzego z’umutekano mu gihe zibasanze bari gukora ibyaha baba bafite imyumvire idahwitse, kuko amategeko abuza buri muntu wese gushaka kurwanya abashinzwe umutekano mu buryo ubwo aribwo bwose. Polisi ivuga ko bimaze kugaragara ko abajura basigaye bajya kwiba abenshi banyoye ibiyobyabwenge kandi ngo nta byangombwa baba bitwaje kugira ngo hatazagira upfa kumenya imyirondoro yabo yuzuye. Yibukije ko kurwanya inzego zishinzwe umutekano ari ukutareba kure kuko bishobora gutuma ubikoze abitakarizamo ubuzima.

title: Kenya: Visi Perezida William Ruto mu bihe bikomeye
content: Ruto wakunze kwibasirwa cyane muri Kenya, ibihe biheruka kurushaho kuba bibi ubwo abagabo babiri, Umunya-Misiri Mustafa Mamdough Amer Lofty n’Umunyamerika Kozlowski Stanley Bruno, ku wa 13 Gashyantare binjiraga mu biro bye bari kumwe n’uwahoze ari Minisitiri wa Siporo, Rashid Echesa. Muri ibyo biro bizwi nka Harambee House Annex bahasinyiye amasezerano ya baringa afite agaciro ka miliyari hafi 40 z’amashilling ya Kenya (miliyoni €366), byitwa ko Ikigo Eco advance Technology LLC kigiye guha Minisiteri y’Ingabo ya Kenya ikoranabuhanga mu bwirinzi bwa gisirikare. Hari ku wa 13 Gashyantare. Echesa yaje gusaba miliyoni 11.5 z’amashillingi ya Kenya abayobozi b’icyo kigo, kugira ngo bahabwe iryo soko. Nyuma yaje gutabwa muri yombi n’abo bafatanyije muri ubwo butekamutwe. Bakurikiranyweho guhimba inyandiko n’ibirango bya leta, no gushaka kwihesha amafaranga mu buriganya. Iperereza rirakomeje Ku wa Kane, Umuyobozi w’Urwego rw’Ubugenzacyaha muri Kenya, DCI, George Kinoti, yavuze ko Echesa yahuriye n’abashyitsi mu Biro bya William Ruto mu gihe kingana n’isaha imwe, iminota makumyabiri n’amasegonda mirongo itanu n’icyenda, ari nabwo bikekwa ko bakoze ubwo bucuruzi bw’amanyanga, mu gihe Ruto aheruka kuvuga ko yamenye ko bamazemo iminota 23. Ni ibikorwa Ruto yakomeje kuvuga ko byihishwe inyuma n’abahanganye na we muri politiki bagamije kumuharabika, asaba inzego z’ubutabera gukurikirana ababigizemo uruhare, “njye mundeke nkomeze gukorera igihugu cyanjye.” Ubugenzacyaha buvuga ko bishoboka cyane ko ibiro bya William Ruto byari bizi neza ibirimo gukorwa muri ayo manyanga. Ibintu byarushijeho kuba bibi Mu gihe iperereza ryari ririmbanyije, ku wa 20 Gashyantare byamenyekanye ko Sergeant Kipyegon Kenei wari umurinzi ku biro bya Visi Perezida Ruto yapfuye, bibanza gutangazwa ko yiyahuye. Gusa DCI yaje kwemeza ko yishwe n’abantu bataramenyekana, banahimba amayeri ngo bise n’aho yiyahuye, nk’uko ikinyamakuru The Standard cyabitangaje. Kenei yari yakoze ku munsi Echesa n’inshuti ze binjiraga muri Annex House aho visi perezida akorera, ndetse yishwe mbere y’umunsi umwe ngo akoreshwe inyandikomvugo muri DCI ku birego bikomeje gukururana. Kinoti yakomeje ati “Ibyavuye mu igenzura rya muganga ryerekanye ko yishwe. Ni ubwicanyi bwari bwateguwe, maze abicanyi babigira nk’aho yiyahuye. Turimo gukora iperereza ku bwicanyi ntabwo ari ku kwiyahura.” Yanavuze ko uburyo basanze Kenei aryamye mu nzu nta kimenyetso na kimwe cyatuma hakekwa ko yiyahuye, ndetse bishoboka cyane ko abamwishe yari abazi neza, kubera ko mbere y’umunsi yishweho, yari yabanje kugisha inama inshuti ze ku buryo yatangamo inyandikomvugo ye mu bugenzacyaha. Izo mvugo nazo Ruto yazifashe nk’iza politiki, ndetse avuga ko aho gukomeza gushyira mu bitangazamakuru imvugo n’ibisa n’ikinamico ritarangira, umuryango wa Kenei n’ibiro bya visi Perezida yakoreraga, bikeneye kumenya ukuri. Ku wa Gatanu yanditse kuri Twitter ati “Ukuri kugomba kujya ahabona kukerekana impamvu, uko byagenze n’uwishe Sergeant Kenei.” Ubwo yari mu muhango wo kumushyingura, Ruto yavuze ko bibabaje kuba hejuru y’ibikorwa byose birimo kuba, ushinzwe umutekano ari we ubaye igitambo, hejuru y’uko birimo gukorwa n’abahanganye na we muri politiki. Ati “Ndasaba abarimo kundwanya muri politiki ngo abandi babareke. Bishe Kenei kubera ko ari we muntu wari kuvuga ukuri kuri uwo muntu wazanye abazungu n’abantu bigize abajenerali mu biro byanjye.” Yavuze ko abo bantu bakoze ibyo bose bafite ubufasha bukomeye, ariko ko hejuru ya byose hari Imana. Hashingiwe ku mashusho ya camera yafatiwe mu biro bya Visi Perezida Ruto, Kenei ngo yari umwe mu batangabuhamya b’ibyo biboneye, kuko agaragara aha ikaze abo bantu mu cyuma kizamura abantu mu nyubako ahagenewe abanyacyubahiro, muri abo harimo uwari wiyambitse nka Jenerali mu ngabo za Kenya. Ubwo basohokaga muri ‘ascenseur’ bageze ku igorofa rya kabiri muri Harambee House Annex, ngo Kenei yavugiraga kuri telefoni, ahita ayihereza uwitwa Daniel Otieno Omondi uzwi nka General Juma. Birashoboka ko umuntu wari umuhamagaye, yamusabye guhereza telefoni uwo bari bafite ibyo baziranyeho. Hari byinshi byibazwa Visi Perezida Ruto yibaza uburyo abantu bashakaga kugura intwaro bari kujya kurangiriza amasezerano mu biro bye aho kujya muri Minisiteri y’Ingabo, cyane ko nubwo ari visi Perezida, adafatwa nk’Umugaba w’Ikirenga wungirije w’Ingabo za Kenya. Byongeye, ngo amashusho agaragaza ko baganiriye ndetse basinya bicaye aho abashyitsi bategerereza kwakirwa mu biro. Ruto yavuze ko ntaho ahurira n’ibijyanye n’ingabo, ku buryo iyi migambi yacuzwe itamuteye ubwoba. Ati “Niteguye guhangana nabyo. Abishe Kenei bashobora nanjye kunyica ariko ntabwo nzasubira inyuma. Kenya ni iyacu twese.” “Niba mwarishe Kenei ngo muntere ubwoba, amaraso ye azabakurikirana. Ndi visi Perezida wa Kenya, nzi ibyo mvuga. Ntabwo ndi umusazi.” Kugeza ubu igikomeje gutera urujijo ni uko abicanyi bahise bakorana na bamwe mu bakozi b’Ikigo cya Safaricom, ku buryo itumanaho rya Kenei ryose ryasibwe n’ibiri muri telefoni ye bigasibwa, ibyo nabyo bikaba bikeneye iperereza. Byongeye, Minisiteri y’Ingabo muri Kenya yeruye ko nta kintu na kimwe izi kuri iryo soko ry’ibikoresho bya gisirikare. Inkubiri ya BBI Muri Kenya hakomeje ibiganiro kuri gahunda yiswe Building Bridges Initiative, BBI, igamije kureba impinduka zikenewe mu miyoborere ya Kenya, hashingiwe ku bibazo byakunze kuranga Kenya bishingiye ku moko n’imvururu zikunze gukurikira amatora. Ni gahunda ifatwa nk’itarakiriwe neza n’uruhande rwa William Ruto mu ishyaka Jubilee riri ku butegetsi, ku buryo hari bamwe batangiye kumwadukira, bikavugwa ko muri ibyo bitekerezo birimo gukusanywa, hashobora kuzasabwa ko Perezida Kenyatta asimburwa na Raila Odinga, aho kuba Ruto nk’uko amaze iminsi abyifuza. Nyuma y’iyi nkubiri yose, bamwe mu basenateri bo mu ishyaka ODM rya Odinga batangaje ko batangiye kureba inzira ziteganywa n’Itegeko Nshinga, mu gukurikirana Visi Perezida Ruto nk’uko Daily Nation yabitangaje. Senateri James Orengo yagize ati "Mube mwihanganye. Mu byumweru bibiri tuzatangira urugendo rwo guhangana na we.” Abagize ishyaka ODM basabye ubugnzacyaha gukurikirana Visi Perezida kugira ngo ahishure ibyo azi kuri urwo rupfu, kuko bafata imvugo ze zigamishe gutera ubwoba ubutabera. title: Kigali: Abamotari bashyiriweho amasomo y’Icyongereza mu kwitegura inama ya CHOGM
content: Inama ya CHOGM izabera mu Rwanda kuva tariki ya 22 kugeza tariki 27 Kamena 2020, ikazitabirwa n’abakuru b’ibihugu na za guverinoma zikoresha Icyongereza. Ubuyobozi bw’abamotari mu Rwanda bwatangaje ko bwahisemo gushyiraho amashuri y’Icyongereza mu rwego rwo kwitegura inama ya CHOGM kuko bwasanze abamotari bagifite imbogamizi muri uru rurimi. Umuyobozi wa FERWACOTAMO, Ngarambe Daniel, yabwiye IGIHE ko basanze bakwiye gushinga ishuri ry’Icyongereza kugira ngo bafashe abamotari kumenya uru rurimi. Yagize ati “Hari nk’igihe umumotari yatse umunyamahanga amafaranga 100 yayavuze mu Cyongereza kandi yashakaga kumwaka 1000 ntibumvikana. Umunyamahanga yatubwiye ibyo yamubwiye dusanga batumvikanye kubera ururimi, rero twabikoze mu rwego rwo kugira ngo bajye batanga serivisi nziza kandi neza.” Nk’abantu bahura n’abantu benshi, Ngarambe yavuze ko bifuza ko abamotari bazabasha kumvikana n’abazaba bitabiriye inama ya CHOGAM mu gihe bagize aho babasaba kubajyana. Ati “Inama ya CHOGM iri mu byatumye dutegura aya mashuri kuko nubwo dufite abamotari bize, umubare mwinshi ni uw’abatazi izindi ndimi mu gihe usanga dutwara abanyamahanga benshi.” Yongeyeho ko bafite icyizere cy’uko muri Kamena abamotari benshi bo muri Kigali bazaba bazi byibuze amagambo y’ibanze bashobora gukoresha baciririkanwa n’abanyamahanga. Byukusenge Emmanuel ukora akazi ko gutwara abantu kuri moto mu Mujyi wa Kigali, yavuze ko kuba barashyiriweho ishuri bizabafasha kubona inyungu ifatika muri CHOGM. Ati “Ni ibintu twishimiye cyane kuko wasangaga duhura n’abagenzi b’abanyamahanga cyane cyane abazungu tukananirwa kumvikana rimwe na rimwe bakatwishyura amafaranga make ugereranyije n’ayo twagakwiye guhabwa kubera ikibazo cy’ururimi ariko kuba twashyiriweho amashuri byadushimishije kuko bizatwongerera inyungu.” Muhizi Jean Claude, we avuga ko ishuri ry’Icyongereza ku bamotari riziye igihe ndetse akanashimangira ko ribafiteye akamaro kanini. Ati “Ubu twatangiye kukiga kugira ngo mu kwa Gatandatu hazagere tukidudubiza neza kandi twizeye ko bizadufasha cyane. Hari aho umuntu yahuraga n’umuzungu akamwihorera kubera ko yabaga azi ko batari bwumvikane ku bijyanye n’ururimi.” Biteganyijwe ko abamotari baziga indimi eshatu zirimo Igifaransa, Igiswahili n’Icyongereza ariko umwihariko ukaba Icyongereza. Buri mumotari yishyura amafaranga ibihumbi bitatu mu kwezi kugira ngo yigishwe izo ndimi. Ku munsi, umumotari ahabwa amasaha abiri yo kwiga. FERWACOTAMO itangaza ko nyuma y’Umujyi wa Kigali, ayo masomo azagezwa no mu tundi turere.

title: Madamu Jeannette Kagame yitabiriye igikorwa cyo kwerekana bwa mbere filime ‘Petit Pays’ ya Gaël Faye (Amafoto)
content: ‘Petit Pays’ yerekanwe bwa mbere mu Rwanda mu gikorwa cyabereye muri Kigali Century Cinema ku mugoroba wo ku wa Gatandatu tariki 7 Werurwe 2020. Iki gikorwa cyitabiriwe n’abarimo Madamu Jeannette Kagame n’abandi bafite izina mu bijyanye no gukina filime, abagize uruhare mu itunganywa rya ‘Petit Pays’ barimo abakinnyi, abatunganya amashusho n’abandi bari mu ruganda rwa Sinema mu Rwanda. Gaël Faye wari muri iki gikorwa yashimiye abakinnye muri filime ‘Petit Pays’, anavuga incamake yayo. Abenshi mu bakinnye muri filime ya Gaël Faye biganjemo Abanyarwanda, kuko bitatu bya kane by’abari bashinzwe tekiniki mu ifatwa ry’amashusho yayo na 95% by’abayikinnye bakomoka mu rwa Gasabo. Umukinnyi w’imena witwa Isabelle Kabano ukina muri iyi filime yitwa Yvonne, yashimiye abagize uruhare ngo iyi filime ibashe gutunganywa. Ati “Nshimiye buri wese wagize uruhare kugira ngo iyi filime ibashe gukorwa, nshimiye Gaël Faye, nshimiye inshuti zanjye z’abakinnyi bari muri iyi filime na Eric wayikoze.” Iki gikorwa cyari kigamije kwereka itangazamakuru, abakinnyi bo muri iyi filime n’abandi bantu bari batumiwe umusaruro wavuye mu gikorwa cyo gufata amajwi n’amashusho byayo. Biteganijwe ko iyi filime izajya hanze ku mugaragaro ku wa 18 Werurwe 2020. Guhera tariki 14 Mutarama 2019 filime ishingiye ku gitabo cya Gaël Faye yise ‘Petit Pays’  yatangiye gukinirwa mu Karere ka Rubavu, aho yakozwe n’Umufaransa Eric Barbier biciye muri studio yitwa Jerico. Iyi filime ishingiye ku nkuru y’ubuzima bw’umwana wavukiye i Burundi abyarwa n’umunyarwandakazi w’impunzi n’umuzungu w’Umufaransa. Uwo  mwana avuga uko yabonaga ubuzima muri icyo gihe, ibibazo by’amoko y’Abahutu n’Abatutsi. Uwo mwana uba ufite hagati y’imyaka 10 na 15, aba yibuka uburyo ubuto bwe bwaje kwicwa n’ibibazo bya politiki zo muri aka karere. Anavuga ku kibazo cyo kuvuka ku babyeyi badahuje uruhu. Nyuma yaje guhungishirizwa i Burayi ari nabwo yaje kubona ko kuba imvange bigoye kuko haba i Birundi no mu Burayi, hose abantu bamufataga nk’umunyamahanga. Amaze gukura yiyemeje kugaruka muri Afurika kuko ariho nibura yumvaga ari iwabo. Mu byatumye yumva yigaruriye icyizere ni ugukunda gusoma no kwandika. Filime ‘Petit Pays’ ivuga ku mateka yaranze u Burundi n’u Rwanda, mu myaka ya za 90 na nyuma yaho. Agatabo gato (novel) kakomotseho iyi filime ‘Petit Pays’ kahesheje Gaël Faye ibihembo birenze bitanu birimo bine yahawe mu 2016 n’ikindi kimwe yahawe mu 2017. Mu 2019 kahatanaga mu bihembo bishamikiye ku Ishyirahamwe Riharanira Iterambere ry’Abirabura muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika [NAACP], ryatangijwe ubwo abirabura bafatwaga nabi mu nzego zose z’ubuzima bw’icyo gihugu. Gaël Faye ni umuhanzi umaze kubaka izina mu buryo bukomeye ku Mugabane w’u Burayi by’umwihariko mu Bufaransa, mu kuririmba, kwandika ibitabo no mu ruganda rwa sinema. Yavukiye mu Rwanda arererwa i Bujumbura mu Burundi, yerekeje i Paris afite imyaka 13, nyuma aza gutura mu Rwanda nyuma yo kurushinga. Gaël Faye yamenyakanye mu ndirimbo zakunzwe i Burayi zirimo iyitwa "Je pars," "Ma femme," "Petit Pays," "Pili Pili" n’izindi. Mu 2018 uyu muraperi ni umwe mu baririmbye mu birori bikomeye byabereye mu nzu y’ibitaramo ya Zénith yo mu Mujyi wa Paris ndetse ahembwa mu bahanzi bagaragaza ubuhanga n’imbaraga mu bihembo bya "Victoires de la Musique" byabaga ku nshuro yabyo ya 33. title: Umwe mu bitabiriye inama yarimo Perezida Trump yasanzwemo coronavirus
content: Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, uwo muryango watangaje ko uwagaragaweho n’iyo virusi aherutse kwitabira inama yigaga ku ruhare rwa politiki mu kubungabunga ibidukikije, yabereye muri Leta ya Maryland hagati ya tariki 26-29 Gashyantare 2020. Ibitaro byo muri New Jersey byasuzumye uwo muntu, byemeje ko arwaye Coronavirus, akaba yahise ashyirwa mu kato aho ari kwitwabwaho n’abaganga nkuko Ibiro Ntaramakuru by’Abashinwa, Xinhua byabitangaje. Inama uwo muntu yari yitabiriye, yarimo abayobozi bakomeye muri Leta ya Amerika barimo Perezida Donald Trump, Visi Perezida Mike Pence, Ushinzwe ububanyi n’Amahanga Mike Pompeo; Umunyamabanga ushinzwe Ubuzima, Alex Azar ndetse n’Ushinzwe Abakozi muri Perezidansi ya Amerika, Mark Meadows. Ushinzwe Itangazamakuru muri Perezidansi ya Amerika, Stephanie Grisham kuri uyu wa Gatandatu yavuze ko bamenye amakuru y’uwo muntu wasanzwemo Coronavirus nyuma yo kuva mu nama yarimo Trump, gusa ngo ntabwo yigeze yegera aho Perezida yari ari. Yagize ati “Kugeza ubu nta cyerekana ko haba Perezida Trump na Visi Perezida Pence baba barahuye cyangwa bari bari hafi y’uwo wasanzwemo indwara.” Mu itangazo ryashyizwe hanze, Ibiro bya Perezida wa Amerika byatangaje ko hafashwe ingamba zikomeye z’ubwirinzi kuri Perezida n’umuryango we ndetse n’abakozi ba Perezidansi. Kugeza kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, abantu 420 bari bamaze kugaragarwaho Coronavirus muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, 17 muri bo yarabahitanye.

title: U Buhinde: Yatawe muri yombi ashinjwa gukorakorera mu ndege umukobwa wari uvuye mu  Rwanda
content: Uwo mugabo yatawe muri yombi na Polisi kuri uyu wa Gatandatu ashinjwa gukorakora umukobwa wari umwicaye imbere mu rugendo rw’indege yavaga mu Rwanda. Ikinyamakuru Mumbai Mirror cyatangaje ko uwatawe muri yombi atuye muri Leta ya Gujarat iri mu Burengerazuba bw’u Buhinde. Umukobwa wakorakowe bivugwa ko yari asanzwe ari umunyeshuri w’imyaka 21 wiga muri imwe muri Kaminuza mu Rwanda ariko akomoka mu Buhinde. Polisi ivuga ko mu rugendo bakoze bava mu Rwanda bajya Mumbai, uwo mukobwa yagiye yicaye imbere ya Ankit Patel. Ngo uregwa yakorakoye uwo mukobwa inshuro nyinshi. Bageze ku kibuga cy’indege i Mumbai, umukobwa yihutiye kubimenyesha Polisi ihita ita muri yombi ukekwa.

title: Nyabihu: Umucungamutungo wa SACCO yatawe muri yombi ashinjwa kunyereza umutungo
content: Uwo mugabo yahise ajyanwa kuri Sitasiyo ya RIB ya Mukamira mu gihe iperereza rikomeje kugira ngo hakorwe dosiye ishyikirizwe Ubushinjacyaha, nkuko RIB yabitangaje ibinyujije kuri Twitter kuri uyu wa Gatandatu. Ntabwo uburyo uwo mutungo wanyerejwemo byatangajwe. RIB yaboneyeho gukangurira Abanyarwanda kwirinda kunyereza ibya rubanda bashinzwe gucunga, inashimira abakomeje kuyitungira agatoki abakora ibyaha kugira ngo bafatwe bashyikirizwe ubutabera. Ingingo ya 10 y’itegeko ryerekeye kurwanya ruswa ivuga ko umuntu wese, yaba umukozi wa Leta cyangwa undi ukora umurimo wa Leta cyangwa ukora mu nzego zayo, umuyobozi cyangwa umukozi mu kigo cy’ubucuruzi cyangwa sosiyete y’ubucuruzi cyangwa koperative cyangwa ukorera undi muntu, umuryango ushingiye ku idini cyangwa undi muryango uwo ari wo wose, ukoresha mu nyungu ze cyangwa iz’undi, umutungo, amafaranga cyangwa inyandiko z’agaciro, yahawe cyangwa yashyikirijwe kubera imirimo akora cyangwa ukoresha mu nyungu ze abakozi ashinzwe ku bw’umurimo aba akoze icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko, ahanishwa igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka irindwi ariko kitarenze imyaka icumi n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda yikubye inshuro kuva kuri eshatu  kugeza kuri eshanu  z’agaciro k’umutungo yanyereje.

title: Gasabo: Imvubu yari imaze iminsi yangiza imyaka y’abaturage yarashwe irapfa
content: Kuva mu ntangiriro z’iki cyumweru bamwe mu baturage bo mu mirenge ya Rusororo na Masaka bari bahangayikishijwe n’imvubu bikekwa ko yaturutse muri Pariko y’Igihugu y’Akagera, yangizaga ibihingwa byabo ndetse bakikanga ko ishobora no guhohotera abantu. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Rusororo, Nduwayezu Alfred, yemeje ko iyi mvubu yarashwe, bityo abaturage yari iteye inkeke bakwiye gusubiza umutima mu gitereko. Ati “Ahagana saa 01h45, inzego zibishinzwe zarashe iyi nyamanswa yari imaze iminsi ihangayikishije abaturage; ubu ikigiye gukurikiraho ni ukujya kuyijugunya mu buryo bwatanzweho umurongo n’inzego zose bireba.” Nduwayezu avuga ko abaturage babanje gukeka ko imyaka yabo iri kwangizwa n’abandi bantu bagamije kubahemukira, ariko baza kubona ibinono by’iyo mvubu. Uyu muyobozi yavuze ko bakeka ko ishobora kuba yaraturutse muri Pariki y’Igihugu y’Akagera, ikagera muri Gasabo kubera umuvu w’imvura imaze iminsi igwa cyane. Kugeza ubu nta mibare nyayo igaragaza ibyo iyo mvubu yangije mu gihe yari imaze, ariko amakuru atangwa n’ubuyobozi ni uko nta muntu n’umwe yishe.

title: U Butaliyani: Abantu miliyoni 16 bamaze gushyirwa mu kato kubera Coronavirus
content: Minisitiri w’Intebe mu Butaliyani, Giuseppe Conte, yavuze ko iki cyemezo kigamije kubungabunga ubuzima bw’abaturage. Yagize ati “Turashaka kubungabunga ubuzima bw’abaturage bacu, turabizi ko izi ngamba zizasaba kwigomwa ariko iki ni igihe aho tugomba gufata izo inshingano.” Abantu bo muri utu duce twashyizwe mu kato ntibemerewe kuharenga ndetse nta n’uvuye ahandi wemerewe kuhagera kereka igihe biri ngombwa cyane. Kuva Coronavirus yagera mu Butaliyani imaze guhitana abarenga 230 mu gihe umubare w’abamaze kwandura wo wazamutse ukava ku 1200 ukagera kuri 5883. BBC ivuga ko iyi mibare yarushijeho kuzamuka ku wa 7 Werurwe aho mu masaha 24 gusa abarenga 50 bari bamaze kwitaba Imana, naho umubare w’abanduye ukiyongeraho 4 683. Mu rwego rwo guhangana n’iki cyorezo u Butaliyani bwafashe ingamba zirimo gufunga inzu zikorerwamo imyitozo ngororamubiri zizwi nka ‘Gym’, inzu ndangamurage no gusubika imwe mu mihango ihuza abantu benshi irimo ubukwe n’ibiriyo kugeza ku wa 3 Mata 2020.

title: EXIM Bank y’u Bushinwa yongeye kwima Uganda inguzanyo yo kubaka umuhanda wa gari ya moshi
content: Ubwo iyi banki yasubizaga ubusabe bwa kabiri bwa Uganda bwo kugurizwa 85% bya Miliyari $2.268 zizakoreshwa mu kubuka uyu muhanda, yayibwiye ko bigomba kubanza gusobanuka niba Kenya igifite gahunda yo kubaka uwayo ikageza ku mupaka, kugira ngo habeho ihuzwa ryoroshye. Kugira ngo Uganda ihabwe inguzanyo, birasaba ko Kenya yerekana ko igifite gahunda yo kubaka igice cyayo kizava Naivasha-Kisumu kikagera Malaba aho Uganda izahera nayo yubaka uwayo. Umuhuzabikorwa w’uyu mushinga, Perez Wamburu aganira na The East African yavuze  ko Kenya na Uganda biri mu biganiro kugira ngo barebe icyakorwa. Yagize ati “Exim Bank y’u Bushinwa yasubije kandi irashaka ibisobanuro ku ihuzwa rya SGR ya Uganda n’iya Kenya, kuko yagabanyije(Kenya) umuvuduko muri uyu mushinga, hari kuba ibiganiro byo mu rwego rwo hejuru hagati ya Kenya na Uganda kugira ngo bemeranye ku ngengabihe nshya.” Ntabwo ari ubwa mbere Exim Bank yima Uganda inguzanyo yo kubaka uyu muhanda kuko  ubwa mbere yayisabye ko yayiha inyigo inoze neza yerekana uko imirimo yo kubaka  izagenda. Nyuma yo kunoza inyigo neza ikagabanya n’amafaranga ikeneye ho miliyoni $26 akagera kuri miliyari $2.268, muri Nzeri,2019 Uganda yarongeye isaba Exim Bank kuyiguriza nubwo nabyo bitagenze nk’uko yabyifuzaga. Uyu muhanda wa kilometero 273 uzava ku mupaka uhuza Uganda na Kenya ugere mu murwa mukuru Kampala,ukaba witezweho kuzasimbura uwari uhari ushaje bityo bikorohereza urujya n’uruza rw’abantu n’ibintu.

title: Nyamagabe: Polisi yafatiye mu cyuho abangizaga ishyamba rya Leta
content: Umuvugizi wa Polisi  mu ntara y’Amajyepfo, Chief Inspector of Police (CIP) Sylvestre Twajamahoro yavuze ko Polisi yahawe amakuru n’abaturage baturiye iryo shyamba bavuga ko hari abantu bigabiza iryo shyamba bakajya kuritemamo ibiti. Yagize ati "Tukimara kumenya ayo makuru twarakurikiranye dufata bariya bagabo bombi barimo kubaza ibiti muri ririya shyamba riri ahitwa Gasasa. Twasanze babanje kubikatamo ingeri zimwe barimo kuzibazamo imbaho izindi barimo kuzitwikamo  amakara." Aba bagabo bombi bahise bashyikirizwa urwego rw’igihugu rushinzwe ubugenzacyaha rukorera muri Sitasiyo ya Polisi ya Kitabi kugira ngo hatangire iperereza  ku cyaha bakoze. CIP Twajamahoro yashimiye abaturage bakomeje gufatanya na Polisi mu bikorwa byo kurwanya no gukumira ibyaha batangira amakuru ku gihe. Yagize ati ’’Turashimira abaturage bakomeje gufatanya na Polisi mu kurwanya ibyaha. Ndagira ngo nibutse abangiza ibidukikije cyane cyane amashyamba ko baba bihemukira kandi bahemukira ibinyabuzima byose kuko ariya mashyamba bangiza niyo atanga umwuka mwiza duhumeka ndetse akagira uruhare runini mu gutuma tubona imvura akanafata ubutaka bw’igihugu cyacu ntibutwarwe n’isuri." Itegeko N°48/2018 ryo ku wa 13/08/2018, mu ngingo yaryo ya 44 rivuga ko hagamijwe kurengera ibinyabuzima, ibikorwa bikurikira birabujijwe: gutwika amashyamba, pariki z’Igihugu n’ibyanya; gutwika ibishanga, inzuri, ibihuru, ibyatsi hagamijwe ubuhinzi cyangwa gutunganya inzuri z’amatungo ndetse n’ibindi bikorwa ibyo aribyo byose byangiza ibidukikije birabujijwe. Ingingo ya 59 y’iri tegeko ivuga ko umuntu wese utuma ibimera bikomye bipfa, ubisenya, ubisarura cyangwa ubyangiza, aba akoze icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko, ahanishwa igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka itatu ariko kitarenze imyaka itanu n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda atari munsi ya miliyoni imwe  ariko atarenze miliyoni eshatu.
