title: Inyungu ku Rwanda, aho imyiteguro yo kwakira CHOGM igeze…Ikiganiro na Minisitiri Dr Biruta
content: Ku itariki 22 kugeza kuri 27 Kamena 2020 u Rwanda rwiteguye kwakira inama ya CHOGM (The Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting). Mu myiteguro bimwe byaratunganye ibindi bikomeje gutegurwa no gushyirwa mu buryo kugira ngo abazayitabira bazakirwe neza. Ni inama u Rwanda ruzakira nyuma y’uko rugaragaje ko rubiftiye ubushake n’ubushobozi rumaze kubona ko umugabane wa Afurika ariwo utahiwe. CHOGM ni inama yitabirwa n’abantu bari hagati ya 5 000 na 8 000. Kuyakira bisaba ko igihugu cyerekana ubushake hakabaho kureba ko igihugu gifite ubushobozi. Mu kureba ubwo bushobozi harebwa ibintu bitandukanye, birimo aho inama izakirirwa,  indege zigana aho hantu, uko bantu babona Visa, umutekano, imiyoborere n’ibindi. Minisitiri Biruta mu kiganiro na Televiziyo Rwanda, yavuze ko nyuma yo kwemezwa kuzayakira, u Rwanda rwatangiye imyiteguro ndetse ngo irarimbanyije. Ati “ Tumaze iminsi twitegura, hari n’ibihugu byohereje intumwa zabyo ziza kureba aho bigeze kureba aho inama izabera,  aho bazacumbika, uburyo bazakirwa ku kibuga n’ibindi. Ibyo byose birakorwa mu gihe twitegura iriya nama.” Inyungu z’u Rwanda muri Commonwealth U Rwanda rwinjiye muri Commonwealth mu Ugushyingo 2009. Ni umuryango uhuza ibihugu 54 byiganjemo ibyakolonijwe n’u Bwongereza bikaba binakoresha Icyongereza ariko hakabamo n’ibindi birimo n’u Rwanda bitakolonijwe nabwo ariko bikoresha Icyongereza. Mu myaka irenga 10 u Rwanda rwabonyemo inyungu nyinshi zirimo iza Politiki n’iz’ubukungu. Uretse ibyo, Minisitiri Biruta avuga ko  ishoramari ryiyongera binyuze mu nama nk’iyo ya CHOGM rugiye kwakira. Ati “Iyo habayeho inama nk’iriya ntabwo ari abakuru b’ibihugu gusa. Haba harimo n’igice gihuza urubyiruko, abikorera, imiryango itari iya leta, abagore n’ibindi. Iyo tugeze ku bikorera urumva ko haba harimo ibintu by’ishoramari, ibyo byose ni ibintu dufitemo inyungu usibye ko byose bizaganirwaho nk’ibidukikije, imiyoborere, ikoranabuhanga na inovasiyo.” Dr Biruta kandi yagarutse ku nyungu abanyarwanda bazagira kubera kwakira CHOGM, nk’abazabona akazi mu rwego rw’amahoteli, ubukerarugendo n’ubucuruzi. Ati “Amahoteli yose azaba yuzuye n’amahoteli mato cyangwa aho abantu bacumbika hose  hatandukanye   bazaba bafite abashyitsi,  urumva rero harimo akazi ari abafite imodoka bakodesha harimo akazi ndetse bariya bantu baba bafite ibibatunga bitandukanye, ibyo bashaka kugura bazajyana iwabo mu buryo bwo kwiyibutsa ko baje mu Rwanda.” Mu gihe habaye inama mpuzamahanga, hari ubwo biba ngombwa ko imihanda runaka ifungwa kugira ngo abashyitsi batambuke. Nubwo hari abo bibangamira, Dr Biruta yavuze ko byumvikana ko iyo umujyi wagize abashyitsi barimo n’abakuru b’ibihugu mu gihe runaka umuhanda ushobora kuba ufunze, ariko ko ugereranyije n’inyungu ziri mu kwakira iyo nama bitakagombye kuba ikibazo. Ati “ Bishobora kugira icyo bibangamiraho abatuye uyu mujyi […] ariko n’abanyarwanda mu bihe nk’ibi byo kwakira abashyitsi turabateguza kugira ngo babe babizi banadufashe no kwakira abo bashyitsi kandi bumve neza inyungu ikomeye irimo iruta kure ibyo byashobora kubangamira umuntu ku isaha iyi n’iyi.” Yongeyeho ati “Ni ibintu by’iminsi navuga nk’ibiri cyangwa nk’itatu igihe abakuru b’ibihugu bazaba baza cyangwa bataha  ibyo ni ibintu tumenyereye ariko inyungu iva mu kwakira iriya nama zirenze kure ari ibyo dushoramo mu kuyitegura ndetse ari n’ibishobora kutubangamira ku isaha iyi n’iyi ku munsi uyu n’uyu muri iriya minsi. Imyiteguro n’ingengo y’imari yo kuyikora U Rwanda rusanzwe rwakira inama  mpuzamahanga kandi abazitabiriye bagataha bishimye. Kuri iyi nshuro nabwo, ibikorwaremezo nk’imihanda, aho inama izabera n’ibindi bikenewe bikomeje gutunganywa. Umujyi wa Kigali watangaje ko mu mihanda mishya iri kubakwa harimo uva Rwandex ukanyura mu Myembe cyangwa se Rwandex- Kigali Convention Centre. Uyu muhanda wamaze kuzura. Undi muhanda ni unyura ku Biro by’Akarere ka Gasabo - Airtel- Sport View Hotel - Control Technique wo wari  ugeze ku kigero cya 35% wubakwa muri Mutarama. Hari undi muhanda wa Nyabisindu – Nyarutarama - Green Hills – Kibagabaga wo wari ugeze kuri 30%. Uyu muhanda wagenewe miliyari 3.3 Frw hamwe n’uzahuza Kabeza-Alpha Palace uzatangira kubakwa mu cyumweru gitaha. Mu mihanda iri gusanwa harimo uwa Murindi - Rusororo wo wari ugeze kuri 25 %. Umwaka ushize Guverinoma yemeje ingengo y’imari ya miliyari 20.1 Frw zigenewe ibikorwa bibanziriza CHOGM, harimo miliyari 10.87 Frw zizakoreshwa mu kwagura aho indege ziparika ku Kibuga Mpuzamahanga cya Kigali i Kanombe n’ibindi bikorwa ku kibuga. Minisitiri Biruta yatangaje ko uretse ikurikiranabikorwa rikorwa n’ibihugu bizitabira CHOGM nta yindi nkunga rwahawe yo kwitegura CHOGM. Kuri we ngo nta gihombo kirimo kuko ibikorwa byubakwa biba bizahoraho igihugu kigakomeza kubikoresha kandi bikaba byanagihesha no kwakira izindi nama kubera uko cyagaragaye. Ati “Byinshi ni ibikorwa bizaguma aha kandi n’ubundi twari dukeneye. Iyo waguye umuhanda cyangwa ugakora undi ni bikorwa birambye, n’abashyitsi nibagenda ni ibikorwa tuzakomeza gukoresha […] kandi birumvikana nitumara kwakira iyi nama bizaba byumvikana ko dushobora kwakira izindi nama ziri muri ruriya rwego kandi imari yashowe izakomeza igire akamaro no mu bihe bizaza kuko ntibizarangirana n’iriya nama gusa.” Ku kuba  u Rwanda rwaba rwarasabye inkunga yo kurufasha kwitegura, yagize ati “U Rwanda nta bufasha bundi twabonye nta nubwo twanasabye tubikora twumva ko ari ibyacu.” Minisitiri Biruta yasabye ko buri munyarwanda bireba yagira uruhara kugira ngo iyo nama izasige isura y’igihugu igaragaye neza mu ruhando mpuzamahanga. Imyiteguro no kuyimenyekanisha ku buryo buruseho byatangiranye na tariki ya 9 Werurwe 2020 hizihizwa umunsi wahariwe kwizihiza umuryango w’ibihugu bikoresha ururimi rw’Icyongereza Commonwealth. CHOGM izaba igizwe n’ibiganiro bitandukanye birimo ibireba urubyiruko, abikorera, abagore, imiryango itari iya leta n’iby’abakuru b’ibihugu na za Guverinoma.

title: Zimbabwe: Umugabo wakekwagaho coronavirus yatorotse ibitaro
content: Nta muntu n’umwe biremezwa ko arwaye coronavirus muri Zimbabwe ariko Minisiteri y’ubuzima yatangaje ko hari umugabo wo muri Thailand watorotse akekwa. Uwo mugabo w’imyaka 26 yageze muri Zimbabwe muri Gashyantare uyu mwaka, yoherezwa mu bitaro byigenga bya Wilkens Infectious Disease Hospital afite umuriro n’ibicurane. Nubwo atagaragazaga ibimenyetso byose by’abarwayi ba Coronavirus, Minisiteri y’Ubuzima yatangaje ko yagombaga kubanza gusuzumwa kugira ngo barebe niba atarwaye. Polisi ya Zimbabwe yatangiye gushakisha uwo mugabo kugira ngo agarurwe mu bitaro. Imibare igaragaza ko abagera ku ijana aribo bamaze kwandura coronavirus muri Afurika. Barimo 55 bo mu Misiri, 20 muri Algeria, barindwi muri Afurika y’Epfo, batanu muri Tunisia, bane muri Senegal, babiri muri Maroc, babiri muri Cameroun, babiri muri Burkina Faso,  babiri muri Nigeria n’umwe muri Togo.

title: Burera: Umugore w’imyaka 44 yafatanywe  amafaranga ibihumbi 300 y’amiganano
content: Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu ntara y’Amajyaruguru, Chief Inspector of Police (CIP),  Alexis Rugigana avuga ko uyu mugore yafatiwe mu mudugudu wa Kabashotsi, akagari ka Nyamabuye mu murenge wa Kagogo biturutse ku makuru yatangiwe igihe n’abaturage. Yagize ati   “Abaturage bahamagaye Polisi bayimenyesha ko uyu mugore afite amafaranga y’amiganano kandi ko ashobora kuba hari abantu agiye kuyaha bityo akaba yakwirakwizwa henshi.” CIP Rugigana yakomeje avuga ko abapolisi bakimara guhabwa ayo amakuru bahise bihutira kujya aho uwo mugore yari ari mu gace ka Kidaho abonye abo bapolisi ari kuri moto yahise ategeka umumotari wari umuhetse ngo yihute. Ati:   “Yari ahetswe n’umumotari afite agakapu karimo ayo mafaranga, abonye abapolisi abwira umumotari ngo yihute ahita ajya guhisha ako gakapu ahita agaruka n’amaguru ahura n’abo bapolisi ariko ntiyari azi ko ubwo yahishaga ako gakapu bamurebaga.” Abapolisi bamubajije aho ashyize agakapu yari afite avuga ko nta gakapu yari afite  bakomeje kumuhata ibibazo banamusubiza inyuma aho yari aturutse bamwereka aho yahishe ako gakapu kuzuyemo amafaranga y’amiganano. Yahise yemera ko ako gakapu ari ake, barebyemo basangamo ibihumbi 319,000 agizwe n’inoti 2 z’ibihumbi  bibiri izindi zose zari inoti z’ibihumbi Bitanu (5,000Rwf) kandi zihuje nimero. Uyu mugore  ntagaragaza neza aho yakuye ayo mafaranga n’uko ayakora usibye kuvuga ko ari ayo yahawe n’Imana nyuma yo gusenga ayisaba amafaranga. CIP Rugigana yashimiye uruhare rw’abaturage bakomeje kugaragaza mu kwicungira umutekano batanga amakuru y’abakora ibyaha. Yagize ati “Ibi nibyo kwishimira no gushishikariza buri wese kuko umutekano utareba ba runaka gusa ahubwo ari ubufatanye bwa buri muntu. Aya mafaranga atesha agaciro ifaranga ry’igihugu kandi agasubiza inyuma ubukungu bwacyo, niyo mpamvu kuyarwanya no gutanga amakuru ku bayacyekwaho ari uruhare rwa buri wese kuko ntawe atagiraho ingaruka.” Uyu mugore yashyikirijwe urwego rw’igihugu rw’ubugenzacyaha  rukorera kuri sitasiyo ya Polisi  i Cyanika, mu gihe iperereza rigikomeje. Ingingo ya 269 y’itegeko no 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange ivuga ko umuntu wese, ku bw’uburiganya wigana, uhindura amafaranga y’ibiceri cyangwa inoti akoreshwa mu Rwanda cyangwa mu mahanga, ibyakwitiranywa nayo, impapuro zifite agaciro k’amafaranga y’igihugu zashyizweho umukono n’inzego zibifitiye ububasha, ziriho tembure yayo cyangwa ikirango cyayo, cyangwa izindi mpapuro zikoreshwa mu Rwanda cyangwa mu mahanga, uzana cyangwa ukwiza mu Rwanda izo mpapuro n’izo noti azi ko ziganywe cyangwa ko zahinduwe, aba akoze icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko, ahanishwa igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka itanu(5) ariko kitarenze imyaka irindwi (7).

title: Ibendera ry’Umuryango wa Commonwealth ryazamuwe i Kigali (Amafoto)
content: Kuri uyu wa Mbere, tariki ya 9 Werurwe 2020 nibwo ibihugu 54 bihuriye muri Commonwealth byizihije uwo munsi ngarukamwaka. U Rwanda rwinjiye muri Commonwealth mu 2009, ruba igihugu cya kabiri cyawinjiyemo kidafitanye isano no kuba cyarakolonijwe n’u Bwongereza nk’uko bimeze ku bindi bigize uyu muryango, nyuma ya Mozambique. Commonwealth Day yasimbuye umunsi witwaga Empire Day, ni umunsi ukunda kwizihizwa ku wa mbere wa kabiri wa Werurwe buri mwaka. Mu rwego rwo kwizihiza uyu munsi, mu gitondo cyo ku wa Mbere ibendera rya Commonwealth ryazamuwe kuri Kigali Convention Centre, inyubako biteganyijwe ko ari nayo izaberamo inama y’abakuru b’ibihugu na za guverinoma bihuriye muri uyu muryango, izwi nka CHOGM iteganyijwe kubera mu Rwanda muri Kamena uyu mwaka. Ibirori byo kwizihiza uyu munsi ku rwego rwa Commonwealth byabereye i London mu birori byitabiriwe n’Umuyobozi w’uyu muryango akaba n’Umwamikazi w’u Bwongereza Elizabeth II. Commonwealth Day yizihizwa ku Isi hose; ni umunsi wizihizwa binyuze mu myiyereko ya gisirikare, amasengesho, imbyino n’ibindi. Insanganyamatsiko y’uyu mwaka ivuga ku ‘guharanira kugera ku ntego rusange’. Tariki 20 Mata 2018 ni bwo byemejwe ko u Rwanda ruzakira inama ya CHOGM, iba buri myaka ibiri igahuza abakuru b’Ibihugu byo muri Commonwealth. Inama ya CHOGM biteganyijwe ko izaba ku wa ‎22–27 Kamena 2020, izitabirwa n’abakuru b’ibihugu na za Guverinoma 53 bikoresha ururimi rw’Icyongereza. Iyi nama ya CHOGM 2020 izareba ku nsanganyamatsiko yo kurebera hamwe ahazaza hasangiwe, hakazaganirwa ku ngingo zirimo imiyoborere, kubahiriza amategeko, ikoranabuhanga, guhanga ibishya guteza imbere urubyiruko, ibidukikihe n’ubucuruzi. Muri Nzeri 2019 nibwo Perezida Paul Kagame ari kumwe n’Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa Commonwealth, Patricia Scotland, batangaje ko inama ya CHOGM izahuza abakuru b’ibihugu na za guverinoma izaba tariki 22 Kamena 2020, abazayizamo bizezwa kuzafatwa neza. Abaturage miliyari 2.4 nibo bagize ibihugu byo muri Commonwealth, 60% muri bo bari munsi y’imyaka 30.

title: Ubuhamya bwa Nambajimana wahozaga umugore we ku nkeke kubera igikwangari
content: Mu buhamya bwabo basangije imbaga y’abaturage bitabirye ibirori byo kwizihiza Umunsi Mpuzamahanga w’Abagore ku Cyumweru tariki ya 8 Werurwe 2020 bagarutse ku rugendo rwabo kuva babana mu 2004. Ni ubuhamya bwakoze ku mitima ya benshi bumvise uko uyu mugabo yakubitaga umugore we buri munsi amuziza ubusa. Nambajimana yagize ati “Nanywaga inzoga yitwa igikwangari nkataha nasinze nkamukubita. Nta kintu twabaga twapfuye ni ubusinzi bwabiteraga tukarwana buri munsi.” Yakomeje avuga ko imirimo yose yayihariraga umugore akayikora wenyine yamusaba kumufasha nabwo akamukubita. Ati “Ikindi twapfaga ni uko yambwiraga ngo mufashe imirimo nkabifata nko gushaka kuntegeka nkamukubita.” Uwitonze Marie Grace avuga ko umugabo we yamukubitaga akamuhoza ku nkeke ariko akabihisha yanga kwiteza rubanda. Uko guhora mu makimbirane ya buri munsi; kutajya inama no kudafatanya imirimo ngo byabadindije mu iterambere ku buryo bicuza igihe bataye. Ati “Byabaga bimeze nabi yataha nijoro akaza ankubita kandi nta n’ikintu cyo kurya yasigiye abana. Ntabwo nigeze mbibwira ubuyobozi kuko namubikiraga ibanga nanga ko twiteza rubanda.”  	Inyigisho zarabafashije Uyu muryango ufitanye abana batanu uvuga ko abaturanyi baje kumenya ko urangwamo amakimbirane babimenyesha ubuyobozi. Ikibazo cyabo kimaze kumenyekana bashyizwe hamwe n’abandi bahabwa amahugurwa n’Umuryango Mpuzamahanga Action Aid bituma Nambajimana afata umunzuro wo kutazongera guhohotera umugore we. Yemeza ko kubera gushyira hamwe kuri ubu bamaze kugura ihene eshatu, ingurube ebyiri n’inkoko imwe byo korora kandi mbere nta tungo bagiraga. Nambajimana ati “Ubu inzoga naraziretse kandi sinshobora kongera gukubita umugore wanjye cyangwa kumuhohotera. Dufite gahunda yo kugura umurima wo guhinga n’inka yo korora.” Nyuma yo kureka amakimbirane binjiye mu matsinda yo kwizigama no kugurizanya. Buri wese aba mu itsinda yizigamamo 2000 Frw buri cyumweru hakaba n’irindi bafatanyije aho babitsamo 3000 Frw. Bagira inama ingo zikiri mu makimbirane kuyareka kuko ari yo atera ubukene n’imibereho mibi. Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Gisagara, Rutaburingoga Jérôme, yavuze ko hakiri imiryango iba mu makimbirane ariko bakomeje gahunda yo kuyigisha kugira ngo iyasohokemo. Yashimangiye ko bari gushyira imbaraga mu kurwanya inzoga z’inkorano zitemewe kuko zitera ubusinzi no guta ubwenge bigatuma abazinywa bahora mu makimbirane n’urugomo. Mu Karere ka Gisagara habarurwa imiryango 489 ihora mu makimbirane atera ingaruka zitandukanye zirimo kwiyahura, kwahukana k’umwe mu bashakanye no gutuma abana bahunga imiryango yabo bakajya mu buzererezi. title: Dr Ngabitsinze, Urujeni na Mukama Abbas mu bahawe imyanya mishya na Perezida Kagame
content: Muri izi mpinduka kandi Mukama Abbas wari umaze igihe asoje manda nka Visi Perezida w’Inteko Ishinga amategeko - Umutwe w’Abadepite - yagizwe Umuvunyi Mukuru Wungirije ushinzwe gukumira no kurwanya ruswa n’ibyaha bisa na yo, asimbuye Musangabatware Clément. Impinduka nshya zatangajwe kuri uyu wa Mbere, zigaragaza ko Dr Ngabitsinze wari Umuyobozi wa Komisiyo ishinzwe gukurikirana imicungire y’umutungo wa leta, PAC, mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, yabaye Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ubuhinzi n’Ubworozi; umwanya utari usanzwe ufite umuntu muri iyi minisiteri. Dr Ngabitsinze si mushya mu rwego rw’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi, kuko yize ibijyanye n’uru rwego aho afite impamyabumenyi y’ikirenga mu bukungu bushingiye ku buhinzi yakuye muri Kaminuza ya Milan mu Butaliyani. Asanzwe ari n’umwarimu muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda aho yatangaga n’ubundi amasomo y’ubuhinzi. Yanabaye Umuyobozi w’Inama y’Ubutegetsi w’Ikigo gishinzwe kuzamura ibyoherezwa mu mahanga bikomoka ku buhinzi n’ubworozi, NAEB. Naho Bakuramutsa Feza Urujeni wagizwe Umuyobozi ushinzwe Ibiro bya Perezida wa Repubulika, yabaye Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Imbuto Foundation. Yanabaye Intumwa y’u Rwanda yungirije mu Muryango w’Abibumbye. Undi wahawe umwanya ni Mukama Abbas wari umaze imyaka ibiri nta mwanya afite nyuma y’imyaka 18 mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko nk’Umudepite. Yagizwe Umuvunyi wungirije ushinzwe gukumira no kurwanya ruswa n’ibyaha bisa nayo, asimbuye Musangabatware Clement wari kuri uyu mwanya. Uwingeneye Joyeuse wakoraga mu Kigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere, RDB, mu ishami rishinzwe ibijyanye n’Imenyekanishabikorwa, we yagizwe Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe gutunganya amasoko ya Leta, RPPA. Abandi bahawe imyanya ni abagize Inama y’Ubutegetsi y’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe ibijyanye n’indege, iyobowe na Niyonkuru Zephanie mu gihe abongerewe manda ku mwanya w’abagize Komite itoranya ku mwanya w’ubukomiseri muri Komisiyo y’Igihugu y’Uburenganzira bwa muntu aho Umuyobozi wayo Kayijire Agnes.

title: Kigali: Abakurikiranyweho guhohotera umukobwa basabiwe gufungwa imyaka 25 n’impozamarira ya miliyoni 100 Frw
content: Kuri uyu wa Mbere, tariki ya 9 Werurwe 2020 nibwo mu cyumba cy’imyidagaduro cya Maison des Jeunes Kimisagara, Urukiko rwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge rwahaburanishirije urubanza rw’abantu batandatu baregwa ubwinjiracyaha bw’ubwicanyi. Ubwinjiracyaha busobanurwa nk’umugambi wo gukora icyaha. Uru rubanza rwasubukuwe nyuma y’uko tariki 5 Werurwe 2020, rwasubitswe nyuma y’uko abaregwa bagaragaje impungenge zo kutagira ababunganira mu mategeko. Mbere y’uko urubanza rutangira, habanje impaka zikomeye abunganiraga abaregwa basaba ko itangazamakuru ritakwemererwa gufata amashusho n’amajwi mu cyumba cy’iburanisha. Umucamanza yanzuye ko abanyamakuru bafata amashusho n’amajwi, ariko ntibagaragazemo inteko iburanisha, ababurana n’abashinjacyaha. Muri uru rubanza rwamaze amasaha hafi umunani, Ubushinjacyaha bwagaragaje ko tariki 16 Gashyantare 2020 aribwo hatawe muri yombi Nkamiro Zaina, Umulisa Gisèle, Kamanzi Cyiza Cardinal, Umuhoza Konny, Umuhoza Rosine, Umutoni Hadidja na Uwimana Zainabu, bafatiwe mu Murenge wa Kimisigara. Baregwa ubwinjiracyaha mu bwicanyi bakoze ubwo bari bagambiriye kwica Mukamana Sandrine, bagateshwa bataragera ku mugambi wabo. Imikorere y’icyaha Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko ku wa 16 Werurwe 2020, Mukamana yemeranyije na Nkamiro Zaina ko ajya kumusura, ajya kugura ibyo kunywa. Mukamana ngo yahageze mu ma saa kumi z’umugoroba ahasanga abandi bakobwa barimo Umutoni Hadidja (murumuna wa Nkamiro), Uwimana Zainabu (umugore wa musaza wa Nkamiro), Umulisa Gisèle (inshuti ya hafi ya Nkamiro) n’Umuhoza Rosine wari uherekeje Umulisa ndetse ngo aba bakobwa bose ntiyari abazi. Mukamana ngo yahageze asanga barimo kunywa inzoga, ahageze na we bamuha ikaze batangira gusangira. Nkamiro avuga ko Mukamana yari asanzwe ari inshuti ye ikomeye, baza kugirana ibibazo baratandukana. Intandaro yabaye ko Mukamana yabwiye inshuti zabo ko umubyeyi wa Nkamiro wari uherutse kwitaba Imana yazize SIDA n’amashitani y’iwabo. Byahuriranye n’umwuka mubi Mukamana yari afitanye na Umulisa Gisèle na we wamushinjaga kugenda amuvuga amagambo. Ubwo bari kumwe uyu mukobwa yagerageje kubasaba imbabazi, anabasobanurira uko byagenze gusa ntibabyemera bahitamo kumuhana, nk’uko babyise mu rukiko. Aba bakobwa babwiye urukiko ko Mukamana yabasabye ko yabasaba imbabazi akoresheje Snapchat ndetse akanabikora ariko bo babifata nka nyirarureshwa. Batangiye kumukubita… Aba bakobwa biyemerera ko bari banyoye inzoga, ngo kwihangana byarabananiye bahitamo kumukubita no kumwogosha imisatsi mu rwego rwo kumuhana. Umulisa Gisèle na Nkamiro Zaina babwiye Mukamana ko bagiye kumuhanisha kumwogosha no kumukubita inkoni kugira ngo bumve ko bamuhannye. Ngo batumye Cyiza imikasi na gillette ku iduka n’inkoni zo kumukubita. Ngo bahereye ku mutwe bamwogosha, bamwe bafata umutwe abandi bafata amaguru. Abaregwa bemereye urukiko ko bamwogoshe umusatsi n’ingohe, barangije bamukuramo imyenda yose basiga ikariso, batangira kumukubita. Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko ibi byabaye Mukamana apfutswe umunwa hifashishijwe igitambaro, banacana radiyo ku buryo nta muntu wo hanze wari kumva urusaku. Mukamana wari wazahajwe, abaregwa bavuga ko yabasabye amazi yo kunywa. Ngo yanyoyeho, asigaye Umuhoza Konny ayamumenaho. Iyi ngingo ntiyavuzweho rumwe mu rukiko kuko Ubushinjacyaha bwavugaga ko uyu mukobwa ubwo yari yazahajwe n’inkoni, bamumennyeho amazi ngo azanzamuke bongere bamukorere iyicarubozo. Ubushinjacyaha bwavuze ko uko bakubitaga Mukamana uwitwa Rosine yafataga amashusho n’amafoto, nubwo abaregwa babihakana. Uko yaje kubirokoka Ubushinjacyaha bwabwiye urukiko ko ubwo bari bamaze kumukubita, uyu mukobwa bamuhaye telefoni ye ngo ahamagare umuntu w’iwabo, akiyifata ahamagara mukuru we, icyakora kuvuga biramunanira araturika ararira. Ubushinjacyaha bwavuze ko mukuru wa Mukamana yahise atangira gushaka umushoferi wamujyanye, abajyana aho yamusize. Bakigerayo ngo barakomanze abandi banga gukingura, icyakora bakumva urusaku rw’abantu benshi barimo n’utaka. Bahise batangira guhagarika buri muhisi n’umugenzi bamusaba kubatabara ku bw’amahirwe haca imodoka y’abashinzwe umutekano yahise ijya kubatabara. Bageze ahabereye icyaha ngo basanze ibimenyetso byasibanganyijwe uwakubiswe yambitswe ikanzu yewe n’ibyifashishijwe byose byahishwe. Aha bose bahise batabwa muri yombi usibye Nkamiro watorotse akaza gufatwa nyuma. Raporo ya muganga yerekanwe mu rukiko yavugaga ko umubiri we wangiritse kubera ibisebe, ahita ahabwa ikiruhuko cy’iminsi 15 ndetse asabwa kugana umuganga w’uruhu kugira ngo amwiteho. Abunganira abaregwa iyi raporo bayifashishije cyane bagaragaza ko ibyabaye atari ugukubita kugambiriye kwica, ahubwo ari ugukubita no gukomeretsa koroheje nubwo atariko ubushinjacyaha bwabibonaga mu rubanza. Basabiwe gufungwa imyaka 25 Abavoka bavuze ko icyaha abo bunganira baregwa gikwiye kuba gukubita no gukomeretsa byoroheje, ku buryo n’Urukiko rwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge rudafite ububasha bwo kuburanisha, ko bakwiye kujyanwa mu Rukiko rw’Ibanze. Ibi byatewe utwatsi n’Ubushinjacyaha bwagaragaje ko ibikorwa byabaye byari bigamije kwica uwakorewe icyaha, cyane ko bamwogoshe ku ngufu bakanamukubita inkoni nyinshi byanamuviriyemo guta ubwenge, akazanzahurwa n’amazi bamumennyeho, bityo basanga byari muri gahunda yo kumwica. Ubushinjacyaha bwasabye ko buri umwe mu baregwa yahabwa igifungo cy’imyaka 25 ndetse bagafatanya kwishyura impuzamarira ya miliyoni 100 Frw. Ni icyifuzo nacyo cyakuruye impaka mu rukiko. Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko bwashingiye ku kuba abaregwa bari bagamije kwica umuntu ariko bagateshwa umugambi batawugezeho, mu gihe iyo bawugeraho bari gufungwa burundu. Ikindi umushinjacyaha yavuze ni uko ababurana batigeze bemera icyaha byibuza ngo bagabanyirizwe ibihano. Mu gihe bahakanaga inyito y’icyaha banavuga ko uru rukiko rudafite ububasha bwo kubaburanisha, abunganira abaregwa bavuze ko impozamarira ya miliyoni 100 Frw ari nyinshi cyane bityo basaba ubutabera kuzakora akazi kabwo. Ubushinjacyaha bwavuze ko aya mafaranga ari impozamarira kuko uwakorewe icyaha yababajwe mu buryo bugaragara no mu bw’imitekerereze. Urukiko rwanzuye ko uru rubanza ruzasomwa ku wa mbere tariki 16 Werurwe 2020, saa Saba z’amanywa aho urubanza rwabereye.  	Kamanzi Cyiza Cardinal wakoraga  kwa Zaina ahakubitiwe Mukeshimana Sandrine yigaramye nyirabuja imbere y’urukiko  	Ijambo ku rindi, Ubushinjacyaha bwahishuye uko Mukamana yahohotewe

title: Uburyo Abanyarwanda batunguwe n’ikoranabuhanga Israel ikoresha mu guhanura za missile z’umwanzi
content: Ibi byateje impagarara maze ibihugu byose by’Abarabu birahaguruka bihuriza hamwe, bivuga ko Abayahudi badakwiye kuba muri Palestine, ko bagomba gushakirwa ahandi bajyanwa. Ibi ntibyabujije ko mu 1948, mu byishimo byinshi by’Abayahudi i Tel Aviv, David Ben Gurion yatangaje ishingwa rya leta y’Abayahudi ari yo Israel. Israel yari yongeye kubaho ariko nta ngabo ifite zo kurwanirira ubusugire ndetse n’ imipaka y’ igihugu cyayo. Yahise ishinga igisirikare gitangira ndetse kujya kubohoza abandi bayahudi bari mu bihugu bitandukanye, bitahise bibaha uburenganzira bwo gutaha mu gihugu cyabo. Mu 1967 ibihugu by’ Abarabu byose byishyize hamwe cyane ibyahanaga imipaka na Israel birimo Misiri,  Syria, Jordan, Iraq na Liban, byafashe umwanzuro  bivuga ko bigiye gutera Israel, ko abayahudi bagomba kuva ku butaka bwa Palestine. Mu ntambara yamaze iminsi itandatu, bitewe n’uko Israel yabonaga ibi bihugu byose nta na kimwe irusha igisirikare gikomeye, yigiriye inama yo kubitera ibitunguye maze tariki ya 5 Kamena 1967 ihagurutsa ibifaru byayo byose n’abasirikare berekera ku mipaka yose icya rimwe, indege zayo z’intambara izerekeza mu Misiri kuko ariyo yari ikomeye cyane ifite n’ibikoresho byinshi. Mu gihe cy’isaha imwe gusa, Israel yari imaze gutwikira ibifaru, indege n’ibindi bikoresho bya Misiri ku bibuga bitaranahaguruka. Ibi byatumye Israel agahugu gato kakivuka kegukana intsinzi, ibintu byatumye bafata n’utundi duce nka Sinai na Gaza ndetse binjira n’ i Yeruzalemu, aho ukwemera kwabo gukomoka. Nubwo Israel yari imaze kwegukana intsinzi, byatumye imitwe itandukanye ikorera muri Palestine irahirira umunsi ku munsi guteza umutekano muri iki gihugu, ndetse ikajya inakoresha ibisasu bikomeye bya missile, akenshi ihabwa n’igihugu cya Iran, umwanzi ukomeye wa Israel. Israel nayo ntiyicaye ubusa ahubwo abahanga bayo bashatse uburyo bwose bahangana n’ibi bitero, harimo no kuba babikumira bitaregera mu gihugu ngo bibe byakwica abaturage. Uretse ibyo abantu basoma kuri internet, ababaye muri iki gihugu bakubwira ko nubwo Israel ari igihugu gituye hagati y’abanzi, ariko ngo ni cyo gihugu abaturage bacyo bakubwira ko bumva batekanye kurusha ibindi bihugu ku Isi. Ibi babishingira ku ikoranabuhanga ry’igisirikare cyabo Umunyarwanda Ndayizigiye Emmanuel, wamaze imyaka irenga ibiri muri iki gihugu kimwe na bagenzi be 28 kuva mu 2012 biga iby’ubuhinzi, yabwiye IGIHE ko ibyo abantu basoma ari bike ugereranyije n’ubuhanga iki gihugu gifite. Avuga ko yabaye hafi y’Intara ya Gaza, aha ni hamwe mu ho umutwe wa Hamas, uba ukagaba ibitero muri Israel ukoresheje za missile. Avuga ko we na bagenzi be b’abanyarwanda bakigera muri iki gihugu, Israel yarwanye na Hamas, ku buryo aho babaga bari mu mirima babonaga ibisasu bibaca hejuru. Agira ati “Icyo gihe ubwanjye nabonaga ibisasu bica hejuru, ndibuka ko twashatse no gutaha mu gihugu cyacu ariko Abanya-Israel batubwira ko batuzanye aho, kuko bumvise ko mu Rwanda habaye intambara, bakaba  rero bari bazi ko tubimenyereye.” Baratubwiye bati “Igisasu iyo bagitera kiba kiri ku butumburuke runaka, ni ukuvuga ko muri ahantu igisasu kidashobora kubagwaho, ahubwo birimo kugenda  bigana muri za Tel Aviv n’ahandi.” Avuga ko muri iki gihugu bafite uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga buzwi nka Iron dome, ubu bukaba ari uburyo buhita bumenya ko hari  igisasu kirenze umupaka kije mu gihugu bagahita bakirasa. Avuga ko iyo icyo gisasu cyinjiye mu gihugu, igihugu cyose hahita humvikana  amajwi mu mijyi  yose, aburira abantu ko hari igisasu kije bagomba kwihisha. Ati “Icyo gihe uba ufite amasegonda atanu ko aho uri uhita uryama, niba uri mu nzu cyane ko inzu zabo zifite icyumba kiba kidashobora gushwanyuzwa n’izi missile, buri muntu asabwa kujya muri icyo cyumba.” Buri muntu muri Israel iyo yubaka inzu,  bamwubakira ako kazu ku buryo ashobora kuzajya yihishamo. Ibi byumba kandi bishyirwa ahahurirwa n’abantu benshi hose mu gihugu. Avuga ko Israel yakoze ikindi gisasu gihita gihaguruka kikajya gushwanyaguza cya kindi kinjiye mu gihugu, ku buryo niyo kigihushije gato, gihita gikata kikajya kugishakisha. Abatuye Israel bumva ari bo bafite umutekano kurusha ahandi ku Isi Ati “Muri Israel bakubwira ko iwanyu ariho hatari umutekano ugereranyije n’iwabo, kandi ukabona  koko ari byo, barakubwira bati hari umuntu urumva igisasu cyahitanye muri Israel? Hari umuntu wumva wateye undi gerenade?.” Iki gihugu kandi gifite ikoranabuhanga ridasanzwe, kuko kubera radar gifite, ngo zishobora kureba umuntu wese winjiye mu gihugu, ku buryo niyo yaba afite icyuma bahita bamubona. Ndayizigiye gusa agaragaza ko nubwo bafite iri koranabuhanga ryose, ikintu bafite gikomeye ni uko bafite umuco wo gukunda igihugu cyabo, bagendeye ku buryo bari baratakaje igihugu cyabo, bakaba barakibonye nyuma yo guhura n’amahano akomeye, ibintu avuga ko bahuriyeho n’Abanyarwanda.

title: Iran: Abantu 20 bishwe no kunywa alcool bibwira ko yabarinda kwandura Coronavirus
content: Umuyobozi Ushinzwe Itumanaho mu Kigo cya Minisiteri y’Ubuzima gishinzwe kwigisha ibijyanye n’ubuzima, Kianush Jahanpur, yabwiye Ibiro Ntaramakuru bya Iran ko abo bantu banyoye alcool kubera ubujiji. Yavuze ko hari abantu batize bibwira ko kunywa alcool byabarinda kwandura, nyamara bishobora kubavutsa ubuzima kandi bibwiraga ko barimo kwirinda. Yakomeje ati “Kubera imyumvire itariyo, mu minsi ibiri ishize abantu 331 bagizweho ingaruka no kunywa alcool, 20 muri bo bitaba Imana. Ni ikibazo gikomeye.” Mu minsi ishize abandi bantu bo mu Ntara za Tehran, Alborz na Khuzestan banyoye methanol bibwira ko iza kubarinda kwandura Coronavirus. Ni mu gihe ibinyobwa bisembuye bitemewe muri iki gihugu kigendera ku mahame ya Islam, ariko hari  bimwe birimo alcool byinjizwa mu gihugu mu buryo bwa magendu. Abaganga bagaragaza ko nubwo Coronavirus ari indwara ikomeye, ishobora kwirindwa byoroshye ariko ikanakwirakwira byoroshye. Gukaraba intoki no guhagarika kuramukanya byafasha mu kwirinda. Kugira ngo umuntu yandure Coronavirus ni uko uyifite ayiha undi mu buryo bw’amatembabuzi ava mu mazuru cyangwa mu kanwa k’uyirwaye, kuko yandurira mu myanya y’ubuhumekero nubwo ishobora guca n’ahandi. Iyo iyi virusi imaze kugera mu bihaha niho itura, ari nayo mpamvu ibuza abantu guhumeka neza bakarwara umusonga, ari nawo ubahitana. Umuntu wese uyanduye ntabwo ahita agaragaza ibimenyetso, hari ababigaragaza vuba ariko ubundi ibimenyetso biza hagati y’umunsi wa mbere umuntu yanduye n’umunsi wa 14, ni ukuvuga nibura ibyumweru bibiri. Iyi virusi ishobora kumara ahantu iminsi ibiri, ni ukuvuga amasaha 48 itarapfa. Uramutse uyikozeho ukaza kwikora ku munwa, uhita wandura. Iyi virusi ishobora kwicwa n’ubushyuhe buri hejuru cyangwa ubukonje buri hasi cyane. Nubwo iyi virusi iteye ubwoba kubera uburyo yandura, ishobora no kwicwa n’ibintu byoroshye nk’isabune na alcool, ku buryo kuyirinda bya mbere ari ukugira isuku. Mu bihugu iyi virusi yagezemo, hashyizweho ingamba zikomeye zirimo ko nko mu Bushinwa, kujya muri resitora bitemewe ko abantu bicara ku meza amwe ari babiri, umuntu aguma ku meza ye. Ahantu hahurira abantu benshi nko mu maguriro rusange aho batonda umurongo, abantu bagomba kugira intera ya metero eshatu hagati y’umuntu n’undi. Abantu bose kandi bagira amakarita y’urugendo agaragaza ko batigeze bajya ku kato, ku buryo umuntu yemerewe kujya hanze akahamara amasaha abiri agasubira mu nzu. Abamaze kwandura iyi virusi hirya no hino ni 105 000, mu gihe abo imaze kwica bagera ku 3800. Muri Iran abamaze kwandura ni 7.161 mu gihe abagera ku 194 bamaze kwitaba Imana.

title: Abakerarugendo bahawe imyaka ibiri yo guhindura amatariki yo gusura pariki kubera Coronavirus
content: Iri tangazo ryashyizwe hanze kuri uyu wa Mbere nyuma y’uko inzego zitandukanye zikomeje gufata ingamba zo guhashya Coronavirus iri guhitana imbaga hirya no hino ku Isi. Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima (WHO) ryatangaje ko COVID-19 ari icyorezo gihangayikishije Isi ndetse mu kwirinda ko cyagera mu Rwanda hafashwe ingamba zifatika. Inama y’Abaminisitiri yo ku wa 6 Werurwe “yemeje gushyira ingufu mu kugikumira no guhangana nacyo harimo gukomeza gukangurira abaturage gukurikiza inama zo kucyirinda, kwitabaza inzego z’ubuzima mu gihe hari ugaragayeho kimwe mu bimenyetso biranga icyo cyorezo no kugabanya ingendo n’inama zitari ngombwa hanze n’imbere mu gihugu.” Iki gikorwa kiyobowe na Serivisi za Minisitiri w’Intebe, Minisiteri y’Ubuzima, iy’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu n’Inzego z’umutekano. Itangazo Minisitiri w’Intebe Dr Edouard Ngirente yashyizeho umukono ku wa 6 Werurwe 2020, rivuga ko mu rwego rwo kwirinda no gukumira Coronavirus, u Rwanda rwifashisha camera ku Kibuga Mpuzamahanga cy’Indege cya Kigali i Kanombe mu gutahura uyiketsweho. Coronavirus ni icyorezo cyatangiriye mu Bushinwa mu mpera z’Ukuboza 2019. Muri icyo gihugu abamaze kucyandura ni 80 859, mu gihe abapfuye ari 3 100. Hanze y’u Bushinwa hamaze kwandura abantu 25 208 ndetse abagera kuri 500 bamaze gupfa. Kugeza ubu mu Rwanda nta murwayi wa Coronavirus urahagaragara. Mu itangazo rya RDB ryashyizweho umukono n’Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere kuri uyu wa 9 Werurwe 2020, rivuga ko na “Serivisi z’ubukerarugendo zikomeje gutangwa nk’ibisanzwe mu gihugu hose.’’ RDB yashyize hanze amabwiriza azagenderwaho mu gihe hari abakerarugendo bashaka gusubika cyangwa kwimura ingendo zabo. Iryo tangazo rivuga ko “Hakuweho uburyo umuntu yamenyeshaga mbere y’iminsi irindwi kugira ngo asure pariki; hakuweho iminsi 30 yagenwaga ngo ikigo gitembereza ba mukerarugendo kibe cyamenyekanishije ko bishyuye.’’ Rikomeza riti “Abakerarugendo bifuza gusubika uruhushya baguze rwo gusura pariki kubera ihagarikwa ry’ingendo z’indege cyangwa bakumiriwe gukora ingendo ahantu runaka bitewe na Coronavirus bafite igihe cy’imyaka ibiri yo kwimura itariki bari bafashe bidasabye ikindi kiguzi; abaguze impushya zo gusura pariki mu mezi atabamo ba mukerarugendo benshi bashobora guhindura igihe bagombaga gusurira ingagi, bagahitamo ikindi gihe nk’icyo bitarenze imyaka ibiri. Abakerarugendo bagombaga kwitabira inama baguze impushya ku giciro kigabanyijwe na bo bemerewe kwigiza inyuma impushya baguze bakaba bazikoresha mu kindi gihe bahitamo mu myaka ibiri.’’ Iri tangazo rigaragaza ko uburenganzira bwatanzwe mu gihe butarahindurwa bwemerewe gukoreshwa mu gihe cy’amezi atandatu uhereye igihe ryashyiriweho umukono kandi urwo ruhushya rugakoreshwa mu myaka ibiri. Public notice for tourism and travel stakeholders on COVID-19 (Corona Virus) 👇🏽. #VisitRwanda pic.twitter.com/JIAsyziVI6 — Rwanda Development Board (@RDBrwanda) March 9, 2020 Mu ngamba u Rwanda rwafashe mu gukumira Coronavirus harimo gushishikariza Abanyarwanda kwirinda kuramukanya abantu bahana ibiganza no guhoberana, kugabanya ingendo zitari ngombwa mu bihugu byagaragayemo icyo cyorezo. Hari kandi kwirinda gukorora cyangwa kwitsamura iruhande rw’abandi, gukaraba intoki hakoreshejwe amazi asukuye cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo gusukura intoki, kwirinda kwegera abandi igihe cyose warwaye ibicurane, inkorora cyangwa ufite umuriro mwinshi. Umujyi wa Kigali na wo kuva ku wa 8 Werurwe wasubitse ibikorwa byose bihuriza abantu benshi ahantu hamwe birimo ibitaramo by’imyidagaduro n’ibindi birori bihuza abantu benshi nk’imurikagurisha, imurikabikorwa, umutambagiro n’ibindi. Coronavirus yandurira mu matembabuzi, igafata imyanya y’ubuhumekero ku buryo yica umuntu imuteye umusonga. Uburyo bw’ibanze mu kuyirinda ni ukugira isuku binyuze mu gukaraba intoki n’amazi meza n’isabune, cyangwa gukoresha alcool yica udukoko. Nta muti wa Coronavirus cyangwa urukingo bizwi, igikomeje kwifashishwa ni ukuvura ibimenyetso byayo gusa. Icyizere ariko kigenda kizamuka kuko mu Bashinwa bari baranduye iyi coronavirus, abagera ku 57 143 barayikize.

title: Ubwiru muri Sena y’u Bufaransa mu kiganiro cy’abapfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi
content: Kuri uyu wa Mbere nibwo muri Sena y’u Bufaransa habereye ibiganiro byiswe ko kigomba kugaruka ku “myaka 60 y’umutekano muke ukomeye mu Karere k’Ibiyaga bigari.” Ni ikiganiro cyari cyateguwe n’abantu bazwiho gupfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, ku buryo abantu bamwe bari bitezwe mu biganiro bitandukanyije nacyo. Dr. Denis Mukwege yanze kwitabira iyi nama ku munota wa nyuma, avuga ko ibyo yifuzaga ko bivugirwa muri iyi nama bitashyizwe kuri gahunda, nyamara ari we wari watangije igitekerezo cyayo abinyujije muri Senateri Gérard Longuet. Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Ikigo cy’Ubumenyi ku masomo yibanda ku bihugu bigitegekwa n’u Bufaransa (Académie des Sciences d’Outre-Mer), Pierre Gény, na we wateganyaga kuba mu bagombaga gutangiza iyi nama, yavuze ko atazayitabira kuko uwo bashyigikiye kandi basanzwe bakorana, Dr Denis Mukwege, atazayibonekamo. Bamwe mu bitabiriye ibi biganiro bahishuye uburyo umugambi w’iki kiganiro ukimara kujya hanze, abagiteguye bakoze ibishoboka ku buryo ibiganiro byabo biguma hagati yabo, birinda ko hagira umuntu uzi neza u Rwanda ushobora no guhinyuza ibyo bavuga winjiramo. Hari hafashwe ibyemezo ko nta muntu ufite camera winjira, abanyamakuru bakumirwa muri iki cyumba kuko byasabaga kubanza kwiyandikisha, kugeza ubwo na Alain Gauthier uyobora umuryango uharanira ko abagize uruhare muri Jenoside bose bagezwa imbere y’ubutabera, yangiwe kwinjira muri ibi biganiro. Mu bandi bitabiriye ibi biganiro harimo Judi Rever wanditse igitabo gipfobya uruhare rwa FPR Inkotanyi yahagaritse Jenoside, Adolphe Muzito wabaye Minisitiri w’Intebe wa RDC ukomeje gukwirakwiza ibitekerezo by’ubushotoranyi ku Rwanda; Charles Onana upfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, Senateri Gérard Longuet wanabaye Minisitiri w’Ingabo w’u Bufaransa ku bwa Nicolas Sarkozy n’abandi. Kuva iyi nama yategurwa yamaganiwe kure, kugeza ubwo Ihuriro ry’Abanyarwanda batuye mu Bufaransa (Communauté Rwandaise de France, CRF), ndetse na Ibuka France, basabye Sena y’iki gihugu kwitandukanya n’iyo nama yari igamije guha urubuga abahakana bakanapfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Amb. Ndagijimana yagaragaje uwo ari we Mu kiganiro cyabaye kuri uyu wa 9 Werurwe, umwe mu batanze ibiganiro ni Jean Marie Vianney Ndagijimana wabaye Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’amahanga wa mbere nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Uyu yavuye mu Rwanda atorokanye amafaranga yagombaga gukoreshwa mu kongera gufungura ambasade z’u Rwanda zari zafunzwe muri Jenoside n’ivanwaho rya Guverinoma ya Habyarimana. Yagize ati "Ni operation Turquoise yahagaritse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu majyepfo y’uburengerazuba bw’u Rwanda. U Bufaransa bwonyine nicyo gihugu cyarokoye Abanyarwanda mu 1994 !" Imvugo ye muri iki kiganiro ntitana n’ubundi n’amagambo asanzwe amuranga apfobya Jenoside.  Ubushakashatsi buheruka gushyirwa ahagaragara na Komisiyo y’Igihugu yo kurwanya Jenoside, CNLG, bwahishuye ko Abafaransa bagize uruhare mu byaha bitandukanye birimo gukorana n’Interahamwe, kwica, gufata abagore n’abakobwa ku ngufu no guhisha ibimenyetso bya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi binyuze mu gushaka guhisha imirambo y’ababaga bamaze kwicwa n’Interahamwe ariko we akavuga ko aribo bahagaritse Jenoside. Uruhare rwa Ndagijimana mu gupfobya Jenoside Ubushakashatsi bwa CNLG buheruka kugaragaza ko Perefegitura ya Cyangugu ifite abantu batandukanye bari mu nzego nkuru za Leta bahunze igihugu, bageze mu mahanga bamamara mu mvugo n’ibikorwa bihakana bikanapfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ambasaderi Ndagijimana Jean Marie Vianney yavukiye mu yahoze ari Komini Cyimbogo i Mururu, ubu ni mu Karere ka Rusizi. Afite impamyabushobozi ihanitse mu mategeko yakuye muri Kaminiza ya Luvanium i Kinshasa. Kuva muri Mutarama 1986, Ndagijimana Jean Marie Vianney yagiriwe icyizere na Habyarimana, agirwa Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda i Addis-Abeba, ahagarariye u Rwanda muri Ethiopia na Sudani, anahagarariye u Rwanda muri OUA no muri CEA, ikigo cya Loni gishinzwe ibibazo by’ubukungu muri Afurika. Urugamba rwo kubohora igihugu rutangiye mu 1990, yagizwe Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Bufaransa akorera i Paris kugeza muri Mata 1994. Nyuma yo kubohora igihugu no guhagarika Jenoside, Ndagijimana yagarutse mu Rwanda, aba Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga muri Guverinoma yari iyobowe na Twagiramungu Faustin, umuturanyi we bakomokaga muri Perefegitura imwe ya Cyangugu. Nyuma y’amezi atanu gusa (Nyakanga 1994 – Ugushyingo 1994), yahisemo guhunga, asubira mu Bufaransa. Amaze guhunga, Ndagijimana yashinze, anayobora ishyirahamwe ryitwa “Ibuka bose” rikorera mu Bubiligi. Ubu ni umwe mu bamamaza ko mu Rwanda habaye Jenoside ebyiri “double Genocide”.

title: Inyungu ku Rwanda, aho imyiteguro yo kwakira CHOGM igeze…Ikiganiro na Minisitiri Dr Biruta
content: Ku itariki 22 kugeza kuri 27 Kamena 2020 u Rwanda rwiteguye kwakira inama ya CHOGM (The Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting). Mu myiteguro bimwe byaratunganye ibindi bikomeje gutegurwa no gushyirwa mu buryo kugira ngo abazayitabira bazakirwe neza. Ni inama u Rwanda ruzakira nyuma y’uko rugaragaje ko rubiftiye ubushake n’ubushobozi rumaze kubona ko umugabane wa Afurika ariwo utahiwe. CHOGM ni inama yitabirwa n’abantu bari hagati ya 5 000 na 8 000. Kuyakira bisaba ko igihugu cyerekana ubushake hakabaho kureba ko igihugu gifite ubushobozi. Mu kureba ubwo bushobozi harebwa ibintu bitandukanye, birimo aho inama izakirirwa,  indege zigana aho hantu, uko bantu babona Visa, umutekano, imiyoborere n’ibindi. Minisitiri Biruta mu kiganiro na Televiziyo Rwanda, yavuze ko nyuma yo kwemezwa kuzayakira, u Rwanda rwatangiye imyiteguro ndetse ngo irarimbanyije. Ati “ Tumaze iminsi twitegura, hari n’ibihugu byohereje intumwa zabyo ziza kureba aho bigeze kureba aho inama izabera,  aho bazacumbika, uburyo bazakirwa ku kibuga n’ibindi. Ibyo byose birakorwa mu gihe twitegura iriya nama.” Inyungu z’u Rwanda muri Commonwealth U Rwanda rwinjiye muri Commonwealth mu Ugushyingo 2009. Ni umuryango uhuza ibihugu 54 byiganjemo ibyakolonijwe n’u Bwongereza bikaba binakoresha Icyongereza ariko hakabamo n’ibindi birimo n’u Rwanda bitakolonijwe nabwo ariko bikoresha Icyongereza. Mu myaka irenga 10 u Rwanda rwabonyemo inyungu nyinshi zirimo iza Politiki n’iz’ubukungu. Uretse ibyo, Minisitiri Biruta avuga ko  ishoramari ryiyongera binyuze mu nama nk’iyo ya CHOGM rugiye kwakira. Ati “Iyo habayeho inama nk’iriya ntabwo ari abakuru b’ibihugu gusa. Haba harimo n’igice gihuza urubyiruko, abikorera, imiryango itari iya leta, abagore n’ibindi. Iyo tugeze ku bikorera urumva ko haba harimo ibintu by’ishoramari, ibyo byose ni ibintu dufitemo inyungu usibye ko byose bizaganirwaho nk’ibidukikije, imiyoborere, ikoranabuhanga na inovasiyo.” Dr Biruta kandi yagarutse ku nyungu abanyarwanda bazagira kubera kwakira CHOGM, nk’abazabona akazi mu rwego rw’amahoteli, ubukerarugendo n’ubucuruzi. Ati “Amahoteli yose azaba yuzuye n’amahoteli mato cyangwa aho abantu bacumbika hose  hatandukanye   bazaba bafite abashyitsi,  urumva rero harimo akazi ari abafite imodoka bakodesha harimo akazi ndetse bariya bantu baba bafite ibibatunga bitandukanye, ibyo bashaka kugura bazajyana iwabo mu buryo bwo kwiyibutsa ko baje mu Rwanda.” Mu gihe habaye inama mpuzamahanga, hari ubwo biba ngombwa ko imihanda runaka ifungwa kugira ngo abashyitsi batambuke. Nubwo hari abo bibangamira, Dr Biruta yavuze ko byumvikana ko iyo umujyi wagize abashyitsi barimo n’abakuru b’ibihugu mu gihe runaka umuhanda ushobora kuba ufunze, ariko ko ugereranyije n’inyungu ziri mu kwakira iyo nama bitakagombye kuba ikibazo. Ati “ Bishobora kugira icyo bibangamiraho abatuye uyu mujyi […] ariko n’abanyarwanda mu bihe nk’ibi byo kwakira abashyitsi turabateguza kugira ngo babe babizi banadufashe no kwakira abo bashyitsi kandi bumve neza inyungu ikomeye irimo iruta kure ibyo byashobora kubangamira umuntu ku isaha iyi n’iyi.” Yongeyeho ati “Ni ibintu by’iminsi navuga nk’ibiri cyangwa nk’itatu igihe abakuru b’ibihugu bazaba baza cyangwa bataha  ibyo ni ibintu tumenyereye ariko inyungu iva mu kwakira iriya nama zirenze kure ari ibyo dushoramo mu kuyitegura ndetse ari n’ibishobora kutubangamira ku isaha iyi n’iyi ku munsi uyu n’uyu muri iriya minsi. Imyiteguro n’ingengo y’imari yo kuyikora U Rwanda rusanzwe rwakira inama  mpuzamahanga kandi abazitabiriye bagataha bishimye. Kuri iyi nshuro nabwo, ibikorwaremezo nk’imihanda, aho inama izabera n’ibindi bikenewe bikomeje gutunganywa. Umujyi wa Kigali watangaje ko mu mihanda mishya iri kubakwa harimo uva Rwandex ukanyura mu Myembe cyangwa se Rwandex- Kigali Convention Centre. Uyu muhanda wamaze kuzura. Undi muhanda ni unyura ku Biro by’Akarere ka Gasabo - Airtel- Sport View Hotel - Control Technique wo wari  ugeze ku kigero cya 35% wubakwa muri Mutarama. Hari undi muhanda wa Nyabisindu – Nyarutarama - Green Hills – Kibagabaga wo wari ugeze kuri 30%. Uyu muhanda wagenewe miliyari 3.3 Frw hamwe n’uzahuza Kabeza-Alpha Palace uzatangira kubakwa mu cyumweru gitaha. Mu mihanda iri gusanwa harimo uwa Murindi - Rusororo wo wari ugeze kuri 25 %. Umwaka ushize Guverinoma yemeje ingengo y’imari ya miliyari 20.1 Frw zigenewe ibikorwa bibanziriza CHOGM, harimo miliyari 10.87 Frw zizakoreshwa mu kwagura aho indege ziparika ku Kibuga Mpuzamahanga cya Kigali i Kanombe n’ibindi bikorwa ku kibuga. Minisitiri Biruta yatangaje ko uretse ikurikiranabikorwa rikorwa n’ibihugu bizitabira CHOGM nta yindi nkunga rwahawe yo kwitegura CHOGM. Kuri we ngo nta gihombo kirimo kuko ibikorwa byubakwa biba bizahoraho igihugu kigakomeza kubikoresha kandi bikaba byanagihesha no kwakira izindi nama kubera uko cyagaragaye. Ati “Byinshi ni ibikorwa bizaguma aha kandi n’ubundi twari dukeneye. Iyo waguye umuhanda cyangwa ugakora undi ni bikorwa birambye, n’abashyitsi nibagenda ni ibikorwa tuzakomeza gukoresha […] kandi birumvikana nitumara kwakira iyi nama bizaba byumvikana ko dushobora kwakira izindi nama ziri muri ruriya rwego kandi imari yashowe izakomeza igire akamaro no mu bihe bizaza kuko ntibizarangirana n’iriya nama gusa.” Ku kuba  u Rwanda rwaba rwarasabye inkunga yo kurufasha kwitegura, yagize ati “U Rwanda nta bufasha bundi twabonye nta nubwo twanasabye tubikora twumva ko ari ibyacu.” Minisitiri Biruta yasabye ko buri munyarwanda bireba yagira uruhara kugira ngo iyo nama izasige isura y’igihugu igaragaye neza mu ruhando mpuzamahanga. Imyiteguro no kuyimenyekanisha ku buryo buruseho byatangiranye na tariki ya 9 Werurwe 2020 hizihizwa umunsi wahariwe kwizihiza umuryango w’ibihugu bikoresha ururimi rw’Icyongereza Commonwealth. CHOGM izaba igizwe n’ibiganiro bitandukanye birimo ibireba urubyiruko, abikorera, abagore, imiryango itari iya leta n’iby’abakuru b’ibihugu na za Guverinoma.

title: Tariki ya 10 Werurwe
content: Hari byinshi byaranze uyu munsi mu mateka yawo, bimwe muri byo ni ibi bikurikira: 1814:  Impanuka yabereye mu kirombe gicukurwamo amabuye y’agaciro yahitanye abacukuzi bagera ku 1099. 1922: Mahatma Gandhi yafatiwe mu Buhinde akatirwa gufungwa imyaka itandatu, gusa nyuma y’imyaka ibiri yarafunguwe agiye kubagwa. 1945: Abasivili barenga ibihumbi 100 barishwe ubwo ingabo za Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika zirwanira mu kirere zateraga ibisasu bya rutura i Tokyo mu Buyapani. 1952: Fulgencio Batista yayoboye ihirika ry’ubutegetsi muri Cuba maze yishyiraho nka perezida w’agateganyo. 1970: Mu ntambara yo muri Vietnam, Captain Ernest Medina yashinjwe ibyaha by’intambara n’igisirikare cya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. 1977:  Abahanga mu by’ubumenyi bw’ikirere bavumbuye uruziga ruzengurutse umubumbe wa Uranus. 1990:  Muri Haiti, Prosper Avril yafunzwe amezi 18 nyuma yo kurekura ubutegetsi. Abavutse kuri iyi tariki: 1846: Edward Baker Lincoln, umuhungu w’uwabaye Perezida wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Abraham Lincoln. 1853:  Thomas Mackenzie, wabaye Minisitiri w’intebe wa Nouvelle-Zélande. 1903:  Clare Boothe Luce, wabaye Ambasaderi wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika mu Butaliyani. 1923:  Val Logsdon Fitch, wahawe igihembo cy’amahoro ‘Prix Nobel’. 1947:  Kim Campbell wabaye Minisitiri w’Intebe wa Canada. 1952:  Morgan Tsvangirai, wabaye Minisitiri w’Intebe wa Zimbabwe. 1957:  Osama Bin Laden, washinze umutwe w’iterabwoba wa Al-Qaeda. Abatabarutse kuri iyi tariki: 1222: Johan Sverkersson, wabaye Umwami wa Suède. 1792:  John Stuart, wabaye Minisitiri w’Intebe w’u Bwongereza. 1951: Kijuro Shidehara wabaye Minisitiri w’Intebe w’u Buyapani. 1966:  Frits Zernike, Umudage wahawe igihembo cya Prix Nobel. 2014: Samuel W. Lewis, wabaye Ambasaderi wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika muri Israël. 2016:  Anita Brookner, Umwongereza wabaye umwanditsi w’inkuru ndende akaba n’umunyamateka.

title: Abanyaburayi bakora ubucuruzi mu Rwanda bashyizeho ishyirahamwe ribahuza
content: Iri shyirahamwe bise "European Business Chamber of Rwanda", rihurije hamwe abagera kuri 14, basanzwe bakora ubucuruzi bwabo mu gihugu. Giovanni Davite, umwe mu bagize uruhare mu gutangiza iri shyirahamwe, yavuze ko  ryatangijwe n’abakomoka mu gihugu cy’u Budage, bashakaga kujya hamwe bakubaka ubufatanye no guteza imbere ubucuruzi bwabo mu Rwanda. Uyu usanzwe ari n’umuyobozi wa Farumasi ya Kipharma  mu Rwanda  yagize ati “Bari bake ku buryo batashoboraga kuba bashinga ishyirahamwe. Ubu kubera iri shyirahamwe, hazajya habaho ubufatanye  buzafasha n’abandi bari ku mugabane w’u Burayi, kuba kuza gushora imari mu Rwanda.” Bimwe mu bigo biri muri iri shyirahamwe harimo Kipharma, Skol, Heineken, Brussels Airlines, Volkswagen n’ibindi. Abashinze iri shyirahamwe bavuga ko  hari abacuruzi b’Abanyaburayi bagera kuri 300 bakorera mu Rwanda. Iri shyirahamwe rivuga ko gahunda yabo y’imyaka itanu iri imbere, harimo  gukora ubuvugizi, gushyiraho ingamba no gusangira amakuru. Bavuga ko gushyira hamwe bizajya bibafasha kuganira ku byerekeye amategeko agenga imisoro ku byo binjiza mu gihugu n’ibyo bohereza mu mahanga, abakozi babo n’ibindi. Uhagarariye Umuryango w’Ubumwe bw’Ibihugu by’i Burayi mu Rwanda, Nicola Bellomo,  yagize ati “Ibi bizafasha guteza imbere inyungu z’aba bacuruzi mu Rwanda, kandi  twiteguye kubafasha.” Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Strawtec Building Solutions, Viktors Semjonovs, yavuze ko iri shyirahamwe ari amahirwe yo kugira ijwi rimwe mu gihe havutse ikibazo runaka. Ati “Muri rusange ni ngombwa ko abantu bagira ijwi rimwe kugira ngo babe bageza ikibazo ku nzego z’ubuyobozi, aho umuntu umwe atashobora kugera.” Aba bacuruzi bavuga ko kubera ko ari abacuruzi, akenshi usanga batagiraga umwanya wo kuba baganira ku bibazo bafite, uyu  ukaba ari  umwanya wo guhura bakaganira.

title: U Bwongereza bumaze gukoresha miliyari 5.7$ muri Brexit
content: NAO yatangaje ko u Bwongereza bumaze gukoresha 70% bya miliyari 6.3 z’ama-pound zateganyirijwe urugendo rw’imyiteguro ya Brexit, hagati ya kamarampaka yo muri Kamena 2016 na tariki 31 Werurwe uyu mwaka. NAO ivuga ko amafaranga menshi yakoreshejwe ku bakozi bihariye angana na miliyari 1.9 z’ama-pound, kubaka ibikorwa remezo bishya byatwaye miliyari 1.5 z’ama-pound naho kwishyura abajyanama bitwara miliyoni 288 z’ama-pound. Umuyobozi wa NAO, Gareth Davies, yavuze ko ‘iyi raporo ku nshuro ya mbere itanze ishusho nyayo y’uburyo guverinoma y’u Bwongereza, yakoresheje ingengo y’imari n’ibyo yayikoreshejemo’. NAO ivuga kandi ko imibare yayo yibanze ku ngano y’ibyo u Bwongereza bwakoresheje mu myiteguro ya Brexit, itarebye ku bindi buzatanga mu gihe kiri imbere harimo nka miliyari 39 z’ama-pound za gatanya bwemeranyijwe na EU. Intumwa ihagarariye u Burayi mu biganiro n’u Bwongereza mu rugendo rwa Brexit, Michel Barnier, ubwo hasozwaga ibiganiro bya mbere nyuma ya Brexit kuri uyu wa Kane, yavuze ko hari ibyo u Bwongereza na EU batarimo kumvikana kandi bikomeye. Ati “Mvugishije ukuri kose, hari ibitumvikanwaho kandi birakomeye, bishobora kuba birenze ibisanzwe”. U Bwongereza bwari bumaze imyaka irenga 50 muri EU, bwayivuyemo kuwa 31 Mutarama uyu mwaka. Ubu buri mu gihe cy’inzibacyuho kizarangira mu mpera za 2020, aho amategeko ya EU agikurikizwa mu gihe impande zombi zikiganira ku masezerano y’ubucuruzi.

title: Abanyarwanda bategujwe ko ibice byinshi bishobora kwibasirwa n’imyuzure n’inkangu
content: Muri Gashyanatare 2020 imvura yaguye yari hagati ya milimetero 39.6 na 174. Impuzandengo y’ubushyuhe bwo hejuru yari hagati ya dogere Celsius 30.7 na 22.4, naho impuzandengo y’ubushyuhe bwo hasi yari hagati ya dogere Celsius 11.10 na 19.4. Meteo Rwanda yakomeje ivuga ko muri Werurwe hateganyijwe imvura izafasha inzuri gukura neza ndetse n’aborozi babone ubwatsi n’amazi by’amatungo. Iyi mvura ishobora gutuma ibihingwa bimera neza muri iki gihembwe cy’ihinga cy’itumba. Yakomeje iti “Uburengerazuba, amajyepfo ndetse n’umujyi wa Kigali ndetse n’utundi duce bishobora kwibasirwa n’imyuzure ndetse n’inkangu. Abantu barwara indwara zituruka ku mihindagurikire y’ikirere zishobora kubibasira. Inkuba zishobora kuzumvikana cyane mu misozi miremire cyane cyane mugace k’uburengerazuba.” Minisiteri y’Ibikorwa by’Ubutabazi (Minema), yatangaje ko imvura yaguye mu mezi atatu ya mbere y’uyu mwaka, imaze kwangiza ibintu bitari bike harimo no kuba imaze guhitana ubuzima bw’abantu 53. Imibare iyi minisiteri yahaye IGIHE, igaragaza ko uretse aba bantu 53 bamaze kwicwa n’imvura, abandi 84 bakomeretse naho inzu 858 zirasenyuka. Isaba Abanyarwanda kwirinda bazirika ibisenge no kuyobora amazi kugira ngo adatwara inzu zabo, bagakoresha imirindankuba aho ziunze kwibasira.

title: U Bufaransa bwemeye kohereza murumuna wa Blaise Compaoré ngo aburanishirizwe muri Burkina Faso
content: François Compaoré ashinjwa uruhare mu rupfu rw’umunyamakuru wakoraga inkuru zicukumbuye witwa Nobert Zongo. Uwo munyamakuru yishwe mu gihe yari ari gukora iperereza ku rupfu rudasobanutse rw’uwahoze ari umushoferi wa François  Compaoré ndetse n’urupfu rw’abandi bantu batatu. Urupfu rwa Zongo rwateje imyigaragambyo ikomeye muri Burkina Faso. Abanyamategeko ba François Compaoré bamaganye icyo cyemezo cyo kohereza umukiliya wabo muri Burkina Faso kuko ashobora guhabwa igihano cy’urupfu kandi kitemewe mu mategeko y’u Bufaransa, nkuko BBC yabitangaje.

title: Kamonyi: RIB yafashe abagabo babiri biyitiriraga abakozi ba MTN bakambura abaturage
content: Mu butumwa RIB yanyujije kuri Twitter kuri uyu wa Gatanu, yatangaje ko abo bantu bafatiwe mu Karere ka Kamonyi aho bohererezaga abantu ubutumwa bababwira ko amafaranga yayobeye kuri telefone zabo, ko bashaka uburyo bayabasubiza. Abafashwe bafungiye kuri sitasiyo ya RIB iri i Runda mu gihe iperereza rikomeje kugira ngo bashyikirizwe ubutabera. RIB yakomeje ikangurira baturarwanda gushishoza no kwirinda abatekamutwe babasaba kubasubiza amafaranga cyangwa imibare y’ibanga (Password) bavuga ko iba yayobeye kuri telefoni zabo. Ingingo ya 34 mu gitabo giteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange ivuga ko umuntu wese wihesha umutungo w’undi, imari ye yose cyangwa igice cyayo mu buryo bw’uburiganya yiyitiriye izina ritari ryo cyangwa umurimo adafitiye ububasha cyangwa akizeza icyiza cyangwa agatinyisha ko hari ikibi kizaba, aba akoze icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko, ahanishwa igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka ibiri ariko kitarenze imyaka itatu n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda atari munsi ya miliyoni eshatu ariko atarenze miliyoni eshanu.

title: ICC yafunguye iperereza ku byaha Ingabo za Amerika zakoreye muri Afghanistan
content: Umushinjacyaha Mukuru w’uru rukiko, Fatou Bensouda, yagaragaje ko hazakorwa iperereza ku byaha byose byakorewe muri icyo gihugu, icyemezo cyenyegeje umuriro hagati y’uru rukiko rukorera mu Buholandi na Leta ya Amerika. Hashize imyaka 13 ibiro by’Umushinjacyaha Mukuru wa ICC bitangaje ko hakenewe iperereza ku byaha by’intambara byakorewe muri Afghanistan, byabereye ku butaka bw’icyo gihugu guhera ku wa 1 Gicurasi 2003. Ni iperereza rizareba ku barwanyi b’Abatalibani (Taliban), Ingabo za Afghanistan n’Ingabo za Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Urukiko rwemeje ko hanapererezwa ku byaha byakorewe muri kasho z’ibanga za CIA muri Lituanie, Pologne na Roumanie. Guverinoma ya Afghanistan yaherukaga kwanga iryo perereza, ivuga ko inzego zayo zifite ubushobozi bwo gukurikirana ibyaha byose byakorewe ku butaka bwayo. Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, kuva kera na kare zagaragaje uburakari kuri iryo perereza ubwo ryari ritangiye gusabwa, cyane ko icyo gihugu kitanashyize umukono ku masezerano ya Rome ashyiraho ICC. Mu minsi ishize Perezida Donald Trump yanatangaje ko azafatira ibihano abacamanza n’abashinjacyaha b’uru rukiko, umunsi batangiye iperereza ku byaha by’intambara ku ngabo za Amerika, birimo gukurirwaho visa. Nubwo hejuru y’izo mbogamizi zose ICC yakora iperereza, bizagorana guta muri yombi abo byagaragara ko hari ibyaha bakoze, ngo babe bagezwa i La Haye ku cyicaro cy’urukiko, nk’uko bigenda ku bandi. Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Mike Pompeo, yavuze ko igihugu cye kitari umunyamuryango wa ICC, bityo kizafata ingamba zose zishoboka mu "kurinda abaturage bacu iyo ngirwa rukiko itagendera ku mategeko". Uyu mwanzuro ufashwe mu gihe Amerika yaherukaga gusinyana amasezerano n’Abatalibani agamije kugarura amahoro muri Afghanistan. Ni amasezerano agomba gutuma Amerika ivana ingabo zayo muri icyo gihugu. Yasinywe ku wa Gatandatu w’icyumweru gishize nyuma y’ibiganiro bimaze umwaka urenga, bigamije guhagarika intambara imaze imyaka isaga mirongo ine. Pompeo yavuze ko bitangaje kuba iki cyemezo gifashwe nyuma y’amasezerano yagombaga gutanga amahoro atarigeze abaho. Yavuze ko gishimangira uburyo uru rukiko rwakomeje kunengwa n’ibihugu byinshi. Nyamara uru rukiko, ibihugu bya Afurika byakunze kuvuga ko rubereyeho gukurikirana abayobozi babyo, kuko rutajya rureba abo ku yindi migabane. Mu gihe Amerika yaherukaga gukuraho visa ku bakozi ba ICC, kuri iyi nshuro ntabwo Pompeo yatangaje ibihano cyangwa ingamba igihugu cye kigiye gufata, aho yise uru rukiko “igikoresho cy’ukwihimuranaho muri politiki.” Mu Ukuboza umwaka ushize ubwo Amerika yakuragaho visa y’Umushinjacyaha mukuru wa ICC kubera iri perereza, Perezida wa ICC Chile Eboe-Osuji, yavuze ko bibangamiye “urukiko mpuzamahanga mu bijyanye n’ubwigenge bw’ubucamanza.”

title: Uganda: Abantu 24 barashaka kwiyamamariza gusimbura Museveni
content: Benshi mu bagaragaje ubwo bushake bwo kuzasimbura Perezida Museveni ntibazwi cyane muri Uganda, usibye Depite Robert Kyagulanyi, uzwi nka Bobi Wine, uhagarariye agace ka Kyadondo y’Iburasirazuba mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, na Lt Gen Henry Tumukunde, wahoze ari Minisitiri w’Umutekano. Gusa haracyategerejwe amazina akomeye agomba kwigaragaza kuko amashyaka menshi muri iki gihugu ataragaragaza abagomba kuyahagararira muri ayo matora. Lt Gen Tumukunde, wari minisitiri muri guverinoma ya Museveni kugera mu 2018, ni we uherutse gutangaza ko agomba kuziyamamaza, agakura Museveni ku butegetsi amazeho imyaka isaga 30. Itegeko rigenga amatora y’umukuru w’igihugu muri Uganda ryo mu 2015 riteganya ko umuntu wese ushaka kwiyamamariza kuyobora Uganda, agomba gutangira inzira itegura kuzahagararira ishyaka rye mu mezi 12 abanziriza itariki y’amatora. Ingingo ya mbere y’iri tegeko ivuga ko muri icyo gihe, ushaka kwiyamamaza yemerewe kuzenguruka igihugu cyose akoresha ibiganiro mu banyamuryango b’ishyaka rye abasaba kumushyigikira, agategura imigabo n’imigambi ye, agategura n’ibindi bikoresho ndetse agakusanya n’inkunga y’amafaranga azakoreshwa mu kwiyamamaza binyuze mu buryo bwemewe n’amategeko n’inama zemewe zatumijwe n’abamuhagarariye mu gihugu hose. Umuyobozi wa Komisiyo y’Amatora muri Uganda, Simon Mugenyi Byabakama, yatangarije Daily Monitor ko ubu abashaka kwiyamamaza bemerewe gutangira gukora ibiganiro byo gushaka ababashyigikiye, ariko yongeraho ko bagomba kubikora bagendeye ku murongo uteganywa n’amategeko asanzweho atandukanya ibyo biganiro n’ibikorwa byo kwiyamamaza. Byabakama yakomeje avuga ko bagira inama abashaka kuziyamamaza yo kutazahirahira bakora ibisa no kwiyamamaza, bazenguruka ku mihanda bitwaje ko bari mu nama z’ibiganiro byo gushaka uko bahagararira amashyaka yabo, kuko ibyo bizaba bihabanye cyane n’ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya gatatu y’itegeko rigenga amatora ryo mu 2005. Mu bihe bitandukanye Polisi yabangamiye inama nk’izi zategurwaga na Bobi Wine, imushinja ko atigeze akurikiza ibisabwa n’amategeko ajyanye n’umutekano Bamwe mu bashaka kuziyamamaza Nyero Francis Elton Lakelle: Uyu yagerageje inshuro nyinshi kujya mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, ahagarariye agace ka Acholi ariko bikanga. Ntiyemerewe kwiyamamaza mu 2017, mu matora y’abadepite bagombaga guhagararira agace ka Arua y’Amajyaruguru, nyuma yo kunanirwa kwishyura miliyoni 3 z’amashiringi yasabwaga ngo yemezwe nk’umukandida. Lt Gen Henry Tumukunde :  Yasezerewe mu ngabo za Uganda (UPDF) afite ipeti rya Lieutenant-General. Yarwanye intambara yagejeje Museveni ku butegetsi hagati ya 1981-1986. Yahawe kuyobora mu myanya itandukanye irimo kuba Minisitiri w’Umutekano, kuyobora urwego rushinzwe umutekano imbere  mu gihugu ndetse ahagararira n’igisirikare mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko hagati ya 1995 na 2005. Robert Kyagulanyi: Azwi cyane ku kazina yavanye mu muziki ka Bobi Wine. Yagaragaje ko azahangana na Museveni w’imyaka 75, mu matora ya 2021. Ubu ni umudepite uhagarariye agace ka Kyadondo y’Iburasirazuba, gaherereye mu karere ka Wakiso. Ahanganye na Museveni yitwaje itsinda rye yise “People Power” ndetse yahanganye n’inzego z’umutekano inshuro nyinshi zimubuza gukora ibiganiro byo gushaka amajwi mu bayoboke be ngo azahagararire ishyaka rye mu matora y’umukuru w’igihugu. Mu bandi bamaze kugaragaza ko baziyamamaza harimo Dr Moses Khalim Amin, Timothy Mugerwa, Apostle Ben Israel Sseninde, Bob Paul Akileng, Isaac Sendagire Salongo, Mathias Semusu, Joseph Mwambazi, Stephen Kaweesa, Christopher Rubaga na  Ambrose Kyomukama. Hari kandi Charles Mutaasa Kafeero, Dr Joel Senkimpi, Yosam Makooma Tunawooza,  Fred Mwesigye, John Herbert Nkangabwa, Moses Byamugisha, Fred Chemuko Wakuri, Maguru Ruhinda, Francis Elton Nrero Lakalle, Lt Gen Henry Tumukunde,  Edward Nyonzima na Grace Kabarungi Muluya.

title: Imvura yaguye mu mezi atatu imaze guhitana abantu 53, abandi 84 barakomereka
content: Imibare iyi Minisiteri yahaye IGIHE, igaragaza ko uretse aba bantu 53 bamaze kwicwa n’imvura, abandi 84 bakomeretse naho inzu  858 zirasenyuka. Iyi minisiteri ivuga ko hangiritse hegitari 196 ziriho ibihingwa, amatungo 27 arapfa, ikigo nderabuzima kimwe kirasenyuka, imihanda 23, ibiraro 17, insengero umunani n’ibindi. Ibikorwa byo kuvuza abakomeretse byatangijwe no gusubiranya ibyangiritse. Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe ubumenyi bw’Ikirere (Meteo Rwanda), cyo kivuga ko ahenshi mu gihugu mu mezi ya Werurwe, Mata na Gicurasi azwi nk’igihe cy’itumba, hazagwa imvura iri hejuru y’isanzwe igwa muri icyo gihe. Meteo Rwanda yatangaje ko izo mpinduka zizaterwa n’uko ubushyuhe bwo mu Nyanja ngari cyane iya Pasifika buri hejuru muri iyi minsi, icyakora ngo bukazagenda bugabanuka uko iminsi ishira.

title: Mu kwezi kumwe RDC ishobora gutangaza intsinzi kuri Ebola
content: Kuwa 3 Werurwe 2020, itsinda ry’abaganga mu kigo gishinzwe kwita ku barwayi ba Ebola, i Beni muri Kivu y’Amajyaruguru, ryishimiye ko umurwayi wa nyuma wa Ebola, Semida Masika, yasohotse mu bitaro yakize. Umuyobozi wa Komite ishinzwe guhangana na Ebola, Dr. Jean-Jacques Muyembe, yavuze ko kuba umurwayi wa nyuma wa Ebola, yarasohotse mu bitaro kuwa 3 Werurwe, bisobanuye ko iki cyorezo kirimo kurwanywa, ariko ari ngombwa gutegereza iminsi 42 kugira ngo nibura hatangazwe ko cyatsinzwe burundu. Avuga ko kubara byatangiye kuwa 2 Werurwe, umunsi umurwayi wa nyuma yasuzumwe ntasanganwe Ebola, aho bivuze ko adashobora kwanduza iyo virusi abandi. Ati “Byose nibiramuka bigenze neza, dushobora kuzatangaza ko icyorezo cya Ebola kitagihari kuwa 12 Mata 2020”. Kuva mu ntangiriro za Kanama 2018, abantu 3444 baketsweho Ebola, abagera ku 3310 basanzwe bayirwaye naho 134 basanga ntayo barwaye. Imibare y’Ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku buzima (OMS), igaragaza ko kugeza kuwa 2 Werurwe, abagera ku 2264 bishwe na Ebola.

title: Nyamagabe: Batanu bahitanwe n’umuvu w’amazi wabasanze mu buvumo basengeragamo
content: Amakuru atangwa n’inzego z’ubuyobozi muri ako Karerere avuga ko byabereye mu Murenge wa Cyanika mu Kagari ka Ngoma mu Mudugudu wa Kamuhirwa. Iyo mvura yaguye ahagana saa kumi n’ebyiri naho abantu umuvu watwaye ni abasanzwe basengera muri EAR Kirambi/Nyagisozi mu Karere ka Nyanza. Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Nyamagabe, Uwamahoro Bonaventure, yavuze ko abo baturage bakomoka  mu Karere ka Nyanza, bakaba bari baje kuhasengera mu buryo butemewe. Kuri ubu inzego z’umutekano ku bufatanye n’abayobozi ndetse n’abaturage barimo gushakisha imirambo y’abatwawe n’uwo mwuzure. Ati “Turacyashakisha ko twababona ku bufatanye n’abaturage duhanahana amakuru n’aho baturuka mu Karere ka Nyanza kugira ngo tubashe kumenya niba  hari abandi babuze.” Yasabye abaturage kwirinda kujya gusengera ahatemewe hashobora gushyira ubuzima bwabo mu kaga. Amazi y’abatwaye ni ayaturutse ku gishanga cyuzuye giteza umuvu w’amazi ubasanga muri urwo rutare. [email protected]

title: Amasomo u Rwanda rwakwigira ku buhinzi buteye imbere muri Israel
content:
Imibare igaragaza ko nibura buri mwaka, Israel yohereza mu mahanga ibikomoka ku buhinzi bifite agaciro ka miliyari 1.3 y’amadorali ya Amerika. Kugira ngo ubuhinzi bw’iki gihugu butere imbere, cyashyize ingufu mu bijyanye no guhuriza hamwe ubutaka no kuhira ibirirwa, hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga ritandukanye. U Rwanda kimwe mu bihugu ku Isi gifite amateka ameze kimwe na Israel harimo aya Jenoside, gishyize imbere guteza imbere umwuga w’ubuhinzi, ntube uwo guhingira kurya gusa ahubwo abantu bagasagurira n’amasoko. Minisitiri w’Ubuhinzi n’Ubworozi, Dr Mukeshimana Gérardine , aherutse kubwira IGIHE ko abanyarwanda 65% batunzwe n’ubuhinzi. Ni mu gihe umusaruro mbumbe uva ku buhinzi, ubu ugeze kuri miliyari 1935 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Ibi byatumye mu 2012 u Rwanda na Israel, bigirana imikoranire igamije guhugura abize amasomo ajyanye n’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi, abanyarwanda bakoherezwa muri iki gihugu guhabwa amahugurwa ku buhinzi mu gihe cy’amezi 11, nyuma bakagaruka mu Rwanda gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo igihugu cyabatumye. Ndayizigiye Emmanuel ni umwe mu banyarwanda 30 ba mbere u Rwanda rwohereje muri iki gihugu mu 2012.
Uyu yaje no  kuba umunyeshuri  wa mbere warushije abandi bageraga ku bihumbi 10  mu masomo, bari baravuye mu bihugu 13. Yagiye kwiga muri iki gihugu avuye kwiga muri Kaminuza ya ISAE Busogo ibijyanye n’ubuhinzi bw’imboga, imbuto, indabo n’ibiti by’imitako. Ndayizigiye yabwiye IGIHE ko umuntu wese ugeze muri Israel atungurwa n’uburyo iki ari ubutayu kuko kigusha imvura gake ariko kikaba cyeza. Yagize ati “Iki nicyo gihugu cyihaza ku biribwa barangiza bagasagurira u Burayi, Aziya n’Abarabu, icyo kintu cyarantangaje cyane, iki gihugu kivana ahandi ubutaka bwo guhingaho, kikanakoresha imashini ku buryo usanga umuntu umwe  atera umuti mu bihingwa bihinze ku hegitari nyinshi.” Iki gihugu gifite inyanja ya Galilee ikoreshwa buhira hose, iyo uhageze ubona barayishyizemo amatiyo azamura amazi,  gusa nyuma gusanga amazi arimo kugabanuka, bafata ingamba zo gushyira andi matiyo mu nyanja ya Méditerranée ku buryo bavomamo amazi akajya mu Nyanja yabo ya galilee. Ati “Ibi iyo ubirebye biragutangaza uburyo twe dufite ibiyaga birimo i Kivu, Muhazi, Mugesera n’ibindi, imigezi minini nka Nyabarongo,  ariko ugasanga muri metero 100 hari imyaka iri kuma, ibi byatumye nandika igitabo kivuga ngo “Niba muri Israel bishoboka, kubera iki mu Rwanda bitashoboka?” Avuga ko byafashe imyaka 30 kugira ngo ubuyobozi buhitemo gushyira  ingufu mu buhinzi n’igisirikare, izindi nzego zikaza zikurikiye. Bisaba iki ngo u Rwanda rugere ku rwego Israel igezeho? Ndayizigiye avuga ko bisaba guhindura imyumvire ku bijyanye n’ubuhinzi, abantu bakareka kumva ko ubuhinzi ari ubwo gukorwa n’abantu batishoboye kuko busaba igishoro kigaragara, cyane ko  iyo bukozwe n’abantu batishoboye nabo babukora mu buryo butishoboye umusaruro ukaba muke. Ati “Ikindi ni uko hakwiye kubaho gahunda z’igihe kirekire, kugira ngo abantu bagire aho bagera ni ngombwa ko bicara bagashyiraho gahunda y’igihe kirekire, ingamba zizabafasha kugera kuri iyo ntego biyemeje ndetse n’ahazava ingengo y’imari bisaba.” Avuga ko gukora ikintu bitewe n’uko byakomeye cyangwa se hari impamvu runaka, bituma bikorwa huti huti kandi ntibikorwe neza mu buryo buzaramba. Uburyo abize muri  iki gihugu biyemeje gufasha u Rwanda Mu 2016, Ndayizigiye yagarutse mu gihugu ashishikariza bagenzi be kwishyira hamwe bagakora ubuhinzi bw’umwuga,  bashinga ikigo gikora ibijyanye n’ubuhinzi cyitwa HoReCo (Horticulture in Reality Corporation Ltd), aba umuyobozi wacyo. Kugeza ubu Koperative HoReCo, igizwe n’abagera kuri 96 bize amasomo atandukanye y’ubuhinzi harimo ubuhinzi rusange, ubuhinzi bw’imboga, imbuto, indabo n’ibiti by’imitako, kuhira imyaka, guhingisha no gukoresha imishani mu buhinzi, ubushabitsi bujyanye n’iby’ubuhinzi n’ibindi, biganjemo abize muri Israel. Nubwo nta bushobozi bari bafite bujyanye n’amafaranga, Ndayizigiye avuga ko bari bafite ubumenyi kandi bumva ko ari umutwaro bafitiye igihugu, cyakoresheje amafaranga menshi mu kubigisha mu mahanga. Ibi ngo byatumye batinyuka, ahitamo guhamagara bagenzi be icyenda ngo barebe icyo bakora, aza no kubigeza kuri Minisiteri y’Ubuhinzi n’Ubworozi (MINAGRI) nabo barabyakira. Nubwo nta bushobozi bw’amafaranga bari bafite, biyemeje buri muntu gutanga umugabane shingiro w’ibihumbi 50 muri koperative. Bahise bajya mu buhinzi bw’imboga, urusenda, watermelon, ibitunguru, n’ibindi mu Karere ka Nyanza ahitwa Rwabicuma. Avuga ko batangiye bakodesha imirima ku bufatanye n’umushinga witwaga LWH wakoreraga muri MINAGRI, batangirira  kuri hegitari zirindwi, aho bahingaga urusenda bakarwohereza mu mahanga, abahinzi bari muri ako gace baza kwigira mu mirima yabo uko bahinga mu buryo bwa kijyambere. Nyuma yo kugaragaza ubumenyi mu by’ubuhinzi, byatumye MINAGRI ibinyujije muri RAB,  basinyana nabo  amasezerano yo kujya bafasha abandi bahinzi bagenzi babo bakorera ubuhinzi mu byanya byuhirwa byatunganyijwe na Leta, biherereye mu turere dutandukanye tw’Igihugu. Amasezerano ya mbere yatangiye mu 2017 bakajya bafasha abahinzi bakorera mu byanya byuhirwa byatunganyijwe na Leta, mu bishanga n’imisozi, batangirira ku buso bwa hegitari ibihumbi bibiri, ubu bageze kuri hegitari 10,037, mu turere 18, bakaba bafasha n’abahinzi barenga ibihumbi 44. HoReCo ivuga ko ishyira umugoronome  muri buri cyanya cyangwa  benshi, bagafasha abahinzi mu bijyanye no gupima ubutaka, guhitamo ibihingwa bijyanye n’ubutaka, igerageza ry’imbuto zitandukanye, gusarura no gufata neza umusaruro nyuma y’isarura n’ibindi. Kugeza ubu kandi batangiye umushinga wo gutubura amoko atandukanye y’imbuto y’ibirayi ku bufatanye na AGRA, MINAGRI na RAB mu Karere ka Musanze mu Kinigi. Yatangaje ko ibi bakora bimaze gufasha igihugu kuko hari aho basanze abantu bafite umusaruro ungana na toni eshatu kuri hegitari ku gihingwa cy’umuceri, ubu bageze kuri toni esheshatu, ku bigori hari aho abaturage bamaze kugera kuri toni  zirindwi baravuye kuri toni enye cyangwa eshatu.

title: Uganda yafunze dosiye ya Ben Rutabana, hahanzwe amaso inzira za politiki
content: Izo raporo zirimo iz’inzego za polisi zishinzwe amaperereza atandukanye, urushinzwe iperereza rya gisirikare n’iry’imbere mu gihugu n’iy’umushinjacyaha wa leta. Izi raporo zose zagejejwe mu rukiko n’umushinjacyaha mukuru wa leta kuri uyu wa Kane. Mu minsi ishize nibwo Urukiko Rukuru rwa Kampala rwategetse inzego zose z’umutekano zirimo Urwego rwa Gisirikare rushinzwe ubutasi, CMI, n’Urwego rushinzwe iperereza mu gihugu, ISO, kugeza Rutabana mu rukiko. Rutabana yafashwe muri Nzeri umwaka ushize. Yabanje kujyanwa ku cyicaro cya CMI i Mbuya, nyuma arahakurwa ajyanwa ku cyicaro cya ISO, aza gusubizwa kuri CMI, gusa ibi byose byakorwaga mu ibanga rikomeye. Nyuma y’uko Umushinjacyaha wa leta abwiye urukiko rukuru ko Rutabana atari mu maboko y’inzego z’umutekano z’igihugu, abamwunganira mu by’amategeko basanga gukurikirana ikibazo cye mu nzego z’ubutabera gisa nk’ikirangiriye ahangaha kuko ari nta kindi ubucamanza bwakora. Umwe mu banyamategeko ba Ben Rutabana witwa David Gureme Mushabe, yabwiye Ijwi ry’Amerika, ko nta handi bajya kuko bakiniraga mu kibuga cy’amategeko none kikaba cyafunzwe. Ati “Magingo aya dosiye yafunzwe, iyo urukiko rusabye ko umuntu agaragazwa izo nzego zishinzwe umutekano zikandika zivuga ko zitamufite mu mfungwa, ubwo aho niho kure urukiko rushobora kugera. Ubu ahasigaye ni ugukoresha inzira za politiki kubera ko izo nzego zishobora kuba zifite umuntu zikandika zivuga ko zitamufite. Twakiniraga ku kibuga cy’amategeko none baragifunze nta handi twajya”. Nubwo inzego z’umutekano n’ubushinjacyaha zivuga ko Rutabana atari mu maboko yabo, Mushabe afite icyizere ko umukiriya we ari ku butaka bwa Uganda. Ati “Umva, amakuru mfite aranyemeza ko ari mu maboko ya CMI nubwo bwose ntafite aho byanditse, mfite abantu bakorana na CMI babimbwiye, ndibwira ko akiri muzima”. Akomeza avuga ko “Nk’umunyamategeko akazi kanjye karangiye ariko nk’abavandimwe n’inshuti bashobora gukomeza izindi nzira harimo n’iza politiki”. Abanyamategeko  ba Rutabana bavuga ko yafatiwe i Kampala n’abantu bari bambaye imyenda ya gisivili bavuga ko ngo bakorana n’amashami ya gisirikare ashinzwe iperereza CMI na ISO mu gitondo cya tariki 8 Nzeri 2019, kuva ubwo akaba yaraburiwe irengero. Amakuru avuga ko Ku wa 4 Nzeri 2019 aribwo Ben Rutabana yahagurutse i Bruxelles n’indege ya sosiyete ya Emirates Airlines ya saa 21:45 yerekeza i Kampala aho yari agiye mu bikorwa by’umutwe w’iterabwoba wa RNC asanzwe abarizwamo, abereye komiseri ushinzwe kongera ubushobozi. Muri uru rugendo ngo yabanje guhagarara i Dubai mbere yo kugera ku kibuga cy’indege cya Entebbe ku wa 5 Nzeri saa saaba n’iminota 50. Muri iki gihe Yakomeje kuvugana kuri telefoni n’umugore we Diane Rutabana hagati y’itariki 5-8 Nzeri gusa nyuma ntiyongera kumva ijwi rye. Rutabana ngo yagombaga gusubira mu Bubiligi ku wa 19 Nzeri nabwo akoresheje Emirates Airlines, ariko baramutegereje baraheba. Hari amakuru yagiye avugwa ko yaba yararigishijwe na bagenzi be bahurira mu mutwe w’iterabwoba wa RNC barangajwe imbere na Kayumba Nyamwasa, kubera ubwumvikane buke bari bafitanye. Umuryango wa Rutabana umaze kwandikira amaburuwa atabarika Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga ya Uganda ari nako utakambira Leta y’u Bufaransa nk’igihugu afitiye ubwenegihugu ngo kigire icyo gikora kuri iki kibazo, gusa byose byabaye ubusa.

title: USA: Elizabeth Warren yivanye mu matora y’uzahagararira aba- démocrates
content: Elizabeth Warren yahariye bagenzi be bari guhabwa amahirwe barimo senateri Bernie Sanders na Joe Biden wigeze kuba Visi Perezida. Warren akuyemo kandidatire ye nyuma yo kwitwara nabi mu matora y’ibanze amaze iminsi aba, kugeza kuwa Kabiri mu matora yabereye muri Leta 14 akabura n’imwe atsindamo harimo na Leta avukamo ya Massachusetts. Uyu mugore akuyemo akarenge akurikira abandi barimo Pete Buttigieg, Amy Klobuchar ndetse n’umuherwe Michael Bloomberg bivanye mu matora mu ntangiriro z’iki cyumweru  bagashyigikira Biden. Warren nyuma yo guhagarika ibikorwa byo kwiyamamaza, ntabwo yahise atangaza undi mukandida mu basigaye azashyigikira. Biden w’imyaka 77 na Sanders w’imyaka 78 nibo bahabwa amahirwe menshi yo kuvamo umwe uzahangana na Perezida Donald Trump mu Ugushyingo 2020. Nubwo mu myumvire ya Politiki Warren ajya guhuza na Sanders, Reuters yatangaje ko ashobora gukomeza gushyigikira Biden nyuma y’itsinzi ikomeye yagize kuri uyu wa Kabiri, atsinda muri Leta 10 muri 14 zakorewemo amatora. Ibyo kandi bishingira ku mubano mubi umaze iminsi hagati ya Warren na Sanders nyuma y’uko Sanders yihakanye Warren ko  nta biganiro bagiranye,  akamubwira ko nta mugore watsinda Trump.

title: Nyarugenge: Abasore batatu bafashwe bari kwambura umuturage
content: Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu mujyi wa Kigali, Chief Inspector of Police (CIP) Marie Gorette Umutesi avuga ko hari hashize iminsi abaturage batanze amakuru ko hari abambuzi bitwikira ijoro  bagatega abaturage mu mudugudu wa Akishuri mu kagari ka Kimisagara mu murenge wa Kimisagara bakabambura ibyo bafite. Mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa Gatatu nibwo abo bambuzi uko ari batatu bafashwe bamaze gushikuza telefoni uwitwa Abimana, bayimushikuza batazi ko hafi aho hari abapolisi n’abanyerondo bari mu kazi niko guhita babafata. CIP Umutesi yagize ati “Uyu musore Abimana yari mu nzira ataha iwabo mu murenge wa Kimisagara mu kagari ka Kimisagara ahura na bariya bantu uko ari batatu, bashaka kumwambura arataka atabaza, niko guhita bamuniga bamwambura telefone ifite agaciro k’ibihumbi makumyabiri.” CIP Umutesi akomeza avuga ko icyo gihe Abimana yatakaga mbere y’uko bamuniga abanyerondo b’umwuga bumvise umuntu utaka bajya kureba agace atakiyemo bahita bahura n’abo bajura bari kwiruka, bitabaza Polisi iraza barabafata. Abaturage batuye muri ako gace babonye abo basore bavuze ko basanzwe bazwiho ubujura cyane ko umwe muri bo yigeze no kujyanwa Iwawa kubera ubujura. CIP Umutesi yibukije abagifite ingeso mbi yo kwiba no gukora ibindi byaha ko bibeshya kuko uburyo bwose n’amayeri yose bakoresha bitazabahira. Ati“Polisi y’u Rwanda igihe cyose iri maso, kandi ku bufatanye n’abaturage ndetse n’izindi nzego z’umutekano, uwo ariwe wese uzagerageza kwiba cyangwa gukora ibindi byaha nta kabuza azafatwa. Turagira inama abafite iyo ngeso kuvana amaboko mu mifuka bagakora bakiteza imbere bakareka kwambura rubanda ibyo batakoreye cyane ko ingaruka yabyo ari ugukurikiranwa mu mategeko.” Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu mujyi wa Kigali yasabye abaturage kujya bagaragaza abantu bose bakekaho gukora ibyaha kugira ngo bikumirwe hakiri kare. Abafashwe  bashyikirijwe urwego rw’igihugu rw’ubugenzacyaha (RIB) rukorera kuri sitasiyo ya Polisi ya Kimisagara kugira ngo bakurikiranwe ku byaha bakekwaho. Ingingo ya 168 mu itegeko riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange rivuga ko kwiba hakoreshejwe kiboko cyangwa ibikangisho bihanishwa igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka itanu ariko kitarenze imyaka irindwi n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda atari munsi ya miliyoni eshatu ariko atarenze miliyoni eshanu.

title: Netanyahu yatsinze amatora ntiyemererwa gushyiraho guverinoma
content: Ishyaka rya Netanyahu rya Likud, ntiryabonye imyanya 61 mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko isabwa ngo rishyireho guverinoma kuko ryabonye 58 gusa nyuma yo guhuza amajwi n’amashyaka yemeye kwifatanya naryo. Bivuze ko hakenewe imyanya itatu. Netanyahu akaba akomeje kuvuga ko yatsinze amatora, aho ishyaka rye n’abo bifatanyije ngo bayatsinze bidasubirwaho. Yashinjije abo bahanganye kugerageza guhindura icyemezo cy’abaturage benshi ba Israel bahaye icyizere cy’intsinzi ishyaka Likud ayoboye. Ishyaka Blue and White rihanganye na Netanyahu ryagize imyanya 33. Umuyobozi waryo Benny Gantz, yavuze ko ‘mu gihugu kigendera kuri demokarasi ibyavuye mu matora n’ibyemezo by’abatora bigomba kubahwa’. Ibyavuye mu matora mu buryo budasubirwaho bizatangazwa kuwa Kabiri nyuma yo kongera kubarura amajwi y’ahantu hatandatu hatorewe ariko hakabamo ibibazo. Gusa abahatoreye bagera ku 5500 ntabwo byitezwe ko bahagije ngo hagire igihinduka mu buryo amashyaka yagabanye imyanya 120 y’abagize Inteko Ishinga Amategeko. Netanyahu w’imyaka 70 ni umwe mu bayoboye Israel igihe kirekire, arimo gushaka manda ya gatanu nyuma y’uko afashe ubuyobozi hagati yo mu 1996-1999, akongera kubujyaho guhera mu 2009. Nubwo abatavuga rumwe na Netanyahu bafite imyanya myinshi, biragoye ko nabo bahuza bagashyiraho guverinoma kuko ntibumvikana. Uko kudashyira hamwe gushobora gutuma umuyobozi wa Blue and White Benny Gantz, agorwa no kubahuza ngo bashyire hamwe amajwi. Gantz cyangwa Netanyahu ntibatabasha kubona imyanya yatuma bashyiraho guverinoma, Israel izakoresha amatora ku nshuro ya kane, ibintu bizaba bibaye bwa mbere. Amajwi yatangajwe ni ayavuye mu matora ya gatatu aheruka, aho Israel yakoze amatora inshuro eshatu mu gihe kitarenze umwaka, kuko amatora yo muri Mata no muri Nzeri nayo atagize uyatsinda ngo ashinge guverinoma.

title: Ingano y’umwuka wa CO2 Umunyarwanda yohereza mu kirere
content: Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe na Oxfam bwatangajwe kuri iki Cyumweru, bwagaragaje umuntu umwe mu Bwongereza bizamufata iminsi itanu kugira ngo agire uruhare mu bikorwa bituma haboneka CO2 mu gihe iyo ngano y’uyu mwuka ku muntu uri mu Rwanda bizamufata umwaka. Ku Cyumweru gitaha tariki ya 12 Mutarama, nibura Umwongereza azaba amaze kohereza mu kirere umwuka wa CO2 ungana n’uzoherezwa umwaka wose n’umuturage wo mu bihugu birimo Madagascar, Malawi, Ethiopia, Uganda, Guinea na Burkina Faso. Ubu bushakashatsi bwagaragaje ingano y’uyu mwuka woherezwa mu kirere ku batuye  mu Rwanda ari toni 0.09, Malawi ni 0.19, Burkina Faso zigeze kuri toni 0.25 ku mwaka. Bwagaragaje ko umuturage wo muri Nigeria agira uruhare mu bikorwa byohereza mu kirere uyu mwuka uhumanya ungana na toni 0.49 buri mwaka naho uwo mu Buhinde akaba ari 1.68. Ikigereranyo rusange ku Isi kiri kuri toni 4.7 ku muntu buri mwaka. Mu Bwongereza honyine, umuturage abarirwa toni 8.3. Abongereza benshi bavuze ko hakwiye kugira byinshi bikorwa mu kurwanya ikibazo cy’imihindagurikire y’ikirere cyane mu kugabanya umwuka uhumanya woherezwa mu kirere.
