Ubwiyongere mu kirere bw’uyu mwuka wa CO2 bugira ingaruka ku bidukikije zirimo ubushyuhe bukabije ku Isi, imyuzure n’ibindi. Mu myaka 100 ishize, ibikorwa bya muntu byongereye ubushyuhe ku Isi ho dogere celcius 2.5. Uko kwiyongera k’ubushyuhe ku Isi kwagiye gutera ibibazo bitandukanye birimo ihindagurika ry’ibihe, imyuzure ya hato na hato, kuzimira kw’inyamaswa n’ibimera bitandukanye n’ibindi. Mu myaka myinshi ishize, ibikorwa bya muntu byakomeje kugira uruhare mu iyangirika ry’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima ndetse n’ihindagurika ry’imiterere y’Isi. Ahari ubutayu bwa Sahara hahoze ibyatsi, amazi ndetse n’amashyamba nkuko byatangajwe n’Umushakashatsi Dr Curt Stager wo muri Kaminuza ya Smith College, nyamara byaje guhindurwa n’imyuzure, agace gasigara kambaye ubusa. Kubera ubushyuhe, ibikorwa bya muntu n’ibindi, amoko 1000 y’inyamswa yarimutse ajya gushaka ahandi aba, andi menshi yo yarazimiye. Mu myaka 15 iri imbere, isunzu ry’umusozi wa Kilimanjaro rizwiho urubura rizaba ryambaye ubusa. Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko ubushyuhe bw’Isi buri gutuma urubura kuri uwo musozi rushonga bidasanzwe. Uyu mwuka wa CO2 ugira ingaruka nyinshi ku buzima bwa muntu. Zirimo kurwara umutwe, kugira umunaniro, kubura ibitotsi, kugira ibibazo by’ubuhumekero kimwe no gututubikana ndetse wongera uburyo umutima utera umuntu akaba yarwara indwara y’umuvuduko ukabije w’amaraso cyangwa se akaba yajya muri Coma mu buryo butunguranye kubera kubura umwuka mwiza. Ubushakashatsi buherutse kugaragaza ko ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe ku bukungu bw’u Rwanda zishobora kugera ku kigero cya 4.5% by’umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu mu mwaka wa 2030. Ubu bushakashatsi bwakozwe n’itsinda ry’ibihugu 19 bihuriye ku kuba bisangiye ingaruka bigirwaho n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere (V20), bwerekanye ko ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe ku buzima bw’abanyarwanda zishobora kurushaho gukomera harimo ukwiyongera kwa Malaria ndetse n’ibyorezo bituruka ku bukonje ndetse n’ubushyuhe bw’ikirere. Ubushakashatsi bw’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cyo kubungabunga Ibidukikije (REMA) bwo muri Gicurasi 2018, ku bitera ihumana ry’umwuka n’iyangirika ry’ikirere, bwagaragaje ko ibintu biza ku isonga mu guhumanya umwuka uhumekwa mu Rwanda harimo umwotsi w’imodoka, imyotsi y’amakara n’inkwi n’ibindi. Bwanerekanye ko uduce duto duto tutabonwa n’amaso twivanga n’umwuka uhumekwa, tubangamiye bikomeye ubuzima bw’abaturarwanda bishobora gutera indwara z’ubuhumekero n’umutima. Bwanagaragaje ko mu bice bituwe hari ubwo naho ikigero cy’utwo tuvungukira kirenga urugero rwemewe, ahanini kubera imyuka ikomoka ku gukoresha ibicanwa bikomoka ku biti no gutwika ibyatsi, ibiyorero n’amashyamba. Hari ibice bimwe na bimwe byagaragayemo ko mu mpeshyi muri metero kibe imwe y’umwuka usangamo hagati ya mikorogarama (microgram) 100 na 150 z’utwo tuvungukira mu gihe ikigero cyemewe kitagomba kurenga mikorogarama 35 kuri meterokibe y’umwuka. Mu guhangana n’ingaruka ziterwa n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe n’iyangirika ry’ikirere, u Rwanda rwashyizeho ingamba nyinshi zitandukanye zirimo gutera ibiti byinshi bitanga umwuka mwiza aho kuri ubu ari ku buso bungana na 30% bw’igihugu. Harimo kandi gukumira imodoka zisohora imyuka ihumanya ihumanya binyuze mu isuzuma zikorerwa no kwimakaza ikoreshwa ry’ingufu zidahumanya. Ibi bijyanye n’uko ubu ku isoko ry’u Rwanda hagejejwe imodoka na moto zikoresha amashanyarazi.

title: Mu Rwanda hagiye gutangizwa banki itera inkunga imishinga y’ibidukikije
content: Amakuru ajyanye n’itangizwa ry’iyi banki mu Rwanda yatangarijwe mu kiganiro cyatangangiwe mu nama ya Cop 25 iherutse kubera muri Espagne mu mpera z’umwaka ushize kireba uruhare rwa banki zigamije guteza imbere ibidukikije mu gutuma ibihugu bigera ku ntego zabyo. Muri iyo nama niho hatangarijwe ko u Rwanda ruzashyiraho banki igamije gushyigikira imishinga igamije kurengera ibidukikije, “Rwanda Catalytic Green investment bank”. Uru rwego rw’imari ruzafasha mu gukangurira ibigo byigenga gushyigikira ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’imishinga itangiza ibidukikije mu gihugu. Umuyobozi ushinzwe ibijyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere muri Banki Nyafurika itsura Amajyambere (AfDB), Anthony Nyon, yatangaje ko hakenewe ingamba zihamye mu guhanga ikoranabuhanga rishya rigamije guhangana n’ibibazo by’imihindagurikire y’ibihe. Ati “Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, Banki Nyafurika itsura Amajyambere, binyuze mu bufasha bw’ikigega kigamije kurengera ibidukikije, iri gukorana n’ihuriro rya banki zigamije kurengera ibidukikije mu kureba uburyo butandukanye bwo gushyira igishoro mu bikorwa bifasha kurengera ibidukikije ku rwego rwo hasi, ari nako tuzamura uruhare rw’abikorera.” Kubera ibibazo by’imihindagurikire y’ibihe, nibura abahinzi bo mu Rwanda batakaza 40% by’umusaruro wabo. Leta yashyizeho ikigega Fonerwa cyahawe inshingano zo gufasha u Rwanda kugera ku bukungu butangiza ibidukikije binyuze mu gutera inkunga imishinga ya Leta n’abikorera iri muri uyu murongo. Kuva iki kigega cyashingwa, hahanzwe imirimo 138000 itangiza ibidukikije. Mu 2017, habarurwaga ko ubutaka bungana na hegitari 21 847 bwatunganyijwe hagamijwe kwirinda ko butwarwa n’isuri ndetse hegitari 12,998 z’inkombe n’imigezi n’ibiyaga zarasubiranyijwe ndetse imiryango ifashwa 17 449 kubona ingufu zidakomoka ku ngomero z’amashanyarazi. Icyo gihe FONERWA yari imaze gutanga inkunga ya miliyoni 100 z’amadorali, iyi nkunga ikaba ihabwa imishinga yatsinze binyuze mu marushanwa.

title: Ubushakashatsi bwerekanye ko Umuryango w’ingagi zo mu Birunga uri kwaguka
content: Ubwo bushakashatsi bwerekana ko ingagi zo mu ishyamba rya Bwindi muri Uganda na Sarambwe muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (RDC) zavuye kuri 400 zikagera kuri 459. Mu Rwanda, imibare y’ingagi  yariyongereye zigera kuri 604 zivuye kuri 480 zabarurwaga umwaka ushize. Ibyo byatumye ingagi zibarurwa mu gice cy’imisozi y’Ibirunga zigera ku 1,063. Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe bigizwemo uruhare n’Ikigega cyita ku ngagi muri Pariki y’Ibirunga (Dian Fossey Gorillas Fund) bushyirwa ahagaragara ku wa mbere tariki 16 Ukuboza 2019. Umuyobozi wa Dian Fossey, Dr Tara Stoinski,  yagize ati “ Ibyavuye muri ubu bushakashatsi ni gihamya y’imbaraga zo kwita ku bidukikije, hagati ya Guverinoma zirimo iy’u Rwanda, RDC na Uganda.” Yongeyeho, ati “Ingagi zo mu misozi ni zimwe mu nyamaswa zirinzwe cyane kuri uyu mugabane, kandi uyu munsi turabona icyo imbaraga z’abafatanyabikorwa mu kuzitaho zishobora gukora. Ni akazi gakomeye ku baturage, abayobozi ba za Guverinoma n’ababungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, ariko bishobora gukorwa.” Mu bushakashatsi bwabanje, ku ngagi zo mu misozi, ababukoze bageze mu bice byose by’ishyamba bashaka ibyafasha kubona amakuru ku ngagi n’izindi z’inyamabere n’ibimenyetso by’ibikorwa bya muntu. Mu bikorwa byabo bakusanyije umwanda wazo kugira ngo harebwe inkomoko yazo, ibyo byakozwe inshuro ebyiri kuva muri Werurwe kugeza Gicurasi 2018 no kuva mu Kwakira kugeza Ukuboza 2018 kugira ngo bimenyekane neza ko buri ngagi yagezweho. Mu mwaka ushize, Ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe iterambere (RDB) cyongeye ubuso bwa Pariki y’igihugu y’Ibirunga iherereye mu Majyaruguru y’u Rwanda buva kuri Hegitari 16,000 bugera ku 16,027 hagamije kwita ku rusobe rw’ibinyabuzima biyirimo.

title: Imvura imaze guhitana abantu 15 hirya no hino mu gihugu
content:
Guhera mu Ukwakira uyu mwaka mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu hagaragaye imvura nyinshi kurusha iyari isanzwe. Ni imvura y’umuhindo Minisiteri y’ibidukikije igaragaza ko ubwinshi bwayo bwatewe n’uruhurirane rw’imiyaga ituruka mu nyanjya y’u Buhinde n’ituruka mu ishyamba rya Congo. Mu kiganiro Kubaza bitera Kumenya cyatambutse kuri Radiyo Rwanda kuri iki Cyumweru tariki 8 Ukuboza, Umunyamabanga Uhoraho muri Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije , Fatina Mukarubibi yavuze ko imvura imaze guhitana abanyarwanda 15 ikangiza n’ibindi bikorwa byinshi. Yagize ati “Muri iyi minsi imvura yabaye nyinshi, ibiza byahitanye ubuzima bw’abantu 15 n’amatungo ndetse hangiritse imyaka iri mu mirima, imihanda, ibiraro amashuri. Ahibasiwe cyane ni mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo n’Iburengerazuba.” Mu guhangana n’ibyo biza, Mukarubibi yavuze ko  hakozwe ikarita igaragaza ahantu hashobora kwibasirwa n’ibiza ndetse n’ibigomba kuhakorwa mu rwego rwo kurwanya isuri inashobora gutera imyuzure. 
By’umwihariko muri ibi bihe, yasabye abaturage kuzirika ibisenge, guca imirwanyasuri no gusibura inzira z’amazi kandi bagatanga amakuru igihe hari ahabaye ibibazo by’ibiza. Mu ngamba z’igihe kirekire, Mukarubibi yavuze ko hari imirimo irimo ikorwa mu rwego rwo kurinda no gusubiranya icyogogo cya Sebeya kuko umugezi wa Sebeya nawo wagiye uteza ibiza mu myaka ishize. Hari kandi gusaba  abubaka  gushyiraho uburyo bwo gufata amazi ava ku bisenge by’inzu. Mu rwego rwo gukumira ko ibiza by’imvura byangiza ibikorwaremezo nk’imihanda n’ibiraro , Mukarubibi avuga ko begereye inzego zibishinzwe kugira ngo bijye byubakwa habanje kwegeranywa amakuru ya tekiniki azatuma ibyubatswe biramba. Yatanze urugero rw’ikiraro cya Nyabarongo cyajyaga kirengerwa n’amazi mu bihe by’imvura, ubu bikaba byarakosowe. Imvura nyinshi imaze iminsi igwa no mu bindi bihugu bya Afurika y’Iburasirazuba ndetse imaze guhitana abasaga 250. Kimwe cya kabiri cy’abapfuye ni abo muri Kenya, mu gihe yagize ingaruka ku baturage basaga miliyoni eshatu. Biteganyijwe ko muri uko kwezi imvura ikomeza kugwa ari nyinshi.

title: Minisitiri Mujawamariya yibukije abangiza ibidukikije ko nta yindi si bafite yo kuzaturaho
content: Ibi yabigarutseho kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki 19 Ugushyingo 2019, ubwo iyi Minisiteri yahuraga n’abafatanyabikorwabayo harebwa uko bakomeza kunoza ubufatanya mu kurengera ibidukikije. Iyangirika ry’amashamba, imyuka ihumanya ikirere iva mu nganda no  mu binyabiziga,  ndetse n’ibindi bikorwa bitandukanye bya muntu,  ni bimwe mu biza ku isonga mu gukomeza kwangiza ibidukikije hirya no hino ku Isi. Minisitiri Mujawamariya avuga ko iyi nama iba igamije guhuza  abafatanyabikorwa mu bikorwa bitandukanye barimo abakora mu by’amashyamba, ubutaka n’abandi, intego ari ugukokomeza kugira igihugu cyiza. Ati “Dukeneye kubungabunga ibidukije ariko n’igihugu gikeneye amajyambere byaba mu bucuruzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro n’ahandi,  icyo dusaba abafatanyabikorwa ni ugukomeza mu nzira turimo nk’u Rwanda dukomeza guteza imbere ibidukikije, kandi dukomeza kugira igihugu kirangwamo n’ibidukikije byitaweho kuva ku mwana kugera ku mu kambwe.” Ati “Iyi si dutuyeho niyo yonyine dufite aho gutura, tugomba rero kuyirinda kubera ko nta handi dufite dutura ni aha gusa, buri wese uko yaba angana kose akwiye kumva ko ari inshingano ze zo kubungabunga ibidukikije.” Umuyobozi w’Ikigo gishinzwe kubungabunga ibidukikije, Eng. Coletha Ruhamya, yavuze ko hakiri imbogamizi mu kubungabunga ibidukikije zirimo ingengo y’imari igenerwa uru rwego,  kudahuza ibikorwa mu nzego ndetse n’ishoramari ridahagije mu kurinda ibidukikije. Agira ati "Usanga ingengo y’imari leta yakoresheje yose, 2,9%  ni yo yagiye mu bintu birengera ibidukikije, ibyo byose rero turashaka kureba ukuntu izo nzego zindi zibishyira muri gahunda yazo.’’

title: Abahanga batanze umuburo ku ngaruka zishobora kwibasira Isi kubera udusimba duto dukomeje gupfa
content: Ubushakashatsi buheruka gukorwa na Kaminuza ya Sussex mu Bwongereza, bugaragaza ko umubare w’udusimba duto turi ku Isi ukomeje kugenda ugabanuka mu buryo bukabije, by’umwihariko 41% byatwo byagabanutse bitewe n’ingaruka z’ihindagurika ry’ibihe, ibiza, ibikorwa bya muntu n’ibindi. Umwarimu wigisha amasomo y’ibinyabuzima muri kaminuza ya Sussex, akaba n’umwe mu bayoboye ubwo bushakashatsi, Dave Goulson, yavuze ko ‘Iryo gabanuka nirikomeza, ingaruka zizaba nyinshi’. Ati “Bitatu bya kane (3/4) by’ibihingwa byacu bibeshwaho n’udusimba duto. Ibihingwa bizatangira kurumba. Ntituzongera kugira imbuto zirimo nk’inkeri...Ntitwabasha kugaburira abantu barenga miliyari 7.5 utu dusimba tudahari.” Gusa iyi raporo basohoye igaragaza ko mu gihe abantu bashyize hamwe babasha kubona igisubizo ku kibazo kigaragara nka kirimbuzi. Ati “Udusimba tuba mu busitari na Pariki byacu, abazitaho bashobora gukora ibitangaza. Igikenewe cyane ni uguhindura abahizi bakaba inshuti n’inyamaswa, bakagabanya gukoresha imiti yica udukoko. Ibyo byafasha cyane.” Abayikoze batanga inama z’uko kandi abantu bakwiye guhinga ibihingwa bifasha iyororoka ry’ibimera akenshi bigizwemo uruhare n’utwo dusimba duto turimo nk’inzuki igihe zirimo gutara. Ubushakashatsi bugaragaza ko utu dusimba duto turimo kugabanuka mu buryo bukabije mu bihugu birimo u Budage na Puerto Rico. Igaragaza ko muri rusange utu disimba ku mwaka tugabanukaho nibura 2.5%. By’umwihariko mu Bwongereza iyi raporo yibanze igaragaza ko hagati ya 1968 na 2007 twagabanutseho nibura 28%. Abakoze iyi nyigo bavuga ko hari izindi zisaga 70 zakozwe ariko nta mpinduka igaragara mu kutubungabunga cyane cyane mu Burayi na Amerika ya Ruguru.

title: Intara y’Iburasirazuba yahawe umwihariko mu gutera amashyamba kubera ubuke bwayo
content: Ibi yabitangaje ubwo hatangizwaga igihembwe cyo gutera amashyamba 2019/2020 cyatangirijwe mu Murenge wa Rukumberi mu Karere ka Ngoma ahatewe ibiti ibihumbi 16 ku buso bungana na hegitari 80. Muri iki gihembwe iburasirazuba hazaterwa amashyamba ku buso bungana na hegitari 609.8, haterwe ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka kuri hegitari 5138.6. Hazavugururwa kandi amashyamba angana na hegitari 275 ndetse hanaterwe ibiti by’imbuto ibihumbi 163 505 mu rwego rwo guhangana n’ikibazo cy’ubutaka bunini budateweho ibiti burangwa muri iyi ntara. Akarere ka Kirehe niko kazaterwamo ibiti byinshi aho kazaterwamo amashyamba angana na hegitari 276, ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka bingana na hegitari 286 n’ibiti by’imbuto 9750. Mukarubibi Fitina yavuze ko bahaye umwihariko iyi ntara kugira ngo bahangane n’ikibazo cy’amashyamba make akunda kuyigaragaramo bigatuma ibice bimwe na bimwe bitabonekamo imvura nkuko bikwiye. Yakomeje avuga ko bishimira ko intego igihugu cyari cyarihaye yo gutera amashyamba ku kigero cya 30%  cy’ubuso bw’igihugu yagezweho mbere ya 2020. Ati “Mu gice cy’iburasirazuba ho baracyari inyuma cyane nko mu Karere ka Ngoma turacyari kuri 12 by’ubuso buteweho amashyamba, biradusaba imbaraga kugira ngo tuzamure iyo mibare ariko n’abaturage barasabwa kubigira ibyabo kugira ngo bya biti babirere bihinduke ishyamba.” Yongeyeho ati “Ubu tugiye gufatanya dushyireho gahunda yihariye yo gutera amashyamba mu burasirazuba by’umwihariko nka Ngoma n’ahandi, hari ubwoko bw’ibiti byagaragaye ko bishobora kwera muri iki gice kandi bigatanga umusaruro harimo nk’igiti cy’umugazi, igifenesi n’ibindi bitandukanye bivangwa n’imyaka, ibyo byose nibyo tugiye gutera muri iyi ntara.” Mukarubibi yavuze  ko zimwe mu mpamvu zituma iyi ntara idakunda kugira amashyamba menshi harimo kuba ubutaka bwaho bukunda kugira umuswa mwinshi hakiyongeraho n’izuba ryinshi. Yasabye abaturage bo mu burasirazuba gukoresha ibiyaga bafite buhira ibiti kugira ngo bahangane n’izuba rikunda kubyumisha. Abaturage bavuga ko zimwe mu mpamvu zituma muri iyi ntara ibiti bihaterwa bidakura ngo biterwa nuko hakunda kugaragara izuba ryinshi na bike bizamutse bikaragirwamo amatungo . Habanabakize Daniel utuye mu Murenge wa Rukumberi yagize ati “ Ibiti inaha turabitera ariko hari bamwe muri twe babiragiramo amatungo bigatuma bitazamuka, ikindi ni ubutaka bw’inaha usanga kubera izuba ryinshi ridapfa kubyorohera mu mikurire yabyo.” Mukakayibanda Verediana we yagize ati “ Hari abantu babyahuramo inka nijoro kuburyo banazishora no mu mirima yacu, kugira ngo ibiti dutera bikure rero nuko leta idufasha mu guhana abo bantu bonesha amashyamba yacu.” Ibarura riheruka gukorwa mu 2016 ryagaragaje ko amashyamba y’abaturage ari ku kigereranyo cya 67% y’ubuso, naho  aya leta akaba ku kigereranyo cya 33%. Hagaragajwe kandi ko amashyamba y’abaturage afashwe nabi kandi afite umusaruro muke.

title: Miliyoni 12 z’amadolari zigiye gushorwa mu mushinga wo kwita ku bidukikije i Gicumbi
content: Umushinga wiswe uwa Gicumbi (Green Gicumbi Project), uzamara imyaka itandatu uhereye mu Ukwakira 2019, ukora ibikorwa byo kwita ku bidukikije mu Karere ka Gicumbi. Arenga miliyoni $ 12.5 muri miliyoni $ 32 azakoreshwa muri uwo mushinga wose, azajya mu bikorwa byo kubungabunga ibishanga, inkengero z’imigezi n’ibindi bikorwa byerekeye ubuhinzi. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere ka Gicumbi, Epimaque Mpayimana avuga ko kubera imiterere y’ako Karere, imvura igira ingaruka zikomeye ku buhinzi kubera imisozi itarwanyijeho isuri. Ati “Twe tugira umwihariko kuko ari imisozi miremire, iyo ahantu rero hari imisozi miremire cyane cyane itarwanyijeho isuri, duhura n’imyuzure, isuri, imihanda ikangirika, ibiraro bigacika n’amazi menshi ingaruka mu by’ukuri ni nyinshi ugereranyije no mu tundi turere, imyaka kumanurwa n’isuri, abaturage bagahinga ariko bamara gutera isuri ikaza ikabitwara.” Avuga ko mu by’ibanze  uwo mushinga uzabafasha ari ugutunganya imisozi ihanamye. Agira ati “Mu buryo bw’ikubitiro azabanza kujya, kudufasha gutunganya imisozi ihanamye, ni ukuvuga ngo iyo utunganyije iyo misozi, ya mirima yo mu bishanga yajyaga itwikirwa n’isuri uba ukoze ku buryo itakwangirika. ibihinzwemo uba ufite icyizere kuko uko wahinze ushobora kweza nta suri ibitwaye.” Ni umushinga ashimangira ko uziye igihe kuburyo n’abaturage bitezweho kugaragaza ubufatanye mu bikorwa byawo. Mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari ushize Akarere ka Gicumbi kabashije gutunganya Hegitari 2,000 z’amaterasi y’indinganire. Icyakora n’ubundi kugeza ubu ngo hari imisozi itarakorerwaho ubuhinzi kubera imiterere yayo. Amaterasi namara kugera kuri iyo misozi bizaba byongereye ubutaka buhingwa n’umusaruro uva mu buhinzi ukaziyongere. nkuko Mpayimana abisobanura, agira ati “Ni ukuvuga ngo rero tubonye izindi hegitari ziyongera zirwanyijeho isuri ziriho amaterasi y’indinganire mu byukuri kiba ari igisubizo kirambye ku baturage bacu kubera ko ubutaka bwo guhinga buba bwiyongeye. Hari ahantu imisozi ihanamye kuburyo udashobora gukoreraho imirimo y’ubuhinzi ubu ngubu. Iyo ukoze amaterasi uba wongeye ubuso buhingwa kandi kongera ubuso buhingwa bisobanuye ko uba wongereye umusaruro. Imibare y’ikigo cy’ibarurishamibare mu Rwanda yerekena ko mu Karere ka Gicumbi, amaterasi ari ku buso bungana na hegitari 8,653.5 naho ubutaka burwanyijeho isuri muri rusange bungana na 88.2%. Uyu mushinga wanyujijwe mu kigega cyita ku bidukikije n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe mu Rwanda (Fonerwa). Umuyobozi w’icyo kigega Hubert Ruzibiza,  avuga ko uzita no ku bindi bikorwa bireba imibereho y’abatuye Gicumbi ndetse no gutera ibiti. Ikindi kandi ukazafatwa nk’icyitegererezo cyo kwigiraho kuburyo wazakomereza mu tundi turere tw’igihugu. Ati “Uyu mushinga wa Gicumbi dufatanyije n’ikigega cy’Isi cyita ku bidukikije, twafatanyije gushyira amafaranga muri Gicumbi tumaze kubona ibibazo yanyuzemo cyane cyane ku bireba ibidukikije […] dushaka kuzamura ubuzima bw’abaturage no kureba babaho muri rusange no gutera ibiti, iki ni icyiciro cya mbere tuzayifata nk’icyitegererezo cyo gutuma ukomereza mu tundi duce tw’u Rwanda.” Imibare y’ikigo cy’ibarurishamibare mu Rwanda y’igihembwe cy’ihinga cya 2019-B yerekana mu buryo bwo kurwanya isuri, Gicumbi yari ifite amaterasi y’indinganire ku kigero cya 32.1% y’ubutaka bwahinzwe muri icyo gihembwe, 0.6% ahateye ibiti, n’imiringoti kuri 0.2%. Mu buhinzi akarere ka Gicumbi kibanda ku bishyimbo bishingirirwa, ingano, ibirayi, ibigori n’imyumbati ku butaka buhujwe burenga hegitari 32,164. Bahinga kawa ku buso bungana na hegitari 601,7 n’icyayi ku buso bungana na hegitari 1678,2.

title: Ubuso bw’u Rwanda 30 % bwamaze guterwaho amashyamba
content: Mu 2011, Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yihaye intego ko mu 2020, ubuso bungana na 30%, buzaba buteyeho amashyamba, naho mu 2030 bukaba bugeze kuri hegitari miliyoni ebyiri mu 2030, hagamijwe kurengera urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Mu isuzuma  ry’aho urwego rw’amashyamba rugeze, mu ntego nyinshi zitandukanye rwihaye n’intego zo kuruteza imbere mu myaka iri imbere, hagaragajwe ko intego ya mbere yagezweho,  nkuko The New Times yabitangaje. Minisitiri Vincent Biruta, yagize ati  “Mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari wa 2018/19 urwego rw’ibidukikije n’umutungo kamere rwageze kuri byinshi ndashimira ubufatanye n’abafatanyabikorwa batandukanye. Ndagira ngo mbabwire ko ubwo bufatanye bwatumye tugera kuri 30% dutera amashyamba aho atari ateye n’aho yatemwe.” Iyi ni intego y’ibanze mu zigamijwe kugerwaho mu 2020. Ati “Dushobora kwishimira aho tugeze.” Inyigo yerekanye ko hagati ya 1990 na 2010, u Rwanda rwatakaje 37% by’amashyamba yarwo bitewe no kuyatema. Minisitiri Biruta yagize ati “Twongeye gutera ibiti aho byari bayatemwe kugira ngo tubungabunge imigezi kandi nishimiye kubabwira ko hegitari zirenga 3,000 zatewe kuri Nyabugogo, Muvumba, Sebeya n’igice cya ruguru cya Nyabarongo.” Yongeyeho ati “Abikorera bajya mu bijyanye no kubungabunga amashyamba nabo bariyongereye. 30% by’amashyamba ya leta ubu aracungwa n’abikorera kandi tuzakomeza gukorana n’abafatanyabikorwa mu kongera kugeza kuri 80% mu 2024.”  Amashyamba ya leta ari kuri hegitari 65,000 hatabariwemo Pariki z’igihugu. Mu gukaza politiki n’amategeko Minisitiri Biruta yavuze ko Minisiteri yashyizeho politiki nshya n’ingamba zigamije kwita ku mashyamba, ibidukikije, imihindagurikire y’ibihe, ubutaka no gucunga ibipimo by’ubushyuhe. Guverinoma yashyizeho uburyo bushya bwo kongera amashyamba bikozwe n’abikorera ndetse no kuyacunga neza. Yashyizeho amatsinda y’abikorera yo gucunga amashyamba “Private Forest Management Units:PFMU” aho amashyamba ari ku buso buto acungwa n’amakoperative. Ayo matsinda agizwe n’amakoperative 8 y’abikorera bato yageragerejwe mu turere twa Gakenke, Gicumbi, Rulindo na Rwamagana mu buryo bw’igerageza yabashije gutera amashyamba kuri hegitari 276. Umuryango Mpuzamahanga wita ku bidukije (IUCN) utangaza ko gusana hegitari imwe y’ubutaka haterwa amashyamba, bisaba amadolari asaga 1000 ariko mu Rwanda ngo ntageramo (ari hagati ya 200 na 400) kubera byinshi bikorwa n’abaturage mu muganda.

title: Minisitiri Biruta yashimye uruhare rwa Banki ya Kigali mu rugamba rwo kugira igihugu gitoshye
content: Yabigarutseho kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki 2 Ugushyingo 2019, mu muganda udasanzwe wo gutera ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka mu Murenge wa Rweru mu Karere ka Bugesera muri gahunda ya Banki ya Kigali yo gutera amashyamba, ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka n’imbuto. Banki ya Kigali yafatanyije  n’ikigo mpuzamahanga cy’amashyamba, ishami ry’u Rwanda (ICRAF-Rwanda), mu gutubura imbuto no guhugura abaturage bazafasha bagenzi babo mu kubungabunga no kwita kuri ibi biti. Mu muganda wo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, mu Kagari ka Nemba, hatewe ibiti ibihumbi 61, ku buso bungana na hegitari 16. Ibiti byatewe birimo ubwoko bwa Grevillea (bibazwamo imbaho), Gracidea (bikurura umwuka), Calliandra na Leucaena. Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Bugesera, Mutabazi Richard yavuze ko iyo umuntu arebye amateka y’u Rwanda nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, ibiti byo muri aka karere byangijwe bitwikwamo amakara byaje gutuma mu 2000, akarere kaba ubutayu. Yakomeje agira ati “Byagize ingaruka ku baturage bacu murabizi bamwe baranasuhutse ariko Leta yahise ishaka icyakorwa ishyira imbaraga mu gutera amashyamba. Igikorwa cy’uyu munsi tunashimira Banki ya Kigali yatanze iyi nkunga, ni kimwe n’ibindi bigomba gukomeza gukorwa biri mu rwego rwo kugira ngo tugire Bugesera itoshye.” Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije mu Rwanda igaragaza ko u Burasirazuba bufitemo amashyamba make aho na Bugesera iri mu turere tudafite amashyamba akwiriye. Imbuto z’ibiti biri gutuburirwa i Bugesera ari nabyo byatewe uyu munsi zirimo izavanwe mu mahanga, aho Banki ya Kigali ariyo yatanze ubushobozi bwo kugura izi mbuto n’amahugurwa yahawe abafashamyumvire. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Banki ya Kigali, Dr Diane Karusisi yavuze ko nubwo batanga serivisi z’imari ariko bagomba kureba niba n’abaturage bafite imibereho myiza, ari nayo mpamvu bahisemo gutanga umusanzu mu kurengera ibidukikije ariko hanibandwa ku biti byagirira akamaro abaturage. Ati "Twarabitangiye mu myaka ishize i Gatsibo na Nyagatare ariko uyu mwaka twaje i Bugesera, ni akarere keza ariko iyo ureba mu misozi ya hano ubona nta biti bihari. Ibi biti ni ibyanyu, mugomba kubyitaho ku buryo uyu murenge wanyu uzatera imbere." Muri rusange Banki ya Kigali imaze gutera ibiti bigera ku bihumbi 500. Intego ni ugutera ibigera kuri miliyoni ariko hibandwa mu bice by’Iburasirazuba. Dr Karusisi yakomeje ati  “Turashaka gukorana namwe abaturage dutera ibiti ku buryo mu bihe biri imbere nta bibazo by’imvura cyangwa amapfa n’imirire mibi bizongera kuba muri aka karere n’ahandi hose hari ibi bibazo. ” Mu 2011, Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yihaye intego ko mu 2020, ubuso bungana na 30%, buzaba buteyeho amashyamba, naho mu 2030 bukaba bugeze kuri hegitari miliyoni ebyiri mu 2030, hagamijwe kurengera urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Minisitiri Biruta avuga ko ibi bidashobora kugerwaho hatabayeho imbaraga z’abafatanyabikorwa by’umwihariko abikorera, aho yatanze urugero rwiza rwa Banki ya Kigali yatangiye kugira uruhare muri uru rugamba. Yavuze ko igice kinini cya  Bugesera ari ubutaka bwiza kandi bwera ariko bwakwera neza bukanatanga umusaruro habayeho kubungabunga amashyamba. Ati "Aka karere karera neza , ariko kakwera kurushaho gateweho amashyamba. Ibyo birasaba gukomeza gufatanya kandi birashoboka. Mu 2000, aka karere kari kabaye ubutayu ariko ubu imvura yaragarutse nubwo idahagije. Bababwiye mwe nk’abaturage ko aya mashyamba turi gutera ari ayanyu mukwiye kuyitaho mukayabungabunga.” Minisitiri Biruta yashimye abafatanyabikorwa barimo BK avuga ko Mu 2015 yafatanyije na leta gutera ibiti mu Karere ka Gatsibo aho kuri ubu ishyamba rimeze neza. Yakomeje agira ati  “Ibyakozwe na BK bigaragaza uruhare rw’abikorera mu kurengera ibidukikije. Dufatanyije na BK muri Bugesera ubushize twafatanyije I Gatsibo, ngaho ibaze ibigo by’imari byose biri mu Rwanda, buri kimwe cyafashe Akarere kamwe urumva byagenda bite? Turagira ngo dufatanye twubake u Rwanda rutoshye." Banki ya Kigali ntabwo yatanze ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka gusa ahubwo hari n’imbuto zirimo avoka, amapapayi ndetse n’imyembe. Ni mu gihe kandi gahunda ya leta ari uko nibura buri rugo rwo mu Rwanda rugira ibiti bitatu by’imbuto. Umwe mu baturage bo muri uyu Murenge wa Rweru witwa Tuyizere , yavuze ko bazakomeza gufatanya n’abaturage gukomeza kubungabunga ibi biti. Yagize ati "Ibi biti bitewe uyu munsi tuzabibungabunga kandi bitugirire akamaro ari ukutubyarira ifumbire n’imbuto ziribwa. Kuva aho dutangiye gutera ibiti bivamgwa n’imyaka by’umwihariko imbuto byagabanyije imirire mibi mu miryango yacu.” Ubuyobozi bwa Banki ya Kigali bwongeye kandi kwibutsa abaturage bo mu Karere ka Bugesera by’umwihariko abahinzi dore ko bagera ku bihumbi 32, kugana gahunda ya ‘Ikofi’ yashyiriweho abahinzi by’umwihariko. Ubu buryo buheruka kwiyongeraho serivisi y’imari ya IKOFI yatangijwe na Banki ya Kigali muri Gicurasi uyu mwaka, ifasha umuhinzi kubitsa amafaranga, kubikuza, kuyohereza ku buntu mu Rwanda, kwishyura imbuto n’inyongeramusaruro, ubwiteganyirize bwa ‘Ejo Heza’ n’ibindi.

title: TI-Rwanda igiye gukurikiranira hafi umushinga wa Gicumbi uzatwara miliyoni $ 32
content: Umushinga wo kwita ku bidukikije mu karere ka Gicumbi uzamara imyaka itandatu, ukazakorerwa mu Mirenge itandatu y’ako Karere; ariyo Rubaya, Cyumba, Kaniga, Mukarange, Rushaki na Shangasha. Imibare y’ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’umuryango urwanya ruswa n’akarengane mu 2017 yerekana ko imishinga yerekeye imihindagurikire y’ikirere yabayeho mu Rwanda yagiye irangwa n’ibura ry’uruhare rw’abaturage rimwe na rimwe n’abayobozi mu nzego z’ibanze ugasanga batayizi. Ibyo bigatuma abayishyira mu bikorwa bakoresha ingengo y’imari yayo mu buryo abagenerwabikorwa badasobanukiwe. Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa wa TI Rwanda, Mupiganyi Apolinaire asobanura ko imibare yerekana ko abaturage 55.5% batari bazi iby’iyo mishinga ndetse ngo hari n’abayobozi mu nzego z’ibanze bagera kuri 40.4% nabo ntibagishijwe inama ngo harebwe niba ariyo bakeneye cyangwa bamenye uruhare rwabo. Ati “Hari imbogamizi twabonye mu mishinga itandukanye nka za biogaz n’indi mishinga igerageza kugabanya kwangiza ibidukikije. Dushingiye kuri ibyo bibazo twabonye mu isesengura twakoze ku yindi mishinga yabanje, twafashe iya mberengo turebe uko twatera ingabo mu bitugu gahunda y’igihugu cyacu yo guha uruhare umuturage kugira ngo amenye ibimukorerwa”. Avuga ko ibi ari byo bizatuma bagira uruhare rukomeye bafatanyije n’indi miryango, inzego n’umuturage kugira ngo ibipimo by’abagenerwabikorwa bavugaga ko batazi ibikorerwa bigabanyuke. Ati "Turemera ko niba tuzamuye imyumvire y’umuturage, gukorera mu mucyo no kubaza utanga serivisi ibyo yakoze niba atabikurikiranye akabibazwa bizafasha kugira ngo uriya mushinga w’icyitegererezo muri Gicumbi uzagere ku ntego twifuza hanyuma bishobore no gukorerwa mu tundi turere.”  Yongeyeho ko bagendeye ku byo babonye mu bushakashatsi bakoze, uyu mushinga munini wa mbere FONERWA ikoze ugomba kurindwa ba rusahurira mu nduru. Umuyobozi mukuru wa FONERWA, Hubert Ruzibiza, yavuze ko binjiye mu bufatanye na TI Rwanda, kugira ngo uzabafashe mu ikurikiranabikorwa bityo ibyo abagenerwabikorwa, abafatanyabikorwa n’igihugu bawitezeho bizagerweho. Ati "Mu by’ukuri  aya ni amafaranga menshi, kandi ibyitezwe biri hejuru cyane, yaba ari ku muturage yaba ari kuri twebwe, na leta cyangwa n’ikigega cyita ku bidukikije [cyateye inkunga uwo mushinga]”. Yongeyeho ko hari uburyo butandukanye burimo ubwo mu ikoranabuhanga buzatuma umuturage ashobora gutanga igitekerezo ku byo abona aho umushinga uri gukorerwa, ku buryo ayo makuru yagera no ku bafatanyabikorwa b’umushinga baba mu mahanga. Biteganyijwe ko mu myaka itandatu uyu mushinga uzafasha abaturage kugabanya imyuka ya gaz carbonique (CO2) ingana na toni 273,720. Uzagera ku baturage 150,000 ugirire akamaro abarenga 380,000 muri rusange.

title: Igifenesi, urubuto rushobora  kuba imari ishyushye ku isoko ry’u Rwanda
content: Uru rwagwa aho aruranguza barugurisha amafaranga 500 ariko ngo ntarashobora guhaza isoko afite bitewe n’uko ari rinini cyane. Uyu mugore  byamuteje imbere ku buryo yubatse uruganda rukora inzoga muri urwo rubuto, akaba afite gahunda yo guhinga ibifenesi byinshi no kubikangurira abandi. Igifenesi ni rumwe mu mbuto zo bwoko bw’inkeri bitewe n’uburyo kiremye, kikaba gikomoka mu Buhinde ariko gikunze kugaragara cyane no muri Thailand, Malaysia na Indonesia. Mu Rwanda urubuto rw’igifenesi ntirukunze kugaragara nk’izindi bitewe n’uko abanyarwanda bataratangira kwitabira kuruhinga, ariko ni urubuto rukize cyane ku ntungamubiri ndetse runafasha kugabanya umuvuduko w’amaraso, kugira uruhu rwiza n’isukari y’umwimerere. Mugabo Jean Pierre uyobora ishami ry’amashyamba mu Kigo gishinzwe guteza imbere amazi n’Amashyamba, RWFA, yavuze ko ari urubuto abantu benshi bakwiriye guhinga. Ati “Igifenesi ni urubuto rwifitemo isukari y’umwimerere, kigabanya umuvuduko w’amaraso, gifasha umuntu kugira uruhu rwiza, kikagira n’intungamubiri za magnesium zigira uruhare mu gukomeza amagufa.” Mugabo yongeraho ko igifenesi gifasha umuntu kubona neza cyane cyane kubageze mu zabukuru, kikagira ubutare buvura indwara yo kubura amaraso bukanatera amaraso  kudatembera neza. Ikindi ni uko ibiti by’ibifenesi bishobora kwifashishwa mu kwirinda isuri, bikaba byakwifashishwa kandi mu gukora ibikoresho byo mu nzu, imirimo y’ubwubatsi, ibikoresho by’umuziki. Igifenesi kandi cyifashishwa mu gukora verini basiga imbaho, guhoma ubwato n’imyenge y’indobo. Mugabo yakanguriye abanyarwanda gutera igiti cy’igifenesi cyane ko ngo Ishami ry’amashyamba mu Kigo gishinzwe guteza imbere amazi n’Amashyamba, RWFA,  rizabafasha kubona ingemwe, bakaba baniteguye gushyira igiti cy’igifenesi  mu bizaterwa mu gikorwa ngarukamwaka cyo gutera ibiti. Ati “Abanyarwanda turabasaba kugitera ku buryo buhagije kugira ngo n’abagikeneye babashe kukibona cyane ko bashobora kubibona mu buhumbikiro butandukanye. Twebwe tuzakomeza kubafasha kubona ingemwe kugira ngo cyinjizwe no muri gahunda ngarukamwaka yo gutera ibiti, dufashe n’abikorera kucyongerera umusaruro.” Urubuto rw’igifenesi rweze rupima ibiro hagati ya 3-5, rukaba rumara amezi 16 mu buhumbikiro. Kugira ngo nyirarwo atangire kurusarura ni uko byibuze ruba rumaze imyaka itandatu rutewe. Igifenesi gisarurwa kabiri mu mwaka, igiti kimwe gifite ubushobozi bwo kwera imbuto 200. Ni igiti gikunze guhingwa mu duce dushyuha nko mu Bugesera, Kayonza, Huye, Gisagara, Nyanza, Ngoma na Rusizi. Mu 2018, Akarere ka Ngoma nka kamwe mu duce duhingwamo igifenesi cyasaruye toni 69. Ku isoko usanga uru rubuto ruri hagati ya 1000-1500 Frw. Inkuru bijyanye: Uko Kankwanzi yahaye agaciro igifenesi muri Kirehe agikoramo inzoga

title: Byinshi ku kayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba gakomeje guhangayikisha Isi
content: Abahanga bavuga ko aka kayunguruzo ari umwuka uboneka mu kirere ku bilometero hagati ya 15-30 uvuye ku butaka, ukaba utandukanye n’umwuka abantu bahumeka wa Oxygène. Abantu benshi bakunze kwibaza icyo ako kayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba kayungurura, imiterere yako n’ingano gafite. Umwarimu mu Ishami rya Kaminuza y’u Rwanda y’Ubumenyi n’Ikoranabuhanga mu ishami ry’ubutabire, Dr. Birame Sekomo Christian, avuga ko imirasire y’izuba ifite imbaraga n’ubukana butandukanye. Asobanura ko iyo imirasire y’izuba imanutse ivuye mu isanzure, umwuka wa Ozone uhita utangira kuyiyungurura ikagira iyo yemerera kugera ku isi (ari ryo zuba tubona), hakaba n’imirasire yitwa ‘Ultraviolet’ ifite ubukana bwangiza igera ku kayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba igahita isubira mu kirere kubera ko kaba katayemereye ko ihita. Gusa iyo akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba kangiritse, ya mirasire ifite ubukana ibasha kukanyuramo bikagira ingaruka ku bantu n’ibindi binyabuzima. Ku bavuga ko akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba wakabonesha amaso cyangwa ari ikintu gifatika, Dr. Birame avuga ko baba bibeshya cyane kuko ni umwuka ntabwo ari ikintu gifatika, nta nubwo wakabonesha amaso. Uko akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba kangirika Dr Birame avuga ko kwangirika kw’akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba bituruka ku kuba katewe n’ibindi binyabutabire bituruka ahanini mu byo dukora mu nganda zacu na gaz dukoresha mu byuma bikonjesha nka za firigo n’ibindi bitanga ubuhehere mu nzu z’abantu no mu modoka. Ibyo binyabutabire byangiza akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba birimo Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs), Hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs), Hydrobromofluorocarbons (HBFCs), Halons, Methyl bromide na Carbon tetrachloride. Imyuka kandi irimo ibinyabutabire nka chlorine, Bromine na Fluorine, iyo izamutse igahura n’umwuka wa Ozone ari ko kayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba iragasenya. Uyu mwarimu avuga ko kuva ibihugu bitandukanye ku isi byashyira umukono ku masezerano ya Montreal yari agamije kurebera hamwe uburyo bwo kubungabunga akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba mu 1987, hagiye habaho impinduka nziza. Ibi abishingira ko mu bipimo byafashwe mu 1990 byerekanye ko aka kayunguruzo karimo gusubirana. Dr Birame avuga ko amasezerano ya Montreal ari amwe mu yatanze umusaruro ugaragara ugereranyije n’andi agenda asinywa. Mu 2016 mu Rwanda hasinywe amasezerano ya Kigali agamije kurwanya iyoherezwa mu kirere ry’imyuka ituruka mu byuma bikonjesha. Amasezerano ya Kigali (Kigali Amendment) avugurura amasezerano ya Montreal yerekeye imyuka yangiza akayunguruzo k’izuba yasinywe mu 1987. Isano y’ubushyuhe bw’izuba na Ozone Dr. Birame avuga ko kuba izuba ryavuye ari ryinshi ku Isi ubushyuhe bukaba bwinshi nta sano bifitanye n’akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba ahubwo ubwiyongere bw’abantu ku isi, ibikorwa abantu bagenda bakora nko gutwika imodoka, ari byo bishobora gutera ubwiyongere bw’ubushyuhe ku isi. Ati “Ntaho bihurira, tugomba kumenya ko isi ari yayindi idahinduka ariko umubare w’abantu uriyongera n’ibikorwa by’abantu bikiyongera umunsi ku munsi. Ni ukuvuga ngo hari iyindi myanda twe tujugunya hanze igira ingaruka mbi ku bihe. Hari indi myuka twohereza mu kirere urugero nko gutwika imodoka na mazutu, ibyo bituma ubushyuhe bwiyongera ku isi.” Yongeraho ko gutwika amavuta y’indege, ibiti n’ibindi bintu byose byifitemo izindi ngufu, bizamura umwuka mubi wa CO2 ugira uruhare mu kongera ubushyuhe ku isi. Ati “Iyo utwitse ikintu gisanzwe gifite ingufu muri cyo, izo ngufu ntabwo zitakara ahubwo zirimuka zigahindura iyindi shusho. Iyo utwitse igiti hasigara ivu, ariko se bwa bunini bw’igiti bwagiye he? Bwahindutse umwuka bujya mu kirere.” Ingaruka zo kwangirika kw’akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba Ingaruka za mbere zo kwangirika kw’akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba ni uko urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima byangirika. Amafi mu nyanja aragabanuka kuko ibiribwa by’amafi byo bihita byangirika iyo bihuye n’imirasire ifite ubukana ya ultra violet [ifite ubukana]. Amababi ku bimera nayo arangirika iyo yahuye n’imirasire ifite ubukana agahinduka umukara. Ibyo bituma igikorwa cya photosynthèse gituma amababi yaba icyatsi nk’uko bisanzwe kitaba kubera iyo mirasire mibi. Dr. Birame akomeza avuga ko kwangirika kw’akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba bigira ingaruka no ku bantu nko kuzana ishaza mu jisho, no kurwara kanseri y’uruhu. Buri mwaka iyi myuka ifite ubukana yiyongera mu kirere ku kigero cya 10% na 15 %. Ikibi cyayo kandi iguma mu kirere imyaka igera kuri 29.

title: Inyoni zo muri Canada na Amerika zagabanyutseho hafi miliyari eshatu mu myaka 49
content: Ubwo bushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko inyoni zo muri ibyo bihugu zagabanyutseho 29 % mu myaka 49 ishize, kandi ko ari ikimenyetso kibi ku bijyanye no kubungabunga ibidukikije. Bwakozwe n’abashakashatsi bo muri Amerika na Canada, ikigo gishinzwe inyoni muri Amerika n’ibindi bigo byita ku rusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Ibyavuyemo byagaragaje ko 90 % by’inyoni zagabanyutse  cyane ari izo mu moko 12 zirimo ibishwi, intashya n’ibindi. Inyonzi zibasiwe cyane kandi ni iziba mu mu kenke n’ahandi haba ibyatsi byinshi, aho zagabanyutseho izigera kuri miliyoni 720. Inyoni zo mu ku mazi no ku migezi nazo zagabanyuteho kimwe cya gatatu. Peter Marra, umwe mu bakoze ubushakashatsi yavuze ko hakwiriye gufatwa ingamba zikomeye kuri iri gabanyuka rikabije ry’inyoni, kuko zifite uruhare runini mu buzima bwa muntu. Abashakashatsi ntabwo bagaragaje impamvu yihariye inyoni zagabanyutse ariko bavuga ko ari ikibazo kiri hirya no hino ku isi. Nko muri Amerika y’Amajyaruguru, bavuga ko kugabanyuka bishobora kuba byaratewe n’ibibazo mu mibereho y’inyoni no kororoka kwazo. Ikindi bakeka kuba intandaro y’igabanyuka, harimo kwiyongera kw’ibikorwa bya muntu nk’ubuhinzi bukorerwa aho inyoni zabaga no kutitabwaho. Hari kandi ibikorwa by’imijyi n’ubwiyongere bw’abaturage, ikoreshwa ry’imiti yica udukoko twatungaga inyoni n’ibindi. Basabye ko hafatwa ingamba zikomeye mu kubungabunga inyoni, haba ku mpande za Guverinoma n’abaturage ubwabo.

title: Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko Isi iri mu kaga kubera ubushyuhe bukabije buri kwiyongera
content: Raporo y’ubwo bushakashatsi yatangarijwe mu nama ikomeye y’Umuryango w’Abibumbye yiga ku mihindagurikire y’ikirere ubwo Umunyamabanga mukuru, Antonio Guterres yahamagariraga ibihugu kongera ingamba zo kugabanya ibyuka bihumanya Ikirere. Raporo “Ishimangira ko hagomba gushyirwaho ingamba zihamye zo guhangana n’ikibazo cy’ubushyuye n’ingaruka zikomeye z’imihindagurikire y’Ikirere”. Impuzandengo y’ubushyuhe bwaranze Isi hagati ya 2015 na 2019 igaragaza ko kugeza ubu ariyo myaka itanu igiye kurangwa n’ubushyuhe bukabije mu mateka y’Umubumbe w’Isi, nkuko byagaragajwe n’iyo raporo. Igaragaza ko “Ubu ubushyuhe bwazamutseho 1.10C ugereranyije na mbere y’iterambere ry’inganda hagati y’imyaka ya 1850 na 1900 na 0.20C z’ubushyuhe ugereranyije no kuva 2011 kugeza 2015”. Umuyobozi mukuru w’Itsinda rirwanya umwuka wa Karubone (anti-carbon group E3G), Tom Burke, yabwiye Al Jazeera ko ikibazo kiri kwiyongera kurusha uko abantu babitekereza. Ati “Ndatekereza ko ibyago biri kwiyongera bivuze ko dufite igihe gito cyo gukemura icyo kibazo kurusha uko tubitekereza. Ni ukuvuga ngo niba dushaka kurandura imihindagurikire y’Ikirere tugomba guhagarika gutwika ibinyabutabire byohereza ibyuka bihumanya ikirere.” Mu cyumweru gishize, Guterres yavuze ko Isi iri gutatanya imbaraga ashingiye  kuri iyo raporo igaragaza icyuho kiri hagati y’ibisabwa n’ibiri gukorwa. Mu 2018 umwuka uhumanya ikirere, CO2 wiyongeyeho 2% bihita bigeza ku mubare wo hejuru mu mateka ungana na Toni miliyari 37. Igiteye impungenge ni uko nta bimenyetso bigaragara byo  kugera ku ntego yo gutangira kugabanyuka kw’ibyo byuka  byoherezwa mu kirere. Amasezerano y’i Paris yo mu 2015 agaragaza ko ibihugu byiyemeje gushyiraho ingamba zo kugabanya izamuka ry’ubushyuhe kugeza nibura kuri 20C cyangwa 1.50C kuko aribyo bishobora guhagarika izamuka ry’ubushyuhe mu buryo buhamye. Gusa ubwo bushakashatsi bwatanze umuburo uvuga ko nubwo buri gihugu cyagera kuri iyo ntego, ubushyuhe buzazamuka kuva kuri 2.90C kugera kuri 3.40C. Kandi nabyo kugira ngo bishoboke ni uko Ibihugu byakuba gatatu umuvuduko biri kugenderaho ubu bishaka kugera kuri 1.50C.

title: Abashakashatsi ba Kaminuza ya Birmingham bagiye gufasha Abanyarwanda kwirinda umwotsi uterwa n’inkwi
content: Ubu bushakashatsi buribanda cyane ku kureba ingaruka z’ubuzima ababyeyi n’abana bahura na zo kubera gucana ibintu bibyara imyotsi ihumanya ikirere. Bugamije kandi gushaka uburyo bushya bwo guhangana n’umwuka uhumanya ikirere, gukusanya impamvu zibitera, ingaruka n’urwego biriho mu mijyi ya Afurika. Dr Kabera Telesphore wo muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda mu ishami ry’ubumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga (CST) afatanyije na Dr Suzanne Bartington  wo muri Kaminuza ya Brimingham, barimo gukora ubushakashatsi buzamara imyaka ibiri, bukazakusanya imibare ku gipimo imyotsi yo mu gikoni yanduza n’impamvu imiryango y’abanyarwanda batekesha inkwi. Iyi gahunda inagamije gushaka inkunga yo gukora uburyo bushya bw’amashyiga azagabanya imyotsi ihumanya ikirere no guhindura imyumvire y’abaturage binyuze mu bukangurambaga bwo kubigisha gutekesha gazi n’ibindi bitari inkwi. Dr Bartington avuga ko gutekesha amakara ari ibisanzwe mu Rwanda ariko hari amakuru make ku mibare y’ingo ziyakoresha n’ingaruka bigira ku bana n’ababyeyi. Yagize ati“Amakara ni kimwe mu byo gutekesha bibi kubera ibigize umwotsi uyakomokaho. Turagerageza gusuzuma ubukana bw’ikibazo n’imyumvire ishingiye ku muco mu bijyanye no guteka.” Akomeza avuga ko abagore benshi bamara amasaha menshi bari kumwe n’abana babo mu bikoni bidafite ahinjirira umwuka, akaba ari yo mpamvu barimo gushaka igisubizo. Yagize ati “Turashaka gukora amashyiga meza, akorewe mu gihugu bikagendana no kwigisha kandi bizagabanya abagerwagaho n’imyotsi batetse.” Ibi biri mu murongo w’igihugu cy’u Rwanda kirimo kwihuta mu iterambere, impinduka mu mibereho y’abaturage n’iterambere ry’imijyi. Dr Bartington mu minsi ishize yaje mu Rwanda gutangiza uwo mushinga w’ubushakashatsi azafatanya na UR-CST. Afite umugambi wo guteza imbere ubushakashatsi bw’imbere mu gihugu no kubaka ubushobozi bw’abanyeshuri biga ibijyanye n’ibidukikije.

title: Asaga miliyoni 2.5 $ agiye kwifashishwa mu guhangana n’ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe mu Rwanda
content: Ibikorwa bya RCCDN bizibandwaho ni ugufata neza ibidukikije, kuhira imyaka, gutera amashyamba,  gufata amazi y’imvura, guha abaturage amakuru ajyanye n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe ku gihe; babifashijwemo n’izo miliyoni 2.8 $. Umuyobozi w’iri huriro, Rwibasira Eugène, yavuze ko imihindagurikire y’ibihe  ari ikibazo gihangayikishije u Rwanda n’Isi. Yagize ati “Imihindagurikire y’ibihe ni ikibazo kidafite umupaka kandi si umwihariko w’u Rwanda ahubwo ni ikibazo cy’Isi. Ntitwavuga ngo kirarangira uyu munsi ahubwo turashaka kureba uburyo twahangana nacyo twibanda cyane ku gukumira kugira ngo bitazatugiraho ingaruka z’ikirenga.” Yakomeje avuga ko mu gihe cy’imyaka itanu biyemeje kuzakora ibikorwa bitandukanye. Ati “Tuzakora ibikorwa byo kubaka ubushobozi bw’abaturage mu bijyanye n’uburyo bamenya amakuru ajyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe, tuzubaka ibikorwaremezo, tuzashyira imbaraga muri gahunda yo kuhira imyaka, hazaterwa amashyamba hirya no hino, tuzarushaho gushishikariza abanyarwanda gufata neza ibidukikije.” Umuyobozi mukuru muri Minisiteri y’ibidukikije, ushinzwe ibidukikije n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe, Kabera Juliette, yavuze ko imihindagurikire y’ibihe ari kimwe mu bibazo byugarije u Rwanda. Yagize ati “Ubukungu bw’u Rwanda bushingiye cyane ku buhinzi n’ubworozi, kubera ihindagurika ry’ibihe imvura isigaye igwa ari nyinshi cyane cyangwa ikabura hakava izuba ryinshi noneho abahinzi bahinga imyaka ikarumba cyangwa imyuzure ikaza ikangiza ibintu byinshi. Twishimiye cyane rero ko iri huriro rigiye gufasha Leta guhangana n’izi ngaruka.” Yashimye cyane ko mu byo iri huriro rizakora harimo gufasha abahinzi guhindura imyumvire bakajya bahinga bakurikije amakuru y’iteganyagihe, badashingiye gusa ku makuru bari basanganywe yo kumenya ngo mu kwezi uku n’uku ni igihe cy’ihinga. Imvura nyinshi, inkuba, imyuzure n’amapfa ni bimwe mu biza byagize ingaruka zikomeye ku banyarwanda mu mwaka wa 2017 ndetse binatwara ubuzima bw’abagera kuri 82 mu gihe abandi 151 bakomeretse. Ibyangiritse byose hamwe bifite agaciro kabarirwa muri miliyari 6.7 Frw. Ihuriro  RCCDN rivuga ko rigiye gufasha leta mu guhangana n’ibi biza biteza igihombo bikanatwara ubuzima bw’abaturage. title: Arboretum ya Kaminuza yashyizwe mu mushinga wa Commonwealth ugamije kubungabunga amashyamba
content: Inama y’abaminisitiri yo ku wa 14 Gashyantare 2018,ni yo yafashe iki cyemezo. Uyu mushinga watangijwe ku mugaragaro mu nama y’abakuru b’ibihugu na za guverinoma zihuriye mu muryango w’ibihugu bikoresha ururimi rw’Icyongereza (Commonwealth),yabereye muri Malta mu 2015. Ni urubuga rwo guhuza imbaraga n’ubumenyi mu byo kubungabunga amashyamba, ibihugu byose bigize uyu muryango uko ari 53 bihuriyeho nk’uko bisobanurwa ku rubuga rwa internet rw’uyu mushinga. Arboretum ikikije Kaminuza y’u Rwanda, ishami rya Huye, igizwe n’ibimera, ibiti by’ishyamba n’ibindi byo mu bwoko butandukanye byatewe ahagana mu 1933 ndetse icumbikiye inyamaswa zirimo inkende, ingeragere, inyoni n’utundi dusimba. Umuyobozi ushinze amashyamba no kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima mu Kigo cy’Igihugu Gishinzwe Umutungokamere,  Jean Pierre Mugabo, yabwiye KT Press ko iyo ishyamba ryinjijwe muri uyu mushinga rirushaho kumenyekana kimwe n’amashyamba yose yo mu gihugu riherereyemo. Yagize ati “ Twatoranyije Arboretum kubera ko ikorerwamo ubushakashatsi ku bijyanye n’amashyamba mu gihugu.” Mugabo yavuze ko Arboretum nimara kwinjizwa muri uyu mushinga u Rwanda ruzungukiramo ibirimo no kujya rubona imbuto nziza z’ibiti. Yagize ati “ Bizadufasha kubungabunga amashyamba bijyanye n’ibyo Commonwealth igenderaho no kubona imbuto nziza.” U Rwanda kandi ruzaba ruhawe ububasha bwo gukoresha urubuga rwa Commonwealth mu gusangira ubumenyi n’ibindi bihugu mu bijyanye n’uburyo bwiza bwo kwita ku mashyamba no guhanga ibishya muri urwo rwego n’ibindi. Kugira ngo ishyamba ryemererwe kwinjira mu mushinga ‘Queen’s Commonwealth Canopy Projet’bisaba ko urwego rwa leta rufite mu nshingano amashyamba rugaragaza gahunda yo kuyabungabunga mu buryo burambye ndetse ko abaturage bazinjizwa mu micungire yawo.
