title: Abaturiye Pariki ya Nyungwe biyemeje gucika ku ngeso yo gushimuta inyamaswa
content: Uturere twa Rusizi na Nyamasheke, ni tumwe muri dutanu dukora kuri Pariki ya Nyungwe, aho abayituriye muri utwo turere bavuga ko mbere bashimutaga inyamanswa ariko ntacyo bakuyemo akaba ari yo mpamvu barabiretse kubera ko icyo bajyaga gushakamo basigaye bakibona binyuze mu bikorwa n’imishinga bakora bagaterwa inkunga. Ngendabanyika Ernest ati "Nigeze kujya ntega inyamaswa; ntacyo nakuyemo kuko ibyo umuntu ahiga agenda abirya nk’aho atabikoreye. Ibintu bikugirira akamaro ni ibyo wavunikiye, ukabicunga neza kuko byakuvunnye, icyatumye mbireka namaze kumenya agaciro ka Pariki ya Nyungwe, nsanga amafaranga ryinjiza ntayabona bituma ndeka ishyamba ry’abandi ariko kuri ubu mbona inyungu nk’amashuri abana banjye bigamo ndetse twatewe inkunga, turi abavumvu." Nyirabagirishya Seraphine ati " Navuye mu ishyamba ngerageza kwiteza imbere, twateguye imishinga bagiye kuduha inkunga tugure amatungo magufi noneho mu gihe nifuza inyama sinzajya mu ishyamba kuko mfite ihene izaba yarungutse ubundi ngure akanyama." Mbabazi Marie Louise ushinzwe guhuza Pariki z’Igihugu n’abaturage bazituriye mu Kigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe iterambere, RDB, avuga ko imibare y’abangiza Pariki ya Nyungwe, yagabanutse ku kigereranyo cya 85%, kubera ko imyumvire y’abayituriye yahindutse bitewe n’inyungu babona mu mafaranga ava mu bukerarugendo akagaruka kubateza imbere mu bikorwa bitandukanye by’amakoperative bibumbiyemo. Ati "Abangizaga pariki babaga ari abaturage baturiye hariya; kubera ko habayeho ubukangurambaga kugira ngo babakundishe ibirimo n’amafaranga avamo kuko na bo bagira uburenganzira bwo kugira ayo bafataho noneho aho kujya kwangiza pariki bakagenda babireka na bariya twahuguye barimo abangizaga pariki. Nkurikije uko mbibona hano muri Nyungwe 85% bateye imbere abasigaye turimo turabigisha." Pariki ya Nyungwe isurwa n’abarenga gato ibihumbi 13 ku mwaka. [email protected]

title: U Rwanda rwahawe inkunga ya miliyari 3 Frw azifashishwa mu gutera amashyamba
content: Iyi nkunga yatanzwe n’ikigega cyo mu bihugu bya Danemark, Finlande, Islande, Norvège na Suède (NDF), gitera inkunga imishinga igamije guteza imbere ibidukikije, ikazifashishwa mu gushyira mu bikorwa umushinga ugamije guteza imbere ibicanwa bikomoka ku biti. Iyi nkunga ya NDF izahabwa u Rwanda inyuze muri Banki y’Isi, ikaba iziyongera ku bikorwa by’Umushinga ugamije kugarura ishusho kamere y’Amashyamba no kuyabungabunga (LAFREC) usanzwe ushyirwa mu bikorwa n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cyo kubungabunga ibidukikije (REMA). REMA yatangaje ko bimwe mu bikorwa bizaterwa inkunga binyuze muri uwo mushinga mushya harimo kuvugurura no gutera amashyamba mashya, kongera ubuziranenge bw’imbuto z’amashyamba, guteza imbere imikoreshereze myiza y’ibicanwa bituruka ku biti ndetse no gukwirakwiza uburyo bushya bwo gutanga ingufu zifashishwa mu nganda z’icyayi no mu ngo. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa REMA, Eng.Coletha Ruhamya, yavuze ko uwo mushinga uzanagira uruhare mu guteza imbere ubuhinzi buvuguruye bw’amashyamba bikazibanda mu bice bikikije Pariki y’Igihugu ya Gishwati-Mukura. Yagize ati “Uzateza imbere amashyamba ndetse n’abayafite muri utwo duce bazareba uko bayacunga neza; hakazabamo no kwigisha abakora amakara bakazayakora neza kandi bikazabaha umusaruro uhagije, ukazanunganira ukuntu twakora indi nyigo yatuma tubona ibisimbura ibicanwa bitari ibikomoka ku biti.” Umuyobozi wari uhagarariye NDF, Martina Jagerhorn, yavuze ko bahisemo gutera inkunga u Rwanda mu kurufasha guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere. Yagize ati “Tumaze iminsi twiga ku mihindagurikire y’ikirere mu Rwanda, ngo turebe icyakorwa kugira ngo rugire ubudahangarwa, dushingiye rero ku bikorwa bya LAFREC tuzakomeza gushyigikira u Rwanda mu guhangana n’ihindagurika ry’ikirere.” Biteganyijwe ko uyu mushinga uzanafasha mu kongerera ubushobozi amakoperative atunganya, akanacuruza amakara mu rwego rwo kuyafasha kurushaho  kuyakora mu buryo burambye, kongera ubuziranenge n’ubwiza bw’amakara ndetse no gushaka amasoko. Ibindi bikorwa birimo kongerera ubushobozi Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Imbuto z’amashyamba   ndetse no gufasha inganda zitunganya icyayi n’abandi baturage kubona ibindi bicanwa bitangiza ibidukikije, bakwifashisha mu mirimo yabo ya buri munsi. Uyu musnhinga utangiye mu 2018 uzasoza ibikorwa byawo mu 2019.

title: Amateka ya Misa ya Papa mu Rwanda, kimwe mu bizaba bigize Pariki  y’i Nyandungu
content: Muri  iyo minsi nibwo  uwari umushumba wa Kiliziya Gatolika ku Isi, Papa Yohani Pwaulo II yagendereye u Rwanda, akahatanga ubutumwa butandukanye, anasura ibikorwa bitandukanye. Nubwo ari uruzinduko rw’amateka, uretse amasuka ari ku Kamonyi, nta handi wabona byoroshye urwibutso rw’ayo mateka. Icyakora, mu minsi mike ayo mateka azaba ashobora kuboneka cyane cyane  ajyanye na Misa Papa yasomeye mu gishanga cya Nyandungu mu mujyi wa Kigali, ku cyumweru tariki ya 9 Nzeri 1990 habura amasaha make ngo asoze uruzinduko rwe. Ayo mateka azaba agaragara mu busitani bwitiriwe Papa (Pope Garden) buzaba ari kimwe mu bigize Pariki y’Ubukerarugendo  bubungabunga ibidukikije (Nyandungu Eco-Tourism Park)  iri gutunganywa mu gishanga cya Nyandungu gikora ku Karere ka Gasabo na Kicukiro. Umushinga wa miliyari 2.4 Frw wo kubaka iyo pariki  watangiye umwaka ushize, bikaba biteganyijwe ko  uzaba warangiye mu myaka ibiri. Umuyobozi w’ibikorwa mu Kigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe kubungabunga ibidukikije (REMA) , Umugwaneza Janet ubwo yasobanuraga ibijyanye n’uwo mushinga kuri uyu wa Gatanu hizihizwa Umunsi mpuzamahanga wahariwe ibishanga, yavuze ko amateka ajyanye n’uruzinduko rwa Papa mu Rwanda azaba agaragara muri iyo Pariki. Yagize ati “Mu mwaka  wa 1990 Papa muzi ko yaje mu Rwanda.Hari misa yasomeye hano, ayo ni amateka rero , turashaka ko ayo mateka ahaguma. Muri iyi  pariki rero hazaba harimo igice cyitiriwe ubusitani bwa Papa.” Mugwaneza yavuze ko bari kuganira n’Ubuyobozi bwa Kiliziya Gatolika mu Rwanda kugira ngo ubwo busitani  buzabe burimo amakuru ahagije ya Misa Papa Yohani Pawulo II yasomeye muri icyo gishanga. Iki gishanga cya hegitari 134, kiri gutunganywa kugira ngo gisubirane umwimerere wacyo no kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Kizaba kirimo ibikorwa bitandukanye nk’ibiyaga bito, ibyatsi n’ibiti bihabereye, uburyo bwo gufata amazi  ava ku misozi no kuyayungurura n’ibindi. Umuyobozi Mukuru Wungirije wa REMA, Munyazikwiye Faustin yavuze ko ibikorwa byari byubatse muri icyo gishanga byatangiye kwimurwa, abatarabyimura na bo bakaba barahawe igihe ngo babe babirangije. Yavuze ko ari umushinga witezweho inyungu nyinshi haba mu kubungabunga ibidukikije ndetse no mu iterambere ry’igihugu. Yagize ati “Hazashyirwaho uburyo bw’inzira z’amazi kandi  buzaba burimo n’ibimera bisanzwe biranga igishanga nk’urukangaga, kugira ngo bibashe gukora za nshingano igishanga cyari gifite zo kudufasha gufata amazi no kuyayungurura. Uyu mushinga uzanadufasha no mu iterambere ry’igihugu kuko ntitugomba kubungabunga ibidukikije gusa ahubwo bigomba no kudufasha mu iterambere.” Ibikorwa nyaburanga bizashyirwa mu gishanga cya Nyandungu  biri mu bya mbere byo ku rwego rwisumbuye bigiye kubakwa mu gihugu habungwabungwa urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Uyu mushinga biteganyijwe ko ushobora kuzinjiza miliyari y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda y’inyungu mu myaka 12,  ni ukuvuga miliyoni zisaga 83 buri mwaka. Uri gukorwa  ku bufatanye n’Ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Gasabo mu Murenge wa Ndera n’aka Kicukiro muri Nyarugunga, Umujyi wa Kigali ndetse n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere, RDB, ugaterwa inkunga  n’Ikigega cy’Igihugu cy’Ibidukikije n’Imihindagurikire y’Ibihe, FONERWA.

title: Polisi y’u Rwanda igiye gutera ibiti ku buso burenga hegitari 50
content: Ibi bikaba biri no muri gahunda yo gushyira mu bikorwa amasezerano y’ubufatanye Polisi y’u Rwanda yasinyanye na Minisiteri y’Ubutaka n’Amashyamba mu Ugushyingo umwaka ushize, agamije kwita no kubungabunga ibidukikije n’amashyamba. Umuyobozi w’Ishami rishinzwe guhuza ibikorwa bya Polisi n’iby’abaturage hagamijwe gukumira no kwirinda ibyaha (Community Policing department) muri Polisi y’u Rwanda Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) Damas Gatare yavuze ko muri rusange bateganya kuzatera amashyamba mashya no gusimbuza ashaje kuri hegitari 4960 naho ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka bakazabitera kuri hegitari 45803. Yagize ati”Gutera amashyamba no gusimbuza ashaje ni igikorwa cyo kurengera ubuzima bw’abaturage kandi Polisi y’u Rwanda igomba kubigiramo uruhare rugaragara kugira ngo irinde abanyarwanda ibiza birimo amapfa, inkangu isuri n’imyuzure kuko ibi byose bigira ingaruka ku buzima bw’abaturage zirimo urupfu mu gihe cy’amapfa cyangwa cy’inkangu n’imyuzure.” ACP Gatare yavuze ko umwaka ushize mu gihugu hose amashyamba yatewe kuri hegitari 704 997, zingana na 29.6% za hegitari zose zigomba kuba ziteweho amashyamba. Yakomeje agira ati ”Muri iyi myaka ibiri buri Ntara ifite ubuso izateraho ibiti aho Intara y’Iburasirazuba izatera hegitari 14744, Intara y’Amajyaruguru itere kuri hegitari 8415, Iburengerazuba batere hegitari 9484, Intara y’Amajyepfo izatera hegitari 26035, na ho mu Mujyi wa Kigali bazatera hegitari 2085.” Mu gutera aya mashyamba Polisi izafatanya na Minisiteri y’Ubutaka n’Amashyamba, Ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe kurengera ibidukikije (REMA), uturere, urubyiruko rw’abakorerabushake mu gukumira ibyaha, (Rwanda youth Volunteers in Community Policing -RYVCP) n’abaturage muri rusange. Mu mwaka wa 2015, Polisi y’u Rwanda yasinyanye amasezerano n’uturere twose tw’u Rwanda uko ari 30, akaba agamije ubufatanye mu kubungabunga ibidukikije harimo no gutera amashyamba mashya no gufata neza asanzwe. Kuva Polisi y’u Rwanda yasinyana amasezerano y’ubufatanye na Minisiteri y’Ubutaka n’Amashyamba mu Ugushyingo umwaka ushize, Polisi ifatanyije n’urubyiruko rw’abakorerabushake mu gukumira ibyaha bamaze gutera ibiti birenga 125, 500 mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu. Ibi byatewe bikaba byiyongera ku bindi byatewe na Polisi y’u Rwanda mu gihugu hose kuri hegitari zirenga 300 mu myaka ishize. Mu rwego rwo kurengera ibidukikije no gutera ibiti, urubyiruko rw’abakorerabushake mu gukumira ibyaha rurenga 230 000, buri wa Gatandatu wa kabiri w’ukwezi rwihaye gahunda yo gukora umuganda mu bikorwa byinshi bakora kuri uwo munsi hakaba hanarimo gutera ibiti.

title: Meteo Rwanda yasobanuye iby’imvura idasanzwe imaze iminsi igwa
content: Icyakora, icyatangaje kinatungura benshi ni imvura yatangiye kugwa kuwa 31 Ukuboza 2017 ikageza mu gitondo cyo kuwa 1 Mutarama 2018, ikagwa mu bice byinshi by’igihugu ndetse ikanakomeza kugwa no mu yindi minsi yakurikiyeho. Mu itangazo Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Iteganyagihe (Meteo Rwanda) cyasohoye, cyatangaje ko iyo mvura idasanzwe yatewe n’ubwiyongere bw’ubushyuhe mu Nyanja y’u Buhinde. Rigira giti “Ibi bihe by’imvura biraterwa no kwiyongera k’ubushyuhe mu Nyanja y’u Buhinde. Byatumye havuka inkubi y’umuyaga bituma kandi mu Karere u Rwanda ruherereyemo higanza isangano ry’imiyaga binongera ubuhehere bw’umwuka ari nabyo bitera kugusha imvura itari imenyerewe muri Mutarama.” Meteo ikomeza ivuga ko ubwo bushyuhe bwo mu nyanja buzaba bwagabanyutse guhera tariki 7 Mutarama 2017, ibihe bigasubira uko byari bisanzwe. Iki kigo cyongeyeho ko igihembwe cy’ihinga A kiri ku musozo, bivuze ko imvura y’Umuhindo iri kugenda iba nkeya, gisaba Abanyarwanda bireba gufata ingamba zikwiriye. Ubusanzwe ukwezi kwa Mutarama kubonekamo  imvura nkeya  kuko kuba gusatira  Gashyantare ibonekamo izuba ryinshi.

title: Ubushakashatsi bwerekanye ko niba ntagikozwe 25% by’ubutaka bw’Isi buzuma mu myaka 30
content: Ivuga ko imbaraga zo kugabanya ubushyuhe kugera kuri dogere 1.5 nkuko byemejwe mu nama ya Paris, zizarengera nibura bibiri bya gatatu by’ubuso bwagombaga kuma. Iyi nyigo inagaragaza ko ibice by’ingenzi bituwe n’abantu bishobora kwibasirwa birimo u Burayi bw’Amajyepfo, Afurika y’Amajyepfo, Amerika yo Hagati, Aziya y’Amajyepfo na Australia. Amasezerano ya Montreal yerekeye imyuka yangiza akayunguruzo k’izuba yemerejwe i Kigali, ni imwe mu ntambwe ikomeye Isi yateye mu rwego rwo kurwanya ingaruka nk’izi. Ku rundi ruhande ariko ubushakashatsi buvuga ko nta cyagerwaho  ibihugu bidashyize imbaraga mu kubahiriza aya masezerano. Gusa nubwo ibihugu bikangurirwa kugabanya ibyuka byangiza akayunguruzo k’izuba, Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika zamaze gukuramo akarenge, nyamara Abanyamerika bafite ibipimo byinshi by’ibyuka byanduza ikirere (Carbone Dioxide) kurusha ibindi bihugu. Amasezerano ya Montreal yo kugabanya imyuka byangiza akayunguruzo k’izuba, avuga ko ibihugu bikize birimo ibyo ku mugabane w’u Burayi, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’ibindi bizatangira guhagarika ikoreshwa ry’ibyuma bikonjesha, HFCs mu myaka mike iri imbere aho bizagabanya kugeza ku 10% mu 2019. Ibihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere nk’u Bushinwa, ibyo muri Amerika y’Amajyepfo n’ibindi bizatangira kugabanya ikoreshwa ry’iyi myuma mu 2024. Ibindi bihugu birimo u Buhinde, Pakistan, Iran, Iraq bizagabanya ikoreshwa ry’ibyuma bikonjesha mu 2028. U Bushinwa nk’igihugu gikora ibi byuma kurusha ibindi ntikizahagarika inganda zibikora mbere ya 2029. Imyuka ituruka mu byuma bikonjesha bikurura ubushyuhe bw’izuba inshuro 1000 kurusha umwuka mubi ( Carbon Dioxide) usanzwwe uzwi mu kugira uruhare mu ihindagurika ry’ikirere.

title: Umwanda wo muri Gereza ya Mageragere watangiye gutunganywa ngo udatera indwara abayituriye
content: Kuba iyi gereza ikikijwe n’imirima n’inzu z’abaturage ndetse n’umugezi wa Nyabarongo, biri mu byatumye hatekerezwa uburyo bwo kubyaza umusaruro amazi ayiturukamo. Hubatswe uburyo bwo gutunganya amazi mabi ava mu bwiherero, mu bikoni ndetse no mu bwogero kugira ngo ajye akoreshwa mu bindi bikorwa by’isuku, kuhira imyaka aho kwisuka muri Nyabarongo cyangwa mu mirima y’abaturage. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa REMA, Ruhamya Collette, yavuze ko bahisemo gutunganya iyi myanda ituruka mu mazi no mu butaka bw’iyi gereza kubera ko iyo idatunganyijwe iba intandaro yo kwangiza ibidukikije no gutera indwara abaturage. Yagize ati “ Nk’uko mwabibonye iki gikorwa kigamije gutunganya imyanda ituruka mu mazi y’iyi gereza kubera ko twese tuzi ko iyo imyanda igiye mu bidukikije nko mu mazi no mu butaka  idatunganyijwe ahanini ariyo iba intandaro yo kwangiza ibidukikije no gutera indwara mu baturage.” Umuyobozi wa RCS, CGP Rwigamba George,  yavuze ko iki gikorwa ari cyiza ndetse kizagira akamaro cyane kuko amazi y’umwanda yavaga muri iyi gereza azatunganywa akongera agakoreshwa. Yagize ati “Bizagira akamaro cyane mu kurengera ibidukikije kubera ko umwanda uva muri iyi gereza  uwuretse ukamanuka uko wakabaye ukajya mu mugezi wa Nyabarongo, wakwangiza byinshi. Akamaro bizagira ni uko amazi y’umwanda yavaga aha agiye gutunganywa akavamo umwanda wose akongera agasubira gukoreshwa mu bikorwa birimo iby’ubuhinzi n’isuku kandi akaba atazagera mu baturage.” Ayo mazi yatunganyijwe bisaba ko abanza gutekwa ku muntu wakenera kuyanywa yujuje ubuziranenge. Binateganyijwe ko gahunda yo gutunganya imyanda izagezwa no mu zindi gereza n’ibindi bigo binini mu rwego rwo kubungabunga ibidukikije.

title: U Rwanda rwatangije uruganda rutunganya imyanda y’ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga
content: Muri Mata 2014, Ikigega gitera inkunga imishinga igamije kubungabubunga ibidukikije ’Rwanda Green Fund’, cyashoye hafi miliyoni 1.5 z’amadolari y’Amerika (miliyari 1.26 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda), mu mushinga wo gukusanya no gutunganya imyanda ikomoka ku bikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga biba bitagikoreshwa. Uru ruganda rwatangijwe kuri uyu wa Mbere, ruzatunganya imyanda ikomoka ku bikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga biba bitagikoreshwa ariko ugasanga bibitse mu buryo butizewe kandi bishobora gutera ingaruka zihariye. Harimo ibikoresho byifashishwa mu ngo nka firigo, imashini zimesa, iziteka, televiziyo, ibyuma bishyushya, telefoni n’ibindi bituma ibyuma by’ikoranabuhanga bidakoreshwa bikomeza kwiyongera, ugasanga ahenshi birunze mu bubiko. Muri ibyo byuma, bizajya bijyanwa muri urwo ruganda ibikiri bizima bigatunganywa hakabyazwamo ibindi bikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga, ibyangiritse bigasenywa ku buryo bitangiza ibidukikije. Mu mezi atandatu rumaze gutunganya mudasobwa zirenga 200 za desktop zari zarapfuye, zikaba zarahawe ibigo by’amashuri. Minisitiri Biruta yavuze ko iyi myanda ari ikibazo gikomeye kandi gisaba ubufatanye n’imbaraga zikomeye mu kugishakira igisubizo. Yagize ati “Turabizi neza ko imyanda ikomoka mu ikoranabuhanga ari ikibazo gikomeye mu bihugu byinshi byo ku Isi. Uretse kuba yangiza ibidukikije, binatera ibibazo bikomeye ku buzima no ku mibereho myiza y’abaturage.”  Uru ruganda ruri mu murongo wo guteza imbere isuku n’ibidukikije, ruzafasha u Rwanda kugera ku ntego yo gutera imbere ibigendana no kugabanya ibyuka bihumanya ikirere mu 2050, rukaba ari urugero muri Afurika no ku Isi. Minisitiri Biruta yagarutse ku bimaze kugerwaho n’Ikigega cyo kubungabunga imyanda muri gahunda y’imyaka itanu, aho hashyizweho itegeko n’amabwiriza abigenga, imirongo ngenderwaho n’ubuziranenge bwabyo. Ubushakashatsi bwerekanye ko hari ingaruka zishamikiye ku myanda ikomoka ku bikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga bitewe ahanini n’icyo biba bikozemo, bikaba byagira ingaruka ku muntu cyangwa bigateza ikibazo mu bundi buryo. Kubitwikira ku gasozi kandi nabyo bishobora guteza ibindi bibazo birimo indwara z’ubuhumekero cyangwa izindi zishamikiye ku bibazo by’umutima.

title: Kayonza: Bralirwa yashyikirije abaturage amashanyarazi akomoka ku zuba inifatanya na bo gutera ibiti
content: Nyuma y’umuganda no gushyikirizwa amashanyarazi kuri uyu wa 2 Ukuboza 2017, Mukarutabana Helena yabwiye IGIHE ko ashimishijwe n’uko atazongera kugonga inkuta z’inzu kubera kuba mu kizima. Yagize ati “Aba bantu barakoze cyane; wasangaga mu gihe cy’igicuku njya hanze nijoro nkagonga urukuta kubera hatabona ariko ubu mpita nkanda ku rukuta hakabona. Hari n’ubwo twacanaga agatadowa umwotsi wako ugasanga uratubangamiye cyane.” Umuyobozi ushinzwe itumanaho no guhuza ibikorwa, Nyangezi Fred, yavuze ko iki gikorwa kigamije kuzamura imibereho myiza y’abaturage batuririye umurima uhingwamo ibyo Bralirwa yifashisha yenga inzoga. Yangeye ati “Ubundi igikorwa cyatuzanye kwari ukwifatanya n’abaturage mu muganda wo gutera ibiti ariko kandi tuje no gutaha ikindi twakoze mbere cyo guha abaturage amashanyarazi akomoka ku zuba. Icyivugo cyacu ni ugutsinda mu kazi, tugatsinda ubukene, umwijima. Murabyumva neza ko twazanywe n’igikorwa cyiza.” Muri rusange, abaturage b’Akarere ka Kayonza bafite umuriro w’amashanyari ni 33%, by’umwihariko mu Murenge wa Ndego, abawufite ni 18%, abandi basigaye baracyacana agatadowa. Umuyobozi wungirije w’Akarere ka Kayonza ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage, Harerimana Jean Damascène, yashimiye Bralirwa ku bikorwa ikora bigamije gufasha abaturage bako, asaba abaturage kubibungabunga, cyane cyane ibyo biti kubera akamaro bibafitiye harimo kuzana umwuka mwiza, gukurura imvura n’ibindi.

title: Inzovu zisaga ibihumbi 20 ziricwa buri mwaka muri Afurika
content: Ibi byagarutsweho mu nama nyunguranabitekerezo yabereye mu karere ka Musanze kuri uyu wa 23 Ugushyingo 2017, ihuje abacunga umutekano, abakozi bashinzwe kurengera ibidukikije n’abakora mu nzego za leta, yateguwe n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere(RDB)ku bufatanye n’Umuryango urengera inyamaswa zo mu gasozi(Rwanda Wildlife Conservation Association). Iyi nama yari igamije kungurana ibitekerezo ku kurwanya  ibyaha byo gushimuta no gucuruza inyamaswa by’umwihariko imisambi yo mu Rwanda, inkura n’inzovu zikunze kwibasirwa haba ku rwego rw’igihugu mu Karere no ku rwego mpuzamahanga no kureba uburyo ibyaha nk’ibi bihanwa. Umunyakenyakazi, Dr. Winnie Kiiru umaze imyaka isaga 25 mu bikorwa byo kurengera ubusugire bw’inyamaswa,wari witabiriye iyi nama, yemeza ko igitiza umurindi ba rushimusi harimo ibikoresho biciriritse ku barinda inyamaswa ndetse n’amategeko adakarishye ahana ibi byaha. Yagize ati “Hagomba gushyirwaho uburyo bwose abarinzi bagira ibikoresho bikomeye, urugero usanga ba rushimusi bateye parike bafite imbunda zikomeye, indege n’imodoka zikaze ariko abarinzi bo bafite inkoni cyangwa amabuye. Murumva izi mbaraga ntizahangana n’aba ba rushimus;hari n’aho usanga amategeko ahana ibi byaha adakaze kurusha inyungu aba bashimuta baba bifuzamo, ibi bikwiye kuranduka kuko mu Rwanda byarashobotse.” Umuyobozi w’Ishami rishinzwe gucunga imishinga iterwa na leta muri RDB, Felix Siboniyo ni umukozi w’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere RDB yemera ko koko amategeko ahari hari igihe usanga atanga icyuho cyane ku kubungabunga ibidukikije. Ati “Hagomba kubaho amategeko yihariye niba mu Rwanda inzovu ziri gucika ni ngombwa ko habaho amategeko yihariye azirengera mu gihe zabonetse kugira ngo zororoke.” Akomeza avuga ko udashobora kugira ubukerarugendo utarengeye ibidukikije kandi udashobora no kurengera ibinyabuzima utagamije iterambere ry’abantu. Ati “Kugira ngo tubigereho hakenewe ubufatanye bwimbitse hagati y’inzego zose kuko nubwo mu Rwanda parike zicunzwe neza, hanakenewe ubukangurambaga muri rubanda, ku bakora ku bibuga by’indege, ku mipaka n’abashinzwe umutekano kugira ngo tugire ubukerarugendo buteye imbere.” Kuri ubu habarurwa inzovu ziri hagati y’ibihumbi 20 na 30 zicwa buri mwaka muri Afurika hagamijwe kuzikuraho amahembe yazo akoreshwa mu bugeni inyinshi zikaba ari izo muri Kenya, Botwana na Afurika y’Epfo. Abitabiriye iyi nama basabwe ko buri wese yaba ijisho ry’igihugu mu kurwanya ubushimusi n’ubucuruzi bunyuranyije n’amategeko harengerwa inyamaswa cyane cyane izigenda zikendera. Abitabiriye iyi nama bari baturutse mu bihugu bya Kenya, Malawi, Uganda, Tanzania Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo n’u Rwanda rwayakiriye. U Rwanda rwashoye imbaraga mu bikorwa byo kurengera inyamaswa; urugamba rwo gufasha amatsinda ashinzwe gukumira ishimutwa ry’inyamaswa no gukorana n’inzego zitandukanye mu gukurikirana, gutanga amakuru no kugeza mu butabera abakora ibyaha byo kuzishimuta rurakomeje.

title: Amavugurura ya Kigali ku masezerano ya Montréal yemejwe bidasubirwaho, agiye gutangira gukurikizwa
content: Uyu muhigo ukomeye weshejwe nyuma y’uko Suède yiyongereye ku bihugu 19 byari bimaze kwemeza burundu ayo masezerano yamaze imyaka irindwi aganirwaho, akemeranywaho mu rukerera rwo kuwa 15 Ukwakira 2016, ubwo abari mu biganiro byabasabaga kurara ijoro muri Kigali Convention Centre bajya impaka. Amasezerano ya Montréal muri rusange bibarwa ko amaze kugabanya 98% by’imyuka yangizaga akayunguruzo kagabanya ubukana bw’imirasire y’izuba iza ku isi, Ozone, irimo nka chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) na hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs), ku buryo katangiye kugaragaza ibimenyetso byo kwisubiranya. Amavugurura ya Kigali kuri ayo masezerano azatuma ibihugu bitera intambwe noneho bijye no mu kugabanya ikoreshwa ry’imyuka ya hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) ituruka mu byuma byohereza umwuka mu nyubako cyangwa ibikonjesha nka za firigo. Nubwo HFCs zo zitangiza Ozone, zifite ingaruka inshuro ibihumbi mu gushyushya uyu mubumbe kurusha ‘dioxide de carbone,’ CO2. Amavuvurura ya Kigali byitezwe ko azagabanya dogere 0.5 ku gipimo cy’ubushyuhe bw’isi mbere y’uko iki kinyejana kirangira, bikaba intambwe ikomeye mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’amasezerano ya Paris yo mu 2015, agena ingamba zizatuma ubushyuhe bw’isi buguma munsi ya dogere Celsius ebyiri. Nk’uko byatangajwe n’ihuriro ry’ibihugu byishyize hamwe mu guharanira ko haboneka ibisubizo ku ihindagurika ry’ibihe, High Ambition Coalition, kuwa Gatanu w’iki cyumweru, amavugurura ya Kigali ni intambwe ikomeye yatewe mu gutuma isi iguma mu gipimo cy’ubushyuhe byemerejwe i Paris. Rigira riti “Kuri uyu munsi wa nyuma w’inama ya COP23 – twageze ku mubare w’ibihugu wari ukenewe kugira ngo aya mavugurura atangire gushyirwa mu bikorwa mu 2019. Kuba bigezweho mu mwaka umwe aya mavugurura yemerejwe i Kigali ni ikimenyetso gikomeye cy’ubushake bwa politiki mu gukuraho ikoreshwa rya HFCs, n’ubushake dusangiye mu guhangana n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe.” Iryo huriro ryavuze ko ryagize uruhare rukomeye mu kwemeza ayo masezerano, cyane ko ibihugu byayemeje ku ikubitiro biribarizwamo. Mu gihe mu cyumweru gitaha hari inama ku masezerano ya Montréal izabera muri Canada, iryo huriro ngo ryizeye ko ibindi bihugu bizemeza burundu ayo masezerano kandi bigatangira kuyashyira mu bikorwa. High Ambition Coalition ihurirwamo n’ibihugu bisaga 100 birimo ibihugu bikize nk’ibyo mu Muryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi n’ibihugu bikennye ariko bifite ibyago byinshi byo guhura n’ingaruka z’ihindagurika ry’ibihe, hagamijwe gushaka ko haboneka uburyo bwo kuzirwanya. Amavugurura ya Kigali agena ko ibihugu bikize bigomba kugabanya ikoreshwa rya HFCs ku gipimo cya 85% hagati y’umwaka wa 2019 na 2036; ibihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere bikagabanya iyo myuka kuri 80% hagati ya 2024 na 2045. Muri Mata 2017 nibwo u Rwanda rwemeje burundu ibyavuguruwe ku masezerano ya Montréal yerekeye ibintu byangiza akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba. Narwo ruri mu bihugu biri kugerwaho n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe kuko ubushyuhe bwazamutse ku gipimo mpuzandengo cya dogere 1.4 (1.4°C) kuva mu 1970, kandi mu gihe nta gikozwe, cyazamuka kugera kuri dogere 2.5 bitarenze umwaka wa 2050. Ayo masezerano agenga inganda zo mu bihugu byayemeje burundu ngo bihange ikoranabuhanga ritifashisha iyo myuka yangiza, kandi ibihugu bikize bikazabigiramo uruhare rufatika cyane ko ari nabyo bifite izo nganda, bikaba bifite n’igihe cya vuba cyo guca HFCs ugereranyije n’ibihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere.

title: U Bwongereza bwemeje burundu amavugurura ya Kigali ku ikoreshwa ry’imyuka yongera ubushyuhe bw’Isi
content: Amavugurura ya Kigali agena ko ibihugu bigomba kugabanya ikoreshwa ry’imyuka izwi nka hydrofluorocarbon (HFCs) ku gipimo cya 85% hagati y’umwaka wa 2019 na 2036. Ni imyuka ituruka mu byuma byohereza umwuka mu nyubako cyangwa ibikonjesha nka za firigo. Minisiteri ishinzwe ibidukikije mu Bwongereza yavuze ko nta gikozwe iyo myuka ishobora kuzaba yiyongereyeho 11% bitarenze 2050, bukaba bwifuza gukumira ko biba. Yavuze ko amasezerano ya Montreal muri rusange ari amwe mu yemeranyijweho agashobora gutanga umusaruro, kuko amaze kugabanya 98% by’imyuka yangizaga akayunguruzo kagabanya ubukana bw’imirasire y’izuba iza ku Isi, Ozone, irimo nka chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) na hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs), ku buryo katangiye kugaragaza ibimenyetso bya mbere byo kwisubiranya. Ibyavugururiwe i Kigali kuri ayo masezerano byo bizatuma haterwa intambwe noneho ibihugu bijye no mu guca HFCs. Nubwo zo zitangiza Ozone, zifite ingaruka inshuro ibihumbi mu gushyushya uyu mubumbe kurusha ‘dioxide de carbone,’ CO2. Amavugurura ya Kigali byitezwe ko azagabanya dogere 0.5 ku gipimo cy’ubushyuhe bw’Isi mbere y’uko iki kinyejana kirangira, bikaba intambwe ikomeye mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’amasezerano ya Paris yo mu 2015, agena ingamba zizatuma ubushyuhe bw’Isi buguma munsi ya dogere Celsius ebyiri. Minisitiri w’Ibidukikije mu Bwongereza, Michael Gove,  yagize ati “Kwemeza izi ntego birashyira u Bwongereza mu mwanya w’imbere ku Isi mu guhangana n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe. Aya masezerano azagabanya ukoherezwa kw’imyuka ihwanye na toni miliyari 70 za CO2 bitarenze 2050,  bingana n’imyuka ishobora koherezwa na sitasiyo 600 zitwika amakara muri icyo gihe.” U Bwongereza n’ibindi bihugu bigize Umuryango w’Ubumwe bw’Ibihugu by’u Burayi (EU) byatangiye guca HFCs, ku buryo bagomba kugabanya kuri 79% hagati ya 2015 na 2030. Amasezerano ya Montreal azatuma u Bwongereza bwonyine bugabanya imyuka ingana na toni miliyoni 44 za CO2. Ibindi bihugu biheruka kwemeza burundu ibyavugururiwe i Kigali muri ayo masezerano ni Maldives na Canada, ku buryo hakenewe ibindi bihugu birindwi kugira ngo bishoboke ko azatangire gukurikizwa kuwa 1 Mutarama 2019. Mu Ukwakira umwaka ushize nibwo ibihugu hafi 200 byahuriye i Kigali byiga ku ivugurura mu masezerano ya Montreal, byemezwa ko ibihugu bikize bizagabanya iyo myuka kuri 85% hagati ya 2019 na 2036; ibihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere bikagabanya iyo myuka kuri 80% hagati ya 2024 na 2045. Ibihugu 10 birimo u Buhinde, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Leta Zunze ubumwe z’Abarabu, Iran na Iraq byo bizagabanya 85% hagati ya 2028 na 2047. Ibyavugururiwe i Kigali bimaze kwemezwa burundu n’ibihugu birimo u Rwanda, Mali, Leta zishyize hamwe za Macaronesia, Ibirwa bya Marshall, Palau na Norvege. Mexico na Costa Rica bari mu rugendo rwo kuyemeza burundu.

title: Amacupa ya palasitiki yatangiye guhabwa akato mu biro bya leta
content: Uku gukumira amacupa ya palasitiki kwatangijwe  na Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije mu gihe hitegurwa kwizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga  w’ibidukikije, ku wa 5 Kamena ariko nta tegeko rihari, ni ubukanguramabaga. Mu gihe yaba mu biro no mu nama wasanganga amacupa y’amazi ateretse imbere y’abayitabiriye,  bigiye guhinduka hajye hagaragara ibirahuri nubwo nta tegeko rica ayari asanzwe rirasohoka. Minisitiri w’Ibidukikije, Dr. Biruta Vincent, uri ku isonga ry’iyi gahunda nshya, kuri Twitter yatambukije  ubutumwa bugira  buti “Ndashishikariza buri wese kwifatanya natwe mu gukumira ihumanya ry’ibidukikije riterwa na za palasitiki. Gukoresha ibikoresho  bya palasitiki  nk’amacupa, ibikombe, imiheha, amasahani ... byangiza ibidukikije. Uburyo bwabisimbura burahari.” Iyi Minisiteri yavuze ko bashishikariza ibigo byose gushyira mu biro za ‘water dispensers’, bakajya banywesha amazi ibirahuri cyangwa udukombe dukoreshwa rimwe. Nubwo nta tegeko rica amacupa ya palasitiki, REMA nayo kuri Twitter yagize iti “Nta cupa na rimwe ry’amazi rizongera kugaragara mu nama cyangwa mu biro. Turashishikariza inzego zose n’imiryango kureka gukoresha ibikoresho bya palasitiki. Dufatanye turwanye ihumanya riterwa na palasitiki.” Minisitiri w’Ubutabera, Johnston Busingye, nawe yashimiye Minisitiri Biruta ku guca amacupa ya palasitiki, nawe ahita agaragaza ko muri minisiteri ayobora agiye kubigenza atyo. Yagize ati “Igitekerezo cyiza Bwana Biruta. Minisiteri y’Ubutabera n’inzego ziyishamikiyeho bigiye gukurikiza urugero rwawe.” Nubwo inzego zatangiye guha akato ibikoresho bya palasiti, hari amakuru ko haba hari no gutegurwa itegeko ribica.

title: REMA yasabye ko imodoka zishaje zikumirwa mu Rwanda
content: Kuri uyu wa 2 Gicurasi 2018, REMA yamuritse ubushakashatsi yakoze hagamijwe kureba iby’ingenzi bitera ihumana ry’umwuka n’iyangirika ry’ikirere. Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko ibintu biza ku isonga mu guhumanya umwuka uhumekwa mu Rwanda harimo umwotsi w’imodoka, imyotsi y’amakara n’inkwi n’ibindi. Bwanagaragaje ko 95,2% y’imodoka ziri mu Rwanda zimaze imyaka irenga 10 zikozwe; 56,6 % zakozwe mbere yo mu 1999 naho 77,2% zakozwe mbere ya 2000. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa REMA, Eng. Collette Ruhamya, yavuze ko Leta yashyizeho ingamba zigamije guteza imbere imodoka zitwarira abantu hamwe mu Mujyi wa Kigali, ariko avuga ko hari ikindi kibazo cy’imodoka zishaje  n’icy’izitwara ibintu biremereye mu mijyi zisohora umwuka mubi. Yagize ati “Tugize imihanda mini, bya bimodoka byose binini mwarabibonye ko biba bitumura imyuka myinshi si ngombwa ngo bice i Kigali, kuko iyo zihahuriye ari nyinshi nibwo usanga ikirere cyangwa imyuka yaho yanduye.” Eng. Ruhamwa yunzemo ati “Ahandi dukangurira abantu, cya gihe utwaye imodoka isa n’ihagaze ariko yaka, hariya imyuka ivamo iba itwanduza. Izindi ni ukureba uko imodoka zishaje twazikumira kuko igihugu cyacu nticyakomeza kuba ahantu umwanda wose ukomeza ujya, tugakangurira abaturage kugura inshya n’izitaramara igihe kirekire.” Ubu bushakashatsi kandi bugaragaza ko uduce duto duto tutabonwa n’amaso twivanga n’umwuka uhumekwa tubangamiye bikomeye ubuzima bw’abaturarwanda   bishobora gutera indwara z’ubuhumekero n’umutima. Bugaragaza ko mu bice bituwe hari ubwo naho ikigero cy’utwo tuvungukira kirenga urugero rwemewe, ahanini kubera imyuka ikomoka ku gukoresha ibicanwa bikomoka ku biti no gutwika ibyatsi, ibiyorero n’amashyamba. Hari ibice bimwe na bimwe byagaragayemo ko mu mpeshyi muri metero kibe imwe y’umwuka usangamo hagati ya mikorogarama (microgram) 100 na 150 z’utwo tuvungukira mu gihe ikigero cyemewe kitagomba kurenga mikorogarama 35 kuri meterokibe y’umwuka. REMA isaba abantu kwimakaza gucana gaz, amashanyarazi na biogaz mu kwirinda izo ndwara. Gusa bamwe mu baturage b’amikoro make, bavuga ko uretse ikibazo cy’amikoro, babangamirwa n’imyotsi y’amakara kuri ubu umufuka wayo ugura asaga ibihumbi 12 Frw mu gihe ikilo cya Gaz kigura agera ku 1000 Frw,  naho amashyiga yayo nayo agahenda, aya make agura ibihumbi bigera kuri 35 Frw. REMA itangaza ko hakenewe ingamba zirenze izafashwe ndetse ko hari umushinga uri gutegurwa wo kujya ikusanya amakuru y’uko ikirere cy’u Rwanda kiza kuba cyifashe mu bijyanye n’ingano y’imyuka ihumanya, bikamenyeshwa Abanyarwanda bakagirwa n’inama y’uko bitwara ndetse  ayo makuru agashobora no kuzajya  atangwa kuri telefone. Minisitiri w’ibidukikije, Dr Biruta Vincent, yavuze ko ihumanya ry’ikirere ritabangamira ibidukikije gusa, binabangamira ubukungu bw’igihugu. Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku buzima mu 2012 bugatangazwa mu 2016, bwerekanye ko Abanyarwanda 2237 bishwe  n’indwara zituruka mu mwuka uhumanye. Misiteri y’Ubuzima yo yatangaje ko abarenga miliyoni 1,6 bakiriwe mu bitaro bafite ibibazo by’ubuhumekero mu 2012, bikuba kabiri karenga mu 2015 bagera kuri miliyoni 3,3; abana bari munsi y’imyaka itanu bishwe n’indwara zifitanye isano n’ubuhumekero bari 22 %. U Rwanda rusanzwe rwarashyizeho ingamba zigamije  kugabanya umubare w’imodoka zakoze zinjira mu gihugu zirimo kuzongerera umusoro. Inama y’Abaminisitiri bo mu karere yo muri Mata 2015 yashyizeho umurongo wo gusoresha ibinyabiziga byakoze byinjizwa mu Muryango w’Ibihugu by’Afurika y’Uburasirazuba narwo rubarizwamo. Nyuma hemejwe ko izo modoka zishyirirwaho ibipimo by’ubusaze bigenderwaho mu gusoreshwa, aho imodoka nshya zisoreshwa 20%, izishaje kuva ku myaka 10 ikozwe gusubiza hejuru zigasoreshwa 80%. Niba irengeje imyaka 10  isoreshwa 80%; imaze hagati y’imyaka 9-10 igasoreshwa 75%; imaze imyaka 8-9 igasoreshwa 70%; imaze 7-8 igasoreshwa 65%, iyi 6-7 igasoreshwa 60%; imaze 5-6 igasoreshwa 55%;  imaze imyaka 4-5 igasoreshwa 50%; iy’ imyaka 3-4 igasoreshwa 40%; imaze imyaka 2-3 igasoreshwa 30 % naho imaze imyaka 1-2 igasoreshwa 20%. Nubwo nta mibare  cyabashije, Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Imisoro n’Amahoro ( RRA) cyatangaje ko imodoka nyinshi zinyira mu gihugu ari izakoze, naho inshya nyinshi zinjira ari iz’abayobozi, ko by’umwihariko mu 2015  ku butaka bw’u Rwanda hinjiye imodoka 7,262.

title: Afurika na Aziya mu kaga k’ihumana ry’umwuka abantu bahumeka
content: Inyigo ya OMS yasuzumye ibyago bituruka ku byuka bihumanya, yaba ibyo mu rugo n’ibyo hanze yarwo muri rusange, yerekanye ko ababarirwa muri miliyoni zirindwi bapfa buri mwaka bazize ibyo byuka. Igaragaza ko abarenga 90 % by’abicwa n’ibifitanye isano n’imyuka bihumanya ikirere ari abo mu bihugu bikennye n’ibifite ubukungu buciriritse byiganje muri Afurika na Aziya. Maria Neira uyobora ishami rishinzwe ubuzima rusange n’ibidukikije muri OMS, yavuze ko ‘iki ari ikibazo giteye ubwoba.’ Iyi mibare yibanze cyane ku bubi bw’uduce duto duto tutabonwa n’amaso twivanga n’umwuka duhumeka dufite umurambararo uri munsi ya micrometre 2.5 (PM2.5) n’udufite umurambararo uri hagati ya micrometres 2.5 na 10 (PM10). Uduce two mu bwoko bwa PM 2.5, turimo; sulphate n’umwuka mubi  wa ‘Black carbon’, dutera ingaruka zikomeye ku buzima iyo twinjiye mu bihaha cyangwa mu mugendo w’amaraso mu mubiri w’umuntu. Ibi bitera indwara zirimo umutima, umuvuduko w’amaraso, kanseri y’ibihaha, indwara zandurira mu myanya y’ubuhumekero nk’umusonga. Iyi raporo ivuga kandi ko abatuye Isi barenga 40 % badafite uburyo bwo guteka budahumanya ikirere n’ikoranabuhanga bakifashisha mu ngo zabo. Gutekesha amakara ni kimwe mu bihumanya ikirere mu ngo, bikaba byica abagera kuri miliyoni 3.8 ku mwaka. Umuyobozi wa OMS, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, avuga ko ‘atari ibintu kwihanganira kuba abarenga miliyoni eshatu, biganjemo abagore n’abana birirwa bahumeka imyuka  ihumanya ituruka mu byo batekesha mu ngo zabo.’ Nubwo hari intambwe imaze guterwa mu gushaka uburyo bwo gutekesha budahumanya abantu n’ikirere, muri Afurika yo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara biracyari imbogamizi. Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cyo Kubungabunga Ibidukikije mu Rwanda (REMA) bwagaragaje ko imodoka, amakara n’inkwi biri ku isonga mu guhumanya umwuka mwiza uhumekwa mu Rwanda. Mu bice by’imijyi ahantu hegereye umuhanda, umwuka abantu bahumeka uhumanywa n’imyuka isohorwa n’ibinyabiziga mu gihe mu bice byagenewe imiturire n’iby’ibyaro, umwuka uhumanywa cyane cyane n’ikomoka mu gutwika no gucana ibikomoka ku biti nk’inkwi n’amakara. Imwe mu ngamba yihutirwa ikaba ari ukongerwa ibikoresho bifasha abaturage guteka hadasohowe umwotsi mwinshi ariko bikagabanyirizwa ibiciro ku buryo bugaragara. Birimo Biogaz, rondereza, imirasire, ingufu zikomoka ku muyaga na gaz.

title: Muhanga: REMA yoroje inka abaturage 78
content: Izi nka zatanzwe mu rwego rwo gufasha abaturage bakorewe abaterasi kuri hegitari 229 mu kongera umusaruro mu gihe byabagurirwa ifumbire yo kwifashisha. Ubwo bashyikirizwaga inka 78 mu zigomba gutangwa zigera ku 119, kuri uyu wa Kane, Umuyobozi ushinzwe gukurikirana imishinga ikorera muri REMA, Ntabana Alphonsine, yasabye abatuye imirenge yose ikora ku mugezi rwa Nyabarongo kuwubungabunga barwanya isuri mu bikorwa byabo bya buri munsi. Yagize ati “Ubusanzwe twakoraga amaterasi tukabagurira ifumbire y’imborera umwaka umwe ariko twasanze  bidahagije twiyemeza kubaha inka ngo zijye zibaha ifumbire buri gihe. Ni mwe mugiye guhinga mukazamura umusaruro ndetse murinda ibidukikije, isuri ntiyangize uru rugomero rwa Nyabarongo. Ku ikubitiro tuzanye inka 78 ariko zigomba kugera ku 119 twizeye ko zizahindura imibereho yanyu.” Yongeraho ko nyuma yo gutera imigano ahenshi ku migezi REMA yabonye ko ari byiza gukora amaterasi agafasha mu kurwanya isuri no kugunduka k’ubutaka gutuma budatanga umusaruro nyawo. Mutarambirwa Athanase umwe mu bahawe inka avuga ko igiye kumuha ifumbire izamubashisha kongera umusaruro, ikazazamura n’imirire myiza biturutse ku mata. REMA imaze gutanga inka zikabakaba 550 mu Mirenge itandukanye igize Akarere ka Muhanga irimo Rugendabari, Rongi na  Nyarusange. Iki kigo gitangaza ko  imishinga yo kubungabunga uruzi rwa Nyabarongo yagenewe amafaranga y’u Rwandaarenga  miliyari imwe naho inka zose zizatangwa zifite agaciro k’amafaranga y’u Rwanda miliyoni 62 n’ibihumbi 732.

title: U Rwanda, Uganda na RDC mu gukaza ubufatanye bwita ku binyabuzima byo mu Birunga
content: Igice cy’iburunga kigizwe n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima biboneka muri Pariki y’Iburunga ku ruhande rw’u Rwanda; Pariki Nkuru ya Virunga ku ruhande rwa Congo  na pariki ya Mgahinga Gorilla National Park ku   rwa Uganda. Izi pariki zirimo inyamaswa zitandukanye zirimo ingagi zo mu misozi ndetse n’ibimera bitandukanye. Kuri uyu wa Kane i Kigali hateraniye inama y’abaminisitiri bo muri ibyo bihugu bafite  aho bahuriye no kubungabunga ibinyabuzima mu nshingano , higwa uburyo ibihugu byafatanya mu guteza imbere Umuryango ugamije guteza imbere ibyo kurengera urusobe  rw’ibinyabuzima mu gace k’ibirunga (Greater Virunga Transboundary Collaboration, GVTC). Bimwe mu byagezweho muri iyo nama, hemejwe ubufatanye bw’ibihugu mu gukusanya ingengo y’imari uwo muryango uzakoresha, gushyiraho ubuyobozi bwawo, abakozi n’ibindi. Hemejwe kandi gushyira ingufu muri buri gihugu kikemeza burundu amasezerano ashyiraho uwo muryango. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa RDB, Clare Akamanzi, yavuze ko nubwo bari gushaka ubufatanye hagati y’ibihugu, ntibizakuraho inshingano za buri gihugu zo kwita ku rusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Yavuze ko nubwo ibihugu bisanzwe bifatanya binyuze muri GVTC ariko ko hakwiye ubufatanye buruseho. Yagize ati “Ingagi ntabwo zizi imipaka, iyo ziri gutembera ntizimenya niba ziri muri Uganda cyangwa mu Rwanda, zigenda ntacyo zikanga bitewe n’icyo zishaka. Kimwe mu byo dufatanya, nk’iyo itsinda rimwe ry’ingagi rivuye mu gihugu rijya mu kindi, hari uburyo dusangira inyungu zarivuyemo.” Yakomeje agira ati “Urugero nk’itsinda ryitwa Kwitonda ryavuye muri Congo none rimaze imyaka myinshi ryibera mu Rwanda. Hagati ya 2012 na 2017, u Rwanda rwasubije Congo miliyoni 1.2 z’amadolari kuko dusangiye inyungu y’iryo tsinda ryaturutseyo.” Minisitiri  w’Ubukerarugendo, urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima n’amateka wa Uganda, Kamuntu Ephraim, yavuze ko kimwe mu byo bakwiye gushyiramo ingufu ni ugukangurira abaturage kugira uruhare mu kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, babafasha no kwiteza imbere. Yagize ati “Ntabwo imiryango ishonje ishobora kurinda ibidukikije ahubwo bazarya izi nyamaswa ariko nubaha ikindi kibabyarira amafaranga bazayakoresha bagura ibyo kurya aho kwica inyamaswa. Tugomba guhindura imyumvire y’abaturage bacu. Ntabwo bikwiye ko polisi ariyo ikubuza gushimuta inyamaswa, ukwiye kwibwiriza ukabihagarika.” Uganda iha abaturage baturiye pariki  20 % by’ibyavuye mu bukerarugendo bw’izo pariki  mu gihe u Rwanda rubaha 10%. Ibihugu byose nibimara kwemeza burundu amasezerano ashyiraho GVTC, bizashyiraho uburyo buhamye bwo kurwanya ishimutwa ry’inyamaswa, kubungabunga ibindi binyabuzima ndetse no guteza imbere imibereho y’abaturiye za pariki.

title: REMA ihangayikishijwe n’uko igihugu gikennye imishinga yo kurengera ibidukikije n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe
content: Green Climate Fund, itera inkunga imishinga itandukanye igamije kurengera ibidukikije no gukumira ingaruka z’ihindagurika ry’ibihe, cyane cyane mu bihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere n’ibyabasirwa cyane n’izo ngaruka. Kuri uyu wa 27 Werurwe 2018 ubwo umuyobozi mukuru wungirije wa REMA, Munyazikwiye Faustin, yatangizaga amahugurwa y’abahanga mu kurengera ibidukikije, agamije kubongerera ubumenyi, yavuze ko nta mishinga ihari. Yagize ati “Minisiteri y’ibidukikije yemerewe guhabwa miliyoni ziri hagati ya 10$ na 50$ ku mushinga umwe wo kurengera ibidukikije. Mutekereze umushinga wa miliyoni 50 mukaba mudafite na mike mushobora gutanga. Guhera mu 2015 nibwo twemerewe ariko muri uyu mwaka nibwo twakiriye umushinga wa mbere wa miliyoni 32[...]mutekereze kuba twaremerewe mbere ariko tukaba nta mishinga dufite! Icyo nicyo kibazo dufite, nicyo namwe mufite.” Munyazikwiye yakomeje avuga ko imishinga icyo kigega gitera inkunga ari igamije kurengera ibidukikije no gukumira ingaruka z’ihindagurika ry’ibihe nk’imvura, imyuzure, amapfa n’ibindi ikubiye mu nkingi zitandukanye irimo iy’ubukungu, ubuhinzi, ingufu, ubwikorezi n’ahandi kandi ko nyuma y’ayo mahugurwa, izo nzobere zizaba zifite ubushobozi buhambaye bwo kuyitegura, bagafasha ibigo bya Leta n’ibyigenga, ku buryo ishobora guhabwa icyo kigo kikayiha amafaranga igatangira gukora. Perezida w’ishyirahamwe ry’abahanga n’inzobere mu bidukikije (RAPEP), Egide Nkuranga, yavuze ko rimaze igihe gito ritangiye ku buryo igikenewe kandi cyihutirwa ari guhugura abanyamuryango. Yagize ati “Icyihutirwa ni ukugira ngo abanyamuryango bahugurwe bari hamwe, cyane mu kazi dukora kugira ngo kavemo ireme rifatika[..] iyo mishinga iterwa inkunga n’icyo kigega tugiye guhugura, ni iteza imbere igihugu mu buryo bwo kurengera ibidukikije. Nitubikora neza, bizatuma ibyo igihugu cyateguye bigerwaho mu buryo bworoshye.” Aya mahugurwa y’iminsi ibiri yateguwe na REMA iafatanije na RAPEP, arahuza abahanga n’inzobere mu bidukikije basaga 50.

title: Météo Rwanda yabonye uburyo buyifasha kumenya amakuru y’ikirere buri segonda
content: Ubwo ku wa 23 Werurwe 2018 hizihizwaga umunsi mpuzamahanga wahariwe iteganyagihe, Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Météo Rwanda, John Ntaganda Semafara, yavuze ko ubusanzwe amakuru y’iteganyagihe aturuka kuri sitasiyo zo hirya no hino mu turere yajyaga aza atinze bigatuma no kuyasangiza abandi bitinda. Yagize ati “Ubu buryo buzatworohereza guhuza n’ibindi bigo by’iteganyagihe byo  ku rwego mpuzamahanga ndetse natwe bidufashe kubona ayo makuru hifashishijwe ibyuma kabuhariwe.” Yakomeje agira ati “ Mbere y’uko ubwo buryo buza, twabonaga amakuru aturuka kuri za sitasiyo zo hirya no hino mu Rwanda binyuze kuri email, none ubu tubasha kwakira no kohereza amakuru mu gihe gito kuko ni uburyo bwikoresha bidasabye umuntu.” Ubwo buryo bufasha mu gutanga amakuru y’ukuri kandi yihuse, agasesengurwa, akoherezwa mu bindi bigo vuba. Météo Rwanda ivuga ko yishimira kuba ifite imashini zigendanye n’igihe ku buryo bitakibatwara igihe bategereje amakuru; mbere byafataga ukwezi kose kugira ngo amakuru agere aho agomba kugera. Usibye ubwo buryo, Météo Rwanda itangaza ko ifite radar ifata amakuru y’ikirere cyose cy’u Rwanda, ikabasha kubona amakuru yihuse, yizewe kandi bigakorwa mu gihe gito. Gufata ibipimo by’imigwire y’imvura n’ubushyuhe mu Rwanda byatangiye ahayinga mu 1930, gusa ubupimiro bw’ibinyabihe (station) bwa mbere bwashyizweho n’abakoloni i Save mu 1906. Météo Rwanda itangaza ko kimwe no mu zindi nzego zitandukanye, urushinzwe ubumenyi bw’ikirere rwahungabanyijwe cyane na Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 bitewe n’uko ibikorwaremezo byarwo byasenywe ku kigero cya 80% hirya no hino mu gihugu. Nyuma ya Jenoside, urwo rwego rwariyubatse ndetse hanashakwa n’uburyo bwo kuziba icyuho cy’ibinyabihe byari byaratakajwe kuva mu 1994 kugeza 2009, hahuzwa ibya mbere yaho byafashwe n’ibyogajuru muri icyo gihe ku buryo ubu amakuru aboneka kandi akaba yizewe.

title: Frigo zisohora imyuka yangiza ikirere mu bitazongera kwinjira mu Rwanda guhera 2019
content: U Rwanda rwashyize umukono ku masezerano avuguruye ya Montréal yerekeye gukumira ibintu byangiza akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba mu 2016. Iteka rya Perezida No 143/01 ryo kuwa 13/04/2017 ryatangajwe mu Igazeti ya Leta ya Repubulika y’u Rwanda, kuwa 20 Mata 2017, ryategetse ko ahita atangira gukurikizwa. Aya mavugurura agamije ko ibinyabutabire bya Hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs), akenshi bituruka mu byuma bikonjesha nka za frigo, byacika burundu ku Isi, guhagarika ikora n’ikoreshwa ry’iyi myuka bikaba bishobora kugabanya dogere 0.5 ku gipimo mpuzandengo cy’izamuka ry’ubushyuhe bw’Isi mu myaka 100. Ubwo yari mu nama yiga ku buryo ibyo bizashyirwa mu bikorwa mu mwaka utaha, Minisitiri w’Ibidukikije, Dr Vincent Biruta, yavuze ko hagomba kurebwa uko ibyo bikoresho byangiza ikirere byasimburwa. Yagize ati “ Turi kureba uko ibyo bikoresho twifuza byaba biteye, turebe niba nubwo ari byiza ariko bitaba bihenze, tunarebe n’ubuziranenge bwabyo kugira ngo n’ugiye kubigura wese amenye icyo agiye gukora ndetse tworoshye n’uburyo bashobora kubibona.” Yavuze ko hazanarebwa uko bazakorana n’abacuruzi kugira ngo bizabashe kugezwa mu Rwanda kandi ku buryo buhendukiye abazaba bagomba kuzikoresha. Umuyobozi wa Porogaramu ifasha mu gushyira mu bikorwa ayo masezerano, Kigali Cooling Program, Kayitare Mauris, avuga ko ibikoresho bisanzwe biriho bitazakurwaho ariko kuva icyo gihe bikaba bitazongera kwinjizwa mu gihugu. Yasabye abaturage kurushaho kumva ibyiza byo gukoresha ibikoresho bifite ikoranabuhanga rituma bitangiza ikirere kuko ngo binatwara umuriro muke. Kugira ngo ayo masezerano atangire gukurikizwa byasabye ko nibura haba ibihugu 20 biyemeza burundu, kugeza ubu hamaze kuboneka ibihugu 28 byayemeje. Biteganyijwe ko mu 2019, buri gihugu cyayashyizeho umukono kikazaba cyarakoze gahunda yo kuba cyarashatse uko kizagenda gisimbura ibyo bikoresho, ari nako hajyaho uburyo bwo gukurikirana ko byubahiriza ibyo byiyemeje.

title: ‘Gatsibo Rice Company’ yatangiye gukora ibicanwa mu bishishwa by’umuceri byashoboraga kwangiza ibidukikije
content: Ubusanzwe ibishishwa byarundwaga hanze y’uruganda aho byari bimaze gukora ikimeze nk’umusozi bigatwara ubutaka bunini ndetse bikaba byazamo udukoko dushobora kubangamira abaturiye uruganda. Mu rwego rwo gukemura iki kibazo no gushaka amafaranga yunganira uruganda, ubuyobozi bwashoye imari mu gukora ibicanwa hubakwa uruganda rutunganya briquette mu mpera z’umwaka ushize. Umucungamutungo wa Gatsibo Rice Company, Mugisha Delphin, yagize ati “Dufite imisozi y’ibishishwa by’umuceri bidafite icyo byakoraga kandi hari uburyo bwo kubibyaza umusaruro. Ubuyobozi bw’uruganda bwatekereje kubaka uruganda mu mpera z’umwaka ushize, briquette za mbere zatangiye gukorwa muri Mutarama 2018.” Yakomeje agira ati “ Uko ibisigazwa by’umuceri bitinda bishobora kubora bikanuka hakaba hazamo udusimba tubangamiye abaruturiye, iyo bivuyeho bikajya gukoreshwa nk’ibicanwa, ibiti byatemwaga n’amakara byose bikagabanuka. Bifite umumaro ku ruganda no ku bidukikije muri rusange.” Mugisha yavuze ko hari inyigo yakozwe kugira ngo uruganda rwubakwe bikagaragara neza ko briquette zizacuruzwa bikinjiriza uruganda amafaranga. Kugeza ubu uruganda ntiruratangira kugurisha briquette n’abaturage kuko ruziranguza n’ibigo bifite ubushobozi burenze ubwabo icyakora mu minsi iri imbere na bo bazajya bazibona aho ngo ibiciro bizaba biciriritse ugereranyije n’uko amakara agura. Ubushakashatsi ku mibereho y’ingo bwakozwe ku nshuro ya kane mu Rwanda, bwagaragaje ko Abanyarwanda bagera kuri 83.3% bakoresha ibikomoka ku biti, ni ukuvuga inkwi n’amakara, nk’uburyo bw’ibanze bwo kubona ibicanwa; ibifatwa nk’icyonnyi gihangayikishije urwego rw’ibidukikije mu gihugu. Intara iza ku isonga ni iy’Amajyaruguru ifite abakoresha inkwi bagera kuri 94.4%, igakurikirwa n’iy’Amajyepfo ifite 92.6%, Intara y’Uburasirazuba ifite 89.9%, Intara y’Uburengerazuba ifite 88.3% naho Umujyi wa Kigali ukagira 25.6%. Abanyarwanda bakangurirwa gukoresha imbabura zirondereza ibicanwa, gas, biogas n’ibindi mu rwego rwo kurengera amashyamba kugeza ubu ari ku buso bugera kuri 29.6% mu gihugu hose. Uruganda ‘Gatsibo Rice Company’ rwakira hafi toni 4000 z’umuceri udatonoye mu gihe cy’umwero zivuye muri koperative ebyiri zikorana na rwo. Umuceri rwakira ni muke ugereranyije n’ubushobozi bwarwo kuko rimwe na rimwe ruhagarika ibikorwa iyo washize mu bubiko. Mu rwego rwo kongera ubuso buhingwaho umuceri ibishanga bitahingwaga bigenda bitunganywa dore ko hataraboneka ubushobozi bwo kuwuhinga imusozi.

title: Musanze: REMA yasabye abaturage  gukumira ibiza binyuze mu kubungabunga ibidukikije
content: Ubu butmwa bwatanzwe mu mahugurwa yateguwe na REMA, yahuje komite z’ibidukikije kuva ku rwego rw’Akagari kugeza ku Karere aho yari agamije kureba ibibazo bikigaragara mu kwangiza ibidukikije no gufata ingamba zo kubikumira. Bamwe mu bayitabiriye bemeza ko hari ibyo batasobanukirwaga bigatuma bangiza ibidukikije bibwira ko bashaka inyungu ariko ubu basobanukiwe neza uruhare rwabo mu kubyitaho. Ayinkamiye Pelagie ni umwe mu bari bitabiriye amahugurwa  yagize ati “Mu buhinzi twakoraga hari ibyo tutasobanukirwaga; nko mu Murenge wa Muko ku nkengero z’umugezi wa Mukungwa ntabwo twasigaga metero 10 zagenwe gusigara cyangwa tugahinga mu bishanga uko tubonye ariko ubu tumenye ko byangiza ibidukikije ikindi tumenye uruhare rwacu mu kubibungabunga natwe twirengera.” Umukozi ufite mu nshingano kurengera ibidukikije muri REMA, Ange Irutingabo yemeza ko mu bidukikije hakigaragaramo  ibibazo bituma bikomeza kwangirika ariyo mpamvu bakomeza gukora ubukangurambaga hirya no hino mu gihugu. Yagize ati “Mu bidukikije haracyarimo ibibazo byinshi bikomeje kubyangiza harimo, ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro bugikorwa mu kajagari, imisarane itujuje ubuziranenge, abahinga ku nkengero z’imigezi ntibasige metero 10 zagenwe, kandi ibi ni bimwe mu biteza Ibiza bya hato na hato. Niyo mpamvu dukora ubukangurambaga biciye mu mahugurwa  nk’aya kugira ngo buri wese amenye uruhare rwe mu kurengera ibidukikije.” Umukozi ushinzwe ibidukikije mu Karere ka Musanze, Ngwijingabo Hyacinthe yavuze  ko kurengera ibidukikije ari inshingano ya buri wese kuko bitabayeho umuntu ntiyabaho nyamara byo bishobora kubaho adahari kuko ni we ubyangiza.

title: Leta yatangiye umushinga wo guhindura amazi ya Nyabarongo urubogobogo
content: Umuyobozi w’Ishami rishinzwe Umutungo Kamere w’amazi mu Kigo gishinzwe Amazi n’Amashyamba,Tetero François, yatangaje ko hatangiye guterwa ubwatsi, amashyamba, imigano, hagacibwa n’amaterasi mu cyogogo cy’umugezi wa Nyabugogo kuko isuri imanukiramo ariyo iyitera gusa na nabi. Yabwiye itangazamakuru ko hari gukorwa igenamigambi ry’imicungire ya Nyabarongo kugira ngo mu minsi iri imbere izahinduke urubogobogo. Yagize ati “Turimo gukora igenamigambi ry’imicungire y’ikibaya cya Nyabarongo kuko kubungabunga umugezi nk’uyu bisaba kureba ahantu hose amazi atemba awinjiramo aho aturuka, tugashyiraho nk’ikarita igaragaza ahantu hose hangiritse n’ubuso bukeneye gukorwaho n’icyakorwa niba ari ahakwiye guterwa amashyamba cyangwa gukora amaterasi." Yakomeje avuga ko iryo genamigambi riri kunozwa kandi mu gihe kitarenze amazi abiri rizaba risojwe ariko bihaye intego yo kurishyira mu bikorwa mu gihe kitarenze imyaka itandatu. Mu bikorwa  byo kubungabunga Nyabarongo hanarimo imishinga y’ibikorwa  by’iterambere nko kubaka ingomero z’amashanyarazi, bigahindura imibereho y’abaturage. Ayabasore Erneste wo mu Kagari ka Matyazo, Umurenge wa Mushishiro, yagize ati “ Twabashije kubona amashanyarazi mu gihe mu myaka yashize ntayo twagiraga njye ubwanjye nanabonyemo akazi nkuramo ibihumbi 100 Frw. Ikindi kandi tutarakorerwa amaterasi  imvura yaragwagwa ubutaka bukirukanka bwose na ya myaka wahize mugasanga iragiye ariko ubu ntikigenda.” Ku nkunga ya Ambasade y’u Buholandi mu Rwanda binyuze muri Water for Growth hamaze gukorwa amaterasi kuri hegitari zigera ku 1000 ziherereye mu turere twa Muhanga na Ngororero mu rwego rw’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’imirimo yo kubungabunga Nyabarongo. Water for Growth Rwanda ni umushinga Leta y’u Rwanda ifatanyije  n’u Buholandi ukaba ugamije kunoza imicungire n’imikoreshereze y’umutungo kamere w’amazi mu Rwanda. Uyu mushinga ugenzurwa na Leta y’u Rwanda binyuze mu Kigo gishinzwe Amazi n’Amashyamba (RWFA) ugaterwa inkunga na Ambasade y’u Buholandi mu Rwanda.

title: Icyo REMA isaba abaturage mu bihe by’imvura n’ibiza
content:
Muri ibi bihe by’imvura hari kugaragara abaturage bahuye n’ingaruka z’ibiza nk’imyaka mu murima itwarwa n’isuri, inzu zihirima, abantu bapfa n’ibindi bibazo bitandukanye. REMA ivuga ko abaturage bitaye ku bidukikije bakabibungabunga waba umuti urambye wo kwirinda ibiza no kubica intege. Iki kigo kiri muri gahunda yo kongerera ubumenyi abagize komite z’ibidukikije ku rwego rw’umurenge n’akarere bujyane no kwita ku bidukikije kugira ngo babitoze abaturage umunsi ku wundi. Ku itariki ya 8 n’iya 9 Werurwe 2018 cyahuguye abo mu Karere ka Huye nyuma y’iminsi ibiri kivuye muri Gisagara. Umukozi muri REMA ushinzwe ubukangurambaga no kwinjiza ibidukikije muri gahunda z’iterambere, Nsanzimana Djuma, yasabye komite z’ibidukikije gukangurira abaturage gushyira ingufu mu kwita ku bidukikije no kubibungabunga nk’uburyo burambye bwo kwirinda ibiza. Yagize ati “Ibidukikije ni urwego rugira imbogamizi zihoraho, uyu munsi dushobora kuba dufite ibibazo by’izuba ubundi tukagira imvura nyinshi, twebwe icyo tugamije ni ugutoza abaturage kwita ku bidukije no kubibungabunga kugira ngo birinde ibiza kuko iyo byaje bibateza ibibazo. Turi guhugura abagize komite z’ibidukikije ku nzego z’ibanze kugira ngo badufashe kwigisha abaturage”. Nsanzimana avuga ko mu bikwiye gushyirwamo ingufu harimo guca amaterasi y’indinganire hirindwa isuri, gutera ibiti birimo n’ibivangwa n’imyaka, guca imirwanyasuri, kwirinda gutura mu manegeka, kudahinga hafi y’imigezi, kubungabunga ibishanga n’ibindi. Abagize komite z’ibidukikije bahuguwe bavuga ko ubumenyi bahawe bagiye kububyaza umusaruro bigisha baturage kandi  bagafatikanya na bo mu kwita ku bidukikije, cyane cyane bibanda ku miterere y’agace batuyemo. Mu minsi ishize kuwa 3 Werurwe 2018, imvura y’umurindi yaguye mu Karere Ka Rubavu, iteza umwuzure, umugezi wa Sebeya usenya inzu 26, izindi zirenga 900 zinjirwamo n’amazi ku buryo abari batuyemo bagiye gucumbikirwa mu baturanyi.
REMA ivuga ko gahunda yo kwigisha komite z’ibidukikije izakomereza no mu tundi turere. [email protected]

title: U Rwanda rwahawe miliyoni 32.8$ zo guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe
content: Uyu mushinga uzabarizwa mu kigega gitera inkunga imishinga yita ku bidukikije mu Rwanda (Fonerwa), ugamije gutunganya igishanga cya Muvumba, kongera ubushobozi bw’abaturage mu gutunganya amashyamba ndetse no gufasha abahinzi bato gukora ubuhinzi buhangana n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe. Uzakorera mu mirenge icyenda y’Akarere ka Gicumbi ari yo  Kaniga, Rubaya, Cyumba, Rushaki, Shangasha, Mukarange, Manyagiro, Byumba na Bwisige. Uzafasha abatuye ahantu haba inkangu n’imyuzure gutura mu buryo buhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe kandi wite ku baturage bakennye cyane badafite ubushobozi. Abaturage bazigishwa uburyo burambye bwo kubungabunga amashyamba, imiturire igezweho, uburyo bwo gutunganya ibishanga n’ibindi, hanyuma buzajye no gukoreshwa mu gihugu hose. Biteganyijwe  ko mu myaka itandatu uyu mushinga uzafasha abaturage kugabanya imyuka ihumanya (CO2), ingana na toni 273,720. Uzagera ku baturage 150,000 ugirire akamaro abarenga 380,000 muri rusange. Uretse izi miliyoni 32.8 z’amadolari, Ikigega cyo kubungabunga ibidukikije mu Rwanda (RGF), kizatangamo ibihumbi 147 z’amadolari ndetse n’Akarere ka Gicumbi gatange ibihumbi 107 $ naho umuryango  ‘The Wood Foundation’  utange 105,964 $.

title: Umuyobozi muri Ambasade y’u Budage yavuze ingorane yahuye nazo  ubwo Nyabarongo yafungaga umuhanda
content: Mandy Hupfer yitabiriye inama yahuje Transparency International Rwanda n’izindi nzego zitandukanye ziga  ku mihindagurikire y’ibihe. Muri Gicurasi 2016, imvura nyinshi yaguye mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru, yatumye imihanda ihuza intara zitandukanye ifungwa by’agateganyo kubera amazi menshi n’inkangu byuzuye muri kaburimbo. Ibi byatumye abagenzi baturukaga mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo batabasha kugera mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Mandy avuga ko icyo gihe umugezi wa Nyabarongo wuzuraga yari mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo na bagenzi be. Mu gihe bari mu nzira bataha i Kigali, abapolisi bacunga umutekano wo mu muhanda ngo barabahagaritse, bababwira ko bidashoka kuko Nyabarongo yari yuzuye. Babagiriye inama yo kunyura mu muhanda uhuza Intara y’Amajyepfo n’Akarere ka Bugesera; gusa ngo kuko batari bazi uko uwo muhanda umeze,   byabaye ngombwa ko bigira inama yo gukoresha uwa Muhanga-Ngororero-Mukamira-Musanze. Uyu muyobozi avuga ko bageze i Musanze  saa munani z’igicuku, bitegura kugana i Kigali, na none abapolisi bongeye kubahagarika, bababwira ko uwo muhanda utari nyabagerwa bitewe n’uko hari inkangu yari yafunze umuhanda mu Karere ka Gakenke. Abapolisi  babagiriye inama yo guca mu Karere ka Burera ku buryo bari kunyura i Rulindo bakagera i Kigali. Mandy na bagenzi be   baraye i Musanze kuko basanze muri bose uwo muhanda batawuzi  kandi batari bizeye ko waba umeze neza. Bukeye bigira inama yo kwambukira ku mupaka wa Cyanika uhuza u Rwanda na Uganda, banyura Kisoro na Kabale barazenguruka bagera ku mupaka wa Gatuna, bafata inzira iberekeza i Kigali. Uyu muyobozi yabwiye abitabiriye inama ko izo ari ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe, avuga ko bikwiye ko abantu bumva ko guhangana na yo ari ingenzi. Yashimiye Guverinoma y’u Rwanda kuko mu bihugu byo mu karere iza imbere mu gushyiraho ingamba ndetse no guhangana n’icyo kibazo. Minisitiri w’Ibidukikije, Dr Biruta Vincent, avuga ko   guhangana n’iki kibazo  bigomba guhoraho mu buzima bwa buri munsi. Yagize ati “Guhangana n’ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe ntabwo ari ikintu tuzavuga ngo tugeze kuri 80% cyangwa 100% kuko ni imihindagurikire y’ibihe nyine, bihoraho buri munsi bigenda bihinduka buri munsi ariko kubaka ubudahangarwa ku mihindagurikire y’ibihe navuga ko hari byinshi bimaze gukorwa. Dufite ingamba, amategeko ndetse n’ikigega nka FONERWA gitera inkunga imishinga igamije guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe.” Ashimangira ko guhagana na byo bigomba no kujya mu bindi bikorwa birimo ibikorwaremezo byujuje ibyangombwa. title: TIR ivuga ko Leta yubakiye ‘biogaz’ abaturage  itababajije zibapfira ubusa
content: Ibi byatangarijwe mu ishyirwa hanze ry’icyegeranyo uyu muryango wakoreye mu turere tune ari two Karongi, Musanze, Nyanza na Rwamagana, kivuga ku mishinga yashyizwemo amafaranga menshi igamije guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe. Muri iyo mishinga harimo iyo kubakira abaturage za Biogaz, za rondereza, kubaha amashanyarazi akomoka ku mirasire y’izuba n’ibindi. TIR ivuga ko hari abaturage benshi baganiriye na yo bayigaragarije ko za biogaz bahawe ntacyo zibamariye, aho ngo mbere yo kuzubakirwa batigeze bigishwa uburyo zikoreshwa ndetse n’ibyo zigamije gukemura. Nubwo hatatangajwe mu mibare abaturage bubakiwe ibyo bikorwaremezo, icyegeranyo kivuga ko ababajijwe bagera ku 1600 mu turere,  63,4% basubije ko batigeze babazwa mbere y’uko bashyirwa muri iyo mishinga. Na ho abagera kuri 70.8% bakavuga ko batazi uwo babaza amakuru igihe bahuye n’ikibazo. Umuyobozi wa TIR, Ingabire Marie Immaculée, yavuze ko biba bikwiye ko abaturage bagira uruhare mu bibakorerwa,  cyane ko iyi mishinga irimo amafaranga menshi. Yagize ati “N’inzego z’ibanze zikwiye kubigiramo uruhare, gufasha abaturage kubumvisha ko biriya bintu ari ibyabo mbere y’uko biba iby’undi wese, kuko buriya bagiye kububakira nk’ariya maziko ya rondereza  cyangwa biogaz haba hakwiye kubaho abantu bahatuye bahugurwa ku buryo bwo gufata neza biriya bikoresho n’uburyo bashobora kubisana byangiritse. Kuko ntabwo byumvikana ko iziko ryameneka ngo bavuge ngo bategereje umutekinisiye warishyizeho ngo ni we uzagaruka kubikora.” Ashimangira ko igitekerezo cyo gushyiraho iyi mishinga ubwacyo ari cyiza, gusa ngo kugishyira mu bikorwa kwayo haracyarimo ibibazo by’ingutu birimo no kuba abagerwabikorwa badakurikiranwa ngo harebwe niba ibyo bahawe bikora uko bikwiye. Abaturage bahawe biogaz ngo banahawe n’inka kugira ngo bazajye babona amase abasha gutuma biogaz bahawe zikora, ariko ngo ntizigikora. Iyi mishinga inyura mu kigega FONERWA gishinzwe kurengera ibidukikije no guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe. Minisitiri w’Ibidukikije, Dr Biruta Vincent, avuga ko ubundi umushinga wose ugenewe abaturage baba bakwiye kuwugiramo uruhare, bakagaragaza icyo bakeneye n’ikibazo bashaka ko cyakemuka. Ati “Iyo haje raporo nk’iyi ngiyi, iba ikubwira ngo  n’ubwo bikorwa bwose ntabwo bihagije, hagomba kurebwa uburyo ubutaha byazakorwa kurushaho. Ni inkunga ikomeye iturutse muri raporo nk’iyi.” Mu mishinga itandukanye yo kubungabunga imihindagurikire y’ibihe, mu mwaka wa 2009 u Rwanda rwakoresheje miliyoni 15$, muri 2013 rukoresha miliyoni 279$ na ho muri 2016 rukoresha miliyoni 415$.

title: Abashakashatsi ba Kaminuza ya Birmingham bagiye gufasha Abanyarwanda kwirinda umwotsi uterwa n’inkwi
content: Ubu bushakashatsi buribanda cyane ku kureba ingaruka z’ubuzima ababyeyi n’abana bahura na zo kubera gucana ibintu bibyara imyotsi ihumanya ikirere. Bugamije kandi gushaka uburyo bushya bwo guhangana n’umwuka uhumanya ikirere, gukusanya impamvu zibitera, ingaruka n’urwego biriho mu mijyi ya Afurika. Dr Kabera Telesphore wo muri Kaminuza y’u Rwanda mu ishami ry’ubumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga (CST) afatanyije na Dr Suzanne Bartington  wo muri Kaminuza ya Brimingham, barimo gukora ubushakashatsi buzamara imyaka ibiri, bukazakusanya imibare ku gipimo imyotsi yo mu gikoni yanduza n’impamvu imiryango y’abanyarwanda batekesha inkwi. Iyi gahunda inagamije gushaka inkunga yo gukora uburyo bushya bw’amashyiga azagabanya imyotsi ihumanya ikirere no guhindura imyumvire y’abaturage binyuze mu bukangurambaga bwo kubigisha gutekesha gazi n’ibindi bitari inkwi. Dr Bartington avuga ko gutekesha amakara ari ibisanzwe mu Rwanda ariko hari amakuru make ku mibare y’ingo ziyakoresha n’ingaruka bigira ku bana n’ababyeyi. Yagize ati“Amakara ni kimwe mu byo gutekesha bibi kubera ibigize umwotsi uyakomokaho. Turagerageza gusuzuma ubukana bw’ikibazo n’imyumvire ishingiye ku muco mu bijyanye no guteka.” Akomeza avuga ko abagore benshi bamara amasaha menshi bari kumwe n’abana babo mu bikoni bidafite ahinjirira umwuka, akaba ari yo mpamvu barimo gushaka igisubizo. Yagize ati “Turashaka gukora amashyiga meza, akorewe mu gihugu bikagendana no kwigisha kandi bizagabanya abagerwagaho n’imyotsi batetse.” Ibi biri mu murongo w’igihugu cy’u Rwanda kirimo kwihuta mu iterambere, impinduka mu mibereho y’abaturage n’iterambere ry’imijyi. Dr Bartington mu minsi ishize yaje mu Rwanda gutangiza uwo mushinga w’ubushakashatsi azafatanya na UR-CST. Afite umugambi wo guteza imbere ubushakashatsi bw’imbere mu gihugu no kubaka ubushobozi bw’abanyeshuri biga ibijyanye n’ibidukikije.

title: Asaga miliyoni 2.5 $ agiye kwifashishwa mu guhangana n’ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe mu Rwanda
content: Ibikorwa bya RCCDN bizibandwaho ni ugufata neza ibidukikije, kuhira imyaka, gutera amashyamba,  gufata amazi y’imvura, guha abaturage amakuru ajyanye n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe ku gihe; babifashijwemo n’izo miliyoni 2.8 $. Umuyobozi w’iri huriro, Rwibasira Eugène, yavuze ko imihindagurikire y’ibihe  ari ikibazo gihangayikishije u Rwanda n’Isi. Yagize ati “Imihindagurikire y’ibihe ni ikibazo kidafite umupaka kandi si umwihariko w’u Rwanda ahubwo ni ikibazo cy’Isi. Ntitwavuga ngo kirarangira uyu munsi ahubwo turashaka kureba uburyo twahangana nacyo twibanda cyane ku gukumira kugira ngo bitazatugiraho ingaruka z’ikirenga.” Yakomeje avuga ko mu gihe cy’imyaka itanu biyemeje kuzakora ibikorwa bitandukanye. Ati “Tuzakora ibikorwa byo kubaka ubushobozi bw’abaturage mu bijyanye n’uburyo bamenya amakuru ajyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe, tuzubaka ibikorwaremezo, tuzashyira imbaraga muri gahunda yo kuhira imyaka, hazaterwa amashyamba hirya no hino, tuzarushaho gushishikariza abanyarwanda gufata neza ibidukikije.” Umuyobozi mukuru muri Minisiteri y’ibidukikije, ushinzwe ibidukikije n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe, Kabera Juliette, yavuze ko imihindagurikire y’ibihe ari kimwe mu bibazo byugarije u Rwanda. Yagize ati “Ubukungu bw’u Rwanda bushingiye cyane ku buhinzi n’ubworozi, kubera ihindagurika ry’ibihe imvura isigaye igwa ari nyinshi cyane cyangwa ikabura hakava izuba ryinshi noneho abahinzi bahinga imyaka ikarumba cyangwa imyuzure ikaza ikangiza ibintu byinshi. Twishimiye cyane rero ko iri huriro rigiye gufasha Leta guhangana n’izi ngaruka.” Yashimye cyane ko mu byo iri huriro rizakora harimo gufasha abahinzi guhindura imyumvire bakajya bahinga bakurikije amakuru y’iteganyagihe, badashingiye gusa ku makuru bari basanganywe yo kumenya ngo mu kwezi uku n’uku ni igihe cy’ihinga. Imvura nyinshi, inkuba, imyuzure n’amapfa ni bimwe mu biza byagize ingaruka zikomeye ku banyarwanda mu mwaka wa 2017 ndetse binatwara ubuzima bw’abagera kuri 82 mu gihe abandi 151 bakomeretse. Ibyangiritse byose hamwe bifite agaciro kabarirwa muri miliyari 6.7 Frw. Ihuriro  RCCDN rivuga ko rigiye gufasha leta mu guhangana n’ibi biza biteza igihombo bikanatwara ubuzima bw’abaturage.
