title: Arboretum ya Kaminuza yashyizwe mu mushinga wa Commonwealth ugamije kubungabunga amashyamba
content: Inama y’abaminisitiri yo ku wa 14 Gashyantare 2018,ni yo yafashe iki cyemezo. Uyu mushinga watangijwe ku mugaragaro mu nama y’abakuru b’ibihugu na za guverinoma zihuriye mu muryango w’ibihugu bikoresha ururimi rw’Icyongereza (Commonwealth),yabereye muri Malta mu 2015. Ni urubuga rwo guhuza imbaraga n’ubumenyi mu byo kubungabunga amashyamba, ibihugu byose bigize uyu muryango uko ari 53 bihuriyeho nk’uko bisobanurwa ku rubuga rwa internet rw’uyu mushinga. Arboretum ikikije Kaminuza y’u Rwanda, ishami rya Huye, igizwe n’ibimera, ibiti by’ishyamba n’ibindi byo mu bwoko butandukanye byatewe ahagana mu 1933 ndetse icumbikiye inyamaswa zirimo inkende, ingeragere, inyoni n’utundi dusimba. Umuyobozi ushinze amashyamba no kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima mu Kigo cy’Igihugu Gishinzwe Umutungokamere,  Jean Pierre Mugabo, yabwiye KT Press ko iyo ishyamba ryinjijwe muri uyu mushinga rirushaho kumenyekana kimwe n’amashyamba yose yo mu gihugu riherereyemo. Yagize ati “ Twatoranyije Arboretum kubera ko ikorerwamo ubushakashatsi ku bijyanye n’amashyamba mu gihugu.” Mugabo yavuze ko Arboretum nimara kwinjizwa muri uyu mushinga u Rwanda ruzungukiramo ibirimo no kujya rubona imbuto nziza z’ibiti. Yagize ati “ Bizadufasha kubungabunga amashyamba bijyanye n’ibyo Commonwealth igenderaho no kubona imbuto nziza.” U Rwanda kandi ruzaba ruhawe ububasha bwo gukoresha urubuga rwa Commonwealth mu gusangira ubumenyi n’ibindi bihugu mu bijyanye n’uburyo bwiza bwo kwita ku mashyamba no guhanga ibishya muri urwo rwego n’ibindi. Kugira ngo ishyamba ryemererwe kwinjira mu mushinga ‘Queen’s Commonwealth Canopy Projet’bisaba ko urwego rwa leta rufite mu nshingano amashyamba rugaragaza gahunda yo kuyabungabunga mu buryo burambye ndetse ko abaturage bazinjizwa mu micungire yawo. Amafoto: KT Press

title: Abaturiye Pariki ya Nyungwe biyemeje gucika ku ngeso yo gushimuta inyamaswa
content: Uturere twa Rusizi na Nyamasheke, ni tumwe muri dutanu dukora kuri Pariki ya Nyungwe, aho abayituriye muri utwo turere bavuga ko mbere bashimutaga inyamanswa ariko ntacyo bakuyemo akaba ari yo mpamvu barabiretse kubera ko icyo bajyaga gushakamo basigaye bakibona binyuze mu bikorwa n’imishinga bakora bagaterwa inkunga. Ngendabanyika Ernest ati "Nigeze kujya ntega inyamaswa; ntacyo nakuyemo kuko ibyo umuntu ahiga agenda abirya nk’aho atabikoreye. Ibintu bikugirira akamaro ni ibyo wavunikiye, ukabicunga neza kuko byakuvunnye, icyatumye mbireka namaze kumenya agaciro ka Pariki ya Nyungwe, nsanga amafaranga ryinjiza ntayabona bituma ndeka ishyamba ry’abandi ariko kuri ubu mbona inyungu nk’amashuri abana banjye bigamo ndetse twatewe inkunga, turi abavumvu." Nyirabagirishya Seraphine ati " Navuye mu ishyamba ngerageza kwiteza imbere, twateguye imishinga bagiye kuduha inkunga tugure amatungo magufi noneho mu gihe nifuza inyama sinzajya mu ishyamba kuko mfite ihene izaba yarungutse ubundi ngure akanyama." Mbabazi Marie Louise ushinzwe guhuza Pariki z’Igihugu n’abaturage bazituriye mu Kigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe iterambere, RDB, avuga ko imibare y’abangiza Pariki ya Nyungwe, yagabanutse ku kigereranyo cya 85%, kubera ko imyumvire y’abayituriye yahindutse bitewe n’inyungu babona mu mafaranga ava mu bukerarugendo akagaruka kubateza imbere mu bikorwa bitandukanye by’amakoperative bibumbiyemo. Ati "Abangizaga pariki babaga ari abaturage baturiye hariya; kubera ko habayeho ubukangurambaga kugira ngo babakundishe ibirimo n’amafaranga avamo kuko na bo bagira uburenganzira bwo kugira ayo bafataho noneho aho kujya kwangiza pariki bakagenda babireka na bariya twahuguye barimo abangizaga pariki. Nkurikije uko mbibona hano muri Nyungwe 85% bateye imbere abasigaye turimo turabigisha." Pariki ya Nyungwe isurwa n’abarenga gato ibihumbi 13 ku mwaka. [email protected]

title: U Rwanda rwahawe inkunga ya miliyari 3 Frw azifashishwa mu gutera amashyamba
content: Iyi nkunga yatanzwe n’ikigega cyo mu bihugu bya Danemark, Finlande, Islande, Norvège na Suède (NDF), gitera inkunga imishinga igamije guteza imbere ibidukikije, ikazifashishwa mu gushyira mu bikorwa umushinga ugamije guteza imbere ibicanwa bikomoka ku biti. Iyi nkunga ya NDF izahabwa u Rwanda inyuze muri Banki y’Isi, ikaba iziyongera ku bikorwa by’Umushinga ugamije kugarura ishusho kamere y’Amashyamba no kuyabungabunga (LAFREC) usanzwe ushyirwa mu bikorwa n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cyo kubungabunga ibidukikije (REMA). REMA yatangaje ko bimwe mu bikorwa bizaterwa inkunga binyuze muri uwo mushinga mushya harimo kuvugurura no gutera amashyamba mashya, kongera ubuziranenge bw’imbuto z’amashyamba, guteza imbere imikoreshereze myiza y’ibicanwa bituruka ku biti ndetse no gukwirakwiza uburyo bushya bwo gutanga ingufu zifashishwa mu nganda z’icyayi no mu ngo. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa REMA, Eng.Coletha Ruhamya, yavuze ko uwo mushinga uzanagira uruhare mu guteza imbere ubuhinzi buvuguruye bw’amashyamba bikazibanda mu bice bikikije Pariki y’Igihugu ya Gishwati-Mukura. Yagize ati “Uzateza imbere amashyamba ndetse n’abayafite muri utwo duce bazareba uko bayacunga neza; hakazabamo no kwigisha abakora amakara bakazayakora neza kandi bikazabaha umusaruro uhagije, ukazanunganira ukuntu twakora indi nyigo yatuma tubona ibisimbura ibicanwa bitari ibikomoka ku biti.” Umuyobozi wari uhagarariye NDF, Martina Jagerhorn, yavuze ko bahisemo gutera inkunga u Rwanda mu kurufasha guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere. Yagize ati “Tumaze iminsi twiga ku mihindagurikire y’ikirere mu Rwanda, ngo turebe icyakorwa kugira ngo rugire ubudahangarwa, dushingiye rero ku bikorwa bya LAFREC tuzakomeza gushyigikira u Rwanda mu guhangana n’ihindagurika ry’ikirere.” Biteganyijwe ko uyu mushinga uzanafasha mu kongerera ubushobozi amakoperative atunganya, akanacuruza amakara mu rwego rwo kuyafasha kurushaho  kuyakora mu buryo burambye, kongera ubuziranenge n’ubwiza bw’amakara ndetse no gushaka amasoko. Ibindi bikorwa birimo kongerera ubushobozi Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Imbuto z’amashyamba   ndetse no gufasha inganda zitunganya icyayi n’abandi baturage kubona ibindi bicanwa bitangiza ibidukikije, bakwifashisha mu mirimo yabo ya buri munsi. Uyu musnhinga utangiye mu 2018 uzasoza ibikorwa byawo mu 2019.

title: Amateka ya Misa ya Papa mu Rwanda, kimwe mu bizaba bigize Pariki  y’i Nyandungu
content: Muri  iyo minsi nibwo  uwari umushumba wa Kiliziya Gatolika ku Isi, Papa Yohani Pwaulo II yagendereye u Rwanda, akahatanga ubutumwa butandukanye, anasura ibikorwa bitandukanye. Nubwo ari uruzinduko rw’amateka, uretse amasuka ari ku Kamonyi, nta handi wabona byoroshye urwibutso rw’ayo mateka. Icyakora, mu minsi mike ayo mateka azaba ashobora kuboneka cyane cyane  ajyanye na Misa Papa yasomeye mu gishanga cya Nyandungu mu mujyi wa Kigali, ku cyumweru tariki ya 9 Nzeri 1990 habura amasaha make ngo asoze uruzinduko rwe. Ayo mateka azaba agaragara mu busitani bwitiriwe Papa (Pope Garden) buzaba ari kimwe mu bigize Pariki y’Ubukerarugendo  bubungabunga ibidukikije (Nyandungu Eco-Tourism Park)  iri gutunganywa mu gishanga cya Nyandungu gikora ku Karere ka Gasabo na Kicukiro. Umushinga wa miliyari 2.4 Frw wo kubaka iyo pariki  watangiye umwaka ushize, bikaba biteganyijwe ko  uzaba warangiye mu myaka ibiri. Umuyobozi w’ibikorwa mu Kigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe kubungabunga ibidukikije (REMA) , Umugwaneza Janet ubwo yasobanuraga ibijyanye n’uwo mushinga kuri uyu wa Gatanu hizihizwa Umunsi mpuzamahanga wahariwe ibishanga, yavuze ko amateka ajyanye n’uruzinduko rwa Papa mu Rwanda azaba agaragara muri iyo Pariki. Yagize ati “Mu mwaka  wa 1990 Papa muzi ko yaje mu Rwanda.Hari misa yasomeye hano, ayo ni amateka rero , turashaka ko ayo mateka ahaguma. Muri iyi  pariki rero hazaba harimo igice cyitiriwe ubusitani bwa Papa.” Mugwaneza yavuze ko bari kuganira n’Ubuyobozi bwa Kiliziya Gatolika mu Rwanda kugira ngo ubwo busitani  buzabe burimo amakuru ahagije ya Misa Papa Yohani Pawulo II yasomeye muri icyo gishanga. Iki gishanga cya hegitari 134, kiri gutunganywa kugira ngo gisubirane umwimerere wacyo no kubungabunga urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Kizaba kirimo ibikorwa bitandukanye nk’ibiyaga bito, ibyatsi n’ibiti bihabereye, uburyo bwo gufata amazi  ava ku misozi no kuyayungurura n’ibindi. Umuyobozi Mukuru Wungirije wa REMA, Munyazikwiye Faustin yavuze ko ibikorwa byari byubatse muri icyo gishanga byatangiye kwimurwa, abatarabyimura na bo bakaba barahawe igihe ngo babe babirangije. Yavuze ko ari umushinga witezweho inyungu nyinshi haba mu kubungabunga ibidukikije ndetse no mu iterambere ry’igihugu. Yagize ati “Hazashyirwaho uburyo bw’inzira z’amazi kandi  buzaba burimo n’ibimera bisanzwe biranga igishanga nk’urukangaga, kugira ngo bibashe gukora za nshingano igishanga cyari gifite zo kudufasha gufata amazi no kuyayungurura. Uyu mushinga uzanadufasha no mu iterambere ry’igihugu kuko ntitugomba kubungabunga ibidukikije gusa ahubwo bigomba no kudufasha mu iterambere.” Ibikorwa nyaburanga bizashyirwa mu gishanga cya Nyandungu  biri mu bya mbere byo ku rwego rwisumbuye bigiye kubakwa mu gihugu habungwabungwa urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima. Uyu mushinga biteganyijwe ko ushobora kuzinjiza miliyari y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda y’inyungu mu myaka 12,  ni ukuvuga miliyoni zisaga 83 buri mwaka. Uri gukorwa  ku bufatanye n’Ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Gasabo mu Murenge wa Ndera n’aka Kicukiro muri Nyarugunga, Umujyi wa Kigali ndetse n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere, RDB, ugaterwa inkunga  n’Ikigega cy’Igihugu cy’Ibidukikije n’Imihindagurikire y’Ibihe, FONERWA.

title: Polisi y’u Rwanda igiye gutera ibiti ku buso burenga hegitari 50
content: Ibi bikaba biri no muri gahunda yo gushyira mu bikorwa amasezerano y’ubufatanye Polisi y’u Rwanda yasinyanye na Minisiteri y’Ubutaka n’Amashyamba mu Ugushyingo umwaka ushize, agamije kwita no kubungabunga ibidukikije n’amashyamba. Umuyobozi w’Ishami rishinzwe guhuza ibikorwa bya Polisi n’iby’abaturage hagamijwe gukumira no kwirinda ibyaha (Community Policing department) muri Polisi y’u Rwanda Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) Damas Gatare yavuze ko muri rusange bateganya kuzatera amashyamba mashya no gusimbuza ashaje kuri hegitari 4960 naho ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka bakazabitera kuri hegitari 45803. Yagize ati”Gutera amashyamba no gusimbuza ashaje ni igikorwa cyo kurengera ubuzima bw’abaturage kandi Polisi y’u Rwanda igomba kubigiramo uruhare rugaragara kugira ngo irinde abanyarwanda ibiza birimo amapfa, inkangu isuri n’imyuzure kuko ibi byose bigira ingaruka ku buzima bw’abaturage zirimo urupfu mu gihe cy’amapfa cyangwa cy’inkangu n’imyuzure.” ACP Gatare yavuze ko umwaka ushize mu gihugu hose amashyamba yatewe kuri hegitari 704 997, zingana na 29.6% za hegitari zose zigomba kuba ziteweho amashyamba. Yakomeje agira ati ”Muri iyi myaka ibiri buri Ntara ifite ubuso izateraho ibiti aho Intara y’Iburasirazuba izatera hegitari 14744, Intara y’Amajyaruguru itere kuri hegitari 8415, Iburengerazuba batere hegitari 9484, Intara y’Amajyepfo izatera hegitari 26035, na ho mu Mujyi wa Kigali bazatera hegitari 2085.” Mu gutera aya mashyamba Polisi izafatanya na Minisiteri y’Ubutaka n’Amashyamba, Ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe kurengera ibidukikije (REMA), uturere, urubyiruko rw’abakorerabushake mu gukumira ibyaha, (Rwanda youth Volunteers in Community Policing -RYVCP) n’abaturage muri rusange. Mu mwaka wa 2015, Polisi y’u Rwanda yasinyanye amasezerano n’uturere twose tw’u Rwanda uko ari 30, akaba agamije ubufatanye mu kubungabunga ibidukikije harimo no gutera amashyamba mashya no gufata neza asanzwe. Kuva Polisi y’u Rwanda yasinyana amasezerano y’ubufatanye na Minisiteri y’Ubutaka n’Amashyamba mu Ugushyingo umwaka ushize, Polisi ifatanyije n’urubyiruko rw’abakorerabushake mu gukumira ibyaha bamaze gutera ibiti birenga 125, 500 mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu. Ibi byatewe bikaba byiyongera ku bindi byatewe na Polisi y’u Rwanda mu gihugu hose kuri hegitari zirenga 300 mu myaka ishize. Mu rwego rwo kurengera ibidukikije no gutera ibiti, urubyiruko rw’abakorerabushake mu gukumira ibyaha rurenga 230 000, buri wa Gatandatu wa kabiri w’ukwezi rwihaye gahunda yo gukora umuganda mu bikorwa byinshi bakora kuri uwo munsi hakaba hanarimo gutera ibiti.

title: Meteo Rwanda yasobanuye iby’imvura idasanzwe imaze iminsi igwa
content: Icyakora, icyatangaje kinatungura benshi ni imvura yatangiye kugwa kuwa 31 Ukuboza 2017 ikageza mu gitondo cyo kuwa 1 Mutarama 2018, ikagwa mu bice byinshi by’igihugu ndetse ikanakomeza kugwa no mu yindi minsi yakurikiyeho. Mu itangazo Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Iteganyagihe (Meteo Rwanda) cyasohoye, cyatangaje ko iyo mvura idasanzwe yatewe n’ubwiyongere bw’ubushyuhe mu Nyanja y’u Buhinde. Rigira giti “Ibi bihe by’imvura biraterwa no kwiyongera k’ubushyuhe mu Nyanja y’u Buhinde. Byatumye havuka inkubi y’umuyaga bituma kandi mu Karere u Rwanda ruherereyemo higanza isangano ry’imiyaga binongera ubuhehere bw’umwuka ari nabyo bitera kugusha imvura itari imenyerewe muri Mutarama.” Meteo ikomeza ivuga ko ubwo bushyuhe bwo mu nyanja buzaba bwagabanyutse guhera tariki 7 Mutarama 2017, ibihe bigasubira uko byari bisanzwe. Iki kigo cyongeyeho ko igihembwe cy’ihinga A kiri ku musozo, bivuze ko imvura y’Umuhindo iri kugenda iba nkeya, gisaba Abanyarwanda bireba gufata ingamba zikwiriye. Ubusanzwe ukwezi kwa Mutarama kubonekamo  imvura nkeya  kuko kuba gusatira  Gashyantare ibonekamo izuba ryinshi.

title: Ubushakashatsi bwerekanye ko niba ntagikozwe 25% by’ubutaka bw’Isi buzuma mu myaka 30
content: Ivuga ko imbaraga zo kugabanya ubushyuhe kugera kuri dogere 1.5 nkuko byemejwe mu nama ya Paris, zizarengera nibura bibiri bya gatatu by’ubuso bwagombaga kuma. Iyi nyigo inagaragaza ko ibice by’ingenzi bituwe n’abantu bishobora kwibasirwa birimo u Burayi bw’Amajyepfo, Afurika y’Amajyepfo, Amerika yo Hagati, Aziya y’Amajyepfo na Australia. Amasezerano ya Montreal yerekeye imyuka yangiza akayunguruzo k’izuba yemerejwe i Kigali, ni imwe mu ntambwe ikomeye Isi yateye mu rwego rwo kurwanya ingaruka nk’izi. Ku rundi ruhande ariko ubushakashatsi buvuga ko nta cyagerwaho  ibihugu bidashyize imbaraga mu kubahiriza aya masezerano. Gusa nubwo ibihugu bikangurirwa kugabanya ibyuka byangiza akayunguruzo k’izuba, Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika zamaze gukuramo akarenge, nyamara Abanyamerika bafite ibipimo byinshi by’ibyuka byanduza ikirere (Carbone Dioxide) kurusha ibindi bihugu. Amasezerano ya Montreal yo kugabanya imyuka byangiza akayunguruzo k’izuba, avuga ko ibihugu bikize birimo ibyo ku mugabane w’u Burayi, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’ibindi bizatangira guhagarika ikoreshwa ry’ibyuma bikonjesha, HFCs mu myaka mike iri imbere aho bizagabanya kugeza ku 10% mu 2019. Ibihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere nk’u Bushinwa, ibyo muri Amerika y’Amajyepfo n’ibindi bizatangira kugabanya ikoreshwa ry’iyi myuma mu 2024. Ibindi bihugu birimo u Buhinde, Pakistan, Iran, Iraq bizagabanya ikoreshwa ry’ibyuma bikonjesha mu 2028. U Bushinwa nk’igihugu gikora ibi byuma kurusha ibindi ntikizahagarika inganda zibikora mbere ya 2029. Imyuka ituruka mu byuma bikonjesha bikurura ubushyuhe bw’izuba inshuro 1000 kurusha umwuka mubi ( Carbon Dioxide) usanzwwe uzwi mu kugira uruhare mu ihindagurika ry’ikirere.

title: Umwanda wo muri Gereza ya Mageragere watangiye gutunganywa ngo udatera indwara abayituriye
content: Kuba iyi gereza ikikijwe n’imirima n’inzu z’abaturage ndetse n’umugezi wa Nyabarongo, biri mu byatumye hatekerezwa uburyo bwo kubyaza umusaruro amazi ayiturukamo. Hubatswe uburyo bwo gutunganya amazi mabi ava mu bwiherero, mu bikoni ndetse no mu bwogero kugira ngo ajye akoreshwa mu bindi bikorwa by’isuku, kuhira imyaka aho kwisuka muri Nyabarongo cyangwa mu mirima y’abaturage. Umuyobozi Mukuru wa REMA, Ruhamya Collette, yavuze ko bahisemo gutunganya iyi myanda ituruka mu mazi no mu butaka bw’iyi gereza kubera ko iyo idatunganyijwe iba intandaro yo kwangiza ibidukikije no gutera indwara abaturage. Yagize ati “ Nk’uko mwabibonye iki gikorwa kigamije gutunganya imyanda ituruka mu mazi y’iyi gereza kubera ko twese tuzi ko iyo imyanda igiye mu bidukikije nko mu mazi no mu butaka  idatunganyijwe ahanini ariyo iba intandaro yo kwangiza ibidukikije no gutera indwara mu baturage.” Umuyobozi wa RCS, CGP Rwigamba George,  yavuze ko iki gikorwa ari cyiza ndetse kizagira akamaro cyane kuko amazi y’umwanda yavaga muri iyi gereza azatunganywa akongera agakoreshwa. Yagize ati “Bizagira akamaro cyane mu kurengera ibidukikije kubera ko umwanda uva muri iyi gereza  uwuretse ukamanuka uko wakabaye ukajya mu mugezi wa Nyabarongo, wakwangiza byinshi. Akamaro bizagira ni uko amazi y’umwanda yavaga aha agiye gutunganywa akavamo umwanda wose akongera agasubira gukoreshwa mu bikorwa birimo iby’ubuhinzi n’isuku kandi akaba atazagera mu baturage.” Ayo mazi yatunganyijwe bisaba ko abanza gutekwa ku muntu wakenera kuyanywa yujuje ubuziranenge. Binateganyijwe ko gahunda yo gutunganya imyanda izagezwa no mu zindi gereza n’ibindi bigo binini mu rwego rwo kubungabunga ibidukikije.

title: U Rwanda rwatangije uruganda rutunganya imyanda y’ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga
content: Muri Mata 2014, Ikigega gitera inkunga imishinga igamije kubungabubunga ibidukikije ’Rwanda Green Fund’, cyashoye hafi miliyoni 1.5 z’amadolari y’Amerika (miliyari 1.26 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda), mu mushinga wo gukusanya no gutunganya imyanda ikomoka ku bikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga biba bitagikoreshwa. Uru ruganda rwatangijwe kuri uyu wa Mbere, ruzatunganya imyanda ikomoka ku bikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga biba bitagikoreshwa ariko ugasanga bibitse mu buryo butizewe kandi bishobora gutera ingaruka zihariye. Harimo ibikoresho byifashishwa mu ngo nka firigo, imashini zimesa, iziteka, televiziyo, ibyuma bishyushya, telefoni n’ibindi bituma ibyuma by’ikoranabuhanga bidakoreshwa bikomeza kwiyongera, ugasanga ahenshi birunze mu bubiko. Muri ibyo byuma, bizajya bijyanwa muri urwo ruganda ibikiri bizima bigatunganywa hakabyazwamo ibindi bikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga, ibyangiritse bigasenywa ku buryo bitangiza ibidukikije. Mu mezi atandatu rumaze gutunganya mudasobwa zirenga 200 za desktop zari zarapfuye, zikaba zarahawe ibigo by’amashuri. Minisitiri Biruta yavuze ko iyi myanda ari ikibazo gikomeye kandi gisaba ubufatanye n’imbaraga zikomeye mu kugishakira igisubizo. Yagize ati “Turabizi neza ko imyanda ikomoka mu ikoranabuhanga ari ikibazo gikomeye mu bihugu byinshi byo ku Isi. Uretse kuba yangiza ibidukikije, binatera ibibazo bikomeye ku buzima no ku mibereho myiza y’abaturage.”  Uru ruganda ruri mu murongo wo guteza imbere isuku n’ibidukikije, ruzafasha u Rwanda kugera ku ntego yo gutera imbere ibigendana no kugabanya ibyuka bihumanya ikirere mu 2050, rukaba ari urugero muri Afurika no ku Isi. Minisitiri Biruta yagarutse ku bimaze kugerwaho n’Ikigega cyo kubungabunga imyanda muri gahunda y’imyaka itanu, aho hashyizweho itegeko n’amabwiriza abigenga, imirongo ngenderwaho n’ubuziranenge bwabyo. Ubushakashatsi bwerekanye ko hari ingaruka zishamikiye ku myanda ikomoka ku bikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga bitewe ahanini n’icyo biba bikozemo, bikaba byagira ingaruka ku muntu cyangwa bigateza ikibazo mu bundi buryo. Kubitwikira ku gasozi kandi nabyo bishobora guteza ibindi bibazo birimo indwara z’ubuhumekero cyangwa izindi zishamikiye ku bibazo by’umutima.

title: Kayonza: Bralirwa yashyikirije abaturage amashanyarazi akomoka ku zuba inifatanya na bo gutera ibiti
content: Nyuma y’umuganda no gushyikirizwa amashanyarazi kuri uyu wa 2 Ukuboza 2017, Mukarutabana Helena yabwiye IGIHE ko ashimishijwe n’uko atazongera kugonga inkuta z’inzu kubera kuba mu kizima. Yagize ati “Aba bantu barakoze cyane; wasangaga mu gihe cy’igicuku njya hanze nijoro nkagonga urukuta kubera hatabona ariko ubu mpita nkanda ku rukuta hakabona. Hari n’ubwo twacanaga agatadowa umwotsi wako ugasanga uratubangamiye cyane.” Umuyobozi ushinzwe itumanaho no guhuza ibikorwa, Nyangezi Fred, yavuze ko iki gikorwa kigamije kuzamura imibereho myiza y’abaturage batuririye umurima uhingwamo ibyo Bralirwa yifashisha yenga inzoga. Yangeye ati “Ubundi igikorwa cyatuzanye kwari ukwifatanya n’abaturage mu muganda wo gutera ibiti ariko kandi tuje no gutaha ikindi twakoze mbere cyo guha abaturage amashanyarazi akomoka ku zuba. Icyivugo cyacu ni ugutsinda mu kazi, tugatsinda ubukene, umwijima. Murabyumva neza ko twazanywe n’igikorwa cyiza.” Muri rusange, abaturage b’Akarere ka Kayonza bafite umuriro w’amashanyari ni 33%, by’umwihariko mu Murenge wa Ndego, abawufite ni 18%, abandi basigaye baracyacana agatadowa. Umuyobozi wungirije w’Akarere ka Kayonza ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage, Harerimana Jean Damascène, yashimiye Bralirwa ku bikorwa ikora bigamije gufasha abaturage bako, asaba abaturage kubibungabunga, cyane cyane ibyo biti kubera akamaro bibafitiye harimo kuzana umwuka mwiza, gukurura imvura n’ibindi.

title: Inzovu zisaga ibihumbi 20 ziricwa buri mwaka muri Afurika
content: Ibi byagarutsweho mu nama nyunguranabitekerezo yabereye mu karere ka Musanze kuri uyu wa 23 Ugushyingo 2017, ihuje abacunga umutekano, abakozi bashinzwe kurengera ibidukikije n’abakora mu nzego za leta, yateguwe n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere(RDB)ku bufatanye n’Umuryango urengera inyamaswa zo mu gasozi(Rwanda Wildlife Conservation Association). Iyi nama yari igamije kungurana ibitekerezo ku kurwanya  ibyaha byo gushimuta no gucuruza inyamaswa by’umwihariko imisambi yo mu Rwanda, inkura n’inzovu zikunze kwibasirwa haba ku rwego rw’igihugu mu Karere no ku rwego mpuzamahanga no kureba uburyo ibyaha nk’ibi bihanwa. Umunyakenyakazi, Dr. Winnie Kiiru umaze imyaka isaga 25 mu bikorwa byo kurengera ubusugire bw’inyamaswa,wari witabiriye iyi nama, yemeza ko igitiza umurindi ba rushimusi harimo ibikoresho biciriritse ku barinda inyamaswa ndetse n’amategeko adakarishye ahana ibi byaha. Yagize ati “Hagomba gushyirwaho uburyo bwose abarinzi bagira ibikoresho bikomeye, urugero usanga ba rushimusi bateye parike bafite imbunda zikomeye, indege n’imodoka zikaze ariko abarinzi bo bafite inkoni cyangwa amabuye. Murumva izi mbaraga ntizahangana n’aba ba rushimus;hari n’aho usanga amategeko ahana ibi byaha adakaze kurusha inyungu aba bashimuta baba bifuzamo, ibi bikwiye kuranduka kuko mu Rwanda byarashobotse.” Umuyobozi w’Ishami rishinzwe gucunga imishinga iterwa na leta muri RDB, Felix Siboniyo ni umukozi w’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere RDB yemera ko koko amategeko ahari hari igihe usanga atanga icyuho cyane ku kubungabunga ibidukikije. Ati “Hagomba kubaho amategeko yihariye niba mu Rwanda inzovu ziri gucika ni ngombwa ko habaho amategeko yihariye azirengera mu gihe zabonetse kugira ngo zororoke.” Akomeza avuga ko udashobora kugira ubukerarugendo utarengeye ibidukikije kandi udashobora no kurengera ibinyabuzima utagamije iterambere ry’abantu. Ati “Kugira ngo tubigereho hakenewe ubufatanye bwimbitse hagati y’inzego zose kuko nubwo mu Rwanda parike zicunzwe neza, hanakenewe ubukangurambaga muri rubanda, ku bakora ku bibuga by’indege, ku mipaka n’abashinzwe umutekano kugira ngo tugire ubukerarugendo buteye imbere.” Kuri ubu habarurwa inzovu ziri hagati y’ibihumbi 20 na 30 zicwa buri mwaka muri Afurika hagamijwe kuzikuraho amahembe yazo akoreshwa mu bugeni inyinshi zikaba ari izo muri Kenya, Botwana na Afurika y’Epfo. Abitabiriye iyi nama basabwe ko buri wese yaba ijisho ry’igihugu mu kurwanya ubushimusi n’ubucuruzi bunyuranyije n’amategeko harengerwa inyamaswa cyane cyane izigenda zikendera. Abitabiriye iyi nama bari baturutse mu bihugu bya Kenya, Malawi, Uganda, Tanzania Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo n’u Rwanda rwayakiriye. U Rwanda rwashoye imbaraga mu bikorwa byo kurengera inyamaswa; urugamba rwo gufasha amatsinda ashinzwe gukumira ishimutwa ry’inyamaswa no gukorana n’inzego zitandukanye mu gukurikirana, gutanga amakuru no kugeza mu butabera abakora ibyaha byo kuzishimuta rurakomeje.

title: Amavugurura ya Kigali ku masezerano ya Montréal yemejwe bidasubirwaho, agiye gutangira gukurikizwa
content: Uyu muhigo ukomeye weshejwe nyuma y’uko Suède yiyongereye ku bihugu 19 byari bimaze kwemeza burundu ayo masezerano yamaze imyaka irindwi aganirwaho, akemeranywaho mu rukerera rwo kuwa 15 Ukwakira 2016, ubwo abari mu biganiro byabasabaga kurara ijoro muri Kigali Convention Centre bajya impaka. Amasezerano ya Montréal muri rusange bibarwa ko amaze kugabanya 98% by’imyuka yangizaga akayunguruzo kagabanya ubukana bw’imirasire y’izuba iza ku isi, Ozone, irimo nka chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) na hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs), ku buryo katangiye kugaragaza ibimenyetso byo kwisubiranya. Amavugurura ya Kigali kuri ayo masezerano azatuma ibihugu bitera intambwe noneho bijye no mu kugabanya ikoreshwa ry’imyuka ya hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) ituruka mu byuma byohereza umwuka mu nyubako cyangwa ibikonjesha nka za firigo. Nubwo HFCs zo zitangiza Ozone, zifite ingaruka inshuro ibihumbi mu gushyushya uyu mubumbe kurusha ‘dioxide de carbone,’ CO2. Amavuvurura ya Kigali byitezwe ko azagabanya dogere 0.5 ku gipimo cy’ubushyuhe bw’isi mbere y’uko iki kinyejana kirangira, bikaba intambwe ikomeye mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’amasezerano ya Paris yo mu 2015, agena ingamba zizatuma ubushyuhe bw’isi buguma munsi ya dogere Celsius ebyiri. Nk’uko byatangajwe n’ihuriro ry’ibihugu byishyize hamwe mu guharanira ko haboneka ibisubizo ku ihindagurika ry’ibihe, High Ambition Coalition, kuwa Gatanu w’iki cyumweru, amavugurura ya Kigali ni intambwe ikomeye yatewe mu gutuma isi iguma mu gipimo cy’ubushyuhe byemerejwe i Paris. Rigira riti “Kuri uyu munsi wa nyuma w’inama ya COP23 – twageze ku mubare w’ibihugu wari ukenewe kugira ngo aya mavugurura atangire gushyirwa mu bikorwa mu 2019. Kuba bigezweho mu mwaka umwe aya mavugurura yemerejwe i Kigali ni ikimenyetso gikomeye cy’ubushake bwa politiki mu gukuraho ikoreshwa rya HFCs, n’ubushake dusangiye mu guhangana n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe.” Iryo huriro ryavuze ko ryagize uruhare rukomeye mu kwemeza ayo masezerano, cyane ko ibihugu byayemeje ku ikubitiro biribarizwamo. Mu gihe mu cyumweru gitaha hari inama ku masezerano ya Montréal izabera muri Canada, iryo huriro ngo ryizeye ko ibindi bihugu bizemeza burundu ayo masezerano kandi bigatangira kuyashyira mu bikorwa. High Ambition Coalition ihurirwamo n’ibihugu bisaga 100 birimo ibihugu bikize nk’ibyo mu Muryango w’Ubumwe bw’u Burayi n’ibihugu bikennye ariko bifite ibyago byinshi byo guhura n’ingaruka z’ihindagurika ry’ibihe, hagamijwe gushaka ko haboneka uburyo bwo kuzirwanya. Amavugurura ya Kigali agena ko ibihugu bikize bigomba kugabanya ikoreshwa rya HFCs ku gipimo cya 85% hagati y’umwaka wa 2019 na 2036; ibihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere bikagabanya iyo myuka kuri 80% hagati ya 2024 na 2045. Muri Mata 2017 nibwo u Rwanda rwemeje burundu ibyavuguruwe ku masezerano ya Montréal yerekeye ibintu byangiza akayunguruzo k’imirasire y’izuba. Narwo ruri mu bihugu biri kugerwaho n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe kuko ubushyuhe bwazamutse ku gipimo mpuzandengo cya dogere 1.4 (1.4°C) kuva mu 1970, kandi mu gihe nta gikozwe, cyazamuka kugera kuri dogere 2.5 bitarenze umwaka wa 2050. Ayo masezerano agenga inganda zo mu bihugu byayemeje burundu ngo bihange ikoranabuhanga ritifashisha iyo myuka yangiza, kandi ibihugu bikize bikazabigiramo uruhare rufatika cyane ko ari nabyo bifite izo nganda, bikaba bifite n’igihe cya vuba cyo guca HFCs ugereranyije n’ibihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere.

title: U Bwongereza bwemeje burundu amavugurura ya Kigali ku ikoreshwa ry’imyuka yongera ubushyuhe bw’Isi
content: Amavugurura ya Kigali agena ko ibihugu bigomba kugabanya ikoreshwa ry’imyuka izwi nka hydrofluorocarbon (HFCs) ku gipimo cya 85% hagati y’umwaka wa 2019 na 2036. Ni imyuka ituruka mu byuma byohereza umwuka mu nyubako cyangwa ibikonjesha nka za firigo. Minisiteri ishinzwe ibidukikije mu Bwongereza yavuze ko nta gikozwe iyo myuka ishobora kuzaba yiyongereyeho 11% bitarenze 2050, bukaba bwifuza gukumira ko biba. Yavuze ko amasezerano ya Montreal muri rusange ari amwe mu yemeranyijweho agashobora gutanga umusaruro, kuko amaze kugabanya 98% by’imyuka yangizaga akayunguruzo kagabanya ubukana bw’imirasire y’izuba iza ku Isi, Ozone, irimo nka chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) na hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs), ku buryo katangiye kugaragaza ibimenyetso bya mbere byo kwisubiranya. Ibyavugururiwe i Kigali kuri ayo masezerano byo bizatuma haterwa intambwe noneho ibihugu bijye no mu guca HFCs. Nubwo zo zitangiza Ozone, zifite ingaruka inshuro ibihumbi mu gushyushya uyu mubumbe kurusha ‘dioxide de carbone,’ CO2. Amavugurura ya Kigali byitezwe ko azagabanya dogere 0.5 ku gipimo cy’ubushyuhe bw’Isi mbere y’uko iki kinyejana kirangira, bikaba intambwe ikomeye mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’amasezerano ya Paris yo mu 2015, agena ingamba zizatuma ubushyuhe bw’Isi buguma munsi ya dogere Celsius ebyiri. Minisitiri w’Ibidukikije mu Bwongereza, Michael Gove,  yagize ati “Kwemeza izi ntego birashyira u Bwongereza mu mwanya w’imbere ku Isi mu guhangana n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe. Aya masezerano azagabanya ukoherezwa kw’imyuka ihwanye na toni miliyari 70 za CO2 bitarenze 2050,  bingana n’imyuka ishobora koherezwa na sitasiyo 600 zitwika amakara muri icyo gihe.” U Bwongereza n’ibindi bihugu bigize Umuryango w’Ubumwe bw’Ibihugu by’u Burayi (EU) byatangiye guca HFCs, ku buryo bagomba kugabanya kuri 79% hagati ya 2015 na 2030. Amasezerano ya Montreal azatuma u Bwongereza bwonyine bugabanya imyuka ingana na toni miliyoni 44 za CO2. Ibindi bihugu biheruka kwemeza burundu ibyavugururiwe i Kigali muri ayo masezerano ni Maldives na Canada, ku buryo hakenewe ibindi bihugu birindwi kugira ngo bishoboke ko azatangire gukurikizwa kuwa 1 Mutarama 2019. Mu Ukwakira umwaka ushize nibwo ibihugu hafi 200 byahuriye i Kigali byiga ku ivugurura mu masezerano ya Montreal, byemezwa ko ibihugu bikize bizagabanya iyo myuka kuri 85% hagati ya 2019 na 2036; ibihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere bikagabanya iyo myuka kuri 80% hagati ya 2024 na 2045. Ibihugu 10 birimo u Buhinde, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Leta Zunze ubumwe z’Abarabu, Iran na Iraq byo bizagabanya 85% hagati ya 2028 na 2047. Ibyavugururiwe i Kigali bimaze kwemezwa burundu n’ibihugu birimo u Rwanda, Mali, Leta zishyize hamwe za Macaronesia, Ibirwa bya Marshall, Palau na Norvege. Mexico na Costa Rica bari mu rugendo rwo kuyemeza burundu.

title: Polisi igiye kwifashishwa mu gutera no kubungabunga amashyamba
content: Ayo masezerano akubiyemo uruhare rwa Polisi mu gutera ibiti no gutanga ubufasha mu kwita ku bihari no gukumira ko hari uwabyangiza; Polisi yiyemeje kuzatera ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka kuri hegitari ibihumbi 22 n’ibindi by’amashyamba kuri hegitari 5000 mu gihe cy’imyaka itanu. Minisitiri w’Ubutabera, Johnston Busingye, yavuze ko ayo masezerano akwiriye kuko ngo u Rwanda rukeneye ibiti ndetse n’ibihari bikaba bikenewe kwitabwaho. Yagize ati “Iki gikorwa kirebana no gutera amashyamba no kuyabungabunga gifashweho icyerekezo gikomeye, iki ndatekereza ko abanyarwanda ari ko babibona, ngira ngo iyo ugenda hirya no hino mu gihugu ukareba uko hasa ku misozi ubona ko ari ikintu kibura mu gihugu cyacu. Igihugu cyacu gifite ibyiza byinshi, gifite imisozi nyaburanga  ariko iyo witegereje urabona ko hari ikibura, ntabwo igihugu cyacu gifite ibiti bihagije.” Minisitiri w’Ubutaka n’Amashyamba, Tumushime Francine, yavuze ko ubwo bufatanye buziye igihe kuko u Rwanda n’Isi muri rusange  rukeneye ibiti n’amashyamba. Yagize ati “Iyi ni intambwe ikomeye cyane navuga ko yatewe, cyane cyane ko ari ugushyira mu bikorwa inama duhora tugirwa na Perezida wa Repubulika y’imikoranire y’inzego.” Yongeyeho ati “Kurinda ubutaka no gutera amashyamba ni kimwe mu bidufasha guhangana n’ikibazo cyugarije Isi ya none cy’imihindagurikire y’ibihe. By’umwihariko u Rwanda rukeneye gutera amashyamba nka bumwe mu buryo bwo kubungabunga ibidukikije ariko tunazirikana ko ibiti bikenewe mu buzima bwa buri munsi bw’Abanyarwanda.”  Minisiteri y’Ubutaka n’Amashyamba igaragaza ko u Rwanda rukenera umubare munini w’ibiti bikoreshwa mu bikorwa bitandukanye; Muri uyu mwaka, u Rwanda rukeneye ibiti toni esheshatu z’ibikomoka ku mashyamba nyamara rufite ibiti miliyoni 1.2 gusa. Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ifite umuhigo ko mu 2020, ku buso bungana na 30% bwarwo buzaba buteyeho ibiti; ikaba isaba ubufatanye bwa buri wese.

title: Ihurizo mu gusezerera amabati ya ‘asbestos’ ku nyubako za Leta n’iz’amadini mu Rwanda
content: Isakaro rya ‘asbestos” ryakoreshejwe  cyane ku nyubako zo hambere  byatangajwe ko rigira ingaruka mbi ku buzima bw’umuntu nko kumutera indwara zidakira nka kanseri y’ibihaha n’izindi. Inzu zisakaje ’asbestos’ nyinshi zagaragaye mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo mu bigo  by’amashuri, insengero n’ahandi ndetse no ku nyubako za Leta zirimo izahoze ari Intara n’iz’abihaye Imana byubatswe mu gihe cy’ubukoloni. Iryo sakaro ryose ringana na hegitari 168  ariko nibwo mu gihugu hose hamaze gukurwaho hegitari 84 gusa. Umuhuzabikorwa w’umushinga ushinzwe guca ’Asbestos’ muri RHA, Ihozo Gisele,  yabwiye IGIHE ko  bafite umugambi w’uko umwaka utaha wa 2018 nta nyubako izaba ikirangwaho aya mabati. Yemeza ko n’ubwo bafite iki cyifuzo bahangayikishijwe n’uko ubuso bunini buriho aya mabati ari ubwa leta n’ubw’abihayimana. Yagize ati “ Gahunda yo gukuraho ’Asbestos’ irakomeje kuko turifuza ko byibuze mu 2018 nta nyubako ya Leta cyangwa iz’abandi bantu zizaba zikiyigaragaraho uretse ko twahuye n’ikibazo cy’uko ubuso bunini iriho ari ubwa Leta n’ubw’abihaye Imana kandi bakatugaragariza ko bafite ikibazo cy’amikoro.” Akomeza avuga ko harimo n’abatihutira gukuraho iryo sakaro kuko  batarumva neza ingaruka ku buzima bw’umuntu. Asaba abo bireba  bose kumva ko byihutirwa mu gukuraho  ’asbestos’.

title: REMA yatangiye kugenzura abacuruzi bapfunyika mu mashashi
content: Kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki ya 25 Ukwakira 2017, nibwo abakozi ba REMA na Polisi y’Igihugu batangiye kuzenguruka mu bice bitandukanye by’Umujyi wa Kigali bahereye mu Karere ka Gasabo n’aka Nyarugenge aho bagenzuraga abacuruzi bakoresha amashashi. Nubwo u Rwanda rumaze imyaka icyenda rutoye ndetse runashyize mu bikorwa itegeko ryo guca ikoreshwa ry’amashashi, hari abayinjiza rwihishwa bakanayakoresha ari na yo mpamvu yatumye izi nzego zihaguruka. Abakoraga ubu bugenzuzi ubwo bageraga mu Karere ka Gasabo basanze hari inzu eshatu zicuruza imigati ziyipfunyika mu mashashi, zihita zicibwa ihazabu y’ibihumbi 300 y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda mu gihe abacuruzi baciriritse bafashwe bo bayatswe bakaganirizwa ku bubi bwayo banasabwa kutongera kuyakoresha. Uwamahoro Diane utuye ahitwa mu Giporoso we avuga ko bakunda gukoresha amashashi kubera ko ahendutse ugereranyije n’ibindi bipfunyikwamo. Yagize ati “Nari nayaguze amafaranga 300 Nyabugogo ariko nyiine umuntu ayagura kubera ko aba ahendutse; kuba banyeretse ububi bwayo bakanambabarira ntabwo nzongera gutekereza kuyakoresha na rimwe.” Itegeko riteganya ko ufashwe akoresha amashashi ahanishwa ihazabu iva ku bihumbi 100 kugeza kuri 500 n’igihano cy’amezi atandatu kugeza ku myaka ibiri y’igifungo. Umucuruzi uyafatanywe acibwa amande y’ibihumbi 50 kugeza kuri 300 mu gihe umuturage we acibwa amande kuva ku bihumbi 10 kugeza bihumbi 100. Umukozi ushinzwe Ubugenzuzi muri REMA, Israel Dufatanye, yabwiye IGIHE ko abantu bose bakwiye kwirinda gukoresha amashashi kubera ko agira ingaruka mbi ku bidukikije. Yagize ati “Iki gikorwa cyabereye mu gihugu hose kugira ngo turebe niba hakiri abantu bakoresha amashashi kubera ko atemewe kuko abangamira ibidukikije cyane cyane ko iyo yandagaye asiba inzira z’amazi akanatuma adacengera mu butaka ndetse muranabizi ko n’iyo amatungo ayariye apfa.” Yakomeje asaba abaturage kwirinda gukoresha amashashi bagakoresha ibipfunyikwamo byemewe n’amategeko kubera ko uzajya afatwa azajya abihanirwa. Iki gikorwa cy’ubugenzuzi bw’abakoresha amashashi cyarangiriye muri Gare ya Nyabugogo mu Karere ka Nyarugenge ahakusanyijwe ibicuruzwa byose birimo imigati, amandazi na keke n’ibindi bipfunyitse mu mashashi kugira ngo abakiyakoresha babicikeho. U Rwanda rwiyemeje guhagarika ikoreshwa ry’amashashi ndetse no kuyinjiza mu gihugu mu 2005, mbere y’uko mu 2008 hashyirwaho itegeko rikumira ikoreshwa n’iyinjizwa mu gihugu ryayo mu rwego rwo kurengera ibidukikije. Ku rwego mpuzamahanga, ibihugu birimo Bangladesh, Botswana, Israel, n’u Bufaransa nabyo byamaze kwemeza itegeko nk’iri.

title: Ibibazo bishamikiye ku ikoreshwa ry’ikibaya cya Nil bigiye gucocerwa i Kigali
content: Ikibaya cya Nil kibarizwamo hafi 25% by’abaturage ba Afurika n’ubutaka bungana na 10% by’uburi kuri uyu mugabane, urwo ruzi rukaba rugenda ruba igicumbi cy’ishoramari rikomeye nubwo ibihugu bitaribona kimwe. Kuva kuri uyu wa 23-25 Ukwakira 2017, abagera kuri 500 baturutse mu bihugu 10 bihurira ku kibaya cya Nil bazakoranira muri Kigali Convention Centre, barimo abo mu nzego za leta n’abikorera, basuzuma ubufatanye bukwiye mu kwita kuri icyo kibaya. Umuyobozi wa Nile Basin Initiative (NBI), Eng Innocent Ntabana, yabwiye itangazamakuru ko iki kibaya gifite imbogamizi nyinshi, ku buryo hakenewe uburyo buhamye bwo kukibungabunga. Yagize ati “Icya mbere ni uko nubwo ari umugezi munini, muremure, ntabwo ufite amazi menshi iyo ugereranyije n’indi migezi haba hano muri Afurika cyangwa ku isi. Ni ukuvuga rero ngo hari ikibazo cy’amazi, tudakoreye hamwe ashobora kutazahaza ibikorwa bigenda bigaragara cyangwa se ukuntu amazi akenerwa mu bihugu bihurira kuri iki kibaya, kubera ko uko umubare w’abaturage biyongera birasaba amazi menshi yo gukoresha.” “Birasaba amazi yo gutanga amashanyarazi, amazi yo guteza imbere ubuhinzi, ndetse n’ibidukikije ubwabyo kugira ngo hagume hari amazi ari mu kibaya, ni ikindi kiba gikenewe.” Ibyo ngo bigaragaza ko ibihugu bikwiye gukorera hamwe ngo birebe imbere uko amazi ashobora kuzaba make bitewe n’uko umubare w’abaturage wiyongera n’ibyo bakenera bikiyongera. Yakomeje agira ati “Ikindi uretse ko amazi ashobora kuzaba make bitewe n’uko umubare w’abaturage wiyongera, ihindagurika ry’ibihe naryo riragaragaza ko rishobora gutuma ayo mazi agabanuka. Bizaba biteye gute? Ni ibindi biganiro na byo bizatangwa, bakareba ngo ese ibi bihugu byagerageza gute guhangana n’iryo hindagurika ry’ibihe kugira ngo amazi akomeze kuboneka mu kibaya.” Imbogamizi zihariye ku bihugu Abahanga bagaragaje ko Nil idahari Misiri yakwisanga ari ubutayu, nayo ikaba ikomeje gutsimbarara ku mikoreshereze y’amazi y’uyu mugezi. Mu 2010 nibwo Misiri yivanye muri NBI ubwo ibihugu byari bimaze gusinyana amasezerano yo kubyaza umusaruro umugezi wa Nil (Cooperative Framework Agreement, CFA), Misiri yanga kuyasinya ivuga ko hari ingingo zitandukanye n’amasezerano yari amaze imyaka agenderwaho. Yavugaga ko harimo ingingo zinyuranye n’amasezerano yo mu 1929 yanditswe n’Abongereza yayihaga uburenganzira buruta ubw’ibindi bihugu ku ikoreshwa rya Nil mu mishinga itandukanye, byo bikavuga ko ari “amasezerano yemejwe mu gihe cy’ubukoloni kandi bamwe bataranakolonijwe n’Abongereza”. Ntabana yakomeje agira ati “Hari ibindi bibazo birebana n’imikoranire, ariko ngirango hazaganirwa ingero nziza zigenda zoboneka mu bindi bihugu cyangwa ku bindi bibaya muri Afurika no ku yindi migezi ku isi n’ukuntu ikibaya cya Nil na cyo cyabigiraho mu gutunganya imicungire yacyo mu bufatanye bw’ibihugu bikigize.” “Hari ibigeragezwa nko kuba twashyiraho amasezerano, ni ibintu bifata umwanya ariko umunsi umwe ibihugu bizabasha kwemeranya ku masezerano amwe. Biri gutinda, ariko ntabwo bitangaje kuba byafata umwanya. Icyo tuzi ni uko hagati aho inzego ziri gukora zifasha ibihugu kandi gusinya ntabwo ari ikintu gitangaje, ubufatanye bushobora kuba bukorwa mu bundi buryo, ibihugu bikazagera aho byemeranya kuri gahunda izaza ishyigikira ibimaze iminsi bikorwa.” Misiri nayo yatumiwe muri iyi nama, nka kimwe mu bihugu 10 bihurira ku kibaya cya Nil. Abayobozi b’ibihugu bya Afurika bakomeje gushakira hamwe umuti ku bibazo ku ruzi rwa Nil, mu 2015 Misiri, Sudani na Ethiopie bikaba byarabashije kumvikana ku masezerano y’ubufatanye, ari na ko Ethiopie ikomeza umushinga wo kubaka urugomero rwa Great Ethiopian Renaissance Dam. Misiri ivuga ko rushobora gutuma abaturage bayo babura amazi ahagije, mu gihe Ethiopie yavugaga ko abaturage bayo bakeneye amashanyarazi, ndetse iza gushyigikirwa n’ibindi bihugu birimo u Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, Kenya n’u Burundi.

title: Abashakashatsi baratabariza udusimba tuguruka turi mu marembera
content: Mu bushakashatsi bwakorewe mu duce turenga 60 dutandukanye tw’u Budage, byagaragaye ko udukoko tuguruka tumaze kugabanukaho 75% mu myaka 30 ishize ndetse impamvu nyamukuru ibitera ikaba itazwi. Aba bashakashatsi bavuga ko kugabanuka kw’ibi binyabuzima bidaturuka ku kirebe bibamo, ubutaka, cyangwa imiterere y’agace bibamo, ikaba ariyo mpamvu bataramenya impamvu nyamukuru bigabanuka umusubizo. Dr Hans de Kroon wari uhagarariye ubu bushakashatsi, yemeza ko bikwiye kurindwa ndetse bikitabwaho hagamijwe kubifasha kutazimira ku isi. Yagize ati” Ntabwo tuzi impamvu nyakuri, ubu bushakashatsi bugaragaza ko ari ngombwa kugira gahunda nziza zo kwita kuri ibi binyabuzima, niyo mpamvu tugiye gukora ubushakashatsi bwimitse tukamenya impamvu nyamukuru itera ibi binyabuzima gukendera. Nibyo bidushishikaje." Igitangaje kandi muri ubu bushakashatsi ni uko no mu bice byagenewe inyamaswa, ibi binyabuzima naho bigabanuka nk’uko aba bashakashatsi babigaragaje. Kugabanyuka kw’ibi binyabuzima bifite ingaruka nyinshi mbi kuko umubare munini wabyo ni ibiribwa na bimwe mu bifasha ibimera kororoka. Dr Lynn Dicks, umwarimu muri Kaminuza ya East Anglia mu Bwongereza, yabwiye BBC dukesha iyi nkuru ko niba koko ibi binyabuzima biri kugabanuka kuri iyi ntera, iki kibazo cyaba ari icyo kwitabwaho nta kuzuyaza. Yavuze ati" Udukoko tuguruka dufite akamaro gakomeye mu mibereho y’ibindi binyabuzima biri ku isi, umubare watwo ni ingenzi cyane." Ubu bushakashatsi bwakorewe ku dukoko dutandukanye turimo inzuki n’ibinyugunyugu, aho hifashishijwe ibyanya 63 byo mu Budage bibamo ibinyabuzima bitandukanye.

title: Uburyo wakoresha wirindamo inkuba
content: Ibi bishobora gutera imyuzure n’inkangu ndetse hari aho inkuba zigenda zihitana ubuzima bw’abantu n’ubw’amatungo. Urugero ni kuwa Mbere tariki ya 9 Ukwakira, aho mu Karere ka Rusizi, mu Murenge wa Bweyeye abantu barindwi bari mu rusengero bakubiswe n’inkuba maze umwe ahita yitaba Imana; na none mu Karere ka Nyamagabe, mu Murenge wa Kitabi, kuri uyu wa kabiri tariki ya 10 Ukwakira, abantu umunani basoromaga icyayi bakubiswe n’inkuba umwe yitaba Imana. Inkuba ni uruhurirane rw’ingufu zihurira mu kirere maze ikubitana ryazo rigatanga izindi ngufu zo mu bwoko bw’amashanyarazi; aribyo twumva cyangwa tubona bikubita nk’inkuba n’imirabyo. Ibi nibyo bikomeretsa cyangwa bikica uwo bihuye nawe. Ariko hari uburyo twakwitwara kugira ngo tugabanye ubukana n’ingaruka bishobora kutugiraho. Mu gihe hagwa imvura ivanze n’inkuba n’imirabyo abaturage basabwa ibi bikurukira:  kwirinda kugama munsi y’igiti kiri cyonyine, Kwirinda kugama ahantu hari inzu za telefoni rusange, ku misozi hejuru, kuko ibyo byose byagira uruhare mu gukubitwa n’inkuba; kwirinda gukorakora no gutwara ibintu bizwiho gutwara umuriro vuba ni ukuvuga ibyuma binyuranye nk’amakanya, umutaka, fer à béton n’ibindi mu gihe ibyo byuma bisumba umutwe w’ubitwaye. Igihe uri mu modoka; ibuka gufunga ibirahure byose, wirinda gukorakora (gushyira intoki) mu madirishya arimo ibyuma bya grillage,  kwirinda kuba hafi cyangwa gukorakora ahantu hari za senyenge cyangwa se ibindi bikoresho bikoze mu byuma. Niba wumvise inkuba uri mu ishyamba, ibyiza ni ukuguma hagati ukirinda kujya mu nkengero zaryo. Kwirinda koga, kuguma cyangwa kugenda mu mazi  mu gihe cy’inkuba. Abana bakabuzwa gukinira mu bidendezi by’amazi; kwirinda gukandagira mu mazi mu nzu ukoropa cyangwa umesa. Kwirinda gukoresha ibyuma bizamuka mu nyubako z’amagorofa aribyo bita Ascenseur (lift) igihe cy’imirabyo n’inkuba.   Kwirinda gukoresha ibintu byose bikoresha amashanyarazi mu gihe utizeye neza ko inyubako yawe ifite “akarindankuba” (paratonnerre).  Kwirinda kuryama hasi ku butaka kuko byakurura gukubitwa n’inkuba.  Niba uri ku igare cyangwa kuri moto, ibyiza ni ukubivaho kuko bishobora gutuma inkuba igukubita. Kurinda ibikoresho bikoreshwa n’amashanyarazi ni ngombwa kwifashishwa ibyuma byabugenewe.

title: Umwaka wa 2100 ushobora kururira ikiremwamuntu kubera ihindagurika ry’ibihe
content: Veerabhadran Ramanathan, umwarimu w’ibijyanye n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe n’ubumenyi bw’ikirere muri Kaminuza ya California, atangaza ko abantu badakwiye gufata izi ngaruka nk’ibintu byoroshye, kuko kuri we abisanisha n’uko ‘indege 1 muri 20 uzajyamo’, izashwanyagurika igahinduka umuyonga. Amavugurura yakorewe i Kigali ku masezerano ya Montreal, agena uburyo bwo kugabanya ikorwa n’ikoreshwa ry’imyuka ya ‘Hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) igira uruhare runini mu izamuka ry’ubushyuhe bw’Isi yitezweho gutanga igisubizo kuri iki kibazo. Abahanga bagaragaza ko guhagarika ikora n’ikoreshwa ry’iyi myuka ya HFCs ahanini yifashishwa mu byuma bikonjesha, bishobora kugabanya dogere 0.5 ku mpuzandengo y’izamuka ry’ubushyuhe bw’Isi. Muri aya masezerano ibihugu bikize birimo ibyo ku mugabane w’u Burayi, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’ibindi bizatangira guhagarika ikoreshwa ry’ibyuma bikonjesha bisohora HFCs, kugeza ku 10% mu 2019. Umuhanga mu byerekeye ihindagurika ry’ikirere, yatangaje ko mu mwaka wa 2100 bimwe mu bihugu bya Afurika nka Tchad, Niger na Angola, urwego rw’ubuhinzi rwabyo rushobora kuzaba amateka rukibagirana burundu. Gusa ibihugu byo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara ni byo Banki y’Isi ivuga ko bizibasirwa cyane n’ingaruka z’ihindagurika ry’ibihe mu rwego rw’ubuhinzi. Dr. Ramanathan na mugenzi we Yangyang Xu, umwarimu muri Kaminuza ya Texas A&M, basobanuye ingamba zikwiye gufatwa mu kwirinda ziriya ngaruka zaterwa n’imihandagurikire y’ikirere nk’uko tubikesha Daily Maily. Muri izo ngamba, hari gukumira imyuka ituruka mu byuma bikonjesha, HFCs, kuko ibi byuma bikurura ubushyuhe bw’izuba inshuro 1000 kurusha umwuka wa CO2 na wo ugira uruhare rukomeye mu ihindagurika ry’ikirere, ibi byose bikaba bikwiye gukumirwa hahangwa udushya.

title: U Rwanda rwasabye amahanga kwemeza byihuse amavugurura ya Kigali ku myuka ihumanya ikirere
content: Ni mu nama yabereye i New York kuri uyu wa Mbere, yitabirwa n’abaminisitiri barebana n’ibidukikije ba Canada, u Bufaransa, Costa Rica n’abandi bayobozi ku rwego rw’Umuryango w’Abibumbye, igamije gushishikariza ibihugu kwemeza ibyavugururiwe i Kigali kuwa 15 Ukwakira 2016. Abahanga bagaragaza ko guhagarika ikora n’ikoreshwa ry’iyi myuka ya HFCs ahanini yifashishwa mu byuma bikonjesha, bishobora kugabanya dogere 0.5 ku mpuzandengo y’izamuka ry’ubushyuhe bw’Isi. Minisitiri Biruta yavuze ko hakenewe nibura ko ibihugu 20 byemeza burundu ayo masezerano mbere y’inama itaha izabera muri Canada mu Ugushyingo, kugira ngo ayo masezerano azatangire gukurikizwa kuwa 1 Mutarama 2019 nk’uko byemeranyijweho.  Yagize ati “Twahuriye hamwe ngo dushimangire ubushake bwacu ku mavugura ya Kigali kandi dusabe ibindi bihugu kwihutisha kuyemeza burundu. Mu kubikora, turaba dutanze ubutumwa bukomeye ko Isi ishyize hamwe mu kurangiza ikoreshwa rya Hydrofluorocarbons no kurengera ikirere cyacu.” Dr Biruta yavuze ko mu gushyira mu bikorwa ayo masezerano hamwe no kwifashisha ingufu zitangiza ibidukikije, intego ishobora kurenga kugabanya dogere 0.5 ikagera kuri dogere imwe. Hasobanurwa ko byaba ari n’intambwe itewe mu gushyira mu bikorwa amasezerano ya Paris yemejwe mu 2015, agena ingamba zo gukumira izamuka ry’igipimo mpuzandengo cy’ubushyuhe bw’Isi, kikaguma hasi ya 2°C, intego ikaba ko kigera hasi ya 1.5°C kugeza mu 2100, nk’uko byahoze mbere y’umwaduko w’inganda,. Biruta yakomeje agira ati “Kwemeza burundu aya mavugurura mu buryo bwihuse bifite n’inyungu ku bihugu, nk’inkunga igenewe ibikiri mu nzira y’amajyambere.”  Yasabye abafatabyabikorwa muri iyo gahunda kuzuza uruhare rwabo mu gushyigikira ishyirwaho ry’ikigega kizafasha ibihugu bidafite amikoro yo guhita bishyira mu bikorwa ivanwaho rya HFCs. Muri aya masezerano ibihugu bikize birimo ibyo ku mugabane w’u Burayi, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika n’ibindi bizatangira guhagarika ikoreshwa ry’ibyuma bikonjesha bisohora HFCs  kugeza ku 10% mu 2019. Ibihugu biri mu nzira y’amajyambere nk’u Bushinwa, ibyo muri Amerika y’Amajyepfo n’ibindi bizatangira kugabanya ikoreshwa ry’ibi byuma mu 2024. Ibindi bihugu birimo u Buhinde, Pakistan, Iran, Iraq bizagabanya ikoreshwa ry’ibyuma bikonjesha mu 2028. Minisitiri Biruta yavuze ko kwemeza burundu aya mavugurura biri mu gusigira Isi nziza ibisekuru biri imbere, ariko biri no mu gufasha cyane ibihugu byatangiye guhura n’ibibazo bishingiye ku gushyuha k’umubumbe. Kugeza ubu amaze kwemezwa burundu n’ibihugu birimo u Rwanda, Mali, Leta zishyize hamwe za Macaronesia, Ibirwa bya Marshall, Palau na Norvege. Iyi nama yasojwe Canada, Mexico na Costa Rica bitangaje ko biri mu rugendo rwo kuyemeza burundu.

title: Ingaruka ziri kugaragara ku isi zitewe n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe
content: Ibikorwa bya muntu nibyo biri ku isonga mu gukurura ibyo byago ndetse nihatagira igikorwa, bimwe mu bikorwa bya muntu bitangaje bizazimira ba nyirabyo bareba ari nabo babigizemo uruhare. Nubwo bitewe n’ubukonje n’imiterere yaho, kuri Antarctic hadatuwe n’abantu, ingaruka z’ibikorwa bya muntu zikomeje gutuma hangirika bikomeye. Kuri ubu  urubura rwatangiye gushonga, ndetse mu duce tumwe na tumwe tw’aho hatangiye  kumera ibyatsi. Ibi biteye impungenge abahanga muri Siyansi, bavuga ko bishobora gutuma imwe mu mijyi ikomeye iri hafi y’inyanja  nka Miami, New York, Mumbai na Shanghai irengerwa n’amazi ashonga muri urwo rubura . Mu myaka 100 ishize, ibikorwa bya muntu byongereye ubushyuhe ku isi ho dogere selisiyusi 2.5.  Uko kwiyongera k’ubushyuhe ku isi kwagiye gutera ibibazo bitandukanye birimo ihindagurika ry’ibihe, imyuzure ya hato na hato, kuzimira kw’inyamaswa n’ibimera bitandukanye n’ibindi. Mu myaka myinshi ishize, ibikorwa bya muntu byakomeje kugira uruhare mu iyangirika ry’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima ndetse n’ihindagurika ry’imiterere y’isi. Ahari ubutayu bwa Sahara hahoze ibyatsi, amazi ndetse n’amashyamba nkuko byatangajwe n’umushakashatsi Dr Curt Stager muri Kaminuza ya Smith College, nyamara byaje guhindurwa n’imyuzure, agace gasigara kambaye ubusa. Kubera ubushyuhe kandi , ibikorwa bya muntu n’ibindi, amoko 1000 y’inyamswa yarimutse ajya gushaka handi aba, andi menshi yarazimiye. Inyamasa nka Pryenian Ibex, Inuma zo mu bwoko bwa Passenger, inkima zo mu Nyanja n’izindi ntaho wakongera kuzibona ku isi, zarishwe, zarahizwe izindi zinanirwa n’imiterere y’ikirere  gishya zirapfa. Inyamaswa nk’amadubu yo mu bice bikonja, inyoni n’ibikuruzanda nabyo bishobora kuzacika kubera imihindagurikire y’ibihe, kuko ubukonje izi nyamaswa zakundaga kubamo bugenda bugabanuka. Ibihugu nka Costa Rica no mu bindi bihugu byo hagati ku mugabane wa Amerika biri mu bibazo byo kugabanyuka gukomeye kw’ibikeri. Imiyaga  ivanze n’imvura nka Irma, imyuzure nka Harvey imaze iminsi izunguza Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe mu mwaka wa 2013, bwagaragaje ko mu myaka iri imbere isi ishobora kujya ihura n’imyuzure n’imiyaga ikaze inshuro zisaga 20 kubera ubwiyongere bw’ubushyuhe ku isi. Mu burengerazuba bwa Amerika, mu myaka mike ishize hakunze kugaragara inkongi z’umuriro mu mashyamba. CNN yatangaje  biterwa n’izuba ryinshi ryumisha amashyamba bikorohera ikwirakwizwa ry’umuriro mu gihe cy’inkongi. Mu myaka 15 iri imbere, isunzu ry’umusozi wa Kilimanjaro rizwiho urubura rizaba ryambaye ubusa. Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko ubushyuhe bw’isi buri gutuma urubura kuri uwo musozi rushonga bidasanzwe. Ibiciro ku masoko Imyaka irashize ibiciro by’ibiribwa ku masoko bizamuka ubutitsa. Leta zikora ibyo zishoboye ngo ibiciro bigabanyuke ariko bikaba iby’ubusa. Inzobere mu buhinzi zatangaje ko ihindagurika ry’ibihe nk’amapfa,  ryagiye rigira ingaruka ku musaruro, ibiribwa bikaba bike. Biteganyijwe ko mu mwaka wa 2050, ibiciro by’ibinyampeke bizaba byarikubye kabiri kubera kurumba cyangwa kudahingira igihe kubera izuba. Akanama ka Loni gashinzwe imihindagurikire y’ikirere gaherutse gushyira hanze ubushakashatsi buvuga ko ibikorwa bya muntu bigira ingaruka ku bidukikije byiyongereye ku rugero rwo hejuru. Ubuturo n’isoko y’ibiribwa by’inyamaswa zo mu Nyanja (coral reef) nabwo buri kwangirika bikomeye.The Guardian umwaka ushize yatangaje ko mu duce nka Mexico, Florida na Bahamas ubwo buturo uhereye mu mwaka wa 1980 bumaze kwangirika ku kigero cya 98 %. Kuva mu mwaka wa 2005, ubwo buturo mu bihugu byegereye ibirwa bya Caraїbes bwagabanyutse ku kigero cya 50 % kubera ubwiyongere bukabije bw’ubushyuhe bwo mu Nyanja. Umushakashatsi Paul Watson yavuze ko mu gihe cya vuba ubwoko bw’inyamaswa n’ibimera busaga ibihumbi bibiri buzaba bwazimiye nihatagira igikorwa ngo ibikorwa bya muntu byangiza ibidukikije bihagarikwe.

title: Amerika yiyemeje gufasha ibihugu birimo n’u Rwanda guhangana n’abashimuta inyamaswa
content: Mu Kiganiro ku murongo wa telefoni IGIHE yagiranye n’Umuyobozi wungirije w’Ibiro bya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika bishinzwe kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge ku rwego mpuzamahanga no kumenyekanisha amategeko, Dan Foote, yavuze ko bagiye gukomeza ibyo bikorwa, bagakomeza amahugurwa ku kurwanya ba rushimusi. Yagize ati “ Kugeza ubu muri Afurika dufite gahunda yihariye muri Kenya, Tanzania, Bitswana, Namibia na Afurika y’Epfo, turifuza kwagura imikorere muri Malawi na Zambia. Turi gukora ibikorwa byinshi mu karere ka Afurika u Rwanda ruherereyemo.” Yongeyeho ati “ Dufite ikigo cyigisha amategeko mu Mujyi wa Gaborone, Botswana, aho duhugura mu mategeko n’abayobozi mu bucamanza baturuka hirya no hino muri Afurika, tukanatanga by’umwihariko amasomo y’uburyo bwihariye bwo gukora  iperereza ku byaha byo gushimuta inyamaswa.” Hashize iminsi nta makuru y’ishimutwa ry’inyamaswa yumvikana mu Rwanda bitewe n’ingamba guverinoma yagiye ishyiraho, gusa ubu bufasha  burakenewe kugira ngo uwabihirahira atabwe muri yombi nta mpaka. Ikiganiro IGIHE yagiranye na Dan Foote  gikubiye mu bitegurwa na guverinoma ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika aho ishami rishinzwe Afurika ritegura ikiganiro n’abanyamakuru bo ku mugabane wa Afurika bakaganira ku ngingo zitandukanye hifashishijwe telefoni mu cyitwa Africa Regional Media Hub Press Briefing. Amerika itangaza ko itanga nibura miliyoni 50 z’amadolari yo guhangana n’ishimutwa ry’inyamaswa, asaga 50% yayo akajya muri Afurika gusa. Umushinga wayo wa USAID kandi nawo ugira uruhare muri ibyo bikorwa. Amerika igaragaza ko ishimutwa ry’inyamaswa muri Afurika rihangayikishije kuko ngo usibye no kwica inyamaswa cyangwa kwangiza ibidukikije ngo bihombya za guverinoma. Ikavuga ko izakomeza gufatanya na Afurika guhanga nabyo. Hashize iminsi kandi humvikana iyicwa ry’inzovu hagamijwe gutwara amahembe yazo, n’andi moko atandukanye y’inyamaswa, Amerika ivuga ko abazishimuta bibinjiriza nibura miliyoni 40 z’amadolari ku mwaka.

title: Abafite ubumenyi gakondo mu nzira yo guhabwa intebe mu gukumira ibiza mu Rwanda
content: MIDIMAR yatangaje iby’iryo barura ubwo kuri uyu wa Kane, Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’itegenyagihe (Meteo Rwanda) cyaganiraga n’ itangazamakuru, cyerekerana uko ikirere cyifashe mu mezi atatu ari imbere. Nsengiyumva yashimangiye ko hari gusuzumwa ubushobozi bw’abavubyi. Yagize ati “Gukorana n’abafite ubumenyi gakondo, mu myaka yashize MIDIMAR yasinye amasezerano ajyanye no gucunga ibiza mu gihe cy’imyaka 15, aho Isi yose yiyemeje guteza imbere ubumenmyi gakondo abaturage baba basanzwe bifitemo. Hari ababa bashobora kumenya ko imvura ishobora kugwa bitewe n’imiterere y’ubuzima bwabo, hari abashobora kubona ibimenyetso nk’udusimba cyangwa udukoko tuva mu butaka bakaba bashobora kubihuza n’uko ikirere kiza kuba kimeze mu minsi ikurikira.” “Twe nka MIDIMAR icyo twatangiye ni ukubarura tureba muri buri karere ni bande, baherereye mu yihe mirenge, ese ibiza bashobora kumenya ko biri bube ni ibihe. Hari uturere 12 tumaze kujyamo tubashakisha kugira ngo tubamenye, tuba dufite uburyo dukoresha kugira ngo tubamenye.” Yakomeje asobanura ko ukorerwa iryo suzuma abazwa ibintu bitandukanye bishobora gushingirwaho niba yashyirwa mu bafite ubumenyi harimo kureba igihe yatangiye kubyiyumvamo, ibyo ashoboye n’ibindi. Nyuma y’iryo barura mu gihugu hose bazashyirwa mu itsinda ry’abashinzwe kuburira abaturage ku biza bishobora kubibasira. Nubwo MIDIMAR iri muri iryo barura,  , Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’itegenyagihe cyatangaje ko kugeza ubu hakiri imbogamizi zo kuba yahuza ubumyeyi bw’abavubyi na siyansi kuko ubusanzwe ibitangazwa n’iki kigo cyo gishingira kuri siyansi. Meteo yatangaje ko mu gihembwe cy’ihinga A (Umuhindo), gihera muri Nzeri kigagera Ukuboza hazagwa imvura ihagije nk’isanzwe  igwa mu bihe byiza, iri hagati ya mm 350 na 400 ku giteranyo cy’imvura yapimwe mu mezi y’umuhindo yose. Umuyobozi mukuru wa Meteo Rwanda, John Ntaganda Semafara, yatangaje ko impamvu nyamukuru ari uko ubushyuhe bwo mu nyanja ngari bumaze igihe buri ku gipimo mpuzandengo cy’ubushyuhe butiyongereye cyangwa ngo bugabanuke.

title: Abaturage baratabaza kubera umunuko w’ikimoteri cy’imyanda y’umujyi wa Muhanga
content: Abarembejwe n’uwo munuko ni abo mu Mudugudu wa Kumukenke, bafite impungenge ko ingaruka ku buzima bwabo. Aba baturage babwiye IGIHE ko ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Muhanga bwahaye Koperative AGRUNI gushyira imyanda y’uruvange ahantu hatuwe, bikabateza umunuko ukabije. Kuri ubu inzu z’aba baturage zihora zifunze ntizigeramo umwuka, birinda ko amasazi abatera, akiyongera ku munuko uturukamo. Mu ijwi ryuje agahinda, Sagahutu Jeremie utuye hafi y’iki kimoteri avuga ko ubu hari umunuko ukabije, bakibaza uko bizaba bimeze imvura nigwa ari  nyinshi bataratabarwa. Yagize ati “Imodoka zizana iyo myanda, usanga huzuyemo amayezi, amagufa, impu n’ibindi byaboze. Ugasanga imbwa zibyirukankana hano hanze cyangwa ibisiga bigaterura nk’izo mpu zikabijugunya hejuru y’amazu yacu, ubundi umunuko ukatwibasira koko.” Kampire Ester, umubyeyi nawe utuye muri aka gace, yavuze ko bagaragariza inzego z’ibanze ko babangamiwe, bakabwirwa ko ikimoteri ari icy’akarere, imodoka zimena imyanda zigakomeza ubutitsa kubihasuka. Byongeye  hakaba hari impungenge ko  kizanduza n’amazi y’isoko bamomaga. Yagize ati “Buriya ureba munsi hariya hari ahantu hari iriba ry’amazi tuvomaho ndetse ubu n’abanyamugi baza kurivomaho ngo i Gitarama (Umujyi wa Muhanga) amazi ntayo bafite yarakamye ku buryo ariyo abaturage bakoreshaga, nyamara iyo myanda uko ihasatira bafite ubwoba ko nayo iyanduza.” Avuga ko imvura yatangiye kugwa bakaba bafite impungenge ko bazahura n’ibibazo bikomeye cyane, kuko amazi avamo ashokera aho bavoma. Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Muhanga, Uwamariya Béatrice, ntiyahakanye ko abo baturage bari mu kaga, avuga ko hari gushakwa umuti urambye. Yagize ati “Abaturage bagaragaje impungenege zabo ariko turi mu nzira igana ku gisubizo kirambye kuko uku kwezi kwa  cyenda twamaze kwemeza ko ijyanwa kumenwa mu Ruhango gusa hari ikiziyongera ku mafaranga batangaga yo kubakurira imyanda mu ngo zabo; gusa hazanozwa uburyo bizakorwa mu gihe cya vuba maze hatangire hatunganywe ku buryo butangiza ibidukikije aho icyo cyari kiri.” Akomeza avuga ko Akarere ka Ruhango kamaze kubaka ikimoteri kigezweho, aho bashaka ko abo bahaye isoko bazajya bajyanayo imyanda ivuye i Muhanga. Mu igenamigambi ry’Akarere ka Muhanga ryo mu ngengo y’imari ya 2012-2013 higeze  gukorwa inyigo y’ikimoteri kigezweho cyashoboraga gutwara arenga miliyoni 789 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ariko kugeza ubu nta kanunu kacyo mu gihe umujyi ukomeje kwaguka ubutitsa.

title: TI Rwanda igiye gushora asaga miliyoni 90Frw mu mushinga wo guhangana n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe
content: Uyu mushinga TIR yatangije kuri uyu wa Gatatu, tariki ya 16 Kanama 2017, yawutewemo inkunga na Minisiteri ishinzwe kwita ku bidukikije mu Budage. Ambasaderi w’u Budage mu Rwanda, Dr Peter Woeste, yatangaje ko ihindagurika ry’ibihe ari ikibazo gihangayikishije isi. Yagize ati “Ndakeka u Rwanda rushyize imbere guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe, icy’ingenzi cyane cyatumye twagura uyu mushinga hanze y’umugabane, ni uguhangana n’ihindahurika ry’ibihe.” Ku bijyanye no kugenzura uko u Rwanda ruzakoresha aya mafaranga, yavuze ko kubikora bitavuze ko hari igikuba cyacitse, anashima u Rwanda kuba inzego zishyira hamwe mu bintu bitandukanye. Yagize ati “Kugenzura uko aya mafaranga azakoreshwa ntibivuze ko ari ikintu kitagenda neza ariko iyo utagenzuye hashobora gukorwa ibitari byiza. Uyu munsi nishimiye kubona imikoranire y’inzego za Leta, imiryango itari iya Leta, polisi, urwego rw’umuvunyi, Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Imiyoborere bashyira hamwe. Birerekena ko ari inzego zidahigana.” Umuyobozi wa TI Rwanda, Ingabire Immaculée yavuze ko uretse kuba irwanya Ruswa n’akarengane, inakora ku bijyanye n’imiyoborere myiza, ko  imihindagurikire y’ibihe ari kimwe mu bihangayikishije isi kandi byashyizwemo amafaranga menshi bityo akwiye gukurikiranwa uko akoreshwa.  Yagize ati “Imihindagurikire y’ikirere ni kimwe mu bintu bihangayikishije isi kandi byashyizwemo amafaranga menshi cyane. Iyo uvuze amafaranga ugomba kumvamo na ruswa. Ariya mafaranga tugomba gukurikirana nibura uburyo mu gihugu iwacu akoreshwa mu guhangana n’iki kibazo. Ikindi, guhangana na cyo haba mu mategeko no mu byemezo bifatwa n’uburyo bishyirwa mu bikorwa, na byo ni ikibazo cy’imiyoborere kandi na yo tuyikoraho. Ubwo rero tugomba kureba niba akoreshwa ibyo agomba, niba no mu bijyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe u Rwanda rubihagazemo neza.” Yavuze ko nta bushakashatsi burakorwa ngo bugaragaze niba hari amafaranga yo guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe yakoreshejwe nabi. Ingabire yakomeje avuga ko aya mafaranga ashobora kuziyongera mu gihe kiri imbere, asaba ko minisiteri zishinzwe kurengera ibidukikije zikwiye gushyira hamwe n’abaturage ndetse na Sosiyete Sivile. Uyu mushinga wo kurengera ibidukikije, u Budage bwawutangije mu 2016, ukorera muri Bangladesh, Kenya, Koreya y’Epfo, Maldives, Mexique na Peru, ushorwamo asaga miliyoni ebyiri n’ibihumbi 400 by’amayero. Muri Werurwe uyu mwaka hiyongereyeho u Rwanda na Nepal.

title: Gutura ahantu hari umwuka uhumanye bigabanya imyaka icyenda ku cyizere cyo kubaho
content: Ni ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’abahanga bo muri kaminuza ya Aarhus muri Denmark, bwakorewe ku bantu ibihumbi 100 .Bashyizwe mu matsinda hakurikijwe imyaka yabo ndetse hakagenzurwa n’umubare w’abagiye bapfa hakurikijwe ikigero cy’imyaka barimo. Ibyavuye mu bushakashatsi byerekanye ko ikigereranyo cyo kubaho ku bantu batuye ahantu hari ihumana ry’ikirere ari imyaka 78,9 kandi ko hakurikijwe ubwiyongere bw’ihumana ry’ikirere rya buri mwaka habaho gutakaza imyaka iri hagati 9 na 11 y’icyizere cyo kubaho ku batuye mu duce dufite umwuka uhumanye. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika  ikiguzi cy’ibikorwa byo kugabanya ihumana ry’ikirere bibarwa hakurikijwe umubare w’ubuzima bw’abantu babungabunzwe. Habarurwa miliyari 7,4 z’amadorali buri mwaka zigenda muri icyo gikorwa. Mu Burayi  usanga abahitanwa  n’ihumana ry’ikirere baba bari hagati y’imyaka 70 na 80 y’ubukure . Kuri bo ihumana ry’ikirere rigabanya icyizere cy’ubuzima ho umwaka umwe cyangwa se ibiri bikagabanya ikiguzi bashora muri ibyo bikorwa. Professeur Mikael Skou Andersen wayoboye iryo tsinda ry’abashakashatsi yagize ati “ubu bushakashatsi butwereka ko hakwiye kujyaho uburyo burambye bwumvikana mu by’ubukungu bwo kugabanya ihumana ry’ikirere kugira ngo ibihugu bishishikarizwe kugabanya ikoreshwa ry’ibyangiza ikirere akenshi bikoreshwa mu kubibyaza ingufu.”

title: Perezida Kagame yifatanyije n’abaturage bo mu turere twa Gasabo na Kicukiro mu muganda
content: Muri iki gishanga hateguriwe umushinga wo kugihindura ahantu nyaburanga (eco-tourism park), abantu bashobora kuruhukira, gukorera imyidagaduro ndetse bakanahavoma amwe mu mateka yo mu Rwanda rwo hambere. Uyu mushinga uri muri gahunda za Leta zo kubungabunga ibidukikije hagamijwe gukumira iyangizwa ry’ibikorwa bifitiye igihugu akamaro, kongera urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima, kugabanya imyuzure, ubukangurambaga bwo kubungabunga ibishanga no guhanga imirimo ishingiye ku bidukikije n’ubukerarugendo, uzuzura utwaye amafaranga y’u Rwanda asaga miliyari ebyiri na miliyoni 400 (2,413,699,149).

title: Abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo basezeye Jacques Kabale wari umaze imyaka 10 ari ambasaderi i Paris (Amafoto)
content: Ni umuhango wabereye mu nzu y’ubuyobozi bw’agace k’Umujyi wa Paris yitwa ’Mairie du 3e arrondissement de Paris’. Mu ijambo rye nk’inshuti y’Abanyarwanda yakoranye bya hafi na Amb. Kabale, Pierre Aidenbaum uyobora aka gace k’Umujyi wa Paris, yashimiye Abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo kuba yifatanyije na bo mu gushimira Amb. Kabale igihe bamaze bakorana. Ati "Uretse n’ibyo mperuka mu Rwanda, imvugo niyo ngiro, ntakuntu umuntu atakwishimira gukorana neza n’abayobozi b’igihugu nk’u Rwanda kigaragaza mu iterambere niboneye." "Ni iby’agaciro kubabona muteraniye muri iyi ngoro y’umujyi, biraduhesha ishema kubera abo muri bo n’imibanire myiza iri hagati y’ibihugu byacu byombi, murisanga." Yabwiye Amb. Kabale ati "nkwifurije ishya n’ihirwe mu yindi mirimo uzashingwa." Amb. Kabale yashimiye abagize igitekerezo cyo guhuza Abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo ngo bamusezereho, nyuma y’imyaka 10 bahuzwa na byinshi. Ati "Nibyo koko igihe kirageze nsubiye mu Rwanda, ariko ntabwo ngiye kure tuzakomeza dufatanye mu gukorera ibihugu byacu byombi mu buryo butandukanye, kuko umuturage mwiza ahora ari ambasaderi w’igihugu cye." Yashimiye byimazeyo Abanyarwanda bitabiriye icyo gikorwa kandi wari umunsi w’akazi. Ati "Biranyereka ko twabanye neza kandi kubagira byaramfashije mu kazi kanjye, inama twagiranye, ibyo twakoranye byose byari umusaruro mwiza ku gihugu cyacu." "Tariki ya 22 Nzeri 2019 nibwo nzasubira mu Rwanda, ariko kandi ndabamenyesha ko mudasigaye mwenyine kuko hari Amb. Ngarambe François Xavier  uzansimbura arabageraho mu gihe gito, muzakomeze mukorane nawe neza nk’uko bisanzwe azaze yisanga rwose." Dr Rutayisire François wavuze ijambo mu izina ry’Abanyarwanda bo mu Bufaransa, yashimye byimazeyo ibyagezweho byose mu gihe Amb. Kabale yari mu Bufaransa. Ati "Ntabwo byari byoroshye, wakoze mu bihe twese tuzi ko bitari byoroshye muri dipolomasi hagati y’u Rwanda n’u Bufaransa ariko ugiye rwose umubano wacu uhagaze neza, turagushimira uruhare wabigizemo nka Ambasaderi. Abanyarwanda bantumye ngo nkubwire nti ’warakoze kandi Imana ikomeze ibarinde n’umuryango wawe.’" Habayeho umwanya wo guha ijambo buri wese akagira icyo abwira Amb. Kabale n’umuryango we, batanga ubuhamya bw’uko babanye muri iyo myaka 10 ahamaze. Amb. Kabale ati "Ndagira ngo mbashishikarize kandi kwibuka gahunda ikomeye cyane ya Rwanda Day izabera i Bonn mu Budage tariki ya 5 Ukwakira, aho umukuru w’igihugu n’abandi bayobozi batandukanye b’u Rwanda bazaza guhura n’Abanyarwanda, inshuti z’u Rwanda, abashoramari, n’abandi, iyi gahunda mukomeze mwiyandikishe muzabe muri benshi muhure na Perezida muganire."
