title: Urukiko rwo mu Bubiligi rwahamije Neretse Fabien ibyaha bya Jenoside
content: Mu Ugushyingo 2019 nibwo urubanza rwa Neretse rwatangiye kuburanishwa. Yashinjwaga ibyaha 13 by’intambara na bitatu byo kwica muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Mu byaha yahamijwe n’urukiko birimo ubwicanyi yakoze, gushishikariza abantu kwica, kurema umutwe w’abicanyi n’ibindi yakoreye mu Mujyi wa Kigali n’i Mataba. Umunyamategeko uhagarariye abakorewe Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, Me. Karongozi André Martin, yabwiye IGIHE ko ibyaha byose yarezwe byamuhamye. Yavuze ko bishimiye ko icyaha cya Jenoside yaburanye ahakana mu gihe gisaga ukwezi urubanza rwari rumaze cyamuhamye. Ati “Ikintu cya mbere twishimiye, ni uko icyaha cya Jenoside cyongeye gushimangirwa, ku muntu wayihakanye kuva urubanza rwatangira kugera rurangiye.” Mu iburanisha ry’uru rubanza, Neretse n’abamwunganira bakunze kugaragaza ko mu Rwanda habaye Jenoside ebyiri zirimo iyakorewe Abahutu n’iy’Abatutsi ndetse mu riheruka abanyamategeko be banongeyeho iya gatatu ngo yabereye muri Congo Kinshasa. Me. Karongozi  yasobanuye ko mu bantu yashinjwaga kwica, babiri aribo urukiko rutamuhamije kugira uruhare mu rupfu rwabo. Ati “Icya kabiri ni uko ibyaha byose bamureze, byamuhamye uretse gusa abantu babiri barimo Ildephonse waherekeje umwana wari wakomeretse akicirwa kuri bariyeri ngira ngo ni hafi ya Kiliziya Charles Lwanga. Ntibavuze ko ari Neretse kuko ataguye aho barasiye abandi, undi ni uwitwa Rutonesha Sixbert, we yari yihishe mu gisenge cy’inzu ariko nyuma avamo aza kugwa ahandi bavuga yuko yaguye mu bafurere b’Aba-Jesuites i Nyamirambo, ni abo bonyine.” Me. Karongozi yavuze ko ari ubwa mbere bibaye mu Bubiligi guca urubanza mu bushishozi nk’ubwo babonye. Ati “Ku bindi byaba byose, iby’i Kigali, abantu yishe, iby’i Mataba harimo bariya bantu barimo abitwa Mpendwanzi  na Nzamwita, ariko cyane cyane n’umubare w’abantu batazwi, biciwe i Mataba. Bivuze ngo perezida asobanuye ko icyemezo cyo kwica abantu, b’Abatutsi kiraturuka no kuri abo bantu bose yagiye yica, interahamwe yari afite amagambo yabwiraga abantu aho yacaga byose yabisobanuye neza ni ubwa mbere bibaye mu Bubiligi.” Yavuze ko nk’abanyamategeko batazura inzirakarengane zazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ariko nibura babona ko batabibagiwe kuko babonye ubutabera. Yashimye abarokotse bemeye kubaha ububasha bwo kubahagararira ndetse kuri we asanga akazi kakozwe karatanze umusaruro. Ku wa Kabiri tariki 17 Ukuboza 2019 nibwo urukiko rwari rwasoje kumva abarega n’abaregwa ubwo humvwaga abaregera indishyi, n’uruhande rw’abunganira Neretse mbere y’uko rwiherera rusuzuma ishingiro ry’uko buri ruhande rwireguye. Perezida wa Ibuka Mémoire & Justice, Ryamukuru Félicité, yabwiye IGIHE ko yashimye ubutabera bw’u Bubiligi avuga ko umwanzuro w’urukiko ubahaye kuruhuka nk’abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ati “Biraturuhuye, kuko twategereje amasaha ahagije, iminsi ibiri yari imaze kurenga, twibazaga aho biri bubere ariko biraturuhuye kuko ntabwo yashoboraga kuba umwere ibyaha byose byamuhamaga ibyaha by’intambara ariko icyiza ni uko icyaha cya Jenoside nacyo kimuhamye. Birerekana ubutabera bwo mu Bubiligi nabwo bwakoze umurimo ukomeye.’’ Yavuze ko guhamwa n’icyaha hari icyo bisobanuye no ku batekerezaga guhakana Jenoside. Ati “Umuntu umwe uhamwe n’icyaha cya Jenoside ni ukuvuga ngo iba yemewe kandi biruhura n’abacitse ku icumu nubwo bitagarura n’umuntu n’umwe ni ubutabera bugaragaje umurimo wabwo.” Biteganyijwe ko urukiko ruzatangaza ibihano ku byaba Neretswe yahamijwe ku wa Gatanu, tariki ya 20 Ukuboza 2019. Uru rubanza rwa Fabien Neretse w’imyaka 71 rwatangiye ku wa 4 Ugushyingo 2019 ubwo hatoranywaga itsinda ry’abaturage bagomba gutanga ubuhamya bumushinja n’ubumushinjura. Nyuma y’iminsi itatu rutangira kuburanishwa mu mizi. Fabien Neretse ukomoka mu Ruhengeri yafatiwe mu Bufaransa mu 2011. Uyu mugabo wari ufite ijambo ku butegetsi bwa Habyarimana, ashinjwa kugira uruhare mu kwica Umubiligi Claire Beckers n’umugabo we Isaïe Bucyana n’umukobwa wabo Katia. Aba biciwe i Kigali ku wa 9 Mata 1994, nyuma y’iminsi mike Jenoside itangiye. Beckers n’umuryango we bashatse uko bahunga bakava aho bari batuye, kuwa 9 Mata 1994 bajya ku Ngabo za Loni zari mu Rwanda, bahagarikirwa kuri bariyeri bararaswa. Bikekwa ko Neretse ari we wagize uruhare mu ihagarikwa rya Beckers n’umuryango we ndetse akaba yaranagize uruhare mu rupfu rw’abandi bantu icumi bari baturanye . Aregwa kandi ubwicanyi yakoreye iwa mu yahoze ari Perefegitura ya Ruhengeri ahitwa i Mataba barimo Mpendwanzi bivugwa ko yagiye kumushaka mu rugo rwe amushinja kuba icyitso cya FPR Inkotanyi nubwo yari Umuhutu. Mu Ugushyingo 2019 nibwo urubanza rwa Neretse rwatangiye kuburanishwa.  Yashinjwaga ibyaha 13 by’intambara na bitatu byo kwica muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Karirima Ngarambe / Palais de Justice Bruxelles

title: U Bwongereza: Umunyarwandakazi bikekwa ko yiyahuye avuye mu igorofa rya 19 yitabye Imana
content: Gatera yaguye mu Mujyi wa Birmingham ku wa Gatandatu, tariki ya 14 Ukuboza 2019, aho yari yasuye inshuti y’umuryango wabo yitwa Eric Gashema. Uyu mukobwa w’imyaka 31 yageze i Birmingham ku wa Kane, aho yari afitanye gahunda na Gashema yo kujyana mu masengesho. Gashema yagiye gutabara inshuti ye yapfushije umubyeyi mu Mujyi wa Manchester, ariko ntibajyana, uwo mukobwa aguma mu rugo. Uyu yerekeje i Manchester nyuma yo gusangira ifunguro rya mu gitondo na Gatera wari umeze neza, wanamusabye kumusigira ibitabo ngo abe asenga. Amakuru Polisi yo muri ako gace yahawe n’umuturanyi ni uko Gatera yaguye hasi ahagana saa Moya n’igice z’umugoroba. Yari asanzwe afata imiti y’indwara y’agahinda gakabije izwi nka ’dépression’. Gashema ngo yageze aho yari atuye ahagana saa Yine asanga polisi yahagose, aza kwemererwa kugera mu igorofa rya 19 yabagamo, ahageze asanga idirishya rifunguye ariko Gatera atarimo. Uyu musore yarebye hasi abona hashyizweho amahema ya Polisi, ahita ajya kubaza aza gusanga ari Gatera witabye Imana. Umurambo wa Gatera wari ugihari ariko yaba Gashema n’ababyeyi ba nyakwigendera [bahageze saa Sita] ntibabashije kuwubona kugeza utwawe na Polisi ahagana saa kumi zo mu rukerera rwo ku Cyumweru. Amakuru yizewe IGIHE ifite ni uko Gatera yari amaze igihe kirekire afite dépression ndetse yafataga imiti ku buryo yari yaratangiye kumererwa neza yiteguraga no gusubira ku ishuri. Gashema asanzwe ari inshuti n’umuryango wa Gatera, baragenderanira kuko bubatse ubucuti akiri mu Burundi. Gatera yabyinaga mu itorero aho yanatumirwaga muri gahunda zitandukanye za Ambasade y’u Rwanda. Yatangiye kubyina afite imyaka itatu aho yanyuze muri Troupe Urunana yo mu Busuwisi. Dépression ni indwara irangwa n’agahinda gakabije no kwiheba. Ishobora gufata uwo ari we wese, ku myaka iyo ariyo yose kandi iyo itavuwe ishobora gutuma uyirwaye afata imyanzuro yo kwiyambura ubuzima. Iyo iyi ndwara itavuwe kandi igira ingaruka zikomeye ku bukungu ndetse n’imibereho muri rusange kuko uyirwaye adashobora kugira icyo yimarira cyangwa ngo agire icyo akora cyamuteza imbere.

title: U Bubiligi: Abunganira Neretse Fabien bongeye kumvikana mu magambo apfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi
content: Uru rubanza rwa Fabien Neretse w’imyaka 71 ushinjwa kugira uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, rwatangiye ku wa 4 Ugushyingo 2019 ubwo hatoranywaga itsinda ry’abaturage bagomba gutanga ubuhamya bumushinja n’ubumushinjura. Nyuma y’iminsi itatu rutangira kuburanishwa mu mizi. Kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki 17 Ukuboza 2019 rwari rwakomeje humvwa abaregera indishyi, n’uruhande rw’abunganira Neretse mu Rukiko rw’i Bruxelles mu Bubiligi. Umunyamategeko, Me. Karongozi André Martin uhagarariye abafite abishwe muri Jenoside bigizwemo uruhare na Fabien Neretse, yabwiye IGIHE ko bakurikije uburyo yigira umwere batari bamwitezeho guhakana Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi nka kimwe mu bikorwa bya Jenoside ariko ngo umwunganira yavuze ko habaye Jenoside eshatu. Ati “Ku bwanjye icyo nababwira gitangaje, twagiraga ngo Neretse azashyira asubire inyuma, ntiyongere guhakana nkuko biri mu bikorwa bya Jenoside. Ntabwo rero byakunze, kugeza n’ejo umwavoka we yavuze ko habaye Jenoside eshatu. Iya Mbere yakorewe Abahutu, iya Kabiri yakorewe Abatutsi, n’iya Gatatu yo muri Congo ariko ibyo byose biterwa na FDLR.” Avuga ko ibyo ntacyo byongera ku kwiregura kwe ahubwo bakeka ko abikorera gutiza umurindi abahakana Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi hirya no hino ku Isi. Ati “Ntabwo rero twari tuzi ko bakomeza ibyo ngibyo kuko ntacyo bimwongerera mu kwiregura ariko ashobora kuba afite umugambi wo kuba ijwi ry’abantu bahakana ku Isi yose nibyo dukeka ubwo rero dutegereje ijambo rye rya nyuma yaduteguje ko azakenera isaha”. Uru rubanza rushobora kurangirana n’iki cyumweru, ngo ni rumwe mu zagoye ababuranyi barega Neretse. Me. Karongozi ati “Uru rubanza rwaratugoye ariko sitwe twenyine, abababaye cyane ni abatakaje ababo muri Jenoside.” Ni urubanza rwaranzwe n’amagambo akomeye apfobya kandi akomeretsa abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ni urubanza rwatangiye abunganira Neretse bari bafite inyandiko irenga amapaji 50 bavuga ko amateka y’u Rwanda avugwa uko atari, bavuga ko Abatutsi kuva na kera bicaga abantu ku buryo hari n’aho bavuze ko abishwe ari abanzi b’u Rwanda. Umwe muri abo bavoka yavuze ko abishwe byatewe na FPR kandi ko ari abantu bafashwe nk’abanzi b’igihugu anabigereranya n’Intambara ya Kabiri y’Isi yose. Me. Karongozi  yavuze ko nubwo ayo magambo atabashimishije ariko bizeye ko urukiko rwumvise ibyabaye byose kandi ko icyo bifuza ari uko Neretse ahanirwa icyaha cya Jenoside yakoze. Fabien Neretse ukomoka mu Ruhengeri yafatiwe mu Bufaransa mu 2011. Uyu mugabo wari ufite ijambo ku butegetsi bwa Habyarimana, ashinjwa kugira uruhare mu kwica Umubiligi Claire Beckers n’umugabo we Isaïe Bucyana n’umukobwa wabo Katia. Aba biciwe i Kigali ku wa 9 Mata 1994, nyuma y’iminsi mike Jenoside itangiye. Aregwa kandi ubwicanyi yakoreye iwa mu yahoze ari Perefegitura ya Ruhengeri ahitwa i Mataba barimo Mpendwanzi bivugwa ko yagiye kumushaka mu rugo rwe amushinja kuba icyitso cya PFR Inkotanyi nubwo yari Umuhutu.

title: Imyaka 75 irashize Ingabo za Amerika zibohoye Umujyi wa Bastogne mu maboko y’Aba-Nazi (Amafoto)
content: Iki gikorwa cyabaye kuva ku wa 13 gisozwa ku wa 16 Ukuboza 2019, cyitabiriwe n’abantu b’ingeri zose kuva ku bana kugeza ku basaza babonesheje amaso yabo iby’iyo ntambara. Abacyitabiriye beretswe imyiyereko y’uko urugamba rwagenze, hagamijwe no gufasha abakiri bato kumenya ko ubwisanzure bafite bwaturutse ku kumeneka kw’amaraso menshi. Abakuze bo baganiraga uko icyo gihe bari babayeho, ubuzima bukakaye banyuzemo, uko Abanazi bicaga urubozo imiryango y’Abayahudi n’uko babashije kurokoka. Intambara ya Kabiri y’Isi yatangijwe n’u Budage tariki ya 1 Nzeri 1939, icyo gihugu cyayoborwaga na Adolphe Hitler cyagabye igitero kuri Pologne. Iyi ntambara yarangiye mu 1945, ihitanye abantu bagera kuri miliyoni 80. Mu rwego rwo gusangira amateka yaranze ibihe n’ahantu habereye ibintu bikomeye byabera abakuru n’abato imfashanyigisho, umunyamakuru wa IGIHE yakurikiranye umuhango wo kwibuka imyaka 75 ishize Ingabo z’Abanyamerika zikuye Umujyi wa Bastogne mu maboko y’Aba-Nazi. Muri uyu muhango herekanywe uko umunsi wo kubohora akarere ka Bastogne wagenze, bikorwa mu myiyereko ya gisirikare aho ingabo zari zitwaje imodoka za gisirikare n’intwaro za rutura zitambuka mu baturage na bo bakazishimira bakoma mu mashyi ingabo zibabohoye. Iyi ntambara yatewe na Hitler wayoboraga u Budage   washakaga inzira yo gucamo muri Ardennes-Belge ashaka kwigarurira akarere k’icyambu cya Anvers. Uyu yaje kugubwa gitumo n’ingabo zari ziyobowe na Général Eisenhower [Dwight David "Ike" Eisenhower yabaye Perezida wa 34 wa Amerika hagati ya 1953 na 1961. Mu Ntambara ya Kabiri y’Isi yari jenerali mu Gisirikare akaba n’Umugaba w’Ikirenga w’Ingabo zahurijwe hamwe mu Burayi] barwana inkundura. Iyi ntambara ngo yabaye mu bihe bikonje cyane by’ubutita aho kubona ibibatunga n’amasasu byari ikibazo gikomeye. Baje guterwa ingabo mu bitugu n’ingabo zirwanira ku butaka zari ziyobowe na Général Patton, intambara yarangiye mu mpera za 1945. Bastogne ni umujyi w’igice kivuga Igifaransa mu Bubiligi uherereye mu Karere ka Wallonie mu Ntara ya Luxembourg ihana imbibi na Luxembourg; ni ahantu hatuje, hari ishyamba ryinshi n’imirambi. Umuhango wo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 75 Intambara ya Kabiri y’Isi muri Bastogne-Ardenne witabiriwe n’abantu barenga 100 000 mu minsi itatu wamaze. Ni igikorwa usanga cyahuruje imbaga nyamwinshi kuko amahoteli yuzura, umujyi na wo uba ushushe nk’icumbi cyangwa inkambi ya gisirikare kuko abenshi mu bawugenda baba bambaye impuzankano ya gisirikare mu guha agaciro n’icyubahiro ingabo nyinshi zahaguye n’izikiriho zibuka zikanerekana  ko Ingabo y’Igihugu ari ishema ry’umuturage. Ababaye abasirikare basubira mu myambaro yabo, aho urubyiruko rukunze igisirikare narwo rurimbishwa; ibi binajyana no kuba icyashara mu nzu zicuruza ibikoresho bya gisirikare kizamuka cyane. Mu Kiganiro IGIHE yagiranye n’Umuyobozi w’Umujyi wa Bastogne, Benoît Lutgen, yavuze ko iki gikorwa kigamije guha icyubahiro abitangiye guhagarika intambara. Yagize ati “Ibi tubikora mu rwego rwo kwibuka kuko ni ngombwa kugira ngo duhe icyubahiro abamennye amaraso ngo tube turi abo turi ubu. Abari abasirikare bake bakiriho tubashimire ku mugaragaro kandi ibi bikabera urugero Isi yose atari mu Bubiligi gusa, ahabaye ubwicanyi nka Jenoside n’intambara zitandukanye.’’ Ku wa Mbere ubwo uyu muhango wasozwaga witabiriwe n’Umwami w’u Bubiligi Philippe; Minisitiri w’Intebe w’u Bubiligi, Saphie Wilmès; Perezida w’Umutwe w’Abadepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko ya Amerika, Nancy Pelosi; Perezida w’u Budage Frank-Walter Steinmeier witabiriye bwa mbere iki gikorwa; Le Grand –Duc Henri wa Luxembourg; Charles Michel uyobora Inama y’ibihugu by’u Burayi n’abandi. Umwami Philippe yavuze ko abantu bakwiye kwitandukanya n’umwanzi no guharanira Uburenganzira bw’umuntu. Nancy Pelosi we yashimangiye ko iki gikorwa kijyana no kuzirikana ku kubaka ahazaza. Yagize ati “Ntitwibuka gusa amateka yabayeho, turebe n’imbere heza hacu.’’ Lutgen yashimye abitabiriye iki gikorwa, ashimangira ko kuba Perezida Frank-Walter Steinmeier yari ahari bigaragaza uko u Budage bushaka kunoza ubwiyunge. Ati ‘‘Nubwo kubabona bibaye bitinze ariko muhaye agaciro ingabo ziri hano zarwanye uru rugamba zikaruhagarika. Ni ubutumwa bukomeye ngo ibyabaye bitazibagirana, haba mu Bubiligi, u Burayi no ku Isi yose muhesheje agaciro kandi demokarasi no kutavugirwamo no kurwanya abaheza nguni aho bava bakagera.’’ Mu batanze ubuhamya harimo Malcolm Buck Marsh w’imyaka 96 y’amavuko ukomoka muri Leta ya Alabama muri Amerika. Uyu musaza wari ufite imyaka 21 ku rugamba yagize ati “Sinigeze ndota kuzagaruka aha Bastogne nyuma yo gutsinda uru rugamba, ariko binkoze ku mutima ukuntu mwatwakiriye, kuba mpawe ijambo hano ni uburyo bwiza bwo gusaba ko mu mirimo yacu ya buri munsi dusaba ko ku Isi haba amahoro.’’ Umuhango wo kwibuka ibihe byo guhagarika Intambara ya Kabiri y’Isi uha abasirikare bari ku rugamba umwanya wo gutanga ubuhamya, bakabwira abato ububi bwo kurwana no kumenya ko aribo ngabo z’ahazaza zigomba kurinda ubusugire bw’igihugu n’ubuzima bwacyo muri rusange.

title: Muri Colorado hatangijwe umuryango w’Abanyarwanda baba mu mahanga (Amafoto)
content:
Ni igikorwa cyateguwe ku bufatanye bw’Umuryango w’Abanyarwanda batuye muri Amerika, Ambasade y’u Rwanda muri Amerika n’Abanyarwanda batuye i Denver. Umuryango w’Abanyarwanda baba muri uwo mujyi ni mushya mu ihuza Abanyarwanda baba mu mahanga, umaze amezi make utangiye gukora. Mu ntangiriro hibanzwe ku gushaka abanyamuryango no gushyiraho inzego z’ubuyobozi byajyanye n’ibikorwa byo gufatanya gutekereza ku mateka y’u Rwanda n’uburyo bwo gufasha igihugu cyababyaye mu iterambere. Uyu muryango wamuritswe ku mugaragaro ku wa 30 Ugushyingo 2019, mu muhango witabiriwe n’abagera kuri 80 barimo Abanyarwanda n’inshuti z’igihugu zavuye mu bihugu birimo Amerika, Nepal, Slovenia [Intara yo muri Croatia], Kenya, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, u Bushinwa, Autriche, Nigeria, Ghana na Sénégal. Mu butumwa bwatanzwe hibanzwe ku gushimangira akamaro ko kwihuriza hamwe no guharanira ibyiza. Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Umuryango w’Abanyarwanda baba muri Amerika, Mbangukira Yehoyada, yagarutse ku rugendo rw’Abanyarwanda kugera ku iterambere igihugu gifite uyu munsi.
Yashimangiye ko hakenewe kurwanya ibihuha n’ingengabitekerezo, ihakana n’ivangura havugwa ubutwari bw’abarokoye abantu mu gihe cya Jenoside no kuzirikana uburyo bafasha u Rwanda kwiyubaka. Yibukije Abanyarwanda bose guterwa ishema n’igihugu cyabo, umuco n’umurage no kutibagirwa kuba abaturage beza no gukora cyane aho batuye muri Amerika. Umunyarwandakazi umaze imyaka irenga 14 aba muri Denver, Angelique Muregware, yavuze ko yishimiye kuba muri uwo muryango yifuza ko waramba, asaba buri Munyarwanda kuwujyamo no gutanga umusanzu mu kuwuteza imbere. Mu bandi batanze ibiganiro barimo Adolphe Kajangwe umaze imyaka igera kuri 20 muri Colorado, wayoboye ikiganiro cyavugaga ku gusura no gushora imari mu Rwanda. Ni ikiganiro cyagizwemo uruhare n’umunyemari ufite ishoramari muri Amerika akaba yaranabaye mu Rwanda amezi atandatu, Andrew Heaton, unateganya gushora imari ye mu Rwanda n’Umunyarwandakazi Françoise Mbabazi umaze imyaka igera kuri 15 muri Amerika n’abandi. Abo bose bagaragaje ubudasa bw’u Rwanda bushingiye ku miyoborere myiza. Bavuze ko bumva bizeye umutekano kandi ko biteguye gushora imari yabo mu Rwanda. Uwari uhagarariye Leta ya Colorado muri uwo muhango (Senator Field) yavuze ko ubuyobozi bwiteguye gufasha uwo muryango. Perezida w’Umuryango w’Abanyarwanda baba muri Amerika, Prof. Yves Musiine, yashimangiye impamvu Umuryango w’Abanyarwanda baba mu mahanga ari ngombwa. Avuga ko u Rwanda ruha agaciro abaturage barwo kugeza ku baba hanze yarwo. Yibutsa ko bagomba kubaho bagira uruhare mu iterambere ryarwo. Umujyanama mu by’Ubucuruzi muri Ambasade y’u Rwanda muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, Bonny Musefano, wari uhagarariye Ambasaderi, Mathilde Mukantabana, yavuze ko Abanyarwanda bagomba guterwa ishema n’igihugu cyabo. Ati “Mureke dufate akanya gato twibaze. Kuki waba ufite igihugu gitera imbere gutya bikaba bitakureba? Kuki dufite ingero nyinshi zikomeye ariko tukaba tugifite abagikwirakwiza amakuru atari yo?’’ Muri rusange yavuze ko abagize uwo muryango ababonamo abavugizi, abambasaderi n’abantu bakomeye bashishikajwe no gukora ibyiza bijyanye n’ibyo igihugu cyabo cy’amavuko cyagezeho, abasaba kubishyiraho umutima.

title: Danemark: Abanyarwanda bizihije isozwa rya 2019, basabwa kongera imbaraga mu cyerekezo 2050
content: Ibi birori byabereye mu Mujyi wa Copenhagen ku mugoroba wo ku wa 7 Ukuboza 2019, mu gikorwa  cyiswe Julefrokost gifatwa nk’igihuza inshuti n’abavandimwe zigasabana mu kwizihiza Noheli ndetse abana bagahabwa impano zitandukanye. Byasuzumiwemo ibikorwa byakozwe n’Umuryango w’Abanyarwanda batuye muri Denmark no mu nkengero zayo mu mwaka ndetse n’imishinga migari iteganyijwe mu wundi mwaka. Dr Innocent Ngoga Jim uri mu bagize Komite Nyobozi y’Umuryango Nyarwanda muri Denmark yavuze muri make ibyakozwe mu mezi 12. Ati “Twagize ibiganiro bigenewe urubyiruko byibanda ku mateka y’u Rwanda nk’igihugu cy’ababyeyi kavukire, aho kivuye n’aho kigeze ngo nabo bazabe Abanyarwanda bubakije ku muco n’ubupfura bazarengera bakanabungabunga amateka y’aho bakomoka n’aho batuye batahibagiwe.’’ Umuyobozi w’Urubyiruko rw’Abanyarwanda bahuriye mu itsinda ryitwa “Turikumwe”, Nshuti Enock, yavuze ko ababa muri Danemark bahuye ngo bafatanye mu kwiyubaka no gushyigikira ibikorwa biganisha u Rwanda ku iterambere. Yatanze urugero rw’umushinga wa Ntarama aho bafatanya n’urubyiruko rwo mu Rwanda gusana inzu ndetse bakaba banateganya kuzageza amazi meza ku baturage. Teajeni Misago uhagarariye Umuryango w’Abanyarwanda batuye muri Copenhagen- Danemark, mu ijambo rye yashimiye abitabiriye icyo gikorwa agereranya n’umuco wo guhuza. Yagize ati “Ndabamenyesha ko iyo urebye aho tugeze usanga hari intambwe nziza imaze guterwa mu gukomeza kwiyubaka nk’umuryango Nyarwanda muri Denmark.’’ Yashimiye komite bafatanyije kuyobora ubwitange yagaragaje, abayigize abasaba gukomeza ubwo bufatanye ngo bazese imihigo ibategereje mu 2020. Umunyamabanga wa mbere muri Ambasade y’u Rwanda muri Danemark, Umulisa Elise, yashimiye Umuryango w’Abanyarwanda batuye muri icyo gihugu intambwe nziza bamaze gutera ashimangira uruhare rw’urubyiruko rwitabira rukanagira uruhare mu bikorwa byose bitandukanye. Yavuze ko aho u Rwanda rugeze mu myaka 25 rubikesha ko habayeho gukorera hamwe nk’umuco abaturage batozwa n’ubuyobozi bwiza, bushyira imbere inyungu z’umuturage n’abari hanze y’igihugu bikatubera indorerwamo ntibatwibagirwe. Yakomeje ati “Icyerekezo 2020 ubu kigana ku musozo, u Rwanda ruteye imbere mu nzego zose z’ubuzima bw’igihugu, yaba mu miyoborere, ubutabera, imibereho myiza y’abaturage, ubuzima, uburezi, ubukungu n’ibindi. Hari byinshi tutarageraho ariko hari n’ibyo twagezeho.’’ Yabasabye ko “Icyerekezo 2050 tuzakigiremo uruhare mu kuzamura ubukungu bw’igihugu, buri Munyarwanda abashe kwigira no kwigenera ejo heza.’’ Muri iki gikorwa Komite Nyobozi yatanze ishimwe ku Munyarwanda wagaragaje ubwitange mu bikorwa byakozwe no ku nshuti zababaye hafi, zasuye u Rwanda, kandi zigafatanya na bo kurumenyekanisha. Uwahembwe ni Gael Ntaho na Clausen Steen n’umugore we bavuka muri Danemark. Abitabiriye ubu busabane basoje bataramirwa n’abahanzi batandukanye binyuze mu majwi meza y’abahanzi b’urubyiruko bafatanyije  n’umuhanzi waturutse mu Bubiligi DJ Flora Hilde Nyirimbabazi umaze kugira ubunararibonye mu mwuga wo kuvangavanga umuziki [DJ] mu Burayi. title: Icyo Amb.  Dr Ngarambe yavuze nyuma yo gutanga impapuro zo guhagararira u Rwanda mu Bufaransa
content: Ku wa 10 Ukuboza 2019 nibwo Ambasaderi Ngarambe yashyikirije Perezida w’u Bufaransa, Emmanuel Macron, impapuro zimwemerera guhagararira u Rwanda muri icyo gihugu. Ambasaderi Dr. Ngarambe yashyikirije Perezida Macron impapuro zimuhesha ububasha bwo guhagararira Repubulika y’ u Rwanda i Paris mu muhango wabereye mu Ngoro y’Ibiro Bikuru bya Perezida bizwi nka Elysée. Nyuma yo kunyura imbere y’itsinda ry’abasirikare bashinzwe kurinda ubusugire bwa Repuburika biyerekana bavuza akarumbeti, Ambasaderi Ngarambe n’Umunyamabanga wa mbere muri Ambasade y’u Rwanda i Paris, Muneza Yves bakiriwe na Komanda w’Ingoro ya Perezidansi n’ushinzwe kwakira abantu [Protocol]. Perezida Macron yakiriye icya rimwe abambasaderi b’ibihugu 33 batanze impapuro zo guhagararira ibihugu byabo mu Bufaransa. Nyuma y’ijambo rye, Perezida Macron yakiriye impapuro z’ambasaderi bahagarariye ibihugu byabo, bakurikiranye bitewe n’uko bageze ku butaka bw’u Bufaransa. Amb.  Ngarambe kimwe na bagenzi be na we yaganiriye na Perezida Macron nyuma yo gutanga impapuro zimuhesha ububasha bwo guhagararira u Rwanda mu Bufaransa. Mu kiganiro na IGIHE, Amb. Ngarambe yavuze ko gutanga impapuro zimwemerera guhagararira u Rwanda mu Bufaransa ari intangiriro yo gusohoza ubutumwa. Yagize ati ‘‘Ni intangiriro nyakuri y’urugendo rwo gusohoza ubutumwa nahawe n’umukuru w’igihugu. Uru rugendo ndutangiranye icyizere gishingiye ku bushishozi, ubushake no kwizerana abakuru b’ibihugu bakomeje kugaragaza.’’ Yakomeje avuga ko “Njyendeye kuri byinshi bimaze kugerwaho mu butwererane no gushyigikirana cyane cyane mu myaka ya vuba, umugambi no kubakira ku byagezweho, kugendera ku mabwiriza n’inama z’ubuyobozi bukuru bw’igihugu ni byo  bizanshoboza gutanga umuganda mu kunoza, guteza imbere no kubyaza umusaruro umubano hagati y’ibihugu byacu byombi.’’ Dr. François-Xavier Ngarambe yahawe kandi inshingano zo kuzahagararira u Rwanda mu Butaliyani, Espagne na Monaco. Azanahagararira bihoraho inyungu z’u Rwanda mu miryango mpuzamahanga irimo uw’Ibihugu bivuga Igifaransa (OIF); Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Burezi, Ubumenyi n’Umuco (UNESCO); Umuryango uharanira Ubufatanye mu Bukungu n’Iterambere (OECD), Ishami rya Loni ryita ku Buhinzi n’Ibiribwa ku Isi (FAO), Ikigega Mpuzamahanga cy’Iterambere ry’Ubuhinzi (IFAD), Ishami rya Loni ryita ku Biribwa (WFP) n’Umuryango Mpuzamahanga w’Ubukerarugendo (WTO). Muri Gicurasi nibwo u Bufaransa bwasohoye iteka rya Perezida wa Repubulika n° 2019-435 ryo ku wa 13 Gicurasi 2019, rigena ko kuwa 7 Mata, ari itariki ngarukamwaka yo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ingingo ya Mbere y’iri teka ivuga ko ‘Itariki ngarukamwaka yo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ni 7 Mata’. Ingingo ya Kabiri ivuga ko ‘Buri mwaka kuri iyi tariki, ibikorwa byo kwibuka bizajya bitegurwa i Paris. Ibikorwa nk’ibi kandi bishobora gutegurwa kandi muri buri ntara bigizwemo uruhare n’umuyobozi wayo [Perefe]’. Ingingo ya Gatatu yaryo ivuga ko Minisitiri w’Intebe afite inshingano zo gushyira mu bikorwa iri teka, rizasohoka mu igazeti ya leta ya Repubulika y’u Bufaransa. U Bufaransa kandi bwanashyigikiye kandidatire ya Louise Mushikiwabo ubwo yiyamamarizaga kuyobora Umuryango w’Ibihugu bikoresha Igifaransa, OIF, umwanya yatorewe ahigitse Michaëlle Jean mu Ukwakira 2018. Muri Gicurasi 2018, Perezida Kagame yasuye u Bufaransa anagirana ibiganiro na Emmanuel Macron ku birebana n’ubucuruzi, ishoramari, ikoranabuhanga, ubuzima n’umubano hagati y’ibihugu byombi. Mu bindi bimenyetso biheruka bigaragaza ubushake bw’u Bufaransa, harimo ubwo muri Mata 2019, Perezida Macron yatangazaga ko agiye kongerera imbaraga urwego rw’ubutabera mu gukurikirana abagize uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, hakanashyirwaho Komisiyo y’abahanga mu mateka, iziga ku ruhare rw’u Bufaransa muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Muri Nyakanga 2019 u Bufaransa bwohereje i Kigali umuyobozi mushya w’ibikorwa bya Ambasade, Jérémie Blin, umugabo ufite ubunararibonye mu bijyanye na politiki ufite ibigwi nk’umudipolomate. title: Ishyirahamwe RESIRG mu gikorwa cyo gutera inkunga ubushakashatsi kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi
content: Iki gikorwa cyabereye mu nzu ndangamuco y’Abanya-Arménie ya Hay Doun (Centre Arménien Hay Doun) iherereye mu Mujyi wa Bruxelles mu Bubiligi ku wa 7 Ukuboza 2019. Cyitabiriwe n’abantu barenga 100 barimo Abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo, bahuye bagasangira bakanataramirwa n’intore z’Itorero Ukwezi. Icyo gitaramo cyanasusurukijwe n’Umunyarwandakazi Kayiganwa Julienne uzwi ku izina rya Big Mama. Banasangiye amafunguro yiganjemo aya Kinyafurika. Ishyirahamwe RESIRG (Réseau International Recherche & Génocide), ryashinzwe kandi riyoborwa  n’Umunyarwanda Déo Mazina. RESIRG yiyemeje guharanira kwimakaza umuco wo kubana mu mahoro kubaha ubuzima bwa buri wese, no kurwanya ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside kuko ariyo yagejeje u Rwanda aharindimuka. Ivugira ikanita ku bacitse ku icumu rya Jenoside yokorewe Abatutsi kuko utakwibuka abishwe ngo wibagirwe impfubyi zabo cyangwa abapfakazi basize. Mu ijambo yagejeje ku bitabiriye iki gikorwa, Mazina yashimiye abantu bose bitabiriye icyo gikorwa n’abafite ku mutima gushyigikira RESIRG. Yagize ati “Igihe ni iki ngo dukomeze kwishyira hamwe no guterana inkunga mu bushakashatsi n’ubwanditsi bukorwa n’abacitse ku icumu rya Jenoside kuko aribo bafata iya mbere mu kubikora. Biri mu byatumye iri shyirahamwe rivuka kugira ngo ngo rishake amikoro yo kubatera ingabo mu bitugu.’’ Yasobanuye ko iryo shyirahamwe rije kunganira ayari asanzwe mu gikorwa cy’indashyikirwa cyo kubungabunga no kumenyekanisha amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, mu budasa, ubumwe n’ubwuzuzanye. Yakomeje avuga ati “Umushinga tuzatangiriraho ni uwo gufasha ababyeyi bari batwite mu gihe hakorwaga Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Iki gikorwa kizadufasha gushyira hamwe ubuhamya bwabo; bavuga uko bababajwe mu bihe bikomeye. Barindiriye urupfu aho gufashwa nk’ababyeyi batwite kugeza n’ubwo akababaro bagasangira n’ibibondo babyaye bareba urupfu imbere yabo.’’ Mazina yavuze ko iyi ntambwe izafasha mu kwandka amateka no kwishakamo imbaraga zo gukomeza ubuzima. Ati “Iri shyirahamwe RESIRG ni iryanyu mwebwe dufatanyije uru rugamba rw’amateka u Rwanda rwaciyemo ariko dukora ngo abana bacu ntibazongere kuyabamo ukundi.’’ Mazina yanasabye ko buri wese yatera inkunga urubanza rwa Fabien Neretse uregwa ibyaha by’ubwicanyi muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 mu Rwanda, rumaze igihe rubera i Bruxelles kandi rugikomeza. Ubwo ibikorwa bya RESIRG byatangizwaga mu 2015, Ambasaderi Robert Masozera mu biganiro byabereye muri Kaminuza yigenga y’u Bubiligi (ULB) yavuze ko Jenoside ari nka kanseri iramutse itavuwe neza ngo irandurwe n’imizi yazagera aho igakwira umubiri wose. Umunyamakuru Colette Braekman mu kiganiro mbwirwaruhame yagiriye muri Luxembourg na we yashimangiye ko “Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ni nka kanseri yambutse imipaka igafatira n’akarere kandi k’Ibiyaga Bigari nko muri Congo. Tugomba kuyihiga ikavurwa, bitabaye ibyo yazafatira n’ibindi bice bya Afurika bisigaye.’’ RESIRG ifite icyicaro i Bruxelles mu Bubiligi biteganyijwe ko izagira n’andi mashami mu bindi bihugu. Iri shyirahamwe  riyoborwa  na Déo Mazina; Umunyamabanga waryo ni Dr Jean Mukimbiri; Umubitsi ni Anny Nyagatare, Ushinzwe itangazamakuru ni Mylliam Joie Umugwaneza. RESIRG yatangijwe ku wa 9 Gashyantare 2013, yitwa RESIR (Réseau Scientifique International pour la Recherche et l’Information sur le Rwanda et sur l’Afrique des Grand Lacs), mu Kinyarwanda ni Urugaga rw’abanyarwanda b’impuguke biyemeje gukora ubushakashatsi ku Rwanda no ku bihugu by’ibiyaga bigari. RESIRG yabonye ubuzima gatozi inatangazwa mu igazeti ya Leta y’u Bubiligi, ku wa 13 Gicurasi 2019.  	Inkuru bifitanye isano: Ishyirahamwe RESIRG rikora ubushakashatsi kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ryemewe n’u Bubiligi Amafoto: Jessica Rutayisire

title: Michel Mpambara, umuhanzi ufite inzozi zo gushinga ishuri ry’ikinamico zo gusetsa mu Rwanda
content: Uyu mugabo uri mu kigero cy’imyaka 46 y’amavuko avuka mu muryango w’abana batanu, abakobwa babiri n’abahungu batatu. Kubera amateka u Rwanda rwaciyemo, yavukiye mu Burundi mu mujyi wa Bujumbura muri 1973, nyuma ajya gutura muri Canada mu ntangiriro za Nyakanga 1990 n’ababyeyi be. Kuva ku myaka 17 yize ibijyanye n’ikinamico (Acteur de Praticien du Théâtre). Bwa mbere atangira yakinnye umukino aho yigaga muri Kaminuza ya Laval (Université Laval – Théâtre provocation) umukino mu kinyarwanda twavuga ko ari agasomborotso cyangwa ukora mu jisho bitewe n’uko wakiriwe. Aha yanditse uwitwa ‘Je suis raciste’ ndi umuhezanguni mu yandi magambo. Mu kiganiro na IGIHE, Mpambara yavuze uburyo ubwo yari mu ishuri ry’ubugeni rya Québec [Conservatoire d’art dramatique de Québec], umwarimu waturukaga mu gihugu cya Argentine yamubwiye ngo ntaho uzagera kubera ko byumvikana mu mvugo aho aturuka (accent). Ibi ariko ntibyamubereye inzitizi ahubwo yabishyizemo imbaraga agera ku rwego ahabwa ibikombe. Muri 2001 yabonye igihembo cy’umuhanzi wa mbere mu gusetsa bita Meilleur Spectacle humour, ku cyumweru tariki ya 8 Ugushyingo 2019, nabwo yabaye mu ba mbere batoranyijwe mu gice bita ‘Gala Les olivier’ mu mukino yise ‘Y a trop de Blanc au Québec’ mu Kinyarwanda ugenekereje ni ‘Hari abazungu benshi muri Québec’. Uyu mukino utamenyereye ibijyanye no gutebya muri uyu mwuga wacyeka ko yarengereye. Mpambara avuga ko kuba umuhanzi kuri uru rwego rwo gusetsa bituma aruhura imitwe y’abantu kandi agahitisha ubutumwa budashobora kuvugwa gutya gusa. “Ati ni umwuga nkunze mazemo igihe kandi umpemba neza”. Mpambara yanagarutse ku mushinga afite wo kuzafungura ishuri ry’ubuhanzi bw’ikinamico rijyanye no gusetsa. Ati “Uyu mushinga si igitekerezo cyanjye gusa ahubwo tubihuje kandi twabiganiriye n’inshuti yanjye Mighty Popo Murigande uzwi cyane muri muzika hano muri Canada”. Murigande ni umuyobozi w’ishuri ry’umuziki ryo ku Nyundo rikorera i Muhanga. Mpambara avuga ko uyu mugabo yamushishikarije gushinga ishuri ryo gusetsa mu Rwanda. Ati “Ariko wowe Michel ko uzi ibya Théatre et Humour [ikinamico no gusetsa] kuki utaza tugashinga ishuri ryabo hano, ni uko igitekerezo cyaje, nanjye nkagira icyo nkorera u Rwanda nkunda bijyanye n’umwuga nkora nkunze cyane kandi utarasakara cyane iwacu”. Mpambara avuga ko kwiga ibijyanye n’ikinamico no gusetsa byatunguye abantu benshi ariko yabitewe na Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yamukoze ku mutima akababara cyane bigatuma ashaka icyamubera inkingi mu mutwe. Avuga ko kwandika no gukina amakinamico bimufasha kandi bifasha n’abandi. [email protected]

title: Gakunzi Makuza agiye gutangiza mu Rwanda umuryango uzusa ikivi cy’umugore we watabarutse
content: Igikorwa cyo gutangiza Heart of Worship in Action Foundation kizabera mu Ubumwe Grande Hotel ku wa 27 Ukuboza 2019 kuva saa Kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba. Uyu muryango ufite intego yo gushyigikira ibikorwa bitandukanye bigamije guhindura ubuzima bwa benshi binyuze mu kubaka no kongerera ubushobozi bw’abari muri sosiyete runaka. Heart of Worship in Action Foundation yashinzwe na Willy Gakunzi n’umugore we Estelle. Aba bombi bahuriye mu Buholandi mu 2004, barakundana ndetse bahuza  inzozi zo gusakaza ibikorwa by’urukundo. Nyuma y’imyaka itanu bashyingiwe bakomeje umuhamagaro wo kuramya Imana no kwitangira ibikorwa byo gukunda abantu. Mu buzima bwabo bashyize imbaraga mu bikorwa bigamije kongerera ubushobozi urubyiruko, impunzi, abahohotewe n’abagore batishoboye. Mu bihugu byose babayemo birimo u Buholandi, u Bubiligi na Canada, ibyo bakora byarashyigikiwe bituma na bo bakomeza inzira biyemeje. Ku wa 8 Ugushyingo 2018 nibwo Estelle yitabye Imana, Gakunzi asigarana n’abana be babiri Kayla na Shayna. Kuva uwo munsi, Imana yahaye Gakunzi iyerekwa ryo gutangiza Umuryango Heart of Worship in Action nk’uburyo bwo kumuzirikana. Gakunzi yavuze ko mu kumuha icyubahiro azakomeza ibikorwa bye by’ubugiraneza. Yagize ati “Nta buryo bwiza bwo kwishimira no guha icyubahiro Estelle nko  gukomeza gushyira mu bikorwa umutima we wo kuramya. Duhamya tudashidikanya ko binyuze muri uyu muryango ubuzima bwa benshi buzakorwaho kandi buhinduke bwiza.’’ Willy M. Gakunzi amaze igihe kirekire yitangira gukorana n’urubyiruko n’abantu bamukikije mu bikorwa bigamije guhindura imibereho yabo. Gakunzi afite Impamyabumenyi y’Icyiciro cya Gatatu cya Kaminuza mu bijyanye n’Ubukungu, International Economics and Business, yakuye muri Kaminuza ya Utrecht mu Buholandi. Anafite icyemezo nk’umuhanga mu gutegura igenamigambi (Functional Business Architect) yakuye mu Ishuri rya CEVORA na Kaminuza ya Antwerp mu Bubiligi. Gakunzi afite ubunararibonye mu gukorana n’ibigo by’imari mu bice bitandukanye ku Isi. Mu nshingano ze abifasha gushaka no gushyiraho uburyo bwo guhangana n’ibyago byatuma bigwa mu gihombo. Uyu mugabo afatanya izi nshingano no kwandika indirimbo akaba n’umuramyi. Yashinze amatsinda yo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana ku Isi. Gakunzi avuga ko ashishikazwa no kubaka ubushobozi bw’abantu by’umwihariko urubyiruko n’abadafite ubushobozi bagahindurirwa imibereho. Ati “Nizera ko hatitawe ku ho umuntu aba n’ubuzima arimo, iyo ufite uburyo bwo kubona igishoro n’ubumenyi bukwiye, ushobora gukora umushinga wahindura ubuzima bwawe.’’ Heart of Worship in Action Foundation ni umuryango udaharanira inyungu watangirijwe muri Canada mu 2019.  	Umva indirimbo “Izina Ryawe’’ ya Makuza Gakunzi

title: Abitabiriye imurikagurisha rya ILTM-Cannes basangijwe amahirwe y’ubukerarugendo ari mu Rwanda (Amafoto)
content: ILTM-Cannes ni imurikagurisha riri mu yo ku rwego ruhambaye abera mu Bufaransa, ahahurira ibigo bikomeye bikora muri uru rwego biturutse mu mfuruka zose z’Isi. U Rwanda rwitabiriye ILTM (International Luxury Travel Market) ruhagarariwe na RDB n’ibigo icyenda byigenga  byaturutse  mu rw’Imisozi 1000. Bigizwe n’amatsinda ahagarariwe na Manzi Kayihura (Thousand Hills Africa), Robert Gakimbiri (Primate Safaris), Daniel Ndizeye (Akagera Aviation), Elise Milenge (Charleston Tours), David Rutikanga ( Songa Africa), Eloisa Barberis Canonico (Volcanoes Safaris), Roberto Viviani (Wilderness Safaris), Simon Bruce Miller (Uber Luxe Safaris) na Bonita Mutoni (One&Only). RDB nk’ikigo kigenzura, kikanareberera hafi ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo cyari gihagarariwe na Kageruka Ariella na Ndandali Philbert. Mu gusoza iri murikagurisha rishyirwaho akadomo kuri uyu wa 5 Ukuboza 2019, RDB yasangiye abaryitabiriye amahirwe y’ubukerarugendo ari mu Rwanda n’uko igihugu cyahanze uburyo bworohereza ishoramari ryabwo. Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ishami ry’Ubukerarugendo no kubungabunga za Pariki muri RDB, Kageruka Ariella, yavuze ko imurikagurisha ryo ku rwego nka ITLM ari umwanya mwiza wo kwamamaza ibyo u Rwanda rukora mu bukerarugendo no kugaragaza ibishya ruteganya. Yagize ati “Yari inama yihariye yari yateguriwe u Rwanda gusa tugirana inama mbwirwaruhame tuganira na bagenzi bacu bakora mu bigo  by’ubukerarugendo mu bihugu bitandukanye by’Isi, twabasobanuriye byimbitse ibyo dufite byo kugaragariza abakerarugendo.’’ Yavuze ko abantu bahuye na bo ari abifuza cyane kumenya amakuru yerekeye u Rwanda. Yakomeje ati “Abantu benshi barakomeza kuduha ubuhamya bati u Rwanda ba mukerarugendo barakomeza kurushaka kubera uko mukora ubuvugizi naho mugeze. Ibi rero biratwongerera ibakwe ryo kurushaho kubashakira ibyiza no kunoza serivisi baza basanga kugira ngo u Rwanda rukomeze rureberwe muri iyo ndorerwamo.’’ Yashimangiye ko ubukerarugendo bugezweho ari bwa bundi buhindura ubuzima bw’uwafashe umwanya we agatembera. Ati “Ubukerarugendo burahinduka mu buryo abakerarugendo batakijya gusa gusura ahantu ahubwo bifuza ko n’aho hantu na bo habasigira ikintu cyubaka ubuzima bwabo mu mitekerereze cyangwa mu myumvire.’’ Abenshi mu basuye aho ibigo byo mu Rwanda byamurikiye serivisi bitanga abenshi babazaga amakuru ajyanye n’ibiciro cyangwa ibindi bintu bakora birenze gusura ingagi n’izindi nyamaswa ziboneka muri Pariki zitandukanye mu gihugu. Kageruka yavuze ko bafite ishimwe cyane ko iminsi bamaze i Cannes mu Bufaransa yatanze umusaruro mu rugendo rwa Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yo guteza imbere ubukungu bushingiye ku bukerarugendo. Imibare ya RDB igaragaza ko mu 2017 u Rwanda rwinjije miliyoni $438 zivuye mu bukerarugendo, bijyanye n’intego ya Guverinoma yihaye ko mu 2024 inyungu ruvana mu bukerarugendo igomba kwikuba kabiri ikagera kuri miliyoni $800. Abitabiriye ibiganiro bisoza imurikagurisha ryabereye mu Mujyi wa Cannes babajije ibibazo bitandukanye, bamarwa amatsiko na RDB n’abandi bahagarariye ibigo byabo byari bihagarariwe. Buri wese mu witabiriye ahawe impano ya film ngufi yakozwe ku Rwanda na Visit Rwanda; uko bakoresha ikoranabuhanga rigezweho mu kubona amakuru y’ingenzi ku Rwanda. Abahagarariye ibigo byaturutse mu Rwanda babwiye IGIHE ko iki gikorwa ari ishoramari ryiza rizatuma barushaho kwagura ibikorwa n’ibitekerezo kugira ngo abaza gusura u Rwanda basanganizwe serivisi zinoze.  Abayobozi baserukiye ibigo byo mu Rwanda bari biganjemo urubyiruko, imigirire itanga icyizere ku hazaza h’ubukerarugendo rwubakiye ku bakiri bato.  Ibigo byitabiriye imurikagurisha ry’i Cannes birimo ibitanga serivisi zo gutwara ba mukerarugendo, amahoteli n’ibindi. ILTM Cannes 2019 yitabiriwe n’abasaga 6000 barimo abakiliya, itangazamakuru n’abamurika baturutse mu bihugu 134 ku Isi. Amafoto: Karirima Ngarambe/ Cannes

title: Tujyane i Cannes, umujyi wihariye mu kwakira amaserukiramuco ahambaye ku Isi (Amafoto)
content: Umujyi wa Cannes uherereye mu gace ka Côte d’Azur [Kitwa French Riviera mu Cyongereza cyangwa Costa Azzurra mu Gitaliyani] ku Nkombe y’Inyanja ya Méditerranée mu Majyepfo ashyira Uburasirazuba bw’u Bufaransa. Cannes yamamaye cyane kubera ubwiza bw’ikirere cyaho, amaserukiramuco arimo iryo ku rwego mpuzamahanga rya Sinema rihuriramo ibihangange mu bijyanye na sinema ndetse n’amamurikagurisha ahuza ibihugu bitandukanye ku Isi. Uyu mujyi uri ku buso bwa kilometero kare 19.62, ubushakashatsi bwo mu 2015 bwagaragaje ko utuwe n’abaturage basaga 74,285. Cannes iri mu mijyi ikundwa, ikanagendwa cyane mu iherereye mu gace ka Côte d’Azur nka Nice na Saint Tropez. Abatembera muri uyu mujyi ni abaherwe bafite agatubutse ariko hari n’ahagenewe abafite ubushobozi buciriritse. Ba mukerarugendo batembera muri uyu mujyi, abenshi basura ahantu nyaburanga hatandukanye harimo Église Notre Dame d’Esperance, yubatswe mu kinyejana cya 16. Hafi y’iyo kiliziya hari inzu ndangamurage yiswe “Musée de la Castre”, ibarizwamo ibikoresho by’ubugeni ndetse yubatse mu buryo abayisura bashobora kuyurira bakayihagarara hejuru bakitegera ibice biyikikije. Ubwamamare bw’Umujyi wa Cannes kandi bunashingiye ku Iserukiramuco Ngarukamwaka rya film riba muri Gicurasi, aho ibyamamare mu Isi ya Sinema bihurira. Ribera ahazwi nka Palais des Festivals aherekanirwa film zatunganyijwe mu mfuruka zose z’umubumbe. Muri aba harimo n’abafite amaraso y’u Rwanda kuko nko mu Iserukiramuco Cannes Film Festival ryabaga ku nshuro ya 71 muri Gicurasi 2018 ryitabiriwe na Miss Sonia Rolland. Uyu yatoranyijwe mu bahanga muri sinema bakoze film nziza ku bagore, ndetse hari izerekanwa zirimo ‘Femmes du Rwanda’ na ‘Une Vie Ordinaire’. Cannes Festival yahawe izina rya International Film Festival mu 2002 yerekanirwamo film z’ubwoko bwose n’ibyegeranyo byakorewe ku Isi hose. Yashinzwe ku wa 20 Nzeri 1946. Mu nzu iberamo iryo serukiramuco uyo winjiyemo ubonamo amafoto y’ibihangange byanditse amateka muri Sinema guhera kuri Sylvester Stallone twamenye nka Rambo n’abandi.  	Izingiro ry’ubwamamare bwa Cannes Iyo uvuye muri metero nke mu Mujyi wa Cannes hari uturwa tune turi hamwe twitwa “Îles de Lérins” turimo Sainte-Marguerite nini kandi yishimirwa gusurwa mu mpeshyi. Cannes iherereye mu gace ka Côté d’azur ku Nyanja ya Méditerrané, Akarere kari gatuwe cyane kuva mu kinyejana cya Mbere ya XIX. Abaturage baho bari batunzwe  n’uburobyi n’indi mirimo ifitanye isano n’ubushabitsi bukorerwa hafi y’amazi. Nyuma y’intambara nyinshi zahabereye ku bavuga Igifaransa n’Icyongereza n’ururimi rwo muri Espagne mu ntangiriro z’ikinyejana ya 19 nibwo Cannes yagaruye agahenge ku bwa  Henry Peter Brougham wari  Chancelier w’u Bwongereza. Kuva icyo gihe iterambere rya Côte d’Azur ryarihuse, itera imbere bidasubira inyuma. Uyu mujyi kandi waje kwamamara, ugira umwihariko udasanzwe ku Isi guhera hagati mu kinyejana cya 19 kubera Iserukiramuco rya Film rikorerwa i Cannes. Uyu munsi ni ahantu hakomeye haruhukira ibyamamare kandi hakabera amaserukiramuco yo ku rwego ruhanitse, inama zakira abakuru b’ibihugu n’abandi bayobozi bo ku rwego rwo hejuru. Bakururwa cyane n’uburyo uyu mujyi wateje imbere ubukerarugendo n’ibijyana nabyo haba mu kwakira abantu no kuzamura ibikorwa remezo by’amahoteli, amaresitora ndetse inzu nyinshi zizwi zicuruza imyenda n’ibijyanye n’imideli zihafite ibyicaro. Ibi byiyongeraho n’ibihe byiza ako karere kagira nk’izuba hagati y’inyanja n’ubutaka nabyo bikurura abakerarugendo, hakarushaho kuba umuryango winjiza ubukungu n’isura nziza y’u Bufaransa. Hari benshi basura aha hantu bashaka kujya gutemberera ku bwogero no kuhogera. Abenshi banishimira kuba bafata ka vino kiganje muri uyu mujyi nk’ikinyobwa gikundwa n’abahatemberera. Cannes mu 2011 yakiriye Inama ya G20, ihurirwamo n’abayobozi b’Ibihugu nk’u Bufaransa, Amerika, u Bwongereza n’ibindi by’ibikomerezwa. Cannes ifite amahoteli ari ku rwego rw’inyenyeri eshanu arenga atanu yamamaye kubera gutanga serivisi zo ku rwego rwo hejuru. Umujyi wa Cannes ni wo wakira imurikagurisha rikomeye ry’Ubukerarugendo rizwi ku izina rya ILTM (International Luxury Travel Market). Kuri ubu riri kuhabera ku nshuro ya kane ndetse u Rwanda binyuze mu Kigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB) rurahagarariwe mu nyubako iryakira ya ‘Palais des Festivals’. ILTM ihuza abaguzi, abagurisha n’abafatanyabikorwa mu bijyanye n’ubukerarugendo bwo ku rwego rwo hejuru ‘‘Tourisme de Luxe.’’; ryitabirwa n’abaturutse mu bihugu bitandukanye byo muri Afurika, Aziya, Amerika y’Epfo, Cannes, iby’Abarabu n’u Bushinwa. Amafoto: Karirima A. Ngarambe / Cannes

title: U Rwanda rurahagarariwe mu imurikagurisha rikomeye ry’ubukerarugendo mu Bufaransa (Amafoto)
content: Iri murikagurisha ryo ku rwego rwo hejuru rizwi nka ILTM (International Luxury Travel Market) ribera i Cannes. Ni ku nshuro ya kane u Rwanda rwitabiriye iri murikagurisha. ILTM ihuriza imbaga mu nzu y’ahitwa ‘Palais des Festivals’ isanzwe yakira ibyamamare muri sinema ku rwego mpuzamahanga, inama mpuzamahanga zihuriramo abakuru b’ibihugu n’imiryango mpuzamahanga n’andi maserukiramuco akomeye. Rihuza abaguzi, abagurisha n’abafatanyabikorwa mu bijyanye n’ubukerarugendo rwo ku rwego ruhanitse baturutse ku Isi yose mu bihugu byo muri  Aziya, Amerika y’Epfo, Afurika, Cannes, iby’Abarabu n’u Bushinwa. U Rwanda ruhagarariwe n’abagurisha ubukerarugendo bigenga  baryitabiriye babifashijwemo na Leta y’u Rwanda binyuze muri  RDB. Itsinda ry’Abanyarwanda bitabiriye imurikagurisha ry’Ubukerarugendo rigizwe na Manzi Kayihura (Thousand Hills Africa), Robert Gakimbiri (Primate Safaris), Daniel Ndizeye (Akagera Aviation), Elise Milenge (Charleston Tours), David Rutikanga ( Songa Africa), Eloisa Barberis Canonico (Volcanoes Safaris), Roberto Viviani (Wilderness Safaris), Simon Bruce Miller (Uberluxe Safaris), Bonita Mutoni (One&Only) na Ariella Kageruka na Philbert Ndandali bahagarariye RDB. Aho bari kumurikira ibikorwa byabo harimbishijwe mu buryo buhamagararira abahanyura gusura u Rwanda bakareba ibyiza rufite mu rwego rw’ubukerarugendo. Kageruka Ariella uhagarariye RDB yabwiye IGIHE ko bitabiriye iri murikagurisha rihanitse ngo bagaragarize amahanga serivisi zitandukanye zitangwa mu Rwanda muri uru rwego. Yagize ati “Twazanye n’ibigo bigurisha ubukerarugendo mu Rwanda, aho buri wese avuga u Rwanda ariko akanerekana serivisi ashobora gutanga. Ni byiza ko dukomeza kwitabira amamurika nk’aya yo kuri uru rwego nk’Abanyafurika  n’Abanyarwanda bafite muri gahunda gukomeza guteza imbere ubukerarugendo mu gihugu  ngo tugere ku ntego twiyemeje.’’ Yavuze ko mu Rwanda hari hoteli nshya zizamurwa ndetse na Sosiyete y’Ubwikorezi bw’Ingendo zo mu kirere, RwandAir biri mu bituma ubukerarugendo butera imbere kurushaho. Yakomeje avuga ko “Turi hano ngo tubwire Isi ko ibyo ukora ntubyerekane ngo bitange umusaruro ntacyo uba ukora, aha rero turi gukora ubuvugizi. Tuganira n’abo twasanze tukabereka uburyo tuborohereza ingendo n’ibyo bazaba baje gusura mu Rwanda.’’ Ubukerarugendo bw’u Rwanda kuva mu myaka 10 ishize bukomeza kuzamuka no kongera ingano y’amadovize bwinjiriza igihugu. Kageruka yavuze ko uko ubukerarugendo bukura harebwa uburyo abakerarugendo bake binjiza inyungu nyinshi bitewe n’imishinga yagutse ibakururira gusura u Rwanda. Elise Milenge uhagarariye Charleston Tours mu kiganiro na IGIHE yavuze ko mu gutangira bakiraga abantu 10 biyongereye bagera kuri 15 kandi bishimira serivisi bahabwa. Ati “Sinkubeshya abakiliya banjye ni bo bampa ingufu zo gukomeza gukorana n’u Rwanda kuko iyo baje iwanyu baza bifuza kugaruka natwe tukagaruka kuko baba bakoze ubuvugizi.’’ Yashimiye Leta y’u Rwanda na RDB yaborohereje mu mikoranire bigatuma akazi kabo kagenda neza. Ati “Usanga kandi abakiliya bacu bagaruka kubera umutekano, isuku kugira GPS mu gihugu, internet yihuta, amahoteli meza agerwaho biradufasha cyane tukabona uko tubareshya kandi tubereka ukuri kw’ibyo bazakoresha.’’ Milenge yavuze ko batangiye kubona n’Abanyafurika ya Ruguru mu bihugu birimo Maroc n’ahandi babaza uko bagana mu Rwanda. Imurikagurisha ry’Ubukerarugendo rya 2019 ryitabiriwe n’ibigo 6000 byose byambara ikirango kiriho Visit Rwanda. [email protected]

title: Abanyeshuri b’Abanyarwanda basoje amahugurwa ku ikoranabuhanga mu Bushinwa
content: Gahunda ya Huawei yise ‘Seeds for the Future’ ni irushanwa ritegurwa n’icyo kigo hagamijwe kugaragaza abahanze imishinga y’ikoranabuhanga ritanga ibisubizo ku bibazo bya sosiyete. Mu ntangiriro za Ugushyingo 2019 nibwo abagera ku munani bahize abandi mu irushanwa rya 2019 bashimiwe ndetse Umuyobozi wa Huawei atangaza ko ku wa 15 Ugushyingo 2019 bazerekeza mu Bushinwa. Bagenda bahawe impanuro na Minisitiri w’Ikoranabuhanga na Inovasiyo, Ingabire Paula bageze mu Bushinwa bakirwa na Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri icyo gihugu, James Kimonyo. I Beijing basuye  Umujyi witiriwe Chairman Mao, urukuta rw’amateka rw’u Bushinwa ‘Chinese Great Wall’ na Stade y’Igihugu y’u Bushinwa ‘Beijing Olympics Stadium’. Huawei yanateguye amahugurwa y’icyumweru ku muco n’ururimi yabereye kuri Kaminuza y’Indimi n’Umuco ya Beijing. Abanyeshuri babashije kwandika Igishinwa ndetse bagira n’ikizamini abagitsinze bahabwa impamyabushobozi. Banasuye kandi basobanurirwa ikoranabuhanga rigezweho rya internet yihuta ya 5G, iry’ubwenge bw’ubukorano (AI), Internet of Things (IoT) ifasha ibikoresho kwakira no kohereza amakuru mu ikoranabuhanga n’iryo koroshya imikoresherezwe ya mudasobwa na internet (Cloud Computing). Abo banyeshuri bagarutse mu Rwanda ku wa 30 Ugushyingo 2019 bavuze ko bangukiye byinshi muri urwo rugendo. Nsabiyumva Willy wiga Computer Science muri Kaminuza Yigenga ya Kigali yavuze ko ibyo babonye mu Bushinwa bihamya ibishoboka igihe impano z’abantu zitaweho. Ati “Inkuru ya Huawei n’u Bushinwa yerekana ko abantu bize bagahabwa n’ubushobozi impano zabo zikitabwaho bitanga umusaruro n’impinduka abantu batatekerezaga.” Iradukunda Karangwa Prosper wiga muri Kaminuza y’Abalayiki b’Abadiventisiti b’Umunsi wa Karindwi yavuze ko ibyo yamenyeye mu Kigo cy’Ikoranabuhanga cya Shenzhen byamweretse ko hari byinshi yavumbura mu Rwanda. Ati “Muri Shenzhen hateye amatsiko, ni n’amahirwe yo kwagura ubumenyi bwo kumenya ibigezweho mu ikoranabuhanga nka 5G,  AI,  IoT na  Cloudy Computing igiye kuyobora Isi ibi bizamfasha kuvumbura amahirwe ari mu gihugu cyanjye.” Muri Shenzhen, abanyeshuri banasuye inzu ndangamurage ‘Shenzhen Museum’ ivuga inkuru y’uko uwo mujyi wabaye igicumbi cy’ubukungu wubatswe mu myaka 38 ukomotse ku mudugudu wari ushingiye ku bworozi bw’amafi. Abanyeshuri basuye ikoranabuhanga ritandukanye ririmo ibijyanye n’itumanaho, uruganda rwa 5G, ahamurikirwa ibikorwa bya Huawei n’uburyo bwo kubaka no gusuzuma  4G na 5G. Iri ni itsinda rya kabiri risuye u Bushinwa muri gahunda ya Huawei “Seeds for the Future” abandi bakaba bari bagiyeyo mu 2018 ubwo iyo gahunda yamenyeshwaga Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame. U Rwanda rwasinyanye amasezerano y’imikoranire na Huawei agamije guteza imbere uburezi no kwihutisha ikoranabuhanga ku wa 16 Werurwe 2017, nyuma y’ibiganiro Perezida Kagame yagiranye n’Umuyobozi wayo Sun Yafang. Ni amasezerano agena ko iki kigo kizafasha u Rwanda kuzamura abanyempano mu ikoranabuhanga, kubaka ububiko bw’amakuru ari kuri internet (Data Center), umuyoboro wagutse wa internet, ikoranabuhanga rituma abafite umuriro w’amashanyarazi boroherwa no kubona internet (Smart Grid) n’uguze umuriro wo gukoresha ugashobora guhita wijyana muri mubazi ku bw’iyo internet.

title: Abakozi ba RICEM bari mu Buhinde bifatanyije n’abandi mu muganda
content: Nk’abandi banyarwanda bose, kuri uyu wa  Gatandatu wa nyuma w’ukwezi  iryo tsinda ryazindukiye  mu muganda  ryifatanyije n’abayobozi   n’abakozi ba EDII. Ibikorwa by’isuku byakozwe harimo gutoragura amasashi mu kigo imbere no mu nkengero z’ikigo, gukubura n’ibindi. Nyuma y’umuganda habayeho no gucinya akadiho no gusangira mu rwego rwo gusabana. Umuyobozi mukuru wa EDII,  Dr. Snil Shukla yitabiriye umuganda anashimira abanyarwanda bateguye igikorwa cy’umuganda kandi abizeza ubufatanye. Umuyobozi wa RICEM, Dr. Mukulira Olivier uyoboye abanyarwanda bari mu mahugurwa na we yitabiriye   umuganda afata umwanya wo gusobanurira Abahinde umuganda ndetse n’akamaro kawo. RICEM ni ikigo gishinzwe guhugura amakoperative, ba rwiyemezamirimo n’ibigo by imari biciriritse giherereye ku Kabusunzu mu murenge wa Nyakabanda akarere ka Nyarugenge. Binyuze muri Minisiteri y’ubucuruzi n’inganda abakozi bacyo boherejwe mu gihugu cy’u Buhinde mu mahugurwa yo gufasha abashaka kuba ba rwiyemezamirimo n’abasanzwe ari ba rwiyemezamirimo guhanga imirimo mishya no konoza ubucuruzi. EDII ni ikigo gishinzwe guteza imbere kwihangira imirimo no gufasha ba rwiyemezamirimo gutera imbere. Guverinoma y’u Buhinde na Guverinoma y’u Rwanda bifitanye umushinga wo gushyira ikigo India Rwanda Development Center( IR EDC) nacyo kizaba gishinzwe gufasha abashaka kuba ba rwiyemezamirimo  n’abasanzwe ari ba rwiyemezamirimo kugira ngo bakure. Ni muri urwo rwego abanyarwanda  15 bagiye mu mahugurwa y’amezi abiri  kugira ngo uwo mushinga ushyirwe mu bikorwa .

title: U Bubiligi: Harimo kumurikwa amateka yihariye ku Rwanda binyuze mu gikorwa cyiswe RwandAfrica
content: Iki gikorwa kizwi nka “RwandAfrica” kizaba kirimo n’imikino y’ikinamico kizanashyirwa mu bikorwa n’iryo tsinda riyobowe n’umunyarwanda Carole Karemera, afatanyije n’umuhanzi Denis Mpunga, umwe mu banyafurika bakunze kugaragara ku rwego mpuzamahanga muri sinema n’amakinamico. Mu kiganiro IGIHE yagiranye n’aba bahanzi ku wa 28 Ugushyingo 2019, bari mu Bubiligi, bagarutse ku buryo iki gikorwa bagiteguye n’uburyo kizafasha benshi kumenya amateka yihariye y’u Rwanda. Karemera yagize ati “Iyi gahunda igamije kwerekana amateka y’u Rwanda rw’ejo hashize, uyu munsi n’ejo hazaza haba mu bugome bwakozwe igihe hakorwaga Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi n’uko u Rwanda rwagiye rubisohokamo nyuma yayo, rukiyubaka n’imbere rwifuriza urubyiruko.” Karemera avuga ko nk’umuntu wavukiye mu Bubiligi akanahakurira, yahisemo kujyana ubumenyi mu gihugu kavukire cy’ababyeyi, kugira ngo agire icyo akora mu muganda wo kubaka igihugu cyari cyaragizwe umuyonga. Yavuze ko RwandAfrica ari gahunda ireba cyane urubyiruko rwaba urwo mu Rwanda cyangwa i Burayi kuko ibyakozwe muri Jenoside bitibagirana kandi ‘Bitanagomba kuduherana’. Ati “Tugomba kubirenga tugakorera hamwe, ari abana bavuka kubishe bababazwa n’ibyo ababyeyi babo bakoze, ari abana biciwe ababo bose bakeneye kubaho neza, ubuhanzi rero n’imwe mu ntwaro zo kubafasha kubimenya no kubiganiraho mu buryo budahutaza uwariwe wese.” Karemera yasobanuye ko imikino izerekanwa itandukanye, buri wose wihariye kandi ujyanye n’ibihe bitandukanye. Hari uwitwa ‘Hier, aujourd’hui, Demain’ cyangwa se Ejo heza, uyu munsi, Ejo hazaza ugenekeje mu Kinyarwanda na filimi yitwa ‘We call it love’ yanditswe na Felwine Sarr  uyobowe na Denis Mpunga. Hari kandi uwitwa ‘La Cathédrale sonore’ wanditswe na  Cécilia Kankonda afatanyije na Carole Karemera, ‘Les enfants d’Amazi’  ugenewe cyane urubyiruko, wanditswe na  Rivardo Niyénizigiye uyobowe na Bernard Chemin, Denis Mpunga na Carole Karemera. Ni igikorwa kizamara iminsi icyenda izarangwa n’imigoroba ihuza abantu kugira ngo bongere baganire aho u Rwanda ruvuye, aho rugeze n’aho rwifuza kugana mu buryo bwo gusangira ibihangano ku banyaburayi n’Abanya-Afurika baba i Bruxelles. Ku wa 7 Ukuboza uzaba ari umunsi udasanzwe mu gusoza, aho hazaba igitaramo kizatangira saa kumi n’ebyiri kikageza mu gitondo saa mbiri, kizitabirwa n’abahanzi barenga 50 bagize itsinda RwandAfrica baririmba, bivuga, babyina, bavuga ibisigo basoma interuro zimwe zo mu bitabo. Hazaba n’ibiganiro byatumiwemo Félicité Lyamukuru uyobora Ibuka Mémoire &Justice-Belgique, Martine Beckers uharanira ko abakoze Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi babihanirwa mu Bubiligi n’ahandi. Hari kand Me Michèle Hirsch umwunganizi w’abiciwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu manza zitandukanye ziri kubera mu Bubiligi, Jacques Delcuvellerie Uyobora ubuhanzi muri Groupov, wanayoboye Théatre Rwanda 94. Mpunga yavuze ko ikintu cyose cyakoze ku mutima w’umuntu  kidasaza ariko kandi kitagomba kumubera inzitizi ku buzima buri imbere. Ati “Nibyo turimo dukora kugira ngo amateka u Rwanda n’abandi bagize ingorane nkarwo muri Afurika n’ahandi ibibazo bye kuba icyuho ahubwo ubuhanzi bube igikoresho kimeze nk’iteme ryo kwambukiraho tugana mu buzima butubereye.” Mpunga yavuze ko Karemera akora kugira ngo ibijyanye n’umuco ntibibe gusa igikoresho cy’ubukungu n’iterambere ahubwo bibe n’uburyo bw’imibereho myiza y’abaturage, kuko nta gahugu katagira umuco. Ati “Ibikorwa bye mu bihe bitari cyera bizavugwa mu mateka y’u Rwanda kuko arimo arabiba iteme rizahuza ibice byose by’u Rwanda kugira ngo urubyiruko rwibone mu ndorerwamo y’umunyarwanda koko.” Yavuze ko mu kazi k’ubuhanzi bakora icyiza ari uko buri wese afite umwanya wo kuvuga icyo atekereza mu buryo bw’ubuhanzi bigahita ntawe bihutaje, kuko ikinamico rivuga rikina ariko rivuga ukuri buri wese akumva akibonamo akibaza cyangwa akisubiza.
