title: U Busuwisi: Ambasaderi Rwakazina yibukije urubyiruko icyo rutegerejweho mu gusigasira ibyagezweho
content: Ibi Rwakazina yabitangarije i Genève mu mpera z’icyumweru gishize mu mugoroba wahuje Abanyarwanda n’inshuti z’igihugu zituye mu Busuwisi. Ibiganiro byatangiwe muri iki gikorwa byibanze ahanini ku kurebera hamwe  uburyo Abanyarwanda baba mu Busuwisi na bo bagira uruhare mu iterambere ry’u Rwanda no guteza imbere imikoranire hagati ya Ambasade n’Abanyarwanda babarizwa ku butaka bw’icyo gihugu. Mu ijambo Rwakazina yagejeje ku bitabiriye uyu mugoroba, yasabye Abanyarwanda by’umwihariko urubyiruko rutuye mu Busuwisi kugira uruhare mu itarembere ry’igihugu no gusigasira ibyo cyagezeho. Yagize ati “Turabasaba mwese, cyane cyane abakiri bato amaboko yanyu, imbaraga zanyu, ubwenge n’ubushishozi byanyu ngo tubumbatire ibyagezweho. Ariko cyane cyane turabasaba ngo mufate iya mbere mu gukemura bimwe mu bibazo igihugu cyacu kigihanganye nabyo.” Ambasaderi Rwakazina yanasangije Abanyarwanda baba mu Busuwisi intambwe ishimishije u Rwanda rumaze gutera mu rugendo rwo kwiyubaka haba mu bukungu, mu mibereho myiza y’Abanyarwanda no mu miyoborere myiza. Yaboneyeho n’umwanya wo gukangurira abifuza gushora imari mu Rwanda ko imiryango ifunguye. Rwakazina yanagarutse ku buryo u Rwanda rumaze kuba inyenyeri imurikira amahanga rubifashijwemo n’ubuyobozi bwiza burangajwe imbere na Paul Kagame. Yagarutse ku ruhare u Rwanda rwagize mu mavugurura atandukanye yakozwe mu Muryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe akagira umumaro munini. Uyu muhuro wabaye n’umwanya mwiza w’amashyirahamwe y’Abanyarwanda akorera mu Busuwisi kugaragaza ibikorwa bitandukanye nkaho “Ibuka-Suisse” n’Urunana yamurikiye abitabiriye iyi nama ibikorwa byabo bigamije kurwanya Jenoside n’ingengabitekerezo yayo no guteza imbere umuco Nyarwanda muri rusange. Abanyarwanda baba mu Busuwisi bagaragarijwe kandi uburyo u Rwanda rushishikajwe no kwita ku mibereho y’abaturage barwo batuye mu mahanga, aho inyungu zabo zirengerwa mu buryo butandukanye.

title: Umunyarwandakazi yafunguye inzu itanga serivisi z’ubwiza mu Bubiligi
content: Uwitonze ni Umubyeyi w’umwana umwe w’ubatse utuye mu mu karere gaherereye ahitwa  "Flandre Occidental", akarere gafite ubukungu buri hejuru y’utundi turere tugize u Bubiligi, kakaba kari no ku Nyanja ya Ruguru (Mer du Nord). Uyu mugore avuga ko iyo urebye uko mu Rwanda abikorera bagenda batera imbere mu kwihangira imirimo, wifuza kugendana nabo nubwo waba uri hanze y’igihugu. Avuga ko umuhate wo kurushaho kwikorera wiyongereye ubwo yitabiraga Rwanda Day i Bonn mu Budage, akumva ubutumwa bwa Perezida Kagame. Ati "Nk’umugore rero nkaba narasanze nakora ibikorwa bijyanye n’ubwiza kuko abagore dukunda gusohoka dukeye kandi kubigeraho birahenda, niyo mpamvu nafunguye iyi nzu Vavavoom izajya icururizwamo imisatsi myiza ivuye mu Buhinde kandi imisatsi nyamisatsi tuba twahawe mu nsengero n’abantu bafite myinshi bakayitangaho impano." "Twe icyo dukora ni ukuyitunganya igacishwa mu byuma byabigenewe kugirango igezwe ku isoko ari nta makemwa. Iyi nzu nafunguye kandi izaba ihuriro ry’abantu baje gukorerwa isuku ibijyanye n’umubiri, bahabwa inama amavuta abereye umubiri wabo, gushyirirwaho inzara bifuza z’ubwoko butandukanye n’ibindi." Uwitonze avuga ko iki gikorwa cye mu minsi iri imbere ateganya no kugifungura mu Rwanda, mu Bufaransa n’ahandi. Vavavoom ni inzu iherereye mu mujyi wa Bruxelles muri Komine ya Ixelles, aho bita Matonge. Ni ahantu hakorerwa n’abanyafurika benshi n’abandi banyamahanga baturuka hirya no hino ku Isi, bikahagira ihuriro rikomeye ry’ibicuruzwa. Matonge ubu imaze kugirwamo ibikorwa bitandukanye n’Abanyarwanda, hari abahafite amaduka, resitora, amagaraji, inzu zikora ibijyanye n’amafaranga nka Rwandacash/Africash, inzu zikora iby’ubwikorezi n’ibindi. Abanyarwanda batuye mu Bubiligi muri rusange usanga ari abakozi mu buryo bushimishije, mu kwihangira imirimo kuko kubona akazi bishoboka ariko bigoye. Usanga abari hagati y’imyaka 25 na 50 abenshi bakorera ba rwiyemezamirimo b’abanyarwanda, ibintu bishimisha kubibona. Iyi myaka kugirango ubabone uhengera ikiruhuko cyo ku wa Gatandatu naho ubundi bose baba bari mu bikorwa byo kwiteza imbere. Ibi ubuyobozi bw’aho batuye burabibakundira cyane kuko usanga abanyarwanda bashimwa na bose, kuko bavuga ko ari abakozi cyane kandi bo kwizerwa. [email protected]

title: Abapolisi b’u Rwanda bambitswe imidali y’ishimwe muri Centrafrique
content: Imidali bambitswe ku wa 16 Ugushyingo 2019 yari iyo kubashimira uruhare bagize mu kugarura amahoro n’umutekano muri iki gihugu. Umuhango wo kubambika iyi midali wabereye mu Kigo cya ‘‘Camp Combattant” giherereye mu Murwa Mukuru wa Bangui. Witabiriwe n’Umuyobozi wungirije mu Butumwa bwa Loni ushinzwe politiki no kurinda abasivili, Kenneth Gluck n’uhagarariye Polisi mu butumwa bw’Umuryango  w’Abibumbye mu kugarura amahoro muri iki gihugu, Komiseri  Generali  Pascal  Shampion; General  Coulibaly Bamoro ushinzwe guhuza ibikorwa bya Polisi n’ingabo ziri mu butumwa bwa Loni, Abanyarwanda batuye muri Centrafrique n’abandi batandukanye. ACP Damas Gatare uhagarariye Umutwe w’Abapolisi bari mu butumwa bwa Loni bwo kugarura amahoro muri Repubulika ya Centrafrique (RWAFPU I) yashimiye Umuryango w’Abibumbye n’ubuyobozi bw’igihugu ku bufasha n’ubufatanye babahaye kugira ngo buzuze inshingano zabo neza. Yagize ati “Nshimiye abari mu butumwa bw’Umuryango w’Abibumbye bwo kugarura amahoro muri Centrafrique (MINUSCA) ku mikoranire myiza n’ubufanye batweretse kugira ngo tugere ku nshingano zo kugarura amahoro n’umutekano muri iki gihugu.” Uhagarariye Polisi mu butumwa bwa Loni bwo kugarura amahoro muri Centrafrique (MINUSCA) CG Pascal  Shampion yashimiye ubuyobozi bw’u Rwanda n’abapolisi bari muri ubwo butumwa uruhare bagira mu kugarura amahoro. Yagize ati ‘‘Ndashimira Guverinoma y’u Rwanda na Polisi y’u Rwanda by’umwihariko kubera umusanzu batanga mu kugarura amahoro muri iki gihugu. Ndashima n’ibindi bikorwa  by’indashyikirwa bitandukanye mukorera mu butumwa bw’umuryango  w’abibumbye muri iki gihugu.” Yakomeje ashima Perezida wa Repubulika y’u Rwanda Paul Kagame wasuye iki gihugu mu kwezi gushize, avuga ko bigaragaza uburyo ashishikajwe no kugarura amahoro mu Isi. Umuyobozi wungirije mu butumwa bwa Loni muri Repubulika ya Centrafrique  ushinzwe politiki no kurinda abasivili, Kenneth Gluck, yashimye ubwitange abapolisi b’u Rwanda bagaragaza mu kugarura amahoro. Yagize ati “Ndashima umusanzu mutanga mu butumwa bwa Loni mu kugarura amahoro muri iki gihugu, ndashima uruhare mugira mu kurinda ibigo bya leta n’abaturage bakuwe mu byabo n’imidugararo ahitwa Batangafo. Ibi bigaragaza ko n’amatora azaba mu minsi izaza azabaho mu ituze.” Polisi y’u Rwanda yatangiye kohereza abapolisi mu butumwa bw’Umuryango w’Abibumbye  bwo kugarura amahoro muri Centrafrique guhera mu 2014;  muri iki gihe bagizwe n’imitwe itatu, irimo ibiri ishinzwe kubungabunga no kugarura amahoro muri rusange n’umutwe umwe ushinzwe kurinda abayobozi.

title: U Bubiligi: Urubanza rwa Fabien Neretse ushinjwa ibyaha bya Jenoside rwakomeje humvwa abatangabuhamya
content: Urubanza rwakomeje ruha abatangabuhamya umwanya usesuye wo kuvuga uko bamwe bo mu miryango yabo bishwe n’agatsiko kari kayobowe na Fabien Neretse. Mu gitondo cyo ku wa Gatanu, ahagana saa tatu nibwo hatanzwe ubuhamya bwa Martine Beckers ugize itsinda rya Parties Civiles, wavuze uko umuvandimwe we w’Umubiligi Claire Beckers n’umugabo we Isaïe Bucyana n’umukobwa wabo Katia bishwe. Martine Beckers ati “Guhera tariki ya 7, 8 n’iya 9 Mata 1994, navuganaga na mwene mama Claire Beckers kuri telefoni nubwo byari bigoye, ariko twaravuganaga. Umugabo wanjye yagiye kwihisha mu nzu twakoreragamo ubucuruzi iherereye i Nyamirambo. Ku wa 8 Mata twatewe n’Interahamwe zivuye ku muturanyi Sisi Evariste, baraza badukorera ubugome burenze ubwenge.’’ Martine akomeza avuga ko ubwa nyuma yavuganye na Claire Beckers yari tariki ya 9 Mata 1994 saa sita, nyuma ntibongeye kuvugana, nibwo tariki ya 10 Mata mu gitondo biciye ku nshuti ye yari iri mu Bubiligi nawe abibwiwe n’inshuti yo mu Rwanda yari ituye mu Kiyovu yitwa Florence ko umuryango wa Bucyana n’abo bari kumwe bishwe. Martine Beckers yanavuze uko yageze mu Rwanda muri Nzeri 1994 asanga hari abana babili Regine na Emmanuel barokotse babaga mu muryango wo kwa Bucyana i Nyamirambo, bikaba byari biteganyijwe ko nabo baza gutanga ubuhamya ku gicamunsi cya tariki ya 15 Ugushyingo. Martine Beckers ubwo yari mu Rwanda icyo gihe yabashije kubona icyobo rusange bari bajugunywemo bamaze kubica batangiye kuribwa n’imbwa. Perezida w’Urukiko yakomeje kumubaza ibibazo na we agasubiza yerekana n’amafoto, avuga uko umuvandimwe we Claire Beckers yari umugore w’umukozi ubana neza n’abantu bose, ufasha abandi, watangaga n’amasomo y’Igifaransa, wikoreraga ubucuruzi n’ibindi. Ati “Birababaje cyane kuba baranyiciye umuvandimwe nakundaga nk’uwo. Umukobwa wabo bishe akiri muto wari umwana ugira urugwiro, ukunda siporo, uhora yisekera mu bandi nta rungu ndetse Bucyana yari umuntu ucishije make w’umukozi w’umva abamugannye.’’ Muri uru rubanza kandi humviswe abatangabuhamya bava inda imwe aribo Mpendwanzi Godelive na Rwigenza Jacques bavuka kuri Joseph Mpendwanzi wishwe n’agatsiko kayobowe na Fabien Neretse kuko ngo yari umuyoboke wa FPR Inkotanyi. Rwigenza yavuze ko Se yari Umuganga kera akaza kubeshyerwa ko yashatse guhirika ubutegetsi bwa Habyarimana bigatuma aciribwa mu cyaro agakomeza kwibera umuhinzimworozi. Ati “Neretse turamushinja ibyo yakoze tariki ya 9 n’iya 10 Kamena 1994 ubwo we n’Interahamwe yayoboraga mu Mataba ahahoze ari Komini ya Ndusu baje ku manywa y’ihangu bagafata data bakajya kumwica urubozo bamwita ngo ni inyenzi nkuru. Yoherezaga abana ba rubanda mu Nkotanyi kandi mu by’ukuri nta gihamya bafite ahubwo byari uburyo bwo kugira ngo babone uko bamuhitana kuko wari umugambi bari bamufitiye guhera 1980 ubwo nyine bamubeshyeraga ko ngo yari afite uruhare mu guhirika ubutegetsi bwa Habyarimana.’’ Ngo byanagizwemo uruhare n’uwari Burugumesitiri wa Komini Ndusu, Bigirimana Jean Sauveur wakwirakwizaga izo mpuha avuga ko Mpendwanzi ari Inkotanyi. Neretse Fabien icyo gihe yashyizeho igihembo cy’ibihumbi 60 Frw ku muturage uzerekana aho Pendwanzi ari ndetse hari umugore waje kumubona arabivuga, arafatwa yicwa urupfu rw’agashinyaguro. Rwigenza yavuze ko gutanga ubuhamya hari ababimuziza ngo kuki abikora kandi ari Umuhutu, ariko we ashimangira ko atahishira Umuhutu wishe abantu. Ati “Dutanga ubuhamya ngo ukuri kumenyekane kujye hanze. Icyo gihe nari mukuru ndabyibuka nari mfite imyaka 23 na murumuna wanjye arabyibuka wari ufite imyaka 21 ubu utuye mu Rwanda.’’ “Ikindi bavuga ngo dukorera FPR Inkotanyi, njye rwose sinkora politiki nkora umwuga w’ubwunganizi mu Buganga, ntaho mpurira na politiki.’’ Umunyamakuru w’Umubiligi wakunze gutara inkuru ku Rwanda no mu Karere k’Ibiyaga Bigari, Colette Braeckman, na we mu buhamya bwe yibanze ku nyandiko n’ingendo yakoreye mu Rwanda n’uburyo yamenye ibihabera bigatuma ahibanda. Yatanze isura y’uko yabonye itutumba ryagaragazaga itegurwa n’ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Yatanze ingero z’ibiganiro yagiranaga na bagenzi be b’abanyamakuru igihe yabaga mu Rwanda akumva abanyamakuru b’Abatutsi bamusezeraho igihe batandukanye bwije. Yagaragaje uko abanyamakuru b’Abatutsi bagendaga bikandagira batinya kwicwa ndetse n’uko indangamuntu yarimo ubwoko yakoreshejwe mu kwica no guhitamo abicwa. Yerekana uko Radio RTLM yari radiyo ikurikiranwa cyane kandi icishaho indirimbo zikunzwe mu bwenge bwo kugirango abayikurikira hagati y’ibiganiro bajy babwirwa n’ubutumwa bwo gucamo abanyarwanda ibice no kubabibamo urwango. Braeckman yagaragaje ko abavuga ko indege yahanuwe n’Inkotanyi bitari gushoboka kuko yarasiwe mu Kigo cya Gisirikare cya Kanombe kuko usibye kuba nta musirikare w’Inkotanyi wahageraga ni ahantu n’Umututsi wese atakandagizaga ikirenge kuko habaga harinzwe. Ati “Ibi ni ibintu bizwi, ushaka kubyumva arabyumva.’’ Umwunganizi wa Neretse, Jean Flamme, amubwiye ko byagaragaye ko ibisasu byayihanuye byavuye mu Burusiya bigaca muri Uganda, Braeckman yamusubije ati “Wowe uratangaje kuko wakoze ubushakashatsi bwananiye abandi babuze irengero ry’ibimenyetso.’’ Braeckman yanagarutse ku gihe yigeze gutumirwa na Minisitiri w’Intebe Uwilingiyimana Agathe akamubwira ko umutekano we utameze neza, akanamubwira ko barimo bategura kuzica Abatutsi. Ati “Ibi byose byamugeragaho muri raporo yahabwaga na serivisi ze zibishinzwe. Ku giti cyanjye nagerageje kwandika ntabaza nyuma yaho umwe mu banyamakuru bo mu Rwanda twakundaga gukorana ansezeyeho ngarutse mu Bubiligi ambwira ko atazi ko tuzongera kubonana ndetse aza kwicwa kuko yari Umututsi.’’ Mu kwisobanura Umwunganizi wa Neretse yireguye agarura FPR Inkotanyi mu bisobanuro bye. Byageze aho Perezida w’Iburanisha azamura ijwi kugira ngo ye kurengera mu buryo yabazaga butajyanye ni uko bigomba kugenda mu rubanza. Ku mugoroba hatanzwe ubuhamya bwa Régine Bategure na musaza we Nkaka Emmanuel barokokeye mu mirambo bari bazi ko bishwe. Bavuga uko baje guhigwa na Neretse yababuze mu mirambo byerekana ko abicwaga bose babaga bazwi iyo baburaga umurambo w’umuntu barongeraga bagahiga aho yaba yarokokeye cyangwa yihishe. Aba bombi bavuze ko bibuka neza neza ibyo Neretse yakoze kuko bararebaga. Mu bagombaga gutanga ubuhamya harimo uwo mu muryango wa Sissi Evariste utabashije kuboneka kubera impamvu z’uburwayi. Iburanisha ritaha riteganyijwe ku wa 18 Ugushyingo 2019, saa tatu z’igitondo, ahazakomezwa gutangwa ubuhamya no kubazwa ibibazo ku bantu batandukanye.  [email protected]

title: Ibigo byo mu Rwanda byatambukanye umucyo mu Imurikagurisha ry’Indabo mu Buholandi (Amafoto)
content: Iri murikagurisha ry’iminsi itatu ryaberaga mu Mujyi wa Fijvehuizen hafi y’uwa Amsterdam ryasojwe kuri uyu wa Gatanu, tariki ya 8 Ugushyingo 2019. Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Buholandi, Jean Pierre Karabaranga, yavuze ko ibigo byaserukiye urwa Gasabo byabonye umwanya wo gusobanura no kugaragariza abaryitabiriye amahirwe ari mu gihugu. U Rwanda ni ku nshuro ya kane rwitabiriye iri murikagurisha, rwari ruhagarariwe n’ibigo birimo “Bella Flowers” ihagarariwe na Muganga Walter, Victor Omuga na Bloom Hills Rwanda Ltd ihagarariwe na Shungo Harada ari nawe uyiyobora. Ibigo byaryitabiriye byafashijwe n’Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe kohereza mu mahanga ibikomoka ku Buhinzi n’Ubworozi mu Rwanda (NAEB) na Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Buholandi. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE, Ambasaderi Karabaranga yavuze ko iri murikagurisha ryababereye umwanya mwiza wo gusobanura serivisi zitandukanye igihugu gifitiye abakigana by’umwihariko amahirwe ahari mu bijyanye n’ubuhinzi cyangwa ishoramari ry’indabo. Ati “Hari n’abantu baba baje gushaka isoko, baje gushaka indabo nziza bazajyana ku isoko mpuzamahanga. Dufite indabo nziza turimo kuboneraho n’umwanya wo gusobanurira abandi bantu ko u Rwanda ruhinga indabo kandi nziza.” Yakomeje agira ati “Iyi minsi itatu ni ukugira ngo dusobanurire abitabiriye iri murikagurisha tubashe no kugera kuri benshi tutabashije kugeraho mu bihe byashize.” Uyu mwaka u Rwanda rwaserukanye ubwoko bugera kuri 18 bw’indabo z’amaroza bwose bushobora koherezwa mu mahanga. Muganga Walter uhagarariye Bella Flowers yagize ati “Dufite indabo nyinshi ku isoko, abantu bamaze kumenya ko mu Rwanda hari igihugu gicuruza indabo n’Abanyarwanda bakwiye kumenya ko indabo ari ubucuruzi kandi tukaba twanagira abantu baza kubyiga bagakora ishoramari mu ndabo.” Yavuze ko iri murikagurisha ryabafunguriye imiryango kuko babonye amahirwe yo kugaragaza ubwoko butandukanye bw’indabo ziri mu Rwanda. Abamuritse indabo baturutse mu Rwanda bashimye igihugu cyabafashije kubona umwanya wo kumurika ibyo bakora ku ruhando mpuzamahanga. Muri uyu mwaka, aho bakorera haragutse ndetse Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Buholandi ibafasha kubona ahantu hegereye irembo ry’abinjira ku buryo kubona indabo zabo byoroha. Aho ibigo byo mu Rwanda byamurikiye indabo hari urujya n’uruza rw’abantu, basobanuza uko indabo zihingwa n’imbaraga zashyizwe muri iryo shoramari. Ubuhinzi bw’indabo ni ishoramari ryunguka kandi rimaze guhabwa agaciro mu Rwanda, kuko rishobora kwinjiza amadovize mu gihugu ndetse n’Abanyarwanda batari bake rikabaha imirimo. Mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari wa 2017/18, umusaruro w’indabo u Rwanda rwohereza mu mahanga wanganaga na toni 144.

title: U Rwanda rwitabiriye ku nshuro ya kane Imurikagurisha Mpuzamahanga ry’indabo mu Buholandi (Amafoto)
content: U Rwanda ruhagarariwe n’ibigo birimo “Bella Flowers” ihagarariwe na Muganga Walter, Victor Omuga na Bloom Hills Rwanda Ltd ihagarariwe na Shungo Harada ari nawe uyiyobora. Iri murikagurisha ry’iminsi itatu u Rwanda rwitabiriye ku nshuro ya kane riri kubera mu Mujyi wa Fijvehuizen hafi y’uwa Amsterdam, aho ryatangiriye ku wa 6 Ugushyingo mu gihe rizashyirwaho akadomo ku wa 8 Ugushyingo 2019. Ibigo byaryitabiriye byafashijwe n’ Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe kohereza mu mahanga ibikomoka ku Buhinzi n’Ubworozi mu Rwanda (NAEB) na Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Buholandi. Mu kiganiro IGIHE yagiranye na Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Buholandi, Jean Pierre Karabaranga,  yavuze ko iri murikagurisha ari amahirwe yo gukomeza kwerekana umwihariko w’igihugu mu ruhando rw’amahanga. Yakomeje ati “Turi hano nk’ikipe y’u Rwanda igizwe na NAEB, Ambasade y’u Rwanda n’abashoye imari mu buhinzi bw’indabo kugira ngo dukomeze twereke amahanga ko dushoboye kuba twabagezaho igihingwa cy’Indabo nziza zituruka mu Rwanda.’’  Yongeyeho ko indabo ari igihingwa cyinjiza amafaranga mu gihugu bityo Abanyarwanda bakwiye kucyitaho bakakimenya ko ku rwego mpuzamahanga cyihagazeho. Ambasaderi Karabaranga yashimiye ibigo bidahwema kumurika indabo ndetse yizeza ko Leta y’u Rwanda izakomeza kubaba hafi. Yanishimiye intambwe yatewe mu gukomeza kugikorera ubuvugizi no kwagura nyabyo ibikorwa byose bijyanye n’indabo. Muganga Walter uhagarariye Bella Flowers yavuze ko intego yatumye bitabira imurikagurisha ari ukurushaho kwagura ibikorwa byabo. Ati “Turi hano ngo twerekane ko mu Rwanda dufite ubushobozi bwo guhinga indabo zishobora gupiganwa ku masoko mpuzamahanga ku biciro byiza kandi tukinjiza amadovize mu gihugu cyacu.’’ Yavuze ko mu buryo bw’umwihariko muri uyu mwaka bamuritse ubwoko bugera kuri 18 bw’indabo z’amaroza  bwose bushobora koherezwa mu mahanga. Ati “Mu mwaka ushize twari dufite amako 16 gusa kandi turifuza ko umwaka utaha tuzazamura hegitari twahingagaho zigere kuri 45 zivuye kuri 40 twahingaga kuri ubu. Twiyemeje rero kongera ingano kuko tubona ko isoko rihari ryo kohereza indabo mu mahanga.’’ Shungo Harada yavuze ko bakoze ubushakashatsi bahinga indabo zitaboneka henshi ku buryo ubu mu Rwanda zihari kandi zakunzwe. Ati “Muri iri murikagurisha benshi baza batugana bibaza uko twe tuzibona bikabatangaza, kandi ni indabo zihenda ururabo rumwe rugura nk’ibihumbi 10.000 Frw.’’ Umuyobozi muri NAEB, Cynthia Mata Uwacu, yavuze ko imurikagurisha ry’indabo rifasha gukomeza kongera abaguzi n’abafatanyabikorwa mu buhinzi bwazo. Ati “Tuzakomeza kubishyiramo imbaraga mu kugira uruhare mu ruhando rw’amahanga mu kwerekana ubwiza bw’indabo zihingwa mu Rwanda kuko ni n’uburyo bwiza bwo gukomeza kwerekana ko natwe ushoboye no gukora ubuvugizi bw’ibikorwa byacu muri rusange.’’ Ubuhinzi bw’indabo ni ishoramari ryunguka kandi rimaze guhabwa agaciro mu Rwanda, kuko rishobora kwinjiza amadovize mu gihugu ndetse n’Abanyarwanda batari bake rikabaha imirimo. Mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari wa 2017/18, umusaruro w’indabo u Rwanda rwohereza mu mahanga wanganaga na toni 144. [email protected]

title: Umunyarwanda arakekwaho kwica umunya-Canada amuteye ibyuma
content: Polisi yatangaje ko Austin Simon witabye Imana yari umugabo w’imyaka 39, wari ufite abana babiri.  Polisi muri Ottawa ivuga ko ubu bwicanyi bwabaye ku Cyumweru.  Kayiranga ngo azakomeza gufungwa kugeza tariki 18 Ugushyingo uyu mwaka ari nabwo azagaragara imbere y’ubutabera. Polisi yavuze ko aba bagabo bombi bari basanzwe baziranye nk’uko ikinyamakuru CBC cyo muri iki gihugu cyabitangaje. Naho ikinyamakuru Ottawa Citizen cyo cyavuze ko  Kayiranga yigeze gukurikiranwaho ubujura, gukora ibya byitwaje intwaro n’ibindi. Uretse iki cyaha cy’ubwicanyi, Kayiranga ngo akurikiranweho n’ikindi kirimo icyo gutunga imbunda, kwitwaza ibikoresho bitemewe n’ibindi. Umuryango wa Simon watangaje ko uyu mugabo witabye Imana, yari umubyeyi mwiza kandi wagiraga umutima ufasha. Mbere y’uko yitaba Imana, Simon yakoraga akazi ko kubaza mu Mujyi wa Ottawa, nk’uko umwe mu bo mu muryango we witwa Rory Jorstad yabitangaje. Urupfu rwa Simon rubaye urwa 12 rubaye muri uyu mwaka mu Mujyi wa Ottawa mu buryo bwo kwicwa, rukaba n’urwa kabiri rukozwe mu gihe kitarenze amasaha 24. Undi muntu w’imyaka 62 yishwe ku wa Gatanu muri uyu Mujyi, hakaba haratawe muri yombi umugore akekwaho kumuhitana.

title: Umunyarwanda uba mu Bwongereza yoroje abatishoboye, anishyurira mituweli abasaga  300
content: Manzi uvuka mu Murenge wa Base mu Karere ka Rulindo, amaze imyaka isaga 20 mu Bwongereza. Binyuze mu Muryango yashinze witwa “Manzi Foundation” tariki ya 3 Ugushyingo 2019, yishyuriye ubwisungane mu kwivuza imiryango 109 igizwe n’abantu 348, naho imiryango 10 itishoboye ihabwa ingurube zo korora. Umwe mu banyamuryango ba ‘Manzi Fondation’, Vumiliya Marie Jeanne, yavuze ko Abanyarwanda bari mu bihugu bitandukanye byo ku Isi, baba bakwiye gusubiza amaso inyuma bakagira umusanzu batanga aho bakomoka. Ati “Umunyarwanda ukunda u Rwanda uri mu mahanga, aba akwiye gushaka ubuzima hariya ariko akibuka gutanga umusanzu aho akomoka kugira ngo igihugu cye gikomeze gitere imbere.” Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Base, Mwumvinezayimana Fiacre, yashimye ubufasha abaturage bahawe, gusa abibutsa ko bikwiriye kubatera imbaraga zo kwishakira ibisubizo ntibategereze guhora bafashwa. Ati “Kwishyurirwa mituweli si ishema, ahubwo hari igihe aba ari uburangare, ugasanga umuntu ahora ategereje ko azishyurirwa kandi mu by’ukuri afite uburyo bwo kubona amafaranga. Inama duhora tugira abaturage nuko bajya mu matsinda bakajya bazigama amafaranga azabafasha kwiyishyurira kandi birashoboka.” Nyirabizeiyimana Valentine, ni umwe mu bishyuriwe ubwisungane mu kwivuza. Yagize ati “Iyi ni inshuro ya kabiri, umuryango wanjye ugizwe n’abantu batanu wishyurirwa ubwisungane mu kwivuza na ‘Manzi Foundation’ ubu nagiye mu itsinda natangiye kwizigamira ku buryo umwaka utaha nanjye nziyishyurira.” Mu rwego rwo kurwanya ubukene mu gace avukamo, Manzi Aloys, akora ibikorwa bitandukanye bigamije gufasha abaturage kwifasha birimo kuboroza amatungo magufi, kwishyurira amashuri y’imyuga bamwe mu bana bo mu miryango itishoboye no kubaha ibikoresho by’ishuri, guhemba abarimu bigisha mu mashuri abanza batsindishije neza n’ibindi.

title: IBUKA Europe yavuze kuri 2019, umwaka watanze icyerekezo gishya hagati y’u Rwanda n’u Bufaransa
content: Iyi nama yabereye mu Bufaransa nk’igihugu cyiyoboye uyu muryango muri manda y’imyaka ibiri. Umwaka wa 2019 wagaragaje agacu ko guhindura intekerezo ku ruhare rw’u Bufaransa muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi no kwibuka ayo mahano nk’uburyo bwo guha agaciro inzirakarengane z’Abatutsi basaga miliyoni bambuwe ubuzima. U Bufaransa ntibwakunze guha agaciro ibirego by’u Rwanda rutahwemye kugaragaza uko bwafashije leta yateguye ikanashyira mu bikorwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ndetse rugakomoza no ku bayobozi b’icyo gihugu babigizemo uruhare. Muri Gicurasi nibwo iki gihugu cyasohoye iteka rya Perezida wa Repubulika n° 2019-435 ryo ku wa 13 Gicurasi 2019, rigena ko kuwa 7 Mata, ari itariki ngarukamwaka yo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ingingo ya Mbere y’iri teka ivuga ko ‘Itariki ngarukamwaka yo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ni 7 Mata’. Ingingo ya Kabiri ivuga ko ‘Buri mwaka kuri iyi tariki, ibikorwa byo kwibuka bizajya bitegurwa i Paris. Ibikorwa nk’ibi kandi bishobora gutegurwa kandi muri buri ntara bigizwemo uruhare n’umuyobozi wayo [Perefe]’. Ingingo ya Gatatu yaryo ivuga ko Minisitiri w’Intebe afite inshingano zo gushyira mu bikorwa iri teka, rizasohoka mu igazeti ya leta ya Repubulika y’u Bufaransa. Perezida wa IBUKA Europe, Dr Kabanda Marcel, yabwiye IGIHE ko umubano wa IBUKA France n’iki gihugu utari umeze neza mbere yuko uwo munsi winjiza mu yindi yubahwa mu Bufaransa. Yavuze ko ari icyemezo gikuraho ikiraro cyari hagati y’ubuyobozi bw’u Bufaransa na IBUKA kuko batumirwaga mu bikorwa byo kwibuka ntibahakandagire. Yakomeje ati “Uyu mwaka tuvuze ibintu byabaye mu Bufaransa byiza , icyo kintu kirimo. Mu myaka 25 hagati yacu na Leta y’u Bufaransa nta kintu twavuganaga; twarabatumiraga ntibaze ugasanga ibyo dukora batabizi cyangwa se batabyishimiye.’’ Inshuro imwe niyo Umuyobozi ukomeye muri Guverinoma yitabiriye igikorwa cyo kwibuka [Bernard Kouchner wabaye Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga ku butegetsi bwa Nicolas Sarkozy] kandi nawe yaje nta rwego ahagarariye. Iteka ryashyizweho rizafungura amarembo ku bikorwa byo kwibuka bizajya bitegurirwa i Paris nkuko bisanzwe ariko bikanagera mu zindi ntara. Dr Kabanda ati “N’ubwo nta kiruhuko cyihariye kizajya gitangwa muri iki gihugu, ni icyemezo cyashimije benshi mu Banyarwanda dore ko byinshi mu bikorwa byo kwibuka wasangaga ubuyobozi bwo mu Bufaransa butabishishikarira.’’ Yashimye iteka rya Perezida Macron, avuga ko ari ‘ikintu gikomeye’ ndetse ni intambwe u Bufaransa bwateye mu kumenya ibyabaye mu Rwanda. Ati “Icyo Macron yakoze, ari nko kuba tariki 7 Mata baremeje ko ari umunsi wo kwibuka ni ikintu gikomeye. Ni umunsi wo ku rwego rw’igihugu sitwe twenyine tuzajya tubikora ahubwo n’abahagarariye leta bazajya baza. Mu mashuri amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi azajya yigishwa, ntibitureba nk’Abanyarwanda gusa ahubwo twese tuzabigiramo uruhare.” IBUKA France ivuga ko iki cyemezo ari intangiriro nziza mu kongera kunoza umubano w’impande zombi. Ati “Ntabwo twavuga ko ibintu byarangiye ahubwo bitangiye neza kandi bizavamo ikintu cyiza, tuvuye mu gihe twari tumeze nk’aho nta muntu uzi aho turi nicyo dukora ahubwo ubu tumeze nk’abageze mu cyiciro cyo kuvugana.” Ibuka Europe ihuriwemo n’amashyiramwe ya Ibuka mu Bufaransa, u Busuwisi, u Buholandi, u Butaliyani n’u Bubiligi ndetse uyu mwaka by’umwihariko u Rwanda rwari rwatumiwe. Ni inama ihuza abo mu bihugu bitandukanye, ifite intego yo kuzirikana abazize Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 no kurebera hamwe icyakorwa ngo bakomeze kurwanya abayihana hakaba uruhererekane rwo guhererekanya amakuru ajyanye nayo mu batayazi. Yanatangiwemo kandi ishusho y’imibereho y’abarokotse Jenoside no kungurana ibitekerezo bitandukanye. Bamwe mu bahagarariye abanyamuryango ba IBUKA mu Budage na bo bitabiriye iyi nama mu kwerekana ubushake bafite bwo gufungura IBUKA Allemagne mu minsi ya vuba. Ibuka-Europe ni ihuriro ryatangiye mu 2003, amasezerano yo gukora byemewe n’amategeko ashyirirwaho umukono i Paris tariki ya 20 Ugushyingo 2010.

title: Higiro Prosper yatanze impapuro zimuhesha guhagararira u Rwanda muri Canada nka Ambasaderi
content: Higiro ni umwe mu bahagarariye u Rwanda mu bihugu 15 by’amahanga bashyizweho na Perezida Paul Kagame kuwa 15 Nyakanga 2019, agera mu murwa mukuru Ottawa ku wa 26 Ukwakira 2019. Kuri uyu wa Gatanu nibwo yatanze impapuro zimuhesha guhagararira u Rwanda muri Canada. Ubutumwa Ambasade y’u Rwanda muri Canada yanyujije kuri Twitter bugira buti “Nyakubahwa Prosper Higiro nyuma yo kugera muri Canada ku itariki 26 Ukwakira 2019 yashyikirije ibyangombwa bimwemerera kuba ambasaderi no gusimbura uwamubanjirije, kuri Guverineri mukuru wa Canada, Julie Payette.” Bukomeza buvuga ko yamugaragarije ko yiteguye gushimangira umubano mwiza usanzwe hagati y’ibihugu byombi. U Rwanda na Canada bifitanye umubano kuva mu 1963. Higiro ni umunyapolitiki akaba yaranabaye umuyobozi w’Ishyaka riharanira Ukwishyira Ukizana, PL. Yabaye umusenateri, yaniyamamaje ku mwanya wa Perezida wa repubulika mu matora yo mu 2010. Perezida Paul Kagame na Minisitiri w’Intebe wa Canada, Justin Trudeau, baheruka kugirana ibiganiro umwaka ushize i Erevan muri Arménie, ubwo bari bitabiriye inama ya 17 y’abakuru b’ibihugu na za Guverinoma bigize Umuryango uhuza ibihugu bikoresha ururimi rw’Igifaransa, OIF. Ni inama yanemerejwemo Louise Mushikiwabo nk’umunyamabanga mukuru wa OIF, asimbuye umunya-Canada Michaelle Jean wari usanzwe kuri uwo mwanya. Minisitiri w’Intebe Trudeau, abinyujije kuri Twitter yatangaje ko baganiriye “ku buryo Canada yakorana n’u Rwanda na Afurika yunze Ubumwe mu guhanga amahirwe agenewe urubyiruko n’iterambere mu nyungu z’ibihugu byombi.” Muri Mata uyu mwaka wa 2019 Guverineri Julie Payette yasuye u Rwanda, yitabira umuhango wo Kwibuka ku nshuro ya 25 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. title: Uwihanganye yashyikirije Perezida Halimah Yacob impapuro zimwemerera  guhagararira u Rwanda muri Singapore
content: Ambasaderi Uwihanganye yari aherekejwe n’umugore we, Mukaseti Pacifique n’uhagarariye inyungu mu by’Ubukungu, Lucas Murenzi mu muhango wo gutanga ibyo byangombwa. Muri uwo muhango wabereye mu Biro bya Perezida wa Singapore, byitwa ‘Istana’, Amb. Uwihanganye yabanje gushyikiriza Perezida Yacob intashyo za mugenzi we w’u Rwanda Paul Kagame, ubundi amushimira umubano mwiza hagati ya Singapore n’u Rwanda. Perezida Yacob yashimye ubufatanye ibihugu byombi bifitanye mu by’ubukungu bwatumye habaho imikoranire mu by’ubucuruzi, ishoramari n’ubukerarugendo, no guhererekanya ubumenyi bigamije kubaka ubushobozi hagati yabyo. Amb. Uwihanganye yavuze ko we n’itsinda rye bazakomeza gusigasira umubano mwiza hagati ya Singapore n’u Rwanda bakazawubakiraho ngo bagere ku bukungu bukomeye no gusangira ubumenyi mu ikoranabuhanga no guhanga udushya, n’ubumenyi mu igenamigambi bizafasha mu gukomeza iterambere ry’u Rwanda. Perezida Yacob yavuze ko abaturage b’u Rwanda na Singapore basangiye indangagaciro n’icyerekezo ndetse ko iki gihugu cyiteguye gukomeza umubano wacyo n’u Rwanda by’umwihariko mu gutanga ubufasha no kubaka ubushobozi no kongera ubucuruzi n’ishoramari hagati y’ibihugu byombi. Uwihanganye yagizwe Ambasaderi nyuma y’igihe yari amaze ari ku mwanya w’Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ibikorwa remezo ushinzwe Ubwikorezi.

title: Abanyarwanda baba mu Bufaransa bagiye kujyana Charles Onana mu butabera kubera gupfobya Jenoside
content: Ku wa Gatandatu nibwo Onana  yaciye mu kiganiro ‘Tout un Monde’ kinyura kuri televiziyo yitwa LCI y’ikigo  TF1, aho yaganiraga n’umunyamakuru Vincent Hervouët ku gitabo yanditse kuri ‘Operation Turquoise’. Ikiganiro kijya kurangira nibwo yeruye avuga ko nta Jenoside yabayeho yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda, yongeraho ko nta n’indi Jenoside yabayeho kuva 1900 kugeza 1994. Umunyamategeko wa CRF, Me Richard Gisagara, yabwiye IGIHE ko umuryango w’abanyarwanda baba mu Bufaransa basanze batakomeza kwihanganira ayo magambo ubu bakaba bari gutegura ikirego bateganya kugeza ku bushinjacyaha kuri uyu wa Kabiri. Ati “Twasanze tutakomeza kwihanganira ayo magambo, umuryango w’abanyarwanda baba mu Bufaransa bansabye ko nategura ikirego, ndi kugitegura nimara kukirangiza ni ukuzagishyikiriza ubushinjacyaha ndumva nshobora kugishyikiriza ubushinjacyaha ejo, noneho tukareba icyo bukora, bwaba butemeye kumushyikiriza ubucamanza twe ubwacu tuzamushyikiriza ubucamanza.” Charles Onana ni umugabo ukomoka mu gihugu cya Cameroun akaba afite n’ubwenegihugu bw’u Bufaransa. Gisagara yavuze ko uwo mugabo amaze igihe kinini apfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ku buryo batakomeza kumwihanganira. Ati  "Ni umuntu guhera kera na kare wakomeje guhakana Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, iyo urebye wagira ngo ubuzima bwe yabuhariye icyo gikorwa cyo guhakana Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Yanditse ibintu byinshi,  yavuze ibintu byinshi ku mbuga zitandukanye,  ku maradiyo, ku mateleviziyo kuburyo igihe cyari kigeze kugira ngo akurikiranwe." Yongeyeho ati “Yigeze kuvuga ngo Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi nicyo kinyoma kinini cyakozwe muri Afurika. Ejo bundi aherutse kuvugira kuri radiyo France24 nabwo ahakana Jenoside, ni ibintu yagize akamenyero. Ubu rero tukaba tubona igihe cyari kigeze ngo tumukurikirane  cyane ko iryo tegeko rihana gupfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ryagiyeho, kuva ryajyaho yari ameze nk’ushaka kujya arica ku ruhande ntabivuge kuburyo bweruye ariko ibyo yavuze ejo bundi ku wa Gatandatu ni agahomamunwa.” Bikekwa ko hari abantu bamuri  inyuma bamufasha kwandika ibitabo kugira ngo bibe inzira yo gutambutsamo ibitekerezo byabo byo gupfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Me.Gisagara avuga ku munyamakuru Vincent Hervouët na we azwiho kugaragara mu biganiro bisesereza cyangwa bipfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, aho atanga urugero rw’ikindi kiganiro yakoreye kuri radiyo Europe 1 muri Mata 2019 ubwo hibukwaga ku nshuro ya 25 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Guhera mu 2017, mu Bufaransa hashyizweho itegeko rihana umuntu wese uzajya ahakanira Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ku butaka bw’icyo gihugu. Iri tegeko rihanisha icyaha cy’ihakana n’ipfobya rya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi igifungo cy’umwaka umwe n’ihazabu y’ama-euros 45000 (asaga miliyoni 36 z’amanyarwanda). Iri tegeko riteganya kandi ingingo iha uburenganzira amashyirahamwe yose arengera abarokotse gukurikirana mu nkiko abantu bose bahakana jenoside cyangwa se bakayipfobya, mu gihe cyose ubushinjacyaha butabikoze cyangwa buzaririye mu kubakurikirana.

title: Amb. Nkulikiyimfura yatanze impapuro zimwemerera guhagararira u Rwanda muri Qatar
content: Ambasaderi Nkulikiyimfura yatanze impapuro za burundu nyuma yuko ku wa 24 Ukwakira 2019, yari yatanze kopi z’impapuro zimuhesha uburenganzira bwo guhagararira u Rwanda muri Qatar. Abinyujije kuri Twitter yagize ati “Nishimiye kuba nashyikirije Umuyobozi w’Ikirenga Sheikh Tamim Bin Hamad Al Thani, impapuro zinyemerera guhagararira u Rwanda.” Amb. Nkulikiyimfura ni umwe mu bahagarariye u Rwanda mu bihugu 15 by’amahanga bashyizweho na Perezida Paul Kagame ku wa 15 Nyakanga 2019. U Rwanda na Qatar bisanzwe bifitanye umubano mu ngeri zitandukanye, wanashimangiwe n’amasezerano y’ubufatanye yasinywe ubwo Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad al Thani, yagiriraga uruzinduko i Kigali muri Mata 2019. Aya masezerano yasinyiwe i Kigali yaje akurikira ayashyiriweho umukono i Doha muri Qatar ubwo Perezida Kagame yagiriraga uruzinduko muri iki gihugu rwabyaye imikoranire mu bijyanye n’indege, guteza imbere no kurengera ishoramari n’amasezerano y’ubufatanye ku butwererane mu bijyanye n’ubukungu, ubucuruzi na tekiniki. Muri Gicurasi 2017 u Rwanda na Qatar nabwo byashyize umukono ku masezerano yo gushyiraho imikoranire mu bya dipolomasi. Mbere y’aho ku wa 26 Gicurasi 2015, ibihugu byombi byasinye amasezerano y’ubufatanye mu birebana no kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge. Ibihugu byombi bisanzwe bifitanye imikoranire iganisha ku ishoramari aho mu Rwanda hari abanyemari benshi bo muri Qatar ndetse indege za Qatar Airways zikora ingendo zihuza Doha na Kigali n’ibindi byerekezo birimo na Dubai. Abanya-Qatar bakomeje kugaragaza ubushake bwo gukorera mu Rwanda aho mu mpera z’umwaka ushize u Rwanda rwakiriye itsinda ry’abashoramari baturutse muri icyo gihugu barambagiza amahirwe ahari. Qatar kandi iherutse no gutangaza ko ishaka gushora imari mu Kibuga Mpuzamahanga cy’Indege cya Bugesera kiri kubakwa.

title: U Budage: Kayitesi Judence yanditse igitabo ku buzima bw’inzitane yanyuzemo muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi
content: Iki gitabo cyitwa ‘Ein zerrochenes leben’ ugenekereje mu Kinyarwanda ni ‘Ubuzima bw’Inzitane’, kizamurikwa tariki ya 12 Ugushyingo 2019, mu Mujyi wa WT Tiengen. Kayitesi w’imyaka 36, akomoka i Rutongo muri Gasabo, yageze mu Budage mu 2010, akaba ari umubyeyi w’abahunugu babiri, umwe w’imyaka 10 n’undi w’imyaka 11 n’umukobwa w’imyaka 12. Mbere ya jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yari mu muryango mugari w’abana batanu hicwa babiri bavukanaga na Se na Nyina baricwa. Kayitesi avuga ko mu muryango w’abantu barindwi basigaye ari batatu. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE, Kayitesi yavuze ko kwandika iki gitabo byaturutse ku mateka y’akababaro n’ubuzima bw’inzitane yanyuzemo muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Ati “Muri jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi barantemye mu mutwe noneho n’ubwenge [mémoire] bwanjye burasibama, nyuma mba ikiragi igihe kinini, biza kugenda bigabanuka kugeza ubwo iyo naganiraga n’umuntu we naramwumvaga ariko simbashe kuvuga nkahitamo kumwandikira”. “Icyo gihe rero naje gufata icyemezo cyo kwandika aya mateka kugirango mbashe kuvuga ibyambayeho n’umuryango wanjye muri rusange, kuko kuba ikiragi byari byanteye ubwoba nti ‘bitazava aho bigaruka nkaba nagenda ntavuze ibyatubayeho muri iyo jenoside yadukorewe”. Kayitesi avuga ko nyuma yo kubyara abana bajyaga bamubaza ibibazo bikorogoshora ngo kuki batabona ba sekuru, kuki batabona uyu n’uyu nk’abandi bigana, ibi bituma yumva ko agomba kubikura za nyandiko yabitse. Ati “Na nyuma yaho ntangiye ubuhamya muri 2018 mu ruhame mu gihe cyo kwibuka, nahise mfata icyemezo byanyongereye imbaraga zo gukomeza kwandika igitabo”. Akomeza avuga ko kwandika igitabo byari ugutanga umusanzu we kugira ngo bitazongera kubaho ukundi haba mu gihugu cy’u Rwanda cyangwa n’ahandi. Ati “Ndifuza ko urubyiruko rwagisoma kugira ngo ntiruzagwe mu mutego”. Iki gitabo cyanditse mu buryo bworoheje kuko buri wese wagize ibihe bikomeye azibonamo. Kayitesi yatanze urugero rwibutsa ko umuntu agomba kudadira agira ati “Iyo utwaye imodoka urebera iby’imbere mu kirahure cyagutse kandi giherereye imbere, hanyuma washaka kureba iby’inyuma urungurikira mu turahure duto kandi akanya gato ngo wikomereze urugendo ujya imbere ibi bikaba bikubiye mu byemezo nafashe byo kudaheranwa n’agahinda cyangwa n’aya mateka mabi twarokotse ari nabyo mu gusoza nifuza ko nasangiza cyane urubyiruko, abana tubyara, n’abandi bose”. Kayitesi avuga ko igitabo cye mu 2020 kizasohoka no mu Cyongereza hanyuma hagagurikiraho Igifaransa n’Ikinyarwanda [email protected]

title: Sudani: Hatashywe ishuri ryubatswe ku bufatanye n’Ingabo z’u Rwanda
content: Mu gushyira mu bikorwa inshingano z’ubutumwa bw’amahoro Ingabo z’u Rwanda zatangije ibikorwa bitandukanye birimo kubakira abaturage rondereza, kubaka amashuri, amavuriro ndetse no gucunga umutekano baherekeje abadamu bajya gutashya inkwi ngo badahura n’ihohoterwa. Ibi bikorwa ni ibiza byiyongera ku nshingano nyamukuru za Loni zijyanye no kubungabunga umutekano w’abaturage. Muri uru rwego ku wa 23 Ukwakira mu Nkambi ya El Salaam mu gace ka El Fasher i Darfur muri Sudani habaye umuhango wo gutaha ishuri ryubatswe n’abasirikare b’u Rwanda bafatanyije n’Umuryango UNAMID Christian Fellowship w’abakirisitu basengana n’abakozi bakorera mu butumwa bw’amahoro bwa Loni i Darfur (UNAMID). Ni nyuma yo kubona ko abakobwa bigiraga mu Ishuri ryisumbuye rizwi nka “NUSAIBAH Girls’ secondary school” bigiraga ahataboneye kuko ibyumba by’amashuri byari byubakishijwe ibiti bigasakazwa ibyatsi gusa. Hubatswe ibyumba 14 bishobora kwakira abana 800 hamwe n’ibyumba bine by’ibiro. Umuyobozi w’iri shuri, Adam Suleiman Muhamad, yashimiye cyane ingabo z’u Rwanda ku musanzu zatanze. Yagize ati “Uyu munsi twishimiye gushyikirizwa ishuri ryujuje ibyangombwa ku banyeshuri bacu. Iri shuri ntirizakoreshwa gusa n’abatuye mu Nkambi ya El-Salaam ahubwo n’abayituriye bashobora kuryigamo.” Umuyobozi ku rwego rw’Intara ya Darfur, Brig Gen Muhamad Ibrahim, na we yashimye uruhare rw’Ingabo z’u Rwanda zibungabunga amahoro muri Darfur mu gufasha mu iterambere cyane cyane mu gace ka El-Salaam. Yakomeje ati “Ibi byerekana urukundo n’ubufatanye hagati y’u Rwanda Sudani.” Ukuriye Batayo y’Ingabo z’u Rwanda muri aka gace, Lt Col Bosco Rugema na we ashimangira ko iri shuri ari ikimenyetso cy’umubano mwiza hagati y’u Rwanda na Sudani. Ati “Mu Rwanda, umuco wo gufashanya si ikimenyetso cy’uko utunze cyane ahubwo ni ikimenyetso cy’urukundo, agaciro n’icyubahiro.” Ingabo z’u Rwanda zibarizwa muri Sudani i Darfur zishimwa umurava uziranga mu kazi kazo ko kubungabunga amahoro.

title: Urubyiruko rw’u Rwanda  ruba mu Bwongereza rwaganirijwe ku buryo bwo gukomera ku muco gakondo
content: Icyo igiterane cyabaye kubw’ubufatanye bwa diaspora Nyarwanda yo mu Bwongereza  (NARC) na University of Winchester Ishami ryigisha ibijyanye n’umubano w’umuntu n’ibidukikije (Human Geography)  rihagarariwe na Dr Jen Dickinson. John Binama uyoboye umuryango w’ abanyarwanda baba mu Bwongereza yabwiye urwo rubyiruko ko kuri  we nta kintu cyiza nko kumva ko ari umunyarwanda. Yabasobanuriye  indangagaciro ziranga umunyarwanda  kandi abibutsa ko nubwo abenshi muri bo bavukiye mu mahanga, aho bari hose u Rwanda barugendana. Reverend Pastor Dr Malachie Munyaneza afatanyije  na Dr Olu Taiwo umwarimu muri Winchester university, baganirije   urubyiruko ku ngorane n’imbogamizi ruhura nazo zituruka ku igongana ry’imico itandukanye harimo umuco nyarwanda ababyeyi bifuza ko abana babo bakurikiza, ndetse n’umuco wo mu mahanga bahura nawo mu buzima bwabo bwa buri munsi. Bibukije urubyiruko ko buri wese agira aho avuka bikamufasha kugira intego ku buzima bwe. Urubyiruko rwahawe umwanya uhagije wo kuganira mu matsinda kuri  ibyo bibazo byose ndetse bavuga n’ibyifuzo by’ibyakorwa kugira ngo rudakomeza kwisanga mu ngorane nk’izo rukunze guhura nazo kuko byagaragaye ko bamwe muri bo bahitamo gutoroka imiryango  rimwe na rimwe bakisanga baguye  mu duco tw’amabandi n’abagizi ba nabi akenshi barangwa no kunywa no gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge. Rumwe mu rubyiruko rwasabye ko hategurwa amahugurwa ku babyeyi bakigishwa uko bafasha urubyiruko kubaho  mu mico itandukanye kandi ko byagabanya ukutumvikana kwa hato na hato hagati  y’ ababyeyi n’abana kuko akenshi ari byo bibaviramo indwara zo mu mutwe. Muri icyo igiterane kandi harimo intumwa ya ambasade yu Rwanda mu Bwongereza akaba n’umujyanama wayo, Fidelis Milonko. Mu ijambo yagejeje ku rubyiruko,  yabasobanuriye gahunda u Rwanda rubafitiye ndetse n’umusaruro  rubategerejeho,abasaba kwiga bashyizeho umwete bakirinda icyabaganisha mu ngeso mbi zose. Kalisa Karemera,  umwe mu basaza b’inararibonye batuye mu gihugu cy’u Bwongereza, yasobanuriye urubyiruko amateka yu Rwanda ababwira ku bwitange bwabaye kugira ngo u Rwanda rube ibihugu gikunzwe mu mahanga yose. Ku byerekeranye n’imibereho rusange, Francine Mukamana umunyarwandakazi ukorera ikigo gikomeye cya Microsoft yabagiriye inama yo kutitinya bagafunguka bagahatana ku  isoko ry’umurimo yaba mu Rwanda cyangwa aho ariho hose ku isi. Uhagarariye urubyiruko muri Diaspora nyarwanda, Noel Ntakirutimanna yasobanuriye ko hari  gahunda zabashyiriweho mu rwego rwo guhatanira imirimo mu Rwanda ndetse no guhabwa amahugurwa yabafasha mu kwitegura kugana isoko ry’umurimo. Yarangije asaba urubyiruko kubana neza n’ababyeyi babo  ndetse no gukoresha uburyo bwose bushobotse ababyeyi bakamenya amakuru yabo ya buri munsi ,ibi bikazashobokera mu buryo bwinshi bwo kuganira ndetse akanya niyo kabura hakaba hakoreshwa ikoranabuhanga. Igitaramo cyasojwe no kwidagadura  bifashijwemo na Anaïs Mutumba umuririmbyi akaba n’umunyamakuru

title: Rwakazina yatanze impapuro zo guhagararira u Rwanda muri Loni n’indi miryango mpuzamahanga i Genève
content: Uyu muhango wabaye ku wa 16 Ukwakira 2019, wakurikiwe n’ibiganiro byahuje Ambasaderi Rwakazina na Valovaya wamuhaye ikaze nk’umuyobozi mushya. Ambasaderi Rwakazina yamugaragarije ko u Rwanda rwishimiye ko ariwe wabaye umugore wa mbere uyoboye Umuryango w’Abibumbye i Genève. Nyuma yo kumugezaho intashyo z’Umukuru w’Igihugu, Paul Kagame, Ambasaderi Rwakazina yamusobanuriye ko u Rwanda rushishikajwe no gutanga umusanzu mu guteza imbere imibanire mpuzamahanga, ashimira cyane umusanzu ugaragara w’Umuryango w’Abibumbye n’imiryango Mpuzamahanga ihakorera muri gahunda yo gusigasira imibanire mpuzamahanga. Ambasaderi Rwakazina yanavuze ko u Rwanda rushyize imbere ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’Intego z’Iterambere Rirambye (SDGS) akaba ariyo mpamvu Leta yabyitayeho mu itegurwa ry’Icyerekezo 2050 na Gahunda ya Guverinoma y’u Rwanda y’imyaka irindwi igamije impinduka mu bukungu  (NST1). Yasoje amugaragariza ko yiteguye gukorana cyane n’abashinzwe gushyira mu bikorwa Intego z’Iterambere Rirambye (SDGs) i Genève, bityo hakubakwa umuyoboro ubahuza n’ikigo gishinzwe ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’izo ntego muri Afurika gikorera mu Rwanda. Tatiana Valovaya yashimiye Leta y’u Rwanda yashyize imbere SDGs no gushyigikira imibanire mpuzamahanga nka bimwe mu biraje ishinga Umuryango w’Abibumbye muri iki gihe. Rwakazina Marie Chantal wari Umuyobozi w’Umujyi wa Kigali, yagizwe Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Busuwisi muri Nyakanga 2019; yasimbuye Ambasaderi Dr Ngarambe François Xavier woherejwe guhagararira inyungu z’urwa Gasabo mu Bufaransa. Biteganyijwe ko mu minsi iri imbere Ambasaderi Rwakazina azatanga impapuro zimuhesha uburenganzira bwo guhagararira u Rwanda mu Busuwisi; Autriche, Vatican no mu yindi Miryango Mpuzamahanga ifite icyicaro i Vienne.

title: U  Rwanda rwatewe amacumu atari make ariko rugakomeza ruhagaze-Perezida Kagame
content: Yabigarutseho mu ijambo yavugiye muri Rwanda Day yabereye mu mujyi wa Bonn mu Budage ahari hateraniye abasaga 3500. Perezida Kagame yavuze ko kubona umwanya wo kuganira ku banyarwanda aho bari hose bifite aho bishingira kuko u Rwanda ari igihugu cyiyubaka kandi kiva kure. Agaruka ku byabaye muri 1994 ubwo habaga Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, yavuze ko igihugu cyasenyutse kitariho, ibyabaye kwari uguhuhura. Yavuze ko muri uko gusenyuka u Rwanda rwanyuze muri byinshi bigamije kuruhungabanya ariko rukabicamo neza. Ati “Hari ubwo njya nibaza iyo twahuye dutya n’ikindi gihe kuko ibyo u Rwanda rumaze kunyuramo muri uko gusenyuka ruterwa amacumu atari make hirya no hino, amwe u Rwanda rukayizibukira ayandi akarufata rugakomereka ariko rugakomeza ruhagaze. Naho ruguye ntiruhere hasi rugahaguruka.” Nubwo ibyo byabaye muri urwo rugendo, yavuze ko  “Imyaka 25 ishize ibyo byagiye bigabanyuka ntabwo bikiri nkuko byari bimeze…abarukoreraga ibyo uko imyaka yagendaga ihita niko bibagora.” Kuba bitakiri nkuko byari bimeze mu myaka 10 cyangwa 20 ishize, Perezida Kagame yavuze ko bigaragaza kwiyubaka. Ati “Ntabwo mbuvuga kugira ngi nirate, ndabivugira kuko ari ukuri. Ni ukuri kwigaragaza.” Yavuze ko ababangamira u Rwanda bameze nk’imiyaga iba ishaka gusubiza indege inyuma ariko ikanga ikagera iyo ijya. Ati “Iyo igenda ihura n’imiyaga y’ubwoko bubiri. Hari uturuka imbere usa n’uyisubiza inyuma, hari n’uturuka inyuma ugasa n’uyisunika. Twe twagiye duhura n’ituruka imbere gusa ariko icyo nshaka kuvuga, iyo ndege kubera imbaraga iba ikoresha ngo ijye imbere nubwo hari iyo miyaga iragenda ikagera iyo ijya. Nuko tugenda natwe, ni nk’indege. Imiyaga iduturutse imbere ikadusunika tuyinyuramo tukagenda.” Ku bundi buryo hari (imiyaga) iduturuka inyuma idusunika, ni mwebwe. Nimwe musunika u Rwanda mwanga ko hari ikirubuza gukomeza ngo rugere aho rwajyaga. Ibyo bigaragarira mu iterambere ry’u Rwanda kuko buri mwaka rutera imbere muri buri rwego; harimo ubucuruzi, ubuhinzi, inganda n’izindi. Yabwiye abitabiriye Rwanda Day ko ari bo mbaraga zisunika u Rwanda rukanyura mu bibazo byose rwahura nabyo. Kagame yashishikarije abanyarwanda bari mu mahanga guhoza igihugu cyabo ku mutima, bakagifasha gutera imbere. Rwanda Day ni umunsi umaze kumenyekana cyane kandi wagize uruhare runini mu gukangurira abanyarwanda baba mu mahanga kugira uruhare mu iterambere ry’igihugu cyabo. Uyu mwaka ibaye ku nshuro ya cumi.

title: Mushikiwabo yasabye ibiganiro byihariye ku Banyarwanda baba mu mahanga
content: Mushikiwabo yabivugiye mu Mujyi wa Bonn mu Budage kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, tariki ya 5 Ukwakira 2019, ahahuriye Abanyarwanda bavuye imihanda yose y’Isi mu munsi uzwi nka ‘Rwanda Day’ ubahuriza hamwe bakaganira ku iterambere ry’igihugu cyabo. Mushikiwabo imbere y’abasaga ibihumbi bitatu, yavuze ko hari Abanyarwanda baba mu mahanga bitinya, bakumva ko atari Abanyarwanda nk’abandi. Yagize ati “Usanga hari Abanyarwanda bakiri bato bameze nk’abikirigita, bitinya, muganira wamubaza uti ko twagiye ahantu nk’aha, ati njye se ambasaderi yantumira. U Rwanda muri uyu mwaka turimo ni u Rwanda aho buri wese afite aho abarizwa, afite igihugu cye. Abari mu mahanga dutangire icyo kiganiro nyuma ya Rwanda Day.” Mushikiwabo wahoze ari Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga w’u Rwanda, yavuze ko nta Munyarwanda ucagase ubaho ku buryo yumva ko aciriritse mu bandi. Ati “Nta Munyarwanda ucagase ubaho, uba Umunyarwanda ukanaba Umudage, Umushinwa ariko Ubunyarwanda buruzuye. Icyo kintu tugice muri diaspora. Umunyarwanda aruzuye, ndibaza ko Bamporiki atampakanya ariko wa mwihariko wacu, uko turamukanya n’uko dukora birihariye.’’ Yakomeje agira ati “Nta Munyarwanda ucagase, u Rwanda ni urwacu twese. Icyo kiganiro cy’abana bakiri bato, nta wa kera ugihejwemo. Ndifuza icyo kiganiro.” Rwanda Day ni ibirori  by’imbonekarimwe ku Banyarwanda baba mu mahanga n’inshuti zarwo ziba zishaka kumenya amakuru y’umunsi ku wundi yarwo n’amahirwe rwibitseho. Kuva mu 2010, Rwanda Day yasize amateka akomeye mu mpande zose z’Isi, yaba muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika no mu Burayi aho imaze kubera. Ni ibihe biba bidasanzwe byatangiye mu Ukuboza 2010 nubwo uyu munsi utari wakiswe Rwanda Day, aho Perezida Kagame yahaye impanuro Abanyarwanda basaga 2400 baba mu Bubiligi; abashishikariza ko bakwiye ‘kwiyizera aho gutegereza ak’i muhana’. Ni umunsi ukoranyiriza hamwe Abanyarwanda mu mahanga wahawe inyito ya Rwanda Day ku nshuro ya mbere muri Kanama 2011 i Chicago muri Leta ya Illinois muri Amerika, ukoranya abasaga 4000. Kuva mu 2011, Rwanda Day imaze kubera i Chicago, Boston na Atlanta muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, i Paris mu Bufaransa, i Toronto muri Canada, i Londres mu Bwongereza, i Amsterdam mu Buholandi, i San Francisco muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika (Rwanda Cultural Day), i Ghent mu Bubiligi, none uyu mwaka yerekeje mu Mujyi wa Bonn mu Burengerazuba bw’u Budage. title: Abashoramari bo mu Bubiligi bagiye kubaka inzu 1000 ziciriritse mu Rwanda
content: Uyu mushinga wamurikiwe Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Bubiligi, Rugira Amandin, mu minsi ishize. Itsinda rizawukora rivuga ko ryahisemo u Rwanda kubera ko ari igihugu gitekanye kandi gikomeje kugaragaza ibikorwa by’iterambere muri Afurika no ku Isi muri rusange. Uyu mushinga ugizwe n’abasore n’inkumi baturuka mu bihugu bitandukanye barimwo Joël Buleli ufite ubwenegihugu bw’u Bubiligi ukomoka muri RDC ari nawe uyobora itsinda, Roxana Dela Fiamor wo muri Iran ufite inkomoko no muri Togo, Ntiberamunda Philibert de Viron, Umubiligi ufite inkomoko mu Rwanda, n’abandi bafatanya bava mu Butaliyani no mu Bubiligi. Umuyobozi wa Soteko , Joel Buleli, yabwiye IGIHE ko bahisemo gutangirira umushinga wabo mu Rwanda, kuko bitakiri ibanga, ntawe utifuza gushora imari muri iki gihugu kubera urwego kigezeho. Soteko izakoresha uburyo bushya bujyanye n’imyubakire kandi mishya muri Afurika, igamije gutanga ibisubizo birambye mu iyubaka ry’inzu zijyanye n’igihe. Inzu zizubakwa zizaba zifite uburyo bufasha umuntu gukurikirnna ibikorerwa mu nzu ye yibereye ahandi aho ariho hose ku Isi, bigakorwa amasaha 24 kuri 24 bitabangamiye indi mirimo, n’icyangiritse akamenya uko ubikemura hakiri kare. Buleli yakomeje ati "Ni umushinga kandi uzatanga ahokorerwa ibijyanye na serivisi zijyanye n’ahaturwa, inzu zihahirwamo amafunguro, ibiro n’ibindi bijyanye n’umujyi ugezweho. Ku ikubitiro hazaba hegereye inzira zigana ku kibuga kindege n’Umujyi rwagati wa kigali, inzu zikorerwamo ibijyanye n’umuco nka za sinema, inzu zikorerwamo ibiganiro mbwirwaruhame, inzu ndangamuzo n’ibindi." Yavuze ko mu kubaka izi nzu hazibandwa ku bikoresho bikorerwa mu Rwanda kandi bikorwe n’Abanyarwanda n’ibindi bigo byo mu gihugu, ku buryo bizatanga akazi. Mu kurimbisha izi nyubako hazifashishwa Imigongo kuko itanga isura nziza y’igihugu. Buleli yakomeje ati "Icyibandwaho cya mbere ni uko ibi bikorwa bya Soteko bigomba kugira ibiciro biciriritse, kandi mu buryo bw’amasezerano aciye mu mucyo kandi yizewe. Igice cya mbere kikazatangira muri Kanama 2020. Inyubako zigera ku ijana zizaba zimaze kuzura muri icyo gice cya mbere. Ibi bikazafasha gutangira gutuzwamo muri Nyakanga 2021." Joel Buleli yavuze ko bamaze kugira amasezerano ku kigero cya 20 % ku nzu zizaturwamo mu Rwanda. Itsinda Soteko rizwi mu rugaga rwikiswe ‘Hub Africa’ rimaze kuba urugero ku bigo 34 byo ku Isi. Soteko kandi ni bamwe mu bashoramari bazaba bari muri Rwanda Day izabera mu Mujyi wa Bonn ku wa 5 Ukwakira 2019.

title: Abanyarwanda baba Abuja muri Nigeria basangiye Umuganura
content: Kwizihiza Umuganura kuri uyu munsi byatewe n’uko abenshi, ku mpamvu zinyuranye  batabashije kuba bari Abuja ku munsi ngarukamwaka wabugenewe, uba muri Kanama. Ibyo birori byabaye umwanya wo kuganira ibijyanye n’amateka arebana n’umunsi w’Umuganura n’icyo kuwizihiza bisobanuye ku banyarwanda. Umuyobozi wungirije w’Abanyarwanda baba Abuja, Madamu Sheila Mutesi, yavuze ko kwizihiza umuganura ari igikorwa cyiza gikomoka  ku bakurambere, kigaragaza ubufatanye bw’abanyarwanda mu kwishimira umusaruro bagize no kujya imigambi yo gukora ibyisumbuye kurushaho. Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Nigeria, Stanislas Kamanzi yashimiye  abitabiriye iki gikorwa.  Yabasabye kurushaho kugira uruhare mu kwifatanya n’abandi banyarwanda mu  gushyira mu bikorwa gahunda z’Igihugu zigamije kubyara umusaruro mwiza ufasha u Rwanda gukomeza gutera imbere. Yashimiye kandi abitabiriye iki gikorwa umugambi mwiza  wo gukomeza gusangiza ku musaruro wabo imiryango itishoboye y’ abanyarwanda, mu gikorwa  cyo kwegeranya inkunga yo kubarihira ubwisungane mu kwivuza. Ku bijyanye n’icyo gikorwa cyo gukusanya inkunga, hemejwe ko cyaba cyasojwe bitarenze impera z’ Ukwakira 2019. Kwizihiza Umuganura byaranzwe n’ubusabane no kwishimira intambwe nziza u Rwanda rukomeje gutera rujya mbere.

title: Abanyarwanda bo mu Bubiligi na Luxemburg barabarira ku ntoki iminsi isigaye ngo bitabire Rwanda Day
content: Mbere gato y’uko itariki ya 5 Ukwakira igera ngo Rwanda Day ibere mu Mujyi wa Bonn mu Burengerazuba bw’u Budage, Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Bubiligi nk’igihugu kizaturukamo Abanyarwanda benshi, Rugira Amandin, yahamije ko imyiteguro bayigeze kure. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE, yavuze ko Abanyarwanda batuye mu Bubiligi na Luxembourg bamaze kwiyandikisha ari benshi ku buryo yizera ko umubare wifuzwa uzaba wagezweho mu minsi isigaye. Ati “Dukomeje kubashishikariza gukomeza kwiyandikisha kuko mu minsi mike turaba dufunze kwandika kugirango tubashe gutegura urugendo, birumvikana rero ko abatarabikora babikora vuba kugirango akazi karimwo katavuna ababirimo.” Mu gihe Perezida Kagame agira gahunda zo gusura Intara z’u Rwanda, Abanyarwanda batuye mu mahanga bishimiye ko na bo gahunda nk’iyi yabagezeho, ariyo Rwanda Day. Yitabirwa n’Umukuru w’Igihugu, abayobozi bakuru mu nzego za leta n’izigenga n’abashoramari bo mu Rwanda, bakaganira mu rwego rwo gukomeza guteza imbere ubukungu n’ubumwe bw’u Rwanda mu bice byose by’ibikorwa. Mu bandi bazitabira Rwanda Day harimo urubyiruko rw’Abanyafurika bamaze kwiyandikisha. Harimo nka Ousman Bah wo muri Guinée, uvuga ko kwitabira Rwanda Day bizamushimisha, kuko yifuza kumva ibitekerezo bya Perezida Paul Kagame, "nk’umunyafurika ufite imishinga kandi ukiri muto.” Ahmed Liamidi Atindehou ukomoka muri Benin na we ni umwe mu bazitabira Rwanda Day. Yagize ati "Nzaba ndi i Bonn kuganira na Perezida Paul Kagame, iki ni igihe cyacu nk’urubyiruko rwa Afurika, kugira amahirwe mu bihe byacu tukagira umuyobozi nka Kagame utuvugira twese bibaho gake, ni amahirwe rero ntakwiyima kandi mbishoboye, si njye uzabona hageze tariki ya 5 Ukwakira, namaze kwiyandikisha’.” Uretse kungurana ibitekerezo, Rwanda Day ni n’umwanya wo kubaza ibibazo Umukuru w’Igihugu, gutanga ibitekerezo n’ibyifuzo nta guca ku ruhande. Habarurwa ko u Bubiligi butuwe n’abanyarwanda barenga ibihumbi 35. Bashobora kwiyandikisha kuzitabira Rwanda Day banyuze hano.

title: U Budage: Uko abanyarwanda biteguye kwakira Rwanda Day izabera i Bonn (Amafoto)
content: ‘Rwanda Day’ ni umunsi umaze kumenyerwa nk’uhuza Abanyarwanda bo mu gihugu, ababa mu mahanga n’inshuti z’u Rwanda, bagahuzwa n’intego imwe yo kuganira ku cyarushaho guteza imbere igihugu cyabo. Kuri iyi nshuro uteganyijwe ku wa 5 Ukwakira 2019. Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Budage ku bufatanye n’Abanyarwanda batuye muri iki gihugu bakomeje imyiteguro y’uyu munsi mu gihe habura iminsi mike ngo habe igikorwa nyirizina cyitezweho guhuriza hamwe abanyarwanda baturutse imihanda yose. Mu kiganiro na IGIHE, Amb. Igor César yavuze ko imyiteguro irimbanyije kandi abazitabira ibi birori bazakirwa neza nk’uko bisanzwe mu muco Nyarwanda. Yagize ati “Twiteguye iki gikorwa cya Rwanda Day, nabwira abazitabira ko baje batugana, natwe turabiteguye rwose. Tubiteguye bijyanye n’umuco nyarwanda, bazagubwa neza ariko ibyo byose tubahishiye n’agashya nakwita gusangira no kuganira ku bitekerezo byinshi binyuranye bitwungura ubwenge, byerekana ubunyarwanda bwacu aho buva aho bugeze, tubyaza umusaruro amahirwe dufite.” Yakomeje agira ati “Turifuza ko u Rwanda muri ayo mahirwe byarenga imbibi bikabera urugero rwiza n’amahanga, kuko ibyiza biryoha bisangiwe, mbese amahirwe yacu akaba aya Afurika n’Isi yose. Tugomba gutekereza kure kandi tukaguka mu ndoto zacu.” Amb. Igor César yavuze kandi ko “Ikindi cyiza kuri iyi Rwanda Day, izaha umwanya uhagije urubyiruko, nicyo ishyize imbere cyane. Rubyiruko mushaka inzira yo kumenya uko mwakora uko mwafatanya n’abandi mu kubaka, mu gukorera mu Rwanda cyangwa kuhashora imari, iyi Rwanda Day ni igisubizo.” Bonn izakira Rwanda Day, iri mu mijyi itandatu minini y’u Budage hamwe na Cologne, Hambourg, Munich, Frankfurt ndetse n’Umurwa Mukuru Berlin, ari naho hakoraniye za Minisiteri n’ibindi biro mpuzamahanga, aha hakaba ari naho kandi hari ibiro bikuru by’Ambasade y’u Rwanda mu Budage. Umujyi wa Bonn uherereye ku nkengero z’uruzi rwa Rhin, mu Majyepfo ya Leta ya North Rhine-Westphalia mu ntera y’ibilometero 25 uvuye mu Majyepfo y’Umujyi wa Cologne no mu bilometero 54 mu Majyaruguru y’Umujyi wa Coblence. title: Abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo basezeye Jacques Kabale wari umaze imyaka 10 ari ambasaderi i Paris (Amafoto)
content: Ni umuhango wabereye mu nzu y’ubuyobozi bw’agace k’Umujyi wa Paris yitwa ’Mairie du 3e arrondissement de Paris’. Mu ijambo rye nk’inshuti y’Abanyarwanda yakoranye bya hafi na Amb. Kabale, Pierre Aidenbaum uyobora aka gace k’Umujyi wa Paris, yashimiye Abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo kuba yifatanyije na bo mu gushimira Amb. Kabale igihe bamaze bakorana. Ati "Uretse n’ibyo mperuka mu Rwanda, imvugo niyo ngiro, ntakuntu umuntu atakwishimira gukorana neza n’abayobozi b’igihugu nk’u Rwanda kigaragaza mu iterambere niboneye." "Ni iby’agaciro kubabona muteraniye muri iyi ngoro y’umujyi, biraduhesha ishema kubera abo muri bo n’imibanire myiza iri hagati y’ibihugu byacu byombi, murisanga." Yabwiye Amb. Kabale ati "nkwifurije ishya n’ihirwe mu yindi mirimo uzashingwa." Amb. Kabale yashimiye abagize igitekerezo cyo guhuza Abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo ngo bamusezereho, nyuma y’imyaka 10 bahuzwa na byinshi. Ati "Nibyo koko igihe kirageze nsubiye mu Rwanda, ariko ntabwo ngiye kure tuzakomeza dufatanye mu gukorera ibihugu byacu byombi mu buryo butandukanye, kuko umuturage mwiza ahora ari ambasaderi w’igihugu cye." Yashimiye byimazeyo Abanyarwanda bitabiriye icyo gikorwa kandi wari umunsi w’akazi. Ati "Biranyereka ko twabanye neza kandi kubagira byaramfashije mu kazi kanjye, inama twagiranye, ibyo twakoranye byose byari umusaruro mwiza ku gihugu cyacu." "Tariki ya 22 Nzeri 2019 nibwo nzasubira mu Rwanda, ariko kandi ndabamenyesha ko mudasigaye mwenyine kuko hari Amb. Ngarambe François Xavier  uzansimbura arabageraho mu gihe gito, muzakomeze mukorane nawe neza nk’uko bisanzwe azaze yisanga rwose." Dr Rutayisire François wavuze ijambo mu izina ry’Abanyarwanda bo mu Bufaransa, yashimye byimazeyo ibyagezweho byose mu gihe Amb. Kabale yari mu Bufaransa. Ati "Ntabwo byari byoroshye, wakoze mu bihe twese tuzi ko bitari byoroshye muri dipolomasi hagati y’u Rwanda n’u Bufaransa ariko ugiye rwose umubano wacu uhagaze neza, turagushimira uruhare wabigizemo nka Ambasaderi. Abanyarwanda bantumye ngo nkubwire nti ’warakoze kandi Imana ikomeze ibarinde n’umuryango wawe.’" Habayeho umwanya wo guha ijambo buri wese akagira icyo abwira Amb. Kabale n’umuryango we, batanga ubuhamya bw’uko babanye muri iyo myaka 10 ahamaze. Amb. Kabale ati "Ndagira ngo mbashishikarize kandi kwibuka gahunda ikomeye cyane ya Rwanda Day izabera i Bonn mu Budage tariki ya 5 Ukwakira, aho umukuru w’igihugu n’abandi bayobozi batandukanye b’u Rwanda bazaza guhura n’Abanyarwanda, inshuti z’u Rwanda, abashoramari, n’abandi, iyi gahunda mukomeze mwiyandikishe muzabe muri benshi muhure na Perezida muganire."
