title: Abanyarwanda baba muri Canada banyuzwe n’igitaramo ‘Ijoro rya gakondo’ cy’itorero Indashyikirwa  (AMAFOTO)
content: Muri uyu mwaka iki gitaramo cyabereye Ottawa ku wa Gatandatu tariki 14 Nzeri 2019, aho ababyinnyi b’imbyino gakondo bo mu Indashyikirwa bataramiye abatari bake bari bahuriye mu cyumba cyabereyemo. Aganira na IGIHE, Dieudonne Siboniyo Umuyobozi w’Indashyikirwa yavuze ko bishimiye uburyo igitaramo cyagenze. Umuyobozi w’iri torero rimaze imyaka irenga umunani rikora ibi bikorwa, yavuze ko bakora iki gitaramo kugira ngo bereke abanyarwanda batuye hanze ko umuco nyarwanda utacitse. Ikindi ni uko baba bagambiriye kwigisha umuco abakiri bato babyiruka. Iki gitaramo kiswe ‘Ijoro rya Gakondo’, Dieudonne yavuze ko batangiye kugitegura mu rwego rwo gususurutsa abanyarwanda batuye muri Canada. Umuyobozi w’itorero Indashyikirwa yavuze ko ubutumwa yaha Abanyarwanda batuye hanze y’u Rwanda ari uko bakunda umuco nyarwanda bakawuteza imbere aho bari bakanawukundisha abakiri bato.

title: Diaspora Nyarwanda muri Australia yamaganye ibiherutse gutangazwa ko ari ‘maneko z’u Rwanda’
content: Iyi nkuru y’umunyamakuru Amy Greenbank, yasohotse ku wa 24 Kanama 2019. Yavugaga ko Abanyarwanda bo muri Australia ari ba maneko ndetse uruzinduko rwa Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga, Dr Richard Sezibera, ku wa 29 Gicurasi, rwari rugamije gucecekesha za mpunzi zakoze ubwicanyi muri Pariki ya Bwindi. Dr Sezibera yagiye muri Australia atumiwe na ADC  (Australian Devos Connections  mu cyiswe ‘Australian Leadership Retreat’ iba buri mwaka igahuza abashoramari bakomeye n’ibigo bikomeye na za kaminuza n’abayobozi ba za guverinoma cyangwa ababaye bo, ngo avuge ijambo nyamukuru. Mu butumwa bwe yakanguriye abashoramari ba Australia bazitabira inama y’Abakuru b’Ibihugu na za Guverinoma bigize Umuryango w’Ibihugu bikoresha Icyongereza (CHOGM), kuza kureba amahirwe y’ishoramari ari mu Rwanda. Ikindi iyi nkuru ya ABC ivuga ko Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Australia ufite icyicaro i Singapore ngo yafatiye imbunda ku gakanu umwe muri abo  Banyarwanda ngo bahigwa na Leta y’u Rwanda. ABC News kandi yavuze ko Abanyarwanda bo muri Diaspora yo muri Australia, batoteza abatavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda baba muri iki gihugu. Umuyobozi wa Diaspora Nyarwanda muri Australia, Karekezi Emmanuel, yabwiye IGIHE ko ibi ari ibinyoma bikwirakwiza n’abo mu mutwe w’iterabwoba wa RNC ya Kayumba Nyamwasa ndetse n’indi iri mu cyitwa P5. Abari ku isonga ry’uyu mugambi mubisha akaba ari Paul Rusesabagina wo mu ishyaka MRCD; Condo Gervais wo muri RNC n’abandi batumirwa n’abatavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda, baba muri Australia nka Mubarak Kalisa na Amiel Nubaha. Uyu ni na we wagize uruhare rugaragara mu itumirwa ry’abo bagabo no gutegura umuhango wo Kwibuka ku wa 6 Mata, wahuje abafobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri Queensland Parliament House. Mu kubatumira ni naho bakusanyirije amafaranga yo gufasha imitwe y’iterabwoba nka FLN. Agaruka ku ibaruwa Diaspora Nyarwanda yandikiye igitangazamakuru ABC News, ku wa 10 Nzeri 2019, aho bakibwiye ko cyahawe ibinyoma n’abantu barwanya u Rwanda ngo babeshyere Abanyarwanda baba muri Australia n’igihugu muri rusange bakaba baribasiye cyane Ngoga Célestin akaba ari n’umuhuzabikorwa wa Diaspora ya Australia n’abandi benshi. Ati “Twasabye uriya munyamakuru kwandika ibindi bibeshyuza atabikora tukazamujyana mu rwego rugenzura abanyamakuru muri Australia. Impamvu ni uko yanditse ibinyoma, akwiye kuvuguruza, imvugo zifutamye kandi zuzuye kubogama.” Icyakora kugeza uyu munsi ntabwo iki gitangazamakuru kiranyomoza ibyo cyatangaje cyangwa ngo gisabe imbabazi. Mu ibaruwa ya Diaspora Nyarwanda, igaruka ku witwa Kalisa Mubarak wavuganye na ABC News, isobanura ko ‘azwi neza cyane nk’umunyabyaha ndetse mbere yo kujya muri Australia aho yabaga muri Afurika y’Epfo, yari umwe mu bagize umutwe w’iterabwoba wa RNC, uyobowe na Kayumba Nyamwasa’. Mbere yo kujya muri Australia yabaga mu nzu imwe na mwishywa wa Patrick Karegeya, witwa David Batenga, ndetse akaba yari umutangabuhamya mu rubanza rw’abaketsweho kurasa Kayumba Nyamwasa muri Afurika y’Epfo. Ibaruwa igira iti “Nubwo yiyita umutangabuhamya mu iraswa rya Kayumba, hari amakuru ko Kalisa Mubarak, ahubwo yari mu mugambi w’abagambanye kumwica kubera amakimbirane yari muri RNC, nyuma yo kwizezwa amafaranga menshi. Nyuma yo kubona ko umugambi umupfubanye yirukankiye kuri Polisi ya Afurika y’Epfo yiyita umutangabuhamya.” Ivuga kandi ko Kalisa ari umunyabyaha ugerageza kwigira umwere abinyujije mu kuvuga ko ahigwa na Guverinoma y’u Rwanda, aho akwirakwiza amajwi n’amashusho hirya no hino ku maradiyo n’abandi henshi ayishinja gukora ibyaha muri Afurika y’Epfo, u Burayi none ubu ageze muri Australia. Mu nkuru ya ABC News, Kalisa avuga ko yaje kohererezwa ubutumwa bwo kuri telefoni igendanwa na nimero yo mu mahanga itagaragaza umwirondoro. Diaspora Nyarwanda ivuga ko ibi bigamije gutera impuhwe ngo arebe ko yabona ubufasha bw’amafaranga. Iti “Izina rye iyo urishyize muri Google ubona ko ari uwagize uruhare muri Jenoside wahunze, bikaba biteye ikimwaro kubona itangazamakuru rya Australia, rimwita uwihisha kubera ubwoba bw’ubuzima bwe.’’ Karekezi avuga ko abakoresha ibi bitangazamakuru ari abagerageza gusebya leta n’Abanyarwanda bari muri Australia kuko usanga banababuza kujya mu Rwanda, bavuga ngo barazana uburozi n’ibindi. Yakomeje avuga ko ikinyoma Mubarak na bagenzi be bacuze kidashinga kuko bitumvikana uko ambasaderi yavuye Singapore atwaye imbunda akayihitisha ku bashinzwe kugenzura imipaka akayinjirana muri Australia maze akayitunga ku ijosi ry’uwabitangaje bikarangirira aho ntiyitabaze polisi ngo iyimwambure. Australia kandi irasa n’iyabaye indiri y’abafite imigambi mibisha ku Rwanda hari n’abakekwa gukora amahano muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi bakidegembya. Buri mwaka batumira abo bita abashyitsi babo barimo Rusesabagina Paul, Condo Gervais,  David Himbara, Serge Ndayizeye na Padiri Nahimana  Thomas bagakusanya inkunga yo gushyira muri ibyo bikorwa byabo bigamije guhungabanya igihugu.

title: Ibyo wamenya ku gitabo ’On n’oublie jamais rien’ cya Dr Gicali Marie-Josée
content: Ni umwe mu bagize umuryango uharanira inyungu z’abacitse ku icumu rya jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi witwa Page-Rwanda ukorera muri Canada. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE, Dr Gicali yavuze byinshi ku gitabo yanditse akacyita ‘On n’oublie jamais rien’, bisobanuye mu Kinyarwanda ngo ‘Ntitwibagirwa’.  IGIHE: Iki gitabo wise ‘On n’oublie Jamais rien’ watekereje ute kucyandika? Dr Gicali: Iki gitabo ni amateka maranye mu byukuri imyaka 25, kikaba gikubiyemwo ibice navuga ko ari bitatu. Ubuto bwanjye aho nkomoka i Karongi ya Mubuga (Kibuye), igice nerekana uko twabayeho tubona jenoside itutumba tukiri bato kugeza ubwo tuyikorewe n’abo twari kumwe, hagaheruka igice cya gatatu cya nyuma ya jenoside cyo kwiyubaka, nkanongeraho ko kuvuga aya mateka ari ngombwa cyane ku bayirokotse kuko nibo ba mbere bafite byinshi byo kuvuga ngo atazavugwa uko atari. Kwandika iki gitabo kuri njye kandi ni inshingano kugira ngo aya mateka yacu abe ari twe tuyavuga, bikongera kuba inshingano kuko ndi umubyeyi, kugira ngo abazankomokaho na bo bazamenye uko kuri batabibwiwe n’abandi, cyane cyane ko abana banjye bavukiye mu mahanga. Ikindi ni uko nubwo nababaye cyane ariko sinaheranwe n’agahinda kuko narwanye n’ubuzima,  ubu mpagaze nemye nibyo nshaka ko umwana wanjye azambonaho mbere y’ibindi bikamuha n’imbaraga, aho ari nawe akagira ishema  aho guhora yigunze kuko nyina yabaye muri jenoside. IGIHE: Muri make mu mapaje 277 agize iki gitabo wayavugaho iki ? Dr Gicali : Buri gice cyose kigize iki gitabo cyamvuye ku mutima kuko buri cyose cyagiye gihamagara ikindi, ni uruhererekane rw’ibitekerezo. Nagarutse cyane ku ijambo ‘Bene gihanga’ kuko ni ijambo nkunda cyane ryerekana ko ubundi abanyarwanda bari bamwe. Iri jambo rikomoza ku mateka y’uko abanyarwanda ubundi bari bateye nabishyize mu gitabo kubera ko abanyamahanga bakunze kwibaza uko twabagaho mbere y’uko tugera aho abanyarwanda bica abandi banyarwanda bagenzi babo. Ikindi gice navuzeho, ndibuka ku itariki 24 abasirikare n’Interahamwe badusanga muri Saint Paul badusohora kujya kutwica  bakatwaka indangamuntu buri wese, umwe umwe bamushyira hariya bakubwira bati wowe byarangiye wapfuye jya hariya, gupfa wabaga wabyakiriye mbese ahubwo wifuza ko bakugirira vuba,  kuko sinatekerezaga ko hazongera kubaho ubuzima. Ikindi navuze ni uburyo nabonye Data wari wararokokeye mu Bisesero, ndababara cyane kumubona nta mubiri agifite yarashenguwe n’akaga, ibintu bitagira imvugo, ariko kandi ni nabwo nongeye kumva ko ngomba kugarura ubushake bwo kubaho no kugira imbaraga. Ikindi kintu cyongeye kumpa imbaraga zikomeye ni igihe Abasirikare ba FPR Inkotanyi batubwiraga bati nimuhumure jenoside irarangiye turayihagaritse, ni hahandi uvuga uti ibyo ndimo ni inzozi cyangwa ni filimi ndimo ndeba, ibi byose byatumye ahari urupfu haba ubuzima, ahari ukwiheba hagaruka icyizere. Ndibuka ko ku myaka irindwi umwarimu watwigishaka yakoreshaga amagambo akomeye yatumye menya ko ndi Umututsi ubwo baduhagurutsaga mu ishuri batandukanya amoko y’abana twiganaga, ati “Utunyenzi Nkotanyi hariya, Abahutu hariya n’Abatwa. Nta no kujya gushakira kure kuko kumvisha abantu ko ari udukoko ari utunyenzi, ujya kubica nawe abica yumva koko ko arimo akora neza yivanaho utwo tuntazi yigishijwe ko ari tubi cyane. Ni aho rero izingiro rikomeye riri mu itegurwa rya jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Uretse ayo mateka ababaje nakubwiye hejuru, ngaruka kandi ku kuvuga ubwiza bw’u Rwanda, mvuga icyo kiyaga cya Kivu nakuze ndeba, nkavuga imisozi nkavuga imirambi, bikaba uburyo bwanjye bwo kumva ko byibura mfite aho nkomoka heza bikanduhura umutima. Kuvuga ubwiza bw’u Rwanda uko nduzi ndubona byatumye mbwirwa n’abasomye iki gitabo bo mu Burayi ko bituma bataremererwa n’amateka akomeye ari mu gitabo. IGIHE: Iyo uvuga u Rwanda wumva urwishimiye, wansobanurira ute uko abacitse ku icumu rya jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi batavanye umutima wabo aho bababariye kuko ubundi aho umuntu yagiriwe nabi ntiyifuza kuhasubira? Dr Gicali: Kuri jye birasobanutse, si abanyarwanda bose bakunze u Rwanda kuko hari abasize baruhekuye bakagenda batanashizwe, kuri bo bumva rwaba rwahanaguritse ku ikarita y’Isi. Kubona aho u Rwanda rwivanye naho rugeze, kuko rwa Rwanda rwabakomerekeje muri jenoside, ni rwa Rwanda rwashibutsemo igihugu kitagira uko gisa, ni u Rwanda ubu ruri kubomora imitima, ni u Rwanda ruduha ishema n’icyizere cyo gukomeza kubaho. Ni u Rwanda rw’umutekano, rw’iterambere, ruha abantu Inka, umugore yahawe umwanya, ibi byose nabigarutseho mu gitabo. Nk’ubu urundi rugero naguha, njya ngira ntya nkumva abana banjye bavuye ku ishuri bati wari uzi ko u Rwanda ari urwa mbere muri ibi n’ibi cyangwa rwakoze iki n’iki, ukabona ko bishimiye kugira igihugu nk’icyo bakanabivuga koko. Nk’ubu umwana wanjye w’umuhungu niwe wabwiye se ko mu Rwanda batashye ARENA niwe wantanze kubimenya. Ni ikintu gikomeye mu kubaka imitima y’abantu bibagarurira icyizere twe barokotse cyane cyane. Ntakubeshye iyo u Rwanda ruguma mu macakubiri sinari kuzarusubiramo bibaho, kuko jenoside irangiye numvaga ntanashaka kubyara ngo nderere muri icyo gihugu cy’amacakubiri. Kuko ubuzima nagiriye mu Rwanda, nifuzaga ko ntawankomokaho cyangwa undi wese nabwifuriza. Ariko mujya mwibuka ko nta bwoko bukiba mu ndangamuntu, hari igihe mbyibuka nkasesa urumeza. Ibintu nagarutseho muri iki gitabo ni no kwerekana ko u Rwanda rutarangwa n’amateka ya jenoside gusa, ko ari igihugu cy’isuku cyiza cyakira kigendwa gituje kirinzwe, nifuza ko abo tubana bambaza amakuru y’iwacu kuko mba mfite ibyiza mbabwira. IGIHE: Tugarutse ku mateka yawe muri jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, wowe wari he? Dr Gicali: Icyo gihe nigaga muri Kaminuza ya Nyakinama, mu biruhuko bya Pasika twese twari turi mu rugo iwacu usibye musaza wanjye umwe wari mu mahanga. Naje kuva ku Kibuye rero tariki ya 6 Mata 1994 ngiye i Kigali, muri iryo joro nibwo abantu baraye bicwa, tubonye bikomeye bukeye duhungira muri Saint Paul. Aho rero niho namaze igihe kinini tuhihishe, nyuma nza kujyanwa muri Hotel des Mille Collines, aho twavuye tujya i Kabuga aho Ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi zari zarafashe zihagira inkambi nini yo kwakira abo bagendaga barokora muri Kigali no mu nkengero zaho. Ku itariki ya 9 rero nibwo bateye mu rugo iwacu hicwa Mama na musaza wanjye wiciwe mu Bisesero n’abandi benshi bo mu muryango wanjye n’inshuti, ibi nabibwiwe na murumuna wanjye warokotse ubwo bwicanyi icyo gihe. Data we yaje kurokokera mu bantu 1000 baje kurokokera mu Bisesero mu ntangiriro z’ukwezi kwa karindwi. Nyuma naje kubonana na Papa na musaza wanjye wari mu mahanga ubwo turongera turisuganya. Nyuma rero nibwo naje muri Canada ubu nkaba nubatse mfite umugabo wo muri iki gihugu twabyaranye abana babiri, umukobwa w’imyaka 15 n’umuhungu w’imyaka 12. Nkaba kandi ndi umwe mu bagize umuryango w’abacitse ku icumu rya jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi witwa PAGE-Rwanda IGIHE: Mu gusoza, wowe nk’umuntu wize ibijyanye n’uburezi buganisha ku mahoro y’urubyiruko (Science de l’éduction pour la paix auprès des jeunes) muri Kaminuza ya UQAM, ni ubuhe butumwa mwaha urubyiruko ruzasoma iki kiganiro? Dr Gicali: Ni ikibazo cyiza kuko ndagisubiza nk’ubikora kandi nk’umubyeyi. Nize muri UQAM, niho nanakoreye ubushakashatsi. Ubu ndikorera, mfite umusinga w’uburezi bwibanda ku mahoro. Ndandika nkanatanga ibiganiro mu nama zitandukanye. Ubundi ku Isi nta muntu uvukana urwango, ariko ibyo twahawe mu burezi iwacu, ku ishuri n’ahandi nibyo bitugira abo turibo ubu. Nkaba nifuza ko twakomeza mu nzira yo guca ikintu cyose kibuza umuntu amahoro, burya umuntu ashobora kubaho nta ntambara arimo ariko akabaho nta mahoro afite, kwita ku bidukikije, gukora rukarwanya ubukene nabyo bituma umuntu abura amahoro. Urubyiruko rw’uyu munsi nirwo dutezeho amahoro kuko nibo Rwanda rw’ejo nibo bayobozi b’ejo twifuza. Ibi bikaba bireba n’abakuru bikaba umuco. Kumenya gutanga ibitekerezo byawe ukagira ijambo mu ruhame nabyo biri mu bigarura amahoro, urubyiruko rurusheho kwitekerereza rukanashishoza, kumva n’iby’abandi, kumenya kuvuga n’igihe cyo kuvuga bijyanye no gukemura ibibazo. Njyewe rero mu gutanga ubuhamya nshinshikariza abarokotse n’abandi bose babibonye gutanga ubuhamya kuko igice cya nyuma mu bigize jenoside ni uko abayikoze bayihakana. Ibi nabyo ni ubutumwa naha urubyiruko kuba maso ntihabeho gupfobya cyangwa guhakana amateka ya jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda. Mu kinyarwanda baravuga ngo ‘Igi ryahanuye inyoni’ aba bana turera bavukiye mu Rwanda rushya nibo bazakosora ababyeyi babo (aseka) mbafitiye icyizere.

title: Umunyarwanda ahataniye kuba umudepite muri Canada
content: Hakizimana ushaka umwanya mu Nteko ya Canada, mu migabo n’imigambi bye harimo ko azita ku guhangana n’ikibazo cy’akazi kadafite abagakora muri Canada. Uyu Munyarwanda rukumbi uri mu bakandida-depite bashaka kwicara mu Nteko igizwe n’abantu 338; afite Impamyabumenyi y’Icyiciro cya Gatatu cya Kaminuza mu Miyoborere, aho yazobereye mu bijyanye na Serivisi z’Ubuzima. Inyandiko ya gahunda y’ibyo yifuza gukora (manifesto) ivuga ko yiyemeje kurengera ubuzima bw’abatagira kivugira mu muryango. Intego ye y’ibanze ni ukurwanya ivangura n’iheza binyuze mu gukuraho imbogamizi zituma hari abatagerwaho na serivisi z’ubuvuzi n’izindi bakenera muri sosiyete. Nk’umuyobozi kandi afite impungenge z’akazi kenshi kadafite abantu bagakora muri Canada. Muri Canada imirimo idafite abayikora yari ku kigero cya 5.6 % mu mpera za 2018, ingano iri hasi kuva mu 1976. Muri Kanama uyu mwaka byari 5.7%. Hakizimana afite intego yo guteza imbere ihame ryo gukorera ahantu hanyura abakozi, bagahabwa imishahara ikwiye. Uyu Munyarwanda ahagarariye Akarere ka Rivière des Mille Îles kari mu Ntara ya Québec, gahagararirwa mu Nteko kuva mu 1997. Umuyobozi wa Diaspora Nyarwanda muri Canada, Rwigimba Théophile, yabwiye KT Press ko iyi ari inkuru nziza. Yagize ati “Birashimishije. Ni intambwe nziza ku Munyarwanda muri politiki ya Canada. Aramutse atowe, byaba ari ingenzi gukora akazi keza.’’ Abakandida bemerewe kwiyamamaza ni abafite ubwenegihugu bwa Canada. Inteko Ishinga Amategeko itorwa mu buryo bunyuze mu mucyo. Mu iheruka harimo abadepite 308 biganjemo abinjiyemo mu 2011 ariko biyongereye bagera kuri 338 nyuma y’amatora aheruka yo ku wa 19 Ukwakira 2015. Rwigamba yavuze ko igishobora guha umuntu amahirwe yo gutsinda ariko uko “Aba azwi n’abantu bo mu gace yiyamamarijemo, afite itsinda rimufasha kwiyamamaza n’amafaranga yo kwifashisha muri ibyo bikorwa.’’ Abanyarwanda baba muri Canada kuri ubu babarirwa mu 10,000.

title: USA: Abanyarwanda batuye muri Leta ya Arizona bizihije Umuganura, bashishikarizwa kwigira
content: Icyo gitaramo cyitabiriwe n’Abanyarwanda batuye muri Leta ya Arizona n’inshuti zabo. Mu bashyitsi bitabiriye umunsi w’umuganura harimo  Musenyeri John Rucyahana na Rev Past  Dr. Antoine Rutayisire n’abakozi ba Ambasade y’u Rwanda muri icyo gihugu. Jean de Dieu Niyomugabo uhagarariye Umuryango w’Abanyarwanda batuye muri Leta ya Arizona, yavuze ko umuganura ari umwanya wo gusuzuma imihigo y’umwaka ushize no guhiga indi y’umwaka dutangiye. Yavuze ko  abanyarwanda batuye muri Arizona  nabo bafite umuhigo wo kwiteza imbere, ku buryo nta we uba umuzigo wo gukomeza gufashwa na Leta. Musenyeri Rucyahana n’ Umujyanama wa Mbere muri Ambasade y’u Rwanda muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika Manzi Lawrence, bose bagarutse ku kamaro k’ umuco w ‘abanyarwanda ari nawo bavomamo indangagaciro zibaranga n’ubumwe bwabo. Musenyeri Rucyahana yasobanuriye abari aho umuco w’umuganura uko wakorwaga, maze  ashishikariza abanyarwanda aho bari hirya no hino gufatana urunana, bagakomera ku muco wabo no ku bumwe bwabo, bakirinda amacakubiri aho yaturuka hose. Yaboneyeho gusobanurira abari aho uburyo nyuma yo gusarura, imbuto za mbere zabaga umuganura w’ababyeyi, ashimangira ko bidakwiye ko abanyarwanda batuye mu mahanga bibagirwa ababyeyi babo basize mu Rwanda, bigatuma baba umutwaro kuri Leta, ikaba ariyo ibamenya mu ntege nke zabo zo mu zabukuru. Manzi Lawrence waje ahagarariye Ambasaderi Mathilde Mukantabana, yashimye abanyarwanda batuye muri Arizona ukuntu bakomeje kuba indashyikirwa mu bikorwa binyuranye bakorera hamwe bikaba bigaragaza ukuntu bashyize hamwe. Yagarutse  ku ndangagaciro ziranga umunyarwanda,  asaba abari bateraniye muri iki gikorwa cy’umuganura kudatezuka ku muco wabo no ku bumwe bwabo. Yavuze  ko ubumwe bw’abanyarwanda, gukunda igihugu ari byo byatumye u Rwanda rutera intambwe igaragara nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi, ubu akaba ari igihugu ntangarugero haba mu bumwe bw’abagituye ndetse no mu iterambere.  Yagize ati “ubu u Rwanda rushyize imbere iterambere rirambye, hamwe no kwagura amarembo rugahahirana n’ibihugu cyane cyane ibyo ku Mugabane w’Afurika.’ Manzi yashishikarije  Abanyarwanda batuye muri Arizona gukomera ku bumwe bwabo no gushishikariza abashoramari bahatuye gushora imari mu Rwanda, ndetse nabo ubwabo. Yagize ati  “Muze mushore imari mu mishinga yunguka, ubuyobozi bw’igihugu buzabibafashamo, kandi isoko ni rinini kuko u Rwanda rwaguye amarembo, ufite ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi mu Rwanda aba afite amahirwe yo kugera ku isoko ryagutse ryo mu karere ndetse na Afurika yose”. Igitaramo cyaranzwe n’imbyino za Kinyarwanda, guha abana amata ndetse no gusangira amafunguro yari yiganjemo imbuto zera mu Rwanda.

title: Danemark: Abanyarwanda bo mu bihugu bigize Scandinavie bizihije Umunsi w’Umuganura (Amafoto)
content: Tariki ya 31 Kanama 2019, nibwo uyu muhango wabereye Copenhague, Umurwa mukuru wa Danemark. Nk’uko bisanzwe iki gikorwa kigenda gihabwa igihugu kizaberamo, umwaka ushize cyabereye Oslo muri Norvège, umwaka utaha wa 2020 bakaba bemeje ko kizabera i Stockholm muri Suède ari naho cyatangiriye Ni umuhango witabiriwe cyane n’abantu barenga 300, umushyitsi mukuru akaba yari Amb. Nkulikiyinka Christine, uhagarariye u Rwanda i Stockholm muri ibi bihugu uko bigize Scandinavie. Mu ijambo rye Amb. Nkulikiyinka yagarutse ku biranga umuganura n’isura iki gikorwa gifite uyu munsi mu mateka y’umuco nyarwanda. Ati “Iki gikorwa gitegurwa mu nzego zitandukanye z’igihugu, bijyanye n’umuco wo soko y’ubumwe bw’abanyarwanda n’ishingiro ryo kwigira. Umuganura kandi nabibutsa ko warenze gusa ubuhinzi ufatira izindi nzego z’ubuzima twifashisha duharanira kwigira nyabyo”. Amb. Nkurikiyinka akomeza agira ati “Ubu umuco wacu tuwuvanamo umusaruro mu ikoranabuhanga, imikino, imyidagaduro, ubucuruzi, ibikorwa remezo n’ibindi”. Yagarutse ku nsanganyamatsiko y’Umuganura igira iti "Umuco, isoko y’ubumwe n’inshingano yo kwigira", avuga ko ishingiye ku ndangagaciro z’umuco w’u Rwanda. Ati “Gukunda igihugu ariko harimo no kurinda ibyagezweho, kandi ntibivuga kukirinda n’urugamba rw’amasasu gusa. Ingamba ni nyinshi, ubu muri iyi minsi turarwana n’urugamba rw’amakuru atari yo (fake news) rw’abantu baba bagamije gusenya ubumwe bw’abanyarwanda. Mujye mutwegera nicyo tubereyeho nka Ambasade tubahe amakuru nyayo”. Ambasaderi Nkulikiyinka yasoje ashimira ukuntu abantu bitabiriye ari benshi kandi harimo urubyiruko rwinshi, ashimira abaturutse hirya no hino mu bindi bihugu n’umuhanzi Jules Sentore waturutse mu Rwanda n’abaturutse mu Bubiligi baje gufatanya kwizihiza uyu Muganura 2019 i Copenhague. Amb. Nkulikiyinka yanakanguriye abitabiriye umuganura kuzitabira Rwanda Day ari benshi tariki ya 5 Ukwakira  i Bonn mu Budage. Teajeni Misago uyobora Diaspora nyarwanda muri Copenhague, mu ijambo rye yashimiye byimazeyo abantu bose baje kubatera ingabo mu bitugu muri iki gikorwa, ashimira abashyize hamwe bose ngo iki gikorwa kigende neza kuko kwakira ibihugu bitanu atari ibintu byoroshye. Ati “Kera iyo umuntu yezaga ntiyisangizaga wenyine, yahuraga n’abandi kugira ngo birusheho kuba byiza. Guhura no gusangira umunezero nicyo twe n’abanyarwanda twiyemeje kuko bidusaba nyine gukora cyane kandi bitanga umusaruro”. Mu biganiro kandi hagaragayemo urubyiruko rurimo umwe mu bagiye mu itorero Indangamirwa 2019, Chelssy Kayihura, watanze ikiganiro abwira bagenzi be b’urubyiruko ko yagize amahirwe adasanzwe yo kumenya amateka yaho avuka biciye mu Itorero Indangamirwa. Ati “Bitanga kumenya imyitwarire, ukamenya gukorana n’abandi kugirana ipfundo n’igihugu cyawe, mbere sinumvaga neza ibyo ari byo”. Kayihura yashimiye ubuyobozi bwa Ambasade y’u Rwanda muri Suède ibafasha kumenya gahunda zikorerwa urubyiruko mu Rwanda, avuga ko ari uburyo babafasha kubigeza ku babyeyi bakabigiramo uruhare mu kumvisha uruhare rwabyo abana. Jackiline Hansen uhagarariye umuryango w’abanyarwanda muri Jylland and Fyn mu ijambo rye, yashimiye ubuyobozi bw’u Rwanda abicishije muri Ambasade uburyo ibaba hafi mu bikorwa bitandukanye. Ati “Natwe nk’abanyarwanda turabizeza ko dufite ingufu kandi ko dukomeje kuzishyira hamwe twakomeza kugera kuri byinshi”. Ni umunsi waranzwe n’ibyishimo, ubusabane no guhanahana amakuru no kumenyana birushijeho. Uyu muhango ngarukamwaka ukorwa buri cyumweru cya nyuma cya Kanama, kugira ngo bahure ari benshi kandi bawitegure neza. Ni umunsi wahuje abakuru, abato, inshuti z’abanyarwanda, ni umugoroba wabayemwo gutaramana n’abahanzi batandukanye nka Sentore Jules waturutse mu Rwanda. Uyu mwaka DJ Nyirimbabazi Flora uturutse mu Bubiligi yasusurukije imbaga yari aho nyuma ya  Sentore mu buryo bushimishije. Amafoto y’uko byari bimeze n’ikiganiro muri Video cya Amb. title: Abanyarwanda bo mu bihugu bya Scandinavie bagiye guhurira muri Danemark bizihiza Umuganura
content: Iki gikorwa umwaka ushize cyabere Oslo muri Norvège, kandi mu mujyi kibereyemo hahita hatangarizwa aho kizabera umwaka ukurikiyeho. Umunyamabanga wa mbere wa muri Ambasade y’u Rwanda muri Suède, Umulisa Elise, mu kiganiro kigufi na IGIHE yahamije ko uyu uzaba ari umunsi ukomeye ku banyarwanda bo muri biriya bihugu. Yagize ati "Iki ni igikorwa kimwe mu binini bihuriza hamwe Abanyarwanda batuye muri aka karere ka Scandinavie mu Majyaruguru y’u Burayi, kigenda gikura buri mwaka, kugira ngo kigende kigera ku ntego baba biyemeje, mu kumenya no kuganira ku bibera mu gihugu no kureba uko babigiramo uruhare.” Yavuze ko Umuganura ari umwanya wo kwishimira ibyiza igihugu cyagezeho. Ati "Turisuzuma tukareba aho tugeze twiyubaka nk’umuryango Nyarwanda muri ibi bihugu by’Amajyaruguru y’u Burayi, uko dutoza abato, uko twakwiteza imbere muri ibi bihugu n’ uruhare twese twakomeza kugira mu iterambere ry’u Rwanda.’’ Umwe mu Banyarwanda batuye muri aka karere, Dr Ngoga Innocent, yavuze ko ari iby’agaciro kugira umwanya bakaganirira hamwe. Ati "Ni iby’agaciro kugira umwanya nk’uyu abana bacu, inshuti zacu, tukabaganiriza aho dukomoka, kuko utagira iyo ava ntamenya iyo ajya, ntanamenya kubana neza n’abamwakiriye. Ikindi kandi bituma duhora turi hafi mu bikorwa no mu bitekerezo n’igihugu cyacu u Rwanda.” Abanyarwanda batuye muri Danemark bakereye kwakira iki gikorwa cy’Umuganura. Umuyobozi w’Umuryango w’Abanyarwanda baba Copenhagen, Misago Teajeni, yavuze ko “Bidufasha kurushaho kumenyana uko dutuye muri ibi bihugu, gukorera hamwe no kwigira ku byiza bamwe muri twe baba bamaze kugeraho, tugakomeza imihigo.’’ Ukuriye Umuryango w’Abanyarwanda muri Jylland and Fyn, muri Danmark, Jackline Hansen yashimiye ubuyobozi bw’u Rwanda buha agaciro Abanyarwanda batuye hanze. Yakomeje avuga ko “Turashimira na Ambasade itekereza ku gikorwa kiduhuriza hamwe tukareba aho twavuye, tukishimira aho tugeze n’aho tujya nk’Abanyarwanda.’’ Umuganwa Marie Christine utuye muri Jylland and Fyn yavuze ko iki gikorwa ngarukamwaka kibongera imbaraga zo gusigasira umuco nyarwanda, ururimi rw’Ikinyarwanda, igitaramo Nyarwanda ati kidukumbuza iwacu. Ati ni igikorwa kandi dutumiramo n’abo muri ibi bihugu dutuyemo, tubaganirira ku gihugu cyacu, bakamenya amakuru y’ukuri ku gihugu cyacu. Uyu munsi uhuza Abanyarwanda bavuye hirya no hino muri ibi bihugu bya Scandinavie uko ari bitanu, uberamo ibiganiro byimbitse hagati y’Abanyarwanda n’inzego bishyiriyeho zibayobora bafatanyije na Ambasade y’u Rwanda muri ibyo bihugu. Ni umunsi w’ubusabane kandi w’umuco wo guhana hana amakuru, no kumenyana birushijeho. Bimaze kumenyerwa ko uyu muhango ngarukamwaka ukorwa buri cyumweru cya nyuma cya Kanama, kugirango Abanyarwanda bahure ari benshi kandi bawitegure neza, kuko usanga ibirometero baturukamo muri ibyo bihugu bigari n’ubwo ari ibituranyi, biba bitoroshye guhuza abantu bangana batyo. Ni umunsi uhuza abakuru n’abato n’inshuti z’Abanyarwanda, utumirwamo abahanzi batandukanye bavuye mu Rwanda cyangwa mu bindi bihugu birimo Diaspora nyarwanda. Uyu mwaka batumiye DJ Nyirimbabazi Flora uturutse mu Bubiligi na Jules Sentore uzaturuka mu Rwanda. Amafoto y’uko byari bimeze umwaka ushize [email protected]

title: Abanyarwanda baba muri Nigeria bizihije Umunsi wo #Kwibohora25
content: Kwizihiza Umunsi Mukuru wo Kwibohora ku nshuro ya 25 byakozwe Abuja uwo munsi kubera impamvu zinyuranye zatumye bidakorwa ku itariki ya 4 Nyakanga yabigenewe. Uwo muhango witabiriwe n’abashyitsi barimo Abayobozi bakuru muri Guverinoma ya Nigeria, bari barangajwe imbere n’ Umunyamabanga Uhoraho muri Minisiteri y’ Ububanyi n’ Amahanga, Ambasaderi Mustapha Lawal Sulaiman;  abahagarariye ibihugu byabo muri Nigeria n’Inshuti z’ u Rwanda. Bose bari baje kwifatanya n’Abanyarwanda baba Abuja n’ ahandi muri Nigeria. Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Nigeria, Kamanzi Stanislas, yagaragaje ko hashize imyaka 25,  u Rwanda rwari rugiye gusenyuka burundu bitewe n’abayobozi babi barangwaga no kudakunda igihugu, bateguye bakanashyira mu bikorwa jenoside yakowe Abatutsi yahitanye inzirakarengane zisaga miliyoni mu minsi 100 gusa. Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi kandi yashegeshe igihugu mu mfuruka zose kuko ubukungu bwacyo bwangiritse, kigera aho cyashoboraga no kutongera kubaho, keretse ku bw’ igitangaza. Yagize ati “Ubu u Rwanda rwariyubatse rurongera rubaho. Uyu mwaka twishimiye kubahamiriza ko dufite u Rwanda rushya, aho abaturarwanda bose bafatwa kimwe kandi bakarangwa n’ubumwe.” Yakomeje avuga ko “byasabye umuhate n’ubwitange bw’intwari z’Abanyarwanda zakoze ibishoboka byose zihagarika Jenoside yakorerwaga Abatutsi, zigahuza Abanyarwanda, zikubaka Igihugu bundi bushya. Yavuze ko urwo rugendo  rwashobotse kubera  imiyoborere myiza  u Rwanda  rwagejejweho  na Nyakubahwa Perezida Paul Kagame. Ati “ U Rwanda ni igihugu kirangwamo imiyoborere myiza ishingiye ku gaciro k’ abanyarwanda, gukunda igihugu,  ku ruhare rwa buri wese mu kubaka igihugu,  ku myumvire kuri buri wese  yo kurangiza inshingano ze uko bikwiye,   umuhate mu gukora byinshi bishoboka kandi byiza kabone n’ iyo amikoro yaba make,   no  ku guharanira impinduka n’ ibikorwa biteza imbere Igihugu hifashishijwe  gutekereza buri gihe uburyo bushya  bunoze byagerwaho.” Ambasaderi Kamanzi yaboneyeho umwanya wo gushimira igihugu cya  Nigeria  ko cyakomeje kubanira neza no gushyigikira u Rwanda kidatezutse, mu rugendo rwo kwibohora  no kongera kwiyubaka. Mu izina rya Guverinoma y’u Rwanda, Ambasaderi Kamanzi yongeye gushimira Perezida Muhammadu Buhari wongeye gutorerwa kuyobora Nigeria, anifuriza ishya n’ ihirwe Guverinoma nshya aherutse gushyiraho. Umunyamabanga Uhoraho muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga ya Nigeria, Ambasaderi Mustapha Lawal Sulaiman yashimye intambwe u Rwanda rumaze gutera nyuma y’imyaka 25 rwibohoye, ndetse n’ibyo rumaze kugeraho mu nzira ya demokarasi, imiyoborere myiza, imibereho y’abaturage n’ibikorwa by’amajyambere. Yashimye kandi uruhare rw’u Rwanda mu bikorwa byo kugarura amahoro n’umutekano mu bihugu bitandukanye. Yagarutse ku mibanire myiza ya Nigeria n’u Rwanda, n’ imikoranire myiza iranga ibihugu byombi mu guteza imbere abaturage babyo, no gushaka icyatuma imibanire mpuzamahanga irushaho gutera imbere. Yagarutse ku rugendo Umukuru w’Igihugu aherutse kugirira muri Nigeria aho yitabiriye iyizihizwa ry’Umunsi mukuru wa Demokarasi muri Nigeria ashimangira ko ari ikimenyetso gikomeye gihamya imibanire n’imikoranire myiza hagati y’ibihugu byombi. Yavuze ko ubuhahirane hagati y’ibihugu byombi burushaho gutera imbere, atanga urugero  ko ibigo by’imari byo muri Nigeria byafunguye amashami yabyo mu Rwanda ndetse n’ ingendo za RwandAir zihuza ibihugu byacu buri munsi. Yijeje ko Nigeria yiteguye gukomeza kwagura no kunoza imibanire n’ ubufatanye mu bukungu hagati yayo n’u Rwanda. Umukuru wungirije mu Badipolomati bahagarariye ibihugu byabo muri Nigeria, Ambasaderi Al-Hassan Conteh wa Liberia, yanyuzwe n’umuhate w’Abanyarwanda utuma ubu igihugu cyabo kiri mu by’icyitegererezo ku Isi. Yagize ati "U Rwanda rwanyuze mu bihe bikomeye mu nzira yarwo yo kwibohora nk’igihugu cyari cyashegeshwe na Jenoside.’’ Yakomeje avuga ko ari ishimwe kuba Abanyarwanda bazirikana ibyabaye mu gihugu mu 1994 mu gihe bishimira iterambere cyagezeho. Yagize ati “Ndashimira Guverinoma y’u Rwanda n’Abanyarwanda uburyo bahagaritse Jenoside, ubu bakaba ari igihugu ntangarugero ku Isi, ahantu hari iterambere ryihuse kandi hakaba harangwa ubumwe n’ubwiyunge.” Ibi birori kandi byaranzwe n’ ibikorwa binyuranye byo kumurikira ababyitabiriye intambwe imaze guterwa na RwandAir mu kwagura amarembo y’ u Rwanda, bijyanye n’ amahame yo kwibohora. Hagaragajwe ingendo zayo mu byerekezo bitandukanye ku mugabane wa Afurika n’ahandi ku Isi. Hanakozwe tombola aho abanyamahirwe batatu batsindiye amatike y’indege yo kujyana na RwandAir.

title: U Bubiligi: Abanyarwanda basuye ingoro ibitse amateka ya Afurika yo hagati mu bukoloni (Amafoto)
content: Ni igikorwa cyabaye mu minsi ishize ku Cyicaro cya ‘Royal Museum for Central Africa iherereye mu nkengero z’umurwa mukuru Bruxelles ahitwa Tervuren, i Leuvensesteenweg, 13 – 3080, cyitabirwa n’abanyarwanda n’abandi bakunda kwitabira  ibiganiro nk’ibyo barimo Abanyaburayi bagenda muri Afurika cyangwa bahakorera. Mbere yo gutambagizwa berekwa iyi ngoro ibonekamo amateka yo mu gihe cy’ubukoloni mu Rwanda, u Burundi na Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo, Umuyobozi mukuru wa Africa Museum (Royal Museum for Central Africa), Guido Gryeels, yagarutse ku mateka y’iyi nzu ndangamateka. Guido Gryeels yavuze ko iyi ngoro yatangijwe mu 1898 n’umwami w’u Bubiligi Léopold II icyo gihe yari gusa Ingoro y’abakoroni ariko biza guhindurwa yongera gufungurwa mu isura nshya mu  Ukuboza 2018 nyuma y’imyaka itanu ivugururwa, mu gikorwa cyatwaye miliyoni 62 z’amayero. Guido Gryeels yishimira cyane kubona ukuntu abanyarwanda bitabiriye kuza ari benshi gusura iyi Ngoro. Ati “Birashimishije ni ubwa mbere tubonye Abanyarwanda hano benshi icyarimwe mu bintu biteguye neza kandi bijyanye na gahunda n’imyumvire y’ubuyobozi bw’iyi ngoro yavuguruwe”. Yakomeje agira ati “Turashaka ko iyi Ngoro Abanyafurika bayigiramo uruhare cyane kuko ibitse ibintu byabo”. Yakomeje ashimira ubufatanye bafitanye n’Ingoro ndangamateka y’u Rwanda, aho ari rwo gihugu cya mbere cyahise kigirana imikoranire nayo byihuse kandi bya hafi hakaba hanateganyijwe imishinga myinshi yo gukorera hamwe no guhanahana bimwe mu bintu byakuwe mu Rwanda mu gihe cy’obukoloni byinshi biyibitsemo. Iyi ngoro ikorerwamo n’ubushakashtsi ku rwego rwo hejuru ku bantu baturuka hirya no hino ku Isi ndetse n’ibitangazamakuru byinshi bikomeye biaz kuhatara amakuru. Karirima Ngarambe uhagarariye IGIHE ku mugabane w’u Burayi niwe wasabye ko iki gikorwa cyabaho nyuma y’ikiganiro yagiranye n’Umushakashatsi w’Umunyarwanda, Dr Uwizeyimana Emeline, akaba n’umwe mu nzobere esheshatu zikomoka muri Afurika zagize uruhare mu mpinduka zakozwe muri iyi ngoro. Iki kiganiro cyabaye ivumburamatsiko kuri benshi bahise bagaragaza inyota yo kumenya byinshi iyi ngoro ibitse ku mateka y’igihugu cyabo n’akarere muri rusange. Karirima yashimiye byimazeyo Umuyobozi mukuru wa Africa Museum [Royal Museum for Central Africa], Guido Gryeels na Dr Uwizeyimana Emeline wabigizemwo uruhare. Mu ijambo rye Gilles Bazambanza uhagarariye DRB-Rugali, yashimiye abagize uruhare bose ngo iki gikorwa kibeho kandi ashimishwa nuko haje urubyiruko rwinshi kuko bazarushaho kumenya amateka yaho baturuka. Yijeje ubufatanye burambye hagati y’abanyarwanda bo mu Bubiligi na Africa Museum (Royal Museum for Central Africa) kuko uku gusura kwakozwe ku bufatanye nta kiguzi, mu gihe ubusanzwe gusura iyi ngoro ndangamurage ari ukwishyura. Dr Uwizeyimana yabwiye IGIHE ko yashimishijwe nuko Abanyarwanda batabiriye  ari benshi, bakabasha gusobanurirwa no kwirebera uburyo habaye impinduka nyinshi, kuko mbere hari ibyo berekanaga kandi bitari byiza. Yatanze urugero nkaho berekanaga Umunyafurika nk’umucakara, bakerekana amashusho y’imirimo y’agahato, agaragaza Abanyafurika mu mashyamba n’imibereho idahwitse. Ati “Ayo mateka y’Abanyafurika yari yaratanzwe n’abera, ibi byose twabikozeho ubushakashatsi habaho impinduka, ni byiza kuza kwirebera, haba hari n’ibyo kutugiramo inama bigakomeza gukosorwa.” ‘‘Iyi nzu yahaga agaciro cyane Ababiligi b’abakoloni nk’intwari, kandi mu by’ukuri baje muri Afurika bica abantu, babakoresha imirimo y’agahato, bituma Abanyafurika benshi cyane nko muri RDC bahatakariza ubuzima.’’ Umuyobozi ushinzwe Ibikorwa mu Nzu Ndangamurage y’Ubukoloni, Bruno Verberg, yabwiye IGIHE ko harimo umutungo gakondo w’amateka y’u Rwanda urimo ibijyanye n’ubugeni, ibisigazwa byakuwe mu matongo, inyandiko za kera zirimo izo abategetsi b’u Bubiligi bohererezanyaga n’Abashefu b’Abanyarwanda n’ibindi byajyanywe n’abamisiyoneri b’Ababiligi. Igikorwa cyasojwe n’ubusabane.  	Indi nkuru wasoma: U Bubiligi: Bwa mbere Abanyarwanda bagiye gusura ingoro ibitse amateka akomeye yo mu bukoloni Igikorwa uko cyagenze mu mafoto

title: U Bubiligi: Byinshi kuri Sesonga umaze kwandika izina mu bucuruzi bw’imodoka (Video)
content: Sesonga yatekereje gufata serivisi yahaga umuryango we arayagura, ayigira ishoramari rishobora kumubyarira inyungu. Yatangiye ubucuruzi bw’imodoka by’umwuga, ashaka ibyangombwa n’uburenganzira bwo gukora. Uyu Munyarwanda yihangiye umurimo abinyujije muri Sosiyete yashinze yise ‘SAM 4’ ifasha Abanyarwanda gutumiza imodoka ku Mugabane w’u Burayi no kuziha ibyangombwa byo gukorera mu bice bitandukanye. Sesonga atuye mu nkengero z’Umujyi wa Liège mu gihe sosiyete ye ikorera hafi y’Ikibuga Mpuzamahanga cy’Indege  gikomeye mu Bubiligi cya Zaventem giherereye mu nkengero z’Umurwa Mukuru Bruxelles. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE yavuze ko ishoramari ry’imodoka akora arihuza no gutanga serivisi zirimo izo gusuzuma ubuziranenge bw’ibinyabiziga (contrôle technique) ku binyabiziga byo mu Bubiligi. Iyi serivisi ikenerwa na benshi kuko abahatuye batabona umwanya wo gukoresha imodoka isuzuma ry’ubuziranenge, bakiyambaza ababigize umwuga. Iyi serivisi itangwa ku modoka zirengeje imyaka ine, ntigenewe abo mu Bubiligi gusa ahubwo n’Abanyarwanda bashobora kuyifashisha mu gihe babengutse imodoka kuri internet. Yagize ati “N’umuntu mu Rwanda ashobora kubona imodoka kuri internet, akadusaba kumurebera ko ari nzima. Hariho abatekamutwe bashyira imodoka kuri internet bakabwira umuntu ngo ohereza amafaranga, rimwe na rimwe wa muntu akabura imodoka n’amafaranga.” Serivisi y’isuzuma ry’imodoka Sesonga ayitanga abifashijwemo n’uburenganzira yahawe binyuze mu kizwi nka “plaque Z.’’ Ni plaque y’igaraje ashobora gukoresha atwara imodoka cyangwa akayiha indi. Iyo plaque iyo ishyizwe ku modoka biyemerera kuba yava mu Budage ikajyanwa mu Bubiligi. Iyo uguze imodoka umuntu asigarana plaque ye kuko iba imwanditseho, iyo ayigurishije yambikwa plaque Z kugira ngo ibone uko igenda idakumiriwe. Sesonga anafasha Abanyarwanda koroherwa no kubona imodoka zivuye i Burayi. Mu Rwanda ahafite sosiyete itanga ubufasha bujyanye no gushakira ibyangombwa imodoka zivuye hanze ikorera muri Magerwa, ikorewamo n’abavandimwe be Rusagara Alexis na Mukasine Marie Grâce. Ati “Uwatumije imodoka, ashobora kohereza amafaranga, ikamugeraho i Kigali kandi mu buryo bwizewe.’’ Sosiyete ya Sesonga ifite umukozi w’inzobere usuzuma imodoka mbere yo gukora urugendo ruva ku Cyambu cya Dar es Salaam yerekeza i Kigali. Iyo imodoka yoherejwe, uwayitumije anafashwa kumenya aho igeze mu nzira yose icamo kuva ku Cyambu cya Anvers  mu Bubiligi gifite uburenganzira bwo kunyuzwaho imodoka zakoze, zoherezwa muri Afurika. Imodoka nyinshi zikurwa mu Budage, mu Buholandi, u Bwongereza zikanyuzwa kuri icyo cyambu aho ubwato buhaguruka inshuro ebyiri mu kwezi. Imodoka ivuye Anvers igera i Dar es Salaam mu byumweru bitatu, mbere yo gusesekara i Kigali nyuma y’iminsi ibiri. Sesonga Samuel amaze no kumenyekana mu Banyarwanda baba mu bihugu bitandukanye muri Afurika, birimo Congo Brazzaville na Sénégal bamutuma imodoka. ‘SAM 4’ itanga serivisi eshatu zirimo izo kugurira ababyifuza imodoka, gukoresha isuzuma ry’ubuziranenge no gufasha umuntu kujyana imodoka aho yifuza hose mu Bubiigi no mu Burayi akoresheje Plaque Z. Mu Rwanda itanga serivisi zirimo gukura imodoka na kontineri ku cyambu cya Dar es salaam zigezwa i Kigali no kohereza ibicuruzwa mu mahanga yose. Ikorera mu nyubako ya “Le prestige’’ iri Rwandex iruhande rwa Sitasiyo ya Discentre. Ushaka ibindi bisobanuro wabaza Sesonga Samuel (0032488 384 832), Rusagara Alexis (00250 788 235 600) na Mukasine Marie Grâce (00250 788 40222).

title: U Bubiligi: Abanyarwanda bahuriye mu rugendo rwa ‘‘Balade Santé’’ ku nshuro ya gatanu (Amafoto)
content: Iki gikorwa ngarukamwaka gitegurwa na IGIHE, Ishami ryo ku Mugabane w’u Burayi rikorera mu Bubiligi, ku nshuro yacyo ya gatanu cyabereye ahitwa ‘‘Château de La Hulpe’’ kuri iki Cyumweru tariki ya 11 Kanama 2019. Balade Santé igizwe n’urugendo rukorerwa ahantu hareshya n’ibilometero bitandatu, yatangiye gukorwa bwa mbere tariki ya 8 Ugushyingo 2015. Uru rugendo rwateguwe ku bufatanye na “Resto Boule Bleu” iyobowe na Rusaro Yvette, “Roums Center Ltd” iyobowe na Rugerero Jean Pierre, “Africa Cash” ya Nsengiyumva Ramadhani na “Resto Archipel” iyobowe na Nadine Kaze, La Verdure iyobowe na Munyampeta Vital na DRB-Rugali, agace ka Brabant Wallon. Umuyobozi uhagarariye IGIHE mu Burayi, Karirima A. Ngarambe, yagarutse ku mpamvu y’iki gikorwa, asobanura n’urugendo rw’imyaka 10 rwa IGIHE rwaranzwe n’imikoranire ihamye. Ati” IGIHE irabashimira byimazeyo ku bwitabire bwanyu. Muri iyi myaka 10 ishize IGIHE yabaye ikiraro hagati ya diaspora n’u Rwanda ku buryo Umunyarwanda aho ari hose umunsi ku wundi yabashije guhora ajyana n’aho igihugu kiba kigeze ndetse na benshi muri mwe mukora ibikorwa bifitiye urwababyaye akamaro, kubimenyekanisha byarushijeho koroha, kandi inzira iracyakomeza” “Kwitabira "Balade Santé" ni uburyo bwo kurushaho kwegerana, gusabana ari nako buri wese ananura umubiri n’ubwonko, dushimiye kandi na none buri wese witabiriye iki gikorwa.” Yakomeje avuga ko icyizere cyabo ari igihango gihoraho mu kurushaho kunoza serivisi zaba iz’itangazamakuru n’izindi zitangwa na IGIHE Ltd. Muri iki gikorwa kandi Abanyarwanda bafite ibikorwa mu Bubiligi no mu Rwanda bahawe umwanya wo gutanga ubuhamya bwaho bavuye naho bageze mu kwiteza imbere binyuze mu kwihangira imirimo. Igikorwa cyasojwe n’ubusabane, indirimbo z’umuco gakondo no gusangira nk’uko byakorwaga mu buryo bw’Abanyarwanda bo hambere. Abitabiriye iki gikorwa basabwe kandi kuzitabira Rwanda Day y’uyu mwaka izabera mu Mujyi wa Bonn mu Budage ku wa 24 Kanama 2019, ari benshi. Dr Mugabo Gérard na Deo Mazina, bari batumiwe muri iki gikorwa cya Balade Santé, baganirije abitabiriye ku byiza byo gukora imyitozo ngororangingo bababwira ko ’Sport’ ari wo muti wa mbere w’ubuzima. Château de La Hulpe aho uru rugendo rwabereye ni mu gace kagizwe n’ishyamba bita ‘‘Forêt de Soignes’’, harimo inzira zabugenewe mu gukoreramo ingendo n’ubusitani bwiza. Ubu butaka bwagiye bugurwa n’abantu batandukanye ariko kugira ngo hamere uko hameze ubu byatangiye mu 1893 ubwo umutungo wagurwaga n’umunyenganda witwa Ernest Solvay, wahimbye sosiyete izwi cyane ku izina rya Solvay & Co, nyuma yaje kuharaga abana be bakomeza kuhakora neza.

title: U Bubiligi: ‘Rukumberi ntikizimye twararokotse’- Mukayiranga
content: Abarokotse Jenoside bafite urugamba rukomeye rwo gusigasira amateka, bakusa ikivi cyasizwe n’abishwe. Uyu mukoro uri mu butumwa bwa Mukayiranga Adorata uvuka i Rukumberi, agace kiciwemwo benshi bo mu muryango we muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Uyu mubyeyi utuye mu Bubiligi yaganiriye na IGIHE atanga ubuhamya ku mateka ye n’umuryango we wishwe, agaragaza ko uwarokotse afite inshingano zikomeye ku mateka ye n’ahazaza. Mu buryo bujimije kandi buri mu kinyarwanda cyiza Mukayiranga aragarurira Rukumberi ishusho yayo, aha iyo avuga Rukumberi aba avuga abe, igihe cyiza yahagiriye haba mu buto no mu bukuru, ibihe byiza yamaranye n’abe bahiciwe cyangwa biciwe hirya no hino mu gihugu aho bari barashatse, cyangwa bakoreraga. Iyi Rukumberi ayivuga agira ati “Ndavuga Rukumberi ariko ibyo mvuga buri wese wabaye muri aya mateka ni ibye kuko tugenda duhuza amateka, si umwihariko wanjye gusa”. Mukayiranga wavutse ku babyeyi baciriwe muri ako gace n’ubutegetsi bubi bwifuzaga ko Abatutsi bazicwa n’isazi ya Tse Tse, agira ati “Ariko uko babishakaga siko byagenze kuko barahabaciriye baraza batema ishyamba, barahahinga barahubaka, Rukumberi igira imiharuro igira imigendererano igira abakobwa n’abahungu barorora baratunga, bahagira ahantu heza bivuye mu ngufu zabo”. Avuga ariko ko bitabujije umwanzi kurangiza umushinga yari yaratangiye wo kubacira mu mashyamba ngo bazicwe na Tsetse, kuko muri jenoside yawushyize mu bikorwa. Mukayiranga, Jenoside yakozwe ari kwa Se wabo i Kigali ariko muri iyo nzu yarimo abantu 12 barishwe arokokamo wenyine. Muri Rukumberi, ahari urwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi  rushyinguyemo imibiri irenga ibihumbi mirongo ine, harimo abaturanyi ba Mukayiranga n’abandi bishwe bazira ubusa. Kugeza ubu we nta muvandimwe we yigeze amenya urwo yishwe, ngo abone umubiri we. Ibi ariko ntibimubuza kuza kenshi gusura no kwifatanya n’abandi igihe cyose habayeho imihango yo gushyingura mu cyubahiro uko imibiri igenda iboneka, bikamufasha kumva ko wenda haba harimwo abe. Basaza ba Mukayiranga babiri, bombi bishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi. Akomeza agir ati “Nubwo muri Rukumberi harokotse abantu bake, ntihazimye bazirikana ubutwari bw’ababyeyi bahageze mu 1959, bagatema ishyamba, hagaturwa, bagatunga, bakabyara abana”. Ku barokotse, uyu mubyeyi agaragaza ko ari igihe cyo gusana imitima no gufasha ababakomokaho kuzusa ikivi cy’ababyeyi bishwe. Yagize ati “Uretse na Rukumberi, turi intumwa ntabwo tugomba kuba abasigariye ubusa, tugomba gukora twishimira ubuzima turimo, twishimira leta yacu idahwema kudufasha, tugomba no kuvuga ukuri ku byatubayeho.” Agaragaza ko hatabayeho kurwanya abashaka kugoreka amateka, hari abafite umugambi mubi bayasibanganya. Ati “Abantu batwishe, bakatwicira imiryango, bakatwicira igihugu, bazatugorekera amateka bitubabaze.” Yibutsa ko kubwira abana amateka nyakuri ari n’inzira yo guharanira ko Jenoside itazongera ukundi. Mukayiranga asanga Abanyarwanda bagize uruhare muri Jenoside yakorerwaga Abatutsi, bakica ababyeyi n’impinja, baranganga igihugu cyabo, “Ntabwo wakunda u Rwanda ngo umene amaraso y’Abanyarwanda.” Ashimira ingabo z’Inkotanyi zabohoye igihugu, zikarokora abari bataricwa, bakabakura mu rufunzo n’ahandi. Ikiganiro muri Vidéo

title: U Bufaransa: Abanyarwanda bararimbanyije mu myiteguro ya Rwanda Day 2019
content: Abanyarwanda batuye mu bice bitandukanye by’Isi bararimbanyije mu myiteguro yo kwerekeza ahazabera Rwanda Day 2019. Abo mu Bufaransa bakomeje gushishikarizwa kuzitabira uwo munsi ufite amateka afatika mu buzima bw’Abanyarwanda n’igihugu cyabibarutse. Mu butumwa bwe, Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Bufaransa, Kabale Jacques, yakanguriye Abanyarwanda kwiyandikisha hakiri kare kuko bizafasha mu myiteguro yo kubakira. Itangazo yashyizeho umukono ryo ku wa 7 Kanama 2019, rigira riti “Ambasade y’u Rwanda iramenyesha Abanyarwanda baba mu Bufaransa, u Butaliyani, Espagne, Portugal na Monaco ko Rwanda Day izabera mu Mujyi wa Bonn mu Budage ku wa 24 Kanama 2019.’’ Rikomeza rivuga ko “Ambasade iboneyeho gutumira abanyamuryango bayo baba mu Bufaransa kwitabira icyo gikorwa cy’ingenzi no kwiyandikisha.’’ Rwanda Day ni umwanya mwiza wo kungurana ibitekerezo, abayitabira bahabwa igihe cyo kubaza ibibazo Umukuru w’Igihugu, gutanga ibitekerezo n’ibyifuzo bitandukanye. Abanyarwanda baba mu Bufaransa bakiriye Rwanda Day yabereye i Paris mu 2011. Icyo gihe yitabiriwe n’abantu 3700 barimo Abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo. Insanganyamatsiko yagiraga iti “Urungano rufite agaciro. Icyerekezo cy’Iterambere.” Muri iyi Rwanda Day, mu butumwa Perezida Kagame yahaye abayitabiriye yibanze ku Rwanda rubereye Abanyarwanda. Yagize ati “U Rwanda rwa none n’urw’ahazaza ni uruha bose amahirwe angana, atuma abatishoboye badasigara inyuma ahubwo bagira uruhare mu iterambere ryacu.” Rwanda Day igiye kuba ku nshuro ya 10 yitezwemo abantu baturutse mu bice bitandukanye by’Isi by’umwihariko abo ku Mugabane w’u Burayi, bazaba baturutse imihanda yose itandukanye. Abanyarwanda banashyiriweho uburyo bwo kwiyandikisha, aho ushobora kunyura hano. title: U Bubiligi: Abanyarwanda bizihije umunsi w’Umuganura bishimira ibyo bagezeho
content: Ni igikorwa cyabaye ku wa 3 Kanama mu Mujyi wa Blankenberge uherereye ku nkengero z’Inyanja ya Ruguru, mu Bubiligi. Cyitabiriwe n’abantu benshi baturutse hirya no hino muri icyo gihugu no mu nkengero zacyo. Wabaye umwanya ukomeye wa ba rwiyemezamirimo wo kwerekana umusaruro wabo n’imishinga iri imbere. Kumurika ibikorwa by’abikorera byashimwe na benshi byerekana ko mu Bubiligi hari ubukungu n’imbaraga zabyazwa umusaruro, abantu bashyize hamwe kurushaho. Bamwe mu bahawe ijambo bagaragaje ibyo bakora, umusaruro wavuyemo n’imishinga bateganya gukorera mu Bubiligi cyangwa mu Rwanda. Umutangana Yvette ukuriye Diaspora Nyarwanda mu gace ka Flandre y’Iburengerazuba, yavuze ko “Hano mu Bubiligi nta masuka dufite ngo duhinge ariko dufite abasore n’inkumi bafite ibikorwa byivugira ni bo twageneye uyu munsi ngo berekane ibyo bakora n’umusaruro wabo.” Rutagengwa Ingabire Olive yagaragaje ko yafunguye iduka mu Bubiligi ricururizwamo imyambaro n’ibindi bikoresho bitunganyirizwa mu Rwanda, ubu amaze kugera ku ntera yo kubimurika hirya no hino mu Bubiligi. Rwiyemezamirimo Bizumuremyi Christian we yatanze ikiganiro kijyanye n’umusaruro atangiye kuvana mu bikorwa afatanyije n’umugore we Kabagwira Delphine, aho batuye mu Mujyi wa Ostende mu Majyaruguru y’u Bubiligi, aho biyemeje guhesha agaciro ibikorerwa mu Rwanda, bafungura iduka ry’ibiribwa byinshi bituruka mu Rwanda. Iri duka ry’ibiribwa by’umwimerere birimo Ikawa Nyarwanda, icyayi cya Karongi kizwiho uburyohe, ifu y’ubugari ikomoka muri Nyamiyaga, amafu avanze y’igikoma y’abana n’abakuru, yaba ay’amasaka, ibigori, uburo, ifu y’ubunyobwa n’ubuki. Yagize ati “Ibi bicuruzwa bikundwa n’Abanyarwanda n’abanyamahanga, batangiye kumenya ibyiza by’iwacu.” Ikirizaboro Anne Marie yatanze ikiganiro ku mushinga wo kumenyekanisha no gucuruza imiti ikorwa mu bihingwa kimeza byizewe, bijyanye no gufata neza uruhu rw’umuntu, kwita ku buzima, kugabanya umubyibuho, rubagimpande no kongera intungamubiri mu buryo butandukanye, akaba anagira abandi inama z’uko bakwihangira imirimo. Rusaro Yvette we yagarutse kuri Restaurant izwi nka "La Boule Bleue" iherereye ku muhanda Chaussée de Wavre N°115-1050 Bruxelles, yakira abantu baba bashaka kuganira, gukora inama ndetse no kwiyakira. Ati “Tumaze igihe dushimishwa no kwakira Abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo baturutse hirya no hino ku Isi, bakishimira kuza tukabakira bya Kinyarwanda ku buryo usanga aho dukorera bahita “Iwacu”. Ni umushinga urenga amafaranga ukabamo urugwiro utabona ahandi.” Kabalira Nadia we yagarutse ku bikorwa by’umuryango udaharanira inyungu yashinze afatanyije n’umugabo we, bise “Abacu-Solidarité-Rwanda”, ugizwe n’Abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo. Ugamije kugira uruhare mu iterambere ry’u Rwanda mu bijyanye n’ubuvuzi, uburezi, umuco no kurwanya ubukene. Ati “Buri mwaka twiyemeje gukusanya inkunga yo kwishyurira mituweli imiryango 3300 y’abatishoboye iba mu Rwanda. Ubwa mbere bitangira twabashije kohereza amayero 4500, yavuje abantu bagera ku 1500 mu Rwanda.” “Ndashimira cyane itsinda dukorana, Abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo bitabira iki gikorwa kuko ni bo batuma tugira icyo tugeraho.” Zilipa Mutiganda wavuze ku mushinga afite wo gufasha abakeneye mituweli mu Rwanda, we yashimangiye ko Umunyarwanda nyawe ari uzirikana ko hari icyo yafasha mugenzi we, akamutera ingabo mu bitugu. Giramata Schmit yavuze ku byiza byo kugira u Rwanda nk’igihugu cye, ashimangira ko bikwiye kukirikana. Ati "Njye sinagize amahirwe yo kugikuriramo ariko nshimishwa no kugira ibikorwa byerekeza ku bituruka iwacu aho nkomoka; ni yo mpamvu murika icyayi n’ikawa bya Virunga.’’ Umuyobozi wa IGIHE Ltd mu Bubiligi, Karirima Ngarambe Aimable, we yavuze ko bishimishije kuba iki kigo gitanga serivisi zinyuranye kirimo kwihihiza isabukuru y’imyaka 10 ishize gishinzwe, ashimira abafatanyabikorwa bacyo. Ati “Ni umwanya mwiza wo kubashimira mwe mwese dusangira umunsi ku munsi amakuru n’izindi serivisi dutanga zijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga n’ibindi.” Ni igikorwa cyitabiriwe na Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Bubiligi, Rugira Amandin n’itsinda ry’abadipolomate b’u Rwanda muri icyo gihugu. Cyitabiriwe kandi n’Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Equity Bank Rwanda, Hannington Namara n’abo bakorana. Ambasaderi Rugira yavuze ko “Nkurikije ibyo mwakoze mutwereka abikorera hano b’Abanyarwanda, tuzareba uko iki gikorwa cyanozwa ahubwo hakajya habaho umunsi wihariye wa expo bagatumira abashoramari kikaba igikorwa kinini, nzabiganiraho nabo dukorana turebe uko byashyirwa mu bikorwa.” Bazambanza Gilles uyobora Diaspora Nyarwanda mu Bubiligi, yishimiye iki gikorwa, ashishikariza Abanyarwanda gukomeza kugira ibikorwa by’umuco nk’ibi. Umwe mu bayobozi b’Umujyi wa Bruges, Mathijs Goderis, yavuze ko u Rwanda ari urugero, ko ibyo yiboneye n’amaso bifuza kubikopera mu karere kabo. Ibi birori byasusurukijwe Kinyarwanda n’Itorero Ingangare, ryaherekejwe n’Imisozi 1000 yakoze mu nganzo n’amajwi meza ikishimirwa cyane.

title: Abanyarwanda baba mu Bubiligi na Luxembourg bakereye kwitabira Rwanda Day i Bonn mu Budage
content: U Bubiligi ni igihugu gifite Abanyarwanda benshi, mu bibahuza hakaba harimo umunsi wa Rwanda Day. Iri ihuriro rigiye kuba ku nshuro ya 10, aho ku wa 24 Kanama 2019, Abanyarwanda n’inshuti z’u Rwanda bazahurira mu Mujyi wa Bonn, mu burengerazuba bw’u Budage. Mu gihe Perezida Kagame muri gahunda zo guhura n’abanyarwanda baba mu gihugu akunda kubasura mu turere twabo, Abanyarwanda bo mu mahanga nabo ntibibagiranye, ari nayo mpamvu Rwanda Day ibahuza n’umukuru w’igihugu, abayobozi bakuru n’abacuruzi bakomeye, bakaganira mu rwego rwo gukomeza guteza imbere ubukungu n’ubumwe bw’u Rwanda mu bice byose by’ibikorwa. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na IGIHE, Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda mu Bubiligi, Rugira Amandin, yavuze ko iki gikorwa kirimo kwitegurwa no mu Bubiligi, ahitezwe kuzaturuka igice kinini cy’abazitabira Rwanda Day 2019 i Bonn mu Budage. Ati “Ndakangurira abanyarwanda batuye mu Bubiligi na Luxembourg ko iki gikorwa twatangiye kugitegura byimbitse nk’uko babizi, Rwanda Day ni urwego rukomeye ruhuza abanyarwanda bo mu mahanga na Perezida Paul Kagame, ni gahunda yabo idakuka nk’uko bisanzwe mu Bubiligi." "Turizera ko tuzacyitabira turi benshi, hakaba hashyizweho umurongo wo kwiyandikisha kugirango dutegure neza uburyo tuzagenda n’uburyo tuzakira abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo tariki ya 24 Kamena 2019 i Bonn mu Budage. Ariko ndongera mbyibutse ko rwose kwiyandikisha kare ari byiza kugirango tuzabakire bitavunanye, Rwanda Day izamo abantu benshi, birakenewe ko tuyitegurana twese dushyize hamwe.” Amb. Rugira yashimangiye ko Rwanda Day iheruka yabaye ku wa 10 Kamena 2017 muri Flanders Expo, yateguwe mu minsi ibiri kandi iritabirwa cyane, ubu hakaba hari igihe kirenze iyo minsi ku buryo byitezwe ko abanyarwanda bazaba ari benshi. Uretse kungurana ibitekerezo, Rwanda Day ni n’umwanya wo kubaza ibibazo Umukuru w’Igihugu, gutanga ibitekerezo n’ibyifuzo nta guca ku ruhande. Habarurwa ko u Bubiligi turuwe n’abanyarwanda barenga ibihumbi 35. Bashobora kwiyandikisha kuzitabira Rwanda Day banyuze hano.

title: Ilayidi, umunsi w’amafunguro kuri bamwe!
Gukoresha nabi Ikinyarwanda bikomeje gufata indi ntera
Ni iki cyihishe inyuma y’isenyuka ry’ingo rya hato na hato?
content:
Imibare y’inkiko igaragaza ko gatanya zizamuka ubutitsa kuko kugeza mu Ugushyingo 2018, hari hamaze gucibwa imanza za gatanya 1311, ni ubwikubwe bw’inshuro 19 ugereranyije n’umwaka wa 2017. Imibare igaragaza ko mu 2016 ingo zatandukanye zari 21, mu 2017 ziba 69; yerekana ko gatanya zikubye inshuro 62 bingana na 6,200% mu myaka itatu ishize. Bamwe mu rubyiruko ubu batinya kubaka ingo kubera ubwoba bwo kuba nyuma y’iminsi mike bahita batandukana. Iyo uganiriye na bo, bakubwira ko nta cyizere bafite ko ingo za bo zizamara kabiri. Igitangaje ni uko mu bari kunyura muri ibyo bibazo, biragoye kubona ukubwiza ukuri kwabyo usibye kukwereka  ko bikomeye gusa. Iyo ugerageje kuganira na bamwe barakubwira bati “Kirazira mu muco kuvuga ibintu mu mazina ya byo.” Ibi ngo ni uko byaba ari ukwishyira hanze, ariko akenshi bakabishingira ku kuba bigoye kubona uwo kwizerwa wabwira ibibazo byawe. Iyo umukobwa agiye kubaka, ba nyirasenge baramubwira bati “Uramenye uzitonde kandi nibikomera uzamenye burya ni ko zubakwa.” Uwo rero aragenda maze yagerayo agahura n’ibikomeye ariko umutima muhanano ntumwemerere kuvuga ibyo anyuramo. Umuhungu na we bamubwira ko umugabo ari uwifata mu bibazo ntagaragaze intege nke, noneho byakomera akabura amahitamo bikazagera ubwo ananirwa kubyihanganira nyamara iyo biganirwaho byari gukemuka. Iyo tuvuze ikibyihishe inyuma ni ikintu kitagaragara ariko kikaba nyirabayazana igeza umuryango aho usenyuka. Muri iyi nkuru yacu, turavuga ku bibazo bamwe badatinyuka kuvugira mu ruhame ariko bishobora kuba intandaro ya gatanya.  	Imibonano mpuzabitsina ikozwe nabi Kimwe mu bituma umuntu ashaka kubaka urugo harimo gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina ihoraho. Akenshi rero hari ubwo umwe mu bubatse aba yarasambanye mbere y’uko akora ubukwe, maze agahora agereranya uwo babana n’abo baryamanye mbere. Hari abandi basanga abo babana bafite intege nke mu mubiri (uburemba), cyangwa bakagira uburwayi butuma badakora imibonano. Iyi ngingo irakomeye kuko izana ibibazo byinshi birimo amakimbirane ahoraho, agasuzuguro, gucana inyuma, kwikunda n’ibindi. Ibi iyo bigitangira birihanganirwa ariko akenshi birangira bamwe bagiye mu busambanyi cyangwa bagatandukana. Igitangaje rero biragoye kubona ukubwiza ukuri ko yasanze ari uku bimeze ahubwo iyo basaba gatanya bahimba ibindi byakumvikana mu bantu kuko batinya kwikoza isoni, nyamara iyo bagirwa inama mbere ahari byari kugira igaruriro.  	Gucana inyuma Iyo umuhungu n’umukobwa barambagizanya, buri wese agerageza guhisha ingeso ze kugira ngo mugenzi we atazishingiraho akaba yamwanga. Agerageza kugaragaza ibyakurura mugenzi we kugira ngo yemere ko bazabana. Rimwe na rimwe iyo ubwiye umwe muri abo ko mugenzi we yitwara nabi, anywa inzoga nyinshi, agira inshuti mbi cyangwa asambana byitwa ko ari ugushaka kumwicira ubukwe. Burya ingeso ntitinda kwigaragaza, wayihisha umwaka umwe ariko bigera aho bikanga. Yaba umugabo cyangwa umugore, nta n’umwe ukunda ko uwo babana amusangira n’abandi kuko iyo mubana uba waramuhaye umutima wose, waramushyizemo icyizere gihagije. Iyo rero ibi byanze, ugasanga abantu bahisemo gutandukana, umwe muri bo cyangwa bose ntatinyuka kuvuga impamvu ahubwo abenshi babirenzaho bagahimba izindi ngo badahabwa amenyo y’abasetsi.  	Kubura urukundo Iyo umuhungu cyangwa umukobwa afata icyemezo cyo gusiga iwabo, ahagurutswa n’ijambo ryitwa “urukundo”. Akenshi mu kurambagizanya, baba bararumweretse ku kigero gihagije. Igitangaje ni uko atekereza ko ari ko bizahora ariko intege nke abagabo benshi bahuriyeho ni uko iyo agejeje umugore mu nzu atongera kumuhamagara buri kanya, kumwandikira ubutumwa bugufi kuri telefoni ku buryo buhoraho, kumubwira utugambo twiza twuzuye urukundo n’ibindi. Abagore ibi bibananira kwihanganira kuko na bo mu ntege nke zabo bakunda kwitabwaho ku kigero cyo hejuru. Iyo icyo yaje ashaka akibuze bamwe bafata imyanzuro yo gutandukana. Kimwe n’abagabo bose, nta wudakunda gukundwa ariko hari ubwo abakobwa bamwe bajya kubaka mu by’ukuri yishakira aho kuba, ariko atazi gutanga urukundo atabasha no kurwakira ahubwo urugo rukaba aderese gusa. Burya usibye abantu n’inyamaswa n’ibimera bimwe na bimwe iyo byeretswe urukundo bitanga umusaruro. Akenshi iyo urukundo rubuze mu muryango, urasenyuka. Rero biratangaje kubana n’umuntu ugasanga arikunda bikabije wibaza icyo wagiye kumara. Iyo bamwe babonye ubitaho, birangira atwaye imitima yabo.  	Kudaha agaciro uwo mwashakanye Guhabwa agaciro ni ikintu buri wese akeneye kandi ibyo ntibikorwa mu magambo gusa ahubwo iyo bivanze n’imirimo ukorera mugenzi wawe birushaho kumwereka agaciro. Uzi ko hari abirirwa batavuganye, maze bataha ntibanasuhuzanye? Ibintu byereka mugenzi wawe ko umutekerezaho kandi ukamuha agaciro ntibiba binini. Igihe utashye ukamuzanira akantu n’ubwo kaba gato, hari icyo bigaragaza. Iyo umugabo yiriwe mu rugo ukamwitaho, na we akakwitaho, ntibigira uko bisa. Gushimira mugenzi wawe ibyiza yagukoreye, kumusuhuzanya ubugwaneza, kumenya itariki y’amavuko ye ukagira impano umuha, mu gihe ahugiye mu mirimo ukamwibuka ukamubwira ijambo rimuruhura n’ibindi. Ibi iyo bibuze bishobora kuzana ibibazo bikomeye mu rushako rwanyu.  	Gukubitwa/ Ihohoterwa ryo mu ngo Uwavuga ko nta hohotera riri mu miryango yaba yigiza nkana kuko amakuru avuga abagabo bishe abagore babo, abakubiswe n’ibindi ntasiba kumvikana. Kera abagore barakubitwaga bakagenda babeshya abantu ko inka yamwishe ku jisho, cyangwa yaguye ku kintu kikamukomeretsa kandi mu by’ukuri ari ukugira ngo ahishire ibyamubayeho. Biratangaje ko muri iki gihe hakiri abagore bakubitwa, hirengagijwe amategeko n’ingaruka bishobora kugira ku wakoze iryo hohotera. Kubera umuco, hari ababikorerwa bagaceceka, bumva ejo bizarangira kugera ubwo biganishije urugo ku byago bitandukanye, harimo no gusenyuka kwarwo. Aha ntitwavuga ko abagore ari bo babohoterwa bonyine, ahubwo hari n’abagabo bahohoterwa n’ubwo umubare wabo atari munini. Ibi iyo bikomeje kugirwa ibanga biba biganisha ku gutandukana.  	Gusuzugurwa Muri kamere y’abagabo harimo gukunda icyubahiro, ku buryo iyo asuzuguwe bituma yiheba, amarangamutima ye ntabyakire, akaba yahitamo no gutandukana n’uwo bashakanye kuko yumva ko yatakaje agaciro. Uyu rero iyo muganiriye, yihagararaho, ntakubwira ko icyatumye asenya ari uko yasuzuguwe ahubwo akenshi ashaka impamvu yindi yumva yarushaho kumvikana. Burya abagabo benshi batinda mu kabari cyangwa mu kazi, si uko bakunda akazi cyane ahubwo aba atekereza aho agiye gutaha akumva nta mpamvu yabyo maze agataha agiye kubyuka cyangwa guhindura imyenda. N’abagore ni uko, hari abasuzugurwa kandi ibi bikaba byaratangiye cyera. Ntawe utazi ko kera iyo umuryango wabyaraga abakobwa benshi, wabonaga bafite ikibazo, bakamera nk’abagushije ishyano. Ibi byatumaga abakobwa badahabwa uburezi ku kigero kimwe na basaza babo. No mu bizera muzi ko bavuga ngo Yesu yahagije abagabo ibihumbi bitanu, ukuyemo abagore n’abana. Ibyo biguha ishusho y’uko umugore yafatwaga. Kugera ubu hari amadini n’amatorero atarabasha guha inshingano zo hejuru igitsinagore kuko bumva ko badashoboye. Ibi rero iyo umugore abikorewe mu muryango bimusiga habi akihangana bigitangira ariko bikazasoza atandukanye.  	Kutaganira ku bibareba Umuco wo kutaganira usenya ingo nyinshi bitewe n’uko uwo mwashakanye adashobora kumenya ibikunezeza cyangwa ibikubangamira keretse ubimubwiye. Uko ugenda ubangamirwa kenshi ntuvuge, umutima uragenda ukazinukwa pe, ukajya wumva nta cyiza kindi utegereje kandi wenda iyo ubivuga mwari gushakira umuti hamwe. Iyo mutaganira ibibazo byatangiye ari bito bihinduka imisozi maze ingo zigasenyuka. N’ubwo kuganira ari byiza ariko hari ibintu bijyana nabyo nko kumenya uko ubitwara, ingingo wibandaho, igihe cyo kuganira, uburyo bwo kuganira, ahantu ho kuganirira. Hari igihe ushobora gukeka ko wavuze wenda ibikubangamiye, ariko bitewe n’uko wabivuze n’ahantu n’igihe wabivugiye ugasanga wangije byinshi. ‘‘Umugore w’umutima wese yubaka urugo, ariko umupfu we ubwe ararusenya.’’ (Imigani 14:1). Mu byo ukuri urugo rwubakwa n’ubwenge ni byiza gusaba Imana ubwenge bwatuma twubaka urugo ntirusenyuke.  	Kutababarirana hagati y’abashakanye  Abantu benshi birabagora kubabarira uwabakoreye ikosa ariko bikarushaho iyo ahemukiwe n’uwo babana. Gusa buriya nta muntu utagira amakosa, ni yo  mpamvu na Bibiliya ivuga ngo tujye tubabarirana uko umuntu agize icyo apfa n’undi kandi ngo mugenzi wawe nagucumuraho uzamubabarire inshuro 77. Ikizakwemeza ko utamubabariye ni uko uhora umucyurira ibyo yakosheje, noneho yagira irindi kosa akora ukabanza kumucyurira ibyo yagukoreye bibi.Ntekereza ko iyo ukunda uwo mwashakanye, kumubabarira biroroha ndetse bikabanguka. Ibi iyo bitinze, urukundo rurayoyoka bikavamo impamvu yo gutandukana kandi utabasha gusobanura neza icyatumye ufata umwanzuro umeze utyo.  	Kwanga kwikosora Ikintu cyo kutikosora cyangwa guhora mu makosa amwe kiraremereye. Hari igihe umwe yumva asa n’uwasonewe gukora amakosa, akumva ntawukwiriye gutinda ku myitwarire ye n’ubwo yaba ibangamiye abandi ahubwo we agahora atunga intoki abo babana, avuga ibibi byabo. Niba ushaka kumenya icyo kwikosora, uzahere kuri cya kindi uwo mwashakanye ahora atonganira, cyangwa avugira nabi cyangwa se kimwe ahora akubwira ko kimubangamira. Ujye wibuka ko Bibiliya itubwira ngo ntitukagire igisitaza dushyira imbere y’umuntu uwo ari we wese.  	Umutungo ukoreshejwe nabi Nta wabura kuvuga ko umutungo ukoreshejwe nabi n’umwe mu bashakanye bishobora kuba imbarutso yo gusenyuka k’umuryango. Hari ubwo umwe amenya amakuru ko hari imitungo icishwa ku ruhande cyangwa hari konti atariho, cyangwa akabona ibiza mu rugo atazi neza amakuru yabyo. Dufashe urugero ushobora gusanga umugabo atahanye imodoka umugore ataragishijwe inama mu kuyigura n’ibindi. Ibi bigera igihe uwabikorewe akibaza ngo “Ese njye ubu ndi iki muri uru rugo?” Hakorwa iki ngo ibibazo byo mu ngo bishakirwe umuti? Muri iyi nkuru twibanze ku bibazo bisenya ingo kandi ba nyirabyo batabasha kubivuga nyamara iyo biganirwaho mbere byari kubonerwa umuti bitaradogera. Reka umuco wo kuganira ku bibazo ube uwacu, bizatuma dukemura ibibazo amazi atararenga inkombe. Abenshi basezerana bafite imiryango. Mushobora kubegera bakabafasha cyangwa ababaherekeje mu bukwe bwanyu (parrain na marraine). 
Abandi bafite insengero basengeramo, mushobora kwitabaza abayobozi banyu mu by’umwuka, yewe n’abayobozi ba leta aho dutuye tubagishije inama badufasha. Burya amategeko ntaberaho gutandukanya abagiranye ibibazo ahubwo icya mbere ni ukubunga. Bikwiye kumvikana ko gutandukana ari ugutsindwa. Mu by’ukuri iyo wananiwe kubaka urugo, bizagora abandi bantu kukugirira icyizere ahubwo bazajya bavuga ngo afite akazi keza, ayoboye abantu benshi ariko yananiwe n’urugo. Reka uruhare rwawe mu biri kukubaho ugerageze kutaba nyirabayazana mu bibazo byageza umuryango wawe ku gusenyuka ahubwo ugerageze gukora ibishoboka byose ngo urugo rwawe rukomeze rubeho.
