Urugero aba bahanga bavuga ko atari byiza guhora ubwira umwana ko ari ‘umuswa’ , ‘igicucu’ , ‘umunebwe’ n’andi magambo menshi y’urucantege. Impamvu ibi babitubuza ni uko uko ubwira umwana kenshi ko ari igicucu ayo makuru ageraho akaba menshi mu bwonko/ubwenge (subconscious mind) noneho ubwonko bukageraho bukayakira bukayabyaza ibikorwa by’ubucucu koko kugira ngo bubisanishe na ya makuru buhora bwakira ko umuntu ari igicucu. Ibi ni ibintu biba nyirabyo atabigizemo uruhare kuko ubwenge bukora iki gikorwa ni nabwo bwenge butuma umutima wacu utera kandi atari twe tubisabye, ni nabwo butuma duhumeka, twayura, igifu kigasya ibiryo n’ibindi bikorwa tudafiteho ubushobozi nyamara tukisanga twabikoze: ‘subconscious mind’. Ubu ni nabwo bwenge butuma dutwara imodoka tugahinduranya amavitese tutabanje kubitekerezaho cyane nyamara igihe twigaga imodoka twarabanzaga gukora imibare myinshi irimo ukuntu uri bubanze gukandagira embrayage hanyuma ukayirekura gake. Uko tubikora kenshi bwa bwenge burabifata bukajya bubyikorera butabanje kubinyuza mu bwenge busanzwe ngo tubitekerezeho. Uku ni nako kwaturiraho umuntu amagambo atari meza bimusubiza inyuma aho kumukangura. Ibi bihuriye he n’izina ‘abasigajwe inyuma n’amateka’ nahereyeho? Amagambo tubwira umuntu kenshi niyo ubwonko bubyazamo ibikorwa bihuye na ya magambo tumubwira nkuko nabivuze hejuru. Gusubiramo buri gihe ko umuntu yasigajwe inyuma n’amateka – igihe cyose ubwonko bwe bumufasha gukora ibikorwa nk’iby’umuntu amateka yasubije inyuma nyine. Iyi ni siyanse izwi hose! Iyo uhora ubwirwa ko uri umuswa, igicucu n’ibindi nta kabuza ubwonko bukomeza kugufasha gukora ibikorwa bigaragaza ko uri igicucu koko! Iyo uhora ubwirwa ko amateka yagusubije inyuma ndetse hakavamo n’inyito bakwitirira nta kabuza ubwonko bugufasha gukomeza gusigara inyuma ku buryo buri gihe cyose umuntu akureba akabona koko  wasigajwe inyuma n’amateka kugira ngo bize gusa n’ibyo ubwonko buhora bwumva. Ku bizera iyobokamana Umwami Salomo niwe wavuze ko uko umuntu atekereza ku mutima we ni nako aba abayeho mu buzima bwe (Imigani 23:7) hanyuma namwe mwizera siyanse umugabo witwa William James akaba ari nawe wa mbere wigishije isomo ry’imitekerereze ya muntu (psychology) niwe wavuze bwa mbere ko guhindura imitekerereze bihindura imibereho y’umuntu. Nkurikije izo mpamvu zose umuntu kuba abantu bose bamwita ko yasubijwe inyuma n’amateka biragoranye ko ayo mateka amurekura ku rwego rwifuzwa mu gihe cyose tukimubona mu isura y’uwasigajwe inyuma n’amateka ndetse tukagera naho tubimushakiramo izina. Izina ‘umunyarwanda’ rirahagije kimwe n’abandi bose. Hanyuma haba hari ibikorwa byihariye ashaka guhabwa bigakorwa bitabaye ngombwa kumushakira izina rihora rimwemeza ko yasigaye inyuma y’abandi.  Binabaye ngombwa cyane ko ahabwa izina ryihariye reka ahabwe izina ritanga icyizere rikamwemeza ko ari gutera imbere. Ibi bibe uko no ku babyeyi bita amazina abana babo. Umwanditsi ni inzobere mu itangazamakuru n’itumanaho. Ibikubiye muri iyi nyandiko ni ibitekerezo bye bwite.

title: Ibiganiro bya Uganda n’u Rwanda: Ikimwaro mu ruhame
content: Abaminisitiri batatu bakuru muri Politiki, Busingye Johnston, Prof Shyaka Anastase na Gen Patrick Nyamvumba, bari mu ntumwa z’u Rwanda zitabiriye ibiganiro bya Uganda-Rwanda; bakinnye agakoryo Abagande, umuto muri bo aba ariwe bagira uyobowe itsinda ryabo. Minisitiri Olivier Nduhungirehe ni muto mu myaka, umunyabwenge, uzi gutebya no kuganira bya kinyarwanda bimwe byo gukirana bacyocyorana, bagakoresha imitego ya ‘Rugondihene’, yamamaye mu mateka nyarwanda cyane iyo abantu babaga basoma ku inzoga y’ubuki y’inkangaza. Intumwa za Uganda hafi ya bose barisaziye, rero bakoze ikosa rikomeye ryo kumwibeshyaho. Iyo hagira ubagira inama ngo barebe ibiganiro byo kuri YouTube bya Nduhungirehe ari i New York, ubwo u Rwanda rwayoboraga Akanama ka Loni gashinzwe umutekano. Ntabwo bamenye ikibakubise. Nk’uko Muhammad Ali yigeze kubivuga, umuvandimwe Nduhungirehe ‘Yanyeganyegaga nk’ikinyugunyugu akadwinga nk’uruyuki’. Tugumye mu mukino w’iteramakofi, nta muntu n’umwe mu ntumwa za Uganda zari mu cyumba, washoboraga guhangana na Nduhungirehe. Uyu munyamabanga wa leta ukiri muto, yashoboraga kwifasha icyumba cyose ubwe, abo bazanye bigaramiye. Mu cyumba harimo kandi Gen Patrick Nyamvumba: Umuntu Abagande bose batinya! Yari yicaye arebana n’abasirikare ba Uganda barimo abakutse umutima kugeza magingo aya bashobora kuba bakinywa imiti y’ihungabana batewe no gutsindwa mu ntambara ya Kisangani. Abayobozi babo Kahinda Otafire na nyakwigendera Kazini icyo gihe bafashwe mpiri n’Ingabo zari ziyobowe na Gen Nyamvumba. Nyuma baza kurekurwa basubizwa Uganda. Afande Nyamvumba rero, yari mu cyumba cy’inama kugira ngo yibutse Abanya-Uganda ko gushaka amahoro ku Rwanda biri mu nyungu zabo. Umwanditsi Hawthorn yigeze kuvuga ko nta muntu ushobora kwiyoberanya akereka isura itari iye rubanda igihe kirekire, amaherezo ntibimuviremo no kuyoberwa uko asa nyabyo. Nkuko nkunda kubibwira abo mburanira iyo bambajije niba turi butsinde urubanza mu rukiko: “ese turavugisha ukuri? Niba igisubizo ari Yego, ntacyo twikeka.” Mu gihe Umunyamabanga wa Leta ukiri muto yari ashikamye abifashijwemo n’ubuhanga bwe, yabwiraga ukuri urundi ruhande, kwigaragaza mu bimenyetso n’abatangabuhamya. Mu gihe ubusanzwe politiki na dipolomasi bifatwa nk’imyuga yiyubashye yo gutsura ubushuti n’iterambere, abayobozi ba Uganda bo babifashe nk’umwuga wo kubeshya. Ibinyoma umunsi ku wundi, nta kindi kigamijwe usibye kuyobya no kujijisha abaturage ba Uganda bayobora. Abaturage ntibabizera, nabo ubwabo ntibizera abaturage ahubwo bose babaswe n’ikinyoma, bateze iminsi iriya leta ngo igende babone kugira amahoro. Kuba turi abaturanyi babo, natwe niko bashaka kudufata.  Ntushobora kwemeranya ikintu n’umunyapolitiki wa Uganda ngo wizere ko ari bugikore ku munsi ukurikiyeho. Nk’uko umugani wa Kinyarwanda ubivuga, ‘Uwububa abonwa n’uhagaze’ ndetse ‘iminsi y’igisambo irabaze’. Kuri iyi nshuro twari twazanye Abanye-Congo n’Abanya-Angola; ngo nabo babyibonere. Ubwo ikibazo cyari kimaze gukomera, u Rwanda rwahisemo gukomanyiriza bicuruzwa bituruka muri Uganda. Abanya-Uganda batangiye kuvuga bati “Abanyarwanda bazasonza bende gupfa. Ibiribwa byose barya bituruka muri Uganda.” Iyo mvugo y’ikinyoma ishoboka muri Uganda honyine. Iyo umuntu afite amafaranga arira muri restaurant ahisemo kandi hari ibihugu 194 umuntu ashobora gutumizamo ibyo akeneye. Ariko Abanyapolitiki bo muri Uganda babeshye abaturage babo ko abanyarwanda barya indyo imwe gusa. Nyuma y’amezi atandatu y’icyo cyemezo, Uganda yari itangiye gusaba inguzanyo yihutirwa muri IMF kugira ngo izibe icyuho cyatewe n’ikumirwa ry’ubucuruzi n’u Rwanda. Muri icyo gihe u Rwanda rwari ruhugiye mu kwishyura miliyoni nyinshi z’amayero ikipe ya Paris Saint Germain yo mu Bufaransa, ngo irimbishe ikipe yayo na Stade ya Parc des Princes ikirango cyamamaye ku isi hose aricyo: ‘Visit Rwanda’ – Umunyarwanda yaravuze ngo: Uwapfuye yarihuse…’ Nyuma y’inama itaratanze umusaruro, abanya-Uganda bashatse gukwiza ikindi kinyoma, basaba u Rwanda ko bakora itangazo rihuriweho rigamije kugaragaza ko ibintu byose byagenze neza. Minisitiri Nduhungirehe yaratangaye: Ababwira ati: Sinabeshya abanyarwanda. Mukore itangazo ryanyu mu Luganda niba mubishaka. Ndakora iryanjye mbabwire ukuri ko tutageze ku masezerano:  	Mwananiwe kutwizeza ko muzirukana imitwe irwanya u Rwanda irimo kwisuganyiriza mu gihugu cyanyu ;  	Mwananiwe kutwizeza ko muzarekura ibihumbi by’abanyarwanda b’inzirakarengane mumaze igihe mufunze batazi ibyo baregwa ;  	Mwananiwe kutwizeza ko muzahagarika gutoteza abanyarwanda bakorera ingendo cyangwa baba muri Uganda. Abanye-Congo bamaze kumenyera guta muri yombi abagize umutwe w’iterabwoba wa FDLR bavuye kubonana n’abayobozi ba Uganda mu nama zigamije gucura imigambi yo gutera u Rwanda. Igisirikare cyabo (FARDC) gikomeje kwica cyangwa gufata abarwanyi batojwe ndetse bagahabwa intwaro na Uganda. Abanya- Angola nyuma yo kuyobora inama ya mbere yiga ku kibazo cy’u Rwanda na Uganda, batangiye kumenya abo Abanya-Uganda aribo. Mu yandi magambo, Uganda yari yonyine mu nama, yumiwe kandi iri ku butaka bwayo. Abenshi mu itsinda rya Uganda babaga bahunyiza, bajya kuvuga bakavuga ibintu bidashinga imbere y’itsinda ry’abahanga bakiri bato, bari maso kandi badaca hirya, bashyigikiza ibimenyetso byabo amategeko mpuzamahanga, ibyemeranyijwemo mu kwihuza kw’akarere na dipolomasi. Umuhanuzi Bob Marley wo muri Jamaica yagize ati: ‘Ushobora kujijisha abantu igihe kimwe, ariko ntabwo wajijisha abantu bose igihe cyose’. Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga wa Angola wari umaze kurambirwa, yaciriye Abanya-Uganda umugani w’inyeshyamba Jonas Savimbi n’uwari umutwe we witwaje intwaro wa UNITA, abihuza na Kayumba Nyamwasa na RNC ye. Yavuze uburyo Savimbi yari afite ibirindiro muri Zaire, agafashwa cyane na Perezida Mobutu wa Zaire. Gusa ubwo Mobutu yari amaze kuvanwaho n’abanyarwanda, Savimbi na UNITA ye ntabwo bamaze kabiri. Yagize ati “kuva ubwo tumaze imyaka cumi n’irindwi y’amahoro,”mu gusoza asa n’uburira abanya-Uganda, ati “Niba mudashaka gukemura ikibazo gito cya Kayumba Nyamwasa, mushobora kwisanga muhanganye n’ikibazo kinini kurushaho”. Ubutaha abanya-Uganda bashobora kutemera ko abahuza baba mu cyumba cy’ibiganiro kubera ko barimo gukozwa isoni mu ruhame.

title: Imicungire n’imiterere y’amashuri makuru yigenga mu Rwanda bikwiye kunozwa
content:
N’ubwo bwose uburezi bushingiye ku mashuri buhera ku rwego rw’ibanze rukagenda ruhererekanya inshingano n’izikurikiyeho ku buryo bwisumbuye, muri aka kanya twifuje kuvuga gusa ku burezi mu mashuri makuru yigenga mu gihugu cyacu. Ibyo tuvuga  bikaba  bigamije gutanga umusanzu wacu muto ku cyatuma icyo cyiciro cy’amashuri kirushaho gukora neza no kuba cyatanga umusaruro mwiza wateza imbere sosiyete y’Abanyarwanda. Muri iyi minsi hakunze kuvugwa ibibazo binyuranye mu mashuri makuru yigenga ( private Higher Learning Institutions) mu Rwanda, bishingiye, cyane cyane  ku mikorere mibi ndetse bikagira n’ingaruka mbi ku ireme ry’uburezi buhatangirwa. Iyo umuntu yitegereje neza uko ayo mashuri akora, asanga ibibazo bihari biterwa ahanini n’imicungire mibi yayo ikunze kuhagaragara muri rusange. Kudacunga neza umutungo w’ayo mashuri, cyangwa kuwukoresha ibyo utagenewe, bituma abakozi bamara amezi menshi badahembwa kandi ntibanabone n’ibindi umukozi agenerwa, nko gutangirwa umusanzu w’ubwitegenyirize bw’izabukuru, kutagira ubwishingizi bwo kwivuza, n’ibindi. Haza kandi n’ikibazo cyo kutagira ibikoresho bihagije, kandi nyamara bikenewe mu kazi ka buri munsi, ndetse tutibagiwe hamwe na hamwe, no kutagira aho gukorera hahagije cyangwa hatunganye. Umwe mu miti yafasha gukemura icyo kibazo ni uko minisiteri y’Uburezi yifashishije Urwego rushinzwe Amashuri Makuru (Higher Education Council–HEC) yarushaho gukurikirana imikorere y’ayo mashuri kandi igafata ibyemezo ku buryo bwihuse ku bibazo binyuranye  bigenda biyabonekamo, ibyo bigakorwa hakiri kare, amazi atararenga inkombe. Ikindi umuntu yavuga muri uru rwego ni ukureba uko itegeko rigenga amashuri makuru mu Rwanda ryasuzumwa kugira ngo harebwe niba koko rijyanye neza n’imiterere y’amashuri rireba. Ibyo ndabivuga  mpereye ko hari amashuri makuru amwe n’amwe usanga yarabaye kandi akagendera ku mategeko asanzwe agenga sosiyete z’ubucuruzi (companies) zisanzwe. Aha rero turatekereza ko uburezi ari ikintu gikomeye cyane ku buzima bw’igihugu no ku hazaza hacyo, ku buryo amategeko areba uburezi yakagombye kugira umwihariko wayo, aho  kugira ngo uburezi bufatwe nk’ubundi bucuruzi cyangwa ubushabitsi busanzwe. Hari ababona ko ibibazo binyuranye birangwa mu mashuri makuru yigenga muri iki gihe, bishobora kuba biterwa  n’igabanuka, kubera impamvu zinyuranye  ry’umubare w’abanyeshuri bayagana; maze nabyo bigatera igabanuka ry’amafaranga y’ishuri batangaga; ahanini ari nayo akoreshwa mu bikorwa bindi by’ishuri. Ibivugwa bishobora kuba byagira ishingiro, ariko rero umuntu wakurikiye neza uko ibintu byagiye bihinduka mu rwego rw’Uburezi mu gihugu cyacu  muri iyi myaka 25 ishize, yahamya ko abo bireba by’umwihariko bakagombye kuba  barafashe ingamba zihamye mbere, kugira ngo ibintu ntibibe bimeze uko biri muri ibi bihe. Mu rwego rwo gushaka ibisubizo byatuma umubare w’abanyeshuri wiyongera, ni ngombwa gutekereza byimbitse ku miterere y’amashuri makuru yigenga dufite mu Rwanda. Muri gahunda igihugu cyacu gifite yo kugira iterambere rishingiye ahanini ku burezi, ntabwo twavuga ko turagera ku mubare uhagije w’abize amashuri makuru kandi baba umusemburo ukomeye w’iterambere. N’iyo urebye amashuri dufite, cyane cyane ayashizwe n’Abanyarwanda, usanga muri rusange, asa nk’ayibanda ku nyigisho zimwe, kandi nyamara hari ibice binyuranye by’ubumenyi bukenerwa mu buzima bw’igihugu tutabona ubu  mubyo amashuri yigenga atanga mu gihugu cyacu. Ibi rero birerekana ko amashuri yacu akeneye impinduka mu miterere yayo. Bikaba byaba byiza buri shuri rigize ibyo ryigisha byihariye kandi rikabinoza neza ku buryo buzobereye (différenciation et spécialisation), ibyo bikaba byanatuma umubare w’abarigana wiyongera kuko buri shuri ryaba rifite ibyo ryihariye ayandi ataba afite. Ariko nabwo rero, iyo urebye uko amashuri yacu yigenga akora n’uko akorana, dushobora kuvuga ko kugira ngo iyo ntambwe izagerweho na none  inkunga ya minisiteri y’Uburezi mu Rwanda ikenewe cyane, kugira ayo mavugururwa azashobore  gukorwa kandi agerweho neza. Mu magambo ahinnye, dusoza iyi nyandiko, twavuga ko twifuje kugaruka kuri bimwe mu bibazo ubu biboneka, muri rusange, mu mashuri  makuru yigenga mu Rwanda n’uburyo byashobora gushakirwa ibisubizo. Twanerekanye uruhare rw’ingenzi minisiteri ishinzwe Uburezi  mu Rwanda yagira mu gushaka umuti watanga ibisubizo byaba bikwiye, ku buryo burambye. Dr Gasana Sébastien
Umwarimu wa Kaminuza n’Umushakashatsi.

title: Inkubi y’impinduka muri RDC n’icyo ihatse
content: Museveni yakomeje kwibona nka Napoleon, ubundi “Bismarck wa Afurika”. Abenshi bagiye bitegereza imvugo ze n’ibikorwa bakabonamo ukwikuza. Ibihamya biri buri hamwe, ibikorwa igisirikare cye kigiramo uruhare n’aho kidakenewe; mu nyandiko ze n’imvugo; cyangwa se icyifuzo cye cyo kuba Perezida wa mbere wa Leta ya Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Ariko nanone niba uyu mutegetsi wa Uganda yibona nk’umuntu ukomeye mu mateka, uburyo yahisemo gukurikirana indoto ze binyuranye cyane n’ibyo abantu bakomeye bakora. Ahubwo bisanga mu rwego rumwe n’abo yahoze anenga, nka Idi Amin. Mu gitabo cye Sowing the Mustard Seed, Museveni yanditse ati “Nahoraga mbona (Milton) Obote nk’umuntu w’amayeri atarangira; umuntu udafite amahame agenderaho wahoraga avuga ko ibyo wagezeho bigaragaza inzira waciyemo. Uretse kuri Obote, iherezo ryakunze kuba ribi kurusha uburyo bwaribanjirije. Iyo mvugo ahubwo ishobora guhindukizwa igakoreshwa mu kugaragaza Museveni uwo ari we n’ibyo yakomeje kugerageza imyaka mirongo mu ntego ze zo kwishyira hejuru. Gusa nyuma yo gusenywa mu bya gisirikare kw’abambari be muri RDC, abo yari yiringiyeho kuzahungabanya umutekano w’u Rwanda nk’imwe mu ntego ze zagutse, imigambi ye ubu iri mu rungabangabo. Ubu umutwe wa RNC w’igikoresho cye Kayumba Nyamwasa, wugarijwe n’amatiku aturukamo imbere. Nyamwasa ashinjwa ko yategetse ifatwa rya Ben Rutabana, umwe mu bayobozi bakuru b’uwo mutwe, kubera amakimbirane arimo imbere kandi umugore wa Rutabana yamaze gushyira hanze, hamwe yifashisha amabaruwa yagiye yandika ahandi agakoresha murandasi n’ibiganiro na radio mpuzamahanga. Umuryango wa Rutabana by’umwihariko washinje Nyamwasa kumushimuta. Ubu umuryango wa Rutabana bivugwa ko “wamaze kwirukanwa muri RNC”. Abasesenguzi bavuga ko umwuka mubi muri uwo mutwe ufitanye isano n’ugutsindwa muri RDC, guhera mu ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka ubwo abantu bayo basaga 200 bicirwaga mu bice bya Minembwe n’abayobozi b’igisirikare cyayo nka Habib Mudathiru bagafatwa, bakoherezwa mu Rwanda bakagezwa imbere y’inkiko. Uku gutakaza imbaraga mu mitwe ifashwa na Museveni byakomeje kugira ingaruka, ndetse mu bantu bo hejuru muri RNC batangira gushinja Kayumba Nyamwasa gucunga nabi ibikorwa bya RNC nko kunyereza umutungo; kwironda no gutonesha abantu bamwe na bamwe no kuba nyamwigendaho mu miyoborere. Uko byaba bimeze kose, impuguke zivuga ko nubwo RNC itera u Rwanda ibibazo iri kure, ubu isa n’iyarangiye. Gishegesha ya mbere yabaye ubwo muri RDC hajyagaho ubuyobozi bukuriwe n’umuntu ushyize imbere imibereho myiza y’abaturage be. Ibyemezo byafashwe birimo guhindura politiki y’akarere ndetse bishobora kudasubira inyuma. Imigambi ya Perezida Museveni ya mpatse ibihugu buri gihe yagiye yubakira ku guhungabanya ubutegetsi bwose bw’ibihugu bimukikije. Mu buryo bwamaze igihe, aka karere kakomeje kurangwa n’umutekano muke kahaye uyu muyobozi wa Uganda, abantu be ba hafi n’abantu bamwe muri UPDF urubuga rwo kuzuza imifuka yabo, akababaro k’abaturage gakomeza kwirengagizwa. Igitangaje nta rundi rwego uretse Urukiko Mpuzamahanga rw’Ubutabera rwabihamije, ubwo mu 2005 rwemezaga ko Uganda igihe yari muri Congo mu 1998 kugeza 2003, yayoboye ubwicanyi n’iyicarubozo byakorewe abasivili ndetse hasenywa insisiro mu gihe ubusahuzi bwari bukataje. Urukiko rwahaye RDC miliyari 10 z’amadorali nk’indishyi ku byangijwe n’ubwo Uganda itarishyura. Iki gikorwa cy’urukiko nticyigeze gica Museveni intege mu gukomeza kwivanga muri gahunda z’iki gihugu cy’igituranyi. Impamvu ni uko uretse amahirwe yo gusahura, uwo muturanyi munini yari urufunguzo  ku migambi ye yo kwigarurira ibihugu. Ibice byose by’icyo gihugu byagizweho ingaruka n’imitwe y’inyeshyamba ifashwa na Leta ya Kampala irimo RNC ya Kayumba Nyamwasa yubakiye ku byifuzo bya Museveni byo guhirika ubutegetsi bwa Kigali. RNC n’indi mitwe itandukanye nk’ishamikiye kuri FDLR yahinduye Uburasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo ibirindiro byayo aho abayigize bahohotera abaturage b’Abanye-Congo mu gihe bagishakisha uko batera u Rwanda. Gusa imigambi ya Museveni n’imitwe ashyigikiye yajemo kirogoya. Ubuyobozi bushya muri Kinshasa butihanganira na gake amabandi y’uburyo bwose ahutaza abaturage b’abasivili, agasahura ndetse agafata ku ngufu, ubu nibwo buyoboye. Ni ubuyobozi bwatanze gasopo ku mitwe yitwaje intwaro ko igihe cy’ibikorwa byayo by’amarorerwa cyarangiye! Niba imitwe yitwaje intwaro yaracyekaga ko ari imikino, basogongejweho ubwo itsinda rya Mudathiru ryagamburuzwaga (hamwe na Sibo Charles we hamwe n’abandi batagize amahirwe nk’aya Mudathiru ngo babashe gukomeza kubaho). Magingo aya, Museveni wakomeje gushaka kuvangira ubuyobozi bw’u Rwanda kubera ko yumvaga ko mu buryo bwa gitware ashobora gutegeka uko ibintu bigenda muri Kigali (ibintu yabwiwe ko nta gihugu gifite ubusugire gihabwa amategeko n’ikindi) icya kabiri kuko yabonye Kigali nk’inzitizi ku migambi afite yo kwigarurira akarere, asa n’uwananijwe. Uyu mugambi wa Uganda wagerwaho igihe waba ushyizwe mu gihugu kiyobowe n’abantu bashyira inyungu z’abaturage munsi y’izabo bwite. Congo ni igihugu cyategereje igihe kirekire umuntu udashobora kwihanganira abanyamahanga basahura abaturage n’umutungo w’igihugu cye. Ubu isa n’iyamaze kumubona. Perezida Félix Tshisekedi aherutse gutangaza ko bibaye ngombwa yiteguye gufatanya n’abaturanyi mu bya gisirakare kugira ngo imitwe yitwaje intwaro irimburwe mu gihugu cye. Imwe mu ntambwe yatewe ni amasezerano y’ubufatanye yasinywe hagati y’ibihugu byo mu karere, agamije ibikorwa bihuriweho mu gihugu cye byo kurandura indi mitwe yose y’inyeshyamba nyuma y’ibiheruka byagenze neza kuri RNC. Impande zitabiriye inama yabereye i Goma kuva tariki ya 25 kugeza ku ya 26 Ukwakira 2019, zose zashyize umukono ku masezerano y’ubufatanye, usibye Uganda. Iyo nama yahuje abayobozi b’Ingabo ba RDC, u Rwanda, u Burundi ndetse n’abahagarariye US AFRICOM na MONUSCO. Uganda yanze gusinya, ahubwo ihitamo guhimba inkuru mu binyamakuru bitandukanye by’icengezamatwara, igerageza gushinja u Rwanda nk’impamvu yo kwanga gushyira umukono ku masezerano. Byari byoroshye gutahura ayo macenga. RNC, FDLR, RUD Urunana, FLN n’indi itandukanye ikorana na Kampala; bityo nta kuntu yari gushyira umukono ku masezerano agambiriye gukuraho iyo mitwe. Iki ni ikindi gihamya, niba hari ikindi gikenewe mu kugaragaza uruhare rwa Kampala ku kubaho kw’iriya mitwe ibangamiye amahoro. Guseta ibirenge kwa Museveni ku masezerano ya Goma ariko nta ruhare runini byagize mu kudindiza uwo mugambi.  Abayobozi benshi ba FDLR, RUD na FLN bamaze kwicwa cyangwa se batawe muri yombi mu minsi mike ishize. Amagana y’abasirikare bayo bamanitse amaboko, bishyikiriza ibirindiro bya FARDC. Indorerezi zihamya ko RNC ishobora kuzagumaho ariko ku izina gusa. Izakomeza ikorere muri Uganda. Izakomeza kubera ikibazo gikomeye by’umwihariko Abanyarwanda baba muri Uganda. Abantu bayo baba muri Kampala n’ahandi nka Mbarara, bazakomeza gukorana n’inzego z’iperereza zaho mu gushimuta, gutoteza no gukorera iyicarubozo inzirakarengane z’Abanyarwanda. Impamvu ikomeye y’iyi kinamico ni uko, usibye Museveni, izindi nyungu zikomeye muri Uganda zashowe mu kubaho kwa RNC. Ntibazahagarika kugaragaza ko RNC igifite intego, babwira Museveni ibyo ashaka kumva, ko RNC ikiri iturufu ikomeye mu guhindura ubuyozi bwa Kigali. Inzego z’ubutasi zirangajwe imbere n’Urwego rwa Gisirikare rushinzwe Ubutasi, CMI, zikoresha ingengo y’imari nini mu buryo bw’ibanga, itajya ibazwa uko ikoreshwa, RNC ikaba urwitwazo. Benshi mu bagize agatsiko gakikije Museveni bagifitiye inzika u Rwanda bakomora ku ntambara ya Kisangani yabaye mu myaka hafi 20 ishize, ntibazarekura ukwihorera kwabo kutagezweho. Ibyo kimwe n’izindi nyungu bizakomeza guhurira kuri RNC. Ndetse bizakomeza kunyunyuza ku mutungo wa Uganda.

title: Impamvu umwuka mubi hagati y’u Rwanda na Uganda atari ikibazo bwite cya Perezida Kagame na Museveni
content: Kuba itandukaniro ry’amahame rihindurwa ikibazo kiri hagati y’abantu bigaragaza urwego icengezamatwara rigezeho muri aya makimbirane, bigapfukirana icyari itangazamakuru ririmo gutera imbere mu karere, bikangiza icyizere abantu bari bamaze kugirira abafatwaga nk’abavuga ukuri muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Abantu bamwe batekereza ko ikibazo gihari uyu munsi ari ingaruka zatinze kugaragara z’intambara za Kisangani mu myaka ya 1990. Nubwo hashobora kubamo ukuri ko abantu bamwe mu bakuze bo mu bajenerali ba Uganda, ahanini ba hafi ba Salim Saleh, bananiwe kwakira isoni bakojejwe, ibyabaye ubwabyo zari ingaruka z’ikibazo kiri hagati ya Uganda n’u Rwanda. U Rwanda rufite amahame rugenderaho kuri Uganda kandi Kagame ni we yubakiyeho nka Perezida w’u Rwanda. Ni amahame y’u Rwanda nk’igihugu cyigenga, ntabwo giteze guhinduka ikindi gice runaka, noneho kiyobowe na Perezida Yoweri Kaguta Museveni. Ntabwo ari ibiri hagati y’abantu, ni umubano hagati ya za leta – ni ibintu bireba ibihugu. Ubwo RPF yajyaga ku butegetsi mu 1994, Museveni n’abambari be batekereje ko babonye ikindi kibuga cyo kongera ku cyo bari bafite. Museveni yashakaga gutegeka ngo ni nde ujya muri Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ndetse bene wabo bamanukira muri Kigali bashaka amasoko nk’uko babikoraga kandi n’ubu bakibikomeje muri Uganda. Museveni wari umaze gukurirwa inzira ku murima yahise atangira amayeri ye. Yatangiye ibikorwa yibwiraga ko bizatera igitutu ubutegetsi bwa Kigali bugaha rugari ugushaka kwe ko kugenzura u Rwanda, mbere na mbere mu nyungu z’umuryango we. Byanze, yahise agaragaza neza ko afite ubushobozi bwo guteza akaduruvayo kuri icyo gihugu cyari kikiri gito, tuvugishie ukuri, gifite ubuyobozi bumaze igihe gito muri Kigali. Icyo cyari kuba ikiguzi cyo kumwima uburenganzira bwo kugira ijambo rya nyuma ku byemezo bikomeye ndetse no guha rugari umuryango we ngo usahure igihugu uko ubyifuza. Uyu muntu wikunda, ukunda abakoloni bucece nubwo ahorana imvugo zo gushyira imbere Afurika, Museveni yatangiye gahunda yo gucamo ibice agamije gutegeka. Yatangiye guha amabwiriza Pasteur Bizimungu wari Perezida w’u Rwanda. Mu 1996 ubwo berekezaga muri Kaminuza i Butare (ubu ni Kaminuza y’u Rwanda), Museveni yinjije Bizimungu “mu biganiro byo kugambanira Visi Perezida Paul Kagame”, yafataga nk’inzitizi ikomeye ku migambi ye, nk’uko umuntu wari muri perezidansi icyo gihe abihamya. Nyuma yaho mu 1998, Museveni “yakomeje kuvugana” n’uwari Umugaba w’Ingabo z’u Rwanda Kayumba Nyamwasa, hirengagijwe uburyo bwagenwe bukurikizwa mu biganiro hagati y’ibihugu, anemera buhumyi kuba igikoresho cya Museveni mu migambi ye. Ubundi Kayumba yagombaga kumenyesha umuyobozi we ko habayeho kurenga ku migirire yemewe, ari we Minisitiri w’Ingabo. Ntabyo yakoze. Uwo mubano udakurikije amategeko warakomeje, maze Museveni akomeza kureshya Kayumba, amukoresha mu mugambi wa mbatanye mbayobore mu Ngabo z’u Rwanda. Mu gihe Museveni yari yaracuze umugambi wo kugambanira Kagame yabonaga nk’inzitizi ku mugambi we wo kugenzura u Rwanda, mu kuri wari uwo kugambanira u Rwanda kuko intego ye kwari ugushyira ubuyobozi bwarwo munsi y’ubwa Uganda, Museveni by’umwihariko. Kandi koko iyo Kagame aza guhuza na Bizimungu na Kayumba muri ubwo bugambanyi, abo uko ari batatu bagombaga kugezwa mu rukiko ku byaba bikomeye by’ubugambanyi. Rero niba Museveni afitanye ikibazo cye bwite na Kagame ni uko atigeze yemera kugwa mu mutego we wo kwishora mu kugambanira igihugu cye. Niba Kayumba hari uwo yatunga agatoki ku guhunga kwe, ni Museveni. Intambara za Kisangani hagati ya 1999-2000 ni ingaruka za Museveni wakomeje guhatiriza ashaka gucisha bugufi ubuyobozi bw’u Rwanda ngo bugendere ku byemezo bye, byose bigamije inyungu z’umuryango wa Museveni. Mu ntambara ya mbere ya Congo mu 1996 ubwo RPA (yahindutse RDF mu 2002) yageraga Mai-Ndombe, hafi yo kwinjira muri Kinshasa, ishyari rya Museveni ko Kinshasa igiye gufatwa UPDF itabigizemo uruhare ryatumye ategura ibiganiro hagati ya Kabila na Mobutu. Byapfubye ubwo Kabila yangaga kubyitabira. Museveni yumvise acitse intege ubwo RPA yateraga Kinshasa igakuraho Mobutu mu gihe we yari akigerageza gukoranya ibyo biganiro. Yahise yohereza umuhungu we Muhoozi, umugore w’umuvandimwe we n’abandi bo mu muryango we ba hafi,”gushakisha amahirwe y’ubucuruzi”. Museveni yongeye gukorwa ahantu ubwo “Kabila yabangiraga” nk’uko amakuru abivuga. Museveni yakomeje kurakazwa no kuba RPA yafashe Kinshasa hatabayeho ubufasha bwa UPDF. Amakuru avuga ko “Nta musirikare n’umwe wa UPDF wabigizemo uruhare, umuryango we wimwe amahirwe yo gusahura”. Mu ntambara ya kabiri ya Congo, Museveni ntiyigeze yifuza ko RPA yabona intsinzi atayifashije. Ubwo RPA yafataga Kisangani, UPDF yahageze nyuma y’ibyumweru ihita ishinga ibirindiro hafi y’Ikibuga cy’Indege cy’Umujyi wa Bangoka no hafi ya hoteli Wagenia, aho bari bashyize icyicaro gikuru cy’umukiliya wabo Wamba Dia Wamba [Yabaye umunyapolitiki muri RDC]. Nyuma y’igihe gito, batangiye gushaka kugenzura ibintu byise bahasanze. Umwe mu batanze amakuru yagize ati “Batangiye guteza ibibazo bashaka kureba uzayobora icyo gice.” Basabye ko RPA yabaha Ikibuga cy’Indege cya Bangoka, aho yari yashyize ibirindiro byayo. RPA yarabyanze, Museveni yumva bimuriye ahantu. Byaje kuba bibi ubwo yasabaga ko ubuyobozi bw’ibyo birindiro byose buhabwa Salim Saleh. Nabwo RPA yarabyanze, birushaho kumurya. RPA yaje gusaba ko hashyirwaho ubuyobozi buhuriweho bw’ingabo buzayobora ibyo bikorwa, ibiganiro Uganda itari yiteguye kwemera. Ahubwo UPDF yahise itangira kongera abasirikare muri ako gace, bituma ibintu birushaho kuzamba. Igikomeye ni uko impamvu zo kugenzura Kisangani zari zitandukanye cyane hagati y’u Rwanda na Uganda. Mu gihe RPA yatekerezaga ko uwo mujyi ari ahantu heza ho gukurikirana FDLR, Museveni yahafataga nk’umuhora wageza umuryango we mu mbaho na zahabu ngo basahure, kandi ko Saleh yari guhagarikira neza uwo mugambi. Ku wa 19 Ukuboza 2005, Urukiko Mpuzamahanga rw’Ubutabera (ICJ) mu rubanza rwaburanwaga hagati ya Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo na Uganda, rwanzuye ko Uganda yasahuye imitungo isaga miliyari $10. Ikibazo gikomeye muri ibi byose ni aho Museveni yashingiraga ananirwa gutekereza ko RPA itaha UPDF umujyi yarwaniye maze ukajya mu biganza bya Saleh. Muri iyo myumvire se, RPA yaba yari yiteguye gukomeza gushyira ubuzima bwayo mu nzira z’umuriro igana Kinshasa, ngo ihereze Saleh buri mujyi munini n’umuto yafashe ku kiguzi kinini ngo ikunde ifashe umuryango we gusahura? Mbere y’umwaka umwe, uwo Saleh Museveni yashaka ko ategeka RPA yari amaze igihe ahura na Seth Sendashonga i Nairobi, mu mugambi wo kugaba igitero ku Rwanda. Umunyamateka Gerard Prunier mu gitabo “Congo, the Rwandan Genocide, and the making of a continental catastrophe”, kuri paji 366-367 yanditse ati “ku Cyumweru tariki 3 Gicurasi 1998, [Sendashonga] yahuriye i Nairobi na Salim Saleh, umuvandimwe wa Perezida Museveni. Ibintu byari bimeze nabi hagati ya Kampala na Kigali, kandi Salim yari ashyigikiye ko ubutegetsi bushya bwakwinjira mu mukino.” Prunier yemeye ko yabigizemo uruhare, ati “yansabye ubufasha mu kuvugana na Kampala maze ntegura ibiganiro bishoboka”, aho yavugaga ku guhuza Sendashonga na Museveni. Nyuma muri Mata 2001, Winnie Byanyima yaje gushinjwa mu rukiko ko yavuze ko “Perezida Museveni arimo gutoza Interahamwe zakoze Jenoside ngo zitere Guverinoma ya Paul Kagame”, nk’uko ikinyamakuru The New Vision cyabyanditse muri icyo gihe. Mu 2006 nabwo Daily Monitor yatangaje ko Umukuru wa FDLR, Ignace Murwanashyaka “yafatiwe mu Budage mu kwezi gushize ubwo yinjiraga mu Burayi kuri pasiporo ya Uganda.” Mbere y’umwaka umwe, mu 2005, Museveni yagerageje kwinjira ku mupaka wa Gatuna aherekejwe n’imbunda ziremereye agiye i Kigali. Inzego zishinzwe umutekano w’u Rwanda zasabye ko babagabanya hagasigara abaringaniye kimwe n’intwaro zabo, ibyasaga nko kwibutsa ko u Rwanda ari igihugu cyigenga kidashobora kwinjirwamo nk’aho ari urwuri rwa Museveni rw’ahitwa Rwakitura ruhakomereza. Umwe mu batanze amakuru yavuze ko icyifuzo cya Museveni cyo kugenzura u Rwanda gishingiye ku bintu n’ibitekerezo. U Rwanda ni igihugu cy’abasekuruza be nk’uko yabyiyemereye mu ijambo yabwiye Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ya Uganda ko akomoka mu Mutara. Uganda ntabwo yigeze igira ahantu hitwa mu Mutara mu mateka yayo. Kimwe n’undi wese, iyi nkomoko y’abakurambere ni ngombwa kuri we. Nyamara ibitekerezo afite muri Uganda byamuhatiye kwitandukanya n’ubutaka bw’abakurambere be. Kugira ngo abone Ubunya-Uganda bukurikije amategeko, yagombye kwigira Umunyankole. Ikintu gikomeye Museveni yakora ngo akire ukwivuguruza muri we ni uko yabona umuyobozi i Kigali akoreramo. Nyamara kugira ngo bishoboke ni uko yabona umuyobozi bafatanya kugambanira igihugu cye. Niba hari ikibazo gihari cy’umuntu ku giti cye, ni icyo Museveni afitanye na we ubwe. Kagame we ni ikimenyetso cy’amahame u Rwanda ruhagazeho. Abanyarwanda ntibakwemera umuyobozi wese wakwishyira imbere y’ubuyobozi bw’undi muyobozi, yaba Museveni cyangwa undi uwo ari we wese. Ikibazo cyakomeje mu masura atandukanye kuva mu 1994 kandi umuntu yakwitega ko kizakomeza kugeza igihe wenda Museveni ahinduye imikorere ye cyangwa mu Rwanda hakaza undi muyobozi wumva ko ashobora kugambana kandi akabikira. Gusa, umuntu wese utekereza ko ikibazo kiri hagati y’u Rwanda na Uganda ari ukubera ukutumvikana kw’abantu ku giti cyabo arasebanya cyangwa arashaka kwigira nk’aho atumva amayeri ya Museveni yo gushaka gushyira u Rwanda munsi ye, cyangwa adashaka kumva imizi y’ikibazo mu nyungu zidahura z’u Rwanda n’umuryango wa Museveni.

title: Umwami ntiyica hica rubanda
content: Byakomeza kunanirana, urubanza rukagenda rukagera i Bwami. Iyo umwami yashakaga, yagishaga inama ibyegera bye, ubundi akaruca akurikije ibimenyetso yahawe. Rimwe na rimwe umwami yajyaga atanga abagome cyangwa se undi muntu wese wabaga yagomeye ingoma, akicwa. N’ubwo umwami yajyaga afata ku bwe ibyemezo bikomeye ntawe abajije, nta na rimwe yigeze atwara u Rwanda adafite abajyanama. Usibye kuba rwari runini, politiki n’imiyoborere yarwo byari bikomatanye n’urugamba ruhoraho rwo kurinda ubusugire bw’igihugu kandi ni umurimo utoroshye. Kugeza magingo aya ubwo busugire buracyabungwabungwa kuko impamvu nto iyo ariyo yose yatuma bujegajega yageza igihugu mu icuraburindi. Urugero ni irondakoko n’irondakere byubatsweho umusingi wo gutegura Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994. Uko Perezida wa Repubulika ashyirwa ku butegetsi (kuko atorwa) n’abaturage, ni nako abo ashyiraho ngo bamufashe kuzuza inshingano ze ari abaturage baba babashyizeho kuko abaturage ari bo shingiro. Umuyobozi wese uyoboye abaturage neza, akabageza ku iterambere rijyanye n’ibyo bifuza kugeraho aba abikoze mu cyimbo cya Perezida wa Repubulika kuko nicyo abaturage baba baramutoreye. Ni kenshi iyo bavuga ijambo ryabo imbere y’abaturage twumva bashima Perezida wabatumye ngo begere abo baturage. Ukuboko kwe kugaragarira muri bo kuko ni we muyoboro w’imirongo migari y’icyerekezo cy’igihugu. Mu minsi ishize, uturere twatangiye gahunda yo kwegera abaturage mu rwego rwo gukusanya ibyifuzo by’ingingo zazashyirwa imbere mu igenamigambi ya 2020-2021. Ni ukuvuga ko icyerekezo abaturage bazahitamo, kizashingirwaho n’abayobozi batandukanye mu kuzuza neza imihigo bagirana na Perezida wa Repubilika. Ni kenshi rero dusanga iyo mirongo migari iba yatanzwe n’igihugu, urwego Perezida ahagarariye, itubahirijwe. Mu buryo butaziguye, Perezida wabatumye ni we uba yatengushywe ariko mu buryo buziguye ni abaturage batenguhwa mbere y’undi wese. Ibitagenze neza ni twe bigiraho ingaruka mbi mbere ya Perezida wabatumye kandi iyo bigenze neza ni natwe bigirira inyungu mbere ya Perezida wa Repubulika. Abo bayobozi ni indorerwamo zifite ibirahure tuba tugomba kwibonamo. Iyo ubonyemo umuyobozi wowe ntiwibone uba wayirebyemo impindurize cyangwa intambike. Iyo utibonyemo wayifashe neza, ni uko umuyobozi ubonamo aba yirunzemo ubwe, agashyira inyungu ze imbere izawe azakazipfukirana. Ibyo badukorera byose biba bigomba kugira ingaruka nziza cyangwa mbi ariko mbere na mbere kuri twe abaturage. Niyo mpamvu twumva kenshi Nyakubahwa Perezida abashishikariza gushyira umuturage ku isonga, byabananira bagaha umwanya ababishoboye. Ibigenda neza rero, bikwiye kudutera ishema nk’abaturage kuko biduha amanota yo kuba twaratoye umuyobozi w’igihugu uduha ibyo yadusezeranyije binyuze mu mfura aba yaratugeneye ngo zituyobore ku bwe. Hari n’abo twitoramo ubwacu ngo batuyobore. Bamwe bakadukundira abandi bakatugomera. Ibitaragenze neza nabyo biba byagenze nabi kubera impamvu ebyiri cyangwa eshatu. Hari ibituruka kuri ba bayobozi baba barabaye imfura z’umutima muke (nanze kubita ibigwari), hari ibituruka kuri byinshi igihugu kidafiteho ububasha, nk’ubushobozi mu by’umutungo cyangwa se ibituruka ku miterere y’aho igihugu giherereye ariko kandi hari n’ibituruka ku baturage ubwabo harimo kwinangira umutima, imyumvire mibi n’umutima muke no gushyira imbere guhinyuza. Uko byagenda kose, kimwe n’ibyagenda neza, muri ibi nsorejeho biba byagenze nabi nta kidafite uwo cyabazwa mbere y’uko kibazwa Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika. N’ubwo mu mwanya muke agira atega amatwi abaturage, haba mu ngendo agirira hirya no hino mu gihugu cyangwa se binyuze mu itumanaho rigezweho, ibibazo byose yakemura ubwe, bipfa kuba bivuye ku muturage, hari uba yarabirengeje ingohe. Uwo ni umuyobozi uhura cyangwa se wagahuye n’uwo muturage mu buryo bworoshye kuko aricyo yashyiriweho ndetse ahemberwa. Abihutira rero kunenga Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika ku biba bitagenze neza ni abatazi uko inzego zakabaye zikora imirimo zishinzwe. N’abo abaturage batishimira imiyoborere yabo cyangwa se bakora andi makosa (n’iyo abaturage batabimenya) Perezida akabakuraho icyizere aba abikoze mu nyungu z’abaturage. Ubwo ni nk’aho ari abaturage bakanabakuyeho. Ibyo rero Perezida aba yarubatse ngo abaturage babigerekeho amabuye bubake ibirenzeho nta wabisenya tureba. Iyo nzira itazima turwana mu kubaka u Rwanda ikwiye kutubera indi mpamvu yo kudashyigikira uwatuyobora uko yishakiye mu nyungu zitandukanye n’izishyira umuturage ku isonga. Utuyobora neza aba abikoze mu izina rya Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika ariko ubikoze nabi aba ahindanyije izina ry’umukuru w’igihugu wamutumye ni uwo kugawa. Ugaya uwamutumye, yitwaje ko mu Kinyarwanda tuvuga ngo “Zitukwamo nkuru” ariko n’izo nto iyo zitutswe zijye zibuka ko zizize wa muturage kuko “Umwami atica hica rubanda”. Imyenda yanduye imeserwa mu gikari Mu gusoza iyi nyandiko ndisabira ababona ibitagenda mu gihugu cyacu byose bakabivugira ku karubanda: Niko se, n’ubwo mudasobwa zadushyize igorora, twaretse gusobwa tukaba imfura. Kunenga ibitagenda si bibi. Ariko se kuki umuntu uzi Ikinyarwanda neza twamunenga mu Rufaransa cyangwa Urwongereza? Hari uwasubiza ngo wenda nizo ndimi ziba zorohewe nyakunenga ariko simbibonamo ubupfura, noneho cyane cyane iyo hanengwa inzego zashyizweho ngo zibe umuyoboro w’ubuyobozi twihitiyemo. Iki ni igitekerezo bwite cya Ntwari Pie, Kicukiro

title: Impamvu ari inshingano za Museveni gusoza ibyo yatangije
content: Bisaba gutekereza neza gusa. Uruhande rwatangije ibibazo nirwo ruba rufite icyo rushaka kugeraho mu buryo bumwe cyangwa ubundi, rubivanye mu byo rwatangije. Mu gihe umaze kumenya ibi, noneho wakwibaza ngo: Biri mu nyungu za nde guteza umwuka mubi uri hagati ya Uganda n’u Rwanda? Ese ni iki yashakaga kugeraho? Kubona ibisubizo nyabyo kuri iki kibazo ni wo musingi wo kumva neza uko byageze aho bigeze aha, aho umubano urushaho kuba mubi umunsi ku wundi. Abaturage haba muri Uganda no mu Rwanda bagiye bumva byinshi kuri uku gushwana. Bumvise ibirego bitandukanye n’ibisubizo byabyo birimo ‘ibyo kuneka’, urundi ruhande ruvuga ko abaturage barwo bafatwa binyuranyije n’amategeko bagafungwa nabi, ko uruhande rumwe rucumbikiye abashaka guhungabanya umutekano n’amahoro by’urundi n’ibindi. Ubu noneho inzego z’umutekano za Uganda ku mugaragaro ziri gukusanya abaturage b’Abanyarwanda mu gisa n’intambara muri Kisoro, bakabarunda mu bikamyo by’imyanda bakabajyana kubafungira ahantu hatazwi cyangwa bakabajugunya ku mupaka. Si ubwa mbere Uganda isutse umujinya wayo ku Banyarwanda b’abasivili, abaturage badafite na gito bazi muri politiki, guverinoma cyangwa se ibijyanye n’umutekano. Si ubwa mbere Abanyarwanda bafashwe batyo hariya ariko uburyo bibasiwemo vuba aha muri Kisoro byo bigaragaza ikintu kimwe: Uganda iri gukomeza ibibazo. Ku ruhande rw’u Rwanda, rwahagaritse urujya n’uruza rw’amakamyo aremereye yavaga muri Uganda, ku mpamvu igira iti: Ni gute ubucuruzi bwashoboka  umutekano w’abaturage utizewe mu gihe bagiye ku rundi ruhande? Uwo mwanzuro wakurikiye kugira inama ikomeye Abanyarwanda yo kutajya muri Uganda mu rwego rwo kubacungira umutekano. Icyabaye ni uko Abagande baturiye umupaka bari mu bihombo bikomeye kuko batagifite Abanyarwanda bagurishaho ibicuruzwa byabo, bakaba basigaye babicuruza magendu n’ibindi nkabyo. Kuba u Rwanda rwinubira ifatwa nabi ry’abaturage barwo si amashyengo. Ambasade y’u Rwanda i Kampala inshuro nyinshi yahaye inzego zirimo urushinzwe Ubutasi mu Gisirikare (CMI) n’urushinzwe Umutekano w’imbere mu Gihugu (ISO) , amazina y’abashimuswe, abafunzwe nta rubanza imiryango yabo idaheruka guca iryera. Ni abantu bari bafite imiryango, inshuti n’abavandimwe. Hejuru y’itotezwa bakorewe n’inzego z’ubutasi, polisi cyangwa igisirikare abandi bagiye bagirirwa nabi n’abashinzwe amagereza muri Uganda. Ubugome bwabo bo mu magereza bugaragarira mu bikorwa nko gutanga Abanyarwanda bafunzwe ngo bajye gukora imirimo imeze nk’uburetwa mu mirima y’abakire bo muri Uganda. None ni nde watumye bigera aha hose? Ni nde watumye twisanga muri uyu mwanda? Kubona igisubizo birasaba nanone kwibaza: Ni bande bakekaga ko bazungukira muri aya makimbirane ari hagati y’ibihugu byombi? Dukoresheje uburyo bworoshye, turahera ku rundi ruhande, ni nde udafite inyungu muri uku kurebana ay’ingwe? Reka duhere ku Rwanda. Imbaraga zarwo zose ziri ku kwiyubaka no kongera kunga ubumwe. U Rwanda rurajwe ishinga no kubaka inganda, ibyo gutwara abantu n’ibintu mu ndege, ubukerarugendo, ubukungu bushingiye ku ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho n’ibindi nk’ibyo. Muri make, nta mwanya rufite w’amakimbirane. U Rwanda rufite umutungo kamere ariko ni muke nawo rukoresha mu guteza imbere imibereho myiza y’abarutuye aho kuwumarira mu ntambara. Ntabwo rukora ku nyanja, kubaho kwarwo rubikesha umubano mwiza n’abaturanyi ari naho haca imihanda inyuzwamo ibyo rujyana hanze n’ibyo ruvanayo. Nta mpamvu n’imwe u Rwanda rufite mu gutangiza amakimbirane n’uwo ari we wese. Icyakora ibyo ntibivuze ko rudashobora guhaguruka ngo rwihagarareho mu gihe rwenderejwe. Iki si igihugu cyicara ngo giterere agati mu ryinyo mu gihe umuturanyi ari gukorana n’imitwe yamaze kugitangazaho intambara. Si igihugu kandi cyicara ngo gituze mu gihe inzego z’umutekano z’umuturanyi ziri kwibasira abaturage bacyo, zibakorera iyicarubozo ndengakamere. None se kuki uyu muturanyi  yahisemo gukomeza gukora ibi bintu? Ibi biratujyana ku ihurizo rya kabiri muri bwa buryo bwacu bwo kureba ikibazo mu buryo bworoshye. Uganda cyangwa se umutegetsi wayo Perezida Yoweri Museveni kuva kera yigaragaje nk’ufite inyungu mu guteza umutekano muke mu Rwanda. Mu koroshya ibintu, uwo mugabo ashaka ko ubutegetsi bw’i Kigali buhinduka. Wenda Umunyarwanda cyangwa Umugande utabizi ni uwavutse guhera mu myaka icumi ishize. Museveni ntasiba kugaragaza impamvu adaha agahenge Kigali. Kiiza Besigye utavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi bwa Uganda yabisobanuye neza mu mashusho aherutse gusakara kuri YouTube aho yagaragaje imyitwarire ya Museveni yo kwishyira hejuru kugeza aho afata Abagande bose nk’aho igihugu ari urugo rwe, akabita ‘abuzukuru’ n’ibindi. Impuguke zakunze kuvuga ko “atekereza ko ari nako yakabaye abigenza ku Rwanda.” Museveni akomeza gutekereza  ko kuba  Perezida w’u Rwanda yarigeze kuba mu Gisirikare cya Uganda, agomba guhora munsi y’amategeko ya Museveni! Ni ibintu benshi bemeza ko birenze ukwemera. Umuyobozi w’u Rwanda yagiye mu gisirikare cya Uganda ku mpamvu ze kimwe n’abandi Banyarwanda bose bemeye kumena amaraso bakagira uruhare mu ntsinzi za Museveni. Ubwo abo Banyarwanda bafataga umwanzuro wo kuva muri Uganda, nicyo gihe Museveni yagombaga kuba yaramenye ko batari ‘abahungu be’ nkuko yabitekerezaga. Ni abagabo barwaniraga kubohora igihugu cyabo. Ubwo babigenzaga gutya rero, buri muyobozi wese yakabaye yarabonye ko bagiye mu buyobozi bw’igihugu kigenga kidahuye n’ubukoloni Museveni yatekerezaga. Yakomeje kwivanga mu mikorere y’ikindi gihugu. Ubwo Kigali yarambirwaga iyo myitwarire ikatura ikabivuga yemye iti “utwubahe natwe tukubahe, ubyange natwe tubyange!” umuyobozi wa Uganda byaramurakaje cyane. Birazwi ko intambara za Kisangani aho Abanyarwanda bari baragiye kurwana n’imitwe yasize ikoze Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi bikarangira banarwaniyeyo na Uganda inshuro eshatu, ni uko ingabo za Uganda zatekerezaga ko zizakomeza guha amabwiriza u Rwanda. Ibyo byarushijeho gutuma Museveni yijundika ubuyobozi bw’u Rwanda ariko birangira Ingabo za Uganda ari zo zihatakarije cyane. Bivugwa ko imigambi ya Museveni yo kwifashisha Kayumba Nyamwasa na RNC ye mu guteza umutekano muke ku Rwanda yacuzwe nyuma yo gutsindwa uruhenu i Kisangani. Uko gutsindwa gushobora kuba kwarakoze mu maso umutegetsi wa Uganda kugeza ubwo anahitamo gukorana n’imitwe yakoze Jenoside nka FDLR nkuko inyandiko zemewe z’impuguke za Loni zasohotse umwaka ushize zibigaragaza. Muri make rero, buri bushyamirane bwagiye buvuka hagati ya Uganda n’u Rwanda bwatangizwaga na Perezida Museveni. Akenshi iyo abantu bakurikiye ibica kuri za televiziyo wumva bavuga ngo “Museveni na Kagame bakwiriye gushyira ibyo bapfa ku ruhande, ibibazo bigakemuka” ariko  ikibazo bakabaye bibaza ni : Ni nde watangije ibibazo? Ni kimwe n’iyo Abagande bavuze ngo ‘ikibazo cy’ifungwa ry’umupaka” cyangwa iyo bavuga ngo ubucuruzi bwabo bumeze nabi kuko abanyarwanda batacyemererwa kwambuka. Ni nde watangije ibi byose? Igisubizo ni uko  ari na we ufite inshingano zo kubisoza.

title: Kurekura Abanyarwanda icyenda b’inzirakarengane ni intangiriro nziza ariko Museveni akeneye gukora ibirenzeho
content: Basabye Uganda kutarekura gusa Abanyarwanda bafungiye muri Gereza n’inzu z’ibanga za gisirikare ziri muri icyo gihugu ahubwo no kuzuza ibyo biyemeje mu masezerano ya Luanda ibihugu byombi byashyizeho umukono muri Kanama 2019, by’umwihariko ingingo ivuga ko Uganda igomba guhagarika gushyigikira imitwe y’iterabwoba igambiriye guhungabanya u Rwanda. Nyuma y’irekurwa ry’aba Banyarwanda icyenda, Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga, Amb. Nduhungirehe Olivier, yavuze ko Uganda ikwiye kurekura amagana y’Abanyarwanda bagifungiyeyo no guhagarika gukomeza gushyigikira imitwe yitwaje intwaro irwanya u Rwanda. Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda muri Uganda, Frank Mugambage, yashimangiye ubu butumwa mu kiganiro yagiranye n’itangazamakuru ku wa 8 Mutarama 2020, asaba Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga wa Uganda, Sam Kutesa, ko n’abandi barekurwa. Ikintu gikomeje kugaruka muri iri cengezamatwari riyobya rinyuzwa mu bitangazamakuru bya Uganda ni uko igihe cyose Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yakomeje kugaragaza ibi bibazo n’ibindi bisa bireba umubano warwo na Uganda, rwabikoze mu mucyo ku buryo busesuye. Mu kiganiro n’itangazamakuru Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga wa Uganda, Sam Kutesa, yashatse kuyobya uburari, ashaka ku gutsimbarara ko Abanyarwanda nabo atari shyashya kandi ko kubarekura ari umwanzuro wafashwe ku nyungu za politiki. Mu by’ukuri nk’Umunyamategeko, Minisitiri Kutesa yakagombye kuba yari abizi ko nta guverinoma cyangwa ubucamanza bufunga abantu imyaka itatu nta kuburanishwa niba koko atari ibya politiki. Uretse ko n’abahohotewe muri iki kibazo bari abaturage b’ikindi gihugu b’inzirakarengane badafite aho bahuriye na politiki. Ikirenze kuri ibyo Minisitiri ku bwende yavanze ikibazo asaba u Rwanda narwo kugira icyo rukora ku ruhande rwarwo. Nta na kimwe gihari cyo kugirwamo uruhare, mu gihe u Rwanda rutigeze rufunga Umunya-Uganda n’umwe uretse no kuba rwabakorera iyicarubozo, baracyakora ibikorwa byabo hano nta muntu n’umwe ubabangamiye. Nibyo koko Uganda buri gihe yagiye ishaka gushyiraho urujijo, igerageza gushyira ubu bushyamirane mu ishusho y’umwanzuro wa Guverinoma y’u Rwanda wo kugira inama abaturage bayo kutajya muri Uganda aho CMI yabatangijeho ibihe byo kubahiga. Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru cyabereye i Kigali ku wa 8 Mutarama 2020, Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga, Dr Vincent Biruta, yatangaje ko igihe guverinoma izaba yanyuzwe n’uko Uganda yahagaritse gufunga no gukorera iyicarubozo inzirakarengane z’Abanyarwanda iki cyemezo kizakurwaho. Ku rundi ruhande muri Kampala, Ambasaderi w’u Rwanda Mugambage Frank, mu kiganiro n’itangazamakuru cyateguwe na Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga wa Uganda yasabye ubuyobozi bwa Uganda gukemura ikibazo cy’imitwe y’iterabwoba ifashwa ikanashyigikirwa n’ubutegetsi bwa Kampala. Nk’uko nabigaragaje mbere ibi si bishya ku Rwanda, guhangana n’ibibazo nk’ibi ndetse no gukorana na buri wese wari witeguye gufasha kubikemura. Mu myaka 25 ishize, igihugu cyahuye n’ibibazo bisa nk’ibi ndetse n’ibibirenze ahanini bitewe na Guverinoma ya Uganda. Nibyo koko hari inzira byakemuwemo zishobora gufasha guharura inzira niba koko Uganda ikomeje mu gushaka igisubizo kirambye. Ku wa 4 Nyakanga 2001, ikinyamakuru cya Leta ya Uganda ‘New Vision’ cyasohoye inkuru ku rupapuro rubanza igira iti ‘Kigali yaburiye Cols Mande, Kyakabale”, nyuma y’umwaka abasirikare bakuru ba Uganda bavuye mu gihugu, bahunze itotezwa rya guverinoma bambuka baza mu Rwanda. Isubira mu itangazo ryakorewe i Kigali, The New Vision yarongeye itangaza ko Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yemeye kwinjira kw’aba basirikare. Mu by’ukuri ibyavuzwe n’u Rwanda byashimangiraga ko abagambanyi bo muri UPDF bari kwemererwa kuguma mu gihugu ari uko bemeye ko batazajya mu bikorwa na bimwe bya politiki birwanya igihugu cyabo cy’amavuko. Afurika y’Epfo yakoze ibisa n’ibyo byatangiye kubahirizwa kuva tariki ya 1 Mutarama 2020 ariko n’ubundi u Rwanda rwari rwarerekanye inzira mu myaka hafi 20 ishize. Abayobozi bo muri Uganda bari barashishikarijwe gusaba ubuhungiro mu Rwanda, nyuma y’uko agatsiko k’abahoze ari abasirikare b’u Rwanda, bafashijwe n’abayobozi b’i Kampala kwinjira muri Uganda aho batangirije ibikorwa byo guhungabanya u Rwanda, bafashijwe na CMI n’izindi nzego zishinzwe umutekano mu gihugu. Gusa ubwo abasirikare ba UPDF bivumburaga, urukweto rwari ku rundi ruhande na Kampala yasabwe guhagarika ubufasha yageneraga abo basirikare b’Abanyarwanda badafite ubwenge ndetse ibashakira n’ibindi bihugu bibakira, nk’uko u Rwanda rwari rwarabikoze ku basirikare ba Uganda bari barahunze. U Rwanda nta mutwe n’umwe w’Abanya-Uganda wifuza guhungabanya igihugu cyabo rufite ku butaka bwarwo, nta n’uwo rwigeze. N’abagerageje gushaka ubuhungiro hano, mu myaka nka 20 ishize ntibigeze bahamara igihe kuko Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yahise ako kanya ibashakira uko boherezwa i Burayi. Ni ku bw’ibyo, igihe kigeze ngo Guverinoma ya Uganda ntihagarike gusa ubufasha n’inkunga yageneraga RNC na FDLR, n’indi mitwe y’iterabwoba igambiriye gutera u Rwanda ahubwo ishake n’ibindi bihugu byakwimurirwamo abayobozi bayo, bahawe uburenganzira bwo gukoresha ubutaka bwabyo mu gutoza no gutegura abahoze batera u Rwanda, nk’uko byagenze vuba aha mu Ukwakira 2019 mu Kinigi, mu Karere ka Musanze aho abantu 14 b’inzirakarengane bishwe.

title: Impamvu umwuka mubi hagati y’u Rwanda na Uganda atari ikibazo bwite cya Perezida Kagame na Museveni
content: Kuba itandukaniro ry’amahame rihindurwa ikibazo kiri hagati y’abantu bigaragaza urwego icengezamatwara rigezeho muri aya makimbirane, bigapfukirana icyari itangazamakuru ririmo gutera imbere mu karere, bikangiza icyizere abantu bari bamaze kugirira abafatwaga nk’abavuga ukuri muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba. Abantu bamwe batekereza ko ikibazo gihari uyu munsi ari ingaruka zatinze kugaragara z’intambara za Kisangani mu myaka ya 1990. Nubwo hashobora kubamo ukuri ko abantu bamwe mu bakuze bo mu bajenerali ba Uganda, ahanini ba hafi ba Salim Saleh, bananiwe kwakira isoni bakojejwe, ibyabaye ubwabyo zari ingaruka z’ikibazo kiri hagati ya Uganda n’u Rwanda. U Rwanda rufite amahame rugenderaho kuri Uganda kandi Kagame ni we yubakiyeho nka Perezida w’u Rwanda. Ni amahame y’u Rwanda nk’igihugu cyigenga, ntabwo giteze guhinduka ikindi gice runaka, noneho kiyobowe na Perezida Yoweri Kaguta Museveni. Ntabwo ari ibiri hagati y’abantu, ni umubano hagati ya za leta – ni ibintu bireba ibihugu. Ubwo RPF yajyaga ku butegetsi mu 1994, Museveni n’abambari be batekereje ko babonye ikindi kibuga cyo kongera ku cyo bari bafite. Museveni yashakaga gutegeka ngo ni nde ujya muri Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ndetse bene wabo bamanukira muri Kigali bashaka amasoko nk’uko babikoraga kandi n’ubu bakibikomeje muri Uganda. Museveni wari umaze gukurirwa inzira ku murima yahise atangira amayeri ye. Yatangiye ibikorwa yibwiraga ko bizatera igitutu ubutegetsi bwa Kigali bugaha rugari ugushaka kwe ko kugenzura u Rwanda, mbere na mbere mu nyungu z’umuryango we. Byanze, yahise agaragaza neza ko afite ubushobozi bwo guteza akaduruvayo kuri icyo gihugu cyari kikiri gito, tuvugishie ukuri, gifite ubuyobozi bumaze igihe gito muri Kigali. Icyo cyari kuba ikiguzi cyo kumwima uburenganzira bwo kugira ijambo rya nyuma ku byemezo bikomeye ndetse no guha rugari umuryango we ngo usahure igihugu uko ubyifuza. Uyu muntu wikunda, ukunda abakoloni bucece nubwo ahorana imvugo zo gushyira imbere Afurika, Museveni yatangiye gahunda yo gucamo ibice agamije gutegeka. Yatangiye guha amabwiriza Pasteur Bizimungu wari Perezida w’u Rwanda. Mu 1996 ubwo berekezaga muri Kaminuza i Butare (ubu ni Kaminuza y’u Rwanda), Museveni yinjije Bizimungu “mu biganiro byo kugambanira Visi Perezida Paul Kagame”, yafataga nk’inzitizi ikomeye ku migambi ye, nk’uko umuntu wari muri perezidansi icyo gihe abihamya. Nyuma yaho mu 1998, Museveni “yakomeje kuvugana” n’uwari Umugaba w’Ingabo z’u Rwanda Kayumba Nyamwasa, hirengagijwe uburyo bwagenwe bukurikizwa mu biganiro hagati y’ibihugu, anemera buhumyi kuba igikoresho cya Museveni mu migambi ye. Ubundi Kayumba yagombaga kumenyesha umuyobozi we ko habayeho kurenga ku migirire yemewe, ari we Minisitiri w’Ingabo. Ntabyo yakoze. Uwo mubano udakurikije amategeko warakomeje, maze Museveni akomeza kureshya Kayumba, amukoresha mu mugambi wa mbatanye mbayobore mu Ngabo z’u Rwanda. Mu gihe Museveni yari yaracuze umugambi wo kugambanira Kagame yabonaga nk’inzitizi ku mugambi we wo kugenzura u Rwanda, mu kuri wari uwo kugambanira u Rwanda kuko intego ye kwari ugushyira ubuyobozi bwarwo munsi y’ubwa Uganda, Museveni by’umwihariko. Kandi koko iyo Kagame aza guhuza na Bizimungu na Kayumba muri ubwo bugambanyi, abo uko ari batatu bagombaga kugezwa mu rukiko ku byaba bikomeye by’ubugambanyi. Rero niba Museveni afitanye ikibazo cye bwite na Kagame ni uko atigeze yemera kugwa mu mutego we wo kwishora mu kugambanira igihugu cye. Niba Kayumba hari uwo yatunga agatoki ku guhunga kwe, ni Museveni. Intambara za Kisangani hagati ya 1999-2000 ni ingaruka za Museveni wakomeje guhatiriza ashaka gucisha bugufi ubuyobozi bw’u Rwanda ngo bugendere ku byemezo bye, byose bigamije inyungu z’umuryango wa Museveni. Mu ntambara ya mbere ya Congo mu 1996 ubwo RPA (yahindutse RDF mu 2002) yageraga Mai-Ndombe, hafi yo kwinjira muri Kinshasa, ishyari rya Museveni ko Kinshasa igiye gufatwa UPDF itabigizemo uruhare ryatumye ategura ibiganiro hagati ya Kabila na Mobutu. Byapfubye ubwo Kabila yangaga kubyitabira. Museveni yumvise acitse intege ubwo RPA yateraga Kinshasa igakuraho Mobutu mu gihe we yari akigerageza gukoranya ibyo biganiro. Yahise yohereza umuhungu we Muhoozi, umugore w’umuvandimwe we n’abandi bo mu muryango we ba hafi,”gushakisha amahirwe y’ubucuruzi”. Museveni yongeye gukorwa ahantu ubwo “Kabila yabangiraga” nk’uko amakuru abivuga. Museveni yakomeje kurakazwa no kuba RPA yafashe Kinshasa hatabayeho ubufasha bwa UPDF. Amakuru avuga ko “Nta musirikare n’umwe wa UPDF wabigizemo uruhare, umuryango we wimwe amahirwe yo gusahura”. Mu ntambara ya kabiri ya Congo, Museveni ntiyigeze yifuza ko RPA yabona intsinzi atayifashije. Ubwo RPA yafataga Kisangani, UPDF yahageze nyuma y’ibyumweru ihita ishinga ibirindiro hafi y’Ikibuga cy’Indege cy’Umujyi wa Bangoka no hafi ya hoteli Wagenia, aho bari bashyize icyicaro gikuru cy’umukiliya wabo Wamba Dia Wamba [Yabaye umunyapolitiki muri RDC]. Nyuma y’igihe gito, batangiye gushaka kugenzura ibintu byise bahasanze. Umwe mu batanze amakuru yagize ati “Batangiye guteza ibibazo bashaka kureba uzayobora icyo gice.” Basabye ko RPA yabaha Ikibuga cy’Indege cya Bangoka, aho yari yashyize ibirindiro byayo. RPA yarabyanze, Museveni yumva bimuriye ahantu. Byaje kuba bibi ubwo yasabaga ko ubuyobozi bw’ibyo birindiro byose buhabwa Salim Saleh. Nabwo RPA yarabyanze, birushaho kumurya. RPA yaje gusaba ko hashyirwaho ubuyobozi buhuriweho bw’ingabo buzayobora ibyo bikorwa, ibiganiro Uganda itari yiteguye kwemera. Ahubwo UPDF yahise itangira kongera abasirikare muri ako gace, bituma ibintu birushaho kuzamba. Igikomeye ni uko impamvu zo kugenzura Kisangani zari zitandukanye cyane hagati y’u Rwanda na Uganda. Mu gihe RPA yatekerezaga ko uwo mujyi ari ahantu heza ho gukurikirana FDLR, Museveni yahafataga nk’umuhora wageza umuryango we mu mbaho na zahabu ngo basahure, kandi ko Saleh yari guhagarikira neza uwo mugambi. Ku wa 19 Ukuboza 2005, Urukiko Mpuzamahanga rw’Ubutabera (ICJ) mu rubanza rwaburanwaga hagati ya Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo na Uganda, rwanzuye ko Uganda yasahuye imitungo isaga miliyari $10. Ikibazo gikomeye muri ibi byose ni aho Museveni yashingiraga ananirwa gutekereza ko RPA itaha UPDF umujyi yarwaniye maze ukajya mu biganza bya Saleh. Muri iyo myumvire se, RPA yaba yari yiteguye gukomeza gushyira ubuzima bwayo mu nzira z’umuriro igana Kinshasa, ngo ihereze Saleh buri mujyi munini n’umuto yafashe ku kiguzi kinini ngo ikunde ifashe umuryango we gusahura? Mbere y’umwaka umwe, uwo Saleh Museveni yashaka ko ategeka RPA yari amaze igihe ahura na Seth Sendashonga i Nairobi, mu mugambi wo kugaba igitero ku Rwanda. Umunyamateka Gerard Prunier mu gitabo “Congo, the Rwandan Genocide, and the making of a continental catastrophe”, kuri paji 366-367 yanditse ati “ku Cyumweru tariki 3 Gicurasi 1998, [Sendashonga] yahuriye i Nairobi na Salim Saleh, umuvandimwe wa Perezida Museveni. Ibintu byari bimeze nabi hagati ya Kampala na Kigali, kandi Salim yari ashyigikiye ko ubutegetsi bushya bwakwinjira mu mukino.” Prunier yemeye ko yabigizemo uruhare, ati “yansabye ubufasha mu kuvugana na Kampala maze ntegura ibiganiro bishoboka”, aho yavugaga ku guhuza Sendashonga na Museveni. Nyuma muri Mata 2001, Winnie Byanyima yaje gushinjwa mu rukiko ko yavuze ko “Perezida Museveni arimo gutoza Interahamwe zakoze Jenoside ngo zitere Guverinoma ya Paul Kagame”, nk’uko ikinyamakuru The New Vision cyabyanditse muri icyo gihe. Mu 2006 nabwo Daily Monitor yatangaje ko Umukuru wa FDLR, Ignace Murwanashyaka “yafatiwe mu Budage mu kwezi gushize ubwo yinjiraga mu Burayi kuri pasiporo ya Uganda.” Mbere y’umwaka umwe, mu 2005, Museveni yagerageje kwinjira ku mupaka wa Gatuna aherekejwe n’imbunda ziremereye agiye i Kigali. Inzego zishinzwe umutekano w’u Rwanda zasabye ko babagabanya hagasigara abaringaniye kimwe n’intwaro zabo, ibyasaga nko kwibutsa ko u Rwanda ari igihugu cyigenga kidashobora kwinjirwamo nk’aho ari urwuri rwa Museveni rw’ahitwa Rwakitura ruhakomereza. Umwe mu batanze amakuru yavuze ko icyifuzo cya Museveni cyo kugenzura u Rwanda gishingiye ku bintu n’ibitekerezo. U Rwanda ni igihugu cy’abasekuruza be nk’uko yabyiyemereye mu ijambo yabwiye Inteko Ishinga Amategeko ya Uganda ko akomoka mu Mutara. Uganda ntabwo yigeze igira ahantu hitwa mu Mutara mu mateka yayo. Kimwe n’undi wese, iyi nkomoko y’abakurambere ni ngombwa kuri we. Nyamara ibitekerezo afite muri Uganda byamuhatiye kwitandukanya n’ubutaka bw’abakurambere be. Kugira ngo abone Ubunya-Uganda bukurikije amategeko, yagombye kwigira Umunyankole. Ikintu gikomeye Museveni yakora ngo akire ukwivuguruza muri we ni uko yabona umuyobozi i Kigali akoreramo. Nyamara kugira ngo bishoboke ni uko yabona umuyobozi bafatanya kugambanira igihugu cye. Niba hari ikibazo gihari cy’umuntu ku giti cye, ni icyo Museveni afitanye na we ubwe. Kagame we ni ikimenyetso cy’amahame u Rwanda ruhagazeho. Abanyarwanda ntibakwemera umuyobozi wese wakwishyira imbere y’ubuyobozi bw’undi muyobozi, yaba Museveni cyangwa undi uwo ari we wese. Ikibazo cyakomeje mu masura atandukanye kuva mu 1994 kandi umuntu yakwitega ko kizakomeza kugeza igihe wenda Museveni ahinduye imikorere ye cyangwa mu Rwanda hakaza undi muyobozi wumva ko ashobora kugambana kandi akabikira. Gusa, umuntu wese utekereza ko ikibazo kiri hagati y’u Rwanda na Uganda ari ukubera ukutumvikana kw’abantu ku giti cyabo arasebanya cyangwa arashaka kwigira nk’aho atumva amayeri ya Museveni yo gushaka gushyira u Rwanda munsi ye, cyangwa adashaka kumva imizi y’ikibazo mu nyungu zidahura z’u Rwanda n’umuryango wa Museveni.
